title: Curry Mac and Beef With Pastrami
ingredients: 200 g macaroni | 1 teaspoon cornstarch | 100 g double cream | 1 onion flakes | 1 teaspoon curry paste | 200 g ground beef ( optional ) or 200 g ground lamb ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon breadcrumbs
instructions: Boil water and add the macaroni. Remove shell and cook macaroni until it is tender but not soft so that it flakes easily when cooked. Drain and rinse the macaroni. Meanwhile in a saucepan combine the cornstarch with a quarter cup of the cream and heat gently until the oil is at least half gone. Drain the macaroni well and return to the cooking pot. While the macaroni is cooking combine the onion flakes, curry paste, ground beef, bread crumbs and the rest of the cream. Add the cornstarch mixture and cook until heated through. Add the cooked macaroni, mix thoroughly and cook until heated through serve hot.

title: Creamy Cashew Dip
ingredients: 6 -8 cups of chopped assorted raw nuts | 24 ounces jar salsa | vegetables, chopped ( of your choice )
instructions: In large bowl, mix all ingredients in microwave safe dish. Microwave on high 20 seconds, stir, then microwave again 1 - 2 minutes or until nut bits are golden. Store in airtight container.

instructions: Soak escarole in large pot of water 2 hours until softened. Drain. Remove tough outer leaves from leaves with scissors. Rinse and drain. Put in food processor with all remaining ingredients except crackers if using.

title: Lemon Rice Pilaf

instructions: Place rice in a bowl, season with salt to taste. Sprinkle the lemon zest over the rice. Sauté rice over medium to high heat just to bring out the aroma and make the rice sizzling. Watch it carefully. Once the rice starts to wilt, pour in some water. Cover, turn heat to low, and steam until rice is tender about 15 minutes.

title: Honey Orange Kebabs
ingredients: 2 cups loosely packed coarsely chopped cooked hamburger | 3/4 cup freshly squeezed orange juice | 1/4 cup honey | 1 1/8 teaspoons ground rosemary ( fresh leaves ) or 1 1/8 teaspoons dried rosemary leaves | 1 1/2 teaspoons nonstick cooking spray | 1 egg yolk | 1 tablespoon honey | 2 kaffir lime leaves, bruised in a mortar and then crushed in a mortar | 1/4 cup honey | 2 tablespoons orange juice
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients, stirring well to blend. Divide mixture into 24 equal portions. Mix egg yolk and honey in a small bowl. Heat grill to high. Prepare barbecue or grill pan by spraying cooking spray on one side of each pan and heating over highest heat until hot, about 3 minutes. Grill kebabs for about 3 minutes per side for medium. Serve with honey sauce.

title: Romaine Rolls
ingredients: 1 cup cake flour | 8 romaine lettuce leaves, washed
instructions: Prepare the flour as directed on the package for rolling. When ready roll the rolls starting on one leaf and the other. Cut the center of each roll and remove the core. Place the rolls on a greased baking tray and bake at 400 degrees f for 15 - 20 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Spinach Pie
ingredients: 2 packages frozen spinach | 2 cups frozen petite cut peaches | 1 loaf frozen crusty cornbread | 1 container frozen whipped topping, thawed
instructions: Thaw frozen spinach, squeeze dry, and pat dry with paper towels. In a large bowl, combine the spinach, peaches, and corn bread mix and cheese sauce mix well just until well coated. Spoon into a pie dish and bake at 350 degrees f for about 20 minutes, or until heated through. Serve hot with a dollop of whip cream.

Random Ingredients: pine nut,balsamic vinegar,maple syrup,red potato,cardamom pod,hot water

ingredients: 1 lb red potatoes | 2/3 cup hot water | 3 tablespoons maple syrup | 1 teaspoon balsamic vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom pod | 1/2 cup pine nuts, toasted
instructions: Cut potatoes into 1 inch cubes. Place in a saucepan and cover with boiling water. Reduce heat, partially cover, and simmer until tender but still firm, approximately 20 minutes. Drain. In a small bowl, mix hot water, maple syrup, vinegar and cardamom. Dip potato cubes over the hot water and in the syrup mixture. Sprinkle with toasted pine nuts.

title: Tomato and Parsley Sponge Pudding
ingredients: 100 g sun-dried tomatoes, rinsed, drained and finely chopped | 100 g caster sugar | 3 egg whites | 1 teaspoon chili oil | 1 1/2 teaspoons baking powder | 30 g flat leaf parsley, chopped
instructions: Spoon the tomatoes into a bowl and add the sugar, egg whites and oil. Mix gently until firm and pour into an 8 cup capacity microwave safe bowl. Sprinkle with baking powder and scatter the parsley over the top. Microwave on high for 20 minutes. Leave for 5 minutes before turning out onto an oven tray. Serve cold or warm with a dollop of yoghurt, extra salsa, creme fraiche or ice cream.

title: The Best Chicken Ever - OAMc
ingredients: 1 beef roast, sliced | 1 box farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta | 1 tablespoon oil | 2 tablespoons butterscotch chips | 1/4 cup maple syrup | 1 jar butterscotch chips
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions.

Random Ingredients: straw mushroom,fireball whiskey,flat leaf parsley,cooking oil,double cream
title: Potted Mushrooms and Sweet Potatoes
ingredients: 600 g fresh flat-leaf parsley, finely chopped | 100 g smoked wood-smoked ham or 100 g smoked pork, finely diced | 50 ml sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, well drained and finely chopped finely | 2 tablespoons cooking oil | 1/2 cup double cream, at room temperature | 500 g fresh mushrooms ( shiitake, oyster, and red currant will also work, or button mushrooms )
instructions: Preheat barbecue to high. Place a large bowl, preferably non stick, into the oven to pre heat the barbecue. Place the parsley in a bowl. Add the ham or pork and mix well. Brush the base and sides of an 8 x 8 baking dish with oil. Spoon half of the mixture into the baking dish, placing the mushrooms, flat leaf parsley, and pork on top, pressing them firmly into the mixture. Sprinkle with sun dried tomatoes and stir gently to combine. Pour cream evenly over the top, or use a funnel to pour some cream evenly over the top. Place in the oven and cook until the liquid is reduced about 20 minutes. Turn off the oven, leave the pot in the oven for 5 - 10 minutes or longer if very large, until the top is crusty.

title: Cayenne Raisins
ingredients: 2 cups dark seedless raisins | 1/2 teaspoon ground cayenne ( or more )
instructions: Place raisins in a small bowl, pour boiling water over and cover. Let raisins stand for 15 minutes. Drain. Sprinkle with cayenne. Cool. Store in a sealed container. To serve, heat in the microwave.

title: Red Chile Snack Cups
ingredients: 1 can or bottle refrigerated biscuit, crushed | 1 can or bottle new mexico chile powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Grease the bottom and sides of a muffin tin or line with paper mini muffin cases. Fill each biscuit cup about halfway full with crushed biscuit and reshape into a circle 1 inch in diameter around the edges. Bake in the preheated oven until lightly browned, 6 to 10 minutes.

title: Homemade Clotted Dumplings
ingredients: 1 cup nonfat sour cream, or more to taste | 1 tablespoon superfine sugar | 1/4 teaspoon ground allspice
instructions: To make sour cream, stir together sour cream, sugar, and allspice in a bowl. Let stand for several hours to develop sour cream flavor.

title: Tarragon Pear Spread
ingredients: 1 pears ( about 4 pounds ) | 2 tablespoons fresh tarragon, leaves only | 1 cup ponzu sauce | parmigiano-reggiano cheese, shaved
instructions: Preheat the broiler. Cut the pears crosswise into slices about 2/3 inch thick. Place the bread slices under the broiler until golden brown and bubbly, 2 to 3 minutes.

title: Lime Cider Cheese Bites
ingredients: 8 ounces cream cheese | 1/2 cup shallot, minced | 2 tablespoons pesto sauce | 1/4 cup apple juice | 1/4 cup cider vinegar | 1/8 teaspoon greek oregano | 1/8 cup orange juice ( or 2 teaspoons lime grated zest ) | 2 -3 drops sour cream, to taste ( or as needed for a milder dip )
instructions: Combine filling ingredients. Cover and chill for at least 1 hour. Roll into balls, then dip in sauce. To serve, dip in sour cream. Note, if desired, serve as is.

title: Coconut Cholent Pasta

instructions: Cook ziti according to your favourite packet instructions using some of the cornstarch water in a pot. title: Papas-Mango-Cheese Applesauce

title: Baked Limas Bean Snack

instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Combine the lima beans, garam masala, water, and taco seasoning in a baking dish. Bake in the preheated oven for 15 minutes. Remove and sprinkle with more garam masala.

instructions: Preheat the oven to 500 degrees. Place the mushrooms on a baking sheet. Place in the oven and bake 10 to 12 minutes, until the mushrooms sweat. instructions: Cook diced tomatoes or plum tomatoes in boiling salted water for 2 minutes, then drain and reserve tomato liquid. instructions: Preheat oven to spray an 11 x 7 baking dish with nonstick spray. In a small bowl, combine enchilada sauce, pepperoni, alfredo sauce, V8, mustard and frozen chopped spinach. Mix well. instructions: Preheat broiler. Line a 15 x 10 inch jelly roll pan with aluminum foil. In a large bowl, combine tomatoes, buttermilk, vinegar, tomato, syrup, and cheese.

title: Sweet & Tasty Mango Mousse
ingredients: 6 medium red potatoes | 100 g baby arugula | 2 large ripe mangoes | 25 g icing sugar ( caster ) | 1 teaspoon oregano ( dried ) | mar maraschino cherry ( to serve )
instructions: Preheat oven to 180c gas unroll the potatoes and either cut them in half lengthways or, if using regular potatoes, cut into chunks. Wash the arugula under cold running water and dry them on kitchen paper. Gently, using your hands, scoop out some of the firmer flesh and reserve for later use. Cut the mangoes into thin slices. Place one potato in each hole evenly and sprinkle each with a few tsp each of the icing sugar, oregano and a drizzle of olive oil. Place the mango slices in a small roasting tin. Carefully place the pear halves under the mango so the flesh is face up and the pear halves sit in an overlapping circle of skin on each side of the potato and mango. Top each mound with a large dollop of pure mango puree and bake for 20 minutes or until the mango is tender and the mousse is bubbling. Remove from oven and stand for 5 minutes. Carefully cut into wedges and serve.

title: Pork Stew,  for 2
ingredients: 1 can ro-tel diced tomatoes and green chilies, undrained well ( i use muir glen fire-roasted tomatoes ) | 2 tablespoons instant chicken bouillon granules | 1/4 cup julienne-cut julienne-cut yellow pepper | 1/4 cup julienne-cut red chili powder | 1/4 teaspoon sugar snap pea | 1/2 lb pork tenderloin, trimmed and cut diagonally into 1/4-inch slices | 1/2 cup polenta, coarsely ground | 10 1/2 ounces low-sodium instant chicken bouillon granules, undiluted | 1/2 cup julienne cut carrot, peeled and julienned medium | tortilla chips, for serving
instructions: Stir tomatoes, chicken bouillon granules and yellow peppers, chili powder and sugar snap peas in small bowl until well combined. Add pork to tomato mixture.

title: Terrific Beef Tenderloin!  the secret is in the meat!!
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs top round beef tenderloin | 1/4 cup champagne | 1 anchovy paste | 2 teaspoons shallots, diced | 3/4 cup rotini pasta ( cooked ) | 1 small apple, chopped
instructions: Slice beef, about 1/8, 1/4 thick, in even thicknesses as possible. Place in shallow baking dish and top with champagne, anchovy paste and shallots. Cover and bake in 375°f oven for 30 minutes. Cook pasta in separate 400°f oven till 'al dente'. Place on plate and surround with meat and wine mixture.

Random Ingredients: saffron,tomato,back bacon,maraschino cherry,oyster sauce,gruyere,chicken stock,beef stew meat
title: Saffron, Bacon and Swiss Meatballs
ingredients: 4 slices lean back bacon, chopped | 1/2 pound beef stew meat, sliced 1/4 inch thick | 1/4 pound thickly sliced fresh back bacon, chopped | 3 tablespoons oyster sauce | 1 pinch saffron | 1 cup chicken stock | 1 small tomato, sliced into thin wedges | 1 tablespoon chopped maraschino cherries | 1 tablespoon grated gruyere cheese, or to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Grease a 9x13 inch baking dish with butter. Place 4 slices of back bacon in a skillet over medium heat. Cook, stirring occasionally, until it begins to brown, about 20 seconds. Remove the bacon slices with a slotted spoon and set aside. Place half the beef in the prepared baking dish, and top with half the bacon, making sure bacon is completely covered. Top with the remaining beef slices. Combine the remaining 4 slices bacon, oyster sauce, saffron, chicken stock, and tomato with the croutons in a saucepan. Bring to a boil, then immediately pour over the meatballs. Bake in preheated oven for 35 to 40 minutes, or until meat is tender and sauce is thickened.

title: Mexican Linguine Fritters
ingredients: 12 thin fresh linguine | 1 3/4 cups cake flour, sifted | 1 1/2 - 2 cups fresh cilantro leaves
instructions: Put the flour into a large bowl. Drip the linguine into the bowl, then cut in half. Dip the pasta in the batter with a plastic spatula, one piece at a time to make sure its fully coated. Then transfer the batter to a clean paper towel covered with another strip of paper towels. Wipe all sides of your spatula with a warm paper towel and put it on the table in front of you. You can also use a little dry cloth that is dampened with a little cold water. Letting the noodles sit for a while makes them easier to work with. After 7 - 10 minutes rinse the pasta well in warm water and dry it as you go. Cut out a circle about 2 inches in diameter and about 2 inches wide and about 1/2 inch deep. Do not add any water, only about 1 tablespoon. You will need about 3 cups of linguine cooking water to make the fritters. In a large skillet, heat 3 tablespoons of oil or you can use a little other neutral flavored oil to saute the fritters in on medium heat until brown on both sides. This can take 3 - 4 minutes per side, turning once or twice. Note do this about 2 times. They cook fast, then take a few minutes longer to get the fritters golden brown in color. Drain well on paper towels. Set the fritters aside and keep warm. Turn the stove down to medium high. Dip the noodles in flour, toss well, and place them in the skillet with the seasoned oil. Cook for 1 - 2 minutes longer. Turn off the heat, toss again and set them aside until needed. Dip each fritter in the seasoned oil. You may have to do this twice or three times. They should cook on each side, but will not be fully cooked. After frying, stir it around gently until it starts to thicken. Stir in the chopped cilantro. Add more cilantro if you like a spicier fritter, depending on the amount you like. Serve the fritters on a lettuce lined platter as they cook.

title: Grilled Chicken Cabbage and Cabbage Sandwiches (21 Day Wonder Diet: Day 1 )
ingredients: 4 boneless chicken breast halves | 1/4 cup red cabbage, shredded
instructions: Cook chicken in hot grill, uncovered, about 12 minutes until cooked through, then slice into strips or chunks. Divide chicken and cabbage among 4 dinner plates, then top with other ingredients.

title: Crock Pot Beef Brisket
ingredients: 1 beef brisket | 1 tablespoon dried marjoram | 3 tablespoons liquid smoke flavoring | 1/2 teaspoon fresh ground black pepper | 2 ounces tomato soup | plain flour, to coat | 1 tablespoon chopped cilantro
instructions: Trim to remove all excess fat from brisket. Trim excess fat. Sprinkle with salt, pepper, oregano, thyme & liquid smoke. Let rest at room temperature for 1 hour. Place brisket in crock pot. Place tomatoes over brisket and pour tomato soup over. Cover with lid. Cook on low setting for 7 - 10 hours. Remove brisket from crock pot and cover with foil. Slice brisket across the grain and serve with the tomato soup. Accompany with fresh herbs, serve with sauce. You can add chopped garlic to the sauce if you wish, but cooking time will vary depending on the freshness of the herbs.

title: Pork Tenderloins With a Basil-Chocolate-Glaze
ingredients: 2 pork tenderloins | bibb lettuce | 4 tablespoons dark chocolate | 1/3 cup basil, torn ( or use fresh chopped ) | 2 tablespoons cornstarch | 1 tablespoon green beans, coarsely chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f. Place pork tenderloins between plastic wrap and flatten to 1 inch thickness with meat mallet or rolling pin. Place in a shallow baking pan and marinade uncovered for 30 minutes, turning them from time to time. Remove tenderloins and reserve marinade. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Bake tenderloins for 25 minutes or until they're golden and cooked through. Remove from oven and spread with dark chocolate glaze. Return to oven for 2 to 3 minutes or until glaze is bubbly. Top with fresh basil.

Random Ingredients: green cardamom pod,sun tomato oil,blue cheese
title: Blue Cheese and Sun-Dried Tomato Chilled Polenta
ingredients: 6 green cardamom pods ( the kind in the pods ) | 3 ounces sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained | 5 ounces blue cheese, cut into 1/2 '' thin sticks
instructions: Place the cardamom pods in a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Quickly cook the green cardamom pods, shaking the pan until they're just fragrant, about 1 minute. Turn the cardamom pods over and continue to cook, shaking the pan, until they're fragrant and a little dark in color, about 2 minutes. Stir in the sun dried tomatoes, then sprinkle blue cheese over. Remove cardamom pods, shaking pan, and transfer the polenta to a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Let the polenta stand at room temperature for 20 minutes. Scoop polenta into a heat resistant serving bowl and carefully transfer it to a serving bowl.

title: Tuna Bites
ingredients: 4 tablespoons orange liqueur | 1/2 cup olive, drained and chopped | 1 can tuna, drained and flaked
instructions: Stir the orange liqueur and olive the tuna. Dip tuna into mixture. Grill or fry for 10 minutes, turning occasionally.

title: Brussels Sprouts With Pecans
ingredients: 1 pint fresh brussels sprout, ends trimmed, in a large bowl | 3/4 cup pecans, lightly toasted, coarsely chopped ( or walnuts ) or 3/4 cup nuts of choice ( or walnuts )
instructions: Using a 3 inch diameter glass or metal spatula, slice the brussels sprouts crosswise into 1/4 inch thick rounds. Remove the center stem, if desired, and discard. Sprinkle the brussels sprouts with 1/4 teaspoon salt and set aside. Using the pestle or electric grater, lightly grind the pecans or nuts of choice. Using a large nonstick skillet, toast the brussels sprouts over moderately low heat, about 10 minutes, stirring constantly, until slightly dark golden in color. Use a spatula or slotted spoon transfer them to a platter. Pour off all but 2 to 3 tablespoons oil from the skillet. Add the brussels sprouts, spread them out on the hot pan, and cook over moderately high heat, stirring often, until the brussels sprouts are browned on top, about 5 minutes.

title: Quinoa Snack - Snack Mix
ingredients: 1/2 cup quinoa, rinsed | nonstick cooking spray
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Spray a baking sheet with nonstick spray. Spread whole quinoa on baking sheet. Place in oven and bake until quinoa is fragrant, about 5 minutes. Cut into bite size chunks and stir in to breadcrumbs. Spray a cookie sheet with nonstick spray. Transfer to snack aisle of your snack aisle.

Random Ingredients: flat leaf parsley,italian sausage,currant,pecorino romano cheese,cumin powder,quinoa
title: Quinoa with Sausage and Herb Spread
ingredients: 1 lb sweet italian sausage, sliced | 1/2 cup fresh flat-leaf parsley, chopped, save some for garnish | 1 1/2 cups quinoa, washed thoroughly and drained | 2 teaspoons cumin powder | 1/4 cup quinoa, washed thoroughly, drained and torn in 1/2 | 1/4 cup currants or 1/4 cup raisins, raisins if you like
instructions: In medium skillet, in the 3rd pound of italian sausage, brown the sausage. When the sausage is no longer pink, remove from the skillet, slice thinly and set aside. Pour off all but about 2 tablespoons fat from the pan, return skillet to medium heat. Add all other ingredients, stirring to make sure the quinoa is covered completely with the liquid. Cover and bring to boil, then reduce heat, and simmer 20 - 25 minutes. After 10 minutes, add the chopped parsley sprigs and cover the pan again. Keep in mind that it will dry out with the moisture it should absorb. The quinoa should still have some moist moisture throughout the quinoa. When the quinoa is cooked, remove from heat and mix. Serve hot or room temperature. Enjoy serve with pita chips, bread, sour cream or crusty italian bread.

title: Rice Noodle and Chile Sausage Sausage Quiche
ingredients: 8 ounces large-pie shell, unbaked | 2 tablespoons safflower oil | 8 ounces wide rice noodles | 3/4 cup chopped poblano chile | 1 can italian-style diced tomatoes, drained | 12 1/2 ounces drained romano-stuffed capers | 1 1/2 tablespoons drained bottled giardiner's chipotle in adobo
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Press 9 of the uncooked pie shells through a fine mesh sieve into a 9 inch quiche dish that is just larger than the pie shell. Add the poblano chile, diced tomatoes, capers, and chipotle and stir to combine. Place the cooked rice noodles into the bottom of the pie shell. Pour the rice and chilies mixture over the noodles and spread evenly. Bake until the crust is light golden, about 40 minutes.

Random Ingredients: okra,basmati rice,beef brisket,garlic paste,wheat flour,grain brown rice,quinoa
title: Jhal Frezi
ingredients: 1/3 cup whole grain brown rice | 1/3 cup quinoa | 1 lb beef brisket | 4 -5 okra, sliced ( depending on size ) | garlic paste | basmati rice, raw ( jasmine or basmati is the best ) | wheat flour, for dusting
instructions: Note, you may want to cook the rice in advance in order to take out the fat and the bitterness. Cook the brisket on rotel till done. Place cooked rice in container and separate meat from bones. Pour off the fat and discard. Slice meat into thin slices when cool enough. You may have to do this in batches. Degrease pot, add rice, let stand for 3 mins. Flavors will be coming out. If not, reduce heat to a medium. Dust with flour and serve.

title: Cheddar Leek and Hazelnut Cheese Balls
ingredients: 5 ounces sharp cheddar cheese, coarsely grated | 1 ounce mixed dried saffron strands ( known as helji or arabic ) | 1 ounce hazelnuts, toasted and skins rubbed off | 1 cup milk | 1 small leek, white part only, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons fresh mint leaves, coarsely chopped | hp steak sauce | 2 teaspoons hot sauce, to taste
instructions: Combine the cheese, saffron, nuts and milk in a bowl. Heat the grill pan to high, with the meat. Grind the chees in a food processor if using, until the mixture resembles fine breadcrumbs. Whisk in the leek and mint, season to taste, and add the steak sauce and hot sauce. Use your hands to shape mixture into 8cm long sticks. Place the meat on a baking tray, leaving a 2cm rim around the edge. Brush with oil and grill on high for 4 - 5 minutes, turning once, until browned.

title: Apricots, Blue Cheese, and Eggs for Two
ingredients: 4 ounces hard-boiled egg yolks | 5 tablespoons soft mild light brown sugar or 5 tablespoons light brown sugar | 3 tablespoons dried apricot, finely chopped | 1 -2 tablespoon bottled finely chopped chili oil | 1/2 cup good quality blue cheese, crumbled
instructions: In a small bowl, using a fork, whish the egg yolks with 3 tbls sugar to a paste, then add the remaining sugar and chopped fruit and stir until blended. Season lightly with the chili oil. Add the cheese and continue whisking until the dip is fairly thick. If the dip becomes too thick, add a little water. Cover and leave to rest in the fridge for about 3 hours. Serve warm or cold with fresh bread or crackers.

title: Brown Sugar
ingredients: 1 cup brown sugar or 1 cup splenda brown sugar blend | 1 -2 tablespoon orange peel, finely grated | 1 chicken bouillon or 1 chicken bouillon | 1/4 teaspoon orange peel ( dried flakes )
instructions: Place brown sugar, orange peel and the chicken in a crockpot. Add rest of the ingredients. Stir well. Cover and cook on low setting, 6 hours, stirring every 15 minutes until thickened, but not mushy. To thicken, add additional water as needed. Store in refrigerator.

title: Dry Cranberry Powder
ingredients: 1 cup dried cranberries | 2 teaspoons ground cardamom seed | 2 tablespoons xanthan gum | 2 teaspoons chipotle chiles in adobo, finely minced
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a dry, clean coffee filter or food storage container with a tight fitting lid. Store in cool, dry place.

title: Sushi Roll (Sushi Roll)
ingredients: 1 can beer | 1 package baby spinach | 1/2 lb pork, thinly sliced | 8 ounces green chilies, thinly sliced | 3 tablespoons instant dashi | 1/3 cup salsa | 1/3 cup oyster sauce | 2 1/2 cups rye flour
instructions: Soak greens and salt in boiling water for 5 minutes or until limp. Drain and pat dry with paper towels. Cook spinach and chillies in boiling water until crisp tender. Mix in remaining ingredients except sesame oil. Mix well. Spread a portion of the mixture with a spoonful or two of the sesame oil mixture and roll like a jelly roll. Serve at once.

title: Pernod Roasted Vegetables(Serves Many)
ingredients: 1/2 lb turnip | 2 russet potatoes | 1/4 lb russet potato | 1/2 vanilla bean | 1/4 cup grated pernod
instructions: Peel, core and cut turnips into 1/2 inch thick rounds. Cut pith from vanilla bean then split the vanilla bean lengthwise and scrap the inside of pinnom pods using scissors. Place cut vegetables in a large roasting pan. Sprinkle with freshly grated parmigiano, and drizzle with the freshly grated pecorino as above. Add 1 tablespoon pernod or other anise flavored oil, or enough for a roasting pan with lots of flavour. Preheat oven to 350°f. Place the vegetable mixture under a hot broiler or in a large roasting pan. Broil for 4 to 5 minutes, until they just start browning. Watch closely to ensure that they do not burn. Watch carefully. Do not burn, as the garlic can burn and spoil the flavour.

title: Beef Kebabs With Warm Potato and Turkey Dip (Brasato Na Pota) #5FIX
ingredients: 1/2 lb ground sirloin | 1/2 lb ground turkey | 1/4 cup light mayonnaise | 1 dash cayenne pepper | 6 russet potatoes, diced
instructions: Combine the beef, turkey and the light mayonaise in a large resealable bag and let marinade in the fridge for at least an hour. When ready to cook, grill the potatoes until browned on the medium hot grill. The meat mixture should have no pink inside and no pink showing. Serve the beef mixture over the warm potatoes.

Random Ingredients: tarragon,focaccia bread,beef sirloin,salmon fillet,pepperoni,garlic,beef bouillon cube,lemon
title: Baked Beef and Poached Salmon Sandwich
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef sirloin, boneless, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 cup water | 2 beef bouillon cubes | 8 slices of thin-sliced pepperoni | 8 pieces of thin-sliced tarragon | 4 slices of thin sliced lemons, for garnish | 2 loaves large focaccia bread | 1/4 cup minced fresh garlic
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f set a large nonstick skillet over high heat. Season the beef with salt and pepper. Add beef to hot skillet. Brown beef on all sides, taking care not to burn. Transfer the beef to a 3 1/2 quart baking dish. Add water, beef bouillon, pepperoni, and tarragon to skillet. Bring to a boil. Cover tightly.

Random Ingredients: bean,garam masala,mar bar,masa harina,beef stew meat,oyster sauce,pork chop
title: Beef & Bean Masala
ingredients: 1 lb beef stew meat | 1 lb boneless pork chop | 1/4 cup masa harina | 1/4 cup oyster sauce | 1 1/2 teaspoons garam masala | 1 can refried beans
instructions: In a large skillet, marinate beef and pork with oyster sauce, garam masala and masa harina. Brown beef and pork in olive oil and remaining marinade. Add beans to skillet and bake for 30 minutes or until meat is cooked.

title: Grilled Tuna Nicoise
ingredients: 3/4 cup saffron | 2 tablespoons cajun seasoning | 2 tablespoons orange rind, grated | 4 tuna fillets, 1 to 1 1/2 inch thick
instructions: In a small bowl, combine saffron, cajun seasoning, grated orange rind.

Random Ingredients: chicken stock,sun tomato,parsley leaf,clove,paprika,asiago cheese,pork shoulder
title: Pork With Sun-Dried Tomato, Asiago Cream and Garlic
ingredients: 3 lbs pork shoulder | 12 ounces sun-dried tomatoes, rinsed, soaked in hot water for 30 minutes, drained | 2 cups chicken stock | 4 ounces fresh asiago cheese, grated | 1 bunch fresh parsley leaves, stems trimmed | 2 cloves | 1/2 teaspoon sweet paprika ( i use szeged )
instructions: Pour all ingredients into a large pot and cover with cold water. Bring to a boil and simmer over low heat for at least 2 hours, or until meats are tender. Remove pan from heat and let cool to room temperature. Remove meat from bones and shred in food processor. Add enough cream or half cup water to sauce until desired consistency is reached. Cool and add remaining ingredients and stir to blend well. Serve with crusty bread. For an asiago cream, adjust the amount of the cheese according to how creamy you like your cream.

Random Ingredients: beef gravy,pork butt,garlic powder,applesauce,cold water,tamari,bean sprout
title: Teddy's Pork Belly Buster
ingredients: 1 lb pork butt | 4 tablespoons tamari | 4 tablespoons cold water | 1 jar beef gravy | 8 ounces fresh bean sprouts | 3 tablespoons garlic powder | 2 tablespoons applesauce ( your preference )
instructions: Cut pork butt into cubes. In medium pot, add pork, water and tamari. Place over medium heat and boil until almost done, about 30 minutes. Meanwhile, in a medium bowl, put together gravy, sprouts, garlic powder and applesauce. When meat begins to render fat, add it over medium heat. When water is boiling again, add sprout mixture. Cover and remove from heat. Wait 30 minutes for the gravy to thicken, usually this can take up to 2 hours. Serve over noodles or rice.

title: Eggplant-Aubergine Salad
ingredients: 1 large eggplant | 2 tablespoons tamari or 2 tablespoons soy sauce | 3 tablespoons fresh rosemary leaves
instructions: Preheat the broiler. Cut eggplant into 1/4 inch slices. Place slices on a baking sheet and broil 3 minutes or until skin is charred. Remove and allow to cool for 5 minutes, then peel off skin. Slice eggplant into 1/4 inch slices and arrange on a serving plate. Toss with tamari, and sprinkle with chopped rosemary leaves.

title: Peanut Flavoured Cream Cheese
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cream cheese or 2 tablespoons mascarpone cheese | 1 tablespoon amaretto | 1 teaspoon brandy or 1 teaspoon rum | 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon
instructions: Using an electric mixer, blend all ingredients together on low speed until smooth. Cover and refrigerate up to one week before serving.

title: Gneaden Kaese
ingredients: 1 lb thickly sliced italian sausage ( sausages in a bun, 3/4-inch slices across the long axis from the point of each sausage ) | 1 cup coarsely chopped pecans | 2 tablespoons caster sugar, plus extra for sprinkling | 4 ounces shredded gruyere cheese
instructions: Heat a large nonstick frying pan over medium heat. Add the sausages and brown on all sides, breaking into pieces with spatula. Transfer the sausages to a plate and cover to keep warm. Add the pecans to the pan and cook, stirring, until lightly toasted, 3 - 4 minutes. Stir in the sugar, increase the heat to medium and toss to coat them with the sugar. Return the sausages to the pan, sprinkle with extra sugar, and cook until warmed through and well coated, around 5 minutes. Meanwhile, pile the gruyere onto a plate. Divide the sausages and pecans among plates, scatter with more sugar, and serve with crackers.

title: Apple Mustard Spray
ingredients: 1/4 cup mustard seeds | 1 cup apple juice ( or apple juice or water )
instructions: Rinse mustard seeds well and spread over a large sheet of wax paper. Bake until blackened, about 40 minutes. Cool thoroughly and press dry with a towel or paper towels. Place in a plastic bag or storage container and let dry at room temperature until ready to use. Place mustard seeds in a dry glass 3/4 to 1 cup capacity resealable plastic bag and add apple juice or water. Close contents tightly and shake until mustard seeds are coated. Store in airtight container, at room temperature for up to 3 weeks or freeze for up to 3 months.

title: Chipotle Spanish Rice
ingredients: 1/2 cup short-grain white rice | 2 teaspoons adobo seasoning
instructions: Prepare the rice according to pkg. Directions with no added fat added. When it comes to a full steam, set it aside. Add adobo seasoning to rice in a hot skillet.

title: Fondue for the Gang or Dinner
ingredients: 6 tablespoons cornstarch | 1 cup grated gruyere cheese | 3 tablespoons sugar, to taste | 6 soft ladyfingers
instructions: Sift all the dry ingredients into a bowl. Stir in the cheese. Coat a fondue pot with warm oil or fat. Serve the fondue with ladyfingers.

title: Yogurt Cheese
ingredients: 8 ounces plain greek yogurt | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley | 1 teaspoon italian seasoning
instructions: Place the yogurt in a bowl or strainer and refrigerate overnight. Stir the yogurt with the parsley with the italian seasoning. Place in your favorite flat dish and refrigerate overnight when serving. When ready to serve, place in small dishes and refrigerate until serving.

Random Ingredients: ginger garlic paste,basil leaf,sesame seed,iceberg lettuce,chunky salsa,white bread,rack lamb
title: Mexican Rack of Lamb
ingredients: 1/4 cup sesame seeds | 8 slices white bread | 2 racks of lamb, frenched | 5 -6 tablespoons chunky salsa | 4 tablespoons ginger-garlic paste ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons basil leaves | 1 iceberg lettuce, large leaves
instructions: Toast the sesame seeds over a gas flame or under the broiler, shaking until they begin to brown, about 3 minutes. Watch them closely. Do this until the sesame seeds have a nice golden brown appearance, stirring often during this process. You may leave the sesame seeds off until serving time, as sesame seeds may not readily toast when heated. You can grind them to your own texture in a mortar and pestle. While the sesame seeds toast, put the rack of lamb onto a large cutting board. Cut slits at 1 inch intervals with a sharp knife, cutting them crosswise to make diamond shaped slits. Lay the sesame seeds cut side down on the cutting board, and cut off excess fat. Use a slotted spoon, if the sesame seeds do not pop out, it is important to have a table to help you do this. When the sesame seeds start to blacken around the slits, remove them with a slotted spoon and drain off any excess liquid.. Spread 2 tablespoons of salsa on both crusty side of each slice of bread. Arrange a slice of slotted lamb on the salsa, and top with the remaining slice of bread. Cover and let sit for about 30 minutes, turning over occasionally so the bread does not break apart. When the sesame seeds are done, arrange the toast on a serving platter or serving plate. Wash and remove the lettuce leaves from the lettuce. Pull apart the lettuce leaves a few times and spread generously with the spicy salsa. Top off each slice with a slivered almonds or more, depending on the desired level of sesame seeds. Serve immediately. If serving warm, you can assemble the sandwich by layering the meat on top, lettuce leaves on top and pressing down gently into the salsa. You can serve this in a bowl along with the sesame seeds and sesame seed slices and top with crispy salsa, shredded onion, or some shredded jalapeno if desired. The salsa will keep refrigerated, if you are going to use it immediately.

Random Ingredients: wheat flour,beef chuck steak,pomegranate molasses,anchovy fillet,mozzarella cheese
title: Swiss Steak Pizza
ingredients: 2 tablespoons pomegranate molasses | 2 whole wheat flour | 1 center-cut boneless beef chuck steak, 1/2-inch thick | 1 cup shredded mozzarella cheese | 2 anchovy fillets, rinsed and drained
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees f. Grease an 8 inch pizza pan. In a small bowl, mix the pomegranate molasses and flour. Dip the beef strips one at a time into the molasses mixture, letting any excess drip off. Arrange the beef strips on the prepared pizza pan. Top with mozzarella cheese and anchovies, if desired. Bake in the preheated oven until the cheese is melted and the crust is browned, about 10 minutes. Cut into 8 wedges and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: feta cheese,anise seed,red chili pepper,season salt,cold water,cream tartar,pie shell,hot chili pepper
title: Indian Feta Cheese Spread on the Half Shell
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs neufchatel cheese or 1 1/2 lbs cream cheese, at room temperature | 8 ounces feta cheese, drained and crumbled | 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1/4 teaspoon ground anise seed | 1/8 teaspoon fresh red chili pepper, minced | 1/8 - 1/4 cup cold water | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon dried hot chili pepper, crushed | 1 dash season-all salt ( optional )
instructions: Place the neufchatel in a bowl and beat with an electric mixer until light and fluffy. Add the feta, cream of tartar, anise, chili peppers, and a dash of seasoned salt.

title: Spanish Garbanzos With Pork or Chicken
ingredients: 1 lb fresh garbanzo beans or 1 lb dried garbanzo beans | 1 kg pork roast, cut into large cubes or 1 kg ground turkey | 1/2 cup parsnip, coarsely chopped | 2 tablespoons shaoxing wine or 2 tablespoons dry sherry | 1 can black olives, sliced | 6 -8 large shrimp, cleaned and deveined ( cooked )
instructions: Soak beans for about 3 hours until almost tender, then boil for 15 minutes. Drain. Place cooked meat and dried beans in large pot along with enough water to cover and simmer on low about 50 minutes or until meat is just cooked throughout. Drain. Meanwhile, in a large bowl, mix together the shaoxing wine, black olive, parmesan cheese and garlic. Place meat back into the pot. Add the shrimp to the pot. Add the cooked, drained beans and mix well. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: cumin,brandy,barley flour,green chili pepper,chipotle powder,cilantro stem,thyme leaf,chicken meat
title: Chipotle-Herb Chicken
ingredients: 3 lbs chicken meat, washed and trimmed | 1/2 teaspoon chipotle powder | 2 teaspoons dried thyme leaves | 2 teaspoons dried cilantro stems | 1/4 teaspoon cumin | 1 can whole green chili peppers, chopped ( or 1 cup jarred roasted red peppers ) | 1/4 cup brandy | 1/4 cup barley flour
instructions: Combine the seasoning ingredients. Cut the chicken in pieces, removing the excess fat if desired. Marinate the chicken in the mixture for at least 1/2 hour. Drain and reserve the marinade. Place the chicken in a shallow roasting pan that has been sprayed with pam. Combine the chiles, brandy, and flour in a small bowl. Drizzle a small amount of the reserved marinade over the chicken. Broil over medium heat until browned.

Random Ingredients: sun tomato,saffron strand,hot sausage,ginger,vanilla ice cream,nicoise olive,chocolate chip
title: Sausage, Nicoise & Olives Parfait
ingredients: 1/4 cup nicoise olive | 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato | 1 tablespoon fresh ginger | 1/8 teaspoon saffron strand ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon dark chocolate chips | 1/2 cup chocolate ripple ice cream | hot sausage ( optional )
instructions: Heat grill / broiler. Place nicoise olives & sun dried tomatoes on grill trays. Place julienned ginger on grill/broiler tray & sprinkle evenly with saffron and dark chocolate chips. Remove from grill & place under broiler to cook for 10 - 15 minutes or until lightly crisp & golden. Remove from oven & slice crosswise into about 4 or 5 cm rounds, set aside. Scatter over remaining ingredients & serve warm.

title: Chinese Style Braised Pork and Black-Eyed Peas
ingredients: 400 g dry black-eyed peas | 400 g coarsely chopped pork shoulder | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds
instructions: Rinse and soak the peas as directed. While that is soaking, grind the pork with a mortar and pestle or with a sharp knife. Add the mustard seed. Cook the peas at the same time as the mustard seeds. The mixture might look watery at first but will become thick as the peas cook.

title: Yummy Zucchini Fajitas
ingredients: 4 medium zucchini ( about 1. 5 kgs ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 5 large tortillas
instructions: Preheat oven to 180 c or160 degrees f. Slice zucchini into very thin disks. Set zucchini on a lightly lined baking sheet or tray. Combine worcestershire sauce and the 1 tablespoon of worcestershire sauce. Spread evenly over the zucchini. Roast for 20 to 25 minutes or until zucchini is lightly browned on the edges. Serve with tortillas, salsa and a side of guacamole.

title: Mexican Spicy Beef and Bacon
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger | 1 jar picante salsa ( medium or hot ) | 1/2 teaspoon red chili powder
instructions: Heat oven to 400°f. Brown hamburger and drain. Add salsa to meat and cook until warmed through, stirring well. Sprinkle chili powder on top and put in oven to heat up the thru stirring often to avoid burning.

Random Ingredients: escarole,miso,orange juice concentrate,rosemary,breadcrumb,palm sugar,baby bok choy
title: Escarole, Broccoli, & Bok Choy Salad
ingredients: 6 cups baby bok choy | 10 baby bok choy | 1/2 teaspoon dried rosemary | 1 dash orange juice concentrate ( optional ) or 1 dash lemon juice concentrate ( optional ) | 3/4 cup miso | 3/4 cup breadcrumbs | 1/4 cup palm sugar ( to be packed in a paper towel when making salad )
instructions: In a strainer, add baby bok choy and remove stems and any tough outer leaves. Cut the tougher ends off the bok choy, discard, and cut the rest into 2 inch pieces on the diagonal or into halves or quarters if desired. Rinse the baby bok choy. Place the pieces of bok choy in a colander and add enough water to just cover. Place over high heat and bring to a boil. Drain in a colander and rinse immediately with cold water, then drain. When ready to serve dish put together equal amounts of the salad greens in individual bowls. Stir the sweetener if using and pour the seasoned sweet/sour mixture over the greens. Garnish with sliced or diced hard boiled eggs, parsley, or dried herbs of your choice.

title: Spicy Currant Chutney
ingredients: 8 ounces fresh currants | 1 green chili, chopped | 1 fresh lime, juice of
instructions: Put all the ingredients in a saucepan and bring to the boil. Reduce heat and simmer, stirring often, until the chutney has all absorbed almost all the moisture.. Pour into hot sterilised jars and seal. Store in a cool dark place.

title: Roasted Red Currant Bread
ingredients: 6 cups red currant jelly | 1 loaf challah, ends trimmed and toasted | fresh italian parsley, finely chopped for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f generously butter 4 large baking sheets and dust with flour. Line the baking sheets with parchment paper and set them aside. Pour the jelly into a shallow bowl and set it aside. Cut the bread in half crossways and cut each half into 2 pieces. Place the bread cut side down onto the baking sheet and spoon 2 tablespoons of jelly onto each bread piece. Sprinkle it with a little of the fresh parsley, if using, and bake in the oven until the jelly is bubbly, golden and crisp, about 15 minutes.

title: Tomato and Soy Mousse
ingredients: 2 ripe tomatoes | 1 teaspoon cornflour | 2 teaspoons cornflour | 2 teaspoons light soy sauce | 1 teaspoon milk ( or more ) | cooking spray | 1 1/2 cups half-and-half
instructions: Peel, core and cut tomatoes into thin slices. Mix the cornflour and 1 teaspoons coconut paste and stir into tomato. Add milk and soy sauce and beat until smooth. Heat up the remaining oil in a small pan and add the tomato mixture. Stir over medium heat until the sauce becomes slightly thick. Remove from heat and sprinkle with remaining coconut paste. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: self raising flour,peach juice,zucchini,kaffir lime leaf
title: Zucchini Damper
ingredients: 2 cups self-raising flour | 1 teaspoon dried kaffir lime leaf | 350 ml peach juice ( not grenadine ) | 2 zucchini ( i used orange zucchini because it was quite sweet )
instructions: Sift the flour into a large bowl with the lime leaf stir through the juice until just combined. Slice the zucchini in to thick wedges. Add the zucchini wedges to the flour, then coat them in the batter. Heat a non stick frying pan, add 4 tbsp of the oil and a small pat of water. Dip the zucchini wedges into the batter, they should not float at all. Fry in batches for 2 - 5 mins each time till they are golden brown. Drain on kitchen paper. Serve the damper with warmed cream and/or mango chutney.

title: Brown Rice
ingredients: 1/2 cup cooked brown rice | 1 1/2 tablespoons sherry ( or sherry ) | 1 1/4 cups farina or 1 1/4 cups whole wheat flour
instructions: In a saucepan, combine rice and the sherry and cook, stirring often until all the liquid is absorbed. Let sit for 15 minutes, then stir in the farina or wheat flour. Return to a boil, stirring continuously. Remove from heat.

title: Cucumber Sauce for Pork
ingredients: 1 cucumber, peeled | 4 ounces salt pork | 2 tablespoons tamarind pulp
instructions: Cut the cucumber lengthwise into 8 slices, then slice the slices in half lengthwise. Cut in half again so they are striped. Using a teaspoon, scoop out the seeds. Set the slices upright on a cutting board and place them side by side in a blender. Add tamarind pulp and salt pork and puree. Place in a large jar, cover tightly and store in the refrigerator for at least 2 weeks before using.

title: Simple Nectarine Shell Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb small shell pasta ( fresh or dried will do in a pinch. ) | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon nigella seeds
instructions: If using dry pasta, let sit at least half an hour, until it turns a golden color at the edges. Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Drop in all the shell pasta and stir, cooking 3 to 5 minutes or until al dente. Drain pasta and return into pot. Sprinkle on the nigella seeds and cook a few min more. Serve warm or at room temp with a robust, chilled sauvignon blanc.

title: Blueberry Veggie Packets - Mushrooms & Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 small fresh button mushroom, finely chopped | 1/2 cup fresh blueberries, washed, dried, picked over | 1 tablespoon fresh blueberries, washed, dried, picked over
instructions: Place mushrooms on a large plate. Sprinkle with fresh blueberries, lightly sprinkle with berries of your choice. Chill for 30 minutes. Serve.

Random Ingredients: ro tel tomato,yeast,brown sugar,pork chop,topping,apple cider,yellow cake mix,beef broth
title: Easy Pulled Pork Loaf
ingredients: 1 lb pork chop ( not thick cut ) | 1 can ro-tel diced tomatoes ( i use no salt added ) | 1 can beef broth | 1 package yellow cake mix | 1 box instant yeast | 1 can reduced sodium beef broth | 1/4 cup brown sugar | 1/2 cup apple cider
instructions: Dice pork chop into 1 inch cubes. Place in a large casserole dish. Add all other ingredients and mix well. Cover with plastic wrap and a tight lid. Let rise about 1 1/2 hours then bake at 350 degrees for approximately 40 - 45 minutes or until golden brown. Serve with sour cream and/or french bread.

title: Blueberry and Bean Sprouts Salad
ingredients: 4 cups mixed beansprouts | 1 cup blueberries or 1 cup other berries | 1 1/2 cups nonfat plain yogurt | 3/4 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: Blanch the beanprouts at a rolling boil, remove and let run under cold water to stop the cooking. Toss the beansprouts in a salad bowl. In a saucepan, heat the berries and yogurt. Add the vanilla essence. If using berries, add immediately. If using fresh berries, leave the saucepan on the stove, remove the berries and blend the berries in a blender. Pour the yogurt yogurt mixture over the sprouts and mix. Add the berries and mix well. Chill well before serving.

title: Cheese Ball Appetizer
ingredients: 16 ounces cream of chicken soup | 1/2 cup unsweetened chocolate, grated | 8 cilantro leaves
instructions: Combine all ingredients with a mixer and mix well. Roll into 1 inch balls and store in airtight container.

Random Ingredients: bean sprout,chicken broth,almond,saffron thread,hash brown potato,bacon,poultry seasoning,pea carrot
title: Chicken, Potatoes, & Bean Sprouts
ingredients: 1 package frozen mixed vegetables ( or fresh mixed vegetables, broccoli, carrots, onion, & cauliflower ) | 1 package frozen peas and carrots, thawed ( thawed, if frozen ) | 3 cups cooked diced leftover chicken ( or cooked or cooked ground turkey ) | 6 slices bacon | 1 teaspoon poultry seasoning ( or mix of your favourite poultry seasoning blend, paprika, paprika, & crushed dried red pepper ) | 1/2 teaspoon saffron threads ( crushed ) | 3 cups chicken broth or 3 cups vegetable broth | 1/4 cup slivered blanched almond, toasted
instructions: Prepare vegetables according to package directions, then drain. While vegetables are cooking, slice bacon into 1/2 inch strips. In a large skillet, cook bacon over medium high heat until lightly browned, stirring frequently. Remove bacon from skillet with a slotted spoon, and drain on paper towels. Reserve grease in skillet. While bacon is still slightly warm, stir in remaining ingredients except almonds. Bring to boil, then reduce heat until simmering. Cook about 5 minutes. Stir in fried almonds and serve right away.

Random Ingredients: olive oil,fine breadcrumb,peach,white sugar,spaghetti sauce,water artichoke heart,tomatillo
title: Pigs in Olives-Tapas
ingredients: 12 tomatillos | 8 cups spaghetti sauce ( i prefer my own ragu ) | 1/2 cup olive oil | 6 cups water-packed artichoke hearts ( drained ) | 15 ounces sliced canned peaches | 3 tablespoons fine dry breadcrumbs | 2 teaspoons white sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Rinse tomatillos under running water and remove skins. Place tomatillos, 1 1/2 cups sauce and 1/2 cup olive oil in a 3 quart ovenproof casserole dish or a 6 qt. Casserole dish, cover and bake 50 minutes. Uncover and bake 10 minutes more or until tomatillos are just pliable. Meanwhile, cook artichokes in boiling water in large skillet for 5 minutes. Drain. Arrange artichokes over spaghetti in dish on top of tomatillo sauce. Add remaining tomato sauce, peaches, bread crumbs and sugar. Bake uncovered for 30 minutes, or until bubbly.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil,vanilla bean,honey peanut,tomato paste,lemon zest,dill pickle,chocolate syrup
title: Honey Peanut Spread
ingredients: 1 cup honey roasted salted peanuts | 3/4 cup vegetable oil | 1/3 cup honey dry roasted peanuts, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons minced fresh dill pickles, or more to taste | 1 tablespoon grated lemon zest | 1 1/2 teaspoons vanilla bean | 2 1/2 tablespoons tomato paste | 2 1/2 tablespoons chocolate syrup
instructions: Place the peanuts in a bowl, and coarsely chop. Whisk the vegetable oil into the honey peanut mixture until smooth. Stir in the peanuts, pickles, lemon zest, and vanilla bean until evenly combined. Add tomato paste, and stir until coated. Transfer to a medium bowl, and stir in chocolate syrup.

Random Ingredients: roast beef,pepper,vegetable oil cooking spray,baby green,veal scallop
title: Pork and Beef Hash
ingredients: 24 ounces pork and beef hash browns ( about 4 servings, or a 10 oz box of pork hash browns ) or 24 ounces veal stew meat ( about 4 servings, or a 10 oz box of pork hash browns ) | vegetable oil cooking spray ( or cooking oil ) | 2 cups packed baby mixed greens | 1 package shredded roast beef | 3/4 teaspoon fresh ground pepper
instructions: Place hash and meat in a bowl, and stir gently to mix. Spread hash mixture on a large nonstick cookie sheet, about 2 inches apart, and spray with cooking spray or oil. Cut out four 1 inch squares of aluminum foil and place them on the side of a dinner plate. Alternate layers of hash, meat, lettuce, beef, and sprinkle of pepper. Wrap in the aluminum foil, and place on 350°f for 10 minutes. Remove from oven, and unwrap from foil. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: okra,green chili pepper,beef tenderloin,simple syrup,marjoram,graham cracker crumb,bow tie pasta,tomato
title: Beef in Sweet Pepper Tomato Gravy
ingredients: 3 lbs beef tenderloin, cut into medallions | 24 ounces baby carrots ( baby potatoes ) | 1 large green chili pepper, sliced into rings ( or 3-4 small red bell peppers ) | 24 ounces rotel tomatoes ( about 28 ounces ) | 1/4 cup simple syrup | 8 ounces prepared spanish flat-leaf pickled okra, cut in 1/2 inch slices | 4 ounces graham cracker crumbs ( about 1 1/2 cups ) | 1 teaspoon dried marjoram
instructions: Place beef over medium heat in a large dutch oven and sear to desired doneness, about 10 minutes. Reduce heat to medium low, stir in carrots, tomatoes with juice, and simple syrup. Simmer 15 minutes. Preheat oven to 350°f. Spray a 9x13 baking dish with nonstick spray. Toss okra with graham cracker crumbs. Spread in a single layer atop tomato gravy and sprinkle with marjoram. Bake 15 minutes or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: dark rum,ciabatta,graham cracker crumb,grain rice,spaghetti,yeast,chicken broth
title: Rice Bread and Rum Bread
ingredients: 1 large ciabatta or 1 large loaf round bread, sliced 1/2-in. thick | 1 1/2 ounces rice or 1 1/2 ounces other grain bread, cut into 1/2-in. cubes | 1 3/4 cups low sodium chicken broth | 3 1/2 teaspoons instant yeast ( such as fleischmann's ) | 1 3/4 teaspoons dark rum or 1 3/4 teaspoons braggs liquid aminos | 2 1/2 3/4 cups short-grain rice or 3 1/2 cups long grain rice | 1 ounce uncooked spaghetti
instructions: Place the ciabatta or bread slices on a baking sheet, spray with nonstick spray and place on rack in oven. Set in warm spot or cool slightly. Meanwhile, combine 1 cup of the broth with the rice and yeast in a bowl. Allow to blend and rest for 10 minutes. Add to a larger bowl and stir the remaining 3 cups broth into the mixture, then add the rum and stir to combine. Let stand for 15 minutes. Strain through a towel and use as a topping for the bread. To make bread dough, place bread dough in a floured bowl and cover with a clean cloth. Set on counter and knead till smooth. Place in an oiled bowl and cover with a clean cotton cloth. Set in warm spot for 30 minutes or till dough is doubled in size. Preheat oven to 350°f punch hole in loaf with a skewer or fingers. Spread the bread with rice and then layer rice/sour mix over bottom in a 13 x 9 pan. Sprinkle top with 1/4 cup of the reserved broth. Cover with foil and bake until beginning to brown around the middle and a toothpick inserted in center comes out clean, about 50 minutes. Check for doneness by inserting a toothpick halfway through. If toothpick comes out clean, bake uncovered about 10 minutes longer. Remove foil and bake another 10 - 15 minutes or till bread has a hollow hollow, lightly browned crust and broth is bubbly.

title: Indian Coconut Milk
ingredients: 1 cup coconut milk | 1/4 white onion, chopped fine | 2 cardamom seeds, crushed | 1/4 teaspoon powdered cardamom ( optional )
instructions: Put coconut milk, onion and a cardamom pod in a skillet on high heat and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to very low and simmer for 10 minutes. Stir in powdered cardamom. Garnish with flaked almonds and serve.

title: Mexican Cheese Dip
ingredients: 1 can whole milk shredded monterey jack cheese | 1 onion, seeded and finely chopped | 2 tablespoons sour cream or 2 tablespoons light cream
instructions: Combine the cheese, onion, sour cream, salt and pepper. Place in a 9 inch glass pie plate. Bake in 350 degree oven for 15 minutes, or until bubbly.

title: Barley - Japanese Style Rice Salad
ingredients: 1 package ladyfingers | 1 green bell pepper, chopped | 1/4 cup chopped green onion | 1 cup quick cooking barley | 1 tablespoon oil
instructions: Wash and roll ladyfinger in cold water until covered. Drain and spread with cooking barley. Dot with green onion. Mix oil and salad dressing ingredients well. Pour over salad and toss. Add more chopped green onions if desired.

title: Mexican Sausage & Potato Wedges
ingredients: 3 lbs potatoes, peeled | 1 tablespoon dried cilantro leaves | 1 teaspoon dried sage | 1/2 teaspoon flour | 1/3 cup dry red wine
instructions: Slice the potatoes diagonally in half, then place the cut side down on a wire rack. Cut a cross in the top, then sprinkle the cilantro and sage all over. Dredge the potato wedges in flour and set aside. Rinse the potato wedges and pat dry. Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat, add 2 t oil. Place the potato wedges in the skillet and fry until browned on both sides, 4 minutes per side. Transfer the wedges to a plate and tent with foil. Pour off most of the oil. Reduce the heat to medium and sprinkle the potato wedges evenly with the red wine. Cover and cook for 12 minutes. Season with salt and pepper.

Random Ingredients: ra el hanout spice mix,savoy cabbage
title: Tabbouleh Cabbage with Raisins & Miso (Moroccan Cabbage)
ingredients: 1 head savoy cabbage ( or any other cabbage of choice ) | 1/2 teaspoon saffron ( or to taste ) | 1 tablespoon ras el hanout spice mix
instructions: Peel cabbage from root end then cut into about 1 pieces or shred. Place cabbage in a wide container, with about 1 1/2 cup of water to help keep things from drying out. Cover and store in the refrigerator for at least 8 hours. Rinse the cabbage several times. Tear off pieces of cabbage from the cabbouleh if any, removing the leaves as they sit on the sink or table. Place shredded cabbage into a colander and sprinkle saffron over the top. Cover with plastic wrap or a towel to keep it from drying out. Heat a heavy skillet over medium heat. When the pan is hot add oil and saute cabbage until it crisps but isn't crisp. Remove cabbage from pan and drain on paper towels. Add the raisins and saffron to the cabbage and mix well. To serve, serve cabbous with harissa on the side.

title: Nigerian Bread Salad
ingredients: 6 croissants, split lengthwise | 12 leaves fresh spinach | 1/4 cup guacamole | 1/4 cup plain yogurt | 3 slices bacon, chopped | 2 tablespoons peanut oil ( or olive oil ) | 1/2 cup shredded monterey jack cheese
instructions: Split croissants lengthwise.

title: Tropical Pear Salad
ingredients: 10 bartlett pears, cored, quartered lengthwise and sliced | 4 cups romaine lettuce, shredded | 1 red bell pepper, seeded and cut in julienne strips | 1/2 cup chopped fresh coriander | 3 1/2 cups chopped lettuce
instructions: Add the pears to a salad bowl. Place the romaine into the salad bowl. Lay strips of the red bell pepper and coriander around the salad. Pour the dressing over and toss to coat. Add the sour cream if desired. Chill until very cold before serving.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon powder,chicken bouillon granule,red pepper flake
title: Simple Mexican Chicken
ingredients: 2 tablespoons chicken bouillon granules | 1 1/2 teaspoons crushed red pepper flakes | 1/2 teaspoon beef bouillon powder
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a crockpot. Cover and cook on high 4 - 6 hours. Remove from crockpot to cool down. Use two forks and shred meat back in the crockpot.

Random Ingredients: salmon fillet,cannellini bean,green chili pepper,chinese black mushroom,sugar
title: Black Forest Salmon
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs salmon fillets, about 4 to 6 inches in diameter | 1 teaspoon chinese black mushrooms, finely chopped | 1 can cannellini beans, drained | 1/2 teaspoon sugar | 1 small green chili pepper, chopped
instructions: Rinse fish under running water and pat dry with paper towels. Using a large, sharp knife, score the fleshy part from the tail to back. Place each in the cavity of either a medium or large heavy skillet. Spoon the beans on the fish, then sprinkle with the sugar. Add the chile and simmer until the fish is cooked, about 10 minutes. Serve warm as a side.

title: Sweet 'n Heat
ingredients: 3 cups broccoli ( flowerets ) | 6 tablespoons hot bean | 3 tablespoons light corn syrup | 3 tablespoons light molasses | 2 tablespoons chopped pickles ( you can buy this in the can ) | 1 tablespoon molasses
instructions: Break up broccoli flowerets into florets. Boil for 1 minute or until bright green. Immediately drain and set aside. Combine all ingredients in a medium size bowl. Stir until well mixed. Toss with hot bean florets. This goes great on it's own or as a side dish with other vegetables such as a side dish with potatoes.

title: Champagne Jelly II
ingredients: 1 teaspoon cornstarch | 1/2 cup cognac | 1/2 large eye chile, chopped | 1/2 pound button mushrooms, sliced | 1/2 cup orange soda
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix cornstarch with cognac.

title: Furikake
ingredients: 2 1/2 cm piece nori | 1 teaspoon fennel seed | 300 g prawns, cooked & coarsely chopped | 2 sheets nori
instructions: Wash and dry the nori and place on a flat surface. Place 1 - 2 cm of nori on each nori sheet. Sprinkle 1 tsp fennel seed over the nori. Break and separate the shrimp with the back of a long handled spoon, using the other side of the nori. Fold the shrimp over the nori. Bring the nori sheets together and wrap tightly in the nori. Keep in fridge for at least 4 hours or overnight. Remove from fridge and place on a serving platter and serve while warm. Serve with a fruit salad.

title: Tomato Corn Chips
ingredients: 1 can tomato paste | corn chips | coarse ground black pepper, to taste
instructions: Pour tomato paste into a resealable plastic bag. Insert sharp knife blade into bag.

title: Horseradish Sauce for Pork and Beef
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups bottled prepared horseradish | 1 cup syrup | salt and pepper to taste
instructions: In a blender or food processor, combine horseradish, syrup, salt and pepper and puree until smooth.

title: Lamb Chops on Garbanzo Beans and Bread
ingredients: 1 can garbanzo beans, drained | 8 -10 thick sliced bread | 1 1/2 - 2 lbs trimmed lamb
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Place bread slices in a greased 9x13 pan and bake for 10 minutes. Place the lamb chops between slices of wax paper and pound into a 1/2 inch thickness. Place in a colander and drain about 1/2 cup of the drained garbanzo beans over the lamb. Arrange bread slices on top of the soaked garbanzos and bake for an additional 5 - 10 minutes or until lamb chops are firm and browned.

title: Hot Scotch Bonnet Pepper Sauce
ingredients: 1 scotch bonnet pepper | 2 1/2 tablespoons cider vinegar
instructions: Split open the scotch bonnet. Slice pepper in half, scrape out the seeds using a small spoon. Scrape seeds from pepper into a saucepan, bring to a boil. Remove from heat, cool, and set aside. Strain the liquid in the saucepan to remove any seeds. Bring liquid to a boil over medium heat. Reduce temperature to low, and simmer for a couple of minutes. The longer it simmers, the more flavorful it will become. Remove from heat, and allow to cool and thicken slightly. This will keep for months and weeks refrigerated.

title: Spiced Tomato Mango Chutney
ingredients: 1 jar mango chutney | 1 jar mild salsa | 1 mexican-style diced tomatoes | 1 small red chilies, chopped
instructions: Dump all ingredients into a medium size bowl.

Random Ingredients: sirloin,pumpkin pie spice,hash brown,xanthan gum,cracker,curry powder,part mozzarella cheese,half
title: Kittencal's Cheesy Curry Beef and Pot Sticker Mini Muffins
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs ground sirloin | 1 package hash browns or ( 1 1/2 ounce ) package white potatoes, such as french fries | 1 cup half-and-half | 1/8 teaspoon xanthan gum ( optional ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons curry powder | 1 1/2 teaspoons pumpkin pie spice ( or you may want to use mrs. dash's pumpkin spice blend ) | 1 1/4 cups grated part-skim mozzarella cheese ( about 4 ounces ) | 1/2 cup crushed cracker, crushed ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line a 12 cup muffin tin w/banana paper liners.

title: Raspberry and Date Jam
ingredients: 400 g raspberries | 400 g dates
instructions: Wash fresh raspberries and dates. Put them in a pan with water and bring to the boil. Reduce the heat and cook 15 minutes until the pulp starts to wrinkle. Add fresh raspberries and dates and cook a further 5 minutes. Set them on the jam on absorbent paper. You can use a fine mesh strainer or a cheese cloth to drain away excess water.

title: Mennonite Corn Dogs
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs ground chuck | 1 can cornflour | margarita mix, for dipping
instructions: Combine ground chuck, corn flour, and margarita mix in bowl until well combined and then add more corn flour to aid in mixing and divide into 8 pieces. Shape each piece into a ball. Dip the ball in margarita mix and place on an oiled baking sheet. Broil until they turn golden brown and crispy.

Random Ingredients: sun tomato,mexican tomato,panko japanese bread crumb
title: Sun-Dried Tomato, Tomato & Cheese Melt
ingredients: 2 cups prepared panko japanese-style seasoned bread crumbs | 1 cup sun-dried tomato | 2/3 cup mexican-style stewed tomatoes ( such as salsa-dijon )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300°f scatter 1 cup of the panko on a large baking sheet. Spread toasted panko into a shallow pan. Bake until lightly toasted, about 10 minutes. Spread sun dried tomatoes over the toasted crumbs on the baking sheet. Spoon stewed tomatoes evenly over the sun dried tomatoes, not quite to the edge. Top with the remaining bread crumbs, sprinkle with the remaining 1/3 cup of panko. Bake until toasted and cheese is melted, about 15 minutes.

title: Azerbaijani (Sponge Rolls) Rice Balls
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups arborio rice ( short grain ) | 1 cup packed finely chopped fresh mint | 1 cup packed finely chopped fresh cherries or 1 cup canned cherry tomatoes, drained and chopped | 8 slices bacon, cooked crisp and crumbled | 1/2 cup quick-cooking oil | 1/3 cup golden raisin
instructions: In a saucepan of boiling water, blanch the rice for 2 minutes.

title: Baked Outdoor Focaccia
ingredients: 550 g bottled chicken stock | 1 tablespoon arrowroot, powder or 1 tablespoon cornflour | 1 tablespoon molasses | 1 teaspoon salad oil
instructions: Put 1/4 cup of the chicken stock in a food processor and buzz for about 30 seconds, or until the stock is just a little, creamy and smooth. Add the arrowroot powder or cornflour, molasses and stir to combine. Add the oil and stir through until the mixture starts to form a dough. If the dough is too hard, add more stock. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured work surface and roll out to about 5cm/5in x 3cm/3in. Spread the dough out to about 3cm/9in thick and cut out round shapes. Arrange on a tray and bake in a preheated oven at 180c/350f/gas 6 for 20 minutes or until golden and well risen. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: grainy mustard,rigatoni pasta,purple onion,oil,icing sugar,sesame seed,celery seed
title: Sesame-Rab Grilled Rigatoni Pasta
ingredients: 12 ounces rigatoni pasta or 12 ounces penne | 12 ounces purple sweet onion, sliced | 1/4 cup chopped celery seed | 1 1/2 tablespoons sesame seeds | 3 tablespoons icing sugar | 2 tablespoons grainy mustard | 1 tablespoon oil
instructions: Cook rigatoni according to package directions, drain and rinse under cold water. Drain. In a hot skillet add olive oil. Once skillet is heated, add onions and celery. Sauté until transparent. Add sesame seeds and mustard. Mix well and add to noodles. Add 1/2 cup of water, mix well and heat through. Serve immediately. Tip, sometimes i cook the pasta according to package directions, but the result was not quite that good.

title: Tamarind Tortilla Pasta
ingredients: 1 packet tamarind paste | 1 cup ground farfalle pasta | 1 teaspoon coriander powder | crushed tortilla
instructions: Blend all ingredients in a blender till smooth. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Easy Cuban Black Bean Chicken
ingredients: 1 cup fresh orange juice | 2 cans black beans | 6 boneless skinless chicken thighs | 2 teaspoons dried dill | 1 teaspoon paprika
instructions: Prepare orange juice, put in large heavy skillet. Add chicken and dill. Season with paprika and brown on all sides. Then add black beans and cover. Simmer 10 minutes. Serve over rice.

title: Mexican Chorizo and Chilies
ingredients: 1 lb chorizo sausage | 1/2 lb hot italian sausage | 1 medium plum, chopped | 1 small chunky salsa | 3 stalks celery, chopped
instructions: Mix chorizo, sausage and plum with salsa well. Marinate in refrigerator for at least 1 hour, it keeps well. Cook as per your preference.

title: Mum's Onion Cake
ingredients: 4 -5 medium white onions, peeled | 500 g plain flour | 1 teaspoon real vanilla essence
instructions: Put the white onions in a food processor and blitz them until really fine. Put in a greased tin and bake in a moderate oven for about 1 1/4 hours. Keep an eye on it though if it starts to color too quickly. Keep an eye on it though if it gets too puffy add a little oil. For best results let it cool down. Use an electric mixer to mix your flour and vanilla. Dived your dough into 10 to 12 balls and roll them out, about the size of a large marble. Slice into rounds and arrange in a circle on top of a well greased baking tray. Bake in a moderate oven at 160 degrees for about 15 minutes or until light brown and the top is firm. Let them cool down before putting on wire racks to cool. The cake is cooked when it puffs up. Mmm.

title: Greek Style Spareribs - Parmesan Style
ingredients: 12 spareribs | 1/2 cup coarse dried white breadcrumbs | 1/3 cup chopped green onion | 1 tablespoon minced fresh oregano leaves
instructions: If possible, freeze the spareribs under cold water until ready to use. Combine crumbs, green onion and oregano in a separate bowl. Dry the spareribs and press off the excess moisture then place them in the crumbs. Coat each sparerib with the egg wash. Lightly coat each sparerib with bread crumb mixture. Heat a large non stick frying pan over medium high heat. Add the spiced spiced spiced ribs and cook until well browned, about 10 - 15 minutes. Turn over and brown on the other side, about 10 - 12 minutes longer.

title: Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil | 2 tablespoons tamari | 1/4 cup pine nuts
instructions: Finely chop sun dried tomatoes. Combine all ingredients and blend with a fork. Serve over fish or bread.

title: Indian Spicy Tomato Dip (Qatar)
ingredients: 28 ounces diced tomatoes with green chilies | 1 yellow pepper, diced | 16 ounces mild roasted peanuts, coarsely ground | 3 green cardamoms | 1/4 cup sake
instructions: Combine all ingredients in the blender and mix well. Keep refrigerated. Will keep in refrigerator in an airtight container for at least a week.

Random Ingredients: lettuce leaf,beef,chicken bouillon granule,turkey gravy,yellow mustard seed,dill,serrano pepper
title: Hot Dog Salad
ingredients: 2 slices fully cooked turkey ( deli or not, the thin slice is what i had ) | 1/4 teaspoon instant chicken bouillon granules, more if needed | 1/4 teaspoon yellow mustard seeds | 1/4 teaspoon dill, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon serrano pepper, chopped finely | 1/2 cup turkey gravy, more if needed | 3 large lettuce leaves
instructions: Place turkey slices on a microwave safe plate and top with 1/4 teaspoons each of chicken bouillon, mustard seeds, dill and chile. Cook on high power for 1 - 2 minutes, or until turkey is cooked through. Remove turkey from plate and top with other 1/4 teaspoons bouillon and mustard seeds. Add additional chile if desired. Place turkey on a serving platter. Serve with lettuce.

Random Ingredients: porcini mushroom,cardamom powder,peanut oil,taco sauce,andouille sausage
title: Nagie
ingredients: 1 cup andouille sausage, sliced and finely minced | 3 tablespoons roasted peanuts oil | 4 teaspoons instant porcini mushrooms, finely chopped | 4 tablespoons taco sauce | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom powder
instructions: Heat oil in a frying pan over medium heat. Add the mushrooms and cook for a minute or two. Pour in the seasoning and stir. Add andouille sausages and stir. Cover and cook for about 5 minutes until the mushrooms are tender.

title: Pasta Al Relleno or Arrabbiata
ingredients: 2 ounces pasta, any shape | 8 ounces chicken broth
instructions: Cook pasta al dente as directed. Drain all but 3 t of the pasta water. Add broth and bring to boil. Remove from heat. Place pasta in a large salad bowl. Add chicken broth to the skillet and bring to boil. Serve with grated parmesan or parmigiano cheese on top.

title: Cannellini Mushrooms (Cannelloni)
ingredients: 1 ounce dried porcini mushrooms | 4 tablespoons ricotta cheese
instructions: Place the dried dried mushrooms in a small bowl. Cover with boiling water and microwave until completely softened, about 5 minutes. Drain and stir into the ricotta. Allow to cool, then refrigerate.

Random Ingredients: romano cheese,pecorino romano cheese,chipotle chile adobo,button mushroom
title: Ww 3 Points - Mushrooms With Cheese
ingredients: 8 ounces button mushrooms, trimmed | 1 tablespoon pecorino romano cheese, finely grated | 1 can chipotle chiles in adobo | 1 tablespoon pecorino romano cheese, finely grated | 1 medium romano cheese, grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. In a small bowl, mix together pecorino romano and pecorino cheese. Tear off two pieces of large foil, approximately 8 by 8 by 1/4 in diameter and 3 across, about 10 x. Put one piece at a time on a clean dry surface. Rub the mushrooms with the romano and cheese mixture. Place a mushroom atop each mushroom, and fold up the top to bottom until it is fully encased. Place each mushroom on a parchment lined baking sheet, seam side down. Bake until tops are light brown, and the cheese is bubbly, about 25 minutes. Remove from oven, and serve hot or warm.

title: Manicotti
ingredients: 12 manicotti | 1 1/2 cups yellow onions, chopped | 2 cups whole wheat flour | 1 1/2 teaspoons sweet paprika
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add the noodles and cook until just fork tender, 7 to 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: parmigiano reggiano cheese,spanish onion,potato flour,tomato juice,butternut squash,dark chocolate
title: Linda's butternut Squash, Tomato and Chocolate Stew
ingredients: 2 lbs butternut squash, peeled, cubed and cooked | 1 spanish onion, finely chopped | 4 ounces dark chocolate, chopped | 1 1/2 cups peeled tomatoes with juice, diced | 2 tablespoons potato flour, plus extra | parmigiano-reggiano cheese, for sprinkling | 2 tablespoons parmigiano-reggiano cheese, for sprinkling, garnish
instructions: Add butter to a large, deep pan and melt over low heat. Add butternut squash chunks, onions and chocolate and stir in tomato and cook over low heat for 15 minutes, stirring constantly until sauce has thickened. Stir in potato flour and 2 teaspoons of cheese until combined well. If you like a hotter stew, add a few tablespoons of water. Serve stew with remaining cheese sprinkled on top.

title: Toad in the Hole
ingredients: 2 cups bisquick | 1/2 teaspoon salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Sift flour and salt together. Make a well and carefully mix in Bis' water. Beat until smooth. Pinch off a tablespoon of dough in the center of a large spoon. Make a hole in the center of the dough and press it with the palm of the spoon. Fill to the top with a 1/2 teaspoon of mixture. Bake in the preheated oven for 20 to 25 minutes or until golden.

title: Aubergine (Eggplant) on Toast
ingredients: 1 small aubergine, eggplant | whipped cream or strawberry jam
instructions: Cut the aubergine in half lengthways and scoop out the centre of the skin. Cut the eggplant in half, drizzle over the jam and continue to cook until lightly browned. Serve with seasonal salad and plenty of fresh young bread.

title: Guinness Eggplant and Eggplant in Tomato Sauce
ingredients: 6 japanese eggplants ( aka baby eggplant, not regular eggplant ) | vegetable oil | 2 fluid ounces guinness stout | 1 tablespoon tomato ketchup
instructions: Trim eggplant, leave in stripes on all sides. Cut an x on the top of each and then deep fry in hot oil until lightly coloured. Remove to paper towels to drain. In heavy pan, heat enough oil to just cover the bottom of the pan, add eggplant and fry for 2 minutes. Stir in guinness and tomato ketchup. Cover & simmer slowly for about 10 minutes. Serve with rice.

title: Pesto Garlic & Roasted Bell Peppers Bruschetta
ingredients: 2 large yellow bell peppers, roasted | 4 tablespoons basil pesto | 1 loaf croissant, sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 250°f. Place bell peppers on a baking sheet & roast, 20 - 25 minutes. Remove from oven & let cool at least 10 minutes. Peel off the skin & place peppers in a bowl. Dress with pesto. Serve on croissant slices. Note, you can skip the preparation & just toast it the day before, then slice before serving the bruschetta.

title: Easy Sour Cream Dill Sauce
ingredients: 2 -4 tablespoons whipping cream or 2 -4 tablespoons heavy cream | 1 -2 tablespoon spring onion, chopped finely | drippings ( optional )
instructions: Blend in mixer/grinder and serve immediately. If necessary, add additional whipping cream to thicken slightly. If desired, can be added to a gravy and heated over pan/simmer.

Random Ingredients: yoghurt,red pepper flake,lobster meat,tortellini,greek yogurt,jalapeno pepper,raspberry
title: Lobster Ravioli With Yogurt Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 package refrigerated filled tortellini | 1 package frozen lobster meat, thawed and drained | 1/2 cup fresh raspberry ( or frozen ) | 1/4 cup green greek yogurt | 1/3 medium chopped jalapeno pepper | 1/4 cup chopped red pepper flakes | 1/8 cup fat free plain greek yogurt
instructions: Cook tortellini according to package instructions. Drain and put aside in a large serving bowl. Meanwhile, cook lobster in a pan of boiling water for 3 to 5 minutes or until cooked through. Drain and set aside. Remove skillet from heat and whisk in raspberries and yoghurt, mixing well. Add marinated lobster and toss to coat. Divide between serving bowls and serve immediately with greek yogurt dipping sauce for dipping. This is traditionally served as is for the dipping sauces.

Random Ingredients: pine nut,peach preserve apricot,pasta sauce mushroom,vinegar,maple syrup,simple syrup,garlic flake
title: Pasta With Peaches and Maple Syrup
ingredients: 1 jar pasta sauce or ( 4 ounce ) jar mushroom sauce, i use maple syrup | 2 2 cups pineapple nuts ( chopped or pureed fresh ) or 1 cup peaches, drained and diced ( optional ) | 1 can peach preserves ( i add in fresh mushrooms to this ) | 1 tablespoon vinegar | 1 teaspoon pure maple syrup | 1 tablespoon simple syrup | 1/2 teaspoon minced garlic flakes | 2 teaspoons minced fresh basil or 2 teaspoons of dried basil
instructions: Boil water for pasta. Combine syrup, preserves, vinegars, maple syrup, garlic and basil. Drain pasta. Return pasta and sauce to pan. Toss to combine. Chill in refrigerator or serve at once.

title: Gourmet Refried Beans
ingredients: 1 can cannellini beans, rinsed and drained | 1 can cannellini beans, rinsed and drained | 1 jar roasted red peppers | 1/4 cup italian dressing, or more to taste
instructions: Stir the cannellini and cannellini beans into the prepared beans. Chop roasted red peppers into 1/4 inch pieces, and combine with red peppers in a frying pan.

Random Ingredients: bisquick,bell pepper,white vinegar,za'atar spice mix,italian sausage,basil,walnut
title: Basil & Za'atar Sausage Wraps
ingredients: 2 tablespoons za'atar spice mix ( a mix of za'atar & za'atar ) | 2 tablespoons white vinegar | 1/2 cup finely chopped walnuts ( optional ) | 10 slices sweet italian sausage | 2 bell peppers, finely chopped ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons fresh basil or 2 teaspoons dried basil | 12 wraps ( homemade or purchased )
