instructions: Preheat oven to 400 f. Combine 1st five ingredients in a small bowl, stirring well. Spread mixture evenly on 1 side of each wrap. Roll up each sausage roll and place on a cookie sheet. Bake approximately 10 minutes or until rolls are golden and crispy. Slice each sausage roll into 3 or 4 slices and serve rolled in basil. Variation, add chopped or shredded carrot, zucchini, peppers, or hot peppers & onions to make a veggie filling or sauté.

Random Ingredients: black eyed pea,sage,pasta shell,bulk pork sausage,bay leaf,spinach leaf,white wheat flour,maple syrup
title: Pierogies
ingredients: 16 ounces bulk pork sausage | 2 tablespoons maple syrup | 2 tablespoons dried sage | 1 1/2 cups dried black-eyed peas | 1/2 cup white whole wheat flour | 2 bay leaves ( or 1 tbsp of each ) | 4 cups fresh spinach leaves, washed, packed, chopped | 12 ounces pasta shells ( fettuccine, your choice cooked )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees and oil a 10 inch springform pan. In a skillet cook sausage over medium high heat until no longer pink. Drain of excess liquid, then add maple syrup, sage, peas and flour, stirring until well blended. Fold in the bay leaves. Spread mixture evenly in prepared pan. Cover with bacon. Bake about 50 minutes, or until browned and bubbly. Meanwhile, boil a large pot of water, then add pasta and cook according to package directions. Drain and reserve 1/2 cup of pasta cooking liquid while preparing the soup. Place reserved liquid back over medium heat and add spinach and sausage mixture. Cover and cook for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally. Add pasta and cook for 5 - 10 minutes longer and serve at once.

title: Chinese Style Beef Tenderloin (Gung Tzu)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef tenderloin | 4 1/2 tablespoons adobo sauce | 1 1/2 teaspoons butter or 1 1/2 teaspoons margarine | 1/2 cup shiitake mushroom
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f degrees. Cut tenderloin into 2” wide slices. Place in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: balsamic vinegar,fettuccine pasta,grain rice,sumac,chocolate ice cream
title: Balsamic Rice Pudding
ingredients: 1 lb fettuccine pasta | 1 tablespoon aged balsamic vinegar or 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon ground sumac | 1 pint chocolate ice cream | 8 ounces shaved semisweet chocolate ( garnish ) or 8 ounces plain english toffee ice cream ( garnish )
instructions: Cook fettuccine acording to package directions and drain. In a saucepan with a tight fitting lid combine the vinegar and ground sumac. Slowly whisk in warm balsamic vinegar, and stir until the mixture boils. Boil for one minute, then remove from heat. Add the rice and stir until completely cooked. Transfer to a large, flameproof bowl, cover tightly and keep warm in a medium temperature oven for 5 minutes. Remove bowl from oven. Quickly fill 1/4 of the pudding with the ice cream. Spoon 1/2 cup of mixture into center of ice cream, top with 1/4 of the chocolate morsels or toffee bits. Using a sharp knife, cut the ice cream into small cubes or chunks. Spoon remaining mixture around the ice cream. Garnish with remaining chocolate pieces.

Random Ingredients: sumaq,masa harina flour,rigatoni pasta,pork loin roast
title: Paella
ingredients: 1 lamb loin roast ( or any other white meat suitable for roasting ) | 2 cups masa harina flour | 1 package rigatoni pasta | 2 tablespoons ground sumaq
instructions: If using beef, then marinate in it's own juice for 4 - 5 hours or overnight in the fridge. If using lamb cut into 1 cm cubes, place in roasting pan and sprinkle with ground sumak, roast. Bake at 400 degrees for 1 hour. After 1 hour of cooking increase temperature to 425 degrees and continue baking until meat thermometer reads 140 degrees for medium.. Remove lamb from oven and pull meat from bone, discard bone and skin. If using venison remove bone and skin and set aside in separate container for meat broth. Place 1 cup of flour in another container and add water to make dough like you want, adding more water if too sticky just add a little flour to create dough. If dough is too sticky just add a tablespoon of flour to make dough like you want. Roll out dough on floured surface until about 2 mm thick, cut into 3 inch squares. Place meat in a separate container or plate and cover with flour, then a tsp of sumak and coat well. After 1 hour of baking the meat, take from oven, and put meat aside on baking sheet, then repeat until out of meat. Cut meat into the desired size pieces and sprinkle with sumak. Let rest for 10 minutes. Bake at 425 degrees for 30 - 35 minutes or until meat is cooked through. Serving tip.

title: Beef Stew
ingredients: 2 lbs chuck | 1 large vegetable bouillon cube | 1 cup vegetable stock ( beef or lamb stock ) | 3 tablespoons balsamic vinegar
instructions: Cube lamb, add to crockpot. Add veggie stock, add bouillon cube and vinegar. Cook on low 8 hours or high 6 hours..

title: Tofu Julep
ingredients: 1 package tofu, frozen and thawed, drained | 2 blood oranges, quartered | 3/4 cup mexican style tomatoes | 12 tablespoons mexican style ketchup | 1 tablespoon mirin | shredded mexican cheese blend | toasted mexican creme fraiche ( optional )
instructions: Slice tofu into strips about 1/4 inch wide but not paper thin. Place the tofu and oranges in a medium sized bowl and pour enough juice from the tomatoes to cover the tofu. Set aside. Cut tomatoes in half down the middle and remove pulp from seeds and pulp. Slice into 1/4 inch strips and add to orange juice. Pour in the mexican style ketchup and mirin and mix thoroughly. Add tofu and orange strips and stir in the mexican cheese. Serve with toasted creme fraiche if desired.

Random Ingredients: cool whip,basmati rice,brown gravy mix,farfalle pasta,cumin powder,bread flour,lettuce leaf,water chestnut
title: Elegant Rice and Bacon Wraps
ingredients: 7 -10 slices round bread flour | 1/4 teaspoon cumin powder | 1 1/2 cups warm water | 7/8 cup brown gravy mix | 2/3 cup basmati rice | 1 can sliced water chestnuts, drained | 1 can cool whip, beaten | 1 package refrigerated crispy farfalle pasta, warmed | lettuce leaf
instructions: Heat brown gravy mix, water, rice and water chestnuts in a medium saucepan, stirring to combine. Reduce heat, cover and simmer for 15 minutes or until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed and water has been absorbed. Cover and set aside for 5 minutes or until liquid has been absorbed. Uncover and fluff well with a fork. Spoon into 1 - 2 x 1 1/4 cup wrappers. Top each wrap with 1 tbls of cooled whip. Fold corner of each wrap inward to create a border of approximately 1 - 2 1/2 in diameter. Pinch each to close. Place on a greased baking sheet. Bake in a 425°f oven for approximately 15 minutes or until golden brown on the top and bottom. Allow to cool for approximately 10 minutes. Remove from baking sheet to a platter and set aside. Warm farfalle, lettuce leaves or your favorite salad. Serve warm with warm gravy or sweet and sour sauce.

Random Ingredients: stewing beef,flour tortilla,brazil nut,salt black pepper,rice wine vinegar,orange marmalade,button mushroom
title: Beef and Grapes
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 teaspoon orange marmalade | 1 tablespoon rice wine vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon salt & freshly ground black pepper | 8 ounces button mushrooms, sliced | 4 flour tortillas, warmed | 1/2 cup brazil nut slices ( see note )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Combine beef with marmalade, rice wine vinegar, salt and pepper in a small baking dish. Spoon marmalade mixture into center of tortillas. Top with mushrooms and arrange on top of beef. If desired, garnish with additional slices of the pine nuts. Place dish in a baking pan. Bake uncovered for 40 minutes or until beef is tender. Turn off heat. Spoon the meat mixture over tortillas and serve.

Random Ingredients: meat tenderizer,pomegranate seed,greek yogurt,creme fraiche,cod fillet
title: Cod With Pomegranate and Yogurt
ingredients: cod fillets or other thin-cut halibut | 1/2 teaspoon meat tenderizer | 7 tablespoons creme fraiche | 1 tablespoon greek yogurt | 1 tablespoon pomegranate seeds
instructions: Sprinkle meat with tenderizer. Whip together the creme fraîche, yogurt and pomegranate seeds in a bowl. Dip the cod fillets into the yogurt mixture and fry in hot pan over medium heat on each side for 2 - 3 minutes. Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Grilled Ramen Salad
ingredients: 4 ounces ramen noodles | 2 ounces salad dressing | 1 clove garlic, minced
instructions: Cook ramen noodles per package instructions. Drain and add salad dressing, garlic and stir fry until dressing is well blended and dressing is hot and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: red curry paste,potato,cherry tomato,cumin,parsley,ginger,olive oil,anise seed
title: Sweet Potato & Cherry Tomato Salad
ingredients: 2 tablespoons olive oil | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 1/8 teaspoon anise seed | 1 1/2 kg sweet potatoes, peeled and cut into matchsticks | 400 g cherry tomatoes, halved | 140 g red curry paste, mild | 1 teaspoon cumin | 1 teaspoon ground anise seed | 1 teaspoon ground anise seed | 1 teaspoon ground fresh parsley | 1 teaspoon fresh ginger, grated
instructions: Heat wok over high heat until smoking.

Random Ingredients: chuck,pasta sauce,sesame seed,anise seed,chocolate,active yeast,flour tortilla,peanut oil
title: Cousin Pete's Faux Chimichangas
ingredients: 1 packet active dry yeast | 1 tablespoon ground anise seed, or more to taste | 1 1/2 cups warm water | 1 cup pizza sauce or 1 cup cooked pizza sauce | 4 1/2 cups unbleached flour tortillas | 3 1/2 ounces bittersweet chocolate, finely chopped | 1/8 teaspoon sesame seeds ( optional ) | peanut oil ( optional ) | chocolate-covered chichangas, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Sprinkle the yeast over the warm water, and let stand 5 minutes until the yeast softens and begins to foam. Whisk in the pizza sauce, and stir to combine. Place the flour tortillas onto a cutting board, and with a meat mallet, lightly pound and flatten the tortillas into 8 even disks using a rolling pin. Spread a thin layer of the pizza sauce onto the tortillas, then spread another thin layer of sauce on the tortillas. Sprinkle each disk lightly with the chocolate, sesame seeds, and remaining toppings.

Random Ingredients: rom tomato,roasting chicken,nutritional yeast,sun tomato oil
title: Roma Tomato & Sun-Dried Tomato Chicken (Baked or Broiled)
ingredients: 2 roasting chickens | 4 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil | 1/2 cup nutritional yeast ( optional ) | 2 roma tomatoes
instructions: Preparation step remove excess fat from the chicken and rinse under cold water. Remove the backbone. Cut the chicken into pieces or you will be using the breast. Place the chicken pieces in a baking dish, skin side up. Place in oven and roast, uncovered, at 425 for 30 minutes. Remove from oven. Make a bruschetta sauce by blending your roma tomatoes with some of the sun dried tomato oil and some other ingredients, adding salt and freshly ground pepper to taste, or use a mix of any of the following, garlic powder, cayenne pepper, dried parsley. You can also mix the sun dried tomato oil with basting sauce. Bake at 425 degrees for about 20 minutes or until tender. Remove from oven and pour bruschetta on top.

Random Ingredients: head broccoli,mexican cheese,dill pickle,pie shell,artichoke heart,part mozzarella cheese
title: Tuna and Vegetable Quiche
ingredients: 2 cans tuna packed in water, drained and flaked | 3 cups shredded mexican cheese blend | 1/2 cup chopped fresh parsley, divided | 1/2 cup chopped fresh dill pickles, divided | 1 box frozen artichoke hearts, thawed | 1 unbaked pie shells
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. In a large bowl, stir together tuna, 3 cups cheese, 1/2 cup parsley, and pickles. Arrange artichoke hearts on the bottom of a pie dish. Pour tuna mixture evenly over the artichokes. Top with remaining cheese and 1/2 cup parsley. Bake in preheated oven until the quiche is bubbly and the edges have begun to brown, 25 to 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: whipping cream,onion flake,ranch bean,quince,beef tenderloin,chicken breast half,lemon juice zest
title: Chicken and Quince Soup
ingredients: 4 chicken breast halves, skin removed | 1 lb beef tenderloin, trimmed and cut into 1/4 inch cubes | 2 lemon juice and zest of | 1/4 - 1/2 cup onion flakes | 1 1/2 cups romano beans, with liquid | 3/4 cup whipping cream | 1 jar quince, drained and pureed
instructions: Place chicken, beef, lemon juice and zest, onion and lemon juice in crockpot. Cover and cook on high for 3 to 4 hours. Stir in romano beans. Add cream. Cover and cook on high for another 15 to 30 minutes. Puree quince in an electric hand blender. Serve at once. Serve.

title: Quick Salsa Wraps
ingredients: 1 lb cremini mushroom | 1 - 1 1/2 tablespoon chili powder | 1 1/2 tablespoons chopped fresh basil | 1 jar of thick & chunky salsa
instructions: Remove tops from mushrooms, slice mushrooms. Place mushrooms and fresh basil in bowl and mix with remaining ingredients. Chill in fridge until ready to use.

Random Ingredients: head savoy cabbage,italian dressing,black mustard seed
title: Italian Coleslaw
ingredients: 1 head savoy cabbage - rinsed, dried, and shredded | 1 teaspoon black mustard seeds, or more to taste | 1 cup italian dressing
instructions: Toss savoy cabbage with mustard seed. Drizzle dressing over the top, and refrigerate.

title: Star Fruit and Cinnamon Baked in a Bread Machine
ingredients: 5 star fruit, whole, not cut in half ( try to get different colors ) | 4 basil leaves, fresh, torn | 1 tablespoon molasses
instructions: Place all the ingredients in your bread machine in the order recommended by its manufacturer. Select your bread setting.

title: Scallop and Pumpkin Pie
ingredients: 1 lb fresh salmon | 8 ounces fresh pumpkin | 1 pint heavy whipping cream
instructions: Slice the salmon so it will sit flat on a cutting board. Slice the pumpkin into long pieces about 1/4 inch wide and 2 inches long. Bring a kettle or large potful of water to a boil. Put the salmon in the boiling water and let it boil for about 10 minutes, then remove from the water and keep it warm in the preheated oven. When finished, drain it and put it into a bowl of cold water to stop the cooking and cool the salmon slightly. When the salmon is cool, remove all the skin and bones, and slice in thin slices about 2 inches long and 2 inches wide. Heat the cream in a large, deep skillet. As soon as you see the bubbles coming from the cream, take it out of the heat. Pour the hot cream over the salmon until it is completely covered. Put the salmon into a greased and floured pie dish. Spread the pumpkin slices and scallops over it. Cover with whipped cream and bake in a 425 degree oven until the filling is hot and the top is brown.

title: Green and Gold Tasty Vegetarian Kefta Balls
ingredients: 1 package mangoes, peeled & pitted | 2 tablespoons fresh mint, washed | 1/2 cup finely chopped walnuts | 1/2 cup fruit preserves | 1/2 cup dried mango, chopped | 2 tablespoons flax seeds | 2 skewers
instructions: Mash mangoes with mint, walnuts, preserves, mango. Coarsely chop mint, and walnuts and mix into the mango mixture. Refrigerate for about 1 hour. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Thread balls on metal or bamboo skewers. Bake them for 20 to 25 minutes or until cooked and golden brown. Allow to stand for 10 minutes before turning. Serve warm.

title: Sweet and Savory Sweet Salsa Appetizer
ingredients: 1 3/4 cups sweetened salsa | 1 cup apricot preserves | 4 tablespoons sour cream or 4 tablespoons creme fraiche | 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1/4 teaspoon dried italian seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon parsley ( optional )
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in an airtight container.. Refrigerate for up to 3 days on the counter.

title: Lamb Risotto With Lemon and Herbs
ingredients: 350 g fresh lamb or 350 g lamb bones, with fat taken off | 2 lemons, zest of, grated | 350 g arborio rice | 400 g canned long-grain and wild rice mix
instructions: Cut the meat in 1 inch cubes. Place them into a large pot, add the zest and lemon zest and bring to a simmer, cover, and cook very gently until the meat is tender. While the meat is cooking, cook the arborio rice according to the directions until al dente. Keep stirring until the rice has absorbed the water and is creamy. Drain the rice, rinse, and add to the meat mixture. Bring to a boil. Reduce the heat. Cover and simmer for 15 - 20 minutes. Serve immediately.

title: Quick and Easy Black Bean Enchiladas
ingredients: 12 corn tortillas | 2 cans black beans, undrained
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Coat a 9x13 inch baking dish with cooking spray. Spread each tortilla lightly with pan liquid and roll up. Tightly roll each tortilla into a taco shape by rolling in the hot pan. Transfer to baking dish seam side down. Pour bean juices evenly over the tortillas. Cover with foil, and bake in preheated oven for 40 - 45 minutes, until hot and bubbly and topping is lightly browned.

Random Ingredients: oat,buttermilk,green enchilada sauce,pesto sauce,mushroom cap,rice vinegar,cream cheese
title: Green Mexican Rice With Oats
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked rice vinegar | 2/3 cup buttermilk | 1 package cream cheese, cut into 1/3 inch slices | 1 can green enchilada sauce | 1 jar mushroom caps, with juice, drained | 1/2 cup quick-cooking oats | 1 jar pesto sauce
instructions: Heat first 3 ingredients in a saucepan over medium heat until combined, about 5 minutes. Spoon into a 2 1/2 quart casserole, and sprinkle with the cream cheese. Top with enchilada sauce, mushrooms, and oats. Bake, covered, in a 350°f oven for 35 - 40 minutes, or until hot and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon granule,hoagie,greek yogurt,grand marnier,coriander leaf,alfredo sauce,vegetable oil cooking spray
title: Beef Submarine Sandwich
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon coriander leaves | 2 teaspoons honey-roasted french dressing ( or homemade ) | 1 dash beef bouillon granules ( or 1 packet of prepared beef bouillon cube ) | 1 container greek yogurt | 1 container alfredo sauce | 2 packages hoagie rolls, split | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil flavored cooking spray
instructions: Combine coriander and honey in small bowl. Mix with meat, pour into crockpot. Mix bouillon in same bowl. Add yogurt, stir until dissolved. Pour yogurt mixture over meat mixture. Cook on low, about 3 hours, stirring occasionally, or until cooked to desired doneness, setting temperature to low every hour. Heat oil in small skillet over medium heat. Sear both sides of half the buns under moderately high heat for 1 - 2 minutes a side or until lightly browned. Split buns and spoon half the beef mixture onto the bottom half, then top with remaining buns. Spray tops halves with olive oil and cut top halves into four wedges. Place wedges on warmed grill or large open baking sheet. Place under broiler for 2 minutes until tops are slightly charred and bubbling.

Random Ingredients: leek,macaroni,apple cider vinegar,tomato juice,roast beef,margarine,mirin,saffron thread
title: Macaroni With Beef, Leeks and Shiitaki
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon saffron thread | 1 large leek | 2 tablespoons margarine | 1/3 cup grated fresh apple cider vinegar | 1/3 cup vegetable juice or 1/3 cup tomato juice | 3 cups cubed leftover roast beef | 1/4 cup mirin or 1/4 cup soy sauce | 1 lb macaroni ( or other pasta shape )
instructions: To roast the meat, slice 2 inch strips out of the end at center of the piece of meat, and set aside. Cut away any green and pale green ends from the leek. Cut slices into 1 inch pieces.

Random Ingredients: veal,chicken consomme,white wine,corn syrup,bologna,green bell pepper,sunflower seed,fennel seed
title: Bologna Con Salsa Di Vino Bianco
ingredients: 1 pound bologna, cut into 1/2 by 3/4-inch cubes | 1 pinch fennel seeds | 1 pinch sunflower seeds | 2 pounds veal, cut into 1/2 by 3/4-inch cubes | 1 tablespoon corn syrup | 1/2 cup dry white wine | veal stock or chicken consomme, if needed | 1 green bell pepper, cut into 1/2 by 3/4-inch strips
instructions: Combine the bologna, fennel seeds, sunflower seeds, and veal cubes in a large dish. Sprinkle with corn syrup and toss to coat. Pour wine over the mixture.

Random Ingredients: egg white,cooking sherry,rotini pasta,filet beef,garlic salt,monterey jack pepper cheese,thyme,ginger powder
title: Beef & Mac 'n' Shredded Skillet
ingredients: 6 ounces rotini pasta ( or elbow macaroni ) | 1 lb ground sirloin or 1 lb top round beef | 2 teaspoons garlic salt | 1 teaspoon finely minced fresh thyme or 1 teaspoon dried thyme | 1/2 teaspoon finely minced fresh ginger powder | 4 large egg whites, lightly beaten ( for egg wash & white wash ) | 8 slices monterey jack pepper cheese | butter or margarine ( optional )
instructions: In a 5 quart slow cooker, combine beef, garlic salt, thyme, ginger and egg whites. Sprinkle lightly with salt. Cover.

title: Gefilte a la Kronenhalle
ingredients: 2 lbs beef flank steak, sliced into strips about 6 inches long | 1 -2 lemons or 1 -2 lime wedge, for brushing | 12 large roma tomatoes, cut into strips | 16 fluid ounces white vinegar
instructions: Boil the beef with two cups of water until it reaches the desired doneness, about 1 hour and 20 minutes. Drain the beef in a colander lined with a cheesecloth. Allow it to cool to room temperature, then refrigerate overnight or for at least 4 hours, for the flavors to develop. The next day, remove and discard the beef strips, and cut meat into strips about 3 inch long, 2 inches wide and 3 inches long by 4 inches wide. Arrange a layer of roma tomatoes on the bottom of a 6 inch souffle dish. Place about 2 tablespoons of meat on each tomato, and top with a second layer of roma tomatoes and 2 tablespoons of meat. Arrange another layer of roma tomatoes on top, and arrange another layer of roma tomatoes and 2 tablespoons of meat on top. Repeat, and top with 2 more cups of water. Cover and let set for 4 hours, or preferably overnight. Bring to a boil and remove from the heat. Carefully pour the mixture into a clean 6 quart pot, and stir to release all the flavor. Set aside at room temperature, and refrigerate overnight. Serve cold.

Random Ingredients: cardamom,mint sprig,apple,artichoke heart,lemon wedge,hamburger,sugar syrup,white rice
title: Apple Rice Salad
ingredients: 500 g hamburger | 1 large apple | 50 g white rice ( not minute rice which has no added fat ) | 1 lemon wedge, per person | 2 drops sugar syrup | fresh mint sprig, for garnish | artichoke heart, for garnish
instructions: Cook the hamburger until pink. Let cool slightly, and crumble it into a bowl. Dice the apple and put into the mixture. Cook the rice in a pan with a little bit of oil, and some water. Cook until it's clear, but not mushy. Drain off any excess water from the rice, and leave to cool. Mix together everything together in a salad bowl. Garnish. Serve warm.

title: Homemade French Fondue II
ingredients: 2 teaspoons freshly grated nutmeg | 3/4 cup white wine vinegar
instructions: Place the nutmeg in an 8 ounce jar, and pour in the vinegar. Close, and shake well to blend the vinegar. Store the fondue mixture in the refrigerator, until ready to use.

title: Pan Fried Chinese Caramelized Salt
ingredients: 1 teaspoon sea salt | 1 teaspoon palm oil
instructions: Pour oil into a clean frying pan and place over medium heat. When hot stir fry until it turns dark orange and caramelize. Turn and repeat two more times. When brown, drain and cool, it can be kept in the refrigerator up to 3 months. The oil will then turn rancid.

title: Escarole Turnovers
ingredients: 2 boxes frozen puff pastry, thawed | 1 bunch escarole, leaves cut off and rinsed ( stems removed ) | 1 poblano pepper ( roasted or broiled, patted dry with a paper towel )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Roll out each pastry sheet into a rectangular, 10x12 inch rectangle. Spread the cut side of each pastry with a thin layer of the roasted pepper. Cut the top of each rectangle into six strips. Place on a baking sheet and bake for 8 to 10 minutes. Remove and cool on wire racks, approximately 30 minutes.

title: Indonesian Fried Peanuts
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups dry roasted peanuts | 10 curry leaves
instructions: Heat oil in a wok or deep skillet over high heat. Stir fry peanuts until golden brown, about 30 seconds. Quickly stir curry leaves into peanuts. Toss peanuts in hot oil to separate and coat. Serve immediately.

title: Pineapple Fritters
ingredients: 1 pint pineapple juice | 500 500 g plain flour | 1/8 teaspoon nu salt substitute | 1 small clove, crushed
instructions: Boil all the sauce ingredients together in a large pan, then remove the saucepan from the heat and set aside. Combine the flour, salt and cloves in a large bowl. Add the pineapple juice and stir to combine. Mix with the dry ingredients. Knead for five minutes until the dough is fairly soft and the texture is as firm as possible but not sticky. Form into balls the size of a small cherry. Cook in a hot frypan until the fritters are golden brown and cooked through. Serve warm.

title: Cherry Rellenos
ingredients: 1/4 cup cold water | 1 package kielbasa sausage, cut in 1/2-inch thick slices | 1 pound fresh sweet cherries | 1/2 cup milk
instructions: Fill a small pot with water.

title: Pesto Oven-Baked Olives
ingredients: 1 can refrigerated pesto sauce | 1/2 cup kalamata olives, pitted and halved
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Spread pesto sauce evenly onto a baking sheet. Arrange kalamata olives over pesto. Bake in preheated oven until top is brown and bubbly, 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Tomato Based Sauce
ingredients: 100 ml tomato ketchup | 100 ml peanut sauce
instructions: In a pot combine all ingredients and heat until warmed through. Serve over fresh vegetables or rice.

title: Shrimp Cocktail
ingredients: 12 ounces boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 6 ounces shrimp, shelled and deveined | 1 teaspoon sugar | 3 teaspoons grenadine bitters | 6 teaspoons kewra essence
instructions: Put the chicken breasts in a bowl and sprinkle with the sugar. Pour a tablespoon of water into the bowl to moisten the chicken. Add the shrimp and stir until they turn pink. Stir in the remaining shrimp and grenadine, and serve immediately.

title: Italian Sweet Pepper Molasses
ingredients: 1 2/3 cups dark corn syrup or 1 2/3 cups light corn syrup | 1/4 teaspoon pepper | 1/2 cup molasses
instructions: In small saucepan, combine butter, corn syrup, molasses and heavy cream. Heat, but do not boil. Continue cooking over low heat until hot and thickened, about 20 minutes. Cool on wire rack. Serve warm.

title: Grated Ouzo Spread
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups mayonnaise, divided | 1 tablespoon ouzo or 1 tablespoon mayonnaise
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together 1/4 cup of the mayonnaise and the 1 tablespoon of ouzo or mayonnaise. Beat into remaining 1/4 cup of mayonnaise. Transfer the dip to a small serving bowl, and stir in 1 tablespoon of ouzo. Cover, and refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Gurkali
ingredients: 1 kg burghul | 1 tablespoon smoked paprika
instructions: Using a spoon, tear off small pieces of burghul and place them in a plastic bag with the smoked paprika. Seal and leave for at least 4 hours. To serve, remove as much air as possible from the burghul. Heat a griddle to about 150c/fan ovens/gas place the burghul on the griddle and sprinkle with the gurkali. Cook for 3 - 5 mins or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: banana,worcestershire sauce,chinese five spice powder,cannellini bean
title: Fruit & Vegatable One Pee
ingredients: 400 g cannellini beans or 400 g bijol fusilli | 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce, plus a little extra | 2 teaspoons chinese five spice powder | 1 chopped banana
instructions: Cook the beans or fusilli in boiling salted water until they are al dente. Drain and leave in a heatproof bowl. Put the worcestershire sauce, 5 spice and a little extra virgin olive oil in a small pan, melt over a low heat and cook for 3 minutes. Add the bean and heat through. Stir through the mashed banana. Serve warm or cold.

title: Pork Schnitzel (Swedish Pigs in Coconut Milk and Bread Filling)
ingredients: 1 kg pork sirloin | 200 g white bread ( cut into small slices ) | 3 tablespoons coconut oil | 1/2 cup butter | 2 tablespoons celery ( diced ) | 2 cardamom seeds
instructions: Cut the pork into cubes about 5cm by 3cm. Cut the bread into thin slices about 3 4cm. Spread the coconut oil in a pan and add the pork pieces, celery and cardamom seeds. Fry on low heat until lightly golden brown. Turn up the heat and add the bread to the pan. Fry for 3 - 5 minutes or until the bread is nicely toasted. Stir from time to time. Remove the pork from the pan and place on a warm serving platter.

Random Ingredients: quinoa,plain yogurt,spaghetti,red pepper powder,white vinegar,littleneck clam,gravy mix
title: Clam Spilt Remoulade
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa | 10 lbs littleneck clams, shucked | 2 1/2 cups cold plain yogurt | 1 1/2 tablespoons white vinegar | 1 1/4 teaspoons red pepper powder | 1 1/2 teaspoons gravies mix | 2 1/4 teaspoons quinoa
instructions: Stir quinoa and 6 quarts cold water to a boil in a 6 quart stockpot. Reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes. Place clams in a large bowl.

Random Ingredients: stilton cheese,tomato paste,french bread,cooking wine,pesto sauce,oyster sauce
title: Stilton and Tomato Bread for a BBQ
ingredients: 4 slices french bread | 2 ounces stilton cheese, shredded | 1 ounce tomato paste | 1 ounce pesto sauce | 2 tablespoons tomato paste | 3 tablespoons cooking wine | 1 tablespoon oyster sauce
instructions: Toast the bread, cut into thirds and rub each with the cheese. Whisk together the rest of the ingredients and spread over toast. Place under gas flame until cheese has melted.

Random Ingredients: parmesan cheese,coconut,maple syrup,tomato garlic olive oil,seasoning mix,cardamom,corn flake,sun tomato
title: Cornflake Pizza
ingredients: 1 cup corn flakes | 3 cups shredded coconut | 1 package hidden valley & reg ; original ranch & reg ; dressing | 1 teaspoon coconut & sun-dried tomato, diced | 1 teaspoon chopped sun-dried tomato | 1/4 teaspoon seasonings mix ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1/4 teaspoon grated fresh parmesan cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. Grease a 12 inch pizza pan or a 12 inch high pizza pan. In a bowl, combine the coconut, ricotta cheese, and seasoning mix.

Random Ingredients: red potato,button mushroom,italian turkey sausage,green cardamom pod
title: Spicy Smoked Sausage Baked  Potatoes #5FIX
ingredients: 2 lbs italian turkey sausages or 2 lbs other sausages | 8 ounces button mushrooms ( cut in half or thirds if large ) | 2 green cardamom pods, crushed | 1/2 - 3/4 cup dry roasted red potatoes ( optional )
instructions: Preheat your oven on 325 degrees f. In a 10 cast iron skillet or oven safe skillet that has been sprayed with cooking spray, cook the sausages or sausage. Cook the sausage, breaking up with a wooden spoon, until no longer pink. Drain off the fat, and sprinkle the sausage over the potatoes. Stir to mix the potatoes. Scoop out the potatoes using a slotted spoon and put into the oven. Cook about 20 minutes or until the potatoes are brown and the sausages are cooked throughout, turning the sausage occasionally. Serve warm, not hot.

Random Ingredients: avocado,potato starch,vanilla pudding mix,golden raisin,chicken stock,fruit,white flour,tomato sauce
title: Tropical Mashed Potatoes with Fruit and Avocado
ingredients: 6 potatoes, peeled and diced | 6 ounces canned tomato sauce | 6 ounces canned fruit, of your choice ( such as pineapple, fruit choclo ) | 4 ounces instant vanilla pudding mix | 2/3 cup chicken stock | 2/3 cup white flour | 4 -5 ounces golden raisins | avocado, peeled and cut into wedges
instructions: Heat potato dutch oven until very hot. Add tomato sauce, fruit and pudding mix and simmer 3 minutes. Meanwhile, mix flour, raisins and avocado. Add to other ingredients and simmer for 10 minutes. Serve warm with bread, crackers or as i do all the time, with a cup of tea.

title: Cheesy Reuben Casserole
ingredients: 1/2 gallon sauerkraut | 1/2 - 3/4 cup chopped mixed dried fruit | 1 can italian-style crushed tomatoes ( hunt's brand canned ) | 1 1/4 cups grated cheddar cheese, divided | 2 1/2 cups shredded swiss cheese ( swiss is a good one ) | 1/4 cup liquid honey | 1 cardamom, ground | 1 dash ground cardamom
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Prepare sauerkraut according to package directions. Drain. Combine first seven ingredients in a large bowl. Stir in the sauerkraut. Spoon in baking dish. Sprinkle with swiss cheese and next three ingredients. Bake in preheated oven 35 - 40 minutes or until edges are browned.

Random Ingredients: extra beef,beef stock,ladyfinger,sun tomato oil,barbecue sauce,toothpick,ginger powder,black peppercorn
title: Crock Pot Thai Beef Steak Sandwich
ingredients: 1/2 cup beef stock | 1/2 cup barbecue sauce | 1 tablespoon ginger powder | 1 tablespoon cracked black peppercorns | 1 lb extra lean ground beef | 4 -6 ladyfingers | 1 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained | 24 large toothpicks
instructions: Place beef stock, barbecue sauce, green chile pepper sauce, ginger powder, and peppercorns in crockpot. Add beef and stir well to combine. Cover and cook for 6 - 10 hours, or until meat is cooked through. Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Remove meat and drain fat. Split ladyfingers lengthwise in half and place on cutting board. Pull apart with your fingers and discard dough. Flatten each half into a 5 inch circle. Spread a heaping tablespoon of meat filling on one half, place another half of meat on top. Brush cut sides with a little water. Wrap bottom half of cheesecloth tightly around each sandwich. Secure with kitchen twine. Place on baking sheet. Bake in 450 degree oven for 15 minutes or until cheese is melted. Remove cheese string. Cut sandwich in half. Serve with sauce.

title: Cajun Spinach
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh spinach | 1 teaspoon cajun seasoning
instructions: Bring a medium pot of water to a boil. Remove and discard stems from the spinach. Wash, dry, and chop leaves. Bring the spinach and cajun seasoning to a boil.

title: Gorgonzola Cheese Spread
ingredients: 1 package gorgonzola | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract | 1/2 teaspoon corn oil | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder | 1/4 teaspoon corn syrup
instructions: Finely chop the gorgonzola cheese. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Makes 1 1/2 pkgs of spreadable cheese.

Random Ingredients: vanilla sugar,portabella mushroom,barbecue sauce,tuna water,irish whiskey
title: Hot Tuna Portobello
ingredients: 400 g canned tuna in water, drained, oil removed | 1 tablespoon light vanilla sugar | 1 teaspoon bourbon ( optional ) | 2 fresh portabella mushrooms, sliced | 1 teaspoon barbecue sauce or 1 teaspoon other sweet barbecue sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small baking dish, and bbq or grill the portobello mushrooms for 5 minutes, then turn, turn for another 2 minutes or bake, uncovered, at 180c/350f for around 15 minutes or until cooked through, and topping is lightly browned.

title: Swiss Cheese and Celery Ribs
ingredients: 4 celery ribs, cut in 1-inch pieces | 4 ounces swiss cheese, cut into 1-inch square
instructions: In a 2 1/2 to 3 quart slow cooker, combine celery, swiss cheese, 3/4 teaspoon salt, celery drippings, and 2 3/4 to 3/4 cups water, cover, and cook on high for 3 to 4 hours, or on low for 8 to 10 hours, or until crock sauce is reduced to about 2 cups.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast half,watermelon,white flour,ajwain,coriander leaf,hamburger,portabella mushroom,wolf brand chili
title: The Mountain's Greatest Chicken Soup Ever Pakistani Style
ingredients: 600 g chicken breast halves | 200 g hamburger | 200 g smoked gi helper chicken chili ( optional ) | 100 g portabella mushrooms ( optional ) | 100 g white flour ( known as `` chana '' ) | 200 g watermelon | 4 small fresh coriander leaves ( known as coriander leaves ) | 2 teaspoons of your favorite jasmine chili
instructions: Cube the meat the finely into small pieces. In another large container, mix the flour and water and then in that you have made your broth mix this with the chili. When i am ready to serve up my meal i put the chicken, in it, on top of boiled rice. Garnish with fried onion, chopped coriander leaves, chopped coriander and a teaspoon of jasmine chili and it's ready to serve hot or cold.

title: Easiest Whole Grain Baklava
ingredients: 3/4 cup couscous, preferably whole-grain | 8 sheets frozen puff pastry, thawed | 1 package frozen puff pastry dough, thawed, defrosted | 1 tablespoon baking soda
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°. Place thawed pastry sheets in a large bowl. Unfold puff pastry sheets on a clean work surface. Brush both sides lightly with cooking spray and sprinkle lightly with baking soda. Line a 17x12x1/2 inch baking pan with a pastry sheet. Place half of the pastry sheets in the baking pan, being sure to cover the top and bottom edges of the pan with a generous amount. Sprinkle with cooking soda. Spread 1/2 cup couscous in the center of the pastry sheets, leaving 1 inch of pastry around the outside edges of the pan. Bring 2 opposite edges of the pastry sheets together over the couscous, and pinch together the loose ends to form a seal. Lay the wrapped pastry sheet on top of the couscous, sealing the pastry together at the top. Repeat with the remaining pastry sheets and couscous. Bake approximately 30 minutes or until golden brown. Let cool 5 - 10 minutes before removing from the oven.

title: Simple and Easy Red Onions
ingredients: 4 medium red onions | 2 cups steamed rice
instructions: Chop onions fine and place in large saucepan with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil, cover and cook over medium heat for 10 minutes. Rinse rice in a sieve removing all solids. Bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer for 25 minutes or until almost tender. Mash onions with potato masher. Add shredded rice and mix together. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: tomato green chile pepper,anise seed,tomato green chilies,salad oil,bay leaf,honey mustard,ginger paste
title: Chili Fry Masaledar
ingredients: 2 tablespoons salad oil | 1 tablespoon ginger paste | 1 can diced tomatoes and green chile peppers, drained | 1 can diced tomatoes and green chilies, drained | 1 bay leaf | 1 tablespoon anise seed | 2 teaspoons honey mustard
instructions: Heat oil in a skillet over medium heat. Stir in ginger paste and cook until fragrant. Mix in diced tomatoes with green chile peppers, diced tomatoes, bay leaf, anise seed, and honey mustard together in the skillet. Simmer on low until flavors have blended and sauce is thick, about 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: honey,rose water,pecan,flat leaf parsley,vegetable shortening,white vinegar,cardamom pod,sumac
title: Roasted Pecans for Two
ingredients: 2 pounds ground pecans | 1 cup chopped pecans | 1/4 cup coarsely chopped toasted | 1/4 cup coarsely chopped toasted ground sumac | 2 teaspoons ground cardamom pod | 2 teaspoons white vinegar | 2 teaspoons honey | 1 teaspoon rose water | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh flat leaf parsley | 1/4 cup coarsely chopped toasted pecan pieces
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Spray a 9x13 inch baking dish or roasting pan with vegetable cooking spray. Mix the ground pecans, 1 cup pecans, 1/4 cup chopped toasted ground sumac, cardamom, vinegar, honey, rosewater, and parsley together in a large bowl. Gradually mix in the remaining ground pecans until the filling is well blended. Gently pack the pecan filling into the prepared baking dish. Bake in the preheated oven until the pecans are browned and the filling is bubbling, about 45 minutes.

title: Simple Ham Sandwich
ingredients: 4 lbs honey-roasted deli ham, sliced | 1 teaspoon kosher salt
instructions: Place ham slices or any thick fat on a piece of meat that will fit on a piece of bread roll. Sprinkle meat with kosher salt. Bake at 225 degrees for 15 to 20 minutes or until cheese is bubbly.

title: Healthified Swedish Meatballs
ingredients: 2 pounds ground pork | 1/2 cup quick-cooking oats | 2 cups quick cooking oats
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place ground pork in a large, deep skillet. Cook over medium high heat until evenly brown. Stir in quick cooking oats, and cook, stirring constantly until the mixture is lightly browned. Roll 1/3 of the crumbs into balls. Place meatballs on an ungreased baking sheet. Bake in preheated oven for 30 minutes. Serve with remaining quick cooking oats.

title: Sweet and Sour Onions
ingredients: 4 lbs sirloin or 4 lbs top round beef tenderloin | sea salt | 3/4 cup superfine sugar | 24 medium onions, peeled and very thinly sliced ( about 2 pounds ) | cayenne
instructions: Rinse the sirloin/legoin under cold running water. Pat dry with paper towels. In a heavy 4 to 5 quart pot with a tight lid, brown the beef in 1/4 teaspoon salt over high heat, turning often and scraping off any browned bits, until browned, about 10 minutes. Transfer the meat to paper towels and blot dry. Add the sugar to the skillet and reduce heat to moderately low, shaking the pan occasionally and stirring, until the sugar is completely dissolved. Return the meat to the pot, add the onions, and cayenne. Cover and simmer, turning the meat occasionally, until meat is very tender, about 1 hour 45 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, transfer the meat to a bowl and let cool slightly. Transfer the onions to a cutting board, reserving the cooking liquid. Cut each onion lengthwise into very thin slices. Serve at once.

title: Roast Beef Gravy for Roast Beef Pies
ingredients: 400 g beef ( for gravy ) | 1 tablespoon plain flour | 1 tablespoon roast beef
instructions: Put the flour in a bowl and dip roast beef into. Put it between sheets of cling film and put into the refridgerator for about 2 hours but do not over do it. Heat oven to 200°c. Put the flour in a bowl. Dry roast beef and pour into the flour. When the oven has taken it out of the oven put it in a tray. Pour a little gravy on it too and make sure the gravy gets into the meat and veggies and get a good crusty crust on the outside. Put it on an oven tray that has been lined with baking paper. Cook for approximately 30 minutes or until gravy is nice and browned and meat is tender.

Random Ingredients: mexican tomato,fish sauce,beef chuck roast,hungarian paprika,olive,onion salt
title: Beef and Avocado Skewers
ingredients: 1 package beef chuck roast, cut 1-inch cubes | 2 tablespoons olive, divided | 1 can mexican-style stewed tomatoes | 2 tablespoons fish sauce | 1 teaspoon onion salt | 1/4 teaspoon hungarian paprika
instructions: Place beef in a large resealable plastic bag, and add 1 tablespoon olive oil. Seal, and marinate beef in the refrigerator for about 30 minutes or longer. Meanwhile, remove beef from resealable plastic bag and discard marinade, reserving marinade. Thread beef onto soaked wooden skewers. Brush the skewers with remaining olive oil, and sprinkle with onion salt. Grill skewers, turning as needed, until nicely browned, 5 to 7 minutes per side.

Random Ingredients: milk ricotta cheese,oil,baking soda,green bean,hot italian sausage,mussel
title: Baked Sausages With Milk and Ricotta
ingredients: 2 large hot italian sausages | 1 tablespoon oil | 1 can evaporated milk ricotta cheese ( or 2 % ) | 2 cups whole milk with seafood | 1 1 tablespoon baking soda | 1 lb fresh green beans
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Remove each sausage link from the casings with a knife, being careful not to slice them to the bone. Cut each link into 4 pieces. Lightly grease an 11x15 inch baking dish. Cut off the tip of each tomato so it can hollow out easily. Rinse the salted shells well. Place the sausages into the prepared baking dish, and spray them with the oil. In a small bowl, stir together the ricotta, milk, and baking soda, and add the drained green beans. Mix to thoroughly mix. Pour a layer of the cheese mixture onto each sausage, and cover with the remaining cheese mixture. Bake for 20 minutes in the preheated oven, or until the sauce is slightly thickened and the cheese has begun to brown.

title: Cherry Mushrooms
ingredients: 2 lbs mushrooms, cleaned & trimmed | salt and pepper
instructions: In a pan cook mushrooms in a little oil, stirring constantly for about a minute or two, till they have release some of their juices. Add more oil if necessary.

title: Simple Mushrooms
ingredients: 2 cups fresh mushrooms | 1 large yellow onion
instructions: Thinly slice mushrooms. Cook in medium skillet on medium heat for 3 - 5 minutes or until tender. If using fresh onion, slice it in half before starting to saute with mushrooms about a half an inch thick. If using fresh mushrooms, slice them about one long by half. Serve with good crusty bread or pasta of your choice.

Random Ingredients: fig,celery rib,vegetarian bean,red wine,pork shoulder,pork tenderloin,double cream
title: Slow Cooker Pork With Frijoles (Pigs With Beans)
ingredients: 2 pork shoulder | 2 pork tenderloin | 1 1/2 cups veggie baked beans | 2 celery ribs | 4 ounces dried figs, soaked and chopped | 1/4 cup dry red wine | 1 pint double cream
instructions: Place pork shoulder and tenderloins in the bottom of a slow cooker. Place celery stalks in another slow cooker and soak them with the figs. Place soaked figs into this mixture and pour the red wine over them. Cover and cook on low for 7 - 9 hours, stir. Stir the cream into the liquid for the last 5 minutes.

title: Chocolate Fish Ball by Betty Webb
ingredients: 1 white fish fillet, skinned and gutted | 2 ounces unsweetened cocoa
instructions: Skin the fish, remove entrails, and cut into thin pieces. Place the fish in a mixing bowl. Add the cocoa, and combine with fingers. Leave to stand for 30 minutes or until the coating of the coating is smooth. Roll the coated fish into small balls. Store in the refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: radish,triple sec,dill weed,mozzarella cheese,butter,grape,chicken breast half,corn
title: Chicken Filled Grape Leaves
ingredients: 2 small boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 1/2 teaspoon dry dill weed ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon butter | 2 1/2 cups halved grapes | 2 tablespoons triple sec ( optional ) or 2 tablespoons orange-flavored liqueur ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons corn | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh dill weed | 1 small radish, julienned | 8 ounces shredded low-mozzarella cheese
instructions: Melt butter over low heat in large skillet. Cook chicken breasts in melted butter until cooked through, about 16 minutes. Cut chicken into 1/4 inch cubes. Discard fat and pour off any accumulated fat. Spread out chicken on paper towels to drain.

title: Pigs in the Blanket (Passover Chicken Wings)
ingredients: 1 lb stew meat | 3 - 3 1/2 lbs frozen chicken wings, thawed, excess fat removed | 2 pears, peeled cored and chopped | 5 hard-boiled eggs, chopped | 1/2 cup finely chopped italian bread, crusts trimmed, torn | 1/2 lb plain doritos | 1 1/2 teaspoons crumbled sage
instructions: Combine stew meat with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil and cook until meat is tender, about 30 minutes. While meat is cooking, place thawed chicken wings in the center of a greased cookie sheet. Cover with the chopped pear slices and finely chopped hard boiled eggs. Arrange in a layer over the chicken mixture in a shallow baking dish or roasting pan. Mix bread crumbs with the sage and sprinkle over chicken mixture. Bake in a preheated 375 degree oven for 1 hour. Reduce heat to 350 degrees and bake 10 minutes more or until browned.

Random Ingredients: yellow bell pepper,espresso powder,bicarbonate soda,beef gravy
title: Beef Fondue
ingredients: 500 g beef gravy ( or beef suet ) | 1 tablespoon instant espresso powder | 1/4 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 1 yellow bell pepper, diced
instructions: Stir the gravy powder and espresso powder into the beef suet until fully dissolved. Add the bell pepper chunks and stir until they are mixed through. Allow the gravy to come to the boil and add bicarbonate of soda.

Random Ingredients: cardamom seed,roquefort cheese,shichimi togarashi,brandy,cranberry,basil leaf,pineapple ring
title: Shishito Toasted Pineapple Spread
ingredients: 4 pineapple rings, halved | roquefort cheese, crumbled | 3/4 cup brandy | 4 ounces fresh basil leaves, chopped | 2 tablespoons dried cranberries, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom seed | 1/4 teaspoon dried shichimi togarashi, divided
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Place pineapple triangles on a piece of parchment paper in a baking dish. Bake for 10 minutes. Remove from oven, and allow to cool. To make the spread, place the cheese, brandy, basil, cranberries, cardamom, and chili in the bowl of a food processor.

Random Ingredients: cilantro leaf,mushroom stem,colby monterey jack cheese,red pepper flake,garlic clove
title: Vegetarian Stuffed Mushrooms
ingredients: 2 large garlic cloves | 2 cups shredded colby-monterey jack cheese ( divided into 4 equal portions ) | 1 -2 tablespoon chopped fresh cilantro leaves, divided | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 10 medium mushroom stems ( capsicum )
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Place a garlic press or paring knife in each mushroom, close and secure with a fork or toothpick. In a small nonstick frying pan combine the 1 - ½ cup cheese, 2 - ½ tablespoons cilantro and crushed red pepper. Stir over medium heat until the cheese melts. Remove from heat and set aside with a large spoonful of the cheese mixture. Place the mushroom caps in a 8 to 10 cup or larger baking dish and pour the remaining cheese mixture among them. Cover and bake 25 minutes, or until the pincers are crisp and browned, remove from oven and serve hot. Note, if using mushroom caps that have not been brushed with butter, place in a bowl and mash with a potato masher, to a smooth paste with a little milk and water. You will have a very sticky mushroom mixture that is perfect for rolling and eating.

title: Macaroni and Saffron Rice Salad
ingredients: 1/8 cup barley ( uncooked ) | 1 medium head cauliflower ( small-curd cottage cheese, finely chopped ) | 1/4 cup dried barley | 1/3 cup rice ( uncooked ) | 2/3 cup low-fat plain yogurt ( plain ) | 1/4 teaspoon saffron
instructions: Bring 5 cups of water to a boil. Add barley and stir to separate. Cover and cook over low heat for 25 minutes. Let stand for 5 minutes. Add cauliflower, cover, and cook 25 minutes longer. Drain well, cool and remove outer leaves. Break into bite sized pieces. Place cauliflower and barley in small serving bowl.

title: Kosher Pig's Feet
ingredients: 1 1/2 slices pork tenderloin | 1 dash cream of tartar | 1 tablespoon vodka | 3 medium carrots, cut diagonally into 3 pieces
instructions: Place pork tenderloins on a plate. Dip each piece in cream of tartar. Then coat with shaved carrots.

Random Ingredients: pork tenderloin,strawberry,black truffle,flour tortilla,bamboo shoot,kalamata olive,fenugreek seed,chinese hot mustard
title: Chinese Truffles, Pork & Black Olives
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon fenugreek seeds, crumbled | 1/2 teaspoon black truffle, crushed | 1 pork tenderloin, trimmed of all but 1/8-to 1/8-1/4-inch thick slices ( about 1-1/3 pounds ) | 3/4 cup black kalamata olive, coarsely chopped | 1 package frozen strawberries, thawed | 1 can sliced bamboo shoots, drained | 4 flour tortillas, 10-inch diameter, warmed | 1/2 cup chinese hot mustard, to finish
instructions: For the rub, mix the fenugreek and black truffle in a mortar and grind to a coarse powder. Place the pork in a glass bowl or ziplock bag, add the spice mix and massage to coat the meat. Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour. Toss the olives with ¼ cup of the olives and reserve. Preheat the oven to 400°f spray baking sheet with nonstick cooking spray. Place tortillas on it and stack them alongside the pork, pressing to adhere. Press the tortillas into the pork slightly, almost to the edges. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes, flipping after 15 minutes, until nicely browned. Remove from the oven and drain off the remaining ¼ cup of olives. Arrange the truffles on a platter, spoon the remaining olives on top. Drizzle on the mustard and serve with the reserved olives and patted dry. To make the black olive dressing, pour the black olive vinegar from the can into a small nonstick saucepan, add the remaining ½ cup of olive oil and bring to a boil over medium heat. Reduce the heat and simmer for 3 minutes, until thickened. Season with salt and pepper. Transfer to a serving bowl. Serve with warm tortillas.

Random Ingredients: quinoa,white wine,zucchini,pepper flake,mustard seed,teriyaki sauce,chili garlic sauce,parmesan cheese
title: Grilled Italian Veggies
ingredients: 1 zucchini, medium diced | 1 lb of fresh chopped garden fresh squash or 1 lb zucchini, medium diced | 3 tablespoons parmesan cheese, grated | 1/2 teaspoon dried mustard seeds | 2 tablespoons chinese red wine or 2 tablespoons any dry merlot | 1/4 cup yoshida low sodium teriyaki sauce | 1/4 cup chili-garlic sauce | 1/4 cup white wine
instructions: In a large bowl, toss together zucchini, squash, cheese, mustard seeds, chinese red wine, teriyaki sauce, chili garlic sauce and white wine. Cover and refrigerate 1 to 10 hours. Preheat grill to medium high. Lightly oil grill grate. Remove vegetables from marinade and arrange on hot grate. Close lid and grill 2 to 3 minutes per side or until veggies are heated thoroughly.

title: Thai Lemon Pickles
ingredients: 2 lemons, zest of, julienned | 1 package kaffir lime leaves, thawed
instructions: Peel lemons removing all the white pith. Cut a lengthwise slit 1/2 inch deep along one side of each lemon, cutting a wedge, through the thin membrane from rind into lemon flesh. Set aside, with the lemon flesh intact. Cut peel in half longitudinally, removing peel as desired. Slice crosswise at 1/8 inch intervals until 1/3 of an inch remains. Place peel in plastic bag and add lime juice. Seal bag allowing lemon mixture to marinate at least 2 hours in fridge. Remove peel from bag and discard. Strain marinade through sieve removing all pulp. Chill. Place lemon in sterilized jars and place in a bowl covered by warm water, removing air bubbles. Wipe rims with a clean, damp cloth. Place in a hot water bath for 15 minutes to soften.. Seal bag and transfer to a pot. Set a heavy heat on the stove, then turn on lowest temperature to dry peel evenly. Dry in dry cloth for 1 - 2 minutes. Dry off peel in a clean towel for 10 - 12 minutes. Drain well. Store in clean, dry jars. Note, you may substitute ginger with garlic, chilli or other hot pepper. This is the dh's preferred pickle and not as original.

title: Koldis Rice With Cherry Tomatoes and Hazelnuts
ingredients: 200 g brown rice | 1/4 cup hazelnuts or 1/4 cup almonds, chopped | 2 bunches fresh coriander | 1 kg cherry tomatoes | 1 teaspoon coriander powder
instructions: Boil rice with 2 cups water and add hazelnuts. Cook rice over medium heat uncovered, stirring occasionally for 20 minutes. Meanwhile steam tomatoes for 15 minutes covered on a grill with foil to prevent skins from forming. Tear into large pieces. Add tomatoes and coriander to cooked rice and serve.

Random Ingredients: broccoli,egg beater substitute,linguine,blueberry,ziti pasta,balsamic vinegar,red chilies,lettuce
title: Pasta Salad With Lemon Dressing
ingredients: 7 ounces fresh linguine, cooked | 2 ounces blueberries | 2 tomatoes, finely diced | 4 fresh red chilies, seeded, finely chopped | 2 ounces fresh broccoli, finely chopped | 1/3 cup egg substitute | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 1/2 cup fat-free low-fat chicken broth or 1/2 cup light-colored canned chicken broth | lettuce, to serve
instructions: Place the pasta in a serving bowl. Add the blueberries, tomatoes, chiles, broccoli and egg substitute until chopped. Whisk the dressing ingredients together in a small bowl. Pour half the dressing over the salad and toss thoroughly. Serve over a bed of lettuce.

Random Ingredients: quinoa,cake flour,asparagus spear,parmigiano reggiano cheese,grand marnier,white sugar
title: Asparagus With Quinoa and Parmigiano-Reggiano
ingredients: 3 1/2 cups quinoa, rinsed, drained | 1/2 pound asparagus spears, trimmed and thinly sliced | 1/4 cup grand marnier | 1 tablespoon white sugar | 2 cups cake flour, sifted | 3/4 cup grated parmigiano reggiano cheese
instructions: Place quinoa in a strainer over a bowl, and rinse with cold water.

title: Onion Apple Chutney
ingredients: 4 tart apples, diced into small pieces | 1 package onion soup mix
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a small pot, bring to a boil, then reduce heat. Simmer on low for 20 minutes over very low heat. Stir occasionally. This is best served warm. Note, i usually leave in all of the liquid before adding the other ingredients and i sometimes leave it all before adding the apples. You can have this chutney over cooked potatoes, and even with other cuts of vegetables.

Random Ingredients: marsala wine,asparagus spear,peanut oil,garbanzo bean,creme fraiche,spinach
title: Art's Asparagus, Spinach & Peanuts
ingredients: 1 cup asparagus spear, trimmed | 4 ounces peanut oil | 1 cup marsala wine | 2 packages frozen chopped spinach | 12 large fresh spinach leaves | 1 tablespoon creme fraiche ( fat free, optional )
instructions: Place asparagus in a bowl and cover with boiling water. Let sit 5 minutes, or until crisp. Drain, rinse well & set aside. Heat oil in a large skillet over medium high heat. Cook asparagus in hot oil just until tender. Remove and toss with marsala wine and spinach. Add asparagus to skillet and toss to combine and coat. Cook, stirring, just until it's heated through.

title: Sue's Sauerkraut
ingredients: 2 pounds round steaks, cut into small cubes | 1 can sauerkraut, drained | 3 tablespoons dry sherry
instructions: Heat a skillet over medium high heat. Cook and stir beef in the hot skillet until browned and crusty, 5 to 7 minutes. Arrange beef in the bottom of a slow cooker. Arrange sauerkraut over the beef.

title: Mexican Pumpkin Pie
ingredients: 1/2 cup light soymilk | 8 ounces solid pack pumpkin ( about 2 cups ) | 2 large free range eggs | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon garam masala | 2/3 cup mexican blend cheese | 1/4 cup frozen blueberries or 1/4 cup frozen chopped spinach
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f. Oil a jelly roll pan with nonstick spray or make your own pie crust. Spread the 1/2 cup light soymilk on the bottom and about 1/2 inch up sides of the pan. In a bowl beat the eggs until creamy. Stir in the rest of the yogurt until well mixed. Spread over the milk mixture. Sprinkle the top with the garam masala. Bake for 45 - 50 minutes or until a knife inserted in the center comes out clean. Cool in pan and cut into 16 - 20 squares.

title: Sicilian Spinach
ingredients: 24 ounces fresh spinach | 2 tablespoons lard | 1/2 cup picante sauce | ham ( or turkey if you prefer ) | garlic powder ( to taste )
instructions: Take your fresh spinach and clean well. In the meantime, heat oven to 350f and roll your cleaned spinach in lard. When they are all done, sprinkle with garlic powder, and let sit for 1 min. You don't want them burned. Put the spinach on a baking sheet and cover with aluminum foil. Bake for about 30 minutes, turn, and bake for another 30 minutes. Open oven to mix the tomato sauce with the spinach. Serve over pasta, but not too hot.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon cube,mix,mustard seed,romaine lettuce,garlic salt
title: Ravioli (Italian Pickles)
ingredients: 1 head romaine lettuce | 2 3/4 cups beef bouillon cubes | 1 tablespoon mustard seeds ( yellow or white ) | 1 teaspoon garlic salt | 2 -3 tablespoons sour mix ( your choice )
instructions: Preheat grill to med hi. Cut the head of romaine lettuce into slices and submerge into boiling salt water. Remove the outer leaves of romaine and submerge into a colander. Put in the sink until ready to use. Drain. Cut the lettuce into thin slices. Heat the bouillon cube on the stove over the fire until just bubbling. Add mustard seeds, garlic salt. Add sour mix and hot bouillon. The heat from the bouillon should cause the sour mix to burn off the bouillon and start to thicken the liquid. The idea is to pour the hot liquid over the lettuce rather than directly over it or else the sour mix will burn off. Once the sour mix has thickened, pour it into a bowl or jar.

title: Hot German Dressing
ingredients: 1/2 cup seasoning salt | 1/4 cup ground cinnamon | 1/4 teaspoon allspice berries | 1/4 teaspoon dried basil | 1/4 cup thousand island dressing
instructions: Stir together all ingredients. Pour into a covered container and refrigerate at least 1 hour before serving.

title: Pizzelles (Italian Style Grated Cheese)
ingredients: 3 -6 lemons | 1 -2 cup romano cheese, freshly grated | 1/2 - 3/4 cup splenda sugar substitute ( or other flavor )
instructions: Wash lemons very well removing white pith and outer rind. Using a spoon remove all visible pith. Cut lemons into 1/4 inch slices using a teaspoon. Place slices into bowl, sprinkle with romano and splenda and mix well. Scoop into 2 inch diameter molds, or small dishes, or small bowls. Place molds in a larger pan and fill with warm water until boiling. Cover pan. When it reaches a full boil, turn heat to medium. If using a smaller pan, cover it and turn off burner. Allow cooking for 5 minutes, or until lemons are soft, but not mushy. Remove from heat and allow to cool for a few minutes. Place on a cutting board and slice using a thick, serrated knife. When soft remove to a warm serving dish and serve with lots of cheese on the side.

title: Turkish Cream Dip
ingredients: 3 cups plain strained cream | 1 cup water, for boiling your sour cream and other ingredients | dill | garlic powder
instructions: Dissolve garlic in water in a small bowl. Pour over both containers of sour cream and mix well. Serve chilled.

title: Sweet and Tart Crockpot
ingredients: 1 jar tomato sauce | 1 package frozen salad greens | 1 bag stew meat | 2 tablespoons liqueur
instructions: Place tomato sauce in crockpot, add frozen salad greens, cook on high for 10 minutes. Add stew meat and liqueur.

title: Kummata
ingredients: 1 kg lamb shoulder | 50 -50 kalamata olives, halved | 100 g icing sugar
instructions: Take your lamb out of the refrigerator. Remove any loose skin and any visible fat from the lamb. Cut into 1cm cubes. Sprinkle all over the lamb in a dish with a layer of kalamata olives. Sprinkle with icing sugar, refrigerate and leave for 24 hours. The next day, remove from the fridge. Remove any excess salt from the lamb and grill until cooked to your liking.

Random Ingredients: yoghurt,raisin,italian salad dressing mix,golden raisin,vanilla essence,apricot
title: Chilled Indian Sweet Bread With Fruit
ingredients: 1 package yoghurt | 1 cup chopped dried apricot | 1/2 cup golden raisin | 1 package powdered aubergine salad dressing mix ( i use good seasons brand ) | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence | 1/2 cup raisins
instructions: Soak the raisins in ice water for 6 - 8 hours or overnight. Drain and set aside for at least 20 minutes or until all liquid has drained from the fruit. Preheat oven to 180c/350f. Grease a small loaf tin or loaf tin. Combine yoghurt, apricots, raisins and mix together in a large bowl. Add the vanilla essence. Spoon mixture into loaf tin and bake 45 - 50 minutes, until the bread is golden and crispy. Leave in tin 10 minutes before removing to a wire rack to cool.

title: Roasted Red Cabbage and Chile
ingredients: 1/4 pound red cabbage, shredded | 1 fresh poblano chile, roasted and rinsed
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Mix cabbage and poblano chiles together in a bowl. Transfer to a parchment lined baking dish. Roast in preheated oven until cabbages and skins begin to peel, 15 to 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: turnip,chocolate,red chilies,mint leaf,crust,carrot,pecorino romano cheese,aluminum foil
title: Chocolate-Filled Turnips With Chilli Pesto
ingredients: 6 medium turnips | 6 red chilies, dried and finely chopped | 1 medium carrot, grated | 2 tablespoons finely chopped mint leaves | 10 g freshly grated pecorino romano cheese | 2 teaspoons finely chopped fresh mint leaves | 4 teaspoons finely chopped peeled chocolate | 6 sheets aluminum foil | chopped chili flakes and extra pecorino romano cheese ( to garnish )
instructions: First, make the chillies pesto, in a small saucepan, heat the chillies, carrot, mint and 1 teaspoon of the cheese into the warm water for 5 minutes. Drain the mixture through a sieve, reserve the liquid it is in the pan and set aside. Boil about 5 minutes until the liquid is reduced by half. Stir in the remaining cheese, mint and the remaining chilli paste. Cut the turnips into thin slices. Place 2 teaspoons of the pesto along the side of each turnip slice. Fold the slices in half and place the turnips in a dish, cover with plastic. Keep the turnips warm in a bowl of hot water on the stove. Light a grill. When ready to cook, heat the foil on the stove. Lift off the turnips with a slotted spoon and place them on a baking tray. Leave to stand for 10 minutes. Using a teaspoon, scoop the turnips out by the centre and place on the foil. Serve sprinkled with extra pepper flakes, chopped chilies and a sprig of cheese on the side.

title: Cheddar & Mushroom Rye Bread
ingredients: 1 cup rye flour | 1/4 cup cremini mushroom, thinly sliced | 1/2 cup shredded cheddar cheese | 3 tablespoons chopped of fresh mint, divided | 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Mix first 7 ingredients well. Spray cookie sheet with olive oil. Dough is easy to handle when raised through the bowl, but you don't have to knead. Add more flour if dough is too stiff. Knead dough 8 - 10 times. Place on greased cookie sheet. Cover with an inverted bowl. Let rest 15 minutes. Lightly butter the top of loaf and sprinkle with 1 tablespoon of the of mint. Bake 25 minutes or until golden brown. Let cool about 10 minutes and slice into slices.

Random Ingredients: mirin,oat,sesame seed,extra large egg,pork rib,beef brisket,coriander powder
title: Asian Beef Brisket- Obrich Egg Nog Roll
ingredients: 3 teaspoons sesame seeds, toasted | 40 mm oat, ground to a paste | 200 g beef short ribs, cut lengthwise in half and sliced into thin slices | 1/4 tablespoon coriander powder | 1 tablespoon mirin | 200 g extra-large eggs, hard cooked and sliced lengthwise | coriander powder, to garnish
instructions: Line a large bamboo steamer with parchment paper or lined and aluminium foil. Preheat the oven to 160°c spread the sesame seeds generously on a baking sheet, then top with the oat paste. Bake the egg mixture for 10 mins, stirring every 5 mins or so until the oat mixture is golden. Cool 5 mins in the steamer, then spread the meat slices out on top of the sesame paste in 1/4mm slices. Roast for 10 mins, then leave to cool completely. Mix the meat with the coriander and mirin, then spread 2 tbsp of the mince mixture on each slice of meat & top with the sliced eggs. Sprinkle with extra coriander. Serve, garnished with sliced coriander leaves.

title: Limeade and Noodles (Limecello)
ingredients: 1 package cellophane noodles, broken | 14 fluid ounces limeade, divided | 1 1/2 cups whipping cream | 1/4 cup chopped fresh oregano
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. In a large bowl, combine the noodles, 1 tablespoon of limeade, cream, and dried oregano. Mix until well blended. Remove from the heat and pour into a 2 quart glass or ceramic bowl. Cover with plastic and refrigerate 4 hours or overnight to chill. Turn the chilled noodle mixture into a resealable plastic bag. Remove all of the air bubbles and lids and discard. Seal and massage the noodles gently to coat. Refrigerate until cold, at least 2 hours. Transfer the noodles to a serving bowl and garnish with remaining limeade.

title: Camarones a la Camarones
ingredients: 1 lb large shrimp | 1 tablespoon cayenne | 2 cans clams
instructions: Place shrimp in a saucepan of boiling water and cook 2 minutes. Drain. Add cayenne to taste, tossing. Heat clams in a skillet with 1 tablespoon of the oil. Pour half of the shrimp into the hot clams and toss. Serve at once or cool and refrigerate the remainder, if necessary.

title: Hot Potato Chips
ingredients: 2 lbs yukon gold potatoes | 2 tablespoons sweet pickle hot pepper sauce
instructions: Peel potatoes, cut into 1/2 thick rounds, then cut rounds in half. Arrange potato rounds on foil lined baking sheet.

Random Ingredients: cream chicken soup,chinese white rice vinegar,ice,fusilli,garlic clove
title: Fusilli Rice With Sour Cream and Garlic
ingredients: 1 package fusilli ( or linguine ) | 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1 can unsalted cream of mushroom soup | 1 -2 garlic clove ( depending on taste ) | 1/4 cup chinese white rice vinegar
instructions: Cook fusilli in a large pot of salted water following the package instructions until tender, but still firm to the bite. Drain. While the pasta is cooking, make the sour cream and garlic by combining together the ingredients in a medium bowl and stirring until just blended. Serve pasta over this mixture and top with more sour cream and garlic.

title: Rye Bread With a Bite!
ingredients: 1 slice rye bread | olive, sliced, to sprinkle on the sandwich | 2 slices ripe olives, to serve
instructions: Cut slices of bread in two. Toast and spread slices on bread with olive or other spread/sugar. Sprinkle olive over. Add slices of tomato or capsicum from loaf.

Random Ingredients: clamato juice,corn niblets,maraschino cherry,banana pepper,yellow mustard seed,baby arugula,gin
title: Seafood Chowder
ingredients: 1 bottle chilled clamato juice | 1/2 bottle gin | 1 teaspoon yellow mustard seeds | 1 bag baby arugula | 1 can baby frozen corn niblets | 2 baby banana peppers | 1 jar maraschino cherries
instructions: In a large bowl, stir together clamato juice, gin, mustard seeds, arugula, corn niblets, and baby peppers. Cover, and refrigerate at least 1 hour, stirring occasionally.

Random Ingredients: lima bean,vanilla ice cream,chili pepper flake,almond milk,lemon peel,cream mushroom soup,canadian bacon,blueberry
title: Canadian Cedar Blush
ingredients: 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1 can lima beans | 1/4 - 1/2 cup almond milk | 1/8 teaspoon chili pepper flakes | 1 tablespoon finely grated lemon peel ( optional ) | 1 cup light cream or 1 cup almond milk | 1/4 cup canadian bacon, cut into patties | whole milk, as needed | shredded cheese for garnish
instructions: Place soup, lima beans, almond milk, chili flakes, and lemon peel in a medium size saucepan and bring to boil. Reduce heat, cover, and simmer 15 - 20 minutes. Place cream/fat in a small bowl. Add cream/fat and let sit until thickened. Place patties in a buttered dish. Pour mushroom soup mixture over the patties. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake at 325 for 45 - 50 minutes, or until heated through and cheese is browned.

title: Grandma's Fried Veggies
ingredients: 5 cans vacuum packed mixed vegetables ( i like the large can of sweet potatoes you can get in the supermarket, the huge can of baby carrots, the small can of broccoli ) | 1/4 cup vegetable oil | 1/4 cup grand marnier or 1/4 cup orange liqueur | 3 tablespoons chopped pepperoni | 2 large carrots, sliced into long strips | 4 slices stale bread, chopped | crushed tortilla chips | crushed tortilla chips
instructions: If you have a vacuum packed bag, vacuum pack the vegetables until they are about as square as bread or chicken. Place bag in sink, and squeeze out excess water. In medium pan, mix together vegetable oil and liqueur. Place vegetables on a paper towel with the paper towel over the veggies and let steam for 5 minutes. Heat oil in large skillet or frying pan until hot until hot but not smoking. Add pepperoni, and toss till just starting to brown a little bit, but not cooked through. Add carrots, tossing till just beginning to brown. About 2 minutes. Drain vegetables in collander or colander, then arrange in a single layer on a serving platter. Serve warm with crushed tortilla chips and crushed tortilla chips.

title: Tortilla
ingredients: 1 cup rice flour | 1 1/4 - 1 1/2 lbs cooked ham | 2 kiwi fruits, peeled and sliced
instructions: Mix water, rice flour and kiwifruit. Dip ham slices in flour mixture and fry in a light frying pan, turning until golden and cooked to your liking. Serve with a green salad of your choice.

Random Ingredients: canadian bacon,fajita seasoning,chili sauce,salsa verde,sun tomato oil,rose water,vegetable,taco seasoning mix
title: Zesty Vegan Chicken Tacos
ingredients: 1 package taco seasoning mix | 2 tablespoons chili sauce ( to your taste ) | 1 tablespoon dried rose water | 4 tablespoons canadian bacon ( chopped or shaved in a food processor ) | 1/2 cup vegetable, chopped | 1 cup fresh salsa verde ( to your taste ) | 2 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, chopped | 1/2 cup shredded reduced-fat montreal-style cheese ( i use mexican blend cheese )
instructions: Set oven rack to the lowest oven setting. Lightly oil the inside of a 9x13 baking dish. In a medium bowl combine the taco seasoning mix, chili sauce, rose water and canadian bacon. Spread mixture evenly into the pan and bake for 5 - 7 minutes. Remove cover, add salsa verde, stir, then cover again and bake for another 5 - 7 minutes, or until cheese melts and mixture is hot. Remove from oven and spoon mixture into a taco or burrito size serving platter. If desired, serve with refried beans and guacamole, shredded lettuce, and a dollop of sour cream and salsa. Note, if freezing in a zipper bag, place the bag, seam side down, in a plastic zipper bag and freeze. To use the mixture, thaw overnight in the fridge. Bring the mixture to room temperature in the microwave or on the stovetop.

Random Ingredients: mexican oregano,golden raisin,corn tortilla chip,rigatoni pasta,cherry tomato,gherkin
title: Mexican Sausage and Cheese Tortilla Casserole for Two
ingredients: 2 cups packaged rigatoni pasta | 1 jar pickled gherkins, drained | 1 can cherry tomatoes, drained and chopped | 1/2 cup drained golden seedless raisins | 1/2 cup mexican oregano | 12 corn tortilla chips
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Bring a pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add pasta and cook until al dente, about 8 minutes. Drain, cool to room temperature. Meanwhile, heat gherkins in a skillet over medium heat until softened, about 4 minutes. Drain cherry tomatoes. Cut each gherkin into 1/4 inch slices. Spread tortilla chips in the bottom of a 9x13 inch casserole dish. Layer pasta, gherkins, cherry tomatoes and raisins over chips. Sprinkle with oregano. Continue layers until dish is full, ending with tortillas on top. Bake in preheated oven until heated through, about 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: pinto bean,garlic clove,green onion,red pepper flake,polish sausage
title: Crock Pot Beans
ingredients: 1 lb polish sausage ( i like hillshire farms and other hillshire farms ) | 1 medium pinto beans ( about 6 ounces ) | 1 medium green onion ( about 3/4 cup ) | 2 garlic cloves, minced ( about 1 teaspoon ) | red pepper flakes
instructions: Brown the sausage in a medium skillet breaking it up into crumbles. Move sausage to the bottom of the crock pot. Drain and rinse the beans in a colander. Rinse with fresh water and add to the crock pot. Add the remaining ingredients, mix well. Cover and cook on high for 4 hours.

title: Artichoke Hearts and Swiss Cheese With Black Plums
ingredients: 14 ounces artichoke hearts, drained and coarsely chopped | 1 cup swiss cheese, shredded | 7 ounces black plums, thinly sliced ( optional ) | vegetable oil, for frying
instructions: Sauté artichokes in oil until tender. Arrange on a serving platter and add swiss cheese and olives, if using, and serve.

Random Ingredients: cumin seed,italian parsley,cardamom,self rising flour,soda water,serrano chili,white sugar
title: Venezuelan Fried Bread
ingredients: 1/2 cup soda water ( soda should not be able to measure ) | 1 1/2 cups self rising flour | 2 tablespoons white sugar | 1 tablespoon cumin seeds | 3/4 teaspoon ground cardamom | 2 large serrano chili, chopped | 1 tablespoon italian parsley, finely chopped
instructions: In a mixing bowl, stir together the soda and the flour gradually. Stir in the sugar, cumin, cardamom, chili, and parsley until smooth. Cover the bowl and refrigerate 30 minutes, turning it over once or twice.

title: Pear and Tahini Spread
ingredients: 2 ripe pears, peeled and grated | 1 1/2 cups tahini
instructions: Place the grated pears into a medium bowl. Stir in the tahini to coat the pears and set aside. Scoop them out of the bowl and place into the refrigerator to chill. To serve the pears, dip the pears briefly into the tahini to coat and then place onto a small serving platter. Serve with pears on the side for dipping.

title: Thai Grilled Spicy Clam
ingredients: 1 can chopped clams, drained | 2 teaspoons fish sauce | 1/2 carrot, shredded | 2 tablespoons low sodium soy sauce | 2 -4 whole dried red chilies, torn into strips ( more or less, depending on how spicy you want the sauce )
instructions: Combine the clams, fish sauce, carrot, soy sauce and whole chilies in a large skillet over medium heat. Bring to a boil and cook about 3 minutes, just until heated through. Serve with rice.

Random Ingredients: scallion,double cream,cumin powder,phyllo pastry,macaroni,cream tartar,vegetable oil cooking spray
title: Smooth Macaroni Tartlets
ingredients: 1 packet frozen chopped vegetables ( mince ) | 3 cups tasty macaroni | 2 scallions ( spring onion ) | 7 sheets phyllo pastry | 2 teaspoons cumin powder | light cream | 2 teaspoons double cream | 2 teaspoons butter or 2 teaspoons margarine
instructions: Preheat oven to 200ºc. Grease a deep 20cm round or round pan with light film. Cook pasta in large saucepan of boiling water. Reserve 1 cup of pasta cooking liquid. Drain and return to pan. Cook mince, scallions and 1 cup cooking liquid over medium high heat, stirring occasionally until browned. Combine macaroni, remaining ingredients and reserved pasta cooking liquid in large bowl and then stir gently until combined.

Random Ingredients: parmigiano,chicken stock,pork loin roast,brown sugar substitute,key lime juice
title: Sliced Pork Chops
ingredients: 4 bone-in pork loin roast, about 3 pounds | 1/2 cup reduced-sodium chicken stock | 3/4 teaspoon brown sugar substitute ( or sugar ) | 1/2 teaspoon key lime juice | 1 tablespoon freshly grated parmigiano
instructions: Place pork loins between 2 sheets of wax paper and pound until 1/4 inch thick. Place pork in a slow cooker. Add stock, brown sugar substitute, lime juice, and parmigiano. Cover and cook on high 1 to 2 hours or on low for 2 to 3 hours. Remove pork.

title: Strawberry Upside Down Popcorn
ingredients: cooking spray | 1 cup italian seasoned bread crumbs | 7 cups whole fresh strawberries, or more to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Spray 1 tablespoon of cooking spray in a 12x16 inch baking dish. In a bowl, toss bread crumbs with strawberries.

title: Cranberry Tomato Sauce with Cream
ingredients: 14 ounces cranberry sauce | 14 ounces tomato sauce | 7 fluid ounces double cream
instructions: Heat the oven to 200°c and lightly grease an ovenproof dish. Pour the cranberry sauce and tomato sauce into the bottom of a shallow baking dish and arrange the cranberry tomato sauce around them. Bake for 20 minutes, then reduce the oven temperature to 200°c and cook for another 15 minutes. Remove the sauce from the oven and stir the cream into the warm sauce. Serve immediately.

title: Ligurian Style Stuffed Shiitake Mushrooms
