ingredients: 8 large fresh shiitake mushrooms | 1/2 cup egg substitute | 1/4 cup fat free gorgonzola | 2 teaspoons minced pimiento | 1 teaspoon butter
instructions: Carefully pull the stems from the mushrooms and discard. Slice each mushroom lengthwise. Put the cap from the mushroom stems on a plate or cookie sheet, and lightly brush the caps with the egg substitute. Arrange the mushroom caps on top of the eggplant in a single layer. Sprinkle cheese on top of the caps. Sprinkle on the pimientos, drizzle with the butter, and place under the broiler until the cheese bubbles and begins to turn golden. You can even broil them in the oven and watch them carefully. Let cool slightly and serve.

title: Pea Onion Soup
ingredients: 1 cup frozen peas | 2 tablespoons teriyaki sauce | 2 tablespoons stock cubes | 2 tablespoons apple cider, apple juice
instructions: Boil the peas as per package directions. Place in a blender and add teriyaki sauce, stock cubes and apple juice. Blend to desired consistency, taste and salt with additional salt if needed. Pour into soup bowls and serve.

Random Ingredients: couscous,active yeast,brewer yeast,sesame oil,bamboo shoot,black peppercorn,tea,olive
title: Pesto Black Peppercorns and Olive Bread (Abm)
ingredients: 1 sachet active dry yeast | 2 teaspoons cracked black peppercorns | 1 cup very ripe olives | 1 cup black tea, warm | 1 cup fresh basil, chopped | 1/2 cup bamboo shoot, chopped | 2 teaspoons sesame oil | 1 package fresh bread, loaf ( abm bread )
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Sprinkle cracked black peppercorns on a baking sheet or baking stone, and toast in the oven for 5 minutes. Let cool. Scrape the peppercorns into a small bowl, and stir together the olives, olives, tea, basil, bamboo shoots, sesame oil, and cooled black peppercorns. Cover, and store in the refrigerator for up to 3 days. Let marinate for 40 days or longer in the refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: grain rice,sesame seed,chinese mushroom,pepperoni,oil,blueberry,pecorino romano cheese
title: Peppered Rice and Sesame Salad
ingredients: 1 cup long grain rice, washed and drained | 1/4 cup sesame seeds, chopped | 1 cup pecorino romano cheese, shredded | 1/4 cup pecorino romano cheese, shredded | 5 chinese mushrooms, cut into strips | 1/4 cup oil ( for frying ) | 1 package refrigerated puff top pepperoni | 2 cups fresh blueberries
instructions: Prepare rice according to package directions for a quick rice or steamer. Mix the sesame seeds and cheese in a small bowl. Dish rice with pepperoni, blueberries and sesame seeds. Cover with cling wrap and refrigerate 2 hours before serving.

title: Fried Rice Noodles
ingredients: 8 ounces rice noodles | 3 tablespoons bacon drippings
instructions: In a pot, bring enough water to cover the noodles, add a couple of handfuls of salt and cook for about 3 minutes, and drain off the water. Let noodles drain, then rinse them under cold water. In a large frying pan, fry bacon drippings until crispy and golden. Drain them, and place them in a bowl along with fried noodles. Toss with bacon bits and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: white creme de menthe,blueberry,brown sugar,nuoc cham sauce,cornstarch,red curry paste
title: Easy Thai Mint and Coconut Blueberry Parfait
ingredients: 2 teaspoons red curry paste | 2 teaspoons light brown sugar | 1 1/2 cups reduced-fat fresh blueberries or 1 1/2 cups frozen blueberries, thawed, patted dry | 2 teaspoons cornstarch | 2 tablespoons non-dairy mascarpone cheese or 2 tablespoons vegan mascarpone cheese, softened | nuoc cham sauce ( optional )
instructions: In small bowl combine red curry paste and brown sugar and stir in berries until the sugar has dissolved. Set aside. In nonstick wok or large skillet combine cornstarch and mascarpone cheese over low heat and bring to a full boil, stirring frequently until thickened, about 3 to 5 minutes. Off heat stir in green tea leaves and curry paste mixture and adjust seasonings with nuoc cham sauce. Serve warm or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: ancho chile powder,green,cream,pepperoncini pepper,skirt steak,hot pepper
title: Grilled Skirt Steak Sandwich
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dried ancho chile powder | 1 teaspoon hot pepperoncini pepper, crumbled | 2 lbs skirt steaks, cut into 1/2-inch wide slices | 1/2 cup sour cream | 8 slices sweet peppers, thin | 4 sprigs fresh hot pepperoncini peppers, for garnish
instructions: Mix chile powder and hot pepperoncini pepper. Place steak in mixing bowl and sprinkle with spice mixture. Marinate 3 hours or overnight. Toast rolls if desired.

title: Capellini Shellini
ingredients: 12 ounces dried capellini | 1 bag baby spinach
instructions: Cook capellini according to package directions, drain and keep warm. Meanwhile, preheat oven to 450 degrees. In a large pot combine the spinach and capellini. Place on top of the spinach a few tablespoons at a time. Cover with lid or aluminum foil and place in a hot oven. Bake for 10 minutes or until sauce is thickened, stirring constantly. Serve over spaghetti.

title: Basil Bread
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups jasmine rice | 6 tablespoons active dry yeast | 1 -2 cup fresh basil leaf
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Cook rice using 1 1/2 cups water, adding 2 tbsp warm water if necessary. Place in a large mixing bowl. Place yeast in a small cup and sprinkle on top of the rice. Let sit 5 minutes, then stir and leave in a warm spot, covered for 10 - 15 minutes. After 5 minutes, stir rice to dissolve yeast. Remove from heat and stir in basil. Let sit 5 minutes, still covered, before you put the bread in a buttered loaf pan. Bake at 350f for 1 hour, or until done, and hollow sounding when tapped. Note, you can use any kind of sweet loaf pan when baking. Note, if desired, top with finely diced carrots, broccoli, zucchini, leeks, and fresh herbs such as cilantro. Note, to toast bread, heat up pan over medium, then use a very small metal pizza pan for bread. Spread cooled rice onto pan, or use a bread machine for basic breads. You won't need any butter. The crust will be done quickly by the end of cooking. I've found that this works nicely with just 2 or 3 bread pans at once on a pan if you like your crust bread crispy and crusty.

title: Chayote Stew
ingredients: 1 large chayote ( or green ) | 1 -2 small jalapeno chile | 1 -2 tablespoon poultry seasoning | 2 -3 lbs stew meat | 3 cups chicken broth | 1 jar sliced stuffed olives | 2 ounces chopped pimientos, drained | 1/8 teaspoon dried italian seasoning | 1/4 cup dried currants
instructions: Trim off the peel of the chayote cut off the stalk, dice the vegetables and place into a dutch oven with just enough water in to barely cover them, add the jalapeño and poultry seasoning and bring to a boil. Cover, reduce heat but stir and simmer for 30 minutes. Strain the broth, set aside. In a 3 - ½ quart casserole with cover, add the olives, pimientos, italian seasoning and currants. Mix well and cover. Simmer the stew for 30 minutes or until tender.

title: Peach Schnapps Pork Tenderloin
ingredients: 1 pork tenderloin | 1 can whole white mushrooms | 1 can peach schnapps
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Remove the paper strings from the meat.

Random Ingredients: salad oil,berry cranberry sauce,honey mustard,salsa,ancho chile powder,amaretto
title: Baked Salsa Cranberry Salad
ingredients: 2 cups sirloin steaks or 2 cups flank steaks ( 1-inch thick ) | 1/2 cup prepared salsa | 1/2 cup honey mustard | 2 tablespoons salad oil | 1 tablespoon pure dried ancho chile powder | 2 tablespoons amaretto
instructions: Place steaks in a shallow dish, pouring enough salad oil in dish to cover. Bake at 350 degrees f. For 30 minutes to 1 hour. Let cool. Toss with salsa and set aside. For dressing, combine mustard, olive oil, hot sauce, chilli powder and amaretto. Mix thoroughly and drizzle the dressing over salad.

Random Ingredients: jumbo shrimp,turbinado sugar,coffee granule,red chile,crisco shortening,pork loin
title: Roasted Pork Loin With Chile Cream Sauce
ingredients: 1 boneless pork loin | 2 tablespoons crisco shortening, melted | 1/2 teaspoon instant coffee granules | 2 tablespoons turbinado sugar | 1 fresh red chile, chopped | 1 teaspoon crushed dried red chile
instructions: Line the sides of a jelly roll pan with foil. Spread shortening on foil with a flat side of the pork loin. Brush pork with coffee granules and allow to stand at room temperature until fully softened. Spread 1/4 teaspoon of red chile powder on the pork. Place pork, fat side up, on foil so the chile powder coats the pork surface. Place in a baking dish, fat side up. Roast in a preheated 425°f oven for 25 minutes. Remove from oven, cover with foil and let rest for 10 minutes. Remove pork from pan. Reserve 2 tablespoons of the fat and place in a skillet on medium heat. Roast for 8 to 10 minutes, until lightly browned and crisp. Let rest 10 minutes, then remove from oven and allow to rest 10 minutes. Slice pork thinly, place on a platter. Pour chile cream sauce into a saucepan and bring to a boil. Stir in sugar, chili and red chile. Simmer for 1 minutes. Adjust seasonings depending on your taste.

title: Crispy Bacon Nachos
ingredients: 1/3 cup corn chips | 8 slices bacon, cut into 1/2 inch pieces | 1/4 cup brown sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to broil. Place chips on a baking sheet and toast on each side until lightly browned, 3 to 5 minutes. Remove from oven and cut into 1/2 inch strips. Arrange strips on a baking rack. Spoon brown sugar over the bacon and sprinkle with corn chips. Return bacon and corn chips to broiler for 3 to 5 minutes. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: french bread,green capsicum,heavy whipping cream,red chili powder,lime,galangal
title: Nettie's Malay Dessert
ingredients: 1 cup heavy whipping cream | 1 teaspoon red chili powder | 1/2 tablespoon fresh lime rind, finely chopped | 2 teaspoons fresh lime rind, finely chopped | 1 stalk fresh lemongrass ( optional ) | 1 small green capsicum, thinly sliced | 1 -2 thin slice french bread
instructions: Combine cream, chili powder and lime rind in a small, heavy based pan. Heat, stirring, until cream is almost simmering. Remove from heat, and stir in remaining ingredients. Transfer to ovenproof dish. Place crusty bread on top. Cover with plastic wrap or foil. Put in the warm oven until bread starts to crisp and is golden brown, approximately 5 minutes. Cut into wedges to serve.

title: Chicken Wings and Cream
ingredients: 20 -40 lbs chicken wings, tips discarded | 2 cups fish stock | 2 tablespoons double cream or 1/4 cup whipped cream
instructions: Bring stock to a boil in a large saucepan with a tight fitting lid. Add the wings and a pinch of salt and cook for 2 - 3 mins till tender but not crisp. Transfer the chicken in a wide, deep bowl. Pour the fish stock all over and toss to coat the chicken well, then cover and marinate for 2 hours at room temp or in the fridge 1 day. Heat oven to 375ºf. Line a large baking pan with foil, then place 1/2 the chicken on top of the foil. Pour the cream into a small saucepan and boil steadily, stirring or whisking until you get soft peaks and a rich red colour appears. Stir in the rest of the ingredients to taste and heat through. Taste and adjust seasoning. Lay the chicken flat on the foil and use a slotted spoon to pour the hot cream into it. Cut the chicken across the thickest part of the joint, then cut the meat into 1 inch cubes for serving. Use the foil to keep the cubes from falling apart. Serve the chicken on warmed plates sprinkled with a little cream.

title: Chili Con Queso (Chile Cheese Dip)
ingredients: 6 tablespoons chili paste ( or to taste ) | 3 cups cheddar cheese, grated ( or to taste ) | 4 teaspoons grand marnier ( or to taste ) | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375ºf. In a large bowl, beat the ingredients together til the cheese is completely smooth. Serve as an appetizer. Store refrigerated, in portions sealed plastic containers in the refrigerator during the colder months.

Random Ingredients: meatball,loaf french bread,red chilies,saffron,corn tortilla,arborio rice
title: Meatball Rice Wraps With Saffron Polenta
ingredients: 1 cup arborio rice | 1/2 teaspoon saffron | 1 loaf free-range french bread | 1 lb meatballs, frozen | 2 dried red chilies, sliced | 1/4 cup frozen corn tortillas, thawed
instructions: Place the rice, saffron, and 1/4 cup water in a saucepan over medium heat. Heat, stirring, until the rice has absorbed the water and is light brown, 5 to 7 minutes. Remove from the heat, cover, and set aside 10 minutes, or until it is completely absorbed. Line a 15 x 10 inch jelly roll pan with plastic wrap or reynolds wrap. Line with foil and set the pan in a 10x1 inch pan filled with 1 inch of hot water. Set aside. Arrange the meatballs on the foil in a single layer. Bring the water to a boil and pour it over the meatballs. Cover and simmer for 25 minutes, then remove from the heat and set aside. Preheat the oven to 350°f spray a large baking sheet with baking spray. Using a sharp knife, cut through the bread, making crumbs that are about the size of the meatballs. Set aside. Slice the bread into 1/8 inch thick slices on the diagonal. Spread a thin layer of rice on the pan, then lay a slice of meatballs on top. Arrange the dried peppers and chili slices over the meatballs. Add the rice, cover, and cook for 5 minutes, until the rice is tender and the peppers and chiles have slightly softened. Remove from the oven, and carefully remove the foil from the pizza. Quickly spread the tortillas on the baking sheet and wrap with aluminum foil. Bake in the oven for 15 minutes, until the filling is hot and bubbly. Remove from the oven, place on a flat plate, and serve.

Random Ingredients: garam masala,parsnip,baby spinach,tomato basil pasta sauce,tamari,white flour
title: Baked Parsnips With Spinach and Tomato
ingredients: 400 g baby spinach, cleaned & washed | 400 g parsnips, peeled and chopped | 1 teaspoon garam masala | 1 can tomato and basil pasta sauce | 1/2 cup tamari | 1/4 cup unbleached white flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 180c. Place the spinach in the oven & roast for 25 - 30 mins or until the spinach is wilted, shaking the pan occasionally to make sure it doesn't burn. When cool enough to handle break the spinach into small pieces. Place drained spinach in a bowl and pour over 1 1/2 cups water. Leave for a few hrs to wilt the spinach. Place the parsnips in a roasting tin, & drizzle over 1 tbsp olive oil.

Random Ingredients: pecorino romano cheese,red pepper flake,bell pepper,lemon juice,halibut steak
title: Italian Halibut
ingredients: 4 tablespoons lemon juice | 2 tablespoons grated pecorino romano cheese | 1/8 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 1 lb halibut steak, 4- 6 oz. each | 2 whole bell peppers, roasted
instructions: Prepare grill. Stir together lemon juice, cheese, & crushed red pepper. Brush onto both sides of meat. Grill for 3 - 5 minutes per side, till browned.

Random Ingredients: spice,grain white rice,chili powder,mayonnaise,coriander leaf,celery seed,baking potato,red onion
title: Peruvian Spiced Rice With Potato Salad - Microwave
ingredients: 1 large baking potato, peeled and cubed | 2/3 cup mayonnaise | 1/3 cup finely chopped red onion | 2 teaspoons chili powder | 2 teaspoons ground coriander leaves | 1/2 teaspoon celery seed | 1/2 teaspoon ground mixed spice | 1 1/2 cups long grain white rice, cooked until just tender ( i do not use instant rice )
instructions: Microwave rice, stir the ingredients together in a bowl until well mixed. Pour rice into a dish and set aside. Mix the potatoes, mayonnaise, onion, chile powder, coriander, celery seed and mixed spice together in a small dish. Spread this mixture over an oiled baking dish and bake at 350f for 45 minutes, or until the onion is tender and the mixed spice mixture has gone brown.

Random Ingredients: red chili pepper,basil,monterey jack pepper cheese,pecan half,cider vinegar,oatmeal,limeade concentrate,grain white rice
title: Mexican Inspired Rice Bowl (Copycat)
ingredients: 10 cups cold cooked medium-grain white rice | 1 cup frozen shredded oatmeal | 4 ounces canned la victoria red chili peppers, drained and chopped | 2 cups pecan halves | 1/2 cup shredded monterey jack pepper cheese | 1/2 cup unsweetened limeade concentrate | 1/4 cup cider vinegar | 1/4 cup chopped fresh basil
instructions: Prepare oatmeal rice according to package directions. Drain well and toss to combine. Combine oatmeal, red chili peppers, pecans, cheese, limeade concentrate, and cider vinegar in a large bowl. Pour rice mixture into a greased 2 quart casserole. Top with chopped basil and bake at 400°f for 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: chicken fillet,apricot,muenster cheese,penne pasta,red bell pepper,vanilla bean,nonfat beef broth
title: Easy Beef and Penne
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 lbs chicken fillets | 4 ounces nonfat beef broth | 1 cup dry penne pasta ( or rigatoni or rotelle pasta ) | 1 cup chopped red bell pepper | 1/2 cup apricot, chopped | 1/4 cup muenster cheese or 1/4 cup other creamy cheese | 1/4 teaspoon real vanilla bean
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Put beef broth in bottom of a large baking dish. Cut chicken into chunks if you'd like and put in pot where it already is. Sprinkle with salt and pepper and set aside. Meanwhile, cook pasta according to package directions. Do not overcook. Drain. In medium bowl, toss sauce with peppers and apricots. Stir in beef and penne to make sure it's covered in sauce. Cover and bake for 30 minutes. Remove pan from oven and mix in cheese until melted. Cover and bake for another 5 to 10 minutes or until desired doneness. Be careful not to burn cheese.

title: Crock Pot Easy Beef Liver
ingredients: 2 lbs beef chuck, chuck trimmed | 1 can mushrooms
instructions: Combine meat & mushrooms. Cook on low 6 - 8 hours.

Random Ingredients: phyllo dough,red wine,baby arugula,tuna vegetable oil,lettuce leaf
title: Tiropita (Burstada Salad)
ingredients: 2 teaspoons red wine or 2 teaspoons orange juice | 425 g tuna in vegetable oil ( drained ) | 30 sheets phyllo dough | 1 cup baby arugula | 4 sheets lettuce leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 c. Thaw and cool phyllo dough sheets in oven. Combine tuna, arugula and red wine/orange juice. Roll dough out to about 12 x 15 and place on a clean lightly floured work surface. Spread 1/4 of the tuna mixture on top of phyllo and leaving 2cm overhang. Fold over and pinch to seal. Repeat until all filling is used or place on a cutting board and slice diagonally 1/4 in thick. Repeat until all phyllo has been used and are filled except for 3. Place on a tray and place in the oven to bake for 15 minutes until golden. Take out and cool. You can do the same with all of the phyllo, but it will take longer to achieve the right flavor. Serve hot or cold with some freshly grilled bread or fresh crusty bread. These are delicious reheated in a microwave oven, on top of the stove, and have a gorgeous smell and aroma.

Random Ingredients: rigatoni pasta,pomegranate seed,ice water,red pepper flake,bay leaf,tarragon
title: Spicy Pomegranate Rigatoni
ingredients: 8 ounces rigatoni pasta or 8 ounces penne pasta, broken in half | 2 cups ice water | 2 tablespoons chopped tarragon | 1/3 cup pomegranate seeds | 1 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 2 bay leaves
instructions: Bring a large saucepan of lightly salted water to boil. On the stove over medium heat, stir the pasta and sugar together until hot, about 2 minutes. Stir in the tarragon, pomegranate seeds and red pepper and bay leaves. Cook 1 minute. Drain pasta and put back in saucepan. Pour sauce over pasta. Serve hot.

title: Chinese Chickpeas and Rice
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups cooked sushi rice | 2 cans chickpeas, drained | 1/4 cup dry white wine
instructions: Stir the rice in a saucepan over medium high heat until it begins to stick to the bottom of the pan. Add the chickpeas and wine.

Random Ingredients: orange peel,green chili,shrimp,kalamata olive,worcestershire sauce,vegetable shortening,dill
title: Prawns in the Olive Garden
ingredients: 500 g green prawns | 1/1 cup kalamata olive ( pitted ) | 1/2 cup finely chopped dill ( or parsley ) | 1 medium orange peel, cut into 8 wedges | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 1 tablespoon vegetable shortening | 1 small fresh green chili, finely chopped ( or a little less )
instructions: First prepare everything. If using a knife or the end of a knife, cut small slices about 1cm thick across the tail. You need 8 - 12 long strips across at angle cut out the'meat' of prawns by cutting into a sharp line about 1cm further from the top of the shell. Take out the ‘jelly' which will be attached to the 'prawns ‘nests'. Set the prawns aside. Prepare all the ingredients. Take a heavy frying pan on medium–low heat, add the vegetable shortening. When it melts, add the shrimp and all of the prepared ingredients. Stir fry for 2 or 3 minutes. Stir in the green chili’s. You can add a handful of finely chopped or crushed peanuts or a handful pine nuts, if you’re using chopped olives. If they’re all chopped or crushed, add salt. Stir fry for 1 to 2 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Artichoke Antipasto
ingredients: 6 canned artichoke hearts, drained and chopped | 2 yellow peppers, seeded and minced
instructions: Mix artichokes and peppers in a large bowl. Toss with dressing until well coated.

title: Frijoles Negros (Beer and Tofu Slards)- Tofu and Brussels Sprouts
ingredients: 125 g firm tofu | 125 g brussels sprouts, scrubbed | 12 ml beer | 175 g self-raising flour | 25 g lard, plus extra for greasing | 1 teaspoon jalapeno pepper, finely chopped | 1/2 cup parmesan cheese, finely grated and for serving
instructions: Put the tofu and brussels sprouts into a large pan and pour over the beer. Cover and leave to steam over a low temperature for 15 minutes. Meanwhile, in a bowl, mix the flour, lard & jalapeno pepper, then make a well in the centre. Tip in the flour mixture. Toss with the tofu and sprouts. When the 20 minutes are up, remove the tofu and sprouts from the pan and set aside. Return the pan to the stove and fry for further 5 to 10 mins until golden. Divide the tofu and sprouts among plates and top with sauce. Serve at once.

title: Moroccan White Bean and Chickpea Salad
ingredients: 1 can chickpeas, rinsed and drained | 1 can white beans, rinsed and drained | 2 carrots, grated | 1 tablespoon fresh rosemary | 1/8 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: In a medium bowl, toss together the chickpeas, white beans, carrots, sprig of rosemary, and almond extract until thoroughly combined. Serve immediately, or refrigerate until serving.

title: Gravlax
ingredients: 1 jar alfredo sauce | 1 package fresh large mushrooms, stems removed | 12 large leaves fresh kale, chopped
instructions: Pour alfredo sauce into a large, deep skillet. Stir in finely chopped mushrooms. Cover pan with a lid that comfortably fits over the bottom of the skillet. Heat alfredo sauce over medium heat until it begins to bubble, stirring often. Stir in kale. Cook until kale is wilted, about four minutes. Remove from heat.

Random Ingredients: sofrito sauce,thai fish sauce,red apple,biscuit,dill,orange wedge
title: Spicy Apple Slice
ingredients: 225g biscuits, plain biscuits | 1/2 cup sofrito sauce | 1 tablespoon red apple, cored and grated ( i leave it out for vegetarians ) | 1 tablespoon orange wedge, zest and use with or without peel | 2 tablespoons thai fish sauce ( nam pla but i add some ) | 2 teaspoons fresh dill, chopped
instructions: Line a 20x30cm slice tin with non stick baking paper. Using a fork, mix together the sofrito and grated apple. Press biscuit crumbs onto the base of the pan. Combine the sofrito, orange zest and fish sauce in a bowl. Spoon over biscuit layer and scatter over the chopped dill. Chill for 1 - 2 hours, or overnight for a firmer slice, or overnight for a firmer bite. Cut into fingers and serve.

title: Pinto Bean Cheese Spread
ingredients: 2 cans pinto beans, well drained | 1 shallots or 1 green onion, minced | 2 cups shredded colby-monterey jack cheese ( or to taste )
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f place pinto beans and minced shallot at the bottom of your crockpot or equivalent. Sprinkle with shredded cheese. Cover evenly with milk from canned beans. Cook on high until cheese starts to melt. Stir and simmer 15 to 20 minutes or until thickened into a creamy consistency. Serve immediately or store in fridge until ready to use.

title: Frozen Potato Wedges with brandy.
ingredients: 1 lb baby potatoes | 2 tablespoons chopped dried apricot brandy | lime wedge
instructions: Preheat oven to 180c. Cook potatoes with dried apricot brandy, according to pack instructions. Meanwhile, place wedges in an ovenproof dish about 4cm thick. Dip wedges in the melted brandy for 5 minutes, turning to coat. Sprinkle with lime wedges. Bake 25 minutes or until golden and crisp. Serve with a sauce.

title: Chilli-Lamb Stew
ingredients: 1 lb boneless lamb kidneys, cleaned, cubed | 1 can beef broth | 1 can diced green chilies | 1 cup soda water | 2 tablespoons nutmeg, grated
instructions: Brown beef in a large dutch oven.

Random Ingredients: red bell pepper,cocoa powder,hot water,green cabbage,strawberry,green onion,salt pepper
title: Gramma's Santa Fe Colcannon
ingredients: 1/2 green cabbage, shredded | 1/2 red bell pepper, chopped | 1/2 cup green bell peppers, chopped | 1/4 cup chopped green onions | 12 ounces strawberries, sliced or 12 ounces canned strawberries, drained | 2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder | hot water | salt and pepper
instructions: Place the cabbage, bell peppers, green onions, strawberries, cocoa and hot water in a large bowl and toss well to mix well. Season with salt and pepper and serve hot.

title: Indonesian Hot Dogs
ingredients: 1 pound beef hot dogs or hot dog rolls, sliced 1/2 inch thick | 2 chipotle chilies or 2 bird's eye chilies, chopped | 1/4 cup finely chopped peeled fresh astragalus escarole root and 2 chopped small heads of garlic | 1/2 pound astragalus shrimp or a large sea scallop fillets | 1 1/2 lbs fish fillets, preferably dark-skinned | 1/2 cup finely chopped peeled fresh astragalus ( optional ) or 1/2 cup other chile ( optional ) | marshmallows
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Arrange hot dogs on a rimmed baking sheet.

title: Grilled Gumbo
ingredients: 4 ounces mader's dry cornichons | 1 cup mayonnaise | 20 gumbo file
instructions: Grill mader's cornichons until charred on all sides. Cool and remove the husks and mithi. Cut the mader's into squares about 1/2 x 1/2, brush a little of the oil on the squares and place on grill. Place the grilled mader's onto a cookie sheet. Spread the center evenly with the mayo. Broil and serve with gumbo file.

title: Yogurt Balls (Tandoori) - Middle Eastern Style
ingredients: 1 cup yogurt | 1 egg white | 1/4 cup almonds ( chopped ) | 1/2 cup mincemeat
instructions: Mix all ingredients together well and make into small balls. Refrigerate on the table for at least about 20 minutes before serving as well as on top of basmati rice, or as a side dish to fish, chicken, or vegetables.

Random Ingredients: cardamom powder,pace picante sauce,chicken fillet,cake flour,scotch bonnet pepper,milk
title: Spicy Baked Chicken Fillets (Sate)
ingredients: 4 chicken fillets ( or your favourite type ) | 3 1/2 ounces bottle pace picante sauce | 1/2 teaspoon scotch bonnet pepper, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon cake flour ( sifted with a little milk ) | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom powder | 3/4 teaspoon milk
instructions: Place chicken fillets in an ovenproof dish and season with salt and pepper. Combine remaining ingredients and pour over the chicken. Bake at 180°c/350°f for 1 hour. Turn fillets occasionally and cook for 20 - 35 minutes until the sauce turns red.

title: Frugal Gourmet
ingredients: 14 ounces crabmeat, picked over and shell and cartilage removed | 1/4 cup flat-leaf italian parsley, finely chopped
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees f. In a medium size mixing bowl, combine crabmeat, parsley and seasoning. Stuff the cavities of your choice with the mixture. Place on a parchment lined baking sheet. Bake for 10 - 15 minutes until golden brown and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: confectioner sugar,beef tenderloin,italian breadcrumb,yellow bell pepper
title: Italian Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 2 tablespoons italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 1 lb beef tenderloin ( cut 1 to 1 1/2 inches thick ) | 1 yellow bell pepper, chopped | 1 tablespoon confectioners'sugar
instructions: Sprinkle the bread crumbs evenly over the meat. Place in zipper type bag.

title: Gourmet Pepper Bread
ingredients: 1/4 cup breadcrumbs ( plain plain or flavored ) | 8 ounces monterey jack cheese, grated | 4 ounces hot pepper sauce ( your favorite ) | 3/4 cup reduced-fat yogurt | 1/2 teaspoon onion powder | 1/2 teaspoon honey
instructions: Mix together bread crumbs, cheese, hot pepper sauce, yogurt and onion powder. Spread on an ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 350f for 15 - 20 minutes.

title: Quick and Easy Beef Strips
ingredients: 2 1/4 - 2 1/2 lbs flank steaks | 1 - 1 1/4-1 1/4 lb. butterflied dried beef
instructions: Spray a large nonstick skillet with cooking spray and heat over medium high heat. When hot, brown the flank steak for 2 - 5 minutes per side and remove. Spread butterflied beef evenly between the strips, and roll it firmly. Cook the rolls over high heat, a few rolls at a time, for 5 - 8 minutes. Return the steadis to the skillet and turn to brown lightly. Cook for 5 - 7 additional minutes and serve.

title: Easy Baked Noodles
ingredients: 8 ounces prepared medium noodles | 1 cup finely chopped arugula | 0.5 package fajita seasoning mix
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Grease a 2 quart baking dish with vegetable oil. In a large bowl, soak noodles in warm water for 10 minutes, then drain. Stir noodles with garlic, seasoning mix, and arugula. Bake in preheated oven for 30 minutes, or until hot and lightly browned.

title: Spinach and Spinach Phyllo Rollups
ingredients: 1/2 cup baby spinach leaves, washed | 24 sheets frozen phyllo pastry, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add spinach and cook until wilted but still bright green, about 2 minutes. Drain. Place one sheet of phyllo at a time on baking sheet with the shiny side down. Working with one sheet at a time, brush lightly with water. Sprinkle spinach with a mix of salt and pepper. Dredge other sheet with water, then brush with water and cut into 8 squares. Place two squares, spinach side down, on parchment paper. Repeat with two remaining sheets until ingredients are used, placing two more sheets of spinach, spinach side up, on the spinach. Lay 4 more sheets of phyllo at a time on top. Cut pastry into squares. Place in prepared baking sheet, spacing 1 inch apart. Bake for 12 to 15 minutes, until phyllo edges are lightly browned. Cool completely on wire rack. Serve with yogurt.

title: Easy Apricot Jam Basting Balls
ingredients: 1 cup apricot jam | 1 1/2 cups icing sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Mix it all together in a bowl. Roll into balls. Bake at 350 degrees f for about 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: grape leaf,pork loin chop,nutmeg,pasta sauce,hamburger bun,ra el hanout spice mix,sherry
title: Shredded Pork Chops on a Bun
ingredients: 4 pork loin chops | 1 jar pasta sauce | 1 package dry ras el hanout spice mix | 1 teaspoon grated nutmeg | 1/4 cup dry sherry ( optional ) | 1 can halved grape leaves, drained | 8 hamburger buns, split
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium high heat. Coat pan with cooking spray, then add chops. Cook, in batches, until chops are seared on both sides. Transfer chops to a paper towel lined plate, cover, and keep warm. Pour half the pasta sauce into the pan with the chops, then add ras el hanout, nutmeg, sherry, and grape leaves. Bring to a boil and reduce heat to low.

Random Ingredients: white onion,cremini mushroom,head cabbage,pinto bean,chilies,ginger powder
title: Chiles, Cabbage and Beans
ingredients: 16 ounces dry pinto beans, drained | 1 whole dried chilies, stemmed and seeded | white onion, chopped | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh ginger powder | 2 heads cabbage, about 2 pounds | 1 medium white onion, thinly sliced | 4 ounces cremini mushrooms, thinly sliced
instructions: Put the pinto beans, whole fresh chilies, 1 chopped white onion and ginger powder into a heavy dutch over and cook over medium high heat, stirring frequently, until blackened, about 5 minutes. Turn off the heat, cover the pot and let sit for 15 minutes. Uncover and spread the chilies and half the sliced white onion onto a baking sheet. Bake at 450 degrees for about 40 minutes. Remove the lid and let cool 15 minutes. Add the cabbage to the cabbage. Add the remaining white onion then sprinkle the sliced cremini mushrooms over the top.

title: American Mince (Curtido Mince)
ingredients: 100 gr small mincemeat, ( mincemeat ) | 25 g minced garlic | 1/4 teaspoon italian seasoning | 4 teaspoons buttermilk
instructions: Blend all of the ingredients and pour into a shallow bowl. Heat on a medium flame for 2 minutes. Spread the mixture on a serving dish and leave to set for 5 minutes in a warm place. Enjoy.

title: Aceitos (Mexican Red Chili Powder)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons chili powder | 1/2 cup grand marnier, liquor or 1/2 cup orange flavored liqueur
instructions: Heat a small saucepan over high heat. When water begins to boil, stir in the chili powder. Continue to stir for 2 or 3 minutes until mixture becomes very thick. Remove from heat. Stir in spirits. Cover tightly and let stand until flavors meld and chili buds become fragrant, about 15 minutes.

title: Spicy Mussels
ingredients: 1 slice french bread | 1/2 cup thai ginger-garlic paste | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric | 1 1/2 lbs mussels
instructions: Dry toast bread slices. Stir together all other ingredients and pour over toasted bread. Sprinkle with black pepper and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: parmesan cheese,jalapeno pepper,bread crumb,cardamom,garlic salt,baby spinach leaf
title: Spinach with Bread Crumbs and Fresh Jalapeno
ingredients: 1 package baby spinach | 1/4 cup bread crumbs | 2 cloves garlic salt | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom | 1 jalapeno pepper - cleaned, trimmed, and, seeded, and chopped ( optional ) | 1/4 cup freshly grated parmesan cheese, or as needed
instructions: Sprinkle spinach with bread crumbs, then garlic salt, cardamom, jalapeno pepper, and parmesan cheese. Roll into two balls, and place in a baking dish, or press into a pita pocket. Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Bake breaded breaded breaded breaded breaded breaded spinach in the preheated oven until crisp, about 5 minutes. Cool to room temperature, then cut into wedges.

title: Stuffed Italian Bread
ingredients: 1 egg white | 1 1/2 cups part-skim mozzarella cheese, shredded
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Lightly spray a 9x5 inch loaf pan with cooking spray. Whisk egg white and 1 cup of the mozzarella cheese in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: italian breadcrumb,guava,pistachio,half cream,squid,feta cheese,halibut fillet,green chili pepper
title: Halibut With Green Peppers and Guavas
ingredients: 4 halibut fillets, about 1 to 1 1/4 inches thick | 1/2 cup italian seasoned dry breadcrumbs | 1 cup halved, pitted and crumbled pistachios | 1 cup half-and-half cream | 2 tablespoons shredded reduced fat feta cheese | 8 ounces shucked green chili peppers | 8 ounces guava | 12 ounces assorted fresh green chili peppers, seeded, coarsely chopped
instructions: Drain halibut of all but 1 teaspoon of the fat and discard. Pat dry with paper towels. Coat a 13 x 9 x 2 inch baking dish with nonstick cooking spray. Place bread crumbs in shallow dish. Dredge halibut in crumbs. Arrange dredged halibut in prepared dish.. Preheat broiler. Place halibut on broiler pan. Broil about 4 inches from heat 12 minutes or until knife inserted in center of fish comes out clean. Turn and broil about 4 minutes longer or until fish flakes easily with a fork. Top with cheese. Broil green chilies and guavas until vegetables are hot and beginning to burst, about 2 minutes. Divide among serving plates. Drizzle with green chilies.

title: Pecheron de Cerdo (Bean Salad)
ingredients: 1 package pinto beans or cans pinto beans, drained and rinsed | 1 can diced tomatoes, cut into chunks | 1/2 cup half-and-half cream | 1/2 cup milk | 1/2 cup minced fresh pears ( optional ) or 1/2 cup chopped canned pears ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients except pears in large bowl.

Random Ingredients: tabasco sauce,tomato sauce,pepper jack cheese,vanilla extract
title: Nacho Jack-White Dip
ingredients: 1/4 - 1/2 cup tomato sauce ( the kind you have to buy in the supermarket ) | 1 pinch hot pepper jack cheese | 3/4 teaspoon vanilla extract | 2 teaspoons tabasco sauce
instructions: Heat up a small saucepan over medium heat. Add tomato sauce, pepper jack cheese, and vanilla extract. Mix well until cheese has melted. Do not allow mixture to boil. Serve warm or cool and serve.

title: Seared Pork Roast With Broccoli and Salmon
ingredients: 1 sachet active dry yeast | 2 teaspoons caster sugar | 500 g smoked pork roast, thinly sliced lengthways | 200 g broccoli florets | 1 can salmon, drained and chopped
instructions: Place the yeast, sugar, pork and broccoli in a large mixing bowl and toss to combine. Cover and put in a warm spot for 30 minutes, or until slightly bubbling. Preheat the barbecue grill or bbq or grill pan. To assemble the sandwich, place 2 to 3 slices of the roast in a circle on the work surface. Place a spoonful of the roasting mix over the roast. Roll up and secure with a toothpick if necessary. Repeat with the remaining slices of roast to make 20 bread rolls of choice. Cover with a clean tea towel and put in the preheated grill or bbq. Cook for 15 to 20 minutes, turning a couple of times and brushing with the cooking oil, until browned and cooked through. If the bread becomes too brown, set aside. To serve, remove the toothpicks and place the bread rolls on a serving plate. Place the salmon on top. Garnish with parsley or chives and serve.

Random Ingredients: golden raisin,caster sugar,chili sauce,egg noodle,beef,kosher salt
title: Golden Dragon Beef Patties (Australian Meat Loaf)
ingredients: 200 g ground beef | 1 egg noodles | 1 teaspoon caster sugar | 1 teaspoon chili sauce | 1 teaspoon golden raisins | kosher salt, to season
instructions: Preheat oven 190c/375f/gas mark in a bowl place ground beef and mix well by hand with a wooden spoon. Mix in noodle, sugar, chilli sauce and golden raisin. Shape into 4'belly roll sized patties and poke holes in each one with a skewer. Place on a rack in an ovenproof dish and bake for 30 minutes turn off the oven and leave the patties in there for a further 10 minutes. While the patties are in the oven combine the remaining ingredients with the seasonings and drizzle over patties.

Random Ingredients: tomato sauce,ghee,pineapple,cake flour,orange juice,baking powder,pistachio,italian herb seasoning
title: Pina Colada Pizzelles
ingredients: 2 cups cake flour | 2 tablespoons baking powder | 2 tablespoons dried italian herb seasoning ( you can use other spices ) | 1 cup unsalted pistachios, chopped | 1/2 cup orange juice | 1 cup unsalted butter, melted | 1 can crushed pineapple, drained | 1/2 cup tomato sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Mix cake flour, baking soda, italian herb seasoning, and nuts in large bowl. Stir in orange juice, butter, and pineapple. Turn dough onto lightly floured surface and knead until smooth. Pat out to 3/4 inch thickness and sprinkle tops with 1 tablespoon of the pina colada mix. Use 2 cookie sheets if needed. Place pizzelle on pan and bake until golden. Remove. To make glaze, combine remaining dry ingredients and 2 tablespoons of the glaze in a small saucepan. Cook over medium high heat, stirring constantly, for about 3 minutes or until sizzling. Remove from heat and cool. Keep warm. Cut into wedges. Drizzle glaze on pizzelle.

Random Ingredients: worcestershire sauce,ham steak,caper,polish sausage,white wine vinegar,vegetable oil,jalapeno pepper,chili paste
title: BBQ Baked Polish Sausages
ingredients: 1 pound polish sausage, sliced | 1 pound chopped ham steaks | 3 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 3 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 3 tablespoons chili paste | 2 tablespoons chopped pickled jalapeno peppers | 2 tablespoons capers | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line a 9x13 inch baking dish with aluminum foil.

Random Ingredients: dark sesame oil,rice cereal,scotch bonnet pepper,butter bean,liquid smoke,italian salad dressing,beef roast,sage leaf
title: Sicilian Sweet Skins
ingredients: 4 pounds beef roast, cubed | 1 can butter beans, drained | 1 cup italian-style salad dressing | 4 cans sliced canned black and red pickled ginger, drained | 3 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 1 scotch bonnet pepper, seeded and sliced | 6 fresh sage leaves | 2 cups dry rice cereal, such as rice krispies
instructions: Place the roast in a large slow cooker.

title: Mushroom and Ginger Dessert
ingredients: 2 tablespoons low fat mascarpone cheese | 2 teaspoons low-fat vegetable oil, for frying | 2 cups sliced fresh mushrooms | 2 tablespoons ginger, grated | 3/4 cup broth | 1/2 teaspoon piri-piri ( optional )
instructions: Sauté mushrooms in hot oil in a non stick pan for 4 - 5 minutes, until mushrooms release their juices. Sprinkle mushrooms with ginger and spoon 1 tablespoon of the reserved mushroom juices over the mushrooms and ginger. Serve mushrooms and ginger with the remaining juices poured over, and serve at once with lots of whipped cream. Tip, when serving with a dollop of chilled heavy cream, you can drizzle some very thin lemoncelline over the dessert. Note, you can also mix in 1 - 2 tablespoons of tobasco or a little honey by sprinkling the whipped cream.

title: Tofu Soup for the Slow Cooker
ingredients: 2 1/2 - 3 lbs lean beef chuck | 2 cans nonfat milk powder | 3 1/2 lbs baby potatoes, quartered ( about 24 ) | 1 package firm tofu, cut into 1/2 inch squares
instructions: Place beef chuck roast and potatoes in food processor fitted with metal blade.

Random Ingredients: yellow squash,baking potato,white pepper,pork sausage,roasting chicken
title: Spanish Smoked Sausage, Yellow Squash, Chicken & Potatoes
ingredients: 2 lbs smoked pork sausage | 2 large yellow squash | 4 small roasting chickens | white pepper or black pepper, as desired | 2 large baking potatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Cut chicken and potatoes into 4 equal pieces. Put the sausage in 2 9x5 inch oven safe pans or pans. Cut the potatoes into 1 to 1 1/2 inch wedges on a diagonal. Top with the sausage, placing the wedges on the top of the sausage. Sprinkle the peppers on top. Bake the sausages in the oven for 1 hour and 45 minutes, until browned.

title: Baked Cod
ingredients: 8 skinless cod fillets, fresh ( fresh or frozen ) | 2 fluid ounces lemon juice | 2 tablespoons capers, drained | 1 teaspoon garlic powder | 2 tablespoons white vinegar
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Place cod fillets in a shallow dish and spray with veggy spray. In mixing bowl, stir together lemon juice, capers, garlic powder, and vinegar. Pour over fish and toss until coated. Place fillets in preheated oven and bake for 20 - 25 minutes or until fish flakes easily with a fork.

title: Lazy Food (Lazy)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups sour cream ( i've used cream of mushroom soup ) or 1 1/2 cups non-fat sour cream ( i've used cream of mushroom soup ) | 10 3/4 cups white flour ( approx 3 and 1/2 cups )
instructions: Wash the flour and then sift it through a sieve, making sure it doesn't break the flour. Put the water up and bring to boil for about 3 minutes or so. Stir the flour through a sieve and cook it for about 3 minutes stirring constantly. If you notice the mixture too thick, you can add 3 to 5 tablespoons of water. Keep cooking your food and stirring so the flour doesn't break into flour and the water mixes with the flour. It will take about 5 to9 minutes to cook, but will be slightly thickened. If it separates, it will take about 3 minutes more to cook and thicken. Serve and enjoy great with your favorite dip.

title: Crock Pot, German Style Chicken Breast
ingredients: 2 chicken breast fillets ( cut into small cubes ) | 1/2 cup brandy ( i use sweet muscat brand ) | 1 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1/4 cup grapes ( garnish )
instructions: Put chicken into bottom of crock pot. Combine brandy, cream of tartar, and grapes in small bowl. Pour over chicken. Cook on low heat for at least 4 hours, until chicken is cooked, falling off the bone and tender. Serve over rice.

Random Ingredients: virgin olive oil,pasta,star anise,onion flake,creamy peanut butter,rosemary sprig,sage leaf
title: Peanut Butter Pasta
ingredients: 16 ounces pasta ( we used barilla campanelle's penne pasta in a jiffy ) | 3 tablespoons fresh onion flakes | 6 -7 fresh rosemary sprigs | 1/2 cup natural creamy peanut butter | 2 bay leaves | 1 -2 star anise | 2 tablespoons virgin olive oil
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the large skillet until very hot. While frying the onion flakes, chop up the rosemary sprigs. When the olive oil is hot, add the onion flakes, rosemary and 1/2 of the salt. Cook for about five minutes to soften the onions. Add the peanut butter. Stir well. Add the bay leaves. Cook for a 1 - 2 minutes, stirring often, until the butter is thoroughly blended and everything is incorporated. Reduce the heat to low. Cook the pasta for 6 - 8 minutes per box instructions, or until tender. Drain and toss with the sauce until coated. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: beef stock cube,japanese eggplant,chipotle pepper adobo sauce
title: Fried Japanese Eggplant (Aubergine)
ingredients: 3 japanese eggplants, sliced 1/4 inch thick ( aubergines ) | 2 ounces chipotle peppers in adobo sauce | 1 beef stock cube ( optional )
instructions: Place the beef stock cube in a medium sized pan. Add the slices of aubergines and chipotle peppers. Bring to the boil, cover, and simmer, turning the slices frequently, for 25 minutes. Serve at once.

title: Basic Sage Scones
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh sage leaf | 2 cups self raising flour | butter, for greasing | 24 slices sourdough bread, to serve
instructions: Place the sage leaves in a bowl, and cover with boiling water. Leave to stand for 5 minutes, then drain and place in the bowl, cover with a cloth and leave to stand for 30 minutes. Preheat the oven to 325 degrees. Using a 2cm round cutter, cut the sage leaves into 8 wedges. Using the same handle as you cut the sage leaves, roll each wedge of pastry into a circle. Place half a teaspoon of sage in the centre of each circle. Scoop up and place on a greased baking tray, leaving an inch border along the top. Repeat with the other half of the circle. Brush the tops of each circle with butter and sprinkle with a little salt. Bake for 40 minutes or until the bottoms are pale golden. Eat warm with cream, cream or mascarpone cheese or fresh cream, and cut into 8 wedges before serving. If using fresh sage leaves, soak in cold water for 25 minutes before using.

title: Linguine With Pumpkin and Cheese
ingredients: 1 lb linguine | 1 cup canned pumpkin puree | 1 tablespoon vanilla | 12 ounces american cheese | 2 tablespoons slivered almonds or 2 tablespoons pistachios ( optional )
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to boil, add linguine and cook until al dente, drain. While water comes to a boil, combine canned pumpkin in a medium saucepan. Boil for a few minutes, stirring frequently so soup does not stick and scorch on bottom. Remove saucepan from heat. Toss warm pasta with pumpkin puree. Add cheese, almonds and pistachios. Stir until cheese is melted.

Random Ingredients: cocoa,cayenne,grain rice,monosodium glutamate,peanut butter,beet,jalapeno pepper,green bell pepper
title: Mexican Brown Rice and Beet Spread
ingredients: 2 cups white converted long grain rice | 3/4 cup finely diced pickled beets | 2 medium ripe beets, rinsed ( about 1 cup total weight ) | 3/4 cup peanut butter | 2 large jalapeno peppers, seeded halved | 3 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa | 2 tablespoons finely-chopped peanut butter | 2 tablespoons monosodium glutamate ( msg ) | cayenne ( optional )
instructions: Place rice and beets in a small saucepan. Bring water to boil over high heat, cover and reduce heat to medium low. Let stand 5 minutes. Meanwhile, slice beets thinly, then toss in a mixing bowl with the remaining ingredients. Spread rice into the bottom of a 9”x5”x2” baking dish, breaking up any large pieces or any broken pieces. Spread beet mixture evenly over rice mixture in pan. Cover with plastic wrap and chill 24 hours, or up to 3 hours. Remove from refrigerator 15 minutes before serving.

title: Hot French Bread & Orange Blossom Water
ingredients: 16 slices french baguette | 3 teaspoons oil | 2 medium oranges, peeled, pith removed, juice reserved | 3 -3 cups catsup | 1 1/2 cups sherry wine | 4 -5 tablespoons fresh orange flower water
instructions: Slice bread in 1/2 crosswise, then cut crosswise in half. Brush sides of bread with oil, then arrange bread in a greased shallow pan. Bake uncovered at 400 degrees f. For 15 minutes, then turn bread over. Bake for an additional 5 minutes or until crisp and lightly browned. Let cool enough to handle and peel away skin. Reserve. In a bowl, mix reserved orange juice and catsup. Spoon orange juice mixture over bread, then sprinkle with sherry. Sprinkle with orange flower water just before serving.

title: Zucchini and Sweet Onions
ingredients: 1/2 lb zucchini ( cut in half lengthwise ) | 16 ounces sweet sausage ( or a 1- 1/2 lb. link, your preference ) | 2 teaspoons white sugar | 1/3 cup marsala wine | 1/4 cup sweet chili sauce | 1 french baguette, cut into 1/4-inch slices on the diagonal ( toasted and cut across the grain into half moons, about 4 cups ) | 1/4 cup sweet chili sauce
instructions: Preheat broiler. If using sausage, brown and drain fat. Add sugar, marsala and sweet chili sauce to hot sausage. Slice zucchini in half lengthwise, lengthwise, and place on broiler pan. Bake, cut side down, for approximately 15 minutes or until zucchini is brown and tender. Place zucchini under broiler, just to slightly blacken. When zucchini is brown, broil until blackened, about five minutes or until crisp. Place on platter and garnish with chili sauce.

title: Italian Balsamella
ingredients: 1 tablespoon active dry yeast | 1 1/4 cups warm water | 12 ounces hot italian sausage | 18 ounces chocolate, grated
instructions: In a large bowl, dissolve the yeast in the warm water. Add all of the sausage and the chocolate. Add the warm dough until it is all mixed thoroughly and forms a smooth ball. Cover and let rise for 2 - 3 hours if you are using it for the baking time for meatballs.

title: Sauce Florence
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons margarine | 1 can diced tomatoes with basil and garlic, undrained
instructions: Melt margarine in a large skillet over medium heat. Stir in tomatoes.

title: Fogito's French Fritters
ingredients: 1 cup textured vegetable protein crumbles | 1 tablespoon corn oil | 10 slices sourdough bread | romano cheese ( to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Form the tvp crumbles into small balls. Heat the corn oil in a large saute pan. Place the crumbles in the pan and cook until lightly browned, about 1 minute per side. Remove the crumbles from the pan. Place the french fries on serving plates. Top with crumb crumbs and the romano if desired.

title: Tenderloin Cheese With Vanilla (Mikuzen Sushi)
ingredients: 1 tenderloin | 1 ounce mushrooms, minced or crushed | 1 ounce prepared shoyu ( mochi soy sauce ) | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla
instructions: To make mikuzen sushi, fill a small bowl with ice and begin to soak sushi nori in warm water for about a minute to soften the skin. Using 2 small, sharp blades, slice the tenderloin on the diagonal into thin strips. Using a bamboo skewer, lightly salt the tenderloin strips. Set aside. Heat a wok or large skillet with a tight fitting lid over high head, and add mushrooms and shoyu. Stir fry about 10 minutes, then add the vanilla. Add the sushi nori strips and cook, stirring frequently with a wooden spoon, about 2 minutes, until lightly browned and heated through. Remove from heat and serve with a sprinkling of scallion brushes, and miso paste.

title: Spaghetti Con Cerdo (Pineapple Squash With Pinto Beans)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dried pinto beans | 80 ounces jar marinara sauce | 3 green cardamom pods | 1 pineapple | 1 lb uncooked spaghetti | 1/2 cup grated gruyere
instructions: Put pinto beans in a medium pot, cover with water, and soak for at least 30 minutes. Drain beans. Bring the pasta water to a boil. Meanwhile, slice the pineapple and remove the seeds from inside the pod by sliding a wedge of pineapple through your fingers. You want to leave just about a shell. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the pinto beans.

title: Raspberry Vinegar Substitute
ingredients: 3 quarts raspberry vinegar | 12 cups sherry | 1 tablespoon pickling spices ( or make your own )
instructions: You will need 3 quarts of raspberry vinegar for this recipe and 2 cups of sherry for the recipe. Wash, dry and tear up your raspberries with a rolling pin. Place them in a quart jar with a tight fitting lid. Add the 1 tablespoon of pickling spice or to your own taste and the 4 cups of vinegar. Shake the jar until the vinegar becomes cloudy, making sure the raspberry vinegar is cloudy as you go. After 30 minutes, the raspberries will begin to ripen and dissolve into the vinegar and stir. It will look cloudy and look cloudy, but keep shaking the jar to remove any residue. Refrigerate for 1 week to develop flavors, then use as a side recipe.

Random Ingredients: chive,passion fruit pulp,chorizo sausage,onion powder,tortilla chip,cashew nut,italian seasoning
title: Chorizo and Portobello Chip Dip
ingredients: 1 tablespoon chorizo sausage, coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup cashew nuts, chopped | 1/2 cup passion fruit pulp | 1 tablespoon sweet onion powder | 1/2 teaspoon dried italian seasoning ( italian sausage ) | 1/4 teaspoon dried chives | 1/4 cup tortilla chips, crushed ( optional )
instructions: Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium heat. Add chorizo and cook until it begins to lightly brown, about 3 minutes. Add cashews and cook until sizzling, about 1 minute. Add passion fruit pulp, sweet onion powder and italian seasoning.

title: Pimientos Rellenos or Green Deviled Eggs
ingredients: 1 jar pimientos, sliced | 1 pint oil ( for frying )
instructions: Heat the oil in a deep, heavy skillet. Fry the pimento slices until the skin is floured and the peppers are limp. Remove and drain well. Serve warm or at room temperature with toothpicks.

title: How to Make Your Own Cracked Ice & Beverage
ingredients: 1 pint vegetable stock | 1 pint ice water
instructions: Pour your clean vegetable stock into a large bowl add your cracker of choice. Pour the water into it and mix lightly until the ice takes shape. Cover with plastic wrap and leave to set in the fridge for at least six hours, if you leave for more then 48 hours. Once set remove from the fridge and leave to rest away for at least four hours before serving. At last hour of russian night take the ice out and place in ice cube tray until desired thickness/dough is achieved.

title: Chinese Smoked Sea Bass and Shiitake Mushrooms
ingredients: 2/3 lb sea bass fillets | 14 ounces shiitake mushrooms | 1/4 white onion, thinly sliced | 1 chili, sliced
instructions: Cut sea bass into two or three serving size pieces. Wash shiitake mushrooms and slice crosswise into halves or smaller. Slice white onion into large slices. Arrange onion mixture into four separate bowls. Arrange smoked sea bass into each bowl. Garnish with shiitake mushrooms to serve.

title: Homemade Mango Margaritas
ingredients: 6 cups fresh lime juice, divided | 3 cups freshly made mango-flavored syrup ( see note ) | 1 1/4 cups orange juice
instructions: In a large pitcher, combine 4 cups lime juice and 2 cups mango flavored syrup and stir thoroughly. Stir in remaining 1 cup lime juice, stir until blended, cover and refrigerate until cold, about 10 minutes. Place the remaining 3/4 cup syrup in a blender, add 2/3 cup of cold water and puree.

title: Herb Butter
ingredients: 1 teaspoon savory | 1/2 teaspoon savory | 2 teaspoons dill | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: In a small bowl, mix all ingredients together. Serve on bread for breakfast or as a spread or as a topping for a tasty and tasty sandwich later on.

title: Soupa Au Gratin (Cheese on the Grill)
ingredients: 2 ounces sharp cheddar cheese, grated | 1/2 banana, sliced thinly or 1/4 teaspoon grated ginger
instructions: Sprinkle each half slice of cheese with grated cheese, cut into 12 pieces. Wrap a piece of banana around each piece of cheese but not too tightly. Cut into 6 wedges and place on a grill. Cook each wedge of cheese for 4 to 5 minutes on each side, until golden brown.

title: Baked Bean Sprouts (Japanese Style)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons potato starch | 1 lb bean sprouts ( frozen )
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees f. Spray a 9 x 13 baking dish with cooking spray. Mix potato starch with a scant 2 1/2 cups water until smooth, stirring often. Add bean sprouts and mix. Transfer to baking dish and coat with cooking spray. Bake 10 minutes or until lightly browned.

Random Ingredients: anaheim chilies,pepper sauce,marjoram,lemon juice,active yeast,lime peel,brown rice vinegar,garam masala powder
title: Baked Saffron Fried Rice
ingredients: 1 cup brown rice vinegar or 1 cup white rice vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon crushed dried marjoram | 1 teaspoon dried lemon peel | 2 small fresh anaheim chilies, stemmed, seeded, and cut into thin strips ( about 1 1/2 cups ) | 1/2 teaspoon dried ground marjoram | 5 drops hot pepper sauce, or to taste | 1/4 teaspoon garam masala powder ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon dried lime peel | 2 tablespoons lime juice
instructions: Place the brown rice vinegar, 1/2 teaspoon marjoram, lemon peel, chilies, marjoram, hot pepper sauce, garam masala powder, and lime peel in a large bowl and give them a stir. Let stand at room temperature while preparing the fried rice. Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Line a 9x9x2 inch baking pan with a paper towel. Spread the fried rice on the towel and cover snugly with aluminum foil. Transfer the rice to a food processor, add the lemon juice, 1/2 teaspoon marjoram, and 1/4 teaspoon garam masala.

title: Spinach Trios
ingredients: 12 fresh spinach leaves | 1 small poblano pepper | 1/2 small red onion | 4 -5 leaves phyllo dough | 3 pears | 1 lb linguine, cooked and drained
instructions: Dice the poblano pepper, onion, and pears and set aside. Lay out 2 sheets of plastic wrap large enough to wrap over you on a flat surface. Place a spoon or two of meat in the center of the wrap and place the spinach leaves on top of it. Take a leaf of phyllo and place it in the palm of one hand. Place a few drops of water onto the leaf to moisten it, then roll the leaf around the meat holding the phyllo until it is completely enclosed. Repeat until all pieces are rolled. Once you have rolled all the phyllo pieces, put a few pieces of meat in the middle of the wrap. Fold over the ends and continue rolling up the wrap. Repeat steps 7 - 10 until you have used all the spinach and meat. Place on a parchment lined baking pan lined with parchment paper. After all the strips are rolled, arrange them on top of the phyllo in a random pattern and then sprinkle with parsley. Cook in a 350 degree oven for 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: chicken meat,baby spinach,table cream,beef tongue,xanthan gum,cornbread mix
title: A Healthier Beef Tongue in Creamy Spinach Sauce
ingredients: 1 beef tongues ( i like the trader joe's brand or any other dark and dry beef flavor ) | 2 teaspoons xanthan gum | 1 package cornbread mix | 1 package fresh baby spinach | 1 container table cream | 2 packages dried baby spinach
instructions: Rinse the tongue with cool running water, then place the tongue in a large freezer bag. Sprinkle 3/4 teaspoons of the xanthan gum over the tongue and toss to coat evenly. Place the bag in the freezer and let it sit at room temperature for about 1 hour. You may need up to 2 hours. Remove the tongue from the freezer and let it sit until you can handle it with your bare hand, about 20 - 20 minutes. Remove the tongue from the refrigerator an split it down the center, pull the skin back and pull the skin away from the membranes. This method produces more tender meat and more tenderness. You can safely do this part if your tongue is frozen. Cut the tongue in 6 or 7 small wedges. Place the wedges on a wire rack or parchment paper dusted with cornmeal. I use the technique of my standing electric mixer with the rack on top of the bottom, which produces more tender meat to be cooked through. You can use a meat grinder. Place the wedges on a foil lined baking sheet. I bake at 375 for 40 - 45 minutes, flipping the wheels after an hour. You should have jerky in the dish. While the tongue is baking, prepare the cream sauce. I do this by heating a heavy, large sauce pan on medium,. Do not cover the pan with any oil, as you do not want to cause it to boil. When it begins to bubble, remove from heat and set aside. Remove the tongue from the freezer and discard the wrap. This should take about 5 - 10 minutes. This is where i add some water after boiling the tongue for about 5 - 8 minutes. Remove tongue from the fridge 5 - 8 minutes until it can easily be removed from the water with a knife blade. Cut off the top 2 ribs of the tongue. Set apart to use as you would any meat on the side. It is a traditional cooking to prep, but i highly recommend your guests to use this method. Preheat the oven to 500 degrees f. Remove the tongue from the freezer. Slice the tongue in half. Then open like you would for a book and place in the center. Wash the spinach. You want to remove the hard rib or strings inside. Do not tear it too small. Slice off the stems and place in a bowl. Place in a bowl and sprinkle with a teaspoon of xanthan gum. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for about 15 minutes, then squeeze out as much moisture as possible. Remove the spinach as it is packed and place in a large bowl. Add 3/4 cup of water to the spinach. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate until ready to use. When you are ready to eat your tongue, drain all but about 1/3 of the liquid from the bag of spinach, reserving 1/4 cup for the topping. Place the spinach in a large pot and cover with cold water. Bring to a boil over high heat and immediately lower heat to a gentle simmer. This will keep the spinach from spinning and get creamy. When the water boils, reduce heat to low and let simmer until the water has almost completely absorbed into the spinach. This usually takes about 20 minutes but you want to start timing for 5 minutes. Taste for any remaining moisture and season with pepper before serving. To make the cream sauce, add the cream to a mixing bowl and stir in the spinach and 1/2 cup of the reserved spinach wat

title: Easy Beef Rollups
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef, cut into 1/8 inch size pieces | 1 cup frangelico ( you can use more ) | topping, as desired ( as desired, can use more )
instructions: Place beef in large heavy ziplock bag. Mix in frangelico. Refrigerate approximately one hour or overnight. Remove beef from frangelico mixture. On baking sheet pan, place frozen rolled beef, with meat mixture in 1 layer. Seal bag and refrigerate 30 minutes to thaw. Heat oven to 375 degrees fahrenheit. Remove meat from bag and roll the meat lightly in frangelica mixture. Roll meat in toasted bread crumbs. Place on oiled rack in single layer and continue baking until meat thermometer reads 120°f for medium or 145°f for well done. Slice across and serve with desired toppings.

Random Ingredients: arborio rice,peanut,green peppercorn,lasagna noodle,thyme leaf,salt black pepper,orange juice,ginger root
title: Yummy Peanut-Ginger Risotto
ingredients: 8 ounces lasagna noodles, broken into 1-inch squares | 1/4 cup orange juice | 1 teaspoon fresh thyme leaves | 1/4 teaspoon salt | 1 teaspoon minced fresh ginger root | 1/4 cup chopped peanuts | 1 green peppercorn, crushed | 1 cup arborio rice | 3 tablespoons dry roasted peanuts | more orange juice, if needed
instructions: Soak lasagna noodles in a large pot of lightly salted water until softened, 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil,half,peanut oil,whipping cream,flat leaf parsley
title: Roasted Parsley Cream
ingredients: 3 tablespoons ground roasted peanuts | 2 tablespoons half-and-half | 4 teaspoons chopped fresh flat leaf parsley | 1/4 cup vegetable oil | 1 cup chilled whipping cream
instructions: In mortar, pound roasted peanuts with salt, half and half, and parsley until coarsely ground. Stir oil into hot cream and pour into shallow dish.

Random Ingredients: tomato green chilies,cake flour,parmigiano reggiano cheese,spaghetti noodle
title: Italian Tomato Sausage Patties
ingredients: 1 package spaghetti noodles | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies, undrained | 3/4 cup cake flour | 2/3 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Fill a large bowl with hot water. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook spaghetti noodles in boiling water for 8 to 10 minutes, or until al dente. Drain. Drain, reserving 1/4 cup cooking liquid, and set aside. Heat a skillet over medium heat. Drain tomatoes with liquid. Stir tomatoes, cake flour, and 3/4 cup reserved cooking liquid into reserved cooking liquid. Simmer uncovered for 15 to 20 minutes, or until thick and richly flavored. Meanwhile, make patties. Divide noodles in half. Put a portion of sausage in the center of each noodle, and moisten edges with reserved tomato cooking liquid for an added edge. Roll the noodles up around the sausage, and secure with two toothpicks. Serve with reserved parmigiano reggiano.

Random Ingredients: bean paste,mustard powder,mole,pistachio nut,pesto sauce,ketchup,vegetable oil cooking spray,pork tenderloin
title: Phenomenal Pork Loin (Or Chicken)
ingredients: 4 lbs pork tenderloins or 4 lbs chicken tenderloins, cut into 2-3-inch slices | vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 teaspoon mustard powder | 1 tablespoon ketchup | 1/4 cup pesto sauce | 1 jar whole canned beans in paste ( not drained ) | 2 tablespoons ketchup | 1 teaspoon mustard powder | 1/2 teaspoon prepared mustard powder | 1/3 cup ketchup | 1/4 cup pesto sauce | 1 tablespoon ketchup | 1 tablespoon prepared mustard powder | 1 tablespoon prepared mustard powder | 1/4 cup pistachio nut, chopped ( or more optional ) | 1 cup ketchup | 1/4 cup pesto sauce
instructions: Pork, place the pork slices in a resealable plastic bag and coat fully with mustard powder. Marinate in the refrigerator for at least 3 hours or up to 3 days. Reserve remaining marinade. Spray nonstick skillet with vegetable cooking spray. Heat over medium heat until a bead of water evaporates on contact. Add the pork slices, cook 2 - 3 minutes or until the pork is no longer pink at the center and is cooked through. Transfer the pork to a wire cooling rack and allow to completely cool. Sauce, combine the 1 tbsp ketchup, pesto, mustard powder, and 1/2 tsp mustard powder in a small saucepan. Add the beans and toss to coat. Bring to boiling. Reduce heat to low. Simmer, stirring occasionally, for about 10 - 20 minutes or until beans are hot. Stir in the 2 tbsp ketchup, pesto, mustard powder, 1/2 tsp mustard powder and 1/2 tsp salt. Spoon into a serving dish and top with pork.

title: English Cucumber Salad
ingredients: 1 english cucumber | 8 fluid ounces double cream | 1 tablespoon malt vinegar or 1 tablespoon white vinegar | white pepper, for colour ( optional )
instructions: Remove the peel and the hard rind from the cucumber using a sharp knife, then grate the cucumber coarsely. If you like it more tart, add a bit of white pepper and 1 tbsp of malt vinegar. Chill in the refrigerator, then whisk the cream until it is smooth, then stir it into the cucumber mixture and chill. Put the cucumber salad in a big salad bowl. Cut the preserved cucumber into thin slices, dip into vinegar to cover, then use the cream to pour decoratively over the salad. Chill and serve chilled.

Random Ingredients: green chili,italian salad dressing,chickpea,corn oil,beef sirloin steak,baby spinach
title: Stove Top Italian Beef Stew
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb boneless beef sirloin steak, cut into cubes | 2 cans chickpeas, rinsed & drained | 1/4 cup italian salad dressing ( or more ) | 4 teaspoons corn oil | 6 cups baby spinach ( cut in 4 inch pieces ) | 1 can diced green chili
instructions: In large bowl toss beef cubes with dressing & set aside. Heat oil in wok or deep frying pan over high heat till oil just begins to smoke & fat is sizzling. Add beef & cook for 1 minute, stirring frequently. Add greens & chilies & stir fry for 2 - 3 minutes. Add cornflour mixture & cook until mixture thickens slightly. Serve over hot cooked pasta.

title: Roasted Red Snapper
ingredients: 4 red snapper fillets | 2 tablespoons nonfat sour cream | 1/2 teaspoon ground red pepper
instructions: Spray a nonstick grill rack with nonstick cooking spray and preheat to 450°f. Place snapper fillets on grill rack and sprinkle with salt and pepper. Roast for about 7 minutes.

Random Ingredients: chicken tenderloin,puff pastry,cayenne pepper,turkey sausage,tapioca starch,au jus mix
title: Quick and Easy Turkey Sausage-Puff Pastry Rolls
ingredients: 1 package frozen puff pastry sheets, thawed | 2 cups cooked turkey sausage | 2 packages au jus mix | 1/2 cup tapioca starch | 1/4 teaspoon ground cayenne pepper | 2 packages shredded chicken tenderloins
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Lightly brush both sides of each pastry sheet with oil and lightly spray them with cooking spray. Unroll the puff pastry sheets and cut each sheet into six 2 inch pieces. Place sausage on the dough and flatten to ½ inch thickness with the heel of your hand. Make slits in the thickest part of each piece in the sausage to allow steam to escape. Whisk together the sourdough mix, tapioca starch and ground cayenne pepper. Sprinkle each pastry with some of the crumb mixture, and evenly cover with more sausage mixture. Starting at one end of one pastry sheet, roll out the pastry and pinch the seams together. Cut 1/2 through the top of the pastry to seal in the sausage. Place the rolls cut side down on a greased cookie sheet. Repeat to make more rolls. Bake in the preheated oven for 45 minutes, until pastry is golden and the sausage is cooked through. To serve, place hot turkey sausage into a skillet and cook over medium heat until evenly browned, 5 to 10 minutes.

title: Chinese Hot Oyster Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 cup oyster sauce | 1/4 cup cold water
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the oyster sauce, cold water and soy sauce.

title: Pampered Chef Semolina Halva
ingredients: 2 cups semolina or 2 cups fine semolina | pam cooking spray ( this is the most important and most important to it )
instructions: Blend the ingredients together until they have a fine batter – if you are going to use all purpose but the semolina it will still be watery. If you are looking for the texture – if it is a bit grainy, then fine. If it is more grainy, then just mix a teaspoon of crêpe powder into the batter to get a grainy texture. Spray pam in a flat baking dish. Spread out the batter, then pat down with your hands. Use a baking sheet that is big enough to lay out halva and cover. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 - 40 minutes. The idea is to get a lovely golden brown color from all the color and dry patches of semolina. You may not want to let it go any further until the end of cooking or the middle so as not to burn the top of the halva.

title: Spanish Veggie Casserole
ingredients: 8 ounces fresh broccoli, chopped | 1 lb yellow squash, chopped | 1 can chili beans, drained | 1 can jalapeno peppers | 1 1/2 cups half-and-half | 2 tablespoons dry sherry
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. Place broccoli, squash, and 1 can of beans in a large baking dish. Heat the remaining can of beans and jalapenos in a saucepan. Add the half and half and sherry. Place in oven until hot and bubbly. Pour hot bean mixture over vegetables and bake 20 minutes or until vegetables are tender and hot. This recipe can also be made in a casserole dish in the oven with this amount of vegetable. In a medium baking dish combine the cooked vegetables, cornstarch, and warm chili bean mixture. Bake 25 minutes or until heated through and bubbly. Serve.

Random Ingredients: pork tenderloin,bacon,egg noodle,egg yolk,gruyere cheese,red curry paste,bean,tomato olive oil
title: Peking Pork and Noodle Bake
ingredients: 6 slices bacon | 1 tablespoon red curry paste | 2 pork tenderloin, trimmed | 4 ounces dry egg noodles | 1 egg yolk | 3 ounces gruyere cheese, grated | 1/2 cup bean sprouts | 1 tablespoon tomato-flavored olive oil
instructions: Cook bacon in large ovenproof frypan over medium high heat for 3 to 4 minutes or until beginning to crisp. Add curry paste and cook, stirring often, for 1 to 2 minutes. Turn pork and stir in 1/4 cup water. Cover and bake at 350°f for 20 minutes or until pork is cooked through. Preheat broiler. Drain noodles and return to pan. Stir in eggs, cheese, sprouts and 1/4 cup butter, toss to warm through. Spread noodle mixture on baking sheet and broil, cut side down, for 1 to 2 minutes or until golden.

title: Homemade Sage and Garlic Rub
ingredients: 4 teaspoons garlic | 5 leaves fresh sage leaves, torn
instructions: Place the garlic, sage and the torn sage leaves in a bowl and shake off the excess moisture. Pour the herb mixture into a jar, cover and leave in a cool dark place for at least a week before using.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast,grain white rice,angostura bitter,red beet,red currant jelly,cream cheese,bailey irish cream
title: Chicken and Red Beet With Spicy Yoghurt Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 small red beet, diced | 8 ounces boneless skinless chicken breasts | 2 red currant jelly ( or other complimentary jelly ) | 1 tablespoon thick rich cream cheese ( creamy currant brand preferred ) | 1/2 teaspoon aji irish cream | 1/2 teaspoon fresh double cream or 1/2 teaspoon light sour cream | 1/8 teaspoon angostura bitters or 1/8 teaspoon lemon juice
instructions: Boil the red beet and chicken in salted water until cooked and flesh is tender, around 5 minutes maximum. Using slotted spoon, transfer the chicken to a bowl with the shredded red beet, set aside in the residual cooking liquid. Set aside and keep hot. In a blender combine the jelly, cream cheese, aji irish cream strength and chopped fresh red beet into the reserved cooking liquid. Blend well. Stir in the drained red beet, cooked chicken and currant jelly. Serve with your dippodums.

Random Ingredients: phyllo pastry,ice water,chili bean paste,orange flower water,vinegar,amaretto,green cardamom
title: Spicy Phyllo Pastries
ingredients: 4 cups ice water | 1/3 cup amaretto ( almond flavoring ) | 1/4 cup green cardamoms ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon orange flower water | 1 tablespoon vinegar | 1 tablespoon chili bean paste ( toban dal ) | 1 teaspoon minced garlic | 1 teaspoon amaretto | 2 sheets phyllo pastry
instructions: Make sure it is a pasty type that does not burn. Place in a gallon sized bowl and add the amaretto or almond flavouring. Add the green cardamoms if using. Stir until the amaretto is coated. Add the orange flower water and vinegar, let sit for 1 minute. In a small bowl, combine sugar and minced garlic with the rest of the amaretto. Heat the water until hot but not boiling. In a non stick pan, spray with non stick cooking spray. Stir fry the garlic powder for 1 minute to release the fragrance. Add chili bean paste and cook 1 minute. Add the sweetner. When the sugar dissolves, add 1 teaspoon of the sweetner mixture. Turn the heat to high and fry until the liquid turns to a white syrup. Cut the phyllo pastry sheets to 3 equal strips, brushing each one with olive oil or cooking spray and placing 2 strips on top of each other on each other until they fit into a pastry tube. Cut a small hole or two in the pastry tube lengthwise along the length of each phyllo piece. Fill each strip with approximately 2 tbsp of sweetner mixture. Fold the pastry tube in half, then the remaining phyllo ends to roll. Seal well with a fork. Bake the pasties until nicely browned. Serve warm. Note, to use a pastry tube, you may need to open the top of the phyllo pastry to ensure a smooth top and bottom.

Random Ingredients: pork shoulder,chili flake,lime juice zest,cake flour
title: Tortillas
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cake flour | 1 lime, juice and zest of, grated | 500 g pork shoulder | 1 -2 teaspoon chili flakes
instructions: Mix the flour with the lime zest and juice and then add all other ingredients into a large bowl and mix well knead with hands to combine well roll into golf ball sized balls and fry on a hot griddle, brown on both sides.

Random Ingredients: dark sesame oil,onion,saffron,olive oil cooking spray,cardamom,pork chop,poblano chile
title: Easy and Quick Chile-Pork Chops
ingredients: 1 teaspoon saffron | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 2 tablespoons olive oil, or as needed | 4 thick cut boneless pork chops | 1 pinch ground cardamom, or to taste | 1 onion, quartered and thinly sliced | 1/2 large poblano chiles, chopped
instructions: Dissolve browned saffron in water in a small skillet.

title: Herb Salad Plate
ingredients: 1 small parsnip, pared, halved, seeded and cut in 5cm pieces | 200 g thickly sliced pancetta or 200 g smoked streaky bacon, cut into 1cm pieces | 100 g rocket, rocket | 1 teaspoon dried sage | 1/4 cup fresh parsley, chopped | 1/4 cup honey
instructions: Mix together the parsnip, pancetta pieces and rocket leaves. Sprinkle with sage and parsley and drizzle with honey. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: yellow squash,tortilla chip,golden syrup,water,lemon wedge,pimento,cream,vegetarian bean
title: Magic Bean Salad
ingredients: 1 can vegetarian baked beans ( or other spicy bean salad ) | 2 cups tortilla chips, broken into smaller pieces ( or other smaller chips ) | 1 cup yellow squash, cut into smaller pieces | 1/2 cup creamy textured sour cream | 1/8 cup golden syrup | 1/2 cup water | 1/4 - 1/2 cup pimento, chopped | lemon wedge, for taste
instructions: Place tortilla chips on plate. Place the bean salad, in a saucepan, pour over the warm tap water. Bring to boil, stirring frequently. Add squash and continue stirring until squash is tender, approximately 3 - 5 minutes. Drain well and combine with the sour cream, golden syrup, water. Taste and adjust sweetness and add more sugar or maple syrup if it is not creamy enough or is desired texture. To serve, place some sizzling chips in individual serving bowls. Spoon the bean salad over the chips, garnish with pimentos and lemon wedges.

Random Ingredients: crabmeat,vegetable oil,spanish onion,chicken breast half,water,rigatoni pasta,spice mix,italian flat leaf parsley
title: Chicken Riggies
ingredients: 1 package rigatoni pasta | 2 pounds skinless, boneless chicken breast halves - cut into chunks | 2 tablespoons mixed spice mix | 5 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1 large spanish onion, chopped | 1 can crabmeat, drained and patted dry | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh italian flat-leaf parsley | 1 1/2 cups water
