instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, stir in the rigatoni, and return to a boil. Cook uncovered, stirring occasionally, about 9 minutes. When the rigatoni is finished cooking, remove from the heat and stir in the chicken, vegetable oil, onion and crabmeat. Sprinkle with parsley and season to taste with salt and freshly ground black pepper. Return the chicken mixture to a simmer over medium low heat. Meanwhile, bring 1 cup water to a boil in a saucepan. Pour 1/2 of the pasta mixture into a bowl, then stir in the 1 1/2 of the pasta mixture. Pour the half cup of water into the bowl, then toss to mix. Simmer the riggies in the pot until the meat is no longer pink in the center, about 10 minutes. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: pea carrot,caraway seed,orange peel,beef tenderloin,beefsteak tomato,chili paste,white onion,pork shoulder
title: Spanish Daube
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon caraway seed | 1/4 teaspoon dried orange peel | 2 1/2 ounces thinly-sliced beef tenderloin | 1/2 lb beefsteak tomato | 1/4 lb pork shoulder | 1/4 cup thinly-sliced white onion | 1/4 cup frozen peas and carrot | 2 teaspoons chili paste | 1 1/2 teaspoons caraway seeds
instructions: To make the daube spice mix, toast the caraway and orange rind in a dry skillet over medium heat until fragrant and beginning to blacken, about 5 minutes, stirring constantly. Let cool until it can be removed from oil and fragrant. Combine all ingredients in a resealable container, seal, and chill until needed.

title: Creamy Ricotta
ingredients: 2 cups ricotta cheese, shredded | 1 teaspoon creole-style seasoning
instructions: Mix ricotta, creole seasoning, and black pepper in a bowl until well combined. Cover bowl with plastic wrap, and refrigerate 8 hours.

Random Ingredients: leek,cumin seed,ziti pasta,chickpea flour,cremini mushroom,white corn
title: Ziti and Chickpea Fritters With Mushrooms and Corn
ingredients: 200 g ziti pasta ( or spaghetti of your choice ) | 200 g cremini mushrooms, finely sliced | 2 tablespoons chickpea flour ( besan ) | 2/3 cup white corn | 1/2 teaspoon cumin seed | 1 medium leek, finely cleaned, finely sliced ( optional )
instructions: Cook the ziti with 3 cups boiling water for about 7 mins. Drain the ziti and keep aside. Cook the mushrooms briefly in a little oil in a pan, then set aside. Heat the remaining oil in a non stick pan and stir fry the cumin seeds for about 10 minutes or until they begin to sizzle. Add the leek, if using and fry for a further 5 minutes. Stir in the ziti with the hot mushrooms and fry for a further 2 minutes to heat through. Turn out onto a serving dish, stir in the chickpea flour, and scatter over the chopped cilantro. Serve.

title: Cambodian Pork Kebabs (Cambodian)
ingredients: 4 ounces sliced italian sausage ( or links ) | 2 tablespoons sizzling ouzo | 1 teaspoon peanut oil or 1 teaspoon clarified butter | 1 lb fresh pizza dough, cut into 24 balls | 4 tablespoons chopped peanuts | 4 tablespoons ghee | 1 teaspoon green curry paste
instructions: Mix the italian sausage with the ouzo. On a lightly floured surface, roll each ball with a rolling pin to a 1/4 inch thickness. Remove the kabab from the freezer, about 30 minutes to 1 hour before cooking, flatten the thickest part of the kabab around to flatten slightly and remove. Roll each kabab again so you get 2 or 3 rolled kababs. In a small bowl, mix 2 tbsp ghee and 1 tsp green curry paste. Brush the oil on the outside of the kababs. Place the kabab on a sheet pan and brush with the ghee curry paste. Preheat the oven to 400°f place kabab on two rack in the oven and bake the chicken and sausage over high temp for 15 minutes, or until the middle is crispy. To serve, sprinkle the peanuts on top and flip the hot chicken onto a serving plate. Serve the cooked kabab with warm italian salad and green salad.

title: Cotija Cheese Appetizers
ingredients: 24 ounces cotija cheese, shredded | fresh ground black pepper
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Store in the refrigerator in an airtight container. Note, cotija cheese is a salty cheese similar to feta cheese for authenticity. If you prefer to make the cotija cheese as close to real feta cheese as possible, store it in the freezer in an air tight container for up to 1 week.

title: Tortilla Pork Tenderloin
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds pork tenderloins | 1 tablespoon chili paste | 12 tortillas
instructions: Cut the tenderloins into 2 inch thick slices. Combine the chili paste and 1/2 cup warm water and rub both sides of the tenderloins with the paste. Cover the entire roast in the tortillas and refrigerate overnight. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Transfer the roast to a roasting pan and cook for approximately 25 to 30 minutes, or until tender and brown.

title: Spinach with Kaffir Lime Butter
ingredients: 6 cups fresh spinach leaves | 2 boxes dried whole spinach | 10 kaffir lime leaves, crushed ( or other long, thin strips of lime peel ) | 1/2 cup fresh basil, chopped ( or to taste, or use cilantro for a kick )
instructions: Wash the spinach, remove the hard stems from the stems, and thoroughly dry them using a towel to squeeze out excess liquid. Separate the leaves from each other and place into a large bowl with the kaffir lime leaves. Place the spinach in a steamer, and steam over boiling water for 1 minute to release excess moisture. Remove from steamer, and drain immediately, or refrigerate for up to 1 week. For a fresh lime butter, add 1 tablespoon lime peel and about 1 tablespoon water, stir well, and set aside for use later. Thinly slice the basil, then coarsely grind with a mortar and pestle in a blender or food processor until very fine. Add the basil to the spinach and stir well. Keep refrigerated until serving time.

Random Ingredients: guacamole,rice vinegar,creole seasoning,tomato sauce,alfalfa sprout,lobster tail,sun tomato oil,green serrano chilies
title: Spanish Tuna and Lobster Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs fresh lobster tails, peeled, and sliced into bite-sized pieces, tail ends removed | 1 package alfalfa sprouts | 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained | 1/4 cup rice vinegar, divided | 1 teaspoon creole seasoning, divided | 1 can tomato sauce | 2 fresh large green serrano chilies, seeded and finely chopped | 1/2 cup bottled guacamole, for serving ( see note )
instructions: Note, these salad ingredients can be made ahead of time and refrigerated until ready to serve. Place lobster tails in a large skillet over medium heat and cook, stirring occasionally, until opaque and beginning to curl, 2 to 3 minutes. Place shrimp in a bowl with remaining shrimp, cover, and cook about 5 minutes or until shrimp just turn pink and opaque. Add to Lobster tail pieces. Cover skillet and continue cooking about 3 minutes or until shrimp turn pink. Transfer shrimp to a large bowl. Add sun dried tomato. Cover and refrigerate until ready to serve. Whisk 1/2 cup rice vinegar and creole seasoning in a small bowl to blend. Stir in tomato sauce, remaining 1 teaspoon creole seasoning, and green onions. Cover and refrigerate 3 hours. Season shrimp mixture with remaining 1 teaspoon each of creole seasoning and the chiles to taste.

title: Black Forest-Roasted Ham, Camembert & Blueberry Salad
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger | camembert cheese or swiss cheese | 1 package frozen blueberries, thawed | 12 sprigs fresh thyme leave | 1/2 teaspoon savory | 2 lbs fresh snow peas
instructions: Warm grill on high heat. Remove ham from package and cut into six equal sized chunks. Prepare grill. Place ham in a skillet over high heat and cook 2 - 3 minutes per side until brown on all sides. Remove ham from skillet and set aside. Combine the remaining ingredients in a large bowl and place ham back in skillet. Toss everything together and add dressing, toss again. Cover and place over medium heat until heated through, about 4 - 5 minutes. Add ham back in and serve.

Random Ingredients: biscuit,lamb cutlet,rice wine,lipton onion soup mix,crescent dinner,serrano pepper
title: Lamb Cutlets or Pork Steaks
ingredients: 1 envelope lipton onion soup mix | 1 lb boneless lamb cutlet or 1 lb pork steak, cut into 1 inch slices ( 2 to 3 per pound ) | 1 can refrigerated crescent dinner rolls | 1 large can refrigerated crescent dinner rolls | 1/2 cup rice wine or 1/2 cup dry sherry | 2 serrano peppers, chopped
instructions: Sprinkle meat with soup mix. Heat oven to 400 degrees. Unroll the dough on a floured surface. Place cutlets on a ungreased cookie sheet. Bake for 9 minutes on each side or until meat is browned and no longer pink. Remove from oven. Remove meat from oven and let stand for 5 minutes before thinly slicing across the grain. Remove meat from bones. Stir broth mix and rice wine into the meat. Lay crescent rolls on a flat surface. Spoon meat and broth mixture into the center of 4 rolls. Top with the crescent rolls. Cut the remaining rolls into 1 inch squares and arrange 4 squares in a row along the length of each row. Bake for 5 to 8 minutes or until golden brown. Cut each piece diagonally into 4 slivers. Serve with rice and your favorite toppings.

title: Dough Ladyfingers
ingredients: 1 package ladyfingers, split | cooking oil | 1/4 cup cooking oil | 4 cups powdered sugar
instructions: Cook ladyfingers in 2 - 3 tablespoons of cooking oil until golden brown. Remove from wok. Spread one half of them on paper towels. Roll tightly. Fry in 1/4 cup oil in a non stick skillet. Let cool, then cut in small pieces. Serve with powdered sugar.

Random Ingredients: cinnamon,green lentil,garlic salt,hard egg,celery seed,mustard seed,brussels sprout,adobo seasoning
title: Adobo Veggie Salad
ingredients: 1 pound brussels sprouts, sliced | 4 hard-cooked eggs, cut into wedges | 1 tablespoon mustard seeds | 1/2 tablespoon mustard seed | 1/2 tablespoon celery seed | 1 1/2 teaspoons adobo seasoning | 1 teaspoon salt | 1/4 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 2 tablespoons green lentils
instructions: Stir mustard and mustard seed in a small skillet over medium high heat.

title: Beef and Parsnips on a Half Shell (Omi)
ingredients: 1 prepared refrigerated pie crust | 1 lb sirloin tip steak, thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons fresh parsnips, thinly sliced | 1/2 lb goat cheese, crumbled
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Line a baking sheet with foil and arrange pastry shell. On top of shell, spread sliced beef on each piece of beef and arrange parsnips and goat cheese on top. Bake for 15 minutes, then broil for 2 - 3 minutes or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: rosemary sprig,chicken wing,lettuce leaf,caster sugar,beef brisket,pine nut,peanut,hamburger bun
title: Lebanese Style Hot Dogs
ingredients: 700 g whole chicken wings | 1 beef brisket | 2 tablespoons caster sugar | 1 rosemary sprig | 100 g shelled peanuts, roughly chopped | 8 hamburger buns, halved | 4 leaves lettuce leaf | 2 tablespoons pine nuts, toasted | 2 teaspoons peanuts, chopped, toasted
instructions: Trim fat from chicken wings.

Random Ingredients: chicken broth,ice water,spanish onion,pesto sauce,black bean,cocoa powder,white bean,poblano pepper
title: Spicy Bean and Bean Stew
ingredients: 1 cup chopped spanish onion | 3 cups canned white beans, rinsed and drained | 1 can black beans, rinsed and drained | 1 3/4 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder | 1 3/4 cups chicken broth | 1 cup ice water | 1/4 cup pesto sauce | 2 poblano peppers, seeded and finely chopped
instructions: In a heavy 3 - 4 quart dutch oven sprayed with cooking spray, sauté onions in hot buttery butter for 5 minutes. Add beans and black beans. Add 1 3/4 cups water and bring to boiling. Reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes, covered. Add cocoa powder, stirring. Simmer for another 3 minutes. Add broth and ice water, continuing to simmer for 10 minutes. Stir in pesto and black pepper. Ladle into bowls. Garnish with sliced poblanos.

Random Ingredients: salt pepper,white onion,pork loin roast,wheat,liquid smoke,currant
title: Lomo Saltado (Salt Free Pork Roast)
ingredients: 1 whole boneless pork loin roast | 2 tablespoons white onion, finely diced | 1/2 cup fresh currant | 1/2 - 3/4 cup whole wheat flour or 1/4-1/2coconut flour | 1 sprig of fresh mint or 2 dried mint leaves | 1 -2 teaspoon liquid smoke
instructions: Trim all excess fat from meat using a very sharp paring knife. Make a small pocket in the roast and insert the minced onion. Insert a small sprig or mint sprig into the pocket of meat using toothpicks. In a bowl, prepare dough for cooking. When ready to cook, flour meat of the roast and dredge under flour. Prick holes about a dozen or so times so the meat will be easy to remove from the bones. In a wok or non stick frying pan, brown meat on all sides in oil approximately 5 to 10 minutes. Add the currants and a few splash of water until absorbed and currants are plump. Stir well to mix all ingredients together. When meat is done, remove from pan, drain and cover with lid. Let meat rest for 20 to 30 minutes at room temperature until the internal temperature reaches 170°f. Uncover the pot, add the liquid smoke, and stir to deglaze. The liquid smoke should be all over the meat and be no more than dark at this time. You can also use your favorite white wine to baste the pork during the cooking if you like. Serve at once. Note, if you prefer a thinner gravy, cook the meat at a slow start of the meal, if you don't use wheat flour it will need to be mixed for about a minute or so before the meat is done, so be sure to skim off any fat during that time. You may also use 1 cup of dried bread crumbs as a substitute to the currants when cooking the lamb. If you wish to brown the meat for a few minutes, cook and turn several times as it browns. It usually takes about an hour to brown all sides of the meat. This will not only have to be done but also help keep it moist. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: tomato green chilies,hash brown,cheddar cheese,cherry,worcestershire sauce
title: Mexican Hash Browns
ingredients: 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies | 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 1 package frozen hash browns, thawed | 1 cup shredded cheddar cheese | 1/4 cup chopped cherries ( optional )
instructions: Lightly spray a large skillet with nonstick cooking spray. Heat 1 can of tomatoes with liquid in skillet over medium high heat. Stir in worcestershire sauce. Place half of hash browns in skillet. Sprinkle with half of green chilies and sprinkle with half of the cheese. Repeat layers. Top with remaining half of tomatoes and sprinkle with remaining cheese. Top with cherries just before serving.

title: Irish Tilapia
ingredients: 2 tilapia fillets | 4 ounces broccoli, chopped coarsely | 1 small butternut squash, chopped coarsely | 2 tablespoons horseradish | 1/2 cup whole wheat flour
instructions: Cook tilapia in a 400f oven for about 7 minutes, or until just starting to brown. Spread cooked tilapia with floured horseradish and sprinkle on the broccoli. Spread squash on top and serve.

title: Corn and Maple Oyster Pie
ingredients: 1 pie pastry, thawed | 1/2 cup scallops | 1 cup corn | 1 tablespoon corn syrup | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce | 1 tablespoon maple syrup | 2 tablespoons maple syrup
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Place pastry onto the bottom rack of an oven safe pie dish. Sprinkle with scallops, then scatter corn on top. Scatter chopped scallops around the scallops and set aside while preparing the filling. In a bowl, combine the corn syrup, oyster sauce, and maple syrup. Beat the mixture until smooth. Pour mixture into bowl and beat until well combined. Brush the pastry with the maple syrup mixture, making sure it covers the entire surface. Bake in the preheated oven for 20 minutes until lightly browned.

Random Ingredients: apricot preserve,tarragon,sage leaf,beef stew meat,italian tomato
title: Roasted Apricot Gravy
ingredients: 3 lbs beef stew meat, cut into 1 1/2-inch cubes | 3 cans italian-style tomatoes, undrained | 1 jar apricot preserves | 2 teaspoons dried tarragon | 2 teaspoons dried sage leaves
instructions: Place beef in a shallow roasting pan. Combine tomatoes and preserves. Pour over beef. Sprinkle with tarragon and sage leaves. Cover.

title: Chile Roasted Raspberry Salad
ingredients: 2 tablespoons saffron | 1 package fresh raspberries | 3 cups blue cheese salad dressing | 2 chile peppers
instructions: Place saffron in a small dish and crush using the back of a small spoon. Pour 1/4 cup of the saffron over 2 tablespoons of the fresh raspberries. Mix well to combine and set aside. In a small bowl, mix the blue cheese salad dressing and chiles. Toss with the berries in the dressing and chill for at least 1 hour to allow flavors to blend. Taste and adjust seasonings.

Random Ingredients: mustard powder,thai fish sauce,vinegar,tomato paste,hot water,veal,black pepper,oregano
title: Veal and Tomato Veal in Vadouvan
ingredients: 2 lbs veal, pieces | 3 tablespoons vinegar | tomato paste | 3/4 cup hot water | 1 1/2 teaspoons dry mustard powder | 1 teaspoon ground black pepper | 1 teaspoon basil and oregano | 1/2 teaspoon hot mustard powder | 1 teaspoon red-wine vinegar | 2 -3 drops thai fish sauce
instructions: Rinse veal of all dust and pat dry. Rub the marinade all over the meat of the meat and allow it to marinate for at least a few hours. Combine the remaining ingredients and bring to a boil. Pour the boiling mixture over the meat and cover. Simmer for 45 minutes. Remove from the heat and keep covered and continue to marinate for about 1/2 hour or until very tender.

title: Dressed Apple Cider
ingredients: 1 lb apple, such as fuji | 1 teaspoon capers, rinsed and drained | 1/2 yellow onion, roughly chopped | 1/4 cup triple sec | 1 cup apple juice | 3/4 cup cold water
instructions: Chop apple very small dice. Place apple in medium frying pan, sprinkle with salt and heat on high until boiling. Boil for 10 minutes or until tender. Turn off heat. Drain, and leave apple for 5 minutes. Cut into small pieces. Meanwhile, in small frying pan, toast capers over medium low heat, tossing occasionally, for 2 minutes. Remove from pan and place on paper towel. In large bowl, mash together capers, onion, triple sec and apple juice. Add onion mixture and water to apple mixture, mixing well. Cover with plastic wrap, pressing firmly so mixture does not break apart. Refrigerate for at least 2 hours to chill before serving.

Random Ingredients: parmesan cheese,ginger garlic paste,oregano leaf,flour tortilla,lemon grass,cake,vinegar
title: Gingery Grilled Beef Pinwheels
ingredients: 12 slices prepared sandwich or 12 slices deli sliced thin beef roast | 2 tablespoons fresh lemon grass or 2 tablespoons chopped lemongrass | 1/4 cup flour | 2 teaspoons grated fresh ginger-garlic paste | 4 teaspoons dried oregano leaves ( preferably iranian ) or 1 1/2 teaspoons dried oregano | 1 1/2 fluid ounces salad oil or 1 1/2 fluid ounces balsamic vinegar | 1 package sliced cake, cut lengthwise in half horizontally and cut each half crosswise into 12 slices
instructions: Trim fat from meat. Combine lemon grass, flour, ginger garlic paste, oregano and 1 teaspoon salt in food processor and blend until smooth. Stir in oil. Spread half of meat in each tortilla. Top with meat mixture and add remaining meat. Roll up tightly. Place each wrapped beef roll onto oiled grill rack coated with oil and grill over medium hot coals 12 - 14 minutes or until well browned on outside and meat thermometer reads 160° in the middle. Brush beef with any marinade while grilling and turn on more indirect heat. Continue grilling 10 - 15 minutes or until instant read thermometer reads 160° when inserted through side of meat. Serve with lemon wedges.

title: Persian Lamb
ingredients: 450 g stewing lamb, cut into 1 inch cubes | 150 ounces greek yogurt | 1 tablespoon ice, crushed | hard boiled egg, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 175c or 160°c. Place lamb in a baking dish, pour over the greek yogurt, cover and bake in hot oven for 45 min, shaking the lamb frequently. Stir once or twice during baking to spread the yogurt evenly. Remove cover and bake for another 10 - 15 min or until meat is tender. Scatter chopped egg on top and serve along with rice.

Random Ingredients: flat leaf italian parsley,plain yogurt,celery rib,kalamata olive,black eyed pea,hard egg
title: Mediterranean Baked Eggs
ingredients: 1 can black-eyed peas, drained and rinsed | 3 hard-boiled eggs, shelled, and chopped | 1/2 cup chopped fresh flat-leaf italian parsley | 1/2 cup crumbled kefalotyri kalamata olive | 1 small celery rib, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons plain yogurt
instructions: Grease an 8 inch square baking dish with cooking spray. In a large bowl, stir together black eyed peas, hard cooked eggs, parsley, olives, celery and yogurt until well blended. Transfer to prepared dish, and sprinkle top with remaining cheese. Cover and refrigerate overnight for flavor to blend flavors.

Random Ingredients: chuck,coriander,beef brisket,tart apple,chili flake,sofrito sauce,french bread,lemon
title: Papas Tacos
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sofrito sauce | 1 lemon, juice of | 1 lb ground chuck | 1/2 lb beef brisket | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 4 tablespoons coriander, chopped | 1 teaspoon hot chili flakes | 12 slices french bread, 1 1/2 inches thick
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f in a medium bowl mix sofrito in 1/2 teaspoon hot water and set aside. Brown beef and brisket. Sprinkle onion into the bottom of a large baking pan, then arrange brisket on top.

title: Sweet Potatoes With Grilled Pork
ingredients: 4 yukon gold potatoes, peeled and cut into chunks | 4 small broccoli | 4 spring onions, chopped | 1/4 cup gin | 1 teaspoon catsup | 1 lb ground pork | 1 teaspoon grated fresh ginger
instructions: Place all ingredients in a large pot and marinate for 2 hours in the refrigerator. Preheat grill to high and line with aluminum foil or a rimmed baking sheet. Grill potato, turning to grill both sides. Slice pork into 1/4 inch thick slices and spoon over potatoes. Sprinkle with ginger.

Random Ingredients: dill,lime,cannellini bean,golden brown sugar,phyllo dough,cajun seasoning,linguine
title: Creamy Cannellini Bean Pasta
ingredients: 12 sheets phyllo dough, thawed | 1 can cannellini beans, drained | 1/2 lime, juiced | 2 tablespoons golden brown sugar | 1 teaspoon dried dill | 1 teaspoon cajun seasoning | 1 packet dry linguine
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Grease a 9x2 inch baking dish. Mix cannellini beans, lime juice, brown sugar, dill, seasoned salt, and cajun seasoning in a bowl. Cover the bottom of the prepared dish with two sheets of phyllo dough. Place 2 more sheets of phyllo dough over the top. Sprinkle with one more layer of phyllo dough. Fold the edges of the phyllo dough over the top. Bake in the preheated oven until phyllo dough and bean filling are golden brown, about 40 minutes. Break out individual portions of the pasta with a spatula. Serve with a slice of lime.

Random Ingredients: anchovy,red onion,coffee,corn kernel,russet potato,green,banana leaf,fish sauce
title: Spicy Vietnamese Potato Cups
ingredients: 1 cup red onion, finely chopped | 1 cup banana leaves, soaked in hot water ( aji panca brand ) | 2 1/2 teaspoons fish sauce | 4 1/2 teaspoons instant coffee, crushed | 1 1/2 cups coarsley chopped small russet potatoes | 1 cup corn kernel, cooked | 1 cup thinly sliced green ( or yellow ) | 1/2 cup thinly sliced anchovy
instructions: Cook onion and banana leaves in saucepan of boiling water 3 to 5 minutes or until onion is softened. Stir in fish sauce and instant coffee. Fill each hole of a chilled muffin pan 2/3 full with potato mixture. Top each with 2 to 3 anchovy slices in a single layer and spoon hot mixture into heated muffin cups. Serve right away.

title: Sizzlin' Italian Bread Tacos
ingredients: 1 loaf french bread, sliced in half lengthwise and crosswise ( or use other bread ) | 5 -6 pieces kale or 5 -6 pieces other fresh kale, stems removed | 1 3/4 cups fresh bean sprouts, packed | 1 small baguette ( or other bread cut around 7-16-inch toasts )
instructions: Toast the bread on the grill or in the oven. Place the cut sides down on a grill pan or frying pan lined with parchment paper, toaster oven, or on a baking sheet lined with foil. Toast for about 10 - 30 seconds on each side or until golden. Allow to cool slightly, before cutting. Trim the ends from the kale and remove the woody leaves. Rinse the leaves in a colander, and set the leaves aside in one layer covered with some tea towels until ready to use. Chop the kale into bite size pieces and place both in a serving dish. Mince the kale, if using, and add to the kale. Add the bean sprouts. Cut the baguette into 4 - 6 wedges, each about 3/4 inch thick. Toast one side of the bread, cut side up first, on the grill or in a toaster oven. Spread the bread with the bean sprout mixture and toast under the broiler until the beans soften. Serve in hot taco shells or tostadas.

title: Boston Roll
ingredients: 1/2 1/2 lb black beans or 1/2 lb red kidney bean beans | 2 tablespoons mirin ( sweet rice wine ) | 2 -3 eggs, lightly beaten | 1/3 cup cooked brown rice
instructions: Soak the beans in cold water for an hour. Drain and rinse under cold water until the water runs clear. Drain again. Bring a pot of water to a boil, add bean sprouts and cook for a few minutes. Rinse and drain in a colander, then rinse gently under cold running water until the bean sprouts are cool enough to handle. Slice the beans thinly. Place beans in a large bowl and coat with a little mirin or white wine. Cover with plastic wrap, then refrigerate for at least an hour. Before placing individual servings in your bento box, crack an egg into the bowl then quickly shake the egg in the bowl to make sure it is mostly scrambled. Place the drained beans in an 8 to 10 inch cast iron fry pan or large pot. Top with a layer of cooked egg, and cover with a layer of rice. Cover with a second layer of bean sprouts, then cover with a final layer of bean sprouts. Press a piece of plastic wrap onto the top, then seal the top tightly with a toothpick to avoid splattering. Place in a 350 degree oven for about 25 minutes. Let stand for 15 to 30 minutes before cutting into small squares.

title: Amchoor Coconut Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup coconut milk | 1/4 teaspoon amchoor powder
instructions: Blend the cincammon pulp and coconut milk in your blender bowl. Once smooth add the amchoor powder, blend well and chill in your refrigerator if you have the time.

title: Puff
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups grated mexican blend cheese | 1 cup grated gruyere cheese | 1/4 cup light rum | 1 teaspoon fresh lemon rind, grated | 1 1/2 cups crushed tomatoes in light rum | 2 tablespoons light brown sugar | 2 tablespoons flaked coconut
instructions: Heat 1 1/2 cups mexican cheese and 1 cup gruyere cheese over low heat in a large nonstick skillet, stirring often, until melted, about 5 minute remove from heat and stir in 1/4 cup rum and lemon rind. Place crushed tomatoes in a bowl or small cup with a cover.

title: Lemon Chicken and Tofu
ingredients: 6 -8 chicken parts | 7 ounces firm tofu | 2 -3 jalapeno peppers, sliced | 1 tablespoon lemon peel, grated
instructions: Remove excess skin from tofu. Pat dry and cut into 1 pieces with knife or spatula, depending on thickness. Slice the tofu and marinate in the refrigerator for 5 - 10 minutes. Grill skin side up on grill for about 5 - 7 minutes or until soft and firm.

Random Ingredients: onion flake,phyllo pastry,puff pastry,orange zest,sesame seed,poppy seed,green tea
title: Sesame Triangles
ingredients: 1 cup poppy seed | 1 1/2 cups sesame seeds | 1 cup grated orange zest | 1/2 cup sweet onion flakes | 1 package frozen puff pastry sheets sheet, thawed | 2 packages frozen puff pastry sheets, thawed ( 5 sheets ) | 1 1/2 cups green tea
instructions: Toast poppy seeds in a dry pan over medium heat, stirring often, until fragrant, 3 to 5 minutes. Combine poppy seeds in a small bowl and add orange zest and sweet onion flakes, stirring well. Set mixture aside. Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Sprinkle thawed pastry sheets with dry salt and pepper. Cut each sheet of thawed puff pastry sheets in half to make four squares. Spray a 17x9x2 inch baking dish with non stick cooking spray. Arrange four squares in the baking dish. Spread ground poppy mixture over the top of the squares, and sprinkle a small amount of sweet onion flakes over the top. Sprinkle sweet onion flakes over onions. Sprinkle sesame seeds over poppy mixture along with the remaining dough triangles. Bake in the middle of the oven for 20 - 20 minutes, until golden brown on top.. Remove from oven and allow to cool for 10 minutes.

title: Black Beans and Apples
ingredients: 4 large apples, cut into chunks | 1 can black beans, rinsed and drained | 2 large lettuce leaves
instructions: Preheat the grill for high heat and lightly oil the grate. Combine the apples, black beans and lettuce in a bowl. To serve, spoon the apple mixture onto the lettuce leaves.

Random Ingredients: mint jelly,wheat pastry flour,red bell pepper,kaiser,vanilla extract,cheese
title: Pizza Delights
ingredients: 8 kaiser rolls | 1 tablespoon vanilla extract | 1 tablespoon red bell pepper, finely chopped | 6 slices cheese | 2 teaspoons hot mint jelly | 1/4 cup whole wheat pastry flour
instructions: Mix ingredients together, spread onto rolls. Sprinkle top of rolls with a little more mint jelly and top with cheese slices. Cut into four pieces and serve.

title: Chinese Oyster Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 package oyster mushrooms | 1 can tomatoes | 3 cups fresh limeade concentrate | 2 tablespoons honey | 1 can artichoke hearts ( drained )
instructions: Heat oven to 300 degrees. In medium roasting pan or casserole, pour in beer, oyster mushrooms, tomatoes and honey. Stir to combine. Bake 1 hour. Add artichoke hearts. Cook 45 minutes longer. Serve warm or cold.

title: Cod Baked in Beans
ingredients: 400 g cannellini beans, drained | 2 cod fish fillets, skin removed and chopped | 1/2 cup button mushroom, thinly sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c. Line a baking tray with baking paper. Place cannellini beans, fish and mushrooms on tray and bake 15 minutes or until fish is just cooked through. Serve with extra olive oil and sour cream.

Random Ingredients: superfine sugar,chili oil,almond,bean,seasoning salt,peanut,red food coloring
title: Nutty Refresher
ingredients: 3 1/2 ounces blanched almonds | 1/2 lb mixed beans, well-washed | 1/2 teaspoon chili oil | 1 fluid ounce dark roasted peanuts ( no salt added ) | 5 fluid ounces superfine sugar | 3 drops red food coloring | 1 teaspoon seasoning salt ( or to taste )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350f degrees/180c. Spread the nuts on a tray lined with baking paper. Roast in oven toasted in the residual heat for 10 minutes, remove, cool. Cut almonds in fine crumbs. Place in a bowl and use your hands to rub the nuts in a bowl with the chili oil, peanuts, sugar, red food colouring, and seasoned salt. Sprinkle the crumb mixture on the nuts to give a festive colour. Put the oven on and leave the nuts to dry in a cool oven. Check that they are dry after about a half hour. If they become brown, it might take another 30 45minutes. Remove from oven. Pour the oven tray into a large metal baking dish. Spread the remaining tray with your fingers to dry the tops. Remove the tray and spread the dry mixture in vertical rows. Leave to dry for 12 hours before cutting into squares. Store covered in the refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: herbes de provence,beef stew meat,rice noodle,sugar,brown rice
title: Peking Beef and Rice Noodles
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless beef stew meat, trimmed | 1 tablespoon dried herbes de provence | 3/4 teaspoon sugar | 3 cups hot cooked brown rice, about 2 cups ( uncooked ) | 1 package fresh rice noodles, about 2 2/3 cups
instructions: Brown beef meat in a large skillet, about 5 - 7 minutes, or until browned. Transfer meat to a plate and set aside. Pour off fat from skillet. Add herbs, sugar and rice noodles. Stir well. Return meat and any accumulated juices to skillet. Cover and simmer until liquid is absorbed, about 20 minutes. Serve.

title: Spaghetti Sauce
ingredients: 500 g spaghetti, spaghetti sauce | 1 bouquet garni
instructions: Boil the spaghetti sauce until it becomes 'al dente'. Put the spaghetti in a large pan and add the bouquet garni. Stir constantly, adding water until it's almost completely reduced. Simmer for approx 10 min or until fully cooked. Note, if you like, you can add a little extra of your favourite vegetable based sauce and leave out the bouquet garni.

title: Leek and Chocolate Barley
ingredients: 1/2 cup pearl barley | 12 ounces leeks | 1/3 cup chocolate, of your choice
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees. Wash, dry and break off the ends of the leeks. Blanch in boiling water till just tender. Place in a baking dish, or small bowl. Drain and return to the oven. Add your favorite mix. If your mix is too dry, add more water. Bake at 425 for about 20 mins or till just warm and firm. Watch out for the steam.

Random Ingredients: sherry wine,maraschino cherry,mint leaf,turnip,hamburger,walnut oil,bell pepper
title: Sweet and Sour Turnips
ingredients: 2 lbs grated lean hamburger | 1/2 - 3/4 cup finely chopped sweet bell pepper | 1/4 cup finely chopped walnut oil | 4 small turnips ( or turnips, peeled and quartered ) | 2 tablespoons sherry wine | 2 -3 large fresh mint leaves | 3 -4 fresh maraschino cherries
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Mix hamburger and vegetables and season with salt. Shape into small oblong patties. Arrange in 2 pie casseroles or baking dishes. Pour sherry over top. Sprinkle with cherries. Bake for 20 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Arora(Ethiopian Apple and Green Apple Stew)
ingredients: 4 bunches green apples ( i used the huge green ones, peeled and sliced thinly ) | 1 tablespoon fennel seed ( crushed or ground ) | 1 tablespoon coarse salt ( or to taste )
instructions: Peel the green apples. Cut the apple into slices about 1 1/2 inches thick, about 1 1/2 inches wide. Place the fennel seed in a coffee grinder or spice mill. You can use the coarse salt, which has little to no large clumping you can do in the blender. Pour the spices in a large bowl. Add the apples and mix thoroughly, mixing them together with one or several cups of water to make a thickish stew like consistency. I used a pressure cooker for 45 min to 1 hr, but can also be used as a side dish for the berbere. The water is optional, but it adds enough to make the stew taste vegetarian.

Random Ingredients: orange marmalade,nacho cheese flavor doritos,grain white rice
title: Orange Rice Bake
ingredients: 1 cup long grain white rice | 1 jar nacho cheese flavor doritos, cut in half and softened | 1 - 1 1/2 cup orange marmalade
instructions: In a bowl, combine the rice and 1/2 cup doritos in 1 cup of softened softened butter or margarine, beating till well blended. Stir in the remaining doritos. Spread mixture evenly into a buttered casserole dish. Sprinkle with remaining doritos. Bake at 375 degrees for 20 to 30 minutes, until hot. Let cool for 5 minutes and serve.

Random Ingredients: serrano pepper,oregano leaf,caper,vanilla ice cream,white bread
title: Capperi
ingredients: 4 serrano peppers | 3/4 cup capers, drained | 1/2 cup oregano leaves | 1 1/2 cups white bread, crusts removed | 3 tablespoons fresh epazote leaves | fresh vanilla ice cream
instructions: Char the chiles on a grill or in a heavy skillet over medium low heat, turning, until blackened on all sides, about 10 minutes. Remove from heat, then split open. Place in a small glass bowl, cover, and refrigerate for 1 hour. Peel away any black spots and finely mince or grind the chiles. Set aside. Meanwhile, place the capers, oregano, bread, and epazote leaves in a blender. Cover and blend until finely ground, about 15 seconds. Add chiles and puree again until smooth. Drain off any excess liquid. Preheat the broiler. Arrange all of the sauce in a shallow baking dish and place in the oven to warm. Cut each slice of bread into 1 chunks. Place toast chunks around the edge of the plates. Fill with the tomato sauce and serve with spanish black forest beans.

title: Spanish Chorizo or Sausage Sausages

instructions: If using chorizo cut into slices 1/4 to 1/2 thick. If using sausage cut into 1/4 thick pieces. Place in a ziploc bag and add some seasoning. Marinate for at least 2 hours. Place on a plate and serve hot.

title: Simple and Low Fat Breakfast Burritos

instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Grease cookie sheet. In a large bowl, beat the eggs with fork until frothy. Divide the eggs between the tortillas, then pour about 3 tbsp of the batter over them. title: Potatoes Dressed With Griottines (Glamorgan Sous Iz Pomidny - Griottines Yum)

instructions: Remove core and blemishes from cabbage and wash it. Cut it up into 4 slices. Place the peels in a bowl. Add the cabbage to the bowl. Squeeze as much juice into the bowl as necessary. Sprinkle over the chopped parsley. Cover tightly and refrigerate. This will keep at least 12 hours.

instructions: Cook your coleslaw, and drain in a colander. In a large bowl, toss together coleslaw and basil until coated, adding more dressing if desired. Serve.

instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees. Place an oven proof skillet on a baking sheet. In a saucepan filled with water, pour cannellini beans into a strainer over a large bowl. Cover and bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat to medium and boil 2 to 3 minutes or until slightly thickened. Stir in tarragon and liquid smoke. Set aside. Pat fish dry and season with salt. Spread 1 tablespoon of sauce in center of a 3 x 7” piece of aluminum foil. Place halibut side by side along one side of the foil. Place 1 asparagus spear and 1 asparagus spear on top of the fish. Wrap up fish with the 2 remaining asparagus spears. Bring the sides of the foil over the anchovies. Heat over medium until foil is just starting to smoke. Remove foil and bake fish 2 to 3 minutes or until fish flakes easily with fork. Meanwhile, bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add 1 tablespoon of water.

Random Ingredients: celery,pea,bulk sausage,barbecue sauce,monterey jack pepper cheese,roasting chicken
title: Cheesy Sausage & Pea Casserole
ingredients: 5 lbs rotisserie roasting chickens | 1 jar of your favorite barbecue sauce | 1 lb bulk sausage | 1/2 lb celery | 1 lb frozen peas ( i prefer fresh ) | 1 lb monterey jack pepper cheese, shredded
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Rinse chicken and pat dry. Lay on cookie sheets and lightly salt. Bake for about 1 hour per rack, or until well done, but not black. Meanwhile, mix bbq sauce and sausage. Once chicken is done, shred, discarding neck and wing tips. Place chicken on a platter, and pour the sauce over it. Cover with foil, and bake in a 350 degrees f oven for 40 minutes. To make the peas, cook 1 cup frozen peas in boiling water for 2 minutes, then drain.

title: Quick and Easy Chicken and Beetroot
ingredients: 2 bone-in chicken wings, skin removed | 1 can prepared guacamole | 1 pound beetroot - peeled, seeded and cut into bite-size pieces | 1 can beef broth
instructions: Place chicken wings, guacamole, and beetroot into a slow cooker. Pour beef broth over the ingredients. Cover, and cook on low for 8 to 10 hours.

Random Ingredients: mascarpone cheese,thai red curry paste,margarine,acorn squash,liquid smoke,zucchini,fine sea salt
title: Spicy Squash Salad
ingredients: 2 lbs acorn squash | 1 lb zucchini | 2 tablespoons margarine or 2 tablespoons butter, melted | 4 ounces mascarpone cheese | 1/4 cup thai red curry paste, with red curry | 2 tablespoons liquid smoke | 1/2 teaspoon fine sea salt
instructions: Cut squash lengthwise or into 1/2 inch slices, with ends intact. Place squash and zucchini in a 9x9 inch baking dish. Melt the margarine in a small saucepan over medium heat, stirring, until it foams and turns golden, about 3 minute remove mixture mixture from heat and stir in mascarpone cheese. Stir thai red curry paste with liquid smoke into mascarpone cheese mixture.

Random Ingredients: graham cracker crumb,basmati rice,cherry syrup,baby spinach leaf,thyme
title: Spinach Rice Cake Sandies
ingredients: 16 -24 fresh baby spinach leaves | 1 cup basmati rice | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh thyme | 1/2 cup cherry syrup | 1 cup graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Preheat oven 375 degrees. Coat the bottom of the lightly greased 9 x 13 inch metal baking pan with cooking spray. In a bowl combine the spinach, rice, thyme and cherry syrup.

Random Ingredients: salt black pepper,hazelnut,tomato soup,white bean,clove,enchilada sauce,self raising flour,graham cracker crumb
title: White Beans  Casserole
ingredients: 180 g white beans or 180 g kidney beans, drained | 1 can condensed tomato soup | 150 g self-raising flour | 25 g hazelnuts, chopped | 30 g graham cracker crumbs | 1 teaspoon ground cloves | salt & freshly ground black pepper | 1 -2 tablespoon enchilada sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 180c. Mix all other ingredients together, saving 1/3 cup. Pour into an oven proof bowl or casserole dish. Sprinkle with crushed hazelnuts. Bake for 30 - 40 minutes or until golden brown. Serve with warmed brandy snaps or white wine. Note the baking time can vary some, especially when using canned beans, they have a higher shelf life. However, i would guess cooking time will be about 15 minutes for canned beans and 30 minutes for canned beans.

title: Kolokithakia (Olives): a Mediterranean Stuffed Olive
ingredients: 1/2 cup sliced kalamata olives, finely chopped | 1/4 cup dry sherry ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon dried marjoram, crushed ( optional )
instructions: Combine the olives and sherry in small bowl. Stuff the mixture loosely with the olives. Sprinkle with marjoram if using.

title: Tarte Filling for Danish Wedding Cake or Asparagus
ingredients: 8 ounces lean suet | 8 ounces peas, shelled | 2 tablespoons cilantro stems or 2 tablespoons cilantro leaves, chopped | 1 tablespoon maraschino cherry, chopped | 1 tablespoon lemon peel, grated | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper | cayenne
instructions: Melt suet in small saucepan and sautee for 10 minutes. Add peas, cilantro, cherries, lemon peel and cayenne and stir constantly to mix. Cool. Strain the mixture and refrigerate for at least 1 hour before using. Dough can also be refrigerated.

title: Cuban Bread
ingredients: 3 loaves bread | 1 cup fresh black olives, pitted and sliced | 1/4 lb country ham
instructions: Cut bread into cubes.

title: Tahini Spiced Crumbs
ingredients: 1/2 cup dry bread crumbs | 1/4 cup tahini | 1/8 teaspoon moroccan mixed spice
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees f. Sift the bread crumbs into a mixing bowl, and make a well in the center of the crumbs. Stir in the tahini, moroccan spice, and 1 1/4 teaspoon of the salt. Stir with a wooden spoon or your hands until the mixture becomes moist and crumbly. Do not use a fork to separate the mixture. Roll the mixture out into a finger size ball and flatten into discs the size of a golf ball. Place onto a lightly greased cookie sheet, and bake at 200 degrees f for 6 to 8 minutes, or until nicely browned.

Random Ingredients: peach schnapps,sirloin,grain mustard,tahini,cider vinegar,live organic natural yoghurt,orange bell pepper,tea
title: Beef and Pepper BBQ Skewers
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs sirloin, thinly sliced and threaded onto 8 metal skewers | 1 tablespoon fresh orange bell pepper, cut into chunks | fresh tahini | fresh peach schnapps | lime, juice and zest, plus lime wedges to serve | 2 tablespoons cider vinegar | 1 tablespoon fresh brewed tea | 8 ounces peaches in natural yoghurt, drained and chopped | 1/2 teaspoon coarse grain mustard
instructions: To make the barbecue grill.

Random Ingredients: dark red kidney bean,fish fillet,garlic,beef rump,lime wedge
title: Vietnamese Beef and Beans
ingredients: 4 rump fat-trimmed beef or four sirloin tip roast ( each weighing about 3/4-1/2 pounds ) | 1 can dark red kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 1 1/2 teaspoons minced garlic | 4 teaspoons fish sauce or 4 teaspoons vietnamese fish sauce | lime wedge
instructions: Place beef in large ziploc bag. Sprinkle with both garlic and 1 - 2 tsp of fish sauce.

title: Spinach Wrapped in Prosciutto
ingredients: 6 tablespoons light molasses | 2 pinches cumin powder | 6 ounces kahlua | 12 ounces ricotta salata prosciutto | 4 ounces whole wheat bread, cut into small cubes | 1 cup fresh spinach | 3 ounces finely grated parmesan cheese
instructions: Preheat oven 350'f. Warm the molasses in a small saucepan. Add cumin and simmer for a few seconds to draw out the flavor. In a separate bowl or a loaf pan, layer the bread, spinach, rinds of prosciutto and cheese onto a large cutting board. Spread the molasses mixture evenly over the bread in an even layer. Place the wrap on top and press down lightly to flatten. Slip from a sharp knife onto the board and slice into squares. Serve with ice cream or sweetened whipped cream.

Random Ingredients: salt pepper,ginger garlic paste,cream corn,green cardamom pod,tomato puree
title: Easiest Indian Corn
ingredients: 1 can cream-style corn, drained ( cream-style corn is best ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons green cardamom pods, lightly crushed | 1 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste ( more or less to taste ) | 1 tablespoon tomato puree | salt and pepper
instructions: In a saucepan, heat cream style corn on high heat. Lower heat and cook for 5 minutes, stirring regularly. Add cardamom pods, ginger garlic paste and tomato puree. Cover and simmer on low heat for 10 - 15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until heated. Season to taste with salt and pepper.

title: Pesto Smoked Salmon & Plantains
ingredients: 4 salmon fillets | 2 plantains | 2 tablespoons sun-dried tomato pesto | 1 can beef consomme | 2 teaspoons chopped fresh thyme | 1 teaspoon cornflour
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°c. Slice the plantains into thick rounds, place them on a baking tray, prick the skin all over and place in oven with 3/4 cup water. Bake for around 20 - 30 minutes. Let cool. Remove the skin and cut into small pieces. In a separate pan, soften the plantains by boiling in a small quantity of water.

title: Lebanese Egg Noodle Burger (Barsi)
ingredients: 2 cups brown lentils | 1 cup cooked egg noodles | 1 teaspoon ginger ale ( i use bhel pura's ginger ale ) | 1/4 tablespoon mixed spice ( or more - i prefer curry powder ) | hamburger bun
instructions: Mix everything together. Put mixture in fry pan and pan fry like you would hamburgers. I prefer a medium heat, so i grill for about 6 - 8 minutes per side.

Random Ingredients: beef tenderloin steak,guajillo chilies,tart apple,palm sugar,tabasco sauce,italian bread
title: Apple and Beef Tenderloin with Chipotle-Apple Salsa
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef tenderloin steaks, cut 1 inch thick or 1 1/2 lbs sirloin steaks, cut 1 inch thick | 4 tablespoons guajillo chilies, stemmed & seeded, split lengthwise | 2 medium tart apples, quartered lengthwise, core & cut crosswise into 1 `` thick slices | 2 tablespoons tapasco sauce | 2 tablespoons light palm sugar | 1/2 teaspoon tabasco sauce
instructions: Trim fat from meat.

Random Ingredients: graham cracker crumb,sparerib,beef sirloin steak,golden delicious apple,grenadine
title: Spiral Beef Burgers
ingredients: 1 cup graham cracker crumbs | 2 lbs beef top sirloin steaks, cut into 3/4-inch cubes | 2 lbs beef flanker, cut into 3/4-inch cubes | 1 large golden delicious apple, peeled, cored, and cut into 6 wedges ( optional ) | 1/2 cup grenadine | 2 tablespoons grenadine | 5 1/2 ounces beef sirloin steaks, thinly sliced
instructions: Preheat broiler. Coat 12 inch nonstick skillet with cooking spray. Place crushed graham crackers in a shallow baking dish. Arrange half the beef cubes in prepared skillet. Place 3 of the beef cubes in a layer over the beef, and repeat with remaining ingredients. Set remaining beef cubes on top and smooth out and smooth out surface. Cover and let stand 30 minutes. Whisk grenadine into 1/4 cup grenadine, about 1 tablespoon, and spoon over beef in skillet.

Random Ingredients: green bell pepper,cake flour,orange juice,baking powder,parmigiano reggiano cheese,cooking spray,chive
title: Italian Pepper Cookies
ingredients: 2 cups cake flour | 1/2 teaspoon baking powder | 1 tablespoon grated orange rind | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh chives or 1 teaspoon dried chives | 1/2 cup shredded parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1 green bell pepper, chopped | butter-flavored cooking spray
instructions: Combine flour, baking powder, orange rind, chives and cheese in medium bowl. Gradually stir in green pepper. Roll dough into 1 inch balls. Place on ungreased baking sheet. Using 2 1/2 tablespoons butter, grease tops of each cookie. Spray tops with cooking spray. Sprinkle with paprika. Bake in preheated 350° oven for 14 to 18 minutes or until bottoms are light brown and tops spring back when lightly tapped.

Random Ingredients: dark soy sauce,meat,oregano,lemongrass,italian bread,mustard powder,chipotle chile adobo
title: Beef & Lemongrass Lovers Slow Cooker Chipotle Meat
ingredients: 1/4 cup dark soy sauce, plus 1/2 tsp. | 1 tablespoon mustard powder ( or 1 tsp. dijon ) | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano | 1 lb lean ground meat ( pork or beef ) | 1 stalk lemongrass, outer leaves removed ( white part only and finely chopped ) | 4 -5 chipotle chiles in adobo, seeded and minced ( canned or fresh ) | 3 tablespoons dark soy sauce, for dipping
instructions: Cut away any thick edges of the lemongrass and the white layer on each side of the stalk. Cut away and discard the white bit of the green. If using an adobo chile, remove seeds and place in a food processor with the chiles and chipotles. Process until smooth. Transfer mixture to the slow cooker. Add 1 1/2 tsp of dark soy sauce to the meat and stir to combine.

title: Basic Beef Chili Rice
ingredients: 1 tablespoon chili sauce | 1 cup basmati rice | 2 1/2 cups beef stock
instructions: Rinse rice. Place 2 cups beef stock and 1/2 tsp chili sauce in a pan. Bring to boil. Cover & simmer 15 minutes. Fluff after cooking. Serve as desired.

Random Ingredients: sea salt,pecorino romano cheese,plain yogurt,russet potato
title: Baked Potatoes with Yogurt
ingredients: 2 lbs medium size russet potatoes, peeled | 1 tablespoon coarse sea salt | 1 2/3 cups of prepared low-fat plain yogurt | 1 cup pecorino romano cheese, freshly grated ( you'll need more if you're using a low-fat cheese )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Cut unpeeled whole potatoes in half lengthwise. Put potatoes in bowl, toss in salt, then shake to coat. Place in shallow 2 1/2 quart baking dish. Pour yogurt over potatoes, sprinkle with grated cheese. Roast 45 - 50 minutes, until potatoes are golden and bubbly and filling is bubbly, and toppings are lightly browned.

Random Ingredients: salt pepper,lemon,honey,vegetable stock,corn tortilla chip,active yeast,taco cheese,cayenne
title: Nancy's Mexican Pizza
ingredients: 2/3 cup vegetable stock | 1 envelope active dry yeast | 1/4 cup honey | 1/8 teaspoon ground cayenne | 1/4 cup shredded taco cheese | 3 cups crushed corn tortilla chips | 1 lemon, sliced | salt and pepper to taste
instructions: In a medium bowl, warm the vegetable stock and stir in the yeast. Let stand until foamy, about 5 minutes. Remove the yeast mixture from the bowl, and stir in the honey, ground cayenne, and taco. Add the shredded cheese.

title: Asafoetida
ingredients: 1/4 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1 pinch pinches tapioca flour | 1 dash japanese soy sauce
instructions: First, dip a pinch of asafoetida in a tablespoon of water for about 30 seconds and then quickly take a second tablespoon or so of water and drop it into the water. If the texture sticks to a bit its not supposed to stick to a spoon. If it doesn't stick, throw it out. The texture of the asafoetida should be softer then regular. Add a pinch of pinches of soy sauce for taste and if it sticks a little bit its not supposed to stick. Mix the asafoetida and pinches of soy with a wooden spoon, or just mix everything together.

title: Baked Beef and Snap Peas
ingredients: 8 ounces snap peas | 6 ounces lean ground lamb
instructions: Pre heat oven to 350 degrees. Place the snap peas in a shallow ovenproof dish just big enough to hold them all without overcrowding them. Sprinkle in the lamb and cook for 45 - 55 minutes, turning often, until the meat is browned all over. Serve straight away with gravy made from recipe # note, if you plan to continue in this way, cover the dish with foil on top. I didn't use these at all and had to use the quick cooking method for a quick and tasty meal.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack pepper cheese,baguette,orange peel,icing sugar,coconut milk,chicken tender
title: Chicken Tarte Tatin
ingredients: 3 tablespoons icing sugar | 4 chicken tenders, skinned | 10 ounces coconut milk | 14 ounces monterey jack pepper cheese, grated | 1 tablespoon grated orange peel | 18 inches crispbread baguettes, thin sliced
instructions: Grease a 13 x 9 inch ovenproof dish. Stir icing sugar into chicken tenders and place mixture on lightly greased baking sheet. Bake at 400 f for 30 minutes. Remove from oven and increase temperature to 400f. Spoon chicken and cheese into bread baguettes. Sprinkle with orange zest and bake at 400 f 30 minutes or until cheese is melted and bubbly.

title: Panir Dip With Wasabi Mayonnaise
ingredients: 4 soft bread rolls | 12 slices panir | 1 cup of coarsely chopped yellow mustard ( or regular mustard ) | 4 ounces cream cheese | 1 teaspoon tabasco sauce | 1/4 cup mayonnaise | 1 1/2 teaspoons yellow mustard ( or regular mustard ) | lemon wedge, for garnish
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. Separate the bread rolls into two 8 thick slices. Using a 1½ inch cutter, cut slices into half moons. Spread one side of each slice of bread with 1½ teaspoons of mustard and 1½ teaspoons of mayonnaise. Divide the panir evenly over that. Using a slotted spoon, transfer the panir to oven until bread is light golden brown, about 5 minutes. To serve transfer the bread slices onto a serving plate. Top with 1½ teaspoons of wasabi mayonnaise. Using tongs, transfer the panir to the plate. Repeat with the remaining bread slices and wasabi mayonnaise. Garnish with lemon wedges.

Random Ingredients: tea,red pepper flake,cherry,lebanese cucumber,shrimp,white vinegar,poultry seasoning
title: Shrimp Cocktail (Camarao)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs shrimp ( peeled, deveined and butterflied ) | 1 tablespoon tequila or 1 tablespoon rum | 1 tablespoon white vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon dried crushed red pepper flakes ( or to taste ) | 1/4 teaspoon poultry seasoning | 1 lebanese cucumber ( peeled and sliced thick ) | 1/2 cup chopped fresh cherries ( or to taste ) or 1/2 cup green cherries ( or to taste )
instructions: Combine all ingredients except shrimp and cucumber in a blender or food processor and process until smooth. Pour hot cocktail into a medium sized serving dish. Garnish with cucumber slices and cherries.

title: Creamy Cauliflower (21 Day Wonder Diet: Day 7)
ingredients: 1 large head cauliflower | 2 tablespoons natural bran ( oat bran ) | 1 1/2 cups light coconut milk with 2 cups water | 125 g green peppers, deseeded and sliced | 1 low-fat cucumber, deseeded and sliced | 1 1/2 teaspoons cayenne
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c cut a medium piece of baking paper, lid and a piece of baking cheesecloth and use to line a large baking tray with baking paper. Place the cauliflower in a large saucepan with enough water to cover it. Bring to the boil over high heat, then reduce the heat and simmer for about 20 minutes, or until crisp tender. Drain and leave to cool slightly. Wrap in baking paper and place in the refrigerator. In a small saucepan, mix the oil with the bran and 1/2 cup of the coconut milk with the remaining coconut milk and bring to the boil. Remove from the heat and stir in the peppers, coconut, cucumber and cayenne. Cover and set aside to marinate at room temperature for 30 minutes. Drain and spread the cauliflower with the marinade. To serve, cut into wedges and serve.

title: Spicy Sweet Potatoes and Squash
ingredients: 1 lb yellow squash, cut lengthwise in 4- lengthwise pieces ( about 12 to 14 ) | 1 large jalapeno chile, minced, seeded ( i used only 1 tablespoon fresh chile-infused chile )
instructions: Heat oven to 400°f line a baking sheet with reynolds wrap 8x8x2 inch foil and set aside. Scrub squash and cut lengthwise in half. Cut squash in half between 2 1/2 inch slices. Put squash halves in baking pan. In small bowl stir together 1/4 cup water, minced jalapeño and remaining 1/4 cup water. Cover and bake 18 to 23 minutes or until squash is tender and water is evaporated.

Random Ingredients: grape leaf,flour tortilla,sage leaf,oat,grain dijon mustard,yellow pepper,basil leaf
title: Crispy Oat Salad Wraps
ingredients: 16 ounces flour tortillas | 1 yellow pepper, sliced thinly | 3 cups coarsely grated low-fat oats | 5 sage leaves, finely chopped | 5 basil leaves, washed, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon whole grain dijon mustard | 1 grape leaf
instructions: Combine all ingredients except tortillas and roll out on a lightly floured board. Cut into 4 even circles and place on a nonstick ungreased cookie sheet. Carefully flatten each circle slightly to cover with a single layer of the tortilla circles. Gently press edges of tortilla round, forming a large circle, until the circle is totally covered with oat mixture. Bake at 350°f for 20 - 25 minutes. Remove from oven and slice crossways into 4 thin slices. You may serve them on a plate with a few lettuce leaves.

title: Pumpkin Pork Tenderloin
ingredients: 2 pork tenderloin | 4 plum tomatoes, seeded and sliced | 1/2 cup grated pecans | 1/3 cup chicken broth | 2 tablespoons vodka
instructions: Slice tenderloin in half.

title: Pacific Halibut With a Banana and Rice Salad
ingredients: 1 halibut | 1 1 cup long grain rice, cooked | 16 ounces water chestnuts | 16 ounces bananas, sliced | club soda
instructions: Wash and dry halibut. Spray grill with cooking oil then grill until fish is browned on both sides and cooked through, about 8 minutes per side. Cut fish into 1 inch chunks using a very sharp knife that goes quickly around salmon bones, if necessary. While fish is grilling heat the water chestnuts and bananas to just melt the bananas. Add water chestnuts and toasted rice to halibut in a salad bowl. Sprinkle with club soda to taste. Eat while still warm.

title: Pistachio & Carrot Lasagna
ingredients: 1/2 lb whole grain mustard | 1/2 lb whole milk ricotta cheese | 1 ounce a.1. original ranch dressing | 12 ounces sauerkraut, drained | 2 tablespoons sweetened condensed milk | 2 teaspoons adobo seasoning | 2 -3 tablespoons ground pistachios, toasted
instructions: Combine mustard, ricotta cheese & ranch dressing mix well. Spread on foil lined baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Bake in preheated 400 f oven for 15 - 18 minutes, or until hot and bubbly. Remove from oven, spread on a sheet of aluminum foil, and spread with sauce.

Random Ingredients: kosher salt,serrano chilies,red potato,soymilk,baking soda,fennel bulb
title: Red Potato Fennel Soup
ingredients: 2 large red potatoes, cooked | 3 serrano chilies, seeded | 1 1/2 cups soymilk | 1 bulb fennel bulb | 3 tablespoons dry sherry or 3 tablespoons dry white wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon kosher salt
instructions: Peel the potatoes, then cut them in half if they are large. Slice the chillies in half and remove the seeds and membranes. Cut fennel bulb into slices 1/2 inch thick. Place potatoes in a pot and cover with 2 cups water. Bring to a boil, then reduce and simmer until the potatoes are tender, 15 - 20 minutes, depending on the size of the potato slices. While the potatoes cook, place the sherry in a small skillet and warm. Remove the stems from the fennel. Dice fennel. Add fennel and sauce to the soup. Dice the chillies and add. Simmer for 5 minutes. Puree soup in a blender or food processor. Add salt to taste and serve.

Random Ingredients: orange juice,tapioca,heavy whipping cream,bulgur,italian seasoning,tabasco sauce,chipotle chile,brown sugar
title: Mexican Rice Salad
ingredients: 3 cups heavy whipping cream | 2 cups brown sugar | 1/2 cup tapioca | 3 tablespoons sweet and sour sauce | 1/4 cup orange juice ( i use orange-flavored ) | 1/2 teaspoon tabasco sauce | 1 teaspoon chipotle chile, chopped | 1 package dried bulgur
instructions: Bring everything to a boil in a large pan. Cover and reduce heat, simmer on low until thickened, about 20 - 25 minutes. Stir occassionally. When done, add the bulgur. Allow bulgur to stand 2 hours, or overnight to absorb flavors of everything. Try to taste and add more if the seasonings are too sour. Serve chilled or room temperature.

title: Minty Onion Kebab
ingredients: 1/2 cup sweet moray onions or 1/2 cup sweet red onion, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon coriander powder | lime wedge, to serve
instructions: Blend all ingredients together. Cover and store in the refrigerator for up to 2 weeks, stirring every few hours. Serve with lime wedges as an accompaniment.

Random Ingredients: american cheese,white bread,green onion,broccoli floret,yellow onion
title: Broccoli Cheese Sandwich
ingredients: 1/2 cup broccoli floret, washed and finely chopped | 1/2 cup white bread, cut into thin slices | 1 -2 slice of medium american cheese, thinly sliced | 1 green onion, sliced | 1/4 yellow onion, thinly sliced
instructions: Cook broccoli in boiling water for 4 - 5 minutes or until crisp tender. Strain and cool in ice water. Drain well. Combine everything except the cheese slices together and stir or shape into sandwich. Top with cheese slices and serve.

Random Ingredients: double cream,arborio rice,white button mushroom,hoisin sauce,tomato green chilies,tabasco sauce
title: Spicy Mushrooms and Rice
ingredients: 100 g white button mushrooms | 4 tablespoons hoisin sauce | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh tomato and green chilies | 2 tablespoons double cream, double cream, extra | 4 teaspoons goya brand hoisin sauce | 2 cups cooked arborio rice
instructions: Heat oven to 200 c. Heat a non stick frying pan. Add mushrooms to oil and cook until soft. Remove stems and chop coarsely. Remove gill from caps, finely chop caps and put into a bowl with the hoisin, tomato, chillies and cream. Place rice in a large bowl and stir in the mushroom mixture. Pour into an ovenproof dish, bake for 15 - 20 mins until rice is tender and top with extra cream and hoisin.

title: Clam Satay
ingredients: 250 g spaghetti | 1/2 cup spicy salsa | 1/2 cup diced peeled shrimp | 2 teaspoons finely minced gingerroot | 3 teaspoons mixed herbs | 3 bamboo skewers
instructions: Cook spaghetti in plenty of boiling water according to instructions on package. Meanwhile, stir fry ginger and shrimp in a small pan over medium heat for 3 - 4 minutes or until pink and cooked through. Drain pasta and serve with remaining salsa, ginger, shrimp/herbs. Serve with skewers.

title: Arugula and Yellow Pepper Salad
ingredients: 3 ounces arugula | 4 ounces yellow peppers ( drained )
instructions: Wash the peppers under cold running water to remove the stems and seeds. Wash and dry well. Slice into thin strips. Place salad on a decorative serving platter, cut into wedges and serve immediately or put in refrigerator to heat further.

title: Lamb and Courgette
ingredients: 1 leg of lamb | 1 bunch courgette
instructions: Cut the lamb into three pieces each. Cover all with water, and boil for 30 - 40 minutes. The water will give you a glas of au jus. Take the lamb out of the oven and pour 1/2 the au jus into a small bowl and set aside for a moment. Heat the oven to 200c/fan 160c/gas remove the meat from the bone and place in a roasting tin. Pour over the au jus, add the courgette leaves and put into the preheated oven. Leave for 40 minutes or until cooked to your liking. This will make meat very dry and moist.

title: Pasta Fagioli
ingredients: 1 pound spaghetti | 1 cup half-and-half | 2 ounces tequila ( optional )
instructions: Fill a pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil. Stir in the spaghetti, and return to a boil. Cook the pasta uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the pasta has cooked through, but is still firm to the bite, about 11 minutes. Drain well. Mix half and half with tequila in a small bowl. Serve pasta topped with half the spaghetti.

title: Spoon It out Paneer (Eggplant Roll)
ingredients: 2 slices eggplants | 2 pieces panir ( indian or indian, approx. 1.5cm x 1/8cm )
instructions: The panir can be obtained at indian stores. The number of slices is easy to cut when buying paneer. Soaking it is a pain for me, you can cut slices in long widthways, so the panir takes hardly any time to cook.

title: Cousropita
ingredients: 1 english cucumber ( peeled, quartered or finely diced ) | 4 teaspoons curry paste | 4 tablespoons pure maple syrup | 1/2 lb hamburger ( browned-fryed-cured-smoked or salted ) | crumbled feta cheese ( optional )
instructions: Combine all sauce ingredients and cook for about 5 - 10 minutes or until desired consistency is achieved.

Random Ingredients: coconut milk,walnut half,extra virgin olive oil,cream mushroom soup,guacamole,icing sugar,chili powder
title: Poppyseed Burritos
ingredients: 3/4 cup whole-wheat flour ( use whole wheat flour as i have it! ) | 3/4 cup icing sugar, sifted | 1 teaspoon ground ginger | 3/4 cup coconut milk, divided | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1/3 cup extra virgin olive oil, plus additional for drizzling | guacamole ( optional ) | powdered icing sugar ( optional )
instructions: Combine the flour, icing sugar, and ginger in a large mixing bowl. Stir in 1/3 cup coconut milk and 1/3 cup can of soup. With a fork, blend well. Stir in olive oil until thoroughly blended. If too wet, add more flour. Add remaining coconut milk and soup. Mix well. Wrap and chill for 1 hour or up to 2 days. Pre heat the oven to 400°f roll the dough into 15 x 1 inch pieces. Use a cookie cutter to cut out 10 circles from circles. Repeat with the remaining dough circles. Place 1/3 cup of soup mixture in the center of each circle. Moisten the edge of the circles with water and fold over the filling. Press edges together to form a sealed package about 3/4 inch thick. Place in a buttered 9x13 inch pan. Drizzle each burrito with oil, and sprinkle with guacamole if desired. Bake at 400 f for 25 minutes or until bubbly. Scoop the reserved soup mixture into a large serving bowl, and drizzle on individual burritos.

title: Easy, Quick and Easy Salmon Piccata
ingredients: 3 2 lbs salmon fillets or 2 lbs sea bass fillets | 1/2 - 3/4 cup wine vinegar | 1 cup matzo meal
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Line a large baking dish with foil and spray it with cooking spray. Spray the fish filets with cooking spray. Place fish in baking dish and add oil and vinegar to coat. Bake, uncovered, for 30 minutes, basting fish occasionally until cooked through. Note, if you use the sea bass as a fillet, drain off the juices. Place matzoh meal in a food processor, and pulse until fine crumbs. Sprinkle crumbs over fish and continue to cook until fish is done. Serve the fish with the sauce.

title: Chickpeas with a Kick
ingredients: 2 cans canned chickpeas, drained | 3 tablespoons finely ground breadcrumbs | 1/4 teaspoon anise seed | 1 3/4 cups prepared enchilada sauce | 1 1/4 cups vegetable stock
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine the drained chickpeas, bread crumbs and anise seed. Spoon the mixture into an enchilada saucepan. Over medium heat, warm the soup stock. Add the soup mixture and simmer until well heated.

Random Ingredients: orange liqueur,yellow bell pepper,cocoa powder,fontina,salt black pepper,dark rum
title: Mimi's Chocolate Orange Peel Sticks With Smoky Rum and Chocolate
ingredients: 1 yellow bell pepper, sliced into thin sticks | 1 cup shredded fontina ( about 8 ounces ) or 1 cup sopressata cheese | unsweetened cocoa powder, for dusting | 2 tablespoons grated orange liqueur ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons dark rum ( optional ) | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Make sure all the bell peppers are sliced very thin. Sprinkle generously with cocoa powder. Place a plate over them to keep them from drying out. Melt the cheese in the microwave or on the stovetop. Add the dark rum if using. Add the light rum and lime liqueur to melted cheese.

title: Irish Soda Bread

instructions: For balsamic sauce,. Place vinegar in a zip lock plastic bag.

instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Peel the squash, and cut off the tips. Scoop out the seeds. Slice the squash into thick half moons about 1/2 inch thick. Place the dish into a roasting pan, and pour enough hot water into the roasting dish to come half way up the sides of the squash halves. title: Mustard Oil With Yogurt

instructions: Heat the mustard oil in a medium size frying pan and add the sugar. title: Dahl-Spiced Orange Lentils

instructions: Put the lentils, coffee and orange zest in a saucepan. Cover and bring to the boil. Reduce the heat and simmer for 40 - 45 minute stirring occasionally. title: Quinoa and Cabbage Salad (Barefoot Contessa)

instructions: Combine quinoa and water in medium saucepan and bring to a boil. Cover and reduce heat to medium low and simmer, stirring occasionally, until quinoa has softened, about 30 minutes. Meanwhile, cook quinoa according to package directions, omitting salt and oil. Drain quinoa and let cool to room temperature. Combine the sofrito with 1 cup cabbage and 1 cup remaining cabbage in a large serving bowl. Toss quinoa with sofrito mixture. Sprinkle cheese on top and serve.

instructions: In a bowl, mix sauerkraut, cheese, pepper, thyme, vinegar, yogurt and turkey. Taste and adjust seasonings if necessary.

title: Grilled Beef Sandwiches Au Jus

instructions: Rinse and lightly pat the roast dry with paper towels. Set the roast in a large, heavy resealable plastic bag and add the sherry. Remove the meat from the bag, discarding the marinade. Lightly oil the grill and set the roast on it. Grill the roast for 20 minutes. Turn the meat over and grill, stirring frequently, until the internal temperature of the meat reaches 140f, about 7 - 8 minutes. Transfer the meat to a cutting board.

title: Rhubarb & Jicama With Cream
ingredients: 3 -4 lbs small jicama | 1 loaf french bread | heavy whipping cream | chopped rhubarb
instructions: Trim the ends off the jicama, cut into 1 inch chunks, and cut lengthwise into 1/4 inch slices. Place cut up jicama in a bowl, and toss lightly with the whipping cream. While this is baking, make the cream by placing the rhubarb in a frying pan. Cook until it just begins to soften, then add about a cup of cream and mix well. instructions: Mix olives and tomatoes together in a bowl. Place cherries in half.

title: Pumpkin Marinade

instructions: In shallow dish, combine marmalade, pumpkin puree, pimento pepper and rosemary. Cover and refrigerate 1 to 6 hours, stirring or kneading once during this time. Marinate chicken, shrimp, or other poultry poultry in the gravy when serving.

instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees fahrenheit. In a large bowl, mix the flour, cherries, serrano pepper, vanilla, and almond extract. Mix to form a stiff dough, using hands. title: Tilapia

title: Tortilla Chip Meat

instructions: Pre heat oven to 400 degrees. Brown meat in a skillet and drain. Mix in tortilla chips until coated and put on a baking sheet. Bake 20 minutes or until dry.
