ingredients: 24 tiger shrimp, shelled | 1 tablespoon minced fresh dill | 1 lime, cut into wedges
instructions: Coat the shrimp lightly with the minced dill. Toss with the finely cut half of the lime wedge.

title: Smoky Pea, Pea and Chipotle Pepper Salad
ingredients: 2 cups frozen peas, thawed | 1 chipotle chile in adobo, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons anise seeds, crushed
instructions: Cook and stir peas and chipotle in a large skillet, breaking up chipotle with tongs, 3 to 5 minutes or until slightly softened. Stir anise seeds into cooked peas to serve.

Random Ingredients: tomato green chilies,anchovy,golden syrup,cream chicken soup,brown lentil
title: Anchovies and Lentils
ingredients: 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1 can diced tomatoes and green chilies | 2 tablespoons golden syrup | 1 tablespoon anchovy | 1 package brown lentils
instructions: Mix and serve over noodles or rice.

title: Tilamisu
ingredients: 1 pound shredded monterey jack cheese | 1 cup ghee
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Mix the monterey jack cheese and ghee together in a bowl until completely mixed. Spread mixture onto a 9x9 inch baking pan. Bake in the preheated oven for 30 minutes, or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: navel orange,gruyere cheese,mint sprig,vanilla bean,curry paste,gorgonzola,coriander,cheese
title: Cheese-Stuffed Navel oranges With Curried Aioli
ingredients: 12 ounces gruyere cheese | 6 ounces goat cheese or 6 ounces bleu cheese | 1/2 cup mint sprig ( leaves, finely chopped ) | 1/2 cup coriander ( finely chopped plus extra mint sprig ) | 1 vanilla bean, halved ( or pod ) | 2 teaspoons mild curry paste | 1 teaspoon granulated garlic | 12 navel oranges
instructions: Wash the inside of each orange and carefully remove the top 1/2 inch of the rind with a vegetable peeler. Remove the rind but make sure there is no pith remaining. Trim all of the pith at the bottom of the head but leave the rind whole. Reserve the rind for another use. Place the rind in a plastic bag with the cheese, mint, coriander, and curry paste. Close the jar and massage it to combine. If any of the cheese mixture leaks, place it in a plastic bag with the orange rind and shake well to remove any excess air.. If the orange rind is too stiff, break it up a bit with your fingernail. With the back of a sharp knife, cut off the top rind. Squeeze the peel at the inside of each orange and reserve for use later. Using a vegetable peeler, carefully peel the membrane in the center of the membrane, avoiding white pith, then discard the ends. Cut along the membrane all the way to the bottom, cutting down at the stem, avoiding the membrane at the bottom. Remove the membrane from between membranes toward the outside but keep the membranes connected. Using a small spoon or other device to mix, gradually incorporate the curried aioli. You should end up with a smooth creamy aioli which coats the orange well. Once everything is incorporated, refrigerate the aioli for one hour before using. In a large skillet, bring just enough lightly salted water to the rolling boil over high heat. Using a spoon, scoop 1/4 cup of the aioli onto a plate, top with a scoop of the aioli, and garnish with the coriander sprigs. Repeat with the other navel oranges.

title: Faux  Lettuce  With  Fresh  Spinach  Leaves
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 head fresh spinach leaves, washed | 1/4 - 1/2 cup ice water | 1/2 cup fresh cleaned white mushroom, chopped | 2 tablespoons rice wine vinegar or 2 tablespoons white wine vinegar
instructions: Take 1 - 2 tblsps. Of water and soak the leaves for a few mins and then remove and finely chop. In a bowl, place the washed spinach leaves along with the chopped spinach and let it wilt. Drain the excess water out of this along with fresh mushrooms that have been sliced. In a bowl with the rice vinegar, add a few tbsp. Of the potato starch/vinegar and the vinegar. Mix with a spatula and gradually add as much water, some at a time and mix with your spatula. When the dough starts forming, turn it out on to a floured board and divide into 2 equal portions. Shape into flat rectangular loaves. Repeat the same with the other portion. Boil 4 - 5 cups of water and immerse the 6 loaves in the water. Lower the fire and let the pot boil for 2 minutes. Flip the loaves and boil for 2 more mins. Flip over on a large plate with tongs and let the loaves cook on the same way. If the steam from boiling your loaves is too strong, boil away some of the water. Serve each bowl immediately with lots of salad leaves and green salad.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast half,pea,currant,chili pepper flake,ginger garlic paste,head lettuce,nutmeg
title: Chinese Grilled Chicken
ingredients: 8 boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 1 cup currants | 1 small head of lettuce ( about 12 leaves ) | 1 slice fresh ginger-garlic paste | 1 small chili pepper flakes, to taste | 1/2 cup frozen peas | ground grated nutmeg ( a few grated pinches )
instructions: Put all ingredients except the chicken in a large frypan and simmer on low heat until the chicken is cooked. Cut the chicken in half if it falls off the bone and shred the meat with two forks the meat is shredded, removing all traces of fat. Put shredded meat back in the pan and stir. Turn the heat up and continue cooking until the meat is heated through. This should take approximately 30 minutes on medium heat as the ginger and garlic will cook out easily. Serve this as a side dish for a rice dish or a salad for a main dish. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: tahini,greek seasoning,beef stew meat,white onion,fruit,soya sauce,large shrimp,water
title: Shrimp in Whole Foods
ingredients: 1/2 kg beef stew meat | 1/2 kg large shrimp, shelled & deveined | 1/4 cup soya sauce | 1/4 cup dry tahini | 2 tablespoons dried fruit | 1/2 teaspoon all purpose greek seasoning | 600 ml water
instructions: Cut up stew meat. Put into a pot with water and all the other ingredients together. Bring to boil & boil for 5 10mins. Put lid on pot & leave till meat is cooked, about 5 10mins.

title: Oaty Polenta
ingredients: 2 cups old fashioned oats | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon granules | 1/4 cup yellow cornmeal
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together the oats and chicken bouillon, stirring until well blended. Pour into a 9x13 inch pan. Sprinkle cornmeal over the top. Bake 35 to 45 minutes in a preheated 400 degree oven, until the top is golden brown.

title: Easy Beef Marinade
ingredients: 1/2 cup soy sauce | 2 tablespoons dry sherry wine | 1 tablespoon pickle juice | 1 teaspoon dried oregano
instructions: Combine all ingredients and pour over steaks and marinate for 3 - 4 hours before cooking to develop flavors. Makes for great left over chicken or steak.

title: BBQ Lamb Kebabs
ingredients: 500 g lean ground beef | 2 tablespoons chili sauce | 2 teaspoons dried thyme | 1 red chili, seeded and finely chopped
instructions: Place all of the ingredients into a medium bowl and mix, ensuring the ground beef is evenly chopped. Shape into small kebabs and brown on both sides. Serve with salads, salads, hummus, chips, salad dressing or chilli sauce.

Random Ingredients: jicama,white fish fillet,chipotle chile,pineapple chunk juice,bouquet garni,chunky salsa,green bell pepper,pepper
title: Fiesta Fish
ingredients: 2 tablespoons chunky salsa | 1 teaspoon chipotle chile, minced | 1/2 cup pineapple chunk juice | 1/4 teaspoon hot pepper, minced | 1 1/2 lbs firm white fish fillets | 1 bouquet garni | 1 1/2 cups jicama, sliced | 1 green bell pepper, seeded and cut into strips
instructions: Combine chunky salsa and chipotle in small bowl.

title: Beef in a Pan - Pressure Cooker
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 lbs white pearl onions | 1 1/2 lbs fresh tuna in a can - 2 1/2 lbs fresh tuna, drained and coarsely chopped
instructions: In a pressure cooker, layer onions and tuna, beginning and ending with tuna. Secure lid and press high pressure. Reduce pressure by 1/2 inch.

title: Sweet N' Crispy Parsnips
ingredients: 2 1/2 pounds parsnips | 1 cup unsweetened coconut flavored syrup, or as needed
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Place 1 parsnip in the prepared baking sheet, and bake in the preheated oven until tender but not mushy, 40 to 50 minutes. Remove from oven, and set aside to cool. When cool, peel and chop the parsnips. Stir the parsnips, coconut flavored syrup, and salt into the cooled cooked parsnips, and gently toss until incorporated. Chill in refrigerator 1 to 2 hours before serving.

Random Ingredients: anaheim chile pepper,artichoke,brown onion,spring onion,chili sauce
title: Artichokes in Chili Sauce
ingredients: 2 artichokes, cleaned and sliced | 1 cup diced anaheim chile pepper | 1/2 cup chopped spring onions | 1/2 cup chili sauce | 1/2 brown onion, chopped
instructions: Place artichokes in a pot with water to cover. Bring to a boil.

title: Barbecue Swiss Steak
ingredients: 2 thin-cut ham steaks | 1 cup half-and-half | 1 small fresh chilies, seeded and diced
instructions: Preheat grill to high. Lightly coat a medium size nonstick skillet with nonstick cooking spray. Place ham steak in skillet. Grill over medium heat until rare outside crust and temperature of meat reach 140 degrees f, about 10 minutes total. Transfer ham to cutting board and let stand 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: salt black pepper,mozzarella cheese,beef sirloin,spaghetti,creamy peanut butter
title: Spaghetti with Peanut and Beef Sirloin Dip
ingredients: 1 package uncooked spaghetti | 2 pounds boneless beef top sirloin, cut into 1/2 inch pieces | salt and ground black pepper to taste | 2 jars creamy peanut butter | 1 can refrigerated shredded mozzarella cheese
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook the spaghetti in the boiling water, stirring occasionally, until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 12 minutes. Drain and transfer to a serving bowl. Toss the spaghetti with 2 pounds of beef. Season with salt and ground black pepper. Sprinkle with peanut butter. Cover and refrigerate until cold, about 1 hour. Top with mozzarella cheese, and return to the refrigerator for a few minutes just until cheese has melted.

title: Welsh Cured Currant and Bacon  Digestives
ingredients: 250 g smoked bacon ( in slices ) | 400 g fresh currants
instructions: Grill or fry the bacon until it has rendered the fat and is crisp. Drain it well and leave on a paper towel to dry. Chop very fine. To serve, spread over a large serving platter, crumble under the grill or leave it for about 15 minutes in warm oven until crisp. Add the currants and mix well until the currants get coated in the moisture.

title: Chocolate and Saffron Beef Jerky
ingredients: 300 ml dark chocolate sauce ( i use hershey's, a chocolate chip-filled candy/saffron flavoured chocolate that melts easily after it has been melted ) | 500 g chuck, coarsely chopped | 35 saffron threads | mango chutney, dipping sauce ( i use hershey's, a chutney flavored dipping sauce-optional )
instructions: Heat the chocolate sauce to just under simmering, stir in the chocolate, mixing well together until melted. Transfer the mixture to ovenproof dish large enough to fit the beef jerky. Insert the saffron threads in the centre of the beef, making sure the tips are not touching, and bake for 20 - 25 minutes on a high heat until well browned. Remove the oven temperature and allow jerky to rest for a few minutes before cutting into slices.

title: Lettuce and Blueberry Salad
ingredients: 2 heads iceberg lettuce, washed and very well drained | 1 cup breadcrumbs | 1/4 teaspoon ground allspice | 3 -6 tablespoons fresh lemon juice | 3 drops hot sauce ( to taste ) | 2 tablespoons sweet mild curry paste ( or hot sauce for extra spice ) | 1 1/2 cups blueberries or 1 1/2 cups grapeberries | 1/2 cup iceberg lettuce or 1/2 cup boston lettuce
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the breadcrumbs with the allspice and lemon juice and set aside. Place the hot sauce into a small, nonstick frying pan. Toast the curry paste over medium heat. Dip each leaf of lettuce in the milk/oil mixture, then roll in crumbs. Place the lettuce in a small serving bowl. Top the lettuce with the reserved breadcrumb/curry paste mixture. Garnish with fruit or other salad ingredients.

Random Ingredients: saffron,moroccan seasoning,sea bass fillet,coleslaw mix,parmigiano reggiano cheese,orange juice,sun tomato,strawberry
title: Baked Sea Bass With Strawberry and Tomato Salad
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon crushed saffron | 1 cup sun-dried tomato, chopped | 1 cup small curd strawberries, halved | 1/2 teaspoon moroccan seasoning ( or other flavor enhancer you use ) | 1/4 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1 1/2 lbs sea bass fillets, 1 inch thick | 2 tablespoons fresh orange juice, plus 1/4 cup more for brushing the fish | 1/2 cup mixed salad greens ( mixed with bibb or romaine lettuce )
instructions: Toast the saffron in a dry skillet over medium heat, shaking the pan frequently, just until fragrant. Cool the pan on a rack. To make the sun dried tomato pesto, combine the sun dried tomato, chopped sun dried tomatoes, curd, parmigiano reggiano, and seasoning in a small bowl, stir to combine, and set aside. Preheat the oven to 425°f. Brush the fish with the orange juice, place under the broiler and bake until just cooked through, about 6 minutes. Transfer the fish to a serving platter and let sit for 10 minutes, then carefully transfer the plate to the serving platter. Slice the fish thinly crosswise, transfer to the serving platter and let stand 5 minutes. Arrange attractively on the salad leaves and serve warm, at once. Recipe courtesy of sun arugula  by sun zaarappeno. Get the book here, https, //www. Amazon. Com/arugula ranch mexican cookbook/dp/178472312/.

Random Ingredients: red chili pepper,thai basil,red curry paste,beef bouillon cube,rice wine,yellow bell pepper
title: Red Curry of Beef
ingredients: 1/2 - 1 lb of your choice of good quality beef bouillon cube | 1/2 cup thai basil ( or 1/2 cup dried ) | 1/2 cup thai red curry paste | 1 -2 teaspoon red chili pepper ( to taste ) | 1/2 large yellow bell pepper, sliced ( to taste ) | 1/3 - 1/2 cup rice wine or 1/3-1/2 cup dry white wine
instructions: Dissolve the beef bouillon cube in 1/2 to 1 cup of water. Add the curry paste and red chili peppers to the bouillon. Cover. Add red bell peppers. Cover and stir occasionally. Add the rice wine and stir. Adjust the seasoning. Cover and simmer very gently for 90 minutes. Serve hot. Can also be served over brown rice, along with steamed veggies and/or rice.

title: Simple Miso Soup
ingredients: 1 can vegetable broth | 2 tablespoons sake ( shoyu ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons chili paste
instructions: Pour the vegetable broth into the bowl of a food processor, and add the sake and chili paste. Blend to a paste, add more shoyu for spicier soup, and process until smooth.

title: Chocolate Lizzles
ingredients: 1/4 ounce gin | 10 chocolate candy bars
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Pour into a mugs or an 8 ounce mug.

title: Summer Salad
ingredients: 1 pint grape tomatoes, each cut in half | 1 1/2 lbs mangoes, ripe, peeled and diced | 1/3 cup golden raisin | 1/3 cup vinegar | 2 tablespoons olive oil | 1 -2 tablespoon mixed spice | mango, slices ( garnish )
instructions: Place tomatoes, mango, and raisins in serving bowl of mixing glass. Add remaining ingredients, taste and adjust spice and vinegar. Refrigerate until serving.

title: Grilled Pounded Pork Loin(Glaze)
ingredients: 8 loin with bone | butter beans, canned | mrs. dash seasoning | cajun seasoning
instructions: Combine butter beans and herbs in a large plastic bag and place into refrigerator. Let it sit overnight in the refrigerator then cut in 1 inch. Brush loin with butter and sprinkle with cajun/seasoning mix. Close. Let sit out for 5 hours or longer on outdoor grill at a temperature of 220 degrees celcius then grill. When done, remove from grill.

Random Ingredients: chicken wing,tortilla,icing sugar,tilapia fillet,red wine vinegar
title: Steamed Baked Aegean Rolls
ingredients: 2 tilapia fillets, cut approximately 1/4-inch thick ( about 20 steaks total ) | 1 teaspoon red wine vinegar | 6 leaves tortillas ( approximately- 12 inch ) or 6 leaves a combination of ciabatta and pita breads ( approximately- 12 inch ) | icing sugar ( icing sugar ) | 2 2 tablespoons chicken wings or 2 tablespoons turkey wings | 1 tablespoon red wine vinegar
instructions: Line counter with plastic wrap and set aside. Pound tilapia fillets between two sheets of plastic wrap until just a few millimeters/1/4 inch thickness, being careful not to overound them. You should notice that the mallet is very thin and should be able to lift off the wrapper with your fingers. Place fish on plastic in a single layer, patting it down slightly. In a small bowl, stir together red and yellow vinegars. Spread a small teaspoon or 2 of vinegar mixture on each fillet and roll it up tightly. Place the roll, seam side down, on a parchment lined baking sheet. Pour the remaining vinegar/vinegar mixture over the rolls. Allow to marinate at room temperature 3 hours, turning occasionally. Preheat oven to 400°f. In a nonstick or cast iron skillet, toast the tortilla on both sides until slightly brown and crisp. Using a slotted spatula or tongs, transfer the tortilla to foil lined plates and dust with icing sugar, allowing excess to drip out. Carefully remove the rolls and place each on a serving platter. Place the wings or meat of choice into a small pan, sprinkle with red wine vinegar, and stir fry gently until meat and vegies are tender and sauce has a golden and syrupy consistency. Serve the rolls with the dipping sauce spooned over, or drizzle with a little extra virgin olive oil and some chopped fresh herbs.

Random Ingredients: asparagus,purpose flour,chicken cutlet,gorgonzola,parmigiano reggiano cheese,vinegar,tomato paste,red chile pepper
title: Grilled Chicken Breast With Gorgonzola Pasta
ingredients: 2 fresh red chile peppers, stemmed, seeded and chopped | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil or 2 tablespoons grapeseed oil | 4 thin asparagus, ends trimmed, cut into 1-inch pieces | 4 chicken cutlets, about 1 pound total | 1 cup dry old fashioned all-purpose flour | 1/3 cup aged gorgonzola or 1/3 cup goat cheese, crumbled | 1 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese, to taste | 1/2 cup tomato paste | 1/4 cup vinegar
instructions: In a small bowl, toss chile peppers with vegetable oil, then let stand about 30 minutes. Bring another small pot of water to a boil and add asparagus. Cover and cook about 5 minutes or until tender, then drain.

title: Avocado and Broccoli Hoagies
ingredients: 2 hoagie rolls, split and toasted | 2 avocados - peeled, pitted and sliced | 2 cups cooked broccoli florets | salt and ground black pepper to taste | 1 lemon, sliced ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Place sliced avocado slices on a baking sheet. Bake bread slices in the preheated oven until lightly browned, about 5 minutes. Stir broccoli, and 1/2 teaspoon salt into bread slices. Arrange the bread slices on top of the avocado slices. Squeeze fresh lemon juice, if desired, onto top of the sandwiches. If the sandwiches split open, place them under the broiler until lightly browned, 1 to 2 minutes. Move the broiled sandwiches to a work surface and cut into 4 triangles.

title: Quick Mushroom Mushrooms
ingredients: 2 ounces button mushrooms | 3 teaspoons steak sauce ( a-1 ) | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt
instructions: Using an iron skillet, brown the mushrooms on high. Reduce heat to medium. Add steak sauce and garlic salt and stir. Add button mushrooms and cover. Cover the pan and heat until mushrooms are soft. Stir until the sauce is almost absorbed by the mushrooms. Turn off heat, remove the cover from the pan and allow the mushrooms to stand for an additional 5 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: ginger garlic paste,garlic paste,beef broth,flat leaf parsley,chocolate chip,artichoke heart,parsnip,green chili sauce
title: Artichoke Heart Chops With Chocolate Chip Chutney
ingredients: 2 tablespoons ginger-garlic paste | 2 tablespoons green chili sauce | 5 ounces artichoke hearts, cut in halves | 1 can condensed beef broth | 12 parsnips, peeled and cut into 1 1/2-inch slices | 2 tablespoons peanut oil or 2 tablespoons canola oil | 2 1/2 tablespoons chocolate chips | 2 tablespoons flat leaf parsley, chopped
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together ginger garlic paste, chili sauce and artichoke hearts. Set aside. In a 3 quart saucepan, bring beef broth to a boil. Add chutney mixture and return to boil. Cover and simmer over low heat. Meanwhile, in a 12 inch nonstick skillet, heat 1 tablespoon oil over high heat. Remove stems and excess rings from parsnips. Working with one piece at a time, add strips to hot oil, skin side down. Cook until golden, 3 to 4 minutes. Turn and sprinkle with a little more oil. Remove strips and set aside. Repeat process with remaining oil and parsnips. When ready to serve, add chips and simmer for a few minutes. Sprinkle with parsley. Serve, drizzled with chutney.

title: Alfajores (Herbed Ricotta Cheese Spread)
ingredients: 250 ml ricotta cheese ( fresh or dry ) | 4 tablespoons flat leaf parsley, chopped | 1 teaspoon ground marjoram | 3 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa | 1 teaspoon of chopped marjoram | 1/2 teaspoon chili oil
instructions: In a medium bowl combine the ricotta and finely chopped parsley and sprinkle with the marjoram and cocoa powder. Stir to combine. Cover and let stand in the refrigerator until ready to use. In a small non aluminum saucepan bring the chili oil to a simmer and place the mixture over a moderate heat, stirring from time to time until the mixture starts to bubble. Add the cheese mixture and cook, stirring constantly until the mixture thickens. Remove the pan from the heat and add the chopped marjoram, increase the heat to medium high, and reduce the liquid until slightly thickened. Remove from the heat. Serve cold with toasted bread.

Random Ingredients: beef steak,coriander seed,strawberry,velveeta mexican cheese,stewing beef,kielbasa,mustard powder
title: Kielbasa & Strawberries Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef | 1 lb stewing beef steak, sliced | 1 lb kielbasa or 1 lb other lean sausage | 1 package velveeta mexican cheese | 1 tablespoon coriander seed | 1 tablespoon mustard powder | 2/3 cup sliced strawberries
instructions: Marinade overnight with the mustard powder. In the morning, mix in the sliced strawberries. Put on skewers or broil until meat thermometer reaches 140 degrees, about 15 - 20 minutes for rare, 15 - 20 for medium. Serve with the kielbasa.

Random Ingredients: ham,cucumber,yukon gold potato,black bean,self rising flour,basmati rice,avocado,wheat bread
title: Corn Baked on White Rice
ingredients: 1 cup white rice, cooked, see note | 2 cups self rising flour | 1 cup uncooked basmati rice, steamed until water is absorbed or 1 cup brown rice, cooked but not cooked | 3 cups cubed cooked ham | 1 cup sliced cucumber | 1 cup frozen black beans, thawed and drained | 3 tablespoons seeded chopped fresh basil | 1 medium avocado - peeled, pitted and sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Wrap pan with foil. Prepare rice and ham. To prepare beans, combine beans, rice, ham, cucumber, rice, basil and avocado.

title: Green Cardamom Salad
ingredients: 1 french bread, loaf cut into bite-size cubes | 1 tablespoon grated peeled fresh ginger | 1 -2 teaspoon freshly grated black cardamom or 1 -2 teaspoon ground cardamom | 2 -3 tablespoons fresh lemon juice
instructions: Place bread cubes in a shallow glass or heavy based casserole dish. Sprinkle ginger and black cardamom over the bread cubes. In a small bowl, stir together the lemon juice and freshly squeezed lemon juice. Drizzle over the bread. Bake in a preheated 400f degree oven until the cubes have crisped up and turned brown all over, about 50 - 60 minutes. Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Chicken and Corn Fritters
ingredients: 4 cups corn oil | 1 cup chicken bouillon granules
instructions: Pour oil into a large pan. Heat oil over medium heat until bubbles form around edges.. Crack eggs into frying pan, add seasoning and stir fry until lightly browned. Place on paper towel covered plate and squeeze excess oil. Note, i microwave my chicken, corn and bouillon until the ingredients are fully cooked and have a lovely sauce. Please note, please note that this recipe works best when cooked with white rice.

title: Polpetas De Polvo
ingredients: 1 package hot italian sausage, casing removed | 12 sheets ladyfingers | 2 1/4 cups all-purpose flour | 1 can creamed corn
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Heat a small nonstick skillet over medium heat. Cook and stir sausage in the hot skillet until evenly browned, about 5 minutes.

title: Salsa Roast
ingredients: 3 lbs beef chuck roast | 3 cloves garlic | 2 cans tomato paste ( no need to use a blender )
instructions: Combine 3 lbs. Of meat, 1 clove garlic and 1 can tomato paste. Marinate in the refrigerator 6 to 8 hours. Place in roasting pan. Bake at 350 - 350 degrees for 1 hour. Remove from oven. Cut into 1 inch cubes, stir up.

Random Ingredients: red bean paste,caster sugar,chicken thigh,anise seed,tomato,paprika
title: Chicken Sausages in Chili Sauce
ingredients: 600 g chicken thighs, in bite size pieces | 1 teaspoon ground anise seed | 1/2 teaspoon caster sugar | 2 teaspoons paprika | 250 ml chopped tomatoes | 1/2 teaspoon red bean paste
instructions: Preheat oven to 180c. Line a shallow oven dish with non stick baking paper. Place chicken, anise seeds, sugar, paprika and tomatoes into a large bowl. Sprinkle with a pinch of salt and some dried redleaf. Toss to combine. Bake 20 mins per kg. Remove from oven and stir, allowing excess marinade to run off. Place back into the oven for another 15 - 20 mins. Remove from the oven, leave to cool slightly. Stuff or twist the sausages until just loose and twist in half. Serve warm with chili sauce spooned over them.

title: Crunchy Thai Pepper Cabbage and Cheese Bread
ingredients: 2 cups shredded cabbage | 1 bunch romano cheese | 2 -3 tablespoons oat flour, to coat ( optional ) | 10 -16 thai chiles, coarsely chopped ( can substitute 1 jalapeno pepper, seeded and finely chopped )
instructions: Mix the shredded cabbage and romano in large bowl. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Pour into a greased loaf pan. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes, or until done.

Random Ingredients: chipotle powder,red chili powder,bell pepper,beef dripping
title: Simple Beef and Peppers (Chipotle)
ingredients: 2 lbs beef drippings ( from pan or package, see note ) | 4 large bell peppers ( about 2-1/2 inches in diameter, can vary from red and green ) | 3 tablespoons chipotle powder ( see note ) | 1 tablespoon red chili powder
instructions: Using highend drippings, saute the peppers until just softened. Reduce heat. Add remaining drippings. Sprinkle chipotle and chile powder on. Cover and simmer on low heat 20 minutes until peppers are tender.

title: Curry Beef
ingredients: 2 lbs beef, cubed | 1 teaspoon curry paste | 1 cup chicken stock | 10 blanched almonds, pounded to grind in blender
instructions: Sauté the meat in a very little oil till all of the fat is removed. Add the curry paste and cook over low heat. Add the stock and mix well or let the curry mixture cook for 30 mintes, stirring occasionally. Serve with boiled potatoes or rice.

title: Queso Content
ingredients: 1/4 lb grated firm white american cheese (,, e.g. camembert ) | 1 jalapeno chile, deseeded if desired | 2 tablespoons ghee or 2 tablespoons vegetable oil
instructions: Heat the ghee in a non stick frying pan or a deep pan. Pour in the cheese, stirring with a large wooden spoon a few times. Once the cheese has melted into a mixture, remove from the heat and stir in the chile. Serve piping hot as a dip.

title: Pepper Sambal Noodles (Julia Child)
ingredients: 1 package snap peas | 1/4 cup cognac or 1/4 cup brandy | 1 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1/4 teaspoon cracked pepper | 1 teaspoon sambal oelek
instructions: Cook snap peas for about 5 minutes in boiling water until crisp tender.

Random Ingredients: beef broth,mushroom soup,soya sauce,cherry brandy,chicken base,vegetable,baking soda,vanilla bean
title: Chicken Bog
ingredients: 1 lb ground chicken or 1 lb ground pork | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 3 tablespoons soy sauce | 3 tablespoons vegetables or 3 tablespoons vegetable broth | 1 -2 tablespoon chicken base | 1 can mushroom soup ( or equivalent in flavor ) | 12 fluid ounces beef broth | 1 vanilla bean, sliced | 1 -2 tablespoon fresh cherries or 1 -2 tablespoon dried cherries
instructions: Heat oven to 275 degrees f. Mix soda and soy sauce in small bowl. Coat chicken well with soda mixture. Press meat in small piece of foil on surface so that it is not sticking. Lay in pan with a small edge left on bottom. Bake for 15 minutes to cook off the color of the meat. Remove from oven with foil and place on serving platter. Add 2 tbsp vegetable or chicken base along top of meat. Remove the rest of the foil and bake for 20 minutes to crisp and brown the meat. Put the meat in a separate baking pan so that all of the pieces are about half cooked. Bake in oven for 3 hours. Pour off most of the grease. Stove top, you want the pieces to be slightly dry. Heat the soup or beef broth to a boil, pour into sauce pan and add the vanilla bean. Put on heat and simmer for 10 to 15 minutes. Add gelatin, stir well, and stir in until gelatin is thoroughly dissolved. Turn off, and add cherries. Pour mixture over meat pieces and allow to cool for 20 minutes. I like to mix this with sliced green chard before i serve it. A salad is good with this.

title: Saganaki
ingredients: 250 g sultanas | 250 g pecorino romano cheese
instructions: Heat the sultanas slowly for 20 minutes. Stir all over. When sultanas start to darken, remove from heat and allow to sit for five minutes. The sultanas should still be a bit runny. Spread on a clean tea towel or cheese cloth to cool completely. Wrap in cheese cloth and serve with crushed ice.

title: Jarl's Thai Cheesecake
ingredients: 10 -12 slices thai chili flavored tortilla-sized strips | topping ( for topping ) | 1/2 cup jarlsberg cheese | 2 tablespoons low fat mascarpone cheese | 1/4 teaspoon hot sauce | 1/4 cup thai sweet chili sauce | dill ( to garnish )
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. In a shallow dish, layer cheese over tortilla strips and drizzle with lard. Bake 10 mins on each side or until cheese is melted and browned. Meanwhile, in a small bowl, mix sweet and hot sauce, chilli sauce and chopped dill. Spread mixture over cheesecake. Remove tortilla strips from oven and sprinkle with chilli sauce/dill mixture. Chill 4hours or overnight. Serve with whipped cream and additional sweet sauce as desired.

title: Super Simple Sriracha Oil
ingredients: 1 tablespoon salad oil | 1 1/2 teaspoons sriracha sauce ( more or less to taste )
instructions: Shake or whisk the oil with a fork, it should have a fairly thin pourable consistency. If it is too thick add water a tablespoon at a time. This will dilute it, so leave it in or if it is too thin add the balance of the oil. Keep in the fridge for at least an hour, longer is better, or at least 1 hour if you have room in the fridge. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: galliano,green curry paste,orange zest,chile pepper,key lime juice
title: Hot Thai Dragon (Thai Green Curry Paste)

title: Sweet and Savoury Beef Rolls
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg pork roast, about | 1/4 cup coarse shortcrust pastry | 1/4 cup tomato ketchup | 2 teaspoons sweet paprika | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 600 ml good quality dark grape juice | 1 tablespoon cilantro leaf
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c. Cut meat into 5mm slices. Combine dry ingredients. Add meat slices and toss well. Place in a baking dish, brush with oil. Bake in oven for 1 to 1 1/2 hours or until meat is cooked. Remove pork from bones, cool slightly. Shred meat with a fork adding fat from bones. Combine meat with sauce and refrigerate for an hour before serving. Garnish with cilantro. Serve with buttered noodles and crusty bread.

title: Roasted Bell Peppers
ingredients: 4 large yellow bell peppers | 1 1/4 cups crumbled cotija cheese | 2 tablespoons lard
instructions: Preheat the oven broiler. Cut off tops and bottom of the bell peppers, cut off the tops and remove the seeds. Heat the lard in a small skillet, and rub the inside of the pepper with some of the butterflour. Roast, rotating the peppers and turning frequently, for about 20 minutes or until soft and slightly crisp. Turn them over on the pan so that they are roasted all the way to the other side. Put one cut side of each pepper on a small plate. Sprinkle with some of the cotija cheese. Bake, turning the peppers a few times, until the cheese is melted.

title: Faux Choy Sushi
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs baby bok choy | 1 1/4 lbs salami ( i like to use a mix of hot and sweet, but it will change vastly ) | 1 lb baby bok choy | 1 yellow onion, sliced ( or a combination ) | 1/2 lb golden raisin
instructions: Wash the bok choy and cut it into 2 inch lengths. Place it in a strainer, or colander, sprinkle with salt, and rinse it. Place a weighted plate on top and let drain overnight. Preheat your oven to 300°f. Spread out the slices of salami evenly in your steamer baskets, lay them on the salt, and cover. Place the bamboo skewers on a cookie sheet and bake for 15 - 18 minutes. Remove the bok choy and slice it into 4 strips. Put it under a hot broiler on each side until golden, then remove and cut in half. To serve, cut your bok choy into 1 inch pieces. Heat up a sushi rolling mat, and spread the bok choy around the roller. Using the roller mat as your guide, spread some of the salami in the middle, then sprinkle some onion slices over the salami, then some golden raisins. Keep moving the bok choy around the onions, trying not to break them. When all ingredients are finished, cut the roll in half, and serve.

title: Shrimp With Bok Choy, and Peanuts
ingredients: 1/4 lb shrimp, shelled and deveined | 1 cup bok choy, coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup peanuts, coarsely chopped | 2 tablespoons ice water
instructions: Cook shrimp in boiling water with salt. Drain. Place chopped bok choy and shrimp with salt and peels on platter. Mix. Sprinkle peanuts while hot.

title: Asian Beef Salad
ingredients: 1 lb lean chuck, trimmed and cut into bite-sized pieces | 4 ounces thin spaghetti ( broken in half or thirds ) | 1 jar marinated artichoke hearts, drained | 1 lb round steak, sliced | 1/2 lb bamboo shoot, thinly sliced | 1 cup frozen cornstarch | 4 tablespoons rice noodles, cooked | 1/2 cup peppercorn, chopped ( optional ) | 1 large maraschino cherry ( optional )
instructions: In a large pot, cook the beef, breaking up pieces with a spoon, over medium heat until no pink remains, about 5 minutes. Drain the beef, then cut into bite size pieces and set aside in a separate dish. Cook the spaghetti in a large pot of boiling, salted water until just done, about 8 - 10 minutes. Drain the spaghetti in a colander and rinse well with warm water. Drain again and set aside. When the beef is cool enough to handle, slice it into thin bite size pieces. Drain the artichokes and put the drained spaghetti, artichoke hearts, steak, bamboo shoots and cornstarch in a large bowl. Mix the cold spaghetti with the beef and veggies and let sit for 15 minutes. To serve, add the pepper and cherry, if using, and a few tablespoons of rice wine. Add a bit of water if necessary to make the dressing slightly moist and the flavors meld together.

Random Ingredients: lemon twist,penne pasta,irish cream,cocoa,salt pepper,heavy cream
title: Irish Cream Pasta With Chocolate Crunch Truffles
ingredients: 1 lb uncooked penne pasta | 1/2 cup irish cream | 1 1/2 cups heavy cream | 1 tablespoon powdered cocoa | 3 tablespoons lemon twists | salt and pepper
instructions: Cook pasta until not quite al dente. Meanwhile, in a medium bowl with a mixer, whip cream until soft peaks form. Fold in cocoa and then stir in cream. Drain pasta and toss with cocoa mixture. Season to taste with salt and pepper.

title: Italian Tuna Bread Casserole
ingredients: 1 loaf italian bread | 4 cups prepared prepared mix ( like bisquick ) | 1 1/4 cups picante sauce | 1 1/4 cups shredded mozzarella cheese | 1 package fresh tuna, in water, drained, flaked | 1 cup fresh basil, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Cut the loaf in half lengthwise, then cut each half crosswise into 6 pieces approximately 2 inches long. Remove and discard bread from the center of each piece. Cut bread crosswise into the 4 1/2 inch thick slices. Place each slice between two pieces of plastic wrap and pound gently with a meat mallet to flatten slightly. Repeat with the other sides of the bread. Spread 1 1/4 cups of prepared mix on the bottom half of each piece of bread. Spread 1 1/4 cups of picante sauce on top of the picante sauce, then spread 1 1/4 cups each of the shredded mozzarella and diced tuna equally on top of the picante sauce.

Random Ingredients: chunky salsa,raspberry jam,artichoke heart,cardamom pod,red lentil,arborio rice
title: Red Lentil and Artichoke Rice Pudding
ingredients: 1 red lentil, rinsed and drained well | 2 cups arborio rice | 2 teaspoons chunky salsa | 2 canned artichoke hearts, drained, liquid reserved | 2 cardamom pods, bruised | raspberry jam, for drizzling ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f in a saucepan, bring the lentils, 1/2 c of the reserved liquid, and 1/2 c water to a boil. Cover and transfer to the oven. Cook, stirring frequently, until lentils are tender but not mushy, 25 - 30 minutes. Drain and set aside. Meanwhile, lightly spray a 1 1/2 qt baking dish with nonstick spray. Remove rice from the heat and stir in the salsa, artichoke hearts, remaining lentil liquid, and cardamom. Spread rice mixture evenly in the dish. Drizzle top with raspberry jam. Bake 15 - 20 minutes until bubbly and rice is lightly browned on the surface. Serve warm.

title: Guatemalan-Style Grilled Apples
ingredients: 12 ounces rice vermicelli | 1/2 teaspoon saffron threads | 1/2 cup gala apples ( peeled, cored, cut into thin half moons ) | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh thyme leaves | 1 tablespoon prepared guacamole
instructions: Cook vermicelli in heavy large skillet over medium high heat until just tender, stirring occasionally with flat of flat of spoon, about 4 minutes. Add saffron and cook 1 minute longer. Stir in apple slices, thyme and adobo and cook until slightly softened about 3 minutes. Transfer to large bowl and sprinkle with salt.

title: Beef 'n Bean Sprouts
ingredients: 1 pound ground sirloin | 2 teaspoons prepared gingerroot, minced | 2 packages fresh bean sprouts | 1/3 cup plain yogurt | 2 1/2 tablespoons confectioners'sugar
instructions: Preheat an oven to 325 degrees f. Place the ground sirloin in a skillet over medium high heat. Cook and stir until browned and crumbly, 5 to 7 minutes. Drain grease from the skillet. Stir in ginger, bean sprouts, yogurt, and confectioners' sugar.

title: Kythoni Kythoni(Vietnamese Sugar-Free)
ingredients: 8 large egg yolks, room temperature | 5 teaspoons black cardamom pods, very finely crushed in a mortar | 5 teaspoons all purpose cinnamon or 5 teaspoons ground cinnamon
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees f. Line a large, deep baking sheet with parchment paper or grease lightly. Whisk egg yolks and black cardamom pods together in a small bowl to combine. Sift together cinnamon and cardamom together in a second small bowl. Using a clean whisk, whisk the egg mixture until thick and creamy. Using a rubber spatula, fold egg mixture into yolk mixture until completely blended. Place parchment paper in a large baking sheet and spread the kythoni mixture across it. Bake for about 45 minutes, or until browned.

title: Vietnamese Rice Noodles With Niles
ingredients: 250 g rice noodles or 250 g vermicelli, cut into thin strips for serving | 600 ml vegetable stock
instructions: Place a large saucepan over high heat and add the noodles. Cook, stirring frequently until golden and slightly charred. Using a slotted spoon, transfer all the noodles to a large mixing bowl. Add the vegetable stock and noodles to the pan and season with salt and freshly ground black pepper. Return the mixture to the pan and bring to the boil. Reduce the heat to low and cook, uncovered, for 20 - 30 minutes, stirring frequently, until the noodles are tender and the stock has been absorbed. Remove from the heat and season to taste. Leave to cool slightly before serving hot, or refrigerate until required.

title: Smoky Cheese Tacos
ingredients: 4 taco shells or 4 flour tortillas | 2 cups grated tex-blend smoked cheese or 2 cups shredded smoked mozzarella cheese | 1/3 cup bottled guacamole | 1/4 cup mild flavored vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon liquid smoke flavoring ( such as tabasco ) | 2 tablespoons thinly slivered green cabbage | 1 dash salt | crouton
instructions: Heat a lightly oiled nonstick frypan over medium high heat. Add the taco filling and then quickly stir in the cheese and a quarter of the dill. Top with the other half of the dill to make 6 tacos. Heat the bacon fat over medium heat until shimmering. Garnish the tacos with the guacamole, vinegar, liquid smoke and cabbage.

title: Nacho Beef and Cheese
ingredients: 8 ounces mexican blend cheese, divided | 1 1/2 lbs boneless beef chuck, cut in 1/2-inch cubes | 1/2 cup thinly sliced radish | 1 -2 tablespoon honey
instructions: Preheat over to 325°. Place half the cheese in the bottom end of a 9 inch square glass baking dish. Cut half the beef into 1/2 inch cubes and layer on top of cheese. Repeat with the remaining cheese. Top with the radish and drizzle generously with honey. Cover with foil and bake 60 - 90 minutes, until top is golden brown.

title: Kathy's Simple Crumble Eggs
ingredients: 12 large eggs | 1 cup graham cracker crumbs | catsup, to taste ( optional )
instructions: Pour 1/2 cup batter into a 10 pie dish, or other shallow baking dish. Top with cracker crumbs. Sprinkle catsup. Bake in a preheated 350f oven until golden brown and crispy.

title: Tomato Sauce(Saucepan)
ingredients: 1/2 cup flour | 1/2 cup sherry wine | 2 lbs plum tomatoes | kosher salt
instructions: Combine tomato flour, and wine in a small sauté pan, heat for 2 - 3 minutes. Bring to a boil, lower heat to medium and cook until liquid is reduced by 3/4, about 20 minutes. Remove from heat and cool slightly. Using a hand held blender, crush the tomatoes in the pan using a large rubber spatula. Slowly warm the tomato mixture to boiling, stirring constantly. Reduce heat to low and continue to cook for another 5 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in salt. This sauce can be used immediately as a base for lasagna or other lasagna.

Random Ingredients: chocolate syrup,coriander leaf,breadstick,cumin,caster sugar,parmigiano reggiano cheese,ice
title: Caramelized Chilli, Coriander and Chocolate Sandwich
ingredients: 2 slices breadsticks | 1 tablespoon of melted chocolate syrup or 1 tablespoon maple syrup, to taste | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 1/4 teaspoon caster sugar | 1/4 cup thinly sliced coriander leaves, washed, dried and chopped | 1 slice parmigiano-reggiano cheese, cut into long thin strips, to garnish ( optional ) | ice
instructions: In a small bowl, blend together the chocolate syrup, cumin and caster sugar. Dip each slice of bread into the chocolate mixture and arrange slices on a platter. Drizzle with the chocolate syrup mixture, garnish with coriander leaves and serve with parmigiano reggiano slices.

title: Penne in Lemony Soy Lime Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb penne pasta | 1/3 cup tarragon, chopped | 2 teaspoons dark soy sauce | 2 teaspoons lime leaves, dry
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. Saute lemons, tarragon, soy sauce and lime leaves in olive oil. Drain pasta.

title: Spiced Beef With Parsnips
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs beef chuck | 4 slices smoked canadian bacon | 2 small parsnips | 2 tablespoons canadian bacon fat ( can be a mixture of red and white ) | 2 teaspoons orange zest, grated ( can use lemon rind )
instructions: Trim the meat and cut into serving pieces. Coat the meat with half the canadian bacon fat. In a skillet, cook the parsnip and green chili over a moderate heat with the canadian bacon fat. When the meat is browned, remove it. Add the remaining canadian bacon fat to the skillet. Add the beef and stir to combine. Bring the mixture to a boil. Spoon the beef mixture into the slow cooker. Cover and cook on the high setting 10 to 12 hours. A fork can also be inserted in the beef. Serve.

Random Ingredients: tortilla,self rising flour,cooking spray,beef brisket,green pepper,turnip,cardamom pod,couscous
title: Beef and Couscous Pot Pie
ingredients: 1/4 cup split green peppers ( i just use a little yellow, but i like red ) | 1/4 cup chopped turnip ( also a little yellow ) | 3 tablespoons uncooked couscous | 3/4 teaspoon ground cardamom pod | cooking spray | 2 1/4 - 2 1/4 lbs corned beef brisket ( i like brisket ) or 2 1/4-2 1/4-2 1/4 lbs roast, cut into chunks ( i like brisket ) | 2 cups quick-cooking couscous | 3/4 teaspoon freshly ground cardamom pod | tortilla
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. Spray an 11x15 inch baking dish with cooking spray, and place in oven to heat while preparing vegetables. Cut 2 1/2 inch thick slice from top of corned beef. Combine 3/4 tsp cardamom, couscous and 2/3 tsp cardamom in a small bowl, and cover.

title: Ginger Adobo Paste
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon ground ginger | 4 tablespoons adobo sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a small bowl.

title: Pickled Turnips
ingredients: 6 lbs turnips | 2 serrano peppers, quartered
instructions: Boil the turnips until tender with their stalk attached. Remove and place in a bowl of cold water to cool. When cool enough to handle, peel and dice into pea size pieces. Place in a clean jar with a tight fitting lid. Seal and process in a hot water bath for 20 to 30 minutes until tender.

title: Grilled Ginger Ginger-Lime Glaze for Vegetables and Chicken
ingredients: 2/3 cup fresh gingerroot, finely chopped | 4 tablespoons fresh lime juice, juice and zest of | 1 tablespoon italian seasoning
instructions: Add all ingredients to a glass measuring cup and stir until it dissolves. Sprinkle mixture over sliced veggies.

Random Ingredients: lamb shoulder,pizza sauce,seasoning salt,dark rum,golden syrup,granny smith apple,kielbasa
title: German Braised Lamb
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb boneless lamb shoulder | 1 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1 ounce dark rum | 12 ounces pizza sauce ( your favourite brand ) | 8 ounces kielbasa, cut across the width into 3-inch slices, and partially frozen | 6 -12 granny smith apples, cut across the width into 3-inch slices
instructions: Rinse lamb well and dry on paper paper towels. Sprinkle 2 teaspoons seasoning salt and 2 teaspoons rum over lamb. Cover and refrigerate for 2 hours or overnight. Remove lamb from refrigerator and drain all liquid. Remove lamb from marinade and pat dry. Reserve marinade and arrange lamb on rack in broiler pan. Cook at 400 for 40 minutes, turning once. Baste lamb with reserved marinade while meat is cooking. Slice lamb thinly across the grain. Arrange onto serving platter and surround with sliced apples. Pour any remaining marinade over meat. Serve with warm noodles and pass extra beer.

title: Sour Chocolate Biscotti
ingredients: 1 lb ricciatelli pasta | bouillon | baking chocolate
instructions: Cook the rigatoni in boiling, salted water according to the package instructions. Drain and place in large bowl with the cooking water and a few shakes of bouillon and allow to cool completely. When the rigatoni is done, drain and press with a spoon, breaking it into small pieces. Place on a paper towel lined baking sheet and allow to dry completely. Preheat oven to 400 °f. Line out a baking sheet with foil and spray a nonstick spray of cooking oil on the foil. Line baking sheet with the large baking sheet and pour the biscotti into the oven. Allow biscotti to dry for approximately 10 to 15 minutes, turn and bake until the tops just turn brown, and biscuits are cooked through. Remove biscuits from the oven from the foil and set aside on the baking sheet. Pour desired amount of chocolate into a bowl. Using an english toffee knife, cut the chocolate into fingers or small squares, about 5 - 6 inches long. Pour these little chocolate pieces into the bowl with the biscotti and gently mix together with your hands. Note, in a microwave safe container, add a little warm water, microwave on high for 4 to 5 minutes, stirring after 2 to 3 minutes. To achieve the right texture, heat oven to 325 °f, which is optimal when your oven is very hot. Variation use in other recipes.

title: Stew Beef Roll Ups
ingredients: 1 can stewing beef | 1 1/2 cups part-skim mozzarella cheese, shredded
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f cut a slit in the top of the roast.

Random Ingredients: carrot,yellow cake mix,caesar salad dressing,green curry paste,white rice,raisin
title: Rice Salad II
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups white rice, short grain | 1 package yellow cake mix | 1/2 - 3/4 cup raisins | 3/4 cup carrot, grated | 1 tablespoon yellow curry paste, to taste | 3/4 cup caesar salad dressing ( or more to taste )
instructions: Prepare rice according to instructions on box. Drain rice and allow to cool then crumble. In a large bowl, mix all ingredients. Dress with salad dressing and mix well.

Random Ingredients: tomato juice,vanilla extract,dark sesame oil,swiss cheese,red wine,bok choy,pecan
title: Bok Choy Gratin
ingredients: 1 teaspoon dark sesame oil | 12 cups sliced bok choy | 2/3 cup sliced swiss cheese or 2/3 cup swiss cheese, shredded | 1/3 cup shredded pecans | 1/4 cup tomato juice | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 2 tablespoons dry red wine
instructions: Mix oil, vinegar, tomato juice, vanilla and wine together in a large bowl and set aside. Place bok choy and half the swiss on each of four plates or gratin dishes. Pour tomato mixture over the bok choy. Sprinkle remaining swiss on top. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: yellow pepper,espresso coffee,green onion,mexican cheese,cooking oil,chili paste,sage
title: Al Espresso and Yellow Pepper Dip
ingredients: 1 1/2 teaspoons cooking oil | 1 -2 teaspoon instant espresso coffee | 2 tablespoons green onions, chopped | 2 tablespoons chopped yellow peppers | 1 teaspoon dried sage or 1 teaspoon oregano leaves | 1 teaspoon chili paste, chili-flavored, or to taste | 1 1/4 cups shredded mexican blend cheese, divided
instructions: In a small saucepan, heat oil over medium heat until hot but not smoking. Combine all ingredients except 1 cup shredded cheese in a small bowl. Place mixture in a medium bowl.

Random Ingredients: apple cider,baking powder,cumin powder,fava bean,anise seed,vegetable
title: Fufu Beans (Foul Mudammes)
ingredients: 2 lbs fava beans, about 1 lb in weight | 1 medium-sized apple, unpeeled and diced ( i use a medium size ) | 10 tablespoons apple cider | cumin powder | 1 teaspoon anise seed | 1 teaspoon baking powder
instructions: In large pot boil the fava beans for approximately 1 - ½ to 2 hours, depending on size of beans so they are cooked but still somewhat firm around the edges. Meanwhile, place apple in a pan of boiling water and simmer until just tender about 10 minutes. Remove apple from water with slotted spoon and place in another bowl. When beans are nearly done, drain them and return them to the pot. Add cider and spices and reduce to just under a simmer. Add water to cover the beans and apple and continue cooking until liquid has completely absorbed. This will take approximately 20 to 30 minutes depending on type of cooked beans.

Random Ingredients: green bean,red wine,pork shoulder,flat bread,peanut butter,fenugreek seed,white flour,self rising flour
title: Fenugreek Green Beans
ingredients: 1 lb green beans, ends cut off | 2/3 lb pork shoulder, cubed | 1/4 lb dry red wine, like taj mahal | 1 1/4 cups white flour | 10 tablespoons peanut butter | 1 teaspoon dried fenugreek seeds | 1 tablespoon self-rising flour | 8 -10 flat bread, for serving
instructions: Place beans in a large saucepan with water to cover, bring to a boil and simmer for 2 to 3 minutes. Drain and reserve. While beans are simmering, mix pork shoulder with red wine, cover and simmer for 1 hour. Remove pork shoulder and set aside. Remove saucepan from stovetop and stir in white flour, peanut butter, fenugreek and 1 cup of cooking liquid until blended. Simmer about 1/2 hr stirring occasionally. Add beans and simmer an additional 15 - 20 minute. Preheat oven to 350 deg for 20 minutes. Serve on flatbread with warm rolls.

Random Ingredients: leg lamb,fennel seed,celery rib,creme de cacao
title: Italian-French Roast Lamb
ingredients: 1 boneless leg of lamb, excess fat removed | 1 teaspoon fennel seed | 1 large celery rib, cut in 3/4-inch slices | 1 ounce creme de cacao
instructions: Rub the lamb all over with the seeds and rub them into the lamb. Cover and set up a roasting pan and bake the lamb on the middle rack of the oven for at least 1 hour. Remove the lamb from the oven and allow it to rest for about 10 minutes. Remove the pan from the oven and skim away as much fat as possible from the surface. Pour the creme de cacao over the lamb and serve.

title: Jamaican Spiced Sage  (Using Cream or Chocolate Butter)
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh sage leaf | 2 ounces unsweetened cocoa | 2 -3 ounces icing sugar | 1/8 teaspoon turmeric | 1/8 teaspoon allspice | 1 tablespoon jalapeno pepper, chopped | 1 tablespoon breadcrumbs ( or dried, to form crumbs )
instructions: Bring cream to a boil in a large saucepan. Stir in cocoa, vanilla sugar, icing sugar, turmeric & allspice. When the cream is hot, add chives and jalapeno. Mix, then remove from heat. Pour into a small, well buttered mould. Allow to cool slightly. Dust the top with dried breadcrumbs or dried breadcrumbs or decorate with crme leaves. Keep in a cool place, outside up until time to serve. If using fresh sage leaves, remove leaves before using. Keep in mind that dry bread crumbs keep for a long time keeping their shape for a long time.

title: Stir Fry Vegetables
ingredients: 2 tablespoons stir-fry vegetables | 1/4 teaspoon celery salt | cooking spray
instructions: Spray a large nonstick skillet with cooking spray.

Random Ingredients: coriander,grape tomato,red wine vinegar,sesame oil,coffee,vegan margarine,cooking onion
title: Tomato Cappuccino Sauce
ingredients: 1 tablespoon vegan margarine | 1/2 cup cooking onions ( optional ) or 1/2 cup shallot ( optional ) | 1/2 cup red wine vinegar | 2 cups grape tomatoes ( fresh or canned ) | 1 teaspoon sesame oil | 1 teaspoon coriander, ground ( optional ) | 3/4 teaspoon instant coffee or 3/4 teaspoon instant espresso ( optional )
instructions: In a small pan, melt margarine over medium/high heat. Add the onion and cook, stirring until translucent, about 3 minutes. Add vinegar, tomatoes, sesame oil, coriander & espresso. Bring to a boil. Lower heat, simmer about 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, or until thickened. Pour into a bowl & chill 2 - 8 hours before serving.

Random Ingredients: water chestnut,turnip,golden raisin,pearl barley,rice,leg lamb,salt pepper
title: Rice and Meat Braised in Barley
ingredients: 1 1 lb raw leg of lamb, cut into 5 to 6 pieces | 1/4 lb pearl barley | 2 quarts fresh water chestnuts, sliced | 4 ounces golden raisins, coarsely chopped | 1 cup turnip, chopped | salt and pepper | 1 cup rice, washed
instructions: Preheat oven to 275f degrees. Remove bones from lamb.

title: Quick Microwave French Fries
ingredients: 1 1/4 teaspoons powdered cardamom | 1 teaspoon ground nutmeg ( or another nutmeg flavour such as ground cloves ) or 1 teaspoon ginger, ground ( or another nutmeg flavour such as ground cloves )
instructions: Place all ingredients in microwave safe bowl and stir until well mixed. The fries may be stored in an airtight container for up to two weeks.

Random Ingredients: dark sesame oil,rose water,gingerroot,white sugar,red pepper flake,mexican cheese
title: Savory Sesame Fondue
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups grated mexican blend cheese ( optional ) | 1 piece fresh gingerroot ( about 1/2 inch or just over a small piece ) | 1/4 cup dark sesame oil | 2/3 cup white sugar | 3 tablespoons mixed rose water ( with or without dark parts ) | 1 tablespoon red pepper flakes | 3 tablespoons red sweetened condensed milk or 3 tablespoons dark sweetened condensed milk
instructions: Place the cheese in the bowl of a stand mixer fitted with the paddle attachment, adding the sesame oil, sugar, rose water, and red pepper flakes. Beat until smooth.. Transfer to a bowl and freeze until solid, at least 2 hours. Transfer the mixture to the fondue pot or crock and set aside. If the fondue is too thick, add a little water, a tablespoon at a time, until you achieve the desired consistency. To serve, reheat the sauce over a moderate flame in your fondue pot, stirring to loosen the fondue from the bottom of the fondue pot. Transfer to a fondue burner and reheat on moderate flame. Transfer to a serving tray, cover, and keep warm over low heat for 2 hours or until slightly thickened. If the sauce is too thin, stir in a little more white sugar or cornstarch dissolved in a little water.

title: Arborio Rice and Apple Casserole
ingredients: 2 -3 pints fresh tart apples, about 1 1/2 pounds | 1 1/2 tablespoons arborio rice
instructions: Preheat to 350 degrees. Core and cut unpeeled apples into bite size chunks, about 1/2 pound. Place apples and rice in large bowl. Sprinkle with enough boiling water to cover. Stand one fourth of apple chunks on top of rice. Place rice around the rice, then top with remaining apples. Make sure apple and rice are all in a single layer, and no liquid settles over the top. Cover bowl tightly with foil. Bake until liquid is absorbed and rice is tender, about 1 hour 15 minutes. You should have a creamy white and crispy edge. Let stand covered at least an hour, then uncover and leave until cool, about 1 hour longer.

title: Baked Easter Eggs
ingredients: 4 -5 large eggs | 2 tablespoons parmesan cheese, grated | 1/2 cup white breadcrumbs, plain bread crumbs
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit. Use a glass, or ceramic bowl or pan large enough to accommodate the eggs in a single layer, to make the eggs slide right into the pan. Lightly tap a couple of the eggs and then turn over. Lift out the egg whites with a slotted spoon and place on a rack over the pan. Sprinkle the tops of the eggs evenly with parmesan cheese. Bake in the oven for 10 - 15 minutes, or until a crusty brown crust will form, taking care not to burn. Remove from the oven, and remove the pan from the oven. Tap the pan lightly on the counter before removing the eggs. Sprinkle more parmesan cheese over the top. Let sit 5 minutes to absorb excess moisture. Place the eggs on a rack and let dry for at least 2 hours.

Random Ingredients: kaffir lime leaf,parsley leaf,mango chutney,sauce,fine matzo meal,red chilies,corn cob
title: Matzah Raita
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups fine matzo meal | 2 1/4 cups hot sauce ( sriracha ) | 1 bunch fresh parsley leaves, minced | 2 large red chilies, minced | 6 -8 kaffir lime leaves, finely shredded | 8 large thin corn on the cob, husks and silk removed, rinsed, patted dry ( about 4 pounds ) | 1 cup mango chutney
instructions: Combine matzah meal and sriracha in large bowl, mix well. Add parsley, chili, lime leaves and corn. Toss to combine. Cover and let stand at room temperature for 30 minutes. Bring to room temperature. Stir in chutney. Cover and let stand 30 minute. Stir before serving.

Random Ingredients: radicchio,egg yolk,beef flavor ramen noodle,chicken thigh,quinoa,chili powder
title: Easy Noodle and Beef Kabobs With Quinoa
ingredients: 2 cooked chicken thighs, shredded | 3 tablespoons dried quinoa | 1 egg yolk | 1 teaspoon chili powder | 8 ounces radicchio ( spring- rinsed and packed ) | 3 cups cooked quinoa | 1 package beef-flavor ramen noodles
instructions: Mix chicken, quinoa, egg yolk, chili powder in medium bowl.

title: Tasty Indian Green Dessert Sauce for Vegetables or Dessert Fruity Addictive Bites
ingredients: 1 jar prepared whipped topping | 1/2 teaspoon ground fenugreek | 3 drops green food coloring | 1 dash onion powder ( optional )
instructions: Heat 2 oz. Of whipped topping in a pan over medium high heat till it starts to bubble. Remove from heat. Quickly stir in 1/4 teaspoon fenugreek powder and mix well. Stir in a little dash of onion powder and green food coloring as well. Pour mixture into a medium bowl. Garnish with a dash of green food coloring.

title: Chinese Glaze
ingredients: 1/3 cup dry white wine ( i prefer shaoxing wine ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons mirin ( or to suit taste ) | 1 tablespoon dry mustard
instructions: Combine in a small pan. Shake over vegetables and let sit until used. Will last 2 years in the fridge.

Random Ingredients: rice,curry paste,phyllo pastry,fish sauce,cabbage,green chili pepper,pork loin
title: Thai Pork and Rice Parcels With Coriander and Green Peppers
ingredients: 1/2 kg pork loin, finely minced | 1 small green chili pepper, sliced | 1 tablespoon thai sweet curry paste or 1 tablespoon thai green chili paste | 3 tablespoons finely chopped coriander | 375 g frozen phyllo pastry sheets | 300 g chopped cabbage ( fresh or thawed ) | 1 tablespoon fish sauce
instructions: Combine the pork, chillies, curry paste and coriander in a shallow dish. Cover and refrigerate for approximately one hour or overnight. Preheat oven to 200°c. Line a baking tray with baking paper. Unwrap phyllo pastry sheets, and cut sheets in half diagonally to form four 4cm squares. Place one square on baking tray, then brush it with water and top with second. Cook in oven uncovered for about 15 minutes, or until base is golden. Remove from oven and sprinkle with fish sauce. Cut the phyllo pastry into 5 12cm strips, and lay on a baking tray. Top with filling, pressing to seal. Top with cabbage and bake in oven for 10 minutes, or until cabbage is almost tender and filling is hot. Serve with a green salad and steamed rice.

title: Quick 'n Easy Mexican Rice
ingredients: 1 lb dry rice ( i like lipton brand ) | 4 cups double cream | 1 package taco seasoning | 1 dash garlic salt | fruit, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Bake 1/3 rice about 20 minutes or until liquid begins to run clear. Add cream and taco seasoning. Mix well. Place in casserole dish. Cover with chopped fruit. Bake 20 minutes. Serve with mexican cheese or salsa.

Random Ingredients: pepperide brown sugar cinnamon swirl bread,cabbage,shiitake mushroom,corn tortilla,mace,eggplant
title: Grilled Eggplant (Aubergine) Enciladas
ingredients: 1/3 cup sweet butter or 1/3 cup margarine, melted | 3 garlic cloves, minced | 1/4 cup peeled, and chopped eggplant | 15 shiitake mushrooms, sliced | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 1/2 teaspoon ground coriander or 1/2 teaspoon ground sage | 2/3 cup shredded cabbage ( optional ) | 12 corn tortillas
instructions: Blend first 7 ingredients, except cabbage, in a medium bowl to blend. Place 1/4 cup cabbage and 2/3 cup cabbage mix in shallow dish. Place 1 tortilla on top of mixture, pressing lightly. Repeat with remaining tortilla and filling. Lightly brush 2/3 cup of the reserved cabbage mix on 6 tortillas. Place 6 tortillas on rack of grill over med high heat. Grill tortillas until golden brown and crisp, turning occasionally about 5 - 10 minute assemble enchildas. If using a bowl of coleslaw mix mix place 1 tortilla on plate, top with 1 tablespoon cabbage mixture, then 1/2 of the eggplant mixture and then top with 1/2 of the tortillas. Fold tortillas over to enclose filling and place on platter. Serve warm.

title: Chinese Style Dill
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh dill | 4 cups water chestnuts | 1 tablespoon sweet chili paste
instructions: Wash dill and remove stems. Cut off stems and set aside at room temperature. Using a sharp knife, cut off the top part of the dill stalks, then pull out the leaves and remove any tough part. Slice out the thick bottom part of the stalk and discard. Do not slice all the way through the center or the leaf. Remove the bitter white part of the stalk. Wash the leaves thoroughly under warm running water and drain well. Place them in a glass jar or a bowl. Heat water to boiling and add a small amount of salt. Cover the jar tightly and set aside until needed. Stem and devein the water chestnuts. If using the fresh dill, drain them thoroughly and slice thinly using a vegetable peeler, or trimming the stalks and using scissors. Discard stalks and cut the pieces in half. Place dill stalks, water chestnuts, and chili paste in a bowl and mix together. The mixture will be more or less cloudy than typical chinese dill weed. Place dill mixture in a serving dish and garnish with slices of white part of the stalk or greens, if desired.

title: Nyum Goongy Gulabak (Feta Salad)
ingredients: 600 g frozen lima beans | 200 g feta ( known as chickpea in hindi ) | 200 g fresh cream | 2 -3 tablespoons ketjap manis | 5 teaspoons chili paste ( hari ) | 4 large lettuce leaves | 1 green ginger, peeled and finely chopped
instructions: Place the frozen lima beans in a pot then cover with very hot water. Bring to a boil on high flame. Reduce flame. Simmer for five minutes. Uncover. Remove from heat. Allow to cool in the refrigerator for ten minutes. Cut feta into 1 cm cubes. Drain and remove skin. Fold in cream, chickpeas and chilli paste. Remove green ginger from the cream. Arrange lettuce leaves around the outer edge. Sprinkle chopped ginger over the lettuce leaves. Pour over the chilled lima bean cream salad. Serve immediately.

title: Pesto-Crusted Halibut
ingredients: 3 ounces white mushrooms, thinly sliced | 1 1/2 ounces garlic flavored croutons | 3 ounces pine nuts, roughly chopped | 1 1/2 lbs halibut fillets, about 5-8 ounces each | 1/4 cup mixed fresh garden herbs, such as chives, thyme, oregano, basil, and rosemary
instructions: Pre heat the grill to high. Place mushrooms, croutons, pine nuts, and fish in a shallow plate. Sprinkle the herbs on top. When the hot grill is ready, set an oven shelf about 6 inches below the heat source and pre heat the to 400 degrees f. Sprinkle the fish and mushrooms with the herb mixture. When the fish is cooked through, it will open up and be able to move around easily. Remove from the grill. Place the fish and mushrooms in a serving platter and serve. Serve warm or chilled.

Random Ingredients: ghee,mini marshmallow,brown mushroom,dijon mustard,red bell pepper,black bean,fig
title: Fig and Beans With Mushrooms & Figs
ingredients: 400 g dried figs, quartered crosswise | 1 tablespoon ghee | 1 red bell pepper, cut into thin strips | 1 cup dried black beans, rinsed | 1/2 cup dijon-style mustard | 1/2 cup brown mushrooms, coarsely chopped | 1 tablespoon ghee
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon ghee in a large non stick pan over medium high heat. Add pepper and figs and cook, stirring, until mushrooms start to soften, add mustard and brown mushrooms. Continue to cook, stirring, until figs are tender, about 3 minutes. Add remaining ghee and remaining figs and cook, stirring, until hot.

title: Beef and Fig Linguine
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs lean chuck roast, about 1 1/2-inches thick | 1/4 lb chuck roast bone ( optional ) | 1 lb fresh fig, chopped | 1 lb fresh figine, cut in half | 1 1/2 lbs lean ground chuck
instructions: In a large stockpot, cook the chuck over medium heat until it browns well on all sides. Transfer the meat to a bowl and set aside. Add the beef bone, figs and figine to the pot and stir to mix. Add another 1/2 lb. Skinned chuck and stir into the simmering stew. Simmer, covered, for 3 hours. Meanwhile, heat a 10 inch skillet over medium heat. Add 2 tbs. Oil and brown the ground chuck for 5 minutes. Use a slotted spoon to remove the meat from the pan and set aside. Set aside the meat drippings. Skim fat from the pan and return the juices to the pan. Boil for a few moments and skim off any dark residue. Return the meat and fig mixture to the pan. Simmer, covered for 30 - 40 minutes or until thickened. Add salt and pepper to taste. Serve over linguine.

Random Ingredients: chinese egg noodle,green tea,dark chocolate,ice water
title: Cha Cha Noodles
ingredients: 3 tablespoons chinese egg noodles | 2 tablespoons ice water | 1 tablespoon green tea | 1 tablespoon dark chocolate ( optional )
instructions: Place the chinese noodles in a small bowl and cover with boiling water. Leave to soak then drain. Place the ice water into a small pot, add the chacha powder and microwave for a few seconds to melt it. Drain the noodles and return. Add the chocolate to the water and heat it up for a few seconds. Drain the noodles and pour over the chacha on the plate. Enjoy.

title: Quick Spinach and Anchovy
ingredients: 1 package spinach | 2 anchovy paste, or more to taste ( optional )
instructions: Wash and dry spinach, place on a plate with the ends touching. Cover with plastic wrap and press out excess water. Let drain for 30 minutes or up to 1 hour. Rinse if necessary, and squeeze the excess water out with a spoon. Cut spinach into squares and transfer to a serving bowl.

title: Pumpkin Seeds(Pumpkin Seeds)
ingredients: 1 1/4 kg black pumpkin seeds, dry weight | 1 teaspoon dried thyme sprig | 1 teaspoon crushed dried rosemary sprig | 1/2 teaspoon coriander powder | 2 fresh tomatoes or 1 can diced tomatoes | 1/4 cup crushed corn flakes
instructions: Heat pan on med high. Add 1tbsp of oil and stirfry eachnut for 4 minutes, stirring till both sides are light brown and very tender. Leave on absorbent paper. Heat remaining oil in pan on medium to medium high. Add pumpkin seeds and fry till they can be stirred continuously on medium high so that they can be mashed without burning. Add remaining ingredients and stirfry for 3 - 4 minutes, till mixed well. Serve warm or cool and leave in the fridge for up to 3 days.

title: Fennel with Black Mushrooms
ingredients: 3 lbs fresh black mushrooms or 3 lbs frozen black mushrooms | 1 fennel bulb
instructions: In a large bowl, mix all the ingredients together well. Cover with plastic wrap and leave in the refrigerator for at least 20 minutes to macerate the vegetables. Heat the broiler. Remove the wrap and broil the mixture for 5 - 10 minutes. Serve immediately.

title: Yellow Curry Scented With Apples
ingredients: 1 apple | 1 teaspoon saffron thread | 2 tablespoons yellow curry paste ( i use jaggery in the asian food aisle ) | 1 1/2 cups cold water
instructions: Pre heat oven 350' or close to the source. Core the apple and place it in a medium pot and pour in enough water to come up about ¾ of the way. Add saffron and cook for about five minutes until the apple becomes soft and mushy. Remove the apple to a bowl. Add yellow curry base to the drained apple and continue cooking for about five minutes. Add water and stir. Bring to boil and then reduce heat to medium. Allow mixture to cook for an hour. Taste and add more saffron if required. Add more water if mixture is too thick. Note, a cup of curry paste can be substituted for the yellow curry base. Add curry base to apple and stir to combine and coat evenly. Serve over steamed or fried rice. For best results, cover the dish at all times with plastic wrap and a thin film of water. The curry tastes better after refrigerating. The taste will improve as each time you eat it.

title: Okra With Lemons and Cheese
ingredients: 1 lb okra, frozen | 3 medium lemons, juiced and zested | pecorino cheese, grated ( to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Place the okra in a large microwave safe bowl and cover with warm water. Cover bowl and microwave on high for 3 to 5 minutes, depending on power of your microwave. The okra should be tender, but not mushy. Stir occasionally during the first 5 minutes, stir in the lemon juice. Transfer to a serving bowl and sprinkle with the cheese, if desired.

title: Pesto Puda (Pesto Pasta Dough)
ingredients: 1 cup coarse white flour | 2 tablespoons pesto sauce ( made with olive oil ) | 1 tablespoon white flour
instructions: Pesto paste combine all ingredients in a bowl with a mixer and beat at low speed until flour forms a thin ribbon. The dough should be the consistency of heavy cream. Knead dough on a lightly floured surface until smooth and elastic, about 2 minutes. Cover with oiled plastic wrap and a towel and let sit in a warm spot until doubled in size, about 30 minutes. Dust a work surface with flour. Make sure that you spray the work surface with oil. Pick a handful of it at a time into the flour. Using your fingers press the dough into a thin, even rectangle with the edges of the flour. This can literally be a tortilla shape. Cut into 1 1/2 inch pieces. Form into a cone shaped tube using a flute, or with a sharp knife. Sprinkle about 1 tbl. Of pesto on each round. Repeat with remaining dough and pesto. Place in a steamer, cover and steam at low heat for 30 minutes over low heat. The pitas should be puffy and brown and puffy.

title: Cafe Con Cerveza
ingredients: 12 white mushrooms ( about 1 ounce each ) | 4 teaspoons instant coffee ( instant coffee powder ) | 3 cups broccoli florets | 1/2 lb crab ( raw or imitation ) | 1/4 cup snipped pimiento | 1 1/4 teaspoons fresh thyme sprigs or 1 1/4 teaspoons dried thyme | 2 tablespoons low-fat yogurt
instructions: Heat the instant coffee granules in a 1 quart stainless steel saucepan over low heat until bubbles form around the sides. Add the broccoli and mushrooms and stir to coat the mushrooms and cook over low heat until crisp tender, about 3 minutes. Stir in the crab and pimientos and stir to combine. Transfer mixture to a serving bowl and let cool at room temperature. Stir in the yogurt. Garnish with a sprig of thyme.

Random Ingredients: clam juice,lemon orange peel,asparagus,dijon mustard,tarragon,orange zest,ginseng root
title: Ginseng Dijon Crab Salad
ingredients: 2 pounds fresh asparagus, trimmed | 3 cups bottled clam juice | 1 cup orange zest | 1 cup lemon orange peel | 1 cup minced fresh tarragon | 4 tablespoons chopped fresh tarragon | 1 1/2 tablespoons dijon mustard
instructions: Bring a pot of salted water to a boil. Add fresh asparagus, and cook for 2 minutes. Drain, and cool under running water. Rinse with cold water. Drain again. Place the asparagus into a large pot with 1 cup clam juice, and the orange zest, lemon orange peel, and tarragon. Bring to a boil, and place lid on pot. Reduce heat to medium low, and simmer for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally. Remove and discard asparagus heads and blemishes. In a small bowl, blend together 1 1/2 tablespoons tarragon with 1 1/2 tablespoons mustard. Stir into seafood mixture and heat through.

title: Simple Beef Cubes
ingredients: 2 lbs stewing beef | lime zest ( optional )
instructions: Place the cubed meat into a non stick skillet. Sprinkle it with lime zest. Cover with water and bring to a simmer over medium heat. Cook for 30 minutes or until meat is tender, stirring occasionally..

Random Ingredients: splenda sugar substitute,vermouth,beef rib,pistachio,walnut half,peach,pork tenderloin
title: Grilled Beef Short Ribs With Pistachios
ingredients: 1/4 cup splenda sugar substitute | 2 tablespoons dry vermouth | 3/4 lb pork tenderloin | 1 teaspoon splenda sugar substitute | 1 3/4 lbs beef short ribs, trimmed | 1/2 cup ground pistachios, toasted | 1/4 cup chopped walnut halves | 1 whole peach, halved
instructions: Combine sugar and vermouth in heavy medium skillet. Cook over low heat until sugar dissolves, but does not burn. Add pork and cook over medium high heat, stirring occasionally, until well browned all over. Transfer pork to plate. Add sherry. Cover and let stand 10 minutes. Meanwhile, combine sugar and meat. Cover and marinate 8 hours or overnight. Preheat grill. Remove pork from plate and wipe meat with dampened paper towel. Brush grill rack with cooking oil. Oil racks and cook short ribs on well oiled rack until well browned, 2 minutes per side. Turn. Brush pork with remaining cooking oil. Grill over hot coals 2 minutes per side or until meat thermometer registers 140 degrees. Remove pork from grill and spread on platter. Sprinkle with pistachios and nuts. Cut peach into 2 wedges and serve with meat.

Random Ingredients: vidalia onion,sherry wine,cheese,browning sauce,thai green chili,pepper sauce,anise seed,salsa
title: Easy Mexican Hot Sauce (Salsa Con Queso)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs vidalia onions | 1 can chipotle-garlic prepared salsa | 1 can sliced thai green chili ( optional ) | 1 cup chopped jalapenos or 1 cup red bell pepper | 1/2 cup sherry wine | 1 teaspoon browning sauce or 1 teaspoon chili paste | 1/2 teaspoon hot pepper sauce ( optional )
instructions: Peel and cut vidalia onions into 1/2 inch slices. Place onions, salsa, chili, bell pepper, and a dash of packed browning sauce in crockpot. Pour sherry over everything. Cook on high 5 hours. Stir every once in a while or crockpot after 1 to 1 1/2 hours. Serve with tortilla chips or vegetables.

title: Okra (Okra) Soup
ingredients: 1 lb okra, cut into 1-inch pieces and soaked for 10 minutes in | 1 pint beef stock | 5 ounces double cream | 1 tablespoon dried savory
instructions: Put okra in a pan big enough to hold all ingredients and add beef stock. Bring to boil and simmer for 15 - 20 minutes add seasonings. Add cream just before serving. Serve.

title: Burritos
ingredients: 1 cup bean sprouts | 2 cups crushed ice rolls
instructions: Mash the ice rolls in a bowl, about 125 times. Spread the bean sprouts in the bottom of a glass 2 inches deep.

title: Coconut Rice
ingredients: 1 cup long grain rice | 1/2 cup chopped dried shredded coconut | 1 1/2 teaspoons prepared mustard | 4 beef bouillon cubes
instructions: Combine all ingredients except rice & bouillon in a 3 1/2 qt slow cooker. Cover tightly & cook on low setting for 8 - 10 hours, or until thickest part of fruit is tender & rice is cooked.

Random Ingredients: worcestershire sauce,enchilada sauce,oat,whipping cream,black olive,jalapeno pepper,spaghetti,orange juice
title: Spicy Noodle Sauce
ingredients: 1 jar mild enchilada sauce | 2 cans sliced black olives, drained | 3/4 cup orange juice | 3 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 2 teaspoons minced jalapeno peppers | 5 cups cooked spaghetti | 1/3 cup rolled oats | 3 tablespoons whipping cream
instructions: Combine enchilada sauce, olives, orange juice, worcestershire sauce, jalapeno peppers, and 1 cup cooked spaghetti in a large saucepan. Bring to a boil. Stir in whipping cream. Reduce heat, cover, and simmer 15 to 20 minutes. Stir in remaining cooked ingredients. Cover.

title: Coconut Yam Yams
ingredients: 4 yams, peeled and halved lengthways | 2 small red food coloring | 1 liter low-fat plain soymilk | 1/4 cup coconut milk | 1 teaspoon ground chile
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c. Line a shallow, 2 litre ovenproof frying pan with baking paper or silicone paper. Place the yams in the oven and bake for 15 minutes or until tender. Place the ovenproof pan over a high heat and, with the soymilk and coconut milk, bring to the boil. Add the chives and chache and simmer for 3 - 4 minutes until the sauce has thickened slightly. Remove from the heat and stir into the yams. Serve immediately.

title: Homemade Cranberry Seasoning
ingredients: 1 package dried cranberries, picked over | 1 can chopped green chilies | 2 teaspoons dried fennel | 1 tablespoon hot cajun seasoning
