instructions: Stir dried cranberries, the green chilies and fennel together in a large glass bowl. Add the cajun seasoning.

title: Broccoli and Chips
ingredients: 1 package broccoli, washed and steamed | 1/2 cup crispy tortilla chips ( such as feta ) | 6 tablespoons diet margarine | 2 teaspoons reduced-calorie margarine | 1/4 cup hard-boiled egg, sliced
instructions: Cut broccoli into small florets and steam for 5 minutes. Place tortilla chips on a plate. Top with 1/2 of the fried broccoli. Melt 1/4 cup margarine over a low heat in a small saucepan. Break egg into a small bowl. Dip eggs into egg yolk and set aside. Heat remaining 1/4 cup margarine in a small skillet over medium high heat. Add broccoli florets and stir fry for 5 minutes or until crisp tender. Serve broccoli with hot tortilla chips.

title: Alfredo
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds ground sirloin | 3 cans mushroom stems and pieces, drained | 3 cans small peas, drained | 1 package shredded mozzarella cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Brown ground beef, mushroom stems, peas, and shredded cheese in a large pot using a paper towel. Stir until melted, then pour into a 9x13 inch baking dish. Cover with aluminum foil, and bake in the preheated oven for 45 minutes. Uncover, and continue to bake until bubbly, and a toothpick inserted into the center of a serving dish comes out clean, 30 to 40 minutes more.

title: Easy Avocado Guacamole
ingredients: 2 medium avocados | 1/2 cup spanish onion, chopped
instructions: Using a fork, mash 1 avocado in a bowl. Stir in the chopped onion and continue to mash until evenly blended, about 2 minutes. Serve imediately with a tortilla chip.

title: Guacamole
ingredients: 1 small avocados or 1 small other slightly soft ripe avocado | 1 teaspoon vanilla bean | 1/2 teaspoon sea scallions, finely minced or minced | pam cooking spray
instructions: Combine avocado, vanilla bean, and sea scallions in a small bowl. Spray pam on a non stick frying pan. Heat over high heat and spray pam with cooking spray. Serve with tortilla chips, as for chips or as for chips with assorted garnishes.

title: Seared Poblano
ingredients: 6 poblano peppers | 1/4 cup white peppercorns | 1 cup pineapple juice
instructions: Preheat the broiler or grill. Cut poblano peppers crosswise into thin strips about 1 inch wide. Transfer the poblanos to a food processor fitted with 2 slicing blades. Pulse the poblanos until they are ground into a coarse powder, but not quite a powder. Add the peppercorns and pulse until finely ground. Add the pineapple juice, pulsing to create a smooth sauce. Sear poblanos on the grill, until charred, turning constantly. This should take less than 5 - 8 minutes. The pimano can also be cooked over the stove top on a low flame.

title: Mustard Pasta
ingredients: 3 lbs linguine, fresh | 2 tablespoons dark brown sugar | 1 tablespoon black mustard seeds
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add the pasta and cook 3 to 4 minutes or until al dente.

Random Ingredients: apple,green bell pepper,tortilla,lime leaf,yellow squash,dark soy sauce,vegetable oil,sunflower seed oil
title: Tortillas With   Veggies(Veggies)
ingredients: 8 ounces tortillas | 1 large yellow squash, grated or 1 large red bell pepper, chopped | 2 green bell peppers, chopped | 2 medium apples, chopped | 1/2 cup sunflower seed oil | 1 1/2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 4 fresh lime leaves | 1 cup dark soy sauce | 1/4 cup dark soy sauce
instructions: Put some oil in a pan and then heat up the oil. Mix in the chillies, soy sauces, green chilies, and apples. Add the veggies and mix well. Warm the tortillas. Heat the oil in a skillet and add one side of the tortilla which should be slightly flattened,. Put this one in the skillet and then turn over. Cook till light brown. You may have to put the finished side on top of the tortilla. Repeat it steps 4 to 5 until all the tortillas are grilled. Spread the sesame seeds on a plate and arrange the veggie slices on top. Then drizzle the soy sauce on top. Garnish with a sprinkle of cashew nuts. Serve.

title: Bunjab Red Pepper Jelly
ingredients: 2 lbs red bell peppers | 1 lb jaggery
instructions: Wash the peppers. Remove their stem and seeds. Slit the peppers with sharp knife, removing all the seeds, and make a slit lengthwise down the pepper. Cut the peppers into half again, removing all the pulp. Put in a clean jam jar fitted with the lid. Grate the ginger and mix with cold water to make a thin paste. Stir in the sugar and pour over the peppers. Cover with lid or a plate and refrigerate for 8 hours before using. It will keep for up to a week, refrigerated.

Random Ingredients: bell pepper,egg white,cranberry juice,ancho chile,onion powder,raspberry jam,red pepper,rice wine
title: Mexican Raspberry Peach Breakfast
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups rice wine | 3/4 cup red wine or 3/4 cup apple cider | 1/4 cup raspberry jam | 1 teaspoon ground ancho chile | 1 teaspoon onion powder | 1 large egg white | 1/2 cup finely chopped bell pepper ( red or yellow ) | 1/4 cup chopped red pepper ( red or yellow )
instructions: Make sure everything is mixed together and chill for at least 1 hour. Heat a large nonstick griddle or skillet over med high for 1 - 2 minutes. Place egg whites in a large shallow bowl. Using a rubber spatula, dip the egg whites into the wine and vinegar reduction. Stir until whites are completely absorbed and the egg whites are completely cool. Fold in the peppers and then the red peppers. Spoon mixture into a parchment paper lined 15 x10 x1/2 jelly roll pan. Freeze overnight or until firm, serving.

Random Ingredients: ancho chile powder,chili flake,olive,barbecue sauce,cumin powder,chili powder,vanilla ice cream
title: Homemade Ancho Smoked Beer Can Ice Cream
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon dried ancho chile powder | 1/2 teaspoon cumin powder | 1/2 teaspoon chili flakes | 1/2 teaspoon dried chili flakes | 1/4 teaspoon unsweetened light-colored barbecue sauce | 1/4 teaspoon bertolli extra light chili flakes | 1 tablespoon light-colored sweet barbecue sauce | 1/8 cup olive, sliced | vanilla ice cream
instructions: Make seasoning, combine all ingredients in small bowl. Store in airtight container at cool room temperature or in refrigerator. Make ice cream, in medium saucepan over medium heat add 3 tablespoons of olive oil.

title: Tunisian Batter
ingredients: 2 1/4 teaspoons active dry yeast | 2 1/2 cups tomato sauce | 1/2 cup chili paste | 1 teaspoon dried rosemary
instructions: In a small bowl, dissolve yeast in warm water. Let stand 10 minutes, or until creamy and a little frothy. Mix in tomato sauce, chili paste, and rosemary. Cover bowl with a cloth and let stand for 30 minutes.

title: Smooth Spinach and Yoghurt Salad with Quinoa
ingredients: 1/2 cup quinoa | 1/2 cup broccoli, cut into 1 inch pieces | 1/4 cup spanish olives, coarsely chopped | 2 teaspoons dried orange peel | 1/2 cup chopped spinach | 3 slices rye bread, toasted
instructions: Place quinoa in a 3 qt shallow baking dish. Bring 5 cups water to boiling in a medium saucepan over high heat. Reduce heat to medium and add quinoa. Cover and cook, shaking the pan occasionally, until quinoa is tender and liquid is absorbed, 10 to 12 minutes. Bring 3 cups water to boiling in a medium saucepan. Add broccoli and olives. Cover and cook over medium high heat, stirring often, until broccoli is crisp tender, about 5 minutes. Drain.

title: Giant Phyllo-Wrapped Oliveoni
ingredients: 6 tablespoons coarsely chopped fresh mint leaves | 5 teaspoons finely chopped pimiento | 2 teaspoons coarsely chopped fresh cracked black pepper | 2 cans refrigerated ladyfingers, unwrapped | 1 jar imported pepper-infused lima pimento, in jar | 1 package frozen farfalle pasta, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 °f. Place pepperinfused pimento in small shallow bowl in microwave oven for 30 second intervals, stirring to coat pimentos. Remove from microwave oven.

title: Sweet Bean Patties
ingredients: 1 can pineapple chunks, drained | 1/4 cup finely chopped button mushroom | 1/3 cup canned bean slices, drained | 1/2 teaspoon chili powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. In a large bowl, toss the pineapple with the mushrooms, bean slices and chili powder. Place equal amounts of the pineapple mixture onto a sheet of parchment paper. Bake for 8 minutess, turning after 5 minute.

title: Thai Grilled Fish
ingredients: 12 ounces fish sauce | 2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa | 2 tablespoons cinnamon
instructions: Mix all ingredients and pour over fish.

Random Ingredients: bok choy,cornflour,garlic salt,maple syrup,beef brisket,cauliflower,rum extract,balsamic vinegar
title: Maple Corn Glazed Corned Beef or Pork Brisket
ingredients: 3 lbs boneless beef brisket, trimmed of excess fat or 3 lbs pork brisket | 2 tablespoons maple syrup | 2 tablespoons aged balsamic vinegar | 1 tablespoon rum extract | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt | 4 heads bok choy, trimmed and cut into 2-5 serving size pieces | 1 cup cauliflower, broken into florets | 1 tablespoon cornflour or 1 tablespoon cornstarch
instructions: Preheat oven to 275 degrees. Place brisket in a roasting pan, and add enough water to just submerge. Add remaining ingredients to the pan. Bring to a boil, then lower to a gentle simmer. Cover, and roast for 2 hours. Remove brisket from the roasting pan, strain if desired, and discard the vegetables. Cover, and roast again for another hour or until the roast reaches an internal temperature of 120 degrees in the thickest part of the meat. Let the brisket rest for 10 minutes before slicing.

Random Ingredients: arborio rice,swiss cheese,beef bouillon granule,dill pickle,molasses,cumin,chile pepper,dark chocolate
title: Chile Risotto con Chocolate
ingredients: 1 cup arborio rice | 1 pound ground sirloin or ground turkey | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon granules | 3 chile peppers, finely chopped, or to taste | 1 jar dill pickles with liquid | 1/2 cup dark chocolate, grated | 1/2 cup shredded swiss cheese
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add the rice.

Random Ingredients: red chili pepper,garam masala,coconut oil,tomato oil,ghee
title: Indian Spiced Tomato and Coconut (Charcoal) Fry
ingredients: 1 kg small red chili pepper | 10 cm piece coconut oil | 2 teaspoons garam masala | 4 tablespoons ghee | 14 tomatoes in oil
instructions: Wash chili and dry completely dry with cloth or paper towel. Cut chili into thin slivers. Heat a wok or a frying pan with 2 tbsp oil with the chilli and coconut oil. When the oil is hot add the tomato flesh and the garam masala and stir fry for 2 - 3 mins. Add the chili and coconut slivers. Continue to stir fry for 2 more mins and then turn off the heat. Cover tightly and leave for 15 mins to chill. Serve with naan bread or steamed white rice.

title: Ground Beef Phyllo
ingredients: 3 cups low sodium beef broth | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder | 2 sheets phyllo dough | 1/4 cup chopped onion | 2 tablespoons whole wheat flour
instructions: Preheat your oven to 350°f. In the bottom of a large, deep non stick skillet, mix the beef broth, turmeric and onion and pour this into the skillet. Cover and cook, stirring occasionally, with the lid ajar, for 1 hour, or until the beef is tender. Let cool. Meanwhile, cut phyllo sheets in half lengthwise. Brush a baking sheet with oil. Lay one half sheet into a wide, shallow bowl with the beef mixture and carefully separate the half sheet as you work. Use the other half of the sheet to cut a small piece off the top of the phyllo dough in the center, and put that on the bottom left hand side of the skillet. Carefully peel the first piece of phyllo and put it down flat, but keeping all the pieces covered. Take the phyllo and place it on two of the other sheets. Now using a pastry brush, cover the phyllo with a little water, then with some more water, as necessary, letting it soak for about 2 minutes. Take the two sheets of phyllo and brush them with oil and water, and lay them one after another on top of one another, using a rolling pin. Turn the phyllo over when you have worked the dough into a rectangle shape about 1/2 thick. Repeat. Brush the top with oil and cut a slit in the phyllo. Repeat with the other two sheets of phyllo, then turn on baking pan. Cut the Phyllo stack into triangles and arrange them across the pan so you have two smaller strips of dough hanging from the outside of the pan. The phyllo should be just barely touching each other at this point. Bake in the preheated oven for about 20 minutes, or until the phyllo is puffed up and crisp.

title: Nigella's Mexican Quesadilla
ingredients: 12 corn tortilla strips | 1 teaspoon nigella seeds | 1 -2 teaspoon spicy mustard
instructions: Spread one side of tortilla with mustard. Spread 1 - 2 tsp of nigella in the middle of the tortilla. Fold tortilla over it, fold and finish rolling up. Repeat till tortillas are gone. Serve with any mexican/spicy combination of your own tastes enjoy.

Random Ingredients: vegetable broth,sherry wine,chickpea flour,chicken stock powder
title: Quick Pasta Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons chickpea flour | 1 cup vegetable broth or 1 cup chicken stock powder | 1/4 cup sherry wine | 1 tablespoon chicken stock powder ( or 1 tablespoon tomato paste )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a saucepan and heat through.

title: Toast Hawaii
ingredients: 8 hoagie rolls, split lengthwise | 1/2 egg white, beaten | 1 teaspoon tamari
instructions: Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Brush the top side of each slice of bread with the egg white and spread with the tamari.

title: Beef and Roasted Celery Roll-Up
ingredients: 1 rump steak | 3 tablespoons flour | 1 tablespoon seasoning salt | 1 tablespoon light brown sugar or 1 tablespoon splenda sugar substitute | 300 g celery | 2 tablespoons sunflower oil
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190 degrees celsius trim excess fat and fat from the rump steak. Cut into 4 equal portions, then roll up with 4 pieces of foil as you would a swiss roll. Wrap each piece of roll with 3 tblsp flour. Place the roast on a rack in an oven tray and sprinkle with seasoning salt. Roast for 20 to 30 minutes until light brown, then turn the meat over. Scatter the sugar over, then roast on a higher shelf for a further 20 minutes, till golden and tender to the touch. Cut the celery sticks from the stalk, leaving 1/4 inch of the stalk attached at each end. Discard the stalk. Heat 2tbsp of the oil in a wok or fry pan and fry the celery sticks quickly, taking care not to overcook them. Remove from heat, pour off excess moisture from the wok, and reheat the remaining oil. Roll the beef in the oil, then transfer it to a warm plate. Use a slotted spoon to remove the fat from the wok. Increase the oven temperature to 220 degrees c and place a beef roll on it. Roll the wrap in the flour, tie with string, then place in a warm oven to brown the other side. Transfer the roll to a warm serving plate and keep warm in the oven. Roll out the remaining roll, then cut into thin slices and serve separately with the celery and oil. Note, the rolls can be made without the celery and cheese, but i find the taste of either kind of flavour improves.

title: Chinese Black Pepper Powder
ingredients: 4 cups black peppercorns | 2 cups quick and easy grinding black peppercorns | 1/2 cup cooking oil | 1/2 teaspoon chopped ginger peel
instructions: Prepare the prongs. Using a mortar and pestle, pound the peppercorns until coarsely crushed. Combine the peppercorns with the oil, ginger, and pepper powder. Use 2 tablespoons for each pound of prongs. Store in an airtight container.

title: Garlicky Clams
ingredients: 2 lbs clams | 2 ounces anise seed | 3 tomatoes, peeled seeded and chopped
instructions: Prepare the aniseed by heating 2 oz. Of aniseed slowly in a heavy skillet over medium heat until the fragrance is released. Watch the heat for a moment and carefully add the clams. This will open up the shell immediately from a perforated shell. Add the clams again. Stir once or twice around the shell. Cover and cook over low heat until they open, about 25 - 30 minutes.

title: Mushroom & Sausage Gravy
ingredients: 1 lb hot italian sausage, rinsed and drained | 7 1/2 ounces dried porcini mushrooms | 4 fluid ounces brandy | 1 1/2 pints stock
instructions: Brown the sausage in a frying pan. Add the mushrooms and cook for 5 mins until softened. Add enough stock to just cover the mushrooms. Season with salt. Cover and simmer for 20 mins until all the liquid has reduced. Transfer to a large pan and cook for 30 mins until thick. Serve with noodles of your choice. Note.

Random Ingredients: serrano pepper,tea,sea salt,margarine,watermelon,yellow bell pepper,tart apple
title: Watermelon and Apple Soup
ingredients: 2 cups chopped seedless watermelon | 2 tart apples, cored and chopped | 1/2 yellow bell pepper, chopped | 1/2 fresh serrano pepper, minced | 1/3 cup margarine | 3 tablespoons unsalted margarine | 1 teaspoon sea salt | 4 cups low-fat milk or 4 cups water ( optional )
instructions: Place the watermelon, apples, bell pepper, and chile in a blender and process until smooth. In a large saucepan over medium heat, melt the 1/3 cup plus 1/3 cup margarine. Add the 1 teaspoon salt and the remaining 1/3 cup margarine. Add the watermelon tomato mixture and bring to a simmer. Cover and cook for 20 - 30 minutes or until the watermelon and apples are tender. Remove from heat. Transfer the soup to a blender. Add the 4 cups water if it is too thick. Puree until smooth. Return to the cooking pan, and heat for 15 minutes and remove from the heat. Cover and store in the refrigerator. Makes about 2 cups.

title: Fontina Tomato Breakfast Casserole
ingredients: 16 ounces fontina cheese, shredded | 4 medium ripe tomatoes, sliced | 1 can sliced black olives, drained | 1 can tomato sauce | 1 large egg, lightly beaten | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh thyme
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees farenheit. Spray a 9x13 inch baking dish with nonstick cooking spray. In a medium bowl, combine the fontina, tomatoes, olives and tomato sauce. Spoon about 1/2 cup of the mixture into the bottom of the baking dish. Arrange the egg on top of the fontina mixture. Sprinkle with thyme. Repeat with the remaining ingredients. Bake 30 minutes or until cheese is melted.

Random Ingredients: merlot,liquid honey,yukon gold potato,rice krispies,ginger,dark rum,white potato,active yeast
title: Yukon Gold Sweet Potato, Ginger & Rum Bread
ingredients: 6 cups unpeeled yukon gold potatoes, cut in half lengthwise, cut off and discard skin and seeds | 2 1/2 teaspoons active dry yeast, dissolved in 1/4 cup hot water | 3 cups white potatoes, peeled and cut into medium chunks | 6 cups cooked rice krispies | 1/2 cup dark rum | 1/4 cup liquid honey | 1/2 cup liquid madras ginger | 2 cups store-bought jerk dark rum
instructions: In a large bowl, mix 4 cups cold water with the yeast. Add the potatoes, rice krispies, 1/4 cup rum, sweetener, honey and ginger. Drain the potatoes, rinse well and pat dry. Let stand, covered, in a warm place for at least 2 hours or up to 1 day. Butter a 5 x 6 inch jelly roll pan and line with parchment paper. Stir the potatoes and marinade into the bowl of the bowl, add the rum and knead on low speed until the dough comes together, about 5 minutes. The dough will appear crumbly and somewhat sticky, but should have a very smooth texture after approximately 2 minutes. Scrape the dough onto the prepared pan. Cover with a clean, damp towel or kitchen towel and let rise until doubled in size, up to 45 minutes. Bake the bread in a 400 degree f oven for 45 minutes, or until the top of the bread is just beginning to brown.

title: Beef 'n Squid Bake
ingredients: 1 1 lb lean sirloin steaks, cut into bite-size pieces | 1 head chinese cabbage, cut into bite-size pieces | 1 can cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 1/4 cup light sour cream | 2 tablespoons fresh minced garlic
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Heat a nonstick skillet on medium high heat. Add beef and saute 5 to 10 minutes or until golden brown, stirring frequently. Remove beef from skillet.

title: The Ultimate Mexican Rice for One
ingredients: 1 cup mexican rice | 2 tablespoons orange liqueur
instructions: Follow the directions for the bag of mexican rice. Once the bag is cool, cut it into 1/4 inch wide julienne slices. Place in a dish and set aside. Bring the bottom of a large pot of water to a boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, stir in the mexican rice and return to a boil. Cook uncovered for 15 minutes, then remove from heat. Stir in the orange liqueur until combined, and cover to keep warm until serving. Once the mexican rice is completely absorbed by the rice, use your hand to gently pull the grains apart into grainy pieces. Serve the rice mixture in a ring, mounded onto plates, and sprinkled with more mexican flavored toppings.

Random Ingredients: green pea,part ricotta cheese,celery,extra virgin olive oil
title: Green Pea, Ricotta and Celery Cheese Pasta
ingredients: 12 ounces part-skim ricotta cheese | 3/4 cup frozen green peas, thawed | 2 tablespoons celery, chopped | 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Rinse the spinach under cold running water and drain briefly, then place in a mixing bowl and refrigerate for a few hours or overnight. Place the rinsed and dried pasta in a large pot with plenty of water to cover. Bring to a boil over high heat, and then reduce the heat to medium. Check the pasta for doneness, if it is still slightly firm, cook for a couple of minutes longer. Stir in the peas, and sprinkle the top with salt, if using. Cook for about 3 minutes before draining the pasta. Remove the vegetables from the water with a slotted spoon, keeping them warm in the oven.

title: Shorter Hash Brown Potatoes
ingredients: 5 medium baking potatoes | 1 tablespoon dry sherry ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400f degrees. Cut potatoes into rounds or rounds approx 3cmx3cm in thickness then arrange over a baking paper lined baking sheet. In a small bowl, mix together sherry and dry sherry, if using stir into potatoes, then bake at 400f degrees for 20 - 25 minutes, until golden brown and crispy, brushing with warm sherry during the cooking if desired.

Random Ingredients: black bean,egg noodle,cottage cheese,broccoli rabe,mustard powder,tamari
title: Bean and Broccoli Noodle Salad
ingredients: 3 ounces dried black beans | 1/2 cup broccoli rabe, chopped | 7 ounces small egg noodles | 3/4 cup low fat cottage cheese | 1/4 cup tamari | 1 1/2 teaspoons mustard powder
instructions: Drain and rinse black beans. Cook, rinse, drain and cut up your bean mixture. Cook noodles according to package instructions, drain and cool. Combine the noodles, bean mixture and cottage cheese in a large bowl. Add the mustard. Before serving, add tamari and toss.

title: Chinese Water Chestnut Pillsbury
ingredients: 1 can water chestnuts, drained & cut into thin pieces | 1 can pillsbury best & reg ; original stretching & seasoning mix | 1 pinch fresh ground black pepper
instructions: Pre heat oven to 400 degrees. Open the can of water chestnuts and drain the juice into a medium size bowl. Add the pillsbury stromboli mix & pepper & mix well. Open the can of water chestnuts & drain the juice mixture into small bowl until you have a nice liquid measure. This means you are adding water, not butter or milk. You don't have to drain the liquid back into the bowl. Put your clean saucepan over medium high heat & add a small amount of your saved strained liquid & mix well till thick. Pour the liquid into a glass 9 x13 baking dish or cookie sheet. Spray pillsbury® reg with non stick spray & let cool for 1 hour. Then drizzle your reserved liquid over your rice bubbles. This step is not included in the recipe but it is optional.

title: Spaghettini (Asparagus and Green Beans Pizza Appetizer)
ingredients: 1 cup shredded asparagus | 6 ounces fresh green beans, trimmed and halved diagonally | 2 ounces bottled pizza crust dough ( storebought or homemade )
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Spray a 12 cup pizza pan with cooking spray or grease or line it with parchment paper. In a medium size saucepan, saute asparagus and green beans in 1 tbs of oil over medium heat for 4 - 6 minutes stirring occasionally so as not to let them brown. Reserve. Turn off heat. Spread the pizza crust dough thin and evenly with the asparagus and green bean mixture. Top with remaining dough, sealing edges to create an even surface. Use the back of a fork or sharp knife to score top crust. Poke holes in top of crust with a fork, place on prepared pizza pan and bake for 15 - 20 minutes or until crust is well browned. Transfer to a cutting board and slice into six wedges.

title: Beef and Pineapple Sandwiches on the Half Shell
ingredients: 2 lbs flank steaks ( or other round steak, such as chuck steak ) | 1/2 cup cornstarch | 1 cup pineapple juice | 1 tablespoon prepared beef base, dissolved in | 1 tablespoon water | 12 slices sourdough bread, toasted on both sides
instructions: Lay flank steak on rack in broiler pan. Place pan on broiler element. Broil 5 - 6 inches from heat 5 - 6 minutes on each side or until internal meat temperature reaches 160 f. Remove from oven. Cut steak diagonally across grain in 1/2 thick slices. In medium bowl, blend cornstarch until dissolved. Stir in pineapple juice, beef base and water.

title: Broccamis
ingredients: 3 lbs red potatoes, cut in 1/2 inch chunks | 3 heads broccoli, cut in 1 inch florets | 1 egg white | 1/2 cup brown sugar
instructions: Steam and boil the potatoes for 9 minutes or till tender, then drain. Steam the broccoli and potatoes for 5 minutes. Cool and chop. Beat the egg white with the sugar till frothy. Fold in the chopped potatoes. Add the broccoli and vegetables. Mix carefully so broccoli and potato coat everything well. Serve it with french bread or crusty bread.

Random Ingredients: gruyere cheese,new potato,ricotta cheese,blueberry,yellow bell pepper,apple,oregano leaf,bell pepper
title: Grilled Cheese and Potato Gratin
ingredients: 4 new potatoes, boiled and sliced | 6 ounces gruyere cheese, thinly sliced | 1 large bell pepper, sliced | 1 large yellow bell pepper, sliced | 1/4 lb baby gruyere cheese, sliced | 1 1/2 cups baby spinach or 1 1/2 cups fresh spinach | 1/2 cup ricotta cheese, well drained | 4 fresh oregano leaves, chopped ( or 1 tsp dried )
instructions: In a baking dish combine potatoes, cheeses, peppers, and spinach. Sprinkle with oregano and salt and pepper to taste. Preheat grill. Place gratin dish on grill and grill grates. To make roman cheese blend all ingredients, blend well. Serve hot.

title: Vegetarian Black-Eyed Pea Soup
ingredients: 3 1/2 cups black-eyed peas, picked and cooked | 2 egg yolks | 2 cups cooked rice
instructions: Boil milk and black eyed peas in 2 cups water for 20 minutes. In a small bowl beat the egg yolks. Pour into soup pan with black eyed peas and simmer covered for 15 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Baked Clam Balls
ingredients: 3 pounds minced beef | 1 cup bread crumbs | 2 cans crushed pineapple with juice | 1 jar capers | 12 littleneck clams, scrubbed
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Place the ground beef in a large, deep skillet. Add the bread crumbs and mix well. Press the hamburger into the bread crumbs so it is evenly moistened. Mix in the pineapple and capers. Drain the littls and gently tear them into large pieces. Roll between fingers until all pieces are coated with crumb mixture. Transfer the pieces to a roasting pan. Insert a clam into each clam. Place under the broiler until browned, about 3 minutes. Sprinkle with additional bread crumbs.

Random Ingredients: black cumin seed,cilantro stem,maraschino cherry,white rice,rocket
title: Cousin June's Rice Croutons
ingredients: 100 g rocket or 100 g arugula | 1/2 cup parboiled white rice | 1 tablespoon black cumin seeds or 1 tablespoon ground cumin | 6 tablespoons chopped cilantro stems | maraschino cherry, to garnish
instructions: Wash the rice with some cold water. Break the rice gently with your fingers. Put the pieces of rice in a colander to collect their juices. Add a pinch of salt. Drain. Rinse the rice. Sprinkle a little freshly ground black cumin between the leaves and add it to the grains. Wrap a leafy piece of rocket or arugula in a loose piece of cheesecloth, tie tightly with cotton thread, remove excess moisture and place gently in a shallow pan in a single layer without any weight. Add the rice to the pan. Using a wooden spoon, fold the rice over in the sides. Sprinkle over some freshly ground black cumin. Drain the lettuce leaves and serve, garnished with maraschino cherries. Variation. Substitute, 3/4 cup white rice, 2 tbsps. Chopped walnuts or cashews of choice. Garnish with a few maraschino cherry.

title: Mango Lime Grilled Watermelon Wedges
ingredients: 1/3 cup watermelon, in cubes | 1/4 cup tamari | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 3 cups shredded mango ( from 10-oz. jar )
instructions: Prepare grill. Remove stems and seeds from watermelon. Slice fruit into 16 wedges, leaving peel on, 1/4 inch thick. Toss wedges with tamari in shallow baking dish. Sprinkle bread well with baking soda. Cover and let stand 1 hour or refrigerate 30 minutes. Grill wedges over medium heat until marked on browned side and tender throughout, about 7 minutes or transfer to serving dish wedges. Serve warm.

title: Lettuce-Potatoes French
ingredients: 1 baguette | 1 package yellow potatoes | sliced lettuce
instructions: Cut baguette in half lengthwise, and hollow out the middle. Arrange the potato slices in a large square of aluminum foil. Split open and place sliced slices in microwave. Cook for 35 to 45 secs until tender and starting to turn brown. To serve, place baguette slices in a serving bowl on a plate. Top with lettuce.

Random Ingredients: taco flour tortilla,red chili pepper,thyme leaf
title: Quick and Easy Fajitas
ingredients: 2 - 2 1/2 cups taco-size flour tortillas | 3/4 cup finely chopped fresh thyme leaves | 1 dried red chili pepper, seeded, minced ( more or less to taste )
instructions: In a bowl mix together thyme, chili pepper, and taco seasoning mix thoroughly. Set aside. Heat your comal or comal iron. While heating up your pan, lightly grease it with oil, a small amount of taco seasoning, and a couple of tbls. Of water if necessary. Brush one side of each tortilla with water. Cook about 5 minutes, or until tortilla's browned. Carefully drop in desired amounts of the fajitas, and sprinkle with your desired amount of taco seasoning. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: irish cream,greek seasoning,sage,red bell pepper,dark sesame oil,broccoli
title: Simple Broccoli & Red Pepper Salad
ingredients: 4 heads broccoli | 3 red bell peppers, cut into thin strips | 1/4 cup irish cream | 1 tablespoon of dark sesame oil | 1 tablespoon dried sage | 1 teaspoon all purpose greek seasoning
instructions: Wash the broccoli, remove the woody stem and blanch the broccoli in boiling water for 3 minutes. Drain the well and set aside to cool slightly. Cut into long thin florets. While the broccoli is cooking, in a bowl stir together the cream, sesame oil, sage, and greek seasoning. Toss the broccoli with the dressing. Serve immediately or refrigerate. The broccoli dressing can be frozen.

title: Cajun Spaghetti
ingredients: 1 package uncooked spaghetti | 3 cups mesclun noodles ( may also use other salad-sized pasta shapes, broken into individual serving pieces ) | 1 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste | 2 1/2 teaspoons italian seasoning | 2 teaspoons liquid smoke ( optional )
instructions: Cook spaghetti to desired doneness, drain and rinse under cold water. Meanwhile, in a medium bowl, toss uncooked spaghetti with seasonings. Transfer the hot spaghetti to a large salad bowl and toss with the italian spice mix. Serve hot.

title: Lighter Chicken Nachos
ingredients: 4 bone-in chicken breast halves | 1/4 cup chopped chili | 1 cup shredded cajun ranch-style processed cheese blend | 1/4 cup half-and-half ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Place chicken breasts in a shallow 2 quart baking dish. Sprinkle with chili and top with the shredded cheese. Bake in preheated oven until hot and bubbly, about 20 minutes.

title: Crab Salad
ingredients: 1 lb crabmeat | 2 teaspoons cream of tartar | 1/2 teaspoon lawry seasoning salt | 2 teaspoons rice vinegar | 1 dash thyme
instructions: Mix salad ingredients together in a bowl. Add more cream of tartar and seasoning salt and/or vinegar and serve on a nice crisp lettuce.

Random Ingredients: granny smith apple,garlic pepper seasoning,fine noodle,margarine,savoy cabbage
title: Sausage and Savoy Cabbage
ingredients: 1 package fine noodles | 3/4 cup margarine | 1 package chopped savoy cabbage | 2 medium granny smith apples, cored and finely chopped | 1 1/2 teaspoons garlic pepper seasoning
instructions: In a large frypan, melt margarine, and saute cabbage and apples until tender. Stir in garlic pepper and season with salt. Bring to boiling, then reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes. Serve as part of a meal.

Random Ingredients: kalamata olive,beef stew meat,cold water,garlic,cabbage,french bread,red curry paste
title: Easy Beef and Olive Stew
ingredients: 1 lb beef stew meat, cut in 1 inch pieces | 3 tablespoons kalamata olives, pitted and chopped ( i like a lot ) | 1 cup shredded cabbage | 2 teaspoons garlic, minced | 2 teaspoons red curry paste | 4 tablespoons kalamata olives, sliced | 2 tablespoons cold water | 2 teaspoons french bread, cut into quarters
instructions: In a heavy nonstick skillet, over medium heat, cook meat for 5 minutes or until brown. Mix in remaining ingredients except french bread. Bring to boil.

Random Ingredients: black vinegar,chocolate,chunky salsa,hot paprika,chili oil,cinnamon bark,olive,purple onion
title: Spicy Mexican Chocolate
ingredients: 3 ounces semisweet chocolate | 1/3 cup chili oil | 3 teaspoons unsweetened dried purple onions, minced | 1 1/2 teaspoons hot paprika | 1 1/4 teaspoons hot cinnamon bark | 1 teaspoon black vinegar | 1 teaspoon chunky salsa ( recommended ) | 1 teaspoon chicharrones mori cilantro chopped ( optional )
instructions: In a heavy saucepan, melt the chocolate over high heat in the oil. Stir in the onion and sauté about 2 minutes. Stir in the spices and remove from heat. Stir in the salsa and cilantro, if desired. Serve warm or cool.

Random Ingredients: white flour,lemon juice,cream cheese,green olive,pork roast
title: Cuban Pork
ingredients: 18 ounces cream cheese ( room temperature ) | 12 ounces pork roast ( cubed ) | 8 ounces green olives ( sliced ) | 1 tablespoon lemon juice | 1/2 cup white flour or 1/2 cup brown rice flour
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Roll into long strips and cook on med hi heat until done. Great served with sour cream or guacamole.

title: Homemade Vanilla Ice Cream (Swedish for South Africa)
ingredients: 1 lb cooking oats ( about 8 ounces ) | 1 pinch each vanilla | chili
instructions: Mix together. Pour into your popsicle trays. Allow to dry on the countertop for 7 days, then store in a freezer container. When ready to eat, scoop out from freezer with a spoon and pour into popsicle trays. You're scooping ice cream into a bowl and straining the liquid into another bowl, then discarding solids. Repeat process until all frozen ingredients are used.

title: Spaghetti in the Slow Cooker
ingredients: 2 cans campbell's tomato soup ( i.e. basic tomato soup can ) | 2 cans diced mild red chilies, undrained | 2 cans canned tomato puree
instructions: Combine all ingredients into the slow cooker and stir well. Cook on high for 1 - 2 hours. This is good served over cooked spaghetti. Delicious.

Random Ingredients: fish fillet,blue cheese,marinara sauce,seasoning salt,tomato green chilies,heavy cream
title: Blue Cheese and Tomato Fish
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs fish fillets, cut into strips | 2 cans diced tomatoes with green chilies, undrained | 1/2 cup fish stock or 1/2 cup fish stock | 2 1/2 tablespoons heavy cream | 1 -2 tablespoon seasoning salt | 2 -3 tablespoons sliced blue cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. In a 13 x 9 x 2 inch baking dish, combine the fish, tomatoes, broth, cream, salt and pepper. Cover dish. Bake uncovered for 40 - 45 minutes till fish is cooked. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake uncovered an additional 3 - 5 minutes to brown cheese.

Random Ingredients: spinach leaf,vanilla cookie crumb,dark sesame oil,grill seasoning,onion powder,lemon zest,spinach,guacamole
title: Spinach Popsicles
ingredients: 20 fresh spinach leaves | 4 slices onions | 1/3 cup shredded cheese-flavored guacamole | 1 tablespoon grated lemon zest | 2 teaspoons grated lemon zest | 3 cups quick-cooking grill seasoning, divided ( spicy or spicy ) | 1 tablespoon dry onion powder | 1/2 teaspoon dark sesame oil | 20 frozen miniature mint balls, each cut in half
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f line 15 muffin cups with paper liners. Wash, stems, and leaves. Slice into 12 even pieces. Place 1 or 2 spinach leaves in each muffin cup. Top with 1 slice of onion and 1 or 2 cheese crumb. Press each of the spinach and onion into bread like crumbs in your fingertips. Repeat with remaining spinach and onion to make 24 patties for each muffin cup. In a medium bowl, mix all remaining ingredients until well blended. Dip each patty into the oil, then press into the bread crumbs to coat. Place on baking sheets with a spatula, then bake at 425f for 25 minutes. Turn patties over and bake for five more minutes.

title: The Daggoo's Russian Salad
ingredients: 500 g fresh spinach leaves | 12 ounces teacups or 12 ounces vodka | 12 ounces worcestershire sauce | 5 ounces vodka | 10 drops worcestershire sauce | 11 ounces teacups or 11 ounces vodka | 14 drops cocoa powder ( optional ) | 14 slices of your favourite fresh rote mushrooms ( optional ) or 14 slices marinated mushrooms ( optional ) | 6 drops of crushed dried sage ( optional )
instructions: Wash the spinach leaves, and cut them in half lengthways. Boil them for 1 minute and drain thoroughly. Drain them completely, and chop into pieces about the size of your palm. Mix the spinach, teacup or vodka, worcestershire sauce, teacups, worcestershire sauce, and worcestershire sauce together in a large bowl. Gently fold the sage into the mixture. Add the mushrooms, if using. Gently fold in the chopped spinach leaves. Chill in the fridge for 20 minutes before serving.

title: Noodles with Snow Peas & Veggies
ingredients: 1 package snow peas | 1 yellow pepper, diced
instructions: Place snow peas in a steamer basket over boiling water. Bake, covered, for 4 minutes. Drain. Meanwhile, place pepper in a microwave bowl. Pour hot water over. Cover and microwave on high 5 minutes, or until tender and bright green.

Random Ingredients: cayenne pepper,chickpea flour,nutmeg,nori,cooking oil,korean chile paste,lettuce
title: Spicy Fried Onigiri
ingredients: 2 cups cooked chickpea flour ( available at asian specialty stores ) | 1 tablespoon cooking oil | 3 tablespoons nori, seaweed sheets | 3 tablespoons shredded lettuce | 3 teaspoons korean chile paste ( gochujang ) | 1/4 teaspoon grated nutmeg | 1 pinch cayenne pepper
instructions: In a small mixing bowl, combine the chickpea flour and 1 t water. Cover and refrigerate dough for 6 hours or overnight. Heat oil in a frying pan on medium heat. Remove any dough from the refrigerator. Roll the dough into 12 even cylinders about 3/4 inch wide. Using a rolling pin, roll out dough to a thickness of about 1/8 inch. Lay the rolled disks on the cutting board. When all 6 disks are rolled out, cut each disk into 2 or 3 slices. Repeat with remaining dough until all disks have been sliced into 1/4 inch wide sticks. Sprinkle each of the cut disks with the nori. Arrange strips of nori on a plate. Place 1 to 2 tablespoons of the shredded lettuce on top of the nori. Sprinkle cheese on top of lettuce. Garnish with the chile paste, nutmeg and pinch of cayenne pepper. Enjoy the extra spicyness of korean chile paste, which can be purchased at Asian specialty stores and/or can be found in rice wine or small foreign markets.

Random Ingredients: brussels sprout,poblano chile,garlic clove,chicken soup base,baharat,sea salt,italian bread,white wine vinegar
title: Garlicky Brussels Sprouts With Sweet Wine Vinaigrette
ingredients: 1 lb brussels sprout, cleaned and cut into 2 inch pieces | 4 poblano chiles, seeded and diced ( wear rubber gloves for not letting the skin burn ) | 2/3 cup dry white wine vinegar | 1/4 cup low-sodium instant chicken soup base | 2/3 cup reduced-fat italian bread, such as cholent | 1 teaspoon good baharat ( or 1/2 tbsp salt ) | 1 large garlic clove, minced | 1/4 teaspoon sea salt
instructions: For the brussels sprouts, heat a large pot of salted water to rolling boil. Add the brussels sprouts and boil 10 minutes or just until barely tender when pierced with a knife. Drain and rinse in large bowl under cold water. Drain again. For the sweet wine vinaigrette, stir the vinegar to blend. Add soup base and blend in the bread. Add the garlic, salt and remaining ingredients and stir to blend. Cover and refrigerate until ready to use. For a party party presentation, ladle the brussels sprouts into bowls, drizzle with the sweet wine vinaigrette and serve.

title: Asiago Beer Canning
ingredients: 12 fluid ounces light beer or 12 fluid ounces non-alcoholic beer | 2 cups coarsely grated asiago cheese ( approximately ) | 1/3 cup dried currant | 2 -3 pickled jalapenos
instructions: Pour beer into canning container. Cover and store at room temperature for up to 10 days. After chilling for up to 2 weeks. Remove from canning jars and wipe clean. Place in refrigerator for 2 to 3 days, rearranging the jar periodically to release any liquid. Fill sterilized canning jars with fine asiago cheese, currant and pickled jalapenos, placing the jalapenos on the bottom of the lid as much as possible. Seal with thin rubber bands. Process in boiling water canner for 5 minutes, remove jars, let cool to warm, and store in refridgerator for up to 1 year.

title: Sweet Corn and Cheese Danish
ingredients: 4 cans refrigerated crescent dinner | 1 jar sweetcorn | 1 package cheese, grated ( i use 2-3 kraft kraft cheese ) | 8 fluid ounces white vinegar | 1 bottle cider vinegar | 3 fluid ounces amaretto
instructions: Dough, preheat oven to 350°f. Open cans and pack into a baking dish. Remove the lids and tilt them toward each other so they overlap on the baking dish. Bake uncovered for 45 minutes or until golden on top. Remove from oven. Cool and sprinkle cheese over top of each bowl. Sauce, mix all ingredients in large, nonstick saucepan until well blended. Heat to a boil. Remove from heat and set aside to cool. Unroll crescent dough. Use a large, round cookie cutter. Spread 1/4 of sauce over both doughs, leaving 1/2 inch bare at the edge. Sprinkle with 1 tablespoon cheese. Spread 1/2 of corn mixture over cheese. Sprinkle with 1/2 of cheese. Top with 1/3 of reserved cheese. Repeat, placing filled doughs on top of the cheese and corn. Sprinkle with 1/2 of reserved cheese. Cover with remaining sauce. Place under broiler for a few minutes, but be careful not to burn the bread edges too much. Turn over and broil for 1 to 2 minutes, or until browned. Cut into 4 serving sized slices. Note, if you are using a casserole dish, place in the bottom of a 2 1/2 quart or larger oven safe baking dish. Add 1/2 of the cheese. Top with 1/2 of the corn. Add 1/2 of remaining sauce. Sprinkle with 1/2 of the remaining cheese. Cover with tin foil. Place in preheated oven and bake 25 minutes. Remove foil and bake 15 minutes more. Remove from oven and let cheese brown for 10 minutes.

title: Baby Salad
ingredients: 24 ounces waffles, any flavor ( i use the premade waffle bread but any waffle will do ) | 4 medium carrots | 2 heads romaine lettuce | 4 large free range aubergines
instructions: To toast the waffles, set a heavy frying pan on a burner and toast until lightly browned on the top. Place the waffles on a plate or baking sheet. Spray the waffles on the baking sheet and cook them at 200 degrees c for about 5 minutes. Meanwhile, preheat the oven to 200 degrees celsius. Peel the carrots and cut into 3/4 inch slices. To assemble the salad, place each of the veggies on a plate, with the lettuce on the top. Cut the aubergine into 1/8 rounds and arrange them on top of the veggies. Place the 2 whole free range aubergines on top of the aubergines. Place 3 - 4 slices of the waffle into each bowl and pour over the salad.

Random Ingredients: romano cheese,parsnip,goat cheese,salt pepper,vanilla bean,potato flake,butter
title: Roasted Parsnip Gnocchi and Goat Cheese
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds parsnips, peeled and cut into quarters | 1 cup plain dry potato flakes | 1/2 cup grated romano cheese | 1/2 cup melted butter | 1 large pinch salt and pepper to taste | 1/2 vanilla bean, split lengthwise and scraped | 1/4 cup grated goat cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Grease a 9x9 inch baking dish with olive oil. Place the parsnips in a large pot. Fill with enough water around the parsnips to cover, and add the potatoes. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to medium low. Cover, and simmer 90 minutes. Stir the potatoes occasionally, and season with salt and pepper. Place a small piece of cheese in the palm of your hand, and form into a ball on top of the parsnips. Roll the ball with a fork into a small ball, poke in a couple of small holes in the center, and flatten into a 1/2 inch diameter circle. Brush the gnocchi with the remaining olive oil, season with salt and pepper, sprinkle with a little bit of the romano cheese, and spread the potatoes evenly on top. Sprinkle on a tablespoon of goat cheese, and top with a few pinches of vanilla bean scraped from the scraped out inside. Bake in the preheated oven until the gnocchi is cooked through and the cheese has melted, about 15 minutes.

title: Czech Calamari
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups warm water | 1 1/2 cups bread machine yeast | 1 1/2 pounds squid | 4 pounds hamburger
instructions: In the bread machine pan put the water, yeast, and hamburger. Add the squid. Mix until the squid is covered by its own juices. Push the dough onto the bread cycle, and check to avoid burning your fingers. It should pull out a little easily. Remove to a warm place to rise until doubled. Grease a large baking tray well. Preheat your oven to 425 degrees f. Cut slits across top of the calamari, and place on the prepared baking tray. Cover tightly with a damp cloth cloth, and let rise in a warm place until doubled. Bake in preheated oven until bread is crusty and deep golden brown, about 25 minutes.

title: Swedish Walnut Oil
ingredients: 1 cup walnut oil | 1/2 cup margarine, melted
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Cover and chill for at least 1 hour. Shake bottle with walnut oil every now and again.

title: Golden Nugget's Raisins and Raisins in Orange-Liqueur Sauce
ingredients: 12 golden raisins | 1 cup orange juice, chilled
instructions: Rinse raisins and drain in a plastic colander, letting any excess liquid drain off. Combine raisins and orange juice together in a small bowl. Let stand 1 hour. Bring to room temperature before serving.

title: Spaghetti With Chicken and Beer
ingredients: 1 tablespoon spanish extra-virgin olive oil | 2 1/2 lbs boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 2 anaheim chilies, fresh, seeded and cut into thin strips | 26 ounces spaghetti sauce
instructions: In a saucepan, warm the olive oil over medium high heat. Add the chicken, 1/2 of the chilies, and 1 1/2 cups water.

title: Orange Blossom (Sweet Wine) Substitute
ingredients: 1 cup orange bell pepper, diced ( about 4 small ) | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla sugar | 1 bouillon, granule ( i used knorr )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a medium glass or ceramic bowl. Cover bowl tightly and refrigerate for several days to let flavors develop. Remove and discard the seeds before serving. Serve immediately.

title: Real Irish Beer Bread
ingredients: 2 cups bread flour, all purpose unbleached | 1 teaspoon dried marjoram, crushed | 1 can beef gravy | 1 bottle beer
instructions: Mix flour and marjoram in a mixing bowl. Add gravy and beer. Knead dough lightly. Form into 2 balls. Place on baking sheets. Flatten out until 3/4 inch thick.

Random Ingredients: french bread,jumbo shrimp,mustard,aubergine,prosciutto di parma,mustard powder
title: Stuffed Aubergines
ingredients: 1 small aubergine, halved lengthways | 4 slices prosciutto di parma ( thick slice ) | 2 tablespoons mustard powder ( heaped ) | 1 pinch mustard powder, mixed with | 1 pinch vinegar | 8 ounces raw jumbo shrimp, shelled and de-veined | 3 slices french bread, cut 1in ( diagonally sliced diagonally )
instructions: Preheat the grill. Place the half aubergines lengthways in a heatproof bowl with a little of the mustard. Place the slices of prosciutto di Parma over the aubergines and lightly sprinkle with the mustard powder and vinegar. Leave for 15 - 40 min, depending on how well you like your french to brown and dry. Spoon the shrimp over the top and season with salt and pepper. Grill for 4 - 5 minutes until the cheese bubbles and starts to melt. Slice into rounds and serve on top of the toasted aubergines with a little more mustard.

Random Ingredients: romaine lettuce leaf,beef stew meat,orange peel,baking powder,beet
title: Beet (Or Potato) and Beef Rollups
ingredients: 4 cups romaine lettuce leaves | 4 beets, sliced thin | 1/4 cup orange peel, sliced thin | 1/4 teaspoon baking powder | 1 lb beef stew meat, sliced thin
instructions: Arrange lettuce leaves, beet slices and orange peel in a shallow baking dish. Sprinkle beef with baking powder. Cover and refrigerate overnight or up to 2 days. Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Remove beef from marinade and bake 5 minutes or until meat is no longer pink in centre. Serve on lettuce leaves.

title: Chinese Cashew Chicken Drumsticks (Cashews)
ingredients: 1/2 cup cashews | 1 small cucumbers, peeled | 1 green peppers or 1 red pepper | 1 -2 tablespoon roasted peanuts | 4 -6 large chicken drumsticks | 5 tablespoons tamarind molasses | 10 -15 dry breadcrumbs | 1 tablespoon chile paste
instructions: Mix the peanut, cucumber, peppers, and peanuts just until the mixture is well distributed. Tear off a few large pieces of the chicken and toss with the peanut mixture. Set aside. Roll all the remaining chicken pieces into the mixture and set aside. Mix the tamarind molasses with one tablespoon of water and pour the mixture over the chicken in a large bowl. Toss until the meat is coated with the molasses mixture and add the bread crumbs and chile paste. Toss again until all the chicken is coated with the mixture. The longer you toss the mixture, the more tender the flavors will be. Let sit for 15 minutes. Preheat the oven to 425°f. Line a large baking sheet with parchment paper. Place the chicken pieces on the baking sheet and arrange them in a single layer as many as possible. Bake until the chicken is cooked through and the chicken no longer pink inside, about 25 minutes. To serve, arrange the chicken on a plate with the stuffing showing and spoon some of the tamarind molasses mix into a small dipping bowl and serve. Repeat the process with the remaining chicken. Serve with steamed jasmine rice.

Random Ingredients: beef tenderloin,golden delicious apple,black cardamom pod,mirin,toothpick
title: Japanese Beef Tenderloin Appetizer
ingredients: 1/4 cup mirin or sweet rice wine | 1 lb beef tenderloin, fat trimmed | 8 medium garlic cloves | 10 whole black cardamom pods | 20 toothpicks
instructions: Combine mirin and rice wine and set aside. Trim and mince garlic, leaving just a few whole cloves. Score entire beef at 1/2 inch intervals and insert garlic cloves in the cuts. Set beef in marinade and marinate 1 - 4 hours. Preheat grill and oil the grate lightly. Remove beef and place on grill. Grill until medium rare, turning once or twice, 8 - 10 minutes. Remove all but 1/2 cup of the marinade and set aside. Mash remaining garlic cloves with a mortar and pestle and add 3/4 of the cardamom pod powder. When slightly browned, place the cloves and remaining cardamom in a dish and crush together with pestle. Remove beef from the grill. Cut diagonally in 1 1/2 to 2 inch thick slices, arrange in a single layer on warmed platter with toothpicks. Spoon reserved marinade over meat, arranging toothpicks beside the meat. Serve with rice.

title: Tasty Veggies: Mushrooms
ingredients: 8 large fresh mushrooms, cleaned | 8 chicken bouillon cubes
instructions: Preheated oven to 400 degrees. Using a steamer, steam the mushrooms for 10 minutes, or until you can see they are tender. Move the mushrooms to a bowl with a slotted spoon. Add the bouillon cubes to the top of the mushrooms and mix in. You don't need to use water, though. Bake, covered, in the preheated oven for 25 minutes, or until sauce is thick. Turn off the oven, but leave the oven on.

title: Lebanese Cinnamon Lentils
ingredients: 1 cup lentils | cinnamon, for dusting
instructions: Boil the lentils in plenty of salted water until tender, about 30 minuters, so that the spices don't overpower. Mix with freshly made cinnamon. Serve warm with a dollop or sandwich spread, if using.

Random Ingredients: montreal steak seasoning,scallion,caster sugar,corn syrup,peach,italian salad dressing mix
title: Peach, Scallion and Montreal Steak Salad
ingredients: 500 g ripe peaches, halved and stones removed | 2 tablespoons reduced-fat montreal steak seasoning | 2 tablespoons real unrefined light corn syrup | 2 tablespoons english salad dressing mix | 1 1/2 tablespoons caster sugar | 1 bunch scallion, trimmed and finely chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 190c degrees. Put the peaches in a lightly greased ovenproof dish and season with salt and pepper. Bake for 10 minutes, then remove from oven and place in a large bowl. Add the steak seasoning, corn syrup, salad dressing mix and caster sugar and toss until well incorporated. Add the scallions and place in the oven for a further 7 - 8 minutes until the peaches are tender. Turn off the oven and leave the peaches to sit for 5 minutes until cool. Remove the leaves from the scallions with the kitchen scissors or kitchen scissors and slice into quarters. Mix everything together and pile onto the serving plates with the salad.

title: Hors D'oeuvres (Beetroot Chips)
ingredients: 1 can beets | 1/2 cup tamari ( clear soy sauce )
instructions: Boil beets in water for about 12 to 15 minutes or until tender and drain. Mash the beets in a bowl using a potato masher or the back of a spoon. Remove beets carefully from the water and add to the bowl with the tamari. Add more tamari to thin the sauce if it is too thick. Let sit for about 15 minutes until flavors are blended to your liking. Serve with bagels or raw veggies of your choice.

Random Ingredients: ladyfinger,cream tartar,peasant bread,mint,turkey breast,fish,coconut milk,chili pepper flake
title: Lobcracker-Grilled Vietnamese Chicken Sandwich
ingredients: 4 tablespoons soft cream of tartar | 6 -8 tablespoons coconut milk ( to taste ) | 1 whole duck breasts ( or 1-1/2 kg. chicken breasts, preferably, quartered ) or 1-1/2 kg. boneless pork shoulder ( or 1-1/2 kg. chicken breasts, preferably, quartered ) | 1 teaspoon chili pepper flakes | 2 -6 tablespoons shredded sweetened coconut ( optional ) | 24 soft ladyfingers | mint ( to garnish ) | 24 slices peasant bread, preferably round
instructions: Combine cream of tartar and coconut milk in a small bowl and set aside in the refresher to warm while you prepare the rest of the sandwich. Place the duck breasts or boneless pork shoulder in a plastic bag, add the chili flakes and stir around to coat. Turn the bag to ensure all sides are covered with sauce. Refrigerate for a few hours. Grill for about 6 to 8 minutes per side, turning every 10 or 15 minutes. While meat is marinating, remove the duck from the coconut oil and remove any excess oil. Set aside in the refre to warm. Assemble sandwich with dollops of sweetened coconut. Top with a dollop of soft ladyfingers and a sprinkle of mint. Serve with rice, noodles or as a sandwich with other condiments.

Random Ingredients: asparagus,parsnip,sharp cheddar cheese,apple pie filling,duck,tasso,parma ham
title: German Style Chopped Vegetables (Vegetants)
ingredients: 1 pound asparagus, trimmed | 1 large parma ham, diced | 1 can deli alpine fat-free refried duck | 1 can low-fat apple pie filling | 1/3 pound smoked german tasso, sliced | 1/4 cup chopped fresh parsnip | 1/2 cup shredded sharp cheddar cheese
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil and blanch asparagus for 3 minutes. Drain. Pat asparagus dry. Place ham in a large, deep skillet. Top with sauteed asparagus and sauteed ham. Slice the apple pie filling into 16 slices. Place 1/16 of the sauteed asparagus, ham and apple pie filling into the center of each slice of sauteed asparagus. Roll the asparagus asparagus around the filling. Arrange attractively on a baking sheet and top with cheddar cheese and remaining sauteed asparagus. Bake in the preheated oven, about 20 minutes, or until cheese is melted and asparagus is hot. Watch carefully, as cheese will quickly brown.

title: Simple, Good and Evil Ground Beef Rissoles
ingredients: 1 lb beef chuck | 1 cup panko breadcrumbs | 2 tablespoons rice wine vinegar | 1/4 - 1/2 cup fine quality bittersweet chocolate
instructions: In a bowl, mix the ground chuck, panko, and rice wine vinegar together. Take about a rounded tablespoon of the ground chuck mixture and roll it between your palms into a round shape in the palms of your hands. Then, roll each round into the palm of ground chuck mixture, firmly pressing well with your fingers. When all the beef is used, spread the rissoles into a baking pan lined with parchment paper, top with plastic wrap, cover tightly, and refrigerate for at least 12 hours or as long as overnight, turning the rissoles halfway through, shaking the pan and rotating them after each one. After about 1 1/2 hours, remove the rissoles, unwrap their wrap, set aside to cool, and repeat on the rest of the beef. After chilling, remove plastic wrap. Break the ground chuck into small meatballs. Dry the rissoles on paper towels, and place them on small cookie sheets lined with waxed paper. Let soak at least 15 minutes. Heat oven to 325f. Bake for about 1 hour.

title: Chili Asiago Bites
ingredients: 12 ounces asiago cheese, grated ( about 1 1/2 cups ) | 1/4 - 1/2 cup sweet chili sauce, like chili sauce de arroz
instructions: Process cheese until smooth using a metal spoon, or process in a food processor until finely ground. Transfer the cheese to a bowl and stir in the chili sauce.

title: Chinese Cucumber Chicken
ingredients: 6 chicken thighs | 2 cups chinese cucumbers, cut into wedges | 2 tablespoons cornstarch | 1 -2 cup english cucumber stick, cut into sticks
instructions: Slice the chicken legs into thirds. Coat the chicken pieces with cornstarch. Place in a single layer in a large, nonstick pan, making sure there are no gaps. Cover the pan with a lid. Cook on low heat, stirring almost constantly until the chicken is cooked, around 10 minutes. Meanwhile, cut the english cucumbers into sticks. Scoop out the chicken thighs and the cucumbers from the pan. Set aside the chicken. Add some water to the pan, and cover. Cook for 3 minutes over medium heat until the liquid in the pan begins to run. Turn down to medium and stir, adding water as needed to make a thick gravy.. Serve over a bowl of white rice.

Random Ingredients: garam masala,wheat tortilla,white chocolate,coriander leaf,bay leaf,corn,pine nut
title: Baked Tortilla (Savoury)
ingredients: 1 whole wheat tortilla | 1 piece white chocolate ( i used 70 % cocoa ) | 2 tablespoons coriander leaves | 2 tablespoons pine nuts | 1/2 tablespoon garam masala | 1 teaspoon corn | 1 bay leaf
instructions: Remove excess water from chocolate piece. Microwave in a flat dish for 30 seconds, or until very melted. Remove from microwave and stir in remaining ingredients until well mixed. Place in serving dish. Use as desired.

Random Ingredients: topping,tart apple,celery,red snapper,french bread,bisquick baking mix
title: French Snapper and Cobbler
ingredients: 1 teaspoon dried celery | 1 teaspoon dryed tart apple | 1 lb red snapper ( or any other firm white fish ) | 1 1/2 cups original bisquick reduced-fat baking mix | 1/2 cup french bread ( may use bread crumbs ) | 1 package frozen thawed corn and apple spread
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f mix celery, and apple.

Random Ingredients: triple sec,sun tomato,purple onion,red chili,ancho chile powder,gouda cheese,epazote
title: Smoked Gouda Cheese and Tomato Dip
ingredients: 2 large red chilies, roasted, peeled, seeded, and chopped | 1/2 teaspoon coarsely ground ancho chile powder | 2 -3 dried ancho chiles, stemmed, and seeds removed | 1 -2 tablespoon triple sec | 1 -2 tablespoon chopped fresh epazote ( optional if ancho chiles are unavailable ) or 1 -2 tablespoon fresh cilantro | 4 ounces mild smoke gouda cheese, finely diced | 1 small purple onion, finely chopped
instructions: In a large bowl, stir together chilies, ancho chili powder, ancho chili seeds and epazote.

title: A Kiwi Naan (Hawaiian Sweet Lenten Cheese)
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups nonfat milk | 2 tablespoons molasses | 3 small firm ripe pears, peeled, cored and cut into 1/2-inch dice | 4 cups grated daikon radishes
instructions: Heat milk and molasses in a saucepan over medium high heat until the molasses just starts to bubble. Remove from heat and stir in pears, radishes, and ¼ cup water. Let sit for 5 minutes, then refrigerate until cold, at least 2 hours.

title: Charishma's Tandoori Pear Soup
ingredients: 4 pears | 4 bird's eye chilies | 4 -5 pinches saffron
instructions: Wash pears, remove any stem and peel. Keep them whole and cut them in lengthwise slices. In a pan on medium flame, place the sliced pears and cook for a few minutes, stirring all the time. Remove them from the heat and place it on the tissue paper napkins and keep aside. When all the pears have been sliced, remove them from the oven too. Heat a pressure cooker and spread the saffron powder in it. Add the sliced pears and let them touch it on the bottom of the inner wall in the pressure cooker. Once the mixture is well blended, stir the saffron powder in it. Once its mixed, transfer the cooked pears into the serving bowl containing the saffron infused juice. Serve hot.

title: Tofu and Cranberry Tripe Wrapped in Tofu
ingredients: 12 fresh large tripe | 3 tablespoons white pepper | 1 -2 tablespoon white pepper | 1 large pimento | 1 can solid pack firm tofu | 1 cup small brown sugar | 1/2 cup dried cranberries
instructions: Trim ends from tripe, wash, dry, pat dry, and slice thin at a 3 pound intervals. Mix together white pepper, white pepper, 1/2 the pepper mix. Rub over top and bottom of tripe. Slice pimento on one side of each tripe, remove seeds, and slice into thin slices. Toss tripe in spice mix then set aside. In large skillet, lightly cook tofu. Remove tofu from skillet and drain on paper towels. Arrange 2 pieces of tripe in an overlapping pattern onto a platter. Put the 3 tbs. Of sugar into a small bowl, and mix in the cranberries. Drizzle over the tripe and cranberries and serve.

Random Ingredients: tomato juice,sherry wine vinegar,plum tomato,wheat pita bread,bamboo shoot,balsamic vinegar,romaine lettuce leaf
title: Pita Chips (Or Tortilla Chips)
ingredients: 4 large whole wheat pita bread | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 1 plum tomato, chopped | 1 roma ( plum ) tomato, chopped | 1 can bamboo shoots, sliced | 1 tablespoon sherry wine vinegar | 2 romaine lettuce leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Brush both sides of each pita with balsamic vinegar. Bake in the preheated oven until toasted and lightly browned, about 8 minutes. Place tomato, roma tomato, and bamboo shoots into a bowl. Mix in sherry and vinegar. Remove and discard pita bread from oven. Arrange lettuce leaves on the toasted pita chips. Spoon tomato mixture onto the romaine leaves. Serve immediately. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: cornmeal,green chili pepper,mexican oregano,chocolate chip,rotelle pasta,chili paste,catfish,yellow onion
title: Mexican Catfish Stew
ingredients: 4 catfish | 1 green chili pepper, cut into 2 inch long strips | 1 yellow onion, chopped | 1 container mexican-style stewed tomatoes | 1 teaspoon chili paste or 1 teaspoon minced hot green chili pepper | 1/2 teaspoon dried mexican oregano | 1/4 cup cornmeal | 2/3 cup shredded mexican chocolate chips, divided | 1 1 lb rotelle pasta or 1 lb penne, cooked and drained
instructions: Coat a large nonstick frypan with cooking spray, then add catfish and cook over medium heat, turning once, until no longer pink, and fish flakes easily when tested with a fork, about 5 minutes per side. Stir in chile and onion, then return catfish to frypan, sprinkle with oregano and tomatoes, stir until combined. Combine chili paste or hot green chile, and oregano in a medium bowl. Stir cornmeal into pasta until well mixed. To serve, mound hot pasta in center of serving dish, and top with catfish mixture. Pour broth over all and scatter with 1/2 cup of chile mixture and 1/2 cup of the chocolate chips.

title: Mediterranean Hummus
ingredients: 1 ounce hummus ( homemade or commercial ) | 1 tablespoon fresh sage leaf ( or 1 tsp dried sage leaves )
instructions: Mix well. Spread on the back of a small piece of warm bread. Then spread with olive oil. Sprinkle with sage. Enjoy.

title: Toffee Hot Sauce (Dietetic)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon yellow mustard | 4 teaspoons coffee
instructions: Place the mustard in a jar with a tight fitting lid. Add the coffee and shake until all of the coffee has been absorbed. Place in a jar and keep in a cool, dark place.

title: Hot Mexican Pasta
ingredients: 8 cups tortilla pasta, cooked well | 1/2 cup crushed corn flakes | 1/3 cup hot sauce | 1/2 lime, juice and zest of
instructions: Cook pasta. Add hot sauce and juice zest. Stir until well blended.

Random Ingredients: risotto rice,splenda granular,grape tomato,gingerroot,cilantro,icing sugar,sriracha hot sauce,plain flour
title: Risotto (Risotto With Grape Tomatoes and Ginger) With Sriracha Hot Sauce
ingredients: 300 g risotto rice | 120 g grape tomatoes, peeled | 1 inch gingerroot | 1/2 teaspoon samba ( hot chili sauce ) | 1 tablespoon icing sugar | 1 tablespoon plain flour | 1 tablespoon sriracha hot sauce | 1 tablespoon icing sugar | 2 tablespoons cilantro ( coriander )
instructions: Cook the rice until half cooked. While you're waiting for the rice, grate your ginger very fine in a pestle and mortar. Place the grate onto the rice when you're ready to cook it. Cut the grape tomatoes in half. Pour a small amount of salt onto your work surface. Place the peeled grape tomatoes on that. Keep the rinsed rice nearby. When the water looks boiling, place 1 tablespoon of sriracha hot sauce in a small cup. Add samba to the cup and stir until it's well combined, and drizzle onto the rice. When the samba begins to bubble, add the rice. Keep stirring to mix well. After about one minute, add 1 tablespoon of sambaracha and 1 tablespoon of icing sugar and stir for another minute. Add the remaining sambaracha and 1 tablespoons of icing sugar in a medium sized bowl. Set the bowl aside. When the sambaracha has cooked for about 15 - 30 minutes, tip the contents of the bowl onto a saucer. To serve, put the bowl on a plate and pile the tomatoes on top. Spread a tablespoon of sriracha hot sauce on the tomatoes. Sprinkle a tablespoon of icing sugar on the tomatoes and let everyone dig inches.

title: Rose Water Ramen
ingredients: 1 box instant ramen noodles | 2 -3 tablespoons rose water, to taste
instructions: Open the ramen noodles. Add the desired amount of rose water to your liking. Mix together. Enjoy.

title: Beef Enchilada Soup
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs top quality ground beef | 1 cup shredded cabbage | 1 teaspoon dried rosemary | 3/4 teaspoon crushed star anise, divided | 1 can red enchilada sauce | 1 can fat-free half and half | 3 -5 tablespoons arrowroot ( or cornstarch ) | 1/4 cup chopped fresh italian parsley
instructions: Brown ground beef then drain. Add cabbage, rosemary, one teaspoon anise, enchilada sauce and half cup of the chopped fresh parsley. Simmer 1 hour. Blend cornstarch with 1/4 cup water. Add to soup and simmer for 5 more minutes.

Random Ingredients: pecorino romano cheese,red chili pepper,monterey jack pepper cheese
title: Spicy Queso Dip
ingredients: 1 cup pecorino romano cheese, shredded | 1/2 cup monterey jack pepper cheese, shredded | 6 jalapeno peppers, roasted ( or serrano pepper peppers )
instructions: Combine pecorino romano cheese and monterey jack pepper cheese in a small bowl. Stir in roasted pepper peppers. Melt the mixture in an appropriately sized skillet over low flame. Let it bubble until the color of the pepper crisps.

title: Penne With a Twist
ingredients: 500 g penne pasta, boiled | 2 tablespoons cornflour | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala powder
instructions: Cook all together in a wok using water until the pasta is done.

Random Ingredients: taco seasoning mix,molasses,fruit,pea,nori,marinara sauce,graham cracker crumb,swiss cheese
title: Quick and Easy Fruit Nachos
ingredients: 1 cup frozen peas, thawed | 1/2 cup canned mixed fruit, drained | 1 package taco seasoning mix, divided | 2 cups swiss cheese, shredded | 1/3 cup molasses | 1 1/2 cups marinara sauce | 1/2 cup graham cracker crumbs | sliced nori, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Microwave peas over high heat in microwave, stirring occasionally, until heated through, about 1 minute. Transfer to a bowl, and mix in mixed fruits. Stir in 1 1/2 cups cheese, molasses, and 1/2 cup salsa. Spread 1 tablespoon of cheese mixture in center of each graham cracker.

Random Ingredients: cider,black cardamom pod,picante sauce,ice cube,salmon,grape leaf,baking potato
title: Smoked Grape Leaves
ingredients: 32 large fresh seedless grapes leaves | cracked black cardamom pod | 1/4 cup picante salsa | 1 lb skinless smoked salmon | 3 cups finely chopped baking potatoes | 2 tablespoons cider or 2 tablespoons distilled white vinegar | ice cube
instructions: Soak the grapes leaves in water for 20 minutes or until softened, then squeeze out excess water. Finely dice the salmon and place in a bowl. Add about 1 to 1 1/2 cups of the potatoes and picante salsa and stir well to combine. Divide the mixture between the four grape leaves and place on a greased, rimless baking sheet, spacing evenly. Bake in a preheated 325°f oven for 30 minutes or until crisp and tender. When cool, remove the center of the leaves using a serrated knife. Drain on paper towels and put one leaf of the mixture at a time in the center of a leaf, then roll the leaf around the mixture. Place on paper towels to drain, then repeat the process with the remaining leaves and filling. To serve, run a knife around the edges of warmed grape leaves and place on a plate. Sprinkle top with a small amount of paprika and serve with a light drizzle of the remaining salsa.

title: Potato Chicken Tenders
ingredients: 1 package chicken tenderloins | 14 ounces baking potatoes, scrubbed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Cut chicken tenderloins in to approximately 8 serving sized pieces. Place chicken pieces in a large bowl and cover with water. Refrigerate for 1 hour. Remove chicken from the water and squeeze out the water. Place the chicken pieces in a shallow baking dish. Bake at 400 degrees f for 10 to 12 minutes. Turn each piece over and baste on the same pan as you cooked the chicken pieces in, until they are browned on all sides. Remove from the oven and pour potato on top of each piece of chicken. Return to the oven and bake for 20 more minutes or until potatoes are golden brown and tender.

Random Ingredients: raspberry,baguette,part mozzarella cheese,plain flour,lemon juice zest,butter
title: Raspberry Bruschetta
ingredients: 2 tablespoons butter | 2 tablespoons plain flour | 2 tablespoons lemon juice, freshly squeezed | 1 cup fresh raspberries or 1 cup frozen raspberries | 1 baguette | 2/3 cup part-skim mozzarella cheese or 2/3 cup grated oaxaca cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c / 400°f. In a small saucer, mix butter or margarine and flour until combined. Add lemon juice. Spread butter/flour mixture over bread and top with raspberries. Top with grated cheese. Bake in oven or grill until cheese is golden.

Random Ingredients: celery rib,black eyed pea,flat leaf parsley,cognac,kaffir lime leaf,sesame oil
title: Black-Eyed Peas a la Kål
ingredients: 1 can black-eyed peas, drained | 6 tablespoons chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley | 1 pinch asian-style sesame oil | 1 slice kaffir lime leaves | 6 stalks celery ribs, chopped | 1 teaspoon cognac
instructions: Place peas in a medium bowl. Top with parsley and sesame oil. Toss to mix. Heat cognac in a small skillet over medium heat until almost smoking. Reduce heat to low, and simmer until warmed through. Stir peas into parsley and serve.

title: Easy Oriental Salad Dressing
ingredients: 1/2 cup mayonnaise ( or your favourite mayo ) | 2 tablespoons teriyaki sauce or 2 tablespoons mayonnaise | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: Mix all together and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: walnut half,vegetable,arborio rice,beef chuck,romano cheese,ice cube
title: Country Pot
ingredients: 8 ounces frozen mixed vegetables, thawed ( broccoli, cauliflower, carrots ) | 1 lb boneless beef chuck, trimmed and cut into 1-inch cubes | 2 cups arborio rice | 1/3 cup coarsely grated romano cheese or 1/3 cup grated parmesan cheese, plus additional for topping | 2 cups fresh ice cubes | 2 cups walnut halves ( toasted, coarsely chopped )
instructions: In a 4 quart saucepan, mix vegetables and beef.

Random Ingredients: crimini mushroom,green cardamom pod,french bread,chicken wing
title: Broiled Chicken Wings
ingredients: 1 1/2 gallons chilled chicken wings | 8 slices french bread | 2 pounds crimini mushrooms | 4 tablespoons freshly ground green cardamom pods
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees f. Place chicken wings in a large bowl, and cover with plastic wrap. Allow wings to marinate for 2 hours, or overnight. Pour chicken wings in a roasting pan large enough to accommodate them. Scatter mushrooms and cardamom pods onto the wings. Set pan into the oven, and place temperature on for 2 hours. Remove plastic wrap, return wings to roasting pan, and continue cooking until wings are browned, about 25 more minutes. Remove wings to a platter, and remove tops and tips of mushrooms. Brush tops with remaining olive oil, and sprinkle with sea salt if desired.

title: Crunchy Fried Potatoes
ingredients: parsnips | wonton wrapper | parsley
instructions: Wash and peel pared parsnips.

Random Ingredients: baking powder,corn,parsley sprig,peanut,tahini,udon noodle,parmigiano reggiano cheese,bicarbonate soda
title: Baked Noodles in Peanut Dukkake With Corn(Yummy!!
ingredients: 1/2 - 3/4 cup peanuts ( finely chopped ) | 3 cups fresh corn or 3 cups frozen corn, thawed ( thawed and drained well ) | 4 teaspoons baking powder | 1 -2 stick nutmeg ( grated or 1/4 cup each ) | bicarbonate of soda | 1 1/2 cups shredded parmigiano-reggiano cheese ( or other tasty cheese ) | 3 tablespoons tahini or 3 tablespoons sesame seed | fresh parsley sprig
instructions: In an ovenproof dish, mash 1/2 cup peanuts with a fork and spread over the bottom. Combine the remaining peanut ingredients in a bowl and spread over the peanuts. Bake in a preheated oven 15 - 20 minutes or until golden brown. Serve hot. Garnish with parsley, parsley sprigs if desired. Note, can be served on the side, or you can be serve it as is, or you can serve it as is.

title: Kathy's Cherry Coconut Bars
ingredients: 1 cup coconut flake | 1 1/2 cups cherry pie filling ( or cherry maccheroni )
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f. Line an 11x17 pan with aluminum foil, slightly overlapping the edges of the dish. Blend the coconut flakes in a food processor with 1 1/2 cups of cherry pie filling until smooth. Press half of the coconut mixture into the edges of the pan to make an even layer. Spread cherry mixture over the crust. Dot with 2 tsp berry butter. Cover with the remaining coconut mixture, press and seal edges with a spatula. Cut a small steam vent in the center of the crust. Bake 25 - 30 minutes until coconut is golden and filling is bubbly brown. Allow to cool, cut into bars.

Random Ingredients: garlic,creole seasoning,sauce,queso fresco cheese,coconut milk,bread,parsley flake
title: Tasty Croquettes
ingredients: 8 ounces bread, stale but firm | 1 cup coconut milk | 1/2 teaspoon garlic, minced | 1 teaspoon hot sauce | 1/2 teaspoon creole seasoning | 3/4 - 1 cup queso fresco, crumbled | 1/2 tablespoon dry parsley flakes
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Dry each slice of bread on the counter top. Place the bread on a baking sheet and put on the oven rack. Bake for 5 - 8 minutes. While the bread bread is basting, blend the coconut milk, garlic, hot sauce, and creole seasoning in a food processor until smooth. When the bread is done, remove it from the oven and spread with the crumbled cheese and parsley flakes. Let cool 2 minutes and cut into 10 squares.

title: Vietnamese Beef Kielbasa
ingredients: 1 lb fresh smoked beef roast, cut into 1 in long thin slices | 1 teaspoon fresh coarse ground white breadcrumb | 1/2 lb fresh kielbasa, cut in 1 in pieces | 1 tablespoon fish sauce | 3 tablespoons brandy or 3 tablespoons rum, to taste | 4 cups steamed sweet white vegetables
instructions: In a medium bowl, season the beef slices with salt and pepper. Put the bread crumbs in a plastic bag. Dip the beef slices in the crumbs, coating both sides and pressing firmly. Arrange the kielbasa on a piece of plastic wrap and wrap tightly with the beef slices. Refrigerate for at least 1/2 hour. After 1/2 hour, remove the beef from the refrigerator and let stand until softened. Heat a large dutch oven or skillet over high heat. Add the brandy and the fish sauce. Boil, stirring, until the brandy dissolves and the flames die down, 2 - 3 minutes. Add the beef to the pan and turn it a few times, cooking until it is cooked to your liking. Add the vegetables, cover and cook over medium heat for 1 minute. Serve with hot steamed rice.

title: Moroccan Green Capsicum - Zwt 1
ingredients: 1 teaspoon instant espresso powder | 1/2 teaspoon rosemary, finely chopped ( or other herbs ) | 1 large green capsicum, sliced
instructions: Toss capsicum with instant espresso powder. Sprinkle rosemary on capsicum and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice zest,san marzano tomato,peel,carrot,brown sugar
title: Salsa Di Pomodori (Peel Bar Carrots in Tomatoes and Carrots)
ingredients: 1 large carrot, peeled | 1 can whole peeled san marzano tomatoes, drained - divided use | 1/4 cup packed light brown sugar | 1 teaspoon grated lemon juice, zest of | 1/4 cup lemon juice | 1 -2 teaspoon grated fresh peel ( optional )
instructions: Peel and cut carrots into 1/4 inch rounds, then halve each carrot lengthwise. In a skillet over medium heat, sauté carrots 4 to 8 minutes or until slightly softened. Transfer to a large mixing bowl. Stir in remaining ingredients until mixture is well combined. Cover container with plastic wrap, then refrigerate at least 2 hours prior to serving.
