title: Korean Pinto Beans - Vegan
ingredients: 2 tablespoons gorgonzola | 1 liter pinto beans | 1 head cabbage kimchi, or | 1 celery rib, chopped
instructions: The day before, place the beans in a pressure cooker and bring to a boil without letting the water drop to the surface. Allow to boil for 20 minutes. Remove from heat and allow the beans to cool down on a towel. Strain the beans and place them back in the pressure cooker with the kimchi, celery and cook for 1 hour. After an hour open and remove the kimchi stalk from the beans. Serve.

title: Cod Sandwich, Australian Style
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg cod | 2 slices ciabatta, 3/4 to 1 inch thick | 2 -3 fresh red chilies | 2 -3 water chestnuts, sliced diagonally
instructions: Cook the cod with water added salt, pepper, chilli and mushrooms on the grill basting frequently.

Random Ingredients: white wine vinegar,stout beer,lard,lemon juice,green chile pepper,peanut
title: The Famous English Mustard
ingredients: 1 cup stout beer ( stout may be substituted ) | 3 teaspoons white wine vinegar | 1/4 cup lemon juice | 2 cups coarsely chopped dry roasted peanuts | 2 tablespoons chopped minced green chile pepper | 1 tablespoon lard
instructions: Stir to dissolve salt in beer and then stir in vinegar. Stir in lemon juice. Cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour, tossing occasionally. Mix in chopped peanuts, green chile and lard. Cover and refrigerate until ready to use.

title: Chile Tabbouleh
ingredients: 1 can whole chilies or 2 cans chilies, drained and rinsed | 2 tablespoons capers | 1/4 cup tahini
instructions: Drain water off chilies and discard. Process drained chilies in blender until finely chopped or put thru food processor and combine with rest of ingredients. Enjoy.

title: Spicy Carrots
ingredients: 2 lbs baby carrots, peeled | 1/2 teaspoon dried peppers
instructions: Place carrots in a microwave safe bowl and sprinkle with the pepper. Cover with cling film and microwave on high for 3 minutes.

Random Ingredients: white sugar,heavy whipping cream,kale,rice paper,hot paprika,yellow onion,basil,bacon
title: Kale with Ginger on Rice Paper
ingredients: 12 sheets rice paper | 6 leaves kale, chopped | 2 tablespoons minced yellow onion | 2 tablespoons minced fresh basil | 8 slices bacon, cooked and finely chopped | 1 cup heavy whipping cream | 1 tablespoon rice sugar | hot paprika ( to serve )
instructions: Place a row of rice paper in a large, shallow serving dish. Place 2 tablespoons chopped kale on top of the rice paper, then spread thinly with a spatula. Sprinkle with onions, basil, sliced bacon, whipping cream and rice sugar. Sprinkle paprika over all. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: baby portabella mushroom,mint sprig,cod fish fillet,banana liqueur,cracker,tomato juice,kale
title: Baked Cod With Sauteed Portabella Mushrooms & Banana Liqueur
ingredients: 2 cod fish fillets | 1/4 1/4 cup fresh tomato juice or 1/4 cup v 8 vegetable juice | 2 -3 fresh mint sprigs | 24 -24 -36 small new baby portabella mushrooms | 16 large banana liqueur | freshly cracked cracker | mint sprig ( garnish )
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Place fish fillets in a shallow 1 1/2 quart casserole dish. Cover fillets with 1 cup or less of v 8 juice and scatter with half of the mint, half of the banana liqueur and half of the remaining mint. Cover tightly and place in hot oven when just cooked, about 10 mns. On each side of the fish for a total of 12 minutes. Remove fish from oven and spoon remaining v 8 juice over fish, smoothing out the top. Cover top of fillets with cracked crackers and return to oven until fish flakes, about 5 mns. For an additional minute or two. Spoon remaining liqueur over fish, garnish with mint sprig and serve.

Random Ingredients: pistachio,hot chili sauce,leek,vinegar,self raising flour,nonfat milk powder,white fish fillet,apricot
title: Pan-Fried Fish With Parsley & Hot Peppers
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg white fish fillets | 2 leeks ( washed well and sliced into rounds ) | 10 -12 small hot chili sauce ( to taste ) | 150 g split sweet dried apricots | 150 g fresh leeks or 150 g leeks, washed thoroughly and sliced very thinly | 50 g self raising flour | 2 tablespoons nonfat dry milk powder ( known as `` nonfat yogurt '' at home ) | pistachios | vinegar
instructions: Slice the fish fillets into small, round pieces. Arrange them in a flat dish and sprinkle with salt. Let stand. In a small bowl, place the pickling solution and mix well to dissolve. To this add the sweet dried apricots, leeks, flour and dry milk powder. Mix well. Pour over the fish and refrigerate for at least 2 hours. After that it should soak for about 15 to 20 minutes before cooking. For more flavour, cover the fish with a clean tea towel and leave to soak for 20 minutes. Take the fish out of the refrigerator and pat dry. Heat some oil in a pan. Fry the fish pieces until golden on all sides. For a beautiful effect, add some chopped pistachios on top or the crispy fish. Serve hot with lemon wedges for an added touch.

Random Ingredients: plain yogurt,olive oil,chinese five spice powder,courgette,chili paste,phyllo pastry,milk powder
title: Chef Flower's Spicy Brik Kebabs
ingredients: 1 kg courgette | 1/4 cup plain yogurt | 2 tablespoons low-fat milk powder | 1 tablespoon chili paste | 1/2 teaspoon chinese five spice powder | 6 sheets phyllo pastry ( double thickness ) | olive oil ( for brushing )
instructions: Make your brussels. Slice them into 1cm thick lengths. Trim the root ends, making a total of 3cm x 5cm. Put them on a baking tray lined with baking paper and brush them lightly with a little water. Brush each piece of meat with olive oil, and sprinkle generously with salt and pepper to taste. Grill over a medium heat for 10 - 15 minutes until cooked. Allow to rest for 3 - 4 minutes. Trim off the ends of the meat, and slice into long slices. Put the yoghurt, salt and pepper, and chili paste in a bowl and mix well. Add the yogurt mixture to the yoghurt mixture. Add the finely grated courgettes, and mix well. Chill, covered in the fridge for an hour or so. Preheat your oven to 220°c. Line a tray with baking paper, and place sheets of the filo on it. Brush generously on the phyllo, and then cut 4 - 4 diagonal slices to fit into each tray. Brush each tray piece with oil and then brush with water. Press down slightly. Bake for 10 - 15 minutes, or until the pastry is dry and very crisp. Remove from the oven and while still hot cut off as much pastry as possible. Arrange the pastry strips over the tops of the kebabs. Return to the oven for 3 - 4 minutes, or until the top is crisp and golden. Remove and serve with your favourite dipping sauce. Enjoy.

title: Easy Potatoes and Chiles
ingredients: 6 medium potatoes, peeled and cut on diagonal into 1/4 inch slices
instructions: Arrange potatoes in a single layer in a baking dish and cover with lightly salted cold water. Turn oven on to 425°f. Place potatoes in pot with water, bring just to boiling. Bake uncovered until tender, about 15 minutes. Drain, cut potatoes into 1/4 inch slices and return to baking dish. Bake, uncovered, until hot, 4 - 5 minutes.

title: Spicy Italian Wedding Soup
ingredients: 1 package small shell pasta | 1 can beef broth | 1 dash ground red pepper, or to taste
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, stir in the shell pasta, and return to a boil. Cook the pasta uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the pasta has cooked through, but is still firm to the bite, about 12 minutes. Drain well in a colander set in the sink, return to the pot, and mix in the beef broth and red pepper. Cover, and allow the soup to heat through, about 10 minutes.

title: Cousin Style Hot Tamale Casserole
ingredients: 1 lb lean ground round ( for mild tamale shrimp ) or 1 lb imitation crabmeat, rinsed | 1/2 cup yellow cornmeal | 2 cups beef broth | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano | 1/4 teaspoon ground cloves | 1/4 teaspoon chili powder
instructions: Cook meat in hot skillet until no longer pink. Drain.

title: The Best Cajun Dipping Sauce for Hot Dogs
ingredients: 2 cups milk | 1 teaspoon ground celery salt | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds
instructions: In a medium bowl, whisk together the milk, celery salt, and mustard seed. Gradually whisk in the milk until completely combined. Makes about 1 cup.

Random Ingredients: ginger ale,tomato puree,red wine,red chile pepper,beef roast,marinara sauce spaghetti,anise seed
title: Italian Beef in Red Wine
ingredients: 3 tablespoons chopped red chile peppers, or more to taste | 2 tablespoons ground fresh ginger ale | 1 tablespoon crushed anise seed | 1 teaspoon crushed marinara sauce ( optional ) | 1 cup merlot white wine | 1 jar red wine, divided | 3 pounds beef bones with lots of fat | 1 can tomato puree
instructions: Preheat your oven's broiler. Place the ground chiles, ginger ale, anise seed, marinara sauce, and 1/2 cup of wine in a blender or food processor and puree until smooth. Place the remaining wine into a large pot and add the beef bones. Cover, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat, and simmer for 1 hour. Transfer the beef bones and their sauce to a roasting pan and pour the remaining wine over the top. Cover and roast in the preheated oven until the meat juices run clear, about 1 hour. Remove the beef from the oven, remove cover, and continue roasting in the preheated oven 30 minutes more, until the internal temperature of the chuck roast reaches 130 degrees f. Transfer the ground beef to a large bowl and toss with the tomato puree until desired consistency is achieved. Serve with sliced baguette slices or toasted baguette slices.

title: Chocolate Shrimp Bites
ingredients: 1 lb large shrimp, peeled and deveined | 2 tablespoons instant xanthan gum ( optional ) | 8 ounces cocoa
instructions: Place all ingredients in a large bowl. Knead by hand until uniform. With hands add a few pieces at a time to the bowl. The result should be firm and gooey. Using your palms, form each batch into a ball. Lightly coat each ball with oil and cook over low or medium heat, flipping once, for about 15 - 20 minutes. Cook for a couple of minutes more, and roll in cocoa to remove from the pan. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: hamburger,streaky bacon,lime wedge,plum tomato,jalapeno,cooking oil,white breadcrumb
title: Smoked Grecian Burger
ingredients: 8 slices smoked grecian lean hamburger ( or other ground burger ) | 1 tablespoon cooking oil | 4 slices white breadcrumbs | 4 slices hot smoked streaky bacon | 8 slices plum tomatoes | 1 fresh jalapeno, chopped | limes wedge ( optional )
instructions: Preheat a non stick frypan over medium heat until hot. Brush one side of each slice of bread with oil. Top bread with the burger. Sprinkle each with breadcrumbs. Fry until golden and cooked through. Meanwhile, fry the bacon until almost crisp. Turn over and fry the tomatoes for a few seconds, then turn heat to very low and add the jalapeno, stirring fry for 1 minute so it can soften slightly. Add to bacon mixture, and stir in the cooked sausage. Spoon onto toasted bread and serve with a lime wedges if preferred.

Random Ingredients: caper,kosher salt black pepper,vodka,dark brown sugar,egg white
title: Gravlax with Capers
ingredients: 1 egg white | 1 pinch kosher salt and ground black pepper, or more to taste | 2 tablespoons capers, drained | 5 drops vodka ( optional ) | 5 drops dark brown sugar, or to taste
instructions: Mix egg white, salt, pepper, capers, vodka, and brown sugar together in a bowl until emulsified.

title: Vegetable Surprise
ingredients: 4 turnips, peeled but unpeeled | 1 celery rib | 400 g guacamole or 400 g homemade guacamole | 1 teaspoon mustard powder | 600 ml veal stock or 600 ml beef stock | 1 tablespoon prepared horseradish | 3 teaspoons mirin or 3 teaspoons sake
instructions: Heat the grill grates. Roughly grate turnips, celery and carrot. Toss vegetable and spices gently with guacamole and mustard, if using.

title: Homemade Dressing
ingredients: 2 ounces breadcrumbs | 2 ounces chile peppers
instructions: Dry breadcrumbs or coarsely chop them.

title: Broiled Garlic Wheat (Shuka)
ingredients: 1/2 cup cracked bulgar wheat | rice, toasted and cooled
instructions: Wrap bulgur wheat in a clean cloth or cheesecloth and squeeze it in a strainer lined with several layers of paper towels for 15 to 60 minutes. Combine cracked wheat with cold water, about 1/2 cup per cupful, stirring well with a fork to remove some of the water. The water should be cloudy and the wheat slightly chewier. The water should be clear and the cloth should be just slightly cloudy. Soak in a bowl of water for 2 to 4 hours, stirring gently every 5 minutes. Remove cloth and drain. Serve using cracked wheat as a garnish for rice, or allow to cool and serve over fresh pilau.

Random Ingredients: ranch dressing mix,onion salt,navy bean,flour tortilla,chicken wing,corn oil,buttermilk
title: Camp the Devil Ranch Chicken
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs chicken wings, separated at joints, tips discarded ( you can use breast, thighs or drumsticks too ) | 1 can navy beans ( use 2 cans ) | 1/2 small onion, cut in wedges | 3 tablespoons corn oil | 1 tablespoon flour | 1 tablespoon old ranch dressing mix | 1 tablespoon buttermilk | 3 flour tortillas
instructions: In a large oven safe dutch oven or roasting pan, add chicken wings, navy beans, onion, oil, and cornstarch. Stir and toss over medium high heat until coated with cornstarch. Cover.

title: Cheese Filling for Savoury Vegetables
ingredients: 1 lb french style green bean ( sliced ) | 1/4 cup coriander seed ( crushed ) | 1 teaspoon cardamom pod ( crushed ) | 1 tablespoon vanilla ( i prefer vanilla bean ) | 1 teaspoon pecans ( optional ) | 1/4 cup pistachios ( chopped ) or 1/4 cup walnut pieces ( chopped ) | 1/4 cup pecans, chopped | 1/4 of a french's green bean ( sliced ) | 1/4 cup coriander ( crushed ) | 2/3 cup white sugar, divided | 1 1/2 teaspoons cornflour ( dissolved in a little water )
instructions: Sauté the seeds, cardamom and pecans in a small saucepan until they turn slightly colored. Remove from heat and add vanilla bean and other seeds then set aside. To make filling, mix all dry ingredients together in a food processor and add pistachios and green beans. Puree until smooth. Add half the sugar and mix well. Pour into a baking dish and place in oven at 375°f. Bake until golden brown. Add remaining sugar, stir well and continue cooking for 15 minutes stirring occasionally.

title: Basil Pesto
ingredients: 1 clove garlic, pressed | 1/2 clove chile, minced | 3/4 cup basil pesto
instructions: In a blender, combine garlic and chile.

title: Homemade Mayonnaise, Italian Style
ingredients: 3 bulb garlic, unpeeled | 1 teaspoon dried oregano | 1/2 teaspoon ground allspice
instructions: Using a medium mortar and pestle or a finely grater, mash the garlic until smooth. Stir in the oregano and allspice. Use immediately or store in the refrigerator in an airtight container for up to 3 days.

Random Ingredients: self rising flour,liquid smoke,flavoring orange,poppy seed,orange bell pepper,orange,arborio rice
title: Poppy Seed Fritters (Ciabatta)
ingredients: 2 cups self-rising flour | 1 cup arborio rice or 1 cup short-grain rice | 1/3 cup poppy seed | 2 tablespoons dried orange, minced fine ( or equivalent ) | 1 tablespoon dried orange sweet bell pepper ( or equivalent ) | 2 tablespoons arborio aromatic seaweed flavoring ( optional ) | 2 cups liquid smoke | 1 pinch flavoring ( i used orge-olive's special )
instructions: First, rinse the rice to remove some of the salt. In a large bowl combine the flours, rice, seeds, and dried pepper and mix together. Stir in liquid smoke until moistened. Drop 1 tablespoon of batter into the oil and fry until golden brown on both sides. Take out of the oil and drain on a paper towel covered rack or plate.

title: Basic French Onion Soup (Oignon)
ingredients: 1 onion soup mix | 2 teaspoons kosher salt
instructions: Heat a small pot over medium heat. Add enough water to just cover the bottom of the pot. Stir in the onions, and cook until the onions are soft, 3 to 5 minutes. Use a strainer or colander to drain the onions completely.

title: Cheese Enchiladas With Irish Cream and Corn Chips
ingredients: 6 corn tortillas, halved | vegetable oil ( for frying ) | 1 teaspoon vegetable oil | 3/4 cup irish cream ( regular or lowfat ) or 3/4 cup cream ( regular or lowfat )
instructions: Heat oil in a skillet to 325 degrees. Place 6 corn tortilla halves in a single layer in a large shallow baking dish. Brush the tortillas with oil and dip them in the tortilla. instructions: Place meat in a large saucepan and cover with water.

title: Pumpkin and Chocolate French Onion Pizza
ingredients: 1 pizza sauce, pizza dough, readymade | 3 tablespoons honey | 3 tablespoons chili powder | 1 teaspoon pumpkin pie spice | 12 small red onions or 12 small fingerling onions | 1 cup extra dry red wine
instructions: Make your own pizza dough according to package directions, using olive oil or olive oil spray in a large bowl toss pizza dough to coat with cooking spray. Spread pizza dough with onion spread and spread thin with prepared pizza sauce. Grate 1 tablespoon of chocolate syrup or melted margarine on top of pizza dough. Spread more of your choice of topping over filling. Bake in preheated 350 degree oven for 8 - 10 minutes.

title: Spinach & Chocolate Chip Dip
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs fresh spinach leaves, washed, spun dry, and torn into bits | 2 -3 tablespoons chili paste ( i use paul prudhomme's chili powder mix ) | 1/4 - 1/2 cup kosher paprika | 1/8 - 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon seasoning salt | 4 -6 ounces milk chocolate chips ( can use semi sweet ) | 2 -4 garlic cloves, minced | 1/2 cup irish cream, good quality | freshly grated cinnamon stick ( optional, for garnish )
instructions: Put spinach into large bowl. Add chili paste and all other ingredients and mix until thoroughly mixed. Spoon into a serving bowl or platter and sprinkle with cinnamon if you like. title: Water Chestnut Risen Sweet Biscuits

instructions: In a medium bowl, sift together the flours and the gluten and the salt, and add the water chestnuts and pistachios.

title: Sesame Nuts

instructions: Heat some vegetable oil in a wok or deep frying pan. Stir fry the sesame nuts a few seconds or until they are lightly colored. Stir fry the sesame until they have dark spots on them. Stir fry the oyster sauce in the wok. Remove with slotted spoon to another bowl. Serve hot with white rice.

title: Best Ever Salmon Macaroni & Grapes

instructions: Boil water and add pasta, cook according to package directions. Drain pasta, but add a touch of olive oil to absorb excess water. Add egg whites to hot pan and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly. Turn heat down to medium. Add cider to egg whites. Pour over salmon and grapes. Stir to combine and serve over hot pasta.

title: Kadai (Apple-And-Vodka-Spiked Apples)
ingredients: 4 tart apples, e.g. granny smith | 1 tablespoon dill weed, fresh chopped | 2 medium red bell peppers | 2 dashes tabasco sauce | 1 teaspoon red bell pepper | 1 cup vodka ( or other liqueur ) | 1/2 cup fresh cilantro leaves, chopped
instructions: Peel apples removing the stem and cores leaving them on. Place in medium heat proof bowl and sprinkle with dill, salt and pepper. Add peppers, stir well. Add vodka and cover with plastic wrap. Marinade in the refrigerator for 45 - 60 minutes. Serve in a small martini style glass with cilantrillo leaves if desired.

title: Apple Sage Bread or "mageirka"
ingredients: 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 1/2 cup apple juice | 3 -4 garlic cloves, finely chopped | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried sage | 1 1/2 teaspoons grated lemons, zest of or 1 1/2 teaspoons orange zest | 1 3/4 cups strong ale ( porter beer preferred ) | 1 1/2 1 1/2 cups alfalfa sprouts or 1 1/2 cups kale ( 1 large, wide ) | 1 teaspoon vegetable oil | 1 -2 tablespoon fresh sage, finely chopped | 2 packages fast-rising yeast or 2 lbs yeast
instructions:

    - bread.

title: Roasted Asparagus and Cucumber Kebabs
ingredients: 4 large cucumbers | 2 cups yogurt | 10 asparagus spears | 6 lettuce leaves | 1 egg | 1 tablespoon fresh rosemary, chopped | 1/4 cup grated parmesan cheese | 12 thin slices tomatoes with thin slices peeled, seeded and pulp removed from the core
instructions: Preheat the broiler. Halve the cucumbers lengthwise, and scoop out the seeds. Slice thinly. Arrange the cucumber slices on a piece of kitchen towels, and set aside. Place the yogurt in a small shallow dish and coat with the rosemary. Line the strainer with cheesecloth and set a plate or bowl on top. Wipe out the strainer and place asparagus in the bowl.

Random Ingredients: garlic powder,prosciutto,salmon,virgin olive oil,meatball,cardamom seed,english cucumber
title: Cardamom Salmon Meatballs
ingredients: 4 lbs skinless salmon, frozen ( see note below ) | 12 ounces frozen precooked meatballs, frozen ( see note below ) | 1 english cucumber | 1/2 cup virgin olive oil | 1 teaspoon garlic powder | 2/3 teaspoon crushed cardamom seeds | 1/2 teaspoon fresh ground black pepper | 12 slices prosciutto
instructions: Note, the number of servings is for using frozen salmon. The amounts of salmon, meatball and cucumber are up to you. If you use canned salmon, add a little salt to the salt. If you use fresh meatballs, rinse them under cold water, drain and set aside. Use a small caner or a small bowl and push the frozen salmon meat and cucumber through a sieve to remove all excess moisture.. If canned meatballs have not been thawed, drain all of the accumulated liquid and put into a large freezer plastic bag. If fresh meatballs are not in season and can be frozen, thaw the frozen salmon meat and cucumber in the freezer again. Measure out 1 cup olive oil and put into a small, heavy pot until it reaches a temperature of 115 degrees f. While you are waiting for the oil to reach temperature, combine 1 teaspoon garlic powder together with 1 teaspoon ground cardamom seeds. Crush the garlic and cardamom seeds with a mortar and pestle on a cutting board or in a coffee grinder, until fine. With the remaining 1/2 cup olive oil, mix in the black pepper. When the oil reaches this temperature, add the garlic and pepper, and mix well. Take all of the salmon meatballs from the freezer, and mix through the garlic and pepper mix. Pour the salmon and cucumber mixture into the olive oil. Toss the salmon and cucumber with the olive oil until well coated. Cook one at a time in the hot olive oil until the salmon is done, or cook two at a time on top of the stove until they are browned. Do not overcook or they will be mushy in the finished cooking process.. Drain the salmon meatballs on paper towels and serve. Note, using medium size ripe olives, cut in half lengthwise. If you prefer a smoother texture, slice into thin slices, then place on a plate and sprinkle with garlic powder and freshly ground cardamom powder. Enjoy note, i used a food processor to prepare the marinade, but any food processor would do. If you use a blender, you may have to do it in two batches. For the garnish, you can use a vegetable peeler to remove the colored green pieces. If you press your garlic with your hands, it will be easy to add the salt in anyway. If you press garlic with your hands, your mixture and the olives will not be so moist that they become bitter. You can also use fresh garlic. You can also use fresh garlic, but it's not so bad. Note, if you get this marinade, you can use a mortar and pestle to combine them. For this, you may have to adjust the quantity of marinade according to your preference.

Random Ingredients: green enchilada sauce,artichoke heart,mustard seed,croissant,lemon verbena leaf,pecan,kosher salt
title: Enchilada-Pecan French Bread
ingredients: 1 loaf croissants | 10 ounces green enchilada sauce | 1 cup chopped pecans | 1 tablespoon lemon verbena leaf, chopped | kosher salt | 2 tablespoons mustard seeds, preferably gray | 16 jelly packed artichoke hearts, drained, rinsed and quartered
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F. Cut a slit on each side of the loaf of bread. Place 1/4 cup of enchilada sauce on each of the halves and top with pecans. Place the remaining 3/4 cup enchilada sauce in a bowl and sprinkle with the lemon verbena leaves and about 2 teaspoons of salt. Place the artichoke hearts in the remaining 1/2 cup enchilada sauce and top with remaining mustard seeds. Place the bread and artichokes on a baking sheet and drizzle with a little more enchilada sauce. Bake for 30 minutes, or until bubbly and the topping begins to golden brown.

title: Easy Chinese Bok Choy Soup

instructions: Wash and slice bok choy. Place all ingredients in a large pot and cook on low heat for 35 more minutes. Serve hot.
