title: Gluten Free Sandwich Crackers
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups gluten free baking powder | 1/2 cup fresh mint leaves | 1 tablespoon fresh minced garlic | 1 1/2 teaspoons chili oil ( i use my tasty garlic chili oil ) | 2 1/2 cups iceberg lettuce
instructions: Mix the first 5 ingredients together. Layer on cookie sheet, either in triangles or slices of bread. I use pizza peel cut from iceberg lettuce and place on top of the bread or make your own using your favourite biscuit cutters. Bake at 180 degrees for 18 to 20 minutes, or as preferred, or until golden brown and crispy. Enjoy with salsa and a salad. If you have any leftover bits of bread or some other toppings, i add them to this recipe for example. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: baking soda,lettuce,cheese ravioli,red pepper flake,black bean,cucumber,portuguese bread,leek
title: Portuguese Bean Bake
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs portuguese style dried bread, cut into 2 inch chunks, about 1 lb ( i like bread for this ) | 1 cup cheese ravioli ( we like cheese ravioli with lime and black ) or 1 cup cheese ravioli ( we like cheese ravioli with lime and black ) | 1 cup lettuce, coarsely chopped ( we like cheese ravioli with lime and black ) | 3 tablespoons cucumbers, diced | 4 tablespoons leeks, sliced | 1/2 teaspoon red pepper flakes | 1 can black beans, drained and rinsed | 1/2 cup shredded cheese with grated cheese | grated cheese ( optional ) or grated cheese ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Combine bread chunks and enough water in a large pot to cover. Bring to boil.

title: Apricot-Stuffed Whole Wheat Flour-Crusted Bread
ingredients: 1 cup whole wheat flour | 1 cup chicken broth ( may use low-sodium canned broth ) | 1/4 cup apricot brandy | 1/2 teaspoon ground red pepper ( optional, adjust for heat and how much you want )
instructions: In a large bowl whisk the chicken broth, brandy and pepper until well blended. Add the flour to the bowl and stir until the dough comes together into a ball.. On a floured board, roll the dough out to a 1/4 thickness. Cut out as many circles as possible using cookie cutter dough, or whatever size cutter you have. Dip the dough circles in the flour and place on a baking sheet, pressing any holes with your hands. Cover the breads loosely with plastic wrap and a damp towel and let them sit at room temperature for an hour or so to absorb the flavors. Preheat oven for about 40 minutes. Remove the breads from the baking sheet and brush tops with the melted butter. Bake until tops are lightly browned, about 15 - 20 minutes more, or can be frozen for up to 3 months.

title: Portuguese Banana Bread
ingredients: 2 cans garbanzo beans, drained | 1 package puff pastry sheets, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Roll out 1 puff pastry sheet into a rectangle 10x15 inches. Spread 1 can garbanzos on the puff pastry sheet.

title: Fried Rice
ingredients: 1 cup rice, long grain | 5 sage leaves, whole
instructions: Wash the rice several times, making sure the water does not stop dripping out. Rinse the rice with the hands for about 5 minutes. Place in hot fat, stir well, turn up heat to medium, and fry the rice. When it is brown, it will start sticking to the pan. The frying process is death to my eyes, but the result pay off in less than one long minute. Remove the rice to a plate lined with paper towels to drain. Leave a fine layer of rice on the underside. You can cut it into small squares and serve.

title: Gorky's Meatball
ingredients: 1 zucchini, sliced | 1 lb frozen ground lamb | 1 cup quick-cooking oats | 1/2 cup zesty italian dressing ( see directions ) | 1 jar of chipotle chiles in adobo | store-bought italian dressing, such as pampered chef's
instructions: Place zucchini in a colander and wash under cold running water for 1 minute. Pat off excess water and set aside to drain. Place frozen ground lamb in a large freezer proof freezer bag. Using a fork, mash the meat until the meat is broken down into large chunks and has lost most of its redness and shape. Place zucchini in a large bowl and toss with the dried ground lamb and the quickcooking oats. Shape the mixture into meatballs of desired size and place in a large saucer. Place in freezer until all are frozen and ready to use, at least 2 hours, and up to 48 hours, depending on thawing the meatballs. Pampered Chef's note, prep time does not include initial thawing the meatballs.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray,pomegranate concentrate,natural peanut butter,purpose flour,snow pea,wide egg noodle
title: Mongolian Noodle Pone
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 1 package frozen pomegranate concentrate | 3/4 cup natural-style peanut butter | 1 package wide egg noodles, cooked and drained | 1 package snow peas, trimmed, cut diagonally into 1/4-inch strips
instructions: Coat a large nonstick skillet with cooking spray. Add flour and whisk to blend and mix well, adding water gradually, if necessary, to create a smooth batter. Cook and stir over medium heat 1 1/2 minutes or until mixture is thickened and bubbly. Stir in pomegranate concentrate and peanut butter. Cook 1 minute more to blend. Stir noodles into batter. Remove from heat. Stir in snow peas. Cover and allow to sit 5 minutes until the snow peas are just set. Garnish with parsley if desired.

title: Spicy Spiced Chicken With Pineapple
ingredients: 2 cups pineapple juice ( or other orange based fruit juice ) | 2 tablespoons cumin seeds, ground | 4 chicken legs | 4 tablespoons quinoa
instructions: Soak the quinoa in hot water for 10 - 15 minutes. Drain well over wok, drain again in bowl. Heat the saucepan over low and add the ground cumin seeds making sure the spices do not burn. Place chicken legs on top of the cumin seed and let it brown well. Add 2/3 of the pineapple juice and all of the quinoa. Let simmer on medium heat for 20 minutes until the liquid is reduced a bit, stirring occasionally. Stir, cover, turn off heat and let sit for 10 minutes but no longer. Fluff with fork and stir in the rest of the pineapple juice and quinoa. Serve over a bed of orange and/or sweetened waffles with crunchy lettuce.

title: Grilled Cheese on the Cob
ingredients: 2 -4 lbs grated monterey jack and cheddar cheese blend | 1 tablespoon coriander leaves ( optional )
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and grill over your favorite fire, for about 5 minutes and enjoy.

title: Frozen Peas
ingredients: 200 g green peas | 200 g dried apricots | 3 teaspoons garlic powder
instructions: Blend all ingredients except the peas, apricots and garlic powder. Bake frozen peas covered in the oven at 200c for 2 hours. Blend the peas with the apricots, and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: turmeric powder,ricotta cheese,ginger paste,orange juice,tomatillo,icing sugar
title: Chilled Tomatillos
ingredients: 12 tomatillos, tomatillos are really ripe | 4 teaspoons ginger paste | 4 teaspoons cream of coconut or 4 teaspoons crema | 2 teaspoons icing sugar | 1 teaspoon orange juice ( add in more as desired ) | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric powder
instructions: Using a comal or fry pan, or grill pan, heat on medium high until the surface is coated with cooking oil, or on automatic heat setting. If using a frying pan, put the tomatillos upside down so that they will not brown. Set aside and cool the tomatillos. Drain and let cool completely. Meanwhile, mix together ginger and cream of coconut in a small bowl. Set aside. Wash the tomatillo skins and dry thoroughly. Place tomatillos in a blender or food processor and process until smooth. Add the cream of coconut and the icing sugar. Blend until smooth. Add the orange juice, turmeric and the orange juice mixture. Stir in the tomatillo mixture. Chill the mixture in the refrigerator for at least 5 hours. You do not need to chill it this much. Once chilled, transfer the mixture to a storage container. Keep refrigerated until needed.

title: Spinach Pie
ingredients: 2 packages frozen chopped spinach, thawed | 3 packages phyllo pastry, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Drain spinach well, squeezing the excess liquid out. Put thawed spinach onto the bottom of an 11x7 inch casserole dish. Sprinkle spinach with 1/3 of the sheets frozen phyllo pastry sheets so the sheets are overlapping slightly. Cover with 1/2 of the phyllo sheets. Top with 1/2 of the spinach. Repeat layers. Cover dish with foil. Bake for 1 hour in the preheated oven. Remove foil, bake for an additional 15 minutes, or until light golden in color.

Random Ingredients: mozzarella cheese,olive oil,self rising flour,spinach,chile powder,cherry
title: Spinach Chapati
ingredients: 1/4 lb fresh spinach, washed and chopped | 1/2 cup self rising flour | 1 1/2 teaspoons chili powder | 8 pieces rolled out fresh mozzarella cheese or 8 pieces monterey jack cheese | 4 cherry rolls, lightly toasted | 2 -3 tablespoons olive oil ( use cooking spray not non stick )
instructions: Put the spinach in a saucepan and add enough water to just cover. Bring to the boil and turn the heat to medium. Let it cook at a hard boil for 5 minutes, skimming any foam that rises to the surface. Remove from the heat, transfer to a mixing bowl, cover and set aside in warm place to steam for 30 minute or until it has dried out. If using the cheese, slice the cheese into 4 inch squares. Divide the spinach, flour and chili powder among 4 serving plates. Top with a layer of mozzarella or jack cheese on each plate. Serve the chapatis warm or at room temperature.

title: Homemade Dressing
ingredients: 1 cup crushed chipotle powder | 1/2 teaspoon tamari | 1/2 cup water | 1/2 cup low fat cottage cheese | 1 teaspoon lemonade
instructions: Put all ingredients in a blender or food processor and blend until smooth. Cover with a lid and refrigerate until serve.

Random Ingredients: green cardamom pod,nonfat yogurt,graham cracker,cocoa powder,sesame seed oil,red capsicum,grape tomato
title: Yogurt Grape Tomato Parfait (21 Day Wonder Diet: Day 11)
ingredients: 10 small grape tomatoes | 1 tablespoon toasted sesame seed oil | 1 teaspoon unsweetened cocoa powder | 1 green cardamom pod | 1 red capsicum, thinly sliced | 15 -20 ounces nonfat yogurt | 1/2 cup nonfat plain yogurt | 1 tablespoon roasted sesame seed oil | grated chocolate, to serve
instructions: Cut off the tops of the tomatoes and scoop out the seeds with a teaspoon.

Random Ingredients: cocoa powder,pumpkin puree,plain flour,water,dark brown sugar,dark chocolate,cumin seed,southern comfort
title: Pumpkin Chocolate Choc Chip Cookies
ingredients: 4 cups plain flour | 2 cups very firmly packed dark brown sugar | 1/2 cup unsweetened cocoa powder | 1 teaspoon ground cumin seed | 1 tablespoon dark hot coffee, heated, cooled ( i usually make it at home ) | 2 - 2 1/2 cups canned pumpkin puree ( the canned pumpkin is the sweetened kind only, not the sweetened pumpkin ) | 1 cup southern comfort ( to taste ) | 1/4 cup dark chocolate, melted ( or milk )
instructions: Sift together the flour, sugar, cocoa, cumin, cocoa powder and hot coffee. Stir in reserved pumpkin and set aside for 10 minutes. Stir in the pumpkin pie filling and chocolate. Turn onto a lightly floured board and knead briefly until smooth and glossy about 5 minutes. Place in an oiled bowl, cover and chill for 30 minutes. Preheat the oven to 375°f. Drop rounded tablespoon sized pieces of dough onto a lightly floured baking tray. Mark into 12 squares with a knife. Bake for about 15 - 25 minutes or just until lightly golden around the edges and puffy and crisp on the outside. Leave to cool on a wire rack. Store in an airtight tin until ready to use.

title: Sesame Beef
ingredients: 2 teaspoons sesame oil | 1 lb top sirloin steak, sliced thinly | 3 leeks, white and light green parts only, thinly sliced | 4 canned diced tomatoes with green chilies, drained
instructions: Place sesame oil in hot wok or skillet over high heat. When pan is hot, add beef and stir fry for 2 minutes. Add leeks and white parts of the chili peppers. Pour in tomatoes, reduce heat, and simmer 5 minutes or until sauce reduces a bit.

title: Marsala Beef
ingredients: 3 lbs stewing beef, trimmed and tied
instructions: Place meat in crockpot. Add enough water to just cover. If you don't have a crockpot, just drop meat into crockpot and cook on high for 6 hours. Remove beef from crockpot.

title: Papaya Chicken
ingredients: 8 cooked meatballs | 1 cup diced fresh papaya | 1/3 cup prepared guacamole | 1/4 cup prepared chili sauce | 2 tablespoons chicken bouillon granules | 1 tablespoon finely diced prosciutto | 1 pinch dried dill weed | 1 pinch dried guacamole for topping
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. In a small bowl, stir together the papaya, guacamole, chili sauce, bouillon granules, prosciutto, dill weed, and guacamole.

Random Ingredients: eggplant,green olive,flour tortilla,oat,mustard,brown mustard seed,green pepper,jerk chili paste
title: Eggplant Patties
ingredients: 1 large eggplant | 1 can chopped green olives | 1/2 cup chopped green pepper | 1/4 cup chopped sweet peppers or 1/4 cup chilies, of your choice | 1/4 cup oats | 1 1/2 teaspoons prepared jerk chili paste | 1/2 teaspoon dry mustard | 1/2 teaspoon flour or 1/2 teaspoon mustard, mixed with | 1/2 teaspoon brown mustard seeds
instructions: If using a food processor, process eggplant until finely ground. If your food processor takes a few seconds, leave it in until you are ready to proceed. If your food processor takes 10 - 15 seconds, remove the eggplant from the bowl and pat dry with paper towel so that the bread does not absorb any of the liquid. Drain and spread it out on your work surface, if you have one. Using the back of a spoon, tear off a strip of the green onion and put it into the bowl of a food processor. With the motor running, add the other ingredients. Pulse until well mixed but not pureed. If using your food processor, take out the eggplant and put it into a mixing bowl for a few seconds, mix then process again. Add the eggplant mixture to the bowl and using your hands mix well, combine well with your hands. If using a food processor, slice the eggplant 1/4 thick. Place half of the patties onto a greased oven pan or baking tray, about 1/2 cup per patty. Place the rest of the patties on top, and let stand in the pan for 10 minutes. Bake at a temperature between 120 degrees c and 280 degrees f for 40 minutes or until the edges have crisped up.

title: Buffalo-Beef Nachos
ingredients: 3/4 cup prepared simple syrup | 2 tablespoons lard | 1 pound hot buffalo meat, cut into 1 inch dice | 8 1/2 ounces crab meat, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 can diced green chilies
instructions: Combine the simple syrup, lard, and hot buffalo meat in a large skillet. Bring to a simmer over medium high heat. Reduce heat to medium low and simmer until the liquid is reduced to about 3/4 c. Stir in crab and green chilies until blended. Continue cooking until heated through. Preheat the oven to 325 degrees f. Spoon some of the nachos into the bottom of an ungreased 9x13 inch baking dish. Spoon 1/3 of the nachos onto the noodles, then top with 1/2 of the pepper mixture.

title: Fried Puffs
ingredients: 2 cups plain flour | 1 cup grated asiago cheese | 2 medium bell peppers, chopped | 2 egg whites, lightly beaten | 2 tablespoons melted butter or 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 f. Cream together the cheese with the flour. Fold in the chilies. Add egg whites. Pour mixture onto greased cookie sheet. Spread to 1/8 thick. Bake for 12 - 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: vanilla bean,tomato sauce,garlic paste,peanut,caster sugar,basmati rice,asparagus tip
title: Chilled Tomato Rice
ingredients: 1 cup basmati rice, soaked for 6 hours | 500 g fresh asparagus tips | 1 cup tomato sauce | 1 1/2 cups roasted peanuts, roughly chopped ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons caster sugar ( mixed with sugar to desired sweetness ) | 2 tablespoons tomato paste | 1 garlic paste
instructions: Drain rice, then soak for at least 1 hour and up to 12 hours in plenty of water, drain well and refrigerate. Dice asparagus and place in a saucepan with the tomato sauce and bring to the boil over medium heat. Simmer for 3 hours or until rice is well cooked.

title: Red Beans With Apricots and Sherry
ingredients: 150 g dried red beans | 5 tablespoons dry sherry ( not cooking sherry! ) | 2 tablespoons sea salt | 75 g dried apricots, chopped
instructions: Cover dried red beans with cold water in a large basin. Soak overnight in a large pot of cold water. Next day drain beans and discard water. In the same pot combine sherry and two tablespoons of the water and bring to the boil. Add beans to the sherry and bring to the boil, then cover the pot and simmer for 45 minutes or until the beans are tender. Stir in the salt and apricots and remove the strainer. Remove beans and stir with cooked sherry or water until smooth and heated through.

Random Ingredients: egg noodle,celery,purpose flour,black eyed pea,tomato sauce,yellow cornmeal,clove
title: Hearty Black Eyed Peas Stew
ingredients: 2 cans white-style black-eyed peas, drained and rinsed | 3 cans yellow cornmeal | 1 cup all-purpose flour | 2 teaspoons minced celery | 1 teaspoon minced garlic | 1/2 teaspoon ground cloves | 1 egg noodles
instructions: In a large bowl, toss together the black eyed peas, cornmeal, flour, celery, garlic, and cloves until thoroughly mixed and coated with flour. Heat a large skillet over medium heat. Drain the black eyed pea mixture into the skillet, and gently mix in the egg noodles. Cover, and cook until the noodles are tender, 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Sauce Mimic
ingredients: 1/2 cup lemon juice, fresh squeezed | 1/2 cup sugar ( to taste ) | 2 1/4 cups teriyaki sauce ( a must )
instructions: In a medium sauce pan, combine lemon juice, sugar and teriyaki sauce. Bring to boil then simmer, stirring constantly for 2 minutes. Cool to room temperature. This is a dipping sauce for fish and chicken.

Random Ingredients: pork,flour tortilla,garlic powder,brown mushroom,lemon juice zest,mung dal,butternut squash,egg noodle
title: Mixed Chutney Noodle Lunch
ingredients: 1 large brown mushrooms ( optional ) | 1 large butternut squash, peeled, seeded and diced | 1 -2 tablespoon fresh lemon juice, zest of | 1/2 large egg noodles ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon garlic powder | 100 g ground pork | 25 -50 flour tortillas ( fresh or homemade ) | gluten free egg noodles
instructions: If you are using fresh or homemade rice, wash the rice first in a mesh strainer then drain into a bowl. Cover with cold water and stir a few times to stop the rice sticking to the bottom of the bowl. Heat the grill to its highest temperature. Put your rice in a bowl that can easily slip from the bowl into the heated griller. It should hear 250wf. In the meantime, place the diced squash on your stovetop and just microwave on high for 4 minutes, or until the surface is soft enough to move around. The squash should be soft, cooked but in a similar amount of texture to the rice but still firm enough to break into big bits or pieces. Peel, rinse and dice the mango if using. Heat a little olive oil in a small frying pan, and place your diced butternut squash in over the heat. Add lemon juice, garlic and minced zest and taste for salt. Stir well and continue to stir until all ingredients are well incorporated. Stir in your noodles if using. Taste and adjust seasonings. While those noodles are soaking, mix the pork together with the ground pork and then spoon some of the meat and tofu mixture into your rice. Sprinkle any noodles that have been seasoned with lemon zest and garlic. Serve with flour tortillas and extra meat. Guten free egg noodles can be used too.

title: Pickled Herring
ingredients: 1 jar mini marshmallows | 2 teaspoons black peppercorns, crushed | 4 pounds herring fillets | 1 head romaine lettuce
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix marshmallows, peppercorns, and herring. Arrange herring fillets on a platter. Dip in warm syrup. Spread marshmallow mixture onto fillets, and decorate with a couple of lettuce leaves.

title: Quick & Easy Refried Beans
ingredients: 4 cans refried beans ( any flavor ) | 1 bunch flat leaf parsley, chopped
instructions: Place an 8 inch heavy skillet on a warm burner on the stove.. In a single, heatproof serving dish or bowl, stir the beans until heated through, about 1 minute each time. Remove from the burner, stir in the parsley and serve immediately.

title: Quick and Easy Rice Noodle Broth
ingredients: 3 cups rice noodles, cleaned & washed | 1 envelope orange flower water
instructions: Combine 3 cups of rice noodles with 1 envelope of orange flower water in small pot and add to boiling water. When the water returns to a boil, reduce the heat and simmer, covered, for 20 - 25 minutes, until noodles are tender. When noodle is tender, remove from the heat and toss the noodles with 2/3 of the broth.

Random Ingredients: white pepper,coleslaw mix,bay leaf,black olive,beef chuck,white sugar,chinese five spice powder,wheat hamburger bun
title: Hawaiian Sloppy Joes
ingredients: 1 cup shredded coleslaw mix | 1 package hawaiian sweet roll hamburger buns, split | 1/3 pound ground beef chuck | 1/4 cup chopped black olives | 1 tablespoon white sugar | 1 teaspoon chinese five-spice powder | 1 bay leaf | 1/8 teaspoon white pepper
instructions: Preheat an oven to 375 degrees f. Combine coleslaw mix and ground chuck in a large bowl. Add black olives, sugar, hot chinese five spice powder, and bay leaf. Mix until evenly distributed. Spread meat mixture evenly on a large baking sheet. Bake in preheated oven until burgers are cooked to desired doneness, about 20 minutes, flipping occasionally. Brush tops of bun with olive oil, and serve with meat mixture.

Random Ingredients: self rising flour,almond essence,breadcrumb,black olive,turkey,cumin,oregano sprig
title: Moroccan Stuffed Turkey
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs ground turkey | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric | 1/2 teaspoon garlic-infused ground cumin | 1/2 teaspoon minced fresh oregano or 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano, crushed | 1/3 cup finely chopped pitted black olives | 3/4 cup coarsely chopped self-rising flour | 2 1/2 cups toasted breadcrumbs | 1/4 cup chopped fresh oregano or 1/4 dried oregano, crushed | fresh oregano sprig ( optional ) or parsley sprig ( optional )
instructions: Mix all ingredients together till the turkey is thoroughly incorporated. Shape the turkey mixture into one inch balls. Bake at 450 degrees f for 13 minutes, reduce the temperature to 325 degrees f and bake for an additional 30 minutes or till internal temperature of meat is 165 degrees f. Remove from the oven and serve with salad or a vegetable side.

title: Easy Basic Tomato-Bake
ingredients: 1 ripe plum tomato, seeded and chopped | 1 1/2 teaspoons baking powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 500 degrees. Pour tomatoes into oiled 8 inch cast iron skillet. Bake tomatoes for about 15 to 25 minutes or until skins are wrinkled. While they are baking, heat the remaining 1 1/2 teaspoons baking powder in a small heavy frying pan. Cook over medium heat, stirring, until a darker puddle of tomatoes forms. Pour off any oil that forms on the sides of the pan. Pour sauce into a container large enough to hold the tomatoes in a single layer. Place cooked tomatoes and garlic cloves in the sauce. Heat for about 5 minutes or until the garlic is just starting to melt into the sauce.

title: Homemade Lavender Salt
ingredients: 1/4 cup whole black peppercorns | 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt | 1 teaspoon black pepper
instructions: Dry roast in a 300 degree f oven until browned, 10 to 15 minutes. Remove from oven and rinse with cool water. Soak peppercorns for 45 minutes. Dry roast on paper towels. Sprinkle salt and pepper generously over the top of the coarsely chopped roasted lavender. Cut into pieces and serve.

Random Ingredients: rice flour,tilapia fillet,locatelli cheese,sherry wine,onion,cannellini bean,broccoli
title: Tilapia With White Clam Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb tilapia fillet | 1 can cannellini beans, undrained | 1 medium onion, coarsely chopped | 2 cups broccoli cuts | 1/4 cup rice flour | 3 tablespoons dry sherry wine | 1 cup shredded locatelli cheese
instructions: Combine beans and next 3 ingredients in a large pan, cover with water and bring to a boil. Cook 4 - 5 minutes. Meanwhile, wash fillets. Pat dry with paper towels. Dredge in rice flour and shake off any excess. Place fillets in a 9x13 baking dish. In a bowl combine white clams with tomato sauce.

title: Cheesy Pudding
ingredients: 6 cups water | 4 ounces part skim milk powder | 8 ounces sour cream or 8 ounces yogurt | 5 ounces shredded part-skim mozzarella cheese | 1 1/2 teaspoons cream of tartar
instructions: For the creamy pudding, pour boiling water over the skim milk powder and stir until no lumps remain. Add sour cream and cheese. Stir until thoroughly mixed. Pour into 9x13 baking dish and add water if necessary to reach cover the pudding. Bake at 350 for 30 minutes and then uncover for 15 minutes. Top with whipped cream or sliced whole wheat bread and more mozzarella cheese to serve.

Random Ingredients: ginger garlic paste,coconut oil,savory,pecan,mexican cheese,self rising flour,cocoa
title: Pecan Mexican Cheese Cookies
ingredients: 1 cup self-rising flour | 1 cup shredded mexican blend cheese, divided ( cheddar, jack, and mexican mix ) | 1/2 cup coconut oil ( canola ) | 1 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 1/2 teaspoon ground savory | 1/2 cup pecans, chopped ( optional ) | 1 -2 tablespoon unsweetened cocoa ( optional )
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a bowl. Form the dough into walnut sized balls, dip them into the cocoa and place on a parchment lined cookie sheet. To bake, place at 350 degrees and let them cook for about 15 to 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: chicken leg,red food coloring,phyllo dough,water chestnut
title: Poulet a La Bière--Bouillon Chicken Legs
ingredients: 12 chicken legs, legs attached | 2 cups water chestnuts, drained, chopped ( optional ) | 6 tablespoons red food coloring or 6 tablespoons black food coloring, of your choice | 3 sheets phyllo dough, thawed
instructions: Wash and dry chicken legs. Place legs in a large, deep frying pan or dutch oven. Combine water chestnuts and 2 tablespoons of green food coloring in a small bowl. Place chicken legs in pan. Using a slotted spoon, remove any cartilege or bones from the chicken legs. Arrange chicken legs in a single layer around the outer edges of the pan or a lid. Spread 1 1/2 tablespoons of green food coloring over chicken legs. Cover and reduce heat to low. Cook for 40 - 45 minutes, or until meat registers 165 degrees f in the thickest part of thigh. Cover with lid, reduce heat to minimum and cook 10 minutes. Uncover. Cook, undisturbed, until the coating is dark and bubbly. Remove cover and let stand 5 minutes. Uncover, cook about 5 mins, or until coating is light and bubbly again. Remove from heat. If the coating is a little too solid, cover with a piece of foil for cooking. Cut diagonally into 4 equal portions. To serve, remove chicken legs from pan and arrange in a serving bowl. Pour accumulated juices from cooking pan over chicken. Taste for seasoning, adding more green color if desired. Serve.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon cube,vanilla extract,sage,tomato salsa,kielbasa,yellow onion,ouzo
title: Mexican Kielbasa Recipe
ingredients: 3 1/2 lbs kielbasa, cubed | 1 can tomato salsa | 1 teaspoon ouzo | 1 teaspoon pure vanilla extract | 1 onion, diced | 2 beef bouillon cubes | 1 1/4 teaspoons oregano or 1/4 teaspoon rosemary
instructions: Preheat oven to 350f degrees. Place all ingredients in a 13 x 9 x 2 baking dish, or a roasting dish. Cover and bake 1 hour at 350°f or until kielbasa cubes are browned and onions are tender.

Random Ingredients: miracle whip,cremini mushroom,beef bouillon cube,cream chicken soup,tomato sauce mushroom,chili bean sauce
title: Quick 'n Easy Beef Burgundy
ingredients: 1 beef bouillon cube | 1 teaspoon sweet chili bean sauce ( or other chili seasoning with a high moisture ) | 1 can tomato sauce with mushrooms | 2 teaspoons miracle whip ( or creamy peanut butter ) | 1 ounce canned gravy or ( 10 ounce ) cream of chicken soup | 1 can cremini mushrooms ( drained )
instructions: Place beef in skillet with bouillon and sweet chili bean sauce or other chili seasoning.

Random Ingredients: portabella mushroom,black pepper,spicy mustard,msg,bamboo shoot,navy bean
title: Spicy Baked Beans & Mushroom
ingredients: 1 can navy beans, rinsed and drained ( 2 cups ) | 1/2 lb fresh portabella mushroom | 1 can bamboo shoots | 2 teaspoons spicy mustard | 1/2 teaspoon black pepper | 1/8 teaspoon msg ( optional )
instructions: Chop and measure mushrooms. Drain beans well. Add mushrooms and mushrooms to bean mixture. Cover and bake for about 30 minutes at 375 degrees. Remove from oven and allow to cool for a few minutes. Place 1/2 cup baked beans and mushrooms mixture in a large oven proof dish. Cover and bake about 20 minutes at 375 degrees.

Random Ingredients: cool whip,chicken,garlic salt,italian seasoning,yellow onion,egg,wheat bread
title: Puffy Italian Chicken
ingredients: 2 - 2 1/2 lbs cooked chicken | 2 eggs ( slightly beaten ) | 1/4 cup plain breadcrumbs | 1/4 cup low-fat cool whip | 1 1/2 teaspoons garlic salt | 1 teaspoon italian seasoning | 1/2 cup yellow onion ( diced )
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and put in casserole dish for a few to three hours at 350 degrees or until it is cooked throughout. Note, do not use microwave bags and only cook in microwave.

title: French Bread Chocolate Mousse
ingredients: 1 loaf french bread | 1 jar white chocolate | 1/2 cup prepared sweet-and-sour mix
instructions: Cut the french bread into long, thin slices. Insert a toothpick in each slice, and place them under a hot tap. Sprinkle chocolate over the top, and let the chocolate melt. When chocolate is melted, stir in sweet and sour mix. Pour onto the hot french bread slices.

title: Spicy Shrimp Broccoli Salad
ingredients: 10 ounces small broccoli | 14 ounces florets fresh blueberries or 14 ounces frozen blueberries | 1 orange bell pepper, sliced | 1 lb large shrimp, cooked
instructions: Wash and trim broccoli, then coarsely chop the stems. Steam or cook broccoli and blueberries just until tender crisp. Drain all, then toss with shrimps and dressing. Serve warm.

title: Red Cabbage Revelation
ingredients: 1 head red cabbage, shredded | 50 g pickled pimento pepper, diced | 50 g diced dried apricots in jam | 1 3/4 teaspoons cider vinegar
instructions: Simmer cabbage in a very low oven for about 30 minutes. Add remaining ingredients and cook for another 20 minutes. Variation use black pepper.

title: Rice Stuffed Sausages
ingredients: 5 hot italian sausage | 1 package arborio rice
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Split the sausage lengthwise and remove the casings. Cook the sausage on a cast iron skillet or cast iron griddle alongside the rice. Cook until evenly browned, about 25 minutes. While the sausage is cooking, drain the fat from the pan on a paper towel. Bring the pan juices to a boil.

title: Fried Tortilla (Zwt Three)
ingredients: 4 small tortillas | 2 -3 tablespoons habanero peppers or 2 -3 tablespoons other hot pepper ( hot or mild )
instructions: Heat a wok until hot. Turn your tortilla over and put some of the hot pepper into the centre and spread out the contents. Wet the edge with a little water and dip it into the water, allowing it to drip through the egg roll. Roll the tortilla into a cone and place a cone on top of the tortilla. Repeat for each tortilla. After cooking all tortillas you have done, place in paper bags and freeze. When ready to use, remove from freezer. Heat up the frying pan.

title: Fried Bok Choy
ingredients: 2 1/2 - 3 lbs bok choy | 1 cup gluten-free flour, for coating
instructions: Cut large leaves off the top of each bok choy so they will not break. Cut lengthwise down into 2 inch lengths and place into a bowl of cold water. Bring 2 quarts of water to a boil and add the bok choy. Cover and reduce heat. Cook for 6 to 7 minutes, or until tender. Drain in a colander, then cool under running water. Remove as much water as possible and squeeze to remove any grit. Cut into 1 squares. Cover and keep warm. To fry, heat a 2 count of oil on a skillet over medium heat. Fry bread squares 1 at a time for 2 to 3 minutes on each side. Drain on paper towels and serve warm with nuoc cham.

Random Ingredients: asparagus,onion powder,hot italian sausage,chocolate,brown rice,maple syrup,black peppercorn,jalapeno pepper
title: Baked Chocolate Sweet and Sour Italian Sausage
ingredients: 1/2 pound hot italian sausage, casings removed | 1 pound fresh asparagus, trimmed and cut into 1 1/2 inch pieces | 1 jar roasted skinless hot italian sausage | 1/4 cup maple syrup | 1/3 cup dry-roasted unsalted sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, finely chopped | 1/4 cup finely chopped sweet onion powder | 1 tablespoon dried minced jalapeno pepper | 1/2 teaspoon crushed black peppercorns
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Arrange a rack in the middle of the oven and heat the oven to 450 degrees. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook the fresh asparagus in the boiling water until just crisp tender, about 3 minutes. Drain. Transfer the hot sausage to a large bowl and crumble into the bowl with the asparagus. Stir in the asparagus, heated maple syrup, sun dried tomatoes, sweet onion powder, jalapeno pepper, and pepper. Transfer to a 9x13 inch baking pan. Bake the sausage and sweet onion mixture in the oven until the sausage is browned slightly and the flavors have blended, about 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: greek yogurt,rice vinegar,pecorino romano cheese,cherry tomato,elbow macaroni,chili garlic sauce,marinara sauce,icing sugar
title: Pecorino Pasta Bake
ingredients: 4 cups uncooked cooked elbow macaroni ( or use whole wheat if desired ) | 1 jar marinara sauce | 4 tablespoons greek yogurt | 4 tablespoons icing sugar | 1 tablespoon chili-garlic sauce or 1 tablespoon minced garlic | 4 ounces shredded pecorino romano cheese | 1 tablespoon rice vinegar | fresh cherry tomatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 f. Place noodles in a large mixing bowl. Add sauce and yogurt. Stir until well combined. Add icing sugar, chili garlic sauce or minced garlic. Stir until well blended, then add cheese and stir until cheese is spreadable. Spoon into a lightly greased 10 inch square cake pan or a larger 2 quart casserole dish. Cover with foil. Bake for 30 minutes. Take foil off and score top with a knife or razor blade. Turn oven off. Let bake 5 minutes more, then take out of the oven. Let cool. Remove sides of foil, then drizzle with some of the sauce. Cover and refrigerate until serving time. Serve with cherry tomatoes and fresh basil. Note.

Random Ingredients: asparagus,monterey jack pepper cheese,metal skewer,farina,corn tortilla,cardamom,chicken bouillon,tomato bouillon chicken flavor
title: Pasta With Asparagus Soup
ingredients: 5 cups fresh asparagus, trimmed and coarsely chopped | 2 cups farina | 6 tablespoons chicken bouillon | 1 teaspoon instant chicken bouillon | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1 loaf round corn tortilla, cut into 1/2 inch slices and cut crosswise into 1/2 inch slices | 12 slices monterey jack pepper cheese, cut into 1/4 inch slices | 9 large tomatos, halved | 12 wooden skewers, cut into 4 pieces
instructions: Combine asparagus, farina, chicken bouillon, cardamom, and 2 cups water in a large stockpot over high heat. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to medium.

title: Chipotle Salt
ingredients: 1 cup fresh herbs | 1 -2 chipotle chile ( depending on the heat of your dried spices )
instructions: Basically, just combine all ingredients and use 1 - 2 tablespoons of the salt for each type of salt you use. Enjoy.

title: Indian Tuna and Lentil Pasta Balls and Ricotta
ingredients: 1 package fennel seeds | 4 ounces cooked rice flour ( or other white flour ) | 14 ounces light tuna ( such as low-fat extra firm ) or 14 ounces smoked salmon, finely chopped | 5 ounces canned green chilies, finely chopped | 1/4 cup cannellini beans, rinsed and drained ( or other white beans ) | 3 -5 ounces low fat ricotta cheese
instructions: Cook fennel seeds in boiling water for about 5 minutes or until lightly browned. Transfer to sieve until cool. Using hands or a mortar and pestle, mash fennel and rice flour into fine grains using a grinding motion. Add tuna, chilies and beans and mix. Using your hands form mixture into walnut sized balls. Place on lightly buttered baking tray. Using the back of a spoon, press gently to flatten into oblong casserole. Bake on middle shelf of 180 degrees celsius for about 30 minutes until golden.

Random Ingredients: maraschino cherry,poundcake,apple pie filling,pear,dark sesame oil
title: Pear-Sealed Pound Cake
ingredients: 2 apples - peeled, cored and sliced into 1/4-inch | 2 pounds poundcake, cut into squares | 1 can pear filling | 1/2 cup dark sesame oil | 1 jar maraschino cherries, drained and rinsed
instructions: Pour the sesame oil into a large skillet and set over medium heat. Stir in the apples, pear filling, and the cherries. Bring to a simmer, then immediately remove from heat. Cover and marinate overnight in the refrigerator, to blend the flavors.

title: Simple Italian Peanut Butter (No Salt) Cheese Ball
ingredients: 1 package cream cheese ( not reduced fat ) | 1 package of dry italian salad dressing mix | 1 1/2 - 2 teaspoons grated fresh lemon rind | 3 cups fine oatmeal
instructions: In a large bowl, mix the cream cheese, salad dressing mix and lemon rind. Add the oatmeal and mix. Knead for 2 - 3 minutes, then divide into 4 smaller balls. Refrigerate and use within 2 weeks.

Random Ingredients: peppercorn,dill,parsley flake,black tea,raspberry,sirloin,pumpkin seed,red chili pepper
title: Chicana
ingredients: 2 lbs sirloin, cut into small pieces | 1 medium red chili pepper, finely chopped | 6 -8 dill, chopped | 2 tablespoons parsley flakes | 1 tablespoon peppercorn, ground in a spice grinder | 1 teaspoon dried red chili pepper, crushed | 10 cups homemade strong black tea, hot from reciappe | 1 1/2 cups seedless raspberry jam or 1 1/2 cups seedless raspberry jam
instructions: Place the sirloin in a large bowl and add the chile and 1/4 cup of dill, parsley, peppercorns, and 1 1/2 cups of the hot tea. Stir to combine and set aside. Prepare the rum infusion in a large pot with 4 cups of hot water. Add 2 tablespoons of jam to the pot. Bring to a boil and boil briefly. Strain and discard the solids, if you wish. Use spanish brown coffee for extra flavor, such as the chocolenco syrup. Heat 2 cups of the rum infused oil in a heavy saucepan. Add the sirloin pieces and brown on all sides turning as needed. When the sirloin is browned remove all but 2 tablespoons of the oil from the skillet. Add the remaining 3 cups of rum, the reserved rum infusion, red chile, remaining dill, and remaining 2 cups of rum. Continue to simmer for 5 minutes, or until the liquid has reduced. Remove the sirloin, add 2 more cups of the rum, and simmer for 5 minutes, until the meat is thoroughly cooked. Place in a large serving bowl and chill for at least one hour. Skewer the sirloin pieces alternating with 8 pieces of raspberry or raspberry jam. If you’re concerned about any spills, serve with a wedge of the chilled rum infused cream.

title: Auberge Grape Tomato Ice Cream
ingredients: 8 ounces grape tomatoes, sliced | 1 ounce light agave syrup | 2/3 cup double cream | fresh nutmeg, to sprinkle | black pepper, to sprinkle
instructions: Blanch the tomatoes and syrup in a pan of boiling water for 3 - 4 minutes until the skins wrinkle and the water is reduced. Remove the skins and chill for 1 - 2 hours. Put the cream in a bowl and beat it with a pinch of freshly ground nutmeg and black pepper. Season with salt and freshly ground black pepper then stir in the grape tomatoes and their syrup. Spoon the mixture into an ovenproof dish and cook in the oven at 190c/375f/gas mark 3 for 5 - 8 minutes until the base of the ice cream is set and lightly golden. Leave to stand for 5 minutes before scooping up and running a knife between the layers of custard. Serve with a little freshly ground nutmeg sprinkled on top.

title: Aussie Pineapple, Black Bean, Rice & Mac
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked macaroni | 4 cups watercress, loosely packed | 1 cup pineapple chunks, flaked | 1 can black beans, rinsed and drained | 2 tablespoons oatmeal | 1 loaf crusty bread, such as ciabatta
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f in a large bowl mix the macaroni with the watercress, pineapple, beans, oatmeal & bread until coated. Cook on a baking sheet in one layer for 20 minutes, turn, and cook for an additional 5 minutes.

title: Russian Lemonade
ingredients: 2 cups besan ( optional ) | lemonade
instructions: Mix 1 cup of besan with 1/2 cup of hot water and pour into a 2 1/2 oz glass jar. When cold add a few drops of lemonade to the top. You can store the remaining mixture in the refrigerator for up to 2 weeks.

Random Ingredients: chili paste,jalapeno chilies,scallion,baby spinach,cooking oil,turnip,red potato
title: Potato and Spinach Stir Fry With Hot Chili Sauce
ingredients: 3 medium red potatoes | 1 cup raw diced turnip | 1 bunch scallion | 12 ounces baby spinach ( 1 cup ) | 4 inches fresh jalapeno chilies, sliced 1/2 inch thick | 2 tablespoons cooking oil | 2 -3 tablespoons hot chili paste
instructions: Chop scallions. Dice potatoes, turnip, and chilies. Heat oil in wok. Add onions and stir fry until just starting to turn translucent add potatoes, chilies, and stir fry until the potatoes are almost cooked, 2 - 3 minutes add spinach, stir fry 2 minutes. Add hot chili paste, mix and serve over rice.

title: Mango and Coriander Chutney
ingredients: 1 mango, washed, peeled and very finely diced | 1 teaspoon black cumin, powdered ( or 1/2 tbsp. ground cumin and 1/4 tsp. paprika ) | coriander powder, to garnish ( optional )
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a bowl. Chill. Garnish with sliced coriander leaves. Serve with bread pita pieces.

title: Cracklins
ingredients: 5 pounds fresh crabmeat | 3 pounds fresh cracked black peppers
instructions: Place crabmeat into a large, deep pan, and season with black pepper. Cover, and let marinate in refrigerator for at least 2 hours. Preheat an outdoor grill for medium heat, and lightly oil the grate. Grill the crabmeat in the grill for about 15 minutes, just long enough to break apart. An instant read thermometer inserted into one end of the crabmeat can be inserted easily into the crabmeat for easy removing. Serve immediately. Crabmeat can be frozen for up to 3 months.

Random Ingredients: cooking oil,garlic powder,mustard seed,bacon,collard green,grain white rice,veal,malt vinegar
title: Collard Greens with Mustard Glaze
ingredients: 3 cups fresh collard greens - rinsed and trimmed | 1/2 pound bacon, chopped | 1 tablespoon cooking oil | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds | 1 1/2 cups uncooked long grain white rice | 1/3 cup malt vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder | 1/2 pound lean ground veal
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add collard greens, and cook for 6 to 8 minutes, or until tender. Drain and set aside. Place bacon in a large skillet over medium high heat, and cook for about 5 minutes, until evenly browned. Remove from heat, and set aside to cool. In a measuring cup, mix together the mustard seeds and vinegar. Stir in the reserved mustard. Bring water to a boil in a pot. Mix in rice, and return to a boil. Reduce heat, and simmer for 20 minutes. Mix in the chopped bacon, veal, and the mustard glaze. Place greens back into the pan, and cook until hot.

title: Lettuce-Wrapped Beef Sausages
ingredients: 4 large pork shoulder, fat trimmed | 4 tablespoons fat, divided | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon chopped hot peppers, of your choice | shredded lettuce leaf | 4 radishes, thinly sliced
instructions: Slice thin and set aside. Remove excess fat from shoulder. Cut crosswise into 1/4 inch thick slices. Heat 2 tablespoons fat in a 10 inch skillet over medium heat. Sprinkle with hot peppers and cook until meat is brown on top and bottom, about 3 minutes. Remove meat and set aside with 1 tablespoon fat. Repeat with remaining fat, adding more fat, if necessary. Spread 1 tablespoon fat on work surface and sprinkle with salt. Overlap 1 to 2 slices of meat and 1 to 2 lettuce leaves. Place 1 radish slice on each leaf. Roll up tightly and secure with toothpicks or 2 toothpicks. Repeat with remaining rolls and meat slices.

title: Taco-Ish Sandwich (For One)
ingredients: 3 cups quick-cooking oats, dry or unbleached, quick-cooking oats | 1 1/2 - 2 cups panko breadcrumbs ( if you prefer soft breadcrumbs, use a whole wheat panko breadcrumb or a similar ) | 1 cup chopped green chili | 1/4 - 1/2 cup pepper, chopped drained, bottled | 2 cups shredded swiss or italian cheese blend, for topping
instructions: Mix oats, panko, green peppers, and 1/4 cup of the cheese together in a bowl. Pat 1 cup of the mixture on the bottom of a 9 x 9 inch, ungreased baking dish of your choice. Sprinkle 1/2 cup of the cheese over the spread. Repeat with the remaining bread crumb mixture and/or cheese. Cover with foil. Heat oven to 325 degrees. Bake for 45 - 50 minutes, until bread is crisp and cheese is melted.

title: Fennel Chicken
ingredients: 4 lbs boneless skinless chicken thighs, cut in half | 4 tablespoons margarine ( or nonstick cooking spray ) | 1 can great northern beans, rinsed and drained | 2 fennel bulbs, trimmed and cut into thirds
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Season chicken with salt and pepper. Melt margarine in a large roasting pan over medium heat. Brown chicken in hot butter and drain off the fat. Add beans and the fennel. Cook, stirring often, until beans are tender, about 5 minutes. Arrange the chicken pieces, skin side up, in a roasting pan. Pour the remaining margarine over the chicken. Place in a preheated oven and bake, uncovered, for 30 minutes. Remove and tent with foil.

Random Ingredients: cauliflower floret,mace blade,beef tenderloin,self raising flour
title: Beef Tenderloins with Souse
ingredients: 2 lbs beef tenderloin, trimmed | 1 1/3 lbs cauliflower florets, separated | 2 lbs self-raising flour | 1/4 teaspoon mace blade
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees celcius. Remove fat sachet from tip of knife. Rinse beef, pat dry, and cut into 4 lengths across the grain. Place in roasting dish. Cut cauliflower floretts into 4 pieces, then place in roasting dish. Toss the flour and mace blade into large mixing bowl, then rub flour into the tip of the knife. Toss beef in mixture. Sprinkle evenly with remaining flour, then place on top of cauliflower and cauliflower. Drizzle with a little water, cover and cook in the oven for 2 hours. Leave to stand for 10 minutes before carving. Serve with sauce or gravy.

Random Ingredients: red chili powder,taco seasoning,turmeric powder,molasses,white flour,chipotle chile adobo
title: Chipotle Taco Fritters (Copycat)
ingredients: 3 tablespoons molasses | 3 tablespoons taco seasoning | 3/4 teaspoon red chili powder | 2 -4 chipotle chiles in adobo | 2 -3 tablespoons white flour | 1 pinch turmeric powder
instructions: In small pot heat the molasses and taco seasoning. Cook for about 2 - 3 minutes, then stir, and add chili, and chipoltes. Pour over your fritters. Toss together so both sides are coated. Place on a rack or baking sheet to cool. Use as directed in your recipe, and keep the fritters refrigerated. Note, to make ahead can also be frozen up to 2 months.

title: Stilton Guacamole
ingredients: 6 -8 small avocados | olive oil | vinegar | 1 teaspoon olive oil | 1/4 teaspoon sugar | 1 teaspoon italian seasoning
instructions: Slice avocados, remove pits and slice very thinly. Add to serving platter. Drizzle with 1/4 tsp olive oil, 1/4 tsp vinegar, 1/4 tsp sugar, 1/4 tsp italian spice. Drizzle remaining 1/4 tsp oil over guacamole and serve right away.

title: Lapouts (Swiss Cauliflower and Rhubarb)
ingredients: 1 large head cauliflower, broken into 1 florets | 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, chopped | 1 leek, sliced, white part only, thinly sliced ( white and light green parts ) | 1 cup rhubarb, sliced about 1/4 inch thick | 1/2 cup coarsely chopped fresh cranberries
instructions: Toss the cauliflower, tomatoes and leeks in a large bowl until coated with oil. Let stand for 30 minutes to allow the flavors to combine. Toss the rhubarb, cajun seasoning and cranberries in a large bowl. Add the salad dressing.

Random Ingredients: sesame seed,vanilla essence,cream chicken soup,taco sauce
title: Nacho Dip
ingredients: 150 ml cream of chicken soup | 2 tablespoons taco sauce | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence | 1 tablespoon sesame seeds
instructions: Combine all of the ingredients in a bowl, add more if desired. Enjoy.

title: Corn with Parsley
ingredients: 2 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley leaves | 1 1/2 cups frozen corn kernels
instructions: Place the corn kernels in a food processor.

Random Ingredients: grain white rice,fennel seed,coriander seed,mustard seed,graham cracker crumb,vinegar,tart apple
title: Apple Rice With Nuts and Fennel
ingredients: 1/2 cup graham cracker crumbs | 1/2 cup finely chopped tart apple | 2/3 cup peeled shredded cored fresh ginger ( about 4 ounces ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons mustard seeds | 1 1/2 teaspoons coriander seeds | 1 1/2 teaspoons fennel seeds | 1 1/4 cups long grain white rice | 1/2 - 3/4 cup vinegar
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f. Arrange graham cracker crumbs in an 8x8 inch baking pan. Top evenly with apple, ginger, mustard seeds, coriander and fennel seeds. In an electric skillet, heat rice and vinegar over medium heat until almost dry, stirring constantly. Transfer to oven and bake covered for 20 - 25 minutes or until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed.

title: Cashew Beef  & Beetroot (Beef Stew)
ingredients: 3 lbs fresh beets, peeled and sliced into chunks | 1 medium yellow onion, sliced into thin wedges | 1 jar cashews, coarsely chopped | 5 cans beef broth
instructions: Place beets in a large pot of boiling water, and cook until tender, about 30 - 45 minutes, but do not over cook or they will be mushy. Drain and allow to cool to room temperature. Dice beets into small 1 1/2 inch pieces and set aside. Place onions and cashews in a large skillet and cook over medium heat until they begin to soften, about 5 - 10 minutes. Stir in beef broth and bring to a simmer. Cover and cook 30 minutes or until beets are tender but not mushy.

title: Gingery Peas (From Vegetarian Khormeh Sabzi)
ingredients: 1 lb green peas ( frozen are best ) | 2 tablespoons ginger paste ( or pure ginger, finely minced ) | 4 teaspoons green gram
instructions: Soak peas overnight. Next day boil them, just enough to have them soft enough to eat. Drain and add ginger paste, green gram and salt or turmeric powder. Mix well. Add salt and continue to boil until peas are soft, about 10 to 15 minutes stirring a few times.

title: Mustard Cranberry Bark
ingredients: 2 bunches fresh cranberries, rinsed | 1 tablespoon mustard powder
instructions: In a bowl, stir cranberries with mustard powder, shaking off any excess. Spread on toasted or toasted bagels. Refrigerate for up to 2 days.

title: Quick and Easy Lunch
ingredients: 3 slices rye bread ( i use pepperidge farm ) | 2 cans baked beans ( r.l. i use bush's )
instructions: Heat up your oven to 250 degrees f. Slice rye bread into 1/4 inch slices, then into 1/2 inch slices. Place untoasted slices onto a baking sheet. Pour the beans over the toasted bread. Bake for 5 minutes at 250 degrees f. You can eat them immediately, or place in the freezer to speed things up.

Random Ingredients: peppercorn,serrano chili pepper,cream celery soup,wine,pineapple juice,tomato,pie shell,lime
title: Spicy Shredded Pineapple Pie from Sharon
ingredients: 1 package refrigerated pie shell | 1 can condensed cream of celery soup | 1/4 cup pineapple juice | 1 tablespoon wine ( optional ) | 1 serrano chili pepper, diced ( optional ) | 1/4 cup chopped tomato ( optional ) | 2 limes, juiced and zested | 1 teaspoon cracked peppercorns
instructions: Cook pie shell according to package directions. Meanwhile, in a small bowl, stir together the creamed soup, pineapple juice, wine, chili, tomatoes and lime juice. Tear off 2 1/2 inch chunks of pineapple and return to the bowl. Stir in peppercorns. Pour into the cooled pie shell and sprinkle with paprika and/or cheese of your choice. Chill in the refrigerator for at least a few hours before serving.

Random Ingredients: dijon mustard,anaheim chilies,egg white,basil leaf,broccoli floret,black pepper
title: Roasted Chilies With Broccoli on Eggs
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs white fresh chilies, halved lengthwise and remove seeds, stems | 4 cups broccoli florets, cut into 1-inch florets | 3/4 cup reserved broccoli florets from steamer package | 1 egg white | 2 teaspoons dijon mustard | fresh ground black pepper | 2 teaspoons fresh basil leaves, minced
instructions: Heat broiler. Arrange chiles cut sides up on medium baking sheet. Arrange broiler rack 8 to 10 inches from heat. Broil until skins are blackened and blistered slightly, turning often, 2 to 3 minutes. Transfer chiles to plate. Place in plastic bag.

title: Chili Pasta
ingredients: 1 package penne | 1/4 cup chili paste | 1/4 cup cider vinegar | 1/4 cup chopped fresh coriander or 1/4 cup cilantro
instructions: Cook the pasta according to package directions, omitting salt and fat. Toss the chili paste and vinegar in a small bowl with pasta. Serve.

title: Perfect Sausage (Grilled Pork or Turkey)
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder | 1 boneless pork loin ( or turkey )
instructions: Combine garlic powder and the salt. Slice pork or poultry into small pieces. Rub salt onto the meat. Place on a grill. You don't want to cook it all the way through and just keep it moving away. Grill over medium high heat turning the meat and turning for about 5 minutes, or until nicely browned on the outside but still pink inside. Serve on buns or bun diagonally.

title: Slow Roasted Potatoes for Two
ingredients: 6 baby new potatoes, halved ( about 2-3-4-3/4 pounds ) | 1 1/2 lbs boneless beef roast | 2 tablespoons grated fresh ginger | 1 tablespoon vanilla extract
instructions: Set oven rack to middle position.

title: Kidney Bean Smoothie
ingredients: 1 can kidney beans | 2 1/2 cups soymilk
instructions: Blend all ingredients. Enjoy note, if the soymilk seems lumpsy, just add some more soymilk.

title: Key Lime Dip
ingredients: 2 cups pecorino romano cheese, finely grated | 3 tablespoons key lime juice ( about 3 key limes )
instructions: Drain grated pecorino in a sieve. In a bowl, mix grated pecorino and lime juice. Serve chilled.

title: Ginger Beer Can Pickled Peppers
ingredients: 1 cup ginger beer, chilled, cut into slices | 2 yellow bell peppers, cut into 1/2-inch pieces
instructions: Pour the ginger beer in a wide, glass jar with a tight fitting lid, and set aside at room temperature to age for 5 days, shaking the jar a few times during the chilling process. Place the yellow bell peppers into the jar, cover with water, and set aside at room temperature for 3 days, shaking a few times. Remove the pepper pieces from the water with a slotted spoon, discard the stems, and discard the skins. Transfer the pepper pieces to a jar, cover, and refrigerate for 2 days before using.

title: Chicken Noodle Kugel
ingredients: 1 package egg noodles | 3 tablespoons chicken bouillon granules | 1/4 cup vinegar
instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions. Drain. Combine bouillon and vinegar. Bring to a boil. Add noodles to boiling liquid and heat through. Serve immediately. Note, cook noodles according to package directions. Drain. Place noodles, liquid and bouillon in a 1 quart casserole and refrigerate until well chilled.

title: Chicken and Asparagus in the Oven
ingredients: 8 chicken thighs | 24 spears fresh asparagus, trimmed
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Place 6 asparagus spears on a baking sheet and drizzle them with a little olive oil. Bake the skin off of the thighs, then arrange them in a circle on the skillet. Sprinkle all 6 pieces of asparagus over the thighs. Roast in the oven for 10 minutes. The thighs should be browned and crispy to the touch. Cook them a few more minutes, then serve with more asparagus on the side.

Random Ingredients: stout beer,rose wine,tilapia fillet,non cooking spray
title: Stout Beer Battered Tilapia With Rose Wine
ingredients: 1 large fillet tilapia fillet | non stick cooking spray | 3/4 cup light irish stout beer | 3/4 cup dry rose wine
instructions: Rinse tilapia and pat dry with paper towel. Heat large non stick skillet over medium high heat. Coat with cooking spray. Season tilapia with salt and pepper. Add tilapia to the pan and cook 3 to 4 minutes per side.

title: Tofu With Banana, Panko and Mint
ingredients: 200 g panko breadcrumbs ( japanese breadcrumbs ) | 1 bunch mint, washed, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons finely chopped mixed leaves ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1/4 teaspoon caster sugar | 3 bananas, sliced | oil, to fry | 1 package ready-made toothpicks
instructions: Mix the panko with the mint, spices and sugar. Mix the bananas with the breadcrumb mixture. Add the oil into a skillet to the recommended temperature of your pancake/fry pan. Heat the pan and fry the banana on one side without any excess oil. Cook on both side until crisp. Repeat the above steps with the remaining banana until done. Drain on clean paper towels. Keep the fried bananas warm. Serve the tofu with mango chutney or pumpernickel bread and/or green vegetable.

title: Tomato and Sage Dip
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh fire-roasted tomatoes | 5 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 1/2 cup minced fresh sage
instructions: Remove the stem from the tomatoes, and using a sharp knife, make a deep cut along the sides of each tomato. Scoop out the coarse pulp and seeds, then cut the pulp into 1/2 inch wide strips. Place the tomatoes into a nonreactive nonaluminum skillet. Mash together the vinegars with 2 tablespoonfuls of hot water to form a thin paste. Gently stir the tomato pulp, crushed tomatoes, and sage into the vinegar mixture. Cook over moderate heat until the mixture is hot and slightly thickened, stirring frequently. Immediately transfer the mixture to a covered bowl and refrigerate to keep warm.

Random Ingredients: chutney,romaine lettuce,green pea,white mushroom,bacon dripping,italian seasoning,matzo meal
title: Mushroom and Matzo Salad
ingredients: 4 slices bacon drippings, divided | 4 cups small green peas | 4 cups matzo meal | 1/4 cup chutney | 1/4 teaspoon italian seasoning | 4 cups romaine lettuce, torn | 2 packages white mushrooms, sliced
instructions: In a very large skillet, cook bacon over medium high heat until crisp. With a slotted spoon, remove bacon. Add peas, matzo meal and chutney to skillet and cook, stirring constantly, for about 5 minutes or until sauce thickens. Stir in seasoning. Remove from heat. To serve, place lettuce, mushrooms, and crumbled bacon on lettuce, mushrooms and bacon. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: egg,porcini mushroom,banana pepper,fennel seed,romaine lettuce,caraway seed,allspice,mushroom
title: Tasty Mushrooms Fried on Greens
ingredients: 1/2 lb red fresno mushroom | 1/2 lb banana pepper ( small dice ) | 6 tablespoons minced fresh mushrooms | 1 tablespoon caraway seed ( whole ) | 1/2 tablespoon fennel seed ( whole or whole ) | 1/2 tablespoon fennel seed | 1/4 teaspoon ground caraway seed | 1/4 teaspoon ground allspice | 1 hard-cooked egg, shelled and coarsely chopped | 1 head romaine lettuce, shredded
instructions: Clean the mushrooms, slice off the stem, and set aside. Cut away the root end of the fresno mushrooms and discard. Cut caps into 1 inch chunks and cut the stems off. Slice the caps very thinly and set aside. Scoop out the stems from the mushrooms. Cut into 1 1/2 inch cubes. Blanch the mushrooms for 1 minute in boiling salted water. Drain. Remove and discard the stems and finely chop. Heat 1 1/2 tablespoons hot butter oil in a large skillet or wok. When the foam subsides, add the minced mushrooms and the mushrooms. Stir fry for one minute. Add all the marinade ingredients except the green. Stir fry a few seconds and add the green. Turn off the heat. Scramble the egg in a bowl and scramble. Serve the green, egg, mushrooms and gravy in a small serving bowl.

title: Grilled Bratwurst and Coconut Ziti
ingredients: 2 packages crumbled ziti pasta | 1 cup crumbled coconut oil | 1/4 cup kirsch | 1/4 cup fresh lime juice | 1 can baby corn, drained | 1/4 cup chopped fresh basil | 12 fresh bratwurst, thinly sliced
instructions: Heat a grill pan over medium high heat. Brush the grill pan with coconut oil and arrange the ziti in it, cook 3 to 4 minutes, or until lightly browned. Remove the pan from the heat and stir in the kirsch, lime juice, baby corn and basil. Arrange the bratwurst on top and serve.

title: Curri Style Peas
ingredients: 3 cups fresh green peas or 3 cups frozen green pea | 3/4 cup dried fenugreek seeds | 1/4 cup red onion, sliced | 1/4 cup superfine sugar ( optional )
instructions: Boil peas 3 - 4 minutes until tender, drain well. Stir in fenugreek and onion and cook over moderate heat 1 min until onion is softened. Remove from heat. Cool 3 - 5 minutes, and stir in sugar.

Random Ingredients: garlic clove,garam masala powder,vegetable bouillon cube,sea salt
title: Indian-Spiced Vegetable (Tamarind) Pickles
ingredients: 2 garlic cloves ( crushed in a mortar and pestle ) | 1 vegetable bouillon cube, maggi vegetable and onion flavored | 1 teaspoon garam masala powder ( or more ) | sea salt
instructions: Wash the jar of tamarind thoroughly. The easiest method is to take a square of waxed paper and put on a towel to soak a hole in it. Pour the bottle of tamarind into the hole you soaked it inches turn the paper over to coat the inside. Take the paper and soak it in the tamind for another 12 hours, stirring every 5 – 7 hours. Afterwards, if you like a thinner, more consistent mix will appear in the end. Transfer to a bowl, cover and set to one side. After 24 hours you can transfer the ingredients from the bag to the fridge or place in the refrigerator for up to 4 days. Tamarind pickles keep in an airtight container at room temperature for up to a week.

title: Gramma Ruth's German Potato Salad
ingredients: 4 large red potatoes, cooked and cubed | 2 cups shredded red cabbage | 1 can pepperoni, cut into strips | 1/2 cup raisins | 1/4 cup red potatoes, chopped | 1/4 cup sesame seeds | 1/3 cup chocolate chips
instructions: Combine the cabbage, pepperoni, raisins, and red potatoes into a large salad bowl. Sprinkle with sesame seeds. Top with the chocolate chips. Microwave, uncovered, on high for 2 minutes. Remove and let stand for 2 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 1 lb fresh whole wheat flour | 2 lbs beef tenderloin, trimmed | 6 tablespoons creamy peanut butter, creamy variety of natural | 1 pint fresh blueberries or 1 pint fresh strawberries
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Place flour in large shallow dish. Dredge beef in flour. Place beef on surface of flour and spread evenly with peanut butter. Place berries on beef and top with remaining 3 tablespoons peanut butter, spreading to cover and making sure beef is well coated. Bake 45 minutes. When done, internal temperature should be 160f. Let sit 10 minutes before slicing. Let stand for 10 minutes before slicing. Serve with fresh hot green salad and crisp green salad.

title: Vietnamese Beef and Coconut Soup
ingredients: 2 lbs top round steaks | 4 cups fish sauce | 1 can coconut cream | 3 kaffir lime leaves, torn into pieces
instructions: In slow cooker, place steak. Pour fish sauce over steak. Cover. Cook on high setting 10 to 12 hours. Stir coconut cream into soup. Stir lime leaves into soup. Cover. Cook on high setting 15 to 20 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Easy Steak Fajitas
ingredients: 75 g red capsicums | 250 g eel steaks | 4 tablespoons picante sauce
instructions: Heat frying pan, adding a little oil if needed. Cut eel steak into strips. Place in fry pan with medium heat. Cook. Flip eel strips over and stir. Cook for 30 seconds. Repeat. Serve with pico de gallo and refried beans.

title: Fresh Vegetables Au Jus
ingredients: 5 firm summer mushrooms | 3 -4 tablespoons chickpeas, drained and rinsed ( or more ) | 150 g baby greens | 1 courgette, cut into 6 even slices
instructions: Heat a griddle or frying pan and dry fry the mushrooms, keeping the flames hot. Tip in the chickpeas, toss to coat and keep warm. Meanwhile, line a roasting tin with greaseproof paper. Place in a heat proof dish large enough to allow vegetables to be undercooked. Spoon over the mushrooms and toss gently so everything is coated. Cook for 15 minutes or until mushrooms just start to soften. Spoon onto a platter and serve with grated parmesan.

title: Pecorino Cheese Crusted Turkey With Pecorino Crumb Topping
ingredients: 1 turkey breast, skin, fat and other excess fat trimmed off | 1/4 cup pecorino romano cheese, fresh shavings, coarsely grated | 3/4 cup pecorino romano cheese, fresh shavings, coarsely grated, about 1/2 cup
instructions: In a small bowl toss the pecorino with the 2 tablespoons grated pecorino and season to taste. Sprinkle the turkey with the pecorino/pecorino. Preheat the oven to 250°. Wrap the turkey snugly with foil and bake until the turkey is hot and the exterior has begun getting crisp, about 1 hour 15 minutes. Let the turkey sit on a cutting board for 10 minutes. Transfer a 14 inch pizza pan at least 10 inches deep on a work surface, large dish, or a small plate. Arrange 2 pieces of aluminum foil atop the dough, allowing both sides of the turkey to touch. Place the two slices of turkey at bottom of the pan over the top and, using the reserved 1/2 cup of grated cheese, press the cheese into the surface of the turkey.

Random Ingredients: milk chocolate,monterey jack cheese,parmigiano reggiano cheese,grain rice
title: Microwave Rice Timbales
ingredients: 2 cups whole milk chocolate, melted | 2 cups long grain rice, well rinsed | 1/2 cup freshly shaved parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1/2 cup grated monterey jack cheese
instructions: In a large glass measuring cup, combine the melted chocolate with about 1 cup of the rice, and stir until blended. Stir in the parmigiano and monterey jack cheeses. Pour mixture into 4 ramekins, or an 8'' x 5'' x 2'' glass, and place ramekins on a baking sheet lined with wax or parchment paper. Freeze until firm, about 3 hours. Transfer the timbales to a cutting board, and slice into 1/2'' x 1'' bars. Store the timbales in an airtight tin for up to a week.

Random Ingredients: fire tomato,iceberg lettuce,garlic head,white onion,tuna brine,monterey jack cheese,stewing beef,beef tip
title: Steak Salad
ingredients: 1 loaf iceberg lettuce | 7 1/2 ounces tuna in brine ( drained ) | 2 large steak ( cut in strips ) | 2 beef tips | 8 ounces monterey jack cheese ( sliced ) | 2 white onions | 6 ounces fire-roasted tomatoes | 3 large garlic heads
instructions: Slice the lettuce in half and remove the outer leaves. Chop the meat and place on lettuce in individual bowls. Add one piece of cheese, one slice of onion and one piece of tomato to each plate and sprinkle with 2 to 3 teaspoons of the pwdr. Stuff this little stack with the tuna and one or two slices of beef on top of each piece of cheese and onion. Pour the fire roasted tomatoes over everything, cover and chill for several hours or overnight until serving.

title: Italian Sausage and Mixed Berry Salad
ingredients: 1 lb bulk italian sausage ( casings removed ) | 12 ounces mixed berry ( cut into 1-inch cubes with 4 cups of fresh b ) | 3/4 cup frozen mixed berries, thawed | 1 teaspoon light rum flavoring ( i use almond flavoring ) ( optional )
instructions: Cook sausage in a 12 inch nonstick skillet, breaking up sausage with a fork, over medium heat until crumbly, about 5 minutes. Remove sausage.

Random Ingredients: trout fillet,mustard powder,white wine vinegar,italian bread
title: Roasted Italian Bread Salad
ingredients: 1/4 cup mustard powder | 1/4 cup white wine vinegar | 1 cup chopped fresh italian bread | 4 slices cooked trout fillet
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. In a small bowl, mix mustard powder and vinegar. Spread mixture evenly over bread, and arrange trout on top. Drizzle with mustard mixture. Return to oven and cook for 15 minutes, until bread is lightly toasted and fish is easily flaked with a fork.

title: Blackened Chicken and Black Beans
ingredients: 1 lb fresh black beans | 1/2 cup molasses | 14 slices bread, cut 1/2 inch thick | 4 -6 boneless skinless chicken breasts | 1 ripe avocado, sliced
instructions: In a 6 quart dutch oven, cover beans with water and bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 1 hour or until tender. Drain beans and place in a blender, add molasses and puree. Set aside. Preheat oven to 300°f remove crusts from bread and cut into 1/2 inch dice. Brush 1 side of bread with oil and place in a small baking dish and bake for 15 to 20 minutes until toasty. Remove from oven. Remove bread slices from liquid and add to blender and puree until smooth. Spread half of bean mixture evenly over bread. Arrange chicken over bean mixture. Top with remaining bean mixture, top with avocado slices and bake for 30 minutes longer. Enjoy.

title: Mexican Red Onion Chili Powder Mix
ingredients: 4 large yellow onions, halved | 1/2 cup red chili powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 250 degrees f. Place half the sliced onions in a paper dutch oven or other heavy roasting pan and sprinkle with half the red chili power, pressing the salt lightly over both of the onions. Place remaining onions over the onions and bake in the oven for about 30 minutes, tossing the onions with a spoon after the 15 minutes, until they are soft & dark brown.

title: Swiss and Black Forest Spinach Bake
ingredients: 6 ounces spinach, chopped ( fresh or frozen and thawed ) | 1 1/2 cups blackberry-flavored panko breadcrumbs | 3/4 cup low-fat vanilla custard powder | 1/2 cup parsley ( optional ) | 1/2 cup pcko ( japanese bread crumbs ), for crumble topping
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Spray 8 x 8 baking dish with nonstick cooking spray. Mix berry crumbs, panko crumbs, and custard powder together in a small bowl. Place spinach on a small plate and sprinkle lightly with pcko. Place 2 tbsp of the spinach crumb topping on top of berry crumb layer. Place remaining spinach on top of crumb layer. Pour custard mixture over spinach, cover, and refrigerate several hours, or overnight. Bake uncovered 35 minutes or until a knife inserted into center of loaf comes out clean.

Random Ingredients: focaccia bread,nori,baby carrot,balsamic vinegar,chicken wing,nonfat milk,salsa,sherry wine
title: The Ultimate Focaccia
ingredients: 3 cups cooked chicken wings | 1/2 cup nimmy dean original salsa ( bottled salsa ) | 3 teaspoons balsamic vinegar | nonfat milk, for diluting | 1 focaccia bread | 1/4 cup sliced baby carrots | focaccia bread, lightly toasted | sherry wine
instructions: Cut focaccia sandwich open lenghtwise, make an x on top to expose the inside. Combine all ingredients in a shallow dish or pie plate then add some sauce on top.

title: Lara's Infamous White Beans & Lamb
ingredients: 6 -8 tablespoons butter beans | 3 tablespoons almond paste, melted | 1/4 cup pesto sauce | 2 tablespoons lea de leche's classic caesar salad dressing or 3 tablespoons alfredo sauce
instructions: Drain but do not clean beans thoroughly place in a 2 cup casserole dish and spread with butter or spreadable pesto. Add the white beans, almond paste and the caesar salad dressing/olive oil or any other desired marinade. Bake at 325 degrees for 45 minutes, then broil at 250 degrees for 15 - 20 minutes. Allow to set for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Chickpea Meat Pie
ingredients: 2 boxes frozen phyllo pastry | 420 g chili beans | 1 packet of black tea | 2 teaspoons moroccan mixed spice
instructions: Put half peas in blender, add half spices, tea, add other half peas and roll. Put in oven and mix it on high til slightly browned on top.

title: Easy Portuguese Fish
ingredients: 2 fish fillets | 2 -3 red chili peppers, finely chopped | 1 slice cooked ham, sliced
instructions: First clean fish fillets, then place them in one glass casserole dish, then cover with sliced ham. The whole thing will not be done. Cover with aluminium foil to stop the drying out, then bake at 180 grades celsius for 1 hour, or until done.

title: Roasted Hazelnut Salad With Hazel
ingredients: 1 cup hazelnuts | 1 - 1 1/2 kg mixed salad greens | salad greens, to serve ( to serve )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200c. Place the hazelnuts in a small shallow nonreactive tray. Bake for 10 minutes, until lightly toasted. While the hazelnuts are baking, place warm, freshly roasted hazelnuts in a dry frying pan and cook slowly for about 10 minutes, until golden. Cool. Wash, dry and very well drain the hazelnuts. Place hazelnuts in a baking tray and bake in the oven for 12 - 15 minutes, or until golden and fragrant. Cool completely then leave to cool completely. When cool, break off the heads and peel off the skin completely. Chop each hazelnut and place in a bowl. Toss with the salad greens. Drizzle on the hazelnuts.

title: Cabbage and Beans
ingredients: 3 cups finely shredded cabbage | 2 pounds pork cutlets, thinly sliced | 7 cups canned pinto beans, drained
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Line a 9x13 inch baking dish with aluminum foil for easy cleanup. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add the beans and cook for 12 to 20 minutes, until tender. Drain and set aside. In a skillet, cook the pork for 8 to 10 minutes or until done. Remove the pork from the skillet, reserving the fat, and set aside. Heat 2 tablespoons of remaining oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the cabbage and cook, stirring frequently, until tender, about 8 to 10 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in the cooked pork, cabbage and beans. Spread mixture into the prepared pan and bake for 20 minutes, or until heated through.

Random Ingredients: chicken wing,red onion,iceberg lettuce,heavy whipping cream,sumac,lettuce leaf
title: Lettuce & Wings Chicken Salad
ingredients: 1 lb whole fresh chicken wings ( about 2 large ones ) | 1 head iceberg lettuce | 1 red onion, halved and thinly sliced | 1 tablespoon sumac | 16 -20 large lettuce leaves | 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream, lightly whipped
instructions: If desired, marinate chicken pieces in salt & pepper sauce overnight. Bring to room temperature before cooking. Cut the wings into manageable sized pieces. Rinse off and place the chicken pieces into a large bowl. Toss with the onion slices and sumac. Pour hot chicken & onion over the chicken & toss gently. Serve at room temperature. To serve, place 2 lettuce leaves on each of 4 salad plates & mound the chicken salad on top. Serve with a dollop of whipped cream.

title: Cranberry Rollatini
ingredients: 3 tablespoons canning spices ( homemade or wild, any flavor ) | 2 cups dried cranberries, soaked and sliced ( about 1 lb. ) | 1/8 teaspoon dry mustard | 2 tablespoons cornstarch | 1/4 cup cider vinegar | 4 -6 6 -8 8 -8 large flour tortillas or 8 -8 -12 large flour tortillas
instructions: Mix all the ingredients for the filling in a mixing bowl and set aside. Toss soaked fruit with cornstarch. Dip in vinegar, and roll into small balls. In a skillet over medium heat, heat 2/3 cup water. Add the rolled fruit mixture, reduce heat and simmer, covered, for about 20 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Tamari Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 can italian stewed tomatoes | 1/4 cup tamari | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil
instructions: Place all ingredients in a bowl. Toss to mix.

title: My Best (And Easiest No-Cook) Breakfast Burritos
ingredients: 6 pieces of thick cut bacon ( i use canadian bacon ) | 12 ounces emmenthaler cheese ( about a cup or so ) | 1 cup brown rice
instructions: Spray some non stick skillet with oil, set aside. Place bacon in skillet on medium heat with about 12 oz. Of emmental cheese. Cover the bacon with the rice. Cover with a tight lid and cook for 20 - 25 minutes, or until rice is done to your liking. When done take the cover off and set aside to keep warm. Enjoy,.

title: Tasty Fennel Salad
ingredients: 1/4 lb peeled prawns | 1 small parsnip | 1 banana | 6 tablespoons taco sauce | 1/2 teaspoon ground anise seed | 1/4 teaspoon fennel seed | 1/4 teaspoon allspice | 2 tablespoons marinade | 2 teaspoons fresh parsley or 2 teaspoons fresh cilantro
instructions: Cut the prawns in half lengthwise. Halve and stone them. Cut the parsnip and parsnip into roughly equal pieces and cut the banana into slices. Dice the tacos in a food processor and mix with the salad ingredients. Stir in the marinade and pour over the salad. Sprinkle with the parsley or coriander sprigs and serve.

title: Spicy Chilies
ingredients: 4 green chilies, cut in half lengthwise ( mild and hot ) | 1 kg cake-and-pastry flour, mix of 1-2 cups | cooking wine, of your choice, plus extra for brushing
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c/400f/gas mark grease and line a deep 12 inch/ 7 inch cake or a loose bottomed cake tin. Line the base and sides of the tin with plastic wrap or a lightly dampened tea towel and grease with butter. Cut the chillies in half lengthways. Place a layer of chillies on the prepared dish. Sprinkle over a thin layer of cake and bake for about 30 minutes or until the chillies start to smell dry and crisp. Remove from oven and cool completely. Place the flour in a bowl and add the icing sugar using half a cup of water. Beat with a wooden spoon until mixture starts to form a paste. Remove chillies from oven and using a slotted spoon, dip them one at a time into the flour, then roll in the sugar to coat, shaking off any excess. Fry the chillies in hot oil until golden. Serve immediately.

title:

Remove the meatballs from the oven and slice them into bite sized pieces. Place the sliced meatballs in a oven safe dish and layer with remaining ingredients, except the blackberries if serving at your next party. Set your oven to broil and get the pan hot and ready. Once all your food is ready, grab a handful of the pitted blackberries and mash together with a fork or wooden spoon. Place all these aside in a small bowl and serve with fresh greens and a bowl of yogurt for a refreshing dinner. The other great addition to this is a little olive oil and a bit of fresh garlic infused with lemon juice. You may also add fresh cilantro when serving if you like. You can also serve this with your veggie burger and crusty itali

title: Gkai Me Lahanas-Spiced Pasta and Cheese
ingredients: 2 lbs pasta ( tagliatelle or tubular ) | 1/4 cup hot prepared mustard | 1 teaspoon fenugreek seeds | 1 teaspoon maggi seasoning, spice ( or any seasoning seasoning you like, i prefer penzey's brand ) | seasoning ( of choice ) | cheddar cheese or munster cheese
instructions: Cook pasta. If your pasta is dry, let them sit for 10 minutes and then mix with hot mustard and fenugreek and mix well. You want it to remain a little lumpy at this point. After that, drain and toss pasta with spice mix. Adjust seasoning to your tastes. Serve with grated cheese on the side. Note, this may also be made with prawns and/or chopped fresh vegetables which would be great.

title: Simple Mushrooms
ingredients: 2 cups mixed mushrooms | honey, as desired
