instructions: Wash your mushrooms. Slice all the way through in half. Don't peel. Place mushrooms in a pan and cover with the honey. Bake in micro for 5 - 6 minutes or until mushrooms are tender.

Random Ingredients: walnut oil,wheat flour,cake flour,apple juice,chili sauce,chocolate,mustard seed,mushroom
title: Gluten Free Pizza Cookies
ingredients: 1 cup cake flour | 1 cup whole wheat flour | 1 tablespoon wheat flour | 2 tablespoons mustard seeds | 150 ml apple juice | 125 -150 ml mushroom, sliced | 1 cup chocolate, chopped ( approx 140 grams ) | 1 -2 teaspoon chili sauce | walnut oil
instructions: Mix all dry ingredients in a bowl. Add applejuice and mix well. Add mushrooms and pour over pastry. Sprinkle over chillies and top with shredded chocolate and olive oil if desired. Allow to set up for about ten to ten minutes before cutting. This is also tasty if served cold.

Random Ingredients: serrano chilies,beef brisket,orange zest,rotel tomato chilies,sesame seed,nutmeg,german chocolate
title: Spice Rubbed Corned Beef and Chilies for a Brisket
ingredients: 3 1/2 teaspoons grated orange zest | 1 1/2 teaspoons grated nutmeg | 7 cups corned beef brisket | 2 cans rotel tomatoes & chilies | 1/2 cup sesame seeds | 4 1/2 tablespoons grated german sweet chocolate | 4 serrano chilies ( seeded and coarsely chopped )
instructions: Remove and discard rind from corned beef.

title: Tarragon Beans and Rice
ingredients: 1 can chick-peas, drained | 1/2 cup water | 1 tablespoon dried tarragon leaves | 1 tablespoon mild tabasco sauce or 1 tablespoon hot sauce | hot cooked rice
instructions: Combine all the ingredients in a saucepan, heat gently until heated through, serve with cooked rice.

title: Swiss Steak  Au Saumon (Chives on a Belly)
ingredients: 4 chives, cut into 1/8-inch pieces | 4 tablespoons salted butter
instructions: Slather chives and the 2 tablespoons salted butter on beef steaks. Sprinkle over any remaining salt.

title: Enchilada Tortellini
ingredients: 1 box cheese tortellini | 2 cups shredded steak ( can also use pork ) | 1/4 cup chopped apple ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground asafoetida powder ( optional )
instructions: Cook tortellini according to package directions. Meanwhile, combine all of your other ingredients and saute in nonstick skillet, breaking up the meat as you cook, until the meat is warmed through and no longer pink. Drain and add to the tortellini. Sauté over medium heat until heated through.

title: Apricot Mint Tea
ingredients: 1 package dried apricot jam ( use apricot flavored jam if not gluten free ) | 1 can condensed beef broth | 1 tablespoon black tea ( i use decaf ) | 1 -4 teaspoon salt | 1/2 bunch spring onion ( optional )
instructions: Place the apricot jam in a glass or plastic container with the beef broth and water. Add the salt and tea. Cover and let stand in a warm place for an hour. Remove the jar from the refrigerator and stir well. Garnish with sliced green onions. If you have extra jam left, you may use it on chips and/or a salad.

title: Easy Rice & Spinach Falafel (From Bob's Red Mill)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups cooked jasmine rice | 1 cup cooked white beans or 1 cup frozen white beans | 4 ounces finely chopped green apples | 1/3 cup currants or 1/3 cup raisins | 1/4 cup dried bread flour or 1/4 cup asian breadcrumbs | 4 ounces canned spinach, drained, well rinsed, squeezed dry, coarsely chopped ( i like a lot of stems ) | 1 teaspoon bottled minced garlic | steamed jasmine rice ( optional )
instructions: In a bowl, gently combine beans with cooked rice, apple, currants, bread crumbs, spinach, and garlic. Add salt, to taste, if using it. Shape mixture into 12 balls, about the size of a large walnut. Place on a tray. Brush or spray with cooking oil. Steam for about 15 minutes, until cooked through but not mushy.

title: Black Russian Tea
ingredients: 3 -4 ounces sliced fresh white mushrooms ( about 1/2 pound uncooked mushrooms ) | 2 1/4 teaspoons caraway seeds ( optional, but recommended ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons salt | 1/4 teaspoon fresh ground pepper | 1 cup strong black tea leaves ( optional ) | 3 slices crisp cooked pepperoni ( optional )
instructions: To prepare the black tea, stir all ingredients together in a bowl and let sit a few minutes to steep. To serve, allow the coffee to cool to room temperature, about 20 minutes. To serve, bring the brewed tea to a boil, add pepperoni and slice mushrooms.

title: Mexican Grilled Peach Salad
ingredients: 1 -1 1/2 lb peaches, peeled, pitted, chopped or can sliced canned peaches, drained | 3 tablespoons salsa | 1 -2 garlic clove, finely chopped | 1 cup iceberg lettuce, chopped | 1/2 cup red onion, chopped | 1/4 cup red pepper, chopped
instructions: Place the chopped or canned peaches or can sliced peaches in a mixing bowl or bowl, and pour salsa over. Let sit to soak flavors for about 10 minutes, until liquid gets absorbed. Stir in the garlic. Chill. Just before serving, chop the lettuce, if using whole leaves of lettuce. Place all of the remaining ingredients in a bowl with some of the dressing and toss well. Taste, adjust seasonings and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: red wine vinegar,apricot,beef brisket,dark chocolate,plain flour,egg yolk
title: Roladanos (Catalan Beef and Apricots Sandwiches)
ingredients: 2 lbs beef brisket | 4 ounces dark chocolate, roughly chopped | 4 ounces dried apricots, roughly chopped | 1 medium egg yolk | 1 1/2 teaspoons red wine vinegar | plain flour, for dusting
instructions: Preheat the oven to 160c/fan 160c/gas trim the meat and slash the fat on the fatty top with a sharp knife. Dust with flour and tie the meat on 4 wooden skewers, securing with string. Arrange them on a roasting tin, allowing space for swelling. Melt the chocolate with half of the apricots, the egg yolk, vinegar and remaining apricots in a bowl. Pour over the meat. Dot with the remaining apricot pieces. Cover with foil and roast for 90 minutes. Turn them over, tent with foil and continue to cook for a further 45 mins, or until the meat is tender and cooked. Remove the foil, sprinkle the remaining apricots over and serve.

title: Penne With Sirloin and Cheese
ingredients: 1 1 lb sirloin, trimmed of fat and sliced 1/8 inch thick | 1 1/2 cups sliced cheese, i use cheddar | 1 cup sliced almonds, toasted | 3 cups cooked penne pasta, i prefer the smaller type for softer noodles | 1 tablespoon minced garlic ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon oyster sauce
instructions: Cook pasta in salted water according to package directions, or package directions. Place sirloin slices in a large nonstick skillet, sprinkle with a little salt, cook on each side until just barely done, turn. Transfer to a shallow serving bowl. Place the rest of the cheeses in another serving bowl, toss with the garlic and oyster sauce. Drain pasta, toss with butter and cheeses. Serve with sauce.

Random Ingredients: pecorino romano cheese,great northern bean,coconut milk,saffron,buttermilk,garam masala,anchovy fillet
title: Indian White Beans (White Beans) W- Buttermilk Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 tablespoon garam masala | 1 tablespoon saffron, crumbled | 11 anchovy fillets | 1 cup coconut milk | 1 cup buttermilk | 2 cans great northern beans, drained and rinsed ( cannellini beans or white kidney beans ) | 1/3 cup pecorino romano cheese
instructions: Heat oven to place saffron in small dish. Heat oil in small saucepan over medium heat. Add anchovies.

Random Ingredients: water,rye whiskey,chipotle chile adobo,pearl barley,sharp cheddar cheese
title: Smokey Irish Pub Style Barley Ries
ingredients: 2 jars smoked rye whiskey | 1/2 cup water | 1/2 cup pearl barley | 1 chipotle chile in adobo, seeded and minced | 1/2 cup shredded sharp cheddar cheese
instructions: In a 1 quart saucepan combine the whiskey, water, barley, chipotle pepper and cheese. Bring to a boil, stirring to melt the cheese. Stir the soup well and heat gently until blended and heated through.

Random Ingredients: white bread,honey,italian seasoning,red jalapeno chile,pepper,cold water,cod,bread
title: Cod in the Mist
ingredients: 8 slices fresh white bread, crusts removed | 2 cans red jalapeno chiles, drained | cold water, as needed to just cover | 4 -8 ounces boiling smoked cod, cut in 1 inch pieces, or ( 3 ounce ) cod tail meat | italian seasoning, to taste | pepper, to taste | crackerly ground bread, to serve
instructions: Arrange the bread slices on 4 plates, top with 2 cans of red chilies, the hot water as needed. Toast sliced smoked cod or or smoked fish and sprinkle with italian seasoning and pepper. Place under the broiler just until the top is a light tan color.

Random Ingredients: ra el hanout spice mix,hot pepper,worcestershire sauce,madeira wine,king prawn,chili oil,pimiento,asparagus
title: Spiced Asparagus & Prawns
ingredients: 400 g king prawns, raw and in the shell peeled ( or equivalent amount of raw, peeled baby prawns ) | 1/4 cup dry madeira wine | 1/4 cup hot pepper, diced ( or equivalent amount of mild chilli pepper ) | 2 teaspoons worcestershire sauce | 1 teaspoon chili oil | 80 g pimientos, canned, diced ( or equivalent amount of fresh pimento ) | 1/2 teaspoon ras el hanout spice mix ( or equivalent amount of mixed spices ) | 1 bunch asparagus, trimmed, cut into 2 | 1 small hot pepper, seeds and membrane removed ( or equivalent amount of red pepper )
instructions: Marinate prawns in madeira wine, chilli oil, diced pimentos, ras el hanout, and hot pepper for 1/4 hour. Meanwhile, steam asparagus or the thick stems until bright green but still crunchy. Slice asparagus into 2 5cm lengths and steam briefly, for approximately 2 - 3 minutes to blanch and cool slightly. When prawns are completely cooked, remove the heads. Rinse off heads under cold water to stop the cooking process. Devein prawns, remove meat from shells and set aside. Place prawn pieces in a shallow glass dish large enough to contain the prawns and marinade of choice. Add prawns and marinade of choice and mix well, coating and turning prawns frequently. Cover and refrigerate for 1 - 2 hours. Cook asparagus, then drain and separate asparagus into 3 4cm lengths, depending on size. Bring a litre of water to the boil and add asparagus and hot pepper and boil for 2 minutes for the bright green asparagus, then remove with a slotted spoon to a warm serving dish. Remove stalks with large holes, then arrange asparagus, hot peppers, prawns and marinade on top of the prawn mixture on the hot plates. Garnish with fresh parsley sprigs & serve immediately with warm bread.

Random Ingredients: black olive,lemon wedge,red potato,pineapple tidbit,black sesame seed,habanero pepper
title: Roasted Potato Salad
ingredients: 2 cans pineapple tidbits | 12 ounces small fresh red potatoes | 8 ounces black olives | 4 ounces habanero peppers, julienned | 6 ounces pineapple tidbits | 2 tablespoons toasted black sesame seeds, lightly toasted
instructions: Slice potatoes as directed on the package. Remove core and thinly slice potatoes. Heat your broiler. Place pineapple tidbits and tomatoes with juice in a large bowl and toss. Place under hot broiler element until tomatoes loosen and turn dark black. Turn tomatoes over and continue to cook until tomatoes get a dark, rich, reddish colored color. Add juliennes to tomatoes and mash with a wooden spoon. Place salad in a large bowl with olives and hot peppers. Sprinkle on toasted sesame seeds and toss well to blend.

title: Farfalle With Spinach
ingredients: 1 lb farfalle pasta | 2 bunches baby spinach | 3 tablespoons white vinegar | 3 tablespoons cold water
instructions: In a large pot of boiling salted water, cook pasta until al dente. Meanwhile, place baby spinach in a bowl of ice water to harden, then drain and rinse under cold water. In a small bowl, whisk together the vinegar and water until well blended. Drain pasta and toss with a few tablespoons of the dressing to coat well with greens and spinach. Serve immediately.

title: Homemade Tahini Dip
ingredients: 1/4 cup tahini | 1 -3 tablespoon salsa or 1 -3 tablespoon picante sauce, of choice
instructions: Mix together and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: graham cracker crumb,sage leaf,beef bouillon cube,bibb lettuce,pine nut,cream mushroom soup
title: Beef on Buns
ingredients: 12 ounces beef bouillon cubes | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1 1/2 cups graham cracker crumbs | 1/2 teaspoon sage leaf | 1 head bibb lettuce | 1/2 cup pine nuts
instructions: Place the base in a deep ceramic dish and crumble the beef bullion cubes into it. Mix them in with the cream of mushroom soup. Cover and refrigerate overnight. The next day, remove the beef and crumble into small pieces. Tear off a handful of the meat from the head and place it on a large plate or shallow bowl. Cover with water and microwave for 3 minutes. Drain the water and put it back into the bowl with the beef and soup mixture. Heat oven to 375 degrees. Remove and discard the top layer of grease from the dish. Layer in a rectangle or diamond pattern the drained meat chunks, pine nuts, and torn romaine leaves. Add the soup mixture on top of every layer and then top with the cheese. Place under the broiler for 3 to 5 minutes or until cheese golden.

title: Pasta With Marinara Sauce
ingredients: 10 -12 flour tortillas, sliced | 16 ounces cooked penne pasta | 3 jars marinara sauce or ( 16 ounce ) jars ranch style sauce
instructions: Cook penne pasta until done. Spray pan with pam or add oil to skillet add tortilla slices and brown slightly. Remove tortilla slices and pour on the marinara or ranch style sauce and toss to completely coat. Place tortilla slices in a separate baking pan and pour the marinara sauce on top. Bake at 350 degrees for 15 minutes. Serve and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: farfalle pasta,dark sesame oil,pizza sauce,strawberry,garam masala,chicken breast
title: Strawberry Chicken Parmesan
ingredients: 2 boneless skinless chicken breasts | 1 box farfalle pasta or ( 12 ounce ) box bow tie pasta | 1 -2 tablespoon black sesame oil | 3 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 1 jar pizza sauce | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon garam masala or 1 -2 teaspoon curry powder | 2 -3 whole strawberries
instructions: Cut up raw chicken breasts in large chunks and sprinkle with 1 - 2 tbsp of sesame oil. Bake in oven about 1 hour. Pour pasta into bowl with chicken breast and continue to cook. In meantime boil water, add pasta and cook to desired tenderness. Pour remaining sesame oil in skillet or wok, and add pizza sauce. Add chopped fresh strawberries and cook until almost all liquid is gone, about 2 - 4 minutes, stirring often. Serve over hot pasta.

Random Ingredients: tea,celery salt,sugar,granny smith apple,rye bread,adobo seasoning,betty crocker sugar cookie mix,vegetable broth
title: Apple Breakfast Soup
ingredients: 8 cups vegetable broth | 4 tablespoons tequila ( do not substitute ) or 4 tablespoons brandy ( do not substitute ) | 1 cup dry old raisin or 1 cup chopped dates | 3 tablespoons granulated sugar | 1 tablespoon adobo seasoning or 1 tablespoon other seasoning, preferably chipotle | 1/4 teaspoon celery salt ( optional ) | sliced rye bread, for garnish | grated carrot ( for garnish )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in slow cooker, and put on high for 1 hour. Turn low and let simmer until soup becomes thicker and the apples and raisins are dried out, another 45 minutes to an hour. Serve with slices of rye bread or grated carrot for garnish.

Random Ingredients: sharp cheddar cheese,potato,romaine lettuce,san marzano tomato,water,garlic clove
title: Tortilla Con Crema Romana, E Al Forno
ingredients: 8 cups water | 1 large garlic clove, minced | 1 lb potato, peeled and cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 teaspoon dried chipotle peppers in adobo ( or chipotle powder ) | 1 cup sharp cheddar cheese, grated | 2 cups romaine lettuce, chopped
instructions: Place water, garlic and potatoes in a large pot, cover and bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat to low and simmer until potatoes are tender, about 15 minutes. Stir in chipotle powder and cook 2 minutes. Remove pot from heat and stir in cheese until melted, stirring constantly. Add romana and warm through.

Random Ingredients: tahini,grand marnier,egg beater substitute,anise seed,quinoa,graham cracker crumb,currant
title: Quinoa Quiche
ingredients: 1 cup dry quinoa | 1 1/2 cups egg beaters ( plain or powdered egg product ) | 1 1/2 cups light tahini | 1 1/2 cups grand marnier | 4 teaspoons anise seeds | 1 cup raisins ( i always use golden raisins but any good white raisins will do ) | 1/2 - 1 cup graham cracker crumb
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Rinse quinoa under cold water and drain well. Bring quinoa, egg, tahini, grand marnier and anise seeds to a boil. Turn down heat.

title: Gravy(Gravlax)
ingredients: 3 medium courgettes ( or yellow squash ) | 2 -4 tablespoons molasses | 2 1/2 tablespoons dry oregano leaves, fresh | 1 cup whipping cream, whipped or 1 cup whipping cream, for the sauce
instructions: Wash and chop the courgettes, or squash into about 3 cubes. Sprinkle them with salt and pepper, and mix thoroughly. Heat molasses in a pan, add the courgette and stir over medium heat, until it is warm. Add the oregano and stir well. Bring all the ingredients to a boil. Reduce heat and continue to simmer for about 5 minutes, depending on how tender you like the vegetables.

title: Moroccan Bouquet Garni (Spiced Vegetables)
ingredients: 2 large bouquet garni ( french herbs ) | 1/2 teaspoon cumin powder
instructions: Pound vegetables lightly. Mix cumin powder and cayenne powder into a paste. Store in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: onion flake,cajun seasoning,chili seasoning mix,chicken part,english cucumber,sugar snap pea,bread flour
title: Easy Jambalaya
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs chicken parts ( i've also used turkey, shrimp, and pork too ) | 1/4 cup onion flakes, flakes | 1/4 cup sugar snap pea ( fresh or frozen ) | 1 package chili-flavored seasoning mix | 1 package dry english cucumbers, sliced | 2 tablespoons cajun seasoning | 1 tablespoon dry bread flour
instructions: Place the chicken parts in a large saucepan. Sprinkle each with onion flakes, snap peas, chili seasoning mix, and cucumbers. Sprinkle the top of each with 1 tablespoon of cajun seasoning and bread flour. Pour in just enough water to cover, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer uncovered, 40 - 60 minutes or until chicken is tender.

title: Italian Shells
ingredients: 12 ounces pasta shells, dried weight | 1 teaspoon liquid smoke flavoring
instructions: Boil a large pot of water. Meanwhile, dry all of the shells by rinsing with cold water in a bag. When water comes to a boil, add the shells. Boil and drain. Put the dried shells between a paper towel, on a paper towel. Press shells over a sink full of cold water and dry. When the shells have soaked up the water, place them in the pot of cold water. Bring to a boil again. When shells boil, drain shells, and fill them with the pasta. Sprinkle with liquid smoke. If desired, sprinkle with shredded pepper flakes.

Random Ingredients: rocket,vegetable bouillon granule,baby spinach leaf,vodka,baby pea,garlic salt,green plantain,red enchilada sauce
title: Baby Spinach and Plantains Enchiladas
ingredients: 5 -6 baby spinach leaves, cleaned and chopped | 50 g frozen baby peas | 1/4 - 1/2 liter red enchilada sauce, depending on how much sauce you like ( depending on how spiciness you like ) | 1/2 potato, boiled and sliced thinly | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt | 1 tablespoon vegetable bouillon granules | 1/2 liter rocket | 10 tiny baby red plantains, sliced in half lengthways
instructions: Soak the spinach in cold water for 10 minutes then plunge into icy cold water and drain. Mix all the ingredients except for the rocket and plantains together. Put the spinach mixture on a parchment lined oven tray, flatten it out, place in the fridge until ready to use. Spread some red enchilada sauce on the spinach mixture and roll it around. Then wrap the spinach in a slice of potato with the rolled spinach in the rolled potato on the tray. Put the filled green plantain slices in the refridgerator for about 10 - 15 minutes to soften them up a little and to marinate them. Remove the potato slices from the oven tray and slice into 4. Heat the red enchilada sauce just before removing from the heat add the rocket and plantains and marinate for 5 minutes on a warm plate. Serve the enchiladas in to small bowls and top each serving with some of the reserved potato slices.

title: Malibu Baked Swordfish
ingredients: 25 g fresh gingerroot | 3 fresh slices bread | 1/4 cup malibu rum
instructions: Place the ginger, bread and rum in a bread machine and start on medium until the bread is toasted. Turn down to the lowest speed and stir. When the bread has absorbed the rum drizzle over the fish while it's still hot.

Random Ingredients: curry paste,calf liver,bay leaf,mushroom,tarragon leaf,parsley leaf,corn syrup
title: Curried Mushroom and Field Mushrooms (Australian)
ingredients: 4 ounces large field mushrooms | 1 lb unsmoked liver | 1 bay leaf | 1 cup fresh mushrooms, sliced | 1/3 cup light corn syrup | 1 tablespoon curry paste | 1 tablespoon fresh tarragon leaves, chopped | parsley leaves, for garnish
instructions: Cut mushrooms crosswise into 1/2 inch slices. Separate leaves from stalks and cut off stems. Set aside. Trim excess skin from liver and wipe dry with paper towels. Cut liver thinly crosswise into 1/8 inch slices. In skillet, add the bay leaf, mushrooms, corn syrup and curry paste. Stir well to blend. Cover and cook over medium low heat for about 10 minutes or until the water evaporates. Add the tarragon and onion and stir until heated through. Pour mixture over mushrooms. Toss well to coat. Serve on a bed of lettuce leaves. Garnish with parsley.

Random Ingredients: tamarind juice,queso fresco,hamburger bun,garlic paste,coffee bean,pork,chunky salsa,apricot preserve
title: Grilled Sandwiches with Pork-Creamed Eggs and Salsa
ingredients: 2 pounds ground pork | 1 1/2 tablespoons roasted garlic paste, divided | 1 can brewed coffee beans, divided | 1 jar chunky salsa | 4 ounces crumbled queso fresco | 8 hamburger buns | 1 cup tamarind juice, or as needed
instructions: Mix ground pork, roasted garlic paste, and 1 can brewed coffee beans together in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: beet,taco seasoning mix,garlic salt,baby spinach,sandwich bun,cooking oil,molasses
title: Beet and Spinach Sandwich
ingredients: 3/4 lb baby spinach, washed | 1 can sliced beet, drained and well rinsed | 1 tablespoon molasses | 3 tablespoons taco seasoning mix ( i use mrs. dash ) | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt | 6 sandwich buns, split | 2 teaspoons cooking oil
instructions: Drain and rinse the spinach and fresh beet, cool quickly under cold water and cut into pieces and set aside. Mix together the molasses, taco seasoning and garlic salt. Place the spinach, beet and oil in a large nonstick pan and cook on medium heat stirring occasionally, until the beets are cooked and just a hint of pink remains inside. Remove from the heat and mix in the molasses mixture. Split and toast the sandwich buns.

title: Chicken Lasagna
ingredients: 6 ounces plain yogurt | 6 ounces vodka | 1 chicken, cut into serving pieces | 1/2 ounce brandy | 1 package lasagna noodles
instructions: Heat oven to 350 degrees f.

Random Ingredients: peanut oil vegetable,sultana,vegetable oil cooking spray,active yeast,bread
title: Nutty Bread Rolls
ingredients: 1 teaspoon active dry yeast | 1 tablespoon sultana | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 2 cups bread, breads, crusts trimmed, cut into 3 | 1 3/4 cups peanut oil or 1 3/4 cups other neutral tasting oil
instructions: In a large microwave safe bowl, dissolve yeast in sultanas. Microwave for 15 seconds. Stir to dissolve. Dissolve the yeast and the oil in 1 1/4 cups warm water, stir. Add to the bowl and stir to combine. Add breads and 1 cup of the oil to the bowl. Dough will be sticky. Let rest about 10 minutes or until water is absorbed. With lightly floured hands, shape dough into a smooth oval. Transfer to a greased bread pan. Cover with towel and let rise in a warm place until doubled. Meanwhile, heat the remaining oil in a 12 inch nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Add 1/2 cup bread and fry on both sides until golden brown, 7 - 10 minutes. Drain on paper towels and serve warm topped with remaining honey.

title: Grilled Cheese Sandwich
ingredients: 1 bottle french baguette | 1 bottle gouda cheese, grated | 4 sandwich buns, split | 2 tablespoons tapioca
instructions: Cut baguette in half lengthwise and cut each into 3 parts to form bread loaves or loaves. Wrap each piece of bread in plastic wrap, then pound with a rolling pin to compress into a flat rectangular shape about 2 inches wide by 2 inches high. In a large bowl, stir together grated cheese and tapioca. Place bread loaves on grill or grill pan with 1 inch of heat and grill bread until golden brown on both sides about 10 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Cold Noodle & Cream Pilaf With Soba Nuts and Roasted Pine Nuts
ingredients: 2 packages soba noodles | 1/2 cup canned espresso or 1/2 cup brewed coffee | 1/4 cup cream | 1/4 cup fresh italian parsley or 1/4 cup flat leaf parsley, chopped, plus sprigs for garnish | 2 tablespoons pine nuts, toasted and chopped | fresh pita bread, triangles for serving
instructions: Soak soba noodles in boiling water for 15 minutes. Drain and set aside. When noodles are cool enough to handle, break into large pieces. Place noodles in a large serving bowl. Add remaining ingredients and stir to combine. Chill until ready to serve or serve at room temp.

Random Ingredients: arborio rice,caper,white button mushroom,yeast,bamboo shoot,yoghurt,blue curacao
title: Blue Cheese Stuffed Mushrooms!
ingredients: 4 large fresh green and white button mushrooms, cleaned, wiped dry, stems trimmed, and wiped with damp cloth | 1/2 cup yoghurt | 1/2 teaspoon yeast ( or yeast cakes-quickening, 1 1/2 teaspoons ) | 2 tablespoons arborio rice | 1/4 cup blue curacao ( rum or other dark rum ) | 5 ounces fresh white button mushrooms | 15 ounces bamboo shoots, drained ( optional )
instructions: To prepare mushroom mixture, in small bowl, mix together yoghurt, yeast, rice, and curacao. Split the capers from the mushrooms and soak in the yoghurt mixture until soft. Slice the mushrooms into 1 1/2 thick circles and gently stuff each mushroom half with a caper circle. Place each mushroom in a buttered 9x9x2 inch baking dish that has been lightly buttered on the inside with the mushroom stem pointing right up. If using fresh mushrooms, place them in a saucepan of boiling water for 3 - 4 minutes. With a slotted spoon, remove the mushrooms and allow most of the water to be drained off. Arrange the mushrooms in a single layer over the mushrooms, and spoon the remaining yogurt mixture over them. Cover and set aside to rise at room temperature for 1 hour or until almost doubled in size. To prepare basting mixture, preheat your broiler. Cut each mushroom on the narrow side of the mushroom and transfer to a shallow baking dish. With a sharp knife, cut a slit into the underside of the mushroom, leaving a small depression in the center of each mushroom, the length of the stems. Place mushrooms in a preheated 400 degree f oven and broil, with the stem end of the mushroom pointing up, for 15 minutes or until the tops are crispy and browned.

title: Wasabi Burger
ingredients: 1 can tuna ( flaked or chunked ) | prepared wasabi powder ( optional ) | 4 tomatoes ( sliced thinly ) | 4 tomatillos ( sliced thinly ) | 4 hamburger rolls
instructions: If using wasabi powder, mix 2 tbsp of wasabi powder with 1 tablespoon of cold water, and then mix it with tuna and wasabi. Cook burger to your liking. Place tomato slices over top of burger. Place a tomatillo over the tomatillo, and top with hamburger bun top, and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: graham cracker crumb,red bean,beef broth,hard egg,fruit
title: Red Beans and Ground Beef
ingredients: 2 lbs small red beans | 1 cup beef broth | 1/4 cup graham cracker crumbs ( optional ) | 1/2 cup mixed dried fruit | 2 hard-boiled eggs, sliced
instructions: In a large saucepan, cover beans with water and place in a saucepan. Add enough beef broth to fill the pan. Bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer until tender, about 15 minutes. When beans are tender, drain. Reserve broth. Stir graham cracker crumbs into the mixture.

title: Pasta Fish Filled With Halibut and Mackerel
ingredients: 1/3 lb halibut fillet | 1 tablespoon sesame oil | 2 cups grated mackerel | 3/4 lb rotini pasta
instructions: Cook sesame oil in hot skillet for 2 minutes, stirring occasionally, until fragrant. Set aside. Sprinkle halibut with salt and pepper. Place in skillet. Sprinkle with salt. Turn heat to high. When pan shimmers, add mackerel. Let fish cook about 3 minutes. Meanwhile, cook rotini according to package directions. Drain. Toss with sesame oil. Spoon mixture over halibut. Add salt and pepper. Serve fish topped with vegetables.

Random Ingredients: onion powder,callaloo leaf,chili without bean,bread dough,vanilla essence
title: Callaloo and Callaloo Kebabs
ingredients: 1 bread dough, ball ( kread ) | 1 onion, chopped finely | 1 can sliced chili without beans ( available from indian stores ) | 2 tablespoons callaloo leaves ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons ground cinnamon
instructions: In a bowl mix well the onion, chilli, cinnamon. Take kababs and form into round balls. Roll out round disc on floured board. Heat griddle and cook bread on both sides. Serve hot or cold.

title: Togarashi (Japanese Creamy Dipping Sauce)
ingredients: 2 cups heavy whipping cream | 1 teaspoon dashi
instructions: Combine the cream and dashi. If you don’t have a large bowl, use a food processor. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: cherry tomato,plain yogurt,phyllo dough,dark brown sugar
title: Bake on Your Own Calzone
ingredients: 6 sheets phyllo dough | 300 g cherry tomatoes ( or any kind of ripe cherry tomatoes ) | 100 -200 g dark brown sugar | 400 g plain yogurt ( or greek )
instructions: Pre heat oven to 180c. Line a cookie sheet with parchment paper. Place the filo sheets on the baking sheet and place in oven on the middle rack. When warm to the touch, brush generously with butter and sprinkle with sugar and bake in the oven at 180c for 10 minutes on every side. If you bake it too soon, the bottoms will be brown. Turn oven off, remove the filo and place on a serving tray in a warm oven. While waiting on your oven to come up to temperature, place a few cherry tomatoes into a bowl and add 1 tablespoon of dark brown sugar. Mix well and stir in a small amount of boiling water until smooth. Dip the filo filo filo into the cherry mix. Cut the filo into 12 equal wedges and brush with melted butter. Then place into a baking tray. The easiest way to do this is by carefully lay the filo wedge and cherry tomato mixture on the baking tray, and bake them in the oven at 180c until golden brown. To serve, cut each calzone on the diagonal & use a fork to spread the sour cream or greek yogurt into a circle. This is not easy, but it is delicious.

title: Cilantro Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 1 head iceberg lettuce, rinsed and dried | 2 tablespoons chopped cilantro
instructions: Tear off the lettuce leaves and discard them. Place one lettuce leaf on a clean work surface, and top with 2 tablespoons of cilantro.

title: Chicken With Fennel and Cinnamon
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs chicken tenders | 1 1/2 teaspoons fennel, ground
instructions: Boil the tenders for 8 minutes and drain. Cut tenders into 6 equal pieces. Sprinkle meat with fennel and bake in a preheated oven for 25 to 30 minutes or until brown. Serve warm.

title: Granny's Simple Asian Peppers
ingredients: 1 lb yellow pepper | 1/2 cup clear honey
instructions: Thinly slice the green pepper and the yellow pepper. Heat the honey in a non stick pan. Add the pepper onions.

title: Creamy Ricotta Cheese for Pasta
ingredients: 1 container part-skim ricotta cheese | 1 cup grated pecorino cheese
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Cook your pasta in boiling salted water, or in 1 quart water according to package directions. Drain when cooked, and cool slightly.

Random Ingredients: eggplant,dill pickle,catsup,lemon juice,ra el hanout spice mix
title: Roasted Eggplant With Ras El Hanout
ingredients: 2 -3 large eggplants | 1/3 cup catsup | 2 teaspoons ras el hanout spice mix | 2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice | 2 teaspoons fresh dill pickles, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees fahrenheit. Cut a circle from the bottom of a 6 inch square of foil, about 1 inch thick. Arrange 2 or 3 eggplants on the foil. Combine catsup, ras el hanout, lemon juice, and dill pickles in a bowl and stir to mix. Spread 1 1/2 tablespoons of sauce mixture onto each eggplant. Fold eggplants over so that the two sides of each eggplant become foil.

title: Easy Blackberry Spaghetti Sauce
ingredients: 1 pound ground pork | 1 green bell pepper, seeded and diced | 1 can anchovy, drained and chopped | 1 jar spaghetti sauce | 1 can blackberry jam
instructions: In a large skillet over medium heat, cook pork and green pepper until pork is browned, about 10 minutes. Drain excess fat. Stir in anchovies and spaghetti sauce, bring to boiling. Simmer for 10 minutes. Stir in blackberry jam and remove from heat.

title: Easy Smoked Salmon
ingredients: 1 pound smoked salmon, cut into thick slices | 1/2 cup shredded mozzarella cheese
instructions: Preheat an outdoor grill for medium high heat, and lightly oil the grate. Brush the salmon slices with oil. Grill the salmon over medium hot heat, turning several times, until tender and lightly colored on one side, about 3 minutes per side. Sprinkle with mozzarella cheese. Continue grilling until cheese has melted, 3 to 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice,green chili pepper,mexican oregano,poblano chile
title: Chile-Mole
ingredients: 1 lb poblano chiles or 1 lb green chili pepper, chopped | 1 -2 tablespoon fresh lemon juice | 1 teaspoon mexican oregano or 1 teaspoon dried oregano | 1 jalapeno chile, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Combine the chiles with 3 teaspoons of the lemon juice and the oregano and chilli. If you would like the sauce warm, stir 1 - 2 teaspoons of the lemon juice into the sauce. Refrigerate for 15 minutes before serving.

title: Capellini (Autumn Sausage and Okra Stew)
ingredients: 1 lb sausage | 2 cups okra | 1 can marsala wine | 1 tablespoon baking soda | 2 cups soymilk | 1 italian parsley, chopped
instructions: Brown sausage and okra in small sauce pan. Add marsala and baking soda and simmer slowly for 2 hours. Strain sausage mixture and put away when cool enough to handle. When cool enough to handle, peel off skin and chop sausage meat. Return sausage to pan and mix with okra. Add the chopped parsley. I like to do this the night before to let flavors blend.

title: Homemade Tamari Yogurt
ingredients: 1/2 cup tahini ( sesame seed paste ) | 1 cup plain yogurt ( i use homemade greek yogurt )
instructions: Mix the yogurt and the tahini together. Place the mixture in strainer and let it drain for about 6 hours. You can refrigerate the yogurt, or you can leave it overnight. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: currant,fennel,cardamom seed,chicken thigh,white pepper,chocolate ice cream
title: Cardamom Pepper Chicken
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon cardamom seed | 1 cup currants or 1 cup raisins, soaked in hot water for about 1 hour, and drained ( about 10 oz. ) | 1/2 teaspoon white pepper | 8 boneless skinless chicken thighs, skin removed | 1/2 cup unsweetened chocolate ice cream, softened | 1 fennel, chopped
instructions: Place cardamom seeds in a shallow dish, sprinkle with a half tsp. Of pepper and 1 tsp. Of the reserved currants. Add the chicken thighs and turn to coat the pieces evenly in the spice mixture. Cover and chill for about 20 minutes while you prepare the sauce, place the remaining currants and the remaining pepper in a small saucepan. Heat at least 2 inches of hot water until boiling. Add the ice cream and simmer uncovered until mixture is hot but not boiling. Do not boil. Lift out of water with a slotted spoon and put a piece of chicken on top, sprinkle with fennel and serve.

Random Ingredients: chipotle chile adobo,pork tenderloin,passion fruit,phyllo dough
title: Spiral Pork Tenderloin (Chipotle) Phyllo Rolls
ingredients: 2 lbs pork tenderloin, pounded to 1/4 inch thickness | 8 phyllo dough ( phyllo should be 12 inch by 17 inch by 3/4 inch wide by 18 inch long, about ) | 6 large chipotle chiles in adobo, halved | 1 cup passion fruit ( fresh or canned )
instructions: Pound pork tenderloins between 2 sheets of plastic wrap to 1/4 inch thickness and transfer to a plate.

Random Ingredients: italian parsley,hard egg,ginger paste,vegetable bouillon cube,corn tortilla,avocado,rice wine,chuck roast
title: Shredded Beef Tacos
ingredients: 2 lbs chuck roast, trimmed of fat and cut into chunks | 4 soft corn tortillas | 2 teaspoons ginger paste | 4 hard-boiled eggs | 1 large avocado, peeled cut into chunks | 1/2 cup vegetable bouillon cubes | 1/2 cup rice wine | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh italian parsley
instructions: Place beef in a dutch oven with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil and boil 30 minutes, skimming foam as needed. Meanwhile, set out some hard boiled eggs, cut side down, and cut into chunks. Peel and chop remaining 3 ingredients. Discard bones and return beef to the dutch oven. Mash some eggs into beef. Cover and simmer over medium heat for about 1 hour. In the meantime, spread out tortillas in a flat pan. Spray tortillas with cooking spray. Slide 8 tortillas on a plate. Dribble some of the beef mixture onto each, top with fried hard boiled egg chunks and chopped avocado. Fold tortillas over meat and avocado. Roll. Slice and serve.

title: Okra and Fruit Kebabs
ingredients: 12 ounces baby okra, halved | 12 ounces mixed dried fruit | 1 tablespoon fresh thyme leaves, minced | 1 1/2 cups maraschino cherries or 1 1/2 cups grape tomatoes, halved
instructions: Wipe the okra and cut into 4 inch lengths. Combine the okra, okra mixture and thyme in a bowl. Toss well to blend, then transfer to a rimmed baking sheet or platter and arrange on a baking sheet. Toss the maraschino or grape tomatoes over the top. Cover and marinate at room temperature for 1 hour or longer. Preheat the grill, broiler or oven to high. Alternatively, thread okra mixture onto the skewers and grill for 5 to 6 minutes, turning occasionally. Serve hot or warm.

Random Ingredients: cream tartar,anise seed,serrano pepper,tamari,iceberg lettuce,greek seasoning,coffee
title: Lettuce-Tater Tacos
ingredients: 8 ounces cream of tartar | 2 tablespoons anise seed, lightly toasted | 1 lb fresh soft salted cheese | 1/4 cup instant coffee ( preferably mexican ) | 1 tablespoon all purpose greek seasoning | 1 tablespoon serrano pepper | 1/3 head iceberg lettuce, trimmed | iceberg lettuce, for garnish
instructions: Combine cream of tartar and anise seeds in a small bowl. Spread on a plate. Toast over double boiler until just light golden. Cool.

title: Chinese Red Onion Salad
ingredients: 1 large red onion | 2 large egg yolks, large | 2 tablespoons corn syrup | 1/2 lemon, juice of | vegetable oil, for frying
instructions: Skin and thinly slice the red onion. Combine the egg yolks, corn syrup and lemon juice in a small saucepan on high heat. Stirring until the mixture thickens slightly and then remove the pan from the heat. Dip the red onion into the egg mixture and carefully return to the saucepan, coating them evenly. Add 1 cup of water to the onions and bring to a boil. Cover and simmer over low heat for 20 minutes or until the syrup has reduced to approximately 1/2 cup. Remove from heat and stir in the remaining chopped onion until thoroughly coated. Serve chilled.

title: Walnut Kiwi Sesame Kiwi Leafs
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/4 lb butter lettuce leaf, leafs washed | 3 tablespoons walnuts, toasted, coarsely chopped | 2 teaspoons sesame oil | 2 kiwi fruits, peeled and seeded, finely chopped | fresh ground pepper
instructions: Bring a large pan of water to a boil.

Random Ingredients: lime,saffron thread,granny smith apple,scallion,cooking sherry,green cabbage
title: Apple Saffron Colcannon
ingredients: 1/3 medium green cabbage, finely shredded | 1/4 medium savoy cabbage, finely shredded | 1/2 medium granny smith apple, peeled, cored and finely chopped | 2 green onions, finely chopped | 1/4 cup bottled cooking sherry | 1 pinch saffron thread
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl. Serve.

title: Pineapple Ham And Cheese Appetizers
ingredients: 2 packages deli ham | 2 packages mozzarella cheese | 1 cup pineapple preserves, or as needed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Lay ham slices out on a baking sheet. In a small bowl, stir together the mozzarella cheese and pineapple preserves. Spread a small amount of the cheese mixture on each ham slice. Bake in the preheated oven until heated through and cheese has melted, 15 to 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: cardamom powder,radish,cooking spray,green cardamom pod,kiwi fruit,spaghetti
title: Karela
ingredients: 200 g spaghetti, vermicelli type | cooking spray | 8 g karela ( orange-flavored spiral noodles ) | 3 cardamom powder | 10 g green cardamom pods | 1 kiwi fruit, sliced thinly
instructions: Cook spaghetti following packet instructions until al dente, rinse under cold water and set aside. Spray karela with cooking oil spray and brown on all sides. Remove, place karela in a serving bowl and sprinkle with cardamom powder and green cardamom pods. Place karela on a plate and scatter with kiwi slices. Pour 1/2 cup of the pasta water over and top with karela.

title: Tex-Mex Bruschetta
ingredients: 15 ounces italian-style stewed tomatoes | 1/2 cup taco seasoning mix, original | 1 cup fresh breadcrumb | 1/4 cup light tasting taco seasoning mix | 1/4 cup vodka | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon tabasco sauce
instructions: Place the stewed tomatoes on a large cookie sheet and sprinkle evenly with taco seasoning mix and bread crumbs. Pour about 1 1/2 cups of the vodka over the top of the tomatoes. Sprinkle the remainder on top and dot with tobasco. Bake at 375 for an important 12 minutes or until the bread crumbs are toasted and the tomatoes are a little browned.

Random Ingredients: graham cracker crumb,italian dressing,lemon zest,brandy,queso blanco
title: Simple Chef John's Cheese Balls
ingredients: 1/2 cup grated fresh cheese cheese ( parmesan or asiago are good ) | 2 cups graham cracker crumbs | 1/4 cup italian dressing | 1 teaspoon lemon zest, zested | 2 tablespoons brandy
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Lightly grease cookie sheets. In a medium bowl, stir together the cheeses, cracker crumbs, italian dressing, and lemon zest. Form the mixture into 1 1/2 1 1/2 inch balls. Place on baking sheets 2 inches apart. Bake in preheated oven until golden brown, about 30 minutes. Allow to cool slightly, then transfer balls to a wire rack.

title: Chef John's Easy Sweet and Spicy Yellow Squash
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cornstarch | 2 cans yellow squash, drained | 3 cups salsa verde | 1/4 teaspoon ground allspice
instructions: Blend cornstarch, yellow squash, salsa verde, and allspice in a blender until smooth. Chill 1 hour before serving.

title: Barkless Blueberry Sauce
ingredients: 8 ounces blueberries, rinsed and dried ( canned okay ) | seasoning ( a sprinkle of boursin, to taste ) ( optional )
instructions: Drain the berries well and place in blender or food processor. Pulse until smooth. You may need to scrape down the sides of the blender a few times. Add seasoning if desired. Pour into a sauce pan on low heat. If desired, serve over your favourite pasta of your choice with lots of freshly made grated parmesan cheese.

title: Cassava With Salmon
ingredients: 6 cups cassava ( cut into two-inch diameter pieces ) | 1 salmon fillet ( about 400g, approximately 3.5 lb )
instructions: Boil the cassava in a large pot of water for about 15 minutes or until slightly fork tender. Drain the water from the cassava, return it to the pan and mash it in your fingers, then set it aside. In a medium non stick frying pan, heat the salmon fillet over medium heat. Grill the salmon for about 5 - 7 minutes until firm and cooked through. Cut the salmon into slices approximately 1/4´ thick. Place the salmon on a serving dish, spoon the mashed cassava over it, season with salt and serve.

title: Sun-Dried Tomato & Lemon Tacos
ingredients: 12 -12 small sun-dried tomatoes, whole ( can use bottled tomatoes ) | 1 lemon, cut in 8 wedges | 1/2 cup water | 1 packet taco seasoning mix | 1/4 cup dry sherry ( can use cooking sherry ) | 4 fat-free lettuce, leafs | 1/2 teaspoon garlic clove, minced
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit. Put the sun dried tomatoes on a foil lined baking sheet. Drizzle with lemon juice to prevent them from turning brown. Bake at 400 degrees fahrenheit for 10 minutes, stirring once or twice. Remove from oven, turn on broiler. Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Add taco seasoning packet and sherry. Stir to mix. Heat just until the sherry starts to bubble around the edge. Add lettuce, garlic and remaining juice. Place 4 tomatoes on each serving plate. Top with salad, if desired.

title: Easy French Vinaigrette - for Salads & meats
ingredients: 5 tablespoons white wine vinegar ( good quality ) | 4 tablespoons dark brown sugar ( regular brown sugar can be used ) | 4 -6 cloves ( depending on taste preference )
instructions: Whisk all ingredients together until sugar is disolved. Add meat to dressing and marinate for 1 - 2 hours. Serve as a salad dressing or use to marinate meats.

title: Mango Fiddlehead Pie
ingredients: 1 ripe mango - peeled, pitted, and diced | 1 can plum tomatoes, chopped | 1 jar fiddlehead | 1 cup graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Lightly grease a 10x15 inch baking dish. Spread the mango onto the bottom of the prepared baking dish, and top with plum tomatoes and fiddleheads. Sprinkle with graham cracker crumbs. Bake in the preheated oven for 30 minutes, or until fiddleheads are hot and bubbling.

Random Ingredients: coffee liqueur,golden raisin,curry powder,monterey jack cheese
title: Curried Raisins and Queso Content
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups golden raisins | 1 1/2 cups monterey jack cheese ( shredded ) | 1/2 cup hot coffee liqueur | 3/4 teaspoon curry powder
instructions: In bowl combine remaining ingredients. Spread on a plate. Microwave on high for 1 minute. Serve. Note the curry powder on the quacomate is a hot gound flavoured rub. It goes nicely with pumpernickel.

title: Avocado Balls
ingredients: 8 ripe hass avocados | 2 -3 tablespoons bacon grease | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence | 1/2 cup chopped pecans ( optional )
instructions: In a food processor or blender, puree the avocados until they are smooth. Add the bacon grease with vanilla essence and pecans. Drop by the tablespoonfuls into miniature paper muffin tins. Makes about 18 balls. Bake at 180°c or 190°c if your muffins aren't very well browned, turn them out onto a tray. When cooled, transfer to a baking sheet lined with aluminium foil. To store, freeze until solid.

title: Fruit Quesadillas
ingredients: 6 flour tortillas ( multicolored ) | 1 cup golden raisin | 1 teaspoon black pepper ( or more )
instructions: Place all ingredient in the order stated in your package. Heat in a sauté pan on a medium heat setting until golden and crispy. Let cool slightly and cut into small fingers with a sharp knife. Serve warm or cold.

title: Barley (Barley With Oranges)
ingredients: 1 cup pearl barley ( about 2 cups ) | 2 tablespoons orange juice | 2 teaspoons cumin ( ground )
instructions: Bring 2 - 3 cups salted water to boil, add barley and cook on low heat until tender. Drain and return to 1 quart pan. Stir in remaining ingredients. Bring to simmer, cover and cook over low heat 10 - 15 minutes or until heated through.

Random Ingredients: vanilla bean,rosemary,beef bouillon cube,matzo meal,asparagus tip,ketchup,ginger root
title: Konih's Grilled Beef Matzo
ingredients: 1 pound fresh asparagus tips, trimmed | 1 whole beef bouillon cube ( optional ) | 1/4 cup ketchup | 1 teaspoon minced fresh ginger root | 1/4 vanilla bean, split | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh rosemary | 2 tablespoons matzo meal, or as needed
instructions: Cut tips from beef bouillon cube, and soak in water for at least 30 minutes. Place meat in a food processor or blender, and pulse until meat falls apart into shreds, about 2 pulses, about 5 seconds. Remove meat from food processor, and return liquid to the food processor. Place meat, ketchup, ginger, vanilla bean, and rosemary in a resealable plastic bag. Remove meat from bag, and stir in matzo meal or as needed to coat meat. Chill in the refrigerator for at least 1 hour.

title: Creamy Cauliflower Sprouts in Sesame Oil
ingredients: 2 heads cauliflower florets | 2 teaspoons sesame oil | 3 garlic cloves | 3 tablespoons oil | 1 1/2 cups broth, base | 1/4 cup double cream | 1 teaspoon basil | 1 bunch basil ( leaves )
instructions: Place all ingredients into a large pot and bring to high heat, turn down the heat and simmer uncovered for 15 minutes or until the cauliflower is cooked, stirring frequently. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: baby spinach,white fish fillet,heavy whipping cream
title: Grilled Whitefish With Spinach and Pecans
ingredients: 2 white fish fillets | 1/4 cup heavy whipping cream | 2 cups baby spinach ( packed )
instructions: Prepare idahoan signature™ russets mashed potatoes according to package instructions. Combine cream and mashed potatoes in medium bowl. Stir in spinach. Coat fish with cream mixture. Place on lightly greased grill and close lid. Grill 6 - 7 min.

Random Ingredients: cheddar cheese,cornstarch,nonstick cooking spray,mint sprig,heavy cream,egg,purpose flour,beef eye
title: Yummy Steakhouse Finger Curd
ingredients: 1/4 lb lean beef eye round, 1/8-inch thick | 1/4 cup all-purpose flour | 1/2 tablespoon cornstarch | 1 1/2 cups heavy cream | 2 eggs, lightly beaten | fresh mint sprig, for garnish | 8 ounces cheddar cheese or 8 ounces monterey jack pepper cheese, grated | nonstick cooking spray
instructions: Cut steak crosswise into 1/8 inch slices. Place flour and cornstarch in 2 shallow dishes. Whisk cream and eggs in second shallow dish until well blended. Dredge steak slices in flour mixture and arrange in one layer on top of each other. Pour egg mixture over and atop meat. Spray nonstick skillet with cooking spray and place over medium high heat until hot. Place meat in skillet, cook 3 - 4 minutes each side or until desired doneness. Transfer to warmed platter and garnish with mint sprigs.

Random Ingredients: iceberg lettuce,beer,saffron strand,zucchini,egg yolk,head cauliflower,chili oil,pasta sauce
title: Saffron and Cauliflower Meatballs #A1
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower | 1 zucchini | 1 large egg yolk | 500 g pasta sauce | 3 -4 saffron strands | 1 tablespoon chili oil | iceberg lettuce | iceberg lettuce
instructions: Grate or finely chop the cauliflower, zucchini & egg yolk into one large bowl. Heat vegetable oil in a large wok or saucepan over medium heat. When the oil is hot stir fry the vegetables for 5 - 6 minutes, or until tender and golden. Season well with salt, stir in the pasta sauce & saffron strands & season to taste with a little sea salt & pepper. Reduce the heat to low & cover for 20 minutes, stirring halfway through. Garnish with fresh coriander leaves & serve as desired.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon cube,irish whiskey,chili paste garlic
title: Hot and Spicy Irish Chicken
ingredients: 1 chicken bouillon cube | 1 cup chili paste with garlic | 1 cup irish whiskey
instructions: Cut three pieces of foil big enough to hold all the pieces of chicken. In a glass baking dish, place the cubes of chicken, chili paste, and whiskey. Pour bouillon on top and seal completely with the bundle and marinate overnight in the refrigerator. Cook on the barbeque, or grill on the grill until brown on all sides. Serve with fries or salads.

title: Spicy Cherry Dipped Cherries
ingredients: 2 lbs sour pitted cherries | 1 cup white flour | 1/2 cup potato starch | 1/3 cup potato starch | 2 -4 habanero peppers or 2 -4 jalapeno peppers | 1 teaspoon dill weed
instructions: Heat oven to 375 degrees and grease jelly roll pan or tart plate. If using cherry pits, place on cookie sheet and bake for 20 minutes. Mix 1st 6 ingredients and fill into jelly roll pan or tart plate. Bake for 20 minutes. Can be served warm or chilled. Cut into fingers.

title: Fusion-Tea Sandwiches
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs cubed lamb shank | 2 tablespoons roasted ground tea
instructions: Combine lamb shanks and tea.

title: Pineapple Cabbage
ingredients: 1 head red cabbage or 1 head green cabbage, cut in large pieces | 2 cups pineapple juice or 2 cups juice | 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon | 1/2 teaspoon ground savory | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala
instructions: Cook cabbage and juice in a pot until cabbage has softened a bit and its juices are getting clear. Add cinnamon, savory and garam masala. Bring to boil, lower heat, cover and simmer for 30 minutes.

title: Broccoli, Chilli and Gruyère Puffs-Pieced Recipe
ingredients: 8 sheets puff pastry | 4 tablespoons grated gruyere cheese | 1 tablespoon sliced green chiles, drained | 2 cups broccoli florets, washed and steamed
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°f lightly grease a 9 1/2 inch pie plate. Cut each sheet of pastry lengthwise into 3 - 4 rectangles. Pierce each rectangle with a fork all around. Place 2 tablespoons of the cheese on the 1 piece of pastry. Place a chile on top of the cheese, then top with the broccoli and remaining cheese. Press the edges firmly together and brush with water. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes or until pastry is golden brown and the broccoli is tender. Serve immediately.

title: Chiang Mai Shrimp and Corn Soup (Napa Dave)
ingredients: 1 whole chicken | 3 stalks celery | 1 pound small shrimp, shelled and deveined | 1 can mung beans | 1 cube chicken bouillon | 1/4 cup cornstarch
instructions: Place the chicken, celery, and shrimp in a pot over medium high heat. Dissolve the bouillon cube in 1/4 cup of water. Add soup and bring to a boil, stirring occasionally. Reduce heat and simmer for 25 minutes. Remove the chicken, vegetables and shrimp from the soup and set aside. Heat the soup over medium heat until very hot. Stir in the chicken, shrimp, and celery. Sprinkle with cornstarch and serve.

title: Portuguese Girl's Lettuce Wraps,
ingredients: 20 ladyfingers | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil or 1 tablespoon olive oil | 1 fresh chili pepper ( use a small hot chile such as aji, fresno or vietnamese chile flakes ) | 1/2 small peeled seeded and finely diced plum tomato ( about 2 tablespoons ) | 1 tablespoon chopped peeled seeded sweet papaya ( about 1 teaspoon ) | 1 teaspoon ground anise seed, slightly crushed | 1 teaspoon baking powder | 8 -12 leaves torn basil leaves or 8 -12 leaves fresh cilantro
instructions: Separate lady fingers lengthwise from center portion. Remove hard center part of fingers by detaching around eyes and running a knife along both sides of each finger. Using one hand to hold uncooked portion of pasta shape and one hand to hold shape, gently remove one end of each finger. Fold in the ends of the fingers and continue folding up the sides until they are firmly packed together. Place on cookie sheet. Heat 1 tablespoon of oil or olive oil in skillet over medium heat. Add chili pepper and papaya. Cook 2 minutes. Add the tomatillo. Cook about two minutes. Remove from heat. Using the side of the cookie sheet closest to you, gently fold in the chili pepper and papaya, stirring. Pinch together and put basil leaves or cilantro on the cookie sheet. Roll one end of the cookie sheet into a cylinder shape. Wrap the bottom end in the basil leaves until wraps are completely closed. Place tortillas on a cookie sheet, seam side down. Repeat with the remaining lady fingers. Preheat oven to 400°f. Sprinkle tortillas on a baking sheet. Bake 10 to 12 minutes or until crisp. Let cool. Cut each wrap diagonally into 8 pieces and serve.

title: Noodles With Fennel and Onion
ingredients: 1 package dry noodles | 1/2 teaspoon fennel seed | 1 tablespoon minced celery | 1 pizza crust
instructions: In a skillet, cook noodles according to package directions. Drain. Meanwhile, in a small bowl, combine fennel seed and celery. Sprinkle noodle mixture over noodles. Bake at 400 degrees for 7 to 10 minutes or until noodles are golden brown.

title: Gramma's Mock Mashed Potatoes
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of asparagus soup | 1/4 - 1/2 cup sour cream or 1/4-1/2 cup plain yogurt | 1 package of shredded cheese ( your choice to sprinkle on top or use your discretion. )
instructions: Heat up soup mix, sour cream to desired strength, pour into pot. Top with grated cheese. Microwave for 2 - 4 minutes on high, or until heated through.

title: Toad in My Bean Cabbage
ingredients: 2 slices bibb lettuce | 2 teaspoons sugar-free syrup | 2 teaspoons prepared english mustard | 1/2 cup kidney bean, rinsed and drained | 1/2 cup pickled red beans, rinsed and drained ( kidney-beans if you can find them )
instructions: Preheat the grill to high and line the grill pan with aluminum foil. Remove one side of the bibb lettuce leaf and carefully unroll it and place it over the other side of the leaf. Spread the bibb lettuce with equal amounts of the syrup, mustard and beans. Layer the remaining spinach leaves on top, with the lettuce on top. Grill the bibb lettuce until the spinach wilts and is lightly browned, 1 to 2 minutes.

title: Ras El Hanout (Cardamom-Baked Fish)
ingredients: 1 teaspoon dried chili pepper flakes | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground cardamom ( from a 1-2-ounce jar ) | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Heat oven to 450f. Line a baking sheet with a clean kitchen towel or parchment paper. Combine remaining ingredients in a shallow bowl or jar and shake to combine well. Rinse fish and pat dry. Sprinkle spice mix over fish. With a sharp knife, slice diagonally at 1/8 inch intervals. Arrange fish in a single layer in a baking dish. Bake, uncovered, until fish flakes easily with a fork, 15 - 20 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Easy Chilled Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons fine dry breadcrumbs | 4 -6 whole black cardamom pods | 1 tablespoon sweet paprika | 2 teaspoons simple syrup
instructions: Place all ingredients in bowl of food processor. Process to coarse meal consistency. Stir often. Store in refrigerator.

title: Pepperoni Pori
ingredients: 1 package pepperoni ( sliced 1-inch thick ) | 12 fluid ounces chicken broth | 1 teaspoon rice wine
instructions: In a 9x13 inch pan over medium heat, combine pepperoni and 1/2 the broth. Cook, covered, 5 minutes. Arrange pepperoni and remaining broth in pan.

title: Rice Stuffed
ingredients: 3 cups rice | grated cheese
instructions: Wash and drain rice well. Place about 2 heaping tablespoons of rice in each of two ramekins. Sprinkle about 3 tablespoons grated cheese around the rice.

title: Potato, Pepperoni and Wine Balls With Truffles
ingredients: 500 g yams, peeled and cut into 5 mm cubes | 200 g spicy tzatziki | 300 g riesling wine | 50 g pepperoni | 150 g dark chocolate, grated | pepperoni, slices for garnishing ( or any other dark bittersweet chocolate, such as ghirardelli )
instructions: Place yams in salted water and bring to the boil. Cook until tender, about 15 minutes. Drain. Cut into 5 cm cubes. Boil until syrupy about 3 - 4 minutes. Drain. Meanwhile, place riesling in a saucepan with plenty of cold water. Bring to the boil. Cover, reduce heat and simmer about 20 minutes until it begins to soften. Drain and cool. Place 1/4 cup of the riesling wine in a bowl and add the drained yams, 100g of the tzatziki, 80g of the cheese and pepperoni. Mix with your hands. Form into balls by gently stretching your fingers. Place on parchment paper lined baking sheet. Repeat with remaining riesling and cheese balls. Lightly coat each with dark chocolate. Sprinkle with pepperoni. Heat a small wok until very hot. Add the oil. Add the miniature chocolate balls.

Random Ingredients: spring onion,self raising flour,green bell pepper,marinade,fennel seed,chunky peanut butter,black bean
title: Peanut Butter and Black Bean Salsa
ingredients: 1 green bell pepper | 1 ounce marinade ( thick ) | 1 1 cup chunky peanut butter | 1 tablespoon fennel seed | 1 1/2 cups cooked black beans | 1 1/2 cups self-raising flour | 1 bunch spring onion
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c cut bell pepper into quarters lengthways. Pour marinade into a large heavy based saucepan and add the diced pepper. Simmer over a low heat for 5 minutes. Add peanut butter to saucepan. Stir until mixed throughout. Add fennel and the beans, cook for a further 3 minutes. Sift together the flour and spring onion and gently fold into the salsa. Place mixture in a non stick baking dish and top with crusty bread to cover. Bake in the oven for 15 minutes and set aside for 10 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: classico spicy red pepper pasta sauce,rice wine,beet,cream tartar,extra virgin olive oil,allspice
title: Red Pepper Cream Sauce
ingredients: 32 ounces jar ragu classico spicy red pepper pasta sauce | 6 cups shredded peeled beets | 2 cups low fat sour cream or 2 cups fat free sour cream | 3/4 teaspoon cream of tartar | 2 tablespoons ground allspice | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil, evoo
instructions: Heat pasta sauce according to package directions. Cool 10 minutes and transfer to blender. Add beets and blend until smooth. Add remaining ingredients, blending until smooth. Refrigerate 6 hours or overnight. Cover and store in refrigerator up to 3 days. Leftovers can be frozen in gallon sized zipper ziploc bags. Makes one 15 - 1 1/2 lb jar.

Random Ingredients: cayenne pepper,lemonade concentrate,green enchilada sauce,beef brisket,potato flake
title: Mexican Style Beef Brisket
ingredients: 1 beef brisket ( about 3lbs. ) | 3 cans green enchilada sauce | 1 1/4 cups potato flakes | 1/2 cup sweet potato flakes | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper
instructions: Cut up beef brisket. Place brisket in crock pot. Add green enchilada sauce over beef. Cover and cook on low for 10 - 12 hours. Remove beef from crock pot, remove excess fat and place onto serving dish. Using fork, shred brisket into fine pieces. Add potatoes to broth. Mix in sweet potato flakes. Place remaining green enchilada sauce in separate containers or resealable plastic bags. Top with hot beef. Serve with tortillas and salsa.

Random Ingredients: beef tenderloin steak,apricot,tortilla chip,chocolate candy bar,oat,cumin,shell pasta
title: Crazy Hot Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 1 package beef tenderloin steaks, cut 1/4 inch thick | 2 tablespoons oats | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 1/4 cup dried apricot, sliced | 1 package plain tortilla chips | 1 package chocolate candy bars | 1 package dry shell pasta
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to boil. Add pasta, and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until cooked through. Drain. Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Grease a 9x13 inch baking dish. In a small bowl, stir together the oats and cumin. Stir in the apricots. Cut the tenderloin into slices, and place them in a casserole dish. Cover with half of the tortilla chips. Sprinkle with half of the chocolate chips. Repeat layers. Bake for 20 minutes in the preheated oven, or until the chocolate and apricots are melted. Top with remaining chips. Let melt before serving.

title: Toasted Melon With Snow Peas, Fresh Mozzarella, Basil and Toasted Almonds
ingredients: 1/2 cup dry vermouth | 1 green cardamom, cracked | 1 bag fresh snow pea | 2 cups fat-free whipped topping ( like haagen daaz - 1 cup ) | 1/2 cup coarsely chopped fresh basil leaf ( not dried, just fresh basil ) | 1/2 cup sliced almonds | 1/2 cup thinly sliced smoked mozzarella cheese
instructions: For the melon, combine the vermouth, cardamom and cracked cardamom seeds in a glass bowl and let sit until the vermouth is reduced to 1 cup, abot 30 minutes. Meanwhile, cut the snow peas in half, place on a baking sheet and toast in a 400 degree f oven for about 10 minutes, until the snow is crisp and beginning to brown. Remove the snow peas from the oven and let cool slightly. Spread the vermouth over 3/4 of the toasted snow peas, to cover, and arrange the snow peas around the base of the melon and on top in a spiral. Spoon the remaining vermouth over the melon. Top the melon with the whipped topping, basil and olives. Return to the oven and bake for 20 minutes or until the cheese is melted.

title: Chipotle Scented Rice Pilaf
ingredients: 3 cups long grain rice, rinsed well and drained ( or regular white rice ) | 1 teaspoon achiote paste or 2 tablespoons achiote paste
instructions: In a large heavy skillet, heat achiote paste.

Random Ingredients: corn,cod,dijon mustard,green chili,cilantro leaf,kirby cucumber,green cardamom pod
title: Cod in Cilantro and Corn Salad
ingredients: 3 lbs cod ( can substitute white snapper or similar fish ) | fresh cilantro leaves | 1/2 cup finely chopped green chili | 1/2 cup coarsely grated kirby cucumber | 2 teaspoons fresh green chili, minced, with seeds | 2 tablespoons dijon mustard ( preferably heinz ) | 2 green cardamom pods, slightly crushed ( seeds and membrane discarded )
instructions: Preheat broiler. Remove fish fillets from their bones. Rinse. Cut into 12 portions. In a bowl combine cilantro, chili, cucumber, and green chili. Toss gently with remaining ingredients. Garnish with cilantro leaves and cilantro sprigs, if desired along with additional fresh cilantro leaves if desired.

Random Ingredients: sherry wine,green peppercorn brine,meat,saffron strand,cocoa powder
title: Sopa De Queso (Maltese Meats) - Com Arrostada Di Papas Con Salsa
ingredients: 1 kg meat, of your choice | 100 g green peppercorns or 100 g black peppercorns | 1/2 teaspoon saffron strand or 3 saffron spoons | 2 tablespoons cocoa powder | 2 teaspoons sherry wine
instructions: Cut the meat into cubes and boil them with water, sugar and vinegar for a few minutes. Drain the meat and add the peppercorns and saffron. Mix the cocoa powder with the sherry to make a rich reddish paste. Add sherry mixed with the sherry to the meat and leave for at least 2 hours. Strain the meat and keep it warm if you like. Pour the meat sauce from the bottom of a soup tureen to serve with crusty bread.

title: Cheater's Pecan Wedges
ingredients: 3 cups mixed salad greens | 1 cup chopped pecans | 1 teaspoon creole seasoning blend | 1/2 teaspoon ground nutmeg
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Stir salad greens, pecans, creole seasoning, and nutmeg together in a salad bowl. Drop teaspoonfuls of the pecan mixture onto a preheated baking sheet. Top with more pecan mix. Bake in the preheated oven until crisp and golden brown, 15 to 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: carrot,worcestershire sauce,beef stew meat,cooking spray,gorgonzola,plum tomato,coffee granule,cherry
title: Quick Beef Kabobs
ingredients: 1/2 cup gorgonzola, crumbled | 1 tablespoon instant coffee granules | 2 teaspoons worcestershire sauce | 1 teaspoon steak seasoning or 1 teaspoon mrs. dash seasoning mix | 1 teaspoon carro telo coffee granules | 1 1/4 lbs beef stew meat, cut into 3/4 inch cubes | cooking spray | 2 large cherry tomatoes
instructions: Combine first five ingredients, then add beef and marinate about 1 hour. Heat a large nonstick skillet with cooking spray over moderately high heat. Add meat.

title: Dilled Linguine(SMS)!
ingredients: 1 cup tamari soy sauce | 1/3 cup chat masala ( try my #, i've also used it with fish ) | 12 ounces linguine | 6 pickles, sliced into thin rounds and fried very crispy
instructions: Combine tamari, chaat masala and salt in small bowl. When ready to cook, bring a large pot of water to boiling. Mix in linguine, turn off heat. When ready to eat, ladle pasta mixture into colander under cold water.

Random Ingredients: bamboo shoot,nicoise olive,oregano,cherry,pumpkin,red cabbage,lemon zest,chocolate chip
title: Mochi Pumpkin Salad
ingredients: 1 lb fresh pumpkin or 1 lb winter squash | 1 large ripe cherry, quartered | 1/2 head red cabbage, cored and cut into wedges ( about 13 oz., about 6 cups ) | 1/2 cup nicoise olive, halved | 3/8 cup choc chip, cut into chunks | 1 tablespoon lemon zest | 1 tablespoon oregano | 1 cup chopped toasted nuts, such as peanuts, cashews, hazelnuts ( optional ) or 1 cup almonds ( optional )
instructions: Quarter, seed tomatoes and cut into 1/4 inch cubes. Slice squash lengthwise into 3/8 inch wedges and remove seeds. Cut wedges in half and gently transfer to a bowl. Add cherry, cabbage, olives, and macintosh, if using. Mix together macintosh and hazelnuts, if using. Pour macintosh and hazelnut mixture over salad. Add lemon zest, oregano and toss salad. Serve topped with toasted nuts, if desired.

title: Lemon Onion Soup Mix with Lemon
ingredients: 8 fluid ounces lemon flavored soup mix | 1 small onion, chopped
instructions: Prepare instant onion soup mix per package directions using envelope of mix. Add onion and combine. Place in a 2 qt crockpot.

title: Pasta for mooshies (Garlic Twists)
ingredients: 7 1/2 ounces whole wheat spaghetti | 1/2 laughing cow light swiss cheese, shredded
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. While the pasta is cooking, preheat your broiler to high. In a medium size casserole dish, add spaghetti in 1/2 cup increments, stirring constantly, until heated. Sprinkle cheese over top of spaghetti. Place under griller until cheese begins to brown. Note, you may also cook the spaghetti in a pan on the stove top, just until the cheese begins to bubble. Drain pasta well. Turn back heat under casserole over the pan. Pour spaghetti evenly among the cheese.

title: Potato & Rose Beef Liver
ingredients: 500 g beef liver, cut into 1 cm cubes | 250 g potatoes, cut into wedges | 1 teaspoon dried sage | 4 tablespoons cornflour, for coating | cooking oil, to cook | sage, for sprinkling
instructions: Toss the liver in the cornflour, shake off excess. Heat the oil in a wide, deep fryer over a moderate flame and fry the potatoes, in batches, for about 8 mins or until golden brown. Arrange the liver in a dish and cover with the potatoes. Sprinkle with sage and serve warm.

Random Ingredients: sun tomato oil,splenda granular,thai red chili pepper,apple,black cardamom pod
title: Spiced Apple and Almond Salad
ingredients: 6 cups apples, peeled, cored, and diced ( about 3-1/2 pounds ) | 2 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained | 1/2 teaspoon splenda granular | 1/8 teaspoon sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained | 3/4 teaspoon fresh ground black cardamom pod, crushed | 2 thai red chili peppers, seeded and minced
instructions: Place apples in a large bowl.

title: French Quarter Whip
ingredients: 3 cups graham cracker crumbs | 1 can sweetened condensed cream | 3/4 cup suuze | 1/2 cup real vanilla vodka | 1 tablespoon hot sauce
instructions: Mix graham cracker crumbs, cream suuze, vodka, and hot sauce in a large bowl until smooth. Spread mixture in a 9x13 inch pan. Refrigerate 8 hours or overnight.

title: Wild Mushrooms and Mexican Crouton
ingredients: 4 tablespoons mexican blend cheese ( cheddar preferred if you can not find mexican blend ) | 1/3 cup wild mushrooms | 2 tablespoons fresh parsley or 2 tablespoons fresh cilantro, minced
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit. Mix together cheese, mushrooms, sour cream and parsley until well combined and cheese is thoroughly mixed into the mushrooms. Transfer mixture to a lightly greased cookie sheet. Bake in preheated oven until lightly browned and bubbly, about 25 - 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: scallion,plum tomato,jalapeno pepper,turmeric powder,grape tomato,rose water
title: Rose Tomatoes(Bangladesh)
ingredients: 10 grape tomatoes, washed ( large are the best, but small cans of whole will do ) | 2 tablespoons dried chilies or 2 tablespoons red pepper flakes | 2 scallions, finely diced | 1 tablespoon jalapeno pepper, finely sliced ( or minced ) | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1 tablespoon rose water
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit. Scald tomatoes. Remove from heat and peel tomatoes. Place tomatoes onto a jelly roll pan or baking sheet and, with a spatula, mash tomatoes up and down so that they are as uniform in texture as possible. Sprinkle on chiles or red pepper flakes, then scallions. In a small bowl, combine turmeric and rose water until well mixed, then add to tomatoes. Toss tomatoes up and down into sauce. Bake, uncovered for 20 - 25 minutes, until hot and bubbly. The last 5 minutes, sprinkle tomatoes with some more finely chopped chile or red pepper and/or rose water, to taste.

Random Ingredients: garam masala powder,stone mustard,snow pea,black cardamom pod,anaheim chili,broth
title: Spiced Snow Peas
ingredients: 1 cup fresh snow pea | 2 tablespoons stone ground mustard | 2 tablespoons ghee or 2 tablespoons butter | 1 large anaheim chili, seeded and finely chopped | 2 black cardamom pods or 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1 1/2 teaspoons garam masala powder
instructions: Trim stem ends of fresh snow peas. If using frozen peas, defrost peas and place into a container. In a saucepan, cook ghee over low heat for 5 - 2 minutes, stirring constantly. Add chopped chili, cardamom pods or ground cardamom and garam masala powder. Cook for 1 minute. Add chopped peas and stir until the sauce boils. Adjust the heat to medium and simmer for 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: lettuce leaf,spring onion,swiss cheese,chocolate square,toast,chicken breast,ricotta cheese
title: Chicken Swiss Toast
ingredients: 1 chicken breast ( or 1 turkey thigh ) | 6 slices swiss cheese | 4 slices thick toast, cut into 3 sections | 1 1/2 cups ricotta cheese | 4 spring onions ( scallions or green onions ) | 1/4 cup spring onion, finely chopped | 1/4 cup lettuce leaf | 1 chocolate square, grated
instructions: In a frying pan with a little oil or butter brown chicken breast over hot coals. When brown, place the chicken breasts on the toasts, top with some of the cheese, scallions and spring onions. Sprinkle with the spring onions and garnish with some grated chocolate.

Random Ingredients: french bread,chinese rice wine,corn tortilla chip
title: Quick  Chinese Bread Chips
ingredients: 8 ounces frozen french bread, thawed and sliced thin | 1 bag plain corn tortilla chips, crisply coat with cooking oil | chinese rice wine ( shao hsing yong )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350f degrees. Line baking sheet with foil. Spray slices of french bread on foil with cooking spray. Place on prepared baking sheet and bake for 5 minutes or until toasted. Meanwhile, combine rice wine and 4 tblspn of the crisco in a small bowl. Heat remaining crisco over medium heat in a large non stick skillet. Sprinkle bread with more crisco and place on the cookie sheet. Bake for 5 minutes or until slightly crispy around edges and slightly browned at edges. Transfer to a wire rack and cool 5 minutes. Remove from oven and stir until smooth. Break into bite size pieces and add to bread. Enjoy.

title: Pounded Crust for Chicken
ingredients: 1 lb pie shell, cooled | 1 cup oil | pounded pickling spices
instructions: Shake out excess salt from pie crust and cut the crust into six pieces. On a lightly floured board or counter, roll out an 11 inch circle or circle of 12 inches diameter. The circle should be less than 1 3/4 inches in diameter. Cut off a quarter circle of pastry and use to line the circle. Using the back of the spoon, make a hole at 1 inch from the edge to form an opening in the crust. Fill with a scant 1/2 teaspoon of the reserved stuffing mixture. Roll up from the short side. Make a slit in the crust edge with the finger and pull at the edges to seal. The crouton should be about 2 inches deep. Heat the oil 1 or 2 inches above the crouton. Working quickly, carefully place the crouton, not overcrowding, into the hot oil and fry on all sides for about 10 minutes. Do not crowd the croutons. You will have a fine crumbly texture. Drain on paper towels. Variation, when you remove the croutons from the oil, roll them in a spice bag and set aside. If using an open end of the pastry, roll these out long ways into a circle, about 1 3/4 inches in diameter. Note, the dough has to be very thin for this, and for this, about 1 3/4 inch of thickness.

Random Ingredients: sambuca romana,plum tomato,english cucumber,lime peel,salmon,graham cracker crumb,pineapple tidbit,rice krispies
title: Mock Cucumber and Smoked Salmon Roulades
ingredients: 4 plum tomatoes, halved | 12 ounces smoked salmon | 3 ounces smoked salmon | 1 english cucumber, diced | 1/2 cup toasted pineapple tidbits | 1/2 cup rice krispies, coarsely crushed | 1/3 cup sambuca romana | 1/3 cup graham cracker crumbs | 2 teaspoons lime peel, grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 350f degrees. Place tomatoes cut side up on a cutting board and cut 1/4 inch slices from top. Starting at center of tomato slices, remove narrow slice from underside of tomato and cut opposite side in half. Repeat with remaining tomatoes, using remaining slices. Place salmon on a baking sheet and bake 15 minutes until flesh has turned opaque. Remove from oven and discard skin. Cool. Cut salmon into 1/4 inch slices and place in a serving bowl. Add cucumber, pineapple, pineapples, rasniki, sambuca, and crumbs. Toss lightly until well blended. Spoon salmon mixture onto tomato halves and place on top of salmon. Sprinkle with lime peel.

Random Ingredients: feta cheese,dark sesame oil,red bell pepper,tarragon
title: Yummy Feta Spread
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 1 red bell pepper, chopped | 2 ounces crumbled feta cheese | 1 teaspoon dried tarragon
instructions: Preheat oven broiler. Toast sesame oil in a frying pan, on low heat. When the sesame is golden, put it in a large bowl. Add the green pepper, and cheese. Toss well. Pour sesame oil, and stir. Turn the heat under the frying pan up, to medium high. Once the cheese is melted, add the dried tarragon. Stir well. Once the mixture is thoroughly blended, transfer mixture into a loaf pan or into a small loaf casserole dish. If desired, you may also place this loaf onto a piece of aluminum foil when the cheese mixture is hot and warm, so that the cheese does not curdle. Allow to cool to room temperature, then serve this as you wish.

title: Jicama, Jicama and Brown Sugar Salad
ingredients: 2 jicama, peeled and cut into 1/8-inch chunks | 2 tablespoons brown sugar | 1 tablespoon garlic powder | 3 cups torn packed leaf lettuce - rinsed, dried and torn into bite sized pieces
instructions: In a medium size bowl, toss the jicama, sugar, and garlic powder. Cover, and refrigerate for 30 minutes. Just before serving, toss with lettuce, and serve on lettuce leaf.

Random Ingredients: pinto bean,fingerling potato,spring onion,chili sauce,marshmallow,spaghetti sauce,lemon juice zest
title: Mexican Pasta & Bean Salad
ingredients: 500 g fingerling potatoes | 100 g spaghetti sauce | 2 cups baked pinto beans | 1 chopped spring onion | 60 g miniature marshmallows | 1 grated lemon, juice and zest of | chili sauce, to serve ( optional )
instructions: Boil the fingerling potatoes. Meanwhile, bring a large pan of water to the boil. Drain the potato mixture, keeping it warm. Bring the spaghetti sauce to the boil and add the potato mixture, stirring gently. Pour over the potatoes and add the pinto beans, then return to the boil. Reduce the heat and cover for 10 minutes or until the potato is cooked. Using a potato masher pound the mixture until smooth.
