Put the marshmallows on to a griddle or frypan to soften and give them a stir. Add the remaining ingredients except for the lemon and chili sauce. Bring to the boil, cover and simmer for 5 minutes until the marshmallows are melted.

title: Caribbean Sandwich With Caramelised Bananas
ingredients: 2 sandwich rolls ( i like soft sandwich rolls ) | 2 slices bread | 2 tablespoons golden syrup ( i like amber maple syrup ) | 1 tablespoon catsup | 1 banana, sliced diagonally | 1 tablespoon peanut oil or 1 tablespoon corn syrup | 1 tablespoon coconut milk ( for dipping ) | 6 -8 slices pecorino romano cheese
instructions: Place sandwich rolls in microwave safe dish, microwave on high 3 - 4 minutes or until golden brown, turning once. Place 2 slices of bread on a plate. Spread golden syrup, followed by catsup on top and top with sliced banana. Place remaining bread slices on plate. Spread peanut/corn syrup, then top with cheese slice, sandwich should just fit into sandwich pan. In a small skillet, saute banana in olive oil for 3 - 5 minutes or until golden brown. Serve with caramelised bananas and dip for dipping.

title: Linguine and Linguine
ingredients: 1 package dry lasagna noodles | 1 pound dry linguine
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add lasagna pasta, and cook for 8 to 10 minutes, or until al dente. Drain, and transfer to a serving bowl. Add linguine, and toss to coat. This can be made ahead, and refrigerated until ready to serve.

title: Homemade Spicy Indian Yogurt
ingredients: 3 cups greek yogurt | 1/2 tablespoon sambal oelek or 1/2 tablespoon crushed chili
instructions: Whisk yogurt and sambal together. Drain any liquid from yogurt and stir it into the yogurt. Transfer to a bowl or chill in the refrigerator before serving.

Random Ingredients: cheddar cheese,leg lamb,scallion,ice water,hot pepper flake,bread
title: Salsa Roast Lamb Sandwich Spread
ingredients: 1 cup shredded cheddar cheese | 1 bunch scallion, chopped | 1 1/2 lbs boneless leg of lamb | 1/2 cup ice water | 1/4 teaspoon hot pepper flakes | 4 -6 slices dry bread
instructions: Place the cheddar cheese and scallions in blender or food processor and process until smooth. Trim any fat from lamb and cut into 2 inch by 2 inch chunks. Put into a bowl with water, hot pepper flakes and salt. Add lamb chunks and stir so all is coated with the creamy mixture. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Preheat oven to 350°f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Uncover the lamb and bake 40 - 45 minutes or till lamb is cooked to your preference. When lamb is cooked, remove from oven, discard paper and allow to rest for 20 minutes. Slice lamb into 1/2 inch slices.

Random Ingredients: plain yogurt,broccoli,vanilla pudding,white fish fillet,beef chuck,italian salad dressing mix
title: Easy Italian Fish
ingredients: 1 lb white fish fillet, fresh | 1 package instant vanilla pudding | 1 package beef chuck, fresh | 1 container plain low-fat yogurt | 1 package italian salad dressing mix | 5 lbs broccoli, fresh | 2 jars roasted garlic flavored pimento-stuffed green olives ( jarred works nicely ) or 2 jars roasted red peppers ( jarred works nicely )
instructions: Spray a roasting pan with non stick spray. Place fish fillet in foil lined pan. Sprinkle with dried Italian salad dressing mix. Roast at 450 degrees for 45 minutes or until fish flakes easily with a fork. Cool and cut into 4 servings. Put fish on serving plates. Top with marinated cheese and roasted garlic.

title: Yummy and Savory Jasmine Jasmine Rice
ingredients: 2 cups jasmine rice ( rinsed thoroughly with cold water ) | 2 drops cream of tartar | pepper | 1 tablespoon rice wine
instructions: Boil your jasmine rice until tender. Stir up any remaining clumps. Add cream of tartar, pepper and rice wine. Stir until the rice has absorbed everything. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: galangal,raisin,baby lima bean,beef gravy,sherry wine,spicy brown mustard
title: Faux Lamb Stew
ingredients: 1 ounce dried baby lima beans | 2 tablespoons spicy brown mustard | 1 tablespoon sherry wine | 1 fresh ginger, sliced | 1 tablespoon grated galangal | 1 fluid ounce beef gravy
instructions: Soak the beans and lima beans in water over night. Boil until cooked and cooled. Remove the water, then drain. Combine the mustard, sherry, ginger and half the grated galangal with enough water to make the gravy. Cover and simmer gently for 10 minutes. Stir in the gravy and serve.

title: Cheesy Vegetable Bake
ingredients: 5 ounces mixed vegetables | 1/4 cup shredded cheddar cheese
instructions: Thoroughly mix together the cheddar and mozzarella cheese in an oven proof dish. In a separate bowl, combine the vegetables and cheese/vegetable mixture. Sprinkle this mix over the chedder cheese and bake in a pre heated 375 degree f oven for 25 - 30 minutes.

title: Brigadeiro
ingredients: 1 tablespoon white sugar, or to taste | 1 teaspoon orange zest | 1 orange, zested ( optional )
instructions: Sprinkle sugar on a piece of waxed paper sprinkled with sugar, and roll up paper tightly. Chill 3 hours. Place orange zest into a dry skillet and add the sugar. Bring to a boil, and cook until the sugar is golden brown. Watch carefully. Remove orange so that it doesn't burn and add the orange, if using. Allow to cool completely. Store in an airtight container.

title: Quick and Easy Pork and Vegetable Dumplings
ingredients: 1 pound ground pork | 1 package instant wonton wrappers | 4 cups chicken stock | 1 package dry chili seasoning mix | 1 package dry pasta, cooked and drained
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium high heat, and cook and stir the ground pork until the liquid has cooked away and the pork is crumbly, evenly browned, and no longer pink. Drain off excess grease, and set the pork aside. Place the wonton wrappers in a bowl, and sprinkle with a little water to prevent them from sticking. Set aside. In a saucepan, mix the chicken stock and chili seasoning mix, and bring to a boil. When the mixture boils, reduce heat to low, and simmer for about 5 minutes. Place the cooked noodles in a serving dish. Spoon pork mixture onto noodles, and top with another serving dish. Garnish the dish with a toothpick.

Random Ingredients: chow mein noodle,cranberry,kalamata olive,milk,green cardamom pod
title: Minty Chawr
ingredients: 2 large minty chow mein noodles | 2 cups milk | 8 green cardamom pods ( crushed ) | 3 tablespoons dried cranberries | 3 kalamata olives, pitted and finely chopped ( or any other dark green vegetable )
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c, gas mk 10, 190c, gas mk 2, fan forced. Bring milk, to the boil in a medium size, non stick frying pan, and add crushed cardamom pods, dried cranberries and chopped kalamata olives. Then turn off heat and leave to infuse for about 5 minutes, you may need to add up to 2 or 3 tbsp of hot water. Drain noodles well and toss them in the sauce. Spread over a large baking tray, and sprinkle top with a little chopped fresh herbs. Bake in the middle of the oven about 25 minutes, until puffed up and golden, turning several times. Allow to cool completely before serving. This can be frozen in small plastic bags and reheated later. This can vary based on your freezer or electricity. A few small batches will go perfectly in a bag.

Random Ingredients: beef chuck,burgundy wine,hot pepper,veal,yellow pepper,chili pepper,water artichoke heart
title: Beef Steak Sandwich
ingredients: 1/2 lb hot pepper, sliced in half into strips | 1/2 lb veal, thinly sliced | 1/2 lb beef chuck, thinly sliced ( or top sirloin ) | 1/2 lb yellow pepper, sliced in strips | 1/2 lb hot pepper, sliced in strips | 1 can sliced water-packed artichoke hearts | 2 cups burgundy wine | 1/4 - 1/2 cup burgundy wine
instructions: Place a large skillet on med flame and brown the steak and peppers with garlic and onion until the meat is cooked. Turn of heat. Add artichoke hearts and burgundy. Simmer, covered, until the wine has reduced somewhat. Add the hot pepper to the wine, stir, and allow to warm. Serve in hoagie rolls.

title: Orange Preserves
ingredients: 3 1/2 tablespoons white vinegar | 4 1/2 tablespoons confectioners'sugar | 2 1/2 teaspoons grated orange zest
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together the vinegar, confectioners' sugar and zest. Pour into 12 clean, dry mini jars. Seal well and process in a water bath for 15 minutes. Cool and store in the refrigerator.

title: Pita Bread Tacos
ingredients: 12 medium pita bread | 1 2 teaspoons chili oil
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with foil. Warm the pita breads in the oven for about 5 minutes. Open the pita breads.

Random Ingredients: chickpea,confectioner sugar,bread machine yeast,plain yogurt,turmeric,garlic clove,salt black pepper,chili powder
title: Chickpea Garlic Naan Bread
ingredients: 2 cups dried chickpeas, rinsed and drained | 1 1/2 teaspoons salt | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground turmeric | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground chili powder | 2 tablespoons bread machine yeast | 2 1/4 cups plain yogurt | 1 1/4 cups confectioners'sugar, sifted | 4 garlic cloves, minced
instructions: Place the dried chickpeas, salt, turmeric, chili powder, bread machine yeast, yogurt, confectioners' sugar, and garlic into the pan of a bread machine in the order recommended by the manufacturer. Select the basic bread setting. When the bread has bread cycle, remove the bread, and beat with electric mixer for a few minutes until the dough looks thick and has a smooth texture. Place the bread into a greased 10x15 inch jelly roll pan or other loaf pan. Cover loosely with plastic wrap and let rise in a warm place until doubled in bulk, about 1 1/2 hours. Cut into nine 1 x 1 1/2 inch thick slices. Bake in a preheated 400 degrees f oven until golden brown on the edges, about 25 minutes. If desired, sprinkle the bread slices with paprika while still hot, or serve warm.

title: Worcestershire Dip
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons nonfat sour cream | 1 teaspoon worcestershire sauce
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together the nonfat sour cream and worcestershire sauce. Cover, and refrigerate for 2 hours to blend flavors.

title: Kale - Make Yourself Own Good Kale!
ingredients: 1/2 cup vegetable shortening | 1/2 cup palm sugar, finely grated ( i use palm sugar substitute ) | 1 package ladyfingers ( thawed if frozen ) | 2 cups kale ( cooked ) | sweet dessert wine, to serve
instructions: Melt shortening in a sauce pan. Add palm sugar and savoury to taste and mix thoroughly. Cook ladyfingers in shortening mixture. Arrange in single layer on large cookie sheet and pour the sweet dessert wine over them to cover. Bake at 375 degrees fahrenheit for 10 - 15 minutes for softer cookies. Cut into slices and serve with sweet dessert sauce.

Random Ingredients: artichoke heart,anchovy fillet,yeast,chili paste,kidney bean,green chile pepper,tamari,steak
title: Spicy Beef on the Barbie
ingredients: 3 cups cooked and shredded sirloin | 1 jar marinated artichoke hearts, drained and quartered | 1 can kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 1 green chile pepper | 1/2 cup tamari | 2 tablespoons chili paste | 1 1/2 (.18 ounce ) packages dry yeast | 10 anchovy fillets, minced | 2 tablespoons prepared minced anchovy paste ( optional )
instructions: Mix shredded steak, artichoke hearts, kidney beans, green chile pepper, tamari, 1 1/2 envelope of the dry yeast, 2 tablespoons of the chili paste, and 1/2 the anchovy flakes in a medium bowl. Cover with plastic wrap and let stand until the yeast is foamy, about 12 minutes. Preheat an oven to 450 degrees f. Line a round baking dish with parchment paper. Mix 1 tablespoon of the minced anchovy paste with the remaining 1/2 envelope yeast and remaining 1 tablespoon anchovy flavor. Transfer half of the mixture in to the prepared baking dish. Spread the remaining cheese mixture over the top. Cover and let stand in refrigerator at least 1 hour. Bake in the preheated oven 40 to 45 minutes, until bubbly and hot. Let stand 5 minutes before slicing.

title: Homemade Coffee for Tea
ingredients: 1 package brewed coffee | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom
instructions: Pour coffee into a mug. Crush cardamom into a spoon and stir. Pour into mug.

Random Ingredients: brown rice,spanish onion,plain flour,tortilla,green onion,dark sesame oil,asafoetida powder,red chile pepper
title: Spicy Nogalese Fried Rice
ingredients: 3 cups cooked white rice | 1/4 spanish onion, finely chopped | 1 large fresh red chile pepper, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon ground asafoetida powder | 1/2 teaspoon dark sesame oil | 2 2 tablespoons plain flour or 2 tablespoons gluten-free flour | 2 green onions, finely chopped | 2 2 tablespoons purchased plain tortillas or 2 tablespoons sesame seeds, toasted
instructions: Place the rice with 1 cup of water in a saucepan. Cover, and simmer over medium heat for 30 minutes, until water is absorbed. Remove from heat and leave to stand for 5 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, fluff the rice with your fingers. Set aside. Finely chop the onion and chili and mix with the remaining ingredients. Set aside. Heat the sesame oil in a non stick pan. Stir fry the rice for 3 minutes, or until heated through. Sprinkle the top each serving with a few tablespoons of the sweet and sour sauce. Tip, to serve, separate the rice into large sections and place on large platter. Fry the noodles in a pan with just a little water. Sprinkle them with more sweet and sour sauce and serve with noodles.

title: Beef Rib & Beetroot Salad
ingredients: 2 lbs beef short ribs | 1 teaspoon cream of tartar | 4 eggs noodles | 1 jar kalamata olives, rinsed and drained | 2 1/2 teaspoons dried oregano | 2 teaspoons ground dried oregano | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla | 1/2 cup sour cream | 1/2 small diced beetroot | radish, to garnish
instructions: Place beef in a large, heavy bottomed pot that has a tight fitting lid. Add water to almost cover the beef. Place over medium heat and bring to a boil. Cover, reduce heat to medium and cook for an hour. Drain and allow to cool in refrigerator. Cut beef into 1 inch pieces. Break each egg into a bowl of cold water and set aside with egg. Place kalamata olives in a large bowl and refrigerate for 30 minutes, then drain. Whisk sour cream and cream of tartar together. Drain and rinse beetroot and add to sour cream and sour cream mixture. Add beef, cooked eggs and dried oregano. Turn the beetroot mixture into a chilled salad bowl, cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 1 - 2 hours. Prior to serving, sprinkle dried oregano on top and garnish with radish.

title: Vanilla Bean Puree
ingredients: 1 medium vanilla bean, split lengthwise | 3/4 cup red beans, soaked overnight | 1 pint vanilla beans
instructions: In double boiler, add all ingredients. Heat to boiling. Lower heat, cover and simmer 45 minutes. Remove vanilla bean pods. Cool down.

Random Ingredients: lemon zest,msg,peanut oil vegetable,penne,peppercorn,coffee liqueur,caesar salad dressing
title: Pub Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb penne | 1/2 cup peanut oil or 1/2 cup vegetable oil | 32 peppercorns | 2 tablespoons chicken flavored salad dressing ( caesar beef salad dressing ) | 3 tablespoons dried basil and lemon zest | 3 tablespoons coffee liqueur ( kahlua ) | 1 teaspoon msg, accent ( optional )
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. While pasta is cooking, heat oil in a frying pan. Add peppercorns to oil and fry for 30 seconds. Remove and add to salad. Toss salad with dressing and spices. Add coffee liqueur to taste and garnish with cheese. Enjoy.

title: Chinese Buffet Style Noodle With Cream
ingredients: 1 package chow mein noodles | 2 cups double cream
instructions: Prepare chow mein noodles according to package directions. Beat cream until creamy and beat into cream noodles. Pour into a large dish or individual serving dishes. Garnish with chow mein noodles.

Random Ingredients: rice,cayenne pepper,rigatoni pasta,jalapeno pepper,shake n bake,chicken breast
title: Chicken Ole'
ingredients: 1 envelope shake-n-bake, chicken flavor | 5 -6 boneless skinless chicken breasts, cubed | 1 fresh jalapeno pepper, seeded and thinly sliced | 2 cups uncooked rice | 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1 package rigatoni pasta
instructions: Slightly coat meat with shake and bake and place in a crockpot. Add sliced jalapeno and sprinkle liberally with cayenne, reserving some for topping. Cook on high for 2 hours, or on low for 4 hours. Add chicken and let it cook until tender. Rinse the rice and drain. Place rice in a large mixing bowl and add enough hot water to cover the rice. Stir until the rice is clear. Add enough chicken broth to the rice if necessary and stir to mix. Cover and refrigerate for at least 8 hours. When ready to serve, bring to a boil, reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 30 minutes or until chicken is hot and rice is tender.

title: Egg Nog Sandwiches
ingredients: 1/2 loaf unsliced whole wheat pita bread | 1/2 cup uncooked long grain rice, rinsed | 1/2 lb mild bulk sausage | 1/2 cup pesto sauce | 8 3/4 fluid ounces water
instructions: Cut off top third of loaf of pita bread and cut loaf into 16 slices. Cut 8 slices of bread into 1 inch pieces. In a medium size, deep fry fryer, cook sausage breaking it up as it fries, until no longer pink, about 10 minutes. Drain and crumble. Set aside. Add rice to fryer.

Random Ingredients: tomato green chilies,beef sirloin steak,italian pork sausage,fire tomato,cauliflower,green cardamom pod,hazelnut,grain wild rice
title: Spanish-Style Beef and Cauliflower Skillet
ingredients: 2 packages long grain and wild rice blend | 2 lbs boneless beef sirloin steaks, cut into 1-inch pieces | 2/3 cup chopped hazelnuts | 12 large cauliflower, florets separated from steaks | 8 medium size green cardamom pods, bruised with blade | 12 ounces mild italian pork sausage, casings removed | 1 can fire-roasted tomatoes, undrained | 1 can tomato-flavored green chilies, undrained ( optional )
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions. Meanwhile, in a skillet, cook beef and hazelnuts over medium heat until meat is no longer pink.

title: Hot Chili Powder
ingredients: 4 tablespoons chili powder | 1 medium red onion, thinly sliced
instructions: Mix and store in an airtight container.

title: Pasta With Tahini Pork and Blue Cheese on the Barbie
ingredients: 500 g pasta shells | 2 tablespoons prepared tapioca's tahini | 1 lb boneless pork tenderloin, shaved | 1/2 cup plain old el paso enchilada sauce | 3/4 cup blue cheese, shredded | 1/4 teaspoon ground coriander | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne
instructions: Prepare the pasta according to the directions on the side of the box, using a large pot of salted water. Drain the pasta, reserving 1/4 cup cooking water, and set aside. Grill the pork until medium rare, stirring often, then set aside to cool to room temperature. Place the pasta and 1 1/2 cups reserved cooking water in a large bowl. Add the tahini and blend until creamy, about 1 minute. Add the pork and stir. Add half the cheese and stir until coated. Transfer the pork mixture to the pasta and toss. Return the remaining cheese to the pasta. Stir in the coriander, cayenne, and remaining cheese. Serve immediately. Store the taco shells on a rimmed baking sheet in the refrigerator.

title: Irish Stout Sole
ingredients: 1 large sole fillet | 1/2 cup irish whiskey ( or irish liqueur ) | 3 drops water | 4 ounces dried cranberries
instructions: Place the sole fillet on two sheets of heavy aluminium cling film and sprinkle each with the whisky. Coat the outside of the fillet with the lime and water mixture. Arrange the cranberries in a circle around the fish and secure with a wooden toothpick. Refrigerate the fish for about 8 hours. Cooks note, may be served with mashed potatoes or crisp rolls.

Random Ingredients: coconut cream,seasoning salt,date,green chili pepper,asafoetida powder,fine salt,szechuan peppercorn
title: Coconut Prawns (Shrimps)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs prawns, raw, peeled weight uncooked | 1 cup coconut cream, full cream | 1 medium green chili pepper, fresh, seeds removed, finely chopped | 1/4 cup dates, coarsely chopped ( or 1/4 cup dried fruit ) | 2 1/2 teaspoons szechuan peppercorns | 1 teaspoon seasoning salt | 2 teaspoons sesame seeds or 2 teaspoons peppercorns, dark for colour
instructions: Put prawns in a saucepan of hot water. Boil. When they are cooked and the prawns are clean, drain them and put them into a clean saucepan. Sprinkle with the salt, sichuan peppercorns, seasoning salt. Bring to the boil again and then add coconut cream. Allow it to boil for 1 minute. Add the green chilli. Cover and simmer on low heat till the prawns are done{approximately 5 minutes}. Serve with coconut rice and pickles.

title: Tomatoes in Tomato Sauce
ingredients: 2 cups grape tomatoes or 2 cups cherry tomatoes, halved | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley
instructions: Preheat oven to 375f degrees. Toss tomatoes with parsley in a large bowl.

Random Ingredients: mushroom,thai red chili pepper,chili pepper flake,bicarbonate soda
title: Tongolian Mushroom Biscuits (Stolen Mix
ingredients: 4 mushrooms, finely chopped | 1 garlic, finely chopped | 1 -2 teaspoon thai red chili pepper flakes | 1/2 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda
instructions: In a bowl mix the garlic, chili, chili flakes and bicarb soda and mix to a paste with your fingers. Add more salt if necessary to bind and then store in an airtight container.

title: Pavo Canapes With Mango and Garlic
ingredients: 2 tablespoons heavy cream | 2 tablespoons canned artichoke hearts, drained and chopped | 5 ounces red dates or 5 ounces dates, chopped | 1 clove garlic salt | 1 1/2 ounces mangoes, sliced
instructions: Heat cream and artichoke hearts over hot water and drain excess liquid. Combine garlic and mango slices, and add cream mixture and stir well. Drop mixture onto paper towel covered cookie sheet.

title: Chocolate-Anise Spread
ingredients: 3/4 cup mayonnaise | 1/4 cup vegetable broth | 1/2 cup hazelnuts, shelled and coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup semisweet chocolate, melted | 1/2 teaspoon anise seed | 1/8 teaspoon clam juice
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine the mayonnaise, broth, nuts, chocolate, anise and clam juice. Mix well. Adjust the spice by adding more nut or anise. Place the mixture into a food processor or blender and pulse until smooth. Spread into a serving bowl and refrigerate until ready to use.

Random Ingredients: dark sesame oil,nam pla,spanish onion,creme de menthe,pam cooking spray,beef tenderloin roast
title: Lucky Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 lbs beef tenderloin roast | pam cooking spray | 3 tablespoons nam pla ( dark soy sauce ) | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil | 1 large spanish onion, sliced | 1 tablespoon nam pla ( dark soy sauce ) | 1 tablespoon nam pla ( thai fish sauce ) | 1 teaspoon nam pla ( thai fish sauce )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°. Coat a roasting pan with cooking spray and set aside. Place beef on rack in pan and brush all sides with dark soy sauce. Let sit for 30 minutes. Cut and score meat across grain in 1/4 inch slices across and in half. Place in roasting pan. Spray top with pam. Sprinkle with 1 tblsp dark sesame oil. Roast until meat thermometer reaches 140° rare 120°, 20 to 25 minutes for medium rare, 25 to 30 minutes for medium well, 30 to 40 minutes for well done. Remove meat from pan, cover and let rest 5 minutes. Increase oven temperature to 400°. In food processor or blender, combine onion and 2 tablespoons nam pla.

Random Ingredients: cumin,red chili pepper,rye flour,lemon juice zest,salmon,chocolate chip
title: Aussie Salmon With Chili & Chocolate Chips
ingredients: 200 g soft bread ( rye or multi-grain ) | 1 tablespoon lemon juice ( zest from 1 lemon ) | 1 medium red chili pepper, thinly sliced | 1/4 teaspoon ground cumin | 4 -8 slices semi-sweet chocolate chips ( or use chocolate chips ) | 180 g salmon, skin removed
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees centigrade. Line a baking tray with foil, spray on a little olive oil and bake for 15 minutes or until golden, or until crisp. Meanwhile, place all ingredients for the chili chip in a food processor, blend for 5 seconds or until the mixture resembles a chunky paste. Cut out a small circle on a chopping board, place the salmon pieces on top and press with a spatula to get rid of the excess liquid. Spread with the chili chip mixture, top with grated chocolate and bake for 5 - 10 minutes, or until the salmon is heated through.

title: Swedish Dessert
ingredients: 1/2 cup yogurt | 1/4 cup sweet hungarian paprika | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 2 tablespoons sliced almonds | 8 tablespoons sweet sour mix ( like bisquick )
instructions: Serve over ice.

Random Ingredients: vegemite,zucchini,bread,salmon fillet,chickpea flour,bamboo skewer,green chili pepper
title: Grilled Salmon With Vegemite Crumbs-Pebrithes
ingredients: 2 salmon fillets | vegemite | 8 slices bread | 1 zucchini, finely grated | 2 green chili peppers, finely chopped | 2 cans chickpea flour ( chickpea flour ) | 8 bamboo skewers, soaked in water
instructions: Preheat a grill pan. Place salmon on the grill pan and brush with vegemite. Cook for 7 - 8 minutes, turning the salmon twice or until just cooked through. Meanwhile, place the bread on a baking tray. Sprinkle with a little salt. Grill for 4 - 5 minutes or until golden. Place zucchini, chilli and chickpea flour in an ovenproof pie dish. Brush with water and then lay the salmon skin side down. Scoop the vegemite mixture onto the fish. Top the fish with the breadcrumbs. Brush with water. Grill for 12 - 15 minutes or until the bread crumbs are golden.

Random Ingredients: apricot,ginger garlic paste,serrano pepper,mushroom,spinach,beef chuck roast,polenta,suet
title: Cassic Roast Beef
ingredients: 5 lbs bone in beef chuck roast | 1 lb suet ( ground into a coarse crumb ) | 1 container instant polenta | 6 ounces frozen chopped spinach | 12 ounces sliced mushrooms | 1 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste | fresh serrano pepper ( optional ) | mushroom ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees farenheit. Trim excess fat from meat. Place in 9x13 inch baking dish and sprinkle with suet. In blender, mix suet, polenta, spinach, mushrooms, ginger garlic paste, and pepper to taste. Spread on top of beef. Cover tightly with aluminum foil, and bake for 2 1/2 hours. Remove from oven. Cover tightly and place roasting pan on top of stove burner. Place roasting pan over low burner for 30 - 60 minutes. Check meat frequently so it doesn't burn. If desired, cover and let rest for another 20 - 30 minutes before slicing.

title: The Best Chili in the World
ingredients: 1 lb uncooked macaroni | 14 ounces hot italian turkey sausage ( mild ) | 1 lb hamburger | 8 ounces cream cheese | 2 1/2 cups shredded basil | 8 slices cooked asparagus | 2 garlic cloves, smashed | 3 tablespoons molasses
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. In a large pot, cook macaroni in boiling water just until al dente, and drain. Brown hot italian sausage and hamburger. Drain fat, if necessary. Set aside and cool slightly. Drain cooked macaroni thoroughly and cut in half. Arrange in the bottom of a large casserole dish. Combine the cooked macaroni and sausage/sausage/sauce/garlic in a bowl and mix well. Spread over the macaroni layer and top with the basil. Combine cream cheese, basil, garlic and molasses in a bowl and spread over the italian layers. Dot with a little bit of the cream cheese mixture on top. Bake in oven for 30 minutes. It is so easy.

title: Halloween Dogs-Bun
ingredients: 30 large corn tortillas | 1 can tomato soup | 2 tablespoons catsup | 2 cups walnuts ( chopped ) | 1/4 cup roasted salted almond ( sliced ) | 1/4 cup roasted walnuts ( chopped )
instructions: In a small saucepan combine the tomato soup, catsup and nuts. Heat on low until almost boiling. Remove from heat and stir in hazelnuts. Spoon into hot dog buns/rolls and sprinkle with sliced nuts.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon cube,tortilla chip,strawberry,baby carrot,orange peel,chinese cabbage
title: Chinese Tortilla Chips Salad
ingredients: 1 bag of tortilla chips | 10 baby carrots, quartered | 2 chinese cabbage, thinly sliced | 1 can of chopped strawberries, drained | 4 tablespoons chicken bouillon cubes | 2 tablespoons orange peel, 1-inch slivers ( optional ) | 1/4 - 1/2 cup crispy red peppers or 1/4-1/2 cup other vegetables ( optional )
instructions: Toss all ingredients. Let set to meld and serve.

title: Mexican Casserole
ingredients: 3 cups cooked long-grain rice ( i use success 11/2 ) | 1/2 cup catsup | 1/2 cup chili, chopped | 1 cup part-skim mozzarella cheese, shredded
instructions: Preheat oven to combine first six ingredients, cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate for several hours or overnight. In a covered casserole dish, spoon rice mixture into casserole dish. Sprinkle with mozzarella. Cover dish tightly with foil, and bake for 45 minutes. Remove foil, and bake an additional 15 - 20 minutes. Note this recipe can be made 24 hours ahead, refrigerated. Reheat, covered, in preheated oven 10 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Low Fat, Low Cal, Low Fat Barley Recipe
ingredients: 1 cup pearl barley ( i use lundberg's ) | 1 tablespoon dried oregano leaves | 1 tablespoon cumin
instructions: Place the barley barley in a medium bowl. Place in refrigerator and cover. When the barley has chilled, drain well and add the oregano, cumin and cilantro. Stir well until mixed and set aside at room temperature. Note, i usually put this in to the same cold brew maker and let stand 10 minutes before serving.

title: Basic Tomato Soup
ingredients: 3 cans tomato paste ( i use progresso ) | 1 tablespoon cornstarch, plus additional | cornstarch, for thickening and whisking
instructions: Pour the tomato paste into a big pot. Stir in the cornstarch and whisk until thickened. Add water, a tablespoon at a time, to make the soup thicker.

title: South Africa Beef and Kabobs
ingredients: 1 cup whole wheat flour | 2 lbs steak, thinly sliced against grain | 1 cup jicama, sliced | 1 can chickpeas | 2 1/2 tablespoons safflower oil | 1 orange or 2 plump limes, juice and rind of, grated | 3 -4 dashes lime juice
instructions: Prepare a large baking dish with non stick cooking spray and line with wax paper. Sift flour over steak, shaking off any excess flour. Place beef in a large zip lock bag. Pour all juices from pan over it. Refrigerate for 6 hours or overnight. Drain beef. Discard juice. Drain jicama. Trim off excess fat from jicama. Cut jicama into 1/4 inch cubes. Set aside. When ready, drain beef of any excess liquid, reserving liquid and rind. Reserve jicama liquid. In a bowl mix rinds, drained liquid, safflower oil and grated orange rind. Soak meat for about 10 minutes in marinade then squeeze the excess juice out. Pour beef into bowl with the reserved marinade. Cover and refrigerate for at least one hour of marination and up to 3 days. Thread beef on skewers. Grill or broil, if desired until well browned, about 2 to 7 minutes per side. Serve with plain boiled rice. Great with pita chips.

Random Ingredients: spring onion,bow tie pasta,nutmeg,monterey jack cheese,thai red curry paste
title: Thai Curried Bow Ties
ingredients: 1 lb bow tie pasta or 1 lb rotini pasta | 2 -3 tablespoons thai red curry paste ( to taste ) | 1 bunch spring onion ( chopped ) | 1 dash freshly grated nutmeg ( to taste ) | 1/2 - 3/4 lb of shredded monterey jack cheese ( the more the better )
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Cook the bow strings until cooked, about 3 - 5 minutes. Drain and rinse with cold water. Drain again. Preheat the oven to 375ºf. In a pan, bring 1 inch salted water to a boil. While it's heating up, cook the bow strings in the boiling water until they are just al dente. While they are cooking, cook the red curry paste in a microwave safe pan. Just to make it a little softer, heat it in a small pot until it melts into a paste. Toss the noodles with the paste in a large bowl. Add the remaining ingredients and mix well. Cover the bowl with a damp cloth and transfer to the oven. Return to the oven. Check the top of the bowl for doneness. If pasta is just al dente, cook it for another 6 - 7 minutes. If it's still firm, recover with a damp cloth and remove from the oven. Serve with a sprinkling of cheese on top of the bowtie and green salad.

Random Ingredients: whipping cream,white onion,button mushroom,dark soy sauce,rice flour
title: Soy Glaze Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 lb fresh button mushrooms | 2 tablespoons white onions, minced or 2 tablespoons shallots | 2 tablespoons rice flour | 1 tablespoon light dark soy sauce | 1/2 cup whipping cream
instructions: Clean mushrooms and finely chop stems, discarding stems. In a heavy pan, on medium heat, saute mushrooms, onions or shallots until limp and tender.

title: French Quarter Fish Kebabs
ingredients: 20 ounces fish fillets ( halibut, trout, haddock, monkfish, whitefish, haddock, any other firm fleshed fish will do ) | 6 eggs | 1 tablespoon chicken bouillon | 1 tablespoon triple sec
instructions: Place the fish in a plastic bag, and refrigerate the fish for 20 minutes. Preheat your outdoor grill to high heat. Meanwhile whisk the eggs with the bouillon and triple sec in a large bowl to form a liquid emulsion. After 20 minutes of refrigeration time, remove the fish and let sit for a further 10 or 15 minutes, so that the egg mixture goes cold to avoid curling. Place the soaked cod in the egg mixture, flake the fish with small bites and gently fold into the egg mixture. Place onto the hot grill and cook on each side for 6 to 8 minutes until they are cooked through and flaky.

title: French Vanilla (French Vanilla Chicken)
ingredients: 1 kg bone-in meat | 1 gallon chicken bouillon | 2 vanilla beans
instructions: Cut the vanilla beans into 4 sections. Put half of the vanilla beans in the blender. Place 1/2 chicken bouillon over the vanilla beans. Cover, leave on the lid and leave on the variable to go until the meat is nice and ripe in your mouth. After 2 hours the vanila is ready. Take out the vanilla beans.

title: Curried Eggs With Chiles in Tomato Sauce
ingredients: 8 small fresh tomatoes and green chilies or 4 small fresh jalapeno chiles, seeded and cut into julienne | 3 tablespoons curry paste | 4 egg yolks, beaten | 6 tablespoons chopped coriander ( cilantro ) or 6 tablespoons parsley
instructions: Heat curry paste in a medium nonstick skillet. Add chopped tomatoes. Season with salt and pepper. Saute, stirring occasionally, for about 10 minutes, or until tomatoes are a little dry. Stir beaten egg yolks in a small bowl. Pour hot mixture into tomatoes, stirring constantly. Serve garnished with coriander or parsley.

title: Tahini Honey Mustard
ingredients: 1/4 cup tahini | 3 tablespoons honey mustard
instructions: Place the tahini in a small bowl. Stir in the honey mustard and combine well. Cover, and refrigerate for up to 3 days, stirring occasionally.

title: Italian Brandy Sauce for Mushrooms
ingredients: 1/2 lb fresh ricotta cheese | 3 tablespoons brandy | 1/2 green bell pepper, roasted and peeled
instructions: Place the ricotta cheese in a medium sized bowl. Add brandy and stir. Add green pepper, stir and serve.

title: Mexican Sour Cream Fritters, or Fritters for Chips!
ingredients: 1 chipotles in adobo sauce, seeded and chopped | 3 small dried chilies ( such as new mexico ancho or jalapeno chiles ) | 2 tablespoons dried spearmint | 10 tablespoons cake flour, sifted | 1 tablespoon soy sauce
instructions: Toast the chilies over dry heat, shaking, so chilies remain intact. Toast the chilies in a dry skillet over medium heat, turning frequently, until charred, about 3 minutes total. Place in a medium bowl, cover and set aside to cool. Meanwhile combine the remaining ingredients and mix well. With your hands, mix in chilies. Dip the fritters in the soy sauce then quickly fry in a heavy skillet until golden brown, 3 to 5 minutes per side.

title: Lime, Asiago, And Chicken Rillettes (Risi E Bisi)
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups chicken stock | 1/2 cup basmati rice | 2 tablespoons freshly grated asiago cheese | 4 lime wedges
instructions: In a medium saucepan, bring the chicken stock to a simmer over medium high heat. Stir in the rice and basil. Reduce heat to medium low, cover, and cook until the rice is tender and creamy, about 18 minutes. Sprinkle asiago cheese over the top and continue to cook, stirring gently, until cheese is melted. Serve warm. Serve with lime wedges.

title: Spicy Gorgonzola Candy
ingredients: 5 ounces gorgonzola | 1/2 cup seltzer water | 1 1/2 teaspoons coriander powder | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom seed | 1/4 teaspoon whole cardamom seed
instructions: Melt gorgonzola over low heat in a double boiler until it gets a creamy consistency. Beat it well with a spoon. Add seltzer water and stir continuously. After a minute or two, mix in spices. Remove the gorgonzola from the double boiler and pour into a small tray. Put into the refrigerator until firm. Cut the candy pieces in half. Take out the cardamom seeds and cardamom. Sprinkle gorgonzola on top. You can store in a dark container.

Random Ingredients: chinese five spice powder,sesame oil,shallot,green olive,red pepper flake
title: Chinese Five-Spice Green Olives
ingredients: 12 ounces green olives, cut lengthwise into 1/2-inch slices | 1 teaspoon sesame oil | 1/8 teaspoon chinese five spice powder | 3/8 - 1/4 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 1/2 shallot, minced
instructions: Combine all above ingredients in jar with tight fitting lid. Shake vigorously until blended. Can be stored in refrigerator for up to 1 month.

title: Butternut Squash and Pepper French Fries
ingredients: 1 lb butternut squash, peeled, seeded, cut in half and seeded | 1/2 lb yellow sweet pepper, halved, cut into thin strips | 10 -12 ounces french fries, cooked | 5 tablespoons cherry, conserve ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees fahrenheit. Cut squash into 1 inch cubes. Place squash and squash on 1 cookie sheet, drizzle with olive oil and bake for 25 minutes or until squash and squash are tender. Scoop out and divide squash among 4 casseroles. Place sweet pepper strips between the pieces and top with french fries.

Random Ingredients: vinegar,black tea,picante sauce,bay leaf,sriracha sauce,cognac,ginger garlic paste,lemon pepper
title: Black Tea Blend Concentrate
ingredients: 4 cups low-sodium black tea ( your favorite brand ) | 2 cups picante sauce | 1 cup cognac or 1 cup brandy | 1 bay leaf | 3 tablespoons ginger-garlic paste | 1 tablespoon lemon pepper | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon sriracha hot sauce | 1 tablespoon vinegar
instructions: Add all ingredients to a heavy saucepan. Stir, bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer 1 to 2 hours, until it has reduced in volume by half, about 15 to 20 minutes. Transfer mixture to a container, cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for up to 1 week.

Random Ingredients: orange juice,orange,mushroom stem,bell pepper,yeast,shrimp,colby monterey jack cheese
title: Shrimp Pizza
ingredients: 1 package dry yeast | 2 cups orange juice, at room temperature ( orange liqueur is a good substitute ) | 1/2 - 1 lb shrimp | 1 large bell pepper, sliced into rings ( red and/or green ) | 1 medium mushrooms sprig, cut in half | 1 can mushroom stems and pieces, drained | 1/2 medium diced orange rind | 1/3 cup shredded colby-monterey jack cheese
instructions: Dissolve yeast in the orange juice in a large mixing bowl. Add the shrimp, bell pepper, mushrooms, orange rind, and cheese. Stir everything evenly to combine and mix with your hands to combine the flavors. Scrape the inside of a large, round, or oval shaped pizza pan, or other heavy bottomed pan. Scatter the shrimp mixture evenly over the top of the meat mixture. Bake in a preheated 425° oven for 15 minutes, then decrease the temperature to 400 f and bake 5 minutes longer or until the crust is browned and bubbling. Allow to cool before cutting. Serve asap. The longer it sits, the more it absorbs the flavors of all the flavors. You can freeze this in a glad 9x13 baking pan, or just freeze them and eat them later.

title: Spicy Duck
ingredients: 4 duck breasts | 1 can spicy bean sauce ( or your hot bean of choice )
instructions: Heat up the spicy bean sauce over medium high, medium flame, on a grill that is not a pan. Cut open the duck breasts and carefully open them up like a book to be stuffed with spicy bean sauce. The whole way place the open boned side up on the pan, and use the same pan to heat up the hot bean sauce over the top, then place the duck breasts in the pan. Sprinkle with salt and pepper then turn a two on top. Let cook down until most of the water evaporates and your nose goes clean. This can take anywhere between 45 to 60 minutes depending on your heat scale, until duck is cooked through, and the internal temperature reaches 160 degrees. Remove from heat and serve.

title: Chinese Five-Spice Apples
ingredients: 2 cups green apples, peeled, cored and sliced | 2 tablespoons szechuan peppercorns, crushed
instructions: Fill a large saucepan 2/3 full with water.

title: Easy and Quick Firm Muffins.
ingredients: 1 1/2 teaspoons baking powder | 1 lime wedge
instructions: Pre heat the oven to 200°c / 325°f line the non stick muffin tin with non stick silicone paper / parchment paper / silicon pad. Place half of the lime wedge into each tin & then sprinkle over the baking powder. When you have 2 / 3 tbsp batter from the lime in each tin pour over half of that quantity of oil. Bake in the oven for 15 - 20 minutes depending on reservoir temp. Once baked remove & check with the toothpick if it comes out clean w/a tooth pick if not just the right colour. When done remove the paper / silicone pad from the muffins and allow to cool. Once cool you can either fill muffins with your favourite topping and enjoy.

title: Lascarpone Sauce W- Chiles & Mascarpone Cheese
ingredients: 2 lbs mascarpone cheese | 1/4 cup chicken broth | 1 fresh chilies ( or 3 teaspoons of fresh minced chiles )
instructions: Put the mascarpone cheese in a bowl and mix in the broth. Gently warm the chiles in a small pan. Stovetop, pour about 1/4 cup hot water into the bottom of your slow cooker to get a depth of 1/2. Add more hot water if desired. Using a spoon, loosen chiles and set aside in refrigerator. To serve, put chile in small bowl and pour a little sauce over it. Top with lots of paprika. Note, if you like extra chile, you can put a little of the chili into a bowl with the mascarpone and mix with a spoon. This would also be perfect in a crockpot along with your favorite vegetarian/vegetarian fajitas. This recipe is even better when you make it for a party or two, allowing guests to choose their own fillings.

title: Roasted Beef Dates (Cookies)
ingredients: 10 -12 dried dates | 1 lb stewing beef | 1 tablespoon creole seasoning
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit. Place dates on a parchment paper lined baking sheet. With scissors slash tops of dates from side to side with sharp knife, forming criss cross rows. Sprinkle with creole seasoning. Bake 15 to 20 minutes or until tender.

Random Ingredients: dark chocolate,chicken bouillon cube,coriander powder,filling,asparagus,green bean
title: Green Beans with Asparagus
ingredients: 1 lb fresh asparagus, fresh, trimmed | 7 ounces green beans, frozen ( cut into 1 inch pieces ) | 7 ounces dark chocolate | 2 cups chicken bouillon cubes ( or 2 cubes made with chicken broth ) | 1 teaspoon ground coriander powder | filling ( optional )
instructions: Wash your asparagus or your green beans with cold water and blanch them in a pot of boiling water for 2 minutes. Meanwhile, slice the green beans diagonally into 1 inch lengths and heat them in a large pan with the chocolate. Add the stock, coriander and chicken bouillon cubes and bring liquid to a boil, add the green beans and asparagus and reduce to low heat. Simmer for 20 minutes, covered. Serve hot or chilled with ice cream, if desired.

Random Ingredients: arborio rice,red bell pepper,shallot,portabella mushroom,chicken breast half,ginger garlic paste,tahini,cashew
title: Cashew Chicken with Portabella Risotto
ingredients: 1 cup shelled raw cashews | 1 cup chopped roasted salted cashews | 1/4 cup red bell pepper, chopped | 2 tablespoons chopped carrot ( optional ) | 2 shallots, minced, or more to taste | 1 tablespoon fresh ginger garlic paste | 1/2 cup arborio rice | 1/4 cup tahini | 2 tablespoons chicken fat
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Mix cashews, salted cashews, red bell pepper, carrot, shallot, ginger garlic paste, and arborio rice in a large bowl. Spread 1 tablespoon chicken fat over chicken and pat to evenly coat. Spread 1 tablespoon tahini paste atop another layer of cashews. Coat bottom and sides of a baking dish with some of the cooking spray. Arrange chicken in the dish. Bake in the preheated oven until chicken is cooked and cashews are toasted and beginning to brown, about 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: coffee,greek yogurt,chickpea,pecan,puff pastry,red kidney bean,sauerkraut,egg beater substitute
title: Totally Delicious Tasty Party Pies
ingredients: 1/2 cup canned red kidney beans, drained and rinsed well | 3/4 - 1 cup chickpeas, drained and rinsed well | 1/2 cup finely chopped pecans | 2 packages frozen puff pastry sheets | 3/4 cup egg beaters egg substitute | 1/4 cup low-fat greek yogurt | 1 teaspoon instant coffee ( powdered ) | 1/2 cup low fat and fat free whipped cream or 1/2 cup low-fat reduced fat greek yogurt
instructions: In a large bowl, combine beans, pecans, and egg beaters. On a lightly floured board, roll out sheets of pastry into a 12 inch circle. Cut into quarters and press edges firmly to seal. Cut in half and brush with egg white. In a bowl, beat together yogurt and instant coffee until smooth. Stir 1 tablespoon into yogurt mixture. Spoon 1/4 cup yogurt mixture into each pastry half. Spoon 1/4 cup bean mixture evenly over each pastry quarter. Fold pastry in half and crimp edges to seal. Place turnovers on ungreased cookie sheets and bake at 400f for 15 minutes. Serve warm or chilled with whipped cream or greek yogurt.

Random Ingredients: cardamom pod,oyster sauce,italian seasoning,hard egg,noodle,broccoli floret,vinegar,balsamic vinegar
title: Broccoli & Oyster Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons oyster sauce | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar | 1 tablespoon italian seasoning | 2 -3 hard-boiled eggs, chopped ( if you like ) | 3 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 1 tablespoon italian seasoning | 2 cardamom pods | 2 teaspoons fresh italian seasoning | 1 lb broccoli floret ( frozen or fresh, if you prefer ) | 1 bag noodles
instructions: In a small bowl, mix the two sauces and set aside. Pour the 2 tbsp of balsamic vinegar into a skillet with the other ingredients, mixing well. Cook them while heating up in the pan. Stir in the broccoli until it is cooked, then remove from heat. Add the noodles to the skillet. Mix the sauce, then serve.

Random Ingredients: red chili powder,egg substitute,saffron,flax seed,red capsicum,green pepper,dill weed,lemon
title: Moroccan Baked Eggs With  Capsicum  (Fesekeh Sabzi)
ingredients: 12 eggs | 16 ounces red capsicums ( sliced ) | 1/2 teaspoon saffron | 10 medium red capsicum ( sliced ) | 3/4 teaspoon dill weed | 1/2 teaspoon red chili powder | 4 fresh lemons | 1 -2 teaspoon flax seed
instructions: Hard boil 8 eggs, if you must remove the shells. Slice the eggs, if you wish, and keep in refrigerator for later. Toast the seeds in a frying pan. Remove as much oil as possible from the capsicums by putting them on paper towel, rubbing between your fingers until all the liquid of the capsicums has dried out. Dice the capsicums and mix with the saffron, then add them to the eggs. Combine capsicum with the dill, chilli powder, and salt to taste, then mix in the lemon peel. Coat the egg whites in beaten egg whites, either by brushing them thoroughly with melted margarine or by pouring the eggs from a pyrex dish into a glass dish, smoothing the tops. Slide the egg carefully into the pan with the capsicum mixture, cover with aluminium foil and bake in a preheated oven for about 40 minutes, until the coating of the egg is golden. Serve hot with ketchup or other dipping sauce or dip.

Random Ingredients: sea salt pepper,bread,shell pasta,onion,chili pepper,pecorino romano cheese
title: Cheesy Bread and Parmesan Cheese
ingredients: 6 -8 slices bread, loaf, loaf is preferable of course | 1/4 cup grated parmesan or 1/4 cup romano cheese | 12 ounces small shell pasta, cooked in salt, well drained and well drained ( or equivalent amount of fresh pasta ) | 1 can chili peppers, sliced | 1 small onion, sliced | sea salt and pepper
instructions: Pre heat oven to 375 f, or 350°f. Place bread on a baking sheet and sprinkle with cheese. Place chili peppers on top of cheese. Add chopped onion. Sprinkle with sea salt and pepper as needed. Bake, uncovered, for 15 minutes, until well colored and bread is crumbly. Watch closely to make sure not to overbake. When browned, remove to warm plate and cover with tinfoil or aluminum foil, to keep warm. If using fresh pasta, prepare according to package directions or package instructions. Serve with some good olive oil on top. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: strawberry,green pepper,mexican chocolate,spring onion,ginger garlic paste,pea,cilantro,red pepper
title: Mexican Chocolate Salad
ingredients: 4 -5 medium strawberries | 1/2 green pepper, cut into thin strips | 1/2 red pepper, cut into thin strips | 12 spring onions | 1 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste | 1/2 cup sweet red pepper, chopped | 1 tablespoon cilantro, chopped | 2 -3 teaspoons mango choclooms unsweetened instant milk, powdered | 1/4 cup frozen peas
instructions: Cut the strawberries in half and discard the hulls. Place the red and green peppers in a salad bowl, cut in strips the julienne as you like. Add the ginger garlic paste, mix and marinate for 30 minutes. In a small bowl add the sweet red bell peppers, cilantro and powdered mango choclooms and mix together. Add the frozen peas and mix all together. Toss all and serve. Note, mango chocloom can be found near walmart in the dairy section of most grocery stores. If you can find them, they make a great gift in the spice section of most the grocery stores.

Random Ingredients: green pea,granny smith apple,coconut milk,salmon,ricotta cheese,fish sauce
title: Coconut-Ricotta, Green Pea and Salmon Crumble
ingredients: 300 g smoked salmon, fillet cut into 8 pieces | 150 g green peas | 150 g low-fat ricotta cheese | 2 teaspoons fish sauce | 1 granny smith apple, finely diced | 125 ml coconut milk
instructions: Spray a medium size casserole dish with cooking spray, scatter in all ingredients. Cover with a lid, bake in oven for 1 hr at 175 c. Stir, bake for a further 1hr or until golden brown, top with a glaze of your choice.

Random Ingredients: pecan,rice paper,cheddar cheese,parmigiano reggiano cheese,egg noodle,cooking oil,panko breadcrumb
title: Noodles & Pecan Cheese Rolls
ingredients: 1 package egg noodles | 4 cups cooking oil | 1 3/4 cups panko breadcrumbs | 4 cups shredded cheddar cheese, divided | 4 teaspoons grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 4 sheets rice paper, or as needed ( approximately 36 square rounds ) | 4 large pecan pieces, for garnish
instructions: Cook noodles in boiling water until barely tender. Drain and rinse with cold water. Transfer noodles to a colander and rinse well with cold water. Drain again. Set aside. Place 2 tbsp of the shredded cheese in a shallow dish and spread out using your hands. Dip a round in the egg noodles, then dredge in panko. Set aside. Repeat with remaining rounds. Heat 2 tbsp of the oil in a deep fryer to 375°f. Deep fry the rolls in batches, about 2 minutes until golden and crisp. Drain on paper towels. Repeat with the remaining oil and rolls. Serve hot with reserved cheese. Garnish with pecan pieces. Nutritional information calories calories 2.

title: Garam Masala & Liver - Shrimp in the Microwave
ingredients: 1 cup water chestnut, chopped | 1 cup dry shrimps, cleaned, washed & halved | 1/4 cup golden raisin | 2 tablespoons garam masala | 2 teaspoons chopped fresh chives | 1 1/2 lbs liver
instructions: Place all ingredients in a 5 quart casserole. Cook on 100% power for 3 hours, rearranging and rearranging during last 30 - 45 minutes. Garnish with fresh chives & serve.

Random Ingredients: yellow bell pepper,vegetable oil cooking spray,spice,raisin,berry
title: Waldorf-Style Brown
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 cup chopped yellow bell pepper | 2 tablespoons raisins or 2 tablespoons currants | 1 1/2 teaspoons mixed spice | 1 lb mixed berries
instructions: Coat a large nonstick skillet with cooking spray and put over medium heat. Add the bell pepper, raisins, mixed spice and berries. Reduce the heat to low and cover. Cook for 10 minutes or until the green pepper is tender. Remove the cover and continue to cook, stirring every so often, until the berries are tender and glazed. Serve warm or cold.

Random Ingredients: greek yogurt,green cardamom,dijon mustard,grape,confectioner sugar,merlot,greek seasoning
title: Grape Vinaigrette
ingredients: 1 pint grape, halved | 1 cup greek yogurt | 1/4 cup red mill greek yogurt | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard | 3 teaspoons confectioners'sugar | 3 green cardamoms, or to taste | 1 1/2 teaspoons all purpose greek seasoning
instructions: Mix grape halves, greek yogurt, red mill greek yogurt, dijon mustard, confectioners' sugar, and cardamom together in a bowl. Cover bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 6 to 8 hours. Stir grape halves, greek yogurt, dijon mustard, and confectioners' sugar together in a bowl with a spoon.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice zest,tomato soup,purpose flour,red potato
title: German Potato Crock Pot
ingredients: 6 medium red potatoes, pared and coarsely chopped | 1 can condensed tomato soup | 1 lemon, juice and zest of, grated | 1/3 cup all-purpose flour
instructions: Saute potatoes with lemon zest, adding a little milk or cooking spray to prevent potatoes from burning. Mix all ingredients together. Transfer to crock pot. Stir. Cover and cook on lo heat for approximately 2 to 4 hours. Note, cooking time should be for 2 hours.

title: Balsamic-Glazed Balsamic Flavoured Rice Pastries With Havarti & Caramelized Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 2/3 cups grain-grain pol rice flour or 1 2/3 cups white rice flour | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 1 teaspoon fresh tarragon, chopped, plus | 3 tablespoons tarragon, extra | 1/3 cup olive, pitted, chopped | 1/3 cup balsamic vinegar | 2 pieces fresh ginger, peeled and sliced | 2 tablespoons light vanilla frosting | 1 1/2 cups havarti cheese, grated | 2 tablespoons fresh tarragon, chopped
instructions: For the syrup, place all the ingredients & in a pan over medium heat. Stir to combine. Allow to simmer for 10 minutes. Set aside to cool. For the pastries, place a baking sheet in the oven & preheat oven to 400º°f degrees. On a floured surface, roll out the pol rice flour & pinch off bits of pastry, about the size of an egg, with a rolling pin, starting from the long side. Bring up two opposite ends & pin together to seal. Place on a floured baking sheet & bake for 10 minutes. For the tomatoes, place a large frying pan or wok over medium high heat, then add the olive, vinegar & ginger. Stir to combine, reduce the heat slightly & saute the ginger for 3 - 5 minutes, or until it starts to turn transparent. Remove from the heat & set aside. Assemble the pastries, transfer the pol rice onto a work surface & spread with the tomatoe glaze. Divide the pol rice into two bundles, roll each lenghtwise in the chopped tarragon, place a piece of the havarti over the tomato glaze & roll up tightly to enclose the filling. Secure with a toothpick if necessary. Heat the oven to 375ºf. Place the pastries seam side down on the prepared baking sheet. Brush with balsamic glaze & bake for 25 - 30 minutes or until golden & crisp. Serve warm.

title: Greek Noodles
ingredients: 1 lb ground burger | 1 cup shell pasta, cooked | 1 package hamburger buns, toasted and crisped
instructions: Brown hamburger well and drain. Add cooked shell pasta to brown hamburger together. Pour noodles onto a foil covered cookie sheet with sides and bake at 400 until heated through. Add buns onto cookie sheet and spread to coat. Spread hamburger mixture onto the toasted buns and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: gruyere cheese,flour tortilla,golden raisin,sharp cheddar cheese
title: Golden Raisin Quesadillas With Gruyère
ingredients: 1 flour tortillas or 1 corn tortilla | 6 -8 ounces gruyere cheese | 6 -8 ounces sharp cheddar cheese | golden raisin
instructions: Cut or tear cheese into 3/4 to 1 inch pieces, depending on how much you like. Spread one piece of cheese on a tortilla and spread with a sprinkling of raisins or other favourite filling. Top with other piece of cheese. Heat a large non stick frying pan over medium high heat, or on an iron skillet set to very low. When the pan surface is hot, slide tortilla from pan onto the pan holding the tortilla onto the pre heated skillet. Use tongs or a slotted spoon to quickly brown the other side of the tortilla. Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Authentic Mexican Chocolate Taquitos
ingredients: 1 cup corn tortilla | 3 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa | 3 ounces boiling water ( not heinz's lite )
instructions: Heat a skillet with low heat for a minute or two if you have one. Smear the bottom of the pan with a tablespoon of water just to keep it bubbly, not too hot. Cut the tortillas in half lengthwise and then use a tablespoon to dip the tortillas into the boiling cocoa. The tortillas will be so soft and a nice, pliable, semi-shredded chocolatey consistency. You can also use a fork dipped in water to dip the tortillas into the hot cocoa. If you add your boiling water, the taquitos will be done in a short period. Once the taquitos are done, place them on a plate and keep in your kitchen sink so they will keep their fresh texture. Melt the remaining 3 tablespoons of cocoa into the boiling water you are going to use as a dipping sauce for the taquitos. When the water begins to boil, dip as many taquitos in the hot cocoa until they're completely covered in the cocoa. You can do this at any time it's your choice to dip the taquitos individually into the cocoa. You can also add the rest of the taquitos after making several batches of taquitos. After dipping the taquitos into your first batch of fried taquitos, place them in the microwave for about 45 seconds or so until they're heated through.. Add the extra 1/4 cup of ice cold water to the tequillas to keep them from freezing and softening as you go along. Dip the taquitos into the cocoa, place immediately on your plate or place directly on the plate/pan. You want to melt the tortillas and let the tortillas become firm. If you add more water or cocoa the dough will be too dry.

title: Ras Gevi - Traditional Libyan Semolina Pudding
ingredients: 1 cup piloncillo rice piloncillo sugar or 1 cup brown sugar | 1 cup dark brown sugar | 1 dried chipotle chile | 1/2 cup semolina | 1/4 saffron
instructions: Dissolve the saffron in a little water. Bring remaining ingredients.

title: Chinese Slaw Puffs
ingredients: 2 packages frozen puff pastry, thawed | 1 bag shredded coleslaw mix
instructions: Spray 24 mini muffin tins with nonstick cooking spray. Unfold pastry onto cookie sheet. Separate sheets of pastry, and press each sheet into a 2 inch circle on the center of each pastry. Top with 1/3 cup coleslaw. Fold the sides over the slaw so they are folded slightly inward. Repeat folding on all sides. Bake at 400° for 20 minutes, or until pastry is golden brown.

title: Easy Cheesy Queso
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs monterey jack pepper cheese, grated | 1/2 cup granulated palm sugar, such as palm sugar molasses ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Drain cheese well then toss with sugar. Spread cheese on parchment lined jelly roll pan. Bake for 20 minutes.

title: Easy Tofu Casserole
ingredients: 1 can tomato sauce | 1 package tofu, cubed
instructions: Preheat an oven to 350 degrees f. Place the tofu in a 9x13 inch baking dish, and cover with tomato sauce. Let soak in the refrigerator 30 minutes. After 30 minutes, take the tofu out of the marinade, and sprinkle with salt and pepper. Let rest at room temperature 10 minutes, then spoon on the tofu. Bake in the preheated oven 30 minutes, until the tofu is browned and liquid is absorbed.

title: The Best Kiwi and Peach Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups cashews, unsalted, chopped | 1 cup peaches, diced | 1 1/2 cups kiwi fruits, sliced | 2 tablespoons triple sec ( optional, but does add great flavor )
instructions: Mix together in a salad bowl.

Random Ingredients: red leaf lettuce,great northern bean,italian green bean,vanilla essence,cooking oil,mustard seed,green food coloring,whipping cream
title: White Bean Salad
ingredients: 2 heads red leaf lettuce ( separated ) | 1 package italian cut green beans, cut into short lengths | 1 package frozen great northern beans, cut into short lengths | 2 cans sweet white beans, cooked ( can use red kidney beans may be substituted ) | 1 container whipping cream ( can use regular white or raspberry ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons mustard seeds | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla essence | 1/2 teaspoon green food coloring | 1/4 cup cooking oil
instructions: Combine all vegetables except whipping cream in a large salad bowl. Whisk whipping cream in a container with a whisk until soft peaks form, add mustardseed and vanilla, whisk again. Blend in whipping cream mixture to salad mixture. Pour dressing over salad and toss gently. Transfer to individual salad plates and top with a green cherry for decoration.

Random Ingredients: cremini mushroom,dark sesame oil,corn tortilla,apricot preserve,zucchini,tomato green chilies,raisin
title: Quick & Easy Vegetarian Enchiladas
ingredients: 4 corn tortillas, 6-inch | 3 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 8 ounces cremini mushrooms or 8 ounces white button mushrooms, thinly sliced | 2 large zucchini, sliced | 1/2 cup raisins, dried | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies, drained | 1 can apricot preserves
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place tortillas on a baking sheet. Brush with sesame oil. Bake in the preheated oven until lightly browned, about 10 minutes. Set aside. Heat a large skillet over medium heat until hot. Saute mushrooms, zucchini, and raisins in the heated skillet until zucchini is just tender, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Spread about half of sauce in the bottom of a 9x12 inch baking dish. Arrange about 1/3 tortillas over the sauce, lightly overlapping. Spoon 1/2 the zucchini mixture over the tortillas and top with 1/3 the mushrooms, black olives, and raisins. Repeat layers. Scatter the chopped tomatoes with green chilies over everything. Spread preserves over the entire dish. Cover tightly with aluminum foil and bake until topping is warm and bubbling, about 30 minutes.

title: Homemade Phyllo Cheese
ingredients: 9 sheets frozen phyllo pastry ( thawed ) | 1/4 cup freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Place frozen phyllo sheets in a large bowl, and sprinkle with a little of the cheese and half of the remaining cheese on top. Lay a sheet of phyllo lengthwise over the top, taking care to make certain that it is completely covered completely. Drape strips of phyllo over the top. Place sheets onto a pastry cloth, and pinch the ends of the phyllo together tightly. Bring a large pot of water to a boil over high heat. Cover, and place on baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven for 40 minutes, or until pastry is golden brown. Remove from the oven, and let cool slightly. Carefully cut pieces into pieces with kitchen scissors. When cool enough to handle, transfer to an airtight container, seal, and let sit for 3 days.

Random Ingredients: jalapeno chile,serrano pepper,italian sausage,broth,jalapeno chile pepper,trout
title: Broiled Italian Sausage and Trout
ingredients: 4 links italian sausages | 2 jalapeno chilies, chopped | 8 slices turkey smoked trout, halved | 2 serrano peppers, chopped | 1/2 cup broth | 2 jalapeno chiles, chopped | 3 slices fresh serrano peppers, chopped
instructions: Preheat the broiler. Arrange the sausages on a broiler safe baking sheet. Bake for 10 minutes, reduce heat to low, and broil for another 10 minutes. Remove from the broiler.

Random Ingredients: radish,celery rib,hot chili sauce,black bean sauce,active yeast
title: Chinese Black Bean Sweet & Sour Mix
ingredients: 1 package active dry yeast | 2 cups hot chili sauce | 1 can black bean sauce | 1/2 cup celery rib, chopped | 1/2 cup radish, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Dissolve yeast in hot chili sauce. Add black bean sauce, celery, radish if using.

Random Ingredients: onion soup mix,serrano chilies,mango chutney,apricot,curry leaf,wheat flour,mustard powder,dark sesame oil
title: Chutney Onion Bhajis
ingredients: 4 cups whole-wheat flour | 1 teaspoon mustard powder | 1/2 teaspoon curry leaves | 1 teaspoon dark sesame oil | 1 teaspoon mango chutney | 2 serrano chilies, chopped | 1/2 cup chopped onion soup mix | 1/4 cup apricot ( optional )
instructions: Place the flour, mustard powder, curry leaves, sesame oil, mango chutney, chile, onion soup mix, and apricots in the order listed. Mix well. Sprinkle on baking sheet. Preheat oven to 350 f. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Hummus With Tabbouleh (Vegan Friendly)
ingredients: 1 cup bulgur | 200 ml buttermilk | 1/4 cup ripe olives, thinly sliced | 1/4 cup diced ripe banana
instructions: Combine bulgur and buttermilk in a bowl, and bring to a boil. Cover, reduce heat, and cook 10 minutes, stirring frequently. Let cool completely. Add olives, and bananas, and stir to mix. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: salmon fillet,green chili pepper,bulk italian sausage,soya sauce,chicken stock
title: Sausage & Green Chile Sauce
ingredients: 2 lbs bulk italian sausage ( bulk sausage ) | 4 ounces chopped green chili peppers | 4 ounces soya sauce | 1 chicken stock, cube | 1/2 cup chicken stock
instructions: Place chicken stock cube in saucepan and put on medium heat, add sausages and chopped peppers. Cover and simmer for about 10 minutes. Stir in soya sauce. Bring to boil, add 1/2 cup chicken stock and return to boil. Simmer until liquid evaporates, pour off excess fat then add remaining chicken stock. Cook another 5 mins or so until thickened.

title: Glamorganica (Glamorganica)
ingredients: 1 1/4 pounds fresh shiitake mushrooms, stemmed | 1 1/4 pounds fresh shiitake pecorino rinsed and coarsely grated, divided | 4 strips orange peel
instructions: Place a pan on medium heat, and cook the shiitake mushrooms and 1 1/4 pound pecorino rinsed and coarsely grated pecorino rinsed and 1 teaspoon orange peel in the heated pan until beginning to soften, about 10 minutes. Mix in the shiitake mushrooms, 1 tablespoon orange peel, and the remaining 1 tablespoon pecorino rinsed and orange peel. Keep warm while you make the gorgonzola by immersing the gorgonzola into small bowls, and keep warm until serving. Serve alongside gorgonzola flavored cream or whipped cream. Recipe summary. To make, in a large pot over medium heat, cook the shiitake mushrooms in hot water for about 5 minutes, until blackened. Remove from pot, and chop into pieces. Serve in a bowl with 1 tablespoon of orange peel on top.

title: The Joy of Vermicelli (Italian Version)
ingredients: 250 500gr vermicelli or 250gr french vanilla thin noodles | 1/2 cup olive oil | 1 tablespoon dried thyme or 2 tsp. dried savory | 1 1/2 tablespoons apple jelly ( optional )
instructions: Start boiling water for pasta, or place in a bowl, cover with cold water and set aside. Heat olive oil and water in a pan. Meanwhile, drain noodles well in a colander. Add thyme and vermicelli to oil and water, simmer over medium low, covered, for 3 minutes till noodles are tender, drain again, add cheese, stir. When pasta is done stir into pasta in pan and toss. If desired, use jelly of choice. If too dry add a little water. Serve immediately. Note, i cook vermicelli to tender and drain all the fat and moisture, adding hot water a few times until noodls and cheese is creamy and warm.

title: Herbed Vinaigrette
ingredients: 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon finely chopped fresh italian parsley | 1 tablespoon finely chopped celery
instructions: Combine all ingredients in small bowl. Cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours.

title: Crock Pot Pork Loin Au Jus
ingredients: 1 lb boneless pork loin, trimmed | 1 yellow bell pepper, cut into 6 thin slices
instructions: Place pork loin in crockpot, then scatter bell pepper slices over the top. Sprinkle garlic over the top. Cover, and cook on low for 6 - 8 hours, to a minimum internal temperature of about 160 degrees f, and internal temperature of 175 degrees f when taken into the thickest part of the loin. Use a sharp knife to thinly slice the meat and serve from the crockpot.

title: Kaffir Lime
ingredients: 1 bunch pepperoni ( or kittoun ) | 1 package sausages ( or other ) | 1 jar kaffir lime leaves
instructions: Slice pepperoni or kittoun into strips long enough to fit on the wall of a microwave safe bowl. Cut sausages lengthwise into thirds, then across the strips to make them stick together. Layer on the kaffir lime leaves, and microwave for 10 minutes, until warm and noodles have slightly expanded. Be careful not to burn.

Random Ingredients: asian chili garlic sauce,yoghurt,balsamic vinegar,sea salt,margarine,cream,prosciutto
title: Spicy Salt and Prosciutto Dip
ingredients: 1/2 cup chopped prosciutto | 1/2 cup greek yogurt | 3 tablespoons margarine or 3 tablespoons butter | 1/4 cup sour cream | 1/2 teaspoon asian chili-garlic sauce or 1/2 teaspoon hot sauce | 1/2 teaspoon balsamic vinegar | 1/8 teaspoon sea salt
instructions: Pre heat oven to 375 degrees. Melt the margarine. In a small bowl, mix the sour cream, greek yogurt, hot sauce and the balsamic vinegar. Place salt on a plate and toss the prosciutto in the dressing. Pour the mixture onto a roasting rack in the oven. Bake for approximately 30 minutes or until golden brown. Serve warm with toasted baguette slices.

Random Ingredients: buttermilk biscuit,rotel tomato,gruyere cheese,lime juice zest,red bell pepper,coffee
title: Mexican Coffee Cheese Wedges
ingredients: 8 ounces deli shredded gruyere cheese or 8 ounces monterey jack pepper cheese ( 4 oz. ) | 1 tablespoon fresh lime juice and zest | 8 ounces rotel tomatoes ( hot ) | 1 tablespoon coffee ( brewed ) | 1 tablespoon canned diced red bell pepper | 1/4 cup buttermilk biscuits or 1/4 cup any round soft biscuit
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Arrange grated cheese evenly over bottom 1/2 of 12x9 inch baking dish lightly sprayed with nonstick cooking spray. Combine remaining ingredients except biscuits or biscuit, spread evenly over cheese. Bake for 8 to 12 minutes or until cheese is browned and bubbly and lightly browned. Meanwhile, prepare biscuit dough according to package directions. Cut each biscuit into 12 wedges. Arrange wedges on cookie sheet. Sprinkle wedges with remaining cheese. Bake at 375 degrees for 10 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Cottage Cheese Spread
ingredients: 1 package cottage cheese | 1/4 cup bourbon | 1/4 cup fresh cilantro stems, chopped | 1/3 cup bottled hickory flavored barbecue sauce
instructions: In food processor or blender, puree cottage cheese until fluffy. Stir in bourbon and cilantro. Spoon into a serving dish and top with a small splash of hickory flavored barbecue sauce. Serve warm.

title: Tomato and Beet Baked in Tomatoes (Pudim De Beets)
ingredients: 1 lb beet, peeled and cut in fourths | 1 lb green pepper, in 1/3 in slices | 1/4 cup tomato paste | 1 tablespoon fresh sage leaf, chopped | 2 tablespoons water | crackers
instructions: Sprinkle fresh sage over beet halves and let sweat for 15 minutes. Scrub beet skins under running water and peel. Cut off woody rib and scrape out any black speckles on the beet root. Trim off beet roots and score top and bottom of beet leaves with a knife in several places. Place beet halves in a buttered casserole dish and cover with water. Bring to a boil. Reduce the heat to a simmer and cook, covered, for 15 minutes. Remove lid and raise the heat to medium. Cook, stirring occasionally, for an additional 15 minutes, until beets are very soft and most of the water has evaporated. Remove beet halves from the casserole and slice off the roots and peel. Discard outer layer and discard. In a saucepan add tomato paste and bring to a simmer. Sprinkle tomato halves with fresh sage and stir to blend with tomato paste. Add salt and pepper to taste and cook over low heat for 4 minutes, or until thick and bubbly. Turn off heat and let stand for 5 minutes. Transfer beet halves to plate. Toss with a few spoonfuls of sauce in pan to coat. Dish up and sprinkle with cracked nuts. Serve.

title: Cheese Veggie Casserole
ingredients: 2 portabella mushrooms, sliced ( about 1 lb per slice or package ) | 16 ounces fat-free ricotta | 1 cup nonfat plain yogurt
instructions: Cook mushroom slices in a bit of water in a frying pan. In a medium bowl, combine ricotta with yogurt. Layer half the mushroom layer on the bottom of a medium sized casserole dish. Layer the cheese mixture over the mushrooms and then the remaining mushroom layer. Bake, covered, in a 350 oven for 35 minutes or until cheese is melted and bubbly.

title: Greek Phyllo Triangles (Aka Arloghi)
ingredients: 8 sheets phyllo dough ( fresh if possible ) | 2 lemons
instructions: You should have about 24 sheets. If not, cut out desired shape. If not, use a cookie cutter and cut out desired shapes. If using a cookie cutter, cut out desired size. Cut one lemon into 6 pices. Take a pastry brush with olive oil, and brush over a circle of phyllo. Take a little bit of lemon juice and then brush over the top of the phyllo, and lightly brush the top using a brush. Using a small pastry brush, take a 1 strip from the bottom of the phyllo sheet, and arrange it on a plate. Take a second strip of phyllo, and place it on top of the first, brush with olive oil, and cover with a circle of phyllo. Take a 1st strip of phyllo from the bottom & brush with olive oil. Repeat until all the phyllo has been used. Take a strip of phyllo from the top & brush with oil. Take an empty strip of phyllo & brush with oil, & place in a strip of phyllo, brush with olive oil, and top with the strip of phyllo. Repeat until all the phyllo and phyllo has been used up, brushing with olive oil if necessary. Take a 3rd strip of phyllo & brush with oil, and place in a strip of phyllo, brushed with oil and covered with a circle of phyllo. Place all the 3 strips of phyllo & brushed with oil. Put on top of the bottom phyllo, brush with oil, and top with the strip of phyllo. Repeat until all the phyllo has been used up, brushing with oil if necessary. Take a strip of phyllo & brush with oil, & place in a strip of phyllo & brush with oil. Repeat, alternating the layers of phyllo and phyllo until all the phyllo and phyllo has been used up, brushing with oil if necessary. Wrap well with a piece of plastic wrap & put in the fridge. Take out when you are ready to serve. It should also be kept in the fridge for up to a week. You can also make your own filling and serve as directed above. It is now ready to freeze.

Random Ingredients: pinto bean,vegetable oil cooking spray,plain yogurt
title: Easy Refried Beans
ingredients: 2 cans pinto beans, undrained | plain yogurt, garnish | vegetable oil cooking spray
instructions: Place beans and yogurt in a blender with some water.

title: Spanish Bread with Peppers, Olives and Pistachios
ingredients: 5 hoagie rolls | 1/4 cup dijon mustard | 1/4 cup chopped roasted red pepper | 8 kalamata olives, pitted | 1/4 cup stuffed green olive, drained | 3/4 cup chopped fresh pistachios
instructions: Stir together mustard and pepper. Brush mustard mixture over roll halves, then sprinkle with olives and pistachios. Broil for 2 to 3 minutes, then turn over and broil 2 to 3 minutes longer.

Random Ingredients: green chili pepper,marinade,orange,tortilla chip,herbes de provence
title: Mexican Fiesta Restaurant Platter
ingredients: 4 tablespoons achiote marinade | 3 large oranges | 1 green chili pepper, chopped | 2 teaspoons herbes de provence | 1 bag tortilla chips, crushed
instructions: In a small bowl, combine marinade and orange peel and squeeze to remove any excess liquid. Grate zest from oranges and add to orange mixture. Remove seeds from chile and add to orange mixture. Chop tortilla chips and add to orange mixture. Let sit for a few minutes if mixture seems dry and then add crushed chips.

title: Simple, Tasty Barbecue Salmon
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups unflavored gelatin | 1 can cream of mushroom soup, undiluted | 1/2 cup tamarind paste | 1 teaspoon dried rosemary, crushed | 4 pounds salmon
instructions: Soak gelatin in water for 10 to 15 minutes until softened. In a large bowl, stir together the softened gelatin with soup, tamarind paste and crushed rosemary. Reserve 1/4 cup of this sauce mixture for later use. Place salmon on a clean work surface, and layer with the drained gelatin mixture, reserving remaining sauce for later use. Starting and ending with reserved 1/4 cup of gelatin mixture, cover salmon with remaining sauce. Chill in the refrigerator until firm, several hours or overnight, depending on size of the salmon.

title: Rice Sushi Roll
ingredients: 3 packages refrigerated crescent dinner rolls | 2 cups sushi rice | 5 tablespoons orange juice | 1/3 cup lemon juice | 1/4 cup curry powder
instructions: Heat oven to 375 degrees f and grease a baking sheet. Unroll each package of crescent dough and lightly roll it with your hands into a sausage shape. Place cooked rice in shallow bowl and mix in citrus juice. Stir until well mixed. Pour juice over meat and rice mixture. Roll meat mixture until well coated. Flatten out meat, place flat side down on baking sheet, and cover with a towel. Bake 20 to 25 minutes, until sizzling and golden brown.

title: Crostini
ingredients: 4 skinless grouper fillets | 2 jalapeno peppers, seeded and finely chopped | 1/4 cup cognac
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place fish in a roasting pan and sprinkle with jalapeno peppers. Combine cognac and 2 tablespoons hot water in a small glass jar. Heat until the water is just hot and stir in cognac. Pour over the fish and bake for about 20 minutes, basting frequently.

title: Smoky Buttermilk Broccoli and Veggies
ingredients: 4 cups fresh broccoli or 4 cups frozen chopped broccoli | 1 spanish onion, chopped | 3 leeks, white and light green parts only, thinly sliced | 1/2 cup toasted pumpkin seeds | 1/4 cup low fat natural unsweetened yogurt | 1/8 teaspoon almond extract | 1/3 cup packed light unsalted butter | 1/3 cup maple syrup
instructions: Steam the broccoli until just tender. Sauté the onion in the butter until tender, not brown, but still yellow, about 10 minutes. Add mushrooms and sauté for another 5 minutes. Stir in the yoghurt with the almond extract and pour into a food processor. Process until smooth, but not smooth. Stir broccoli, onion, and mushrooms into the yoghurt mixture. Pour into serving dish and refrigerate for 1 hour or over night. Stir, then refrigerate for at least 4 hours or overnight. Serve over cooked hot rice.

title: Rice and Apricot Pie
