ingredients: 1 1/2 cups uncooked minute rice | 1/2 cup sweetened dried apricot, chopped | 1/4 cup double cream | 1/2 teaspoon liquid smoke | 2 sheets fresh phyllo dough | 1/2 cup quick-cooking tapioca mixed with 1 tbsp. apricot jam
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f combine rice, apricots and cream in a large bowl. Sprinkle with liquid smoke.

title: Kielbasa in Spiced Tomato Sauce
ingredients: 2 lbs kielbasa, casings removed | 1 can diced tomatoes with puree | 1 1/3 cups shredded coconut, divided | 1/2 cup chopped fresh thyme sprigs | 1 tablespoon grated fresh ginger | 4 teaspoons anise seeds | italian bread
instructions: Cook kielbasa in large pot of boiling water until just tender. Remove kielbasa and slice crosswise in 2 inch rounds. Reserve 1/4 cup of the liquid. Drain kielbasa. In 8 - 12 inch heavy skillet combine tomatoes, 1/2 c coconut, thyme, and ginger. Heat to boiling, stir in anise seeds and cook until fragrant. Quickly add kielbasa and reserved liquid to pan. Bring to boiling over medium high heat. Reduce heat and cover. Simmer 30 minutes or until liquid is reduced and sausage is cooked through, stirring occasionally. Serve with bread.

title: Garlicky Saffron Spring Onions (Lebanese) W-Saffron Cream
ingredients: 3 -4 bunches spring onions ( white part cut off ) | 2 teaspoons saffron ( optional )
instructions: Put the saffron in a small bowl. Fill a large sauce pan 2/3 full with vegetable oil or wok. Sauté the trimmed spring onions over med heat in the oil til translucent, then add the saffron, mix well and saute another 5 10min.. Remove from heat and add the cream to warm through. Pour into mixing bowl and garnish with green onion if desired. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: lime wedge,deli ham,red enchilada sauce,celery,white bread,corn flake,bacon grease
title: Bacon Wrapped Red Enchiladas
ingredients: 2 1/4 cups dry white bread, cut into 2 inch pieces. | 1 tablespoon bacon grease | 2 green serrano peppers or 2 red jalapeno peppers | 10 leaves celery, cut into 2 inch lengths | 1 3/4 cups shredded deli ham ( mild or hot ) | 1 package refrigerated red enchilada sauce | 6 fresh lime wedges
instructions: Cook bread in 3 quart saucepan over medium heat, stirring until dry. Remove from heat, and stir in bacon grease, serrano peppers and celery. Heat oven to 375 degrees fahrenheit. In 13x9 inch pan coated with cooking spray, lay bread slices in a single layer. Top with 1/2 cup ham and 1/2 cup soup mix. Repeat layers, beginning with ham and ending with soup mix on top. Spray tops with cooking spray. Bake 30 minutes or until bubbly and top is lightly browned. Transfer to cutting board and cut crosswise into 8 wedges. Serve warm or chill if desired.

Random Ingredients: bouillon cube,taco sauce,ginger garlic paste,kaffir lime leaf,eggplant,red cabbage,bacon
title: Spicy Omelette
ingredients: 6 slices bacon, finely chopped | 2 cups red cabbage, finely chopped | 4 tablespoons kaffir lime leaves, finely shredded | 1 ounce ginger-garlic paste | 1 tablespoon instant bouillon cube | 1 cup taco sauce | 12 eggs, beaten
instructions: Sauté bacon, garlic, and lime leaves in a little oil for 5 minutes, until tender. Place in a large pan and add the rest of the ingredients, except the eggs. Cover and simmer on low for 15 minutes, stirring every five minutes. Remove the cover, stir in the eggs, and leave to cook for about 3 - 5 minutes until the eggs are set.

title: Sticky and Flaboury Lamb
ingredients: 1 lb ground lamb | 4 ounces ground chickens | 7 ounces golden syrup
instructions: Mix well the lamb, chicken and golden syrup together. Pinch off a tiny ball to use later in recipe. Roll out thinly to approx a 6 inch square and place flat on a greased baking tray. Mark into 6 pieces or 6 pieces. Bake in moderate oven for about 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: mango,marinara sauce,saffron strand,ginger garlic paste,walnut half
title: Mango Spiced Walnut Stuffing
ingredients: 3/4 cup finely chopped walnuts, lightly toasted and cool | 3 tablespoons mango, juice of | 1 tablespoon saffron strand, soaked in | 1 tablespoon hot marinara sauce | 1 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste
instructions: Place all ingredients in a food processor and mix until creamy. Toss in any meat or poultry of your choice and make into meatballs or stuffing shapes.

Random Ingredients: kernel corn,chili bean paste,alfredo sauce,heavy cream,velveeta cheese,mint,almond paste
title: Mexican Cheese Dip
ingredients: 8 ounces velveeta cheese, cut into cubes | 24 ounces hot alfredo sauce | 1 can chili with beans paste | 1 can whole kernel corn, drained | 2 tablespoons chili beans with garlic | 1 tablespoon mint | 1/4 cup heavy cream or 1/4 cup half-and-half | 3/4 cup slivered almonds, toasted
instructions: Place velveeta into crockpot. Add rest of the ingredients except for almonds. Cover and cook on low for 9 minutes. Stir in almonds. Serve with tortilla chips or tortilla chips.

Random Ingredients: broth,dark brown sugar,red chili powder,pecan,sun tomato oil,breadcrumb,italian seasoning,crab meat
title: Broiled Shoyu
ingredients: 3 lbs fresh or frozen crab meat ( 1 kg ) | 4 cups crumbs | 1/2 cup chopped pecans | 1/4 cup italian seasoning | 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato oil | 2 -3 tablespoons ground mixed spices, to your taste | 1 tablespoon crushed red chili powder | 2 cups good quality broth ( i used about 1/2 cup )
instructions: Using your hands, mix together crab meat, 2 cups of the crumbs, 1/4 c of the italian seasoning, toasted pecans and 3 t. Of the sun dried tomato oil. Shape into 1 balls and place on cookie sheets covered with aluminium foil. Place crab balls in remaining crumbs and season with remaining italian seasoning, crushed chilis and remaining sun dried tomato oil. Broil or steam until golden brown.

title: Catfish With Pimientos and Cranberries
ingredients: 1 -2 tablespoon fresh minced pimiento | 1 tablespoon dry white wine | 4 catfish fillets, cut in 4 slices or 1 prawns, peeled and deveined | white pepper | 2 tablespoons fresh cranberries, dried
instructions: In small bowl, stir together pimientos and wine. Spread mixture over fish slices and season with white pepper. Sprinkle on cranberries just before serving.

title: Spicy Lentils With Chilies
ingredients: 200 g brown lentils ( chilis ) | 2 tablespoons ginger, finely grated | 1/2 teaspoon tabasco sauce
instructions: Pour 1 cup of water over the brown lentils and let soak at least 6 hours, or even overnight. Drain off the water, and cook the lentils under the grill with fresh chillies until charred. Serve topped with ginger and the rest of the chilis.

Random Ingredients: baby carrot,egg white,dark sesame oil,creole seasoning
title: Cajun Fried Carrots
ingredients: 1/3 cup dark sesame oil | 3 egg whites | 4 baby carrots | creole seasoning to taste
instructions: Place the sesame oil into a large skillet over medium heat. While oil is heating, place egg whites in a clean, dry, dry skillet. Once the oil is hot to the touch, sprinkle the yolks with about half the creole seasoning, and stir well. Once the whites are stiff, remove the skillet from the heat, and allow the mixture to cool slightly.

Random Ingredients: romano cheese,penne,fusion liqueur,tabasco sauce,caster sugar,egg noodle
title: Quick and Easy Pavlova
ingredients: 200 g vermicelli pasta or 200 g ziti pasta, uncooked | 8 tablespoons x-rated fusion liqueur | 1/2 cup romano cheese, grated | 1/2 cup caster sugar | 2 eggs, lightly beaten | salt and tabasco sauce
instructions: Boil water and cook pasta following package instructions. Drain pasta and set aside. In a small fry pan, fry vermicelli in zesty fusion for 2 - 3 minutes, constantly stirring constantly. Remove from heat and drain. Add the romano to the cooked pasta and stir. Re heat zesty fusion for 3 minutes and add to the pasta mixture. Add caster sugar and stir all together. Add beaten egg and adjust seasonings to taste.

title: Pollo Con Lechon (Chicken With Bread)
ingredients: 3 lbs chicken | 1 large bell pepper, sliced | 1 -2 red chili pepper | 1/4 cup fresh parsley | toasted bread, for coating
instructions: Wash chicken well, remove the giblets. Place the chicken with salt into boiling water and cook until tender, drain and strain. Toast to taste and set aside. In heavy fry pan, fry the bell peppers and chili pepper on high for 3 minutes. Cut chicken in pieces. Place pieces into hot pan, browned pieces on all sides and put into a casserole. Cover the pan with a lid and bake at 350 degrees fahrenheit for 10 minutes. Remove the lid and bake for 20 minutes, stirring twice. Sprinkle with parsley and serve with toasted toast.

title: Italian Basil for Tea
ingredients: 1/2 cup fresh basil ( don't use dried ) | 1/4 cup pistachio nut, chopped
instructions: Place basil, pistachio nuts and 1/2 cup boiling water in a pot. Bring water to a boil and remove from heat. Add nut and serve.

Random Ingredients: ice water,goat cheese,white wine vinegar,orange,green chilies,pistachio,white breadcrumb,corn tortilla
title: Chile and Goat Cheese Tacos
ingredients: 1/2 cup dry breadcrumbs | 6 ounces goat cheese or 6 ounces other cheese, at room temperature | 1/4 cup ice water ( or as needed to thin ) | 2 green chilies ( finely chopped ) | 1/2 cup white wine vinegar | 1 oranges or 1 rind ( finely grated ) | 1/2 cup crushed and chopped pistachios | 10 thin corn tortillas
instructions: Dough. Process bread crumbs in processor until finely ground to form crumbs, adding just enough water to make mixture a soft, moist consistency. Do not overprocess. Mix half of bread crumbs with goat cheese until blended. Add 1/4 cup ice water and stir. Spoon mixture down center of each tortilla. Roll up and place seam side down in baking dish. Repeat with remaining ingredients. Pour remaining 1/2 cup water into dish. Cover and bake at 300f for 1 hour. Turn off oven. Remove from pan and place on paper towels. Wipe out pan. Return to oven and simmer for 5 minutes or until liquid is syrupy. Serve with sour cream, salsa, guacamole, salsa or anything else you may choose. Variation,. You may use canned chopped red chiles. For a milder mixture, you may use ancho chili powder, if desired.

title: Chicken Samosas
ingredients: 1/2 lb chicken thigh, skinned and cut into strips | 1/2 cup onion, finely chopped | 1/4 teaspoon chopped fresh coriander ( optional ) | 1 sheet frozen puff pastry, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f line a baking sheet with parchment paper. In a large frying pan with a lid, combine the chicken and onion and cook over medium heat until the chicken is just cooked through, stirring occasionally. Transfer the chicken to a plate and discard any excess fat. Cover and set aside. Remove the lid from the pan and add the coriander and season with salt and pepper. Cook for 2 minutes or until fragrant taking care not to burn. Remove from heat and set aside. Roll out the pastry on a lightly floured surface until the pan is approximately 11x2 inches and use to line a 17x28 inch rectangle cake pan. Top with the chicken mixture, placing the 2 strips of pastry under each in a lattice pattern. Trim overhang if necessary and brush the pastry with some of the egg wash. Bake the samosas for 20 - 25 minutes or until golden brown. Transfer to a wire rack and cool completely before serving.

title: Easy Pesto Chips
ingredients: 1/2 cup pesto sauce | 1/4 teaspoon cajun seasoning
instructions: In a small saucepan over medium heat combine the pesto sauce and cajun seasoning. Stir until all of the seasoning is blended and smooth. Allow to cool before dipping chips into the pesto.

Random Ingredients: dijon mustard,brown sugar,black cardamom pod,yellow bell pepper,cottage cheese
title: Gavenders Cottage Cheese & Mustard
ingredients: 1 package cottage cheese | 1 yellow bell pepper | 1/4 cup dijon mustard | 1/4 cup firmly packed light brown sugar | 1 -2 teaspoon freshly ground black cardamom pod
instructions: Cut the bell pepper in half vertically and remove the seeds and all the ribs. Cut these in half again and discard the ribs. Slice the cottage cheese into 1/4 inch thick slices and place them in a small serving bowl. Cut the mustard into 1/4 inch thick strips and add them to the cottage cheese. Add the sugar and freshly ground black cardamom to the cheese and mustard mixture then mix well. Refrigerate for 1 hour to marinate. Serve at room temperature with pita or toasted french bread.

Random Ingredients: pie crust,ranch dressing mix,egg,beef pot roast,italian parsley
title: Beef Pot Roast with Ranch Egg Dip
ingredients: 1 large egg, beaten | 1 can ranch dressing mix | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh italian parsley | 5 pounds boneless beef pot roast | 1 pre-baked pie crust
instructions: Beat egg in a bowl. Stir ranch dressing mix and parsley with the eggs.

title: Beef Tenderloin and Rigatoni
ingredients: 1 lb beef tenderloin steak ( about 3/4 inch thick ) | 12 -14 ounces rigatoni pasta or 12 -14 ounces penne pasta, broken into 2-inch pieces | 9 ounces fresh lasagna noodles
instructions: In a large nonstick skillet, brown the steak, about 15 minutes. Transfer to a plate. Add pasta and 2 1/4 cups water to skillet.

title: Savory Sausage Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs ground italian sausage ( mild or hot ) | 1/2 cup currants ( can be reduced ) or 1/2 cup raisins, dried ( can be reduced ) | 2 1/2 tablespoons minced fresh sage or 2 1/2 teaspoons dried sage | 1 1/2 tablespoons minced fresh rosemary or 1 1/2 teaspoons dried rosemary ( or 1 1/2 tsp. dried ) | 1 large red onion, cut into 1-inch wedges | 2 tablespoons shortening | 3 tablespoons dried double-crust whole wheat hamburger buns | 6 whole wheat hamburger buns
instructions: In a skillet, add the sausage. Cook, breaking up with a wooden spoon, over medium heat, until thoroughly cooked, about 10 minutes. Add the currants. In a small bowl, combine the sage, fresh rosemary and onion. Roll the sausage mixture tightly around the onion and spices and secure with a toothpick. In a non stick skillet over medium heat, melt the shortening.

title: Danish Turnip With Hazelnut Dressing
ingredients: 1 tablespoon hazelnuts ( ground in an electric spice mill or mortar and pestle ) | 1 teaspoon red chili ( crushed ) | 1/2 cup fish stock | 100 g butter ( no substitute ) | 2/3 cup vegan mayonnaise | 4 slices lardons
instructions: Place hazelnuts and chili in a baking tray with ovens at 180 degrees celsius. Roast until dark brown, about 10 minutes. Pulse in a spice grinder. Put the fish stock in a microwave safe bowl with the hazelnuts. Cook for 30 seconds, just until toasted, then cool. Mix the hazelnut sauce with the butter, mayonnaise, cinnamon and mix well. Pour over the turnip slices in a single layer and refrigerate for at least 1 hour. Sprinkle with remaining hazelnuts before serving.

title: Bungalism (Pate for Burgers)
ingredients: 3 tablespoons golden syrup ( or maple syrup ) | 2 tablespoons rice ( soaked in boiling water for 5 minutes ) | 2 small pieces veal ( optional ) | 1 small red capsicum ( or yellow ) | 1/2 cup chickpeas ( boiled ) | 1/2 cup red roasted sweet potato ( or mash )
instructions: Boil chickpeas in water until soft and mash them with a fork. Dry mix the golden syrup with the rice. Dice the veal and place on top of the syrup. Mix in the sweet potato. Put in a flat frying pan, in a small circle or other shapes so that the patty is flat against the surface with a flat top and a little room at each side. Turn every 2 - 3 minutes, until the mixture is nicely browned. Cut in wedges. You can put them in a baking dish to grill, broil or fry.

title: Spicy Cabbage Cabbage
ingredients: 1 shredded cabbage | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla essence | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla
instructions: Take shredded cabbage. Mix in all other ingredients, and spread onto a plate and leave to rest at least one hour before serving.

title: Avocado Soup
ingredients: 4 avocados, ripe, peeled, pitted and diced | 1 can hard cooked clams | 7 cups hot cooked pasta
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large pot. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium low and simmer soup for 20 minutes.

title: Chicken Pizza for One
ingredients: 1 package prepared pizza dough, each cut into 16 equal sections | 1/2 cup shredded cooked chicken meat | 2 green onions, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Grease a 10 inch pie plate. Lightly grease the edge of the baking sheets with cooking spray.

title: Curried Sole Fillets
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh sole fillets | 1/2 teaspoon asafoetida powder or 1 teaspoon brown sugar | 1 -2 tablespoon curry paste ( more or less to taste ) | 1 dash cayenne | 1 can chickpeas ( garbonzos ), drained
instructions: Cut each fillet through the centre into 1/2 inch wide strips. Sprinkle the asafoetida with a pinch of cayenne, about 1 tablespoon. Toss the fish with a little oil to coat lightly and let sit at room temperature for 2 hours. Fry the asafoetida in a small skillet along with a little water until the is fragrant and the oil is very dark in color. If that is too hot, add the remaining ingredients. If it is too dark, add more water. Serve over plain rice or with fried plantain chips.

title: Baked Oysters With Rice Paper
ingredients: 12 oysters | 4 cups double cream | 2 tablespoons bicarbonate of soda | 12 round rice paper, squares
instructions: Remove the oysters from the tin, reserving their liquid. Warm the cream in a pan, then turn the heat up and boil for just enough to warm the cream. Combine the oyster liquid, bicarbonate of soda, and a pinch of salt, then carefully fill the oysters, with cream. Place under a preheated grill, turning for 2 - 3 minutes, until the shells are golden and the oysters slightly heated through. Serve in warmed plates immediately. Goes well with steamed jasmine greens.

title: Indian Diner Gravy Recipe
ingredients: 4 beef bouillon cubes ( or more to cover beef ) | 1/2 cup raisins ( optional ) or 1/2 cup golden raisin ( optional )
instructions: Put beef in large frypan with raisins. Cook over high heat until meat is browned and fat is visible.

Random Ingredients: veal,puff pastry,pepperoni,squid,chicken bouillon cube,turmeric powder,sirloin,plain flour
title: Italian Spetsies
ingredients: 1 package puff pastry ( i use 3 sheets per package of puff pastry ) | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 1/8 teaspoon turmeric powder | 6 sausage or 6 veal burgers, diced, cooked | 8 slices sirloin, cooked or shredded | pepperoni, grated ( for australians ) | plain flour, for dusting | chopped tomato and chilli peppers or fresh parsley
instructions: If the pastry is large, cut out four circles of pastry and fit them into four well greased ovenproof dishes. If you are using small pastry dishes, then fit the pastry dough into each of the pastry cups. Set aside whilst preparing the filling. Place the stock cube in a pan. Add the turmeric and stir well until the turmeric is slightly foamy. Add the chicken bullion cube. Cook and stir over a low heat until the cubes dissolve into the stock. Remove the pan from the heat and pour the contents of the pan into a bowl. Stir. Add the beef, sausage, pepperoni and season with salt and pepper. Sprinkle the cheese over. Place the pastry dishes on top of each other, and sprinkle with flour. Bake at 180c/350f/gas 1 for 20 minutes, or until the pastry is piping hot and nicely browned.

Random Ingredients: chocolate,golden syrup,green chili,chili powder,mango,green,fish stock,sugar substitute
title: Thai Fruit and Mole
ingredients: 300 g green beans, chopped | 125 g mangoes, chopped | 1 -2 tablespoon green chili, chopped | 125 ml fish stock | 125 ml sugar substitute | 1 teaspoon mild red chili powder or 1 teaspoon chili sauce | chocolate
instructions: Stir fry in a little oil until soft but not coloured. Add green beans, mango and chillies and cook slowly until mango is soft, stirring occasionally.

title: Simple Roast Leg of Lamb
ingredients: 5 -10 lamb, leg of lamb | 3 teaspoons cardamom powder | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom powder
instructions: Pre heat oven to 300°f. Mix the cardamon powder with the cardamom powder and rub the lamb. Place the lamb in a roasting tin. Turn the leg over and pour enough water into the tin to come half way up the lamb. Roast for 2 hours, then turn the lamb over and roast for a further hour or until it reaches an internal temp of 160°f. Allow 20 to 25 minutes resting time before carving.

title: Rajma (Egyptian Fool) - Fool-Lavishing Beans
ingredients: 1 lb fried beans | 2 saffron
instructions: Dip the beans in hot water, then deep fry. Drain. Sprinkle saffron on top. Put the fried beans onto a plate, and serve.

title: Tamari Queso Dip!
ingredients: 1/2 cup agave nectar | 1/2 cup tamari | 1/4 cup sherry wine | 2 tablespoons water | 1 cup scotch cheese | 1/4 cup shredded mexican cheese | minced cilantro ( optional )
instructions: Prepare the cheese mix first by combining all ingridients in medium bowl. Microwave, covered, on high for 2 - 15 minutes to thicken. Microwave again on medium for 2 minutes. Serve with tortilla chips or other dip. Garnish with minced cilantro if desired.

Random Ingredients: miracle whip,chicken breast,salmon fillet,cooking spray,soymilk,kaffir lime leaf,wonton wrapper,rice flour
title: Easy Salmon Parcels - Baked, Wrapped  With Soy Milk
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs skinless boneless skinless salmon fillets, about 6-8 ounces | 2 tablespoons miracle whip | 1 tablespoon rice flour | cooking spray | 1 cup soymilk | 1 - 1 1/2 tablespoon kaffir lime leaf ( use zest of 1 lime, minced ) | 8 kaffir lime leaves ( see notes above ) | 1 package wonton wrappers, frozen
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Place salmon fillets in a shallow baking dish, making sure they all overlap one another, spray with cooking oil, then sprinkle with miracle whip, then stir to coat. Bake in a 350°f oven until salmon is opaque in the center, about 12 minutes, then remove cover and place on a plate. Spoon 1 tbs water into saucepan, then stir in soy milk and juice from 1 lime. Cook over high heat until mixture begins to bubble, then lower heat and cook until water becomes syrupy and thickened, about 3 - 4 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in lime leaves, then spoon over salmon fillets. Meanwhile, heat oven to 350°f. Make a horizontal cut in salmon, about 1/2 from the edge, going 1/2 over the top. Place 1 kaffir lime leaf on a square of plastic wrap, then use the tip of the large knife to split down its length just enough to open up sides of kaffir. Lightly spray with cooking spray. Brush outside of wrapped salmon with cooking spray and cover salmon with remaining kaffir lime leaf. Repeat wrapping with remaining fillets, then place wrap on a plate and set aside to dry for at least 30 minutes. Bake at 350 degrees f for about 25 minutes, until fish is just cooked through, but skin is crisp and coating. Serve with a dollop of sweetened soy milk, and dipping sauce. To toast wontons, place one square of plastic wrap on a plate. Using a fork, dip a frozen wonton into warm water and place on top or in the center of the plastic wrap, leaving 1/2 of the corner of the wrap on the outside, leaving about 1/2 around the far edge of the wrap. Fold the corner up to the center and then the outside corners toward you. You should now have a circle of plastic wrap that is at least 6 inches in diameter. Carefully peel off the plastic wrap and carefully lift out the frozen package. Place onto a plate and serve with your choice of dipping sauces. Notes, kaffir lime leaves are available at asian grocery stores and most supermarkets. The lime leaves are slightly longer than the normal lime leaves. It helps to have a piece of lime hanging over each end of cooking time. To prepare frozen parcels, thaw the package, place a square of plastic wrap on top of a square of plastic wrap, then place 2 pieces onto the plate and top with another large square. You will also need 1 - 2 bunches for each portion of the parcels. Then, you can just place the wraps on top on a tray with a lip, then place in the freezer until ready to serve. You may also want to line a cookie sheet, loosely covering the top with parchment paper and foil. Lay the frozen package onto the parchment paper, then cover with the foil to stop it from sliding off the side onto the tray. Seal the edges with a fork. Bake in the oven for about 30 - 40 minutes, depending on oven, or until the parcels come out of the oven. To serve, let the parcels cool for at least 10 minutes then open up, remove the plastic wrap, then serve with a dipping sauce recip

title: Chipotle Coffee(Somali)
ingredients: 8 ounces coffee, sweetened with your favorite spices | 6 -8 ounces chipotle chiles, canned in adobo
instructions: Brew coffee with chipotle paste following label directions on the package. Serve hot or chilled with a shot of chocolate. Variate, substitute grated chocolate for chocolate.

Random Ingredients: phyllo pastry,tomatillo,apple juice,pancake syrup,baby green,horseradish,chicken breast half
title: Chicken and Shiitake Empanadas
ingredients: 1/4 cup sweet pancake syrup | 1/4 cup apple juice | 2 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves | 1 pound shredded fresh tomatillos | 1 package frozen phyllo pastry sheets | 1 cup shredded swiss-style processed cheese and monterey jack cheese blend | 1/3 cup shredded horseradish, or to taste
instructions: Preheat your oven to 375 degrees f. In a medium saucepan, combine pancake syrup, apple juice, and chicken breasts. Bring the mixture to a boil to reduce saltiness.

title: Anasazi Cheese Spread
ingredients: 2 cups asiago cheese, grated | 1 can dark rum, such as bacardi 151 calypso
instructions: Preheat ove to 350°f in a blender, combine the grated cheese with the rum and asiago and blend on high speed until you have a smooth mass. You should have about ¼ cup of dough. Transfer to a covered container and refrigerate for 1 to 2 weeks. Transfer the mixture to a bowl and serve. Store refrigerated.

Random Ingredients: parmigiano reggiano cheese,mirin,chipotle chile pepper,chicken breast,italian parsley,italian salad dressing mix,taco seasoning
title: Chipotle Chicken
ingredients: 4 boneless chicken breasts | 1 package taco seasoning | 1 package italian salad dressing mix, with dill | 1 teaspoon chile pepper, or more to taste | 1/2 cup shaved parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1/4 cup chopped italian parsley | 1/4 cup mirin
instructions: Heat a grill pan over medium heat. Line the bottom of a large, straight sided skillet with aluminum foil or parchment paper, set the chicken breasts side by side in the pan, and sprinkle the tops with taco seasoning. Place in the pan, and sprinkle the chicken with chile pepper and taco seasoning. Drizzle with vinaigrette dressing mix to cover all of the chicken. Wrap, and refrigerate for several hours or overnight. The next day, remove the chicken, and pat dry with a paper towel. Heat a separate grill pan over medium high heat. Place the chicken in the pan, and grill, basting frequently with the leftover marinade, until the juices run clear and the chicken is cooked through, 10 to 15 minutes. Arrange on a platter, and sprinkle with the cheese, pepper, and parsley.

title: Chili Glaze
ingredients: 3 tablespoons chili, chili hot sauce, from jar of chili chilies | 1 package dream whip | 1 cup apple cider or 1 cup apple juice
instructions: Put in blender and blend until smooth. If adding cream, pour into glass & refrigerate until needed. Enjoy.

title: Dynamite (Mexican Red Sauce)
ingredients: 4 small red chilies | 1 teaspoon vanilla
instructions: Place 2 chili peppers in an enameled cast iron skillet, top with 1/4 teaspoon vanilla, and top with another 1/4 teaspoon vanilla, then fry in butter on top. Pour remaining chilies over all and serve with rice or as a burrito filler.

Random Ingredients: cellophane noodle,leg lamb,bacon,russet potato,basmati rice,sirloin steak,sirloin,dill pickle
title: Beef Rouladen
ingredients: 5 lbs sirloin, lean, top quality, 1-inch thick | 1/2 cup cellophane noodles ( cellophane noodles may be substituted ) | 1 lb boneless leg of lamb, cubed 3/4-inch thick | 3 russet potatoes, cut into 1/2-inch x 1/4-inch pieces, unpeeled | 4 slices bacon, cooked, crumbled | 6 slices sirloin steaks, boneless, skinless cut across grain into 1/4-inch thick slices | dill pickle, cut into thin strips | steamed basmati rice, hot cooked
instructions: Slice sirloin across grain into very thin slices across grain. Soak cellophane noodles in a very large quantity of very hot water just until softened, about 2 minutes. Rinse under cold water and drain. Reserve noodles and noodles separately. Place sirloin slices in a dutch oven and brown in a dry large deep skillet over moderately high heat, turning pieces over for 5 minutes.

title: Chilli Prawn and Prawns
ingredients: 500 g minced beef stew meat | 500 g shelled prawns | 375 g cooked chicken livers
instructions: Cook the shrimp and prawns until pink. Set aside. Mix stew meat and prawns in pot. Stir. Add all the spices. Cook on medium heat for 15 minutes. Stir and add shrimp and prawns. Cook 2 - 3 minutes more on high/high heat or 4 - 5 minutes on low heat.

title: The Easiest Seitan French Bread Melt - Quick Version
ingredients: 1 can tomato soup | 2 1/2 ounces ouzo bacon, pieces cooked & crumbled | 1/2 cup parmesan cheese ( fresh grated, or not, just a few shreds ) | 1 roma tomato, cut into thin wedges | 1/4 cup of fresh mint ( minced, to taste. dried will do, but fresh will do, just not dried! ) | 4 slices bacon, cooked & cubed, but not crisped, to save time | 4 whole hoagie rolls, split | 4 tablespoons rice vinegar
instructions: Put tomato soup into med. Bowl. Set aside. Pour 1/2 cup cheese into empty soup pot. Cut roma tomato into thin wedges. In a seperate pan, over medium high heat, add 4 t. Or so of the ouzo bacon cubes to the soup. Sauté with the salt and pepper to taste. Remove from heat when you see nice browning on the edges, remove from heat & set aside. Turn the heat down to medium low, add the chopped bacon, tomato, mint and ouzo bacon pieces. Add the bread bowls, turning to coat with the ouzo/sauce. Cover & let bake 15 - 20 minutes, until bread bowls heated through and bread is crumbly. Remove from heat & spoon onto the bread, and enjoy.

title: Creamy Pork and Rice Stuffed Pork Tenderloins
ingredients: 1/3 cup half-and-half | 4 ounces cream cheese | 1/3 cup cooked basmati rice | 4 -5 lbs pork tenderloins
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. In a small bowl, combine half and half, and cream cheese. Stir in rice until evenly blended. Line a shallow roasting pan with foil. Lay pork, cut side up, in roasting pan, and place in roaster. Bake 1 hour or until pork is tender and stuffing is slightly crumbly. Let sit 10 minutes before removing from oven. Slice thinly, and serve with reserved stuffing.

title: Lemon Thyme Lemon Chicken
ingredients: 1 1/4 kg chicken bouillon cubes | 1 lemon, very thinly sliced crossways | 1/4 teaspoon dried thyme, ground | 1/2 tablespoon grated lemon rind
instructions: Mix in a large bowl with a wooden spoon to a paste with a pouring consistency. Add spices, mix well. Place in a fridge for an hour or two. Serve with your favourite vegetable or meat.

title: Chile Colorado
ingredients: 6 ounces red chilies, canned and chopped | 3 tablespoons dry oregano | 1 teaspoon active dry yeast | 2 1/2 lbs top sirloin, thinly sliced | 2 lbs trimmed of fat and very lean stew meat, cut into 1-inch cubes
instructions: Process chiles, oregano and yeast in a food mill or in a food processor until completely combined.

Random Ingredients: lettuce,sugar bean,goat meat,ricotta cheese,italian breadcrumb,salt black pepper,lemon wedge,anise seed
title: Bucatini in Agrodolce (Brazilian Sweet and Sour Meat Salad)
ingredients: 1/3 lb goat meat | 2 cups ricotta cheese | 1/3 cup sugar beans ( cooked ) | 1/4 cup fresh italian-style breadcrumbs | 1/4 teaspoon anise seed | salt & freshly ground black pepper | lettuce | lemon wedge
instructions: Cut the meat lengthwise into six 4 by 3 1/2 inch strips. If using goat meat, cut up it into bite size pieces. Place the slices on a plate with the fat on top. Arrange in one layer on a plate. In a bowl, mix the ricotta with the sugar and toast the bread crumbs in a skillet over medium low heat. Add the anise seed and remove from heat when toasted. Turn the meat pieces over and pour the ricotta mixture over them. Season with salt and pepper. Serve immediately, topped with some lettuce leaves and lemon wedge, if desired.

title: Pasta With Vermicelli, Herbs and Noodles and Tarragon
ingredients: 1 package vermicelli rice noodles | 4 ears fresh corn tortillas or 4 ears fresh spinach, cleaned and cut into 3-inch lengths | 1/2 cup tarragon, divided | 1 cup small shell pasta, such as farfelline
instructions: Cook rice noodles in boiling water for about 5 minutes. Drain and rinse. Heat 2 tbs. Olive oil in a large nonstick frypan or wok over medium high heat. Drain the noodles, but leave about a tablespoon of olive oil in the pan. Toss the tortillas in another 2 tbs. Olive oil. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the tortillas turn golden all over, about 1 minute per side. Transfer to a warmed platter, then sprinkle with half the tarragon and the remaining tarragon and serve immediately.

title: Gran's Chicken Baked in Apple Sauce
ingredients: 1 can beets, drained | 2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice | 1/4 cup apple juice | 2 cups cooked chicken, chopped | 3/4 cup graham cracker crumbs | 1 pear, peeled and sliced
instructions: Strain beets and juice through cheesecloth. Squeeze juice from the skins. Combine with remaining ingredients. Place on a lightly greased baking dish. Sprinkle with cracker crumbs and bake at 400 degrees f. For 30 minutes or until top is lightly browned.

title: Our Favorite Pizza Crust
ingredients: 2 cups prepared sourdough bread ( i recommend pizza crust ) | 1 3/4 cups bottled louisiana-style hot sauce ( i recommend louisiana-style hot sauce ) | 1/4 cup tomato juice | 1/2 teaspoon baking powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 500 degrees f and spray an 8x8x2 inch baking dish with cooking spray. Place 1 cup of prepared bread onto bottom of dish, drizzle half of hot sauce on the bread if using, stir it around and sprinkle with remaining bread. Distribute rest of hot sauce over top, sprinkle with baking powder, then top with remaining 2 cups bread. Bake 10 to 15 minutes, until dough is browned and bubbly and crust is crisp. You may use store bought hot sauce instead of the hot sauce in this recipe. Serve with warmed pizza toppings and sauce.

Random Ingredients: rum,heavy whipping cream,tarragon,cream mushroom soup,mandarin orange,yellow squash
title: Tartar Sauce for Pastry Filled Cream Cheese Squash
ingredients: 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream ( or half & half, half milk mixture ) | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1 tablespoon chopped tarragon | 1 can mandarin oranges, drained | 1 yellow squash ( about 1 lb., peeled, cubed ) | 1/4 cup rum
instructions: In a bowl, pour cream of mushroom soup, tarragon & mandarin oranges. Stir well to blend. Add squash and continue stiring gently. Add rum & stir. Pour mixture into pastry lined ramekins & refrigerate at least 1 hour & up to 2 days.

title: Easy Rocket
ingredients: 1 cup finely diced watermelon | 1/2 cup finely diced fresh raspberries | 1 tablespoon finely chopped gyoza skins | 1 1/2 teaspoons cayenne
instructions: Combine watermelon, raspberries, gyoza skins and cayenne in a large glass bowl. Microwave on high 4 minutes.

title: Dynamite Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons oil | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 3 tablespoons rice vinegar | 1 1/2 tablespoons palm sugar
instructions: Heat oil in sauce pan. Add condensed soup. Fry until golden brown. Add rice vinegar and palm sugar. Serve over steamed rice.

title: Gram's  Peppers and Onions (Won Ton)
ingredients: 20 green peppers ( red, purple, pixie ear, yellow or orange ) | pickled vinegar
instructions: Cut the tops off the green peppers. Remove the peels with a teaspoon. Slice in half and arrange on a serving platter in rows. Add 1/4 cup pickling vinegar to the remaining 1/4 cup vinegar. Stir to blend. Pour on the vegetables and allow to stand for 1 hour before serving.

title: Nepalese Roasted Mushrooms.
ingredients: 1 cup mixed coarse vegetable, such as baby bella mushrooms, cremini mushrooms, shiitake mushrooms, or oyster mushrooms | 1 inch fresh ginger root, cut into thin strips
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a roasting pan with aluminum foil, and spread mushrooms onto the lined pan. Stir ginger and garlic together with vegetable peeler to a paste. Spread ginger garlic paste over the mushrooms. Bake mushrooms in the preheated oven for 15 to 20 minutes, or until tender. Serve mushrooms with roasted vegetables.

Random Ingredients: leek,belgian endive,sesame oil,orange peel,egg noodle,baking potato
title: Sesame Noodles With Endive and Leeks (Rice Cooker)
ingredients: 3 large baking potatoes | 2 belgian endive, ends trimmed ( about 12 cups ) | 2 teaspoons sesame oil | 3/4 teaspoon dried orange peel | 1 egg noodles ( uncooked vermicelli ) | 2 leeks, white part only
instructions: Rinse and quarter potatoes, cut into chunks. Scrub endive, cut in 1/2 inch cubes and sprinkle with 1 teaspoon sesame oil and freshly ground pepper. Set aside at room temperature at least 18 - 30 minutes. Cook noodles following package directions. When done to your liking, drain and run potatoes through a ricer into a large bowl. Stir in remaining sesame oil and peel. Divide noodles among 2 1/2 to 3 quart slow cooker, spread in a single layer. Pour noodles over noodles, sprinkle with remaining 1 teaspoon of sesame oil, and cover with a lid or plastic wrap. Cook on high 4 - 6 hours or on low 5 - 7 hours or until noodles are tender but firm and fluffy. If desired, remove plastic wrap and cook on low 5 minutes before serving and stir well before serving. Note, may make up to 24 additional servings.

title: Ginger and Sour Cream Soup
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1/4 teaspoon ground ginger root, or more to taste | 1/8 teaspoon xanthan gum
instructions: Combine cream of chicken soup with ginger, xanthan gum, and green chile pepper paste in a saucepan.

title: Oatmeal
ingredients: 6 cups quick cooking oats | 3/4 cup sherry wine vinegar
instructions: Dry the rolled oats on a clean towel. Place the rolled oats in a large bowl and sprinkle with vinegar. Stir lightly until combined but do not over mix. Spread on a tea towel and leave for five hours in a warm place. Cook in a double boiler for 12 - 15 minutes until well toasted.

Random Ingredients: puff pastry,topping,tater tot,basmati rice,clear honey,milk,dark sesame oil,beef stock
title: Cream of Tater Tot Rice Pilaf
ingredients: 500 g tater tots | 200 g uncooked basmati rice | 1/2 cup beef stock ( or veg stock ) | 1 tablespoon clear honey | 100 g frozen puff pastry, thawed | 100 g reduced-fat whipped topping, thawed ( or spreadable ) | 1/2 cup reduced-fat milk | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon dark sesame oil ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven 350f and lightly oil the inside of a 9 x 15cm ovenproof dish. Rinse tater tots with cold water and drain. Place in a microwave safe bowl and microwave on high for 2 minutes or until thawed and heated through, stir well. Add rice, beef stock and honey to the rice and stir well to combine. Spoon the rice mixture into the casserole dish. Cover and microwave on high for 6 minutes or until rice is tender and almost cooked. Uncover and fluff with a fork. Add the tots and top with puff pastry and milk. Sprinkle top with sesame oil if using. Place in oven and bake for 30 minutes or until pastry is crisp and brown.

Random Ingredients: mustard powder,sherry wine,sirloin,sauerkraut,lima bean,chipotle chile adobo,fillet salmon
title: Chipotle Salmon With Limas and Beer!
ingredients: 2 lbs sirloin, 4, cut into 4 portions | 2 cans chipotle chiles in adobo | 1 can sauerkraut, drained | 1 lb lima beans ( fresh or frozen ) | 2 pints dry mustard powder, divided | 1/4 - 1/2 cup sherry wine | 4 fillets salmon
instructions: Combine chipotles & 1 c mustard powder in a blender, process until smooth. Strain into a large bowl, set aside. Combine sauerkraut & lima beans, rinse well with cool water, drain well. Blend well. Using your hands, rub 1 tbsp of the chipotle marinade all over each salmon fillet. Place fillets into a large covered glass baking dish & spread remaining chipotle marinade around fillets. Cover with plastic wrap & refrigerate. Preheat oven 325 degrees f. Remove the bag of steaks from marinade & place each piece in a small casserole dish or roasting pan. Set aside while preparing remainder of ingredients. Heat the remaining mustard powder, pour over the salmon fillets, bake in the oven for about 12 - 15 mins. Remove & let cool for about 1 minute. Cover tightly & refrigerate until cold. Bake or serve at room temp w/a bread & enjoy.

title: Garlic Mayo, Cabbage Rolls, and Vegetables
ingredients: 6 large cabbage leaves | 1 1/2 cups marzipan, spreadable spreadable spread ( such as tinkyada ) | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Cut 3 large leaves from each large leaf. Stack leaves, cutting out the core to make 12 leaves total, and running kitchen shears lengthwise along each pile of leaves. Spread a thin layer of spreadable spreadable spread over each leaf, then sprinkle with a small pinch of minced garlic salt. Place a cabbage leaf seam side down on a baking sheet, or lightly spray with vegetable cooking spray. Bake in the preheated oven until heated through and the spread is lightly crisp, 15 to 20 minutes. Allow cabbage rolls to cool slightly before serving.

title: Gourmet Style Black Pepper
ingredients: 1 lb bacon, in 1. 5-inch pieces | 1/2 cup zest of half orange | 1/4 teaspoon fresh ground black pepper
instructions: Cut bacon into 1 inch slices crosswise.

Random Ingredients: guinness stout,sage,english cucumber,beef stew meat,grape tomato,french mustard,kale,hazelnut
title: Grape Tomato Beef Stew
ingredients: 1 cup guinness stout | 1 lb beef stew meat, cubed | 1 lb kale, stems removed, leaves chopped into 1 inch pieces | 1 cup grape tomatoes, halved | 2 cups english cucumbers, diced | 3 tablespoons hazelnuts, toasted and chopped | 1 tablespoon french grain mustard ( yellow mustard ) | 1/2 teaspoon dried rubbed sage, crushed
instructions: Combine guinness and meat in a dutch oven and cook over medium heat until meat is browned on all sides, about 10 minutes. Place greens in a colander and let drain 15 - 20 minutes. Add meat, kale, tomatoes, cucumbers, hazelnuts and mustard to meat. Cover tightly and cook over low heat for 5 hours, until vegetables are tender. If planning to serve in bowls, cover and warm in the oven.

title: Split Pea Soup
ingredients: 2 cans condensed chicken broth | 2 cans english peas, drained | 3 red potatoes, cubed | 1 pound hamburger
instructions: In a large saucepan combine the chicken broth, split peas, potatoes and burger. Heat to boiling, stirring occasionally.

Random Ingredients: ha avocado,rosemary,marinade,white bread flour,garlic powder,salt water,mayonnaise
title: Avocados With Garlic Aioli
ingredients: 1/2 cup mayonnaise | 1 dash rosemary | 1 dash white pepper | 2 tablespoons prepared marinade | 1 dash garlic powder | 6 large firm ripe hass avocados | 1/4 teaspoon salt water
instructions: Make a cross on one side of each avocado half and peel. Cut cross into halves or thirds. Place avocado halves and marinade in a food processor with a steel blade or spoon and process until smooth. Stir in mayonnaise and season with rosemary, white pepper, salt, and garlic powder. Slice the avocado halves or quarters and place in a serving bowl. Spoon garlic aioli over the avocado and serve. Serve with toasted baguettes or toasted whole wheat french bread rolls.

Random Ingredients: beef sirloin,nonfat milk powder,chili pepper flake,pepperoncini pepper,dijon mustard
title: Low Fat Pepperoncini Beef
ingredients: 3 cans reduced fat beef sirloin | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon dried minced chili pepper flakes | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon dried hot pepperoncini pepper, crushed | 1/4 cup dijon-style mustard ( or dijon mustard if unavailable ) | fat free nonfat dry milk powder
instructions: Puncture beef with a fork after cutting, and place in crockpot. Combine the remaining ingredients and pour over the beef. Cook on low for 8 - 10 hours, high for 1 hour. Serve over pasta.

Random Ingredients: cider vinegar,breadcrumb,irish cream,soy sauce,butternut squash,club soda,reblochon cheese
title: Irish Champignons
ingredients: 12 ounces butternut squash ( about 1.5 lbs ) | 2 ounces breadcrumbs | 2 ounces reblochon cheese ( about 2 1/2 ounces ) | 2 ounces club soda | 1 tablespoon cider vinegar ( i use balsamic for a nice tang and flavor ) | 1 teaspoon soy sauce | 2 -3 teaspoons rye whisky or 2 -3 teaspoons irish cream
instructions: Pre heat oven to 450°. Pierce squash with a fork and cook in boiling water with lid on for about 10 minutes. Drape over cloth towel to cool. Slice in half, about ½ inch thick. Arrange slices on a platter and cover with remaining breadcrumbs. Sprinkle with rind of 1 orange. Dot cheese over. Combine ingredients for whisky marinade and pour over breadcrumbs. Marinate for 1 hour if you don't have an hour. Serve at once. Make sure the guests have plenty of wine.

Random Ingredients: taco seasoning mix,beef gravy,bamboo shoot,ginger root
title: Quick & Easy Beef Tips
ingredients: 1 package taco seasoning mix | 2 cans sliced bamboo shoots | 2 pounds ground beef round | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh ginger root
instructions: Prepare taco seasoning according to package directions for basting meat with seasoning. Meanwhile, heat a large skillet over medium high heat. Cook and stir beef and ginger in the hot skillet until browned and crumbly, 5 to 8 minutes.

Random Ingredients: green chilies,chocolate,sharp white cheddar cheese,pinto bean,romaine lettuce,plain yogurt,steak
title: Beef and Cheese Tacos
ingredients: 1 loaf round steaks, cut in half | 1 can pinto beans | 1 can chopped green chilies | 8 ounces plain fat free yogurt or 8 ounces sour cream | 1 cup shredded mild white cheddar cheese | romaine lettuce | 2 ounces chopped unsweetened chocolate
instructions: Cut flank steak in half on the diagonal, if the butcher has it. Scoop out each half and place it on a plate. Combine beans, chilies, and yogurt in a saucepan and heat over medium until very warm and easy to stir. Place one third of each of the meat and cheese into each of your tortillas. Place a second layer of meat and cheese in each tortilla and top with a dollop of the bean and yogurt mixture. Serve over salads of lettuce, salsa and grated chocolate.

title: Spicy Halibut
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/4 lb halibut, boned and butterflied | 1 apple, peeled, cored and sliced | 1/4 cup dry breadcrumbs | 1 egg yolk | 2 tablespoons cognac | 1/2 teaspoon ibzar mixed spice | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom powder | 2 cups plain breadcrumbs | 2 teaspoons cocoa ( optional )
instructions: Place halibut filets in a shallow bowl and cover with plastic wrap. To make a sandwich, lightly coat each filet with 1/4 cup breadcrumbs. Place on a plate and cover with plastic wrap. Let sit 30 minutes to 1 hour. After 30 minutes, remove from plastic wrap, remove plastic and discard plastic wrap. Mix together egg, cognac, ibzar, and cardamom powder in a medium bowl. Dip each filet in the egg mixture and then roll in breadcrumbs. Heat a large frying pan on medium high. If you prefer a firmer pan, you may need to add a little olive oil. Fry the fish until golden on all sides, flipping them once. Place rolls on a baking sheet and spread with the cognac mixture. Return to the oven. If you want a crisp exterior, bake at 300f. Approximately 20 minutes or until the fish flakes easily when prodded with a fork. Serve with thick apple wedges, steaming hot watercress, a side dish of fresh vegetables, and a light side dish of your choice of dippables from the crockpot.

title: Lasagna a La Mexicana
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon saffron | 1/2 teaspoon ground tamari | 1 can diced fire-roasted tomatoes, coarsely chopped | 1 can sliced olives, drained | 1 poblano chile, seeded and cut into strips | 1 pound lean ground meat | 3 lasagna noodles, broken up
instructions: Heat a skillet over medium heat until hot, or broil the lasagna sheets. Sprinkle saffron, and tamari over hot surface and toast until fragrant, 20 seconds to 1 minute. Stir in tomatoes, olives, poblano, and meat. Spray broiler rack with cooking spray. Arrange tomato mixture on the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish and top with lasagna sheets. Sprinkle with salt. Broil 3 minutes, just until vegetables are tender and beginning to brown. Turn over, cover, and broil 5 more minutes. Remove lid, then broil 3 more minutes. Remove from oven, and serve.

Random Ingredients: cilantro leaf,saffron strand,salt cod fish,margarine,chicken thigh
title: Preserved and Baked (Rajas Daal)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs salt cod fish, rinsed if dry | 1/2 lb margarine | 4 -5 ounces saffron strands ( see note ) | 1 bunch cilantro leaf | 5 -8 cups chicken thighs, rinsed if dry
instructions: Place fish in large pot or baking pan. Cover with water and bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer covered for about 12 minutes or until fish flakes easily with a fork. Drain fish and cool off any remaining bones, skin and bones. Cut fish into chunks about the size of a large walnut. Melt margarine in frypan and add saffron strands. Toss in fish, skin side down and saute 3 - 4 minutes. Remove fish from pan and place chicken in roaster. Pour enough cold water into roaster to reach 1 1/2 cups. Cover. Bake in 350º oven for 1 hour or until fish is tender. Remove cover, stir in chopped cilantro leaves and cook 1 - 2 minutes more.

Random Ingredients: sesame oil,cream cheese,spaghetti,white mushroom,chinese cabbage,saffron,taco shell,greek oregano
title: Saffron Sushi Cups
ingredients: 250 g light cream cheese | 1 pinch saffron ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon toasted sesame oil | 5 -6 white mushrooms, cleaned, cut into small cubes | 6 chinese cabbage, shredded thinly | 2 cups of cold cooked spaghetti | salt and toasted sesame oil | all purpose greek oregano
instructions: Pre heat oven to 250°f. Combine cream cheese with saffron, toasted sesame oil, white mushrooms and chopped cabbage. Season. Scoop a 3 cup of the mix onto each square of tofu. Top with salt and toasted sesame oil. Place in a single layer on a baking tray lined with parchment paper. Bake in a 250° oven for 25 - 30 minutes. Serve warm. Enjoy.

title: Homemade Pecorino Cheese for Pasta
ingredients: 1 package cream cheese | 150 g pecorino romano cheese, grated | 6 teaspoons vanilla essence
instructions: Put all the ingredients in a food processor and blend till you get a creamy paste. Add more cheese if you want less thick pasta. Serve with your favourite pasta or make your own pesto. Also, it is wonderful as a marinading filling for your pasta.

title: Beef and Rhubarb Lasagna
ingredients: 1 pound ground beef chuck | 3 tablespoons catsup | 2 tablespoons ranch dressing | salt to taste | 2 pounds rhubarb, trimmed and cut acrosswise into small pieces | 15 lasagna noodles, or as needed
instructions: Heat a skillet over medium heat and cook and stir the burger until browned and crumbly, 5 to 10 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in catsup and ranch dressing until well mixed. Set aside 1/3 of the meat mixture. Spread 1/3 of the meat mixture into the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish. Layer with 1/3 of the rhubarb and half of the lasagna noodles. Repeat layers twice, ending with a layer of meat, rhubarb, and lasagna noodles. Pour the reserved meat mixture over the lasagna noodles. Cover the lasagna with aluminum foil and refrigerate the lasagna for 1 week. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Uncover and bake the lasagna for 1 1/2 hours, or until the top is nicely browned. Allow to stand for 10 minutes before serving.

title: Mint and Pork Belly - Microwave Recipe Recipe
ingredients: 1 kg pork belly | 1 packet of powdered mint
instructions: Place the pork belly in a microwave safe bowl. Sprinkle over the mint powder and cover with cling film. Microwave on high power level for 5 - 8 minutes or until cooked. Let stand for 3 minutes. Carefully unwrap the pork belly and slice across the grain into slices approximately 5 mm thick. Serve with lemon wedges and mint sprigs. Serve with any other type of roast.

title: Tortilla Cakes from Kaffir Lime Beverage
ingredients: 3/4 lb zucchini, washed and finely julienned | 1/4 lb sweet corn tortilla strip ( like mission street ) | 6 kaffir lime leaves, plus 2 tablespoons kaffir lime flavored liqueur
instructions: Place the zucchini in a colander, sprinkle with salt, and set aside for 30 minutes to drain. Transfer the zucchini to 1 quart of lightly salted boiling water, and cook for 1 minute. Drain, cool, and cut into 1/2 inch pieces. Transfer to a mixing bowl, and add the tortilla strips. Fold together, and refrigerate until very cold. Mash the lime leaves with a mortar and pestle or a fork. Stir into the chilled zucchini mixture. Preheat the oven to 300 degrees f. Roll the tortilla pieces in the lime leaves to coat them evenly. Place them on a baking sheet, and bake until hot and lightly browned about 15 minutes. Flip the taquitos over, and bake about 10 minutes longer, until the zucchini is tender, and the filling is just beginning to brown. Remove from the oven, and serve.

Random Ingredients: pomegranate juice,italian salad dressing,pine nut,pearl barley,garam masala powder,wheat tortilla,red wine vinegar,bread
title: Toscano Barley Bread Salad (Barley) Wraps #RSC
ingredients: 1 cup whole wheat tortillas | 3/4 cup dried pomegranate juice | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon garam masala powder | 3 tablespoons italian salad dressing | 1 cup refrigerated pearl barley | 1/4 cup toasted pine nuts
instructions: Combine all ingredients & refrigerate. Bring to room temp before making wraps. Warm wraps by placing a small amount of the barley in the center of each wrap, then top with a piece of roasted pomegranate.

title: Chunky Mango Masala
ingredients: 3 mangoes, thickly sliced | 1 dash garlic salt | 1 dash curry powder | 1 dash dried parsley flakes
instructions: Cut mangoes into 2 inch chunks, or bite size pieces. Mix with all dry spices. Spread onto serving dish and let sit 2 hours. Serve with plain rice.

Random Ingredients: cauliflower,golden delicious apple,brie cheese,mini marshmallow,turbinado sugar,cranberry,red chile pepper
title: Roasted Cauliflower With Brie Cheese and Roasted Apples
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower, coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup turbinado sugar | 1 head roasted red chile pepper, coarsely chopped | 20 mini marshmallows | 15 ounces brie cheese, crumbled | 5 gold delicious apples - peeled, cored, and coarsely chopped | 20 miniature marshmallows | 1 jar dried cranberries, stems reserved
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add cauliflower and cook uncovered until tender yet crisp, about 2 minutes. Drain. Transfer cauliflower to a large bowl. Add turbinado sugar, red chile, roasted chile, marshmallows, brie cheese and apples. Mix well to combine. Spread evenly in an 11x7 inch baking dish. Using a long spatula, scrape cauliflower from the pan. Stir in cranberries, being careful not to break the whole cumble. Bake in preheated oven until bubbling and lightly browned, about 40 minutes. Turn out onto a platter and serve warm.

title: Easy Low Fat Amish Veal and Almonds
ingredients: 2 tablespoons light cream of tartar | 1 tablespoon sweetened italian salad dressing ( or to taste ) | 1 teaspoon almond extract | 1 lb veal, trimmed of fat | chopped parsley
instructions: In 12 inch skillet, stir together cream of tartar, italian salad dressing, and almond extract. Cook over medium low heat, stirring constantly until it thickens slightly. Remove from heat.

Random Ingredients: mozzarella cheese,white sugar,vermouth,tomato ketchup,salt pork,fruit,mustard seed
title: Burgers
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs lean salt pork, cut into 1 inch pieces | 2 cups dry vermouth or 2 cups dry white wine | 1 cup tomato ketchup | 1 cup mango paste with fruit | 1 teaspoon salt ( use 1/2 teaspoon ) | 1/2 teaspoon white sugar | 1/4 teaspoon mustard seeds
instructions: Remove all visible fat from the salt pork and discard. Cut into 1 to 1 - ½ inch pieces and set aside. To make the ketchup sauce, combine the vermouth, ketchup, mango paste, salt, sugar and mustard seeds in a saucepan. Stir with a wisk or wooden spoon over low heat, until hot. Bring water to a boil. Add salt pork, reduce heat and simmer for 1 - ½ hours, or until meat is very tender. Remove from heat and allow the sauce to cool a little. Transfer the ketchup to a container and whisk in a spoonful of water if necessary. Taste the sauce and add more sugar or ketchup if needed. Transfer the sauce to a clean serving bowl and refrigerate, covered, for at least 3 to 4 hours.

Random Ingredients: canadian rye whisky,extra virgin olive oil,banana,chili paste
title: Smokies (Banana & Whisky Canapes)
ingredients: 4 bananas, peeled and halved lengthways | 2 tablespoons chili paste ( or 1 tablespoon hot chili powder ) | 2 tablespoons canadian rye whisky | 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Blanch the bananas in a pan of simmering water for 5 - 6 minutes or until tender. Drain and mash well with a fork or potato masher. Stir in the chilli paste, then stir in the whisky. Drizzle over the oil for decorative flavour. Serve at once.

title: Indian Spinach and Mascarpone Herb Dessert
ingredients: 3 tablespoons mascarpone cheese, room temperature | 2 tablespoons finely chopped fresh rosemary sprig | 2 tablespoons thai kitchen curry leaves ( available at indian markets and asian specialty food stores ) | 1 tablespoon finely chopped lemongrass, inner white part only | 1 1/2 teaspoons garam masala | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh sage | fresh rosemary sprig ( to garnish )
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the mascarpone, 1 tablespoon of the chopped fresh rosemary, and 1 tablespoon of the curry leaves. Cover and chill for 2 hours,. Remove the leaves from the lemongrass. In a medium bowl, combine the mascarpone mixture with the remaining 1 tablespoon of fresh rosemary, the remaining 1 1/2 teaspoons curry leaves, lemon grass, garam masala, and remaining 1/2 teaspoon of curry leaves. Set aside 5 leaves of the curry leaves, and finely chop the leaves coarsely. Add the chopped leaves to the cheese mixture, and combine well. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Let rest at room temperature for 10 minutes, then sprinkle the remaining chopped rosemary leaves over the top. Serve with fresh rosemary sprigs for garnish.

title: Spicy Mexican Grilled Cheese
ingredients: 2 lbs colby-monterey jack cheese ( coarsely grated ) | 2 cans chili paste
instructions: Mix all ingredients together until well blended.

title: Eggs from Michigan (Eggs in Michigan)
ingredients: 8 eggs, beaten | 1 tablespoon hot beef bouillon
instructions: Beat the eggs well with 2 tablespoons of hot beef bouillon. Put the egg whites into a large, shallow, non metal pan that has a rack in the bottom. Place the pan into a pre heated oven until the eggs are set. This may take 20 minutes depending upon your oven, but watch carefully, because eggs will continue to cook as they cool. Place the pan in the over of the pre heated broiler set at 300° fahrenheit. The hot broiler will burn the whites quickly, as soon as the whites have begun to set, they will burn quickly and quickly in the hot oven. Turn off the oven but leave the door open for a moment, so that the eggs will have a little room at the bottom of the pan. Cover the pan tightly with foil, and set it in the 325° fahrenheit oven. Cook to give the pan a chance to cool off a bit. The eggs are done when they are the bottom of the whites have begun to set but are still somewhat soft, the tops are a nice, deep color. Remove the pan from oven and place on a serving plate, placing it directly on the hot tap water tap.. Serve them while they are still somewhat warm or cold.

title: Herb and Cheese Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup cornflour | 1/3 cup fresh chives, chopped | 1/3 cup fresh mint, chopped | 2 ounces ripe camembert cheese, chopped | 7 ounces romaine lettuce, torn into bite-sized pieces | 2 -3 dashes ground pepperoni
instructions: Whisk cornflour and remaining dill and the chives, mint and cheese in a bowl. Toss in lettuce and pepperoni. Season with black pepper.

Random Ingredients: tarragon,black eyed pea,corn oil,currant,canadian bacon,ginger root
title: Baked Irish-Canadian Black-Eyed Peas
ingredients: 1 package dried black-eyed peas | 1/2 pound canadian bacon, diced | 3/4 cup corn oil for frying | 3/4 cup dried currants | 3 tablespoons dried tarragon | 1 tablespoon minced fresh ginger root
instructions: Soak black eyed peas in 4 cups water for 18 to 20 hours, or overnight. Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Wrap peas in a large package of hot cheesecloth, squeeze out excess water, and fold in bacon, corn oil, currants, tarragon, and fresh ginger. Place on a baking sheet, and bake 45 minutes in the preheated oven. Remove cheesecloth, and continue baking 10 minutes, or until peas are tender.

title: Spicy Indian Flatbread
ingredients: 3 cups self-raising flour | 2 teaspoons ginger-garlic paste | 2 teaspoons finely grated fresh ginger-garlic paste
instructions: Sift the flour and the garlic ginger garlic paste into a bowl or a measuring cup and add enough water to mix a workable dough. Leave to stand for 3 mins to allow it to relax. Roll out to a thickness of 1/4 or thinner. Cut out four circles or a round with 1 round cutter or glass, place on a floured greased tray, brush the edges with water and then prick a few holes with a fork. Bake on a hot griddle or until golden brown. Leave to stand on a sheet pan until completely cooled.

title: Black Bean and Date Stir-Fry
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1/2 cup dates, cut in thirds lengthwise and then crosswise into 1/2 inch slices ( about 3 ounces each ) | 1 cup black beans, drained and rinsed | 1 package semisweet baking chocolate | 1/2 cup vegetable oil
instructions: In a small saucepan over medium heat, combine the 2 tablespoons oil and the dates with 1/2 cup of water. Bring to a simmer. Cover and cook until the dates are warmed through, about 5 minutes, stirring often. Remove and set aside. In a 10 inch nonstick skillet, heat the remaining 2 tablespoons of oil over high heat. Add the black beans and cook, stirring, until just tender, about 1 minute. Add the peanut butter. Cook and stir until the mixture melts into a thick sauce and is light brown in color, about 1 minute. If the sauce is too thick, thin it with a little water, 1 tablespoon at a time. Serve warm, sprinkled with the chocolate.

Random Ingredients: lemon zest,flat leaf parsley,pork shoulder,kidney bean,rice wine vinegar,orange blossom water,yoghurt,hazelnut syrup
title: Smoor (Palestinian-Style Red Bean Salad)
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs kidney beans, soaked overnight, drained | 1/4 cup hazelnut syrup, warmed | 2 lbs pork shoulder, thinly sliced | 1/2 cup orange blossom water or 1/2 cup sunflower oil | 1 1/2 tablespoons lemon zest, finely grated | 1 1/2 tablespoons rice wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons fresh flat-leaf parsley, chopped | 1 1/2 tablespoons yoghurt
instructions: Place rinsed beans in a saucepan and add enough cold water to cover the beans by 1/2 inch. Bring to the boil and boil for 5 minutes. Drain beans and transfer them into a large non metallic bowl. Add cooled beans, hazelnut syrup, pork, orange blossom water, lemon rind, rice wine vinegar, parsley and yoghurt, mixing thoroughly. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 24 hours. Remove the plastic wrap at serving time and serve chilled.

Random Ingredients: cottage cheese,heavy whipping cream,lemon juice,alfredo sauce,ramen noodle,egg,soymilk
title: Lemon Mushroom Stroganoff
ingredients: 6 ounces ramen noodles ( not `` quick rise '' noodles ) | 1 cup heavy whipping cream | 1/2 cup soymilk | 6 ounces cottage cheese | 1 tablespoon grated lemon juice | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh lemon juice | 1 egg, lightly beaten | 1 jar creamy alfredo sauce
instructions: Cook ramen noodles according to package directions. Drain and rinse with cold water. Combine noodles with cream, soy milk, cottage cheese, lemon juice, and lemon juice in a bowl. Pour hot alfredo sauce over noodles, stirring to combine. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: lime juice,pearl barley,cranberry,cream mushroom soup,cauliflower floret,lime jell o gelatin,bacon,sun tomato oil
title: Cauliflower-Barley Jell-O
ingredients: 1 box frozen pearl barley | 1 box lime jell-o gelatin | 2 cans cream of mushroom soup | 3/4 cup sour cream | 1 cup lime juice | 1 teaspoon lime jell-o powdered instant potato flakes ( optional ) | 2 slices bacon ( optional ) | 1/4 cup dried cranberries ( optional )
instructions: Stir together, barley, Jello and soups. Stir together, sour cream and lime juice in a saucepan and heat thoroughly. Fold in potato flakes. Pour into a 9x13 baking dish. Cook at 350 degrees f for 20 - 25 minutes until bubbly and set.

title: Fillets Portuguese-Style Tilapia
ingredients: 3 fish fillets ( tilapia, sole, snapper ) | 1 1/2 quarts fish stock | 1 cup dry red wine | 2 tablespoons cilantro leaves
instructions: Combine fish stock and wine in a large pot. Bring to boil over medium heat. Add fish. Reduce heat, cover and simmer until fish are tender, about 10 minutes. Remove fish from skillet and place on a platter while straining sauce. Boil sauce until reduced by half and pour over fish.

title: Spicy Chipotle Barbecue Marinara Sauce
ingredients: 6 cans tomato sauce | 1/4 cup chopped chipotle chile in adobo
instructions: Pour tomato sauce into a heavy non reactive saucepan. Add chopped chipotles into saucepan. Heat over medium heat for 3 to 5 minutes or until hot. Reduce heat to low.

title: Chinese Sweet Onion Dip (Diabetic)
ingredients: 1/2 cup reduced sodium soy sauce | 1/2 cup italian dressing
instructions: In a medium bowl, whisk together soy sauce and dressing. Add the dry ingredients and toss to coat the onions and place on a baking sheet. Bake at 325 degrees f for 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: maraschino cherry,pre mozzarella cheese,bamboo skewer,cellophane noodle
title: Cherry Cheesecake
ingredients: 1 package cellophane noodles, broken | 4 bamboo skewers | 1 1/2 cups shredded pre-shredded mozzarella cheese | 1 can sliced maraschino cherries, drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place cellophane noodles in a large pot and cover with water. Bring to a boil over high heat, then remove from heat and let stand for 5 minutes. Drain.

Random Ingredients: tart apple,shiitake mushroom,dark soy sauce,basil leaf,mint jelly,chicken stock,pork shoulder,choy sum
title: Shichimi-Style Pork With Herbed Apples and Choy Sum
ingredients: 4 1/4 lbs pork shoulder, cut into 6 equal pieces, preferably a lean pork butt | 1/3 cup chicken stock | 8 small shiitake mushrooms, stemmed sliced | 1/2 cup chopped fresh basil leaf | 1/4 cup tian shao hsiang sweet dark soy sauce | 1/2 cup mint jelly, chilled ( or jelly jelly of your choice ) | 6 slices thin tart apples | 6 -10 fresh basil leaves, whole, for garnish | 1/2 cup choy sum, for garnish
instructions: Place the pork and stock in a large saucepan. Add the mushrooms, basil, and sauces. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer for 25 minutes. Remove the pork from the pan and put in a warm pot. Strain the sauce through a fine sieve and return the sauce to the pan. Bring to a boil over moderate heat, then reduce the heat and boil rapidly for about 5 minutes to reduce slightly. Transfer the pork, mushrooms, and herbs to a bowl. Stir in the jelly until completely coated. Let cool. When ready to serve, heat an ovenproof skillet over high heat until just barely smoking. Place 2 basil leaves in the skillet, and cook for 1 minute, stirring occasionally. Place 2 pork slices in each of the heated basil leaves. Spoon 2 tablespoons of the sauce over each pork slice. Arrange the remaining 2 leaves around the pork slices and bake in the preheated oven for 25 minutes, or until the pork is fork tender and beginning to brown. Arrange the basil leaves around the sides of each pancake and place a few slices of the pork on top. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: kale,italian bread,ginger paste,fontina cheese,turnip,cumin seed,flour tortilla,dark soy sauce
title: Sweet Potato and Kale Chips
ingredients: 8 ounces lean kale | 1 1/2 teaspoons sambal oelek or 1 1/2 teaspoons other dark soy sauce | 1/2 teaspoon ginger paste | 1/4 teaspoon cumin seed, crushed | 1 turnip, thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 8 8-inch flour tortillas or 8-inch corn tortillas | 1 ounce fontina cheese, freshly grated
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°f rinse the kale and dry well. Trim off stem ends. Cut kale into long strips or julienne if using fresh kale. In a food processor or blender, combine the sambal oleckk, 1/2 tsp ginger paste, cumin and 1/2 teaspoon soy sauce and pulse til well blended but not pureed. Place the carrots and turnips in a heavy bottomed skillet or a large baking dish. Add 2 tbsp soy sauce. Bring to a boil and reduce heat to low. While the carrots and turnips are cooking, line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Transfer the turnips and green vegetables to the prepared baking sheet and cover with a kitchen towel. After several minutes, transfer the vegetables to a cutting board and cut into thin slices. To wrap the chips, place the wrap, along with any accumulated juices, on a work surface and use your fingers to squeeze the excess moisture from the wrap. Top the wrap with the vegetables and sprinkle with the fontina cheese. Press down to compact. Sprinkle the chips evenly over the tops and sides of the wrap. Bake until the vegetables are browned, crispy, and golden brown and crisp, about 25 minutes.

title: Tea Party Viking
ingredients: 8 american cheese slices | 4 teaspoons instant coffee | 1/4 fluid ounce vanilla frozen yogurt, softened and sweetened | 1 ounce smoked veal | 3 tablespoons black tea | 2 tomato slices
instructions: Combine coffee and yogurt to make a spread on cheese slices and top with sliced meat and tomato slices.

Random Ingredients: shiitake mushroom,asafoetida powder,artichoke heart,red swiss chard,spice
title: Swiss Chard and Artichokes in Spiced Salt
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh asafoetida powder | 1 bunch fresh shiitake mushrooms | 1 bunch fresh red swiss chard | 4 dried artichoke hearts, soaked in water and chopped | 2 teaspoons mixed spice ( spice essence )
instructions: Roughly chop the chard, swiss chard, and artichoke hearts, separating the stalk and leaves. Rinse and soak the salt and the chard and artichoke hearts separately in plenty of water for 30 minutes. Drain the soaked salted mixture and rinse it well. Remove the spinds by slicing off the hard end with a paring knife and running a knife down the side. The salt should be about 1/2 cm thick. Set a strainer over a bowl, pour the sauteed mixture, and pour enough hot water over the top to cover the salted mixture. Let this drain for an hour or more, then rinse in cold water and place in a colander. Serve on a bed of rice.

title: Yuzukiri Salmon
ingredients: 1 salmon fillets | 1/4 cup sour cream | 2 tablespoons mirin | 1 teaspoon poultry seasoning
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Rinse the salmon and pat dry with paper towels. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Arrange the fillets in a single layer on the prepared baking sheet. Mix the sour cream with mirin, poultry seasoning, and salt and pepper in a large bowl until thoroughly combined. Pour the sour cream mixture over the fish, and wrap the salmon tightly with the mixture. Bake in the preheated oven until the salmon flakes easily with a fork, 40 to 45 minutes.

Random Ingredients: swiss cheese,agave nectar,clove,beef sirloin steak,black bean,mayonnaise
title: Steak Steak in Black Bean Dip
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless beef sirloin steaks | 1 1/2 teaspoons dry agave nectar | 1/4 teaspoon ground cloves | 1 cup mayonnaise | 1 cup shredded swiss cheese | 1 can black beans, rinsed and drained
instructions: Place steak in a shallow casserole dish and sprinkle with the agave and cloves. Cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes. In a medium bowl, whisk the mayonnaise and swiss cheese until the cheese is melted. Drain and discard the bag of beans. Mash the beans with a potato masher, using more for a thinner and more creamy mixture. Lightly oil an 8 inch square metal baking dish. Remove steak from refrigerator and discard marinade. Grill steaks over high heat 5 minutes for medium rare or 7 for medium. Serve hot with the bean dip.

title: Smokey Oranges
ingredients: 7 oranges, remove white membrane and membrane | 1 tablespoon orange peel, finely grated
instructions: Cut the oranges in half lengthwise. Remove and discard the pith to expose the white membrane. Rinse under running water, then drain well. Place the orange halves on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and sprinkle with grated orange peel. Smoke for 20 to 25 minutes by indirect heat. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes, or until the internal temperature reaches 90 degrees f in the hand held slicer. Let stand 10 to 15 minutes before removing from the pan.

title: Sausage and Spices
ingredients: 6 cups meat, chopped | 1/2 gallon chili sauce | 1/2 gallon dark brown sugar | 1 gallon lard | beef cubes, for coating
instructions: In a large pot combine all ingredients and bring to boil, rolling and stirring until it boils and thickens somewhat. Pour into crock pot and cook on low for 10 - 12 hours. If the sauce is too thick, add 1/4 1/3 cup cold water. Slice and serve with boiled potatoes, gravy, noodles, etc.

title: Greek Dressing Risotto
ingredients: 1/4 cup quinoa, chopped coarse | 1 cup hominy, drained | 1 lb lamb stock | 5 ounces greek yogurt | 8 ounces sweet cherries, in natural juice
instructions: Put quinoa in a bowl. Cover with boiling water, let stand for 10 - 15 minutes until water is absorbed. Drain well. Add hominy, lamb stock and yogurt to quinoa and stir well to combine. Rinse mixture well, drain and dry. Add cherries and stir together. Chill. Serve with bread and pita chips.

title: Simple English Chip Cookies
ingredients: 6 green onions | 1 box milk chocolate chips
instructions: Melt milk chocolate chips in a double boiler. Then stir in green onions. Drop on waxed paper and cool. Break into pieces and store in airtight tin.

Random Ingredients: corn syrup,tomato green chilies,green pepper,nonfat milk powder,raisin
title: Mexican Mashed Potatoes
ingredients: 6 medium potatoes | 1 can chopped tomatoes with green chilies | 1/2 cup nonfat dry milk powder | 1 can corn syrup | 1/2 cup green pepper, finely chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Scrub potatoes and cut in 2 inch chunks. Place in a large roasting pan and toss with tomatoes, corn syrup, green pepper and raisins until thoroughly combined. Cover and bake in preheated oven for 1 hour or until potatoes are tender. Gently stir. Let stand covered for 10 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: beef broth,hard egg,self rising flour,cardamom seed,green chile,currant
title: Finnish Egg Care
ingredients: 1 cup self-rising flour | 1 cup beef broth | 4 hard-boiled eggs, peeled and sliced | 1 can chopped green chiles, drained | 1/4 cup dried currants | 2 tablespoons ground cardamom seeds
instructions: In a small bowl, combine flour and broth. Beat well. Stir in egg yolks, chiles, currants, and cardamom. Drop batter by spoonfuls into boiling water. Boil uncovered for about 1 minute, drain and serve hot.

title: Paneer (Indian Cheese)
ingredients: 1/2 lb fresh cheese ( paneer ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons ghee ( can also use clarified butter ) | 4 -6 kaffir lime leaves | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom seed ( optional )
instructions: Cut fresh cheese into one inch cubes or small pieces and deep fry in oil. Remove from oil and place on tray. Keep aside. Heat 1 - 2 tbsps. Of ghee in oil. Add cardamontine seeds which have been crushed and spread out on the same side as cheese. Shallow fry the same. If using cinnamon stick, add a couple of drops of water as per usual to the grinder, then grind them into powder. Toss all the items together. Sprinkle salt and cinnamon, if using, over the paneer just before serving. Garnish with a few slices of fresh basil leaves. Serve immediately with a cup of hot indian yellow rice.

title: Spinach & Herb Salad
ingredients: 200 g spinach leaves | 2 tablespoons mixed fresh herbs ( borage, thyme, mixed chard, rocket, rocket and chard )
instructions: Wash and dry the spinach well in a salad spinner. Wash the herb in cold water. Drain well, and remove some of the thick stems and leaves. Put into a glass bowl. Add the spinach leaves & herbs. Toss gently. Serve at room temperature. This recipe can also be prepared in advance, and frozen for upto 5 months.

title: Skewered Red Pepper Strips
ingredients: 1 lb red bell pepper | 1/2 cup packed light brown sugar | 2 serrano chilies
instructions: Fire up the grill. Peel the bell peppers and slice lengthwise about 1/8 inch thick, about 1 1/2. Place pepper slices on skewers in a single layer. Sprinkle evenly with brown sugar. Wrap tightly with toothpicks. Grill over preheated grill 4 to 6 inches from the heat for about 5 minutes, turning as necessary, until the peppers and sugar are evenly cooked and slightly scorched. Skewer hot peppers.

title: Sizzler Tomatoes
ingredients: 4 small roma ( plum ) tomatoes, cut horizontally into 1/4 inch slices | cooking spray | 1 can diced green chile peppers, drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Arrange roma tomatoes on a baking sheet. Spray with cooking spray. Bake in the preheated oven 2 to 3 minutes per side, until lightly browned. Spread tomato slices with chile peppers, and continue baking 2 to 3 minutes.

title: Asiago and Apple Torte
ingredients: 500 g french beans, topped and tailed | 1 tablespoon grape juice | 1 packet gelatin ( small packets of ) | 2 tablespoons apple juice | 4 ounces chevre cheese | 1/2 cup grated asiago cheese or 1/2 cup grated bresaola cheese | 1 tablespoon chopped walnuts, toasted or 1 tablespoon chopped roasted paprika
instructions: To make the asiago, mix the cheese, walnuts and paprika together in a bowl add the beet juice to taste and stir until well mixed. Cover and refrigerate for up to 1 day. Cut the beans diagonally into 2cm pieces. Bring a pan of water until boiling. Blanch the beans for 2 minutes or until tender. Drain. Transfer to a bowl and add the beet juice and gelatine. Toss well to combine. Drain the beans and remove the stalks with a metal or bamboo spoon. Place in a serving bowl. Add the cheese mixture and enough boiling water to just below the boiling point to cover the beans. Sprinkle the beans with the asiago cheese and toss until the cheese melts. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: triple sec,yellow squash,new potato,beef broth,coconut,lime wedge,cardamom seed
title: Crock Pot Beef With Yellow Squash and Red Spices
ingredients: 1 cup beef broth | 1 tablespoon triple sec or 1 tablespoon orange flavored liqueur | 1 large yellow squash, cut into 1-inch chunks ( about 2 pounds ) | 3 lbs new potatoes, cut into 1-inch chunks | 2 tablespoons crushed dried coconut | 1/2 teaspoon crushed cardamom seed ( optional ) | 8 lime wedges
instructions: Combine broth, triple sec, and next 3 ingredients in crock pot, stir. Add squash and potatoes.

Random Ingredients: cocoa powder,poblano pepper,port wine,parsley,navy bean,superfine sugar
