title: Baked Poblano Beans
ingredients: 3/4 cup superfine sugar | 1 cup poblano pepper, roasted ( from a jar, or canned ) | 2 tablespoons unsweetened dried parsley | 2 1/2 cups navy beans, cooked ( canned or fresh ) | 1 1/4 cups port wine | 1/2 tablespoon cocoa powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Place beans and 2 tbsp of the sugar in a small baking dish. Mix well and set aside. Place remaining sugar, the remaining poblano peppers, parsley and remaining sugar in a food processor and process until the mixture resembles a coarse paste. Spread over the beans. Sprinkle with cocoa powder. Bake the beans in the preheated oven for 15 to 20 minutes or until the peppers are soft and the beans are golden.

title: Prawns or Shrimps Appetizers
ingredients: 24 -30 cleaned raw prawns | 1/2 cup sweetened flaked coconut ( to garnish ) ( optional ) | 0.5 package mild flavored mirin ( to taste ) ( optional )
instructions: Heat enough oil to cover the bottom of a large frying pan or wok. Place prawns or shrimps in the pan and fry, stirring, until they turn light pink. Remove the prawns or shrimps from the pan and discard any oil in the pan. Put into a medium size bowl and sprinkle enough mirin to cover the prawns or shrimps. Stir to coat prawns or shrimps. Garnish with the flaked coconut and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: tart apple,puff pastry,pepperoni,mango,manicotti shell,red pepper flake
title: Apple and Pepperoni Appetizers (Tarte Aux Tarte Et Aux Mangoes)
ingredients: 8 slices pickled pepperoni | 4 tart apples, peeled with cored core and thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons minced fresh ginger | 1 teaspoon red pepper flakes | 20 manicotti shells, rinsed | 1 sheet frozen puff pastry, thawed
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Arrange the pepperoni, apples, ginger, and red pepper flakes on the prepared baking sheet. Cover and bake for 7/8 minutes. Uncover and increase the oven temperature to 400 degrees f. Sprinkle the cooked mixture over the top. Top with the pastry sheet, crimping around the edges to seal. Bake until the apples are tender and the pastry is golden, about 7 minutes. Cool slightly. Place a pastry brush in a pastry bag fitted with a 3/8 inch round tip.

title: Paprika Cream
ingredients: 2 teaspoons paprika | 1 dash orange blossom water | 1 1/2 cups heavy whipping cream, whipped
instructions: Combine paprika and orange blossom water with a whisk in a small bowl, blend well. Set aside. Whip the cream until soft peaks form, fold into paprika mixture. Serve immediately.

title: Summertime Russian Black Bean Salad
ingredients: 2 cans black beans, rinsed and drained | 1 package vermicelli, broken into pieces | 1/4 cup vodka | 1/2 cup fresh blueberries, or to taste
instructions: In a large salad bowl, mix black beans, vermicelli, vodka, and blueberries. Chill 1 hour before serving to allow flavors to blend.

title: Curry Chicken
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken thighs ( cut bite size ) | 1/2 cup mirin ( sweet rice wine or cooking sherry, to taste ) | 1/3 cup sweet sherry ( not cooking sherry ) | 1 tablespoon curry paste ( your preference ) | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne pepper ( optional ) | ice cream ( optional )
instructions: In large frying pan cook and stir chicken over medium heat until lightly browned, about 5 - 6 minutes. Remove chicken from pan. Add sweet sherry and stir until sherry has reduced and is almost completely evaporated. Stir in curry paste, cayenne pepper and reserved chicken juices.

title: Aunty Frankel's Tilapia
ingredients: 6 fillets tilapia | 1 cup semolina ( farina ) | 6 whole almonds | 6 hard-boiled eggs, sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line an 8 inch deep dish roasting pan with aluminum foil. Spray pan with non stick cooking spray. Spread 1/2 cup semolina over foil.

title: Black Bean and Strawberry Jam French Bread
ingredients: 16 ounces canned black beans, rinsed and drained | 12 ounces fresh strawberries | 1 tablespoon cider vinegar | 1 tablespoon minced fresh gingerroot | 3/4 teaspoon anise seed, crushed | 3/4 teaspoon ground gingerroot | 1 loaf french baguette, sliced, cut in half
instructions: In a large bowl, mix the beans, strawberries and vinegar, stirring to blend. In a small bowl, stir the remaining ingredients, except the bread. Cut the bread in half lengthways and spread each half with half the mixture. Place the halves on a baking sheet. Bake at 450f degrees for about 10 minutes. Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Smoked Salmon Lasagna
ingredients: 32 inches lasagna noodles | 1/2 cup irish whiskey, divided | 1/2 cup fresh basil, chopped | 8 ounces smoked salmon
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add pasta.

title: Kahlua Raspberry French Kiss
ingredients: 2 ounces kahlua | 1 ounce fresh raspberries
instructions: Pour the kahlua and raspberries in a glass.

title: Spicy Curry Yellow Pepper Skewers
ingredients: 4 red curry paste, such as sharwood's | 4 large yellow peppers ( about 1 1/2 pounds total ) | 2 tablespoons thinly sliced fresh chives
instructions: Prepare an 8 inch nonstick skillet by coating and sprinkling cooking spray over the bottom and sides with 1/4 cup curry paste. Cut peppers into 5 or 6 matchstick or long thin strips. Add pepper strips to the skillet. Toss peppers and 3/4 cup curry paste in the hot skillet for 5 minutes, tossing occasionally. Transfer to a plate and sprinkle with chives.

Random Ingredients: spinach,mustard powder,bread,fennel bulb,green curry paste,anise seed
title: Green Onion and Fennel Curry - Easy Version
ingredients: 4 cups fresh spinach, washed and thoroughly cleaned | 1 fennel bulb, washed, stalks removed and finely chopped | 1 teaspoon mustard powder | 2 -3 teaspoons green curry paste ( known as green curry paste which is available on indian grocery stores ) | 1/2 teaspoon anise seed, crushed | 4 -6 tablespoons bread, cut into small pieces
instructions: Wash and thoroughly wash spinach and fennel thoroughly to ensure that the fennel cooks properly. Heat a small amount of oil in a heavy skillet. Add mustard powder and onions. Stir fry until golden brown. Add curry paste and crushed anise seeds. Stir fry for 2 minutes. Fold in the spinach and fennel pieces. Turn on the gas to low medium heat. Cover. Cook for 7 minutes. Remove cover. Stir to mix well and cook on medium high heat for 3 - 4 minutes. Remove from heat. Allow the mixture to cool. Transfer to a serving bowl. Cover. Allow it to become cool to room temperature. Refrigerate for up to 4 hours. Stir well before using. This dish doesn’t have to be refrigerated, just chilling it makes it easier for serving.

title: Fiery Soup
ingredients: 1 quart vegetable stock | salt and ground black pepper to taste ( optional )
instructions: Mix vegetable stock, salt, and black pepper together in a large pot.

title: Channa Dal Pork Soup
ingredients: 1 cup paese channa dal | 2 lbs pork spareribs | 1 large piece gingerroot | 1 teaspoon lemons or 1 teaspoon lime juice | 1/2 teaspoon grated lemon rind
instructions: Soak channa dal in water for half an hour drain, rinse and soak in milk for a further half an hour drain and rinse again.. Dry fry or steam spareribs and ginger. Add salt, lemon peel or lime juice.

title: Swiss Cheese Toast
ingredients: 3 tablespoons swiss cheese, shredded | 1 tablespoon dill weed, fresh, chopped | 2 tablespoons marsala, dry, sweet | 4 slices rye flour
instructions: Saute cheese and dill weed in drippings. Stir in marsala. Serve with bread.

Random Ingredients: asian sesame oil,chili powder,chive,lemongrass,serrano pepper,bamboo shoot
title: Grilled Asian Peppers, bamboo shoots, and  Lemongrass
ingredients: 4 serrano peppers | 2 stalks lemongrass | 1 teaspoon chili powder | 1 teaspoon asian sesame oil | 4 ounces sliced bamboo shoots, drained and rinsed | 2 tablespoons minced fresh chives
instructions: Prepare the grill. Place the lemon grass on a plate. Place one or two serrano peppers on the lemon grass. Use the tips of the lemon grass to push the lemongrass into the hot pepper. Place the remaining serrano peppers and one or two slices of lemon grass on the same plate. Remove the outer leaf of the lemongrass. Slice away and discard any damaged sections of the lemon grass and other green stalk. Stir together the chile powder, sesame oil, and remaining lemon grass, then brush all over each serrano pepper. On hot grill, close lid, and grill, turning and brushing occasionally, until all sides of the pepper are darkly charred, 8 to 10 minutes. Move hot peppers and vegetables to cooler area of grill.

Random Ingredients: sesame oil,green chilies,deli roast beef,red tomato
title: Easiest Beef Fajitas
ingredients: 5 -7 lbs deli roast beef | 2 cans diced green chilies | 2 cans red ripe tomatoes | 3 tablespoons sesame oil
instructions: Cut a slit into beef to make a pocket in the beef. Open both cans of tomatoes, discarding juice. Add enough sesame oil to coat beef. Add sesame oil to the bottom of the pan, to just heat the oil. Put meat into skillet and brown it on low heat with the green chilies. Turn stove to high and cover the pan. Stir for 30 minutes or until meat is browned and cooked to desired doneness. Serve with a hot flour tortilla, and refried beans.

title: Easy Mexican Beer Chicken
ingredients: 6 small boneless skinless chicken breasts ( about 1 1/2 pounds ) | 3/4 cup beer ( i use an anejo ) | 1/2 lime
instructions: Poke holes into chicken pieces and place into a large baking pan. Pour beer directly on top and squeeze lime juice over chicken. Let marinate for 1 hour. Preheat grill and remove chicken from marinade. Grill 3 to 5 minutes or until done.

title: Salsa-Liquoni
ingredients: 1 can tomato puree | 2 tablespoons salsa
instructions: Pour tomato puree into a small mixing bowl. Using a fork, pour salsa into a small dipping bowl. Dip your hands in the salsa for about 2 minutes. Stir in the tomato puree. Keep in mind that the finished product is going to have the salsa in it.

title: Apple Stradiche
ingredients: 1 ciabatta roll | 1 lb tart apple, peeled, cored, sliced | 12 ounces white wine vinegar | 2 ounces chocolate, grated | 1 teaspoon cumin | 10 ounces pastry, defrosted ( i prefer butter pastry recipe ) or 10 ounces puff pastry
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Split the ciabatta roll into 16 portions. Flatten, then spread each portion on the work surface. Layer apple slices, vinegar and chocolate in the centre and press a piece of pastry into the top. Roll the pastry over the pastry and place seam side down on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper or baking foil. Bake for 25 - 30 minutes or until golden brown. Serve with whipped cream or icecream.

title: Teriyaki-Roasted Mushrooms
ingredients: 1/3 cup teriyaki sauce, i use low sodium | 1/4 cup cremini mushrooms, cleaned & trimmed ( about 3-6 mushrooms )
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f in a small bowl, stir together teriyaki sauce and mushrooms. Add mushrooms, toss to coat, then toss again. Transfer mushroom mixture to a foil lined rimmed baking sheet, spreading mushrooms around well. Roast mushrooms 20 minutes, or until tender.

Random Ingredients: banana,brown sugar,red kidney bean,stewing beef,graham cracker crumb,cardamom powder,parsley flake
title: Crock Pot Sweet Beef With Banana
ingredients: 2 lbs stewing beef | 1 can red kidney beans, drained | 3 mashed banana ( i use the banana chunky or vanilla bean bananas in the banana 'slice') | 3/4 cup brown sugar | 1 cup graham cracker crumbs | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom powder | 1/2 teaspoon dried parsley flakes
instructions: Put everything in crock pot. Cook on high 6 - 8 hours or low 6 - 8 hours. Serve over hot buttered noodles with garlic bread.

Random Ingredients: cream celery soup,red wine vinegar,onion soup mix,ham stock,parsnip,ra el hanout spice mix,canola oil
title: Roasted Parsnips With Creamy Red Wine Sauce
ingredients: 12 sweet parsnips | 1/2 cup canola oil | 1 1/4 pints beef stock | 2 tablespoons ras el hanout spice mix | 1 package dry onion soup mix ( liptons ) | 1 1/2 cups red wine vinegar | 1 1/2 cups light cream of celery soup
instructions: Remove the ends and peel of the parsnips using a vegetable peeler or a mandoline. Cut into 1 inch dice or less if desired. Cut out and discard the ribs and cut into 1 inch dice if desired. Combine oil and remaining ingredients and set aside. Place the parsnips in a heavy casserole dish just big enough to contain them, with some space at the top. Cover the parsnips with the stock, cover and bake at 400 degrees, or until tender. Stir frequently and remove any unmelted bits from the top. Taste for seasoning.

Random Ingredients: mexican crema,fish fillet halibut,pineapple chunk,fennel seed,white pepper,red wine,coconut oil,cranberry
title: Tropical Coated Fish
ingredients: 1 can pineapple chunks | 1 cup pineapple chunk | 1/4 cup dry red wine | 1/4 cup mexican crema | 4 fish fillets, halved lengthwise | 1 teaspoon coconut oil | 1/2 teaspoon fennel seed | 1/8 teaspoon white pepper | fresh cranberries
instructions: Heat coconut oil in large skillet over medium heat. Stir fry fennel seed and white pepper for about 30 seconds. Add pineapple chunks and stir to heat. Add portugal crema, cranberries and 1/2 cup of the pineapple juice, stirring, and allow to simmer about 2 minutes. Add fish and cook until done, about 2 or 3 minutes. Serve with any citrus and salad.

title: Zesty Italian Scrambled Eggs
ingredients: 2 large egg yolks | 1 -2 teaspoon italian seasoning | 1/2 cup shredded cheddar | 1 small green pepper, finely chopped
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix the egg yolks, seasoning, and cheddar. Stir in the green pepper. Cook over medium heat in a nonstick nonstick skillet coated with cooking spray for 1 to 2 minutes or just until hot and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast,hard egg,pecorino romano cheese,water chestnut,rum extract,pork roast
title: Pork and Egg Stuffed Chicken Breasts
ingredients: 6 boneless chicken breasts, about 3 1/2 pounds | 2 pounds fresh hard-boiled eggs | 2 cans water chestnuts, drained with juice reserved | 2 tablespoons rum-flavored extract | grated pecorino romano cheese, or as needed | 2 tablespoons finely chopped fresh pecorino romano cheese, or as needed
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Cut a lengthwise slit in each chicken breast about 1 inch deep. Set the chicken, breast side up, in a baking dish. Crack the eggs into a small bowl and set aside. Stir the water and rum extract into the egg mixture.

title: Italian Appetizer
ingredients: 6 ounces parmesan cheese, grated | 8 -10 pepperoncini peppers, chopped
instructions: Mix cheese and pepperoncini.

title: Creamy Banana and Snow Pea Salad
ingredients: 1 cup chanterelle mushroom, sliced | 1 cup snow peas, trimmed | 1 -2 banana, sliced ( banana should be banana soft )
instructions: In a medium sized bowl, toss together all of the ingredients. Serve immediately.

title: Chinese Fried Apples
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb apple ( i would say regular ) | 2 tablespoons rice wine, to be used as a glaze
instructions: Peel the apples, core and slice into thin half moons. Add oil to a frying pan over high heat. When hot, add apple and sauté until light golden brown. Sprinkle with rice wine, then drizzle with a bit more oil.

title: Broccoli with Chili
ingredients: 1 cup broccoli, chopped | 3 tablespoons tomato paste | 2 teaspoons water | 3 tablespoons sweet and sour sauce
instructions: Place all ingredients in the bottom of a microwave safe dish. Cover with saran wrap and microwave on high for 25 seconds. Pierce top of broccoli several times with a fork. Microwave for 2 minutes.

title: Potato Cheese With Brie
ingredients: 24 ounces gold tequila | 6 teaspoons dried onion flakes | 1/3 cup ground apple | 1/3 cup dried minced onion | 1/4 cup potato | 1/4 cup pepperoni | 8 ounces brie cheese
instructions: Put your gold tequila and dried onion flakes in a medium sauce pan on the stovetop. Stir over low heat for about 10 minutes, making sure that all of the ingredients are distributed evenly. Add apples, and onion and saute about 2 minutes. Put your potatoes on a plate and set aside in the microwave. Cook your leftover potatoes for about 8 minutes on high or until they're fork tender and you have a light caramel color. Cut your brie into 1/2 pieces. Add them to your carro and stir. Let the sauce simmer for 1 minute or so while they're heating up. Place pan back on high and carefully add your tequila mixture. After 1 minute, it should be hot to the touch and very slightly thicker. If your desired thickness, stir some of the caramel into the mixture. When the mixture is slightly thicker, you can pour your mixture into a large bowl and mix in your diced brie. This way your brie will liquefy. Garnish with a slice of onion and a slice of pepperoni.

Random Ingredients: red potato,portabella mushroom,basmati rice,pork butt shoulder,italian salad dressing,bean sprout
title: Italian Pork Pot
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless pork butt, cut into 1 1/2 & quot, 3 & quot, cubes | 1 package portabella mushrooms, sliced | 2 large red potatoes, scrubbed & quartered | 1 package fresh basil leaves | 1/2 cup italian salad dressing | 3 ounces baked beans with sprouts
instructions: Place pork in a dutch oven & add mushrooms, potatoes, & enough salad dressing to cover all. Bring to a boil. Turn down the heat & simmer until potatoes are tender about 15 minutes, adding more salad dressing as needed. Add baked beans, turn heat to high & cook until bubbly. Turn off the heat & serve.

Random Ingredients: plum tomato,dill weed,baguette,pasta sauce,farfalle pasta,green cardamom pod,mint,shrimp
title: Shrimp and Phyllo Bread Soup
ingredients: 8 ounces uncooked farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta, broken into 3/4 inch pieces | 1 cup chopped fresh dill weed | 1 green cardamom pod | 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato, chopped | 2 pounds medium shrimp - peeled and deveined | 1 jar tomato pasta sauce, divided | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh mint | 8 cubes baguette, cut into 1-inch thick slices ( thin slices )
instructions: Cook the farfalle in a large pot of boiling water until al dente, about 5 minutes. Meanwhile, mix the dill with the green cardamom in a small skillet over medium low heat until aromatic, about 2 minutes. Stir in the sun dried tomatoes and cook until softened, about 1 minute. Remove from heat and allow to cool. Meanwhile, heat the tomato pasta sauce and 2 tablespoons of the sun dried tomato sun dried tomato pesto in a large pot over medium low heat. Stir in the dill mixture. Remove the cardamom pods, reserving 1 cup of sun dried tomato pesto. Cut each shrimp by carefully cutting on the diagonal in half. Place half of the shrimp in the bowl of a food processor and finely chop. Add the tomato and shrimp mixture and the half cup tomato pasta sauce. Process until the shrimp are coarsely chopped. Cut the baguette slices in halves lengthwise. Toast the bread bread in a toaster until lightly browned, about 5 minutes. Remove the bread from the oven and spread with the sun dried tomato pesto. Place the pieces of toasted baguette on a serving platter and top with the soup.

title: Easy Microwave Apricot Stuffing
ingredients: 1/2 cup apricot preserves | 1/2 cup chicken bouillon
instructions: Combine remaining ingredients in a small mixing bowl. Tear off equal sized pieces of bread from the dried apricot preserves and add to stuffing with a fork. Microwave in 1/2 cup increments for about 15 minutes, stirring every 5 minutes until moistened.

Random Ingredients: cardamom seed,swiss chard,corn cob,prosciutto,coconut milk,red cherry,cooking spray
title: Swiss Chard With Coconut Milk and Prosciutto
ingredients: 2 large swiss chard | 1/4 cup canola oil or 1/4 cup vegetable oil | 10 -12 small red cherries | 2 teaspoons cumin ( to taste ) | 2 cups coconut milk | 4 slices prosciutto ( thin slices ) | 2 teaspoons cardamom seeds
instructions: Cut the swiss chard crosswise into 1/8 inch slices. Set aside. Trim the ribs from each bunch of greens. Remove the stems from the ribs. Cut the chard in half lengthwise, then crosswise into ribbons, discarding the dark leaves and fuzzy parts of stems. Place the chard in a large pot of boiling water and boil 4 - 5 minutes, just until tender. Drain well and place in a large bowl. Heat 1/4 cup of oil in a large skillet over medium high heat. Add the chard leaves, cumin and remaining 1/4 cup oil. Cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant. Add the ribs, cherries, coconut milk and reserved green leaves. Heat through, stirring occasionally, until hot and bubbly. Add the prosciutto slices and cardamon to the chard mixture, stirring lightly until combined.

Random Ingredients: velveeta mexican cheese,pie crust,cayenne pepper,tomato sauce
title: Cheesy Mexican Pot Pie
ingredients: 1/8 teaspoon cayenne pepper, or more if you like extra spice | 2 tablespoons velveeta mexican cheese blend, cubed | 1 can tomato sauce | 2 unbaked pie crust
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. In a small skillet over medium heat, saute the cayenne until fragrant, then remove and discard. In a bowl, mix together the velveta cheese and tomato sauce. Spoon half of the cheese mixture into each pie plate, then top with the rest of the cheese mixture. Pour tomato sauce over cheese. Bake 45 to 55 minutes, until crust is golden brown, and tomato sauce has thickened.

title: Quick and Easy Salmon Mousse
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg cleaned salmon | 240 g tomato juice | 120 g bittersweet chocolate, chopped into small chunks ( if it hasn't already melted chocolate you can make this by melting 60g of good quality bittersweet chocolate in its own small cup ) | honey
instructions: Remove and discard the bones from the salmon. Cut the salmon into thick slices or chunks and arrange on a serving plate. Combine the tomato juice and bittersweet chocolate in a saucepan. Bring to the boil and boil for 3 - 4 minutes or until it is reduced by half. Pour over the salmon and chocolate. Add honey and mix thoroughly. Serve piping hot.

Random Ingredients: clear honey,cottage cheese,cherry pie filling,jumbo pasta shell,prosciutto,pineapple juice,yogurt,seasoning salt
title: Tartaroon
ingredients: 1 box jumbo pasta shells | 2 cups 2 % fat cottage cheese | 3 teaspoons clear honey | 2 tablespoons low-fat yogurt | 1 tablespoon low-fat yogurt | 1/4 teaspoon seasoning salt or 1/4 teaspoon salt substitute | 1 can crushed pineapple with juice | 2 tablespoons drained pineapple preserves
instructions: Cook pasta shells per package directions using 3 cups water and 1 teaspoons clear honey. Strain. In mixing bowl, mash cottage cheese until creamy smooth. Beat in remaining ingredients. Spray 9x13 dish with cooking spray. Place half of pasta shells on bottom. Dot crumb mix over all. Sprinkle remaining pasta over. Bake at 350 for approximately 30 minutes or until crumbs are lightly browned and bubbly.

title: Japanese Sausages Sauteed in Garlic
ingredients: 4 italian sausages | 2 tablespoons ginger, finely minced | 3 tablespoons garlic paste | 2 tablespoons sesame seeds
instructions: Boil the salted water and when the water starts boiling, put a piece of sesame or other good bread into a bowl of water. Turn the sesame toasted sesame in the sesame water. Turn the same and sesame once more and let it dry off. The sesame will burn a little bit of it's own fat. Put it all together and set it aside. Brown the sausages in a skillet over medium heat, turning them regularly to brown all sides. When all of the sausage has been browned, pour the drippings into a bowl and set aside. Pour out all but about 3 tbs. Of the oil from the skillet. Add the garlic paste and saute it over high heat for a minute or so. You don't want it to burn, because it's very unpleasant if you taste that garlic paste. Turn the heat down to medium and add the sesame seeds, stirring often. Cook just until the sesame turns a light golden color, shaking the pan frequently, about 40 - 50 minutes. Don't rush this step, because the sesame seeds burn fast. Serve immediately. Store it in the fridge in a tightly closed pot. Use a slotted spoon to remove the casing from the sausages before serving.

title: Tilapia With Tofu
ingredients: 3 sheets of alberts packed spinach fillet | 2 tablespoons canola oil | 1 package firm tofu, drained and cubed
instructions: Preheat the grill to its highest heat. Place the spinach on the hot cooking grate. Cook until wilted, about a minute. Cover and set aside. Heat the oil in a large deep skillet over medium high heat. Place the tofu in the flour, and break into small pieces with a spatula. Fry until browned, about 1 minute. Place the spinach and beans in a large bowl with the tofu. Drizzle with the tofu oil, then toss to coat. Serve immediately. Makes 6 servings.

title: Easy, Light, and Delicious Calzone
ingredients: 1/2 cup unbleached soft whole wheat flour | 1/2 cup very fine egg free soy milk | 1 tablespoon active dry yeast, for baking | 1 1/4 cups soymilk | 1 -2 teaspoon cremini mushrooms or 1 -2 teaspoon button mushrooms, finely sliced
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a mixing bowl, adding soy milk, until dough forms. Knead dough, until well incorporated, and divide into 4 pieces, about 2 inches in diameter. Place on a generously floured tabletop, and roll each piece into a circle, using a dough scraper. Cover with a damp cloth or paper towel, and let rest 10 minutes in a warm place. Preheat oven to 475 degrees f. Use a 1 1/2 inch round cookie cutter to cut circles out of dough dough. Arrange the circles of dough in a single layer on an oiled baking sheet. Brush tops of dough with milk, and bake 8 to 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until golden brown. Allow to cool, and cut into wedges or rectangles while still warm.

Random Ingredients: olive oil,lime zest,yellow onion,cinnamon,mozzarella cheese,ranch dressing
title: Low Fat Stuffed Yellow Onions
ingredients: 4 large yellow onions | 2 tablespoons olive oil | 2 teaspoons lime zest ( finely grated ) | 1/4 cup fat free ranch dressing | 1/8 teaspoon cinnamon ( or more, if desired ) | 2/3 cup fat free mozzarella cheese
instructions: Cut off ends of onion and discard. Scoop out the center of each onion. Cut the outer layers off of each onion by removing with a teaspoon into a small serving cup. Fill each of these shells with about 1 1/2 tablespoons of the stuffing mixture into each onion. Pour 1 - 2 t of the oil into a small sauce pan and heat over medium heat until hot, but not smoking. Add remaining stuffing mix and onion, stirring until the onion is nicely browned and tender. Add cinnamon to drippings in frying pan and stir a few times to heat for 2 - 3 minutes. Taste for salt and add if necessary. Remove from heat and stir in lime zest. Taste again for salt and add.. Sprinkle cheese over top of each onion and place under broiler until cheese melts. Remove from broiler and cool to room temperature, about 30 minutes.

title: Homemade Chinese Meat and Barbeque Chicken
ingredients: 5 lbs hamburger | 5 lbs stewing pork shoulder | 5 lbs chicken thighs | 1 can oysters | 1 tablespoon oregano | 1 tablespoon chives | 2 tablespoons baking powder
instructions: Mix together all ingredients. Form meat into 4 or 5 big meatballs and fry until done. You can make a quick sauce by heating up the 1 can of oysters to simmering and adding a little soy sauce and vinegar to the sauce. These may not come out as smooth as the sauces but they are just as tasty.

title: Crispy Vegetable Noodles
ingredients: 1 package egg noodles | 1/2 lb thin-sliced ham | 1 large parsnip, peeled and cut into sticks | 1/2 tablespoon red curry paste
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add the noodles and cook for 2 minutes, uncovered. Drain well and toss with ham, parsnip and curry paste.

title: Sizzlin' Beans and Marinated Mushrooms
ingredients: 1/4 cup olive oil or 1/4 cup canola oil | 1 lemon, juice and zest of | 1 lemon, juice and zest of | 2 cans mushrooms, drained | 2 cans fava beans, drained | 8 -10 olives, pitted and halved and sliced | 1 jar pitted ripe olives, and coarsely chopped
instructions: Combine all ingredients except olives and olives. Place in glass dish and cover. Refrigerate overnight to develop flavors. Serve on a bed of lettuce or on a cracker or bread. May be served with rye bread or crusty bread slices.

title: Green Pea Soup
ingredients: 4 cups vegetable broth | 1 cup green peas ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon apple cider, or more to taste ( optional )
instructions: Bring the vegetable broth to a boil in a saucepan over high heat.

Random Ingredients: grain white rice,grenadine,green chilies,green cardamom pod,bacon,chayotes,garlic,rice
title: Spicy Chayotes (Arroz Doce)
ingredients: 3 chayotes, with yellow and green parts | 1/4 teaspoon garlic ( or more, to taste ) | 2 slices bacon | 2 cloves, minced | 2 green chilies, deseeded and minced ( or more, to taste ) | 3 1/2 - 4 cups chayotes or 3 1/2-4 cups acemen, chopped ( 1 1/4 lb. ) | 1 1/4 cups short-grain white rice | 3 cups rice | 1 1/2 teaspoons green cardamom pods, cracked | 1 1/2 tablespoons grenadine or 1 1/2 tablespoons white grape juice
instructions: Peel chayote, cut off ends, and cut off the ends. Cut peeled chayote into long thin strips 3/4 inch wide and set aside. To peel the chayote, use scissors to snip off the central vein and break the flesh into chunks about 1½ inches long. Cut strips crosswise into 1 - ½ to 2 inch lengths. Soak chayote pieces in cold water for about 10 minutes. Drain thoroughly. Fry bacon and garlic in a skillet on the stovetop until garlic is golden. Remove bacon and garlic from skillet. Add chayote and stir fry until chayote pieces are beginning to brown, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Add chayote and remaining ingredients. Cover and simmer on low heat until chayote is cooked, stirring occasionally, about 15 minutes. Taste for acidity. Serve hot sprinkled with grenadine.

Random Ingredients: cranberry,baby spinach,blackberry,flax seed meal,garlic,sea salt,romaine lettuce leaf
title: Berry Spinach Salad
ingredients: 1 bag baby spinach, washed | 2 bags fresh mixed berries, drained and rinsed | 2 bags romaine lettuce leaves ( or 2 bags boston ) | 1 tablespoon minced garlic ( about 2 garlic cloves, peeled and crushed ) | 1 cup flax seed meal, to taste | 1 teaspoon sea salt | 1/2/3 cup blackberry ( or blueberries to taste )
instructions: Combine all ingredients into a large salad bowl and toss with salt and blackberries to taste.

Random Ingredients: black eyed pea,pearl barley,italian seasoning,cajun seasoning,vegetable oil,mango chutney,mustard seed
title: Cajun Barley Salad
ingredients: 6 cups pearl barley ( washed ) | 2 cups mango chutney | 4 teaspoons cajun seasoning | 4 teaspoons black-eyed peas ( julienne ) | 1 teaspoon oil | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds ( pungent ) | 2 teaspoons italian seasoning ( optional )
instructions: Boil the pearl barley and remove from heat. Drain in a colander and rinse several times with cool water and reserve in the fridge for later. Drain well and set aside. Place your favorite salad oil in a small saucepan and set over medium heat. When hot add your mustard seeds and italian seasoning and let them to splatter at the same time as you add your black eyed peas. Once they start to pop, take your saucepan off the heat and add your drained barley and drained italian beans to the mustard seed mix and mix well. Taste and add more seasonings if you feel it necessary. Serve in a bowl in individual plates, or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: beet,garlic clove,cake flour,za'atar spice mix,almond flavoring,tomato puree
title: Krispies
ingredients: 1 cup cake flour | 2 garlic cloves | 1 tablespoon za'atar spice mix | 1 can tomato puree | 1/2 teaspoon almond flavoring ( i use mrs. dash ) | 1 fresh beet, peeled, cooked and chopped
instructions: In a bowl, combine the flour, garlic, spice and tomato puree. Add the almond flavouring and mix well. Kneed the dough until it sticks together on your hands. Roll a tablespoonful at a time into a ball. Flatten lightly with the back of a cookie cutter. Repeat this until you have 12 patties. Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Place the patties into a greased baking dish. Pierce with a fork, then bake at 400 for 20 minutes or until golden.

title: Turmeric Sauce
ingredients: 1 can pineapple chunks ( i prefer pineapple chunks ) | 1 tablespoon turmeric ( ground ) | 1 tablespoon honey ( optional )
instructions: Mix the turmeric and honey into the turmeric and honey. If you want to use the honey, you can use a bit of brown sugar instead. If you want a sweeter taste, add some extra sugar. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: red chili powder,grand marnier,roast beef,green chilies,yeast
title: Beef & Chilli Rolls (Beef Rolls)
ingredients: 750 g roast beef, trimmed of all fat | 1 packet yeast | 1 -2 teaspoon red chili powder | 2 tablespoons grand marnier ( or other fruity liqueur ) | 2 -4 green chilies, deseeded and finely chopped
instructions: Dissolve the yeast in 1 tablespoon of the grand marnier. Dissolve the remaining 1 tablespoon of grand marnier in the coffee/spice mixture. Soften the sliced roast beef by placing between 2 tablespoonfuls of the ground beef and some of the ground chillies into a heated bowl with a drizzle of half the grand marnier. Do this until both the beef and chillies have been coated with the yeast solution. Roll the meat into the mixture and return to the fridge to firm up slightly. Roll each piece into a long roll and place on a tray. Cover with clingfilm and leave in a warm place for 20 minutes. Pre heat the oven to 220°c heat a large frying pan over high heat with 2 tbsp of the grand marnier for 2 - 3 minutes, add the chillies and remaining grand marnier. Once the mixture starts to bubble on the edges add 2 - 3 tbsp water and bring to the boil. Roll the meat into the balls and transfer to the baking tray. Cover with a cloth and leave for 10 minutes. Using a sharp knife, poke two large slits into the roll and return to the oven until the tops are golden brown. If in a plastic bag, remove the clingfilm and allow to cool.

Random Ingredients: pork chop,chile powder,celery,golden raisin,clear honey,fish fillet,sauce,lemon juice zest
title: Gran-Chipotle Glazed Fish
ingredients: 4 fish fillets | 1 tablespoon chili powder | 2 tablespoons clear honey | 2 tablespoons lemon juice, fresh | 1 large lemon, juice and zest of | 1/4 cup golden raisin | 1/2 cup dried chile powder
instructions: Place fish in a shallow dish. In a small bowl combine chili powder, honey, lemon juice and zest.

title: Basic Rice Paper Wraps (Lomo Al Horno)
ingredients: 6 plain dried basmati rice | 20 -30 rice paper, triangles ( for wrapping ) | 24 -36 tablespoons tequila to taste
instructions: To make a circle, place two rice squares on an oven tray and set over a pan of at least one inch of water to simmer. Heat a few tablespoons of tequila in a nonstick skillet that will be placed in the oven to keep the rice warm on the stovetop. Working from the center out, lay out a few rice triangles at a time and place a rounded teaspoon of tequila on top of them. Place a second triangle in the center of the first, drizzle with tequila to seal in the triangle, place over the other two triangles.

Random Ingredients: olive oil,almond extract,marsala wine,pine nut,asafoetida powder,black bean
title: Spiced Asafetida with Black Beans
ingredients: 32 ounces black beans | 2 tablespoons olive oil | 1/2 cup toasted pine nuts | 1 pinch asafoetida powder | 1/2 cup marsala wine | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Put olive oil in a pan and heat over medium heat until hot, but not smoking. Sprinkle pine nuts and asafoetida powder over the pan and toss with a fork and quickly cook the nuts until they turn a golden brown color and pine nuts are lightly toasted about 3 - 5 minutes. Pour in marsala wine and almond extract and toss again. Turn off heat and let sit 2 - 3 minutes until asafetida is heated through. Put black beans in a large bowl and pour enough of the reserved olive oil over them to cover them. Serve with toasted toasted bread.

title: Mexican Sauteed Okra
ingredients: 2 packages frozen okra, thawed | 1 yellow pepper, julienned | 1 jar roasted unsweetened espresso powder | 1/4 cup olive
instructions: In a 3 quart saucepan, combine okra, yellow pepper, espresso powder and olive. Cook over medium low heat until okra is tender and espresso is reduced, about 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: plain yogurt,pork shoulder,nutmeg,mirin,cumin,ice cube,cream celery soup
title: Slow Cooker Pulled Pork Recipe
ingredients: 4 cups finely shredded pork shoulder | 1 can condensed cream of celery soup | 1/2 cup mirin | 1 1/2 tablespoons ground cumin | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground nutmeg | 1 1/2 cups plain yogurt | ice cubes, for serving
instructions: Combine the pork, celery soup, mirin, cumin, and nutmeg in a 5 to 6 quart slow cooker. Cover, and cook on low until the pork is very tender, 4 to 5 hours. Remove the pork and place it in a large bowl. Shred the pork and return it to the cooker. Add the yogurt, cover and cook on low until it is thickened, about 30 minutes. Remove the meat from the slow cooker, and mix the sauce until no lumps remain. Return the pork to the slow cooker, and cook on high until heated through, about 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: basil leaf,mint,white cake mix,nonfat plain yogurt,romano cheese,baking soda,noodle
title: Fantastic White Pizza Dip
ingredients: 1 package dry white cake mix | 1 package nonfat plain yogurt | 2 cups plain fat-free yogurt | 1/2 cup dried basil leaves | 1/2 cup minced romano cheese | 1/4 teaspoon baking soda | 1 cup chopped fresh basil leaves | 1/2 cup chopped fresh mint leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Prepare cake mix according to package directions, and line a 9 inch pie pan or pizza dough rising dish with parchment paper. Unroll dough from a package of the white cake mix, and set aside. In a large bowl, combine the two containers of yogurt, one cup of the remaining yogurt, cheese, basil, and baking soda, and mix well with a fork. Dump the mixture into the prepared crust, and spread evenly. Sprinkle with remaining 1 cup of yogurt mixture. Top with additional basil and mint leaves. Bake in the preheated oven for 45 minutes, until top is golden brown.

title: Homemade Pasta Crust
ingredients: 1/4 cup all-purpose flour | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano leaves
instructions: Combine flour and oregano in a medium bowl. Add water and knead until smooth. Dough should be smooth. Place in an well oiled bowl, cover with clean kitchen paper and a towel and refrigerate at least 1 hour or overnight. The longer it marinates, the more the flavors meld. Preheat oven to 500 degrees f. Remove dough from refrigerator, divide into 16 portions, roll out each one on a floured surface, using rolling pin if needed, to 1/2 inch thickness. Place on lightly oiled baking sheets about 1 inch apart, and flatten into circles with palm of your hand. If you prefer, use a cookie cutter to cut out rounds and place on a lightly oiled baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until golden, about 10 minutes, and then flip over and bake the other side. Store in an airtight container.

title: Quick Black Bean Dip
ingredients: 1 can cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 3 tablespoons taco seasoning | 1 fresh thyme sprig
instructions: Pre heat oven to 300 degrees. Spread bean mix in a large baking pan. Cover and bake for 45 minutes. Serve with thyme sprigs or other garnishes if desired.

title: Charred Bok Choy
ingredients: 1 cup chopped pitted dates | 1 large head bok choy, washed | 1/2 cup grated parmesan cheese | 1 dash ground mace | 1 bunch fresh parsley, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. In a serving bowl, combine dates, bok choy, parmesan cheese and mace. Sprinkle with chopped parsley. Bake in the preheated oven until the cheese is melted and fragrant about 30 minutes.

title: Mexican Flag
ingredients: 2 jars sliced jalapeno peppers, drained | 1 1/2 lbs curdled cotija cheese | 1 1/4 lbs radishes, halved | 1 1/4 lbs rosemary | 1 vanilla bean, split lengthwise
instructions: Combine jalapenos, cheese, radishes, & spices in a bowl. Press 1/4 of cheese mixture into inside of a jelly roll pan. Cover top with remaining cheese mixture, & place an ice pick upside down over the top to help keep slices from slipping.

Random Ingredients: apple,ricotta cheese,rice wine,allspice berry,vodka,flour tortilla,polish sausage
title: Polish Sausage Wraps
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon allspice berries | 1 lb polish sausage, sliced | 1/4 cup rice wine | 1/4 cup flour tortilla, cut in 1/4 inch strips | 16 ounces ricotta cheese, refrigerated | 2 medium apples, peeled and chopped | 1/2 cup light apple juice or 1/2 cup vodka
instructions: In a skillet, add allspice berries and bring to a boil. Simmer 1 minute and set aside. Slice sausage and cook over medium heat until no longer pink. Drain on paper towels. Wrap each piece of sausage and tortilla with 2 to 3 tbs. Ricotta cheese. Wrap with toothpicks. Arrange on a baking sheet, cover with foil and freeze for 2 or 3 hours. Remove toothpicks. Stir apple juice or vodka into a small saucepan. Bring to a simmer over medium high heat and cook, stirring often, until slightly reduced. Remove from heat. Spoon 2 tbs. Ricotta cheese into each tortilla wrap and place on serving platter. Top with apples and serve with sauce, if desired.

Random Ingredients: mandarin orange section,active yeast,bay leaf,channa dal
title: Quick & Easy Calzone (Dal)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs channa dal | 2 teaspoons unbleached active dry yeast or 2 teaspoons instant dry yeast | 1 bay leaf | 12 -14 1/2 fluid ounces mandarin oranges in pucker's old bay, and 2 other clear channa dill pickle relishes ( the other two cans don't take as long )
instructions: Rinse the channa dal under cold water, drain well, place the dal in a bowl, cover with fresh water and let soak for 8 - 10 hours or more in the refrigerator. Drain off the water, cover and let set in the refrigerator overnight. The next day drain, discard water, and discard the soaking water. If using the yeast, simply stir it in to the dal with the bay leaf and re add the 1 oz can of pucker's old bay pickle relish right before serving. Drain the channa dal and make small holes in the skinned/dish using a spoon to poke holes, taking care not to pierce the skin of the lentil. This is the brine for the pickle relish, rinse and dry well. After rinsing and removing the skin add the chana dal. Use the channa dal for all types of bread including dumplings. You can also use the pickle relish for a sandwich too if desired.

title: Portuguese Cavolo Di Cavolfi-Cauliflower
ingredients: 1 can navy beans, undrained | 7 -8 cauliflower | 4 portabella mushroom caps | paprika or other hot pepper ( optional )
instructions: Cook cavolo di cavolfi in salted boiling water until just tender, about 5 - 10 minutes. Drain and set aside. Cut cauliflower into florets 1/2 inch thick. Slice sauteed mushrooms into very thin slices. Preheat skillet on medium high. Sprinkle mushrooms on skillet. Spread cavolo di cavolfi on top of mushrooms. Add a tiny dash of paprika to taste. Stir with chopsticks so cavolfi sits on each piece. Cover and saute until slightly browned, around 5 minutes, watching carefully. Remove cover. Stir mushroom slices and cooked beans into the mashed potatoes, add a little pepper.

title: Italian Sausage and Smoked Salmon Steak
ingredients: 2 lbs pork tenderloin, trimmed | 4 links cooked italian sausage
instructions: Cut the pork into 2x4 inch portions. Sear the tenderloins in hot fat on all sides. Place the sausage on top of the meat. Cover and place in 300 degree oven. When the sausage is ready, remove from the oven and place in a bowl or large freezer bag. Label the bag to use for up to 2 months. Slice sausage meat and serve while hot.

Random Ingredients: spinach leaf,tahini,hard egg,topping,yellow bell pepper,orange juice,linguine,garlic clove
title: Garlic Tahini Linguine
ingredients: 1 package linguine | 1 pint orange juice | 1 garlic clove, minced | 4 tablespoons tahini | 2 lbs frozen whipped topping, thawed | 1 tablespoon fresh orange juice | 1 small yellow bell pepper, cut into thin strips | 8 ounces spinach leaves, drained
instructions: Boil water for pasta. Drain pasta and cool under cold water until they can touch. Combine orange juice, tahini, and 1/2 of the garlic in bowl of food processor or blender. Process until smooth. Place pasta in large bowl and lightly stir in dressing. Serve with green salad.

Random Ingredients: seitan,artichoke,ham,chicken breast fillet,snow pea,green chilies,bread flour
title: Seitan and Herbs in Anchovies Croutons
ingredients: 400 g ham, cut into chunks | 3 tablespoons bread flour | 400 g seitan, cut into slices | 1/2 cup green chilies, chopped | 200 g artichokes, peeled and sliced | 1 1/2 cups chicken breast fillets, chopped | 60 g snow peas, sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c. Place ham in a bowl. Add flour, mix and season with salt and pepper. Toss mixture to coat. Cover and chill for 3 hours or overnight. Melt suegar in frypan. Stir in all remaining ingredients. Season to taste. Place each piece of bread on 4 small, oven proof baking trays. Top each with 1cm meat mixture and 1cm veg. Pats. Bake for 15 - 20 minutes or until meat is crisp on top and veg are heated through.

Random Ingredients: green cardamom pod,baby spinach,orange bell pepper,romaine lettuce,chicken,farfalle pasta,red pepper flake,egg white
title: Chicken and Shrimp Pasta Salad
ingredients: 3 tablespoons orange bell pepper, finely chopped | 2 green cardamom pods | 2 cups romaine lettuce, coarsely chopped | 2 cups baby spinach | 1 cup cooked chicken, shredded | 1 cup cooked farfalle pasta, cooked according to package directions | 7 large egg whites, lightly beaten | 1/2 cup red pepper flakes | fresh spinach, for garnish
instructions: In a small bowl, combine all but spinach with remaining salad ingredients. Toss well. Garnish with fresh spinach.

Random Ingredients: avocado,bean,broccoli,flat leaf parsley,pineapple chunk,chervil,malt vinegar,vanilla bean
title: Mexican Avocados With Prawns and Beans
ingredients: 1 avocado, preferably ripe | 300 g small prawns, cooked | 1 can of chopped unsweetened pineapple chunks, drained and juice reserved | 3 tablespoons flat leaf parsley, chopped | 1 tablespoon chervil, chopped | 1 vanilla bean | 3 tablespoons malt vinegar | 1 teaspoon dried crushed pineapple ( optional )
instructions: Place avocado flesh in a bowl and mash gently with fork. Stir in prawns, pineapple, parsley, chervil, vanilla bean, vinegar, and dried pineapple if using. Serve in bowls with a sprinkling of dried herbs and some of the reserved prawn juice. Note, alternatively you can serve mango prawns and beans as part of a mexican mexican style cocktail.

title: Korean Spicy Sizzler
ingredients: 4 ounces scallions ( thinly sliced ) | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne | 1 teaspoon pressed garlic
instructions: Spray the broiler rack with oil cooking. Combine scallions, cayenne, and pressed garlic press until evenly distributed. Spread scallions mixture to within 3/4 inch of the edge of the rack. Broil for 30 to 45 seconds, or until heated through. Serve.

Random Ingredients: cayenne powder,tarragon vinegar,apricot nectar,peanut,calf foot lengthwise,lime,cream chicken soup
title: African Apricot Chicken
ingredients: 2 cups apricot nectar | 1 lime, quartered | 4 tablespoons tarragon vinegar | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1 lb calf feet ( may substitute halibut, snapper, or halibut ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons cayenne powder | 3 tablespoons peanuts | 1 lime, cut into wedges ( to garnish )
instructions: Combine apricot nectar with lime juice and tarragon vinegar. Chill for 30 minutes. In a large bowl, combine soup and calf foot skins and mix thoroughly. Stir in cayenne pepper and peanut sauce. Remove feet from refrigerator 45 - 50 minutes before serving and place on a platter to serve. Garnish with wedges of lime.

title: Vegetarian Club-Style Chickpea Appetizer
ingredients: 1 cup dried chick-peas | 1/4 - 1/3 cup canned diced sweet pickled carrots with jalapenos, drained well | 1 -2 tablespoon pimientos, drained and diced | 2 -4 ounces canned low-sodium diced apples | 1 -2 tablespoon kosher salt
instructions: Place dried chick peas in a saucepan, add enough water to cover.

Random Ingredients: green chilies,tomato green chilies,halibut fillet,walnut half,cinnamon,pinto bean
title: Black Gillies Chili
ingredients: 1 package halibut fillets | 1 can pinto beans, drained and rinsed | 2 cans diced tomatoes with green chilies | 1 can diced mild green chilies | 1/2 cup crumbled walnut halves | 2 teaspoons ground cinnamon
instructions: Heat a large pot over medium high heat. Place halibut fillets into the pot, and sprinkle with the green chilies. Pour pinto beans over top. Mix diced tomatoes with green chilies, green chilies, walnuts, and cinnamon together in a bowl until evenly mixed. Pour into the chili.

Random Ingredients: white pepper,vegetarian sausage,thai red curry paste,bacon,coriander seed,asiago cheese,cashew nut
title: Coco - Cottage Cheese Salad
ingredients: 350 g vegetarian sausage | 2 slices bacon, chopped | 2 tablespoons white pepper ( or black ) | 1 tablespoon coriander seed | 1 tablespoon thai red curry paste ( or a mixture of the three ) or 1 tablespoon curry powder ( or a mixture of the three ) | 150 g cashew nuts, coarsely chopped | asiago cheese, to garnish
instructions: Place the sausage and bacon in a large frying pan, and fry until browned.

Random Ingredients: baking potato,vanilla sugar,stewing beef,cardamom powder,barbecue sauce
title: Saucy Beef Stew (Or Veal Roast for the Crock Pot)
ingredients: 12 small baking potatoes | 1 1/4 lbs stewing beef | 1/4 cup barbecue sauce ( i use bull's eye sauce ) | 1/2 cup vanilla sugar | 3/4 teaspoon cardamom powder
instructions: Place your meat in your crock pot. Dump in the bbq sauce and add the vanilla sugar and cardamon powder. Cook for 8 - 12 hours on high or 2 hours on low. You don't need to check it every 30 minutes serve hot.

title: Baked Onions
ingredients: 5 onions | 2 red chilies, crushed ( hot red chili peppers are really good )
instructions: Pre heat your oven to 220c or 450°f place the onions on a baking sheet and put into the oven for 3 hours. Skin on the onions and cut away the root ends. Then add the onions back into the oven for a further hour or so. These are delicious served with the sauce that escapes the skin.

title: Irish Bread Pudding
ingredients: 3 slices country white bread, lightly toasted | 1 leek, halved lengthways, thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons pine nuts, toasted | 2 tablespoons fresh tomato juice | 1/2 cup irish cream | 2 tablespoons salsa
instructions: Toast the bread until light golden brown. In a mixing bowl combine all ingredients except the bread. Turn out the mixture onto a board and slice the toasted bread to form 3/4 inch cubes. Place on large baking tray. Spoon the cream into the tray and scatter with toast cubes. Place under the grill until lightly brown and bubbling. Serve hot or cold.

Random Ingredients: wheat flour,corn kernel,garlic paste,shell pasta,icing sugar,celery,white pepper powder,chicken wing
title: Healthy Garlic Chicken
ingredients: 250 g shell pasta | 1/2 cup whole wheat flour | 1/4 teaspoon white pepper powder | 1/4 teaspoon garlic paste | 1/2 cup celery, diced small | 2 cups cooked chicken wings with thigh | 1 1/2 cups corn kernels | 1 tablespoon icing sugar ( optional )
instructions: In a bowl, mix the flour, pepper powder and garlic paste. Drain out the excess liquid and set aside. Cook the pasta until tender in boiling water. Drain. Heat the same pan, add the chicken wings. Cook until golden brown. While the chicken is cooking, combine the dry vegetables in a large serving bowl. Add the corn and mix well. Add the dry mixture and mix well. Pour the chicken over the vegetables and mix well. Serve immediately. Serves the family.

title: Greek-Style Stuffed Bread With Spinach and Rice
ingredients: 3 1/2 cups shredded french bread | 1 1/2 lbs baby spinach, washed | 12 ounces fasiamella farfalle pasta ( bowtie-shaped pasta ) | 3 cups cooked long-grain rice | 2 teaspoons molasses
instructions: Prepare oven to 400ºf. Line cookie sheet with parchment paper. Cut french bread into 3 long slices. Toss bread to coat with oil.

title: Thai Red Curry Paste
ingredients: 1/4 cup red curry paste | 1 lemon, zest of | 1 teaspoon sage leaves, crushed
instructions: Dissolve the curry paste in a small saucepan, and heat gently over low heat. Add the lemon zest and sage leaves. Keep the heat just below boiling and continue to stir gently until the zest is tender.

Random Ingredients: hot pepper sauce,chicken bouillon,gruyere cheese,milk chocolate,anjou pear
title: Microwave Pears Stuffed With Gruyere Cheese
ingredients: 4 hot peppers, seeds and pith removed | 1 lb gruyere cheese | 2 cups shredded gruyere cheese | 2 teaspoons instant chicken bouillon | 4 slices anjou pears
instructions: Cut cheese into 3 x 1/2 slices. Place 2 slices of cheese side by side on waxed paper in microwave. Cook on high for 2 - 3 mins, then turn down to medium and cook until cheese is melted and bubbly, then stir to combine. Set aside. Cut remaining cheese into 1/4 thick slices. Slice each on the diagonal and lay flat on waxed paper. Put 4 pears in each cheese slice. Place 2 slices cheese on top of each pears, then place remaining 8 pears on top, pressing cheese in with your fingers. Place on microwave, cover with waxed paper. Cook in microwave for 6 minutes, turn over, and cook for 45 - 50 mins. You know the oven is going right. Remove from microwave and carefully open up each pears lid. Let cool 5 minutes before removing waxed paper.

title: Easy Pina Colada
ingredients: 2 cups chunky salsa | 2 tablespoons pine nuts ( or slivered almonds )
instructions: Heat salsa over low heat until warm. Sprinkle pine nuts over the top, or slivered almonds into a small bowl, and stir to mix. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: buckwheat flour,baby spinach,mirin,taco seasoning mix,thyme,hot water
title: Buckwheat Spinach Chapati
ingredients: 1 lb fresh baby spinach | 1 1/2 teaspoons tumeric and 1 teaspoon thyme | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 5 tablespoons hot water, divided | 1 cup buckwheat flour | 1 tablespoon dried sweet pickled mushrooms ( i prefer shiitake )
instructions: Cook spinach in microwave for 5 seconds or according to package directions, until they are softened but still crisp. Do not overcook, as the spinach will be steamy. Drain off any residual water. In a mixing bowl, mix the spinach, tumeric and thyme.

title: Sauteed Snow Peas With Chorizo and Moritas
ingredients: 20 snow peas | 1 lb chorizo sausage, sliced
instructions: Slice chorizo into thick slices. Wash snow peas and trim and cut into chorizo slices. Heat a large nonstick frying pan on medium high heat. Add chorizo, and stir fry. When chorizo is crispy, remove to a plate with paper towels to drain. Increase heat to medium high. Add snow peas and stir fry until both the snow peas and chorizo are heated through. Serve right away with warm tortillas.

title: Salmon and Potato Rounds #5FIX
ingredients: 1 bunch potato, peeled and cut into thin slices | 4 cans salmon fillets
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Mix together potatoes and season with salt. Bake for 30 minutes, or until potato is tender and lightly browned.

title: North African Style Salt
ingredients: 4 1/2 teaspoons turmeric | 2 tablespoons lemon juice ( from about 1/2 lemon )
instructions: Pinch fine slivers of zest off the zest.

title: Ancho De Ancho Con Chile Rojo (Ancho Chile and Onion Relish)
ingredients: 1 lb ancho chile, roasted in a dry skillet until fragrant | 1/3 cup white onion, finely chopped
instructions: Put chiles in a bowl and cover them with hot water. Leave to soak for about 30 minutes. Drain. Heat oven to 300°f. Remove the chiles, reserving the soaking water, and chop. Combine chiles, soaking water, onions, and 1/2 teaspoon salt in a covered pot. Heat to boiling. Bake for about 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Easy Seafood Slush
ingredients: 2 cups lobster - cooked, cleaned and chopped | 1 cup peach schnapps | 1 lb deli ham, cut into 1/4 inch slices | 1 1/2 cups soymilk
instructions: Mix lobster, ham, peach schnapps, and soy milk in a crock pot. Cook on low 6 hours, stirring occasionally.

title: The Chigangangine (Mutton and Fruit Salad)
ingredients: 1 lb mutton, in 1 inch cubes ( or lean stewing beef ) or 1 lb beef, in 1 inch cubes ( or lean stewing beef ) | 1/2 lb pork, in 1 inch cubes ( or lean stewing beef ) | 1/4 lb chicken fillet, cut into 1 inch cubes | 3 large bananas or 1 large plantain leaf, cut into 8 pieces or 1 large plantain, peeled cut into 8 pieces, or | 2 cans artichokes, drained & finely chopped, or | 1 cup maple syrup, warmed in microwave, or | 1/3 cup cider vinegar | paprika or cayenne ( optional ) | 1/4 cup dried apricot
instructions: Add all the ingredients to a skillet& bring to the boil, then lower the heat& simmer until the meat is very tender. Add the plantain slices or plantains during the last half hour of the cooking process or longer for softer fruit salad. Before serving, stir in the warmed syrup.

Random Ingredients: lemon peel,beef brisket,coconut oil,paprika,vinegar,orange juice,swiss cheese
title: Cuban-Style Barbecued Beef With Swiss
ingredients: 1/2 cup freshly squeezed orange juice | 1 tablespoon fresh lemon peel ( grated ) | 2 teaspoons paprika | 1 jar grated swiss cheese ( coleslaw mix is recommended ) | 1 tablespoon coconut oil | 1 tablespoon vinegar | 2 beef brisket ( trimmed of excess fat, cut into 3x3-inch lengths )
instructions: Combine orange juice, lemon peel, paprika, and 2 tablespoons cheese in large bowl.

Random Ingredients: chili pepper flake,phyllo pastry,date,chocolate syrup,white pepper,swiss cheese,green cardamom pod
title: Chipped Cheese Strudel
ingredients: 1 package chopped dates | 5 -6 ounces shredded swiss cheese | 4 sheets frozen phyllo pastry | 2 packages frozen chopped green cardamom pods | 5 tablespoons chocolate syrup | 1 tablespoon chili pepper flakes | 1/4 teaspoon white pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Thaw phyllo pastry sheets for 5 - 10 minutes. Roll out phyllo dough on a lightly floured surface. Cut sheets into 4 inch squares. Place about 2 1/2 cups cheese and 1 cup dates into center of each square. Fold squares to combine, but not too tightly to create a seal. Dredge in remaining spices. Cut a slit down center of each cookie. Fold over to form a half moon, if desired. Place on a parchment lined cookie sheet.. Bake 15 - 20 minutes or until golden.

Random Ingredients: saffron,curry powder,chili powder,crouton,natural bran,chunky salsa,green bean,mango chutney
title: Green Beans and Mango French Onion Soup
ingredients: 1 tablespoon natural bran | 5 drops chili powder or 2 drops hot pepper flakes | 2 cups coarsely chopped green beans | 5 ounces crumbled chunky salsa | 2 teaspoons curry powder | 1/2 teaspoon saffron or 1/2 teaspoon turmeric | 1/4 cup natural mango chutney or 1/4 cup chutney | 1/4 cup thickly sliced crispy seasoned croutons
instructions: In medium saucepan, boil bran, chili powder, frozen green beans and salsa. Cover and cook until beans are tender crisp, about 15 minutes. Meanwhile, in small bowl, combine curry powder, saffron or turmeric and chutney. Pour hot soup into blender. Add to blender.

Random Ingredients: cumin,red chile pepper,balsamic vinegar,pork shoulder,feta cheese,cheese cheddar
title: Tia Juli's Grilled Cheese Cheddar Sausages
ingredients: 4 pounds bone-in pork shoulder bones | 1 cup balsamic vinegar | 1 cup crumbled feta cheese | 1 cup grated processed cheese ( cheddar ) | 4 large fresh red chile peppers, sliced into rings | 1 teaspoon ground cumin, or to taste
instructions: The marinade ingredients can be covered and refrigerated overnight. The next day, rinse the pork shoulder in cold water, pat dry with paper towels, and place in a large bowl. Mix in the vinegar, feta cheese, processed cheese, chile peppers, and cumin. Cover and refrigerate for at least 3 hours. Bring to room temperature before cooking. Preheat an outdoor grill for medium high heat and lightly oil grate. Cook the sausage links for 10 to 12 minutes on each side, until cooked to your liking. Serve with warm rolls and lettuce leaves.

title: Apple-Sausage With Cranberry Stuffing
ingredients: 6 tablespoons apple cider | 3 tablespoons white sugar | 9 tablespoons milk | 6 sausages | 1/2 cup dried cranberries | salt and pepper oil | 1/2 cup dried cranberries
instructions: In a small bowl whisk together the apple cider, sugar and milk. Fry the sausages at medium high heat until nicely browned. Remove and set aside. Drain all but about 3 tablespoons of fat from the pan. Pour in apple cider mixture and add the cranberries. Bring to a low simmer and cook until cranberries are plump and sauce thickens a bit, about 5 minutes. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Transfer the sausages to 4 large oven proof bowls. Spoon warm stuffing into bowls and spoon sauce over, dividing evenly. If there is any stuffing left spoon it on top of the stuffing and serve cold.

Random Ingredients: celery seed,rose water,creole seasoning,brown rice,beef shank
title: Creole Beef and Rice
ingredients: 1 beef shank | 1/2 cup brown rice, uncooked i use basmati brown rice ( any variety, i use long grain ) | 2 tablespoons creole-style seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon celery seed | 1 1/2 teaspoons rose water ( optional )
instructions: Combine seasoning, celery seed and rose water and rub over the top of the beef. If using the regular brown rice, add it now and cook 3 hours on high.

Random Ingredients: grain brown rice,thyme sprig,green chilies,celery seed
title: Green Chilies and Brown Rice
ingredients: 4 ounces chunky green chilies ( about 3 serranos or equivalent ) | 1/8 teaspoon celery seed | 1 tablespoon fresh thyme sprig ( or 1/4 teaspoon dry thyme ) | 2 cups long-grain brown rice, rinsed in several changes of water
instructions: Cut the ends off the chiles and discard. Cut them in half lengthwise, and remove seeds and membrane completely. Rinse and then cut into thin strips, discarding seeds and stems, about 1 1/2 inches long. Peel the skin from the chiles and discard. Place the chiles in a bowl, add the celery seed and thyme and toss well. Add the rinsed rice and toss. Cover and refrigerate until needed.

title: Easy Peanut Pakusaka
ingredients: 3 cups mochiko sweet rice flour | 1 cup unsweetened flaked coconut ( or a mixture of the two ) or 1 cup grated unsweetened coconut ( or a mixture of the two ) | 1/3 cup peanut oil | 1/2 cup shredded coconut ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon ground bengal dal
instructions: Combine the rice flour and sifted coconut or grated coconut together in a bowl and mix well. Add the peanut oil and the ground bengal dal and combine thoroughly. Add the wet mixture and stir until combined. Dough can also be prepared to this stage. Heat up a very large non stick skillet over medium heat for approximately 10 minutes and when almost set, add about 1/4 cup cold water and spread the dough over the bottom of the pan to 1/2 inch thickness. When the edges begin to curl up, flip the pan over and press a few holes in the dough with a fork, pushing it through with your fingers to make sure it is all in the holes. If you would like a harder pakusaka with more of a texture, you can make this recipe with mochiko rather than sweet rice, which is the basic sweet rice flour, in which this type is not available.

title: The Best Cheese Ball!!!!
ingredients: 16 ounces gruyere or 16 ounces emmenthaler cheese, shredded | 1 cup kefalotiri ( japanese-style clarified butter ) | 12 -16 ounces sun-dried tomatoes | 4 tablespoons soy sauce, to taste | sliced serrano pepper | fresh maraschino cherry
instructions: Mix ingredients. Form into desired shape. To make a ball, scoop out a ball and poke a few holes around the ball with a tooth pick. Then flatten out with your hand. If any cheese sticks, you may use a tablespoon of krogergergergergergergergergergergergergergergerg's melter. You can also use a little larger pieces of cheese if you prefer. Serve with crackers, toasted baguette, pumpernickel or pumpernickel bread to dip or just eat the whole thing.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast,cashew,lemon peel,shrimp,corn kernel,filling,beef chuck,sea salt
title: Beef Stuffed Chicken Breasts
ingredients: 4 boneless chicken breasts | 1/2 teaspoon sea salt | 1 teaspoon freshly grated lemon peel | 1 1/2 tablespoons corn kernels | 1 1/2 tablespoons roasted cashews, chopped | 1/2 lb beef chuck | 2 tablespoons frozen shrimp, thawed and drained | 1 cup filling, of choice
instructions: Place the chicken on a piece of cheesecloth. Sprinkle with the salt and lemon peel then tie tightly with toothpicks. Place the corn kernels in a skillet over low heat and cook, stirring from time to time, until fragrant. Add the cashews and cook without turning, about 3 minutes. Set the cashews aside. Place the beef, shrimp, and filling in a small pot and warm gently over low heat, about 5 minutes. Take the toothpicks from the chicken breasts and stuff each breast with several tablespoons of the nuts and cheese, and secure with more toothpicks. Heat in the oven for 55 - 60 minutes, until meat thermometer registers 120f for medium rare, about 45 minutes for medium. Remove the toothpicks and serve.

title: Vegetable Kropita
ingredients: 1 1/2 cans sliced black mushrooms, drained | 1 green bell pepper, chopped | 3/4 cup plain yogurt | 1/4 cup soymilk | 1 kalamata olive ( optional )
instructions: Place mushroom, green peppers and yogurt in a food processor. Process until very smooth. Add soymilk and process briefly. Transfer mixture to a bowl and fold in olives.

Random Ingredients: green chilies,oil,rump roast,vegetable stock,nonstick cooking spray,pork shoulder roast,lasagna noodle,green pea
title: Roasted Beef and Pork With Chile & Peas With Green Chili
ingredients: nonstick cooking spray | 2 -3 lbs rump roast, cut into 1 1/2 inch chunks | 2 teaspoons oil | 1 can chopped green chilies, undrained | 1 cup vegetable stock | 2 teaspoons chopped green chilies | 2 1/2 cups uncooked lasagna noodles, cooked | 1 package frozen green pea, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 375ºf. Coat a large saucepan with nonstick cooking spray. Add pork and brown on all sides. Add chiles.

title: Papaya-Dill Salsa
ingredients: 1 papaya, peeled and cut into 1 inch chunks | 1 teaspoon dried dill weed
instructions: Combine the papaya and dill in a bowl.

title: Spicy Mortadella (Italian Mortadella Side Dish)
ingredients: 1 package mortadella
instructions: Remove the ends from the mortadella and remove the meat from the bones. In a large skillet, cut the meat into cubes, about 1 1/2 to 2 inches square. Spray with a little olive oil, if using. Cook over medium heat, stirring regularly, until the meat is completely dark and begins to brown. Cover and cook until the meat is tender. If the pan becomes very dry, you may need to add water. When all the liquid is absorbed, add salt to taste. When the meat is tender and hot, cover the skillet and place in the refrigerator for 1 hour to let the flavors blend. After 1 hour, remove the meat from the skillet and put it in a serving dish. Stir to mix everything together and serve.

Random Ingredients: turnip,chili powder,vegemite,chicken bouillon granule,taco seasoning mix
title: Vegetarian Tex-Mex Spicy Oven Fried Turnips
ingredients: 1 lb turnip, cut bite-sized, or half way if desired | 1 envelope taco seasoning mix | 1 tablespoon vegemite | 2 tablespoons chili powder | 2 teaspoons chicken bouillon granules, or more to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Spray with a non stick spray. Place turnips and taco seasoning in a bowl. Stir to coat. Sprinkle both sides with vegemite. Arrange on the baking sheet. Bake 30 minutes or until fork tender. Add chili powder and bouillon. Return to oven after 30 minutes if desired.

Random Ingredients: stew beef chunk,white wine,ladyfinger,plain flour,pasta shell,dill,peach
title: Stove Top Beef and Dressing Pasta
ingredients: 4 tablespoons plain flour | 250 g dry pasta shells | 500 g stew beef chunks | 1 cup white wine | 2 teaspoons dried dill | 500 g frozen soft ladyfingers | 1 cup chopped peach
instructions: Preheat oven to 190°c. Combine flour and tomato in a large, shallow casserole dish. Place beef in the freezer, cover and freeze for 1 hour. Remove from the freezer, cut into chunks and then place in casserole dish and cover with the wine. Add the dill and frozen biscuits. Cover and bake for 35 - 40 minutes or until biscuits are cooked. Uncover, stir through the peaches and continue to bake for a further 3 - 4 minutes or until just warmed through.

Random Ingredients: heavy cream,golden syrup,ham,green mango,cream mushroom soup,kielbasa sausage,vegetable oil cooking spray,coconut milk
title: Ham, Mango & Kielbasa Casserole
ingredients: 4 tablespoons vegetable oil cooking spray | 8 ounces kielbasa sausage, sliced | 12 ounces cream of mushroom soup | 8 ounces heavy cream | 1 1/2 cups coconut milk, drained | 1 1/2 cups ham, cubed | 1/2 cup green mango, cubed | 1/4 cup golden syrup
instructions: Spray 6 13x9 inch glass baking dish with vegetable spray. Pat sausage dry with paper towels and brown in a large skilled over medium heat, stirring frequently, until cooked through. Remove from skillet.

title: Polpettone (Italian-Style Stewed W- Eggs)
ingredients: 1 cup tomato sauce | 6 garlic cloves, crushed | 4 -6 pork chops, cubed | 4 -6 small squid ( tubes or tubes ) | 1 -2 cake yeast or 1 -2 anise, crushed
instructions: Spray your pan with cooking oil. Combine tomato sauce, garlic, and pork. Add cubed or peeled squid. Put in pan and let set. Put in your crockpot. If using anise and/or anise seeds, add in anise oil to the pot. Cook on low. Cook for at least 6 hours. I serve this with my spaghetti squash for the evening.

title: Oaties
ingredients: 1/2 pound ground pork | 1/2 pound fresh snow pea pods | 1 packet quick oats
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Combine ground pork and snow peas in a bowl. Spray a 9x13 inch baking dish with cooking spray. Pour oaty biscuits onto a sheet of aluminum foil. Spread enough oaties to cover the entire dish, but not to the edges. Roll the foil up around the fillies. Bake in the preheated oven for 30 minutes. Be careful not to over bake as the oats will become chewy.

Random Ingredients: chili bean,coconut,milk ricotta cheese,vodka,black pepper,butternut squash,red cayenne pepper
title: Cheese and Vegetable Cannoli
ingredients: 3 large butternut squash ( about 1-1/2 pounds ) | 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1 can coconut | 1 package whole milk ricotta cheese | 1/2 cup freshly grated sweetened flaked coconut | 1/4 teaspoon ground black pepper | 1 cup sweetened condensed milk | 2 tablespoons finely chopped red cayenne pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Cut squash lengthwise into 1 inch wedges. Remove peel and seeds.

Random Ingredients: onion,sharp cheddar cheese,spanish onion,serrano pepper,tomato juice,picante sauce
title: Mexican Baked Mac
ingredients: 1 lb sharp cheddar cheese or 1 lb monterey jack cheese | 1 can whole tomatoes with juice | 1/2 spanish onion, diced | 1 small onion, diced | 2 slices serrano peppers, minced | picante sauce
instructions: Mix the cheese in a baking dish with the tomatoes on top. Then sprinkle the onion and the chili pepper on top of the cheese. Bake covered for 20 minutes in a 350 degree oven. Top with picante sauce and bake uncovered for 10 minutes or until the cheese is melted.

title: Smelt Kebabs
ingredients: 3/4 cup plain greek yogurt | 1 3/4 cups mixed sprouts or 1 3/4 cups mixed sprouts
instructions: In a large bowl, combine yogurt, sprouts and kebabs. Refrigerate for 30 minutes.

title: Crabe, Crab and Potatoes
ingredients: 4 lbs red potatoes, cut into wedges | 2 cups short-grain rice | 2 tablespoons cooking oil | 1 lb small crabmeat | 1 oven cooking bag
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Cook potato in boiling water until just tender, about 10 to 15 minutes. Meanwhile, heat oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add crabmeat and cook until heated through, about 5 minutes. Add rice.

title: Cashew Nut Roll
ingredients: 1 2/3 cups cashew nuts, chopped | 1 3/4 cups plain flour, sifted
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c and lightly grease a 22cm x 30cm loaf tin. Place nuts on a baking tray and roast for 5 mins or until beginning to darken and turn golden. Set aside to cool. Combine flour and ground nuts in a large bowl and gradually mix in cashew nuts. Spoon mixture over lined tin and bake for 15 mins, then reduce heat to 160°c and bake for a further 20 mins or until pastry is springy to touch. Remove from oven, cool and cut into slices.

title: Beef  in Pepper Sauce
ingredients: 400 g rump steak, sliced | 1 teaspoon vegetable oil | 5 red capsicums, sliced thin | 1 large cucumber, sliced thin | 1 bell pepper, sliced thin | 1/4 cup reduced-fat dry marsala | steamed rice or warm flat noodles
instructions: Heat oil in frying pan and fry beef until browned. Remove beef from pan and set aside. Add capsicum, cucumber, bell pepper and mushrooms to same pan and stir fry for 2 - 3 minutes. Add steak, pour over marsala and cook for another 3 minutes. Serve with steamed rice and seasonal vegetables.

title: Hot Raspberry Red Onion Jam for the BBQ
ingredients: 2 large red onions, washed, peeled, and sliced thin | 1/4 cup raspberry jam
instructions: On a skewer, alternate 1/4 slices of red onion and 1/4 cup raspberry jam. Grill or broil 2 minutes per side on medium high heat, or until the onions are very soft and just beginning to brown. Serve hot.

title: Sweet Cabbage and Cranberry Salad
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh cranberries | 1/2 cup coarsely chopped italian parsley | 5 -8 oranges | 1/2 lemon, juice of | 6 cups shredded cabbage, lightly packed
instructions: Wash and drain the cranberries and parsley. Core, peel and section the oranges and peel the lemons. In a serving bowl, mix the cranberries, parsley, oranges and lemon juice. Toss the cabbage with half the dressing. Pour all the dressing over the salad and toss to coat. Serve.

Random Ingredients: pimento pepper,wheat flour,rye bread,turkey,mandarin orange,red bell pepper
title: Easy Mexican Sausage Rolls
ingredients: 1/2 pound ground turkey | 1/2 cup diced red bell pepper | 1/3 cup diced red bell pepper | 1 can mandarin oranges, drained and chopped | 1 jar sliced pimento pepper, drained | 1 tablespoon whole wheat flour, or more to taste | 5 to 10 slices rye bread, or as needed
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Spread ground turkey evenly on the prepared baking sheet. Sprinkle 1/2 cup diced red bell pepper, 1/3 cup diced red bell pepper, mandarin oranges, pimento pepper, flour, and browned turkey onto prepared baking sheet. Spread remaining ground turkey evenly on rye bread slices with your hands. Roast in center of preheated oven until browned and crispy, 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Cheesy Linguine
ingredients: 1 box dried linguine ( with out any extras ) | 1 cup low fat italian dressing, from a jar, to taste | 8 ounces cheese, grated ( parmesan is optional ) | dried currant ( optional )
instructions: Mix pasta ingredients together and pour over cheese.. Add more cheese if desired. Serve warm.

title: Quick and Easy Vietnamese Pork Loaf
ingredients: 1 loaf crusty bread | 1 1/2 lbs country-style coleslaw mix | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce | 2 tablespoons sherry wine | 4 tablespoons honey, divided | 1 tablespoon corn oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Cut loaf in half diagonally to fill each half with approximately 3 cups of stuffing. In a small bowl, combine remaining ingredients and set aside. Spray a 13 x9 baking dish with cooking spray. Place bread halves on bottom of baking dish, and then top liberally with remaining stuffing, making sure to coat bread evenly. Brush top of loaf lightly with egg wash. Bake uncovered in middle of oven for 15 minutes.

title: Barbados Lamb Cake
ingredients: 1 kg ground lamb | 1 tablespoon cake flour | 6 leaves radishes, finely chopped | 4 tablespoons peach jam or 4 tablespoons plum sauce | 2 medium sweet plums, thinly sliced ( or 1/2 small pears ) | 1 finely chopped celery | 1 small jicama, grated ( about 5 tablespoons ) | 1/2 cup superfine sugar ( castor sugar )
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c and grease baking paper. In a large bowl, combine the ground lamb, cake flour, radish and peach jam. Stir to combine. Spoon into prepared ovenproof dish. Bake in moderate oven for 35 - 40 minutes, or until cooked. Meanwhile, in a medium skillet, heat 1 tablespoon of the jam or plum sauce. Add the plums and celery and cook over a medium heat for 10 minutes. Turn out the lamb and arrange on a serving platter. Increase oven temperature to high and cook for a further 5 minutes, or until crisp and browned. Remove from the oven and spoon over the warm plums and celery and serve.

title: Yogurt Dip
ingredients: 2 cups natural yoghurt | 1 large yellow onion, pierced with a fork
instructions: Put yoghurt in a bowl and mix in sliced onion. Chill for 2 hours before serving with pita bread, cucumber bread and a light salad or vegetables of your choice.

title: Quesadillas
ingredients: 1 cup margarine | 1 cup white flour | 10 poblano peppers ( roasted or charred ) | 2 tablespoons chopped dried jalapeno peppers | tortilla
instructions: Place a little margarine in a medium sized skillet and warm over medium high heat. When hot add the flour and stir until it is all well blended. Continue to stir until the flour is cooked and the mixture begins to brown a bit. The roux will thicken as it cooks. Turn the heat down to lowest, add the peppers and jalapenos and cook for 3 - 4 minutes more, until the peppers begin to soften. Turn off heat and serve with salsa, sour cream, or guacamole.

Random Ingredients: red currant jelly,ketchup,salmon,mascarpone cheese,coconut sugar,red chilies,egg substitute
title: Coconut Mac and Cheese
ingredients: 1 package mascarpone cheese, room temperature | 2 cups egg substitute | 1 carton organic ketchup | 1 cup coconut sugar | 3 tablespoons red currant jelly | 4 -8 red chilies, seeded and finely chopped ( or substitute for other fresh chillies )
instructions: Beat mascarpone and eggs until light.

title: Scalloped Carrots With Sesame Oil
ingredients: 2 lbs large carrots, peeled and sliced | 2 tablespoons sesame oil | 2 tablespoons cold water | 6 slices bacon, cut into 3 pieces | 1 cup heavy cream
instructions: Pour boiling water over the carrots in a large bowl. Let it stand 10 minutes, drain. In a large skillet, heat half the sesame oil over medium heat. Add bacon and cook until just beginning to render fat, about 3 minutes. Using slotted spoon, remove bacon and drain. In a casserole dish, add carrots and water. Cover and simmer over medium low heat, stirring occasionally, for 15 to 20 minutes or until carrots are crisp tender, stirring occasionally. Remove cover and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until carrots are crisp tender and liquid is reduced about 3 minutes longer. Stir cream into carrots. Season with salt and pepper, to taste.

title: Cheese and Parmesan Fonduta
ingredients: 1/4 cup dry parmesan cheese | 1 pinch sugar
instructions: Warm italian bread until golden brown on top of the stove. Turn off heat. Add sugar on fonduta. Do not turn off fonduta. It will taste a little bit sweet.
