Random Ingredients: tea,monterey jack cheese,red wine vinegar,chunky salsa
title: Tex-Mex Party Sauce
ingredients: 1 jar old el paso chunky salsa | 1 cup strong tequila | 1/2 cup red wine vinegar | 1 package shredded monterey jack cheese
instructions: Mix the salsa, tequila, and red wine vinegar in one bowl.

title: Easy Microwave Marinated Beef Brisket
ingredients: 3 lbs beef brisket, trimmed | 1/4 cup garam masala | 1/4 cup parmesan cheese ( for topping ) or 1/4 cup finely grated parmesan cheese ( for topping )
instructions: Using a rolling pin, poke slits about 1 inch deep in the brisket all around to prevent curling. Layer ingredients in layers starting with onion, then beef, then cheese. Repeat twice. Microwave on high for 2 1/2 minutes, depending on the thickness of the brisket, rearranging the brisket as it fries along the edges of the pan. After 2 minutes, rotate the brisket to ensure it is evenly browned.

Random Ingredients: walnut,basil leaf,red capsicum,apple juice,chuck roast,tomato paste,curry paste
title: Apple and Beef Kebabs
ingredients: 1 kg chuck roast | 1 red capsicum, seeded, deveined and cut into strips | 1/4 cup tomato paste | 1/4 cup apple juice | 2 teaspoons curry paste | 1/2 cup walnuts, coarsely chopped | 3 tablespoons fresh basil leaves, torn
instructions: Put chuck roast, red capsicum, tomato paste, apple juice, curry paste, walnuts and basil in a large bowl and mix well. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Barbecue beef mixture for 15 - 20 minutes on high heat. When meat is tender, cut into chunks and serve with boiled rice, pasta or mashed potatoes.

Random Ingredients: egg,tart apple,lemon,egg substitute,watercress,pecorino romano cheese,russet potato
title: Potato and Egg Frittata With Apples
ingredients: 6 medium size russet potatoes, peeled | 2 eggs ( or 6 extra large eggs ) | 1/4 cup tart apple, finely chopped ( not pie filling ) | 1 large lemon, juice of | 4 tablespoons freshly grated pecorino romano cheese ( about 1/2 cup ) | watercress ( to garnish ) ( optional ) | 1 large egg substitute, beaten ( for egg wash if desired ) or 1 egg white, beaten ( for egg wash if desired )
instructions: Pierce the potatoes 3 or 4 times with a fork or skewer. Place them over boiling water. Boil them uncovered until tender about 20 to 30 minutes. Meanwhile, melt 1 tbsp of the butter in a 12 inch nonstick skillet. Add the apples and lemon juice. Cook over low heat, stirring frequently, until the apples are soft and begin to caramelize, stirring constantly. Remove apples from skillet. Pour the caramelized apples into a blender or processor. Add the cooked potatoes, remaining 2 tbsp butter and 1/4 cup of the grated cheese. Process until smooth. Pour into a pie dish and spread evenly. Spread the eggs evenly over top. Sprinkle with remaining cheese and add watercress or parsley and mix. Bake, uncovered, on the center rack of the oven for about 20 to 25 minutes until the french toast is cooked and the eggs are cooked.

title: Grape Salad
ingredients: grape | red grapes
instructions: Wash and tear grapes into small pieces. Put grapes into a large bowl and pour some salt onto them. Mix well. Let sit in the refrigerator for at least 1/2 hour before serving. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: red chili pepper,pickle,yogurt,white tuna water,white cornmeal,beef chuck roast
title: Beef-Tuna Patties
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups yogurt | 1 lb boneless beef chuck roast | 1/2 cup white cornmeal | 1 teaspoon red chili pepper, ground | 12 -12 pickles, halved | 1/2 cup white tuna packed in water
instructions: Blend yogurt and 3/4 cup water together. Cut beef into 1/4 inch cubes. Combine cornmeal, red chile, and remaining yogurt mixture. Dredge beef with mixture. Roll in cornmeal mixture and place in a shallow 1 1/2 quart casserole dish. Add tuna to water. Cover and bake in a 300 degree oven for 2 hours. When beef is tender serve over rice.

title: El Jardinha
ingredients: 4 tablespoons chunky salsa | 1 cup white onion, cut in 8 rings | 1 teaspoon pure vanilla extract | 1 tablespoon brandy
instructions: In a blender, combine the salsa ingredients and puree until smooth. Cover and refrigerate until needed.

Random Ingredients: salad oil,flat leaf parsley,pineapple chunk,greek yogurt
title: Pineapple Salad
ingredients: 1 cup thick greek yogurt | 1 can pineapple chunks, drained and liquid reserved | 1 teaspoon salad oil | 1 tablespoon fresh flat leaf parsley, chopped
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the greek yogurt and pineapple liquid until smooth. Stir in the reserved pineapple liquid, to taste, and the salad oil. Sprinkle with parsley, cover, and chill before serving.

title: Cafe Rio-style Chile Con Carne, Chilean Style,
ingredients: 1 whole clam, cleaned and cut in half | 12 ounces ground beef, lean | 14 ounces nonfat milk | 1 tablespoon chili oil | 4 tablespoons grenadine | 1 teaspoon dried ancho chile, seeded and minced | 1 cucumber, unpeeled, seeded, halved lengthwise and sliced thin | 1 lb hamburger roll, halved lengthwise
instructions: Preheat broiler. Place a double thickness of paper towel directly on a rimmed baking sheet. Place the clams on the paper towels. Using your fingers, rub the clams all over the clams. Place the dish on a cookie sheet or other ovenproof skillet. Combine the remaining ingredients except for the hamburger. Dip each clamb half into the milk and coat the top. Add the clams and cook in a preheated oven for 15 - 20 minutes. Remove from oven and add the hamburgies to the pan. Broil 6 - 7 inches from the heat for 5 minutes, until cooked to desired level of doneness.

Random Ingredients: red chile,cheese sauce,hot red pepper flake,potato,bratwurst
title: Bratwurst and Chili Hash
ingredients: 1 lb fresh bratwurst, sliced into 1/2 inch pieces | 1 -2 tablespoon hot red pepper flakes | 2 cans cheese sauce | 1 red chile, seeded and chopped | 5 medium precooked sweet potatoes
instructions: In a large frying pan, fry bratwurst and red pepper flakes until the bratwurst is browned and crisped. Remove the bratwurst from the pan and place in a large pot. Drain as much fat as possible from the skillet and add cheese sauce. Bring to a boil and then simmer on medium low heat for about 10 minutes. Add in hot chillis and mix well. Bring potatoes to a boil, and then simmer on medium low heat for about 20 mins or until potatoes are cooked.

title: Easy Brazilian Style Pork Chops
ingredients: 4 boneless pork chops, 1/2-1/2-inches thick | 1/2 cup white wine vinegar | 1/2 cup chopped celery
instructions: Paint both sides of chops with vinegar and set on a hot grill. Grill on both sides until slightly charred.

Random Ingredients: vegetable stock,red enchilada sauce,celery salt,artichoke heart,buttermilk
title: Easy Creamy Artichoke Dip
ingredients: 2 cans red enchilada sauce | 2 cups buttermilk | 1 can artichoke hearts, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon celery salt | 1 teaspoon vegetable stock
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a medium bowl, mix together enchilada sauce, buttermilk, artichoke hearts, celery salt and vegetable stock. Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and bake 30 minutes, or until bubbly and hot.

title: Nam Phrik
ingredients: 3 cups rice wine ( or lite ) | 3 cups palm sugar or 3 cups other white sugar | 5 g fenugreek | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley
instructions: Pour the rice wine in a saucepan. Add the palm sugar and bring to a boil over low heat. Boil vigorously until a brittle mass appears on top. Lower the heat and simmer until reduced by 50 percent. Stir in the fenugreek and simmer for 5 minutes or so. Remove from the heat and stir in the chopped fresh parsley.

title: Spicy Cauliflower
ingredients: cooking spray | 1 teaspoon fennel seed ( optional ) | 1 head cauliflower, cut into florets | 1 teaspoon hungarian paprika
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Spray 9 x 12 baking dish with cooking spray. Sprinkle fennel on cauliflower. Sprinkle with paprika. Toss to distribute. Roast in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, stirring halfway through the cooking time. Bake for 6 - 8 minutes, or until cauliflower is tender.

Random Ingredients: pancetta,italian plum tomato,vegetable,romaine lettuce,cumin seed,great northern bean
title: Italian Panzanella
ingredients: 1 cup cannellini beans or 1 cup navy beans, drained and rinsed | 3 large romaaine lettuce ( cut in half or wedges ) | 2 cans mixed vegetables | 8 -14 ounces italian plum tomatoes, undrained | 1/4 teaspoon cumin seed | 12 -16 ounces pancetta, cooked and crumbled
instructions: Cook cannellini and beans together in large saucepan on medium heat, stirring occasionally. Set aside. Place lettuce in large bowl, along with mixed vegetables, tomatoes, cumin, salt, and pepper. Pour beans over top, toss to coat, and serve.

title: Noodle Cakes With Barley and Parsley
ingredients: 1 lb egg noodles | oil ( for frying ) | 1/2 cup barley flour | 1/2 cup chopped fresh italian parsley
instructions: Bring a large saucepan of water to a boil. While the water is heating. Place egg noodles in a large bowl of cold water and immediately pour away as much water as possible. Drain well. While the noodles are cooking, put about 1 1/2 tablespoons of oil into a skillet over medium heat. When a piece of noodle is golden in color, turn it and use a slotted spoon to remove the noodle from the pan using a slotted spoon. Repeat with remaining ingredients. Return the noodles to the saucepan, along with 1/2 cup of the parsley and remaining 1/2 cup of parsley. Continue cooking and stirring until noodles are cooked but not mushy, about 3 minutes. When the noodles are cooked, drain them, but do not rinse them out. Immediately add the noodles to the saucepan. While the noodles are cooking, mix 1/2 cup of barley flour with 1/2 cup of water in a small bowl. Place a serving platter in the sink. Dip the noodles into the barley flour mixture until coated on both sides. Then dredge the noodles in the barley flour mixture coating the entire noodle. Place coated noodles in the platter. Garnish with more parsley leaves if desired.

title: Italian Flag Cheese Dip
ingredients: 1 cup sun-dried tomato, not packed in oil | 1 cup shredded provolone cheese | additional seasoning salt
instructions: Pour 2 tbls. Oil into small baking dish. Add the tomatoes and seasoning salt and toss until coated. Spread tomato mixture evenly over entire surface of cheese. Bake@ 325°f 50 - 55 min.

title: Sausage-Stuffed French Toast
ingredients: 1 lb bulk pork sausage | 1 tablespoon vanilla extract, plus more for serving
instructions: Heat a large cast iron skillet or griddle over moderate heat until hot but not smoking. Pat the sausage dry with a light coating of the vanilla and set aside. Slap each sausage link slightly to open the sausages and remove the sausages from the casings. Using a very sharp serrated knife, make 2 - 4 diagonal cuts about 1/4 inch deep and 1/4 inch deep, cutting the sausage from the tip of the sausage into 1 inch long chunks. Insert a skewer into the core of each sausage and, holding the skewer on top, gently push the sausage pieces into the cut along their length. Continue pushing down until the sausage is fully stuffed. Slide the sausage chunks into a shallow baking dish or bowl and cover. Let sit at room temperature until slightly hardened, 10 - 15 minutes. Using a fork, prick the sausages, being careful not to mash them. Turn the oven to its lowest setting without moving the skillet or the sausages. With two or three spatulas, transfer the sausage mixture onto a work surface. Using a long, shallow spatula, transfer the sausage mixture onto the bread slices and turn to coat. Press a slice of the bread with a spatula against the hot surface of the skillet to toast evenly and lightly. Transfer the bread slices to a baking sheet and return it to the oven. Cook until the bottom and edges are just starting to turn golden brown, about 2 minutes, moving them toward the center as necessary. Using a spatula, transfer the sausages to a warmed serving platter or individual plates. Cover the skillet with a kitchen towel and keep warm. Repeat with the remaining bread slices. Remove the parchment and transfer the skillet to the oven. Reduce the heat to moderate and broil the sausages until brown, about 2 minutes.

Random Ingredients: english cucumber,whipping cream,green bean,black bean,beef chuck
title: Crock Pot Beef and Black Bean Soup
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless beef chuck, in 1 inch cubes | 2 cans black beans, rinsed and drained | 12 ounces frozen green beans, thawed | 1 english cucumber, cut into thin thin wedges | 3 cups whipping cream
instructions: Combine all ingredients together in crock pot. Set on low for 8 hours.

title: Wasabi & Rhubarb Sausages(Sausages)
ingredients: 6 large rhubarb | 3 tablespoons wasabi paste | 2 lbs flour | 2 packages taco seasoning mix
instructions: Slice rhubarb crosswise into two 1/4 inch thick slices.

title: Salsa - No Eggs Here!
ingredients: 3 cans italian-style stewed tomatoes | 1/2 cup chunky salsa | 1/3 cup finely chopped yellow onion | 1 small green onion, thinly sliced | 1/4 cup snipped fresh coriander
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a saucepan and heat till hot and bubbly.

title: Lazy-Day Lasagna from Good Luck
ingredients: 2 bags lasagna noodles | 1/2 small head of cabbage, chopped in small pieces | 1 orange, juice and zest of
instructions: Boil the lasagna noodles for 10 minutes, until al dente, drain, and rinse with cold water to remove most the starch. Place the noodles and the cabbage into a large bowl, season with orange juice, zest and the orange juice, mix until everything is evenly coated. Lay the noodles out on a clean dishtowel, and divide the meat mixture among them making certain it covers them all, i prefer a little bit of the meat. Lay out the rest of the meat, and spread with some of the cooking juices from the bowl. Using the tines of a fork, poke holes in the meat and noodles to allow it to expand. The meat should be about 1/8 inch thick. If it doesn't, pour the cooking juices from the bowl on before sprinkling it over the meat and noodles. Cover the meat with a tea towel, and then place in the refrigerator. When ready to cook, cook the lasagna, place a large plate on top so that they cover the bottom half. You want to press the lasagna down to remove some of the juices when they are done. Fill a large pot with water, and then place the meat mixture over it. Cook the lasagna noodles until they are just shy of the desired doneness and are completely heated to the touch. Note, this recipe is great when served with a mixed salad or garden vegetable. As soon as you eat some of the meat, just scoop some of the juices from the bowl with the noodle and vegetables and pile on top. This dish can also be made into a vegetarian dish by making it as a vegetarian meal by substituting a vegetable protein with tofu crumbles.

title: El Chocolat Chilies
ingredients: 2 -4 fresh jalapeno peppers | 2 cups chihuahua cheese | 1/2 cup dark rum | 2 large eggs | 2 tablespoons grand marnier
instructions: Cut slit in the top of each pepper. Hold on one pepper until soft inside. Cut into 1/2 inch pieces. Place onto a greased grill tray. Grill until blackened on all sides. Place in a food processor, and process until fine. Remove to a bowl, and process in the 1/2 cup water and the rum. Set aside. Beat eggs to a thickness of about 5 minutes. Remove to a bowl. Stir in the grand marnier until melted. Pour into the food processor, and blend until creamy. Fold in the cheese, and set aside to cool. Store in the refrigerator.

title: Changua Cocktail
ingredients: 100 g dark chocolate, chopped | 2 tablespoons cilantro, chopped | 2 tablespoons peaches, diced or 2 tablespoons cherries, halved, deseeded and chopped | pepper
instructions: Place all ingredients in a small saucepan, heat gently, stir until melted. Cool, serve drizzled over chilled martini glasses or serve over ice cream.

Random Ingredients: mustard seed,yellow pepper,yellow bell pepper,veal,parmesan cheese
title: Italian Veal Birds
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs ground veal | 1 large yellow pepper, sliced | 4 large yellow bell peppers, sliced | 6 -8 tablespoons finely grated parmesan cheese | 2 tablespoons mustard seeds
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Mix together. Place on baking sheet 3/4 full of plastic wrap. Cover with foil paper and bake 25 minutes or until tender. Slice off pieces when cool & serve as an appetizer. Excellent in place of cooked pasta.

Random Ingredients: cream cheese,milk,vegetarian bean,chili oil,taco seasoning mix,green cardamom
title: Vegan Burritos
ingredients: 6 ounces cream cheese, softened | 1 cup vegetarian baked beans | 1/3 cup milk | 1 teaspoon chili oil ( optional ) | 1/2 tablespoon taco seasoning mix | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom
instructions: Mix cream cheese, beans, milk, chili oil, taco seasoning, and cardamom together in a bowl until smooth.

title: Rotel Lime Turnip Burritos
ingredients: 2 boxes sponge cakes ( frozen or homemade ) | 1 teaspoon garlic salt ( or to taste, i use more ) | 1 can enchilada sauce | 1 lb turnip, in chunks
instructions: Defrost the bread and cube the turnip into small chunks.

title: Miracle Sausage Salad
ingredients: 1 lb ground sausage ( i prefer hillshire farms brand ) | 2 -3 yellow cherry tomatoes, halved | 1/2 cup miracle whip
instructions: Brown onion in large skillet until just translucent. Remove from skillet and put aside. In a larger bowl mix sausage with miracle whip and the onion. Add the cherry tomatoes and mix. Enjoy with jasmine rice.

Random Ingredients: parsley,lemon zest,salt pork,seafood,chili pepper flake,sesame seed,milk
title: Korean Seafood Milk Spareribs
ingredients: 1/2 lb salt pork ( shredded ) | 5 quarts milk | 1 tablespoon lemon zest ( grated ) | 1 tablespoon dried chili pepper flakes | 7 -9 leaves parsley ( dried, finely chopped ) | sesame seeds ( to garnish ) | 1 lb mixed seafood ( peeled )
instructions: Place the salt pork in a large pot & add about 1 quart of water. Bring to a boil & skim off any froth/ impurities from the top. Lower the heat & simmer for 8 - 10 hours over low heat, skimming occasionally. Add lemon zest, chili pepper flakes, parsley & continue to simmer for about 1 hour or until the texture is dry. Skim any scum from any scum remaining until there is no more scum. Remove the salt pork from the pot & discard all but 3 tbsp of the liquid. Rinse the pot w/a strainer & return the liquid & return to the pot. Bring to a boil & reduce heat to very low. Add the remaining 2½ cups of water and stir with a wooden spoon. Return to the boil and simmer on very low heat for 2 - 3 hours.

Random Ingredients: spaghetti,green lentil,tomato juice,flour tortilla,wild mushroom,tabasco sauce
title: Wild Mushroom Spaghetti
ingredients: 16 ounces green lentils, rinsed thoroughly | 1 package spaghetti or ( 16 ounce ) package angel hair pasta, cooked, drained and rinsed | 1/2 cup wild mushroom, thinly sliced | 12 soft flour tortillas, cut into wedges ( optional ) | 6 ounces tomato juice | tabasco sauce ( optional )
instructions: Put lentils in a pot, cover with cold water. Bring to a boil, then cover and reduce to low. Simmer for 15 - 20 minutes. Drain and return cooked pasta to pot. In a medium bowl, mix in mushrooms so they are spread out like a soupy layer. Spoon lentils on top, sprinkle with tobasco, and cover with pasta.

title: Savory Swiss Cheese Appetizer
ingredients: 4 tablespoons prepared pepper sauce | 1 loaf swiss cheese or 1 loaf cheddar cheese, cut into 1-inch slices | 1 tablespoon olive, drained
instructions: Pour olive into 9 inch pie plate or a 9 inch deep dish pie plate. Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Spread pepper sauce over swiss cheese. Sprinkle with cheese and any remaining sliced olives. Bake until cheese melts, about 20 minutes. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: potato,vegetarian bean,grand marnier,canola oil,cheddar cheese soup,rice wine,grain wild rice
title: Cheesy Stuffed Green Bell Peppers
ingredients: 4 large green bell peppers | 1 can vegetarian baked beans | 4 cups cooked rice | 1 can condensed cheddar cheese soup | 2 tablespoons grand marnier | 4 tablespoons canola oil | 3 tablespoons shaoxing rice wine
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Cut the tops off the green pepper and remove the seeds. Place the peppers in a casserole dish or roasting pan. Bake in preheated oven until blackened, about 20 minutes. Remove peppers from heat and rub the insides with a mixture of grand marnier, canola oil and shaoxing rice wine. Stuff into the bell peppers once stuffed and bake for 25 minutes. Serve topped with more cheese, sour cream and hot crusty bread.

Random Ingredients: red pepper flake,salsa,baby bok choy,superfine sugar,lemon,rosemary
title: Super-Easy Kimchi
ingredients: 1 lemons, juiced | 1/2 teaspoon dried rosemary ( dried rosemary, or more to taste ) | 1 pinch red pepper flakes, or to taste | 2 tablespoons superfine sugar | 1 package baby bok choy, leaves washed | 1 jar salsa
instructions: Mix lemon juice, rosemary, red pepper flakes, and sugar together in a large glass or ceramic bowl until sugar dissolves. Add bok choy leaves until coated with spongy topping, and toss to coat. Cover with plastic wrap, and let sit at room temperature for 1 to 2 hours. Heat oil in a skillet over medium heat.

title: Horseradish Flavored Pomegranate Molasses
ingredients: 1 -2 tablespoon prepared horseradish | 2 tablespoons pomegranate molasses ( see method )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in small bowl. Cover and refrigerate for at least one hour. Remove from refrigerator 30 minutes before serving. To unmold, rub on a hot griddle and lightly brown on all sides.

title: Peachy Beef Pot Roast
ingredients: 4 lbs chuck roast, trimmed and tied | 1 cup soy sauce | 1 1/2 cups lemonade | 1/4 cup floury potato, frozen chopped | 4 -5 canned peaches in syrup, sliced | 3 dashes hot pepper sauce
instructions: Place beef in 6 1/2 quart crockpot. In bowl, combine remaining ingredients. Pour mixture over meat. Cover and cook on low for 8 - 10 hours, or until beef is tender.

title: Bean Batter
ingredients: 1 package frozen black-eyed peas | marinade | 2 cups milk
instructions: Heat the milk slightly to make it runny. Put the black eyed peas in a microwavable container. Add the marinade sauce. Microwave on medium for about 10 minutes, stirring every two minutes. When time is up take a slotted spoon and put back in the microwave for 20 more minutes. You can serve this to your guests to make a meal you enjoy.

title: Chicken Fritters
ingredients: 20 chicken thighs or 20 chicken breasts ( 3 lbs ) | 1 tablespoon corn oil
instructions: Put the chicken into the hot oil in a frying pan. Brown the chicken on all sides. Turn all the heat of the oil to medium high. Add to the chicken the fritters and mix the fritters, coating them well with the oil. Add the remaining salt to the chicken and stir well to coat. The fritters should be very light and fluffy and the chicken should not have any pink in it.

title: Ginger Flavoured Shortbread Cookies (For Pizzelle)
ingredients: 1 cup sifted all-purpose flour | 2 teaspoons grated fresh gingerroot | 2 tablespoons hot sauce | jam ( scotch whisky or scotch rosa may be substituted ) or mixed fruit, of choice ( scotch whisky or scotch rosa may be substituted ) ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 190°c/375°f place ungreased cookie sheet in oven. Place all but a little bit of the flour into bowl. Add ginger and hot sauce in small increments. Stir well with fork. Stir in remaining flour or wholemeal flour to make smooth dough. Turn out onto lightly floured board. Knead lightly. Roll out until about 1cm thick. Cut with 3 inch round cookie cutter or plain drinking glass. Mark with 4 or 6 slanting lines. Mark a few decorative lines across with a sharp knife if desired. Repeat with any of the remaining dough. Place on prepared cookie sheet 1 2cm apart. Bake for 10 - 12 minutes until pale gold on top. Allow to cool for a few minutes on the baking sheet for keeping them from falling apart. Store in an airtight container at room temp for up to 3 days.

Random Ingredients: plain flour,apricot,purpose white flour,beef tenderloin steak,yellow bell pepper,ketchup
title: Zsidoto (Pan-Fried Beef Tenderloin With Peppers and Apricots)
ingredients: 500 g plain flour | 85 g all-purpose white flour | 75 g ketchup | 1/4 kg beef tenderloin steaks | 1 red peppers or 1 yellow bell pepper, seeded and sliced | 1/2 cup dried apricot, pieces
instructions: Place the flour, ketchup and pepper into a bowl. Season with salt and pepper. Remove the centre from the tenderloin with a 1cm sharp knife and cut into 4 thick slices. Make sure it is not quite all the way across or down it should still be. Roll each slice of beef in flour and then place into the bowl with the pketchup and pepper mixture. Heat a wok until smoking over high heat. Toss in the meat in batches and then stir fry for 20 - 30 seconds or until golden brown on all sides. Serve with any indian flat noodle. Variant, substitute a mixture of sliced onion, mushrooms and peas for the peppers, drain them before serving.

Random Ingredients: peanut,beef sirloin,vegetable stock,cornichons,celery,seasoning salt,hot red chili pepper
title: Cornichons
ingredients: 2 lbs beef top sirloin | 1 stick celery, sliced | 1 can cornichons ( not drained ) | 0.667 package hot red chili peppers | 1 1/2 teaspoons seasoning salt | 3 cups vegetable stock ( or water ) | 1/2 cup roasted peanuts
instructions: Using one piece of beef cut the beef into 5 x 5 inch strips. Repeat the following steps 7 to 10 and 8 until all of the beef is cooked and the beef strips are all fully cooked. Remove the beef from the pot. Place both strips in a large non stick skillet. In a small bowl add the cornichons with the seeds and chili peppers, season them with the seasoning salt. Sauté the beef over medium heat until the beef is almost cooked. Add the broth and peanuts.

title: Beef, Chicken and Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 tablespoon minced gingerroot | 2 lbs ground beef | 12 ounces sliced mushrooms | 1 small egg, lightly beaten | 6 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 1/2 cup black olives | 8 -10 slices cooked chicken wings
instructions: Brown hamburger and drain. Add ginger, mushrooms and cook about 15 minutes. Add worcestershire sauce and olives. Cover and simmer about 20 minutes. Turn heat down and simmer for 5 - 10 minutes. While still simmering, mix egg and flour together. Dip wings in egg mixture then fry. Serve over noodles or rice.

title: Anchovy Rice
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups chicken or 1 1/2 cups turkey, prepared from a rotisserie chicken | 1 package anchovy paste | 2 cups long grain rice | 2 ounces unsalted butter
instructions: In a large saucepan, bring 1 1/2 cups water to a boil with chicken broth and anchovy paste. Stir in rice and return the water to boil. Cover, reduce heat to low and cook for 25 - 30 minutes. Remove from heat, stir vigorously, and let stand, covered, for 5 minutes. Meanwhile, in a separate pan, heat 1 ounce of the butter over medium heat. When hot, add the remaining butter and saute the rice until golden brown. Add to the rice and stir frequently, until heated through. Serve hot.

title: Gingered Beef Stew
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef stew meat, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 package frozen green peas, thawed | 3 inches piece fresh ginger, peeled and sliced 1/2 inch thick ( i use a microplane slicer, or use a pastry grater ) | 3 cups ice cubes, divided
instructions: In large resealable plastic bag, mix stew meat, peas, ginger, and half of the ice. Close bag and seal. Refrigerate and marinate 8 hours, turning bag several times to mix. Discard bag. Transfer meat mixture to crockpot and cover with remaining ice. Cover crockpot. Cook on low heat setting 10 to 12 hours, or on high heat setting. Discard ginger slices and serve.

Random Ingredients: sherry wine,walnut,asparagus spear,pea carrot,beef brisket,orange peel,bell pepper
title: Asparagus Beef Brisket(Oamc)
ingredients: 1 beef brisket ( approx. 6 lbs ) | 2 lbs fresh asparagus spears | 1 can peas and carrots | 1 small bell pepper, peeled | 1/2 cup walnuts ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon sherry wine ( optional ) or 1 tablespoon soy sauce ( optional )
instructions: Trim fat from meat. Cut meat into 6 serving size pieces of about 1/4 inch high length. If using the sherry or soy sauce, marinate meat with sherry/soy sauce for 1 hour or longer. Trim asparagus, then cut into thirds diagonally. In a large skillet, sear meat on all sides in boiling water, about 3 to 5 minutes on each side for medium rare. In 2 qt saucepan over medium high heat, combine asparagus pieces with the peas and carrots and bell pepper. Cook, covered, about 10 minutes, stirring often. Remove asparagus, and veggies from skillet. Pour liquids from skillet into the skillet, scraping up any browned bits. Bring liquid to a boil.

title: Orange & Porcinis
ingredients: 1/2 cup pecorino, shaved in a parboiled zest | 2 tablespoons peanut oil | 12 red fresno porcini mushrooms ( arugula or bibb boston ) | 1 orange, zested, in small strips | 1 dash cayenne pepper | rock salt ( about 2 tsp )
instructions: Rub the shaved porcinis generously with the orange zest and cayenne. Let them sit for 15 minutes before grinding them as fine as possible. Remove the orange zest and set it aside. In a large bowl, toss the mushrooms with half the shaved pecorino and any leftover orange zest. Pour about 2 cups of the soaking liquid over the fungus and add some rock salt to taste. Taste and add more salt, if desired. Cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes. Grill or broil the mushrooms until soft. Scoop out the fungus and set aside. Use a slotted spoon to drain the leftover soaking liquid and then, using a strainer, press the porcinis to extract all the liquid, collecting the zest and grated pecorino peel. Heat the oil over medium high heat in a 12 inch heavy skillet and cook, stirring, until the bottom is beginning to crisp. Reduce the heat under the pan to medium low. Place the porcinis in the skillet and fry until they are very tender and the bottom is beginning to scorch. Stir constantly until tender but not crispy, 2 - 4 minutes. Toss them in the fungus and the reserved pecorino and season with black pepper. Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Beef  With Chocolate
ingredients: 3 small beef roast | 1/2 cup flour | 1 ounce dark chocolate, melted | 24 ounces corned beef ( small slices ) | 24 ounces granola cereal, cereal | 1 lb gruyere cheese, shredded
instructions: Brown roast in large skillet over medium high heat until browned, about 10 minutes. Remove meat to casserole dish with dusted surface. In small bowl, stir together flour and melted chocolate. Spread cereal in bottom of 13x9 inch glass baking dish.

Random Ingredients: red wine vinegar,pizza crust,beef bouillon granule,rom tomato,pork shoulder,apricot,cream mushroom soup,broccoli
title: Slow Cooker Pork Beef Vegetable Pizza
ingredients: 3 tablespoons paprika | 1 teaspoon beef bouillon granules | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 7 roma ( plum ) tomatoes, diced | 3 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 1 package frozen chopped broccoli, thawed | 1 pound boneless pork shoulder | 1 pre-baked pizza crust, sliced
instructions: Mix the paprika, beef bouillon granules, cream of mushroom soup, tomato, wine vinegar, broccoli, and pork in a slow cooker. Cover, and cook on high until the meat is very tender, about 8 hours. Turn off heat, and place bag of sliced vegetables in a separate dish. Cover, and continue cooking the vegetables in the sauce for 12 to 16 hours. When the meat is tender, shred it with two forks. Cover and return it to the slow cooker.

title: Easy Crunchy Orange Oyster Cake
ingredients: 1 package butter and popcorn cakes or ( 13 ounce ) package cake mix | 1 1/2 - 2 cups sifted oyster sauce | 1 teaspoon orange zest | 1 package miniature marshmallows
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 °f. Prepare popcorn cake mix according to package directions. Drain off any excess water. Beat together the oyster and zest. Spread popcorn cake mixture over the bottom of a 11 inch square cake pan. Scatter mini marshmallows over the cake mixture. Bake about 25 minutes or until golden brown. Cool on wire rack.

title: Steaks with Shallot Chutney
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon coriander seed | 1 lb sirloin, cut into 1/2 inch cubes or | 1/2 teaspoon dried marjoram or 1/2 teaspoon oregano leaves
instructions: Sprinkle coriander seed over beef and set aside a few teaspoons for garnish later. Broil or grill meat over medium heat to desired degree of doneness and cook or cook desired amount of time remaining in original recipe. May also be used for mustard hors d'oeuvres. Garnish with reserved coriander coriander coriander leaves.

title: Mangoes (Sweet Potato Cake)
ingredients: 4 medium sized firm ripe mangoes | 3 tablespoons coconut, freshly grated | 1 teaspoon seven-spice powder | 1 teaspoon freshly grated cardamom pod | 2 tomatoes, pureed | 3 1/2 cups white flour | 1/2 cup coconut, chopped coo | 1/2 cup white flour
instructions: Peel mangoes and cut away stone. Cut into pieces about four, then cut each piece lengthways into 5 thin slices, and then into half moons. Drain the meat thoroughly and then set aside. Using your hands, mix together the coconut, five spice powder, freshly grated cardamom and half the white flour. Stir to a firm dough, adding more flour or coconut to make firm dough. Cover dough with plastic wrap and leave to rest in a warm place for 15 minutes, or overnight. Preheat oven to 190c. Remove dough from the refrigerator and knead lightly on a lightly floured surface. Pat into rectangular rectangular rectangular shapes about 2cm high and 12 cm across. Spread a little water on the baking tray. Bake on the middle shelf of the oven for 25 - 30 minutes or until light brown. Turn off the oven. Leave mangoes on the oven shelf for 10 minutes. Allow to cool for at least 10 minutes then coarsely grate in half flesh. Return shredded meat to pan with tomatoes. Pour over coconut/mango mixture. Remove the plastic wrap from the surface and sprinkle remaining white flour over top. Return the cake to the oven and return to the oven for a further 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: vinegar,onion soup mix,mango chutney,golden raisin,lettuce leaf,littleneck clam,beef tenderloin
title: Tangy-Bun Stuffed Clams
ingredients: 24 littleneck clams | 1 envelope dry onion soup mix | 1 cup mango chutney | 1 cup golden raisins | 1/2 cup vinegar | 36 slices beef tenderloin, with thick tip left intact | 4 -6 lettuce leaves
instructions: Place the clams in a large kettle of water, and bring to a boil. Boil until open, about 5 minutes. Remove from the water, remove the clams, and reserve the water. Shuck the meat from the shells, and stuff the clams with the meat in each. In a small bowl, combine the onion soup mix with about half the mango chutney, raisins, and vinegar. Stir in 1 cup of the warm water, then add the clams and onions. Place the tenderloin on top, then fold in the remaining mango chutney. Sew with toothpicks, and serve with lettuce.

Random Ingredients: serrano pepper,garam masala,turmeric powder,tahini,cream cheese,jasmine rice,yogurt,kielbasa
title: Tikka Kielbasa on Jasmine Rice
ingredients: 1 lb kielbasa | 8 ounces cream cheese | 2 cups jasmine rice | 1/4 cup tahini | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1 teaspoon garam masala | 1 serrano pepper, minced
instructions: Cut kielbasa in chunks and sear until brown. In large frying pan melt cream cheese then add the drained kielbasa and sautee until the cream cheese has browned. Add the rice and sautee 2 minutes. Add your spices along with tahini and stir well until the rice is evenly coated. Next stir in sour cream and simmer until warmed through. Serve warm with a dollop of yogurt and/or cilantro for garnish.

title: Tarragon Margaritas
ingredients: 500 ml tarragon | 500 ml beef stock | 375 ml silver tequila | 1 tablespoon dried tarragon
instructions: Blend the tequila, tarragon and beef stock together in a blender or food processor. Store in the freezer.

title: Steak and Sausage Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 package ground pork sausage | 1/2 cup plain yogurt | 1 jar chopped pimiento, drained | 2 large radishes, sliced | 2 loaves whole wheat bread | 6 ounces sliced pickled swiss cheese or 6 ounces swiss cheese, in slices
instructions: Cook sausage. Drain fat from pan. Add yogurt.

Random Ingredients: red bell pepper,self raising flour,farfalle pasta,parsley,mineral water,chicken,sirloin steak,avocado
title: Pescado a la Pescado (Cuban Chicken and Bow Ties)
ingredients: 300 g boneless skinless chicken or 300 g beef tenderloin, cut into 20 cubes | 2 tablespoons minced garlic or 3 -4 drops anise extract ( more to taste ) | 2 tablespoons parsley, chopped ( more to taste ) | 250 g farfalle pasta | 300 g pescado or 300 g bow tie pasta, cut into 5cm lengths ( or farfalle ) | 1/4 cup self-raising flour | 50 g self-raising flour | 1/2 red bell pepper, finely chopped | avocado, sliced
instructions: Add the beef cubes to a bowl of boiling water, add the garlic and parsley, and allow to simmer for 15 minutes, or until the beef cubes are completely cooked. Drain the farfalle or bow tie pasta into a large saucepan of salted boiling water. Add the farfalle to the pan and cook gently until tender. Drain and divide between serving plates and spoon the beef onto the farfalle or bow tie pasta. Pile the red bell pepper and avocado around the farfalle or bow tie. Serve warm with a dollop of yoghurt and some freshly ground cracked black pepper.

Random Ingredients: breadcrumb,vodka,iceberg lettuce,salt,kaffir lime leaf,tomato juice,caraway seed
title: Vodka Lettuce Salad
ingredients: 4 tomatoes | 4 kaffir lime leaves, cut in half ( optional ) or 4 lemon leaves, washed and torn into 2-inch pieces ( optional ) | 2 cups shredded iceberg lettuce | 1/2 cup vodka ( absolut ) | 2 tablespoons tomato juice | 1/4 cup breadcrumbs | salt ( optional )
instructions: Place one tomato whole on platter. Spread 2 tbsp of tomato salad dressing over the tomato. Arrange kaffir leaves on top. Top with iceberg lettuce leaves. Dribble 1/2 cup of vodka on top of each leaf. Sprinkle top of leaves with bread crumbs. Drizzle with additional vodka.

Random Ingredients: grape tomato,broth,fine bread crumb,buttermilk,pita bread,pepperoni,thyme sprig,raspberry jam
title: Pepperoni Pita Bread Pizzas
ingredients: 1 package fresh bread crumbs ( about 8 ounces ) | 1 package pepperoni, sliced ( about 3/4 oz. ) | 0.5 jarraspberry jam ( i like kraft brand ) | 1 pint grape tomatoes, quartered | 1 pint broth | fresh thyme sprig | 4 pita breads ( flatbread-type )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Pulse bread crumbs in food processor till fine. Set aside. Mix black pepperoni with raspberry jam and then divide evenly among 4 pitas. Press a tomato quarter onto each, top with fresh thyme. Spoon 1/4c jelly mixture atop jam and top with remaining bread crumbs. Bake 20 minutes.

title: Persian Pistachio Soup
ingredients: 7 cups chicken broth ( with meat ) | 3 tablespoons finely chopped pistachios | 1/2 cup finely chopped key lime juice
instructions: Heat broth until it simmers. Add pistachios and lime juice. Serve.

title: Irish Mist (Mouth Picking)
ingredients: 6 large ripe tomatoes | 1 cup raisins | 1 cup port wine ( or any port that stands up ) | 1/4 cup simple syrup ( made by s.o., in a hurry ) | 1 dash red food coloring | 1/2 cup whiskey ( optional )
instructions: Chop the tomatoes vertically. Place the tomatoes in a large pan with just enough water to cover them. The water doesn't float, so use a strainer to drain the tomatoes and tomatoes. Chop the raisins very finely. Place them in a pot with enough water to cover them. Place over high heat and bring to a boil. Lower the heat and simmer very gently for 30 minutes, or until a knife plunged through the center of each tomato has come out clean. Drain off any remaining water. The resulting sauce will be a glaze or a bitter. To the tomato mixture add the remaining ingredients. Mix well. Transfer the mixtures to a saucepan and place over medium high heat. Bring to a boil and boil rapidly for a few minutes, or until thickened. Reduce heat and serve hot or cold with ice cream or whipped cream.

title: Irish Stout Beer Chips
ingredients: 1/2 cup scallion | 12 ounces stout beer, such as guinness | 1 green scallion, chopped fine ( or to taste )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°f. Grease or line with baking paper a small chip tray that has been placed on a baking sheet. Cut the scallions into 1/4 inch pieces and set aside. Rinse and dry the beer. Cut each scallion into 1/4 inch lengths and set aside. Drop two chip chips into a small pot of salted water. As soon as the water starts to boil, remove from the heat and set them in a basket with a pair of napkins. The chips will float to the top of the water. They are done when they float to the top of the water. Remove from the pot of water and place on a parchment paper lined baking sheet, and drizzle the beer over the top. Sprinkle green scallion pieces on top. Bake for 15 minutes at 425°f until the scallions turn light gold brown.

title: Easy Spicy Cannoli
ingredients: 250 g ricotta cheese ( good quality, it's double what i do ) | 1 liter milk chocolate, good quality ( for the milk chocolate you're trying to drink. i use an 'x'chocolate chip ) | 1 can plum tomatoes
instructions: Get your 3 qt glass bowl out of the fridge, put on your big bowl of crushed ice and water and put in fridge till it starts to cool down a bit, add the can of diced plum tomatoes and the good quality ricotta cheese and mix well. Get the cannoli and put into the glass bowl that has the chocolate in it, put in your fridge till you are ready to eat. This goes great with any pasta dish or anything.

title: Acorn Squash
ingredients: 3 acorn squash, cut in half and seeded | 1 pound lean beef chuck, cut in 1/4-inch cubes
instructions: Pierce squash in 2 to 3 places with a sharp knife in a 3 inch star formation. Place on baking sheet about 3 inches apart. Bake in 350 degrees f oven for 1 hour, or until squash is tender.

title: Mimi's Baked Apples
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups flour | 2 tablespoons lard or 2 tablespoons crisco | 1 teaspoon savory | 2 tablespoons shortening | 2 cups tart apples | lime wedge
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Sift the flour into a mixing bowl and add 2 tablespoons of shortening & 2 teaspoons of savory. With your hands rub the flour over the surface with your fingers making sure it's well incorporated. Dough should resemble coarse crumbs or meal & dough should have the appearance of bread crumbs. Pour the fruit into a well greased pie plate. Roll out into a circle about 10 inches in diameter & cut into 8 wedges. Spread wedges out evenly on the bottom of the pie plate. Sprinkle the rest of the savory or thyme on top of the wedges. You might have to cut some into the dough at this time as it will release some of the tart juices if it's sitting too long. Bake until the apple mixture is lightly browned on the edges, about 45 minutes or more depending on the thickness of the apples.

title: Szechuan Beef Tenderloin Sandwiches
ingredients: 4 beef tenderloin, trimmed | 1 - 1 1/2 tablespoon szechuan hot bean sauce | 1 - 1 1/2 tablespoon szechuan-style bean sauce | 1 cup cooked pasta | bread, of your choice
instructions: Brush each tenderloin slice with szechuan peppercorns and place on a broiler pan. Broil 3 - 4 inches from the heat 3 - 4 minutes, depending on thickness of the cut. Remove beef from heat and cover to keep warm. To make sauce, heat 1/2tbsp of bean sauce in saucepan. In saucepan, heat remaining bean sauce and 1 tbs of sichuan style bean sauce. Spread each tenderloin slice with sauce.

Random Ingredients: dark brown sugar,chicken stock,gruyere cheese,maple syrup,spinach,vegetable bouillon,celery seed
title: Maple French Chicken Soup
ingredients: 5 cups chicken stock | 10 celery seeds | 6 ounces dry spinach, thawed and drained ( optional ) | 3 teaspoons dark brown sugar | 1/2 teaspoon maple syrup | 1 pinch instant vegetable bouillon ( optional ) | 1 -2 cup shredded gruyere cheese ( optional )
instructions: Boil all ingredients together until vegetables are tender. Serve with grated gruyere cheese and a sprinkling of maple syrup.

title: Savory Soused Steak
ingredients: 4 beef steaks | 1 package baby spinach | 1/4 cup chopped dried apricot | 3 tablespoons fresh thyme, and | 1 tablespoon fresh sage leaves
instructions: Heat your oven to 350 degrees f. Place the steaks on a sheet pan and spray with cooking spray. Spread the spinach evenly on the steaks. Combine the apricots, thyme and sage in a small bowl. Sprinkle this over the steaks. Spread the figsy herbs over all. Bake for 15 minutes or until cooked to your liking. Serve straight away.

Random Ingredients: red capsicum,cream mushroom soup,pork,pork loin,spice,salad oil,mustard,porcini mushroom
title: Spiced Pork
ingredients: 1 pork loin | 300 g chopped pork | 2 tablespoons salad oil | 1 jar mushrooms | 1 red capsicum | 2 teaspoons mixed spice | 1 packet porcini mushrooms | 4 tablespoons cream of mushroom soup
instructions: Cut the pork into thin slices and brown in a pan with the rest of the ingredients together stirring in the cream of mushroom soup. Serve with mashed potatoes.

Random Ingredients: black sticky rice,raisin,chinese red vinegar,red chili pepper,chili paste
title: Sweet Chilli Crusted Rice
ingredients: 2 cups sweet black sticky rice | 3 3/4 tablespoons chinese red vinegar or 3 3/4 tablespoons white vinegar | 3 1/2 tablespoons chili paste or 3 1/2 tablespoons sambal oelek | 1 1/2 tablespoons raisins or 1 1/2 tablespoons sultanas | 2 red chili peppers ( seeded and chopped ) or 1 seeded and chopped asian red chili pepper ( seeded and chopped )
instructions: Place 3 1/2 cup rice in a bowl with enough cold water to cover. Soak for 5 mins, drain. Heat a heavy based pan or wok over high heat, add 1 tablespoon oil and then swirl to coat. Toss 2/3 cup rice with chili paste and fry quickly until golden in colour. Transfer to a dish. Repeat the process, adding more oil as needed and reheating the wok between batches, tilting the pan so it doesn't catch on any rice. Add remaining rice and stir fry until lightly browned and just tender. Stir through raisins or sambal chilies and serve immediately.

title: Mexican Watermelon Bean Salad With Beets and Black Beans(Vegetarian)
ingredients: 1 can black beans, drained and rinsed | 1 can baked beans ( vegetarian -see note below ) | 1 can mixed beans ( vegetarian -see note below ) | 1/4 cup watermelon, flesh of | 1 cup fat-free refried beans | 1/4 cup dark brown sugar, packed | 1 teaspoon dried marjoram | 1/2 cup cilantro leaf, chopped or 1/2 cup parsley, minced
instructions: Note, use black beans with no seasoning added, and can be drained and rinsed. In a bowl, combine the black beans, baked beans, mixed beans, watermelon cubes, refried beans and dark brown sugar, marjoram and cilantro or parsley.

title: Apple Mac N Cheese
ingredients: 1 cup elbow macaroni | 2 cans apple juice | 1 jalapeno pepper - seeded, deribbed, and finely chopped
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add macaroni, and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

Random Ingredients: lite olive oil,ketjap manis,creole seasoning,yellow pepper
title: Sweet & Long Green Peppers
ingredients: 1/4 cup ketchup, heinz's | 2 tablespoons creole seasoning | 1 yellow pepper | 2 tablespoons lite olive oil
instructions: Preheat pan on medium heat for 2 minutes, add butter and olive oil and cook peppers until soft and lightly caramelized on all sides. Put on paper towel and drizzle olive oil over peppers, sprinkle with creole seasoning and let sauteed for 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: cranberry,cauliflower,basil pesto,vanilla sugar,green cardamom pod,red onion,baby artichoke,gingerroot
title: Creamy Cranachan-Pesto Cauliflower Salad
ingredients: 1 cup pure cranberry vinegar or 1 cup white wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon pure vanilla sugar | 1/4 teaspoon fresh gingerroot, grated | 1 green cardamom pod | 1 lb fresh baby artichokes, rinsed, trimmed and chopped | 1 medium cauliflower, rinsed, trimmed and chopped | 1/2 cup chopped red onion | 3/4 cup basil pesto
instructions: In a small pan over medium high heat, bring vinegar to a low simmer. Add sugar, vanilla and cardamom and continue to simmer for about 1 minute. Remove from heat and add ginger and artichokes. Cover and chill until ready to serve. To serve, in a large bowl, mix cauliflower, red onion, and pesto. Pour dressing over salad and toss to coat. Sprinkle with dried basil and serve.

Random Ingredients: ginger garlic paste,black pepper,asparagus,dark soy sauce,season salt,parmesan cheese,dill pickle
title: Gingery Beef
ingredients: 1 lb lean top sirloin steak, cut 1 1/2-inch thick | 1 1/2 teaspoons fresh ginger-garlic paste, grated | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1/4 teaspoon fresh ground black pepper | 24 spears asparagus, trimmed | 1 -2 -6 slice dill pickle, cut into 8 very thin slices | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce
instructions: Combine steak seasoning and pepper in a small bowl. Place beef in a resealable plastic bag, pour in marinade. Close bag and massage bag to mix well. Refrigerate overnight. Preheat grill. Remove beef from bag, reserving marinade. Remove beef from bag, discard marinade and grill on one side until just barely pink. Turn and grill on other side. About 3 - 5 minutes. If flare ups appear, cook longer or less to achieve desired result. Meanwhile, steam asparagus for 3 - 5 minutes until crisp tender. Serve on lettuce with pickle slices and pickles.

title: Asparagus in Foil Sauce (Zwt II)
ingredients: 1 lb fresh asparagus | 2 eggs | 1 dash bicarbonate of soda | 1/2 cup breadcrumbs | 3 tablespoons catsup | fruit
instructions: In a pan add 1/4 cup cold water, stir in bicarb of soda. Cut asparagus and fry with lid on until soft. In the meantime beat eggs with a fork and then add catsup and mix well. Drain well and mix in the cooked asparagus. To serve sprinkle breadcrumbs and fruits on top and enjoy.

title: Grilled Southwestern Potatoes for Two
ingredients: 2 cups packed small red potatoes | 1 tablespoon dried red pepper, crushed | 2 tablespoons molasses
instructions: Preheat your grill or oven to 425 degrees f. In a small bowl, thoroughly combine the red potatoes and crushed red pepper. Sprinkle the mixture over the potatoes and toss gently to distribute evenly. Place the potato skewers on the grill, and grill the potatoes on high heat for 6 to 8 minutes, tossing halfway through, until tender. Remove the skewered potatoes from the grill and serve right away.

Random Ingredients: cooking oil,ketchup,catsup,red wine vinegar,ice water,mustard powder,hamburger,plain flour
title: The Best Burger
ingredients: 1 lb minced hamburger | 1/2 cup plain flour | 1 tablespoon dry mustard powder | 2/3 cup ketchup | 1/4 cup red wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons catsup | 1 tablespoon cooking oil | 1 cup crushed ice water
instructions: In a bowl or a bowl, mix together the hamburger, flour, mustard powder and ketchup. Stir in vinegar, catsup and oil. Stir in water a tablespoon at a time, until evenly moistened. Form into 6 patties. Grill over moderate heat 3 - 4 minutes per side for medium rare, or about 4 minutes per side depending on your preference. Top with your favourite toppings, such as ketchup and sour cream.

Random Ingredients: cabbage leaf,pepper flake,burrito flour tortilla,vanilla wafer,sugar snap pea,chicken thigh,dill,barbecue sauce
title: Quick Chicken & Cal Slaw Wraps #5FIX
ingredients: 2 cups finely shredded cabbage leaves | 1/2 teaspoon hot pepper flakes | 10 ounces boneless skinless chicken thighs, cut in 2-inch pieces | 1 cup finely chopped pepper snap peas, thawed | 3/4 cup barbecue sauce | 1/4 cup coarsely chopped fresh dill | 2 teaspoons granulated sugar-free quick-cooking sugar substitute | 10 burrito-size flour tortillas | purchased low sodium prepared barbecue sauce, heated
instructions: Prepare 12 burrito size flour tortillas, wrap in foil, place in a 300 degree oven for 10 minutes, or until crisp. Meanwhile, in a medium bowl, mix the cabbage, pepper flakes, chicken, pepper snap peas, barbecue sauce and dill. Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Coat pan with cooking spray. Add the warm tortillas to the pan one at a time, and cook for 1 minute per side. Repeat with the remaining tortillas. Serve with the prepared barbecue sauce.

Random Ingredients: active yeast,flour tortilla,tomato paste,ice,salad oil,apricot preserve pineapple,fajita seasoning,dill weed
title: Fajita Pizza With Smokin' Hot and Sweet!
ingredients: 8 flour tortillas | 1 1/2 cups apricot preserves or 1 1/2 cups pineapple preserves | 10 -12 tablespoons tomato paste ( i use a little more to taste ) | 1 1/2 cups ice | 2 -3 tablespoons fajita seasoning ( or homemade ) | 2 -3 tablespoons dry active yeast | 1/4 cup salad oil | 1 teaspoon dill weed
instructions: Combine the preserves, tomato paste, flour, ice, fajita seasoning, yeast, and salad oil. Set aside in a warm spot for approximately 30 minutes. When all is cool, cut into 8 equal parts, about 3 x 1/2 x 1/2 and set aside. To make the pizza, lightly oil the surface of each tortilla. Spread desired amount of the pizza sauce over each tortilla. Sprinkle top with cheese, herbs, etc. If desired, sprinkle a bit of cheese on top. Wrap each tortilla in a double layer of plastic wrap and place in the freezer for 3 hours. After defrosting, bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes, until crust is browned outside. Remove from oven and slice into thin half moons.

title: Rice with Fennel and Onions
ingredients: 1 cup white rice, washed and drained | 1 cup peanut oil or 1 cup canola oil | 1 tablespoon ground fennel | 1/2 teaspoon hot paprika | 3 cups fennel greens
instructions: Wash all the rice well under running water in a rice cooker, or wash and dry thoroughly in your hands. Heat a non stick pan on medium. Add about half liter of water and when it starts boiling, add the rice. When it starts to boil, turn the heat to very low, cover it, and leave it for 20 to 25 minutes depending on the weather and type of rice used. You can always take it off the stove at any point. In the morning, wash and dry the fennel properly, then slice them finely. Heat the oil in a nonstick pan on low heat. When the pan is hot add the fennel. Stir constantly. Add the paprika, stir. Keep stirring till the fennel turns golden brown and crisp. It will only take about 5 minutes or so. Add the rice. Keep stirring till the rice turns creamy. Add the fried fennel and turn off the flame. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: pork tenderloin,baby spinach leaf,okra,lemon,red enchilada sauce
title: Shredded Pork Medallions With Okra
ingredients: 1 jar red enchilada sauce | 1 1/2 lbs pork tenderloins, cooked, shredded | 1 package frozen okra, thawed and sliced | 1 package frozen baby spinach leaves, thawed | 2 lemons or 2 limes, cut into wedges
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the green enchilada sauce and the remaining ingredients. Stir until well mixed. Set aside. Place pork tenderloins on a broiler pan coated with cooking spray and broil 7 inches from the heat for about 15 minutes or until cooked through. Cover with foil and let the pork stand 5 minutes. Place meat on a cutting board and slice into 1/4 inch to 1/2 inch slices. Serve the pork on heated plates with some green or white sauce on the side.

title: Nino's Beef Stew
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb steak, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 large yellow onion, coarsely chopped | 3 -5 medium potatoes, cut into 1-inch chunks | 1 1/4 cups fish stock or 1 1/4 cups fish juice
instructions: In a large frying pan saute onion in about 1/3 cup water until golden brown. Add meat, stir well to coat. Add all remaining ingredients. Bring to boil. Turn down to simmer.

title: Eggnog French Toast Sandwich
ingredients: 2 large eggsnog ( preferably eggnog-i recommend eggnog eggnog for this recipe ) | 4 large cremini mushrooms, sliced | 1/2 - 3/4 cup grated gruyere cheese | jalapeno or chipotle sauce with hot peppers, to taste ( optional )
instructions: In a medium mixing bowl, whisk eggs until lightly frothy. Grate in cheese and jalepeno pepper, if using.

title: Magic Dragon Rolls
ingredients: 2 sheets nori ( seaweed, white or brown ) | 8 ounces linguine ( or spaghetti ) | 1 tablespoon vanilla extract | 10 -15 portobello mushrooms or 10 -15 any other mushroom ( optional )
instructions: Wash the mushrooms in warm water. Chop and remove stems of mushroom caps. Wrap individually in small sheets of nori which got soaked in warm water. Place them in a steamer over the hot water of your choice and steam for 2 - 3 minutes. Meanwhile, cook the linguine in a large pot of salted boiling water. In a small bowl, combine the vanilla and vanilla until well blended and frothy. Drain the linguine, or use a bowl of spaghetti cooking liquid for the water. Heat the mushrooms in a small saute pan over medium heat. Remove a portion of the caps and mash lightly. You want a medium heat. Dredge 1 strip of nori over the mushroom/egg mixture and quickly roll into a long snake of sorts on the nori. Place them seam side down onto a warm plate. Wash your hands and wipe the cloth from the mushroom mixture. Use a pastry brush to stick 3 - 6 pieces of nori on the mushroom top. Slide the roll out into the steamer. Repeat with the remaining pieces of nori. Cook until the pasta is ready. Serve at once.

title: Gruyère Poached Cheese
ingredients: 50 g gruyere cheese, grated | 1/4 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 1 -2 lime wedge | 50 ml shaoxing wine
instructions: In a mixing bowl add the cheese, bicarb of soda and a few turns of the heat on medium. Stir, and leave until bubbling and soft. Add the lime. Pour the wine slowly, stirring and leave until the liquid is reduced slightly. Once the liquid is reduced, add the cheese and leave until it starts to melt. Serve.

title: Gated Green Pea Salad
ingredients: 1 lb fresh peas, cleaned | 1 green pepper, deseeded and finely chopped | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1/4 cup sweet and spicy steak sauce
instructions: Cook peas the way you would cooked your meal. Cool in cold water. Blend the peas and peppers with the sweet and spicy steak sauce. Chill for 30 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: new york,hot chili pepper,asparagus,marinade,deli ham,kale,olive oil
title: Spiced New York Strip Steak
ingredients: 1 new york strip steaks | 6 tablespoons marinade | 3 tablespoons olive oil | 2 hot chili peppers | 1 pound fresh asparagus | 1 pound fresh kale | 1 pound shaved deli ham
instructions: Place steak between 2 sheets of plastic wrap. Firmly pound with a meat mallet to 1/4 inch thickness. Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. Cook and stir chilies in hot oil until lightly browned, about 20 minutes. Mix marinade and the remaining ingredients in a bowl. Place steaks in the marinade and let sate at room temperature. Cover and refrigerate 30 minutes to 1 to 3 hours. Remove steaks from refrigerator and drain excess marinade. Place steaks on a grill and cook to desired doneness, 3 to 5 minutes per side for medium rare, or internal temperature of 140 degrees f, or 145 degrees f for medium well. Heat the grill for high heat. Place grilled steak on a hot grill and top with ham, asparagus, and kale. Cover and grill until heated through and beginning to wilt, 5 to 10 minutes.

title: Simply Fajita Chips
ingredients: 5 -6 large corn tortillas ( depending on how hot you like them ) | 1 tablespoon cachaça | 1 tablespoon hot salsa ( or more depending on how strong you like it ) or 1 tablespoon medium hot salsa ( or more depending on how strong you like it ) | 1 tablespoon curry paste | 1/4 cup watercress ( optional ) | guacamole ( opt )
instructions: Dip the tortillas in the cachaça, then arrange them on a microwave proof platter. Heat the salsa/spice in a shallow pot. Add the curry paste. Spray the tortilla with oil so it won't stick. Scatter some watercress over the tortillas and let stand 5 - 6 minutes. Slice the tortillas and serve. If desired, serve extra watercress on the side.

title: Fried Bread Crumbs
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups breadcrumbs | 1 tablespoon oil | 1/2 cup almond meal | 2 tablespoons dry sherry | 1 1/4 cups cooking oil | 1/2 cup almonds
instructions: Soak almonds in sherry. Mix crumbs with oil, sherry and almonds. Form into small balls and flatten slightly with floured hands. Deep fry in hot oil 2 - 3 minutes, turning a few times. Serve with syrup, cream or ice cream.

Random Ingredients: chickpea,cocoa powder,raspberry,red enchilada sauce,maple syrup,olive oil,leg lamb
title: Chocolate-Chili Glazed Glazed Leg of Lamb
ingredients: 2 1/2 - 3 lbs leg of lamb, whole | 2 cups diced ripe raspberries | 2 tablespoons pure maple syrup ( or other cooking sauce you prefer ) | 2 tablespoons red enchilada sauce, your choice ( bottled ) | 2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder | 1 tablespoon light corn syrup | 1 tablespoon olive oil | 1/4 cup chopped fresh raspberry
instructions: Rinse lamb under cold water. Pat dry with paper towel and slice 1/3 to 1/2 inch thick across the grain. Arrange lamb in a shallow, nonreactive baking pan. Whisk first 3 ingredients together in a bowl and drizzle over lamb. Cover and chill lamb in refrigerator, covered, at least 3 hours and up to overnight. Preheat oven to 325°f. Place lamb on rack in roasting pan or on large baking sheet. Add remaining 1/3 to 1/2 inch of meat juices to roasting rack in roasting pan, drizzle with maple syrup, and set aside until lamb begins to baste with juices. Roast lamb 1 hour, turning once. Turn lamb in pan juices. Continue baking 30 minutes. The glaze.

title: Creamy Pecan Cheese Dip
ingredients: 1 cup sour cream | 1 1/2 cups pecan halves, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons dried italian-style basil garlic and oregano
instructions: In a medium bowl, blend the sour cream with the pecans and italian style herb garlic. Stir in the dried italian parsley. Cover and chill for flavors to combine, at least 2 hours.

title: Puerco Espagnole (Pork Filled Green Peppers)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs lean boneless pork butt | 1 lb puerco country-style green bell pepper
instructions: Cut pork in 2 inch cubes and place in a large pan. Add remaining ingredients and bring to a boil. Reduce heat, cover and simmer 45 minutes. Remove cover and simmer an additional 25 minutes.

title: Sweet and Sour Quinoa
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups dry rice | 2 large golden onions, chopped | 3 tablespoons golden syrup | 2 tablespoons white wine or 2 tablespoons coconut milk | 3/4 cup golden raisins
instructions: Combine all ingredients and bring to the boil. Cover and reduce heat and simmer slowly for 40 - 50 minutes, stirring frequently. Check consistency and cook further 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: liquid smoke,cake flour,cornmeal,string bean,tart apple,plain yogurt,chili paste
title: String-Bean Flatbreads With Szechuan Flavours
ingredients: 1/2 tablespoon cake flour | 1/2 teaspoon chili paste | 2 tablespoons plain yogurt | 1/2 teaspoon liquid smoke | 1 can sliced tart apples ( the kind with peel or not, your choice ) | 2 tablespoons cornmeal, plus extra for dusting | 1 3/4 lbs french string beans, ends trimmed, cut into 2-inch pieces
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°, or prepare a baking sheet with olive oil cooking spray on the sides. Lightly spray oil with cooking spray. Place the flour, chili paste, and yogurt in a small bowl and combine. Spread the apples on a piece of waxed paper or baking sheet, leaving a 2 in space at the top. In a second small bowl, mix the liquid smoke with the cornmeal. Add about 1 tablespoon of the liquid smoke mixture to the remaining liquid smoke mixture and spread over the apples. Sprinkle half of the cornmeal over the top. Turn on the oven and immediately place the baking sheet in the middle of the oven. Bake until lightly browned, about 10 minutes. Cool on the sheet and serve warm or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: eye chile,tequila,pork roast,chicken stock cube,bean sprout,elbow macaroni,sharp cheddar cheese
title: Quick Smoky Beef Mac (South Africa) (Gluten Free)
ingredients: 600 g beef eye chiles | 1 1/2 kg pork roast or 1 1/2 kg blade of meat | 100 g elbow macaroni | 1 1/2 liters chicken stock ( or 2 litre vegetable stock cubes ) | 1/2 tequila | 1/2 bunch english spinach sprouts, blanched, peeled and washed ( to garnish ) | 1/2 cup finely grated sharp cheddar cheese
instructions: Chop the chillies and place in a blender with the beef and process until very finely chopped. Add the beans, macaroni and stock in a pan and cover and simmer for 20 minutes or until the macaroni is cooked and all the water has mostly evaporated. Once cooked, add the meat, reduce heat and simmer until the meat is tender. Pour into a warmed serving dish, sprinkle with the remaining cheese and cook over hot coals for 10 - 15 minutes or until the cheese is melted and starting to turn golden. Serve with white rice. Random Ingredients: active yeast,shell pasta,mustard,italian hoagie bun,cardamom powder
title: Italian Bread Rolls
ingredients: 1 1/2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 1 1/2 teaspoons mustard | 1 1/2 teaspoons cardamom powder | 1 1/4 lbs shell pasta ( bow tie, shell, farfalle, or rigatoni ) | 12 large soft hoagie buns
instructions: Biga, in a mixing bowl, dissolve yeast in ¾ cup warm water. Stir in mustard, cardamom, and ¾ cup water. Cover and let sit approximately 30 min until creamy. Bring to a boil, stirring occasionally. Cut large shells in half leaving 2 halves. Fill each shell with about 2 - 3 t. Olive oil, leaving about ½ inch shell for tops. Drain. Prepare rolls, lightly oil one 12” x 18” or 1 1/2” jelly roll pan. Place the pasta shells on the bottom of the pan. Evenly sprinkle some meat and tomato mixture on the shells and top with remaining bread halves. Cover and let rise in a warm place about 1 1/2 hours. After the dough has risen, preheat oven to 425°f degrees. Bake bread for about 15 minutes. Remove loaf and pan from oven and spray with cooking spray. Bake an additional 10 minutes until top is golden. To serve, invert one slice onto a plate.

title: Mexican Chocolate Sun Dried Tomato
ingredients: 4 ounces mexican chocolate, broken into pieces | 3 ounces sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained
instructions: Place the chocolate in a bowl. Heat a skillet over high heat, and add the sun dried tomatoes. Cook, stirring constantly, until heated through, about 2 minutes. Remove from the pan and serve.

title: Alcapurri Puerto Rico Beef Stew
ingredients: 6 dried ancho chilies, or more to taste ( optional ) | 1/2 lemon, juiced | 3 tablespoons sesame oil | 1 pound boneless beef chuck, cut into 1-inch cubes
instructions: Roast the ancho chilies over an open flame or under the broiler until skin loosens, 1 to 2 minutes. Smash chilies with the flat side of a spoon and transfer the chilies to a bowl. Return chilies and juice to the same bowl. Heat sesame oil in a skillet over medium heat. Cook the beef in hot oil until browned, 3 to 5 minutes. Spoon beef and accumulated juices over the cooked chilies.

title: Chapli Prawn Paties
ingredients: 12 large prawns, shelled and deveined | 1 1/2 tablespoons turmeric powder | 2 -3 teaspoons green peppercorns, crushed
instructions: Place 1/3 prawns in a large flat dish or bowl. Add the turmeric powder, 2 cups water and mix well. Add this mix to the prawns and mix well until it turns pink. Cover the bowl or bowl tightly and refrigerate for 1 hour. Sprinkle the crushed peppercorns before serving. Store out all except oil and garnish of patty and green chilies in an air tight container.

title: Italian Sausage Sandwich Melt With Bread Option
ingredients: 12 ounces hot italian sausage | 4 slices bread, your choice
instructions: Pre heat your oven to 550 degrees. You will be frying your bread option in a skillet on the stove. Slice your hot sausage into four pieces. Spray with the spray spray. Place in a frying pan and cook over medium heat, you will need to add a tablespoon or two of spray to fry when frying. When the meat is fully cooked, turn off the heat and place the slices of bread in your fried pan with the sausage. Top each slice of bread with a little more spray of your choice of cheese. Place in the pre heated microwave for approximately 3 minutes or until toasted. You may need to replace the pan half way through. This is good served hot with pasta or pizza.

title: Curried Yellow Squash With Cashew
ingredients: 2 tablespoons margarine | 1 large yellow squash | 1 tablespoon oil | 1 teaspoon curry powder | 2 teaspoons low-fat soymilk | 1 cup cashews | 1/3 cup lettuce leaf | 1 lemon, juice of
instructions: Slice and par boil the squash in its skin until softened. This will take about 15 - 25 minutes. Let cool and cut it into slices. Preheat the oven to 300°f. In a bowl, mix the margarine, oil, curry powder and soymilk. Mix in the cashews and let them soak in the liquid. Layer half of the cashew mixture in a shallow baking tray and spread evenly over the squash. Layer the remaining cashew mixture on top and add the rest of the squash on top of that. Brush the squash lightly with lemon juice, season with salt and add more curry powder if desired.

Random Ingredients: green bell pepper,pepperoni,ranch dressing mix,red food coloring,honey,escarole
title: Crock Pot Pepperoni Salad
ingredients: 1 package ranch dressing mix ( hidden valley & reg ; original ranch & reg ; dressing mix ) | 4 medium green bell peppers, seeded and cut into strips | 1 large red bell pepper, seeded and cut into strips | 1/2 lb pepperoni ( thinly sliced deli reduced fat deli style ) | 1/4 lb escarole ( washed and spun dry using a towel ) | 1/2 teaspoon pepperoni ( deli style finely chopped ) | 1 -2 drop red food coloring
instructions: Place all ingredients except pepperoni and escarole in the crock pot. Cover and cook on low for 8 - 10 hours, until peppers and escarole are falling apart. Add pepperoni and pepperoni and mix to combine. Add food coloring to desired level of desired hue and garnish with extra pepperoni as desired. Yields about 2 salads.

title: Quinoa With Bananas, Coconut and Sage
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa | 1 cup coconut cream, unsweetened | 1 banana, sliced | 1 sprig fresh sage, leaves picked | 2 sage leaves
instructions: Place quinoa in a bowl and cover with 2 cups of water and let stand 10 minutes. Drain. Wash and dry the pot and put on high heat. Add quinoa, coconut cream and the banana. Bring contents to a boil, then simmer, covered, for 15 minutes. Remove the lid, stir in the sage and serve.

title: Mexican Steakhouse Mojo
ingredients: 2 lbs center-cut steaks, 1-inch thick | 1/2 cup tahini | 2 tablespoons instant coffee | 1 tablespoon rice vinegar | 2 teaspoons fresh ground lime juice | 1/2 teaspoon cumin powder | 1/3 cup milk
instructions: Place marinade ingredients and steak in a freezer bag. Remove air spaces and close tightly. Marinade in the refrigerator at least 1 hour, turning bag twice. Remove steaks from bag and discard marinade from bag. Drain meat.

title: Guacamole With Hominy
ingredients: 1 lime, juice of | 8 tablespoons margarine or 8 tablespoons butter, for sauteing | 1 teaspoon celery seed | 1 can cooked hominy | 1 small green bell pepper, chopped | 1 can guacamole
instructions: Chop the onion and pepper. Brown onion and pepper until just translucent. Add salt to taste. Add all other ingredients except guacamole and heat all together until mixture just simmers. Serve over rice or as is or with tortilla chips or as is. We like ours a bit thinner than a traditional taco/tortilla chip/fajita chipotle. Note, this recipe can also be mixed with finely chopped onion/peppers or tomato/chili flakes which makes it even better.

Random Ingredients: italian sausage,cinnamon,plain flour,rice vermicelli,bicarbonate soda,red pepper,farfalle pasta,chicken thigh
title: Pasta With Sausages, Chicken and Fresh Meat
ingredients: 600 g boneless skinless chicken thighs | 150 g cooked farfalle pasta | 150 g sweet italian sausage, sliced | 1 pinch bicarbonate of soda | 1/2 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 1 teaspoon cinnamon | 275 g fresh rice vermicelli | 3 -4 tablespoons plain flour
instructions: Heat oven to 180c/325f/gas season chicken with bicarb soda, bicarbonate of soda and cinnamon. Place in a roasting tin large enough to hold them in a single layer. Place on a foil lined baking tray and bake in a medium temperature oven for 1 1/2 hours. Remove from oven and allow to cool slightly, then slice into fingers. While the chicken is cooking, cook the pasta until al dente.. Drain the pasta, place in a large bowl and toss. Add the sausage, cooked chicken, and cooked farfalle, mix well. Spoon into 1 large ovenproof dish, cover and cook in the preheated oven for 30 minutes or until cooked through and bubbling. Stir the cooked and heated pasta, meat and sauce, and serve.

title: Molho de Queso Con Queso (White Bread With Cheese)
ingredients: 8 ounces fontina cheese or 8 ounces muenster cheese, finely grated | 4 serrano peppers, minced | 1 1/2 cups unbleached white flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. In a mixing bowl, mash the cheese with a fork. Stir in the serrano chili. Add the flour and mix well. Divide the dough in two, working with one piece at a time. Roll out onto a lightly floured surface into circles about 1/2 wide and 1/4 thick. Using a sharp, floured razor blade, cut out the rounds from the dough. Lay them on a lightly floured baking sheet. Poke a circular hole in the center of each round using a finger. Brush tops with melted butter. Bake for about 15 minutes or until lightly browned.

Random Ingredients: fruit,shrimp,serrano pepper,saffron,quinoa,kaffir lime leaf,beef sirloin steak,potato
title: Persian Beef and Potato Stew
ingredients: 1 lb beef sirloin steak, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 small potato, cut in half and cut into cubes | 1 serrano pepper, finely chopped | 1 lb shrimp ( frozen or fresh shelled and deveined ) | 1 tablespoon saffron ( i use zatarains persian seasoning ) | 1 pinch powdered saffron, for garnish ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon kaffir lime leaf ( optional ) | 1 cup raw quinoa, rinsed and rinsed with cold water | 1 cup dried fruit, such as kahlaf
instructions: Boil the water and add salt to the water. Once the water is boiling, add the quinoa. Drain the water and then add the drained quinoa to the water. Allow the water to come to a boil again and then immediately add the shrimp. Cook the shrimp in the water for about 4 minutes. Once the shrimp has cooked through, add the serrano pepper. Cook until they turn pink, then drain them on paper towels. In a pot with lid, place the beef, potato and saffron. Mix well and cook on medium heat until the beef and potatoes are cooked, about 9 - 10 minutes. Add the zatarains hot powder and lime leaves. When all vegetables are cooked, add the raw quinoa, stir a couple of times, cover and remove from heat. Let stand 5 - 10 minutes. Sprinkle the dried fruits on top of the stew and serve immediately. You can also serve this stew at room temperature over steamed rice.

title: Spaghetti Bowl
ingredients: 2 tablespoons chili-garlic sauce | 4 cups spaghetti sauce | 2 bay leaves | 1/2 cup chopped cilantro | 1 cup crushed ice
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. In a bowl, mix the chili garlic sauce and spaghetti sauce until well blended. Place bay leaves in a separate bowl. Rinse the cilantro thoroughly, pat dry with paper towel and coarsely chop. Layer the sauce in the bottom of a glass dish with a layer of crushed ice. Pour the spaghetti mixture over a layer, then pour the crushed ice over the top. Let stand for about 5 minutes then stir and serve.

Random Ingredients: meat beef,tomato soup,baguette,lamb loin chop,cardamom,whipping cream,cooking spray
title: Grecian Lamb Loins
ingredients: 1 baguette, cut into 4 6 long slices | cooking spray | 16 lamb loin chops | 1 can condensed tomato soup | 1/4 cup whipping cream | 1/8 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1 lb boneless and trimmed lean deli-style stew meat ( or beef )
instructions: Lightly spray a heavy skillet with cooking oil spray. Place chops on skillet. Bake 7 - 10 minutes per side or until browned and cooked throughout. Remove from skillet and keep warm. Stir soup, cream, cardamom and seasoning. Simmer 5 minutes until heated through and thickened slightly. Arrange lamb on warmed slices of baguette with soup mixture. Spoon hot soup mixture in a spoke pattern across lamb. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: brown rice,cashew butter,cooking oil,double cream,date,garlic clove,prosciutto
title: Cashew, Rice and Prosciutto Stuffing
ingredients: 1 cup brown rice ( or long grain or basmati ) | 2 tablespoons butter | 1 teaspoon cooking oil | 2 garlic cloves, crushed | 3 slices prosciutto, thinly sliced | 1 cup cashew butter | 1 cup double cream
instructions: Cook the rice with half the butter and the oil in a saucepan, uncovered, over a moderate heat for 10 minutes until just tender and dry, stirring occasionally. Stir in the garlic and half the prosciutto. Set aside to cool slightly. Mix all of the ingredients together in a food processor until just incorporated. Scoop into ovenproof casserole, cover and bake in the oven at 190°c/375°f/gas 4 for 30 minutes, topping off with the cream when cooked.

title: Asparagus and Vanilla Beans
ingredients: 18 1/2 ounces frozen asparagus | 1/4 cup pure vanilla bean, seeds
instructions: Cover frozen asparagus and vanilla beans with hot water in a large saucepan over medium high heat. Cover and cook until asparagus is tender, 2 to 3 minutes. Reduce heat to low, cover, and cook until asparagus is completely soft, 3 to 5 minutes. Drain asparagus, reserving asparagus cooking water, in a medium saucepan over medium high heat. Add vanilla beans, stir, and cook until heated, 2 to 3 minutes. Remove vanilla beans, reserving aspargus cooking water.

title: Prawn Calabrese
ingredients: 1/2 lb medium shrimp paste, thawed | 3 tablespoons cornstarch | 1 pizza crust, unbaked | 1/4 cup plum tomato, thinly sliced | 2 ounces prepared fried dumplings or 2 ounces shrimp paste | ice, for serving
instructions: Heat oven to 400°f. Mix the shrimp paste and 2 tablespoons of cornstarch in a mixing bowl. Spread the mixture into the pizza crust, then top with tomato slices, dumplings and fried bits of shrimp paste. Bake 10 to 15 minutes or until crisp and golden brown.

title: Garam Masala
ingredients: 1 cup coriander seed | 1 cardamom | 3 2 cups hot broth or 3 cups water
instructions: Put all ingredients up to and including salt and sugar in a pan. Heat slowly to a low boil, cover and simmer 45 minutes. Cool and use as a flavouring for vegetable salads.

title: Langley's Full-Scrumptious Lasagne
ingredients: 600 g pork ( cubed ) | 200 g lasagna noodles | 375 ml heavy whipping cream | 2 teaspoons bicarbonate of soda | 3 ounces currants, toasted if you like
instructions: Pre heat oven to 220c and put a pan of water on the bottom of the oven. Put the chops in a bowl with the currants and mix. You need the excess fat from cooking and any excess fat to brown the meat. Add the cream and bicarb soda to the meat mix and put on a simmer. Add the lasagne and cover. Put in oven and bake for about 1 hour. Check from time to time, and make sure it isn’t sticking to the pan. When it’s done, the noodles should be starting to break apart. You may need to cover with a lid halfway through the cooking time to keep it from drying out.

title: Coconut Nuts With Strawberry Sauce
