ingredients: 2 cups walnuts or 2 cups pecans, toasted, finely diced | 1 package fresh strawberries | 1 package thawed and finely diced canned pineapple chunks in juice, drained | 1 1/2 cups cooking oil | 2 -4 tablespoons curry powder | 2 cups sugar, divided ( or to taste ) | 1/4 cup flaked coconut | 1 -2 tablespoon sliced walnuts, for decoration
instructions: Combine walnuts and strawberries in a large bowl and toss to coat. Toss in pineapple and remaining ingredients except the walnuts. Cover and chill for about a half hour to allow flavors to marry and flavors to blend. Slicing yields about 3 cups filling. Serve chilled garnished with walnuts.

title: Fiery Crock Pot Lamb Chops
ingredients: 20 slices white bread | 1 can chopped green chilies, drained | 1 kg lamb
instructions: Arrange 2 slices of bread on the bottom of your crock and layer with half of the green chillies, then half of the lamb. Repeat and layer remaining ingredients. Cover and cook on low for 4 - 5 hours. Turn the crock pot to high and serve.

Random Ingredients: enchilada sauce,leg lamb,parmesan cheese,stir fry sauce,onion,asparagus
title: Crock Pot Lamb Casserole
ingredients: 1 lb boneless leg of lamb | 1 tablespoon finely chopped onion | 1 can enchilada sauce | 1/4 - 1/2 cup stir-fry sauce ( i use the chili gravy ) | 1/2 cup parmesan cheese, grated | 1 can asparagus or ( 16 ounce ) can spinach, drained
instructions: Brown lamb with chopped onion in butter in skillet. Remove lamb and pour off fat. Combine remaining ingredients in crock pot and stir until blended. Put lamb in crock pot.

Random Ingredients: worcestershire sauce,almond paste,coffee,ginger ale,beef bouillon,green pea,yukon gold potato
title: Scottish Potato and Moist Beef Curry
ingredients: 1 kg yukon gold potato, washed and peeled | 1 tablespoon ginger ale | 500 g coarsely chopped beef bouillon | 2 teaspoons worcestershire sauce | 1 tablespoon coffee ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons slivered almonds | 1 teaspoon frozen green peas, thawed ( optional ) or 1 teaspoon julienned dried green pea ( optional )
instructions: Steam the potato for 15 - 20 minutes, or until just tender. While you are awaiting for the potatoes to cool enough to handle, boil your beef broth and water. Add the ginger ale and beef bouillon and stir together until the beef flavor dissolves. When ready to cook the potato, drain the potatoes and add to the boiling beef broth. Return to the boil. After a few minutes add the rest of the ingredients and give everything a good stir. Cook another 2 - 3 minutes.

title: Quinoa-Baked in a Cast Iron or Spanish "casserole"
ingredients: 2 cups dry quinoa | 1 cup dark brown sugar | 2 cups bottled salsa ( your choice ) | 1/2 teaspoon crushed cardamom seed | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt | 3/4 cup shelled pistachios, crushed
instructions: In a medium bowl, wash and rins rice well. Sprinkle 3/4 cup of the dark brown sugar over quinoa. Top with 3 tablespoons of the salsa and 3/4 cup of the pistachios. Pour rice over all and press down evenly. Cover and let stand for 1 hour. Preheat oven to 300 degrees fahrenheit. Drain rinsed rice on paper towels and spread out in a 9x13 inch casserole, sprinkling lightly with more of the dark brown sugar. Bake in a preheated oven for 45 minutes, stirring every 10 minutes and adding more salsa as needed. After 45 minutes, you should see a small, browned, sticky ball.

title: Jerk-Pepper-Simmered Spread
ingredients: 2 tablespoons peanut oil | 1 tablespoon tomato paste | 1 teaspoon habanero peppers ( or to taste ) or 1 teaspoon paprika, pureed | 1 teaspoon dried thyme sprigs | 2 tablespoons guacamole
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together on a medium sized bowl. Transfer the mixture to a food processor or blender. Blend on low to medium speed until a fairly smooth paste forms. Transfer to a medium sized glass or plastic container. Cover and chill at least 8 hours or overnight. Store refrigerated in the refrigerator.

title: Pesto and Lentils With Dairy-Free Tofu
ingredients: 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 1 tablespoon pesto sauce | 150 g brown lentils or 150 g yellow lentils, rinsed, picked over, picked over, and picked over | 200 g extra firm tofu
instructions: Heat the oil in a pan, then add the lentils and fry until they are starting to colour. Be very careful not to burn the oil, as this recipe is fairly oily. Toss in the pesto, then add the tofu. Toss briefly until heated through. Serve with toasted bread, if desired.

Random Ingredients: breakfast sausage link,canola oil,potato starch,poblano chile,curry powder,hazelnut,liquid honey,lime juice
title: Sweet Potato Sausages With Roasted Chiles and Hazelnuts
ingredients: 1 tablespoon canola oil | 500 g breakfast sausage links, casings removed | 2 large sweet potatoes, peeled, cut into 1-inch chunks and cooked to your liking | 375 g poblano chiles ( roasted chile and sweet potato sausages ) | 1/2 cup hazelnuts, halved, toasted, roughly chopped | 2 teaspoons curry powder | 1 tablespoon liquid honey | 1/3 cup reduced-fat lime juice
instructions: Heat the oil and gently saute the sausage until cooked. Transfer to a large bowl, cover with plastic wrap and set aside. Combine the potato and poblano chilies in a food processor with the cashews and curry powder and process until smooth. Stir in the honey, lime juice and remaining ingredients. Serve with the cooked sausage.

title: Korean Black Sesame Oil
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon black sesame seed | 2 -3 tablespoons hot sauce
instructions: Mix together in a small skillet. Spread on a piece of aluminum foil, then sprinkle over any kind of meat it dries out.

Random Ingredients: sparkling water,hazelnut,rhubarb,icing sugar,monterey jack cheddar cheese,jicama,lime wedge,spring onion
title: Rhubarb and Jicama Salad
ingredients: 1 teaspoon icing sugar | 2 teaspoons chopped fresh rhubarb | 2 tablespoons sparkling water ( lemon juice ok ) | 2 tablespoons snipped spring onions | 1 tablespoon grated jicama | 1 tablespoon roasted chopped hazelnuts | 8 ounces monterey jack and cheddar cheese blend, cut into cubes | 8 -12 lime wedges, for garnish
instructions: Drain rhubarb, reserving 1 tablespoon poaching liquid. Chop rhubarb. Combine reserved poaching liquid, rhubarb, lemon juice, scallions, jicama and nuts in a small bowl. Mix cheese with reserved poaching liquid. Add to goat's cheese dressing stirring until smooth. Stir until well coated. Top with cheese cubes, serve on the side with lime wedges.

title: Garlic & Herb Macaroni & White Beans
ingredients: 8 ounces dry elbow macaroni | 1 can white beans, drained and rinsed | 3 tablespoons walnuts, chopped | 2 tablespoons fresh cilantro, coarsely chopped | 1 tablespoon fresh thyme leaves or 1/2 t. dried thyme | 1/4 teaspoon smoked paprika
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. Drain. Return pasta to pot. Add remaining ingredients and toss to combine.

title: Apple and Beet Salad
ingredients: 12 medium dried small beets | 8 -10 slices bacon, minced | 12 large fresh marjoram leaves | 3 large flat tart apples ( granny smith work best ) | 1/4 cup fresh mint leaves, chopped
instructions: Cut off any leaves on beets and carefully remove the outer stalk. Cut off the ends of the beets and scrape the leaves. Place the beet mixture in a bowl. Sprinkle lightly with the minced bacon. Sprinkle with majoram and cover with plastic wrap. Refrigerate for an hour and a half to macerate the moisture. Drain off the juice. Remove the beets from the container and discard the beet skins. Peel and core the beets and slice the beets into thin slices. You can make your own beets if you want to. Cut off the ends of the beets and set aside. Peel, core and slice the apples into 1/4 inch slices, the apples unpeeled depending on their size. In a large salad bowl, place beet, apples, mint and bacon and season to taste with majoram and the lemon juice to taste. Toss, using as much of the juice as you like, until you have a nice salad.

title: Spiced Salt Blend
ingredients: 1 1/2 teaspoons cumin seeds ( lightly roasted and cumin seeds are good ) | 1 teaspoon green peppercorn | 5 whole red chilies | 1 teaspoon canola oil
instructions: Grind the first 4 ingredients together and then add the oil. Store in a dark, cool place.

title: Coconut and Brown Sugar Stir-Fry
ingredients: 3 tablespoons dark brown sugar | 2 spring onions, thinly sliced ( shallots are nice too! )
instructions: Wash your shallots, slice them into 1/2 cm pieces. Pour all the brown sugar in a non stick frying pan over a medium heat. Stir and bring up to just barely bubbling, then remove from heat. Allow the liquid to cool completely. Throw away any solids that float to top. Add the onions and toss well. Serve immediately with some white basmati rice or naan bread.

title: Faux Easy French Lard Lasagne
ingredients: 12 ounces lasagna noodles | flour | 4 tablespoons lard ( use vegetable oil for frying or olive oil )
instructions: Boil noodles in plenty of water for 5 - 6 minutes or until tender but firm. Drain and rinse with cold water. Cut in half lengthwise, then crosswise into thirds. You may slice into 4 lengths. Heat 1 tbsp of the lard in a nonstick pan over high heat. Using a slotted spoon, brown a few pieces of noodles at a time until golden, then turn over and fry all the same way. You want your noodles to turn lighter when cooked. Transfer to a separate dish and set aside. Repeat with remaining noodles and lard, adding more lard to the pan if no lard left in the pan and returning all the noodles to the pan. Continue, adding more lard as needed, stirring until all the noodles are coated. Season to taste with salt and pepper, place a bed of noodles on individual plates and top with a mound of fried lard and sauce. Serve with more hot sauce if desired.

title: Baked Curacao
ingredients: 1/2 cup breadcrumbs, dry | 1/3 cup tomato soup mix | 1/3 cup tequila ( optional ) | 1/4 cup dark soy sauce | 1 tablespoon turmeric | 1 tablespoon ground mace | 1/2 teaspoon ground red pepper or 1/2 teaspoon orange pepper flakes
instructions: Combine breadcrumbs and dry ingredients.

title: Spareribs a la Tim
ingredients: 4 lbs spareribs | 3 cups half-and-half cream | 1 tablespoon caster sugar | vegetable shortening
instructions: In a saucepot, cover the spareribs with water and bring to a boil. Simmer, covered, until tender and easily pierced with a knife, about 2 hours. Drain the spareribs and reserve the cooking liquid for later. Preheat oven to 400°f. Spread dry ribs on a baking sheet. Bake spareribs on the racks for 20 minutes. Whisk the half and half, caster sugar and 1 tablespoon of the reserved cooking liquid in a large saucepan. Bring to boil over medium heat, stirring until mixture starts to thicken, about 10 minutes. Bring ribs to boil again to reduce slightly. Reduce heat and simmer for 4 minutes. Preheat grill pan to the highest temperature and grease the grate. Remove ribs from saucepan and brush on the shortening. Grill for 10 minutes. Turn ribs over and grill 10 minutes more. Remove the ribs from the grates and serve.

title: Mexican Style Apples
ingredients: 4 medium tart apples | 1 package taco seasoning | 16 pickled yellow peppers, sliced into rings
instructions: Peel, core and dice apples.

title: Arugula With Garlic and Arugula
ingredients: 10 large arugula, stems trimmed, leaves picked
instructions: Place arugula on paper towels. With the heel of your hand, flatten the arugula until it resembles a very thin pancake. Spread leaves over entire surface with a generous layer of arugula. Sprinkle with garlic. Wrap tightly and refrigerate, at least 1 hour, up to 1 day.

Random Ingredients: green bell pepper,tomato paste,worcestershire sauce,cream tartar,red food coloring,turmeric,mozzarella cheese
title: Spicy Cheese Ball
ingredients: 8 ounces sour cream or 8 ounces cream cheese, room temperature | 1 1/2 teaspoons worcestershire sauce | 1 teaspoon ground turmeric | 1 teaspoon ground red food coloring, to taste | 1 dash worcestershire sauce | 1 dash red food coloring, to taste | sour cream ( such as miracle whip or cream of tartar ) | fresh mozzarella cheese
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine sour cream, worcestershire sauce, turmeric, red food coloring, worcestershire sauce and worcestershire sauce. Stir in food coloring until mixture is smooth. Add more red food coloring to achieve a medium tan color or a brighter punch. Chill the mixture for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally to prevent darkening. Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Divide evenly into 24 balls, keeping the balls covered with plastic wrap. Place each piece of cheese onto a foil lined baking sheet. Cover with plastic wrap and place in oven for 8 to 12 minutes. Allow cheese to warm to the touch. Remove the foil and slice cheese into 1 inch pieces. Place the pieces of cheese around the cheese balls and sprinkle with mozzarella balls. Remove the cheese balls from oven and place on a lined baking sheet for an additional 2 to 4 minutes, until cheese is melted. Remove from oven and immediately roll cheese in a dish towel to allow excess moisture to drain.

title: The Easiest Olive Paste in the World!!
ingredients: 1 teaspoon chili paste | 400 g chopped ripe olives | 50 g icing sugar | 2 tablespoons tomato paste | pepper ( optional )
instructions: Mix together with the rest of the ingredients. Keep in fridge until use.

Random Ingredients: celery,brown rice,onion,italian sausage,rum,ra el hanout spice mix,italian flat leaf parsley
title: Smoked Sausage, Rice and Herb Stuffing
ingredients: 2 lbs smoked italian sausages | 1 cup brown rice | 2 tablespoons onions, finely chopped | 1 1/2 teaspoons celery, finely chopped | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried italian flat leaf parsley | 1 1/2 teaspoons ras el hanout spice mix | 1/2 cup light rum ( optional, i don't use it )
instructions: Brown the sausage in a skillet. Combine rice, onions, celery, parsley and ras el hanout. Dice sausage, and mix with rice mixture. Add rum if using.

Random Ingredients: green olive,golden brown sugar,queso fresco,potato starch,beet,white onion
title: Potato-Artichoke Fritters With Cheese
ingredients: 4 medium beets, trimmed, sliced in rounds | 12 ounces green olives, chopped | 1 small white onion, finely sliced | 1 tablespoon golden brown sugar, packed ( not superfine sugar ) | 1/2 cup queso fresco ( if you use feta, it should be soft goat cheese, without the creaminess ) | 1/2 cup potato starch
instructions: Steam beets until tender. Mash them. Let cool a few minutes.

Random Ingredients: peach,scallion,liquid smoke flavoring,dark chocolate,american cheese,rhubarb,orange,red wine
title: Chocolate-Peach-Rhubarb Mousse
ingredients: 2 lbs ripe fresh rhubarb | 2/3 cup good red wine | 1/3 cup unsalted orange juice ( i use frozen ) | 3 ounces american cheese, cubed | 1 teaspoon liquid smoke flavoring | 2 -3 leaves scallions, chopped | peaches, pitted peeled and chopped ( optional ) | grated dark chocolate, for garnish
instructions: Slice rhubarb stalks lengthwise into 1/4 inch thick rounds. Toss rhubarb with red wine, orange juice, cheese and liquid smoke. Cover, and chill in fridge at least 1 hour, or overnight, depending on how thick the slices can get. Arrange cheese cubes, cut side up, in a glass or ceramic bowl. Spoon rhubarb mixture over cheese to create a well. Top with scallions. Sprinkle with chopped, toasted dark chocolate.

Random Ingredients: red wine vinegar,fennel seed,tart apple,cranberry,olive oil
title: Apple & Cranberry Salad
ingredients: 3/4 cup red wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons cranberries ( chopped ) | 1 tablespoon fennel seed | 3 tart apples ( such as fuji ) | olive oil ( optional )
instructions: Toast fennel seeds in a dry pan until they turn slightly darker. Dry them on paper towels, remove the seeds. Place all ingredients in a glass or porcelain bowl and mix well. If using apple, drizzle the olive oil on top and toss well. Let stand to mellow the fruit's flavour. Serve at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: metal skewer,sharp cheddar cheese,cooking oil,vegetable,mace,crescent dinner
title: Schnitzel-N-Egg Drop Cheesecake
ingredients: 1 package refrigerated crescent dinner rolls | 6 tablespoons sliced sharp cheddar cheese | 6 tablespoons sliced stuffed vegetables | 1 tablespoon vegetable peeler snipped | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace | 1/2 teaspoon cooking oil
instructions: Heat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit. Separate dough into 8 triangles. Re roll each triangle, cut side up, on cookie sheet. Cut each dough into 8 - 12 wedges. Arrange on baking sheets. Lightly coat tops of each square with cooking oil. Top each wedge with 1 tbls. Chopped veggies, cheese, celery and mace. Bake 25 - 35 minutes or until golden brown. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: ancho chile,salt pepper,tuna fish,roasting chicken,head garlic,swiss cheese,banana
title: Grilled Tuna and Chicken Sandwich for One
ingredients: 2 cans tuna packed in water ( or use plain white tuna and water ) | 4 -5 soft rolls ( your preference ) | 4 -5 soft bolillos or 4 -5 hoagie rolls | ancho chile ( optional ) | 1 small head of garlic, very finely minced or 1/2 teaspoon dried chilies | salt and pepper, to taste | mashed sweet potato ( optional )
instructions: Prepare the grill to high. If using a grill pan, the grill will need to be medium hot. Prepare the rolls and grill them as follows, split the soft roll in half. Spread each half with 3/4 teaspoon of the very finely minced garlic, and the whole chilies. Spread a layer of tuna evenly over the chilies, leaving about 1/4 of an inch at the very top of a roll. Add a layer of sliced, whole, salted pepper until just covering the tuna. Add a small layer of mashed sweet potato, if using. Add another layer of tuna, sweet potato, and finally the top roll. You may want to slice the sandwich very thin before you cut or eat it to help it get a good stickiness that suits you. Remove from the grill and eat it immediately. Note, it's also excellent with other fresh chiles such as serrano or jalapeno peppers.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack pepper cheese,wasabi paste,extra virgin olive oil,rye bread,hoisin sauce,cremini mushroom,bean,sesame seed
title: Wasabi Mushrooms With Hoisin Beef
ingredients: 2 tablespoons hoisin sauce | 1/8 cup hoisin sauce | 1 tablespoon wasabi paste | 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil | 3 cups cremini mushrooms, cut into 1/2 inch slices | 1 lb swiss style bean, trimmed | 1 lb cremini mushroom, cut into 1/2 inch slices | 1/2 cup shredded monterey jack pepper cheese | 6 slices rye bread ( thin slices ) or 6 slices sourdough bread, cut into triangles
instructions: Whisk the ingredients for the hoisin sauce together in a bowl. Heat the oil in a large non stick skillet over medium heat. Add the mushrooms and saute, stirring frequently, until golden. Stir in the bean slices, and cook 2 minutes, or until tender. Stir in the cheese and cook until golden. Place 1 to 2 tablespoons of meat and sauce into individual bowls, top with the warm hoisin cheese triangles, and serve.

title: Homemade Turai or Dukka
ingredients: 1/2 lb fresh lemon peel | 1 1/2 teaspoons garam masala
instructions: Place all ingredients in a mortar and pound into a paste using a little water to reach a smooth consistency. Serve cool or room temperature.

title: Lazy Manhattan Lasagna
ingredients: 1 bag rigatoni or dried lasagna noodle | 2 tablespoons triple sec liqueur | 1 can or bottle dark beer
instructions: Cook rigatoni noodles as directed on package. Drain water from noodles and rinse with cold water. Drain and set aside. Pour liqueur into a small saucepan and set over low heat. Stir in salt, if desired. Stir in beer.

title: Tuna, Lime and Provolone Fondue
ingredients: 3 cans tuna, drained | 1 cup diced provolone cheese | 1/2 cup freshly shredded taco-style limes | 4 teaspoons minced orange zest | 3/4 teaspoon chili powder | 2 tablespoons cornstarch | 5 soft ladyfingers
instructions: Place tuna in a large mixing bowl. Add 2/3 cup of provolone cheese and toss to combine. Spread tuna mixture evenly over the bottom of a fondue pot set over medium heat. Cook until evenly browned. Remove from heat and stir in lime zest, chili powder, and 1 tablespoon of cornstarch. Fill center of a soft ladyfinger with tuna mixture and insert into center of fondue pot. Serve warm.

title: Asian Beef Skillet Dinner
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs chuck steaks, 1.5-oz | mexican noodles or rice | 1 bag fresh broccoli, chopped | napa cabbage
instructions: Trim steaks and cut into 1/4 thick slices. Put steaks and noodles in large skillet. Cover with broth. Heat to boiling. Skim fat. Cover and simmer, 15 minutes. Add broccoli and cook, covered 3 minutes or until vegetables are crisp tender. Serve over noodles or rice.

title: Kolachi Spice Blend
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon chili pepper flakes | 2 teaspoons dried lemon
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together. Use as a seasoning or seasoning for grilled fish. Grill. Note, if you don't plan on using this for seafood, use anchovy fillets or other meat of your choice.

title: Red Salsa
ingredients: 1 green chili pepper | 1 celery rib
instructions: Place celery, chile and chili pepper in a food processor and pulse until finely chopped. Pour into a bowl and chill until ready to serve. Keeps for up to 1 week.

Random Ingredients: vanilla bean,tuna,vegetable stock,wheat flour,plain nonfat yogurt,flour tortilla
title: Tuna Fajitas
ingredients: 6 flour tortillas | 1 can tuna, drained ( flaked ) or ( 6 ounce ) can canned tuna, undrained ( flaked ) | 2 tablespoons whole wheat flour, divided ( or 2 tbsp. flour ) | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla bean ( seeds scraped ) | 4 tablespoons plain nonfat yogurt | vegetable stock
instructions: Place the flaked tuna, 2 tablespoons of flour, and vanilla bean in a food processor or blender and process for 20 - 30 seconds. Add the yogurt and blend on high for a couple seconds, or until creamy, about 20 - 30 seconds. Spoon about 1/2 cup of the tuna mixture down the centre of each tortilla. Fold in the sides of the tortillas so they are snugly closed. Coat 1 side of each tortilla with cooking spray. Place the fajitas on a paper lined tray or baking sheet. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Spray a nonstick frying pan with cooking spray and heat over medium heat. Scoop 3 heaping tablespoons of the tuna salsa into each tortilla and warm. Repeat with the remaining salsa and fajitas. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: red curry paste,self raising flour,puff pastry
title: Spicy Red Curry Pasties
ingredients: 1 sheet frozen puff pastry | 1 teaspoon red curry paste | 1/2 cup self-raising flour
instructions: Place thawed pastry on a baking tray and using a cookie cutter or a 3/4 or 5cm/1 in piece of tin foil, cut into four squares. Spoon half of curry paste into the centre, and then place other square on top. Brush all over with water or run under warm water. Bake at c for 15 minutes until golden. Dust pastry with flour and place on a plate lined with cooking paper. Serve with remaining curry paste on the side.

title: Pumpkin Shrimp Bisque
ingredients: 7 1/2 cups peeled and deveined shrimp | 1 pound ground veal | 1 can pumpkin puree | 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream | 6 chipotle chiles, seeded and minced
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Cook shrimp in boiling water until opaque in the center, 2 to 5 minutes. Remove with a slotted spoon to a bowl of ice water to cool. Repeat process with shrimp.

Random Ingredients: chinese five spice powder,toffee,pepperoni,salt pork,cream cheese
title: French Bread
ingredients: 1 package cream cheese, softened | 1/2 pound salt pork, shredded | 2 cups chopped pepperoni | 1/4 cup chinese five-spice powder | 1 teaspoon salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a medium bowl, mix together the cream cheese and the salt pork. Dip the bread into the cream cheese and pork mixture, and place into a lightly greased 9x13 inch baking dish. Sprinkle with pepperoni. Bake in the preheated oven 35 minutes, until the edges are golden brown and the tops are crispy and beginning to pull away from the sides of the baking dish.

title: Palms Pizza
ingredients: 1 pizza crust | 3/4 teaspoon ice water
instructions: Preheat oven at 450 degrees. In a small bowl, mix the ice water and flour to form a smooth dough. Brush the crust with the dough, then top it with the crust, leaving a 1/2 inch rim. Bake for 15 minutes, then brush again with some of the remaining dough. Bake for another five minutes, or until the crust is golden.

Random Ingredients: sun tomato,dark rum,double crust pie,italian plum tomato,pork loin roast,purpose flour,margarita mix
title: Pork & Tomato Empanadas
ingredients: 2 lbs lean boneless pork loin roast ( can be cut into 3/4-inch cubes ) | 1 can plum tomatoes ( not drained ) | 1/4 cup chopped sun-dried tomato ( not oil-packed ) | 1/2 cup margarita mix, plus | 1 tablespoon margarita mix | 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour | 1 1/4 cups freshly crushed dark rum or 1 1/4 cups brandy | 2 double crust pie shells
instructions: Place pork in a small dutch oven or heavy pot. Add 4 t of the sun dried tomatoes and the remaining ingredients. Simmer, covered, for 1 hour. Meanwhile, heat a greased 1 inch skillet over medium high heat. While that simmers, line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Strain the pork and tomatoes. Discard the tomato stems and any large pieces of remaining tomato. Return the pork with the liquid to the pot and bring to a boil. Reduce the heat.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon cube,black eyed pea,red miso,mussel,cheese whiz
title: Miso and Black-Eyed Pea Dip
ingredients: 1 box cheese whiz | 1 teaspoon instant beef bouillon cubes or 1 teaspoon instant au jus de leche with 1/2 cube dissolved in | 1 cup black-eyed peas, cleaned | 1 tablespoon red miso | 1 tablespoon mussels or 1 tablespoon shucked oysters
instructions: Drain the beans with their liquid and reserve. In a food processor put the cheese whiz, beef buillon powder, black eyed peas, red miso and mussels. In a skillet, heat 1 tbs of oil over medium high heat and add the beans, simmering for 5 minutes or until heated through, add 1 tbsp of oil to help heat, if necessary add a little cooking liquid to help with the blending. Serve warm with crackers of your choice and fresh parsley on top.

title: Linguine With Fennel and Lettuce
ingredients: 36 ounces linguine | 1 fennel bulb, trimmed and finely sliced | 8 iceberg lettuce, leaves separated and washed
instructions: Cook fennel in boiling water until cooked but still slightly chunky. Drain well. Cook linguine according to directions until only the amount of water necessary is included in the cooking times. Drain linguine and toss with fennel and lettuce. Serve immediately. Variation, substitute red bell pepper or other chile.

title: Spicy German Cheese Fondue
ingredients: 1 tablespoon butter | 2 tablespoons white onions, minced | 1/8 cup pimiento, minced | 1/8 cup red pepper, minced | 12 medium ounces gruyere or 12 medium swiss cheese, cut into chunks | 12 light beer or 12 dark beer | 1 pinch crushed red pepper or fresh chives ( to garnish )
instructions: In a medium size skillet, melt butter over medium heat. Once butter is melted, add onion, mushrooms, pimiento, and red pepper to skillet. Cook and stir until vegetables are crisp tender and slightly browned. Sprinkle cheese with a pinch each of red and red peppers. Add half of the beer to the fondue and stir and scrape fondue into fondue skillet. Add about 2 tablespoons extra beer or beer and stir to mix. Serve hot, garnished with chives.

title: American Stroganoff
ingredients: 1/4 cup light mayonnaise | 2 tablespoons peach schnapps | 2 teaspoons fresh basil, chopped | 1 can italian-style diced tomatoes | 1/2 cup fresh mushrooms, sliced
instructions: Mix remaining ingrediants until smooth. Serve over your favourite noodles or top your servings w/roasted vegetables.

title: Rice Noodles With Kielbasa, Kielbasa and Sausage
ingredients: 1 lb kielbasa | 8 ounces uncooked rice noodles | 1 can tuna in water, drained | 1 -2 tablespoon dried sage leaves | 6 fresh guajillo chiles ( or more to taste )
instructions: Cut the sausages into 1/2 inch slices crosswise and arrange them on a serving platter. Pour 2 quarts lightly salted water into a medium sized, heavy pot that will hold the rice noodles inside 3 or 4 quart ramekins. Bring to a boil over medium high heat.

title: Souvlakia (Greek Spinach Skewers)
ingredients: 1 whole lemon, cut into 3 wedges | 1 lb fresh spinach, washed | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried oregano leaves | 1/2 teaspoon saffron thread, crumbled | 1 1/2 - 2 lbs liqueur ( i prefer saffron )
instructions: Cut the fresh spinach in half and trim off some of the thick stems. Squeeze as much juice as you can from the spinach leaving about 1 tblsp of the liquid in the large bowl on the greens. Rinse well and put in a medium bowl. Stir in the remaining ingredients to create a marinade with a bit of a kick. Add the drained spinach and toss well to coat. Cover and marinate in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours or up to 2 days stirring occasionally before each use. Soak skewers in water at least 1 - 2 hours before frying.

title: Mexican Corn Snack Mix
ingredients: 3 cups mexican-style corn ( or frozen corn ) | 4 1/2 teaspoons soya sauce | 3 1/2 teaspoons sesame seeds | 1 1/4 cups low salt soy sauce | 1 1/4 cups whole wheat bread or 1 1/4 cups multigrain whole wheat bread, soaked in water 20 minutes, squeezed till dry, and cubed
instructions: Combine all of the ingredients except the bread and toss. Tear off a ping pong ball sized piece from the bread and scatter around your fingers and roll it in the mixture. Let it sit for a few minutes to absorb the flavors, shape as desired. Cook in large nonstick skillet on medium high heat till heated through, about 3 minutes or till golden.

title: Baked Parsnips
ingredients: 4 parsnips, peeled and cut into chunks | 8 slices ham, cut into pieces | 1 cup chopped pecans
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place the parsnips into a large casserole dish. Top with ham and any remaining parsnips. Sprinkle with pecans. Bake in preheated oven until the parsnips are tender and the ham is hot and crispy, 25 to 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: fine sea salt,pine nut,pecan nut,tilapia fillet,lettuce leaf,french bread
title: Grilled Tilapia with Pine Nuts
ingredients: 1/4 cup fine sea salt, coarsely ground in mortar and pestle | 2 tablespoons pine nuts, toasted ( see note ) | 2 tablespoons toasted pine nuts, toasted | 1 1/2 lbs tilapia fillets, cut crosswise into 1/2-inch slices | 3 large lettuce leaves ( see note ) | 16 french bread, wedges
instructions: Combine salt and pine nuts in small bowl. Combine pine nuts and salt on plate.

title: Watermelon Cones
ingredients: 1 tablespoon brandy | 8 slices sharp cheddar cheese | 2 cans sliced watermelon, rinsed
instructions: Cut each watermelon in half.

title: Tomatillo-Tomatillo Salsa (Chunky)
ingredients: 4 tomatillos ( coarsely chopped ) | 1/4 teaspoon onion powder | 1 slice rye bread
instructions: Dice tomatillos coarsely and chop a bit of onion. Combine the tomatillos, onion powder, and salt to taste. Remove crusts and cut rye slices up into small chunks or triangles. Put the slices into a blender and puree till smooth. Add water if necessary, to get the right consistency. Serve with chips, veggies, or alone.

title: Avgolemono with Nogado (Beef With Pear Nests)
ingredients: 2 lbs sirloin, cut into bite sized pieces | 4 pears, in their shell, peeled and cut into quarters | 4 -5 ounces fresh tzatziki | 1 lb angel hair pasta, cooked al dente
instructions: Dice meat into bite sized pieces. Place on a large platter. Pour tzatziki overtop. Serve with noodles.

title: Japanese Style Shell Potatoes With Fried Potatoes
ingredients: 1 lb russet potatoes | 1/2 pound kokum, peeled and sliced | 1 package jumbo pasta shells
instructions: Bring large pot of water to boil. Place potato shells on a baking sheet. Bake in a preheated 450ºf oven for 20 minutes. Heat a few tablespoons of oil in a non stick frying pan. Drop potatoes into boiling water.

Random Ingredients: swiss cheese,ice,monterey jack cheese,shiitake mushroom,coriander seed
title: Shiitake Mushroom and Swiss Cheese Dip
ingredients: 1 lb swiss cheese, cut into 1/2-inch chunks | 1/2 lb monterey jack cheese, cut into 1/2-inch chunks | 12 shiitake mushrooms, sliced | 3 coriander seeds, crushed | 2 cups ice
instructions: Melt cheeses over ice in large bowl in the microwave for 15 to 20 seconds or until smooth. Remove 1 cup toasted coriander seeds. Spread cheese on a platter and top with 2 sliced shiitake mushrooms. Sprinkle with 1/2 cup of the toasted coriander. Repeat procedure with remaining ingredients. Serve with crackers.

Random Ingredients: pork sausage,white wine vinegar,beef sirloin steak,cheese
title: Scotch Burgers
ingredients: 2 pork sausage | 2 slices processed cheese | 1 beef sirloin steak | 1/4 cup white wine vinegar
instructions: Remove the rind from the sausage and pull meat off the bone. Remove the meat from its casing and, using your hands, tear off the remaining fat and discard the skin. Cut it into 1 1/2 to 2 inch cubes and place them in a medium sized bowl, making sure all the fat has been squeezed out. Add the white wine vinegar and mix well. Add the meat and stir well to coat. Cover the bowl and allow to sit for an hour or so, stirring once or twice. Preheat a grill to high heat. Thread the meat onto skewers by brushing with a little cooking oil and using the palms of your hands to roll the meat around it, pinching to keep the meat sealed. When ready to cook, lightly oil the grill grate. Cook the burgers, covered, for 3 to 5 minutes or until nicely browned, turning them as needed. Serve with dipping sauces.

title: Quick Okra Fried Rice
ingredients: 1 tablespoon brown rice | 1 cup uncooked okra | 1/4 cup chopped onion
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium high heat. Add rice, okra and onion.

Random Ingredients: ice cube,tomato sauce,tuna,topping,fine semolina,taco seasoning mix
title: Fiesta Tuna Melt on a Plate or in a Bag
ingredients: 1 cup fine semolina, flakes or 6 ounces fine grains | 2 cans tuna, drained | 1 can tomato sauce | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 2 cups crushed ice cube ( or more ) | topping
instructions: Crack tuna into small bowl and mix with tomato sauce. Mix dry ingredients in large bowl with a fork. Fill 1/2 cup tuna mixture into ice cube trays. Microwave on high power for about 1 minute. Scoop out of freezer with fork and sprinkle topping on tuna as desired.

title: Peach Yogurt Sauce With Peaches
ingredients: 1 cup peach ( i usually just cut the pit and remove the pit when i don't want to serve ) | 1/2 cup rice vinegar | 2 tablespoons low-fat peanut sauce or 2 tablespoons reduced-fat vanilla yogurt | 1 1/2 cups chicken stock
instructions: Place peach in a medium sized bowl and pour boiling water over it. Stir until peaches are completely peeled and the remaining water is clear. Drain the peaches and place in blender or food processor. Stir and puree until smooth. Add remaining ingredients except for broth and continue to blend. Add broth or water if neier consistency is required. Add enough stock or water to desired thickness. Cover and chill in refrigerator, but do not over blend.

Random Ingredients: curry paste,bread flour,chunky salsa,egg,red curry paste
title: Spicy Thai Bread
ingredients: 100 ml bread flour | 1 egg, lightly beaten | 1 tablespoon red curry paste, to taste | 2 tablespoons chunky salsa, to taste | 1 teaspoon curry paste | 1 teaspoon chunky salsa, to taste
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180c. Grease and line 2 baking trays with baking paper for ease of cleaning. Mix all ingredients, except the salsa, together throughly. Using the flat edge of a knife, shape the mixture into 2 even even discs. Roll each disc around the skewer alternating, slightly apart, with the ends overlapping upwards. Trace 2 circles from one baking sheet onto the second sheet using a skewer to secure the first, then repeat on the third sheet. Transfer the bread onto the second baking sheet. Bake in the oven for 15 - 20 minutes or until lightly browned.

title: Quick Tortilla Roll-Ups
ingredients: 12 corn tortillas | your favourite hot sauce | chopped tomato
instructions: Place 2 corn tortillas on a clean work surface. Spread approximately 1/4 cup of the hot sauce over both sides of each tortilla. Place them into a greased shallow baking dish. Allow the tortillas to dry on one side for approximately 15 - 20 minutes until they are a bit charred. Flip over and brush the top of each tortilla with a little more hot sauce. Bake in a 300 degree oven until the tops of the tortillas reach a golden brown, about 15 - 20 minutes. If you like a roll like mine, place the pan over high heat for a couple of minutes then scrape the bottom of the pan with a wooden spoon to loosen the tortillas. Cut each roll into 10 portions and serve. You should have about 20 cut outs so you can serve up.

title: Lettuce Cups
ingredients: 4 cups cold torn iceberg lettuce | 1/4 cup light golden syrup | 2 teaspoons margarine or 2 teaspoons butter | 3 bay leaves, chopped | 10 allspice berries | 1/2 cup frozen blueberries
instructions: In large bowl toss lettuce with golden syrup and set aside. In 12 inch skillet melt margarine or butter over low heat, stirring occasionally for 2 - 3 minutes or until light brown. Add bay leaves, allspice berries and blueberries and stir till berries are hot. Divide lettuce among lettuce cups. Top with citrus mixture.

Random Ingredients: watermelon,black bean,green bean,plain nonfat yogurt,spinach,purpose flour,okra
title: Warm Black Bean and Spinach Tzatziki
ingredients: 1/2 package frozen chopped spinach, thawed and drained | 1/2 cup chopped green beans | 1/2 cup frozen cut okra | 1/4 cup watermelon, cubed | 1/4 cup plain nonfat yogurt | 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 3/4 teaspoon all-purpose flour | 1 can black beans, rinsed and drained
instructions: Preheat the broiler. In a medium bowl, combine the spinach, green beans, okra, watermelon, yogurt, and 1/4 cup flour. Mix thoroughly with a spoon. Place in a baking dish, and broil 4 minutes, until top is browned. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: corona beer,greek yogurt,almond,tomato basil pasta sauce,confectioner sugar,self rising flour,yellow bell pepper
title: Almond Wheat Pizza
ingredients: 12 ounces barilla creamy goat-milk greek yogurt | 1 container plain greek-style yogurt | 1/4 cup crushed almonds | 4 1/2 cups self-rising flour | 1/2 cup grated confectioners'sugar | 1/3 cup seeded, chopped tomato and basil pasta sauce | 1 cup finely chopped yellow bell pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Grease a 8x8 inch baking dish. Mix all ingredients in a large bowl. Cover and refrigerate for about 30 minutes. Bake in the preheated oven until browned, 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Chutney Cucumber Chutney
ingredients: 2 tablespoons chutney | 2 cups chicken stock | 1 cup diced cucumber | 1 cup chopped bok choy | 1/2 cup plain yogurt
instructions: In a medium saucepan over medium heat, combine the chutney, chicken stock and cucumber. Simmer until the cucumber is tender, about 8 minutes. Stir in the bok choy. Cool to room temperature. Spoon into serving bowls.

title: Jalapeno Pepper Balls
ingredients: 2 large fresh jalapeno peppers - stemmed, seeded, and diced | 1 cup bread crumbs | 1 1/2 teaspoons grated orange peel
instructions: Place the jalapeno peppers, bread crumbs, and orange peel into a food processor, and pulse until mixture looks like coarse crumbs. Shape peppers into little balls with your hands. Place them on a plate, and roll in bread crumbs.

title: Avocado With Cherries(Crock Pot)
ingredients: 4 avocados, cut in half and stones removed | 1 beef stock cube, dissolved in | 2 tablespoons hot beef stock or 2 tablespoons warm beef stock
instructions: In a non stick frying pan add just enough of the beef stock to make a slurry. Slip the avocados into the stock, then drop them into the hot pan and fry them. Turn them over and cook them the other way, until they are turning black and starting to crisp.

title: Simple, easy and elegantly simple Fillet of Salmon from America's Test Kitchen
ingredients: 2 salmon fillets, about 6 oz each | 2 tablespoons horseradish ( about 2 tablespoons )
instructions: Preheat the oven broiler. Spray a baking pan with non stick cooking spray and line them with foil. Rub with some of the horseradish. Cut the fillets crosswise in half. Place it on the baking tray under the broiler. Broil about 3 - 5 minutes, until the skin is blackened and the fillets feel firm. Turn them over. Use a slotted spoon to lift the skin from the top.

title: Pea Avocado Tiramisu
ingredients: 6 large russet potatoes, thinly sliced | 1 package frozen yellow peas, thawed | 1 avocado - peeled, pitted, and sliced | 2 tablespoons italian seasoning | 2 teaspoons vanilla extract | 1 package ladyfingers | 1/4 cup miniature vienna flavored velveeta peppers ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Spray a 9x13 inch baking dish with cooking spray. Arrange potatoes in a single layer in the baking dish. Arrange frozen peas in a small dish.

title: Cured Veal Rolls
ingredients: 3 lbs veal, fillet trimmed | 1/2 lb grape tomatoes or 1/2 lb plum tomato, cored and cut into 1/2-inch strips | 1/4 cup capers, drained, rinsed | 1/3 cup good quality white wine vinegar | more caper, drained
instructions: Tie veal with string 1 or 2 times. Lay out on flat work surface, brush with a little olive oil, and sprinkle with salt and pepper. Put grape tomatoes on top, put a strip of capers on top and roll up jellyroll style. Arrange in buttered baking dish. Sprinkle with red wine vinegar, cover with foil and marinate 3 to 4 hours, or overnight. Baste with marinade occasionally and set oven to 300 degrees. Continue soaking rolls for a total of 3 hours. Remove from dish and drain off liquid. Use cooking fat in saucepan to deglaze for gravy, if necessary. Boil sauce for 30 to 40 minutes, or until thickened. Remove from heat and let stand for a few minutes before serving.

title: Creamy Rice Pilaf
ingredients: 3 cups vegan chicken ( i've used vegetarian chicken ) | 1/2 cup fresh cranberries, chopped | 1 1/2 cups arborio rice
instructions: Boil the 1 1/2 cups of rice in a large heavy nonstick pot with a tight fitting lid. When the rice is starting to turn slightly opaque, reduce the heat. In a separate pot, cook the 2 pieces of chicken in butter on medium high heat, turning until the skin is browned on the outside. If you wanted more flavor, skip the butter. You won’t be able to tell the first 5 to 10 minutes by what type of chicken you used. Transfer the chicken to the bowl of a food processor and add the 1 1/2 cups of cooked rice. Turn the cooker on to high and scrape up any bits of rice and chicken and add the 1/2 cup of cranberries and 1 1/2 cups of cream. Turn on to medium heat and let boil, mixing often, until the cream is reduced to about 1/3 it should be a little syrupy at this point. Serve or refrigerate for up to 5 days.

Random Ingredients: yellow onion,turmeric powder,thai fish sauce,caster sugar,savoy cabbage,pepper,marsala wine,onion soup mix
title: Thai Colcannon (Stir-Fry With Napkins or Cabbage)
ingredients: 3 tablespoons marsala wine or 3 tablespoons marsala wine | 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce ( or to taste ) | 1/2 teaspoon pepper | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1 yellow onion ( small or 1/2 large ) | 1 savoy cabbage ( large or 1/2 large ) or 2 medium cabbage, shredded ( large or 1/2 large ) | 1 envelope dry onion soup mix | 2 tablespoons thickened cream or 2 tablespoons light cream
instructions: To make white cabbage salad, cut finely across in half and remove core. Cut into 1 cm / 1/4 in slices. Combine with white cabbage, onion soup mix, cream and pepper powder. To serve, place half the salad mix into each serving bowl.

Random Ingredients: seasoning salt,greek salad dressing,monterey jack cheese,taco seasoning mix,green chilies,pecorino romano cheese,mint leaf,marshmallow
title: Microwave Spicy Mexican Cheesebake Salad
ingredients: 1 teaspoon seasoning salt | 4 tablespoons greek salad dressing ( i like miracle whip, but any dressing will do ) | 2 tablespoons marshmallows | 1/2 cup shredded monterey jack cheese | 1/4 cup grated pecorino romano cheese ( fresh grated cheese can also be used ) | 2 -3 green chilies, seeded and chopped ( depending on your taste ) | 1 teaspoon taco seasoning mix | 2 cups miniature marshmallows
instructions: Place first five ingredients in bowl, stir together well. Place in a microwave safe dish, and microwave on high for 3 minutes. Remove dish from microwave, and spread evenly over the top of the dough. Sprinkle evenly with the cheeses. Pour water, if necessary, to cover the cheesebake completely. Microwave on high for a further 10 minutes, or until cheesebake reaches desired doneness. Sprinkle with remaining cheeses and chilies. Microwave again for a few minutes to melt the cheeses and chillies. If desired, cover and keep warm until serving time.

title: Sweet Rice and Turkey Lullaby
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups sweet sticky rice | 10 ounces sweet turkey, sliced or 2 1/2 cups turkey, cooked and finely diced | 1 cup marsala wine or 1 cup sweet sherry wine | 1 1/4 cups grenadine
instructions: In a 4 cup glass measure or 1 cup glass measuring cup, add the rice, turkey, marsala or sherry, and grenadine. Microwave for 20 seconds or until it shimmers. Stir, remove and leave outside of glass, and let stand 5 minutes. Stir once more, and pour into a 9x13 inch baking dish filled with 2 2/3 cup boiling water. If the rice expands, microwave a couple more seconds longer. Cool for 15 - 25 minutes, or until the rice cools slightly. Cut into bite sized pieces.

title: Easy Saffron-Coated Chicken and Pot Au Feu
ingredients: 12 ounces chicken thighs, boned, skin on | 12 ounces flank steaks, trimmed of visible fat and cut into 3/4-inch diagonal slices | 3 eggs plus 2 egg whites | 1 pinch saffron thread, crushed ( or equivalent ) | 1/2 cup superfine sugar or 1/2 cup fine sugar
instructions: Place chicken thighs between plastic bags, and flatten with a meat mallet until very thin. Place flank steak between plastic bags, and flatten with the mallet or roller to a thickness of 1/4 inch. Place 1 egg in the center of each piece of chicken to make an indentation in the center of the chicken. Place 1 sliced sausage in each indentation, and top with one slice of chicken. Place remaining slices of chicken on top of the sausage, and press down on the sausage with your fingers. Invert the chicken onto a plate. Repeat with remaining pieces of chicken, egg whites, saffron, and sugar. Lightly oil the grill. Put the rack 3 inches from the heat, and preheat grill to high. Grill chicken and tomato slices, turning once, for 20 to 30 minutes, or until juices run clear. Serve as is, or with boiled or roasted vegetables.

Random Ingredients: salmon fillet,navel orange,cremini mushroom,beef consomme soup
title: Crock Pot Salmon With Mushrooms and Orange
ingredients: 2 medium navel oranges | 1/2 lb cremini mushroom | 2 cans beef consomme soup | 2 lbs salmon fillets
instructions: In crock pot arrange 1/2 orange and 1 mushrooms, cover with soup and cook on low heat setting 7 - 7 hours.. Rinse salmon with salt and pepper then place skin side up on serving dish sprinkle salmon with remaining orange, mushrooms and pour remaining can of soup over salmon and sprinkle with black pepper. Serve with french bread and enjoy.

title: Easy Polish Dip (Czech)
ingredients: 10 ounces butter | 4 cups light cream of celery soup | 1 cup vodka ( not cooking soda ) | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Melt butter in frying pan on medium heat, add soup, salt, and pepper. Toss with sour cream a few minutes before serving. Serve with toasted bread.

Random Ingredients: water chestnut,edamame,baking potato,cremini mushroom,white rice,shiitake mushroom,chicken broth
title: Citrus Broth
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked white rice | 1 1/2 cups chicken broth | 3 small baking potatoes, peeled and cut into 2-inch cubes | 2 cans sliced shiitake mushrooms, drained | 4 ounces cremini mushrooms, drained | 1 can water chestnuts, drained | 3 cups sliced edamame | 1/4 cup rice water ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. In a bowl, combine the rice, broth, potato, mushrooms, and water chestnuts and allow to sit for 15 to 20 minutes. Stir in the edamame and cover with aluminum foil. Bake for 30 minutes, stirring every 10 minutes. Remove from oven.

title: Bread Dip
ingredients: 4 tablespoons natural yoghurt | 225 g boneless pork, finely diced | 2 serrano peppers, seeded and finely diced | 1 loaf rye bread, cut into 1/4-inch slices
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the yoghurt, pork and peppers and mix well. Lay the ramekin slices on a clean, dry baking tray. Heat under a grill until the slices are sizzling hot and starting to crisp around the edges, about 2 minutes per side. Place the ramekin slices onto a serving platter and scatter with bread cubes to serve.

title: Chile Enchilada Sauce
ingredients: 4 cans enchilada sauce | 3 tablespoons red wine vinegar
instructions: Warm enchilada sauce over medium heat in a heavy medium saucepan. When heated through, remove from heat, and blend the sauce until smooth.

Random Ingredients: hazelnut,biscuit,lamb fillet,seasoning salt,kidney bean,angel hair pasta,cocoa,egg noodle
title: Chewy Lamb Casserole
ingredients: 500 g fresh egg noodles | 2 lbs boneless lamb fillets, sliced thinly | 1 packet angel hair pasta | 1 can kidney beans, drained | 125 g good quality cocoa | 4 tablespoons cocoa, extra | 2 teaspoons seasoning salt | 2 large biscuits, crushed
instructions: Cook noodles according to packet instructions, drain and set aside. Fry lamb with onion until browned. Add kidney beans and cocoa and simmer until mixture is reduced in volume. Drain noodles and mix with sauce. Spoon mixture into a 2l shallow buttered ovenproof dish. Dot with extra cocoa and sprinkle with biscuits. Cover with foil. Bake for 40 - 45 mins at 180 degrees celsius. Serve with steaming vegetables.

title: Green Chilies Yogurt Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup plain nonfat yogurt | 4 small dried mild green chilies, reconstituted in hot water and then crushed
instructions: Remove stalks from the green chilies. Wash and dry the chilies. Bring them to a boil in a pan of warm water, just until the chilies soften, about 10 seconds, then add the yogurt. Simmer, uncovered, for 3 mins, then put on a flat bladed serving dish. Sprinkle the crushed green chillies over as garnish.

title: Cucumber Poppy Seed Sandwich
ingredients: 1 lebanese cucumber, thinly sliced | 2 slices rye bread, toasted | 2 teaspoons poppy seeds | 2 tablespoons almonds, sliced, toasted | 4 teaspoons thousand island dressing
instructions: Spread the poppy seeds on the toasted rye bread, followed by the sliced cucumber and almonds. Drizzle with thousand island dressing. Cut into 1/2 inch pieces.

Random Ingredients: fenugreek leaf,broccoli,blue cheese,five spice powder,green onion,pork bean,dark cooking chocolate,dill
title: Chop Suey and Beans
ingredients: 100 g green onions | 1 tablespoon dill | 1 tablespoon dried fenugreek leaves | 200 g lean pork beans, sliced ( chappellini ) | 300 g chappellini beans, rinsed and cut into 2 cm chunks | 1 tablespoon dark cooking chocolate, grated | 6 tablespoons crumbled blue cheese ( optional ) | 3/4 teaspoon five-spice powder
instructions: Trim the stalks of the green onions, wash and place on a large tray. Place the chopped green onions, dill and fenugreek in a food processor or blender, blend until fairly smooth. Place in a bowl, add the remaining ingredients and blend until thoroughly combined. Spread into a large non stick frypan, heat on medium, add enough water that the chappellini beans are just covered, cook for 5 minutes, stirring often. Remove from heat. Place the chappellini and the chappellini beans on individual serving plates. Spoon on the chappellini bean mixture, serve with cream and a sprinkling of choliso or chomegranate seeds.

title: Sultana Scones
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups sultanas | 1 1/2 cups self raising flour | 1/4 cup white sugar | 1 tablespoon capers
instructions: Preheat the oven to 220c / 220c fan forced / gas mark mix all the dry ingredients together in a large mixing bowl. Stir in the sultana flakes. Roll out on a floured surface to about 1/4 inch thickness. Cut into scones using two biscuit cutter / 2 round and 4 inch scone shapes. Arrange on an oiled baking tray and prick with a fork. Brush over a light glaze of oiled olive oil and bake for 12 to 14 minutes. Leave for 5 minutes before transferring to wire racks to cool. Serve warm or at room temperature. Makes 6 servings with a salad with a good sharp cheese.

Random Ingredients: italian seasoning,egg noodle,tomato juice,walnut,stewing beef,halibut fillet,brown basmati rice
title: Halibut Jambalaya
ingredients: 2 lbs stewing beef | 1/2 teaspoon italian seasoning | 1 egg noodles | 1 cup brown basmati rice | 1 can diced tomatoes with juice | 1 head walnuts, chopped | 1/2 lb halibut fillets ( or other small fish, such as cod, shrimp or halibut )
instructions: Prepare meat according to package directions. While meat is cooking, cook egg noodles as directed on package. When meat is done drain meat and allow it to cool until easy to handle. Meanwhile, preheat oven to 325°f place walnuts on a baking sheet and sprinkle them with cooking spray. Bake uncovered for 10 minutes or until lightly toasted. Set aside to cool. When meat has cooled, remove some of the fat and discard. Remove and discard the core and all visible parts from the walnuts. Slice meat into 3/8 inch thick strips. Heat a large skillet over medium high heat. Add the walnuts and cook for 2 to 3 minutes or until lightly toasted. Add the meat to the skillet, and then quickly stir in the noodles. Stir in the tomatoes with juice, and cook just until warmed through. Spoon mixture over walnuts and serve.

title: Potato and Pear Tacos
ingredients: 3 medium yukon gold potatoes, washed, peeled and cut in 1/4-inch dice | 1/3 cup pine nuts, toasted | 2 -3 tablespoons taco seasoning, spicy | 2 cups chopped canned pears | 3/4 cup rice ( hot ) | 1 tablespoon mustard, spicy | 1/3 cup taco seasoning | 1/3 cup pine nuts, toasted
instructions: Cook potato until tender but firm in the centre. Drain and allow to cool. Add remaining ingredients except pine nuts. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Dry the potato mixture well, and stir in the pine nuts. Serve chilled with toasted pita bread slices.

title: Perfect Maple Syrup
ingredients: 4 cups maple syrup | 1 orange, zest of, finely grated on a microplane
instructions: In a large saucepan, bring the syrup to a boil. When the syrup reaches 185°f or warm to 110°f on a candy thermometer, add the orange peel.

Random Ingredients: peppercorn,clove,onion salt,orange peel,monterey jack cheese,vegetable broth,olive
title: Mexican Cheese Dip(Copycat)
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 cups vegetable broth ( or water ) | 2 1/2 lbs monterey jack cheese | 1 package creamed cured olives | 1 package orange peppercorns, lightly crushed | 2 teaspoons dried oregano granules or 2 teaspoons freshly peppercorns mixed with 2 t dried oregano | 1 pinch peppercorn ( optional ) | 1 pinch onion salt ( optional ) | 1/4 cup minced onion ( or more )
instructions: Mix first eight ingredients in a crockpot, or a medium sized pan. Cook on low 6 - 8 hours. If dip is too thick, add a small amount of water. Serve warm with tortilla chips, crackers, or vegetables.

Random Ingredients: mushroom,ice cream,apple,bell pepper,chinese rice wine,rib beef,parmigiano reggiano cheese
title: Rib Eye Beef Steak Sandwiches
ingredients: 1/4 lb rib eye beef, sliced super thin | 1/4 cup rice wine or 1/4 cup dry sherry | 1 medium apple, unpeeled chopped & shredded | 1/4 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1/2 cup sliced mushrooms | 2 teaspoons chinese-style rice wine or 2 teaspoons dry sherry | ice cream, to serve ( optional )
instructions: Place beef between two sheets of wax paper and pound till 1/4 inch thick. Place rice wine in a small bowl. Add 1 cup water and mix well. Add to beef and stir till combined. Let stand at room temp for 15 minutes. Stir remaining wine into beef. Cover and refrigerate beef for 1 hour. For rolls, place beef, cheese, mushrooms, rice wine and ice in a medium bowl and toss to combine. Serve at once.

title: Teriyaki Squash With a Twist
ingredients: 2 lbs beef, chunks ( i use flank steak, but use what you want ( about 1 lb ) | 6 tablespoons teriyaki sauce ( or 3/4 cup of leftover steak sauce ) | 1 -4 tablespoon lemon peel, grated | 5 tablespoons dried minced onion | 3 tablespoons ground sage ( divided in half, use 1 tblsp. ) | 1 cup yellow squash
instructions: The marinade works best with your hands, or in your food processor. The oil/oil will get in the beef, so make sure its trimmed of all fat. Combine 3 tb of soy sauce, 1 tblsp. Lemon peel, minced onion, and 1 tbsp ground sage in a medium size bowl. Rub the mixture all over the beef and marinate in the refrigerator for 2 hours or overnight if not using the marinade. Heat a large frypan or wok over medium high heat. Add 1 tb of oil. When it's almost smoking, add the meat. Cook until it is just seared on the outside, stirring occasionally, about 2 minutes. Transfer meat to a tray and let cool slightly, then add enough teriyaki sauce to cover the meat. Sprinkle on the lemon peel and 1 tblsp rubbed sage, and let the meat marinate and absorb the flavors until the beef is completely warmed through, about 15 minutes. Cut squash into even pieces, place in a roasting dish and bake, covered, in a 350 degree oven about 40 minutes. Remove and allow to cool slightly before serving. I served this over basmati rice with a little side salad and some extra teriyaki sauce and sliced carrots.

Random Ingredients: sugar,pine nut,shiitake mushroom,red bean,rum,rotel tomato chilies,rose water,sage
title: Vegetarian Feijoada (Antilles Style Speciality)
ingredients: 12 -20 fresh shiitake mushrooms, sliced in half lengthwise and then cut into thin, ribbons about 1/8 inch thick | 1 teaspoon sugar | 20 -24 tablespoons rum, divided into 8 equal portions | 12 -10 fresh rotel tomatoes & chilies, canned, drained and crushed ( use 1/2 t of each ) | 20 -24 leaves fresh rose water | 1 pinch ground sage ( optional or to taste ) | 1/2 cup pine nuts, lightly toasted | 1 can refried red beans
instructions: Rinse and gently dry mushrooms on paper towels. Place mushrooms, sugar and 1 t rum in a small pot. Cook over medium heat until sugar is melted and sugar is dissolved. Add tomatoes and rose waters. Bring to a boil over medium heat. Cover and reduce heat to simmer, and cook for 20 minutes. Stir in crushed chilies and sage. Adjust seasonings with additional rum or sugar if desired. Remove mushrooms and set aside. Stir in remaining rum and pine nuts. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: tortilla,chunky salsa,chickpea,grain white rice,cumin powder,cognac,broth,yellow cornmeal
title: Rice With Chickpeas and Cognac-Salsa
ingredients: 2 cups chunky salsa ( i prefer herdez ) | 40 ounces chicken stock or 40 ounces broth | 1 cup red long grain white rice | 4 tablespoons dried red millumin ( i use whole-grain white pepper ) | 3 cans chickpeas, drained | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 1 cup thickly sliced grain white rice | 1 tablespoon cognac or 1 tablespoon brandy ( optional ) | 20 tortillas, warmed
instructions: In a small saucepan, heat salsa. Stir in chicken stock or broth. Let stand 15 minutes. Rinse and drain chickpeas and discard liquid. Set aside. In a large skillet, cook 1 cup rice in hot oil over medium heat for 2 - 3 minutes or until dry. Add black rice and black millumin, stir 2 minutes, or until browned. Remove from skillet and set aside. Add drained chickpeas and 2 1/2 cups water.

Random Ingredients: teriyaki sauce,purple onion,snow pea,purpose white flour,sirloin steak
title: Teriyaki Beef & Snow Peas(Oriental Beef)
ingredients: 1 sirloin steak | 1/3 cup vegetable teriyaki sauce | 1/2 teaspoon all-purpose white flour, divided | 1 large purple onion, halved, sliced into half-moons | 3 cups snow peas
instructions: Slice the beef very thinly, about 1/8 inch thick. Place into a lightly oiled 13 x 9 inch baking dish. Combine teriyaki sauce & 1/2 tsp of the flour.

Random Ingredients: spring onion,hard egg,artichoke bottom,grapefruit,garlic,pine nut,yellow pepper
title: Italian Salad (Medley)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons pine nuts or 2 tablespoons almond nuts, toasted and cooled | 10 -12 artichoke bottoms, canned in olive oil ( drained after removing from olive oil ) | 3 -4 grapefruits | 1 spring onion ( to taste ) | 2 -3 garlic, roasted ( to taste ) | 1 yellow pepper ( roasted to taste )
instructions: Chop up the grapefruits into small pieces while leaving the garlic and peppers whole. Cut the bell peppers in half and remove seeds and membrane. In a large bowl, mix together all ingredients except grapefruits and nuts. Pour the salad on top of the nuts and mix well. Cover with parchment paper and refrigerate for an hour or longer.

title: Spicy Chiles
ingredients: 2 tablespoons coriander seeds, toasted ( husk may be left on ) | 2 teaspoons cilantro leaves, chopped | 1 can or bottle beer, or lager-infused
instructions: Put coriander seeds and cilantro leaves in a dry skillet over medium heat.

Random Ingredients: peppercorn,celery root,tony chachere seasoning,salad green,salt substitute,liquid honey,dark red kidney bean,cannellini bean
title: French Country Party Beans
ingredients: 40 ounces red kidney beans, drained ( the canned beans may be left whole or they will not be in the finished dish ) | 20 ounces dark red kidney beans, drained | 4 cups diced celery root | 1 1/2 cups salted mixed salad greens | 1/2 of an equivalent amount chopped peppercorn | 2 tablespoons tony chachere's seasoning | 2 tablespoons liquid honey | 1/2 teaspoon salt substitute, or to taste
instructions: Drain all the beans, but do not use dried ones. Transfer to a dutch oven or heavy pot with a medium flame. Add celery, water, honey, salt and chachere's seasoning. Bring to boil over medium high heat.

title: Peach Sizzlin'
ingredients: 1 1/2 ounces peach schnapps | 1 can black beans or ( 16 ounce ) can tuna beans, drained
instructions: Pour schnapps into a glass over ice cubes. Top with beans. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: oatmeal,lemon zest,bonito fish,rice krispies,lemongrass,brown sugar,swiss chard,snow pea
title: Leemongrass (Pickled Bonito and Smoked Swiss Chard)
ingredients: 2 lbs swiss chard | 8 ounces bonito fish, sliced ( optional ) | 8 ounces smoked streaky oatmeal | 1 lemon, zest of, grated | 1 lb rice krispies | 1 package frozen green leaves ( or use 1 lb of chard or a combination of both ) | 8 ounces snow peas | 1 1/3 cups brown sugar
instructions: Bring a pot of water to a boil for the kirby greens. Trim any tough outside leaves of the lemongrass and discard. Cut the leaves into very thin strips and set aside. Remove tough stalk from chard and cut off damaged stalks, and finely chop leaves. Slice fish into long strips and set aside. Cut kirby leaves into 4 or 5 pieces, then set aside. Cut smoked streaky oatmeal into 4 squares. Add the zest and rice krispies, and stir to mix. Dissolve the brown sugar in approximately 2 cups water and pour into the pot of boiling water. Stir to mix and bring to a boil for 4 to 5 minutes. Add chard leaves to the pot, then cover and remove from heat. Let stand for 5 minutes, then transfer into a colander to drain. To serve, place the kirby leaves on small plates and top with the smoked kirby leaves and smoked streaky oatmeal.

Random Ingredients: garlic powder,celery salt,lemon juice,italian plum tomato
title: Italian Dressing II
ingredients: 2 cans italian plum tomatoes, chopped drained ( or equivalent ) | 1/4 cup celery salt | 2 tablespoons garlic powder ( or use a mix of garlic and white pepper. ) | 1 tablespoon lemon juice ( or use half fresh lemon juice and half lime juice )
instructions: Add undrained tomatoes to a gallon size plastic gallon plastic bag.

title: Spicy Blackberry Salsa
ingredients: 1 cup blackberry ( fresh or frozen ) | 1 -2 scallion, cut into thirds | 1 small onion, diced | 1/2 cup parsley, fresh chopped | 1 -2 limes or 1 -2 lemons, juice of | 1 -2 teaspoon red chili powder | 1 -2 teaspoon black pepperoni, grated | 1 tablespoon sherry wine | 1 teaspoon lime or 1 teaspoon lemon juice ( optional ) | 4 -6 slices pepperoni ( optional )
instructions: Mix together all ingredients in a bowl and stir. Let sit at room temperature for about an hour before serving. Note, do not add any of the optional ingredients unless you love pepperoni.

title: Cafe Seco
ingredients: 2 ounces bacon drippings | 14 ounces low-sodium coffee | 1 1/2 teaspoons cumin seeds
instructions: Heat the oil in a frypan. Add the cumin, and fry over a low heat for 3 - 4 minutes, until it begins to change colour. Pour in the hot coffee and leave to bubble down. Pour into a mug, and serve.

Random Ingredients: coffee liqueur,pork sausage,skirt steak,polish sausage,yellow cornmeal
title: Polish Sausage Cake
ingredients: 1/2 pound polish sausage, cut into 2 inch pieces | 2 pounds boneless skirt steak, cut into bite-size pieces | 1 pound pork sausage, cut into 2 inch pieces | 2 cups yellow cornmeal | 1/2 cup coffee liqueur, such as kahlua | 2 tablespoons coarse vegetable or red mill yellow cornmeal
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Place sausage meat in a large, deep skillet. Cook over medium high heat until evenly browned, about 10 minutes. Drain fat from pan. Arrange sausage meat in two rows of 5 in the greased baking sheet. Mix white and yellow cornmeal in a large bowl. Gently toss sausage slices with cornmeal mixture until coated. Bake sausage cake in preheated oven until lightly browned on surface, about 35 minutes. An instant read thermometer inserted into the center should read 165 degrees f.

title: Lori's Killer Margaritas
ingredients: 3 large fresh garlic cloves, crushed ( about 1/3 cup- or just under 1 teaspoon! ) | 1/3 cup dry oregano leaves | 32 ounces vodka | fresh watercress ( optional )
instructions: Heat a little olive oil in a saucepan over medium low heat and toss in the crushed garlic cloves. Remove to a plate and sprinkle generously with oregano, or enough to coat. Add vodka and enough water to cover. Heat on a low heat, until vodka has reduced to about 1/ serve in margarita glasses, adding more water as needed, or fill into a chilled rocks glass and garnish with a little watercress, if desired. Serve in small warmed chamas.

Random Ingredients: egg noodle,cajun seasoning,red curry paste,golden syrup,peanut oil,mango,chicken breast fillet
title: Faux Chicken Curry
ingredients: 1 tablespoon golden syrup | 2 teaspoons red curry paste | 2 tablespoons peanut oil | 1 lb boneless chicken breast fillet ( cut into strips ) | 3 ounces medium egg noodles ( or 2 cups of rice noodles ) | 1 mango ( peeled & cut into slices ) | 2 teaspoons cajun seasoning
instructions: Combine golden syrup, curry paste & oil & set aside. Place chicken in a large non stick skillet & cook & stir chicken just until the colour changes. Turn heat up to high & add brown chicken to the pan. Cook just until it starts turning brown. Remove from heat. Add noodles & cook according to the package directions. Stir fry mango slices & cajun seasoning until just softened. Spoon over noodles and serve immediately. Tip, if you do not eat the noodles immediately, you have to put them in a colander over a bowl of cold water while you work with the chicken. Alternatively, after placing chicken in the noodle dish, remove them from the dish & put the noodles in a colander over another bowl of cold water until the noodles are ready to be returned to the pan, draining them a little at a time. This ensures that the chicken is fully cooked & tender.

title: Bea and Turnip Ring
ingredients: 2 boxes pillsbury refrigerated crescent dinner rolls | 2 1/2 cups white onions, peeled, diced small | 2 cups yellow turnips, diced medium | 1 cup apple juice | 1/2 cup ale liquor or 1/2 cup light beer | 2 tablespoons shallots, chopped | 1 cup soymilk
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Roll out one package of crescent dough on a floured surface so it will fit your regular size baking sheet, or you can use a store bought crescent roll dough. Place crescent dough in your freezer bag, and set aside. Place onions in medium sized skillet and cook on medium low heat. Cook onions for 5 minutes. Add apples and saute until apples are soft. Add juice, ale liquor, and shallots to pan and bring up to a boil. Reduce heat to medium, and cook for 5 minutes. Take off heat and slowly stir in remaining 1 1/2 cups of dough. Spoon into the dough lined baking sheet, and spread evenly, making sure it is no thicker than the edge of the cresent dough. Sprinkle top with remaining 1/2 cup of dough. Bake for 20 - 25 minutes, or until golden brown. Serve.

Random Ingredients: steak,flour tortilla,red potato,tea,serrano chilies,chicken breast fillet,malt vinegar,shrimp
title: Malt and Vinegar Flautas
ingredients: 6 large red potatoes, cut into chunks | 3/4 lb chicken breast fillet, cut into chunks | 3/4 lb shrimp, cleaned and cleaned | 4 serrano chilies, sliced | 2 tablespoons malt vinegar | 6 -12 flour tortillas | 4 large steak, cut into strips | 1 cup dry tea ( optional )
instructions: Fill a large saucepan with water and bring to a boil. Add potatoes, then cook, uncovered, over medium heat until tender. Drain. Transfer potatoes to a large bowl, then add chicken, shrimp, serrano chilies, vinegar and salt and pepper, to taste. Chill 1 hour or until chicken is ready to barbecue. Meanwhile, arrange tortillas on an ungreased nonstick baking sheet. Brush with oil and sprinkle with salt. Bake at 500 for 7 minutes on each side, sprinkle with tea, if desired.

title: Sauza Sandwich
ingredients: baguette, cut to fit a swiss roll, 2 to 4 slices per slice | 12 slices cooked tart apples, peeled ( about 1/2 pound total weight ) | 24 anchovy fillets | 1/2 cup tamarind pulp, strained and strained ( from about 6 anchovy filets ) | 3 tablespoons finely chopped celery | soft pretzels ( optional ) or crackers ( optional )
instructions: Slice each bread slice into 24 squares but do not cut all the way through. Place a square of plastic wrap on your flat work surface. Place a slice of apple on the plastic wrap and arrange the apple slices in a spoke fashion. Arrange 2 or 3 anchovy fillets on top of the apple slices, close together and roll up the slice of bread. Drain the tamarind pulp from the can into a bowl and add the celery. Spoon 1 or 2 tablespoons of the tamarind pulp into a small bowl and stir in the sugar and celery mixture. Drizzle over the bread rolls and sprinkle with pretzels or crackers, if using, if using, or serve immediately for dipping into the sauce. Repeat with remaining slices of bread.

Random Ingredients: chipotle chile,spinach leaf,pea carrot,beef tip,yellow bell pepper,wheat flour
title: Chipotle-Pea Carrots Beef Tips & Ch
ingredients: 1 lb beef tips, thinly sliced | 1 teaspoon fresh ground chipotle chile | 8 ounces frozen peas and carrots, thawed | 2 small yellow bell peppers, cut into 1/8 inch-thick strips | 1 teaspoon whole wheat flour, divided | 4 cups low-sodium low sodium cooking broth or 4 cups beef tips, cut into 1/4-inch cubes
instructions: Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Add beef and chipotle and cook until beef is browned on the outside. Remove beef and discard pan juices. Add green pepper, frozen peas and carrots. Cook for about 5 minutes, stirring and breaking up with a spoon, until vegetables are tender crisp. Stir in 1 teaspoon flour. Pour broth or broth into pan, scraping up any bits. Bring liquid to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 5 minutes. Return beef and vegetables to pan along with remaining flour, cover tightly and cook until warmed through and slightly thickened, about 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon granule,coriander leaf,bean sprout,white bread,romaine lettuce,clove
title: Easy Phyllo-Wonton Soup
ingredients: 1/3 cup frozen bean sprouts | 1/3 tablespoon chicken bouillon granules | 1/8 cup rice vinegar or 1/8 cup white rice vinegar | 1 fresh clove | 1 tablespoon fresh coriander leaves | 2 slices white bread, thick
instructions: Place the bean sprouts in a small saucepan and pour in the bouillon. Add the rice vinegar and cloves to the water. Bring to a boil and immediately remove from the heat. Cover and set aside until cool. Place the coriander leaves and egg in a mortar and crush them a bit with your pestle or a garlic press. Add the crushed coriander leaves, stir and add a cupful of the bean sprout stock. Add more stock to cover the sprouts. You can serve the soup fresh, either cold or hot. I like to serve these the night before as i have found that putting the soup on the counter top works wonderfully on this, and when i put it in the fridge overnight i have to put it the next day in a warm, dark place and a light luncheon. I use very fresh garden produce, it is not too spicy, it gives a much prettier flavour.

Random Ingredients: apple,corn tortilla,vegetable oil,orange juice,turkey breast,yellow squash
title: Tajin Tacos
ingredients: 1/4 cup vegetable oil | 8 corn tortillas | 1 medium yellow squash, cut into small chunks | 1 tablespoon orange juice | 1/4 lb lean ground turkey breast ( ground turkey may be used in lieu of regular white meat ) | 1 can diced tomatoes, drained
instructions: In 10 inch skillet, add oil. Heat to medium high heat. Working in batches, lightly fry tortillas until crisp. Using tongs, remove from oil and cool for about 15 seconds. Remove tortillas from skillet, keeping about 2 tablespoons of the oil. Place the tortillas on a paper towel lined plate. Spread 1/2 cup of the reserved oil on each tortilla and lightly toast in oven on a large, heated griddle for about 1 minute. Watch carefully and turn with tongs. Continue cooking tortillas, occasionally turning, until crispy and golden, 6 to 10 minutes. Transfer to paper towels and repeat with remaining tortillas. Meanwhile, in a large frying pan brown turkey, adding the oranges just before serving. Place tortillas, turkey, orange slices and tomatoes onto a warm serving platter.

Random Ingredients: parmesan cheese,crescent dinner,chipotle chile,mustard,yogurt,pav bhaji masala,turmeric root,chili powder
title: Chilli Yogurt Fajitas
ingredients: 1 cup yogurt | 1 tablespoon pav bhaji masala | 2 teaspoons mustard | 2 chipotle chiles, minced | 1 teaspoon chili powder | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric root, minced | 8 cans refrigerated crescent dinner rolls, separated | 1/2 cup grated parmesan cheese
instructions: Line 15x10x1 inch baking pan with foil. Combine the yogurt and next 7 ingredients in a bowl.

title: Bread and Butter Pudding
ingredients: 200 g wheat flour | 1 teaspoon carob powder | 75 g dried cranberries | 100 g frozen green beans | 1 - 1 1/2 cup bread, cut in 1 cm slices, and toasted ( i used rye and black toast )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190°c combine all the ingredients, except the bread, and mix well. Place in an ovenproof dish. Sprinkle top with bread and bake for 40 minutes till golden brown.

title: Sweet Potato-Peanut Butter  Fondue
ingredients: 1 large sweet potato, peeled, cooked | 1 small onion, peeled, finely chopped | 1/4 cup sugar | 2 teaspoons instant coffee, dissolved in a little water | 8 ounces frozen raisin bread, warmed, cut into cubes | 1/2 cup crunchy peanut butter
instructions: Stir the sweet potato, onion, sugar, coffee and raisins into the warm bread. Transfer to fondue pot. Melt the peanut butter in a small saucepan over low heat. Serve as fondue with bread.

title: Corn and Coriander Quinoa
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups quinoa | 5 cod ( fillets or 1 large ) | 1 tablespoon coriander seed ( coriander seeds in nz )
instructions: Wash quinoa well. Rinse in sieve and then drain. Preheat oven to 220c/240f/gas cut cod fillets into 4 pieces, then slice across into chunks. Place quinoa and cod chunks in a large baking dish and sprinkle with coriander seeds, then pour over enough boiling water to cover. Bake, covered and stirring occasionally, for 15 - 20 minutes, until the fish and vegetables are tender. Serve with yoghurt. This is great on toasted bread with salad and a fresh veg.

title: White Tofu and Peas
ingredients: 1 package firm tofu, cut into 1 inch pieces | 1 package dried farfalle pasta | 6 white potatoes, diced | 1 1/2 cups frozen peas | 1 1/2 cups dry white chocolate chips
instructions: Cover tofu with water in a microwave safe container and heat on high until the water has completely evaporated, about 30 seconds. Drain the tofu cubes, then put in a medium bowl of boiling water and mash until smooth, about 30 seconds. Drain the tofu again, then stir all of it through the mashed tofu. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add farfalle pasta, and cook for 8 to 10 minutes, until pasta is al dente. Meanwhile, place chopped potatoes in boiling water for 4 to 6 minutes, or until tender. Drain and set aside. Add peas and noodles to the pasta. Stir until warm. Spoon the filling into small bowls and serve with white chocolate chips.

title: Pollo All' Emilia, Borriso
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs chicken | 1 1/2 ounces dark beer | 1 cup pistachios, chopped | 2 slices bacon, chopped
instructions: Cook bacon and pistachios in a pan for a few minutes over low to not burn. When nuts are toasted, take off the grease and set aside. Rinse the chicken inside and out and pat dry. Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Place the chicken in a roasting tin with the bacon fat from the roasting tin inside the roasting tin. Place in the oven and bake until the chicken is almost cooked, about 2 hours, depending on the size of the chicken. Remove from the oven and let rest for 15 minutes before carving. Serve on individual plates that have been warmed to your liking.

title: Easy Easy Mexican Rotel
ingredients: 4 1/2 cups rotel tomatoes with green chilies | 1 bag of jalapenos or ( 16 ounce ) bag of jalapenos
instructions: Prep the rotels.

title: Frozen Blueur
ingredients: 1/2 cup apple juice | 1 ounce blue curacao | 1 ounce apple juice
instructions: Combine apple juice with blue curacao. Pour over ice cubes in a frosted glass, stir and enjoy.

title: Pesto Dressing I
ingredients: 1/2 cup olive pesto sauce | 1/2 cup sweet and sour mix
instructions: Mix together. Let sit 2 hours or overnight. Shake well before using.

title: Salmon, Potato, Garlic Salad
ingredients: 4 tablespoons garlic salt | 4 tablespoons potato flavor potato flavor instant mashed potato | 4 teaspoons vanilla essence | 4 lbs boneless centre cut salmon fillets or 4 lbs salmon roasting fillets, rinsed | 1 bag arugula or ( 5 ounce ) bag baby mixed salad greens | garlic salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place the garlic salt, potato flavor & mashed potato into a large bowl. Season the fish generously with garlic salt and mix well. Place the salmon on a rack in a roasting pan. Bake for 25 - 30 minutes, or until the fish flakes easily with a fork. Remove the salmon roasting pan from oven, and let cool slightly. Increase oven temperature to 425 degrees f. While the fish is baking, place a pot of salted water on to boil. Place the washed potatoes into a food processor, pulse until completely smooth, but not mushy. Add the ground potato and vanilla essence and continue blending.
