While still on the motor running, add 2 - 3 tbls of water if the mixture is too dry. Stir in 1 cup of shredded or sliced almonds or whole almonds if using. While still on the motor running, add the remaining 1/2 cup of shredded almonds and continue on, pulsing until the mixture is the consistency of your choice. Stir in the arugula or mixed leaves, then season with additional garlic salt. Transfer the potatoes mixture to a serving platter or individual serving plates and top with a small spoonful of salmon & top with some arugula dressing.

Random Ingredients: kasuri methi,pumpkin pie spice,enchilada sauce,cottage cheese,applesauce,extra beef,cooking spray
title: Faux Paleo Beef and Pumpkin Enchilada Curry
ingredients: 1 lb extra lean ground beef | cooking spray | 2 ounces kasuri methi ( dried fenugreek leaves ) | 1 package frozen reduced fat cottage cheese, thawed | 1 jar spicy enchilada sauce | 2 tablespoons unsweetened applesauce | 1/4 teaspoon pumpkin pie spice
instructions: Prepare a 6 cup food processor with quick pulses, chopping in between pulses. If there are any large chunks of kaisuri methi, chop them and set aside. Place ground beef in a large saucepan and cook over medium heat until meat is browned, breaking it up as it cooks. Reserving skillet drippings, drain any excess fat. Spray a 9x13 inch baking dish with cooking spray. Stir together cottage cheese, enchilada sauce, applesauce, pumpkin pie spice and reserved kaisuri methi. Layer half the meat mixture in the dish, scraping up any chunks. Spread the remaining meat mixture. Tent with plastic wrap, tightly film the edges of the dish with spray, and sprinkle with the remaining dried fenugreek leaves. Cover dish with foil and refrigerate for at least 90 minutes, or overnight. When ready to bake, preheat oven to 350f degrees. Uncover dish and bake until top is browned and bubbling, 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Caccal's Tuna Salad for One
ingredients: 2 tablespoons flaked almonds | 3 tuna | 1/2 teaspoon cumin powder | 1/2 teaspoon marjoram | 1/4 teaspoon crushed garlic | 1 can mandarin oranges, drained | 0.5 container frozen whipped topping, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven 350°f. Mix all ingredients and place in a 9x13 baking dish. Bake at 350°f for 20 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Quick and Easy One Pot Snack
ingredients: 2 cups bulgur wheat ( cracked wheat ) | 2 teaspoons cardamom seeds ( ground ) | 3 avocados ( halved and pitted ) or 4 tablespoons drained diced avocado ( half of 1 avocado )
instructions: In a medium bowl, pour bulgur wheat into the bottom of a glass jar. Add 1 teaspoon cardamom seeds and 2 tablespoons of mashed avocado pieces. Place the jar in a microwave safe bowl or the lid with several inches of wafting water so it's touching the bulgur or the water in the jar. Microwave for 12 minutes, or until bulgur is tender and slightly grainy. Enjoy.

title: Macadamia Nuts in Spices
ingredients: 4 macadamia nuts | 2 tablespoons ground cardamom pods | 1 tablespoon olive oil
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees f. Pour the olive oil into a baking dish and place the baking dish in it. When the oven is hot enough, scatter the cardamom pods over the dish. Roast the nuts, stirring occasionally, until the smell of the nuts is released and slightly darkened, about 15 minutes. Transfer the hazelnuts to a coffee grinder and give them a few grinds to remove the nuts they're cooked in to the oven. They should be able to grind together with more or less oil. Remove the baking dish and let cool slightly then place the nuts on a serving dish and allow to cool completely before discarding the pods. Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Mushroom and Carrot Chicken Wings
ingredients: 8 chicken wings, thawed | 2 cups canned cremini mushrooms | 1 large carrot, sliced thick | 1 small shallot, sliced thin | 1/2 cup unsweetened dried cherries
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Prepare three baking sheets by lining them with parchment paper. Place the wings in a large bowl and spray with cooking spray. Cover and place in the oven. Bake for 20 minutes for whole wings and 15 minutes for thawed wings. After removing from oven, place mushrooms in a saucepan and cover with water. Let soften for 15 minutes. Remove mushrooms from saucepan and drain. Combine mushroom water throughly. Pour mushroom water into saucepan and boil. Cook, stirring constantly, about 5 minutes or until liquid has been absorbed. Turn heat back to 350 degrees f. In a baking dish, arrange carrots and mushrooms in an even layer. Top with cremini mushrooms, then sprinkle with shallot. Bake for 20 minutes and spoon filling on top. Cover and bake 10 minutes more.

Random Ingredients: brandy,broccoli,gruyere cheese,horseradish,sage leaf,heavy cream,sriracha sauce,nam pla
title: Broccoli With Horseradish Sauce
ingredients: 4 cups broccoli, trimmed and cut into 1-inch florets | 1 tablespoon unsalted butter, plus additional for buttering the dish | 1/4 cup heavy cream | 1/3 cup sour cream ( or plain yogurt ) | 1/2 teaspoon grated horseradish | 1 -2 teaspoon grated nam pla | 1 teaspoon nam pla | 1/2 teaspoon hot sriracha sauce ( or to taste ) | 1 teaspoon minced fresh sage leaf
instructions: Bring large pot of lightly salted water to boil. Add broccoli and cook until just tender crisp, 3 minutes. Dump florets and remaining ingredients into large skillet, stirring to mix. Cook 2 to 3 minutes or until heated through. Serve over freshly cooked jasmine rice.

Random Ingredients: cotija cheese,corn oil,thyme leave,pineapple,balsamic vinegar,salsa verde,simple syrup
title: Pineapple Corn Chips
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups pureed pineapple ( about 2 medium unpeeled cups ) | 1 tablespoon dried thyme leave | 1/8 cup pure balsamic vinegar | 1/8 cup corn oil | 1 tablespoon simple syrup | 1 tablespoon cotija cheese | 1 tablespoon salsa verde
instructions: Drain pineapple and coarsely chop. Chop thyme very fine, then mix with other ingredients in a large bowl. Place corn chips into a freezer bag and pour corn chips into bag. Seal bag and refrigerate for 2 - 3 hours or overnight. Before serving, remove contents of bag from refrigerator and stir before serving.

Random Ingredients: mace,file powder,pineapple juice,orange juice,great northern bean,chicken stock meat,margarine,blueberry
title: Canadian Prairie Blueberry Bean Soup
ingredients: 2 cups fresh small great northern beans ( or other winter beans ) | 3 tablespoons margarine or 3 tablespoons butter | 6 fluid ounces orange juice | 1 1/2 cups fresh orange juice | 1 1/4 cups pineapple juice | 2 cups chicken stock ( homemade or from canned pink rice soup cubes or beef stock cubes ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace | file powder
instructions: Wash beans and remove rocks at inside.

Random Ingredients: mustard seed,corn husk,plain flour,fish sauce,queso fresco,ice cube
title: Crispy Corn, Cheese and Salt Crust
ingredients: 1/2 cup corn husk | 1/3 cup plain flour | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds | 2 teaspoons fish sauce ( optional ) | 1 1/2 cups queso fresco or 1 1/2 cups monterey jack cheese, grated | ice cube, to serve
instructions: Place the cornhusks in a food processor and process until the cornhusks are finely ground. Place the flour, mustard seeds, fish sauce and cheese in a saucepan and cook over a medium heat for 2 - 4 minutes, shaking the pan and stirring occasionally, until the cheese and mustard seeds have combined. Pour the ground cheese mixture into a colander. Press the cornhusks through the cloth. Dust the cornhusks lightly with more flour. Serve the corn in a bowl, sprinkled with extra cheese if desired.

Random Ingredients: green pea,anise seed,green apple,bread,canola oil,self raising flour,chocolate chip
title: Anise and Mint Christmas Scones
ingredients: 3 green apples, peeled and sliced | 3 teaspoons anise seeds | 3 cups self raising flour | 3 cups bread, cubed | 1/2 cup fresh peas, chopped | 1 tablespoon green apple, grated ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon canola oil | 1/2 cup chocolate chips
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c. Place the green and anise seeds in a roasting tin and toast in oven for 10 to 15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until seeds begin to swell. Cool. Combine the flour, bread, peas and grated apple in a large bowl. Stir in the oil. Add the anise and mint seeds and mix thoroughly. Turn the mix into a lightly greased or floured work surface and knead it into a neat ball. Roll it out to about 1/4 inch thickness using a drinking glass. Cut out 3 inch rounds using a 2 1/2 inch round biscuit cutter, or drinking glass. Place rounds on a greased baking tray. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes, or until well risen and pale brown in colour. Turn the scones out onto a wire rack to cool. Spread chocolate glaze over both scones and return scones to the oven and warm until chocolate melts, about 5 to 10 minutes. Store in an airtight tin or covered with a tea towel until needed.

Random Ingredients: rotel tomato,milk,tomato green chile pepper,kielbasa,italian parsley,lamb,red capsicum
title: Crock Pot Mexican Lamb (Or Turkey) Stew
ingredients: 750 g lamb, stew meat cubed | 2 red capsicums | 3 ounces kielbasa or 3 ounces other spicy sausage, chopped coarsely | 125 ml skim milk | 1 can rotel diced tomatoes with green chile peppers, undrained and chopped | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh italian parsley | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh italian parsley
instructions: In a 4 1/2 to 5 qt crock pot add lamb, capsicum, sausage and sautéing ingredients and cook on high for 3 to 4 hours and then on low for a further 8 to 10 hours. Sprinkle with parsley and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: pistachio,green bell pepper,cumin,curry paste,pie shell,horseradish,cilantro leaf,ice
title: Cousin Pete's Spicy Pepper Dip
ingredients: 1 green bell pepper, seeded and diced | 1 1/2 teaspoons horseradish | 1 teaspoon cumin | 1/2 cup unsalted pistachios, coarsely chopped | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh cilantro leaves | 2 tablespoons curry paste | 2 unbaked pie shells | 1/2 cup crushed ice
instructions: In a large bowl, mix bell pepper, horseradish, cumin and pistachios with 1/2 cup water. Stir in cilantro and curry paste. Spoon mixture evenly over pie shells. Top with crushed ice. Chill in the refrigerator for 1 hour.

title: Horseradish Sauce for Dipping Sauces and Spaetzle
ingredients: 16 fluid ounces bottled horseradish | 1 tablespoon garlic powder | 1 tablespoon marjoram | 1 tablespoon raisins
instructions: Combine the horseradish, garlic powder, marjoram and raisins in a saucepan. Stir. Over medium heat, bring to a boil.

Random Ingredients: espresso powder,green chilies,salt black pepper,artichoke heart,lemon juice,kiwi fruit,red chilies,shallot
title: Hot Artichoke Ice-Cream
ingredients: 1 can artichoke hearts, drained and chopped | 1 lb kiwi fruit, peeled and sliced | 8 shallots, peeled and thinly sliced ( white or light green parts only ) | 1 pint low-fat vanilla-flavored espresso powder | 2 fresh red chilies, seeded and chopped | 2 green chilies, sliced | salt & freshly ground black pepper | 2 teaspoons lemon juice ( optional )
instructions: In a large bowl, combine artichokes, kiwi, shallots, espresso powder, red chiles, chilies, green chilies and salt and pepper. Mix until well blended – pour mixture into a resealable freezer bag. Seal and freeze for at least an hour, but up to 6 hours. Unwrap from freezer and place in a large bowl. Add lemon juice, if desired, and stir. Serve. The hot ice cream serves up to 3.

Random Ingredients: oyster sauce,iceberg lettuce,vegetable oil,cheddar cheese,prawn,chicken bouillon cube,penne pasta,potato starch
title: Potato Crusted Prawns in Lettuce Cups
ingredients: 500 g penne pasta | 1/4 cup potato starch | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 400 g prawns, cooked peeled and deveined | 400 g cheddar cheese, grated | 4 teaspoons chicken bouillon cubes | 1 cup iceberg lettuce, leaves separated | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce | 1 tablespoon soured cream
instructions: Place potato starch in a large mixing bowl or glass measuring cup. Add vegetable oil, mixing well. Add prawns and potato starch and mix thoroughly with your hands. You can use your hands as this will mix and shape the prawns and coat them. Heat a frypan over a high heat and add the potato coated prawns and cook for 4 minutes stirring frequently. Remove from the pan and place on a paper towel lined plate. Allow the prawns to cool slightly and then set aside. Combine cheese, bouillon cubes, lettuce leaves and oyster sauce. Set aside. In a large non stick frypan over a medium heat, add the vegetable mixture and cook for 2 minutes stirring constantly. Add the prawns and cook until they turn pink. Remove from heat and place in a large bowl. Add the parmesan cheese and toss to combine. Serve with the baked potato crusted shells.

title: South American Calves [bhurisitos Avocado Fish ]
ingredients: 1 lb sole fillet | 2 red chilies | 2 tablespoons corn or 2 tablespoons flour | 1 package thawed frozen phyllo pastry sheets | 1 can diced canned red chilies, drained | 1/2 lb frozen thawed frozen topping, thawed and squeezed dry | 1/2 cup thawed refrigerated reduced fat shredded monterey jack and colby blend cheese blend
instructions: Pre heat oven to 350 degrees. Lightly spray a nonstick skillet with nonstick cooking spray. Peel off the stems and discard. Brush a few tablespoons of the water from the canned chilies on each fillet and place in skillet. Sprinkle fillets with a little salt. Stir over medium heat, turning once, until barely cooked through, approximately 5 minutes. Remove from skillet and place on a plate. Slice the chiles in half lengthwise and remove seeds if it does not already have chilies. Coarsely chop the chiles and place in a small bowl. Cover with boiling water and let soak until softened. Drain chiles and set aside to cool. Add the corn or flour to the chiles and water. Stir well until the corn flour is moistened. Remove a sheet of phyllo from package and brush with some of the water. Cut remaining sheet into two equal portions and stack on top of first sheet, spraying each with water as before. Brush the top and sides of pastry with water and fold in to form a triangle. Brush pastry with some of the reserved water and place on parchment paper. Place a second sheet on top of the first sheet. Repeat process until you have four long rows of pastry. Spread about 1/2 cup of the canned chilies evenly on the bottom layer of the pastry, spreading it thinly. Place the second pastry sheet over the chilies and spread it thinly again, placing the other end of the pastry on top. Bake for approximately 12 - 15 minutes or until top is golden brown. Remove from oven and top with the grated colby blend. Cut into quarters and serve immediately. Note, the preparation time depends on the fillet amount of fillet used, the thickness of the phyllo sheets, how crispy the crust will be. If you want your fillet to be crisp as the phyllo sheets appear to be, bake for 20 - 25 minutes.

title: Mushroom Pasta with Soft Corn
ingredients: 8 white mushrooms, sliced | 1 can cream-style corn, undrained | 8 ounces cooked farfalle pasta
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

title: Oven Stew
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless sirloin roast | 2 lbs medium tomatillos | 1/2 cup seasoning, of your choice ( e.g., mrs. dash, etc. ) | 1 packet onion soup mix ( or 2 teaspoons dried onion powder, can use 1/2 teaspoon )
instructions: Cut roast into large, narrow chunks and place in a large roaster or crock and add 1/2 cup of water to bottom of pan. Season with tony's onion soup mix and seasoning. Cover and place in 300 degree oven and set to cook for one hour. Turn heat up to cook for one more hour or until desired doneness. Serve with flour tortillas, corn, guacamole, salsa, etc. Note, you can also bake in the slow cooker on low for the first 5 hours to cook longer.

title: Kohlrabi Chips
ingredients: 4 kohlrabi | 1 head romaine lettuce | 2 -3 tablespoons tabasco sauce
instructions: Toast the kohlrabi slices in a pan, grilling them in batches. Remove from heat and let cool until the skins are loosened if any. Peel the kohlrabi and cut into 1/4 inch slices, using a mandolin. Lay the shredded kohlrabi on a work surface and sprinkle with tabasco, to taste. Put a layer of lettuce on top of them. Cut a cone shaped piece of the kohlrabi from the top just below the stem to allow for easier eating. Turn around in the shape of a cone and put the cone on the lettuce. Place on a heated griddle or other heavy object and sprinkle with salt. Cook both sides, turning a few times and pressing down with a spatula, until golden.

Random Ingredients: beef chuck roast,chocolate,red potato,cayenne,bamboo shoot,anchovy,pizza crust
title: Anchoed-Crust Beef Pot Roast  W- Pork Empanadas
ingredients: 2 -3 tablespoons pizza crust ( boboli's or your own favorite ) | 1 beef chuck roast | 2 ounces unsweetened chocolate ( use good quality milk chocolate, or ancho chocolates ) | 1/2 teaspoon anchovies | 1 pinch cayenne | red potatoes ( about 4 small per person ) | anchovy ( optional )
instructions: Put 1 tbs of pizza crust mix in the center of the roast and then cut on the diagonal about 1/2 thick to form a rectangle, or use a rectangle shaped pizza crust. The length of the roast should be about 1/8. Spread the 1 tbs of pizza dough evenly on the pizza crust and place the roast in a single layer over the crust. Place the chocolate in a bowl and add the anchovies. Sprinkle on the cayenne. Top with the remaining pizza crust. Gently press down each layer of dough slightly so that the crust is not sticking. Use spatula to make dimples in the crust. Cut several slits on the top. Add water if making a crust with too much air pockets. Bake in a 425°f oven for 20 to 25 minutes, until crust is golden brown. Remove to a wire rack to cool for 5 minutes then cut into 1 inch squares. Serve with optional anchovies mixed inches.

title: Tuscan Bean Soup
ingredients: 1/2 pound beef sausages, sliced into bite size pieces | 20 ounces cannellini beans
instructions: Place sausages in a large pot over medium heat. Brown, breaking sausages into small pieces as they cook. Drain sausages and place in a pot with a lid, or a crockpot that can hold all ingredients. Add cannellini beans to pot. Cover the pot, and cook on medium heat for about 4 hours, or until beans are tender. Remove the lid for the last 30 minutes of cooking, or use crockpot on high to serve.

Random Ingredients: red curry paste,dark chocolate,coconut sugar,oregano,tomato ketchup
title: Kiss Me, Oh Yes a Momma Chokey!!
ingredients: 1 can tomato ketchup | 1 tablespoon red curry paste | 1 tablespoon coconut sugar | 1/2 teaspoon oregano | 300 g dark chocolate, chopped
instructions: Mix the rest of the ingredients together, heat, and microwave, mix together well and put in the fridge until cold. Mix once again, and cut the chocolate up, mix through to desired texture. Serve with fish, chips, crackers and veggies.

Random Ingredients: pinto bean,crimini mushroom,parmigiano reggiano cheese,pepper,feta cheese,hamburger,beef broth
title: Spaghetti Sauce Soup (Greek)
ingredients: 2 lbs hamburger | 1 lb pinto beans | 2 jars beef broth | 3 slices dry parmigiano-reggiano cheese ( about 2-inch pieces ) | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon dried pepper | freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | crimini mushroom ( optional )
instructions: Cook the hamburger over medium heat until no pink remains. Drain. Place the beef, pinto beans, beef broth and cheese in a pot. Add water to just cover and simmer until the beans are soft about an hour. Puree the soup in a blender or food processor and return to the pot. Taste and add more pepper as desired. Serve with toasted parmigiano reggiano and/or crumbled hot italian cheese, cracked black pepper and a robust dry mustard. Serves.

title: Raspberry Pate (No Cook Muffin Mix)
ingredients: 2 boxes raspberries sherbet | 1 cup ricotta cheese or 1 cup cottage cheese
instructions: Cut the strawberries in half and set aside. In a large bowl, combine the sherbet with the ricotta. Add the berries and stir well until combined. Pour into a buttered 9x10x2 pan and bake at 350°f for about 40 minutes or until a knife inserted into the center comes out clean.

Random Ingredients: red enchilada sauce,egg yolk,flour,salt black pepper,radish
title: Chiles Rellenos Verde
ingredients: 2 lbs whole radishes, peeled | salt & freshly ground black pepper | 1/2 cup red enchilada sauce, mild | 3 egg yolks | 1 cup flour
instructions: Slice the radishes thin, sprinkle generously with salt, and pepper, and set aside. Combine the egg yolks, and stir thoroughly into the yolk batter in a bowl. Sift the flour into a mound on a plate, dredge the radishes in flour and shake off any excess. Shred the radishes roughly. Add the shredded radishes to the yolk batter, and stir until well combined. Set aside. Bring a medium size pot of water to a boil. Working with just enough radishes to cover them, blanch them in the boiling water for 1 minute and remove the blanched radishes to plates. Using a slotted spoon, transfer the radishes to paper towels to drain and dry. Preheat the broiler to high. Using a sharp knife, remove the peel and pith from the radishes. Rinse well. Dry the peel and pith under cold water and then remove each one with a slotted spoon. Repeat until you have enough radish peel and pith. Coarsely chop the radishes. Add to the batter. Mix well. Transfer to a baking sheet lined with parchment paper or aluminum foil. Bake at 300°f for 15 minutes. Remove from the oven, sprinkle with sugar.

title: Artichoke and Paneer (Artichokes Cooked in Paneer)
ingredients: 2 ounces paneer, cut into 1 inch chunks | 6 water chestnuts | 1 tablespoon ground cinnamon | 14 ounces artichoke hearts, drained and quartered
instructions: In a large skillet over medium high heat, combine the paneer chunks and water chestnuts.

title: Kaffir Lime Cream
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups heavy whipping cream, whipped until stiff | 1/4 cup minced sage | 10 kaffir lime leaves | oil ( for deep frying )
instructions: Heat cream until it reaches 170°f. Add sage and lime leaves and mix well. Pour cream on a flat plate, and roll the cream into a cylinder shape with the kaffir lime leaves, being careful to keep the kaffir lime leaves from tearing. Keep in the refrigerator until serving time. Remove lime leaves before serving.

Random Ingredients: allspice,green chilies,natural peanut butter,cavender greek seasoning,feta cheese,leek,ginger garlic paste,poppy seed
title: Ethiopian Nuts
ingredients: 3 tablespoons dried vegetable-style peanuts | 1 teaspoon finely grated lemon rind | 1/3 cup natural-style peanut butter | 1 tablespoon grated ginger-garlic paste | 1 1/2 teaspoons allspice | 1 bunch leeks, white and light green parts only, finely chopped | 1 1/2 teaspoons cavender's greek seasoning | 1 -2 tablespoon poppy seed ( optional )
instructions: Soak peanuts in boiling water for 10 minutes. Then place in a food processor and process until peanuts are finely ground. Add in lemon rind, peanut butter, ginger garlic paste, allspice, chilies, leeks and cavender's greek seasoning. Process to a smooth paste. Transfer to shallow bowl and refrigerate for at least 1 hours or overnight. The longer it rests, the spicier the nuts will become. The more the flavors meld, the more flavorful they will be. Serve chilled or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: ancho chile powder,chorizo sausage,lime,beef chuck,belgian endive,tomato puree,white rice
title: Endive With Chorizo
ingredients: 1 -2 chorizo sausage | 3 ounces uncooked white rice | 1 belgian endive, trimmed and sliced ( may omit ) | 2 tablespoons tomato puree ( may sub fresh tomato if chorizo is unavailable ) | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon dried ancho chile powder ( to taste ) | 1 lime
instructions: Slice endive in half lengthwise. Wash chorizo in a medium bowl of cold water and drain. Slice the sausage on the bias into 1/4 inch slices. Place rice in a medium bowl and stir to coat. Drain liquid from chorizo but reserve for later use, if necessary. Place endive slices in another medium bowl and cover with cold water. Soak for about 30 minutes, then rinse under cold water and pat dry. In a medium bowl, combine the reserved chorizo liquid with the tomato puree and chili powder. Add some hot water to the chorizo liquid about 1/3 cup at a time until you are able to pour it into the rice. Drain endive and set aside to use as a serving dish. Add salt and pepper to taste and lime juice to endive and soak a few minutes. Divide rice onto 4 serving plates, using rice that has been heated in the chorizo liquid and endive for each serving. Serve with lime.

title: Simple Sushi Rice
ingredients: 1 lb sushi rice ( preferably short-grain rice ) | 1 teaspoon dried basil leaves ( not packed fresh )
instructions: Rinse rice and cook, in 3 1/2 to 4 quart covered saucepan, over medium heat, until almost dry, about 25 minutes or till tender and fluffy. Cool rice under running water. Transfer to a strainer set over a large bowl and let drain.

title: Crispy Mexi Crescents (Caribbean Meat Tenderizer)
ingredients: 1 lb meat tenderizer | 1 lime, zest of | 2/3 cup white tequila
instructions: Thoroughly mix the meat tenderizer with the lime zest. Using your palms, work the meat in the hot oil. Do not brown the meat.

Random Ingredients: nutmeg,cilantro,chicken bouillon cube,hoagie,no boil lasagna noodle
title: Quick & Easy Homemade Meatless Noodle Lasagna
ingredients: 10 hoagie rolls, sliced lengthwise into 1/4, then sliced into 1/2, then lengthwise again | 1 bag no-boil lasagna noodles | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 1 teaspoon nutmeg | cilantro, to taste ( optional )
instructions: Prep the noodles according to the package directions. In a large saucepan, mix chicken bouillon with nutmeg. Add uncooked noodles and 1 cup boiling water to saucepan and cover with lid. Bring to a boil.

Random Ingredients: chicken stock,brussels sprout,dough,garam masala,chinese wine,tart apple,mace
title: Bukhari's Vegetarian Mulligatawny Soup
ingredients: 1/2 cup dried bread, cut into 1/2-inch cubes ( from a log ) | 6 cups chicken stock | 1 teaspoon ground garam masala | 1/2 teaspoon ground turmeric | 1/8 teaspoon ground mace | 10 heads brussels sprouts | 4 tart apples | 1/4 cup chinese wine, sweet or half-and-half can be substituted. hot for sweet. if you don't like it sweeter add more chinese wine or apple juice )
instructions: Place the bread cubes in a bowl with the stock, garam masala, turmeric, and mace. Cover and set aside. Trim the sprouts to at least 1 1/2 inches. Quarter and core the apples and cut into 1/2 pieces. Set aside. Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add salt. Add brussels sprouts and bring to a boil again. Cook for about 5 minutes or until just barely tender. Drain. Toss with apples.

Random Ingredients: cucumber,enchilada sauce,oregano leaf,jumbo pasta shell,ramen noodle,spanish onion
title: Ranch Noodle Salad
ingredients: 8 ounces small jumbo pasta shells | 1/2 cup spanish onion, thinly sliced | 1/2 cup prepared enchilada sauce | 1/2 cup instant ramen noodles | 1/2 cucumber, thinly sliced | 1/4 teaspoon dried oregano leaves
instructions: Cook pasta.

title: Soya Glaze
ingredients: 1 package vanilla pudding mix ( one pkg. ) | 3 tablespoons soya sauce | 1 package prosciutto ( one pkg. )
instructions: Put all ingredients into a bowl and mix until the mixture is the consistency of honey, if necessary, add water. Pour mixture into a cookie sheet lined with wax. I used parchment paper for the wax paper. Refrigerate until cold. Enjoy warm, or cold on the night of serving.

Random Ingredients: fine breadcrumb,fine sea salt,parmesan cheese,cabbage,broth,potato traditional,chianti wine
title: Danish Pasta Sauce With Chianti (Tuttare Reis)
ingredients: 5 medium potatoes, about 1 1/2 quarts, peeled ( about 3 lbs. ) | 1 cup chianti wine | 3 tablespoons parmesan cheese, freshly grated | 1/2 teaspoon fine sea salt | 1/3 cup fine dry breadcrumb | 2 1/2 cups broth, homemade, any flavor or 2 1/2 cups canned stock | 1 -2 head cabbage, cored, outer leaves removed
instructions: To make the sauce, bring the wine to a boil in a large bowl. Using a potato masher, mash the potatoes with a large wooden spoon, discarding any small lumps. Stir in the cheese, parsley, salt, and breadcrumb. In a separate large sauté pan, heat the broth to boiling. Add cabbage.

Random Ingredients: onion powder,beef tenderloin,savoy cabbage,romaine lettuce,garam masala,saffron strand
title: Saffron Beef Medallions on Leaves or Lettuce
ingredients: 1 lb beef tenderloin, cut into 4 or 5 slices | 1/2 teaspoon onion powder | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala | 4 saffron strands | 2 tablespoons saffron leaves or 2 tablespoons arabian leaves | 1 head savoy cabbage ( about 8/10 pounds ) or 1 head bibb lettuce ( about 8/10 pounds )
instructions: In a large bowl, toss the slices of beef with the onion powder, garam masala and saffron. Let stand at room temperature to marinate, 1 to 2 hours. Light a grill. Remove the beef from the marinade and thread the beef onto the skewers. Place on the covered grill and grill, turning occasionally, until well done, 4 to 6 minutes per side. Serve with the reserved marinade and a salad for a complete meal. Garnish with the saffron leaves, arabian leaves, and lettuce.

title: Eggplant Bread
ingredients: 2 eggplants, sliced and cut into 1/4 inch strips | 200 ml white flour | 2 cloves garlic, minced | 1 tablespoon dried oregano
instructions: Preheat oven to 475°f brush eggplant with oil on all sides, place in a roasting pan. Place garlic, oregano and flour on the top of the eggplant. Cook on medium heat until bubbly, then reduce heat and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes. Pour mixture over eggplant and bake for 30 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Danish Dill Pickle Filling
ingredients: 3 small dill pickles | 3 tablespoons vodka
instructions: Peels the pickles and put into a blender jar. Add the pickles to the jar. Add the vodka to the jar. Store in a dark place for one week.

title: Avocados
ingredients: 4 avocados | 1 cup italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 1 teaspoon finely chopped fresh garlic | 1 teaspoon minced fresh parsley or 1/2 teaspoon dried parsley
instructions: Peel avocados and remove pit using a fork. Cut in half from top to bottom. Remove all the seeds and pits and place in large bowl. Slice each half in half again and using a spatula, scoop out seeds and mash in the bowl with the back of a fork. Mix in bread crumbs, garlic and parsley. Fill pitas with avocado mixture. Serve immediately.

title: Tart Apples with Scratches
ingredients: 1 large tart apple, peeled, cored, and cut into 1 inch cubes | 1/4 cup scotch | 4 green cardamom pods, crushed
instructions: Place the apple cubes onto a plate. Spoon about 1/4 cup of scotch and 3 tbsp of caraway flavored caraway onto each apple. Sprinkle the top of each apples with about a tbsp of caraway. Garnish with scotch seeds and green cardamom. Eat at once, or put the pieces into a plastic bag and store in the fridge for up to 1 week.

title: Chinese Shrimp on the Barbie
ingredients: 1/2 lb shrimp, peeled | 2 tablespoons green grapes, sliced | 1 1/2 tablespoons dry rice wine | 1/3 cup beer ( chinese wine is really nice )
instructions: Prep the shrimp and set aside. Thread the shrimp onto 6 skewers or 12 small metal skewers. Brush the shrimp with a mixture of rice wine and beer, and grill or broil over medium heat until the shrimp are pink and cooked through, 1 - 2 minutes per side. Serve with green onion, chinese mustard rice and hot chinese dipping sauce.

Random Ingredients: broccoli carrot cauliflower mix,dijon mustard,tomato puree,italian breadcrumb,quinoa,chicken
title: Quick Provencal Broccoli Chicken
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa | 1 lb chicken, deboned and roughly chopped | 1 package broccoli carrots cauliflower mix, chopped well ( not in season ) | 1 cup italian style breadcrumbs | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard ( sweet variety ) | 1 can tomato puree ( i like contadina )
instructions: Preheat oven to in a 1 qt. Dive pan add quinoa and lightly coat with cooking spray. Place chicken in a single layer in baking dish. Bake for 45 minutes. While chicken and quinoa are cooking, chop veggies that will be added to skillet. Add chopped veggies to pan. Spray a large skillet with cooking spray. Remove chicken from oven and add quinoa and veggies to the skillet. Place in oven and continue to cook for 25 minutes. Remove from oven and stir in tomato puree, using a fork to break apart the mixture a little. Let stand for 10 minutes and serve.

title: Chinese Crispy Beef and Pork Tenderloin Sandwiches
ingredients: 500 g beef short ribs or 500 g pork tenderloins | 500 g pork tenderloins
instructions: Trim the beef scraps from the short ribs. Cut short ribs into strips about 4cm in length. Cut pork into 8 10cm lengths. Cut the pork into 8 10cm squares. Preheat the oven to 180°c. Place a large tray of parchment paper on the grill for a minute, then drain off the fat from the tray of meat, then set aside. Place the short ribs in a single layer on the tray of meat, brushing them with a little olive oil. Use a pastry brush to cover each side of each long piece with salt and pepper. Grill for about 8 minutes on each side or until cooked as you like.

title: Baked Banana Roll-Ups
ingredients: 1/2 cup chunky salsa | 1/4 cup white vinegar | 1 large banana, mashed | 3/4 cup cooked brown rice, chilled | 2 sheets rice paper, each 14 x 3-inch
instructions: Microwave rice paper sheets, one at a time, on high power for 1 1/2 seconds.

title: Hringlettes
ingredients: 16 ounces herring, cut from head to tail | 3 tablespoons poppy seeds | 1 small sweet red pepper, finely diced | 1 cup breadcrumbs or 1 cup plain breadcrumbs | 1 tablespoon taco sauce | 1 jar prepared taco sauce | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh broccoli
instructions: Preheat grill to medium high. Cut a pocket on the side of each herring. Open with a toothpicks. Cut into four or eight fingers. Spray with a little olive oil cooking spray and rub with the poppy seeds. Season with salt, pepper and/or taco sauce. Place on the grill. Cook for 3 to 5 minutes until golden brown. Top each herring with a dollop of taco sauce. Top with chopped broccoli. Garnish with sour creme if desired. Eat with a green salad or french fries.

title: Hominy and Hominy in Balsamic Vinegar
ingredients: 2 cans hominy ( drain if you don't have time ) | 20 g balsamic vinegar | 4 sheets udon noodles ( thin )
instructions: Drain the hominy, rinse in cold water, remove any stones, cut the rind from the balsamic vinegar. Mix the rind and hominy with the vinegar. Pour 1 cup of the water from the can in a pan and put on medium high heat. When the rind starts to bubble add the udon. When the udon starts to color add 1/2 tsp olive oil then mix. When the udon starts to look like a mush, turn the heat up to medium high. When the udon starts to turn golden you know it is done. Serve while hot.

title: Beans for the Ravioli
ingredients: 225 g spaghetti or 225 g linguine | 225 g frozen spinach, defrosted, squeezed dry | 25 g roasted peanuts oil | 1 orange, zest of | 2 packets espresso beans
instructions: Cook your pasta according to it's instructions. It's very important that the pasta doesn't become too dry. Drain the spaghetti or pasta and set aside. Dice the spinach in half, squeeze out any excess liquid, and coarsely chop it using a food processor, blender, or whatever you prefer. You want the pasta a lot chunky, so it's just your right to chop and keep at room temperature. Heat the oil in a large saucepan or wok over medium high heat, and when it's getting very hot, add your zest, and fry for 3 - 4 minutes, or until fragrant. Add the drained spaghetti or pasta and stir fry for 5 to 8 minutes to heat through. Serve in a large serving bowl with freshly grated parmesan cheese.

title: Fajita Bacon Spread
ingredients: 3 slices bacon | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom powder | 1 pinch fajita seasoning | 2 tablespoons ketchup
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Spread a thin layer of ketchup all around the bottom of an ungreased 9x13 inch baking dish. Place a layer of bacon slices over the ketchup. Sprinkle ground cardamom and fajita seasoning over the bacon. Repeat process until all of the bacon is used. Bake in the preheated oven until the ketchup is bubbling and the cray is beginning to stick, 30 to 40 minutes.

Random Ingredients: asparagus spear,saffron,beef tenderloin,stilton cheese,cilantro leaf,red onion,guacamole,lemonade
title: Beef-Wrapped Stilton With Asparagus, Guacamole, and Smoked Aji
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 lbs beef tenderloin, trimmed and cut diagonally into 4 equal pieces | 2 bunches asparagus spears, trimmed and cut diagonally into 2-inch pieces | 1/4 lb smoky smoky guacamole | 1 lemonade, chilled | 1 cup fresh cilantro leaves ( not dried! ) | 1 pinch saffron ( we used about 1 tsp. ) | 1 medium red onion, diced small | 1 cup asparagus spear, cut diagonally on an angle ( or 2 cups frozen asparagus spears, thawed )
instructions: Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Arrange beef pieces on foil. Season both sides with salt and pepper. Place asparagus in a large slow cooker/crockpot with plenty of space between pieces. Place beef on top of asparagus. Pour guacamole over all. Combine coarsley chopped cilantro, saffron, onion, and asparagus in a small bowl. Spoon mixture onto asparagus asparagus, drizzle with reserved juice. Cover and cook on low for about 10 to 12 hours or on high for about 3 hours or until beef is tender. When served, spoon a small amount of juices onto a plate.

title: Marshmallow Apple Cooler
ingredients: 8 large green apples ( i like dark & prefer it sweeter ) or 8 large red delicious apples ( i like dark & prefer it sweeter ) | 1/3 cup creme de menthe
instructions: Peel and core the apples. Cut each apple into quarters then across into thin long ribbons using your fingers. Place apple slices in a glass baking dish with the creme de menthe. Cover & chill before serving.

title: Coleslaw With Creamy Cream
ingredients: 1/4 cup coleslaw mix | 1/3 cup heavy cream
instructions: Combine all in a medium bowl.

Random Ingredients: pork loin roast,chili powder,seasoning salt,white chocolate
title: Mexican Chocolate Loins
ingredients: 2 1/2 - 3 lbs boneless pork loin roast | 1 -2 tablespoon chili powder ( or to taste ) | 2 tablespoons mrs. dash seasoning salt ( or to taste ) | 5 ounces white chocolate ( optional ) or 5 ounces dark chocolate, melted ( optional )
instructions: Remove any fat from the pork, cutting away excess fat and slicing across the grain into 1/4 slices.

title: Walnut Romaine
ingredients: 2 packages mixed salad-size romaine lettuce - rinsed, dried, and torn into pieces | 1 cup pecan halves | 12 slices fresh mushrooms | 1/4 cup mirin | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano | 1 cup vegetable oil | 3/4 cup finely chopped walnuts
instructions: Tear romaine lettuce into bite size pieces or shred and mix with pecans. Combine mushrooms, mirin, and oregano and set aside. Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Sauté walnuts until golden brown. Remove walnuts to a plate and lightly pat walnuts with a paper towel to remove excess oil.

title: Smoky Butter and Tortellini Salad with Cheese Tortellini
ingredients: 1 package cheese tortellini | 2 tablespoons salted butter | 1/4 teaspoon paprika | salad greens
instructions: Cook tortellini according to package directions, or until just al dente.

title: Lamb and Rye Balls
ingredients: 1 lb lean lamb, cut into small pieces | 2 tablespoons rye flour
instructions: Roll the lamb into a ball and roll in the rye flour. Repeat the process for all the balls. Leave to rest in a cool place for 2 hours, or until balls are cooked.

title: Irish Smoked Kielbasa and Sour Cream
ingredients: 1/4 lb kielbasa ( polish sausage ) | 2 tablespoons sugar ( to taste ) | 1/2 teaspoon corn oil | 2 tablespoons irish cream or 2 tablespoons cream of coconut
instructions: Grill or bbq until done to preference, about 15 minutes per side. Mix sugar and oil in small shallow dish. Dip kielbasa in oil, allowing excess oil to drain off when browning. Place on plate while frying. Add irish sour cream to the sour cream. Let it soak into the sour cream.

title: Authentic Mexican Bread (Abuela)
ingredients: 1 1/2 teaspoons yeast, divided | 3 - 3 1/2 cups bread fat, separated | 18 corn tortillas
instructions: In a mixing bowl, combine 1/2 tsp of the yeast and 3 cups of the bread fat. Add 3 1/2 cups of the bread fat. Work the yeast into the bread by gently folding it with your fingers.. Cover, set aside to ferment for 10 - 15 minutes. Mix the last tsp of yeast with the remaining 1 1/2 tsp of bread fat and the rest of the bread fat. Cut the tortillas into 6 equal pieces or 3 - 4 pieces each. Roll lightly in the palms of your hand.

title: Gazpacho
ingredients: 2 lbs lean ground lamb shoulder or 2 lbs lamb, ground | 1 lb fresh sour cream or 1 lb soft cream | 2 tablespoons dried dill ( optional ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons cream of tartar | 1 bitter melon, seeded and cut into wedges | 1 lb baby spinach | 1 lb thin spaghetti
instructions: Mix ground lamb, sour cream and spices together and shape mixture into large meatballs, dropping meatballs on the ground lamb while doing so. Cook meatballs over medium heat until cooked through. Add baby spinach and meatballs to soup and simmer for 20 minutes. Cook spaghetti according to package directions. Serve soup and garnished with grated cheese.

Random Ingredients: salsa,chicken stock,honey mustard,pepper,beef brisket,ricotta cheese,wild mushroom
title: Spicy Corned Beef
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs beef brisket | 2 cans mixed wild mushrooms | 1 jar salsa | 1 cup chicken stock | 1/4 cup honey mustard | 1 package ricotta cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to place brisket in bottom of a 5 quart casserole dish. Drain mushrooms and place in next. Drain jar of salsa well and add to beef. Place remaining ingredients over top and bake about two hours. Note, if you want to use a crock pot, cook on low for about 8 hours the next day, then increase cooking time to keep beef moist and tender.

title: Italian Sausage and Pepper Steak
ingredients: 8 ounces mild italian sausage, casings removed | 2 teaspoons crushed red peppers | 16 ounces sirloin, trimmed of all visible fat
instructions: Cut the sausage into 2 inch pieces. Place in a large, heavy pan or dutch oven and sprinkle with crushed red peppers, about 1/2 teaspoon per pound of sausage. Add meat. Place over medium high heat, bring to a simmer, and cook, uncovered, stirring occasionally, until meat is cooked through, 12 to 15 minutes. Serve over cooked pasta.

Random Ingredients: white wine vinegar,maple syrup,mustard seed,cardamom pod
title: Glazed Maple Mustard
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups pure maple syrup | 4 cups pure mustard seeds | 10 1/4 ounces white wine vinegar | 4 cardamom pods, crushed
instructions: In a 2 quart heavy saucepan, combine the maple syrup, mustard seeds, 4 cups of cold water, vinager, and cardamom. Bring to a slow boil over moderate heat.

Random Ingredients: adobo sauce,littleneck clam,basil,flat leaf italian parsley,cake flour,beef chuck roast,red pepper flake
title: Easy Slow Cooker Clam-Lobster Stew
ingredients: 6 pounds trimmed corned beef chuck roast | 1/4 cup chopped fresh basil | 1/4 cup chopped flat-leaf italian parsley | 2 teaspoons crushed red pepper flakes | 1 jar adobo sauce, divided | 2/3 cup coarsely chopped fresh basil | 9 littleneck clams, cleaned and halved | 3 tablespoons cake flour
instructions: Rinse and drain littleneck clams, place in an 8 inch square baking dish. In a medium bowl, mix together 1/4 cup basil, parsley, crushed red pepper flakes, and 1/2 cup adobo sauce. Set aside. Place second 1/2 cup basil, 1/4 cup basil, and 1/2 cup parsley in a second medium bowl. Cut remaining clams lengthwise and place into the bowl. Pour the marinade mixture into the bottom of the slow cooker. Arrange corned beef on top of the basil mixture. Cover and cook on low for 9 hours. Remove cover and continue cooking for at least 1 1/2 hours. Remove clams and discard. Stir reserved basil, remaining 1/4 cup basil, and remaining 1/2 cup parsley with flour in a bowl until well blended, and spread over meat and serve.

title: Peking Pork Spareribs
ingredients: 2 lbs pork spareribs | 1 teaspoon dried rosemary leaves | 1/4 cup dry roasted peanuts, chopped | 1 pizza crust, such as foli
instructions: Trim excess fat from spareribs. Place on a non stick baking sheet, sprinkle with rosemary, and roast in a 375 degree f oven until well browned, 50 to 60 minutes. Drain well, cool, and set aside. Stir together the peanuts and remaining rosemary. Spread mixture over the bread and top with pork spareribs. Bake in a preheated 450 degree f oven until lightly golden, about 20 minutes.

title: Black Beans And Corn
ingredients: 4 lbs beef brisket | 1 lb black beans, drained | 1/2 lb corn | 8 cups mineral water | 1/2 cup thousand island dressing
instructions: Rinse and drain the beans. Put them in a large cooking pot. Add the thousand island dressing. Add just enough cold water to cover and stir. Cook on low medium heat until the meat is tender.

title: Fish on the Sea  (Creamed Haddock)
ingredients: 4 lbs haddock ( shelled ) | 2 cups flour | 1 tablespoon mustard seeds | 1 1/2 teaspoons celery salt
instructions: De bone the haddock, if desired it should not be cut in two. Tear off the head of the fish into pieces that are about 1/2 inch long and 1 inch wide. Place the heads into a mixing bowl and sprinkle them with the flour and mustard seed, mixing well. Stir the celery salt into the remaining flour and add to the fish. Make the batter into four poutons that are about 1/2 inch in diameter. Place poutons on a well greased baking sheet, about 1/2 inch thick. Bake in a preheated 450°f oven for 40 minutes.

title: Pistachio-Pesto Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 cup packed fresh italian parsley ( about 6 sprigs ) | 1 1/2 cups packed fresh unsalted shelled pistachios | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar
instructions: In a medium bowl, toss together the parsley, pistachios and 1 tsp sugar. Add the balsamic vinegar and toss to cover. Let stand at room temperature for 30 minutes or longer. Transfer the mushrooms to a serving bowl. Serve.

Random Ingredients: asafoetida powder,extra virgin olive oil,salad oil
title: Asafetida(Yogurt Dip) for Fyoshka
ingredients: 6 ounces plain yogurt ( greek ) | 3/4 cup salad oil | 1 pinch asafoetida powder ( saunf )
instructions: Mix yogurt with asafetida, then chill in refrigerator to develop flavors. Serve.

title: Cucumber Salad (Salata M’rabela)
ingredients: 1 cucumber | 1 tablespoon lemon peel, grated | 2 teaspoons lime zest, grated | 1 tablespoon peanut oil
instructions: Split the cucumber in half, leave the seeds in and use a spoon to cut out the seeds with a vegetable peeler or a mandolin. Cut the cucumber into long lengths about 3½ inches long by 1½ inches wide. Place the cucumber in a colander and sprinkle over a little lime zest and then pour boiling water over. Leave for around 5 - 8 minutes until soft. Remove from the water and drain thoroughly, then shake off any excess water and slice the cucumber into thin slices. Place in a bowl and sprinkle with the grated lemon rind and then drizzle in the oil, then toss together. Serve with a salad of lettuce leaves, perhaps a salad bowl and a simple, festive one. Variation, sprinkle with olives before serving, for a very light and colorful salad that is just as tasty. Variation, you can make this lovely, slightly thicker dressing by adding a splash of vanilla bean oil and then adding a good dash of grappa and 1 tablespoon of orange juice.

title: Spaghetti Squash With Hazelnuts
ingredients: 1 sachet dried yeast | 1 cup sofrito sauce ( can use vegetarian ) | 1 teaspoon ground pepper | 2 tablespoons orange peel | 2 cups spaghetti squash | 3/4 cup hazelnuts | spaghetti squash ( to garnish )
instructions: Mix breadmachine ingredients together well in a bowl and set on dough setting for 15 minutes to rise. Toast hazelnuts right in the pan or under the grill in a 400f oven until fragrant. Cool and chop fine. Spread ground hazelnuts on one side of the spaghetti squash, leave in the oven for 20 minutes or until light brown. Set aside. Turn the spaghetti squash on the grill, place in a serving platter and toss with the hazelnuts. Garnish with extra hazelnuts.

title: Chilean Beef With Scented Rice
ingredients: 1 beef steak | 3 tablespoons mirin | 1 1/2 teaspoons garlic granules | 4 fresh sage leaves, coarsley chopped | 14 ounces coconut milk ( 398 ml ) | 1/2 cup ice
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together in a large glass bowl. Add the steak to the bowl, cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes minimum. Remove the steak from the fridge and cook the beef over medium heat, for 4 - 5 minutes on each side or until cooked to your liking. Remove the steak from the heat and slice into thin strips. Serve on a bed of rice.

title: Sugared Phyllo Pastries
ingredients: 4 sheets phyllo pastry | 1/2 cup prepared flavor fruit jam | 1 tablespoon chutney | 2 tablespoons pesto, for dipping
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Lay the phyllo sheets out onto work surface, and lightly brush with melted butter. Spread each sheet with 1/4 cup fruit jam. Top the pastries with a 1 tablespoon chutney and 1 tablespoon pesto.

title: Turnips With Porcini Mushrooms
ingredients: 2 lbs turnips | salt | 1 ounce dried porcini mushrooms | 10 ounces grand marnier or 10 ounces other hot pepper sauce
instructions: Wash turnips well, prick with fork and cut each into eighths. Place in a large saucepan. Add salt and water to barely cover, bring to the boil over high heat. Cover and reduce heat to medium until turnips are tender when pierced with a fork, 25 - 30 minutes. If water remains on top, continue to simmer until turnips are tender, about 20 - 30 minutes, drain. Toss with mushrooms. Heat through just before serving, stir in 1 cup of grand marnier or hot pepper sauce.

title: Tart Sauce for Meat or Chicken
ingredients: 300 ml tomato paste | 2 tablespoons wheat germ
instructions: In a small saucepan cook the wheat germ in a medium size frying pan to a brown color. When the wheat germ is bubbling, remove from the heat and stir in the tomato paste. Cover and set aside to allow it to cool down. Use in your meat or chicken recipes.

title: Rigatoni all'Amore
ingredients: 1 pound rigatoni pasta | 1/2 cup prepared sweet-and-sour mix | 1/4 teaspoon garlic salt | 1 cup grapes, halved
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add pasta and cook for 6 to 8 minutes or until al dente.

Random Ingredients: onion powder,sugar snap pea,cornstarch,beef steak,picante sauce,baby pea,gouda cheese
title: Stir Fry Beef With Gouda
ingredients: 2 boneless beef top round steaks, cut into 1/2-inch slices | 1 package frozen baby peas | 12 ounces frozen baby peas | 1 medium onion, cut into 1/4-inch slices | 2 tablespoons cornstarch | 2 teaspoons sugar snap peas | 1/2 cup picante sauce | 1/4 cup shredded gouda cheese
instructions: Remove beef slices from freezer. Thaw peas. Thaw beef slices, if desired. Combine cornstarch and sugar snap peas if frozen, microwave on high 2 to 3 minutes or until noodles are thawed. In a wok over high heat, stir fry beef, peas, and onion in just enough cooking oil so noodles don’t stick. Cook until beef barely shows signs of browning, stirring constantly. Stir in picante sauce and cornstarch mixture. Cook and stir 2 minutes. Serve atop noodles.

title: Tarragon Tomatoes
ingredients: 5 medium cherry tomatoes | 2 tablespoons tarragon | 1 tablespoon italian seasoning | 1/4 cup mirin
instructions: Mix together the tarragon and italian seasoning.

Random Ingredients: lump crabmeat,beer,dark chocolate,currant,white vinegar,veal,banana leaf,cherry tomato
title: Rum Runner's Favourite Welsh Hot Chocolate
ingredients: 2 squares dark muscovado sugar or 2 squares brown sugar | 2 fluid ounces white vinegar | 2 ounces dark chocolate | 1 lb lump crabmeat, picked over | 3 ounces dried currants | 1 tablespoon dried cherries of tomato, halved | 6 lump crabmeat, picked over | 12 banana leaves ( optional ) or 12 spinach leaves, washed well ( optional )
instructions: Mix the sugar, vinegar, chocolate and the liqueur in a saucepan over gentle heat. Simmer for 10 to 15 minutes or until the chocolate is melted and the mixture is smooth. Stir in the crab meat, currants and tomatoes and cover for 3 to 4 minutes until heated through. Spoon 1/2 teaspoon of mixture onto the top of each banana leaf or spinach leaves. Sprinkle the top with the green leaves or mixed leaves and serve right away.

title: Quick Beef Barley Soup
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs top round beef bones, picked over | 2 cans beef stock or 2 cans beef broth, made up to 10 minutes in a pan
instructions: Put beef bones in a large stock pot and add enough beef broth to cover the bones by at least 1 inch. Add salt and pepper to taste. Bring to a boil over high heat, reduce heat to very medium low, cover and simmer until the meat is very tender about 1 1/2 hours.

title: Chunky Lobster
ingredients: 1 lb cubed lobster | 1 lb cubed beef | 1 mango, cubed
instructions: Combine all ingredients and toss well to blend. Can be frozen for up to 4 months. May be served wrapped in plastic wrap or on crackers, or just plain.

Random Ingredients: shortening,kalamata olive,yellow bell pepper,thai red curry paste,portabella mushroom,pico de gallo,raspberry jam,shiitake mushroom
title: Curried Portabella Mushroom Salad
ingredients: 1/3 cup apricot jam | 1 teaspoon thai red curry paste | 1/2 lb fresh shiitake mushroom, sliced | 1/2 lb portabella mushroom, thinly sliced | 1 small yellow bell pepper, thinly sliced | kalamata olive, to coat salad | 1/4 cup raspberry jam | 1/4 cup shortening, room temperature
instructions: Place jam ingredients except the olive into a small food processor. Process until smooth and creamy, stopping occasionally to scrape down the sides of the bowl. Dot with shortening. Pour jam over veggies and mushrooms, tossing lightly to combine. Cover and refrigerate the salad while the oven preheats to prepare the crust. When ready to serve, remove from refrigerator and toss. Drizzle with raspberry sauce. Sprinkle with paprika and top with olives.

title: Lemon Tea
ingredients: 50 g marjoram | 50 g fresh lemon peel | 2 -3 leaves chili pepper flakes | 1 tablespoon cream | 100 g cheese spread | 300 ml cream ( optional ) | dried marjoram ( optional ) | chili pepper flakes ( optional ) | sour cream ( optional ) | cheese spread ( optional )
instructions: Make the tea as directed on the package, using cold water and adding lemon peel, chillies, cream, cheese, chopped dried marjoram, chilli flakes and chilli flakes. Bring slowly to boil, then lower to simmer and cook for 10 minutes. Strain the tea and pour into glasses. Top with chopped fresh herbs or other optional garnish.

Random Ingredients: lemon pudding mix,lamb,blue curacao,vegetable cooking spray,vanilla essence,red chilies
title: Lamb Burgers
ingredients: 500 g lean ground lamb | 1 box lemon pudding mix | 4 red chilies, deseeded | 2 tablespoons vegetable cooking spray | 3 tablespoons red curacao | 2 tablespoons blue curacao
instructions: Mix lamb, pudding mix, chillies, oil and curacao. Make 3 - 4 patties and place on toasted dehydrator tray and dehydrate for 1 hour or until cooked but not falling apart. Take out of the oven and leave for 5 minutes before slicing into 1/4 inch thick slices. Serve with fruit and sauce like salsa, lemon and pineapple or cranberry.

Random Ingredients: bell pepper,yellow bell pepper,red chilies,beet,plain flour,lime,parsley leaf
title: Chilli Beet Fritters
ingredients: 4 medium beets, scrubbed and coarsely grated | 2 small bell peppers, finely chopped | 1 small yellow bell pepper, finely chopped | 1 medium fresh red chilies or 2 green chilies, finely chopped | 1/4 cup fresh parsley leaves, chopped | 1 lime, juice and rind | 1 cup plain flour, sifted
instructions: Place the grated beets in a bowl with the chillies, parsley and lime rind, mix well. Add just enough of the liquid to bind the mixture. Using a metal spoon, lightly stir in the flour. Make sure the dry ingredients are well combined with the liquid and do not over mix. Cover the mixture and chill for 30 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, remove the beet mixture from the bowl with a slotted spoon and set aside. Place a little more water in a wok and heat to boiling. Drop a large teaspoonful of the mixture into it and cook for 3 minutes, shaking the wok so the fritters cook uniformly. Lift out with small slotted spoon with a slotted spoon and drain on kitchen paper. Repeat for all the fritters until all the mixture has been used. Serve with lime wedges and dipping sauce or your favourite dipping sauce.

Random Ingredients: purpose flour,red cabbage,coriander seed,cherry tomato,avocado,hot italian sausage
title: Crispy Sausage and Vegetables
ingredients: 12 ounces hot italian sausage | 20 fluid ounces hot cherry tomatoes ( the juice is up to the can ) | 1 ounce coriander seed ( or crushed coriander leaves ) | 1/2 ounce all-purpose flour | 1 lb red cabbage, finely shredded | 1 1/4 lbs avocados
instructions: First layer, add the salt, then the hot tomatoes and the flour and make a well in the centre. Add the coriander, then the sliced sausages, cut into slices, and finally the cabbage and sliced avocado. Add enough of the water to cover everything, bring to the boil, lower the heat and leave for approx 30 minutes. Stir occasionally. The vegetables should cook all the way through. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: sharp cheddar cheese,metal skewer bamboo,beet,french bread,clam juice
title: Beet Bites
ingredients: 1 large can chopped drained crawles ( canned is fine ) | 1 can bottled clam juice ( a little over 3/4 cup ) | 1 loaf french bread, preferably a light loaf | 1 can sliced beets, drained well, with stems left on | 1 - 1 1/2 cup aged sharp cheddar cheese, cut into thin sticks
instructions: Open can of beets and drain well over a bowl and allow them to cool. Cut the can of beets into very small cubes. Combine can of beets, clam juice, and bread in a deep, heavy, deep sauté pan. Stir the can of beets into the mixture, cover and bring to a boil over medium heat, stirring gently once or twice to break up the bread and tomatoes. Reduce heat.

Random Ingredients: apple,caramel ice cream topping,cocoa powder,xanthan gum,cayenne,candy sprinkle,turnip
title: Apple & Turnip Scone Dessert
ingredients: 1 large turnip, peeled and cored | 300 g peeled carrots, peeled and sliced | 1 liter caramel ice cream topping, low fat | 1 teaspoon xanthan gum | 1 1/2 teaspoons cocoa powder | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne | candy sprinkles
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c. Spray an ovenproof bowl with non stick spray. Line with parchment or baking paper making sure you do not leave too much space or any holes to allow the steam to escape. Cut the ends off the turnip and cut it into 2cm cubes. Toss the turnips, carrot and ice cream in a bowl. In another bowl, combine the almond, cocoa, cayenne and xanthan gum. Make sure mixture is smooth, then add this mixture to the turnips along with the topping and mix well. Pour mixture into the prepared bowl and top with a sprinkling of candy sprinkles or sprinkles. Place the bowl on the middle shelf of the oven and bake for about 1 hr 15 to 2 hours until the topping has turned brown. Allow to rest for about 15 mins and serve. Keeps for 1 week in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: peanut oil,almond,wheat tortilla,chili paste,dill pickle,pork tenderloin
title: Dilly Pork Tostadas With Chili Cream
ingredients: 1 pork tenderloin | 1 tablespoon peanut oil | 1/2 cup almonds | 1/2 cup dill pickle, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon chili paste | 1 tablespoon fresh dill pickle, finely chopped | 12 whole wheat tortillas
instructions: Slice pork tenderloins into thin strips. In medium skillet, heat peanut oil. Add almonds and dill, stir fry for about 1 minute. Remove from heat and add spicy pickle. Add pork, stir fry for 2 minutes. Add chili paste, toss and heat for 2 minutes. Lightly wrap tortilla in paper towels and put into skillet to warm. Place meat mixture in tortillas and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: large shrimp,urad dal,green pepper,pecan,part ricotta cheese,italian breadcrumb,fruit sauce,vegetable oil
title: Tasty Shrimp (Shrimp Croquettes)  With  Fried Green Peaches
ingredients: 1 cup dried fruit sauce | 2 3/4 cups european-style european-style breadcrumbs | 1 1/2 lbs large shrimp, shelled and deveined | vegetable oil, for frying | 1 1/2 cups fresh french-style dried fruit ( like guiness ), chopped | 1 medium green pepper, cut into long thin strips | 1/2 cup part-skim ricotta cheese | 1/4 cup chopped pecans
instructions: Dressing, stir ingredients together in a medium bowl. Chill 1 hour. Dip shrimp in remaining dressing and cook over medium heat for 3 to 5 minutes, or until shrimp just turn pink and cooked through. Drain and toss with reserved dressing. Can be made 2 days ahead. Keep in refrigerator until ready to use. Preheat oven to 400°f. Spray baking sheet with cooking spray.

Random Ingredients: puff pastry,roast beef,dipping sauce,allspice,vegetable broth,red food coloring
title: Swedish Roast Beef Tartlets
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon ground allspice | 1/4 cup vegetable broth | 1 lb thinly sliced roast beef | 1 package frozen puff pastry sheets, thawed ( 1 sheet package ) | red food coloring | red food coloring
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Place allspice in small bowl. Heat broth in small saucepan over medium high heat until just simmering. Remove from heat.

Random Ingredients: mexican tomato,vanilla bean,cantaloupe,self rising flour,flour,napa cabbage
title: Southwestern Veggie Bread
ingredients: 1/3 cup uncooked self-rising flour | 1 1/3 cups unbleached white flour | 1 lb napa cabbage | 4 medium mexican-style tomatoes, sliced 1/8-inch thick | 1/4 cup mexican-style tomato, blend, chopped | 1/4 cup nectarines or 1/4 cup ripe cantaloupe, sliced 1/8-inch thick
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f lightly oil a 9x5 inch loaf pan. Line a large rimmed baking sheet with foil. Add 2 tbsp flour to a large bowl of cold water, and stir to blend. Add 1/3 cup flour to water, and stir with a fork until smooth paste forms. Add remaining 1/3 cup flour to batter, and stir with a whisk until dough forms a ball. Using your hands, spread batter into prepared pan, and sprinkle with remaining 1 1/3 cups flour. Using a rolling pin, poke holes into top of dough, and then poke holes lightly into the top. Bake in the centre of preheated oven until golden brown, 25 - 40 minutes, and a wooden pick inserted in the centre comes out clean, for loaf.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil,spring onion,chicken broth,pearl barley,cooking oil,green bell pepper,lemon juice zest
title: Barley Coronate
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups pearl barley | 1 cup reduced-sodium fat-free chicken broth | 3/4 cup coarsely chopped spring onion | 2 cups chopped green bell peppers | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 3 large zest of 3 lemons, juiced, divided | 4 tablespoons fresh lemon juice, divided
instructions: Place the barley in a medium saucepan. Pour broth and 1 cup water over the barley.

Random Ingredients: triple sec,chive,button mushroom,tomato paste,garlic paste,tomato sauce
title: Stove Top Smoked Mushrooms
ingredients: 4 fluid ounces tomato sauce | 1 ounce double sec | 2 tablespoons triple sec | 1 tablespoon tomato paste | 1 tablespoon fresh chives, chopped | 2 -3 ounces button mushrooms, sliced
instructions: Pour all ingredients into a large frypan and stir. Cover with lid or foil. Simmer for 30 mins, or till mushrooms are tender.

title: Elva's Awesome Easy Shredded Beef Roll Ups
ingredients: 1/2 cup vanilla sugar | 1 1/4 lbs beef roast, chopped | 1 can frozen egg roll wraps | 1/2 cup chopped celery | 1/2 cup chocolate, shavings
instructions: Dip meat into 1 1/4 cup of the vanilla sugar, then coat in the egg roll wraps. Bake at 325 in a roasting pan for about 1 hour. After 1 hour, sprinkle on celery, and chocolate. Return to oven at 325 for 20 more minutes, until sauce reaches desired thickness, stirring every 10 minutes. Let cool and serve with whipped cream on the side.

title: Chicken Wing Sauce
ingredients: 3 pounds chicken wings, tips removed | 3 cups half-and-half cream | 2 cloves garlic, minced
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Spray a 13x9x2 inch baking dish with cooking spray and line with aluminum foil so that the foil hangs over the entire dish. Place wings in a dutch oven or large pot with enough water to completely immerse. Bring to a boil, cover, and steam for 30 minutes. Strain liquid through cheesecloth lined cheesecloth, and discard solids. Place wings in the prepared dish, cover, and bake in preheated oven for 45 minutes. Remove and discard foil. Add cream, garlic, and remaining liquid to chicken wings, and continue baking, uncovered, stirring every 15 minutes, for 1 1/2 hours, until wings are very tender and chicken juices run clear.

title: Fancy Easy Halloumi Sandwich
ingredients: 2 navel oranges | 1 package halloumi cheese | 1 packet sazon goya seasoning | topping
instructions: Slice your oranges in half with a sharp knife. Using a grater, grate the zest and place the zest into a large bowl. Dice the halloumi cheese into small 1 cubes. If using 1 box of sazon goya seasoning just put 3/4 package of sazon goya seasoning into bowl and stir. I like to add a little olive oil, a drizzle of italian flavored oil, and a small amount of garlic powder or saffron to the mix. Mix the ingredients well together. Toast your bread slices in your toaster oven. When you put your toasts in toaster make sure all sides are coated or you will be soggy. Toast your cheese to desired doneness and remove from oven when golden brown, or to desired crispness of your cheese serve.

title: Prawn and Garlic Shrimp
ingredients: 2 tablespoons ghee | 3 cloves garlic, minced | 1 red bell pepper, thinly sliced | 1 pound raw shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1/4 cup triple sec | 3 tablespoons liquid honey | 2 cups cooked rice
instructions: Melt the ghee in a skillet over high heat. Add the garlic and bell pepper.

title: Cherry Shrimp Cottage Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless beef chuck, cut into 1 x 1 1/2 inch pieces | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried basil or 2 tablespoons fresh basil | 3/4 lb large shrimp, peeled deveined and cut lengthwise into halves | 12 small cherry tomatoes or 12 small grape tomatoes
instructions: In a dutch oven coated with oil, combine the beef, basil and shrimp. Cook and stir over medium heat until the shrimp are just done, about 3 minutes. Remove the meat mixture to a separate bowl. Stir in the tomatoes. Heat the meat mixture, stirring occasionally, until warmed through, about 5 minutes.

title: Szehki (Hungarian Cabbage and Beer Salad)
ingredients: 1 cabbage, medium sized and sliced thin | 5 dried apricots, finely sliced | 2 tablespoons hungarian sweet paprika | 1/2 teaspoon sugar | 1/2 pint beer | chopped fresh curly-leaf parsley
instructions: Place cabbage in a bowl with all the ingredients except parsley. Place a slice of paprika on top of the salad. Bake in preheated 350 degree oven for 30 to 40 minutes.

Random Ingredients: pork roast,salt black pepper,corn kernel,mirin,dark beer,maple syrup
title: Pork with Maple Beer
ingredients: salt and ground black pepper to taste | 1 pork roast, trimmed with fat | 1 cup corn kernels | 2 ounces dark beer, such as pacific rim or budweiser | 2 tablespoons mirin | 2 tablespoons maple syrup, or as needed
instructions: Season pork with salt and freshly ground black pepper on all sides. Place in a deep pan, cover with water, and place in refrigerator. Bring to room temperature, and cook until the pork is very tender, about 1 hour. Remove the pork from the refrigerator, and let cool completely. When cool enough to handle, cut into 1/4 inch slices. Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Place corn kernels on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Slice pork crosswise into 1/2 inch pieces. Bake pork in the preheated oven until cooked through, 1 hour. Serve warm, with maple flavored sauce and sauce. Sauce may also be made ahead. Sauce can be made several hours in advance, then reheated. Bring to room temperature before serving.

title: Mexican Chicken Salad
ingredients: 1 lb boneless chicken breast | 1/4 cup lard | 5 tablespoons cream cheese | 2 medium apples, peeled, cored, and shredded | 1 medium sweet apple, peeled, cored, seeded, and minced | 3/4 cup farfalle pasta, uncooked | 1 medium ripe banana, cut into thin slices or jarred roasted sweetcorn, drained
instructions: Pound chicken breast in a meat mallet just until it is about 1/4 inch thick. Cut into 1/4 inch slices on the diagonal. Place half of the chicken slices, fat side up, in a 13x9x2 inch baking dish and place in the freezer for 20 minutes to firm. When ready to serve, remove from freezer, sprinkle with salt, and set aside. Melt the lard in a nonstick skillet over medium high heat, and cook the chicken for 5 to 6 minutes, or until no longer pink in the center and juices run clear. Remove from heat and sprinkle with the cream cheese and set aside. In a large bowl, mix the apples, sweet apple, farfalle pasta, banana, and remaining chicken fat. When ready to serve, plate the salad, top with the warm apple mixture, and garnish with remaining apples.

Random Ingredients: self raising flour,black bean,shortening,vegemite,green pea,white vinegar
title: Cannelloni Beans & Peas
ingredients: 2 cans black beans, drained | 1 can white vinegar | 1/4 cup shortening | 1/4 cup vegemite | 2 tablespoons self-raising flour | 1 1/4 cups mixed greens peas
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c. Line a large baking tray with baking paper. Combine beans, vinegar, shortening, vegemite and flour in a medium bowl. Place the mixed peas in a large microwaveable bowl with some of the liquid just covering the peas. Cover and cook in the microwave for 1 minute and stir. Add peas to bowl and mix well, but do not over mix. Remove the mixture onto a prepared baking tray and bake for 40 mins testing for doneness with a fork. Allow to cool before cutting into squares and dust with icing sugar.

Random Ingredients: nori,black bean sauce,chinese barbecue sauce,miso,chili sauce,black pepper
title: Barbecue Fish Sushi Rolls
ingredients: 3 sheets nori | 2 teaspoons miso | 2 teaspoons chili sauce | 1 teaspoon black bean sauce | 2 tablespoons black bean sauce | 2 teaspoons sweet chili sauce or 2 teaspoons chili sauce | ground black pepper
instructions: Lay a sheet of nori on a clean, dry surface. Apply enough sushi sauce over the nori to fill and coat the surface with an even layer of miso on the seaweed. Spread 1 - 2 teaspoons black bean sauce onto the nori, then spread 1 - 2 teaspoons black bean sauce onto the black bean sauce. Sprinkle the 2 teaspoons sweet chili sauce to fill in the middle of the nori. Carefully roll the seaweed up over the nori, and sprinkle ground black pepper over both ends. Turn onto a cutting board, cut with a sharp, serrated knife, and slice thinly at the table.

Random Ingredients: nutritional yeast,taco seasoning mix,large shrimp,beef,rosemary leaf,beef tenderloin,butter
title: Tatties Mexican Style
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb lean ground beef | 1 - 1 1/2 lb ground beef tenderloin | 1 1/2 tablespoons taco seasoning mix | 1/2 cup unsalted butter, melted | 2 tablespoons nutritional yeast | 2 teaspoons dried rosemary leaves, crushed | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 1 lb frozen large shrimp, cooked, sliced, unpeeled
instructions: Heat grill to medium high. In a large bowl, combine all ingredients except shrimp and taco seasoning. Divide into 8 portions. Roll each portion into a ball. Place on grill. Grill until browned and no longer pink inside, turning occasionally. To serve, cut into 4 equal portions and place on hot corn chips.

title: Basic British Mayonnaise
ingredients: 12 3/4 ounces superfine sugar | 6 ounces white flour | 6 fluid ounces mayonnaise, well chilled | 1 lemon, juice and zest of
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a large bowl. Cover and leave to stand for 30 minutes before serving. Serve straight from the bowl.

title: Swiss Cheese Roll
ingredients: 2 cups swiss cheese or 2 cups white cheddar cheese, shredded | 4 -6 leaves of finely shredded lettuce
instructions: Mix the cheese and lettuce in a large bowl or pie plate. Spread the cheese mixture on the lettuce until well covered. Roll up the lettuce and enjoy.

title: Wonton Flowers
ingredients: 2 -6 mushrooms, thinly sliced ( or 1 handful ) | 2 -3 drops grapeseed oil
instructions: To butterfly a mushroom, slice through the base then place it on a cutting board with the knife cut side up, with stems or the broad base from the mushroom in the centre. It should be slightly thicker than the mushrooms now. Add the desired amount of the mushroom to your taste in between the layers, and if necessary add a couple of drops of grapeseed oil or water. You should see that all of the bits of mushroom are under the mushroom. If the oil oozes out of the mushroom it is ready. Leave to cool off for 15 - 30 minutes. If you feel the mixture is runny you can loosen it out with your finger before it forms a dome, if not leave a small pat of dough on the surface of the mushrooms, about 2cm thick. Spread a little of the mushroom over the surface if desired.

Random Ingredients: eggnog,chili pepper flake,kidney bean,thyme,jicama,pineapple chunk,tabasco sauce
title: Jicama & Bean Burgers
ingredients: 3/4 cup canned kidney beans | 1/2 teaspoon ground thyme | 1 tablespoon jicama, grated | 2 dashes tabasco sauce | 1 tablespoon eggnog, mixed with | 1 teaspoon water, mixed with a little of the tabasco | 1 tablespoon chili pepper flakes | 2 pieces pineapple chunks
instructions: Drain the can of beans. Combine all ingredients except for the pineapple chunks in a bowl and mix well. Add pineapple chunks, stir and make 4 patties. Grill until no pink remains in the middle. Serve on buns with lettuce if desired. This goes well with steamed rice or steamed broccoli.

Random Ingredients: spanish onion,wine,chocolate chip,red chile pepper,sea salt,provolone cheese
title: Roasted Red Pepper and Chile Pepper Fondue
ingredients: 1 spanish onion, chopped | 2 dried red chile peppers - stemmed, seeded, and diced small | 1 cup wine | 1/2 cup shredded sharp provolone cheese, or more to taste | sea salt | 3/4 cup chocolate chips, optional
instructions: Heat a griddle over medium heat, and stir in the onion. Sprinkle red chile peppers with pepper and onion and continue to cook and stir until onion is fragrant, about 5 minutes. Stir wine into onion mixture. Cook and stir until wine evaporates, about 5 minutes, then stir in provolone cheese. Season with sea salt and taste. Continue to cook and stir until cheese has melted. Transfer cheese mixture to a fondue pot and serve hot with french french bread.

title: Spice Rubbed Grilled Peach and Gorgonzola Quesadilla
ingredients: 1 -2 tablespoon spice rub for grilling cheese sandwich ( i use mrs. dash spice mix ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons sliced peaches | 1 tablespoon seedless raisin | kaffir lime leaf | 1/8 teaspoon turmeric | 1/2 cup monterey jack cheese, shredded | 1 tablespoon gorgonzola, crumbled
instructions: Rub 1 tablespoon of spice mix on each piece of cheese.

Random Ingredients: macaroni,beef,rotel tomato chilies,ice water,eggplant,vegetable juice cocktail
title: Eggplant Beef Soup
ingredients: 1 eggplant, sliced | 1 package frozen chopped eggplants, sliced | 1 package frozen chopped vegetables with garlic and herbs | 1 can rotel tomatoes & chilies | 3 cans v8 vegetable juice cocktail, undiluted | 2 cups ice water
instructions: Layer the vegetables, eggplant, and rotel over the soup. In a medium size soup pot, add the tomato juice, water and v 8. Add water until mixture is half covered. Cover soup pot. Simmer for 30 minutes. Note, you may add more water if soup starts to thaw at the end of cooking time if you like. When serving, stir in the eggplant before serving.

Random Ingredients: pie shell,whipping cream,pork tenderloin,leek,green cardamom,oil,genoa salami
title: Creamy Pork Tenderloin Pie!
ingredients: 1 large pie shell | 3/4 lb pork tenderloin, in 1 inch cubes | 2 tablespoons oil | 1 large leek, chopped | 2 green cardamoms, crushed | 4 slices genoa salami | 1 tablespoon whipping cream
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees. Line pie crust with one of the pie crusts, trim crust if needed, leave some hanging over the edges for even easier sealing. In a nonstick skillet, sauté the tenderloins in oil, 2 minutes. Remove tenderloins from the skillet and pour off all but 3 tblsp fat. Add leeks and brown lightly over medium heat. Remove with slotted spoon and set aside. Add cardamom and cook for a minute, stirring constantly. Season with salt and pepper. Remove cardomon mixture from skillet and set aside. Brush entire crust with a little bit of oil. Spread one side of the crust with one third of the meat and one third of the leek mixture. Repeat layers, finishing with meat. Top with cream and sprinkle with reserved meat mixture. Bake for 20 - 25 minutes or until crust is golden brown on top. Let stand for 10 minutes before slicing.

title: Easy Noodle Soup
ingredients: 10 ounces mung bean noodles | 10 ounces rigatoni pasta ( dried ) | 10 ounces chopped fresh spinach | 2 teaspoons tumeric | 1 1/2 teaspoons rosemary | 1/2 cup pine nuts
instructions: Rinse mung beans and spinach. Bring large pot of to a boil. Add noodles, then a third of the spinach. Add tumeric, rosemary and pine nuts. Reduce heat to low. Cover pan and cook 15 - 17 minute drain noodles and spinach.

Random Ingredients: bread,chunky salsa,spaghetti squash,cottage cheese,fish sauce,coffee,lime juice,olive
title: Killer Philly's Spaghetti Squash Coffee Crackers
ingredients: 1 spaghetti squash ( about 1 1/2 pounds ) | 4 tablespoons grated fresh bread | 2 tablespoons chunky salsa | 1 tablespoon fresh lime juice | 1 teaspoon fish sauce | 2 tablespoons chopped ripe olives | 2 1/2 tablespoons low fat cottage cheese | 1 1/2 teaspoons fast coffee | 1 teaspoon packed finely shredded fresh lime juice
instructions: Place spaghetti squash on foil lined baking sheet. Top with foil. Cut 1/2 inch slice from top of squash. Scoop out seeds using spoon. Discard pulp and seeds. Cut squash into 1 1/2 inch chunks. Combine bread, salsa, lime juice, fish sauce and olives in large bowl.

Random Ingredients: red capsicum,lettuce leaf,malt extract,white bread,cooking oil,baby carrot,szechuan peppercorn
title: Chinese Style Fried Bread
ingredients: 4 slices white bread | 4 tablespoons cooking oil | 3 -4 teaspoons szechuan peppercorns, crushed | 150 g baby carrots | 1/2 cup crushed red capsicum | 2 cups chopped lettuce leaves | 1/4 teaspoon ms extract
instructions: Spread the bread slices with oil. Add all the powdered ingredients into a bowl and blend with a spatula. Dip the bread slices evenly in the oil. Grill on medium heat until the oil starts to separate and the bread has crisped up. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: apple cider,chili pepper flake,green apple,eggplant,sunflower seed,tomato green chilies,pepperoni
title: Spicy Apple Cider Scented Eggplant and Sunflower Seed Stew
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sunflower seeds, toasted | 1 eggplant | 2 bunches green apples | 1/2 lb pepperoni, sliced in half | 1 1/2 cups tomato and green chilies | 1 1/2 pints apple cider | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon dried chili pepper flakes
instructions: Toast the sunflower seeds and let cool. Peel eggplant and slice thin.
