Place eggplant, apples, pepperoni slices, chopped green onion in a deep, heavy frying pan and stir to coat with oil. Cook over moderate heat until eggplant is golden and the apples are just tender, about 10 minutes. Stir in tomato and green chilies. Pour in apple cider and chile flakes. Bring to a boil, cover and simmer for 15 minutes.

title: Homemade Italian Breadcrumbs
ingredients: 2 cups italian seasoned bread crumbs | 4 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder | 1 medium onion
instructions: Place bread crumbs into a large bowl and mash with hands to a coarse mixture. Add cocoa powder and minced onion stir until coated. Form the mixture into a 6 inch long loaf. Place loaf on a waxed paper lined or cookie sheet. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Bake for 70 minutes or until lightly golden brown, turning once.

Random Ingredients: beef chuck,lime zest,chili oil,pistachio,beef,dill pickle,creme de cacao,wheat germ
title: Beef With Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef top round beef, trimmed, cut into 1-inch cubes | 2 tablespoons unflavored wheat germ | 1 tablespoon unflavored creme de cacao | 1/2 teaspoon finely minced lime zest | 2 teaspoons chili oil | 1/2 cup finely minced mint | 2 ounces crushed salted pistachios | 4 tablespoons coarsely chopped dill pickles
instructions: In a medium bowl, stir together the beef chuck and 2 tablespoons of the wheat germ. In a small bowl, stir together the creme de cacao, lime zest, and chili oil. In a large skillet, heat the remaining 2 tablespoons of water to boiling. Pour into the beef along with the mint, pistachios and 3 tablespoons of the pickling juices. Cover and cook over low heat for 2 minutes. Dip the beef and pickle pieces into the creme de cacao mixture, shaking off any excess. Serve right away.

title: Spaghetti and Cheese
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger | 1/2 cup smooth peanut butter or 1/2 cup crunchy peanut butter | 1 teaspoon ground allspice | 1 lb spaghetti | 1 cup mexican cheese
instructions: Brown hamburger. Drain. Melt peanut butter in a saucepan. Add hamburger & allspice to pot. Bring to a boil. Drain spaghetti. Add to saucepan. Mix well. Heat through. Sprinkle cheese all over before serving.

title: Blueberry-Mushroom Mustard
ingredients: 1/2 cup dry mustard | 3/4 lb white mushroom, coarsely chopped | 2 lbs fresh blueberries or 2 lbs frozen blueberries | 1 teaspoon sesame oil
instructions: In a dry skillet, toast mustard over medium heat until dark brown and almost burnt, about 5 minutes. Stir in mushrooms, scraping up browned bits, toasted sesame oil and a sprinkling of sugar. Cook until mushrooms are tender. Just before serving, stir in 1 lb. Blueberries.

Random Ingredients: fruit chutney,bread flour,green pea,beef stock,sea bass fillet,maple syrup,habanero pepper,german chocolate cake mix
title: Hot and Spicy Chilean Sea Bass
ingredients: 1 tablespoon sea bass fillet | 1 tablespoon fresh green pea | 1/3 cup dried bread flour | 2 tablespoons german chocolate cake mix | 1 tablespoon maple syrup | 1/2 cup beef stock | 1 dried habanero pepper | 1 cup seedless dried sweetened fruit chutney ( jamee brand suggested )
instructions: Place fish on broiler pan, skin side down and brush with melted butter. Broil 4 in from heat, 3 to 5 minutes or until fish is opaque and flakes easily with a fork. While fish is broiling, combine flour and german cake mix in bowl. Press together with fingers to shape into a ball and knead lightly about 10 times. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate 30 minutes. Meanwhile, bring beef stock just to boiling in small saucepan. Remove from heat. Slice habanero pepper in half lengthwise and discard seeds. Slice flesh into 1/4 inch slices. Place chile slices in a small bowl and pour hot beef stock over it to cover. Soak chile in boiling beef stock and let stand 5 minutes. Drain water and reserve. Cut fish into chunks. To serve, arrange fish on serving platter. Drizzle with chile and maple syrup. Serve chopped chutney on side.

title: Sweet Chili Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sweet chili sauce | 1 tablespoon thai fish sauce | 1 teaspoon allspice
instructions: In mixing glass bowl, add thai chile sauce. Add allspice. Mix. Serve with chicken or lamb.

Random Ingredients: coffee,iceberg lettuce,rice,lime juice,parmigiano reggiano cheese,red wine,dark chocolate
title: Mexican Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 6 ounces dark chocolate, chopped ( about 2 1/2 ounces ) | 3 tablespoons freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1 teaspoon fresh lime juice | 1/4 cup brewed coffee, divided | 6 cups shredded iceberg lettuce ( see notes ) | 2 tablespoons freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 3 teaspoons fresh lime juice | crushed iceberg lettuce
instructions: Position rack in middle of the oven and preheat broiler. To make the filling, melt the chocolate and 1 tablespoon of the parmigiano over low heat. Beat in the lime juice, 3 tablespoons of the coffee and the remaining 1/2 tablespoon of parmigiano. Add 2 cups of the lettuce, toss to coat evenly. Spread 1 to 1 1/2 cups of the filling on one side of each lettuce leaf and roll up, jellyroll style in plastic wrap, about 24 or 25 lettuce leaves. Place rolls, seam side down, on an oiled baking sheet. Brush rolls with remaining 1/4 cup of the coffee. Bake, switching the positions of the baking sheets halfway through, until the filling is hot and cheese is melted, about 20 minutes. Serve sandwiches, warm or at room temperature.

title: Pasta W- Chestnuts (Gluten Free)
ingredients: 1 bag pasta ( gluten free spaghetti ) | 1/3 cup raisins | 1/3 cup mixed chestnuts, drained and finely diced | 1/2 cup brown sugar | 2 tablespoons confectioners'sugar
instructions: Boil water and add pasta. Leave to cook until al dente. Meanwhile combine raisins, chestnuts, sugar and confectioner's sugar in a bowl and mix well. Drain pasta and add to the bowl mix well and serve.

title: Vegan Panini Rollers
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups lukewarm plain wheat flour | 2 tablespoons maple syrup | 1 1/2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 1 1/2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 12 ounces cheese, softened ( low-fat provolone cheese ) | 1/4 cup chopped fresh fruit ( such as blueberries, apricots, etc. ) | 1 tablespoon chopped pecans or 1 tablespoon walnuts | 12 flour tortillas
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together flour, maple syrup and yeast. Add cheese and fruit.

title: Chinese Potatoes and Artichoke
ingredients: 3 1/2 lbs baking potatoes | 2 teaspoons baking soda | 2 teaspoons black peppercorns | 4 ounces pea pieces ( frozen, in bags and cooked ) | 2 ounces cabbage, cut into thin shreds | 2 teaspoons sesame oil ( or more ) | 1 can artichoke hearts ( i used frozen ones, frozen, uncooked, drained )
instructions: Scrub potato well. Place potatoes in 9 x 13 inch, greased pan. Cut out and discard peel. In medium bowl, add 1 teaspoon baking soda, 1 teaspoon black pepper and 1 teaspoon black peppercorns. Mix well. Sprinkle over the potatoes and top with cabbage and 1 teaspoon sesame oil. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Remove from refrigerator 30 minutes before baking. Remove toothpicks. Preheat oven to 350°f. Remove potatoes from marinade, arrange them on top of cabbage mixture and bake uncovered 40 minutes. Remove from oven, cover tightly, and let stand 15 minutes. Meanwhile, in medium skillet, sauté artichoke hearts in 1/2 teaspoon sesame oil until tender, about 5 minutes. Using slotted spoon, transfer artichoke hearts to bowl with remaining sesame oil, then set aside. Serve with steamed vegetables.

Random Ingredients: vanilla ice cream,maraschino cherry,brown sugar,green olive,avocado,wooden skewer,kidney bean,sun tomato oil
title: California Sundae Salad
ingredients: 8 bamboo skewers | 2 avocados, peeled and chopped | 1/2 cup green olives, sliced | 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained and sliced | 1/2 cup baby spinach leaves | 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained | 2 tablespoons brown sugar | 1/4 cup dry kidney bean, rinsed and drained | vanilla ice cream, for serving
instructions: Cut the bamboo skewers in half. Arrange skewers on a wire rack directly over a medium barbecue. Place the rack about 6 inches from the heat.

Random Ingredients: fig,strawberry,bow tie pasta,beef chuck roast,vegetable bouillon cube,limeade concentrate
title: Fast Easy Spicy Beef Soup
ingredients: 1 can frozen limeade concentrate | 2 1/2 lbs beef chuck roast | 5 -6 cups vegetable bouillon cubes | 2 cans sliced ripe figs, drained | 1 package bow tie pasta ( i only use 1 package ) | 1 box bow tie frozen desserts decorate
instructions: Place limeade concentrate into crockpot, on high until it starts to pop on the meat. Then stir in beef. Add 1 quart of vegetable bouillon cubes to the pot, stirring to dissolve any brown solids. Turn to low, cover and cook for 8 hours. Add figs and remaining vegetable bouillon cubes. Continue cooking for 30 minutes. Break the bowtie cookies and mix with the soup. Cook for 10 more minutes.

title: Spicy Chili Con Queso Fresca
ingredients: 3 -4 chilies, minced | 1 1/2 tablespoons flat leaf parsley, minced | 1 serrano chilies or 1 red chili pepper, minced | 3 bay seasoning | 1 lb squash, sliced thin
instructions: Soak chilies in cold water for 10 - 15 minutes, then rinse, devein and chop chilies into quarters. Combine chile, parsley, serrano or red pepper, chili pepper and bay seasoning in a skillet in a single layer and place over a medium low heat. Steam for 5 minutes or until the sauce is very thick. Add squash to sauce. Cook until the squash is tender about 3 - 5 minutes on each side, or until slightly browned and heated through.

title: Orange and Whisky Ice Cream - Pressure Cooker
ingredients: 3 oranges, juice of | 1 cup whipping cream
instructions: Juice the 3 oranges, and reserve the juice. Place the orange juice in a 4 quart saucepan, and bring to boil over medium heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to low and pour the juice into the pressure cooker, discarding the orange skin. Heat the juice at medium heat until it begins to boil and stir occasionally. Do not let the juice boil. Once it does, remove from heat, and let cool. Whip the cream just until soft peaks form, about 5 minutes, then fold in the orange juice. Place the lid on the pressure cooker, and set on high for 5 minutes. Remove the lid, and turn up the heat to high. When the pressure starts to come up, quickly turn the heat low again.

title: Cajun Zucchini Chips
ingredients: 2 zucchini, sliced into 1/2 inch thin rounds | 1/2 cup dry shredded mexican-style corn | 1/2 cup maraschino cherries, drained | 2 tablespoons dry cider | 1 teaspoon baking powder
instructions: Preheat the oven's broiler and set the oven rack at about 6 inches from the heat source. Line 2 baking sheets with aluminum foil, and spray with cooking spray. Brush the zucchini slices with cooking spray, and place in the oven. Watch carefully so they don't burn. Place the zucchini in the preheated oven. Cook, turning once, until zucchini is golden brown and tender, 5 to 10 minutes. Drain on paper towels. Combine the mexican style corn, cherries, cider, and baking powder in a bowl. Toss with the zucchini chips. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: beef steak,grain white rice,tequila,currant,marjoram,beef roast,rom tomato
title: Beef and Rice With Tomato and Burrros Salsa
ingredients: 1 lb beef top round steak | 1/2 lb beef roast | 1/2 teaspoon dried marjoram | 1 1/4 cups uncooked long-grain white rice | 3 tablespoons currants | 2 roma tomatoes, seeded and chopped | 1/2 cup tequila
instructions: Cut steak into 10 slices. Sprinkle with marjoram. Place each steak between two pieces of plastic wrap and pound with a meat mallet until 1/8 1/4 thick. Arrange steak and rice on a platter. Spread currants on platter. Make salsa by blending tomatoes, tequila and salt and pepper to taste. Pour over steaks.

Random Ingredients: golden raisin,fuji apple,green chili pepper,non dairy topping,red chili pepper flake,sage
title: Vegan Tofu Appetizers.
ingredients: 16 ounces vegan sour cream non-dairy topping or 8 ounces lite sour cream or 16 ounces fat free sour cream | 1/4 cup golden raisin | 2 small fresh hot green chili peppers, seeded and snipped | 1 medium fuji apple, cut into 1/2-inch dice | 1 dried red chili pepper, chopped finely | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh sage ( optional )
instructions: In a tall clear glass bowl, spread the non-dairy topping or whipped topping with one tablespoon of sour cream. Cover with the golden raisins then top with the hot chilies. Top with the apple and dried red chilies. Using the back of a spoon, gently mix together. Serve the tofu slices in small, shallow dishes or small rimmed martini glasses. Makes about two cups per serving.

title: Deer Crunch
ingredients: 1 kg whole duck ( or 3lb if using 2lb, 3lb if using 3lb ) | 1 tablespoon mixed spice | 1 tablespoon dried thyme | 150 g basmati rice ( or another long grain rice ) | 4 tablespoons cocoa | 1 liter mussels, scrubbed
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c. Heat the spice packet and add the thyme. Wash and chop the fish into pieces of equal size pieces. Place in a bowl, add the rice and cocoa, and mix to coat. Place the mussels in a steamer over lots of boiling water, cover with cling film and steam for 2 - 3 hours. The rice is cooked if it is still firm, but with a little crunch left. Add the mussel meat back into the pot, warm through. Serve in hearty bowls and drizzle with a little melted chocolate and cream.

title: Star Anise Bread Crumb and Star Anise
ingredients: 1 cup graham cracker crumbs | 3 star anise | 3 1/2 cups rye bread, cut into cubes
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Crush star anise in a mortar and pestle. Add graham cracker crumbs, star anise, and the rye bread cubes. Stir well until the mixture becomes moistened. Line a muffin tin with pam.. Pour the crumb mixture evenly into the muffin tin, spreading evenly. Bake in the preheated oven until crust is browned and crumbs have turned to a golden brown color.

title: Spaghetti Squash Noodle Salad
ingredients: 16 ounces spaghetti squash, halved and uncooked | 2 teaspoons fennel seeds | 1 teaspoon dried minced prosciutto | 1 can kidney beans, rinsed and drained | 2 tablespoons tahini | 1 tablespoon fish sauce | 3 tablespoons fresh minced fennel seeds
instructions: Cut the spaghetti squash in half lengthwise. Slice the squash into 1/8 inch thick slices. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add squash, salt, and cook, stirring occasionally, until tender, about 15 minutes. Drain. Place the cooked spaghetti squash in a large bowl. Add 2 teaspoons fennel seeds, prosciutto, and kidney beans. Blend the tahini with the fish sauce. With a wooden spoon, mix in the fennel seeds. Stir in the drained spaghetti squash into the bowl with the vegetables. Refrigerate overnight to develop the flavors. Serve chilled.

title: Peach-Pear Tampala
ingredients: 3/4 cup dry sherry | 3 cups thinly sliced peeled peaches
instructions: Spoon sherry into mugs. Place peaches on top of sherry. Serve.

title: Pommes Chef Anne
ingredients: 3 plum tomatoes | 2 teaspoons marsala wine or 2 teaspoons dry sherry
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f lightly oil rimmed baking sheet. Core tomatoes and cut in half and remove cores and seeds. Drizzle with olive oil and bake about 10 - 12 minutes or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: italian sausage,sun tomato,duck,bicarbonate soda,red wine vinegar,fish sauce
title: Duck, Dung and Italian Sausage Salad
ingredients: 100 g italian sausage | 1 kg duck | 50 g sun-dried tomatoes | 50 g duck fat | 1 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 1 tablespoon fish sauce
instructions: Cut the duck fat into 2 inch cubes and put it together with the rest of the ingredients in a large bowl, except the duck fat. Put the duck and the mixture in a sauce pan with a light touch of water and bring to a boil over a medium heat. Mix the duck fat and the mixture with the other ingredients, until the duck fat has desolved. Put the mixture on a board with a wide mouth or a plate that fits down over the duck fat to catch the liquid.

Random Ingredients: heavy cream,green curry paste,liquid smoke,lemon peel
title: Easy Thai Blush
ingredients: 3/4 cup heavy cream | 1 teaspoon green curry paste | 1/2 teaspoon lemon peel, grated | 1/4 teaspoon liquid smoke
instructions: Blend all ingredients together in a blender on high speed. Pour into hot glass.

title: Island Fried Rice
ingredients: 2 cups uncooked long grain rice, washed | 8 fluid ounces thousand island dressing | 1/2 cup cider vinegar
instructions: Combine rice and thousand island dressing in a microwave safe bowl and heat 30 seconds or just until hot. Stir rice gently to prevent it from sticking together. Cover and refrigerate for up to 3 hours. After steaming for 10 to 20 minutes, fluff rice with a fork, and serve.

title: Mushrooms in Spice
ingredients: 10 large fresh mushrooms stems ( about 3-4 pounds, or 10 -12 cups frozen fresh mushrooms, defrosted ) | 1 can pineapple chunks in juice, drained | 2 cups sugar, divided | 1 1/2 cups white peppercorns ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon cinnamon
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place the reserved capsicums, juice, sugar, 2 cups water & peppercorns in a 2 quart casserole dish. Sprinkle with cinnamon. Cover with additional 3/4 cup water if the dish is not tightly sealed. Bake, covered, for 45 minutes or until capsicums are tender.

title: Chow Fun Chicken
ingredients: 800 g japanese eggplants, halved lengthways | 1 red onion, halved and thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons mixed herbs | 2 tablespoons rice noodles | 1 cup of thicken stock or 1 cup of broth | 2 whole star anise
instructions: Arrange half the eggplant and half the onion on a tray. Using a pestle and mortar, crush the anise seeds and then combine them with the remainder of the onion mixture. Sprinkle over the garlic chive and then mould the mixture into a small ball. Repeat with the remaining eggplant, onion, onion, spice, and stock. Heat a wok over the highest heat, then add 2 tbsp vegetable oil. When the oil is hot, add the chicken in batches, cook over high for 2 mins each side then transfer the chicken to a piece of foil. Add 2 tbsp vegetable oil to the wok. Add the star anise and stir fry for 1 minute then put the chicken on top of the onion in the wok. Stir fry over medium heat for 5 mins each side making sure the browning is not too strong and just turning soft and fragrant. Add the broth and a little more oil and bring to the boil. Scatter over the remaining veggies, cover and cook for 3 mins until the eggplants are tender. Use a slotted spoon to serve the chow fun, garnish with the remaining star anise.

title: White Bean Bread Bake
ingredients: 2 slices whole wheat bread | 1 cup great northern beans or 1 cup navy beans, prepared | 2 tablespoons green snipped fresh cilantro leaves | 1 tablespoon fresh rosemary, snipped
instructions: Place bread, beans, and cilantro in baking dish. Sprinkle with rosemary. Cut a cross in the top and bake at 350 degrees for 20 - 25 minutes or until edges are golden brown and beans are heated through. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: cilantro leaf,italian breadcrumb,cremini mushroom,tabasco sauce,chicken bouillon cube
title: Hot Mexican Mushrooms
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh cremini mushrooms, sliced | 2 tablespoons minced fresh cilantro leaves | 1/2 cup italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 1 lb chicken bouillon cube | 2 dashes tabasco sauce
instructions: In medium bowl combine mushrooms, cilantro, bread crumbs, bouillon and tabasco and mix well with hands. Spread mixture into ungreased 12x8x2 inch baking pan. Cover pan and bake at 350° for 20 minutes. Remove from oven and sprinkle with black pepper.

Random Ingredients: basil,cream cheese,chive onion cream cheese,eggplant,self raising flour,gruyere cheese,soba noodle
title: Stuffed Eggplant
ingredients: 3 eggplants, peeled but sliced thinly | 1 cup self-raising flour | 1 1/2 cups cream cheese, softened | 1/4 cup chives and onion cream cheese | 1 cup swiss gruyere cheese, grated | 2 cups cooked soba noodles | 2 tablespoons fresh basil, chopped
instructions: Cut a slit in the eggplant with a knife and slice thin. Beat the cream cheese, soba noodles and basil together. Take the eggplant out and add a tablespoon of the sour cream mixture into a small bowl. Take the flour and cream cheese mixture and add to this. Stir the cheese mixture around until evenly mixed. Fill the slices of eggplant with this mixture. Place in a baking tray and bake at 220°c until lightly browned on both sides.

title: Chile Con Carne
ingredients: 2 cans red enchilada sauce | 1 pint cherry tomatoes, halved | 1/4 fluid ounce grand marnier
instructions: Place the cherry tomatoes into a roasting pan, pour enchilada sauce over and scatter over the 1/4 oz grand marnier. Roast in a 400°f oven for 20 minutes.

title: Candied Ginger
ingredients: 1 cup finely chopped ginger powder | 1 -2 tablespoon sugar syrup, your favorite kind | 1 bottle ginger ale
instructions: In a bowl or bottle with a lid add ginger powder sugar syrup and ginger ale stir. Cover and chill. Keeps in the refrigerator.

title: Ginger Mushroom Stroganoff
ingredients: 1 cup vegetable broth | 1/3 cup red wine | 1/4 cup chopped gingerroot | 3 cups sliced mushrooms | 1 package philadelphia sour cream and cream cheese, softened
instructions: Combine all ingredients and let chill for a few hours. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: rose petal,sea salt black pepper,cilantro,green chile pepper,romano cheese,boston lettuce
title: Hot Green Chile Wedges
ingredients: 5 leaves boston lettuce | 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro | 1 green chile pepper | 3/4 cup grated romano cheese | 1 teaspoon coarse sea salt and black pepper, or to taste | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh cilantro, or to taste | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh cilantro, or to taste
instructions: Preheat an outdoor grill for medium high heat. Arrange the boston lettuce leaves on a foil lined baking sheet. Roast the lettuce leaves in their husks until softened, about 7 minutes. Chiffonade each piece of boston lettuce into 3 squares, cut into 4 wedges. Sprinkle 1/4 cup of fresh cilantro and 1/4 teaspoon of salt and pepper over the lettuce wedges. Top with 1/4 cup romano cheese.

title: Baby Spinach With Ponzu Sauce
ingredients: 8 ounces baby spinach | 2 tablespoons ponzu sauce | 1 tablespoon fresh oregano leaves | 1/8 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: In a microwaveable bowl, sprinkle 2 tbs of the ponzu sauce over the spinach to coat, stirring occasionally. Microwave for 10 minutes or until the spinach and ponzu are hot remove and set aside. In a small bowl, stir together the ponzu, oregano and remaining 1 tbs. Ponzu. Stir in the spinach and toss to wilt. Spoon onto a serving platter and serve.

title: Cottage Cheese Soup (Sopa de Queso)
ingredients: 4 cups vegetable stock | 1 cup cottage cheese | 2 teaspoons adobo seasoning, < a href= '' https : //www.geniuskitchen.com/recipe/adobo-seasoning-mix-479122 '' > adobo seasoning mix < /a >
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine the vegetable stock, cottage cheese, and adobo seasoning mix and heat until warm and bubbly, about 2 to 4 minutes. Using a skimmer or long fork, remove the soup pan from heat and let stand 5 minutes. Serve and enjoy immediately.

Random Ingredients: apricot preserve,rye bread,salt pepper,pork roast,marinara sauce,duck,cherry,malt vinegar
title: Duck 'n' Sauvignon Stuffed Rye Bread Wedges
ingredients: 1/2 cup apricot preserves | 2 tablespoons malt vinegar | 3 tablespoons dauphino duck gravy sauce | salt and pepper to taste | 24 ounces prepared marinated boneless pork roast, chilled | 1 cup chilled sliced cherries | 4 slices rye bread | 1 pinch salt and pepper to taste
instructions: In a small bowl, mix apricot preserves, malt vinegar and duck gravy sauce. Spoon 1 tablespoon filling into each bread wedge, and top with a piece of marinated pork, and cherries.

title: Baked Pork Burgers
ingredients: 1 lb ground lean pork | 2/3 cup crumbled feta | 2 teaspoons dried thyme sprigs, plus extra | fresh thyme sprigs ( to garnish ) | 1/2 teaspoon black peppercorns, plus extra | feta ( to garnish ), for garnish
instructions: Mix ground pork with feta, thyme, and pepper until combined. Wet hands and shape mixture into patties about 3 - 4 inches in diameter. Heat the grill until it is just smoking. Place burgers on the grill, close the cover, and cook until the internal temperature reaches 165 f. Slash the top of the burgers halfway through to allow burgers to absorb some of the pan juices, if necessary. Transfer burgers to a large shallow baking dish. Preheat oven to 350 f, and place a baking sheet on the rack. Place burgers on a rack to catch drippings.

title: Mixed Beef and Orzo
ingredients: 2 lbs flank steaks | 6 ounces dry orzo pasta | 2 medium leeks, washed washed
instructions: Cut flank steak lengthwise in half and across grain. Slice leeks in half and discard tough ends. Cook orzo as directed on package. When or orzo is half way done, place the orzo, beef and leek in a bowl or pan. Cover and heat. Note, if you like, you can mix the vegetables with the orzo just before serving.

Random Ingredients: feta,egg white,bell pepper,pepper sauce,white wine vinegar,purpose flour,orange marmalade
title: Bell Pepper and Feta Crusted Fritters
ingredients: 1 bell pepper | 1/2 cup all-purpose flour, plus more as needed | 2 tablespoons minced orange marmalade | 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar | 2 teaspoons hot pepper sauce | 1 egg white | 1 tablespoon crumbled feta
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Roast bell pepper directly over the flame of a gas burner until skin blackens and blisters, about 30 minutes. Remove pepper from heat and transfer to a plate and cover with foil to steam for 20 minutes. Remove pepper from steaming water and transfer to a medium bowl, cover with plastic wrap and let stand until cool enough to handle. Peel and seeds pepper, then coarsely chop. In a small bowl, combine all remaining ingredients. Stir in flour until smooth. Drain pepper and add to egg white, stirring until just combined. With lightly floured hands, roll teaspoonfuls of mixture into thin, 1/2 inch wide strips and arrange on a parchment lined baking sheet. Sprinkle strips with additional flour if needed. If desired, bake in preheated oven for 5 to 7 minutes. They will puff up and thicken as they cool. Serve warm or room temperature. Variation, to make a more rustic colored fritter, add 1 to 2 tablespoons of prepared dijon mustard to 1/2 cup of prepared dijon mustard and mix well. Add 1 tablespoon dried red onion flakes and/or a teaspoon of dried hot mustard to pepper strips and mix well.

Random Ingredients: cooking spray,orange juice,parsley,arborio rice,beef brisket,ice cube,sunflower seed,lemon
title: Frozen Corned Beef and Rice With Citrus
ingredients: 2 teaspoons sunflower seeds, toasted | 2 teaspoons fresh parsley, chopped | 1/2 lb corned beef brisket, trimmed and cut in 2- 3 inch cubes | cooking spray | 1 cup arborio rice | 2 cups orange juice, chilled from the freezer and squeezed from the skin ( about 1/2 cup ) | 1/2 cup lemon, freshly squeezed, divided | ice cube
instructions: Soak the sunflower seeds and fresh parsley in 2 tablespoons warm water for 20 minutes. Rinse the brisket and then blot dry. Spray the brisket with cooking spray and brown all over in a 350 degree oven for 2 minutes on each side or until cooked through. Set the meat on a platter and refrigerate until set, then tear or cut into thin bite sized pieces. Place the rice and orange juice in a large mixing bowl and stir to mix. Add the cooked corned beef, corned beef and half of the lemon juice. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Coat a 3 to 4 quart slow cooker with cooking spray. Place the slow cooker on top of the rack in the slow cooker. Using a fork, poke holes in the brisket with a fork about 2 inches deep. Pour the remaining juice from the pan over the meat. Top the brisket with the remaining lemon juice. Cook on high setting until the meat and rice are hot through or on setting to warm, 10 to 24 hours depending on how hungry you are. Serve the beef and rice on a platter for a beautiful presentation.

title: Pasta with Carrots  and Linguine
ingredients: 500 g fresh linguine | 800 g carrots | 500 -500 g lemongrass ( fresh only ) or 500 -500 g fresh orecchiette ( fresh only ) | 100 300 g white flour
instructions: Start by preparing the pasta as per packet instructions. Cut the lemongrass and carrots in thin slivers, then leave peel on till later add to the pasta. Cook the pasta as per packet. It should be cooked with good results so don´t overcook it in order to allow the pasta to absorb the flavour. Drain pasta, then toss with the carrots. Serve and enjoy.

title: Bocconcini With Italian Sausage
ingredients: 8 ounces italian sausage | 1 loaf bocconcini | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom powder | 1 head lettuce | 1 can tomato paste
instructions: Brown onion and sausage. Add the tomato paste and simmer over low heat for 30 minutes. Add the cardamom powder. Cut bocconcini into 2 or 3 pieces and place 1/3 of the mixture on the bottom of a small soup plate. Cut the other half of the bocconcini into 1/3 slices and place on top of the mixture. Cover and cook until bocconcini is tender and bocconcini is crisp looking. Take out and sprinkle the top with coarse ground coriander.

Random Ingredients: matzo meal,milk powder,saffron,dark soy sauce,walnut,italian plum tomato
title: Patzaria - Italian Ploughman's Lunch Rolls
ingredients: 1 teaspoon saffron | 1/8 liter milk powder ( you can use 2 %, but the milk powder is important for this ) | 800 g italian plum tomatoes, canned, chopped ( use your favourite brand ) | 2 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 1 tablespoon roasted unsalted walnuts | matzo meal for dusting rice
instructions: Fry saffron in a pan. Set aside and keep hot. Put the milk powder in a pan and add boiling water, as required to dissolve the powder. Once the water comes up to a bit, put a towel on the pan and put this on the heat. Stir with a spoon, stirring all the time. Keep mixing it. As soon as the milk and the dissolved chinese powder start flowing, put the pan on the other side. Once the rice is ready, put it on a clean cloth with some holes in it. Cover the rice with a wet cloth. When the rice is cool to the touch, transfer it to another bowl or plate. Cover with this warm milky liquid. Keep it on the stove on low heat, stirring in the hot milk powder. Keep the rice covered with the towel for 1 - 2 hours, stirring once in a while. At the end of the hour, add the dark soy sauce, sunflower seeds, chopped tomatoes and saffron in. Mix well. Allow to cool, then put in a greased dish. Dust lightly with the roasted nuts. Keep refrigerated until ready to serve.

title: Easy Bolognaise
ingredients: 6 chicken parts | 3 fluid ounces vegetable stock
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c/350°f. Remove skin from chicken. Place in a casserole dish. Sprinkle over the vegetable stock. Bake at 180°c/350°f for 1 hour, or until chicken is cooked through and juices run clear. Serve with plain boiled potatoes.

title: Orange Blossom Couscous
ingredients: 200 g couscous | 1 3/4 cups half-and-half or 1 3/4 cups cream | 25 g cornflour | 1 1/2 tablespoons orange blossom water
instructions: Prepare couscous according to the instructions on the pack. While the couscous is boiling melt the cream or half and half and cornflour in a small pan to make a syrup. When the couscous is ready, pour the cream mixture into the couscous and stir well. Serve straight from the pan.

title: Spicy Sausages
ingredients: 1 package kraft toasted nori ( to soften crisps easier ) | 1 package chorizo sausage, cooked ( i prefer johnsonville, but i've also used other brands. ) | 1/4 cup seedless red chili | 1 package granola ( to make caramel topping ) | 1 pinch cayenne | 1 pinch grain mustard powder | 1/4 cup quick-and-serve english toasted nori ( to soften crisps easier ) ( optional )
instructions: Heat oven to 350 degrees. Cut kraft toasts into 6 pieces. Remove casings. Cut chorizo into 1/2 inch slices.

title: Sweet and Sour Sole
ingredients: 20 sole fillets ( with skin ) | 1 small turnip | 1 small sweet potato ( not too sweet ) or 1 small but firm sweet potato ( not too sweet ) | 3 tablespoons icing sugar | 1/4 cup of chopped fresh italian parsley | 2 tablespoons water | 12 toothpicks
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 f. Wash, peel and dice up your sweet potato into bite size pieces or you can dice your fresh sweet potato into bite size pieces. Cut up sweet potato into bite size pieces or just cut up potatoes into thick bite size pieces. Peel turnip into skinless bite size pieces. Cut up sweet potato into bite size pieces or maybe even a little bit less. Put a wooden spoon or a toothpick into the thick side of each piece of fish. Using a small, heavy wooden spoon, gently fold fish in half and gently tug to squish the pieces around for the stuffing to stick to the fish until it sticks more easily. Place fish in a 13x9 baking dish. Using a small knife, poke holes in the thick sides of the fish with a fork or poke several holes in the thick side with the spoon. The fish shouldn't be so thick that it tears into easily. The fish shouldn't be to juicy or soupy. Sprinkle icing sugar over fish, then the water, then the chopped parsley. Using a spoon or toothpick, gently spread the cut side of the fish with the sweet potato and roll up starting the long side. Sprinkle all over with the sieved icing sugar. Bake in 400 f oven for 20 minutes, then turn the fish skin side down again. Carefully remove toothpick. Cut open and serve with the juices in the pan on the side.

title: Spicy Tuna and Blackberries
ingredients: 1 can tuna or ( 11 ounce ) can tuna, drained | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh cilantro stem | 1/4 cup blackberries, cut in half | 1/2 - 1 lb veal, cut into 1-inch cubes
instructions: Combine tuna, cilantro, and blackberries. Divide tuna mixture among serving plates or ramekins.

Random Ingredients: clove,brussels sprout,mexican chili powder,pandan leaf,cooking spray
title: Spiced Brussels Sprouts
ingredients: cooking spray | 1 can brussels sprouts, rinsed and drained | 1/2 teaspoon mexican chili powder | 1/4 teaspoon ground cloves | 1/2 teaspoon dried pannkalkan leaves or 1/2 teaspoon regular dry-roasted green peppercorns, crushed
instructions: Heat oven to 450 degrees. Spray a large casserole dish or souffle dish with oil and set aside. Line a rimmed baking sheet with foil.

Random Ingredients: blue cheese,ancho chilies,garam masala,pineapple juice,russet potato
title: Sweet Potato & Pineapple Chutney
ingredients: 250 g russet potatoes, grated | 1/4 cup blue cheese, crumbled | 2 dried ancho chilies, leaves finely chopped | 2 tablespoons pineapple juice | 2 teaspoons garam masala
instructions: Combine all ingredients and heat through. Chill and serve chilled.

Random Ingredients: black bean sauce,salt pepper,lemon,pine nut,epazote,pita bread
title: Black Bean Patties for 1 or 2
ingredients: 2 cans black beans - drained, rinsed, and patted dry | 1/2 teaspoon chopped fresh epazote | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh lemon rind | 2 tablespoons pine nuts | 1 dash salt and pepper | 3 pita bread, split
instructions: Mix drained beans, epazote, lemon rind, pine nuts, and salt and pepper to taste until well combined. Shape mixture into balls the size of a golf ball. Set in fridge for about 10 minutes. Meanwhile, heat a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Add patties.

title: Carrot, Daikon and Thyme Tea
ingredients: 1/2 kg cabbage ( about 1 large head ) | 2/3 kg carrot | 2/3 kg radish | 3/4 kg active dry yeast | 1/3 kg vanilla bean, split lengthwise | 2 teaspoons dried thyme
instructions: If necessary, slice off the core of the cabbage, leave the core intact and cut into pieces roughly the same size as the carrots. Peel, wash and slice the carrots and add to the bowl. Wash the daikon and thyme, cut and add to the bowl. Pour the boiling water over to cover and leave in a warm place for 40 - 60 minutes. Add the yeast and pinch the ends of the vanilla bean over. Strain the liquid and dissolve in 5 cups boiling water. The yeast will act as a guilty foam and act as a sponge once the liquid boils and forms a foam, cover the bowl and leave for an hour. Meanwhile start making your tea. Slice and chop the vegetables roughly roughly same size and add to the bowl. Dissolve the yeast in 3 tablespoons warm water. Stir the yeast into the liquid so that it begins to disolved. Stir in the thyme and leave to rise again until doubled. Boil about 40 minutes. Strain. Ladle the tea into small tea glasses and add a tablespoon or two of vanilla bean seeds. Garnish with a teaspoon of the reserved thyme.

title: Herb, Mint, and Chili Powder Mix for Dogs
ingredients: 2 tablespoons chili seasoning mix ( can use chili powder or mix of your favorite herbs ) | 4 tablespoons dried mint | 2 teaspoons paprika, sweet-pepper flavored ( or a mild hot pepper of your choice )
instructions: Dissolve the chili seasoning in 1 tblspice essence. To use mix, combine the mint leaves, mint, and paprika in small cups, to equal 1/2 cup. Store this mix in an airtight container and keep in the fridge for up to 3 months. This spice mix can be used for dogs or sausages.

title: Baby Bok Choy Salad
ingredients: 1 cup baby bok choy, washed | 1 head bibb lettuce
instructions: Wash and cut the head of bok choy into 1/4 inch slices. Wash and separate the stems from leaves. Place them in a bowl. Pour the full quantity of water containing the bok choy spinner over the heads. Cover and let it sit in the refrigerator for 15 - 20 minutes. Pour out the excess water. After the 15 - 20 minutes, add the baby bok choy leaves. Toss them around in the bowl. Remove the excess water from the bowl using the bok choy leaves. Arrange the leaves around the bok choy leaves, in attractive pattern.

title: Coconut Meat (Keftet Maandoor)
ingredients: 1 kg coconut meat ( keftet ) | oil ( for frying ) | 2 teaspoons extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Fry the meat until golden brown. Remove and drain on a clean kitchen towel. Dice the meat and fry it in a skillet with 1 teaspoon oil, in it for 5 minutes. Spread coconut on a deep plate. Serve with plain rice and salad.

title: Walnut Balls (Tod Kratiem Prik Tai)
ingredients: 1 lb walnuts, ground | 3 tablespoons dried dill weed | 1/2 cup fish sauce | 1 tablespoon vanilla | 1 lb graham crackers, crushed fine | 16 ounces pineapple, chunks
instructions: Place all ingredients in a food processor and process until it resembles a coarse meal. Turn into a bowl and stir in graham cracker crumbs. Divide into walnut sized balls. Roll into pineapples if desired. Refrigerate until ready to use.

title: Caramel Sauce
ingredients: 3 cups heavy cream | 1 pinch ground mace
instructions: In a medium, heavy based saucepan, bring cream and mace to boil over medium high heat. Boil about 5 minutes. Remove from heat, whisking constantly to prevent scorching. Gradually pour caramel into hot caramel and set aside until cool.

title: Sun-Dried Tomatoes With Lime and Tomato
ingredients: 7 sun-dried tomatoes, packed in oil | 3 limes
instructions:
Take 2 of the tomatoes & lay 1 slice of lime on top of the other. Sprinkle with oregano & top with your choice of herbs such as cilantro or basil 

 ## Cooking instructions ##
 Take another slice of lime and cut the slices in half. Stand this in the middle of the tomatoes & lay them together on top of each other. The lime will make the end result less likely than you think it will. Leave to sit & serve hot or at room temperature. This recipe can also be prepared in advance & reheated for a snack. Just keep in mind it freezes pretty well.

title: Baked Pear Compote
ingredients: 4 large pears | 2 lbs yukon gold potatoes, washed, peeled and cut into quarters | 1/4 cup molasses
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f butter 10 inch baking dish. Place potatoes in a baking dish. Stir pears, molasses, and 1/2 the pear mixture in to baking dish, reserving remaining mixture for later use. Pour reserved mixture over the potatoes and vegetables. Sprinkle remaining pear mixture on top and bake approximately 2 1/2 hours or until golden brown.

title: Dieted Spanish Onions - Rachael Ray
ingredients: 1/2 cup french roasted salted coffee | 1 spanish onion, peeled and quartered
instructions: Combine the coffee and onion quarters in a small bowl. Let stand at room temperature for 30 minutes or up to 3 days. Toss onion quarters with the coffee/onion mixture.

title: Homemade Mushrooms
ingredients: 24 cremini mushrooms | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh oregano
instructions: Wash and lightly dry the mushrooms. If using the stems of the mushrooms, clean them by placing them in a colander over a bowl filled with cold water. Rinse the mushrooms under running water until the water stops separating between the stems and shells. Slice each piece into four or five pieces, depending on the size of the mushrooms. Repeat, using a spoon to separate the stems and shells from the inside of the mushrooms. Remove the leaves and discard. Remove and discard stems. Sprinkle the caps with chopped oregano, and let stand for 1 hour, stirring gently every 10 or 20 minutes to ensure even coloring. Bring a pot of salted water to boil. Meanwhile, preheat the oven to 425 degrees f. Place the mushrooms in a small dish. Place the oregano in a mortar with a pestle and mash with the pestle. When the water comes to a boil, pour the mushroom mixture over the mushrooms and stir gently to distribute them evenly. Return it to the water, cover, and place in the preheated oven. Bake for 20 to 30 minutes, or until the gravy thickens and mushrooms are tender.

title: Potato Croquettes
ingredients: 5 yukon gold potatoes | 3 slices whole wheat bread | 1/4 teaspoon cumin powder
instructions: Pierce the potatoes with a fork. Put them in a pot and cover with water.. Boil until they are tender. Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Slice the potatoes into rounds, if possible, and drop them in a big bowl. Mash with a potato masher for a while until the mixture is smooth, and it forms soft ball like dough. Cut the bread into small, crumb like pieces. Roll the bread into small balls, and insert a small ice cream scoop into the centre of each one while you are waiting for the water to boil. Bake until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: horseradish,poblano chile,bean,spicy mustard,chicken tender,vegetable,red chili pepper flake
title: Horse-Crusted Roast Chicken With Beans
ingredients: 1 medium poblano chile | 4 teaspoons prepared horseradish | 1 teaspoon red chili pepper flakes, crushed | 1/2 teaspoon spicy mustard | 8 -10 chicken tenders | 1 can refried beans | 1 package assorted fresh vegetables
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Char chile on all sides in small frypan over medium heat. Cut chile in half lengthwise and remove seeds. Slit chile's lengthwise and scrape out seeds. Cut into halves lengthwise then cut each half into thin strips. Set aside. Pierce entire skin of poblano chile with a few places, rub with a little oil, and sprinkle with horseradish, chili flakes, and dry mustard. Place chile strips on a board, sprinkle with remaining horseradish, chili flakes, and mustard. Spread refried beans over top. Arrange vegetables around the chicken. Wrap tightly with the toothpicks. Place in a large roasting pan. Add water to roasting pan by about 1/3 of the way up the side of the chicken. Bake for 50 - 55 minutes, basting frequently with pan juices. Remove toothpicks before serving.

Random Ingredients: cayenne,bailey irish cream,taco seasoning,molasses,onion soup mix,phyllo pastry
title: Baked Phyllo Triangles
ingredients: 1 1/2 packages dry onion soup mix | 1 cup molasses | 3/4 cup anejo rosa hot cocoa powder or 3/4 cup mccormick hot cocoa powder, divided | 1 cup baileys irish cream ( bailey's ) | 2 cups rolled sweet roll oats or 2 cups regular rolled oats ( approximately 5 oz ) | 20 sheets frozen phyllo pastry
instructions: Drain the soup mix and stir in molasses and ¼ cup the hot cocoa powder, mixing well. Add the remaining ½ cup cocoa powder and bailey's and stir until incorporated. Stir in the oats until coated in cocoa. Sprinkle some oats on the bottom of a jelly roll pan lined with parchment paper or waxed paper, and begin layering the phyllo sheets in 2 different layers using approximately 18 sheets, brushing each phyllo sheet with some cocoa/liqueur mixture. Working from a wide and long sides, roll up the phyllo dough, beginning with the wide side, and seal with a fork. Repeat until all the phyllo sheets are gone. Arrange 10 phyllo sheets, beginning and ending with phyllo sheets, brushing each with cocoa. Spray the phyllo top with some cocoa, and cut a slit in each and let stand for 15 minutes. Bake at 350 degrees for 10 minutes, then reduce the heat to 390 degrees, and bake for 20 minutes or just until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: oyster,balsamic vinegar,bean,italian seasoning,beef sirloin,tomato green chilies,half,prawn
title: Oyster & Prawns Casserole
ingredients: 1 lb prawns | 500 g beef sirloin | 1 cup prawns, shell and deveined | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies ( i used rotel ) | 3 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 2 tablespoons italian seasoning | 1 cup fat-free half-and-half | 2 cans refried beans
instructions: Prepare the beef and prawns as per instructions. Cook the prawns on the grill. Put the prawns and beef and prawns in the casserole dish. Cut the tomato and red capsicum in strips. Mix the balsamic vinegar, italian seasoning and the half and half until it's the consistency of maple syrup. Pour over the casserole. Cook for 15 minutes at 180°c or till the prawns are pink and the sauce is thickened. Serve over noodles if desired.

title: Italian Pork Loin
ingredients: 24 -32 ounces pork loin | 1 1/2 cups pizza sauce | 1 can beer or 2 cups beer | 1/2 cup meat, shredded
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Put pork loin in greased pan. Mix sauce and beer. Spread over pork. Cover with aluminum foil. Bake for 35 minutes. Reduce heat to 325 degrees. Bake 45 minutes more and serve.

Random Ingredients: chipotle pepper,red bell pepper,sun tomato oil,sirloin,beef stock cube,coriander leaf,celery
title: Spicy Beef Stew Skewers With Chipotle-Tofu
ingredients: 400 g lean sirloin, cubed | 1 red bell pepper, chopped | 2 stalks celery, sliced | 4 slices sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, quartered | 2 beef stock cubes | 1 teaspoon ground coriander leaves, chopped | 1 teaspoon chipotle pepper ( paste )
instructions: Grill or barbecue sirloin, bell pepper and celery on high heat about 4 minutes each side, or until cooked to your liking. Transfer to a plate. Meanwhile, make the chipotle tomatoo by combining the chipotle pepper paste with some of the beef stock cube liquid until smooth. Stir into beef mixture. Divide among serving plates and sprinkle with coriander leaves and chopped chipotle. Serve with fresh crusty bread such as chunky bread, crisp rice and plenty of yoghurt mixed with lots of napkins if desired.

Random Ingredients: red pesto sauce,miso,thyme leaf,pork tenderloin,prosciutto,margarine,chicken broth,jalapeno cheese tortilla
title: Tortillas Mexicano
ingredients: 1 lb pork tenderloin | 2 tablespoons margarine | 2 tablespoons red pesto sauce | 1 tablespoon finely shredded jalapeno cheese or 1 tablespoon muir glen cheese | 1/8 cup chicken broth | 3 -4 sprigs fresh thyme leaves, to taste | 2 slices prosciutto ( thick slices ) | 2 tablespoons finely chopped jalapeno cheese or 2 tablespoons muir glen cheese | 4 crisp corn tortillas
instructions: Cut the tenderloin lengthwise into 8 equal thin slices. Place the slices between two sheets of plastic wrap and pound together until they are approximately 1/4 inch thick. Melt the margarine in a large skillet over medium high heat. Add the pork slices and cook, turning, until they are well browned on both sides. Remove the pork from the skillet and arrange on a plate. In the same skillet, add the pesto and 1/8 cup of hot water. Simmer for 5 minutes. Add the pork to the skillet with the rest of the ingredients. Cook for 20 minutes or until thoroughly heated. To serve, place a tortilla on a plate. Top with 1/2 cup of the pork mixture. Top with a tablespoon or so of cheese and some of the herbs. Add a dollop of the additional 1/2 cup of hot water and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: grand marnier,farfalle pasta,ice,turkey,kosher salt,chunky salsa,canola oil,lemon
title: Quick Turkey and Bow Ties
ingredients: 1 lb ground turkey | kosher salt, to taste | 2 bags farfalle pasta ( bow tie pasta ) | 3 quarts canola oil | 2 packages frozen chunky salsa ( trader joe's brand salsa is good for this ) | 1/4 cup grand marnier | 1 1/2 lemons | 4 disks ice
instructions: Cook turkey and pinch of kosher salt, according to package directions, set aside. Bring a pot of water to boil, add 3 cups water, and bring it back to a boil. Meanwhile, bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Cook farfalle in boiling water for 8 - 10 minutes or until just tender, drain. Drain. Cook bowtie pasta according to package directions, drain, and cool. While farfalle are cooking, place canola oil in a large bowl, and mix in salsa, grand marnier and ice cubes. Taste and adjust seasoning if necessary. Place dry pasta into mixing bowl, and add enough dressing to coat. Toss well, and serve with more dressing on the side.

title: Chinese-Style Fruit Salad
ingredients: 1/4 cup dried apricot, chopped | 1 tablespoon palm sugar or 1 tablespoon brown sugar, granulated | 4 cups mixed mushrooms | 1 can sliced peaches, drained | 1 1/2 kg fresh meat, sliced
instructions: Soak dried apricots in hot water for 10 minutes. Drain, remove pits and dice them. In a pan, brown the green onions with the sugar. Stir in the apricots and mushrooms. Add the beef and pour over the pineapple chunks with the juice that the pineapple has soaked in it. Cover and simmer for 1 - ½ hours.

Random Ingredients: pizza sauce,egg yolk,buttermilk,parmesan cheese,onion,apricot,ice cube,sage leaf
title: Sage & Onion Quiche - Vegan Recipe
ingredients: 1 large onion, grated ( about 1 1/4 cups ) | 1 1/4 cups low-fat buttermilk | 1 egg yolk | 1 teaspoon dried sage leaves | 1/2 cup fresh grated parmesan cheese | 2 cans prepared pizza sauce | 1 cup ice cold water ( or milk ) | 1/4 cup dried apricot, roughly chopped ( optional )
instructions: Saute onion in buttermilk.

title: Chow Mein Salad
ingredients: 1 package fresh meatballs ( or 2 lbs., sliced sausage and cut up, i like to use 2 lbs. ) | 8 ounces swiss cheese | 1 cup mayonnaise | 1/2 cup chow mein noodles | 1/2 cup feta cheese
instructions: Cook meatballs and swiss cheese in a large bowl until the cheese is fully melted and the meat is heated through. Serve immediately over hot chow mein noodles.

Random Ingredients: pear,wheat germ,pie shell,cream tartar,chicken bouillon,red curry paste,romaine lettuce leaf,red currant jelly
title: Pear Tatin Salad
ingredients: 4 -5 medium ripe pears, cored and sliced thin | 1/2 cup chicken bouillon, divided | 1 package refrigerated rolled refrigerated pie crusts, chilled | 1/3 cup grainy wheat germ | 1/2 cup fat free sour cream ( or cream of wheat ) | 2 tablespoons red curry paste | 2 -3 romaine lettuce leaves, torn into tiny pieces | 1/2 cup drained red currant jelly
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Combine pears and 1 1/2 tablespoon bouillon in large bowl.

title: Easy Sugar and Spice Sugar Free Marinade for Beef or Pork
ingredients: 1/2 cup tomato juice | 1/4 cup dark sesame oil | 2 tablespoons caster sugar
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a shallow dish and stir to blend well. Put onto beef or pork and leave to marinate for up to 24 hours or overnight before cooking, turning occasionally to ensure the sugar has dissolved.

Random Ingredients: cucumber,apple cider vinegar,baking soda,macaroni,caster sugar,tamarind pulp
title: Shallot & Tomato Chutney (21 Day Wonder Diet:day 14)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon apple cider vinegar | 1 1/2 tablespoons caster sugar | 3/4 teaspoon baking soda | 2 tablespoons tamarind pulp | 1 medium cucumber, deseeded and finely diced | 2 1/2 ounces dried macaroni, cooked
instructions: Combine all the ingredients in a small bowl, stir well. Pour into a small, shallow, non metallic bowl. Cover and refrigerate for a minimum of 3 hours and up to 3 hours. Bring to room temperature before serving and drizzle over freshly made vegitable style breadcrumbs or flat leaf parsley for lunch.

title: Herbed Brown Rice
ingredients: 1 cup raw brown rice, rinsed well | 1 tablespoon mixed fresh herbs with seasoning mix | 1/2 teaspoon white pepper ( optional )
instructions: Coat an 8 or 10 inch nonstick frying pan with cooking spray. Bring the oil to 350°f. Line a large platter with rice. Sprinkle with pepper. Stir in the mixed herbs. Place the rice in the pan, and fry until the rice is dark and crispy on the outside. Turn the rice out onto a flat dish. Turn the rice onto the cooked side. Cut into pieces or wedges.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon cube,korean red pepper paste,lime wedge,parmigiano reggiano cheese,coconut powder,bread butter pickle,green onion,celery rib
title: Korean Beef Stew (Sinangagang)
ingredients: 1 kg beef chuck or 1 kg blade roast | 2 tablespoons coconut powder | 5 tablespoons korean red pepper paste ( gochujang ) | 1 cup bread and butter pickles, finely chopped ( i don't mix ) | 1/2 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 2 beef bouillon cubes ( or equivalent packet of regular instant beef stock cubes ) | 2 large celery ribs, thinly sliced | 1 bunch green onion, sliced
instructions: Pulverize rock corn or similar cracker into a coarse, coarse meal. Cut the roast into chunks. Place the chuck in a bowl. Add all other ingredients in the order given and mix thoroughly. If you're using a crockpot or dutch oven, you don't need to wash the meat first. Once all the ingredients are in, cover and cook on low for 5 to 6 hours. Stir the stew every 20 to 30 minutes to be sure nothing sticks to the bottom of the pot and that the beef is drying out. I usually serve this topped with steamed jasmine rice. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: food coloring,sherry,tomato green chilies,brandy,almond extract,lime leaf,pineapple chunk
title: Pineapple and Chilli Spritz
ingredients: 6 small tomatoes and green chilies, deseeded and finely chopped | 1 teaspoon pineapple chunk, deseeded and finely chopped | 2 -3 tablespoons dark sherry | 1 can pineapple chunks, well drained | 1 teaspoon almond extract | powdered sugar, to taste ( optional ) | food coloring, to color
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl and leave in a cool place to chill. Once the colouring of the tomato and chillies changes to a pink colour, stir in a teaspoon of powdered sugar until the colour is vivid again.

title: Nova Scotia Cheddar Seeds - Canning & Filling
ingredients: 1 tablespoon coriander seed ( i buy coriander seeds ) | 5 cups all-purpose white flour, sifted | 1 cup shredded cheddar cheese | 1 cucumber, peeled and grated ( optional )
instructions: Dry fry the coriander seeds in a little butter on a medium heat for about 20 - 30 minutes till golden. Remove and cool. Beat the flour and cheddar together in a big bowl with a little water with a fork till the dough forms. Grate the cucumber and mix with the flour, if using. Add about a teaspoon of the ground coriander and mix well. Form the dough into about 20 walnut sized balls. Chill the dough balls for a few hours in a sealed container in the refrigerator. When ready to bake the nova Scotia cheddar seeds either preheat the oven to 375°. Using a knife, poke three or four indents along the base. Drop a few into the oven, close the door and bake for 15 - 20 minutes, till light brown and springy to the touch. These can also be cooked in a frying pan with a little oil which takes them all into a nice deep, uniform paste. Cool a few minutes in the pan before removing to cool on an oiled rack. Store in an airtight container and use on sandwiches, in salads, as a filling for crackers or as a topping for any meat or poultry.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack cheese,dark rum,pork chop,ginger ale,fennel seed
title: Pork Chops With Rum and Fennel
ingredients: 16 ounces pork chops ( i used country-style ) | 1 teaspoon fennel seed, crushed | 1/2 teaspoon dark rum | 1 cup beer ( any kind will do ) | 1 cup monterey jack cheese, grated
instructions: Brown chops in a little hot rum. Remove chops. In a small pan combine fennel seed, rum, beer and cheese. Simmer for 5 minutes. Put chops back into pan. Top with remaining cheese. Cover and simmer until cheese is melted and chops are heated through.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast half,tomato paste,cooking oil,coconut,shiitake mushroom,milk powder,white vinegar,radish
title: Healthy Chicken With Mushrooms
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cooking oil | 6 shiitake mushrooms, stems removed and caps sliced | 4 skinless chicken breast halves, about 1/2 inch thick | 1 1/2 tablespoons tomato paste | 1 package frozen sliced radishes | 2 tablespoons skim milk powder | 1/4 cup unsweetened shredded coconut, toasted | 1 tablespoon white vinegar
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium high heat. Saute mushrooms 2 minutes. Spoon excess liquid from skillet and discard. Add chicken to skillet. In another skillet, stir together tomato paste and remaining ingredients. Saute for 2 minutes. Add tomato mixture and cook, stirring, for an additional 3 minutes. Arrange chicken on top of mushrooms and serve.

title: Mild Sausage
ingredients: 1 teaspoon meat tenderizer | 1 pound white chicken meat, cubed
instructions: Season the dry poultry tenderizer with the amount of tenderizer and set aside. Cook the chicken meat a few at a time in a large, deep skillet. Cook over medium high heat until the meat is browned, about 10 minutes. Using slotted spoon, remove from skillet and place on a paper towel lined plate to drain.

title: Black-Eyed Peas, Great British Beans, Black-Eyed Peas!
ingredients: 8 ounces fresh black-eyed peas | 1 inch fresh clove
instructions: Place a steamer into a saucepan and cover with just enough water to just cover the beans. Bring to the boil and cook for 3 - 5 minutes, or until just tender. Drain off water and leave in the saucepan. Trim the pea pods and remove their thick stringy spines. Wash the peas under running water and dry in a cloth or tea towel. Scrape off the skins, break them into chunks and place into the saucepan with 2 of the steamer's empty contents. Cover with the remaining steamer's contents, cover and steam for 8 - 10 minutes, or until the peas are tender. Check to make sure the peas are heated through before removing from the heat. Serve hot.

title: Grilled Breakfast Sausages
ingredients: 2 - 3 lbs. sausage, with casing | 12 tablespoons unsalted butter, divided
instructions: Preheat a grill. Butter or spray a baking pan, or cast iron casserole dish with nonstick spray and arrange the sausage as follows at least 20 rows of sausages about 3/4 inch thick. Spread 1 tablespoon of butter all over each sausage. Cook over medium heat until well browned, 10 to 12 minutes, turning once. Transfer to a warm platter and cover with foil while making the glaze. To cook the sausage, wipe grill rack clean, and return to stove. Add remaining butter to skillet. Place skillet over medium high heat and, when melted, add the sausage. Cook, tossing with tongs, until browned all over, about 10 minutes. Transfer to a piece of foil while preparing the glaze and pour the glaze over the sausage.

Random Ingredients: red beet,cream chicken soup,salmon,baking powder,apricot preserve,parsley leaf
title: Easy Beets and Smoked Salmon Muffins
ingredients: 2 cups red beet, sliced ( fresh or canned ) | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 2 ounces smoked salmon, shredded | 2 tablespoons apricot preserves | 2 teaspoons baking powder | 1 pinch dried parsley leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Spray muffin tin with cooking spray. Combine the beets and soup in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: chunky salsa,bar,rice,summer savory,red wine,parma ham,rosemary leaf
title: Mediterranean Rice Bake
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked rice | 1/2 cup chunky salsa | 2 tablespoons light bar-b-que sauce or 2 tablespoons hot monterey pepper sauce | 2 tablespoons red wine or 2 tablespoons beef broth | 1/8 teaspoon rosemary leaf | 2 tablespoons parma ham, of your choice chopped into 1/8 inch-thick pieces | fresh rosemary leaf
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°. Combine all ingredients in a bowl. Pour mixture into a greased 9x13 baking dish. Bake for 45 minutes or until liquid is evaporated.

title: Mexican Style Salmon
ingredients: 1 whole salmon | 1 diced fresh green chili
instructions: Remove skin from salmon and discard it. Slice off any dark bones. Coat salmon liberally with a thin layer of the salt. Place in a baking pan, place in a 350 degree oven and bake for approximately 20 minutes or until the internal temperature reaches the point of soft pull the salmon apart and serve them with your favorite taco fixings. Enjoy.

title: Cappuccino (Porridge)
ingredients: 1 cup small pasta ( spaghetti or macaroni ) | 1/2 teaspoon of crushed cardamom seed | 1 tablespoon unsweetened cocoa powder
instructions: In a medium sauce pan add pasta, cocoa powder, and cardamom seeds and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low and add 2/3 cup hot water or broth to moisten. Stir well and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: oyster sauce,potato,veal,crescent dinner,chili pepper flake,millet flour,epazote,blueberry
title: Blueberry Calzone
ingredients: 1 lb ground veal | 1/2 teaspoon hot chili pepper flakes | 1/2 lb potato ( small dice ) | 1/2 lb philt betty crocker low-fat crescent dinner roll, separated into 2 halves | 2 tablespoons millet flour | 1 tablespoon oyster sauce | 1/2 cup berry juice from can evaporated milk or 1/2 cup milk | 1/2 cup fresh blueberries, washed ( optional )
instructions: Melt a nonstick pan over medium heat. Add the ground meat and chili flakes and cook about 5 minutes until meat meat starts to brown. Remove meat from heat and set aside to cool. Heat 2 tbsp of the butter and the flour in a skillet over high heat until it begins to brown. Add the rest of the ingredients and bring to boil, stirring constantly. Turn heat to low and add the meat and sauce to the meat mixture. Heat thoroughly, but do not heat. Let cool. Put mixture into a 9x13 baking dish and spoon in the berry juice or milk. Place the other half of the sheet of crescent dough over this and poke in the top with a fork. Bake for 30 minutes or until golden brown. If you don't have a 13x9 inch baking dish, bake your dough in the lower half of the oven at 350 to 375ºf or until crispy. Let cool and serve.

title: Tandoori Masala
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1/2 cup tandoori masala
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Serve immediately.

title: Basic Japanese Rice
ingredients: 1 cup jasmine rice, washed and drained well ( the kind with the skin on, which you've got from a box, see photo ) | 4 -5 drops tabasco sauce ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt
instructions: Heat rice until boiling, then cover, turn heat to one and cook about 15 minutes. Check after 15 minutes to cook through. Add tabasco, if using, and salt. If not to your liking, add a small amount of water. Note, if doing this, i would advise to add a bit of the kikkoman light flavored sriracha sauce, perhaps 1/2 tsp red chili paste to this or 1/4 c hot sauce. If the rice is to salty, add 1/4 c water and mix well. Note 2, if you don't have a rice strainer, you could also add a can of whole wheat couscous to this rice and mix. Also, if too thick, dilute with a small amount of water. Note 3, if you don't have a strainer, try adding 1 cup of whole wheat couscous to this rice and mix. Dissolve this in 1/2 cup of water. Try tasting and tasting again, this is the important part and adjust water with tabasco. Add rice to boiling vegetable or meatless dish and mix. Serve warm and enjoy.

title: Pistachio Chive Nests
ingredients: 250 g savoiardi pistachio pudding mix | 2 tablespoons finely chopped chives
instructions: Preheat oven to 190c/fan 160c/gas 2. Bring a small jug of water to the boil in a small saucepan over a high heat. Add the pistachios and toss until the outsides turn golden brown. Drain the excess water and leave to cool. Pour the pistachios onto baking paper lined trays. Sprinkle with chives, then bake for 15 - 20 minutes or until the tops feel dry and crumbly. Serve warm or cool and store in an airtight container.

title: Mexican Corn on the Cob (Honey Corn)
ingredients: 4 ears corn on the cob, husks and silk removed | 1 1/2 tablespoons fresh thyme | 1 lime, zest of, finely shredded
instructions: Preheat the grill to high. Place the corn on a large baking sheet or piece of foil. Sprinkle the corn with thyme and the lime zest. Grill the corn over direct high heat, rotating the husks occasionally with a metal spatula, until the kernels have grill marks and the corn is just tender, about 10 minutes. If the corn is to dry before the husks are done, allow 30 seconds.

title: Easy Red Enchilada Sauce
ingredients: 7 red enchilada sauce | 3 cups ice cubes
instructions: Boil 6 cups of ice, then remove cubes. Scoop out ice from a strainer and let cool. Dip each enchilada glass into a little bowl of enchilada sauce until covered. Fill each glass with enough ice so that the ice doesn't spill over. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: tuna fish,crescent dinner,orange flower water,spring onion,beef chuck,white wine,guava nectar
title: Guava and Tuna Croquettes
ingredients: 200 g white tuna fish, drained | 100 g guava nectar | 2 spring onions | fresh orange flower water | 100 -275 g crescent dinner rolls | 600 g beef chuck ( cubed ) | white wine
instructions: Finely dice the spring onions. Drain the tuna and place it in a bowl. Add guava nectar mix well and add the orange flower water stir well and mix in the diced spring onion. Allow to cool. Add the sate into the mixture. Cut the crescent rolls into quarters and preheat a large pan of rapidly boiling water. Open the crescent and put 1 tablespoon of mixture onto each half. Place in the pan and cook for 10 - 45 secs until golden brown. Serve with white wine and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: cardamom seed,red pepper flake,mustard powder,biscuit mix,chipotle chile adobo,kalamata olive
title: Fajita Bread
ingredients: 2 cups biscuit mix | 3/4 cup grated kalamata olive, such as stuffed olives | 3 chipotle chiles in adobo | 1/4 teaspoon mustard powder | 1/4 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 1/4 teaspoon mustard powder | 1 teaspoon crushed cardamom seed ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350f degrees. In bowl, mix flour, baking mix and nuts. Stir in olive and chipotles. On greased and floured parchment or baking sheet, pat each loaf with fingers. Bake for 20 - 25 minutes or until done. Serve with salad. Variation, try canned guacamole. Variation, add 1 - 3 tablespoons dried lime or lemon lime juice or chile salsa. Variation, omit mustard powder. Instead, you can add 1 tablespoon dried minced onion, if desired.

Random Ingredients: lemon,green olive,leaf thyme,italian seasoning,salsa,basil pesto,white bean,floury potato
title: Italian Potato Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs floury potatoes ( about 6 medium ) | 1 bunch basil pesto ( or use your own purchased basil pesto ) | 1 can diced green olives | 2 -3 tablespoons lemon rind | 1 tablespoon dried leaf thyme | 2 -3 teaspoons italian seasoning | 1 can white beans ( drained ) | salsa ( optional )
instructions: Make the pesto for the salad. Boil the potatoes for about 1 hour, or until they are just tender, but not falling apart. Drain once they are cool enough to handle. I like a little less juice, but the taste will not be as good with the potatoes. Place potatoes in a colander set over a bowl and let drain for about 15 minutes, or until all of the potatoes are moist. This will help them get rid of the sticky skins. Remove the potatoes from water, place in a large serving bowl, and pour the prepared pesto over them. Toss thoroughly. The easiest way to do this is to spread the salad on a salad plate, then spoon about 2 tbsp of pesto on top of that, and top it with the other 2 tbsp of pesto, basil, green olives, lemon rind, thyme, italian seasoning and beans. You want your veggies evenly layered on the surface of the salad, so don’t worry if they don’t line up on the plate. At this point, you can chill any remaining salad, which makes the vegetables easier to eat. This is good served hot, too.

title: Spinach Omelette
ingredients: 6 large eggs | 2 tablespoons fresh spinach, chopped | 1/8 teaspoon allspice
instructions: Mix eggs, spinach and allspice together. Heat up omelette pan using low heat. Pour egg mixture on, cover and cook for about 10 minutes. Garnish with your choice of fresh vegetables.

title: Homemade Homemade Mexican Bread
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups plain flour | 1/4 teaspoon active dry yeast | 1/4 cup warm water | 1/4 cup epazote, finely chopped | 1/2 - 3/4 fresh serrano chili, finely chopped
instructions: Mix ingredients together into a dough ball and place in an oiled bowl. Cover with a damp cloth and set aside in a warm place for 60 minutes to 1 hour. When dough is about to double its size, punch it down. Divide into 20 equal dough portions. Roll onto a floured surface, into a 12 inch round. Place on a parchment lined pizza tray or baking sheet, cover and allow to rise until doubled in bulk, 15 to 20 minutes. Preheat oven to 450°f. Bake for about 15 minutes, or until golden on top. Allow to cool slightly. Spread hot or cold filling on the hot dough and serve.

title: Mock Jaffa Ramen
ingredients: 1/2 cup italian-style salad dressing | 1 cup half-and-half | 1 cup half-and-half | 1 cup cashews | 1 1/2 cups frozen chopped mixed vegetables | 4 -5 cups ramen noodles
instructions: Put italian dressing in a 2 cup measuring cup and put in refrigerator until cooled. Put half and half, cashews, mixed vegetables and ramen noodles in a blender and blend till smooth. Pour back in pan. Cover and let marinate overnight or for at least 2 hours.

title: Irish Soda Bread--Granesh Up For Years!
ingredients: 1 cup golden raisin | 3 tablespoons red wine vinegar or 3 tablespoons cider vinegar
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Spread on crackers.

title: Chile Mor Lahmi in Cilantro
ingredients: 16 large lamb cutlets ( lamb loin or sirloin ) | 1 -2 cup chopped cilantro | 2 -4 medium shallots ( optional )
instructions: Heat a charcoal grill or broiler. Spray cutlets liberally with nonstick cooking spray. Place cutlets on grate or broiler pan and cook 4 or 5 minutes on each side or till done to your taste. To cutlets, spread a thin layer of chile mor haram on each cutlet. Serve with a garnish of cilantro and shallots. Use as a garnish over pita bread. Can be served with fish dishes, pita chips or rice.

Random Ingredients: ziti pasta,balsamic vinegar,chicken breast,flat leaf parsley,blueberry,pepperoni,thai fish sauce
title: Philly Chicken Salad
ingredients: 4 boneless chicken breasts, cooked | 2 cups bite sized ziti pasta, cooked ( or use your favorite ) | 2 bunches fresh flat-leaf parsley, leaves separated and washed well | 1 package pepperoni, sliced into rings | 2 cups fresh blueberries | 3/4 cup thai fish sauce | 1/4 cup balsamic vinegar | 2 tablespoons minced flat leaf parsley
instructions: Combine salad ingredients in a large bowl. Combine fish sauce, vinegar and parsley in a small bowl and whisk until well combined. Add to salad and toss to combine, coating all sides of salad. Serve with croutons or crackers.

Random Ingredients: red kidney bean,brussels sprout,red chili powder,italian parsley
title: Quick Beans With Sprouts
ingredients: 1 can red kidney beans, drained and rinsed ( garbanzo beans ) | 2 tablespoons mixed italian parsley, chopped | 1 1/2 teaspoons red chili powder | 1 bag fresh brussels sprouts, trimmed
instructions: In a 3 quart saucepan, stir together the beans with the parsley, red chili powder and brussels sprouts. Place over medium high heat and bring just to a boil. Reduce heat to medium low and simmer, uncovered, until sprouts are just tender, about 3 - 5 minutes.

title: Homemade Cranberry and Spice
ingredients: 3 cups fresh cranberries | 3 vegetable bouillon cubes
instructions: Wash, dry, and chop the cranberries and place them in a large bowl or pot with vegetable bouillon. Cover, and let marinate 10 minutes. Add more water and water to cover and place the bowl in the refrigerator. Stir often and let stand for an hour.

Random Ingredients: cream mushroom soup,tahini,pine nut,lima bean,chili pepper flake
title: Napa Beef Dip
ingredients: 12 ounces cream of mushroom soup | 1/4 cup tahini | 1/2 - 3/4 teaspoon dried chili pepper flakes ( or to taste ) | 1/3 cup lima beans, cooked | 1/3 cup toasted pine nuts ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small serving dish. Mix well. Stir well. Spoon into mugs or small serving dish. If desired sprinkle toasted pine nuts on top of the dip.

title: Fettuccini Fritters - Shrimp, Chicken and Pork
ingredients: 500 g hamburger | 1 teaspoon peanut oil | 12 ounces dry fettuccine | 4 tablespoons shallots or 4 tablespoons onions, finely chopped | 1 dash vanilla extract
instructions: In medium sized frying pan, add peanut oil. Add chopped shallots to frying pan. Let them go limp, then add meat. Add vanilla, stir. Add fettuccini and stir. Let boil for about 10 minutes, add 1/2 cup of water. Let sit for the fritters to be ready. Serve with cream sauce or ice cream or as a side for a party night snack. You can cut fettuccini into smaller pieces and fry them first.

Random Ingredients: pepper sauce,meat,kaffir lime leaf,almond,ancho chile powder
title: Ancho Chile Nuts
ingredients: 1 quart meat, from ground sirloin and turkey | 1/4 teaspoon hot pepper sauce | 1/2 cup toasted chopped almonds | 1 tablespoon dried ancho chile powder ( optional ) | 2 small dried ancho chile peppers ( optional )
instructions: Brown meat in small amount of oil on all sides. Set aside. When cooled, remove meat into strainer. Discard any remaining oil. Heat remainder of oil in empty container and add chopped almond and hot pepper sauce. When hot, add browned meat. Stir and heat until hot. Add ancho chile if using. Drain any excess onion. Fill into paper cup with boiling water. Cool and strain. Can be stored tightly covered in refrigerator up to 1 week.

title: Lobster tail soup
ingredients: 1 lobster tail ( cooked ) | 1 tablespoon fish sauce
instructions: Clean lobster tail carefully with water. Remove meat with large claws. In a large sauce pan, mix fish sauce with fish sauce. Set aside. Put lobster tail pieces in pan and cover. Steam lobster tail pieces for approx 3 - 5 minutes. Then turn over and cover. Steam for approx 5 - 10 minutes.

title: Grilled Beef With Asian Plum Tomatoes and Grilled Tomatoes
ingredients: 10 sweet italian plum tomatoes | 8 slices sirloin ( thin slices ) | 3 tablespoons thai fish sauce
instructions: Preheat grill to medium high. Combine all ingredients for the barbecue sauce in small bowl, stirring to blend. Place tomatoes on grill and brush with the barbecue sauce.

Random Ingredients: white flour,white fish fillet,portabella mushroom,chili oil,egg
title: Portabella Fried Fish
ingredients: 150 g portabella mushrooms, thinly sliced | 3 teaspoons chili oil | 2 eggs | 3 teaspoons white flour | 4 white fish fillets
instructions: Heat chili oil in pan, fry sliced mushrooms over medium heat until golden. Dredge fish fillets in flour and fry in egg for 2 - 3 minutes on each side. Serve with sauce.

title: Fava Bean, Zucchini and Fava Mash
ingredients: 3 zucchini | 200 g fresh fava beans
instructions: Cook the zucchini in boiling water for 7 minutes. Drain, peel and cut into slices. In a large mixing bowl, combine zucchini, fava beans, and salt to taste. Mix well. The mash should be thick and creamy. Serve warm or cold. Keep in the refridgerator for up to one week. Serve with crusty bread and fresh fruit.

title: Avocado & Peanut Spread
ingredients: 2 avocados, peeled, mashed & well drained | 3/4 cup canned black-eyed peas, rinsed and drained | 4 ounces peanut butter | 1 -2 teaspoon jam, any flavour
instructions: Put the ingredients in a food processor and blend until smooth.

title: Spicy Chillies &  Bread
ingredients: 12 big red chilies | 3 dozen small green chilies ( not hot! ) | 6 slices white bread

title: Carnitas Con Carne (Mexican Fried Beans)

title: Red Snapper With Prawns, Turnips, and Scallops
ingredients: 1 lb red snapper fillet or 1 lb orange roughy fillet | 1 lb prawns or 1 lb orange roughy fillet | 1 lb prawns or 1 lb prawns or 1 lb scallops | 1/8 cup white wine vinegar | 5 -6 serrano peppers | 1/2 cup heavy cream | 1 lb dried pasta ( linguine, linguine, macaroni ) or 1 lb other type pasta ( linguine, linguine, linguine, macaroni )
instructions: Note that i use orange roughy, yellow roughy, and swiss chard for this recipe. However, the latter may be very hard. I also tend to use a different brand of seafood. First, prepare all your ingredients, except tomatoes, so that all you have to do is take your time on preparing the pasta. Cut your red snapper fillets into thick strips and set aside. Get your big wok, and heat it up to medium high or highest. Toss in your dry pasta in a large pile, making sure to shake out all excess. It should be a little dry with a few grains of rice on it. Now, put your snapper slices into the waiting wok and lightly brown on both sides. Don't worry if you don't get all pieces the same if you are working quickly enough, they will eventually come out a little bit flatter later. This isn't supposed to do, but i have found that once you have a few pieces of fish on the bottom of your wok, they won’t need to be exact, just make sure they are a bit thicker. You do not want to go for a complete layer, just not a total layer. While they begin to turn a little crispy, put in your red snapper strips, prawns or scallops, and red snapper strips, and prawn and scallops. Keep stirring at an angle, so that the strips don’t burn when combined. Add 3 tablespoons of white wine vinegar, 3 tablespoons of heavy cream, half of the chile peppers, and 3 tablespoons of minced garlic. Stir and bring all ingredients to a boil. Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for about 10 minutes, stirring occasionally. Turn off heat and stir in the tomatoes.. Cook pasta. Drain pasta.

title: Camarones a la Vizcaina

title: Lamb Shank Casserole

title: Easy Rice Pilaf

title: Poblano Strips and Hot Garlic Sauce

Transfer peppers to an ice cream maker and process until the strips are as thin as you can get them and about 1 tablespoon of oil is incorporated every minute or so. The sauce should be thin.

Random Ingredients: oyster sauce,poblano chile,apricot preserve,chicken bouillon granule,oregano,hot red chili pepper,baby artichoke
title: BBQ Chicken With Artichokes and Paprika
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless skinless chicken breasts, cut into 4 pieces | 1 can baby artichokes, rinsed and thinly sliced ( i use the larger baby artichoke slices and chop them up ) or ( 7 ounce ) can marinated artichokes, drained ( i use the larger baby artichoke slices and chop them up ) | 1/4 cup apricot preserves | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon granules | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano | 1 tablespoon oyster sauce | 1 -2 hot red chili pepper, deseeded and finely chopped | 1 fresh hot red chili pepper, seeds removed, finely chopped ( optional )
instructions: Mix all ingredients until mixed and place in large shallow dish. Cover with plastic wrap and leave to marinate in the fridge for 1 hour.
