Cook chicken on a hot bbq plate and brush with a little oil. Turn when cooked through. Serve with rice, beans or noodles. Optional. Paprika may be sprinkled over the top. Cooks note, for more seasoning, you may use cayenne and/or hot paprika instead of oregano and/or cayenne. Cooks note, if using chili peppers, you may use green chili instead of hot pepper.

Random Ingredients: mini marshmallow,flour tortilla,bread flour,basil,pineapple,tomato puree,pork baby back rib
title: Pork and Pineapple Fritters
ingredients: 1 teaspoon bread flour ( i use gluten-free bread flour ) | 1/2 cup pineapple, finely chopped ( i substitute fresh cilantro ) | 1/2 cup canned tomato puree ( i substitute 2 cups fresh, finely chopped canned tomatoes ) | 2 tablespoons basil | 4 small soft flour tortillas, torn into 1 1/2-inch pieces | 6 pieces pork baby back ribs ( about 1.5 oz each, 1/3 inch thick ) | 12 mini marshmallows
instructions: Heat a nonstick skillet over medium high heat for 1 minute. Stir in the bread flour and pineapple with tomato puree, basil and the torn tortillas. Stir to combine then add the ribs. Cook and stir until the pork is just cooked through, about 3 minutes. Remove pan from heat. Place 1 piece of the baby back rib on a plate, cover and set aside. Reheat the pan over medium high heat, then add 3 tbss. Of the reserved pan liquid. Stir to loosen the grits from the bottom of the pan. Add the marshmallows and cook and stir until fragrant and the marshmallows are fragrant, about 1 minute. Taste for seasoning, adding salt. Add the rest of the pork. Use a spatula to spread a few tbsps. Of sauce over each fritter. Serve immediately.

title: Linguini With Chocolate Candied Garlic & Coconut
ingredients: 1 package linguine, spaghetti | 1/4 - 1/2 cup sweetened coconut, toasted | 1/4 cup chocolate candy bar, chopped | garlic salt
instructions: Cook noodles according to directions. Remove from pan once pasta is finished cooking. Meanwhile, combine coconut, melted chocolate and garlic salt.

Random Ingredients: chocolate square,sharp cheddar cheese,prego pasta sauce,beef stock cube
title: French Onion Bake With Chocolate
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs lean stewing beef or 1 1/2 lbs veal, cut into 1 inch cubes | 3 large prego pasta sauce | 1 beef stock cube, crumbled | 1/4 cup grated sharp cheddar cheese
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f. Mix the sauce together, crumble the beef into one layer and pour onto a medium oven proof casserole dish, reserving 2/3 of the pan. Sprinkle the cheddar over the top of the beef and bake uncovered for 1 hour. Remove the casserole dish from the oven and raise the temperature for the remaining 2/3 of the baking dish to 425°f slice the onions thinly and arrange them onto the beef. Top with the cheesy cheddar and return to the oven for a further 20 minutes or until the cheese is melted and bubbling.

title: Thai Mustard With Kale
ingredients: 1 bunch kale, rinsed and torn into pieces or 2 bunches chard leaves | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds | 1 teaspoon ground turmeric
instructions: Place in a large bowl. Add mustard seeds and turmeric and cover tightly with plastic wrap. In a wok, add a little oil and add the mustard seeds. When they begin to pop, put in kale and cover tightly. The heat of your wok is very hot, this is when you can add the lid. Cook for 1 to 2 minutes or until the leaves just turn limp. Remove from wok and serve.

title: Pounded Beef
ingredients: 1 pound ground round | 1/4 cup coconut oil for frying
instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a skillet over medium low heat. Fry the beef until evenly browned, about 10 minutes. Remove beef and drain oil onto a plate. Stir the onions and coconut into the drippings in the skillet. Cook and stir until onions are translucent. Return shredded beef to the skillet and cook, stirring constantly, until thickened, 3 to 5 minutes.

title: Pimiento Focaccia
ingredients: 1 fresh yeast ( no substitute ) | 1/3 cup pimiento, chopped into small dice
instructions: Using 1 tablespoon of salt, dissolve the yeast in 1/3 cup of hot water. Dissolve the remaining liquid in a large bowl. Stir in the pimiento and stir to combine. Using lightly spry your fingers, work the mixture into a ball. If the dough becomes dry, add a little water. Dough should be wet but not sticky. Allow to rest a few minutes. Form into a round or oval and place in the oven for 15 - 20 minutes until lightly browned and set.

title: Easy French Onion Soup
ingredients: 2 tablespoons butter | 1 large head pancetta ( cured, not pancetta grease ) | 4 cans beef broth | 1 can tomato juice | 1/2 cup wine
instructions: Chop pancetta into cubes. Place butter and bacon in a large saucepan. Heat to medium, then add onions. Cook on medium, stirring occasionally throughout, until almost transparent and beginning to brown, about 30 minutes. Drain fat, then pour in beef broth, tomato juice, and wine. Bring to boil.

title: Healthy Cranberry Salad
ingredients: 1 bag shredded iceberg lettuce | 1 can almond milk | 1 can sweetened cranberry juice | 1/2 cup prepared and prepared dry sour mix
instructions: Place all ingredients into a large bowl. Shake well and refrigerate overnight with a slice of orange as a lid or just before serving.

Random Ingredients: cream chicken soup,cayenne,garlic red chile paste,papaya
title: Creamy Papaya (Creamy) Hot Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb papaya, peeled and diced | 3 cans cream of chicken soup | 1 tablespoon garlic and red chile paste ( can add one more can ) | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon cayenne
instructions: Place papaya in a pot with enough water to cover completely. Bring to boil stirring a few times. Boil for 2 minutes, then remove pan to large bowl of cold water. Turn heat down so that it just barely boils off. Turn off heat and stir in soup. Place a tablespoon of chile paste in the base of a soup bowl. Dunk the papaya in water, one at a time, then dip the papaya in the paste, coating it well. If you want to use the sauce in another dish, place papaya in a covered bowl and toss with the sauce until coated, then place in fridge and let it rest for at least 30 minutes. Serve with rice.

Random Ingredients: hot red pepper,red bell pepper,orange zest,garam masala,fettuccine,horseradish,walnut,spinach
title: Spinach and Pepper Fettuccine
ingredients: 8 ounces fresh fettuccine | 1 lb fresh spinach, trimmed | 1/4 cup finely chopped red bell pepper | 1/4 cup chopped red bell pepper | 2 tablespoons prepared horseradish | 1 tablespoon grated orange zest | 2 teaspoons garam masala | 1/4 teaspoon dried hot red pepper
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. Meanwhile, cook spinach according to package directions, then rinse under warm water and drain well. Toss pasta with peppers, horseradish and orange zest. Sprinkle with garam masala and red pepper.

title: Black Beans and Spinach
ingredients: 1/4 teaspoon saffron strand | 1 can black beans | 1 tablespoon mustard powder | 3 spinach
instructions: Drain and rinse the saffron. Add in the chopped black beans and saffron. Add mustard and chopped spinach leaves. Add salt and pepper if required. Cover. Cook on the grill.

title: Anchovy Topped With Arugula
ingredients: 1/4 cup packed anchovy, drained | 1/4 cup fresh thyme sprig, leaves plus | 1/2 teaspoon thyme leaves, about 1 ounce
instructions: In a small bowl, using a mortar and pestle, mash anchovies, thyme and pepper.

title: Quick Beef Roulades
ingredients: 12 beef bouillon cubes | 1 cup vodka | 1 bag graham cracker crumbs
instructions: In a deep fryer or saucer, combine bouillon cubes and vodka. Let sit 5 minutes. Dip beef roulades in the vodka mixture, coating well. Dredge in graham cracker crumbs. Fry in oil or bbq, turning occasionally, until golden, about 15 minutes.

title: Bread Crusted Potato Wedges
ingredients: 400 g potatoes, cut into wedges | 1/2 cup herb, any kind, chopped | 1/4 cup white flour | herbs, of your choice ( garlic, onion, capsicum, herbs, oregano ) or cilantro, to garnish
instructions: Place all your ingredients in a large bowl. Toss the wedges gently to combine, then cover and leave to marinate for 20 minutes 30 minutes. Preheat the oven to 200c or 400°f. Bake for 45 - 50 mins until golden on top and crisp.

Random Ingredients: salad green,meatball,green curry paste,jalapeno pepper,french onion soup
title: Tasty Thai Meatballs
ingredients: 1 can french onion soup | 1 package frozen prepared meatballs, thawed | 12 thin jalapeno peppers | 1 tablespoon green curry paste | 4 cups mixed salad greens
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Arrange frozen meatballs in layers on a large baking dish. Bake in the preheated oven until browned, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven, and cool. Cut meatballs in half, and set aside. In a medium bowl combine the french onion soup, thawed meatballs, jalapenos, green curry paste, and mixed salad greens. Mix well, and place mixture in a 2 1/2 quart baking dish. Add enough additional water to the baking dish to cover the meatballs.

title: Sesame Roulades (Egypt)
ingredients: 1 cup all-purpose flour | 1 cup biscuit mix | 1/4 teaspoon mace | 2 tablespoons olive, sliced | 2 tablespoons sesame seeds
instructions: In a large bowl, stir together flour and biscuit mix. Stir in mace. Stir in olive slices and sesame seeds. Cover bowl with plastic wrap, and refrigerate for several hours, or overnight. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Roll dough out onto a floured working surface. Cut into 4 equal pieces, and press into ramekins. Bake in a preheated oven until light brown, about 20 minutes. Cool on a wire rack.

title: Banana Cheese Appetizers (Vinaigrette)
ingredients: 1 small banana pepper, sliced | 1/4 cup mayonnaise
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a glass bowl. Enjoy.

title: Apple Nests
ingredients: 4 apples | 14 ounces tortilla chips
instructions: Put chips on a cold plate and cover with foil. Microwave on high for 1 minute.

title: Cheese Flavoured Dashi Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups dashi stock | 1 ounce dark chocolate | 1 tablespoon miracle whip | 2 teaspoons cumin seeds | 2 tablespoons sour cream
instructions: Put the stock and chocolate in a saucepan. Cover the pan and set over a medium heat. Cook for 5 minutes, stirring often, then reduce the heat to low and stir in the other ingredients. Remove from the heat and stir until smooth, then return to the heat. Whisk in the sour cream just before serving.

Random Ingredients: semolina flour,sharp cheddar cheese,canola oil,cardamom pod,cayenne pepper
title: Cheese Puffs
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups semolina flour | 1 cup grated sharp cheddar cheese | 2 tablespoons canola oil | 1/8 teaspoon cardamom pod | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit. Mix the semolina, grated cheese, oil, cardamom, and cayenne pepper together in a bowl, and roll the mixture into walnut sized balls. Place balls on a parchment lined baking sheet and bake on the middle shelf of the oven until they are golden brown, about 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: baking cocoa,rosemary,grain rice,monterey jack cheese,ginger ale,butter
title: Rosemary Baked Rice
ingredients: 1 cup long grain rice | 2 1/2 cups ginger ale | 12 tablespoons butter | 1/2 cup baking cocoa | 2 cups monterey jack cheese, shredded | 1 tablespoon rosemary
instructions: Preheat oven to in a large baking dish, combine the rice, ginger ale and 1 t butter. In oven, melt the remaining 1 t butter. Spoon in the rice mixture and stir till liquid is absorbed. Spoon rice into a casserole coated with cooking spray. Spoon half the cheese on top. Cover with remaining cheese and bake for 40 minutes.

Random Ingredients: triple sec,kaffir lime leaf,arborio rice,tomato green chile pepper,brie cheese,pasta,half
title: Rice and Avgolemono
ingredients: 2 cups arborio rice | 2 cups half-and-half | 2 pounds brie cheese | 2 chopped tomatoes with green chile peppers | 1 jar diced tomatoes with red pepper | 2 kaffir lime leaves | 2 tablespoons triple sec
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, stir in the Arborio, and return to a boil. Cook the rice uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the rice has cooked through, but is still firm to the bite, about 20 minutes. Drain well in a colander set in the sink, squeezing out excess water. Return the cooked rice to the hot pot. Toss in the half and half, brie cheese, chopped tomatoes with green chile peppers, diced tomatoes with red pepper, and kaffir lime leaves. Season with triple sec and stir. Serve topped with a drizzle of olive oil.

Random Ingredients: red chili pepper,dill seed,cashew,jalapeno pepper,macaroni,scallion,spring onion
title: Macaroni in Chilli
ingredients: 1 cup macaroni | 3 spring onions, finely chopped | 2 -4 drops red chili pepper, chopped ( or a teaspoon of chilli powder ) | 3 -4 tablespoons cashews, finely finely chopped | 4 tablespoons spring onions, finely chopped | 1 jalapeno pepper, chopped coarsley | 3 -4 tablespoons cilantro, finely chopped | 1 -2 teaspoon dill seed, crushed
instructions: Boil macaroni until dente. Drain. Fry spring onions in oil. Add chilli. Fry cashews. Add spring onions and mix together. Add macaroni and seasonings and stir. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: white rice,plain flour,poblano chile,anaheim chili,leafy green,avocado
title: Aussie Sausage & Pepper Flatbread
ingredients: 6 poblano chiles | 3 anaheim chili, sliced | 6 leafy greens | 6 tablespoons plain flour | 2 large avocados, peeled, pitted and sliced | 1 cup white rice, cooked
instructions: Remove the seeds from the poblano peppers then split them length ways into halves. Cut the chilies lengthways into 1/4 inch pieces. Cut the anaheim chillies in half horizontally then split the halves length ways into 4 equal pieces. Cut the greens into 1/4 inch slices. Place the flour in a bowl and stir in a little of the water from the chilies. Dredge the vegetables and flour in the seasoned flour then shake off any excess. Heat a non stick frying pan/skillet over medium to medium high heat. Add the poblanos and cook, stirring with tongs, until the skins begin to blister, about 1 minute. Transfer to a plate lined with a paper towel. Leave to cool slightly then remove all the skins. Place the flour mixture on a plate to cool slightly. Add the avocados to the pan. Dip each one of the poblanos into the batter then coat in the flour. Heat the pan for the final 2 minutes. Cook 3 - 4 minutes or until the tops of the poblanos have blackened. Remove from the pan. Serve the sausages over the cooked rice then sprinkle with the chiles and greens.

Random Ingredients: corn oil,greek yogurt,coriander,extra virgin olive oil,garlic
title: Garlic Yogurt Sauce
ingredients: 8 ounces plain greek yogurt | 1/2 cup grated garlic | 1/2 cup corn oil | 1/2 cup fresh coriander | 3 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Put all ingredients in a food processor and process into a paste. Use as a dipping sauce or spread on bread.

title: Broccoli, Clam and Provolone Spread
ingredients: 4 cups coarsely chopped fresh broccoli | 1 can chopped clams with juice | 1 cup cubed provolone cheese
instructions: In a medium bowl combine the broccoli and clam juice, stirring to coat. Place the provolone block in a microwave safe dish. Place the broccoli mixture in the cheese in a layer over it. Cover with plastic wrap and microwave on high 30 seconds. Remove plastic wrap and microwave on high 5 minutes or until heated through. Stir and serve.

Random Ingredients: soy sauce,red wine,peanut oil vegetable,garam masala,pepper,tart apple,coconut
title: Quick and Easy Fried Apples
ingredients: 10 -12 medium firm but firm tart apples | 1 tablespoon peanut oil or 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 1 teaspoon garlic, minced | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala, spice ( more if desired ) | 1/4 cup sweet red wine ( such as sherry, chardonnay or gewurztraminer ) | 4 teaspoons soy sauce | pepper, to taste
instructions: Peel, core and cut apples into wedges or strips. Heat oil in wok or deep fryer over high heat. Add apples and stir fry until they are crisp tender, about 3 - 4 minutes. Remove apples and set aside in a serving dish. Heat a drizzle of oil over high heat. Add garlic and garam masala. Stir fry 5 seconds. Add wine, stirring to coat apple,. When wine is evaporated, add apples and soy sauce. Stir fry 2 minutes. Add pepper. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: lemon lime beverage,vanilla bean,almond,pimento,cherry,onion salt,vanilla,sun tomato oil
title: Cherry Bombs
ingredients: 1/2 cup cherry, cut in half | 1/2 cup fresh orange juice or 1/2 cup lemon-lime beverage | 1 teaspoon lemon-lime flavored carbonation or 1 teaspoon vanilla | 1/4 teaspoon onion salt | 1/8 teaspoon vanilla bean | 4 sliced almonds, toasted ( optional ) | 1 ripe pimento, chopped ( optional ) | 8 strips fresh vanilla, cut in strips ( optional )
instructions: Place cherries, orange juice, lemon lime beverage, spices, and almonds in a small jar with a tight fitting lid. Shake until well dissolved. Spoon into mini ice pop molds. Makes 24 balls or 25 cherry Bombs.

title: Peach, Peach and Rice Vinegar Salad With Sweet Pepper Dressing
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs fresh ripe peaches | 1 1/2 lbs cold-pressed rice vinegar
instructions: Peel the peaches and cut into halves. Cut them into bite size pieces. Place the pear pieces into a clean, covered salad bowl. Add the rice vinegar and gently toss to coat. Refrigerate for four hours before serving.

title: Couscous with Sage and Gorgonzola
ingredients: 2 chicken breast halves, sliced into thin strips | 2 pieces gorgonzola, cut into thin strips or rectangles | 1 -2 fresh sage leaf, chopped | 1 -2 fresh mango, cut into strips | 1/2 teaspoon cracked black peppercorns, to taste | 1 -2 tablespoon drambuie
instructions: In a large skillet, fry the chicken strips until they are completely sealed. Remove them from the skillet and put aside. Into the same skillet, add the sage and cook over high heat for a few seconds. Then add the mango and peppercorns and toss around a bit until they turn a little pink and start to soften. Add the chicken back to the skillet, along with the drambuie and toss through the mixture. Serve immediately, hot, and not too cold.

Random Ingredients: kirsch,bean sprout,kaffir lime leaf,liquid smoke,yellow squash
title: Candied Zucchini, Kiefer Lime and Fresh Vegetables
ingredients: 2 large yellow squash, cut into 1-inch cubes | 8 ounces fresh bean sprouts | 2 kaffir lime leaves | 3 tablespoons kirsch | 1 tablespoon liquid smoke
instructions: Place the squash and the bean sprouts into a large pot with just enough water to cover. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat to medium low, cover, and simmer until the vegetables are tender, about 15 to 20 minutes. Transfer to a resealable plastic bag. Trim the stem and remove the leaves and coarse fibers from the kiefer lime leaves. Remove 1 inch of the kiefer lime leaves, then finely chop them. Place the cooked vegetables and remaining kiefer lime leaves into the skillet with the squash mixture. Pour in the kirsch and liquid smoke, then gently stir to mix. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: gelatin,sloe gin,soy sauce,extra virgin olive oil
title: Cape Jack
ingredients: 1 tablespoon unflavored gelatin | 2 tablespoons low sodium soy sauce | 6 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | sloe flavored gin ( jack daniels )
instructions: Coat a 9x13 inch baking dish with cooking spray and set aside. Sprinkle gelatin over 1 tbs. Of hot soapy water in saucepan and set aside until gelatin is softened, about 4 minutes. Heat remaining 2 tbs. Oil in a small saucepan over medium low heat and sprinkle gelatin over hot water. Cook, stirring constantly until gelatin dissolves completely, about 1 minute. Add soy sauce and remove from heat. Allow to cool slightly. Stir gelatin mixture into cooled gelatin mixture and set aside for about 10 minutes. Pour gelatin mixture into prepared baking dish. Refrigerate until set, at least 8 hours. When ready to serve, garnish with sloe flavored gin.

Random Ingredients: egg yolk,rice vinegar,chickpea,black tea,tabasco sauce,cod fish fillet,bamboo shoot
title: Chili Pepper Jelly Cod
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 lbs cod fish fillets, cut into 2 inch wide strips | 2 1/2 cups canned chickpeas, drained | 1/3 cup bamboo shoot, thawed and sliced | 6 eggs yolks | 3 tablespoons rice vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon tabasco sauce | 2 cups strong black tea
instructions: Marinate the prepared cod in the black pepper jelly overnight. The jelly baste can also be mixed in a small saucepan and heated over low heat, stirring for 3 minutes or until hot and bubbly. Remove the cod from the marinade and dry with paper towels. Place the meat and the marinade, drained chickpeas, bamboo shoots, and eggs yolks in a large heavy saucepan. Cook and stir over moderate heat for 7 - 8 minutes, or until very thick. Lower the heat, add the black pepper jelly, and cook, stirring for 1 minute. Pour in the vinegar and tabasco. Cover and cook over low heat for 5 minutes, or until the sauce coats the back of a spoon. Let cool. When the sauce is cooled, transfer to jars, filling to within 1/2 inch of the top. Place in the refrigerator for at least one week and up to 1 day for flavor enhancement. Refrigerate unused portions until storage. Note, add hot pepper jelly for a twist for those that do not like spicy food.

Random Ingredients: cherry,salmon fillet,cooking tapioca,onion soup mix,kosher salt,breadcrumb,green chili pepper,okra
title: Baked Okra
ingredients: 2 packages frozen okra, chopped ( about 2 lbs ) | 2 packages dry onion soup mix | 10 1/2 ounces cherry tomatoes, cut in half | 1 green chili pepper, seeded and chopped | 1 teaspoon kosher salt | 2 tablespoons quick-cooking tapioca | 1/8 cup dry breadcrumbs | 1 ounce quick-cooking tapioca
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f cook okra, onion soup mix, cherry tomatoes, and green chili in a 10 inch oven proof skillet with a lid, stirring occasionally, until tomatoes are softened and okra is browned, about 15 minutes. Stir in salt, tomato mixture, 1 1/2 t. Paprika, and tapioca and return skillet to oven. Bake, uncovered, until okra is warmed through and topping is golden, about 25 minutes total.

Random Ingredients: turmeric powder,pecorino romano cheese,liquid smoke,toothpick,beer,fenugreek leaf
title: Beer Battered Cheese
ingredients: 1 tablespoon instant coffee granules or 1 tablespoon liquid smoke | 1 tablespoon dried grated pecorino romano cheese | 1/2 teaspoon ground fenugreek leaves | 1/8 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1/8 teaspoon liquid smoke | 8 toothpicks | 1 cup carbonated beer, such as budweiser ( about 9 oz. per cup )
instructions: Place a clean cloth towel over the base of a glass baking dish, and sprinkle the dry cheese evenly over the towel. Let drain for 3 minutes. Gather the corners of the towel and squeeze out excess moisture with your fingers. Sprinkle cheese all over the top. Dissolve the instant coffee and liquid smoke in a small bowl, pour over the cheese, and sprinkle with the fenugreek flakes, turmeric powder, and liquid smoke. Cover and refrigerate for 4 to 6 hours. Remove the cheese and oil from the refrigerator, and use a sharp knife to slice the cheese into 8 slices. Spread 1/4 cup soda on a dinner plate, and place each slice on top. Garnish each with 2 teaspoons of your favourite black grape juice. Serve at once.

title: Homemade Sausage
ingredients: 1 cup dark molasses | 1/2 pound bulk pork sausage | 3 large fruit, cut into sections, pulp reserved
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a large saucepan combine the molasses, pork sausage, fruit and reserved pulp and place the mixture over high heat. Bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer, uncovered, until heated through about 15 minutes. Remove mixture from heat and let cool to room temperature.

title: Linguine in Prosciutto Di Maiale
ingredients: 12 ounces linguine | 3 slices prosciutto
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Bring a large pot of salted water to boil. Cook pasta in boiling water until al dente, 8 to 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: farfalle pasta,cottage cheese,plain nonfat yogurt,cumin,half cream,pepper,caster sugar,peach
title: Peach Pasta With Peach Cream Dip
ingredients: 4 medium peaches, peeled and thinly sliced | 300 ml reduced-fat cottage cheese | 1 tablespoon caster sugar | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 300 ml half-and-half cream | 150 g chopped peaches | 500 g bow shaped farfalle pasta or 500 g penne pasta | fresh ground pepper | 2 tablespoons plain nonfat yogurt
instructions: Preheat oven to 350f degrees. Place the peaches in a heat proof bowl and pour boiling water over, then allow to stand for 5 minutes until softened. Using a slotted spoon remove the peaches and set aside. Bring a large pan of lightly salted water to the boil. Place the cottage cheese in a food processor and process until smooth. Add the caster sugar and cumin and process to combine. Using a medium size spoon, stir in the cream until combined. In a large pan, cook the pasta following the packet instructions. Drain and allow to cool. Stir in the peaches, cottage cheese mixture and season with freshly ground black pepper. Transfer to a baking dish and top with half the yogurt. Bake for 10 - 15 minutes, until golden and bubbling and the cottage cheese dip is bubbling around the edges.

Random Ingredients: strawberry,bread flour,serrano chile pepper,dark red kidney bean,filet beef,espresso,anchovy,pepperoni
title: Beef Steak and Chile Pepper Bread
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds filet of beef, sliced 1/4 inch thick | 2 cans dark red kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 2 serrano chile peppers, seeded and minced | 2 packages fresh bread flour | 1/2 cup thinly sliced pepperoni | 1 can anchovies | 2 packages fresh strawberries, with stems | 1 can espresso
instructions: Place beef slices between layers of plastic wrap and pound lightly with a meat mallet to 1/4 inch thick. Arrange beef on a plate and cover with plastic wrap. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a small bowl, stir together the kidney beans, chile peppers, and bread flour. Place beef slices in a baking dish. Top with pepperoni, anchovies, and strawberries. Use toothpicks to hold the toothpicks in place. Bake in preheated oven for 25 minutes, or until bread is golden brown and beef is cooked. An instant read thermometer inserted into the center should read 140 degrees f and the internal temperature of the steak should be 125 degrees f. Remove from oven. Top each slice of beef with one slice of bread, if using, and serve with warm espresso.

Random Ingredients: sofrito,quaker square brown sugar cereal,vanilla bean,spinach leaf,chicken breast
title: Spinach and Chicken
ingredients: 1 chicken breast, cut into strips or 4 -6 pieces per serving ( optional ) | 4 -6 tablespoons sofrito or 4 -6 tablespoons other sauted light colored soybeans powder | 1 box quaker square browns sugar cookies | 1 package spinach leaves | 1 box vanilla bean
instructions: Cook the sofrito on low for 5 minutes. Add chicken.

title: Crazy French Canadian Cheese
ingredients: 1 can dark beer | 1 jar maraschino cherries
instructions: In a casserole dish place the beer, cherries, and the crushed jar of maraschino cherries or whatever extras you like at first. Heat under broiler until bubbly around the edges.

title: Champagne Chilli
ingredients: 10 red chili peppers | 1 tablespoon cornflour | 2 ounces champagne
instructions: Skin and deseed the chilis. Add 2oz of the cornflour to half a pint of cold water and whisk in the chilli stalks, adding another 1oz and half or the champagne, stirring until the chilli is well coated with the cornflour. Add the chilli mixture to the rest of the cold water, stir to blend and set aside to cool down, then stir in the rest of the mixture. Heat up over a gas flame and pour into sterilized, hot glasses.

title: Hodaabasa (Fish in Sweet Wine)
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs fish, whole ( cod, haddock, or salmon, depending on what you prefer ) | 1 inch ginger paste | 1/4 lb pineapple chunk
instructions: In large pot combine fish, ginger, and pineapple. Add water to cover. Bring to simmer. Simmer 30 minutes. Remove ginger and pineapple.

title: Cabbage, Pea pods, and Pork Casserole
ingredients: 12 ounces ground pork, at room temperature | 3 ounces split pea pods | 3 ounces dried pea pods | 13 -14 fresh sage leaves, plus | 3 -4 fresh sage leaves, for garnish | 1/2 cup finely chopped serrano pepper, such as jalapeno
instructions: Spray a baking dish with oil. Combine the pork, split pea pods, split pea pods, dried pea pods, and 1/2 the sage leaves in a large bowl. Add water to cover the pork by 1½ inches. Press the pea pods tightly to reshape the pea pods and discard the remaining leaves and sage. Preheat the oven to 300of. Line the bottom of the baking dish with the remaining 1½ sage leaves and a few sage leaves. Spread the pork mixture evenly in the baking dish. Cut the reserved sage leaves into thin strips, then cut crosswise into thin strips. Arrange the strips over the pork mixture in the dish. Dot with butter and bake, uncovered, until it begins to brown, about 1½ hours. Remove the pan from the oven and let stand for 10 minutes. Sprinkle with a little more sage and remaining sage. Cover the casserole and return to the oven for about 45 minutes longer, or until the pork is cooked through and the peas are tender.

Random Ingredients: bailey irish cream,lime,tomato green chilies,shrimp,guacamole,lemon,rye bread,pastry
title: Dirty Shrimp Stuffed French Bread
ingredients: 1 recipe pastry for a 9 inch double crust pie | 12 large cooked shrimp, shelled and deveined | 1 can tomato and green chilies, pureed in blender with pureed tomatoes ( rotel-your choice ) | 1 1/2 cups baileys irish cream | lime ( to garnish ) | 3/4 cup guacamole | 16 slices ritz rye bread | lemon slice ( to garnish ) | cooked guacamole ( to garnish )
instructions: To make sauce, puree all ingredients in blender and strain thru cheese cloth.. Slice bread to size of pastry. Fill each bread with shrimp, tomato, chili, guacamole and cheese. Grill on an oiled grill directly over high heat for 3 to 5 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Artichoke & Oranges
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs artichoke hearts, cut in half | 4 1/2 lbs mixed vegetables | 1 tablespoon orange blossom water
instructions: Bake artichokes as directed. Serve in deep bowls, drizzled with orange blossom water.

title: Spicy Tarragon Eggs
ingredients: 1 lb egg substitute | 1 tablespoon dried tarragon | 1 teaspoon dried parsley | 1/2 teaspoon garlic granules | 1/4 teaspoon mixed spice | crushed mixed green peppercorns
instructions: Whisk together all ingredients in a small bowl. Spoon mixture into a covered container and refrigerate, covered, for 6 hours or longer. Break eggs at regular intervals. Sprinkle with crackers and serve.

Random Ingredients: white bread,extra virgin olive oil,red cabbage
title: Pierogi (Colour Gobbler)
ingredients: 4 teaspoons extra virgin olive oil | 1/2 lb red cabbage, finely shredded | 2 slices white bread, crusts removed
instructions: Heat oil in pan on medium heat. Add cabbage, browning lightly. Add bread, cook until crusty. Turn over, sprinkle with freshly ground salt. Turn bread over again. Cook until bottom is browned, about 2 minutes. Serve hot or warm as an option to use while you are eating.

title: Mango and Sweet Potato Stuffed Rani
ingredients: 1 large baking potato | 1 mango | 2 cups grated jasmine rice or 2 cups regular long grain rice
instructions: Bake potato and mango, in a pan of boiling water, for 1 hour. Drain, peel, cut in large cubes, and mash with fork. Stir rice into potato mixture. Bake in 350°f oven for 1 minutes or until rice is tender and mixture begins to brown, stirring to make sure rice sticks to sides and bottom. Remove from oven and top with mango slices. Drizzle rice with a little more jasmine jasmine juice or other spicy dressing you like.

title: Cacio E Pepe
ingredients: 20 -25 ounces ground patty with pectin | 3 tablespoons palm sugar | 1 - 1 1/2 cup grated pecorino cheese ( or pecorino grated parmesan ) | 5 -10 drops tabasco sauce ( e.g. peri peri peri )
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine the patty, palm sugar, and pecorino cheese. Add the tabasco sauce. Mix well. Form into a ball. Refrigerate 1 to 2 hours before serving.

Random Ingredients: almond extract,white wine vinegar,baking apple,ha avocado,cumin,beef steak
title: Apple Beef Roll With Avocado
ingredients: 2 large baking apples | 14 ounces beef steaks, trimmed | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract | 1/2 cup white wine vinegar | 1 small hass avocado, halved, peeled, seeded, and cut into 1/2 inch slices
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Core and thinly slice apples, and toss with beef. Stir in cumin and almond extract. In small saucepan over medium heat, combine vinegars and half of liquid. Bring to a boil and cook until reduced by half. Pour half over beef mixture. Arrange apple slices around top, and roll up. In a small baking dish, drizzle with reserved vinegar mixture. Bake until beef is cooked to desired tenderness, 20 minutes. Let rest about 10 minutes before serving, cutting into 1 inch slices. Dunk into avocado slices.

title: Fennel Seeds Sour Cream
ingredients: 1/2 cup sour cream | 2 teaspoons fennel seeds
instructions: In a small bowl, combine 1/2 cup sour cream and fennel seeds. Cover and refrigerate for 8 hours or overnight. Bring mixture to room temperature before serving.

title: Tikka's Foolproof Rich & Creamy Yoghurt Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup soymilk | 1 small red onion
instructions: Put yoghurt into a blender & add onions & milk. Start to mix until smooth.

title: Bucatini Amatraciana
ingredients: 2 large bucatini pasta | 10 ounces fat-free refried beans, heated | 2 teaspoons pure vanilla extract
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add bucatini pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

Random Ingredients: parsnip,garlic clove,belgian endive,yellow pepper,currant,lime juice zest,jalapeno pepper
title: Jalapeno & Parsnip Tapas With a Kick
ingredients: 2 cups parsnips ( about 4 medium ) | 2 cups belgian endive ( about 2 medium ) | 2 large yellow peppers ( about 1 medium ) | 8 large garlic cloves | lime juice, zest of | 1 fresh jalapeno pepper | 1 teaspoon currants
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Wash and dry parsnips. Cut in half lengthwise and crosswise. Using hands, remove and discard seeds and tough outer leaves. Cut endive in half crosswise. Cut endive into 1/4 inch slices. Using the sharp serrated knife, cut 2 slits in end of each slice. Using the knife, scrape the seeds from the pepper slices into small bowl. Set aside. Toast sliced green pithoms, about 1 minute and then rinse under cold water. Pat dry with paper towels. Cut green peppers into 1/4 inch pieces and slice yellow peppers. Cut endives crosswise into 1/4 inch slices. Cut garlic cloves crosswise into thin slices, removing soft center stem and leaving white bulb intact.. Place garlic, lime zest, jalapeño and currants in food processor. Puree until almost smooth and thick texture. Toss everything together with parsnips and vegetables in large bowl for at least 5 minutes. Serve with a bit of tabasco sauce on the side.

title: Noodles With Eggs
ingredients: 8 ounces dried chinese egg noodles | 2 1/2 cups whipping cream
instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions.

Random Ingredients: red chilies,bean sprout,hot sauce,yellow pepper,berry,hard egg,swiss cheese
title: Egg Foo Yong Salad
ingredients: 6 hard-boiled eggs, peeled | 1 medium yellow pepper, thinly sliced | 1 small swiss cheese, shredded | 1 can fat-free refried beans with chili | 1/2 cup fresh mixed sprouts | 1 small fresh red chilies or 1 small green chili, seeded and sliced ( optional ) | hot sauce, to taste
instructions: Cut the eggs in half lengthwise and place cut side down on a baking tray. Bake in a preheated oven for 7 - 8 minutes or until eggs are barely set. Remove and allow to cool. Meanwhile, place the yellow pepper in a mixing bowl. Arrange the egg halves on the pepper in a spoke fashion and top with the cheese. Drain the chili and stack it with the bean sprouts, chilies, and green chilies. Drizzle with a thin layer of hot sauce and top with the egg.

Random Ingredients: cardamom seed,lima bean,vegetable oil,celery seed,pork tenderloin,maple syrup
title: Crispy Maple Glazed Pork Tenderloin
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1 teaspoon cardamom seed | 1 teaspoon celery seed | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom seed | 1 can lima beans, drained and rinsed | 1/2 cup maple syrup | 1 pork tenderloin, filet | 3/4 cup maple syrup
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a skillet over medium high heat until hot. Brown the pork on all sides. Place the browned pork in a baking dish. Heat remaining oil in the skillet over medium heat and stir in the cardamom, celery seed and cardamom. Cook and stir until fragrant, about 1 minute. Pour the sauteed flavored maple syrup over the pork. Bake at 350 degrees f for 35 to 40 minutes or until a meat thermometer registers 145 degrees f, basting with syrup occasionally.

Random Ingredients: white miso,no boil lasagna noodle,cranberry,veal shank,shrimp,sesame oil,walnut oil
title: Cran-Shrimp Lasagna
ingredients: 1 -2 cup shrimp, cooked | 2 -3 cups fresh cranberries, cleaned & picked as desired | 24 no-boil lasagna noodles | veal shanks or other shortening | 2 cups white miso, can use low sodium variety ( or gluten-free `` regular '' ) | 4 tablespoons toasted sesame oil | 1/4 cup walnut oil ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Cut or dice the meat into very small chunks and set aside. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add pasta & shrimp and cook until just done. Remove pasta and shrimp with a slotted spoon, reserving 4 cup of the pasta cooking liquid. Drain pasta if pasta is not ready, then rinse the pasta under cool water, drain & return to the pot with the shrimp.. While tossing pasta with the shrimp and adding the melted shortening, spread a thin layer of the miso on a 13 x 9 backing dish or lasagna sheet. Cover with sliced vegetables. Place a few shrimp on top of the miso, then add 2 more tablespoons miso on top of this, continuing to layer. Top with 2 more sheets of nori, covering the shrimp & veggies in a thin layer. Spread the remaining 3 tablespoons miso on top of this, again covering the shrimp & vegetables in a thin layer. Cover with another 2 more sheets of nori, covering the shrimp & vegetables in a thin layer. Top with the final 3 sheets of nori, covering everything in a thin layer. Top with the remaining 2 tablespoons of miso & a drizzle of sesame oil. Bake 1 hour, or until golden brown.

title: Mexican-Style Brussels Sprouts
ingredients: 1 tablespoon baking cocoa | 1/2 teaspoon chili powder | 1 lb fresh brussels sprout, trimmed
instructions: Preheat oven to 325^f. Spray baking sheets with vegetable oil spray or lightly with nonstick spray. Place the baking sheet in the oven while the oven preheats. In a small bowl, mix the cocoa, and chili powder until well blended. Place the sprouts in a large bowl, and toss with the cocoa mixture. Sprinkle with more chili powder if desired. When the oven is very hot, place the sprouts on the prepared baking sheet. Put the baking sheet in the center of the oven, and bake for 45 minutes, tossing once, until the sprouts are brown and crispy on the edges and still firm in the center.

title: Kathy's Grilled Lemon and Molasses Dipping Sauces - Just Like Mama Used to Make
ingredients: 2 lemons | 1 cup margarita mix | 2 cups dry bread crumbs | 1 cup unsulphured molasses
instructions: Juice 1 of the lemons.

Random Ingredients: red potato,chuck steak,peach preserve,corn kernel,tarragon,extra virgin olive oil,mustard powder,graham cracker crust
title: Savory Steak and Potato Pie
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs chuck steaks | 4 unbaked graham cracker crusts, keebler suggested, but i use mama mary's, but i don't | 1 teaspoon mustard powder | 1/4 cup peach preserves | 1 tablespoon tarragon | 3/4 cup frozen whole corn kernels | 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil | 1/4 cup canned red potatoes, drained
instructions: Heat oven to 350 degrees. Cut steak across grain into thin, bite sized pieces. Mix mustard powder with preserves, tarragon, corn kernels and olive oil in a medium bowl. Add steak to coat lightly. Transfer steak to a large casserole dish coated with nonstick cooking spray. Cover with crusts, pressing well to adhere. Pour peaches into crust, then top with potatoes, then drizzle top with remaining olive oil. Seal with foil, then put in the oven. Bake for 45 minutes, then remove foil and top with sour cream, if desired.

title: Swiss Hot Brown (Oamc)
ingredients: 2 cups shredded swiss cheese | 1 can condensed tomato soup ( i use hunts one )
instructions: Spray crockpot with vegetable cooking spray. Combine all ingredients in crockpot and cook on low for 10 to 12 hours.

title: Mexican Vermicelli With Beans and Onions
ingredients: 1 can pinto beans ( not kidney beans ) | 1/2 medium onion ( chopped ) | 3 tablespoons mixed herbs | 1 tablespoon dark brown sugar | 1 tablespoon onion powder
instructions: Chop the onion and set aside. Wash and rinse pinto beans in a large pot and add enough water to cover by 1/4 and allow to soak overnight. Drain the beans and set aside. Pour water to cover the beans and bring to a boil. Add chopped onion and stir well. Reduce heat and simmer for 45 minutes or until the onions are soft, stirring a few times at first and adding more water as needed to cover.. Remove from heat and stir in the dark brown sugar and onion powder. Cover and store in the fridge until ready to eat it's ready to be eaten.

title: Portobello
ingredients: 6 cups pasta sauce | 1 pound thin, boneless rump roast | 4 slices ham, chopped | 8 ounces queso fresco, crumbled | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 12 spears fresh asparagus
instructions: Place a large pot of water on to boil. Add the pasta sauce, and cook for 15 minutes. Place the rump roast into a large stock pot, and set aside. Stir ham, queso fresco, and vanilla extract into the pasta sauce until melted together. Place the asparagus into the stock pot, and cook just until tender, about 5 minutes. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: yellow bell pepper,taco sauce,flat leaf parsley,sunflower oil,cream mushroom soup,black bean,white onion,corn tortilla
title: Easy-To-Wash Fajitas
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 can black beans, drained and rinsed | 1 tablespoon sunflower oil | 1/2 white onion, diced small | 1 small yellow bell pepper, diced small | 2 tablespoons chopped flat leaf parsley | 8 corn tortillas, each cut into 6 wedges | 1/2 cup taco sauce, heated
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. In a medium bowl combine soup, beans, sunflower oil, onion and bell pepper. Brush tortillas with taco sauce and arrange on a baking rack. Bake until golden and crisp about 10 minutes, or according to package directions. Heat soup and spoon onto tortillas. Serve with sour cream and guacamole if desired.

title: Vegetable Borscht
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower, chopped | 1 whole yellow zucchini, sliced | 1/4 small head iceberg lettuce, chopped | 2 teaspoons ground cinnamon
instructions: Place cauliflower, zucchini, and lettuce in a large bowl. Season with cinnamon.

Random Ingredients: savoy cabbage,oil,worcestershire sauce,swiss cheese,head cauliflower,vanilla ice cream
title: Cauliflower and Swiss Cheese Pierogies
ingredients: 1 large head cauliflower, cleaned and chopped | 1 large head savoy cabbage, cleaned and chopped | 1/2 cup oil, divided | 1 lb swiss cheese, grated | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 8 ice cream
instructions: Saute cauliflower and savoy cabbage in 1/2 cup oil on medium heat for 12 minutes.

title: Mikki Naeng (Daikon Radish Ice Cream)
ingredients: 1 lb daikon radish | 3 cups double cream, whipped | 1/2 cup fine grated daikon radish, garnish
instructions: Clean daikon until it's soft to the touch and has no blemishes. Cut the end, then peel if you like, but don't peel it. Cut away the root and root ends of the daikon and, with the peel, cut off the very thin stem portion. Make the cream by mixing together the 1/2 cup of fine grated daikon with the 1/2 cup of fine grated daikon, and stir into the whipped cream. Pour into a container and chill in the freezer for at least half an hour before serving. Once it's been chilled, scoop out a scoop of ice cream and freeze it for a few hours. Transfer to an ice cream maker and either freeze immediately or leave in the freezer until cold for 4 to 6 hours. Remove from the freezer and then break into cubes or put into an ice cream maker according to manufacturer's directions. When the cubes are ready, pour the cream over them and mix gently.

title: Grilled Flank Steak Fajitas
ingredients: 1 beef top sirloin | 1 chipotle chile, coarsely chopped | 1 teaspoon dried ancho chile | 0.5 can refrigerated crescent rolls, unrollable | 2 ounces cherry rolls ( optional )
instructions: Season steak and grill over hot coals or medium high heat until medium rare, about 3 minutes per side. Transfer to cutting board and let stand about 10 minutes before slicing. Meanwhile, combine chile and ancho chile in processor or blender and pulse until coarsely chopped. Transfer chile mixture to small bowl and stir in chili mixture and meat. Reserve 1 tablespoon of marinade in pan. To prepare rolls, unroll dough and separate into eight triangles per tray. Using lightly moistened fingers, press a dough triangle onto tray and cover in a damp paper towel and let stand a minute so dough won't stick to dough and dry slightly. Arrange triangles on a plate and cover with towel and let stand for 15 to 30 minutes. Heat pan over medium high heat until hot. Lay flour tortillas on hot pan and shake to help tortillas spread, then quickly stack tortillas. Grill or broil fajita, flipping once, until golden brown and cooked through. Serve with guacamole, salsa or sour cream.

Random Ingredients: beer,szechwan pepper,fennel seed,olive oil cooking spray,cilantro leaf,shrimp paste,french baguette
title: Shrimp Fritters (Omac)
ingredients: 4 french baguettes, sliced 1/2-inch thick ( thin slices ) | 1 tablespoon ground peppercorn szechwan pepper, coarsely ground | 1 tablespoon minced cilantro leaves | 2 tablespoons olive oil or 2 tablespoons other neutral flavored cooking spray | 3/4 lb large raw shrimp paste, such as sambal oelek | 1 teaspoon fennel seed | 1/3 cup beer, any flavor
instructions: Set up a baking sheet that will hold all the shrimp, bread and spices in a single layer, and put it on top of the oven rack. Cook the shrimp in 1 tablespoon of olive oil or other neutral flavored cooking spray on the rack for 2 minutes or until they turn pink, turn over, and cook the other side for 30 seconds to 1 minute more. Remove shrimp from the oven and place on a baking sheet to keep warm. Meanwhile, in a mixing bowl, combine peppercorn, cilantro leaves and remaining olive oil. Season with salt and pepper and set aside. Toast the baguettes in the oven for about 4 minutes, turn and toast on top. Serve with shrimp mixture and extra cilantro.

Random Ingredients: picante sauce,aluminum foil,peanut oil,wide rice noodle,raisin,chicken thigh,fine breadcrumb
title: Baked Chicken and Noodle Skillet
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken thighs, flattened | 1 cup medium grain white rice noodles, uncooked | 1/2 cup raisins | 1/4 cup picante sauce | 1 tablespoon melted peanut oil | 4 sheets aluminum foil | fine breadcrumbs | minced peanuts
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Lightly spray a 12 inch ovenproof skillet with nonstick spray, with some of the oil. Place thighs in the skillet, and turn them in so they are evenly coated. Bake for 20 minutes, or until cooked through and lightly browned and juices run clear when thighs are pierced with a fork. While the chicken browns, bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add the rice noodles, and cook for 8 minutes, stirring occasionally. Drain. Place the sliced chicken into a small baking dish, and brush with some of the oil. Bake chicken for 13 minutes. Turn it over, then sprinkle with raisins and picante sauce. Bake for 10 minutes more, or until crisp and browned and juices run clear. Remove the chicken from the oven and pour off any accumulated juices. Remove chicken to a serving platter, top with crumbs, and drizzle with more of the oil and a handful of peanuts. Serve sauce drizzled over chicken.

title: Gordita - Zucchini Chips
ingredients: 2 medium zucchini, sliced | 1 tablespoon palm oil | 1 teaspoon sweet paprika | 1 teaspoon garlic salt
instructions: Spray non stick cooking spray on a plate. Combine sliced zucchini with ingredients in a bowl. Spread on a large microwave safe plate evenly. Microwave on high for 6 minutes, stir and microwave on medium low for another 6 minutes. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: yellow onion,iceberg lettuce,shiitake mushroom,garlic herb salad dressing mix
title: Mushroom Toss
ingredients: 3 large shiitake mushrooms | 1/2 white onion, diced small | 1 envelope garlic and herb salad dressing mix | 1 1/2 cups iceberg lettuce, shredded | 1/2 cup shaoxing wine or 1/2 cup green wine vinegar
instructions: Dice up your shiitake mushrooms very small. Mince onion. Set aside. In a medium bowl, mix the garlic and salad dressing mix. Toss the mushrooms with the dressing mix. Put the lettuce on the counter top. Take each shiitake mushroom and separate them, then place the shiitake mushrooms on the lettuce. Sprinkle the onion over the mushrooms. Mix in the shaoxing or green wine vinegar. Put in a large non metallic container and chill for at least 2 hours.

title: Portuguese Chicken Soup
ingredients: 1 box chicken bouillon | 4 2 cups arborio rice or 4 cups carnaroli rice
instructions: Heat chicken bouillon in 5 quart pot. Dissolve bouillon in hot broth. Add rice and bring to boil, stirring constantly. Reduce heat and simmer covered for 20 minute. Stir once after 20 minutes and add water from the pot. This will cause the rice to absorb some of the broth.

title: Real Easy Vanilla Sugar - Made Easy
ingredients: 2 cups breadcrumbs ( white or wheat ) | 1 vanilla bean
instructions: Make a long loaf, cut 2 1/2 inch lengths on the top of the vanilla bean. Carefully squeeze out seeds and save. Using a small ice cream scoop, scoop out the vanilla bean at the center. You can also take an 8 inch circle of bread, cut it into 8 - 10 slices, put the bread in a little bowl and, using clean hands, shape it as you want the bread crumbs to hold its shape. The easiest way to do this is to make a little hole in the bread crumbs using the point of a small finger. You may need to push the bread crumbs through a sieve. You will not be able to use the juice inside, but once all the bread crumbs come out, there will still be bread crumbs on there. Take out a strainer set over a bowl or bowl with a little bit of the vanilla bean juice. Drain the vanilla bean thoroughly, but save the juice from the vanilla bean whole it. Squeeze out the flavor of the vanilla bean. Place all of the bread crumbs in a large clean bowl and gradually pour in the reserved 1/2 cup of ice cream. Mix until well combined. Form the rest of the bread crumbs into balls about the size of a golf ball. Drop the crumbs into 2 cups of hot water and, with a slotted spoon or spatula, gently shake them so they sit flat. They should hold their shape, but if it doesn't, just pop the coated crumbs back into the boiling water. Cook the crumbs about 1 - 2 minutes or until the balls are a bit crispy and golden brown. Serve warm with vanilla ice cream and sweetened condensed milk.

Random Ingredients: pineapple chunk,brandy,kosher salt,celery rib,red chile powder,salad oil
title: American Kitchen Classic Basic Dressing Recipe
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 12 cups salad oil | 1 1/2 tablespoons ground red chile powder | 1 1/2 tablespoons smoked paprika or 1 1/2 tablespoons smoked paprika, for a milder taste ( i use pimento, spanish ) | 2 tablespoons brandy | 1 1/2 teaspoons kosher salt | 4 celery ribs, cut into 1-inch pieces
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the first eight ingredients. Mix well. Store tightly covered in the refrigerator.

title: Italian Beef With Red Balsamic Crostini
ingredients: 2 lbs baking potatoes, peeled and thinly sliced | 1 baguette or 1 baguette, sliced 1/4 inch thick | 5 tablespoons prepared yellow mustard | 3 tablespoons snipped fresh chives | 1 jar red alfredo sauce
instructions: Place potato slices on foil lined rimmed baking sheet and set aside. Cut each baguette slice in half lengthwise and place on baking sheet. Bake at 375°f for 20 minutes or until lightly toasted on the outside but firm to the touch. Remove baguettes slices to serving dish. Meanwhile, in a small bowl, stir together mustard and chives. In a small skillet, cook alfredo sauce over medium high heat. When heated through, stir hot alfredo, chives and potatoes into hot beef.

title: Fenugreek Soup
ingredients: 4 tablespoons ghee ( clarified butter ) | 7 vegetable bouillon cubes | 3 cups chicken broth | 1/2 teaspoon dried fenugreek leaves
instructions: Heat the ghee over low heat in a covered pot. When the ghee stops foaming, stir once or twice. Pour in the vegetable bouillon cubes. Stir over a low heat for 1 minute. Once the liquid is hot, stir in the water. The water should start to thicken. Stir well until the soup boils up, then reduce the heat to maintain a gentle simmer. Simmer soup for 20 minutes.

title: Steak and Fennel Rolls
ingredients: 6 tablespoons sherry | 2 teaspoons fennel bulbs, chopped | 4 teaspoons fruit or 4 teaspoons pineapple | 600 g rump steak, chopped | 4 sandwich buns, split
instructions: Combine sherry and fennel in microwave safe bowl. Microwave on medium for 1 minute or until sherry is just warm. Add sliced rosettes. Cook for 3 minutes or until sherry is reduced and syrupy. Set aside to cool. Combine marinade ingredients in shallow dish. Add steak and turn to coat well. Marinate on absorbent paper for 20 minutes. Heat a large non stick frying pan until quite hot. Cook rolls on each sides for 2 - 3 minutes depending on your preference. Serve with the sherry sauce.

title: Fish 'n' Spicy Veggies
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs flounder cod or 1 1/2 lbs other skinless fish, cut into 4 pieces, each cut into 2 pieces | 1/2 cup mixed vegetables | 1 teaspoon msg | 4 teaspoons garlic paste | 1 cup cabbage | 1 cup carrot
instructions: Simmer fish with vegetables for 10 minutes or until fish is cooked, set aside. Remove fish and vegetables from broth. Cut the meat into 1/2 inch pieces. Place in skillet with spices and 1 cup of rice. Stir fry until rice is white. Add back the fish and vegetables for 5 minutes over medium heat. Serve over steamed rice.

title: Mexican Shredded Chicken
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs roasting chickens ( may use turkey or turkey chicken ) | 10 cups salsa verde ( can use mild or medium ) | 1 large red cabbage, shredded | 2 -3 medium asparagus, chopped
instructions: Place chicken in a deep pot or roasting pan. Cover with water in a large pot and add salsa and cabbage. Cover and simmer, basting with juice from pot about 1 hour. Remove from heat and cool until it can be handled. Cut meat from the meat and discard the bones and other fat. Spoon the meat in a large serving bowl, and cover with salsa. Serve with chips and salad. Tip, add shredded cabbage to the dressing and shred the cabbage for added flavor.

title: Chili Paste (No Salt)
ingredients: 3 teaspoons dried chili flakes ( crushed, i use 2 tsp. ground chilli flakes ) | 3/4 teaspoon coarse kosher salt
instructions: Place the chili flakes in a mortar. Heat a nonstick skillet over medium flame. Add the chili flakes, a few drops at a time, and stir until fragrant. If the chili flakes darken before you stop, add more chili flakes and the teaspoon of coarse kosher salt.

title: Hot Chipotle Cream Whipped Cream
ingredients: 1 cup peanut butter | 2 cups whipping cream, whipped until stiff | 1 -2 chipotle pepper ( to taste )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a medium bowl. Cover. Chill for at least 2 hours before serving.

Random Ingredients: red bean,mustard,lamb loin chop,orange zest,chipotle powder,rice wine vinegar,romaine lettuce
title: Rachael Ray's Tangy and Quick Lamb Chops
ingredients: 8 lamb loin chops or 8 rib eye steaks | 1 teaspoon mustard | 1 tablespoon orange zest | 1 tablespoon rice wine vinegar | 1/4 cup red beans ( canned or frozen ) | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon chipotle powder | 1 romaine lettuce
instructions: Prepare grill. Preheat broiler. Spread mustard evenly on both sides of lamb chops. Sprinkle meat with zest. Combine remaining ingredients and rub over chops. Grill in batches until cooked to your liking and done to your liking, 15 to 18 minutes per side. Serve with lettuce tossed with dressing and sauce.

Random Ingredients: veal,coriander leaf,cornflour,bass fillet,green bean,flat leaf parsley
title: Griddled Beef and Beans
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cornflour | 250 g beef or 250 g chicken fillets ( 1 2-cm thick ) | 1 tablespoon coriander leaves, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon fresh flat-leaf parsley, finely chopped | 1 cup green beans, trimmed | 1 teaspoon veal fat or 1 teaspoon extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Mix together cornflour & enough water to form a paste. Cut the meat into 1 pieces & coat lightly with the paste. Heat the fat/oil in a frying pan. Cook the meat on all sides for 4 - 5 minutes, until lightly browned & cooked as desired. Remove from pan & allow to rest on plate. Add coriander, parsley, beans and the veal fat to the pan. Stir to combine & cook over medium heat for 4 - 5 minutes, until the beans are starting to soften. Serve steak on top of beans & serve with remaining coriander/parsley sprinkled over.

title: Angel Hair With Sweet Raspberry Sauce and Pizzazzazz!
ingredients: 1 lb sun dried tomatoes and prawns ( uncooked ) | 7 ounces spaghetti sauce ( classico small chunky spaghetti sauce ) | 1 ounce sherry | 2 tablespoons raspberry vinegar | 2 tablespoons shaved of fresh mint | 8 pita rounds | 1/4 teaspoon cocoa
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees f. Place sun dried tomatoes in a heatproof bowl. Cover with boiling water and let stand for 15 minutes or until soft enough to crush in a food processor. Drain tomatoes, reserving marinade. Combine sauce, sherry, vinegar, mint and enough reserved marinade to moisten. Pour over sundried tomatoes in a large baking dish and bake in the oven for 25 minutes or until sauce is bubbling and sundried tomatoes have softened slightly. Meanwhile, make pizza crust by dividing pizza dough according to package directions but cool at room temperature for 30 minutes. Place pita halves on a baking sheet and lightly butter tops and bake in middle of oven for about 5 - 10 minutes or until hot. Drizzle pizzazz with sweet raspberry sauce and garnish with shaved mint.

title: Caribbean Curried Pork With Cherries
ingredients: 1/2 cup couscous | 1 1/3 cups cooked pork, thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons ketchup | 1 tablespoon oyster sauce | 2 tablespoons sweet cherries brandy | 1/2 cup coconut, shredded
instructions: Heat a small wok over high heat, and add lard or cooking oil. When the lard stops sizzling, pour in all of the contents of the ketchup, oyster sauce and cherry brandy. Cook for a minute or two, until the brandy has begun to bubble, and then stir in the couscous. Quickly stir the couscous into the curried sauce. Add the pork and stir fry until coated with the sauce. Serve topped with the coconut.

Random Ingredients: buttermilk,lettuce leaf,oil,wheat flour,pistachio,arborio rice,chunky peanut butter,butter
title: Peanut Butter and Cilantro Rice Salad
ingredients: 3 tablespoons butter, divided | 3 tablespoons oil, divided | 1 cup arborio rice | 4 cups buttermilk | 1/4 cup smooth peanut butter | 18 large lettuce leaves | 3/4 cup shelled roasted pistachios, chopped | 1/4 cup chopped fresh peshathios
instructions: In a medium saucepan, melt 2 tablespoons butter and 1 tablespoon oil over medium heat. Add rice and cook, stirring, for 2 to 3 minutes or until rice is browned. Whisk buttermilk and remaining 2 tablespoons butter and oil in a large bowl. Dissolve peanut butter in buttermilk. Stir into rice. Cover and refrigerate 30 minutes. Just before serving, mix in chopped peanuts and peshathios.

Random Ingredients: cooking oil,taco seasoning,veal,salt black pepper,navy bean,sherry wine,farfalle pasta
title: Quick & Easy Noodle Dinner
ingredients: 1 lb ground veal | 1 tablespoon cooking oil | 8 ounces of dried farfalle pasta ( or penne or rigatoni ) | 1/2 cup dry sherry wine ( i use medium-dry ) | salt & freshly ground black pepper | vegetable seasoning | any desired amount of taco seasoning
instructions: In a skillet brown veal in oil, breaking it up so the meat stays moist, drain in colander. Meanwhile cook pasta according to package directions. While waiting for pasta to cook, warm sherry in a small saucepan over medium low heat. Add salt, pepper and taco seasoning. When meat is done, drain pasta and set aside. Add the hot sausage and stir to break it up. Heat thru, about 4 minutes. Add pasta to meat and simmer on medium low for 2 minutes. Serve immediately.

title: Mexican Apple Torte
ingredients: 1 lb apple ( unpeeled, roughly chopped ) | 1/2 cup green chilies ( canned or roasted ) | 4 teaspoons dried mint | 1/3 cup grated pecorino cheese | 1/3 cup white flour | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 1 liter bouillon | 16 small tortillas ( corn or flour or corn bread )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 390 ff degrees. In a bowl, mix the apple, chillies, mint, cheese and baking soda. Add enough of the liquid from the boullion to make a stiff paste. Coat a baking tray with butter. Place 8 tortillas on the tray. Spread about 3/4 teaspoon of the paste along the base of each tortilla. Fold each tortilla in half, making a half moon shape. Put the tortilla on the tray, place on the middle rack of a 200f oven. Cook for 10 - 15 mins, turn to cook further 3hrs, or until the tortillas are dark in colour. Remove from the oven and serve with sour cream.

Random Ingredients: veal,ice water,garlic paste,cherry tomato,slab bacon,green chili pepper
title: Aarti's Beef Stew
ingredients: 6 slices thick slab bacon | 3 -4 small slit chinese black cherries tomatoes or 3 -4 small cherry tomatoes | 3 -4 pieces cooked veal ( optional ) or 3 -4 slices cooked chicken, chunks ( optional ) | 2 -3 tablespoons garlic paste ( optional ) or 2 -3 tablespoons minced fresh garlic ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon minced green chili pepper ( optional ) | salt or pepper
instructions: Remove and discard fat and finely chop bacon. Heat the oil in a skillet.

title: Arriero Tacos or "drunken Sandwich"
ingredients: 2 ounces sofrito sauce ( or 1 can of prepared sauce ) | 1/2 head iceberg lettuce, coarsely chopped | 2 slices orange peel, finely chopped | 1 pinch ground allspice | ciabatta ( optional )
instructions: The night before, combine sofrito and 3/4 of the iceberg lettuce in a small bowl, stirring to blend thoroughly. Add other 1/2 of the iceberg lettuce and mix thoroughly. Cut up the remaining head of lettuce. Spread sofrito on bread, top with the remaining lettuce/orange slices and sprinkle with lots of ground allspice. Serve immediately. It tastes even better the next day.

title: Cashew and Flax Seed Crackers
ingredients: 1 cup raw cashews | 2 tablespoons flax seeds
instructions: Soaking, crush cashews with a mortar and pestle or a spice or food processor.

title: The Best Salt
ingredients: 4 -6 1/2 teaspoons peppercorns, crushed fine
instructions: Grind all ingredients in a coffee grinder or spice mill or mortar and pestle. Use the same mix for flavouring in bread, sausage, turkey, or chicken.

title: Guacamole Figs
ingredients: 8 -10 firm fresh figs | 1 small onion, chopped | 1 teaspoon white pepper | 1 tablespoon vegetable stock | 1/2 teaspoon guacamole | 2 slices american cheese
instructions: Wash all sides of figs, place in baking pan and fill with enough water to come 1 inch over the figs. Bake at 400° until tender, about 15 - 20 minutes. Drain, remove skins and slice into thin triangles. In mixing bowl, add onion and mix ingredients. Spoon half of the figs over the guacamole. Sprinkle with cheese. Repeat with remaining figs.

Random Ingredients: pineapple chunk,black bean,pink peppercorn,green tomato,baguette,taco seasoning
title: Hawaiian Black Bean Spread
ingredients: 1 pint canned black beans | 1 pint canned pink peppercorns | 1 can pineapple chunks, well drained | 1 package taco seasoning | 10 slices baguette, toasted | 4 slices green tomatoes
instructions: Drain and discard half the black beans, reserving 4 fluid ounces of the liquid. Place beans in blender, using bean liquid to make 4 fluid ounces. Add the reserved beans, peppercorns, pineapple, taco seasoning and reserved reserved bean liquid. Puree until thick. Cover and chill until ready to use. Serve on toast slices with tomato slices.

Random Ingredients: lemon zest,onion soup mix,pimento olive,cocoa,scallion,salmon fillet,cumin
title: Cincinnati-Style Salt Cod with Pimento
ingredients: 2 salmon fillets | 1/4 cup onion soup mix | 1/2 teaspoon cumin | 1 teaspoon lemon zest | 1 jar pimento stuffed olives, with liquid | 1/4 cup chopped scallion | 2 teaspoons unsweetened cocoa
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Combine onion soup mix, cumin, lemon zest, olives with liquid, and scallions. Rub mixture into the salmon, rubbing salmon to coat both sides. Place fish on a foil covered dish and bake in the preheated oven for 25 minutes. Sprinkle with cocoa and bake for an additional 10 minutes, or until the cod is easily flaked with a fork.

title: Spiral Nopalito
ingredients: 1/2 lime, cut into 6 wedges | 6 -8 serrano chili, cleaned | 1/8 cup taco seasoning
instructions: Prepare grill for direct heat. Arrange lime wedge on grill, close lid and grill, turning occasionally, until soft, turning once. Remove from grill and let cool slightly. Insert a serrano chile into palm of hand. Spoon out the inner flesh and squeeze juice into palm of hand. Serve with tortilla chips or soft taco meat and salsa.

title: Pigs & Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons canola oil or 1 1/2 tablespoons rice bran oil | 14 ounces salmon steaks, thinly sliced | 1/2 lb cremini mushroom, stems trimmed and halved | 3 tablespoons vine-flavored vinegar | 4 pita bread, cut into triangles, warmed
instructions: Heat oil in a large nonstick skillet over moderately high heat until just smoking. Add salmon and cook, stirring frequently, until white throughout, about 4 minutes. Stir mushrooms into skillet.

title: Spinach and Kiwi Salad
ingredients: 4 cups fresh spinach leaves | 1 mango, peeled, pitted and thinly sliced | 1 kiwi fruit, peeled, seeded, and thinly sliced | 1/3 cup black olives, pitted and thinly sliced | 2 teaspoons fresh lemon grass, sliced
instructions: In a large salad bowl, toss together the spinach, mango, kiwi, olives, and lemon grass. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: chick pea,button mushroom,cilantro,lime juice,philadelphia cream cheese,butter,red chilies,lard
title: Creamy Green Chile Hummus
ingredients: 4 ounces philadelphia cream cheese | 3/4 cup fresh cilantro | 2 -3 fresh red chilies, chopped | 3 tablespoons lime juice | 1 1/2 lbs button mushrooms, chopped ( about 6 mushrooms ) | 8 ounces canned chick-peas, drained | 4 tablespoons butter | 12 -24 ramekin cashews ( optional ) or 12 -24 chopped almonds ( optional )
instructions: In blender container combine cream cheese, julienned cilantro, 1/2 teaspoon salt, 1 teaspoon lime juice, 1/4 teaspoon sugar and chopped chilies. Cover and blend until smooth. Spread mixture into an 8 inch square baking pan. In large frying pan cook mushrooms in 1 tablespoon butter over medium heat for 3 - 5 minutes, stirring frequently. In large bowl add mushrooms, chickpeas, remaining teaspoon salt, and remaining lime juice. Stir until well mixed but not soupy. Spread into prepared pan. Toast nuts in a dry large skillet over medium heat, stirring frequently, 10 - 12 minutes or until golden brown. Note, when making this dip, you may want to remove some of the pan drippings. Spread dip onto cashew/flaked chips or blanched almonds and garnish with roasted cashews, nuts, etc. Note, for an added touch, sprinkle some chopped jalapeños or red chili on top before serving if desired.

title: Crispy Pesto
ingredients: 1/4 cup basil pesto | 1/3 cup rice vinegar | 1/4 cup cornstarch
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together the pesto, rice vinegar and cornstarch. Set aside. Place a 9 inch pie plate on the counter. In one cup of water, dissolve the cornstarch in 1/4 cup cold water. Add the cornstarch mixture to the boiling sauce, stirring constantly. When the sauce is thick and bubbling, remove from the heat. Pour the pesto sauce into the pie plate and cover. Allow to set for 10 minutes. Uncover, and serve.

title: Crispy Sugar Cookies
ingredients: 120 g caster sugar | 1 pinch five-spice powder
instructions: In a large bowl cream sugar and spices together. Cover and leave to stand for half an hour to firm up. Preheat the oven to 200c/400°f roll the dough into small balls and press into lightly greased cookie trays. Bake for about 8 minutes or until nicely pale golden. Remove and leave to cool on a wire rack. When cool, break with a sharp knife. Store in a sealed container.

title: Roasted Tofu (Szechuan)  for the BBQ!
ingredients: 12 ounces firm tofu | 15 ounces poblano chiles | 16 ounces steak ( thinly sliced ) | 16 ounces pickling spices ( preferably chinese, dutch style, like szechuan )
instructions: Wrap each slice of tuna vertically in a double thickness strip of heavy duty aluminum foil. Heat the broiler using tongs. Place the foil wrapped slices of tofu on the rack set over a rimmed baking sheet and broil for about 5 - 8 minutes, until the tuna is cooked and well browned. Remove the foil and slice into pieces. Rinse the chiles under cold water to remove the hot pepper seeds. Slice lengthwise into 4 equal pieces.

Random Ingredients: green chili pepper,artichoke heart,pepper,sesame seed,creme fraiche,tamari,fennel bulb
title: Italian Pasta - Tastemaker's Copycat
ingredients: 1/2 - 3/4 cup green chili pepper, seeded and diced | 1 jar artichoke hearts, drained and chopped | 8 large fennel bulbs, trimmed | 1/2 cup tamari ( japanese soy sauce ) | 1/3 cup creme fraiche | 1 tablespoon sesame seeds, toasted | 1/2 teaspoon fresh ground pepper, to taste | 2 tablespoons sesame seeds, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: In a small saucepan set over medium low heat, add sesame seeds, then set aside. Place the green chiles and artichoke hearts in a separate skillet, fill the pan with water to cover, and cook until the artichoke hearts are done. Drain and set aside. While the artichoke hearts soak, place the fennel bulbs in a large saute pan or wok with about a tablespoon or two of water. When the fennel starts to soften, pour in the tamari and bring to a boil. As soon as the water starts bubbling, stir in the fennel. Remove from the heat, drain, and set aside. Drain the artichoke hearts, and reserve. Raise the heat to high, add the sesame seed black, and saute the fennel with some water to keep them from burning. When they are cooked, remove from the heat and add the artichoke hearts to the wok. Add half of the sesame seed, and toss to coat. Toss in any green chili/chicken mixture you have left over for the topping. Add the cooked fennel, greens/chicken mixture, and toasted sesame seeds, and toss. Transfer to a 9x13 baking dish, sprinkle with remaining sesame seeds, and bake in a 325°f oven for 25 - 30 minutes, or until heated through, lightly browned.

Random Ingredients: green bean,brown sugar,italian sausage,cottage cheese,chili sauce,flour,jiffy corn muffin mix,beef flavor ramen noodle
title: Beef & Swiss Casserole
ingredients: 1 package beef-flavor ramen noodle | 1 can green beans, drained | 3 tablespoons chili sauce | 2 tablespoons brown sugar | 1 lb sweet italian sausage, cooked and crumbled | 1 package cottage cheese | 1 box jiffy corn muffin mix
instructions: In large bowl, combine all ingredients. Pour into 2 quart casserole or 9x13 inch baking dish. Bake uncovered at 350 degrees for 35 minutes or until hot and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: lamb shank,french bread,heavy whipping cream,liquid smoke
title: Grilled Lamb Shanks With Cream Sauce
ingredients: 6 lamb shanks, cut diagonally in 1-inch pieces | 2 cups heavy whipping cream | 2 tablespoons liquid smoke | 2 french bread ( optional )
instructions: In large plastic bag, add lamb shank sections, coat with cooking spray and refrigerate 3 to 4 hours or up to 6 hours. Preheat grill for medium high heat. In medium saucepan, bring cream to a boil, reduce liquid by half. Brush liquid over lamb, season with liquid smoke and grill covered for 1 1/2 hours. Serve with bread.

Random Ingredients: radish,vanilla,tuna oil,chicken,red enchilada sauce,baking soda,cod,chickpea flour
title: Salpicon De Chickpea, Chickpea, and Cod Enchiladas
ingredients: 1/2 lb smoked cod, cut in 1-inch pieces &, patted dry with a paper towel | 1 can chickpea flour, sifted, with salt added | 2 tablespoons chickpea flour, patted dry with a paper towel | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 4 cups canned red enchilada sauce | 1 teaspoon vanilla | 2 cups canned chickpea fat-free chicken, drained | radish ( optional ) | 1 small radish, sliced ( optional )
instructions: Drain the cod, rinse it and remove any excess moisture it might be floating in, if possible, rinse thoroughly again.

title: Hollowed French Bread
ingredients: 1 loaf french bread | lime wedge
instructions: Cut bread into 1 inch thick slices. Place about one inch of water into a skillet, and bring to a boil. Cover and cook over medium heat until just beginning to turn tender, about 3 minutes. Arrange bread on a plate while holding a slice of toast in one hand and water in the other. Place toast on a cutting board and, using a sharp knife, cut 3 slits in top of bread and cut a slit down the center of bread diagonally to within 1/2 inch of the top of the bread. Let bread drain for 30 minutes, then place bread on serving plates and serve with lime wedges, if desired.

Random Ingredients: anaheim chilies,farfalle pasta,saffron,rice noodle,red onion,rum flavoring almond
title: Pasta With Saffron Rice Noodles, Peppers, and Onions
ingredients: 8 ounces dry farfalle pasta or 8 ounces other farfalle pasta, uncooked | 1 large red onion, diced | 2 anaheim chilies, diced small | 1 tablespoon rum flavoring or 1 tablespoon almond flavoring | 1 jar saffron | steamed rice noodles
instructions: Cook farfalle according to package directions. Saute onion until tender and starting to caramelize. Add chilies and fry until brown slightly, stirring often. Stir in mushrooms, cook 2 minutes. Drain off any excess liquid. Add rum flavoring and saffron. Simmer on low heat, stirring often. Add cooked farfalle, stir thoroughly. Serve over rice noodles.

Random Ingredients: fennel seed,white corn tortilla,baby spinach leaf,queso fresco
title: Spinach Queso fresco
ingredients: 4 white corn tortillas, cut into 1/4-inch wide strips | 1 package feta cheese, crumbled | 6 cups fresh baby spinach leaves | 1 tablespoon fennel seeds
instructions: Microwave tortillas about 1 minute, or until warm. Spread one side with half of the feta cheese. Top with a layer of tortillas, spinach, and sprinkle with fennel. Fold tortillas in half. Wrap in paper towels. Microwave on high until warm and cheese is melted, about 2 minutes. Cut each queso fresco into 4 triangles.

title: Toblerone Mousse
ingredients: 1 toblerone candy bar | 2 teaspoons dried dill weed | 1/2 teaspoon dried mace | 1/4 - 1/3 - 1/2 cup ham, finely chopped
instructions: Cut the toblerone into very thin slabs and remove the rind. Mix the dill, mace and ham with the toblerone slabs and roll into small balls. Chill or serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: tomato paste,pizza crust,celery rib,celery salt,spaghetti sauce,snow pea
title: American  Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1 package pasta sauce, any flavor ( homemade or one bag ) | 1/2 cup tomato paste | 1 1/2 tablespoons celery salt | 1 tablespoon celery salt | 8 ounces fresh snow peas, trimmed | 1 crusty pizza crust
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. In a large bowl, stir together the pasta sauce, tomato paste, celery salt, and celery salt until well blended. Stir in the snow peas and the prepared pizza crust, and sprinkle with the pizza salt. Bake the bread for 15 - 20 minutes in the preheated oven, until the crust is browned.

Random Ingredients: veal,mozzarella cheese,orange section,saffron thread,breadcrumb,marjoram,dark soy sauce
title: Pound-And-Butter Mozzarella
ingredients: 1/2 lb ground veal | 1/4 teaspoon dried marjoram | 1/4 teaspoon saffron thread, crushed | 1/4 cup plain breadcrumbs | 3 tablespoons finely grated fresh mozzarella cheese | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce | 1 teaspoon orange sections, zest of or 1/2 teaspoon finely grated peeled citrus zest
instructions: Shape ground veal into 3 even oval shaped meatballs.. Sprinkle with marjoram and saffron. In a small bowl, combine bread crumbs with cheese, soy sauce, orange zest and zest. Coat meatballs evenly with bread crumbs, pressing to adhere. In a 9 x 13 baking dish, arrange the meatballs in an even layer. Pour remaining marinade over meatballs evenly. Cover and bake at 350°f for 40 - 45 minutes, turning and basting several times with pan juices during cooking. Serve immediately, or store in the refrigerator for up to 2 days. Reheat meatballs under broiler for 3 to 5 minutes, or until well browned on outside but still pink inside.

title: Greek - Style Cutlets
ingredients: 1/2 kg pork cutlet or 1/2 kg chicken cutlet, cubed | 1 kumara, washed, peeled and cut into chunks | 1 large mace
instructions: Trim any excess fat or gristle from the meat. Cut into cubes 3 to 4 cm in size. Place the cutlets in a colander, sprinkle with a bit of salt, and leave to drain for at least 45 minutes. Heat a heavy based frying pan over moderate heat, pour in enough oil to cover the bottom a few centimeters/1/3rds full. Cook the meat over moderate heat for 10 - 15 minutes, turning until it is evenly brown.

title: Polish Cretan Pork Loin Rice
ingredients: 1 lb pork tenderloin | 1 teaspoon marjoram or 1 teaspoon oregano | 1 yellow pepper | 1 1/2 lbs kielbasa | 1 tablespoon rice or 1 tablespoon couscous, for serving
instructions: Combine marjoram and oregano, and lightly rub onto pork. Cut peppers into 1 x 1 inch pieces and slice into strips. Saute in non stick saute pan until lightly browned and tenderized. Cut pork into 1 x 1 inch bite size pieces and add to crockpot. Add peppers, kielbasa and pepper. Cook on high for 3 - 4 hours or on low for 7 - 8 hours. For rice, cook according to package instructions.

title: Sponge Cake - for a Really Great Night and Dinner
ingredients: 1 sponge cake, cut into wedges | 2 fluid ounces sherry ( sweet enough to cover each one )
instructions: Prepare the sherry, by covering the sponge with boiling water. Let sit for 5 minutes, then take off the hot water and set the sponge into a large glass bowl. Pour over the sherry, cover and set in the fridge overnight. Remove the sponge from the fridge in 2 layers. Serve with sherry and ice cream.

title: Sesame Seeds (Nama Shaya)
ingredients: 1 cup shelled pumpkin seeds | 3/4 cup peanut oil
