instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Line baking sheet with an aluminum foil sheet. Combine pumpkin seeds and 3/4 cup peanut oil in a small mixing bowl. Spread the mixture onto the baking sheet. Bake in the oven for 20 minutes, checking the color frequently.

title: Spaetzle II
ingredients: 2 cups apple juice | 3/4 sugar, to sweeten
instructions: Heat juice and sugar in a saucepan over medium heat until sugar dissolves. Bring to a boil, then simmer, stirring, for 5 minutes. Cool completely. Pour into a greased metal bowl. Break up with a fork and mold into noodles using your hands. Serve warm.

title: Lentil Pate With Green Chilis
ingredients: 1 can sweet lentils ( can use drained ) | 1 lb beef tenderloin | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh gingerroot | 1 1/2 cups croutons, plain | 1 large mild green chili ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Place the rind and all of the other ingredients in the food processor or blender to blend.. Put mixture into baking dish. Bake 25 - 30 minutes or until the lentils are tender.

title: Dipping Sauce for Beef Kabobs
ingredients: 1 tablespoon paprika | 1 tablespoon rice vinegar | 1 garlic clove, minced
instructions: In a small bowl, combine paprika, rice vinegar, and garlic.

Random Ingredients: beef chuck roast,onion soup mix,thyme,green cardamom pod,white wheat flour,rice
title: Beef or Pork Gravy in Rice
ingredients: 3 1/2 lbs beef chuck roast, fat trimmed, cut into 1/2 | 1 envelope dry onion soup mix | 1 teaspoon fresh thyme, minced | 1 tablespoon dried minced onion | 1/8 teaspoon white whole wheat flour | 1 teaspoon green cardamom pods, crushed | 2 cups leftover rice
instructions: Place meat on lightly greased rack of meat roasting pan, fat side down. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Roast on lowest rack of oven 40 to 50 minutes, turning meat every 15 minutes, until an instant read thermometer inserted into centre registers 130°f. About 20 minutes before end of baking, sprinkle rack with dried onion soup mix mix. Remove meat from oven and tent loosely with foil or kitchen towel. Let stand for 5 minutes or longer. While meat is standing, combine thyme, minced onion, flour, cardamom and white whole wheat flour in small bowl. Set aside. Cut meat across the grain into 1/4 slices. Rinse meat, dry and season with salt and pepper. Arrange meat on rack in roasting pan, fat side up. Cover tightly and place in roasting pan with tight fitting lid. Cook in 325° oven until meat is very tender and cooked through, about 5 hours. Remove meat to platter. Remove foil. Pour juices into saucepan. Heat over low heat until liquid boils and thickens, stirring occasionally. Pour over meat.

title: Easy Baked Chimichangas
ingredients: 1 boneless chuck, in one piece | 1/2 lb boneless pork roast | 1 can mixed vegetables ( i used whole baby carrots, celery, mushrooms ) | 1/2 cup frozen tiny ice cube | vegetable oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 f degrees. Place chuck, pork and vegetables in the oven and cook for 25 - 30 minutes. Serve in our favorite style with tortillas, corn chips, or crackers. The frozen breaded mixed veggies would be really good with this meal.

Random Ingredients: chili paste,spice,peanut oil vegetable,corn oil,lemon zest
title: Homemade Singapore Dry Rub for Beef (Chingi Yahng)
ingredients: 1/4 teaspoon chili paste ( also called donyeon chili paste or jalapeno pepper ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons peanut oil or 1 1/2 teaspoons vegetable oil | 2 tablespoons fresh lemon zest, minced | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground mixed spice ( i used phet de la vera which comes in a small package or a few small pieces of lemon zest ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons corn oil
instructions: Mix together the chili paste, oil and lemon zest on a cutting board. Brush the salt all over your beef and dry with a clean dry cloth on both sides of the meat using a wet paper towel. Store away from direct sunlight in a cool dry place or refrigerate for up to 6 days. The longer it sticks to the cutting board the hotter it will get. Remove from the direct heat and allow the salt to cool completely to room temperature. Transfer to a sealable container and refrigerate until ready to use. Trim off any excess fat, dry any excess fat and slice the meat for stir frying or basting. The more the meat is sliced it becomes more tender and will sear more quickly, not so much that you will be able to seal in fat. For meat fowl, use a combination of beef and fish and make your fowl or dip with the salt before frying. For basting, you can also dip the meat strips into the mixed spice. This will give you a more distinctive aroma when it is cooked. Note, the ginger in the paste will have a strong smell and flavor. Try your salt before seasoning and if you think it needs more, add the following. 1 3/4 teaspoons ground ginger and 1/2 teaspoons dried thyme. Use more ginger as a substitute or in place of chile paste if you are using chile paste.

Random Ingredients: white breadcrumb,garlic powder,chocolate bar,tomato puree,stew meat
title: Snoqualmie Beef Meat Loaf
ingredients: 2 lbs stew meat, cut into 1. 5 inch slices | 2 teaspoons garlic powder | 1 can tomato puree | 2/3 cup fresh white breadcrumbs | 7 ounces chocolate bars, chopped fine
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees farenheit. Spray a 9 x 5 loaf pan with cooking spray. Arrange meat slices around the side of the pan and spread evenly with the garlic powder, tomato puree and bread crumbs. Sprinkle the chocolate bits evenly over the top. Bake for 1 hour or until meat thermometer reaches 160 degrees farenheit and tops are golden brown.

Random Ingredients: pineapple juice,granny smith apple,maui onion,haddock,heavy whipping cream,beef stew meat
title: Easy Slow Cooker Swedish Steak
ingredients: 1 pound maui onions | 1 pound beef stew meat, cubed | 1 can pineapple-flavored juice | 1 cup heavy whipping cream | 1 package maui onions | 1 package smoked haddock, or more to taste | 1/2 pound granny smith apples - peeled, cored and cubed
instructions: Mix maui onions and beef in the slow cooker crock. Pour pineapple juice over beef. Stir cream and maui onions in slow cooker until blended, then pour over beef. Place smoked haddock in slow cooker. Stir apples into slow cooker. Cover, and cook on low until the beef is tender, about 6 hours.

Random Ingredients: lemon peel,apple cider,active yeast,onion flake,cheddar cheese,black pepper,celery leaf,sesame seed
title: Cheesy Apples
ingredients: 1 package dried active yeast | 1 1/2 cups apple cider or 1 1/2 cups apple juice | 1/2 cup onion flakes | 3/4 cup celery leaves | 1 1/2 cups cheddar cheese, shredded | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh lemon peel | 1/2 teaspoon fresh cracked black pepper | 2 tablespoons sesame seeds
instructions: Dissolve yeast in cider or apple juice until foamy. Stir in onion, celery leaves, cheese, lemon peel, pepper and sesame seeds, blending thoroughly. Dough will be thick. Knead for 1 or 2 minutes until smooth. Add water if dough is too sticky. Place on a floured surface, and knead for 5 or 6 minutes. Place dough into a greased bowl, cover, and let rise. Grease two 9x13 baking pans, or line with parchment paper. Place dough onto prepared pans. Bake at 350 degrees f for 15 minutes. Remove from baking pans, and cool slightly.

title: Auntie Lori's Simple and Delicious Garlic Rub!
ingredients: 6 whole bulbs garlic | 3/4 cup baking powder, heaping | 1/2 cup crushed real crushed garlic flakes, heaping
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees. Wash and scrub the garlic bulbs. Cut off as much of the tops of the garlic bulbs as will fit if you leave them intact. Cut off the stem and any soft tops, if your bulbs are large, remove the hard center part and cut the cloves into 3/4 pieces. Make sure they are cut in half lengthwise and not julienne. Put garlic bulbs into a roasting pan and add enough water to barely cover, about 1/3 of the way up the side of the pan. Bake in the preheated oven for 3/4 to 1 hour. Drain the garlic through a sieve into a clean saucepan and bring to a boil, about 2 - 5 minutes. Reserve the garlic water. Place the cooked garlic bulbs into a food processor and add the baking powder. Turn the processor on and add enough garlic water to reserved garlic water to make a sauce consistency. You can always add more of the garlic water if needed. Add the crushed garlic flakes right at the end.

title: Gorgonzola Beet Relish
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs gorgonzola, diced | 3/4 cup canned orange juice concentrate, defrosted | 3 tablespoons hot chili oil ( use a little or a little bit of the chili oil for a bit of `` heat '' to have more flavor ) | 1/2 cup chopped canned beets
instructions: Pour the orange juice concentrate into a small bowl and whisk. Melt the cheese, stir in the oil and chilis to taste. Put a few spoonfuls of the cheese mixture onto a large piece of waxed paper or parchment paper, make a layer of this mixture on top and sides of the waxed paper or paper, place a few beets inside as a frame, cut slits across the top and sides, place in the freezer for about an hour or till the cheese mixture is solid. These are not delish. This can be made a day ahead, chill in the fridge and reheat till warmed.

Random Ingredients: veal,puff pastry,white fish fillet,vanilla pudding,cooking apple
title: Wurstfleckerl - Danish Meat Pie (Flan)
ingredients: 1 frozen puff pastry sheets | 1 small cooking apple, peeled and diced | 1/4 lb ground veal | 1 package instant vanilla pudding, instant or 1 bag vegetable instant vanilla pudding mix | 1 package beef top round white fish fillets or ( 7 lb ) package frozen fish fillets, in bite-sized pieces
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Roll out the frozen pastry into 8x8 inch rectangle on a lightly floured surface. Spread all the ground meat on the pastry leaving some on the sides. Place a small piece of apple on top of the meat, then top with remaining meat. Sprinkle with a small amount of water. Fold the right and left edges of pastry over the meat, then carefully roll from the bottom toward the center, sealing the edges with a fork. Cut the pastry into six 1 x 8 inch bars. Place on a slightly greased baking sheet, then bake for 30 to 45 minutes, or until the pastry is crusty and the meat is cooked through.

title: Baked Peppers on Toast
ingredients: 1 bell pepper, red or red | 1/2 cup white breadcrumb
instructions: Slice pepper and place in baking pan with breadcrumbs in a shallow tray. Heat broiler add pepper to breadcrumb mix till just about bubbly or warm and spread on top of pepper. Broil until lightly browned.

title: Yogurt Free Taco Appetizer
ingredients: 1 packet active dry yeast, 2 1/4 - 3/4 g. packages | 1 tablespoon low sodium soy sauce | 1 tablespoon tahini ( sesame spread ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground turmeric | 1 cup warm water | lettuce, for garnish | 1/2 cup coarsely chopped cucumber ( optional ) or 1/2 cup black olives, chopped ( optional )
instructions: In a large bowl, sprinkle the yeast over the warm water. Leave 10 - 15 minutes, or until frothy, and dissolve the yeast completely in the water. Stir in the remaining ingredients.

title: Japanese Style Chicken on Rice
ingredients: 4 tablespoons rice wine ( or sake ) | 4 tablespoons minced chicken thighs | 4 tablespoons minced celery | 4 tablespoons sake | lettuce leaf | corn, strips or fried rice
instructions: Combine the rice wine, chicken, celery, sake and a fried rice in a bowl.

title: Barley Pumpernickel
ingredients: 1 cup barley | 3 tablespoons quick-cooking oil | 1/4 cup bacon fat or 1/4 cup margarine | 1/2 cup golden raisin, dried | 1 cup dill pickle relish | 2 tablespoons vodka | dill pickle relish, for topping
instructions: In a large saucepan, mix in your first seven ingredients. Cover and simmer on the lowest heat for 30 minutes. Remove from heat. Mix in vodka. Serve warm on pumpernickel bread, with dill pickle slices floating next.

title: Chutney Chicken
ingredients: 8 ounces barbecued pork shoulder, cut into 1-inch cubes | 8 ounces pearl barley | 3 ounces chutney | 4 ounces pecans, coarsely chopped | 4 ounces chopped pecans | 2 teaspoons chicken bouillon, cube | 2 tablespoons oregano leaves, fresh | 1 1/2 tablespoons granulated sugar
instructions: Place all ingredients except pork in slow cooker, stir well then add pork cubes. Cover and cook on low setting until meat is tender, 6 - 7 hours. Shred pork with tweezers and serve hot.

title: Spicy Thai Glaze
ingredients: 2 teaspoons minced lemongrass | 1 teaspoon ground ajwain ( dried black bean ) | 1 teaspoon liquid honey
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl. If needed, pour in a tad of water. If too thick, add more water.

title: Pan-Fried Pork Shoulder "the Easy"
ingredients: 4 boneless pork shoulder | 2 cups chicken broth ( or water may be used as suggested in comments below ) or 2 cups turkey broth ( or water may be used as suggested in comments below )
instructions: Cut the pork shoulder into pieces about 1 1/2 x 2 1/2 x 1/4 then gently push a piece of the skin side down into the broth or water to be flattened slightly. Tie the breast, skin and meat together using kitchen twine if necessary. Bring the broth or water just to a boil and add the meat. Cook to your preference of doneness then drain. Note if not serving immediately, refrigerate overnight or for up to 2 days. Bring the broth just to a boil again and remove the meat from the broth. Serve with crusty bread for dipping.

Random Ingredients: coleslaw mix cabbage carrot,cod fillet,oyster sauce
title: Cod and Coleslaw
ingredients: 1/8 cup oyster sauce | 1 lb cod fillet, cut into 2 x 1/4-inch chunks | 8 ounces coleslaw mix ( packaged ) | 1/4 cup coleslaw mix, coarsely chopped
instructions: Combine oyster sauce and cod in bowl. Add remaining ingredients. Cover and marinate at least 1 hour in refrigerator. Heat oven to 400 degrees. Spray 13x9x2 inch baking dish with cooking spray. Add cod to dish. Bake 20 minutes. Remove cod and bake 5 additional minutes. Turn fish.

Random Ingredients: egg yolk,canola oil,icing sugar,apple,cocoa powder,rice vinegar,mix
title: French Apple Cake (Healthy, Low Fat)
ingredients: 1 3/4 cups apples ( fresh or frozen ) | 1/4 cup rice vinegar | 1 tablespoon cocoa powder | 1/4 cup icing sugar | 2 cups sweet mix ( i use sugar free ) | 3 egg yolks | canola oil ( for frying )
instructions: Combine all apples in medium bowl. Beat egg yolks in a large bowl and add rice vinegar, cocoa and icing sugar. Slowly beat in mix. In a small pan, heat oil. Pour cake mixture into oil and fry until golden brown on both sides. Serve warm with icecream or cream.

title: Danish Pesto
ingredients: 1/2 cup sweet pickle relish | 1 tablespoon pesto sauce
instructions: Pour sweet pickle relish in to a screw top jar with pesto. Close lid and shake vigorously until very creamy. Let sit in refrigerator for at least 2 hours before using.

Random Ingredients: bok choy,red currant jelly,mirin,red chili,harissa,thai red chili pepper,coriander
title: Spicy Red Curry With Bok Choy
ingredients: 1 bunch bok choy | 1 small mild red chili, deseeded | 4 tablespoons red currant jelly | 1 tablespoon mirin | 1 -2 thai red chili pepper, deseeded | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon harissa | 1/3 bunch coriander, leaves, chopped
instructions: Wash and dry the bok choy. Cut off stem end and discard. Cut the leaves into 4cm lengths and remove the hard rib at the base of each leaf. Cut a slit along the top of the stalk and remove the ribs by running a knife lengthways through this. You should end up with about eight equal pieces of leaves. Set the leaves aside for 10 minute meanwhile, heat a wok over a high heat until very very hot. Add the chilli, currant jelly, mirin, chili and harissa. Allow the jelly to bubble up and dissolve slightly. Add the bok choy, stir well to coat the leaves & leaves in the jelly then remove from the heat. Allow to stand for 5 - 8 minute. Serve scattered with the chopped coriander leaves.

Random Ingredients: mint leaf,crabmeat,white bread,seasoning,ghee,corn muffin mix,dark chocolate,mace
title: Mint Chops and Crabmeat
ingredients: 1 cup crumb corn muffin mix | 2 tablespoons grated dark chocolate | 1/2 tablespoon seasoning ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon mace | 1/3 cup crushed fresh mint leaves | 1/3 cup melted butter or 1/3 cup margarine | 1 can crabmeat, drained, flaked ( drained weight ) | white bread, cut into 6 triangles ( for dipping )
instructions: In a small bowl mix together the crumb corn muffin mix with the chocolate, seasoning and mace. Add the mint leaves and mix well. In a small bowl mix together the melted butter or margarine with the crab meat. Dip one side of each triangle of bread around a chunk of the crabmeat and then press it lightly into the bread with fingers to make a crust. Place about 1 tablespoon of the mixture on each piece of bread and fold the sides in like a book. Repeat with the remaining bread pieces. Bake at 350° for about 30 minutes, or until heated through. Serve with cocktail sticks.

title: Cuban Style Veal
ingredients: 3 lbs boneless veal | 1 tablespoon garlic salt | 1 teaspoon fresh ginger, sliced | 7 tablespoons chicken bouillon | 1 cup fresh lime zest | 2 cans black beans
instructions: Combine garlic salt, ginger and chicken bouillon in a bowl.

title: Mild Hot Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup buttermilk | 1 -2 large jalapeno pepper
instructions: Cut chili pepper in half and remove seeds. Put on a small plate and cover with buttermilk. Let sit about 30 degrees. Strain the milk before adding to your hot sauce.

title: Suzanne's Easy Sesame Green Pepper Dipping Sauce - Microwave
ingredients: 1 cup sesame seeds | 1 1/4 cups green peppers, finely chopped | 2 cups irish cream or 2 cups whipping cream
instructions: Spray 2 large microwavable ramekins with non stick cooking spray and sprinkle 2 tablespoons sesame seeds on each. Microwave on high for 5 minutes. Stir contents and keep on top of the stove. Let rest until mixture cools, about 15 minutes. Stir in black pepper and green pepper. Add irish cream.

Random Ingredients: shrimp paste,cooking spray,mozzarella cheese,pistachio,vegetable stock,spaghetti sauce
title: Shrimp & Mozzarella Filled Pasta
ingredients: 8 ounces uncooked rigatoni pasta or 8 ounces spaghetti | cooking spray | 1 cup low-fat mozzarella cheese, shredded | 3/4 - 1 cup vegetable stock | 2 tablespoons shrimp paste | 3/4 cup store-bought pestazz di padano or 3/4 cup grated parmesan cheese
instructions: Cook rigatoni or spaghetti according to package directions.

title: Italian Artichoke Salsa
ingredients: 2 cans frozen artichoke hearts, thawed, drained and chopped, about 1 1/2 cups | 7/8 cup sultana ( dark or golden ) | 1/8 teaspoon italian seasoning | 1/4 cup maple syrup, about 1/4 cup if using maple syrup for sweeter salsa
instructions: Using blender or food processor, process all ingredients until well mixed, about 1 minute, stopping blender occasionally to scrape down sides. Cover and chill at least 3 hours. Stir or blend salsa as directed in description.

title: Persian Spinach, Chocolate & Raisin Parcel
ingredients: 2 teaspoons gluten-free flour | 100 g frozen chopped spinach, thawed, drained | 50 g golden raisins | 12 tablespoons unsweetened chocolate bars, roughly chopped, divided | 1/3 cup spinach, chopped | 2 -3 tablespoons onions, finely diced | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric | 125 g baby spinach ( baby handfuls, leaves ) | peach, wedges, to serve
instructions: Sift the flour into a bowl, add the spinach, raisins, 2 tbsp choclate, 1 tablespoon of chopped chocolate and the other tablespoon of choclate and combine well. In a separate pan heat the remaining 7 tablespoons of chocolate on a medium heat, add the spinach mixture and stir for 3 minutes. Serve in small parcels and top each with a peach wedge.

title: Taco Cheese
ingredients: 3 scallions, minced | 1/2 lb monterey jack cheese, shredded
instructions: Blanch and peel the scallions, then slice into thin rings. In a large bowl, combine the scallions and cheese. In a second large bowl, stir half of cheese mixture and the scallions with the scallions. Put in a lightly oiled 2 quart casserole and bake at 350 degrees for 15 to 20 minutes or until browned, bubbly, and lightly browned.

title: Baked Halibut
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds fillets halibut into 1 inch chunks | 1 can tomato juice
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Grease a 13x9 inch baking dish. Place halibut in the bottom of the dish. Sprinkle with tomato juice and pour tomato juice over. Cover with aluminum foil. Bake in the preheated oven 40 minutes, or until fish flakes easily with a fork.

Random Ingredients: green bell pepper,fish stock,mango chutney,corn,spaghetti,butternut squash,cooking spray,chicken breast
title: Chicken Fajitas With Mango and Noodles
ingredients: 1/4 cup mango chutney | 1/4 cup fresh corn or 1/4 cup frozen corn, thawed ( i don't like the addition of corn ) | 1 tablespoon fish stock | 12 ounces boneless chicken breasts or 12 ounces butternut squash, thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons quick-cooking spray | 1 green bell pepper, seeded, thinly sliced | mango chutney | cooked spaghetti
instructions: In a small nonstick skillet, combine first three ingredients. Heat over medium high heat, stirring often, until hot and bubbly. Remove from heat. Spray a 2 cup glass measuring cup with cooking spray. Add chicken.

title: Spicy Pickled Beets
ingredients: 8 large beets, peeled | 2 sheets cake flour ( not bread flour ) | ice cube | warm watercress | 1/4 cup ketchup | 1 teaspoon anise seed, ground | crushed bay leaf | cayenne
instructions: Place beetroots in a steamer over boiling water and cook until tender, about 40 minutes.

title: Stuffed Cabbage
ingredients: 10 -12 -12 medium cabbage | walnuts ( optional ) | mccormick seasoning, to roll salad ( optional ) | 1/2 cup green cabbage, shredded ( or other seasonal vegetable or green ) | rice ( optional ) or egg noodles ( optional )
instructions: Wash, core, and slice cabbage. Place cabbage in salted water and let sit 10 minutes then drain. Place in bowl. Make as many rolls as you need and mix with your desired seasoning. Place on a baking tray then place on oven rack. Bake in 400 degree oven 20 minutes. Flip half way through until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: penne,fish oil,chipotle chile,yogurt,tomato basil pasta sauce,mandarin orange segment
title: Penne With Whole Lettuce and Chipotle
ingredients: 12 ounces penne | 14 ounces canned mandarin orange segments, drained | 1 1/2 cups low-fat yogurt | 1 teaspoon bottled chipotle chile | 1 1/2 cups fat-free low-sodium tomato and basil pasta sauce | 1 tablespoon fish oil
instructions: Cook tomatoes and chilies in oil, over medium heat for about 5 minutes over low heat, breaking up tomatoes with spoon. Mix in pasta sauce until heated through. Combine pasta noodles and sauce and serve.

title: Chunky Capsicum & Cabbage
ingredients: 1 large red capsicum | 1 large cabbage, shredded
instructions: Set oven to 200degc. Cut capsicum into 5cm thick diagonal slices. Place capsicum slices on a piece of baking paper. Put cabbage on top & scatter over the capsicum. Bake in oven, uncovered, until capsicum is tender. Remove from oven & cool slightly, slice in half & set aside. Serve with tea or coffee.

title: Moroccan  Chickpeas
ingredients: 1 package frozen chickpeas | 1 1/2 tablespoons grated orange peel
instructions: Place the chickpeas and the orange peel in a microwave safe dish. Cover with water and microwave on high in 12 minutes, stirring halfway through the cooking time. Remove from microwave, drain, allow to cool 3 - 5 minutes on a plate. Store in airtight container.

title: Pesto and Mint Crumbs for the Eyes of Romaine
ingredients: 16 teaspoons refrigerated pesto sauce | 8 teaspoons finely chopped of fresh mint | 2 cups unbleached white flour | 1 cup graham cracker crumbs ( not coarsely grated fine )
instructions: Mix 1 cup of the pesto with the mint and flour and season generously with salt and pepper. Add the crumbs and mix lightly. Press the mixture into an 8x8 pan. Spread evenly. Score into bars to entertain younger children, or as an extra course at a party. Bake at 350 until the crumbs have turned a pale tan color, then break away all crust and continue to bake until crispy and crisp.

title: Bordertov
ingredients: 1 liter beef bouillon | 1 cup soya sauce | 1 liter vodka | 3 tablespoons oil
instructions: Heat all oil in a saucepan. Mix in 1 litre of bouillon. Stir. Add all the soya. Stir. Boil for 20 minutes. Allow to cool. Remove from heat. Add 1 tsp cardamon powder and serve over bok choy. Makes about 2 litre.

title: Ancho Chile Salt
ingredients: 2 cups ricotta cheese | 4 dried ancho chile powder ( optional )
instructions: Mix together the ricotta and chile powder in a bowl until dissolved. Cover the bowl and shake well to combine. Store in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.

title: Grilled Steak Sandwich
ingredients: 4 sirloin steaks | cracked black pepper, to taste | 1 cup long grain rice | 4 slices american cheese
instructions: Pre heat your grill. I always add some olive oil to the grill grill with the sirloin. Wrap your steaks in heavy aluminum foil and lightly season with cracked black pepper, to taste. Set up grilling pan with the grill lid on the indirect heat. When the foil touches the grill, turn the steak over. Once the steak is cooked, use the oil from the cheese to brush the grill with the meat mixture. Let it sit 5 - 7 minutes. Remove the steak from the grill. Invert the meat onto the plate with a spatula. Flip the steaks back to the grill and let them cook on the same sides. Cook the steak to desired doneness and enjoy.

title: Croissant French Dip
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of celery soup | 12 frozen plain croissants, split | 1 can sliced peaches, drained | 1 jar chopped pimiento, drained | 12 puff pastry sheets
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Combine soup, croissants, peaches, and pimientos in a 1 1/2 quart baking dish. Arrange croissants cut side down, on top of soup mixture in dish. Pour remaining soup mixture evenly over croissants.

Random Ingredients: purpose flour,mustard powder,white pepper,chili pepper flake,seasoning salt,ginger paste,buttermilk,flat leaf parsley
title: Mauricelli (Indian Onion Cookies)
ingredients: 1/2 cup plain buttermilk | 1/3 cup finely chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley | 1/4 teaspoon mustard powder | 1/4 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1 teaspoon ginger paste ( i use 1 tsp. fresh ) | 1 teaspoon chili pepper flakes, crushed ( or to taste ) | 1/2 teaspoon white pepper ( or to taste ) | 2 1/2 cups all-purpose flour, more if needed
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Beat together buttermilk, parsley, mustard powder, seasoning salt, ginger paste, chili pepper flakes and white pepper, until smooth. Combine flour and margarine, add to wet ingredients. Stir until dough just begins to form a ball. Turn out on lightly floured surface and knead for 2 - 3 minutes, until smooth and elastic. Line an 8 inch cake pan or large cookie sheet with parchment paper and spray with non stick cooking spray. Separate dough into three sections, wrap in waxed paper and chill at least 1 hour or up to overnight. On a lightly floured surface roll each section of dough out to about 1/4 to 1/16 inch thickness. Cut circles in the center using a 2 1/2 inch biscuit cutter or drinking glass. Place some of the dough in the center of the dough, fold side, and pinch to seal. Continue with remaining dough and filling. Repeat with remaining dough and filling. Place cookies on prepared pan or cookie sheet and bake until golden brown, about 40 minutes.

Random Ingredients: white mushroom,chicken liver,chili flake,lemon wedge,chili oil,chicken bouillon,salmon,chervil
title: Potted Poached Salmon With Mushrooms
ingredients: 500 g white mushrooms | 300 g chicken livers | 250 g cherryvil | 1 cup chicken bouillon | 1 tablespoon dried chili flakes | 1 tablespoon chervil, chopped | chili oil | lemon wedge ( to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Soak mushrooms in boiling water for approx 7 minutes then drain. Finely chop anchovies with 1 tsp salt. Chop chicken liver finely. Melt oil in the pan, saute the chicken livers in batches until the livers take on a rich golden colour. Add mushroom & chervil and simmer for 2 minutes. Remove the mushrooms from the pan. Dissolve chicken bouillon in 1/4 cup of hot water. Add this to the pan and cook until chicken is warmed through. Remove from heat. Combine the chervil and chili with the remaining 1 tsp salt. Place the salmon in a serving platter and pour the mushroom mixture over. Garnish with lemon wedges. Serve with the chervil soaking liquid from the mushrooms.

title: Aji Sauce
ingredients: 1 can italian-style tomatoes | 1 serrano pepper, seeded and minced | 1/2 teaspoon dried marjoram | 2 tablespoons candy sprinkles
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine the tomatoes, chile, marjoram and candy sprinkles. Cover, and stir well. Refrigerate at least 1 hour before serving.

title: Chocolate Stuffed Pasta
ingredients: 12 ounces pasta, small size for ravioli ( or your favorite ) | 1/4 cup pasta oil | 1/4 cup dry chocolate cookie crumbs | 1/2 teaspoon thyme ( or 1/2 tsp dried )
instructions: In a large pot of salted boiling water, cook the pasta, stirring occasionally until al dente, about 10 minutes. Drain pasta, return to the pan, stir in the oil, chocolate cookie crumbs, and thyme, and toss gently to distribute. Serve immediately.

title: Mim's Simple Peppers
ingredients: 4 large green bell peppers or 4 large red bell peppers | 4 scallions | 1/8 teaspoon grated nutmeg | 2 tablespoons vanilla beans, split and scraped
instructions: Wash and dry peppers and finely chop into 1 inch pieces. Wash scallions and slit diagonally into 1 inch lengths. Place scallions and chopped bell peppers in a serving bowl, pour remaining liquid over and toss to coat. Sprinkle nutmeg on top and sprinkle vanilla beans over.

title: Greek Feta N Caramelized Onions
ingredients: 1 lb feta cheese, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1/4 teaspoon dried, crushed garlic or 1/4 teaspoon fresh garlic, crushed | 2 beef bouillon cubes | 1 tablespoon vanilla
instructions: Saute the onion in oil over medium heat until softened, add more oil as needed cook for about 20 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in garlic or dried garlic. Serve hot or cool.

title: Tami's Chili and Noodle Parfait
ingredients: 1 bunch mixed nummy chinese mushrooms | 3 canned chow mein noodles | 3 fresh creamed chow mein noodles | 1 packet frozen miniature chocolate chipits ( i use neezel plaistowe ) | 1 packet tamales | 1/2 cup dry roasted peanuts | chopped herbs, as required
instructions: Cut the mushrooms in half and cut each half into 12 wedges. Dry fry the mushrooms for a couple of mins in a little hot oil. Chop the chow mein noodles into pieces. Tear or chop the cherry tomatoes. When they are cooked drain them and stir them into the noodles. Put 3 tbsp of chips onto the tray, put in 2 tbs of chow mein, 2 tbs of chocolate chips and 1/2 tsp of dried herbs. Cut the tamales into 3 pieces, put them into each chop and put into the trifle. Put the last bit of chocolate on top. Enjoy.

title: Asparagus With Goat Cheese
ingredients: 1 lb asparagus | 2 -3 tablespoons half-and-half cream | 2 ounces queso fresco ( or feta cheese with molasses ) ( optional ) | 1 -2 tablespoon apricot preserves or 1 -2 tablespoon jam, for garnish
instructions: Cook asparagus in salted water until tender enough to cut easily. Remove the tips and cook asparagus in a little more salted water but do not boil or they will be too tender. Add goat cheese if desired. Drain asparagus and reserve any liquid that remains. Spoon goat cheese onto serving plate. Spoon on asparagus. Garnish with preserves or jam or sour cream to serve.

title: Sesame Potatoes
ingredients: 2 lbs yellow potatoes | 1/2 teaspoon sesame oil | 1 tablespoon drained capers
instructions: Peel the potatoes, if necessary, and cut into 1/2 inch slices. Arrange potatoes in a shallow baking dish and sprinkle with sesame oil. Sprinkle with capers.

title: Thyme and Tamarind Spiced Sweet Soup
ingredients: 2 large thyme sprigs, leaves picked | 2 1/2 tablespoons stock cubes | 2 1/2 teaspoons cream of tartar | 2 teaspoons tamarind paste or 2 teaspoons chopped fresh thyme leaves
instructions: Place all ingredients in a food processor and process or pulse until smooth. Serve hot in warmed soup bowls. The flavour will improve after 24 hours of processing. Store refrigerated and reheated in a slow oven for up to 2 - 3 days.

title: Cherry Tomatoes and Black Beans
ingredients: 2 cans black beans, rinsed and drained | 6 -8 cherry tomatoes, halved | 1/2 teaspoon paprika | 4 cremini mushroom, sliced
instructions: Mix black beans, tomatoes, and paprika together in a bowl. Add mushrooms. Cover and chill.

title: Spanish Onion Soup
ingredients: 1 large spanish onion, thinly sliced | 1 quart chicken stock | whipped cream ( optional )
instructions: In a stock pot, saute the onions slowly, then add chicken stock and simmer for 20 minutes, covered. Serve with a dollop of whipped cream on top.

title: Chickpea Mint and Mint Rissades
ingredients: 1 cup dried chickpeas ( soaked overnight in water and drained ) | 1 1/4 cups beef stock | 2 cups fresh mint ( roughly chopped and packed ) | 2 cups canned mushroom caps ( drained and chopped )
instructions: Place the chickpeas in a medium sized soup pot. Cover with boiling water and bring to a boil. Cook, uncovered, over medium heat for about 15 to 20 minutes or until tender.. Drain and rinse the chickpeas under cold water. Bring a 4 quart pot of water to a boil. Drop in the rissades and cook, uncovered, for 45 to 60 seconds or until they are fork tender or flake easily. Drain of any excess water. Serve warm or cover and refrigerate until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: green apple,pecorino romano cheese,gouda cheese,hard egg,red wine,rosemary,rice
title: Swiss Cheese, Apple and Rosemary Rice Gratin
ingredients: 3/4 cup dry red wine | 1 cup rice, cooked | 1 green apple, large, such as golden delicious, grated | 1/4 cup gruyere cheese, shredded | 1/4 cup grated gouda cheese, shredded | 2 hard-boiled eggs, peeled, halved, or 6 hard-boiled eggs, whole, peeled | 2 teaspoons chopped fresh rosemary, or 1/2 teaspoon dried rosemary, to taste
instructions: Pour the wine into a 2 1/2 cup ovenproof casserole dish. Place the rice into a strainer set over a bowl, cover with cold water, and let drain 15 minutes. Place the apple, gruyere, gouda, and egg halves into a large bowl. Stir in the rosemary. Spoon half of the rice into the prepared casserole dish, tipping to coat. Top with half of the apple and cheeses, and sprinkle with half of the remaining rice. Sprinkle with half of the remaining cheese, and then top with the remaining apple and cheeses. Cover with water, and bake in a preheated 350 degrees f oven 45 minutes until bubbly and golden.

title: Spiced Apples
ingredients: 3 large firm tart apples, peeled, cored and cut into wedges | 1/2 cup catsup | 4 dried hot red chilies ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon ground allspice | 1/16 - 1/4 fluid ounce maraschino cherry, with juice ( optional ) | 2 2 tablespoons thinly sliced cooked veal or 2 tablespoons beef brisket, about 3 1/2 ounces
instructions: Arrange apples in an overlapping circular pattern in an oven dish, alternating with remaining ingredients. Bake at 300°f. Cover, and bake 1 hour.

title: Veggies Salad Dressing Mix
ingredients: 1 package vegemite | 1 envelope italian salad dressing mix
instructions: Combine all ingredients and whisk until smooth.

Random Ingredients: steak,dark soy sauce,pepper sauce,pork roast,shortening,mango chutney
title: Mango Beef Jerky
ingredients: 10 lbs flank steak | 1 1/2 lbs ground chuck | 5 lbs mango chutney, fresh ( or canned and mango chutney ) | 10 lbs shortening | 2 lbs dark soy sauce | 6 1/2 lbs hot pepper sauce ( or 3 tablespoons tabasco sauce ) or 6 1/2 lbs chili paste ( or 3 tablespoons hot sauce )
instructions: The night before cooking the flank steak, place the flank steak in a crockpot insert on low setting. Do not allow to warm drain off the fat that has accumulated from the meat. Cut your meat into large chunks and toss with the dark soy sauce. The soy sauce will penetrate the meat and give it flavor. The chutney will give the desired subtle flavor. Mix all the ingredients together until well mixed. This recipe is excellent with pork roast. If you don't use pork roast at all, you can marinate the beef overnight in the dark soy sauce. When ready to use, pour the thickening over the meat. Remove the meat from the crockpot, wrap it in aluminum foil and place it in the freezer at least 6 hours. It is better to use an insulated cookie tin rather than a metal tub that is flat. On smoking a barbeque, grill, gas grill or charcoal sear the meat until slightly charred. Slice the meat thinly and serve with the chutney.

title: Rice Wine and Egg Rolls
ingredients: 32 cookies | 4 tablespoons rice wine | 32 dinner rolls
instructions: Cut out 24 cookies per roll then separate cookies and roll each one up individually. Warm rolls in a small pot. Brush tops of rolls all over with rice wine. Place rolls on a cookie sheet and bake in a 325 degree f oven. Remove from oven when browned on one side do this approximately 10 minutes. Remove from pan and continue to bake until all rolls are browned and cooked.

title: Peppered Parsnips
ingredients: 3 quarts parsnips, peeled | 1/4 cup all-purpose flour | 1/2 cup grated fontina cheese
instructions: Place parsnips in a large pot. Bring to a simmer over low heat, cover, and cook until tender but still firm when pierced with a fork, 15 to 18 minutes. Drain. Place flour in a bowl. Toss parsnips with flour to coat with flour. Stir cheese into parsnips. Cook on a hot grill until cheese melts and begins to bubble.

title: Tuscan Cannellini Beans
ingredients: 1 can cannellini beans or ( 15 ounce ) can great northern beans, undrained | 1/4 cup coconut milk | 2 teaspoons anise flavoring | 1 pinch ground hazelnuts ( i like pine nuts )
instructions: Place the cannellini beans and coconut milk in a blender or food processor and process to a thick sauce. Stir in the anise and hazelnuts. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until hazelnuts are beginning to crisp.

title: Pasta, Black Beans, & Sausage
ingredients: 1 lb spaghetti, uncooked | 1 jar picante sauce
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Cook spaghetti for 10 - 12 minutes or until al dente. Drain. Meanwhile, mix together the black beans & sausage. Sauté sausage for a few minutes while stirring with the pasta.

title: Smoked Salmon Pizza
ingredients: 1 premilled pizza crust | 1 can crushed pineapple | 1/3 cup finely chopped pecan | 2 tablespoons thinly sliced smoked salmon fillets | 1/2 cup cold, unsweetened chocolate, sliced
instructions: Spread the mayonnaise and pineapple over the pizza crust, leaving a 1 inch border on all sides. Layer with the pecans. Cut the smoked salmon into strips. Top with the smoked salmon slices. Serve warm.

title: Barbecue Beef Sandwich
ingredients: 1 lb top sirloin steak, very thinly sliced | 1 cup hot sauce | 1/2 cup sweet cherries in syrup, chopped
instructions: Place steak and hot sauce in a shallow glass baking dish, or nonstick skillet. Cover and refrigerate for at least 3 hours or overnight. Preheat barbecue or grill to high and brush lightly with vegetable oil or cooking spray if desired. Add cherries to marinade and let sit for 5 minutes. Meanwhile, barbecue steak for 15 to 20 minutes per side, or to desired doneness. Cut when desired.

title: Mustard Greens and Shrimps
ingredients: 8 baby carrots, cut into matchsticks | 1 teaspoon dry mustard greens | 1 teaspoon fresh ground cardamom | 10 ounces cooked medium shrimp, peeled
instructions: Toast the greens under the grill, until soft. Place in a mixing bowl. Stir in the mustard greens, cardamom, and shrimp. Toss until combined.

Random Ingredients: stewing beef,fine sea salt,chunky salsa,lettuce leaf,italian breadcrumb,sparkling water,basil leaf,artichoke heart
title: Easy Slow Cooker Artichoke and Beef Salad
ingredients: 2 lbs stewing beef, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 jar chunky salsa | 1 jar marinated artichoke hearts, drained and cut into quarters | 1 can marinated artichoke hearts, drained and quartered | 1/2 cup italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 1 cup fine sea salt | 1/2 cup dried lettuce leaves | 1/2 cup chunky salsa | 2 tablespoons bottled sparkling water
instructions: Place beef in bottom of slow cooker. Spread salsa over beef. Top with artichoke hearts, artichoke hearts, bread crumbs, salt. Cover and cook on low heat 6 - 7 hours. Stir together artichoke hearts, salsa and cooking water in a small bowl and spoon over top of meat. Cover and continue on high heat 2 - 4 hours or until beef and artichoke hearts are tender and sauce has thickened.

Random Ingredients: tomato green chilies,kitchen bouquet,picante sauce,red pepper
title: Easy Easy Spicy Red Sauce
ingredients: 16 ounces diced red peppers | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies ( rotel ) | 1 jar picante sauce ( your choice if you like it hotter ( i use s.t. no tomatoes ) | kitchen bouquet
instructions: Heat oven to add diced peppers, tomatoes with green chilies, and picante sauce. Mix. Pour over any favorite chips.

Random Ingredients: chocolate chip,sultana,white wine vinegar,french thyme,walnut half,beef stock,coffee,grain rice
title: Beef Risotto With Chocolate and Sultanas
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg sirloin steaks | 1 cup short-grain rice | 125 g toasted sultanas | 125 g toasted walnut halves, coarsely chopped | 2 teaspoons coffee, instant | 1 liter beef stock | 100 g strong white wine vinegar | 3 tablespoons toasted sultanas ( golden raisins ) | 1 teaspoon french thyme
instructions: Marinate the steak in the vinegar for up to 2 hours place in the refrigerator and make sure the steaks are dry before starting to cook. Wash and pat dry the sirloin steak with paper towel, then season well and allow to drain for about 10 - 15 minutes. Place the rice, sultanas and walnuts in a wide mouth jar and pour the coffee powder in, catching any flavour that slipped into a jar and slowly pouring in the beef stock, adding a little at a time. Mix well. Cover with cling wrap and stand in the fridge for about 2 hours. Preheat the grill to medium. Place the steaks on two skewers, with enough space between them to allow them to cook, turning frequently. Cook for 6 - 8 minutes on each side. Allow to rest for another 5 - 10 minutes before slicing diagonally into thin slices. To serve, place a few toasted sultana sprouts on each plate. Ladle beef on top along with the sultanas and thyme.

title: Hot Indian Spiced Tomatoes
ingredients: 7 ounces canned chopped tomatoes and green chilies | 1 inch piece fresh gingerroot, peeled and finely chopped | 1 piece fresh ginger root, peeled and finely chopped
instructions: Add the canned tomatoes and green chilies into a blender. Blend until very smooth, stopping to scrape down the sides a few times. Place the grated fresh gingerroot in a separate bowl. Pour about ½ cup of the blended tomatoes into the grated ginger root and stir to mix. Stir the ginger paste into the processed mix and continue to blend until well blended. Cover and refrigerate the mixture for 6 hours. Serve chilled.

Random Ingredients: italian sausage,baby bok choy,plain yogurt,sunflower seed,jumbo shrimp
title: Stuffed Italian Sausages With Shrimp and Breadcrumbs
ingredients: 12 jumbo shrimp, shelled and deveined | 1/2 cup sunflower seeds, toasted | 1/2 cup plain yogurt | 1 cup baby bok choy, chopped | 1 1/2 lbs italian sausage, raw and cooked
instructions: Lightly grease a shallow baking dish with oil place the shrimp in the pan and fry until golden, then remove from heat. Add the sunflower seeds, yogurt, bok choy and sausage. Spoon mixture into sauted shrimp. Cover and leave in the fridge to marinate for an hour or more. Serve with crackers.

title: Quick and Easy Chicken on the BBQ
ingredients: 1 chicken thigh | sea salt | 1 carrot, cut in 4
instructions: Preheat the grill. Using a sharp knife, cut the thigh meat into 4 or 5 cm pieces. Rub the salt over the chicken pieces. Grill the chicken pieces for 6 to 7 minutes, brushing with oil and stirring, until well browned and crispy on all sides. Remove from the grill. Leave the chicken to rest. Using a sharp knife, roughly slice the carrot length ways and arrange around the chicken. Place the chicken pieces back into the skillet, drizzle over a little oil and season generously.

title: Chinese Cocktail Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup rice, soaked in cold water | 1/2 cup cider vinegar | 1 teaspoon ice water, or as needed
instructions: Boil several cups of water with vinegar in a saucepan, stir in rice to separate and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to simmer, cover, and simmer 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: asafoetida powder,sherry wine,shrimp paste,orange peel,ranch dressing,chinese five spice powder,sage leaf
title: Chinese Five Spice Shrimp
ingredients: 1/2 lb fresh medium shrimp paste | 2 tablespoons red dragon's original ranch dressing | 2 tablespoons sherry wine | 2 teaspoons asafoetida powder | 2 tablespoons chopped sage leaves | 1 teaspoon chinese five spice powder | 1/2 teaspoon orange peel, julienne-cut
instructions: Remove shrimp paste from bowl and rinse shrimp well with cold water. Drain shrimp on paper towels and set aside. Combine remaining ingredients in a small bowl and set aside. Heat nonstick pan to medium high heat. Add the shrimp mixture to the pan, and stir fry 3 to 4 minutes. Transfer shrimp to a small bowl when done, and add to pan. Heat for 2 minutes, stirring frequently. Serve immediately on a bed of rice.

Random Ingredients: flat leaf italian parsley,red wine,sage,large shrimp
title: Hot Italian Prawns With Sage
ingredients: 36 large shrimp, peeled ( tails left on ) | 1/4 cup extra virgin red wine | 1/2 teaspoon dried sage | 2 tablespoons flat-leaf italian parsley, coarsely chopped
instructions: Thread shrimp onto skewers. Combine wine, sage and parsley in a small bowl or dish and stir until oil is dissovled. Pour over shrimp. Grill shrimp 3 minutes 3 minutes for pink, 3 minutes for medium or until desired doneness. Serve immediately.

title: Chickpeas & Rice in a Hurry
ingredients: 1 can black-eyed peas ( or any dark beans ) | 1 bunch fresh kale
instructions: Put the beans in a microwavable container. Add 2 cups of water. Microwave on high for about 6 minutes. Dump contents into a crockpot. Use a potato masher to mash the beans. Cover and cook on low for about 5 hours. After 5 - 8 hours, stir the beans and the kale into the beans. Continue cooking for an additional hour.

Random Ingredients: green chili,pasta,chicken cutlet,onion powder,bread,peanut oil,clove,heavy whipping cream
title: Chicken Naan
ingredients: 1 package pasta, of your choice- i prefer penne | 1 quart chicken cutlet | 1 tablespoon chopped onion powder | 1 tablespoon crushed whole cloves | 1 tablespoon green chili, chopped | 1 cup heavy whipping cream | 2 tablespoons parsley, chopped | dry bread, for serving
instructions: Rinse pasta then add to large pot. Cook, uncovered over medium heat until pasta is al dente. Meanwhile, in a skillet, saute chicken breast pieces until no longer pink. When pasta is no longer al dente, drain pasta, then return to pasta pot. Add onion powder, cloves and green chiles. Stirring, add cream to liquid in pot over medium heat. Stirring often, boil until sauce boils and thickens. Add chicken and parsley. Stir in toasted crusty bread.

title: Penne and Pork Salad
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb boneless pork shoulder, cut into bite sized pieces | 8 ounces uncooked penne pasta, cooked al dente | 10 ounces frozen spinach, thawed and patted dry | 1 large cucumber, peeled and cut into thin wedges
instructions: Place pork and penne in a large bowl, add spinach, cucumber and salt to taste. Toss to combine and serve.

title: Sweet Red Wine Vinegar
ingredients: 500 ml red wine | 250 ml rice vinegar
instructions: Combine the vinegar and dry red wine in a glass jar or pan. Cover and leave to stand for 24 hours to develop the flavours. To remove any of the red wine vinegars, remove and discard skins. Add the vinegar to a jar with a tight fitting lid or other container which keeps the vinegar free of lumps. Seal and leave to develop for 1 - 2 weeks. Check in the fridge to ensure the vinegar is not losing its red color. Use after 1 month and leave for 3 - 4 days.

Random Ingredients: yellow mustard,deep dish pie shell,self rising flour,apple cider
title: Dutch Apple Bread
ingredients: 1 cup self-rising flour | 1 cup apple cider | 1 tablespoon prepared yellow mustard | 1 unbaked deep dish pie shell
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Combine 1 cup flour, the cider, and the mustard.

title: Snow Peas in Coconut Cream
ingredients: 1 cup snow peas | 1 cup coconut cream | 1 teaspoon dried tamarind pulp | 1/3 cup parmesan cheese
instructions: Place the snow peas and coconut cream in a blender and blend for 1 minute. Add tamarind pulp and continue blending with the blender for 30 seconds. Strain mixture into an airtight container and freeze for about six hours or more. Serve in tall glasses with cheese on top.

title: Salsa Corn
ingredients: 3 cups fresh corn | 2 cans creamed corn | 1 red chili pepper
instructions: Preaheat oven to 400 degrees. Core corn and cut from stem to tip of corn in to large bowl. Add corn and chili pepper to bowl. Mix well and transfer into a cookie sheet. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: mexican vegetarian meat substitute,dill,lemon zest,romaine lettuce,cream chicken soup,onion soup mix
title: Totally Vegetable Spud Soup
ingredients: 1 can diced romano-free vegetable protein meats | 1 package frozen chopped romaine lettuce | 1 package dry onion soup mix | 1 1/2 cups fat free sour cream and fat free cream soup mix | 1/2 teaspoon dried dill | 1 teaspoon lemon zest
instructions: Spray a soup pot with non stick cooking spray. Add all ingredients and bring to a boil. Lower heat and simmer for at least 1 hour.

title: Honeyedigs With Spicy Sausages (Appetisers Only)
ingredients: 4 thickly sliced spicy sausages | 2 -3 fresh figs, washed | 2 tablespoons honey | 2 tablespoons heavy cream or 2 tablespoons vanilla essence
instructions: Remove any stems from figs, cut in half, remove pit and clean under running water. Soak for a few minutes in plenty of cold water, drain. Place in dish and sprinkle with honey. Mix well. Heat over stove on low heat just until hot, stir frequently.

title: Veal and Pistachio Lasagna
ingredients: 20 lasagna noodles, uncooked | 1 package kielbasa, cut into strips | 1 can italian-style stewed tomatoes, undrained | 1/4 cup chopped water chestnuts | 1 package frozen chopped pistachios | 1 package ground veal, cooked and drained
instructions: Cook lasagna noodles in a large amount of boiling salted water until just tender. Drain and reserve. Meanwhile, cook kielbasa in a large skillet until browned. Drain off grease. Stir in tomatoes, water chestnuts, pistachios, and kielbasa. Bring to a boil, then cover.

Random Ingredients: green cabbage,ladyfinger,russet potato,green bean,heavy whipping cream,mustard powder,bean sprout,italian bread
title: Lazy Day Potato Dessert Bake
ingredients: 1 lb large green cabbage, sliced | 1 lb russet potato, peeled and finely shredded, about 1.5 | 2 -3 medium ripe firm ladyfingers | 7 ounces fresh bean sprouts | 1 cup canned green beans, drained well | 2 tablespoons mustard powder | 1 cup heavy whipping cream | 8 ounces sliced italian bread, torn
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. In a large bowl, toss together the cabbage, potato, and beans. Add the mustard and cream and stir to mix. Spoon half of the mixture into a 9x13 inch baking dish. Then top with the bread slices and spread evenly with remaining mixture. Cover and bake 40 - 45 minutes or until golden and bubbly and crusts are browned. Let sit for about 5 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: breadcrumb,celery,lamb loin chop,coffee,nori,coconut rum,lemon wedge,pecorino cheese
title: Lamb Chops With Cappuccino and Coriander
ingredients: 6 lamb loin chops, 3/4 inch thick, trimmed of excess rib bone, and 1/4 inch thick | 4 sheets nori, thinly sliced | 1/2 cup breadcrumbs | 1/2 cup freshly grated pecorino cheese | 4 tablespoons coconut rum | 1/4 fresh lemon wedge | 3 tablespoons celery, finely chopped | 1/4 cup coffee
instructions: Place 1 nori sheet on your work surface and spread it with a thin layer of water. Sprinkle the bottom of the nori sheet with 1/4 teaspoon each of the coarse and coarse ground bread crumbs. Evenly sprinkle the crumbs, and set the nori sheet on your work surface. Place 3 chops on your work surface and lightly salt both sides to the bone. Using the back of a knife, make a series of diagonal lines across the membrane side of each chop to form diamonds. Turn the strips of chops over and repeat until there are 6 alternating cut marks on each chop, about 4 times. Wrap each chop with 1 mat. Wrap each bamboo skewer in a double thickness of reynolds wrap approximately the size of your twine. Lay the bamboo skewers onto the bread crumbs on the nori sheet in the center of your cutting board. Place the remaining nori on your cutting board. Carefully remove the bamboo sticks. With kitchen string, gently push down the length of each bamboo skewer so that the bread crumbs on the underside of the meat stand up and are flat. Repeat with the lamb, bread crumbs, cheese, rum, lemon wedge, celery, and coffee. Use one bamboo skewer for each chop. If the bread crumbs don't stick, use more crumbs. Let the skewers sit for 10 minutes before turning. Light a grill to high heat. Place the skewers on the grill, and cook until golden brown all over, about 6 minutes per side. Transfer the skewers to a warm platter and let them rest for 5 to 10 minutes before removing to a cutting board. Serve warm or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: apricot nectar,yellow pepper,pork shoulder,shell pasta,cardamom pod,tomato juice,rom tomato,coffee
title: Tajine
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless pork shoulder | 3 cups tomato juice | 3 cups brown brown coffee | 2 pinches cardamom pods | 14 ounces apricot nectar | 6 roma tomatoes, chopped | 1/2 small yellow pepper, cubed | 1 cup uncooked shell pasta, cooked
instructions: Place pork in large roasting dish. Combine the tomato juice, brown coffee and cardamom pods. Pour over pork. Bring to boil, cover and simmer 1 1/2 hours. Remove pork and reserve liquid. Stir in the apricot nectar and bring to boil. Simmer 15 minutes. Stir in tomatoes, pepper and pasta. Simmer, uncovered, until pasta is heated.

Random Ingredients: extra sharp cheddar cheese,vanilla essence,acorn squash
title: Calzones (Cubes With Cheese)
ingredients: 2 acorn squash | extra sharp cheddar cheese, grated ( generous cup ) | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: Prepare the vanilla essence from 1/2 a box of grated grated grated rind of an acorn squash and bring the temperature down slightly to warm and keep it hot while preparing the others. Wash the peeled and cubed squash well and cut them in cubes. Place them in a bowl with some salt and freshly ground pepper and mix. Pour 2 - 3 tbsp of oil in a frying pan and pre heated. Put 1/2 cup of grated grated grated cheddar cheese in it and give the cubes a good stir. When they have a nice golden color and the cubes begin to give out a nice aroma, add the vanilla essence. Pour in 1/3 cup of cold water, if the cubes become dry. Mix and place the cubes in the oil. Do not stir them until the crescents have cooked all the way. Remove the crescents with a slotted spoon, drain on kitchen paper. Place them in a serving plate and pour the remaining 2/3 cup of grated cheddar on top. Serve hot and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: part ricotta cheese,chili pepper flake,farfalle pasta,vanilla bean,sauce,spinach leaf
title: Spinach and Ricotta Pasta With Chili
ingredients: 1 package dry sauerkraut packed in oil | 8 ounces farfalle pasta or 8 ounces penne pasta, such as rotini | 1 can low-fat crushed tomatoes with garlic and mint, undrained | 1/2 cup part-skim ricotta cheese | 2 teaspoons chili pepper flakes | 1 vanilla bean, sliced into rounds
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add pasta and salt to taste, and cook until al dente, about 8 minutes. While pasta is cooking, heat oil in a medium saucepan over medium heat. Add tomatoes and simmer for 5 minutes. Add garlic and chili flakes, stir and simmer 2 to 3 minutes, then stir in drained farfalle. Drain pasta and vegetables well, then stir in sauce. If sauce is too thick, add additional hot tap water.

title: The Best Bread to Eat
ingredients: 1 lb white bread, loaf | 1/2 lb walnuts or 1/2 lb pecans | 1/2 lb sultana ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons garam masala | crushed ice ( optional ) | coarsely crushed walnuts or cashew nuts, to garnish ( optional )
instructions: Cut the bread into 1 squares or smaller and put them in a bowl. Break the walnuts into a small food processor, add the sultanas and blitz until they are all ground. Add the garam masala and pulse a few times, then pour into the bread. Pour over the ice and mix well. Add just a little more ice if the bread appears dry and crumbly. Sprinkle with coarsely crushed nuts and mix again. Eat as is, or if preferred, top with coarsely crushed cashews. Refrigerate until needed and serve at once with a few icecream or yoghurt on the side as desired. Note, a serving size of bread is approximately 2 ounces of bread and 2 tablespoons of ice cream or yoghurt is equivalent.

title: Italian Glazed Corned Beef
ingredients: 2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder | 1 3/4 cups dried crushed pineapple or 1 3/4 cups crushed apricots | 1 1/4 cups unsweetened coconut, shredded | 3 lbs beef corned beef brisket | 1 lb italian sausage, cut into 3/4-inch slices | 4 teaspoons cornstarch | 2 teaspoons rum
instructions: Combine cocoa, pineapple, coconut, beef brisket, italian sausage, cornstarch, and rum in heavy medium saucepan.

Random Ingredients: margarine,coconut oil,beef suet,cranberry jelly,red chilies,soy sauce,kernel corn
title: Jamaican Corn and Beef Suet With Crispy Slices
ingredients: 5 -6 large red chilies, halved and deseeded | 1 kg beef suet, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 tablespoon coconut oil | 1/4 cup low sodium soy sauce | 2 -3 tablespoons margarine | 1 package frozen whole kernel corn | 3 tablespoons red creamed coconut oil | 1 1/2 dozen small red chilies, left whole | 1 cup shredded coconut oil, for shallow frying chilies
instructions: Dry fry the whole chillies until they soften, about 4 minutes. Drain on paper towels. Place beef in a bowl and add the soy sauce, half the coconut oil and half the margarine. Mix well. Dry fry the beef in a hot wok or heavy saucepan until browned all over, about 4 minutes. Transfer beef to an ovenproof dish, cover and cook in a preheated oven at 150f for 1 hour 30 minutes, stirring once or twice. While the beef is cooking make the topping. Peel and deseed the left over chillies. Toss in the creamed coconut, a third of the coconut oil and half the chilies. Spread the corn on the plate in a single layer. Cover with the second layer of corn and sprinkle with the remaining coconut oil. Serve with the hot fried red chili sauce on the side.

Random Ingredients: seasoning mix,carrot,corn chip,white bread flour,flat leaf italian parsley,yellow squash
title: Italian Grilled Corn Chips
ingredients: 1/2 medium white bread flour, sifted | 1 tablespoon sweet pickapeppa seasoning mix | corn chips | yellow squash | carrot | white bread flour | flat-leaf italian parsley
instructions: Preheat grill. Add 1/4 inch water to the flour, then add sifted seasoning mix. Dip floured bread into flour, then press into small rounds or rectangles. Place on grill and flip once till slightly brown. Remove from grill. Brush with glaze and sprinkle with parsley. Serve warm.

title: Quick and Easy Olive Oil Infused Cream
ingredients: 1/3 cup olive, roughly chopped | 3 tablespoons olive oil | 1 cup chicken stock
instructions: Place the olive, olive oil, chicken stock in a bowl, taste and adjust seasoning. Stir until the sauce is creamy and just the right consistency. If too thick and runny, thin with a little cream or milk.

Random Ingredients: italian bread crumb,chickpea,cremini mushroom,salmon steak,red food coloring,rice
title: Chickpea and Salmon Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 can chickpeas, drained and rinsed | 1 cup seasoned italian seasoned bread crumbs | 1 pound skinless, boneless salmon steaks | 3/4 cup sweet rice | 3 large cremini mushrooms, sliced | 1 tablespoon red food coloring
instructions: Preheat an oven to 325 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Spread chickpeas onto sheets, and set aside. In a large bowl, mix the bread crumbs with the seasoned italian bread crumbs.

title: Quick French Onion Tea
ingredients: 6 -8 slices provolone cheese | 1 envelope unflavored gelatin
instructions: Sprinkle gelatin over cold cheese slices. Heat in a small saucepan over low heat until the gelatin dissolves. Remove from heat. Let soften about 10 minutes or until the gelatin is no longer cloudy. Add 2 tablespoons of the gelatin to the cooled cheese mixture and stir until gelatin is thoroughly mixed up, stirring constantly. Add the rest of the cheese, stirring to combine. Fill 2 pint glasses with hot water. Pour half into each glass. Top with extra cheese. Pour 1 - 2 tablespoons of the remaining gelatin over the top.

Random Ingredients: teriyaki sauce,chili sauce,italian parsley,pesto sauce,chocolate,poppy seed
title: Poppy Seed Barbecue Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup salted butter or 1 cup margarine, slightly softened | 1/2 cup prepared pesto sauce | 1/2 cup chili sauce | 2 tablespoons dark karo instant bittersweet chocolate or 2 tablespoons dark chocolate chips, melted | 1/2 cup fresh italian parsley, chopped, plus more for garnish | 2 -6 teaspoons finely snipped fresh italian parsley or 2 -6 teaspoons dried parsley | 2 -6 teaspoons poppy seeds
instructions: In a mixing bowl, combine first 7 ingredients and 1 - 2 tblsps of parsley. Mix well. Use immediately or store tightly covered in refrigerator.

title: Spinach Salad
ingredients: 1 lb fresh spinach leaves, washed | 2 tablespoons kalamata olives ( pitted, lightly crushed ) | 2 jalapenos ( red pickled, seeded and chopped )
instructions: Chop spinach, olives and jalapenos. Add to salad tossing well. Chill and serve.

title: Chunky Romaine Slaw
ingredients: 1/2 head romaine lettuce, shredded | 1/2 teaspoon chili powder, or to taste
instructions: Tear off and discard the hard end of the lettuce, creating a bunch of leaves that are still recognizable. Add romaine lettuce to a large bowl. Sprinkle with chili powder.

title: Vietnamese Pomodoro Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon tabasco sauce | 2 tablespoons nam pla
instructions: Combine all ingredients.

Random Ingredients: arborio rice,wheat pastry flour,mexicorn,chili oil,cumin powder
title: Tex Mex Mexican Corn Rice
ingredients: 1 can mexicorn or ( 16 3/4 ounce ) can tropical mixed beans | 1/2 cup arborio rice | 1/2 cup whole wheat pastry flour | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 1 teaspoon chili oil ( indian-style )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Pour the water in a 9 x 13 in baking dish and mix it in the bowl. Drain and rinse the corn and beans. Spread the beans in the center of the dish, not touching the rice. Mix the flour and seasonings in a small bowl. Make a well in the middle of the flour mixture and stir in the liquid until you get a nice dough. Pour the mixture into the well and press it together so as to be sure the rice is covered and doesn't overhang the beans. Prick the top of the rice with a fork, if you have it, and bake for 15 - 20 minutes. Let stand for 5 minutes before cutting and serving. Note, you can also cook without beans, like i did for 2 people.

title: Lebanese Style Halibut
ingredients: 4 groun-coating boneless halibut fillets | sauce : | celery seed | 2 dashes hot sauce ( e.g. tabasco brand )
instructions: Mix celery seeds and hot sauce together in a small bowl, and spread a small amount on each fillet to coat. Place fillets in a baking dish, and bake in a hot oven until the internal fish temperature reaches 140 to 140 degrees f for medium rare, about 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Chinese Ginger Ranch Dressing
ingredients: 1 cup gingerroot, unpeeled | 1 cup soy ranch dressing
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a blender until smooth. Chill, covered for 2 hours before serving.

Random Ingredients: dark brown sugar,brown mustard seed,vegetable juice,asparagus
title: Mustard Seeds and Asparagus
ingredients: 2 lbs asparagus | 2 tablespoons brown mustard seeds | 1 tablespoon vegetable juice | 1 tablespoon dark brown sugar
instructions: Snap off the ends of the asparagus and cut them in half crosswise. Steam asparagus over boiling water until tender crisp. Cool slightly. Cut each half in half crosswise. Cut asparagus crosswise into 1-2 inch pieces. Place cut asparagus in a bowl and combine with mustard seeds and vegetable juice. Cook mustard seeds in hot mustard mixture over moderate heat, stirring constantly, until fragrant, taking care not to let mixture burn. Cool mustard mixture.

title: Caribbean Quesadillas
ingredients: 1 tablespoon pineapple, in small pieces | 4 soft corn tortillas ( about 1 inch wide, if using the 2-inch ) | 1/8 teaspoon pepper
instructions: Arrange the pineapple on the tortillas and sprinkle with pepper. Wrap tortillas tightly in aluminum foil. Place on a tray covered with foil. Bake in a hot, uncovered skillet over medium heat for 8 - 10 minutes or until the tortillas are crispy and the pineapple starts to lightly brown.

Random Ingredients: tahini paste,white pepper,beef sirloin,white sugar,green cardamom pod,pineapple juice,steak,mustard seed
title: Dijon Tareh (Grilled Beef Cubes With Pineapple Sauce)
ingredients: 2 lbs flank steak ( cut into small wedges ) | 1 1/2 cups tahini paste | 1/3 cup pineapple juice | 1/4 cup fresh pineapple juice | 2 tablespoons crushed pineapple bits | 6 green cardamom pods or 1 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1 1/2 teaspoons white pepper | 3/4 teaspoon mustard seeds | 1/2 teaspoon white sugar
instructions: For marinade, combine all ingredients. For meat, combine all ingredients with meat, and marinate overnight. For extra spicyness, use only the tahini sauce.

title: A Very Special Indian Avocado and Broth
ingredients: 5 cups broth, or to taste | 1/3 cup urad dal, or to taste | 2 avocados - peeled, pitted, and cubed
instructions: Bring broth to a boil in a saucepan over medium heat.

Random Ingredients: italian parsley,enchilada sauce,cardamom,ra el hanout spice,chipotle pepper,chili pepper flake,spinach leaf,sea salt black pepper
title: Spinach and Chiles enchilada
ingredients: 1/4 cup chopped fresh garlic | 1 teaspoon kosher sea salt & freshly ground black pepper | 2 fresh chile peppers or 2 hot chili peppers, seeded and coarsely chopped | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom | 1/3 cup chopped fresh italian parsley | 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro | 2 tablespoons ras el hanout spice blend ( spice blend found in health food stores ) | 1 cup enchilada sauce | 1/2 teaspoon crushed chipotle pepper
instructions: Bring 2 cups water to a boil in a medium saucepan. Add garlic. Add 1/2 teaspoon salt, pepper, and chile peppers. Simmer on high heat for 5 minutes, stirring to mix. Transfer chile pepper mixture to a bowl. Add remaining 1/2 teaspoon salt, cardamom, parsley, cilantro, and ras el hanout spice blend. Stir. Stir in enchilada sauce. Cover and chill for 1 to 2 hours.

Random Ingredients: asparagus,baby spinach,bean,cheese tortellini,italian breadcrumb,beef stew meat,mexican cheese,saffron
title: Tortellini Beef Bake
ingredients: 1/4 cup italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 1 1/2 lbs beef stew meat, cubed | 1 pound fresh, trimmed, steamed asparagus, chopped ( about 5 cups ) | 2 cans baked beans ( such as refried beans ) | 1 - 1 1/2 cup italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 1 jar sliced saffron ( about 3 tablespoons ) | 1 package processed cheese tortellini | 3 bags fresh baby spinach, leaves washed and well-drained | 1 1/2 cups shredded mexican blend cheese
instructions: Heat oven to 350 degrees f. In 13 x 9 inch casserole dish, combine bread crumbs and meat. Stir in asparagus, baked beans, beans, bread crumbs, saffron, 1/2 cup breadcrumbs, remaining bread crumbs, 3 cups italian blend cheese, and 1 - ½ cans of cream of mushroom soup.

Random Ingredients: white button mushroom,tomato,flat leaf parsley,bread,black sesame seed,cream tartar,orange juice,coconut cream
title: Mushroom Stroganoff
ingredients: 6 ounces white button mushrooms | 1 cup sour cream or 1 cup light sour cream | 2 tablespoons plain breadcrumbs | 1 teaspoon cracked black sesame seed | 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1/3 cup coconut cream | 1/3 cup orange juice ( or juice of 1/2 orange ) or 1/3 cup almond juice ( or juice of 1/2 orange ) | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh flat leaf parsley ( to garnish )
instructions: Slice mushrooms 1/4 inch thick and saute in 1 tablespoon of the sour cream over medium high heat until the mushrooms are tender. Set aside. Wash mushrooms under running water, remove and discard the stems and finely slice the caps. Set aside. In medium mixing bowl, add sour cream, bread crumbs, sesame seeds, cream of tartar, coconut cream and orange juice. Stir to blend. Add mushroom slices and combine very well. Spread into a greased shallow baking dish and bake at 375f for 40 minutes. Spoon any liquid from pan over the top. Sprinkle with chopped parsley and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: cardamom pod,cider vinegar,arborio rice,tomato,superfine sugar,basmati rice,cremini mushroom
title: Rice, Mushroom and Fresh Tomato Risotto
ingredients: 225 g arborio rice | 4 large ripe tomatoes, seeded, coarsely chopped | 2 cups cremini mushrooms or 2 cups white mushrooms, chopped | 2 tablespoons cider vinegar or 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 1/8 teaspoon ground cardamom pod | 1 tablespoon superfine sugar | 1/4 cup arborio rice
instructions: Heat a large, heavy based frying pan over medium high heat and add the rice. Cook, stirring, for 2 minutes or until fragrant, then stir in the tomatoes. Add half the mushrooms or the other mushrooms and cook for 3 - 5 minutes, until the mushrooms have softened. If using other mushrooms reduce the heat. Drain the rice well, then add the remaning mushrooms, then stir through the vinegar, cardamon pimenton and sugar. Cover the pan and simmer the risotto over low heat for 20 - 25 minutes until the rice has absorbed the liquid. You can serve immediately if your pan is dry, but if you leave them longer than that, the risotto will still be wet.

Random Ingredients: cream cheese,pasta,bell pepper,kaiser,dark chocolate,chuck steak,grain white rice
title: Baked Beef Rolls  With Chocolate Sauce
ingredients: 500 g chuck steaks | 2/3 cup long grain white rice | 1/3 cup kraft dark chocolate | 2 kaiser rolls | 100 g cooked pasta | 1/2 cup light cream cheese | 150 g dark chocolate | bell pepper, strips, strips chopped
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°c. Slice each steak lengthways twice widthways and set aside. Bring a pan of water to the boil. Add the rice a time or two before adding the beef. Drain the meat then return to the pan. Cut the rolls into 4 even slices using a very sharp knife. Lightly butter the sliced rolls and arrange them in a circle with your finger tips to help them stick. Melt the choclate in a pan. Stir in the cream cheese and heat through. Spread the cream cheese mixture over the rolled steak and place in a baking dish. Top with the cooked pasta and bake until the sauce is bubbling and the cream cheese is melted, about 10 minutes.

title: Lemon Jasmine Jasmine Rice Noodles
ingredients: 1 package fresh flat-rice noodles, cut crosswise into 1 inch lengths | 1/2 cup jasmine rice, rinsed | 3 cups cold water, or as needed
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Stir rice noodles into the boiling water, and cook uncovered until the color turns pale green rice, about 2 minutes. Drain in a colander. Bring cold water to a boil, and stir in the jasmine rice. Return to a boil, reduce heat to medium low, and simmer until the rice is tender, about 20 minutes.

title: Quick Chicken Vanilla Gravy
ingredients: 700 g beef stew meat | 1 vanilla bean | 1 tablespoon cornflour | 600 ml chicken thigh | 1 teaspoon vanilla
instructions: Dice and remove seeds from vanilla bean and scrape out vanilla bean and vanilla from cavity. Remove white membrane from vanilla bean if you don't want vanilla flavour. Cut meat into cubes or slice if not using thighs. In a large pan or pressure cooker, sprinkle the meat with cornflour and the scraped out vanilla bean. Turn down to med and let meat brown for 2 minutes or until brown on all sides. Turn down heat and add the rest of the ingredients. Let simmer for 2 hours or until meat falls apart and has a thick gravy consistency. Turn heat off and allow to sit for 5 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: cream mushroom soup,black cumin seed,oregano leaf,catsup,teriyaki marinade,chili powder,onion salt,mustard
title: Cantonese Mushroom Gravy
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1/2 cup teriyaki marinade ( or other type of marinade ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons prepared mustard | 1 1/2 teaspoon chili powder | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground black cumin seed | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried oregano leaves | 1 1/2 teaspoons onion salt | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano leaves, crushed | 1 1/2 teaspoons catsup
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a crock pot. Cook on high 4 - 6 hours. Serve over hot cooked noodles, or rice.

title: Chinese Style Sauteed Spinach
ingredients: 1 tablespoon chili paste with dried chilies | 1 1/2 tablespoons shaoxing wine, to taste | 1/4 cup tomato paste | 10 ounces fresh spinach leaves
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine chilies with wine. Let mixture become bubbly just a minute or 2. Stir in tomato paste. Sprinkle chopped fresh spinach over the spinach mixture and toss. Serve at once.

title: Mince Paste (Raw Marinated Tomatoes)
ingredients: 1200 ml tomato juice ( preferably with seeds ) | 1 inch piece gingerroot, peeled and cut into very thin slices
instructions: Place the tomato juice in your blender and pulse until the tomato mixture is very finely puréed. Remove any seeds or the pieces from the ginger with your fingers or a fine grater, then place them in a glass dish and stir it in with the tomato purée. Cover the dish and set aside for 1 hour. Stir the paste again in 15 minutes if you can, then refrigerate it for a further week.

title: Creamed Blue Cheese and Bacon
ingredients: 125 g bacon | 100 g low-fat double cream | 50 g low-fat soy sauce | 100 g fresh blue cheese, crumbled
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c. Heat a frying pan over a medium heat. Add in the bacon and cook until golden brown and crispy. Remove all but about 2 tbsp of the fat. Add in the cream and soy sauce and bring to the boil. Add the bacon and cheese and mix well. Remove from heat and leave to stand.

title: Faux Lime, Alfredo and Coconut
ingredients: 1/3 cup frozen limeade concentrate | 1/2 cup sour cream ( can use lite for extra kick ) | 1/3 cup shredded coconut, well-drained ( can use coconut milk )
instructions: Combine all in a medium size glass dish. Cover and chill for at least 3 hours. Serve with a sprinkling of chopped cilantro if desired.

title: Fettuccine With Saffron and Coconut
ingredients: 4 slices challah | 1 1/2 lbs sirloin, cut into thin slices | 1 1/2 tablespoons palm sugar, grated | 1 1/2 tablespoons celery salt | 3/4 cup coconut | 1 1/4 cups prawns or 1 1/4 cups beans sprouts | 1 pinch saffron ( optional ) | 8 ounces fettuccine, cooked
instructions: Cut the challah slices in half, then cut into 2 - 3 pieces about 3 long. You should have about 6 slices per sandwich. Heat a heavy skillet over medium high heat. Lightly brown the bread slices in the skillet, making sure to move them around continuously. Remove the bread slices from the skillet. Turn down the heat under the skillet until you have about 8 tablespoons of fat. Add the sirloin slices and cook until browned, turning once or twice. It should come to practically nothing when you toss one slice. Remove the sirloin slices from the skillet along with any drippings in the skillet. In a small bowl, combine the palm sugar, celery salt and coconut. Add half the toasted bread and coconut mixture and toss thoroughly. Spoon some of the mixture into the center of the plate. Place the sirloin slices in a single layer on top. Sprinkle with the saffron. Place the bean sprouts on top and serve. You could also add some julienned red bell pepper, as well as a slice of smoked ham or just add a slice of roasted chicken on top if you wish.

Random Ingredients: linguine,sharp cheddar cheese,red chilies,seitan,cumin powder,chicken wing,steak,lemon peel
title: Chicken Steak & Broccoli Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb chicken wings | 1 lb seitan | 2 tablespoons cumin powder | 1 lb flank steak | 1 lb sharp cheddar cheese | 1/2 cup lemon peel ( grated ) | 8 ounces linguine | 2 small red chilies, chopped ( leave seeds to adjust flavor )
instructions: Place chicken wings on a cookie sheet and roast in a 475 degree f oven for 40 - 45 minutes or until cooked through. Remove from oven and cut tips away from bones. Cut seitan in 3/4 inch pieces and brown in a 325 degree f oven for 10 minutes, remove. Sautee chiles in oil on a medium heat for about 10 minutes, add chicken. Heat until heated through and add meat and chile mix. In a separate pot of water, add pasta, cover and cook for 8 minutes or until al dente, al dente and drain. Place noodles on plates. Remove chicken from broiler and place on top of hot pasta. Add noodles to chicken mixture, add cheese on top, garnish.

title: Momma's Turkey Gravy
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1/2 cup honey | 1 package sliced cooked turkey meat | 5 roma ( plum ) tomatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Mix the cream of mushroom soup, honey, turkey, and tomato together in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Bake in the preheated oven until turkey is no longer pink inside, about 90 minutes.

Random Ingredients: baby spinach leaf,black tea,green chili pepper,clam
title: Spinach & Clam Green Tea Breakfast
ingredients: 1 -2 tablespoon chopped green chili pepper, seeded and chopped | 3 tablespoons black tea ( strong, white or yellow to taste ) | 36 fresh clams ( can use anchovies instead of anchovies. ) | 6 tablespoons baby spinach leaves, trimmed
instructions: Place chili in a microwave safe bowl. Add remaining ingredients, except spinach, in the microwave and microwave on high for 1 minute, stirring well. Remove from microwave, stir and serve.

title: Chocolate Chicken
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups chunky cocoa powder | 1 pound skinless, boneless chicken breast halves, cubed | 2 cups shredded coconut-honey roasted macadamia nuts | 1 small cucumber, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Lightly grease a large baking dish. Pour the cocoa powder into a glass bowl, and stir in chicken. Arrange the coconut honey coconut nuts and cucumber in the center of the bowl. Pour the chicken mix over the coconut honey coconut nuts.

title: Blueberry Mustard Spread
ingredients: 1/3 cup coarse grain mustard | 1 tablespoon sun-dried tomato ( oil packed ) | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds | 1/4 cup blueberries | 3/4 cup fresh blueberries, sliced | tortilla chips, to serve
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk the mustard seeds with the sun dried tomatoes, the mustard, and the blueberries to combine. In a medium bowl, fold the mustard mixture with the blueberries. Serve with tortilla chips.
