title: Cafe Tomatillo-Orange Chili Powder (Zwt Three)
ingredients: 2 medium tomatoes ( red ripe ) | cooking spray | 1/4 teaspoon cinnamon | 1/4 teaspoon red chile powder or 1/4 teaspoon new mexico chili powder | 16 dill, sprigs | 4 cloves, whole | 1 small orange, zest of, freshly juiced | 4 medium tomatillos
instructions: Rinse tomatillos in cold water. Set aside. Place tomatoes on a foil lined baking sheet & brush with cooking spray. Bake in preheated 350 degree f oven, turning once, until skins blistered & flesh is blistered, about 1 hour. Cool tomatoes slightly & peel. Cut crosswise into 1/4 inch thick slices. Place in a bowl. Add spices & zest. Stir gently to blend. Set aside. In a blender, combine 1/2 cup water, tomatoes, & zest.

title: Creamy Fish Cakes
ingredients: 14 ounces creamy tomato and basil pasta sauce | 2 tablespoons chopped of fresh basil, divided | 4 -6 fish fillets
instructions: Mix together the cream style tomato and basil sauce, 2 tbsp of the chopped basil, and 1 tbsp of the chopped fresh basil until all ingredients are mixed. Place a fillet in the centre of each steak and fold the mixture into a firm, even patty. Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour. Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Heat a medium sized non stick frying pan, on a medium heat, to medium high. Add the patties and cook until fish flakes easily. Serve immediately.

title: Fiesta Wraps
ingredients: 2 flour tortillas | 1 teaspoon cornflour | 1 teaspoon cornflour | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves
instructions: Mix the corn flour with water to form a paste. Lightly coat both sides of the tortillas with the cornflour paste. Heat a non stick pan or griddle on high heat. Place one tortilla on your skillet and spoon a little bit of the cornflour paste on top. Fry until the tortillas are golden brown on both sides. Cut into small pieces with a pizza cutter and serve warm.

title: Baked Mozzerella Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 package fresh mushrooms | 1/4 cup pesto sauce ( or homemade if that's all you have at hand... ) | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes ( or more, to taste ) | freshly grated swiss cheese | chopped fresh hot pepper ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 f. Wipe mushrooms with a damp towel.

title: Finger Fry Pizzas
ingredients: 2 cans of large frozen pizzas ( i like pre-made ) | 1 jar of finely chopped pimientos | 3 tablespoons taco seasoning | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil
instructions: Preheat pan with oil on high heat to 500°f. Using two deep curved spoons, place one can of prawns on each spoon. Spread prawns on both sides of the tortillas. Spread pimientos and taco seasoning on the prawns. Fold over and fry for 5 minutes or until prawns are cooked. Remove prawns from pan and place on paper towel to drain off excess oil before serving.

Random Ingredients: pork tenderloin,kielbasa,baby spinach,orange,brown rice,ginger powder,dark soy sauce,orecchiette
title: Teriyaki Chicken and Rice With Kielbasa
ingredients: 8 ounces kielbasa, slice 1 '' x 1/4 `` '' | 9 ounces orecchiette ( or your favorite pasta ) | 1/4 teaspoon orange rind, grated | 1 tablespoon soy sauce | 1 dash ginger powder | 2 1/2 cups brown rice, cooked or 2 1/2 cups arborio rice ( regular or gluten free ) | 1/2 - 3/4 cup baby spinach | 1/2 medium orange, cut into 4 wedges
instructions: Cut kielbasa into 1 inch/ 5'' pieces. Saute kielbasa over medium to high heat in an 8 - 10 oz saucepan with 1 tablespoon of the soy sauce and about 1/2 cup of water in the base of the pan, until the kielbasa just begins to brown. Add the uncooked rice, orange rind and orange juice in the pan. Bring mixture to a full boil and then reduce to a simmer. After 20 minutes, add the spinach and remove from heat. Serve over hot white rice with garnish of slivered orange chunks. Garnish with orange wedges if desired.

title: Faux Stuffed Eggplant (Aubergine)
ingredients: 6 large eggplants | 1 lb plums tomato | 1 jar sliced pimientos, with juice | 1 cup chopped ripe olives ( drained ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried savory | 1 1/2 teaspoons grated orange peel ( optional ) or 1 1/2 teaspoons citric acid ( optional ) | 2 cups shredded fat free low-fat thawed whipped topping
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Pierce eggplants in several places with a fork.

Random Ingredients: sage leaf,white vinegar,red food coloring,active yeast,nonfat milk,chipotle powder
title: Chipotle Herb - Salt Free, Overnight Baking Stalk Pretzel
ingredients: 3/4 cup nonfat milk | 1 teaspoon dried chipotle powder | 1 1/2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 1 1/2 cups nonfat dry milk, warmed | 2 cups white vinegar | 2 teaspoons dried chipotle powder | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon hot red food coloring | 12 fresh sage leaves ( optional )
instructions: Using spoon or hand mixer, mix the 3/4 cup milk and chipotle powder in small bowl. Sprinkle yeast over the milk and let stand until foamy, about 5 mins. In small mixer bowl stir 2 cups nonfat milk and remaining 3/4 cup nonfat dry milk with the 2 teaspoons dried chipotle powder and the hot red food coloring. Bring just to boil over medium low heat and stir in yeast mixture. Dough will be a wet foam foam which will form on top. Turn dough out onto a lightly floured board and knead 5 - 6 minutes. Place in a large, well buttered bowl and loosely cover with a cloth. Let rise in a warm, draft free place about 1 hour or until doubled. Punch dough down and form into a long roll. Place into a well buttered 10 x 5 baking dish and score with scissors. Place 1 cup sage leaves and 1/2 teaspoon each salt and pepper in slit. Place dough in baking dish, seam side down. Sprinkle with remaining 1/2 teaspoon chipotle powder. Cover baking dish and let rise until doubled, about 45 mins. Preheat oven to 425°f. Bake for 45 - 60 minutes, or until dough is puffy and lightly browned and has a hollow sound when tapped. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: cumin seed,half cream,poblano chile,red kidney bean,taco seasoning mix,skirt steak
title: Mexican-Style Steak and Refried Beans
ingredients: 1 cup canned red kidney beans, rinsed and drained | 2 ounces taco seasoning mix | 2 ounces whole milk half-and-half cream | 4 tablespoons poblano chiles, chopped | 4 thick-cut boneless skirt steaks
instructions: Combine the beans and 1 1/2 cups water in a large skillet and bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce the heat to low and cook, undisturbed, until most of the water is absorbed, about 10 minutes. Remove from the heat, cover, and set aside to keep warm. Meanwhile, using a fork, mash the remaining beans with a large pinch of salt. Stir the milk, poblano chiles, and 1/4 cup water into the beans. Heat until warm, but not boiling, about 3 minutes. Meanwhile, pat the skirt steak dry on both sides. Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Rub the steaks with the vegetable oil. Cook one steaks for 1 minute on each side, until well done. Using a slotted spoon, transfer the steaks to a cutting board and set aside. Discard any excess oil. Cook the steak, uncovered, about 3 minutes. Turn the heat to medium and pour in the refried beans. Cook for another 3 to 4 minutes, until the mixture thickens somewhat. Stir in the cooked steak and heat through. Serve with the remaining 1/4 cup water from the beans added to the skillet.

Random Ingredients: cold water,margarine,feta cheese,ham,red chili pepper flake,spinach leaf
title: Ham & Spinach Stew
ingredients: 1 lb fresh spinach leaves, washed | 1/2 cup margarine | 1 -2 dried red chili pepper flakes ( to taste ) | 1 tablespoon cold water | 1/2 lb diced ham | 2 ounces crumbled feta cheese
instructions: Heat margarine in large pot on medium low heat. Saute chili pepper for 2 minutes and add to skillet.

title: Roasted Beef and Lamb Steaks
ingredients: 4 beef steaks, 4 oz. each | 1/2 - 3/4 lb lean roast beef | 1 lamb, 2-1/2-ounce piece ( loin ) | 1/4 cup whole wheat flour | 2 teaspoons fresh lemon zest, chopped | 2 teaspoons fresh parsley, chopped | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne
instructions: To prepare the horseradish sauce, blend all the ingredients and chill until ready to serve. Trim and slice the meat into 1/2 to 3/4 pieces. Place on a foil lined tray or baking sheet and bake at 415°f for 15 minutes or until the meat is no longer pink.

Random Ingredients: canola oil,white vinegar,gouda cheese,garlic clove,cannellini bean,beef bouillon cube,baby carrot,pea
title: Beef & Vegetables Au Gratin
ingredients: 1 lb baby carrots | 1 lb fresh peas | 1 lb small piece of cheese, grated ( such as velveeta ) | 4 large garlic cloves, minced | 1 beef bouillon cube | 1/2 cup canola oil | 1 teaspoon white vinegar | 1 cup low-sodium cannellini beans, drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Place the carrots, peas, and cheese in the bottom of a casserole with 2/3 of the garlic. Drizzle the oil over the vegetables. Sprinkle the remaining 1/3 garlic, and the vinegar over the entire dish. Cover the casserole with foil. Bake 1 hour. Add the cannellini beans with liquid.

title: Vietnamese Pickled Eggs(Vegetarian)
ingredients: 4 large eggs | 1 small handful rice wine ( or other sweet dessert wine )
instructions: Place the eggs in a bowl and pour enough water to cover them by an inch or two. Cover with cling wrap and refrigerate until the eggs are cold. Use the egg pickling liquid as a dipping sauce to eat, and serve on slices of your choice.

Random Ingredients: cocoa powder,orange zest,italian herb seasoning,bell pepper
title: Brazilian Orange Sizzle Roasted Pepper Mix
ingredients: 8 large sweet bell peppers | 1/2 cup unsweetened cocoa powder | 1 teaspoon italian herb seasoning | 2 teaspoons orange zest
instructions: Cut peppers in half lengthwise. Remove seeds and ribs. Place peppers halves in a baking pan skin side down, stem side up. Drizzle 1/2 teaspoon of cocoa powder on tops. Bake at 425 degrees f. For about an hour or until tender and peppers. Roast peppers under a hot broiler until blackened and blistered. Sprinkle with remaining 1/4 teaspoon of cocoa powder. Broil peppers until skins are browned. Remove and discard pepper skins. Add remaining cup of cocoa to the pan drippings. Mix until smooth. Stir in italian herb seasoning and zest. Drizzle the cocoa liquid over the peppers. Serve.

Random Ingredients: nutmeg,hard egg,beef broth,heavy whipping cream,elbow macaroni
title: Swiss Macaroni and Beef
ingredients: 1 lb elbow macaroni | 1 can beef broth ( fat free if you prefer ) | 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream | 1/8 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 6 hard-boiled eggs ( chopped )
instructions: Cook elbow macaroni according to package directions.

title: Italian Beef and Beans
ingredients: 1/2 lb stew meat | 1 can black beans, drained and rinsed | 1 1/2 cups bread flour
instructions: Place beef, beans, and flour in crockpot. Cook on low for 5 - 6 hours until the beef is tender. Remove beef and beans and shred with two forks. Return the beef and beans to the crockpot, stir well. Serve over noodles, rice, or mashed potatoes.

Random Ingredients: pistachio nut,ranch dressing mix,blue cheese,roquefort cheese,almond extract
title: Spicy Blue Cheese Dip
ingredients: 1/2 cup ranch dressing mix, i use hidden valley original ranch and # 82168 | 1 1/2 cups feta cheese, crumbled | 1/2 cup blue cheese, crumbled | 1/3 cup slivered almonds or 1/3 cup slivered hazelnuts | 1 tablespoon poppy seed extract
instructions: Drain any fat from your blue cheese and crumble, set aside. Combine blue cheese, almonds& poppy seeds into a bowl. Add ranch dressing, blue cheese, almonds& hazelnuts. Stir well. Serve with tortilla chips.

Random Ingredients: green cardamom pod,sherry wine,greek yogurt,clove,pesto sauce,coriander seed,vanilla bean
title: Sherry, Cardamom and Garam Masala (Sherry Sauce)
ingredients: 750 ml low-fat greek yogurt | 1 tablespoon garlic-infused cooking sherry wine | 1/2 teaspoon whole coriander seed | 2 whole cloves | 4 green cardamom pods | 2 whole cloves | 2 ounces good-quality pesto sauce
instructions: Combine yogurt with olive oil, garlic and spice paste or sherry in a blender and blend until smooth. Transfer to an airtight container and refrigerate until ready to use. Note, some people like to use an extra 2 1/2 tsp of ginger to make this sauce, but i prefer it to be stirred fairly dry. A 1/2 tsp of ginger is plenty popular amongst some kabobs. If you have any leftover yogurt, transfer it to a jar with a tight fitting lid and shake vigorously until dissolved. Otherwise, use a coffee filter to filter any leftover yogurt water, but shake vigorously. To use, use the funnel in a coffee filter pitcher to remove any ice cubes or other contaminants.

Random Ingredients: walnut,cake flour,tuna water,beef stew meat,self rising flour
title: Beef and Pineapple Fritters
ingredients: 2 tablespoons self rising flour | 1/3 cup finely chopped walnuts | 3 tablespoons sifted cake flour | 1 pound finely chopped beef stew meat | 1 can canned tuna in water, drained
instructions: Mix together the flours, walnuts, and sifted cocoa powder. Add tuna and water mix everything together. Place heft teaspoonfuls on greased baking sheets into a lightly greased 1/2 quart casserole. Bake at 350f degrees f for about 20 minutes.

title: Mexican Style Pistachios
ingredients: 1 box pistachios, shelled | 1/4 cup taco sauce, plus more | soy sauce, for dipping | your favorite taco sauce
instructions: Bring 2 quarts water to a boil with 1 tablespoon salt or kosher salt. Meanwhile, dry roast the pistachios. Remove as much fat as possible. Dry on paper towels. When cool enough, break into about 2 inch pieces. Dip in taco sauce and fry in a skillet with 1/4 cup taco sauce until coated. Note, if you make more than one bowl, you can freeze it and re heat in the microwave for 30 seconds to make them crispy.

title: Puff Pastry Samosas
ingredients: 200 g puff pastry | 1/3 cup hp steak paste or 1/3 cup asafoetida powder | 1/3 cup dijon-style mustard | 1/2 teaspoon dried wonton skins | 1/4 small cup sliced capsicum | 1/2 teaspoon crushed dried rosemary or 2 teaspoons chopped fresh rosemary
instructions: On a board lay out puff pastry, cut around the bottom edge to within 1/2 inch of the top with one side on the outside so that puff pastry can open like pie pie dough. Carefully place it on a cutting board with a pastry blade or sharp knife. Repeat this until the pastry is all used. Place a small cup of hot water into a pan. On a cutting board quickly knead the pastry into a cylinder, then twist each piece to make the samosas easy to remove. Once the water is allowed to reach the top edge of the pastry rectangle, stretch it down to the thickness of your rectangle. Once fully enclosed fold each samosa in half vertically through the rectangle and pinch the edges firmly to seal. You can use a plastic pastry bag or other fancy sealer to seal the edges of the pastry. Place samosas on a baking sheet and bake in the oven for 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Ricci E Pescado (Shrimp in Prawn Brochettes)
ingredients: 8 ounces raw shrimp, peeled and deveined ( prawns should be the size of prawns ) | 8 ounces lettuce, washed | 2 large parsnips, peeled and thinly sliced | 2 teaspoons cornflour | 2 teaspoons anise seeds
instructions: Soak the shrimps in cold water for at least 8 hours. Rinse and dry on paper towels. Cook the shrimp in boiling water for about 1 to 2 minutes until bright green. Drain well, transfer to a bowl, and mix with the parsnips. Mix the shrimp with the corn flour and anise. Shape into patties and fry in hot oil until golden brown.

title: Super Spaghetti With Veal, Meat, and Sausage
ingredients: 1 lb ground veal, in 1/2-inch cubes | 1/4 lb sweet italian sausage, casing removed, in 1/2-inch slices | 1/2 cup diced sweet italian sausage | 1/4 cup diced limes or 1/4 cup lemon juice | 1 tablespoon cumin seeds, toasted and crushed | 1 teaspoon cumin seed, toasted and crushed | 5 -8 quarts boiling water | 3 lbs fresh spaghetti or 3 lbs dried spaghettini
instructions: Cut a 2 to 3 inch slit in each sausage link. Prick all over with a fork, in small groups. Place all ingredients except water in slow cooker. Cover and cook on high for 1 hour. Add water, about 1 cup at a time until meat is cooked. Stir well before cooking further. Serve spaghetti hot with parmesan or other good quality bread.

title: Yummy Seafood Platter
ingredients: 50 g rice | 200 g chopped cooked seafood ( i like mahi mahi, cod, shark, hake, shrimp, etc ) | 100 -150 g chopped chicken or 100 -150 g chopped fish | 120 -300 ml broth | 1/2 green capsicum, chopped ( optional ) | 1/2 cup chopped green pitted olive ( optional ) | 1/2 cup chopped fresh mint | 1/4 - 1/2 cup shredded lettuce leaf
instructions: Steam the rice until 'al dente'. Put rice into a bowl and mash with a potato masher or the back of a fork. Add the rest of the ingredients and mix. Place in the fridge for a few hours to allow flavours to blend. When ready to serve, top with shredded lettuce leaves.

title: Melon Chicken
ingredients: 2 -3 fresh lemongrass | 3 -4 lbs chicken, diced | 1 tablespoon margarine | 6 ears white corn, cut on the cob | 1/2 lb colby-monterey jack cheese, thinly sliced | 1 - 1 1/4 cup chopped canned cantaloupe
instructions: Grill chicken until done. Saute lemongrass in margarine till golden. Grill corn just to tender. Cut corn into thin slices. Place corn in large salad bowl. Mash lemongrass, using a slotted spoon. Add sliced chicken, corn, mozzarella cheese and cantaloupe. Garnish with a sprinkling of parsley.

title: Baharat Aka Middle East Recipe (Algerian Spice Mix)
ingredients: 4 tablespoons mayonnaise | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh epazote ( or cilantro ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon rubbed sage ( optional )
instructions: Mix it together very slightly with a fork if you have never made this mix before, especially if making in batches and you plan on using it again. It should have a pleasant and very tasty, slightly tart flavor. Store in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 1 week or until ready to serve. Use as a seasoning for chicken, pork or fish.

title: Rice and Ketchup
ingredients: 2 cups jasmine rice ( or other long grain rice such as nishiki ) | 1 cup ketchup | white pepper
instructions: Rinse rice and soak in cold water for at least half an hour. Drain the rice and set aside. Place rice in a deep, heavy bottomed pot on medium heat, making sure to stir constantly, especially at the first sign of steam being on the surface. The ketchup should sizzle and bubble up. Add all the remaining ingredients except the pepper.

Random Ingredients: salmon,filling,chicken thigh,thai red curry paste,corn,red chilies
title: Quick and Easy Chicken Sambal
ingredients: 1 can red thai red curry paste | 1 lb boneless skinless chicken thighs | 1 - 1 1/2 lb salmon, cut into 8 pieces | 10 corn, shucked | 1/4 cup filling | 1/2 cup pickled diced red bird chilies, thinly sliced, for garnish
instructions: Prepare the chicken by cutting along one side of the thigh bones or belly bones and cutting across the bone into chunks, discard any remaining bones. Reserve bones. Rinse the chicken and cut into 1 by 2 chunks. If you are using a smaller, thicker piece, remove bones from bones by first pulling the meat away from the bone and pulling it off the bones and using your fingers to remove the skin. Cut chicken chunks and chunks into smaller pieces using a knife and sawing between plastic wrap if it is too hard to get your finger inches place in a large bowl. Preheat oven to 350°f place chicken pieces in a single layer on a greased cookie sheet. They may be transferred to a zip lock bag, then refrigerate overnight. Place curry paste in a large frying pan, heat on medium for a few minutes until fragrant. Do not brown, if you wish to add a little oil. Add 3 1/2 cups water to pan and bring to a boil. Stir to mix. Add chopped chicken pieces. Simmer for 5 minutes on medium, stir to combine. Cover and transfer to the oven. Bake for about 40 minutes or until chicken is nicely browned and skin is crispy. Transfer to a platter. Serve with a small bowl of the pickled red bird chilies for dipping. Serve the sambal with pickled red ginger, and a little chopped kalamata olives.

Random Ingredients: saffron,onion salt,zucchini lengthwise,hot pepper flake,lettuce,white poppy seed,vanilla essence
title: Vegetable Sa Mumbai
ingredients: 4 teaspoons white poppy seeds | 3 whole zucchini, halved lengthwise | 1 teaspoon saffron | 1/4 onion salt | 1/4 cup green gram ( chana dal ) | 1/4 teaspoon hot pepper flakes | lettuce | 1/4 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: Place poppy seeds in a coffee grinder bowl and grind them until fine. Place the zucchini in a microwave safe bowl. Add 1 tsp of the poppy seeds and cover with water. Microwave on high for 5 minutes. Drain thoroughly but keep water in the bowl. Transfer the zucchini now to a bowl of cold water. Keep aside. Place saffron in a small bowl. Place onion salt, green gram and hot pepper flakes in a medium sized bowl. Add the saffron and mix well. In a large non stick skillet, heat the remaining oil on medium high flame. Add the blended poppy seeds and fry till they sizzle. Place all the prepared vegetable in a separate bowl and sprinkle with vanilla essence. When ready to serve, place the mixture under the microwave pressure cooker. Cover with lid. Microwave on high for 7 minutes. Remove from the microwave and keep in a bowl lined with kitchen paper on high for 3 minutes. Serve.

title: Passion-Marinated Chicken
ingredients: 2 large chicken thighs | 12 ounces yogurt ( plain ) | 3 1/2 ounces sugar snap peas, cut lengthwise | 1/2 pint cherries
instructions: Combine yogurt, sugar and cherry halves in a non reactive glass bowl or glass dish. Stir well. Cover and marinate chicken, refrigerated 20 minutes. Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Uncover, cover, and bake 45 - 1 minute. Turn chicken over and bake an additional 15 minutes, basting several times with yogurt mixture.

title: Linguine with Marsala and Green Chile
ingredients: 1 package linguine pasta or ( 7 ounce ) package linguine, uncooked, any flavor | 3 1/2 cups diced peeled cherry tomatoes or 3 1/2 cups halved cherry tomatoes | 3 cans diced green chili peppers, drained | 1/4 cup rice-free sherry marsala or 1/4 cup cooking sherry wine vinegar, divided | 1 teaspoon minced seeded fresh chili pepper ( optional )
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. Drain. Combine tomatoes and chili green peppers in a large saucepan. Add pasta, 2 cups sauce, 1 tbls. Of the vinegar, and the remaining tablespoon each of water and salt. Heat to boiling over high heat. Stir, cover and cook for about 3 minutes or until pasta and vegies are tender. Stir in remaining 1 tablespoon of vinegar and chili. Cover and continue cooking until pasta and vegies are hot.

title: Beef and Rice Noodle Salad
ingredients: 2/3 cup pearl barley | 1/3 cup minute grain rice | 1 cup long grain rice noodles | 1 winter squash, seeded ( optional )
instructions: Cook barley in boiling, slated water until tender but not mushy, 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Passover Phyllo Rolls
ingredients: 1 pound matzo meal | 1 cup white sugar | 3 cups matzo meal, divided | 3 tablespoons vanilla extract | 3 cups white sugar, or as needed | 3 cups white sugar, or as needed
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Pour 1 cup matzo meal into a large bowl, and mix in 3 cups white sugar until thoroughly combined. Mix in 3 more cups matzo meal. Roll 1/2 the dough into an 8x12 inch rectangle on the baking sheet, and spread it out to 1/4 inch thick. Brush dough with 1 teaspoon vanilla extract, and sprinkle 1 cup confectioners' sugar over and around the dough. Starting at the short edge farthest away from you, roll up the dough, jellyroll fashion, and pinch the seam to seal. Repeat with the remaining dough and confectioners' sugar and dough until you have used up all the filling and wrappers. Cut each roll into 8 equal pieces using scissors and scissors. Place rolls, cut side down, on the prepared baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until golden brown on top, about 20 minutes. Place 1 cup confectioners' sugar onto a large spoonful of confectioners' sugar while still hot, and shake until the sugar has dissolved. Remove rolls from oven, and quickly spread remaining 5 tablespoons of confectioners' sugar over them while they are still hot. Allow to cool to room temperature, and cut into pieces with a sharp knife.

title: Carambola - the Easy Way
ingredients: 14 lasagna noodles | 3 cups barbecue sauce | 2 teaspoons fish sauce | 1 tablespoon cognac or 1 tablespoon brandy | 2 hot peppers, sliced | 2 teaspoons steak sauce or 2 teaspoons red hot pepper flakes
instructions: Cook noodles. Stir sauce ingredients. Place hot sauce on hot noodles. Spoon noodle mixture on hot sauce, over noodles and sauce. Sprinkle with cheese or serve with fresh vegetables.

Random Ingredients: chili pepper,pesto sauce,cooking spray,coconut cream,vegetable broth
title: Chilli Pesto Vegetable Soup
ingredients: 2 cups fat-free vegetable broth or 2 cups chicken broth | 1 tablespoon pesto sauce | 1/2 cup lowfat coconut cream | 1/2 teaspoon ground chili pepper | cooking spray
instructions: In saucepan, combine broth and pesto. Bring to boil, reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 5 minutes. Add coconut cream and peppers, simmer for 5 minutes longer. Stir in remaining ingredients, bring to boil, and serve immediately.

title: Spinach and Pea Scones
ingredients: pastry dough, for a 8 inch tin | 2 cups peas, frozen unshelled | 6 ounces frozen chopped spinach, thawed and tulsified ( i just don't throw it away, i just let it cool down a bit so the moisture will ) | 1/8 teaspoon liquid smoke | 3 tablespoons self-rising flour ( for coating )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Roll out the pastry on a floured piece of tin, cutting and gathering the pastry so it's about 2/3 inch thick. Cut out 6 scones and place on ungreased oven trays about 2 inches apart. Place frozen peas on top of pastry, along with the spinach and pinch together. Sprinkle with liquid smoke and then sprinkle on the flour. Bake for 15 minutes, or until the edges are golden.

title: Spicy Sweet Peas
ingredients: 1 lb sugar snap peas | 2 cups uncooked long grain and wild sweetened sweet peppers ( or 1 - 2 1/4 pound of your favorite mixed sweet peppers, chopped ) | 1 tablespoon finely grated orange rind | 2 teaspoons chili powder
instructions: Trim any tough stems from the bell peppers. Slice lengthwise in half, then slice thin in a long, thin strip. Cut each half in half again creating 2 strips.

title: Pepperoni Clam Chowder
ingredients: 3 clam juice | 3 slices pepperoni | fresh ground pepper ( optional )
instructions: Put all ingredients in a blender and puree. Pour into bowls and serve.

Random Ingredients: pinto bean,chili oil,spaghetti,saffron strand,cooking spray,baby portabella mushroom,rice vinegar
title: Vegetarian Feijoada Con Piselli
ingredients: cooking spray | 6 saffron strands | 24 baby portabella mushrooms, sliced | 2 packages dry noodles | 7 tablespoons rice vinegar | 3 tablespoons sweet chili oil | 1 tablespoon saffron strands | 24 saffron strands | 30 fluid ounces pinto beans, drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Spray a large baking sheet with cooking spray and arrange mushrooms, cooked noodles, and saffron strands in a single layer, in a single layer. Bake, stirring once, until mushrooms are soft, about 30 minutes. Stir rice vinegar, sweet chili oil, and saffron strands in a bowl until coated. Pour pinto beans into pot and bring to boil, scraping up browned bits from sides. Reduce heat.

title: Baked Lamb With Fresh Strawberries
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs boneless lamb, cut into 1 inch cubes | 2 tablespoons shortening | 6 tablespoons raisins | 1/4 cup black peppercorns | 1/2 cup red cooking wine | 125 g fresh strawberries, thinly sliced | 125 g fresh strawberries, trimmed and sliced
instructions: Heat oven to 170c. Toss lamb with shortening, 1 tablespoon raisins and black pepper. Transfer to a lightly greased baking dish and sprinkle with remaining raisins. Sprinkle with remaining seeds and peppercorns. Bake in the oven for 20 minutes. Turn lamb half way through cooking. Place the remaining raisins and sliced strawberries in a serving bowl. Scatter over lamb. Cover and allow to stand for 5 minutes. Serve with sliced strawberries.

title: Bean Taquitos
ingredients: 1 can cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 10 flour tortillas
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Pour the beans into a small baking dish and bake for 30 minutes, or until heated through. Roll each tortilla into a ball, then place on a baking sheet, and cover with a kitchen towel. Place in the oven to dry, about 25 hours, or until firm. Heat the canellini beans in a saucepan over medium heat for a few minutes to soften. Remove and discard the towel, and allow to cool until warm. Slice the taquitos into 3 or 4 pieces, and roll each piece in a flour tortilla.

Random Ingredients: cumin powder,carrot,chipotle chile,rice,white sugar,beef stew meat,pie crust mix,chili sauce
title: Carri's Chipotle Beef Pie
ingredients: 2 lbs beef stew meat ( or turkey ) | 1 can chipotle chiles ( canned whole canned peppers ) | 5 tablespoons chipotle sauce ( or to taste ) | 1 1/3 cups hot chili sauce | 3/4 cup white sugar | 1/4 cup white sugar | 1 tablespoon cumin powder | 1 1/2 teaspoons rice | 1 frozen pie crust mix ( or 1 cup pie crust mix )
instructions: In a deep frying pan or dutch oven brown the beef in 2 tablespoons of butter. Add rest of ingredients, bring to a boil and simmer for 2 hours stirring frequently. While the beef mixture is simmering prepare pie crust. If any liquid has boiled up just add water to the 2 pie crust pans or the dough may separate. Pour beef mixture into pie crusts or pie crusts. If the mixture does not come together just add more water. Bake at 400 for 30 minutes or until the crust is golden brown.

title: Guacamole
ingredients: 2 hass avocadoes or 12 green beets, peeled, chopped | 1 large ripe banana pepper, seeded and chopped | 10 green peppercorns, well drained | 15 cherry tomatoes, halved, seeded if desired
instructions: Mash avocados in a bowl with a fork. Add banana, pepper, peppercorns and tomatoes. Mix well. Let sit at least 10 to 15 minutes to blend flavors. Storing, in an airtight container, the guacamole will keep for up to 2 days.

Random Ingredients: yoghurt,parmigiano reggiano cheese,curry leaf,tart cherry,lamb,grapeseed oil
title: Fried Lamb Romesco
ingredients: 500 g chopped lamb, ( lean, lamb shoulder, leg chops, thigh etc ) | 8 large tart cherries, halved | 1 teaspoon grapeseed oil | 8 fresh curry leaves | 200 g yoghurt ( smooth ) | 2 tablespoons freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: In a large wok over a low to medium heat, slowly add the grapeseed oil and curry leaves. When they start to wilt, add the chopped lamb. Cook just for 1 minute, stirring, and then add yoghurt. Allow to bubble and thicken slightly, and then add most of the parmesan. You may need to stir it continuously, and then leave it to simmer for another minute or two. Serve with white rice. I like this with a fresh baked potato gnocchi, or a tossed salad, or a crisp green salad. Enjoy.

title: Bamia Beef Kabobs (African Style)
ingredients: 1 lb beef flank steak ( or other inexpensive steak ) | 1 can edamame, drained ( or any other green soy bean ) | 1 -2 tablespoon allspice
instructions: Cut flank steak into 1/2 inch cubes or thinner, depending on the thickness of the beef. Thread meat onto skewers. Arrange on grill over medium high heat. Sprinkle allspice inside meat, then sprinkle edamame over top. Cook for five minutes on each side.

Random Ingredients: crystal sugar,pearl barley,extra virgin olive oil,great northern bean,shiitake mushroom
title: Barley and Shiitake Mushroom Frijoles
ingredients: 1 bunch shiitake mushrooms | 3/4 cup pearl barley | 1 tablespoon extra-virgin olive oil | 1/4 cup crystal sugar, or as desired, plus more on top if desired | 1 can great northern beans, drained
instructions: Rinse and place the mushrooms in a bowl. Wash and pat dry the shiitake mushrooms. Cut caps into 1/4 inch slices and cut the shiitake and mushrooms crosswise into thirds. Place the barley in a wide, shallow bowl. Heat the oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add the mushrooms, barley, shrimp, mushrooms, and crystal sugar and cook until the barley is brown and the mushrooms are tender, about 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: cream chicken soup,kidney bean,pork loin,frying chicken,garlic salt,peanut oil
title: Quick Coated Sopa Seca
ingredients: 12 ounces dried kidney beans | 1 frying chicken, cut into chunks | 2 lbs boneless pork loin, cut into thin bite-sized pieces | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt | 3 tablespoons cream of chicken soup | powdered cream ( garnish )
instructions: Soak beans in enough water to cover overnight. Drain through a coffee filter or colander and place in the crockpot. Add chicken pieces. Sprinkle with garlic salt and mix well. Add cream of chicken soup and stir to mix soup. Cover and cook on low heat for 7 hours. Remove chicken pieces and discard the fat, if desired. Place on a serving platter and garnish with creamy cream and serve.

Random Ingredients: white chocolate chip,kaffir lime leaf,grenadine,oregano leaf,squid,chipotle powder,hot pepper
title: Chipotle Spicy Sausages
ingredients: 1 lb medium sized sausage ( i use spicy spicy tex-mex spicy sausage ) | 1 large firm red squid, cleaned, patted dry, and cut into 6 small pieces ( about 2 pounds ) | 1/4 cup white chocolate chips | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves ( or 1 tbsp fresh oregano, finely minced ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground chipotle powder | 12 kaffir lime leaves, torn apart | 1 jar hot peppers, with stems sliced ( about 15 whole or 1 cup chopped canned peppers )
instructions: Bring 6 cups water to a boil in a small saucepan. Add in sausage and cook for 7 minutes. Drain.

Random Ingredients: crabmeat,dark rum,carom seed,limeade concentrate,tarragon vinegar,almond extract
title: Lime Picktail from the Caribbean
ingredients: 1/2 cup fresh limeade concentrate | 1/4 cup dark rum | 2 tablespoons tarragon vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon carom seed ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract | 1 1/2 tablespoons imitation crabmeat
instructions: In a blender, combine limeade concentrate, rum, vinegar, carom seed, and almond extract until well combined. With the blender running, gradually stir in imitation crab meat until thoroughly blended.

title: Corn in Syrup
ingredients: 3 serrano peppers | 1 papaya, cut into matchstick strips ( or a couple of your favorite fruit ) | 2 cans cream-style corn | 2 tablespoons peanut oil
instructions: Separate each serrano pepper in two lengthwise and remove seeds, trim and devein stem and scrape skin. Heat oil in large deep skillet over medium high heat. When oil is shimmering but not smoking, lay one chile in and fry until skin blisters, turning over once. Immediately remove from skillet and place chile in bowl. Repeat with remaining chile. Holding oil jar down in pan, pour in hot oil. Peel and cut chiles into strips and add to bowl with cream corn. Stir. Cover and let stand for 15 minutes. Stir again before serving.

title: Super Simple Broccoli Sprouts
ingredients: 1 ounce alfalfa sprouts | 1 -2 red pepper ( capsicums, capsicum, red belles )
instructions: Wash the alfalfa sprouts thoroughly and cut in the shape of a bun.. Slice the capsicums into thin slices and cut the red pepper into thin strips.. Cook them briefly in boiling water. Drain and add everything to a mixing bowl. Toss with a wooden spoon to ensure everything is covered well with the sprouts. You can serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: cocoa powder,basil leaf,rice noodle,green pepper,sugar,pork,rib beef
title: Lily Kwok's Vietnamese Pork and Beef Noodle Soup
ingredients: 1/2 lb pork ( sliced thinly against the grain, or any other cut, whatever is in the bag. look at the meat, if any cut isn'tn'tn'tn'tn't n ) | 1/2 lb rib eye beef ( chunked thick, or whatever you want ) or 1/2 lb pork ( chunked thick, or whatever you want ) | 3 tablespoons good quality unsweetened cocoa powder | 1/2 tablespoon sugar | 1 package rice noodles | 1 green pepper ( or other mild green pepper ) | 1 -2 basil leaves
instructions: Place pork, beef and green pepper in large sauce pan with generous quantities of water and bring to a full boil. Boil rapidly until beef is fully cooked. Strain when done and reserve the beef/pepper stock. Cut meat into large bite size pieces and discard the meat chunks. Place meat back into pot and add the reserved stock and cocoa powder. Stir and simmer over low heat until soup is thick and flavours have come together. Meanwhile, cook noodles according to package directions, drain and put in a large bowl. Toss noodles with reserved meat and peppers. Serve hot, with shredded lettuce and chopped tomatoes on side for a delicious hot and festive lunch.

title: Avocado- Hazelnut Dip
ingredients: 1 cup hazelnuts, roughly chopped | 1 avocado | 1 container plain low-fat yogurt | 1 pinch salt
instructions: Put hazelnuts into a pan over low heat. Roast hazelnuts for about 7 minutes, stirring frequently to prevent burning, until they start to toast. Cool and chop finely. Place hazelnuts to a food processor, add avocado and puree until smooth. Stir in yogurt and salt until well blended.. Enjoy.

title: Sweet Pea and Barley Salad
ingredients: 2 cups dried chestnuts | 3 tablespoons margarine or 3 tablespoons butter | 1 teaspoon red curry paste | 1 teaspoon savory | 1 cup raw barley ( i like white organic ) or 1 cup red kidney bean ( i like white organic ) | 20 ounces frozen chopped spinach, thawed
instructions: Combine all ingredients except spinach in large bowl & mix well. Add spinach. Toss well & enjoy.

Random Ingredients: orange juice,raspberry,mango chutney,lime juice,brioche bread,olive oil
title: Peach Melba Toast
ingredients: 500 g fruit fresh raspberries ( or any berries of your choice ) | 1 tablespoon lime juice | 1 tablespoon orange juice | 1/2 teaspoon lime juice | 250 g brioche bread | 1 tablespoon olive oil | paprika ( optional )
instructions: Mix the fruit with the orange juice and lime juice until it's smooth. Cut brioche into 4cm lenghts and toast each piece in a hot dry frypan until lightly golden brown. Spread each slice with olive oil then top the slices with the fruit mix. Sprinkle with paprika if desired.

title: Spicy Cheese With Parsnips
ingredients: 2 lbs parsnips, peeled | 2 cans stewed tomatoes with chilies and peppers, undrained | 1 teaspoon cayenne ( or to taste ) | 1 lb fresh mozzarella cheese, cut into 1 inch cubes
instructions: Cook parsnips in boiling water until tender.

title: Black & Tan Quinoa Pizza (Rachael Ray)
ingredients: 5 teaspoons white bread flour | 1 1/2 teaspoons cocoa | 3/4 teaspoon salt | 1/4 teaspoon ground black quinoa | 1 tablespoon lemon zest, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon hot sauce | 1 teaspoon aquilopo hot sauce | 3 1/2 ounces blue curacao | 1 small radish ( garnish optional ) | 1/4 cup white currant jelly ( optional ) | 2 slices thin white bread, finely sliced on the diagonal ( garnish )
instructions: Mix the ingredients for the crust, in a small bowl, using a fork or a wire whisk. Spray a pizza peel with cooking spray. Preheat oven to 425°f. Pour the pizza dough onto the prepared pizza peel. Sprinkle with any other optional toppings and form into an even layer on the pizza. Bake for 10 minutes, reduce to 425°f and bake for an additional 8 minutes. Remove from the oven and immediately spoon the greek currant sauce over the pizza, spreading evenly. Return to the oven for an additional 5 minutes or until the greek currant sauce is bubbling. Remove from the oven and allow to cool completely before slicing. Serve with slices of crusty bread that have been sliced thinly.

title: Olive Garden Spaghetti
ingredients: 8 ounces spaghetti sauce ( i like bertoli's ) or 8 ounces other creamy spaghetti sauce ( i like bertoli's ) | 1/2 - 1 garlic clove, minced | 1 tablespoon vodka ( optional ) | 4 1/2 cups broth ( chicken or vegetable broth ) | 2 ounces swiss cheese or 2 ounces cheddar cheese, shredded | chopped almonds, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Cook spaghetti according to package directions. Drain and keep warm. Heat a small amount of oil over medium high heat in a saucepan. Add the garlic and saute until fragrant, about 1 minute. Stir in the spaghetti sauce and 1/2 broth or water. When the ingredients are blended and heated through, add the cheese and stir for 1 - 2 minutes. Taste and add more salt and pepper if needed. Serve drizzled with a little of the remaining broth. Garnish with almonds if desired.

title: Easter Cheese Rolls
ingredients: 1/2 stewing beef, chopped | 1/3 cup mayonnaise | 1/3 cup sour cream | 1/2 cup grapes, halved | salt | 1 egg, hard boiled, chopped | 1/2 cup sliced almonds | 1 package phyllo dough
instructions: Brown meat, breaking it up while it browns. Drain meat. Mix mayonnaise, sour cream and half grapes in bowl. Stir in meat, egg and nuts. Preheat oven to 375 degrees fahrenheit. Place a strip of phyllo dough on work surface. Place 1/2 of mixture on top. Roll up tightly like a jelly roll. Repeat until filling is used up. Place seam side down on a baking sheet and brush with melted butter. Bake at 375 degrees fahrenheit for 40 minutes. Enjoy.

title: Stir Fried Spicy Sausages
ingredients: 2 large mild spicy sausage, such as v8 | 1/4 cup tamari ( dark soy sauce ) | 1/4 cup finely chopped ginger paste ( or equivalent ) or 1 -2 fresh ginger root, peeled and chopped ( or equivalent ) | 1 1 tablespoon grated fresh ginger paste | salt, to taste | 2 teaspoons cornstarch
instructions: First, dry roast the sausages over high heat in the pan until a nice dark brown color begins. Place in a bowl and add remaining ingredients except cornstarch and stir to mix. Cook briefly, stirring to ensure there are no chunks of fat. The result is going to be a crispy mess. Dissolve cornstarch into a little bit of the pan liquid, or use as a dipping sauce for the sausage. Serve with korean, regular thin rice and any leftover vegetable stew.

Random Ingredients: water,thai chili sauce,banana,tomato sauce,bay leaf,egg,kosher salt black pepper
title: Banana Meatball Soup
ingredients: 1/2 cup thai sweet chili sauce | 1 large ripe banana | 8 cups water | 1 teaspoon kosher salt | 1 piece banana, cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 1 egg, slightly beaten | 1 bay leaf, crushed | kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper, to taste
instructions: Cut the banana into 2 inch chunks and the tomato into 1/2 inch slices. Put the water in a large pan and put it over medium heat. Slice the banana into 1/2 inch chunks and add to the pot. Bring to a boil, then lower the heat and simmer, covered tightly for 20 minutes. Remove the banana and transfer to the bowl of a food processor or blender. Process all of the cooked banana pieces and add to the blender. Process to puree. Add the tomato sauce and continue pureeing. Put water in a large pot over medium high heat. Break the banana into pieces and add to the pot. Cook, uncovered, for 10 minutes and add salt and pepper, to taste. Add the potato pieces and continue cooking for 5 minutes. Remove the bay leaf and stir. Stir in the egg and cook for 2 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Roasted Peppers With Capers and Caper
ingredients: 3/4 cup yellow bell peppers or 3/4 cup orange bell pepper, cut into 1 `` strips | 1/2 cup capers, drained and crushed | 1/4 cup black vinegar
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. Line a rimmed baking sheet with foil. Arrange peppers on the prepared baking sheet. Insert a fork through each pepper and spread the capers evenly over the top. Using a potato peeler, peel the skin sides of the peppers and carefully remove the seeds. Sprinkle the pepper strips with salt and place on the prepared baking sheet. Roast for 40 to 55 minutes, turning peppers halfway through for even browning.

Random Ingredients: ginger root,fontina cheese,steak,black eyed pea,arbol chile
title: Cheese With Black-Eyed Peas
ingredients: 1 pound flank steak | 2 pounds black-eyed peas, drained | 1 ounce grated fontina cheese | 2 teaspoons minced fresh ginger root | 1 arbol chile, or other hot chile, seeded and chopped
instructions: Preheat a skillet over medium high heat. Cook and stir steak in the hot skillet until browned and crumbly, 5 to 7 minutes. Stir black eyed peas into steak.

title: Noodles and Noodles
ingredients: 6 ounces egg noodles | 4 ounces chilled cream or 4 ounces ice cream
instructions: Cook the noodles in boiling well salted water just until tender. Drain and transfer to mixing bowl, add cream or ice cream and mix well. Place in refrigerator and serve.

title: Pineapple Pepper Tea II
ingredients: 1 can pineapple chunks, drained ( reserve juice ) | 1 cup brewed tea, chilled
instructions: In a bowl, mash pineapple with reserved pineapple juice. Let stand for one hour before serving.

Random Ingredients: snow pea,molasses,potato,great northern bean,carrot,saffron,swiss chard,farfalle pasta
title: Quick and Easy Classic Saffron Pasta
ingredients: 1 pint medium grain farfalle pasta | 4 cups potatoes, diced | 2 cups carrots, thinly sliced | 2 cups swiss chard, coarsely chopped | 4 ounces dried great northern beans, soaked overnight and rinsed thoroughly | 1/2 teaspoon saffron, crumbled | 1/2 cup molasses | 1/3 cup sweet cornmeal ( or a mix of both ) or 1/3 cup fine breadcrumbs ( or a mix of both )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 fahrenheit. Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Boil farfalle for 8 to 10 minutes and drain. Transfer farfalle to a large baking dish. Cover with water and bring to a boil again and simmer for another 5 minutes. Transfer farfalle to a large skillet. In the same skillet sauté potatoes, carrots, swiss chard and beans until swiss chard begins to soften. Stir in saffron and molasses. Pour over farfalle. Bake for 45 minutes, stirring often, until farfalle is tender and sauce is thickened. Bake an additional 10 - 15 minutes or until farfalle is just bubbly.

title: Homemade Powdered Sugar
ingredients: 1/4 cup freshly chopped spearmint | 3 oranges, rind of or 3 limes
instructions: Mix thoroughly. Cover and store in refrigerator.

title: Macaroni With Saffron
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon saffron ( approximately ) | 1 1/2 cups vegetable stock ( or water ) | 1 1/2 cups elbow macaroni, cooked | 2 2 cups dried small anchovies or 1 1/2 tablespoons anchovies packed in oil, minced | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 1 3/4 cups rice flour ( see note above ) | 2 large round cake parchment paper, cut into 24 squares | parchment paper, for garnish
instructions: Toast saffron according to package directions with vegetable stock and set aside to steep. Cook macaroni in a 6 qt saucepan of boiling salted water, uncovered, to just tender but still firm, about 5 minutes, stirring occasionally. Drain. Add remaining ingredients. Toast 1 square of parchment at 350°f for 10 minutes. Cool completely. Sift rice flour over parchment and sprinkle mixture evenly over dough, shaking out excess. Spread macaroni evenly over parchment with back of fork. Sprinkle with the reserved saffron. Cut 2 squares or 1 sheet into 24 squares and stack them on a plate and cover with plastic wrap. Refrigerate 30 - 40 minutes. Remove plastic wrap and cut squares or strips of parchment into 24 squares, separating all layers. Serve at once. Note, to toast squares of parchment, heat 1 - ½ - 2 cups of boiling stock in a 4 qt saucepan over moderate heat about 1 minute. Turn off heat and let stand 5 minutes. Sprinkle squares with more salt and allow to cool completely. Store in a tightly covered container.

title: Simple Portuguese Beans
ingredients: 2 cans white beans, undrained | 4 medium red potatoes, cut into wedges | 1/3 cup unsalted butter or 1/3 cup margarine
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Spread potato wedges in a 1 1/2 quart ovenproof baking dish. Cover with water and bake for 30 minutes.

title: Chipotle Breakfast
ingredients: 1/4 teaspoon fresh ground chives | 1/2 teaspoon pureed canned chipotle chiles, < a href= '' https : //www.geniuskitchen.com/recipe/chipotle-chipotle-adobo-369693 '' > chipotle chipotle chipotle adobo < /a > | 4 medium firm ripe bananas, about 2-3 tablespoons each | 8 ounces granny smith apples ( cut into 8 wedges ) | 1 teaspoon pure vanilla
instructions: In a small bowl, combine chives, chiles and pureed chipotle chipotle peppers.

title: Homemade Chicken Kefalon
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless skinless chicken breasts, cut into pieces | 4 teaspoons kosher salt | 1 teaspoon dried marjoram | 3 1/2 cups water
instructions: Cut each thigh into 4 equal pieces, and then cross through the middle lengthwise. Place on a lightly oiled rack placed over a large platter. Season with 1 teaspoon each of kosher salt and marjoram, and cover loosely with plastic wrap. Refrigerate for an hour, or at least overnight. Line bamboo skewers with cotton or parchment paper and set aside. Remove the chicken from the refrigerator, pat dry with paper towels. Place each piece into a small, 1 - 2 inch wide log, making sure to place them well apart, and trim off any excess fat if necessary. Place onto the skewers. Preheat the grill to high heat. Lightly oil the grate. When the grill has ready, discard the lemon zest from one of the lemons. If using a charcoal grill, place the pieces, skin side down, on the grill. Grill for about 3 minutes, turning every 2 - 3 minutes or until lightly browned and no longer pink. The chicken will be cooked from the steam. If necessary, use a slotted spoon to remove the chicken from the grill to a cutting board. If using a gas grill, add 1 teaspoon kosher salt and 1/4 teaspoon dried marjoram to the chicken.

title: Rhubarb Spaghetti Sauce and Fresh Lime
ingredients: 1/2 cup chopped rhubarb | 1 cup uncooked spaghetti sauce ( your favorite ) | 1 teaspoon dried cilantro or 1 teaspoon fresh minced cilantro | 1/2 teaspoon grated lime zest | 1 jalapeno, minced | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace | 6 ounces spaghetti sauce | 2 egg yolks | 1/4 lime zest | 1 tablespoon tahini
instructions: Saute rhubarb in 1/2 cup of spaghetti sauce for 2 minutes. Add 1 tsp cilantro, lime zest, jalapanese mace, remaining spaghetti sauce and picante sauce. Simmer, uncovered, 20 minutes. Beat the egg yolks in a small bowl. Add 2 tablespoons chopped lime zest and tahini. Fold into sauce. Cook spaghetti in a large pot al dente' until al dente'.

title: Spicy Sausage Loaf
ingredients: 10 ounces spicy sausage | 1 cup graham cracker crumbs | 1 cup seasoned breadcrumbs | 1 cup chopped plum
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. In a medium bowl, combine ground sausage, graham cracker crumbs and seasoned bread crumbs. Use your fingers to coat each loaf with the bread crumb mixture. Arrange the loaf in a lightly oiled pan. Top with the green plum.

title: Chess Turnovers
ingredients: 30 wonton wrappers | 1/2 cup apricot jam | 1 tablespoon sherry wine | 2 tablespoons chopped pistachios
instructions: To prepare filling, in small bowl, stir together jam and sherry. Brush wontons lightly with the jam mixture. Place a tablespoon or 2 of the filing in the center of each wonton wrapper. Brush edges lightly with egg wash or water dipped in cornstarch.

title: Creamy Caraway Dressing With Broccoli
ingredients: 1/2 cup mayonnaise ( can use gluten free or vegan ) | 2 tablespoons caraway seeds ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon salad oil | 7 ounces broccoli cuts ( fresh or frozen ) | 1 cup beef broth | 1/4 cup hot italian dressing ( see my note )
instructions: Note, we used an 8 ounce bag of frozen broccoli cuts and it still had enough protein. I had to use the entire bag. I had to add 1 cup of beef broth, then added the rest of the ingredients. It will probably have the same consistency as your packaged dressing. I used 3/4 cup of hot dressing at the end. The recipe didn't have any nuts on it. I just added just enough to get the flavor. The flavor was never there to it. We made this again because we wanted to have the calories down. We just took it off and replaced the oil with a little more. This recipe was delicious. We served it on a sandwich and i loved it. You could add some chopped green onions. I used 1/2 cup fresh parm flakes and 1/2 cup of roasted garlic. This salad is great and needs to be made as directed, but can make more.

title: Green Onion Vinaigrette
ingredients: 2 green onions, finely chopped | 1/2 cup vinegar
instructions: Place onions and vinegar into a screw top jar. Add enough extra virgin olive oil to make a dressing with the consistency of catsup.

title: Crispy Asafetida Dumplings
ingredients: 1 cup masa harina | 1 teaspoon mayonnaise | 1 dash peppercorn | 1 pinch asafoetida powder | 1 pinch confectioners'sugar | 1 pinch peppercorn | 1 pinch asafoetida powder | 1 pinch confectioners'sugar | 4 shelled peppercorns
instructions: Put all the ingredients for the dough together in a big bow and mix well. Form the dough into small balls, wrap in plastic wrap and put on a board or flat tray. Let them dry for an hour or more. Prepare the filling by mixing all the ingredients very well with your hands. Take a small portion of prepared dough and roll it out into a very thin circle. Heat a non stick frying pan until very hot but not smoking. Drop a spoonful or two of the cooked dough into the pan and flatten it slightly. After taking care not to let the dough burn, put the dumpling in the heated frying pan and cook it until it is golden in color. Use more or less heat it if necessary and the dumpling can be kept warm in low temperature oven. You can serve the dumplings warm.

Random Ingredients: miracle whip,italian dressing,yoghurt,mango,chunky salsa,cake flour,white vinegar,pineapple juice
title: Pineapple Salsa Dips With Honey Mustard Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup red onion, finely chopped | 1/4 cup low fat greek yogurt | 1 tablespoon unsweetened pineapple juice | 2 teaspoons white vinegar | 1 teaspoon mirin ( or 1 teaspoon honey ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons miracle whip | 2 tablespoons salad dressing | 2 tablespoons chunky salsa | 1/4 cup chopped mango
instructions: Whisk together all the ingredients except the mango in a large bowl. Toss with the salsa to coat. Add the mango and toss. Serve.

Random Ingredients: red chili powder,xanthan gum,cardamom pod,baby carrot,fontina cheese,lime,cherry
title: Baked Carrots in Sour Cream and Chili
ingredients: 4 large baby carrots, peeled ( about 3 cups ) | 1/2 teaspoon xanthan gum ( optional and to taste ) | 1 teaspoon red chili powder | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon whole cardamom pod | 2 tablespoons shredded fontina cheese ( or your preference ) | 1/4 cup finely crumbled cold fontina cheese ( optional ) | 1/8 cup chopped fresh cherries ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 300ºf. Prick carrots with the tines of a fork to release steam. Place in a baking dish that is just large enough to hold them in one layer and bake. Stove top, place baking dish on oven rack and bake carrots 40 minutes or until tender when pierced with a tines of fork.. Cool about 15 minutes or until cool enough to handle. Cut each carrot in half crosswise.

title: Ganizte All' Arrabbiata
ingredients: 1 cup semolina | 1 cup cold water | 1 cup half-and-half cream | 1/2 cup grated pecorino cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f in a small bowl, stir together semolina and 1 cup cold water. Using a wooden spoon, pour into an ungreased 8x8 inch baking dish. Stir once or twice as you press the mixture together so that it's evenly coated, and let the mixture fall into the cold water. Pour half and half into a small pan over medium low heat, and bring to a boil. Remove from heat, and stir in pecorino. Spread ganizte batter into the prepared pan, sprinkle with grated cheese, and bake in the preheated oven until golden, 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Sweet and Sour Potatoes
ingredients: 1 large red potato, cut into thin wedges | 2 teaspoons molasses ( or vegetable molasses ) | 1 tablespoon chinese black bean paste ( or chili bean vinegar ) | 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro | lime wedge, for serving
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. Using a slotted spoon, remove potatoes from bowl and toss with 2 teaspoons molasses. Place potatoes on a baking sheet and bake about 40 minutes, stirring every 8 minutes until charred on the edges. Meanwhile, pour remaining molasses and chilies into small bowl.

title: Portuguese Crabmeat Penne
ingredients: 1 white onion, peeled | 1 quart lump crabmeat, undrained | 1 lb dry penne
instructions: Cook onion in salted water 2 minutes. Drain, reserving 1 tablespoon liquid. Pour drained onion in large dutch oven. Place drained crabmeat and reserved liquid in over medium heat in dutch oven. Break up crab meat into small pieces.

title: Grilled Mushrooms With Limes
ingredients: 1 lb fresh shiitake mushroom, stems trimmed | 2 lime wedges, cut in half
instructions: Trim mushrooms of any tough stems and cut off the loose woody centre part of the stems, trim the woody stems and stems of the shiitake mushrooms. Place 1 mushroom cap on a skewer or skewer and insert one half of a lime wedge into each cavity. Place on a grill over medium high heat and broil in batches for 15 minutes for medium. Turn frequently until the underside of the mushrooms are darkly brown.

title: Camembert Stuffed With Camembert Peppers and Rice Wine
ingredients: 3 camembert cheese | 1 head garlic salt, unpeeled | 3 tablespoons rice wine ( rice, vermouth or a combination works too ) | 1 tablespoon vinegar | 1/2 cup pepperoncini, drained ( can use canned )
instructions: Using a small sharp knife, make 3 horizontal slices of cheese per camembert, slightly off center of cheese, making a cross on the inside of cheese. Sprinkle inside of cheese with garlic salt and set cheese in a bowl set in a large enough bowl to fit tightly. Stab cheese with a fork a few times, extracting as much liquid as possible. Sprinkle inside of cheese all over with garlic salt. In a small bowl, stir together wine, vinegar and pepperoncini. Dip cheese in wine mixture, one slice at a time, and place under a double broiler until browned. You may have to place cheese toasted on a baking pan on the stove top to get all the cheese brown. Place cheese on individual small plates, then put a slice of pepperoncini between the slices.

title: Horseradish Potatoes
ingredients: 4 medium baking potatoes, peeled | 2 tablespoons fresh horseradish | 1 tablespoon vodka
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Place potatoes into a medium baking dish. Drizzle with olive oil and sprinkle with horseradish. Bake uncovered 15 to 20 minutes, until potatoes are golden brown.

title: Horseshoes
ingredients: 3 lbs london broil beef | 3 tablespoons bacon grease or 3 tablespoons margarine | 3 tablespoons hing ( optional )
instructions: Trim fat from meat. Cut meat into 2 or 3 inch cubes. In a dutch oven, melt grease or margarine over low to medium heat. Saute meat until brown. Turn meat and brown on all sides. Add hing. Reduce heat. Cover and let simmer for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Tasty Shrimp Rolls & Spicy Salsa!
ingredients: 1 lb jumbo shrimp, peeled | 1 packet orange gelatin | 1 jar chunky salsa | rice paper, to make rolls ( spring rolls )
instructions: Mix the jello, salsa & shrimp together in a bowl. Spread mixture into the center of a rice paper wrapper. Fold in the sides of the wrapper. Repeat with each layer until the filling is nearly covered. Wrap each roll in a damp paper towel & place on a baking sheet. Bake in a 300 degree oven until golden brown the rolls will take about 30 minutes.

title: Apple Phyllo Samosas
ingredients: 1 1/3 cups dried black beans, cooked and drained | 4 slices tart apples | 2 packages frozen miniature phyllo pastry sheets, thawed ( thawed if purchased by the grocery store ) | 1 bunch thai basil, snipped
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit. Place bean and apples in a large saucepan. Cook over medium heat, stirring often, 5 to 7 minutes but do not brown apples. Remove from heat and drain. Place 1 sheet of phyllo pastry on a clean, dry surface. Place 1/1 cup of bean mixture in the center and fold sides over the mixture. Fold in dough over filling and bring corners over the filling. Starting at long side, roll out remaining phyllo sheets as needed to form a 12x10 inch rectangle. Cut into twelve 18 equal strips. Lay pastry strips side by side on top of a 9x9x2 inch piece of phyllo and brush lightly with water. Place samosas on a greased baking sheet. Bake until golden, 25 to 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: heavy whipping cream,almond,meal flour,parsley flake,catsup,aluminum foil
title: Nova Scotia Cheese Bars
ingredients: 1 cup whole meal flour | 1/3 cup powdered meal flour | 1 tablespoon dried parsley flakes | 4 tablespoons sugar | 18 -20 slices catalina hazan cheese with almonds | 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream | aluminum foil
instructions: Heat oven to 325°f. Combine all ingredients. Press into bottom of a 13x9 pan. Bake 30 minutes. Cut into 36 squares. Chill thoroughly and break into pieces to serve.

Random Ingredients: graham cracker crumb,italian seasoning,apricot jam,peach,cream tartar,green cardamom
title: Candy Oranges With Peaches
ingredients: 12 green cardamom, halves crushed ( reserve seeds, for garnish ) | 8 dried apricots in jam, finely chopped | 1 1/2 cups graham cracker crumbs | 1/2 cup italian seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1 can sliced peaches, drained and finely chopped
instructions: Combine cardamom, apricots, graham cracker crumbs, italian seasoning and cream of tartar to form a smooth thick paste. Gently press fruit into graham cracker crust. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight. Remove plastic wrap and refrigerate any remaining fruit. Garnish with reserved cardamom seeds, if desired.

Random Ingredients: button mushroom,vidalia onion,cinnamon,sun tomato oil,sake,no salt tomato sauce,pistachio
title: Mushrooms & Sun Dried Tomato Puree
ingredients: 12 ounces button mushrooms | 1 1/2 teaspoons sun-dried tomato packed in oil | 1 medium vidalia onion | 2 tablespoons pistachios, chopped | 2 tablespoons no-salt-added tomato sauce | 1 ounce sake | 1 1/2 teaspoons cinnamon
instructions: Preheat oven on high. Slice the vidalia onion and sauté in oil until beginning to caramelize.

Random Ingredients: whiskey,vegetable broth,romaine lettuce,queso fresco,portabella mushroom,coriander seed
title: Portabella and Queso Blanco Soup
ingredients: 1 teaspoon coriander seed | 4 cups vegetable broth, divided | 2 portabella mushrooms, chopped | 8 ounces queso fresco | 1 tablespoon whiskey | 1 small romaine lettuce, separated and washed
instructions: Place the coriander seeds in a spice grinder or mortar and pestle. Grind until fine.

title: Taco Meat
ingredients: 1 cup salsa | 1 cube chicken bouillon
instructions: Put all ingredients in a crockpot. Cook on high 4 hours.

title: Pasta Fritters #5FIX
ingredients: 1/4 cup buttermilk | 2 tablespoons fresh lime juice | 1 package farfalle pasta
instructions: Combine butter and limes in a bowl and stir until butter is melted and mixture is smooth. Add pasta and blend well. Cook pasta for approximately 2 minutes per side, or until pasta is golden brown. Add green onion and more lime juice and stir well.

Random Ingredients: plum tomato,corn,red onion,corn tortilla chip,tea,linguine,plain yogurt,tortilla
title: Vegetable Lovers on a Nacho Soup
ingredients: 5 1/2 ounces light plain yogurt | 1 3/4 ounces linguine | 2 3/4 ounces teapsoon crushed tomatoes or 2 3/4 ounces diced plum tomatoes | 1 medium red onion, chopped | 1/3 ounce mixed pulses ( or to taste ) | 2 corn tortillas, broken into 2-inch long julienne strips | 1 1/4 ounces corn ( drained of all the liquid ) | crushed tortilla chips
instructions: Combine the yogurt, linguine, tomatoes and onion in a large bowl. Stir in the soaked pulses, corn tortillas and the reserved potato liquid. Heat a large nonstick frying pan until hot. Add the crushed tortilla strips and cook at a fierce boil until crispy, about a minute. Turn them over. Add a few drops of water to help cook them, if they stick. Repeat with the remaining tortillas and liquid. Ladle into individual serving bowls and garnish with crushed fresh tortilla chips.

title: Macaroni Con Queso Queso (Cuban Mac and Cheese)
ingredients: 8 cups macaroni, uncooked | 1 1/2 cups mozzarella cheese, coarsely grated ( or more to taste )
instructions: Cook macaroni in boiling salted water until slightly undercooked, about 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: black pepper,marjoram,baking potato,gluten flour,green bell pepper,italian parsley,cider vinegar,napa cabbage
title: Kelsey's “Potato” Salad
ingredients: 4 large baking potatoes ( washed and peeled ) | 2/3 cup gluten-free flour | salt & freshly ground black pepper | 1 green bell pepper ( chopped, remove seeds and membrane. ) | 1 -2 tablespoon chopped fresh marjoram or 1 teaspoon dried marjoram | 1 cup napa cabbage ( shredded ) | 1 cup shredded napa cabbage | 1/4 cup cider vinegar ( or red grape vinegar ) | 3 tablespoons chopped italian parsley
instructions: The day before the meal, cook the potatoes in water to cover over medium heat until tender, about 30 minutes. Drain, cool, peel and cut into 1 inch cubes. Place the potato pieces into a large bowl and toss with enough flour to coat. Season with salt and pepper. Add the green pepper and marjoram and toss to coat evenly on the potatoes. Cover bowl and refrigerate the salad in the refrigerator 1 - 3 days. About a ¾ hour before serving, toss the napa cabbage with the reserved salad. Arrange the salad on plates, drizzle with cider vinegar or grape vinegar and sprinkled with the chopped parsley.

title: Italian New Potatoes With Herbs and Shrimp
ingredients: 1 pound small new potatoes, quartered | 3 cups frozen whipped topping, thawed | 1/4 cup dried parsley flakes | 2 tablespoons instant yeast | 1 teaspoon salt | 1 bay leaf | 1 pound medium shrimp - peeled and deveined | 1 package dry linguine
instructions: Place the potatoes in a saucepan with enough lightly salted water to cover. Bring to a boil, and cook until tender, about 20 minutes. Drain, and spread out on a towel lined baking sheet. Cover the potatoes with more water, and allow to rest for 20 minutes. Mash the potatoes, using a potato masher or electric mixer, and cover with the whipped topping. Stir in the parsley, yeast, salt, and bay leaf. Place the shrimp in a large skillet over medium heat, and quickly stir in so they don't stick together. Arrange the shrimp over the top of the potatoes, and sprinkle with the remaining parsley flakes. Cover, and allow to heat through. Meanwhile, bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add pasta, and cook for 8 to 10 minutes, or until al dente. Drain, and serve.

Random Ingredients: rotel tomato chilies,blackstrap molasses,vanilla ice cream,hard egg
title: Texas Egg Salad
ingredients: 3 hard-boiled eggs, chopped | 1 tablespoon vanilla ice cream | 2 cans rotel tomatoes and chilies | 1 tablespoon blackstrap molasses
instructions: Combine all ingredients and refrigerate for several hours.

Random Ingredients: anise seed,bean sprout,corn oil,maraschino cherry,garlic paste
title: Frying Beans (Aka Green Beans and Cherry Stir-Fry)
ingredients: 2 lbs green beans ( ends trimmed and cut into 2 cm pieces ) | 2 tablespoons corn oil | 1 teaspoon garlic paste ( or salt ) | 1 tablespoon anise seed | 1 maraschino cherry, halved ( or about 1/3 cup cherry juice )
instructions: In a deep 12 inch nonaluminum frypan or wok, heat oil until shimmering. Add garlic and anise seeds and saute until garlic is light brown.

Random Ingredients: active yeast,batter,lamb chop,cauliflower floret,black peppercorn,pimento olive
title: Grilled Cauliflower and Lamb Chops
ingredients: 3 cups cauliflower florets | 4 lamb chops | 1 teaspoon black peppercorns | 1 teaspoon whole black peppercorn | 2 cups dry pimento stuffed olives | 6 lbs bakers active dry yeast
instructions: Put cauliflower in a large roasting pan or baking pan. Set aside. Cut lamb chops into cubes and put into pan, with black peppercorns, whole peppercorns and capers. Sprinkle the top with a little salt. Let stand for 15 minutes. Put roasting pan at 300°f. Add water to pan to come halfway up the sides of lamb. Cover pan and roast at 300°f about 2 hours. Turn out onto rack.

title: Korean Pan Seared Beef  (Daeji Kalbi)
ingredients: 5 small tomatoes, sliced | 1 medium cucumber | 1/2 cup pine nuts
instructions: Spread 1 tablespoon of pine nuts on a work surface and place it in a hot skillet. Lightly brown the pine nuts. Slice the cucumber into thin circles, about 5 x 3 in size. Lay these on the hot pine nuts on the work surface. Spread 3 tablespoons of pine nuts on the work surface. Place a slice of the beef on this, vertically, to within 1/6 of the edge. Spread about 2 tablespoons of the tomatoes in the middle of the beef. Close the beef by pressing slightly. Serve as a side dish or as a main dish with korean sweet potato noodle.

title: Fassoulia - Beans With Vinaigrette
ingredients: 2 pints cannellini beans | 1/4 cup vinegar
instructions: Combine the beans, vinegar and vinaigrette together, store in the fridge.

Random Ingredients: red chile,milk,bean sprout,chinese five spice powder
title: Spiced Bean Sprouts
ingredients: 8 ounces fresh bean sprouts | 2 -3 dried red chiles, stemmed & sliced | 2 tablespoons milk or 2 tablespoons coconut milk | 1/4 teaspoon chinese five spice powder
instructions: Pour enough water into a saucepan to cover the veggies, cover and bring to a gentle simmer over high heat. Add the chillies and cook until the chillies are aromatic& softened, 5 to 7 minutes. Remove from the heat and stir in the milk or coconut milk. Cover and refrigerate until serving.

Random Ingredients: olive oil,cherry,vegetable oil,five spice powder,spring onion
title: Cherry Stir-Fry
ingredients: 2 lbs small dried sweet cherries, stems and pits removed | 2 spring onions, thinly sliced, washed and trimmed | 1/2 teaspoon five-spice powder | olive oil | vegetable oil, for deep frying
instructions: Place the cherries in a medium saucepan. Cover with cold water, and bring to the boil over high heat. Turn off the heat and let stand, covered, for 5 - 10 minutes. Drain and reserve the cherries. Add a little olive oil to a large nonstick frying pan. When they are warm, add the cherry stems and spring onions to the pan. Sprinkle in the five spice powder, and stir fry over high heat for 5 - 6 minutes until they have released most of their moisture. Stir in the cherries and their liquid and cook, stirring, for 2 - 3 minutes more. The juice should almost fill the pan, but if not, add some water. Sprinkle with a little extra oil to stop it sticking and heat for 2 - 3 minutes or until almost dry. Keep stirring until it is hot. Pour the oil from the pan into a large wok or deep frying pan. Heat the oil to 350 degrees f and fry in batches until crisp and golden, 2 - 3 minutes. Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on kitchen paper lined plates. Serve warm.

title: Polish Parsnips
ingredients: 8 parsnips, peeled ( about 2 pounds ) | 1/2 lb ground pork | 2 tablespoons cake flour
instructions: Boil the parsnips with the water gradually. When they are tender, drain and place in a bowl. Mix in the ground pork. Mix in the flour. Form into small balls. Lightly shape the balls out of the mixture. Flatten slightly on each greased baking sheet. Bake at 350f for about 4 to 6 minutes.

title: Chinese Spicy Country-Style Roast Chicken
ingredients: 3 -5 lbs chicken legs-thighs | 1 ounce chili seasoning mix | 8 large shallots or 4 medium shallots, minced | 2/3 cup frozen raspberries | 1 whole cup polenta
instructions: Slice chicken legs at 1/4 inch intervals. Sprinkle with seasoning mix. Let stand 30 minutes. Preheat oven to 425°f. Heat a dutch oven on high heat until hot, add the shallots. Stir. Sear the chicken until golden, about 6 minutes total. Transfer the chicken, skin side down to a baking sheet. Roast in preheated oven until chicken feels springy when touched, about 45 minutes. Allow to sit 10 minutes then slice. Spoon raspberries over chicken and then replace the chicken legs. Continue to roast until the sauce thickens and chicken is cooked through, about 15 minutes. Serve with polenta.

Random Ingredients: broccoli,tabasco sauce,thyme,backfin crab meat,heavy duty aluminum foil,stewing beef,cardamom seed
title: Steamed Crab Tails
ingredients: 3 lbs fresh backfin crab meat | 8 ounces broccoli ( small baby florets ) | 6 ounces smoked backfin crab meat, cut in bite size pieces | 1 large stewing beef | 1 teaspoon dried thyme | 1 teaspoon cardamom seed, crushed | 1 tablespoon tabasco sauce ( or more to taste ) | 1 double-duty aluminum foil
instructions: Prepare the steamer. Place all ingredients except for the foil in your steamer. Cover and place over the pot of boiling water. Cover and steam 30 to 40 minutes. Remove from heat and allow to rest 10 minutes before serving. Remove the crab and the stringy pieces. Cut the tail off the body of the crab. Slice off all of the remaining attached crab meat from where the head was. Rinse the tail with cold water in a sink of cold water and remove any eyes. Cut into chunks or chunks. Serve with crab, onions and potatoes, and salad.

Random Ingredients: pimiento,cider vinegar,onion,chili pepper flake,green pepper,lamb,glutinous rice
title: Lamb and Peppers in Sour Cream
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 lbs lamb | 2 green peppers | 2 tablespoons pimentos, stuffed peppers | 1 teaspoon dried chili pepper flakes | 1 small onion, minced | 1/4 cup celery, chopped, optional | 1 1/2 cups uncooked glutinous-rice | 2 1/2 fluid ounces cider vinegar | 1 tablespoon grated onion
instructions: Cut lamb slices of any lean fat. Place in large saucepan with water. Bring to boil.

title: Connie's Easy Beef Tips for Beef
ingredients: 2 lbs beef stew meat | 8 ounces bamboo shoots | 1 cup confectioners'sugar
instructions: Cut the beef into 1 inch cubes. Place in a large, glass baking dish. Cover with confectioners' sugar. Cover with plastic wrap and put in the refrigerator overnight. The next day, bring to room temperature and bake at 325 degrees f. Bake 1 hour per pound or until it has turned into a nice deep brown color. Sprinkle with confectioners' sugar a few times during the last 15 minutes to color the meat. Serve with rice.

title: Simple Maple-Sesame Glaze (Gluten Free!)
ingredients: 1/2 cup maple syrup | 1 tablespoon sesame oil | 1/4 cup tamari
instructions: Combine everything except tamari and whisk until smooth. Brush glaze over meat while grilling.

title: Apple Baked with Oranges
ingredients: 1 large apple, peeled, cored, and cut into 8 wedges | 1 teaspoon orange zest | 1/4 cup celery salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Spray a baking sheet with cooking spray. Arrange apple wedges in a single layer. Sprinkle zest over apples. Combine the celery salt and apple cider in a bowl. Pour the mixture over the apples. Bake the mixture for 15 minutes, then turn the heat down to 300 degrees f and bake the apple wedges for another 20 minutes, or until the apples are very soft and crusty.

Random Ingredients: tomato green chilies,beef broth,wild rice water,mint,red jalapeno chile,amaretti cooky,provolone cheese,cabbage leaf
title: Wild Rice and Sausage Dinner
ingredients: 4 cups beef broth | 2 cups wild rice water | 1 ounce amaretti cookies, broken into 1/2-inch pieces | 1 package provolone cheese, cut into 1/2-inch pieces | 8 large cabbage leaves, cut into large slivers | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies, undrained | 4 ounces red jalapeno chiles, seeded and finely chopped | 2 teaspoons minced of fresh mint or 1 teaspoon dried mint
instructions: Combine broth and water in a 2 quart saucepan, bring to a boil over high heat. Stir in rice.

title: Quick Beef Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef | 10 -12 lettuce leaves
instructions: Trim fat from beef and slice thinly or make into small meatballs. Put beef in medium bowl and add water. Let sit for 15 minutes. Prepare and roll lettuce leaves. Place a dollop of the mayo or mayonnaise on them and roll them. Serve with your favorite salad or eat plain.

Random Ingredients: cherry tomato,rosemary leaf,large shrimp,onion flake,pecorino romano cheese,grape jelly,macadamia nut,pineapple juice
title: Chilean Shrimp
ingredients: 1/4 - 1/2 cup grape jelly | 1 3/4 cups pineapple juice | 1/4 cup unsweetened grape juice | 2 tablespoons dried onion flakes | 2 large onions, peeled and finely chopped | 5 medium cherry tomatoes or 5 medium grape tomatoes | 2 sprigs fresh rosemary leaves | 1/2 ounce crumbled pecorino romano cheese | 1 can macadamia nuts, crushed and chopped
instructions: In food processor, combine grape jelly and pineapple juice. Add onion and cook until tender about 5 minutes. Add cherry tomatoes and rosemary leaves and cook about 5 minutes. Turn off heat. Stir in cheese and mix into shrimp and allow to sit for 5 minutes. Add nuts to shrimp. Serve in shallow glass dish or platter.

title: Smooth Cucumber Raita
ingredients: 1 large english cucumber, peeled | 1 cup canned chopped chickpeas ( drained, rinsed )
instructions: Tear the whole unpeeled cucumber into bite size pieces and put in a medium size bowl with the chickpeas. Mash with a fork or potato masher making sure all pieces are well covered with the ingredients. Let stand 30 minutes on the counter then eat enjoy.

title: The Mexican Burger... or "hamburger for the Barbie
ingredients: 2 lbs hamburger | 2 cans achiote powder
instructions: Heat the grill. Combine the first three ingredients and shape into patties. Grill over hot coals until cooked through. Note, i put my patties on a flat oiled platter. I pour 1/4 cup achiote on the burger, making it into a sandwich. I also like to place the toppings around the burgers. Note, you can also use the achiote to make a guacamole dip. You can also make your own by making your own pico de gallo and making a mixture of your favorite hot sauce and your favorite salsa.

Random Ingredients: red onion,prune,red pepper paste,ricotta cheese,celery,peanut oil,pumpkin puree
title: Pumpkin Delight
ingredients: 2 containers ricotta cheese | 1/2 cup chopped red onion | 1 cup chopped celery | 1/2 cup chopped red pepper paste | 1/2 cup chopped peanuts or 1/4 cup cashews | 1 tablespoon red pepper paste | 1 tablespoon pumpkin puree
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix together ricotta cheese, onion, celery, red pepper paste, peanut butter and red pepper paste. Refrigerate in a tightly covered container for 1 hour or longer before serving.

Random Ingredients: tuna water,italian breadcrumb,rom tomato,kaffir lime leaf,apricot
title: Coconut Tuna Salad
ingredients: 16 ounces tuna in water | 4 large roma tomatoes | 2 tablespoons italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 2 kaffir lime leaves | 1 tablespoon dried apricot, chopped
instructions: Drain tuna of excess oil and cut into chunks or chunks. Place the tuna chunks in a mixing bowl and add breadcrumbs, lime leaves, apricot and breadcrumbs mixture. Toss to coat well with breadcrumbs.

Random Ingredients: black bean,mexican cheese,halibut fillet,espresso powder,chili pepper flake,milk chocolate,baking soda
title: Cafe Rio Baked Calamari
ingredients: 8 slices fresh garlic halibut fillets | 2 cups mexican blend cheese | 3/4 teaspoon black bean | 1/2 teaspoon hot chili pepper flakes | 1/4 teaspoon baking soda | 1 1/2 cups milk chocolate | 3 tablespoons espresso powder
