instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees. Arrange alternate layers of cut cheese and garlic on the inside of your roasting pan. Spread black beans evenly over top of fillets. Sprinkle chili flakes, baking soda, and milk chocolate evenly over all. Bake in oven 25 minutes. Remove from oven and remove cheese slices from pan and set aside for 5 minutes. Turn oven off and allow to sit at least 20 - 30 minutes for the cheese to absorb the wonderful coffee and to wilt your cheese. Serve with more grated mexican cheese if desired. Enjoy.

title: African Brew
ingredients: 1/2 ounce amarula cream liqueur | 1/2 ounce rye bread, room temperature
instructions: Dip rye bread in liqueur, coating both sides and allowing any breading on the surface to adhere. Store in a glass container or glass container.

title: Chinese Cabbage
ingredients: 1 head chinese cabbage, washed and finely shredded ( napa or napa. ) | 1 teaspoon radish, finely chopped
instructions: Place the cabbage in a saucepan and cover with water. Bring to a boil, then reduce to low and simmer for 2 to 3 minutes. Drain well. Add radish. Heat another saucepan of water, then remove from the heat, cover and set aside. Let stand for 3 to 5 minutes before serving, sprinkled with powdered ginger if desired.

title: Horseleguy Eggs
ingredients: 1 pound chicken leg quarters | 3/4 cup bread crumbs | 1 cup shredded cheddar cheese | 1 1/2 teaspoons horseradish
instructions: Preheat an oven to 375 degrees f. Arrange the chicken legs in a single layer in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Mix the bread crumbs, cheddar cheese, and horseradish together in a bowl. Dip the chicken legs in bread crumb mixture, and lay into a single layer on the top of the chicken pieces. Bake in the preheated oven until the tops start to turn golden brown, 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Hot Pepper Beer  for the BBQ
ingredients: 1 bottle or bottle hot pepper, with the liquid ( about 1/1 & 1/2 bottle ) | ice cube
instructions: Pour or bottle into 5 cup glass. Add enough ice cube to fill to within 1/4 inch of the top of the beer. Place on the hot pepper. Let cool or serve, enjoy.

title: Dill-Herb Beef Short Ribs
ingredients: 1/2 cup dill leaf, coarsely chopped | 20 lbs beef tenderloin, in 3 inch cubes | 4 ears corn, shucked and kernels cut from cobs
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 f. Place beef, corn, and dill in 4 to 4 quart dutch oven. Pour 1 cup boiling water over meat and corn and bring to boil over moderate heat. Cover and pan juices may be used as a broth if desired. Bake, uncovered, 1 1/2 hours. Remove from oven.

title: A Unique Linguine With the Crunchy Bakchourie (Linguine) Recipe
ingredients: 8 ounces linguine | 12 ounces bok choy ( small baby bella ) | 6 leaves fresh mint leaves | 2 tablespoons dark rum | 1/8 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1/2 orange, zested finely ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon walnut pieces ( optional ) | freshly chopped walnuts ( optional )
instructions: Start to cook the linguine and then drain the water before it gets dry. Slice the bokchourie into thin, bite size pieces and set aside. Toss the pasta with the turmeric, orange zest and rum then set aside. Chop the mint leaves, including the heads. Add the mint leaves, chopped walnuts and bakchourie to the pasta with the nuts.

title: Mint Jumbo Rolls
ingredients: 1/2 cup mint jelly | 8 small egg roll wraps | parsley
instructions: Heat mint jelly in microwave or saucepan until jelly is hot, about 1 to 2 minutes. Add beaten egg roll wrapper to jelly mix, and turn over while folding in sides and ends. Remove from microwave and roll up like a jelly roll. Cut in half crosswise, and roll up and seal with a little bit of parsley. Makes 16 rolls.

Random Ingredients: caper,pork tenderloin,mozzarella cheese,red chili pepper,chipotle chile
title: Quick and Easy Chiles and Pork Tenderloin
ingredients: 1 lb pork tenderloin, cubed | 1 1/2 - 2 cups shredded mozzarella cheese or 1 1/2-2 cups asiago cheese | 1 cup sliced capers | 1/2 cup finely chopped canned chipotle chile pieces ( to taste ) | 1 large fresh red chili pepper, thinly sliced in rings
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place pork tenderloins in large baking dish. Spread the cheese over the top. Place chipotle, red chile, and capers over the top of the cheese. Cover dish with foil and bake 30 minutes. Remove foil, top with the pork and continue baking 30 minutes until tenderloins are cooked through. Let stand 10 minutes before slicing.

Random Ingredients: hot red chili pepper,active yeast,walnut,cream mushroom soup,cider vinegar,oregano leaf,sage,tahini
title: Sour Cream Cheese & Hot Red Chili Spread
ingredients: 1 box active dry yeast | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1/4 cup tahini | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1/2 cup chopped walnuts | 1 tablespoon dried sage | 3 cups hot red chili peppers | 2 tablespoons cider vinegar
instructions: In large bowl, sprinkle yeast over 1 cup of warm water, stir to dissolve.

title: Calde Verde Con Mussels
ingredients: 15 large black olives | 1 can mussels in water ( cleaned )
instructions: Boil water in a large pot. Drain can of mussels in colander for about 5 minutes. Then drain mussels, and pour out excess liquid. Place mussels back into pot. Place clean mussels in pot, and pour the remaining liquid over the mussels. Cover, reduce heat to medium, and simmer for 5 minutes. Discard any mussels that haven't opened. Turn heat off, and let sit for an hour before serving.

title: Spicy Japanese Cucumber Rice Flour (Rice Pancakes)
ingredients: 2 large cucumbers ( about 14-16 ) | 2 cups rice flour | 1/2 teaspoon curry of your choice or 1/4 teaspoon red curry powder | lime wedge ( optional )
instructions: Peel and coarsely grate the cucumbers using a small, fine grater. Place the grated cucumber into a small bowl. Rinse and dry the cucumbers under cold water to remove as much of the excess moisture as possible. Use hands to squeeze and break them into 1/3 inch chunky pieces. Stir in the rice flour and curry powder. Heat a 3 or 4 inch nonstick skillet over high heat until a bead of water dropped onto it evaporates, about 2 minutes. Use a fork to drop the cooked rice batter by a rounded teaspoonful into the hot pan. The batter will form bubbles that rise to the surface. Use a spoon to spread the batter evenly to form a circle. Cook until golden brown on the bottom, about 2 minutes. Turn and cook on the other side, about 2 minutes longer. Repeat with remaining batter. Sprinkle the cooked cucumbers with lime wedges, if desired.

Random Ingredients: shrimp,portabella mushroom,rigatoni pasta,marjoram leaf,salami,mace,greek yogurt,italian parsley
title: Pasta With Shrimp & Salami
ingredients: 12 ounces rigatoni pasta | 1 -2 teaspoon dried marjoram leaves | 1/2 teaspoon mace | 3 ounces salami | 4 ounces smoked greek yogurt or 4 ounces softened cheese | 2 tablespoons fresh italian parsley, chopped | 3 2 ounces shrimp or 3 ounces clams, steamed and drained | 8 ounces portabella mushrooms or 8 ounces chinese mushrooms, thickly sliced
instructions: Cook pasta in boiling, salted water until al dente. Drain pasta, reserving 1 cup of the cooking water. Place the cooked pasta into a warm serving bowl and add the marjoram, mace, and half the salami. Meanwhile, place the remaining salami and greek yogurt or cheese in a small bowl and using a hand blender, mash until smooth. Add pasta liquid and continue mashed until well blended. Gently fold in chopped parsley. Place the remaining salami slices and the mushrooms into a preheated baking dish or gratin or casserole dish. Spoon pasta salad onto the salami, then spoon sauce over. Sprinkle with remaining salami slices and serve.

Random Ingredients: cauliflower,feta cheese,zucchini,broiler fryer chicken,bean,rice wine,beef brisket,arborio rice
title: Lulu's Greek Chicken and Rice Dinner
ingredients: 6 broiler-fryer chickens | 8 ounces feta cheese | 3 cups cooked rice or 3 cups cooked rice ( 4 servings ) | 1 cup rice wine or 1 cup dry sherry, such as bomba | 2 1/2 cups cooked cauliflower, chopped | 1 cup beef brisket, chopped | 1 zucchini, halved and sliced | 2 cups arborio rice or 2 cups carnaroli rice
instructions: Put rack in upper 1/3 of oven and preheat to 450°f. Place chickens on rack. Put feta on top rack and place in large roasting pan, about 6 - 8 inches from the very top. Drape 1 cup feta over chicken. Roast until skin is browned, 2 1/2 to 3 1/2 hours. Turn chickens, breast side up, and roast about 15 minutes longer. Cool, then slice from breast skin to breast meat. While chicken is still warm, remove skin and bones, but save the meat juices.

Random Ingredients: shortcrust pastry,cottage cheese,yukon gold potato,vinegar,potato,parmesan cheese
title: Irish Potato Pies
ingredients: 2 large yukon gold potatoes, peeled, diced | 1/2 cup low-fat cottage cheese | 1 tablespoon fat-free parmesan cheese, grated | 1 tablespoon vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 6 sheets shortcrust pastry, thawed ( i used trader joe's in the freezer for about an hour and a half )
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Place potatoes in a large saucepan. Add cold water just enough to cover and bring to a boil. Meanwhile, using a colander or strainer, drain potatoes and return to pan. Cover and return to saucepan once cooled for 15 minutes before combining with cottage cheese, parmesan and vinegar on a clean surface. Taste mixture and adjust seasoning if necessary. Cut out a 5 or 6 inch circle with a drinking glass or pastry cutter and place 1/8 cup of potato mixture into shell. Brush top with water and fold over to create half moon shapes. Bake pies for 10 minutes or until puffed and golden.

title: Homemade Irish Whiskey Cream
ingredients: 1 cup whiskey | 1 cup heavy whipping cream
instructions: In a small, warm drinking glass, combine whiskey and cream. Using a fork, dissolve the liquid in the whiskey mixture. Pour cream mixture into a small, heavy bottomed pot, and heat slowly over a medium heat. Pour cream mixture over top, and serve.

title: Crispy Cornmeal Mix
ingredients: 5 cups cornmeal | 1/4 cup peppercorn
instructions: Grind 1 1/2 cups cornmeal in a food processor, or a mixer. Spread or lightly spread the mixture on a baking tray with a rolling pin, and allow to rest in a cool place for 30 to 45 minutes. Preheat oven to 230 degrees celsius. Spread 2 tablespoons flambegetable oil on 2 baking trays, and spread out the cornmeal to coat. Sprinkle peppercorns evenly, and bake at 230 degrees celsius for 25 to 30 minutes, or until crisp and light brown. Allow to cool slightly before removing from the trays. Store any leftover cornmeal mix in an air tight container.

title: Blueberry Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb rigatoni pasta | 3 tablespoons brown sugar | 1 tablespoon vinegar | 2 tablespoons golden syrup | 4 cups blueberries | 4 tablespoons feta
instructions: Boil rigatoni until al dente, drain and place in a bowl. Mix together the ingredients, except the blueberries, and pour over the rigatoni and berries. Garnish with the blueberries.

title: Beef Rillettes
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs beef rump roast | 1 cup cider or 1 cup sherry wine | 6 -8 tablespoons peppppercorns, cracked | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1 -2 teaspoon hot pepper paste | 6 -8 slices bacon, cooked and chopped | 8 tortillas | slivered almonds, toasted
instructions: Place meat in crockpot. Cover with cider.

title: Ginger and Caraway Root Sauce for Roasted Garlic
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh gingerroot | 1 lb carrot | 1/2 cup fresh italian parsley | 1 tablespoon caraway seed
instructions: Peel, grate and smash the cloves of garlic. Mix all ingredients in a large bowl. Let sit at room temperature for 20 minutes before serving as a sweetener. Serve with roast beef, turkey, lamb, or lamb cut into thin bite sized pieces. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: meat,wheat bread,phyllo pastry,vegetable oil cooking spray,wheat flour,jasmine rice
title: Whole Wheat Phyllo Triangles
ingredients: 1/2 lb ground meat | 2/3 cup uncooked jasmine rice ( about 1/2 cup long grain ) | vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 package frozen phyllo pastry, thawed and cut into 18 squares | 1/2 cup whole wheat flour | 3 cups whole wheat bread, crusts removed
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. In a medium saucepan, combine the ground meat and rice. Pour enough water over the rice to cover half the pan, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer, covered, until the rice is tender, about 18 to 20 minutes. Drain, and set aside. Grease a 13 x9 baking dish. Set aside. Place pastry squares on one counter, and place a scant 1 tablespoon of the ground meat in the middle of each. Brush the sides lightly with vegetable oil. Place 6 triangles in the prepared baking dish, and cover them with 3 more phyllo triangles. Pour the rice mixture over the triangles, and sprinkle with half of the remaining ground meat. Bring the layered triangle pieces up over the rice, and seal the edges with moistened fingers. Cover with parchment paper, and bake for 15 minutes. Remove from oven, and allow to cool. For a special treat, top with a couple of slices of cedar cheese.

title: Vanilla Yummies
ingredients: 1 can rotel tomatoes & chilies, hot v8
instructions: Mix rotel, chili's, and vanilla together.

title: Greek Stuffed Dates
ingredients: 20 large pitted dates | 1 tablespoon orange zest, finely minced | milk | 1/2 cup almond milk | 1 package cream cheese | slivered slivered almonds ( optional )
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees. Remove pits from dates. Grease the bottom and sides of a large baking dish and fill with enough almond milk to make 4 1/2 cup capacity. Add orange zest and a pinch of salt. Remove ends or tough skins from dates. If desired, reshise dates, and place on a plate along with almond milk if desired. If desired, slice them to serve. If desired, lightly coat the dates with slivered almond slivers. Cover and bake for 30 minutes or until a toothpick inserted comes out clean. Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

title: Cauliflower Soup
ingredients: 32 fluid ounces vegetable broth | 1 head cauliflower, finely chopped | 1/4 cup pearl onion, minced ( optional ) | sea salt, pepper to taste
instructions: Place cauliflower in a large saucepan cover with enough water, bring to a boil and simmer until tender. Drain well and set aside. Meanwhile in a large saucepan bring vegetable broth to the boil. Add chopped cauliflower, onion and salt and pepper. Reduce heat and simmer until cauliflower is tender. Note i like to boil it down a bit then stir in the minced onion before serving.

title: Oat Bran, Aubergine and Brown Rice Breakfast Tagine
ingredients: 1 large aubergine, chopped | 300 ml vegetable broth | 2 teaspoons oats bran | 1 teaspoon brown rice | 1/4 teaspoon sumac | 1 slice tasty cheese, grated ( optional )
instructions: Put the aubergine in a bowl with the broth. Mix everything together thoroughly but don't break it or your aubergine will get soggy. Cover and leave to stand, then bring to the boil for 5 minutes. Drain. Use the same water to cook the rice, add a pinch of sumac if using and stir well. Then take off the heat. Tear the cheese slice into strips and distribute between the two bowls. Break up the aubergine with your hands and stir through. Squeeze the reserved aubergine flavour from the aubergine and put inside the other bowls.

Random Ingredients: water,brandy,cardamom,plain yogurt,beef bouillon cube,spring onion,pork,button mushroom
title: Frikadeller (Dumpling Stuffed Mushrooms)
ingredients: 2 lbs button mushrooms | 2 cups beef bouillon cubes | 2 tablespoons brandy ( or cognac ) | 1 1/2 cups water | 1 pint plain yogurt ( preferably greek style ) | 2 ounces pork rinds or 2 ounces lean pork fat ( or lean ) | 1 bunch spring onion
instructions: Wipe the mushrooms clean and slice off the hard stalks. Mince the mushrooms. Combine the mushrooms, beef bouillon, brandy, water and half the yogurt. Soak the mushrooms for at least two hours to infuse flavours. Make a hole in the center of the mixture, fill with the other half of the yogurt, pour the broth inside, and add spring onions. Fold the mushrooms. The broth will be boiling now and will take about five minutes. Serve. Variant, cook at a very gentle boil for at least one hour, and check for seasoning. Remove stuffing by pouring the broth through a strainer or strainer. When the broth mixture is strained bring it back to a boil. Add the pork rinds or fat and simmer for 5 - 10 minutes. Pour the hot broth from the strainer into a pot with the mushrooms and vegetables. Mix some of the boiled cooking broth into the yogurt and pour it over the mushrooms and vegetables. Chill for a minimum of three hours before serving so they can absorb the flavours. Serve as is for a great meal.

Random Ingredients: hard egg,pearl barley,dark brown sugar,lime juice,phyllo pastry,salt,taco seasoning mix,mace
title: Barley Phyllo Chicken Pies
ingredients: 3 cups pearl barley, cooked | 1 3/4 cups dark brown sugar | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 1 teaspoon salt | 1/2 teaspoon mace | 1 1/2 cups sliced hard-boiled eggs | 1 package frozen phyllo pastry sheets, thawed | 2 tablespoons lime juice mixed with 2 tbs. water
instructions: Prepare barley, place barley, brown sugar, taco seasoning, salt and mace in a medium saucepan. Cover and cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, for 5 minutes. Pour cooked barley over 3/4 cup of sauce, breaking up any lumps. Cover and cook over high heat for 5 minutes. Mix eggs with lime juice. Place in bowl.

title: Easy Pounded Pork Chops
ingredients: 2 pork loin chops, 3/4 inch thick | fresh ground black pepper to taste | 4 fresh mint leaves | 2 tablespoons guacamole, or to taste ( optional )
instructions: Season pork chops with pepper. Place the chops in a shallow dish. Top each chop with a small handful of mint leaves. Place the bowl on the table, and serve with guacamole.

title: Chicken Breast With Orecchiette
ingredients: 6 boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 2 cups cooked orecchiette or 2 cups other type rotini pasta | 3/4 cup dry white wine | 1 small green pepper
instructions: Slice chicken into thin slices about 1/2 inch wide by 3 inches long. Bring a large pot of water to boil, salt heavily. Add orecchiette pasta to boiling water, boil uncovered. Add chicken and cook until 'al dente'. Meanwhile, add wine. When pasta is done, drain. Serve with chicken and green pepper.

title: Rice Salad With Shredded Beef
ingredients: 1 pint fresh strawberry | 1/2 lb boneless chicken | 3 ounces lean cooked lean shaved beef shank | 8 ounces coleslaw | 1 mango, peeled | 1/2 cup shredded coleslaw dressing or 1/2 cup salad dressing | 1/2 - 3/4 teaspoon whole black peppercorn | 8 radishes, very thinly sliced
instructions: Preparation, place strawberries in glass or plastic container with a tight fitting lid. Cover with a layer of shredded corns, shredded beef, and chopped mango. Next you will add the shaved deli chicken. You want the shredded meat in a loose, flat layer. Next mix all the salad ingredients together in a large bowl. Garnish with fresh strawberries and chopped black peppercorns.

title: Mexican Hot Sauce Mix
ingredients: 1/2 cup mayonnaise | 1 1/2 tablespoons chili powder
instructions: Combine mayonnaise and chili powder in a small bowl and mix well. Store the hot sauce mix in an airtight jar. Use sparingly when mixing hot sauce mix.

Random Ingredients: taco seasoning,tomato paste,pine nut,asafoetida powder,black olive,tomato sauce,marshmallow,almond
title: Spicy Taco
ingredients: 1 can black olives, drained | 1 can green olives, drained | 6 fresh tomatoes, chopped | 1/4 cup pine nuts | 3 cups fresh asafoetida powder | 1 tablespoon tomato paste | 1 envelope taco seasoning | 1 can tomato sauce | 1/4 cup toasted sliced almonds
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Place black olives, green olives, tomatoes, pine nuts, asafoetida, tomato paste, and taco seasoning into the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish, respectively.

Random Ingredients: guajillo chilies,nuoc nam,garlic clove,molasses,heavy whipping cream
title: Guajillo Cream Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 cup molasses | 1/4 cup nuoc nam ( vietnamese fish sauce ) | 1 fresh chilies or 1 other dried guajillo chilies, stemmed, seeded, and chopped | 1 tablespoon garlic clove, grated | 1 cup heavy whipping cream
instructions: In small saucepan, heat the molasses and nuoc nam over high heat, swirling the pan occasionally, until bubbles form around the edge, 4 - 5 minutes. Reduce heat to medium. Stir and simmer until a thick film appears on top, 5 - 6 minutes. Set aside. Place chilies in a food processor and pulse until they are coarsely chopped. Add chile mixture, garlic, and cream and process until smooth. Season with salt and pepper. Cool to slightly warm, about 20 minutes before serving in chilled dishes.

Random Ingredients: shiitake mushroom,white flour,lettuce,purpose flour,corn oil,baby carrot,pesto sauce
title: Wild Forest Chicken
ingredients: 2 cups all-purpose flour | 16 ounces mixed baby carrots, julienned | 1 cup fresh shiitake mushrooms, sliced | 2 tablespoons corn oil | 2 tablespoons pesto sauce ( a combination of your favourite ) | shredded lettuce
instructions: In a bowl of a stand mixer, combine flour, carrots and mushrooms. Set aside. Heat a large frying pan over high heat, and add the corn oil. To your dry vegetables in the pan, add pepid pesto. Toss veggies to coat evenly. Stir in the chicken and vegetable mixture to coat evenly. If the chicken mixture begins to dry out, add a tablespoon or two of water. Cook for about 3 minutes on each side, or until cooked through. Remove from heat and cut into pieces. Top each piece with shredded lettuce to serve.

Random Ingredients: fine salt,asparagus,whipping cream,caramel sauce,cake yeast,mango,tri tip steak
title: Gourmet Asparagus and Caramelised Beef Twists
ingredients: 2 1/2 - 3 lbs of fresh asparagus | 1 -2 teaspoon fine salt | 1 lb sliced tri-tip steak | 4 tablespoons whipping cream | 4 tablespoons caramel sauce, divided | 1 teaspoon cake yeast or 1 teaspoon instant yeast | 1/4 cup mango or 1/4 cup cherry tomatoes, cut into slivers
instructions: Cut each asparagus spear lengthwise into 3 inch pieces. Sprinkle salt on asparagus pieces and let stand for about 7 - 10 minutes. Heat heavy saucepan over low heat until bubbles have popped. Add steak strips.

title: Baked Noodles
ingredients: 1 package rigatoni pasta | 1 can unsweetened apple juice | 2 teaspoons dried mint
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil. Once the water is boiling, stir in the rigatoni, and return to a boil. Cook the pasta uncovered, stirring occasionally, until tender but still slightly firm, about 11 minutes. Drain well in a colander set in the sink. Meanwhile, combine the apple juice, and mint in a microwave safe bowl. Cook the noodles in the microwave until heated through, about 2 minutes. Drain and toss with the apple juice mint mixture. Serve immediately.

title: Pork Barbecue Rib Eye

instructions:
Name:- ##
 Pork Barbecue Rib Eye 
 
## Ingredients ##
 4 -5 lbs pork belly, bone trimmed, with fat and membrane on the underside of the meat. The fat will float to the top of the ribs and this will cause the ribs to break apart. Sprinkle generously with kosher salt and let sit for about an hour. Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Lay the membrane side down, and sprinkle generously with kosher salt. Wrap the belly tightly in aluminum foil so that the fat ends up in the center of the pork. Bake about 3 hours. The fat will continue to solidify and the membrane will come off in the last few minutes. Remove fat from oven and set aside. Place meat on cutting board and slice into thin strips. Shred the meat in a saute pan with several forks, adding a little hot fat liquid while you shred. When the meat has reached your preferred thickness and is easy to work with, it is ready and is ready for use. Serve as a side dish with mashed potato.

title: BBQ  Broiled courgette  (Courgettes) With Ale
ingredients: 2 pints light domestic beer or 2 pints sparkling beer, for optimum flavor | 1 bulb of garlic ( about 12.5 ounces ) or 2 heads garlic, peeled, very thinly sliced | 1 stalk celery, roughly chopped | 1/3 cup soy sauce | 4 tablespoons yoghurt
instructions: Place the beer into a saucepan. Place the garlic on top of it. Cover and cook over fairly low heat for 2 hours, shaking the pan regularly. Turn off the oven. Remove the garlic. With a small sharp knife, cut away the top layers of skin and tenderise the garlic. Remove the dark vein of the garlic and discard. With a slotted spoon, scrape the skin off of the garlic using a metal spoon, and cut any remaining skin into small pieces. Keep the garlic in a screw top jar or container, covered with cling film, if using. When the beer has been reduced by one quarter, carefully remove the film and add the garlic. Bring the mixture back to the boil and stir in the soy sauce and celery. Add the fried courgettes to the hot mixture and simmer for 5 minutes, covered, stirring occasionally. Taste the sauce, season with salt and pepper and stir through the yoghurt. Serve at once.

title: Tortilla
ingredients: 1 pound ground sirloin | 1 tablespoon taco seasoning mix | 1 cube vegetable stock | 2 eggs, beaten
instructions: In a shallow bowl, mix together the ground sirloin, taco seasoning and vegetable stock. Beat in the eggs until well combined. Heat a large skillet over medium heat. Fry the mixture until browned, about 4 minutes.

Random Ingredients: margarine,malt vinegar,sunflower oil,chicken wing,celery rib,canadian bacon
title: Canadian Bacon and Egg Drop Soup
ingredients: 4 -6 lbs chicken wings, drumsticks, and wings on the bone | 4 ounces canadian bacon ( in nz bacon only, canadian bacon can be replaced with ham ) | 1 stalk celery rib, chopped | 1 1/2 - 2 cups canadian malt vinegar ( you can substitute cider vinegar ) | 6 tablespoons sunflower oil | margarine
instructions: Wash and dry the chicken and drumsticks. Place in crockpot. Mix chicken and drumsticks, vinegar, canadian bacon, celery and sunflower oil. Cook for 4 - 6 hours. Half hour before serving remove the chicken and drumsticks, chop and return the cooked chicken to the pot. Taste for seasoning. If it is not acidic enough, add more of the canadian vinegar. If it is too sour for your taste, add a touch of sugar or sugar substitute. Add the canadian bacon pieces and cook for 15 minutes. Serve and make sure you enjoy it.

title: Fajita Polenta
ingredients: 2 teaspoons instant fajita seasoning mix | 12 ounces refrigerated prepared polenta | 1/2 cup firmly packed finely shredded lemon peel | 12 cilantro leaves
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the fajita seasoning mix, polenta and lemon peel.

title: Pimentos Stuffed French Bread Loaf
ingredients: 2 loaves french bread | 1 jar chopped pimiento
instructions: Cut loaves lengthwise, then crosswise into 1/2 inch slices. Stuff bread with pimientos. Wrap each strip of bread with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 1 hour to marinate. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Bake in a preheated oven on a baking sheet until puffed up and lightly toasted, about 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: vegetable broth,bitter melon,pear,yellow bell pepper,white wine vinegar,icing sugar,farfalle pasta,galangal
title: Chili, Pear and Freckle Soup
ingredients: 1 cup farfalle pasta | 2 small bitter melon, halved lengthways and seeds removed | 1 1/2 cups cubed peeled pears | 1 yellow bell pepper, cubed | 4 tablespoons vegetable oil or 4 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 8 cups hot vegetable broth | 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar | 1/2 cup icing sugar
instructions: In a large pan of boiling water, cook the pasta, return to the pan and cook until al dente. Drain well and keep hot. Meanwhile, cut the malfish from their spears. Cut the melon in half crossways and crosswise. Cut the pears into chunks about 1 3/4 inch square. Cut the pears in half crossways and crosswise using a small biscuit cutter. Heat oil in another pan. Cook the malfish, pears, pepper, and celery in oil over high heat, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 5 minutes. Add the broth and vinegar, bring to a boil and simmer, uncovered, until the pears are just tender, about 5 minutes. Cool. Transfer the soup to a blender and puree until smooth. Return to the pan, stir in the sherry and bring to a boil. Remove from the heat and stir in the icing sugar, season to taste, and serve.

title: Frisilli Di Pollo
ingredients: 1 medium roasting chicken | 1/2 teaspoon black mustard seeds
instructions: Place whole unpeeled chicken in a well oiled pan. Sprinkle oil all over the skin. Sprinkle with mustard seeds. Turning over often with a fork, cover with foil. Keep in a 250°f oven. Boil 4 - 5 quarts of water. When the water comes to bubbling, remove chicken and place it on a heated dish. Simmer over boiling water until the juices run clear. This may take anywhere from 45 minutes to 1 hour. Remove chicken from the pan. Drain liquid. Cool completely for 15 minutes, then pull skin off. Shred meat, store for use later. Use in other recipes or eat cold.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray,pinto bean,apple juice,cooking onion,lemon juice
title: Easy Elegant Mexican Refried Beans
ingredients: 1 lb pinto beans or 1 lb red kidney beans | 1 medium cooking onion, chopped fine | 1 1/2 cups apple juice or 1 1/2 cups apple juice | 2 1/2 teaspoons lemon juice | vegetable oil cooking spray
instructions: Place beans and onion in a large pot and cover with water. Bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat to a simmer. Cover and simmer approximately 3 to 4 minutes until tender. Drain, reserving 1 cup of cooking liquid. Cool, then transfer beans to a blender or food processor. Add the apple juice, lemon juice, and cooking liquid. Blend until smooth. If too thick, thin with reserved cooking liquid. Spray a nonstick skillet with cooking spray. Add beans, onion and apple. Cook over medium heat, stirring often, until heated through. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: vegetable broth,cream wheat,green curry paste,vanilla vodka,cocoa
title: Spicy Chocolate Cream Soup
ingredients: 4 ounces vanilla vodka | 3 -5 drops green curry paste | 3 tablespoons cream of wheat | 4 -5 soup cans vegetable broth or 4 -5 cans vegetable broth | 1 tablespoon cocoa
instructions: Add all the ingredients to a crockpot on high. Cook on high for two hours. Serve with good toast, crackers, or your favourite condiments.

title: Angel Food Cake With Snow Peas
ingredients: 1 package angel food cake ( any type will do ) | 1 package snow peas ( you can buy frozen )
instructions: Heat oven to 350 degrees. Unroll the angel food cake and cut out a circle from the center. Place in baking dish. Dot with butter. Sprinkle with angel food powder. The more it is in the dish, the prettier this will get. Bake 1 hour or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean. Serve warm with your favorite fruit.

title: Chocolate Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb beef tenderloin steak | 2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder ( i use hershey's cocoa )
instructions: Put cocoa powder in zip loc plastic baggie and add the meat. Shake until well coated. Refrigerate for 10 minutes. Heat oven to 350°f. Remove meat from bag. Cut meat in 10 pieces or 1 inch slices, depending on how thin you slice or how much meat you have.

title: Homemade Salsa Fresca
ingredients: 2 jars jar picante sauce, your choice | coriander powder
instructions: Place jar of picante sauce in a small bowl that has a lid. Dump the cinamon powder over the jar of picante sauce in the bowl with the picante sauce to get a little moisture out of the picante sauce which will be leftover with the salsa and other ingredients. Serve with your favorite tortilla chips.

title: Orange Biscuits
ingredients: 2 cups bread flour | 1 tablespoon dried marjoram ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon grated orange zest
instructions: Sift the flour with 1 tablespoon dried marjoram, orange zest, and bread into a large bowl. Gradually add enough water to make a fairly stiff dough. Knead until the dough is smooth and soft, about 5 or 6 minutes. Place the dough on a floured surface, shape into a ball, and roll it out to a thickness of about 1/8 inch. Cut the biscuit into quarters and lightly flour them. Place the biscuit on a floured baking sheet and bake in a 400 degree f oven for 6 to 7 minutes.

Random Ingredients: romaine lettuce,brussels sprout,creole seasoning,ziti pasta,kaffir lime leaf
title: Ziti Primavera
ingredients: 8 ounces ziti pasta, broken up | 1 teaspoon creole seasoning | 1 green giant frozen brussels sprout | 7 kaffir lime leaves, torn | 1 romaine lettuce - rinsed, dried and torn
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente. Drain pasta well. Add creole seasoning, green giant frozen sprouts, and kaffir lime leaves. Transfer to a shallow baking dish. Bake in the preheated oven for 8 to 10 minutes for pasta and 30 to 40 minutes for ziti and 20 minutes for other ingredients.

Random Ingredients: tomato puree,coriander powder,brandy,curry leaf,heavy whipping cream
title: Indian Tomato Cream
ingredients: 250 ml heavy whipping cream | 50 g brandy | 2 1/2 teaspoons ginger & garlic paste or 2 1/2 teaspoons fresh ginger, ground | 2 teaspoons coriander powder | 1/2 teaspoon curry leaves
instructions: In a glass bowl, pour whipping cream and add brandy or other liquor. Mix till thick. Add ginger/garlic paste and corriander powder. Mix well till combined. Chill 1 hour. Serve chilled with indian flatbreads.

title: Polish Pineapple Soup
ingredients: 1 can crushed pineapple in juice | 3 cups chicken stock or 3 cups broth | 1/2 teaspoon dried marjoram
instructions: Pour pineapple juice into a food processor. Add broth, marjoram and marjoram. Process until smooth.

Random Ingredients: liquid honey,garam masala,red pepper,cremini mushroom,vegetable stock,sesame seed,coconut,roasting chicken
title: Roasted Red Pepper Chicken
ingredients: 1 roasting chickens | 2 tablespoons vegetable stock | 2 tablespoons liquid honey | 2 teaspoons roasted sesame seeds | 1 teaspoon garam masala | 1/4 teaspoon dry crushed red pepper | 1/2 cup shredded coconut | 2 tablespoons flaked coconut | 1 tablespoon toasted sesame seeds
instructions: Place chicken in a large, shallow dish. Sprinkle with 1 teaspoon of vegetable oil, and mix with a fork to coat chicken. Roast, covered, in a preheated 425° oven for 30 minutes. Turn chicken, and roast until well browned and juices run clear, another 20 to 25 minutes. Transfer chicken to a medium bowl, and stir in remaining 1 teaspoon of oil, honey, 2 teaspoons of sesame seeds, garam masala, and 2/3 cup of shredded coconut. Cover, and refrigerate about 30 minutes. Remove chicken from oven, and discard marinade. Stir in 1 tablespoon of coconut. Transfer chicken to a roasting pan. Sprinkle with remaining 1 tablespoon of coconut, 1 tablespoon of sesame seeds, and remaining 1 tablespoon of coconut. Stick 1 toothpick through center of each piece of chicken. Bake in oven until coconut topping is bubbly, about 35 minutes.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack cheese,self rising flour,chili pepper flake,harissa,pork shoulder,salt black pepper,wheat bread,pineapple juice
title: Pork and Hawaiian Green Tea Bread Crumbs
ingredients: 1 cup self-rising flour | 2 1/2 cups canned crab or quinoa burrito-sized green tea beans ( one 15 ounce or 7oz ) | 3 tablespoons grated monterey jack cheese or 3 tablespoons mild monterey jack cheese | 1 tablespoon harissa | 1/4 teaspoon chili pepper flakes ( to your heart ) | salt & freshly ground black pepper ( to your heart ) | 1 lb pork shoulder, cut into 1 3/4 inch cubes ( i prefer boston butt ) | 3/4 cup pineapple juice
instructions: For the first 3 ingredients, mix thoroughly and let sit 5 minutes. Add the second 1/2 cup of flour. Mix everything together. Add more flour if it's sticky. Let knead lightly for a few minutes by hand at least 1/2 hour. Form into a round loaf and place in a shallow baking dish, preferably glass or porcelain. Bake at 350&deg.

title: Pumpkin Seed Candy
ingredients: 12 ounces chocolate cookie crumbs | 1/2 cup pumpkin seeds
instructions: Preheat oven to mix cookie crumbs and pumpkin seeds together. Press into a small loaf tin. Bake for 25 minutes, or until golden. Cool.

Random Ingredients: worcestershire sauce,cardamom pod,monterey jack cheese,chicken breast half,savory
title: Chicken Queso on a Stick
ingredients: 2 boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom pod | 1/4 teaspoon dried savory ( or other herb of choice ) | 2 1/2 - 3 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 1/2 cup shredded monterey jack cheese or 1/2 cup cheddar cheese, blend ( optional )
instructions: Place the chicken breast halves between plastic wrap and pound with a mallet until 1/4 thick. Sprinkle the cardamom and savory onto the chicken, and then sprinkle with worcestershire or cheddar cheese. Roll up the chicken.

Random Ingredients: iceberg lettuce,baby green,triple sec,summer savory,pesto sauce,jasmine rice,date,orange peel
title: Wild Rice Salad With Sticky Citrus Pesto
ingredients: 2 cups jasmine rice | 1 cup triple sec or 1 cup other orange-flavored liqueur | 1 cup fresh basil or 1 cup of fresh mint, coarsely-chopped | 1/2 cup seedless spring savory | 5 tablespoons prepared pesto sauce, of choice ( or fresh dill ) | 6 ounces whole wheat berry lettuce, washed and dried | 1 cup of sliced sweet baby greens | 1/2 cup diced orange peel
instructions: Boil rice and triple sec for 5 minutes. Let stand for 10 minutes. Immediately stir in basil, savory, pesto and 2 tbsp of the pesto. Serve rice and garnish with brussels sprouts, lettuce, orange peel and remaining pesto.

title: French Lamb Stew
ingredients: 1 lb lamb, cut into pieces | 1 bag cannellini beans
instructions: Put all ingredients in crockpot, cook for 7 - 8 hours.

title: Spicy Beef, Cauliflower, and Shrimp Cocktail
ingredients: 2 teaspoons gold syrup | 1 lb flank steak, trimmed | 1 large head cauliflower, florets separated and cut into large florets | 12 medium shrimp | 3 tablespoons dry tequila | 1/4 cup fresh parsley, chopped | 24 toothpicks
instructions: In a shallow baking dish, combine the golden syrup with the steak and marinate in the refrigerator, covered, overnight. In the morning, preheat the broiler. Broil the meat for 3 minutes on each side for medium rare, or longer if you prefer. Cut the beef into 1/8 slices and set aside. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add the cauliflower and steam, uncovered, until the cauliflower is crisp tender, about 5 minutes. Drain and plunge into warm water. Drain the vegetables completely. Slice the meat and arrange on a platter. Drain off and discard the water that has formed over the meat. Cut the meat into thin slices and toss with the shrimp to coat. Place the sauteed vegetables on the serving platter and serve with the steak cocktail. Serve immediately.

title: Wedgehog
ingredients: 1 savoy cabbage or 1 other cabbage | 10 slices kielbasa, very thin
instructions: Wash your savoy or any other cabbage well. Core it and cut it into wedges. Boil the wedges about 7 minutes, then plunge them into cold water to stop the cooking. You can cut it into wedges to cook later, if desired.

Random Ingredients: beef chuck,fish,file powder,self rising flour,cornbread,chili powder,chili pepper flake
title: Fish Stew
ingredients: 600 g of sliced fillet | 1/2 tablespoon self-rising flour | 300 g self rising flour | 100 g fish, diced ( optional ) | 2 ounces dried chili chili peppers ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon fish, seasoning | 1/4 teaspoon chili powder | 1/2 teaspoon cornbread, crumbs, crumb
instructions: Coat the bottom of a large frying pan with oil. Place the slices of fish in the frying pan and fry for about 3 - 4 minutes, or until cooked through and golden brown. Remove to a medium baking dish and cover with a cloth to steam for approx 5 - 7 minutes. Repeat steps 5 - 8 until all fish is cooked and removed from the pan. Place the self rising flour in a sifter, place over a saucepan of luke warm water, and stir until the flour is dissolved. Remove from the heat, then stir in the fish, season, and chilli. Divide the mixture among serving bowls. Top with crumbs.

Random Ingredients: curry powder,water chestnut,dark soy sauce,pork roast,plain flour,asafoetida powder
title: Pork Roast
ingredients: 2 teaspoons plain flour | 1 teaspoon curry powder, medium strength | 1/4 teaspoon asafoetida powder ( optional ) | 1 1/4 lbs boneless pork roast | 2 cans sliced water chestnuts | 3 -4 tablespoons dark soy sauce
instructions: Mix flour with curry powder and asafetida. Dredge the roast in the mixture. Place in a fry pan and cover with boiling water. Set the pot to low and cook for 30 minutes, turning occasionally. Drain the pork roast in a colander overnight, or place in large plastic bags and press out excess blood. Add the rest of the ingredients and simmer for 20 minutes. Serve warm.

title: P.r.'s. F. (Vegetable Feta) Salad
ingredients: 1 cup orzo pasta | 1 -2 tablespoon peas | 3 -4 peppercorns ( optional ) | 1/4 red pepper, chopped very fine | 1 -2 tablespoon commercial peppercorn ranch dressing
instructions: Mix well. Refrigerate for an hour prior to serving to allow flavors to blend.

title: Yakisoba (Japanese Breaded Yakisoba)
ingredients: 1 lb bagel | 1 cup panko breadcrumbs
instructions: Cut bagels into 1 pieces and place in steamer over boiling water. Cover and steam until light firm. Remove and cool. Run cold water over bagel to get rid of any excess moisture. Coat bread with panko then dip into bread crumbs pressing bread crumbs into melted butter. Refrigerate at least 2 hours or overnight before eating.

Random Ingredients: topping,bread flour,tomato puree,maraschino cherry,thai red curry paste,pie crust,rice noodle,oregano leaf
title: Chef John's Spicy Thai Red Curry Pastry
ingredients: 1 package rice noodles | 2 tablespoons thai red curry paste | 15 ounces frozen whipped topping, thawed | 3 tablespoons tomato puree | 3 tablespoons dried oregano leaves, crushed | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh thyme leaves to taste | 2 tablespoons coarse bread flour | 1 unbaked pie crust
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add rice noodles and boil for 3 minutes. Drain and set aside. In a medium bowl, mash frozen soups with thai red curry paste using a fork or potato masher until creamy. Stir in the cream, tomato puree oregano, thyme and crushed dried red pepper flakes. Spread mixture into the pastry shell. Pour soups into crust. If there are any large crumbs on top of the dish, remove them. Sprinkle crumbs on top of phyllo pastry just before baking. Bake in the preheated oven until golden brown, 35 to 40 minutes. Cut into squares.

Random Ingredients: cherry pie filling,kale,beet,bay leaf,garlic powder,lettuce leaf,white bean
title: White Bean and Beet Salad
ingredients: 1 can white beans | 1 can beet, drained | 1 small bay leaf | 4 -6 lettuce leaves | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder | 1 can cherry pie filling | pickled kale or beet leaves
instructions: Combine beans and water to cover and simmer until tender. Drain well. Boil beet greens about 5 minutes and remove from heat. Let cool, then peel and chop. Place beet greens, beet filling, sliced beets, and bay leaf in a salad bowl and toss lightly. Pour dressing over beans and garnish with kale or beet leaves.

title: Lemony Hamburger Grinder (Bier Suppe)
ingredients: 4 lbs hamburger | 2 -3 large red cabbage | 1 lemon, juice and zest of, grated
instructions: Slice the hamburger in long ribbons. Cut each wedge on the diagonal and the wedge on the diagonal. Arrange the grinder in a container with a tight lid. Place the wedge of grated lemon rind in a circle on top of the meat. Press it firmly against the grinder with the blade of a heavy knife so as to leave a thin layer of rind. Sprinkle the rind lightly with coarse salt or sea salt. Turn the grinder on low and, with the tip of the sharpest knife, work the zest into the rind. Grind thoroughly in small batches until finely ground and no traces of pink remain on the meat. Transfer the minced hamburger to a dish and cover with hot water. Let stand 5 minutes. Transfer to a colander and squeeze the rind from the grinder with your hands, squeezing out as much moisture as possible. Rinse the grinder with cold water and then squeeze again until the rind is fine and all the water is absorbed. Discard rinds. Rinse the pot again with cold water and heat it over high heat or in a microwave until a teaspoon of water evaporates within 3 minutes of heating. Working from the center out, carefully and quickly drain the meat and pat it dry with paper towels. Press a fine, fine layer of grinder and a thin layer of grinder into a medium oven pan with a tight lid. Place in the oven and when the grinder becomes fragrant it stops shaking. Continue to cook 1 hour, stirring every 15 minutes as the grinder heats.

title: Chili Potatoes
ingredients: 4 large potatoes, peeled and diced | 2 packages chili seasoning mix | 3 tablespoons sherry wine | 2 tablespoons dried tarragon
instructions: Spread potatoes on paper towels and sprinkle with chili seasoning mix and sherry then sprinkle with tarragon.

Random Ingredients: roast beef,malt vinegar,corn oil,pistachio,hot pepper,mustard powder,peach,black olive
title: The English Antipasto Burger
ingredients: 1 australian small hot pepper | 2 teaspoons mustard powder | 2 slices roast beef, roughly chopped | 1 slice peach, roughly chopped | 1 teaspoon corn oil | 1 tablespoon mustard powder | 1/2 teaspoon malt vinegar | 1/4 cup pistachios, coarsely chopped
instructions: Grind or crush the pepper very coarsely. Put the pepper and mustard powder in a small bowl. Add the roast beef, peach, oil and mustard powder. Mix well. Spread the ground pepper on a piece of clingfilm and use a sharp knife to make four small burgers. Place a good dollop of mustard mixed with a little malt vinegar into each of the burgers and press down with the spoon to coat all of them nicely. Heat a good knob of oil in a frying pan. Cook half the burger for about 3 - 4 minutes on each side, depending on the thickness of the slice of beef. Remove from the pan and serve warm with the remaining prepared mustard dressing. For extra flavour, make the sandwich with a little mustard, pistachios and some good crumbs mixed together with a little water. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: chili paste,rotini pasta,ice water,black pepper,gruyere cheese,penne,veal
title: Veal and Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb sliced veal, sliced 1/4 inch thick ( i use extra lean cuts ) | 1 lb dry penne ( about 12oz uncooked per package directions ( or use 1 box ) | salt and freshly cracked black pepper ( to taste ) | 1 tablespoon chili paste | 7 cups ice water | 2 cups shredded gruyere cheese or 2 cups swiss cheese
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions, adding salt and pepper to taste, for 10 minutes. Meanwhile, cook the veal in a heavy skillet over medium high heat, stirring, until lightly browned. Drain off any excess fat. Add chili paste and pasta to meat in skillet, bring to a boil over high heat and cook 5 minutes. Place in bowls, top with cheese, then add additional chili paste if desired and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: chicken wing,greek seasoning,allspice berry,apricot preserve,parsley flake
title: Chicken Wings with Apricot Glaze
ingredients: 5 lbs chicken wings, cut into single wings | 1 jar apricot preserves | 3 tablespoons allspice berries, crushed | 1 teaspoon dried parsley flakes | 1 1/2 teaspoons italian seasoning
instructions: In a large pot, bring chicken, preserves and spices to a boil. Boil gently for 10 minutes until thickened, about 10 minute. Cool and use to glaze chicken. Place in ziplock bag and chill.

title: Irish Creme Fraiche
ingredients: 1/2 cup cointreau liqueur | 1 dash hot sauce
instructions: Pour cointreau into a glass. Add hot sauce.

title: Black Bean Salad With Cashews (Choko Hariyoko)
ingredients: 1/2 cup cashews | 1/2 cup chopped cashews | 1/2 cup frozen lima beans ( choko hariyoko ) | 1/2 teaspoon white pepper | 1/2 cup blanched almond ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon black-eyed peas ( optional )
instructions: Toast almonds in oil and cool. Toast cashews in the food processor until very fine. Combine nuts, beans, white pepper and almonds. Chill.

title: Fish Taco With Nutty Barley Salad
ingredients: 1 lb tilapia fillet ( any medium-sized piece ) | 1 head of cabbage ( or other leaf lettuce-i use baby greens as the whole lot will not taste the same ) | 1 head iceberg lettuce ( i use whole leaves instead ) | 1 head romaine lettuce | 1/2 cup rice barley, boiled ( or rice mixed grains ) | 1/4 cup hazelnuts, halved
instructions: Put everything into a big dish, except fish and romaine. Cut fish into pieces. Put it in the salad bowl, toss. Serve immediately with pita, salad, sour cream and lots of napkins.

title: Lemon Soup With Beef Broth and Consommé
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups dried lemon ( the type with seeds or you decide ) | 1 can condensed beef consomme soup
instructions: Put the dried lemons in the broth. You can strain them, or add any other liquid you would like to use in a soup. You can also add fresh lemon slices in this recipe. If you would like to heat the soup in the microwave or on low, you can do so in a small covered casserole dish that is dusted with flour or use a lid. When dinner is ready, pour into the casserole a 1/4 cup at a time until it bubbles. You can cook this soup on a stove top, or in the crock pot.

title: Asafetida Powder
ingredients: 1/4 teaspoon saffron vanilla bean, split lengthwise | 1/8 teaspoon asafoetida powder
instructions: Dissolve saffron in warm water. Pour into a glass jar with a tight fitting lid. Insert a fine mesh fine nylon blade through the stem of the jar. Sprinkle the contents of the strainer into the jar, making sure the asafetida is dissolved inside. Cap the jar tightly. Leave it in a cool, dry spot.

title: Beef Curry III
ingredients: 1/4 cup lemon juice | 1 1/2 teaspoons curry powder | 3/4 cup ice water | 1 tablespoon beef sirloin | 1/4 cup carbonated lemon juice
instructions: Combine 2 tablespoons lemon juice, curry powder, ice water, and beef sirloin in a microwave safe bowl. Microwave in 3 to 4 minutes, or until beef are no longer pink and juices appear clear. Stir well.

title: Pistachio Chicken Wings (Pollo All' Arancia)
ingredients: 6 skinless, boneless chicken breasts | 2 cans chicken wings, drained | 1 jar chopped pimento pepper | 1 cup shelled pistachio
instructions: Combine chicken, pimento peppers, and pistachios in a slow cooker. Cook on high 3 to 4 hours, until chicken is cooked through and slightly browned.

Random Ingredients: part mozzarella cheese,cayenne pepper,chili powder,yellow squash,rosemary,baking soda
title: Veggie Pizzas
ingredients: 2 cans yellow squash, drained and cut into 1/2-inch pieces | 2 teaspoons baking soda | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried rosemary | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried chili powder | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 2 cups part-skim mozzarella cheese, shredded
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. In a mixing bowl, combine the squash, baking soda, rosemary, chili powder and cayenne pepper. Add the cheese and toss until completely coated with the spices. Arrange on the baking sheet. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes, until the puffed up and the edges are lightly browned. If your pizza is browning too quickly, let it sit until the oven is heated again. Serve warm.

title: Shoyu Dressing for Veggies and Spring Rolls
ingredients: 3 tablespoons shoyu ( sweet soy sauce ) | 1 tablespoon light sesame oil | 1 tablespoon leeks or 1 tablespoon onion, finely chopped | 1 cup fresh tomato, finely chopped | 1/4 cup bamboo shoot, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon fresh rosemary leaf
instructions: Combine shoyu with the ginger, garlic, and sesame oil. Place finely chopped vegetables, chopped tomatoes, and diced bamboo on the shoyu and pour in the remaining ingredients. Blend everything together, taste, and adjust seasoning. Let set for at least 30 minutes.

title: Cumin Spareribs
ingredients: 2 cups self-raising flour | 1 tablespoon ground cumin | 1/2 cup crushed dried red chili ( i used bottled red chili flakes ) | 1/2 cup amaretto | 1 red onion, chopped | 12 ounces spareribs, broken up | hot cooked pasta
instructions: Sift flour into mixing bowl with cumin, chili flakes and onions. Mix in spareribs. Fold in reserved ingredients. Spoon mixture into greased casserole dish. Cover and bake at 325°f or 180°c oven for 1 hour or until tender. Serve over rice and top with parmesan cheese.

title: Brigadella (Cheese Cake)
ingredients: 1/3 cup soy sauce | 1/3 cup ground smoked pork, ground veal or 1/3 cup ham, ground sirloin | 1/2 lb kefalograviera cheese ( cheese that comes in tubes, about 3/4 inch wide, 3 1/2-inch diameter ) | 1/2 cup kefalograviera cheese, grated | 1/3 cup half-and-half cream
instructions: In a medium bowl, stir together soy sauce, ground meats. Add cheese and sour cream and mix until well blended. Pour half and half into a small skillet. Heat over medium heat until steaming. Pour warm sauce into heated skillet and let cook over medium heat until thickened, whisking constantly. Serve immediately, or refrigerate overnight.

title: Italian Style Sweet Coated Pork
ingredients: 3 lbs boneless pork shoulder | any fresh herb ( rosemary, oregano, parsley, and thyme )
instructions: Make your own savory pork roast. You don't have to ask your butcher to grind it first if you ask them to. Wrap your roast in aluminium foil and place in fridge. If your butcher does it, this is important. Cut away any damaged or bruised ribs from the roast. The meat will take several days to reach reach reach room temperature when done. Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Place roast in 9x13x2 inch baking dish, seam side down. Pour enough water into the pan to come up about 1/2 inch above the meat. This will create a large shallow roasting pan, about 1 1/2 inches deep. Spread the meat evenly with your favorite herbs on the meat. You should have about 1 gallon of flavorful roast. Place dish in a larger roaster, making sure the water penetrates evenly onto the roast. Bake at 350 degrees for 2 1/2 hours or until internal temperature reaches 170 degrees. Remove from oven and let sit for at least 15 minutes. Cut away any leftover fat and place meat on a cutting board to cool slightly. If your butcher does not get a thermometer it will be too hard to cut with a knife. Cut into slices across the grain and serve with lots of freshly chopped vegetables. You can also wrap each slice in cellophane and microwave on high 1 to 2 minutes until heated through. Let sit 10 to 15 minutes before eating or reheating any leftovers until ready to use. It is also great reheated the next day if you have leftovers. Also if making gravy from the meat it is excellent reheated the next day.

title: Homemade Italian Vinaigrette
ingredients: 1/4 cup vinegar or 1/4 cup white wine vinegar | 1 1 tablespoon italian seasoning ( or more )
instructions: Combine all ingredients and let flavors blend. Let stand overnight in a covered container. Drain salad when using as directed.

title: Spicy Oriental Sausages
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs lamb shoulder | 1/2 lb ground italian sausage | 1 tablespoon cayenne powder | 2 tablespoons rice noodles, dry | 1/2 lb frozen mixed vegetables
instructions: Trim any excess fat from meat. Cut it into 1/2 inch cubes. Place a meat mallet or other heavy sausages in a plastic bag until fully covered. Sprinkle 1 tablespoon cayenne on the meat, and set aside. Remove the air from the bag and shake bag to remove as much air as possible. Flatten the meat with the palm of your hand and spread a portion of the seasoned meat in the middle of the sausage. Roll the meat, starting with the long side, toward the outside edge. You will now be able to shape the meat into a cylinder. Tie with kitchen string or a piece of string that can't be peeled apart. Repeat with remaining meat and meat cylinders, to make more sandwiches of your choice. Place the vegetables in a colander and rinse thoroughly under cold water until well drained. Place them in large, deep pot. Set aside. Place the rest of the seasoned meat on the top of the seasoned meat, making sure that the sausages are well coated on all sides. Add water to cover the sausages. Bring to a boil, then turn heat down to a simmer. Cook for 3 hours. While the sausages are simmering, clean out the pot, return the pot to the stove, and add about 8 cups cold water, one can or enough to cover the bottom of the pan. Add the rice noodles, and cook for 20 minutes, and stir well. When they have absorbed the water, place the sausages on top of the rice noodles and cook uncovered for an additional 20 minutes. Turn off the cover, and let sit for five or ten minutes while the rice noodles soak up sauce. Serve, and enjoy.

title: Quinoa and Chives (Gluten Free)
ingredients: 1/2 cup quinoa, uncooked | 4 tablespoons whole wheat pastry flour | 1/2 cup fresh lemon juice | 1/4 cup nigella seeds or 1/4 cup arugula | 2 tablespoons minced chives
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 f and line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Spread the quinoa in a single layer onto the prepared baking sheet. In a bowl, stir together the flour and remaining ingredients and then using a spatula or your hands, blend until the dry ingredients look like small pasta. Spread the mixture over the quinoa and bake for 7 - 9 minutes. Remove from the oven and sprinkle with the chives.

Random Ingredients: grape leaf,mirin,heavy whipping cream,mustard powder,cake flour,cardamom,tomato puree
title: Grape Leaf Rollatini
ingredients: 16 large fresh grape leaves | 1/8 teaspoon cardamom | 2/3 cup heavy whipping cream | 1/3 cup sake or 1/3 cup dry white wine | 2 tablespoons pureed tomato puree | 1/4 teaspoon mustard powder | 1 1/2 tablespoons cake flour
instructions: Make sure the leaves are dry enough to bend easily with your fingers. Place the small raised ends toward the center of your rolling pin and place a small plate on top of each. Wrap the leaves at a slight angle to keep them round. Place the rolled leaves between two sheets of wax paper on a clean, large tray. Pound lightly using a rolling pin. Spread a teaspoon of cream onto each grape leaf, about 1/4 inch deep. Place it on the sheets. Let stand 10 minutes. Meanwhile, bring the wine to a simmer in a medium saucepan. Add the tomato puree, mustard powder and the tomato paste. Cook until the mixture thickens, about 7 minutes, stirring frequently. Remove from the heat and reserve. Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Spread the sauce in a 10 inch circle on the rolls. Bake, uncovered, until the leaves are crispy and slightly softened, about 25 minutes. Drizzle with the reserved tomato cream and serve warm.

Random Ingredients: white hominy,apple cider vinegar,romaine lettuce,green curry paste,beef bouillon granule,enchilada sauce,gold tequila
title: Thai Green Curry Salad
ingredients: 2 cans white hominy, drained and rinsed | 1 1/2 cups apple cider vinegar | 2 teaspoons garlic and herb seasoning blend | 1 can enchilada sauce | 1 tablespoon green curry paste | 1 tablespoon beef bouillon granules | 1 romaine lettuce - rinsed, dried, and torn into bite-size pieces
instructions: Place the hominy in a bowl. Combine apple cider vinegar, garlic herb, enchilada sauce, curry paste and bouillon and stir well. Pour over the hominy and toss well. Cover and let sit at room temperature 8 hours or overnight. Before serving in bowls and garnish with romaine.

Random Ingredients: drambuie,head cabbage,lobster stock,pecorino romano cheese,lemon pepper,cream,okra,malt vinegar
title: Lobster Consommé
ingredients: 1 head cabbage | 1 1/2 cups lobster stock | 1/2 cup malt vinegar | 1/2 cup chopped pecorino romano cheese | 1 teaspoon lemon pepper | 1 package frozen okra | 1 bunch fresh lobsters, rinsed and deveined | 1/2 cup whipped cream
instructions: Quarter the cabbage lengthwise. Fill a large pot with water and bring to a boil over high heat. Meanwhile, place the lobster and okra into a skillet and steam for 3 to 5 minutes, or until tender but still firm. Drain, and set aside. To the boiling water, add the cabbage and bring back to a boil. Cook until the cabbage is just wilted. Drain well and return the cabbage to the pot. Stir in the lobster stock, vinegar, and lemon pepper. If you are planning to refrigerate the consommé, remove from the refrigerator and allow to sit undisturbed for 30 to 45 minutes. In a large serving bowl, combine the pecorino cheese, cheese mixture, and lobster meat. Top with whipped cream.

title: Lebanese Triffidores
ingredients: 1 lb ladyfinger, sliced | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh dill pickles | 1 1 tablespoon fresh coriander seed, ground | 1 teaspoon honey | 1 teaspoon capers, drained | 2 teaspoons prepared pesto sauce | honey, to drizzle
instructions: Dip the ladyfingers into a little honey, then into the coriander. Arrange the ladyfingers in a shallow roasting tin, then sprinkle over the pickles. Drizzle over the pesto or add oil. Sprinkle with honey to taste. Cook under a hot grill, turning once, until golden brown, about 6 - 8 minutes.

Random Ingredients: blue cheese,lavender blossom,chicken,pasta sauce,sage leaf,fennel seed
title: Blue Cheese, Sage and Fennel Roasted Chicken
ingredients: 1/3 cup dried lavender blossoms | 1/3 cup freshly chopped sage leaf | 1 1/2 lbs chicken pieces | 1/2 cup chicken fat | 1/4 cup fresh blue cheese, crumbled | 14 ounces chicken fat | 1/4 cup pasta sauce | 2 tablespoons dried fennel seeds
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Toss the lavender blossoms with the sage. Spread in one layer on a clean towel and let stand 10 minutes. Remove the herb mixture and pat dry. Spread chicken pieces in a roasting pan and sprinkle with both cheeses. Roast 15 to 25 minutes until the cheese is crusty and brown. Turn the pieces over and roast 15 minutes more. Remove from heat and let stand 10 minutes. Remove and discard the herb mixture. Cut the chicken into bite size pieces and return to the roasting pan. Cover and bake 40 to 45 minutes longer, until the chicken is cooked and the juices run clear. Remove the chicken from the pan and keep warm. Strain the pan juices and keep the juices cooking back. Whisk in the butter and strained juices from the roasting pan. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Serve the roasted chicken with the sauce and fennel seeds.

title: French Quarter King Ranch Shrimp
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1 envelope unflavored gelatin | 1 pound baby shrimp, peeled and deveined, tail left on | 1 can refried beans
instructions: Pour condensed soup into a bowl, and sprinkle gelatin over soup. Drain shrimp, and arrange on top of gelatin. Cover, and refrigerate for 2 hours. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line a baking dish with plastic wrap. Place shrimp on plastic wrap, and cook in microwave for 3 minutes on high, or until shrimp are pink. Set aside. Spread shrimp mixture in the prepared baking dish, and top with refried beans. Return to the oven, and bake for 35 minutes in the preheated oven, until hot and bubbly.

title: Alfredo Fresca
ingredients: 400 g smooth cheese, preferably parmigiano-reggiano | 8 -10 red chilies, finely chopped ( leave seeds in if using less heat ) | 4 -5 mint leaves, finely chopped
instructions: Grate the cheese, using a fine grater / food processor, into a large bowl. Stir in the red chillies, grated cheese, and mint leaves, until the mixture just holds together.

Random Ingredients: tomato sauce,bay leaf,green bell pepper,dark chocolate,ricotta cheese,grapefruit juice,green tomato,mini chocolate chip
title: Dawn's Grapefruit-Chocolate Chip Lasagna
ingredients: 12 green tomatoes, cut into fourths | 1 green bell pepper, cut into thin strips | 1 can tomato sauce | 1/4 cup canned grapefruit juice | 1/4 cup ricotta cheese | 1/4 package sweet mini chocolate chips | 1/4 cup dark chocolate, grated | 1 bay leaf
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Arrange tomato strips and green bell pepper strips into a 9x13 inch baking dish. Mix tomato sauce, grapefruit juice, ricotta, sweet mini chocolate chips, and grated chocolate in a bowl with a spoon until well blended. Pour the mixture over top of tomatoes.

Random Ingredients: ricotta cheese,shrimp,onion soup mix,white sugar,tomato,green olive,salad green
title: Shrimp Salad II
ingredients: 1 pound uncooked medium shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1 container ricotta cheese | 1 package dry onion soup mix | 1 can stewed tomatoes, drained | 1/4 cup chopped green olives | 1 package mixed salad greens | 1 pinch white sugar
instructions: Place shrimp in a medium saucepan with enough lightly salted water to cover. Bring to a boil, reduce heat to medium low, and simmer for 8 to 10 minutes or until opaque. Drain. Cool, and remove tails, and flake shrimp. In a small bowl combine ricotta cheese and onion soup mix. Stir in tomatoes with juice from shrimp, olives, and salad greens. Stir in sugar and add shrimp. Cover and chill.

title: Microwaved English Pea and Aged Cheese Flatbreads
ingredients: 2 tablespoons wheat flour | 2 tablespoons wheat flour | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1/2 cup asiago cheese | 1 cup english pea ( frozen or fresh ) | 1/2 cup pure maple syrup
instructions: In a small nonstick bowl mix the flours and tumeric powder. In a large microwave safe bowl, mix the english peas, maple syrup and cheese, stirring well until cheese melts and mixture is smooth. Spread out evenly into a 12 x 1/2 x 2 1/2 inch baking pan and bake in a microwave, on high power, covered, for 3 or 4 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Roasted Red Pepper and Pepper Salad
ingredients: 1 red bell pepper, seeded, deribbed and sliced into strips | 1 teaspoon celery seed | ground black pepper, to taste
instructions: Preheat the broiler. Place the pepper on a baking sheet. Broil for 3 minutes on each side, until the skin is black and the pepper is crisp. Move the pepper from top to bottom and slice into strips.

instructions: Thaw water chestnuts and dice. Stir water chestnuts, lime peel and sweetened condensed milk into the china. Chill until cold. Stir and chill until ready to use.

title: Anchovy Puff With Banana-Mascarpone Filling and Beans Sprouts
ingredients: 1 ounce anchovy fillet, coarsely chopped | 1/4 cup mascarpone cheese | 2 tablespoons cannollini beans sprouts ( in light syrup ), drained and rinsed ( about 1 pkg ) | 1/4 teaspoon red cayenne pepper | 1 small fresh banana, sliced | 1/4 cup bean sprouts
instructions: Heat grill pan over medium heat. Combine anchovy, mascarpone, beansprouts, and cayenne pepper in small bowl. Toss until well mixed. Spread mixture on lightly greased grill pan. Grill until puffed and edges are slightly golden brown, 3 to 4 minutes per side. To serve, slice guava lengthwise into thin slices. Sprinkle each plate with bean sprouts.

Random Ingredients: green chilies,jalapeno pepper,mango,rice wine,basil,grainy mustard,part mozzarella cheese
title: Mango-Cheese Sauce
ingredients: 1 medium mango, peeled and cut into 1 inch cubes | 1/4 cup green chilies ( i prefer green thai ) | 1/4 teaspoon dried basil ( i used fresh basil ) | 2 tablespoons grainy mustard | 1 -2 teaspoon jalapeno pepper, finely chopped ( i use a combo of jalapenos, serrano peppers, jalapenos, habanero peppers, and fresh jalapenos ) | 4 ounces part-skim mozzarella cheese, shredded ( or monterey jack ) | 1/4 cup rice wine
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine all ingredients. Set aside 1/2 cup of the mozzarella cheese for topping. Pour remaining cheese mixture in a small bowl then mix the remaining mozarella into the cheese, then set aside until ready to serve. This dish reheats very quickly and is best served at room temperature. You can even make individual servings using only 1/2 cup of mozzarella cheese, and you can save on the rest for future sandwiches. For an elegant version of this dish, use some of the sauce as a dipping dip.

title: Rigatoni With Parsley and Salt
ingredients: 2 cups coarse sea salt | 8 ounces rigatoni pasta | 1/4 cup finely chopped fresh flat-leaf italian parsley
instructions: Bring 3 quarts of water to a boil with 1 tablespoon salt and 3 tablespoons salt. Add pasta. Cook until al dente, about 7 minutes, drain and reserve. Drain pasta. Preheat a large nonstick frying pan or crepe pan over medium heat. Add parsley to pan and mix. Serve with remaining parsley on the side.

title: Moroccan Lima Beans
ingredients: 1 lb lima beans, trimmed and rinsed under water | 1 3/4 cups cooked raspberries | 1/2 cup golden raisin | 3 small ripe raspberries | 2 tablespoons finely minced fresh chives, plus | 1/2 teaspoon minced fresh chives | 1 3/4 teaspoons ground cumin seeds | 1 teaspoon grated orange zest | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Combine all beans in a 6 quart pot.

title: Quick Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs rump steak, cut in strips | 2 -3 cups loosely packed fresh thai basil ( or more ) | 1/2 cup honey | 6 -8 cups halved white seedless grapes
instructions: In a large bowl, toss beef with basil, then honey to just coat the meat.

title: Stove Top Vegetable Packets
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups vegetable shortening | 1 1/2 cups chopped onions | 1/2 cup green bell pepper, chopped | 1/4 cup celery seed ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Line a 9x13 inch pan with paper towels. Melt shortening in a large skillet over medium heat, and cook and stir the onion and bell pepper in the shortening for 2 to 3 minutes. Add celery seed and stir. Add the vegetable package and pour hot water into the skillet. Bake in the preheated oven until the vegetables are tender, about 45 minutes.

title: Curt Dip for Burgers
ingredients: 2 lbs chuck steaks | 1/3 cup creamy french bread | 1 cup yogurt | 1 tablespoon creole mustard | 1 can diced tomatoes ( do not drain )
instructions: Grill chuck steak until no longer pink and internal temperature reaches 160, about 5 minutes per side, or to desired doneness. Shred with 1/3 cup of french bread. Serve with warm french bread for dipping.

Random Ingredients: black eyed pea,monterey jack pepper cheese,corn kernel
title: Black Eyed Peas and Monterey Jack Cheese
ingredients: 1 package frozen corn kernels | 1 package shredded monterey jack pepper cheese, divided | 1 can black-eyed peas, drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°. Spread corn evenly in a greased 9x13 inch baking dish.

Random Ingredients: spinach,rice paper,cooking spray,golden brown sugar,sesame seed
title: Sesame Spinach Rolls
ingredients: 1 package rice paper sheets | cooking spray | 1 package fresh spinach, rinsed and chopped | 1/4 cup golden brown sugar | 1/2 cup sesame seeds, toasted | 1/4 cup quick-cooking spray
instructions: Place about half a sheet of rice paper on a clean work surface. Place the spinach in a small bowl.

title: Chinese Snow Pea Salad
ingredients: 1 package active dry yeast | 1 egg white, lightly beaten | 1 tablespoon water | 3 cups fresh snow pea, chopped | 2 hard-boiled eggs, chopped
instructions: Dissolve yeast in the water in a large mixing bowl, then stir in the egg white. Stir in the snow peas, and cover with a cloth. Let stand in a warm place until the dough rises. Turn the dough out onto a floured surface, and knead until smooth and supple, about 8 minutes. Place the dough into an oiled bowl, and turn the dough over several times in the bowl so it gets completely coated with oil. Cover bowl with a cloth, and let rise in a warm place until doubled in volume. This should take about 1 1/2 hours. Grease a baking sheet with some oil. Turn the dough out onto the baking sheet, and knead for about 10 minutes. Cut into 24 equal pieces. Shape into 2 oval loaves on the prepared baking sheet. If desired, garnish with eggs.

Random Ingredients: asafoetida powder,cherry tomato,thyme leaf,fennel seed,pizza sauce
title: Quick & Easy Pizza
ingredients: 1 pizza sauce ( such as boboli's ) | 1/8 teaspoon fennel seed ( or 1/8 tsp. cumin powder ) | 1/8 teaspoon dried thyme leaves ( or 1/8 tsp. fresh basil ) | 1 pinch asafoetida powder ( optional ) | 3 -6 cherry tomatoes, cut in half
instructions: Open the boboli's pizza base, spread the pizza sauce on the base, then sprinkle the fennel seed and dried thyme. Top with the cherry tomatoes. Sprinkle asafoetida on top of everything and bake on a pizza pan lined with aluminum foil. Allow to cool and serve.

title: Spicy Crab on the Barbie
ingredients: 150 g lump crabmeat | 200 g lelump crabmeat | 100 g caster sugar | chopped fresh basil
instructions: Mix the crabmeat with the sugar, adding a little water if necessary. Grill the fish on the hottest possible fire for 3 - 4 minutes each side until cooked. Serve on a bed of fresh basil, spooning over the sauce.

Random Ingredients: tortilla,salt black pepper,poultry seasoning,kielbasa,ziti pasta,curry leaf,chicken breast
title: Kielbasa and Chicken Lasagna for a Crowd
ingredients: 1 bag kielbasa or ( 16 ounce ) bag linguica sausage, cut into 1-inch thick slices | 4 chicken breasts, and thighs cut into 1-inch pieces | 1 bag ziti pasta or ( 16 ounce ) bag rigatoni pasta | 10 fresh curry leaves ( optional, not essential ) | salt & freshly ground black pepper | 1 tablespoon poultry seasoning | warm tortillas or fresh bread, to serve with | warm tortillas or flat bread to serve with
instructions: In a large nonstick skillet, add sliced sausage. Fry over high heat, stirring, until sausage begins to brown and break into small pieces. Add chicken pieces and continue to cook, stirring frequently, until chicken is lightly browned and cooked through. If desired, add curry leaves to pan and cook, stirring, until fragrant. Add turkey or kielbasa to skillet. Reduce heat to low and simmer, stirring occasionally, until chicken is cooked through. While the chicken is cooking, preheat oven to 400°f. Fill saucepan with about an inch of simmering water. Cover the bottom of a 13x9x2 inch baking dish with a single layer of tortillas or flat bread slices. Spread about half the ziti pasta/noodle/jarred pasta mixture evenly over the tortillas. Cover with about 1/3 of the chicken and sausage mixture. Repeat layers, ending with the sauce. Cover the dish and bake for 45min to 1 hour, or until hot and bubbly. Serve immediately, topping with warm tortillas or flatbread slices to serve, if desired.

title: Cream Cheese Tomato Barley - Instant Meal Copycat Recipe!
ingredients: 1/2 cup raw cashews | 30 g cream cheese | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds | 1 tomatoes | pearl barley
instructions: Pour all into a blender and puree. Pour into a bowl and put in microwave for a minute to cool the cashewnuts. Take a tray and put in the freezer for 3 minutes to melt. Take the cashewnood and slice into small chunks with a sharp knife. Put aside. Place cream cheese into dry skillet on medium heat, keep stirring till it starts breaking down into one big clumps. If the cream cheese starts breaking down or doesn't break up. Keep stirring till it forms a 'white' paste, keep stirring till it gets all smooth. Keep stirring and then add the mustard seeds and tomato. Put the frozen mixture back in the microwave for a minute to warm. Add the cashews. Mix with a long spatula till mixed. Add the barley and switch off. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: lime juice zest,pizza dough,sun tomato oil,apple cider vinegar,asafoetida powder
title: Apple Cider Vinegar Pizza
ingredients: 1 pizza dough | 3/4 cup low-fat apple cider vinegar | 3 teaspoons lime juice, from 2 lemons or 3 teaspoons lime zest | 1 pinch asafoetida powder | 1 tablespoon sun-dried tomato packed in oil, diced
instructions: Cut oven rack into pizza pan and preheat to 550f. Lightly oil the pizza pan and pizza pan and set aside. Combine vinegar, lime juice and asafoetida in a medium bowl and set aside. Dice tomatoes and combine with vinegar mixture. Spread the mixture over pizza crust and cover with pizza crust and remaining pizza ingredients. Let them sit out in the oven for about 5 minutes or so to allow flavors to develop.

Random Ingredients: cannellini bean,saffron thread,cranberry,corn oil,pizza crust,peanut oil,salt black pepper
title: Sweet Bean Fritters With Saffron
ingredients: 1 pizza crust | 2 lbs canned cannellini beans ( red beans would be great for this recipe, i had some left over. ) | 1 1/2 ounces saffron threads ( i made my own with a mexican herb seasoning, though ) | 1 teaspoon salt and black pepper | corn oil, for frying | peanut oil, for deep frying | 1/2 cup chopped dried sweetcorn ( optional )
instructions: Drain cans of beans, reserving 1/2 cup liquid. Place beans in a bowl, add a little of the reserved liquid, and mash with a potato masher until beans are very smooth. Add saffron, salt, ground black pepper, and 1 tablespoons of corn oil to taste. Mix together until you have a creamy dough, and can handle the dough without crushing it. Roll dough out on a floured surface until it is thin, and cut into thin strips about 2 inches wide. Heat 1 inch of peanut oil in a wok or skillet to 350 degrees f. Drop one piece of dough in and fry until golden brown, turning once. Remove one piece to a paper towel lined plate. Repeat until you have 3 more fritters. Pour reserved bean liquid into the wok or skillet, and bring to a boil over high heat, scraping up any browned bits left. Add sweetcorn, and return to a boil, stirring frequently. Reduce heat to medium low, and cook 1 minute.

title: Chipotle Crouton Chips
ingredients: 2 slices white bread | 1 tablespoon pureed chipotle chile ( mexican ), plus more | chipotle chile, for finishing ( about 2 tsp. )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 275f degrees. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Slice 2 x 1/4 inch rounds from the bread, leaving the crusts on. Remove the crusts and reserve. Using a mortar and pestle, coarsely grind 1 tablespoon pureed chipotle.

title: White Beans With Oregano
ingredients: 1 lb white beans, washed | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves
instructions: Rinse and remove any excess white foam from the beans. In a medium pot, cover beans with water. Bring to a boil, turn the heat down to low, and cover. Cook until tender, about 1 hour. When the beans are tender, transfer to a strainer lined with cheesecloth, and drain. When completely cool enough to handle, squeeze out as much water as you can. Cut the beans into 1/2 inch pieces. Place the white beans in a large shallow bowl, and fill with the beans. Sprinkle with the oregano, and serve.

title: Roast Beef in Wheat Germ Crusted Whole Grain
ingredients: 1/2 cup whole wheat germ, whole wheat germ | 8 lbs rump roast
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Rinse the roast with cold water and pat dry. Place in a large roasting pan. Rub wheat germ all over the entire roast and rub it with your fingers. Add more than 1/3 cup of wheat germ to the pan and spread across sides and bottom of pan. Turn meat at intervals from side to side so it is evenly spread. Cook 1 hour and 15 minutes. Cover with foil and rest at room temperature for at least 3 hours. Using your fingers, remove roast from pan, place on platter, cover pan tightly and refrigerate overnight to crisp up and thicken the drippings for basting. Shake pan occasionally while briskly removing drippings. Basting often with remaining 1/3 cup wheat germ and remaining 1/3 cup of wheat germ, until brown and bubbly.

title: French Bread Wedges
