ingredients: 4 1/4 lbs french bread, cut into 3 inch slices | 1 jar roasted sweet peppers or 1/2-3/4 lb canned pimento-stuffed sweet peppers, cut in strips | 1 lb fresh spinach, rinsed and chopped | 2 cups shredded mexican blend cheese | 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour
instructions: If using a microwaveable bowl, cover loosely with foil and microwave on low power for 5 - 7 minutes to steam moisture. When bread is cool, preheat oven to 350 degrees. Arrange 1 slice each of the peppers into triangles. Coat with 1 t. Of cheese. Repeat with another slice of bread. Place remaining pepper strips over the peppers. Top with remaining bread slices, cheese and remaining cheese. In a small bowl, combine the flour and remaining pepper strips. Sprinkle evenly over bread slices. Fold up the ends of the bread. Then, with a spatula, make a 1 1/2 inch pocket along the edge of each bread wedge. Seal well. Arrange wedges in a 2 quart casserole dish that has been sprayed with cooking spray. Sprinkle the remaining cheese over all. Sprinkle flour over all, and shake pan to coat the bread. Bake uncovered for 35 - 45 minutes or until bread is crisp and topping is golden.

title: Tropical Corned Beef
ingredients: 1 corned beef brisket ( with spice packet ) | 1 can artichoke hearts, rinsed and thinly sliced | 1/2 cup applesauce, warmed | 1 tablespoon drambuie
instructions: Using kitchen scissors, cut brisket crosswise into about 8 wedges. Add artichokes and apple sauce to brisket. Cover.

title: Sausage With Breakfast
ingredients: 1 slice rye bread, buttered | 1/2 lb kielbasa sausage | 1/3 cup chopped onion | 2 slices cooked chicken | 1/8 teaspoon sumac
instructions: Spread the sliced rrye bread with nonstick cooking spray. Place sausage, onion and chicken on toast. Sprinkle with sumac to taste. Top with remaining toast.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon cube,garlic paste,cornstarch,anise seed,farfalle pasta,sauce,port wine,wheat breadcrumb
title: Garlic Pasta With Farfalle
ingredients: 6 tablespoons farfalle pasta, uncooked ( bowtie pasta ) | 1 tablespoon minced garlic paste | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 1 dash hot sauce ( e.g. tabasco ) | 1 teaspoon cornstarch, dissolved in | 1 tablespoon whole wheat breadcrumbs, mixed with | 1 tablespoon port wine or 1 tablespoon dry sherry | 1 tablespoon anise seed ( toasted and crushed on the counter )
instructions: Cook farfalle according to package instructions. Drain and set aside. Saute garlic paste, then add water in saucepan and bring to simmer for about three to five minutes. Add bouillon cube, hot sauce, cornstarch and aniseed. Whisk until dissolved and add farfalle to the sauce, and cook on low heat, stirring constantly to prevent sticking. The pasta will be rather dry initially, but will have absorbed the sauce as far as the pasta absorbs it. Serve sprinkled with crumb mixture.

title: Cabbage and Chicken Salad
ingredients: 1 lb shredded cabbage | 1 lb boneless chicken breast, cubed | 1/2 cup cornmeal | 4 teaspoons cider vinegar
instructions: Cook all the above ingredients on med high heat in pot, until cabbage and chicken are done. Drain off excess liquid. Mix together cabbage and chicken on platter. Sprinkle with vinaigrette.

title: Fruit-Poached Corn and Eggs
ingredients: 12 ears corn ( fresh, frozen or canned ) | 4 teaspoons tea or 4 teaspoons coriander tea
instructions: Wash the corn thoroughly or run under running water. Place two ears of corn on a teacup with the skin side up. With a sharp knife cut three slit lengthwise down the middle. Carefully and carefully slit the lengthwise slit almost all the way through to the corn. This way you can place the ear of corn in each of the 4 portions above the corn. Use a sharp knife so that the kernels are fully encased. Place in steamer or on a stove above 6 inches of boiling water. Close and steam 2 - 3 minutes, or just until the corn is cooked when tested with a knife. Remove, and place, in a serving dish. Serve hot, or cold. To make fresh coriander tea, bring hot water to the boil and take the outer leaves off the tea stalks. Steep 2 - 3 minutes. Scoop leaves out with a spoon and discard. Pour tea or tea over them.

title: Spaghetti with Orange-Garam Molasses
ingredients: 1 pound uncooked spaghetti | 1 1/2 cups orange marmalade | 1 cup guacamole | 1/2 cup grated parmesan cheese | 1/4 teaspoon garam masala
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to boil. Cook spaghetti in the boiling water, stirring occasionally, until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 12 minutes. Drain. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook spaghetti in the boiling water, stirring occasionally, until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 11 minutes.

Random Ingredients: olive vegetable oil,russet potato,summer savory,turkey,parmesan cheese,pinto bean,soymilk,chicken stock
title: Worsteburger & Bean Soup
ingredients: 2 lbs ground turkey | 2 tablespoons summer savory | 4 tablespoons olive oil | 1 can pinto beans, drained | 1 cup low-fat soymilk | 1 tablespoon dried parmesan cheese | 1 1/2 lbs russet potatoes, peeled, cut into 3/4-inch cubes | 2 cups low-fat chicken stock
instructions: Mix together the ground turkey, seasonings and parmesan. Form into small patties. Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Sear the patties until browned and cooked through, about 5 minutes per side. Add the beans and soy milk, lower the heat and simmer for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally. Add the potatoes, stir, and simmer for an additional 10 minutes. In the meantime, heat the soup over medium heat, and let cook for 10 minutes. Serve the soup immediately.

Random Ingredients: beef rib,parsley leaf,lemon,bread dough,bamboo skewer,hazelnut,dill pickle
title: Hazelnut and Mustard Beef Kabobs
ingredients: 1 lb prepared bread dough | 1 small egg roll mixed with parsley leaves | 1 lemon, juice of | 10 hazelnuts, peeled, and crushed | 8 -10 slices hazelnuts ( to garnish ) | 5 beef ribs | 1 sprig dill pickle, cut into 4 wedges ( to garnish )
instructions: Remove the crust from the bread dough. Take a small spoonful of dough on the countertop, and roll into a long thin cylinder shape. Use the end of the roll to form a kabob roll. Place on a plate. Repeat for all kabob cylinders. Mix together the bread dough with the lemon juice. If you haven’t done this, mix in a little water to the mixture, and refrigerate the kabob for at least 1 hour. While the beef is chilling, cut the meat into approximately 1/2 inch pieces. Using a mandoline, slice each piece into about 1 thick pieces with a knife or kitchen scissors. Spread the hazelnuts on a baking sheet. Place the meat onto the bread dough in a single layer. Cover with the remaining bread dough. Bake the meat, nuts, and pickles in a preheated oven for about 45 minutes, until the meat is cooked through and the bread has absorbed the nut and hazelnut mixture. Serve either hot, room temperature, or room temperature. You can also serve this as an appetizer with a side of hummus or as a side dish. Hazelnut oil, if you don't have an electric stove, you can use a small heavy skillet and toast the nuts in it over medium heat, stirring constantly, until golden brown. It will take about 10 to 20 minutes for the nuts to become crispy. If you don't have a skillet, you can fry the hazelnuts in a skillet over medium high heat for about 5 minutes, or until golden brown.

title: Peachy Peaches With Bean Crust
ingredients: 500 g sliced peaches | 2 tablespoons bean curd, mixed with 1 ml water
instructions: Slice each peach in half and remove the peels. Place peach halves in a small baking dish. Combine remaining ingrendients and pour over the peaches. Bake in a moderate oven for about 40 minutes, basting occasionally with the leftover sauce. Serve warm with ice cream or cream.

Random Ingredients: brandy,raspberry,tea,italian sausage,cocoa powder,taco shell,purpose flour,milk ricotta cheese
title: Tia's Amazing Cannoli Pie
ingredients: 1/2 lb italian sausage ( you can use 2/3 pound sliced sausage ) | 12 tablespoons brandy ( any brand ) or 12 tablespoons rum, divided ( any brand ) | 3 cups brewed tea | 1/2 cup milk ricotta cheese ( i used cottage cheese ) | 3 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 1/2 cup cocoa powder | 48 taco shells ( i just made them up ) | fresh raspberries ( optional )
instructions: Cook sausage until browned on all sides, then remove onto a plate lined with wax paper. Return sausage to pan and brown for another 5 minutes, just a slight taste. Transfer the sausage to the bowl you cooked the sausage in, then put into refrigerator to marinade. Drain the sausage and set aside. Discard the other sausage and discard the rest of the sausage fat. Chill. Preheat oven to 350°f. Prepare the salsa by combining all the ingredients, except for the taco shells, in a large bowl. Mix well. Set aside. Backe your appetizer shells if you like, but you can eat on them. If using a taco shell, you will need to use a 9 pie plate. Spoon the hot, sausages into the shell. Top with a scoop of ricotta cheese, then the optional raspberries. Cover with second plate, then wrap with wax paper and bake. Note, i like to use a baking sheet, or any pan that will hold everything in one layer. I didn't use a pan, however, the baking sheet would be easier for me if my oven were using a 9 pie plate, i did, and it took 20 - 45 minutes to get a nice golden brown crust before my aunt didn't, just because they were nice and crusty. If you use a 9 pie plate instead of a glass, you can freeze the dish for later use.

title: Mock Vietnamese Peanut Sauce
ingredients: 500 g peanut oil | 30 -50 ml peanut oil | 1 pinch crushed red chili pepper flakes ( optional ) | cachaca ( optional )
instructions: Heat up peanut oil in a pot or wok over medium heat. When oil is smoking add crushed chili flakes, and allow to wilt slightly. Add oil and add cachaca. Stir, then add the crushed chili.

Random Ingredients: canola oil,burrito flour tortilla,swiss cheese,cheddar cheese,sultana,lettuce leaf,kitchen bouquet
title: Twice-baked Chimichangas (Crispy Chimichangas) on a Baked Lettuce
ingredients: 12 soft burrito-size flour tortillas | 1 1/2 cups shredded fat-free cheddar cheese | 1 cup shredded swiss cheese | 1 cup low-fat cheddar cheese | 6 lettuce leaves ( red or green ) | 1/4 cup sultana ( or toasted green ) | kitchen bouquet, spice | canola oil or extra virgin olive oil, for frying
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Brush a 9 x 13 baking dish with about a tbls. Of oil. Place one tortilla briefly in the pan, so that it sits flat on the bottom and slightly higher than the sides. Place one piece of chees in the center of the tortilla, then spread it into a patty shape on top of the chees. Place another tortilla, with the chees on it and the sandwich, on top, slightly lower back on the cheese. Continue the process. Slice into six or eight even pieces, or about the width of your finger tips. Repeat with more tortillas and sandwich, making sure to keep the sandwich on the bottom and part of the tortilla. Arrange tortillas on top of the cheese so that they are flat in the center. The amount of filling increases as it rises. Sprinkle a little kitchen bouquet spice over each chimichanga. Cover them loosely with aluminum foil and bake in the oven until tortillas are softened and crispy, approximately 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: white sugar,garlic salt,sesame seed,white fish fillet,red wine,topping,tea
title: Oriental Fish
ingredients: 1 tablespoon sesame seeds | 1/4 cup white sugar | 1/4 cup red wine | 1 1/2 cups brewed tea | 1 tablespoon finely sesame seeds | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt | 4 white fish fillets | 1 envelope whipped topping
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Spread sesame seeds in a shallow baking dish. Bake in the preheated oven until fragrant, 1 to 2 minutes. Turn oven off and cover with foil. Allow to cool. In a shallow pan, mix sesame seeds, sugar, red wine, tea, sesame seeds, garlic salt. Place fish fillets in the pan, and pour the tea mixture over the fish. Cover and refrigerate for about 30 minutes. Remove fish from marinade, and arrange on a serving platter. Top with a thick dollop of whipped topping.

title: Lentil and Beef Dip
ingredients: 150 g green lentils, soaked overnight but then rinsed | 4 cups beef stock | 250 g arugula
instructions: Place the beef stock in a saucepan over a high heat. Bring to the boil, skim off any scum that rises to the surface, and add lentils. Cover and simmer for 15 - 60 minutes or until lentils are tender and broth is reduced. Stir in arugula just before serving. Serve with bread.

Random Ingredients: white pepper,tuna steak,milk chocolate,spanish onion,dark brown sugar,rice vinegar,vegetable broth
title: Tuna With Chocolate and Onions
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups milk chocolate, finely chopped | 1 cup vegetable broth | 2 tablespoons rice vinegar | 2 tablespoons dark brown sugar | 2 1/2 lbs firm white tuna steaks, cut into 1/2 inch wide strips | 1 spanish onion, thinly sliced | white pepper, freshly ground
instructions: For the chocolate mixture, in a microwave safe bowl, add the chocolate and oil. Cook, stirring, over high 1 minute. Add the broth and vinegar. Stir gently. Cover and set aside for 15 minutes to soften slightly. Meanwhile, prepare the tuna. In a medium skillet, over medium high heat, stir together the brown sugar and white pepper to taste. When the mixture begins to bubble, add the tuna, spreading it in a thin layer. Cook over high heat for 3 minutes, stirring occasionally. Remove the tuna with a slotted spoon and transfer to a plate. Add the onions to the pan and cook for 2 minutes, stirring and scraping the bottom of the pan to loosen the browned bits. Add the tuna to the pan. Raise the heat to high. Add the warm chocolate mixture and cook until it is just melted, stirring very gently. Pour the mixture over the tuna. Serve warm.

title: Carrabba's Red Bell Pepper Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 cup white wine | 1/4 cup yellow bell pepper, chopped
instructions: Over medium high heat, bring the wine to a boil. Add the chopped white and yellow bell peppers.

Random Ingredients: honey,spring onion,white bean,red wine vinegar,stewing beef,curry powder,peppercorn,clam
title: Crock Pot Mussaman's Baked Beans and Meat
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef | 5 -6 cups cooked white beans | 1/2 cup red wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons honey | 1 can chopped clams | 2 teaspoons crushed peppercorns | 2 -3 teaspoons curry powder | 4 spring onions, chopped
instructions: Place the meat and beans in the crock pot. Add all the other ingredients except the spring onions.

title: Peach Salsa
ingredients: 2 cans sliced peaches, drained | 4 cans light cream-style corn | 1 teaspoon italian seasoning | 1/2 cup sliced red leaf lettuce
instructions: Drain juice from cans into a large bowl and stir in corn and italian seasoning until evenly mixed. Cover and chill in the refrigerator about an hour, stirring occasionally. Arrange slaw in a serving bowl and scatter red leaf lettuce around it.

Random Ingredients: orange flower water,icing sugar,yellow bell pepper,vinegar,no salt tomato paste,meat broth,olive oil cooking spray,purpose flour
title: Sweet Spanish Pepper Rings
ingredients: olive oil flavored cooking spray | 1 lb fresh meatball, such as sirloin or 1 lb skirt steak | 1/2 cup all-purpose flour | 1 1/2 cups non-dairy canned tomato paste, such as dei fratelli brand ( san marzano brand ) | 1 1/4 cups reduced-sodium fat-free chicken broth | 1 tablespoon vinegar | 1/4 cup icing sugar | 1 tablespoon orange flower water
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Coat a baking sheet with the olive oil spray. Place meatballs on baking sheet and place in oven for 8 minutes to warm.

Random Ingredients: sazon goya,jalapeno,arborio rice,marjoram,cold water,vanilla bean,chicken breast
title: Chicken Arancione
ingredients: 8 ounces uncooked japanese arborio rice | 1 whole boneless skinless chicken breast, halved | 1 canned jalapeno, sliced | 3 tablespoons cold water | 1/2 teaspoon ground marjoram | 3/4 teaspoon sazon goya, with a few dashes of cayenne pepper | 1 teaspoon vanilla bean
instructions: Rinse the rice under running water until most of the water has left the rice. Put all ingredients, except the vanilla, in a large pot and bring to a boil. Turn down the heat, cover the pan and simmer for 25 minutes. Remove from heat, fluff with fork and allow to cool to room temperature. Serve with any garnishes.

title: Peach Brisket With Beef
ingredients: 12 large pears, preferably fresh | 1/4 cup celery salt | 2 tablespoons fresh coarse ground peaches, or | ice
instructions: Remove peel from peaches. Cut in half and scoop out the pit. Set peaches in a small bowl of cold water to remove the excess moisture. Fill a bowl with ice. Drain the peaches and set aside. Combine celery salt and peaches in a separate bowl. Incorporate the celery salt/peaches into the beef mixture. Chill for 1 hour or longer. Serve with the ice.

title: Blackberry Pork or Beef
ingredients: 5 lbs pork roast | 2 cans mushrooms ( with liquid ) | 1 can mushrooms, drained | 1 can blackberries
instructions: Mix all ingredients, except blackberries, together in crock pot. Set on low. Simmer for 8 hours before serving. Stir and serve over pasta.

Random Ingredients: celery seed,sea salt,steak seasoning,pancake mix,cucumber,wheat flour
title: Peppered Flank Steak
ingredients: 1 teaspoon celery seed | 1 teaspoon sea salt | 1/2 teaspoon steak seasoning | 1 tablespoon pancake mix | 1/2 teaspoon celery seed | 2 teaspoons whole wheat flour | 1/2 cup dry toasted wheat flour | 1/2 cup cucumber, peeled and chopped
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine celery seed, sea salt, steak seasoning, pancake mix, celery seed, whole wheat flour, and cucumber. Toss with enough floured flour to moisten all sides. Coat grill rack with nonstick spray. Preheat grill for medium high heat.

Random Ingredients: porcini mushroom,red bean,red potato,mustard powder,pear,plum tomato,feta
title: Greek Porcini Salad
ingredients: 1 lb dried red beans ( new barrell or great northern beans ) | 8 ounces dried pears | 4 large plum tomatoes | 1/2 lb small red potatoes ( yukon golds are best if you can stand to salt both ) or 1/2 lb sweet potato, unpeeled ( yukon golds are best if you can stand to salt both ) | 12 ounces dried porcini mushrooms | 1 tablespoon mustard powder ( optional ) | 1/4 cup feta, crumbled
instructions: Pick through dried beans and place in large stockpot. Cover with cold water by 2 inches, add pears. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer 3 to 5 minutes. Drain beans completely and place in large serving bowl. Peel tomatoes and cut in half, then cut each tomato into 3, then each half into 3, then all into thirds. Cut potatoes into bite size chunks and place in large bowl.. Add 1/2 1 tbsp of mustard and 1/2 tsp of pepper to onions and mushrooms and stir well. Add beans to onion and mushrooms.. Add remaining ingredients. Season to taste with pepper. Cover and refrigerate.

Random Ingredients: peanut oil,porcini mushroom,saffron,swordfish steak,vegetable oil cooking spray
title: Spanish Sauces With Beef
ingredients: 1 lb swordfish steak, cut to 3/4 inch thick ( or other small firm white fish ) | vegetable oil cooking spray | 1/4 cup dry porcini mushrooms | 1/4 cup hot peanut oil | 1 pinch saffron
instructions: Spray a shallow tray with veggie spray. Add mushrooms and let them soften on your hands. Place a generous 1/2 teaspoon of sugar on the palm of your hand over the mushrooms and press the mushrooms against the plate until it is evenly covered about 1/8 inch thick. Place the fish on another piece of foil and press the mushroom to seal. Repeat until the fish is used up. Heat an iron skillet to 350°f. Place fish fillets in the skillet and sprinkle with salt and pepper. Cook for 2 to 3 minutes on each side and transfer to a plate while preparing the other ingredients. Heat the oil over medium heat in a skillet. Sprinkle saffron over the oil and quickly ignite with tongs, or you can use kitchen shears for this step, but you can use a wood or fire extinguisher. Transfer fish fillets to the skillet and warm through for one to two minutes then remove and let them rest on paper towels. Slice the fillets into thin strips. Serve them hot, with rice.

title: Guinness Pork and Sauerkraut
ingredients: 1 lb pork, cut into 1 inch cubes | 6 ounces sauerkraut | 1/2 cup clear honey | 1/2 cup salsa | 3 poblano chiles, roasted, skins rubbed off, seeded quartered | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh mint leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Place pork in a large ceramic baking dish, fat side up. Cover with sauerkraut, drizzle with honey. Cover and refrigerate. Bake sauerkraut for 30 minutes, then remove meat from dish. Rinse and drain off liquid. Add salsa, chiles and mint. Set aside. Bake pork for 20 minutes, uncovered, until pork is cooked through. Serve pork with sauerkraut in soup bowls.

Random Ingredients: mango chutney,white creme de cacao,barbecue sauce,brown rice,tamarind juice
title: Barbecue Rice Appetizers
ingredients: 1/2 cup mango chutney or 1/2 cup green chutney | 1/4 cup barbecue sauce | 1/4 cup white creme de cacao | 1/4 cup tamarind juice | 1 cup cooked brown rice
instructions: In mixing bowl combine all ingredients. Mix thoroughly.

Random Ingredients: tomato green chilies,rigatoni pasta,red pepper flake,scotch bonnet pepper,dark beer,white sauce
title: Cindy's Hot Dog Pasta "chocolate"
ingredients: 1 lb rigatoni pasta ( or your favorite spaghetti ) | 1 can dark beer | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies | 1/2 teaspoon red pepper flakes, or more to taste | 3 tablespoons white sauce | 1 can white sauce, or more as needed
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add pasta to boiling water.

Random Ingredients: peanut oil,cider vinegar,caper,pineapple juice,gouda cheese,couscous,snow pea,tapioca flour
title: Tibetan Couscous With Pineapple-Pineapple-Caper Dressing
ingredients: 1 box couscous | 1/3 cup pineapple juice ( from canned pineapple in vinegar ) | 2 tablespoons peanut oil | 2 tablespoons cider vinegar ( to taste ) | 1 tablespoon capers | 2 teaspoons maple syrup or 2 teaspoons cornstarch | 8 ounces smoked gouda cheese, cut into 3/4-inch cubes ( use danish if you want more authentic ) | 1 cup snow peas, trimmed and halved lengthwise and cut in half if large
instructions: Set couscous aside. Heat oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat. Add cider vinegar and capers to skillet. Cook, stirring, until garlic flavor is released but not yet brown. Add couscous and stir. Remove pan from heat and add pineapple juice. Stir, cover tightly and let stand for 5 - 10 minutes. Fluff with a fork. Add cheese, stir until melted. Pour couscous onto a serving platter. Arrange snow peas over top and drizzle with remaining dressing.

Random Ingredients: crescent dinner,sun tomato oil,red enchilada sauce,green cardamom pod,yoghurt
title: Red (Indian) Crescent Enchiladas
ingredients: 1 can red enchilada sauce | 7 tablespoons red enchilada sauce | 1/4 teaspoon green cardamom pods, crushed | 1 1/4 cups yoghurt | 1 package crescent dinner rolls
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Empty one can of enchilada sauce into a pie plate. Split open the rest of the enchilada sauce and mix in a small bowl. Pile 2 tbsp enchilada sauce onto the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish to form a shell around 2 large rimmed baking dishes. Next, lay a single sheet of each ingredient in one layer of each the following, 1/3 each of the white sauce and the green cardamom pods. Next, make a second layer of the cheese filling, using only 1/3 each of the white sauce and the green cardamom pods. Repeat layering in 3 layers, ending with cheese filling and top with remaining 1/3 each of white sauce and green cardamom pods. Bake 30 to 35 minutes at 350 degrees f, or until warm and bubbling.

title: Paneer( Indian Cheese Tart)
ingredients: 2 lbs very finely grated paneer ( indian cheese ) | 3 1/2 cups double cream
instructions: Mix the cheese with the cream until it becomes creamy. Spread in the bottom of the pie shell and put it into a preheated oven at 350° for about an hour. When ready fill with fresh cream and serve garnished with finely chopped coriander leaves.

title: Broccoli Cheese Dip
ingredients: 500 g velveeta cheese | 1 cup yoghurt ( low-fat or normal ) | 350 g fresh broccoli florets
instructions: Put evoo in medium sized pot and heat to medium. Cut cheese into cubes and add to heated pot. Mix well and keep on heating. Take it off heat and keep covered for about 15 minutes. Then remove lid again and stir the mixture. Add yoghurt. Mix well. Garnish broccoli florets. Serve. Feel free to use a type of vegetables like potatoes, carrots, zucchini…. Try coconut milk, peas….

Random Ingredients: bread,chocolate ice cream,hot chili sauce,bow tie pasta
title: Chocolate Pasta With Chipped Pasta
ingredients: 12 ounces bow tie pasta | 1 1/2 cups sweet chili sauce | 1 1/2 cups chocolate ice cream | 1/4 cup bread
instructions: Cook pasta in lightly salted boiling water 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente. Drain, return to pan and toss with chili sauce. Heat to boiling over medium heat and stir in chocolate ice cream. Cover and cool to room temperature. Drain pasta, reserving 1 cup of the pasta water. Place pasta, warmed chili sauce and chopped bread in large bowl and toss with 1 - 2 tablespoons reserved pasta water. Serve with additional warm chocolate ice cream.

title: White Beans and Broccoli
ingredients: 1 bunch broccoli | 1 can white beans, drained
instructions: Clean broccoli and break into florets. Steam until desired consistency. While still hot stir beans into broccoli.

Random Ingredients: sugar snap pea,dinner,sea bass fillet,caper,tomato green chilies,white bean
title: Quick and Easy Calico
ingredients: 9 frozen dinner rolls, thawed | 1 package frozen sugar snap peas, thawed | 2 cans diced tomatoes and green chilies, undrained | 1 container drained white beans with liquid | 1/4 cup chopped drained capers | 1/4 cup chopped uncooked sea bass fillet
instructions: Heat oven to 400°f. Combine rolls, peas, tomatoes, beans and capers.

title: Cider Jelly
ingredients: 3 tablespoons coarsely crushed lemongrass ( found in asian groceries ) | 6 1/2 cups unfiltered apple cider
instructions: Combine lemon grass and apple cider in 2 quarts, heat to boiling, stirring frequently. Remove from heat. Stir in crinkle paste. Refrigerate for at least 3 days before using. When ready to use, use in breadcrumbs, crackers, as a sandwich, etc. Makes about one 3/4 cup.

Random Ingredients: pomelo fruit,bouillon cube,monterey jack cheese,apricot preserve,cocoa
title: Pomelo Refrigerator Swiss Steak
ingredients: 1/2 cup pomelo fruit, pulp only | 1/2 cup apricot preserves, drained ( i find these are too soft for our taste ) | 1 bouillon cube | 1/2 - 1 cup shredded monterey jack cheese | 1 teaspoon cocoa
instructions: Dice pomelo into small chunks and mix with drained apricot preserves and cheese. Serve over crackers.

title: Tasty Fried Ramen Grilled Skewers
ingredients: 8 ounces fresh toast ( from leftovers! ) | 12 slices of your favorite roasted garlic ( optional ) | 2 -3 tablespoons freshly grated lime zest ( about 1-2 limes ) | 2 packages of ramen-style noodles ( or 1 package hot cooked asian noodles ) ( optional )
instructions: To make kewers preheat broiler. Trim crust from toast and set on cookie sheet. Sprinkle toast with lime zest and bake in 375 degree preheated oven for 5 - 5 minutes until beginning to crisp. Watch carefully so they don ` t burn and turn over in the oven. Turn off oven and add the hot cooked ramen noodles or japanese noodles, then spread onto hot crusted toast. If using the noodles, toast under broiler briefly until golden brown. Slice and serve hot, but not so hot that they burn, your guests will not taste that goodness. Serve with ketchup or sour cream for a real treat.

title: Tacu Tacos (Fried Onions and Yogurt)
ingredients: 12 large onions | 1 bunch fresh cilantro leaves, or as desired
instructions: Using a sharp knife, peel the onions and slice in half lengthwise, about 1/2 inch thick. Place a half onion slice into a bowl and sprinkle with cilantro. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: shallot,black mustard seed,wine vinegar,cider vinegar,tomato puree
title: Dijon Shallot Vinaigrette
ingredients: 1 shallot, peeled | 1/2 cup cider vinegar | 1/2 cup cider vinegar | 1/4 cup tomato puree | 1 tablespoon black mustard seed | 1 tablespoon wine vinegar
instructions: In a medium bowl, whisk shallot with cider vinegar, tomato puree and mustard seed until well incorporated. Refrigerate for 1 - 2 hours. Season to taste with salt and pepper before serving.

title: Santa Fe Bean Bread Pizza With Mango Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 ounce active dry yeast | 1/2 cup warm milk | 3 cups unbleached white beans ( from 1 large white bean ) | 1 tablespoon honeydew melon, finely chopped | 2 cups diced peeled apples | 1/4 cup sweet chili sauce
instructions: In large bowl dissolve yeast with warm milk. Add white beans, melon & apples and mix to mix. Turn out into large casserole dish. Drizzle with honeydew sauce. Cover with plastic wrap and let rise until doubled, about 1 hour. Bake at 400 degrees for 15 to 20 minutes or until toppings are bubbly. Mango sauce.

title: Mojhy Mint Drops
ingredients: 6 ounces bittersweet chocolate, roughly chopped ( not unsweetened ) | 6 ounces unsweetened chocolate, roughly chopped ( not unsweetened ) | 1 teaspoon instant aniseed ( optional ) | of fresh mint ( optional for garnish )
instructions: Place all of the ingredients in a food processor and process until finely chopped, stopping to scrape down the sides halfway through. Pour into a bowl and add the mint sprigs and stir to combine. Place in a jar and cover tightly. Place in the refrigerator until needed. Enjoy.

title: Anchovies for Your Home! (Guillamole)
ingredients: 2 cans kidney beans, drained and rinsed well | 1 teaspoon anchovy paste ( paste, not paste ) | 1 1/4 cups water | 2/3 cup tequila ( for the rim of your glass )
instructions: In a nonreactive saucepan, combine the first 5 ingredients. Bring just to a boil over medium head. Boil briskly for 20, then pour into nonreactive bowl and mash.

title: Be Ahead, Steamed and Broiled Oysters
ingredients: 1 large turnip, peeled, cut 1 inch pieces | 6 -8 medium asparagus, topped and tailed | 1 can oysters, drained and cut in half | sweet sauce, to taste |  gin ( optional )
instructions: Prepare the turnip for steaming by placing on a bamboo steamer rack in a baking dish and placing under a hot grill for 3 - 4 minutes until just tender. Rinse off the asparagus cut spears at the base of the asparagus. Rinse under cold water. In an oblong casserole dish, layer the asparagus spears on top of the turnip. Lay slices of oysters across the fillings. Sprinkle sweet sauce over oysters. Drizzle with gin, if using. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: colby monterey jack cheese,ramen noodle,lobster tail,garlic clove
title: Garlic Crusted Lobster With Ramen Noodles
ingredients: 2 garlic cloves, minced | 3/4 lb cooked lobsters ( tail of cob ) | 4 sheets of fresh seasoning ramen noodles | 4 cups shredded colby-monterey jack cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f cut ends off garlic clove. Drizzle with olive oil to prevent skin from forming. Rub mixture onto lobster tails. Bake until cooked through, turning as needed, 12 to 15 minutes. Meanwhile, cook ramen noodles according to package directions. Toss noodles with cheese and serve.

title: Homemade Beef Barley
ingredients: 1 lb of precooked pearl barley ( about 1 pound ) | 3 beef bouillon cubes
instructions: The pearl barley should take a few minutes to get tender. Drying them should be enough so that they can be picked to get ready in about 15 - 30 minutes. In a dutch oven, heat the beef with the bullion over medium heat until the broth bubbles. It took about five minutes to boil. The broth should be bubbly and starting to thicken up. Stir often so it doesn't burn. After about five minutes, add pearl barley, cover and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer for about 20 minutes.

title: Yogurt Dip
ingredients: 1 cup plain yogurt, room temperature | 1/4 cup onion powder or 1/4 cup dry onion flakes | 1/2 cup yellow pepper, finely chopped or 1/2 cup chopped green pepper | 1/4 cup simple syrup
instructions: Stir yogurt, onion powder, yellow pepper, and syrup together in a bowl. Cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours.

Random Ingredients: salmon fillet,chive,celery seed,raspberry jam,coconut milk,green chile,cranberry,triple sec
title: Baked Salmon With Raspberry Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 cup raspberry jam | 3 tablespoons triple sec | 1 1/2 tablespoons celery seeds | 1 3/4 cups coconut milk | 8 ounces salmon fillets | 1/4 cup canned red raspberries | 1 fresh green chile, chopped | 1/4 cup dried cranberries ( to garnish )
instructions: For sauce, stir together raspberry jam, triple sec, celery seeds, and coconut milk. Set aside. Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Prepare a shallow baking dish by spraying with cooking spray. Place salmon fillets in dish and brush with raspberry mixture. Sprinkle with raspberries, chili, and cranberries. Bake 18 to 20 minutes or until fish flakes easily when prodded. Serve over prepared pasta.

Random Ingredients: broth,bouquet garni,mirepoix,pecan,vodka,semolina flour,shiitake mushroom,chicken stock cube
title: Smoked Mushroom Pies
ingredients: 6 1/2 fluid ounces low salt chicken stock cube, crumbled | 3 1/2 fluid ounces vodka or 3 1/2 fluid ounces cognac | 8 -12 ounces mirepoix ( optional ) or 8 -12 ounces other smoked vegetables, chopped | 1 cup pecans, chopped | 1 bouquet garni ( thyme, sage or rosemary ) | 300 ml shiitake mushroom soup or 300 ml creamed mushroom soup, heated | 1 1/2 tablespoons coarse semolina flour
instructions: Sauté mushrooms gently in a medium heatproof jug/bowl. You should now have a golden brown crusty surface. Once golden brown, remove from heat. Drain off any liquid from the surface and deglaze. Add stock cube and vodka/cognac and cook for 30 - 60 minutes. Mix in the mixed vegetables and continue to cook for about 2 minutes. If using creamed mushrooms, add now and cook for about 1 additional minute. Stir in 1 1/2 tablespoons semolina. Remove from heat and gradually stir in the soup mix until smooth and creamy. Serve warm.

title: Thai-Style Basil Ham
ingredients: 3 pounds country-style ham, thinly sliced | 1/2 cup fish sauce | 1 cup orange juice | 1 cup fresh basil leaves, or to taste
instructions: Place ham slices in a large dutch oven, and cover with water. Bring to a boil, and cook until water is absorbed, 5 to 8 minutes. Stir in fish sauce and orange juice. Heat through, about 10 minutes. Remove ham slices to a serving platter. Bring orange juice until liquid can be removed. Place basil in a small bowl, and place hot ham on top of the basil.

title: Cuban Cigars
ingredients: 1 package phyllo pastry sheets, thawed | 1 teaspoon mexican oregano
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Line baking sheets with parchment paper. Lay out each sheet of phyllo dough on a work surface, and place 1/2 teaspoon of oregano on the base. Fold one corner of phyllo in half to form a small rim. Fold other corner in half again to make a small rim. Repeat with remaining phyllo dough and oregano, until you have layered 12 sheets, or 24 total. Place 5 cigars onto the parchment paper. Poke a toothpick through every other edge, and then spray the paper with nonstick cooking spray. Bake in the preheated oven until golden brown, 15 to 30 minutes. Cool 5 minutes before removing. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: banana jelly,mexican cheese,mushroom cap,asparagus spear,margarine,ginger,yellow pepper
title: Hot Stuffed Pepperjack Caps
ingredients: 24 asparagus spears | 2 red ripe mango caps | 1 cup shredded mexican blend cheese | 2 tablespoons minced ginger | 3 banana jelly | asparagus spear | margarine ( optional ) or butter ( optional )
instructions: Slice off the top and bottoms of the peppers. Set aside. Carefully remove seeds from the tops, keeping as much of the pulp as possible in the caps. Scoop out the pulp from the underside, reserving about 1/4 cup of the pulp for another recipe. Place 1 tablespoon of the cheese into each cavity of the pepperjack. Combine 1 tablespoon of the ginger and 1 teaspoon of salt in a small bowl, and add 1 teaspoon of the mixture to each cap. Fill each pepperjack with a few spoonfuls of the reserved cheese. Place peppers in a large non stick skillet, and cook over medium heat until cheese begins to melt and is lightly browned. Transfer the peanutter mushrooms with a slotted spoon onto a plate, and allow them to cool completely. Wipe the skillet clean, removing any browned bits from the bottom of the pan. Heat over medium high heat until hot. Add the jelly and stir until bubbly. Stuff the peppers with the drained mushroom pulp and serve.

title: Banana and Swiss Bread
ingredients: 1 baguette, cut in half lengthwise and toasted
instructions: Preheat the broiler. Place the toasted baguette halves on a baking sheet. Place under the heat until the crusts are dark about 2 inches of the heat, 3 to 5 minutes. Remove from the heat. Slip the bread into a large baguette sandwich bowl and slice, 1/2 inch thick, in half. Spread the slices with the remaining toasted bread. Place a slice of cooked banana on top of the bread. Cut the sandwich into 4 sandwiches.

title: Artichokes With Vinegar and Artichokes
ingredients: 2 cups cider vinegar | 24 artichoke hearts
instructions: Combine vinegar, artichoke hearts and remaining ingredients in a small saucepan.

title: Cottage Cheese Chicken Wings
ingredients: 2 cups cottage cheese | 1 pound chicken wings, separated | 2 cups canned green beans, drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place cottage cheese, chicken wings, and green beans in a baking dish and mix well. Bake in the preheated oven 1 hour, or until heated through and bubbly.

title: Beets in Cheese
ingredients: 1/4 cup diced pickled jalapeno | 1 can diced beets, drained | 1/4 cup sour cream | 1 sheet frozen puff pastry | topping, for serving
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Combine jalapenos, beetroot, sour cream and cheese in a bowl. Press onto the center of the baking sheet. Bake 10 minutes. Remove from oven. Unprick. Drizzle with topping.

title: Threesomesauce for Fish, Vegetables and Almonds
ingredients: 250 g rolled oats | 50 g chopped walnuts | 1 red chili pepper, deseeded and deseeded
instructions: Soak the rolled oats in a mixture of cold water and a large pinch of salt for 10 minutes. Drain and place in a food processor. Process until they are well ground, pulsing regularly until they are the consistency of thick cream. Stir through the walnuts, chilli and season to taste. Store in a covered container.

Random Ingredients: garlic paste,bay leaf,cider vinegar,cucumber,black eyed pea,serrano chilies,feta cheese
title: Hoppin' Cucumber Salad
ingredients: 1 small cucumber, peeled | 1 can black-eyed peas, rinsed and drained | 2 serrano chilies | 3 dashes garlic paste | 1 bay leaf | 5 ounces crumbled feta cheese | 1/3 cup cider vinegar
instructions: Place the cucumber, black eyed peas, chilies, garlic paste, and bay leaf in a large bowl. Gently stir in cheese. Whisk together the vinegar and mustard. Drizzle over salad just before serving.

Random Ingredients: red curry paste,salmon,bean,garam masala,pineapple juice,ladyfinger,vanilla,cheddar cheese
title: Curried Bean Fish Pie
ingredients: 1 can baked beans ( i like the multi-colored ones on the bottom of one 13-oz. dish- i think they arent that deep ) | 2 cans crushed pineapple with juice | 2 tablespoons red curry paste ( i like mine very hot, but the kids love it ) | 3 tablespoons plain yogurt | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala | 3/4 cup cheddar cheese ( grated or finely crumbled ) | 13 ladyfingers | 1 teaspoon vanilla
instructions: Heat oven to in a large bowl, toss beans thoroughly with pineapple, paste, yogurt, garam masala, and 1/2 the cheese, and mix together until well combined. Spray a 13x9 glass dish or nonstick pan with nonstick spray. Line the bottom of the dish with 10 ladyfingers, keeping the ends free of the batter. Layer with 2nd slice of fish, top with sauce mixture, then the rest of cheese. Cover dish with foil and bake in a preheated oven 50 minute stir and top with remaining 10 ladyfingers, bake 15 minutes more.

Random Ingredients: cayenne,yellow squash,vegetable broth,white flour,lemonade,maraschino cherry,parsley flake
title: Southern Squash Soup
ingredients: 1 can veggie broth | 4 yellow squash, medium, peeled, cut into small pieces | 1/2 cup prepared lemonade | 3 teaspoons dried parsley flakes | 1 teaspoon cayenne | 2 tablespoons white flour | 1/4 cup maraschino cherry, chopped
instructions: Combine all ingredients except cherry in a crock pot and stir together. Sprinkle with cherries. Cover, set to low and cook for 4 hours. This soup will be soupy.

Random Ingredients: pinto bean,provolone cheese,green chili pepper,cardamom pod,cajun seasoning,chicken cube
title: Chef John's Refried Beans
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups dried pinto beans or cans pinto beans | 8 ounces provolone cheese or 8 ounces mozzarella cheese, cut into small cubes | 1 1/2 cups bottled chopped green chili peppers | 1 teaspoon cajun seasoning or 1 teaspoon chili powder | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom pod | 1 chicken cube, with seasoning removed ( optional )
instructions: Rinse the beans and separate the beans by breaking them into 2 inch pieces. Place them in a saucepan and add just enough cold water to cover by about 1 inch, about 2 inches above the beans. Bring to a boil over high heat, and then reduce heat to low. Cook, covered occasionally, over low heat until beans are tender and almost all the liquid has been absorbed. When beans are tender, remove from heat. Drain beans, and stir in all the filling ingredients. Cover and chill until ready to serve.

title: Greek Favourite Kidney Beans
ingredients: 2 cans tomato sauce | 2 teaspoons fennel seeds | 1 teaspoon sugar substitute | 3 lbs lamb kidneys or 3 lbs beef, cubed
instructions: Mix all ingredients, except kidneys, into crockpot. Add kidneys, cover and cook on low for 8 - 10 hours.

Random Ingredients: cumin,chicken bouillon cube,cherry tomato,scallion,beef brisket,enchilada sauce
title: Slow Baked Chili - Crock Pot
ingredients: 2 lbs beef brisket, trimmed | 3/4 cup enchilada sauce, divided | 2 cans hot cherry tomatoes, cut in halves | 3 cans stewed tomatoes, cut in chunks | 2 packages frozen chopped scallions | 2 tablespoons ground cumin | 3 chicken bouillon cubes
instructions: Place brisket in crock pot and pour enchilada sauce on top, reserving 1/2 cup. Pour tomatoes and green chilies evenly around the brisket. Sprinkle scallions and cumin on top. Add chicken bouillon, reserving juice from crock pot for later use. Cook on low for 7 to 8 hours or high for 5 to 6 hours, or until meat is fork tender. Remove brisket from cooker. Pull apart with two forks and slice across the grain, removing as many pieces as possible. Serve with corn tortillas and flour tortillas.

title: Homemade Steamed Meatballs
ingredients: 1 lb ground chuck | 2 1/2 cups icing sugar, sifted | 1 teaspoon fine sea salt or 1/4 teaspoon kosher salt
instructions: Put the chuck through the fine disk of a meat grinder with the finest blade. Add icing sugar and salt and mix everything well until it forms a ball around the blade. If the mixture is too liquid, let the meat rest for a moment until it starts to harden. Put the meat in an earthenware or aluminium foil lined colander, cover and put a weighted plate on top to keep from drying out. Cover the colander and leave in a warm place to dry out for 3 - 4 days, shaking the colander a couple time to collect excess moisture. At the end of this 3rd day, remove from the colander and place it on paper towels to drain. Keep in a cool place for up to 2 - 3 weeks.

Random Ingredients: green apple juice concentrate,allspice,watermelon,dark rum,vanilla pudding,beef roast,taco seasoning,tuna olive oil
title: Caribbean Pot Roast Delights
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs lean boneless beef roast | 1 package taco seasoning | 1/2 cup water ( reserved ) | 1 can tuna in olive oil | 1 can green apple juice concentrate ( or 3.5 oz canned pineapple juice, diluted with 3/4 cup water ) | 1/4 cup dark rum | 1/4 teaspoon allspice | 1/4 cup taco seasoning | 4 -5 cups watermelon slices ( i used the ones from a melon cobbler )
instructions: Place the steak & taco seasoning in a large ziploc bag & add the 4 ounces of tuna. Mix well & refrigerate for at least 2 hours covered with the taco seasoning,. Prep time does not include marinating time.

title: Pear Mirin
ingredients: 2 ounces mirin | 5 ounces pear, peeled, seeded, and diced
instructions: Place mirin and pear in a saucepan over low heat and bring up to a simmer. Cover and simmer for 8 minutes until the pear is tender. Remove from the heat and add the pears to the saucepan. Mix gently. Cool before serving.

title: Casserole (Low Cal Pumpkin Seeds & Cheese for Breakfast)
ingredients: 1 medium summer squash ( diced ) | 1 crusty french roll ( shredded ) | 6 -8 leaves fresh sage ( chopped ) | 8 -12 slices low fat mexican blend cheese ( sliced ) | 1/2 cup pumpkin seeds ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Lightly coat a casserole dish with cooking spray. Pour squash into skillet and cook over medium heat until tender, 2 - 3 minutes. Cool slightly. Grate squash into bowl, add sage and mash into squash with a fork. Mix in the cheese slices. Spoon mixture into casserole dish and bake until cheese is browned and bubbly, about 15 - 20 minutes. Serve topped with pumpkin seeds.

title: Hot Goat Cheese Enchiladas
ingredients: 1 package goat cheese, crumbled | 4 olives, chopped | 1 can enchilada sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a medium bowl, stir together goat cheese and olives. Heat the enchilada sauce in a medium saucepan over medium high heat. Pour about 1/3 of the cheese mixture into the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish. Roll tortilla with your fingers over the bottom of the tortilla to make a 1 inch wide enchilada. Fill the enchiladas with the remaining cheese mixture. Top with enchilada sauce. Cover dish with aluminum foil and refrigerate for 2 hours. Uncover dish, and bake for 30 minutes in the preheated oven. Remove from oven, and let stand for 10 to 15 minutes before serving.

title: Sautéed Vegetables for Canning
ingredients: 8 cups assorted fresh vegetables, cut into 1-inch cubes | 2 packets yellow squash jell-o, with spice
instructions: Fill a large plastic bag or colander with water.

Random Ingredients: cold water,tomato,green onion,avocado,pie crust,five spice powder,chocolate syrup
title: Elegant Baked Avocados
ingredients: 1 pie crust, for a 4-inch spring roll | 2 ripe avocados ( ripe ) | cold water | 5 -6 teaspoons chocolate syrup | 1 medium tomatoes ( ripe ) | 1 small green onion ( green parts only, thinly sliced ) | 1 teaspoon five-spice powder
instructions: Remove the peel from the avocados and cut off the pit. Cut the avocados in halves lengthwise then gently remove the pit. Dislodge the pit. Place the avocado flesh in a bowl of cold water. Use a spoon to mash the avocados to make sure they are soft. Drain well and set the avocado aside. In the other bowl of an electric mixer, beat the chocolate syrup with a pinch of salt until dissolved. Stir in the tomato, green onion and five spice powder. Place half of the cooled avocado mixture into each of the four spring roll pans. Spoon the chocolate sauce over the avocado layer. Sprinkle the remaining half of the spring roll pan over the sauce, and bake in a preheated 450 degree oven for 12 to 15 minutes, or until the top is lightly browned. Enjoy warm or room temperature with a cold beer.

Random Ingredients: horseradish,cream cheese,button mushroom,curry powder,coconut cream,lettuce leaf,coffee
title: Curried Mushroom Rolls
ingredients: 3 cups small button mushrooms | 6 ounces cream cheese | 1 tablespoon shredded coconut cream | 1 teaspoon prepared horseradish | 2 teaspoons instant coffee ( optional ) | 1/3 cup chopped coriander | 8 small lettuce leaves, washed
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine mushrooms, cream cheese, coconut cream, horseradish, and coffee. Scoop a tbsp for each roll, and wrap in lettuce leaves to resemble a taco. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: rice noodle,red pepper,jalapeno jack cheese,garam masala,deep frying oil,tea,watermelon,meat
title: Indian Rice Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 package fresh rice noodles ( any will do ) | 2 lbs meat or 2 lbs poultry ( any will do ) | 1 cup red pepper | 24 cups deep frying oil | 2 cups watermelon, cut in 1/4 slices ( i use frozen ) | 1 cup jalapeno jack cheese | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon garam masala | 1/4 cup tea
instructions: Cook rice noodles in hot oil until tender with drain. Set aside. Cut vegetables into small chunks. Dice cheese. Drain noodles. Make sure all noodles are cut in one inch pieces. Deep fry the noodles till golden. Set aside. Heat deep fryer to 400 degrees. Coat deep fryer with cooking spray. Place drained noodles into hot deep fryer. Place 1/4 cup vegetable mixture onto noodles. Add 1/4 cup cheese. Fold in all noodle cake ingredients. Turn noodles gently with tongs so mixture coats all noodles. Deep fry till golden brown. Set aside. Best if eaten a while warm.

title: Aash-E Shalgham
ingredients: 350 g spaghetti | 400 g wheat flour | 400 g russet potatoes | 150 g pine nuts, roasted | 150 ml milk | 50 g peanut butter
instructions: Soak the spaghetti in boiling water and cook until almost tender. Drain in a colander. Meanwhile, boil the potatoes until tender. Drain and mash them with the peanut butter, which should be quite creamy. Set aside. Make the flour the previous day, in a bowl, mix the flour in the milk. Peel the russet potatoes and cut into small pieces. Rinse the spaghetti in a large pot, and allow it to dry a bit. Cut up the potatoes lengthwise, add to the flour mix, and stir until everything is well mixed. Drain the spaghetti in a colander, and mix the noodles on a kitchen towel. Heat a bit of oil in a large pot. Dip the spaghetti into the flour mix and quickly fry it in the oil on medium heat until golden on the outside. Add more oil, if required. Serve the aash on a large plate with lots of extra flour.

title: Lime Sichuan Salt (Sichuan Mix)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons peppercorns | 1 tablespoon lime zest ( optional )
instructions: Crush the peppercorns using a mortar and pestle to coarsely grind. Stir in the lime zest. Keep in an airtight jar in a cool and dark place. Use in marinating food and decorate dishes, such as a paste.

title: Russian Party Punch
ingredients: 1 1/2 liters of strong espresso, hot | 350 g raspberries, chilled ( optional ) | 2 tomatoes, finely diced | 1 bunch radish, sliced | fresh sliced speckled radish ( optional )
instructions: Sieve the espresso into a large jug with a pouring spout. Stir in raspberries and tomatoes. Let cool slightly. Strain through a fine sieve. Divide among punch glasses or martini glasses. Top with smoked speckled radishes. Optional variations, to add to each glass the optional optional garnish, peaches, pears, dates, etc.

title: Totally Kettle's Apple Meatball Soup
ingredients: 1 package turkey kielbasa ( about 2 pounds ) | 1 can light healthy request fruit chutney ( chutney is also great ) | 4 cups half-and-half | 1 tablespoon vanilla ice cream | 1 apple, cut into 1/2-inch cubes ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees f. Cut kielbasa into 1/4 inch pieces. Place the chicken and turkey kielbasa in a 9x13 baking dish. Spread the chutney on the kielbasa. In a medium saucepan, combine half and half and the vanilla ice cream. Bring to a boil, then remove from the heat and stir in the apples. Let stand for about 15 minutes, then pour the apple mixture over the kielbasa. Cover and bake for 1 hour, stirring every 15 minutes. If using apple cubes, remove the pits and add to the soup.

Random Ingredients: bamboo shoot,cashew,rump roast,heirloom tomato,almond paste,hazelnut liqueur,almond
title: Heirloom Tomato Barbecue
ingredients: 1 box sliced almonds | 1 1/4 pounds rump roast | 1 jar almond paste | 1 can reduced-sodium cashews | 1 cup hazelnuts | 2 cans diced heirloom tomatoes | 1 cup almond paste | 2 jars cashews | 1 cup hazelnuts, coarsely chopped
instructions: Preheat an outdoor grill for medium high heat, and lightly oil grate. Cook the almonds until lightly browned and fragrant, stirring several times. Set aside. Cut the roast into 3/4 inch cubes and place into a resealable bag. Place the bag with almonds into a blender and blend until finely ground, about 5 seconds. Mixture can also be made by hand by cooking with the bag.

title: Low-Fat, Low Cal, Low Cal Breakfast Tacos
ingredients: 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon granules | 1 -2 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 8 -10 low-carb tortillas
instructions: In a large jug, combine the water, bouillon granules, and bicarb of soda. Add a few spoonfuls of the mixture to one side of each tortilla. Fold over the two sides and heat up on a griddle or frying pan. Alternatively, you can leave the tortillas with a little fatback in the middle to cook on. When brown on both sides you have to use a paper towel to remove excess grease. Allow to cool slightly before cutting.

title: Beef and Vege Stew With Nuts
ingredients: 1/2 - 3/4 lb sirloin | 1/2 - 3/4 lb sirloin | 1/2 cup bamboo shoot | 1 can evaporated watermelon or ( 50 g ) can chunk-free watermelon | 1/2 teaspoon espresso powder | 1/2 teaspoon ginger | 1/4 cup frozen beetroot | 1/2 teaspoon instant espresso powder | 1/2 cup canned sliced watermelon
instructions: Trim fat and cut meat into 3/4 inch cubes. Cut bamboo shoot in half, lengthwise then slice into 1 inch lengths. Remove skin from beef. Cut into 3/4 thick strips. Using 3 tbs beef drippings, saute beef, bamboo pieces and beetroot in drippings over medium heat untill beef is cooked. Add ground espresso powder and 1/2 cup water. Boil 1 minute. Add 3/4 cup water and 1/2 tsp espresso powder. Cover and simmer 30 minutes. Stir in 3/4 cup each of snow peas, peas, & beets. Cook about 20 minutes more.

Random Ingredients: splenda brown sugar,chicken breast,cheddar,lasagna noodle,broccoli,hamburger bun,taro root,tomato basil garlic oregano
title: Baked Chicken
ingredients: 1 package lasagna noodles | 1 lb chicken breast, cooked or thinly sliced | 1 lb hamburger bun | 1 lb broccoli | 3 -4 large taro root ( or 2 frozen cut broccoli spears, thawed ) | 1 can diced tomatoes with basil garlic and oregano | 1 package splenda brown sugar blend | 2 cups cheddar or 2 cups jalapeno slices
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f grease bottomed casserole dish. Cook lasagne as per package directions. Meanwhile, cook chicken and hamburger.

Random Ingredients: pearl barley,icing sugar,rose petal,yellow pepper,peppercorn,chicken sausage,wild rice,onion salt
title: Wild Rice Rice and Sausage Skewers #RSC
ingredients: 2 packages chicken sausage, links | 1 medium yellow pepper | 1 medium sweet pepper | 2 boxes boxed brown rice, uncooked | 1 box pearl barley ( i use barley flour instead of box barley ) | 1 teaspoon peppercorn, mixed in | 3 - 4 teaspoons icing sugar | 1/4 teaspoon onion salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Cut the sausages into 1 inch pieces. Put the brown rice in your food processor. Cut the yellow pepper and sweet pepper in 1 inch pieces. Cut the sasages into 1 inch pieces. Cut the chicken sausage into 1 inch pieces. Combine all ingredients except the icing sugar, and mix until well combined. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Form the mixture into 1 inch logs.. Place logs on the pan and bake for 20 - 25 minutes. Remove carefully from the oven and remove the parchment paper. Turn the oven off. Place skewers on the parchment paper and cover with a towel and place in the fridge for at least 2 hours. Remove skewer and place the finished skewers on a serving plate. Remove excess oil from the pan. Take 1 box of pearl barley and place in pan. Place the warm rice and sausages in the rice and sausages. Dot with cinnamon and sprinkle with icing sugar.

title: Saffron Ravioli
ingredients: 3 cups saffron threads | 2 cups orange peel, cut in 1-inch strips | 2 teaspoons garlic powder | 2 teaspoons chili powder | 3 lbs fresh ravioli
instructions: Remove rind from saffron threads. Place in small bowl, cover with enough warm water to cover and refrigerate overnight until softened. Drain the rind and use to moisten ravioli. Set aside. Combine in small bowl, garlic powder, chili powder, and half of the saffron threads. Place in small saucer or ziplock bag and sprinkle with remaining saffron threads. Toss to coat. Bring 10 cups water to boil in heavy large skillet. Stir in ravioli and cook 3 - 3 minutes or until just tender. Drain and keep warm. Repeat with the remaining ravioli.

title: Luxury Lasagna
ingredients: 9 asparagus, trimmed and cut crosswise into 1/2-inch pieces | 1 package uncooked spaghetti | 1 tablespoon cider vinegar | 1 teaspoon cream of tartar | 2 cups dry madeira wine | 3 tablespoons corn, minced | 9 lasagna noodles
instructions: Cook spaghetti according to package directions.

title: Alfredo
ingredients: 12 1/2 ounces processed cheese | green food coloring
instructions: Slice processed cheese in half and place on waxed paper paper, until soft. You may need to chill the processed cheese under cold running water until set, about 15 minutes. Place processed cheese back into wax paper lined mold, cover and refrigerate until set, about 5 hours.

title: Chinese Coleslaw
ingredients: 2 cups shredded chinese cabbage | 2 tablespoons buttermilk | 3 tablespoons minced canola or canola oil, divided | 3 cans green chilies, drained | 1 tablespoon creole seasoning or ( - 1 1/2 tsp ) other seasonings
instructions: Place cooked coleslaw in a large salad bowl. In a small bowl mix buttermilk, 2/3 of the chilies, hot sauce and creole seasoning. Pour over coleslaw and toss. Refrigerate for up to 1 day.

Random Ingredients: coriander sprig,brown sugar,green onion,cocoa powder,kiwi fruit
title: Chocolate Kiwi Fruit Dip
ingredients: 2 kiwi fruits, peeled and finely chopped | 4 green onions, minced | 1/2 cup unsweetened cocoa powder | 1/3 cup brown sugar | 1/4 cup coriander sprigs, chopped
instructions: Combine kiwifruit, green onions, cocoa powder, brown sugar and coriander sprigs in a serving dish. Cover and refrigerate until serving.

Random Ingredients: farfalle pasta,lemon juice zest,icing sugar,cumin seed,sultana
title: Flamme Fruit and Nut Pasta
ingredients: 250 g farfalle pasta ( bowtie pasta ) | 2 cups sultanas ( golden raisins ) | 1 cup of good lemon juice, freshly squeezed | 1 cup icing sugar ( confectioners'sugar ) | 1 -2 teaspoon cumin seed, toasted and crushed ( optional )
instructions: Bring water to a boil, salt it and then add farfalle and allow to cook for 10 - 11 minutes until al dente. In the meantime, mix lemon juice, sultanas and icing sugar together and set aside until time to boil. Drain farfalle and put it back in the pot and add the lemon, sultanas and cumin seed. Put it back on high heat and boil for 5 - 7 minutes until you can smell the nutty nutty flavour. Drain farfalle and put it back on heat, stir until all the ingredients are mixed well.

title: Frescavena
ingredients: 6 large red ripe tomatoes, peeled, seeded and coarsely chopped ( about 1 1/3 cups ) | 1/2 cup corn oil | 1 1/3 tablespoons golden syrup
instructions: Place the tomatoes in a 3 quart saucepan just large enough to hold them in a single layer. Add the corn oil, golden syrup and 1 teaspoon salt and heat to boiling, then simmer uncovered for 10 minutes. Remove from the heat and, holding the tomatoes under running water, immediately immerse them in the hot syrup. Carefully peel the tomato skins, cut off the tops with a knife and reserve them in the syrup. Gently place them in a bowl containing ice cubes and let the tomatoes stand at room temperature while you finish cooking them. Transfer the tomatoes to a large bowl, cover with plastic wrap and set aside for 5 to 10 minutes to cool. Pour out the excess oil and pass through a fine sieve into a clean bowl or, if using wooden spoons, press it through a fine sieve. Serve chilled.

title: French Fruit Salad With Pineapple Vinaigrette
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups fresh pineapple juice | 1/3 cup creme fraiche | 1/2 cup snow peas, trimmed
instructions: To serve, place a serving plate on a serving plate.

title: Gasconzola
ingredients: 4 cups soft cream of tartar | 1/2 cup anise seed | 1/4 cup brandy
instructions: Place cream of tartar in a large bowl, and beat with an electric mixer until very thick, about 10 minutes. Stir in anise seed, then set aside. Strain cream, and discard any excess liquid. Cool cream slightly, but stir in grated anise seed and brandy. Pour into molds, and refrigerate until chilled, at least 2 hours. Serve with truffles or other pastries for dipping.

title: Simple Fried Kale
ingredients: 1 bunch kale, washed and dried | 2 tablespoons feta cheese | 1 cup oil for frying | 12 fluid ounces hot sauce ( optional )
instructions: Place kale in a bowl with enough cold water to cover. Place in microwave and cook on high 2 to 3 minutes, or until tender. Drain. While kale is cooking, combine feta cheese and olive oil in a small frying pan. Heat over low heat and stir continuously until cheese is melted. Remove from heat. Cut kale into 1-inch pieces. Using a slotted spoon, transfer to a separate bowl. Stir hot sauce into cheese mixture.

Random Ingredients: baking potato,scotch bonnet pepper,red onion,coconut milk
title: Caribbean Potato Soup
ingredients: 2 large baking potatoes, peeled | 1 red onion, chopped | 1 scotch bonnet pepper, chopped | 3 cans coconut milk
instructions: Place the potato in a large pot with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil, then simmer until soft. Place the potato, onion, scotch bonnet pepper, and coconut milk into a blender, and puree until smooth. Reheat the soup for serving.

Random Ingredients: extra virgin olive oil,cashew,white mushroom,crab,baby carrot,ginger
title: Japanese Mushroom and Crab Stuffed Mushrooms
ingredients: 2 cups baby carrots, peeled ( about 3 cups ) | 2 cups small white mushrooms | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil ( for frying ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground ginger | 1 cup raw cashews ( about 6 ounces or use walnuts or pecan pieces ) | 10 medium crab, cleaned
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees, and prepare carrots. Cut a thin slice from the top just below the base of each mushroom. Place the bottom of each mushroom on a square of aluminum foil. Place the carrots in a steamer basket over boiling water. Cover and cook until just tender, about 4 minutes, then use a slotted spoon to transfer the carrots to a bowl of cold water for a few minutes until cool. Transfer the carrots to a large bowl and set aside. Drain the baby carrots and save for another meal. Finely chop the caps and set aside. Peel the mushrooms and cut them into 1/2 pieces. In a deep skillet, heat the olive oil over high heat, then add the ginger. When the ginger starts to sizzle, add the carrot caps. Stir fry for 3 to 4 minutes, then add the nuts. Stir fry for about 2 minutes, then add the crab and the cooked mushrooms along with their juices. Stir fry for about 4 to 5 minutes, then remove and discard the crab. Carefully slip the mushrooms off the foil and arrange evenly on a baking dish. Stir the eggs and pile them into the carrots and mushroom mixture. Cover the mushrooms with the cashews and bake for 15 minutes or until hot.

title: Peanut Vodka Rice
ingredients: 1 cup dry basmati rice, rinsed | 2 cups peanut butter ( not creamy ) | 1/2 cup vodka | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh italian parsley | 1/2 teaspoon salt and ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Place rice in the bowl of a blender.

title: Oyster Pie Crust
ingredients: 1 can refrigerated cherry pie filling, chilled | 1 1/2 tablespoons chopped italian parsley | 1/2 cup cold crushed ice
instructions: Combine fresh cherry pie filling, parsley, and ice in a mixing bowl.

Random Ingredients: green cardamom pod,green cabbage,burgundy wine,walnut half,eggplant,pine nut
title: Eggplant (Aubergine) and Cabbage Kebabs
ingredients: 2 large eggplants, cut into quarters | 2 lbs green cabbage, shredded | 1 lb green cabbage | 3 1/2 ounces walnut halves | 6 slices pine nuts | 6 green cardamom pods | 2 1/2 tablespoons burgundy wine or 2 1/2 tablespoons dry white wine
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f. Arrange eggplant on baking paper lined cookie sheet.

Random Ingredients: lamb chop,natural peanut butter,chili pepper flake
title: Lamb Chops in Peanut Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons natural peanut butter | 4 lamb chops | 1 pinch chili pepper flakes ( or to taste )
instructions: Place peanut butter in a small bowl and stir in the chili pepper flakes. Coat pork chops with the dipping sauce. Heat a little oil in a hot frying pan and fry the chops quickly over a medium heat. Serve hot, with the dipping sauce.

title: Blueberry and Apricot Beef Skillet
ingredients: 1 lb lean boneless beef, cut into 1-inch cubes | 3 1/2 ounces dried apricots, coarsely chopped | 10 ounces blueberries
instructions: In 10 inch skillet, cook beef and apricots over medium heat in 1/3 cup hot water about 8 minutes, stirring occasionally, until beef is just tender.

Random Ingredients: bell pepper,taco seasoning mix,chili garlic sauce,button mushroom,green chilies
title: Microwave Spicy Chili Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 bell pepper, cut into chunks | 1 package button mushrooms ( regular size ) | 1 can chopped green chilies | 1 packet taco seasoning mix ( i prefer the taco seasoning mix ) | sweet chili-garlic sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients in one microwave safe bowl. Cover with plastic wrap and microwave on high for 3 minutes.. Open microwave, pour salsa over top and enjoy with tortilla chips, veggies. Please note, the longer you leave the microwave on high in the bowl the milder it will be.

title: Orange Spiced Cheese for Tea
ingredients: 1 package refrigerated cheese blend, with celery | 1/2 cup orange juice | 1 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1 dash turmeric powder | 1 dash white sugar | 1/2 cup red currant preserves or 1/2 cup dried cranberries, chopped
instructions: Combine all sauce ingredients in medium saucepan. Cook over medium heat.

title: Pancake Nabe(Vegetarian)
ingredients: 2 cups green maraschino cherries | 3/4 cup chopped blanched almonds or 3/4 cup sliced almonds | 3/4 cup chopped blanched almond ( or slivered almonds ) | 1 teaspoon cherry extract | 2 cups bean sprouts | 1 teaspoon dried currant
instructions: Combine candied cherries, almonds, almond extract and bean sprouts. Let sit for at least two hours before shaking the pan to redistribute fruits. The idea is that the nuts will release their juices too. Variation, to serve, add a small amount of apricot preserves to each plate. Top with fruits or nuts.

Random Ingredients: vanilla extract,rosemary,arborio rice,pecan,creme de cassis,rib beef,mascarpone cheese,quinoa
title: Grilled Short-ribs With Grilled Parmesan-Cassis Rice
ingredients: 3 ribs of beef | 1 1/2 cups arborio rice ( about 13 ounces ) | 2 cups creme de cassis | 2 tablespoons creme de cassis | 1 cup mascarpone cheese or 1 cup cream cheese, room temperature | 1 teaspoon pure vanilla extract | 1 3/4 cups coarsely chopped toasted pecans ( about 10 pecan pieces, about 11 to 13 cups ) | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh rosemary
instructions: Prepare grill pan. Trim shortribs of excess fat. If desired, line a grill rack with aluminum foil, and position the shortribs on the foil. Prepare grill pan.. Place rice on grill rack, and grill 5 to 7 minutes over direct heat. Turn, and grill another 5 minutes to reach desired doneness. While rice is cooking, prepare cream cheese according to the package directions, adding creme de cassis until soft smooth. Beat mascarpone cheese and vanilla in a small bowl until smooth, about 5 minutes. Spread the mascarpone mixture over the grilled shortribs, leaving a 1/2 to 1/2 inch edge on the shortribs. Sprinkle pecans over shortribs, and add rosemary, and top with another 1/2 to 1/2 inch border of shortribs. Close the grill. Grill shortribs until just beginning to curl, about 5 minutes. If desired, grill pan, uncovered, about 2 to 3 minutes. Alternatively, grill pan and shortribs on grill rack until grill marks appear, about 5 minutes per side. Turn off grill and set aside 5 to 6 minutes. Brush grilling pan with olive oil. Place shortribs on grate, brush top with oil, and grill until tops are a shade darker in even color, about 5 minutes per side. Cut shortribs into slices.

title: Homemade Taco Dip With White Cheese
ingredients: 1 package cream cheese, softened | 1 package dried taco seasoning, or 3 tablespoons taco seasoning | 1 teaspoon toasted sesame oil | 1 teaspoon ground allspice | 1 package shredded american cheese
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix the cream cheese and taco seasoning with an electric mixer. Stir in the sesame oil and allspice. Stir in 1 package of the shredded cheese, and mix until the mixture is crumbly and smooth. Transfer to a serving dish, and refrigerate until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: icing sugar,saltine cracker,cannellini bean,sun tomato oil
title: Cannellini Bean Cookies
ingredients: 1 can cannellini beans ( drained and rinsed and mashed with 1/2 cup bean liquid ) | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon icing sugar ( to taste ) or 1/2-1 teaspoon granular artificial sweetener ( to taste ) | 3/4 cup finely crushed saltine crackers | 1 -2 teaspoon sun-dried tomato packed in oil, chopped
instructions: Combine everything except for the sun dried tomatoes in a bowl and blend thoroughly. Shape into 1 balls. Flatten each piece with the bottom of a glass or biscuit/coffee/sugar spoon. Set aside on a dish or platter. Sprinkle lightly with additional icing sugar or sun dried tomatoes to taste and serve cold with butter chunks.

Random Ingredients: sharp cheddar cheese,peanut butter,chipotle chile,green onion,date,sirloin steak,popcorn,mango
title: Spicy Beef Rolls
ingredients: 24 ounces sirloin steaks | 1 can diced mangoes, drained and chopped | 1 cup frozen chopped dates, thawed | 1/4 cup peanut butter | 2 tablespoons chopped chipotle chiles | 1 green onion, thinly sliced | 1/4 cup shredded sharp cheddar cheese | 1 cup popcorn, popped
instructions: Trim excess fat from steak meat.

Random Ingredients: sauce,cashew nut,red pepper,cumin powder,basmati rice,green chili
title: Basmati Rice & Cashew Nuts
ingredients: 4 cups cooked basmati rice or 4 cups basmati rice, washed and drained | 1 green chili, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon cumin powder | 1/4 teaspoon red pepper | 2 -3 tablespoons hot sauce | 2 1/2 tablespoons cashew nuts, roasted and chopped
instructions: Saute cashew nuts in oil on medium flame. Keep aside. Heat remaining oil and stir fry the green chili/chilli with cashews. When green chillies is slightly brown remove it from fire. Keep aside. Pour 1 - 2 tbsps. Of oil in an oven proof dish. Now add the rice, green chilli paste and remaining ingredients, except cashew nuts. Mix well. Spread mixture in oven proof dish. Sprinkle cashew nuts over this mixture. Cover tightly. Cook on high flame for 15 minutes.

title: Prosciutto Wrapped Peanuts
ingredients: 5 cups broth | 16 slices prosciutto ( thin slices ) | 4 cups coarsely chopped skinned peanuts, or more to taste | 2 tablespoons chopped orange peel
instructions: Fill a large pot with water and bring to a boil. Rinse peanuts with cold water and drain well. Stir enough broth into peanuts to cover them. Bring to a rolling boil.

title: Hot Marsala Wine II
ingredients: 1 bottle marsala wine | 1 teaspoon italian seasoning
instructions: Combine marmalade, and mealy wine in a mug. Stir.

Random Ingredients: rum,confectioner sugar,raspberry jam,iceberg lettuce,celery rib,tortilla,red pepper paste
title: Raspberry Colada
ingredients: 1 container seedless raspberry jam | 2 large celery ribs, thinly sliced | 1 large ripe red pepper paste | 8 -10 tortillas | 1 small ripe romaine lettuce, chopped | 2 cups confectioners'sugar | 1 1/2 fluid ounces rum ( optional )
instructions: Combine the jam and celery in a small saucepan over medium heat. Cook 10 minutes, stirring frequently, until the celery has softened and the liquids have evaporated. Remove from the heat and add red pepper paste. Spread a layer of tortillas on a plate. Heat a few spoonfuls of the jam mixture along one side of the tortilla, then fold tortillios toward the jam. Repeat with remaining tortillas and mixture. Remove from heat, cover, and let stand 20 minutes. Serve warm sprinkled with confectioners' sugar, if desired.

Random Ingredients: steak,saltine cracker,apple juice,rye flour,green onion,plain flour,snow pea,ham
title: Simmered Swiss Steak
ingredients: 12 ounces low fat steak | 2 tablespoons plain flour | 1/2 teaspoon saltine crackers, crushed | 8 ounces fresh snow peas, trimmed and halved | 1/4 cup apple juice | 4 ounces fat-free ham, chopped | 1 green onion, finely sliced and cut into 2 pieces, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Coat steak with flour, saltines and crackers. Place snow peas on a baking tray lined with baking paper and place in 450f oven while steaks soak. Heat oven to 350f / 220c / gas mark lightly grease roasting tin with 2 tbsp oil. Place steaks in tin and bake for 35 mins or until cooked to your liking. Remove steaks from pan and set aside and keep warm. Add the apple juice to the pan and cook over medium heat for 2 - 3 mins, until liquid is reduced by half. Drain steak and peas reserving juice. Return steak, peas and apple juice to the pan stir in the ham and onions. Spoon over the steamed beans and serve immediately.

title: Easy Italian Enchilada Pizza
ingredients: 2 loaves pizzas | 1 lb bulk italian sausage | 1 lb sirloin | 1 can enchilada sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Brown the sausage and add the meat. Drain grease and stir in the enchilada sauce. Let it simmer for about 15 - 20 minutes. Spread the sauce on both top of the pizza crust and on the bottom. Then place the meat in the oven for the last 5 minutes or so. Cut the pizza into two slices then put a tooth pick through it for added flavor.

title: Irish Colcannon Colcannon
ingredients: 2 lbs frying chickens, cut into serving pieces ( i keep the small chicken pieces in the freezer ) | 1 1/2 cups light almond milk ( or to taste ) | 1 1/2 cups light beer ( such as guinness or tecate ) | 1/2 cup rice vinegar | 2 -3 large savoy cabbage
instructions: Rinse and quarter the cabbage. Place the chicken in a large pot. Add milk, beer and vinegar. Bring to a boil. Cover, reduce heat slightly and simmer slowly until chicken is cooked through, about 45 minutes. Note, i keep one small chicken breast for my son to poach before serving, so if you have no problem with skinless chicken, leave the breast whole and cut across the breastbone into bite sized pieces if desired. Remove pot from heat, discard boneless skin and cut into tiny pieces.

Random Ingredients: vanilla extract,tomato sauce,parma ham,louisiana sauce,aluminum foil
title: Louisiana Parma
ingredients: 2 parma ham ( or other smoked ham ) | flaked aluminum foil | 1 can tomato sauce | 1/2 teaspoon real vanilla extract | 2 tablespoons louisiana hot sauce or 2 tablespoons favorite steak sauce
instructions: Bake at 400 degrees for 15 - 20 minutes. While the oven is heating up mix tomato sauce with warm sauce in small bowl. Cut the ham off the foil and remove the slices of ham. Spoon tomato/sauce mixture on top of ham and bake for 15 - 20 minutes, until ham is bubbly on top. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: tangerine juice,ham,chili pepper flake,self rising flour,bacon,anchovy paste
title: Tangerine Ham and Bacon Rolls
ingredients: 500 g self-rising flour | 250 g bacon or 250 g margarine | 200 g tangerine juice ( from about 1 whole tangerine ) | 2 tablespoons anchovy paste | 1/4 teaspoon chili pepper flakes | 1 teaspoon tangerine juice | 1 teaspoon dried chili pepper flakes, crushed
instructions: Preheat oven to 180c/360f. Place the flour, bacon etc, tangerine juice, anchovy paste and chili flakes in a blender or processor and pulse to combine. Add the tangerine juice and puree smooth. Add salt and pepper to taste. Turn dough out on to a lightly floured board and roll gently to 3cm thick. Using a sharp knife, cut the dough into 4cm squares. Place a generous amount of filling in the centre of each square and fold over. Place on a lightly greased baking paper. Bake in oven for 15 - 20 minutes, or until golden brown.

title: Blueberry Cheese With Roquefort
ingredients: 1 package roquefort cheese | 1/2 cup blueberries
instructions: Thoroughly crumble cheese and toss with blueberries. Serve immediately.

title: Grandma's Italian Romaine
ingredients: 1 head romaine lettuce | 1 can red kidney beans, drained
instructions: Shred the romaine lettuce into 1 1/2 pieces. Mix it up really well in a salad bowl. Spoon the kidney beans on top, and toss in the dressing. Stir well.

Random Ingredients: active yeast,palm sugar,colby monterey jack cheese,green chile
title: Tex Mex Cheese Bread #2
ingredients: 4 cups white whole milk or 4 cups low-fat milk | 2 tablespoons active dry yeast | 2 tablespoons palm sugar | 1/2 cup shredded colby-monterey jack cheese
instructions: In a medium saucepan, heat milk to 120°f on the stove. In a small bowl, mix together yeast and sugar, and add the warm milk. Add the yeast mixture and cook for 5 minutes. Place a metal bowl on a warm burner that has been coated with butter or margarine and allow to simmer about 10 minutes. Stir in cheese and remove from heat. Pour into a greased 9 x 5 inch loaf pan. Bake at 450°f for 50 - 55 minutes.

title: Wendy's Mushroom Hot-N' Hot Remedy
ingredients: 10 button mushrooms ( sliced, or use fresh button mushrooms ) | 1/2 red bell pepper, diced ( optional ) | 2 jalapeno peppers, diced ( optional )
instructions: In a large skillet cook mushroom slices with a bit of oil or margarine, until they are browned, but still firm. Add bell pepper and jalapeños and cook another 5 minutes. Serve imediately.

Random Ingredients: walnut,bread crumb,olive oil cooking spray,fontina cheese,lime leaf
title: Crispy Mexican Monkey Bread
ingredients: olive oil flavored cooking spray | 4 slices fontina cheese | 1 cup walnut pieces, toasted | 1 tablespoon sliced lime leaves | 1 cup dry bread crumbs, or as needed
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Spray a 1 1/2 quart baking dish with cooking spray. Line the bottom and sides of the baking dish with a circle of parchment paper. Pour olive oil into a bowl. Place a slice of fontina cheese or toasted walnut into the bowl. Dip the sandwich with olive oil in the oil, then bread crumbs. Top with bread crumbs to cover and pinch off crumbly bits of cheese on top. Bake in the preheated oven until bread crumbs are golden brown and cheese is beginning to caramelize, about 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: chuck roast,onion powder,golden syrup,cream cheese,white bread
title: Quick 'n-Easy Beef Dip
ingredients: 2 lbs chuck roast | 1 package cream cheese | 1/2 cup golden syrup | 1 teaspoon onion powder | 2 loaves thick white bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Trim excess fat from meat.

title: Chinese Chili Sauce
