ingredients: 2 tablespoons chopped gingerroot | 10 chipotle chiles | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1 cup mayonnaise | 1 1/2 cups light cream or 1 1/2 cups light mayonnaise | 1/4 cup vinegar, of your choice | 1 teaspoon dried oregano | 1/4 cup cocoa | peanut oil or other neutral flavored oil
instructions: Combine the ingredients in the blender, and puree until smooth. For thicker sauce, mix cream of mushroom soup with low fat mayo. For thinner sauce, mix mayonnaise, cream of chicken soup with the vinegar. Combine with other ingredients in a large bowl. Scoop into hot oil. This keeps a long time in the fridge, because the mayonnaise tends to split in half.

title: Texas Pralines
ingredients: 4 cups coarsely chopped pecans | 1/4 cup dark rum | 1/2 teaspoon paprika
instructions: Crumble pecans and place on a baking sheet. In a bowl, combine rum, paprika, and pecans. Pour over pecans and toss until evenly coated.

title: Garlic Green Olives
ingredients: 4 -5 garlic cloves, slivered | 2 cans green olives ( i use the ones in the jar ) | cinnamon, to sprinkle
instructions: Place garlic in a bowl and add the olives. Sprinkle with cinnamon. Store in the fridge.

Random Ingredients: dijon mustard,ginger juice,brandy,hash brown,rice wine,romaine lettuce,vegetable broth,egg yolk
title: Chinese Potato Pancakes
ingredients: 8 ounces hash browns | 3 cups vegetable broth | 1 tablespoon rice wine | 1 teaspoon dijon mustard | 1 teaspoon ginger juice | 1 egg yolk, lightly beaten | 2 teaspoons brandy | 2/3 cup romaine lettuce, coarsely chopped
instructions: Prepare pancakes, preheat oven to 350°f. Heat broth to boiling and add potatoes. Return to a boil and cook for 8 - 10 minutes, until the potatoes are fork tender. Drain and set aside. Prepare the filling, bring the stock to boil. Stir in rice wine, mustard and ginger in a small bowl. Whisk the egg yolk in a small bowl, then slowly beat in the brandy. Stir the egg yolk mix into the stock mixture. When the soup is cooked, stir in the cheese and lettuce. Spoon a small amount of the hot filling on the center of the pancake and fold them around it to close it. Serve hot.

title: Brothy Beef Dry Mustard
ingredients: 1 cup yellow mustard | 1 tablespoon prepared yellow mustard | roasted deli brothy beef or deli ham
instructions: Line broiler pan with foil and brush with yellow mustard. Broil until lightly golden, about 1 minute. Spread mustard mixture in broiler pan near meat and sprinkle with the brothybeef.

title: Double Chocolate Pita Bread Rounds #5FIX
ingredients: 1 package mini chocolate chips | 1 egg | 1 teaspoon dry mustard | 1 package pita bread, cut into triangles
instructions: In med saucepan, melt chocolate chips. Stir in remaining ingredients. Bring to boil. Remove from heat.

title: Colcannon and Chicken
ingredients: 6 medium chicken breasts | 1 green cabbage, finely chopped | 3 tablespoons self-raising flour | parsley, to serve
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees. Place chicken breasts in a baking dish, and bake for 20 minutes, turning and basting twice. Remove from oven and set aside for 5 minutes. In a large bowl, mix together the veg and flour until well mixed. Remove chicken from the oven, and add half of the carrot's shredded cabbage to the veg mixture and stir until well blended. Return chicken to the oven for a further 5 minutes, turning once during cooking. Arrange the chicken mixture over the chicken, and return to the oven. Bake for 1 hour, or until golden brown.

title: Spoon-Ahead Rice and Sweet Corn Pudding W-Pierogies (No Churros)
ingredients: 1 package instant polenta, such as jiffy | 1 package instant vanilla pudding mix, such as jiffy | 1 package frozen mixed baby corn, thawed | 1/3 cup rice vinegar | 1 cup instant rice vinegar | 1 package frozen sliced pierogies
instructions: Prepare instant polenta according to package directions. While polenta is baking, cut 2 plates for the sweet corn and set aside. Using a food processor, combine the sweet corn, rice vinegar and rice vinegar. Process to form a creamy puree. Place drained piepies in the bowl of a food processor or blender with the sweet corn mixture. Pulse until well mixed. Spread mixture into a 2 to 3 quart baking dish, and cover the top with cling film. Freeze while making the rice pudding. To complete the pudding, uncover, remove plastic film and refrigerate pudding until chilled, about 8 hours. While the pudding is chilling, cut remaining polenta into 1/2 inch cubes, then set aside. Using a fork, remove polenta from freezer and add sweet corn puree, rice vinegar and pierogies. Remove polenta from the freezer, and stir until thoroughly combined. Serve pudding w/pierogies for a traditional table presentation.

title: Biscuits or Sugar Cookies
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups icing sugar | 1 cup cornflour
instructions: Cream icing sugar, corn flour and a drop of water. Stir until smooth. You can decorate this with coloured sugar as desired. Keep in a cool bowl for up to 1 week.

Random Ingredients: chunky salsa,mexican chocolate,salt black pepper,salad green,lettuce,parmigiano,phyllo pastry,pine nut
title: Cara's Grilled Quesadillas
ingredients: 1/2 cup chunky salsa | 2 tablespoons miniature mexican chocolate chips | salt and ground black pepper to taste | 1 package frozen miniature phyllo pastry, thawed | 1 cup shredded lettuce | 1 cup chopped, fresh italian cheese blend | 1/4 cup pine nuts, toasted | 1/2 cup shredded parmigiano
instructions: Pour chunky salsa and mexican chocolate chips into a bowl and mash until creamy, breaking up any lumps as your mix stands. Set aside. Place phyllo pastry on a floured work surface and cut until the pastry is roughly the size of your hand. Working with 1 piece at a time, gently brush the tops with a little cold water and stack over a damp kitchen towel. Repeat with 1 sheet of phyllo at a time and then using damp cloth as needed to prevent drying. Lightly brush both sides of each stack with water and set aside until all of the phyllo is stacked on the work surface. Preheat grill for medium heat, or if using a metal grill rack set inside a shallow pan. Place 2 sheets of phyllo on a work surface and lightly brush with water.

Random Ingredients: salt pork,part ricotta cheese,ham,allspice,onion seed,plain flour,black,fettuccine
title: Alfredo with Ham and Fettuccini
ingredients: 3 tablespoons salt pork, shredded | 2 ounces ham, chopped | 1/3 cup onion, diced | 2 tablespoons plain flour | 1 teaspoon ground black | 1 teaspoon ground allspice | 4 ounces part-skim ricotta cheese | 16 ounces cooked fettuccine, drained
instructions: Saute salt pork in olive oil for 2 minutes. Add ham and onion and cook until onion is soft, about 5 minutes. Add flour, mix and cook for a few seconds. Add spices, cook for 1 minute. Add ricotta, cook for several minutes, stirring constantly. Pour onto warmed pasta and serve warm.

Random Ingredients: oat bran,pineapple chunk,bay leaf,dark sesame oil,cocoa powder
title: Pineapple, Walnut or Dutch Oat Bran Mix
ingredients: 2 cups oat bran | 1/3 cup dark sesame oil | 2 slices fresh pineapple chunks | 1 bay leaf | 2 tablespoons cocoa powder
instructions: Pour all ingredients into a food processor and process to a smooth and moist mixture. Store in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: buttermilk,poblano chile,asparagus spear,chicken bouillon cube,amaretto,balsamic vinegar
title: Clam Sauce with Asparagus
ingredients: 8 fresh asparagus spears, trimmed | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 1 canned fire roasted poblano chile, drained | 2 -3 chicken bouillon cubes | 2 tablespoons amaretto ( almond flavored liqueur ) | 3 tablespoons buttermilk
instructions: Place the asparagus spears in a bowl and pour boiling water over them to cover the asparagus. This will cook them for 2 minutes. Drain well. When done, remove the asparagus with a slotted spoon and plunge them into a bowl of ice water. This will loosen the sand from the shells and give them a chance to curl up while eating. The cooking here will also help them retain some of the green color and flavor. They are cooked when they are crisp and still a bit firm at the ends. When done, remove them with a slotted spoon and cover with cold water. Drain and reserve the liquid. Place the chilies in a saucepan with enough water to just cover. Cook over medium heat for about 2 minutes. Drain and set aside to cool. Remove the asparagus spears from the water and put in a blender or food processor. Add the vinegar, poblano chile, bouillon cubes and amaretto. Blend until smooth. Transfer the sauce in a pan and heat until bubbly. Add the drained asparagus and the reserved liquid. Bring to a boil, reduce heat, and simmer for about 10 minutes until asparagus is done, but not yet tender. Serve warm over your favorite pasta.

title: Oriental Soya
ingredients: 1 head spanish onion, thinly sliced | 1 3/4 cups soy sauce
instructions: Using a spoon, scrape out a little of the purple top but not so much that it becomes bitter. Discard the white papery peel. Place the onions in a microwave safe dish with 2 cups of water. Cook in 1/2 inch of water for 15 minutes. Drain. Remove from microwave and stir. Set to high setting. While the liquid is seeping in the dish, add the soy sauce and stir well. When liquid has cooked down and turned cloudy, mix it into the soy and onion mixture, stirring well.

title: Crispy Cannellini (Brussels)
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons oil, more as needed | 1 cabbage, quartered | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh thyme sprig | 1/4 cup cognac | 1 1/2 cups shredded monterey jack pepper cheese | assorted garnish : | fresh basil, slivered
instructions: In a medium saucepan of boiling water, blanch cabbage for about 1 minute. Drain in a sieve. In a 3 quart saucepan, heat oil over medium heat. Stir in cabbage. Add thyme, cognac and pepper jack cheese. Simmer until cheese is melted, about five minutes. Stir in basil a moment before removing from heat. Serve with additional cheese on the side for dipping.

title: Rhubarb and Asparagus Stir Fry
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs red potatoes, peeled | 1 1/2 lbs stalks fresh asparagus, trimmed | 1/2 cup fresh cilantro, chopped | 1 tablespoon mustard powder | 1 tablespoon mixed spice | 3 cups asparagus, ends, cooked | 1 - 1 1/2 lb rhubarb, chopped ( or spinach, if you have it ) | 1 lb small west indian chinese cabbage, cut into 6 wedges
instructions: Place potatoes in salted water and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer until tender, about 20 minutes. Drain and place potatoes in a large bowl. Remove stems from asparagus. Cut into 1 inch pieces. Cut stems into 1 inch pieces. Add asparagus, cilantro, mustard, and mixed spice. Mix to coat. Add potatoes and stir.

Random Ingredients: tomato juice,brown sugar,rice wine,pepperoni,tap water,cider vinegar
title: Pepperoni Italian Sausages
ingredients: 2 ounces pepperoni, sliced in long thin strips | 2 cans tomato juice, reserve 1/3 cup of syrup for sauce | 1 tablespoon cider vinegar | 1 tablespoon rice wine, optional | 3 tablespoons cider vinegar | 3 tablespoons packed light brown sugar | 3 cups tap water
instructions: Cook pepperoni strips in hot oil until both sides have a nice browning on each side. When pepperoni is brown remove from oil and set aside. Combine tomato juice with sauce and add the rest of the syrup, 1 tablespoon of cider vinegar, and rice wine. Bring to a boil and simmer for 15 minutes. Add brown sugar and pepperoni and cook for 15 to 20 minutes longer, stirring occasionally. Serve hot with warm biscuits or toasted bread rolls. Note, this makes a great appetizer.

title: Deep Curry Chicken
ingredients: 1 frying chicken | 1 teaspoon chili oil | 1 teaspoon fenugreek seeds | 1 teaspoon dried galangal | 1 cup ground hazelnuts
instructions: Cut chicken into serving size pieces. Heat oil in a wok and fry chicken till just golden brown. Lower heat, add cumin seeds, chili oil and fry the fenugreek seeds for 2 more seconds. Add ground galangal and ground hazelnuts. Add 3/4 cup water and reduce heat.

title: Famous PA Dutch for Years With Oven Roasted Beef
ingredients: 3 -4 lbs chuck roast | spices | oil, for roasting | spices, to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f. Mix together all ingredients in a large bowl and knead all ingredients until well combined. Insert meat into a large roaster or roasting pan and heat in the oven on the stove. You may also add spices to taste after 20 minutes or so, depending on the spice level.

title: Asparagus and Hot Chili Sates
ingredients: 20 large asparagus spears, ends trimmed | 1 fresh hot chili pepper, seeded, finely minced | 1/4 cup chopped of fresh mint or 1/4 cup chopped parsley | 8 bamboo skewers, soaked in water for 30 minutes
instructions: Cut the asparagus in half lengthwise and then crosswise to yield long, thin pieces. Cut each piece into long, thin strips. Add the chili and chopped mint to the asparagus and stir to coat. Place skewers on a broiler pan. Broil 3 - 4 inches from the heat about 3 minutes, turning, until just tender and slightly charred. Serve with salad.

title: Tropical Cream
ingredients: 2 tablespoons butter | 1/2 cup half-and-half, or more, to taste | 1/8 teaspoon tamari, or more to taste
instructions: Melt butter in a pot over medium low heat.

Random Ingredients: corn kernel,heavy whipping cream,curry paste,spaghetti,cornstarch,spring onion
title: Spicy Curried Corn and Cream Sauce
ingredients: 350 g spaghetti or 350 g linguine | 150 ml heavy whipping cream | 2 tablespoons curry paste ( your favourite variety ) | 1 1/4 lbs corn kernels or 1 1/4 lbs frozen corn kernels, thawed ( about 40 corn kernels ) | 1 3/4 teaspoons cornstarch | 4 spring onions, chopped ( scallion )
instructions: Cook spaghetti in boiling salted water according to packet directions, omitting any oil. In a large bowl, combine cream, curry paste and corn. In a 3/4l shallow ovenproof, non stick pan, place corn in one even layer and sprinkle with salt. Place under hot broiler and bake, stirring several times, until golden and corn is hot. Combine corn, cream mixture and spring onions in a small bowl. Drain spaghetti well and toss together with sauce. Serve immediately, sprinkled with chopped spring onion.

title: Caribbean Lime Cooler
ingredients: 2 limes, thinly sliced | 2 cups soda water | 1 1/2 tablespoons grenadine syrup
instructions: Drain juice from limes into tall glass about 4 cups. Add soda water and sprinkle with grenadine syrup. Add sliced lime slices to glass.

title: Baked Pear Soup
ingredients: 3 lbs pears ( or apples ) | 10 ounces water ( reserved from cooking pears ) | 4 teaspoons chicken bouillon granules | 1/3 cup celery | 1/2 cup celery leaves | sea salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Remove pears from their shells and chop. If you want to make more, cut up smaller pears. Place pears into large container and cover with the water. In another container, mix the bouillon, celery leaves and salt. Drain pears and add to the mixture. Bring to boil and then simmer for about 20 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand until cool enough to handle, about 2 hours. Put pears and celery leaves into processor and pulse until smooth. Add to soup and serve immediately.

title: Ajiaco
ingredients: 1 large stewing chicken | white pepper powder, to taste | 2 fresh hass avocadoes ( peeled, pit removed )
instructions: Pre heat the oven to 180°c place the chicken in a roasting tin, sprinkle with pepper and cover with white pepper powder. Bake in the oven for 3 minutes at 180°c. Remove the chicken and place in fridge. Cut the avocados into small chunks, remove the skin and seeds and cut into small chunks. Return the chicken to the oven and bake for 20 - 30 minutes. Serve with fresh corn chips.

Random Ingredients: mussel,lettuce,asparagus,yellow bell pepper,filling,white sugar,celery rib,iceberg lettuce
title: Asparagus Mussels
ingredients: 10 large hard-cooked mussels, scrubbed and beards removed | 2 celery ribs, thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons light white sugar | 4 heads iceberg lettuce, shredded | 1/2 cup chopped yellow bell pepper | 1/2 cup chopped asparagus | filling : | 3 tablespoons minced garlic | 3 tablespoons white sugar
instructions: Pour 3 quarts water into a large pot. Add mussels, celery, 1 tablespoon sugar, and shredded lettuce. Bring to a boil, then cover and set aside to steam over medium heat 15 minutes. Uncover and cook 10 minutes longer, or until mussels open. Remove mussels and discard any discolored shells. In a medium bowl, mash 1/2 cup bell pepper and 1/2 cup asparagus with a fork. Stir in remaining 1/2 cup sweet red pepper, 1/2 cup chopped garlic, 3 tablespoons sugar, and remaining 3 tablespoons sugar. Stuff mussels with half the stuffing, pressing in to help fill the shells. Stuff remaining stuffing into the shells, including some stuffing into each serving. Allow to cool before serving.

title: Gérard Mulot's Aniseed Flower Tea
ingredients: 1 kg young green chilies or 1 kg other green chilies, seeds and stems removed and meat finely cut, seeds and membranes separated ( about 12 ) | 3 tablespoons anise seed, crushed | 1 bunch fresh edible flower, to decorate ( violets, pansies, pansies, etc.. )
instructions: Grind chilies with aniseed and salt and water.

Random Ingredients: scallop,thai fish sauce,tamari,saltine cracker,jalapeno pepper,rigatoni pasta,hot water
title: Scallop and Scallop Rigatoni
ingredients: 1 package rigatoni pasta | 1 pound large sea scallops | 1 can hot water | 3 tablespoons tamari | 3 tablespoons thai fish sauce | saltine crackers, for garnish | 1/2 jalapeno pepper, finely diced
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, stir in the rigatoni, and return to a boil. Cook the pasta uncovered, stirring occasionally, until cooked and slightly undercooked, about 11 minutes. Drain well in a colander set in the sink. Place scallops into a large bowl. Pour the hot water over the scallops, and refrigerate for 15 minutes. Remove scallops from the marinade, and drain well. Reserve the marinade. Meanwhile, place the scallops into a large pot with 1/2 of the reserved marinade, and the tamari, fish sauce, and 3 tablespoons of water. Bring to a boil over high heat, then immediately remove from the heat. Stir in the reserved scallops. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Once the water is boiling, stir in the rigatoni, and return to a boil. Cook the rigatoni uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the pasta has cooked through, but is still firm to the bite, about 12 minutes.

Random Ingredients: italian parsley,italian seasoning,picante sauce,lemon,granny smith apple
title: Picante Apples
ingredients: 10 granny smith apples | 3 tablespoons lemon juice | 3 tablespoons picante sauce ( mild, hot, sour or chunky ) | 1/2 teaspoon italian seasoning | 3/4 cup chopped fresh italian parsley
instructions: Core and slice apples into strips. Place them in a skillet on medium high heat and stir occasionally until lightly browned and juices run clear. This should take about 10 minutes. Sprinkle parsley over apples and return skillet to medium heat. Add picante sauce and seasoning. Cook for 2 - 3 minutes or until apples are slightly wilted. Serve as an accompaniment to pasta.

title: Coriander & Pepper Soup
ingredients: 500 ml chicken stock | 15 g coriander leaves | 3 g italian seasoning | 2 1/2 tablespoons cilantro | 1 small yellow pepper, chopped
instructions: Simmer stock, herbs and pepper in a saucepan over low heat for 5 minutes. Puree soup in a blender, return to pan, stir through cilantro and serve.

Random Ingredients: pasta,dark beer,tomato sauce,bread flour,turmeric powder,cocoa,plain yogurt
title: Cocoa-Beer Battered Pasta
ingredients: 450 g pasta | 175 g plain yogurt | 275 g tomato sauce | 1 tablespoon cocoa | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder | 2 tablespoons bread flour | 1 tablespoon cocoa | 1/4 cup dark beer, like dark beer
instructions: Cook pasta per instruction on pack. Mix all of the dry ingredients together and mix well. In a large pan cook in a bit of oil or bacon fat on a gentle heat and mix well. Pour tomato sauce, yogurt and spices on the pan and mix well. Serve with warm pasta. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: maraschino cherry,head broccoli,porcini mushroom,plum jam,dark rum,chicken breast,asparagus spear
title: Rum-Glazed Chicken Breasts with Asparagus and Broccoli
ingredients: 4 boneless chicken breasts ( about 1/2 pounds total ) | 4 plums jam, preferably white, divided ( optional ) | 6 1/2 ounces dried porcini mushrooms | 3/4 cup dark rum, divided | 1 tablespoon maraschino cherries | 1/2 head broccoli, trimmed and cut into florets | 12 asparagus spears, trimmed from stems
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil.

Random Ingredients: cajun seasoning,taco seasoning mix,olive oil,orange juice concentrate,pita bread,goat cheese
title: Goat Cheese Fritters
ingredients: 1 cup crumbled goat cheese | 1/4 cup orange juice concentrate, thawed ( canned ) | 1 tablespoon olive oil | 2 tablespoons taco seasoning mix | 1 tablespoon cajun seasoning ( tony chachere's creole fresh seasoning blend ) | 4 pita bread, round rounds
instructions: Spray skillet with cooking spray. Set aside. Combine cheese, orange juice concentrate, oil, taco seasoning and cajun seasoning until well blended. Fold in goat cheese and form into patties. Preheat pan on medium heat and add oil and patties. Cook for 4 minutes each side, or until golden. Cut into halves and serve with dip or other condiments as desired.

Random Ingredients: asiago cheese,sherry,fruit,creamy peanut butter,head cauliflower,pie crust,rigatoni pasta
title: Spicy N' Crunchy Pasta Salad for Two (Vegetarian or Not!)
ingredients: 1 cup asiago cheese, grated | 1/4 cup creamy peanut butter | 2 tablespoons dry sherry | 2 tablespoons dried fruit | 1 1/2 lbs prewashed mixed fruit, diced | 1 pie crust | 2 cups rigatoni pasta ( or other tubular pasta )
instructions: Put 1/2 cup cheese in a food processor and blend until fine. Add peanut butter, sherry, and mixed fruit and blend until creamy. Add other 1/4 cup cheese and blend until smooth. Fold in pasta and pour into a pie dish. Sprinkle with remaining chopped cheese. Bake at 400 f for 25 - 30 minutes or until crust is browned.

title: Easy Baked Strawberry Sauce
ingredients: 3 1/2 cups ketchup | 1 1/2 tablespoons italian seasoning | 1/4 teaspoon ground cloves | 1 teaspoon dried basil leaves | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried shredded suet or 1 1/2 teaspoons butter | 1 cup strawberry preserves
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a large bowl, mix ketchup, italian seasoning, cloves, basil, and suet. Mix well, and pour half into a shallow baking pan. Stir preserves into ketchup mixture. Bake 25 to 30 minutes, until bubbly and slightly thickened. Use immediately or store in refrigerator up to 1 week.

Random Ingredients: broccoli floret,sun tomato oil,baking potato,cold water,taco seasoning,egg substitute,italian sausage,fish sauce
title: Napa Dave’s Smoked Sausage Fried Potatoes
ingredients: 1 lb smoked italian sausage | 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil | 1 1/2 lbs baking potatoes, cut into quarters lengthwise and then cut crosswise in half | 1 tablespoon fish sauce | 1 1/2 cups chinese broccoli florets | 2 tablespoons sun-dried tomato packed in oil | 1 1/2 cups egg substitute | 1 1/2 - 2 cups cold water
instructions: Brown sausage, drain, and cut into bite size pieces. Set aside. In a large skillet, sauté potatoes in oil until browned. Add the broccoli and sun dried tomatoes. Cook until broccoli is tender crisp, about 5 minutes. Remove mixture from skillet and keep warm. Add the fish sauce, salt and pepper to taste and mix well. Add egg substitute and water stirring to blend. Return sausage mixture to pan. Stir in potato and broccoli mixture. Heat through. Serve.

Random Ingredients: tomato juice,chili sauce,baguette,part mozzarella cheese,dark chocolate,pinto bean,aubergine,apricot nectar
title: Creamy Italian Toast
ingredients: 2 aubergines | 3 cans pinto beans, drained and rinsed | 1 liter tomato sauce | 1 liter chili sauce | 1 baguette | 50 g shaved dark chocolate | 50 g shaved part of mozzarella cheese, to eat | 1 tablespoon dried apricot nectar
instructions: Boil the aubergines for 5 minutes in 3 cups of boiling water. Turn them over and boil for 8 more minutes. Leave to cool. Peel the aubergines. Cut each in half and scoop out the meat and bones. Cut the aubergines in half again and slice in the same paper thin slices. Pour the bean and tomato sauces into a large saucepan, bring to the boil and reduce for 5 minutes to keep warm. Wipe the pan dry with a paper towel. Arrange the aubergine slices in a single layer in a well greased shallow ovenproof dish. Pour a little tomato sauce over the slices. Put under a grill or under a griller grill until the skins blister. Turn over and cook until very crispy. Heat the chili sauce. Divide the baguette slices between two large bowls. Top with 1/3 of the aubergine slices, a generous portion of the tomato sauce and 1/4 of the shredded cheese. Repeat with the remaining ingredients. Top with the remaining cheese and place under the grill to melt the cheese. Allow 10 minutes for the cheese and 10 minutes longer for the slices to become crispy. Remove from the grill and serve with the warmed dish and the warmed nectar.

Random Ingredients: beer,sherry wine,vanilla wafer crumb,spanish onion,grain brown rice,brandy,butter bean,chili paste
title: Easy Spanish-Mushroom Rice With Beans and Onions
ingredients: 1 package spanish onions, thinly sliced | 3/4 cup chili paste | 1/2 cup unsalted butter beans, drained | 2 cups low-grain brown rice, rinsed | 2 tablespoons brandy ( or cognac ) | 5 cups low-sodium canned beer | 1/2 cup dry sherry wine | 1 teaspoon pure vanilla-flavored gelatin ( optional ) or 1 teaspoon vanilla extract ( optional )
instructions: In a large, deep skillet, saute the onions in the butter and hot bean paste over a moderate heat until the onions are golden and the paste darkens in color, about 10 minutes. Stir the rice into the pan and fry it for 2 minutes. Stir in the brandy, beer, and vanilla extract. Cover and simmer over very low heat for 15 minutes, or until most of the liquid has been absorbed.

Random Ingredients: self rising flour,pineapple chunk,white cheddar cheese,water chestnut,lime juice zest,currant,apricot,basil leaf
title: Cheddar & Fruitcake
ingredients: 1 cup soft white cheddar cheese | 1/2 cup currants ( can use raisins ) | 1/2 cup dried apricots or 1/2 cup dates, diced | 1 can pineapple chunks, drained | 1/2 cup chopped water chestnut | 2 teaspoons lime juice and zest of | 7 tablespoons fresh basil leaves, chopped ( or 3 tablespoon dried basil leaves ) | 2 cups self-rising flour
instructions: Cream white cheddar cheese and currants. Add apricots or prunes and pineapple chunks and the water chestnuts and mix again. Add lime juice and lime zest. Add basil and stir. Mix in flour gradually, stirring until it becomes a soft dough. If flour is not covering the fruit, add more flour. Preheat oven to 375f degrees. Pour dough into a greased and floured cookie cutter and bake for 28 minutes. Serve warm with ice cream. Makes 24 servings.

Random Ingredients: cinnamon sugar,graham cracker crumb,honey,grain rice,red chili paste,pineapple,shortening
title: Red Rice and Pineapple-Rice Balls
ingredients: 1 can condensed light cream of rice, about 1.5 cans | 2 1/4 lbs peeled fresh pineapple, about 2 1/2 cups, cut into 1/2 inch dice | 3 tablespoons shortening ( or vegetable oil ) | 1/3 cup honey | 1/3 cup finely ground cinnamon sugar | 1 teaspoon red chili paste or 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1/4 cup graham cracker crumbs or 1/4 cup finely ground cracker crumb
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300°. Place the rice and 3 cans of water in a large saucepan and bring to a boil. Cover and return the pan to the stove and boil gently until liquid is absorbed, about 15 minutes. Transfer the rice to a bowl and stir in the pineapple. To prepare the filling, melt the shortening, honey, cinnamon, sugar, and chili paste in a large bowl over moderate heat. When hot but not hot, stir in the rice pudding until well mixed, about 1 minute. Add the crumbs, a tablespoon at a time, stirring well after each addition and adding more until the mixture is moist but doesn't hold its shape. Do not over fill the rice, or the mixture will not hold together when molded together. Cover the saucepan and place in the oven, and leave until all of the pudding is absorbed, about 20 minutes. Do not stir in the crumbs, or else the rice will not stick together. Remove from the oven, remove the pudding from the pan and serve at once.

Random Ingredients: anise seed,teriyaki marinade,stiffly egg white,chicken wing,radish,ice,brown lentil
title: Spicy Italian Chicken Wings
ingredients: 2 cups dry brown lentils | 1 cup finely shredded ice | 2 -3 lbs chicken wings | 1 tablespoon teriyaki marinade | 1 tablespoon finely chopped radish | 1 teaspoon finely crushed anise seed | 1 teaspoon finely shredded unsalted butter or 1 teaspoon margarine
instructions: Sort and wash the lentils and drain well. Let sit over night, covered, if possible, in a colander to get rid of the excess water. In a saucepan add 1/2 cup of the water, then add the chicken wings and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a low simmer and partially cover. Simmer gently for 30 - 45 minutes to an hour, or until the wings are tender, but not mushy. Remove chicken wings from broth and place in a bowl. In a small stainless steel bowl, combine the teriyaki marinade with the remaining 1/2 cup of water. Add the dressing to the chicken and toss well. Let sit in the fridge or overnight. When ready to cook, preheat oven to 400 degrees. Line a 13 x 9 inch baking dish with parchment paper and bake the chicken wings, uncovered, for 15 - 20 minutes, or until tender. Slip off the parchment paper, remove from oven and let cool 15 minutes for easy handling. Slice off the meat from the wings. Drain the broth from the chicken wings and place in a bowl add the remaining ingredients. Toss well to mix. Note, it is best to make this up to a few days before and refrigerate. It is best served over jasmine rice.

Random Ingredients: rotel tomato chilies,stout beer,chocolate chip,crisp chow mein noodle,margarine,cherry tomato,sharp cheddar cheese
title: Chocolate-Stuffed Cherry Tomatoes
ingredients: 2 lbs cherry tomatoes, halved lengthwise | 1/2 cup semi-sweet chocolate chips, melted | 1/3 cup margarine, melted | 1 can rotel diced tomatoes & chilies | 1 can rotel tomatoes & chilies | 1 cup shredded sharp cheddar cheese or 1 cup monterey jack cheese | 1/2 cup crispy chow mein noodles ( optional )
instructions: Spray 8x8x2 inch baking dish with pam.

title: Tagliatelle With Fresh Mozzarella Fonduta
ingredients: 20 -24 ounces tagliatelle pasta noodles | 1 1 cup part-skim mozzarella cheese ( i've also used low-fat parmesan )
instructions: Wash and cut the linguetti into 1/2 inch slices.. Add 5 cups cool water to a large pot that has a lid. Add the tagliatelle noodles and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium and simmer, stirring occasionally until tender, 30 - 45 minutes to 1 hour. When done, drain the pasta and add it back to the pot over low heat. Add 4 cups of water, 1 1/2 cup of parmesan cheese, 3/4 cup of dry instant espresso and 1 teaspoon salt and blend thoroughly until all the cheese has been incorporated. Transfer contents of pot into the fonduta pot and serve, garnished with extra parmesan cheese.

title: Yummy Ginger Dipping Sauce
ingredients: cooking spray | 1/2 teaspoon minced fresh ginger
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Spray a small glass dish with cooking spray. Add minced ginger.

title: Stolen from Recyclers
ingredients: 1 can pineapple chunks, drained and crushed | 1 teaspoon sesame oil
instructions: Stir the pineapple, sesame oil and crushed pineapple chunks together. Season with pepper and salt, if desired.

title: Spinach Gnocchi
ingredients: 1 lb fresh spinach, cleaned, trimmed and torn into bite size pieces | 1/2 lb baking potato, peeled & julienned | 1 vanilla bean, split | 1 tablespoon chopped of fresh mint, plus extra mint, for garnish | fresh thyme sprig, for garnish
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place spinach, potato and vanilla bean in a large mixing bowl. Add mint and thyme and stir to combine. Place 2 or 3 tablespoons of gnocchi in a skillet over medium heat.

title: Wild Mushroom Daube on the Ice Cream
ingredients: 32 ounces wild mushrooms | 32 ounces potato sticks ( frozen will work too ) | 1 tablespoon accent seasoning ( optional ) | 1 scoop vanilla ice cream, with a touch of vanilla extract | 4 slices currants, to garnish if desired
instructions: Place the mushrooms in a saucepan, and add cold water to cover. Bring to a boil. Once it comes to a boil, cook the mushrooms for 10 minutes, then drain. In a separate bowl, mix together 2 cups of fresh mushrooms and the potato sticks. Add the accent, and mix. After the 10 minutes, remove, and drain off excess water. Dump them into the bowl with the mashed potatoes. Add in the accent, if using for 1 minute and mix. Spoon mixture onto the ice cream, garnish with currants, if using them. Enjoy.

title: Riviera's Savoy Crisp
ingredients: 1 savoy cabbage | 1 tablespoon raisins | 150 ml mirin | 2 teaspoons vanilla essence
instructions: Quilt or shred cabbage into thin shreds. Sieve and soak raisins or soak overnight. Mix all ingredients in a bowl. Chill before serving.

Random Ingredients: anchovy fillet,pie crust,pork rib,taco seasoning,chocolate chip,salad green,hamburger bun
title: Crock Pot Pork Fondue
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger roll ( country-style ) | 1 lb pork rib ( country-style ) | 2 packages taco seasoning | anchovy fillet, rinsed and patted dry | 3 packages chocolate chips | salad greens or mixed salad green | tacos or hot dog bun ( toasted )
instructions: Line a 3 1/2 to 4 1/2 quart slow cooker with plastic wrap. Place ground chuck and pork ribs in bottom of slow cooker. Add taco seasoning, then top with chocolates, anchovies, and mixed salad greens. Cover and cook on low for 6 to 8 hours, or high for 3 1/2 to 4 1/2 hours. Remove from cooker and let meat mixture rest 5 minutes. Meanwhile, cut ends off of roll and serve with toothpicks, if desired.

title: Spiced Tomato and Pistachio Shortbread With Brandy
ingredients: 2 3/4 cups all-purpose flour, divided | 1 cup unsalted shelled pistachios, coarsely ground | 1 tablespoon paprika | 1 teaspoon sweet paprika | 1 cup tomato sauce ( of your choice )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350f and line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Sift a cup of flour onto a clean dry surface. Add half the pistachios, the paprika, and the second half of the flour. Mix and gently knead the dough with your hands to form a firm and smooth dough. Divid the dough evenly between your palms and form little balls. Place them on the prepared baking sheet. Flatten slightly with your thumb and then press them lightly into 3/4 circles and brush the tops of the biscuits with some of the brandy. Bake the shortbread until they are pale gold in the center, about 25 minutes. Remove the shortbread from the oven and transfer to a wire rack. Let cool. Serve.

Random Ingredients: baking powder,chicken liver,french dressing,rump steak,champagne,yellow squash
title: Steak With Champagne
ingredients: 1 cup champagne | 1 tablespoon baking powder | 1 lb rump steak, sliced | 1 1/2 cups yellow squash, sliced | 1/3 cup french dressing | 1 1/2 cups fresh boneless skinless chicken livers
instructions: Combine champagne and baking powder and pour into glass baking dish. Add meat. Cover and marinate 30 minutes at room temperature. Combine squash, dressing and livers and stir well. Pour over steak. Cover and marinate 2 hours, turning several times, barbecue on medium heat 45 to 55 minutes.

Random Ingredients: jam,cheddar cheese,anise seed,white vinegar,pork shoulder,beef tenderloin steak,heirloom tomato
title: P. F. Chang's Sandwich
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sesame-seed oil or 2 tablespoons white vinegar | 1 tablespoon honey | 1 teaspoon anise seed | 1 1/2 lbs lean pork tenderloin steaks or 1 1/2 lbs rib eye steaks, cut 1 inch thick | 1 lb fresh cheddar cheese | 3 medium heirloom tomatoes | 2 lbs sliced multicolored fresh tomato, sliced 1/4 inch thick
instructions: In large shallow dish, combine oil, honey and anise seeds.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon cube,kaffir lime leaf,rosemary sprig,red chilies
title: Rosemary Paste
ingredients: 10 cups fresh rosemary sprigs | 2 small dried red chilies | 14 cups chicken bouillon cubes or 14 cups vegetable bouillon | 4 kaffir lime leaves, crushed
instructions: Place the rosemary sprigs and red chillies into a large soup pot. Add enough water to cover and bring to a boil over high heat. Add the bouillon and bring to a boil again. Remove from the heat and add the lime leaves. Serve hot.

title: Mexican Spaghetti Chips 2007
ingredients: 2 cups whole wheat flour | 1/2 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1 jar picante sauce, heated | 1 package cooked spaghetti
instructions: Combine the flour, nutmeg, picante sauce and 2 cups water to make dough. Cover and set aside. Roll dough out to about 1/8 inch thickness and dip into reserved sauce. Arrange on a flat surface and place 2 inches apart on a preheated cast iron grill or grill pan. Cook 7 to 8 minutes until golden brown. Remove from the grill and place on a paper towel lined plate. Repeat with remaining dough.

Random Ingredients: corn kernel,hot chili sauce,red bell pepper,lime juice,swiss cheese,lemon,beef sirloin
title: Famous Southwestern Beef Kebabs
ingredients: 2 lbs trimmed sirloin, cut in 1/4 inch slices | 2 red bell peppers, cut in 1/4 x 2 inch strips | 1 cup fresh corn kernels ( cut from 2 ears of corn or use frozen kernels ) | 1 lemon, halved, seeds removed | 2 limes, juice of | 1/2 cup sweet hot chili sauce | 1/2 cup grated swiss cheese
instructions: Preheat barbecue grill to medium high heat. Combine all ingredients except cheese in a small bowl. Divide into four. Thread one piece of beef on each skewer. Place kebabs on rack over grill. Grill kebabs approximately 2 minutes per side for medium rare. Remove beef from grill and put on towel to absorb excess liquid. Slice beef and serve.

Random Ingredients: ricotta cheese,egg noodle,jalapeno pepper,white sesame seed
title: Spicy Tomato Lasagna
ingredients: 10 ounces of thin egg noodles | 1 pint low fat ricotta cheese | 1/2 cup white sesame seeds | 1 jalapeno pepper
instructions: Cook noodles in a pan of simmering water for about 8 minutes or until tender. Drain and rinse noodles. In a bowl mix the ricotta, seeds and the chile pepper. Put 1/3 the sauce into a baking dish and cover with noodles. Add the remaining sauce on top. Sprinkle with white sesame seeds. Bake at 350°f for 40 minutes.

Random Ingredients: water,allspice,ritz cracker,kaffir lime leaf,heavy whipping cream,bread flour
title: Kaffir Lime Cream (Malai Kaffir) Pastry
ingredients: 1 cup bread flour | 1 cup heavy whipping cream | 2 cups water ( about ) | 1/4 cup prepared sweet-and-sour chicken-flavored liqueur ( such as tiger tiger or crema de canton ) ( optional ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons allspice | 1 large kaffir lime leaves, sliced in 4 | 1 1/2 teaspoons salt
instructions: For the pastry, stir allspice into liqueur and lime leaves, salt to taste. Slowly add 1/2 cup water to flour mixture.

title: Raspberry Biscuits With Sausage and Tomatoes
ingredients: 600 g sweet sausage | 450 g raspberries or 450 g strawberry preserves | 450 g tomato juice | 1 teaspoon baking powder | 2 teaspoons mixed herbs | 1 teaspoon roasted peanuts, chopped
instructions: Dice the sausage into small squares. Combine the sausage and remaining ingredients in a large saucepan, bring to the boil, turn off the heat cover and leave to stand for 1 hour. Strain the saucepan and place the mixture into a blender. Blend until smooth. Pour into a deep baking tin, lined with baking paper and bake in a preheated oven for 45 to 55 minutes, or until golden and crisp. Allow to cool slightly, then cut into quarters. Serve with the tomato biscuits.

title: Morel Cumin Fish Stock
ingredients: 3 1/2 cups morels, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon whole cumin | 2 pints water | 1 tablespoon of crumbled dried parsley
instructions: In a heavy pot, combine the morels, cumin and water and bring to a boil. Lower heat, partially cover pot and simmer for 30 minutes, skimming any scum that rises to the top. Skim any foam that rises to the top and stir in the parsley. Discard the morels and cumin and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: self rising flour,ribbon noodle,onion soup mix,vanilla essence,coconut cream,quinoa
title: Coconut and Quinoa Scrolls
ingredients: 50 g quinoa ( long grain is best ) | 1/4 cup light coconut cream | 1 onion soup mix ( knorr ) | 1 tablespoon vanilla essence | 25 g self-rising flour | 4 tablespoons shredded sweetened desiccated coconut on top
instructions: Place water and rice in a saucepan and bring to the boil. Reduce heat and simmer covered for 40 minutes. Meanwhile, make the topping by combining ingredients and then gradually adding the coconut cream whilst continuing to boil. Once cooked, remove from heat and allow to cool slightly. When rice is cool to the touch, stir in half the coconut and place in an oven proof casserole dish. Add the topping and spread evenly over the rice and bake at 180oc for 20 - 25 minutes or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: blackberry,chinese five spice powder,heavy cream,red chili,rice vinegar,raisin,beef brisket
title: Sweet & sour brisket- Crock Pot
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless beef brisket | 2 tablespoons dark rice vinegar | 2 teaspoons chinese five spice powder | 1 teaspoon dried red chili | 1 can blackberries ( drained & rinsed ) | 1/2 cup raisins ( optional ) | 1/2 cup heavy cream ( or milk )
instructions: Trim all fat from brisket & cut into 1 inch pieces. Combine vinegar, five spice powder & chilies in a large mixing bowl, & add brisket, turning to coat.. Cover & let marinate for 1 hour, flipping bag occasionally. Drain off fat from skillet & reserve. Rinse liquid from pot, remove brisket from liquid & arrange in crock pot. Pour reserved marinade over brisket. Cover & cook on low for 8 - 10 hours, or on high 3 - 4 hours or until meat thermometer reads 160f. When done, meat should pull apart with fork, but no liquid remains. While meat is cooking, place blackberries in blender along with raisins & cream. Blend on high speed until thoroughly mixed & slightly thick. Spoon blackberry mixture over brisket & serve.

Random Ingredients: water,treacle,pea,ginger paste,parmigiano reggiano cheese,yellow lentil,dark soy sauce
title: Noodles With Lentils (Sopa De Milanara)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups yellow lentils, rinsed and picked over | 2 1/2 cups water | 2 slices fresh ginger paste | 3/4 cup low-sodium treacle ( cornflour ) | 3/4 cup extra virgin dark soy sauce | 3/4 cup shaved parmigiano-reggiano cheese | fresh peas ( to garnish ) or thin julienned coconut ( to garnish )
instructions: Bring lentils and 2 1/2 cups water to a boil in a large pot. Reduce heat to low and cook until lentils are just tender, about 20 minutes. Drain. Transfer to a bowl and stir in sliced ginger. Mix in treacle, soy sauce, cheeses and the remaining 1/2 cup of water. Cool completely. Cover and refrigerate until ready to use. To serve, preheat broiler. Slice vegetables of choice. Transfer to a serving dish. Garnish with peas or tricolor curls of coconut.

Random Ingredients: hungarian paprika,kaffir lime leaf,cream chicken soup,apricot,arborio rice,ice cube,penne pasta,mustard powder
title: A Very Special Aussie Rice  With Kaffir Lime
ingredients: 1 cup long grain penne pasta, soaked under very hot water until tender | 1 can cream of chicken soup, undiluted | 1 cup chopped dried apricot ( i often double the amount ) | 1/2 teaspoon hungarian paprika ( to taste, use very generous measure ) | 1 teaspoon mustard powder | 1 lime leaf, cut in slivers ( optional ) | 1 cup cooked arborio rice ( can use white rice ) | 1 3/4 cups kaffir lime leaves, minced ( can use fresh zest of 1 limes ) or 1 3/4 cups rice-curd, rinsed and drained | ice cube, for serving ( optional )
instructions: Prepare pasta as directed on package. Drain. In a large pot, cook rice following package directions.

title: Boiled Lamb and Crab
ingredients: 2 teaspoons crushed dried crabmeat ( optional ) | 1 piece lamb ( or a combination of lamb and crab ) | 1 tablespoon cider ( optional )
instructions: Place the crab meat, or any other meat you like in a pot with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil, and then simmer for about 10 minutes, until the liquid has evaporated and the crab meat has turned white. Remove the crab and crab meat from the liquid, and set aside. Add the cider to the crab and meat juices, or just if using, you may do this in the crock pot and mix it in before serving. If mixture seems too dry, add a little more water and continue cooking.

title: Roast Beef with Brasciole
ingredients: 1 boneless chuck roast | 4 eggs, beaten | 2 large chilies, diced | 1 cup nonfat sour cream | 8 slices prosciutto ( small slices ) | 8 cups chopped mixed chard leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Place roast in pan with hot water, cover and roast about 2 2/3 hours or until tender. Cool slightly, refrigerate until cold. Shred, refrigerate until ready to serve. Slice beef, and cook eggs in a nonstick skillet over medium heat, stirring, until eggs are puffed and golden brown, 4 - 5 minutes.

title: Roasted Canadian Bacon
ingredients: 1/2 lb canadian bacon, chopped ( or any other bacon ) | 1 cup vegetable broth | 4 tablespoons superfine sugar | 1 tablespoon dried marjoram ( or 1/4 c. fresh marjoram leaves ) | 2 -4 lbs pork roast, trimmed of fat
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees fahrenheit. In a medium ovenproof heavy duty pan, combine the all the ingredients and bring to a boil, scraping pan occasionally. Place pork on top of all of pan and cover tightly with foil. Bake for 30 minutes, remove the foil, and bake for another 30 minutes or until pork is quite tender. Remove from oven, remove pork and slice. Serve hot or cold and reheat if needed.

Random Ingredients: lime zest,french bread,pork,baking powder,tomatillo,chipotle chile,spinach leaf,anise seed
title: Puerto Rican Pork Stuffed Tomatillos
ingredients: 1/2 lb ground pork | 20 tomatillos, stems removed ( about 1.5 pounds total ) | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh basil or 3 tablespoons flat leaf parsley | 1 1/2 tablespoons finely grated fresh lime zest | 1 can chipotle chiles, in adobo with seeds | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground anise seed | 1/4 teaspoon baking powder | 4 -6 slices french bread ( baguette ) or 4 -6 slices other country-style bread
instructions: Heat oven to 400°f. Remove husks of tomatillos. Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Trim off the stems with kitchen scissors if they are long and thin. Bring a 4 lb. Salted water to a boil. Meanwhile, clean tomatillos and set aside. Remove stems from tomatillos and chop. In a large skillet, cook ground pork over medium heat until no longer pink, breaking it up into bite size hunks. Drain the fat. When it cools, coarsely chop. Add tomatillos, 1 tablespoon basil or parsley and 1 1/2 teaspoons lime zest, to pork and set aside. Finely chop remaining 1 1/2 tablespoons basil, 1 1/2 teaspoons lime zest, and 1/4 teaspoons anise seeds. Mix well. Stuff tomatillo mixture into hollows of bread, about 2 inches in diameter. Place stuffed bread on a rack on a rimmed baking sheet. Bake until a bit brown on tops and bottom, approx. 20 minutes. Let cool for 5 minutes, then serve warm.

title: Easy Mango Salad
ingredients: 2/3 cup shredded mango | 1/3 cup chopped almonds | 1/3 cup prepared guacamole | 1/4 cup prepared salsa | 2 tablespoons distilled white vinegar | 1 1/2 cups cold water
instructions: In a mixing bowl, combine the mango, almonds, guacamole, salsa, and vinegar. Mix well. Pour water into bowl and stir until mixed evenly. Pour into a serving bowl and chill in the refrigerator at least 1 hour before serving.

Random Ingredients: active yeast,green cardamom pod,mozzarella cheese,rump roast,chicken meat,celery rib,manchego cheese,papaya
title: Jamaican Stuffed Pumpkins
ingredients: 4 1/2 - 5 lbs boneless lean rump roast | 1/2 cup shredded mozzarella cheese | 3 tablespoons grated manchego cheese | 1 tablespoon dried papaya ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon green cardamom pod | 2 -3 3 -5 tablespoons vegetable oil, warmed to 375 degrees or 3 -5 tablespoons canola oil ( as needed ) | 3 cups chopped peeled pumpkin or 3 cups shredded canned pumpkin ( canned may be substituted ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 1 white label dried pizza spice bag
instructions: Grease the inside of the mushroom caps. Using a sharp knife cut a deep pocket into the top of each mushroom cap. Reserve one for another use. Place the mushrooms on a rimmed baking sheet. Combine the cheese, manchego cheese, papaya, cardamom and a sprinkling of the vegetable oil in small bowl. Divide evenly among the mushroom caps. Top with the shredded mozzarella cheese. Set aside. Top the tops of the mushrooms with the remaining vegetable oil, spreading evenly. Make the pizza spice according to the package directions. Gently stir in the pumpkin before placing the mushroom caps on the baking sheets. Set aside. Punch puffs on baking sheet for 10 to 15 minutes until just starting to set, then sprinkle with the yeast. Use 2 spoons to scrape the sides of the mushroom cap and to check for burning or release any juices remaining from the mushroom caps. If the puffs have no flavor, cover with a clean kitchen towel and allow to cool. Remove the mushroom caps from the baking sheet and use spatula to pick out any hardened dough inside. Return the puffs to the baking sheet and return to the preheated oven. Bake the mushrooms, covered loosely with aluminum foil, for 15 minutes, until slightly browned and the internal temperature reaches 210 degrees. Remove from oven and let cool. Using a pizza peeler or very sharp knife, slice the puffs in half lengthwise to within 1/4 inch of the bottoms. Open up the tops and set a few scrapings along the inside of the puffs, with a sharp knife, to make a pocket. To serve, use a slotted spoon to take a portion of the open mushroom caps and place on top of the puffs and spoon the stuffing mixture in the center of the puffed mushroom caps. Place the filled mushroom caps on the pizza peel. Note, the cheese and crumb packages will be different.

Random Ingredients: cardamom seed,spring onion,red leaf lettuce,kielbasa,swiss chard
title: Wendy's Sausage and Swiss Chard Wrap
ingredients: 8 slices kielbasa | 6 leaves red leaf lettuce | 1 bunch chopped spring onion, green parts only | 1 teaspoon whole cardamom seed | 1 head red leaf lettuce, leaves separated
instructions: Slice kielbasa into 1/4 inch slices. Place sliced sausage and lettuce in lettuce leaf. Sprinkle with spring onions or chopped green onion.

title: Chilled Honey and Garlic Pasta
ingredients: 14 ounces dried tri-colored spiral pasta | 1 tablespoon honey
instructions: Place pasta on a medium high grill. Place 1/2 tbsp honey in a small bowl.

Random Ingredients: ginger juice,amaretto,taco seasoning,mustard powder,jalapeno pepper,coconut cream,jalapeno chili,savory
title: Mock Beef Jerky (Spice Hunter)
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/8 lb thin steak ( i use skirt steak ) | 5 ounces coconut cream ( no substitutes ) | 0.5 packet lawrys taco seasoning, mix | 1 tablespoon dried chipotle chili powder hot amaretto | 1 tablespoon dried mustard powder | 1 tablespoon crushed ginger juice | 1 tablespoon dried savory ( i used dried chipotle chilies from the original recipe, but this is not necessary ) | 1 tablespoon pickled jalapeno chili, minced ( again, i used pickled jalapenos for a twist )
instructions: Preferably, a whole fresh jalapeno pepper should be seeded and sliced vertically into juliennes about 3/4 cup to one inch wide. I had the costco brand sliced jalapeno lengthwise into small strips. Lay strips of jalapeno out on clean towels and pat dry. Slice meat into about five inch long strips. Place meat in a large ziplock bag, along with the coconut cream, taco seasoning, mustard powder, ground chipotle and dried chiles. Poke holes in the meat using a tined fork or tooth pick. I was lucky to come out clean, because the meat really started to lose it’s crunch and was just as tasty. Marinate in the fridge for about 2 hours, flipping once or twice. After 2 hours, remove meat from marinade and discard marinade from bag and refrigerate for 1 - 4 hours. I marinated the meat overnight, and returned it to the marinating pan. I took the meat out and took the excess marinade off, but didn’t dump out the water. I took the excess marinade and poured it over the meat. It worked out fine. It took out a bit of that crunch, but the finished result was very flavorful.

Random Ingredients: white poppy seed,chicken,cake flour,strawberry jam,red wine,epazote
title: Acapulco Chicken
ingredients: 1 lb chicken, cut into pieces | 1 cup confectioners'sugar | 1 cup dry red wine | 16 large fresh strawberries, hulled | 1/4 cup white poppy seeds | 3 tablespoons dried epazote
instructions: Place chicken pieces, in plastic bag, and cover with confectioners' sugar. Add wine and marinate in refrigerator at least 3 hours. Remove chicken pieces from marinade and shake to remove excess. Place strawberries, in a glass bowl, sprinkle with poppy seeds and minced epazote and toss until well coated. Thread chicken pieces onto skewers and grill over medium hot coals for 5 to 7 minutes per side or until chicken is cooked through and tender and the strawberries are lightly roasted.

title: Easy Microwave Wet Rub
ingredients: 2 tablespoons picante sauce | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon bay leaf
instructions: In small bowl, combine picante sauce and bay leaf.

Random Ingredients: fennel bulb,taco sauce,button mushroom,canola oil,cream mushroom soup,broccoli,american cheese
title: Mexican Vegetable Cheese Steak
ingredients: 2 fennel bulbs, sliced | 2 lbs round steaks | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1 can button mushrooms | 1/2 cup canola oil | 1/2 cup taco sauce | 1 package american cheese, shredded
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees fahrenheit. Trim the fronds from the fennel. Slice the fennel bulb in half lengthwise and then cut into thin slices. Set aside. Cut the steaks into strips about 1/2 x 1 1/2, 1/2 inch thick. Place on a sheet tray lined with waxed paper. In a large bowl, combine the soup, mushrooms, canola oil, and taco sauce. Add the french fry strips and mix. Place the cheese in a 9x13 baking dish. Spoon the soup mixture over the cheese. Bake for 10 minutes or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.

title: Lentils With Bourbon (Moroccan Recipe)
ingredients: 1 lb dried lentils, picked over | 1/4 cup bourbon | paprika
instructions: Cook the lentils the night before. Drain and rinse. Put them in a crock pot with the booze. Cook on low for 4 hours. Remove from crock pot. Let cool slightly. Serve.

title: Meat Karo
ingredients: 250 g meat | 1 tablespoon bicarbonate of soda | 250 ml water | 2 tablespoons ketjap manis | 1 tablespoon butter
instructions: Cut meat into cubes or chunks. Mix the soda and water and keep aside. Put all the other ingredients into the meat and toss until well combined. Put meat in a buttered iron casserole or pan. Pour the soda mix on top, put into a pre heated oven and bake for 1 1/2 hours at 160 degrees celcius until the meat is cooked. Serve with rice.

Random Ingredients: kasuri methi,rump roast,table salt,achiote powder,onion soup mix,taco seasoning mix,thai basil
title: Grilled Thai Beef Rolled over Tacos
ingredients: 2 tablespoons achiote powder | 1/3 cup table salt | 1 1/2 teaspoons dry onion soup mix | 1 1/2 teaspoons achiote powder | 1 package dry taco seasoning mix | 3 lbs rump roast, trimmed and cut into 1 1/2 inch chunks | 1 cup kasuri methi | 2 cups finely chopped fresh thai basil
instructions: In a small bowl, mix the achiote powder, 1/3 cup of the table salt, onion soup mix and achiote powder. Place the meat in a shallow dish. Spread the achiote mixture over the meat. Cover and refrigerate for 4 hours. Preheat an outdoor grill for medium high heat and lightly oil grate. Using 3/4 cup of water, spread the kasuri methi over the surface of the meat. Place on the preheated grill. Cook, turning once, until the kasuri methi is browned, 12 to 15 minutes. Transfer the meat to a cutting board and slice into strips. To serve, spread 2 tablespoons of the achiote sauce over each warmed taco.

title: Queso Fundido
ingredients: 2 cups pumpkin, peeled and cubed | 2 chiles with adobo sauce, or to taste ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons dried oregano, or to taste | 1 hard cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a medium bowl, mash pumpkin cubes with a fork. Stir in chile peppers. Season with oregano. Grease a 9x13 inch baking dish with cooking spray. Press 1/2 cup of the pumpkin mixture into the dish. Sprinkle with 1/2 cup of the cheese. Spread remaining 1/2 cup of the pumpkin mixture over the cheese. Bake in preheated oven until heated through and bubbly, 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Parmesan Cheese Crust Pies
ingredients: 3 tablespoons canola oil | 1/2 cup shredded parmesan cheese | 1 pie crusts, unbaked
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Combine oil and parmesan cheese. Add crumb mixture and beat in fork until mixture forms smooth dough. Pat dough into 6 inch pie shaped patty shaped tins and place on a large baking sheet. Bake 7 to 10 minutes or until golden and tester comes out with indentations. Let cool 5 minutes and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: white pepper,orange peel,garam masala,snow pea,confectioner ' sugar,green bean
title: Lebanese Green Beans, Snow Peas, and Orange Peel
ingredients: 1 package frozen green beans, trimmed | 2 tablespoons minced candied orange peel | 1 tablespoon fresh garam masala | 1 tablespoon ground white pepper | 3 tablespoons confectioners'sugar | 2 tablespoons water
instructions: Place the green beans in a microwave safe bowl. Toss with 1 tablespoon orange peel, garam masala, and white pepper.

title: Curried Spiced Fruit With Rice (Vikalinka)
ingredients: 1/2 cup finely chopped fresh strawberries | 3/4 cup vegetable protein | 1/2 tablespoon of mild curry paste | 1/2 teaspoon paprika | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: Puree all the ingredients in a blender. Divide between 8 serving cups. Sprinkle with a little bit of ground cinnamon. Serve in a bowl with a mint sprig and a toothpick.

Random Ingredients: plain nonfat yogurt,japanese pumpkin,white bean,egg noodle,chicken leg,taco seasoning mix,red onion
title: Crock Pot Chicken Fakin'
ingredients: 1 package dried white beans, soaked overnight | 6 chicken legs with thigh | 1 package taco seasoning mix, 1 packet | 1 medium red onions or 1 medium yellow onion, sliced to desired thickness | 2 large japanese pumpkin, peeled and sliced ( can make up to 3 cans drained canned chick peas and can also do 6 to 8 cups of pumpkin and chick peas ) | 1 container light plain nonfat yogurt | 1 package chicken-flavored instant egg noodles, prepared as per package directions ( 2 soup plates, 6 to 8 cups per serving )
instructions: Rinse beans, add to crock pot. Add chicken, taco seasoning mix and sliced onion. Cover and set on low heat setting for 6 to 8 hours. When done, chicken will be cooked. Remove chicken to serving platter. Remove onion slices. When cool enough to handle, tear about 1/2 of chicken into chunks, add onions and pumpkin. Stir and combine lightly. Serve over hot cooked egg noodles. Enjoy and enjoy.

title: French Onion Soup
ingredients: 2 envelopes onion soup mix | 4 cups white wine | 1/4 cup simple syrup
instructions: Dissolve soup mix in white wine. Let stand five minutes. Pour into 4 cups. Refrigerate overnight, stirring once or twice. Soup must not be left on the top. Refrigerate and cook at least one hour.

Random Ingredients: meat,chocolate,chicken bouillon granule,vegetable oil,apricot cherry,pink salmon
title: Puerto Rican Gravy With Baked Salmon
ingredients: 1 cup cooked salmon, cut into large bite size pieces - or enough for 2 to 3 servings depending on the size ( or to taste ) | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil ( i use olive oil or canola oil ) | 1 tablespoon instant chicken bouillon granules ( or to taste ) | 1/4 cup dried apricot ( with juices ) | 3 -4 tablespoons chocolate, finely chopped ( or bittersweet chocolate ) | 3 slices pink salmon, for serving
instructions: Line the bottom of an 8x8 shallow baking dish with parchment paper or spray lightly with cooking spray. In a bowl, pour half of the hot oil or oil from the canned salmon. Stir in the chicken broth as you cook it. Set aside, covered, for 10 minutes or longer. Add the rest of the oil or oil to the pan and bring to medium heat. Add the salmon and cook for 2 or 3 minutes then stir in the bouillon. Cover and cook for 5 more minutes, stirring occasionally while boiling. Stir in the apricots just to warm them up then remove cover. When the gravy has finished steaming down, stir in the chocolate. Season to taste with salt and pepper, if necessary, and serve. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: baking soda,vegetable stock,vegetable oil,cream tartar,bean sprout,salsa,green pepper
title: Mexican Refried Beans
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1/2 cup sliced green pepper | 1 cup vegetable stock | 1 teaspoon vegetable oil | 1 tablespoon salsa | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 1 teaspoon cream of tartar | 2 cans baked beans in light syrup
instructions: In a 4 quart deep sided frying pan, heat 1 tablespoon oil and add green pepper and cook until softened, about 2 minutes. Stir in stock, salsa, baking soda and cream of tartar. Stir to combine and heat through. Pour into a serving bowl and serve warm.

title: Sherry Baking Powder
ingredients: 1 cup sherry wine | 1 1/2 tablespoons bicarbonate of soda ( you may find it in a canning jar or other dark-brewish specialty store )
instructions: First mix all your ingredients together then leave to stand on your counter for about an hour or until it starts to foam. Take out of the fridge stir all the dry ingredients together then beat with the back of a spoon. The baking powder should be of pouring/pouring consistency rather than dropping in the liquid as you go with your dry ingredients. Use immediately, i usually only add about a tablespoon a tablespoon at a time for a few minutes and then it forms a fairly thick paste which makes a thick paste. It gets thick while standing, and i have found when drying in a plastic bag this mixture makes a firm paste that won't stick to anything but does absorb liquids.

Random Ingredients: amaretto,rye bread,pastry crust pie,beef,stilton cheese,catsup,mozzarella cheese
title: Smoked Beef and Stilton Pie
ingredients: 1/2 lb lean ground beef | 9 inches pastry for double-crust pie | 1/4 cup amaretto, divided | 8 ounces stilton cheese ( blue rind or white oat will work too ) | 3 ounces smoked mozzarella cheese | 2 tablespoons catsup | 2 tablespoons rye bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Brown ground beef in 10 inch skillet over medium heat, stirring just until crumbly but not cooked through. In a mixing bowl, combine 1/4 cup amaretto, stilton, smoked mozzarella, catsup and 1 1/2 tablespoons of the reserved amaretto. Spread meat mixture evenly over one of the crusts. Spoon cheese mixture over meat mixture in crust and top with second crust, sealing edges with fingers. Place on a parchment or baking sheet. Cut steam vents from parchment, brush top of pie with remaining 1 1/2 tablespoons amaretto. Bake in a 425 degree f oven for 10 minutes or until crust is golden brown and cheese is melted. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: bell pepper,cottage cheese,vanilla extract,vegetable broth,onion,chunky salsa,double cream,icing sugar
title: Salsa Soup
ingredients: 1 cup finely chopped onion | 1/2 cup chopped bell pepper ( red, yellow, green pepper ) | 1 package cottage cheese, drained | 1 cup double cream | 1 can vegetable broth or ( 10 1/2 ounce ) can chicken broth | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1 tablespoon icing sugar
instructions: In a large pot, saute onions with peppers in butter until soft. Blend in the cottage cheese, stock, and vanilla. Bring to a boil, stirring regularly. Remove from heat and stir in icing sugar. Serve with a light sprinkling of green chilies.

title: Chocolate Peanut Butter Spread
ingredients: 1 box mini chocolate chip | 1 teaspoon garam masala ( optional )
instructions: Pour 1/2 jar of mini chocolate chips into the bowl of a food processor. Pulse until chips are finely ground. Add garam masala if desired. Process again until mixture is smooth. Transfer to a bowl.

Random Ingredients: onion salt,arabic bread khobz,vinegar,oregano leaf,rotel tomato chilies
title: The Perfect Ajo Blanco
ingredients: 1/4 cup onion salt | 8 ounces rotel tomatoes & chilies | 10 ounces vinegar | 1/4 cup oregano leaves | 8 ounces arabic bread or 8 ounces khobz
instructions: Dissolve the salt in 6 cups of water and add the onion salt to it. Put it on high heat on the stove and wait until it boils. Turn burner down to low. Cut off the stem of the tomatoes and the chilies and add them to the boiling salt. As soon as it boils, add the vinegar and continue stirring a few minutes. It should thicken. At this point add oregano and mix thoroughly. Put the arabic for a few minutes then spread it on a piece of toasted bread or roll it up and serve with warm pita bread or as you would with pita chips.

title: Crispy Corn Cakes
ingredients: 3/4 cup yellow cornmeal | 1 1/2 cups cold water | 1 teaspoon paprika | 1/4 cup fresh coriander, minced | 1/4 cup fresh kale, minced | 1 cup fontina cheese, shredded | 10 ounces refried beans | paprika ( for sprinkling on top )
instructions: In a medium bowl, whisk together the cornmeal, water, paprika and coriander. Add the kale and toss to coat. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Lightly toast 3 - 6 cereal squares or one packet for each of the cakes. Spray a large cookie sheet with pam spray. Using about 1/4 teaspoon of batter for each baking sheet, spread each cake out into an 8 x 12 rectangle. Spoon about 3/4 cup of the cheese mixture evenly over 1 rectangle of cornmeal. Top with another 1/4 cup of cheese mixture, spread it thinly across the cheese. Fold the left and right edges toward the center while forming a packet. Press the edges with a fork to seal. Spray two sheets of foil with pam spray and place each packet on the cookie sheet. Bake for about 16 to 20 minutes until crisp and lightly browned. Remove from oven and sprinkle with paprika. Cut into squares while still warm.

Random Ingredients: stew beef chunk,brown sugar twin,asparagus,cilantro stem,beer,yellow onion,green chili pepper,tomato
title: Beef and Veggie Gumbo
ingredients: 1/4 cup firmly packed brown sugar twin | 1 cup beer ( i use hoegaarden pale brown ale with a touch of philadelphia flavor ) | 1 lb stew beef chunks, cut into 1-inch pieces | 1 lb fresh asparagus, trimmed and cut into 2-inch pieces | 2 medium yellow onions, chopped | 2 cups fresh cilantro stem, leaves only, chopped | 2 cans green chili peppers, drained | 1 medium tomatoes, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Combine brown sugar twin, beer, stew beef, asparagus, onions and cilantro in a 9x9 inch casserole dish and mix to combine. Top with chilies and tomatoes. Cover and bake 1 hour, uncover, and bake an additional 30 minutes, until meat juices bubble to the surface.

title: Vegetarian Tortilla
ingredients: 8 tortillas | 1 pint cherry tomatoes, halved with an olive ( i like progresso brand )
instructions: Heat the oil on the stove in a sauté pan. Put tortillas on a plate, cut side down for ten seconds in order to soften. Turn over and on the other side you will get brown patches. Remove. Put cherry tomatoes on your plate and put tortillas on top of them. Pour the tomatoes over the tortillas and mix it up. Put the plate back on the stove and turn on the stove to medium low. Let simmer for 10 minutes. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: tamarind pulp,salad oil,hard egg,mustard seed,beef brisket

Random Ingredients: gorgonzola,cider vinegar,red chile pepper,chipotle pepper adobo sauce,allspice,vanilla yogurt
title: Chipotle Yogurt Sauce for Fish or Chicken
ingredients: 1/2 cup chipotle peppers in adobo sauce, minced, or more to taste | 3 tablespoons cider vinegar, or as needed | 2 tablespoons gorgonzola, crumbled | 3/4 teaspoon ground allspice | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla yogurt | 1 red chile pepper, chopped
instructions: Stir chipotle chile adobo sauce, cider vinegar, gorgonzola cheese, allspice, vanilla yogurt, red chile pepper with seeds, and garlic chile peppers together in a bowl until cheese is completely melted.

title: Nunyobere
ingredients: 350 g macaroni | 3 tablespoons crunchy peanut butter | 1 1/2 tablespoons chili oil | 1 teaspoon crushed anise seed | 1 green mixed vegetable
instructions: Drain pasta, but do not rinse it. Cook macaroni while boiling in a pan of salted water for 7 8min. Drain and put in the serving bowls with the peanut butter, and a couple of tbsp of the chili oil. Add the seeds and stir well. Serve with mixed vegetables alongside or with bread. Variation, add a can of chopped green chillies at this point, but they do not need to be deseeded.

Random Ingredients: lime wedge,dark brown sugar,chicken thigh fillet,fennel bulb,sugar
title: Slow-cooking Lemons
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs chicken thigh fillets, cut into 5 to 8 pieces | 4 medium fennel bulbs, thickly sliced and washed | 10 1/2 fluid ounces dark brown sugar | 1 1/4 cups granulated sugar | 1 lime wedge ( to garnish )
instructions: Place the chicken and fennel bulbs in a 4 - 5 quart slow cooker. Sprinkle with the brown sugar and then stir in 4 cups of water. Place a large slice of lemon over the top and then press firmly. Garnish with lime wedges. Serve with warm, crusty french bread and cold beer.

title: Antipasto Sandwich
