instructions: In a large nonstick frying pan, cook the ground beef, anchovy, and pepperoni over medium heat until browned. Add lettuce and orange peel and heat through, about 3 minutes. Serve with bread to scoop out excess juices.

Random Ingredients: cream mushroom soup,soy sauce,lettuce leaf,pepperjack cheese,tuna steak,superfine sugar
title: Tuna Steak in Mushroom Gravy
ingredients: 4 tuna steaks | fresh ground pepperjack cheese | 1/2 cup light soy sauce | 1 tablespoon superfine sugar | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 2 -4 lettuce leaves
instructions: Mix all ingredients and marinate tuna for 5 mins in fridge. Grill to your liking. Serve with lettuce or mixed greens.

title: Pizza With Ham (Kesra)
ingredients: 4 sheets prepared pizza dough | 2 tablespoons yogurt | 1 tablespoon honey | 1/4 lb shaved ham | 1/4 lb thinly sliced ham | 3/4 teaspoon ground allspice
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. In a small bowl, mix yogurt, honey, ham and allspice. Place each sheet of dough on work surface and spread with yogurt mixture. Top dough with ham and drizzle with honey/soy mixture. Roll out dough to approximately 15 x 10 inch rectangle. Brush the edges with water. Fold top and bottom edges over to seal. Poke holes in the dough all over with a fork. Bake on cookie sheet for 20 minutes. Slice into 6 wedges and serve.

Random Ingredients: apricot jam,garlic salt,nut,ice,parmigiano reggiano cheese,red cabbage,virgin olive oil
title: Apricot Cracker Cheese Ball
ingredients: 3 pints thin red cabbage | 2 cups dried apricot jam ( apricot preserves ) | 1 1/2 cups crushed ice | 1/2 cup finely grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | garlic salt | nut ( optional )
instructions: Cook the cabbage in plenty of water until crisp tender, about five minutes. Drain and pat dry. In a bowl, add the apricot preserves and crush ice with a wooden spoon. Add cheese and mix gently. Add garlic salt and mix. Add pecorino or parmigiano or as desired. Refrigerate until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: center pork chop,pork shoulder,peppercorn,pesto sauce,white flour
title: Pan-Seared Pork Chops With Pesto
ingredients: 2 center-cut pork chops | 1/3 cup pesto sauce | 1 tablespoon white flour | 1 teaspoon cracked peppercorn | 2 tablespoons pesto sauce
instructions: Brush pork chops with oil and season with salt and pepper. Combine pesto and flour and coat chops well. Place chops in a nonstick skillet sprayed with cooking spray and cook over medium heat for five minutes per side. Transfer chops to serving plate & spoon pesto over chops. Serve with sauce and salad.

title: Spicy Tofu, Peppers, and Goat Cheese Skewers
ingredients: 16 frozen peppers and onions, thawed and sliced into thin strips | 8 ounces firm tofu, cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 4 ounces fresh goat cheese, cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 1/2 cup picante sauce | 1 large anaheim chili, halved and seeded | 2 tablespoons ground chipotle powder | salt | 1 cinnamon stick | 1/2 teaspoon ground nutmeg
instructions: In a large bowl or food storage container, combine all ingredients. Place peppers, onions, and tofu pieces in a large resealable plastic bag. Pour salsa over shrimp or other seafood and marinate. Drain marinated seafood and place in a large zipper bag. Seal and place in refrigerator 30 minutes to an hour. Arrange seafood, tofu and shrimp or shrimp skewers on skewers. Pour remaining salsa over skewers and bake in a 350°f oven 4 - 5 minutes, until shrimp is curled and hot throughout.

Random Ingredients: cider vinegar,hard egg,bourbon,pork shoulder,flour tortilla,bacon,chicken breast half
title: Southern Pulled Pork Carnitas
ingredients: 12 pork shoulder ( see note below ) | 2 tablespoons flour | 1 tablespoon cider vinegar | 2 cups chicken breast halves or 2 cups pork chops, cooked and shredded | 3 hard-boiled eggs, sliced | 3 slices bacon | 6 flour tortillas
instructions: Note, use a combination of each ingredient, and adjust the amount of vinegar and chicken and pork you want. Marinate the meat at least 4 hours and up to 24 hours. Preheat oven to 300°f in 2 quart dutch oven or 4 quart heavy pot, heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium high heat. Cook pork about 3 minutes per side and transfer to roasting pan. Cook, stirring occasionally until browned. Transfer to large platter and set aside. Heat remaining oil in dutch oven over medium high heat. Stir in remaining ingredients and bring to boil scraping the bottom of the pan with a wooden spoon as the oil starts to brown. Transfer pork to platter. Spoon sauce over pork, and surround with fried eggs and bacon on top. Cook on middle rack of oven until bacon is crisp and beginning to brown. Discard all but 1 tablespoon drippings. Serve with warm tortillas and/or rice.

Random Ingredients: vinegar,picante sauce,red pepper flake,jack daniel whiskey,chili sauce
title: Sauce Haskel For Two!
ingredients: 24 ounces jack daniels whiskey, at least 3/4'bourbon can | 2 tablespoons red pepper flakes, chopped | 1 tablespoon vinegar | 1/3 cup picante sauce | chili sauce ( optional, i didn't use, but it was a must imho )
instructions: Open the can of jack daniel's. In a medium saucepan with an over medium heat, melt the red pepper flakes, vinegar, chili sauce, and whiskey. You want to get as much smoke flavor into the whiskey as possible. Once the red pepper flakes are in melted, pour the whiskey into the empty can. Place the whiskey into the saucepan with the hot sauce. Do not stir, and shake the saucepan to mix evenly every time. This will allow the whiskey to be absorbed. This should take about 10 - 15 minutes. The sauce should be a little thick but still smooth. It should be sweet, but not too bubbly.

Random Ingredients: fine salt,meat tenderizer,beef tenderloin,chive,part ricotta cheese,yellow pepper,asparagus,potato
title: Pepper Potatoes and Asparagus With Meat & Asparagus
ingredients: 1 lb potato, peeled and cut into chunks | 1 package baby fresh asparagus, cut into 1-inch pieces ( about 1 pound ) | 4 lbs meat tenderloin | 1 1/2 teaspoons asparagus fines salt ( or salt substitute ) | 2 large yellow sweet potatoes, peeled and cut into 1-inch pieces | 1 jar part-skim ricotta cheese | 3 tablespoons fresh chives, minced | 2 teaspoons fresh chives, minced | 1/2 teaspoon asparagus tips or 1/2 teaspoon asparagus tips | 1/4 teaspoon fine salt | 1/8 teaspoon fine salt substitute
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. In a roasting pan, sprinkle potatoes with salt. Place meat on top of potatoes, and drizzle with 1/4 cup worcestershire sauce. Cover with foil, and bake 90 to 120 minutes, until potatoes are tender and meat is browned and crisp. Meanwhile, make filling. Remove meat from pan and place in a medium bowl. Using a slotted spoon, remove asparagus tips, reserving asparagus tips until step with the beef. Cook beef tips in pan with 1/4 teaspoon of mixed spice for 1 minute. Remove asparagus tips, and set aside. To make potatoes, place yellow sweet potato into a large bowl. Add 2 quarts of water, 1/4 teaspoon salt, 1/8 teaspoon fresh ground black pepper, and 1/8 teaspoon fresh ground black pepper. Stir to mix. Bring up to a boil in a large pot, then reduce heat and simmer, covered, over low heat for 20 minutes. With a slotted spoon, remove asparagus tips, and set aside with beef. To build up a pot à la phoron's omelet, place a 1 inch thick slice of potato on the beef layer in the bottom of a skillet, followed by a layer of asparagus mixture. Remove crust from meat. Place 1 tablespoon of ricotta cheese over the asparagus in the center of the skillet, and sprinkle a little of the asparagus tips over the cheese. Sprinkle a little chives and 2 teaspoons of fresh minced chives over the cheese. Repeat layers, making five final layers, sprinkling with 1/4 teaspoon of fine salt. Bake the final 15 to 20 minutes, until potatoes are tender and cheese is golden.

title: Stuffed Sugar Snap Peas
ingredients: 1 lb fresh sugar snap peas | 3/4 lb fresh beef sausage ( cooked and crumbled ) | 1/4 teaspoon pepper ( or to taste )
instructions: If your meat is precooked, cut in large chunks or cubes. If your bag doesn’t have a quick soak setting, cut in half. With a knife or meat tenderizer, scrape each sugar snap in the bag to open it up like an open book. If your bag has a quick soak setting, just press the whole thing down into the bag with your wet fingers. The snap peas will open while holding their shape. If you’re using dry spices like salt, garlic powder, cinnamon, etc. If your meat is really fresh, put it in the freezer until it’s solid and frozen, about 4 hours. The peas can be stuffed by holding them in your bag and then holding them in your bag again, squeezing the air out of them and then using the air to stuff more or less snaps. The last time i made these, my note, i trimmed the ends off the peas, then cut them at an angle into 1/2 inch chunks. My mom eats them by stuffing the peas right into bread crumbs with her, draining them well in the crockpot before cooking so they absorb as much water in the stew. One other addition since her husband serves them in the stew, she said that they would always make a good addition to the stew but wouldn’t tell her what to add to it just because she could’t remember eating the entire recipe that way. She said she took the advice of a family large enough to get them, right?. And she said that she thought that she would be better without them. This turned out great as her meat turned out great. I took them out right out of the bag, put on dinner plates and made some stir fried rice to finish it up. I also cooked them as above. I had some great gravy on the side for those who didn't have a quick soak setting. I had them on the bag, stuffing them into bread crumbs with the meat. They were a hit, too. You can use this and if you don’t care for the way they look, you can just throw these in a hot frying pan or skillet. I had them at the party with the party mixer, made this and used them in the next time. I had made these just a few days ahead and they were awesome. I couldn’t imagine a cooking family could not.

title: Homemade Nipping Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 head napa cabbage, chopped | 2 cans sliced black olives
instructions: Place cabbage into a wide mouth container for easy handling. Pour olives over cabbage and let stand overnight. After cabbage is cool enough to handle, chop coarsely and transfer to a jar or container that contains remaining ingredients. Cover and store in refrigerator.

title: Grilled Green Chilies or Poblanos(Cook's Country)
ingredients: 2 green poblano peppers or 2 red jalapeno peppers | 1 head leafy lettuce ( i used a hand held mix of romaine lettuce and iceberg lettuce ) or 1 head iceberg lettuce ( i used a hand held mix of romaine lettuce and iceberg lettuce ) | 1 fresh jalapeno, sliced ( optional )
instructions: Set up all your ingredients and grill the veggies. This recipe should be stored in clean containers or refrigerated in an airtight container. Use this grilled veggies as a garnish to tacos or salads.

Random Ingredients: yogurt,celery salt,hamburger bun,roast beef,cornmeal,purple onion,serrano pepper
title: Yummilicious Beef Sandwiches, 5-Qt or 270g
ingredients: 2 -3 hamburger buns ( i actually do quite a high, since they are so hearty ) | 1/4 cup cornmeal or 1/4 cup plain flour | 1 teaspoon celery salt | 12 slices lean cooked roast beef | 1 medium purple onion, thinly sliced | 6 -8 slices serrano peppers | 1/4 cup thick yogurt
instructions: Pre heat bbq grill to medium heat. Dip each burger in cornmeal or flour and cook until just lightly browned on both sides. Place beef, onions, pepper strips, and yogurt in a medium sized bowl and gently spread on one side of the buns. Grill for 2 - 3 minutes, or until top is crisp and lightly browned. Serve with any leftover salad and your favourite accompaniments on top.

Random Ingredients: cream mushroom soup,rice noodle,orange,baby spinach leaf,yellow pea,corn oil,baking powder
title: Spinny Noodle Casserole
ingredients: 1 package rice noodles | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1/2 cup orange juice or 1/2 cup white wine | 1/4 teaspoon baking powder | 1 bag baby spinach leaves | 2 tablespoons corn oil | yellow peas, as an accompaniment
instructions: Cook the noodles following package instructions or you will need to cook your noodles for the actual cooking. Heat the oil in a skillet or electric fry pan. Drain noodles and put into a large casserole dish. Mix the soup in, orange juice, baking powder, peas and pour over noodles. Cover and place in preheated oven at 350 degrees f. Heat for 45 minutes, stirring once or twice. The last 5 minutes remove lid, mix and serve.

title: Applesauce and Maple Salmon Smoked Salmon!
ingredients: 3 slices smoked salmon | 3 ounces smoked pork | 3 tablespoons unsweetened applesauce | sunflower oil
instructions: First make your smeared salmon. I like to have my smoked pork, which has a distinct maple flavour. Start by lightly frying the salmon. I like to fry it on the stove a little on the pan's burner, watching the edges of the tin. I don't really need any oil, so i can just leave a little of it in the pan. Smear the salmon with a little sunflower oil. Place it on the grill and leave for 5min and 30mins. I like to leave it on a foreman's shelf, but you can use any ovenproof saute pan you like. Once the smoke has had subsided add the applesauce. Turn the heat up to high and fry the salmon on one side for a few mins.. Then flip the salmon, season it if you want, and leave it on a foreman's shelf for a further 2 - 5 mins. Cut into small pieces, stir, and eat when the salmon is crispy. Tip, if smoked salmon is smoked about 5 mins from the time you're smoking it on the smoke, you don't need to leave the smoke behind. Simply pour a little melted butter over the salmon and serve.

Random Ingredients: yellow pea,pepper,chicken stock,chicken wing,pepper flake,leg lamb,vegetable juice
title: Pepper Lamb Kebabs (Yoshinoya)
ingredients: 1 bone-in leg of lamb | 4 tablespoons chicken stock | 4 tablespoons yellow split peas | 1 teaspoon pepper | 1 -2 teaspoon hot pepper flakes | 1 1/2 teaspoons vegetable juice | 6 chicken wings
instructions: Place the lamb in the bag with the salt. Shake to coat. Place the bag in the refrigerator for 3 - 4 hours. When ready to cook, rinse the lamb in a colander and drain excess liquid. Preheat grill. Remove the lamb from the refrigerator. Remove the lamb shoud be careful not to break the bone. Slice into 1/4 inch pieces. Prepare the spicy chicken broth by combining all of the ingredients. Add the lamb pieces, coat thoroughly, and allow to marinate at room temperature for 8 hours. Place the chicken wings in a skillet, and allow to brown on high heat for about 5 minutes, turning to prevent burning. Allow them to seperate, remove the wings, and set aside. Place skewers in a hot grill or bbq and cook until browned evenly. Transfer the meat onto a serving platter, and serve sauce over them.

title: Smoked Scallops
ingredients: 1/2 cup chili powder | 1 teaspoon celery seed | 1/2 teaspoon coarsely cracked black pepper | 18 large sea scallops
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Mix chili powder, celery seed, and pepper in a large bowl. Place scallops in the bowl and coat with chili sauce. Transfer scallops to a baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until the scallops are no longer opaque in the center, 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Pasta e Fagioli (Ziti With Black Olives and Zitron)
ingredients: 2 cups ziti pasta | 1 can sliced black olives, with liquid
instructions: Wash the ziti, drain, and set aside. In a large pot of boiling salted water, cook the ziti until tender but firm, about 12 to 15 minutes. Pour the ziti into a large bowl. Place drained ziti into the bowl with the cooked ziti. Mix in the olives, and add enough cold water to make a creamy sauce.

title: Jicama Salad
ingredients: 1 lb jicama, peeled and cut in cubes | spring onion | cornflour | cheddar or monterey jack cheese, grated
instructions: Sprinkle spring onion with cornflour and then cheese on the jicama. Place in large bowl and serve immediately.

title: Rice and Orange Snowball Rice Balls  - Rice Cooker
ingredients: 1/3 cup brown rice | 1/3 cup orange sherbet ( or your favorite flavor )
instructions: Put rice into rice cooker. When done, place bag in the rice cooker and swipe it around a bit with a long handled fork to get all of the rice in the goie. Turn the rice cooker to warm, and when you think it's cooked, close a lid or the lid. Let the rice rest about 10 minutes before removing the bag with it and putting it in a bowl. Place sherbet in the goie and stir it around a bit and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: savoy cabbage,bay seasoning,black olive,apple cider vinegar

instructions: Combine vinegar and next 5 ingredients in a small saucepan. Heat over medium low heat, stirring occasionally, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat, stir in cabbage wedges and olives. Can be served warm or cold. This salad is good hot or cold.

title: Walnut-Woozed Snow peas

instructions: Heat marsala in large pot on medium heat. Add veal and onions and lightly brown. Cover. Simmer 1 1/2 minutes, stirring occasionally. Uncover. Add cabbage and sprinkle with herbs. Cover. Simmer on high, stirring occasionally for 15 minutes, or until cabbage is tender and veal cooked. Add vodka and cook until vodka is absorbed.

title: Thai Beef Stew

instructions: Cut beef into 1-inch cubes. Place beef in crockpot. Combine remaining ingredients except mustard seeds and pepper. Pour over beef. Cover and cook on low heat 8 - 10 hours, or until meat is tender. Stir in mustard seeds and pepper. Serve with rice.

title: Deep Fried Beans (Tortilla De Frijoles Y Queso)

instructions: Make the beans, in a medium bowl, combine the beans with any liquid from the package. Refrigerate overnight. Drain the beans, reserving the liquid. Make the quesadillas, remove the beans from the refrigerator and pat dry with paper towels. Heat 1/2 cup canola oil in a large deep skillet over medium high heat. Remove the bean mixture to a paper towel lined plate. Repeat with remaining bean mixture. While the bean mixture is cooking, make the filling. Drop 1 tablespoon of filling onto the center of each tortilla. Fold in the sides until they are semicircular.

instructions: Coat a large nonstick skillet with cooking spray and add steak. Cook over medium heat until browned, stirring occasionally but not browned.

instructions: Cook pasta, drain and rinse. Set aside to cool. While pasta is cooking heat remaining ingredients, except cheese, for sauce together and heat through. Reserve one cup of sauce. Add orange juice as needed for a tangy extra flavor. You may garnish with parsley if desired.

title: Spicy Molasses Pork Tenderloin
ingredients: 2 pounds pork tenderloin | 4 ounces milk chocolate chips | 2 tablespoons molasses | 1/4 cup shredded american cheese
instructions: Slice tenderloins in half lengthwise, and place at least 1 inch apart on greased, foil lined baking sheets. Bake at 450 degrees f until light brown, 15 to 20 minutes. Cool.

title: Cheese En Papillote (Mexican Style Pizza)

instructions: Heat oven to 425 f degrees. Spread the pizza crust with yoghurt if using. Sprinkle with jalepeno, and top with remaining ingredients. Bake 12 - 14 minutes or until cheese is lightly browned and hot.

title: Salsa and Rice Crostini
ingredients: 1 baguette, sliced | 250 g philadelphia cream cheese, softened | 2 tablespoons cornflour | 2 tablespoons brown rice, cook & dry | 1 cup salsa
instructions: Sauté rice with cream cheese, add salsa and mix well. Put baguette slices on a baking tray and spread with salsa mixture. Bake at 180 degrees celsius. For 20 minutes or until golden brown.

instructions: In microwave safe bowl, cover quinoa with boiling water.

instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl. Pour into a lightly greased pie pan or 2 quart or 9 1/2 round baking dish. Cook at 375 degrees, covered, for 30 minutes or until top is golden brown.

title: Kythoni Glyko (Chocolate Filling)

instructions: Place chocolate and chervil in a heavy 8 ounce pot over low to medium heat. Store in the refrigerator. You can also stuff the mixture into a mini foil wrapped candy jar, or use for decoration.

title: Hungarian Sesame Dumplings
ingredients: 1/2 pound ground lean pork | 1 package small fresh chanterelle mushrooms | 1/4 cup sesame oil | 3 cups all-purpose flour | 1 tablespoon sesame oil, divided
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Mix the ground pork, mushrooms and 2 tablespoons sesame oil together thoroughly. Roll into golf ball sized balls, and place the dumplings on the prepared baking sheet. Using your thumb, rub the bottom of the dumplings around the inside of the dumplings, tilting the pan so that all sides are coated. Return the dumplings to the oven for 15 minutes, or until tender. Serve with soy sauce.

title: Homemade Oil for Artisan Passover Sandwich

instructions: Pour olive oil into a small, heavy frying pan or saucepan, and pour in enough olive oil to completely cover the surface. Transfer to a glass jar or jar cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate until very hot and starting to get pungent, at least 1 day. Use as needed, and enjoy.

title: Chicken Stove
ingredients: 1 whole chickens, cut into 8 pieces | 1 cup small curd cottage cheese
instructions: Rinse chicken pieces and pat dry. Place in a roasting pan and place fat side up on top of chicken pieces. Season with salt and pepper. Let cook in the oven, about 1 hour at 275 degrees f, and then turn over, and let cook about 20 minutes more. Drain. In a bowl combine cottage cheese and 2 tablespoons of water, stirring well. Spread over chicken pieces and serve.

title: Pan-Fried Scallops
ingredients: 8 sea scallops, unpeeled | 1 head fresh flat-leaf parsley, leaves only, rinsed and snipped | 2 cans whole kernel corn, drained of all liquid | 2 cloves garlic, coarsely chopped
instructions: Put scallops in a large skillet and cover with lightly salted water. Bring to a boil and immediately lower heat to medium. Place scallops on a platter and cover with hot cooked pasta. Garnish with chopped parsley slices, if desired.

title: Cabbage Napoleons
ingredients: 1 head cabbage, chopped | 1 medium orange bell pepper, chopped | 10 ounces frozen corn, thawed | 12 ounces apple juice | 2 teaspoons white wine vinegar | 6 tablespoons dry white wine | 2 teaspoons liquid smoke
instructions: Combine all ingredients except cabbage in a large bowl. Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour. Place cabbage on a double layer of heavy duty foil, then spray with cooking spray. Spray foil with additional cooking spray if desired. Place cabbage mixture on top of the foil in a single layer. Cover and refrigerate for 2 hours. Remove vegetables from refrigerator about 1 hour before serving, to allow juices to redistribute. Slice cabbage thinly using a large biscuit cutter or a serrated knife. Arrange on a platter surrounded by hot, white wine or pumpernickel bread.

title: Chi Chi's Green Chile Enchiladas or Chimichurri
ingredients: 2 cans green chilies, drained and cut into wedges | 1/2 cup vegetable broth | 1/4 cup orange liqueur | 18 -24 small red enchilada or 18 -24 small white corn tortillas
instructions: Heat broth and liqueur in a medium saucepan over medium heat and simmer until slightly reduced and reduced, about 5 minutes. Combine chilis, vegetable broth and 1/2 cup reserved cooking liquid. Heat until heated through, about 3 minutes. Spread about 2 tablespoons chili mixture in the bottoms of a 9x13 baking dish and roll up. Pour 1/2 of the reserved cooking liquid and sauce into the tortillas and fold over the chimichurri. Place seam side down in the baking dish. Cover and refrigerate for at least 20 minutes.. Remove from the refrigerator during baking. Note, if you are preparing this ahead of time, it may take up to 2 hours and refrigeration time, but i'm reluctant to go over the time recommended on the package. Makes 10 or 15 servings.

title: Tea Smack
ingredients: 1 can sweetened condensed tea ( not hot ) | 1 teaspoon old bay seasoning
instructions: Pour the tea can down the side of the canning funnel for easy removal. Add old bay to tea canning funnel. Place canning funnel in a deep heavy bottomed jar. Fill canning jar two thirds full with strong tea. Cover and store in the fridge.

title: Fig and Garlic Studded Salmon
ingredients: 3 large figs | 3 ounces steak, trimmed | 3 ounces salmon steak | 1 1/2 teaspoons seasoning salt | 1/2 cucumber, peeled, sliced
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees. Place figs on half of a sheet of foil and flatten to about 1 1/2. Place the steak on top with the figs and fold the sides over. Sprinkle the fish with seasoning salt and slice the cucumber. Wrap up the foil and bake for 15 minute serve. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: turnip,shrimp,spice,enchilada sauce,alfredo sauce,beef rib,tequila,red chili pepper
title: Albondigas Mexicana
ingredients: 2 lbs beef short ribs, cut into 3/4 inch squares | 1 package enchilada sauce | 3 tablespoons tequila | 3 cups alfredo sauce | 1/2 lb turnip, peeled and cut into chunks | 3 dried red chili peppers | 3 tablespoons masa mixed spice | 48 medium shrimp, cooked
instructions: Combine ingredients in a bowl.

title: Easy Chicken Wings
ingredients: 2 tablespoons olive oil | 2 pounds skinless, boneless chicken wings
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. Place the chicken wings in the skillet, and fry until the wings are browned, and no longer pink inside, approximately 10 minutes. Drain well, and sprinkle with salt. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: kosher salt,italian salad dressing,eggplant,romano cheese,thyme sprig,creme fraiche,bread,cardamom pod
title: Couscous Eggplant
ingredients: 4 medium eggplants, seeded and quartered | coarse kosher salt | 4 cups good quality country-style stale bread, crusts cut off if they are too soft, if you do not wish to | 1 1/2 cups creme fraiche or 1 1/2 cups sour cream, whisked and well chilled | fresh thyme sprig ( optional ) | 1 package fresh italian salad dressing, mixed with | 1/4 cup freshly grated romano cheese or 1/4 cup parmesan cheese | 5 cardamom pods | fresh oregano ( optional ) or fresh parsley sprig ( optional )
instructions: Adjust oven rack to middle position and heat to 350°f line a rimmed baking sheet with foil. Arrange eggplant halves on pan and sprinkle lightly with kosher salt. Bake until very tender when pierced with a fork, about 15 minutes. Set aside until cool enough to handle. Remove and discard skins from bread, leaving just enough to make croutons. Place bread crumbs in a large bowl and toss with 1/8 teaspoon salt until bread crumbs are evenly moist. Add croutons and enough creme fraiche or sour cream to moisten. Add thyme sprigs if using, if using and cardamom pods and oregano or parsley. Taste and season if desired. Spoon mixture into 6 ramekins and place in a roasting pan. Cover pan tightly with foil and place in hot oven. Bake until eggplant is very tender, about 45 minutes. Set aside to cool slightly. Stir gently to break up any clumps. Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Spicy Black coffee Beans
ingredients: 16 ounces of fresh black coffee | 14 fluid ounces of hot chili paste | 1 lb raw peeled prawns
instructions: Place the black coffee beans and chili paste in the jug of a coffee grinder. Process for 10 seconds, then strain through a sieve onto another jug. Repeat until all the beans are processed. Remove the prawns from their shells and place in the jug with the beans and coffee paste. Stir well to combine. Allow the mixture to sit for at least an hour before serving.

Random Ingredients: cayenne,parsley flake,vanilla extract,beef bouillon cube,apple cider,bread crumb,papaya,chickpea flour
title: Beef, Chickpea, and Papaya Fritters
ingredients: 1 can chickpea flour | 1/4 cup bread crumbs | 1/4 teaspoon fresh parsley flakes | 1/4 cup low-sodium beef base or 1/4 cup beef bouillon cube | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne | 2 large apples, preferably one with the skin on, cored and chunked | 1 1/2 teaspoons papayas, ground
instructions: In a medium bowl, sift together chickpea flour, bread crumbs, parsley flakes, beef base, sugar, vanilla, and cayenne. Add apples, tossing to combine. Cover loosely and refrigerate at least one hour. Heat griddle or skillet over medium high heat. To cook fritters, in 1/2 cup measure, make small indentations on top of mixture. Spoon about 2 t. Of batter with 1/2 t. Of a tap water into center of each indentation. Cook until top bubbles up and fritters are slightly firm, 1 - 2 min or until puffed and center is dry. Turn and cook until second side crisps and fritters are crisped, about 1 - 2 min. Repeat with remaining batter until all fritters are cooked. Serve fritters hot with yogurt and/or powdered sugar, if desired.

title: Irish Cabbage and Eggs
ingredients: 1 cabbage | 2 eggs
instructions: Cut all leaves and cook on low heat. Do not overcook. Put cabbage on plate and beat eggs. Pour egg on top. Serve hot or cold.

Random Ingredients: black bean,vanilla,ranch dressing,pecorino romano cheese,linguine,vanilla bean,double cream,tortilla chip
title: Pasta With Black Beans and Fresh Tortilla Chips
ingredients: 6 ounces linguine | 2 cups black beans, drained | 1 vanilla bean, sliced | 3 cups double cream | 2 tablespoons real vanilla no-sugar-needed artificial sweetened cream | 2 cups freshly grated pecorino romano cheese | 1 pint freshly made vanilla bean, scraped | 4 large tortilla chips, preferably the crisp kind, halved
instructions: Bring a 10 inch pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook the linguine as directed on the package.

title: Cafe Rio Lamb
ingredients: 1 lb ground lamb | 1/2 teaspoon cracked black pepper | 1/2 cup marsala wine | 1/2 chipotle chili sauce
instructions: Combine meat with pepper and half the marsala wine in a medium bowl stir together using a fork until well combined. Shape into eight patties. Cook patties over high heat for 5 minutes. Turn patties, season with adobo sauce.

Random Ingredients: sesame seed oil,dark brown sugar,cellophane noodle,white pepper,cheddar cheese,grain mustard,caper,anchovy fillet
title: Baked Noodles With Capers & Anchovies
ingredients: 4 ounces cellophane noodles ( or thin sliced if desired ) | 1 tablespoon sesame seed oil | 1 tablespoon can anchovy fillets or 12 anchovy rings, drained | 1/4 cup dark brown sugar | 1 1/2 teaspoons coarse grain mustard | 1 1/2 teaspoons white pepper | 6 tablespoons capers | crusty cheddar cheese ( for garnish )
instructions: For the sauce, soak anchovies in cold water to plump them for 10 minutes. Drain and pat dry with paper towels. In a small bowl, combine remaining ingredients except cabbage, cheese and sesame seeds and set aside. Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Grease a 9 x 13 inch baking dish. In a medium bowl, combine noodles with sauce just before using. Spread noodles in prepared baking dish then top with capers. Bake covered for 25 minutes or until bubbly. Sprinkle with cheese and sesame seeds, if desired, and serve.

title: Green Chile Salsa
ingredients: 2 cups tomatoes and green chilies, drained and chopped | 1/4 teaspoon salt
instructions: Combine and heat thoroughly, but do not boil serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: cumin,pumpkin,thai fish sauce,white bread,lemon juice zest,nut
title: Nutty Pumpkin Patties
ingredients: 1 package refrigerated white bread ( not dry white bread ) | 2 tablespoons fresh-squeezed lemon juice ( fresh ) | 1/4 cup thai fish sauce ( nam pla ) | 2/3 teaspoon ground cumin | 1 1/2 lbs fresh pumpkin or 1 1/2 lbs winter squash, cut into 3/4-inch cubes | 1/4 cup chopped nuts ( pecans, walnuts, etc. for topping )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f generously oil a 4 to 5 quart shallow baking dish. Place bread and lemon juice in a medium bowl, cover with plastic wrap and set aside. Whisk fish sauce, cumin and salt and pepper in a medium bowl. Add pumpkin, nuts and lemon mixture to bread and stir until moist but not sticky. Spread bread mixture into prepared dish and bake until golden brown, about 50 minutes, topping with tomato based salsa if desired. Serve hot or cold. Makes 8 servings.

Random Ingredients: sherry wine,orange,olive oil,pie crust,heavy cream,plum tomato
title: Red Tartiflette
ingredients: 2 refrigerated pie crusts, thawed if frozen | 2 cups heavy cream ( may use low-fat ) | 1/2 cup dry sherry wine | 1 medium plum tomato, sliced | sliced orange ( for garnish ) ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon olive oil
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°f lightly coat a 9 pie pan with cooking spray. Unroll the crusts on a large piece of waxed paper, and cut each into 4 thin circles, cutting each into quarters. You can also use a 6 inch round or oval shaped tartlet pan if you have them. Divide the cream among four pastry circles, arranging them in a circle around the edges. Pour in wine, cover the circle, and bake for 20 - 25 minutes or until the crust is golden and the filling is bubbly. Meanwhile, for the topping, toss together the tomato, orange slices, and olive oil. Remove tartiflette from oven, and place on top of the cream cheese and tomato mixture. Return to the oven, and bake an additional 2 - 3 minutes, or until the topping is bubbly and the tomatoes are crisp and starting to brown.

title: Nettet Snack (Stir Fry)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs cleaned squid | 2 1/2 lbs prawns or 2 1/2 lbs snails | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds | 1/4 teaspoon horseradish | 3 tablespoons fish sauce | 2 tablespoons fresh parsley flakes, chopped
instructions: Clean squid and prawns leaving skin on. Cut squid in bite sizes. Arrange squid, prawns and mustard in a 2 quart baking dish or baking dish and place the seafood in that order around the squid. Sprinkle horseradish and parsley over the top. Cover the seafood and sprinkle with fish sauce. Cover loosely with aluminium foil and place in 350 degree oven for 45 minutes. Remove foil and bake until prawn meat is hot and seafood is cooked through.

title: Chayote Cheese Fondue (Or Chayote Cheese)
ingredients: 1 chayote | 4 tablespoons chablago champagne | 100 -200 g ricotta cheese | 1 -2 teaspoon dried oregano | 2 tablespoons dark rum
instructions: Peel and slice chayote into cubes, about 1/8 inch thick. Place the chayote cubes in a pan with the champagne, then bring to a simmer. Mash the ricotta with a fork, then place in a bowl. Add the oregano and rum. Season with salt and pepper to taste. When ready to serve, pour into fondue pot or fondue tureen.

title: Irish Pork Roll-ups
ingredients: 3/4 - 1 lb pork tenderloin, cut into 1/4 in slices | 4 large parsnips, peeled, cut in half and cut crosswise into 1/2/3 to 3/4-inch slices and crosswise into 1/3-inch slices | 1/2 lb smoked sausage, cut into 1/2 inch slices | 1/4 cup sour cream
instructions: Heat 1/3 qts water in 10 skillet over medium high heat. Sprinkle pork with salt and pepper. Quickly sear pork, 1 1/2 minutes per side. Stir in parsnips and sausage. Cook, uncovered, over low heat, turning once, until hot and crisp, about 6 - 8 minutes. Remove pork& sausage. Cut pork into 1 1/2 in chunks. Spoon pork& parsnips into shallow dish.

title: Cottage Turnips
ingredients: 2 turnips, peeled, but with the skin on | 1/2 lb velveeta cheese | 4 tablespoons flour
instructions: Cut and peel turnips, cut in half and toss with the flour. Brown on both sides until tender.

title: Toffee, Kumara, Chilli Dessert
ingredients: 1 package frozen whipped topping, thawed | 1 small kumara | 1/2 cup sweet red wine | 3 tablespoons golden syrup, warmed | 1/2 cup glace cherries or 1/2 cup glace apricot, cut into quarters
instructions: Cook kumara until tender then cool slightly. Chop kumara and place in medium serving bowl. Pour over the browned sour kumara, adding the rest. Mix. Serve warm with extra sweetened syrup.

title: Easy Slow Cooked Beef
ingredients: 4 -5 pounds beef chuck steak | 3 tablespoons worcestershire sauce
instructions: Trim excess fat from steak. In a large plastic bag, distribute worcestershire sauce. Add steak and coat in mixture. Heat in a slow cooker for 8 to 10 hours on low. Remove beef from slow cooker, and let stand for 10 to 15 minutes. Slice the steak in 1/2 inch slices, and serve with your choice of side dish.

Random Ingredients: pork,vegetable stock,chicken stock cube,pinto bean jalapeno pepper,saffron thread,anise seed,chili oil,peanut butter
title: Choclo
ingredients: 2 pints vegetable stock ( or water based ) | 1/4 cup chili oil | 1 pork shind with bones | 2 tablespoons saffron threads | 2 canned chipotle peppers in adobo with dashes of saffron infused with oil, plus the equivalent of about 2-1/2 tsp. dried chipotles in sugar | 1 chicken stock cube, crumbled ( knorr ) | 3/4 cup crunchy peanut butter | 1 teaspoon salt | 10 cups cooked pinto beans or 10 cups cooked jalapeno peppers
instructions: Combine all the ingredients in a large saucepan. Bring the mixture slowly to boiling, then reduce the heat and simmer, uncovered, until the mixture is thick and creamy. Stir occasionally as the solids settle to the bottom and to ensure the solids don't stick to the base of the pan.. Stir in the peanuts just before the final cooking stage. Serve the choclo with warm crusty bread.

title: Roasted Neck Lamb
ingredients: 1 boneless leg of lamb | 3 fresh pears
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees f. Spread the lamb with olive oil, season with salt and pepper and place on a rack in a roasting pan. Roast in the preheated oven for 45 minutes. When ready to serve, remove the roast from the oven and pour off all of the fat from the roasting pan. Cover the roast with the pears, cut into wedges and serve with the warm pan juices.

Random Ingredients: white sugar,milk chocolate,chicken tenderloin,brandy,currant,plain yogurt,pork loin
title: Quick and Easy Churros
ingredients: 2 chicken tenderloins | 2 lbs pork loin | 16 ounces plain yogurt | 2 1/2 ounces milk chocolate | 6 ounces currants | 1/4 cup white sugar | 1/4 cup brandy
instructions: Grill chicken tenders under a broiler or until fully cooked. When cool enough to handle, slice into strips. Cut pork loin into strips. Chop meat into strips as if you were preparing churros. In heavy bottomed heavy pot over low heat melt chocolate& currants. When melted, add meat and turn over in chocolate mixture and turn off heat. In a shallow bowl, combine yogurt, sugar& brandy. Fill bowls with churros and pour yogurt mixture over top.

Random Ingredients: olive oil,allspice berry,jasmine rice,caraway seed,vanilla essence,pink bean
title: Pissalé a La Vainlou #2
ingredients: 2 cups jasmine rice | 3/4 cup pink beans ( if available ) | 2 tablespoons caraway seeds | 2 dried allspice berries | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla essence | 2 tablespoons olive oil
instructions: Place all dry ingredients in a pot, and turn the stove to its lowest setting. Place your cast iron pan on the burner and turn the burner on until the temperature reaches 250 degrees. Place the cast iron pan back on the burner and place it into the oven for 25 minutes before releasing the contents of the pot into the rice cooker. If you have a cast iron pan, place that in your kitchen sink and turn the burner off before the entire process goes out. Once the rice cooker is cooked, fluff with an iron, and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: peach,heavy cream,gruyere cheese,spanish onion,italian turkey sausage link
title: Spicy Creamy Italian Sausage and Peaches
ingredients: 1 jar sweet italian turkey sausage links | 1 jar sliced peaches | 1 package shredded gruyere cheese | 1 cup heavy cream | 1/2 cup shredded spanish onion
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Lightly grease a 9x13 inch baking dish. Open a jar of the hot, sweet sausage and slice them into slices. Arrange sausage slices on the bottom of the baking dish. Mix together the sausage, peaches, gruyere cheese, cream, and onion in a bowl. Pour the cream mixture over the sausage. Bake in the preheated oven until sausage is hot and bubbling, about 45 minutes.

Random Ingredients: cream,grain white rice,cremini mushroom,seasoning salt,allspice,peach,tahini sauce
title: Mushroom Rice Bowl With Allspice
ingredients: 4 cups cooked long-grain white rice ( i like orlando brand jasmine ) | 1/2 cup sour cream | 3 tablespoons tahini sauce | 2 tablespoons quick-cooking seasoning salt ( i use spike ) | 1/2 teaspoon allspice | 1 1/2 cups sliced cremini mushrooms | 1 cup sliced peeled fresh peaches
instructions: Combine all ingredients in small serving bowl. Serve immediately.

title: Simple Green Salsa
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups green salsa ( such as pepitas ) | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
instructions: Simply stir in a medium size bowl. Pour the contents of the bowl into a food processor or blender.

title: Pine-Sherry Glazed Raisins
ingredients: 1 lb golden raisin | 1/4 cup sherry wine
instructions: Cover raisins with cold water and bring to a boil. Reduce to simmer and cook, covered, for 1 1/2 to 2 hours until tender and swollen. Drain excess water and discard. Combine reserved raisins with sherry and warm raisins in bowl.

title: Pepperoni's Thai Chicken
ingredients: 2 tablespoons peanut butter | 1/4 cup triple sec | 1/2 cup vodka | 1 1/2 lbs boneless skinless chicken thighs | 1 medium ripe pear, peeled, cored, diced | 3 cups hot cooked rice
instructions: In a small bowl, mix peanut butter with triple sec. Rub the mixture onto the boneless thighs, and place in a shallow baking dish or casserole dish in a single layer. Sprinkle with diced pear. Cover. Bake at 375°f for 75 - 80 minutes, or until the chicken is no longer pink and the sauce is bubbly. Serve over hot cooked rice.

title: Gorgonzola French Bread
ingredients: 2 1/2 teaspoons dry yeast | 1/2 cup sherry wine | 1 1/2 cups gorgonzola, crumbled | 1 teaspoon unsweetened cocoa powder | 1 can diced green chiles, drained
instructions: Dissolve yeast in sherry. Stir in cheeses and cocoa. Beat until thoroughly combined. Add the green chiles. Turn the dough onto a well floured work surface, and knead until smooth and a little bit more elastic, about 8 minutes. Place in a greased bowl, and turn the dough over several times in the bowl so the entire surface is covered. Cover the bowl, and let rise in a warm place until doubled in volume, about 1 hour. Grease a baking sheet well with oil. Turn the dough out onto the prepared baking sheet. Cover the pan, and let rise in a warm place until doubled in volume, about 45 minutes. Bake in the preheated oven until golden brown, about 25 minutes.

title: Olive-Zinfandel
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons pine nuts, toasted | 1/4 cup white rice wine, or as needed
instructions: Combine the pine nuts in a dry skillet over medium heat. Toast the pine nuts until dark, about 5 minutes. Stir frequently as pine nuts can burn easily. Stir in the rice wine. Stir just until the wine reduces by 1/4. Pour olive oil into a glass jar, or funnel it through a muslin lined sieve into a jar. Seal and store in the refrigerator up to 1 week, shaking the jar once a week. Use as directed in recipes calling for olive oil, chicken stock, or wine.

title: Grilled Cheese With Cherry Tomatoes and Creamy Marshmallow Dippers
ingredients: 4 teaspoons unsalted hot marshmallow creme | 1 baguette, cut into 1-inch rounds | 1/4 cup canned cherry tomatoes | 1 package mini marshmallows, miniature candies
instructions: To assemble the baguette, arrange the rounds on a baking sheet. Cover with plastic wrap and set aside at room temperature until ready to grill, about 30 minutes. Preheat a grill pan to medium hot. Toast the bread on the grill until golden brown and crisp, about 3 minutes, then rub it with the creme to soften. Transfer to serving plates. Divide the cherry tomatoes among the baguette rounds, and top with mini marshmallows. Top the marshmallow side with the grilled cheese slices.

Random Ingredients: littleneck clam,chicken breast meat,salsa,mushroom,canadian bacon,nutmeg,lemon juice zest
title: Spicy Clam Chowder
ingredients: 2 slices canadian bacon | 2 cooked boneless skinless chicken breast meat | 1 can littleneck clams, drained, juice reserved | 1 jar salsa | 1/4 cup shredded mixed mushrooms | 2 lemon slices, with crusty tops | 1/4 teaspoon grated nutmeg
instructions: In a slow cooker, layer bacon and chicken. Cover chicken with clam juice and pour remaining salsa over. Cover, and cook on low for 10 hours. In a cup, mix together mushrooms, lemon peel and lemon peels. Fold mixture into clam mixture. Cover, and cook on high for 5 more hours, or on low for 1 hour, stirring occasionally. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: white rice,grand marnier,dark chocolate,red potato,chicken bouillon,fennel seed
title: Easy Red Potato Brown Rice
ingredients: 1/2 cup dried white rice | 1 tablespoon fennel seed | 1 cube chicken bouillon | 1/8 cup grand marnier | 2 tablespoons dark chocolate, finely chopped | 1 ounce diced dark chocolate, finely chopped | 1/3 cup diced red potatoes
instructions: Combine all ingredients except potatoes in an 8 qt. Saucepan. Cover and bring to a boil. Turn heat to low and simmer, covered, until liquid is absorbed and rice is tender, about 30 - 40 minutes. Gently stir in potatoes and chocolate. Let stand for 5 minutes. Note, after rice is cooked, it will be more flavorful. Makes a delicious snack for lunch.

Random Ingredients: grain rice,seasoning salt,chinese five spice powder,lettuce leaf,salt pork
title: Chinese Five-Spice Fried Rice
ingredients: 2 lbs salt pork, cut into 1 inch cubes, about 3/4-inch squares | 1 tablespoon chinese five spice powder | 1/2 teaspoon salt, to taste | 3 3 cups cooked long-grain rice or 3 1/2 cups rice | 5 10 large lettuce leaves or 5 large napa cabbage leaves
instructions: In a large deep skillet, add pork pieces and sprinkle with five spice powder, stir until they are well coated. Increase heat and, stirring, cook for 2 - 3 minutes, until pork is lightly colored. Stir in remaining ingredients, except lettuce and rice. Bring to boil. Cover skillet and reduce heat to low and cook, stirring occasionally for about 15 - 20 minutes, until mixture has thickened and pork pieces are cooked through. Stir in lettuce for a last minute or two before serving.

title: Lebanese Leekie Party Liqueur
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs leeks, trimmed and sliced lengthwise ( about 12 cups ) | 2 teaspoons ground cardamom seed | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne, plus a pinch | 1 1/4 teaspoons ground cardamom ( about 50g ) | 24 soft ladyfingers
instructions: Trim the leeks leaving root ends attached.

title: Green Hot Chili Paste
ingredients: 4 dried anaheim chilies | 3/4 cup red currant jelly | 3 tablespoons flour
instructions: Wash and place peppers in a pan with just enough water to cover. Bring to a boil. Boil 4 to 6 minutes. Cool and peel peppers. Strain peppers. Put hot peppers in blender and add just enough water to cover. Add 1 tbsp of flour, blending in and blending until smooth. Stir in remaining ingredients.

Random Ingredients: yellow pepper,mango chutney,vegetable oil,cornbread stuffing mix,beef rib,wonton wrapper
title: Sweet Heat Beef Cubes
ingredients: 24 wonton wrappers | 1 lb beef ribs | 1/2 cup chopped yellow pepper | 1/2 cup chopped sweet yellow pepper | 1/2 cup mango chutney | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil
instructions: Soak wonton wrappers in hot water. In a skillet, saute pork ribs in oil. Remove from skillet. Stir fry peppers, mango chutney and beef in drippings. Drain water from pan. To each won ton wrapper, place a portion of filling. Close, seal edges with water. Arrange on cookie sheet. Repeat for other wrappers. Spray tops with oil. Bake at 365 degrees for 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray,black olive,creole seasoning,basmati rice,sauerkraut,red curry paste
title: Red Curry Sauerkraut & Rice With Black Olives (Baked)
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 3 cups sauerkraut, drained, rinsed, and well drained | 1 tablespoon red curry paste | 2 -3 tablespoons creole seasoning ( or spicy ) | 2 -4 tablespoons chopped black olives | 7 -10 cups cooked basmati rice
instructions: Spray an 8 x 8 baking dish with oil cooking spray. Heat oven to 350f/190c. Put sauerkraut, curry paste, black olives and creole seasoning in a bowl. Pour mixture in dish and add enough water to a 1 1/2 depth. Bake uncovered for about 30 - 35 minutes.

title: Lengu's Nasi Lemak
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh coriander leaves, washed
instructions: Wash and dry the corriander leaves well. Separate the leaves and discard them. Blend into a fine paste using a mortar and pestle or your choice of grinding device. Place in a glass bowl with a 1 inch of room room between them. Cover with a damp cloth and chill for 1 hour. When ready to serve, stir the paste into the chilled corriander leaves. Serve with plain boiled or roast potatoes.

title: Broa Flaming Eye
ingredients: 2 1/2 tablespoons whole wheat flour | 1 beef eye round ( such as haggis brand ) | 16 olives
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a resealable plastic bag and shake to blend. Remove about 3 tablespoons of the beef fat from inside the bag with a sharp knife or a long handled spoon and place in the bag with the beef and seal. Transfer the bag to the refrigerator and allow to rest at least 30 minutes or up to 1 day. In a small skillet, sear the sausages in a bit of the olive oil over medium heat, turning only once, until nicely browned and cooked to desired doneness, about 15 minutes. Serve immediately with crackers or assorted garnishes.

Random Ingredients: vanilla essence,swiss cheese,radicchio,chanterelle mushroom,ranch dressing mix
title: Swiss Cheese Stuffed Mushrooms
ingredients: 24 unpopped fresh chanterelle mushrooms | 24 slices swiss cheese | prepared ranch dressing mix | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence | 2 tablespoons swiss cheese blend, grated
instructions: Heat oven to 400°f place mushrooms on a jelly roll pan or cookie sheet. Cover mushrooms with cheese. Bake for 10 minutes or until golden brown on top.

title: Raspberry and Black-Eyed Pea Salad
ingredients: 2 cups black-eyed peas | 1 apple, grated | 1 tablespoon palm sugar, grated | 1 tablespoon fish sauce | 1 1/2 tablespoons dried raspberries
instructions: Preheat oven to 200degc/180degc if using conventional oven. Bake black eyed peas for approx 30 - 40 mins stirring twice though. Toss with a little oil to keep from sticking together and leave to cool further. In the meantime, place the remaining ingredients in a pot with a good splash of water. Bring to the boil, then simmer for approx 10 - 15 mins. Toss through the black eyed peas and leave to cool, then eat. Enjoy.

title: Spicy Porridge
ingredients: 2 teaspoons red curry paste | 1 ounce porridge oats | 2 tablespoons soup
instructions: Heat the soup in a pan, add the curry paste and oats and stir through. To serve, scatter over chopped coriander and serve hot.

title: Simple and Delicious Blackened Limeade
ingredients: 6 large limes, juice of | cayenne pepper, to taste | 1 can limeade concentrate, chilled
instructions: Pour the lime juice and cayenne pepper into a 2 quart pitcher. Add remaining ingredients. Stir all ingredients together. Refrigerate, covered, for at least 6 hours before serving. Serve with corn chips.

title: Potato and Parsnip Fritters
ingredients: 500 g baking potatoes | 1/3 cup white flour | 1/3 cup flour | 5 g sesame seeds | 5 g anise seeds | 3 g parsnips or 3 g turnips
instructions: Mash potatoes and mix together with white ingredients. Form mixture into small patties. Heat sesame, flour, seeds and parsnip on the frying pan. Add potato patties, fry till golden brown on both sides turning frequently. Serve immediately.

title: Namibian Burritos
ingredients: 1 can flaked coconut | 2 teaspoons crushed chili oil | 1 teaspoon hot pepper sauce | 1 package burrito-size flour tortillas
instructions: Mix together coconut, chili oil, and hot pepper sauce. Spread enough on each 1/2 cup burrito size flour tortilla to cover the surface of the tortilla. Roll burritos up like a jelly roll. Chill well before serving.

title: Red and White Spiced Vegetable Burgers
ingredients: 25 red potatoes | 1 zucchini | 2 small red potatoes | 1/4 cup quinoa, rinsed well and drained ( can use instant or quick-cooking rice ) | 1/2 teaspoon asafoetida powder ( optional-it's too spicy! ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons flour
instructions: Wash potatoes and cut into large chunks. Cut zucchini into 1/2 inch cubes. Cut potatoes into quarters lengthwise and then cut strips into 1/4 inch cubes. Cook zucchini in a saucepan with enough water to just cover it. Add quinoa and a pinch of salt. When the water comes to a boil, add potatoes and boil gently until tender. Drain well and mash with a fork or potato masher until mixture is smooth. Add zucchini, potatoes and asafoetida. Serve in pita pockets and drizzle with olive oil. Makes a little over two cups.

Random Ingredients: milk,vanilla wafer,saffron thread,black mustard seed,barley,green pea,mayonnaise,egg noodle
title: Mashed Potato Noodle and Vegetable Salad With Saffron
ingredients: 1 box rice-cooking noodles | 1 pinch saffron thread, crumbled | 2 eggs noodles, boiled and cubed | 1/2 cup milk | 1/2 cup green peas, cut in thirds | 1/2 - 1 cup mayonnaise | 2 teaspoons freshly ground black mustard seeds | 1/2 teaspoon saffron threads, crumbled | 2 teaspoons black mustard seeds
instructions: Place a small amount of water on the bottom of a rice cooker. Meanwhile, heat oven to 375 degrees. Place the rice, saffron and eggs noodles in a large bowl or pan. Mix with a wooden spoon. Place in the center of oven until the bottom is golden brown, and the nori or any part of the noodles is crisp. When the rice is done, add the remaining ingredients except mustard and mustard seeds and mix.

title: Egg & marshmallow Delight
ingredients: 2 large egg yolks | 1/2 cup mashed beans | 1/2 cup marshmallow & marshmallow creme | 1 teaspoon garlic salt | 1 tablespoon fresh coarse ground sando
instructions: Combine egg yolks, mashed beans, cheese, garlic salt & sando until well mixed. Add just enough marshmallow & marshmallow creme to mix. Pour the mixture into a glass dish. Using a spatula or a pastry brush, swirl the egg mixture around the edges so the marshmallow & marshmallow creme cover the dish with plastic wrap. Using a fork, spread the egg mixture evenly over the marshmallow base, pressing lightly with your spatula. Wrap the dish with a double thickness of aluminum foil or a damp towel. Refrigerate the dish under a cold tap for 12 minutes. Unwrap it &, using a sharp knife, remove the plastic wrap & place the dish under your towel. Carefully lift the foil, then peel off the plastic wrap. With a knife, cut several grooves into the top of the dish. Remove the dish from the refrigerator & set over a tray of boiling water. Bake in a preheated oven for 20 - 25 minutes or untill the marshmallow topping is bubbly & lightly browned.

title: Baked Mango & Cheddar Mango Salad
ingredients: 4 tomatoes, large chunks, halved | 4 mangoes, large chunks, cut into 2 cm thick slices | 1 teaspoon mild curry powder-sweetened rum | 2 -4 tablespoons cheddar cheese, shredded, plus extra for sprinkling | sea salt ( to season )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200c. Cut 4 large squares of baking parchment paper. Make sure the paper is very well buttered. Place the tomatoes and mango, cut side up in the baking paper. Sprinkle the curry powder and sprinkle over the cheese. Bake in the pre heated oven for 10 - 15 minutes, or until the tomatoes and mango have started to caramelise. Remove the paper from the oven and scatter a pinch of salt. Add the mango, tomatoes and mango to the baked salad and stir gently to combine. Serve warm or cool and serve chilled. If serving cold, put in an airtight container and store in a fridge.

Random Ingredients: great northern bean,taco seasoning mix,oregano,flour tortilla,panko breadcrumb,caster sugar,green cardamom pod
title: Chilean Bean Burritos
ingredients: 1/2 lb great northern bean ( canned, rinsed and drained ) | 1/4 teaspoon oregano | 1/2 teaspoon taco seasoning mix, see note | 4 large green cardamom pods, bruised | 1 tablespoon panko breadcrumbs ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons caster sugar | 8 -10 large flour tortillas, heated | salt and freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Note, i use no fat shredded meat, or fat free browned tofu. If using vegan do not use pomegranate juice or apple juice. The oil comes in several sizes at either end.

title: Sesame Broccoli on a Budget!
ingredients: 1 lb fresh broccoli, cut into bite size pieces | 2 tablespoons sesame seeds | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom, ground
instructions: Steam over boiling water 7 minutes, remove from heat and let cool in refrigerator. Place in bowl and cover with sesame oil for a little to crisp. Grate the spice bag of your choice and add to bowl with broccoli, stir to coat the broccoli with the sesame oil and cook for 4 minutes on each side. Watch closely so the sesame oil does not burn.

title: Cavatappi
ingredients: 3/4 lb cavatappi pasta | 1 tablespoon butter | 1 pinch cayenne pepper
instructions: Cook cavatappi in boiling salted water for 5 minutes or the desired temperature.

title: Panko and Sauerkraut
ingredients: 1 can sauerkraut | 1/4 cup panko breadcrumbs | 3/4 teaspoon dried marjoram
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Drain the kraut well and place in a baking dish. Sprinkle with the panko, marjoram and mix well. Spoon into a baking tin about 1 - 1 1/2 inches thick, and bake for 15 - 20 minutes, or until the tops are browned and crispy. Serve immediately.

title: Egyptian Plain Rice for the Pressure Cooker
ingredients: 1 cup long grain rice | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom seed
instructions: Wash the rice under running water. Heat the pressure cooker, and place a tight fitting lid on bottom of the lid. Once the steam starts to escape, put the lid on. Turn down the heat, close the lid, and wait 25 minutes on high pressure. Remove from heat, remove the lid, and fluff up the rice with a fork. When the rice is cooled, fluff up with a fork again, then put back into the cooker pot. When the pressure starts again, put it on low heat and wait 10 minutes on low pressure. Take the lid off of the pot, and turn on the pressure cooker again, leaving pressure on the cooker. Turn the rice cooker on high for 15 minutes, then let steam escape from the cooker.. When the rice is done, fluff up with a fork again, and serve.

title: Spiordas
ingredients: 3 packages mascarpone cheese | 1/2 teaspoon marjoram
instructions: In a mixing bowl, blend together the mascarpone cheese and marjoram. Cover and chill the cheese for at least 2 hours before serving to let the flavors develop.

title: Cake : Catfish With Guinness and Irish Cream Filling
ingredients: 4 teaspoons cream of tartar | 4 teaspoons icing sugar | 1 1/4 - 1 1/2 kg catfish fillets, fillet ( about 4 inches thick ) | 4 teaspoons guinness stout | 1 -2 tablespoon icing sugar, for dusting
instructions: Combine cream of tartar, icing sugar, and guinness stout with fork in a shallow bowl.

Random Ingredients: orange bell pepper,mini chocolate chip,black olive
title: Cajun Black Olive and Chip Rounds
ingredients: 1 package chopped black olives | 1/2 cup mini chocolate chip | 1/2 orange bell pepper, cut into thin strips
instructions: Microwave onion chip in large saucepan over high until melted, about 1 minute. Add sliced olives.

Random Ingredients: sun tomato oil,corn tortilla chip,pear,coffee crystal
title: Easy and Fast Hawaiian Pear and Coffee Nachos
ingredients: 2 cups crushed corn tortilla chips | 2 teaspoons coffee crystals | 2 whole ripe pears, cored, seeded and chopped | 1/2 tablespoon sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained
instructions: Pour chips into a large bowl. Add the coffee crystals and stir well. Stir in pears and sun dried tomatoes. Place in a single layer on a microwave safe plate. Cook on medium heat 1 to 2 minutes or until chips and pears are hot. Cut into wedges with a very sharp knife. Serve immediately.

title: Swiss Chard in Hard Boiled Eggs
ingredients: 1 bunch swiss chard leaves | 2 hard-boiled eggs | 1 medium unpeeled thickly sliced fresh strawberries
instructions: Trim ends from chard leaves. Separate leaves and trim stalks. Cut leaves and stalks into thin slices. Slice egg slices into halves, lengthwise, and set aside. Arrange chard leaves in a mound, about 3 to 4 inches in diameter. Arrange strawberry slices onto chard leaves.

title: Aubergine Spaghetti
ingredients: 500 g fresh aubergines, cut in half lengthways and then crossways into batons ( about 250g each ) | 1 1/4 liters tamari | 8 teaspoons dried chili flakes | 600 g spaghetti cappelini or 6 ounces spaghetti ( 3 1/2oz each )
instructions: Place aubergines, tamari, chilli flakes in a large saucepan and cover with cold water. Bring to the boil, reduce heat, simmer for 15 minutes. Cook spaghetti according to packet directions. Drain and toss with sausages.

title: Easy Spicy Refried Beans
ingredients: 1 can pinto beans ( refried beans ) | 1/2 cup ground chili pepper ( dried chili pepper )
instructions: Drain and rinse beans. Combine all ingredients and mash ingredients. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: grain white rice,tomato paste,cayenne,beetroot,portabella mushroom,buckwheat groat,flat leaf parsley
title: Beetroot and Mushroom Pilaf for One
ingredients: 6 large beetsroot, tops trimmed | 1 lb fresh portabella mushrooms or 1 lb white mushroom | 1 1/2 cups long-grain white rice ( not instant ) | 1 can tomato paste | 1 1/2 teaspoons cayenne ( or more, to taste ) | 3 tablespoons flat leaf parsley, minced | 1 cup buckwheat groats, halved
instructions: Combine beets and mushroom in saucepan or microwaveable container with tight fitting lid. Add enough simmering water to cover beets.

title: Swiss Cheese Rounds
ingredients: 2 ounces swiss cheese, cut 1/4 inch thick | 1 tablespoon canola oil | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh mint leaves
instructions: Cut cheese in half lengthwise. Place on cutting board. Using a 1 1/2 inch round biscuit cutter, cut into 36 slices. Arrange cheese in a circle on center of each piece of cheese. Over medium low heat, make a hole in the center of each slice with a fork. When cheese has melted, add mint leaves and cover cheese with another 1/4 inch round of cheese. Repeat process until all cheese has been prepared. Place on large plate and serve.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray,sesame seed,balsamic vinegar,jigger vodka,salmon fillet,topping
title: Ravioli With Spicy Smoked Salmon
ingredients: 8 salmon fillets, skin on | vegetable oil cooking spray | 1/4 cup sesame seeds | 2 teaspoons balsamic vinegar | 1 jigger vodka | 2 cups fresh whipped topping, thawed ( or whipped greek yogurt )
instructions: Spray both sides of salmon with veggie oil cooking spray. Sprinkle sesame seeds on fish, place salmon in a large baking dish. Preheat oven to 400°f. Combine balsamic vinegar, vodka and a half cup of ice cubes in a small jar, shake well. Pour over fish, seal tightly with plastic wrap. Roast in oven uncovered for 30 - 40 minutes or until done. To serve, spoon over warm creamy greek yogurt, drizzle with spiced balsamic reduction.

Random Ingredients: amaretto liqueur,raspberry,hungarian paprika,self rising flour,watermelon,gruyere cheese,jamon serrano
title: Watermelon Gratin (Sandino Al Limone)
ingredients: 4 cups watermelon, julienned | 4 cups shaved raspberries ( about 48 raspberries ) | 1 3/4 cups grated gruyere cheese | 2 tablespoons self-rising flour, or as needed | 2 tablespoons sweet hungarian paprika | 1 tablespoons amaretto liqueur, or as needed | 1 jamon serrano, minced, according to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Lightly oil gratin dishes or a 9x13 inch baking dish. Mix watermelon and raspberries in a bowl.

title: Easy French Onion Sandwiches
ingredients: 6 -8 hamburger buns | 3 tablespoons chicken bouillon
instructions: Bake the hamburger buns. Open them up a little and use a spoon to scoop in the bouillon onto one side of a bun, then add the meat. Close. The other side you should have a good, tasty sandwich.

Random Ingredients: catsup,chili sauce,green capsicum,green bell pepper,egg,maple syrup
title: Homemade Sweet and Sour Chilli
ingredients: 1 green bell pepper, sliced | 1 green capsicum, sliced | 1 tablespoon catsup | 2 tablespoons chili sauce | 1 tablespoon maple syrup | 1 egg, lightly beaten
instructions: Place pepper, capsicum & chilli sauce in a microwave safe bowl and cook on full power for 2 minutes or until the vegetables soften and have a little texture. Remove the bowl from the microwave, pour over the catsup & syrup and mix well. Add the egg & mix well. Heat for 1 minute, remove & serve with your favourite meal.

Random Ingredients: belgian endive,cantaloupe,mung bean sprout,chicken breast,salt pork,cold water
title: Grilled Belgian Endive and Puff Shell Soup
ingredients: 1 lb belgian endive, washed and cut into 12 sections | 2 belgian endive, washed, with all leaves, cut into 12 small sections | 2 -6 ounces pork belly fat ( or soft bacon ) or 2 -6 ounces salt pork fat ( or soft bacon ) | 6 cups cold water | 1/2 cup fresh mung bean sprouts, washed | 1 boneless chicken breast, cooked, cubed
instructions: Toss all ingredients in a large bowl. Cover and refrigerate 2 - 4 hours. The chicken should be chilled and not chilled completely. Place in a small bowl and mix with about 2 cups of cold water until the soup is a thick, soupy liquid. Do not use a stock pot. Place the soup in the refrigerator, put it back in the refrigerator for at least an hour and serve.

title: Lettuce Wrapped Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 pint grape tomatoes, halved | 1 1/2 green beets, sliced thin | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh dill | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh dill, or as desired
instructions: Place halved grape tomatoes, beets, sliced green chile slices, dill to a bowl. Toss to mix. Stir oyster sauce and remaining dill in a separate bowl. Spoon tomatoes around greens.

title: Beer-Glazed Turnips (Halwa Em Farcis)
ingredients: 4 large pints shucked halved turnip | 1/2 cup sliced shallots, halved | 1/2 cup raisins | 1/2 cup sesame oil | 2 egg whites | 2/3 cup light beer | 1 cup prunes ( in natural juices )
instructions: Remove pips from heads and cut in halves crosswise. In large bowl, combine shallots, raisins, sesame oil, egg whites, beer and prunes. Arrange halved turnips on rimmed baking sheet. Cover and refrigerate 1 hour. Drain off liquid. Preheat broiler. Arrange turnips on baking sheet.

Random Ingredients: flat leaf parsley,iceberg lettuce,leek,blueberry,part mozzarella cheese,parsley,apple
title: Warm Cheese, Red Rocket & Apple Salad
ingredients: 4 cups shredded iceberg lettuce | 2 apples, cored and chopped | 1 leek, sliced | 6 ounces blueberries, chilled | 1 tablespoon fresh flat-leaf parsley, torn | 2 tablespoons lowfat shredded part-skim mozzarella cheese | 1 tablespoon finely chopped fresh parsley
instructions: Place the lettuce, apples, and leek in a large salad bowl. Top with blueberries, parsley, and cheese. Garnish with the chopped parsley.

title: Roasted Parsnips
ingredients: 2 lbs parsnips | 2 teaspoons roasted mixed spice | olive oil | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Preheat the broiler. Cut the parsnips into thin wedges and place in a large mixing bowl. Drizzle with olive oil and season with salt and pepper. Mix well. Place on a foil lined baking sheet. Broil, turning once, until they turn brown around the sides about 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: red cabbage,white vinegar,extra sharp cheddar cheese
title: Red Cheddar Coleslaw
ingredients: 1/2 small red cabbage, coarsely shredded | 1/2 teaspoon white vinegar | 1/2 cup extra-sharp cheddar cheese, grated
instructions: In a medium bowl, toss the cabbage with the vinegar and grated cheese. Serve immediately.

title: Red Peppers with Honey
ingredients: 1 jar roasted red peppers, drained and patted dry with paper towels | 1/2 cup mirin | 1/4 cup liquid honey | 1 teaspoon herbes de provence
instructions: Place roasted red pepper in a heat resistant bowl, cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate until chilled, about 20 minutes. Unwrap red pepper, then slice diagonally in half, then cut in half again. Heat mirin and honey in a small saucepan until the honey is fragrant, about 1 minute. Remove from heat and add the red pepper halves.

title: Vinaigrette for Beef, Pork, or Chicken
ingredients: 4 oranges | 1 1/2 tablespoons rice vinegar | 3/4 cup frozen broth
instructions: Slice each orange lengthwise into 4 thin strips. Pour 1 1/2 tablespoons vinegar into a small bowl, drizzle with remaining 3 - 4 tablespoons of vinegar, and set aside. Place the rest of the ingredients into a food processor, and process until creamy, adding more vinegar as needed.

Random Ingredients: vanilla essence,coriander leaf,brown mustard seed,cooking wine,yogurt,garlic powder
title: Tandoori Dahi (Bunya Mustard Seeds and Beverage)
ingredients: 1/4 cup rice wine ( i used sweet rice wine ) or 1/4 cup cooking wine ( i used sweet rice wine ) | 4 tablespoons low-fat yogurt | 1 1/2 teaspoons vanilla essence | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder | 1 teaspoon black mustard seeds | 1 teaspoon coriander leaves ( optional )
instructions: Make sure you start with rice wine and let it dissolve to the water. Add the yogurt, vanilla and all the spices. Mix well. Put the mixed ingredients into a glass. Leave it in the fridge till it becomes cool and then serve. For one and a half days. Enjoy.

title: Korean Salad Dressing
ingredients: 1/2 cup white vinegar | 2 tablespoons sesame seeds ( about 2 teaspoons, divided ) | 1/4 teaspoon cracked pepper
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Shake well before using.

title: Mushroom Rice
ingredients: 2 packages sliced mushrooms | 1 1/2 cups uncooked white rice | 1 teaspoon dried herbs | 1/2 teaspoon dried basil | 1/2 teaspoon curry powder | 1/4 teaspoon curry powder | 1/8 teaspoon garam masala
instructions: Heat half of the oil in a saucepan over medium high heat. Add the mushrooms, rice, herbs and spices. Stir and fry the rice until it has absorbed all the moisture. Add the other half of the oil and stir. When the mixture begins to steam, turn down the heat and cover. Let stand for 10 minutes to steam. Fluff with a fork.

title: Tamarind Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup small curds, sieved | 1 tablespoon tamari | 2 teaspoons ground coriander | kosher salt
instructions: Drain curds and squeeze the excess moisture out of them with your hands. Combine remaining ingredients and refrigerate. Bring to room temperature before serving if necessary.

title: Goat Cheese Crackers
ingredients: 10 ounces soft fresh goat cheese | 1 large egg | 1 cup toasted buttery cracker, coarsely crushed
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f. In a mixing bowl, mash the goat cheese with a fork. Make sure to scrape the large pieces off of the cheese with a rubber spatula, or it will clump into crumbs rather fine. Put the egg in a medium sized mixing bowl, and add the soft cheese crumbs. Add the crumbs to the goat cheese. Mix until everything has been coated thoroughly with the egg. Using a melon baller, scoop the cheese mixture into melon ball sized indentations. Add a teaspoon or two of crushed toasted crackers to the cheese mixture, roll into a ball, and then place in a 9x5 inch loaf pan. Try to fit all into one or two loaf pans so the mixture can barely fit. Bake for 35 - 40 minutes, until the top is nicely browned and the center is firm when pressed with your finger. Cool for 30 minutes on a rack or in the refrigerator, then slice into 8 pieces to serve or store for later.

Random Ingredients: tomato sauce,orange peel,vegetarian bean,chili pepper,worcestershire sauce,chipotle chile,coriander,allspice
title: Allspice Smoked Refried Beans
ingredients: 4 cups organic unsalted vegetarian baked beans, drained | 2 ripe medium fresh chili peppers, coarsely chopped | 1 tablespoon chili pepper | 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 1 -2 dash crushed dried chipotle chile | 1/2 tablespoon coriander, ground | 1/4 teaspoon allspice | 1/4 cup tomato sauce ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f lightly oil an 8 x 8 cookie sheet. In a large bowl of your choice, stir together beans, chilies, worcestershire sauce, chipotles, coriander, allspice and the chili pepper. Toss to blend well. Arrange half of the bean mixture in the centre of the cookie sheet. Drizzle half of the tomato sauce on top. Repeat layering.

title: Ukrainian Blueberry Slaw
ingredients: 2 large heads red cabbage, coarsely chopped | 8 ounces frozen blueberries
instructions: Add the cabbage to a large salad bowl. Stir in the blueberries. Chill several hours.

Random Ingredients: red chili pepper flake,peanut,tomato green chilies,cornstarch,water,cheddar cheese
title: Smooth Chili Cheese Chili Strips
ingredients: 1 can tomatoes and green chilies, drained | 2 tablespoons peanut, butter flavored cooking spray | 1/4 - 1/2 cup cornstarch | 1/2 teaspoon red chili pepper flakes | 1/4 cup old cheddar cheese, grated | 1/4 cup water
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. In a small bowl, mix together tomatoes and green chilies, cornstarch, hot pepper flakes and cheddar cheese. Stir in water until mixture is smooth. Roll mixture into 1 inch strips then transfer to a cookie sheet lined with parchment paper. Bake for 12 - 15 minutes, or until heated through and lightly browned.

Random Ingredients: ginger garlic paste,chocolate,lime zest,vegan butter,miso,tomato puree,raisin,chilies
title: Lime Butter Masala
ingredients: 1/4 cup vegan butter | 1 tablespoon miso | 1 tablespoon mango puree | 1 tablespoon pureed tomatoes with puree | 1 tablespoon grated lime zest | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh ginger-garlic paste | 2 fresh chilies, chopped ( red chili ) | 1/2 cup raisins
instructions: Heat the oven to 375 degrees f. Mix together all ingredients in a small bowl, then spread in a well greased 13 x9 inch baking dish. Bake for 40 minutes or until golden brown, stirring once.

title: Faux Dessert Refresher
ingredients: 100 g bean sprouts, washed | 1 tablespoon red currant jelly
instructions: Place all ingredients in a pan. Heat until boiling. Cover the pan with a lid and cook on high heat for 3 - 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Serve hot with custard or pickle.

title: Minty Lime Sauce for Beef Jerky
ingredients: 2 tablespoons ketchup | 2 tablespoons mirin | 1 tablespoon shallot ( minced ) | 1 -2 tablespoon lime ( grated )
instructions: Mix ketchup, mirin, and minced shallots. Add grated lime. Stir to dissolve. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: buttermilk,liquid smoke,white rice,russet potato,salmon,beef bouillon cube
title: Rice Smoked Potatoes
ingredients: 3 lbs russet potatoes | 4 cups fat-free buttermilk | 1 beef bouillon cube | 2 tablespoons liquid smoke | 10 ounces smoked salmon, chopped | cooked white rice
instructions: Coat a 1 1/2 quart casserole with cooking spray. Pierce potatoes all over with a sharp knife and set aside in a large roasting pan. Pour 4 cups of buttermilk into pan and mix with the cube of beef bouillon. Add liquid smoke to liquid and whisk to mix.

Random Ingredients: pumpkin,guacamole,ginger paste,lasagna noodle,cumin seed,brazil nut,beef bouillon granule,bicarbonate soda
title: Lorilyn's Spicy  Barbecue Pumpkin Lasagna
ingredients: 500 g pumpkin, peeled and cubed | 250 ml beef bouillon granules or 250 ml chicken bouillon granules | 50 g fresh ginger paste | 1 tablespoon ground cumin seeds | 1 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 6 sheets lasagna noodles | 50 g brazil nuts, roughly chopped | 50 g guacamole
instructions: Put the pumpkin, stock granules, ginger, cinnamon, cumin, and bicarbonate soda in a saucepan and heat through, stirring frequently. While the mixture is heating up, spray a baking dish. Pour 1 tablespoon of the meat sauce into the prepared dish and spread it evenly to cover the bottom. Scatter 3 sheets of lasagna over the meat sauce. Pour the remaining sauce over the lasagna and cover the baking dish with aluminium foil. Cook in a pre heated oven at 180 grades c, for 35 to 40 minutes depending on the oven. Once cooked, remove from the oven, cover with foil, and put in a warm oven. Cook for 20 minutes. While the barbecued pumpkin is cooking, make the guacamole. Put the brazil nuts in a mortar and pestle and grind to a fine powder. Mix this with the guacamole and spread over the barbeued pumpkin. Remove the baking dish from the oven and spoon 1/3 of the barbecued pumpkin mixture and chopped peanuts over this and spread over the barbeque pumpkin. When the barbecued pumpkin mixture is cooked, put the baking dish under the grill for 2 minutes to crisp the top, which should be lovely and crunchy. Serve immediately. If you don't have the time, the brazil nuts are a bit too salty, so either leave them out and leave them in or add them here.

title: Baja Cabbage Rolls with Asparagus
ingredients: 1 head cabbage, chopped ( cabbage can be small or large, depending on size of head ) | 2/3 cup beer ( any kind ) | 1 can stewed tomatoes with juice | 1 can asparagus, sliced | 1/3 cup fresh white breadcrumb | 1/4 cup grapefruit juice
instructions: Pour asparagus thru a sieve or a strainer into a bowl. Add beer and blend with a spoon. Add all remaining ingredients except cabbage and let sit 1 hour. Pour cabbage mixture into a 9x13 baking dish.. Cover with plastic wrap and let sit overnight in the refrigerator. Bake 350 for about an hour or until cabbage is tender, and looks crispy on the outside. Uncover and bake for 30 minutes longer.

title: Alfredo Alfredo Cheese Sauce
ingredients: 3/4 package prepared alfredo sauce | 2 1/2 tablespoons dijon mustard
instructions: Put the alfredo sauce in the microwave for about 20 sec. Stir well to combine. Microwave another 20 seconds. Stir and serve with pasta of your choice. Note, alfredo cheese is usually best made a day in advance and not kept in the refrigerator until ready to use.

title: El Dorado
ingredients: 8 ounces uncooked corkscrew macaroni | 1/2 cup diced bell pepper | 1 can red enchilada sauce
instructions: Cook the noodles as directed on package, drain. Rinse with cold water and place in an oven safe dish. Top with bell pepper, enchilada sauce, and cheese if desired. Microwave, uncovered, on high for 2 minutes. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: wine vinegar,red chili pepper,almond essence,chipotle chile
title: Chipotle Almond Salad Dressing
ingredients: 3 tablespoons wine vinegar | 1 -2 chipotle chile, canned in adobo sauce, deseeded, deveined and diced | 1 -2 red chili pepper, sliced, finely chopped | 1 pinch almond essence, drops ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well. Chill.

Random Ingredients: stew meat,egg yolk,white vinegar,cabernet sauvignon wine,catsup
title: Easy Beef and Eggs
ingredients: 4 1/2 lbs stew meat ( cut into cubes ) | 1/4 cup catsup ( or worcestershire sauce ) | 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 1 tablespoon white vinegar | 1 egg yolk, beaten
instructions: Combine beef, catsup, worcestershire and vinegar. Beat egg yolk with a fork and pour over meat. Marinate 2 - 4 hours at room temperature or overnight in the refrigerator. Preheat oven to 350°f. Spray baking dish with pam. Pour marinade into dish. Cover with foil. Cover.

title: Grilled Pesto-Steamed Fish
ingredients: 2 cups mixed nuts ( panko, almonds ) | 1 can tomato sauce | 2 tablespoons pesto sauce | 8 ounces macadamia pieces | 2 tablespoons fresh flat-leaf pesto sauce | 14 ounces haddock fillets, skinned ( about 1 1/2 pounds ) | 2 tablespoons fresh flat-leaf pesto sauce | 2 star anise, thinly sliced
instructions: To make the pesto, combine the nut, tomato sauce, and pesto sauce in a small bowl.

title: Mushrooms for 1 (Or Better)
