ingredients: 1 cup orzo pasta or 1 cup rice | 400 g cremini mushrooms, sliced thickly | 1 tablespoon pickle, minced
instructions: Cook orzo until al dente.

Random Ingredients: red wine vinegar,black pepper,flat leaf parsley,dijon mustard,vanilla sugar,garam masala,chinese wine
title: Prawns Vindaloo
ingredients: 300 g large raw prawns, shelled and deveined | 1/4 cup dijon mustard | 1/4 cup red wine vinegar | 1/4 cup flat leaf parsley, finely chopped | 1/4 teaspoon fresh ground black pepper | 1 teaspoon vanilla sugar ( or 1/2 tsp honey if you prefer ) | 2 tablespoons fresh ground black pepper | 1/4 teaspoon garam masala
instructions: Whisk the mustard and the red wine vinegar in a small bowl. Stir in the herbs. Place the prawns in a large non stick frying pan and cook, stirring, over medium high heat, for about a minute. Add to the pan and toss to coat. Cook, stirring, for another minute, until the prawn are cooked through. Add the remaining ingredients and toss to combine.

Random Ingredients: active yeast,cream chicken soup,green bell pepper,cod,dark sesame oil,sherry wine,basil
title: Smoked Cod (Smoked Cod or Whitefish)
ingredients: 1 package active dry yeast | 1 cup cream of chicken soup | 1/2 cup sherry wine | 1 green bell pepper, chopped | 1 teaspoon basil | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 1/2 lb smoked cod ( or whitefish ), cut in 2-inch pieces
instructions: Mix the yeast with 1 cup sour cream, sherry and pepper in a large bowl. Put the bread on to counter and let it rise until doubled. Turn the dough out onto a floured board and knead it by hand about 10 times. If the dough is very sticky, add 1 tbls flour. Divide the dough in half. You can work with 1 half of the dough and divide to be used all along the length of the greased bread. But the dough should be elastic. Place the dough in a well greased bowl and turn the dough over so the greased side is up. Cover the bowl with a dish towel and let the dough rise until doubled. Turn the dough out onto the floured surface and knead it by hand about 10 times. Take the dough out of bowl, let it rise 30 minutes. Mix the filling and form into 2 loaves about 3 by 5 in size, the size of a 10 inch angel food cake. Place the loaves in the oven and let them bake at 500 for 20 minutes. Remove from the oven and let cool. Serve with soup or gravy.

title: Fennel bulb with Caramel
ingredients: 2 fennel bulbs, trimmed and sliced thin | 4 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Toss fennel in a large baking dish with the olive oil. Transfer to the preheated oven and roast until tender and starting to pop, about 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: amchoor mango powder,asparagus spear,adobo sauce,daikon radish,green bell pepper,cabbage
title: Cabbage, Daikon Appetizer Bowls
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon amchoor mango powder ( aka mango powder ) | 1/2 teaspoon minced green bell pepper | 1/2 cup chopped daikon radish | 1/2 cup peeled and grated cabbage ( i use coleslaw mix ) | 3 tablespoons adobo sauce, from a can | fresh seaweed ( optional ) | 8 asparagus spears, tough ends removed
instructions: In a small bowl, mash 1/4 teaspoon coconut powder into mango powder. Stir in green pepper, daikon, cabbage, onion, and adobo sauce. Divide mixture into 8 balls. Sprinkle the balls with the cilantro, if desired and serve on top of jasmine rice and accompanied by hot steamed pita.

title: Easy Easy Vegetable Stew
ingredients: 1 package baby carrots | 1 can baby carrots, drained
instructions: Heat a small amount of olive oil in a saucepan, then add the carrots. Simmer for about 1 minute, then add the baby carrots with liquid. Simmer for a few minutes, then serve.

title: Real French Bread
ingredients: 3 cups day old italian bread or 3 cups country bread ( 3 lbs, not a total of 3 cups ) | 3 teaspoons baking powder ( preferably fleur de sel )
instructions: The night before the meal, preheat the oven to 300 degrees f. Line the counter with a round of paper or silpat. Cut a round of bread into slices about 2 by 2 1/4 inches thick, about 3 tablespoons. Use a serrated knife to cut a few slashes on the bread. Arrange the slices in a single layer in a well buttered shallow baking pan, spacing them about 1/2 inch apart. Mix the baking powder with 1 teaspoon of salt. Spread the mixture evenly over the slices, being careful not to disturb them. Bake for about 1 hour or until golden brown. Remove from the oven and, turning once, turn the bread. The bread should look dry and crisp in the center. Turn out of the pans onto a rack. Let cool. Store in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: asafoetida powder,orange juice lime,broccoli floret,rice wine vinegar
title: Orangey Veggie Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups broccoli florets | 4 tablespoons orange juice or 4 tablespoons lime juice | 2 teaspoons rice wine vinegar | 1 pinch asafoetida powder
instructions: Place the broccoli in a medium saucepan with enough water so that it steams. Bring to boil, cover, and steam for about 4 minutes. Drain, and fluff with a fork. Transfer to a serving bowl, and stir in the orange juice or lime juice. Taste, and adjust seasonings if necessary. Sprinkle with asafoetida. Let cool for 10 minutes. Note, if you don't like asofetida, you can use 2 teaspoons of curry powder.

title: Spicy Bacon, Bacon and Chocolate Pasta Salad
ingredients: 200 g dried penne, cooked | 200 g thin salami | 200 g fresh chocolate ( or 250 g chopped chocolate ) | 3 tablespoons peanut butter | 1/4 teaspoon ground chili flakes | 1 pinch cayenne
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a large bowl. Serve.

title: Turnip Chips
ingredients: 2 green turnips | 1 tablespoon oil
instructions: Peel, wash and cut turnips into chips. Heat up frying pan on medium high until oil is hot.. Turnip chips over and fry on both sides until golden brown. Take out and drain on paper towel, then serve hot, hot or cold.

title: Crazy Semolina Rice Con Carne
ingredients: 2 cups rice ( short grain, brown or savory ) | dijon mustard | semolina
instructions: Rinse the rice with water and let soak in the fridge. Put about 1/8 cup of mustard and 1/8 cup of semolina on the inner side of a baking sheet and bake 400 degrees on each side the rice should be light golden brown and the grain should be golden in color. If you don't have any baking sheet outside you can dry it after the rice has turned to a different color it should not be necessary. Once all the grain has been dry take your oven seat, put on the baking sheet and turn the heat to 400 degrees. Put the rice in the oven on the rack. Once the timer goes off take the tray out and put the baking sheet under it with the rack. Let it cool for 10 - 15 minutes. Open the rice with a fork and give the grains a quick stir so it won't stick on the baking sheet.

title: Marinated Pears With Mustard and Sherry Sauce.
ingredients: 1 cup mirin | 1/4 cup dijon mustard | 2 tablespoons canola oil | 2 lbs ripe pears, peeled, cored and sliced
instructions: In 2 cup glass jars combine the mirin, mustard and 1 tbsp canola oil and shake well. Add the pears and seal. Let stand 2 days, shaking well after each. Ladle into sterilized jars and seal.

title: Lecho Me Kremer (Lecho Me Kremer)
ingredients: 1 head of cabbage | 1 beef bouillon cube | 1/4 cup kalamata olives
instructions: Wash cabbage thoroughly with water. Slice cabbage in thin stripes about 3 1/4 inches thick. Add to water. Dissolve beef bouillon in 1/4 cup kalamata olives. Heat oven to 200 degrees. Pour meat mixture into large roasting pan to cover cabbage completely. Cover pan with lid, and bake in preheated oven for 3 hours. Add olives. Cover pan, and continue baking for an additional hour or until meat is tender and juices run clear.

title: Grilled Rice Dipping Dogs
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger | 1 tablespoon minced garlic | 2 tablespoons minced spring onions | 1 tablespoon ghee ( clarified butter ) | 1/2 tablespoon rice vinegar ( or white rice vinegar )
instructions: Cook hamburger. Add minced garlic, chopped spring onions, ghee, rice vinegar to hamburger and cook on low for 15 minutes. Serve warm with ketchup or your favorite dipping sauce.

Random Ingredients: cheddar cheese,chinese vegetable,baby rocket,dark beer,monterey jack cheese,rice flour,white breadcrumb,peach
title: Beef  Peanut Sandwiches With Pear Sauce
ingredients: 12 slices white breadcrumbs | 16 ounces hawaiian rolls, split | 14 ounces chinese-style mixed vegetables, drained ( such as carrots, turnips, zucchini and sweet potato ) | 16 ounces steak, coarsely chopped ( leftover deli meat is ok ) | 4 ounces monterey jack cheese, coarsely chopped | 4 ounces cheddar cheese, coarsely chopped | 6 ounces ripe white rice sticks, soaked in warm water
instructions: Put bread crumbs into 2 shallow bowls. Stir bread crumbs into veg and meat in batches. On two sl sheets of heavy waxed paper, roll each bread slice up tightly from one long side. Secure with kitchen string or toothpicks, if desired. Drain bread rolls, reserving liquid. Make sauce, mix reserved liquid from toast rolls with chees, rice sticks, pears and onions. Brush tops with sauce. Set on table, in pairs, and keep warm. To assemble, if bread rolls are very stale, place under broiler until bread crusts are lightly browned.

Random Ingredients: tart apple,fish sauce,deli roast beef,red grape,dill,sherry,portabella mushroom
title: Beef, Parchment Paper, and Apple Strudel
ingredients: 12 cups leftover cooked steak & stuffing | 2 tart apples, cut into 1/4 inch slices ( i like to use fuji apples ) | 1 cup fresh portabella mushrooms, sliced | 1/3 cup red seedless grapes, grapes cut in half | 1/2 cup finely chopped portabella mushroom, stems included | 2 1/2 tablespoons fish sauce | 1/4 cup dry sherry ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon finely chopped fresh dill ( optional )
instructions: On a large platter, place a portion of the stuffing on the center. Cover with equal size slices of the leftover steak stuffing, and then top with half of the sliced apples, mushrooms, and other half of the portabello mushrooms. Place a third of the grape slices atop the mushrooms in an overlapping pattern on top. In a small bowl, mix the fish sauce, dry sherry and dill. Drizzle over the top of the meat. Serve warm.

title: Chile and Cherry Blossom Butter
ingredients: 1 cup dried cherries, packed in brine | 1 1/2 bunches cherries, trimmed & left whole | 1 tablespoon chopped shallot | 1 -2 teaspoon dried thyme leaves | 7 poblano chiles, roasted and peeled
instructions: Place cherries in a bowl and pour 3 cups water into mixture. Cover bowl with plastic wrap and let cherries soften to room temperature. About 2 to 4 hours or overnight. Drain cherries, saving juices. Chop the pits and pits. Place cherries in a food processor. Add the shallot and thyme, process until smooth. In a medium skillet, heat remaining juice of 1/2 red anaheim chile with the reserved juices over moderate heat until just barely boiling. Gradually pour hot juice into skillet and cook, stirring constantly, until sauce is thick and syrupy. Cool. Transfer chile purée to a food processor and process for 15 seconds to purée.

title: Aebleguitlert (Beer-Poached Sauerkraut)
ingredients: 16 ounces sauerkraut | 3 egg whites, lightly beaten | 3/4 cup flour | 1/4 cup tequila ( i use mexican pisco ), depending on taste
instructions: Preheat your oven to 350 degrees f. Line the bottom and sides of a 9x13 inch pan with parchment paper, allowing the paper to hang over the edges of the pan. Trim off excess paper. Boil sauerkraut for about 10 minutes, then drain and run tap water over it to wilt the sauerkraut a little while set for another 5 minutes. Remove the parchment paper from the sauerkraut, and in a small bowl combine the egg whites and salt and pepper of your choice until they are fluffy. You will not need to salt the mixture, it will firm up after chilling for 10 minutes. In another small bowl, mix the flour and tequila together, then add the flour mix to the beaten egg whites and mix well. Do not overwork the dough. Stir in water if the mixture has a dry consistency. Sprinkle a little flour over the drained sauerkraut, and pat into a 9 x13 inch pan. Spread sauerkraut out evenly. Cover the sauerkraut with a piece of aluminum foil, or just a damp cloth to prevent it drying out. Bake for 45 minutes. Turn oven off, but leave in for another 10 minutes of oven to finish cooling before cutting. It should look like a dark brown. If not, remove foil or cloth from pan right before serving.

title: Crock Pot Chickpea Burgers #2
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef chuck | 1 can chickpeas | 1/4 cup sliced green chili ( about 2-3 ) | 2 tablespoons hoisin sauce | 1/4 cup crumbled feta
instructions: Place beef, chickpeas and green chili in a 6 quart slow cooker. Mix well. In a small bowl, whisk together hoisin sauce and remaining ingredients except feta. Pour over meat mixture or stir in feta.

title: Puerto Rican Pasta With Crushed Pork
ingredients: 5 ounces pork tenderloin, trimmed of visible fat
instructions: Cut the pork into 1/2 inch dice. Preheat ove to 400 degrees f. Line a large baking sheet with parchment paper. Spray the pork with cooking spray. Spray the pork evenly with cooking spray. Sprinkle the pork with cooking spray. Bake the pork in the preheated oven until an instant read thermometer inserted into the center of the meat registers 145 degrees f, about 20 minutes. Turn the oven off and transfer the pan to the oven. Leave for 5 minutes while you preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Drain the pork and place on a platter. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: vanilla,hot chili sauce,sesame seed,beef,chicken breast meat,rosemary leaf
title: Stirfry Chicken Breasts With Sesame Seeds
ingredients: 1 1/2 teaspoons rosemary leaves, finely chopped | 1/4 teaspoon hot chili sauce ( tobasco brand recommended ) | 1 lb skinless chicken breast meat, cut into 2 inch pieces | 1/4 cup sesame seeds, toasted | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla | hot chili sauce
instructions: In a glass bowl, combine the rosemary, hot chili sauce and chicken pieces. Cover and refrigerate several hours or overnight. Drain the chicken from the marinade. Set aside. In the bowl of a food processor, add the sesame seeds, vanilla and enough hot sauce to thicken the paste. Add the chicken and marinade and process until they are just coated. Heat the nonstick skillet on medium high heat until hot. Cook the chicken in batches until it is cooked through. Serve with spiced ketchup.

title: Holiday Fusion Meal
ingredients: 1 lb ground veal | 12 ounces turkey breast | 14 ounces tofu | 3 ounces cheeze durkero tofu | 3 ounces farfalle pasta | 1/2 tablespoon baking soda | 1/4 cup cachaca, shavings
instructions: Boil pasta water, boil farfalle, drain, and keep warm. Sautee veal until no longer pink in centre and cooked through. Chop ground turkey and tofu, add to pan. Drain cooked farfalle and tofu, add to pan. Pour cachaca into pan, stir to combine. Pour in soda into pan and stir. When soda stops bubbling, add farfalle and turkey mixture. Stir over heat until heated through and pasta is hot.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon,cardamom seed,sausage,tomato paste,tabasco sauce,chicken stock
title: Sausage with Pepper (Kefa Kebab)
ingredients: 1 lb sausage ( i use spicy portuguese sausages ) | 3 tablespoons tomato paste | 4 cups chicken stock | 2 teaspoons chicken bouillon | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom seed | tabasco sauce, to taste
instructions: Combine tomato paste with stock, chicken bouillon and spices. Bring slowly to a boil adding more stock if needed. Sausages, slit lengthwise, on a diagonal and then cross cut in half. Poke the middle of with a fork. Fry over low heat until they are brown on all sides.

title: Beef Tuna Roll - Roll
ingredients: 1 package refrigerated light cream cheese, softened | 1 can cooked drained tuna | 1 cup chopped cooked beef or 1 cup cooked shredded chicken | 1 jar pickled grape leaves
instructions: Mix softened cream cheese and drained tuna together.

title: Chutney Soup
ingredients: 2 cups beef stock ( or stock cubes ) | 1 tablespoon chutney
instructions: Pour the stock into a medium size saucepan and stir in the chutney. You can do this in advance. Place over a medium heat, and bring to a simmer. Enjoy note, for vegetarian use the vegetable broth.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon,shiitake mushroom,spinach,salt pepper,ketchup,green olive,ginger powder
title: Sauteed Spinach and Shiitake Mushrooms
ingredients: 8 shiitake mushrooms, soaked ( i use shiitake ) | 8 ounces fresh spinach | 2 tablespoons ketchup | 1/4 teaspoon chicken bouillon ( or other meat flavor ) | 1/4 teaspoon ginger powder ( or more if desired ) | 1/4 teaspoon salt and pepper ( optional ) | 2/3 cup green olives ( optional )
instructions: Prepare spinach by wash throughly.

title: Flour Tortilla Rollups
ingredients: 2 flour tortillas | 1 cup bisquick | 1/2 cup filling
instructions: In a non stick skillet heat 2/3 cup of flour to boiling. Slowly stir in 1/2 cup of bisquick. As soon as the mixture comes to boil, remove skillet from heat and pour batter into the hot mixture. Spread tortillas out on a baking sheet. After 10 minutes roll the tortillas with your fingers until thin and very light in color.

title: Cajun Vegetable and Penne
ingredients: 3/4 cup dry sherry | 1 package penne | 1 tablespoon cajun seasoning | 1 head fresh broccoli, diced | 1 can sliced bamboo shoots, drained and cut into chunks | 1 small turnip, diced
instructions: In a medium saucepan, mix the sherry, cajun seasoning, and broccoli. Heat over medium heat for 3 minutes. When the sherry mixture starts to bubble, add the turnip.

title: Pistachio Hazelnut Smoothie
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups buttermilk | 1 tablespoon ground pistachios | 1 tablespoon green bell pepper, finely diced | 1 tablespoon fresh edible flower ( such as a mint or basil, or try giada de laurentiis ) | 1 tablespoon low-fat soymilk ( if you're not calorie-free, but low-fat would be good too )
instructions: Whisk all of the ingredients together in a blender or food processor. Serve straight away.

title: Chilled Beetroot in a Coat(Antilles)
ingredients: 1 can beetroots ( or any flavour fresh fruit such as pineapple, banana, grapeseed, beetroot, berry or mixed fruit ) | water, to cover | fresh mint leaves, with mint leaves, to decorate ( optional )
instructions: Prepare the beetroot, then cut into 1 inch cubes. Heat a few drops of water in a large saucepan, then add the cubes, stir well and allow them to brown lightly. Turn the slices over and brown the other side. Allow them to cool. In a blender or food processor, blend the beetroots with water to give a fine paste. Return the puree to the heat and add the mint leaves if using. Taste and add seasoning or salt only if necessary. Simmer gently for 10 minutes until the flavours have blended. Allow 10 minutes for the flavours to develop, then transfer the beetroot to a glass preserving jar, refrigerate and serve at room temperature. To re heat, place a few mint leaves in a heatproof bowl, pour hot water on top and let steep for 5 minutes. Serve chilled or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: hamburger,panko breadcrumb,phyllo dough,pie shell,orange bell pepper
title: Orange Pepper and Ham Pot Pie
ingredients: 2 pies crusts | 1 cup chopped orange bell peppers ( or use regular peppers ) | 1/3 cup panko breadcrumbs | 1 lb hamburger | 2 packages frozen phyllo dough, thawed
instructions: Mix peanko crumbs thru olive in small bowl. Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium heat. Dredge hamburger in crumbs, then coat with crumb mixture. Arrange in single layer in skillet. Cook for 8 - 10 minutes or until browned, stirring once. Stir in 2nd box of phyllo, folding them underneath the hamburger to cover as much beef as possible. Layer 2nd pack of phyllo dough over the hamburger. Lay the last layer of phyllo dough over phyllo. Cover and let sit 5 minutes. Use a pizza peel or a sharp knife to cut through dough.

title: Spinach With Figs or Capers
ingredients: 1 lb fresh spinach | 1 lb fresh figs or 1 lb fresh banana, chopped or 1 lb fresh banana, sliced
instructions: Wash and dry the spinach. Wash and pat dry the figs or tomatoes. Wash and dry the spinach. Arrange the figs or tomatos in a circle on the spinach. Wrap the spinach around the figs or tomatoes. The spinach can be added to any large salad dish or individual cups or plates.

title: Pizzas - Italian Sausage Spread
ingredients: 6 lbs sweet italian sausage | 6 -8 cups mayonnaise | 1/2 bunch cilantro | lemon wedge
instructions: Cut sausage links into 3 inch chunks. Cover with water and simmer gently for 10 minutes. Drain. Place sausage, mayonnaise and cilantro in blender. When sauce is smooth, remove from heat and stir in sausage with spoon. Fill 6 - 8 cup size martini shaker with batter. Cover with a cloth towel and close lid. Process for 3 minutes. Remove cloth and towel and pour mixture in. Shake very well to mix. Serve with lemon wedges.

title: Beef Tenderloin and Egg Sandwich
ingredients: 2 slices beef tenderloin | 2 hard-boiled eggs
instructions: Toast. Serve on bun. Beef tenderloin is very rare, so add a bit of water. Enjoy.

title: Blueberry and Mashed Potatoes in a Coriander Based Lard
ingredients: 400 g blueberries | 400 g russet potatoes | 2 tablespoons cornflour or 2 tablespoons cornstarch | 1 tablespoon lard | 1 tablespoon coriander powder
instructions: Place blueberries in salted water and bring up to the boil. Cut up the potato into wedges of around 10cm. Heat the lard in a frying pan and fry potato until golden. Drain on paper towel. Mix cornflour and the coriander powder and coat the potatoes. Toss in the drained blueberries and toss to heat through. Serve over some green salad and crusty bread.

title: Asian Steamed Salmon
ingredients: 1 sirloin steak or 1 salmon fillet | 1 king-sized prawns, peeled | 1 cup canned bamboo shoots, drained | 1 can salmon fillets
instructions: Soak a moulded tin with cooking paper in a wok until it's soft. Remove paper and mould the salmon fillet onto the paper to form a small circle. Cut the salmon into thin slices. Place the prawns on top of the salmon. Place the bamboo shoots on top and wrap the fish in the prawns. Place the lid on the wok and steam for 10 minutes, remove lid. Serve on a bed of steamed rice.

Random Ingredients: urad dal,spinach,crouton,graham cracker crumb,creme fraiche,vegetable oil cooking spray,banana,purpose flour
title: Gramma Andres' Spinach Fritters (With Banana Fritters)
ingredients: 12 ounces spinach, cleaned and stemmed | 1 large banana, peeled and cut into 1/4-inch slices | 1/4 cup crouton, crushed | 1/4 cup creme fraiche ( optional ) or 1/4 cup sour cream ( optional ) | 3 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 1/4 cup coarsely crumbled graham cracker crumbs | vegetable oil cooking spray | 1/4 teaspoon coarse salt or 1/4 teaspoon kosher salt
instructions: Wash and remove wilted spinach, discarding tough stems. Cut into 1/4 inch lengthwise slices. Place in a colander and shake to remove excess moisture. Grate banana using grater directly into a food processor or a mini chopper. Sprinkle in crouton crumbs and blend well. Coat 1/4 cup coarsely crumbled graham cracker crumbs in a separate dish. Dredge the spinach in crumbs. Coat in cracker crumbs. Coat 4 - 6 servings of rice fritters this way if desired. Heat a nonstick or cast iron skillet set about 5 inches below medium high heat. Use cooking spray or a nonstick spray coated cast iron skillet if you like. Place 2 fried fritters in the skillet and cover with more crumbs. Cook until edges of fritters begin to turn brown and centers are firm, 1 - 2 minutes.

Random Ingredients: rice wine,cocoa powder,vanilla bean,egg white,chicken bouillon cube,picante sauce
title: Mexican Chocolate Pie
ingredients: 1 ounce rice wine ( spanish or mexican ) | 2 cups picante sauce ( mild to hot ) | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 2 ounces low-sodium instant powdered cocoa powder | 5 large egg whites | 1 small vanilla bean
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, melt together the rice wine and picante sauce. Crush the garlic, add to mixture. Break up the vanilla bean add to mixture, and mix. In a saucepan, heat the chicken bouillon cube and cocoa powder over medium heat.

Random Ingredients: egg,mace,soy flour,white onion,panko breadcrumb,chili powder,mandarin orange
title: Mandarin Fried Onions
ingredients: 4 mandarin oranges, peeled | sour cream or soy creamer | 2 tablespoons white onions, minced | 1 teaspoon chili powder | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace | 1/4 cup panko breadcrumbs | 1 egg
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit. Remove the peel from the mandarin oranges, then cut out the white pith into segments lengthwise.

title: Rigatoni With Italian Tomato and Dried Fruit
ingredients: 6 tablespoons italian bread, crumbs, divided | 1/4 cup italian bread, crumbs | 8 ounces can italian-style stewed tomatoes, undrained | 1 teaspoon sugar | 1 teaspoon dried tarragon | 1 package rigatoni pasta, cooked and drained
instructions: In medium bowl, stir together 2 tbls bread crumbs and 2 tbls bread crumbs. Stir in undrained tomatoes, sugar, and tarragon until well blended. Set aside. In large skillet, stir remaining 2 tbls bread crumbs with remaining bread crumbs. Add to tomato mixture and toss to coat. Divide mixture evenly among 13 inch diameter metal baking dishes. Sprinkle with remaining crumbs. Preheat broiler. Bake, uncovered in preheated oven 20 to 35 minutes, or until golden and bubbly, stirring twice.

title: Easy One-Pot Rice
ingredients: 1/2 cup rice, uncooked | 8 ounces ham ( cubed ) | 1 teaspoon fennel seed | 1 cube chicken bouillon ( instant or raw, if using raw chicken ) | 1 cup water
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a casserole dish. Simmer covered until water is absorbed and rice is tender.

Random Ingredients: russet potato,chuck,lemon juice,orange juice concentrate,horseradish,cheddar cheese,cauliflower floret,great northern bean
title: Beef Fondue With Roasted Corn and White Beans
ingredients: 1 lb lean chuck, cut into bite-size pieces | 1 small cauliflower floret | 2 russet potatoes, quartered | 1 cup canned great northern bean, drained | 1/4 cup frozen orange juice concentrate | 1/4 cup fresh lemon juice | 3 tablespoons grated horseradish, divided | 1/2 cup shredded cheddar cheese
instructions: Preheat the broiler to high. Arrange the chuck pieces on a rack in a broilerproof pan. Broil until the beef is brown, about 10 minutes on each side. Set the beef cubes aside. Place the cauliflower and potatoes in a large pot with just enough water to cover. Bring to a boil, and cook until the cauliflower is tender. Remove from heat, cover, and set aside to steam for 15 minutes. Transfer the roast to the slow cooker. Mash together the beans, orange juice concentrate, 2 tablespoons lemon juice, horseradish, and 1 tablespoon of the cheese in a bowl. Spread the bean mixture over the beef and veggies, and sprinkle with the remaining tablespoon of cheese. Cover and cook on high for 2½ hours or on low for 3 hours, or until the beef and vegetables are tender.

Random Ingredients: bok choy,poblano chile,beef brisket,italian bread crumb,shiitake mushroom,cream corn,hot sauce,fennel seed
title: Slow Cooker Corned Beef and Poblano Chile Brisket
ingredients: 6 ears fresh hot dogs or 6 beef briskets, cut crosswise into thick slices | 1 tablespoon fennel seed | 1 pound fresh shiitake mushrooms, sliced | 8 ounces fresh kok choy, sliced | 1/2 cup sour cream | 1 cup italian seasoned bread crumbs | 1/2 cup chopped fresh chives or 1/2 cup green onion | hot sauce to taste
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees fahrenheit. Coat the inside of a 9x5 inch crock of food with cooking spray. Place in the bottom of the crock of a slow cooker. Sprinkle with fennel seed and layer ingredients in following, sauteed onion, fresh shiitake mushrooms, sliced kokchoy, sour cream, and bread crumbs, ending with kokchoy. Season with hot sauce and pour enough water in the crock to cover. Cook on high for 3 to 3 1/2 hours.

title: Cafe Noodle Kugel
ingredients: 12 ounces egg noodles, cooked and drained | 1/2 teaspoon instant coffee powder | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne pepper
instructions: Place noodles in a large mixing bowl. With your hand, mix thoroughly until everything is combined. With a fork, stir in the coffee powder and cayenne pepper until completely mixed up. You can mix together any kinds of spices, especially dijon or spicy. Pour the noodles into a baking dish and put in a cold oven to chill for at least one hour.

title: Pepperoni and Pepperoni Slice With Chocolate
ingredients: 2 bell peppers, finely chopped | 1/4 celery, finely chopped | 200 g sliced pepperoni, finely chopped | 3 tablespoons cornflour | 1/2 cup milk chocolate ( chopped ) | 1 teaspoon italian seasoning
instructions: Put pepperoni, celery, mushrooms and chopped chocolate into greased 20x10 cake tin. Mix cornflour with a little bit of cold water until smooth then add to the rest of the ingredients. Spread the mixture evenly over the top. Bake at 190 degree c/350°f for 30 minutes until golden brown.

title: Asian Corned Beef and Spinach
ingredients: 2 tablespoons margarine | 1 lb corned beef brisket, trimmed and cut into 24 pieces | 1 head romaine lettuce or 1 head bibb lettuce lettuce, cored and chopped | 2 packages frozen chopped spinach | 1 teaspoon ground ginger | 1 cup baking powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 475 degrees. Melt margarine in large skillet. Add brisket and brown well on all sides. Transfer brisket. Combine meat in dutch oven with romaine, spinach, ginger, and baking powder. Add water to cover and bring to boil. Reduce heat to low and cover tightly. Cook over lowest heat for about 1 1/2 hours until brisket and vegetables are tender.

Random Ingredients: lime juice,wine,eggplant,italian dressing,chinese five spice powder,baking soda,black bean
title: Lighter Chicken Cakes
ingredients: 4 large japanese eggplants, sliced lengthwise into half-moons | 1 can black beans, drained and rinsed | 1 teaspoon champagne or 1 teaspoon any other dry white wine | 3/4 teaspoon baking soda | 1/2 teaspoon chinese five-spice powder | 1/2 cup italian dressing, i use good seasons | 1 teaspoon fresh lime juice
instructions: Heat a nonstick skillet on medium high. Coat pan with cooking spray and cook eggplant, stirring often, for about 8 minutes, or until lightly browned. Transfer eggplant to a plate and cover with foil to keep hot. Add beans to pan and cook for another 3 minutes. Add sherry to pan and pour over eggplant. Sprinkle with baking soda, five spice powder and italian dressing.

title: How to Make Dal(Kathi)
ingredients: 2 cups mung dal ( soaked for 6 to 8 hours ) | 2 cans crushed pineapple, with juice
instructions: Put all ingredients into a pot and boil for 20 more minutes on medium heat until the dal is soft to the touch. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: goya adobo pepper,idaho potato,hazelnut,mozzarella cheese,cumin seed
title: Mexican Mashed Potatoes with Cheese and Hazelnuts
ingredients: 1 box goya whole mashed potatoes | 1 cup chopped hazelnuts | 1 teaspoon cumin seed | 2 tablespoons goya finely chopped adobo peppers | 1 lb mozzarella cheese, grated
instructions: Prepare potatoes as directed on the package. Mix with cumin, chipotle pepper, and mozzarella. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: wheat bread flour,raspberry vinegar,pizza dough,grapefruit juice,bisquick,red bean,whipping cream,brussels sprout
title: Red Beans and Fruit Pizza Crust
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups seedless red beans ( pinto beans weight ) | 1 cup seedless grapefruit juice | 1/3 cup raspberry vinegar | 1/3 cup whipping cream | 1/2 lb shredded fully cooked brussels sprout | 1 1/2 cups whole wheat bread flour | 1 lb pizza dough | 1 teaspoon instant yeast
instructions: Mix in the following, pita bread rounds, 1 1/2 cups of the bread flour, 1 tsp of yeast, 1/2 cup grapefruit juice, 1/3 cup raspberry vinegar and 1/2 cup whipping cream. Mix until all the flour is incorporated. On floured surface. Kneed 10 - 15 times or until you have a ball of dough. Divide dough into 2 parts for each baking. On floured surface, stretch dough into a rectangle that is about 1/2 inch thick. Brush dough with beaten egg. Line a pizza pan lightly with plastic wrap. Press the dough into the pan to form an edge and to make a crust. Prick the crust all over with the tines of a fork. Spread beans evenly and top with grapefruit juice and berries. Spread to make a crust. Put the remaining 2/3 cup of grapefruit juice, vinegar and whipping cream on the crust. Bake until crust top is a brown color. Remove crust and bake in oven uncovered for 30 minutes. Remove from oven and top with brussels sprouts. Cut into wedges and serve with salad and a fresh glass of red apple concord. Makes.

Random Ingredients: thai chili sauce,pork chop,mustard powder,soya sauce,maple syrup,cornflour,fine breadcrumb
title: Spicy Glazed Pork With Peppers & Maple
ingredients: 2 pork chops | 3 tablespoons smooth pure maple syrup | 1 teaspoon fine dry breadcrumb | 1/2 tablespoon mustard powder | 1 tablespoon thai chili sauce | 2 tablespoons soya sauce | 1 tablespoon cornflour
instructions: Mix together the pure maple syrup, crumbs, mustard powder and chili sauce, then spread the mixture on the pork chops. Wrap the chops with aluminum foil and marinate in the fridge for 1 hour. Heat oven to 400°f arrange the coated pork on baking paper covered tray and bake for 10 minutes. Meanwhile blend the soya sauce and cornflour together until creamy. Brush onto the pork during the last few minutes of cooking. Serve with boiled rice, noodles or noodles and vegetables.

title: Crawfish Tails
ingredients: 1 pound peeled crawfish tails | cola to serve | 1 pound frozen cut cola
instructions: Cook crawfish tails, in boiling water for 2 to 3 minutes. Drain.

title: Spicy Chestnut Mushrooms
ingredients: 6 chestnut mushrooms | pepperoni
instructions: Cut the stalks off the mushrooms. Sprinkle on your favourite spices. Bake in 180 degrees c oven for about 15 mins until soft and well cooked.

Random Ingredients: eggplant,ale,caper,monterey jack cheese,tomato puree,tea,tabasco sauce,taco sauce
title: Mexican Eggplant Stew
ingredients: 2 medium spanish eggplants | 4 cups monterey jack cheese, shredded | 1 1/4 cups taco sauce | 1 can tomato puree | 1 bottle light ale | 1/8 cup capers | 1 teaspoon tabasco sauce | 10 ounces egg noodles ( optional ) or 10 ounces egg noodles, cooked
instructions: Wash eggplants and cut in 1/4 inch slices. Place in salted water and bring to boil. Cover and reduce heat and simmer for 25 - 30 minutes or until eggplants are tender when pierced with fork. Drain. Meanwhile, in a saucepan, stir together taco sauce, tomato puree, ale, capers, and tabasco sauce. Bring to boiling and immediately reduce heat. Simmer for 5 minutes then remove from heat and pour over eggplant in a serving bowl. Serve immediately.

title: Red Wine Yeast Marinade for Bread Machine
ingredients: 1 cup red wine or 1 cup white wine vinegar | 1 1/2 teaspoons cilantro leaves | 1/2 teaspoon creole seasoning | 1/2 cup red wine or 1/2 cup white wine vinegar | 1/3 cup creole seasoning | 1 1/2 tablespoons dried yeast
instructions: Add all ingredients to bread machine in order suggested by manufacturer. Set to white or white. Start.

Random Ingredients: egg,garbanzo bean,bouillon cube,focaccia bread,feta cheese,confectioner sugar,garlic clove,linguine
title: Garbanzo Bean and Feta Linguine
ingredients: 1 can garbanzo beans, drained and rinsed | 1/2 cup feta cheese ( optional ) | 1 bag uncooked linguine | 1 jar small to large disposable-range burrito-size crumbled feta cheese, such as feta ( optional ) | 1/2 cup confectioners'sugar | 3 eggs | 2 tablespoons finely chopped garlic cloves, or to taste | 1 bouillon cube, crumbled | 2 tablespoons prepared crumbled feta cheese, or to taste ( optional ) | 1 loaf focaccia bread, cut into 4 thick slices
instructions: Combine the garbanzo beans and 2/3 package of feta cheese, if using, in a blender.

title: Lamb Kebabs
ingredients: 1 1/4 kg lamb, cut into 3cm cubes | 250 g hazelnuts, roughly chopped | 3 heads bibb lettuce | 2 tablespoons mustard | 1 tablespoon malt vinegar | 1/2 dash cayenne
instructions: Place lamb in a bowl with the hazelnuts, and let them sit for 30 minutes in a cool place. Grind the lettuce with mustard, vinegar, cayenne and salt and pepper. Remove meat from the bowl, and mix in the hazelnut mixture. Cut the meat into 3 cm cubes, and thread onto skewers. Grill on the bbq until browned and cooked. Serve garnished with pistachios and lemon wedges.

Random Ingredients: liquid smoke,sherry wine,sherry,napa cabbage,genoa salami,baking potato,lard
title: Potato and Salami Galettes
ingredients: 4 lbs baking potatoes, scrubbed, scrubbed and cut into wedges | 1 1/4 lbs genoa salami, coarsely cut into 1/4 inch slices | 3/4 lb lard | 3/4 lb napa cabbage, cored and separated into leaves | 1/2 cup sherry wine | 3 1/2 cups dry sherry wine | 1/2 cup liquid smoke
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees fahrenheit. Bring large pot of salted water to a boil. Add potatoes, reduce heat to low, cover and simmer until tender, about 15 minutes. Drain, cool completely and cut into wedges. Slice salami and lard in 1/4 inch slices. Core cabbage and cut into wedges. Arrange cabbage in a single layer on a rimmed baking sheet. Stir together sherry, sherry and liquid smoke and pour over cabbage. Bake until cabbage is tender, about 20 minutes. Cook meat separately.

Random Ingredients: grape tomato,coriander seed,chicken stock,cumin powder,cake flour,habanero pepper
title: Tomato Chilli
ingredients: 400 g ripe grape tomatoes ( or cherry tomatoes ) | 1 tablespoon finely chopped habanero pepper | 1 1/4 teaspoons cumin powder ( or 2 cayenne pepper flakes ) | 2 1/4 tablespoons cake flour ( cornflour ) | 1 tablespoon coriander seed | 1 liter chicken stock
instructions: Scoop out the seeds from the tomatoes and chop finely. Place all the ingredients in a pan and simmer for 15 minutes then remove from heat immediately or leave in the fridge overnight for better flavor. Reheat and serve with rice.

Random Ingredients: chickpea flour,saffron strand,margarine,white cabbage,pepperoni,apple cider,beef brisket,taco seasoning mix
title: Microwave Smoky Corned Beef and Cabbage
ingredients: 2 tablespoons margarine | 1/4 teaspoon saffron strand ( optional ) | 1 corned beef brisket, fat trimmed | 1 package taco seasoning mix ( low sodium ) | 3 cups white cabbage, coarsely shredded, about 24 medium | 1/2 cup apple cider | 1 cup frozen peas and corn flour | 1/4 teaspoon pepperoni, crushed
instructions: Put beef brisket fat side down in a 9x12 glass dish. In microwave, melt margarine and saffron. Place corned beef fat side down on top in microwave. Cook uncovered on high 5 minutes. Spread taco seasoning on beef. In a bowl, combine all remaining ingredients except beef. Pour over beef.

Random Ingredients: brussels sprout,cider vinegar,butter,buttermilk,fennel leaf,lemon juice zest,cinnamon
title: Pierogi Brussels Sprouts
ingredients: 1 jar dried brussels sprouts, rinsed and drained | 2 cups buttermilk | 2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice, plus 1/8-inch zest | 2 tablespoons cider vinegar | 1 tablespoon dried fennel leaves | 1 lemon, juice and zest of | 2 tablespoons butter, melted
instructions: Rinse and drain brussels sprouts. Place brussels sprouts in a colander and pour enough water over to almost cover them. Leave in brussels sprouts. Place buttermilk, lemon juice, lemon peel, cinnimon, and butter in a saucepan and cook over medium heat. Bring to a simmer and cook for 6 minutes. Toss in brussels sprouts and reduce heat to low.

title: Bacon for the BBQ
ingredients: 4 slices bacon | 4 -8 fluid ounces beef eye beer ( i use budweiser )
instructions: Place the bacon strips into a frypan. Heat over a medium heat, turning regularly to prevent them sticking to the pan, until crispy. Remove the bacon from the pan without crowding the pan, and slice into 2 squares. Once all of the bacon is processed, pour in the beer. Stir to combine evenly over the bacon. Cover and cook over a medium heat for 15 - 20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the meat is cooked. Note, if you have a choice of cuts, use 2 thick slices of bacon. This can now be done in a bbq grill the bacon, until cooked to your preference.

Random Ingredients: chili pepper,dark sesame oil,date,penne,mushroom,wheat bread crumb,molasses,spinach
title: Spinach and Sun-Dried Tomato Pasta Sauce
ingredients: 1 package refrigerated prepared sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, undrained | 1 cup reduced sodium molasses | 3/4 lb fresh spinach, coarsely chopped | 1/2 lb medium mushrooms, sliced | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 2 loaves whole wheat bread crumbs, for dipping | 1/4 cup dates, finely chopped ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons chili peppers, minced ( or 1/2 teaspoon hot pepper flakes )
instructions: For the marinade, combine the tomatoes, molasses, spinach, mushrooms, sun dried tomatoes and sesame oil in a large bowl. Add the bread crumbs. Mix thoroughly. Spoon into a resealable plastic bag, add the mushrooms and chillies. Let sit at room temperature 15 minutes, pressing out excess liquid, about 15 minutes. Place on a dinner plate and spoon the sauce on top. Sprinkle with the dates and chillies.

title: Lemongrass Sauce
ingredients: 1 teaspoon green chili, crushed | 1 tablespoon catsup | 1 medium roma tomato, diced | 1 tablespoon lemon grass, sliced | 3 tablespoons wine | 1/2 cup applesauce | 2 tablespoons double cream or 2 tablespoons whipping cream
instructions: Combine ingredients in a bowl and cook over medium heat until sauce thickens.

title: Mexican Pork Stuffed (Pork Sausage)
ingredients: 1 pork tenderloin | 1/2 cup tequila | 1 tablespoon agave ( or more to taste ) | 2 tablespoons flour | 300 g manchego cheese ( preferably mexican melting cheese ) | 1/2 liter beef stock cube | 1 tablespoon flour
instructions: Trim fat from roll. Slice into two slices. Place one slice in each slit. In a bowl mix the tequila and agave, then add the remaining marinade ingredients. Poke holes in the roll with a fork to allow steam to escape during browning. Place roll in a large oven safe dish, top with cheese and place into oven to grill. Turn the rolls over in the cheese, and smoke until browned. If using my recipe for beef stock, you can also use one of the above ingredients.

ingredients: 1 yellow hot green chili pepper, seeded and chopped | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil or 2 tablespoons cooking spray | 2 plantains, cut lengthwise into 1/4 inch slices on the bias, then cut crosswise into 1/4 inch slices | 6 cups shredded cabbage | 1 cup orzo pasta
instructions: Heat oil in heavy 12 inch skillet or dutch oven over medium heat until hot but not smoking. Saute plantains 3 to 4 minutes. Turn with slotted spoon.

instructions: Stack leaves on serving platter. Combine salsa, mustard and vinegar. Pour over leaves, turning to coat.

instructions: Place 1/4 cup broth in a small saucepan.

instructions: Place mustard seeds in a small bowl. Pour 1 teaspoons water onto the mustard seeds and stir to coat. Let stand at room temperature for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally. After removing and removing half of the mustard seeds, grind to a fine powder in a grinder. Repeat with remaining mustard seeds. Store in airtight jars in the refrigerator.

title: Fettuccine With Shallots

title: Hawaiian Meat Pie Appetizers
ingredients: 1 packet onion soup mix | vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 lb hamburger | chile ( red or white ) or red chile ( jalapeno or green ) | 1 can pineapple juice | 1 bay leaf | 1 puff pastry sheet
instructions: Preheat oven on medium on the stove. Spray a 9x9 baking pan with nonstick spray and mix the soup mix into the meat. Add the onions and peppers and brown until the onions are soft. title: Strawberry Barley Stew
ingredients: 1 cup pearl barley | 2 1/2 cups chicken ( cut in bite sized pieces ) | 1 cup yellow bell pepper, chopped | 1 1/4 cups yellow bell peppers, chopped | 1 can tomatoes and green chilies | 1/3 cup malt vinegar | 2 tablespoons banana liqueur ( optional ) | 8 small fresh strawberries
instructions: Combine barley and chicken in large pan or dutch oven. Bring to a boil over high heat then cover and reduce heat to low and simmer about 45 minutes until tender. Stir into barley, add strawberries, cover and simmer for 10 minutes.

instructions: Combine all ingredients with hand blender or mixer. Blend until well mixed and fairly smooth. Refrigerate until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: creamy peanut butter,green olive,spaghetti noodle,pork belly,jasmine rice,salt pork,bean sprout,basmati rice
title: Jorge's Fried Rice
ingredients: 2 tablespoons creamy peanut butter | 1/4 lb ground lean pork or 1/4 lb ground veal | 1/4 lb salt pork, shredded | 2 cups cooked basmati rice ( i use jasmine ) | 1 can baked beans in peanut sauce | 1 cup hot cooked spaghetti noodles ( can use any pasta size of rice that will go into your bowl ) | 1/3 cup sliced green olives ( no stems ) | 2 -3 cups of cooked jorge's creamy peanut butter | 2 cups hot cooked long-grain jyard's creamy peanut butter | 1/2 - 3/4 cup warm water ( optional )
instructions: Make rice,. Heat skillet on medium high heat. When pan is hot, add peanut butter. When it begins to spread, add peanut butter/syrup mixture to your pan and stir quickly until smooth, about 10 minutes. Do this until pan is heated again. If it becomes difficult to incorporate in your pan, continue stirring for about 30 seconds. Remove from heat. As your peanut butter mixture in your pan starts to spread, scrape pan to distribute peanut butter mixture evenly around the pan so you can spread it on the sides. Do this to avoid it sticking to the pan after adding the peanut butter mixture, or it won't get enough spreadable spreading. Remove your pan from burner and set aside in a warm spot. While spreading your peanut butter mixture out, saute the salted pork/veal, until brown. If you have a lot of fat remaining in the pan, you can drain the fat off if you wish. Drain excess grease if there is any. Once browned, remove from heat. Place in a bowl and set aside. While waiting for pork, add the rice, beans and olives to the pan. Stir over low heat until heated through, about 5 minutes. Add in the hot drained pork/veal mixture. Add in your peanut or pork bacon mixture. Stir thoroughly. Pour warm water over everything and mix. Cover and place in 300 degree oven. Set timer for 8 minutes. Remove from oven and let stand until timer goes off.. After you leave the oven, stir the rice once more to mix, and place one large scoop of rice into a large bowl. Pour in one cup of creamy peanut butter, and mix thoroughly. Once timer goes off, turn your oven on to broil. Stick the entire mixture into your large pot of peanut butter mixture, and mix well. To keep hot, and to avoid burning your peanut butter mixture while mixing, you can use two small metal bowls or a glass jar to pour peanut butter mixture into pot of peanut butter mixture, and stir well to spread peanut butter mixture onto the rice. Allow rice to spread peanut butter mixture evenly across the surface of the rice, being careful not to spread peanut butter over the rice. If you see browning at the top, turn your oven down to 250 to 300 degrees. Broil for another few minutes and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: sea salt black pepper,bread flour,heirloom tomato,lemon juice zest,dark soy sauce,purpose flour,celery rib
title: Heirloom Tomato Focaccia
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs heirloom tomatoes, cut 1/8-inch dice | 1/2 cup finely chopped celery rib | 1 tablespoon all-purpose flour | 2 1/2 tablespoons stone-ground bread flour | 1 1/2 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 2 1/2 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 1/4 cup fresh lemon juice, plus more | lemon juice zest | sea salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Preheat the oven broiler. Line a cookie sheet with parchment paper. Combine the tomatoes, 1/4 cup of the celery and the 2 - ½ tablespoons of flour in a bowl of a food processor. Process until smooth, about 30 seconds. Add 1½ tablespoons of the remaining celery and the bread flour and process until incorporated. Stir in the remaining 2½ tablespoons of flour, the soy sauce and lemon juice. Transfer to a bowl. Season with salt and pepper. Add the remaining ½ cup of fresh lemon juice to finish. Transfer the tomato mixture to an oiled baking sheet. Using a pastry brush, apply the remaining 1½ teaspoons of lemon oil to the tomatoes, then evenly sprinkle with sea salt and pepper. Broil the focaccia until the tops are golden and starting to curl, about 5 minutes. Transfer to a rack and let cool. Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Spaghetti With Green Garlic and Chili
ingredients: 1/3 cup green garlic, finely chopped | 3 tablespoons anchovy-type paste or 3 tablespoons pimiento | 1 teaspoon dried chives or 1 teaspoon thyme | 12 ounces spaghetti or 12 ounces small other pastas, uncooked | 2 teaspoons sea salt
instructions: Heat the garlic in a small nonstick frying pan over a medium heat, stirring occasionally until it darkens lightly. Stir in the anchovies, chili or thyme and saute over a low to medium heat until the anchovies have melted. Add the spaghetti and 1/2 cup water to the pan and stir over the mixture until it is heated through. Top the sauce with the chives or thyme and serve.

Random Ingredients: celery rib,pepperoncini pepper,ginger ale,soy sauce,mustard powder,red pepper
title: Spicy Hot German Peppers and Peppers

instructions: Roughly chop the celery and pepper, put in bowl and drizzle ginger ale over them. Stir to mix together, cover and set to the side. Mixed them together by squeezing a handful of mixture, or whizz in blender. Pour into hot jars and close lid. Put on cap and screw on ring. Process for 15 minutes. instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a medium bowl, mash the cheese slightly with a fork. Stir in the chile peppers, onion, cardamom, parsley and refried beans. title: Pumpkin and Broccoli Baked in Spiced Cream
ingredients: 1 large head broccoli floret | 1 package solid pack pumpkin ( approx 4 cups ) | 1 1/4 cups nonfat milk | 1/2 cup nonfat milk | 1/4 cup buttermilk baking mix | 1/4 teaspoon ground cloves | 1/8 teaspoon ground agave ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Halve the broccoli florets, remove the core and florets if necessary and place in a strainer set over a bowl. Pour pumpkin mixture in the prepared pan and spread it out evenly over the top and sides. Sprinkle a bit of the florets over the pumpkin mix and bake for approximately 35 - 40 minutes, stirring every 5 minutes for the last 20 minutes or until golden and tender and a little crusty on the surface. title: Guacamole and Kaffir Lime Vinegar Snails

instructions: Prepare all the ingredients, including the lime leaves, including the jalapeno, in a clean kitchen towel. Place the snails and kaffir lime leaves together in a bowl. Add the white wine vinegar and gacamole. Mix thoroughly. Cover the snails with the lime leaves. Allow to marinate for a few minutes before serving.

instructions: Combine all the ingredients in a large bowl. Beat until combined, then set to the side. If the dressing looks too thick, stir in a little more water. Store in an airtight container in the fridge.

instructions: Grind the mustard seeds to a coarse powder in a grinder or in a food mill. Add onions, lemon juice and freshly ground pepper to taste. Let stand for a few hours or overnight before using.

title: Spinach and Fennel Sandwiches (Antipasto)
ingredients: 1 loaf sliced white bread | 1 can chopped spinach leaves, drained | 1/2 cup crushed fenugreek seeds | 2 tablespoons fennel seeds | 1 tablespoon chili powder | 1/2 pound ground beef or ground turkey | 1 package sliced pepperoni
instructions: Preheat an oven to 325 degrees f. On a cutting board, cut the loaf of bread into 4 pieces along the long sides. Place the bread rounds on a microwave safe plate. Cover with plastic wrap and microwave on high for 5 minutes. Transfer the bread to clean a separate plate and set aside. Meanwhile, in a bowl, combine the fenugreek, fennel, and chilli. Spoon some of the filling onto each toasted sandwich, cover with a slice or two of pepperoni, and let sit for about 5 minutes to absorb some of the juice before serving at room temperature.

instructions: In a medium bowl, mix together the parsley, ginger, seasoning mix, and chinese five spice mix. title: Corn on the Cob (Pierogi)
ingredients: 4 ears corn, with husks | 1 teaspoon toasted sesame seeds | 1 cup sour cream or 1 cup mayonnaise | 4 eggs, separated | 1 package roquefort cheese | 1 teaspoon dried mixed italian herbs | 1 teaspoon rice vinegar | 1 1/2 cups shredded mozzarella cheese, divided
instructions: Place corn on a gas grill or under broiler and cook until charred on one side. Turn corn over half way through to avoid burning. Cool. Combine the sour cream with egg yolks in a medium mixing bowl and beat until thick and creamy. Combine the chevre cheese with the sesame seeds, rice vinegar and 1 egg yolk mixture in another bowl. Beat the egg whites until stiff. Fold the whites into the corn mixture. Place a rack in the center of an oven and heat to 300 degrees. Place a corn niblet on a cutting board. Spread about a quarter of the sour cream mixture on the corn and shape into a 3 inch circle. Place the circle on top of an oiled baking sheet, spread with the remaining sour cream mixture, and sprinkle with italian herbs and half the cheese. Bake the corn until the outside is browned and the interior is hot and bubbly, about 40 - 50 minutes, depending on the temperature of your grill. Serve warm, sprinkled with more cheese.

Random Ingredients: linguine,roasting chicken,cannellini bean,malt vinegar,chocolate,torn cilantro leaf
title: Chicken Pasta Salad

instructions: Rinse chicken under running water and pat dry with paper towels. Place chicken in a shallow roasting pan. Add cilantro to taste, cover and refrigerate for at least 3 hours. instructions: Rinse hens. With wet hands, rub hens with 1 teaspoons vegetable oil. Heat pressure cooker over high heat. Reduce heat to medium. Cook hens for 40 minutes.
