Place into a sealable plastic bag and store for up to 2 months.

Random Ingredients: wheat flour,vegetable stock,baby spinach,cream,kaffir lime leaf,butternut squash,red bell pepper,cherry
title: Butternut Squash Soup With Cherries and Spinach
ingredients: 1 butternut squash, deseeded and cut into bite-sized chunks | 1 red bell pepper, de-seeded and cut into 1-inch cubes | 4 -8 fresh kaffir lime leaves, torn ( the limes have a tendency to turn bitter and act like a stew. we prefer kaffir lime leaf ) | 2 -3 cups vegetable stock, simmering | 2 tablespoons whole wheat flour | 1 ounce cream | 8 ounces baby spinach, shredded | fresh cherries or red cherries ( to garnish )
instructions: Place the squash cubes in a microwaveable bowl, add the red pepper, kaffir lime leaves and stock and stir until just mixed. Cover and microwave on high for 3 minutes, until the squash is almost cooked. Add the flour, stirring continuously for 2 - 3 minutes. Remove from the microwave and stir in the cream until thoroughly combined and smooth. Stir in all the spinach to the casserole dish and cook until wilted, stirring. Taste and adjust the seasoning with salt and pepper. Spoon into serving bowls and garnish with cherries or cherryries.

title: Chipotle Cream Substitute
ingredients: 1/4 cup nonfat milk | 1/2 teaspoon chipotle chile in adobo ( minced and seeded )
instructions: In small bowl, whisk milk with chipotle in adobo blend. Cover and chill for an hour. Serve with assorted crackers.

title: Swiss Pork Chops With Turnips and Mushrooms
ingredients: 4 pork chops, well trimmed | 3/4 lb turnip, peeled | 1 1/2 teaspoons salt | 1 bay leaf | 1 1/2 cups heavy cream | 1 ounce chopped fresh marshmallows
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees. Place pork chops in a 9 x 13 inch baking pan. If necessary, trim excess fat from the chops. Bake chops for 45 minutes, or till tender and cooked completely through. Remove chops from oven. Reduce oven temperature to 450 degrees. Place turnips and salt in a food processor. Process til smooth. Transfer mixture to a bowl. Stir in the bay leaf. Stir in cream and marshmallows, stirring till well blended. Spoon gravy over chops and serve immediately.

title: Homemade Smoked Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 1 head lettuce leaf | 1 pint sour cream | 1 tablespoon mixed spice
instructions: Place the lettuce leaves on a baking tray and cover with water. The water helps to keep the leaves from drying out. Allow to soak for 15 minutes. Drain. Combine all the ingredients and mix well. Scoop into a bag with a 2 inch tip. Tie the wraps closed. Heat up a generous tablespoon or two of smoke in the bottom of the wrap. As soon as it is bubbling, take hold and turn the heat down to low. Allow to smoke for a few minutes or until the smoke stops. Leave the wrap inside the bag. This helps keep the smoke from getting inside each wrap.

title: French Herb Twists
ingredients: 1 sheet shortcrust pastry, thawed | grated mace or mixed fresh herbs ( optional ) | cinnamon, and | dried chives ( optional )
instructions: Roll pastry sheets to thickness of 15 mm / ½ inch. Line greased & floured pastry dough with pastry, pinching dough edges together slightly. Dust pastry with a mixture of spices & spices if using. Trim or sift pastry onto greased baking tray, bake in preheated oven for 15 - 20 minutes or until golden. Dust pastries with cinnamon & dust well with chives & serve warm or cold.

Random Ingredients: chocolate cake mix,vegetable stock,graham cracker crumb
title: Chocolate Gravy for Pasta
ingredients: 1 box chocolate cake mix | 1 package instant graham cracker crumbs | 2 1/2 cups vegetable stock
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. In a medium bowl, mix together the cake mix, graham cracker crumbs, and vegetable stock. Stir in the chocolate mixture just until moistened. Spread pasta in a large roasting pan or jelly roll pan. Evenly spread the gravy over the pasta. Cover the pan with aluminum foil. Bake for 45 minutes in the preheated oven.

Random Ingredients: mango chutney,bacon dripping,chili paste,oregano leaf,green bean,jicama,golden raisin,tarragon
title: Green Beans With Mango and Jicama
ingredients: 1 lb fresh green beans, cut in half | 3 tablespoons bacon drippings or 3 tablespoons olive oil | 3/4 cup raw mango chutney | 4 slices bacon, chopped | 3/4 cup jicama, finely chopped | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried tarragon | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried oregano leaves | 1/4 teaspoon chili paste, like sambal oelek or 1/4 teaspoon chipotle pepper flakes
instructions: Trim ends off the green beans and cut them into 1 lengths. Bring a large saucepan of water to a boil, add the beans and cook until just tender, about 3 minute drain, and set aside. Heat the oil in a skillet or saute pan over medium heat. Add the chutney and bacon and saute until the bacon is browned and the mango is translucent, about 5 minute add the beans, tarragon, oregano, chili paste, and drained cooked green beans. Cook and stir until hot but not boiling, 2 - 3 minute serve immediately.

title: Cheese Spread With Yellow and Gruyere Dressing
ingredients: 1/2 cup shredded mexican cheese | 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 3/4 teaspoon yellow mustard, preferably grey ( to taste ) | fresh thyme sprigs ( optional )
instructions: Stir all ingredients together in a shallow bowl. Cover and place in the refrigerator until ready to serve. Garnish with thyme sprigs, if desired.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast meat,limeade concentrate,red potato,kidney bean,shallot,baby spinach
title: Slow Cooker Chicken, Spinach, and Kidney Bean Salad
ingredients: 3 cloves garlic, minced | 1, fresh limeade concentrate, or more as needed | 1 skinless, boneless chicken breast meat, cut into bite-size pieces | 1 shallot, finely chopped | 1 can kidney beans, rinsed and drained | 1 can diced red potatoes, drained | 1 package fresh baby spinach
instructions: Put the garlic, limeade concentrate, and chicken into a slow cooker and sprinkle with shallot. Cover, and cook on low for 10 minutes. Stir in the kidney beans, red potatoes, and spinach.

title: Aubergines, aubergines & Bacon
ingredients: 2 -6 aubergines, sliced diagonally | 3 tablespoons cider vinegar | 12 tablespoons pure maple syrup | 1 teaspoon coriander powder | 150 g mascarpone cheese, softened
instructions: Spray shallow non stick pan with oil. Dip sliced aubergines into the cider vinegar & let them dry for a few minutes. Place the sliced aubergines, coated with the maple syrup and coriander in the preheated pan & cook over medium heat for approx 15 minutes. When done drain the aubergines on kitchen paper & spread out on clean kitchen paper. Cover with the mascarpone cheese & return to the preheated oven to a medium heat, cook the aubergines for 3 - 4 minutes until they have golden on the edges & are cooked through and the cheese is melting.

title: Pasta Rosa
ingredients: 1 lb penne pasta, uncooked | 4 whole cloves | 1/4 cup dry sherry | 1/4 cup light-colored honey | 1 bunch fresh basil leaves
instructions: Cook pasta in 1 quart boiling salted water until al dente. Drain pasta while still warm.

Random Ingredients: lime wedge,orange zest,white rice,egg yolk,caul,flour tortilla,pimiento
title: Grilled Rice Burritos
ingredients: 3 cups cooked white rice | 1 jar pimiento slices | 3/4 cup chopped egg yolk | 2 tablespoons orange zest | 5 flour tortillas | 1/2 cup finely chopped cooked egg yolk | lime wedge
instructions: Soak rice and pimiento in boiling water for 20 minutes until rice is softened. Drain well and pat out excess water. In a small bowl, stir egg yolk with orange zest. In nonstick skillet, heat tortillas over medium heat until lightly golden on both sides, and about 1 minute per side. Divide cooked rice among each tortilla and roll up. Garnish with egg yolk mixture and lime wedges. Serve warm.

title: Candied Squash
ingredients: 1 cup dark corn syrup | 1/2 lemon, juiced | 1 yellow squash, cut into bite-sized chunks
instructions: Bring the corn syrup, lemon juice, and squash to a boil in a saucepan over moderately high heat. Boil the sauce, stirring frequently, until thickened and reduced by about half, about 10 minutes. Transfer the mixture to a shallow baking dish. Let cool completely. Serve warm, or let cool completely before storing in the refrigerator. Variation, store the cooled squash in the freezer until serving.

title: Simple Vegan Veal Burger
ingredients: 500 g veal patty ( the recipe just stated 4 servings- i use extra virgin veg ) | vegetable juice, from the can ( see recipe description above ) | 1 tablespoon vegetable juice ( see recipe description above ) or 1 tablespoon water ( see recipe description above ) | 1 teaspoon brown sugar
instructions: If using veg, mix ingredients in a plastic bag, seal, and shake to combine. Cook veg for 5 minutes on each side, or until cooked through. Place the burger on a heatproof plate, and press veg lightly with a meat tenderiser so that it has an even weight. Spray non stick vegetable spray or oil spray onto grate for cooking. Top with burger sauce and serve with extra sauce. Tips, if you don't have a veeg, you can use a meat grilling basket for your veg patty, but i don't find it to be as tasty as a pan fried basket. If you use the oil, it will not do, because you can't have loads on your plate this way, and a non stick spray would go great for it.

title: Peach and Olive Rolls
ingredients: 2/3 cup canned sliced almonds | 1 can sliced peaches, drained | 1 package frozen chopped spinach | 6 sheets nori | 1 1/2 teaspoons mustard powder | 3/4 teaspoon chili sauce | 1/4 teaspoon allspice | 1/4 cup chopped fresh strawberries ( optional )
instructions: Blend almonds and peaches together in a food processor until finely chopped. Separate sheets of nori and lightly sprinkle evenly with sesame seed. Set aside. Spread peanut spread evenly over nori. Place a second layer of nori on the peanuts and spread with sesame seeds. Repeat with remaining nori, peanut spread, and remaining nori to make 3 sandwiches. Strawberry topping, combine all ingredients in a bowl, and stir well with a fork. Spread each sandwich with the strawberry topping, and serve.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil,tilapia fillet,celery,mint,brown sugar,italian dressing,caster sugar
title: Tilapia Salad with Dressing
ingredients: 4 tilapia fillets, about 5oz each, skin on | 8 ounces mixed chopped vegetables | 1 tablespoon chopped celery | 1 teaspoon caster sugar | 1 tablespoon brown sugar | 1 1/2 ounces mixed dried italian dressing | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil
instructions: Pre heat the oven to 350°f. Tear up the fish fillets into fine pieces. Layer the vegetables and herbs over the bottom of a oven proof casserole dish. Whisk together the sugar, brown sugar, oil, and dressing in a small bowl and toss in the fish. Cover the pan with foil and bake for 20 - 25 minutes. Serve warm with crusty bread.

title: Christmas Time English Pea and Tomato Soup
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes | 3/4 cup buttermilk | 6 cups white chocolate or 6 cups semisweet chocolate chips | 2 celery ribs | 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato seeds | 16 ounces frozen peas
instructions: Place the sundried tomatoes into a small saucepan or large microwave safe bowl. Add buttermilk, bring to a boil, and then add chocolate, stirring until melted. Chop celery sticks into 1/4 inch sticks. Heat oven to 350 degrees. Stir peas into the melted chocolate mixture. Pour into a 2 cup oven safe baking dish, and sprinkle with sun dried tomatoes. Place dish in oven, and bake 45 minutes or until heated through.

title: Champignon Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 tablespoon prepared horseradish | 1 package chantignon mushrooms, sliced | 1/2 cup cherries, pitted and coarsely chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Grease a baking sheet with butter. Mix the horseradish and mushrooms in a small bowl. Spoon mushroom mixture into the prepared baking sheet, spreading it evenly. Bake for 5 minutes.

title: Barbecue Ribs, Artichokes and Spices
ingredients: 1 cup cake flour | 1/3 cup molasses | 2 tablespoons paprika or 2 tablespoons hot madras curry powder | 1 teaspoon coriander | 1 teaspoon spice | 1 1/2 - 2 lbs country-style spareribs, cut into 4 serving pieces
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. In a large bowl, combine the flour, molasses, curry powder, coriander and spice. Add the spareribs, rubbing them in the mixture to coat well. Place on a large baking sheet with sides and bake for 1 hour. Turn pieces and bake until golden brown, 25 to 30 minutes longer.

title: Veal Noodle Soup
ingredients: 3 lbs veal ( or beef ) | 1 tablespoon seasoning salt | 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme, crushed | 1/4 teaspoon caramels or 1/4 teaspoon other aromatic spices | 1 1/2 pints beef broth | 1/2 cup cashews, roasted ( not unsalted ) | 1/2 cup sliced carrot ( or sweet potatoes, peeled, or mixed ) | 4 ounces egg noodles
instructions: Cut veal into 1 inch cubes. Brown in a 2qt. Slow cooker. Drain all but 1/2 drippings in cooker, add veal to cooker. Combine spices, broth and cashews. Pour mixture over the veal and stir in carrots. Cover. Cook on low for 8 hours. Serve topped with noodles.

title: Pea and Kale Salad
ingredients: 2 cups kale, coarsely chopped | 1 cup split peas, drained | 1/2 cup sliced pepperoni
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well.

title: Horseradish Potato Salad
ingredients: 4 potatoes | 2 small cucumbers | 1/4 cup chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley | 1/2 cup low-fat sour pickle flakes ( or horseradish mustard ) | 1 -2 tablespoon bottled horseradish, grated ( or use your favorite dipping sauce ) | 1 -2 tablespoon mirin | 3 -4 drops tabasco sauce
instructions: Boil potatoes until tender and easily pierced, about 12 - 15 minutes.. While potatoes are cooking cut up cucumbers and parsley into large bite sized chunks and mix with sour pickle, horseradish or your favorite dipping sauce i used a mix of dijon, mayo and sesame seed. Drain potatoes and stir in mixture. Add tabasco or other hot sauce to taste if desired.

title: Beshwat (Barefoot Fom Couscous)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons garam masala | 1 1/2 lbs beef brisket, trimmed | 1/4 cup lemon juice | 1 1/2 tablespoons chopped chipotle chiles ( or less )
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°. Place the garam masala in a resealable freezer bag and massage in the meat. Massage until the meat has been thoroughly coated with oil. Pat dry with paper towels. Place the brisket on a roasting rack. Rub with the lemon juice and sprinkle with the chiles. Cover and refrigerate for 2 hours, turning the meat occasionally. Remove the meat and let rest at least 15 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: buddha pizza pie crust,pesto sauce,chunky salsa
title: Quick and Easy Pizza With Pesto
ingredients: 1 prepared pizza crust | 1 cup pesto sauce | 1/2 cup chunky salsa
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Spread pesto sauce on pizza crust. Spread salsa on pizza crust. Use toothpick to secure crust. Bake in preheating oven 12 to 15 minutes to finish a drizzle.

title: Baked French Fry Onion Rings
ingredients: 3 medium sweet onions, sliced | 1 cup hot water | 1 tablespoon dark brown sugar
instructions: Heat oven to 400°f. Place onions in a shallow casserole dish. Spoon the hot water down the center of the slices and scatter the brown sugar over the tops. Cover and bake for 45 minutes.

title: Cheesy Lamb Chops With Beets & Swiss Chard
ingredients: 1 tablespoon fat-free tapioca | 24 ounces boneless lamb rib- chops | 2 fresh beet tops, stems removed | 2 tablespoons pickled beets | 4 ounces shredded provolone cheese | 6 nori | 1 pinch ground nutmeg | 12 frankfurters | pickled maraschino cherry
instructions: Preheat grill to high heat. Spray a large skillet with nonstick cooking spray. Combine tapioca with 1/2 cup water in a small bowl.

Random Ingredients: tamarind juice,thai fish sauce,sazon goya,mint leaf
title: Basic Vietnamese Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 cup tamarind juice | 2 tablespoons thai fish sauce | 1 teaspoon sazon goya | 1 tablespoon fresh mint leaves, minced or 1/2 teaspoon dried mint ( optional )
instructions: Squeeze excess water from tamarind and discard the pulp.

Random Ingredients: serrano chile pepper,cayenne pepper,red wine,active yeast
title: Gujarati
ingredients: 2 1/2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 2 cups warm red wine or 2 cups water | 4 -5 serrano chile peppers, chopped | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper
instructions: The gujarati is ready when the surface cracks on the surface and looks dry around the edges. If using warm white wine, stir it into the gujarati just before proceeding, the liquid will act as a thin sponge. Dissolve the yeast in the warm red wine and stir well. Stir in the chiles, cayenne, and a generous pinch of salt. Let rise in a warm place until it stops bubbling. Punch down, brush the inside of a shallow baking dish with a little oil, or grease it lightly with oil. Spoon the gujarati into the hot oil, flattening to a 1 1/2 pound coin shape. Bake in a preheated 450º oven for about 20 to 25 minutes, or until the top is golden. Serve hot or cold.

Random Ingredients: parmesan cheese,chicken breast meat,water,teriyaki sauce,beer,tortilla,strawberry,vanilla sugar
title: Chicken Milkshake With Crispy Wheat Nests
ingredients: 1 cup chopped fresh strawberries ( about 15 strawberries ) | 12 ounces chicken breast meat | 1/4 cup teriyaki sauce | 2 tablespoons water | 1/4 cup beer | 3 tablespoons vanilla sugar | 12 -14 tortillas | 1/2 cup grated parmesan cheese
instructions: Mix together the first 3 ingredients in a bowl. Heat a griddle or small skillet until a drop of water bounces off the surface of the griddle or skillet. Brush the griddle/skillet with oil and set over medium high heat. Dip each tortilla into the chocolate mixture. Lay tortilla in hot skillet and let sit 2 minutes. Toast tortillas until golden brown, about 3 minutes on each side, moving them to side as needed. Dip chicken into the chocolate mixture, shaking off any excess. Serve one tortilla per person drizzle each with a little teriyaki sauce then top with more sauce.

title: Blue Cheese, Roasted Tomato and Rice Salad
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups long grain rice ( white, italian or river rice can also be used ) | 4 ounces blue cheese ( blue is traditional but any type of soft type will do ) | 4 -6 large cherry tomatoes, cut into halves
instructions: Pre heat oven to 350°f. Prepare rice according to directions on box. Add blue cheese to rice and toss till melted. Add tomatoes and toss till coated. Transfer rice to oven and bake for 25 - 35 minutes or till rice is light golden brown and the cherry tomatoes just start to burst.. Eat and enjoy.

title: Gouda and Asparagus Rice
ingredients: 1 bag asparagus spears, cooked | 2 cups white rice, cooked | 2 cups gouda cheese, shredded
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Line a baking pan with aluminum foil, and spray with non cooking spray. Cut asparagus into 1 inch pieces, if you like, and place in pan. Spray tops with non cooking spray and sprinkle with cheese. Place in oven until cheese has melted. Remove from oven and serve.

title: Russian Grilled Bread
ingredients: 1 loaf ciabatta, sliced, about 1/4 of an inch thick ( i like white or some crusty bread from the grocery store ) | 1 -2 teaspoon cooking oil ( more if desired ) | 1 packet chicken soup | 1 bottle vodka | 1 bottle dipping sauce ( your favorite )
instructions: Cut bread into 1 inch squares. Spread 1/4 of the oil on both sides of bread and let stand for about 15 minutes. Combine the next 10 ingredients in a bowl and spread onto bread. Place a cookie sheet on top of the bowl and put a plate on top of the bowl. Grill bread until the cheese is melted and bread is slightly crisp, about 2 - 3 minutes. Remove from grill and cool slightly. Cut into 4 squares and serve with dipping sauce. You can top them with sour cream if desired.

title: Brazilian Cod Pig-Chops
ingredients: 1 pound cod, cut into 1 inch strips | 8 ounces large shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1 bunch baby spinach | 1/2 cup unsweetened baking cocoa | 1/2 cup white vinegar | 1/2 cup butter
instructions: Place cod and shrimp in a large saucepan. Add water to cover. Bring to a boil.

title: Dulce De Leche
ingredients: 2 cups white sugar | 1/3 cup ground cardamom pod
instructions: Melt sugar. When cool, mix in cardamom. Pour into a 9x13 inch pan. Let harden before cutting.

title: Homemade Green Chilies
ingredients: 8 ounces green chilies | 1 bunch of fresh celery
instructions: Remove stalk from celery. Cut into 1 inch by 2 pieces. Roast chillies in a skillet until dark and dark. Let cool. Place chilies in a blender with a few drops of water. Puree. Add pureed chilies and celery to blender for a smoother texture. Add extra water if mixture is too thick and water to cover. Blender should take just a few seconds. Pour into a glass jar or jars. Seal and leave for several months. After removing chillies to release excess juices, mix with a whisk. Then add 1 - 2 tsp of sugar.

Random Ingredients: baby carrot,tomato paste,carrot,golden raisin,cooking oil,chicken quarter,frying chicken
title: Chicken Stew from the Jq King
ingredients: 1 frying chicken quarter, cut up | 1/2 cup cooking oil | 1 can tomato paste | 2 lbs new baby carrots | 1 lb baby carrots | 2 tablespoons quick-cooking oil | 1/2 cup golden raisin | 2 tablespoons tomato paste | 1/2 cup browned carrot | 1 tablespoon quick-cooking oil
instructions: In a large dutch oven or pot heat oil over medium heat until it shimmers. Sear chicken until well browned. Transfer to slow cooker and add tomato paste and remaining ingredients. Cook on low heat for 6 hours or on high heat for 3 - 4 hours. Serve with rice.

Random Ingredients: tamari,oregano leaf,green bell pepper,dashi stock,horseradish,white chocolate,tahini
title: Grilled Tahini and Pepper Nests
ingredients: 1/4 cup tamari | 1/2 cup dashi stock | 2 teaspoons horseradish | 2/3 cup white plain yogurt or 2/3 cup sour cream | 4 green bell peppers or 4 red bell peppers, halved lengthwise | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried oregano leaves | 1/4 teaspoon dried tahini
instructions: Combine tamari, stock, horseradish, 1/3 cup yogurt and 1 or 2 pepper halves in blender, process until smooth. Stir remaining yogurt with 1/2 teaspoon salt. Transfer to small bowl.

title: Pommes D'alsange (Red Apples in Potato Cakes)
ingredients: 2 baking potatoes, peeled and cut into rounds | 4 large red apples, such as granny smith, cored and sliced ( about 8 oz. each ) | 1/2 cup dried mixed fruit
instructions: Heat oven to 400°f. Line baking sheets with parchment paper. Slice each potato lengthwise into thin rounds with a serrated knife. Arrange apple slices and mixed fruit attractively on parchment lined baking sheets. Bake until apples are tender when pierced with a fork, 12 to 15 minutes. Transfer to paper towel lined plates. Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Onion Sauce
ingredients: 14 ounces cream of tartar | 1 large onion ( thinly sliced )
instructions: Mix the cream of tartar and onion. Use to thicken your favorite pasta sauce. Use as a filling for fettuccine.

title: Cottage Cheese, Kale, Sweet Bacon, and Bread Appetizer
ingredients: 6 slices bacon | 3 1/2 cups dry curd cottage cheese | 1/4 cup sweet bread crumbs | 2 tablespoons sesame oil | 1 bunch kale, chopped
instructions: Place bacon in a large, deep skillet. Cook over medium high heat until evenly brown. Drain, crumble, and set aside. Place cottage cheese in a medium bowl. Mix in crumbs and bread crumbs. Drizzle with sesame oil and mix well. Place kale in the skillet over medium heat. Cook 2 to 3 minutes, until tender crisp and lightly browned. Stir kale mixture into cheese and bacon, and serve.

title: Basic Garlic Sauce
ingredients: 4 heads fennel seeds | 2 1/2 teaspoons salt
instructions: Roast the fennel in a 300 degree f oven for 10 to 15 minutes. Then cool. Grind the fennel seeds and salt together in a pestle and mortar or by putting them through a ground coffee grinder. Store in closed an airtight container for up to 1 week.

title: Arepas With Peas, Cilantro and Grapes
ingredients: 1/2 lb fresh green pea, shelled | 1/2 cup old amber beer, such as guiness | 2 tablespoons molasses | 2 tablespoons finely chopped cilantro, plus extra | chopped fresh cilantro | 10 leaves lettuce ( such as arugula or other leaf lettuce, large stems removed ) | 1 large green grape, halved lengthwise
instructions: Place both pea halves in a shallow glass bowl and pour over the amber beer. Let stand 10 minutes. Meanwhile, place the molasses in a small bowl and stir in the cilantro. Preheat a grill. Thread the peas onto skewers. Grill over medium coals and cook until crisp and brown, about 3 minutes, turning once, and sprinkling with salt as needed, about 3 minutes more. Remove from the grill and place in a bowl to cool slightly. Remove the nuts from the pea halves and set them on the sides. Top each with 2 whole lettuce leaves, about 2 tablespoons per serving. Garnish with cilantro. Serve warm.

title: Thai Vegetable Soup
ingredients: 4 cups frozen broccoli florets | 2 fresh hot dried red chilies, crushed | 1/4 cup vinegar | 1 can stewed tomatoes with juice | 1 can chinese vegetables, drained
instructions: Cook the broccoli in a large saucepan over a gentle heat for 5 - 10 minutes, stirring frequently and turning frequently. Meanwhile, combine all the remaining ingredients in a large saucepan, bring to the boil. Reduce the heat and simmer covered for 15 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender and the soup comes to the boil.

title: Sweet N Sour Soup
ingredients: 2 lbs firm tofu | 1/2 cup chicken stock | 2 tablespoons minced garlic | 1 cup half-and-half | 3/4 cup desiccated coconut | 1/4 cup half-and-half | 2 teaspoons orange blossom water | 5 -6 teaspoons minced peanuts ( optional )
instructions: Cut tofu into cubes about half inch sized. Cut off top layer of tofu. Discard any excess water/frying. Put tofu into a colander and let sit for about 10 minutes. Remove water, discard tofu. Drain tofu and set aside. Slice off any excess water/frying juices and set aside. Heat chicken stock to a boil and throw in the minced garlic. Stir soup and return to a boil. In a bowl, combine half and half, coconut, half&half, orange blossom water and tofu with the broth and stir well. Add peanuts if desired. Simmer for about 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: green olive,mexican cheese,granny smith apple,cumin powder,enchilada sauce,spaghetti sauce mix,almond essence,oil
title: Auntie Jack's Mexican Apple Squares
ingredients: 1 package spaghetti sauce mix | 1 lb granny smith apple, peeled, cored and cut into 8 slices | 1/3 cup green olives | 1 envelope dry enchilada sauce | 1 1/2 teaspoons oil | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 1 teaspoon almond essence | 1 package shredded mexican blend cheese ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f put a layer of rice on the bottom of a 20x10 or 9x9 inch baking dish. Layer all ingredients of the sauce over rice and bake for 45 minutes to 1 hour or until hot & bubbly.

title: Quick and Easy White Beans and Mash
ingredients: 1 cup cannellini beans | 1 tablespoon cornflour | 1 teaspoon garlic salt | 2 tablespoons kielbasa | 1 -2 tablespoon soymilk
instructions: In a small bowl mix together beans and soymilk. Mash the beans with the cornflour and garlic salt. Add the kielbasa and mash to combine. Serve in small bowls.

title: Kielbasa and Green Enchilada Sauce
ingredients: 32 ounces green enchilada sauce | 1 package kielbasa, cut into 1 inch slices
instructions: Pour about one third of enchilada sauce into a 9x13 inch baking dish or crockpot, and arrange half the kielbasa in the dish. Repeat layering, starting with the kielbasa, ending with the kielbasa. Pour remaining enchilada sauce over top. Cover, and bake for 4 hours at.

Random Ingredients: serrano pepper,red capsicum,pimiento,confectioner sugar,vegetable broth,anise seed
title: Spanish Confiture
ingredients: 2 serrano peppers, deseeded and thinly sliced | 1 tablespoon fresh pimientos, chopped | 2 teaspoons anise seed | 1 cup vegetable broth | 1 red capsicums, cut into 4 chunks ( optional ) | 1 pinch confectioners'sugar
instructions: Place the serrano peppers, pimiento, onion, and aniseed in a blender. Pulse, gradually, until finely chopped. Using a strainer, squeeze the mixture a little to remove all the liquid.

title: Chutney Pastries
ingredients: 1 sheet frozen puff pastry, thawed | 1/2 cup mango chutney
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Press pastry in bottom and sides of 10 inch pie dish. Bake in preheated oven until edge of edge is golden brown and dry. Let cool before filling. Pour mango chutney over pastry. Cover and refrigerate 10 minutes. Roll pastry out thinly.

title: Warm Chicken Salad With Tahini Dressing
ingredients: 1 cup tahini | 1 teaspoon vanilla | 1 cup diced cooked chicken meat | 1 head romaine lettuce or 1 head boston lettuce, torn | 1/3 cup kalamata olive, halved
instructions: Mix tahini, and vanilla in a bowl, making sure to stir constantly. Add chicken. Toss salad with tahini dressing, garnish with olives, and enjoy.

title: Easy Cashew Nut
ingredients: 1 can condensed tomato soup ( no. 303 ) | 2 tablespoons cashews, finely chopped | 1 1/2 teaspoons cardamom seeds ( if you prefer ) or 1 1/2 teaspoons coriander seeds ( if you prefer )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl and add enough water to make a thick, even gravy. Keep refrigerated in a tightly covered container.

Random Ingredients: tandoori spice mix,basil,cheddar cheese,red cabbage,coconut milk
title: Thai Red Cabbage
ingredients: 1/2 cup coconut milk | 2 teaspoons tandoori spice mix | 12 ounces shredded red cabbage | 3/4 cup shredded aged old cheddar cheese | 1/2 tablespoon roughly chopped fresh basil
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f combine coconut milk, tandoori spice mix and cabbage in a large bowl, tossing to coat.

Random Ingredients: pearl barley,beef bouillon cube,ladyfinger,seasoning salt,shortening,almond butter,carom seed
title: Swiss Barley Hot Dog
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups pearl barley, cooked | 1/2 lb shortening | 3/4 cup shortening | 4 1/2 teaspoons seasoning salt | 1 teaspoon carom seeds | 2 beef bouillon cubes | 1 lb ladyfinger | 1/2 cup almond butter
instructions: Drain pearl barley with a sieve then place into a saucepan with 1/2 cups water and cover. Bring to a boil over high heat and cook until barley is tender. Drain and set aside, covered. Cream shortening and 1/4 cup shortening in a bowl until light and fluffy. Mix in salt, carom seeds and 1 teaspoon bermade. Set aside. Beat remaining 3/4 cup shortening and 2 cups water in medium bowl until smooth. Mix flour and 1/2 cup pearl barley and fold into shortening mixture along with remaining barley. Divide into 6 serving portions. Roll each portion of dough into a thin log. Lay on two baking sheets, seam side down. Using a plastic or damp cloth, press ends to seal. Bake until just golden, about 30 minutes. Transfer to a wire rack and cool. Remove peel. Wrap in plastic and chill 20 minutes. Slice diagonally onto 1/2 slices. Place back into freezer. Repeat process until all the ingredients are used. To reheat, line a broiler pan with foil and heat just until hot. To serve, place warm biscuits on a flat plate and drizzle with almond butter.

title: Pasta With Yogurt and Sage

title: Crockpot Chicken and Rice
ingredients: 1 package instant pudding-style rice | 1 chicken meat
instructions: Cook rice. Drain excess water. Add onion and meat. Cover and cook until rice is done.

title: A Scotch Broiler

instructions: Heat your broiler setting. Combine the green onions, whiskey and corn syrup in a small jug or small bowl. Pour the mixture onto a hot frying pan about two thirds full of water should run over the surface. Turn and brush the surface with the mixture frequently. Immediately turn the broiler and broil for 2 to 3 minutes until the top is browned and bubbly. Serve straight away with toast or ice cream.

title: Crock Pot Stewed Lamb and Potatoes
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs lamb, cubes | 1 3/4 lbs new potatoes, peeled | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 1 cup frozen whipped topping, thawed
instructions: Combine ingredients in crock pot slow cooker. Cover and cook on low for 6 - 8 hours.

Add crab mixture to skillet and stir fry until heated through, about 3 - 4 minutes. Transfer to a large platter and sprinkle with ham and serve hot with rice.

title: Beef and Coleslaw Mix
ingredients: 4 lbs beef brisket | 2 tablespoons ground cloves | 1 ounce pepper ( mesquite, calcuto-optional ) | 2 pounds coleslaw mix | 1/4 cup tea, base
instructions: Place brisket in a large, heavy dutch oven or other large pot over medium heat. Add enough cold water to cover. When meat has cooked 30 minutes, remove to a cutting board, and remove and discard wood chips or cones. Trim fat from brisket, and cut in 1 inch cubes. Discard any fat remaining in pot. In a saucepan, stir together the ground cloves and pepper. Add remaining meat. Pour in the clove pepper mixture and enough water to cover.

Random Ingredients: chicken broth,bell pepper,pineapple chunk,white flour,linguine,green cabbage

ingredients: 8 ounces linguine | 8 ounces shredded chicken or 8 ounces other firm white meat | 8 ounces pineapple chunks | 4 slices green cabbage or 4 green cabbage | 1 small bell pepper, seeded and cut into thin strips | chicken broth or vegetable broth
instructions: Cook linguine in boiling salted water. Add vegetables and chicken. Return to boiling. Drain linguine and toss with broth. Serve.

instructions: Place cornflour in a bowl & combine with a little of the tomato paste. Add the rice and stir until well coated, cover and leave for 5 mins, until rice is cooked.

title: Spinach and Mushroom Casserole

Pour the mixture into a greased 2 quart casserole dish. Cover and bake in the preheated oven for 55 minutes. Let cool for 15 minutes before serving.

title: Sydney Bean Dip

instructions: Chop onion and leeks. Dice green chilies. In bowl, soften beans. Mix beans into onions and leeks. Drain baked beans and mix with leeks. Add mango chutney and pepper. Blend well. Spread on a greased cookie sheet or dish. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: rice flour,purpose flour,spinach leaf,green pepper,curry powder,masa harina
title: Spiral Green Sauce

instructions: Combine all the ingredients in a saucepan, stirring well with a whisk. Bring to a boil over medium heat. Reduce heat and simmer 5 to 7 minutes, stirring constantly, until thick. Pour into a bowl and serve warm.

title: Easy BBQ Dip

instructions: In a large skillet, cook bacon over medium heat until crisp, breaking into small, crumbly pieces. Pour bacon and grease into a bowl and set aside. Place baking dish on center rack of oven and bake for 45 minutes until puffed and top is browned.

Random Ingredients: onion powder,gelatin,flour tortilla,rigatoni pasta,kiwi fruit,coriander,pea carrot,sirloin
title: Aussie Beef Fajitas

instructions: Place beef into crockpot. Sprinkle on onion and coriander. Soak 8 - 10 minutes. Drain beef. Cut into ¾ inch cubes. Place on plate with a towel. Wipe out crockpot. Sprinkle with gelatin. Arrange on tortillas with peas and carrots. Add kiwifruit, jalapeños and pickled jalapeños. Arrange on 4 plates.

title: Falafel-Burger With Cumin, Semis or Garlic

instructions: Combine all the ingredients except for the semolina flour or wheat flour and the marjoram. Form into balls, and press out balls with your hands until they are about ¾ inch thickness. Cook the falafel burgers on a hot, oiled griddle for a few minutes on each side.

Random Ingredients: corn syrup,vanilla pudding mix,plain nonfat yogurt,flour tortilla,pepperoni,trout fillet,cheese spread,rye bread

Bake in 300 degree oven 10 minutes, or until just barely hot. Serve warm with sour cream and pepperoni slices. For vegetarian use the tofu cheese. Drain water from meat and replace with vegetable broth.

title: Spinach and Mushroom Pasta
ingredients: 12 ounces farfalle pasta | 7 fluid ounces ready made pizza sauce | 4 ounces porcini mushrooms, coarsely chopped | 1 tablespoon plain flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 350f degrees. Cook pasta in a large pan of rapidly simmering salted water until tender.

title: Wild Rice Mushroom Dip With Snow Peas
ingredients: 1 package cream cheese, softened | 1 can cremini mushrooms, finely chopped | 1 cup heavy whipping cream | 1 lb frozen snow peas
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 f degrees. Line 15x10x1 inch cookie sheet with foil. In a medium bowl, combine cream cheese, mushrooms and whipping cream. Toss lightly, adding more cream if needed. Fold in snow peas. Spread mixture evenly on foil lined cookie sheet. Bake 30 - 45 minutes. Serve warm with your favorite dippers.

title: Creamy French Onion Gravy
ingredients: 1/2 medium spanish onion, cut into 1/2'slices ( vidalia, walla walla ) | 1 dash garam masala powder | 1 tablespoon marshmallow creme
instructions: Saute onions on medium heat until brown, reduce heat to low if they're too dark, and continue to cook, stirring as necessary when removing lid, stir in gravy powder, and cook for 2 or so minutes, until liquid is reduced a bit by half, and gravy appears smooth. Remove from heat.

instructions: Preheat the broiler. In a bowl, stir together the yogurt, wine, and sliced beef. Spoon into baking dishes, and sprinkle with cheese. Place under the broiler, and broil until cheese is bubbly, about 2 minutes.

title: Baked Okra With Okra

instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f degrees. Place thawed okra, mirin and fish sauce in a large oven proof bowl. Coat okra with the marinade. Bake 25 minutes, until heated through.

title: Teriyaki Vegetables
ingredients: 1 lb frozen mixed vegetables
instructions: Bring water to boil in a medium saucepan. Cover and cook 3 minutes. Stir in vegetables. Cook, uncovered, 5 to 6 minutes or until vegetables are crisp tender.

title: Candy Mix for Hot Dogs
ingredients: 3 tablespoons powdered onion powder | 3 tablespoons powdered cardamom | 3 ounces candy ( your favourite brand or mix of your favourites ) | 1/2 cup crushed candy ( your favourite brand or mix of your favourite brand )
instructions: Mix the powdered onion powder with 1 tbsp of powdered cardamom. Melt the other 1/2 tbsp of powdered onion powder in a saucepan. Take off the stove, pour out the grease and set aside. After one hour add crushed candy.

title: Homemade Sriracha
ingredients: 2 serrano chilies | 1 1/2 cups irish whiskey ( or to taste )
instructions: Rinse a large jar with water. Turn the jar upside down for 15 minutes and pour off any liquids that might be trapped inside. Cut the chiles lengthwise into pieces 2 or 3 inches long. Combine chiles and whiskey and set aside. Store samarita in a glass container with a tight fitting lid.

title: Enchiladas Verde
ingredients: 1 pound ground beef | 1 can or bottle mexican-style stewed tomatoes
instructions: Preheat a skillet over medium heat and stir in the ground beef. Cook and stir until the beef is mostly browned. Drain excess grease. Stir in the tomatoes, reduce heat to low, and simmer until the flavors blend, about 15 minutes.

instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Combine ¼ cup cheese and potatoes in a large bowl and toss lightly. Transfer to a sprayed 11 x 7 baking dish. Sprinkle with remaining 1/2 cup cheese. Bake 30 to 35 minutes or until top is dry and golden brown.

instructions: Stir together cream cheese, wild rice, jalapeno pepper, and rosemaryweed in a medium bowl until well combined. Cover bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate until the mixture is chilled, at least 30 minutes.

instructions: Throw everything in to the crock pot and cook on low about 6 hours, or over high 4 - 4 hours. Serve with a good pumpernickel bread.

instructions: Cut the beef or sirloin into thin slices. Boil the onions in a pan until transparent, add them to a blender with half the cream, brandy, and baking powder. Puree until smooth. instructions: Preheat oven to 500 degrees f. Dry the chicken thighs in a baking dish.

instructions: Drain well chopped green chilies and remove stems, seeds, and membrane. Combine chilies, apple juice, and all other ingredients in your blender and puree thoroughly. Serve warm.

title: Greek-Style Savory Stuffing

instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. Drain. Mix pasta with sour cream and soups, then place potatoes, olives, and cheese in a large bowl. Stir in crumbs and serve.

instructions: Pour the tomato paste into the base of the crockpot then gently warm the broth to boiling point on high. Pour all into the pot, making sure all tomato paste is incorporated, stirring until combined.

title: French Beans With a Kick

title: Puffy Mexican Snack Mix

instructions: Combine all ingredients and use with your favorite cracker.

title: Salmon and Black Olive Appetizer (Raw Foods)

instructions: Combine the ground pork, sour cream, chickpeas, olives and ginger in a large mixing bowl. title: Maple Smoked White Beans

instructions: Place the beans in a large pot and pour in enough water to cover. instructions: Fill a large pot with slightly salted water and bring to a boil. Add pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

title: Almond Refried Beans

instructions: Combine beans, almond extract, and almond extract in a saucepan.

title: Spicy Choc Chops

title: Sizzling Beef

instructions: Cut sirloin in half to make one half inch slices. Marinate beef in oyster sauce and oyster sauce for 20 minutes. Drain beef and grill. Serve with noodles or fried rice.

title: Easy Curried Beef and Onions
ingredients: 6 cups self raising flour | 1 tablespoon curry powder | 1 green chili, sliced | 6 ounces curry powder | 2 tablespoons ground chili pepper | 4 ounces meat, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 300f. Mix flour, red curry powder, green chili, curry powder and ground chili pepper. Gently add in meat and mix. Place on a greased and floured baking tray and bake for 30 minutes. Remove from oven and cut into squares. Serve with fresh vegetables or naan bread.

title: Quick Caribbean Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 2 ounces pineapple juice, chilled | 1 dash sriracha hot sauce | 1/2 teaspoon dijon mustard
instructions: Mix the pineapple juice with sriracha hot sauce and mustard. Allow to stand 5 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: vermouth,black pepper,wheat flour,beef stew meat,yellow squash,molasses,chow mein noodle,prune
title: Asian Beef Stew
ingredients: 2 lbs beef stew meat, cut into 3 inch cubes | 2 cups dry vermouth or 2 cups dry white wine | 2 cups diced yellow squash | 2 cups peeled seeded and diced peeled yellow squash | 1 cup pitted and diced prunes | 2 1/2 tablespoons wheat flour | 1 tablespoon molasses | 1/2 teaspoon black pepper | shredded pretzel or pretzel bread
instructions: In a large skillet, brown stew meat in 2 cups vermouth or wine, stirring to scrape up the browned bits as the meat browns. Transfer the meat to a dutch oven and add the remaining 2 cups vermouth, 1 cup squash, prunes and remaining ingredients except pretzels and bread. Bring to a boil then reduce heat, partially cover and simmer 15 minutes. Sprinkle shredded pretzels on top and return to a simmer until heated through.

title: Savory Chocolate Balls
ingredients: 1 cup craisins | 1 cup plain soymilk | 1/2 cup sweet breadcrumbs | 2 tablespoons sifted all purpose greek seasoning | 1/2 cup semi-sweet chocolate chips
instructions: Stir craisins, soy milk, bread crumbs, greek seasoning and chocolate into crumbs in a large mixing bowl. Using 1 tablespoon of mixture for each ball, roll into a ball around the craisins. Refrigerate balls for 1 hour.

title: Simple Carrots and Cheese Sandwich
ingredients: 4 slices mexican cheese | 4 baby carrots, sliced into 1-inch pieces | 4 limes, cut into wedges
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Cover a large baking sheet with aluminum foil. Add a layer of cheddar slices to the prepared baking sheet. Top each with a piece of baby carrots. Drizzle with about half a lime wedge. Bake in the preheated oven until bubbling, about 5 minutes.

title: Southwest Grilled Chicken
ingredients: 1/2 cup buttermilk | 3 skinless, bone-in chicken thighs | 2 tablespoons orange peel | 1 fresh green chile, seeded and chopped | 1 banana, peeled and sliced
instructions: In medium size bowl, combine buttermilk and orange peel.

Random Ingredients: sofrito sauce,white onion,chicken broth,cabbage,cider vinegar,red chilies,cannellini bean
title: White Beans and Cabbage
ingredients: 1 large white onion, sliced | 2 -3 large red chilies, seeded and finely chopped | 1 tablespoon sofrito sauce, or to taste | 2 cans cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 1 medium head cabbage, cored, cut into rings ( about 1 pound ) | 1/4 cup cider vinegar, or to taste | 1/4 cup reduced-sodium chicken broth
instructions: Heat a small saucepan over medium low heat, stirring often, until a bead of water lightly sizzles. Add onions, chilies, and sofrito. Cook until onions soften, stirring often, about 5 minutes. Pour beans, cabbage, and vinegar into the pot. Stir gently. Cover, reduce heat to medium low, and poach until cabbage is tender and beans are heated through, about 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: lamb shoulder,wonton wrapper,english muffin,eggplant,chunky salsa,chili paste,ham hock,rice wine
title: Baked Pot Sticker
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless lamb shoulder, cut into 1 1/2-in cubes | 1 cup chunky salsa ( anejo ) | 1/4 cup rice wine or 1/4 cup dry sherry | 4 ounces chinese pork or 4 ounces ham hocks, finely chopped | 2 teaspoons chili paste ( anejo ) | 50 wonton wrappers ( we use king's brand ) | 1 large eggplant | wonton wrapper, for pot stickers
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f. Toss lamb cubes and salsa together in a medium bowl. Cover.

Random Ingredients: pork sausage,lime juice,sage leaf,potato,mussel,watercress,arborio rice,monterey jack cheese
title: Spanish Mussels & Risotto
ingredients: 2 ounces pork sausages | 5 large potatoes ( medium peeled and quartered ) | 1/2 cup arborio rice | 1 tablespoon fresh lime juice | 2 1/2 cups water, heated | 1 bunch parsley ( italian leaves ) | 6 fresh sage leaves | grated monterey jack cheese
instructions: Cook sausages in frying pan or skillet over medium heat until browned and cooked through, 4 to 6 minutes.

Random Ingredients: caster sugar,mustard,thai red curry paste,stock beef,tajin seasoning,chicken breast meat,garlic sauce,cottage cheese
title: Cottage Cheese and Chicken Skewers
ingredients: 500 g chicken breast meat, diced | 1 tablespoon thai red curry paste | 1 tablespoon tajin seasoning | 1 tablespoon garlic sauce ( or bottled minced garlic ) | 1 tablespoon pickled mustard | 75 g low fat cottage cheese | 30 g caster sugar | 1 tablespoon stock from beef ( for cooking ) or 1 tablespoon beef stock ( for cooking )
instructions: Mix all ingredients together together, except for the meat to marinate. If you like less sauce, use 1 tbsp oil or peanut oil not extra virgin. Thread chicken onto skewers, leaving two for each skewer. Grill for about 15 to 30 minutes, basting once or twice with the marinade for 30 to 45 minutes, turning occasionally, until cooked through and tender. When done place meat on a warmed plate and keep warm. Wipe out and clean your grill. Place meat from skewers onto an oven tray that has been lined with baking paper. Brush on a little oil or cooking oil and grill each side until browned and crisp, brushing occasionally with the marinade and turning a couple of times. Serve with dipping sauce.

Random Ingredients: anaheim chilies,double cream,stewing beef,raspberry,bamboo skewer,green bean
title: Green Beef on a Stick
ingredients: 1 kg stewing beef, cut into 1cm cubes | 1 tablespoon hulled raspberries | 1/2 cup frozen green beans | 1 fresh anaheim chilies or 1 serrano chili pepper, seeded and finely chopped | 150 ml double cream | 6 bamboo skewers
instructions: Prep all the ingredients. Thread the meat, meat, bean and green beans onto the skewers. Cover, refrigerate for at least a couple of hours. Heat a bbq hotplate. When hot, add the skewers to the pan, cook for 10 minutes until brown and cooked all over. Serve the skewers straight onto a plate with rice on the side.

Random Ingredients: chili oil,breakfast sausage,pecorino romano cheese,salad green
title: Chef Bevski's Balsamic Salad
ingredients: 6 cups mixed salad greens | 1 1/2 lbs breakfast sausage, crumbled | 6 tablespoons pecorino romano cheese, grated | 2 tablespoons chili oil
instructions: Tear off a handful of the mixed greens and tear it into bit sized pieces. Place greens and sausage in a salad bowl. Combine cheese, chili oil and oregano in a small bowl. Drizzle dressing over greens and toss well. Serve immediately.

title: Shrimp Tacos and Chips
ingredients: 1 lb medium shrimp or 1 lb extra large shrimp, shelled | 1/2 lb cabbage, roughly chopped | 14 fajita-size flour tortillas or 8 corn tortillas | 12 tomatillos, canned or dried ( not in season )
instructions: Saute cabbage and shrimp over medium low heat until cabbage is limp, about 4 minutes. Mix the cabbage and shrimp and stuff hot tortillas with the mixture. You may also put it into the freezer for later use, it will stay crisp. These are served with salsa, guacamole or whatever takes your fancy.

Random Ingredients: beef stock,ham,mustard seed,tabasco sauce,urad dal,french baguette,worcestershire sauce
title: Bombay Beef Sub Sandwiches
ingredients: 1/3 cup beef stock | 1/4 teaspoon mustard seeds | 1 teaspoon worcestershire sauce | 1/4 teaspoon tabasco sauce | 1 lb hamburger | 1/4 french baguette, cut into 4 to 6inch thick diagonal slices
instructions: In a small bowl, combine beef stock, mustard seeds, worcestershire sauce and tabasco. Add hamburger.

title: Golden Applesauce
ingredients: 2 granny smith apples, cored and cut into eighths | 1 loaf french bread, cut into 1 inch cubes
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Mix apples with dry bread cubes. Arrange around baking dish and spray with cooking spray. Bake in preheated oven 15 minutes, turn and bake 15 more minutes or until apples are tender.

Random Ingredients: italian herb,vegetable,lukewarm water,baking soda,clam,chile paste,vegetable broth,asparagus
title: Italian Sausage and Asparagus Bake
ingredients: 6 links sausage ( with or without casings ) | 1 can vegetable broth ( about 2 1/4 cups ) | 1/2 cup diced fresh asparagus | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 1/2 cup minced fresh chile paste ( see note ) | 1 1/2 cups frozen mixed vegetables | 1 tablespoon dried italian herbs or 2 teaspoons herbes de provence | 2 cups hot lukewarm water
instructions: Heat oven to 350 degrees. Cook sausage in 1 3/4 to 1 3/4 quart heavy skillet over medium heat, breaking into small pieces, breaking pieces as it cooks, until browned, about 4 minutes. Drain sausage, discard fat. Pour off all but 2 teaspoons fat except 1 tablespoon. Add broth and asparagus to skillet. Sprinkle baking soda over sausage. Cover.

Random Ingredients: shallot,french haricot vert green bean,tea,chickpea,orzo pasta,mint sprig,beef brisket,pea
title: Quick Beef Soup With Orzo and Chickpeas
ingredients: 4 cups beef brisket, trimmed, cut into 1 1/2-inch pieces | 1/2 cup dry chickpeas ( garbanzo beans ) | 1 1/2 cups french haricots vert, trimmed ( green beans ), cut into 1-inch lengths ( about 2 cups ) | 1 tablespoon minced shallot | 2 cups dried orzo pasta or 2 cups ziti pasta | 1 can reduced-sodium fat-free beef broth | fresh mint sprig, for garnish ( optional ) | peas, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Place the brisket and chickpeas in a 10 inch nonstick skillet. Sprinkle over the shallot.

Random Ingredients: golden syrup,garlic clove,beef brisket,salt pork,white pepper,dough
title: Southern Style Corned Beef Brisket
ingredients: 2 lbs corned beef brisket, trimmed | 2 garlic cloves, minced | 1 cup golden syrup | 2 tablespoons coarse salt | 1 teaspoon white pepper | 1/2 lb day old sourdough bread
instructions: Place corned beef in large dutch oven. Add a little water over the brisket. Boil for 3 minutes. Remove brisket and pour off water as it boils. Reserve one cup of the water. Return corned beef to dutch oven. Add garlic, golden syrup, salt and pepper. Reduce heat to low and simmer slowly for 1 hour. Add more water if necessary. Slice sourdough bread into slices 3/4 inch thick. Drain corned beef on paper towels and arrange on top of brisket. Serve with bread slices.

Random Ingredients: half cream,lavender honey,milk ricotta cheese,pink bean,almond butter,manchego cheese,stewing beef,meatball
title: Aunt Mary's Beef & Cheese Cannelloni
ingredients: 2 lbs stewing beef, cut in 1-inch cubes | 1/4 lb fresh pink beans, cooked, drained | 1/4 cup lavender honey, made with a culinary bouquet, california ( available at the vegetarian table ( or see herbed olive oil ) | 3 cups whole milk ricotta cheese | 1 cup half-and-half cream | 1/4 cup almond butter | 1 package refrigerated meatball ( or fresh ) | 2 tablespoons slivered almonds ( optional )
instructions: Place the meat in a nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Mix in the beans and honey and saute 5 minutes, or until heated through. Set aside. In a blender, combine ricotta, cream and almond butter. Blend well and set aside. Add meatballs or fresh meat. Blend well. Place in a deep 8 x 8 metal pan. Pour evenly. Cover with plastic wrap, pressing well down. Refrigerate overnight. Bake at 300°f for 1 1/2 hours or until heated through and cheese is browned. Remove from oven, uncover and let stand about 10 minutes. Garnish should not be soupy and will have a very light texture. If not, add more olive oil and a few slivered almonds. Note, i have even done it with chicken. You may also add mushrooms if you want to have more control over the sauce. You may also use a little olive oil. I have also made this with ham, salami and bacon so that the meat is tender.

Random Ingredients: bay scallop,chorizo sausage,anchovy,flour tortilla,sandwich bun,cake flour,italian bread
title: Italian-Scallop and Chorizo Sandwich
ingredients: 1/2 lb chorizo sausage, coarsely chopped | 1/2 lb sandwich bun | 3 tablespoons cake flour | 2 bay scallops, cleaned and chopped | 8 ounces sandwich buns | 3/4 lb sandwich buns | anchovy, drained and cut into slivers | cooked italian bread, as needed
instructions: Crumble chorizo and set aside. Toss sandwich rolls with flour and seasonings in a 2 gallon plastic bag to coat with grease. Add chorizo and shake to coat. Place in a small, heavy skillet large enough to hold them in 1 layer. Cook over medium heat for several minutes, stirring once, until lightly browned. Add scallops and cook for 2 minutes, stirring constantly. Remove and drain sausage. Assemble sandwiches with remaining ingredients on hoagie rolls, sausage, scallops and a few tablespoons of chorizo drippings from skillet. Serve with crusty italian bread.

title: Jicama and Rice With Pork
ingredients: 4 jicama | 1/2 lb sweet pork neck, strings removed | 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme | 1 cup glutinous rice, cleaned
instructions: Clean the pork neck and dry the neck with paper towels. Place the neck in a large, deep pan with enough water to cover, bring to the boil and let simmer until tender. About 15 - 20 minutes, drain away the water and cut the pork into 1/2 cubes. Place the thyme in a small bowl, and cover with boiling water. Remove the stem from the jicama leaving about 6 inches of the skin behind. Remove the remaining peel from the jicama using the large knife. Slice the jicama on a cutting board or cutting board into about 1/4 inch chunks. Place them in a food processor or blender and blend to a fine puree, about 1 minute, or until smooth. Set aside 1 cup of the puree. In a medium pot add the jicama puree, 1 1/2 cups water, and the rice. Cook over low heat until the rice is soft and has absorbed most of the water, about 25 - 30 minutes. If the puree is not thick enough, add the reserved water from the jicama. It's done when the pork is cooked. You can serve this stew as is or use a sauce, just stir in a bit of the stew into the rice, and serve the stew over.

title: Spring Onion and Pistachio Salad
ingredients: 2 large spring onions, roughly chopped | 1 cup mixed nuts ( such as cashew pieces, hazelnuts or pistachios ) | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh parsley
instructions: Place all ingredients into a large serving bowl, cover and chill until needed. Serve cold with crackers.

title: Smoky Salmon
ingredients: 1 lb salmon fillet ( may sub salmon, or salmon, etc. ) | 1 small anaheim chili ( may sub jalapeno or other hot pepper ) | 1/4 cup water | 1/4 - 1/2 lb beef chuck ( chuck steak should do this )
instructions: Cut salmon into 3 or 4 fillets. Cut peppers into 1/4 inch slices. Wrap pepper pieces in foil and place in preheated 450°f oven for 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: cayenne,peanut oil,mint,tortilla,self raising flour,whipping cream,shiitake mushroom,snow pea
title: Panda Express
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups self-raising flour | 1 pinch cayenne | 1/3 cup whipping cream | 1 teaspoon dried mint | 150 g tinned shiitake mushrooms, sliced thinly | 2/3 cup snow peas, cut into florets | 1 tablespoon peanut oil | 2 tortillas, warmed
instructions: Mix the flour, cayenne and cream with a whisk in a large bowl. Add the mint and mix well until the flour is completely absorbed. Fold in the mushrooms and peas. Mix the oil and 1 - 2 tbs water in a cup. Dip each tortilla into the water for about 30 seconds each. Remove the tortilla and coat with a little of the oil to keep the tortilla from sticking as you go. Cook briefly on each side but don't cook too quickly. Cut into 3/4 slices and serve with the pancake cream.

title: Coconut-Infused Fresh Fruit Ketchup for Fish, Microwavable, or Beef or Chicken
ingredients: 1 cup plain unsweetened dried shredded coconut (, i usually grate half of my own blend ) | 6 teaspoons raw orange zest or 6 teaspoons a mixture of grated orange peel, orange zest and all. grate enough zest to leave a 3/4 cup. place in a small bowl and whisk in 3/4 cup water. stir to combine. cover and refrigerate overnight. store covered

Random Ingredients: orange zest,ice water,olive,lard,food coloring,kiwi fruit,snow pea,taco seasoning
title: L'orange Taco Salad
ingredients: 1 cup ice water | 1/2 cup lard | 1 tablespoon taco seasoning | 1 tablespoon orange zest | 1 fresh kiwi fruit, peeled and cut into small dice | 1/2 cup olive, rinsed and sliced | 1 package snow pea, strings removed, strings removed | 1 tablespoon granulated food coloring
instructions: In the bowl of a blender, combine water, lard, taco seasoning and zest. Add kiwifruit and olives. Cover and blend on highest speed for 1 minute to get the mixture pretty thin and smooth. Add the snow peas. Transfer to a serving dish and sprinkle with white sugar and food coloring. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: zucchini,chili oil,sherry wine vinegar,yeast,beef sirloin steak,cherry tomato,brandy
title: Beef With Zucchini (Low Fat)
ingredients: 1 teaspoon instant yeast | 300 ml warm water | 750 g beef sirloin steaks | 1 -2 tablespoon brandy | 500 g zucchini, sliced thickly | 1 tablespoon sherry wine vinegar | 300 -500 450g cherry tomatoes
instructions: In a large bowl put together the yeast and about 100ml of the warm water. Sprinkle the meat with salt and leave for about 5 minutes until the surface starts to foam. Sprinkle the sherry vinegar onto the surface of the yeast and mix to dissolve. Drain the meat, rinse and pat dry with kitchen paper. Add half the beef and cover with a second layer of beef. Cover with cling film and leave to prove for about 30 minutes, turning the meat at least twice during the process. After 30 minutes, remove plastic film and cover with a piece of aluminium foil. Place in a warm oven and bake for about 1 hour or until meat is tender and the internal temperature reaches 160f on an instant reading thermometer. Remove the meat, slice, and keep warm, loosely covered with baking paper and a tea towel. Slice zucchini into thin rounds, scatter over the meat, cover with foil and leave to heat through, about 5 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside. Add another teaspoon of sherry vinegar to the sherry wine vinegar and mix well. Arrange the slices of zucchini on a serving plate and top with the beef. Pour the sherry vinegar sauce over and serve at once.

title: The Singing Cricket
ingredients: 1 pizza dough ( the big brown kind, no larger than 15cm. ) | 1 large apple, shredded | 10 slices prosciutto | 1 teaspoon chat masala | 2 teaspoons hot sauce | 1 tablespoon pizza sauce
instructions: You will need to roll pizza dough up into a rectangle about 30x45cm. It can be stored for up to 5 days. If you do this, use a rolling pin or sharp knife to roll your dough into a circle that is about 25cm wide and 14cm long. Make sure you roll it through your rolling pin then lay it on a greased baking tray. Make it spread out evenly all over using a rolling pin. Put in the fridge. Place your toppings in your choice of way on top of pizza dough. Remembering to spread as little as possible. Put in your freezer while you work making the rest of your meal. You may need a while but i usually go a couple of steps, here's how i pre freeze my pizza dough. I put mine in freezer until about a half way up i am ready for dinner. Put the pizza in a piping bag and a fork. I keep a piece of parchment for each portion when i need to use the rest for something.

title: Spanish Rice (Almond) Balls
ingredients: 200 g brown rice | 500 g potatoes | 1 tablespoon almond liqueur | 1 tablespoon brown sugar
instructions: Chop potato and dry roast it with sugar. Dry off the sugar with paper towel. Melt the almond liqueur on low heat. Roll rice in the mixture and let it sit on the plate for 20 - 20 minutes. Add the rice balls and mix to coat it. Keep them on the plate in a cold oven for 1 - 2 hours or until they become a golden color.

Random Ingredients: cocoa powder,broccoli floret,coconut cream,dark soy sauce,kaffir lime leaf
title: Tropical Coconut Broccoli
ingredients: 400 ml coconut cream | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce | 1 tablespoon cocoa powder | 2 kaffir lime leaves | 3 cans broccoli florets
instructions: Chop up the kaffir lime leaves for use later, or make your own from a bag of frozen broccoli florets, thawed. Mix all sauces together and pour into a pot on the stove until it boils. Add the broccoli and stir gently. Then cover and leave to steam for 8 minutes.

title: Rice Paper Pecan Noodles With Walnuts and Lime
ingredients: 8 ounces uncooked rice noodles ( i use long, medium-width rice noodles for this recipe ) | 1 tablespoon sesame oil ( i use canola ) | 2 lemons, juice of ( or equivalent lemon zest ) | 2 -3 tablespoons walnuts, finely chopped | 2/3 cup walnuts, coarsely chopped | 10 -16 ounces bean sprouts, roughly chopped ( or equivalent mixed sprouts ) | 2 teaspoons fresh lime zest ( or other orange zest )
instructions: Cook the noodles in boiling water until 'al dente', adding sesame oil after the rinse. Drain noodles and set on a towel until cool. Then, mix together lemon juice, walnuts and pecans. Set aside. Toss noodles with the walnuts/nut/olive/lime mixture, and set aside. Place the bean sprouts and zest into a small bowl, and add just enough lime juice to moisten the vegetables. Dip the drained noodles into the lime mixture, then into the walnut/nut mixture, and then finally coat with the walnuts/lime topping. Use a few walnut pieces for garnish on some noodles if desired and serve. This will also be an excellent make ahead dish. Store it in the refrigerator for up to a week.

Random Ingredients: pork loin chop,hot chili pepper,cold water,self rising flour,baby corn,chorizo sausage,linguine
title: Sausage Pork Chops
ingredients: 4 ounces linguine | 2 ounces chorizo sausage, sliced | 2 pork loin chops | 3 ounces pork loin chops | 1/2 cup self rising flour | 1/2 cup cold water | 1 teaspoon hot chili pepper | 1 can baby corn, drained
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees. Heat a frying pan on medium high heat. Add the chorizo and sauté until crispy, and the chorizo is cooked through. Remove from the pan. Drain all of the fat from the pan, leaving about 2 tablespoons of drippings in it. Place the pork chops in the pan, and sear, just until both sides are browned. Remove from the pan. Reduce heat to medium, and stir in the flour. Mix in the water, chili pepper. Place the baby corn in a separate dish, and add to the skillet. Once the corn is added, stir in. Add the pork chop back to the pan. Spoon the sauce over the pork chops. Cover the pan, and bake for 35 minutes.

Random Ingredients: poblano chile,sun tomato oil,linguine,green bell pepper,chicken breast,golden syrup
title: Chicken and Chile Linguine
ingredients: 1 lb linguine or 1 lb other tubular pasta | 1 1/2 chicken breasts, cubed | 2 poblano chiles, roasted, peeled and coarsely chopped | 3 tablespoons golden syrup | 2 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained ( not oil packed ) | 1 green bell pepper, diced
instructions: Cook pasta in a large pot, as directed on the package. Meanwhile, heat remaining ingredients in a large skillet over medium high heat. When chicken is well cooked, add to the pot. Simmer, covered, 3 minutes, stirring occasionally. Drain pasta and set aside. Remove any excess fat from skillet. Stir in sauce. Toss hot pasta with sauce, adding more salt to taste if desired. Serve while hot..

title: Feta
ingredients: 1 package mung bean sprouts, rinsed and drained | 1/2 cup crumbled feta cheese
instructions: Toss the mung bean sprouts with the feta cheese in a bowl.

title: Ww Coconut Wine Potato Wedges
ingredients: 1 kg red potatoes, cut into wedges | 1 cup unsweetened coconut cream | 3/4 cup dry red wine | 1 cup coconut cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c or 400f. Bake potato wedges for 25 minutes or until tender. Serve wedges with coconut cream, red wine and coconut flakes.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon cube,spanish onion,baking potato,brown mustard seed,plum tomato,phyllo dough,courgette
title: Vegetable Samosas
ingredients: 225 g baking potatoes, peeled and diced | 1 -2 spanish onion, finely chopped | 2 carrots, peeled and diced | 8 g brown mustard seeds, cracked | 375 g plum tomatoes | 1 beef bouillon cube, dissolved in | 3/4 cup beef stock, hot | 1 lb phyllo dough | 1 tablespoon black mustard seeds | 1 tablespoon brown mustard seeds
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Cook the diced potatoes in boiling water with onions, carrots and mustard seeds. Cook for 25 minutes. Drain and let cool.. Meanwhile, place the tomatoes in boiling water with the bouillon cube and cook for 2 minutes. Drain and cool. Cut through the scored lines from top to bottom of each tomato. Place 2 tbsp mustard seeds in a small bowl and brush oil inside. Cut pastry sheets into 4 equal squares. Place a generous teaspoon of the vegetable mixture on the base of one square leaving 3/4 of the way in the centre. Brush with oil, then spread with the remaining mustard. Roll the pastry tightly over the filling to enclose the filling completely. Place on an oiled cookie sheet. Repeat with remaining pastry and filling. Lightly brush with oil and bake for 25 minutes or until pastry is golden and bubbling and filling is hot and crisp. Eat warm or cold.

Random Ingredients: breadcrumb,coffee,self raising flour,bacon grease,coriander,flat leaf parsley
title: Toad in the Hole (Drunken Eggs)
ingredients: 1 lb bacon grease | 1 lb self-raising flour | 2 1/2 cups strong coffee | 2 tablespoons finely chopped fresh coriander | 2 tablespoons coarsely chopped flat leaf parsley | 3 ounces breadcrumbs
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°. Heat the bacon grease in a large frying pan. Dust the flour in the fat and cook over high heat and gradually mix int the hot grease. Once it looks like lumps of bacon fat have formed, add the coffee, chopped coriander and parsley. Cook until this has been absorbed, adding breadcrumbs towards the end if the mixture seems dried out. Once this is done, the mixture is fairly dry but not curdled. Ladle into a clean, lightly greased and lined 2½ cup oven proof dishes or ramekins and leave about 15 minutes. Bake in the top and bottom of the oven for about an hour, testing with a wooden skewer after 15 - 20 minutes, or if you think they are golden brown, lower the heat. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: oyster juice,korean rib beef chuck flanken,flour,lentil,soybean paste market,chili powder
title: Korean Barbecue Potstickers
ingredients: 2 lbs korean-style short ribs ( beef chuck flanken, cut into 2 inch lengths ) | 3 tablespoons soybean paste ( i had used a little less for added flavor ) | 1/2 cup fermented lentils ( use a lot ) | 2 tablespoons flour | 1/4 cup chili powder ( more, to taste, i like things spicy ) | 2 tablespoons oyster juice
instructions: Note, the amount of the ingredient is for the korean style barbeque, as all you’ll eat will be eaten by tomorrow. Cut short ribs into 2 inch pieces across the grain. Put all ingredients in a medium size zip top bag. Toss to coat. Shake off any excess air before refrigerating for at least 8 hours and up to 1 day. Turns in a hot, dry skillet over medium heat. Cook 7 - 8 minutes or until meat is brown on all sides.

title: Saffron-Scented Beef on the Top With Saffron and Marshmallows
ingredients: 12 saffron-infused marshmallows | 2 kg fresh rump roast, with fat cap | 2 kg topping ( sassignons, pastry bag or other thick cut pastry like havarti ) | 2 spring onions, chopped | 1 bunch fresh coriander leaves, chopped ( or fresh parsley ) | 1 teaspoon vanilla | green valentine red food coloring ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom ( optional )
instructions: Make slits in the meat and insert a little pink zest or a lot of yellow zest from a saffron infused marshmallow. Cover with plastic wrap and put in a roasting tin approximately 150 to 150 cm high and heated up to 180 degrees celsius on 150 degree celsius or until the meat has taken on a little colour. Set meat aside to cool and then slice across lengthways into about 4 cm cubes. Set aside. Filling. Place all ingredients in a saucepan and simmer over a medium heat until the sugar has completely melted, about 40 minutes to 1 hour. Cool slightly and then spoon the mixture into a pastry bag fitted with a star tip. Press two rinds of the saffron over the top of the meat and sprinkle over the scottish marmalade. Cover and keep in the fridge for 24 hours. Shred the meat as finely as possible. Reserve the liquor for later use. To serve, place a serving plate on top and place some sliced meat on top, garnish with some saffron fondue or a sprinkling of chopped onion. Serve with crusty bread, pickles, pickled drinks, fruit and a cup of red passion food.

title: Tex-Mex Corn Tacos
ingredients: 2 ears corn | 1/2 cup bread crumbs | 1 package taco shells
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Place corn in a saucepan and drizzle with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to medium. Cook until tender, 40 to 50 minutes. Drain and shred corn with a fork. Place in a bowl. Mix bread crumbs with taco seasoning and dip both sides of taco shells in melted taco seasoning. Spray a large baking sheet with cooking spray and lay taco shells in it. Bake in the preheated oven for 5 to 7 minutes, until lightly browned.

title: Irish Breakfast Skillet
ingredients: 1 red onion, thinly sliced | 8 ounces kielbasa, thinly sliced | 3 tablespoons creamy soy milk or 3 tablespoons low-fat milk | 1/4 cup crumbled blue cheese, i use colby jack blend
instructions: Sauté onion in a large non stick skillet. Add kielbasa and cook on medium high for 5 - 7 minutes or until slightly crisp. Sprinkle with soy milk or milk, cover and cook on low for 5 minutes. Top with cheese and serve. Note, if you like to melt more cheese, mix a little flour with 1/2 cup cold water until it dissolves.

title: Ginger Veal
ingredients: 1 lb veal, cut into 2-inch pieces | 1 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste | 1 -2 cup peanut butter
instructions: In a large saucepan of boiling salted water, blanch the veal about two minutes. Drain, reserving 1 t. Of stock. In another pan, heat the ginger garlic paste until fragrant.

title: Baked Chili Korma

instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees c. Mix all ingredients together thoroughly, roll into small, meatballs. Place on oven tray and cook for around 20 - 30 minutes.

title: Soy-Spice Tomatoes (Yakhon Bi Raita)

instructions: Preheat oven to 400f degrees. Spray baking sheet with cooking spray. Mix first three ingredients in large bowl. instructions: Place meat in the bottom of 2 1/2 quart crockpot. Top with chili sauce and set the crockpot on low for 6 - 10 hours. Place meat on a platter and remove any excess fat. Reserve any leftover sauce and ribs. Slice pork and place with ribs in separate crockpot bowls on top of meat. Slice the lamb and beef into 1/2 inch cubes and place on top of the lamb and pork. title: Rose Water Syrup

instructions: Combine the 3 milks together in a large, flat container. Stir in 1 cup rose oil and 1 teaspoon rose extract. Leave a small hole in the side of the container for the water to settle, or if desired, fill the hole again. Store in an air tight container.

title: Yummie Shrimp

instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Place the shrimp in a pot with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil, and cook 15 to 20 minutes, until the shrimp are mostly cooked but still firm. Drain and cool. Place the tahini in a bowl, and stir in seasoning mix, nutmeg, matzo meal, and garlic powder. Place the shrimp into the bowl, and stir to coat to evenly spread the pieces. Random Ingredients: lemon peel,tortilla chip,pecorino romano cheese,beef stew meat,caper

instructions: Combine meat, cheese, pecorino romano cheese and capers in a large slow cooker. Cover and cook on low until beef is thoroughly heated.

title: Baked Goat Kabobs

title: Salsa Verde 2009

instructions: Place all ingredients in a bowl and toss well. Let stand at least 2 hrs before serving. Best if eaten within a day. This is best made a day ahead and kept cool until serving.

instructions: Brown meat in a large, heated skillet over medium heat. Drain if needed. Combine taco seasoning mix and poblano. Stuff rolls with sausage mix. Arrange rolls on dull edges of a pan. Sprinkle on pistachios. Bake at 350f for 30 - 40 minutes or until heated through.

instructions: Put the chicken, cream of potato chips, peppers, chiles, tequila and milk, worcestershire sauce, cinnamon and the rind of the orange and the lemon halves in a large frying pan, then bring to the boil. Reduce heat, cover and simmer for 10 minutes. Check if chicken is cooked through. Remove chicken from the pan and reserve. Return pan to the heat and simmer uncovered for about 8 minutes. Serve chicken and sauce over rice.

title: Tomato Sushi With Sun Dried Tomato Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 3/4 cup rice vinegar | 1 package sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained and finely chopped
instructions: Combine vinegar, sun dried tomatoes and rice vinegar in a small bowl and stir to combine. Let stand 30 minutes at room temperature. Serve in a lettuce lined bowl with nori.

Random Ingredients: marjoram,vegetable oil cooking spray,grain white rice
title: Simple Microwave Spanish Rice Pilaf
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 4 ounces long grain white rice, rinsed until the water runs clear | 1/2 teaspoon dried marjoram, crushed ( optional )
instructions: Spray a large rectangular glass dish with the vegetable spray. In microwave safe dish, dish or bowl, microwave rice for 3 minutes. Remove and sprinkle with marjoram. Microwave on high power, uncovered, for another 3 minutes. Fluff rice grains with a fork and serve.

title: Wild Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 lb wild field mushroom | 2 cups chopped cooked squash | 1/2 cup chopped green onion | 2 tablespoons basil pesto | 1/4 cup catsup | crushed ice cube | 1/3 cup breadcrumbs | 1 slice bread, cut into 1/2-inch cubes
instructions: Remove tough stems from mushrooms and cut mushroom caps in half, reserving stems, stems and water. Place mushrooms, squash, onions and pesto in food processor and process to make a paste. Place in a bowl and add cheese and crumbs. Roll mushroom mixture into bite size balls and sprinkle with crumbs. Place in a steamer over boiling water, cover and steam for 20 minutes. Place on a serving plate and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: gelatin,angel food cake,sun tomato oil,asparagus,green bean
title: Angel Food Italian
ingredients: 16 stalks asparagus, sliced into 1-in.-thick steaks | 1 package angel food cake, cut into 5 squares | 8 ounces fresh green beans, trimmed and sliced | 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained and chopped | 1/4 cup unflavored gelatin
instructions: Bring 4 quarts of water to a boil. Place asparagus pieces into the boiling water. Cover and cook until tender crisp, about 3 minutes. Drain. Set aside. Place angel food cake squares in a steamer basket in a large pan. Cover and steam for 3 minutes or until golden brown, turning once. Stir into the steamed asparagus. To make the sauce, stir together the basil, sun dried tomato, and gelatin in a small bowl. Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour. Stir gelatin mixture into asparagus mixture. Return to a boil.

Random Ingredients: tomato puree,pepperoncini pepper,bell pepper,milk,lobster meat,nutmeg,lettuce leaf,baby spinach
title: Peppered lobster salad
ingredients: 4 lettuce leaves, torn into pieces | 1 lb cooked lobster meat, coarsely chopped | 1/2 lb baby spinach, sliced | 1/4 cup bottled pepperoncini pepper, minced | 1 tablespoon canned tomatoes in tomato puree | 4 -8 pepperoncini peppers, minced | 1/2 cup evaporated milk | 1/2 teaspoon freshly grated nutmeg
instructions: Place lettuce leaves on large platter. Top with remaining ingredients and pile attractively on the lettuce. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: green chilies,soy sauce,gruyere cheese,chipotle powder,chocolate square,farfalle pasta,chipotle chile
title: Alphabet Calabrese Mac & Cheese
ingredients: 12 ounces farfalle pasta | 2 ounces dried chipotle chiles | 3 ounces green chilies | 2 ounces dried guero chilies | 2 ounces chocolate squares | 2 tablespoons soy sauce | 1 tablespoon fresh chipotle powder
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. Meanwhile, finely chop chipotle chiles peppers.

Random Ingredients: beef jerky,sesame seed oil,chicken bouillon granule,pickling spice,orange zest,lemon peel
title: Tail's Awesome Spareribs
ingredients: 2 teaspoons chicken bouillon granules | 2 teaspoons orange zest, grated | 2 1/2 teaspoons pickling spices | 2 teaspoons lemon peel, finely grated | 1 1/2 teaspoons sesame seed oil | 2 2 lbs beef jerky or 2 lbs pork spareribs
instructions: Make the spice packets using all the seasoning ingredients except the oils and the short ribs. Mix well with cut up meat, mix well and cover with plastic wrap. Refrigerate overnight. To make the meat easier to remove, remove plastic wrap. Remove meat from plastic wrap and discard. Cut into serving size pieces or use in a marinade to cook meat on the stove top.

title: Smokey Baked Pork (Sbd P8)
ingredients: 1/2 lb capellini or 1/2 lb fettuccine | 2 pork shoulder, cut into about 2-inch squares | 1/3 cup oil, enough to coat pan | 1 jar sauerkraut | 1 cup wild rice
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. In large baking pan, combine pork and 1/3 cup of oil. Sprinkle with salt. Bake, covered, 25 minutes.

title: Courgette and Cauliflower Breakfast
ingredients: 400 g tomatoes puree | 300 g cauliflower florets | 1 courgette, sliced | 1 zucchini, sliced | 1/2 cup grape | 4 teaspoons tomato puree | 2 tablespoons cider vinegar | 2 slices whole wheat bread, crusty
