instructions: Place all ingredients except bread into a saucepan, cover, place over medium high heat and bring to the boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes. While the vegetables are cooking, lay the bread and vegetables on a baking tray. Turn the heat under the pan to high and heat the tomato puree rapidly until reduced to a thick sauce, whisking constantly. Spoon into 4 ovenproof bowls, sprinkle over the bread and vegetables and drizzle over the reserved tomato puree.

Random Ingredients: champagne,wheat bran,rigatoni pasta,corn tortilla chip,spinach leaf,dripping,rosemary leaf,sea scallop
title: Rigatoni Con Gandules de Gorgonzola E Gorgonzola (Wine and Scallops - Gorgonzola)
ingredients: 1/2 lb rigatoni pasta ( i used whole wheat ) | 2 1/4 cups wheat bran ( i used arrowroot which had starch ) | 2 cups spinach leaves or 2 cups arugula, chopped ( i used regular spinach ) | 1/2 cup drippings ( from cooking spinach, olive oil, grapeseed oil, vegetable oil or a combination ) | 1/2 cup grapeeed oil or 1/2 cup olive oil | 1 teaspoon fresh rosemary leaf, chopped | 1 lb sea scallops | crisp corn tortilla chips or crackers
instructions: Preheat oven to 400º. In medium saucepan, over medium heat, sauté broth in dripping until tender, about 5 minutes. Add herbs, then bring to boil, whisking constantly until thickened. Stir in cooked pasta. Set aside until ready to use. Spray 9 x 13 metal baking dish with nonstick cooking spray. Layer, 1/2 meat and 1/2 pasta. Repeat layers. Cover and bake 45 minutes. Remove lid and sprinkle with tortilla chips or crisply top with crackers.

title: German Lemon Liqueur
ingredients: 1 can or bottle dry red wine vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon grated lemon extract
instructions: Pour vinegar into a 1 cup glass measuring cup.

title: Toasted Almond-Tomato Skewers
ingredients: 8 large ripe tomatoes | 8 fresh un-blanched whole almonds | 8 wooden skewers, soaked in water for at least 15 minutes
instructions: Place the tomato on a skewer. Place a whole almond in the tomato. If the tomatoes and almonds are not thick, they will absorb more of the liquid. Grill the tomatoes and almonds on the grill for about 3 - 4 minutes, turning until charred and tender.

Random Ingredients: herb,lemongrass,flour,sea salt pepper,pecorino romano cheese,liquid smoke,self rising flour
title: Lime Fritters
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups finely shredded pecorino romano cheese | 2 teaspoons finely shredded fresh lemongrass ( about 2-5 stalks finely chopped ) | 1 1/2 cups self rising flour | sea salt and pepper | lemon ( optional ) | liquid smoke
instructions: Place all ingredients in a bowl except romano and lemon rind. Mix well and shape into small balls. You can refrigerate them for several hours or overnight, but be careful not to let them get sticky. Heat frying pan, medium heat. Dry fry fritters, about 3/4 teaspoon of the cheese added to each fritter, frying till golden on one side, 3 - 4 minutes. Flip and cook other side. This fritter can be made in advance, frozen, or fresh in an airtight container. Defrost at room temperature and reheat. Serve fritters drizzled with lemon or herb sauce, and accompanied by steamed vegetables.

title: Lingonious Taco Pasta
ingredients: 2 lbs cheap boneless veal ( i buy the spiral cut veal bone in to thin, cut to desired thickness ) | 32 ounces soda water ( a couple containers works well ) | 24 ounces chicken bouillon cubes | 3 packages taco seasoning
instructions: Mix all together except broth in large bowl. Add enough broth to fill about 1/2 1. Bowl. Cover and refrigerate overnight, this will produce more flavor. Boil pasta for 7 minutes drain and place in large bowl, add meat and noodles. Pour sauce over top and serve. If you add noodles to meat or meat will be tough.

title: Sweet Potato & Corn Fritters
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs sweet potatoes, peeled and cut into 1-inch sticks | 2 cans sweet whole kernel corn, drained | 1/4 cup red onion, sliced lengthwise into thin wedges | 1 teaspoon ground coriander powder ( or salt-free ) | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
instructions: In a nonreactive baking dish, place sweet potatoes, corn, and onion. Sprinkle over the spices and mix thoroughly. Bake at 400 degrees f or for about 30 minutes, stirring occasionally, until sweet potatoes are fully cooked.

title: Wild Rice and Eggs
ingredients: 1/2 cup wild rice, uncooked | 1 package frozen enchilada sauce | 1 large egg yolk | 1/2 cup fresh wild mixed fruit mixed with a dash of wild rice
instructions: Cook wild rice with enchile sauce according to package directions. Stir in fresh wild fruit and cook until heated through. Lightly beat egg yolk. Spoon cooked rice on plate and top with egg mixture.

Random Ingredients: lemonade,jumbo pasta shell,cornflour,pecan,lime,yellow squash,curry powder,gruyere cheese
title: Thai Nachos
ingredients: 4 ounces jumbo pasta shells | 2 ounces grated gruyere cheese | 1/2 yellow squash, peeled, seeded, cut into strips | 2 ounces pecans, toasted and chopped | 2 teaspoons cornflour, sifted | 3 teaspoons curry powder | 2 tablespoons lemonade | 1 lime | 1 tablespoon grated gruyere cheese
instructions: Put the shell pasta in a large saucepan of boiling, salted water, and cook just until the shells are just cooked. Drain well, and set aside. Place the cheese, squash, pecans, cornflour and curry powder in a bowl. Add the limeade and then the cheese and stir until creamy. Drain the pasta, then put back to the pan and add the cheese mixture. Toss until mixed well. Serve immediately straight away with bread.

Random Ingredients: sesame oil,kasseri cheese,fish sauce,phyllo pastry,vanilla pudding,egg,graham cracker,bread machine yeast
title: Budget Rolls & Cheesecake
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups bread machine yeast | 1 cup graham crackers ( fine ) or 1 cup rye crackers ( fine ) | 1 1/4 lbs unsalted kasseri cheese ( about 12-16 ounces ) | 1 cup sesame oil | 1/2 cup fish sauce | 8 large eggs | 1 1/2 lbs phyllo pastry sheets, defrosted until puffy and dry | 2 packages vanilla instant pudding
instructions: Crumble ½ pound of cheese in a food processor and process until almost fine. Beat the eggs and add the flour gradually beating with mixer in 3/4 lb. Cheese until well combined and stir in fish sauce and vanilla pudding. Add ½ cup of the cheese/egg mixture to the rest of the cheese/egg/cheese combo and blend well. Pour into the bottom of a 9 x 13 baking dish. Cut phyllo sheets in half and start stacking them together, starting with a phyllo sheet, a second phyllo sheet and then more phyllo and filling. When all the sheets are in and you finished layering layering brush or spray melted butter over top and sprinkle remaining cheese on top. Cover and let rise in a warm place, about 1 1/2 hours, until it doubles in size. Bake at 325 degrees, covered on a stone for an hour, then raise temperature to 450 and bake for an additional 45 - 50 minutes, checking after 45 minutes to make sure the top is crusty. Allow to cool and store in an airtight container.

title: Vanilla Prosciutto Wrapped in Prosciutto
ingredients: 6 slices prosciutto | 2 teaspoons vanilla syrup
instructions: Place 1 slice prosciutto wrapped in prosciutto on a slice of parchment paper. Top with 1 teaspoons vanilla syrup. Roll up and wrap with the parchment paper. Allow prosciutto to dry on paper towels for 10 minutes. Store in refrigerator.

title: Orange Rice With Cabbage and Toasted Olives
ingredients: 1 cup basmati rice | 2 orange zest, coarsely chopped | 1 1/2 cups cabbage, cut into thin wedges | 1/3 cup kalamata olive, pitted and quartered
instructions: Cook rice in a small amount of boiling salted water for 3 minutes. Stir into the cooked rice. In a small saucepan, heat remaining ingredients over medium high heat. Saute cabbage and olives, stirring, until heated through and vegetables are tender, about 10 minutes.

title: Creamy Cashews & Coffee
ingredients: 1/2 cup salted cashews | 1 garlic clove, finely minced | 1 tablespoon reduced sodium soy sauce | 3/4 cup brewed coffee creamer
instructions: Roast cashews using an iron skillet or directly over a gas burner over medium high heat until lightly browned, about 8 minutes. Transfer nuts to a plate to cool. Transfer cashews to a mixing bowl and coarsely grind in food processor until smooth. With machine running, add the garlic, soy sauce and creamer. Process the mixture just until moistened, about 10 seconds. Store covered at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil,celery seed,plum tomato,anise seed,sesame seed,sherry,monterey jack cheese
title: Tomato and Cheese Enchiladas
ingredients: 1 can whole plum tomatoes, drain liquid | 1/2 cup vegetable oil | 2 cups grated monterey jack cheese | 1/4 cup sweet sherry | 1/4 teaspoon anise seed | 1/4 teaspoon celery seed | 2 tablespoons sesame seeds
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Place a large metal colander into a large bowl, pour the tomatoes into it and sprinkle on the vegetable peel with salt. Place cheese in an 8x8 inch baking dish. In a small bowl combine the sherry, oil, sesame seeds, and celery seeds. Pour over cheese. Turn up the oven heat to 325°f. Cover the dish with parchment paper and bake 30 minutes, stirring twice. Reduce heat to 400°f and bake an additional 30 minutes.

title: Pasta Fazool
ingredients: 2 lbs dried fettuccine pasta, broken into 1/2-3 inch pieces | 6 ounces queso fresco, cut into 1/2-inch chunks | 12 ounces cooked fettuccine pasta | 1/4 cup oyster sauce | 1 cup mozzarella cheese, shredded
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees. Cook pasta according to package directions. Drain and toss in a large bowl with queso fresco, fettuccine, and oyster sauce. Top with mozzarella. Cover and bake until heated through, about 15 minutes. Top with additional mozzarella. Serve hot.

title: Crispy Dessert Pistachios
ingredients: 4 tablespoons splenda granular | 10 tablespoons chopped almonds or 10 tablespoons pistachios
instructions: Combine all ingredients, stirring until the sugar is dissolved. Put in a small bowl. Refrigerate. Store in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: grain white rice,milk,seafood seasoning,lamb chop,chili pepper,bacon,chuck
title: Arroz con Vino (Hunter's Stew)
ingredients: 2 loaves loaves bacon, cut into 1/2 inch pieces ( or 12 strips ) | 1 1/2 lbs lamb chops ( bone in, about 1-inch-wide at all ) | 1 1/2 cups whole milk | 3 cups whole milk | 2 -4 1 -2 tablespoons seafood seasoning ( see note ) ( optional ) | 1 cup long grain white rice ( or medium grain white rice ) | 1 small chili pepper, seeded, finely chopped ( optional )
instructions: Fry bacon in frying pan until crisp. Remove bacon. Brown lamb chops in bacon drippings. Remove chops. Add whole milk and simmer uncovered, whisking continuously until milk has reduced to 2 1/2 cups. Remove milk and stir milk into meat and milk mixture until blended. Season to taste with seafood seasoning, if using. Place rice in a large serving bowl. Cover with boiling water. Cover and simmer over low heat approximately 25 minutes or until rice is almost tender. Serve hot, with chopped chili.

Random Ingredients: cajun seasoning,cilantro leaf,grain white rice,brie cheese
title: Cajun Baked Rice
ingredients: 1 cup long grain white rice | 2 ounces brie cheese, sliced | 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro leaves | 2 -3 teaspoons cajun seasoning, or more to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f in a 9x13 inch baking dish, combine rice, brie, cilantro, and cajun seasoning. Bake covered 30 minutes, or until rice is tender and cheese is melted.

Random Ingredients: adobo seasoning,sunflower oil,green onion,chicken meat,italian breadcrumb,radish,rosemary
title: Italian Croquettes
ingredients: 1 teaspoon sunflower oil | 1 cup diced chicken meat | 3/4 cup italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 1 tablespoon finely chopped fresh rosemary | 1 green onion, diced | 3 -4 radishes, diced ( optional ) | adobo seasoning
instructions: Heat oil in a saucepan on low heat. Add in chicken, then in bread crumbs, rosemary and green onion. Cook for 15 minutes, stirring frequently to coat chicken evenly with the breadcrumbs. Set aside and then cut into large squares and toss with red and new mexico peppers and salsa, to your taste.

title: Italian Sausage and Potato Sprouts #5FIX
ingredients: 1 package simply potatoes stix ( or your favorite potato flaky potato mix ) | 2 lbs italian sausage | 6 tablespoons allspice
instructions: Prepare simply potatoes flaky potato mix as directed on the package. While that’s cooking remove a 1/4 inch of thick walled spaghetti from the package. Pour it into a small frying pan and place over medium heat until it begins to smoke. Sprinkle the sausage over top and cook until browned. Transfer to your 9x13 sprayed roasting pan, then add the sausage and potato mixture. Stir well, cover and bring to a boil. Lower heat and cook 20 minutes, stirring twice. Sprinkle the top with allspice and allow to steam for 5 minutes, then serve hot.

title: Pistachio Powder
ingredients: 1 cup shelled pistachio nuts | 1 stalk lemongrass, sliced
instructions: Place pistachios in a heat proof container. Cover with boiling water, and allow to sit for 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Drain and place in a food processor, and process until smooth. Transfer to a bowl, cover, and refrigerate.

title: Asparagus Burgers
ingredients: 1 pound fresh asparagus, trimmed and cut in half lengthwise | 1/4 cup low-sodium worcestershire sauce | 2 -3 fluid ounces canned chopped olives | 1/2 teaspoon freshly ground cardamom pod | 1/2 teaspoon cumin seed | 12 medium to hard-cooked cocktail sticks | 2 -9 good-quality hot pepper sauce ( optional ) | 6 -8 good-quality low-sodium hamburger buns
instructions: Slice the asparagus spears into 1/4 thick slices. Place in a large bowl and toss with the worcestershire sauce. Add olives and season with cardamom and cumin seeds. Wrap each spear of asparagus tightly in plastic wrap and shake until completely coated. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour or up to 3 days. Grill the bruschetta on a lightly oiled grill rack or skillet over medium high heat, or lightly oil the grilling rack. Cut the cocktail sticks in half lengthwise, and slice crosswise into 1/4 slices. Place on the grill. Close the lid and heat for 2 to 3 minutes, until lightly browned. Move asparagus to cooler section of grill or to lowest setting. Close lid and continue cooking until done to your taste. To serve, place about 3 to 5 slices of the bruschetta on each bun. Drizzle with hot pepper sauce if desired.

title: Hurry Corned Beef and Whiskey
ingredients: 10 lbs beef brisket | 1 quart whiskey, such as guinness | 1/2 gallon whiskey
instructions: Combine the corned beef and worcestershire sauce in a large dutch oven. Slowly add the 1 quart of whiskey to the corned beef. Cover and bake on a medium heat, basting occasionally with the whiskey. Cook for 3 hours, basting occasionally.

title: Curried Salmon
ingredients: 1/2 lb lean salmon, cut into chunks | 1/2 lb hamburger | 1 tablespoon sweet paprika | 1 teaspoon curry powder | 1 teaspoon cardamom seed | 6 cups water
instructions: In a large covered saucepan, bring water to boil. Add salmon and hamburger. Boil 1 minute. Add sweet paprika, curry, and cardamom and stir fry 2 minutes. Turn off heat. Add water.

Random Ingredients: emeril,pearl barley,yellow bell pepper,ha avocadoes,garlic salt,red onion,ginger paste
title: Emeril Islands Guacamole
ingredients: two 12-ounce hass avocadoes | 1/8 cup red onion, minced fine | 1/4 cup pear sweet potato red bell pepper, chopped fine | 1 teaspoon ginger paste | 1/4 teaspoon garlic salt | 1/4 teaspoon emeril's original essence ( or 1 tsp. if unavailable ) | powdered pearl barley or cooked pearl barley
instructions: Peel or pit avocadoes so they will stand upright. Cut off peel from top but leave a light layer of avocado's around the pit. Mash the avocados, along with 1/8 cup red onion, pear, ginger and minced sweet potato and 1/8 cup red bell pepper. Add essence and garlic salt. Sprinkle with the granulated pearl barley or stir to combine. Serve and enjoy.

title: Hot Beef Soup With Aubergine and Broccoli
ingredients: 3 tablespoons cornflour | 200 g stew meat | 400 g broccoli florets | 200 g aubergines | 3 tablespoons chinese rice wine | 1/2 teaspoon black pepper
instructions: Cut the aubergine in 3 cm chunks and steam them till they become transparent. Cut the beef into cubes and toss it together with the remaining ingredients till the meat gets the right consistency, add the cornflour and leave it rest till served.

Random Ingredients: spinach leaf,heavy whipping cream,dijon mustard,corn oil,italian parsley
title: Spinach with Mustard Cream
ingredients: 30 fresh spinach leaves, washed, dried and torn | 1 cup heavy whipping cream | 1 teaspoon dijon mustard | 1 tablespoon corn oil | 1 tablespoon minced italian parsley
instructions: In a blender or food processor, combine the spinach, cream, mustard and corn oil and blend until the mixture is smooth. Refrigerate until needed. Sprinkle with parsley just before serving.

title: Mustard Seeds
ingredients: 1 inch fennel seed | 1 inch mustard seeds | 2/3 pound can water chestnuts, drained
instructions: Split fennel and mustard seeds using a spice mill. Place in a skillet with water. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer uncovered until fennel is tender and mustard seed crackles, about 1 hour. Cool and store in an airtight container at room temperature.

title: The Best Coffee Beans!
ingredients: 2 teaspoons ground cumin | 2 teaspoons salsa | 2 teaspoons prepared coffee
instructions: In a medium sized bowl stir together the cumin, salsa, coffee and 1 t oil. Place the beans on a large, non stick pan with a tight fitting lid. Cover and let them get warm over medium low heat. Be gentle and stir once or twice. Serve.

Random Ingredients: vanilla syrup,romaine lettuce heart,lime juice zest,baking cocoa,chili powder
title: Mexican Fiesta Salad Dressing
ingredients: 2 cups baking cocoa | 2 cups romaine lettuce hearts, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1/4 cup fresh lime juice, plus zest | 1 tablespoon fresh lime juice, plus zest | 1/2 cup vanilla syrup | 1/2 teaspoon chili powder
instructions: Place the cocoa, romaine, lime juice, lime zest, vanilla syrup, and chili powder in a food processor, and pulse to combine. Store in an airtight container, in a cool, dark place, for up to 3 days.

title: Cranberry Chinese Fried Oysters
ingredients: 8 large oysters in syrup, not syrup packed | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1/2 cup cranberry sauce | 1 teaspoon baking powder
instructions: In a small saucepan over medium heat, heat syrup and vanilla extract until warm. Stir in cranberry sauce.

title: Chilean Fried Rice (Nasi Goreng)
ingredients: 3 cups rice flour or 3 cups glutinous rice flour ( glutinous rice flour ) | 1/2 lb shrimp or 1/2 lb chicken breast, minced | 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato ( julienned ) | 2 -3 tablespoons fish sauce ( nam pla ) | 1/4 - 1/2 cup sugar, to taste
instructions: Dissolve sugar in fish sauce. Dissolve rice flour or glutinous rice flour in enough water to bring to a boil, then stir until the mixture thickens. Remove from heat and stir in shrimp or chicken. Form into a flat disc, then chill for 5 minutes. Slice into 1/2 inch squares and fry in a skillet with a small amount of oil until golden on both sides. Drain on paper towels.

Random Ingredients: liquid honey,mozzarella cheese,golden raisin,beef rib,cinnamon,brandy,blueberry,chicken bouillon cube
title: Crock Pot Big Batch Beef Grilled Cheese-Stuffed
ingredients: 6 large beef short ribs | 2 cups fresh blueberries or 2 cups frozen blueberries | 1 can sliced ripe tomatoes, drained and reserve juice | 2 teaspoons liquid honey or 2 teaspoons maple syrup | 1 tablespoon brandy ( or rum ) | 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 5 chicken bouillon cubes | 1/4 cup golden raisin
instructions: Place short ribs in crock pot. Top with remaining ingredients except raisins. Cover and slow cook on high for 3 hours. Stir in raisins and serve.

title: Panna Cotta
ingredients: 4 ounces sweet tea | 1 tablespoon sweetened condensed milk | 7 ounces evaporated milk | 2 teaspoons grand marnier
instructions: Place the tea in a glass jug. Add sweetened condensed milk, evaporated milk and grand marnier.

Random Ingredients: salmon fillet,clear honey,gruyere cheese,parsley,cardamom seed,ladyfinger,cider vinegar
title: Tunisian Glazed Salmon on Faint Baguette
ingredients: 2 1/4 lbs salmon fillets, skinless, boneless | 1 1/2 cups clear honey | 1 1/2 cups cider vinegar | 4 ounces gruyere cheese, shredded | 1/2 cup fresh parsley, chopped & packed | 12 large lemon-sized ladyfingers | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom seed | 1/4 cup chopped fresh parsley, for garnish
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Cut salmon horizontally through twice through the centre crosswise to within 1/2 inch of the top of the fillet. Using fingers, form 2 inch pieces of fish to fit into a deep, 1 1/2 quart baking dish. Drizzle bread with honey and vinegar. Sprinkle with cheese, parsley, cardamom, 2 tsp of salt and 1/2 tsp pepper. Cover tightly with foil. Bake for about 30 minutes or until fish flakes when pierced with a fork. To serve, loosen fish from foil with a spatula and transfer to a warm serving platter. Serve immediately. Garnish with remaining chopped parsley.

title: Homemade Beans
ingredients: 2 cans cannellini beans, drained, juices reserved | 2 cloves garlic, broken into pieces
instructions: In a medium saucepan over boiling water, stir together cannellini beans and garlic. Cook and stir until the beans have absorbed liquid, about 5 minutes. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: tomato green chilies,sage,broth,apple pie,serrano chilies,vegetable oil cooking spray,jalapeno,greek seasoning
title: Broiled Red Bell Peppers
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 large ripe apple pie | 4 large red bell peppers or 4 large yellow bell peppers, cut in 1 inch slices | 2 teaspoons all purpose greek seasoning | 1 tablespoon minced jalapeno | 2 teaspoons rubbed sage | 1 can fire-roasted diced tomatoes with green chilies, undrained | salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Preheat broiler. Place the baking pan sprayed with cooking spray on the broiler rack. Broil on high 5 minutes, spraying with cooking spray once during cooking. Cool slightly, and then remove the peppers from the pan. Arrange the pepper slices on the hot baking sheet. Sprinkle with the greek seasoning and jalapeno. Broil, cut side up, for 7 - 9 minutes or until the pepper is blackened. Turn and broil until blackened all over. Cut lengthwise into 1/4 inch slices. Place the roasted peppers on a cutting board. With a serrated knife or sharp knife, carefully score the peppers. Combine the garlic, chiles, sage, tomatoes with chilies in a medium saucepan. Stir in 2 t. Water, and bring to a low boil. Reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes. Season with salt and pepper, and serve over the peppers.

Random Ingredients: vanilla pudding,vinegar,rice vinegar,thyme leaf,lemon wedge,red wine,irish whiskey
title: Homemade Drunken Whiskey Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup unsweetened apple cider or 1 cup unsweetened apple juice | 2 tablespoons rice vinegar or 2 tablespoons rice vinegar | 1 tablespoon irish whiskey ( not imitation ) | 1/2 cup red wine | 1/8 teaspoon thyme leaves | 2 teaspoons vanilla instant pudding | fresh lemon wedge
instructions: In medium mixing bowl, combine cider or juice, rice vinegar, whiskey, red wine, thyme and vanilla pudding mix. Stir until blended well. Cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours.

Random Ingredients: hard egg,mango chutney,chinese cabbage,beef chuck roast,chicken thigh,red bell pepper
title: Chicken and Cabbage Stuffed Chinese Cabbage
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless beef chuck roast | 1 chicken thigh ( or other tender meat ) | 4 hard-boiled eggs | 4 teaspoons mango chutney ( or more if you don't like mango chutney ) | 4 heads chinese cabbage | 1 red bell pepper ( optional )
instructions: Trim excess fat from meat, cutting away most of the gristle from the inside of the roast and place it in the crock. Sprinkle with salt, cover the crock with a plate, and set aside. Remove meat from its bones, leaving the skin on, and place it on a rimmed baking sheet.. Cut a cross on one side of the meat, and stuff the cross in with a small egg. In a small bowl, beat 2 teaspoons mango chutney with a fork, and pour this over the meat. Place the baking sheet with the meat in the crock, and let the meat stand at room temperature for 1 hour. Cut off the top third of a head of cabbage, and remove outer leaves. Remove the hard stem ends of the cabbage, and pull off the thick leaves of the head leaving a 1 inch thick shell from the thick leaf attached to the bottom of the head. Rinse leaves well under cold water, and dry on paper towels. Cut remaining head into 2 1/2 inch lengths. Fill cabbage with the meat, and place one head on top of each other. Slice a small piece of bread in half, and dip each piece in bread. Replace each leaf with a layer of meat, and spread a few teaspoons of chutney over each and a few drops of water. Place a piece of egg on top of each, and close the lid. Repeat until you have used up the meat. Steam the stuffed cabbage 2 or 3 times, depending on the size and tenderness of the piece of meat. Do not overcook.

title: Namibian Sweet and Sour Taco Sauce for Taco Filling
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups sweet taco sauce | 3 tablespoons sugar | 1/2 - 1 tablespoon cayenne ( adjust for heat level ) | 2 teaspoons sesame oil
instructions: Place ingredients in a small bowl and stir well. Pour mixture into a resealable plastic tub and refrigerate until ready to use. In the meantime prepare the filling and prepare the tacos that have been pre heated. Spread the mixture into an 8 x10 inch pan and broil until lightly browned and bubbly, 3 - 5 minutes, watching closely.

Random Ingredients: navy bean,green bell pepper,cardamom seed,artichoke heart,monterey jack cheese,self rising flour,triple sec,shortening
title: Artichoke and White Bean Cake
ingredients: 2 cans navy beans, drained and rinsed | 1/2 cup finely chopped green bell pepper | 1 package frozen artichoke hearts, thawed | 1 lb self-rising flour, sifted | 1/4 cup shortening or 1/4 cup margarine | 1 cup shredded monterey jack cheese or 1 cup cheddar cheese | 1/4 cup triple sec | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon crushed cardamom seeds
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Spray and greased an 8 x 4 inch loaf pan. Stir together the beans, green pepper and artichokes. In a medium mixing bowl, combine the flour, shortening, cheese, triple sec, and cardamom. Add the vegetables to the flour and vegetable mixture. Stir with a fork until mixed. Spread the mixture into the prepared pan. Bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour or until an inserted toothpick comes out clean. Remove from pan and allow to cool for 10 minutes before removing from pan.

title: Prosciutto and Cherry Pasta
ingredients: 8 ounces spaghetti | 8 ounces prosciutto or 8 ounces ham | 2 tablespoons chopped dates | 1 tablespoon chopped cilantro leaf | 1 tablespoon chopped cherry
instructions: Boil a large pan of water. Meanwhile, cut the prosciutto into thin strips about 2 - 3 long. Slice the tomatoes into thin half moons. Put the spaghetti into the boiling water, put on a timer, and boil till tender. Heat a pan of oil to its max high and fry the prosciutto for a couple of minutes, stirring now and then. Add the cherry and proscuitto, stirring. Drain the spaghetti, then tip in all of it in and mix in the contents to thicken the sauce, adding more cherries and cilantro if desired.

title: Elegant Japanese Steakhouse Marinade
ingredients: canola oil or vegetable oil, for frying | mirin ( japanese sweet cooking wine ) | vegetable oil or canola oil
instructions: In a mixing bowl add the mirin, salt and pepper and mix well until the salt has dissolved. Add the oil and toss until the oil has fully incorporated. Let sit for at least one hour while you prepare the raw meat. Drain meat well and then dry. I use my grill pan with a cover, but any gas grill will work just fine. You can use my pre cooked steak slicer in there or you can use a meat tenderizer. This gives you a fine texture and will yield a nice result. You could also use your marinade bottle to use for marinating if desired. Grilling is also an excellent source of flavor unlike deep frying and can also be purchased in asian grocery stores.

title: Brazilian Peanuts (Shrimps)
ingredients: 1/2 cup dry roasted salted peanut ( like peanuts or hazelnuts ) | 1/2 cup panko breadcrumbs | 1 tablespoon unsweetened cocoa powder, ( optional ) | 1 lime, zest of
instructions: Break the nuts, place them in a bowl and toss with the panko, cocoa and lime zest. Spray the pan with cooking spray, add enough olive oil to reach the pan, set over medium heat and saute peanut shrimps for 3 - 5 minutes, turning and pressing down with a spatula until the color is darker, rich and deep. When the shrimps are about 1 1/2 minutes, remove from the pan and serve either hot or warm.

Random Ingredients: italian plum tomato,green onion,soda water,dinner,celery seed
title: Italian Plum Tomatoes
ingredients: 24 italian plum tomatoes | 1/2 cup soda water | 2 teaspoons celery seeds | 2 green onions | assorted snack trays, such as fritos
instructions: Wash the tomatoes.

title: Fresh Blueberries With Green Chili Sauce
ingredients: 2 poblano chiles, roasted, peeled and deseeded | 1 lb fresh blueberries | 1 jar bottled alfredo sauce | 3/4 tablespoon sugar substitute
instructions: Cut tops off green chili peppers and discard. Wash and core poblano chiles. Place poblano on a paper towel and pat dry. Cover with 2 towels and let sit 30 minutes to get rid of some of the chilies' moisture. When they are cool enough to handle, cut chiles in half and remove seeds and tenderized inner ribs. Preheat oven to 425°f. Heat alfredo in a skillet over medium heat and add green chili. Cook until alfredo coats back of spoon, then remove from heat. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper or a silicone baking mat or lined with a silicone liner. When chilies are cool enough to handle, carefully peel away paper and membrane and finely mince with a mortar or mini chopper, until no large chunks remain. Strain alfredo sauce and mix into green chili mixture. Line a strainer with cheesecloth or a double layer of damp cheesecloth. Place 1/2 the blueberries in a microwave safe bowl and cover with alfredo. Cover bowl with another paper towel. Microwave on high for 1 minute or until berries are soft but not completely mushy. Remove bowl from microwave and place blueberries in a plastic zipper bag. Remove air bubbles and seal. Let sit for 3 minutes. Transfer the frozen blueberries to a dish and gently muffle with a fork. Cover with aluminum foil and let sit in the fridge for an hour. Remove chilies from the bag with a slotted spoon and slice into 1 inch pieces. Line the strainer with a plate or plate with a damp cheesecloth. Drain the blueberries well.

Random Ingredients: soy mozzarella cheese,spinach leaf,coriander powder,cumin powder,cream coconut
title: Low-Stuff Spinach With a Greek Twist
ingredients: 12 ounces frozen chopped spinach leaves | 2 teaspoons ground coriander powder | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 1 teaspoon light soy mozzarella cheese, grated | 1 carton light thickened cream of coconut ( not miracle whip )
instructions: Thaw the spinach at room temperature. Thaw it if too cold, then place it in a bowl and toss lightly with the coriander and cumin powders and light soy cheese. Mix well with the spinach. Cover and store overnight. Unwrap the washed spinach if using fresh. Mix gently with the cream of coconut, and use the as little as possible in the filling. Spoon into a dish, sprinkle with greek yogurt and serve warm.

title: Kielbasa and Broth
ingredients: 1 lb kielbasa, cut crosswise into 1 inch slices | 1 can of pacific low sodium chicken broth | 1/4 cup dark rum | 1 cup cooked pasta
instructions: Brown the kielbasa, using only a amount of oil, not that you need to grease. As you brown, the chicken broth will evaporate some of the fat. Once the meat is nearly done, deglaze the pan with the broth, then add the rum. When the mixture is almost dry, add the pasta and simmer over low heat until the pasta is cooked, but still a little firm, about 15 minutes. Serve and enjoy.

title: Jamaican Jerks
ingredients: 1 whole chicken | 4 -6 scotch bonnet peppers ( this amount is not enough for the heat ) | 8 -12 dates
instructions: Roast the chickens and peppers. Remove the skin from under the skin, if desired, and put a small plate over the birds to keep the chickens moist during cooking. Brush with some water. Sprinkle with pepper, scallions and dried fruit. Put on a baking sheet or foil and bake at 450 degrees until done, about 15 minutes. Allow to cool on a foil covered cookie sheet. Slice and serve warm or cold.

title: Easy Mexican Sandwich - Vegetarian
ingredients: 1 large tomatoes, sliced | 1 lb roast pork, thinly sliced on the diagonal | 1 head lettuce, shredded
instructions: Preheat your oven to 375 degrees fahrenheit. Arrange the roast pork around the bottom of a casserole dish. Spread the slices with some salsa, then top with tomato slices. Cover with shredded lettuce for the last few minutes of cooking. Slice into wedges and serve with salsa verde on the side.

title: Sesame Ricotta Spread
ingredients: 1 cup ricotta cheese, preferably whole milk | 2 teaspoons sesame seeds
instructions: Beat the ricotta cheese and sugar to blend thoroughly. Toast the sesame seeds in a fry pan and add a small amount of oil. Once they are a fine powder, add to the cheese mixture. Sesame seeds may also be added to the mixture. Add remaining olive oil to desired thickness.

title: Filipino Pork Roast
ingredients: 1 piece galangal, sliced | 1 tablespoon lite evaporated milk | 2 tablespoons lime juice | 1 3/4 pounds pork loin roast, fat trimmed | 8 ounces fresh fettuccine
instructions: Trim excess fat from the pork and cut into 1 inch strips. Place in a large saucepan, over medium heat, and stir in the galangal, evaporated milk, and lime juice. Bring to a simmer, and cook 4 to 5 minutes, or until the sauce is somewhat reduced. Arrange the pork onto a serving platter, and cover with foil to keep warm. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add fettuccine, and cook for 8 to 10 minutes, or until tender.

Random Ingredients: graham cracker,caper,grain white rice,spanish onion,brandy,pimiento,chinese cabbage
title: Chia-Yaya's Rice Pilaf
ingredients: 2 cups short-grain white rice | 1 cup white cabbage, shredded | 1 spanish onion, chopped | 1 jar pimientos, drained and chopped ( optional ) | 15 capers ( optional ) | 2 jars roasted garlic-stuffed olives ( optional ) | 1/2 cup brandy, to taste | 10 graham crackers
instructions: Wash your rice in a sieve for a minute or two under running water. Put in a large bowl and add all the other ingredients except the brandy. Mix well, then set aside, covered, for about an hour. Remove the rice from the bowl, reserving the liquid. Using a stick blender, puree your rice in the bowl. Add brandy, and mix. Serve as is or stir once or twice.

title: Prawn Sticks
ingredients: 350 g pork loin | 375 g medium prawns | 8 sheets phyllo dough | 2 teaspoons marsala wine
instructions: Cook the pork loin in water with a lid on, then drain it through a colander. Cut the prawns into thick slices, about ¼ inch thick. Preheat the oven to 160 ° celsius. Cut the phyllo dough into strips. Place a teaspoon of pork and prawns at the centre of the strip, shiny side up. Fold the strip into a triangle shape to enclose the filling. Repeat for remaining wrappers and the phyllo dough. Roll each piece out into a log about 4 inches long and 2 - 3 inches in diameter, so that the leaves are at least 6 inches long. Spread 2 teaspoons of marsala over the pastry. Add the remaining sliced pork and prawns along the strips and roll each piece up. Line a baking tray with parchment paper, and place the rolls in the tray. Brush the tops with milk and bake for 15 - 20 minutes, or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: pineapple juice,serrano pepper,baking soda,yellow onion,mushroom cap,tabasco sauce
title: Sweet and Sour Sweet Hawaiian Pineapple and Mushroom Jam
ingredients: 1 yellow onion, chopped | 1 jar mushroom caps, drained | 1 can large crushed pineapple in juice, undrained | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 1 jar roasted serrano peppers, drained | 2 tablespoons tabasco sauce
instructions: Cook onion and mushroom caps in a large saucepan over medium heat for 5 minutes, or until just tender. Stir in pineapple and baking soda. Bring to a boil, stirring frequently, reduce heat to low, and simmer for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally. Remove from heat and set aside for 10 minutes. Stir in serrano peppers and let stand 10 minutes, then pour into a baking dish. Top with tobasco sauce and bake at 350 degrees for 20 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center of the jutu comes out dry.

Random Ingredients: cream mushroom soup,lime,scotch whisky,lime wedge,chipotle chile,cornmeal,kaffir lime leaf,thyme
title: Tex Mex Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 2 cans condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 can condensed chipotle chiles, drained | 8 kaffir lime leaves, crumbled | 2 teaspoons dried thyme or 1 tablespoon fresh thyme, chopped | 2 teaspoons fresh lime rind, grated | 1/2 cup light cornmeal | 3 tablespoons scotch whisky, or to taste | lime wedge
instructions: Heat soup, chipotle chiles, kaffir lime leaves, thyme, and lime rind in a medium saucepan over moderate heat until the chile crumbles. Remove from heat and allow to cool, about 3 minutes. Blend soup mixture and cornmeal. Stir in the whiskey. Divide mixture among 8x8x2 inch pieces of lettuce. Sprinkle with lime wedges.

Random Ingredients: garlic powder,vegetable oil,fontina cheese,onion soup mix,bouillon,red potato,rose water
title: Vegetable Fritters
ingredients: 1 package onion soup mix | 1 bouillon, cube | 2 cloves garlic powder | 1/2 cup vegetable oil | 1 teaspoon rose water | 1 package dry fontina cheese | 1 lb red potatoes
instructions: Prepare onion soup mix in a small bowl, stir in bouillon and garlic powder. In a large, heavy frying pan, warm 1/2 cup vegetable oil over medium heat. Stir in chopped potatoes and 3/4 of soup mix. Cook 1 minute, or until potatoes are light brown in color. Spread potatoes in a single layer in pan. To serve, place a piece of fontina cheese on top of the potato mixture. Add remaining soup mix on top of cheese.

Random Ingredients: currant,shallot,broccoli floret,salmon,cream celery soup,kielbasa,bleu cheese salad dressing
title: Smoked Salmon and Broccoli
ingredients: 1 bunch broccoli floret | 1 can cream of celery soup | 8 ounces smoked salmon | 8 ounces smoked kielbasa, chopped | 1 small shallot, minced | 1/2 cup currants | 1/4 cup sour cream or 1/4 cup salad dressing
instructions: Mix together soups, salmon, kielbasa and shallot. Layer ingredients as follows, broccoli, kielbasa mixture, soup mixture and cheese. Serve at once or refrigerate for up to a week.

title: Napa Dave's Easy Mashed Pot
ingredients: 4 ounces meatballs ( frozen ) | 1 teaspoon dried marjoram | 1/2 teaspoon caster sugar | 1/2 teaspoon corn oil | 1 can black beans | 7 fluid ounces beef gravy | 2 1/2 fluid ounces molasses or 2 1/2 fluid ounces maple syrup
instructions: Combine meatballs, marjoram, castoram and sugar in medium bowl, add corn oil, black beans, beef gravy and mix thoroughly. Fill 4 - ½ pint ramekins with mix and place on baking tray. Preheat oven at 140°c. Bake for 20 minutes or until meatballs are cooked. Leave in tins and return to oven for 20 - 30 minutes until bubbly.

title: Apricot Sesame Oil Oil
ingredients: 2 fluid ounces salad oil | 1 pinch ground cloves | 1 teaspoon sesame oil | 1 teaspoon apricot jam ( optional )
instructions: Whisk together the oil, spices and jam.

title: Dynamite Beef Gravy
ingredients: 1 can condensed tomato soup | 1/2 cup prepared beef gravy | 1/8 teaspoon dried tarragon
instructions: In a medium bowl combine the tomato soup, gravy and tarragon. Transfer the tomato soup mixture to a microwave safe glass baking dish. Cook in microwave on high for about 7 minutes or until heated through.

title: Poulet a La Tajine
ingredients: 14 ounces pineapple slices ( not packed in juice ) | 1 teaspoon celery seed | 1 teaspoon dried pomegranate ( seeds of 1 pomegranate ) | 1 lb fish fillet, in bite-size pieces
instructions: Heat 1 tbs. Oil in heavy skillet over medium high heat. Add celery seed and pomegranate seeds. Toast spices over low heat 5 to 10 minutes or until aromatic. Transfer mixture to plate. Add fish to skillet. Cook, turning once or twice, until fish is just opaque throughout, 1 - 2 minutes. Serve immediately.

title: Green Chilies Stuffed with Cashews
ingredients: 500 g green chilies, stems removed | 200 g margarine or 200 g unsalted butter | 100 g ground almonds or 100 g cashews | 3/4 cup green chili, finely diced | 3/4 tablespoon rum or 1/2 tablespoon brandy flavoured liqueur | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: To make cashew filling, heat margarine or butter in a pan over medium to low heat and stir continuously. Add remaining green chillies. Saute for 3 - 4 minutes or until chillies turn golden brown. Remove from heat, stir in nuts, rum or brandy flavouring and vanilla, and leave to cool. Roll cashew filling into small balls. Arrange on a tray, cover with foil and chillies in between layers of prepared cheesecloth. Keep refrigerated in the fridge until ready to serve. Serve with crackers or toasted almonds.

Random Ingredients: grit,ginger garlic paste,self raising flour,dark sesame oil,chili flake,coffee liqueur,orange peel,chili
title: Tortilla Fingers
ingredients: 2 cups self-raising flour | 1/3 cup brown rice flour | 1/3 cup ginger garlic paste | 1/4 cup dried chili, de-seeded | 1/2 cup chili flakes | 200 ml strong coffee liqueur | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil | orange peel, chopped | hot spiced chile flakes
instructions: Preheat oven to sieve both flours into a bowl, and add the rest of the ingredients. Knead lightly. Roll the dough into sausage shapes, roughly 3/4 in diameter. Place the fritters on a dry non stick baking sheet. Spread chile flakes and oil into the pan. Bake for 20 - 30 minutes, until done.

Random Ingredients: jalapeno seed,mustard powder,white sugar,emmenthaler cheese,ramen noodle,superfine sugar
title: Egg Roll
ingredients: 1 package top ramen noodles, broken | 1/2 cup shredded sharp cheddar-romano cheese blend | 1/4 teaspoon ground mustard powder | 1/4 teaspoon white sugar | 1 teaspoon finely chopped pickled jalapeno seeds | 1 teaspoon superfine sugar
instructions: Place broken ramen in a large bowl. Sprinkle the cheddar cheese blend on top. Sprinkle the mustard, white sugar, jalapenos, and superfine sugar over the top. Using your hands, press the mixture into the corners of the bowl, then roll or press the bowl with your hands to tighten the roll. Slice and serve warm. Note, if the mix is still cracker type, sprinkle on a little more of the cheddar cheese.

Random Ingredients: yellow bell pepper,garlic red chile paste,scotch bonnet pepper
title: Hot Pepper Paste for Grilling
ingredients: 25 ounces hot scotch bonnet peppers | 1 small yellow bell pepper | 1 tablespoon garlic and red chile paste, or to taste
instructions: Place red chile peppers into a bowl of water and cover. Let sit for 30 minutes to soften. Heat grill to medium and lightly oil grate. Remove stems and seeds from peppers and coarsely chop. Add peppers to a food processor and process until smooth. Add black pepper paste and process until finely ground.

title: English Sushi
ingredients: 2 packages vanilla pudding, any flavor | 2 tablespoons raspberry vinegar | 1 large spanish onion, chopped | 1 package fresh strawberries
instructions: Prepare 1 jelly roll pan, or 6 - 8 sushi mat sheets. In saucepan, add 1 package of vanilla pudding, 2 tablespoons raspberry vinegar, 3 tablespoons of chopped onion and 1 package of fresh strawberries. Cook over medium heat until mixture begins to thicken. When mixture is thick, add the other package of vanilla pudding. Bring to a boil. Remove from heat with rubber spatula, and remove from heat. Spread one side of each sushi mat with 1/2 cup of filling. Spread 1 - 2 tablespoons of jelly roll mix inside top of the sushi mat, and spread on jelly roll mix. Repeat using remaining sushi mat and filling. Sprinkle each roll with finely chopped or sifted sugar. Place sushi mat in heated sushi, and cover with steamed water. Cover, and allow to steam for 4 - 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: chicken stock,peanut butter,pork loin roast,sherry wine,cornflour,cooking spray,icing sugar
title: Roast Pork With Peanut-Sherry Glaze Filling
ingredients: 1 lean boneless pork loin roast | cooking spray | 1/2 cup peanut butter, smooth | 2 tablespoons sherry wine | 3 cups chicken stock, low-sodium | 1 tablespoon cornflour or 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 2 tablespoons icing sugar
instructions: Prick the pork with a fork and arrange in a lightly oiled baking dish. Bake uncovered in a moderate oven for 2 hours or until cooked. Let stand 15 minutes. Meanwhile, cook the peanut butter and sherry in a small heatproof bowl over boiling water, stirring until smooth and hot. Add the broth, stirring until the sauce boils and thickens slightly. Remove the pork from the oven. Cut into strips, about 2cm thick. Heat a little oil in a small nonstick frying pan over high heat and sear the pork in batches for about 4 to 5 minutes or until tender and lightly browned. Remove from the pan and set aside. Boil the stock for about 3 minutes or until reduced by half. Stir the corn flour or cornstarch into the fat in the frying pan and cook, stirring, until thickened. Transfer to a small serving bowl and stir in the pork. Dusting with icing sugar and serve in the pan.

Random Ingredients: eggplant,rice noodle,hamburger bun,flour tortilla,bay leaf,beef stock
title: Beef Pho
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs ground sirloin | 1 cup beef stock | 1 bay leaf | 6 flour tortillas | 2 eggplants, sliced | 12 crisp fried hamburger buns
instructions: Cook beef in skillet until thoroughly cooked.

title: Pesto Dressing
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dried hot pesto sauce | 4 teaspoons cooking oil
instructions: Pour the cooking oil into a small jar with a lid. Stir in the pesto sauce, cover, and shake until the pesto is evenly distributed. Chill before using.

Random Ingredients: beef brisket,bucatini pasta,masa harina,salt,red potato,parmigiano reggiano cheese,thyme sprig
title: Potato-Breaded Beef Brisket with Fresh Herbs
ingredients: 3 lbs beef brisket | 2 cups masa harina | 1 teaspoon salt | 1 sprig fresh thyme sprig | 1 pound red potatoes, peeled and halved | 12 pieces bucatini pasta | 3/4 bunch fresh thyme, leaves separated | 1/2 lb grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Cut brisket across the grain into 1/2 inch thick slices. Make sure you get a pocket. In a large bowl, mix the masa harina, salt, and thyme. Dry the meat with paper towels. Place the meat into the breading mixture, and sprinkle it with the potatoes. Arrange the bucatini in a pile atop the meat, and arrange the thyme leaves over the bucatini. Sprinkle with the cheese. Heat a large skillet over medium high heat. Add enough water to cover the meat, and bring to a boil. Cook for 45 minutes, or until meat is fork tender. Remove from water, and let meat rest for 15 to 20 minutes. Pull meat apart, shred and serve.

title: Soy and Bran Candy
ingredients: 1 cup soymilk | 1 tablespoon brandy or 1 tablespoon rum | 2 tablespoons cocoa
instructions: Combine everything in a bowl and leave overnight in the fridge, stirring once or twice. The next day, remove the cacao sachet or sachet by hitting the bowl with a cutting board and holding it with a fork. Dip your hands into the melted chocolate and roll or press until smooth. Sprinkle with cocoa, to serve.

Random Ingredients: tabasco brand chipotle pepper sauce,rotel tomato,chipotle chile,cider vinegar,red onion,white onion
title: Spicy Chipotle Salsa
ingredients: 2 lbs rotel tomatoes | 3/4 teaspoon dried chipotle chiles | 1 1/2 teaspoons hot tapasco brand chipotle pepper sauce or 1 1/2 teaspoons other spicy hot chipotle pepper sauce | 3/4 cup chopped red onion | 3/4 cup chopped white onion | 1/4 cup cider vinegar | 2 tablespoons minced canned chipotle chiles
instructions: Preheat broiler.

title: Candied Pineapple
ingredients: 2 cups fresh pineapple chunks or 2 cups canned pineapple chunks | 1/2 cup honey | 1/4 cup light corn syrup | 1 large crystallized ginger, peeled and sliced | 1 sprig fresh pistachios
instructions: Place pineapple chunks into a bowl, pour just enough water over to cover and gently toss to coat. Allow to stand 20 minutes. Drain pineapple, drain and discard juice. Place honey, syrup and ginger into a saucepan. Heat over medium heat, stirring constantly for 2 minutes. Remove from heat, add pineapple and toss well. Transfer to a serving container. Sprinkle with pistachios. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Keeps up to 2 weeks.

title: Tuna in Red Sauce
ingredients: 3 cans tuna in brine, drained | 2 green chile peppers, sliced | 5 tablespoons golden syrup | 2 tablespoons dried sage | 2 tablespoons dried sweet peas, optional
instructions: In a medium size saucepan over medium high heat, combine the tuna, green chile peppers, golden syrup, sage, and sweet peas.

Random Ingredients: soy sauce,tomato soup,cranberry juice,grape,grain rice,basil leaf
title: Rice and Tomato Bake
ingredients: 1 can condensed tomato soup | 4 cups cooked long grain rice | 1 can low-fat canned cranberry juice or ( 15 ounce ) can raspberry-infused juice | 4 fresh basil leaves | 2 -3 tablespoons light soy sauce | 1 cup seedless grapes
instructions: Preheat oven to 350&deg.

title: A Very Proper Chunky Mango Pickle
ingredients: 2 cups caster sugar | 500 g green chilies, deseeded and finely chopped ( green pea ) | 2 tablespoons mustard, very coarsely chopped ( optional - i always leave it out )
instructions: Boil the sugar and chillies in the water till they come to the boil, about 10 - 15 minutes, and then add the mustard.

title: Rose Foil With Raisins(Seychelles)
ingredients: 4 tablespoons rose petals | 8 ounces raisins
instructions: Heat oil in saucepan over medium high heat. When oil is hot, add rose petals and raisins. Stir and fry until all raisins are golden brown and oil separates from nuts. Let drain a few minutes on paper towels. Enjoy.

title: Peach Smoothie
ingredients: 4 ripe peaches | 1/4 cup caster sugar, plus extra ( superfine ) | 1 bunch spring onion, sliced | 3/4 cup low-fat yogurt ( greek-style )
instructions: Peel peaches and remove stones. Place in a blender with sugar, spring onions and yogurt. Add more sugar, if required, to taste. Pulse to desired consistency and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: white wine vinegar,dark soy sauce,ginger,cream cottage cheese
title: Spiced Cream Cheese With Caramelised Ginger
ingredients: 8 ounces cream-style cottage cheese | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce | 1 teaspoon white wine vinegar | 2 teaspoons finely grated fresh ginger
instructions: Combine the cottage cheese, soy sauce, vinegar and ginger in a bowl. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour or overnight. Bring to room temperature before serving and set aside to soften slightly. Serves as a dip or a side dish with vegetables, rice or noodles.

Random Ingredients: caramel ice cream topping,cucumber,green cardamom,pepper,alfredo sauce,stout beer
title: Beer & Creme Brulee
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups beer | 1 carton creamy alfredo sauce | 1 can sliced cucumbers ( undrained ) | 6 green cardamoms | 6 tablespoons caramel ice cream topping | pepper
instructions: Heat oven to combine beer, sauce, cucumber, cardamom, & caramel topping.

title: Okra Steamed Mixed-up (Toshikake)
ingredients: 1 package dry yeast | 1/2 cup hot water | 4 -4 cups fresh sliced okra ( about 1 lb. ) | 1 1/2 cups chunky salsa ( about 4 oz. ) | 2 -3 tablespoons fennel seeds | 2 plum tomatoes | 1 1/2 - 2 cups hot water | 2 tablespoons mirin or 2 tablespoons sweet rice wine vinegar | 2 teaspoons frozen minced shallots ( or 3-4 teaspoons minced fresh garlic, or 2 teaspoons minced white onion )
instructions: In a large mixing bowl or in the bowl of a stand mixer fitted with a dough hook, combine salt, yeast and the hot water, beating at medium speed until yeast mixture is very foamy, about three minutes. Add okra, salsa and fennel seeds, beat at medium speed, scraping bowl occasionally until mixed well, about three minutes. Add tomatoes and enough water to make a firm dough. If dough is still runny, add a little more water, one tablespoon at a time. Place dough in a greased bowl or in two lightly oiled 1 quart casseroles or an oiled 9 x13 inch baking dish. Cover tightly with two layers of plastic wrap, place in a warm spot and allow to rise until dough has tripled in size, about 1 1/2 hours. Meanwhile, preheat oven to 425°f place casseroles on a baking sheet with sides. Cover with a towel and allow to rise until doubled in size, about 1/2 hour. Drain. In large saucepan, combine the mirin and reserved 1/2 cup water. Bring to a boil over medium high heat, stirring frequently. Reduce heat and add the shallots and 1/2 teaspoon salt. Cook, stirring often, about two minutes. Remove from heat. Cover and refrigerate. Punch down dough, then divide into six equal pieces. On a lightly floured surface, roll each piece of dough into a long, thin cylinder about 15 inches long and 3/4 inch thick. Starting with the long side, roll the dough tightly in the shallot mixture, then fold the long side over the dough. Roll up firmly and transfer seam side down to baking sheet, seam side down, and pinch seam to seal. Brush with egg, glaze with remaining 2 1/2 cups water. Cover with plastic wrap. Allow bread to rise until about 1 1/2 times in size, 20 to 30 minutes. Bake until golden brown and puffy and bread edges are well dried, about 45 minutes. Allow bread to stand at room temperature for 10 to 15 minutes before serving. To serve, slice bread and serve from dish or spoon into warm bowls. Serve with salsa.

title: Aimee
ingredients: 1 sheet puff pastry | 1/8 cup tamarind paste | 1/2 cup kalamata olives
instructions: Make a short film with your favourite jam and spread the mixture. Cut pastry into 6 equal sections. Put each section on a lightly greased oven tray. Prick with a fork. Bake in a moderately hot oven for 15 - 20 minutes or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: vegetable shortening,collard green,mexican cheese,lasagna noodle,white wine vinegar
title: Lazy collard greens (Tex-Mex)
ingredients: 12 lasagna noodles | 1 pound collard greens, ends trimmed | 1/2 cup dry white wine vinegar | 1/2 cup vegetable shortening | 1/2 cup shredded mexican cheese blend
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add lasagna noodles and blanch for 3 to 5 minutes, or until al dente.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon cube,poultry seasoning,tomato puree,chili oil
title: Homemade Taco Seasoning
ingredients: 1 beef bouillon cube, crushed | 1 can tomato puree, with peppers | 1/4 cup chili oil | 1 dash poultry seasoning
instructions: Put in a crock pot. Cook on low 1 hour or to desired consistency.

Random Ingredients: dark rum,port wine,scallion,yogurt,chive,poblano chile pepper,pasta shell,sage leaf
title: Yogurt, Poblano Chile Pepper and Sage Pasta
ingredients: 4 fresh poblano chile peppers - stemmed, seeded, and coarsely chopped | 1 tablespoon dark rum or sherry wine | 10 fresh sage leaves | 1/2 cup port wine | 1/2 cup plain yogurt, drained | 1/4 cup chopped fresh chives | 16 ounces pasta shells | 4 scallions, thinly sliced
instructions: Heat oven to 300 degrees f. Combine the poblano peppers, dark rum, sage leaves, port, yogurt and chives in a large bowl. Stir to combine. Add pasta and toss to combine. Transfer the mixture to a baking pan shaped baking dish. Bake, covered, for 30 minutes, stirring halfway through. Uncover and bake 5 or 6 minutes more, or until the sauce is bubbly. Serve with scallions.

Random Ingredients: vegetable,pork tenderloin,fish sauce,chicken meat,fast rising yeast
title: Easy Vietnamese Fried Pork
ingredients: 1 pound pork tenderloins | 1 pound chopped frozen vegetables | 2 teaspoons fast-rising yeast | 2 tablespoons fish sauce | 1/2 cup warm water
instructions: Place pork tenderloins in a large skillet and sprinkle the frozen vegetables with yeast. Place over high heat and cook, stirring frequently, until vegetables are tender crisp, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in fish sauce. Transfer to a warm bowl. Heat the oil in a large skillet or deep fryer to 375 degrees f. Dip the pork tenderloins first into the warm water, then fry until brown, about 5 minutes per side.

title: California Braised Zucchini
ingredients: 10 -12 zucchini, trimmed and cut diagonally into 1/2 inch slices | 1 cup dry red wine vinegar | 1 - 1 1/2 lb lean ground meat | 2 tablespoons pecorino romano cheese, freshly grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees fahrenheit. Place zucchini in a colander and toss lightly. Transfer zucchini to baking pan and lightly oil top of zucchini with cooking spray or lightly butter. Sprinkle zucchini with cheese evenly, and pour oil over all. Bake for 40 minutes, until zucchini is heated through and zucchini is lightly browned.

title: Besan Chips #2
ingredients: 2 cups golden raisins | 1/2 cup coconut oil
instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a small heavy bottomed frying pan on medium high heat. You can also do this in a double boiler. When the oil is hot, fry the bran until it is evenly brown. Drain on paper towels. Place in a plastic bag while it is still warm to store in the refrigerator. To serve, place a handful on some paper towels and set aside. Sprinkle with the bran and let cool for a couple minutes. Break into bits and top with more bran on the side.

title: Chipotle Bell Pepper Soup
ingredients: 1 bell pepper, stemmed | 1 1/2 - 2 cups water ( or more as needed to cover ingredients ) | 2 tablespoons dried mint leaves | 5 -6 -8 chopped canned chipotle chiles | 2 -3 tablespoons adobo seasoning | 1 -2 cloves garlic, peeled, crushed ( or 1/4 tsp garlic powder )
instructions: Place all the liquids in a medium saucepan and bring to a boil. Meanwhile, trim tops from peppers by peeling the stalk and slicing them vertically. Place the cut sides of the peppers into a small bowl and pour 1/2 cup water over. Sprinkle the entire peppers with adobo, then cover and refridgerate. Drain the peppers and reserve 2 cups of the liquid. Put peppers and reserved liquid in blender or food processor, puree. Add the minced garlic and puree the soup again. Add more water, as needed, to reach desired consistency. Adjust seasonings, if necessary. Serve hot or chilled. If you are serving with crackers, sprinkle generously with crumminess and toasted almonds.

Random Ingredients: tomato sauce,marjoram,double cream,turmeric powder,asparagus,tilapia fillet,sambal oelek,plain flour
title: Spicy Fillet & Asparagus
ingredients: 4 tilapia fillets, skinned | 4 tablespoons plain flour | 1 tablespoon double cream | 2 tablespoons tomato sauce | 2 teaspoons red asparagus, steamed to just barely tender | 1 tablespoon sambal oelek | 1 sprig marjoram, leaves to decorate | 1 pinch turmeric powder
instructions: Lightly dust tilapia fillets with flour, dust them lightly with salt and set aside. Place tomato sauce, asparagus and sambal oelek and 2 tablespoons of tomato sauce in a pan over high heat and bring to the boil. Add asparagus, reduce heat and simmer gently for 5 minutes. Reduce heat to low, cover and simmer for 10 - 12 minutes or until asparagus is tender. Remove from heat and set aside. Serve the remaining tomato and asparagus sauce over the fish. To make the gravy, place the remaining tomato sauce, asparagus, cream and turmeric in a pan and bring to the boil. Simmer for 5 minutes.

title: Zucchini With Ricotta Cheese
ingredients: 2 zucchini ( small, about 9 ounces. ) | 1 -2 cup ricotta cheese, at room temperature
instructions: Using medium/large knife, cut 1 - 2 small rounds out of large zucchini about 1/4 thick in size pieces. If using large zucchini cut into 3 pieces. If using larger pieces, cut them in half if desired. Place a little bit of ricotta inside each zucchini piece. Grill zucchini on a rack and let cool, or place in serving bowl, add another small circle of zucchini on top. Spoon on more ricotta or use as garnish.

Random Ingredients: curry powder,parmigiano,catsup,salt black pepper,mint leaf,milk,italian sausage
title: Cajun Style Cajun French Fries
ingredients: 2 cups milk | 1 tablespoon catsup | 1 teaspoon dried mint leaves | 1/4 teaspoon curry powder | salt and ground black pepper to taste | 1/4 cup grated parmigiano
instructions: Pour the milk into a saucepan and bring to a boil. Place the maple syrup into a small bowl. Place the catsup and dried mint into the hot milk and whisk to combine. Allow the mixture to return to a boil and stir until the catsup has completely dissolved. Season with curry powder, salt and pepper.

Random Ingredients: cardamom pod,black cumin,honey,tabasco jalapeno sauce,cremini mushroom,celery salt
title: Spicy Mushrooms with Cajun Spareribs
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups medium cremini mushrooms, cleaned and coarsely chopped | 1 tablespoon creolehoney | 1 teaspoon tabasco jalapeno sauce | 1/4 teaspoon celery salt | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom pod, crushed | 1/8 teaspoon black cumin, crushed
instructions: Warm 2 teaspoons of oil in a small skillet over medium high heat. Add the mushrooms and stir until softened, about 5 minutes. Stir in the honey and tabasco. Stir in the celery salt. Add the cardamon, cumin and black pepper. Toss with your favorite spareribs.

title: Blueberry Appetizers
ingredients: 2 cups fresh blueberries | 1/4 cup plain fat free greek yogurt, or more if necessary ( optional ) | 1/4 cup dried breadcrumbs, or amount suggested by your bread crumbles | 2 tablespoons capers, drained
instructions: In a medium bowl, gently stir together the blueberries and yogurt. In another medium bowl, stir together the bread crumbs and capers. Sprinkle mixture into blueberry mixture, then stir in the capers. Chill in the refrigerator 30 minutes before serving.

title: Homemade Flour Tortillas
ingredients: 1 lb boneless beef chuck, trimmed and cut 1/4-inch slices | 1/2 cup half-and-half
instructions: Place slices onto a paper towel lined large piece of heavy duty aluminum foil and sprinkle on the remaining salt. Roll up the ends of the foil and form a tube on top of it. Wrap the tube tightly in the foil and bake at 375 degrees for about 1 hour, or until very tender and very well cooked. Remove the tube with the foil and cool completely. Cut into about 4 equal chunks. Serve warm, warm, or room temperature.

Random Ingredients: soymilk,green cardamom pod,red cabbage,spinach,philadelphia cream cheese
title: Spinach and Cabbage With No-Yeast Cheese
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs red cabbage, shredded | 8 ounces philadelphia cream cheese, neufchatel cheese or 8 ounces other fat free creamy cheese | 1 container soymilk or 2 % low-fat milk | 8 ounces frozen chopped spinach, thawed and well drained | 1 green cardamom pod, thinly sliced
instructions: Place shredded cabbage in a colander and lightly toss so that they are all moistened. Reserve 1 cup of remaining liquid. Using a food processor combine all remaining ingredients and process to desired consistency.

title: Crock Pot  Noodle Mousse
ingredients: 3/4 cup chopped dried apricot | 2/3 cup double cream | 1/3 cup dried instant porridge or 1/3 cup porridge oats ( use quick cooking method if porridge oats are unavailable ) | 1/2 tablespoon celery seed | 1/4 teaspoon unsweetened cocoa powder | 2 cups cooked rigatoni pasta
instructions: Place chopped apricots and dried porridge oats in crock pot. Whisk cream, cocoa powder and celery seed in a bowl. Stir cream mixture and pour evenly over vegetables. Cook on high until soup and porridge oats are hot and simmering. Turn crock pot on low for 6 to 7 hours or on high for 3 to 5 hours. You may need to take the crock pot off for any reason during the last 5 - 10 minutes of cooking. When finished remove soup from crock pot and stir in cooked rigatoni. Serve in soup plates and top with extra cream.

title: Tobourie in Madeira-Apple Jam
ingredients: 1 baguette | 2 lbs tart apples | 4 ounces dried currants | 1 teaspoon palm sugar | 1/2 cup madeira wine | 2 tablespoons madeira wine | 2 tablespoons softened butter or 2 tablespoons margarine
instructions: Wash and peel apples, cut into eighths then cut into a large thick slice. Scoop out seeds with fork.

Random Ingredients: applesauce,green enchilada sauce,icing sugar,cream corn,lemon zest
title: Green Chili Con Carne!
ingredients: 14 ounces cream-style sweet corn | 2 cans green enchilada sauce | 1/4 cup icing sugar | 2 teaspoons lemon zest | 1/2 cup unsweetened applesauce
instructions: Empty all cans of sweet corn into a large bowl. Dump in the green enchilada sauce and mix well. Add the icing sugar and lemon zest. Stir well until all mixed thoroughly, then stir in applesauce. Spoon sauce over corn and garnish with a sprinkling of cinnamon and/or more cheese if desired.

title: Tofu Taco Cakes II
ingredients: 1 package firm tofu | 1 teaspoon taco seasoning | 3 dashes hot pepper sauce, or to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Cut tofu into squares 2 inches thick. Cut squares into cubes 3/8 to 1/4 inch thick, about 4 squares total. Mix tofu, taco seasoning, and hot pepper sauce together in a bowl. Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat.

title: Penne Pasta with Beef
ingredients: 1 lb boneless beef chuck | 1/2 lb boneless skinless smoked salmon | 1/2 cup dehydrated onion flakes | 1/3 cup dried jalapeno chile, minced | 1 1/2 cups dried penne pasta
instructions: Cut chuck into 1 in cubes. Cut salmon into 1 in chunks. Place in large roaster and sprinkle with onion flakes and chiles. Add 2 cups of water and bring to a boil. Reduce the heat and cover, cook 15 min over med. Heat. Remove cover. Cook 12 min or until water has evaporated and meat is no longer pink. Cook pasta according to package directions and serve.

title: Noodle and Tofu sandwich
ingredients: 6 eggs noodles ( sandwich size ) | 4 tablespoons leeks or 4 tablespoons white onions, chopped | 1 tablespoon yeast or 1 tablespoon instant minced leek | 1 loaf italian bread, crusts trimmed, cut lengthwise | 1/2 cup shredded gruyere cheese | 1 tablespoon anise seed | 10 ounces firm tofu, drained, sliced, cut into 4 equal halves
instructions: Prepare the noodles according to package directions, then drain, reserving the liquid for later if desired. If using yeast, in a large bowl, combine 4 tablespoons of the liquid with the leek and onions. Stir in the bread and set aside. Toast and crumble anise seeds in a dry skillet over medium heat until just beginning to change color, about 3 to 5 minutes. Stir a small amount of the reserved liquid from the drained tofu into the leek mixture, then gently warm. Arrange the tofu, a few slices at a time, on the bottom half of the bread. Spoon on the leek mixture, then top with a layer of the noodles. Repeat in this manner until the bread is used. Sprinkle the top with the cheese and toast the sandwiches over medium heat until cheese melts and begins to brown, being careful not to let it burn. Serve with sliced tomatoes, if desired.

title: Pounded Pork - Giada De Laurentiis
ingredients: 6 slices pork, from the belly attached to the neck | 1/2 cup italian seasoned pork stuffing mix, seasoned with kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper | 1 ripe banana liqueur ( optional ) | 1 sweet italian slice ( optional )
instructions: Place the chicken breasts between two sheets of wax paper and pound them with a meat mallet or rolling pin until they are 1/4 inch thick and about 3/8 inch thick. Spread the pork out on a plate and cut between the two sheets of wax paper into 12 - 12 equal portions. Set aside. Place 1 portion of stuffing stuffing in the center of each portion. Fold the sides of the pork over, then the other portion of stuffing over top of that and make a roll about 2 1/2 inches in diameter. Repeat with another portion of stuffing. Heat the banana liqueur in a small pot over medium heat until warm. Place the roll on a cutting board and cut along the inside of the roll using a wide cut motion to make two identical halves of the roll. If using the sweet italian slice, slice it in half horizontally and use it on top of the rolls. Using a slotted spoon, transfer the roll to a warm platter or serving platter and garnish with sweet italian slices accompanied by a sprig of fresh basil from the garden.

Random Ingredients: anaheim chilies,fish sauce,chili flake,oyster,orange bell pepper,bacon dripping,turmeric,ziti pasta
title: Gai Pad (Ziti) with Fish Sauce
ingredients: 8 ounces ziti pasta or 8 ounces other medium penne pasta | 1/2 cup bacon drippings | 1 large anaheim chilies or 1 large jalapeno pepper, seeded and chopped | 1 tablespoon turmeric | 1 red anaheim chilies or 1 green anaheim chilies, seeded and chopped | 1 orange bell pepper, seeded and chopped or 1 yellow bell pepper | 1 2 teaspoons chili flakes or 2 tablespoons red pepper flakes | 2 tablespoons fish sauce
instructions: Heat bacon drippings over medium heat in a large pot or skillet. Saute peppers.

Random Ingredients: lobster meat,vegetable broth,yellow pepper,russet potato,bread,spring onion,chili oil,coffee
title: Tasty Lobster Soup
ingredients: 500 g lobster meat, cubed | 2 tablespoons sweet chili oil | 1 yellow pepper, diced | 2 tablespoons vegetable broth | 2 cups soft bread, crusts removed, cubed | 2 spring onions, coarsely chopped ( white part only. not green part ) | 3 teaspoons instant coffee | 2 russet potatoes, diced
instructions: In a large pot, heat the chili oil over medium heat and add the cubed lobster meat. Cook, stirring often, until the meat is lightly golden or about 3 minutes longer. Add the yellow pepper, cover, and saute until the pepper is tender and the meat is cooked throughout. Pour the broth and vegetable broth into the pot and bring to a boil. Add the bread, spring onions, and instant coffee. Stir to coat all the slices of bread with the liquid. When the soup comes to a boil, add the potatoes, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes, or until potatoes are tender. Remove the soup from the heat and allow to stand for about 5 minutes. Ladle into 4 bowls.

Random Ingredients: scallion,blue cheese,black olive,italian salad dressing mix,watercress,rye flour,aubergine,sea salt
title: Grilled Hormeh Bakes With Blue Cheese and Scallions
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs very lean ouhi top loaves lee hazelnut rye flour or 1 1/2 lbs hothouse rye bread, cut in half | 1 1/4 pints water or 1 1/4 pints milk | 2 pinches coarse sea salt | 2 pints very fresh watercress | 2 pinches coarse sea salt | 2 pints very fresh black olives, sliced thin | 3 scallions, chopped coarse coarsely | 1 package dried italian salad dressing mix | 1/2 lb blue cheese, crumbled, for topping as desired ( or you can use gorgonzola )
instructions: Preheat the grill or preheat a non sticking sauté pan on medium heat. Cut off all the crusts from the ouhi top loaves. Trim the crusts to about 1½ by 1½ inch size. Set aside in a medium bowl. Wash the ouhi surface in warm water and dry. Pat the ouhi dry with paper towels. If your ouhi surface is dirty, blot it with paper towels, then blot the surface again. Place the ouhi top loaves on the hot grill and grill for about 30 to 35 minutes until the top is brown and crusty. Watch them closely. Remove from the grill and cool. Carefully remove the cheese from the crumb topping and set aside to cool. Remove the crusts from the ouhi tops. Toast the loaves on both sides in a medium hot oven, about 8 to 10 minutes. When both has cooled, slice the loaves into 1 squares and place half on a serving plate and sprinkle with scallions and then crumbled blue cheese. Serve the grilled hommeh bakes warm or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: ham,jasmine rice,kale,beef bouillon cube,tortilla,new potato,bacon dripping
title: Crazy Huey Rice
ingredients: 2 cups jasmine rice | 2 beef bouillon cubes | 4 slices bacon drippings or 4 slices butter | 4 ounces sliced ham | 4 fresh potatoes, diced | 4 -5 fresh kale, sliced | 8 tortillas, warmed
instructions: Put all ingredients in a stock pot that has been sprayed with pam. Bring to boil. Reduce to low and cook for 30 minutes then take off heat and let sit for 20 minutes to absorb the liquid. Serve with warm tortillas and/or veggies.

Random Ingredients: whipping cream,cumin,peanut oil,pesto sauce,onion flake,egg noodle,pistachio,alfredo sauce
title: Egg Noodle Salad Supreme
ingredients: 2 boxes egg noodles, dried | 1 cup whipping cream | 1 box pesto sauce | 2 tablespoons peanut oil | 2 tablespoons dried onion flakes | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 1 jar alfredo sauce ( i've used trader joe's basil ) | 1/2 - 1 cup chopped roasted peanuts
instructions: Put the noodles in to a large pot and cover with plenty of cold water by 1/2 inch or so. Bring to a boil then cook for about 15 20min until cooked and tender. Drain and immediately rinse under cold water until the water runs clear. Drain, and then place in a large bowl. In a medium bowl, mix the cream with pesto. Set aside. In a separate medium sauce pan whisk up the oil and add the onion flakes and cumin. Cook until onion is starting to turn golden. This can take a while. You want it to be sort of brown and nice and bubbly and a little crispy, but not burnt. You shouldn't need to let it get brown or burned. Remove from heat. Add the alfredo and peanut oil to a small bowl. Mix together. Once the noodles have finished cooking, add them to the bowl with the cream sauce and mix well. You can taste and adjust the seasonings, then add the pesto. Mix thoroughly. When all is combined, place into the refrigerator for an hour or more to let the flavors meld. Dish out and scatter on the peanuts before serving. This goes great with crusty bread and a salad too.

title: Cousin Pete's Cafe Risotto
ingredients: 1 package dry yeast | 3 cups arborio rice | 1 tablespoon serrano chili pepper, minced | 1 cup short pasta, cooked ( preferably linguine )
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water. Let sit 10 minutes. Place rice in large serving bowl and sprinkle with serrano pepper. Pour over yeast and set aside at room temperature until it begins to foam and begin to ferment. Pour rice into bowl. Cover bowl with plastic wrap and set aside in a warm location to allow rice and yeast to develop flavors. Punch down rice and knead by hand in bowl until well mixed and supple. Place in lightly greased bowl, cover and let rise in a warm place until doubled in bulk, approximately 45 minutes. Line rimmed baking sheet with aluminum foil, leaving 2 inches between two ovens. Preheat oven to 375 f. Stir arborio rice with a fork or metal spatula and spread in a thin layer. Fold a large tablepoon or two of water into risotto, breaking up lumps. Roll risotto into a loose cylinder and place in a large round glass baking dish, leaving ample space for expansion. Spoon risotto onto baking sheet. With fingertips, press uncooked portion of risotto into rice around edges of baking dish. Repeat with remaining rice, ending with uncooked portions of rice, or press between hands until mixture is nearly immedded into risotto. Carefully remove foil. Place baking dish in oven and bake until rice is light, about 50 minutes. Turn off oven and allow rice to sit in oven 15 minutes longer. Fluff rice again with fork and serve immediately.

title: Superb Beans and Rocket
ingredients: 1 cup vegetable stock | 2 teaspoons adobo sauce, from canned chipotle chile | 5 ounces rocket | 1/4 cup black beans
instructions: Line a large, shallow roasting tin with foil and line the base with baking paper. Bring the stock and chile to the boil in a saucepan then pour into the tray with the rocket. Remove from the heat and stir. Cover with aluminum foil and leave to infuse for 10 minutes. Uncover then spoon over the beans. Return to the oven, then cook for a further 10 mins until the rocket is tender and crunchy.

title: Chili and Romano Chicken
ingredients: 3 lbs frying chickens | 1/2 cup sweet chili paste | 1 tablespoon chili pepper | 1/2 cup romano cheese or 1/2 cup cheese, shredded
instructions: Rinse chicken and pat dry. Slice into 12 pieces. Place chicken in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Mix chili sauce and spice in bowl and pour over chicken. Cover the baking dish with aluminum foil and bake in a preheated 350 oven for 1 hour and 15 minutes or until juices run clear.

title: Vanilla Ice Cream Ice Cream Cake With Egg Yolks
ingredients: 2 tablespoons egg yolks | 1 carton vanilla ice cream
instructions: In bowl of stand mixer fitted with medium speed, beat egg yolks and vanilla ice cream for 5 to 7 minutes, scraping bowl as necessary. Pour mixture into bowl with 1/2 cup ice cream. Cover.

title: Green Curry Paste
ingredients: 2 tablespoons green curry paste | 1 cup chopped preserved lemon verbena | 2 teaspoons wasabi ( japanese seven spice ) | 1/2 teaspoon sugar | 1/2 teaspoon ground wheat germ
instructions: Combine curry paste with lemon verbena, wasabi, sugar and ground wheat germ in a bowl. Enjoy.

title: Pork and Pea Rongol
ingredients: 350 g pork, cut in half lengthways, then sliced | 50 g pineapple chunks | 100 g green peas, frozen | 1/2 small tomatoes, chopped | 2 teaspoons chopped oat | 1/2 teaspoon tomato puree
instructions: In a pan of boiling water, sauté pork. Add pineapple, peas, tomatoes and oat. Cook for 5 minutes. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Serve with pasta.

title: Peas-Black-Eyed Peas and Leeks
ingredients: 1 lb dried split peas | 2 cups cold water | 1 cup cottage cheese | 1 large leek or 2 medium leeks, white and light green parts only, cut into half-inch pieces | 1/2 - 3/4 cup whole canned black-eyed peas, rinsed and drained
instructions: Rinse the peas several times over to remove any salt. In large saucepan with tight fitting lid, combine the water, cottage cheese and the leek or scallion, split peas, water and black eyed peas. Bring to a boil over medium high heat, stirring once or twice. Reduce heat to low. Cover and simmer 1 hour. Stir once or twice during cooking to ensure even cooking. When peas and leeks are tender, remove from heat and transfer to a serving dish, leaving about 1/4 inch of clear liquid in the saucepan. Taste and adjust seasoning. Cool to room temperature. When the refrigerated portion of the dish, the peas and leeks should be hot, heated through and the cottage cheese coated. If desired, serve with bread or toast.

title: Wicklewood’s Chicken
ingredients: 4 chicken breast fillets, skin on | 1 ounce rice vinegar
instructions: Preheat grill to high and heat griddle pan and spray with oil. Place chicken on griddle pan and skin side up. Cook until skin has just darkened and flesh is cooked. Place on a serving platter. Drizzle with rice vinegar and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: raspberry,cajun seasoning,basil leaf,red chilies,dark sesame oil,cauliflower floret,italian parsley
title: Grilled Raspberries and Cauliflower
ingredients: 2 raspberries | 2 small red chilies | 1/2 teaspoon dark sesame oil | 1/4 teaspoon fresh basil leaf | 1/4 teaspoon fresh italian parsley | 2 heads cauliflower florets | 1/2 teaspoon cajun seasoning
instructions: Cut raspberries in half and remove the juice. Cut raspberries into thirds. Cut chili and chillies in half.
