Combine all ingredients except the cauliflower and cajun seasoning in a large bowl. Add cauliflower and mix well. Cover and marinate for at least 2 hours in the fridge but no more than 1 hour. Heat grill on high and lightly oil the grate. Remove from the marinade and place into the cauliflower halves. Grill for 3 - 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: sirloin tip roast,hard egg,cilantro,chili flake,salsa,cornstarch,worcestershire sauce
title: Tex-Mex Beef Skillet
ingredients: 1 tablespoon chili flakes | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 1 3/4 lbs sirloin tip roast, trimmed of fat and cut into 1/2-inch slices | 2 hard-boiled eggs, sliced | 1 cup salsa | 2 tablespoons reduced-sodium worcestershire sauce | 2 tablespoons finely chopped cilantro
instructions: Combine the chili flakes, cornstarch and 2 tbls water in a shallow bowl. Add half of the roast and turn to coat. Heat a 10 inch nonstick skillet over medium high heat 1 minute. Add the meat and cook, stirring with a fork or wooden spool to separate the slices evenly, until no longer pink, about 8 minutes for rare or more if you are using chuck roast. Transfer to a bowl.

Random Ingredients: sharp cheddar cheese,radish,fire tomato,chicken bouillon granule,allspice,heavy whipping cream
title: Cheesy Radish & Smoked Tomato Soup
ingredients: 1 cup heavy whipping cream | 2 tablespoons instant chicken bouillon granules | 1/2 teaspoon allspice | 4 large radishes, thinly sliced | 1/2 lb smoked sharp cheddar cheese, diced | 4 medium fresh hot fresh hot fire-roasted tomatoes, chopped
instructions: In a 2 to 3 qt. Saucepan, combine cream with bouillon and allspice. Over medium heat bring to boil. Add diced radishes.

Random Ingredients: wheat bread crumb,fine sea salt,ramen noodle
title: Baked Eggs and Ramen
ingredients: 24 large free range rambox noodles | 1 1/4 cups fine sea salt | 1 large whole grain bread crumb
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 degrees celcius. Rinse the rambox and set aside. Place rambox in a bowl and add sea salt and bread crumbs. Stir until moist and evenly covered. Using a teaspoon, fill ramen molds about halfway full of the ramen mixture and place on a baking tray. Bake for 15 minutes, flipping once and sprinkling with a little extra sea salt when done. Serve immediately.

title: Oyako Donburi (Wonton)
ingredients: 2 thick slices white bread, about 2 inches square | 2 bunches bok choy, leaves cut from stem, cleaned and shredded
instructions: Place the bread and bok choy leaves on wooden skewers, alternating between the pieces of bread and green choy. Lightly brush the tops with water to prevent them sticking, and grill over high heat for 2 minutes. Carefully slip the skewers off the skewers, and serve on separate plates with a wedge of katsuobushi for dipping.

Random Ingredients: ranch dressing,potato,dark sesame oil,brown sugar,yellow onion,swiss cheese
title: French Quarter Sweet Potato Salad
ingredients: 1 package simply potatoes diced potatoes | 1/2 cup white swiss cheese, shredded | 1/2 cup diced yellow onion | 1 tablespoon light brown sugar | 1 1/2 teaspoons dark sesame oil | 1/3 cup ranch dressing
instructions: Diced up the potatoes into 1 inch cubes, toss lightly in 1 tbsp. Shred the swiss cheese into the potato mixture. Combine brown sugar, sesame oil and ranch dressing in a small bowl and pour over the potatoes. Stir gently. Refrigerate covered for an hour or longer before serving to allow flavors to develop. Serve with a salad for a complete meal. Enjoy.

title: Tahini Applesauce
ingredients: 5 apples, peeled cored and sliced | 1/3 cup tahini
instructions: Place apple slices in a bowl. Pour tahini over apples.

title: Spanish Rice & Salsa-Fried Carrots
ingredients: 4 tablespoons oil | 1 lb carrot, cut to thin matchsticks or 1 lb jalapeno pepper, seeded | 1 cup bottled salsa, heat | 3/4 cup red wine vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon chicken bouillon ( i used homemade, but in a pinch any kind would do ) | 1 tablespoon ground coriander
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large skillet or wok. When the oil shimmers, add the carrots. Stir a few times, adding the peppers when they begin to soften. Mix well, add the salsa and stir again.. Cook about 3 minutes, stir. Add the chicken bouillon and the ground coriander, cook just a minute, add rice, cook about 30 seconds, stirring, then remove from heat if it starts to stick. Serve w/biscuits/breads.

title: Easy Beef & Dumplings
ingredients: 1 lb ground meat | 2 cups bisquick baking mix | 2 tablespoons vinegar
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl. Roll into golf ball size balls. Fry in large skillet over medium high heat until lightly browned on both sides. Serve.

Random Ingredients: mango chutney,red chilies,vegetable oil cooking spray
title: Chutney Mango Chips
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 2 medium red chilies, chopped ( i use red-ripe jalapeno ) | 1/4 cup mango chutney
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Coat a baking sheet with cooking spray spray. In small bowl, combine the chilies, chutney and mango chutney. Mix well. Spread mixture between a single layer on baking sheet. Bake in middle of oven 2 - 3 minutes or until golden and crispy.

title: Beetroot Apple Crumble
ingredients: 4 medium beets, about 3 pounds | 2 medium apples, about 3 pounds | 1/2 cup flour | 1/2 teaspoon orange zest, grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Cut beets into six wedges. Remove and discard outer leaves from beets and scrub with a cloth. Place wedges side by side in a pan and fill with enough water to cover the vegetables. Bake in the preheated oven until tender, approximately 40 minutes. Drain water from beets and place in a food processor.

title: Ginger Mint Tingler (Gardai Ginger Mint Chutney)
ingredients: 1 bunch ginger | 1 bunch fresh mint leaves, washed
instructions: Finely mince the ginger and remove the pulp. Place a large, heavy bottomed pan over medium heat. When the pan is hot, pour in the ginger and fry for several minutes. Add mint leaves and continue to fry for about two minutes. Till the leaves smell aromatic and turn light brown, pour this into the pot and stir the mint mixture to mix in the mint leaves. This takes about 45 seconds to 1 hour to blend all the flavors.

Random Ingredients: green bean,thyme,wine vinegar,brandy,red potato,vegetable oil cooking spray
title: Red Potatoes With Beans (21 Day Wonder Diet: Day 7)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons reduced-sodium vegetable oil flavored cooking spray | 1 1/3 lbs red potatoes, cut into 4cm pieces | 1/4 cup wine vinegar ( or lemon juice ) | 1/3 cup brandy, warmed ( or cognac ) | 1 teaspoon ground thyme | 200 g string green beans, trimmed | 2 teaspoons vegetable oil ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c or 180c fan forced. Spray large shallow 2 cup capacity ovenproof dish with oil. Place potatoes in a medium bowl and spray with oil. Sauté, toss or turn over after 2 minutes. Place in a single layer on a baking tray. Roast, stirring occasionally, for 15 minutes or until golden, tossing and rearranging after 5 minutes. Meanwhile, combine vinegar, brandy and thyme in a bowl. Remove pot from oven. Arrange potatoes on top. Spoon any juices that have collected on the baking tray into a small saucepan. Bring to the boil and simmer, uncovered, for 15 minutes or until sauce thickens slightly. Pour over potato and beans.

Random Ingredients: coconut milk,rose water,scallion,acinus di pepe pasta
title: Ridiculous Low Fat Pasta Bowl
ingredients: 1/4 cup fat-free sweetened coconut milk | 1 teaspoon dried porcini di pepe pasta | 1 teaspoon low sodium scallion ( finely chopped ) | 1/2 teaspoon rose water
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to boil. Add coconut milk, peperoncinis, scallion, and rose water. Cook 8 minutes. Drain pasta and serve.

title: Fish Stock Bombay
ingredients: 2 cups fish stock ( or other flavourless fish stock ) | 1 teaspoon curry paste ( i use mild or hot depending on your taste ) | 1 tablespoon whiskey
instructions: Wash the fish and remove any bones or scales preventing the fish from falling off the bones. Put the stock in a saucepan and bring to the boil/toast. Add the curry paste and whiskey. Keep the heat on to medium low and simmer a few minutes. Add the fish to the hot stock. Mix well and serve.

title: Chilies and Onions on Toast
ingredients: 20 -25 corn tortillas | 1/2 onion ( chopped ) | 1 can of chopped chilies | 1 pint irish cream | 1 pint flour tortilla
instructions: Preheat oven to 250°c. In a bowl mix together chilies, cream and onions. Spray a baking dish with butter and place 3 tortillas face up. Pour in chile mixture and spread evenly. Place 2 tortillas face down and place on top and cover with foil. Bake 2 hours. Cut crosswise 3/4th inch thick slices to serve.

title: Easy Restaurant Style  Cilantro Croutons
ingredients: 1 cup graham cracker crumbs | 1 - 1 1/2 cup finely shredded low-fat lettuce leaf | 1 -2 tablespoon finely chopped fresh cilantro leaves
instructions: Preheat your oven to 325°f. Mix the crumbs with the lettuce, cilantro and seasoning. Add more if necessary to form into a slightly sticky ball. Spread the crumb mixture on a cookie sheet and lightly coat. Using a pastry cutter, cut as many croutons as needed for round circles. Bake for about 20 minutes, or until golden. Serve immediately.

title: Green Peas and Mushrooms
ingredients: 2 packages frozen green peas, thawed | 1/4 cup chicken stock | 1 package sliced fresh mushrooms | seasoning salt to taste
instructions: Place the peas, stock, mushrooms and seasoning salt in a saucepan, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat, cover, and simmer 15 minutes, or until the peas are tender. Serve hot over rice.

title: Swiss Onion Soup
ingredients: 1 tablespoon unsalted butter or 1 tablespoon margarine | 12 -16 ounces swiss cheese, shredded | 1 teaspoon dried marjoram | 1/2 cup buttermilk | 1 spanish onion, coarsely chopped
instructions: In a heavy small saucepan melt butter, then add the onion.

Random Ingredients: curry powder,red capsicum,red chili pepper,cheddar cheese,pearl barley,baby clam,greek yogurt
title: BBQ Chilli & Celtic Clam Bake
ingredients: 1 red capsicum, chopped | 1 red chili pepper, finely chopped | 125 g baby clams, drained | 125 g pearl barley, cooked, rinsed & drained | 400 g greek yogurt | 1 tablespoon curry powder | 1 tablespoon cheddar cheese, grated
instructions: Preheat the grill to high. Mix together the chilli, capsicum and baby clams in a shallow baking dish. Combine the barley, yoghurt, curry powder & red chilli powder in a bowl, then pour over the dressing. Toss to combine then sprinkle over the cheese.

title: Creamed Calzones
ingredients: 1/4 cup salsa | 1 pinch kelp ( optional ) | 1 cup dry bread crumbs, divided | 1 teaspoon chopped pickled ginger ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. In a medium bowl, mix salsa, klp and bread crumbs. Remove kelp. Sprinkle meat with salt and pepper. Sprinkle with ginger to taste. Spoon mixture onto a slice of bread. Roll tightly. Place in a small baking dish. Bake 20 minutes in the preheated oven, then turn over, sprinkle with remaining crumbs, and bake 5 minutes more.

title: White Seaweed Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs asparagus tips, trimmed, cut into 3/4-inch pieces | 2 lbs mixed greens ( baby spinach, washed, stems removed, and spun dry or just dry ) | 1 cup frozen mixed vegetables, thawed, cut into 1/2 inch pieces | 2 tablespoons white wine vinegar
instructions: Place asparagus in a bowl. Scatter around the vegetables and toss together. Cover and refridgerate for at least 1 hour or until cold. Just before serving toss in the vinegar.

title: Balsamic Mushrooms
ingredients: 16 ounces button mushrooms | 1/4 cup balsamic vinegar
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees. Place mushrooms in an 8x8 x3 baking dish.

Random Ingredients: saltine cracker,serrano chile pepper,mayonnaise,wheat flour,hamburger bun,red lentil,cognac
title: Red Lentil and Swiss Roll-Up Burger
ingredients: 1/3 cup mayonnaise ( i use hellman's, or miracle whip ) | 2 serrano chile peppers, seeded and minced fine ( about 1/2 tablespoon ) | 1 1/2 cups red lentils, drained and rinsed | 1/4 cup cognac ( optional ) | 1/8 teaspoon saltine crackers, crushed | 1 cup shredded swiss hamburger buns | 1 serrano chile pepper, seeded and minced fine
instructions: In mixing bowl, stir together mayonnaise, chili peppers, lentils, cognac, and salt. Form into 4 patties. Grill or broil burgers to desired doneness, about 5 minutes per side, or until desired doneness, and transfer to a serving plate. Serve hot. Note, i like to spread the mayonnaise mixture with a little black pepper on each burger before cooking the rest of them. For dipping sauce, sprinkle with chopped chiles just before serving. Serve with the toppings of your choice.

title: Shrimp and Apple Apples
ingredients: 5 medium tart apples, peeled cored and sliced | 1 1/2 teaspoons shrimp paste | 1 small fresh chives, chopped | 2 shiitake mushrooms, sliced | 3 tablespoons slivered almonds, toasted and chopped
instructions: Put apples in a salad bowl, add shrimp paste and chives and toss. Top with almonds and toss again.

Random Ingredients: cannellini bean,walnut,beef bouillon cube,chili pepper,pineapple ring,rice
title: Beef, Bean, Rice Dish in a Hurry
ingredients: 2 lbs lean ground beef or 2 lbs cooked pork | 3 cups cooked rice | 1 can cannellini beans ( rinsed and drained ) | 1 -2 tablespoon finely chopped chili pepper | 1 teaspoon instant beef bouillon cube, dissolved | pineapple ring, for garnish | finely chopped walnuts, for garnish
instructions: Heat oven to 350 degrees. Spray a 15x10x1 pan with cooking spray and set aside. In a skillet, mix together the beef or pork, rice, beans, pepper, and the dissolved beef bouillon. Drain cooked rice and bean mixture from the cans onto the bottom of the pan.. Stir hamburger mixture into mixture in pan. Bake, uncovered, for 1 hour, stirring twice during baking.

title: Zucchini With Sangria (Rachael Ray)
ingredients: 1 large zucchini, coarsely grated on the large holes of a box grater ( about 3/4 cup ) | 1 1/4 cups sparkling wine, chilled until cold, about 10 minutes
instructions: In a large colander, toss the zucchini with the grated zucchini. Place the grated zucchini into a large shallow serving dish and, working quickly, push some of the zucchini into the sparkling wine so that it is fully submerged. Let the zucchini absorb the wine, about 10 minutes. Let the zucchini cool, uncovered, about 1 hour. Transfer to a food processor or blender and add the remaining sparkling wine and the reserved zucchini. Pulse until the zucchini are pureed, about 20 seconds.

title: Sweet and Spicy Fruit Kebabs
ingredients: 500 g seedless red chili | 120 g cornflour | 4 tablespoons taco seasoning | 2 tablespoons maple syrup | 1 tablespoon red chili | 2 cups dried raspberries in light syrup | 1/3 cup shredded bean sprouts
instructions: Cut the chillies into 1cm thick slices. Slice the chillies into thin strips. Mix the cornflour, taco seasoning and half the maple syrup together. Add to the chillies and stir, making sure the cornflour mixture is well mixed. Toss the fruit with the marinade and thread onto skewers. Grill the kebabs on the bbq plate or bbq basting with the marinade. Serve with fruit, salad and salsa.

title: Grpa's Shrimp in a Grape Leaf
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs large shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1 cup of large shrimp-grape leaf, washed and trimmed | 10 teaspoons of pepitas mixed cumin seeds | 1 teaspoon whole cumin seed | 1/2 cup ice water
instructions: Place the large shrimp in a pot and cover with water. Bring to a boil. Cook for 15 minutes. Drain and reserve cooking water of the shrimp. Add 1 cup of grape leaves and half of the cumin seeds to the shrimp and broth. Cover and simmer for 1 hour and 20 minutes. Remove the shrimp and shrimp. Place remaining 5 cups of grapes in a pot with 1/2 cup of reserved cooking liquid and all the other spices. Bring to a boil and reduce heat to simmer. Cover the pot and simmer for 3 to 4 minutes. Remove from the heat and serve.

Random Ingredients: mustard seed,curry powder,vanilla sugar,ghee,pepperoni,couscous,sherry wine vinegar
title: Spiced Pepperoni Salad
ingredients: 200 g couscous | 100 g pepperoni | 150 g greek yogurt or 150 g sour cream | 2 tablespoons sherry wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons mustard seeds | 2 tablespoons vanilla sugar | pepperoni, slices to garnish
instructions: Prepare the couscous by following the directions on the packet. Rinse the pepperoni. Cut it in half lengthways, lengthways and crossways. Put the couscous and pepperoni into a large bowl. Pour boiling water in a microwave proof bowl. Cover and stand for 1 minute until the water just absorbed. Remove from microwave and stand for 2 minutes. Add the cooked pepperoni, soured cream and sherry vinegar. Dressing combine chill the dressing and pour over salad just before serving.

title: Ziti Haluski
ingredients: 1 lb ground chuck | 1 cup kernel corn | 1 tablespoon capers packed in salt | 1 tablespoon canola oil | 1 package ziti pasta, cooked and drained | 1 can cornbread
instructions: Preheat oven to in a large skillet cook ground chuck and set aside. In same skillet put corn, capers and oil. Cook and toss in ziti. Combine all 3 ingredients and spread in a 9x13 baking dish. Bake for 15 - 35 minutes, until ziti is golden brown.

title: Chilled Black Tea
ingredients: 2 tablespoons black tea ( strong black tea ) | 1/2 yellow bell pepper, thinly sliced
instructions: Using your finger, rub one side of pepper slices evenly against the surface of your tea. When the black pepper has been rubbed, move it to your left side of the pepper. Leave pepper in the tea. You may now serve this tea on a rocks bed, with a sprinkling of sugar, if desired.

Random Ingredients: white bread,amarula cream liqueur,chili powder,cherry pie filling
title: Amarula Cherry Chimichangas
ingredients: 1 cup cherry pie filling ( kalamee ) | 1 slice white bread | 1 teaspoon chili powder | 1/2 teaspoon amarula cream liqueur
instructions: Remove crust from each slice of bread and place the slices under the broiler to light the crust. Place 1/2 teaspoon of chili powder in a small jar with a lid. Heat the cherry pie filling in a skillet set over medium heat, until the liquid just begins to bubble around the sides of the jam. Remove from heat and remove hot cherry from heat. Spread each slice of bread with the kalamee and top with a cherry.

title: Caribbean Potatoes
ingredients: 5 medium potatoes | 1/4 cup teriyaki sauce ( or other soy sauce ) | 1 cup chopped watermelon ( optional )
instructions: Peel and dice potatoes and steam potatoes until tender. Place in a serving bowl. Combine teriyaki sauce and watermelon with potato mixture.

Random Ingredients: rye flour,italian salad dressing,harissa,cream cheese,thyme sprig,cooking spray,cumin,vanilla extract
title: Tunisian White Pizza
ingredients: 2 tablespoons quick-cooking spray | 1/2 teaspoon harissa | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin | 1 container low-fat cream cheese | 1/4 teaspoon dried thyme sprig | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1 teaspoon italian-style salad dressing | 4 1/4 cups rye flour or 4 1/4 cups all-purpose flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f set rack in center of oven and heat oven to 400°f spray and flour 4 pizza pans. Combine harissa, cumin, cream cheese, thyme, vanilla and italian style salad dressing in medium bowl.

title: Kielbasa & Kielbasa Rissoles
ingredients: 1 cup of chopped brown rice | 1 cup quinoa | 1 lb kielbasa sausage | 500 g of ground lamb ( optional ) or 500 g ground beef | 1 teaspoon cayenne powder | 1 teaspoon cardamom or 1 teaspoon paprika | 3 drops cayenne powder | 1 cup whole wheat flour
instructions: First of all, rinse & put the rice, quinoa & italian herbs into a large bowl. Heat a large frying pan until very hot, add the kielbasa or beef & cook for a few minutes, breaking it up as it cooks, until meat is browned. If desired, add a can of kielbasa flavored with spices & spices. When done, drain the grease of the pan, then add the meat & rice to the pan & mix thoroughly. Then add the cayenne and the cardamon. Mix again & let it sit for a five minutes or so, mixing it a bit when you stir, you will see some liquid, so if it needs more of that liquid, then you can pour it up or down in the pan & serve immediately.

title: Orange Turkey Tenderloin
ingredients: 2 small turkey breast tenderloins ( about 2 pounds, may buy frozen cut into portions ) | 1 medium orange | 1 jar sliced pimientos, drained | 1 teaspoon turmeric | 1 teaspoon red pepper flakes ( or to taste )
instructions: Cut orange in half.

Random Ingredients: swiss cheese,wonton wrapper,chicken,baking soda,vegetable stock,shrimp paste
title: Crispy Shrimp Dumplings
ingredients: 1 quart vegetable stock | 1 tablespoon shrimp paste | 1 whole cooked chicken, cut into small pieces | 1 piece swiss cheese, shredded | 20 round wonton wrappers, lightly salted, but not soggy | 1 teaspoon baking soda
instructions: In a large pot, simmer stock and shrimp paste in the hot stock. Add chicken pieces and bring to a boil.

title: Persian Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 3/4 cup peanut oil | 2 1/2 tablespoons cider vinegar | 1/2 cup crushed pistachios
instructions: In medium saucepan, combine the peanut oil, vinegar, and peanuts. Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, for 5 minutes. Stir in warm peppers, remove from heat, and let sit for 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: orange juice zest,prune,garlic clove,sage leaf,chili,thyme,grape tomato
title: Prune Stuffed Grape Tomatoes
ingredients: 4 grape tomatoes | 2 tablespoons prunes ( pitted ) | 1 teaspoon mint | 1 garlic clove ( minced ) | 1 teaspoon lime juice ( freshly squeezed ) | 1/2 teaspoon thyme | 1 large chili ( chopped )
instructions: Cut a slice on the bottom of the tomato if you wish, to reveal the core and remove the seeds. If you use a grape tomato scoop out the core of the tomato and keep the core in tact. Chop the reserved pulp. Combine the pulp with remaining ingredients. Stuffed tomatoes should be about 1½” thick and placed on a tray. Place under broiler until the tops just begin to turn golden and puffed slightly.

title: Warm Spinach and Okra Sauce
ingredients: 1/3 pound fresh okra, cut into 1/2-inch slices | 1 cup baby spinach leaves | 1/3 cup heavy cream | 1/2 cup oyster sauce
instructions: Place spinach and okra in a large bowl. Cover with ice water and toss gently to remove moisture. Set aside. Heat cream and oyster sauce together in a skillet over low heat. Cook the spinach mixture and okra until heated through, 2 to 5 minutes.

title: Pixie Rainforest
ingredients: 1 lb boneless chicken thigh fillet, sliced into bite sized pieces | 2 cups pumpkin, cubed ( i used yukon gold but they were very nice ) | 2 cups sorrel, chopped ( i used red sorrel and had a hothouse mix ) | 1 cup picante sauce ( the best brand i had ever come across ) | 1 tablespoon hoisin sauce | 1/2 cup pineapples, quartered ( i only used 1 cup ) | 1/2 cup pistachios, coarsely chopped | saffron rice ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients except rice in crockpot and cook on low for 8 - 10 hours. Stir and serve over rice.

Random Ingredients: pork sparerib,pineapple juice,brown rice,coconut extract,golden raisin,chervil
title: Sticky Bun
ingredients: 2 1/2 - 3 lbs pork spareribs | 1 cup brown rice | 2 tablespoons coconut extract | 2 tablespoons candied chervil or 2 tablespoons parsley, finely chopped | 1/3 cup golden raisin | 2 tablespoons pineapple juice
instructions: Place ribs in a large saucepan and cover with water. Bring to a boil, then cover again and reduce heat to low. Simmer for 25 minutes or until ribs are tender. Using 2 forks or a slotted spoon, skim off any fat residue. Transfer ribs to a large bowl, reserving marinade. Bring reserved marinade to a boil in a small saucepan over high heat. Slowly cook until reduced to 1 cup, stirring occasionally. Stir in rice, coconut extract, chervil or parsley. Add raisins and pineapple juice. Remove syrup from heat. Ladle hot syrup into a serving dish and serve immediately, dipping ribs in the pan to coat with sauce. Garnish with chervil or parsley.

title: Homemade Mocha Nita for the Microwave
ingredients: 12 kalamata olives | 4 tablespoons instant coffee granules, powder | 1 tablespoon chili flakes | 1 teaspoon nori, powder
instructions: Place the kalamata olives in a glass and microwave on high power level for 1 1/2 minutes. Stir to see if it is ready. Add the instant coffee powder and mix well. Place the nori in a glass bowl and sprinkle both sides with the chili flakes. Microwave on high for 1 second. Do not overcook. Remove and garnish with the chopped kalamata olives. Eat and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: cooking apple,dark rum,herbes de provence,rotini pasta,sprinkle,thyme sprig
title: Cannel Mac and Cheese
ingredients: 1 lb uncooked rotini pasta | 1 cooking apple, peeled, cored and coarsely chopped | salt and pepper | 1/2 teaspoon herbes de provence ( plus a pinch of dried thyme ) | 1/4 - 1/2 cup dark rum ( preferably cognac ) | fresh thyme sprig ( to garnish )
instructions: Cook and drain pasta as directed on package. Meanwhile combine apple, salt, pepper, herbes de provence and rum. Set aside and keep warm. Drain pasta and stir into apple mixture. Garnish with thyme sprigs.

title: Skewered Chilli Pork Hamburgers
ingredients: 2 tablespoons red wine | 1 tablespoon milo | 1 tablespoon mustard powder | 1 clove garlic, crushed | 2 skewers
instructions: Combine all ingredients and marinate the steaks for 20 minutes. Heat a grill or bbq plate until very hot, add the meat and cook 4 - 5 minutes. Turn and cook 6 - 8 minutes or until cooked to your liking.

Random Ingredients: agar,vegetable stock,coconut milk,garbanzo bean,banana pepper,greek yogurt,green pepper
title: Easy Banana Pepper Bean Soup
ingredients: 1 small green pepper, chopped | 1 small banana pepper, chopped | 1 can garbanzo beans, drained | 20 ounces vegetable stock | 1/4 cup coconut milk | 1 teaspoon agar-agar | 10 ounces fat free greek yogurt
instructions: In a large pot, add all ingredients except yogurt and cook on medium heat until pepper is tender. Add yogurt and mix. Cook for ten more minutes. Serve in soup bowls.

title: Pesto Pasta With Lingines
ingredients: 2 tablespoons shortening | 1/2 cup pesto sauce, buitoni ( use one store bought and one that's in tube ) | 1 cup dried linguine or 1 cup thin spaghetti | 2 tablespoons minced fresh thyme sprigs | 1/4 teaspoon crushed dried vanilla bean ( or to taste )
instructions: Heat shortening in heavy large skillet over high heat. Add pesto.

Random Ingredients: hot paprika,pork loin chop,thai basil,salt black pepper,sesame oil,gruyere cheese,half cream
title: Pork Chops with Gruyere and Sesame Cream Sauce
ingredients: 6 pork loin chops | 1 teaspoon sesame oil | 1 bunch thai basil | salt and ground black pepper to taste | 1 tablespoon hot smoked paprika | 1 tablespoon gruyere cheese, shredded | 1/2 cup half-and-half cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Spread sesame oil into the bottom of a large baking dish or roasting pan. Rinse and dry basil leaves. Layer pork chops into the dish, cutting off any excess. Season with paprika, salt and pepper. Drizzle half and half cream atop the pork chops. Bake until pork chops are cooked through and tender, about 45 minutes.

Random Ingredients: pineapple,tart apple,peach,bell pepper,black eyed pea,japanese eggplant,kaffir lime leaf,frying chicken
title: Island Chicken and Bean Stir-Fry
ingredients: 1 lb frying chicken, cut into 1-inch pieces | 6 ounces black-eyed peas | 2 ounces japanese eggplants | 6 ounces carrots, cut into long thin strips | 6 ounces small pink peaches, cut in halves | 6 ounces tart apples, cut into thin wedges | fresh pineapple, halved | japanese eggplants | kaffir lime leaves
instructions: To make the stir fry, in a wok or large frying pan, add the oil, and saute the chicken until brown on all sides but still white. Add the black eyed peas, Japanese eggplant, and carrots, and stir fry for about 1 minute. Add the orange wedges and pineapple, and stir fry for another minute or so to warm through. Serve the chicken and vegetables over rice.

title: Baked Tortellini
ingredients: 1 can white mushrooms, drained and sliced | 1 ounce soya sauce | 3 3/4 lbs cheese tortellini
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. In large bowl combine mushrooms, soya sauce and two thirds of the tortellini and mix. Place mixture in large casserole dish about 1 inch depth. Cover with remaining tortellini. Bake covered for 40 minutes, uncover and bake for about 15 more minutes or until hot and bubbling.

title: Jicama and Pineapple Salad
ingredients: 2 jicama, peeled and cut into � inch batons | 3 tablespoons tahini, stirred | 1/4 cup tahini ( sesame paste ) | 1/4 cup plain nonfat yogurt | 2 tablespoons minced fresh thyme | 1 cup crushed pineapple, packed in water
instructions: Dice the jicama into � inch dice, about 3 cups. Toss the jicama in 2 tb. Butter in a large bowl. Place the tahini, tahini, 1/4 cup butter, yogurt and thyme in a blender. Process until smooth. Fold jicama into the yogurt mixture. Cover and refrigerate at least 5 hours and up to 8 hours or overnight.

title: Beef and Mango Couscous
ingredients: 800 g ground beef gravy | 200 g medium diced mangoes | 2 tablespoons white flour | 200 g couscous | 1/2 cup couscous
instructions: Combine all ingredients and set aside for 30 - 45 minutes to allow flavour to develop. Cook the couscous in a sauce pan of boiling water for 5 minutes or until tender. Combine beef and gravy and heat through.

title: Jalapeno and Coconut Sorbet
ingredients: 150 ml coconut milk | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1 -2 jalapeno, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon rice vinegar, plus a little extra | water or milk | 2 teaspoons finely grated gingerroot | 1 -2 teaspoon dried marjoram
instructions: To prepare the ice cream, in a metal bowl, dissolve the cream of tartar in a splash of very warm water, for about 10 seconds, until it foams. Immediately pour the hot liquid into a blender, and add the rest of the ingredients. Cover and blend for about 15 - 20 seconds until the mixture is smooth. Place in the freezer for at least 10 minutes, or up to an hour. To serve, break off chunks of ice and tip into serving dishes with the slushies. Drizzle with extra olive oil and sprinkle with salt and pepper.

Random Ingredients: peanut butter,celery,kalamata olive,wheat flour,seasoning salt,olive oil
title: Mediterranean Flat Bread (Filled)
ingredients: 2 cups wheat flour | 1/3 cup olive oil or 1/3 cup canola oil | 2 tablespoons peanut butter | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1/4 cup chopped celery ( for topping ) | 1/4 cup chopped pitted kalamata olive
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a large bowl and form into a flat shape. Wrap in waxed paper and refrigerate for minimum of 2 hours. Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Roll out dough on a floured surface, using a cookie cutter or a rolling pin to cut rounds. Bake for about 15 minutes or until the bottoms are lightly golden. Keep a watch on these thinish bottoms as they can be extremely hot.

title: Gobel Mogel Mogel (Bake Mixture)
ingredients: 1 package ketchup | 3 -4 tablespoons dashi | 1 tablespoon vanilla or 1 tablespoon lemon juice | 3 tablespoons ketchup | diced anaheim chili, to taste | diced cheddar cheese, to taste
instructions: Toast the bottom and sides of a casserole or cookie sheet. In a small bowl, mix ketchup, vanilla or lemon juice, and ketchup. Dish kobelmakkeh onto warm oven proof platters. Fill center of the platter with a heaping tablespoon of cheese, then sprinkle with minced chilies and/or chopped up green onions. Microwave for 30 seconds or two to melt cheese. Top with a dollop of tomato ketchup.

Random Ingredients: nut almond,active yeast,yam,pineapple chunk juice,picante sauce,thai red curry paste
title: Yam Roll
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups picante sauce | 3 3/4 teaspoons active dry yeast | 1 cup yams, peeled, cooked, mashed or grated | 1 tablespoon thai red curry paste | 1 1/2 cups pineapple chunks in juice | 1/2 cup nuts, chopped
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients in a bowl, stirring well to dissolve yeast. Beat well. Stir in mashed yams, curry paste, pineapple, and nuts. Turn onto a well floured surface, knead to form a smooth, elastic dough. Place in a greased bowl, cover, and let rise in a warm place until double in bulk. Bake at 375°f for 1 hour or until well risen and golden brown.

Random Ingredients: hash brown,garlic salt,fine salt,nonfat cream,tomato soup,pinto bean,cool whip
title: Easy Texas Hash Brown Casserole
ingredients: 4 cups frozen hash browns, thawed ( about 50 or 60, depending on which type of hash browns you use ) | 1 can condensed tomato soup | 0.5 can nonfat sour cream ( regular or low fat ) | 1 jar cool whip | 1/2 teaspoon fine salt | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt | 1 teaspoon crushed dry instant garlic or 1 teaspoon dried garlic
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Grease an 11 x 7 inch baking dish. In a small bowl combine the potato, soup, sour cream, cool whip, salt, garlic salt and dried garlic. Pour into baking dish and bake for 45 to 55 minutes or until top is hot and topping has crisped up a bit. Remove from oven and serve.

title: Pesto Macaroni and Cheese
ingredients: 2 cups cooked elbow macaroni | 1/2 cup crumbled cotija cheese | 1 package fresh frozen phyllo pastry, thawed ( found in the frozen desserts section of your groceys )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Combine cooked macaroni, cheese, and frozen phyllo pastry in a bowl to combine. Cut stack in half lengthwise, stack 3 sheets in a large baking dish. Fill dough and top with macaroni mixture. Sprinkle with remaining cheese. Cover with aluminum foil. Bake 25 minutes. Let stand for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Homemade Mincemeat  (Mincemeat)
ingredients: 4 lbs mincemeat, of choice | 1 teaspoon dried thyme ( or more, to taste )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Melt fat in 4 quart pan or dutch oven over medium heat until it just begins to haze. Add thyme and mincemeat. Brown until well mixed and dry. Transfer mince mixture to baking dish or platter. Insert 1/2 teaspoon of salt between mincemeat and crumbs. Pour off excess oil. Sprinkle remaining salt on top, if desired. Bake, uncovered in oven 20 minutes, or just until top is brown and top is light tan. Remove mincemeat to a serving platter and let cool.

title: Barley and Apricots over Hot-Seeded Apricots
ingredients: 200 g pearl barley | 4 green onions, cut in 2 | 4 -5 dried apricots, chopped | 1 -2 teaspoon pickled jalapeno chile, crushed | 1 -2 teaspoon rosemary ( optional )
instructions: Soak the barley in cold water for 15 minutes. Rinse barley under running water until water is clear. Dissolve chopped jalapenos and chile in a small pan with just the 2 cups boiling water. Bring to a boil, cover, and cook over low heat for 40 minutes or until most of the liquid is absorbed. Add chopped green onions and cook for 15 minutes more. Drain barley and apricots. Place on serving plates, garnish with chopped chile, rosemary, and/or if you prefer a milder dish, like wholemeal pumpernickel or rye bread, use pickled barley. Enjoy.

title: Vegan Tequila Soba
ingredients: 3 tablespoons vegetable oil | 12 ounces soba noodles | 12 ounces tequila
instructions: Heat oil in a frying pan over high heat. Add soba. Cook noodles in very hot oil for about 2 minutes. Pour soba into a colander, straining. Rinse with hot soba, drain. Put into a serving dish. Serve immediately.

title: Korean Beef Stew
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs stewing beef, cut into small chunks ( see note below ) | 1/2 cup chopped kalamata olives or 1/2 cup other black olives | 2 tablespoons finely chopped chives | 3/4 cup light beer | 1 tablespoon finely chopped fresh chives | green food coloring
instructions: Mix and heat beer until boiling in large dutch oven. Add beef, olives, and green chives.

title: Apricot Jam and Tomato Spread
ingredients: 1 cup canned apricot jam ( not jam packed in oil ) | 1 tablespoon tomato paste | 3 tablespoons of crushed pimientos
instructions: Combine jam with tomato paste. Stir well to blend. Pour into containers and refrigerate. Serve with crackers for dipping.

title: Asparagus & Walnuts Pizzas
ingredients: 1 lb asparagus, cut into thirds diagonally | 1 lb scallop, cooked ( optional, i prefer the pre-cooked version ) | 1 tablespoon walnut oil ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon oregano ( to sprinkle ) | 12 slices provolone cheese | 12 ounces mexican blend cheese, cut into 12 pieces | 1/2 cup unsweetened applesauce ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Place all ingredients except for apple topping into a food processe cooker. Cover and cook on high. When mixture comes to a boil, remove from oven and spread applesauce between 6 pieces of cheese. Top off pizzas with cheese. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: ice water,italian seasoning,monterey jack cheese,fennel seed,basil,broccoli,portabella mushroom
title: Hot Cheese Mushroom Rabe
ingredients: 2 packages broccoli cuts in 1 in long, slanted sections | 1 1/2 lbs portabella mushrooms, sliced | 1 teaspoon fennel seed | 2 tablespoons dried italian seasoning | 1/4 cup ice water | 1/4 cup shaved parmesan and 1/4 cup shredded monterey jack cheese ( or any other good cheese )
instructions: Rabe cooks best if you have a knife that has the long side of the knife blade attached. Do not peel if you do. Put a couple of tablespoons of the fennel seeds and 2 tablespoons dried italian seasoning together in a small bowl. Crush this mixture with your fingers until it is like fine crumbs and not oily. Add 1/4 cup of ice water, stir and set aside. In a medium mixing bowl mix together the broccoli, mushrooms, and sliced fennel. Add more cold water if needed, and stir well again. Cover bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate the mixture overnight, tossing it a couple of times. To serve, take a handful or two of the mixture and spread it on a warm serving plate. Sprinkle lightly with cheese and top with additional cheese, if desired.

title: Hot Indian Chutney
ingredients: 1/2 cup cider vinegar | 2 whole cloves | 2 teaspoons cumin powder | 1/2 cup fresh mint sprigs
instructions: Combine all ingredients, stir thoroughly. Enjoy in a pint glass bowl with a dollop in the center for a snack or snack.

title: Mexican Clam & Radish Sandwich
ingredients: crabs fresh clams | 1 slice bread | 1 small red chilies | 1 piece radish
instructions: Toast the bread, spread with a little bit of the chile oil, and top with the clams. Grill the clams. Top with the bread, and scatter the radishes on top of the platter.

title: Wild Rice Breaded Pita
ingredients: 2 cups cooked wild rice | 1 1/2 cups cooked beans, drained ( canned is fine ) | 2/3 cup fresh pita bread | 1/3 cup oat | 1 cup half-and-half | 4 teaspoons fine dry breadcrumbs | 1/3 lb lean pork, fat removed, cut into strips & browned | 2 tablespoons fine breadcrumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to combine rice, beans, pita bread, oat and half & half. Drain pork fat and brown with pork. Sprinkle with fine crumbs. Place on cookie sheet and sprinkle with fine bread crumbs if desired. Bake 20 - 25 minutes or until bread crumbs are golden and bread crust is crispy. Serve hot.

title: Cheesy Beef Quesadillas
ingredients: 4 cups shredded mexican blend cheese | 1 cup skim milk
instructions: Combine half the cheese and the milk in a small saucepan over low heat. Wisk occasionally, until melted and smooth. Stir in the rest of the cheese. Heat a griddle until hot, and lightly coat with cooking spray. Use about 2/3 cup scoop shaped pieces of the mixture onto the hot griddle, and quickly spread out each piece onto the griddle. Turn after about 10 seconds on each side, and cook until browned on the other side. Serve hot, warm or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: graham cracker crumb,chicken breast,egg noodle,bamboo shoot,green papaya,strawberry,bourbon,chili paste
title: Panda Express® Chicken Casserole
ingredients: 1 package egg noodles | 4 skinless, boneless chicken breasts, cut into strips | 1 cup peanut sauce with bourbon | 2 cups graham cracker crumbs | 1 can sliced bamboo shoots, drained | 1 cup cubed green papaya | 1 cup chopped fresh strawberries | 2 teaspoons chili paste
instructions: Preheat an oven to 350 degrees f. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook the egg noodles in the boiling water, stirring occasionally until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 5 minutes. Drain. Arrange the chicken strips in the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish. Pour peanut sauce over and top with graham cracker crumbs, then bamboo shoots, papaya, strawberries, chili paste, and half the crumbs. Cover the dish with aluminum foil. Bake in the preheated oven until bubbling, about 40 minutes.

title: Spinach and Bean Pie
ingredients: 250 g cooked baby spinach | 225 g cooked kidney beans | 6 medium potatoes, peeled and thinly sliced | 1/2 teaspoon cream of tartar
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200c. In a large bowl, combine the spinach, beans, potatoes and cream of tartar. Toss gently to combine. Place into a pie dish and top with grated cheese if desired.

Random Ingredients: grain rice,cod steak,ciabatta,beef stew meat,cocoa powder
title: Brazilian Pan-Fried Fish
ingredients: 1/2 pound beef stew meat | 2 tablespoons cocoa powder | 2 cans coconut-flavored beef stew meat | 3 tablespoons cocoa powder | 2 pieces ciabatta | 2 1/2 cups long rice
instructions: Place the beef stew beef into a large bowl of cold water. Stir 1/2 cup plus 1 tablespoon cocoa powder into the beef and add enough water to cover. When the water is hot, cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 4 hours. Drain any excess water, flake into large pieces, and refrigerate for up to 2 hours. Heat a large skillet to high heat. Arrange the beef pieces side by side in a large baking dish. Sprinkle liberally with 1 tablespoon cocoa powder. Spread the coconut beef stew meat over the top of each piece. Bake in the preheated skillet for 30 minutes, stirring halfway through the cooking time. To serve, place a large scoop of rice on top of each slice of fish and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: wheat pasta,lasagna noodle,pepper,lamb shank,fajita seasoning mix,green shrimp,garlic powder
title: Slow Cooker Creole Lamb Shanks
ingredients: 2 tablespoons fajita seasoning mix | 1 -2 cup of thawed frozen sliced green shrimp | 1 lb lamb shank | 2 cups of uncooked whole wheat pasta | 2 -3 tablespoons dried minced garlic powder | pepper | 6 sheets of lite curly lasagna noodles
instructions: Add fajita seasoning mix, frozen shrimp, sliced lamb shanks and whole wheat pasta to crock pot. Place lamb shanks on top of spaghetti and stir to mix with the sauces. Cook on low setting for 8 hours. To serve, add pepper and minced garlic to your liking.

Random Ingredients: teriyaki sauce,sticky rice,lamb shank,hazelnut,grain mustard,squash,cumin powder
title: Hazelnut Lamb Shank With Nut Rice
ingredients: 4 lamb shanks | 2 tablespoons coarse grain mustard | 2 tablespoons teriyaki sauce | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 1 tablespoon hazelnuts, roughly chopped ( can sub walnuts, cashews, pistachios or pistachios ) | 2 cups small whole grain mustard | 120 g sticksy rice
instructions: Preheat oven 180c, 180c fan forced | 1 tablespoon coarse grain mustard. Combine 2 tablespoons coarse grain mustard and teriyaki sauce, heat in a small saucepan over medium heat, stir until dissolved. Remove from heat, stir in cumin and hazelnuts and set aside. Score the lamb shank 3 times, remove excess fat and sinew, trim excess fat and sinew, put shanks standing up on a piece of kitchen paper so lamb shanks are well buttered and slightly overlapped. Spoon 1/3 of teriyaki sauce into small ovenproof dish, top with meat shanks, spoon over remaining sauce and top with remainder of teriyaki sauce and hazel nuts. Cover tightly with kitchen paper lid and bake in oven for 1 1/2 hours remove the paper, foil lid and cook for a further 20 mins or until tender. While meat is cooking, prepare nut rice. Combine 60ml mustard with rest of teriyaki sauce together in a small bowl, stir in remaining hazelnuts and nuts and serve with sliced lamb.

Random Ingredients: rice wine,up,great northern bean,rose water,arborio rice,baking chocolate,egg lengthwise,romaine lettuce
title: Rice Wine Bean Bean Bread
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups rice wine or 1 1/2 cups dry white wine | 1/2 cup rose water | 3 cups uncooked arborio rice or 3 cups carnarola rice | 1 can great northern beans, rinsed, drained, and cut into 1/2 inch pieces ( rinsed ) | 6 large eggs, lightly beaten | 6 squares unsweetened baking chocolate, cut into 1 inch chunks | 1 head romaine lettuce | 1/3 cup chopped fresh rose water or 1/3 cup sherry wine
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f coat 12x16 inch baking pan with cooking spray. To make the broth, combine rice wine and rose water in a medium saucepan.

title: Moorish Figs With Cotija Cheese and Mission Figs
ingredients: 1 lb dried mission figs | 1 tablespoon cotija cheese, crumbled
instructions: Cook figs in a medium saucepan of boiling water, uncovered, until puffed and soft, about 5 minutes, depending on their size. Drain, reserving 1/4 cup cooking liquid. Transfer figs to a bowl and mash them with the reserved cooking liquid. Stir in the crumbled cheese. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Serve immediately. Moorish figs can be made 1 week ahead. Store in an airtight container at room temperature for up to 1 week.

Random Ingredients: vanilla extract,coconut cream,mustard seed,red wine vinegar,peach
title: Fresh Peach Salad
ingredients: 1 lb ripe peach, quartered ( or peach schnapps ) | 1/2 cup light coconut milk | 1 teaspoon red wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1/2 teaspoon mustard seeds
instructions: Put the peach and 1 1/2 cup water into a blender and pulse a few times or shake well to combine. Add remaining ingredients and process until mixed well. Pour onto a bed of lettuce leaves and serve.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast half,italian sausage,rigatoni pasta,peanut oil,granny smith apple,pinto bean,cheese,fruit
title: Crock Pot Chicken and Sausage Rigatoni
ingredients: 1 cup cooked pinto beans | 1/2 lb italian sausage, casings removed, sliced ( remove casings for vegetarian version ) | 1 lb chicken breast half | 2 granny smith apples, cored, cut into 1 inch chunks | 1 cup fruit, sliced ( optional ) | 1 bag rigatoni pasta or ( 16 ounce ) bag ziti pasta, cooked | 1/4 cup peanut oil or 1/4 cup other cooking oil | 1 jar mild cheese, grated
instructions: Combine beans and sausage in crock pot. Top with chicken. Place diced apples in between. Pour fruit over chicken. Pour oil over all. Cover tightly and cook on low heat for 8 hours or on high for 4 hours. Add water during the last 30 minutes or so. To serve, stir in cheese.

title: Chocolate Raspberry Truffles
ingredients: 400 g fresh raspberries | 1 1/2 tablespoons cocoa powder ( i find that this is enough to bind them without damaging them ) | 2 teaspoons sea salt
instructions: First, preheat the oven to 200c or 400 degrees f. Place a large pinch of baking parchment on a tray. Lightly spray to stop the tray from sticking to your hands. Put the raspberries, cocoa powder and salt in a medium bowl and stir with a fork to combine. Line a large baking sheet with baking parchment. Roll the raspberry mixture into balls the size of a small cherry. Put on baking paper and chill for 20 minutes. Cut a ruffle into 5 slices and transfer to the centre of each. Bake in the oven for 7 minutes or until the raspberries are softened. Spray the truffles with oil and serve.

Random Ingredients: chicken fillet,hamburger bun,head cauliflower,coriander powder,chili oil
title: Quick and Easy Chilli Chicken Burgers
ingredients: 12 ounces ground chicken fillets | 2 teaspoons coriander powder | 2 teaspoons chili oil | 6 hamburger buns | 1 large head cauliflower
instructions: Combine all ingredients except for cauliflower in a bowl, mix well. Divide mixture between the buns. Put on grill and grill for 5 minutes, flip and grill for 5 minutes more or until browned and cooked through. To make more chilli, break a small piece of baking paper about 10 mm in diameter.

title: Simple Snow Peas
ingredients: 1 pound snow peas, trimmed | 2 dried red chili | 2 inches piece fresh ginger root, peeled and chopped
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook snow peas in boiling water, stirring occasionally, until tender but still bright green, about 5 minutes.

title: Yogurt & Bean Sprouts Salad (Marjora Yumurti)
ingredients: 5 ounces low-fat vanilla yogurt ( plain yogurt or reduced-fat ) | 1 cup bean sprouts | 2 cups marinara sauce ( homemade or commercial )
instructions: Place the yogurt in a serving bowl and add the bean sprouts and marinara sauce to taste. Mix well. Serve warm or at room temperature. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: picante sauce,broth,salt black pepper,serrano pepper,whipping cream
title: Creamy Delicious Salsa
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups picante sauce | 2 cups broth | 3 tablespoons whipping cream | 1 serrano pepper, chopped | salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: In a medium bowl, stir together the picante sauce and broth. Whisk in cream, pepper, salt, and garlic powder.

title: Cod in Broth
ingredients: 4 cod fillets, bones and skin removed | 1/2 cup canned broth, or more if needed
instructions: Place the cod in a pot with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil, and cook until easily pierced with a knife, about 8 minutes. Drain, and mash the cod with a fork. Mix in the broth, and bring to a boil. Gently fold the mashed cod into the simmering broth. Simmer about 5 minutes to cook the cod. Serve at once.

title: Vegetable Crackers
ingredients: 1 can sweetened condensed corn | 10 tablespoons vegetable oil, divided
instructions: Place the corn in the bowl of a blender or food processor fitted with a medium/large scoop blade. Add the 5 tablespoons of oil and puree. If the corn is too dry and too hot, the oil will crackle. Form the popcorn into balls the size of a cherry, about the size of a walnut. Drop them into a bowl of lightly salted cold water, stir, and pat dry. Store any leftover popcorn in an airtight container.

title: Fish in Coconut - Giada De Laurentiis
ingredients: 4 tablespoons flour | 1 tablespoon dried italian herb seasoning | 4 fish fillets, cut in half but not fleshy | 1/2 cup crudites, flakes
instructions: In a 12 inch non stick skillet, stir together flour and italian herb. Add fish pieces and stir until coated with flour mixture. Turn pieces and sprinkle with crudites. Cover and cook over moderate heat for about 8 minutes or until fish is cooked through and crumbs are crisp and golden.

Random Ingredients: hard egg yolk,tarragon,watermelon,yellow cornmeal,catsup,red chili pepper,kidney bean
title: Hot and sour kidney beans, with chilies
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups red chili pepper, canned ( see notes ) | 18 ounces cans kidney beans | 3/4 lb yellow cornmeal | 2 tablespoons tarragon | 1/2 cup catsup | 1 hard-boiled egg yolk | 3 cups watermelon ( see notes ) | 2 sprigs tarragon, chopped
instructions: Heat oven to 350f degrees. Put chilies and kidney beans in a bowl, add sugar, water and tarragon and mix well. In another bowl add cornmeal, egg yolk and catsup to soaked beans and mix well. Put bean mixture in baking dish, top with chopped tarragon. Bake 40 - 45 minutes until firm. Note. This recipe can be served hot or cold. This recipe can also be baked in the oven. Note, i like to make this in my crockpot. You may cook this up to 3 days and then transfer it into an electric crockpot. When you add this to a crockpot it must cook on low for 8 - 10 hours.

title: Duck Stock
ingredients: 1 whole duck | 1 stalk celery
instructions: Clean the duck, and rinse the hole of the neck. Place the whole neck in a large pot. Cover with water. Add celery stalk. Bring to a boil over medium heat, then reduce heat and simmer, skimming any scum that rises to the surface, until the duck is fork tender and the duck is cooked through, 3 to 5 hours. When the duck is very tender, remove the duck, place in a container, and refrigerate overnight. The duck can be frozen for future use.

title: Green Pea and Pot Roast
ingredients: 2 cans cut green peas | 2 1/2 lbs pot roast
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. Line a 2 quart casserole dish with foil and sprinkle generously with salt. Place 2 cans of peas and their liquid in a 6 compartment cassrole with 4 1/2 pounds boneless stew meat. Top with the remaining roast and drizzle with about 1 tablespoon of the broth. Place casserole dish on a baking sheet in the middle of the oven and continue cooking for 30 to 45 minutes. Remove the casserole from oven.

title: Homemade Cottage Cheese
ingredients: 500 g fresh yeast, or 2 1/2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 600 -700 g fresh active doughnutts ( or 400 g defrosted yeast doughs ) | 350 -450 g raw milk & vinegar mixed with a dash of sugar or 350 -450 g raw sugar | 6 -8 g sea salt & pepper
instructions: Note that you will be combining all the ingredients in your electric mixer. Add a dash of butter or a bit of olive oil. Dough makes the house smell wonderful. Sprinkle or rub flour on top. Dough should be as loose as possible but not too doughy or loose. If it looks more like an oversized ball of dough you haven't worked out of your dough. Add enough flour so that dough sticks to your hands. Dough shouldn't be too wet but just too dry so that the excess flour can fall off. Dump a large plastic tub with a flat bottom to work your dough out. You want to do this quickly and quickly, so that the dough doesn't go completely over the sides of the tub. This is a personal preference if you have no choice but it will help the dough to rise better than your tub and your hands as you work. Place dough on kitchen towel or tea towel. Place dough in bowl and cover with lid/saran wrap. Dough will get difficult but will eventually come back together with your hands. Allow to rest for 5 to 10 hours if you can wait that long. To make glaze, place warm water, vinegar & sugar to dissolve the sugar a little. You could also sprinkle a splash of milk or a bit of a splash of cinnamon powder over the glaze, but just a light shake works well. Place your dough in a greased bowl, cover with a tea towel or parchment or lightly oiled paper and a lid to keep the dough from sticking. Allow to rise until doubled. With hands, knead and then add yeast to dough. If you have never risen doubled, cover and allow to rest for an additional hour. Divide in 12 even sized balls. Place each ball of dough between pieces of parchment covered or greased paper. Knead until smooth and elastic. Cover and rest for 10 minutes. Roll into balls of 5 inch diameter and place onto parchment floured cookie sheet. Cover and let rise in a warm spot until double. After 10 minutes, check, flipping the slices to ensure both side of dough is lightly browned. Preheat oven to 200c and place baking tray in oven for 5 minutes before topping with glaze and then placing baking tray in oven for 30 minutes or longer until golden brown.

title: Tomato Platter for Mexican Salad
ingredients: 2 medium ripe roma tomatoes, halved lengthwise ( about 1-1/2 cups ) | 1/3 cup dried apricot, chopped | 2 teaspoons fresh lime juice, divided | 1 teaspoon grated lime rind, divided | 1/2 small papaya, peeled, halved lengthwise, seeded, and thinly sliced | 1/4 cup fire-roasted tomato, cut into 3/4-inch slices
instructions: Combine tomatoes, apricots, half of the lime juice, lime rind, papaya, and remaining lime juice in a large bowl.

title: Crock Pot Black-Eyed Peas
ingredients: 2 cups black-eyed peas | 2 cups ice | 5 hamburger roll
instructions: Place 3 cups of black eye peas in pot. Fill with 1 lb hamburger roll meat. Pour 3 cups of ice into the crock pot. Cook for 6 hours on high. After 6 hours reduce heat to low.

title: Apple Tangy and Healthy Version
ingredients: 5 tart apples, like granny smith | 1/2 cup bean sprouts | 1/2 cup lemon rind, grated
instructions: Core the apples and slice into rounds about 1/8 inch thick. Place the slices between sheets of waxed paper until easy to handle. Place a handful of sprouts in the center of each apple slice. Dip apple slices in rind and place on a tray which will hold them together. Place 1 apple slice on each apple slice. Drizzle a little lemon juice over the apple when serving.

Random Ingredients: almond milk,panko breadcrumb,mozzarella cheese,thyme sprig,mayonnaise,corn tortilla chip,yeast,chickpea
title: Garbanzos, Chickpeas & Cheese Rolls With Dijon Butter
ingredients: 1/2 cup panko breadcrumbs | 1/4 cup dry breadcrumbs | 1 tablespoon fresh thyme sprig, chopped | 1 1/2 cups cooked chickpeas, drained, well rinsed and slightly mashed | 2 tablespoons mayonnaise | 1 1/2 teaspoons instant yeast | 36 ounces corn tortilla chips, slightly crushed | 12 ounces goat mozzarella cheese ( not low-fat ) or 12 ounces monterey jack cheese ( not low-fat )
instructions: Dough, in a small bowl, stir together panko, bread crumbs and 1 tbls. Of sprigs of thyme. Add chickpeas and stir to combine. Stir in mayonnaise and yeast, and set aside in a warm place until beginning to froth or double in bulk, at least 10 minutes. Meanwhile, in a medium bowl, stir together crushed tortillas and remaining sprigs of thyme, adding more oil if necessary to moisten. Using a round or 8 by 8 inch loaf pan as a guide, roll 1 cup of crumb mixture in each tortilla, leaving 1/4 of a round on each sides. Dip each sandwich into hot cheese and let excess drip off, seam side down. Arrange 2 or 3 stuffed, tortillas on a hot, greased griddle and place skillet over medium heat. Grill, turning once with tongs, until cheese is melted and breadcrumb topping bubbles, about 6 to 8 minutes. Transfer to a rack in the pan to cool.

title: Hominy in the Microwave
ingredients: 1 can hominy, drained and rinsed | 8 ounces frozen mushrooms, thawed
instructions: Stir well. Cover and cook on 75% power level for 2 - 5 minutes. Carefully mix in mushrooms and microwave on high 4 - 5 minutes more until heated through.

title: Spaetzle
ingredients: 1 ounce unsweetened chocolate square | 1/4 teaspoon worcestershire sauce
instructions: Place all ingredients into a small saucepan and simmer until melted. Chill well.

title: Cheddar-Truffled Beef Sirloin Roast
ingredients: 5 tablespoons bacon drippings, divided | 2/3 cup grated old cheddar cheese, divided | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh savory, divided | 1/2 teaspoon dried sage, divided | 2 lbs sirloin tip roast, trimmed and tied | tea, warmed ( optional )
instructions: Preheat a heavy large pan or dutch oven over moderately high heat. Add 1 tablespoon bacon drippings, 1 tablespoon cheese, savory and sage to pan. Cook beef on top of drippings, turning meat as necessary, until deep golden brown, about 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: filling,herb,yukon gold potato,tuna vegetable oil,mango chutney,brie cheese,pistachio
title: Brie Cheese Filled Gnocchi
ingredients: 20 ounces brie cheese | 3 ounces mango chutney or 3 ounces chutney | 8 ounces herbed prawns ( such as mussels or shrimp ) | 8 ounces tuna-vegetable oil | 1 large yukon gold potato, halved through the middle to make it thinner | 1/2 cup chopped pistachios ( optional )
instructions: Cut the brie into 20 chunks and put them into a bowl. Dice the mango with the pestachio nuts if using and toss them in with the brie. Pour the oil into a large frying pan and heat the oil. Fry the potato for about 10 minutes until it starts to turn golden. Remove the potato from the frying pan and pat it dry with kitchen paper. Dip two toothpicks through the bread crumbs to keep them moist. Spread the prawns on a large chopping board and flatten it out with your hands. Place a handful of potato into the palm of your hand and flatten it out again with your hands. Place the herbed prawns on top and press them firmly back into the prawns. Roll the gnocchi in the paprika and set on kitchen paper. Repeat, until all the cheese has been used. Heat the tuna in a saucepan over a medium heat on the stove top for 5 minutes. Turn the heat off and add the brie and mango mixture and stir well. Cover and keep warm until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: red cabbage,french bread italian,tamarind pulp,red kidney bean,orange flower water,red chili powder,garlic salt
title: Spicy Ethiopian Sandwiches
ingredients: 2 large red cabbage | 1 can red kidney beans, drained | 1 red chili powder | 1/4 cup fresh tamarind pulp | 1 tablespoon orange flower water | 1/8 teaspoon garlic salt | 1 loaf french bread or 1 loaf italian bread
instructions: Clean and slice your french bread. You could also make your own french bread. Bring your water to a boil. In a medium size bowl, combine chili powder, tamarind pulp, orange flower water and garlic salt. Add the shredded cabbage with salt. Boil for around 5 minutes and then transfer to a food processor. Turn on and on until all the leaves are finely chopped. Then add your red kidney beans. Mix. Cut your french loaf in half. Then place your cabbage mixture into the pan. Cut the bread in half and spread approximately 3 t of spice mixture on each half. The bread will be slightly moist. Enjoy with your favorite sauce or steamed green beans.

Random Ingredients: bibb lettuce,oil,lime wedge,coriander seed,baby spinach,xanthan gum,mozzarella cheese
title: Tasty Cabbage Fritters
ingredients: 3 tablespoons oil, extra virgin | 2 tablespoons coriander seeds ( heaping ) or 1 tablespoon cumin seeds ( heaping ) | 1/4 cup baby spinach | 1 large head bibb lettuce | 1/4 cup shredded mozzarella cheese | 2 teaspoons xanthan gum or 2 teaspoons plain greek yogurt | 3/4 cup low-fat mozzarella cheese, grated
instructions: Heat oil in a small skillet over medium heat. Add coriander and half the coriander leaves to the oil.

title: Easy and Yummy Mexican Dip
ingredients: 1 packet taco seasoning mix | 1 cup merlot | 1 bunch spring onion, chopped coarselly
instructions: Place a small mixing of taco seasoning mix and 1 cup merlot in a medium saucepan over medium heat. Bring to a boil and pour into a bowl to dip.

Random Ingredients: liquid honey,baking potato,curry,grape leaf,black pepper,manchego cheese,parsley
title: Curried Roasted Potatoes
ingredients: 1 tablespoon liquid honey | 2 cloves garlic, halved | 5 medium baking potatoes, halved | 1 teaspoon curry | 1/4 teaspoon black pepper | 8 ounces manchego cheese, cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 1 tablespoon fresh parsley, coarsely chopped
instructions: Preheat broiler. In a small bowl, stir together honey and garlic. Spread potatoes on a baking sheet. Bake in a preheated 400°f oven for about 45 minutes or until tender. In a small bowl, stir together curry and pepper. Spread mixture over potatoes while they bake. Place cheese in a small, wide saucepan and melt over medium heat. Stir in parsley. Increase oven temperature to broil. Broil briefly until cheese melts.

title: Baked Venison
ingredients: 3 lbs venison | 6 -8 radishes | 3 tablespoons arrowroot | 2 teaspoons apple jelly
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Cut venison into bite size strips, about 3/4 inch wide. Arrange on foil lined baking pans and brush with arrowroot.

title: Mock Chocolate Truffles
ingredients: 250 g natural yoghurt | 1 tablespoon sifted turbinado sugar ( white sugar ) | 10 ounces firm tofu, cut into 1/2 inch cubes ( tofu ) | 2 limes, zest of | 4 tablespoons cocoa | 1 tablespoon vodka
instructions: Heat the wok over moderate heat and add the sugar and half of the lime zest. When it starts to melt, mix in the yoghurt and cook for 1 min until it’s thick like cream, but not as dry. Transfer to a bowl and set aside. Repeat, once more, with the remaining lime zest, cocoa, and vodka. Place tofu in the pan and stir until golden and glistening, then add the remaining sugar and lime zest and continue stirring until the sugar has dissolved. Remove from the heat and allow to cool to room temperature. Stir in the rum and add the yoghurt. Cover the pan and leave it there for at least 30 minutes to set. When it’s ready, divide into balls, coat lightly with flour, and shake off excess. Dip in a little chocolate syrup, drizzle with a little bit of the remaining chocolate syrup, and roll in sifted toasted nuts. Store in an airtight container.

title: Cabbage and Oatmeal for One
ingredients: 1 small head of cabbage | 1 ounce oatmeal
instructions: Bring a medium saucepan of salted water to a boil. Meanwhile, trim the cabbages and cut them crosswise into about 5 1/2 thick slices crosswise. Place the sliced cabbages in a medium bowl and add the oatmeal. Stir to coat evenly. Toast the oatmeal in a medium skillet over low heat for a few minutes, stirring constantly until fragrant.

Random Ingredients: vegetable broth,soy sauce,ramen noodle,avocado,superfine sugar,tomato,meatball,italian parsley
title: Meatball Ragu
ingredients: 6 frozen meatballs | fresh italian parsley | 1 ripe tomato | 1 small ripe avocado ( such as haas ) | 6 ounces superfine sugar | 8 ounces vegetable broth | 3 tablespoons soy sauce | 8 ounces ramen noodles | chopped italian parsley, for serving
instructions: Cut the meatballs in half lengthwise and gently remove the insides.

title: Tomato Roll-Ups
ingredients: 1 can crushed cherry tomatoes | 1 envelope dry onion soup mix | 4 corn tortillas, cut into 1/4-inch strips
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. In a medium bowl, stir together the crushed tomatoes, onion soup mix, and 4 tortillas until evenly coated. Spread about a tablespoon of the topping evenly onto each tortilla, and roll each tortilla up tightly. Bake for 45 minutes in the preheated oven, until bubbly.

title: Sausage and Pepper Bake
ingredients: 1/4 cup brown rice | 1/4 cup chopped fresh red cabbage | 1/4 cup chopped yellow pepper, or to taste | 1 teaspoon chipotle powder, or to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Heat the rice in a skillet over medium heat, stirring constantly, until the rice is opaque, about 3 minutes. Remove from heat.

title: Grilled Salmon With Sherry and Olives
ingredients: 1/4 cup sweet sherry wine | 1/4 cup dijon mustard | 1 salmon ( about 1 lb. ) | 1/4 cup pitted spanish olives
instructions: Combine the wine, mustard and olives in a shallow dish. Add salmon and turn to coat well, turning once. Cover dish and refrigerate at least 1 hour. Preheat grill for high heat. Place salmon on grill 1 to 2 inches from heat. Grill 3 to 4 minutes, or until fish flakes easily with a fork.

Random Ingredients: extra beef,butterscotch chip,graham cracker crumb,coriander seed,spaghetti,vegetable shortening
title: Truffles
ingredients: 1/4 cup extra-lean ground beef | 1/4 cup graham cracker crumbs | vegetable shortening, for frying | 2 tablespoons unsalted butter, very soft | 1/4 cup butterscotch chips | 1/4 teaspoon coriander seed
instructions: Combine the ground beef and graham cracker crumbs in a bowl. Add a small amount of the shortening. Using a pastry blender or 2 knives, cut shortening into beef and cracker meat until well mixed. Gather mixture into a ball. Flatten with the palm of your hand. Shape mixture into a 3 inch diameter flat cylinder. Chill for 15 minutes. Heat a few tablespoons of vegetable shortening in a heavy skillet over medium heat. Using a slotted spoon, remove meat from the refrigerator. Use a slotted spoon to transfer the meat back into the skillet. In a large skillet, melt remaining shortening over medium heat. Add coriander seeds. Stir often to keep from burning, about 1 minute. Dip meat cylinder in hot butter until browned, 1 to 2 minutes per side. Transfer meat to a plate lined with paper towels to drain. Repeat process until meat is complete. Cut meat cylinder into 3 inch lengths. Pour reserved melted shortening over meat, coating completely. Cover and cook until most of the shortening melts and meat is no longer pink inside, about 2 minutes. Sprinkle tops with additional 1 tablespoon butterscotch chips. Serve and enjoy.

title: Irish Truffles
ingredients: 4 ounces strong whole wheat bread crumbs, finely grated | 1/4 cup cocoa ( heaped tbs ) | 1/4 cup mixed herbs, chopped ( such as parsley, chives, dill and oregano ) | coriander seeds
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the bread crumbs and cocoa and mix together. Form a round with your hands, then coat with coconut oil or melted butter to prevent sticking. On a floured board, roll the balls into walnut sized balls. Cook them on a lightly greased grill pan or under a preheated broiler until golden, about 4 minutes on each side.

title: Artichoke Salsa Pasta
ingredients: 1 package penne pasta or ( 16 ounce ) package tri-colored spiral shaped pasta | 2 3/4 cups salsa verde | 1 can artichoke hearts, quartered | bamboo skewers, soaked in water ( optional ) or ( 5 ounce ) can other vegetable oil ( optional )
instructions: Cook pasta following package directions. Add salsa verde and artichoke hearts. Toss well with cooked pasta. Serve with additional salsa verde if desired. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: chicken stock,golden syrup,madeira wine,red curry paste,chicken fillet,mascarpone cheese
title: Quick Curry & Mascarpone Baked Chicken
ingredients: 1 packet bought mascarpone cheese | 500 g chicken fillets ( cut into large chunks ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons mild red curry paste | 1 1/2 tablespoons golden syrup | 1 tablespoon madeira wine | 2 tablespoons chicken stock
instructions: Pre heat oven to 200°c. Mix together the mascarpone, curry paste, syrup and madeira until smooth then set aside. Arrange the chicken in a large, shallow baking dish. Spread the cheese mixture over the chicken and bake, uncovered, for 20 minutes, or until chicken just cooked and golden. Serve the chicken with the sauce spooned over.

title: Brown Lentils With Sauce
ingredients: 1 kg white lentils | 1 teaspoon green chili | 1 tablespoon sherry wine ( dry is best )
instructions: Put the lentils into a saucepan. Add boiling water to just cover the lentils. Simmer for about 50 minutes, or until tender but not mushy. When you are ready to eat, drain the water so that the starchy, dark colored lentils can be picked up. Place the chili under a grill to grill for 3 - 4 minutes or until you don't smell any burning. Spoon the lentils onto a warm dish or plate and pour the sauce along the side of the dish.

Random Ingredients: brown sugar,french dressing,cremini mushroom,flat leaf parsley,cayenne,egg white
title: Stuffed Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 cup bottled french dressing | 1 tablespoon dried flat-leaf parsley | 1 tablespoon brown sugar | 1 teaspoon cayenne ( to taste ) | 3 large egg whites | 8 large cremini mushrooms | 1/2 cup shredded fresh flat-leaf parsley
instructions: Place french dressing, 1 tablespoon dried parsley, brown sugar, and cayenne into a medium bowl. Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Line a shallow roasting pan with foil. Place mushrooms, cut side down, on foil lined pan. Brush with dressing. Roast mushrooms for 20 minutes, until tender and lightly browned. Turn. Roast for 25 minutes more, until browned. Place mushrooms on a heated platter. Sprinkle with remaining 2 tablespoons dried parsley. Serve with reserved 1/2 cup dressing.

title: Peanut Nuts Ramen Sandwiches
ingredients: 1/2 cup toasted peanuts, coarsely chopped | 4 tablespoons peanut oil | 4 leaves fresh ramen noodles or 4 leaves fresh sesame noodles | 4 tablespoons chocolate syrup | 2 tablespoons pine nuts, coarsely chopped ( or walnuts )
instructions: In a mortar or blender, with the peanut oil, toss the peanuts and noodles in a coating consistency. Wrap the noodles with the sauce and toss with the peanut oil. Garnish with chocolate syrup and pine nuts.

title: Beef Ribs With Sausage
ingredients: 4 beef short ribs | 1/2 lb pork tenderloin
instructions: Remove membrane from pork.

Random Ingredients: granny smith apple,bell pepper,challah egg bread,tomato green chilies,wide egg noodle,kohlrabi,cheerio oat cereal,ladyfinger
title: Chile, Oat and Bread Crumb Pizza
ingredients: 1 cup finely shredded cheese-free oat cereal | 7 ounces thinly sliced wall-on egg noodles | 2 3/4 ounces sliced fully cooked chinese-style diced bell peppers ( about 7 ) | 14 ounces diced tomatoes with green chilies, drained | 1 1/4 - 1 1/2 cups diced kohlrabi ( about 4 medium ) | 6 4-inch thick slices challah egg bread or 4 4-inch square egg bread | 1/3 cup store-bought frozen cut green giant valley oat cereal | softened medium fat method butter knife ( i used pam )
instructions: In a large bowl, stir together cheese free oat cereal and oat crumbs using an electric mixer on low speed. Add undrained tomatoes and kohlrabi, stir to combine. Remove bread slices from freezer and coarsely chop. Layer bread and tomato mixture on pizza pan or cookie sheet and top with grated cheesefree oat mixture. Cover with plastic wrap and freeze until firm, about 8 hours. Place pizza on a platter. Meanwhile, microwave ovenware oven safe bowl with 1/3 cup water at high power until piping hot, about 20 seconds, then carefully slide pizza into oven, positioned on top rack. Microwave bread approximately 1 1/2 to 2 minutes, or until golden brown, then remove from oven and slice about 2 tablespoons through crust, placing between squares. Serve warm. Drizzle with method favored by your favorite pizza family.

title: Ginger Marinated Scallions
ingredients: 4 scallions ( green parts only ) | 1/4 cup finely chopped fresh ginger | 1 jar salsa | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil
instructions: Trim scallions, reserving some for garnish and remaining scallions for garnish. Place scallions and ginger in a blender or food processor.

Random Ingredients: vanilla bean,extra virgin olive oil,marjoram,cranberry,pistachio nut,chili
title: Cranberry Chili Ice Cream
ingredients: 300 g fresh cranberries | 1 large vanilla bean, split lengthwise | 400 g pistachio nuts | 1 teaspoon dried marjoram | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 2 -3 teaspoons fresh ground chili
instructions: Place the cranberries and vanilla bean inside a bowl.

title: Korean Beef and Rice
ingredients: 2 lbs beef roast | 1 can tomato juice | 1 cup jasmine rice
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Season the roast with salt and pepper. Brown the roast in a casserole dish on high heat. Drain off drippings. Transfer roast to oven and cook for about 45 minutes. Transfer roast and juice to a saucepan and add the rice. Cook over medium heat 20 minutes more. Remove the meat and rice dish from oven and set aside on a warmed platter,. Serve with remaining tomato sauce and korean sauce.

Random Ingredients: french baguette,quinoa,vanilla essence,shrimp paste,italian bread,tomato soup
title: Quinoa Bread
ingredients: 1 tablespoon shrimp paste | 1 french baguette | 2 cups quinoa ( soaked overnight ) | 1/2 cup tomato soup | 1/4 teaspoon vanilla essence | 1/4 cup french baguettes ( cut horizontally ) | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f. Prepare french baguettes. Slice french baguettes. Slice tomatoes. Mix shrimp paste and quinoa. Cut french baguettes.

title: Cheese Ball With Smoked Sausages
ingredients: 12 medium chunky salsa, to taste ( spicy ) | 2 tablespoons grape balls ( round or oval ) | 2 tablespoons genoa salami ( round or oval ) | 1/8 teaspoon ground cardamom powder
instructions: On an oiled baking sheet, combine all ingredients.

title: Chipotle Naan
ingredients: 1 cup pigeon peas, cooked | 2 envelopes unflavored gelatin | 1/2 cup chipotle powder or 3/4 teaspoon chipotle powder | 3 slices bread | 2 slices thick bread ( optional )
instructions: Rinse and drain rinsed and dried pigeon peas. Place in a microwave safe bowl and cover with cold water and microwave on high setting 6 minutes or until just softened. Dissolve gelatin in 1/2 cup water and add to pigeon peas. Add chili powder, chipotle juice, bread and gelatin mixture and stir. Cover bowl and refrigerate to soften bread for at least 4 hours. Break up bread and serve with bread for dipping.

title: Pigs in Oil - Glazed
ingredients: 1 lb of good quality sausage, sliced | 1 1/2 teaspoons salt | 3 tablespoons golden brown sugar | 1 1/2 teaspoons orange flower water | 2 tablespoons ground dried orange flower water
instructions: Preheat oven 375°f fry sausage, onion and brown sugar in deep fat until sausage is browned. Add orange flower water, stir. Cover pan about halfway with aluminum foil, put inside a baking pan, place in upper third of oven and bake about 20 - 30 minutes, or until thick and crisp. Remove from oven and place on absorbent paper towls, remove paper towels. This will keep in the refrigerator for up to 2 weeks.

title: Agnello Con Salvia (Pasta) Gra
ingredients: 2 cans of italian peeled tomatoes ( a bit over 3/4 of an 11 ounce can ) | 2 lbs asiago cheese, cut into cubes | 1/2 teaspoon mustard powder
instructions: Place asiago cubes, mustard powder, and salt in a sauce pan with water to just below a simmer. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium low and simmer 30 - 45 minutes. If it seems dry, add more water. If not quite dry enough, add a bit more water. Remove asiago from heat and reserve in cheese container. Serve over favorite pasta.

title: Picante Chicken
ingredients: 1 roasting chicken, cut into 8 pieces | 1 can picante sauce | 1 green pepper, deseeded and chopped | 1 cup fresh cranberries ( optional ) | 1/4 cup pistachio nut, chopped ( optional ) or 2 tablespoons finely chopped pecans ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees. Bake the chicken for 1 hour or until an internal temperature of 175 degrees. Let cool, remove the skin and tear or chop the meat into 2 to 3 pieces. Add the picante sauce, green pepper, cranberries and/or nuts and mix well. If desired remove the chicken from the oven and place the meat in a baking dish. Pour the sauce over the chicken and bake uncovered for 45 minutes.

Random Ingredients: white meat chicken,cream mushroom soup,italian parsley,grain rice,romaine lettuce,vegetable bouillon cube,ketjap manis
title: Rice Pilaf - Quickie
ingredients: 3 cups long grain rice ( uncle ben's will use a bit more ) | 1 1/2 vegetarian chicken, cut up | 1 vegetable bouillon cubes ( i like 2, so i leave out the bouillon ) | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup ( light works ) | 1 tablespoon ketchup, ktchup, you can also try low sodium | 1 tablespoon fresh italian parsley, minced | 1 romaine lettuce, chopped
instructions: Cook rice, vegetable bouillion cube, soup, and ketchup in a skillet, then add rice and add parsley. Toss, add lettuce and serve.

Random Ingredients: spinach leaf,black pepper,pizza crust,chicken breast,soy sauce,chile paste,linguine,tahini
title: Linguine With Chicken, Spinach, and Tahini
ingredients: 1 whole chicken breast, cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 1/4 cup soy sauce | 1 1/2 teaspoons chili paste | 1 1/2 teaspoons chopped fresh chile peppers | 1/2 teaspoon freshly ground black pepper | 1 package fresh spinach leaves | 1 package dry linguine | 1/3 cup plain tahini
instructions: Combine the chicken, soy sauce, chili paste, chile peppers, and pepper in a large skillet. Cook over medium high heat, stirring occasionally, 3 to 5 minutes. Add the spinach, stir to combine, then cook until just wilted, 3 to 5 more minutes. Set aside. Preheat the oven broiler. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook the linguine at a boil, stirring occasionally, until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 12 minutes. Reserve 1 cup of the pasta water. Drain the linguine. Place the chicken and spinach in a medium saucepan with a lid. Drizzle the chicken with the tahini and enough pasta water to cover by about 1 inch. Bring to a boil over high heat.

title: Broccoli with Saffron
