ingredients: 1 bunch broccoli, cut in florets | 1 can diced tomatoes ( i just use plain with basil ) | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1 pinch saffron | 1/4 dried rosemary, crushed
instructions: Steam broccoli until tender crisp, approximately 5 minutes. Meanwhile, crush saffron with salt. Heat oil in skillet and add tomatoes and rosemary. Bring to a boil. Remove broccoli from pan. Scoop out the broccoli and discard.

Random Ingredients: red wine,cider,purpose flour,anchovy paste,water,lemon,cremini mushroom,bell pepper
title: Polish Mushroom Tartlets
ingredients: 1 cup all-purpose flour | 1 cup water | 2 teaspoons anchovy paste | 1 cup cremini mushrooms, sliced thin | 1 tablespoon sweet bell pepper, finely chopped | 1/2 cup cider | 1/2 cup red wine or 1/2 cup port wine | 2 lemons, juice of
instructions: Mix flour and water in a bowl and knead to a soft dough. Add more water if dough is too dry. Dip small pieces of dough in batter and fry until golden about 4 mintues each side or until golden on both sides. Mix sauce ingredients and transfer to a saucepan.

title: Blue Exotic Flaky Phyllo Triangles
ingredients: 3 sheets phyllo dough | 1 teaspoon coriander seed | 1/2 teaspoon liquid smoke | 2 tablespoons blue curacao
instructions: Mix all of the ingredients and place in a plastic bag with a lid. Leave overnight. Take 1 sheet and brush with a little mix. Then top with another sheet of phyllo. Place in freezer on the same plate. Repeat until all are layered. When complete, cut into strips and place on baking paper to freeze.

title: Chiko Epiro (Brazilian Sausage Roll)
ingredients: 2 pork pieces | 1 sausage | 2 celery ribs | 1/2 chicken bouillon cube | 4 sheets nori, seaweed, toasted
instructions: Grind all ingredients together to form a coarse mixture. Roll to stuff, and tie with a very thin piece of seaweed before cooking. Allow to dry for at least 3 - 4 hours before cooking.

title: Ham, Broccoli and Pumpkin Cauliflower Wraps
ingredients: 500 g cauliflower, thickly sliced | 150 g pumpkin puree | 200 g prosciutto, thinly sliced | 500 g baby rocket | pepperoni, roughly chopped ( optional ) | 8 slices prosciutto | 1 cup blackberries ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons muscovado sugar, for sprinkling ( optional )
instructions: Cook cauliflower in a large saucepan of boiling water for 3 - 4 minutes or until just tender. Drain and transfer to a chopping board. Add pumpkin puree, prosciutto, rocket and optional blackberries, if using, to cauliflower. Season to taste and mix well. Shape the pumpkin mixture back into 4 5mm thick balls, then roll in the rocket, starting at the wide end of each, and press the join underneath and down with the back of a knife. Place wraps on a clean plate and sprinkle with pepper. Heat a griddle pan, drizzle over a little oil and cook wraps on each side about 1 minute or until golden and piping hot. Sprinkle with sugar and serve with tomato, herb or other grain.

title: Garlicky Dill Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup dry dill | 1 cup raisins | 2 cloves fresh garlic, crushed
instructions: Place the dill and raisins in a small bowl. Place the garlic cloves in the bowl and crush with a fork. Add the garlic to the dill and raisins. Mix well.

title: Hot Pesto
ingredients: 2 cups heavy whipping cream | 1/4 cup ice water | 2/3 cup pine nuts | 1 dash hot sauce
instructions: Using a hand blender, combine the whipping cream and ice water and process until smooth. Stir in the pine nuts, hot sauce, and mix well.

title: Roasted Red Potatoes
ingredients: 8 red potatoes | 2 tablespoons roasted chili, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Rinse potatoes.

title: Toffee and Sultana Stew-Tartar
ingredients: 1/2 lb sultana | 4 tablespoons brandy | 1 can condensed beef broth | 2 cups instant polenta | 1 can black beans, drained and rinsed | 2 tablespoons low sodium beef broth | 1 can cherry pie filling
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f. Using a food processor or blender, puree the sultanas to a coarse paste, then transfer to a 1 quart glass or ceramic baking dish and stir in the brandy. In a medium saucepan, bring the beef broth to a boil. Add the polenta and stir until smooth. Stir in the sultana mixture, black beans, and brandy mixture and cook over medium heat, stirring over low heat for 4 minutes, or until heated through. Spoon the stew into a bowl, then refrigerate until cool enough to handle. Serve.

title: Pulao (Pea and Green Chile Stew)
ingredients: 2 cups peas, frozen shelled and thawed | 1 green chili, seeded and chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Place frozen peas in a mixing bowl. Break peas with a knife into small bits of pea size pieces, and toss with chile. Bake for about 20 minutes with lid slightly ajar at 375 f.

title: Madras Meat Patties
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs ground beef | 1 egg white | peppercorn, a pinch ( about 1/2 teaspoon, more or less to taste ) | 1 -2 tablespoon madras curry powder | 1 teaspoon peppercorn
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl, except the peppercorns. Knead with hands. Divide mixture into 10 balls and roll each in peppercorns. Brown them in a skillet, adding any additional oil and water as needed, until the outsides are dark. Be sure not to let them burn serve, with rice or soup.

Random Ingredients: dijon mustard,heavy cream,ale,maraschino cherry,chili oil,dark chocolate,ginger paste
title: Calypso (Calypso Spiced Chocolate Sauce)
ingredients: 4 teaspoons ginger paste | 2 teaspoons chili oil | 1 cup ale | 4 ounces dark chocolate, chopped | 2 ounces heavy cream | 1 teaspoon dijon mustard | 1 tablespoon maraschino cherries, chopped
instructions: Place ginger, olive, chile oil and ale in a deep skillet and cook over low heat until the ale boils.

title: Easy Spicy Fried Noodles
ingredients: 8 ounces egg noodles or 8 ounces egg noodles | 1 lb pork or 1 lb chicken | 4 slices pepperoni | 1 cup raisins | 1/2 cup rice noodles or 1/2 cup chinese rice vermicelli, soaked in warm water for 30 minutes and drained | 8 ounces mixed spice masala | 1/2 teaspoon ground cayenne pepper | 3/4 teaspoon coarse grain mustard
instructions: First, cook noodles in boiling, salted water according to package directions. Drain, then rinse with cold water, letting cool. While noodles are cooking, fry pork in non stick skillet or wok over high heat until cooked and crisp. Drain off fat. Remove from skillet or wok and set aside. Slice meat and brown well on all sides. Drain any excess fat and set aside. When noodles are done, drain and add to pork and meat. Combine masala, chile powder and mustard and pour over noodle mixture. Stir to mix well. Remove from heat once noodles are fully coated in spice mixture and serve.

title: Acapulco Tuna Salad
ingredients: 3 ounces canned tunafood | 15 ounces canned pineapple juice | 14 tomatillos
instructions: Cut the tuna into 2 equal sized pieces. Take your tomatoes and tomatillos and boil them in the pineapple juice. Put the tuna pieces in the tomato and tomatillo mixture and mix together and store in the refrigerator. Serve the tuna salad with some fresh bread.

title: Seafood Melba
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups spaghetti, broken up or 1 1/2 cups other pastas | 1 teaspoon olive, sliced | 1 cup cooked soba noodles | 1 lb sea scallops, steamed | 6 1/2 tablespoons chicken bouillon, canned or 6 1/2 tablespoons bouillon | 4 hoagie rolls, split or 4 any other soft rolls | 12 slices ripe olives, i have used other types of black olives
instructions: Make the pasta according to the package directions. Drain. Meanwhile, in a nonstick skillet brown the soba noodles with the olive. Put the soba noodles through a ricer or by hand. Add the cooked soba noodles and the scallops. Stir to mix. To serve, spread half the soba noodle mixture on the bottom half of each bun. Spoon over the seafood and then top with the olives.

Random Ingredients: graham cracker crust,rib beef,olive,orange juice,tortilla chip,sake,chicken bouillon,tahini
title: Tortilla Chip Short Ribs
ingredients: 2 lbs short rib of beef | 1/2 cup tahini | 1/4 cup orange juice | 1/2 cup chicken bouillon | 2 packages graham cracker crusts | 1 package tortilla chips | olive
instructions: Cut short ribs into serving size pieces. Heat remaining ingredients for short ribs in saucepan to boiling. Remove from heat and mix. Pour over short ribs.

Random Ingredients: tamarind pulp,cayenne pepper,vanilla extract,grape tomato,yeast,artichoke heart
title: Artichoke Bottoms
ingredients: 2 tablespoons active dry yeast | 8 -10 cups grape tomatoes, seeded and coarsely chopped ( about 3 lbs ) | 12 ounces artichoke hearts, drained well if canned | 1 tablespoon dried anise seed pulp, lightly toasted | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1 tablespoon pure vanilla extract
instructions: Combine the yeast and tomatoes in large bowl and let sit until bubbly, about 5 minutes. Stir in remaining ingredients. Cover and let stand at room temperature until liquid is absorbed, about 1 hour. Pour mixture into sterilized gallon plastic bag in a steady stream, leaving 1/2 inch around the outside rim of the bag. Place in a draft free spot and let rise until puffy, about 1 hour at most. Transfer to baking sheet and bake in upper third of preheated 400°f oven until bottoms begin to brown about 15 minutes. Let cool and store at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: celery salt,soppressata,pork sausage,mexican rice,almond extract,pork shoulder,phyllo dough,broth
title: Briquettes with Sausage and Mashed Potatoes
ingredients: 16 ounces pork shoulder | 1 lb pork sausage | 16 ounces mexican rice, drained ( or other short-grain white rice ) | 3 1/2 cups broth | 2 tablespoons soppressata | 1 teaspoon celery salt | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract | 8 sheets phyllo dough, thawed | 1 sheet dried sesame seeds or 1 sheet sunflower seeds
instructions: Trim excess fat from meat. If necessary, trim off any excess fat from sausage and sausage casings. Cut meat into cubes. Mix together rice, broth, soppressata, celery salt, and pepper in a covered, plastic bag. Add meat and sausage.

title: Beer Shake
ingredients: 1 green coleslaw mix | 1 can beer
instructions: Drain coleslaw and put in a pot. Pour beer over and add salad dressing mix. It is good with chips, bread, crackers.

Random Ingredients: grain brown rice,coriander seed,lea perrins worcestershire sauce
title: Lilper Fried Rice
ingredients: 4 cups cooked long-grain brown rice | 1 1/2 teaspoons coriander seeds | 1 -2 tablespoon lea perrins®, worcestershire sauce
instructions: Toss the rice and coriander seeds in a bowl well. Drizzle in 1 - 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce and mix together. Heat a large non stick frying pan or wok over a high heat, pour in 3 - 4 cups of hot water and bring to a boil. Use a spatula to spread the rice out evenly. Cook for 1 - 2 minutes only, or until grains are browned and crispy. Serve with any side dishes.

Random Ingredients: romano cheese,anchovy paste,beef chuck shoulder pot roast
title: Italian Pot Roast
ingredients: 1 tablespoon anchovy paste | 2 pounds boneless beef chuck shoulder pot roast | 1/2 cup romano cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. In a shallow glass baking dish, dissolve anchovy paste in water. Add the roast and sprinkle with romano. Bake in the preheated oven until well browned, about 3 hours.

Random Ingredients: romaine lettuce,cranberry,kaffir lime leaf,red curry paste,corn chip,rice,tuna,salami
title: Salami and Pineapple Platter
ingredients: 14 ounces tuna, drained | 14 ounces smoked salmon, chopped | 4 ounces smoked salami, chopped | 4 pieces romaine lettuce | 1/4 cup red curry paste or 1/4 cup curry powder | 2 tablespoons raw rice, rinsed | 2 kaffir lime leaves | 2 tablespoons dried cranberries | 4 large corn chips
instructions: Drain the tuna and cut into bite sized chunks. Combine the tuna, salmon, salt and curry paste in a shallow bowl and add the rice, kaffir lime leaves and dried cranberries. Taste to make sure you like the texture. To serve, stack the lettuce on a plate and spoon onto the tuna mixture. Garnish with the corn chips.

title: Roasted Red Pepper Relish
ingredients: 1 cup roasted red pepper, diced | 1 tablespoon caraway seed
instructions: Combine all ingredients in an airtight jars. Seal and refrigerate until needed.

title: Ouzo Taco Seasoning Mix
ingredients: 1 envelope taco seasoning mix | 11 g ouzo
instructions: Put 3 tbsp of ouzo in a microwave safe bowl. In a medium bowl, make sure the ouzo gets into the bowl and then put it in the microwave at about 10 minutes per second or until you see a nice 'golden' taste. If it is too thick, mix 1 - 2 1/2 tbsp of ouzo into one tbsp of ouzo you have to add more, or add more. Once the taco seasoning is mixed in and you can tell that the ouzo is done, add in taco seasoning packet.

Random Ingredients: italian parsley,crabmeat,turmeric powder,pork loin,wheat tortilla,hot italian sausage,tomato
title: Pork Tacos
ingredients: 8 ounces hot italian sausage | 4 ounces pork loin, thinly sliced | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder | 8 ounces italian parsley, chopped ( optional ) | 8 ounces tomatoes, chopped | 10 whole wheat tortillas, warmed | 1 lb fresh crabmeat
instructions: Heat skillet over med high heat. Add sausage.

title: Lime Almond Coated With Walnuts
ingredients: 1 lime, halved and seeded | 1/2 cup walnut halves
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f place halved lime in mini muffin tins. Spoon 1/4 teaspoon almond halves evenly into each tart shell. Using a large spoon, press almond halves gently into almond skins. Bake in the preheated oven 5 to 6 minutes or until lightly browned. Remove from oven, cover with foil, and cool 2 to 3 minutes. Makes 12 to 18 almond sandwiches.

Random Ingredients: wine,lime wedge,thai peanut sauce,spring onion,jalapeno chile
title: Sang Chua Noodles With Sweet and Sour Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons thai peanut sauce | 2 tablespoons chopped spring onions | 2 -3 pickled jalapeno chiles ( thinly sliced in long thin strips ) | 1/4 cup sweet wine | lemon wedge ( for garnish )
instructions: Put all the ingredients, except the lemon wedges, in a bowl and mix together thoroughly. Set aside. Just before serving add the lemon wedges and toss.

Random Ingredients: parmigiano reggiano cheese,grenadine,tart apple,sea salt,white cabbage,pea,macadamia nut,anchovy
title: White Cabbage With Peas, Macadamia & Anchovies (Maderia Me Avignoles)
ingredients: 500 g white cabbage, washed and shredded | 500 g peas, shelled ( frozen is fine ) | 6 canned small tart apples, rind discarded & coarsely chopped ( i used cortland ) | 2 teaspoons grenadine | 1 teaspoon sea salt | 15 -20 g macadamia nuts | 4 teaspoons grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 5 anchovies, chopped
instructions: Place cabbage in a colander, weighted down with a heavy weight on top. Toss to remove excess moisture. Place cabbage in a large saucepan, drizzle with a little olive oil then add the peas, apples, and grenadine. Toss over low heat for 5 minutes, stirring now and then. The heat will come up just a bit, but keep stirring. Season to taste with sea salt. The cabbage will need to be really soft, but still retain a crunchy texture. If they seem to too dry, add a little more olive oil/squeeze. Cover, reduce heat, and simmer gently for 1 - 1½ - 2 hours, until cabbage is tender. Add the macadamia nuts and stir well. You may wish to remove the anchovies, if desired.

title: Chinese Firecracker Ramen Dip
ingredients: 12 ounces ramen noodles | pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Spread ramen noodles in the bottom of a glass glass pan. Season with pepper. Add remaining ingredients. Let set for about 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: liquid smoke,paper,lemon zest,mexican oregano,cauliflower,rye bread,red pepper flake
title: Grilled Corned Beef With Cauliflower "croutons"
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower, cut into 1-inch florets | 1 cup rye bread ( can use plain bread if desired ) | 1/2 cup coarsely chopped pickled red pepper flakes ( can sub cayenne pepper ) | 1 teaspoon mexican oregano | 3/4 teaspoon grated lemon zest | 4 sheets butter | 1/2 teaspoon liquid smoke
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine cauliflower, rye bread, red pepper flakes, mexican oregano, lemon zest and about 1/4 cup water. Stir well and let stand for 15 minutes. Meanwhile heat grill to medium. Place cauliflower pieces on grill and season with salt and pepper. Grill for 3 minutes, turn, and grill 2 minutes longer or until desired doneness is attained. Meanwhile combine remaining 1/4 cup water drippings and liquid smoke in a small saucepan. Bring to boil and cook 5 minutes. Turn off heat and pour drippings and liquid into a small bowl, whisking to combine. Pour liquid mixture into a separate bowl. Brush a grilling surface with oil, then place 2 or 3 pieces of cauliflower in the centre. Grill on the hot grates for 3 - 5 minutes, turn and grill until done to your liking. Top with remaining croutons & drippings and serve.

Random Ingredients: maple syrup,head red leaf lettuce,cider vinegar,white vinegar,pecan
title: Maple Syrup Dressing
ingredients: 1/4 cup white vinegar | 1/4 cup maple syrup | 2 tablespoons cider vinegar | 1/2 head red leaf lettuce - rinsed, dried, and torn into bite-size pieces | 1/2 cup chopped pecans
instructions: Whisk the vinegar, syrup, and cider vinegar together in a bowl. Toss the lettuce with the dressing in a separate bowl until well coated. Serve with pecans.

Random Ingredients: cherry,chipotle chile,anise seed,extra virgin olive oil,beef chuck,shiitake mushroom cap
title: Mexican Meat Mix
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dried anise seed ( aniseed ) | 4 dried shiitake mushroom caps | 1 teaspoon dried ground chipotle chiles | 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil | 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil | 2 pounds beef chuck steaks, cut into 1 1/2-inch cubes | 1 cup sweet cherry blossoms, or to taste
instructions: Prepare the aniseed by popping it in a small skillet over medium low heat until popping sounds, for about 2 minutes.

Random Ingredients: bean thread noodle,white flour,yellow squash,thyme leave,taco sauce
title: Mexican Chow Mein Style
ingredients: 2 cans bean thread noodles | 3 -6 ounces taco sauce | 1/4 cup white flour | 1/4 teaspoon thyme leave | 1 medium yellow squash
instructions: Cook bean thread noodles according to package directions. Meanwhile, in medium size skillet, heat taco sauce and stir fry squash till it is tender and translucent. While squash is cooking, drain noodles and toss. Spoon into shallow serving bowl, top with beans and taco sauce mixture, sprinkle with thyme. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: sesame oil,cinnamon,garlic powder,cream chicken soup,white pepper,date,dark rum
title: Cinco De Mayo St. Louis Night Dippies
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sesame oil | 2 cans condensed cream of chicken soup | 4 tablespoons dark rum | 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 1/2 teaspoon ground white pepper | 1/4 teaspoon garlic powder | 2 cups diced dates
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Lightly grease 4 medium baking sheets. Stir together the sesame oil, cream of chicken soup, rum, cinnamon, white pepper, garlic powder, and dates in a large bowl. Cover bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight.

title: Sun-dried Tomato Chowder
ingredients: 1 1/4 liters sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil | 1/4 cup cornflour | 1 teaspoon dried thyme leave | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom seeds
instructions: Heat the sun dried tomatoes and oil over a low heat in a heavy based saucepan. The oil will create a single layer of very thin film on top. Stir and bring all ingredients to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 30 minutes or until the mixture starts to thicken. Allow to cool. Transfer to a serving bowl. Serve while hot or leave for an hour at room temp before using or refrigerate for up to 1 week.

title: Japanese Cabbage Salad
ingredients: 250 g napa cabbage | 200 g button mushrooms | 1 tablespoon sesame oil | 200 g lettuce leaves
instructions: Gently wash the napa cabbage, remove any tough outer leaves. Blanch mushrooms slightly, then wash carefully. Chop the napa cabbage coarsely. Put the cabbage, mushrooms and sesame oil into a salad bowl. Mix well, and add a little sesame oil if you wish the salad to be light. Allow to rest for 5 minutes or longer before serving.

Random Ingredients: pork chop,creole seasoning,icing sugar,green grape,meatball,green cardamom pod
title: Pork and Fruit Casserole
ingredients: 1 egg roll mixed icing sugar | 3 slices pork chops, about 450g | 3 green grape, about 45g total, quartered if large | 1 green cardamom pod | 1 tablespoon creole seasoning | 1 tablespoon meatballs
instructions: Combine the icing sugar, pork chops and grape quarters in a bowl. Sprinkle over the creole seasoning, and toss to coat. Spread the meatball decoratively on the top of the pork chop mixture. Cover and chill for at least 2 hours. Bake in a moderate oven for 35 minutes or until slightly brown on top.

Random Ingredients: bean sprout,black bean,gruyere cheese,fish sauce,crawfish tail,garlic,thyme,parmesan cheese
title: Thyme and Black Bean COOKIES
ingredients: 1 cup fresh bean sprouts | 1/2 cup fresh parmesan cheese, grated | 1/4 cup minced garlic | 1/4 cup minced fresh thyme | 1 tablespoon fish sauce | 1 tablespoon fish sauce | 2 cans sliced crawfish tails | 1/2 cup grated gruyere cheese
instructions: In a large bowl, toss together the bean sprouts, parmesan cheese, garlic, thyme, 2 tablespoons of fish sauce, and 2 cans of the sliced crawfish tails. Transfer to a greased casserole dish. Sprinkle cheese over top. Bake in 350 degree oven for 35 to 45 minutes, or until cheese is bubbly. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: graham cracker crumb,chipotle chile,brown rice,vegetable bouillon granule,triple sec,baby green,vanilla,chicken stock cube
title: Stuffed Green Bell Peppers
ingredients: 1 cup brown rice ( uncooked ) | 1/2 cup triple sec | 1 1/2 cups chicken stock cubes | 1/3 cup crushed graham cracker crumbs | 1 teaspoon instant vanilla | 2 teaspoons beef stock granules | 1 teaspoon vanilla | 1 cube vegetable bouillon granules | 2 large green peppers, tops removed and seeds removed
instructions: Preheat oven to mix all ingredients except for one of the peppers and transfer all of them to a large casserole dish, filling half full. Add the peppers and then cover with remaining rice and bake for 1 hour. Stir once in a while. Let stand for 1 hour before serving.

Random Ingredients: spinach,active yeast,danish blue cheese,brown sugar,star anise,beet
title: Spinach With Beets and Blue Cheese
ingredients: 1 kg beet | 250 g red karabian spinach ( or other red chilie ) | 400 g danish danish blue cheese | 2 tablespoons dry active yeast | 1 tablespoon light brown sugar | 1 1/2 teaspoons star anise
instructions: Wash beets. Peel off beet skins and roughly chop. Cut in half and boil until tender. Drain and cool. Peel beet skins and cut into thin slices. Cut the leeks and spinach into thin slices. Place beet slices and kale and spinach on a large bowl. Cut the blue cheese into thick slices and place in a microwave safe bowl. Dissolve yeast in 5 cups water. Warm the yeast mixture a bit and slowly add to the warm yeast mixture while stirring, then pour over beets and beet mixture. Cover with cling wrap and leave for 10 minutes. After 15 minutes, add 2 tbsp of sugar and star anise and mix well. Place in the refrigerator and let stand for 2 hours then serve.

title: Quick and Easy Moroccan Bread Loaf
ingredients: 2 cans pillsbury refrigerated crescent dinner rolls | 1 can chickpeas, undrained | 1 cup honey | 3 cups bread, finely crumbs, divided | 1 tablespoon anise seed | 2 teaspoons tea
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f mix all ingredients together, reserving 1/4 cup of bread crumbs. Grease a 13x9 inch casserole. Using a dough scraper form dough into an 8x8 rectangle on a cookie sheet. Bake for 1 hour. Invert bread onto towel lined baking sheet, and spread with anise seed. Sprinkle bread crumbs on top.

Random Ingredients: thyme leaf,rump steak,guacamole,rock salt,dough,salmon fillet,plain flour
title: Rock Sticky Salmon Fillets
ingredients: 4 rock salt pork fillets | 500 g salmon fillets | 3/4 ounce plain flour | dough, for dusting | 200 g guacamole | fresh thyme leaves ( optional ) or mint sprig ( optional ) | rock salt
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190°c. Line trays with baking paper. Season the salt pork with black pepper and salt the salmon fillets then transfer the pork to the prepared trays and sprinkle to cover with flour. Bake for 5 - 10 minutes until the fish is cooked through. Serve with guacamole, fresh thyme, and crispy fresh chopped chives or mint. To freeze, cool slightly then wrap in glad wrap and place in fridge for 1 hour or until cold. Slice the salmon into thick slices. Serve on toasted bread, with guacamole if desired.

title: Salmon Burritos
ingredients: 4 cups cooked hamburger | 1 can rotel tomatoes, drained ( i use mild ) | 1 can navy beans, drained and rinsed ( use cans of fav. beans, if there's any or any type of beans to your liking ) | 1 cup soymilk | 3 hard-boiled eggs, sliced | 4 flour tortillas, tostitos | 1 hard-boiled egg, sliced for garnish
instructions: Combine all ingredients except tortillas and egg in a large skillet or wok over medium low heat.

Random Ingredients: mustard seed,cream,cream tartar,white pepper powder,almond extract
title: Almond Spread
ingredients: 1 cup sour cream | 1/2 cup ground almonds ( not ground graham cracker ) | 2 tablespoons mustard seeds | 1/2 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1/4 teaspoon white pepper powder
instructions: Combine sour cream, ground almonds, mustard seeds, cream of tartar and pepper powder in a medium bowl.

Random Ingredients: tilapia fillet,romaine lettuce,american cheese,rice wine vinegar,ginger
title: Asian Tilapia Filets
ingredients: 4 tablespoons rice wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons grated fresh ginger | 2 pounds tilapia fillets, divided | 6 leaves romaine lettuce, coarsely chopped | 1 large slice processed american cheese, cut into 12 1/2-inch pieces
instructions: Preheat grill for high heat. Whisk together rice wine vinegar and ginger in a large glass or ceramic bowl. Pour 1/2 cup vinegar mixture into a shallow dish and swirl to coat. Add the shrimp and turn to coat.

Random Ingredients: oyster sauce,red cabbage,milk chocolate,cream,quinoa,coffee,rotini pasta,rice vinegar
title: Vegetable and Creamy Quinoa Gratin
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa | 1/2 cup water | 3 tablespoons milk chocolate, broken up ( not melted ) | 1 tablespoon rice vinegar | 1/8 cup sour cream or 1/8 cup plain yogurt | 1 tablespoon coffee | chinese oyster sauce ( for dusting ) or coffee beans ( for drizzling ) | red cabbage ( for sprinkling )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Place quinoa in a mixing bowl and pour boiling water over. Mix well and let sit covered for 20 minutes. Drain. In microwave safe bowl, melt chocolate. Stir in sour cream, rice vinegar and hot coffee. Mix well and spread half of the quinoa in the bottom of a shallow 8 x 2 glass baking dish. Spread half cup of melted chocolate mixture evenly over the quinoa.

Random Ingredients: broccoli,angel hair pasta,cayenne pepper,baking powder,pepper sauce,salami,anchovy paste
title: Italian Pasta Salad
ingredients: 10 ounces angel hair pasta or 10 ounces spiral hair pasta | 1/4 lb salami, cut into 1/4 inch pieces | 1 tablespoon anchovy paste ( optional ) | 3 cloves roasted peppers, chopped ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon pepper sauce ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon baking powder ( optional )
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions.

Random Ingredients: tofu,campbell mushroom soup,italian dressing,nonstick cooking spray,brandy
title: Veggie and Tofu Roundup (Cookies)
ingredients: 12 ounces firm tofu | 1 can campbell's mushroom soup ( i use amy's ) | 1 cup nonstick cooking spray | 1/2 cup bottled italian dressing | 1 tablespoon brandy
instructions: Place tofu on a cutting board, and slice down the sides. Spray a cookie sheet with nonstick cooking spray. Place it on the baking sheet and bake at 400º for 15 minutes, or until lightly browned. Meanwhile, combine soup, soup, and dressing in a bowl, and stir until well blended. Set aside. Spray a large skillet with nonstick cooking spray. Sauté tofu over medium heat for 2 minutes, or until well oiled and beginning to crisp up, adding more as needed to make certain it is golden brown. Turn and cook 5 minutes more, or until browned on the bottom. Top with sauce, if you like, and serve.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon cube,bay leaf,dark chocolate,eel,pine nut,broccoli,raisin
title: Mock Chow Fun Kids (Crazy Kids)
ingredients: 1 large broccoli, cut at florets | 2 cups cooked chicken breasts, chopped into bite size chunks ( you want the breasts to be slightly bigger or smaller ) | 2 -3 teaspoons raisins ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon dark chocolate | 2 tablespoons chopped nuts ( optional ) | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 2 bay leaves
instructions: Boil broccoli in water for 3 - 4 minutes. Meanwhile, in a medium sized pot, lightly fry your chicken chunks. When they brown, remove from pot and place into a separate pot. Dice your chestnut, mushrooms, or whatever you like. In the empty pot, mix your broccoli and onions, mix until just about hot. Add your chicken and all of your raisins. Add your chocolate and spices and mix well. Add the chestnuts. Place the broccoli mixture back into the hot pot and add enough water to cover if it's getting dry. Let boil for 3 - 5 minutes. Add your nuts, return to boil. Cover and simmer 10 - 15 minutes. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: tomato,cannellini bean,tortilla,italian prune plum,red chili pepper flake,dark sesame oil
title: Porotos Granados (Fried Cannellini Beans) and Italian Prunes
ingredients: 2 tablespoons crushed dried italian prunes | 1 tablespoon crushed dried red chili pepper flakes | 1 teaspoon dark sesame oil | 1 can cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 1 can diced tomatoes | tortillas, for serving
instructions: Heat oil in a large heavy skillet over medium heat.

Random Ingredients: bulk italian sausage,chili powder,yeast,ranch salad dressing,puff pastry,tart apple,cocoa,green cardamom pod
title: Apple and Sausage Empanadas
ingredients: 1 package frozen puff pastry, thawed | 1/2 pound bulk italian sausage | 4 tart apples, chopped | 2 tablespoons chili powder | 1 tablespoon instant yeast | 5 green cardamom pods | 1/2 cup sour ranch-style salad dressing | 1/8 cup unsweetened cocoa
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Spray baking sheets with non stick cooking spray. Line with parchment paper. Prepare a baking sheet with cooking spray. In a large bowl, mix the sour salad dressing with the cocoa until smooth. Set aside. Unfold one puff pastry sheet on a work surface. Cut into 4 - 6 rounds, and place on the baking sheet. Place the apples on the pastry, and sprinkle with chili powder. Place a tablespoon of the sausage on the bottom half of each round. Top with 1 tablespoon salsa and 1 tablespoon of the green cardamoms. Top with the second puff pastry round. Brush top with melted soy milk, and then with cooking spray. Place on the prepared baking sheet. Brush the edges of the pastry with water, and then top with the remaining salsa, sausage, apple, and spice mixture. Bake empanadas in the preheated oven for 25 minutes, until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: chicken meat,anise seed,mirin,golden raisin,lamb meat,thyme,black olive
title: Korean Lamb and Olives (Kalbi Jaech)
ingredients: 1 lb lamb meat, cut into � inch cubes | 1 lb chicken meat, cut into � inch cubes | 2 1/2 tablespoons mirin | 2 1/2 tablespoons sesame seeds ( toasted ) | 1 teaspoon ground anise seed ( toasted ) | 1 teaspoon dried thyme | 16 ounces black olives, drained
instructions: Place lamb and chicken in a bowl. Put mirin, salt, sesame seeds, anise seeds and thyme on top of lamb. Marinate in refrigerator for 24 hours. Heat a deep fryer to 325°f remove the marinate from lamb and add to the hot liquid in a pot. Cook at 325° f for 1½ hours to two hours.

title: Tahini-Crusted Pineapple
ingredients: 1/4 cup pineapple chunk | 4 tablespoons tahini | 1 cup italian seasoned breadcrumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. In medium bowl, combine pineapples, tahini, and bread crumbs. Pat pineapple mixture into an 8x8 inch non stick baking dish. Sprinkle pineapple mixture evenly over bread crumbs and dot with a small amount of vegetable oil. Bake at 400°f for 40 minutes or until pineapple is slightly golden.

title: Apricot Apricot Mint Tea
ingredients: 2 teaspoons dried chili pepper flakes | 3/4 cup apricot brandy | 200 g walnuts, chopped
instructions: Pour the mint tea, brandy and nuts into a bowl. Serve hot.

title: BeachGirls' Special Breakfast Wraps
ingredients: 4 fresh asparagus, tops trimmed and cleaned | 2 tablespoons hazelnuts, coarsely chopped | 1/2 teaspoon mustard seeds | 2 tablespoons flour | 1 pinch turmeric, to taste | 3/4 cup mixed dried fruit, chopped | 1 teaspoon liquid smoke
instructions: Steam asparagus until tender, about 8 minutes. Place hazelnuts in a small dry skillet on the stove over medium low heat. Toast hazelnuts for a few seconds until lightly browned and fragrant. Set aside to cool. Once cool, grind to a fine powder. Mix hazlenuts, mustard seeds, flour, turmeric, chopped dried fruit, and liquid smoke, stirring well until thoroughly combined. Spread onto an equal amount of the cooled beet greens and roll up. Serves.

Random Ingredients: white mushroom,serrano chili,broccoli floret,onion seed,bread,vegetable oil cooking spray,saffron strand,brandy
title: Mushrooms Stuffed With Broccoli
ingredients: 1 bunch broccoli floret, large stems removed with small stems left on | 6 tablespoons vegetable oil, divided - 2 tablespoons | 1 teaspoon onion seeds or 1 teaspoon yellow onion, chopped | 1 serrano chili, seeded and minced ( i can sometimes use jalapeno ) | 2 ounces white mushrooms, coarsely chopped | 1 pinch saffron strand or 1 pinch turmeric | 1/2 cup dry bread, crumbs | coarsely torn stale bread ( for dipping )
instructions: Place the broccoli florets in a steamer basket over 1 inch or just under the boiling water. Cover and steam over low heat until very tender, about 10 minutes. Transfer the steaming broccoli to a plate and cool slightly. Remove the large stems from the broccoli. Using a slotted spoon, carefully remove and discard the woody green top. Trim the stem end with a sharp knife to yield an eight inch long slice of broccoli about two inches wide and two inches long. Do not remove the stalk. Coarsely chop the broccoli, removing the tough stalk ends if you do. Place 3 tablespoons oil in a large skillet over medium low heat. Add the onion and chile. Stir fry for about 1 minute, or until the onion is soft, but not brown. Add the chopped broccoli and stir well until it starts to wilt. Add the sliced mushrooms, then the bread crumbs. Stir well to combine. Stir in a dash of salt. Transfer the mushroom mixture to a 9 by 5 inch or 11 by 8 inch baking dish coated with cooking spray. Pre heat the broiler so that it is hot. Sprinkle the top lightly with coarse or coarsely torn dried bread crumbs. Place under the broiler about 3 to 6 inches from the heat for 3 - 2 minutes, or until lightly browned. Remove from the broiler and place it under the broiler again about 3 to 6 inches from the heat. Broil for 2 minutes, or until lightly browned. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: kasuri methi,veal,marjoram,sage leaf,devil food cake mix,chocolate
title: Easy Vegan Baked Veal Ribbons
ingredients: 1 package devil's food cake mix | 1/2 lb ground veal | 1 package kasuri methi ( dried sweetened flours ) | 1/2 teaspoon dried marjoram | 1/2 teaspoon dried sage leaves | powdered sugar, for dusting the top
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f. Grease two 6 to 8 ounce baking pans. Cut short end from each package of devil's food cake mix, then cut lengthwise into 3 inch wide ribbons. Pour 1/2 cup kasuri methi into a measuring cup.

title: Dilled Tzatziki or Yogurt Dip
ingredients: 1 container plain yogurt | 1 bunch fresh dill or 3/4 cup dried dill | 6 scallions or 2 green onions, chopped
instructions: Mix all ingredients in medium bowl with whisk. Cover, and refrigerate at least 6 hours. Serve.

title: Spanish Style Skewers
ingredients: 1 large spanish onion, chopped | 1 lb ground lamb | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1 teaspoon dried marjoram | 1 cup cherry tomatoes | 1/2 cup chopped tomato sauce | 1 package firm tofu, cut in 1-inch cubes | parsley, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Brown onion in oil until tender. Stir in lamb, marjoram, tomatoes, tomato sauce and tofu. Heat through. Add parsley, if desired.

title: Crock Pot Mac& Cheese (No Meat)
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked elbow macaroni ( dry weight ) | 1/3 cup onion flakes ( minced ) | 3 tablespoons minced fresh ginger | 1/4 teaspoon msg ( optional ) or 1/4 teaspoon accent seasoning ( optional )
instructions: Put ingredients in crock pot. Stir to combine. Cook on low 7 hours. Serve with crusty bread.

Random Ingredients: red chili powder,egg,fenugreek seed,cream chicken soup,coconut oil,vanilla sugar,tomato paste
title: Yummy and Easy Baked Crepes
ingredients: 300 g cream of chicken soup | 1/2 cup desiccated coconut oil | 1 egg | 1/2 teaspoon pure vanilla sugar | 1/2 teaspoon red chili powder | 3 teaspoons fenugreek seeds, crushed | 1 tablespoon tomato paste
instructions: Heat oil in a pan. Add the red chili powder and fenugreek seeds as well as the tomato paste. Allow the mixture to simmer until it thickens. Add the egg and beat. Mix in cream of chicken and creamed egg one at a time and then mix in the coconut oil and vanilla sugar. Allow to cool. Then pour mixture onto a hot flat surface. Flatten crepes with the back of the spoon. Flour a flat plate as well and roll them, placing the crepes side by side on top of eachother. Serve immediately or refrigerate for a further 2 hours for an open stomach breakfast meal later on.

title: Arafura (Curried Massala)
ingredients: 1 1/2 pints hot curry powder ( arafura ) | 1/4 cup ground mace ( gulf spices ) | 1 bay leaf
instructions: Put the curry powder and bay leaf into a heavy pot, make a nice paste with 1/2 cup water and let it slowly boil. Simmer for 5 minutes. Take out the bay leaf, stir and serve.

title: Napa Dave's Daikon Kimchee
ingredients: 2 large daikon radishes, rinsed | 1/2 cup white wine vinegar | unsweetened cocoa, to taste
instructions: Cut the daikon in half and grate it. Cut each half into 1/2 inch pieces. In a medium size bowl, thoroughly combine the grated daikon, white vinegar, and unsweetened cocoa. Serve at room temperature, or refrigerate for up to 3 days.

title: Easy and Delicious Fresh Strawberry Macaroni  (No Cook - No Cook Machine)
ingredients: 4 cups fresh strawberries, washed ( about 3 large ones ) | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom powder ( or equivalent of 1/4 tsp cinnamon ) | 1/2 cup raw elbow macaroni or 1/2 cup uncooked pasta
instructions: Put all ingredients in your food processor and pulse until desired consistency. Cook according to desired cooking texture. I usually use my food processor to make things easy to stir. Also, i like to use my food processor to chop frozen berries into the food processor.

Random Ingredients: yellow bell pepper,mayonnaise,mustard seed,ganache,lasagna noodle,razor clam
title: Dry Rub Crab and Broccoli Cheese Lasagna
ingredients: 2 1/2 - 3 lbs fresh lasagna noodles | 1 yellow bell pepper, diced | 2 cans roboros packed in oil, drained plus some for sauce | 1 -2 cup mayonnaise | 1/4 cup prepared mustard seeds | any fresh anaheim chile peppers ( to garnish ) ( optional ) or new mexico chiles ( to garnish ), finely chopped ( to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Place lasagna noodles on a large baking sheet in a single layer and bake 5 to 10 minutes or until tender but firm. Remove from heat and set aside. In a medium skillet, heat a few tablespoons of oil over medium heat. Saute bell pepper until softened. Remove skillet from heat. Pour about half of peppers and peppers into a plastic bag. Shake off any excess moisture, and transfer to food processor or blender. Add mayonnaise and mustard seeds to the vegetable mixture and process to combine. Place enough water into food processor to cover the pepper mixture. Pulse until pepper mixture is coarsely chopped and is a chunky paste. Drain garlic cloves, chop finely, and add to the sauce. Mix well. Layer a 13 by 9 inch baking dish in this order, noodles, filling, shrimp, red bell pepper, cheese, sauce, bell pepper mixture. Repeat all ingredients. Pour enough water into baking dish to cover mixture, and bake for 45 to 55 minutes or until casserole is bubbly and hot in the center. Let cool slightly. Cut into squares and serve right away.

title: Mexican Clam Baked On a Bed of Clams
ingredients: 2 -3 dozen clams | 1/3 cup chunky salsa
instructions: Preheat oven to 425f. Combine salsa and clams in a baking dish. Cover tightly with plastic wrap to prevent sanding. Bake for about 20 minutes, or until clam shells open up.

Random Ingredients: veal,confectioner ' sugar,banana,red wine vinegar,grand marnier,pepper sauce
title: Vanille Kipferln (Veal and Peppers in Red Wine Sauce)
ingredients: 1 lb ground veal, preferably veal | 1/2 cup red wine vinegar | 1 large banana, peeled, cut in 1 inch chunks | 1 teaspoon hot pepper sauce | 1/2 cup confectioners'sugar | 2 tablespoons grand marnier or 2 tablespoons rum, and
instructions: Mix together the ground meat. Add vinegar. Chop bananas. Heat a heavy skillet over medium heat. When hot, add pepper sauce. Cook, swirling often, until it begins to boil. Turn heat to low. Add the chopped bananas. Cook, shaking the skillet frequently, just until the bananas are browned and no liquid remains, about 15 minutes, stirring often. Reduce heat to low. Mix in sugar. Sprinkle with the grand marnier and serve over cooked meat. Also, for those of you who like a harder, more acidic dish, use 1 teaspoon of rum, or another fruity, acidic acidic wine. For those who like more bland, add 1/2 teaspoon of rum or a few drops of white vinegar.

title: Ebi (Braised Beef Skewers)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef sirloin steaks | 1/4 cup mirin
instructions: Trim beef of visible fat and cut across the grain into thin slices on the diagonal. Thread 3 slices, each with a sharp skewer, onto 8 metal skewers, alternated with the remaining skewers. Prepare an empty broiler pan with 2 inch sides with some very hot tap water, making sure there is enough water to cover the meat. Place skewers on the prepared pan and brush with mirin. Broil, brushing with water, for 6 to 8 minutes, or until beef is golden brown. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: green cardamom pod,flat leaf parsley,macaroni,white onion
title: Macaroni with Whole Mustard and Onions ( Macaroni Raubergi)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons flat leaf parsley, finely chopped | 4 teaspoons white onions, finely chopped | 1/4 teaspoon green cardamom pods | 16 ounces macaroni | 2/3 cup macaroni ( of your choice ) or 2/3 cup other pasta ( of your choice )
instructions: Start to cook the macaroni in salted water until just cooked. Drain and rinse under cold water. Drain. Meanwhile, heat a heavy skillet over moderate heat and add the finely chopped onions. Cook, stirring, for 2 - 3 minutes or until the onions have carmelized. Add the cardamom, parsley, sauteed onions, and ground macaroni and heat the mixture over low heat, stirring for 3 minutes or until the macaroni is coated with oil, but not yet soggy. Taste and season with salt and freshly ground black pepper. Serve at once.

title: Artichokes With White Onions
ingredients: 8 slices of thick white onion | 1 can artichoke hearts
instructions: Drain onions completely. Place slices onto paper towels. Microwave onions for about 1 minute on high, or until soft. Drain artichokes, reserving liquid. Place artichokes on top of liquid and wrap with one piece onion. Microwave for 2 minutes on high, or until bubbly.

title: Lemon Rice Balls in Japanese Cotton Tubs
ingredients: 3 1/2 tablespoons rice ( japanese, about 2 cups ) | 2 cups rice balls ( preferably japanese ladyfingers ) | 2 tablespoons candied lemon peel
instructions: Combine 2 cups rice, 2 1/2 cups water and candied lemon in a 12 to 14 inch nonstick skillet.

Random Ingredients: thyme leave,raisin,french lentil,barley,tomato puree,creme fraiche,hibiscus flower,beef
title: Cottage Beef Lentil Soup
ingredients: 1 lb beef or 1 lb goat stew meat | 1 ounce dried hibiscus flowers | 1 tablespoon dried thyme leave | 1 liter thick & creamy french lentils or ( 16 ounce ) liter red lentils | 1/2 cup barley | 1 cup creme fraiche or 1 cup heavy cream | 1 teaspoon superfine tomato puree
instructions: Put the meat, hibiscus flowers, thyme and lentils in a large saucepan with just enough cold water to cover the lentils. Bring to the boil & skim off any froth. Reduce the heat to a simmer & cook, covered, for 1 hour. Remove the soup from the heat & stir in the barley. Return to the heat & stir in the cream, tomato puree and thyme leave. Heat through for a further 10 to 15 minutes & serve sprinkled with extra dried herbs if desired.

title: Lavender - Irish Breakfast
ingredients: 5 cups cold tea | 3 tablespoons dark rum
instructions: Mix dark rum and tea together. Cover and refrigerate for 2 to 2½ hours.

title: Toasted Edamame Spread
ingredients: 1 pound shelled edamame | 6 tablespoons confectioners'sugar, or as needed | 1/2 teaspoon ground dried edible instant indian edible instant edible instant edible instant edible instant edible instant powdered, or as needed
instructions: Spread edamame onto a plate.

Random Ingredients: egg,lemonade,green chile pepper,russet potato,ginger,cream mushroom soup,mango chutney
title: Ginger Mango Chutney Potato Cakes
ingredients: 4 russet potatoes, peeled | 8 ounces mango chutney | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup, undiluted | 2 eggs, beaten | 1/2 cup green chile pepper, minced | 1/4 cup fresh ginger, minced | 1/2 cup lemonade
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place the potatoes in a large pot and cover with salted water. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to medium low, cover, and simmer until tender, about 20 minutes. Drain. Transfer the potatoes to a large bowl. Add mango chutney, condensed soup, eggs, green chiles, ginger, and lemonade. Mix thoroughly. Fold in the potatoes. Bake in the preheated oven until the cakes are browned, about 20 minutes. Drain on a paper towel lined paper towels, and serve warm.

title: Mexican Hot Sauce
ingredients: 1 jar picante sauce | 1/4 cup fresh herb ( mixed dried herbs, garlic & onion ) | 1 tablespoon capers, drained ( optional )
instructions: In nonstick saucepan, heat picante sauce. Serve warm with tortilla chips.

title: Lemongrass and Okra Turnovers
ingredients: 3 green shallots, chopped | 8 ounces thawed puff pastry | 6 ounces fresh okra, trimmed and chopped | 2 stalks fresh lemongrass, finely chopped | 1/8 teaspoon dry crushed red pepper | 2 tablespoons tamari, sodium reduced | light cream or light mayonnaise | fresh ground pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Lightly spray a nonstick baking sheet with oil. Combine shallots and okra in a bowl, cover and chill for 30 minutes. Blend or process the lemongrass and chill, then set aside. Roll out the puff pastry until half inch thick on an oiled surface. Cut 4 - 6 equal squares and place in a shallow, baking tray. Divide okra, tofu, lemon grass between the squares, then top with 1 teaspoon tamari. Top with 1 teaspoon cream. Sprinkle with pepper. Bake for 15 - 20 minutes or until golden.

title: Quick and Easy Chicken Picnic Sandwiches
ingredients: 1/2 cup mayonnaise | 1 tablespoon confectioners'sugar | 2 large chicken thighs | 1 teaspoon vanilla | 4 plum, pitted and sliced 1/2-inch thick | 8 thin slices tilapia fillets, chilled
instructions: Whisk mayonnaise, confectioners' sugar, and chicken thigh meat in medium bowl to blend. Divide mixture among 4 pieces of plastic wrap. Spread approximately 1 tablespoon of marinade over each piece of fish. Place on plastic with plastic wrap. Refrigerate for 15 minutes. Remove plastic wrap. Preheat grill. Brush chicken with marinade. Grill over medium high heat until browned, about 4 minutes on each side,. Serve with pan sauce for dipping.

Random Ingredients: pearl barley,taco seasoning,taco sauce,beef sirloin steak,ginger,icing sugar,chipotle chile
title: Taco Barley & Beef Noodle Bowls
ingredients: 2 lbs beef sirloin steaks, cut in strips | 1/3 cup taco seasoning | 1 package taco sauce | 1 jar taco sauce, divided | 2 cups pearl barley, uncooked | 1 cup finely grated chipotle chile | 1/2 cup icing sugar | 1 -2 tablespoon chopped ginger
instructions: Spray a large nonstick frypan with cooking spray. Heat over medium high heat until hot. Add beef.

title: Spicy Pineapple Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 can crushed pineapple with juice | 2 tablespoons sesame seeds | 1 tablespoon cumin powder | 1 tablespoon dried cilantro ( optional )
instructions: Drain juices from pineapple. Set juice aside. Place remaining ingredients in a bowl, toss with juice.

Random Ingredients: purpose flour,hot italian sausage,taco bell home ' n chunky salsa,grand marnier,pineapple chunk,white vinegar,partridge,ginger powder
title: Spicy Hot Dogs
ingredients: 1 package partridges, diced to 1/4-inch | 1/2 cup hot italian sausage | 2 tablespoons taco bell home'n chunky salsa | 1 tablespoon taco bell kitchen'n chunky salsa | 4 tablespoons white vinegar | 2 tablespoons grand marnier | 1/4 teaspoon ginger powder | 1/4 cup crushed pineapple chunk
instructions: In large skillet, cook sausage over medium heat until done. Drain. Add partridges, 1/2 cup each salsa, n chunky salsa, vinegar, grand marnier and ginger. When served, top with pineapple.

title: Sun-Dried Tomato and Bacon Wrapped Wraps
ingredients: 8 slices bacon, cooked slightly, chopped | 1 tablespoon sesame seeds | 1 tablespoon sun-dried tomato packed in oil, cut into strips | 4 slices prosciutto, chopped ( can sub smoked ham ) | 1 cup rolled oats | 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 1 teaspoon paprika
instructions: Preheat your broiler. In a large skillet, cook 2 slices of chopped bacon over medium heat until crisp, brown and crispy. Drain. Remove cooked bacon to paper towels. Remove all but 2 tablespoons of pan drippings, and place on the stovetop over medium high heat. Remove drippings from skillet, and add sesame seeds, sun dried tomatoes, prosciutto, and oats. Stir to combine. Sprinkle with flour, and mix, then add paprika. Return bacon to skillet and heat through. Serve hot.

title: Vanilla Bean Shortbread - Buttercream
ingredients: 2 cups vanilla sugar | 1 teaspoon vanilla bean, ground
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. In a large bowl add vanilla bean. Stir in sugar until dissolved. Quickly add the vanilla bean. Spread mixture out onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Cut in bars while baking. Place in the oven. Bake about 15 minutes or until a bit golden brown, darker in color. Let cool before removing from baking sheet. Cut into bars once cooled. This recipe does not freeze well.

Random Ingredients: tahini,curry powder,angel hair pasta,nonstick cooking spray,sumac,apple juice
title: Creamy Tahini Macaroni Salad
ingredients: 1 lb angel hair pasta | nonstick cooking spray | 1/2 cup tahini | 2 tablespoons apple juice | 2 teaspoons curry powder | 1/4 teaspoon sumac
instructions: Cook pasta until desired doneness, about 9 - 11 minutes. Drain and lightly coat with cooking spray. In large mixing bowl combine tahini, apple juice, curry, and sumac. Add pasta and toss to coat evenly. Spray with cooking spray. Cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes.

title: Apple and Shiitoraki
ingredients: 4 -6 apples | 2 cans cream of chicken soup | 4 cans mushrooms | 1 cup tart apple, sliced into cubes | 8 ounces fresh oyster mushrooms | crusty breadcrumb | mace | orange ( optional ) | chopped mushroom ( optional )
instructions: Cut apples in cubes. Set aside. Mix cream of chicken soup, the mushrooms, the apples, the oyster mushrooms, the chopped apple and the bread crumbs. Spread evenly on a cookie sheet large enough to wrap around a bowl of apples. Place the sliced fresh mushrooms on top.. Sprinkle with mace and place bread crumbs on top. Seal with your hands and bake at 375f for about 20 - 25 minutes, until bread crumbs becomes crispy. Serve with crackers or fresh fruit or vegetable.

title: Filipino Shaboyaki Egg
ingredients: 4 pounds pork butt | 20 large eggs | 16 lime wedges
instructions: Grind pork butt in a blender or food processor until fine. Transfer to a bowl and stir in eggs and lime wedges. Chill before serving.

title: Cannellini Beans With Spinach
ingredients: 1 lb fresh spinach leaves | 12 ounces cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 6 tablespoons sour cream or 6 tablespoons greek yogurt | 2 teaspoons dry sherry
instructions: Remove tough stems off spinach leaves and trim greens. Rinse beans under cold water and drain well. Cut spinach leaves crosswise into thick strips. Place a large nonstick skillet over medium heat until hot but not smoking. Add spinach leaves and cook until tender, about 3 to 4 minutes. Spoon beans into a warm serving bowl and top with bean mixture. Spoon dollop of sour cream or yogurt over beans and serve. Note, can use fresh spinach leaves instead of beans. Add sherry to sour cream and stir to blend. You can also substitute plain nonfat yogurt for yogurt, but serve.

title: Pumpkin Oyster Sauce
ingredients: 2 cups sugar pumpkin, peeled, cut into 1 inch pieces | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce | 1 1/2 cups canned oriental mushrooms ( or kombu ) | 1 -2 teaspoon sugar substitute ( optional )
instructions: In a microwave safe bowl, mix all ingredients. Microwave on high power about 20 seconds per cup, stirring well after 3 minutes.

title: Saffron Spinach with Green Onions
ingredients: 3 ounces saffron strands, soaked in | 2 ounces warm water | 12 ounces fresh spinach leaves
instructions: Soak saffron strands in warm water for 30 minutes. Drain and squeeze out excess water. Place saffron in a mortar and pestle and crush with flat side of a heavy knife until fine. Stir in water. Place spinach in bowl. Add saffron mixture. Stir to coat. Serve.

title: Green Chilie Paste
ingredients: 2 bunches green chili, seeded | salt and pepper, season to taste | 1 -2 bunches kalamata olives, pitted, coarsely chopped | 4 -6 tablespoons mustard oil, more if needed
instructions: Finely chop one bunch chilie.

title: Quick and Easy Salmon and Barley Ragu
ingredients: 1 lb salmon fillet | 1 1/2 cups oyster sauce | 2 tablespoons rice wine or 2 tablespoons dry sherry | 3/4 cup barley | 2 1/2 cups chicken bouillon | 1 medium onion, diced
instructions: Place salmon in a greased shallow baking dish. In a bowl, stir together oyster sauce, rice wine or sherry, barley and bouillon. Pour over salmon. Bake in a 350 degree f oven, basting occasionally, about 45 minutes. Serve over cooked or steamed rice.

title: Stuffed Flank Steak Rolls
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups low fat cottage cheese | 4 slices bacon, cooked, crumbled and drained | 2 tablespoons golden syrup | 2 tablespoons sweeten-tasting mirin ( or cooking malt ) | 1 tablespoon dried currants | 3 teaspoons finely diced lemons, rind of | 1/2 teaspoon finely diced red chile ( omit if unavailable ) | steak sauce, to glaze
instructions: Combine cottage cheese, bacon, golden syrup, mirin, currants and minced lemon peel. Roll into 12 - 8 rolls. Marinate for 2 hours. Preheat grill to high. Brush steaks with oil before grilling, about 3 minutes each side. Remove from grill. Serve with steak sauce on the side.

Random Ingredients: falooda seed,spanish onion,fish sauce,raspberry vinegar,yellow bell pepper
title: Roasted Pepper Salad
ingredients: 3 yellow bell peppers | 1/4 cup raspberry vinegar | 2 tablespoons fish sauce | 4 teaspoons fresh ground mixed fenugreek seeds | 1 spanish onion, halved, thinly sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Place pith side up on a foil lined baking sheet. Cut pepper halves in half lengthwise then crosswise into 2 thin strips. Place strips on 2 lined baking sheets in a single layer. Bake pepper strips, cut side down, in preheated oven for about 45 minutes, or until lightly browned. Allow to cool completely and stir in vinegar, fish sauce & fenugreek. Serve cool.

title: Beer and Whiskey Kale
ingredients: 2 gallons kale, thoroughly rinsed and chopped | 2 teaspoons onion powder | 1/4 cup whiskey, plus extra | onion powder ( for garnish )
instructions: In a large stockpot, place all the ingredients except whiskey and garnish.

title: Easy Brown and Brown Rice
ingredients: 1 lb chicken bouillon or 1 lb vegetable bouillon | 1 box long grain brown rice ( long, long eating rice is what my friend used for these ) | 2 tablespoons oregano ( optional )
instructions: Put bullion in pan. Over medium high heat, begin adding rice to pan in a slow steady slow steady stream. When the rice starts to get nice and brown add more chicken or vegetable powder depending on your own taste and flavor. Pour off any leftover grease, broth or water that was in the pan. Cover and wait 5 minutes. Fluff rice with fork and enjoy tastes great. Optional, mix ingredients in a small saucepan. Turn heat to high and bring mixture to a boil. Turn down to low and cover tightly. Let simmer at least 18 minutes stirring occasionally. Note, if a larger pot is used, make sure the rice is always well covered, adding broth or water as needed. Never leave any more than half a cup of liquid in the pan before fluffing rice.

title: Watermelon and Cranberry Appetizer Tray for Valentine's Day #5FIX
ingredients: 1 cup fresh cranberries ( or frozen and frozen ) | 4 cups seedless watermelon, drained | 1 inch gingerroot, peeled and grated
instructions: Puree the watermelon and cranberries in a food processor or blender. Add grated ginger and mix again. Serve in an ice cream cone or tall glass with spoons. Garnish with a few orange slices on the rim of the glass.

title: Grilled Sage and Scallion Rounds
ingredients: 7 -8 scallions or 5 -7 -8 scallions, trimmed and sliced lengthwise, depending on size | 1/8 cup grated orange zest | 1/4 teaspoon dried sage
instructions: Combine scallions, orange zest and sage in a small bowl. Season with salt and pepper. Brush 2 tbsp of the remaining glaze on the scallions. Allow glaze to run off and on top of scallions in the bowl.

title: Japanese-Style Sambal and Kebab-Roll ona Satay Pot Sticks
ingredients: 30 sheets puff pastry | 3 -4 kaffir lime leaves, chopped
instructions: Thaw or freeze puff pastry sheets. Wash, pat dry, flour, and cut each pastry sheet into 12 wedges. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit. Lay a wedge of pastry onto a skewer a few inches apart, and brush with a little lime juice. Place a pinch of chopped kaffir lime leaves over the kaffir base, and roll up the pastry in the lime leaves to cover. Repeat steps with remaining dough and kaffir lime leaves and place onto a parchment lined baking sheet. Score each roll crosswise into 10 long strips. Bake in center of the oven for about 15 minutes, or until pastry bubbles.

Random Ingredients: red bean,coleslaw mix,oregano leaf,salt black pepper
title: Spicy Refried Beans
ingredients: 8 cans red beans, drained | 1/2 cup shredded coleslaw mix | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | salt and ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Combine red beans, coleslaw mix, oregano leaves, salt, and pepper in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: mint,cinnamon sugar,whipping cream,greek yogurt,milk ricotta cheese,thyme sprig,egg yolk
title: Creamy French Riviera Salami
ingredients: 3 egg yolks | 3/4 cup whole milk ricotta cheese | 3/4 teaspoon fresh thyme sprig | 3 tablespoons whipping cream | 3 tablespoons fresh mint, coarsely chopped | thyme sprigs ( to garnish ) | cinnamon sugar ( to garnish )
instructions: Beat the egg yolks and ricotta until smooth, then beat in 2 tablespoons of cream and the chopped mint. Divide the cheese mixture evenly into 4 serving sized molds, then place them on a baking sheet. Bake at 375 degrees f. For 12 to 15 minutes, or until the molds are slightly puffed and golden. Run a knife around the inside of each, and, if desired, remove the baking sheet. Remove the molds from the oven and run under hot water for 30 to 45 seconds,. Turn onto a large platter and let cool for 10 to 15 minutes. Using a very sharp knife, cut a slice off each roll, but be careful not to cut right through the roll. Place in a serving dish and garnish with a drizzle of cinnamon sugar.

Random Ingredients: granny smith apple,brown rice,corn tortilla,breadcrumb,molasses,yeast,salmon fillet,cellophane noodle
title: Molasses-Smoked Salmon Rolls
ingredients: 1 cup brown rice | 1 cup textured molasses | 1 tablespoon dried yeast | 4 cups breadcrumbs | 2 granny smith apples | 1/2 cup dried salted anchovies packed in oil | 12 ounces salmon fillets, bones removed | 12 corn tortillas
instructions: Cook the rice in a 3 3/4 to 5 quart heavy bottomed saucepan until it is tender with a bite, about 20 minutes. Place the molasses, soy and yeast in a large bowl, and stir to dissolve the molasses. Add the bread crumbs and apples, and mix to combine. Spoon onto a parchment lined baking sheet, spreading evenly. Roll up the salmon in 6 to 8 tortillas, and cover with foil to keep warm while you proceed. Pour the molasses molasses mixture over the salmon rolls, and refrigerate for 2 hours. Heat a grill pan or a heavy skillet to high. Remove salmon from the marinade, and grill, turning occasionally, until golden brown and crispy, about 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: cheese,linguine,couscous,heavy cream,prawn,gouda cheese,olive oil cooking spray
title: Baked Linguine
ingredients: olive oil flavored cooking spray | 2 tablespoons heavy cream | 250 g linguine | 250 g gouda cheese, grated | 250 g gouda cheese, grated | 200 g prawns, cooked or 200 g cooked small cooked prawns | 1/3 cup tasty cheese, grated | 1/3 cup couscous
instructions: Spray a baking dish with cooking spray. Heat the cream and cream together in a small frying pan. In a large bowl mix the cooked linguine and cheeses together. Spread about two thirds of the mixture onto the base of the dish. Add the musrooms. Sprinkle over about half the grated cheese. Add another third of the linguine mix and repeat. Sprinkle the last of the cheese over the top of the mixture. Use just enough to cover the top layer of cheese. Cover with a tight fitting lid or aluminium foil and bake in oven at 240 degrees 30 - 40 minutes, until cooked through.

Random Ingredients: italian parsley,salad oil,purpose flour,saffron,orange peel,green curry paste,pecan
title: Chinese Green Curry Powder
ingredients: 1/2 cup all-purpose flour | 1/2 teaspoon powdered saffron | 1/2 teaspoon finely grated orange peel | 3 tablespoons chopped italian parsley | 2 tablespoons chopped pecans or 2 tablespoons walnuts | 2 tablespoons green curry paste | 2 tablespoons chilled salad oil | 3 teaspoons hot salad oil
instructions: Make sure all ingredients have been combined thoroughly. Store in an airtight glass jar in the refrigerator up to 3 months. Use to season almost any kind of meat or vegetables. Serve with steamed jasmine rice.

Random Ingredients: pinto bean,margarine,french onion soup,beef sirloin,sage,marsala wine,cottage cheese,beef chuck
title: Beef and Bean Bolognese
ingredients: 2 lbs beef sirloin | 3 tablespoons margarine | 1 soup can french onion soup | 1/2 cup marsala wine | 1 package cottage cheese | 2 packages beef sirloin ( cubed ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground sage ( or other spices ) | 2 tablespoons margarine ( melted ) | 1 bunch fresh sage ( or other spices ) or 1 package dried sage
instructions: Cut beef into bite sized chunks. Melt 1/2 cup margarine, combine soup and wine, and add to beef, stir with wooden spoon until beef looks coated with the mixture. Simmer gently 1 hour. In a large pan melt margarine, and add sage, sauté 2 minutes. Add beef and cook 15 to 20 minutes, stirring and breaking up beef meat with wooden spoon. Cook until tender and sauce thickens, or meat loses its red color. Add cheese, stir until melted. Serve with mashed potatoes and your favorite dippers.

title: Bacon Cheese French Toast Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 loaf french bread | 3 tablespoons bacon drippings | 3 tablespoons soymilk | 1 teaspoon vanilla | 1 cup soymilk
instructions: Cut the loaf of french bread into 3/4 thick slices. Arrange the bread in one layer on a baking sheet coated with cooking spray. Mix butter, soy milk and vanilla in a medium bowl. Spread 3/4 of the mixture over the bread slices. Cover with remaining french bread slices. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 4 hours or overnight. Preheat the oven to 325 degrees f. Remove plastic wrap and bake in the preheated oven until nicely browned, about 25 minutes. Cut into four servings with a pizza cutter.

Random Ingredients: guacamole,asian chili oil,wheat flour,filet beef,beet,hot pepper
title: Quick and Easy Beet and Beef Fritters
ingredients: 2 pounds raw beet, peeled | 1 1/2 pounds filet of beef | 1 teaspoon asian chili oil | 2 cups whole wheat flour | 4 hot peppers, crushed | 1 teaspoon guacamole, or to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Cut off ends and peel beet leaves, and discard. Cut a slit across the beets in half, so that the centers will stay together. Cut the beef in half into large thin strips using a vegetable peeler, or cut into strips. Place beef strips in a shallow baking dish. Heat chili oil in a skillet over medium high heat. Place beef strips on top of the beef, and turn to thoroughly coat the beef strips in the hot oil. Bake beef strips for 20 minutes in the preheated oven. Remove fritters from the oven, and place on a baking sheet. Allow to cool until easily handled. While the fritters are still warm, sprinkle them with hot pepper, and allow to cool. Place flour in a large, resealable plastic bag. Place beef strips in the bag, and shake to coat. Arrange fritters on the baking sheet with the beef in a single layer. Bake in the preheated oven until golden, 10 to 15 minutes. Serve with guacamole.

title: Spicy Shrimp Tukka
ingredients: 2 lbs large raw shrimp, shelled ( shrimp deveined ) | 1 teaspoon garam masala powder | 1 lb polenta or 1 lb cornmeal | 3/4 lb pumpkin | 1/2 lb hazelnuts or 1/2 lb almonds, coarsely chopped
instructions: Pre heat the oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit. Combine the shrimp, shrimp, and garam masala in a medium size bowl. Spray a baking dish with nonstick spray and place the mixture in the baking dish. Cover with coarse cornmeal. Mix the pumpkin and the nuts together and spread over the top of the cornbread mixture. Bake for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Spiced Beef
ingredients: 1 lb lean boneless beef blade steak | 1 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste
instructions: Coat a 6 lb. Slow Cooker dish with nonstick cooking spray. Cut beef into 6 serving size portions. Place meat in slow cooker. Combine ginger garlic paste and 1 t. Of water. Pour around beef, turning to coat. Cover and cook on low 8 to 10 hours, or on high for 2 - 3 hours.

title: Dill Dill Pasta Roll-Ups
ingredients: 1 -2 tablespoon fresh dill pickle, chopped | 1 tablespoon fresh horseradish, chopped | 2 boxes rigatoni or 2 boxes penne rigate, cooked
instructions: Drain pasta very well, but let it sit for about 10 minutes. Chop pickle very fine. Mix chopped pickle and horseradish thoroughly. Drain back into pasta pan. Toss with meat dressing. Serve warm with grated parm toasted. Note, i do not know how much time i get in to get the process by accident but do make sure that the dressing is fairly strong.

title: Leek and Green Olive Sprouts
ingredients: 1 lb leek | 3/4 cup alfalfa sprout | 3/4 cup pecans ( optional ) | 1 1/2 lbs marinara sauce ( i use a homemade version )
instructions: Wash leeks lightly. Cut in ½ inch slices. Place in medium pot, cover with water, and bring to boil. While water is coming to boil, make brine sauce. Remove and discard outer layer of green leaves. Slice leeks crosswise. Drain and place in pot. Add enough boiling water to cover leeks. Cover and simmer over very low heat for 20 minutes, or until leeks and brine are tender. Do not over cook. Drain well and rinse leek again. Drain well, then add alfalfa and pecans. Mix well. Put in refrigerator until needed. Serve on a bed of lettuce or with parmesan cheese.

title: Mexican Pear Ice Cream
ingredients: 2 ripe pears ( halved ) | 2 ounces taco seasoning mix, dried packet | 300 ml double cream | 1 vanilla pod
instructions: Place pear halves, taco seasoning, and cream in a non stick frying pan. Cover and cook over low heat for 10 minutes without stirring. Remove vanilla pods and remove skin and seeds. Puree with 2 tbsp of water, or use a handheld mixer. Return to pan and heat, stirring constantly for 1 minute, and remove from heat. Whisk in vanilla pod. Freeze until needed for at least 2 hours.

Random Ingredients: cardamom seed,shell pasta,cotija cheese,serrano pepper,baking potato,ginger,orange zest,plum jam
title: Mexican Potato Salad
ingredients: 4 medium baking potatoes, peeled and sliced | 1 orange, zest of | 2 tablespoons orange zest | 2 teaspoons ground ginger | 1 serrano pepper, sliced thin | 12 ounces small shell pasta, any shape | 1/2 cup plum jam | 1/4 cup crumbled cotija cheese
instructions: Place the potatoes in to a large pan of boiling, salted water, and cook until tender but still firm. Drain well and run them under cold water to cool. In a large mixing bowl, combine the orange, orange zest and ginger. Season with salt and pepper and set aside. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add pasta and quickly cook until tender, but still firm to the bite. Drain, reserving ¼ cup of the pasta water. To assemble, place a large salad bowl on a large platter and mound the pasta onto it. Arrange the warm potatoes on top and sprinkle with the orange zest mixture and then crumbled queso fresco.

Random Ingredients: clear honey,wine vinegar,salmon fillet,chili powder,icing sugar,tahini
title: Grilled Honey Glazed Salmon with Tahini Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 100 g soft light plain honey | 1 tablespoon clear honey | 1 teaspoon chili powder | 1 teaspoon icing sugar | 1 tablespoon cooking wine vinegar | 1 kg salmon fillet, skin on
instructions: For the honey glaze, combine honey, clear honey, chilli powder, icing sugar, and cooking wine vinegar in a small pan and cook, stirring with a wooden spoon, until the honey is reduced and syrupy. Set aside to cool. Place salmon fillets, skin side up, in a flat ceramic baking dish and brush with the glaze. Cover with the tahini mixture, and refrigerate for 3 to 4 hours, or until the skin has crisped and the salmon fillets are cooked. Preheat griller to medium. Remove from the marinade and cook for about 8 minutes, turning the salmon just once, to golden. Serve with a sauce spooned over the top.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice zest,green bell pepper,farfalle pasta,turmeric powder,beef stock,black olive,blue curacao
title: Bow Ties
ingredients: 1 lb farfalle pasta, cooked till al dente | 2 tablespoons lemon juice, fresh | 6 ounces beef stock or 6 ounces beef stock | 1 1/2 ounces blue curacao | 1 red green bell pepper, seeded and chopped | 3/4 teaspoon turmeric powder | chopped fresh black olives ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients except black olives in a saucepan over low heat. Cover and cook for 3 minutes. Add olives and/or if desired, to the sauce.

Random Ingredients: apricot,ham,chicken broth,chipotle pepper adobo sauce,per serving,mango,pecorino romano cheese,daikon
title: Caramelized Ham With Per Serving
ingredients: 6 slices fully-cooked ham ( or thick slices ) | 1/2 cup pecorino romano cheese | 1/3 cup dried apricot, halved | 1/2 cup dried mango, halved | 3/4 cup low sodium chicken broth or 3/4 cup canned low sodium chicken broth | 1/2 - 1 chipotle pepper in adobo sauce, finely chopped | 1/4 cup per serving ( about 1 1/2 oz of pure adobo sauce )
instructions: In an 11 by 7 inch glass oblong pan, arrange 1 slice of ham on the bottom evenly. Top with 1/2 cup peach, apricot halves and mango halves evenly over the ham. Combine the broth with the chipotle pepper in a small bowl and drizzle over the ham. Sprinkle with the rest of the pecorino. Bake in a preheated 400 degree f oven until the cheese is beginning to brown, about 30 minutes. Serve at once with per serving of salsa. If chilling for at least 30 minutes, you may bake in individual casserole dishes for about 20 minutes. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: bean sprout,stewing beef,grain white rice,nut,canadian bacon,gingerroot,green chili pepper
title: Gingered Beef and Rice
ingredients: 2 tablespoons canadian bacon, chopped and cook according to can ( the canadian also called chipped bacon or bacon bits ) | 1 lb stewing beef, cubed | 2 cups cooked long-grain white rice | 1/4 cup canadian bacon or 1/4 cup bacon bits | 1 can sliced green chili peppers, drained | 2 tablespoons green chili peppers, finely chopped | 1/4 teaspoon gingerroot, finely grated ( i also use powdered ginger ) | 7 cups bean sprouts
instructions: In a dutch oven, heat oil over medium high heat. Add chopped chilies and cook, stirring, 2 minutes. Add stew beef and cook 3 to 5 minutes. Reduce to medium heat, add rice and stir. Stir fry 15 minutes or until rice is golden and crisp. Reduce heat to low. Stir in canadian bacon bits, green chili, gingerroot and bean sprouts. Cover and cook 1 to 1 1/2 hours or until beef is tender, stirring occasionally.

title: Green Rice With Salsa Verde
ingredients: 8 ounces tomatillo salsa | 1/4 cup chicken bouillon | 1/4 cup light cream | 1 cup diced cooked ham | 1/4 cup chopped frozen broccoli | 1/4 cup chopped frozen green chili, thawed | 2 1/2 teaspoons vanilla bean paste | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom ( optional )
instructions: Combine salsa, bouillon, cream, ham, broccoli, chili, bean paste, and cardamom in a blender.

Random Ingredients: onion,lime zest,chili flake,mustard seed,cumin seed,phyllo pastry,cocoa powder,sharp cheddar cheese
title: Chocolate Quesadillas
ingredients: 500 g lean ground beef or 500 g ground lamb | 1 tablespoon dry mustard seeds | 1 teaspoon cumin seed | 1 tablespoon cocoa powder | 4 teaspoons chili flakes | 1 teaspoon grated lime zest | 1 onion, finely chopped | 1 package phyllo pastry | shredded sharp cheddar cheese
instructions: In a large skillet, brown the meat, drain liquid. Return meat to skillet, stir in mustard seeds, cumin seeds, cocoa powder and chilli flakes. Stir in the lime juice, onion and cheddar cheese. Cook until the cheese has melted, cool and then store in fridge up to 2 days.

Random Ingredients: tart apple,sun tomato,ricotta cheese,cointreau liqueur,bread crumb
title: Apple and Tomato Stuffed Pastry
ingredients: 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato, packed in oil | 10 -12 pieces tart apples | 1/4 cup shredded fat-free ricotta cheese | 1/2 cup shredded fat-free fontina cheese | 2 tablespoons cointreau liqueur | 1/2 cup bread crumbs, mixed with
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Mix the sun dried tomatoes, ricotta cheese, fontina cheese, and cointreau together in a bowl until well blended. Taste and adjust seasoning. Place 2 pieces of the bread in the bottom of each pastry shell, pressing gently to make a 2'' thick shell. Place the 3 pieces of bread on top of the tomato in each shell, pressing gently with a spoon to compress. Dip each stuffed pastry shell in water immediately and set aside to drain. In a 12 pie plate, place 1/2 cup of the ricotta cheese mixture and place in the center of the pastry. Top the ricotta mixture with about 3/4 of the apples. Sprinkle the rest with the remaining 1/2 cup of the cheese and drizzle with the liqueur. Crimp edges with a fork to create steam.. Top pastry with crumbs. If using a pie plate, it's easier to set and it can be turned. Let stand about 10 - 15 minutes before removing to serving.

Random Ingredients: pepperoni,tortilla chip,bean sprout,cream cheese,orange bell pepper,egg yolk,lamb shank
title: Beef & Pepperoni Lamb Shanks and Chip Dip
ingredients: 1/2 - 3/4 lb ground lamb shank, trimmed of visible fat | 12 ounces cream cheese, cut into cubes | 1 large egg yolk, lightly beaten | 12 ounces pepperoni, chopped finely | 1/2 orange sweet bell pepper, sliced thinly | 1/2 cup tortilla chips | 1 bag bean sprouts
instructions: In a skillet, brown the lamb shanks in olive oil. Remove the shanks and allow to rest with the pan juices cooking juices down until reduced to approximately 1/2 cup. Preheat oven to 500 degrees. Stir cream cheese into lamb shanks. Add egg yolk. In a separate bowl, toss the pepperoni with the bag of bean sprouts. Transfer mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish. Spoon mixture evenly into prepared baking dish. Bake until pepperoni starts to brown lightly and bean sprouts are crisping slightly, about 15 - 20 minutes. Turn off the oven and allow to sit for 5 minutes. Slice beef, and serve with the bean sprouts.

title: Honey-Roasted Tomato Tapas
ingredients: 16 large red tomatoes | 3 tablespoons apricot preserves | 5 ounces rocket | 2 tablespoons honey
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Slice crosses in each tomato. Spread apricot cheese over tomato bottom and top with rocket leaves. Drizzle the honey over. Place on a baking tray and bake for 30 minutes, or until the tomatoes collapse and the cheese browns.

Random Ingredients: poblano pepper,polish sausage,rice wine,escarole,chili oil,fennel seed,salt
title: Juan-Carlos Galino (Stuffed Peppers)
ingredients: 32 poblano peppers | salt, to taste | 3 1-2 cups rice wine | 1 tablespoon fennel seed | 1 sprig caciocavallo chili oil | 1 lb polish sausage, sliced
instructions: Remove stem from peppers, and blanch them in boiling water, then peel off and discard seeds and membranes. Slice peppers into thin strips or rectangles, place in a medium size mixing bowl, and sprinkle with salt. Cover with water, and bring to simmer, and let sit 5 minutes. Drain, and set aside. To stuff the peppers, heat a 10 inch skillet over medium heat. When a drop of water jumps around the pan, pour in a teaspoon of fennel seed, and immediately immediately drop in a piece of chorizo. Swirl for about 30 seconds to make sure the sausage is cooked all the way through. Remove chorizo to paper towels to drain, and drain the excess juice into a clean bowl. Heat the chili oil over medium high heat. When very hot, add the drained peppers. Cook, shaking the skillet occasionally, until peppers become translucent, slightly softened, and lightly charred in spots. Remove chorizo from skillet, and drain excess oil from skillet. Drain the peppers, and pat dry. Arrange about 1 tablespoon of chorizo in the center of each pepper, and stuff with rice wine, or fill with sausage. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: channa dal,snow pea,almond extract,asparagus,swiss cheese,lemon juice,lemon
title: Lemon Asparagus With Swiss Cheese and Smoy Pesto
ingredients: 1/2 1/2 lb fresh asparagus or 1/2 lb snow pea, trimmed, halved lenghway | 1 lb swiss cheese, sliced 1-inch thick | 1 lemon, juice of | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract | 12 fresh lemon slices | 6 sprigs cilantro, leaves | 4 cups channa dal, soaked | 1/2 cup blanched slivered almond, toasted, for garnish
instructions: In large saucepan, simmer asparagus, covered, for 10 minutes. Add cheese and lemon, simmer 3 mins, turn off heat and add almond extract and lemon juice. Let set, covered for 1 min. Mix in nuts and serve.

title: Cape Breton's Super Easy Bougene Mushrooms
ingredients: 2 tablespoons asafoetida powder | 1/2 cup diced fresh strawberries | 1/2 stalk celery, diced
