instructions: Grind the asafoetida into a coarse grain using a mortar and pestle. Stir in the strawberries just before you want to serve.

title: Lemongrass Tofu Soup
ingredients: 3 tablespoons minced lemongrass | 2 oranges sweet bell peppers | 1 quart veggie stock | 1 soft firm tofu | 6 hard-boiled eggs
instructions: Remove the zest from the lemon grass and finely mince half the lemongrass, but do not use all the white pulp. Reserve remaining lemongrass for a garnish on individual salad leaves. Peel the remaining zest by immersinging in water. Slice the zest very thinly.

Random Ingredients: cooking oil,pineapple juice,scotch bonnet pepper,bell pepper,capsicum,red pepper flake,potato
title: Dynamite
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cooking oil | 1 -2 slice bell pepper | 1 small sweet potato, cut into 2cm cubes | 2 -3 pieces capsicums ( the small variety, red ones ) | 1 scotch bonnet pepper, chopped ( optional jalapeno if you are brave ) | 1/4 cup pineapple juice | 1 -2 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes
instructions: Cook all ingredients over a medium heat for 15 minutes stirring every so often. Serve immediately with lime wedges or crushed ice.

title: Apple-Ourice Quesante
ingredients: 1 small apple | 1 burrito-size flour tortillas | 1 tablespoon treacle | 1 cup greek yogurt | 2 tablespoons madeira wine
instructions: Wash the apple and pat dry. Cut it small, and use the tips of your hands to squeeze out the juice. Cut the apple into thin julienne sticks like the apple in your food processor. Place the apple pieces on four quadrants of kitchen paper. Spread a small amount of treacle over the apple. Cover the apple with a layer of greek yogurt. Fold up the tortillas, and then finish with a few drops of madeira to finish. Preheat a 12 inch nonstick skillet over medium heat for 3 minutes, or until the quesadillas begin to bubble. Cook for 1 minute, and then flip them over. Sprinkle quesadillas with treacle, and continue to cook one minute longer. Serve immediately.

title: Frozen Herb Chocolate Bark
ingredients: 1/2 cup smooth unsweetened chocolate syrup | 1 tablespoon finely ground cardamom | 2 tablespoons finely shredded sharp cheddar cheese | alfalfa sprout
instructions: Combine chocolate syrup and cardamom in small bowl. Microwave chocolate mixture on high 5 minutes or until very warm. Stir in cheese. Spoon mixture into ungreased 5 x 3 inch metal baking pan. Top with sprouts and chill at least 30 minutes.

title: Beef Kebbles With Chocolate and Chilli
ingredients: 1 lb soba noodles, preferably wattie's brand | 1 cup chopped peach | 1/2 cup sweet chocolate, finely chopped | 1/4 cup catsup | 1/2 teaspoon baking powder | 1 teaspoon red chile, seeded and diced
instructions: Soak the noodles in a bowl of iced water for 10 minutes. Drain completely. Thread the noodles onto skewers. Place the kebbles, on a greased grill rack over a medium coals. Cook for 5 - 6 minutes or until cooked as desired. Turn and cook for an additional 5 minutes or so or until cooked to your liking.

Random Ingredients: broccoli carrot cauliflower mix,yellow bell pepper,mexican cheese,chili paste,honey,brown rice,parmigiano reggiano cheese
title: Veggie Rice and Cheese Stir-fry
ingredients: 1 cup instant brown rice ( uncle ben's brand ) | 1/2 cup chili paste ( mexican-style brand ) | 1/2 cup honey | 1/2 cup grated mexican blend cheese, divided ( cabot brand ) | 8 ounces broccoli carrots cauliflower mix ( or a combination of cauliflower and cauliflower ) | 1 small yellow bell pepper, cut into 1-inch pieces | 1/2 cup freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese ( about 7 ounces )
instructions: In saucepan on medium heat, combine rice, chili paste, and honey. Stir to blend. Microwave 2 minutes, stirring once. Stir in half of cheese, half of broccoli, half yellow pepper, and remaining cheese. Stir once more, then cover and microwave on high 7 minutes. Stir once, microwave 7 minutes, uncovered, still covered. Stir once more, remove cover, and microwave until all vegetables are tender. Serve and top with cheese and remaining bell pepper, if desired.

Random Ingredients: olive,dark creme de cacao,ketjap manis,chunky salsa,chicken wing,veal,romaine lettuce
title: Veal & Kebabs
ingredients: 1 1/4 lb pork or 1 1/4 lb veal, cut into 20 cubes | 3 -4 tablespoons olive oil | 1 1/2 teaspoons dark cajun seasoning ( or other anise flavouring that resembles cumin ) | 1/2 chunky salsa ( or your favorite prepared salsa ) | 2 tablespoons ketjap manis | 1/2 - 1 head romaine lettuce, washed and torn into pieces | 2 large ripe olives, halved lengthwise, pitted and thinly sliced
instructions: Coat the meat in olive oil, then add the cajun seasoning and the salsa. Stir to combine well. Pour over the meat in the dish and refrigerate, covered, for 10 minutes. To serve, arrange the lettuce and olives around the meat and pour in a little bit of the oil from the meat if needed to moisten everything before eating. The meat can also be cooked on a hot grill.

title: Beef Tenderloin and Beer
ingredients: 3 1/2 - 4 lbs beef tenderloin steaks | 3 tablespoons fresh yeast | 3 cups warm beer or 3 cups water, to cover steaks | 2 packages dried egg noodles
instructions: In a large bowl, soak noodles according to package directions. Drain, toss in a medium sized bowl with just enough water to cover, and allow to sit 5 minutes. Drain again. In three separate bowls, place the tenderloin steaks, and mix the yeast. Dip each steak first in the beer to partially cover them, then place the steaks in the yeast solution and let sit in a warm draft free place until the tenderloin is ready to grill. Bake, covered, at 450 degrees fahrenheit for about 45 minutes, or until internal temperature reaches 140 degrees fahrenheit. Test tenderloin with a meat thermometer, and slice into 1/4 inch slices. Serve with fresh french bread and a salad.

title: Oaty Oaty Bread
ingredients: 1/4 cup oatmeal | 4 tablespoons oatmeal | 3 -4 tablespoons rice | 3 -4 teaspoons five-spice powder | 2 -4 slices bread machine yeast | 4 -5 tablespoons rice
instructions: Put all ingredients in bread machine and let rise for one hour. When ready to bake, preheat oven to 400°f. Cut 2 or 3 or 3 breads into 3 pieces. Place on a baking sheet and slash tops with a knife at 1 intervals. Sprinkle with more oatmeal and bake for 15 to 20 minutes or until the tops are golden. Serve hot or cold.

title: Risotto Plantains
ingredients: 1 large ripe plantain, peeled and cut into 2-inch pieces | 1 jar pace picante sauce | 8 ounces risotto rice, cooked
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Spread rice out in baking sheet or roasting pan. Spread each piece of plantain flat with one tablespoon of picante sauce, making sure to coat all of the plantain. Bake plantains at 350 degrees f for about 40 minutes or until fork tender and the riuce is deep golden brown. Turn plantains over after 15 minutes.

title: Sweet and Savory head iceberg lettuce
ingredients: 3 large head iceberg lettuce, cored, washed and dried
instructions: The day before serving, cut the lettuce into 1 inch squares. Cover a baking sheet with foil, put the squares in the oven and let them get to room temperature. Warm the foil slightly and arrange the lettuce squares around the foil. You should be able to arrange the lettuce on the baking sheet right on top of the vegetables. They should not be crowded and the foil should be slightly damp. If any of the lettuce squares are not moistened, cover with foil in a tight layer. When the oven is set to 400 degrees or the door is hot enough to melt the foil open to let steam escape, turn off the oven and let the head of lettuce steam under it until it is very soft, about 20 minutes.

title: German Spinach Noodles
ingredients: 1 package fresh spinach, washed thoroughly, trimmed, and drained | 7 ounces rice noodles | 1 cup extra-sharp cheddar cheese, grated | peanuts ( to garnish, i use chopped almonds ) or cashews, coarsely crushed, very lightly to make a topping | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar ( to taste )
instructions: Bring about 3 cups of water to a boil in a medium skillet. Add the spinach. Cook 3 minutes, stirring frequently. Add the noodles and cook another few minutes, or until tender but firm. Stir in the cheese and nuts. Drain pasta mixture. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: white bread,ice cube,turmeric,lemon juice zest,puff pastry,italian parsley,beef tenderloin steak
title: Herbed Beef Tenderloin - Croquettes
ingredients: 1 lb beef tenderloin steaks, cut 3/4 thick, about 10 ounces | 2 slices country-style white bread, cut 1/4 thick and 1/2 thick | 1/3 cup fresh italian parsley, minced | 2 tablespoons lemon juice and zest | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric | 1/2 cup unsifted all-purpose flour | 2 frozen puff pastry sheets, thawed ( i use king arthur brand ) | 2 cups ice cubes, cut in half
instructions: Adjust oven rack to middle position and heat oven to 400°f. Arrange beef on a rack in a lightly oiled 12 by 9 inch sheet pan. Sprinkle beef with salt and pepper.

title: Vegan Tempura (Somagiri No Fuhu)
ingredients: 2 cups vegetable stock | 6 tablespoons soymilk | 4 teaspoons mirin
instructions: Mix the vegetable stock into a medium saucepan and bring to a boil. Reduce the heat to low, and simmer 5 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in the soy milk and mirin. Pour the mixture into a large sealable plastic container. Tightly cover, chill 1 hour, and up to 8 hours before using.

title: Quick Beef and Pasta for Two
ingredients: 8 ounces uncooked dried small shell pasta | 24 ounces boneless beef top round steak, cut into strips | 1 lb dry fettuccine pasta
instructions: Cook pasta according to pkg, adding 2 t beef broth. Cook steak according to package directions, then drain& set aside. Meanwhile, cook pasta according to package directions, then rinse& set aside. Heat broiler and spray with oil. Place beef in broiler proof skillet, and broil until desired doneness, about 5 - 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: beer,japanese soy sauce,pecorino romano cheese,pork heart,baby spinach,chickpea,parmesan romano cheese
title: Portuguese Pork and Spinach
ingredients: 1/2 lb pork heart | 1 cup chopped mixed baby spinach | 2 -3 tablespoons grated parmesan-romano cheese | 1 cup chopped pecorino romano cheese | 4 cups dry garbanzo beans ( canned chickpeas ) | 4 cups beer | 1 tablespoon japanese soy sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Trim the pork heart of any excess fat or connective tissue, and cut into 1/4 inch slices. Place the slices in a buttered baking dish. Bake for 1 hour 15 minutes, or until golden brown. Remove from oven, and set aside. Tear off 3 pieces of heavy duty aluminum foil about 6 inches long and 12 inches wide. Combine the green leaves with 3 tablespoons of the parmesan cheese. Place in a serving bowl, and divide the spinach among the 3 pieces of foil. Dividing evenly, top with 1/2 cup of the chopped parmesan. Top with 1/2 cup of the chopped pecorino romano. Place 4 cups of the garbanzo beans in a saucepan over medium heat with 6 cups of water. Bring to a boil and cook, stirring frequently, until slightly thick, about 3 minutes. Stir in the soy sauce and remove from the heat. Spoon the beans onto the pork slices, and mound 1 tablespoon of pecorino cheese on top. Serve with remaining pecorino cheese sprinkled over the top.

title: Sirloin  Beef  with Grape Leaves
ingredients: 1 lb chuck, cut into strips | 1/3 cup grapeseed oil or 1/3 cup olive oil | 2 packages fresh grape leaves | 2 packages jumbo shrimp, cut into halves | 1 lb cooked jumbo shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 1 1/2 teaspoons chili powder | 1/4 cup currants
instructions: In a large skillet, brown the meat over high heat in the oil. Remove meat from skillet and add grapeseed oil and grapeseed oil. Mix cornstarch and chili powder and add to meat. Add chopped shrimp, mix well and bring to a boil. Stirring frequently. Turn heat to low and cover. Let meat simmer for 45 minutes. Add shredded cooked shrimp and currants and cook for 15 minutes longer. This does not have to be a thick sauce, but you may add a small amount of the grape leaves and water to thin out if necessary.

title: Pretend Ham Sandwiches
ingredients: 4 slices deli ham | 8 sticks celery
instructions: Toast the ham sticks or slice sandwich rolls. On the ham sticks the celery should be about 1/8 inch thick and 3 inches long. Place on hot buns. Enjoy.

title: Salsa De Tomate
ingredients: 2 plum tomatoes, chopped | 2 tablespoons canola oil
instructions: Combine the plum tomatoes and canola oil in a medium bowl. Add salt and pepper to taste. Serve immedietly.

title: Veal Saltimbocca
ingredients: 1 teaspoon garlic powder | 4 1/2 lbs veal cutlets, pounded to 1/2 inch thickness | 1/2 cup gin | 1 large lime | 1 radish, finely diced
instructions: Combine garlic powder and salt. Add the veal cutlets, coating them well. Pour the gin into the plastic bag of a meat grinder to extract as much liquid as possible. Use the meat grinder attachment to grind the mixture until completely smooth. Transfer the mixture to a resealable plastic bag with the marinade and seal the bag. Refrigerate overnight, turning the bag whenever you want at least 3 days. Preheat oven to 300 degrees fahrenheit. Remove veal from the plastic bag and reserve marinade in the saucepan. Brown the meat lightly in the reserved marinade at the highest temperature. Line two baking sheets with parchment paper. Slice the lime wedge and radizi into thin slices. Place meat in a wide, shallow bowl. Place sliced radishes over the meat. Pour reserved marinade over the meat, sprinkle with garlic powder to taste. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: fast rising yeast,garam masala,yellow tomato,cocoa,radicchio,cashew,white bread
title: Indian Naan Bread With Currants and Green Mayonnaise
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups shredded red naans or 2 1/2 cups white breads | 2/3 cup unsweetened cocoa | 1 teaspoon instant masala ( preferably madhur jain ) or 1 teaspoon dried masala ( preferably madhur jain ) | 1 tablespoon dried salted cashews | 1/4 teaspoon fast rising yeast | 3/4 cup yellow tomato, diced | 12 medium radicchio, leaves trimmed, cut into 1/4-inch slices | 4 cups loosely packed shredded radicchio
instructions: Place naan in a large bowl and add about 2 cups warm water. Let it sit until the water bubbles and the naan rises to the top, about 10 minutes. Drain the water and reserve, then refrigerate the naan until cold, about 30 minutes. Dissolve the cocoa, masala and/or dried masala in a small bowl with a tablespoon of water. Let stand until it is warm, about 10 - 15 minutes, then stir in the cashews. Transfer the naan to a work surface and spread the onion mixture evenly over it. Dividing the onion evenly, top it with 2/3 cup chopped yellow tomatoes. Dividing evenly, top the onion evenly with the radicchio leaves and tomatoes. Spread about 1 teaspoon of the currant spice mixture evenly over the radicchio leaves. Place the naan in an 8 – 10 inch, round baking dish and arrange the radicchio slices upright in the baking dish. Top with the remaining currant spice and tomato mixtures. Cover tightly with plastic wrap and let stand in a warm place until the radicchio is softened, about 18 hours. Preheat the oven to 350°f remove the plastic wrap and sprinkle it with about 1 tablespoon of chopped fresh mint. Bake in the center of the oven until the top is golden and bubbling, about 45 minutes. Cool on the baking pan for 3 minutes to crisp the top. Remove from the baking sheet and let cool to room temperature, about 30 minutes. Garnish with more mint and serve.

Random Ingredients: asian basil,italian seasoning,anchovy fillet,peanut oil,chicken thigh
title: Easy Satay Chicken Breasts
ingredients: 3 lbs skinless, boneless chicken thighs ( or breasts ) | 4 tablespoons peanut oil | 1 teaspoon asian seasoning | 12 anchovy fillets, drained | 1 bunch italian-style basil
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Place chicken on a rack in a roasting pan. Season with salt and pepper. Pour oil into a skillet, heat, and saute chicken, turning to brown evenly, about 10 minutes. Stir in the seasoning. Pour half of the basil over the chicken and stir to coat. Arrange on a platter and sprinkle with remaining basil. Place the remaining chicken in the oven, and bake 45 minutes, depending on amount of chicken you use.

Random Ingredients: vegetable shortening,feta cheese,sugar snap pea,white sugar,manicotti,taco seasoning mix
title: Quick Taco Feta and Sugar Snap Peas
ingredients: 20 manicotti | 1/4 cup vegetable shortening | 1 package crumbled feta cheese | 1/4 cup sugar snap peas | 1/3 cup taco seasoning mix | 1 tablespoon white sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil. Stir in manicotti and return to a boil. Cook noodles uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the pasta has cooked through, but is still slightly firm, about 12 minutes. Drain pasta well, and transfer to a bowl. Meanwhile, melt the shortening in a skillet over medium heat. Mix in the feta cheese and snap peas, and mix until melted. Transfer to a 9x13 inch baking dish. Stir in the taco seasoning mix. Dip the manicotti into the hot cheese mixture until coated. Bake at 350 degrees f for 30 minutes in the preheated oven, until edges are lightly browned.

title: Quick Fruit Nests
ingredients: 1 lb angel hair pasta ( bowtie ) or 1 lb whole wheat angel hair pasta, cooked as directed on package | 1 can passion fruit pulp ( about 1 3/4 cups ) | 1/2 cup dried apricot, chopped | 1 package tortillas
instructions: Line a 13 by 9 by 2 inch baking dish with parchment. Toss the pasta with the passion fruit pulp, apricots and tortillas in a large bowl. Spoon the mixture into the prepared pan. Bake, uncovered, in a 350 degree f. Oven for 35 to 45 minutes.

title: Quick, Easy, Easy Faux Vietnamese Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb farfalle pasta ( bowtie ) | 1 lb small red potatoes | 26 ounces sweet chocolate syrup | 3/4 cup fish sauce
instructions: Cook pasta in boiling water until al dente. While pasta is cooking, peel potatoes and cut into cubes. Coarsely chop cooled pasta into 3/4 inch pieces. Cook potatoes in a large skillet until browned and tender. Meanwhile, heat remaining 3/4 cup of sweet chocolate syrup with fish sauce and sauté potatoes until all the ingredients are warm. Drain pasta, then stir in sweet potato mixture. Serve with your favorite sauce and chile sauce.

Random Ingredients: spice,french baguette,lentil,lingonberry preserve,corn flake,chicken meat,clear honey
title: Lentil Croquettes
ingredients: 1 can lentils, rinsed and drained | 1/4 cup chopped cooked chicken meat | 1 clove fresh spice, or to taste | 1/4 teaspoon mixed spice | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried corn flakes | 1 french baguettes, split in half lengthwise | 1/4 cup light-colored clear honey, or to taste | 1 tablespoon dried lemons or 1 tablespoon orange juice, divided
instructions: Place lentils and chicken meat in a saucepan over medium heat, and stir to blend. Season with 2 teaspoons of the mixed spice mix, the salt, and remaining spice blend. Bring to a simmer, and cook for 3/4 cup, or until thick and creamy. Add corn flakes to lentils, cover, and cook for 1 minute. Meanwhile, heat oven to 500 degrees f. Place bread halves in a single layer on baking sheets. Brush with honey. Bake 5 minutes in the preheated oven, watching carefully to make sure bread does not burn. Remove from baking sheets to cool. Spread half of lentils in the bottom half of each piece of bread. Top with remaining lentils, and top with honey and lemon juice. Serve immediately.

title: Korean Turnip Dip or Potato Wedges
ingredients: 1 bag pepitas ( mini turnips ) | 1/2 cup water | 1 package cream cheese | 1/2 cup chopped garlic clove ( i like to use bottled minced ) | 1 tablespoon rice vinegar | 2 tablespoons cocoa | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt | 2 teaspoons dried almonds
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Slice the turnips in half, width wise and press into the palms of your hands to make a wedge. Place cut side down on a jellyroll pan that has been lined with parchment paper. Bake for 20 minutes until light brown and crispy. Cool. Remove turnip from oven, remove parchment paper and turnip over. In a small bowl, mix cream cheese, garlic, vinegar, cocoa, garlic salt and almonds until well blended. Spread mixture over turnip and bake for 25 minutes or until golden brown. Serve with toasted pita chips, pita chips or pumpernickel bread.

Random Ingredients: heavy cream,white rice,dark beer,bay leaf,poblano chile
title: Poblano Chiles Molcajete
ingredients: 2 cups white rice | 12 ounces dark ale, room temperature | 7 poblano chiles | 1 quart heavy cream | 2 bay leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Boil the rice in the beer for about half an hour, while stirring so the rice doesn't stick to the bottom of the pan. When the rice is done, drain and set aside. While the beer and rice are cooking, roast the poblano peppers. Cut them into large chunks and place in a medium sized ovenproof dish with a lid. Cover and bake, turning once, for 15 minutes. After 15 minutes, remove the poblano peppers from the oven and place on the foil lined pan. Cover with aluminum foil and bake another 15 minutes. After 15 more minutes, remove the poblano peppers and place in a bowl to cool. When the rice is cool, place in a bowl. Place in the refrigerator until ready to assemble. In a medium bowl, stir together the cream and the bay leaves. Bring to a simmer and pour into the bowl. Stir in the cooled rice and the cooled pepper mixture.

Random Ingredients: mango chutney,red chili paste,tortilla,white rice,caper,summer squash
title: Faux Baked Rice & Veggies (Yum-Yum)
ingredients: 4 cups cooked white rice | 2 medium winter squash | 2 tablespoons capers, drained | 6 tablespoons paprika red chili paste | 1/4 cup mango chutney | 4 medium tortillas
instructions: Boil the rice. Toss them, one by one, in the microwave for 20 seconds. Place about 1 cup of rice into each of 3 small ramekins or individual ovenproof dishes. Add the rest of the ingredients to the microwave, except the tortillas, to microwave at 50% power for a few seconds at a time, stirring every 30 seconds. Mix everything together, until the rice is soft. Divide among the ramekins or dishes, and bake on 400 degrees for about 10 - 20 minutes. Cut in the middle to serve, or, if at room temperature, chill for a few minutes before eating, so the rice and veggie mix can set up better.

title: Spashetta Con Piselli
ingredients: 2 cups white flour, unbleached | 2 teaspoons coarse salt
instructions: Using a fine mesh sieve, sieve flour and salt into a bowl, mix in remaining ingredients. Let stand for 15 to 30 minutes at room temperature. Form into a ball and remove from bowl. Cover with plastic wrap and set aside in refrigerator until ready to use. Roll dough on floured board into a 6 inch long cylinder. Cut cylinder into 4 or 8 inch long pieces. Place on a flat board and lightly flour your rolling pin. Holding one end of each piece of dough at a 45 degree angle, lift dough about 2 inches from the board. Press dough with fingertips to form a 4 inch long round. Repeat with remaining dough as above and place rounds on lightly floured board.

title: Chilean Pizza With Maple-Glaze
ingredients: 1 prepared pizza crust, unbaked | 1 large ripe tomatillo, coarsely chopped ( optional ) | 1/2 cup maple syrup ( i used orange flavored )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Combine tomatillo with maple syrup in small bowl. Spread pizza dough with glaze, or spread with toppings to desired size. Cover with foil. Bake 10 - 12 minutes until golden.

Random Ingredients: vanilla bean,navel orange,apple cider,kosher salt black pepper,rotel tomato,rum,chicken wing,roasting chicken
title: Easy-Fast Spanish Chicken Wings!
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs roasting chickens | salt and black pepper, to taste | 1/4 vanilla bean | 2 lbs organic carrots ( peeled-cut into 1 1/2-inch chunks ) | 6 navel oranges | 1 quart apple cider | 1 -2 fluid ounce rum | 3 fluid ounces canned rotel tomatoes
instructions: First you'll want to trim away the excess fat of your chicken wings. Rinse the chicken. Sprinkle with salt and black pepper on all sides. Place in a large plastic bag and put in a cool spot for about an hour or two before it goes to bed or for best results, take the vanilla bean and split open and place in the same spot. Split each vanilla bean and scrape out the seeds and any bitter juices from them with the spoon. Discard the vanilla bean. Split the seeds if using the vanilla bean also. This process will take literally a couple of seconds. Now place the chicken, the 1/4 vanilla bean and the 2 - 3 fluid ounces of apple cider in a large pot and cover with water. Add a pinch of salt and a light touch of a red bell pepper, and bring to a boil. Turn down heat and simmer, covered, until the chicken is done, about 45 minutes to 1 hour. Check every hour and notice that the chicken is tender. It'll be hard to control the heat, but you'll have to do it after 45 minutes of simmering. The end result should be almost gravy like. Take the chicken out of the pot and cool a bit, then slice into finger sized pieces. Put the pieces back in the pot, cover with the carrots and pour the rest of the apple cider over, making sure the wings are just sitting inches and mix well. Strain the stock from the pot into a bowl, pressing on the vanilla bean seeds until the seeds have dissolved. The rum should be the flavor you're looking for. Add the molasses, rum, tomatoes to the soup and mix well. Let the curry simmer for about another hour. Serve at once. Note, if you use the rotel tomatoes right away, it can be really hot.

Random Ingredients: pork roast,grain mustard,red chili pepper,tomato paste,bisquick,sesame oil,bread,grape tomato
title: Tomato and Mustard Pork Sandwich
ingredients: 1 pork roast, trimmed of visible fat | 4 1/2 ounces tomato paste | 1 1/2 tablespoons grain mustard | 2 tablespoons sesame oil | 16 ounces grape tomatoes | 1 small red chili pepper | 1/4 cup bisquick | 1/2 cup bread, of your choice
instructions: Prick the roast numerous times with a fork and rub in tomato paste. Cover with plastic wrap and place in the refrigerator for at least one hour. Preheat the oven to 550 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Remove the pork from the fridge and pat dry with paper towels. Place the pork on the baking sheet, skin side down. Make holes in the pork with the tip of a knife. Place the pork on the baking sheet. Bake for 20 minutes, then turn over and bake until lightly browned on the meat all over. The internal temperature will be 180 degrees f when you press the pork with your thumb. This should take about 15 minutes. Once flipped, remove pork from the pan and cut into thin slices. Combine the remaining ingredients in a blender, and mix until smooth. Pour mixture slowly into the pan. Place the pork slices back on the baking sheets. Cover. Continue baking for about 45 minutes. Slice the sandwich, and serve.

title: Spaghetti with Green Beans
ingredients: 1 package dry spaghetti | 1 pound frozen cut green beans
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, stir in the dry spaghetti, and return to a boil. Cook the pasta uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the pasta has cooked through, but is still firm to the bite, about 12 minutes.

title: Crab Sticks
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs fresh yellow crab | 1 tablespoon red pepper, finely chopped | 1/4 cup breadcrumbs
instructions: Chop crab into chunks.

Random Ingredients: flour tortilla,thyme sprig,salad,ginger juice,lipton onion soup mix
title: Easy Chilled Onion Soup in Tortillas
ingredients: 1 packet lipton instant onion soup mix | 2 fresh thyme sprigs | 2 -3 slices ginger juice ( or 2-3 shakes of ginger powder ) | 20 -25 flour tortillas | salad ( optional )
instructions: In a microwave safe bowl cover the onion soup mix with water and microwave on high for 15 minutes. Remove the 1/4 cup of water. Rinse out the microwave bowl and stir it to dissolve the soup mix. Return to the microwave, stir again, cover and microwave on high for another 5 minutes. Add the ginger juice or 1/4 teaspoons of ginger powder to taste and mix. If desired, thinly slice the thyme and serve with tortillas.

Random Ingredients: cornmeal,mustard seed,sesame seed,polenta,bamboo shoot,asparagus spear,chocolate chip,buttermilk
title: Cornmeal and Asparagus Roundup
ingredients: 4 stalks asparagus spears, trimmed and trimmed | 1 tablespoon sesame seeds | 1/2 cup canned bamboo shoot, drained | 2 tablespoons cornmeal | 1/2 cup polenta | 1 tablespoon dry mustard seeds | 1/2 cup buttermilk | 1 ounce unsweetened chocolate chips
instructions: Preheat broiler. Place asparagus in a 12x9 baking dish. Sprinkle with sesame seeds and black pepper. Broil until charred. Reduce heat.

title: Homemade Phoniques
ingredients: 500 ml double cream | 300 g thyme honey from growing in the fridge ( organic, free of pesticides ) | 3 thai red chili peppers, deseeded and chopped ( or you can use 2 teaspoons of sambal oelek from a jar )
instructions: Blend your honey with your cream. Add your chilies and process until smooth. Pour into a container and leave to mature in the fridge for at least 2 weeks. When you are ready to use add the phons to a piping bag and pipe the cream onto the top surface of the phon. You may need 1 teaspoons of paste per log.

title: Cafe Rio Cheese With Beans
ingredients: fresh cilantro ( to taste ) | 2 cups beef broth or 2 cups water
instructions: Place cilantro in medium bowl and add 3/4 cup of the broth, enough to cover.

Random Ingredients: parmigiano reggiano cheese,cardamom seed,yellow squash,green pepper,hard egg,wheat flour,corn niblets,jalapeno pepper
title: Paglia E Arrabiata
ingredients: 3 cups whole wheat flour | 1 cup corn niblets | 1/2 cup green pepper, diced | 1/2 cup yellow squash, diced | 1/4 cup jalapeno pepper, diced ( optional ) | 6 hard-boiled eggs, thinly sliced | 6 ounces parmigiano-reggiano cheese, shredded | 2 tablespoons cracked cardamom seeds ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Whisk together flour, corn, green pepper, squash, jalapeno pepper and eggs in a bowl. Stir in the cheese and cardamom until the cheese is completely blended and the dough is shaggy. Place dough onto an oiled, rimmed baking sheet. Sprinkle cracked cardamom over the surface of the dough. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes, until the top is golden brown.

title: Quick and Easy Indian Molasses Egg Drop Rings
ingredients: 2 egg whites | 1/2 cup molasses | 1/4 cup cider | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric | oil or vegetable cooking spray
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk egg whites until foamy.

title: Pork and Stout Punch (Coddle)
ingredients: 6 pounds stewing pork | 7 cups stout beer | 2 tablespoons white sugar
instructions: Place a large saucepan or stockpot over medium heat. Sprinkle pork with salt. Add stout, and simmer until pork is cooked and tender, approximately 20 minutes. Stir in sugar, and cook until mixture is completely thickened, about 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: coriander powder,sugar,extra virgin olive oil,lemon zest,red food coloring,pomegranate seed
title: Kolachi - Moroccan Sugar Body Food
ingredients: 3 lbs raw sugar body fine preserved lemons and zest, in one bag | 1/3 cup extra virgin olive oil | 1 1/2 tablespoons pomegranate seeds ( if they are in a jar, they make a nice, dry-curd snack ) | 1 teaspoon ground coriander powder | 1 teaspoon lemon zest, grated | red food coloring
instructions: Preheat the oven to 275°f line a 12x15 inch baking pan with parchment paper. Using a vegetable peeler, peel off the green pith from the head of the lemons by placing them between sheets of waxed paper or a cloth. Cut off the white membrane with a vegetable peeler, taking care to scrape away the colored white pith. Slice down the peel into segments. With a teaspoon, measure 1 cup of white membrane in each of the zest sections, if using. Place 1/3 cup olive oil in a small bowl and mix in the pomegranate seeds with the coriander, lemon zest and food coloring. Add the mixture to the remaining 1 cup olive oil and mix well. Pour into the prepared pan. Place the pan on the middle rack of the oven and bake for 30 minutes, stirring every 30 minutes. Once the 30 minutes have passed, reduce the oven temperature to 250°f and continue to bake for 45 - 50 minutes more, until the color turns deep orange brown. Remove the pan from the oven and allow to cool completely for 15 minutes. Remove from the oven and set aside to completely cool completely. You may store the kolachi in an airtight container at room temperature, covered by an airtight seal, for up to up to 2 weeks. Note, i'm not sure of the zest sizes or how long it sets up. If you slice the body and zest in half, you may have to slice them lengthwise first, then into half again. I use a mandolin to slice each slice in rounds only for the eyes.

Random Ingredients: rice wine vinegar,taco sauce,orange zest,pie crust,nutmeg,salmon
title: Sushi Roll
ingredients: 1/3 cup orange zest | 1/3 cup light rice wine vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon taco sauce | 1/8 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1/2 cup minced fresh salmon | 1 unbaked pie crust
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Arrange 1 pie crust in a 9 inch pie plate. Combine orange zest, rice wine vinegar, taco sauce, and nutmeg in a bowl. Stir salmon into the zest mixture. Spoon over the crust in the crust. Bake in the preheated oven until the rice is golden brown and the salmon is heated through, about 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: triple sec,cheddar monterey jack cheese,vegetable,sugar,canola oil,asparagus spear
title: Veggies Filled With Cheese and Asparagus
ingredients: 1 lb fresh asparagus spear, trimmed | 1 1/4 lbs mixed fresh vegetables, such as broccoli | 3 tablespoons canola oil | 1 1/4 cups cheddar monterey jack cheese, shredded | 1/2 cup granulated sugar | 1/2 teaspoon triple sec
instructions: In a 12 inch sauté pan over medium high heat, combine the canola oil, asparagus and the cheese. Cook until the vegetables are tender. Stir in the sugar and triple sec. Cool to room temperature. Pour into 2 custard cups and chill. Serve chilled.

title: Sweet Corn
ingredients: 2 cups sweetcorn | 1/2 cup hoisin sauce, or to taste
instructions: Place sweetcorn in a bowl.

title: Yogurt with tropical fruit, spices
ingredients: 1/4 cup light cream or 1/4 cup low fat plain yogurt | 2 cloves | 1/2 teaspoon tropical mixed fruit, mixed spices
instructions: In a small serving bowl stir together the cream and spices. To serve, spread a layer of yogurt on a warm platter. Top with tropical fruit and sprinkle with additional fresh fruit slices.

title: Feta Cheese Spread
ingredients: 1 lb feta cheese | 2 -3 large fresh basil leaves, chopped ( or 2 tsp dried )
instructions: Place feta into a mixing bowl. Add basil to the feta cheese and with your hands blend thoroughly until fluffy. Form into an oval loaf or wrap in foil and then chill in refrigerator for 1 - 2 hours.

Random Ingredients: greek olive,chinkiang vinegar,ketchup,asparagus spear,saffron strand,white wine
title: Beef Borscht
ingredients: 1 lb asparagus spear, peeled and sliced into thirds | 3 cups chinese-style black grapes ( or berry berries of choice ) | 1/8 teaspoon saffron strand | 1/4 cup greek olive, such as nyons harissa | 2 tablespoons ketchup | 1 tablespoon chinkiang vinegar
instructions: Prepare grill. In a large saucepan, combine asparagus with grapes, saffron strands, olives, ketchup and chinkiang vinegar. Bring to boil then reduce heat and simmer on low for 30 - 45 minutes or until tender. Season with pepper. Serve hot.

title: Middle Eastern Lamb and Beef Pie
ingredients: 180 g lean ground lamb | 180 g minced beef | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 1 1/2 cups vegetable stock | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley | 1 package frozen phyllo pastry sheets, thawed | 1 lime, cut into wedges
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 degrees, with a rack in the middle. Place lamb, beef and cumin into a large bowl and mix well. Cook for 3 - 4 minutes, until the beef and meat brown and the seasonings are thoroughly combined. Add the stock, parsley and half the spring onion. Place the sheet of filo on a clean surface and cover it with another sheet of filo, allowing the moisture to spread out while you roll out the pastry as thinly as possible. Turning into a 12 round. Lay this sheet in the bottom of a roasting tin, place in the oven and bake for 15 minutes until the pastry is crispy. Squeeze the juice from the lime wedge into a small bowl. Turn the pastry down into the oven and roast for 45 minutes, or until golden brown.

title: Tomato Granola
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs ripe italian tomatoes | 1 1/4 ounces bacon drippings or 1 1/4 ounces oil | 1 tablespoon dried tarragon | 2 tablespoons of fresh mint, chopped | 1 1/4 ounces fresh tarragon, chopped ( optional ) | 2 garlic cloves, crushed | 1 1/2 ounces semolina | 2 tablespoons brown sugar
instructions: Slice off tops of tomatoes and reserve for a garnish. Reserve the tops of the tomatoes to use later, if desired. Cut into 4 pieces each. Remove the pulp from the tomatoes and set aside. Heat the drippings in a frying pan and add the tarragon, mint, and tarragon. Saute for 2 - 3 minutes, or until thick. Break up the tomatoes and stir in one cup of the syrup. Place the tomatoes and sauce in sterilized jars and seal.

title: Lebanese Style Savoury Crackers
ingredients: 1 cup channa dal | 2 tablespoons flour
instructions: Combine the dal, flour and salt in a bowl. Add water until the dough comes together. Place on lightly floured surface and knead gently for 10 minutes or until the dough becomes firm. Cut into 12 equal sized pieces. Place on non stick cookie trays. Using a 1cm round cutter, cut each dough into 4 triangles. Heat a non stick pan, add breadcrumbs and cook for 8 - 10 minutes, turning as necessary, until golden brown and crispy.

title: Saffron Crackers
ingredients: 2 cups apricot preserves or 2 cups preserves | 3/4 cup garlic bread, crumbs | 1/4 teaspoon saffron thread | 1 pinch coriander powder
instructions: Mix the preserves with the crumbs and rub over the crackers until coated on all sides. Place on greased baking sheets and press in lightly buttered nuts. Bake at 225 degrees for 8 to 10 minutes or until crisp.

title: Kicked Up Avocados
ingredients: 1 large hass avocadoes | 6 tablespoons ice water | 1 cup flaked cauliflower
instructions: Halve the avocados lengthwise. Scoop out the flesh and place in a medium size bowl. Mash with a fork. Add the ice water to bind. You want the avocado liquid to be the consistency of sour cream, about the consistency of heavy cream, so use this little chunk if it looks too thick. Taste, add salt and more water if it isn't right for you. Serve immediately.

title: Roast Beef With Cabbage and Sun Dried Tomato
ingredients: 1 lb deli roast beef, lean, cut 1/4-inch thick | 5 -6 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained | 1 head cabbage, thinly sliced | 1 lime, cut into 6 wedges
instructions: Preheat the broiler or grill to high. Brush both sides of the roast with the oil. Put the roast on the broiler pan and leave 3 - 4 inches between the heat. Cook until the internal temp reaches 180 c or the internal temp reaches 160°c. Remove the meat and let rest, covered loosely, for 15 minutes. When the time is up, scatter both sides with the tomatoes. Place under the grill for 5 minutes. Serve with the lime wedges. Variation, to roast the vegies, substitute a large cooked onion or a cooked egg and a sliced carrot with a roast of beef. If you prefer, place the roast in a casserole dish and bake at 350 f for 30 minutes or until tender.

title: Fruit and Chutney Bowls
ingredients: 1 cup long grain white rice | 3 cups hot cooked long-grain white rice | 1 teaspoon ground ginger | 1/2 cup mango chutney ( about 2-3 tablespoons ) | 2 1/2 cups broth
instructions: Bring all ingredients to the boil in a medium saucepan over high heat. Cook, covered, stirring constantly, for 5 minutes. Lower heat and let mixture continue to simmer, covered, for 25 to 30 minutes, or until rice is tender and completely absorbed. Serve hot over rice.

Random Ingredients: flour tortilla,cinnamon,dashi stock,fennel seed,enchilada sauce,meal flour,yeast,egg white
title: Empanada and Cinnamon Bread
ingredients: 1 cup dashi stock ( or chicken stock ) | 1/4 teaspoon instant yeast | 1 1/2 cups whole meal flour | 1/3 cup whole meal flour | 2 tablespoons crushed fennel seeds ( optional ) | 1 egg white, lightly beaten | 1 1/2 cups enchilada sauce ( your favourite ) | 1/2 cup cinnamon ( for topping )
instructions: Measure ingredients into bread machine pan in the order recommended by the manufacturer. Process on low or large setting until a bread loaf consistency forms when pressed lightly.. Remove bread from bread pan and cool to room temperature on a wire rack. Serve on warm plates. Top each serving with a drizzle of enchilada sauce and sprinkle with cinnamon.

title: Apple Butter Roll Sushi Rolls
ingredients: 9 ounces sushi rice ( sushi rice ) | lemon, cut in half | 7 ounces apple butter ( or use your favourite butter for best results and squeaky ) | 2 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 1 lime, cut into 8 thin wedges
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f and lightly oil a baking sheet. Break the sushi rice into large chunks and arrange half of it over the baking sheet. Sprinkle with half the lemon and half the soy sauce. Fold the other half of the rice over the sushi rice and sprinkle with the balance of the soy sauce. Use the remaining parchment to roll the sushi into long bamboo sushi rolls. Slice each roll into 8 equal pieces with a sharp knife. Spread the lime wedge over each roll. Bake in the preheated oven for 15 to 20 minutes, or until heated through and sticky.

Random Ingredients: beef chuck,green onion,avocado,sugar,milk ricotta cheese,sugar syrup
title: Guilt-Free Ricotta Pie - Quebec City Style
ingredients: 1 lb lean boneless beef chuck, trimmed | 1 cup sugar-free syrup | 3/4 cup milk ricotta cheese | 3 green onions, thinly sliced | 1/2 avocado, sliced | 2 teaspoons sugar-free syrup
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place beef chuck in a shallow skillet.

title: German Lentil Salad
ingredients: 1 cup brown lentils | 1 cucumber, peeled, halved, and diced
instructions: Place lentils in a bowl. Slice cucumber in half lengthwise, and slice into small wedges. Toss cucumber with a little bit of water, but not until the water becomes cloudy or starts to scald up too much. Cover in a bowl, and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes, or over night before serving.

Random Ingredients: rye bread,au jus mix,flour,egg wrap,lebanese cucumber,herb
title: Vegan French Bread Sticks
ingredients: 1/2 cup dry yeast | 1 1/2 tablespoons flour | 1 cup lebanese cucumber, chopped | 1/2 cup fresh herb ( mixed, including rosemary, basil and parsley ) or 1/2 cup savory leaves ( mixed, including rosemary, basil and parsley ) | 12 -18 slices rye bread | 1 egg roll wrap
instructions: Place bread stick in a large bowl, cover with plastic wrap, and set aside for 15 - 20 minutes to develop gluten in the flour. Prepare the filling. Place the cucumbers in a colander and allow to drain for several hours, and then squeeze out all excess water and place in food processor. Add basil, parsley and herbs, and process to a spreadable consistency. Place the bread sticks on a baking tray lined with parchment paper. Spread 1 tbsp. Of the filling evenly over bread sticks. Place on a baking sheet coated with parchment paper. Cover with plastic wrap and place in a warm oven for 25 - 30 minutes. Uncover and bake for another 4 - 5 minutes until crispy.

title: Salmon With Crackling Cracked Pepper Crackers
ingredients: 1/3 cup cracked salt pepper | 2 salmon fillets
instructions: Pour the cracked salt pepper into one side of each fish fillet and flatten it down to make a little cracker about 1/2 inch wide. Wet the cracker with your hands and press the cracker lightly into the thick side of each fillet. Use a fork, and poke holes in the cracker until the mixture looks like cracker crumbs.. Lightly sprinkle the cracker crackers over both sides of the salmon and place the fish on a lined baking sheet. Grill on high over direct heat until the fish flakes easily when tested with a fork, about 10 minutes per side.

Random Ingredients: walnut,thyme leaf,coriander powder,cream mushroom soup,basil leaf,lemongrass,monterey jack cheese
title: Lemon Grass & Walnut Dip
ingredients: 150 g monterey jack cheese, grated | 1 tablespoon fresh coriander powder | 2 lemongrass, scored | 100 g walnuts ( or pecans finely chopped ) | 1 tablespoon fresh thyme leaves | 150 g light cream of mushroom soup | 1 teaspoon basil leaves, fresh
instructions: Mix monterey jack cheese, coriander powder, lemon grass, walnuts, thyme and soup together.

Random Ingredients: gingerroot,rice wine,mozzarella cheese,red snapper fillet,pistachio,panko breadcrumb,pecan
title: Grilled Red Snapper With Pecan Crumb Topping
ingredients: 1 red snapper fillet | 1/4 lb mozzarella cheese, cut into strips | 1/4 cup pecans, chopped | 1 cup panko breadcrumbs | 1/4 cup rice wine | 1/4 cup grated fresh gingerroot | 1/4 cup chopped pistachios
instructions: Prepare grill. Wash, wipe scales off and pat dry. Sprinkle fish with salt. Place on grill, lower heat. Grill for 10 minutes, or until done. Let stand for 5 minutes, remove fish to a covered dish and let stand for 5 more minutes. Cut diagonally into 1/2 inch wide strips. Put cheese, nuts, bread crumbs, rice wine and ginger into 3 separate bowls. Dip fish strips in topping mixture, then arrange on cookie sheet. Grill for 5 minutes, or until fish is crisp and lightly browned. Sprinkle with pistachios to serve.

title: Baked Pork With Crab, Crab and Chilli (Carynks)
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs boneless pork shoulder | 2 ounces uncooked crab
instructions: Trim all excess fat from the pork with sharp scissors. Slice the meat into 6 thick slices. Prehat the oven to 300°f scatter the crab on the bread. Place the pork slices over the crab, cover with foil and bake for two hours. Remove the foil and bake another 40 to 50 minutes until pork is browned and tender. Serve hot or on the side.

Random Ingredients: sharp cheddar cheese,passion fruit pulp,beef lard burger,ketchup,almond extract,feta,hazelnut,eggplant
title: Azerbaijane (Sponge Cheese Mixture)
ingredients: 1 small eggplant | 1/8 lb feta | 2 tablespoons hazelnuts, chopped | 4 teaspoons sweet passion fruit pulp ( i used canned ) | 1 -2 tablespoon ketchup | 1 teaspoon almond extract | 1/2 lb lean beef lard or 1/2 lb lean bologna or 1/2 lb lean sirloin steak | 2 -4 slices sharp cheddar cheese
instructions: Remove and discard the peel and hard center of the eggplant, if there is any. Wash well and cut lengthwise lengthwise into 1/4 inch slices. Gratomize your pick. Mash up coarsely the nuts with a fork. In a mixing bowl, combine the passion juices, ketchup, almond extract, and prepared cheese. Add the grated cheese. Stir until incorporated and the mix gets smooth. Marinade for at least 10 to 12 hours before using. If using beef, slice it extremely thin and grill it until rare, slice it thinly, slice it diagonally and fry it until crisp and browned. Spread on paper towels to drain the excess oil. Set aside. Cook eggplant until tender, but not mushy, about 15 minutes. Drain on paper towels and put into a bowl. Add the passion juice, ketchup and ground nuts and mix. Serve warm, with slices of crusty bread.

Random Ingredients: head cabbage,topping,thai red curry paste,tomato green chilies
title: Easy Cabbage Slaw
ingredients: 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies, drained | 1 head cabbage, rinsed and torn into bite-size pieces | 1 can thai red curry paste, or to taste | 1 container frozen whipped topping, thawed
instructions: Mix tomatoes with green chilies, cabbage, and curry paste together in a large bowl until the cabbage is evenly coated.

title: Brandy-Slice Dates
ingredients: 1/2 cup brandy | 1 1/2 tablespoons olive oil | 1 can whole pitted dates, halved | 1 jar peperoncini pepper juice, with juice | 1 tablespoon quick-cooking oil
instructions: Combine the brandy and olive oil in a small, nonreactive saucepan, and heat until the brandy comes to a boil. Remove from the heat and stir in the dates, peperoncini juice, salt, and pepper. Strain off any excess liquid if desired, and let cool to room temperature. Refrigerate and use within 1 week. Slice the dates into 1/2 inch pieces.

title: Pork Sausages from the City
ingredients: 5 links pork sausage links | 1 can tomato paste
instructions: Place the sausage links in the base of a hot, greased dish. Use a slotted spoon to carefully push the fat out of each sausage. Sprinkle the tomato paste over all. Heat the remaining ingredients on the top until boiling. Cover and simmer over a medium low heat for 90 minutes.

title: Cucumbers With Garlic and Sesame Salt
ingredients: 1 large cucumber, peeled, seeded, and sliced thin | 12 cloves garlic ( i've used 1/2 tsp garlic powder & 1/2 tsp garlic powder mixed with 3 tbsp olive oil, 1 tsp of sesame and 1/2 tsp lemon juice ) | 12 green cardamom pods | 6 tablespoons sesame seeds ( i used roasted and lightly crushed ) | ice
instructions: Slice the cucumber in half length wise and scoop out excess water. Arrange slices in a large bowl or serving platter. Crush the garlic with a mortar & pestle then mix in the oil, garlic, cardamom powder, sesame seeds, and 1/4 teaspoon salt. Using a fork, pierce the cucumbers several times and sprinkle with remaining 1/4 tsp salt. Refrigerate several hours or overnight, tossing gently several times. Serve right away, or store at room temp for up to 4 days.

title: Smoked Lettives (Shish Kabob) Salad
ingredients: 4 tablespoons minced fresh coriander | 1/2 teaspoon cumin seed | 1 lb hamburger | 1 red pepper, thinly sliced | 1/2 cup coarsely chopped smoked salmon | 8 ladyfingers | 1/4 cup sugar | 1/8 teaspoon harissa
instructions: Grind spices together with fingers or meat mallet. Combine all ingredients and serve on plates with lamb.

Random Ingredients: dark sesame oil,yellow squash,snail,italian cheese,tiger shrimp,rigatoni pasta
title: Shrimp and Trevian Style Primavera
ingredients: 1 package rigatoni pasta | 24 medium tiger shrimp | 24 small tiger shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1/2 lb yellow squash, cut in 1 inch slices | 8 ounces italian cheese, shredded | 1 1/2 tablespoons dark sesame oil
instructions: Prepare rigatoni according to package directions. Keep warm. Shell and devein shrimp. In large bowl, toss shrimp, squash, and cheese. Toss with sesame oil. Add rigatoni to shrimp mixture and toss well. Garnish with scallions if desired, and serve.

Random Ingredients: sirloin,ginger garlic paste,ricotta cheese,chicken thigh fillet,rye bread,chipotle chile adobo,graham cracker crumb
title: Chipotle Cheese Crusted Chicken
ingredients: 500 g ricotta cheese | 30 g ginger-garlic paste | 120 g smoked sausage or 120 g chorizo | 1 chipotle chile in adobo, finely chopped | 1 lb boneless sirloin | rye bread, cut into four pieces | 1/2 cup cracker crumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to moderate 180c. Mix all of the ingredients together. Roll into 6cm long logs with long ends extending over the sides. Slightly flour the ends of the logs but make sure they don't touch. Place the roped logs on a baking tray and top evenly with the prepared bread pieces. Sprinkle the crumbs over top. Bake in the oven for 10 - 15 minutes or until golden and cooked through.

Random Ingredients: beef stew meat,kosher salt black pepper,steak seasoning,ranch dressing,cumin powder
title: Beef Taters(Carne Asada)
ingredients: 1 beef stew meat, cut into 1 inch pieces | 1/2 cup ranch dressing | 1 cup beef sirloin seasoning | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Preheat the broiler to high heat. Toss the beef with the ranch dressing, cumin and beef seasoning. Season with salt and pepper and place in oven on the rack 3 inches from the heat. Cook 1 hour and 15 minutes to medium rare, or your desired degree of doneness. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: vegetable bouillon cube,garlic powder,white wine vinegar,rabbit,jalapeno pepper,sun tomato oil,red pepper,shell pasta
title: Rabbit With Pasta
ingredients: 4 rabbit, cutlets, not legs ( i cut a cube of chicken ) | 12 ounces small shell pasta, any shape | 16 ounces rindless bacon from a package | 1 tablespoon sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained and diced | 1 jalapeno pepper ( optional ) | 1 vegetable bouillon cube | 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon garlic powder
instructions: Place chicken, rind, sun dried tomatoes and jalapeno pepper in a baking dish sprayed with vegetable oil. Bake at approximately 400 degrees for 30 minutes. Place bacon in a skillet and cook on medium to high heat until slightly crisp. Drain bacon on paper towels and set aside. Add vegetables in baking dish to skillet and cook on medium to low heat with the bacon grease. Add vinegar, garlic powder and mix well. Cook until vegetables cook down add water to sauce to make 2 cups. Cover and cook on medium low for about 45 minutes or until thickened.

Random Ingredients: peanut oil,curry powder,rigatoni pasta,curry paste,apple cider
title: Indonesian Curry Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb rigatoni pasta, uncooked | 1 teaspoon peanut oil | 1/2 cup unsweetened apple cider | 1 teaspoon curry powder | 1 teaspoon mild curry paste
instructions: In medium saucepan of boiling salted water, cook rigatoni until al dente, rinse and drain. In large skillet, heat oil on medium heat, add cider and curry powder, cook 1 minute. Add curry paste, cook 1 minute. Drain cooked pasta and add to skillet, stir until coated with curry paste.

Random Ingredients: cane sugar,salt pepper,corn oil,potato,yellow bell pepper,pork,lemon peel,cabbage
title: Filipino Shami Cabbage and Potato Casserole
ingredients: 12 potatoes, peeled and cut into 6 inch pcs | 1/2 lb cabbage, finely shredded | 1 lb ground lean pork or 1 lb ground chicken | 4 lemons, peel and juice of | 2 yellow bell peppers, cut into 1 inch squares | 1/2 cup corn oil | salt and pepper | 1/2 cup unbleached cane sugar
instructions: Shami cut raw cabbage into 2 inch pcs. Cut each square into 6 inch square slices, with the core removed. Rinse the cabbage well several times. Set aside. In a deep pan, combine the pork, salt, pepper and lemons juice. Squeeze the juice of 1 lemon in the mixture. Add the chopped yellow peppers. In the bottom of a casserole dish, layer the cabbage and half of the potatoes. Add the rest of the pork mixture, sprinkle with half the cane sugar and cover with the remaining potato. Bake in a preheated 350°f oven for 30 - 40 minutes, or until all the liquid has come out of the bottom of the casserole. It is time consuming and labour intensive. Serve hot.

title: Paella Bread Bowl
ingredients: 100 g backfin crab meat, in one piece or 10 g fresh crab meat, finely chopped | 1 cup arborio rice | 1 cup frozen peas ( or fresh if possible ) | 1 can chicken wings, split | 1/2 cup teriyaki sauce ( or tamari or soy sauce ) | 1/4 - 1/2 cup water or 1/4-1/2 cup water
instructions: First, make the bomba bread by combining the crab, peas/parsley, rice, and teriyaki sauce in a bowl and mixing well. Add the water or wine to achieve a silky creamy consistency. Heat an 8 inch iron skillet or frying pan to medium heat. Dip each wing quarter into the teriyaki sauce, then place them in the skillet. Cook for around 2 minutes until lightly browned. Carefully flip the wings. Serve immediately straight away. Serve with pappardia or other chinese rice.

title: Pepper Steak on the Grill
ingredients: 1 lb rump steak | 6 slices white bread | 6 apples ( recommended -- granny smith, empire, rome, macintosh )
instructions: Preheat your grill to medium. Take your four rump steak tucking them together and make a cavity in each one. Add two slices of bread to the cavity and press a few slices of apple onto each steak. Repeat two more times. Place burgers on preheated grilling surface and continue grilling. You will need to rotate your steak around every 5 minutes for the last 6 - 8 minutes so both sides are done through.

title: Corn-Braised Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 2 lbs beef tenderloin | 2 celery ribs, thinly sliced | 2 cans white corn
instructions: Combine celery, corn and beef in large baking dish. Cover. Bake in a 350° oven until meat falls off the bone. Internal temperature is 135° and meat falls from the bones. This may take 45 minutes to 1 hour. Let stand 5 - 10 minutes before slicing.

title: Cabbage and Bell Peppers Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups cabbage, very thinly sliced ( any color ) | 1 cup bell pepper, chopped | 1/2 cup radish, chopped | 1/4 cup almonds, sliced | 1/2 cup spaghetti sauce | 1/4 cup watercress or 1/4 cup flat leaf parsley
instructions: Place all ingredients in a large bowl. Toss well, and serve at once..

Random Ingredients: yellow bell pepper,cooking spray,dill weed,pesto sauce
title: Herbed Grilled Peppers
ingredients: butter-flavored cooking spray | 1 tablespoon dill weed, divided | 1 yellow bell pepper, cut into 6 pepper rings | 2 cups prepared pesto sauce
instructions: Preheat grill to medium high. Spray skillet with cooking oil. Grill peppers about 10 minutes on one side, until blackened. Turn to other side and grill another 10 minutes or until blackened. Remove from grill and let cool until slightly warm. Brush pepper with oil and grill for 5 minutes on each side. Remove from grill and stir in about 1/2 t dill weed or 1/2 tsp dillweed per slice. Spoon peppers onto serving platter. Top with remaining dill weed. Cover with remaining pepper slices. Pesto sauce. Cook pepper rings over medium high in microwave for 5 seconds or until crisp. Arrange on platter with remaining dill weed and pesto.

title: Mexican Pork & Rice Salad
ingredients: 400 g pork, cubed | 1/2 cup soymilk | 300 g mexican blend cheese, finely grated | 1 tablespoon rice wine vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together in a bowl. Put in fridge for at least 1 hour and serve.

Random Ingredients: extra sharp cheddar cheese,chicken broth,vanilla extract,chicken,lemon juice,tomato sauce
title: Creamy Greek Chicken (Greece)
ingredients: 1/2 cup light extra-sharp cheddar cheese, grated | 1 can tomato sauce | 1/2 teaspoon pure vanilla extract | 1/2 cup chicken broth | 1 tablespoon fresh lemon juice | 2 cups cooked chicken, cubed
instructions: In a blender or food processor, combine cheese, tomato sauce and vanilla. Blend until smooth, adding broth gradually, blending after each addition. Add lemon juice, blending after each addition. Transfer to a shallow dish. Cover, and refrigerate 3 hours or overnight. To serve, remove lid, and spoon greek sauce into serving dishes. Garnish with fresh parsley and paprika if desired.

Random Ingredients: green chilies,barbeque sauce,louisiana sauce,vegetable oil,onion powder
title: Fried Green Chilies
ingredients: 1/4 cup barbeque sauce | 1/8 cup vegetable oil | 1 can chopped green chilies | 1 teaspoon onion powder | 2 teaspoons louisiana-style hot sauce
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large skillet over medium high and lightly fry green chilies. Add barbeque sauce or favorite sauce to pan and simmer for 10 minutes. Meanwhile, heat remaining oil in a heavy skillet over medium heat. When hot, add green chilies and onion powder.

title: Yogurt Raita
ingredients: 4 ounces plain yogurt | 1 ounce tea, your favourite | 1 tortilla chips, for dipping ( optional ) or 1/4 cup crushed tortilla chips, for dipping ( optional )
instructions: Place the yogurt in a coffee mug or serving dish. Add the tea and stir to distribute the yogurt evenly. Top with the crushed tortilla or crushed tortilla chips. Serve warm or chilled.

title: Grilled Arepas (Mexican Corn Fritters)
ingredients: 4 ears fresh corn, shucked and cut in half lengthwise ( about 3-inch diameter ) | 4 tablespoons dark rum, approximately ( more or less to taste ) | lime wedge ( optional )
instructions: Place corn cut side up on a work board or rimmed baking sheet and cut a slit in top of each ear and then carefully remove the corn'snack', leaving the cut out the ‘fruit. Discard the shell. If using the lime wedge, remove the seeds and white membrane from inside. Place the corn on the work surface or the cutting board, sprinkle lightly with rum, and close the ears. Using a meat mallet or a rolling pin, pound the corn out to about 1/4 to 1/4 inch thickness. Transfer the corn to your work surface and carefully cut into 1/2 inch thick pieces.. If using the lime wedge, lightly toast the corn on a griddle until lightly golden brown and crisp, being careful not to burn. Grill, turning once, the arepas over direct heat, stirring constantly with a slotted spoon, for 1 - ¼ minutes on each side or until they are light brown on all sides. Serve with lime wedges.

Random Ingredients: lipton onion soup mix,yellow rice,chicken thigh,cider vinegar,almond extract,ice water
title: Almond Chicken Pilaf
ingredients: 4 lbs chicken thighs | 1 envelope lipton dry onion soup mix | 1 envelope lipton onion soup mix | 1 1/2 teaspoons almond extract | 3/4 cup sliced almonds, toasted | 1/3 cup water | 1/3 cup white wine vinegar
instructions: Preheat oven to 425ºf. Place the legs and thighs in a large, oven proof baking dish large enough to hold them in a single layer. In bowl mix dry soup mix, onion soup mix and almond extract. Pour over chicken and turn to coat. Cover tightly with foil. Bake at 425ºf for 1 hour. Turn oven to broil and broil for 10 minutes longer. Remove foil and top with sliced almonds. Broil chicken for an additional 2 to 3 minutes, turning chicken halfway through. Remove from oven. Degrease pan juices and deglaze. Pour sauce over chicken and serve.

Random Ingredients: hot italian sausage,palm sugar,spice,green chili pepper
title: Homemade Spiced Spanish Hot Italian Sausages
ingredients: 2 -4 lbs hot italian sausages ( about 6 links about 3.5 pounds total ) | 1/2 cup dry-roasted garlic or 1/2 cup dried roasted garlic | 1/2 cup green chili pepper, finely chopped | 1/2 cup mixed spice, see note below
instructions: Combine all ingredients except for sausage and mix thoroughly. Brush on sausages. Grill or broil over hot coals for about 20, moving frequently when browned, 5 - 10 minutes for small ones. Serve with hot yellow rice, white wine, or fresh bread slices with a touch of spice added.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast,chicken stock cube,onion powder,lemon wedge
title: Lemon Chicken
ingredients: 1 chicken breast, sliced | 1 large onion, sliced ( optional ) | 3 tablespoons lemons, juice of ( i use lime juice ) | 2 chicken stock cubes
instructions: Place all ingredients in a saucepan, or ziplock bag, and whisk together. Heat on medium, covered, until chicken is tender. Note, if i was cooking right away, i might use my bbq to marinate, covered.

Random Ingredients: pea,grenadine,fryer chicken,red cabbage,artichoke heart,beef,curry leaf,garlic powder
title: Budget Curry in Crock Pot
ingredients: 1 fryer chickens, cut into bite-size pieces | 1/2 teaspoon curry leaf, crushed ( can use 1-2 tbs. dried ) | 2 cans of quartered artichoke hearts, drained | 1 jar frozen peas, drained | 1/4 cup bottled roasted garlic powder ( about 4 or 5 cloves ) | 2 teaspoons grenadine | 1 1/2 cups red cabbage, shredded | 1 head fat-free range broccoli, chopped
instructions: Spray the crock with cooking spray and add all ingredients. Stir to mix thoroughly. Add more garlic powder if you love garlic. Place on bottom layer of crock pot set to low or warm to lukewarm temperature and cook until chicken and vegetables are tender. Serve over steamed jasmine rice.

title: My Version of Sausage Orzo
ingredients: 6 cups dry orzo pasta ( orzo ) | parsley
instructions: Cook the pasta and drain. Stir well. Top with a sprinkling of parsley.

Random Ingredients: neufchatel cheese,pork shoulder,eggnog,active yeast,grain white rice,whipping cream,mexican cheese,oregano flake
title: Peruvian Pork Carnitas (Or Carnitas)
ingredients: 2 cups eggnog, room temperature | 1/4 dry active yeast, dissolved in 1 cup warm water | 3 cups long-grain white rice, not minute rice | 5 lbs boneless pork shoulder, cut into thirds | 2 tablespoons dried oregano flakes or 2 tablespoons fresh oregano | 1 package neufchatel cheese, softened | 3/4 cup whipping cream | 2 cups mexican cheese, shredded
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Lightly grease 1 9x13 baking pan. Make first layer using eggnog, then the yeast/water mixture. Rinse rice in colander and dry with paper towels. Place rice in large bowl and add enough water to cover. Soak at least 1 hour or up to 48 hours, in the refrigerator overnight. When ready to make carnitas, preheat oven to 375°f. Drain rice thoroughly and spread 2/3 in bottom of baking pan. Layer with pork and then 1/3 of crème fraîche and 1/3 of shredded mexican cheese. Repeat layers until pan appears at least 3 layers of stuffed rice. Bake at 375°f for 30 minutes. After 30 minutes, remove from oven and carefully pour cream/cheese mixture over top. Return pan to oven, uncovered for 15 minutes, until top is browned. Note, i use a very large cast iron skillet. It can also be heated on medium high with the cast iron skillet. If you don't have a cast iron skillet, make sure to place a small piece of pan directly on the bottom of the pan. It helps to toast the bread more nicely. I also like to spread some paprika on top of the cornbread layer when baking.

title: Prawns in Prawn Sauce (Antiguan Empanadas)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs hamburger | 500 g baby shrimp, cooked ( peeled ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried oregano leaves
instructions: Heat the palm of your hands a bit, or do your best to have the palm in front of you. Put the mince in a bowl and mix with the oregano. Roll the prawns in the mixture until well coated. Put the prawns on a plate, sprinkle with oregano, and then grill the prawns until the outside is just cooked and just firm. Serve with your favourite dip from the dish. Also great served with rice.

title: Hot Samosas
ingredients: 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil, plus extra for tossing | 14 ounces dark rum
instructions: Heat the olive oil on medium high heat in a skillet. When the oil almost reaches smoking point, add the rum and turn down to medium. Let the rum infuse for a minute or two until a light golden brown. Pour the hot samosas into a resealable plastic bag, and allow to settle, shaking gently until all of the air is gone. Store in the fridge for up 3 days.

title: Sugar-Burned Shortcut Spice Mix for Fish or Chips
ingredients: 1 cup coarsely ground pepper ( green, black ) | 1 cup sweet unsweetened coconut oil | 2 tablespoons chili oil
instructions: Combine all ingredients in small bowl.

title: Cedar Door Firecracker Polish Sausage
ingredients: 1 package kielbasa sausage | 4 slices fresh gingerroot | 3/4 cup dark sesame oil
instructions: Preheat grill. Place sausage links on grill grate. Cook for 15 minutes. Turn sausage over and cook for 15 minutes more. Let sausage cool for 10 minutes, then slice into thick matchstick size pieces. Heat sesame oil over high heat in deep skillet, until almost smoking. Place sausage on hot, cooked side down, and cook for 10 to 15 minutes, until meat is crispy. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: alfredo sauce,orange juice,baby carrot,greek yogurt,white onion,serrano chili
title: Elegant Carrot and White Onion Parcels
ingredients: 1 lb baby carrots | 1/4 cup white onion, chopped | 1/2 anaheim chili, deseeded and cut into thin strips | 1 fresh serrano chili, deseeded and finely diced | 2 tablespoons fresh orange juice | 2 tablespoons olive oil or 2 tablespoons coconut oil | 1 container plain low-fat greek yogurt
instructions: Place the carrots in a pot of salted water and boil for 20 minutes or until very tender. Drain and set aside to get rid of any excess moisture. Heat the olive oil in a large saute pan and saute the green or red onions until tender but not brown, about 2 minutes,. Add the chilies and continue to saute 1 minute. Taste and adjust seasoning with salt and pepper. Remove from the heat and set aside. When the carrots have cooled to room temperature, peel off the skins. In a blender, puree the carrots and the onions in batches until smooth. If you feel like adding more oil after about 10 minutes of puree, don’t over purée. You may need to add more oil at this point. Transfer the filling to a medium bowl. Stir in the orange juice and mix well. Refrigerate until ready to serve, about 10 minutes. Divide the yogurt among 4 dinner sized serving bowls. Spoon the carrot mixture evenly over the yogurt. Serve chilled.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil,potato flour,mix,cumin seed,lasagna noodle,parsley leaf,salt,potato
title: Yummy Potato and Parsley Lasagna
ingredients: 9 lasagna noodles | 750 g potatoes ( diced ) | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 1 tablespoon potato flour | 1 teaspoon ground cumin seed | 2 tablespoons parsley leaves ( chopped ) | salt | vegetable oil, for deep frying
instructions: Grate potatoes, and boil. Add 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil to a pan and bring to the boil. Add potato flour, cumin to pan and stir until mixture thickens and starts to bubble. Add parsley to skillet and stir. Turn heat down, put lid on and simmer for 20 minutes. Drain lasagna noodles and set aside. Boil water and heat a large, deep pan. Layer into pan the mashed potatoes, then cover with another layer of potatoes. Repeat layers twice the time. Keep sprinkling with potato flour, mix and put lid on. Cook on low heat for 45 minutes, or until potatoes are cooked through. When time is up, check to see if potatoes are done.

title: Turmeric Marsala (Hot and Spicy Marsala)
ingredients: 2 ounces marsala | 1/8 teaspoon turmeric | 1 dash of freshly grated nutmeg
instructions: Combine all ingredients and stir to mix well. Store in the refridgerator away from direct sunlight or in a cool, dark place. Serve or store airtight in a cool airtight container. Keeps up to 3 years.

title: Grilled Scallops
ingredients: 4 sea scallops | 2 ounces grenadine
instructions: Brush scallops with grenadine.

title: Sweet and Sour Sandwich
ingredients: 1 tablespoon herbs ( such as sage, dill, parsley, chives or chives ) | 1 tablespoon hoagie roll | 1 tablespoon sugar-free syrup
instructions: Put all the ingredients except honey in a microwave safe bowl and microwave for 2 - 3 minutes, stirring twice. When the sandwich is warm, spread with honey.

Random Ingredients: pearl barley,green cardamom pod,parmesan cheese,daikon radish,red wine vinegar,spinach
title: Garlic Pepper-Bowl Soup
ingredients: 1 bag fresh spinach, washed ( about 10 cups ) | 1 cup pearl barley, about 1 1/2 pounds | 1 cup daikon radish, peeled, halved, thinly sliced crosswise | 1/4 cup red wine vinegar | 2 green cardamom pods, seeds scraped, bruised with | ground cardamom | grated parmesan cheese ( for garnish )
instructions: Cook spinach with barley over medium heat just until tender, about 5 minutes. Add radishes and red wine vinegar. Break blackened cardamind in handfuls.

title: Souvlakia (Souvlakia) (Homemade Vinegar)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dried italian parsley | 1 - 1 1/4 lb bottled sweet wine
instructions: Drain the parsley well, rinse well, then squeeze with your hands to remove the sand. If it feels hard and dry, let your hands dry some more. Measure the 1/4 lb. Of parsley out in a strainer and place in a medium saucepan with enough water to cover completely. Bring to a boil over high heat, reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer, stirring once or twice during cooking, for 1 hour. Meanwhile, make the sauce. Stir the wine, pouring over the soaked parsley as you pour. Return to a boil over high heat and cook until reduced to half, 2 to 5 minutes.

title: Tunisian Style Salad (Barefoot Contessa Bakari)
ingredients: 2 heads kielbasa, halved crosswise | 2 pears ( i love pears, but i usually just use what i can find ) | 1/2 cup catsup | 2 shallots | 1 teaspoon dried fenugreek leaves
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Remove the hard stem pieces with a spoon, and plunge the kielbasas in, one at a time. Cook until the meat is no longer pink inside and the kielbasas are soft. Place kielbasa on a cutting board, and slice into 1/4 inch slices. Place in a serving bowl, and toss with the pears, catsup, and shallots. Sprinkle with fenugreek flakes, cover, and refrigerate for at least four hours, tossing the salad while it's still hot.

Random Ingredients: triple sec,lettuce,white rice flour,basil leaf,spinach leaf,chicken,cottage cheese
title: Chicken and Spinach Rolls
ingredients: 4 ounces spinach leaves, washed | 4 ounces fresh spinach leaves | 9 ounces tri-colored cheese ( such as gruyere, monterey jack or other blue cheese ) | 1 lb lean ground chicken | 1 tablespoon whole white rice flour | 4 tablespoons mixed salad greens ( such as boston bibb or leaf salad greens ) | 6 -8 fresh basil leaves, washed
instructions: Rinse the spinach leaves and dry them very well. Slice the center of half the spinach leaves thinly and reserve. Toast the remaining spinach leaves in a dry skillet. Heat the chicken over moderate heat until lightly brown. Break up the cheese into small pieces and stir into the chicken until melted. Remove from heat. Place the rice flour in a small bowl, add half of the hot chicken fat and stir it through the flour until lightly mixed. Remove the chicken fat from the skillet and set aside. In another small bowl, place the spinach leaves and stir them into the chicken fat. Let fry, stirring, until wilted and brightly colored, about 2 minutes. Drain the spinach on paper towels. Heat the remaining 2 tablespoons reserved chicken fat in a large skillet. Add the spinach and the cheese in the skillet and stir over medium heat until the cheese is melted, about 2 minutes. Serve the dough on a platter and place the spinach and cheese mixture on top of it. Wash the basil leaves and arrange them around the roll as a garnish. Dollop a couple tablespoons of the hot chicken fat over the top of the roll.

title: Granita
ingredients: 1 pound dried small tomatoes and cranberries, coarsely chopped | 2 tablespoons dried fruit flavored fruit, such as peaches, apricots, grapes, red peaches, cherries | 1 can tomato puree
instructions: Place dried tomatoes and cranberries in a bowl with water to cover. Soak overnight, or for at least 8 hours. Drain and rinse. Transfer to a saucepan, and boil for 45 minutes, or until softened. Drain and discard any excess water. Stir in dried fruit flavored fruit. Pour tomato puree into a saucepan, and mix with cranberries. Reduce heat to low, and simmer for 1 1/2 hours, or until thick.

Random Ingredients: serrano chilies,cremini mushroom,ginger root,mozzarella cheese,chicken bouillon
title: Chinese Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds cremini mushrooms | 3 tablespoons chicken bouillon | 1 piece fresh ginger root, thinly sliced | 1 serrano chilies, minced | 1/3 cup shredded mozzarella cheese
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Place mushrooms in the boiling water, and remove from heat. Cover, and let mushrooms steam until tender, about 5 minutes. Squeeze mushrooms, and mash together with the chicken broth and ginger. Stir in the serrano chilies. Heat the shredded cheese in a skillet over medium heat, and cook until melted. Stir the mushroom mixture into the cheese, reduce heat to low, and simmer until mixture is hot and bubbly, about 5 minutes. Serve.

title: Kielbasa and Brisket over Pasta
ingredients: 1 package beef brisket ( cut into 3/4 in. slices ) | 1 package kielbasa, sliced 1/2-inch thick | 2 cups uncooked spiral shaped pasta shells | 1/3 shallot, minced | 1 anchovy fillet, chopped | 1 can of anchovy fillets, undrained, chopped | 1 1/2 cups beef broth | filling, recipe follows
instructions: Heat 1 tblsp. Oil in heavy large skillet, over medium high heat. Sprinkle beef with salt and pepper. Working in batches, cook beef for 5 minutes per batch, adding more oil if necessary. Transfer beef to plate.

Random Ingredients: malt vinegar,cumin,ice water,turnip,lentil,sharp cheddar cheese,red apple,asafoetida powder
title: Dhikari Yveshi (Lentils & Turnips)
ingredients: 1 cup lentils, picked over and rinsed | 4 1/2 cups ice water | 2 large red apples, such as fuji, peeled, cored, and diced | 1 large turnip, peeled, cored, and diced | 1 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground cumin | 1 1/2 teaspoons malt vinegar | 1/2 cup sharp cheddar cheese, shredded
instructions: Place the lentils and the 4½ cups of water in a heavy 4 quart saucepan. Cover, and bring to a boil over moderate heat. Reduce heat, and simmer for 10 minutes. Cover and set aside to simmer on a low heat. Meanwhile, place the apples, turnip, and asafetida in a medium large skillet. Cook over moderately high heat, stirring occasionally, until the fruit is slightly softened, 5–6 minutes. Remove from the heat. Place the cinnamon, cumin, and remaining 2 1/2 cups water in a blender. Add 2 tbsp of the cheese, and blend until finely chopped. Add half the spice mixture to the lentils. Cover and simmer over low heat, stirring occasionally, for 30 minutes. Add the remaining spice mixture and simmer, stirring, 5 minutes longer. Serve in warm bowls.

Random Ingredients: jalapeno chile,red potato,spanish onion,picante sauce,rigatoni pasta
title: Mexican Potato Skins #Ragu
ingredients: 2 lbs red potatoes, quartered | 1 spanish onion, chopped | 1/2 cup picante sauce | 2 jalapeno chiles, seeded and chopped | 1 lb rigatoni pasta, cooked
instructions: Place potatoes in 6 cup microwave safe dish. Cover and microwave on high for 8 - 10 minutes, until tender. Drain. Coarsely chop. Stir chopped potatoes, onion, picante sauce and jalapeños into potatoes. Cover and microwave an additional 3 minutes, until hot and bubbly.

title: Sweet and Curried Red Curry Paste for Fish
ingredients: 1 teaspoon red curry paste | 1 teaspoon sugar
instructions: Sieve the red curry paste and add the sugar. Keep the mixture refrigerated at least an hour. Take out a little of the curry from time to time. Stir well and leave to cool. Pour it into a non reactive bowl. Add more curry paste and keep stirring. Let it cool.

Random Ingredients: ginger ale,tapioca,black sesame seed,cream chicken soup,red potato,ra el hanout spice mix,vanilla sugar,tomato soup
title: Crock-Pot Baked Red Potato Fondue
ingredients: 2 lbs small red potatoes, peeled and diced into chunks ( about 4 medium or 6 medium ) | 1 jar roasted green sesame seeds | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup ( campbell's condensed fat free cream of chicken soup with 1 can ) | 1 can condensed tomato soup ( campbell's condensed ) | 3 tablespoons low-sodium tapioca | 1/2 teaspoon ground ginger ale ( not evaporated light or regular soda ) | 2 tablespoons vanilla sugar | 2 tablespoons ras el hanout spice mix | 1/2 teaspoon black sesame seed ( optional )
instructions: Place the potatoes in a 3 1/2 to 4 1/2 quart slow cooker. Sprinkle with the black sesame seed seeds. In a medium bowl, mix the cream of chicken soup, tomato soup, and tapioca. Pour into the insert of the slow cooker. Stir the ras el hanout spice mix into the soup mixture.. Do not mix the two, just mix enough to combine. Pour over the potato mixture..
