Cover and cook on high for 3 1/2 hours or on low 5 1/2 hours until the potatoes are tender. Ladle the fondue into a small bowl, and stir in the powdered ginger ale, vanilla sugar, and sesame seeds. Serve with fresh french bread.

title: Elva's Easy Vegan Baked Chickpeas & Rye Bread Casserole
ingredients: 1 package phyllo pastry sheets, thawed ( i bought ours at walmart ) | 1 can low-sodium chickpeas, drained and rinsed under cold water | 4 cups sliced rye bread | 1 1/2 teaspoons vanilla essence ( not essence plain ) | 1 cup panko breadcrumbs ( breadcrumbs can be used )
instructions: Prepare 10 x 15 inch jelly roll pan with nonstick cooking spray. Line bottoms with 1 sheet of phyllo. Trim phyllo to size for pan. Line bottom with remaining layer of phyllo. Trim and discard excess phyllo. Trim and discard phyllo from bottom of pan.

Random Ingredients: baby spinach,red onion,anchovy,salmon fillet,water chestnut,ginger ale,spice
title: Anchovy Fish Platter(Jamaican)
ingredients: 1 can anchovies ( i use king oscars anchovies ) | 1/3 cup ginger ale | 1/3 cup red onion, minced and divided | 1/4 cup baby spinach ( or greens of your choice ) | 1/4 cup canned water chestnut ( or green of your choice ) | 2 teaspoons dried mixed spices ( i use spice island mix ) | 5 2 lbs salmon fillets or 5 lbs salmon steaks
instructions: Make slits in anchovies with a sharp knife, just in one side of each slice of fish. Mix beer with 1/2 c minced onion and 1 tbs dried spice mix in small bowl to make marinade.

title: Spicy Amarello
ingredients: 9 sheets phyllo dough, thawed | 1/2 cup amaretto ( almond flavored liqueur ) | 1 tablespoon turmeric | 1/2 teaspoon chili
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Thoroughly mix amaretto and turmeric. Brush 1 sheet of phyllo dough with amaretto mixture. Repeat with the remaining sheets, brushing each sheet with the last brush. Place half of the phyllo sheets on a baking sheet. Brush the top of the phyllo sheets with the remaining amaretto mixture. Bake in the preheated oven, reducing heat to 350 degrees f as the phyllo sets, about 40 minutes. Allow the phyllo to cool completely.

Random Ingredients: acorn squash,masa harina flour,thai peanut sauce,lamb shoulder,apple juice,almond,pie crust,tomato puree
title: Baja Indian Lamb Pie
ingredients: 1 pie crust | 1/2 - 3/4 lb boneless lamb shoulder, cubed | 1 cup masa harina flour | 1 tablespoon tomato puree or 3 tablespoons ketchup | 1 tablespoon apple juice, from can ( or tomato juice ) | 1 tablespoon almond, sliced | 1/2 teaspoon thai peanut sauce | 1 1/2 cups masa harina flour | 1/2 cup chopped toasted almond | 1/4 cup chopped tomatoes, canned, drained
instructions: Brown lamb in large skillet. Add the onion and bring to a boil.

title: Kurdish Kebabs
ingredients: 1 pound ground beef, or more to taste | 1 tablespoon pine nuts | vegetable oil for frying
instructions: Mix ground beef with pine nuts in a large bowl. Heat a large skillet over medium low heat.

Random Ingredients: red chili paste,parsnip,peanut oil vegetable,pink grapefruit juice,broccoli floret,pearl barley,glaze,caper
title: Sweet and Sour Broccoli Barley Salad
ingredients: 1 head broccoli floret | 1 medium parsnip | 100 g pearl barley | 1 pink grapefruit, peel only, cut into 8 segments | 2 teaspoons red chili paste | 1/2 teaspoon pink grapefruit juice | 2 tablespoons peanuts oil or 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 3 teaspoons capers, drained
instructions: Heat a large saucepan over a medium heat. Add broccoli and parsnip. Sizzle for 2 - 2 1/2 minutes. Add pearl barley, grapefruit segments, chili paste, grapesfruit juice and pepper to taste. Cook for 15 - 20 minutes stirring occasionally.

title: Bacon Appetizer (Mark Bittman)
ingredients: 1 loaf, day old bread, cut into thick slices | streaky bacon, slices for wrapping
instructions: Lay the bread slices in a large clean flat dish, turning them over every few minutes until all slices have been painted with oil and the surface is dry. Wrap in foil and freeze overnight. Remove slices from freezer and slice thickly. Place on a lightly oiled oven proof dish and bake on a slow oven shelf. Serve hot, hot or cold. Variation, the croissant can be split into two smaller pieces and baked on the back of a tray or in a regular oven. The idea is very lightly, very lightly browned outside but not burned and the former with no colour showing at the edges. Variation, if using bacon as a sandwich filling, add a slice of bacon to the bread before wrapping it in slices of bread. A great alternative to wrap your bacon in slice of bread is to wrap it in very thin slices of bacon, wrap it in either a leaf of bread, wrap it in a leaf of bacon and tie closed with a string. A great alternative would is to wrap a piece of bacon around a slice of bread. A great demo on making your own sandwich filling for vegetarian or other dishes, please note, i have successfully made my own sandwich filling with this recipe, which i can happily see popping in the pan in the microwave. A nice variation is to use 1/2 small piece of bacon.

Random Ingredients: curd,garlic,bean sprout,anise extract,blue cheese,olive oil,rump roast
title: Anisette Beef
ingredients: 1 lb rump roast, cut into bite-size pieces ( rump or sirloin steaks will work also ) | 1 cup large curd | 1 container large curd, whipped as desired | 8 ounces shredded blue cheese | 2 teaspoons anise extract | 1 tablespoon minced garlic | 1 teaspoon olive oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Lightly coat a baking sheet with cooking spray. In a plastic bag, combine all ingredients except the beef. Shake well to combine. Add beef in a single layer and toss to coat. Place onto pan and bake until internal temperature reaches 160 degrees for medium rare beef, about 25 minutes. Place on cutting board and cover. Stand 10 minutes. Cut thin slices against grain into thin diagonal slices. Serve immediately or refrigerate for up to 4 days.

title: Vegetarian Lasagne
ingredients: 16 lasagna noodles ( not instant ) | 2 packages frozen plain soymilk or 2 packages cream cheese ( 2 container works well ) | 1/2 - 3/4 cup pistachio nut | 2 1/2 cups baby spinach ( finely chopped ) | 1/3 - 1/2 cup sultana ( optional ) | 2 1/2 cups low fat gouda cheese ( shredded ) | 1 can baked beans, warmed
instructions: Cook lasagne noodles as directed on the package. Drain noodles and set aside. In saucepan, bring soymilk and pistachios to a boil. Stir in spinach, reduce heat and cook about 2 - 3 minutes or until spinach is wilted, stir through sultanas and cook for another minute. Stir in noodles and heat through. When serving, spoon mixture into 9 x 13 pan or 2 9x9 x 5 pan. Top with grated cheese and bake at 350f for 30 minutes.

title: Coconut Fondue
ingredients: 1/4 cup molasses | 1/2 cup white wine | crushed ice water ( add just enough to cover the bottom of the pot ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons coconut extract | additional fresh parsley leaves, for garnish
instructions: Add the molasses, wine, and enough ice water to cover the bottom of the pot. Place over medium high heat until a boil is formed, whisking often. Add the coconut extract and transfer to a fondue pot set to warm. Taste for heat, adding more coconut extract if necessary. When the fondue starts to bubble, remove from heat and sprinkle with parsley.

Random Ingredients: red pepper flake,pernod,oregano flake,bicarbonate soda,coffee,topping,vodka,whipping cream
title: Ragout a la Panna
ingredients: 2 cups whipping cream | 500 ml vodka | 150 g fat-free whipped topping | 1 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 1 teaspoon pernod | 1/2 teaspoon oregano flakes | 1/2 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 1/4 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda
instructions: Pour the cream into a pan and bring to near boiling point. Add the vodka, whip thoroughly with a wire whisk. Add the whipped topping, red pepper and oregano. Beat until smooth and fold in the bicarb soda. Pour into serving cups and decorate with fresh oregano. Store in refrigerator. Ragout takes days to prepare.

title: Greek Yogurt Drink
ingredients: 2 tablespoons greek yogurt | 1 lime, juice of
instructions: Place all ingredients in a blender and blend until smooth.

title: Tuna and Tomato Sauce for Fish
ingredients: 1/3 cup tomato sauce, ketchup | 1/4 lb tuna, cut in 2 x 1 x 1/2 inch pieces | 1 whole red pepper | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom | chopped radish
instructions: Heat tomato sauce and tomato paste in saucepan over medium high heat. When sauce begins to bubble, add tuna cubes and cut up pepper and sprinkle with cardamom. Reduce heat and simmer, covered, 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: queso fresco cheese,cardamom pod,baking powder,kaffir lime leaf,flour tortilla
title: Mexican Queso Fresco Appetizer
ingredients: 1 lb queso fresco cheese, cut in 1/2/3 inch cubes | 8 -10 flour tortillas ( i like to tear them into 8 or 12 small flour tortillas ) | 2 large baking powder | 3 -4 kaffir lime leaves ( or other dry leafy-type herb leaves, for garnish ) | ground cardamom pod ( optional ) or cinnamon ( optional )
instructions: Set oven rack to lowest position and pre heat oven to 400 degrees f. Grease 8x10 baking pan. In a small bowl, combine the queso fresco, flour, and baking powder. Add 1 or 2 cups water, just enough to make the mixture stick together. Add the lime leaves or other dry herbs to your taste. Spread the mixture evenly into the baking pan and top with the baking pan. Bake for 15 - 20 minutes, depending on the oven.

title: Prosciutto Wrapped Rice With Prosciutto Strips
ingredients: 6 ounces prosciutto, trimmed | 2 1/2 cups basmati rice | salt & freshly ground black pepper, to taste
instructions: Preheat an oven to 350 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper and set aside. Cut the prosciutto strips into 1/2 slices. Cut each slice in 1/2. Place the strips 1 inch apart on parchment paper. Roast rice in the preheated oven until lightly browned and tender, about 15 minutes.

title: Salsa Verde
ingredients: 2 cups chunky salsa | 1 tablespoon olive oil | 3 tablespoons cooking oil
instructions: Combine salsa and 2 tablespoons oil in a medium bowl. Cover and refrigerate for at least an hour to allow flavours to combine. Serve over hot cooked rice.

title: Chipotle-Cafe Powder
ingredients: 2 teaspoons ground chipotle powder | 2 teaspoons instant espresso powder
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small bowl. Store and use in an airtight container..

title: Prosciutto-Wrapped Salmon
ingredients: 12 ounces salmon fillets | 8 slices prosciutto | 1/4 cup hijiki seaweed ( korean soy bean paste ) | 1 tablespoon roasted salami or 1 tablespoon ham, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f place salmon on a large baking sheet. Divide seaweed and prosciutto slices among salmon on the baking sheet. In a small bowl, stir together horseradish and hot pepper sauce to taste. Spread horseradish mixture over salmon and top with ham. Bake approximately 10 minutes or until fish flakes with a fork.

title: Easy Butter Bean Mash
ingredients: 1 can butter beans, drained and rinsed | 1 teaspoon dried apricot | 3 medium yellow squash
instructions: Slice each squash in half through its base and remove the seeds. Rinse the beans and pat dry. Microwave the beans on high 1 minute or until warm. Stir in the apricot, cover, and microwave on high for 2 minutes.

Random Ingredients: beef chuck,avocado,heavy whipping cream,manzanilla olive,tilapia fillet,fish stock,thyme leaf
title: Shannon's Shrimp and Avocados
ingredients: 1/2 pound tilapia fillets | 1/2 pound ground beef chuck | 1 avocado - peeled, pitted and diced | 1 can sliced manzanilla olives, drained | 1/2 cup fish stock | 1 tablespoon heavy whipping cream | 1 tablespoon fresh thyme leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place tilapia fillets on a sheet of aluminum foil. Cook and stir tilapia in a skillet over medium heat until just crisp tender, about 3 minutes per side. Transfer tilapia to a paper towel lined plate and roll to drain. Arrange tilapia on a serving platter in a single layer. Place ground beef in a skillet, and cook over medium high heat until evenly browned, about 10 minutes. Drain fat, and season with salt and black pepper. Stir in avocado and manzanilla olives. Add fish stock and cream.

Random Ingredients: penne,ginger garlic paste,chipotle chile adobo,sage leaf,american cheese
title: Capellini Allo (Penne With Fresh Sage)
ingredients: 1 lb american cheese, sliced in 1/2-inch cubes | 1/4 cup chipotle chile in adobo | 1 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste | 1/2 cup fresh sage leaf, torn | 1 lb penne, cooked for al dente
instructions: Toss everything in large bowl. Garnish with a bit of extra chopped sage before serving.

title: Easy Baked Beef Cubes
ingredients: 10 lbs sirloin | 10 boxes frozen white flour ( bag ) | 15 cans coconut milk, do not use water | 1 cup guacamole
instructions: Place sirloin in crock pot. Top with 1 boxes of coconut milk. Cover with a layer of rice noodles. Top with remaining cans of coconut milk. Sprinkle with more guacamole. Cover crockpot and cook for five hours. When ready add another layer of rice noodles and cook another ½ hours till meat is cooked.

Random Ingredients: pork tenderloin,panang curry paste,olive,sirloin tip roast,blueberry
title: Crispy Banana Pork Tenderloin
ingredients: 1 tablespoon panang's curry paste | 1 lb pork tenderloin | 1/2 cup fresh blueberries, hulled and washed | 2 tablespoons fresh sliced ripe olives | 2 tablespoons olive, minced
instructions: Heat oven to 325 degrees f. Spread pork evenly with panang. Coat pan with cooking spray. Place tenderloin, cut side up, on cutting board. Place in center of roasting pan. Top with blueberries, olives, and 1 tablespoon cooking oil. Cut crosswise into 1/2 inch slices. Roll in remaining olive mixture and place in large baking dish. Bake, uncovered, at 325 degrees f for 30 minutes or until internal pork temperature of 145 degrees f is 145 degrees f when taken with a meat thermometer. Let stand 15 minutes before slicing. Note, the cream sauce recipe editor tip, recipe editor tip, recipe editor tip, 3/4 cup panang curry paste.

title: Almond Crisp
ingredients: 1 lb blanched almond | 1 teaspoon fresh thyme sprig
instructions: Preheat oven to 350f. Lightly oil a baking sheet and set aside. Dry roast almonds in a 350f degree oven until crisp and golden, about 20 minutes. Drain on paper towels and toss with thyme. Spread on baking sheet and bake 5 minutes. Cool and store in an airtight container at room temperature.

title: Beef and Broccoli
ingredients: 1 kg beef | 1 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 4 tablespoons cooking wine | 80 ml cacao ( dark brown ) | cooking wine | 8 ounces broccoli florets | 150 g onions, sliced thin | cooking wine | cacao, to sprinkle
instructions: Cut beef into 1 inch cubes. Cut onions into quarters and slice thin. Cut broccoli florets into 2 inch lengths. Place the beef and onion in a large pot with a lid, pour on enough cooking wine to cover the beef and cover. Let it cook over a moderate heat, stirring occasionally until the beef has turned a darker brown colour. If the liquid is too concentrated add some of the cooking wine and turn it back up. If the pot is too dry, add a little more cooking wine. Keep the pot covered, simmering for 90 minutes. When the beef is almost tender, remove the lid and add the cacao and cacao mixture. Keep simmering, stirring occasionally until all the liquid has almost completely boiled away. Keep checking the broth, it should come to the boil right away. If you feel that the liquid is boiling away add a little more cooking wine and the broccoli. If the beef is tender before the beef, add another 50 minutes or so. If you feel the water level is enough, add a little bit more cooking wine, just a quick taste, and check it for doneness.

title: Grilled Fish
ingredients: 2 pounds fish | 1/4 jar prepared pesto sauce | 3 fresh jalapeno peppers
instructions: Preheat an outdoor grill for high heat and lightly oil grate. Grill fish, flesh side up until fish is firm and easily flaked with a fork, 3 to 5 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, remove fish from grill and place on a platter. Place a fresh jalapeno pepper on top of fish.

title: Salsa Croutons
ingredients: 1 cup thick and chunky salsa | 3 tablespoons shortening, softened ( optional )
instructions: In a large bowl, stir together the salsa, and cream the shortening. Make the croutons the size of a cherry. Roll the crouton in the salsa to coat. Chill, and serve right away.

title: Artichoke and Artichoke Dip
ingredients: 4 cups marinated artichoke hearts | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning salt
instructions: Stir artichoke hearts and seasoned salt together in a bowl. Cover bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 30 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Taco Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup mixed vegetables ( broccoli, carrots, cauliflower, or green onion ) | black pepper
instructions: Puree the ingredients in a blender until smooth.

title: Pea Stew
ingredients: 1 jar whole sweet peas | 3/4 cup all-purpose flour | 10 button mushrooms | 4 plum tomatoes, finely chopped | 4 tablespoons peanuts, finely chopped
instructions: To make a richer stew with peas, mix the flour with just enough water to make a paste. Saute the mushrooms, tomatoes and peanuts in the flour paste for about 6 minutes. Add the peas and cook for 30 more minutes on a gentle heat. Alternatively cook in the crockpot on low until done.

title: Barley Raita
ingredients: 1 cup pearl barley, rinsed | 3 tablespoons dark rum | 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 1/8 teaspoon ground red pepper ( optional )
instructions: Combine the barley, rum, cinnamon, and ground red pepper in a salad bowl.

title: Danish Christmas Cardamom Cookies
ingredients: 1/4 lb ground veal, fine ground | 1/4 lb cooked lean pork or 1/4 lb finely ground veal | 1 tablespoon cream of tartar | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin | 1 cup cherries, coarsely chopped | 1/8 cup kahlua
instructions: Combine all ingredients and blend well. Shape into 1 inch balls and roll in sugar. Store in an airtight container.

title: Spiced Beef Shank Pastry
ingredients: 1 beef shank, trimmed | 1 cup freshly grated parmesan cheese | 16 sheets frozen puff pastry
instructions: Place the beef shank, about 2 1/2 tablespoons each, on a large piece of wax paper. Sprinkle the parmesan cheese in a small spot on the meat. Cut 3 - 2 x 2 pieces of pastry from the short side of each piece of pastry and, using the wax paper, cut the pieces in to 8 triangles each. Press together the triangles, but not quite to the end with a fork, to make a neat rectangular shape about 10x15 inches. Place on a baking sheet. Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Roll out the pastry into a circle 1/8 inch thick. Transfer the triangles to a floured work surface. Place one triangle on top of a large spoonful of meat in the center of each piece, pressing to seal. Repeat with the other three triangles. Wrap each pastry in plastic wrap. Arrange the triangles on a cookie sheet. Bake for 25 minutes in the preheated oven. Let stand for 5 minutes before eating.

title: Chickpea and Squid Stew
ingredients: 2 cups cooked chickpeas | 1/2 lb ground pork | 12 ounces squid, tubes sliced in rings | 3 garlic cloves, chopped | 2 tablespoons baking powder | 1 small cabbage ( about 1 pound )
instructions: Combine the chickpeas and pork in a small stockpot. Sprinkle the squid with garlic and stir to coat. Cover and cook over low heat for 20 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in.. Combine baking powder and enough water to make a paste and stir in. Add slivered/chopped cabbage. Return to heat. Heat through and serve. Variation, 1 lb of ground beef.

Random Ingredients: sherry wine,curry paste,green chili pepper,irish cream,sake,peppercorn,marmalade
title: Malaysian Spiced Steak
ingredients: 4 tablespoons sherry wine | 6 tablespoons marmalade | 4 tablespoons shaoxing wine or 4 tablespoons apricot juice | 3 tablespoons curry paste | 2 tablespoons scotch whisky or 2 tablespoons arm-flour, combined with | 1 tablespoon peppercorn | sake
instructions: Preheat a grill and grill steaks on high heat for about two minutes on each side for medium rare / medium done or until cooked to your liking – keep warm whilst you prepare the sauces. Stir together the sherry, marmalade, shaoxing, whisky/apricot juice, curry and peppercorns and season with salt and pepper. Place the steak on a board and carve into serving portions or place on serving plates and place a small bowl of the sauce on top of each. Serve with steamed rice. Enjoy.

title: Linguine With Rosemary Oil & Fresh Rosemary Infest
ingredients: 12 ounces linguine ( or other flat pasta ) | fresh rosemary sprigs or parsley, to garnish
instructions: Cook linguine according to package directions. Add rosemary to hot, buttered, pasta water, making sure the water doesn't boil over. Drain pasta, and add a bit of the hot water to warm. Garnish with fresh rosemary or parsley. Serve.

title: Cold Cucumber Cocktail
ingredients: 4 cucumbers | 4 tablespoons sour cream | 4 tablespoons lemonade | 1 tablespoon horseradish ( i like lots of flavour ) | 2 tablespoons gouda cheese ( grated ) | club soda ( optional )
instructions: Place all ingredients into blender or food processor. Blend for 2 minutes. Pour into a glass, serve chilled. Note, i had a little trouble imagining how the effect of a spoon would be if you poured 2 - 3 tablespoons of the cocktail into a glass, glass or ceramic bowl, the effect of the cocktail would be if you dipped the rims first in sour cream, followed by a piece of gouda cheese, then pour in a thin layer of club soda.

title: Roasted New Potatoes for Two
ingredients: 20 red new potatoes, unpeeled | 2 lbs extra lean ground beef | 1 1/2 lbs ground veal | 1 1/2 cups pecans, chopped | 12 fluid ounces grand marnier, heated
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Place potatoes on a towel lined baking sheet. Place in a large roasting pan. Place beef, veal and pecans in a large bowl. Place in oven and bake for 20 minutes. Remove from oven and stir. Spoon the gravy over potatoes. Sprinkle top with the sugar.

Random Ingredients: sauerkraut,chili paste,rice wine vinegar,kidney bean,garam masala,pearl barley,tomato soup,celery rib
title: Baked Beans Barley
ingredients: 2 bags uncooked pearl barley | 2 cans condensed tomato soup | 1 can kidney beans, rinsed and drained | 1 1/3 cups sauerkraut | 1/4 cup rice wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon garam masala | 1 teaspoon chili paste ( or to taste ) | 3 teaspoons dried minced garlic
instructions: Pre heat the oven to 350°f. Line a 9x13 inch pan with foil and spray with nonstick cooking spray. Combine onion, soup, beans, 1 1/3 cup water, vinegar, garam masala, chili paste and garlic, and bring to boil. Remove from heat, and mix well with a wooden spoon. Pour into the prepared pan. Spread barley mixture evenly over top. Cover and bake in the preheated oven approximately 1 hour and 45 minutes, until the barley is tender and mixture has taken a firm and chewy shape. Allow to cool for 15 - 20 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: cooking oil,brown mustard seed,cremini mushroom,cognac,oyster,pecorino romano cheese,white bread
title: Wild Oysters and Toast
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cooking oil | 1/2 teaspoon brown mustard seeds | 1 cup cremini mushrooms, sliced | 12 cremini mushrooms | 4 slices white bread, toasted | 2 teaspoons cognac | 1/2 cup pecorino romano cheese
instructions: Place a rack in the top third of your oven. Heat the oil in a skillet over medium heat and fry the mustard seeds until they start to pop. Add the cremini and shitake mushrooms and saute until tender. Remove heat and top with toast. Sprinkle with cognac and let melt. Top with cheese and serve.

title: Cheese Rosti
ingredients: 2 cups cheese, grated | 2 cups cauliflower, chopped
instructions: Combine the cheese and cauliflower in a medium bowl. Place one third of the cheese mix in the center of each tortilla and roll up. Place the tortillas on a baking sheet and heat in a 400 degree oven for 10 minutes, or until warm.

title: Flowers of Watermelon
ingredients: 3 -5 lbs fingerling potatoes, scrubbed and halved lengthwise | 2 lbs watermelon ( rind on ) | 2 tablespoons onion seeds
instructions: Place watermelon and onion in a large saucepan and add enough water to cover the fruit. Place potatoes on top, and put a heavy weight on top. Bring to a boil and cook for 5 to 6 hours, or until tender. Strain and serve.

Random Ingredients: corn syrup,fruit,salsa con queso,cinnamon,irish cream,pepper juice,dark rum,shell pasta
title: Mexican Nite
ingredients: 1 can salsa con queso, i prefer my own homemade brand | 1 - 1 1/2 cup dark rum | 1 tablespoon light corn syrup | 2 tablespoons light corn syrup | 1 cinnamon sticks or 1 tablespoon cinnamon | 1 teaspoon fresh ground pepper ( or to taste ) | 1 tablespoon fresh ground mixed fruit or 1 tablespoon dried fruit, crushed or | 1 tablespoon irish cream ( optional ) | 8 ounces small shell pasta, cooked ( bowtie, macaroni, or small shells are good )
instructions: Make the salsa con queso. In a small pot add 1 - 2 tablespoons of light corn syrup and 1 - 2 tablespoons of light corn syrup. Over medium heat, until the temperature reaches 235 degrees celcius. Immediately lower the heat, but keep stirring until the temperature reaches 235 degrees celcius again. Immediately remove from the heat. Add the rum, 1/2 teaspoon of cinnamon, 1/2 teaspoon of pepper. Stir to combine. Refrigerate 30 - 45 minutes or longer. Mix the remaining 1 - 2 tablespoons of light corn syrup with the cooked pasta. Serve chilled. Stir in a large serving bowl over the hot salsa con queso. Stir in the spiced fruit if using. Serve hot.

title: Baked Brisket
ingredients: 1 beef brisket | 2 tablespoons margarine | 1/4 cup dry sherry | 1/4 cup dried apricot
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. In a small skillet, melt the margarine over medium high heat. Quickly lay out the brisket, then pour margarine all around. Place brisket on a rack in a roasting pan. Cook, uncovered, in preheated oven for 1 hour. Turn over the brisket, and continue cooking for 1 hour and 15 minutes. Remove brisket, and remove the pan juices. Place brisket onto serving platter, and brush with the sherry and apricots. Serve cold.

Random Ingredients: black soy sauce,asafoetida powder,mustard seed,prosciutto ham,cognac,white sugar
title: Tangy Ham Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds thick-cut prosciutto ham, sliced | 2 tablespoons mustard seed | 2 teaspoons white sugar | 1 teaspoon black soy sauce | 2 1/2 teaspoons black soy sauce | 1/4 teaspoon asafoetida powder
instructions: Arrange prosciutto slices in a single layer on a flat, microwavable baking dish. Combine 2 tablespoons mustard seed with 2 teaspoons sugar and black soy sauce in a small, dry skillet. Heat over medium heat, stirring occasionally and watching carefully to make sure sugar has melted. When the mixture is bubbling, add asafetida powder and whisk well. Allow to cook for 1 minute. Pour mixture over prosciutto slices and stir to coat.

Random Ingredients: cauliflower floret,milk,bean,cannellini bean,hard egg,bulk sausage,green chile pepper,self raising flour
title: Sausage Bean Crepes
ingredients: 12 hard-boiled eggs | 1/2 cup whole milk | 1/2 cup green chile peppers | 1 cup chopped cauliflower florets | 1 can cannellini beans, drained | 2 cups self-raising flour | 3 -4 cups hot cooked beans, chopped | 1 cup cooked crumbly bulk sausage
instructions: Remove and chop each egg into 6 wedges.

Random Ingredients: plain yogurt,blue curacao,tomato,dashi stock,yellow bell pepper
title: Greek Goddess
ingredients: 1 can diced tomatoes, drained, juices reserved | 1 dash good dashi stock | 4 small yellow bell peppers ( or orange or green bell peppers if you can find it ) | 1/3 - 1/2 cup plain yogurt, at room temp | 1 -2 teaspoon mild blue curacao
instructions: Place drained tomatoes in a small bowl. Douse with dashi. I used a splash of sherry which was a nice touch to the yogurt. Use reserved tomato juice if needed for a thicker consistency. Slice the yellow pepper thinly. Place in a bowl with a drizzle of olive oil and the yogurt. Add salt to taste. Let it sit on the counter for ten minutes to absorb excess moisture. Mix well, let sit for a couple of minutes. Chill several hours so flavors can develop. Add more olive oil and yogurt if needed if needed. Serve on bed of or asparagus.

title: Salsa
ingredients: 3 -4 pints cherry tomatoes | 2 -3 jalapenos | 2 tablespoons cayenne pepper
instructions: Roast the tomatoes, jalapeno, and cayenne pepper in a 400 degree oven until they begin to shrivel. Let cool so that they are easier to handle. Wash and core the jalapenos and put them with the tomatoes and jalapenos in a food processor. Pulse until you have a coarse salsa to make tacos. You can add cayenne pepper to season at this point if desired. Store in a small jar in the refrigerator and use for chili or other recipes.

Random Ingredients: tarragon,cardamom seed,cayenne pepper,cooking oil,dark soy sauce,lemon lime beverage
title: Lemont's Lemony Russian Cocktail
ingredients: 1 cup plain dark soy sauce | 1 bottle lemon-lime flavored carbonated beverage | 1/2 cup cooking oil | 2 tablespoons dried tarragon | 2 tablespoons cardamom seeds | 1 pinch cayenne pepper
instructions: Combine the soy sauce, lemon lime soda, oil, tarragon, cardamom, and cayenne pepper in a blender, and blend until smooth. Pour into a glass over ice, and refrigerate the drink.

title: Harry's Rainy Day Cocktail
ingredients: 24 ounces ketchup | 12 ounces cherries
instructions: Mix ketchup and cherries together to make the ketchup ketchup. Start at least 2 hours before serving, but serve over ice.

title: Linguine and Pear Stir Fry
ingredients: 1 package linguine, chilled | 1 cup frozen pear slices | 1/2 cup lemongrass | 1/4 lb linguine, cooked | 1/4 teaspoon oregano | 1/4 teaspoon anise extract | 3 drops hot sauce
instructions: Cook linguine according to package directions on the package. Reserve 1 tablespoon of the cooking liquid and set aside. Mix the remaining ingredients in a bowl and set aside. Cook linguines according to package directions. Top with reserved cooking liquid and serve with the reserved cooking liquid.

title: Salmon Filets (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 4 salmon fillets ( about 1/2 inch thick ) | 1 can green beans, in water, drained | 1 jar maraschino cherries, drained | 1 cup sour cream | 1 cup cherry juice ( juice reserved ) | 1 tablespoon marjoram, chopped | 1 jar meatballs ( in tomato sauce )
instructions: Place salmon, beans, cherries, sour cream, cherry juice, marjoram, and meatballs in the crock of a 5 quart or larger slow cooker. Cover and cook on low for 6 to 8 hours. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: chicken stock,baby corn,cheddar cheese,chicken thigh,bonito flake,mustard powder
title: Crusty Chicken and Corn Soup
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs chicken thighs ( cut into chunks ) | 1 package fresh baby back corn, cut into bite-sized pieces | 4 canned chicken stock | 4 1/2 tablespoons instant bonito flakes | dried mustard powder | 2 cups cheddar cheese ( shredded ) or 2 cups monterey jack cheese ( shredded )
instructions: In a deep pot combine the chicken pieces, corn, stock and bonito flakes. Bring to a boil, reduce the heat, cover and simmer for 40 minutes or until chicken is cooked and the vegetables are tender. Stir in mustard and check seasoning. Ladle into soup bowls and top with shredded cheese.

title: Rosemary Coffee
ingredients: 2 cups coconut cream, unsweetened ( i use low fat ) | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence ( or any flavour-free vanilla sugar substitute, i.e. orange ) | 1 tablespoon dried rosemary, chopped
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a blender or in a cup and puree until smooth, pour into cups and freeze.

Random Ingredients: green chile,raisin bread,thai red curry paste,tomato juice,cabbage
title: Curried Cabbage Patties With Raisins and Tomatoes
ingredients: 4 slices raisin bread, 1/2-inch cubed ( or 1/2 cup coarsely shredded cabbage ) | 1 tablespoon thai red curry paste | 3 cups shredded cabbage ( about 8 medium ) | 1 large tomatoes, chopped | 2 tablespoons raisins ( or 1/4 cup snipped dried apricots )
instructions: Cut bread in half horizontally, then cut crouton into 1 1/2 inch pieces. Place bread cubes in bowl of food processor. Add curry paste.

title: Quick 5-Minute Harrief Burritos
ingredients: 1 can chickpeas ( drained ) | 1 tablespoon chili beans ( minced ) | lemon wedge, for garnish | 2 corn tortillas
instructions: In a food processor, mix chickpeas, and minced chili. Cover, and process until smooth. Divide into 2 equal portions, and wrap each in plastic wrap. Let rest at room temperature for 10 minutes. Slice each tortilla into four 6 wedges. Serve each with lemon wedges on a spoon. Variation to make harrief burrito filling, heat 1 tablespoon oil in a medium skillet over medium low heat. Cook tortillas briefly on each side so they soften a little and pliable. Turn occasionally while cooking.

Random Ingredients: yellow pepper,thyme,cilantro,fruit chutney,italian seasoning,italian sausage,chipotle powder
title: Grilled Italian Sausage Patties
ingredients: 1 lb sweet italian sausage | 1/4 cup chopped yellow sweet pepper | 1 teaspoon cilantro, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon dried thyme | 1 teaspoon dried italian seasoning | 1 teaspoon dried chipotle powder | 2 tablespoons fruit chutney ( such as miracle whip or vinaigrette )
instructions: Heat barbecue grill to medium heat or broiler. Combine sweet pepper, cilantro, thyme, italian seasoning, and chipotle powder. Roll sausage into approximately 8 patties, 1/2 inch thick and 3 inches long. Place patties on grill, skin side down. Cook until well browned, about 5 minutes on each side, and meat thermometer inserted in center reads 160 degrees f. Remove from grill and cut into ¾ inch pieces. Meanwhile, combine chutney and fruit chutney in small bowl.

title: Mexican "cheese Sandwich"
ingredients: 4 slices whole wheat bread ( i like the mini thin sandwich size or you can use multigrain bread ) | 4 ounces tortilla chips ( or your favorite tortilla chips to make smaller pieces ) | 1 tablespoon chives ( to garnish ) | 1 tablespoon chili flakes ( to garnish, mexican chili powder )
instructions: Preheat the broiler. Place the bread on a baking sheet that has been sprayed with olive oil. Drizzle olive oil on top of bread slices until slightly golden. Remove bread from oven. Spread the 2 chips on the top of the bread. Sprinkle a little chives and chili flakes on top of the chips. Broil in the broiler until the cheese is bubbling, about 1 minute. To serve, sprinkle extra chives, chili flakes and or a little additional chives on top if desired.

Random Ingredients: cream chicken soup,baby corn cob,red currant jelly,pork
title: Crock Pot Pork Stew
ingredients: 1 package baby corn cobs | 3 tablespoons red currant jelly | 1 pound pork, cubed | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup
instructions: Place the corn and redcurrant jelly in two 3 quart slow cooker crock pots. Place pork on top of corn mixture. Pour cream of chicken soup over the pork and top with cheese. Cook on low setting for 7 hours.

Random Ingredients: bacon dripping,green chili,adobo sauce,bread,onion powder,ancho chile,yellow onion,french onion soup
title: Bacon Guacamole
ingredients: 2 cans condensed french onion soup | 10 slices bacon drippings | 1 medium tomatoes, finely diced | 1/2 medium yellow onion, diced | 2 teaspoons adobo sauce, from can ( i don't like my food spicy ) | 1 -2 dash ground ancho chile | 1/4 teaspoon onion powder | 2 slices bread, toasted
instructions: Mix the soup, bacon drippings, tomato, onion, adobo sauce and ground chiles. Cook at medium heat until warm, and simmer, stirring occasionally. This can be topped with the fried bread.

title: Chile Mix
ingredients: 6 poblano chiles, seeded, halved crosswise and seeded cut into 1/2- to 3/4-inch pieces | 1/2 tablespoon red chili powder | 1/4 teaspoon black peppercorns
instructions: Toast the poblano chiles directly over medium heat, turning occasionally, until they begin to open, 2 - 3 minutes. Using a slotted spoon remove the chiles from the skillet, reserving any drippings in the skillet. Rinse the chile peppers under cold water, and, using your fingers, pry the seeds from the chiles with a mortar and pestle. Stir the chiles into the skillet in small batches and fry over high heat for 2 minutes, stirring often, until fragrant. Stir in the chili powder and add the peppercorns. Remove from the heat and sprinkle with water to blend, if necessary. Keep warm in a bowl. Store in the refrigerator. Keeps 1 month.

title: Lebanese Inspired Onion Salad
ingredients: 8 large sweet onions ( persian or persian ) | 1 head spanish onion | 1 fresh hot sauce ( tabasco ) | 2 teaspoons grated orange zest | 2 teaspoons oil or 2 teaspoons unsalted butter
instructions: Peel the onion and slice in halves. Separate the slices into rings and blanch the rings in a large pot of boiling salted water for 2 - 4 minutes only, until completely softened. Remove and allow to drain. Peel and slice the rings, lengthwise into 2 or 3 thin slivers, then set aside. In a large bowl, toss the sliced rings with the onion slivers. Spread the hot sauce on the outside of the ring and place the ring in the bowl. Top with the orange zest and 1 - 2 tbsp of the oil. Toss well to combine. Heat the remaining oil in a 12 inch wok or nonstick wok over med high heat. Add the onion rings and fry until limp and just beginning to color, turning frequently. Add the remaining spice mixture and fry until fragrant, 1 - 2 minutes. Remove. Dish the onion salad and scatter with pine nuts before serving.

title: Smoked Salmon & Hazelnut Salsa for Healthy Eaters
ingredients: 1 can diced tomatoes and green chilies ( drained ) | 1 can smoked salmon, shredded ( 1/2 cup ) | 1 ounce hazelnuts, coarsely chopped | 1 teaspoon bottled liquid smoke, optional ( see note above ) | 2 teaspoons instant minced garlic ( or 1/2 teaspoon fresh minced garlic )
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together tomatoes with juices, hazelnuts, liquid smoke and minced garlic. Cover, and refrigerate 2 hours or overnight for flavors to develop. Serve with rye crackers.

title: Honey Wheat
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups soymilk-flavoured soy milk ( use soyri or soyri to make this vegan ) | 3 1/2 tablespoons toasted wheat germ, see note
instructions: Bring soy milk to boil in a medium saucepan. Add wheat germ and stir, then remove from heat and cover. Set aside to cool for about 10 minutes, then slowly add the soymilk until it just reaches the boiling point. Stir with a fork at the end of the cooking time and serve. Note, toasted wheat germ is used in many recipes for sushi. Soyri used in beverages, salads and dishes as a dry breadcrumb substitute.

Random Ingredients: pecan half,parmesan cheese,caraway seed,baking soda,breadcrumb,green chilies,salmon,chickpea flour
title: Moroccan Fish-Pastry Breaded Salmon
ingredients: 2 cups breadcrumbs | 3 cups chickpea flour ( besanhos de maiz is really good ) | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 1 teaspoon caraway seed | 2 cans green chilies, chopped and seeded | 1/2 cup parmesan cheese | 4 -5 ounces smoked salmon, chopped | 1 can chickpea flour ( besanhos de maiz ) | parmesan cheese
instructions: Place bread crumbs, chickpea flour, baking soda and caraway seed in food processor and process till it becomes a dough. If it is too dry like you might want it to be, add a little water to get it to the consistency you like. Turn dough onto floured surface and knead lightly about 10 times. Pat out to an 8 inch circle on baking sheet and then cut into 8 wedges. Set aside. Heat oil in large saucepan over medium heat. Add salmon, chickpea flour and green chilies. Cook about 5 minutes or just until heated through. Spoon half onto each wedge of bread. Sprinkle with parm cheese. Serve hot.

title: Soup Base for Chicken
ingredients: 24 ounces chicken bouillon cubes | 2 -3 tablespoons chili paste
instructions: Place all ingredients in soup or saucepan. Set on medium heat and bring to boil.

title: Smooth Cabbage Rolls
ingredients: 1/2 medium red cabbage, shredded | 1 tablespoon thick coconut cream or 1 tablespoon sour cream | 1 tablespoon mustard | 1 1/2 tablespoons basmati rice or 1 1/2 tablespoons jasmine rice, cooked
instructions: Preheat grill to med hi. Spread the shredded cabbage evenly on a cutting board and scatter over rice to within ½ inch of the edges. Spread rice evenly to within ½ inch of its edges. Spread mustard over mustard until mixture is just smooth. Spread coconut milk evenly over rice. Starting at one end of the cabbage roll up. Place rolls on preheated grill and cook until the cabbage rolls are just cooked through, about 3 minutes.

title: Chinese Mustard Chicken
ingredients: 1 lb boneless chicken breast | 1/4 cup catsup | 1 tablespoon prepared mustard
instructions: Mix the mustard and catsup to make the dressing. Dip chicken into dressing, then rest in a pan of warm water for 5 - 10 minutes. Serve with steamed white rice.

Random Ingredients: vanilla bean,cremini mushroom,asafoetida powder,bean sprout,egg yolk,cumin powder,pumpkin seed,chicken stock
title: Asafoetida Pumpkin Seeds
ingredients: 1 cup cornflour ( maize corn flour ) | 1 cup chicken stock, and | 3/4 cup chicken stock | 2 tablespoons cremini mushrooms ( dried ) | 1/2 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 1 teaspoon pumpkin seeds ( optional ) | 1 egg yolk | 1/4 cup whole cashews ( optional ) or 1/4 cup chopped roasted peanuts, for garnishing ( optional )
instructions: Mix corn flour, stock, chicken and cremini mushrooms into a smooth paste. Add the asafoetida powder, cumin powder and pumpkin seeds. Mix well to make a batter of well blended flour powder, egg yolk, cashew nuts and nuts. Set aside for half an hour to cool down. Remove from refrigerator and serve garnished with cashew nuts if desired.

Random Ingredients: saltine cracker,bamboo shoot,fenugreek seed,dumpling wrapper,white flour
title: Bamboo Shoot Samosas
ingredients: 1 package frozen bamboo shoots, thawed and drained | 1 package fenugreek seeds | 2 1/2 cups sifted all purpose white flour | 1/2 cup split polished white flour | saltine crackers
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Place frozen bamboo shoots in a medium pot with water to cover and bring to a boil. Simmer, partially covered, for 8 minutes or until done. Drain and rinse with cold water.

title: Minty Peppers (Panch Phali)
ingredients: 24 medium green peppers | 3 green cardamom pods | 12 fresh mint leaves, rinsed and dry
instructions: Wash green peppers thoroughly and cut into 1 inch pieces. Bring a large pot of water to boil. Add green cardamom pods and after 5 minutes, remove from water. Stir green pepper pieces gently. Remove from heat, drain, and set aside to cool to room temperature. When cool enough, scoop out the flesh of the peppers and discard the seeds and the pulp. Stem and roughly chop peppers. Add pepper pulp, mint leaves, and green cardamom pods to the chilled mint mixture. Stir to combine and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: yellow bell pepper,sauerkraut,green bell pepper,red chilies
title: Korean Sauerkraut
ingredients: 4 lbs sauerkraut | 2 large red chilies, stemmed, seeded, and chopped | 1 large green bell pepper, chopped ( or sweet potato ) | 1 medium yellow bell pepper, chopped
instructions: Soak sauerkraut for 1 hour in enough water to cover. Place in medium size pot.

Random Ingredients: hungarian paprika,telera french bread,cream celery soup,whiskey,water chestnut,cardamom pod,heavy whipping cream
title: Tikka Toast
ingredients: 1 loaf unsliced telera french bread, cut into 2 inch cubes ( about 6 cups ) | 12 ounces canned cream of celery soup | 1 quart water chestnut, diced ( about 1 1/2 cups canned ) | 1/2 cup hot hungarian paprika | 1/2 cup whiskey | 1/4 cup heavy whipping cream, whipped | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom pod ( or 5 to 6 whole cardamom pods )
instructions: Place 1 piece of bread in a large, shallow bowl. Set aside. Combine soup with water chestnuts, parsley, hot paprika, whiskey, cream, and cardamom in a saucepan.

title: Pizzelles With Baking Spice
ingredients: 3 baking soda | 2 cups shredded baking chocolate chips ( i use hershey's ) | 6 sunflower oil | 1 chicken stock cube | 3/4 cup grated mixed nuts
instructions: Preheat the oven to gas mark 10, 220°c. Combine baking soda with the chipolte mix with the sunflower oil and stock cube. Mix with a wooden spoon until well blended. It should be the consistency of soft cream. Add the mixed nuts and mix thoroughly. Drop a tablespoonful of dough into the hot pizzelle moulds. Place in a shallow oven tray and bake 20 minutes or until golden.

Random Ingredients: green curry paste,cookie,red bean,hamburger bun,green onion
title: Baked Burgers with Beans
ingredients: 1 1/3 cups red beans, rinsed | 2 tablespoons green curry paste, or more to taste | 3 hamburger buns, split | 1 teaspoon chopped green onion | 2 slices cooked ham, or to taste ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven's broiler and set rack 6 inches from the heat. Spread red beans onto the broiler tray. Cook and stir red beans in the preheated oven until heated through, 2 to 3 minutes. Stir curry paste and green chutney together in a bowl. Arrange hamburger buns on a baking sheet. Spread a few spoonfuls of curry paste on the toasted buns.

title: Apricot & Noodle Stir-Fry
ingredients: 425 g dried apricots | 100 g egg noodles
instructions: Combine apricots and noodles in a bowl & toss. Add seasoning with boiling water to moisten. Serve immediately.

title: Broiled Red Chilli-Stuffed Bread
ingredients: 4 tablespoons margarine or 4 tablespoons spreadable oil | 250 g thai red chili peppers ( or other bird's eye chiles ) | 250 g baguette ( sliced in half lengthways ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground sage | 1/2 cup stock or 1/2 cup broth
instructions: Melt margarine or spreadable oil in a non stick frying pan over medium heat. Halve chillies.

Random Ingredients: brie cheese,parmesan cheese,collard green,green chile pepper,chicken bouillon,banana,lasagna,cream cheese
title: Lazy Brie Cheesecake Stuffed Green Chiles
ingredients: 2 packages frozen chopped collard greens, thawed and drained | 6 bananas, sliced | 1 1/2 pounds brie cheese, cubed | 2 cans chopped green chile peppers, drained | 1 container soft cream cheese | 2 tablespoons chicken bouillon, or as needed | 12 lasagna sheets | 1/4 cup grated parmesan cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place collard greens and bananas into a large pot along with the cubed brie cheese. Bring to a boil, reduce heat to low, and cover. Simmer 1 hour. Uncover, and stir in green chile peppers. Combine cream cheese and bouillon in a bowl, and mix until smooth, adding bouillon to help blend. Spoon a few spoonsful of cream cheese mixture onto a lasagna sheet to cover, and spread about 1/2 teaspoon of cream cheese mixture across the bottom. Top with layers of green chile mixture and sliced brie cheese. Repeat layers, beginning with a layer of cream cheese mixture, then top with parmesan cheese. Bake in the preheated oven until cheese is bubbly and lightly browned, about 1 hour. Allow cheese to set before slicing. The cheesecake can be frozen, resealable, and frozen for up to 1 month.

title: Aunt Dude's Baked Macaroni With Apple and Peaches
ingredients: 3/4 lb dried old mill elbow macaroni or 3/4 lb rotini pasta, uncooked | 8 ounces sliced livers, cut in half | 1 tart apple, julienne | 1 pepared peach, julienne ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons dry sherry | 2 tablespoons olive oil | salt and coarse ground pepper | dried peppercorns
instructions: Mix all ingredients together, in a large casserole dish or roasting pan. Cover and bake in a 350 degree oven for 3 - 3 1/2 hours. Remove cover for last 2 hours of cooking. Season to taste. Note, preparation time includes time to prepare salad.

title: Saliqi
ingredients: 2 -3 green cardamoms | 2 cups vegetable stock or 2 cups chicken stock
instructions: Heat 2 - 3 tbsp oil in a skillet. Pour in 1/2 tsp. Of green cardamoms to the pan. Let them darken color and they will be ready. Add 1 cup of vegetable or chicken stock. Reduce heat until liquid is mostly absorbed. Add more cardamom if desired. Cover, and cook on medium heat for 5 - 10 minutes, shaking the pan occasionally to make sure the spices don't burn. Remove cover and cook until water evaporates, 4 - 5 minutes more.

Random Ingredients: soy sauce,chili paste garlic,chipotle powder,black olive
title: Black Olive Dip
ingredients: 2 packages pitted black olives | 1 tablespoon chili paste with garlic ( garlic-infused garlic may be used ) | 1 tablespoon soy sauce | 1 pinch chopped chipotle powder ( optional )
instructions: Rmove any excess oil from the olives and rinse them well under running water. Place all ingredients in a food processor or blender and puree until smooth. Add more sugar and/or soy sauce if needed. Serve with pita chips, tortilla chips or vegetables.

title: Hot Deviled Eggs
ingredients: 12 ounces boneless egg noodles | 1/4 cup chili oil | 2 1/2 tablespoons dijon mustard | 1 1/2 tablespoons chopped chili peppers | 1/3 teaspoon chili pepper-flavored pepper | 1/4 teaspoon allspice
instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions, omitting salt and fat. Drain well and set aside. Meanwhile, heat oil in a nonstick skillet over medium heat. Add mustard, chili peppers, chili pepper flakes and allspice. Cook, stirring frequently, 1 to 2 minutes or until heated through. Pour hot noodles over mustard mixture.

title: Pounded Pork With Black Olives
ingredients: 3 onions, sliced | 1/2 cup fresh black olives | 1 tablespoon ground ginger | 1 1/2 teaspoons vinegar | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried onion powder
instructions: Place onions in a medium bowl, and top with olives. Sprinkle the ginger and vinegar over, and mix in the dried onion powder. Cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate for at least one hour.

title: Cheese and Leeks With Russian Spareribs
ingredients: 1 can of fully ripened beef sandwich steaks, sliced 1/4-inch thick ( about 12 ounces total weight ) | 3 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 2 -3 slices low-fat swiss cheese
instructions: Pierce each side of each steak with a skewer lengthwise. In a large bowl, use a fork or pastry brush for brushing the meat with the worcestershire sauce, set a rack in the center of the oven and heat it to hot. Arrange the steak on the rack, meaty side up. Top each steak with one slice of cheese on top. Set rack in a roasting pan and roast the steak for 13 - 15 minutes or until the cheese is melted. Let stand for 5 minutes and serve.

title: Quick and Easy Homemade Cranberry Sweetened Mix
ingredients: 4 cups frozen sweetened cranberries ( or sweetened mix of the two ) | 1/4 cup pure vanilla extract | 3 tablespoons fresh lime juice | 3 cups prepared sweet-and-sour mix ( homemade is best ) or 3 cups prepared sweet-and-sour mix ( homemade is best )
instructions: Drain the cranberries, and reserve the liquid. Rinse and drain the sweetened mix. Put the cranberry liquid into a large mixing bowl. Add the sweetened mix, and mix well until all the spices have been evenly dispersed throughout. Mix the vanilla and lime juice together in a small bowl. Mix the vanilla and lime juice into the mix. Add the sweetened mix to the bowl and mix well. Cover and chill for at least 1 hour. Strain into a covered container or resealable plastic bag until ready to use. Let the mixture sit covered about 30 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: corn syrup,salmon fillet,amaretto,golden syrup,shallot,scotch bonnet pepper,harissa
title: Grilled Salmon
ingredients: 4 salmon fillets | 1 1/2 - 2 cups corn syrup | 1/4 cup golden syrup | 1 tablespoon harissa | 1/4 cup shallot, minced | 1/4 cup scotch bonnet pepper, minced and seeded | 1/4 cup amaretto
instructions: Preheat grill to medium. Using a brush, lightly brush a grill pan with olive oil. Line the foil with aluminum foil and set aside. Place the salmon fillets on the foil, skin side down and spread 1/4 cup of corn syrup evenly over salmon fillets. Place in a 400 degree oven for approximately 7 to 10 minutes, or until the fish has turned a light amber color. The time depends on the thickness of the fillets and how thick you like your fillets. Remove to a serving platter and top with a dollop of scottish wasole to serve.

title: Jalapeno and Lemon Rice Candy
ingredients: 1 lb jalapeno pepper | 1 package lemon flavored rice | 1 tablespoon dried rice | 1 tablespoon dried shrimp or 1 tablespoon dried mixed-up vegetables
instructions: In a skillet, grill pepper over low heat, turning frequently, until blackened on all sides. Remove pepper and place in a plastic bag for 15 minutes. Rinse and pat dry. Set aside. In a large bowl, stir together lemon flavoring, rice and shrimp. Place in a 9 x13 baking dish. Cut up pepper strips slightly, and drop into rice mixture. Place on top of peanut brittle and press around edges to make a small square. Refrigerate overnight, tightly covered, or freeze. To serve, carefully remove from pan. Break away air. Dip fingers in melted chocolate, and coat with more melted chocolate. Store in a cool, dry place.

Random Ingredients: egg yolk,red wine vinegar,red chilies,fish sauce,brown rice,tart apple
title: Caramelised Red Curry With Rice
ingredients: 150 ml red wine vinegar | 300 g brown rice | 12 fresh red chilies | 1 small tart apple, such as fuji, peeled and cored | 12 egg yolks | 2 tablespoons fish sauce
instructions: Cook the rice until just tender. Drain water. Cool. Remove skin from chillies, discard cut end and stem, then slice thinly. Cut the chillies in half lengthways and discard, discard seeds. Cut flesh from chillies. Remove seeds and membrane, then cut chilies into thin strips. Chop apples roughly. Using a whisk or a fork blend the yolks and fish sauce until smooth. Stir the rice, chillies, apple and egg yolks into the egg mixture. Transfer to a large, non metallic bowl, cover and refrigerate for 4 hours or overnight. Heat a large pan over high heat and stir fry the chicken a few minutes or until just cooked. Remove from the pan and keep warm. To serve, place rice in serving bowl, drizzle with curry and serve with a slice of apple, a drizzle of curry and a sprinkle of green leaf if using.

title: Creamy Tomato Gravy
ingredients: 1/2 cup evaporated milk | 1 1/4 cups tomato puree | 3 teaspoons chili-garlic sauce
instructions: Pour milk into a saucepan over medium heat. Stir tomato puree and chili garlic sauce together in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon cube,salad green,veal,sunflower oil,calimyrna fig
title: Beef Burger
ingredients: 1 beef bouillon cube | 75 g mixed salad greens, washed and drained ( such as iceberg, red leaf, spinach, baby potato or your favourite salad greens ) | 1 thinly sliced veal ( or beef steak, pork or sausage ) | 1/4 cup sunflower oil | 175 g calimyrna figs ( or other citrus figs cut in halves or quarters )
instructions: Slice the beef or pork into thin strips or use sliced steak or pork steaks. Melt the oil over medium high heat in a shallow frypan and cook the meat for approximately 2 minutes each side or until browned and crispy. Place the mixed greens in a bowl and pour over the warmed oil and cook for another minute or so, until just wilted and the greens are lightly coloured. Place the salad greens on to a plate and top with the sliced beef or pork. Scatter over the figs and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: plum tomato,prosciutto ham,miso,pineapple juice,garlic,dark soy sauce,golden brown sugar
title: Sweet Heat Restaurant Platter or Salad
ingredients: 1 tablespoon miso ( dark soy sauce ) | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce ( regular soy sauce can also be used ) | 1/4 cup pineapple juice | 1 tablespoon hoisin sauce or 1 tablespoon plum sauce | 2 cloves garlic, minced | 1 medium plum tomato with skin, chopped very finely or | 4 slices aged provolone ham | 4 ounces thick-cut prosciutto ham
instructions: To make miso, combine miso with soy sauce, orange juice, hoisin or plum sauce, garlic and dark soy sauce in a medium bowl.

title: Danish Sour Creamy Chocolate Pizza
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups sour cream or 1 1/2 cups chicken soup, i use a homemade sour cream mix in the jar | 1 tablespoon instant yeast | 1/4 cup butter or 1/4 cup margarine, melted
instructions: Using dough hook on lowest speed of mixer, in a medium size bowl stir the sour cream, yeast, and butter together until yeast foam subsides. Gradually sprinkle in enough of the flour from sour cream mix to make a smooth, but slightly sticky dough.. Knead on floured surface until smooth and elastic.. Place dough in lightly oiled bowl and turn once to coat with oil. Cover with plastic wrap and let rise until doubled. Punch down and divide dough into three equal pieces. Roll out one piece on floured surface into a thin round. Spread the top with the sour cream mixture. Top the sour cream with the other piece of dough, stretching slightly. Brush the edges with water and fold. Turn the two out onto a pizza pan or cookie sheet. Turn on the oven to 400 f and bake until crust is deep golden, about 20 minutes. I bake mine on my own pizza stones or pan sprayed with cooking spray at 200 degrees for 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: green pepper,beef bouillon cube,kosher salt,sesame seed,mushroom
title: Sesame Sauce for Spaghetti
ingredients: 1/2 cup sesame seeds | 2 beef bouillon cubes | 4 -5 cups sliced fresh mushrooms ( the best i buy ) | 1/4 cup green pepper, diced ( if you like a lot of color, go for 1/8 cup. ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons kosher salt
instructions: Mix all the ingredients. Let sit on the counter for a few minutes to absorb the flavors. Store in a dry and cool place and use as directed in your favorite spaghetti.

Random Ingredients: vodka,mini chocolate chip,cottage cheese,rom tomato,leg lamb,beef brisket,salt black pepper,green pepper
title: Smothered Irish Lamb
ingredients: 5 lbs boneless leg of lamb, with fat intact | 3 pounds kosher beef brisket | 2 packages mini chocolate chips | 2 cans low fat cottage cheese | 12 roma tomatoes | 6 tablespoons vodka ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons chopped green peppers | salt and black pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees to prepare oven proof roasting pan with a roasting rack. Combine lamb, lamb fat, kosher beef brisket and kosher beef briskets in large pot. Add enough water to cover meat and allow to rise. Bring to boil, reduce heat and simmer 1 1/2 hours. Remove meat and set aside until cool enough to handle, 3 to 4 hours. Shred fat from beef into separate pieces and place in a bowl. Using a slotted spoon, transfer meat to same bowl. Pour off fat from cooking pot.

title: Sangria
ingredients: 6 -10 fresh mint leaves | 12 cups red wine, inexpensively chilled
instructions: Combine 2 cups red wine and 2 cups mint leaves in a pitcher. Cover and let mellow for at least 2 hours but up to 4 weeks. To test if you can squeeze the juice out of mint leaves, put a small ice cream scoop onto a glass and drop in a handful of mint leaves. If it falls out, the drink is finished, but the mint will still be fresh if it was put out before. Serve 1 to 2 mint leaves per serving for garnish and 1 mint leaves per serving for garnish for a garnish.

Random Ingredients: red capsicum,lamb,grain mustard,rib eye,rigatoni pasta,grain white rice,romano cheese
title: Mediterranean Lamb Pasta Casserole
ingredients: 500 g rigatoni pasta | 400 g chopped lean lamb | 1 red capsicum, chopped | 1 -2 teaspoon whole grain mustard | 150 gr romano cheese | 150 g short-grain white rice | 1/2 - 2/3 cup of coarsely grated romano cheese
instructions: Place the ground meat in a large dutch oven, add a cup of water. Cover and cook very slowly until the meat is no longer pink, about 1 hour. Drain the meat, set it aside. Bring 6 cups of water with the garlic and mustard to the boil. Add the drained meat and simmer gently about 20 minutes, stirring occasionally. Add the rice and stir. Remove from heat and stir in the romano cheese and set aside. Heat oven to 170°c. Place the drained meat and the risotto in an ovenproof casserole dish, cover with the romano cheese and bake in the oven for about half an hour, stirring every 10 minutes to prevent the pasta sticking, until the noodles are tender. Top up with hot pepper sauce to serve.

Random Ingredients: spaghetti sauce,taco meat,russet potato,ha avocadoes,white onion,purpose flour
title: Tortellini with Nacho Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup all-purpose flour | 2 pounds russet potatoes, peeled and cubed | 1 can prepared spaghetti sauce, or to taste | 1/2 white onion, chopped | 2 hass avocadoes, pitted and peeled | 1 pound shredded taco meat, or as desired
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Spread flour onto a baking sheet, and place in the preheated oven. Bake in the preheated oven until lightly browned, 10 to 15 minutes. Drain off excess browning, and place potatoes into a mixing bowl. Heat a large skillet over medium high heat. Stir in the spaghetti sauce, and cook until lightly thickened, about 2 minutes. Stir the onion into the mashed potatoes. Crumble in the taco meat, and mix until evenly coated. Place the tortellini in the oven, and bake until the tortellini is tender and hot, about 30 minutes. Turn off oven, and allow inside to remain inside 10 minutes more. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: apricot,banana,wheat pastry flour,pomegranate juice,cabbage,white wine vinegar,blue cheese
title: Liege Dessert
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups whole wheat pastry flour | 1 1/2 cups cider vinegar | 2 cups white wine vinegar | 1/2 cup pomegranate juice | 1 cup blue cheese, crumbled | 1 cup dried apricot, sliced | 1 small cabbage, shredded | 1 pinch dried blue cheese, crumbled ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Line a glass 9x13 baking dish with foil. In a bowl, stir together flour, cider vinegar, pomegranate juice and blue cheese until well blended. In another bowl, mix together apricots, shredded cabbage and pinch of crumbled blue cheese. Add the flour mixture and mix well. Spoon over the greased baking dish. Bake in preheated oven for 40 minutes or until browned on top.

title: Orange, Turkey or Pork Oat Cakes
ingredients: 1/2 cup quick-cooking oats ( heaping ) | 1/2 cup half-and-half cream | 2 tablespoons orange juice | 1/2 lb ground turkey or 1/2 lb ground pork
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f. Lightly oil an 8 x 8 x 2 baking dish or a loaf pan. Stir together the oats, half and half, orange juice and turkey. Shape the mixture into 6 patties 1 inch thick. Line the prepared dish with the greases patties, pressing together to form two thick patties. Bake the cooked patties for about 25 minutes or until no longer pink inside, turning once.

Random Ingredients: green onion,oil black olive,parmesan cheese,vanilla yogurt
title: Parmesan and Green Onion Frozen Yogurt Salad (Dorie Greenspan)
ingredients: 1 cup plain yogurt | 2 tablespoons oil-cured black olives or 2 tablespoons green olives, coarsely chopped | 1 tablespoon chopped green onions | grated parmesan cheese, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Combine yogurt and olives in small bowl. Cover and chill while preparing garnish. Sprinkle with onion and parmesan cheese if using.

title: Simple Fried Veggies
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 bell pepper, sliced | 1 teaspoon cumin seed | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon garlic paste
instructions: To the cumin seeds, add the garlic paste and saute over medium heat for about 15 seconds or until fragrant. Reduce heat to low and simmer until veggies are tender. Serve hot.

title: Lemon-Pepper Raspberry Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds frozen raspberries | 2 tablespoons fresh basil leaves, torn | 1/2 teaspoon lemon pepper | 1/4 teaspoon lemon pepper
instructions: Place raspberries in a bowl with basil, lemon pepper and lemon pepper.

title: Easy "smoking" Chocolate Fizz
ingredients: 1 1/2 teaspoons dark chocolate | 1 teaspoon liquid smoke or 1 teaspoon sherry wine
instructions: Melt the chocolate with the liquid smoke in the top of a double boiler over hot water. Allow to cool slightly, then stir into the cooled chocolate with a metal spoon. Spoon into a dry, clean dry plastic bottle.

Random Ingredients: pinto bean,sun tomato oil,topping,kidney bean,golden syrup,maple syrup,bean sprout,black mustard seed
title: Sun-Dried Tomato Bean Dip
ingredients: 15 ounces dried beans, rinsed | 1 1/2 cups dried shredded toasted pinto beans | 16 ounces bean sprouts | 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, chopped | 2 tablespoons golden syrup | 2 tablespoons maple syrup | 1/2 teaspoon black mustard seeds | 1/4 cup fresh sundried tomato packed in oil, chopped | 2 1/2 teaspoons maple syrup
instructions: Place dried beans in bowl and cover with cool water.

title: Cheesy Tortilla
ingredients: 1 whole wheat mexican blend cheese | 10 corn tortillas or 10 flour tortillas, about | extra cheese ( to garnish )
instructions: Note, depending on number of scoops, it may need more cheese, or more tortillas. You can also use corn tortillas rather than white tortillas. In a microwave proof dish, sprinkle a touch of low power or low oven cooking spray on top of the tortillas and microwave until softened, about 3 minutes. Spread about 2 - 3 tablespoons of cheese over half of each tortilla and roll up tortilla. Repeat with all tortillas. Garnish with cheese and serve piping hot.

Random Ingredients: russet potato,pimiento,basil,irish whiskey,egg noodle,fish sauce,hard salami,custard
title: Irish Potato Salad
ingredients: 2 lbs russet potatoes ( about 4 medium ) or 2 lbs yukon gold potatoes, unpeeled ( about 4 medium ) | 4 hard salami, slices | 3/4 lb radish, thinly sliced about 1/4 inch thick | 1/2 lb imported irish whiskey, such as hormel, cut into 1/4 inch rounds | 6 hard salami, cut into 1/4 inch slices | 1 ounce sliced pimiento | 2 tablespoons fish sauce | 1 tablespoon custard | fresh basil ( to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Place the potato and salami into a 2 quart saucepan. Cover with 6 cups boiling water.

title: Chunky Beef Stew
ingredients: 1 large stewing beef | 1 can stewed tomatoes | 2 tablespoons gluten
instructions: Put all ingredients in crock pot and cook on low for 8 - 9 hours.

title: Quick & Easy Caribbean Rice
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked instant brown rice | 1 cup uncooked long-grain spaghetti or 1 cup other short pasta | 1 cup shredded coconut flakes | 2 teaspoons finely minced orange zest | 1/3 cup chopped fresh parsley leaves ( optional )
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions, then set aside. Meanwhile, cook pasta according to package directions until al dente. Drain, then set aside. Combine all ingredients in a large bowl, adding reserved cooked rice. Mix well. Serve immediately. Note, the flavor is similar to that of paese's macadamia flavoured rice, but not so good that someone who tastes garlic latkes trying it makes their own..

Random Ingredients: potato flake,beef stew meat,corn,creme de cacao,artichoke heart
title: Beef Stew over Sweet Home
ingredients: 1 boneless beef stew meat | 1/2 can corn | 1 jar artichoke hearts, undrained | 2 tablespoons creme de cacao | 1/2 cup instant potato flakes
instructions: In a skillet, brown stew meat over medium high heat in creme de cacao until well browned. Add potatoes, cooking mixture, and artichokes to the stew. Lower heat to medium and simmer, turning to coat meat with the mixture occasionally, for about 1 hour or until meat is very tender. I like to serve this hot with bread slices, mashed potatoes, and salad.

Random Ingredients: garlic herb spreadable cheese,cabbage,port wine,phyllo pastry,green onion,spring onion,serrano pepper
title: Port Port Veggies (Vegetable Ensemble)
ingredients: 15 sheets phyllo pastry | 1 1/2 lbs cabbage ( or similar type of cabbage, if you prefer ) | 3 green onions, minced | 1/2 - 1 cup port wine, fruity or mild, depending how sweet to your liking ( depending on how sweet ) ( optional ) | 1/2 cup garlic herb spreadable cheese, use a strong cheese flavor ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon serrano pepper, minced ( optional ) | 1 1/2 cups green onions, chopped | 1/3 cup spring onion, minced
instructions: Preheat oven to lightly oil a baking sheet. Line a large baking sheet with parchment paper, or spray with cooking spray. Cut the cabbage into 2 inch pieces and set aside. If you have a large, well oiled skillet, heat on medium, adding the water. Once it boils, add the green onions, garlic and serrano. Stir occasionally until everything is well cooked. Once it starts to boil, add the cabbage pieces, stirring constantly. Cook about 12 minutes, or until the cabbage is limp and liquid has reduced. Remove from heat, and place it in a bowl. Add the port and blend thoroughly with your hand or a fork. It should be very smooth and creamy. The mixture should be quite dry but have little bits of green onion.. Place the mixture into an oiled 13x9x2 inch pan. Lay out the strips of phyllo dough. Place an egg sized portion of the veggies in the center of phyllo, allowing room for spreading. Spread 1 1/2 cups of the cheese and a few drops of water on top. Place another 1/2 cup of the veggies and a few drops of water on top. Cut the stack into 6 - 8 strips or smaller. Repeat on the second sheet. Bake for 30 minutes, or until the cheese starts to brown and the phyllo has gone a nice golden color.

title: Chiles Enchiladas
ingredients: 5 fresh poblano chile | 2 cans tomato sauce | 1/4 cup corn oil
instructions: Heat oil in a heavy skillet. Cut poblano chiles in strips.. Add poblano strips and fry with tomato sauce. Fill each poblano chile with sauce. Garnish with chopped green onion.

title: Jungle Jelly
ingredients: 1/4 cup gelatin | 1 bunch fresh cilantro, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Sprinkle gelatin over hot water and blend thoroughly. Leave a few minutes to soften gelatin. Stir in cilantro until mixture is firm and creamy. Pour jelly in sterilized jars and seal.

title: Ugandan Mushroom & Egg Soup
ingredients: 2 cups beef broth | 1 aubergine | 1 tablespoon beef broth, base or 1 teaspoon bouillon granules | 3 sliced shiitake mushrooms | 1 teaspoon vegetable bouillon granules
instructions: Cut the aubergine in half lengthways. Remove the hard center ribs, but do not peel the skin. Slice the aubergine in half, so that it stands up like a book. Bring a large pan of water to the boil and add the aubergo and beef base base. Boil until the aubergine is soft. Drain and allow to cool. Use a slotted spoon to lift the skin off the aubergine and reserve. Cut the aubergine into small chunks and place in the food processor. Process until smooth and add to the food processor with the broth and mushrooms. Taste and add salt and pepper or bouillon granules if necessary. Blend until smooth. Pour into bowls. Serve topped with shredded fresh herbs and steamed white rice.

Random Ingredients: lemon zest,corn flake,cornflour,cannellini bean,curry leaf,mirin,vanilla essence
title: Tasty Vegetable Pancakes
ingredients: 2 cups corn flakes, crushed | 2 teaspoons lemon zest, grated | 3 cups cooked cannellini beans | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence | 3 tablespoons cornflour, dissolved in | 1/2 cup mirin | 20 curry leaves, finely chopped or 5 cm piece ginger, peeled and finely shredded
instructions: Preheat a pan on medium high. Slightly heat 3 tsp of cornstarch in a large, shallow bowl/plate. Add zest, beans and vanilla essence. Mix together. Add remaining cornflour and mix until the mixture starts to thicken or just starts to colour. Stir through the chopped coriander, curry leaves, lemon rind and cooked cornflakes. Heat 1/4 cup water in a large, shallow frying pan. Make pancakes by dropping a spoonful of mixture into the hot water and quickly pressing down with the base of the spoon. Cook until crispy on the outside and cooked though. Remove from the pan, and put on a plate lined with paper towelling. Repeat until all pancake mixture is used, ending with pancakes, placing each onto a plate lined with paper towels. Serve with yoghurt or sour cream on the side.

Random Ingredients: cremini mushroom,dill pickle,saffron thread,vegetable stock,pistachio,green cardamom pod,tomato basil
title: Vegetarian Doro Wat
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon saffron threads | 1/4 cup vegetable stock | 1 cup tomato basil | 1 cup cremini mushroom | 1/2 cup pistachios | 2 green cardamom pods | 2 dill pickles
instructions: Bring saffron and vegetable stock to a boil in a small saucepan over low heat. Remove from heat. Stir in tomato basil, cremini mushrooms, pistachios, green cardamom pods and dill pickles. Season to taste. Cover and refrigerate until serving.

title: Quick & Easy Mocha Brew
ingredients: 1 can hot coffee | 1 drop red food coloring
instructions: In a tall glass over ice, stir hot coffee. Stir about half the way into the coffee.

Random Ingredients: chili sauce,pine nut,yellow bell pepper,tomato puree,garlic powder,plain flour,salsa
title: Spicy Tomato and Pine Nut Salsa Mix
ingredients: 2 tablespoons plain flour | 1 teaspoon garlic powder | 1 medium yellow bell pepper | 2 tablespoons salsa | 1 tablespoon chili sauce ( tomato puree ) | 1 tablespoon pine nuts | 100 g canned whole tomatoes in tomato paste - drained, liquid reserved
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190c/375f/gas cut the bell pepper into 1cm cubes. Spray the inside of a small baking paper lined 20cm x 30cm tin with cooking spray.

title: Strawberry Sauce II
ingredients: 1 cup strawberry preserves | 1 package dry ranch dressing mix
instructions: In a 3 1/2 quart saucepan, stir preserves and dressing mix with 1/2 cup water. Cook over medium heat until bubbling and thickened.

title: Torticas (Mexican Fried Green Lettuce)
ingredients: 2 head lettuce | 1 orange peel
instructions: Wash lettuce very well, and dry very well with paper towels. Tear off a thin slice of cheese with no grains attached, place on paper towels, fold cheese over and roll up the lettuce. Repeat with remaing slices. Wrap the cheese with the orange peel on the salad. Refrigerate several hours.

title: Green Chilies and Guinness
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh green chilies | 8 ounces guinness stout | 2 fresh sage leaves
instructions: Char grill. Heat chilies on grill rack. Toast chilies on grill rack, turning every 3 minutes, until lightly charred. Peel chilies and slice very thin then set aside. Pour guinness into a bowl or pitcher. Place chilies and sage in chilies and stir. Top with guinness and serve with lime wedges.

title: Crumptious Meat Wraps
ingredients: 1 pie crust ( store-bought or your own recipe ) | 1 package store-bought frozen ladyfingers ( about 10 to 12 servings ) | 1 lb ground meat | 3 ounces prosciutto | 1/4 cup chopped orange peel | 1/2 cup burrito-size flour tortilla
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Place frozen ladyfingers in a large bowl of water and add 1/2 teaspoon salt. Soak for 15 minutes. Drain the dough and arrange half the biscuits around the rim of a 9 inch pie plate. Spread a scant 2 teaspoons of ground meat on each biscuit. Sprinkle with prosciutto, orange peel and another 1/2 pound of ground meat. Roll up each biscuit, then place, seam down, on a damp, clean paper towel lined rimmed baking sheet. Bake 20 minutes, or until lightly golden and cooked through. Wrap in warmed flour tortillas and serve.

title: My Special Chicken Burritos
ingredients: 4 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves | 1 package plain greek yogurt | 1 can or bottle greek style yogurt, such as kameya | 1/2 cup dried cranberries
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Place chicken breasts between two sheets of aluminum foil and pound to 1/4 inch thickness. Bake chicken in preheated oven, 20 minutes. Cut about 8 slices from each breast and set aside. Mix 1 package of greek style yogurt with 1/2 cup dried cranberries and 1/4 cup of the crushed dried cranberries in a large bowl. Cut remaining breast into thin strips and arrange around a dinner plate. Spoon half of dressing over chicken and top with remaining yogurt and cranberries. Serve.

title: Jicama Pasta With Bacon and Burrata
ingredients: 400 g penne pasta | 1 tablespoon cumin seed | 1 small chili pepper, finely diced | 2 slices bacon, rind sliced diagonally into thin strips | 1 -2 cup jicama, small dice | 2 teaspoons season salt | 1 teaspoon harissa
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions, drain and return to pot. Add all other ingredients and mix well. Gently toss the pasta until all ingredients are coated in the saurk and heated through serve immediatley.

Random Ingredients: vanilla pudding mix,asian chili oil,sauce,radish,sherry wine,kielbasa,taco sauce
title: Chinese Meatloaf (Sauce and Meat)
ingredients: 1 package hot taco sauce | 2 packages thin taco sauce | 1 package instant vanilla pudding mix | 1 package kielbasa ( thinly sliced ) | 1/2 cup sherry wine | 1/4 cup spicy hot sauce | coarsely chopped fresh radish ( to garnish )
instructions: Heat overn to 350°f combine 1 package taco sauce and package of pudding mix in medium bowl. Stir to blend well. Press into loaf pan. Combine 1 package of hot taco sauce and contents of remaining package of pudding mix in small bowl, stirring to blend. Spread evenly over top of meatloaf. Combine 1/4 cup sherry and 1/4 cup spicy hot sauce in small saucepan, stirring to blend well. Cook and stir over medium heat until sherry is no longer cloudy, about 3 minutes. Spread over top of sauce and top with chopped radish.

title: Prawn Tacos
ingredients: 1/2 lb prawns, shells on, heads and tails on | 3 tablespoons sweet chili sauce | 1 serrano pepper | 2 teaspoons dried oregano leaves | 24 corn tortillas or 24 flour tortillas, warmed | 1 can rotel, drained
instructions: Heat prawn in sauce in skillet, skin side down, over medium heat. Cook 5 - 7 minutes or until pink and opaque. Remove to a bowl and let cool. Rinse prawn and pat dry. Stir chilli sauce and oregano in skillet. Heat to boiling, stir in prawn and heat 2 minutes. Spread 2 tortillas on baking sheet. Spoon shrimp mixture down center, top with tortilla and then top with remaining tortillas.

title: The Best Sticky Potato Bread Ever.
ingredients: 2 lbs baking potatoes, peeled and cut into 2-inch chunks | 3 cups breadcrumbs | 3/4 cup heavy whipping cream | 1/3 cup soymilk
instructions: Boil potatoes in a large pot of salted water until just tender. Meanwhile, mix together bread crumbs, cream and soymilk in a bowl. Drain water from potatoes and place potatoes into crumb mixture and toss to combine together evenly. Turn mixture into greased 9x5 pan and cover with plastic wrap. Chill for at least an hour, or until set. Slice into 1/8th rings. Serve with fresh grated parmesan cheese and fresh basil for garnish.

Random Ingredients: cooking oil,cilantro leaf,ziti pasta,poblano pepper,lemonade,daikon radish,spanish onion,egg white
title: Ziti With Daikon, Olives, and Eggs
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cooking oil | 1 1/2 lbs daikon radishes or 1 1/2 lbs swedes, peeled and cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 1/2 spanish onion, coarsely chopped | 1 large poblano pepper, seeded, deveined and finely chopped | 2 cups ziti pasta or 2 cups penne pasta, uncooked | egg white | fresh cilantro leaves ( optional )
instructions: In a medium saucepan over medium high heat, warm the cooking oil. When it just starts to smoke, add the radish cubes and sauté for 3 minutes, stirring constantly, until beginning to soften. Add the onion and poblano and sauté for 5 to 7 minutes, until very soft and beginning to brown. Add the ziti and cook, stirring frequently until slightly browned.
