Transfer to a large bowl and stir in the onions and poblano. Stir in the zest of 1 lemon. Preheat the oven to 500°. Transfer the mixture to an 8 x 8 x 2 baking dish, spreading it thinly. Bake until puffed up and browned, about 30 minutes. To serve, garnish with cilantro, if desired. Serves about 8 as an appetizer and 8 to 10 servings.

title: Tex-Mex Artichokes
ingredients: 2 cups all-purpose flour | 1 1/2 teaspoons dry mustard | 1/4 teaspoon crumbled saffron threads | 1 jar barbeque sauce | 1 cup picante sauce | 1 can artichokes, drained and thinly sliced
instructions: In a medium bowl, stir together the flour, mustard, saffron and barbecue sauce. Stir in picante and artichokes. Preheat grill to medium high heat. Brush grill with oil. Oil grill. Toss the artichokes with the mixture until coated. Cook 5 to 10 minutes, turning once, or until heated through and lightly browned.

Random Ingredients: white fish fillet,egg,serrano pepper,london broil beef,golden raisin,red chilies
title: Steamed Fish With Raisins, Chilies and Eggs
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs white fish fillets | 2 teaspoons minced serrano peppers | 2 teaspoons minced fresh red chilies | 1 lb london broil beef ( about 6 ) | 2 tablespoons chopped golden raisins | 3 large eggs, separated
instructions: Bring 1/2 3/4 cups water to a boil in a 2 to 3 qt saucepan.

Random Ingredients: sugar cane,pineapple,graham cracker,chicken leg,red wine,tart apple,lime wedge
title: Pineapple-Filled Chicken Legs
ingredients: 8 chicken legs | 1/2 cup dry red wine | 1/2 cup granulated sugar cane | 2 -3 limes, juice of | 24 ounces crushed pineapple, undrained | 12 whole ginger-size firm tart apples, pared | graham cracker, for serving
instructions: Place chicken legs in a shallow pan. Stir together the wine, sugar cane juice and juice and pour over chicken, turning to coat. Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes and up to 4 hours. Preheat oven to 325°f place whole ginger in a small pan and drizzle with oil. Grind ginger to crumbs. Drain chicken. Remove bone, skin and any extra fat. Roll chicken in the crumbs and place on baking sheets in a single layer. Bake until no longer pink in the middle, about 40 minutes, basting with liquid any additional oil that escapes from the chicken. Top with pineapple juice and serve accompanied by a scoop of crackers.

title: Basic Italian Doughnuts
ingredients: 2 cups all-purpose flour | 1/2 cup shredded monterey jack cheese | 1 teaspoon dried oregano, or to taste
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Mix flour, 1/2 cup cheese, and oregano in a bowl.

title: Garlic Croutons
ingredients: 5 tablespoons chicken bouillon granules | 5 yellow bell peppers, seeded and cut into strips
instructions: Stir the bouillon into the reserved bouillon until it dissolves. Stir in the peppers with about 1/4 cup of water. Cover and refrigerate overnight.

title: Egg-Lard Halal(Fesenjika)
ingredients: 2 cups water | 1 medium hard-boiled egg
instructions: Wash the egg and cut it in half lengthwise. Remove the yolks and place them in the bowl of an electric mixer fitted with a whip attachment. Beat until foamy and a little lemoncent in color, then gradually pour in the water while beating. Slowly and gradually add the zest. Cover and chill for at least two hours before serving. If you do not have a whip attachment, whip the egg whites until they begin to thicken and then add the sugar gradually, beating until you use stiff peaks. Pile on to a plate while still warm. Sprinkle the halal with white cardamon. Serve chilled.

title: Glamorganised Tomatoes
ingredients: 8 ripe tomatoes ( about 400g total weight ) | 1/3 cup tomato puree | 80 g dark sesame oil | 1 1/4 cups peaches, coarsely chopped
instructions: Bring a large saucepan of water to the boil, add the tomatoes, return to the boil and simmer until the tomatoes are very tender. Drain the tomatoes and finely dice them, place in a bowl or a jug. Add the puree, sesame oil and 1 1/2 teaspoons salt and mix well. Pour into a colander lined with cheesecloth and place over a large pan of boiling water. Cover and simmer for 10 minutes or until the liquid has nearly evaporated. Transfer to a platter. Garnish with chopped peaches.

title: Cucumber-Maple French Bread
ingredients: 1 pizza dough ( i use a small bijoliter pizza dough or just a single medium or large baking mix - i use a tube size ) or 1 pizza dough ( i use a small bijoliter pizza dough or just a single medium or large baking mix - i use a small bijoliter pizza dough or just a single large baking mix - i use a small bijoliter pizza dough or just a single medium or large baking mix - i use a small bijoliter pizza dough or a single large baking mix ) | 1/2 - 1 english cucumber, chopped ( i like to add a handful of chopped jalapenos, but you're likely to end up using more than two whole jalapenos ) | 1 cup pure maple syrup ( i use light, dark or regular syrup ) | maple syrup
instructions: Preheat oven to 550 degrees. Line baking tray with parchment paper. Cut dough in half. Spread maple syrup on top of each piece of dough, covering evenly. Sprinkle diced cucumber onto syrup. Arrange in a circle in the oven. Bake in the preheated oven until bread is browned and crisp on the edges, and bottom is crispy and brown on the tips too.... Note, if using a loaf pan you might have to bake it in the oven, this does not really matter. But if using a dough baking pan, cut pieces of bread and bake until bread is brown and crisp on the edges, about 5 - 8 minutes. If using a pizza dough bake in oven on the lowest rack for 30 minutes or so, or until golden on the edges.

Random Ingredients: beet,yellow pepper,tahini paste,jalapeno,white fish fillet,worcestershire sauce,ha avocadoes
title: Beet and Avocado-Wrapped Fish (Salatah Ma’ Zanghi)
ingredients: 2 hass avocadoes, halved and seeded ( about 1 1/2 pounds ) | 4 waxy beets, peeled | 1 jalapeno, halved and seeded | 2 yellow peppers, halved and seeds scraped out | 2 medium yellow peppers, halved and seeds scraped out | 1 cup homemade tahini paste, or more if desired ( to taste ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons worcestershire sauce ( to taste ) | 2 lbs firm white fish fillets, cut into 4 portions
instructions: Grate the avocados with a cheese grater, then mix with the beets, jalapeno, and yellow and jalapeno peppers. Place 6 pieces of fish on each tortilla with some of the avocado carrot mixture and a little of the tahini sauce, and sprinkle with worcestershire sauce.

title: Raspberry Chowder With Chilies
ingredients: 5 -6 medium russet potatoes, scrubbed, peeled | 1 tablespoon pearl barley | 7 -8 cups cold water or 7 -8 cups vegetable broth | 12 ounces chopped fresh raspberries, fresh or frozen | 6 -8 large chilies, dried red and seeded ( or to taste )
instructions: Place potatoes in a large pot. Add water, barley and enough cold water to cover. Bring mixture to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat and simmer until it falls from the spoon, about 15 - 20 minutes, stirring occasionally. Stir in raspberries and let come to a boil again. Reduce heat and simmer until berries are soft, stirring occasionally, about 20 minutes. If soup becomes rather dark, add salt. To serve, ladle soup into bowls/bowls and sprinkle with chiles.

Random Ingredients: white vinegar,red wine,sherry wine,meat beef,ziti pasta,mayonnaise,pork roast
title: Greek-American Baked Ziti (Ziti Alla Romana)
ingredients: 1 lb dried ziti pasta | 3 1/2 lbs pork roast | 16 ounces medium meat ( your choice, 1/2 - 3/4 pound ) | 2 cups red wine | 4 cups white vinegar | 3 cups mayonnaise | 3 cups sweet sherry wine ( i like to use a mix of red, blush, or white or grape flavored )
instructions: Place the beef and pork in a large roaster and set it on top of a cookie sheet, covering it with foil. Sprinkle the meat with salt and pepper and cover tightly with foil. Bake at 300 degrees fahrenheit for 4 hours. Remove the foil and turn the beef and pork over. Continue baking until the meat is cooked and the liquid is reduced completely. Slice the roast into slices about 1/2 wide and 2 long. Remove the meat from the roaster and reserve. Turn oven on to broil. Brush the pan and roaster with melted butter. Place each strip of beef on a wooden skewer or toothpick and place the skewer or tooth pick in a cheesecloth bag. Pour 1 cup of the reserved liquid into a small bowl, pour liquid around the roast and marinate in the refrigerator for 2 or 3 hours, turning occasionally. Cut the meat into small cubes. Put the meat in a slow cooker and add the wine, vinegar, and mayonnaise. Stir well. Cover and set cook until the vegetables are tender. About 6 hours and 45 minutes. When the ziti is done baking, transfer the ziti to a shallow, oval pyrex dish. Spread the ziti evenly with the meat and vegetables. Turn the oven to broil. Place the broiler pan in the oven. Watch carefully, so the top is brown and crisp. Watch for signs of burning at the top.

Random Ingredients: salt,beef chuck roast,walnut oil,mozzarella cheese,ginger root,catsup,shrimp
title: Frugal Gourmet's Beef Shrimp
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds boneless beef chuck roast, cut into 1-inch cubes | salt to taste | 1 1/2 cups catsup | 3 tablespoons finely chopped fresh ginger root ( optional ) | 1/4 cup finely chopped walnut oil | 1 pound raw shrimp, peeled | 1 1/2 ounces crumbled dried mozzarella cheese
instructions: Combine beef cubes, catup, ginger, and walnut oil in a bowl. Place a piece of cheese on the bottom of a 12x18 inch pan or soup tureen. Arrange shrimp on top. Spoon half the beef mixture in the center of the cheese. Top with remaining beef mixture, and sprinkle with mozzarella cheese. Bake in the preheated oven until shrimp are easily peeled, 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

title: Simple Beef Tips (Pork & Beef)
ingredients: 4 lbs beef tips ( ground beef, pork ) | 3/4 cup beef bouillon | 5 tablespoons oyster sauce ( kikkoman )
instructions: Brown beef tips in a skillet or wok until nicely browned. Drain any excess fat and discard. Add 1 t water to skillet or wok. Add 2 t beef broth and seasoning. Cover and simmer over low heat for 1/2 hour. Add oyster sauce and simmer 15 minutes more. Serve as a stew over steamed rice.

Random Ingredients: dill,white wine vinegar,rigatoni pasta,italian seasoning mix,chili pepper flake
title: Pasta with Dilly Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup white wine vinegar or 1/2 cup tomato juice | 1/4 teaspoon chili pepper flakes | 1/4 teaspoon italian seasoning mix | 1/8 teaspoon dried dill | 1 lb rigatoni pasta
instructions: Cook pasta until al dente.

title: Protein Mixing for Sausages
ingredients: 3 tablespoons of ground pistachio nuts | 35 g poultry seasoning
instructions: Combine the ground pistachio and poultry seasoning together in a bowl. Add salt to taste, stir well.

Random Ingredients: cream celery soup,poblano pepper,cilantro leaf,eggplant,cocoa powder,coconut oil,feta
title: Grilled Chicken with Chile Con Coco, Tomatillo and Roasted Eggplant
ingredients: 2 cups shredded cooked chicken | 1 peeled and sliced poblano pepper | 2 poblano peppers, sliced | sliced eggplant | 1 can condensed cream of celery soup | 1/4 cup unsweetened cocoa powder | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh cilantro leaves | 2 eggs, beaten | 1/3 cup coconut oil
instructions: In a bowl, combine the chicken, poblano peppers, and poblano pepper. Pour the soup over all and stir well. Spray a grill rack or heat a grill pan. In a shallow pan, whisk together the cornstarch and eggs. Drizzle over the chicken mixture. Grill or cook chicken, turning once, until no longer pink, 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Beef Kabobs or Kebabs
ingredients: 2 lbs sirloin or 2 lbs top round beef, cubed | 1/2 bunch flat leaf parsley
instructions: Soak skewers in cold water. Make sure you have thoroughly washed all fat from the beef pieces. Thread the beef onto the skewers. Place on a rack over a foil lined baking dish or broiler tray and brush lightly with some of the remaining marinade. Broil kebabs 10 minutes, turning often, so that all sides are evenly browned. Serve hot or cold.

title: French Onions
ingredients: 4 large vidalia onions, halved | 3 -4 tablespoons apple juice | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence ( optional )
instructions: Place sliced onions in a bowl lined with baking paper or a paper towel. Drizzle with apple juice and sprinkle with salt. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and leave in the fridge overnight. Remove the vegetables from the bowl and pat dry with a paper towel. Chill. Place onions in a microwave safe bowl sprayed over a medium high heat and cook for 12 - 15 minutes. Add vanilla essence, if using. Cook for 3 - 5 minutes more, or until onions are golden brown.

title: Italian Cheesy Corn Dip With Bread Crumbs
ingredients: 1 can whole kernel corn, drained | 3/4 cup italian cheese blend, shredded | 1/4 cup mayonnaise | salt & freshly ground black pepper | 1 cup fresh breadcrumb | 1/4 cup cheese, shredded
instructions: Combine corn, cheese blend and mayonnaise. Add salt and pepper to taste. Place bread crumbs in a shallow baking dish lined with parchment paper. Dip each slice of bread into crumbs until evenly coated. Place onto paper for 2 minutes. Serve with your favourite dippers such as tomatoes, crackers, vegetables, etc.

title: Mung Bean Sprouts Lasagne
ingredients: 16 ounces dry mung bean sprouts | 1 1/2 teaspoons dry yeast | 10 cups cooked lasagna noodles | 1 tablespoon allspice
instructions: Soak the sprouts overnight in the refrigerator. Drain and rinse them well. Mix yeast with 3 cups water and place in bowl. Add the sprouts to the bowl and allow them to rise overnight. In the morning divide the mixture into smaller portions and place in a large pan. Add the remaining 3 cups water, bring to boil, cover and simmer, stirring the mixture once or twice. When it is finished simmering remove from heat. Leave to cool, then refrigerate for at least 6 hours or overnight. Before serving spread the noodles out on the counter and let cool until they are completely cool. Spread the noodles out on the counter and spread the bean sprouts evenly on them. Sprinkle the yeast on top and allow them to rest for a few minutes. Spread the sprouts and spread on some bread slices.

Random Ingredients: habanero pepper,pam cooking spray,basmati rice,fontina cheese,brown lentil,canning salt,amaretto almond liqueur
title: Crock Pot Adobo (Lebanese Corned Lentil and Rice Pudding)
ingredients: 1 bag brown lentils | 1 cup dry white basmati rice or 1 cup arborio rice | 2 -3 habanero peppers ( or one of your choice ) | 2 tablespoons amaretto almond liqueur, for the brave | 1/4 cup canning salt | 4 tablespoons canning salt ( or to taste ) | 1 jar light amaretto almond liqueur | 1/4 cup canola oil or 1/4 cup canola oil | 1 1/2 1 1/2 cups fontina cheese or 1 1/2 cups muenster cheese, shredded, divided
instructions: Sort and wash lentils and rice. Soak lentils and rice for 24 hours. If you are going to use a pressure cooker, pour boiling water over and pressure cook over medium heat for 15 minutes. When ready to remove pressure, drain off any excess water. Meanwhile, in a non stick pan, heat amaretto, canning salt to boiling over medium heat. Drain the rice and lentils very well. When ready to use, ladle boiling water over rice in the non sealing pan and stir till rice is covered in water. Add enough amaretto to cover. Simmer till rice is done, about 20 - 25 minutes... To serve, sprinkle 3 tbsp of the 3 tbsp of amaretto onto the cooked rice and toss with grated cheese.. Enjoy on a bed of fresh greens or a mound of sourdough bread. Also delicious over a bed of spinach tossed with a little bit of cheese and drizzled with amaretto over the top. Also a delicious salad or a sandwich.

title: Simple Sausage and Egg Omelet
ingredients: 3 large eggs, beaten | 4 ounces bulk pork sausage
instructions: In a medium mixing bowl, combine the eggs and sausage. Using a fork or a wire whisk, whisk the eggs until they are thick and creamy. In a hot nonstick skillet, place the sausage mixture in the bowl with the egg mixture and scramble the sausage on medium low heat, turning often to fully coat the sausage evenly. When the sausage is fully cooked and evenly crumbly, remove it from the skillet and set it aside. The cooking of the sausages will create the best results in this recipe. Allow the sausage to cool slightly, then add it to the eggs. Then, in a small, warm skillet over medium heat, scramble the eggs until they are light and frothy, about 1 minute.

title: Spicy Shrimp Rolls
ingredients: 1 lb large shrimp, raw, peeled and deveined | 1/2 cup ricotta cheese | 1 teaspoon horseradish | 1 teaspoon garlic paste | 1/4 cup rice wine
instructions: In a food processor or blender, process the shrimp until finely minced. Add the remaining ingredients and process until thoroughly smooth. Shape mixture into 24 small patties using 2 teaspoons of the mixture for each. Grill the patties on a hot skillet or fry in a sauce pan until the outside is light brown and crispy. Serve with sour cream on the side. This goes well with garlic toast, pasta and vegetables.

Random Ingredients: cream cheese,bamboo shoot,cottage cheese,clam,asiago cheese,cocoa powder,whipping cream,soymilk
title: Chocolate and Asiago Clam Balls
ingredients: 1/2 cup low-fat whipped cream cheese | 1/2 cup light sour cream | 1 tablespoon unsweetened cocoa powder | 1/4 cup dried shucked clams | 20 canned chopped clams, drained | 20 canned sliced bamboo shoots, drained | 1/2 cup grated asiago cheese | 1/4 cup heavy whipping cream | 2 extra large eggs | 1/3 cup low-fat evaporated low-fat milk
instructions: Chocolate and asiago filling, combine cream cheese, sour cream, cocoa powder, 3/4 cup clam juice or clam broth in a bowl. Fold in drained canned clams and bamboo shoots. Spread filling into a 2 cup shallow baking dish, then sprinkle with 1/2 cup grated asiago cheese. Bake at 400 degrees f for 12 - 15 minutes or until mixture is hot and bubbly, then remove from oven and stir in the cream. In a bowl, whisk eggs lightly, then add 1/3 cup evaporated skim milk. Slowly pour egg mixture back into hot, bubbly chocloate and clam mixture. Stir until blended. Pour into a pastry bag fitted with fluted tube to pipe hot cream mixture onto a 12 inch square piece of wax paper. Cool for at least 1 hour and no longer than 8 hours in the refrigerator, stirring every 15 minutes or so. Coconut cream filling, over medium heat, melt chocolate. Add remaining 1/3 cup clam juice or clam broth and heavy whipping cream and stir constantly until chocolate has melted and cream sauce is smooth. If you have too much thickened cream, just whisk in a tablespoon at a time. If too thin, cook until too thin, stirring constantly. Spoon into bowl and stir in remaining 1/2 cup of shredded asiago cheese and the additional milk. Let cool completely, then break and divide among six 1 cup serving dishes. Top each serving with a tablespoon of coconut cream filling and a sprinkle of shredded asiago cheese.

title: Stuffed Peppers
ingredients: 6 large peppers | 500 g pork sausage | 2 teaspoons cornflour ( cornstarch ) | 1 teaspoon pine nuts or 1 teaspoon cashew halves, crushed
instructions: Preheat oven to 180 c gas mark cut the tops off the peppers, remove the seeds under cold water. Remove the ribs and any excess juices.

Random Ingredients: molasses,sirloin tip roast,grainy mustard,tea,rigatoni pasta,sugar syrup,red capsicum
title: Oriental Beef Salad
ingredients: 1 lb sirloin tip roast, trimmed and cut into 3cm cubes | 2 tablespoons molasses | 2 tablespoons dark grainy mustard | 2 tablespoons strong grainy mustard | 8 leaves roli pasta, cooked | 2 red capsicums, quartered | 2 tablespoons roasted unsalted molasses | 1 tablespoon sugar syrup
instructions: Place beef in a bowl, cover with cold water and leave to stand for 30 minutes. Drain and run cold water over beef and then dry with paper towel. Combine remaining ingredients, seasoning well and pour over beef and toss. Chill. Serve with roast salad.

Random Ingredients: red pepper flake,coconut oil,greek yogurt,red chili powder,beef stew meat,white vinegar
title: Pumpkin Curry Dump
ingredients: 3 lbs lean beef stew meat, bone-in and cut into cubes | 1/2 cup greek yogurt | 1/3 cup light coconut oil | 1/4 cup white vinegar | 1 teaspoon red chili powder | 1/2 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. In a large bowl, toss the beef with the yogurt, coconut oil, vinegar, chili powder and pepper flakes. Transfer to an oiled casserole dish and bake, uncovered, for at least 1 hour, or cover and bake 1 hour longer. Remove cover for last 15 minutes of cooking to brown the surface.

title: Mace and Walnut Fries
ingredients: 25 g walnuts | 25 g fresh mace | 3 ripe hass avocadoes
instructions: Heat wok or fry pan at medium heat until walnuts turn black on the outside, taking care not to burn as you stir, watch carefully as they burn very quickly. Cut the avocados in half and remove the stones. Peel off black skin. Place the nuts in a frying pan with a little water, and cook on the stove. When golden brown, put the walnuts on a plate to cool, when set, chop into pieces. Take care not to burn them and let cool to room temperature. Take a small piece of avocado and put one hazelnut in a small frying pan over low heat stir frequently, and watch if they turn a bit black.

title: Thai Blueberries With Fresh Fruits
ingredients: 2 cups fresh blueberries | 2 -4 teaspoons fish sauce, to taste
instructions: Rinse the blueberries and toss them in a big bowl with the fish sauce. Allow the blueberries to cook while still warm. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: rub,lamb shoulder,ladyfinger,kaffir lime leaf,roquefort cheese,orange peel
title: Lamb & Goat Cheese Skewers With Kaffir Lime and Grilled Cheese
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless lamb shoulder, cut into 1-inch cubes | 2 lbs soft wafer roll, cut into 1-inch pieces | 1 1/2 ounces softened mozzarella cheese | 1/2 ounce soft roquefort cheese ( crumbled ) | 2 teaspoons finely shredded orange peel | 2 tablespoons very finely crushed dried kaffir lime leaves
instructions: Thread lamb on two 4 inch skewers. Thread cheese, cheese, kaffir lime leaves, and orange peel through metal or bamboo skewers.

title: Sourdough Pies
ingredients: 1/2 lb kielbasa, cubed | 1/2 lb sourdough bread, cubed | 1 teaspoon anise seed | 1 red capsicum, sliced into 2 wedges
instructions: Place all ingredients in a large pan, cover with water and boil gently until tender and most of the liquid has reduced. Spoon into 8 x 2 inch ramekins or heatproof serving dishes. Freeze for 1 hour or until solid. Store in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: penne pasta,cottage cheese,egg yolk,clove,half,bean sprout,chicken thigh,parmigiano reggiano cheese
title: Creamy Chicken and Pasta Bake
ingredients: 3/4 lb boneless skinless chicken thighs, cut into 1/2-inch dice | 1/4 cup fat-free cottage cheese | 1 1/2 cups half-and-half | 3 large egg yolks | 8 ounces drained canned fat-free penne pasta | 1/4 teaspoon ground cloves | 1/3 cup grated fresh parmigiano-reggiano cheese | sliced fresh bean sprout
instructions: Combine chicken pieces, cottage cheese, half and half, egg yolks, and 1/2 cup reserved chicken broth in a medium bowl. Place the remaining 1/4 cup chicken broth, 1/2 cup reserved chicken broth, cloves, pasta, and cheese in a large casserole dish. Cover with plastic wrap, and marinate the chicken, refrigerated, for 4 hours and then the other 1/4 cup reserved chicken broth for the topping. Preheat the oven to 400f degrees. Remove plastic wrap from casserole, and bake for 15 minutes. Remove the cover, stir, and bake an additional 8 - 10 minutes. Top with bean sprouts, and bake an additional 5 minutes on top, until top is warm and bubbly.

title: Sicilian Olive Pudding
ingredients: 10 small fresh green olives | 2 large serrano peppers, halved | 6 green cardamoms | 1/4 teaspoon allspice berry ( optional )
instructions: Wash and dry the olives, place in a blender and add all other ingredients. Cover and blend until smooth and creamy. Pour into wine glasses that have been rubbed with a garlic press or paper towels. Place glass in the freezer for at least 3 hours and no longer than 5 hours. To serve, spoon off all but about 1 cup of the liquid.

Random Ingredients: cream celery soup,chili pepper flake,lemon,nonfat milk,buttermilk,leek,red potato
title: Lemon Potato Soup
ingredients: 1 large leek | 1 can condensed cream of celery soup | 1/2 cup dry nonfat milk | 2 cups cubed red potatoes | 1/2 cup shredded nonfat milk | 1 tablespoon dry chili pepper flakes ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon lemon rind ( optional ) or 1/2 teaspoon lemon extract ( optional ) | 1 lemon, sliced
instructions: Trim away any dirt from the leek.

title: Homemade Grated Lemons
ingredients: 6 lemons, zest of | 12 cloves garlic, peeled
instructions: Place the zest and cloves in a blender and pulse on high for 15 to 30 seconds. Transfer the zest to a bowl and add the water, 1 tablespoon at a time, until you get a thin paste. Spread over the lemons to prevent discoloring, and refrigerate for 1 to 2 days before using as desired.

Random Ingredients: five spice powder,cheese spread,wheat pita bread,salsa,parsley leaf,egg yolk
title: Spanish Toast
ingredients: 1 whole-wheat pita bread | 2 eggs | 2 tablespoons low fat cheese spread | 2 tablespoons salsa | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh parsley leaves | 1 teaspoon five-spice powder
instructions: Preheat nonstick skillet on medium heat. Using about 2 tablespoons of oil, place pita bread, cut side up, in skillet. Scramble eggs until fluffy and whites have been whisked until frothy. Place eggs in a separate bowl and mash eggs with a fork. Scramble in cheese, salsa and parsley leaves. Spread cheese and egg mixture on pita bread, sprinkle with five spice powder and serve immediately.

title: Aussie Style Beef Strips
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs lean ground beef | 1/2 cup fresh herb, finely chopped ( such as dill, chives, or basil ) | 1 -2 tablespoon juice ( or liquid from beef schnice )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f or 190 degrees celsius. Crumble beef and place in an ovenproof dish with enough drippings to just coat the beef. Sprinkle with beef drippings. Sprinkle with chopped herbs. Add liquid or liquid of your choice, as to your liking. Bake for 10 - 12 minutes or until meat is cooked through, but not too browned. Serve. If you are on short or longer the beef mixture may take from 15 - 20 minutes to cook, depending on size. When you serve it, sprinkle with salt if desired.

Random Ingredients: bitter melon,onion flake,nutella chocolate hazelnut spread
title: Lazy Bitter Melon Spread for Birthday
ingredients: 1/2 small bitter melon, cut in half and seeded | 1/2 package nutella chocolate hazelnut spread | 1 small onion, chopped | 1 (.25 ounce ) package dry onion flakes
instructions: Preheat the microwave for 2 minutes on high. Stir in the butter spread, onion, and onion flakes. Cool completely at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: sun tomato oil,hot water,ricotta cheese,yellow squash,basil leaf
title: Roasted Squash and Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 large yellow squash | 1/3 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil | 3 cups ricotta cheese | 3 tablespoons hot water | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Slice squash diagonally into quarters and place in a 1 quart baking dish. Drizzle with 3 tbsp of olive oil and toss to coat. Sprinkle with salt and top with sun dried tomatoes, basil, and remaining 2 tbsp oil. Roast in pre heated oven for 35 to 45 minutes until a fork goes through easily and squash is tender. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: matzo,awamori,chicken stock,rice noodle,basmati rice,feta cheese,methi seed,shell pasta
title: Matzoh (Indian Cheese rice Noodle soup)
ingredients: 6 cups chicken stock | 2 dried matzoh ( kombu ) | 2 boxes medium shell pasta, such as pappas | 1 cup uncooked basmati rice | 1/4 lb feta cheese | 1/4 cup whole basil or 1/4 cup dill, leaves only | 1/2 cup ground dried awamori ( kombu ) or 1/2 cup tahini | 1 tablespoon whole methi seeds
instructions: In a large stock pot or deep fryer, combine chicken stock, matzoh, and kombu. Bring to a boil, skimming from the top. Transfer mixture to a bowl. Cut the pasta into bite size pieces. Add to bowl along with the feta and basil. Cover and cook over low heat for 20 minutes.. After 20 minutes, remove cover, add methi and bring to a boil. Cover and cook until the water is reduced by half. Meanwhile, heat oil in a large frying pan or deep fryer. When the oil has reached the desired temperature, pour the soup into a blender. Using a hand blender, puree soup until smooth. Replace the lid and cook slowly, stirring soup often, until soup has thickened slightly, about 20 minutes. This may take 10 - 15 minutes depending on the quantity of soup used.

Random Ingredients: chicken wing,yellow pea,beef stew meat,rib eye steak,cilantro,pumpkin
title: Quick and Easy Slow-Cooker Spicy Beef Stew
ingredients: 3 pounds beef stew meat, cubed | 1 pound boneless short-grain rotisserie cooked chicken wings, cut into thirds | 2 cans yellow split peas | 1 can petite diced tomatoes with green chile peppers, undrained | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh cilantro
instructions: Spread short grain jerk seasoning on the bottom of a slow cooker. Sprinkle the top with beef and rotisserie chicken wings, then pour the canned tomatoes over the meat. Top with 1/2 cup split peas, half the cilantro, the remaining 1/2 cup split peas, the remaining 1/2 cup split peas, the remaining chopped cilantro and the onion if desired.. Cover, set slow cooker to high, and cook for 2 to 3 hours, adding more liquid if needed during cooking.

Random Ingredients: yellow potato,graham cracker crumb,vanilla pudding mix
title: No-Bake German Potato Squash
ingredients: 1 pound yellow potatoes, peeled | 1 package instant vanilla pudding mix | 1/2 cup graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Cook potatoes in boiling water until tender, 15 to 30 minutes. Mash potato and mix with pudding mix until blended. Transfer to a 9x13 inch baking dish. Sprinkle crumbs on top. Bake at 400 degrees f for 15 to 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: bay leaf,onion powder,kidney bean,honey,margarine,vegetable oil cooking spray,pretzel
title: Vegan Refried Beans
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 cup dried kidney beans | 1/2 teaspoon onion powder | 1/4 teaspoon honey | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon bay leaf | 1 cup pretzel ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon margarine or 1/4 teaspoon butter
instructions: Combine beans, onion, honey, bayleaf and pretzels and add enough water to cover. Bring to a boil and then let stand 10 - 15 minutes over medium heat to soften a little bit. Spray a nonstick pan with cooking spray and heat. Add 1 tablespoon margarine to oil on medium high heat and quickly brown mixture, stirring often. Take off heat and let sit until browned and set up. Add 1 tablespoon margarine to beans and mix well. Melt remaining tablespoon margarine on medium level. When margarine is hot enough, add beans and stir well until mixed evenly with other ingredients, but not to the point that it tastes mashed. Remove pot from burner and serve. This is wonderful on it's own as well.

Random Ingredients: salt pepper,mushroom,onion salt,pork tenderloin,mustard powder,pineapple juice,anchovy fillet
title: Dynamite
ingredients: 2 pork tenderloin | 1/4 teaspoon onion salt | 1/4 teaspoon mustard powder | 1/4 cup pineapple juice | 1/4 ounce anchovy fillet, cut up | 1/4 cup mushroom | 1 teaspoon salt pepper
instructions: Combine salt mixture and pepper. Slice tenderloins and marinade the overnight in mixture. Spray casserole with pam, and layer meat and sauce. Bake at 350 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Torta Di Mushrooms - Di Papalli
ingredients: 500 g white mushrooms | 50 g raisins | 150 g dates | 1/2 cup mixed dates | 3 cups flour | 2 cups sifted cocoa powder | 1/2 - 1 tablespoon cardamom, powder
instructions: Clean mushrooms and cut them in medium lengths. Mix flour with cardamom in a bowl. Add butter in it to make a soft dough. Add raisins into the soft dough. Add dates and mix into a dough. Mix dough to make a smooth dough. Cover the dough with a cloth and stand for 1 hour. On a greased tray, pat and press mixture on each mushroom. Cover with cloth and keep aside for another 15 minutes. Take a small pot and cook them in the water for 10 minutes. Remove from pot. Heat flour in a pot. Keep on a rolling fast. Add a little water and mix well. Add the sifted cocoa powder and mix. Add a little of the flour water and mix. Repeat until you obtain a thick paste of dough mixture. Spread the paste evenly over the mushrooms. Sprinkle nuts or raisins over the balls and bake in preheated oven till brown on outside. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: dijon mustard,cinnamon,green bean,beef bouillon cube,red chili pepper flake,bean sprout,beer
title: Beef and Beans With Onions
ingredients: 1/2 lb fresh green beans ( cut in half ) | 1 can chopped drained canned beans ( use fresh, drained bean can ) | 3 tablespoons beef bouillon cubes | 2 teaspoons dijon mustard ( your favorite, do not use prepared ) | 1 teaspoon red chili pepper flakes, crushed | 1/4 teaspoon cinnamon | 1 cup beer
instructions: In a deep saucepan over medium heat cook beans with half the bouillon cubes for 12 to 15 minutes or until tender. Remove from heat and add remaining ingredients. If desired you can also add 3 - 4 tbsp fresh minced onion. Serve with rice.

Random Ingredients: nonstick cooking spray,marjoram,enchilada sauce,red bean,tofu,green onion
title: Tofu & Bean Enchiladas
ingredients: 8 ounces dry red beans, rinsed and drained | 8 ounces firm tofu, drained | nonstick cooking spray | 1/2 teaspoon dried marjoram | 6 green onions, thinly sliced | 3 cups prepared enchilada sauce, warmed
instructions: Spread beans on a cookie sheet. Spray with cooking spray. Spray again with cooking spray. Sprinkle each with marjoram. Let stand 30 minutes or refrigerate for up to 2 hours. Spray a 9x9 inch baking dish with cooking spray. Remove beans from refrigerator. Using a pastry wheel or sharp knife, cut a 1 inch deep opening in the center of each bean. Scoop out as much as possible from bean shells and discard. Set shells aside. Remove tofu from marinade.

title: Sauerkraut and Almonds
ingredients: 300 -400 g sauerkraut and blanched almonds ( both can be prepared in advance with good results! ) | cabbage, shredded and washed
instructions: Rinse sauerkraut well, if needed. In one frying pan, add a little olive oil, then toss in sauerkraut with almonds. As soon as the sauerkraut is golden brown on the edges, remove from heat and stir in cabbage and cover until serving time..

title: Asiago Strawberries
ingredients: 2 pounds fresh raspberries, rinsed | 1 package asiago cheese, grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line a baking dish with aluminum foil. Spread raspberries evenly over the baking dish. Sprinkle the asiago cheese over the raspberries. Bake in the preheated oven until the berries are tender and the asiago has melted, at least 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: harissa,flour tortilla,white bread,lemon pepper,tater tot,ginger,green cardamom pod,peanut oil vegetable
title: Crunchy Tater Tot Wraps (Vegan)
ingredients: 1 lb tater tots ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon minced ginger | 1/5 tablespoon lemon pepper | 1/8 tablespoon harissa | 1 can fat-free peanut oil or ( 3/4 cup ) can vegetable oil | 12 flour tortillas | 1/4 teaspoon green cardamom pods | 8 slices white bread, crust removed
instructions: Cook taters according to package directions. Drain and set aside. Melt the oil in a large nonstick skillet over med high. Add ginger, lemon pepper and harissa. Cook 1 minute, until fragrant, but not browned. Add the patties and cook until golden on both sides. Remove tater tots from pan and sprinkle with cardamon. Divide the tater tots onto half of the tortillas. Spoon some of the filling over. Fold tortillas over. Serve and enjoy.

title: Mediterranean Pasta
ingredients: 2 lbs cooked macaroni pasta or 2 lbs your favorite pasta, of choice | 2 lbs fresh parsley roots, sliced into rings | 4 1/2 teaspoons mixed italian herbs | 1/4 cup fresh lemon rind, julienned | 1/2 cup fresh marinade | 1/2 teaspoon tabasco sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit. Place pasta, parsley carrots, mixed italian herbs, lemon rind, marinade and tabasco sauce into a bowl and mix well. Heat small amount of olive oil in nonstick skillet.

title: Potato and Parsnip Gratin (21 Day Wonder Diet: Day of Wonder Diet: Day 20)
ingredients: 1 ounce flour | 4 tablespoons fat ( from fat of 3 ozs of fat, chilled ) | 4 tablespoons milk | 2/3 cup nonfat sour cream ( i used fat star plain fat free sour cream ) | 2/3 cup sweet potato, grated and cooked | 2/3 cup parsnip, grated and cooked | 1/2 cup barbecue sauce | 1 tablespoon sherry wine
instructions: Preheat oven to 140c. Combine flour, fat 1oz, and milk in a small bowl. Beat with electric mixer, or electric mixer on low until combined and smooth. Add sour cream, sweet potato, parsnip, bbq sauce, and sherry and then beat on medium speed until combined, scraping down sides of bowl as needed. Scatter 1/3 cup of the potato mixture into a 2 cup capacity gratin dish, and top with rest of the potato mixture. Spoon potato mixture into gratin, filling almost to cover surface of gratin. Using a fork, make holes in top of gratin with a skewer. Cook for 15 - 20 minutes, or until golden brown and cooked through. Keep the gratin covered loosely with foil in the preheated oven until serving time.

title: Horseradish Fish
ingredients: 2 sole fillets, cooked | 3 tablespoons prepared horseradish | 1 napa cabbage, quartered | 1 tablespoon bottled bottled sweet-hot taco sauce
instructions: Place the fish in the bottom of a small shallow baking dish. Cover with horseradish and napa cabbage. Combine hot taco sauce and pour over the fish. Cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours or overnight.

Random Ingredients: artichoke heart,rye bread,avocado,cod,lemon pepper,red pepper cayenne,red lentil,feta
title: Smoked Cod Dip W- a Crunchy Re
ingredients: 2 cans artichoke hearts, drained and rough chopped | 2 avocados, chopped ( or 3/4 cup of the liquid from the can ) | 1/2 cup crumbled feta ( can sub any other ) | 1/2 cup red lentil | 1/4 teaspoon lemon pepper | 1/4 teaspoon ground red pepper ( or cayenne ) | 4 slices rye bread | 1/2 cup jarred roasted red peppers packed in oil
instructions: Blend and set aside the artichokes, avocados, feta, lentils, lemon pepper, red pepper flakes and black eyed peppercorns together in a large bowl. Line 2 pie plates with the rye bread slices. Spoon the liquid mixture evenly over the rye bread slices. Sprinkle with the red peppers. Dot the top of the mixture with the reserved artichoke hearts. Dump the bread, with liquid from 1/2 cup, over the red peppers in the pie plate. Bake at 375 degrees for 40 minutes.

title: Pear Salad
ingredients: 4 medium pears | 2 tablespoons ketchup
instructions: Cut pears and set aside. Bring a large saucepan half full of water to a boil. Add pears and immediately turn off heat. Let stand for 10 minutes. Drain completely removing and discarding any tough outer skin. Slice 1/4 inch slices. Mix ketchup with 2 tablespoons of olive oil. Set sauce aside. Mix 1 tablespoon of ketchup with the reserved pear mixture and the remaining 1 tablespoon of oil. Pour into glass bowl. Add the sliced pears. Refrigerate until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: sugar chocolate pudding mix,dark sesame oil,bok choy
title: Chinese Spiced Choy and Bok Choy (Chop Suey)
ingredients: 4 bunches bok choy ( you can use any choy ) | 1 box sugar-free instant chocolate pudding mix | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil
instructions: Wash bok choy. Trim off any damaged and white ribs. Slice the stalk of stalks lengthwise with scissors. Place on clean, dry plates. Sprinkle the tops with dark sesame oil. Cook in microwave for 4 minutes on 100% power to soften. Set aside to cool to warm and firm. This can be made in advance and returned to the fridge until ready to use as a gift, or later on, frozen or canned portions.

title: French Onion Pie
ingredients: 12 ounces frozen pierogies | 2 tablespoons rice flour | 3 teaspoons dried thyme sprigs | 2 bay leaves | 1 3/4 cups leftover beef, chopped | 1/2 cup kahlua | fresh spinach leaves, coarsely chopped
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f cook pierogies according to package directions, rinse with cold water, place in a large baking dish with the thyme and bay leaves. Bake for 10 minutes. Stir in the beef and kahlua.

Random Ingredients: pork sausage,breakfast sausage link,anchovy paste,sausage,pineapple chunk,island dressing,red wine,celery leaf
title: Pigs in Anchovies
ingredients: 1 pound pork sausage, casings removed | 1 pound breakfast sausage links, casings removed | 1/2 cup thousand island dressing | 1 can pineapple chunks, drained | 1/2 cup red wine | 1/2 cup italian-style salad dressing | 4 small anchovy paste | celery leaves
instructions: In a large, deep skillet, cook and stir pork sausage until done, about 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: jalapeno pepper,pork shoulder,sharp cheddar cheese,cilantro leaf,tequila,skewer,plain flour,icing sugar
title: Skewered Pork Empanadas
ingredients: 4 large jalapeno peppers, seeded, halved lengthways | 50 g plain flour | 1 1/4 lbs boneless pork shoulder | 1 1/2 ounces unsalted fresh cilantro leaves | 1 1/4 teaspoons icing sugar | 60 ml tequila | 18 skewers | 4 ounces sharp cheddar cheese, shredded
instructions: Place the jalennos on to a grill tray with a well fitting lid. Grill them for 5 minutes or until cooked, turning often. Place the flour in a processor with the pork, cilantro and sugar. Mix until the mixture resembles fine breadcrumbs. Pour the tequila over and process just until the mixture forms fine breadcrumbs. Transfer to a bowl, knead lightly and season with salt and pepper. Roll the mixture into 18 small saucer size balls. Press a piece of cheese into each ball. Place the tray of Empanadas onto a plate and refrigerate while preparing the rest of the empanada.

title: Easy Espresso Noodle Bowl
ingredients: 1 package fettuccine, uncooked | 1 1/2 cups hot espresso | 1/2 - 3/4 teaspoon fresh ground peppercorn | 1 can diced italian-style salad dressing | 3 -4 serrano chili, seeded and chopped ( optional )
instructions: Cook fettuccine, according to package directions, omitting salt. Drain. Place cooked pasta in large saucepan. Pour espresso over pasta, then add chopped chiles, or as desired, and stir. Pour over prepared salad dressing until just warm, and toss. Refridgerate for up to 1 - 2 hours. Serve chilled.

title: Pecorino Pesto Genovese
ingredients: 1/2 cup chopped pecorino romano cheese | 1/2 cup chopped green olives | 1 package frozen strawberries, thawed and drained | 1/4 cup molasses | 1/4 cup grated pecorino romano cheese | 1 pound sliced pepperoni
instructions: Mix the pecorino, olives, strawberries, molasses, and pepperoni together in a bowl.

title: Hang in a Hole - Canning
ingredients: 2 cups grapefruit juice | 2 tablespoons apple cider | 6 chicken drumsticks or 6 chicken legs ( about 2 kilogram ) | 100 -200 ml paprika | 100 -200 ml golden syrup
instructions: If the drumsticks are whole the joint. Place the drumsticks in a large casserole dish or roasting tin. If not you can leave them whole. Pour the juice onto a chopping board. Cut off the wing tips of the chicken legs. Use the back of a knife to scrape around the insides of the chicken legs until they have joined at the joint. Then cut the legs into even sized chunks about the size of the drumsticks. Pour over the grapefruit juice until your leg is nearly covered. Sprinkle in the paprika, golden syrup, and enough cold water to pour them all into the crockpot. Cook on low for 6 - 7 hours or on high for 3 - 5 hours. Remove the chicken legs from the syrup and discard. Use a sharp knife to score your skin several times on each side. Pour off the syrup and discard it. Place chicken legs into a sterilized jars and pour over the reserved syrup which has been strained. Seal and leave until the jars are filled or up to 2 years.

Random Ingredients: cilantro stem,baby green,serrano pepper,worcestershire sauce,vegetable oil cooking spray,cumin powder,olive,margarita mix
title: Mexican-Style Mixed Greens
ingredients: 16 ounces frozen mixed baby greens, thawed ( i like romaine ) | 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 1 tablespoon cumin powder | 1 serrano pepper, seeded and diced | 1 cup frozen olive, sliced | 1/4 teaspoon cilantro stem, finely chopped | vegetable oil cooking spray | 1/4 cup margarita mix, for serving
instructions: Combine the worcestershire sauce and cumin in a small bowl and set aside. Place the green and serrano peppers in a large, nonstick frying pan coated with cooking spray. Cook, stirring, until the peppers are crisp tender, about 3 to 5 minutes. Transfer to a paper towel lined plate and sprinkle with the cumin powder. Heat the olive oil in a medium saucepan over medium heat until very hot, about 3 minutes. Add the green mixture and the olives and stir to combine. Cook and stir until the greens are hot, about 3 minutes. Transfer to a bowl and serve with chips, if desired.

Random Ingredients: coconut cream,vanilla,currant,devil food cake mix,okra,unsulphured molasses
title: Coconut Okra and Okra Trifle
ingredients: 3 cups frozen okra | 3/4 cup unsulphured molasses | 1 1/2 teaspoons vanilla | 1 can coconut cream | 1 can coconut cream ( or your own coconut cream ) | 3 packages devil's food cake mix
instructions: Cook okra, molasses and vanilla in 2 - ½ cups of water over moderate heat, stirring, until okra is cooked but still slightly crisp. Drain liquid and blend into coconut cream and coconut milk. Stir in cake mix and mix well. Cover and refrigerate overnight if desired. Serve chilled or cold.

title: Cheese and Olive Refried Beans
ingredients: 1/2 cup refried beans | 1 pinch green cardamom | 1/2 cup monterey jack cheese, grated | 1 pckg. green olives
instructions: Slightly toast the cardamom and add it to the beans. Heat the gille in a frying pan with a few pinches of the cardamom and lightly brown. Add the beans, olives, and the remaining cardamom and serve warm.

title: Hot Chili Sauce
ingredients: 4 cups sweet chili, such as arbol | 1/2 cup hot sauce | 2 tablespoons liquid smoke | salt and freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Puree the chili with the hot sauce, liquid smoke, salt and pepper in a blender or food processor, about 20 seconds to a minute. Alternatively, you can use the food processor and blend in the liquid smoke or ketchup. Alternatively, transfer to a jar with a tight fitting lid and store in the refrigerator for up to one week. Bring to a simmer before serving.

Random Ingredients: cardamom pod,rosemary sprig,pea,vegetable stock,curry paste,stewing beef,pork butt
title: Aurora - Curried Meat Soup
ingredients: 6 ounces stewing beef, trimmed | 6 ounces lean pork butt, trimmed | 3/4 cup green peas | 2 cups vegetable stock | 1 teaspoon curry paste or 1 teaspoon cumin, ground | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom pod, freshly ground | rosemary sprig, for garnish
instructions: Cut stewing beef and pork into 1 chunks and place in a large saucepan. Add 2/3 cup of the broth. Add the curry, cardamom pods and rosemary sprigs. Bring to boil, reduce heat and simmer for 1 hour. Remove the cinnamon, cardamom and rosemary sprigs and serve.

title: Roasted Feta Cheese Sandwich Fingers
ingredients: 1 package crumbled feta cheese | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh coarsely chopped fresh coarsely chopped fresh coarsely chopped fresh coarseley chopped fresh coarsely ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon coarse grain mustard or 1 tablespoon dijon mustard | 1/8 teaspoon baking soda
instructions: If using feta cheese, stir in coarsely chopped fresh garlic.

title: Cuban-Style Slow Cooker Beef Sandwich
ingredients: 1 boneless beef chuck roast, cut into six equal portions | 4 black olives, sliced | 1 tablespoon grainy mustard, or more to taste
instructions: Place all ingredients in a slow cooker. Cover, and cook on low for 6 to 8 hours.

title: Vegetarian Baked Potatoes
ingredients: 2 large baking potatoes | 2 1/2 cups vegetable stock | 1/4 teaspoon instant vegetable bouillon granules
instructions: Scrub potatoes and cut into thin slices. Place potatoes in a large saucepan and cover with water.

Random Ingredients: rosemary,oregano,wheat flour,barbeque sauce,white wine vinegar,italian parsley
title: Italian Bread Dip
ingredients: 2 cups coarsely chopped italian parsley | 2 cups coarsely chopped italian parsley | 2 cups coarsely chopped italian parsley | 2/3 cup white wine vinegar | 1 3/4 cups whole wheat flour | 1/4 teaspoon ground dried oregano | 2 tablespoons barbeque sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line baking sheets with parchment paper. Lightly grease a bowl. Mix italian herbs and 1/4 cup of the parsley in a large bowl. Set aside. Combine vinegar, remaining 1 1/4 cup parsley, oregano, and garlic mixture in a small bowl, whisking until well blended. Stir in remaining 1/4 cup parsley. Add to bread mixture and toss. Pour into an ungreased 9x12 inch baking pan. Bake in preheated oven until golden brown and bubbly, 20 to 25 minutes. Makes about 1 cup.

Random Ingredients: cocoa powder,cassava,apple cider,pepper,arborio rice,sugar snap pea,red wine
title: Creamy Risotto With Nuts and Fruit
ingredients: 3/4 cup apple cider | 1 tablespoon cocoa powder | 2 cups sugar snap peas | 2/3 - 1 cup arborio rice | 3 tablespoons red wine ( any wine will give you the creamier consomme flavor ) | 1 teaspoon fresh ground pepper | 1/2 teaspoon parsley, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Boil 4 cups of water. In a large, deep saucepan over medium low heat, combine 1/2 cup apple cider and the cocoa.

title: Saffron Beet Soup
ingredients: 4 large beets | 2 teaspoons saffron threads | 6 cups chicken stock | 1 ounce tangerine, peeled and sliced in rounds | 1 pinch garlic powder | 8 dried figs
instructions: Place the beets in a large pot with water to cover. Bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmmer for 1 hour. Rinse and drain. Set aside and let cool. Peel and mash with saffron. In separate pot, stir fry the tangerine slices in oil for one minute. Add garlic for the last minute. Blanch the figs one by one and add to the simmering soup. Simmer for 5 minutes to heat through. Remove pectoral and ventral fins from the beets and chop into small cubes. Pour some of the soup into a blender with tangerine pieces and blend until smooth. Return to soup and stir in the saffron beet soup for garnish.

Random Ingredients: red chili pepper flake,flat leaf parsley,margarine
title: Mexican Chili Oil (For Salad)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons margarine or 2 tablespoons shortening | 1 tablespoon fresh ground flat leaf parsley | 1/4 teaspoon red chili pepper flakes
instructions: Blend margarine, parsley and red pepper flakes in an electric blender. Serve with toasted pita bread.

Random Ingredients: taco seasoning,corn,spaghetti sauce,sirloin beef,chicken bouillon cube,tuna olive oil
title: Lighter Spaghetti Meat & Tuna
ingredients: 1 spaghetti sauce | 6 tablespoons taco seasoning | 1/2 cup chicken bouillon cube | 4 tablespoons tuna in olive oil, drained | 1 1/2 lbs ground sirloin ( cut into large chunks ) | 2 cans corn, drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Coat 9x13 inch baking dish with nonstick spray. In small bowl combine spaghetti sauce, taco seasoning, and chicken bouillon cubes. Add tuna, mix. Reserve 1/2 cup of tuna mixture. Spray 9 x 13 inch baking pan with nonstick cooking spray. Place beef evenly over salsa mixture in baking dish.

title: Poblano a La Parra Joaquin
ingredients: 2 cups masa harina | 3 tablespoons dried orange rind, finely chopped
instructions: In a mixing bowl, combine masa harina and 1 teaspoon salt. Stir in 1 teaspoon of the orange rind. Make sure you stir it very well. Using one hand, mix in 2 cups water by hand until dough pulls easily from bowl. Refrigerate overnight. If dough seems dry, add about 1/8 cup more water as needed to keep dough from sticking to fingers. Cover, and refrigerate dough for 1 hour. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. On lightly floured board, roll out dough into strips about 1/4 inch wide and 1 1/4 inch long. Cut each strip lengthwise into 4 equal strips. Place a piece of dough on 2 parchment lined baking sheets. Top with a second piece of dough, pressing together to seal. Repeat with remaining dough and filling. Bake until golden brown, about 40 minutes.

title: Danish Breakfast Sandwiches
ingredients: 4 slices ham | 1 tablespoon apricot preserves | 4 pitted dates
instructions: Cover one slice of the ham with preserves. Place a dates into a shallow bowl, sprinkle with confectioner's sugar. Top with the second slice of ham.

Random Ingredients: chinese wheat noodle,hot pepper,cayenne pepper,ale,parsnip,taco meat,basil leaf
title: Taco Noodles With Parsnips and Beer
ingredients: 1 lb thin chinese wheat noodles, uncooked | 14 ounces taco meat, drained | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh basil leaves | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried basil leaves | 2 teaspoons chopped hot peppers | 2 teaspoons ground cayenne pepper | 1 cup finely chopped parsnip | 1 cup beer ( corona is best )
instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions. Drain, cool and mix all ingredients in large, shallow baking dish. Cover and refrigerate at least 3 hours or up to 3 days. Remove lid and spoon mixture into casserole dish. Cover and bake at 350 degrees for 15 minutes, or until heated through.

title: Rotel Beef
ingredients: 3 tablespoons canola oil | 2 lbs beef stew meat, cut into 1/2 in. cubes | 1 can rotel | 1 can tomatoes in puree | 1/4 cup yoghurt
instructions: Heat oil in large pot over medium high heat. Cook beef in oil for 10 minutes or until browned.

Random Ingredients: quinoa,green olive,red chili pepper flake,turmeric,adobo seasoning,pepperoni,chive
title: Spanish Style Quinoa and Pepperoni Salad
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa, rinsed and drained | 2 medium green olives, thinly sliced | 1/2 - 3/4 teaspoon pepperoni, minced ( or more to taste ) | 2 tablespoons chives, snipped | 1 -2 pinch hot red chili pepper flakes | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric | 1/2 teaspoon adobo seasoning
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the quinoa, olives, pepperoni, chives and hot pepper flakes. Mix spices together in a smaller bowl, and add to the bowl. Toss to combine. Serve cold.

title: Easy Tomato Sauce
ingredients: 2 cans tomato sauce | 1/2 teaspoon sea salt | 1 teaspoon vanilla
instructions: Put all ingredients into pan on medium heat. Stir it every once in awhile, you want to get the tomato sauce nice and thick to your taste. Bring just to boil and then simmer, stirring all the time. Enjoy.

title: Toasted Wheat Nuts
ingredients: 1/2 cup wheat germ | 1/2 cup rice vinegar
instructions: Put all the ingredients in a saucepan or wok and cook over low heat, stirring frequently until the mixture is well combined and dark. Remove from heat and let cool to room temperature, about 12 hours. Refrigerate leftovers.

title: Couscous With Peppered Chicken
ingredients: 1 tablespoon chicken bouillon, i use 1 pkg. instant recipe ready strips | 1 1/2 cups couscous
instructions: In skillet, add 1 teaspoon of chicken bouillon, then couscous. Cover skillet and cook on med heat for 5 minutes, until all the water has evaporated. Stir. Cover and let stand 2 minutes. Fluff with fork and serve.

title: Tahini and Cranberry Dressing - Wheat Free
ingredients: 2 cups quick cooking oats ( i use oatmeal ) | 1 cup dried cranberries | 1 red capsicum, finely diced | 1/2 cup onion powder | 1/3 cup tahini | 1/4 cup dried cranberries
instructions: To make the quick oats, put all the ingredients into a medium sized bowl, and mix well but don't over mix. Cover the bowl loosely and put in the fridge overnight if any.

title: Warm Mexican Cheese (From the Rio Grande Valley Restraunt)
ingredients: 1 lb part-skim mozzarella cheese, shredded | 1/2 lb smoked gouda cheese, shredded | 1 roma tomato, diced
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees. Combine the mozzarella, gouda, and tomato and blend thoroughly. Place mixture on a baking sheet and bake for 15 to 20 minutes, or until cheese is melted.

title: Brats in Blankets
ingredients: 2 bratwursts | 1 jar marinated artichokes, drained and rinsed
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Slice brats in half lengthwise, and lay out on a cutting board with flat side facing up. Place one artichoke half at a time on each piece of brat. Roll up jelly roll fashion, and slice each brat in half. Place on a rack in a heavy baking dish. Bake brats at 350 degrees f for 45 minutes. Remove brats to wire rack to cool.

title: Spanish Pork and Veggies #5FIX
ingredients: 1 lb ground pork loin | 1 lb parsnip, peeled and shredded | 1/4 cup fresh tomato puree ( or ketchup ) | 1 pinch saffron | 1 yellow bell pepper, seeded and cubed | 16 ounces fresh broccoli, cut into florettes
instructions: In a skillet, brown the pork, parsnips and tomato puree over medium heat. Add saffron. Simmer 2 minutes then add the bell pepper cubes. Simmer 15 to 20 minutes until vegetables are tender and pork is browned. Serve over hot fluffy white rice.

Random Ingredients: cooking oil,amaretto,cognac,butter,black mustard seed,jalapeno jack cheese,red chili powder,rice vinegar
title: Peruvian Grilled Cheese
ingredients: 1 lb montreal cracker montreal jalapeno jack cheese ( grilled cheese should be able to stick together. ) | 4 tablespoons clarified butter | 2 tablespoons rice vinegar | 1 pinch red chili powder | 1 teaspoon amaretto | 1 tablespoon black mustard seeds | 3 tablespoons cooking oil | 1 teaspoon cognac
instructions: Grill cheese on a hot grill. Spread out grilled cheese on a cool dish or on a baking pan lined with foil. In a bowl mix together all ingredients. Spread mixture over cheese on the grill. Place under preheated grill.

title: Carne Asada (Rump)
ingredients: 1 rump roast, 4 inches diameter, tied or 4 -6 inches long | 2 mangoes, ripe, peeled, pitted, and sliced | 2 tablespoons dry sherry ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven 325 degrees f. Remove netting from ends of roast and place in pie dish. Cut away excess fat from underside of meat, and rub with sherry to coat well. Wrap tightly in foil and roast for 2 1/2 hours, basting every 30 minutes. Remove meat from oven, turn heat to 325 degrees f, and continue roasting another hour. Remove foil and continue cooking for 1 1/2 hours or until meat thermometer reaches 145 degrees f. If desired, roast some mango slices on top of the meat for added decoration.

title: Tajine Ki Halwa  (Kielbasa Salad)
ingredients: 500 g waxy kielbasa ( a.k.a. halved ) | 150 ml yoghurt | 1 sprig cilantro leaves ( to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Cut the kielbasa into small cubes about the size of walnuts. Cut the yoghurt in half and mix it with the drained kielbasa cubes. Place in a serving bowl. Sprinkle on the chopped cilantro leaves if using.

Random Ingredients: apricot,oregano leaf,french bread,salt pepper,catsup,kaffir lime leaf
title: Catalan Spamies (spamies)
ingredients: 1 can apricots, cut into chunks | 10 kaffir lime leaves ( fresh from the can ) | 1/2 cup catsup | 1/3 cup french bread, crumbs | 1/2 teaspoon oregano leaves | salt and pepper
instructions: Open the can of apricots and scrape the meat from the top. Drain the liquid to get up the liquid. Do not reserve the liquid. Combine the soaked fruits and kaffir lime leaves in a saucepan and stir over low heat until mixed. Remove from the heat, add the catsup, bread crumbs, oregano and salt and pepper to taste. Mix well. Cool to room temperature. Form the mixture into little balls or small patties about 1½ inches in diameter. Put the patties on a tray lined with parchment paper. Bake at 450° for about 22 minutes, or until cooked through. Remove from the oven, and transfer to a platter. The meat can be chilled in your crockpot or on the stovetop for up to 2 hours. Garnish with a little chopped coriander or parsley and served with fried plantains and hot peppers or sauteed greens.

title: Cashew Nuts
ingredients: 2 cans condensed cream of mushroom soup | 3/4 cup cashew nuts
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Unwrap cashews. Place a baking sheet in the oven and lightly spray with cooking spray. Mix cashew nuts with cream of mushroom soup, taking care not to break cashews into smaller pieces. Spread in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Bake in preheated oven until browned and bubbly, about 40 minutes.

Random Ingredients: italian green bean,confectioner sugar,olive oil,nut,mandarin orange
title: Italian Green Beans
ingredients: 2 tablespoons olive oil | 1 package frozen italian cut green beans, thawed | 1 can mandarin oranges, drained | 1/4 cup chopped nuts | 1 tablespoon confectioners'sugar
instructions: Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. Cook and stir the green beans in the warm oil until tender, about 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: italian sausage,sparerib,sunflower oil,spaghetti,burgundy wine,coriander seed,beef chuck roast,chicken
title: Braised Beef Ragu
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sunflower oil | 3 lbs beef chuck roast | 2 pounds sweet italian sausage | 1 1/2 teaspoons coriander seeds | 2 1/2 lbs cured pork back ribs | 1/3 cup burgundy wine | 1 large chicken, jointed | 12 ounces spaghetti
instructions: Heat oil in a dutch oven over medium heat. Add beef, sausage, and coriander and brown evenly, about 10 minutes. Pour in wine and continue cooking until the wine has stopped. Add the chicken and cover pot. Reduce heat to low and braise meat, turning once, at least 2 hours, or until done. Remove chicken and place in a medium size bowl. Cover and keep warm. Strain the beef broth through cheesecloth if desired. Return broth to pot and add spaghetti. Cook over low heat for about 30 minutes or until the spaghetti is al dente. You could also make this a week ahead. To serve, place ragu on plate, top with beef broth, and serve with french fries and salad.

Random Ingredients: salt black pepper,kaffir lime leaf,sesame oil peanut,italian sausage,chocolate shaving,white vinegar,oyster sauce
title: Astragalus Chips (Breadsticks with Eggs)
ingredients: 2 pounds italian sausage | 3 tablespoons distilled white vinegar | 2 1/2 cups oyster sauce | 1 1/2 tablespoons sesame oil or 1 1/2 tablespoons peanut oil | salt and ground black pepper to taste | 1 package kaffir lime leaves | 1 1/2 teaspoons asian-style shavings
instructions: Place the italian sausage in a skillet over medium heat, and cook until evenly browned, and crumbly, about 10 minutes, breaking it up into crumbles as it cooks. Drain fat.

title: Indonesian Spicy Sweet Pastries
ingredients: 3 tablespoons coconut milk | 2 tablespoons tamarind paste | 3/4 lb phyllo pastry | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1/8 teaspoon ground mace
instructions: In a small bowl, mash tamarind extract into coconut milk. Layer 3 sheets of phyllo pastry on bottom of bowl, brushing it twice to prevent it from drying out. Cut phyllo sheets into 1 1/2 inch squares. Place a sheet of phyllo in the bowl of phyllo and spread it with oil. Pour in the coconut milk mixture. Sprinkle with ground mace to taste. Repeat the process by adding cayenne pepper and mace. The phyllo pastry sheets will keep refrigerated in the refrigerator for at least an hour or two before serving.

title: Cajun Style Refried Beans--refritos
ingredients: 1/2 cup oil | 1 teaspoon vegetable oil | 1/2 tablespoon instant yeast | 3 cans pinto beans, drained and rinsed | 2 teaspoons cayenne pepper
instructions: In a large baking dish, mix together the oil and yeast. Stir the pinto beans and cayenne pepper into the yeast mixture, and mix well with a spoon. Cover the dish, and let rest for about 15 minutes. Preheat the oven to 250 degrees f. Heat the vegetable oil in a skillet over medium high heat. Remove the cover from the dish and quickly stir the beans into the oil. Reduce heat to medium, and bake for 5 hours, stirring and checking the beans at halftime. After 5 hours, the beans will have a light brown color and smell like a lot of wet bean grease. Remove from the oven, and allow to cool for a few minutes before refrying. Store in an airtight container.

title: Tomato Vodka Gravy
ingredients: 3 -5 tomatoes | 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar | 2 teaspoons beef base or 2 teaspoons beef bouillon granules | 1/2 teaspoon vodka
instructions: Cut tomatoes in half and remove seeds and membrane. Place in a bowl and crush with a fork. Add bouillon and other ingredients. Toss well and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: grain rice,pineapple chunk,serrano pepper,tang orange crystal,chicken stock cube,bok choy
title: Spicy Rice and Bean Stew
ingredients: 1 cup long grain rice ( cooked ) | 15 -20 ounces chicken stock cubes | 2 cups pineapple chunks, drained | 1 tablespoon tang orange crystals | 2 small red peppers or 2 small yellow peppers, chopped | 2 -3 small bok choy, thinly sliced
instructions: Rinse rice in very hot water, and drain. Place rice in a large saucepan and add enough water to cover rice by 1/4 inch. Bring to a boil, place lid on saucepan and turn heat to medium low. Simmer for 20 minutes, covered. Add salt to taste. Dissolve chicken stock cubes in about 1/4 cup water in a small saucepan over low heat. Add orange crystals to chicken stock and bring to boil. Add remaining ingredients except the green beans, and simmer uncovered for 40 minutes or until rice is tender. Add green beans and cook a further 10 minutes. Serve stew on a bed of rice and top with more orange crystals.

Random Ingredients: maple syrup,pizza cheese,yellow mustard seed,fish sauce,shortcrust pastry,green pepper
title: Sweet and Sour Spam for One
ingredients: 100 g thin crust frozen shortcrust pastry | 1 -2 teaspoon maple syrup | 2 -3 teaspoons prepared yellow mustard seeds | 1 -2 green pepper, sliced, for the topping | 2 -3 tablespoons fish sauce, for the top | 100 g your favourite prepared pizza cheese, for topping
instructions: Preheat the oven to 150°c. Roll out the pastry thinly on a lightly floured work surface. Using a sharp knife, cut out a 12 circle. Place the pastry onto a greased or lightly floured baking tray or cookie sheet. Bake for 30 - 35 minutes, or until light golden. While the pastry is cooking, heat a dry wok over a medium heat. When hot, add the maple syrup, mustard seeds, and green pepper. Stir and cook for 30 seconds, then add the fish sauce and stir in until well mixed. Remove from the heat. Pour the sauce mixture over the pastry, spreading evenly. Sprinkle over the pizza cheese and bake for 2 - 3 minutes or until the cheese has melted and turned golden.

title: Grpa (Egyptian Water Chestnut Soup)
ingredients: 1 can water chestnuts | 1 small saffron
instructions: Heat up the saffron in a pot. When the water begins to boil add the saffron strands. You can add a pinch of salt. Once they begin to turn a little darker, remove from heat. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: peanut oil,red chili pepper,cardamom pod,fine breadcrumb,french,pepperoni,coriander
title: Peppers - Fried Rice
ingredients: 2 cups leftover cooked rice | 1 tablespoon fine dry breadcrumb | 1/4 cup grated dry french ( or parmesan ) | 12 pepperoni slices or 12 slices canned italian sausages, halved ( or to taste ) | peanut oil, for frying | 1/2 cup red chili pepper, seeded and thinly sliced | 2 -4 cardamom pods, lightly crushed
instructions: Set up the fried rice to serve, in a large bowl, add the rice, bread crumbs, french, pepperoni slices, oil, chili pepper and cardamom pods. Toss well to thoroughly coat the rice with oil. Serve hot.

title: Rosemary & Lime Chicken
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups vegetable broth | 1 teaspoon dried rosemary sprig | 1 lime, cut into eighths | 2 tablespoons active dry yeast | 8 3/4 lbs chicken wings, split at joint
instructions: Place broth, rosemary, lime halves and the yeast in large bowl and, using a wooden spoon, beat together with a wooden spoon, until yeast dissolves. Dip the chicken wings in the yeast mixture then place in a 5 lt deep baking pan. Cover and leave to prove in a warm place for 40 minutes. Preheat oven to 400°f. Remove wings from the bowl and discard yeast mixture. Place into the oven and braise for 20 minutes, or until chicken is cooked and browned and crusty and juices run. Toss wings a few times during braising. Serve with your favourite fresh garden herb.

Random Ingredients: red pepper flake,pasta,club soda,purpose flour,kidney bean
title: Pasta and Beans
ingredients: 1/2 cup all-purpose flour | 1/4 cup club soda | 1/4 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 3 cups drained canned kidney beans | 1 1/2 cups hot cooked pasta
instructions: Place flour, club soda, red pepper flakes, and beans in a 2 quart saucepan and stir over low heat until the flour forms a thin paste, about 5 minutes. Mix in pasta and heat through, about 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: tabasco sauce,pinto bean,watermelon,liquid smoke,herb,garlic granule,tuna,flour tortilla
title: Veggie Tuna Burritos
ingredients: 3 cups pinto beans | 3 cups watermelon | 13 fluid ounces tuna, drained | 1/4 teaspoon garlic granules | 2 teaspoons smoked herbs, such as dill | 2 fluid ounces tabasco sauce | 2 1/2 teaspoons liquid smoke | 20 1/2-inch flour tortillas
instructions: Place pinto beans in medium saucepan and cover with 2 cups cold water.

title: A Slightly Flammable Spiced Sausages
ingredients: 8 -20 small sausages or 8 -20 small sweet sausages | 500 g veal ( the good meat for this ) or 500 g pork sausage ( the good meat for this )
instructions: Cut the meat into bite sized chunks. Boil the sausage or pork sausage for about one minute and drain them. You can either slice it up finely or use a mandolin to shred it into fine bits. Bake on a hot grill turning them once and allow to dry on the hob for a few minutes, until they are a bit crusty. They will still have a slight texture. Serve with plain boiled rice and tomato purée. Note, the ratio of meat to sausages is your choice.

title: Prawns With Swiss Miss Chocolate Peanut Butter
ingredients: 2 cans jumbo shrimp, drained ( you may use larger shrimp if desired ) | 1 box jumbo shrimp, shelled and deveined | 3 -4 pieces pepperoni, cut into thin slices ( or less ) | 1 -2 cup crumbled italian breadcrumbs ( to garnish ) | 2 -3 cups fresh blueberries ( to garnish ) | 1/2 cup good-quality unsweetened unsweetened cocoa
instructions: Shell and devein the prawns if you like, leaving the tail intact. In a large mixing bowl, add the drained prawns and, with your fingers, mix into the cracker crumbs and italian bread crumbs. Place in the fridge for 30 minutes so that the noodles can absorb the flavours of the cracker crumbs. Heat the oven to 450 degrees fahrenheit. Remove everything that has not been prepped and set them aside. Stir the prawn mixture into the cracker crumbs and divide evenly among four ovenproof dishes, spreading evenly around the sides of each dish. Sprinkle with mozzarella cheese, top with a few blueberries and bake for 15 minutes or until the cheese melts and the prawns are tender.

Random Ingredients: rice wine,carrot,applesauce,plum tomato,pineapple juice,yellow bell pepper,bosc pear
title: Pears & Pear Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 12 cups prepared rice wine vinegar salad dressing | 1/3 cup apricot-pineapple juice | 1 1/2 cups applesauce | 1 large yellow bell pepper, chopped | 2 large carrots, shredded | 1 large bosc pear, cored, seeded, and cut into wedges | 1 can plums in heavy syrup, drained
instructions: Combine rice wine vinegar, apricot juice, 1 cup of the applesauce, the bell pepper, carrots and pear in a large pot over medium heat. Bring to a boil and simmer 3 minutes or until vegetables are tender. Remove from heat and stir in remaining apple sauce. Divide mixture among lettuce leaves and serve.

title: Thai Key Lime Sauce
ingredients: 4 -5 key limes, juice of | 2 stalks lemongrass or 1 tablespoon lemongrass, chopped
instructions: Dip lime slices in lemon or lime juice and transfer to a bowl. Add other ingredients and mix well to combine well. Let sit in the refrigerator for 1 hour prior to serving as it will discolor when chilling. Note, preparation time does not include marinating time.

title: Mexican Baked Corn
ingredients: 1 package active dry yeast, packages | 1/4 cup sour cream | 2 tablespoons cornstarch | 3 1/4 cups unbleached all-purpose flour | romaine lettuce leaves, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: In a large bowl, dissolve yeast in sour cream. Stir in cornstarch, then add flour. Beat until dough forms a ball. Turn dough out onto a floured surface and knead until smooth and elastic, about 8 minutes, adding additional flour as needed. Form into a ball, place in a large greased bowl, turn over so top is greased, and let rise until doubled, about 1 hour. Punch down dough and turn to grease top. Turn dough onto a lightly floured surface and knead until smooth and elastic, about 8 minutes. Divide dough into 8 equal portions and place each on a lightly floured surface. Cover with a damp cloth and let rise until doubled about 45 minutes. Meanwhile, preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Line a large baking sheet with parchment paper. Divide dough into 18 equal parts. Roll each portion into a ball, place on prepared baking sheet, and gently flatten each portion into a 1/8 inch thick circle. Brush each circle with a thin film of egg wash. Cover with another damp cloth and let rise until doubled, 20 to 30 minutes. After dough has risen, bake in preheated oven until browned, about 20 to 25 minutes. Transfer to a cutting board and cut crosswise into 8 slices. Serve warm, garnished with romano cheese.

Random Ingredients: brown bean sauce,artichoke heart,malt vinegar,aburage,kidney bean,cucumber,flour,carambola
title: Pretend Dip
ingredients: 1 can kidney beans | 1 can cannellini beans | 1 -2 ounce carambola, sliced into rounds | 1 ounce albert's pancetta, slices diced | 1 jar marinated artichoke hearts, drained ( optional ) | 1 -2 teaspoon malt vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon brown bean sauce | assorted dippers ( such as mushroom sticks, ham, celery, and onion )
instructions: Drain beans and reserve liquid. Chop carambola and artichoke hearts. If using the artichokes, peel, and chop finely. Place all ingredients into a blender. Cover and blend until smooth. Place in containers and refrigerate. Serve with warm bread or crackers.

Random Ingredients: serrano chili,green capsicum,spinach,chili paste,sesame oil,cotija cheese,cream mushroom soup,white onion
title: Spinach and Chile Pasta
ingredients: 400 g spinach | 1 medium white onion | 4 tablespoons sesame oil | 2 hot serrano chili | 1 green capsicum | 2 cans cream of mushroom soup | 3 tablespoons grated cotija cheese | 1 tablespoon chili paste
instructions: Wash the spinach, remove stems and cut it into small pieces. Heat sesame oil in a wok and fry the onions for 3 minutes until light brown. Add chilli, capsicum, stir to mix. Add spinach and mushroom soup and stir to combine. When it comes to a boil, add cheese, let boil away, 1 - 2 minutes. Serve over pasta, top with minced cilantro if you like.

Random Ingredients: bread crumb,flat bread,cider vinegar,phyllo pastry,thyme,pesto sauce,mandarin orange,orange zest
title: Creamy Pesto French Toast (21 Day Wonder Diet: Day 13 )
ingredients: 8 slices flat bread, 3/4-inch to 1-inch thick | 1 package phyllo pastry sheets, thawed | 1 can mandarin oranges in syrup | 1 tablespoon reduced-fat pesto sauce | 2 teaspoons orange zest, grated | 1/4 cup low fat bread crumbs | 1 teaspoon dried thyme | 1/2 - 3/4 cup cider vinegar
instructions: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.

Random Ingredients: ranch bean,coconut oil,espresso powder,corn kernel,red chile
title: Spicy Brazilian Spiced Bean Dip
ingredients: 1/2 cup corn kernel | 5 tablespoons coconut oil | 2 tablespoons ground dried red chile | 2 cans ranch-style beans, rinsed and drained | 5 tablespoons espresso powder
instructions: Place the corn kernel and coconut oil in the bowl of a blender and blend it on high, gradually adding the ground red chili peppers. Once smooth, transfer it into a small bowl and keep stirring, until you have a thick puree. Add the beans to the corn mixture along with the almond and espresso powder, blending the mixture on high until almost all the beans have been broken down. Refrigerate in an ice cream cone, covered, for at least 20 minutes and up to 3 days.

Random Ingredients: italian sausage spaghetti sauce,cheese,tomato paste,half,vanilla essence,guacamole,broccoli,margarine
title: Sausage and Broccoli Pizza Casserole
ingredients: 1 bag frozen cooked broccoli - thawed and finely chopped ( this can vary depending on how large or small pieces you have on hand ) | 1 jar of good quality italian sausages with spaghetti sauce | 1 jar tomato paste | 1 1/2 cups low fat and creamy half-and-half | 1/2 cup margarine | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence | 4 cups grated cheese | guacamole
instructions: In a fairly large frying pan, melt margarine, add sausage and brown it. Add tomato paste and half and half, and simmer for 10 - 30 minutes. Remove pan from heat and stir in vanilla. Pour sauce mixture over broccoli and broccoli and mix. Transfer to a 2 lb casserole dish and spread cheese on top. Bake in a pre heated oven in a pre covered oven for 20 minutes, turn broccoli and bake for 10 more minutes, or until cheese is bubbly and golden. Take out of oven and top with guacamole.

title: Red Enchilada Turkey.
ingredients: 3/4 lb extra lean ground turkey breast, not too lean | 2 tablespoons red enchilada sauce | 2 lime wedges
instructions: Heat up some enchilada sauce. Add diced turkey, and let simmer until the liquid comes out of the turkey. About 5 minutes. Turn into a medium sized casserole dish, and sprinkle the bottom with some crushed red beans, black bean, or black beans of choice. Squeeze some lime on top, and top with a drizzle of red enchilada sauce. Bake at 375 degrees for 15 - 20 minutes, or just until it gets nice and browned.

title: Cajun Chipped Cream
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cajun seasoning | 1 large red chile - deseeded and finely chopped | 2 cups heavy whipping cream
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together the cajun seasoning and red chile. Place cream in a saucepan over medium heat until it just starts to warm, but not boiling. Reduce heat to low. Stir the cream into the dry seasoning mixture. Simmer until the cream is thick and creamy, about 20 minutes. Allow cream to cool to room temperature.

Random Ingredients: fettuccine,garlic clove,almond extract,tarragon,egg yolk,curry powder,lettuce leaf
title: Almond Spiced Fettuccine (Celinena Hazan)
ingredients: 2 packages fettuccine | 1 pinch salt | 1 tablespoon curry powder | 1 container fresh tarragon | 1 garlic clove, diced | 1/4 teaspoon almond extract | 6 large egg yolks | 1/4 cup slivered almonds
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. In medium bowl, combine the salt, curry powder, tarragon, garlic and almond extract. Stir in the egg yolks. Drain the pasta and return to the pot. Whisk the egg mixture into the hot pan. Cover and cook over medium heat for 5 minutes, until the pasta is al dente. If it is too thick, thin with a little of the water. Turn the heat down and stir in the nuts. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: curry leaf,salsa,almond extract,rice noodle,cream chicken soup
title: Quick and Easy Indian Rice Noodle Casserole
ingredients: 1 package dried rice noodles | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1 jar mild salsa | 1 teaspoon curry leaves | 1 teaspoon almond extract
