instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Arrange the rice noodles in an 8 inch square baking dish, and cover with aluminum foil. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil, and cook noodles for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

title: Sour Cream and Tomato Dip
ingredients: 1 can plum tomatoes | 3 tablespoons sweetened agave nectar | 2 tablespoons sweetened cream | 1 tablespoon chili paste
instructions: Drain all the excess liquid out of the can of tomatoes, chop the tomatoes roughly and combine with the rest of the ingredients in a bowl. Stir well and serve with crusty bread.

Random Ingredients: parsnip,fennel seed,chili oil,beef broth,red snapper fillet
title: Roasted Red Snapper
ingredients: 4 large red snapper fillets | 1 tablespoon fennel seed | 2 teaspoons chili oil | 10 fluid ounces beef broth | 2 whole parsnips
instructions: Preheat oven to 275 degrees f. Coat fish evenly with oil. Place in an oven proof dish. Add stock. Top with parsnips. Place under broiler and cook until parsnips are tender and fish flakes easily with a fork.

Random Ingredients: coconut,chili sauce,cream mushroom soup,pork loin,flat leaf italian parsley,iceberg lettuce,canola margarine
title: Pork Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 1 pork loin, trimmed of visible fat | 2 cans condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1/2 cup sweet chili sauce | 1/4 cup shredded coconut, toasted | 1/4 cup chopped flat leaf italian parsley | 1 teaspoon canola margarine, divided | 3 cups shredded iceberg lettuce
instructions: Cut a 1/3 inch thick slice from the end of the loin to allow slicing and flaring during braising, and slice it crosswise into 1/3 inch wide strips. Lay strips between 2 sheets of wax paper or plastic wrap. Using the tines of a fork, poke slices repeatedly until desired lengths are reached line a large baking sheet with plastic wrap. Place loin strips in a single layer on the plastic wrap, and refrigerate for 20 minutes or up to 2 hours. In a medium bowl, mix soup, chili sauce, coconut, and parsley. Melt 1/4 cup of the margarine over medium heat in a large skillet. Quickly place lettuce leaves in skillet. Cook until lettuce begins to soften and pork slices are hot, 1 to 2 minutes. Place a few slices of lettuce on each lettuce leaf, roll them up, and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: liquid honey,brown mustard seed,sultana raisin,kitchen bouquet,rose water,breadcrumb,greek yogurt,tomato sauce
title: Tomato Sultana Honey Mince
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg tomatoes sauce | 375 ml greek yogurt, plain | 250 ml dry breadcrumbs | 4 teaspoons kitchen bouquet | 3/4 cup mixed sultana raisin | 1/2 tablespoon brown mustard seeds | 1/2 tablespoon greek yogurt | 1/4 teaspoon liquid honey | 1/4 teaspoon sweet grain mustard seeds | 1/4 teaspoon rose water
instructions: Place tomato sauce, greek yogurt, breadcrumbs, puragar and mustard in a pot and mix well. Cook on very low heat for 15 - 20 minutes, stirring frequently until thick and creamy. Add honey. Add rosewater and turn up heat to medium and cook for 5 - 10 minutes until bubbly, stirring frequently. Remove from heat. Spoon mixture into sterilised jars and seal. Leave for 1 week.

Random Ingredients: serrano pepper,red cabbage,dill,ra el hanout spice mix
title: Moroccan-Spiced Red Cabbage (Or Green) Cabbage(Vegetables)
ingredients: 1 cup shredded red cabbage ( with rinsed and dried vegetables or combination ) | 1/3 cup seedless ra el hanout spice mix ( or homemade spice mix ) | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh dill ( or 1 tsp. dried dill ) | 1 -2 teaspoon minced serrano pepper ( or green chili peppers ) ( optional )
instructions: Put cabbage/vegetables in a medium bowl. Stir in the chile, remaning to mix with cabbage, spices, and salt to taste. Let sit for at least an hour to really let flavors meld. Great at room temperature.

title: Spanish Bread Appetizers
ingredients: 3 cups shredded french bread | 1 1/2 cups chunky salsa | 1 green bell pepper, chopped | 1/4 cup chopped fresh parsley | oil for deep frying
instructions: Cut bread diagonally into 16 slices, and cut each slice into 16 triangles.

title: Pinto Bean and Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 lb dry pinto beans ( or other white bean of your choice ) | 1 lb small mushroom
instructions: Wash the beans in a colander, removing the bean skins from the mushroom stems and collecting all of them in a bowl, or leave whole. Drain them well, and dump into a medium size nonreactive saucepan, reserving all the soaking liquid. Add the reserved cooking liquid, and mix thoroughly. Cut the large mushroom stems and tops into large pieces, and rinse the beans thoroughly in cold water. Add these to the pot, along with the mushroom pieces. Stir the beans and the mushroom pieces together to combine. Cover and let sit over low heat to let the flavors develop for 20 minutes. If the liquid in the pot becomes too thin, simmer uncovered for 15 minutes, to allow some of the moisture to reduce. Serve warm.

title: Cantaloupe and Turmeric-Crusted Beef Brisket
ingredients: 2 tablespoons turmeric | 2 lbs beef brisket | 3 cups cantaloupe | 3 tablespoons thyme ( fresh )
instructions: Preheat oven to 325ºf. Rub 2 tablespoons turmeric onto each side of the brisket. Place brisket in a 3 quart roasting pan and roast, uncovered, in middle of oven until meat thermometer registers 140ºf for rare, about 2 hours. Transfer meat to a cutting board and let rest, covered, 15 minutes. Combine melon and thyme. Slice brisket slices crosswise. Sprinkle brisket with remaining tablespoon turmeric and pour liquid into crockpot. Cook on high setting until hot, about 15 minutes. Cook brisket brisket on high setting until hot, about 5 minutes. Remove brisket from crockpot using a slotted spoon.

Random Ingredients: currant,kosher salt,panko bread crumb,white breadcrumb,onion powder,beef flavor ramen noodle,basil pesto
title: Crunchy Panko Topped Ramen Rolls
ingredients: 1/4 - 1/2 cup panko bread crumbs | 2 tablespoons dried basil pesto | 1 tablespoon dried onion powder | 1 tablespoon dried red basil or 1 tablespoon fresh basil, minced | 2 teaspoons kosher salt | 1/4 teaspoon white breadcrumbs | 1 lb lean ground beef round | 1 can refrigerated beef-flavor ramen noodles, drained
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees and lightly coat a large baking sheet with cooking spray. In a medium bowl, stir together the panko crumbs and pesto. Stir in the dried onion powder, dried red basil, salt and bread crumbs. Stir in the ground round. Turn the meat into a lightly floured bowl that has been lightly pressed. Shape into 2 thick logs about 1 1/2 inches long and place on the prepared baking sheet. Repeat with the other logs. Cover and refrigerate while making the remaining rolls. Using a sharp paring knife, cut each log crosswise into 1/4 wide slices. Repeat with remaining meat slices, adding a little more panko if necessary, to moisten both sides. Make a slit on one side of each biscuit and pull one end through to open the hole. Fill each loaf with 1/3 a teaspoon of meat, about 1 1/2 tablespoons per biscuit. Use a knife to carefully pinch the meat so that it is totally closed. Place the filled rolls side by side on the baking sheet. Bake just until heated through, 15 - 20 minutes, flipping once. Note, this step may be difficult, as most of the time it is very easy and quick because of the panko/onion powder, pesto, dried basil filling, and salt. Time to cut will depend on the shape of the meat.

title: Peanut Butter Crumpets
ingredients: 100 g salt pork, very finely diced | 2 - 3 tablespoons light peanut butter | 100 g cherry tomatoes or 100 g grape tomatoes, halved
instructions: Place the salt pork in a saucepan and add a few tablespoons of water stirring to break up any lumps. Cover and cook until the pork has browned slightly, about 20 to 25 minutes. Cool and then crush fine using a fork. Add the peanut butter and gently mix into the pork and cook for a couple more minutes, until smooth. Transfer the mixture to a bowl and shape into small cakes. Chill until set.

title: Cabbage With Shallots and Dijon(Swedish Republic)
ingredients: 1 head cabbage ( about 1.5 kg ) or 1 head babbari ( about 1.5 kg ) | 1/3 cup tamari or 1/3 cup soy sauce | 2 tablespoons dijon mustard or 2 tablespoons coarse sea salt | 1 tablespoon fresh chervil or 1 tablespoon fresh chives
instructions: Core cabbage and cut into slices approximately 2 1/2 wide by 2 long and 3/4 thick. Bring large pot of water to a simmer. Put cabbage in a large bowl. Add 5 tbsp tamari, 1/3 cup vinegar and 2 tbsp mustard. Toss to mix. Place cabbage in the simmering water, cover and simmer on low until tender. Add 1 tbsp each of chervil and chives to cabbage, stir, garnish with remaining chervil and serve with noodles.

title: Duck Rolls With Cranberry Stuffing
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef | 4 tablespoons dry sherry or 4 tablespoons water | 4 ounces cranberries | 1 ounce italian style breadcrumbs | 1 small hard apple ( optional ) or 1 small vidalia onion, grated ( optional ) | 1/2 cup cashews, chopped coarsely | 2 tablespoons sherry or 2 tablespoons water, if needed
instructions: Mix together ground beef, sherry or water and cranberries. Form into roll about 2 inches long. Stuff rolls lightly with meat mixture. Roll in bread crumbs. Set in a baking pan and bake at 400 degrees f for about 18 to 20 minutes or until meat is cooked through. If using the hard apple, sprinkle with a little brown sugar now, too. Drain on paper towels. If using the vidalia onion very, very well. Remove roll from pan. Sprinkle with chopped cashews and sherry. Serve with your favorite gravy or cream sauce.

Random Ingredients: white bread flour,raisin,mccormick albondigas al chipotle,butter,orange peel,chipotle chile adobo
title: Chipotle Raisin-Butter Loaf
ingredients: 2 cups white bread flour | 1 1/2 tablespoons mccormick's montreal brand steak seasoning blend | 1 teaspoon dried chipotle chiles in adobo | 1 cup raisins | 4 tablespoons butter | 1 tablespoon grated orange peel
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f, and lightly grease, 10x2x1 pan with butter. Place the flour, salt, pepper, chipotle and garlic powder in a large food processor. Add the raisins. Pulse until a ball forms. Transfer the dough to a floured surface and knead until it forms a smooth ball, adding oil if required. Shape the dough into a 12 inch long loaf. Cut a cross in the center of the loaf and make a 1 1/2 inch slit down the length of the loaf. Place loaf on a baking sheet, seam side down. Place baking sheet on middle rack of oven and bake 40 - 45 minutes until bread is golden& tester inserted in center comes out clean. Remove from oven and let cool for 5 minutes. Using a sharp knife, score loaves crosswise into 1/2 inch thick slices that are about 12 x 1 inches. Place slices on rack and let cool completely. Meanwhile, cook chipotle butter until it starts foaming and becomes difficult to mix with other ingredients. Remove garlic powder from chipotle and combine with butter, then stir in the orange peel. Spread chipotle butter over sliced loaf and let cool completely before serving.

title: Ragu Beef & Parmesan
ingredients: 12 ounces lean ground beef or 12 ounces extra lean ground beef | 1 1/2 cups ragu fully-flavored pasta sauce | 1/2 cup freshly grated parmesan cheese
instructions: Cook ground beef until it begins to brown. Remove from heat. Add 1 cup ragu sauce and parmesan cheese. Drain ground beef and mix well. Return to heat and cook, stirring frequently, for 3 - 5 minutes. Serve.

title: Scottish Sage Beef Stuffing
ingredients: 6 -8 ounces lean stewing beef | 1 cup fresh white mushroom, chopped | 2 teaspoons dried sage leaves | 6 -8 tea bags
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f in a heavy casserole dish, cook beef over high heat, stirring well to break up chunks with a wooden spoon, until browned and cooked through. Stir in any accumulated juices. Add mushrooms and sage leaves. Pour through a fine mesh or sieve and discard the solids. Stir to mix well. Stuff into clean, airtight tin foil lined lids, making sure the edges of foil do not touch each other. Place in oven and bake approximately 1 hour or until stuffing is heated through. Do not allow stuffing to over cook during this time.

title: Smoked Trout and Blueberry Pasta
ingredients: 1 smoked trout fillet | 2 cups cooked small shell pasta | 1 cup canned light coconut milk | 1/2 cup fresh blueberries | 1/4 cup fresh grapes, halved
instructions: Cut the smoked trout into 2 pieces, removing the bones and skin as necessary. Place the trout pieces on a plate and cover with plastic wrap. Let rest for 15 minutes, then slice thinly lengthwise. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add pasta and cook according to package directions. Drain, and return to pot, and toss in coconut milk and blueberries, along with the smoked fish. Season with salt and pepper to taste.

Random Ingredients: kiwi fruit,pork belly,chicken bouillon granule,wheat pastry flour,vanilla bean,chicken bouillon powder,ramen noodle
title: Pork Leg Leg Wraps
ingredients: 1/2 smoked pork belly, bones removed | 2 1/4 ounces chicken bouillon granules, dissolved in | 6 tablespoons whole wheat pastry flour | 3 ounces chicken bouillon powder | 2 ounces instant ramen noodles, broken into small pieces | 1/4 teaspoon vanilla bean | 1 1/2 kiwi fruits | 1 1/4 teaspoons instant chicken bouillon granules, dissolved in | 1 1/4 teaspoons chicken bouillon powder
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a bowl. Chill overnight. Slice kiwis in half and discard ends. Remove excess fat from leg, discard. Tear apart leg meat, leaving only a few pieces. Place leg meat in a plastic zipper bag and add marinade. Add kiwi pieces. Toss to coat with marinade. Refrigerate for 30 minutes. Drain off any excess liquid then saute for 15 to 30 minutes on each side in oil for medium or until dark brown on all sides. Remove from skillet and wrap loosely on waxed paper. Remove casings for serving. Store leftover leg meat in refrigerator for up to 6 days. Slice legs crosswise into slices. Serve on papertowels or other traditional soup for dipping, or with dipping sauce as an accompaniment.

title: Sizzling Egg Salad
ingredients: 1 head iceberg lettuce | 3 hard-cooked eggs | 1 can diced green chile peppers | 2 teaspoons capers, drained
instructions: Trim the hard and sharp ends off the lettuce and coarsely tear it up with your hands. Using a large spoon, remove and discard the coarsely chopped lettuce, cutting the heads into wedges. In a medium bowl, mash the hard cooked eggs and green chile peppers. Add half of the egg mixture and stir to coat the salad. Sprinkle with capers and serve at once.

Random Ingredients: orange zest,bread crumb,beef sirloin steak,seasoning mix,malt vinegar
title: Orange Beef Steak Sandwiches
ingredients: 4 beef top sirloin steaks, about 1 inch thick | 1/4 cup fresh bread crumbs | 2 tablespoons orange zest | 1 tablespoon malt vinegar | 1 envelope dry seasoning mix
instructions: Preheat grill to medium high or preheat an outdoor grill to high heat. Rub the meat with 1/4 cup bread crumbs, and sprinkle with orange zest, vinegar, and seasoning mix. Let the steaks cook on the grill, 3 to 5 minutes per side. Serve with the reserved bread crumbs.

Random Ingredients: feta cheese,mung bean sprout,whiskey,green chilies,dashi,lasagna noodle
title: Hogga
ingredients: 5 cups dashi | 2 green chilies | 32 lasagna noodles | 1 1/2 cups mung bean sprouts | 8 tablespoons butter | 1 1/2 cups feta cheese ( crumbled )
instructions: Bring dashi to boiling in a pan and simmer for 10 minutes. Strain and set aside. Wash bean sprouts, place in a bowl and pour boiling liquid over and let soften about 10 minutes. Set aside. Cook lasagna noodles according to instructions on package. While noodles are in simmering, melt butter in a pan and stir in shredded cheese. Place noodles on a large plate. Place 2 ladels full of noodles and cheese mixture on top and roll up. Place back into pan and simmer with the side of your left hand. If the noodles seem dry and crispy, turn the noodles out onto a paper towel and roll up slightly. Place into your refrigerator to firm until time to serve. To serve remove the roll and cut into pieces to serve. Enjoy.

title: Grilled Orange Pepper-Stuffed Peppers
ingredients: 1 orange bell pepper, halved | 4 fresh thyme sprigs | 4 fresh basil leaves
instructions: Preheat the grill. Remove the stem of the orange bell pepper, from the membrane and discard. Pierce the orange bell pepper with a knife 2 to 3 times. Place in a paper bag for two to three minutes to loosen the skins and loosen them. Remove the peel from the pepper with a small spoon or other knife, and remove all the seeds and white membrane. Fill the cavity of the pepper with the pepper flesh, trimming away any tough white pith. In a large non stick skillet, arrange the orange pepper halves over high heat until they are well coated. Cook one minute or so until softened and lightly marked. Remove the pepper halves from the pan. Arrange on the platter. Brush the orange pepper halves with some of the pan juices and sprinkle with thyme. Serve hot or warm.

title: Easy and Simple Cherry Soup
ingredients: 10 maraschino cherries, with pits | 1 tablespoon chicken bouillon granules
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a saucepan and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer 15 minutes. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: rice noodle,chunky salsa,cotija cheese,cabbage leaf,green chilies,extra virgin olive oil,hoisin sauce
title: Vegetarian Cabbage Rolls
ingredients: 7 -8 large cabbage leaves | 1 1/2 cups chunky salsa ( we recommend trader joe's ) | 1 tablespoon hoisin sauce | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 1 small green chilies or 1 small anaheim chili, thinly sliced ( optional ) | 1/4 cup cotija cheese, crumbled ( we recommend feta ) | 3 cups hot cooked rice noodles
instructions: Fill a large pot with water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. While the water comes to a boil, cut off and carefully remove the top 2 layers of cabbage leaves with kitchen shears, cutting away any very tough portions of the head and leaf. Slice the leaves crosswise into 2 long slivers. Meanwhile, combine the salsa with the hoisin and 1/4 tsp salt in a small bowl & set aside. Heat a large non stick frying pan over medium high heat. When the water comes to a boil, add the cabbage slivers and cook, covered, stirring, for about 2 minutes or until the leaves soften and are just limp enough to remove from the water. Remove the cabbage slivers with a slotted spoon and set aside. When the water comes back to a boil, add the noodles and cook, stirring often, until the noodles are tender, about 3 - 5 minutes or so. Drain the noodles well in a colander and allow to cool slightly. Remove all of the cooked cabbage leaves and cut them into 1 lengths. Add the cabbage to the salsa mixture, along with the olives. Stir to combine. Warm the remaining 1 1/2 tsp salt in the pan over medium heat for a minute or two. Add the crumbled cheese and stir well until the cheese is melted. Add the noodles and stir continuously until everything is warmed through. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: red curry paste,phyllo pastry,pork tenderloin,ricotta cheese,chicken breast strip,orange marmalade
title: Thai Pork and Sweet Red Curry Phyllo
ingredients: 1/4 pound pork tenderloin, thinnly sliced | 1/4 cup fresh orange marmalade | 1 tablespoon orange curry paste | 8 phyllo pastry sheets | 1/2 cup ricotta cheese, fat-free ( may add more ) | 2 boneless skinless chicken breast strips, cooked
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Place pork slices onto an a piece of parchment paper or a waxed paper and drizzle with marmalade. Toss to coat evenly on both sides. Place in the refrigerator while you prepare the phyllo dough. In a small bowl, beat together orange chile paste with 1 tsp water. Spread about half the orange sauce evenly over pork slices and refrigerate. Brush phyllo sheets with remaining orange sauce and stack on top of each other. Working from the center to the edges, roll up and cut into small strips, about 3” long. Repeat until phyllo is used up. Place one strip of phyllo on work surface and place 1/4 of the cooked pork on it. Top with 1/4 of the sweet red curry and roll up like a jelly roll, jellyroll style. Place on a lightly greased baking sheet. Repeat until pork is used up, ending with phyllo. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate until ready to use. When ready to bake, remove plastic wrap and cut phyllo strips into 4 squares. Place 1 cup ricotta at the bottom of each pastry square. Add 1/2 cup of chicken and 1 or 2 tsp water to filling.

title: Vegetable & Dijon (Low Fat)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons toasted sesame seeds | 1 1/4 cups chopped fresh apricots | 2 cups chopped eggplants ( i like the yellow ones! ) | 2 tablespoons toasted pineapples ( optional ) | 1/4 cup water | 1/4 cup low-fat mango chutney | 1 pinch vanilla sugar | 1/4 cup chopped fresh radish
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine the sesame and apricots and stir together. Set aside. In a medium saute pan over medium heat, add about ½ cup water and bring to a boil. Add mango chutney, cook until it liquefies. Remove from heat and add in the rest of the ingredients and stir. Serve warm, or allow to cool then cover and refrigerate.

Random Ingredients: flat leaf parsley,dark brown sugar,pork,panko breadcrumb,dijon mustard
title: Tonkatsu ( Japanese Meatballs) With Mustard Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb lean ground pork | 1/4 cup flat leaf parsley, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon panko breadcrumbs | 1/3 cup dark brown sugar | 1/2 teaspoon dijon mustard
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine the pork, parsley and panko.

Random Ingredients: herb,fish stock,mandarin orange,yellow onion,poblano pepper,sauce,szechuan peppercorn
title: Mongolian Fish Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup yellow onion | 1 cup minced poblano pepper | 1/2 cup sweet sauce | 2 tablespoons fish stock | 1 tablespoon of minced herbs | 1/4 teaspoon whole szechuan peppercorns | 1 can mandarin oranges
instructions: Chop the onion, poblano pepper, sweet sauce, fish stock to approximately 1/2 inch dice, and stir fry in a hot pot until the vegetables are lightly browned and soft. Add the herbs and peppercorns and reduce heat so as to simmer a bit. Add the mandarin oranges and simmer for an additional 5 minutes. Adjust hot temperature so as not to scorch the peppercorns. Serve as a side dish with meats, or eat as an oriental condiment to stir fried meats like chicken, tofu or other vegetables. Mongolian condiment, combine 1 teaspoon of dry crushed szechuan peppercorns with 1 tablespoon of cold water to make a fresh, strong paste. Sprinkle over any fresh vegetables before use. Store refrigerated for up to 6 months.

Random Ingredients: brussels sprout,red pepper,hot green chili pepper,white flour
title: Ethiopian Shredded Brussels Sprouts for 2
ingredients: 4 cups white flour | 20 -22 cups brussels sprouts, cleaned & trimmed | 2 -6 fresh hot green chili peppers, seeds removed, crushed | 1 medium red pepper, seeded & cut into 2-inch strips
instructions: Cut the brussels sprouts or leave them whole. Slice the fresh chili pepper in 2 to 3 pieces, place in a non reactive bowl & set aside. Slice the white pepper & red pepper pieces into 2 to 3 pieces, set aside. In a bowl combine the 2 cups of flour with 2/3 cup of water or enough to make a soft pliable paste. Stir the paste into the boiling water in a wok. Add brussels sprouts or continue to cook, undisturbed for 3 - 4 minutes, until they are tender. Add chile & red pepper strips, taste for seasoning, & serve.

title: Mexican Corn, Corn and Prawns for 2
ingredients: 2 teaspoons masa harina | 1 1/4 lbs corn or 1 1/4 lbs butterflied corn, shucked, leaving a little corn kernels showing | 1 package frozen cut corn, thawed | 18 large raw peeled prawns or 18 large raw prawns, defrosted | 8 ounces chunky peanut butter | 3 ounces pimentos or 3 ounces diced jalapeno chiles, from a jar, such as jalapenos, jalapenos, pickled jalapenos may be substituted for chiles
instructions: Combine masa harina in a shallow dish or plastic bag stir corn or seafood into masa harina mixture and let sit for 30 minutes. Rinse shrimp well and pat dry with paper towels. Place prawns in a medium size bowl and toss with 1/2 a teaspoon of the peanut butter until coated, about 30 seconds. Spoon corn or shrimp on the corn and prawns, toss to coat evenly with peanut butter. Divide between two plates, top with the remaining peanut butter and chilies.

Random Ingredients: cranberry,apple cider vinegar,red food coloring,oatmeal,baby spinach leaf,spinach leaf
title: Kiwi Sushi
ingredients: 1/4 cup dried cranberries | 1 1/2 cups water | 1 1/2 teaspoons apple cider vinegar | 1 package baby spinach, washed and chopped | 1/2 cup chopped fresh spinach leaves | 2 drops red food coloring | 1/2 cup old fashioned oatmeal, crushed
instructions: In a small bowl, combine cranberries and water.

Random Ingredients: cream chicken soup,chicken,cranberry,pork roast,hot red chili pepper,tart apple,mace,tomato
title: Crockpot  Irish Pork Roast
ingredients: 6 lbs roast ( boneless with bone left whole or boneless ) | 4 cans cream of chicken soup ( campbell's irish ) | 1 can tomatoes ( undrained, 2 medium ) | 1/2 cup cranberries | 1/4 cup hot red chili pepper ( minced, i prefer jalapeno! ) | 1 medium tart apple, peeled, chopped | 1 1/2 teaspoons mace ( or to taste ) | 1 large roasting bag, with rinsed, dried bread crumbs
instructions: If using boneless pork roast, cut into 4 serving pieces. Combine cream of chicken soup, undrained tomatoes, cranberries, red chiles, apple and mace.

Random Ingredients: meat,coriander seed,chipotle chile pepper,self rising flour,fennel,beef brisket,spicy pork sausage
title: Tex Mex Beef Brisket
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds beef brisket | 1 package spicy smoked pork sausage | 12 ounces shreddeddies-pack frozen cooked meat | 3/4 cup self-rising flour | 1/2 teaspoon ground coriander seed | 1/2 teaspoon ground fennel | 1/4 teaspoon ground chipotle chile pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place brisket in a roasting pan. Cook in the preheated oven until very tender, about 1 hour. Remove from oven and drain off excess fat. Cut brisket in half and pull strings around the meat so it will fit snugly. Place brisket and sausage in a saucepan and fill with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil and simmer until meat is tender, about 15 minutes. Drain and discard the excess fat. Let cool. Heat an oven to 400 degrees f. Blend flour, coriander, fennel and chipotle in a small bowl. Pour a little flour mixture into the saucepan with meat mixture, tossing to combine. Cook in the hot oven until browned and bubbly, about 10 minutes. Serve with the meat.

title: Fried Meat Balls: Indian Style Apples and Fenugreek
ingredients: 4 large apples, such as macoun, granny smith, and cortland digestives | 2 cups chickpea flour | 4 ounces cream cheese, softened | 1/2 teaspoon dried fenugreek, crushed | 1 1/2 lbs minced veal
instructions: Peel apples.

Random Ingredients: tahini,mint leaf,horseradish,chicken bouillon,wheat flour,maple syrup,italian turkey sausage,romaine lettuce heart
title: Tahini Vinaigrette Turkey Sausage Salad
ingredients: 3 1/4 tablespoons tahini | 1 tablespoon maple syrup | 1 teaspoon prepared horseradish | 1 teaspoon instant chicken bouillon | 1/2 teaspoon dried italian turkey sausage | 2 romaine lettuce hearts, torn | 3 tablespoons torn fresh mint leaves | 1 tablespoon whole wheat flour
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together the tahini, maple syrup, horseradish and bouillon. Set aside. Meanwhile, prepare meat and lettuce dressing by placing salad greens in a serving bowl, then spoon dressing over top.

title: Homemade Chocolate
ingredients: 500 g dark chocolate | 1 teaspoon vanilla
instructions: Grease the inside of your baking tin with a little oil and line the base with parchment paper. Heat up the oven to 150°c, 350°f, gas mark 6 or 170°c in a medium heatproof bowl placed in a microwave. Warm the chocolate with the vanilla essence for 5 minutes so as not to loose any of the alcohol in the bowl and whisk it into the chocolate. Using a large metal spoon pour the chocolate into the prepared baking tin, spreading evenly. Place your baking tin on top of the preheated oven and bake for 20 - 25 minutes. When the chocolate has become to hard to the touch and it's all melted and set, remove it from the oven and allow to sit for 5 minutes then turn out onto a cooling plate and cut into small squares, removing the parchment paper. Store in an airtight container.

title: Pork Chops Italian
ingredients: 4 pork chops, about 1 1/2 inches in diameter | 3 cups italian seasoned breadcrumbs
instructions: Place the pork chops in a mixing bowl. Pour a little water into the bowl, but don't allow them to touch. Sprinkle the bread crumbs in a second bowl. Mix well. Dip each chop first in the two bowls, then coat each chop with bread crumbs, coating each chop completely. Heat a large, lightly greased skillet. Working in batches, add the chops to the skillet. Cook over medium heat, turning once, until browned on each side and no longer pink inside, about 10 minutes total.

title: Garlicky Grilled Scallops
ingredients: 6 ounces dry fettuccine | 6 ounces thickly sliced scallops | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom | 6 whole wheat tortillas
instructions: Prepare grill or broiler. Mix cardamom with fettucine according to package directions. Lightly toast both sides of tortillas. Place about 2 tsp of scallop mixture in center of tortilla. Top the scallops with a second tortilla. Heat grilling pan over medium heat. Place tortillas on grill. Cook, turning once, until golden, 2 - 3 minutes per side. Turn and cook until golden on all sides. Serve with sauce.

Random Ingredients: confectioner sugar,spice,yellow mustard,irish cream,white sugar,green enchilada sauce,kale,vanilla essence
title: Irish Kale and Irish Cream Salsa
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh kale | 1 cup white sugar | 1 bottle green enchilada sauce ( i use old el paso mild ) | 2 cups yellow mustard | 1/4 cup mixed spice | 1 cup confectioners'sugar | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence | 1/2 cup irish cream, room temperature
instructions: Wash and rinse the kale thoroughly. Slice the leaves as thin as possible. You should end up with kale with 3 - 4 cups of leaves from the bunch. Chop kale coarsely. Combine all other ingredients and mix well. Cover and chill. Stir well before serving.

Random Ingredients: yellow bell pepper,great northern bean,golden syrup,cherry tomato,green chili pepper
title: Tasty White Beans and Peppers
ingredients: 1 lb great northern bean | 3 green chili peppers, sliced | 1/2 yellow bell pepper, sliced in thin strips | 10 cherry tomatoes or 10 grape tomatoes, cut in wedges | 3 tablespoons golden syrup | extra green chili pepper, sliced ( optional )
instructions: Cook beans, peas and tomatoes in plenty of boiling water along with green peppers until just soft but not watery. Drain, serve warm with extra green chili if desired and extra crushed red pepper. Note, this makes a huge batch because it uses no beans and only veggies.

Random Ingredients: iceberg lettuce,spinach,bok choy,graham cracker crumb,bouillon,herb stuffing mix
title: St. Paddy's Day Special Puddings. (No Eggs)
ingredients: 3/4 cup instant bouillon | 2 bags frozen chopped spinach, thawed and drained | 4 heads bok choy, cleaned and thickly sliced crosswise on diagonal | 1/2 lb frozen cheese-filled goat's stuffing mix | 1/2 cup graham cracker crumbs ( i use ritz cracker crumbs ) | 1/4 cup fresh herb flavored stuffing mix
instructions: Toss all ingredients together except stuffing and bread crumbs in large serving bowl until well combined. Spread mixture into 12 muffin cups or 6 individual soup plates, or small crocks with lid. Top each with 2 to 3 tablespoons of the goat cheese stuffing or your choice of filling, topping with crumbs.

Random Ingredients: kaffir lime leaf,fish sauce,pork shoulder,coconut milk,pork loin,cremini mushroom
title: Grilled Pork Loin Vietnamese Style
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs pork loin | 12 cremini mushrooms | 2 tablespoons fish sauce | 1 tablespoon kaffir lime leaf, finely chopped | 2 cups coconut milk, with | sliced kaffir lime leaf
instructions: Trim the excess fat from the pork and slice into thin 1 in strips about 1 in long. Remove the ends of the mushrooms and slice into 1/4 thick slices. Slice the stems and leaves of the mushrooms crosswise, being careful not to tear them apart too much, removing the stems from at least 1/4 of the mushrooms. In a mortar place the sliced pork with one half of the mint leaves then add the other half of the mint leaves. Sprinkle with a few grindings of salt. Add 1 - 2 tablespoons of the fish sauce. Add 3/4 cup of coconut milk with a little bit of coconut milk if desired with a touch of sugar or brown sugar. Mix well before heating up the final coconut milk in a deep skillet with water to 1/2 inch over high heat. Add more coconut milk as needed, about 1 heaping tablespoon at a time. Mix thoroughly after each addition. When the coconut milk steams a bit again to warm up add the slices of pork. If more liquid is needed, just stir it inches do not remove the pan from the heat.

title: Tofu and Lemony Chocolate Crust
ingredients: 300 g firm tofu, drained if its a little runny | 2 egg yolks | 1 lemon, juice and zest of | 200 -300 g dark chocolate, with a good amount grated, with a good amount of grated zest
instructions: Preheat oven for 180 degrees celsius. Roll out the soft tofu to make a thick, even rectangle. Cover each side with a few tablespoons of grated chocolate, make sure the edges are sealed well or place on a greased baking tray and sprinkle over some grated chocolate. Make sure the middle is clean and grease with egg or milk as much as required. Bake at 180c for about 15 - 20 minutes, depending on the thickness of tofu. Turn out onto a plate and sprinkle over some grated chocolate before serving.

title: Rice and Ricotta in a Bottle (For Gifts)
ingredients: 15 ounces ricotta ( drained from block in refrigerator ) | 15 ounces rice vinegar
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large jar, close tightly and shake well until well mixed. Place in refrigerator at least two days before using.

title: Baked Beans Sprouts and Parmigiano-Reggiano Cheese in a Glass
ingredients: 1 gallon fresh bean sprouts | 1 cup freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1 teaspoon vanilla
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil or parchment paper. Rinse and drain the sprouts. Place the sprouts in a large bowl and sprinkle with the cheese. Stir in the vanilla. Pour into the baking sheet. Bake for 35 to 40 minutes, until golden and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: cream chicken soup,bacon,thyme sprig,taco seasoning mix,lobster,lemon grass
title: Lobster Thermidor
ingredients: 2 cans cream of chicken soup | 2 packages taco seasoning mix | 1 lemon grass, finely chopped | 1 lemon grass, finely chopped | 3 -4 slices bacon, chopped | 1 1/2 lbs fresh lobsters, cooked ( i prefer the fresh ones )
instructions: Place soup, thyme, and 5 bay leaves in a large pot and heat. Do not boil, stir soup occasionally until soup thickens. Add green and white parts of lemon grass. Cook for 2 minutes. Place cooked lobster and cooked bacon on top of soup mixture. Simmer for 15 minutes.

title: An Apricot Potato Salad.
ingredients: 5 red potatoes | 12 dried apricots
instructions: Boil the red potatoes in salted water until tender. Drain, and allow to cool until easily handled. Peel off the skin. Halve the white flesh. Tear the red potatoes into bite size pieces, sprinkle with salt, and toss with one of the apricots. Serve chilled.

title: Bun-Bread (Sweet Bread Appetizer)
ingredients: 2 puns bread ( i recommend chatelaine or your favorite bread ) | 1 cup catsup, sweet or sour cream
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees. Cut each bread loaf in half lengthwise. Place the split bread halves between plastic wrap and pound with a rolling pin or your fingers until the pieces resemble bread crumbs. Place a spoonful of catsup onto each half. Roll the bread into a roll about 1/4 thick. Repeat with the rest of the bread. Place bread roll on a baking sheet and bake 25 minutes or until golden brown and bubbly. Serve immediately.

title: Cindy's Pea & Pies
ingredients: 150 g frozen peas | 150 g frozen mushrooms | 150 g red beans | 1 can condensed 98 % fat free cream of mushroom soup | 250 g parmesan cheese
instructions: Cook peas, mushrooms, & red beans until tender & creamy. Drain the pasta's. Mix the soup with the peas and the parmesean cheese until smooth. Put the mixture in a pie dish or pie dish. Bake at 180°c for about 20 minutes.

title: Super Easy N' Easy Spaghetti.
ingredients: 10 cups of dry spaghetti, broken in lengths of 4 inches. | 15 cups corn, cooked | 32 fluid ounces white vinegar | 15 fluid ounces white wine vinegar
instructions: Rinse and clean your hot dry and place the spaghetti in a large pot containing boiling water and a lid. Cook 10 minutes, stirring frequently. Immediately drain the spaghetti and put it back to the pot. Add the corn, white wine and garlic soda stir well and return to the stove. Cook for 12 minutes, stirring constantly. Place a dish towel over the pot so it does not drain the liquid. Keep the pot on the burner and heat the spaghetti for 2 or 3 minutes as the liquid mixes with the noodles. Don't let it dry out. Enjoy.

title: Cheesy Kohlrabi
ingredients: 2 cups glutinous rice | 1 cup white wine | 3/4 cup chili sauce | 4 ounces velveeta cheese | 1 medium tomato, chopped | 1 bunch kale, chopped
instructions: Cook rice and set aside to cool for about 10 minutes. Pour wine into a medium size saute pan. Once cool, pour in chili sauce over medium heat. Stir well. Place velveeta cheese over a plate, and set aside. When cheese has melted and started to turn slightly crispy, add in chopped tomatoes and heat through. Add in rice to mixture. Add in chilli sauce to coat rice. Toss and heat through for a few minutes.

title: Sauerkraut with Kielbasa and Banana
ingredients: 1 teaspoon butter or margarine | 1 slice kielbasa | 2 cups cabbage, chopped | 4 cups fresh broccoli, chopped | 1 small banana, sliced | 1/4 cup pecan halves, toasted | 1/8 teaspoon cardamom pod, crushed
instructions: Cook kielbasa in nonstick 12 inch skillet over medium heat, turning occasionally, until browned and crumbly.

title: Spiced Fajitas
ingredients: 4 flour tortillas ( or other small soft tortillas ) | 3 tablespoons creamy peanut butter | 1 tablespoon sesame-seed flavored oyster sauce | 1/4 teaspoon ground cinnamon
instructions: Cut each 1 1/2 inch thick fajita into 1 inch pieces. Mix peanut butter, oyster sauce, and cinnamon in a large bowl. Spoon peanut butter mixture down center of each fajita, and roll up. Serve immediately, or wrap in waxed paper and freeze. Thaw before serving. Cook's notes, you can easily make these ahead and reheat the fajitas until ready to serve. Cook's notes, you can also prepare these ahead and reheat them the same day you make them, adding the sauce an hour or more before serving.

title: Cactus (Fish in the shell )
ingredients: 1 lb poblano chile, sliced lenghtwise | 1 lb orzo pasta, cooked al dente | 1 shallot ( optional )
instructions: Cut poblano chiles in half or into thirds.

title: Sultanas Breakfast Sausages
ingredients: 4 sausages | 1/2 green bell pepper, seeded and finely chopped
instructions: Remove giblets from sausages and discard. Slice sausages lengthways and crossways into slices. Place sausages onto a greased plate. Sprinkle with pepper. Serve.

title: Baked French Bread
ingredients: 3 pita bread ( whole pita ), split lengthwise | 1 bottle of pre pita breads
instructions: Pre heat oven to 350 degrees f. Open up your first piece of bread and lay it out flat on a cutting board. Cut the entire pita into quarters. Use a serrated knife to slash the top and bottom, then separate the sections. Place slices flat in a large baking dish. Spread pre warmed bread with pre heated pita breads. Bake for 25 minutes.

title: Pork Chops in White Wine
ingredients: 4 pork chops | 2 tablespoons dried italian parsley | 3 teaspoons bicarbonate of soda | 1/2 cup white wine | 1 cup teabags | 2 tablespoons rose's sweet tea
instructions: Heat oven to 200c/250°f. Trim excess fat from chops and sprinkle with dried parsley. Dissolve bicarb soda in the wine. Baste pork chops with wine mixture then place on greased oven trays and roast for 20 minutes, basting every 2 minutes. While meat bakes tie the loose ends of the tea bags and tear them, place on baking tray and bake for 1 1/2 hours. Add rose's tea into pan juices and increase heat to 180c/375f/gas remove the chops from the oven, transfer the pan juices to a pot and bring to a boil. Cover pan tightly and return to oven for 10 more minutes. Remove the pork chops, keep warm. Place the pan juices over a low heat and boil gently for 5 minutes. Serve the pork chops on warmed plates, pour sauce around the chops and drizzle with more of the sauce.

Random Ingredients: fine breadcrumb,corn kernel,broccoli,taco seasoning mix,apple cider,jalapeno pepper,spaghetti sauce,horseradish
title: Baked Spaghetti With Corn Relish
ingredients: 1/2 lb spaghetti sauce ( low sodium ) | 1 jalapeno pepper, diced | 1/2 cup fine crumbs ( from a tube or jar ) | 1 teaspoon horseradish ( grated, divided ) | 1/2 cup corn kernel | 1/2 cup broccoli, chopped | 1/4 cup fine breadcrumbs | 4 1/2 teaspoons taco seasoning mix
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Spread the spaghetti sauce in a 9x13 baking dish. Combine the jalapeno, corn, broccoli, and 1/4 cup of the bread crumbs in a food processor. Add the taco spice mix and process. Add corn mixture to the pasta sauce and stir. Spoon the mixture into the baking dish and sprinkle with remaining 1/4 cup bread crumbs. Bake, uncovered, for 15 - 20 minutes until bubbly. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: curry powder,butter bean,lemon pepper,flat leaf parsley
title: Lemon Spiced Butter Beans (Lebanese - Style)
ingredients: 1 lb butter beans | 1/2 bunch whole flat leaf parsley | 3 tablespoons curry powder | 1 tablespoon lemon pepper or 1 tablespoon red pepper flakes
instructions: Place beans in a large pot with boiling water to cover. Boil for 2 minutes. Drain, run under cold water and cool under running water. Peel again and cut beans into halves or thirds. Meanwhile, in a small skillet, melt butter with curry powder. Sauté for 1 - 2 minutes or until softened. Add lemon pepper. Toss with beans. Makes about 1 1/2 cups.

title: Sara's Ziti With Pineapples
ingredients: 1 lb ziti pasta | 1 can crushed pineapple with juice | 1 -2 dried red chili, dried
instructions: Boil the pasta until al dente. Drain pasta. While draining the pasta, prepare the pineapple with pineapple and red chili in microwave safe bowl. Microwave 30 seconds or until hot but not mushy. Squeeze into pasta bowl. Rinse and dry chili. Add to pasta bowl. Toss to mix ingredients. Serve with grated parmesan cheese.

Random Ingredients: peanut butter,rice,green chilies,wheat tortilla,dark soy sauce
title: Rice and Peanut Butter Softies With Green Chilies
ingredients: 8 whole wheat tortillas | 8 ounces roasted peanut butter | 4 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 1 tablespoon rice, plus extra for serving | 1 small green chilies, finely chopped ( i add extra, if like me ) ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c / fan 160c / 350f / gas cut the tortillas into 8 wedges, then place them on baking paper lined oven trays. Whiz together the peanut butter until creamy, then add the dark soy and rice and process briefly while still hot. Tip onto the hot griddle in a single layer and scatter over the green chilies. Grill the tortillas for 2 - 3 mins each side.

title: Macaroni, Mango & Sweet Peppercorn Crumble
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups macaroni cheese ( the tiny ones ) | 4 -6 teaspoons sunflower oil | 250 g sweet mangoes, peeled, halved, deseeded and cut into 12 wedges or 125 g equivalent size pieces | 1 tablespoon sunflower oil | 500 g french bread, loaf cut into 2 cm cubes | 1 cup shredded italian macaroni cheese | 1/2 cup grand marnier or 1/2 cup liqueur, of your choice | 2 teaspoons seeded and crushed peppercorns or 2 teaspoons finely chopped fresh rosemary
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c degrees f. Mix the cheese together to make a smooth paste, adding a little more oil if necessary. Add the macaroni and toss to combine. Transfer macaroni mixture to a baking dish, then top with remaining mixture. Combine the remaining ingredients in a bowl and pour over the macaroni. Season with salt and pepper then cover the dish and bake for 30 minutes or until topping is golden brown. Remove from the oven and leave until cool, then remove from foil. Serve immediately.

title: Spicy Kale Salad
ingredients: 2 lbs kale, washed, rinsed, dried and coarsely shredded | 1 cup colby cheese, shredded | 2 cardamom pods
instructions: In a large bowl, toss together the kale, colby cheese and cardamom pods. Season to taste with salt.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack pepper cheese,ketchup,arborio rice,cayenne pepper,nutmeg
title: Cheesy Rice (Pantry)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups arborio rice or 1 1/2 cups rice cereal | 1/2 cup ketchup | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1/4 teaspoon nutmeg | 1/2 - 1 cup monterey jack pepper cheese, shredded
instructions: Heat butter in saucepan, add rice. When all ingredients are coated, spread onto greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350, 8 minutes or until cereal is firm. Watch carefully and stir gently when toasted. Remove from oven and sprinkle cheese over cereal.

Random Ingredients: cream celery soup,chicken thigh,guacamole,zucchini,habanero pepper,taco seasoning mix
title: Gourmet Crock Pot Chicken
ingredients: 4 -6 chicken thighs, skin on, bone in | 1 can condensed cream of celery soup | 1 1/3 cups grated zucchini ( i use cut one zucchini lengthwise in half and remove the stone ) | 4 tablespoons taco seasoning mix | 1 -2 habanero pepper, chopped ( more if you like it hotter ) | guacamole
instructions: Place chicken thighs in crock pot on low for 8 hours. Discard bone in chicken thighs and discard chicken parts. Shred chicken into bite sized pieces and return to crock pot. Add all remaining ingredients to the crock pot and mix well. Cover and cook on low heat for at least 3 hours. Serve with a mexican, texas style tostada and lots of sour cream for a quick dip/topping mixture.

title: Perfect Basic Rice for One (21 Day Wonder Diet: Day 1 )
ingredients: 1 cup basmati rice | 3 cups white rice ( or long-grain white rice ) | 3 3/4 7 3/4 cups black-flavored coffee or 3 3/4 cups water, warmed, boiling | 2 small ladyfingers
instructions: Cook basmati rice according to package directions using 3 cups of water or rice. Rinse a little bit if needed and place rice on a large, flat baking tray or cookie sheet. Heat a large frying pan on high. Using the back of a fork or your fingers, spread the warm coffee or water very slowly over the rice. Dip the ladyfingers in the warm coffee or water. Place half at a time into 1 - 2 portions with a touch of the rice, and spread to make them look like ladyfingers. Repeat for the next layer, using a total of 4 ladyfingers, soaking all the ladyfingers in the hot coffee or water. When you're done, place finished dish on a cookie sheet, and place in the freezer for 4 - 10 hours to set. Serve.

title: Kidney Bean Casserole
ingredients: 2 cans kidney beans ( drained or rinsed ) | 2/3 cup heavy whipping cream ( no subsitutions or artificial sweetener ) | 1/4 cup milk | 1 dash chili powder | 1 tablespoon cider ( optional )
instructions: Turn oven on to 350f degrees. In a medium size casserole dish, mix beans, cream, milk, chili powder and cider. Pour into pan. Cover casserole. Bake 45 - 55 minutes until bubbly and heated through. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: double cream,malt vinegar,bell pepper,allspice,bean,almond extract,basmati rice
title: Burnt Bean Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons malt vinegar | 8 ounces mixed beans, drained, rinsed | 1 teaspoon malt extract | 1/2 teaspoon allspice | 1 1/3 cups fresh basilmati rice | 2 -3 tablespoons double cream ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons chopped roasted salted almonds, toasted ( optional )
instructions: Put the vinegar, beans and spices in a large salad bowl. Add the rice and toss until the rice is coated so that all of the grains have turned red. Add the cream, if using. Spoon the rice salad onto plates and sprinkle the almonds over and serve immediately.

title: Cheese-Free Mexi-Beef Dip
ingredients: 1 lb 80 % lean ground beef | 1/3 cup nutritional yeast flakes | 1/2 cup mexican blend cheese, shredded | 1 tablespoon cider vinegar
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit. Brown ground beef, drain. Add yeast flakes, cheese, and vinegar. Let sit for 5 minutes or more. Serve warm with tortilla chips.

Random Ingredients: taco seasoning mix,radish,celery,plain flour,cannellini bean,oil,red bell pepper
title: Quick Salad Beans - Crockpot
ingredients: 1 tablespoon oil | 1 can cannellini beans, undrained | 1/4 red bell pepper, diced | 1 tablespoon dried shredded dried swiss ranch celery | 1 tablespoon taco seasoning mix | 10 radishes, sliced | 1 1/2 ounces plain flour or 1 1/2 ounces cornflour, mixed with 1 1/4 cup water
instructions: Add oil to bottom and sides of crockpot. Mix all other ingredients together except flour mixture and cornflour. Add flour mixture to crockpot. Stir to mix all ingredients. Sprinkle flour on top, stirring to blend into mixture. Cover and cook on high 4 - 5 hours or on low 10 - 12 hours.

title: California Guacamole
ingredients: 1 beef brisket | 1 can sliced button mushrooms | 1 avocado - peeled, pitted and sliced | 2 pounds shaved beef brisket
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Place the beef brisket in a large roasting pan. Cover the brisket with plastic wrap and place in the oven to marinate. Cook until meat is very tender, about 2 hours. When meat can be easily pulled easily with a fork, place the roast, mushrooms, and avocado in a large serving bowl. Heat the vegetable mixture to boiling, and pour over the brisket. Place brisket into a roasting pan and cover with aluminum foil. Bake in the preheated oven until heated through and the stuffing is hot, about 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: pecan,red curry paste,tomato,saffron thread,cream chicken soup,sesame oil,egg,apricot jam
title: Apricot Curry Cheesecake
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons saffron threads | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup, undiluted | 1/4 cup sour cream or 1/4 cup plain yogurt | 1 teaspoon red curry paste | 1 ripe tomatoes, peeled, seeded, minced | 1/2 cup chopped pecans | 1 tablespoon sesame oil
instructions: Mix saffron with soup, sour cream, curry paste, and tomato. Transfer mixture to a 9 inch springform pan. Spread mixture evenly over the surface and sprinkle with pecans. Bake at 350°f for 40 - 50 minutes or until bubbly. Cool. Remove sides of pan. Heat sesame oil in a small nonstick skillet over medium heat. Brown pecans in oil about 1 minute. Place on a plate lined with paper towels until cool. Cut into thin strips.

Random Ingredients: beef brisket,grand marnier,thyme leaf,pork shoulder,cider vinegar,mozzarella cheese,graham cracker crumb,yeast
title: Cheeseburger Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dry yeast | 1 lb lean ground beef brisket | 1/2 lb lean ground pork shoulder | 1/2 cup graham cracker crumbs | 2 tablespoons cider vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme leaves | 9 tablespoons grand marnier or 9 tablespoons other hot dry-hot pepper sauce | 12 slices mozzarella cheese ( see photos )
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 1 cup warm water. In medium bowl, combine beef, pork, graham cracker crumbs, vinegar, thyme, and hot pepper. Mix well. In 5 quart, ovenproof skillet, lightly oil surface of meat mixture. Spread half meat mixture in center of each croissant. Sprinkle each with 1 slice mozzarella cheese. Roll up jellyroll fashion and pinch edges together. Arrange on baking sheets. Cover tightly and refrigerate overnight. Bake at 375° until meat and cheese are thoroughly cooked and bubbly.

title: Harpquest's Chili Paste I
ingredients: 1 cup ground chile pepper | 2 1/2 tablespoons chili powder, or more to taste | 3 fluid ounces dry milk powder | 1 tablespoon cornstarch
instructions: Place chile pepper, chili powder, and water in a saucepan, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer until most of the liquid has been adsorbed, 15 to 20 minutes. Blend in milk powder and continue cooking 1 more minute.

title: Campfire French Dip
ingredients: 20 ounces cream of mushroom soup | 3/4 ounce instant tea | 1 minced garlic clove
instructions: In bowl mix soup, instant tea and minced garlic. Chill and serve with sour cream.

title: Tomato-Ginger skewers or sesame skewers
ingredients: 14 medium tomatoes, quartered | 8 skewers | 2 tablespoons ginger, minced
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil and spray with cooking spray. Arrange tomatoes in a single layer on foil and sprinkle with ginger. Bake in preheated oven until tomatoes are tender and beginning to turn brown, 20 minutes. Remove from the oven and cool for 15 minutes. Serve immediately, turning the skewers occasionally.

title: Mexican Vermicelli (Chef Julianne)
ingredients: 1 cup vanilla-flavored soymilk ( or 1 part almond milk for a thicker texture ) | 3 tablespoons instant coffee ( sub espresso if you have it ) | 3 poblano chiles, sliced | 8 ounces dried vermicelli, broken up | 3 cups cherries or 3 cups mixed fresh fruit
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f and lightly spray an 8x4 baking dish with nonstick cooking spray. Whisk together the soy milk, coffee and the poblano chiles in a saucepan in a circular motion until the mixture is fully blended. Add the vermicelli and stir until it coats an entire surface. Pour the mixture into the dish. Stir in the remaining ingredients, breaking up the vermicelli as it wilts. Bake for 1 hour or until thoroughly heated. Serve hot.

title: Pesto and Pimento Spread
ingredients: 1 jar pimientos | 1/2 cup pesto
instructions: Put pimentos into food processor or blender, and process until all ingredients are chopped. Add pesto, and process until all ingredients are mixed well, and spread on bread or rolls to spread as desired.

title: Dilly & Olive Hummus
ingredients: 1 can navy beans ( can also use great northern beans ) | 1/2 lb black olives, pitted and sliced | 1/4 cup fresh dill, chopped | 1 -2 pinch cayenne ( to taste )
instructions: Drain kidney beans and rinse. Add black olives and dill. Add cayenne if using. Chill and serve. Variation. Substitute dried chick peas or rice. Add finely chopped fresh spinach or tomatoes for the garnish. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: extra sharp cheddar cheese,chicken tenderloin,buttermilk,iceberg lettuce,bacon
title: Poultry Grilled Chicken Tenders
ingredients: 16 chicken tenderloins, 4 to 4 1-inch thick | 8 slices bacon, rind removed and evenly | 16 leaves iceberg lettuce | 2 cups shredded extra-sharp cheddar cheese ( about 4 ounces ) | 2 cups buttermilk
instructions: Preheat the grill to low. Place the chicken tenders on the grill rack about 4 inches from the broiler and cook until easily inserted with a knife, 3 to 5 minutes. Turn and cook until golden brown on both sides, about 4 minutes. Place the bacon and lettuce on a baking sheet and loosely cover loosely with plastic wrap. Allow the bacon to warm in the oven until it is soft, about 10 minutes. Spread each tenderloins with equal amounts of the crumbled bacon and cheese, turning the tenderloins to lightly coat each one lightly. Set the tenderloins on the baking sheet and cook the tenderloins until heated through, about 3 minutes. To serve, place each tenderloin on a lettuce leaf and top with equal amounts of the buttermilk.

Random Ingredients: ricotta cheese,poundcake,ice cube,coffee powder,vanilla pudding,poblano chile,peach,tortilla chip
title: Peach and Tortilla Tiramisu
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups fresh peaches, peeled | 8 ounces fat-free ricotta cheese | 1 1/2 teaspoons instant vanilla pudding | 2 tablespoons strong coffee powder | ice cube | 1/2 cup peaches, thinly sliced | 2 ounces thin-cut fat-free tortilla chips | 1 poblano chile, sliced and deseeded | tortilla chips, for serving
instructions: Combine peaches, ricotta, and vanilla in a food processor and blend until smooth. Add the coffee and pulse a couple times until smooth. Add small ice cubes. Pulse until mixture is smooth. Spread 1/2 the filling mixture in the bottom of a 9” springform pan. Layer 3 peach slices and 3 tortilla chips on top of the filling mixture. Spread remaining filling mixture over the tortillas. Top with remaining tortilla chips. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 8 hours or overnight. Slice into 8 slices.

title: Tuna Vegetable Salad
ingredients: 2 cans tuna in water, drained ( solid white, solid white ) | 1/2 cup vegetable juice ( v8 vegetable juice cocktail can be used ) | 1 medium tomatoes sauce ( v8, tomato sauce can be used, v.i.e.p., etc. ) | 2 teaspoons cornstarch | 1/2 teaspoon aniseed | 2 -3 large lettuce leaves ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons vanilla bean ( optional ) | 1 small tomatoes, finely diced ( optional )
instructions: In a small bowl, combine tuna with tomato sauce and cornstarch and mix well into the tuna.

title: Grilled Kebabs
ingredients: 1 bunch very small fresh kirt steak | 1 garlic clove
instructions: Trim all excess external fat from ketsch steak. Cut ketsch steak into 4 sections, lengthwise. Using your palms, press the garlic clove on the surface of each piece of meat. Place meat on grill over medium high heat, and cook for 4 - 5 minutes on each side, or until a thermometer reads 160 degrees f. Allow to rest for 5 - 10 minutes before cutting to serve.

title: Bacon Maple Pea Soup (Ngow Num
ingredients: 1 -2 slice bacon, diced | 1 can beef broth or ( 12 ounce ) can beef consomme | 1 package frozen peas | 1 -2 fresh curry leaf or 1 -2 dill sprig, chopped
instructions: Place bacon in frying pan on medium heat. When crispy, remove bacon to paper towels to drain grease. Return frying pan to burner. Bring broth to boil, add peas. Add curry leaves. Reduce heat to low. Simmer for 20 minutes.

title: Chocolate Gravy Mix
ingredients: 3 tablespoons saffron | 6 ounces milk chocolate, finely chopped | 2 fresh red chilies or 2 medium dried red chilies, deseeded and finely chopped
instructions: Combine all ingredients and store in an airtight glass container.

title: Boiled Sardines With Lemon or Sumacchio for One
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs fresh sardines | 2 slices white breadcrumbs | 1 grated lemon | 4 hard-boiled eggs | 1/4 cup lemon or 1/4 cup white sugar | 4 leaves fresh mint leaves | 1/2 cup white flour | 1 tablespoon dried oregano
instructions: Wash and cut the sardines in half lengthwise, then cut them in half lengthwise again. Rinse them and pat dry with paper towels. Place breadcrumbs in a shallow bowl. Dip fish pieces into the crumbs to coat them. Add the lemon rind and set aside. Mix eggs, lemon juice, sugar, mint leaves and flour. Stuff the fish with the egg mixture leaving about 1 cm of flesh on each side. Bring some water to a boil. Turn off the heat and cook the fish in the boiling water for about 10 minutes until cooked through. While the fish is cooking, sauté the sardines in boiling salted water with the lemon rind. As soon as the sardines are cooked, add the sardines and boil for a further 2 minutes. Serve the rice with the sardines and lemon.

Random Ingredients: broccoli floret,fish sauce,roast,hot dog,mango chutney,pepper sauce,cooking oil,stewing beef
title: Vietnamese Dogs Delight on a Bun
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef, sliced thinly | 3 tablespoons cooking oil | 2 teaspoons hot pepper sauce | 1 bunch broccoli floret, chopped | 2 tablespoons fish sauce | 1 1/2 cups mango chutney, chopped | 6 hot dogs | 6 slices beef diagonally cut on the diagonal
instructions: In skillet brown meat in oil over medium heat add hot pepper sauce. Stir fry for a few minutes add vegetables, fish sauce and chutney. Simmer for 5 minutes serve on the side and eat with hot rice.

title: Chinese Cabbage and Squash Bread Pudding
ingredients: 1 lb french bread | 1 lb squash or 1 lb zucchini | 1 large jalapeno chile | 1/2 cup loosely packed fresh parsley | 1 lb chinese cabbage, roughly shredded or shredded
instructions: Slice bread diagonally into 1/2 cubes. Slice squash or zucchini diagonally into quarter and half pieces. Slice jalapeno into thin rings. Remove seeds of whole chili pods and discard. Place all remaining ingredients in a large pot and bring to a boil. Cover and cook over med low heat for 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Cover and let sit for 10 minutes to soften slightly. Turn out and cut into cubes. Serve warm.

title: Meatball Casserole with Feta
ingredients: 1 pound ground beef chuck | 1 package frozen baby peas | 1 package frozen precooked meatballs, thawed | 1 1/2 cups crumbled feta cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a large bowl, mix ground chuck, peas, and meatballs. Transfer mixture to a baking dish that is filled halfway with oil. Bake in preheated oven 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: cooking spray,ice cream,madeira wine,italian sausage,salmon fillet
title: Elegant Salmon With Madeira Sauce
ingredients: 16 ounces fish fillets, sliced into thin strips | 3 cups ice cream | 1/4 lb sweet italian sausage, sliced into matchsticks | 1/4 cup madeira wine | cooking spray
instructions: Add fish to skillet and fry over high heat, stirring until both sides are browned, about 5 minutes. Spread each slice of fish with about 3/4 cup of the madeira sauce. Cover and cook over medium heat for 3 minutes, then turn and brown the other side. Transfer salmon into a pre heated platter. Continue to cook until sauce is reduced, about 3 minutes. Heat the remaining prepared sauce over medium heat until steaming and thickened, about 10 minutes. Serve with salmon.

title: Spanish Peppers
ingredients: 4 green bell peppers, cut into strips | 3 1/2 cups self-rising flour, or as needed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Arrange the green bell peppers in a single layer on the baking sheet. Cook in the preheated oven until tender and beginning to blacken, 10 to 15 minutes. Remove from oven and cool slightly. Heat a small non stick skillet over medium heat. Cook and stir the flour in the hot skillet until thickened, about 2 minutes. Add the cooked green bell pepper mixture to the flour and skillet and stir to combine. Remove from heat and allow to cool slightly. Form mixture into a patty shape by rolling into 1 inch thick rounds on the prepared baking sheet. Spray the top of the patties with non stick cooking spray and bake in the preheated oven until golden, about 10 minutes. Remove to a wire rack to cool completely.

Random Ingredients: single cream,white flour,plum sauce,spanish onion,topping,guacamole,flat leaf parsley
title: Guacamole Pie
ingredients: 2 large spanish onions, peeled, trimmed of the tops and finely chopped ( about 12 ounces each ) | 3/4 cup plain white flour | 5 fluid ounces single cream | 10 fluid ounces plum sauce or 10 fluid ounces canned plum sauce | 1/2 cup flat leaf parsley, chopped | flat leaf parsley, to garnish
instructions: Put the onion in a pan with 6 pints of boiling water, cover and simmer for 15 minutes. Drain and leave to cool slightly. Heat the griddle or frying pan, add the flour and cook for 1 to 2 minutes to make a roux. Slowly add the cream and then stir in the onion mix. Bring to the boil and keep stirring for a few minutes. Season with salt & freshly ground black pepper. Add the plum sauce, parsley and adjust seasoning. Spoon the mixture into a greased 23cm deep dish pie tin and brush with a little of the reserved sauce. Using a skewer, push a few parsley leaves into the surface, then prick a few holes in the top with a toothpick. Pour the filling into the pie case and leave to cool. Cook in a moderate oven for 2 hours or until the top is a golden colour.

Random Ingredients: italian herb,tart apple,cognac,tahini paste,rye flour,grapeseed oil,basil leaf,mushroom stem
title: Paleo Apples With Cognac and Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs tart apples, such as jonagold or 1 1/2 lbs granny smith apples, about 9 | 1/4 cup tahini paste | 2 tablespoons grapeseed oil | 2 tablespoons dried italian herbs | 14 1/2 ounces canned mushroom stems and pieces | 1 tablespoon tahini paste | 1 tablespoon cognac or 1 tablespoon brandy | 1/2 cup fresh basil leaf, roughly chopped | 2 tablespoons fresh tahini paste or 2 tablespoons brandy | 1/2 teaspoon dried italian herbs | 1/4 cup fresh basil leaf, roughly chopped | tart apple, cut in wedges ( optional ) | rye flour
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°f with a cooking brush on the pate oil. On a baking sheet, pat the apples into 4 1/2 x 4 1/2 rectangles and place them in the oven. Bake until very pale golden, about 25 - 35 minutes. Meanwhile, in a small bowl, stir together the tahini paste, grapeseed oil, and italian herbs. Remove the pate from the oven. Spread the pate onto the apples, top with the mushrooms, and drizzle with the cognac. Sprinkle with the tahini, herbs, and basil. Place the apples in a deep, nonreactive baking dish. Make a deep cross in the top of the apples, then drizzle with the warm cognac and dot with the toasted tahini paste. Bake until the apples are tender, about 25 to 30 minutes. Remove from the oven, sprinkle with additional tahini paste and top with a few fresh basil leaves,. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: white bread flour,tomato ketchup,dark sesame oil,radish,tortilla,hot green chili pepper,sea salt,flour tortilla
title: Easy Mexican Tortillas
ingredients: 10 ounces fresh tortillas ( torn into 10 inch size pieces ) | 3 ounces white bread flour | 2 tablespoons sea salt | 3 -4 tablespoons tomato ketchup | 3 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 12 fluid ounces bottled tomato ketchup, any brand | 1 -2 green hot chili pepper ( seeded and chopped ) | 1 -2 radish, sliced into 1/4 inch thick matchsticks
instructions: Mix all the wet ingredients together in large bowl. Dip the cold tortillas in the batter and then toss the coated tortillas in the liquid. Fry in lightly oiled pan until lightly browned. Heat up the ketchup and ketchup until boiling and stir vigorously. Spread on warm tortillas and add all the hot peppers. Spread on tortillas. Garnish with radishes.

title: French Bread and Cheese Pudding
ingredients: 3 cups milk | 1 cup panko bread crumbs | 1 1/4 cups sour cream | 1/4 cup beer | 1 french baguette, cut into 1/2-inch slices | 1 cup prepared french-style bread crumbs
instructions: Place milk, panko, sour cream, and beer in a saucepan.

title: Cajun Spaghetti
ingredients: 500 g spaghetti | 2 cups plain soymilk | 300 g pine nuts | 3 tablespoons cajun seasoning | 2 teaspoons ground mace
instructions: Put soymilk, pine nuts, cajun seasoning, and mace in a small pan. Bring to boil, then reduce to a low simmer. This takes about an hour or so, until the sauce is the consistency of your choice. Remove from heat, and just before serving, stir through..

Random Ingredients: yellow potato,fusion liqueur,salmon,lime juice zest,beef stock cube,butter,avgolemono sauce
title: Smoked Salmon and Potato
ingredients: 4 yellow potatoes, peeled and halved lengthways | 25 g butter | 600 ml beef stock cubes, i used knorr beef | 2 tablespoons xnox liqueur | 1 lime, juice and zest of | 200 g smoked salmon, diced ( just use the small amount. the small smoked salmon will be reduced for the quantity. if you omit, increase some ) | 2 tablespoons algolemono sauce ( i used newman's own )
instructions: Place potatoes in large saucepan and cover with water. Bring to the boil and cook over medium low heat until potatoes are tender. Drain and cool under running water. When cool, transfer to an electric grater and grate. Add butter and crumble into small pieces. Scoop out potato mixture and transfer to a large casserole dish. Use half to make the sauce and then place the rest of the mixture in a saucepan. Melt butter in a saucepan over medium heat then add stock and liqueur. Heat and add lime juice to taste. Pour sauce over potato mixture. Top with smoked salmon and cover with foil. Heat through in a pre heated oven 180c for 25 to 30 minutes. Stir before serving.

Random Ingredients: apricot preserve,red wine vinegar,peanut oil,plain nonfat yogurt
title: Apricot Dip
ingredients: 1/2 cup plain nonfat yogurt | 1/4 cup apricot preserves | 1 tablespoon red wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons peanut oil, for brushing | 1 tablespoon red wine vinegar
instructions: Place the yogurt and preserves in a bowl and blend with a fork until creamy and well combined. Add the remaining ingredients and mix. Refrigerate until served.

title: Crispy Taco Shells
ingredients: 1 can diced tomatoes and green chilies, drained | 1/2 teaspoon anise seed | 2 cups corn flakes, crushed | 1/2 cup salsa
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. In a medium bowl, combine tomatoes with green chilies, ground anise seeds, corn flakes, and salsa. Stir in salsa until evenly blended. Spoon mixture into cookie sheets, and bake in the preheated oven until topping is browned and crumbs are dry, 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Easy Lentils With Chili (Yucatecan Style)
ingredients: 1 lb red lentil ( or yellow turnip ) | 3 serrano chiles
instructions: Wash the lentils thoroughly and place in the pot of boiling water. Bring to a boil and cook until tender. Drain the water, and set aside to cool a bit. Grind the chili chilies together with some of the soaked lentils. Place chili mixture in a food processor and process until almost smooth. Serve or store in refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: head cabbage,chicken meat,taco seasoning,taro root,lime zest,oyster,oyster sauce
title: Korean Cabbage Soup
ingredients: 2 quarts chicken steamed tots ( kimchi ) | 8 ounces cooked chicken meat | 2 containers oyster sauce | 1 package taco seasoning | 1 head cabbage | 2 limes, zest of | 1/4 cup fish sauce
instructions: Chop cabbage into 1/2' to 3/4' pieces. Cut one limes into wedges. Add cabbage to a kettle or soup pot with water to just cover. Boil until cabbage is softened and pliable. This will take a while, depending on how long you boil it inches this will depend on how large the pieces were. Remove cabbage from heat. You will be adding one soup or two cups of broth after each. While cabbage is simmering slice your taro root. Remove and discard tough outer leaves of taro and soak in cold water for 15 minutes with taco seasoning. Squeeze out excess water with your hands. Slice off and discard bottom half of your head of cabbage. Use a spoon to break off and remove all the 'disloches' from the cabbage. Use the same spoon to slice taro off and discard any pieces of cabbage with the larger pieces of cabbage. You will be adding your chicken, oyster sauce, and taco seasoning at this point. This will be your “bowl. ”. Dip the kimchi, kimchi, chicken, lime zest and lettuce in the sour cream mixture then line up in a large pot. Add the remaining broth, cabbage, and the remaining taco seasoning. Bring to a boil then turn down heat and simmer approximately 20 minutes or until cabbage is tender. Serve with freshly made spoons if desired.

Random Ingredients: sea salt,graham cracker crumb,cottage cheese,sherry wine vinegar,italian bread,fine breadcrumb
title: Cheese Fingers
ingredients: 3/4 cup fine dry breadcrumb | 3/4 cup fine dry breadcrumb | 3/4 cup cottage cheese | 1 tablespoon sherry wine vinegar ( or red wine vinegar ) | 3 tablespoons fine dry breadcrumbs | 1 tablespoon fine dry breadcrumb | 1/4 teaspoon sea salt | 1/4 cup fine dry breadcrumb | 8 1/2 ounces canned giardiniera cheese, drained but not dry
instructions: Preheat oven to 400'f mix the fine dry bread crumbs, cottage cheese, sherry vinegar and fine dry bread crumbs, salt, and fine dry bread crumbs in a large bowl. If there are any pockets of crumbs, rub them together with your fingers. If not, let sit until crumbs become soft and elastic.

Random Ingredients: sesame oil,pecorino cheese,rom tomato,cardamom,egg noodle,sage,italian sausage
title: Spicy Sausage Egg Noodles With Sage
ingredients: 3 eggs noodles | 6 links mild italian sausage ( hot or sweet ) or 6 links hot italian sausage ( hot or sweet ) | 1 tablespoon sesame oil | 1 bunch fresh sage, finely julienned about | 3 roma tomatoes, seeded and coarsely chopped | 1 cup pecorino cheese | 1 teaspoon cardamom
instructions: Soak the noodles in lots of cold water until soft. Drain well. Cook the italian sausage over medium heat with the oil and saute until cooked through and well browned and crispy. Toss all ingredients except sesame oil, sage and cheese together in a large bowl. When done, stir the mixture together in the bowl until it coats everything, evenly. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: artichoke heart,linguine,chicken wing,yellow cornmeal,vanilla essence,extra virgin olive oil
title: Cousin June's Chicken and Artichoke Pasta
ingredients: 500 -750 g chicken wings | 1 can artichoke heart | 5 -6 tablespoons yellow cornmeal ( to be gluten free, go for the yellow corn meal ) | 3 -4 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 1 tablespoon vanilla essence | 50 g frozen linguine, thawed
instructions: Trim any joints or fat from the chicken wings and cut into four pieces on a slight diagonal. Place into a mixing bowl and stir through the cornmeal to make sure the chicken is coated thoroughly. Heat a little olive oil in a pan and add the chicken and artichoke hearts. Cook for 2 - 3 minutes on each side until brown. Remove the chicken and artichokes from the pan. Bring a pot of water to a boil. Add the pasta and cook according to the instructions on the package. Meanwhile, stir the cornmeal into the chicken mixture. Place back onto the heat until the mixture begins to thicken. Stir in a little water if the sauce is too thin. Drain the pasta and return it to the pan with the chicken and artichoke mixture and the warmed sauce. Taste and adjust the seasoning. Serve as soon as possible.

title: Passion Chicken
ingredients: 2 -4 lbs boneless skinless chicken breasts | 1 cup vegan sour cream | 1/2 cup coconut rum | 3 tart apples
instructions: Cut chicken breasts into 1/3 inch cubes. Mix all together until all chicken pieces are covered. Place in a plastic baggie. Freeze. After about three hours remove meat from the freezer and cut off all access fat and place in a baking dish and cover with sprayed thawed coconut rum. Bake at 375f degrees for 15 - 20 minutes until golden brown. Cut apples and stir in with coconut rum. Serve over french toast.

title: Agua De Molcajete a Cuban Melon Sandwich
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon clove | 3 cups bread, day-old, crumbs | 1/4 teaspoon clove | 3 cups cantaloupe, fresh shelled ( about 1 pound ) or 3 cups honeydew, fresh shelled ( about 1 pound ) | 1 1/2 lbs ham, sliced into 1/4-inch slices | 1/2 lb tomato, sliced into 1/8-inch thick slices | 5 cloves garlic, minced | 1 1/3 cups bread machine yeast
instructions: Place the 4 cups of bread in the machine pan or bread maker, and allow it to knead. In a large bowl, blend the 1/4 teaspoon clove, 1 cup of the cantaloupe, and the ham with the tomato and garlic. Transfer the mixture to a baking dish, and spread the tomato mixture evenly over the surface. Place the second baking dish on top. Cover with plastic wrap, and place a heavy weight on top of the plastic wrap. Allow to rise at room temperature about 90 minutes. After 45 minutes, remove the plastic wrap and let the loaf rise again. Preheat the oven to 400ºf. Dry the loaf on a baking sheet with a rack. With a wooden skewer, poke holes in the surface of each loaf. Bake the bread until the edges have puffed and started to color, 20 to 25 minutes. Allow to cool in the door for 10 minutes, then remove the loaf from the oven, and cool completely on a wire rack. Slice very thin and serve.

Random Ingredients: chicken broth,tomato puree,basmati rice,vanilla bean,white bread,red grape,vanilla powder,chicken wing
title: Vanilla Bean Chicken with Preserved Lemon
ingredients: 1 fresh ripe tomatoes ( or 2-3 tsp sugar ) or ( 1/2 tsp ) vanilla extract ( or 2-3 tsp sugar ) | 1/4 teaspoon vanilla powder ( or 1/2 tsp sugar ) | 1 3/4 cups low sodium chicken broth | 2 -3 lbs chicken wings, tips removed ( about 10 to 12 whole legs ) | 3 slices white bread, crusts removed, torn into small bits | 1/4 cup tomato puree | 1/4 cup dry red grapes, cut in half ( about 6 small ) | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon pure vanilla powder, to taste | 1/3 cup chicken stock or 1/3 cup canned reduced-sodium chicken broth | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon pure vanilla powder | 1/4 cup basmati rice, washed and drained
instructions: Place the tomato, 1 tsp of the vanilla, and the broth in a blender, and process with the remaining 1 tsp of vanilla until smooth. In a deep skillet, heat 1 tbsp oil or butter over medium high heat. Add the bread bits and cook until golden and crunchy, stirring constantly. Set aside to cool. Add the tomato puree, grapes, and remaining 1 tsp of vanilla to the bread bits, and cook over high heat until the liquid has reduced by half and the grapes have turned a rich brown color, about 3 - 5 minutes. Stir in the water or broth, bring to a boil, then reduce heat. Simmer the chicken until just cooked through, 20 - 30 minutes. Discard bones. Meanwhile, remove the chicken from the broth and rinse under cold running water. Pat dry with paper towels. Transfer the chicken to a bowl, cover, and refrigerate overnight. The next day, return the broth to a boil. Add the rice and the tomato puree, and allow it to return to a boil, then reduce to a simmer and cook on the lowest heat for 30 to 35 minutes, or until the rice is tender and has absorbed all of the liquid. Remove the chicken from the broth and set aside to cool slightly for 5 minutes. Fluff the rice with a fork, and spoon the rice into a serving dish. The chicken can be served immediately, or left to cool completely before refrigeration. Sprinkle the remaining 2 tsp of vanilla on top and serve immediately. It can also be served cold or warmed warm.

title: Cheese and Spice Cracker Dip
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs aged cheddar cheese | 1 pinch red pepper flakes
instructions: Line a 2 lb loaf pan with waxed paper, or a round cake pan. If using the waxed paper, lightly grease the paper with a little oil, then cut the cheese into slices approximately 3 x 1 x 1/4. Slice the cheese slices into halves about 1/8 thick. Press the cheese slices into the baking pan with the long side of a spoon to ensure that they are completely covered with the waxed paper. Sprinkle with a little salt and a pinch of ground red pepper flakes. Set aside for about 20 minutes. Using the waxed paper, dip half of the cheese slices into the dip until well coated. Repeat with remaining cheese slices until the dip is gone. Serve warm or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: red wine vinegar,amaretto,apricot nectar,vanilla pudding mix,flat leaf italian parsley,green chile
title: Passion Fruit Salad
ingredients: 1 package dry vanilla pudding mix | 3 cups chopped green chiles | 3/4 cup apricot nectar | 1/3 cup dry red wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons chopped flat-leaf italian parsley | 1 teaspoon amaretto ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Grease a 9x13 inch baking dish. In a large bowl, stir together the pudding mix, green chiles, apricot nectar, wine vinegar, parsley and amaretto. Carefully stir in the warm sauce. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate at least 2 hours before serving.
