title: Quick and Easy Chinese Ramen Casserole
ingredients: 1 package ramen noodles, uncooked | 1 package mini marshmallows
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place ramen noodles and mini marshmallows in a 9x13 inch casserole dish. Cover with enough hot water to cover. Bake, covered, in preheated oven 25 minutes. Uncover and sprinkle with remaining marshmallows. Bake, stirring halfway through, 5 minutes or until marshmallows have melted.

Random Ingredients: graham cracker crumb,lime juice,golden raisin,catsup,onion soup mix,caper
title: Glorious Faux Cracker Cookies
ingredients: 1 package onion soup mix | 1 package lime juice, fresh squeezed | 3 tablespoons catsup | 3 tablespoons golden raisins | 20 graham cracker crumbs | 2 tablespoons capers
instructions: Set oven to 325 degrees with rack in middle. Spray a large baking dish with cooking spray. In large bowl, combine all ingredients, except cracker crumbs. Mix well, and form into 1 inch balls or 8 smaller if desired. Place balls on baking dish and bake for 20 - 25 minutes until golden. Sprinkle with cracker crumbs when cool.

title: Red Snapper in a Bowl
ingredients: 2 slices red snapper, thick-cut, with bones | 4 ounces thin wheat spaghetti
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place the snapper on a baking sheet lined with foil.

Random Ingredients: madras curry powder,pork chop,yellow squash,taco seasoning mix,coconut,cream celery soup,mexican cheese
title: Mexican Pork
ingredients: 2 pork chops, cut into bite-size pieces | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 3 yellow squash, cut into bite-size pieces | 2 cups light sour cream, or more to taste | 1 can condensed cream of celery soup | 1 cup shredded mexican-style cheese blend | 1/4 cup shredded coconut, or more to taste
instructions: Place pork chops in a greased 9x13 inch baking dish. Combine taco seasoning mix and yellow squash in a bowl.

title: Frozen Peas
ingredients: 2 packages frozen green peas | 1/2 teaspoon artificial sweetener
instructions: Prepare bag or steamer basket at least 6 inches square/5 feet deep, with a well fitting lid, or a dutch oven. Cook peas according to package directions until crisp and slightly tender. Remove peas and sweetener. Using slotted spoon, lift peas out onto paper towels. Spread peas on bag using plastic wrap to cool. Refrigerate covered, about 30 minutes to crisp peas. Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Teriyaki Barley - Vegetarian & Gluten Free
ingredients: 1 cup pearl barley | 1/4 cup dark soy sauce
instructions: Combine all of the ingredients in a small container with a lid and shake vigorously until the sugar is dissolved. Serve as a dipping sauce on a slice of your favourite barbecued chicken bar, vegetables etc. Enjoy.

title: Blueberry and Coriander Rice Pudding
ingredients: 2 cups cooked jasmine rice | 2 tablespoons coriander leaves | 200 g fresh blueberries | 2 slices french bread, cut into cubes
instructions: Pre heat oven to 180°c. Heat 1/2 tsp of oil in a non stick frying pan on a medium heat. Add 1/2/3 of the rice and stir to coat it completely in oil. This will take about a minute or two before it goes light brown. Tip rice out of the pan into a large caserole/lid or casserole dish. Dissolve the remaining 1/2 tsp of oil in the pan and tip rice over. Add the coriander and blueberries and stir to coat. Cook on a medium heat until the berries are soft and lightly coloured, about 5 - 10 mins, then tip the rice back in. Spread the remaining rice over the rice and scatter with the blueberries. Place into a shallow ovenproof dish and bake on a medium/low heat for 15 - 20 minutes until firm and lightly browned on top. Serve with your favourite chutney and fresh fruit of your choice such as yoghurt and yoghurt.

Random Ingredients: hash brown potato,butter,pork roast,beer,almond,chinese five spice powder,mango chutney,cooking oat
title: Smothered Pork Roast With Mango Chutney and Almonds
ingredients: 3/4 lb smoked pork roast | 3/4 cup quick-cooking rolled oats | 2 tablespoons unsalted butter | 3 tablespoons fresh beer | 1/2 teaspoon chinese five spice powder, plus | chinese five-spice powder, for garnish | 3/4 cup finely chopped toasted almond | 2/3 cup sliced dried mango chutney
instructions: Heat oven to 425 degrees. Rub roast with 2/4 tsp chinese five spice powder and rub in remaining 2 tsp chinese five spice powder. Place roast in a roasting pan. Cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes. Heat oven to 375 degrees. Cook roast on the middle rack, about 6 minutes per side for medium rare / medium well, or until cooked to desired doneness. Remove to a warm platter and leave covered in a warm place. Add remaining 2/3 cup chutney to fat remaining in the roasting pan. Cook over medium heat, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom of the pan with a wooden spoon. When the chutney begins to melt, add about 1/2 cup water and stir to mix, then cover and set aside. Remove meat from oven and set aside. Increase oven temperature to 400 degrees / place roast back in pan. Stir in oats and butter. Bake, covered, until browned lightly and reduced somewhat, about 40 mins per side. If using smoked pork roast, heat 2 tbls. Of chutney to boiling and toss lightly in with baked roasted. Roasted toasted almonds, drain and spread over roast toasted, buttered, top of roast when finished cooking. Serve the turkey with the almonds on a platter or with a spatula. If desired, sprinkle top of toast with chutney, then top with thinly sliced mango chutney. Note, to toast and slive almonds, soak them in a bowl of warm water for 30 - 45 minutes, then drain and spread on a towel, shaking away excess moisture.

Random Ingredients: salt black pepper,italian bread,asiago cheese,chicken thigh,buttermilk,hamburger
title: Baked Chicken With Ham & Toasted Asiago Cheese
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger | 1 lb boneless skinless chicken thighs | salt & freshly ground black pepper | 1 cup grated asiago cheese | italian bread, cut into 1-inch slices | 1 cup buttermilk
instructions: Cook the hamburger meat over medium heat until browned and crumbly. Remove the meat and place in a bowl. Add the chicken to the meat and combine. Season with salt and pepper. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees. Butter or generously flour an 8 x 8 x 2 pan. Transfer the mixture to the pan and bake, uncovered for about 30 minutes. Remove from the oven and set aside until later. Spread the top of the pan with buttermilk and then top with the italian bread. Cover with the meat and then top with the cheese. Bake about 15 minutes longer or until bubbly.

Random Ingredients: onion salt,sausage,herb,beef gravy,iceberg lettuce,wheat flour,flour tortilla
title: Sausage and Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 4 ounces lean ground sausage | 1/4 cup chopped onion | 1/2 tablespoon seasoned flour | 1/2 teaspoon mixed herbs | 1 pinch dried herbs | 1 cup 90 % lean ground beef gravy | 1 teaspoon whole wheat flour | 8 8 small flour tortillas or 8 small corn tortillas
instructions: In large skillet, cook sausage, onion and seasoned flour over medium heat until sausage is well browned, breaking into 1 inch pieces. Drain well. Stir in the herbs and gravy and simmer 10 minutes. Spoon gravy mixture among tortillas and roll up. Top with shredded cheese and other desired toppings, if desired. Garnish with additional chopped onions.

title: Kiwi Spicy Pasta Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup pasta sauce, spicy ( kikkoman brand is gluten-free ) | 2 tablespoons brandy ( i like jack daniels ) or 2 tablespoons rum ( i like jack daniels ) | 1 teaspoon garlic, minced | 10 kiwi fruits, sliced or 1 cup frozen kiwi fruit, thawed | 1 cup watercress
instructions: Combine all ingredients except for kiwifruit and watercress in a bowl until well blended. Chill the kiwifruit for about 20 minutes. Pour off excess garlic. To serve, place watercress on a plate and top with spicy kiwifruit.

Random Ingredients: baking potato,caster sugar,maraschino cherry,white vinegar,tomato soup,mango chutney,garlic clove,avocado
title: Cheats Mango Chutney Potato Salad
ingredients: 3 large baking potatoes, peeled and cubed | 2 large ripe mango chutney | 125 g maraschino cherries, halved | 125 g tomatoes and tomato soup | 2 garlic cloves, crushed | 1 tablespoon white vinegar | 2 tablespoons caster sugar | avocado, sliced | extra mango chutney, to serve
instructions: Place the potatoes on a baking paper lined baking tray, cover and microwave for 1 - 2 minutes or until cooked. Turn potatoes over, cool, and roughly chop into bite sized pieces. Place the mango chutney, cherries, tomato, tomato soup, garlic, vinegar, and sugar in a large bowl. Toss until well combined. Add the potatoes and gently stir to combine. Serve in bowls garnished with avocado slices. Enjoy.

title: Caraway Coleslaw
ingredients: 1 green cabbage, chopped into smaller pieces | 1/2 cup palm sugar | 1/4 cup splenda sugar substitute | 1 -2 tablespoon prepared mustard
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Chill. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: orange juice,iceberg lettuce,lemon juice zest,alfalfa sprout,sugar syrup,whipping cream
title: Lettuce-Orange Salad
ingredients: 1 lime ( juice and zest of ) | 3 tablespoons sugar syrup | 2 tablespoons orange juice | 2 tablespoons whipping cream | 1 head iceberg lettuce, shredded | 2 -3 alfalfa sprouts ( optional ) | sugar syrup
instructions: Squeeze lime and zest over lettuce and sprouts in a large bowl. Mix together the dressing ingredients and pour over sprouts. Toss. Serve cold.

title: Grilled Skirt Steak
ingredients: 4 loaves processed cheese, cut into squares | 4 tablespoons horseradish, divided | 1 bag frozen mixed vegetables | 2 cups steak sauce | 4 boneless skirt steaks, trimmed ( about 1-1/2 lbs total ) | 16 ounces cool whip, thawed
instructions: In medium bowl, mix cheese, 2 t. Horseradish, vegetables, and remaining horseradish. Place in shallow dish or resealable plastic bag. Heat coals in oven on the lower rack. Place one steak on each piece of meat. Spoon 1 1/2 cups of sauce over steak. Marinate 15 - 30 minutes in refrigerator. Remove steak from marinade.

title: Spinach & Meat in Cardamom
ingredients: 1 -2 lb beef sirloin | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom | 1 -2 tablespoon orange rind, grated ( or 1/8 tsp. ground cardamom powder ) | 2 bags spinach, washed | 1 tablespoon freshly ground cardamom
instructions: Trim any fat from meat and cut into about six pieces. Spread the meat into a dish and sprinkle 1 - 2 t. Of kosher salt on it. Add about a tablespoon of freshly ground cardamom. Pour enough water over it to just cover the meat. Let stand for about 20 minutes at room temperature. Meanwhile, heat a large non stick skillet over medium high heat. Add 1 t. Of olive oil and cook the meat pieces until brown on both sides, about 3 to 4 minutes per side. Using a slotted spoon, transfer the pieces to a serving platter and tent loosely with aluminum foil. When the meat is done, discard all but a few tablespoons of pan drippings or liquid from the pan. Turn the heat to medium. Pour the remaining oil into the pan. When it's hot, add the drained spinach. Cover pan and cook, stirring a few times, over medium heat, until the spinach is starting to wilt about 4 - 5 minutes. Stir in the reserved salt and freshly ground cardamom. Stir to coat the spinach with oil. Stir in the meat. Spoon evenly over the spinach. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: sherry wine vinegar,mayonnaise,pepperoncini pepper,kidney bean,beer,vidalia onion,soy flour
title: Beanshell Dressing
ingredients: 1/2 cup mayonnaise | 1 tablespoon lime juice or 1 tablespoon vinegar | 2 tablespoons dry sherry wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon minced onion | 1 can kidney beans | 1/2 cup minced pepperoncini pepper ( optional ) | 1/4 cup beer
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a blender or food processor. Cover and process until well blended. Refrigerate for up to 2 days.

title: Brie and Sea Salt Filo Parcels
ingredients: 100 g brie cheese, rind removed | 1/3 cup finely chopped sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained | 30 g chopped fresh clams or 1 -2 teaspoon dried clams ( i don't measure, so i've omitted it ) ( optional ) | 10 sheets phyllo pastry
instructions: Preheat oven to 220c/170c fan forced. Wash brie and remove rind if necessary.

Random Ingredients: tomato paste,brown sugar,green chilies,sage leaf,chicken wing
title: Chicken in a Tomato Sauce
ingredients: 500 g chicken wings, separated ( skinless ) | 5 tablespoons tomato paste | 1/4 cup brown sugar | 2 green chilies, chopped | 1 fresh sage leaf, leaves removed, chopped
instructions: Cut chicken wings into three or four pieces. Blend tomato paste with sugar and chillies. Heat 1/4 cup of oil in a wok or a large non stick pan over high heat. When a small drop of water sprinkled into water evaporates instantly, add half the chicken, a few pieces at a time, and cook for approx 20 seconds on each side. Serve hot.

title: Apricot Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 4 tablespoons cream of mushroom soup | 1 teaspoon apricot brandy ( or brandy sherry wine ) | 1/4 cup sour cream
instructions: Combine sour cream and mayonnaise thoroughly.

title: Chocolate & Honey Pasta
ingredients: 375 g pasta | 1 tablespoon pumpkin pie spice | 1 tablespoon honey | 1 cup cheddar cheese, grated ( any type, i use sharp cheddar ) | 2 tablespoons bittersweet chocolate, grated | 1 pinch cayenne
instructions: Cook pasta according to package. Meanwhile, heat honey in small saucepan until very warm, but not boiling. Remove from heat. Add cheese and stir until melted. Add spices. Drain pasta. Stir well. Add cheese mix to saucepan and reheat slowly for a minute. Serve.

Random Ingredients: coconut oil,hamburger bun,grain rice,chipotle pepper,kalamata olive
title: Smoky Chipotle Beef and Rice Burger
ingredients: 1 lb lean ground sirloin | 6 tablespoons coconut oil | 1 cup long grain rice or 1 cup white rice, uncooked | 1/2 cup kalamata olive, sliced | 1 large chipotle pepper, minced
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions. Cut beef into thin strips using either a food processor or electric mixer. Preheat grill to medium high. In a large bowl mix all ingredients together. Form into 6 rissoles and place on grill. Cook for 7 - 9 minutes or until cooked through.

title: My Very Own Garlic Salt
ingredients: 4 tablespoons garlic salt ( approx ) | 1 2/3 cups icing sugar
instructions: Combine garlic salt and icing sugar. Add to your favourite pizza dough tray. Spread on any tasty dough/soft pizza bases. Refrigerate for 1 hour prior to baking. Bake at 180c for 15 - 20 minutes, or until goldenbrown.

Random Ingredients: taco seasoning mix,seasoning salt,milk chocolate candy,swiss cheese,canola oil,squash
title: Microwave Swiss Squash
ingredients: 2 lbs squash, cleaned, sliced thin | 2 teaspoons seasoning salt | 1 package swiss cheese, sliced | 1 -1 1/2 cup evaporated milk chocolate candy | 1 package taco seasoning mix, mix ( or 2 packages, see note ) | 3 -4 tablespoons canola oil
instructions: Cook squash in microwave for 6 - 7 minutes on high, stirring once or twice. In separate bowl, mix cheese, pudding mix and taco seasoning mix. Place butter in microwave safe bowl or in 9x13 glass dish sprayed with cooking spray. Microwave on high until mixture comes to 185f or about 15 minutes, stirring every few minutes. Spoon onto plate and let cool. Microwave for 2 minutes. Stir. Spread over cooled squash. Microwave on high for 3 mins or until cheese is melted. Sprinkle top with milk chocolate or candied cherry rind, if desired. Notes, you can also bake these ahead of time, refrigerate, and bake later in the day, then reheat, adding about 1/4 cup milk and some grated chocolate for garnish, if desired.

Random Ingredients: taco seasoning,adzuki bean,coconut flour,lime juice zest,miso
title: Adzuki Beans Baked in Coconut Cream & Miso
ingredients: 2 cans adzuki beans, drained | 1/2 envelope taco seasoning, mix ( i use caldo de siri ) | 1 tablespoon shredded coconut flour | 1 1/2 teaspoons grated lime zest | 1 tablespoon fresh lime juice or 1 tablespoon lime juice
instructions: Heat oven to 400°f unroll adzuki beans. Stuff each bean with one heaping 1 teaspoon of taco and 1 teaspoon of coconut flour. Mix together lime zest, lime juice or 1 tablespoon lime juice if using. Spoon mixture into the center of each bean. Bake for 15 - 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: hamburger bun,pistachio,thyme,kernel corn,whipping cream,black bean,poppy seed,soy sauce
title: Best Ever Black Bean Burger
ingredients: 1 can black beans | 1 can whole kernel corn | 1/2 cup whipping cream | 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme | 1/4 teaspoon poppy seed | 4 -6 hamburger buns | soy sauce | pistachios, chopped
instructions: Combine all ingredients except buns and spread evenly on hamburger buns. Top with sauce. Sprinkle with chopped pistachios.

title: Spinach With Orange and Lemon
ingredients: 1 package fresh spinach ( or frozen cleaned ) | pesto infused olive oil or pesto ( or to taste )
instructions: Cook spinach according to directions on box, rinse well. Thin with extra virgin olive oil or lemon oil. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: sirloin steak,russet potato,chili oil,mango chutney,cracker crumb,cheddar cheese,maple syrup
title: Spiced Steak (Irish)
ingredients: 2 lbs sirloin steaks, cut diagonally into bite-sized pieces | 2 russet potatoes, peeled and cut crosswise into large slabs | 2 tablespoons chili oil | 1/2 cup real maple syrup | 8 ounces thick-and-chili flavored creamed chutney | 8 ounces grated cheddar cheese | 2 tablespoons cracker crumbs
instructions: Preheat 1 tblsp oil in large heavy skillet over medium high heat. Add potatoes and cook 4 min., stirring occasionally. Transfer to bowl of ice. Cook steak to desired doneness, about 1 min per side for rare. Transfer to platter. Repeat with 2 batches of steak. Return potatoes to skillet. Add 1 tblsp oil. Cook til golden brown and cooked through, about 3 min. Transfer to plate. Toss potatoes with 1 tblsp oil and maple syrup. Spoon over steak. Sprinkle with chile chutney. Serve with cheese and cracker crumbs.

Random Ingredients: asparagus,jalapeno pepper,salmon fillet,active yeast,cream cheese,sirloin beef
title: Sensational Beef and Asparagus Rolls
ingredients: 4 teaspoons active dry yeast | 4 lbs sirloin beef | 18 thin asparagus | 24 slices smoked salmon fillet | 24 ounces cream cheese | 1 large jalapeno pepper, seeded and finely chopped
instructions: Prepare and make the filling of your choosing, and set out in the refrigerator to chill while making the rolls. Slice the beef very thinly. Combine the rest of the filling ingredients in a bowl and let the flavors meld together for at least an hour. Take the chilled beef slices out of the refrigerator. Preheat your oven to 450 f put slices of beef inside 4 thick rolls, cutting them to fit if necessary. Line the rolls tightly with plastic wrap. Place them on an unfloured baking sheet and bake the rolls for 20 minutes, until they are nicely browned. To serve, take the rolls out of the oven and brush tops with melted butter.

title: Tomatillo and Swiss Chard Salad
ingredients: 1 bunch swiss chard, rinsed and sliced | 1 cup diced canned tomatillo | 1 cup frozen raspberries
instructions: Steam the chard until it begins to soften. Remove the stems and leaves. Place a layer of chard on a serving dish.

Random Ingredients: cardamom pod,orange zest,lime peel,onion salt,rye bread,pork,serrano chile pepper
title: Smokey Mexican Meatballs
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds ground pork | 1 small onion, chopped | 3 serrano chile peppers, chopped | 1 tablespoon grated lime peel | 1 1/2 teaspoons grated orange zest | 1 1/2 teaspoons grated lime peel | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom pod | rye bread rounds, for serving
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the ground pork, onion, serrano chile peppers, 1 tablespoon lime peel, orange zest, 1 1/2 teaspoon grated lime peel, cardamom pod, and 1 teaspoon ground cardamom. Mix together using your hands. Mix together using your hands until the mixture becomes a paste. Roll into 1 inch meatballs, and refrigerate in an airtight container for 1 to 2 hours. Preheat an outdoor grill for medium high heat and lightly oil the grate. Lightly oil the metal skewers, and set aside. Place the remaining 1 teaspoon orange peel in a small bowl. Lightly oil the grill grate, place 4 to 5 meatballs on the grate, and cook 5 minutes, until lightly charred, turning once, and turning as necessary. Turn off the grill. Serve kebabs drizzled with salsa and a dollop of salsa vera, if desired.

title: Quick and Easy Artisan Pizza Dough
ingredients: cooking spray | 1 teaspoon canning salt | 1 1/4 cups plain nonfat yogurt, drained canned | 1/4 cup olive, canned sliced pitted olives, drained | 2 teaspoons yeast
instructions: Combine canning salt, yogurt, whole olives, and yeast in a large bowl. Knead on a floured surface until very smooth. Place dough in a well oiled bowl, and turn to coat. Cover with a cloth, and let rise in a warm place until doubled, about 1 hour. Meanwhile, preheat grill. Drain the dough, and roll out onto a lightly floured surface into a circular shape, about 11 inches long, using a 2 1/2 inch round cookie cutter. Transfer the pizza dough to a pizza pan large enough to hold it in two layers. Top the dough with olives, and sprinkle the top with mozzarella cheese. Place pizza pan on the center rack of the preheated grill. Cook pizza until top is golden brown, about 10 minutes.

title: Cuba Libre
ingredients: 1 lb fresh mixed beans | 1/3 cup dark rum | 1/4 cup white rum ( i like to throw in some jimmies ) | soy sauce
instructions: Blend together the rum, white rum and soy sauce in a medium sized saucepan and simmer over medium heat. When it bubbles, add the beans. Cover and cook just until a wooden bean can be cut into the beans. Watch carefully so as not to break up the beans or scorch. Note, you don't want to over cook the beans.

title: Creamy Lemon Quinoa Salad
ingredients: 2 cups cooked quinoa, cold | 3/4 cup light sour cream or 3/4 cup light sour cream | 1/2 teaspoon fresh lemon juice | 4 large white mushrooms, cleaned and quartered ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a serving bowl. Refrigerate until ready to serve, up to 3 days.

Random Ingredients: rice paper,chipotle chile,pico de gallo,baking soda,cremini mushroom,shiitake mushroom,broccoli floret
title: Crunchy Mushroom Bread
ingredients: 2 cups shredded broccoli florets | 2 cups small shiitake mushrooms | 1/2 cup chopped cremini mushrooms | 1 tablespoon minced chipotle chile | 2 cups pico de gallo | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 8 soft rice paper sheets | pico de gallo
instructions: Preheat oven to 500 degrees f. Grease a 5 inch tube pan with cooking spray. Bring a medium pot of water to a boil and add the steamed broccoli and mushrooms. Cover and boil until tender, about 5 minutes. Remove broccoli from the pot and set aside to cool slightly. Rinse in cold water until cool enough to handle. Drain. Halve the mushrooms and set aside. Place the chipotles in a small bowl and cover with boiling water. Cover and let sit for 15 minutes to soften. Strain and place both the capsicums on paper towels to soak up any excess moisture. Drain as follows, place them in the bowl of a blender along with the cooked broccoli, mushrooms and chipotles. Blend until very smooth, about 1 minute. Place the bread onto a baking sheet and spread the pico de gallo evenly over the bread and place into the oven for about 5 minutes or until the topping becomes golden brown and crispy. Serve warm.

title: Asian Beef in White Beans [for Two]
ingredients: 1 tablespoon tamari | 1 tablespoon fish sauce | 1 lb top round roast ( fresh, boneless or the beef of your choice ) or 1 lb top rump steak, sliced thinly ( fresh, boneless or the beef of your choice ) | 1 can white beans
instructions: Mix the tamari, fish sauce, and oil. Tightly place the beef in and let it marinade at least one hour. When ready to cook, remove the beef from the marinade and add the white beans as well as their liquid and the marinade from the beef and the white beans and refrigerate overnight in refrigerator. The next day, cook the beef to desired doneness. When the beef is done and cooked to desired doneness, remove from the pan and let it rest at room temperature while making the white bean sauce. Serve with white rice and dipping sauces. If you want to serve this dish with steamed vegetables, soak up the leftover marinade in the microwave. The leftover marinade is great for dipping the steamed vegetables into.

Random Ingredients: purpose flour,sourdough bread,tomato,onion flake,watermelon,chinese rice wine
title: Watermelon and Sushi Bread Pizza
ingredients: 3 cups sourdough bread, crumbs | 1 cup crushed tomatoes | 1 cup chopped sweet potatoes ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon all-purpose flour | 1/2 cup soureddough bread, crumbs | 1/2 cup sweet potato, diced ( optional ) | 1/2 cup watermelon, diced ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon chinese rice wine ( optional )
instructions: Topping, combine the sourdough crumbs, crushed tomatoes, sweet potatoes, flour, and 1/2 cup of soureddough bread crumbs in a large bowl.

title: Creamy Kielbasa Appetizer
ingredients: 1 pound sausage | 1 package kielbasa sausage | 1 1/2 cups apple jelly | 1/4 cup unsweetened cocoa
instructions: Cook bacon in a large skillet until it becomes browned and crispy. Remove from skillet and break into pieces. Return the crumbs to the skillet. Brown sausage in the bacon fat. Add sausage to skillet, and stir to coat well. Spread mixture onto a 9x13 inch baking dish. Bake at 375 degrees f for 30 minutes. Spread jelly on the sausage and drippings. Sprinkle cocoa on top. Continue baking at 375 degrees f for 30 minutes more.

Random Ingredients: salmon fillet,worcestershire sauce,herb,tomato sauce,tamarind paste,rigatoni pasta,sun tomato oil
title: Rigatoni Salad
ingredients: 7 ounces rigatoni pasta | 1 tablespoon sun-dried tomato packed in oil, chopped | 2 teaspoons tamarind paste | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 2 teaspoons mixed herbs, such as oregano, fresh basil, thyme, dill | 1 tablespoon sun-dried tomato packed in oil, chopped | 2 ounces salmon fillets
instructions: Cook pasta until al dente. Drain pasta but do not rinse. Meanwhile, combine all dressing ingredients in a small bowl. Toss pasta with dressing. Serve immediately.

title: Beer Stainer
ingredients: 1 quart stout beer ( a good, cheap beer ) | 2 teaspoons lemongrass, powder, powder ( fresh or dried or crushed ) | 1 tablespoon hot paprika | 1 small chocolate square, grated
instructions: Heat the stout in a tall, heavy saucepan until bubbles float and the surface of the stout appears to bubble. Remove from the heat. Add lemon grass powder and paprika and stir. Stir in the grated chocolate. Cover immediately and refrigerate. Stir the mixture several times during the day to prevent it from boiling over.

title: Easy Noodle Lasagna
ingredients: 3/4 lb dried chinese egg noodles ( or other small size pasta such as lasagne ) | 3 tablespoons fish sauce | 3 tablespoons peanuts, coarsely chopped | 1 teaspoon chili paste | 1/4 lb small curd cottage cheese | 1/4 lb white chocolate | pimiento, slices and | grated white chocolate
instructions: Cook noodles according to instructions. While noodles are cooking. Add fish sauce into the pasta and mix well so noodles don't break. Set aside and let stand for 10 minutes. In a separate saucepan over medium heat combine remaining ingredients. Bring to a boil. Once noodles are almost done cooking, construct the lasagna by lining bottom of a 9 x 13 baking dish with a single layer of noodles. Spread the cottage cheese on noodles. Spread the pimiento slices and white chocolate on top of cheese. Carefully pour noodles over remaining ingredients and sprinkle with grated chocolate. Cover with foil and set in a warm place to allow to rise.

title: Simple Non-Grampy Beans
ingredients: 20 ounces kidney beans | 1 teaspoon of finely chopped green coriander
instructions: Wash the beans a few times. Dry beans with paper towels and add to your food processor. Pour beans into a large pot that has no water. Turn heat to high until beans are sizzling hot and begin to pop. It will only take about 3 minutes. Add your chopped green coriander and allow the soup to boil for 3 minutes. Stir. Turn off heat. Let stand for 5 - 10 minutes. Serve hot with rice and refried beans or any other vegetable of you like. This is a great recipe for you to have your children grow green. Also, you have other fun things to remember to eat that's it.

title: Spicy Mexican Quilt-Cooker Pizza Sauce
ingredients: 1 package part-skim ricotta cheese | 1 can red chilies
instructions: Place ricotta cheese in a medium bowl. Heat a pizza stone in a 425°f oven for 5 minutes. Mix in red chilies. Spread contents of a can or jar of chilies in a 9x6 inch glass pie plate. Spread with spaghetti sauce. Sprinkle with remaining cheese. Cover with a clean cloth or kitchen towel, and keep warm in a 200°f oven for 5 minutes. Place on a serving platter, and serve warm.

Random Ingredients: bow tie pasta,vanilla essence,pineapple juice,flour,egg yolk,lemon wedge,red beet,tequila
title: Tequila Mashed Sweet and Sour Heart Beet Pasta
ingredients: 500 g red beets, small ( approx � 300g ) | 250 g bow tie pasta, cooked and drained, according to directions | 150 ml pineapple juice ( approximately 20ml ) | 60 ml lemon juice | 1/4 teaspoon vanilla essence | 2 egg yolks | 1/4 cup flour | 125 ml tequila
instructions: Chop beet tops and slice into sticks. Place beet sticks and drained pasta in a small bowl. Add other ingredients together. Mash thoroughly. Put mix into a small crock pot, add a bit extra pineapple juice if needed. Cook on low for approx 3 hours, stirring every 30 minutes. If sauce thickens after about 15 minutes, remove from heat. Serve hot.

title: Peppered Cheese Using Peppers
ingredients: 8 ounces ricotta cheese | 10 slices pepperoni
instructions: Place the cheese on a piece of plastic wrap. Cut a slice of pepperoni into four equal portions. Sprinkle a small amount of the cheese mixture inside each piece. Roll up the cheese around the pepperoni. Seal the edges with cold water. Place on a grill pan or cookie sheet and bake at 500 degrees for about 10 minutes. You may also do in a pizza maker, or place in a tortilla press. Serve warm.

title: Carrots and Onions
ingredients: 5 lbs baby carrots | 4 lbs white onions, peeled, quartered | 6 lbs lard | 4 cups kosher salt | 2 cups crushed peanuts
instructions: Cook the baby carrots in boiling water until tender, about 5 minutes. Drain the carrots. Cut the ends away from the carrots and drop them into large bowl of ice water. Rinse the carrots under cold water and drain well. Drain and then place into a large stainless steel bowl, and set aside. In a large frying pan on medium high heat, melt the lard on medium high heat. When the lard is hot, add the onions, carrots and kosher salt. Stir to mix thoroughly. Reduce heat to medium low and cook 30 minutes, stirring occasionally, until onions are caramelized. Toss the carrots with the caramelized onions. Transfer to serving bowl and sprinkle with peanuts. I served the vegetables on a platter.

title: Tasty Hungarian Spaghetti Sauce
ingredients: 2 leeks | 1 jar spaghetti sauce ( ragu old world brand ) | 1 chicken bouillon granules ( knorr brand ) | 2 teaspoons seasoning salt
instructions: Cut off the ends of the leeks and discard them. Remove the green tops and the very white parts from the leeks with scissors. Cut them into pieces about 1/4 inch length or less and throw away the dark green part. If you are using the kitchen scissors on the inside, it is easier to cut off the very white portion entirely, because it lends more flavor to the sauce and to prevent it from bleeding. In a heavy kettle boil water and bouillon granules. Add the leeks into the water and bring to a slow boil. After about 15 minutes turn off the heat. Using a slotted spoon, lift out the pieces that float to the top. Put the leeks back in with the spaghetti sauce. This recipe tastes great either way.

title: Baked Beef With Apricots and Chili Sauce
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs sirloin steaks | 2 ounces dried apricot jam | 4 ounces chili sauce
instructions: Cut the steak into 2 or more thick slices, and arrange them with the ham in a greased shallow ovenproof casserole. Mix together the jam and jam mixture, pour over the meat, and bake in the centre of an ovenproof dish for about 1 1/2 hours, or until cooked to your liking. Serve at once.

title: Cheezeburger Filling
ingredients: 2 cups mango chutney | 1/2 cup cornstarch | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1 package pepperoni ( round, sliced )
instructions: Combine all ingredients.

Random Ingredients: coriander seed,basil leaf,apple juice,walnut oil,cannellini bean,asparagus
title: Foolproof Australian Bushman's Salad
ingredients: 1 can cannellini beans ( drained and rinsed ) | 2 1/2 cm asparagus | 2 tablespoons walnut oil | 1/4 cup apple juice | 2 teaspoons coriander seeds | 1/4 cup chopped basil leaf
instructions: Drain excess liquid from beans with a slotted spoon. Cut asparagus into 5cm lengths and place in a large bowl of cold water to stop the cooking. Combine the oil and apple juice in a small bowl and gradually whisk in the apple juice mixture. Drain the asparagus and set aside. Remove the stems from the asparagus and cut them into 5cm lengths. Add the asparagus to the bowl of cold water and stir to blanch the asparagus. Combine the bean and asparagus mixture and toss to coat evenly. Serve sprinkled with the walnuts.

title: Strawberry Pumpernickel Bread
ingredients: 4 cups self-rising flour | 3 cups strawberries, hulled and sliced | 1 cup jerk sauce | kosher salt to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Lightly grease a medium baking sheet. In a medium bowl, mix half of the flour with the strawberries. Cover a second bowl with ice cubes and toss well with your hands to combine. Add remaining flour and jerk sauce to strawberries and toss to moisten, then gently fold in the rest of the flour. Divide the dough into six pieces and shape into loaves. Place on the prepared baking sheet, spacing them about 3 inches apart. Cover with plastic wrap and a kitchen towel and put in the refrigerator. Allow to stand at room temperature for 30 minutes. Bake in the preheated oven until a nicely browned crust is formed, 15 to 20 minutes.

title: English Muffin with Raspberry Sorbet & Horseradish Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 4 english muffins | 1/4 cup prepared horseradish | 1 bunch leeks or 1 bunch green onion, julienned | 1/2 cup grated carrot | 2 1/2 cups raspberries sorbet or 2 1/2 cups raspberry gelatin sorbet
instructions: Preheat broiler or grill. Toast the english muffins just until they feel dry. Rinse off any unabsorbed liquid from the muffins. Split the english muffins in half lengthwise, then remove the crusts. Brush both sides of each bun with a little prepared horseradish. Place the muffins, hollow side up, on a cookie sheet or broiler pan. Broil/grill the tops for about 3 - 4 minutes or until toasted. Keep the broiler off the heat until time for the sorbet and serve with the warmed english muffins.

title: Fried ham (Lobster tail )
ingredients: 1 ham, cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 2 chicken bouillon cubes
instructions: Place ham in a skillet. Place skillet in medium heat. Add bouillon cubes. Cook until ham is lightly brown. Place ham in freezer bag. When cool enough to handle, remove stuffing from freezer bag, leaving about 1/4 inch around the ham. Pour ham, stuffing and enough water to cover the ham. Heat and stir till boiling. Drain on paper towel. Serve on a bed of browned lettuce.

Random Ingredients: garlic clove,salsa verde,white sugar,vegetable broth,monterey jack cheese,sauerkraut
title: Kraut and Sauerkraut Soup
ingredients: 1 cup dry salsa verde | 4 cans vegetable broth | 1 garlic clove, minced | 1 1/2 lbs sauerkraut, drained and rinsed | 1/2 cup white sugar | 1/2 cup shredded monterey jack cheese or 1/2 cup other mexican cheese
instructions: Combine the salsa verde, vegetable broth, garlic, and sauerkraut in a large saucepan. Cover and warm over low heat. Add sugar and salt as the soup is heating, stirring constantly. Serve immediately. Garnish with cheese.

title: Mirish Smoothie
ingredients: 1 cup low-fat amaretto ( or almond flavored liqueur ) | 1/2 cup caster sugar or 1/2 cup superfine sugar | 1/4 cup miracle whip
instructions: Add ingredients to a blender container, press down with the back of a spatula. Blend thoroughly for 10 seconds. Enjoy.

title: Homemade Salsa Al Cinco
ingredients: 2 cups heavy cream or 2 cups heavy whipping cream | 1 can tomato sauce
instructions: In a large stainless steel bowl, whip cream until stiff peaks form. Spread cream in the bottom of a 3 quart serving bowl. Spread half the tomato sauce in a 9 pie plate. Then spread half the cream over the tomato sauce and spread cream over the cream. Repeat layers until cream is gone. Add remaining tomato sauce and top with reserved cream. Chill in refrigerator for at least 4 hours, or, overnight, before serving.

Random Ingredients: natural peanut butter,tomato,yellow squash,cider vinegar,arborio rice,cornflour,water,cream tartar
title: Peanut Butter Rice Dressing
ingredients: 440 g tomatoes | 310 g yellow squash, cut into 3cm cubes | 310 g arborio rice | 1/2 cup water | 1 1/2 tablespoons smooth natural peanut butter | 2 tablespoons light sour cream tao liqueur or 2 tablespoons cider vinegar | 2 teaspoons cornflour or 2 teaspoons rice flour | 1 teaspoon cider vinegar or 1 teaspoon red wine vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar
instructions: Chop tomatoes & squash into 3cm cubes. Combine with rice and combine lightly to combine. Combine peanut butter, sour cream, vinegar, corn flour or rice flour, cornstarch & cream of tartar, mix well. Pour dressing over rice & vegetables, mix well until well mixed. Cover & chill 1 hour before serving.

title: Rigatoni With Black Cardamom and Eggs
ingredients: 12 large eggs | 12 large fresh black cardamom pods, coarsely crushed
instructions: Put the eggs in a saucepan of simmering water and whisk until almost set. Remove from the heat and let sit just enough to cool slightly. Melt the eggs in a deep saucepan or a skillet over medium heat, turning once, for 2 to 3 minutes until the whites are just set but the yolks can still be runny. Transfer half of the egg to a plate and allow to cool slightly.

Random Ingredients: tarragon vinegar,irish whiskey,black eyed pea,kosher salt
title: Irish Smoked Black-Eyed Pea Vinaigrette
ingredients: 1 can black-eyed peas, drained and rinsed | 1/4 cup tarragon vinegar | 1 tablespoon irish whiskey | 1 tablespoon kosher salt
instructions: In a blender, combine the black eyed peas, tarragon vinegar, whiskey, and salt. Puree until smooth, or pulse until combined.

Random Ingredients: irish cream,szechuan peppercorn,mineral water,beef broth,sesame seed
title: Beef in Peppercorns
ingredients: 1 cup filtered mineral water | 1 -2 cup beef broth | 1 tablespoon sesame seeds, toasted | 1 -2 teaspoon szechuan peppercorns, ground | 1 cup szechuan peppercorns, ground
instructions: Combine the water, beef broth and sesame seeds in a medium saucepan and bring to a boil. Skim as much froth as possible off the top and reduce heat to a simmer. Cover and cook until liquid is reduced to about 3 tablespoons, about 30 minutes. Strain through a fine mesh strainer through the cloth lined sieve. Store this stock at room temperature covered while you cook the meat. Add sesame seeds to the pot during the last 10 minutes of cooking and watch as they darken slightly when exposed. Serve on basmati rice.

Random Ingredients: italian seasoning,garam masala,cornmeal,saffron,peanut butter,red pepper flake,caster sugar
title: Sweet Corn Mixture With Peanut Butter
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups cornmeal, sifted | 1/2 cup plain low-fat peanut butter | 1/2 teaspoon saffron, crushed | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala, ground | 1/2 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 1/4 teaspoon ground dried italian seasoning | 1/4 teaspoon caster sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Grease a baking sheet and dust with corn meal / baking powder. Combine the cornmeal & peanut butter & add remaining ingredients & mix well. Bake in oven for 20 minutes, stirring every 5 minutes, until mixture turns golden & creamy. Remove from oven & allow to cool slightly. Serve as a spread on toasted pita bread & serve with indian flatbreads.

Random Ingredients: dark sesame oil,black pepper,prosciutto,shrimp,orange peel,pistachio,basmati rice
title: Prosciutto Shrimp & Rice
ingredients: 1/4 cup basmati rice, raw | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 6 ounces shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1 1/2 ounces prosciutto, diced ( about 2 slices ) | 1/4 cup chopped pistachios | 1 teaspoon orange peel, cut into slivers | crushed black pepper, to taste
instructions: Place rice in a bowl and add 3/4 cup water. Cover with plastic wrap and set aside for 15 minutes. Meanwhile, heat oil in a skillet over fairly high heat. Add shrimp and sauté 2 - 3 minutes. Add prosciutto, pistachios and orange peel. Cook 3 - 4 minutes. Add rice and stir. Remove from heat.

title: Steamed Oysters With Lobster and Pasta
ingredients: 20 fresh cremini mushrooms | 1 1/2 lbs small rigatoni pasta | 32 oysters | 1 lime
instructions: Start the water to boiling in a large pot. Chop the mushrooms and place them in the boiling water. While the mushrooms are boiling, boil the rigatoni until it is al dente. Drain the rigatoni and place it in a large shallow bowl of cold water. Drain the lobster and place it, cut side down, on a paper towel lined plate. Dip 4 oysters in the water and set aside. Place the mushrooms and lime juice on a cutting board and place them at the edge of the seaweed. Top with more crab, lobster, and mushrooms. Serve the oysters on a bed of croutons.

title: White Chocolate Lasagna
ingredients: 16 lasagna noodles, oven ready | 1 cup white chocolate, semi-sweet | 12 ounces beer | 16 drained capers
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Cook noodles until al dente. Drain and set aside. Place two layers of lasagna noodles in a pyrex bowl, approximately 3/4 inch thick and slightly overlapping each slice. Spoon approximately half of the white chocolate sauce over noodles in bowl. Top with a handful of capers. Repeat layers. Place in oven on 350f for 20 minutes or until top is nicely browned and cheese is melted.

title: Greek Yogurt Shake
ingredients: 8 fluid ounces yoghurt | 1/4 teaspoon mustard powder | 1 teaspoon garlic | 1/2 cup pecorino romano cheese | some maraschino cherry, chopped, optional for garnish
instructions: Place all the ingredients in a blender. Mix until smooth. Serve in a clear glass bowl garnished with pistachios, nuts or some other fancy garnishes.

Random Ingredients: heavy whipping cream,cilantro stem,colby monterey jack cheese,irish whiskey,farfalle pasta,great northern bean,spice,swiss cheese
title: The King and Queen's Four-Cheese White Bean Casserole
ingredients: 14 ounces great northern bean, undrained | 2 scoops heavy whipping cream | 1 tablespoon irish whiskey, or more to taste | 1 teaspoon dried mixed spice | 1 cup shredded colby-monterey jack cheese, divided | 1 cup shredded swiss cheese, divided | 12 fresh cilantro stems, chopped, divided | 1 package uncooked farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Spread the beans with cream in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Bake in the preheated oven until warmed through and golden brown on the edges, 20 to 30 minutes. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook the bow tie pasta at a boil, stirring occasionally, until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 12 minutes. Drain. Mix the irish whiskey, cooked beans, 1 cup shredded colby monterey jack cheese, and swiss cheese in a bowl. Arrange bean mixture in the prepared baking dish, overlapping it slightly if necessary. Sprinkle with cilantro stems.

Random Ingredients: garlic granule,beef chuck,brussels sprout,plum tomato,baking soda,ketjap manis,rose water,peanut oil
title: Jamaican Beef Stewed Brussels Sprouts(Pressure Cooker)
ingredients: 2 lbs beef chuck or 2 lbs tip roast, cut into 2 inch cubes | 1 can brussels sprouts ( or other vegetable sprouts ) | 2 tablespoons ketchup ( ketjap manis ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons baking soda | 2 teaspoons ground rose water | 1 teaspoon garlic granules | 3 medium plum tomatoes | 1 tablespoon peanut oil ( or other neutral tasting oil )
instructions: In pressure cooker, place all the ingredients except the brussels sprouts. Lock the lid in place, and set to high heat for 5 minutes. Select quick release or quick release release. Do not drain the brussels sprouts or discard liquid, just rinse them and pat dry. With a sharp knife, slice the brussels sprouts into 1 inch cubes. Discard any slices that fall off. Add to pressure cooker. Over medium high heat, bring brussels sprouts to boil in a large pot of water. Reduce heat to simmer, cover, and cook 7 minutes. Remove cover and cook 15 minutes or until brussels sprouts are tender. You may have to add water in 1/2 cup increments to give the dish a consistent thickness for the cooking process. This should take about 20 minutes. While the brussels sprouts are cooking, heat oil in a small pan. Sauté brussels sprouts over medium high heat for 2 minutes. Remove from heat, drain, then stir into the stew. If desired, serve with steamed rice and other accompaniments of your choice.

title: Queso Pepperoni Casserole
ingredients: 1 bag frozen pepperoni | 2 cups diced ripe papayas | 1 1/2 cups vegetable broth | 1 package mexican chocolate, grated | 2 tablespoons nonfat milk | 1 tablespoon mrs. dash seasoning
instructions: Place pepperoni, pepaya, vegetable broth, chocolate, milk, and seasoning in casserole dish. Cover and bake at 350 degrees f for 40 minutes.

Random Ingredients: chuck roast,lasagna noodle,heirloom tomato,cherry tomato,pepperoncini pepper,cherry,chili garlic sauce
title: Slow-Cooker Beef-Crock Pot Lasagna
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless chuck roast, tips sliced | 13 cherry tomatoes, halved | 15 cherry tomatoes, halved large | 1 jar pepperoncini peppers | 8 ounces cherry tomatoes, halved | 2 tablespoons heirloom tomatoes, italian style, cut into 3/4-inch slices | 1 1/2 tablespoons chili-garlic sauce | 12 lasagna noodles, fresh
instructions: Place chuck roast tips in a slow cooker. Spoon cherry tomatoes around meat. Top with cherry tomatoes, pepperoncini peppers, cherry tomatoes, chili garlic sauce, and 2 of the sliced green onions. Cover and cook on high for 8 - 10 hours or on low for 7 - 9 hours, depending on your slow cooker. When cooked through, place 2 lasagna noodles flat on a microwave safe plate, and microwave on high for 1/2 an additional minute to lightly cook noodles. Remove meat from the slow cooker, stir into noodle mixture, and serve sauce over noodles.

title: Spanish Potatoes
ingredients: 4 small yukon gold potatoes | 12 ounces mixed spice mix | 1/2 cup sultana | 1/2 cup fresh cilantro
instructions: Place potatoes on foil lined large baking sheet. Bake at 400 for 15 to 20 minutes, or until tender but not mushy. Drain and run under cold water. Transfer to bowl and add sultanas, cilantro and mix thoroughly. Serve hot, cold or room temperature.

title: Lentil Ring Bites
ingredients: 1 pound green lentils, rinsed and picked over | 1/3 cup unflavored gelatin | 3/4 cup cold water, or as needed | 1 package rigatoni pasta
instructions: Place lentils in a saucepan and cover with about 3 cups water. Soak on low heat until lentils are tender, about 45 minutes. Drain and place in a bowl. Pour 1/3 cup boiling water over gelatin, then stir to blend. Pour gelatin mixture over lentils. Allow to soften until gelatin is firm. Cook rigatoni in a large pot of lightly salted boiling water until just tender, about 8 minutes. Drain and place in a large bowl with cold water. Toss with remaining gelatin to coat. Place roni rigatoni mixture in the center of a graham cracker. Top with roni. Crumble remaining roni over cheese and place on top of crust. Chill until set, about 1 hour.

title: Cajun Spice Islands - Caribbean
ingredients: 1 teaspoon hot pepper sauce | 1 teaspoon ground serrano pepper
instructions: Combine the hot pepper sauce and the ground pepper together. Store the mixture in an airtight tumbler. Use as directed in recipes calling for hot pepper sauce.

title: Indian Sausage Sandwiches
ingredients: 2 1/2 pounds hot italian sausage | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 1 teaspoon garam masala | 1 pinch ground nutmeg | 2 bay leaves | 1 loaf french bread, cut lengthwise into 8 slices and toasted
instructions: Crumble sausage into a large frying pan over medium heat, and cook until evenly browned, breaking it up into crumbles. Drain excess fat, add cornstarch, garam masala and nutmeg. Toss to coat. Arrange bread slices on a serving dish, and serve immediately with sausage.

title: Golden Raisin Cheese Triangles
ingredients: 1 box frozen puff pastry sheet, thawed ( approximately 20 sheets ) | 2 cups golden raisins | 1 celery rib, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f line 12 muffin cups with parchment paper. Place raisins in a medium bowl.

title: Grilled Filet Flank Steak (Skewered Beef Tenderloin)
ingredients: 3 lbs beef tenderloin, cut 1 inch thick
instructions: Preheat your grill. Trim any fat from the beef. Place the beef between 2 sheets of wax paper. Using a mallet, pound the meat very thin, about 1/8 inch thick. Cut a slit in the thickest part of the beef. Insert a skewer in the strip of beef. Heat grill to medium, or set setting the broiler to high. Lightly oil the grates and oil the grates. Cook beef 4 minutes on each side, or to desired doneness.

title: Carbonara - Giant Edges and Beans
ingredients: 300 g fresh green beans, trimmed, peeled and cut into thirds | 50 g fresh yeast | 400 g tapioca | 2 limes | 1 ounce olive oil | 3/4 cup olive oil | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: Place the beans, yeast and 1 1/2 cups warm water in a large bowl and make sure all is covered in water. Leave for 10 minutes or until frothy. Stir to combine. Place in a large lidded glass jar, cover and prove in a warm spot for 45 - 50 minutes. After 45 minutes remove from the draft and stir well until the surface is clear. Drain off any excess water. Place the remaining water in a saucepan and add the olive oil. Once the water boils add the vanilla and leave to stand for 20 minutes. Pour the oil from the jar and set aside for the beans. Dice the remaining limes and set aside. Once the beans have grown and become more difficult to manage, break them apart with your hands so that the skins break off easily. Place in a large pot with the olive oil, vanilla and sugar. Allow this simmer. When the liquid reduces by half and the mixture is reduced again, stir in the finely chopped limes which will help the flavour develop. Cover the pot and leave until the beans are completely dried.. After 20 minutes remove the lid, add the lime juice and let the mixture sit for 10 minutes.

title: Smoked Smoked Beef
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless beef chuck, cut in 1-inch cubes | 4 slices provolone cheese | 1 envelope dry onion soup mix | 2 tablespoons dried minced onion soup mix | 2 ounces smoked salmon
instructions: Place beef, cheese, onion soup mix and dried onion soup mix in crockpot. Cover and cook 12 hours on low setting, or 4 hours on high setting. Serve over mashed potatoes.

title: Fish With Chilli Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 5 red chilies, deseeded | 1/2 cup prune, stoned | 5 catfish fillets
instructions: Cut fish into 6cm wide strips by 3cm long. Place chilli, prunes and 1 1/2 tbsp of the anchovy paste in a mortar and pound to a smooth paste. Brush 1 tbsp of anchovy paste over each piece. Place the fish in a shallow bowl and top with remaining paste. Cover and leave for 1 hour to marinate at room temperature. Drain fish and leave on paper towels. Cook the remaining anchovy paste in a small frying pan, uncovered, until fragrant. Remove from heat, stir in remaining 1 tbsp anchovy paste and serve with fish.

Random Ingredients: dark sesame oil,apple,brown lentil,green cardamom pod,sesame seed,ra el hanout spice mix,flat leaf parsley,red cabbage
title: Lentils and Apple Salad
ingredients: 1 cup brown lentils ( such as french haricot rins ) | 2 tablespoons sesame seeds | 1 tablespoon sesame seeds | 7 green cardamom pods | 1/2 red cabbage, shredded | 2 apples, cored and thinly sliced into bite-sized wedges ( about 2 cups ) | 1/4 cup finely chopped flat leaf parsley | 3 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 2 tablespoons ras el hanout spice mix
instructions: Place lentils in a saucepan with 2 1/2 cups water and bring to a boil. Reduce heat, cover, and simmer until lentils are tender, 2 1/2 to 3 hours. Drain well and transfer lentils to a serving bowl. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate until cold, at least 30 minutes. Meanwhile, toast sesame seeds in a dry, heavy cast iron skillet over medium heat, moving the pan often to promote smoke. Cook and stir for 2 minutes. Remove seeds and discard. Set aside. Place 5 cardamom pods in a dry skillet over medium heat and place a sheet of paper towels on the top. Place cardamom in skillet and toast, shaking the pan once, until fragrant, 1 to 2 minutes. Transfer cardamom to a mortar and pestle. Finely mince pods and add along with cabbage and apples to lentils. Mix coarsely with sesame seeds, then taste and adjust seasoning. Whisk together 1/4 cup warm water and remaining tablespoon sesame oil in a small bowl and pour over salad. Toss lightly and sprinkle with extra chopped chives. Serve salad alongside pita chips.

title: Hoisin' Eggplant (Eggplant) With Shrimp
ingredients: 1 large globe eggplant, with peel attached | 10 -12 large shrimp, peeled and deveined, tails left on | 1/3 cup green olive flavored glaze or 1/3 cup hoisin sauce | 6 hoagie rolls, split lengthwise | white pepper, to taste
instructions: Cut ends off the eggplant. Spierce the base with a fork, making sure that the pulp comes out. Slice the crosswise in 1/2 inch slices. Lay the slices on a parchment lined baking sheet in a single layer. Lightly brush the tops with olive oil. Sprinkle them with pepper. Bake in a preheated 450 degree oven for 10 to 15 minutes, until the eggplant is tender and the juice released has evaporated. Remove from oven, and let set for 3 minutes. Drizzle with the shrimp glaze, or to taste, and serve right away.

Random Ingredients: vanilla bean,rhubarb,italian salad dressing mix,chicken tender,cod fish fillet
title: Rhubarb Chicken
ingredients: 3 pounds chicken tenderloins, cut into thirds | 1 cup italian salad dressing mix | 1 vanilla bean, split lengthwise | 1 package frozen rhubarb, thawed and cut into 2 inch pieces | 2 pounds cod fish fillets, cut into chunks
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the chicken tenderloins, salad dressing mix, vanilla bean, and rhubarb. Cover, and refrigerate for at least 3 hours. Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Arrange the chicken pieces on the baking sheet. Bake in preheated oven for 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: tea,jumbo pasta shell,fenugreek leaf,iceberg lettuce,rye bread,green chilies,black cardamom pod
title: Yogurt with Fenugreek
ingredients: 1 small iceberg lettuce | 2 small firm green chilies | 1 fresh jumbo pasta shells | 1 pinch black cardamom pod | 2 teaspoons finely chopped fenugreek leaves | 1 cup low-fat plain yogurt | 8 slices rye bread, crusts removed
instructions: Break the iceberg lettuce into small pieces. Separate each into four sections, wash them and pat dry. Wash and cut up the chili pods. Separate the cardamom pods. Heat a frying pan on medium heat. Add the chili pods. Stir fry until fragrant. Remove from heat and place on a plate covered with paper towels. Turn heat to medium low. Add the fenugreek leaves and stir well. Stir every few seconds until the leaves turn light brown. Add the green chillies. Cook until the chillies have darkened slightly and become aromatic. Remove from heat. When cool enough to handle, press each of the softened chillies through a sieve. Stir the yogurt into the chilli mixture. Stir well. Spread 1/2 the yogurt mixture inside each of the four shells. Divide the lettuce among the shells. Top with a few chilies. Place the bread over the top of the shells. Place under the grill until the bread is browned on top and the cheese is melted. Serve while still warm, with some yogurt or yogurt on the side.

title: Texas Zucchini and Corn Salad
ingredients: 2 medium zucchini, sliced into rounds | 4 tablespoons pure maple syrup | 2 1/2 cups chunky salsa | 1 cup fresh corn, chopped, cooked in water to tenderize | 2 tablespoons liquid smoke | 2 tablespoons basil and italian parsley, shredded | 1/4 cup italian parsley, minced
instructions: Whisk all the salad ingredients together in large bowl, toss to coat. Drizzle with maple syrup and sprinkle with remaining parsley, if desired.

Random Ingredients: non vanilla yogurt,chicken bouillon powder,asafoetida powder
title: Homemade Freezer-N-Vietnamese Yogurt Powder
ingredients: 1/2 cup non-fat vanilla yogurt | 1/2 teaspoon instant chicken bouillon powder | 1 pinch asafoetida powder, or pinch hing
instructions: Place yogurt and bouillon in the freezer container of a food processor, or blender or food mill and process until smooth about 1 minute or until desired consistency, about 10 seconds, stopping the machine halfway through processing. Add asafoetida and process until incorporated into a smooth paste. Transfer to a resealable plastic bag and freeze about 1 hour or until solid and slushy, 10 to 12 hours. Turn out and let thaw before using. Serve as a sandwich filling, on bread, as a soup filling, or atop gluten free rolls.

title: Caramelized Carrots, Watermelon and Pecorino Cheese Salad
ingredients: 4 -6 baby carrots | 1/2 cup watermelon, sliced | 1/4 cup pecorino romano cheese or 1/4 cup pecorino romano cheese | 1/4 cup juice, v8 | 1 teaspoon onion powder
instructions: Place carrots in bowl, cover with cold water. Let cool, then add remaining ingrdients. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Drain and serve over fresh or chilled greens, such as arugula.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon cube,soymilk,confectioner sugar,chickpea,apple juice,pork chop
title: Sauerkraut
ingredients: 2 tablespoons soymilk | 1 beef bouillon cube | 1 can chickpeas | 1 apple - peeled, cored and shredded | 2 tablespoons confectioners'sugar | 1/2 cup apple juice, or as needed
instructions: Stir soy milk, beef bouillon cube, chickpeas, and apple in a bowl until well blended. Beat confectioners' sugar in a separate bowl until smooth. Gradually beat in apple juice. Pour the glaze into the pork chops and coat evenly.

Random Ingredients: broccoli,spanish chorizo,epazote,thyme leaf,burgundy wine,red potato,liquid smoke
title: Sopa De Burro (Spanish Chorizo Stew)
ingredients: 3 lbs broccoli, cleaned | 1 lb spanish chorizo, in 1 piece, chopped ( chorizo can be found in latin specialty food stores ) | 1/2 cup spanish chourico ( portuguese chorizo can be found in latin specialty food stores ) | 1 lb red potatoes, peeled, cut into quarters | 1/3 lb epazote, chopped | 1 tablespoon epazote ( spanish is the mexican oregano leaf, found in latin specialty food stores ) | 1 tablespoon smoke | 1 tablespoon liquid smoke
instructions: Combine all ingredient except liquid smoke, and bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer 1 hour or until potatoes are tender. Add liquid smoke if needed to increase heat. Add epazote. Serve over hot cooked jasmine rice.

Random Ingredients: oregano leaf,thyme sprig,beet,italian breadcrumb,vanilla yogurt,heavy whipping cream
title: Beets Stuffed With Yogurt and Oregano
ingredients: 8 beets, raw ( or 3 lbs ) | 1 cup fresh italian breadcrumb | 2/3 cup heavy whipping cream | 1/4 cup finely chopped fresh oregano leaves | 1/4 teaspoon finely chopped fresh thyme sprigs | 2/3 cup low-fat vanilla yogurt
instructions: Bring a small pot of salted water to boil. Place beets in boiling water. Cook until tender, about 15 minutes. Drain and cool in cold water. Peel beets. Using 1/2 cup breadcrumbs, mash beet until mixture resembles course meal. Transfer beets to a bowl and stir in remaining crumbs, heavy cream, oregano, thyme and yogurt. Chill. Preheat oven to 350°f. Remove beets from bowl and stir in remaining bread crumbs. Spoon mixture into a buttered shallow, 2 1/2 qt casserole dish. Bake, uncovered, for 90 minutes, or until tops are light golden brown. Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Roasted Chilli Wings

instructions: Preheat oven to 180 degrees celsius cut a 1/2 inch slit in each wings and reserve. Combine the chilli sauce ingredients and mix well. Wash and pat dry wings. Brush with the chilli sauce. Roast in oven for 1 - 2 hour or until brown. Serve with salads and pickles.

title: Horseradish Dressing
ingredients: 1/2 cup pecans, chopped | 1/2 cup dry white wine | 1 celery rib, finely diced | 1/2 teaspoon prepared horseradish, drained
instructions: Place pecans, wine and celery in small shallow bowl. Sprinkle with horseradish and toss to coat.

title: Paprika Salt
ingredients: 8 cups raw bread ( day old is best ) | 1 2/3 pints yeast ( or 100g sachet ) | 1 bunch fresh herbs ( or a combination of these ) or 1 bunch fresh herb, chopped ( or a combination of these )

Pile onto lightly greased oven trays and let rise until double. Bake on top rack of oven at 200°c for about 15 minutes until light golden brown and crisp.

title: Hot & Spicy   Chicken
ingredients: 500 g baby peas | 500 g baby english peas | 2 teaspoons instant coffee powder | 2 teaspoons chili paste | 1 1/2 teaspoons vanilla essence | salsa ( optional )
instructions: Place in a microwave safe dish with the peas, instant coffee powder and chilli paste. Cook on auto for 10 miutes, add the essence. Serve hot with salsa.

Random Ingredients: chili powder,madeira wine,taco seasoning mix,rotel tomato,mustard,milk chocolate

title: Elderberry Rice

instructions: Combine all ingredients in stock pot and bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer covered for 45 minutes. Remove from heat immediately and store covered.

title: Zuccchini Salad

instructions: Toss zucchini slices with olive oil and cardamom.

title: Sizzling Amaretto Sherry

instructions: Pour amaretto, turmeric, and sherry into a glass. Stir. If you want to double, add 1/4 ounce in a shaker.

instructions: Fill a medium nonstick skillet with water. Bring to a boil. Add the oysters and cook on the lowest heat possible setting for 5 minutes. Turn them over and repeat until all the shells have been removed. Cut off the top shell of each oyster and open them out. Fill the shells with sauce and place a small handful of provolone cheese on top. If all 4 shells have been opened and the cheese begins to melt, stir the filling together a few minutes until the cheese is completely melted.

ingredients: 10 ounces spanish olives, pitted with the stalks removed | 2 cans water chestnuts, drained and coarsely chopped | 1 1/2 tablespoons ground cumin | 1 -2 teaspoon instant espresso powder | 1 teaspoon freshly squeezed lemon juice or 1 teaspoon lime juice | 1 tablespoon olive oil ( optional ) | water, to moisten
instructions: Place olives in a small bowl. Combine water chestnuts, water chestnuts powder, cumin and espresso powder and stir well. Add olive oil and whisk briskly. Pour over olives and stir. Cover and chill 1 to 2 hours. Serve with plain white rice.

ingredients: 2 cups dry bread ( italian or french ) | 3/4 cup water chestnut, drained | 1 tablespoon fresh dill, chopped ( or 1 tbls. dried dill weed-found on box isle ) | 1 teaspoon fennel seed, crushed ( or 1 tsp. ground fennel ) | 4 tablespoons icing sugar ( more to taste ) | 1 lb romano cheese, grated ( can use mozzarella ) | fennel seed, also called rosemary ( optional ) | 1 can solo refried beans ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. For the white bean filling spread bread in a 9 inch pie dish. Press it dry with your palms. Fold in half and cut a slit down the center of the loaf in the middle. Place on baking sheet. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes or until golden brown. Serve warm with solo.

title: Spicy Noodle Salad
ingredients: 500 g angel hair pasta | 400 g good quality tarragon | 60 ml vinegar | 40 ml maraschino cherry juice | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh coriander | celery ( optional )
instructions: Heat oil in large pan, when hot add noodles, tossing to coat in oil. Remove from heat, add vinegars and maraschino cherry juice, if using, add herbs now if using. Pour over noodles and toss. Serve with a wedge of celery if desired.

instructions: Place all ingredients in a cheese cloth bag or large container and tie with twine. Seal in a cool dark place for up to 1 week. Shake off excess water before freezing.

title: Tofu and Veggies
ingredients: 1/4 lb firm tofu | 1 cup prepared yellow squash
instructions: Cut the tofu into 1/4 inch slices and cut the slices into 1 inch cubes. Bake at 350 degrees fahrenheit for about 20 minutes or until done. While the tofu is baking, steam the squash for about 20 minutes, or until it gets translucent. Place the tofu on a paper towel lined baking sheet and toss with warm squash. Set aside for about 10 more minutes, then serve.

Random Ingredients: red bell pepper,red potato,green curry paste
title: Cabbage and Potatoes
ingredients: 2 cups chopped red potatoes | 3 cups chopped green curry paste | 1 red bell pepper, chopped
instructions: Spray a large skillet with cooking spray and saute potatoes and curry paste until potatoes are tender. Mix in bell pepper and heat through.

Random Ingredients: mint,pesto,confectioner ' sugar,polenta,ricotta cheese,tomato paste,italian breadcrumb,chili paste garlic
title: Pesto Italian Baked Tomatoes
ingredients: 4 medium ripe tomatoes or 2 lbs fresh tomatoes, in one layer | 1/2 cup parmesan-reggiano cheese, grated ( about 1/4 cup ) | 1/2 cup pesto | 1/2 cup italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 1 tablespoon flour | 3 tablespoons pesto | 2 tablespoons tomato paste | 2 teaspoons italian chili paste with garlic | 1/4 teaspoon dried mint | 2 teaspoons confectioners'sugar
instructions: Place the tomatoes on a foil lined baking sheet. Paint the top with the 3 tablespoons of the parmesan reggiano cheese. Bake at 400°f/190°c for 5 minutes. Pour reserved tomato juice over meat, scraping off any scum. Cover and bake, in preheated oven, 1 3/4 to 4 hours or until fork tender.

Random Ingredients: lemon,baking potato,tomato green chilies,gelatin,white sugar,rump roast
title: Lemon Roasted Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 lemon, juiced and zested | 1 cup lemon juice, divided | 2 tablespoons white sugar, divided | 1 pound rump roast | 2 teaspoons unflavored gelatin | 5 medium baking potatoes
instructions: In a glass bowl, combine 1 cup lemon juice and 1 tablespoon sugar. Add beef.

title: Ancho Chile Con Queso
ingredients: 1 packet sauce | 1/2 teaspoon fennel seed, crushed | 1 teaspoon dried ancho chile powder, crushed
instructions: Combine all of the ingredients in a bowl and stir well. Enjoy,.

instructions: Baked baguette slices, line baking sheet with parchment. Trim ends from coriander root and cut into 4 pieces lengthwise. Put raisins in bowl and cover with several inches of water. Roast in a pre heated oven 25 minutes or until golden brown. If desired, place raisins on serving platter. Cut top off french bread and discard in slices.

Random Ingredients: ziti pasta,blueberry,chunky salsa,pork sausage,shiitake mushroom,oil,dill weed,italian herb seasoning
title: Jambalaya from the Times

instructions: In a wide frying pan, pour 1/4 of dressing over salmon fillets. Set aside in a cool place for 30 minutes or until fish flakes into large flakes while fillets are cooking. title: Brazilian Prawns

instructions: Heat oven to 200c. In an ovenproof dish, heat the bell pepper and cracked black pepper on a rack for about 30 seconds, until the peppers become transparent. title: Herbes De Provence

instructions: Mix one tablespoon of dried thyme leaves with two tablespoons of olive oil. Heat oven to 325°f. title: Moroccan-Style Beef and Bean Meal

instructions: Melt preserves in a skillet over medium low heat, but do not boil. Stir about 1 tablespoon of the melted preserves into the chocolate just before removing it from the heat. title: Chili Cheese Baked Ziti

instructions: Spray an 8x8 baking dish with nonstick cooking spray and set aside. Prepare a large bowl of your favorite baking mix. After 15 - 20 minutes of soaking, fluff up rice and fluff up again. Pour the contents of the bowl into the rice and stir to mix well. Serve immediately.

title: Capsicum and Barley Soup (With Irish Cream)

instructions: Place the capsicum in a medium saucepan, with 1 tablespoon lime rind, juice and 1/4 cup warm water. title: Basil Chutney

title: Mexican Tuna Skewers

title: Brazilian Pear Soup

instructions: Peel the pears well and cut off the tip if it has any pith, cut off the bottom part only and discard any that are very dark colored. title: Homemade Sherry Crackers

instructions: Combine all ingredients except pepper strips and cheese. Stir well. Add peppers. Stir in cheese. Sprinkle with additional parmigiano, if desired. Store in container in refrigerator.

instructions: In a small bowl, make marinade by mixing together barbecue sauce with lime juice and peppermint extract.

title: Lentils in Greens
ingredients: 1 lb green lentil | 7 -8 fresh spinach, rinsed and roughly chopped ( or just use frozen and thawed ) | 1 teaspoon dried thyme leaves | 4 -6 cups fine breadcrumbs | fresh white pepper | white pepper
instructions: Bring lentils to boil in 2 cups of water and boil for 2 minutes. Reduce heat and cook, covered for about 15 - 15 minutes or until lentils are tender. In the meantime, prepare spinach according to package instructions while lentils are cooking drain the spinach and rinse well and squeeze out excess water. Combine all ingredients except bread crumbs and pepper in a large bowl. Add just enough bread crumbs to bind together, or to your desired texture. Roll into little balls the size of a golf ball and then coat well with bread crumbs. Heat an iron skillet for a few minutes and then add the balls and fry until brown on all sides. Remove from skillet onto paper towels to drain. Serve with lemon wedges and fresh fruit.

title: Low-Fat Chickpeas and Kale
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups chickpeas, cooked ( organic chickpeas are also good for this ) | 1 bunch fresh kale | 1 teaspoon dried dill or 4 tablespoons fresh dill, chopped | 1 teaspoon dried marjoram or 1 tablespoon fresh marjoram, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon spicy spices, advieh ( found in ethnic section of indian grocery stores and is usually sold in packets or spice aisle of indian food market ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons poultry seasoning, any or all | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried dill or 1 1/2 teaspoons dried dill
instructions: Wash and drain beans. Wash kale well. Split down middle, then cut into 1 inch lengths. Rinse and drain dill. Cut kale lengthwise into 1/4 inch wide strips. Stack the strips and set aside. Trim tops and bottoms of greens, and cut down sides so they have a uniform size bunch, just like you're cutting a french loaf. Rinse spinach well. Remove leaves individually and cut into 1 1/2 inch lengths. Combine greens, dill, spices, advieh, and 3 teaspoons of the dill mixed with water in a small bowl. Add as much seasoning as you like to flavor, but no exact measurement.

title: Thai Oven Roasted Veggies
ingredients: 1 tablespoon olive oil | 2 teaspoons minced fresh ginger root | 2 teaspoons minced garlic salt | 6 medium zucchini, cut into thick slices | 6 medium chilies, deseeded and deveined, sliced | 2 tablespoons icing sugar, or as needed
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Warm olive oil in a small skillet over medium heat. Stir in ginger, garlic salt, and zucchini.

title: Angel Hair and Chicken Salad
ingredients: 1 package uncooked angel hair pasta | 2 pounds andouille chicken meat, cut into bite size pieces | 1 package fresh salad, leaves separated
instructions: In a large pot of salted boiling water, cook angel hair pasta according to package directions. Stir in chicken, andouille. Drain pasta and chicken mixture, reserving 1/2 cup of the cooking liquid. Add reserved cooking liquid and stir to mix. Place salad leaves over the top, and serve.

Random Ingredients: food coloring,golden raisin,tomato green chilies,margarine,oregano,bamboo shoot
title: Cheese Boardwalk Tomatoes
ingredients: 4 ripe tomatoes and green chilies ( i used 2 ) | 12 grape-sized bamboo shoots, sliced into strips ( or 2 of each if canned ) | 1/2 cup margarine | 1 1/2 teaspoons oregano | 1/4 teaspoon food coloring | 1/4 cup golden raisin ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons canned green chilies
instructions: Drain tomatoes on paper towels. Using 1tablespoon margarine, mix together tomato/green chilies, remaining margarine and oregano, food coloring and raisins. Arrange in 2 1/2 quart baking dish or 2 individual ramekins. Cover with plastic wrap and chill for at least 1 hour. Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Uncover and bake for about 10 - 15 minutes or until tomatoes are lightly browned. If desired you may sprinkle green chilies on top to taste.

title: Hot Dog
ingredients: 1 lb sausage | 1 bag dry roasted peanuts
instructions: Preheat oven to 375. In a skillet, brown sausage. Remove. Add peanuts and saute for a few minutes. Put in a 9x13 inch baking pan then add the peanuts to the sausage/peanuts. Bake in preheated oven for 15 to 20 minutes, stirring frequently.

title: Red Kid Beans in Soy Milk
ingredients: 400 g dried red kidney beans | 1/4 cup soymilk | 3 tablespoons sweet paprika
instructions: Pour the soy milk into a large saucepan over medium heat, bring to boil then reduce the heat and simmer for 5 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in the paprika. Cover and leave for 15 minutes to absorb any oil or remaining liquid.

title: Linguine With Cheddar & Potato Glaze
ingredients: 1 cup catsup or 1 cup heinz ketchup | 1 1/2 cups shredded cheddar cheese | 1 box linguine or ( 5 1/2 ounce ) box dried linguine | 1 1/2 tablespoons potato starch
instructions: Prepare the pasta according to package directions. While waiting for the pasta to come to a boil, combine all ingredients together in a small bowl and whisk together until smooth. Drain the linguine into a large bowl. Toss with catsup mixture, coating and rinsing out the pasta. Serve immediately or allow to chill in the refrigerator and serve as per instructions.

title: Shrimp & Rice With Zucchini
ingredients: 12 slices toast, i use french bread ( or use pumpernickel ) | 1 lb large shrimp, peeled and deveined ( optional ) | 2 zucchini, sliced crosswise into 1/4 inch thick slices ( or use as many as you like ) | 2 tablespoons italian seasoning | 1/2 tablespoon splenda granular | 2 2 cups cooked black rice or 2 cups cooked white rice
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Place toast on a parchment covered or silpat baking sheet and toast in oven for 5 minutes, stirring half way through. Remove and cool for a few minutes. Slice zucchini thin on the mandolin. Spray a 10 x 15 inch jellyroll pan with cooking spray, or lightly oil it with pam. Place zucchini slices on top of bread, if using, and spread shrimp on top, then sprinkle zucchini slices over shrimp and zucchini. Sprinkle italian seasoning and splenda on top. Cover, and bake for 1 hour, or until shrimp are just cooked through, and zucchini are tender..

title: Meat Stuffed Peppers
ingredients: 1 kg sweet potato | 1 eggplant | 1/2 kg italian sausage | 150 g sweet potato | 200 g ground turkey | 1/4 cup tomato paste | 1 tablespoon dried tarragon | 1/4 cup ground walnuts | 2 teaspoons bicarbonate of soda | 1 tablespoon dried tarragon
instructions: First, wash and peel the sweet potato. Then, remove the core from the eggplant and use a mandolin to scrape the flesh out of the plant and the soft inside, then peel away the skin and the outer membrane. Cut off the outer papery rind from the tomato paste with a vegetable peeler, then rinse if necessary. Stir the tomato paste into the sweet potato, then add the sweet potato and break apart the slices with your hands. Then, take the sweet potato mixture, mix thoroughly, then divide into 10 - 12 small round peppers, depending on the size of your peppers. Set each stuffed pepper on its side and place into a bowl of water, so that they are not touching on the wall of the bowl, if necessary. Make sure that the sweet potato mixture reaches the level of the potato mixture, then drain thoroughly. Mix the ground turkey and the tomato paste through the potato mixture. Gently mix through the tarragon, then stuff with the turkey mixture. Finally, sprinkle the walnuts and some dried tarragon on top. Place peppers into a pan with enough water to cover the peppers a bit. Bring to boil then boil the peppers over medium heat for about 2 hours. Turn off the heat and leave the peppers for about 1 more hour. If you want a thicker sauce, boil for about 15 minutes longer, then mix through the bicarb of soda, then taste for season, adding salt and if not used up, more salt. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: vanilla,san marzano tomato,baby green,hoisin sauce,seasoning salt,vinegar,yellow squash,orecchiette
title: Oriental Omelet Surprise!
ingredients: 10 -12 ounces orecchiette ( or other egg shaped pasta ) | 1 -2 tablespoon hoisin sauce | 1 can san marzano tomatoes | 1 yellow squash | 1 small baby green | 1 teaspoon dried oregano ( or 1 tbsp fresh oregano, minced ) | 1/2 teaspoon steak seasoning salt | 1 teaspoon vinegar ( your favourite flavour, of choice )
instructions: Cook pasta in boiling water until al dente. While pasta is cooking slice the squash length ways into thin slices, about 1/8 inch thick. Set aside. Slice the tomato about 1/4 inch thick and set aside. Cut squash slice in half length ways and set aside. Heat up a wok or large frying pan over medium high heat and add the sauce mixture. As desired add in the tomatoes and stir fry for 10 - 15 minutes till the tomatoes are all soft and the squash is cooked. Remove the cooked pasta from the heat, toss in the green squash, add the hoisin sauce and stir in well. Add the oregano and steak seasoning salt and vinegar to taste. Add the tomatoes and squashes and stir to combine. Serve.

Random Ingredients: rose water,vanilla extract,nonfat cream,cremini mushroom,rye flour,salmon steak
title: Wild Berry Smoked Salmon With Cremini Mushrooms
ingredients: 10 ounces cremini mushrooms, fresh | 2 tablespoons nonfat sour cream | 1 tablespoon nonfat sour cream | 1 tablespoon rose water | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract | 2 salmon steaks
instructions: Wipe mushrooms and cut into 1 inch sticks. In a bowl mix the nonfat sour cream, rose water, and vanilla until well mixed and set aside. Rinse salmon and pat dry. Place on a parchment lined baking sheet. Spoon about 1/4 cup of the prepared mushroom mixture onto the salmon and top with the mushrooms. Bake in a preheated 425°f oven until mushrooms are tender and fish flakes easily with a fork, about 10 minutes.

title: Tatties With Fruit and Smoked Beef
ingredients: 24 slices thick cut white bread, toasted | 14 slices bacon | 10 ounces smoked extra lean ground beef or 10 ounces lean ground beef, such as deli-blend | 2 cups cooked fresh fruit, diced ( such as pears, strawberries ) | 1 tablespoon instant chicken bouillon | 2 teaspoons tamari | 2 bay leaves
instructions: Cook bacon in a large skillet over medium heat until crisp. Remove bacon to paper towels, drain, reserving fat in skillet. To drippings in skillet, add ground beef and brown.
