Add canned fruit, and cook stirring often until heated through. Meanwhile, toast bread slices and brush with reserved bacon fat. Add 2 slices toast, bacon and beef mixture to skillet. Cook until lightly browned. Remove to a serving serving platter. Spoon the fruit and beef mixture over bread, and serve with tamari and bay leaves.

Random Ingredients: rice vermicelli,fenugreek seed,chili pepper flake,white wine
title: Fried Noodle from Scratch With White Wine (Vietnamese Fideo Congee)
ingredients: 1/2 lb rice vermicelli, preferably long skinny | 2 tablespoons white wine or 2 tablespoons dry vermouth | 1 1/2 tablespoons ground dried chili pepper flakes ( thai hot pepper ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons fenugreek seeds
instructions: Remove from refrigerator. Break noodles and soak in cold water for 20 minutes to 20 minute. Drain noodles in colander. Mix wine and chili and stir fry noodles over medium heat for 2 - 3 minutes. Stir in fenugreek and serve.

title: Spicy Asparagus in Tomato Cream Sauce
ingredients: 3 lbs asparagus | 1 tablespoon fresh ground black pepper | 1 tablespoon coriander powder | 1 tablespoon seasoning | 1 tablespoon tomato puree, ketchup | 1 1/4 cups nonfat milk
instructions: Wash asparagus and cut on the stem end into 2 inch pieces. Boil the asparagus in plenty of water with a splash of lemon juice added. When they are cooked, transfer the pieces to a heavy bottomed skillet. Add seasoning and tomato puree to the skillet. Heat sauce on low fire until it becomes thick. Pour sauce over asparagus. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: dark rum,french onion soup,kosher salt,anchovy paste,blueberry
title: Red Wine Canapes
ingredients: 1 cup fresh blueberries | 1 can french onion soup | 1 tablespoon anchovy paste | 1 teaspoon dark rum | kosher salt
instructions: Open up the bag of fresh blueberries, and put in a microwave safe bowl. Add 1 can of french onion soup and half can of anchovy paste and dark rum. Mix thoroughly. Add 1/4 teaspoon salt to coat the blueberries well. Microwave for about 1/2 one minute, or until slightly warm and slightly darkened in color. If necessary, use a sharp kitchen knife to cut into pieces. Cool slightly before filling each can of french onion soup. If mixture seems a bit dry, microwave for another minute.

Random Ingredients: black eyed pea,rye bread,semolina flour,white wine,ice cube
title: Finnish Black Eyed Pea Soup
ingredients: 1 cup semolina flour | 1 1/2 quarts cold water | 2 1/2 pounds fresh cracked black-eyed peas | 2 1/2 tablespoons white wine | 2 ice cubes
instructions: Combine the semolina flour and 1 1/2 quarts cold water in a bowl, and mix to a smooth, thick paste with a fork. Cover, and let rest for at least 3 hours, but overnight is a nice option. Bring the black eyed peas and white wine to a boil in a large pot, and season with salt and pepper. Reduce heat to medium low, and simmer for about 5 minutes, or until liquid is reduced by half. Serve in bowls, filling for each bowl with about 1 cup black eyed peas.

title: Swiss Cheese Bread Stuffing
ingredients: 4 slices rye bread, or | 1/2 cup shredded swiss cheese | 1 tablespoon finely grated lemon peel | 1 cup leftover cooked swiss cheese blend, melted
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place one slice of bread, cut sides up, on a board and sprinkle with 1/4 cup swiss cheese and 1/2 teaspoon lemon peel.

Random Ingredients: lemon peel,cayenne,double cream,greek yogurt,salt,caster sugar,pistachio nut
title: Turkish Delight
ingredients: 250 g greek yogurt | 1/2 bunch pistachio nut, shelled | 30 g caster sugar ( superfine sugar ) | 1 teaspoon fresh lemon peel ( grated ) | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 2 dashes cayenne | 150 ml double cream
instructions: Line base and sides of a large shallow bowl with baking paper. Mix yoghurt, pistachios, sugar, lemon peel, salt, cinnamon and cayenne with a hand mixer until smooth. Add cream and beat until thick and free of graininess. Spoon half the yoghurt mixture into bowl and chill until firm.

title: Mint Chive Vinaigrette
ingredients: 6 leeks, trimmed lengthwise, washed and cut lengthwise into 1/2 inch wide strips | 2 -3 tablespoons of fresh mint leaves | 1 teaspoon ground cumin powder | 1/2 teaspoon clear honey | 2 -3 teaspoons chopped fresh chives or 2 -3 teaspoons mint leaves, to garnish
instructions: Place the leeks in a large glass or ceramic bowl or dressing container with the mint, cumin and honey. Pour the vinaigrette over the leeks and stir well to combine the ingredients. Taste and adjust seasoning so that the vinaigrette suits your taste. Cover and refrigerate for a minimum of 4 hours to allow the flavours to develop. Serve immediately, garnished with chopped fresh herbs before serving.

title: Italian Breadsticks
ingredients: 1/2 cup rye flour | 1/4 teaspoon dried basil leaves | 30 toothpicks
instructions: Place flour into a medium size bowl. Add the dried basil leaves. Sprinkle on rye flour. Using a pastry brush, brush the breadsticks with a little olive oil. Place toothpicks in a plastic bag and twist together. To freeze, thaw at room temperature for up to 2 days.

title: Red Chile Chili Gravy
ingredients: 32 ounces chicken broth | 1 red new mexico chile, seeded and chopped | pepper, to taste
instructions: In a medium sauce pan warm the chicken broth. Slice chile into thin strips and add them to the broth with the pepper. Cook on high heat until the mixture starts to bubble. Let simmer for about 20 minutes.

title: Tinga-Tasticana (Grape Tomatoes)
ingredients: 2 cups masa harina | 1 jar pickled roasted peppers and onions | 1 bunch fresh red seedless grapes
instructions: In a large bowl, mix masa harina with peppers and onions. Cut grapes in half and add to masa mixture. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Mix until smooth. Set aside for about 5 hours or more to allow flavors to meld. Serve.

title: Aunt Sharleen's Creamy Curried Beef
ingredients: 2 lbs beef blade roast | 1 cup half-and-half | 1 1/2 tablespoons jam | 3 -4 teaspoons mild curry powder, to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f. Place roast in a roasting pan. Place roasting pan in oven for at least 24 hours. The longer the roast sits in the pan the thicker it will become. After roasting, allow to cool and place in a crock pot. Mix half and half & jam, curry powder, and 1 - 2 tbsp of water.

Random Ingredients: grapeseed oil,orange,pasta shell,taco flour tortilla,olive oil,celery salt
title: Tortilla Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1 lb taco-size flour tortilla | 2 teaspoons grapeseed oil, divided | 1 celery salt, finely grated | 1 orange, peeled, sectioned, and cut into wedges | 1/2 cup olive oil | 1 jar roasted red peppers ( drained and cut into strips ) | 1 package dry pasta shell, cooked and cooled
instructions: Heat tortillas in 1 tbs. Oil in a 12 skillet over medium heat about 2 min. Turn, and brown both sides, stirring occasionally. Cool. In a small bowl, combine the celery salt and orange juice. Using a slotted spoon, remove the tortillas from the oil, place in a bowl, sprinkle with the celery salt mixture, and toss to combine. Toss the pasta with half the olive oil and the remaining olive oil.

title: Mexican Strawberry Salad
ingredients: 1 cup unsalted strawberries, quartered | 2 tablespoons salsa | 1 tablespoon chopped pitted peanuts | 1 package assorted vegetables, chilled | 2 tablespoons butter or 2 tablespoons margarine
instructions: Combine strawberries and salsa.

Random Ingredients: pizza crust,kalamata olive,green olive,bamboo skewer,arugula,cooking spray,plum sauce
title: Lighter Grilled Pizza
ingredients: cooking spray | 1 prepared pizza crust ( or homemade style crust ) | 1 cup commercial prepared plum sauce | kalamata olive | green olives | 3 cups arugula ( can use baby bok choy ) | 2 teaspoons bottled kalamata olive tapenade ( or use a bit of balsamic vinegar ) ( optional ) | 1/4 cup prepared pizza sauce or 1/4 cup plum sauce ( optional )
instructions: Heat grill or broiler. Heat oven to 375°f using 2 teaspoons olive oil spray and a large pinch of salt, grill or broil pizza crust. Brush with 1 tablespoon olive oil. Place on baking sheet. Brush lightly with 1/2 teaspoon olive oil. Bake 7 - 8 minutes until edges of crust are lightly browned. Remove from oven and spread pizza sauce or bruschetta on top. Top crust with arugula and olives. Brush the top with remaining oil. Wrap baking sheet with foil and bake for 15 minutes until crust. Reduce heat and lightly brown arugula. Top with sauce and serve warm.

title: Kale and Walnut Soup
ingredients: 3 cups cold milk | 4 cups finely chopped kale | 2 green bell peppers, seeded and finely chopped
instructions: Wash, trim, and finely chop the vegetables. In a medium saucepan, combine the milk and kale over medium heat. Bring to a boil, then simmer, uncovered, about 30 minutes or until kale is tender. Ladle hot soup into bowls and garnish with bell pepper.

Random Ingredients: juniper berry,yellow lentil,kidney bean,mustard,lemon wedge,escarole,coriander seed,roast pork
title: Beans and Bacon for a British Pub Lunch
ingredients: 1 lb yellow lentils | 2 tablespoons coriander seeds | 2 tablespoons mustard | 1 tablespoon juniper berries, crushed | 2 lbs fresh escarole, washed and thinly sliced | 1/2 lb thinly sliced good-quality roast pork | 4 -5 lemon wedge, to serve | 1 can kidney beans, drained
instructions: Toast coriander and mustard in large pan over medium heat for 1 minute, until fragrant, then cool. Put lentils in a large bowl and cover with cold water. Leave for 10 minutes. Drain. Place remaining ingredients except meat and lemon wedges in a large saucepan, bring to the boil, and simmer for 15 - 20 minutes or until lentils are cooked and quite soft. Remove from heat, cover and set aside. Grill or fry meat until done, about 8 - 10 minutes depending on the degree of doneness desired. Remove sausage and set aside. Bring lentils to the boil, reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes or until they are just tender. Dice meat and stir into lentils to blend.

title: Broiled Halibut
ingredients: 1 cup canned tomato puree | 1/4 cup all-purpose flour | 1 pound halibut fillets, cut into 4 pieces
instructions: Preheat an oven to 500 degrees f. In a medium bowl, stir together the tomato puree, flour, and tomato. Spread mixture evenly on top of fish, and cover with plastic wrap. Place the fish in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Cover with plastic wrap, and marinate fish in the refrigerator 30 minutes to 1 hour. Remove plastic wrap from dish, and remove fish. Cover the dish with aluminum foil. Arrange the fillets in a single layer on top of the tomato puree mixture. Place the baking dish on a baking sheet, and place a pan of water on top. Bake 25 to 30 minutes in the preheated oven, until fish flakes easily with a fork.

Random Ingredients: broccoli,mint,hot chili pepper,oil,vanilla extract,orange bell pepper,chili garlic sauce
title: Chili Hot Sauce
ingredients: 12 ounces fresh broccoli | 2 hot chili peppers | 2 tablespoons hot chili sauce | 1 tablespoon oil, any quantity | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1 teaspoon chopped of fresh mint ( optional ) | 1 orange bell peppers or 1 red bell pepper, diced ( optional )
instructions: Separate the leaves, stalks from the stalks, and boil for 3 - 5 minutes, or until cooked. In a saute pan brown the broccoli until tender, drain well, and rinse out the pan. Heat up oil in the saucepan. Add the chilies and chili sauce. Stir in the chopped mint, and cook over a low heat for 2 minutes. Add the chia mixture and cook for 1 - 2 minutes, or until hot, stirring frequently. Serve with sliced orange and bell peppers.

title: Spice Bread (For Bread Machine)
ingredients: 1 cup rice flour | 1 tablespoon spice ( your favourite spice
instructions: Measure all ingredients into bread pan of your bread machine, press start, add more spices, salt or nutmeg to taste. Turn on bread machine and walk away for 5 - 10 minutes. You can also add extra spices to spice mixture if you wish to. Let cool.

title: Orzo and Raisins With Chilies and Raisins
ingredients: 4 tablespoons unsalted butter | 12 small dried chili peppers ( or a few serrano chilies in adobo, finely chopped, seeds removed ) | 1/2 - 1 cup raisins ( to taste, can use golden raisins ) | 1/2 cup soymilk or 1/2 cup rice milk | 1 teaspoon dried oregano | 1/2 - 1 pod scraped vanilla bean, split lengthwise | 1 cup orzo pasta, cooked
instructions: In a large saucpan, melt 3 tbls. Of the butter over medium heat. Gently fry the chilies, stirring, until soft. If using the chilies, break a slit in the side of the pepper to release the seeds. If using the seeds, add them now after adding the butter.. Add to the pan. Add the raisins and soy milk. If using harissa, do not rinse, just add some. Continue cooking. In a small bowl combine oregano and the scraped vanilla bean and scrape out as much of the seeds as possible. Add that, too. Stir to combine with the soy milk mixture. Cook, stirring, for 2 minutes over med. Heat. Remove from heat. Set aside. In a pot, place the cooked orzo and let it sit covered for about 5 min so that water is absorbed. The rice should cook just a bit under the boiling water, but not excessively soft. Stir to combine. Serve topped with the raisins and chilies if desired.

Random Ingredients: pinto bean,turmeric powder,farfalle pasta,walnut,gruyere cheese,brown rice,tart cherry,lemon
title: Pasta With Pumpkin Seeds
ingredients: 1 lb dried pinto bean | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1/2 cup brown rice | 1/2 cup walnuts, toasted, chopped | 1/2 lemon, juice of | 2 tablespoons pared and finely chopped tart cherries, pitted | 12 ounces farfalle pasta | 2 ounces gruyere cheese, grated ( about 4 slices )
instructions: Put beans in a large pan, add water to cover and bring just to the boil. Reduce heat and simmer, uncovered, stirring occasionally for 1 1/2 hours or until the beans are very tender. Drain. Meanwhile, in a saucepan cook the rice with half the turmeric powder over medium. Stir constantly until the rice is toasted then add walnuts and cook until golden. Stir in lemon juice, cherry juice and remaining turmeric powder. Remove from heat. Cook the farfalle pasta in a big pot of boiling water until al dente according to package directions. Drain well. When beans are cool, in a saute pan combine the bean, walnuts and pumpkin with half of the cheese and lemon juice. Stir until the cheese has melted and the pasta is heated through. Serve with remaining cheese sprinkled on top.

title: Maple Syrup Tomatoes With Juniper Berries
ingredients: 550 g whole peeled cherry tomatoes | 10 -12 juniper berries, crushed | 2 tablespoons maple syrup
instructions: Bring 1 - 2 litre boiling water to the boil and add the strawberries. Cover and simmer about 20 minutes. Drain and place in a shallow glass. Bottle and refrigerate overnight to draw out the juices. Serve the next day with fresh tomato.

title: Neptuno Sciatto
ingredients: 1 lb fresh clams | 1 teaspoon sesame seeds | 3/4 teaspoon dried italian herb seasoning | 1 teaspoon dry wine
instructions: Scrub and scrub clams and remove as much of the sand or shells as possible. Place in a 6 quart enamel lined 4 to 6 qt pot. Add sesame seeds and italian seasoning. Dissolve wine by boiling for 2 to 3 minutes. Pour over clams and bring to a full rolling boil. Cover and reduce heat to a slow boil. Steam for 15 to 20 minutes. Serve immediately.

title: Vegan Taco Pasta
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked macaroni | 1 tablespoon taco seasoning mix | 1/2 cup chopped celery | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
instructions: Prepare dry macaroni according to package directions, omitting salt and fat. Drain. Meanwhile combine all ingredients except pasta and cook over medium heat for 5 - 10 minutes, or until pasta is tender.

Random Ingredients: tarragon vinegar,olive vegetable oil,jalapeno pepper,mexican cheese,cider vinegar
title: Jalapeno-Spiked Cheese Vinaigrette
ingredients: 5 -6 ounces sharp mexican cheese, in cubes | 4 tablespoons jalapeno peppers, with seeds ( or substitute a combination of jalapenos and serrano peppers ) | 4 tablespoons olive-light vegetable oil | 4 tablespoons cider vinegar | 3 tablespoons tarragon vinegar
instructions: Place a colander into a large bowl. Drain the cheese in cheesecloth bag and reserve the cheese liquid. Combine the cheese cubes, peppers, oil, cider vinegar, and tarragon vinegar in the cheesecloth bag. Shake the bag to blend everything well, cover, and refrigerate for at least two hours before serving.

title: Sourdough Bread
ingredients: 500 g strong white chocolate ( not unsweetened ) | 300 g fresh yeast | 1 teaspoon turmeric
instructions: Put your strong white chocolate and 100ml lukewarm water in a large jug and set aside. Mix the yeast and turmeric together, then use this to prepare the starter. When the chocolate has melted and the water is at a warm temperature, mix it into the starter. When the mixture has dissolved, mix in 2 tsp of salt. Leave in a warm place for 20 minutes.. To use, spread dough on baking paper. Knock the air out of your dough. Knead and cover with a large cloth so it doesn't become sticky. Leave in a warm place for 30 minutes, then kneed and shape into a loaf. Place the loaf on a lightly oiled baking paper lined tray. Leave until doubled, then bake at 250°c for around 7 – 10 minutes, depending on how well you like your bread. Remove the loaf from the oven, and allow to cool on a cooling rack. When completely cold, cut into slices and serve.

Random Ingredients: sirloin tip roast,milk ricotta cheese,ham,pork chop,roasting chicken
title: Pork and Ham Lasagne
ingredients: 4 -5 boneless pork chops | 4 -5 thin slices of your favourite ham, of your choice ( optional ) | 4 -5 slices roast chicken, with bone in ( optional ) | 3 packages whole milk ricotta cheese | 2 jars ragu milk pate
instructions: Slice the meat on the diagonal, into thin strips, across the grain. Place the ham, if using, and chicken in the freezer. Remove the meat from freezer once done, slice into thinner strips to make smaller pieces for lasagne. Take italian bread or lasagne containers you're going to use for the party. Place 1/3 of the sliced pork in the bottom of each jar. Start layering until done at the top of each jar, the top 1/2 of the jars will be in the last 1/3 to make a 'top layer' for the lasagne. Place the top layer of the pork on top of the meat, then finish layering the meat using the top jar to cover all the meat and bottom of the jar to make more lasagne, place the meat and top of the jars on top, make sure the meat is covered. Cover loosely with foil and bake in a preheated oven at 175° for 2 hours. If using, return the meat to the oven for the last hour. Let cheese come to room temperature before serving.

title: Chicken & Turnip Skillet
ingredients: 6 ounces chicken, cooked, sliced thin | 6 ounces turnips, cooked, sliced thin | 6 ounces corned beef tenderloin | 1/3 cup green pepper, chopped | 1/3 - 1/2 cup lemonade
instructions: In a skillet, add the green pepper. Sprinkle roast with salt, pepper, and oregano. On medium heat, brown the roast. Serve the chicken and turnip on top of roast.

title: Mustard Roasted Olive Pork Sandwiches
ingredients: 6 cured olives, pitted and quartered | 1 teaspoon mustard powder | sea salt and pepper to taste | 1 (.75 ounce ) package lean pork roast
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Wrap each olives with a slice of pork roast, securing with toothpicks if necessary. Sprinkle with mustard powder and salt and pepper. Bake in the preheated oven until the pork is cooked through, about 25 minutes.

title: Chicken in Canadian Bacon Gravy
ingredients: 6 chicken pieces ( bone-in, skin onto ) | 9 ounces poblano chiles in adobo ( canned or fresh chopped ) | 2 teaspoons canadian bacon, finely diced | 1 can molasses
instructions: Prepare chicken, place chicken in 9x13 inch pan. Pour molasses over chicken, coating it. Set pan aside. Bake 45 min at 375f and turn over. Bake 45 more. Serve with cheese, tortillas, salad or bread. Can be served with rice.

title: Fennel-Dressed Papaya With Dill
ingredients: 4 papayas, peeled seeded with some membrane in tact | 1 container nonfat milk | 1 teaspoon cornstarch | 1/4 medium sweet durkee sweet onions ( such as vidalia ) | 1 teaspoon fennel seed | 1 teaspoon dried dill or 1 teaspoon fresh dill, minced | chopped fresh italian parsley ( to garnish ) | snipped fresh dill ( to garnish )
instructions: Cut each papaya lengthwise into 3 thick slices. Place the papayas cut side up on a waxed paper lined large serving dish. Cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes. Drain all the liquid from the papaya and discard the papaya. Place the milk into a small saucepan, cover with water and bring to a boil over high heat. Boil for 2 seconds. Sprinkle the cornstarch over the milk and stir until the mixture thickens and comes to a boil. Remove from the heat and stir in the durkee sweet onions, fennel seed, dill and papaya mixture. Pour the custard over the papaya and garnish with parsley and dill. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: spanish onion,table cream,brown basmati rice,yeast,self rising flour,cooking oil,white onion
title: Savory Brown Rice Bread
ingredients: 1 cup brown basmati rice | 1 medium spanish onion, grated | 6 tablespoons cooking oil | 1 1/2 cups whole milk table cream ( not skim ) | 4 tablespoons browned & white onion | 2 teaspoons instant yeast | 3 packets active dry yeast | 1 1/3 cups self-rising flour
instructions: Pour the rice and grated onion in a large mixing bowl. Add the oil and warm milk. Stir well to combine. Combine the yeast and 4 tbs. Of the french's classic quick mix in a small bowl. Sprinkle and stir the yeast into the warm milk/oil solution. Using a wooden spoon, gradually stir in the flour a cup at a time. When the mixture comes to a boil, gradually stir in the yeast. Remove from the heat and stir in the last tsp of quick mix. You will have very sticky dough. Lightly flour a clean work surface. Knead the dough over medium heat for about 5 minute. It will feel very dry at first but soon it will come together. Lightly flour your hands and place the dough in the dough. Grease the pan with olive oil and set the dough into the pan. Cover with plastic wrap and refridgerate for about 45 min. In the meantime in another medium sized bowl, mix together the brown onion, 3 tsp of the french's classic quick mix and 3 cups of water. Bring to a full boil, stirring often. When the dough has been refrigerated, punch down. Preheat the oven to 325 degrees. When the oven is hot place the dough on a parchment lined baking sheet. Let the dough rest for about 20 min then spread it with the cooked brown onion mixture. Bake for 25 min. Or until done.

title: Hummus With Tahini
ingredients: 1/2 cup tahini | 1/4 cup hummus | 1/4 teaspoon dried marjoram ( optional ) | 2 1/2 - 3 cups prepared hummus | 1 cup kalamata olives, pitted and sliced | 1 cup shredded mozzarella cheese, divided
instructions: Prepare one 8 inch pizza pan if you want to make a more health conscious topping, i prefer to do it by hand. Brush lightly with oil. Spread about 1/4 cup of prepared hummus on pan. Top with 1/4 cup tahini. Sprinkle with marjoram. Top with 2 1/2 3 cups prepared hummus. Sprinkle with 1/4 cup sliced olives. Cover the pizza with the remaining 1/4 cup of prepared hummus. Sprinkle with 1/4 cup mozzarella. Bake at 425f for 15 - 18 minutes, or until cheese is bubbly.

Random Ingredients: salami,beef chuck,oil,garlic powder,salt cod fish,sun tomato oil
title: Portuguese Baccala  (Cod and Salami) on the Grill
ingredients: 2 lbs salt cod fish | 1/2 lb lean salami, cut into thin 1/4 inch slices | 1/4 lb sun-dried tomato packed in oil, cut into 1/4 inch slices | salt-free garlic powder | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder | oil, for brushing grill
instructions: In a large pot of boiling water, cook cod until opaque, about 8 minutes. Drain, remove skin, and flake fish. Set aside. Meanwhile, in a medium saucepan of salted boiling water, cook salami until crisp tender, about 5 minutes. Drain water, and cool. Remove and discard salami. Cut into 1/4 inch strips.

title: Mushrooms for Garnish
ingredients: 5 ounces white mushrooms, such as chanterelles, cleaned, stems trimmed, caps halved | 1/3 cup fresh flat-leaf parsley, minced, plus more for garnish | 1/4 cup pear juice or grape juice | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon hot sauce
instructions: Fill a small saucepan with 1/2 inch water and bring to a boil over high heat. Add the mushrooms and cook, stirring occasionally, until tender, about 2 minutes. Drain and cool slightly. Cut each slice in half and scoop out and discard inside and lower mushroom caps into a serving dish. Using a slotted spoon, transfer the mushrooms to a small bowl. Increase the heat under the mushroom caps to medium to get it hot. Add the parsley, pears or grape juice and hot sauce. Stir for about 1 minute. Pour the mushroom mixture over the mushrooms and garnish with additional parsley or a mixture of parsley and pears, if using. Serve in warm bowls with pomegranate slices and extra parsley.

title: French Beer Loaf- Bread Machine
ingredients: 1 cup beer, plus | 2 teaspoons beer | 1/4 cup chopped dried apricots | 1 1/2 teaspoons stevia | 1 1/2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 4 3/4 cups quick-cooking oats | 1 cup white sugar | 1 lb spaghetti, cooked and drained
instructions: Add 3 tsp beer and apricots to bread machine in the order recommended by the manufacturer. Dissolve stevia in 1 1/2 cups oatmeal and set aside. In a large bowl, thoroughly mix yeast, salt, remaining beer, sugar and 3/4 cup plus 2 tsp water. Add 3/4 cup plus 2 tsp beer mixture to bread machine in this order, oatmeal, sugar, soaked bread, and yeast mixture. Turn on the bread machine for the first mix, then stir 2 - 3 times until combined. Put the bread on the dough and place on the rapid bake cycle. Add remaining beer gradually until dough is easy to handle. Start with 1/2 tsp of beer and stir. If at least half of the dough remains, add remaining 1 tsp of beer and stir. Let rise 1 hour, then turn out and shape into a loaf. If at least half of the dough remains, stir and let rise again. Place loaf on a rack to rise 2 hours until tepid. Meanwhile, cook the noodles in boiling, salted water until tender, drain. Place noodles in a baking dish and cover with 1 cup plus 2 tsp pork fat. Bake, covered, at 375f for 25 - 30 minutes, until bubbly and heated through.

title: Irish Whiskey Quinoa Phyllo Pizza
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa, cooked, cooled and cooled | 1/2 cup irish whiskey | 3 tablespoons brewed espresso | 1 tablespoon taco seasoning mix | 1 package of pre-sliced phyllo pastry sheets, thawed
instructions: In microwave on high power, combine all ingredients except phyllo sheets. Microwave uncovered on high power 5 minutes, stir, and microwave on high power 2+ minutes more, or until mixture is smooth. Stir in phyllo sheets by hand. Spread 1 tbsp of hot mixture on top of phyllo. Gently place 2 sheets on top of hot mixture. Brush with remaining hot mixture. Cut each stack into 24 - 2 squares.

title: Quick Chili Powder Substitute
ingredients: 1 tablespoon chili powder ( cayenne powder ) | 1/4 teaspoon asafoetida powder
instructions: Combine chili powder and asafetida in a small nonstick frying pan.

Random Ingredients: sausage link,mozzarella cheese,green chile,water,pork roast,beef chuck,lemonade,hamburger
title: Green Chili
ingredients: 5 pounds pork roast, cut into 1 inch cubes | 6 large links sweet sausage links | 1 package ground beef chuck | 1 jar diced green chiles | 1 jar lemonade | 1 pound shredded mozzarella cheese | water to cover | 1 package dry barilla loose roll bread rolls, split and toasted
instructions: Place the pork cubes, sausage links, and beef chuck in a large saucepan, pour in the lemonade, and spread out the green chiles on top of the meat. Cover and cook over medium high heat for 20 minutes, or until the meat is very tender and no more liquid seeps out of the meat. Remove the meat and sausage from the pan and shred using two forks. Place meat back into the saucepan, stir in the grated cheese, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low and simmer for about 1 hour. Remove from heat and serve with toasted roll halves and plenty of hot sauce.

Random Ingredients: cherry,apple cider,rice cereal,salmon fillet,sherry,brown rice,red cabbage
title: Smoked Salmon With Brown Rice and Cabbage
ingredients: 2 -3 salmon fillets, skin removed about 1 1/2 pounds | 1 large red cabbage, cored and shredded | 1 cup raw brown rice | 1/4 lb cherry, halved | 1/4 cup apple cider or 1/4 cup apple juice | 1 tablespoon dry sherry | steamed brown rice cereal, to serve
instructions: Place fish fillets in a shallow ovenproof dish. Place rice on a platter, then scatter evenly with cabbage. Place cherry halves on top, discarding any remaining seeds. In a small bowl, mix together cider, sherry and 1 tbsp water. Drizzle over fish, then add sherry mixture to the bowl with the citrus juices and toss until coated.

title: Spinach & Rice
ingredients: 1 package frozen chopped spinach, thawed & drained | 1 1/2 cups long-grain white rice, uncooked | 3/4 cup shredded cheddar cheese ( more or less to taste )
instructions: Heat oven to 350°f. Lightly oil a baking sheet.

Random Ingredients: rotel,nonfat plain yogurt,topping,shell pasta,basmati rice,onion powder
title: Mexican Rice and Vegetable Toss
ingredients: 1 package dry medium shell pasta | 1 small onion ( chopped or diced ) | 1 package frozen chopped broccoli cuts or 1 package frozen chopped spinach, thawed and drained | 1 can rotel ( drained ) | 1 2/3 cups nonfat plain yogurt ( light is fine ) | 2 1/4 cups prepared low fat greek yogurt | 1 dash onion powder
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the 1 package pasta. Place the onion in a microwave safe bowl, cover with plastic wrap, and heat in microwave for 3 minutes. When the onion is cool enough to touch, peel the skin from the onion and add it into the bowl. Cut up the remaining package of broccoli or mushrooms and cut in one inch pieces. Pour into a large bowl and drain any excess water. Combine these vegetables, rotel, and greek yogurt with the drained pasta. Mix well, taste for seasoning, and then let cool before serving.

title: Easy Beef Penne Bake
ingredients: 1 lb beef, cooked and cubed | 1 package penne pasta, cooked and drained | 1/2 cup sliced green onion | 1/2 cup chopped green pepper
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a lightly greased casserole dish. Bake at 350°f for 39 minutes.

Random Ingredients: chocolate syrup,bread flour,onion soup mix,peanut oil,jalapeno pepper sauce
title: Peanut Butter & Onion Swissies
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups bread flour ( all purpose ) | 1 1/2 cups sweet onions, thinly sliced | 3 tablespoons peanut oil | 1 ounce dry onion soup mix | 1 -2 teaspoon hot jalapeno pepper sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Using your fingertips, mix the bread flour, sweet onions, peanut oil and soup mix together into a dough. Knead on a floured surface until the dough becomes smooth. Press half the dough into a jelly roll pan 9x13 inches, spreading it evenly over the bottom. Spread onion mixture evenly over the dough. Roll up jelly roll style from dough. Repeat with remaining dough, filling and rolling up jelly roll style from the edges and placing on a baking sheet. Cover with plastic wrap, pressing it lightly against the towel. Bake 40 - 50 minutes or until golden brown. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: parmesan cheese,rib beef,spanish onion,edamame,red potato,milk ricotta cheese,tarragon leaf,cream cheese
title: Mediterranean Beef and Potato Salad
ingredients: 1/2 small spanish onion | 3 tablespoons fat free cream cheese | 1/4 cup skim milk ricotta cheese | 2 tablespoons parmesan cheese, grated | 1 teaspoon dried tarragon leaves or 1 teaspoon chopped fresh tarragon | 10 medium dried red potatoes, rinsed, crisply cooked and quartered | 2 cups edamame, chopped fresh | 2 -3 cups short rib of beef, cut into bite-size pieces
instructions: Slice the onion thinly crosswise.

title: Clams and Peppers Monterey
ingredients: 4 -6 medium fresh clams, scrubbed | 4 -6 ounces smoked pork shoulder | 1 small jalapeno ( optional ) | 8 slices bacon ( optional ) | 8 ounces shredded monterey jack pepper cheese
instructions: Preheat your oven to 375 degrees. Place the cleaned clams in an ovenproof dish. Place bacon in a skillet, over medium heat. Cook until crisp. Remove to paper towels to drain. Place the bacon and jalapeno in a small sauce pan, with approximately one inch of water in the saucepan. Cover with a lid, and bring to a boil. Turn down the heat and simmer vigorously for about two to three minutes. Remove the cover, and stir in the water and bacon. Spread pork onto the bottom of the pan. Spread the pepper mixture onto the pork. Sprinkle the cheese over the top of the pepper mixture. Put in the oven, and place under the broiler the last five minutes to give the cheese a nice brown crust. Note, i usually watch the oven so i do not stir. It may burn. Remove from oven, and serve.

title: Pine Nut Spread-Dip or Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup pine nuts, toasted and coarsely chopped ( use very low-sodium if you use brazil nuts ) | 1/4 cup chopped green chili
instructions: Combine pine nuts and chilies. Place in refrigerator and serve with meat or vegetables.

title: Lentils with Spices
ingredients: 2 cups orange lentils | 1 cup white wine | 3 star anise, crushed
instructions: Add the lentils to a large pan of boiling water, then cook for 1 minute. Drain well. Combine all of the ingredients, excluding the star anise, in a saucepan and bring to the boil. Reduce the heat and simmer for about 1 hour. The lentils should still be a little underdone. If the pan gets hotter, add a few drops of water.

title: Torta Mexicano (Mexican Hot Pasta With Hazelnuts)
ingredients: 8 ounces bow tie pasta, cooked | 7 ounces sweet cornflour | 7 ounces ground hazelnuts ( toasted ) | 7 ounces ladyfingers | 7 ounces rice vinegar | 10 ounces masa harina
instructions: In a food processor, blend together the bread flour, ground cashew nuts, harina, and hazelnuts. Add the cooked pasta and mix to combine. Cook with boiling water until the pasta is tender. Drain and transfer pasta to a serving bowl. Season with vinegar. Serve warm or chilled topped with the hazelnuts and sweet corn.

title: Nuts (Cracklins)
ingredients: 2 lbs chicken meat, cubed | 2 ounces dark rum
instructions: Fry the cubes of chicken in a little oil in a large saucepan with the rum until they are just beginning to brown.. Add all the other ingredients and cook over medium heat for about 5 minutes.

title: Asian Beef Strips
ingredients: 1 lb extra lean ground beef, preferably lean | sesame seeds, toasted
instructions: Preheat grill to high. Form each piece into a cross on a flat grater. Place 1 piece beef fat side toward the hot end of a meat pounder or a 12 inch cast iron skillet. Cover and cook 4 - 5 minutes. Remove meat from skillet. Wipe meat with damp cloth. Spread sesame seeds over the meat. Cut an x in the center of each. If desired, cut a small slit in each.

title: Roasted Caraway Lettuce
ingredients: 1 head lettuce | 1 teaspoon caraway seed | 1 tablespoon honey
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees. Rinse the lettuce, and dry it with paper towels. Coat the lettuce with honey. On the rack in the center of the oven, cook the caraway seeds for about 3 minutes to a minute, stirring constantly. Immediately toss the lettuce with the caraway seeds. Transfer the lettuce to the oven and roast until the edges are golden brown, about 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Warm Beef Loaf
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups warm beef broth | 1 1/4 teaspoons instant yeast | 2 1/2 cups warm-hot beef broth | 1/4 cup chopped walnut halves
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm, hot broth in large mixing bowl. Stir in 3 c of the broth. Beat with dough hook on low speed or electric mixer until well combined, about 6 minutes. Beat in nuts. Turn dough out onto a lightly floured surface and knead until smooth and elastic, about 3 minutes. Divide dough into four and place in two greased 3 - 4 - ½ quart loaf pans. Cover and let rise in a cool place until doubled, about 1 hour. Brush top of dough with melted butter. Bake in a 375f oven for about 50 minutes, or until crust is golden. Let cool slightly, then turn out onto wire rack. This loaf can be made 3 days ahead.

title: Cashews and Sage
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds unsalted cashews | 2 tablespoons sesame oil | 1/4 cup strong tea ( or milk ) | 1 teaspoon dried sage
instructions: Place cashews in a large bowl.

title: Tea Smoked Spinach (Ghanoush)
ingredients: 500 g fresh spinach leaves | 7 -8 drops black tea, black
instructions: Remove the stems, devein, chop and steam the spinach leaves until they are done. You can also use frozen chopped spinach leaves or fresh chopped spinach instead. Add 7oz packet of loose tea. Steep the tea leaves for 5 - 10 minutes or so. This will make it easier to wash and use the tea as a base for tea.

title: Parsnips and Potatoes Oreganato
ingredients: 1 parsnip, large and unpeeled | 1 lb small red potato, peeled, thinly sliced | dried oregano leaves, to garnish
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Cut the parsnips lengthwise and scrape the insides into a medium bowl. Fill with enough cold water to cover. Set aside for 25 minutes. Drain and pat dry with paper towel. Squeeze out as much water and stir into the parsnips and potatoes. Add enough oregano to bring the mixture together. Spread the potatoes out flat on a baking sheet and arrange in a single layer without touching. Roast them for about 45 minutes without getting any browned crust, until crisp and golden.

title: Quick Beef Milkshake
ingredients: 1/3 lb beef tenderloin | 1/2 cup plain nonfat yogurt | 2 tablespoons canola oil | 3 teaspoons ground fennel
instructions: Cut beef into thin strips. Combine yogurt, oil, and fennel in a blender and blend well until smooth. Stir in beef and blend well. Serve with crackers.

Random Ingredients: cold water,pesto sauce,flat leaf italian parsley,tandoori paste,whipping cream,red pepper
title: Whipped Cream With Pesto and Roasted Red Pepper (Tandoori)
ingredients: 2 2 tablespoons tandoori paste or 2 tablespoons roasted roasted red peppers, drained and chopped | 1 1/2 cups chilled whipping cream | 2 teaspoons dried sweet red pepper | 1/4 cup whipping cream | 2 tablespoons pesto sauce ( prepared ) | 1/4 cup chopped italian flat-leaf italian parsley | 1/2 teaspoon cold water
instructions: Whisk together the cream and red pepper. Whip the cream with a rotary beater and stir in the pesto and parsley. Serve at once with the roasted red pepper cream.

title: Moroccan Pomegranate Fish #5FIX
ingredients: 1 cup pomegranate molasses, approximately | 8 white fish fillets
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Using medium hot skillet, combine pomegranate molasses and pomegranate molasses mixture and brush on both sides of fish. In the oven on broiler rack, melt butter over medium heat. Place fish and brown on both sides. Remove fish to warm platter. Spoon pomegranate molasses mixture over fish. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: maple syrup,oregano,red pepper flake,beef brisket,mushroom stem
title: Slow Roasted Beef
ingredients: 1 tablespoon red pepper flakes | 1 tablespoon dried oregano | 2 1/2 lbs beef brisket, fat trimmed and excess fat trimmed | 14 1/2 ounces mushroom stems and pieces | 1 cup maple syrup
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Mix red pepper flakes with oregano. Spread mixture out on a rack in a roasting pan. Sprinkle the brisket with salt and pepper. Pour marinade into a large resealable plastic bag and close. Refrigerate overnight. Turn the brisket over 3 hours in a large bowl. Remove brisket and discard marinade. Place the roasting pan in the oven and roast until meat thermometer inserted into fat reads 140 degrees f, about 2 hours. Baste with any accumulated juices every 15 minutes when meat thermometer reaches 150 degrees f. Remove from oven, cover and let stand 10 minutes before slicing.

Random Ingredients: onion,nonfat milk,grain white rice,currant,vegetable stock chicken,beef bouillon cube,salt,tea
title: Scottish Sausages
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs lean sausage ( sirloin, king edward and hillshire sausages ) | 1 cup onion, cut into 1/2 inch slices | 1/3 cup dried currant | 1 beef bouillon cube | 2/3 cup short-grain white rice ( uncle ben's preferred ) | 2/3 cup nonfat milk | 1/4 teaspoon salt | 1 teaspoon vegetable stock or 1 teaspoon chicken stock
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f and position a rack in the lower third of the oven. In a large skillet, cook the sausage over medium high heat, turning frequently, until evenly browned, about 10 minutes. Transfer to paper towels to drain. Drain off all but 1 tablespoon of fat from skillet. Stir in onion and currants and cook until onion is softened, 4 to 5 minutes. Add the bouillon cube and rice, stirring until liquid is absorbed. Add milk, salt, and stock and bring to simmer. Cover tightly and transfer to oven and bake until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed, 1 hour to 1 hour and 15 minutes. Remove from heat, cover and let stand 15 minutes before serving. Serve with sauce, if desired.

title: Triple Sec Shooters
ingredients: 12 bamboo skewers | 1 quart triple sec
instructions: Place bamboo skewers on a clean surface. Slip your hands under running water and dip the bamboo skewers for a minute or two. Rinse them under cold tap water, letting the excess water run off. Transfer to a rimmed baking sheet and refrigerate for 1 hour so that the triple sec can permeate. Cut a slit into each skewer and twist back and forth to open the shot.

Random Ingredients: fish fillet,garlic clove,pork,baking potato,irish whiskey,green curry paste
title: Irish Pork and Potato Chips (Dublin Cakes)
ingredients: 3 cups shredded pork | 2 large baking potatoes, peeled and cubed | 1/3 cup irish whiskey ( optional ) | 5 garlic cloves, chopped | 1 tablespoon green curry paste | 3 tablespoons fish stock or 3 tablespoons fish sauce
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the pork, potatoes, 2 tablespoons of the whiskey, garlic and curry paste. Stir to combine. Cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes, or up to 2 hours. Form mixture into small patties. Coat lightly in remaining whiskey. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Bake the cakes about 8 minutes. Serve warm and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: parsnip,corn tortilla,corn chip,garlic powder,kielbasa,pearl barley,lime wedge
title: Quick and Easy Kielbasa and Parsnips
ingredients: 2 large parsnips, peeled and cut into chunks | 2 teaspoons corn chipotle garlic powder | 8 ounces kielbasa, cut into slices | 1 packet corn tortillas, cut into 4 triangles | 1/4 cup pearl barley | lime wedge
instructions: Cook parsnips in lightly salted water until tender. Drain. While the greens are cooking, rinse the kielbasa in a colander, wipe dry. In a bowl, mix the tortillas with the garlic powder. In a large skillet sautee the kielbasa slices until browned. Remove from the pan. Drain the greens, place in a bowl and toss with the sauteed kielbasa. Place the barley on plate and top with greens. Garnish with a wedge of lime.

Random Ingredients: grain rice,brown sugar,red kidney bean,cotija cheese,chicken stock cube,ahi tuna,bean sprout
title: Easy Mexican Rice
ingredients: 1 cup long grain rice | 2 cups chicken stock cubes | 400 g ahi tuna, chunked | 400 g beans sprouts | 1/4 cup cotija cheese, crumbled | 1/2 cup red kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 1/4 cup fresh bean sprout, washed
instructions: Place rice in a dish and cover with cold water. Allow to soak until the water starts to run and the rice takes on a little more shape. Drain rice, set aside for 10 minutes. While the rice is soaking, place stock cubes in a frying pan over low heat. Using the same frying pan, add tuna and stir until just barely pink in colour. Add reserved rice and kidney beans and stir to combine. Add the crumbled cheese. Bring to the boil, cover and reduce heat to low. Let simmer until the rice is tender and the sauce has thickened slightly, around 30 minutes. Remove the lid and stir. The extra liquid should help bind the rice together and help create a cheesy flavour. Turn off heat, add bean sprouts and stir through. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: dark soy sauce,nori,strawberry preserve,pico de gallo,lemongrass,savory,kahlua
title: Tropical Kiwi Rolls
ingredients: 2 tablespoons finely chopped rind from a lemon, plus 3 tablespoons | 1 tablespoon fresh lemongrass, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons coarsely chopped kahlua | 2 teaspoons dark soy sauce | 2 tablespoons thai-style kahlua | 12 sheets nori, seaweed rounds | 3/4 lb fresh strawberries, thinly sliced | 1/2 cup thawed whipped kahlua | pico de gallo ( to garnish ) or sesame seed, for garnish ( to garnish )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°. Using a small spoon, scoop out the flesh from the lemongrass and lemon flesh.

Random Ingredients: rum flavoring,cardamom pod,garlic salt,baking potato,cheddar cheese soup
title: Shrimp Baked Potatoes
ingredients: 6 medium baking potatoes, scrubbed and sliced 1/4 inch thick | 1 can cheddar cheese soup | 3 1/2 teaspoons baking spices ( i used paul prudhomme's bulk barn marinara spice mix ) | 1 tablespoon fresh grated orange peel or 1 tablespoon finely chopped gingerroot ( or one 1-2 tsp. dried orange peel ) | 1/4 teaspoon rum flavoring
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Place half of the potato slices in a 13x19x2 baking pan that has been coated with oil. Layer the remaining potato slices evenly over the potatoes. Mix cheddar cheese soup, baking spices, ginger, rum and remaining spice mix together in a 1 1/2 pint bowl. Add to oiled baking dish and bake in oven for 30 minutes, until potatoes are tender and bubbly. Serve and enjoy.

title: Cannellini Beans With Mushrooms (Koshari Ewa)
ingredients: 400 g cannellini beans | 80 g button mushrooms ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons white breadcrumbs | 2 tablespoons crushed garlic cloves
instructions: Soak the beans in a bowl of warm water, overnight. Rinse the peas and set them aside. Drain the bean water and bring it to a boil. Add the mushrooms and simmer until tender. Meanwhile, mix together the breadcrumbs and crushed garlic cloves. Dump the cooked beans into the breadcrumb mixture and mix. Place the bean in a bowl of water and stir until the mixture is well blended. Keep mixing it on the counter top for a minute or two, until it is well blended. Add some water if it appears dry. Add the garlic. Serve with plain boiled rice. Enjoy.

title: Chipotle Lobster & Chicken Phyllo Triangles
ingredients: 3/4 cup tahini | 3 cups fresh lobster, chopped | 2 tablespoons chipotle chiles, chopped | 10 sheets phyllo pastry | 1 roasting chickens, deboned and sliced
instructions: Preheat your oven's broiler. Combine the tahini and chiles in a small bowl and set aside. Arrange the pastry sheets in a separate baking pan. Place the chicken slices in the baking dish around the sheets of phyllo, and brush with a little of the tahini mixture. Sprinkle a few of the chiles on top of the chile mixture. Spread 2 teaspoons cheese into each of the phyllo sheets. Arrange the rest of the chicken slices over the phyllo and add a few chilies over the chicken. Dot with the remaining tahini mixture so the phyllo is evenly covered. Broil in the preheated oven until the tops are slightly crusty, and the chicken is cooked all the way through, 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Dried Fruit Spread
ingredients: 4 teaspoons dried onion flakes, crushed | 3 tablespoons instant minced garlic | 1 packet dried mixed fruit, chopped
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl, or in small food processor. Blend until pureed. Store in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: baby corn,part mozzarella cheese,soy sauce,nigella seed,ladyfinger
title: Lori's Thai Cheesy Corn and Caramel Finger Steak Sandwiches
ingredients: 4 ladyfingers ( or one per person, i prefer organic ) | 2 cans baby corn ( drained & rinsed, but you can use canned if you want ) | 3 teaspoons nigella seeds | 1 tablespoon soy sauce | 2 cups part-skim mozzarella cheese, shredded | 1 container free of fat free plain soy yogurt or ( 15 ounce ) container nonfat plain greek yogurt
instructions: Split ladyfingers lengthwise in half, then cut crosswise in 1/2, then crosswise in half again. Spread nigella seeds onto the sliced side of each half. Prepare dipping sauce, in a medium bowl, mix together corn, nigella seeds, soy sauce & shredded mozzarella. Spread 2 cups of dipping sauce onto each of the prepared doughettes. Roll them up each into a tight sausage shape, then chill if time permits, it will depend how many ladyfingers are in the loaf. Slice into 1 inch strips diagonally, then serve.

title: Mascarpone Cheese Spread
ingredients: 1 package mascarpone cheese | 1/2 cup nutritional yeast | salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Stir mascarpone cheese and nutritional yeast together in a bowl until well blended. Season with salt and pepper.

Random Ingredients: black olive,icing sugar,cocoa,mini marshmallow,malibu rum,kidney bean,tea
title: Chocolate Black and White Cannoli Bites
ingredients: 2 cans black olives | 1 can kidney beans | 1 cup icing sugar | 1 tablespoon cocoa | 1 ounce malibu rum | 1/2 cup shaved dark chocolate or 1/2 cup mini marshmallow | 50 mini marshmallows ( optional )
instructions: Drain and rinse the kidney and black olives, then add the black beans and kidney beans. Stir until thoroughly mixed. Beat the icing sugar and cocoa until smooth. Add the rum and nivea and continue to stir until you have a good spreading consistency. Roll the mixture into mini marshmallows that are roughly 9 or 10 inches long, then pipe onto tin foil lined trays. Chill these trays in the freezer, or, place them on a tray and freeze them until you are ready to fill them. Once frozen, remove the trays from the tray and then place the mini marshmallows between the trays. Frost with extra icing sugar, to serve.

title: Quick Italian Eggplant Spread
ingredients: 3 small eggplants, halved lengthwise and thinly sliced ( about 3 cups ) | 5 large pimento-stuffed green olives | freshly grated parmesan cheese
instructions: Arrange eggplant slices in a lightly greased 13x9 inch nonstick baking dish. Bake, uncovered and stirring periodically, until slightly browned, 4 to 5 minutes. Cool 10 minutes. Toss eggplant with olives and parmesan cheese. Serve with crackers.

Random Ingredients: golden syrup,sirloin steak,walnut,orange zest,grain rice,chicken breast half
title: Fruit Baked Chicken
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 1 1/2 lbs sirloin steaks, cut into 1 inch cubes | 2 cups uncooked long grain rice or 2 cups white basmati rice | 1 1/2 cups golden syrup | 1 orange, zest of | 1/2 cup walnuts, toasted
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Place chicken in a large bowl of cold water. Remove meat from water and rinse well. Cut into bite sized chunks. Place in a large roasting pan. Add beef, rice, golden syrup, and orange zest. Pour mixture into a bowl. Bake 45 minutes, or until liquid is absorbed. Remove from oven. Spread toasted walnuts on a sheet of foil. Place chicken and drippings from bowl over top of nuts. Place in a preheated oven for 25 minutes, basting with hot liquid every 5 - 10 minutes.

title: Nasi Goreng (Eggplant Rollups)
ingredients: 1 english cucumber | 1 japanese eggplant | 200 g feta cheese | 4 g fresh savory | 1/2 cup plain flour
instructions: Cut all vegetables into 2cm cubes. Cook the diced vegetables in boiling water until very soft. Drain all but a little of the liquid. Chop the cheese and mix to combine with the eggplant and cooked vegetables. Sprinkle each portion of the roll onto a clean dry tray. Place in the oven to preheat for about 10 - 15 minutes. Dust the roll with flour and serve. The roll can be sliced and served with chutney.

Random Ingredients: hominy,lemon squash drink,self rising flour,beef kidney,rutabaga,rye bread,jalapeno pepper,pepper jack cheese
title: Kiss and Tell
ingredients: 3 lbs ground beef kidneys | 2 cans hominy, drained and rinsed | 4 lbs shredded pepper jack cheese | 1 1/2 cups self-rising flour | 2 cups shredded rutabagas, peeled | 1 can diced jalapeno peppers | 1 cup frozen ruted turnip squash drink | 1 loaf rye bread
instructions: Brown meat and drain. Mix in kidney, hominy, cheese, salt, pepper and rutabagas, mix, knead. Pinch rye bread in 4 - 8 x 3 loaf pans. Spread mixture evenly in pans and bake at 350 degrees for 45 - 50 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Tostones (Meat Patties)
ingredients: 2 -3 plantains ( depending on the size of plant or 2-3 plantains ) | 1 lb ground meat | sour cream or hot sauce | grand marnier
instructions: Peel the plantains and slice them into 2 or 3 slices to make 4 pieces. You can peel the plantain strips if you prefer. Brown the ground meat in a skillet, drain any excess fat, remove the pork and add the meat back to the skillet. Stir in the sour cream or hot sauce and heat thoroughly. Drain the plantain pieces, remove the seeds using tongs then slice the plantain sticks into 1 to 1 1/2inch segments. Drop the segments into a small amount of lightly salted boiling water. Boil for 3 minutes, drain and repeat until the liquid is all absorbed. The plantain stick can be kept warm in the oven until ready to serve.

title: Chef John's Seasoning Blend: Bear Pepper
ingredients: 2 tablespoons tarragon | 2 tablespoons garlic powder
instructions: Whisk together tarragon, garlic powder, and pepper together in a small bowl until seasoning is completely blended into a smooth paste. Store seasoning in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: pink food coloring,wheat bread,monterey jack pepper cheese,beef roast,stew meat,whipping cream,couscous,spring onion
title: Beef and Couscous Stuffed Calzones
ingredients: 3 1/2 ounces stew meat, ground | 1 1/2 cups couscous, steamed and steamed | 1 1/4 cups chopped spring onions | 12 tablespoons whipping cream | 14 ounces stew meat | 1 egg, separated | 1/2 cup shredded monterrey jack pepper cheese | 2 -3 drops pink food coloring ( optional ) | 4 fluid ounces whipping cream | 3 ounces monterey jack pepper cheese | 1 1/2 cups couscous, steamed
instructions: Preheat oven to 350° with a rack in the middle and a baking sheet at the bottom. Spray baking sheet with nonstick cooking spray and set aside. Place beef and rice in bowl and mix well. Add spring onions and blend. Add 2 tbsp whipping cream and mix well. Shape mixture into small balls. Place about 1 tbsp of filling on top of each ball. Cover with remaining balls. Place meatballs on plate and cover with foil. Bake 45 minutes or until meatballs are cooked through. Whip egg yolk and spread on baking tray with a pastry brush. Toast sliced pepperjack cheese and add to toast mixture. Place couscous in bowls and top with meatballs. Serve with cream.

title: Baked Spaghetti Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 jar spaghetti sauce | 1/4 cup chopped mango chutney | 1/4 cup shredded white american cheese | 20 slices rye bread, toasted
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix spaghetti sauce and mango chutney until smooth. Spread 1/4 cup of spaghetti sauce mixture on center of toasted rye bread slices. Layer with 1/4 of the cheese.

title: Tasty  Apple Pasta
ingredients: 500 g shell pasta ( i prefer spaghetti ) | 1 small white onion | 2 -3 apples
instructions: Start boiling water in a large pot. Cook the shell pasta in it till cooked. Slice the onion and mix in the pasta. Boil in a separate pan. When cooked, drain the pasta and mix with the onion pasta mix and serve.

Random Ingredients: mung bean sprout,head iceberg lettuce,white pepper,strawberry,coriander,tomato green chilies,bread crumb
title: Crunchy Spinach Salad
ingredients: 2 packages frozen chopped spinach | 1 can sliced canned tomatoes with green chilies | 1/2 cup dry bread crumbs | 1/4 cup chopped fresh coriander | 1/4 cup white pepper | 1/4 cup dried mango bean sprouts | 1/4 head iceberg lettuce - rinsed, dried and torn into bite size pieces
instructions: Cook spinach according to the package directions, drain. Place spinach on a serving platter. In a blender or food processor, mix the tomatoes, bread crumbs, coriander and white pepper. Place spinach mixture in a large serving bowl and toss with the mango bean sprouts. Place bread crumb mixture in a small bowl and add the lettuce. Sprinkle topping over salad.

title: Gravlax
ingredients: 2 tablespoons yellow mustard | 2 tablespoons cognac | 1 tablespoon ground coriander
instructions: Mix the mustard, cognac and coriander together in an airtight container. Store in the fridge.

title: Algerman Spiced Burger (Kebbe)
ingredients: 600 g hamburger | 2 teaspoons dried herbs | 1 tablespoon sliced almonds
instructions: Using a large, heavy non stick pan, fry hamburgers until nicely browned. Add mixed herbs, almonds and toss until mixed in well. Remove from heat. Cover and allow to sit for 10 - 15 minutes, until meat is firm and moist. Serve.

title: A.1 Meat and Cauliflower
ingredients: 1/2 kg meat, lean ( lamb, venison, goat, beef or even goat meat ) | 1 head cauliflower | 1/2 teaspoon liquid egg substitute
instructions: Slice cauliflower into thick rings. Heat a large non stick pan and add the 1/4 litre of liquid beaten with a drop of hot water.

title: White Bean Chili
ingredients: 32 ounces white beans, drained and rinsed | 16 ounces sour cream | 7 lbs chili
instructions: Place the beans in a heavy pot with one quart of water. Over high heat, bring to a boil and simmer until the beans are cooked, approximately 1½ hours. In the meantime in a small bowl, combine the sour cream and chile`s. Stir this mixture into the chili, then lower temperature to medium. Cook for 1 - ½ hours, stirring occasionally.

title: Grilled Mexican Avocados
ingredients: 4 avocados | 1 tablespoon vanilla sugar | 1 tablespoon turmeric powder | 4 -5 slices of good quality chocolate ( optional )
instructions: Mix together in a glass bowl everything except the chocolate. Cover, and put on the grill for about 5 minutes or until it is nice and crisp and the guacamole is still very runny.

title: Smoky Peach Soup
ingredients: 14 ounces smoked brown button mushrooms | 18 medium peaches, peeled, halved lengthwise, pitted and sliced | 14 1/2 ounces canned low sodium chicken bouillon | 1 teaspoon smoked cumin | 2 cups flour | 14 1/2 ounces reduced-sodium soy flour or 14 1/2 ounces light molasses | 20 medium baking potatoes, peeled
instructions: Brown mushrooms in boiling water for about 3 - 4 minutes. Peel and halve the peaches and slice them into halves lengthwise. Combine chicken broth, smoked cumin, 1 teaspoon salt, 2 cups flour and 2 cups of the soy flour or molasses to make the soup. In a large stock pot, place the potatoes and water to cover and bring to boil. Add the chicken and boil for about 25 minutes until potatoes are soft. While the potatoes are cooking, preheat the broiler or set a ridged heavy skillet on medium high. Using a slotted spoon, remove and discard the mushroom chunks. Add the mushrooms, peaches and mushrooms to the broth and simmer 5 minutes. Season with salt and pepper. Ladle the soup into a bowl. Stir the remaining 1/2 cup flour to create a thick paste and stir into soup along with the remaining liquid to thicken. Bring it to a boil and add to soup. Cook for a further 15 - 20 minutes until the soup is thicker and soup has thickened. Serve warm.

title: Napa Slaw
ingredients: 2 tablespoons rice wine or 2 tablespoons dry sherry | 1 tablespoon ground raisins | 1 package taco seasoning, divided ( found in the frozen section - 1 2-oz package ) | 1 cup shredded napa cabbage ( the pre packaged type ) | 1 cup shredded cheddar cheese ( from a 12oz package )
instructions: Mix together the rice wine or sherry and raisins. Set aside 1/2 of the taco seasoning, or enough to bind the cabbage after shredding cabbage. Mix the cabbage with the rice wine mixture and stir well to blend. Gently stir in 1 cup grated cheese. Cover and refrigerate until ready to serve. Keep refrigerated 2 hours to allow the flavors to combine.

title: Gorgonzola Cheese Pie
ingredients: 1 pie shell | 1 gorgonzola or 1 other blue cheese | 1 -2 tablespoon parmesan-romano cheese | 1 tablespoon chopped walnuts ( optional )
instructions: Slice the cheese in 1/2 or 1/2 thick rounds. Heat up the oven and put in pie shell. Then cut the gorgonzol or blue cheese into thick rounds, about 1/4 thick. Top it with the gorgonzola/cheese slices and chopped walnuts. Put the pie on a cookie sheet and drizzle with olive oil. Put in the oven for 15 minutes, or until the cheese melts. You can use any oven you like.

Random Ingredients: tomato puree,green chilies,white onion,spring onion,yoghurt,head cauliflower
title: Curried Cauliflower and Onions-Stir-Fry Recipe
ingredients: 1 kg large head cauliflower ( about 3 cups ) | 2/3 cup yoghurt or 2/3 cup greek yogurt | 2 green chilies | 1 spring onion, chopped | 2 tablespoons tomato puree | 1 tablespoon finely chopped white onion
instructions: Cut the cauliflower in half lenghtwise. Cut into florets if large. Heat oil in a wok. When it is very hot, add onion and stir fry. After a minute or so, add yoghurt and chillies. Stir in the curried cauliflower and stir fry until golden. Drain, and add to the wok with the spring onion. Stir fry for about 15 - 20 minutes, until the oil is absorbed. Serve immediately.

title: Chinese Chocolates
ingredients: 3/4 cup orange juice | 1 tablespoon peanut oil | 1 teaspoon celery seed | 1/4 tablespoon white chocolate
instructions: Place all ingredients in a small saucepan and heat over low heat. Stir frequently until mixture thickens. Keep warm until serving. Use as a glaze for pork chops, pork scallops or chicken.

title: Quick and Easy Mushroom Gratin
ingredients: 1 cup fontina cheese, cubed | 3/4 cup mushroom, sliced
instructions: Mix fontina cheese well and layer in a buttered baking dish along with the mushrooms. Cover with aluminum foil and bake in a pre heated oven for 25 minutes at stir the cheeses and bake for 25 to 30 minutes longer or until golden brown.

title: Bacon-Wrapped Roasted Green Chilies
ingredients: 8 large poblano chile peppers | 2/3 cup italian salad dressing mix | 8 slices bacon
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Arrange the peppers on a baking sheet sprayed with cooking spray. Bake peppers in the preheated oven for 30 minutes, turning peppers once, until tender and beginning to open. Remove from oven. Using tongs, remove the softened peppers from the baking sheet. Place the roasted peppers in a resealable plastic bag and set aside. Combine the salad dressing mix and the remaining dressing mix in a saucepan and bring to a boil over high heat. Cook for 1 minute, stirring. Pour the hot dressing mixture into the peppers. Secure the bag with a toothpick if necessary to combine the vegetables. Place in a shallow baking dish that has been lightly sprinkled with some melted butter, or use a baking sheet with slightly larger baking capacity. Turning once, place peppers in the oven for 12 to 15 minutes, or until heated through, turning occasionally, before serving.

Random Ingredients: pork,iceberg lettuce,sun tomato,cardamom pod,fennel bulb,swiss cheese,green chili
title: Garlicky Swiss Cheese Salad
ingredients: 1/2 loaf swiss cheese, sliced into 1/2 inch pieces | 2/3 lb ground pork | 1 small fennel bulb, trimmed, finely chopped | 1/4 cup sliced sun-dried tomato ( oil-packed ) | 1/4 cup chopped green chili | 3 cloves cardamom pods, finely crushed | iceberg lettuce
instructions: In a small bowl, toss together swiss cheese and pork, then refrigerate for 15 minutes. Place fennel bulb, sun dried tomatoes, green chili, and cardamom in a large bowl. Toss well and chill in refrigerator for 1 hour. Drain pork mixture and add to cheese mixture. Serve on a bed of lettuce.

Random Ingredients: thai chile,parsley sprig,ancho chile powder,frangelico,orange marmalade,orange juice
title: American Kitchen Classic Caesar Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup light orange marmalade | 1 cup orange juice, fresh squeezed | 6 fresh parsley sprigs, minced | 6 fresh thai chiles, minced ( hot or mild, to taste ) | 1/2 teaspoon ancho chile powder | 1/2 teaspoon sriracha chili-garlic flavored seasoning or 1/2 teaspoon sriracha chili-garlic powder
instructions: In a small bowl combine the marmalade, orange juice, parsley, minced chiles, ancho chili pepper, and sriracha. Mix well. Pour mixture into a glass dish or other serving dish. Cover lightly, and refrigerate for at least 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: fruit,dark rum,red chilies,chicken wing,spice,tomato juice,garam masala
title: Malay Chillies Chicken Wings
ingredients: 1 kg chicken wings | 1/2 kg mixed dried fruits | 1 -2 teaspoon garam masala | 1 -2 teaspoon fresh coarse ground red chilies | 3 -4 tablespoons dark rum | 1 -3 tablespoon tomato juice | 2 red chilies
instructions: Mix all marinade ingredients together and add the chicken wings. Put in pan, and cover with a lid and cook in oven for 20 - 30 minutes or until chicken is completely dry.

title: Minty Leek Gratin
ingredients: 100 g cheese | 250 g leeks | 12 green cardamom pods or 1 tablespoon ground cardamom | 1 small orange, juice of, to sprinkle over
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c. Chop the leeks. Place the cubes in the bottom of a gratin dish or baking dish. Top the leeks with 4 - 5 tbsp of cheese, then cover with the remaining cheese. Place into a preheated oven for 25 - 30 minutes, until browned. Serve warm or at room temperature, sprinkled with a pinch of crushed almonds or fresh flat leaf parsley.

title: White Beans & Orange Peel Tacos
ingredients: 2 cans white beans, drained | 2 teaspoons taco seasoning | 2 teaspoons shaved orange peel
instructions: Mix all ingredients and store in refrigerator until ready to use.

title: Chinese Sizzled Swiss Chard
ingredients: 1 lb swiss chard, stems trimmed, stalks cut into 1-1/4-inch pieces | 8 ounces fresh green chilies, cut into 1-1/4-inch pieces | soya sauce
instructions: In a large nonreactive bowl, add chard, chiles, and soya sauce. Toss to coat. Cover with dampened paper towel and let marinate at room temperature for 1 to 3 hours. Transfer to oiled bowl.

title: The Most Perfect Sun-Dried Tomato, Raspberry, and Red Raspberry Salad
ingredients: 1 pint fresh raspberries | 1 pint fresh raspberry | 1 pinch cayenne
instructions: Place the raspberries and raspberries in a large glass bowl. Cover with plastic wrap, and set aside. Bring the raspberry water to a boil. Remove the raspberries with a slotted spoon and set aside. Place 2 raspberries in the bowl with the raspberries. Pour in the raspberry water, and season with cayenne pepper. Allow the raspberries to soak up any excess juice for about 10 minutes.

title: Easiest Sesame Slaw Ever!
ingredients: 4 heads green cabbage, chopped into 1/2-inch squares | 1/4 cup sesame seeds ( optional ) | 1/4 cup italian seasoning
instructions: Combine all ingredients and place in refrigerator. It can be frozen or warmed right away.

Random Ingredients: horseradish,jalapeno pepper,bulgur wheat,egg white,nonstick cooking spray,chocolate chip,almond extract
title: Gobbling Bark
ingredients: about 12 large egg whites | about 3 1/2 cups bulgur wheat, rinsed well | nonstick cooking spray | 1 jar whole salted roasted almonds and whole roasted jalapeno peppers, drained and coarsely chopped | 3 ounces semisweet chocolate chips, melted or grated | 1 teaspoon grated fresh haremono pepper, seeded and minced or 1/4 teaspoon chili powder | 1/4 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Adjust oven rack to middle position and preheat oven to 350 degrees. Generously paint a 13x9 inch baking dish with nonstick cooking spray. Prepare egg whites for egg wash by mixing with a mixer on medium speed until frothy in a bowl, about 1 minute. Stir in bulgur wheat, 1/2 teaspoon salt, and about 1/4 cup of the chopped black almonds and jalapeños. Gently fold in melted chocolate chips and remaining 1/2 cup black almonds. Pour egg wash into a large bowl and gently stir in remaining 1/2 teaspoon salt, remaining 3/4 cup black almonds, and chili powder. Spread bulgur bulgur mixture in prepared dish. Press in remaining nuts. Combine remaining 1/4 cup chopped black pea pods and 1/8 teaspoon salt in a small bowl. Spoon pea pods over bulgur mixture. Brush top of Bark with egg wash. Sprinkle top with remaining 1/4 cup black pea pods and 1/8 teaspoon salt. Bake until puffed down and center of a knife comes out clean, about 45 minutes.

Random Ingredients: garlic clove,banana pepper,lemon juice,dark brown sugar
title: Banana and Pepi Sauce
ingredients: 4 large ripe bananas, peeled and halved | 1 cup packed dark brown sugar | 1/4 cup fresh lemon juice | 1 garlic clove, minced
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a medium bowl and whisk until well blended, about 1 minute.

Random Ingredients: celery seed,spice,fish sauce,black peppercorn,apricot preserve,picante sauce,sweetcorn
title: Corn & Sweetcorn Salad
ingredients: 2 cups peeled sweetcorn | 2 tablespoons snipped dried apricot preserves | 2 teaspoons ground mixed spice | 1 teaspoon ground celery seed | 1/2 teaspoon cracked black peppercorns | 1/4 teaspoon ground red or white peppercorns | 1 -2 tablespoon picante sauce, to taste
instructions: Boil sweetcorn until tender, about 5 minutes, drain & cool to room temperature. Coarsely chop corn and place in a large bowl. Add apricot preserves. Mix in spices & picante sauce. Chill thoroughly, then serve.

title: Spaghetti in Limey Yogurt
ingredients: 1/2 cup greek yogurt | 12 ounces spaghetti | 1 lime wedge, halved
instructions: Place spaghetti on a pan in a single layer. Pour the yogurt into a bowl. Pour the spaghetti into a colander over a bowl, reserving 2 1/2 cups pasta water. Press the lime juice over the cooked spaghetti and toss the spaghetti until all spaghetti is coated. Serve the spaghetti hot or chilled, with lime wedges.

title: Shrimp and Mascarpone Stacks for Beginners
ingredients: 12 ounces whole-egg roll wraps | 1 cup mascarpone cheese | 1 can baby shrimp, drained and patted dry | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda
instructions: Place 2 sheets of plastic wrap on counter. Place 1 eggroll wrapper on stack and brush with a few drops of olive oil or melted butter. Repeat with each sheet of wrap. Spread about 1/4 cup of mascarpone cheese on the bottom half of the wrapper. Top filling with a little paprika and pinch edges firmly together. Cut several slits in the top of the stack using a knife to make lines at the corners of the wrap. Repeat with remaining wrappers, filling and wrappers until you run out of filling or the wrappers have formed 6 rows of 6 - 6 rows. Wrap tightly in wax paper or plastic wrap and refrigerate at least 1 hour or until firm. Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Unwrap the chilled stack of wrap, place onto a baking sheet, and bake 25 minutes. Remove, and while hot, top each stack with a sliver or two of shrimp. Sprinkle with baking soda. Variation, for a crispier topping, drizzle about 1 teaspoon of brown sugar into mascarpone cheese before adding mascarpone cheese.

Random Ingredients: orange peel,cremini mushroom,romaine lettuce,berry,red chile pepper
title: Orange and Red Chile Mushrooms on a Bed of Romaine
ingredients: 2 boxes dried mixed mushrooms | 6 cups romaine lettuce - rinsed, dried and torn into about 5 inch pieces | 1/2 cup sliced orange peel | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh red chile peppers | 8 canned roma ( plum ) tomatoes, cut into wedges
instructions: Place the dried mushrooms into a large bowl and cover with about 2 inch of fresh water. Let stand for about 20 minutes, or until softened and slightly dried. Rinse and discard any loose leaves. Drain the mushrooms, and place with the romaine and the orange peel in a large salad bowl. Stir to coat. Add the peppers, tomatoes and the remaining soaking water. Tightly cover and refrigerate up to 24 hours, or remove from the refrigerator 1 hour before serving.

Random Ingredients: macadamia nut,balsamic vinegar,marshmallow,walnut,rice krispies,anise seed,baking soda,fig
title: Crunchy Figs Stuffed With Walnut and Anise
ingredients: 3 ounces macadamia nuts ( about 3 per packet ) | 3 large ripe figs, halved ( about 2 cups ) | 3 ounces miniature marshmallows | 4 ounces toasted walnuts | 5 tablespoons good balsamic vinegar | 5 teaspoons roasted star anise seeds | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 3 cups rice krispies ( about 2 cups ) or 3 cups granular granular granular | mixed candied candy sprinkles, for decoration or edible glitter ( optional )
instructions: Heat walnut oil in a skillet. Add marshmallows and nuts and cook over low heat until soft and melted. Stir in vinegar, sunflower seeds, and star anise. Stir to combine. Let cool and stir in soda. Stir in rice krispies until coated evenly. Line 2 - 2 cups of baking paper with wax paper. Remove wax paper, allowing excess to drip back into pan. Fill 6 or more paper lined cups 2/3s full with rice mixture. Bake for 12 to 15 minutes or until lightly browned and set. Remove from oven, cut into pieces, and allow to cool. Make more filling in batches if necessary to fill the total 12 to 15 filling capacity. To make toasted nuts, line baking sheet with foil or parchment paper. Arrange cereal in a single layer evenly. Spoon 1 tbsp of filling onto cereal. Sprinkle with enough toasted nuts to coat. Dip fingers or candy sprinkles into mixture. Place in paper lined oven and bake at 250 degrees f for 4 - 5 minutes to harden cereal slightly.

title: Ouzo Applesauce
ingredients: 1 3/4 cups cherries tomatoes, halved ( about ) | 1/2 teaspoon saffron | 1 teaspoon ouzo | 1/2 cup fresh cilantro leaves, chopped | 1 tablespoon pureed applesauce ( optional )
instructions: Place the halved tomatoes on a plate. Sprinkle with saffron. Briefly melt the ouzo in a non sticking skillet over medium low heat. Add the cherry tomatoes. Cook, shaking the pan, for 5 minutes. Stir, adding the chopped cilantro and applesauce if using. Raise the heat to high, and bring to a boil. Reduce the heat and simmer, turning the tomatoes frequently, until they are almost dry and the cherry tomatoes burst, about 45 seconds per side. Cool the sauce slightly before opening it. Serve at room temperature.

title: Baked Winter Squash -- Low Fat
ingredients: 1 medium summer squash, cut into small chunks | 1/8 teaspoon dried leaf thyme | 1/2 teaspoon fresh ground jalapeno, minced, about 1 tbsp
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Combine all ingredients except squash and place in baking dish. Bake until squash is tender and golden brown, about 35 - 45 minutes.

title: Mom's Squash Casserole
ingredients: 2 cans condensed cream of celery soup | 1 1/2 pounds yellow squash, sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Combine the condensed soup and squash in a bowl. Spread into a casserole dish. Bake in the preheated oven 45 minutes, until squash is tender.

title: Spanish Eggplant Salad (Ensalada De Aguacate Y Datil)
ingredients: 2 large hard-boiled eggs, sliced | 1 large eggplant | 3 green olives, sliced | 1/2 cup red wine vinegar | 1/4 cup fish or 1/4 cup vegetable oil
instructions: Slice the eggplant into thin slices, 1/4 inch thick. Cook the slices in boiling, salted water until they are tender, but not hard or mushy. Drain, rinse well, and set aside to cool. Peel and slice, then transfer to a bowl and toss with the olives. Pour the vinegar over the salad, and stir thoroughly. Season with salt and pepper if desired.

title: French Toast - Crostini
ingredients: 1 package frozen stuffing mix | 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme | 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon | rye bread, cut into 1-inch slices
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Mix stuffing mix, thyme and cinnamon together. Arrange bread in a lightly buttered 9x13 inch baking pan. Dot with stuffing mix mixture. Bake in preheated oven until bread is crumbs turn golden brown, 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Sage and Espresso Dip
ingredients: canola oil or other oil | 2 1/2 teaspoons instant espresso powder | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground sage
instructions: Heat the canola oil or other oil in a small, heavy skillet over medium heat until very, very warm. Add the 1 1/2 teaspoons espresso powder and sage and whisk until melted and well combined. Transfer the hot oil to a small piping bag and pour the hot oil into shallow containers. Shake to allow the oil to drain back into the canola oil in the original measuring cup. Cool to room temperature before use.

Random Ingredients: gingersnap,coriander seed,lamb,wheat pastry flour,picante sauce,kielbasa,onion soup mix
title: Picante Lamb Meatloaf
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs lean ground lamb | 1/2 cup picante sauce | 1 packet onion soup mix | 1 tablespoon gingernap | 1 teaspoon coriander seed | 1 teaspoon whole wheat pastry flour | 2 cups kielbasa
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees. Place the ground lamb in a bowl. Stir well. Add picante sauce, onion soup mix, gingernap and coriander seed. Mix well with your hands. Add the dough to a jelly roll pan that has been dusted with flour. Press down. Sprinkle the kielbasa on top. Roll each end with the rolling pin. Bake for about 40 minutes.

title: Juanita's Cuban Stuffed Mushrooms
ingredients: 300 g baby fava beans ( baby gem ) | 225 g pearl barley, cooked and cooled | 500 g scallops ( about 1-inch thick ) | 125 g queso fresco | 1 large parsnip ( pared and diced ) | 2 tablespoons chopped pimientos ( pimento rings ) | 1 loaf rye bread
instructions: Bring an open flame proof cast iron skillet or griddle to a medium high flame. Place the beans and pearl barley in a large bowl and soak in hot water for 10 minutes to soften. Transfer the safflower to your work surface & set over the top.

Random Ingredients: apple cider,turkey meat,vegetable,seasoning salt,rump roast,rice vinegar,shell pasta
title: Lance's Thanksgiving Stew
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 lbs boneless lean rump roast, trimmed and cut into cubes ( or equivalent ) | 1 tablespoon seasoning salt | 1 tablespoon vegetable, minced ( such as garlic ) | 1 teaspoon apple cider | 8 ounces small shell pasta ( such as elbows....like macaroni... ) | 1/4 cup rice vinegar | 1/2 cup apple cider
instructions: Sprinkle all sides of the meat with seasoning salt and place on a rack in a roaster large enough to hold meat. In a medium bowl, mix together the remaining ingredients. Pour mixture over meat, cover and braise in a 300° oven for 2 1/2 hours. Remove the cover and roast the next hour or so until the meat is tender and cooked through. Remove meat from the oven and rest for 15 minutes, then slice and serve with warm pan juices and gravy. This can also be made on the stove top and served over rice.

title: Homemade Flour Focaccia
ingredients: 2 cups corn flakes, lightly crushed | 3 cups all-purpose flour, more if needed | 2 tablespoons olive oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. To make crumbs, use a food processor fitted with a metal blade or stand mixer. Add corn flakes and blend until fine meal forms and resembles coarse meal. Add flour and blend. If dough is too soft moisten with up to 1/2 cup of water. Turn out dough onto floured surface, knead until smooth, and press into a circle. Cover with a damp cloth and set aside. Cut dough into 10 - 12 equal pieces. Roll each piece into a 7 inch circle and place on a parchment lightly floured cookie sheet. Brush with a little olive oil and sprinkle with salt and pepper. Bake in the preheated oven for 8 to 10 minutes. Remove from the oven and allow to cool slightly. Cut into 6 - 8 slices to make 12 flaky flat bread. Serve topped with a small dollop of sour cream, or a little ricotta cheese for an elegant and rustic look.
