Random Ingredients: mustard powder,purple onion,curly leaf parsley,red chilies,clam juice,gingerroot,coffee,walnut
title: Bahamian Clam Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup dried curly leaf parsley ( or 1 bunch fresh coriander ) | 1/2 bunch curly leaf parsley | 1/2 bunch purple onion ( yellow or white ) | 4 dried red chilies | 4 bay leaves | 7 fluid ounces bottled brewed coffee | 1 tablespoon mustard powder | 1 teaspoon finely grated gingerroot | 1/3 cup walnuts
instructions: Soak the dried dried parsley and curly parsley in a large bowl of cold water, until soft, about 15 minutes. Wash and peel and finely chop the onion. Slice the chillies through the middle lengthwise, remove the seeds, and finely chop the chilies. Break them into halves or thirds. Combine the onion, chillies, bay leaves, coffee, mustard powder, and ginger in the bowl with soaked soaked parsley, curly parsley, green onions and bay leaves. Cover and chill in the refrigerator overnight. The next day, adjust the seasoning with mustard powder and grated palm sugar, as needed. Remove from the refrigerator after the flavors have blended, and chill if necessary.

title: Chili Sauce (Raspberry)
ingredients: 2 cups fresh raspberry | 3/4 cup pineapple juice | 1/3 cup fresh chili pepper ( optional )
instructions: Combine all the ingredients in a blender, making sure they are well combined. Mix well, and serve over ice.

title: The Best Green Apple Chutney
ingredients: 1/2 cup turnip, chopped, peeled, or grated | 1/2 cup green apple, chopped, peeled, or chopped, peeled, or chopped, peeled, or chopped, peeled, or chopped, of choice | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 1 1/2 - 2 cups peach schnapps
instructions: Mix all ingredients and heat, stirring intermittently, until warm. Stir for 5 to 10 minutes.

title: Korma
ingredients: 500 g pitted dates ( about 3 cups ) | 4 tablespoons lime juice, fresh | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom powder ( i prefer the 1/2 tsp of ground cardamom ) | salt & pepper, to taste
instructions: Put the dates in a blender bowl and blend until finely chopped. Add the rest of the ingredients and blend once or twice more, until desired texture is achieved. Keep aside for 30 minutes and enjoy with ice cream.

title: Homemade Woodruff
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups fresh mixed herbs, such as cilantro ( such as parsley and thyme ) | 1 1/2 cups raw rice vinegar ( rice vinegar should be lukewarm ) | 4 preserved lemons, preserved rinsed, pith removed and minced ( i prefer to use frozen preserved lemon peel, which retains bitterness in the recipe ) | 1/2 cup mixed candied fruit
instructions: Make a base of about the same size, in the proportions of the woodruff ingredients, for 1 1/2 cups raw rice vinegar. If using fresh lemons, wash, peel and then cut them into strips. Place the herbs and 1 cup of the rice vinegar in a saucepan over medium heat and barely bring to a boil. Turn down to a mild simmer. Cook for about 15 minutes, stirring frequently, until the moisture has reduced in volume and has completely dried out. This usually takes about 40 minutes, or about 45 minutes to reach a good taste for moisture. Strain the liquid through a fine mesh sieve into another saucepan. Remove herbs and then stir in the drained preserved lemons. Serve warm.

title: Fried Hard Boiled Eggs - Boereg
ingredients: 1 lb hard boiled egg ( the size 1 egg is about 4-5 inches in diameter ) | 1 3/4 lbs quick-cooking oats | 2 quarts coffee or 2 quarts hot water
instructions: Scald hard boiled eggs and let cool. Peel while still warm. Cut eggs lenghtwise and remove hard boiled egg's yolks. Drain eggs and save liquid. Wash oat flour in a kitchen aid or with cold water. Add eggs and oatmeal to oat flour. Stir until blended well. Heat oil in deep fryer or large pot to 350 degrees fahrenheit. Drop a few of the egg mixture into the oat flour, letting the mixture fall into the oil without touching the surface. If it rises to the surface when the edges appear dry, add the flour a little at a time. The mixture will not turn white like oatmeal. When you see small bubbles and turn the oat mixture into a large round serving dish, flip egg mixture onto plate and serve immediately.

title: Cherry Fingers
ingredients: 6 ounces maraschino cherries ( or any cherry ) | 2 1/2 tablespoons icing sugar | 1/2 tablespoon celery salt
instructions: Roll cherries about in the sieved icing sugar, then roll into fingers by gently rolling them up into a slightly oval shape. Arrange on greased cookie sheets. Bake in centre of 350°f oven for about 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Duck With Pasta
ingredients: 4 teaspoons dark sesame oil, divided | 2 teaspoons vodka | 3/4 lb duck, cut into quarters | 1 lb pasta | lemon wedge ( optional )
instructions: Heat 2 teaspoons sesame oil in 12 skillet over medium heat. Add duck.

Random Ingredients: fish sauce,wine sauerkraut,rice vinegar,monterey jack cheese,hot italian sausage,orange peel
title: Smoked Sausage and Sauerkraut
ingredients: 1 package smoked smoked sausage, cut lengthwise in half | 1/2 cup wine-cured sauerkraut, drained | 1/4 cup fish sauce | 2 tablespoons rice vinegar | 3 tablespoons grated orange peel | grated swiss and monterey jack cheese blend
instructions: Combine all ingredients except sausage, stirring until heated through. Pinch sausage links with a fork.

Random Ingredients: white shoepeg corn,heavy whipping cream,filling,peanut,rice flour
title: Nettle (Nawabi Corn Custard Pie)
ingredients: 1/2 cup chopped peanuts | 1 package frozen white shoepeg corn | 6 tablespoons rice flour | 1 1/2 cups heavy whipping cream | filling : | 2/3 cup rice flour | 1 ounce crushed peanuts, or to taste ( optional, for garnish )
instructions: Fill a skillet with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil. Cook the frozen corn for about 5 minutes, or until cooked but still slightly crisp. Drain and cool enough to handle. Remove the kernels and place in a blender or food processor along with the shoepeg corn kernels, 1 tablespoon rice flour, and 4 tablespoons of the cream. Blend on high for a few seconds until smooth. Add 1/3 cup of rice flour and process until mixture is smooth. Transfer mixture to a 10 inch deep dish pie plate. Sprinkle with 2 tablespoons of crushed peanuts, if using.

Random Ingredients: apple cider,chunky salsa,spaghetti,italian herb seasoning,fruit chutney,cinnamon
title: Apple Salsa Spaghetti
ingredients: 1 lb spaghetti | 1 jar chunky salsa | 1 large apple, peeled and crushed | 8 ounces fruit chutney | 1 tablespoon dried italian herb seasoning | cinnamon, to taste
instructions: Cook spaghetti according to directions on the package. Meanwhile, prepare the sauce. Sauté fruit over medium heat until heated through. Add salsa and cook for 2 to 3 minutes, until hot. Add the herbs and drained spaghetti and mix well. Serve warm or allow to cool and refrigerate.

Random Ingredients: oregano,nam pla,gummy worm,rutabaga,italian salad dressing mix,bulgur,pea
title: Gummy worms With Noodles
ingredients: 3/4 lb rutabaga, diced | 3/4 cup julinne uradura's dried salad dressing mix | 1 package frozen peas | 1 package frozen nummy worms | 1 teaspoon oregano ( dried is easiest to find. i buy it at the italian market ) | 1 teaspoon nam pla ( thai chili paste, or to taste ) or 1 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes ( dried is easiest to find. i buy it at the italian market )
instructions: Put all the ingredients in a large slow cooker and blend well. Cover and cook on high for 1 1/2 hours. If you do not have an old pot, let it cool a little and then stir in a few drops of water until it reaches desired texture. Taste and adjust seasoning. Serve with any or all of the optional garnishes listed above.

title: Prosciutto Wrapped Green Cardamom T <RECIPE_STAR
ingredients: 8 green cardamom pods | 6 slices prosciutto
instructions: Place the green cardamom pods and prosciutto on a cutting board and gently pound 1 of each up and over with the blade of a knife. Remove the cardamom pods from the pods. Slice each cardamom pod in half crosswise. Wrap each half in a slice of prosciutto. Arrange the tassels upright in a shallow salad bowl. Serve.

Random Ingredients: quinoa,swiss cheese,apricot preserve,flat leaf parsley,strawberry jam
title: Swiss and Apricot Quinoa Salad
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa | 1/2 cup apricot preserves | 1 cup shredded swiss cheese | 1/4 cup diced strawberry jam | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley
instructions: Rinse quinoa well and place on a baking sheet. Bake the quinoa 15 to 20 minutes, until it begins to turn golden brown. Let cool completely. Heat jam to boiling in a small saucepan, then remove from heat. Stir in the apricot preserves and heat gently just until warm. Add the quinoa, cheese, and parsley. Taste until cheese is melted and desired consistency is reached.

Random Ingredients: turkey,star anise,chorizo sausage,chili bean,chicken cutlet,wheat germ
title: Spanish Turkey Cutlets With Chorizo and Beans
ingredients: 4 chicken cutlets | 2 star anise | 2 links chorizo sausage | 2 tablespoons wheat germ | 1 can chili beans, drained | 2 tablespoons sliced pickled chorizo sausages, drained
instructions: Heat oil in a skillet over medium high heat. Add chorizo and stir fry until brown, 2 minutes. Add wheat germ, stir fry for one minute. Place chicken cutlets in an 11 x 7 x 2 inch baking dish. Spoon the chorizo and bean mixture over chicken. Cook, uncovered, about 20 minutes, or until chicken juices run clear and chicken is cooked through. Sprinkle with chorizo and serve.

title: Irish Style Hash Browns
ingredients: 1 russet potato, peeled ( about 2 lbs ) | 3/4 large red onion, finely chopped | 3 tablespoons parsley, minced
instructions: Cut potato into 1/2 inch chunks. Place potatoes in a 5 to 6 quart slow cooker. Sprinkle onions and parsley over potatoes. Cover tightly and cook on low heat setting 7 to 8 hours. Do not uncover during the last 30 minutes or so of cooking..

title: Grilled Turkey Tacos
ingredients: 1 jar dried chopped vegetables ( fresh or frozen ) | 2 packets splenda sugar substitute | 1 dried chipotle chile, seeded and chopped ( optional ) | 2 cups chopped cooked chicken cutlets or 2 cups thinly sliced cooked turkey | 2 teaspoons olive oil | 1/4 cup chopped fresh brandy ( optional ) | 2 packages escarole, chopped into bite size pieces
instructions: Cover all ingredients except for escarole with water.

Random Ingredients: double cream,tomato soup,half cream,lamb,purpose flour,rice wine,red snapper fillet,mango chutney
title: Mexican Red Snapper
ingredients: 2 red snapper fillets, skin removed | 1 cup all-purpose flour | 1 cup half-and-half cream | 1/2 cup half-and-half cream | 1 cup tomato soup | 1 tablespoon rice wine | 1 tablespoon mango chutney | 2 tablespoons half-and-half cream | 2 tablespoons half-and-half cream
instructions: Place snapper in a baking dish. Coat fish with flour, then place on top and bake at 400 degree for 10 to 12 minutes, or until cooked through. In a bowl, mix together 2 cups of half and half cream, tomato soup, rice wine, chutney, cream, and 2 tablespoons of the milk until smooth and creamy. Top with the snapper fillets and bake for about 15 minutes or until heated through. To make into a sauce, combine 2 tablespoons of half and half and 2 tablespoons of the milk in a saucepan. Whisk until heated. Stir in the remaining milk. Serve the dipping sauce over the fish.

Random Ingredients: italian plum tomato,fennel seed,red pepper,flat leaf italian parsley,cocktail sauce,french bread
title: Pizza Crouton
ingredients: 1 can italian plum tomatoes, mashed | 1 tablespoon minced fennel seed | 1/4 cup flat-leaf italian parsley, minced | 1/4 cup sweet red pepper, minced | 6 ounces french bread, cut lengthwise into 1/2 inch thick slices | 5 tablespoons bottled cocktail sauce, or to taste | 1 tablespoon minced fennel seeds
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix the tomatoes, fennel seed, parsley, red pepper, and french bread slices. In a small bowl, stir together the cocktail sauce and fennel seeds. Brush each slice of bread with half of the cocktail sauce.

Random Ingredients: cardamom powder,raisin,self raising flour,chicken bouillon,wonton wrapper
title: Bread Dumplings (Koulourakia)
ingredients: 30 wonton wrappers | 2 1/2 cups self-raising flour | 1 teaspoon cardamom powder | 1 tablespoon raisins | 1 1/4 teaspoons instant chicken bouillon
instructions: In a saucepan mix flour, cardamom, raisins and bouillon. Mix well until smooth. Keep warm on a low flame. Separate 2 - 3 tsp of batter mix in a small bowl. Drop one teaspoon of mixture into the batter and the other into the boiling water and immediately turn over. Repeat till all the mixture cooked. Keep dumplings from touching and waiting until all the dough is gone from the pot. Spray the tops of the dumplings with a little oil and put them into a tray. Repeat till all the mixture is used. The more batter mixture left in the tray the crispy dough will be easier to seal. Sprinkle a bit of sugar on top of this when done.

title: Easy Roast Brandy Butter
ingredients: 1/4 cup brandy | 1/4 cup clear honey | 1 1/2 tablespoons tomato paste | 1 shallot, minced | 1 tablespoon grated fresh coriander | 8 ounces panir, chopped
instructions: Place the brandy, honey, tomato paste, shallot, coriander and olive oil into a bowl. Stir well, then place into a pre heated 190 degree c oven and roast for about 30 minutes or until golden and bubbly. Allow to cool slightly, then spoon into warmed sterilised jars, leaving a 1/4 inch knob uncovered, to allow air to collect. Allow to cool on a wire rack to room temperature. Serve at room temperature if you wish.

title: Lobster Thermidor
ingredients: 1 dozen lobster | 4 1/2 cups cream | 1 teaspoon green pea ( optional ) | 2 cloves ( optional )
instructions: Slice lobster.

title: Tex Mex Pot Sticker Curds (Vegetarian)
ingredients: 1 box regular frozen quinoa | 1 cup tequila | 20 wonton wrappers
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Place quinoa in a bowl, and sprinkle with tequila. Leave 1/2 inch of space at the top of the bowl of quinoa. Use a measuring spoon to pack the rice into the bowl, but don't pack it all the way up in the pot. Take a won ton wrapper from a block box of quinoa, and place it up the center of the wrapper nearest to you. Gently draw up the sides of the wrapper by laying it above the bottom, and holding it down slightly, then gently lift down the wrapper about half way. Place on an ungreased baking sheet, and sprinkle the top with a little more tequila. Repeat until you've used up all of the ingredients. Bake for 12 minutes in the preheated oven, or until golden all over. If it looks like it's cooked all the way down, cover the pan with lightly oiled foil. Keep refrigerated until ready to serve.

title: Hot Feta Soup
ingredients: 50 g feta cheese | 150 g leeks ( washed and sliced lengthwwith two ) | 25 g tomato ketchup | 3 teaspoons shaoxing wine | 1 cup stock | 1 tablespoon capers | 2 cardamoms | 1 tablespoon apple ( grated )
instructions: Cut the leeks into 2cm pieces & blanch in a bowl of salted boiling water. The leeks will be slightly softened but should not become translucent. Once cooked, drain & leave them to cool. Cut the feta into chunks or chunks and place in a strainer & rinse thoroughly. Mash the feta with a fork into a smooth paste, then stir through the lemon & the tomato ketchup. Heat the stock & stir in the feta mixture. Stir & bring to boil, then simmer for 20 minutes. Add the capers & cardamom to the soup, then reduce heat. Serve immediately with grated apple, if desired.

Random Ingredients: cream broccoli soup,shrimp,arugula,almond extract,penne rigate,salt pepper,beef tenderloin
title: Baked Beef Tenderloin with Shrimp
ingredients: 1 package penne rigate | 1 pound shrimp - peeled and deveined | 1 teaspoon almond extract | 1/2 cup sour cream and broccoli soup | salt and pepper to taste | 1 pound beef tenderloin, trimmed of fat | 2 bunches fresh arugula, rinsed and chopped
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add the rigate and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

title: Vanilla Crusted Lamb Wings
ingredients: 2 kg leg of lamb ( approx., or any tenderising cut of lamb ) | 2 tablespoons vanilla
instructions: Cut the lamb into 2cm/2 thick slabs, making sure the lamb is well trimmed and leg ends are facing upwards. With a sharp knife, slice each slab diagonally, so that when cut they are roughly twice their original size. Push the slabs into cuts about 1 cm wide. In a large roasting tin, spread the cut lamb out evenly and place in the centre of the roasting tin. Sprinkle the vanillough over the lamb. Push the tail of the lamb into the slabs on the surface and sprinkle with a little black pepper. Dot with icing sugar. Cover with aluminum foil and slow roast in a preheated oven at about 150c/130c gas 3 for about 3 hours or until the lamb is tender and cooked through.

title: Torshi-Wrapped Carrots
ingredients: 1 lb baby carrots, peeled, washed thoroughly | 3 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 2 cups ice water
instructions: Put the carrots in boiling water for about 1 minute, and drain on paper towels. While shaking the carrots, put the vinegar in a saucepan and bring it to a boil. Add the carrots and bring back to a boil once again. Simmer until the carrots are tender, about 5 - 10 minutes. Drain in a colander, shaking the colander a few times, and let drain. Transfer the carrot back to the saucepan and mix in any juice to moisten. Let cool. Transfer the caramelized carrots to serving bowls and serve.

Random Ingredients: broccoli floret,corn,brown sugar,ancho chile,baby spinach,french green bean,rice wine vinegar
title: Spinach and Brown Sugar Salad With Corn and Chiles
ingredients: 1 packet frozen french style green beans | 1/4 cup rice wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon packed brown sugar | 2 canned chopped ancho chiles | 1 cup frozen corn, thawed | 1 cup frozen mixed baby spinach | 2 cups cooked frozen broccoli florets
instructions: Cook beans in boiling water until crisp tender, about 3 minutes.

title: Cranberry Sauce (Indian Cheese Sauce)
ingredients: 16 ounces cranberries or 16 ounces cherries | 1/4 cup cornstarch
instructions: Combine cranberries and cornstarch in a small bowl, stirring well. Heat large saucepan over medium high heat. Whisk in cornstarch 1 tablespoon at a time. When thickened, remove from heat. Stir in cranberries. Serve warm or cold.

title: Sweet Chilli Garlic Lamb (Shui-Korean Style)
ingredients: 1 kg lamb, cut into 6 cm cubes ( leg of lamb preferred ) | 3/4 cup oyster sauce | 1/4 cup ginger puree | 4 cm gingerroot, crushed ( approximately a 1/2-inch piece ginger root ) | 120 g bamboo shoots, cut into 1 cm long strips | 3 tablespoons olive oil ( to coat meat ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons ginger paste from shaoxing wine or 1 1/2 tablespoons garlic puree
instructions: Combine the garlic ginger paste and the oyster sauce in a bowl. Cover and leave to marinate in the fridge overnight. Dry fry the lamb cubes in a hot wok. Remove if they brown and then add to the oyster sauce marinade. Increase the heat and stir fry for about 5 minutes. Add the chilli garlic paste and ginger syrup and stir fry for 5 minutes. Add the bamboo strips. Stir fry for about 5 minutes. Garnish with finely chopped fresh ginger. Serve with rice, perhaps with fish.

Random Ingredients: fish sauce,chipotle powder,pork,onion flake,lamb shank,stilton cheese,pineapple chunk
title: Lamb Shank With Pineapple
ingredients: 4 lbs pork shoulder, and | 4 lbs lamb shanks | 1 1/2 lbs stilton cheese, crumbled or 3/4 lb blue cheese | 1/2 cup dried onion flakes ( i use dehydrated ) | 1/2 cup dried pineapple chunks | 1/4 cup dried chipotle powder | 4 tablespoons fish sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients including seasoning mix in crockpot, and let cook 6 - 8 hrs on low.

Random Ingredients: brown mustard seed,beef sausage,gruyere cheese,worcestershire sauce,buttermilk
title: German Style Sausage and Gruyere Cheese
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs beef sausage ( mild, medium or hot, depending on size of sausages ) | 3 cups shredded gruyere cheese ( about 4 cups if available ) | 1/2 cup buttermilk | 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 1 tablespoon brown mustard seeds or 1 tablespoon cracked wheat
instructions: Cut sausages into thirds or into 6 portions, depending on desired shape/size. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil, add sausages and cook according to package directions or until heated through. Drain meat and remove from pan. While sausages are cooking, melt a little bit of the butter in a large pot over medium heat, add the brown mustard seeds and brown well. Place meat back in the pot and add all the cheese, mixing well with a wooden spoon. Transfer the cheese to a heated platter or bowl, and pour the sauce over until the sausages are coated well. Serve immediately.

title: Easy, Healthy and Elegant White Bean Soup
ingredients: 1 can cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 2 tablespoons chicken broth | jam ( optional ) or cinnamon ( optional ) | 3 pecans or 3 almonds, finely chopped ( optional ) | fresh mint sprig, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Combine beans and broth in saucepan. Heat slowly. Do not boil. Add 2 tbsp jam if desired. Just before serving stir through chopped nuts, optional. This raises the fiber of the beans and helps them to float in the soup. Serve hot, garnished with extra chopped or thinly sliced mint.

Random Ingredients: okra,ghee,thai chile,sesame oil,coconut extract,cocoa powder,white chocolate chip
title: Chocolate and Okra Curry
ingredients: 12 ounces frozen okra, thawed ( the kind in packages without the green part or `` pod '', they look like government-sized chunks of okra ) | 1 1/2 ounces unsweetened coconut flavored shredded coconut-coarsely grated | 1 1/2 teaspoons coconut extract | 4 tablespoons ghee or 4 tablespoons oil | 3 tablespoons sesame oil | 1 tablespoon unsweetened cocoa powder | 2 -3 thai chiles, dried, minced ( you may use 2 serrano peppers )
instructions: Heat the ghee in a large, shallow heavy skillet or wok over medium high heat. Add in the shredded coconut and chiles and cook stirring constantly for about 1 minute. Add in the okra. Mix well. Add the coconut extract and sesame oil and cook stirring until heated thoroughly. Remove from heat and mix in cocoa powder and stir in toasted sesame oil. You may store the curry in the fridge for up to 10 days. Variation, add green curry powder to the okra with the okra, stir in, heat the curry through and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: chunky salsa,mint leaf,sesame seed,pork loin,chili pepper flake,salad oil,pinto bean,parsley
title: Mint Jorim (Stolen Sesame Beans With Pork)
ingredients: 3 -4 cups cooked pinto beans, drained throughly | 6 -12 tablespoons salad oil ( i use olive oil ) | 1/4 cup chili pepper flakes, finely chile paste ( not dried ) | 1/4 cup parsley, finely chopped | 1/4 cup mint leaf | 1/3 cup chunky salsa ( your favorite brand ) | 1 whole boneless pork loin, cut into 1/2 - 2 inch chunks ( to make it easier to slice, you can use 2 lean or 1 lb. if you like ) | 2 teaspoons sesame seeds, toasted
instructions: Put all ingredients into a blender and process for 3 - 4 minutes. If you want a thinner sauce, leave out the seeds and stir in sesame seeds, and serve at once. If you use pork, remove meat prior to shredding. In a large non stick skillet, add the oil and heat on medium high heat until oil starts to smoke. Saute pork until brown on all sides. Remove pork with a slotted spoon to a bowl and toss with sauce, keeping hot over low heat until sauce is well incorporated. If using raw onions, saute over low heat until onion is almost translucent.

Random Ingredients: beef tenderloin,jicama,anise seed,pistachio nut,saffron,fenugreek seed,salmon fillet,white corn tortilla
title: Baked Salmon and Pimenton-Wrapped Tortillas
ingredients: 2 lbs salmon fillets, cut into 1-inch thick slices | 2 teaspoons fenugreek seeds | 3/4 teaspoon finely ground anise seed | 1 1/2 teaspoons salt | 1/2 teaspoon ground fennel seed | 1 teaspoon crushed saffron | 4 jicama, peeled and cut into 2-by-2-inch sticks | 3/4 cup toasted pistachio nut, coarsely chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f mix fish, fenugreek, anise seed, salt, fennel and saffron in medium mixing bowl. Spoon half of fish mixture over fish mixture. Coat both sides of each tortilla with an even coating of oil and place on large baking sheet. Bake at 350°f for 45 minutes to 1 hour and 10 minutes or until fish flakes easily when prodded with a fork. Transfer fish to cutting board and cut into strips. Meanwhile, combine pistachios in a small bowl. Toss with a fork and spread over tortillas. Cool for 20 minutes, then spread nuts over the top. Serve.

title: French Oven Shellfish
ingredients: 1 box pasta shells or 1 box ziti pasta | 2 packages dry onion soup mix | 1 cup anchovy paste
instructions: Prepare a large baking dish. First, boil the pasta in salted water, approximately 6 minutes, until al dente. Reserve 1/2 cup cooking water, but drain the pasta and return it to the pan. In the meantime, mix the garlic and anchovy paste and put together in a medium sized bowl then add some of the cooking water to make a paste. Drain the pasta, reserving 1/2 cup, and mix 1/2 of it into the garlic & anchovy paste mixture. Return all of the pasta to the pan, add the paste mixture and mix well. Pour the pasta into the pan, add 1/2 cup or more of reserved cooking water if it starts to stick. Bake at 400 degrees for about 30 minutes.

title: Easy Beef Enchilada Soup
ingredients: 1 can condensed golden mushroom soup | 1 can enchilada sauce
instructions: Combine soup and enchilada sauce in a large pot. Bring to a boil.

title: Cauliflower Salad
ingredients: 2 cups cauliflower | 2 teaspoons caster sugar | 2 teaspoons italian spices | 2 tablespoons orange zest | 100 g mizithra cheese
instructions: Break down cauliflower into small florets using a sharp knife. Place in a large bowl, sprinkle with caster sugar and italian spices. Toss lightly using your best judgement and lightly sprinkle with the zest of the orange. Chill for 20 minutes before serving.

title: Grilled Pineapple Salad
ingredients: 2 cans pineapple chunks, with juice, well drained | 1/3 cup flat-leaf italian parsley, chopped
instructions: Drain juice from pineapple and discard the pulp. Combine the pineapple juice and parsley in a large bowl. Refrigerate in a pitcher for up to an week.

Random Ingredients: creme de banane,mustard,vegetable oil cooking spray,table salt
title: French Quarter-Style Creme Dauphinoise
ingredients: 1/2 cup creme de banane | 3 tablespoons mustard ( french-style sweet yellow mustard ) | 1/4 teaspoon table salt | 4 teaspoons vegetable oil cooking spray
instructions: Heat oven to 350 degrees f. Combine creme de banane, mustard, and salt in a medium bowl, breaking up lumps. Stir in 3 tablespoon of creme de banana mixture until well combined. Coat a 10 to 12 inch nonstick skillet lightly with cooking spray. Transfer the mixture to the skillet, spreading it evenly in a thin layer. Cook over medium heat 1 to 2 minutes, or until the base is lightly browned. Using a spatula, carefully transfer it to a baking sheet and bake until bubbling, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven and cut into squares.

Random Ingredients: red onion,tea,cheddar cheese soup,pea,purpose flour,cardamom pod,black cardamom pod,dashi
title: Peekies (Peperoncinis) Soup
ingredients: 1 large red onion, finely chopped | 8 ounces frozen peas ( not thawed ) | 1 teaspoon dry dashi ( instant ) | 2 black cardamom pods | 6 black cardamom pods | 1 cup cheddar cheese soup | 1/2 cup all-purpose flour | 12 tea bags or 12 white button mushrooms, sliced
instructions: In a medium saucepan, heat dashi, cardamon pods and black cardamom pods until hot but not burning. Add onion and peas, cook slowly 3 minutes. Stir in cheddar, cook 2 minutes on high. In a small bowl, blend soup and flour until smooth. Stir into onion and peas soup. Bring to boil. Reduce heat to low, simmer gently for 10 minutes. Serve with dumplings or bread.

Random Ingredients: chicken sausage,baking potato,lettuce,swiss cheese,pie crust,currant,taco seasoning
title: Quick and Easy Potato & Swiss Cheese Fold-In
ingredients: 1 pie crust, baked @ room temperature until golden brown | 10 ounces chicken sausage | 1 container fat-free refried beans | 2 cups shredded swiss cheese | 1 package taco seasoning | 1 large baking potato, peeled and cut into wedges
instructions: Heat oven to 425 degrees f. Remove the pie crusts from the oven. Dip the cut up sausage into a skillet and cook over medium heat, breaking up meat with a spoon as it cooks. Drain off fat.

title: Bread and Butter Bean Gratin
ingredients: 1/4 cup pearl fried french beans | 1 can light pears | 1 can oysters | 1/2 cup bulgar, soaked in warm water for 15 30 minutes | 4 slices whole wheat bread, crust removed | 2 tablespoons coarsely crushed wheat bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Combine the french beans, pears, and oysters in a bowl. Mix the bulgur and the boiled bulgur. Strain the bulgur mixture. Arrange bread slices on a rimmed baking sheet and using a serrated knife, score them in small squares. Mix bulgur mixture with the crumbled bread. Bake for approximately 15 minutes.

title: Tropical Pikelets (Doughnuts)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups bread flour or 1 1/2 cups flour, sifted | 3/4 teaspoon sugar syrup | 1 teaspoon bread flour or 1 teaspoon all purpose flour
instructions: In a bowl mix bread flour or flour, sugar and syrup. Mix thoroughly. Let stand 15 - 30 minutes. Form into patties 1 wide and 1 inch thick. Place on ungreased griddle and cook for 45 - 60 seconds, turning once. Turn them over and cook other side 5 - 7 seconds. Sprinkle with powdered sugar and serve warm.

title: Hot Pear Salad
ingredients: 1 pint buttermilk | 3 cloves, crushed | 1/2 ounce ginger ale | 1 red chili pepper | 1 ounce orange peel | 1 teaspoon ground cloves | 6 ounces cheese | 5 pears | lettuce
instructions: Dissolve the buttermilk in the hot pepper juice, add the crushed cloves, ginger ale, chili pepper, and orange peel and let stand for a few hours, until it is reduced by half. Cut the pears into small wedges. In a large bowl, toss the cheese with the remaining buttermilk and the pear wedges. Add the dressing and toss well. Chill until ready to serve.

title: Fondue (Vinaigrette - West European)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups wine ( i used white burgundy ) | 1 cup kalamata olive | 1/4 cup mirin | 1/2 cup grated lemon peel | 1/2 cup chopped banana
instructions: Combine wine, olives, mirin and lemon peel in a 2 qt. Saucepan. Bring to a boil.

Random Ingredients: pecorino romano cheese,ro tel tomato,pesto sauce,adobo seasoning,cream tartar
title: Pesto Rojo
ingredients: 4 cups loosely packed fresh pesto sauce | 1 1/2 cups grated pecorino romano cheese | 2 -4 tablespoons adobo seasoning, from chipotle chile and oregano | 4 -6 teaspoons cream of tartar | 1 can ro-tel tomatoes ( ro-tel brand recommended )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. In a blender or food processor combine the pesto sauce, cheese, adobo and cream of tartar. Cover and refrigerate. Stirring occasionally for about 5 minutes scrape mixture into a medium size bowl. Stir in rotelle roséed tomatoes. Garnish with basil/pesto mixture.

title: Mulligatawny Rice
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups arborio rice | 1 cup rice | 1 tablespoon tamarind paste ( available in some asian supermarkets ) | 2 egg whites | 1 large garlic clove | 3 cups cooked rice | 2 large dried cranberries | papaya ( for garnish )
instructions: Rinse rice in a colander until water runs clear. Place rice, tamarind paste and garlic in a large saucepan and bring to the boil. Cover and simmer for 20 minutes. Remove from heat and let rice sit, covered, for 10 minutes. Meanwhile, beat egg whites until frothy and add to cooked rice, mixing well. Place rice mixture in a medium sized ovenproof dish or in a large bowl with cover. Cook, uncovered, in a moderate oven until rice is light brown, about 25 minutes. Stir in cranberries and serve.

title: Lamb on the Side
ingredients: 3 pounds boneless lamb shoulder, trimmed of fat and cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 1 cup grated gruyere cheese | 1/2 cup lemon curd, or more to taste
instructions: Place lamb cubes into a slow cooker. Sprinkle with Gruyère cheese and lemon curd. Cover and cook on low setting until the lamb is tender enough to be pierced with a fork, 8 to 10 hours. Serve immediately.

title: Rhubarb-Raspberry Lasagna
ingredients: 6 ripe lasagna sheets about 10x14 | 12 tablespoons pesto sauce | 9 ounces raspberries | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom | 12 ounces sugar free fruit-free raspberries ( i used craisins ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons seasoning salt or 2 tablespoons seasoned salt | 1 egg substitute | 1 ounce suet ( optional ) or 1 ounce walnut pieces ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Place a pan of water on the lowest heat of your oven, and heat the pasta box on. To assemble the lasagna, break off the dough, roll it out, and then cut in desired circles the mixture should be quite small, 1/8 to 1/4 thick. Bake the lasagna for 5 minutes, and place a lasagna sheet on top. Spread some pesto on top of the lasagna and let bake another 10 minutes, or until the dough begins to brown.

Random Ingredients: leek,vegetable,garam masala powder,ginger garlic paste,tomato puree,jalapeno pepper,parsley leaf
title: Easy Masala Veggie Masala
ingredients: 1 cup mixed vegetables, such as broccoli florets, baby carrots and baby corn, sliced into rounds | 2 tablespoons ginger-garlic paste | 1 green leeks or 1 white onion, sliced | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala powder | 1 1/2 teaspoons tomato puree or 1 1/2 teaspoons tomato paste | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh parsley leaves ( optional ) | 1 -2 jalapeno pepper, seeded and finely chopped ( optional )
instructions: Rinse the vegetables in a fine mesh sieve or strainer and set them aside. Combine the ginger garlic paste with 1 cup of water and heat over medium heat until hot.

title: Chinese Glass Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 package chinese egg noodles | 1 can sliced bamboo shoots | 1 pound fresh green beans, trimmed
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, stir in the chinese egg noodles, and return to a boil. Cook the noodles uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the noodles have cooked through, but are still firm to the bite, about 5 minutes. Drain well in a colander set in the sink, and allow to steam dry for a minute or two. Remove the noodles from the hot water. Place the bamboo shoots in a bowl of water to soften, about 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: sesame oil,wine vinegar,purpose flour,milk,beet,pork chop,veal,olive oil
title: Gramma Corbasi's Rouladen
ingredients: 1 tablespoon olive oil | 2 boneless pork chops | 1 tablespoon olive oil | 4 medium beets, chopped | 4 teaspoons garlic flavored sesame oil | 3 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 2 cups beef broth ( or chicken ) | 2 tablespoons sesame oil | 2 tablespoons wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons fresh milk
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large frying pan. Cut chops into strips, 2 or 3 pieces. Add to pan and fry them, turning once, until nicely browned on all sides. Place meat in a baking dish, cover with a lid or saran wrap, and marinate for about 30 minutes. Peel the beets, and chop them up finely. Put the beets in the food processor or blender. Mix in all the other ingredients. Cover and marinate for the time stated on the package, and cook overnight in the oven at 190c / 375f / gas 4 for about 1 hour. Remove from the oven when they have been ready to serve and place on a tray to cool. When the rouladen is cooled, heat the sesame oil in another large frying pan. Add the meat and fry on each side, constantly stirring. Transfer to a plate and keep warm while you cook the sauce. Add broth or marinade to the sesame oil in the pan and stir rapidly over medium heat until it boils, then reduce the heat and simmer for about 10 minutes, then stir in vinegar and milk and set aside before serving.

title: Potato Gnocchi with Currant Sauce
ingredients: 1 package potato gnocchi | 1 can condensed vinegar | 2 cups currants | 1/2 cup dried currant | 1 teaspoon dried thyme leaves | 2 teaspoons dried oregano, crushed | 1 teaspoon tapioca flour
instructions: Cook gnocchi in lightly salted water until tender.

title: Yellow Bell Pepper Grilled Vegetables
ingredients: 12 baby yellow bell peppers | 12 large sliced carrots
instructions: Grill the bell peppers in a hot skillet for 5 to 10 minutes or until tender. Cut the charred peppers on a diagonal and arrange them on a plate. Arrange the carrots in a circle around each pepper.

title: Beetroot Carbonara
ingredients: 2 tablespoons chopped pork fat bacon drippings or 2 tablespoons bacon drippings | 2 medium onions, cut into small dice | pasta | 1 can beets in puree, undrained | 1 cup kale, packed and finely chopped | 1/2 tablespoon dark rum ( optional ) | 1 package pecans, chopped
instructions: In a large skillet, cook bacon drippings until crisp. Remove from heat and add onions to drippings. Saute in hot bacon fat until onions are soft. Add beet puree and kale, mix well. Cover, lower heat and simmer until the mixture has thickened slightly and the beets are very tender. Add rum and heat through, stir in pecans. Spoon mixture into a 9 x 13 baking dish, top with remaining bacon drippings and bake at 400 for 20 minutes. Remove and let stand for 5 minutes.

title: Quinoa and Cornbread (Quinoa Cooker)
ingredients: 12 ounces quinoa ( white ) | 1 cup half-and-half | 1/2 cup red wine | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom pods, crushed | cornbread, crumbs
instructions: Place quinoa in the rice cooker, select red wine, and press start. When cooker stops, remove quinoa to a large bowl, set aside, and cover. Add half and half, red wine, and cardamom to pot, and stir to combine. Serve quinoa topped with cornbread crumbs.

title: Caribbean-Style Mango Appetizers
ingredients: 4 large firm mangoes | 2 flour tortillas
instructions: Cut mango flesh lengthwise into 16 wedges. Place fruit wedges onto lightly greased baking sheet. Bake at 350 degrees f for 30 minutes or until mango is tender. Cut tortillas into 20 equal squares, removing excess pieces. Mash mango in a bowl.

title: Grilled Dill Cheesecake
ingredients: 1 cup half-and-half | 8 ounces cream cheese | 24 leaves fresh dill, or more to taste | 8 scallions, chopped | 1 port wine
instructions: Preheat an outdoor grill for high heat and lightly oil grate. Beat half and half cream cheese in a bowl with a fork in a separate bowl. Chop dill and scallions, and mix with cream cheese mixture. Stir in the port. Grill cheesecake 3 to 5 minutes on the center oven rack, or to desired temperature, until browned and set. Serve with warm dill butter.

Random Ingredients: golden brown sugar,corn oil,pork,beer,bicarbonate soda,yukon gold potato,honey
title: Baked Sweet Potato With Honey and Wine
ingredients: 5 tablespoons corn oil | 1 lb yukon gold potato, peeled and chopped into chunks | 2/3 cup honey | 2/3 cup beer | 1 tablespoon bicarbonate of soda | 1 1/2 lbs lean pork, cubed
instructions: Pre heat oven to 425f/160°c. In a large saucepan, heat the oil over a medium heat. Drain the potatoes, but leave the peel intact, and saute until golden, then set aside and leave to cool slightly. To make the beer and honey solution, in a saucepan, combine all the ingredients and bring to the boil over a medium heat. Reduce the heat to a low simmer, and cook uncovered until the liquid has reduced by half, around 10 minutes or so. Pour the liquid into a 2 1/2 cup capacity oven proof dish or casserole dish, add the sweet potatoes, and sprinkle with the honey. Bake on the middle shelf of the oven until the potatoes are golden brown, about 45 minutes. Allow to cool slightly, then cut into wedges and serve.

title: Avocado Pasta Salad
ingredients: 2 medium avocados, diced small | 1 granny smith apple, diced small | 1/2 cup lime zest | 2 cups small pasta | peanut oil ( for frying )
instructions: Place a large pot of water on to boil. Meanwhile, place the oil to heat. When boiling, add small amount of peanut oil and 1/2 teaspoon salt. When oil is heated, add pasta to skillet to cook according to package directions. When pasta is al dente, drain and transfer to bowl with zest. Add diced avocados, apple and lime zest to bowl with cooked pasta. Toss well. Add desired amount of peanut oil to coat pasta and vegetables in oil. Serve with extra salad to add fresh color as desired, such as lime wedges or chopped fresh herbs.

title: Taco Vegetable Packets
ingredients: 2 lbs mixed vegetables ( broccoli, red squash, etc. ) | 1 teaspoon finely grated orange zest | 1 teaspoon finely grated red chili pepper | 1/2 teaspoon finely chopped pickled jalapeno | 1/2 teaspoon taco seasoning
instructions: Put vegetables on a flat plate or on a clean surface such as a cookie sheet. Sprinkle zest, chilies, jalepenos and taco seasoning over vegetables. Seal with plastic wrap and press down to flatten. Leave a little space between bites, because the steam from the microwave can cook down the vegetables and to keep them crunchy. Bake in a hot oven until crisp and heated through. Allow to cool before storing in glass jar.

Random Ingredients: chili pepper flake,vegetable oil cooking spray,cheese tortellini,orange juice,pear,black salt,hash brown,ramen noodle
title: Cheese Tortellini Pronto - Ww Points = 4
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 box frozen cheese tortellini | 10 ounces frozen hash browns | 1/2 teaspoon dried dried chili pepper flakes | 1/2 cup orange juice | 1/4 cup fresh squeezed squeezed orange juice | 3 packages ramen noodles | cracked black salt to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Lightly spray a 7x11 inch baking dish with cooking spray. Bring 12 cups water to a boil in a large pot. Add tortellini and cook until tender but firm to the bite, stirring occasionally, about 8 minutes. Combine cooked tortellini, chopped hashbrowns, dried chili flakes, orange juice, and orange juice in a large bowl. Drain the tortellini mixture under running water and rinse well to remove excess starch. Add tortellini to remaining soup base ingredients.

title: Horseradish Cheese Mushroom Potatoes
ingredients: 1 bag baby spinach ( about 10 ounces ) | 9 ounces of fresh button mushrooms | 3/4 cup prepared horseradish | 4 tablespoons cheddar cheese | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400f degrees. Place spinach on a plate with water near the stove. Cook according to package directions, approximately 3 - 5 minutes. Meanwhile, toast mushrooms in a skillet over low heat, approximately 3 minutes each side until they begin to release their juices. Remove mushrooms from pan and set aside. Drain the spinach well, place it in a strainer, and press as much liquid out of it as possible with your fingers. Dump the spinach into a bowl and toss with the horseradish, cheese, and cardamom. Transfer to a greased 9 x13 baking dish, cover and place in the preheated oven. Bake for 25 - 30 minutes, or until the potatoes are hot and bubbly. Remove from oven and serve immediately.

title: Sgroppino - Pumpkin Bread, Artichoke & Pumpkin Salad
ingredients: 2 loaves brioche bread, cut into 1 `` x 1 '' x 1/2-inch slices ( about 10 x 8 '' ) | 12 ounces grated pumpkin | 1 can artichokes, drained & chopped ( or fresh ) | 1 -2 tablespoon hot pepper flakes ( optional )
instructions: Spread each slice of loaf with a thin layer of pumpkin and top with a few artichoke chokes, if using. Top with remaining bread, pressing down to compact. Slice off top of bread crust and cut into 6 or 8 equal pieces. Place on cookie sheet & bake at 350 degrees for about 30 minutes or until puffed & lightly golden. Let cool for 10 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: sharp cheddar cheese,chinese cabbage,baking soda,ziti pasta,radish,anchovy
title: Korean Baked Ziti
ingredients: korean-style chinese cabbage ( cha-kae ) | 1 head chinese cabbage ( daikon-dang ) | 1 quart radish, thinly sliced ( daikon-shi ) | 8 anchovies, chopped | baking soda | 1 package ziti pasta
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a large pot, combine the shredded cabbage, radishes, anchovies, and baking soda. Toss with the ziti. Spread on a baking sheet and bake for 1 hour and 15 minutes, or until the ziti is crispy on the edges. Serve with korean sweet chile, chile powder, or hot pepper sauce.

Random Ingredients: lettuce leaf,parmesan cheese,herring fillet,coriander leaf,bean sprout,red capsicum
title: Herring Salad in Prawns
ingredients: 1 bunch coriander leaves, washed, finely chopped | 1 cup capelline beans sprouts | 1 small red capsicum, chopped ( bell pepper ) | 1/4 cup finely grated parmesan cheese | 1/4 cup small lettuce leaf, washed | 1 herring fillet, filleted
instructions: Place coriander and capsicum in a bowl. Grate parmesan cheese and scatter over the lettuce leaves. Arrange the sprouts over the lettuce. Place the fish fillet on top of the sprouts. Sprinkle over the cheese. Cover in plastic wrap and put aside for 30 minutes. Cook the prawns over a moderate heat in a dry frying pan until the shells have turned opaque and the meat is cooked through.

Random Ingredients: noodle,heavy whipping cream,madras curry powder,tomato sauce
title: Noodle and Madras Ramekins
ingredients: 8 ounces noodles | 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream | 1 tablespoon madras curry powder | 2 tablespoons tomato sauce ( or ketchup plus salt )
instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions. When done, drain the noodles and add to the cream in the container. Add curry powder and mix well. Add tomato sauce to taste. Place noodles in serving dish, sprinkle with madras curry powder. Enjoy.

title: Sausages on Saffron
ingredients: 8 sausages ( or 2 prawns ) | 8 ounces of diced ham ( or 1/2 tin of ham, diced ) | 1 tablespoon of minced garlic | 1 tablespoon of diced lemon peel | 1 tablespoon double cream
instructions: Wash sausages and pat dry with paper towel. Slice the sausages into long thin slices. In a frying pan, add the garlic and lemon peel and sweat for 2 minutes. Add the bacon and sauté until its fat begins to run out. Add the sausages and ham slices. Sauté until the meat is cooked through. Add double cream. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: cardamom seed,yellow squash,coconut milk,farfalle pasta,ricotta cheese,carrot,stella doro anisette toast
title: Stella Doro Macaroni Grill
ingredients: 1/2 cup flaked coconut milk | 1 cup shredded carrot | 1 cup shredded yellow squash | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom seed | 1 1/3 lbs favelli ( bow tie ) pasta | 1/2 cup stella doro anisette toast | 1 cup ricotta cheese
instructions: In large saucepan, add coconut milk, carrot, squash and cardamom seeds. Bring to a boil. Cook pasta according to package directions. Drain pasta and return to pot. Add sieved ricotta cheese and stir til well mixed.

Random Ingredients: white wine vinegar,cherry pepper,baby spinach,cremini mushroom
title: Strip the Magic Bullet Spinach
ingredients: 1 bag baby spinach | 1 bag cremini mushrooms, cleaned and sliced | 3/4 cup white wine vinegar or 3/4 cup vinegar, of your choice | 1 jar cherry peppers, drained
instructions: Place the bag of spinach in the spinach with the liquid from bag of mushrooms. Close the lid and shake a little bit to release some water if any. Open the lid again, and pour the vinegar around the spinach. Close in the lid, and shake a little bit to mix the whole thing up. Put it away. Let it stand for half an hour before enjoying.

title: Gazpacho
ingredients: 1 can fat-free refried beans with jalapeno | 3/4 cup tomato juice | 2 tablespoons dried dill weed | 1 teaspoon dried sage | 1 tablespoon ground cucumber | 1/3 cup chopped almonds
instructions: Stir together the refried beans, tomato juice, dill weed, sage, cucumber, and almonds.

Random Ingredients: jigger cranberry juice,beef steak,serrano pepper,brown sugar,egg wash,sherry,black tea,pomegranate juice
title: Faux-Friendly Spicy Marinated Flank Steak
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dry sherry | 1 tablespoon brown sugar | 1 tablespoon pomegranate juice | 2 pickled serrano peppers, drained ( seeds included ) | 2 tablespoons jigger sweet sherry | 1 tablespoon pickled jigger cranberry juice | 3 egg wash | 1 boneless beef flank steak
instructions: To make marinade, in a small nonmetal bowl, combine sherry, brown sugar and pomegranate juice.

title: Chef John's Vegetarian Pate of Alan Leonetti (((Wonderful)))
ingredients: 1/2 cup margarine, plus extra for greasing | 1/2 lb veal, sliced into chunks | 1/2 ounce dehydrated sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained and chopped ( not oil packed ) | 1/2 teaspoon dried mixed herbs ( basil, parsley, oregano and rosemary ) | banana leaf | fresh herb, such as mint
instructions: Melt the margarine in a skillet. Add the veal, tomatoes and herbs, and toss to coat well. Place the bananas on a serving plate, cover with a layer of vegan margarine and top with a heaping spoonful of vegan cheese. Serve with fresh herbs like mint leaves and basil.

title: Scallops Cakes
ingredients: 1 lb scallops | bread, crumbs | 1/4 cup fresh parsley, finely chopped | cooked brown rice, as needed | 1/2 lb spaghetti sauce, i use ragu robusto | 1/2 lemon, zest of, grated | 1/2 cup peanuts, chopped
instructions: Toast bread and dry with foil and spread in a cast iron skillet. Sprinkle over scallops. Combine cooked rice, spaghetti sauce, lemon zest, and peanuts. Add to scallops. Cook over medium high heat until heated through. Serve.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice,jalapeno pepper,red chile pepper,extra tofu
title: Jalapeno Tofu
ingredients: 1 package extra firm tofu | 2 tablespoons lemon juice, or as needed | 3/4 ounce jalapeno pepper | 1 red chile pepper
instructions: Drain the tofu, reserving water. Place the tofu in a steamer or deep pot set over a pan of lightly salted water. Cover, and steam over medium heat for 12 to 15 minutes. Meanwhile, stir lemon juice into enough water to cover the tofu and jalapeno. Place the whole red pepper on the top of the tofu in the steamer. Cover, and steam for 12 to 15 minutes, or until the tofu is fork tender and the peppers are tender. Serve tofu warm with the chopped green onion.

title: Roasted Fennel Bread
ingredients: 1 teaspoon fennel seed | 1 1/2 slices rye bread | 1 tablespoon oyster sauce, or as needed
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Combine fennel seed with rye toasted bread slices in a small bowl. Pour enough oyster sauce overtop to cover the bread. Sprinkle bread lightly with more fennel seeds. Roast bread in the preheated oven until browned and crumbly, about 20 minutes.

title: The Best Green Tomato Jam for Chourico
ingredients: 6 green tomatoes, about 2 pounds | 18 jalapeno chiles ( seeded and deveined ) | 1/4 cup chambord raspberry liquor
instructions: Peel the tomatoes. Cut tomatoes in half lengthwise. Remove the seeds. Cut each half into thick slices about 1/4 inch thick. Slice each half into 4 wedges. Arrange the hot jalapenos on a foil lined baking sheet. Drizzle the plum seeds, which should be on the tomatoes and chilis. Broil 15 to 25 minutes, depending on their color, turning once.

title: Horseradish Canapes
ingredients: 2 tablespoons horseradish | 1/2 cup vegetable broth or 1/2 cup water | 1 tablespoon vanilla essence | 1 screwpine leaves, rinsed and dried
instructions: Combine horseradish, broth and vanilla. Divide the mixture among clean, dry non stick frying pay. Wrap screwtop leaves and add to each ear. Bring to a slow boil. Reduce heat and cook for 20 - 25 minutes. Cool and refrigerate until solid, at least 2 days.

Random Ingredients: fruit raisin,cinnamon,golden syrup,cheese,apple juice,beef heart,cake pastry flour,honey mustard
title: Chipped Beef Heart Parcels
ingredients: 2 beef heart pieces | 3 tablespoons honey mustard | 2 tablespoons golden syrup | 1 tablespoon sour apple juice | 150 ml cake-and-pastry flour | 3 tablespoons cake-and-pastry flour | cinnamon | 80 g dried fruit ( raisins, sultanas, dried apricots or dates ) | 200 g grated tasty cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 c / 325 degree f / gas mark trim or slice beef heart pieces into small pieces. Lightly spray 2 x 140cm bread trays with cooking oil. Place a meatball mix into each tray. Bake for 6 to 7 minutes or until cooked through. Drain well. Combine the glaze ingredients in a jar with a tight lid and shake vigorously. Set aside 1 teaspoon of this mixture and set aside to glaze. Spray an oven tray with cooking oil. Place a tray in a large bowl. Add the flour, cinnamon and fruit. Mix lightly with your hands. Dop the beef in the glaze. Turn each piece over to coat the beef. Place the beef onto the tray and cover with foil. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes or until beef is tender. Remove the meat from the oven and increase temperature to 220 degrees c / 425 degrees f / gas mark remove the beef and set aside to rest for 5 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, remove the meat pieces from the sauce. Pour any juices into a bowl and mash with a wire whisk and place them in the sauce.

title: Homestyle Chinese Green Salad
ingredients: 1 package mixed salad greens | 3/4 cup catsup
instructions: Arrange greens on plates. Mix the catsup and pour over salad. Serve.

Random Ingredients: shortcrust pastry,red wine vinegar,kirsch,hot pepper,large shrimp,bow tie pasta,white vinegar,french bread
title: Gourmet Hot Shrimp Pasta Salad - the Hot & Riesling Style
ingredients: 300 g bow tie pasta or 300 g farfalle pasta | 120 g small cooked medium-large shrimp | 20 g shortcrust pastry | 100 g french bread, cut into 1-in cubes | 3 teaspoons red wine vinegar | 2 teaspoons white vinegar | 2 hot peppers | 1 dash kirsch
instructions: Cook the bowts in boiling water with 2 tsp of salt until cooked but tender. Drain well and set aside. Meanwhile, steam the shrimp in boiling water for 30 seconds, until pink. Drain, cool and slice in half lengthways, and set aside. Remove and reserve the shellfish heads and shells for another use. Rinse the shellfish well under running water, and pat dry. Dry thoroughly and transfer the shellfish heads into a bowl. Add all the remaining ingredients and toss to combine. Allow the pasta to cool slightly before adding the shrimp mixture, mix, then transfer to a serving bowl. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: cajun seasoning,spanish onion,half cream,spaghetti sauce,brie cheese,black salt pepper,red wine,port wine
title: Baked Port Cheddar Noodle Sauce

instructions: Pre heat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit. Cook noodles drain & set aside. Heat sauce in a large saucepan or dutch oven over medium heat. Add cooked noodles, and top with remaining sauce and the smoked cajun seasoning. Place in oven for 30 minutes. Enjoy.

title: White Beans With White Beans
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs white beans | 1 1/2 cups sodium-reduced chicken stock or 1 1/2 cups canned broth
instructions: Rinse beans and place in large saucepan. Add water to cover beans by 2 inches and bring to boil over moderate heat. Reduce heat, cover and simmer very gently undisturbed until tender, about 6 to 8 minutes. Add stock and bring to boil over moderate heat. Reduce heat and simmer, covered until beans are tender, about 3 minutes more. Serve sprinkled with freshly grated nutmeg an dallin if desired.

title: Garlic Pepperoni
ingredients: 1/2 lb pepperoni, chopped | 1 package bacon | 2 tablespoons garlic powder | 3 cardamom pods ( crushed )
instructions: Cut pepperoni into small pieces and fry in a little oil until they are almost black. Add pepperoni to pan and fry until pepperoni is crisp and golden brown. Add the cooked pepperoni to pan and stir quickly. Add more oil if necessary and add garlic powder and crushed cardamom. Stir until the pepperoni is mixed with the spices and add salt to taste.

title: Candy Canege
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs potatoes starch or 1 1/2 lbs starch ( not self-rising flour ) | 1 1/2 gallons warm beer | 1 tablespoon almond extract | 20 asparagus tips, cut in 1-inch thick pieces
instructions: In a heavy duty plastic bucket combine the potatoes starch and beer. Heat and stir until the mixture starts to bubble. Add the almond extract. Add asparagus. Cover. Simmer until the asparagus start to color slightly and the dough is smooth, about 30 minutes. Cool for 10 minutes. Drain and cool completely and store in an airtight container.

title: Cheese Fonduta
ingredients: 1 box pasta | 1 romano cheese, grated
instructions: Put a couple cups of cheese into a bowl and add a bit of a shot of romano cheese and mix it up. Dump the pasta into the pan and let it get hot, too. Serve up with a green onion if desired. Note, if you do the dipping recipe right on the box, it will be difficult to dip the cheese into the hot pasta, so you may prefer to throw it in a plastic bag while eating the dish. Substitution, if it's too soft, add a small little yogurt in between dipping and sprinkling.

title: Chinese Roast Chicken

instructions: Preheat oven to 300f and brush the inside lightly with oil. Combine all ingredients including the wings in a blender and process on high speed for 2 minutes, stopping when mixture is smooth. Place the chicken on a large roasting pan and add the remaining ingredients. Spoon over the chicken. Place in oven and bake 1 - 1 1/2 hours. Turn chicken twice during the cooking process.

Random Ingredients: egg noodle,baking potato,banana pepper,tomato garlic,coconut cream,provolone cheese,crab
title: Baked Potato With Crab, Avocado and Provolone
ingredients: 1 lb baking potato | 6 tablespoons unsweetened coconut cream | 2 tablespoons imitation crab | 5 1/2 ounces crab sticks ( cooked and drained ) | 3/4 cup shredded provolone cheese | 6 -8 slices provolone cheese | 4 eggs ( lightly beaten ), for garnish
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Toss potatoes with coconut cream. Spray baking sheet with nonstick cooking spray. Cut 1/8 of potato on top of potato. Place into baking sheet. Bake 25 to 30 minutes, or until golden brown. Drain on paper towel. Place remaining potato in bowl. Add imitation crab, crab sticks, cheese and 3/4 of egg. Stir to combine. Spoon on top of potato, sprinkle with remaining 1/4 c cheese, and bake for 15 - 20 minutes, or until golden and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: cooking onion,mint sprig,white pepper,red onion,green chili,topping
title: Lebanese Vegetable Juice
ingredients: 1 small cooking onion, chopped | 10 green chili, chopped | 2 tablespoons mint sprigs | 1 1/2 cups soft fresh topping | 2 -3 drops white pepper, to taste ( optional ) | 1 cup low-fat low-sodium canned green chili
instructions: Chop onion and chilies finely. Combine all ingredients in a blender or food processor and puree for a 1 to 1 1/2 minute. Note that if you want a smoother consistency with the soup, the ingredients can be mixed up with a little more of the green chilli paste, which is diluted in a little water or milk.

title: Maraschino Bites (Marinated Marinated Fish)
ingredients: 6 maraschino cherries ( green or red ) | 3 tablespoons thai fish sauce | 1/4 cup thai fish sauce, for frying
instructions: Put cherries into a strainer to remove the juices.

title: Lamb Massalao, the Secret Recipe
ingredients: 1 lb boneless lamb shoulder, trimmed and cut into 1/3-inch squares | 1/3 cup tapioca, soaked in 1/2 cup warm water | 6 hard-boiled eggs, peeled | 6 whole black cardamom pods, crushed
instructions: In a pot, bring 2 1/2 2 cups of water to boil. Add the lamb cubes and simmer until the meat is tender, about 25 minutes. Drain and reserve the pot. Toss the tapioca with 2 cups of the lamb liquid in the pot. Place the hard boiled eggs in the pot, cover the pot and simmer 5 minutes. Pour in the lamb and hard boiled eggs. Cover and simmer 5 minutes longer.

title: Soy Belly Beans
ingredients: 1 cup bean sprouts, drained | 1 beef bouillon cube | 1 teaspoon orange zest, zest of
instructions: Boil the bean sprouts in a wok or large frying pan for five minutes, then drain. Add the bouillon cube to the water in the pan, and boil for an additional 5 minutes to flavor the broth. Add the orange zest, remove from heat and serve.

Random Ingredients: mace,coconut milk,farfalle pasta,soya sauce,red potato,english muffin,superfine sugar
title: American Muffin Bake
ingredients: 350 g farfalle pasta or 350 g penne | 8 large red potatoes | 300 ml coconut milk | 1 teaspoon superfine sugar | 1 teaspoon mace or 1 teaspoon curry | 1 teaspoon soya sauce | 6 english muffins, split | 1 teaspoon superfine sugar ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 200degc. Oil a 19cm by 28cm cake tin or a large roasting tin and line it with aluminium foil or grease proof paper. Cook the pasta in boiling water to cover for 7 - 8 minutes and drain. Meanwhile, peel the potatoes and cut into smallish cubes or shred them with a mandolin. Boil, steam or microwave the potatoes, until tender. Drain and return to the pan. Pour the coconut milk, sugar, mace or curry and soya sauce into a bowl and stir well. Stir in the potatoes and mash well. Divide the mixture among the paper lined cake tin and smooth the surface. Use a toothpick or a knife to give a criss cross pattern all over. Smooth the surface even and spread the potato mixture over the top until it is even and slightly thicker. Bake in the preheated oven for 50 - 60 minutes until golden.

title: Chipotlé
ingredients: 1/2 cup low-fat sour cream | 1/4 cup fresh irish cream | 1 tablespoon mirin | 2 teaspoons chipotle chiles in adobo
instructions: Blend all ingredients together in a food processor. Chill in refrigerator for 1 hour prior to serving.

title: Sicilian Chicken Drumsticks
ingredients: 8 chicken drumsticks, with | breadcrumbs | 4 serrano peppers
instructions: Rinse and dry the drumsticks. Sprinkle them with salt. Place 1 tablespoon of bread crumbs in each drumstick. Cover with a few drops of olive oil. Set on a baking tray lined with parchment paper. Set in a warm oven. Bake 20 minutes or until juices run clear.

title: Steak Flambe
ingredients: 1 lb top round steak | 2 tablespoons whipping cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 500 degrees fahrenheit. Cut steak into four portions. Place on a greased baking sheet. Paint with cream and sprinkle both sides with pepper. Bake 15 minutes. Serve immediately.

title: Sake-Marinated Japanese Steak
ingredients: 6 -10 lbs steak ( japanese-style or other, i use skirt ) | 1 cup sake | 1 cup grand marnier
instructions: Cut meat into 6 - 8 medallions. Place each medallion on serving plate. Combine sake, grand marnier and sake. Pour mixture over meat. Serve with plain white rice and hot steamed vegetables.

title: Irish Whiskey Cornflour Clam Chowder
ingredients: 1 kg clams | 2 tablespoons corned beef or 2 tablespoons fish stock | 2 cm fresh ginger, grated | 1 spring onion, chopped finely | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 1 tablespoon cornflour ( cornstarch has a 'crumbly looking' taste ) | 2 tablespoons whiskey | 1/4 teaspoon black mustard seeds
instructions: Boil the clams in water for 1 minute. Drain. Rinse clams and add in the corned beef or fish stock. Put on lid and cook for 3 minutes. In a separate pan, add ginger, green onion and cornflour mix with whiskey and mustard seeds. When bubbling, put in clams and cook till the clams have opened through the liquid and reduced slightly. To serve, stir.

title: Ethiopian Green Cardamom Sherbet
ingredients: 1 1/2 pints green cardamom pods, peeled | 1/2 cup dry sherry
instructions: Crush the cardamom pods in a mortar, if necessary. Place the cardamom pods into a 4 quart saucepan, add the sherry, and bring to a boil over moderately high heat. Reduce the hear to low and simmer, stirring occasionally, for 20 minutes. Discard the cardamom pods and serve immediately.

title: Dieter's Fish Casserole
ingredients: 1/2 lb firm fish | 1 small whole salmon | 1/2 cup mixed berry, with | 1/2 cup red potatoes, thinly sliced | 1 medium shallot ( minced ) | 1/2 lb celery rib ( sliced ) | 1/3 cup fresh basil leaf | 2 tablespoons capers
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Prepare a large casserole dish with a lid. In a bowl, add fish, mushrooms and shallots to the mixture, then add berry with the capers to the mixture. Sprinkle celery with basil and layer in casserole dish. Add the fish mixture and cover the casserole dish and bake in oven for 45 min.

title: Creamy Hazelnut and Kaffir Lime Dessert
ingredients: 2 cups single cream | 1 tablespoon sweet paprika | 6 -10 fresh kaffir lime leaves, torn in a few, leave one stem on ( or more, to your taste ) | 1/2 cup very very finely chopped hazelnuts, toasted and roughly chopped
instructions: Place cream and paprika in a heavy bottomed saucepan and bring rapidly to boil. Add the lime leaves or kaffir lime leaves and return to boil. Add nuts and cook gently over low heat for 2 - 3 minutes. Taste and season with salt and pepper. Pour into serving bowl and cut into chunks.

title: A+ Crunchy Baked Sesame Nuts
