instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Place the ginger, pepper and juice in a bowl and add the oil, tahini. Add the chickpeas and toss together. Place in a baking dish and top with pine nuts and celery. Season with black pepper and cook for 15 minutes, until toasted and hot, stirring gently to keep them from sticking. Serve warm or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: water chestnut,red potato,tarragon vinegar,extra beef,lima bean,corn,serrano pepper
title: Barbecue Beef and Potato Salad on the Skillet
ingredients: 1 lb extra lean ground beef | 3 tablespoons red potatoes, uncooked | 1 cup frozen lima beans | 1 can corn, drained | 1 tablespoon fresh tarragon vinegar | 1 serrano pepper, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons water chestnuts, drained and finely chopped
instructions: Spray a large nonstick skillet with cooking spray. Over medium high heat, break the meat into large chunks about 1/4 1/2 inch. Using a slotted spoon, remove any excess meat from the skillet.

Random Ingredients: cassava,icing sugar,salsa con,turnip,chicken tender,red wine vinegar
title: Cassava and Turnip Salad
ingredients: 6 -10 large cassava, rinsed ( peeled if frozen ) | 20 -30 large turnips, rinsed if frozen | 1/2 cup red wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon icing sugar | 2 tablespoons salsa con queso ( or other hot con crema, hot chilies, aji or enchil pepper )
instructions: Wash, peel and chop the cassava very finely, then stir in all the other ingredients and chill for at least 2 hours before serving.

title: Coconut Coconut Chicken
ingredients: 1 1/4 kg coconut, desiccated | 250 g chocolate chips | 300 g skinless chicken breast fillets | 1 tablespoon coriander powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c. Line a large baking tray with baking paper. Place the coconut over a medium high heat, stirring continuously until the coconut has melted and starts to darken. Dip chicken and place in fridge. Melt 2 tbsp of the coconut in a bowl and add the melted coconut & chocolate. Mix well. Place chicken pieces in a single layer on the tray, spacing them roughly 2cm apart. Sprinkle with coriander. Bake for 20 - 25 minutes or until cooked through. Serve.

title: Warm Cape Slice
ingredients: 350 g spaghetti, cooked until tender ( ca. 35 mins ) | 175 g bacon ( chopped ) | 1 red cabbage | 4 spring onions, chopped | 1/4 cup apricot nectar
instructions: Heat oven to moderate. Line an ovenproof bowl with baking paper. Cook bacon in a non stick pan for 5 minutes stir in cabbage and onions. Place pasta into bowl and pour over remaining ingredients. Sprinkle with bacon/cabbage mix well. Cook for 20 minutes, until heated through, if mixture curls and starts to brown.

title: Quick Oat Stuffing
ingredients: 2 cups quick cooking oats | 2 cups shredded red cabbage
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Lightly coat a 2 quart baking dish with cooking spray. Place oats and shredded cabbage in a large bowl. Use hands to mix. Spread mixture onto the bottom of the baking dish. Sprinkle top with baking powder. Cover with aluminum foil. Bake in preheated oven for 40 minutes. Remove foil. Bake until light brown, about 35 minutes.

Random Ingredients: mint sprig,kalamata olive,tuna vegetable oil,green cardamom pod,caster sugar,vegetable
title: Moroccan Tuna Pies-Patties
ingredients: 1 teaspoon vegetable oil | 200 g mixed vegetables, chopped into 3cm dice | 3 green cardamom pods, crushed | 2 tablespoons chopped of fresh mint sprigs | 350 g tuna in vegetable oil | 1/4 cup caster sugar | 2 tablespoons kalamata olives, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c combine the oil with the vegetables, cardamom, mint, tuna and sugar in a large bowl. Season with salt and pepper and stir to combine. Spoon mixture into 8 mini muffin pans. Bake for 15 minutes or until hot and risen. Stand for 3 minutes in pan, then unmould onto plate before serving. For omac, serve topped with olives.

Random Ingredients: green cardamom pod,chicken wing,red pepper flake,radish,head cabbage
title: Persian Cabbage Chicken
ingredients: 1 small head of cabbage, about 2 pound | 2 green cardamom pods | 1 dash crushed red pepper flakes | 8 -10 lbs chicken wings ( fresh or frozen ) | 1 small radish, sliced thin ( to garnish )
instructions: Core cabbage and cut into quarters. Using a sharp knife, remove the hard core at the base of the cup. Remove the core from each head half. Slice the head into bite size chunks removing any large clumps. Cut each of the chicken wings into thirds and then crosswise into 3 - 4 pieces. Separate the wings from the thigh portion and separate them from the drum bone. Reserve any remaining wing segments for gravy or serve separately for a soup. Place the reserved wings and whole pods in a deep ceramic pot or large bowl. Wash cabbage thoroughly and add to the pot with the reserved wings, cardamom pods, red pepper flakes, and water, and bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and cook for about 30 - 40 minutes until tender. Meanwhile, separate the radish into 4 thin strips and drop into cold water to halt the cooking process. While the cabbage is cooking, slice the radish thin and place on a plate. Add more water if necessary to bring the temperature back down. Slice the radish into matchstick pieces and place in a bowl with the onion and the sliced radishes and stir well to mix. Remove cabbage from its liquid and serve the chicken, along with any gravy left in the bowl. Adjust the seasoning if necessary. Note, i don't add any salt as it can make the dish look bland for a bland dish.

title: Mock Sesame Barley Pudding
ingredients: 1 cup pearl barley | 2 tablespoons sesame oil | 10 wooden skewers, cut in half
instructions: Rinse and drain barley. Stir in sesame oil to taste. Transfer to a small saucepan and stir in barley. Cover and simmer until done.

title: Penne with Sweet Peppered Peppers
ingredients: 1 lb sweet peas ( about 8 ) | 2 quarts cold water
instructions: Boil peas in water until they can be pierced with a sharp knife or knife. Drain and place in a large soup kettle. Add sugar, cover and simmer for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Grilled Citrus Hot Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons fresh lime juice | 2 teaspoons grated orange zest | 1/2 teaspoon dried sage, crushed | 1 -2 drop hot sauce, such as sriracha
instructions: Combine the lime juice, orange zest, sage and chili hot sauce in a small bowl and stir to blend. If not using an outdoor grill, preheat your grill to high. Place a small plate on top for easy extraction while holding the rack 2 inches above the grill. Remove 1 tablespoon of hot sauce mixture after 5 minutes of grilling. Using tongs, dip the heated grilling rack and the rack directly directly under the hot coals for about 1 to 1 1/2 minutes, turning over once. Transfer the warm grilling rack to cool slightly and remove the rack from the direct heat. Cover tightly with plastic wrap and allow to stand at room temperature for 15 to 20 minutes for the infused flavors to develop.

Random Ingredients: purple onion,dijon mustard,gruyere,loaf french bread,beef sirloin steak,almond extract,oregano
title: Baked Beef & Gruyere Panini
ingredients: 6 beef top sirloin steaks | dijon mustard | 1/2 cup crumbly bread, crumb finely crushed fine | 1 small purple onion, finely chopped | 1/2 cup gruyere, shredded | 1 teaspoon dried oregano | 1 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Cut each steak into 6 pieces, then arrange on a medium baking pan. Mix together bread crumbs, onion, gruyere, oregano and almond with a few tbsp of water until well blended. Pour mixture onto beef and shake to coat. Sprinkle each piece of meat with bread crumb mixture. Turn each piece of meat over and spread evenly with gruyere mixture. Bake at 400f for 40 - 50 minutes or until meat is cooked to desired tenderness.

Random Ingredients: macaroni,sea salt,superfine sugar,cumin seed,spring onion,lime juice
title: Chilli and Herb Macaroni With Lime Syrup
ingredients: 1 kg macaroni | 2 tablespoons sea salt | 12 tablespoons dried spring onions, minced | 14 1/2 ml cumin seeds | 2 tablespoons superfine sugar | 4 tablespoons fresh lime juice
instructions: Place your macaroni and salt in a large jug and pour boiling water over them, to come up a third of the way up the side of the macaroni. The water should come about halfway up the pack. Leave for five minutes if you like it really mushy, or a further 10 minutes if the salt just covers the pasta. Meanwhile, place your other three ingredients in a small saucepan. Bring to the boil, then turn the heat down and simmer for about 15 minutes. Remove from heat, stir in the cumin seeds and lemon juice and set aside. Cook the macaroni in the boiling water for 6 - 10 mins or until just tender and then drain. Transfer to a shallow serving dish. Stir in the lime syrup, pour over the macaroni and sprinkle with the cumin seeds.

title: Apple Black Beans
ingredients: 1 can black beans | 1 bell pepper, cut in small squares | 1 apple, chopped | 1 tablespoon dried chipotle powder
instructions: Pour beans into slow cooker. Add the chopped apples. Sprinkle pepper and dried chipotle powder on top. Cook on high for 5 hours.

Random Ingredients: liver,spanish onion,strawberry,chicken wing,red wine,tarragon,fajita seasoning,parmesan cheese
title: Fajita Chicken Wings
ingredients: 20 -24 lbs chicken wings, whole | 1 bunch fresh strawberries | 2 large spanish onions | 1 bunch fresh tarragon | 2 packages fajita seasoning | 1 cup red wine ( good quality or semi sweet ) | 1 lb parmesan cheese | parsley
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f. Mix seasonings in a large bowl. Marinate chicken for several hours or in the refridgerator overnight. Bring to boil with some water, then transfer to roasting pan. Bake, basting ocasionally, for 1 1/2 hours. Stir often. When done remove from heat and let cool in pan. Cut and discard wing tips, and remove wings apart. Arrange wings on platter or on serving platter. Sprinkle parmesan cheese over top. Garnish with fresh strawberries and chopped parsley. Note, these can be used in the frigerator.

Random Ingredients: white pepper,feta cheese,self raising flour,soup meat,coffee granule,taco seasoning mix,green bell pepper,feta
title: Cheat's Baked Taco Meat Sausages
ingredients: 16 ounces soup, chopped mixed meat | 1 green bell pepper, finely chopped | 1 packet taco seasoning mix or 2 teaspoons instant minced onion | 2 tablespoons instant coffee granules | 1 teaspoon white pepper | 1 tablespoon feta cheese ( optional ) | 1 1/4 cups self-raising flour | 1 1/2 cups self-raising flour
instructions: Put the chopped meat into a baking dish with the chopped green pepper. Sprinkle over the taco mix and the white pepper. Pour over the coffee and set aside. Sift the flours into a large bowl. Work with one flour into a fine batter with clean hands. Heat a cast iron, oiled frying pan or griddle on med high. Dust your hands with flour and divide the batter between the sausages. Cook for 2 - 3 mins each side or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: mini chocolate chip,cauliflower,brown rice,celery rib,swiss cheese,taco sauce
title: Cauliflower and Swiss Cheese Wraps (21 Day Wonder Diet: Day 11)
ingredients: 1 small cauliflower, broken into florets | 1/2 cup reduced-fat swiss cheese, grated | 1 1/2 cups cooked mini chocolate chips | 1/2 cup low-fat reduced-fat swiss cheese, grated | 1 1/2 teaspoons low-fat taco sauce | 1 celery rib, finely chopped | 1 cup cooked brown rice
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180°c. Line a baking tray with baking paper. Heat a large non stick frying pan on a high heat, add the cauliflower and swiss cheese. Stir fry for 2 minutes. Add remaining ingredients. Bring mixture to the boil. Cook for 2 minutes, then remove from heat. Fill wraps using 1/2 cup of mixture and roll in reserved swiss cheese. Lay on oven tray and bake 15 - 20 minutes, until golden and bubbling.

title: Penne Pasta Fazool
ingredients: 1 lb penne ( dried ) | 3 large onions, sliced thinly
instructions: Cook penne according to package directions. In a separate pot, cover penne with cold water and bring to boil. Add onions in batches and cook until tender, and drain. Return onions. To serve, place penne in a bowl and top with cooked onions. Season with onion powder, salt and pepper.

Random Ingredients: pasta sauce,brandy,garlic salt,bean sprout,italian seasoning,pesto sauce,dill
title: Pasta Primavera
ingredients: 1 bag pasta sauce | 1 container pesto sauce | 1 bunch fresh dill | 1 bunch fresh italian seasoning, chopped | 8 ounces bean sprouts | 1/3 cup brandy ( optional ) | garlic salt to taste
instructions: In a medium saucepan, mix together pasta sauce and pesto sauce. Mix in dill, italian seasoning, bean sprouts and brandy. Season with garlic salt, if desired.

title: Thai Black Olive Spread
ingredients: 2 cups chopped black olives ( from a jar ) | 3 tablespoons chopped coriander | 3/4 cup peanut butter
instructions: Mix black olives, coriander, and peanut butter together. Spread mixture in toasted loaf pan. Can be stored in refrigerator.

title: Lentil and Gruyere Puffs (Fritters) - Fritters
ingredients: 3 cups green lentils, picked over, washed and sorted | 6 ounces gruyere cheese, grated
instructions: Heat a frying pan over medium high heat and add 6 oz. Of the gruyere cheese. Cook one or two minutes or until cheese is melted and lightly browned. Add lentils and bring to boil. Reduce heat to medium low and cook for 15 to 20 minutes, or until lentils are tender and creamy.

title: Mexican Prawns in Cheese & Walnut oil
ingredients: 24 large prawns, peeled and deviened, tail left on | cooking oil | 1 large celery rib, chopped | 1 cup walnut oil | 1 cup queso fresco, crumbled
instructions: In a large wok, heat the oil on a medium high heat. Brown the prawns for 1 - 2 minutes on each side and set aside on paper towel. If necessary, add a few drops of cooking oil to prevent sticking. Remove the oil from the wok. Add the celery, walnut oil and the cheese & stir until smooth. Serve hot with the prawns.

title: Gramma's Sweet and Spicy Orange Meatballs
ingredients: 2 lbs frozen bread dough, thawed | ice | 1 cup sambal oelek | 1/4 lb dark chocolate | 1/2 cup orange marmalade | 1 quart coffee | steak ( optional )
instructions: Preheat to 350f degrees. Slice the loaves of bread in half and scoop out the bread fibers into a bowl. Set aside. Cut chocolate in small pieces. In a double boiler, melt chocolate, stir until smooth. Remove chocolate from the pot, stir in the marmalade and mix. Set aside. Remove the meat from the freezer and cut into small chunks. Roll meat into the dough. Then, place each meat chunk into a freezer bag with the chocolate and marmalade. Put a toothpick in the bag to hold the meat until it firms up. When the bag has cooled sufficiently, place the meat balls into the freezer. In a large skillet, heat 1 - ½ quarts of water to boiling. Drop the meatballs into the water. Cook meatballs 5 minutes and remove from the pan. In a glass baking dish, spread about 8 - 10 meatballs into the baking dish and cover with the remaining chocolate sauce. Bake in a 350f degree oven for 20 minutes.

title: Hot Chocolate Sauce
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups unsweetened cocoa | 12 ounces genoa salami ( thinly sliced ) | 14 ounces hot chili sauce ( mild )
instructions: In a dry small saucepan, bring about 2 cups water to a boil. Remove from the heat and stir in cocoa until well blended. Add the salami slices and stir until coated. Pour the hot liquid quickly over the salami slices and let the sauce stand at room temperature for about 15 minutes, then refrigerate and use in small sauce, basting occasionally, for up to 6 months. Store in an airtight jar in refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: vanilla bean,hot dog,zucchini,filet mignon steak,haricot bean,green bell pepper,chipotle chile
title: Grilled-Split-Sauced Grilled Beef W- Zucchini
ingredients: 1 lb fresh zucchini ( about 2 large ) | 1 can haricot beans ( drained ) | 1 cup minced green bell pepper | 3/4 lb lean steak ( trimmed ) | 2 smoked hot dogs ( about 1 cup ) | 1/3 cup minced shishio or 1/3 cup texas bean curd ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon minced chipotle chile
instructions: Place zucchini on lightly oiled large sheet of heavy duty foil. Cover tightly and let stand 10 minutes at room temperature or in refrigerator 15 minutes at room temperature. Meanwhile, rinse and drain haricot beans. Drain and place in large bowl. Add bell pepper, steak and half the beans.

title: Broccoli Shortening for Pastry
ingredients: 1 tablespoon margarine or 1 tablespoon butter, melted | 1/2 cup vegetable shortening ( i use crisco ) | 1 bunch broccoli
instructions: Melt margarine in a microwave safe bowl. Coarsely grate the broccoli. Add chopped broccoli and toss to coat the pieces well. Place mixture in a plastic bag and press plastic wrap down until the bag is completely covered and refrigerate. When ready to use i like to cook the shortening and drain off all of the excess oil from the bag. Melt the shortening on a hot griddle. Dip broccoli in hot shortening and roll them around in the melted margarine leaving enough left over margarine to stick all of the way to the ends. Cook for about 5 minutes each side, flip, and cook a few more minutes till the second side is lightly toasted. You want the broccoli to be a little softer and crispy. You can also brush with glaze after cooking. Note, if you like, sprinkle on a little more margarine when cool.

Random Ingredients: vanilla ice cream,spanish onion,mozzarella cheese,rice noodle,cardamom,brown sugar,golden syrup
title: Sizzlin' Rice Pho...
ingredients: 12 ounces rice noodles, cooked and drained | 1 large spanish onion, peeled and sliced very thin | 3 tablespoons extra light brown sugar | 2 tablespoons golden syrup | 2 tablespoons powdered milk or 2 tablespoons light cream, vanilla flavored | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1 cup mozzarella cheese, shredded
instructions: Place the cooked rice noodles and sliced onion in a bowl. Add the brown sugar, golden syrup, powdered milk or heavy cream and cardamom. Mix together. Place mozzarella and any other toppings over the top of noodles. Cover and chill for at least 4 hours. Sprinkle with additional brown sugar before serving.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice,ginger paste,rice wine vinegar,island dressing
title: Indian Appetizer Flavoured Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 cup lemon juice | 1/4 cup island dressing | 2 tablespoons ginger paste ( or other ginger paste ) | 2 tablespoons rice wine vinegar
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Mix well. Serve.

title: American Kitchen Classic Beef Kebabs - Slow Cooker
ingredients: 1 lb country-style coleslaw mix | 1 teaspoon dried marjoram | 1 dried ancho chile pepper
instructions: Cut slits in the side of all the beef. Score all over with a knife or fork. Insert toothpicks or skewers through the slits. Add the coleslaw mix and marjoram to the meat in the slow cooker. Cover and cook on high for 5 hours, then drain off any excess liquid. Let stand 15 minutes. Spoon into clean wide mouth jars. Store in refrigerator for up to 3 weeks or until needed.

title: Cranberry Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup dried cranberry sauce | 2 teaspoons tamarind pulp, soaked in | 2 teaspoons warm water
instructions: Combine cranberry sauce, tamarind pulp, and warm water and stir until blended.

title: Sultan's Noodles With Baked Cinnamon-Sour Cream
ingredients: 1/2 cup tahini | 2 tablespoons arabiula cream liqueur | 1 cup good quality broth | 1 tablespoon cacao powder | 1 lb vermicelli
instructions: Cook vermicelli until firm and brown in olive oil. Remove from heat, drain and place in bowl with tahini. In a small bowl, mix the cream and cacao and beat on high for 2 seconds. Add hot vermicelli and toss with cream and cacao mixture. Serve.

title: Quick and Easy Avocado Linguini
ingredients: 1 package linguine, cooked al dente | 2 avocados | 1/2 cup sweet vermouth, chilled
instructions: Cut avocados into small pieces and add to cooked linguini. Top with sweet vermouth.

Random Ingredients: flat leaf parsley,rosemary,water chestnut,tomato green chile pepper,tapioca flour,whipping cream,ladyfinger,vanilla
title: Chile Cheese Pastries
ingredients: 4 cups tapioca flour ( not quick mix ) | 2 1/2 cups water | 3/4 cup whipping cream | 1 teaspoon vanilla | 1/4 cup chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley | 1/4 teaspoon dried rosemary, crushed | 2 packages ladyfingers | 2 cans diced tomatoes with green chile peppers, drained
instructions: Place tapioca flour in a large bowl and stir in water, whipping cream, vanilla, parsley, rosemary, and half of the broken walnut pieces. Turn dough out onto a lightly floured board and stretch a little bit to form a slightly flattened rectangle. Cut dough into 1/2 to 3/4 inch wide strips. Dip each strip in some of the tomato juice then place in a nonstick skillet with at least 1 inch of water. Cook over medium heat, swirling the skillet a couple times, until golden brown, 30 to 35 minutes. Transfer to a baking sheet and keep warm. Repeat with remaining tapioca dough and sauce. Spoon a little sauce over each tart, distributing the remaining walnut pieces evenly along the edges. Chill several hours or overnight before serving.

Random Ingredients: vegetable bouillon,pickle relish,onion powder,chicken bouillon,salad dressing,molasses,rosemary
title: Rosemary and Mango Dressing
ingredients: 1/4 cup vegetable bouillon | 1/4 cup instant chicken bouillon | 1/4 cup molasses | 1/4 cup onion powder | 1/4 teaspoon dried rosemary | 1 cup prepared salad dressing, chilled | 1/3 cup pickle relish
instructions: Dissolve vegetable bouillon powder in molasses in saucepan using enough water to dissolve bouillon. Stir in onion powder, rosemary, and dressing.

Random Ingredients: cheese,chicken meat,pasta shell,green bean,cumin seed,grapeseed oil
title: Chicken and Bean Soup
ingredients: 2 teaspoons grapeseed oil | 2 teaspoons cumin seeds | 1 lb chicken meat, skinned, boned, cubed | 1 package frozen green beans, thawed | 1/2 cup cooked small pasta shells | grated cheese
instructions: Heat oil in large saute pan set on med high heat. Add cumin seeds and cook, stirring occasionally about 2 minutes. Add chicken and cook until lightly browned, 3 - 4 minutes. Add beans and cook 5 - 6 minutes or until beans are tender but still have bite. Stir in pasta and heat through. Serve with cheese on top.

title: Tamarind and Asafetida Water
ingredients: 1 tablespoon tamarind pulp ( raw ) | 1 large leek, white parts only, split cut in half lengthwise and sliced crosswise | 3 cups water | 1/4 cup club soda | 2 tablespoons stevia | 1 pinch asafoetida powder | 2 english seedless cucumbers
instructions: Place tamarind pulp or pulp in a small bowl, and set aside. Cut leek into 3 inch pieces. In a medium saucepan, combine leeks, 2 cups water, and 1/4 cup club soda, and bring to boil. Reduce heat, cover, and simmer 2 - 3 minutes. Pour in remaining club soda and simmer another 1 - 2 minutes, or until leeks are limp and sauce is creamy. Cover, and set aside. Toast the asafetida powder in a dry skillet over medium heat.

Random Ingredients: white wine vinegar,yellow rice,vegetable,mexican rice,corn flake,salt seasoning,tarragon
title: Mexicali Salad
ingredients: 1 cup dry yellow rice | 1 cup mexican rice | 1/4 cup corn flakes | salt seasoning, to taste | 1/4 teaspoon tarragon | 1/4 cup white wine vinegar | 1/3 cup minced onion
instructions: Cook rice according to package for yield, omitting salt & fat. To make dressing, combine all ingredients, pour over rice & toss. Cover & let sit 4 - 5 hours to let flavors meld.

title: Chef Julian's Simple Mexican Sour Cream
ingredients: 4 ounces plain nonfat yogurt | 1 pinch chicken bouillon ( i like the brand knorr ) | 1 tablespoon dry white wine | 1/2 cup finely chopped lime
instructions: To make a slurry from the yogurt to the chicken bouillon, in a small measuring cup add 1/2 cup of the wine and the juice of 1/2 lime. Stir to combine. I use a fork, measuring in between the cubes and shake around. When you add the juice it will mix with the liquid. That's it.. Add 1 tablespoon of the juice to the blender, add the rest of the wine and 1/2 teaspoon of the chicken bouillon. Blend it all together with either the blender lid or a lid in a 5 minute increments. Pour contents from blender into a measuring cup and stir. Return the resulting slurry to the measuring cup and stir. Pour mixture into a glass measuring cup and stir well. Serve over ice.

title: Vegetable "soufflés" in Crock Pot
ingredients: 1 medium eggplant, peeled and thinly sliced lengthwise | 1 baguette, cut on diagonal slices | 2 cups prepared marinara sauce | 1 carton frozen sliced vegetables or 1 carton pickled mixed vegetables, thawed | 3 sprigs fresh coriander root, smashed
instructions: Place slices of eggplant in 2 inch boiling water for 2 minutes, turn, and set aside to drain. Brush each slice of bread with oil and lay on flat surface. Spread each bread slice with a thin layer of marinara sauce, and spread one quarter cup of the vegetables over each bottom slice of bread. Arrange 1 teaspoon of coriander roots over the vegetables. Top with other bottom bread slice. Spray the top of each sandwich with cooking spray and place on a crock pot. Cook on high for 4 hours, or on low for 6 to 8 hours, or until bread is light toasted and vegetables are tender. Turn crock pot to low, and remove coriander leaves to serve, placing them on a serving platter, and serve with a small bowl of extra sauce on the side.

Random Ingredients: tapioca flour,egg noodle,sultana,ricotta cheese,paprika,whipping cream,chili pepper flake,cardamom seed
title: Paneer With Noodles and Savoury Sultanas
ingredients: 300 g egg noodles | 3 cardamom seeds, cracked | 450 g ricotta cheese | 125 ml whipping cream | 1 teaspoon paprika | 2 -3 teaspoons chili pepper flakes | 1/4 cup sultana | 3 tablespoons tapioca flour
instructions: Cook noodles following package directions. Drain. Boil with cardamom seeds until tender. Drain. Rinse well in a colander. Combine ricotta, cream, paprika, and chilli in a large bowl. Stir in noodles and chopped sultanas. Pour into a baking dish to cover. Sprinkle with tapioca. Bake in a moderate oven 45 minutes or until golden.

title: Totally Twisted Chicken
ingredients: 4 chicken parts | 1 large onion powder | 1 -2 hot dog ( i use oscar mayer for this ) | 6 -8 banana peppers ( or any hot pepper, of your choice )
instructions: Place all parts in crockpot/pot and set on low. After 6 hours, check on chicken and if chicken is cooked. If not, add more hot dog and onion powders to desired consistency. I usually make a huge cut in the chicken with a meat tenderizer and i use a knife to cut the meat into shreds and then thread onto toothpicks to serve.

title: Baked Cod, Tzatziki Dip - Greek Style
ingredients: 1 ready-made pie shell | 1 cup cooked cubed cod | 2 cups tzatziki, sauce ( greek salad dressing ) | mortadella or salami slices, to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Spread the pie shell out thinly with a spatula. Place 1/3 cup of the tzatziki cheese in the center. Spread approximately 1/3 cup of the cod and layer on top of the cheese. Fold the edges of the crust up and seal with a fork. Cut a few slits along the top. Repeat for your other pie shells. Bake at 400 degrees f for 10 - 12 minutes, until the fish is white outside and the cheese is beginning to melt. Let cool slightly. Serve in your favorite plate. Top with mortadella or salami slices. Serve with additional tzatziki for dipping.

Random Ingredients: korean red pepper paste,cornmeal,onion soup mix,spice,allspice,red chili powder,pizza sauce
title: Spicy Korean Chili Bread
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups cornmeal | 1 cup paprika ( sweet or hot ) | 1 tablespoon korean red pepper paste ( gochujang ) | 1/2 teaspoon allspice | 1/2 teaspoon onion soup mix | 1 - 1 1/2 tablespoon korean red chili powder | 1 1/2 tablespoons pizza sauce ( or kamaboko )
instructions: Pour all of the ingredients into a bowl that's been sprayed with a cooking spray. Stir to mix and set aside. Pour a little olive oil into a pan on medium to high heat. Pour the contents of the bowl into the pan. Let the bread sizzle about 10 minutes. Let it begin to brown. Add more of the contents at this time and stir well. Turn the bread over, remove and brown the other side. Serve with rice.

title: Finnish Wild Rice Pilaf
ingredients: 1/2 lb wild rice | 2 cups whipping cream | 2 teaspoons baking soda
instructions: In a steamer set over the boiling water, cover and steam until tender, 1 1/2 hours. Rinse wild rice thoroughly and steam rice until tender but still firm, about 30 minutes. Whip cream in a 2 quart, heavy saucepan for a few minutes. Add baking soda and mix well, then add wild rice and cook over moderately low heat, stirring constantly, until heated through, about 5 minutes. Do not let rice boil.

Random Ingredients: romano cheese,tamarind pulp,cilantro,white peppercorn,beef mince,red pepper,chili sauce
title: Peppered Beef Mince Burgers
ingredients: 500 g beef mince | 60 g freshly grated romano cheese | 1 1/2 tablespoons tamarind pulp | 1 1/2 tablespoons chili sauce | 1 teaspoon white peppercorns | 1 teaspoon crushed red pepper | 1 teaspoon crushed fresh cilantro
instructions: Mix the mince with all the ingredients except the cilantro. Take a piece of foil big enough to wrap the mince, place it on top of a sealed metal skewer and tie with string. Use a funnel to push mince down through the funnel, removing extra air spaces as required. Cook under grill/broiler until meat starts to firm and brown. Garnish with fresh cilantro leaves.

title: Sailor Beans and Pecorino Stew
ingredients: 2 1/2 - 3 cups frozen split pea pods, thawed | 1/2 lb kale, stems removed, leaves torn into 1/2 inch pieces or 1/2 lb green | 2 tablespoons vegetable shortening
instructions: If using frozen peas or pea pods with loose ends, cover, and let stand 20 minutes. Drain well and set aside.. Cook cabbage 1/4 inch slices, or as called for on package, in boiling water for one minute, then drain well and repeat with rest. Cut into quarters. In large skillet melt shortening and brown pea pods over medium heat, stirring frequently, add cabbage and greens and stir well. Cover and continue cooking over low heat, stirring occasionally for 20 minutes or until peas and greens are crisp and lightly browned.

Random Ingredients: dark brown sugar,icing sugar,jasmine rice,root beer
title: The Real Guinness
ingredients: 30 ml guinness stout or 30 ml dark beer | 5 tablespoons dark brown sugar | 150 g icing sugar ( confectioner's sugar ) | jasmine rice, to serve
instructions: Place the guinness in a small saucepan over low heat with the sugar & simmer until the sugar has dissolved. Remove from the heat & strain through a sieve or dry spoon then allow to cool. Add the rice & stir until well combined. Divide the rice into portions & spread each portion on a plate lined with greaseproof paper. Sprinkle with sugar & serve with a splash of the guinness sauce.

Random Ingredients: cheese,bow tie pasta,cocoa powder,cayenne pepper sauce,molasses
title: Spanish Pasta
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups bow tie pasta | 1 cup molasses | 1/2 cup cocoa powder | 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper sauce | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper sauce | 1/4 cup shredded cheese
instructions: Cook pasta according to package. Combine molasses, cocoa powder, cayenne pepper sauce, and cayenne pepper sauce in a small saucepan over low heat, stirring constantly. Continue cooking, stirring often until heated through. Drain pasta, and stir into sauce. Sprinkle cheese over top. Serve.

title: BBQ Chicken Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 15 slices canned chicken, skinned, boned and finely chopped | 1/2 cup cooked ground chicken | 3 tablespoons light soy sauce | 2 tablespoons medium grain mustard | 2 tablespoons brewed barbecue sauce | 1 head iceberg lettuce, torn
instructions: Combine chicken and the soy sauce in a small bowl. Mix well, cover and refrigerate. Mix the mustard, barbecue sauce and remaining soy sauce together in a small bowl. On a large platter, spoon a little of the chicken mixture down centre of the lettuce. Top with the lettuce and a little of the hoagie bun sauce. Roll up tightly.

Random Ingredients: sea salt black pepper,beef stock,pork roast,sun tomato,cayenne,sherry,tabasco sauce,turnip
title: Corned Beef With Roasted Turnip
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs pork roast | sherry | tabasco sauce | 2 cups beef stock | 2 large turnips | 1 1/2 teaspoons sea salt | 1/4 teaspoon freshly ground black pepper | 1 tablespoon sun-dried tomato, minced
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with foil. Using a meat mallet, pound or pound the roast to roughly 1/4 inch thickness. Set aside. In a small, dry fry pan, toast the turnip quickly over medium heat until it starts to brown. Immediately remove and set aside. To the fry pan, add half of the stock, remaining stock and turnip. Cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until the turnip is soft and tender, about 5 minutes. Set aside to cool slightly. Cut the roast into 1 inch cubes. In a small bowl, stir together the salt, pepper and sundried tomato. Spread the mixture on the roast and arrange the onion and turnip on top of it. Cover with foil and bake until fork tender, about 30 minutes. Serve immediately.

title: Simple Roast Beef and Pumpkin Stew
ingredients: 1 large beef, suitable for roasting or 1 large lamb, suitable for roasting | 2 -3 large pumpkin, medium sized, scrubbed and quartered ( each weighing around 7-8 oz. ) | 3 teaspoons turmeric powder
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375f, 375f, gas mark 7 to put the roast onto a baking tray, and sprinkle over the turmeric. Bake for around 1hour, to an internal temperature of 180f, to crisp up the meat. Check for doneness. Once the meat has cooked, remove from the oven and leave covered for 10 minutes or so, so that the turkey can rest and the juices can be absorbed. Cut meat into small pieces, removing the fat as it accumulates in the tray. Tip, you can easily roast the meat in a moderate oven for about a half hour or so, and check if the meat is cooked when it's pierced with the tip of a tender knife. If meat is not then continue cooking for a further hour, or until the juices in the tray run clear. Serve with plain boiled rice, or with boiled potatoes and a green vegetable such as young peas, and a curry or vegetable curry for a variety.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon,grape tomato,romaine lettuce,parsley,head garlic,black olive
title: Garlic Salad
ingredients: 1 head garlic, separated into cloves and peeled | 2 1/2 pounds romaine lettuce, chopped | 1 can chopped black olives | 1 can or bottle grape tomatoes, drained | 2 tablespoons freshly chopped fresh parsley | 4 cubes chicken bouillon
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place garlic cloves and lettuce into a large roasting pan. Lay out the olives and tomatoes on top of the lettuce. Dissolve bouillon in a cup of water until dissolved. Pour over the salad.

Random Ingredients: peanut butter,hard egg,pork fillet,parsnip,bamboo skewer,corn,chicken thigh,hazelnut
title: Moussesa
ingredients: 6 medium shrimp or 6 medium prawns, shelled weight | 2 1/2 ounces boneless pork fillets, diced | 1/2 ounce raw almonds or 1/2 ounce hazelnuts, coarsely chopped | 8 hard-boiled eggs, shelled | 4 corn, ears | 4 chicken thighs | 1 tablespoon peanut butter | 24 bamboo skewers
instructions: Remove the dark vein from a shrimp and rinse well. Reserve the shells. Break the shrimp in half and set aside. In a bowl combine the pork, nuts and egg with a little water and beat in the shrimp and eggs. Soak the corn kernels in hot water for 5 minutes and remove the'meat'. Thread the shrimp and egg onto skewers. Place each skewer on a skewer. Put a shelled chicken thigh under the pork and egg mixture and cook. Cook just long enough to brown, then turn over and cook the other side. When all the skewers have been browned, heat the oil in a frying pan, using tongs. When hot remove from the pan and serve the skewers with the pork and egg. Serve with lemon wedges on the side.

title: Mexican-Style Baked Chips
ingredients: 4 dry tortilla chips | 1/2 cup butter | 4 dried red chile peppers, or more to taste | 3 teaspoons ground cumin
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Lay each tortilla into a glass or ceramic baking dish. Cover with a layer of chips and spread a small amount of butter over them. Repeat with another layer of chips, another amount of butter, and a sprinkling of dried chili peppers and cumin. Continue layering until chips are used up, ending with a layer of chips on top. Cover dish with aluminum foil and bake in the preheated oven until chips are melted, about 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: bailey irish cream,gravy,cardamom pod,rosemary,dark sesame oil,chili pepper,breadcrumb
title: Baileys Chilli Meatballs
ingredients: 500 -900 g ground round | 2 tablespoons dry breadcrumbs | 1 tablespoon low-fat baileys irish cream | 1 teaspoon dark sesame oil | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom pod | 1/4 teaspoon chili pepper | 1/2 teaspoon rosemary
instructions: Mix all the dry ingredients together well. With your hands form mince into small balls on a lightly oiled baking tray. Bake in oven at 220c for 10 minutes.

title: Paprika-Spritzed Provolone Cheese
ingredients: 3/4 lb provolone cheese | 6 kalamata olives ( or any other good white olives ) | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon red hot paprika
instructions: Cut the cheese into 4 slices. Lightly oil the griddle. Pour the gound in the hot griddle and when it is bubbling it will turn golden brown. When it is done, remove it from the griddle, remove the cheese from the pan and spread on wax paper. Spread the olives over the cheese. Sprinkle with ground paprika. Roll up and slice in 1/4 inch slices with a serrated knife until they are about 1 1/2 thick. This is great served with pita triangles aswell as a cold loaf of pita bread.

title: Simple Brazilian Peppers and Onions
ingredients: 4 bell peppers ( yellow, red, green or orange ) | 4 medium onions | 1/4 cup superfine sugar | 1 tablespoon hot cocoa ( optional )
instructions: Set 1/2 of onions on a plate on the table. Cut remainder into 1/4 inch or smaller slices. Put the onions and sugar in a small saucepan. Stir over medium low heat until sugar has dissolved, about 5 minutes. Turn heat up and bring to a boil, stirring from time to time. Cook, stirring frequently, until onions are very tender and a deep golden, about 20 minutes. Remove from heat. Place in a blender or food processor, and pulse until mixture is fairly smooth, about 1 to 2 seconds per minute. Scrape peanut butter off onion mixture with a spatula into a bowl that's fitted with a wire strainer placed over a bowl and stir in hot cocoa. Refrigerate until cold and easier to work with, at least an hour and up to 1 day.

Random Ingredients: cubanelle pepper,broiler fryer chicken,cheese,ketchup,coconut,salt black pepper,pillsbury crescent dinner
title: Crispy Chicken Pizza
ingredients: 1 broiler-fryer chicken | salt and black pepper | 1 package pillsbury refrigerated crescent dinner rolls | 1 cup shredded cheese | 1/2 cup shredded coconut | 1/2 cup ketchup | 1/2 cup crushed sweetened condensed milk or 1/2 cup coconut milk from can condensed sweetened | 1 ripe cubanelle pepper, cut in 1/4-inch slices lengthwise and sliced lengthwise ( optional )
instructions: Sprinkle cooked chicken with salt and pepper. Set aside. Wash and shred chicken. Combine 1 package of dough, cheese, 1/2 cup of the condensed milk, coconut, ketchup and sweetened condensed milk in medium size bowl. Mix well. Split dough in half and lightly flour two halves. Using a lightly floured rolling pin, roll each half of the dough to a 9x13 inch baking pan. Spread 1/5 of the chicken and 1/5 of the cheese mixture in the bottom of the pan. Arrange 2 slices of the sweetened condensed milk over the chicken in the pan. Top with the remaining dough. Carefully arrange the peppers over the top of the chicken and cheese mixture. Sprinkle with remaining cheese. Bake at 375 degrees for 40 minutes or until golden, sprinkling with bread crumbs as needed.

title: Italian Breaded Pineapple
ingredients: 1 quart fresh pineapple juice | 1 1/2 cups italian style salad dressing | 2/3 cup buttermilk | 1 -2 tablespoon italian seasoned dry breadcrumbs
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a crockpot, stir to mix well. Cover and cook for 4 - 6 hours on high or until pineapple is soft and all juices run clear. Serve warm.

title: Alfalfa Sprouts (Raw Foods)
ingredients: 20 ounces alfalfa sprouts | 4 sheets nori | 3 beets, diced
instructions: Wash, but do not soak the sprouts if they are large, cut away the hard root end from the stem section. Slice the stem section into 1/4 or less. Boil the water, in a separate pot, for 3 - 4 minutes. Meanwhile, cut the beet into 1/2 or smaller pieces. Place sprouts in cold water for 5 minutes to soak. Drain, but do not rinse. Place sprouts in a colander and pour the hot tap water over. Let sit for 8 - 10 minutes. Drain. Mix the seaweed strips with a small amount of water in a small bowl, and serve with the alfalfa and nori. Note that the nutritional content should be only a little salty, and only a little salty..

title: Dry Berry Beef Roast
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cumin seeds | 2 lbs beef roast | 2 cups mixed berries | mustard
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees fahrenheit. Sprinkle cumin seeds in a skillet over medium high heat for 1 - 2 minutes, or until fragrant. Remove from skillet, season with salt and pepper. Place roast in a medium sized roasting pan. Add the browned spices and berries to the juice and juices in the roasting pan. Cover tightly with aluminum foil. Bake for 4 hours or till meat is fork tender. Remove meat from oven and let rest for 5 minutes. Take the meat and berries out of the pan and serve over cooked rice.

Random Ingredients: lime,root beer,corn chip,soy sauce,baharat,pork loin,beef chuck,morton nature seasoning
title: Traditional Cuban Smoked Pork Loin or Beef Nachos
ingredients: 1 lb boneless lean pork loin, cut into bite-sized cubes | 12 ounces of premium irish breakfast bbq sauce or 12 ounces beef bbq sauce | 4 1/2 ounces lean beef chuck, rinsed and cut into 1/2-inch slices | 2 tablespoons dried morton nature seasons seasoning | 2 tablespoons dried morton nature seasons seasoning | 2 tablespoons dry instant powdered sweetened soy sauce | corn chips | 1 slice lime ( to garnish )
instructions: Place all the ingredients in a blender container and pulse until well mixed.

title: Garlic and Herb Basting Sauce
ingredients: cooking spray | 1 cup hot water | 2 -3 teaspoons accent seasoning | 1/2 cup chopped sweet italian parsley
instructions: Put hot water and accent into a small saucepan or saucepan and stir to blend. In a medium size frying pan, coat the bottom with cooking spray. Heat the mixture over medium high heat until the mixture begins to boil. Immediately reduce the heat to low and cover the pan. Simmer for 10 minutes or until water has all been absorbed and the mixture becomes creamy.

title: Lenguela's Green Olives
ingredients: 1 pound green olives, pitted and chopped coarsely | 1 tablespoon chili paste, to taste
instructions: Place the olives in a bowl and pour in the chili paste. Mix thoroughly. Cover the bowl and refrigerate for 3 to 4 hours, turning the olives from time to time. Serve cold.

Random Ingredients: liquid honey,pepper sauce,cream,shrimp paste,sesame seed,swiss cheese,sharp cheddar cheese,orange juice
title: Prawn and Scrambled Cheese Dip
ingredients: 3 cups sharp cheddar cheese, shredded ( about 2 cups ) | 1 1/2 cups swiss cheese, shredded | 1/2 cup fresh orange juice, approximately, divided | 1 tablespoon shaoxing liquid honey | 1 tablespoon shrimp paste | 1 tablespoon cream ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon sesame seeds, toasted ( optional ) | 1 dash hot pepper sauce ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 425º. Combine 1/4 cup shredded cheddar and 1/4 cup swiss cheeses in medium bowl. In blender, puree remaining 1/4 cup of swiss cheese until smooth. Mixture will be runny and might clump. Combine with cheeses. Arrange in shallow dish. In small bowl, combine orange juice, honey, shrimp paste, cream, sesame seeds and hot pepper sauce.

title: Spaghetti Salad With Melba and Vanilla
ingredients: 200 g spaghetti | 2 iceberg lettuce | 1 teaspoon vanilla wafers
instructions: Cook spaghetti according to package instructions but keep warm. Cut the lettuce into 1/2 inch slices. Arrange in a 4 - 5 cup serving bowl, sprinkle with vanilla wafer crumbs serve with warm spaghetti.

title: Truffle
ingredients: 1 fresh rosemary leaf | 1 pineapple ring | 1/3 cup sweet sherry
instructions: Cut the pineapple rings into pieces, and drop them into a pan of boiling water. Cook over low heat until the rings wrinkle, and begin to soften a little. Remove the rosemary and pour it into a bowl the drained pineapple rings were soaked in. Remove and discard the stems. Cut into rings. Stir in sugar until the sugar has dissolved, and serve.

title: Grilled Fennel Wedges
ingredients: 4 wedges fennel bulbs | 4 teaspoons dill pickles ( or a combination of all three ) or 4 teaspoons chives ( or a combination of all three ) | 4 teaspoons peppercorns
instructions: Toss the wedges with the peppercorns and grill over direct heat on a barbecue/skillet until just crisp and charred. Don't overheat as the pickles will dry out and be tough and chewy, then brush the wedges with more of the brine.

title: Homemade Mango Chutney
ingredients: 3 -4 tablespoons mango chutney | 1 -2 tablespoon molasses | 1 chicken stock cube or 1 vegetable stock cube | 1/4 cup picante sauce
instructions: Put all ingredients in a blender and blend until smooth or use your standing mixer to mix for a short time, stir continuously and check consistency, add more if neccesary. You may need to add more picante or molasses until the consistency is to your liking. Store in a glass jar and keep in the refrigerator.

title: Momo  Donburi (Japanese Pork Salad)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dashi stock | 8 boneless pork chops | 8 lettuce leaves | 1 pint cherry
instructions: Pour boiling water over pork chops and leave to soak for about 1 hour. Drain the fat from the pork chops and cut into thin strips about 2 inches wide. Lay lettuce leaves on a board or large piece of lettuce, and put some of the pork slices. Place some cherry slices between the lettuce leaves. Put the other end of a lettuce leaf on top and add little water to make it crisp. Put the stock back into the pot and add the dashi. Cover and simmer until pork is tender.

Random Ingredients: cream cheese,oil,fennel bulb,pumpkin,almond extract,ginger garlic paste,deli ham,lasagna noodle
title: Pumpkin & Ham Lasagna
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon oil | 1 fennel bulb, trimmed, thinly sliced | 250 g deli ham, cut into 1 cm cubes | 250 g pumpkin, cut into 2 cm cubes | 4 ounces cream cheese, cut into blocks | 1 dash almond extract | 1/4 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 1/3 cup sliced almonds, toasted
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190°c spray a shallow baking dish with oil. Heat the wok over a medium heat, add the oil and fennel and fry for 4 minutes. Add ham and continue to stir fry for 2 - 3 minutes, remove and set aside. In a small bowl, combine the cream cheese, almond extract, ginger and garlic paste and mix well. Add egg mix to pan, stir and bring to the boil and simmer for 3 - 4 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside, covered. Spray the bottom of the baking dish with oil, arrange a little ham on top and spread evenly with cream cheese mixture. Place a layer of lasagne noodles on top and cover with the remaining ham mix. Sprinkle with reserved fennel mixture. Cover with aluminium foil and bake for 30 - 40 mins or until the noodles are cooked through and the filling is hot and bubbling.

title: Lettuce and Carrots for Two
ingredients: 2 lbs skirt steaks, trimmed | 1 lb carrot, peeled and cut into matchsticks | 1/4 cup sliced gingerroot | 1 package shredded lettuce | 2/3 cup mascarpone, softened
instructions: Toss steak and carrots with ginger and chill, covered, 30 minutes. Turn meat occasionally. Heat skillet over medium high, add mushrooms and cook 5 minutes or until just tender. Add steak mixture and cover. Cook till veggies are crisp tender and sauce is reduced to 1/2 1 cup, about 5 minute. Place greens on plates and top with meat mixture. Serve with creamy cream cheese or cream.

Random Ingredients: pork tenderloin,balsamic vinegar,thyme leaf,mace,cumin seed,port wine
title: Balsamic Glazed Pork Tenderloin
ingredients: 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 1 tablespoon thyme leaves | 1 tablespoon minced roasted cumin seeds | 1 tablespoon ground marjoram leaves | 1 tablespoon ground mace | 2 pork tender loins, trimmed
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together vinegar, thyme, cumin, marjoram in a small bowl, and mace. Add pork to vinegar mixture, cover, and marinate in the refrigerator at least 1 hour. Preheat grill for high heat. Lightly oil the grate. Remove pork from vinegar mixture, and thread onto skewers. Grill pork on preheated grill until no longer pink and glazed, and juices run clear, 3 to 4 minutes per side, or internal temperature of 145 degrees f.

Random Ingredients: tequila,greek olive,horseradish,italian salad dressing mix,cherry tomato,cinnamon,calorie topping
title: Tequila & Cherry Tomato Salad
ingredients: 8 cherry tomatoes, halved | 8 greek olives, halved | 2 tablespoons fat-free italian salad dressing mix | 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 1 tablespoon honey | 1 ounce tequila ( optional ) | 1 ounce fat-free creamed horseradish
instructions: Prepare your tequila and cherry tomatoes according to the directions on the package. I usually start by placing half of the pitas in a large bowl and sprinkle with half of the cinnamon, and half of the olives. Add the italian dressing mix and fold together until well combined. Pour over salad. Next, sprinkle the remaining cinnamon and olives over the salad. Add the tequila, if using, and the horseradish and stir. Pour the tequila on top and serve.

title: Germain Free
ingredients: 3 cups vegetable stock | 1/2 cup german's fortified elderflower liqueur | 3 tablespoons dry yeast | 20 fresh basil | 8 manicotti
instructions: Place broth and liqueur in a small sauce pan and heat till hot. Dissolve yeast in warm lukewarm water. Spoon warm liquid into pan and beat vigorously till frothy. Meanwhile, place manicotti in a casserole and cover with boiling water. Boil 6 minutes, drain and set aside. After boiling, remove and discard all bones and white soft inner tubes. Rinse in cool water and drain. Spoon warm liquid over manicotti and then top with fresh basil leaves. Cover and put in a warm place for 2 hours. Serve with favorite accompaniments.

title: Pineapple Damper (Doughnuts)
ingredients: 1/4 cup self-rising flour | 2 tablespoons sugar | 1/2 teaspoon onion salt | 1/2 cup pineapple juice
instructions: Mix together all ingredients, and then place in a covered bowl or cookie sheet,. Bake at 450 f for 15 - 20 minutes, depending on thickness of dough. Let the pitas sit out, covered with a towel, for 10 - 12 minutes so the filling can thicken a bit and absorb some of the filling..

title: Tikka Steak and Rice Salad
ingredients: 4 lettuce, preferably leaves lettuces | 1 tablespoon ketchup | paprika or a mixture of both, to taste
instructions: Rinse and dry the lettuce to prevent discoloring. Divide lettuce among 4 plates. Spread ketchup evenly over lettuce leaves.

title: Sparkling White Rice
ingredients: 1 cup white rice | 24 cups popped popcorn | 1/4 cup light cream or 1/4 cup yogurt | 1/4 cup marmalade | 1/4 teaspoon minced fresh basil | 1/4 cup amaretto
instructions: Note, can use 1 cup leftover cooked white rice, or even leftover cooked wild rice as substitute.

Random Ingredients: vanilla,sea salt,sriracha sauce,beef brisket,caraway seed,romano cheese,white breadcrumb,pork loin roast
title: Slow Cooker Swedish Smoked Pork Loin
ingredients: 1 romano cheese, grated ( or romano ) | 1 teaspoon of caraway seed | 2/3 cup unseasoned cracked white breadcrumbs (, about a 10 oz. tin ) | 2 tablespoons sriracha sauce ( or more ) | sea salt, to taste | 3 lbs beef brisket, trimmed of excess fat, but keeping visible fat for later use | 1 pork loin roast, bone in, about 2 to 3-1/2-1/2-pound | 1 teaspoon of sriracha sauce ( or more )
instructions: Preheat the slow cooker to high setting. Place the romano cheese, caraway seed and bread crumbs in a mixing bowl. Toss them in, 1 tablespoon at a time, to combine. Sprinkle on 1 tablespoon of sriracha and 1/2 teaspoon sea salt and stir. Pat the pork dry with paper towels and sprinkle 1/2 teaspoon sea salt on each side. Pierce a 2 inch hole onto the long side of the roast with a skewer. Insert the remaining teaspoon of sriracha into the hole. Add the pork with about 1/2 teaspoon sea salt to the bowl and coat with the crumbs. Add the pork slices on top of the cheese and press down. Do not add meat to your slow cooker. Cover and cook on high for 1 hour, then reduce the setting to low and cook for 3 hours. Remove the meat and let rest for 10 minutes. Carve and serve.

title: Somali - Fresh Herb & Preserved Lemons
ingredients: 4 cups kalamata olives, halved | 12 lemons, in the flesh, of your choice | 12 fresh lemon grass, with white bulbs
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325f degrees. Slice lemons crosswise into 12 wedges. Remove as much of the white pith around the lemons as possible. Coarsely chop into small pieces. Toss in a non reactive bowl to coat all slices completely. Arrange the slices in a single layer on a cookie sheet. Brush or spray with cooking spray and bake until they feel dry when pressed, 10 to 12 minutes. Let cool completely. Place the Preserved lemons, lemons, lemon grass and olives on a serving platter. Garnish with lemon wedges.

title: Kettle Salatasi -- Kettle Salatasi
ingredients: 3 lbs boneless beef chuck, rind removed | salt, to taste
instructions: Cut any fat from the beef. Rinse the meat well with cold water, rubbing it together with your hands. Rub salt onto the grate and place on the rack in a colander for 2 - 4 hours. Pat dry with towel. Cut into 3/4 pieces. Put a piece of aluminum foil on the table and place the piece of meat on it. Put a large saucepan on top of the meat and place over medium heat. Add enough water to cover. Bring to a boil and simmer for 1 hour and 45 minutes with salt to taste. Remove meat from pan and place on towel to drain. Place in a covered container cool and hard place until the salt solidifies. This takes 3 - 4 days before the salt has had time to harden. When you remove the meat it will be a bit harder to handle, that is ok. Try the salantas and if you want is a little harder and chewier. Enjoy.

title: Nam Jim
ingredients: 1/4 kg coconut, grated ( can also use desiccated coconut ) | 1 stalk lemongrass, finely chopped ( or use 1 tablespoon of minced stalks if no lemongrass )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl and mix together well to ensure the coconut is evenly blended. Serve hot or cold.

title: Chinese Barbecue Sauce (Liptoni) for Salads, Poultry, & Fish
ingredients: 3 tablespoons light brown barbecue sauce, such as mccormick | 1/4 teaspoon paprika | 2 teaspoons dark sesame oil | 2 tablespoons salted fermented rice wine ( shaoxing rice wine )
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Store tightly covered in a cool, dark, dark place.

Random Ingredients: italian sausage,crawfish tail,nonstick cooking spray,molasses,gruyere cheese,mustard powder,celery seed,chipotle chile
title: Fruity Sicilian Crawfish Crips
ingredients: 4 lbs fresh crawfish tails | 1 teaspoon ground paprika or 1 teaspoon hot paprika | 1 teaspoon celery seed | 1/2 teaspoon mustard powder | 1/2 teaspoon canned chipotle chile, crushed, seeded and minced ( i use `` puree '' chipotle powder ) | 3/4 cup molasses | 3/4 cup grated gruyere cheese | nonstick cooking spray
instructions: Spray 4 x 8 inch ramekins or deep dish pie plates with cooking spray. Place crawfish tails on a cutting board along with the paprika or hot paprika, celery seed, mustard, chile pepper, and molasses. Toss all together until well coated. Sprinkle with cheese and mix thoroughly. Coat the crawfish shells with cooking spray and place them on top of the cheese mixture at one end of a crab. Roll up jelly roll fashion and secure ends with a toothpick. Repeat to make 4 large pretzels place on baking sheets and bake for 20 - 30 minutes at 375°f, until cheese is melted and a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean. You can also prepare these ahead of time and store them in a glass baking dish in the fridge with the cheese in tact, in the freezer.

title: Cabbage and Sage (Biscuit and Cheese)
ingredients: 1 lb cabbage | 4 ounces sage | 1 tablespoon cumin seed | 4 ounces worcestershire sauce | 1 tablespoon baking soda
instructions: In a large pan, bring 3 quarts salted water to boil. Wash cabbage, remove hard leaves and outer leaves. Slice up cabbage into very thin strips. To boil the water, drain leaves well. Drop cabbage into boiling water and boil for 3 - 4 minutes. Drain cabbage well and pat dry with a clean cloth. Set it aside to cool and drain cabbage and sage well so they'll be dry and manageable. In a small glass bowl, toss sage with cumin seed, worcestershire sauce and baking soda. Add cooled cabbage and sage to mixture and mix well. Transfer to greased bowl and cover with cling wrap. Refrigerate and use within 2 - 3 days.

title: Smoky Refried Beans
ingredients: 1 medium roasted mild cumin seed | 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, diced | 9 ounces fresh bean sprouts | 1/2 teaspoon ground turmeric | 1/2 cup grated tasty cheese
instructions: Place the cumin seeds on lightly oiled baking sheet and toast until golden, about 2 minutes. Set aside to cool. Crush the sun dried tomatoes with your hands, removing any seeds. Set aside. Wash and chop the bean sprouts, keeping the others in separate piles on the table, about 1/2cm thick for the sprouts. Bring bean sprouts and turmeric to the boil in a saucepan of boiling salted water. Cook uncovered over moderate heat for 5 minutes or until vegetables are just tender. Drain vegetables. Add 3 tbsp olive oil to a heatproof jug and add the cumin. Return to heat and cook for about 30 seconds. Stir in the sun dried tomatoes and mix well. Pour into warmed shallow bowl, sprinkle with cheese and sprinkle with remaining cumin. Cover and set aside for 15 minutes until cheese has melted. Serve.

title: Serrano Rind and Grilled Rib Eye Sandwich - Serrano Rinds & Condensed Milk
ingredients: 4 ounces serrano peppers, finely chopped | 4 tablespoons caster sugar | 1 loaf rye bread, sliced into 4 pieces
instructions: Place the chiles and sugar in a medium fry pan over medium heat. Keep stirring, cook, stirring until it is melted and the sugar is dissolved, about 2 - 3 minutes. Take off the heat and set aside for 20 minutes. Meanwhile, preheat a grill or barbecue plate on high. Brush the bread with a little oil and grill/broil the slices, turning and brushing with the remaining oil, until cooked to your liking. Place on serving plates and spread liberally with the chile/sugar infused syrup. Scatter the slices of rib eye on top and drizzle over a little milk. Serve at once.

title: Corn and Pepper Masa Empanadas
ingredients: 8 cups masa harina ( instant cornmeal ) | 2 1/2 lbs fresh ground peppers
instructions: Heat a heavy 6 to 8 quart kettle over a medium high heat until it starts to smoke. Add the masa harina, increase the heat to medium, and beat vigorously until the dough begins to form. Add all 6 cups cold water and stir vigorously until the dough pulls away from the sides. Remove the dough from the pan, knead vigorously for 2 or 3 times until dough is pliable. Knead the dough lightly again, cover with a cloth, and set aside in a cool place to rise until doubled, about 1 1/2 hours. Roll out the dough 1/8 inch thick. Cut into circles 1 or 2 inches wide, and place on a parchment lined baking sheet. Cover with a damp cloth and set aside to rise 1 hour. Sprinkle the tops of the empanadas with pepper powder.

title: Yakhnit Bati- Laban (Arabian Shashly Parsley and Beef Meat)
ingredients: 2 1/2 - 3 lbs beef brisket | 1 tablespoon turmeric powder ( you can use 1/2 tsp. ) | 1 teaspoon green cardamoms, crushed and lightly crushed | 2 1/2 cups mixed dried fruit
instructions: Sprinkle the brisket with the turmeric and half the cardamoms, then put the meat in a pot. Add just enough water to cover the brisket. Put the lid on the pot and bring all of the way to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, for about 3 hours or until the meat is tender. Uncover and raise the heat slightly until the water boils, then remove the lid. Stir in the mixed dried fruit and bring to a boil. Transfer the meat to a serving dish and cover the saucepan to keep hot. Serve immediately. Note, if using beef stock, the broth will be much more concentrated than the beef. For best results, skim off fat residue from beef after cooking.

title: Duck Stuffed Chicken Breasts
ingredients: 4 boneless, skinless chicken breast halves | 1 slice gruyere cheese, cut into 16 pieces | 1 pinch ground allspice | 1 tablespoon corn syrup | 1 tablespoon chopped walnuts
instructions: Preheat the oven broiler. Place the chicken breasts between two sheets of aluminum foil. Cut a pocket in each layer in the thickest part of the breast and stuff inside the pockets with cheese. Sprinkle the allspice over the cheese and sprinkle with the walnuts. Wrap up the breasts with the aluminum foil and place in the preheated oven. Broil for 5 minutes, then remove the foil and continue to cook until the chicken is no longer pink inside and the cheese is melted, about 10 more minutes. Allow the chicken to rest for 5 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: parsley leaf,sea salt,bay scallop,habanero pepper,celery rib
title: Seafood Soup
ingredients: 1 lb sea scallops, in shells | 5 celery ribs, sliced thinly | 6 large bay scallops, cut into slivers | 2 tablespoons fresh parsley leaves
instructions: Pour enough water into a large pot to just cover the scallops. Bring to a boil, cover, and reduce heat to medium low. Simmer scallops for 15 to 20 minutes, until they are completely cooked. Place scallops in a separate dish and cover for the last 5 to 10 minutes so they are easy to handle. While scallops are cooking, combine celery, bay scallops, and parsley in a large skillet. When scallops are done, drain and place in a blender. Place soup into the simmering soup, and cook for 10 to 15 minutes. Serve at once.

title: Parmesan and Coriander Crackers
ingredients: 80 g parmesan cheese, grated | 1/4 cup coriander leaves, chopped
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine the parmesan, coriander and parmesan. Dry off the remaining cheese and stir into the cereal mixture with a wooden spoon. Serve immediately.

title: Pork Sausages With Herbs

instructions: Cut sausage into bite size pieces and place into a large pan with milk. Bring to the boil, add fresh herbs and then cook on low for 15 to 30 minutes.

ingredients: 1 loaf unsliced loaf unsliced breadcrumb | 1/2 lb ground beef chuck | 1 package hidden valley & reg ; original ranch & reg ; dressing and seasoning mix | 1 package shredded cheddar cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Pulse the bread crumbs in the food processor just until moist crumbs form. Mix beef, hidden valley dressing ingredients and mix together well. Spray a 13x9 pan well with cooking spray. Fill each loaf with the ground beef mixture, pressing gently with your hands. Sprinkle with cheddar cheese. Bake in oven 45 minutes.

instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. In a baking dish, spray with oil. In another baking dish, alternate layers of turnip and carrots.

ingredients: 1 cup dried pinto beans or garbanzo beans ( 1 1/2 cups ) | 2 tablespoons vegetable shortening | 1 bay leaf | 1/4 teaspoon paprika | 10 ounces nonfat yogurt | 1 tablespoon canola oil | 1/2 teaspoon canola oil | 1 tablespoon nonfat yogurt
instructions: Rinse beans.

title: Italian Grilled Cheese Skewers on the Exceed
ingredients: 4 garlic cloves, unpeeled | 1 bunch fresh cilantro | 2 -3 pints fresh rosemary, leaves only | 1 cup dry white wine | 1 cup cheddar cheese, grated | 16 ounces marinated artichoke hearts, drained | 2 packages vanilla ice cream, softened
instructions: Make sure the garlic is unpeeled and unpeeled. Slices are usually attached to the top of the head of garlic when broiling. Rinse well to remove excess salt and dry with paper towels. To prepare the garlic, finely chop the garlic and place in the blender with a little olive oil or water and process until garlic is just pureed. You may need to add more oil/water. Strain through coffee filter into a glass measuring cup or bowl that will fit into a larger bowl. Measure out 3 cups of cheese and set aside. Place the 1 1/2 cups of cheese, cilantro and rosemary in a blender with enough wine to measure a total of 6 cups. Cover and process until leaves are a bit coarsely chopped but not a paste. If it is too tart, add more wine. Strain through cheesecloth and discard rinds. Stir in artichoke hearts, salt to taste. To soak wooden skewers in your marinade, place them onto a plate and pour about 4 tablespoons of marinade onto chicken skewers and place under the broiler for about 8 - 10 minutes. You may also soak wooden skewers in water for 6 - 10 minutes, turning them over after 4 - 5 minutes. Remove from pan and sprinkle with the remaining 1/2 cup of provolone cheese. Serve hot.

title: Visions of Chambord Raspberry Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup whipping cream | 1 tablespoon cooking oil | 1 tablespoon chambord raspberry liquor
instructions: Bring whipping cream and oil to a boil over medium heat. Turn off heat and stir in chambord. Cool before stirring. Strain warm cream into a glass jar and refrigerate until cold. Serve.
