title: Green Beans, Sautéed With Pistachios and Lemon for 4
ingredients: 1 lb fresh green beans, trimmed | 1/4 cup of finely chopped fresh sage | 1 lemon, juice and zest of | 3/4 teaspoon chinese five spice powder | 3 tablespoons chopped pistachios
instructions: Cook green beans in a saucepot of boiling salted water.

Random Ingredients: olive oil,breadcrumb,rice paper,vinegar,flat leaf italian parsley
title: Baked Paper Wrapped Herring
ingredients: 60 ml olive oil | 1 1/4 tablespoons vinegar | 1 tablespoon flat-leaf italian parsley | 500 g fresh flat-leaf italian parsley, finely chopped | 60 g breadcrumbs | 60 g rice paper sheets
instructions: Preheat oven to 190°c. Mix oil, vinegar and half the parsley and the remainder of the parsley together. Put the extra virgin olive oil and some salt into a clean glass or ceramic jar. Add onion, mix well then cover with breadcrumbs. Heat in oven for 45 to 60 minutes, until breadcrumbs are light golden. Cut round corncobs with a sharp knife. Arrange on a baking sheet, brush with olive oil and put over a hot grill plate. Toast for 30 minutes meanwhile make the stuffing. Put the remaining parsley and any leftover stuffing in a mortar. Add remaining parsley and pour over the stuffing. Drain off extra liquid if stuffing is too salty. Serve the mixture on the corncobs with more breadcrumb on the side.

title: Crunchy Ramen Pasta Salad
ingredients: 16 ounces ramen noodles | 8 tablespoons kalamata olives or 8 tablespoons green olives | 1 package frozen corn | 2 cups cooked pasta
instructions: Boil the ramen noodles according to package directions. Drain well, and then chop fine and put in the salad bowl. Place in refrigerator while making the dressing. Drain the olives well, keeping them whole if they have been whole. Toss the ramen noodles with the kalamata olives, corn, and dressing.

Random Ingredients: garlic,kosher salt black pepper,lemon juice,cauliflower floret,lasagna noodle
title: Homemade Cauliflower Lasagna
ingredients: 2 cups fresh cauliflower florets | kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper | 3 tablespoons kosher salt | 3 tablespoons lemon juice | 16 sheets lasagna noodles, about 6 inches wide and 3 inches long | 1 clove garlic, minced
instructions: In a large skillet over medium heat, combine the cauliflower and 1 tablespoon of the kosher salt and 1 tablespoon of lemon juice and cook, stirring often, until the cauliflower begins to soften, about 3 minutes. Remove from heat and toss the cauliflower with enough water to bring to 1 1/2 cups, 1/2 teaspoon salt and the lemon juice in a bowl. Let sit 5 minutes and then stir in the cauliflower. Preheat the oven to 450 degrees f. Place the lasagna sheets on a flat surface and place about 1 - 2 tablespoons of cauliflower mixture at the bottom of each. Brush the edge of each lasagna sheet with some melted butter, fold over and pinch the seams to close the lasagna. Place the lasagna in a large roasting pan. Spread with 2 tablespoons of the remaining melted butter and sprinkle about 1 teaspoon of chopped garlic over the cauliflower mixture. Top with about 1/2 cup of cauliflower mixture. Sprinkle with 1/2 teaspoon salt and bake in the oven, covered, for 12 minutes or until the vegetables are tender and cooked.

title: Crock Pot Smoked Salmon Sandwich
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs smoked salmon steaks ( i prefer pacific cod ) | 1 can sliced ripe olives, drained | 2 whole 4-ounce cans salmon steaks | 8 ounces velveeta cheese, divided ( use your favorite ) | 1/4 cup minced fresh thyme leave | 2 tablespoons hummus or 2 tablespoons purchased hummus spread | 1/2 cup crushed ice | roasted whole wheat bread or tostada, warmed
instructions: Rinse salmon under cool running water and pat dry with paper towels. Remove fish from bones, trimming of silverskin and excess fat, leaving about 1/4 inch thick skin on each side. Coat each side of fish with 1 tablespoon olive oil and layer it with the olives. Set the fish side by side in a crockpot with the salmon steak on top. If there is any visible fat, crumble it lightly with a fork. Add the remaining ingredients, except the bread, and mix well. Cover and cook on low all day for 7 to 8 hours, or until thickened and flavors are married through and fish cooked. Serve over toast topped with extra crumbs from the swiss cheese, if desired. Note, if you prefer a thinner filling, use the velveeta cheese, spreading it on the salmon and topping with the hummus or spread on the hoagies, before topping with the bread.

title: Oaxacan, Green Chocolates and Flaming Batter (Mae ploy)
ingredients: 1/2 cup olive oil | 2 tablespoons white chocolate grated fresh white chocolate | 1/4 teaspoon white pepper
instructions: Stir all ingredients together and refrigerate for 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: marjoram,sharp cheddar cheese,rice krispies,soymilk,garam masala,white bread
title: Cheese Rice Crispies
ingredients: 1 cup soymilk ( or any other nondairy substitute ) | 1/2 teaspoon dried marjoram | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala | 3 cups shredded sharp cheddar cheese, divided ( i like more cheese ) | 4 cups raw rice krispies ( optional ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons garam masala | 4 slices white bread, cubed ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Combine soymilk, marjoram and 1/2 tsp garam masala in a small dish. Sprinkle cheese on cut surfaces of 5 cups of rice krispies. Press the rice krispies flat into a 7 x 11 shallow sided baking dish. Sprinkle with 1/2 tsp garam masala. Add a layer of krispies, breaking krispy pieces into pieces as you go, and repeat process until all krispy pieces are used. Sprinkle with 1/4 tsp garam masala. Repeat process with remaining 5 cups rice krispies. Top krispies with remaining krispy pieces and sprinkle with remaining garam masala. Cover dish with foil and bake for 30 minutes. Uncover and bake an additional 10 minutes, or until krispies are crispy to the touch and golden brown.

Random Ingredients: yukon gold potato,heavy cream,ginger garlic paste,portabella mushroom,cooking oil,green chili
title: Spiced Potatoes With Mushrooms & Caramelized Ginger
ingredients: 3 tablespoons oil or 3 tablespoons cooking oil | 6 yukon gold potatoes, peeled & halved diagonally | 8 ounces baby portabella mushrooms, sliced | 1 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste | 1 fresh green chili, seeded and finely chopped | 8 fluid ounces heavy cream ( to cover ) | 3 tablespoons grated fresh ginger-garlic paste
instructions: Heat oil in 12 inch skillet over medium high heat until foaming. Add potatoes and sauté until beginning to brown, about 6 to 10 minutes. Add mushrooms and sauté until softened, about 3 minutes. Transfer potatoes to platter and cover to keep warm. Repeat until oil remains. Add ginger garlic paste, chili and cream to skillet. Decrease heat to medium, then bring to a simmer. Cook, uncovered, stirring occasionally until mixture is thin and creamy, about 2 minutes. Spoon over baked potatoes.

title: Tasty Beef and Gravy
ingredients: 1 kg beef chuck, lean, cut in 3cm cubes | 14 ounces tomato ketchup
instructions: Put a good handful of fat of beef into the casserole over a medium high heat and sear it on all sides until browned. Take it off the heat and leave to stand. Add a small amount of water to the pan that had the browned meat and stir it up until it thickens slightly. Add the tomato ketchup and mix everything together until it boils. Once it comes to the boil, simmer for 10 minutes then taste and adjust the seasoning. Serve with crusty bread or mashed potato.

title: My Danish Friend's Danish Cheese Balls
ingredients: 32 ounces cottage cheese, drained well | 1 package instant vanilla pudding mix
instructions: Cream together cottage cheese and pudding mix using mixer, just until soft. Shape by rounded teaspoon or small amount into balls or smaller balls.

Random Ingredients: ghee,thyme sprig,olive,butterscotch schnapps,penne,red kidney bean,vanilla essence,brown rice
title: Sweet and Savory Two-Ingredient Red Beans & Rice
ingredients: 1 can red kidney beans or ( 19 ounce ) can white kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 1 tablespoon olive oil or 1 tablespoon butter | 1 large brown rice | 1 pinch dried thyme sprigs ( or 1 tsp. dried thyme ) | 400 g butterscotch schnapps | 3 tablespoons ghee or 3 tablespoons unsalted butter | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence | 150 g toasted mixed nuts ( chopped ) or 150 g toasted sliced almonds ( chopped )
instructions: Add rice to a pan of boiling cold water and bring to the boil. Stir regularly to prevent catching and to ensure a thick, even steaming. Drain. While the rice is cooking, heat the olive oil or butter in a frypan and sauté the brown rice for about a minute or two, until browned. Toss the grains with the schnapps and set aside to absorb the flavours. Add the rice, beans, thyme and vanilla to the beans and warm through. Place nuts or toasted nuts on a large platter. Spoon the hot beans and rice over the toasted nuts. If you like a little extra spice, dust with a couple of cloves, cinnamon, cinnamon sugar and sugar. Serve immediately.

title: The Perfect Seasoning for Seasoning Salt
ingredients: 1 tablespoon fennel seed | 2 tablespoons seasoning salt
instructions: Mix all the salt ingredients together. Enjoy this spice mix.

title: Baked Cod and Apple Pizza
ingredients: 1/2 cup water | 1 tablespoon honey | 3 ounces tart apple ( peeled, cored and chopped ) | 1 1/2 lbs cod, cleaned | 1 1/2 teaspoons kosher salt | 1 3/4 cups plain flour | 1 1/4 teaspoons active dry yeast | 1 cup crushed ice
instructions: Heat the oven to 400°f place the baking sheet in the oven and warm it, then preheat to the meanwhile to 200°f. Stir the water and honey together in a small pan until the honey dissolves, then stir in the apple and salt. Set aside to cool. Drain the fish, reserving the marinade and flake the fish into the marinade, then coat with flour and shake off any excess flour. Make a well in the flour and slowly stir in the yeast and ice, then mix into the beer. Pour the mixture into a lightly greased and floured 8 inch pizza tray, about an inch deep. Cover with a tent of foil and a damp kitchen towel and let rise for about 20 minutes, then remove the tent. Bake until the crust is brown, about 7 minutes, top with extra honey and bake 3 - 5 minutes longer, or until the fish is cooked through and the juices are beginning to bubble. Let cool for 5 minutes, then slice into thick slices and serve warm.

title: Slow Cooker Korean Style Pork Ribs
ingredients: 2 1/2 pounds country-style pork ribs | 1 1/2 pounds fresh singapore-style kale | 2 tart apples, cut into 1-inch chunks | 1 cup arborio rice | 2 cups chili sauce | 1/4 teaspoon ground cinnamon, or to taste
instructions: Place the pork ribs and kale in the bottom of your slow cooker crock. Arrange the apple chunks around the pork, pouring 1 cup of water into the cooker. Cover, and cook on high for 2 to 4 hours. Once cooked, stir in the rice, and season with chili sauce and cinnamon. Cover, and cook for up to 1 1/2 hours more.

title: Beef, Black Beans and Chillies - Gluten Free
ingredients: 1 lb roast beef, cut into strips | 1/2 pint light vegetable stock | 1 teaspoon chili | 8 olives, sliced in half | 8 hazelnuts, sliced | 4 ounces dried fruit, of your choice | 1 fresh chili, deseeded and chopped | 1 tablespoon pine nuts, toasted
instructions: Heat a little oil in a frying pan and fry the beef for 3 - 4 minutes. Add the stock and cook over a moderate heat for about 20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the beef is tender. Leave to stand for at least 5 minutes. Meanwhile, put a little oil in a frying pan and fry the hazelnuts for 2 - 3 minutes. Remove from the pan and spread the hazelnuts out on kitchen paper to cool. Add the dried fruit, chilli, pine nuts and hazelnuts to the beef in the pan and stir. Add the beef mixture and reheat gently until just warm through. Serve with white rice and a salad.

title: Lamb and Cabbage With Parmigiano-Reggiano
ingredients: 1 medium head cabbage, thinly sliced | 2 lbs lamb fillets, cut into strips | 1 1/2 tablespoons shredded fresh parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Preheat the broiler. Arrange the cabbage in a single layer on foil. Top with the lamb strips. Drizzle with both tablespoons cheese and a sprinkling of salt. Broil the meat strips until the cheese is browned and bubbly, about 4 minutes.

title: Blueberry and Tamale Salad
ingredients: 2 whole tamales | 1 pint blueberries | 2 tablespoons tamales magic bullet pesto sauce ( this will get 1 c diluted ) | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon splenda sugar substitute
instructions: Slice the tamales and put all the other ingredients, except the tamales, into a container that will fit the tamale slices. I use a small pot to get the liquid to the bottom of the container, and then just pour half of the liquid over the tamales, turning them to coat the tamale pieces. Place the tamale slices in the fridge for about 30 minutes or longer to let the flavors develop. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: bamboo shoot,white wine,kalamata olive,cherry pepper,bulb garlic,paprika,panko breadcrumb,phyllo dough
title: Shrimp and Oyster Rolls
ingredients: 12 ounces panko breadcrumbs, more as needed | 6 large shrimp, cleaned and de-veined | 12 ounces bamboo shoots | 12 ounces cherries in olive | 2 bunches cherry peppers, cut in half lengthwise | 1 bulb of garlic, finely chopped | 2 ounces dry white wine | 10 sheets phyllo dough, defrosted if frozen
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Place panko on wax paper and press until lightly toasted, about 1 - 2 minutes. Roll out panko into a rectangle about 10 in diameter. Remove shrimp from their shells and set aside. Pat shrimp dry with paper towels. Remove the seeds and veins from the chilies. Using a very sharp knife, scrape off the veins as easily as possible. Stuff a half shrimp into the panko, then roll over. Tuck in the ends of the shrimp so that the shrimp don't twist too much. Place the shrimp in a 9x13 baking dish, preferably one that is big enough to hold them snugly in one layer. Drizzle with oil from the shrimp. Bake shrimp until shrimp are lightly browned, about 10 - 12 minutes. Remove shrimp from oven and set aside. Reduce the oven temperature to 350°f. Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a sauté pan over medium high heat. When the oil is hot, add the cherry peppers and remove immediately from heat. Set aside until needed. Place the olives and cherries in a blender or food processor and puree, then spread out over the shrimp. Drizzle the wine over the shrimp and cherries. Place sheets of phyllo dough between 2 sheets of wax paper, overlapping them slightly. Rolling and folding each sheet around the shrimp and cherry mixture until the dough is about 1/4 inch thick. Place 1 - 2 shrimp in the center of the phyllo dough.

title: Portuguese Oregano Oil
ingredients: 1 cup light corn oil | 1 cup virgin olive oil | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves
instructions: Mix oil and oregano together. Store in airtight container. Use sparingly when buying the oil.

title: Coconut Magic (Coconut and Herb Versi)
ingredients: 1 can coconut cream | 1 dash mixed italian herbs ( we like the herbaceous dijon, but any combo of dried herbs is okay )
instructions: Shake coconut cream vigorously over low heat to make sure no lumps form. A few seconds after it starts to bubble, add the mixed herbs, a few drops or a splash of water. This recipe should be enough to just fill a 2 cup container, but if it seems dry, add more just to make sure the coconut cream is moistened. If it seems dry, add more and repeat. The amount of mixed herbs required will vary, we like lots of them. The coconut cream should have been smoothed out and stirred slightly during the 2 minute cooling time, it will firm up somewhat, but will not be smooth again.

title: Ajon (Ethiopian Sweet Pickled Onions)

instructions: Heat vinegar in a heavy bottomed pan until it boils, about 3 minutes. Meanwhile, crack the cardamom pods with a small sharp knife, leaving the stalk attached. Remove cardom pods with a slotted spoon.

instructions: Combine romano cheese, thyme, basil, and roast beef slices in a bowl.

instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.

title: Shredded Beef Ramen
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 lbs bear rump roast, shredded | 2 tablespoons miracle whip | 1/4 cup green lentil, rinsed and drained | 2 tablespoons green maraschino cherries, chopped | 1 teaspoon anise seed | 16 ounces oysters, drained
instructions: In a shallow dish, stir together the miracle whip and lentils. Add the beef, cherries, and anise seeds. Mix. Cover, and marinate in the refrigerator for at least 4 hours. Heat a grill pan, or grill pan, and oil lightly. Grill beef for 2 minutes, or to desired doneness. Serve hot.

title: Red Bell Pepper Puree
ingredients: 1 red bell pepper | 2 cups vegetable stock, or more if needed | 1/2 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Wash and peel the red pepper, removing the seeds and membrane. Cut into chunks and place in a large saucepan. Pour in enough vegetable stock to cover or stock pot, about 1/2 inch below the top of the pepper. Stir the peppers and any accumulated moisture from the peppers into the puree. Bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat, cover and simmer until peppers are tender and slightly blackened in some parts, about 15 minutes. When peppers are tender, discard the lid and stir in the parmigiano reggiano. Transfer pepper puree into a food processor or blender and puree until smooth, or puree in batches in a blender until smooth.

title: Baby Corn
ingredients: 2 lbs potatoes, quartered | 12 ounces self-raising flour | 1 tablespoon mustard seeds | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 2 ounces honey | 1 tablespoon sesame seeds | 1 teaspoon juniper berries | 12 fluid ounces applesauce | whipping cream
instructions: Pre heat oven to 200c. Place potatoes in saucepan with 6 cups cold water to cover. Bring to the boil, cover, and cook 2 minutes until just tender. Drain well.

title: Homemade Sausage

instructions: Bake sausages over medium hot coals in a 300 degree oven for approximately 45 minutes or until well puffed up.

title: Linguine with Beef Ragout and Veggies
ingredients: 1 lb dry linguine, uncooked | 1 teaspoon vegetable oil | 1 jar barbecue sauce | 1 1/2 cups whole milk ricotta cheese | 1/2 cup beef broth | 1 1/2 cups sliced tomatoes | 1 1/2 cups shredded ziti pasta | 1 cup halved cherry tomatoes
instructions: Cook, pasta according to package directions. Drain, reserving 1 cup of pasta liquid. Meanwhile, melt oil in a large skillet. Stir in barbecue sauce and cook 2 minutes, or until heated. Stir in ricotta, beef broth, and wine to mixture. Cover, and cook 5 minutes longer. Stir in tomatoes, ziti, and cherry tomatoes. Toss with reserved 1/2 cup reserved pasta water. Toss until just combined. Divide pasta among 4 plates, and top with 1/2 cup stewed veg. Spoon beef sauce over top.

title: Indian Fried Rice Noodles
ingredients: 8 ounces rice noodles, halved lengthwise, rinsed, drained if necessary | 1/4 cup chopped peeled fresh garlic | 2 tablespoons curry paste, or more to taste ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons hot beef broth, or more as needed, divided
instructions: Cook and stir rice noodles in boiling hot water until just softened, 3 to 5 minutes. Drain noodles on paper towels, let cool, and separate strands. Heat the garlic flavored oil in a large skillet over medium heat.

title: Hot Sauce for Baking Chips
ingredients: 1/2 pound red chile peppers, sliced | 2 tablespoons pickle juice | 4 ounces white chocolate, melted
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place red chile peppers, pickle juice, and white chocolate in a heavy, shallow baking dish. Bake in the preheated oven until hot and chocolate mixture is beginning to melt, about 10 minutes. Use a slotted spoon to remove chile peppers.

Random Ingredients: kernel corn,green bell pepper,pistachio,clam,rosemary leaf,five spice powder,pork,plum tomato
title: Portuguese Spicy Spiced Pork Coastal Style
ingredients: 1 lb ground lean pork | 1/2 cup chopped green bell pepper | 1 can whole kernel corn | 1 cup chopped plum tomato | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried rosemary leaves, crushed | 1/4 teaspoon five-spice powder | 1 clove chopped fresh rosemary leaf | 1 box frozen chopped pecans
instructions: Set aside 1 large jar of canned corn and drained whole kernel corn. In a large skillet, brown pork over medium high heat in remaining green pepper. Drain beef and add to skillet. Mix well with pork. Sprinkle 1 1/4 tsp.Rosemary and 1/4 tsp. Five spice powder over top and cook 1 - 2 minutes. Stir in 1 cup of fresh chopped rosemary. Stir in remaining 1 1/4 cup cold water. Bring to boil. Reduce heat to medium low and cook for 1 hour. Stir in 1/2 cup of chopped pecans, and cook for 15 minutes longer. Spicy croutes on a serving platter and top with 1/2 of each of the canned corn and cream mixture.

Random Ingredients: garam masala powder,sambal oelek,chili paste,lemon juice zest,chili oil
title: Easy Rasab (Sugar-Free) - Microwave on 100% Lemon Juice
ingredients: 1 tablespoon sambal oelek | 1 teaspoon chili oil or 1 teaspoon oil | 1/4 teaspoon garam masala powder | 1/2 teaspoon chili paste | 1 teaspoon lemon juice | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala powder
instructions: Prepare lemon juice by placing all ingredients in the microwave bowl. Cook on high for 5 minutes. Set aside. After 5 minutes, mix everything in a container with a lid. Then, gently squeeze lemon juice into the container. Mix well. Cook for 5 minutes on high. Serve and enjoy with your favourite grain.

title: Portabella Mushrooms
ingredients: 20 g plain flour | 50 g dried portabella mushrooms | 2 tablespoons horseradish | 2 tablespoons rice wine | 1 1/2 tablespoons chili paste
instructions: Finely chop the mushrooms and place in a large bowl. Add horseradish, rice wine and chilli to the mushrooms. Stir to combine. Cover and leave overnight. Pre heat oven 400 degrees f. Bake mushrooms for about 15 minutes, until soft and glistening. Serve with a crisp green salad and crusty bread.

title: Peachy Surprise
ingredients: 4 ripe peaches, peeled and quartered | 1 1/2 teaspoons grated peeled gingerroot | 1 vanilla bean, split lenghtwise | 1 teaspoon peanut oil | 1/2 cup shredded monterey jack cheese
instructions: In a medium size bowl, combine the peaches with the ginger, vanilla bean and salt and pepper to taste. Let sit out at room temperature 10 minutes. Thread peaches with the peel, then grill over medium heat 4 - 5 minutes each side. Remove to a serving dish and top with the cheese.

title: Rice Chicken With Vanilla Sauce
ingredients: 4 5 lbs chicken or 4 lbs turkey | 1 cup brown rice or 1 cup arborio rice | 4 cans crushed tomatoes | 1 teaspoon vanilla
instructions: Prepare rice according to package directions. You might need to use more than 1/3 a cup of rice. If you need to, add some water if it gets a little dry. Place chicken in bottom of crock pot. Turn crock pot on low and let stand 5 - 6 hours. Once chicken is sitting, begin making sauce. In a separate pot, cook brown rice according to package directions. Drain browned rice and set aside. Take chicken out of crock pot and set aside.. Do not rinse chicken meat completely. I do this in a couple batches. I leave the ribs on for flavor. In a bowl, crush tomatoes into a puree.. Turn rice to high. Add tomato puree to chicken and rice. Stir chicken mixture. Cover and cook on low for 5 hours. Note, make sure your crock pot is very large before placing chicken mixture in crock pot. This recipe should take around 4 hours, depending on how large the chicken is. The chicken should be falling off the bones and most of the liquid should be absorbed. Some of the liquid may be floating and some may be floating and other things may need to be done depending on your crock pot, but keep a close eye on it as it may boil over. I find 4 hours in a box when i first start, i have a long time to cook. I check my rice after the last 15 minutes of cooking, if it is done, then keep an eye on it, if it is not, continue cooking, and add water, stirring constantly, to keep it moist, if it is too wet, add some of the rice. Let chicken rest for 5 - 10 minutes before serving. Note, for a little extra flavor, serve over your favorite curries this is also a good dip for a hearty chicken breast half.

title: Pickled Onions
ingredients: 2 large white onions | 2 teaspoons pickling spices | 3 tablespoons rice wine or 3 tablespoons dry sherry
instructions: Peel the peeled sliced white onions and slice them into wedges or rings with the pointy side of a cleaver. Heat a griddle and brush the onions with oil. Stir once, add the pickling spices and stir well. Place the onions into a large glass jar and cover with the dry sherry. Seal with the lid. Place a weight on top or you can shake the jar to shake it. Leave to mature in the sun for 2 weeks. Enjoy your pickled onions.

title: Acorn Squash and Peppers (Antigua and Barbuda)
ingredients: 1 acorn squash, cut in half lengthwise and seeded | 4 large bell peppers or 4 large sweet bell peppers, cut in half lengthwise and seeds removed
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f place squash on baking parchment, sprinkle with salt and toss. Roast for 12 - 15 minutes until the squash has some colour and soft texture. Transfer squash and peppers to a bowl. Immediatize the vegetables over a baking dish. Return the baking dishes to the oven and roast for 10 - 20 minutes depending on size and shape of squash. Serve hot or cold.

Random Ingredients: coconut milk,fine semolina,heavy cream,salmon fillet,malt vinegar,bacon,tahini,sun tomato
title: Smoked Salmon in Brown Sauce
ingredients: 4 -6 pieces smoked salmon fillets | 8 slices bacon | 2 cups shredded coconut milk ( i used 2 % ) | 1/4 cup malt vinegar | 2 tablespoons plain fine semolina, not quick-rising ( i used a light dusting of semolina that had a little bite ) | 2 tablespoons heavy cream | 2 teaspoons tahini ( sesame seed paste ) | 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato ( optional )
instructions: In a skillet cook the bacon until just crisp, about 2 minutes, then add the salmon, and cook over medium heat until browned. Add the coconut milk, vinegar, and sundried tomatoes. Lower the heat, cover, and simmer 5 to 10 minutes, depending on the thickness of the salmon. Taste for seasoning, and adjust if necessary to warm through. Serve immediately.

title: Crusty Greek Sour Cream Salad
ingredients: 12 ounces greek yogurt | 3 -4 tablespoons sunflower oil | 1/2 red cabbage, shredded, leaves separated
instructions: Shred cabbage and add to yogurt. Mix. Refrigerate overnight covered with cling wrap to prevent curling. Serve chilled. Can be eaten cold.

title: Butternut Squash in Tomatoes and Kamatis
ingredients: 2 lbs butternut squash, peeled and cut into chunks | 1 teaspoon margarine, more if necessary | 1/4 cup margarine, for brushing | 6 cups tomato juice, for thinning | 1/4 cup kirsch ( cherry ) | ground-black kirsch ( cherry kirsch ) ( optional )
instructions: For large chunks, place in a large pot and cover with cold water. Bring to a full boil over high heat and cook until tender. Drain the squash, but reserve the liquid. When the squash is cool enough to handle, remove the seeds using kitchen shears or a vegetable peeler. Cut each one into 5 wedges and set aside. Toss the wedges in the 2 t margarine. Set aside. Place tomato juice in a large pot with the kirsch. Bring to a boil over medium high heat, stirring occasionally. Cook for 30 minutes, stirring frequently until the mixture thickens a little. Stir in the wedge pieces, reduce heat and simmer for 2 hours. Serve with the toasted kirsch. Note, the sauce should not be too thick. If the consistency is too thin, reduce heat, cover and simmer 30 minutes or until desired texture is reached.

title: Naked Noodles
ingredients: 4 packages frozen dried navy beans | 2 cups peanut butter
instructions: Place navy beans in a large pot, and cover with several inches of water. Bring to a rolling boil, then reduce heat to medium low, and simmer until beans are tender, about 1 hour. Drain beans, and return to the pot with peanut butter, and mix together.

Random Ingredients: kaffir lime leaf,chicken bouillon powder,lemon zest
title: Chicken Powder
ingredients: 2 tablespoons chicken bouillon powder | 1 teaspoon grated lemon zest | 2/3 cup kaffir lime leaves
instructions: In a small bowl, blend the bouillon powder and lemon rind.

Random Ingredients: tomato puree,zucchini,yellow pepper,cannellini bean,mint leaf,vanilla ice cream,beet,puff pastry
title: Beet, Zucchini & Basil Tart
ingredients: 1/2 cup canned cannellini beans, drained thoroughly | 3 zucchini, halved lengthwise, cut into 2-inch pieces then cut into sticks and halved crosswise | 1 medium yellow sweet pepper, cut into thin 1/2-inch strips | 2 cans canned beets, drained, cut into 1-inch pieces | 1 can tomato puree, divided | 1/4 cup mint leaf, finely chopped | 1 sheet puff pastry | vanilla ice cream ( optional )
instructions: Place cannellini beans over medium heat. Heat 3 minutes or until barely boiling. Stir in zucchini sticks, green pepper strips, beet halves, tomato puree 1/4 cup of mint, then transfer to medium bowl. Cover and chill 3 hours or overnight. Roll pastry sheet on a lightly floured board about 1/8 inch thick. Cut into 8 - 3 inch squares. Place 1 tablespoon bean mixture on one half of 1 pastry square. Spread with 2 tablespoons beet mixture. Fold other half of pastry over filling and enclose. Seal edges. Place tart on a lightly floured board, pressing with fingers to flatten. Cut steam vent holes in top using sharp knife. Repeat process with other pastry, bean mixture and mint. Place tart on a parchment lined baking sheet. Brush with a few tablespoons of the tomato puree then place under broiler for 3 - 5 minutes or until browned. Drizzle with remaining tomato puree. Top with remaining beet mixture and bake in oven at 450 degrees f for 20 - 25 minutes or until filling is bubbling and is hot and bubbling.

title: Ethiopian Spiced Beef in Lentil Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb beef chuck, cut into 1 inch cubes | 2 tablespoons finely chopped fresh ginger ( about 2 inches ) | 2 cups lentils, rinsed | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom ( optional )
instructions: Place the meat in a heavy pot and season it with salt and hot pepper. Add the ginger and stir to coat. Cover and cook over low heat about 1 1/2 hours or until meat is tender. Add the lentils and spices and simmer covered about 1 1/2 hours, or until the lentils are tender.

Random Ingredients: kaffir lime leaf,caper,rump roast,white onion,mirin,pasta sauce,garlic granule,chipotle chile
title: Chipotle Shredded Beef
ingredients: 1 lb rump roast, boneless, trimmed | 1 package dry pasta sauce | 1 -2 tablespoon chipotle chile fresh minced | 1 teaspoon garlic granules | 1 teaspoon white onion, minced | 1/2 tablespoon capers | 1/4 cup mirin ( japanese sweet wine ) | 10 -12 slices kaffir lime leaves ( or fresh, if desired )
instructions: Place beef in a plastic bag with the pasta sauce, chipotle, garlic, onion, and capers and shake to combine. Refrigerate 30 minutes and up to 2 hours. Preheat oven to 425 degrees then place beef in a roasting pan. Insert a knife on the thick part of the rump roast and poke several holes in it with a fork. Drizzle marinade from the bag all over the beef, rubbing it into the beef as it browns. Cover the pan tightly with aluminum foil and bake, basting occasionally, at 425 degrees for 2 hours or until a meat thermometer registers 325 degrees. If desired, you may also stir the meat around a bit after about 1 hour of cooking.

title: Grilled Smoked Salmon
ingredients: 2 cups salmon fillets, skin and bones removed | 1 cup fresh broccoli, chopped | 1 tablespoon serrano pepper, chopped | 1/4 cup creme de cacao
instructions: Pound salmon fillets until thin. Place broccoli in a bowl, and add 1/4 cup of water. Toss with remaining ingredients to coat. Cover, and marinate in the refrigerator at least 1 hour. Grill salmon 6 to 8 minutes, turning once, or until fish flakes easily.

title: Watermelon Celery Salad
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs seedless watermelon, cubed | 2 stalks celery, chopped | 1/4 cup virgin olive oil | 1 tablespoon water
instructions: Place all ingredients in a food processor and puree.

Random Ingredients: lemon zest,asafoetida powder,coriander seed,cremini mushroom,dark chocolate,worcestershire sauce,cream tartar,fish sauce
title: Tantalizing Asian Mole Sauce
ingredients: 10 1/2 ounces cremini mushrooms | 1/4 teaspoon dark chocolate, finely chopped | 1/4 teaspoon worcestershire sauce | 1/4 teaspoon lemon zest | 1/2 teaspoon coriander seed | 1/4 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 2 tablespoons cream of tartar or 2 tablespoons treacle | 1 teaspoon fish sauce
instructions: Put the mushrooms, worcestershire sauce, zest, coriander seeds and asafoetida into a mortar and pound until smooth. Transfer mixture to a bowl and stir in the cream of tartar until dissolved. Stir in fish sauce and refrigerate until ready to use.

title: Cedar Door Filling
ingredients: 10 ounces kielbasa or 10 ounces smoked sausage | 1/3 cup vinegar ( i use red wine ) | 1 can pineapple rings | 1/3 cup green peas | 1/3 cup chopped fresh coriander seed | 1 teaspoon sage
instructions: Slice kiel into 1/2 inch pieces. Cook kiel pieces and onion with oil in a 2 qt saucepan or stockpot. Add spices and cook for 3 minutes. Add remaining ingredients and cook 10 minute or until thick and creamy.

title: Sausage and Barley Pilaf with Jasmine Rice
ingredients: 2 -3 ounces italian sausages, cut into 1/2- to 3/4-inch slices ( optional, can use more ) | 1/2 cup pearl barley ( uncooked ) | 1 1/2 - 2 cups jasmine rice ( or other long grain rice )
instructions: If using jasmine rice, soak it in enough boiling water to cover it, then drain it before cooking.

title: Quick and Easy Tasty Indian Filter Wontons
ingredients: 1 pinch asafoetida powder ( optional ) | 1 cup stock
instructions: In a pan on a medium flame, add 1 cup of water. When the water is very hot, add 1 tbsp, pinch of asafoetida powder. Turn off the flame. Empty the oil from the pan onto the asafoetida powder mixture. Do not use any additional water. Instead, slowly pour the stock into the pan. Mix well and take off some of the asafoetida powder. Keep stirring every 10 mins or so. Instead, if the pan gets dry add 1 more cup of water. You may have to use a slotted spoon to get the asafoetida liquid through the strainer. You may have to do this in batches. The water may dilute the process if the oil does not completely dry at the bottom. This is a matter of personal preference. Remember that it may act as a moderator and make adjustments as desired. You may now also add your salt, chili powder, red chili powder or cayenne powder to the mixture if using. Keep stirring. After adding ingredients, taste and add more as desired. The taste may be a tad dry and the spice mix may still be on the dry side. If you are feeling adventurous, use a spoon. Make sure your mix does not become too dry. Allow to cool, then store in an air tight container. The longer the storage is stored, the more flavor of this paste we can be used. This paste is also good if used to make dosas or chapati sandwiches. This is not intended to be eaten as an appetizer.

title: Cauliflower, Beef & Cocoa Cube Steaks
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef tenderloin steaks | 1 1/2 cups low-sodium cocoa, divided | 1/4 cup vinegar | 1 teaspoon vanilla | 3 tablespoons ice cubes | 1 head cauliflower floret
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Lightly spray foil with nonstick spray. Place steaks on top of foil in nonstick baking pan. Combine 4 cup cocoa with vinegar & vanilla & drizzle over steaks. Bake at 350f for 40 minutes, turning steaks halfway through. Place cauliflower on plate, top with steaks. Drizzle sauce over steaks & can't let them touch. Serve remaining remaining sauce in sauce pan.

title: Roasted Capsicum and Lemon
ingredients: 1 kg red capsicum, halved and seeded if desired | 1 tablespoon zest, grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 150°c place capsicum in a small glass baking dish and spray with oil. Sprinkle with zest. Roast, uncovered, for 1 hour. Cool for about 15 minutes, then slice and serve. Variation, try roasting vegetables such as capsicum, leeks with olives.

title: My Italian Sausage and Spinach
ingredients: 1 package frozen chopped spinach ( thawed and drained by hand ) | 1 jar meatless spaghetti sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Lightly coat a baking dish with non stick cooking spray. In a medium bowl combine the spinach, spaghetti sauce and meat sauce.

title: Italian Spinach Lasagna
ingredients: 12 lasagna noodles | 1 pint whipping cream | 1 bag fresh baby spinach
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Cover a 12x18 inch baking sheet with aluminum foil. Bring a pot of water to a boil over high heat, and add uncooked pasta. Cook for 10 to 12 minutes, or until al dente.

title: Pear En Papillote (Tropical Pear and Spinach Tarts)
ingredients: 1 tart dough puff pastry, thawed ( about 10 oz. ) | 2 large bosc pears, peeled, cored and thinly sliced | 1 cup thinly sliced radish, such as kirby kumara | 8 ounces fresh spinach, stemmed, cleaned and torn into bite-sized pieces | 1/2 cup coconut milk | 3 tablespoons chopped of fresh mint
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Place pie crust on ungreased cookie sheet. Thoroughly mix the pear slices with the radishes, spinach, coconut milk, mint, pears and ½ cup of the water in a medium bowl. Divide the mixture evenly among the four tart shells. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes or until the filling is puffed and golden brown, and the crust is crisp and golden brown.

title: Maggie's Mushrooms & Spinach
ingredients: 400 g button mushrooms | 4 baby spinach ( washed and chopped ) | 1 tablespoon nutritional yeast
instructions: Heat 3tbsps juice from mushrooms. Add the mushrooms, sprinkle the spinach over it and mix well. Then add the nutritional yeast and stir. Enjoy this.

title: The Big Fat Greek Dip
ingredients: 1/2 cup yoghurt, plain | 1/2 cup apricot preserves, divided | 1/2 teaspoon celery salt | 1/2 teaspoon taco seasoning or 1/4 teaspoon salt | sweet tomato puree
instructions: Mix together all ingredients. Serve with pita chips or raw veggies.

Random Ingredients: chili flake,cake flour,plain yogurt,jalapeno pepper,turnip,nigella seed,cream chicken soup,currant
title: Curried Turnip Patties
ingredients: 10 large yellow turnips, peeled | 14 ounces cream of chicken soup, undiluted | 1/3 cup plain yogurt, unflavored | 1/3 cup sour cream or 1/3 cup nonfat sour cream | 2 -3 jalapeno peppers, seeded and minced | 1/4 cup dried currant | plain yogurt, for dipping patties in | 2 tablespoons cake flour | 2 tablespoons nigella seeds
instructions: Cut the turnips, removing the peel and taking the seeds, into thin, even chunks. Set aside. In a large bowl, whisk together the soup, yogurt, sour cream, chili peppers, currants and sifted cake flour. Add the salt & set aside. Peel and dice the turnips, keeping the juice. When ready to serve, in a frypan, heat just enough oil or oil to fry the patties. Dip each patty in yogurt and place on top of a turnip. Garnish with nigella seeds and sour cream.

title: Chocolate Portabella Mushrooms
ingredients: 16 portabella mushroom caps | 1 tablespoon unsweetened chocolate, chopped | 1 whole green tomato | 1 teaspoon real vanilla extract
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°. Place mushrooms on a foil lined baking sheet with parchment paper or plastic wrap. In each mushroom, top with a whole green tomato and sprinkle top of each mushroom with chocolate and vanilla. Wrap tightly in foil, and bake 20 minutes.

title: Fresh Mint and Blueberry Bites
ingredients: 2 cups fresh blueberries ( or frozen, thawed ) | 3/4 cup finely chopped of fresh mint ( white or fresh ) | 2 -4 teaspoons dark sesame oil | 1/2 cup unsalted dry-roasted peanuts, chopped ( or coarsely chopped )
instructions: Place the berries in a small mixing bowl or food processor, and process them until they become coarsely chopped, no larger pieces of berries. Stir in the chopped mint and sesame oil. Using a small spoon, stir in the chopped nuts. Cover and chill in the refrigerator until ready to serve.

title: Charishma's Date-And-Black-Bean Bread for ABM
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups warm water | 1/2 cup pitted dates, finely chopped ( about 16-20 dates ) | 2 teaspoons active dry yeast
instructions: Line a parchment paper or other baking sheet with a clean, oilfree silicone baking mat. Combine the water, dates and yeast in a small bowl, stirring well. Let the mixture stand for 5 minutes. Stir in the dates and transfer to your bread machine according to your manufacturer's directions. My machine instructs to date mixture in 2 batches. When finished, remove and transfer to a lightly oiled bowl, turning the dough around to coat. Cover and let rise in a warm place until doubled, about 30 minutes. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Uncover the dough and slash a cross in the surface. Bake until well browned and the edges are light brown spots, about 30 to 40 minutes. Immediately remove from oven and allow to cool on a wire rack. Cut into 3/4 inch slices and transfer to a serving container with a lip.

title: Pizza Crust
ingredients: 2 cups monterey jack cheese, shredded ( or your favourite cheese ) | 1/2 cup cold water | 1 tablespoon salt | 1/2 teaspoon marjoram, crushed
instructions: Combine all ingredients in large bowl. Mix all at once. Roll out on a lightly floured surface and divide into 5 portions. Bake at 400 in two buttered 9x13 inch pan for 20 - 25 minutes until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: kosher salt,flour,raisin,celery rib,fast rising yeast,romaine lettuce,baby carrot
title: Easy Spring Roll Bread
ingredients: 1 lb baby carrots, finely chopped in batches | 6 ounces baby carrots, finely chopped in batches | 1/2 lb romano lettuce, finely shredded | 2 1/4 teaspoons fast rising yeast | 2 tablespoons kosher salt | 1 cup unbleached flour | 2 tablespoons raisins
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f and lightly flour a large metal loaf pan. Spray with cooking spray and set aside. In a medium size mixing bowl add the baby carrots, romano, yeast, salt, and flour and mix well by hand. Using a wooden spool, break the dry ingredients into the bowl of a food processor and add the raisins and mix well with the flour. Increase the speed and pour the batter into the pan, breaking up the larger pieces as you go. Spray the loaf and place in the preheated oven. Bake about 50 to 55 minutes or until bread has pulled away from the sides of the pan. Allow to cool 10 minutes and turn out onto a large platter or loaf pan. Let cool completely and cut into 32 slices.

title: Bacon Bits or Spread
ingredients: 2 packages bacon bits | 2 tablespoons golden syrup
instructions: Place bacon bits in the microwave for a minute or two, until the bits are all coated. Add the brown syrup. Use a pastry brush to spread the syrup on the bacon bits, or spread them on a plate. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: pork shoulder,oregano leaf,nonfat cream,tomato paste,peanut,garam masala,graham cracker crumb
title: Easy Raita
ingredients: 3 pounds boneless pork shoulder, thinly sliced | 1 clove fresh garlic, minced, or more to taste | 1/2 cup grated roasted peanuts | 1/2 cup nonfat sour cream | 1/4 cup tomato paste | 1 teaspoon ground dried oregano leaves | 1/2 teaspoon ground garam masala | 1/3 cup graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line a 9x13 inch baking dish with plastic wrap, leaving about 1 1/2 inch of wrap hanging over the sides. Arrange pork slices in one layer in the prepared baking dish. Blend garlic, peanuts, sour cream, tomato paste, oregano, and garam masala in a blender until smooth. Spread 1/4 cup graham cracker crumbs onto a baking sheet, cover with cheese cloth, and sprinkle 1/4 c graham cracker crumbs on the crumbs. Repeat layers twice, using 3 more graham crackers per layer. Bake in the preheated oven until the crumbs are beginning to brown, about 1 hour. Cool.

Random Ingredients: hamburger,thyme,italian salad dressing mix,white wine vinegar,coconut
title: Cajun Sandwiches
ingredients: 3/4 cup italian salad dressing mix | 1 teaspoon white wine vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme | 1 1/2 pounds hamburger, thinly sliced | 2 cans coconut slices, well drained
instructions: In a medium bowl, stir the italian dressing mix, vinegar and thyme. Add hamburger mince, and mix until well coated. Cover, and refrigerate for 8 to 10 hours. Heat a small nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Place a pineapple chunk about 1/2 cup of mixture into the heated skillet. Top with coconut. Place another small chunk of burger over the top, and cook until bread is golden brown and the sauce is warm, about 5 minutes.

title: Taco Seasoned Goat Cheese
ingredients: 1 cup feta cheese ( crumbled and preferably crumbled ) | 1/3 cup dried pecans | 1 teaspoon cumin seed | 10 tablespoons grand marnier
instructions: Stir together all ingredients. Pour into 1 1/2 cup sized molds. Preheat oven 350 f. Bake in a 400 f oven for 18 minutes. Serve warm from molds.

title: Rice and Vegetable Saute
ingredients: 1 teaspoon canola oil | 1 cup jasmine rice | 2 zucchini, cut | 2 ounces button mushrooms, sliced | 10 ounces fresh spinach, coarsely chopped | 2 tablespoons olives, finely chopped | 6 fresh spinach leaves
instructions: In a medium skillet, heat the canola oil over medium heat. Add the rice and cook, stirring, until light golden brown, 2 to 3 minutes. Stir in the zucchini and cook, stirring, 1 minute. Add the mushrooms and 1/2 cup water.

title: Creamy Garlic Beef Hash
ingredients: 1 head garlic | 1/4 cup vegetable oil | 2 jars jar popping popcorn | 1 container of la choy sweet and sour beef spread with soy sauce and garlic | 2 sheets nori | 1 container of la choy sweet and sour beef spread with soy sauce and garlic | 2 cups vegetable oil | 3/4 cup white sugar
instructions: Shred and mince the garlic. Heat up one quart or so of vegetable oil in pot. Add one handful of popcorn and fry for a few seconds, being careful not to burn, until it is golden brown. If it burns, put the lid on and let it steam for a few minutes until all the kernels stick together. Throw it onto a plate. Repeat with remaining bags. If you have one of those handy chop your garlic into small pieces, and lightly fry it in a little hot oil in a skillet over medium high heat in about one cup of the vegetable oil. Add the shredded garlic, and shake the skillet so all the garlic gets a coating of oil out of that.

Random Ingredients: bouquet garni,vanilla,chive,baking powder,banana,liquid smoke,plum tomato,lemon peel
title: Lemon and Chive Fritters
ingredients: 1 medium ripe banana, cut crosswise into 1-inch wide strips | lemon peel ( optional ) | 3 tablespoons coarsely chopped fresh chives | 1 teaspoon baking powder, plus extra for sprinkling ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon pure vanilla | 1 teaspoon cherries ( optional ) or 1 jigger lemon juice | 1 teaspoon liquid smoke | 10 plum tomatoes or 10 roma tomatoes, cut into wedges
instructions: Cut banana crosswise into 1 wide strips and place in a bowl. Peel lemon peel and then cut strips in half crosswise through the middle, lengthwise about 1/2 inch thick and set aside. Cut chives into 3 thin slices then set aside with banana. In a small bowl, combine baking powder, vanilla, lemon peel and chives with lemon juice, liquid smoke and plums. Add to banana mixture and stir just until mixed. Refrigerate any remaining fruit and/or juices for at least 30 minutes and up to 3 hours. Serve with flour tortillas, if desired. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: beef tenderloin fillet,almond extract,potato starch,extra virgin olive oil,ancho chili
title: Grilled Beef Tenderloin With Ancho Chili
ingredients: 6 tablespoons potato starch | 6 lbs top sirloin steaks or 6 lbs beef tenderloin fillets | 1 large ancho chili, seeded and stemmed, finely chopped ( about 2 tablespoons ) | 1/4 teaspoon almond extract | extra virgin olive oil, as needed
instructions: Make the achiote mixture by combining the potato starch and 1/2 cup water in a bowl.

title: Reubens-Baked Sauerkraut
ingredients: 2 lbs sauerkraut | 1/4 cup light vegetable broth | 1/2 celery rib, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons ketchup | 1 teaspoon coriander seed
instructions: Rinse, drain and set aside sauerkraut and place in a roasting pan, sprinkle with vegetable broth mixture and roast in a 350 degree oven for 1 hour. Combine ketchup and coriander in a small bowl. Combine with ketchup mixture and stir well. Reubens bake, uncovered for 15 minutes or until slightly softened.

title: Smoked Salmon With Chocolate-Spinach Dip (Chilean Meets Tahini Nut Dip) (Vegetarian)
ingredients: 1/4 cup tahini | 2 tablespoons cayenne powder | 1 package frozen spinach leaves, thawed and roughly chopped | 1/2 cup chocohua tahini ( or other soy-flavored lite dip ) | 4 6 ounces smoked salmon fillets or 4 ounces salmon steaks, thinly sliced | 1 package tortilla chips
instructions: Preheat broiler. To make the sauce, in a medium bowl, whisk together the tahini, 1/4 cup water, and 4 tablespoons grated cheese. Add the chocohua.

Random Ingredients: red chile,red curry paste,allspice,raisin,wheat flour,red bell pepper,allspice berry
title: Roasted Red Pepper Chilies and Raisins
ingredients: 2 tablespoons whole wheat flour | 1/2 teaspoon ground allspice | 1/4 teaspoon hot red curry paste | 1/4 teaspoon ground black red chile | 1/8 teaspoon ground allspice berry | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon ground red chile | 1 1/2 tablespoons raisins | 2 tablespoons finely chopped red bell peppers
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f coat a roasting pan with cooking spray. Combine flour, allspice and salt in a medium bowl and stir in curry paste. Add ground chilies, allspice, chile, raisins and red bell peppers and mix well. Spread into roasting pan and roast until tops turn golden brown.

Random Ingredients: chili paste,guacamole,cayenne,plain yogurt,daikon radish,beef cap,beef chuck,garlic clove
title: Asian Beef Gyros
ingredients: 1 lb lean beef chuck | 1 lb daikon radish ( grated, unpeeled ) | 4 garlic cloves, minced | 4 tablespoons chili paste ( sriracha recommended ) | 1 teaspoon cayenne ( to taste ) | 1 cup plain yogurt | 1 -2 tablespoon guacamole | 4 beef capes, drained
instructions: In a bowl, combine beef chuck, daikon radish, garlic, chili paste, cayenne, half the yogurt, guacamole and beef capes. Stir gently to combine and marinate meat overnight, or at least 8 hours, covered. The next day, preheat broiler. Place in a covered baking dish and broil about 10 minutes or until meat is medium rare. Serve with the remaining yogurt, guacamole and remaining guacamole.

title: Portuguese Pickled Herbs
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs fresh coriander leaves, finely chopped | 1 -2 cup green onion, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons capers, finely chopped, if desired | 1 teaspoon mustard powder | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon | 1 teaspoon mustard powder
instructions: Mix all ingredients together with clean hands.

title: Creamy Fettuccine With Oyster Sauce
ingredients: 500 g dry fettuccine pasta | 2 tablespoons oyster, drained | 2 tablespoons low-fat yogurt
instructions: Cook the fettuccine following the packet instructions until al dente. Rinse with cold water until any grit is released. Drain and place in a large bowl. With one teaspoon of oyster sauce, add one cup of yogurt and mix until creamy. Pour onto drained cooked fettuccine and mix. Tip, if the noodles are being served as a side with salad or chicken add a small amount of oil to the yogurt before adding in step 1.

title: Chinese Hot Slaw
ingredients: 1 medium chinese cabbage, cored and shredded | 1/2 cup lightly packed fresh watercress | 1/4 cup water | 1 hard-cooked hoagie, cut into 1-inch slices ( you can buy this also in the produce section of the grocery store )
instructions: Place cabbage, watercress and sliced hoagie bread on a microwave safe surface and heat on high for 2 - 3 minutes, or until hot. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: frito corn chip,pineapple preserve,italian tomato,lamb meat
title: The Singing Cricket: the Singing Cricket Stampede With Lamb
ingredients: 1 cup frito corn chips, crushed | 1 can italian stewed tomatoes | 1 1/2 kg lamb stew meat | 2 tablespoons unsweetened pineapple preserves
instructions: Mix together the crushed frito and stewed tomatoes. Cut the lamb into cubes about 1 x 3/4 x 2, then rub into the mixture. Cover and refrigerate for 24hrs to develop the flavor. Preheat the oven to 300f and line 1 baking tray with foil, spray with oil and line the foil with the foil to keep it from burning. Place into the oven and bake for about a 1 2hrs or until the lamb is cooked, stirring every 10 15mins to ensure the lamb is well coated with the sauce. To serve, arrange shredded lamb over a mound of frito and drizzle with pineapples.

Random Ingredients: button mushroom,olive oil cooking spray,extra beef,golden syrup,sambal oelek chili paste
title: Sambal-Pepper Burgers
ingredients: 1 lb extra lean ground beef | 20 button mushrooms, finely chopped | olive oil flavored cooking spray | 2 tablespoons sambal oelek chili paste ( also called thai chili paste ) | 1/2 cup golden syrup ( or brown sugar or maple syrup )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f, lightly spray a baking sheet generously with olive oil spray. In a bowl, combine beef, mushrooms, sambal olek and corn syrup. Mix well. Shape into 4 burgers. Cook on the prepared pan, brushing with any remaining oil and topping with the sambal paste.

title: Pepper Sauce Chocolate Cream Fudge Sundae
ingredients: 3 cups water | 1 pound milk chocolate squares | 1/2 cup vegetable shortening | 3 teaspoons hot pepper sauce | 1/3 cup sour cream
instructions: Pour the water into a medium saucepan over medium high heat. Stir in the milk chocolate squares in a bowl using a rubber spatula to melt. Remove from the heat once the chocolate has melted. Remove half of the milk chocolate from the bowl and place in a large bowl. With a mixer, blend in the shortening. Add hot pepper sauce and sour cream and blend until smooth. Stir in the remaining milk chocolate and return to a medium heat. Stir until chocolate is melted. Transfer to a bowl and refrigerate until it coats the back of a spoon. Stir well before serving.

Random Ingredients: white onion,yellow pepper,beef bouillon granule,lemon juice zest
title: Lemon and Onion Soup
ingredients: 3 lbs white onions | 4 yellow peppers ( or a yellow pepper ) | 2 teaspoons lemon juice and zest of, grated | 1 tablespoon beef bouillon granules
instructions: Peel and slice the onions. Dice the peppers. Place in a 6 quart pan. Sprinkle with lemon zest. Add water to cover. Cover the pan and simmer over low heat for 45 minutes to 1 hour. Remove the soup base from heat. In a blender, puree the soup into a smooth puree. Add lemon juice. Chill before serving. I prefer to use a hand held blender to make the soup. If using a hand held blender, transfer soup to a saucepan and heat through.

title: Kiwi Dips
ingredients: 1 can condensed french onion soup | 1 kiwi fruits, peeled and sliced | 1/2 cup nuts, chopped
instructions: Drain soup and mix in kiwifruit and nuts. Serve chilled with bread crackers.

title: Haitian Spicy Meat & Shrimp Tacos
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sunflower oil | 1 australian australian leg of lamb, cut into four equal pieces | 8 ounces uncooked medium shrimp, peeled and deveined | 6 corn tortillas, heated | 2 tablespoons toasted chopped pistachios, for garnishing ( optional ) | guacamole ( optional )
instructions: Heat the oil in a frying pan over medium heat. Season the lamb with salt and pepper and cook for about 15 minutes, or until golden brown all over. Turn the meat over. Stir in the shrimp. Drain any excessive fat, then cook for about 10 minutes or until the shrimp start to turn pink. Spread a warmed tortilla with a little guacamole and smear a little sunflower oil on top. Add the lamb, cheese and pistachios and serve immediately.

title: Ajiaco
ingredients: 2 bags arlong noodles | 1/2 lb linguine | 6 ounces cream cheese, firm | 3 tablespoons soy sauce | 1/8 cup rum, preferably calvados | chopped pear ( optional ) | 1/2 cup currants | 1/4 cup chinese noodles
instructions: Bring 4 of salted water to a boil.

title: Sausages in Spicy Sausage
ingredients: 3/4 cup honey | 1/2 cup white sugar | 1/4 cup pitted black olives, chopped | 12 cherry rolls, split | 1 pound sweet pork sausage
instructions: In a small saucepan, melt honey over medium low heat. Stir in olives, and simmer until liquid is absorbed. Slightly flatten sausage out into bite sized, bite sized pieces. Arrange sausage onto a serving platter. Pour honey sauce over, and sprinkle with sugar to taste.

title: Chicken with Yellow Squash
ingredients: 8 chicken wings, tips discarded | 8 stalks yellow squash, cut into pieces
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Mix chicken wings, yellow squash, and remaining marinade together in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Bake in the preheated oven until bread is golden brown and chicken is no longer translucent, 45 minutes to 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: white fish fillet,ricotta cheese,rosemary,anaheim chile pepper
title: Cannelloni with Rosemary and Chiles
ingredients: 2 white fish fillets, cubed | 1/3 cup ricotta cheese | 2 -3 chiles anaheim chile peppers, diced, or to taste | 1 sprig fresh rosemary, or to taste
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Place the fish cubes in the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish. Sprinkle the fish with ricotta cheese. Add the chiles and rosemary. Bake in the preheated oven until the cheese is bubbling and the fish is soft, about 20 minutes.

title: Jicama Stuffed With Bacon, Beef and Jicama - Tyler Florence
ingredients: 16 slices bacon | 32 ounces beef eye round | 2 lbs jicama - peeled, seeded and cut into 4 strips | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place bacon in a large oven safe skillet or dutch oven. Cook over medium high heat until evenly brown. Remove bacon and drain on paper towels. Place beef eye of round on bacon and pat down with the bacon fat to absorb the fat. Slice beef into 4 strips. Place on a large plate. Rub jicama with vanilla. Wrap 2 strips around the slice of beef and secure ends with a toothpick. Place the beef on top of bacon. Bake in the preheated oven until beef is browned, and the jicama is softened, about 30 minutes.

title: Baked Chimichangas
ingredients: 4 -6 flour tortillas | 1 can mexican cheese or ( 6 ounce ) can mild cheddar cheese, grated | 1 lb ground chuck | 1 teaspoon cinnamon | 1 teaspoon hot sauce | 1/2 teaspoon amaretto or 1/2 teaspoon amaretto
instructions: Brown ground beef and drain. Layer hamburger, cheese, cinnamon, and hot sauce in a 13 x9 baking dish. Heat oven to 400 degrees. Sprinkle top with amaretto and bake at 400 degrees covered for 35 - 40 minutes, or until bubbly and cheese has melted and is starting to turn golden. Serve in warmed tortillas with lettuce, olives, sour cream, tomatoes, etc.

title: Homemade Fudgy Rolls
ingredients: 4 lbs suet | 4 lbs fresh mint leaves
instructions: In this way, you will be able to roll out the dough in small batches. To roll out the dough, begin with one batch and continue until all the dough has been used. Do not roll out all the dough. You may use a rolling pin if it is too hard or if you have to stretch the dough a little. Roll out the dough into thin, straight sheets. Cut dough into about 15 roll each about 1/4 inch to 1/8 inch slices using a very sharp knife. You now have ready to roll and stretch the slices of dough until all you have done is one batch of rolls. Lay slices flat on a rack and let sit for a few hours until all the rolls have gone completely dry. This step is optional and is not necessary. After the first hour, cut each slice into thirds. These should have about 8 pieces. Keep going until you have used all the dough this way. After the second hour and hour, let the rolls sit for 15 minutes. Preheat oven to 350°f. Grease the cookie sheet with pam first. Place the breads on the cookie sheet. Sprinkle with salt, pepper, and confectioners' sugar. Bake in the oven for 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: onion powder,beef bouillon cube,kaffir lime leaf,saffron strand,chili sauce,serrano pepper,baby spinach,hazelnut
title: Cousin Pete's Spicy Beef
ingredients: 1/3 cup saffron strand ( the lebanese equivalent of 3-4 saffron strands ) or 1/3 cup ground almonds | 3 tablespoons chili sauce or 3 tablespoons chili paste | 1 beef bouillon cube, plus 1 tablespoon bouillon ( or 2 tablespoons instant bouillon ) | 5 kaffir lime leaves, chopped ( or 3-4 large limes ) or 5 small lime leaves, torn into pieces ( or 3-4 large lime leaves ) | 1 onion powder | 4 ounces baby spinach ( fresh, or frozen, or a combination ) | 1/3 cup hazelnuts ( or more... or other nuts of your choice )
instructions: Soak the saffron in 1/3 cup of hot water for about two hours. Stir and scrape the pieces of cinnamon, lime leaves, or lime peel with your fingers into the saffron liquid until it is crumbled. Add a little of the chili sauce or chili paste. Add the remaining chili sauce or chili paste and a bouillon or 5 - 7 bouillon cubes. Heat over a brisk flame until the liquid has reduced completely. Do not boil, as soon as the surface of the liquid evaporates, it will scorch. Turn a high flame and add 1 pkg of chopped spinach or baby spinach leaves, then cook, stirring with a wooden spoon so that it wilts and starts to turn brown, until spinach is tender. Drain the spinach well. Add more chili sauce or chili paste if you like a smoother consistency. Add the kaffir lime leaves or lime peel, and chop up the hazelnuts or other nuts of your choice. Stir until you have a smooth and creamy filling. Variation, when adding nuts of your choice or spinach leaves, stir constantly after adding the rest of the sauce or chili paste. Add the saffron and almonds, while you are using the stock for the beef.

Random Ingredients: white mushroom,sun tomato paste,green cardamom pod
title: Sun-Dried Tomato Mushrooms
ingredients: 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato paste, sun-dried tomatoes ( not oil packed ) | 1 green cardamom pod, finely crushed ( optional ) | 8 ounces white mushrooms, cleaned
instructions: Pour sun dried tomatoes into a large shallow saucepan add the cardamon pods and cover. Leave to stand for about 10 mins so as not to burn. Stir fry over medium heat until the color turns to a light reddish brown and the oil rises. Meanwhile, cut the mushrooms into 1/2 inch thick slices and place into a pan of rapidly boiling water. Cook for about 10 mins to seal the mushrooms, stirring once or twice. Remove from the pan with a slotted spoon and set aside to drain slightly. Toss the mushrooms with the sun dried tomato paste and serve.

Random Ingredients: thai chili sauce,chili pepper flake,ricotta cheese,black cardamom pod
title: Spicy Ricotta Dip Spread
ingredients: 500 g ricotta cheese | 2 tablespoons thai sweet chili sauce | 2 black cardamom pods | 1 pinch dried chili pepper flakes, can also use fresh chili de arbol chili peppers
instructions: In a medium sized serving bowl add the ricotta cheese and stir well. Chili sauce is a good choice. Add black cardamom pods, chili pepper flakes, and if desired dried chili pepper flakes. Taste and adjust seasoning, if necessary. Serve chilled or warm.

title: Easy Jalapeno Jelly
ingredients: 2 tablespoons hot pickled jalapenos ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon light corn syrup | 1/2 teaspoon sea salt | unsweetened cocoa/confectioners'sugar for dusting
instructions: Rinse and drain the jalapenos very well. Add all ingredients and mix well. Wearing rubber gloves, rub mixture into 1 cup confectioners' sugar. Allow the jalapenos to sit for 1 hour before attempting to eat, to help loosen the jelly. You may use a toothpick or sharp knife to get rid of air bubbles.

Random Ingredients: salmon steak,chili powder,chili sauce,chili pepper flake,eggplant
title: Grilled Baby Eggplant (Aubergine) With Chilli Sauce
ingredients: 2 eggplants, lengthwise and sliced crosswise | 200 g salmon steaks | 2 tablespoons chili sauce | 1 tablespoon sweet chili pepper flakes | 1 pinch chili powder
instructions: Brush slices of fish with a little water. Sprinkle with a little chili sauce. Brush capsicum with chilli sauce over fish and grill until the fish flakes easily. Cut the fish into slices and serve with sauce.

Random Ingredients: oriental flavor ramen noodle,iceberg lettuce,methi leaf,red chili pepper
title: Asian Noodles and Chilies
ingredients: 5 -6 cups iceberg lettuce ( or use leafy green cabbage ) | 1 red chili pepper, thinly sliced ( or 1 green chili, thinly sliced ) | 4 -5 tablespoons oriental-flavor instant ramen noodles or 4 -5 tablespoons other oriental-flavor instant ramen noodles | 1/2 - 3/4 - 1 cup minced fresh methi leaves ( available at asian market or asian market-style stockers )
instructions: Note, if using dried ramen noodles, use less seasoning packet, if desired. If using fresh melon slices or green chili slices, slice into thin pieces, lengthwise. Using chile slices, slice into thin pieces. Set aside. Separate lettuce leaves and shred or tear into bite size pieces. Drain water and divide among 4 serving bowls. Top with chili slices, noodles, and garnish with a fresh leaf of methi leaves or a few mint leaves, if desired.

title: Anu's Cherry Balls
ingredients: 12 cherries, pitted and cut in half | 8 ounces andouille sausages, cut in half ( sweet is best ) | 1/4 cup all-purpose flour | 3 tablespoons icing sugar | 1 1/2 teaspoons rum flavoring | 1 cup mayonnaise | 1/2 teaspoon rum flavoring | 1 cup icing sugar | crushed ice
instructions: Mix flour, icing sugar, rum flavoring and mayonnaise together in a bowl. Add cherry halves and mix with hands. The cherries should not have any bits of cherried on them. If you have a fancy bag, make your own icing sugar, and if you don't have a fancy bag, just mix all together and roll teaspoon fulls of icing sugar into small balls. Roll balls in crushed ice. Place the balls on a pan so the ice doesn't melt the balls, and cook slowly on the middle rack on the stove with a tight lid until they start to soften, then flip and cook for a few more minutes.

title: Tequila & Chive-Lassi
ingredients: 2 cups watermelon, juice of | 2 tablespoons chives, thinly sliced | 1 tablespoon light tequila ( or other semi-sweet orange liqueur ) | 1/2 cup low-fat yogurt
instructions: Place watermelon juice, chives, and tequila in a blender. Cover, and blend until smooth. Top with yogurt and blend until smooth and creamy.

Random Ingredients: salt pepper,red currant jelly,cilantro leaf,radish,vanilla bean,crabmeat
title: Crab Cakes III
ingredients: 1 pound fresh crabmeat, picked clean and picked clean | 1/2 cup red currant jelly | 1/2 cup fresh cilantro leaves | 1/2 vanilla bean, split | 4 large radishes, sliced into thin rounds | salt and pepper to taste
instructions: Place the crabmeat, currant jelly, cilantro, and vanilla bean in a large jar with a tight fitting lid. Seal the jar, and shake until the mixture is well mixed. Add in the radishes, seasonings, and a pinch of salt and pepper, if desired. Cover the jar, and shake until evenly mixed. Serve over cooked brown rice, or as a snack with raw vegetables.

Random Ingredients: red potato,pea carrot,chili oil,mint leaf,golden raisin,shrimp
title: Cantonese Style Potatoes & Shrimps
ingredients: 6 red potatoes, halved and sliced | 3 lbs medium shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1 cup frozen peas and carrots, thawed | 8 mint leaves, sliced | 1 cup golden raisin | 2 tablespoons good chili oil
instructions: Place the potatoes in a large pot of lightly salted boiling water. Boil until tender, approximately 7 - 10 minutes. Drain, rinse under cold water and drain again. Add the shrimp to the potatoes. Stir well, breaking up the clumps and mashing the shrimp with a fork. Add the peas, carrots, mint and raisins and stir well. Heat the red chili oil in a small skillet until hot. Add the mixture and cook over medium high heat until the mixture is bubbly. Serve hot.

title: Ginger Biscuit Snack
ingredients: 1 can refrigerated biscuits | 1 inch grated ginger root | 2 whole serrano chilies, or to taste ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Place the biscuits in a baking dish, and prick holes in the top with a fork. Bake for 7 minutes in the preheated oven. Remove from the oven, and set aside. Toast the ginger in a small skillet over medium heat until fragrant, about 1 minute. Use a slotted spoon to remove ginger, and transfer ginger to a bowl. Cook and stir serrano chiles in the reserved ginger drippings until tender, 5 to 10 minutes. Stir the ginger chile oil into the hot biscuit crumbs. When the biscuits are cool enough to handle, dip 1 biscuit in the hot oil, and press it into the crumbs. Repeat the coating process with remaining biscuit. Arrange the biscuits in a single layer on a baking sheet. Bake for 5 minutes in the preheated oven, then remove from baking sheet. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: chocolate syrup,flour tortilla,ice cube,chow mein noodle,black bean,tahini,oil black olive,rose petal
title: Black Bean Chimichangas
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons oil ( from canola or other cooking oil ) | 1 - 1 1/4 lb pre-cooked black beans, rinsed and drained | 1/4 cup tahini | 1/4 cup chocolate syrup | 6 -8 large flour tortillas | 5 -6 cups sliced ice cubes | 3/4 cup shredded chocolate piece | 1/4 cup sliced black olives ( such as kimchee, kamaboko or other black olives ) or 1/4 cup capers ( such as kimchee, kamaboko or other black olives )
instructions: Preparation, if using a can of black beans, do ahead, set aside to drain while preparing for use. Dressing, in a food processor, add the beans and next 6 ingredients and pulse to combine. With the machine running, pour the dressing through the fine mesh sieve over a large salad bowl or bowl, pressing down hard and evenly to remove excess moisture. Serve with tortillas, refried beans and more sauce, if desired. Cooking, preheat a cast iron skillet or outdoor grill pan over medium high heat. When it is very hot and lightly browned, put in about 1/2 cup of the topping mix. It won't take very long to brown, but it will likely begin to take less than one minute. Transfer the hot oil to a paper lined plate. When the fat is smoking, put 3 or 4 tbls. Of filling over one side of a tortilla. Roll up and use tongs to flatten into a circle, about 3/4 inch thick. The thinner your tortilla and less filling will be, the easier it will be. Cook, if using a cast iron skillet, heat until it is very hot before turning. Remove from heat and cut into 3 or 4 inch segments, then fry until golden brown. Serve with black beans and dipping sauce.

Random Ingredients: bamboo shoot,vegetable stock,spaghetti sauce,lemon juice,potato,corn niblets,lard,pork loin chop
title: Potato, Pork and Sweet Potato Noodle Soup With Fresh Veggies
ingredients: 1 tablespoon lard | 6 boneless pork loin chops, cut into 1 x 1/4-inch cubes | 3 cups sweet potatoes, cut into 1 x 1/4-inch sticks | 6 cups vegetable stock | 1 can bamboo shoots, drained and cut into 1/2-inch strips | 1 teaspoon lemon juice | 1 cup prepared spaghetti sauce | 7 cups hot cooked spaghetti pasta and vegetables, such as ditsoi
instructions: In a 12 inch nonstick skillet, melt the lard over medium high heat until just smoking. Add the pork and cook, stirring frequently, for 10 minutes or until it is lightly browned. Add the sweet potatoes, stock, bamboo strips, lemon juice and noodles.

Random Ingredients: sesame seed,turkey bacon,dark beer,basil,plain flour,shallot,coleslaw mix
title: Soy Slaw
ingredients: 1/2 cup dark beer | 2 tablespoons plain flour | 1 tablespoon dried basil or 2 tablespoons cilantro | 1 shallot, finely diced | 3 slices turkey bacon or 3 pieces bacon, chopped | 3 ounces coleslaw mix | 1 tablespoon toasted sesame seeds
instructions: Place dark beer, flour, dried basil or cilantro, finely diced shallot and turkey or bacon in a jug or bowl with a lid and stir to combine. Cover and leave to stand for 15 minutes. Stir again and then stir again. Taste and add more seasoning. Add the coleslaw mix as desired.

title: Chili Relish
ingredients: 2 teaspoons cornstarch | 1 large shallot, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon chili paste | 1/3 cup prepared horseradish
instructions: Combine cornstarch and shallot. Add chili paste and stir to blend.

title: Crunchy Cauliflower
ingredients: 1 small head cauliflower | 1 medium head cauliflower | 3 tablespoons lemon advieh ( hebrew ) | 3 tablespoons whipping cream | 2 -3 tablespoons sour cream
instructions: Make sure the cauliflower is completely trimmed of any excess water. Slice the cauliflower into florets that are no more than 3/4 thick but not more than 1/4. Bring a small pot of water to a boil, add the cauliflower and cook for about 5 - 6 minutes. Drain and set aside to cool. Remove the cauliflower from the pot of water and place in a large bowl. Cover with cold water and set aside for 5 - 10 minutes. Drain, and set aside. Meanwhile, heat a frying pan over medium heat. Add 3 tbsp oil to the pan and saute the cauliflower for 8 - 10 minutes. Remove and set aside. In a bowl, mix the lemon advieh, whipping cream and sour cream until well mixed. Cut the cauliflower into small florets. Add to the frying pan and cook over medium heat for 10 - 15 minutes, or until cauliflower is tender but the cauliflower does not overcook. Serve in a shallow bowl with some of the cauliflower alongside.

Random Ingredients: green bean,baking potato,celery salt,pomegranate seed,mushroom stem,egg noodle
title: Dairy Noodles
ingredients: 2 cups pomegranate seeds | 4 baking potatoes, peeled and chopped | 12 ounces fresh mushrooms, sliced | 1/4 cup celery salt | 2 teaspoons baking powder | 1 package egg noodles | 1 cup fresh green beans, chopped
instructions: Place pomegranate seeds, potatoes, mushrooms, celery salt, cayenne pepper and baking powder in a food processor. Process until ingredients are smooth.

Random Ingredients: cumin powder,sea scallop,lime,cornstarch,wheat bread,asparagus,rigatoni pasta,red cabbage
title: Scallops, Asparagus, and Cornstarch Baked in Cumin Crust
ingredients: 1 package rigatoni pasta | sea scallops | 1 can asparagus, drained | 4 ears fresh corn on the cob, shucked, washed, and trimmed | 1 teaspoon cornstarch | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 1 lime, cut into wedges | 1 small red cabbage, shredded
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add asparagus.

Random Ingredients: tomato paste,basmati rice,chorizo sausage,onion,greek yogurt,meat,molasses,grain rice
title: Iraqi Rice Stuffed With Chorizo and Rice
ingredients: 3 cups cooked long-grain rice, and | 2 cups water | 1/4 lb fresh chorizo sausage, casings removed ( about 2 links ) | 1 onion, chopped | 1 can tomato sauce ( see note in introduction ) | 1 ounce tomato paste | greek yogurt ( optional ) | basmati rice or pilaf, for serving ( optional )
instructions: Bring water and rice to a boil in a saucepan over high heat. Stir in chorizo, onion, and tomato sauce. Lower heat and simmer, covered, for 30 minutes. Set the topping aside, and cool completely. Cut a deep slit lengthwise in the rice, and stuff with rice mixture, mashing with the back of a spoon to form an egg shape, if there are any leftover stuffing, fill the gaps with breadcrumbs. Place rice on a baking sheet, and bake in a 400° degree oven, until crispy, about 30 minutes. If desired, top with yogurt.

title: Simple Italian Sausage and Clove (For Dogs)
ingredients: 2 lbs italian sausages | 1 chicken stock cube | seasoned poultry seasoning
instructions: Heat grill and remove casings from the sausages. Drain excess liquid, then tear sausage into large chunks. Sprinkle with poultry seasoning and place in a large roasting tin. Pour any excess fat and juices onto the sausages around the sausages as well. Add a small amount of water to deglaze the pan or grill the sausages for 1 - 2 minutes each side. The sausages should still be moist and a little crisp inside.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack cheddar cheese,manchego cheese,ginger,corn chip
title: Ginger Crunchy Cheese Ball
ingredients: 2 packages chonghir cheese | 1/2 - 1 lb manchego cheese, grated | 1 tablespoon fresh ginger, grated | 2 cups crushed corn chips, divided
instructions: Mix the cheeses, ginger, and 1 cup crushed corn chips together. Use 2 tablespoons crushed corn chips for each ball. Spoon into a parchment lined 9x9 baking pan, allowing 3/4 cup of crushed corn chips to form in between the eyes when you press them slightly. Use remaining crushed corn chips as a crumb topping for final dessert.

title: Arugula Pesto Bread Wedges
ingredients: 1/2 loaf whole wheat bread, cut into 1 inch wide wedges | 2 cups mayonnaise | 1/2 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt | 1 cup orange-flavored mayonnaise | 1 1/2 cups pineapple juice | 2 cups arugula, stems trimmed
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees f. Spread each wedge of bread with 1/2 cup mayonnaise. Sprinkle nutmeg on each wedge and cover with a towel to prevent drying. Spread both sides of the buttered bread with 1/2 cup mayonnaise. Arrange 1/2 cup orange and 2 tablespoons mayonnaise on the bread. Spread pineapple juice evenly over the bread. Arrange 1/4 cup arugula on top and sprinkle generously with remaining nuts. Spread a light coating of olive oil on one side of each wedge and arrange on a foil lined baking sheet. Bake 10 to 15 minutes, until bread is golden and bubbly.

title: Garden Fresh Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 pound green tomatoes, cut into 1-inch wedges | 1 kosher salt, or as needed
instructions: Cook tomatoes in boiling salt water until soft, about 15 minutes. Place onto a plate lined with a baking sheet to allow excess water to drain. Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Sprinkle tomatoes with half of the kosher salt. Bake in the preheated oven until the tops are golden, 7 to 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: french onion,plain yogurt,quinoa,asafoetida powder,chicken broth,ra el hanout spice mix,corn tortilla chip
title: Asafetida (Wedding Balls in Chicken Noodle Soup)
ingredients: 3 1/2 - 4 cups cooked quinoa | 1 can low-sodium low-fat chicken broth | 1/8 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 2 teaspoons ras el hanout spice mix | 16 slices french-fried onions | 3 cups plain yogurt | corn tortilla chips or chelotte chips
instructions: Stir together the quinoa and broth in a dutch oven. Cover and bring to a boil over medium high heat. Reduce heat, and simmer until the broth and quinoa are tender, about 20 to 25 minutes. Remove from the heat and stir in the asafetida. Stir in the ras el hanout and divide the quinoa mixture among six soup bowls. Top with the fried onions, and sprinkle with toasted croutons. Serve immediately.

title: Mint Sauce
ingredients: 6 -8 garlic cloves | 2 cups tomato sauce | mint
instructions: Clean mint leaves, cut off roots, remove pips, chop up finely, place mint in mortar& crush with pestle add all ingredients to saucepan bring to boil simmer till desired thickness. Use for mint chutney, in bikkies, in sandwiches, or add to meat for a complete meal.

Random Ingredients: garlic,ladyfinger,green olive,red enchilada sauce,celery leaf,habanero pepper,white bread
title: Easy Enchilada Bread Salad
ingredients: 6 slices white bread, crusts removed | 1 cup red enchilada sauce | 1 tablespoon light garlic, minced | 1/4 cup green olives, chopped | 4 stalks celery & leaves, chopped | 1 tablespoon habanero pepper, finely chopped | 1/4 cup crushed soft ladyfingers ( optional )
