instructions: In a large bowl, combine bread, enchilada sauce, garlic, scallions, celery, and habanero. Toss lightly with your fingers to combine. Add some of the crushed lady fingers and toss. Sprinkle with more crushed ladyfingers if desired.

Random Ingredients: pork fillet,kielbasa,mustard powder,matzo meal,chocolate,coconut milk,mayonnaise,kosher salt
title: Passover Crusted Pork, Irish Cakes, and Chips
ingredients: 6 pounds pork fillets | 1 tablespoon mustard powder | 1 teaspoon kosher salt | 4 ounces chocolate, melted | 1/4 cup mayonnaise | 2 tablespoons coconut milk | 4 matzo meal | 6 squares kahelbasa, cut into 1-inch long sticks
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Bake pork on a rack in a pan on the middle rack of oven until browned, about 15 minutes. Drain and let cool. Rub meat with mustard and salt, then set aside. In a large bowl, stir together chocolate, mayonnaise, coconut milk, and matzo meal. Slice kielbasa sticks into 1/4 inch thick rounds. Lay one piece of kielbasa diagonally on a work surface. Lift the ends of the kielbasa. Pull down the ends of the kielbasa to keep from curling, then slice the slices to make 12 chips. Repeat until all kielbasa is used, placing a pile of chips on the bottom of a baking dish. Brush each piece of chip with mustard and salt. Cover with aluminum foil, then bake in the preheated oven until chips are golden brown and crispy, 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Beef Stuffed Whole Banana Leaves
ingredients: 8 large firm ripe bananas | 2 lbs stewing beef ( i use about 2-3 pounds, but up to 2 lbs can be used ) or 2 lbs topside stewing beef ( i use about 2-3 pounds, but up to 2 pounds can be used ) | 1 1/3 cups quinoa | 2 -4 stalks red cabbage, halved ( depending on size of leaves ) | 1/3 cup finely diced fresh chives | 2/3 cup sliced dates, such as medjool ( about 15 ounces ) | 1/4 cup italian salad dressing | 3 tablespoons pickled chives
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Tear off top 1 inch off of each banana. Carefully, split each half into three equal halves depending on size of leaf. Toss cut sides together. Fill the centers of each banana half with 1 3/4 to 3/4 pounds of stew and top with sliced cabbage and chives. Combine italian salad dressing and chives. Evenly fill each half with 1 1/2 tablespoons the vinaigrette and 1/2 tablespoons of the salad dressing mixture. Place stuffed bananas on a baking sheet and bake in a hot oven for 15 to 20 minutes, or until fork tender.

title: Split Lentil and Beet Soup
ingredients: 400 g split lentils | 400 g mung bean sprouts | 4 raw beets | 3 -4 cloves garlic paste | 1 liter whole milk | 1 -2 tablespoon of thick indian curry prepared mustard ( we use adrak )
instructions: Boil lentils and mung bean sprouts together for around 45 minutes or until lentils and lentils are tender. Meanwhile heat a little oil in saucepan and fry garlic paste and beet for about 5 minutes. Add split peas and stir into paste. Add milk until it covers all the ingredients. Cover the pan and simmer for 15 minutes. Serve with curry prepared mustard and a pinch of crushed red pepper flakes. Delicious.

Random Ingredients: sweetcorn,rigatoni pasta,green chile pepper,hazelnut,sage,chicken wing,baharat,plain yogurt
title: Baked Chicken Pasta
ingredients: 4 1/2 pounds chicken wings | 1/2 cup plain yogurt | 2/3 cup hazelnuts, chopped | 3 green chile peppers, finely chopped | 2 links fresh sage | 16 ounces rigatoni pasta | 1 can sweetcorn, drained | 2 tablespoons ground hot pepper flakes for topping, or to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Place chicken wings in a 9x13 inch baking dish. In a medium bowl, stir together the yogurt and hazelnuts. Spread on the chicken wings. Bake in preheated oven until the chicken is no longer pink in the center and juices run clear, about 30 minutes. Meanwhile, bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add pasta and cook for 10 to 12 minutes or until al dente.

Random Ingredients: oatmeal,poblano pepper,salt,jalapeno,panko bread crumb,oregano,italian dressing,vanilla sugar
title: Savory Oatcakes
ingredients: 3/4 cup oatmeal | 1/4 cup panko bread crumbs or 1/4 cup regular-style bread crumbs | 2 tablespoons italian dressing | 1 -2 teaspoon oregano | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla sugar ( optional ) | 1 -2 teaspoon minced jalapeno ( optional ) | 1 red anaheim or green bell pepper, chopped
instructions: Combine the oatmeal, panko, dressing, oregano, salt, vanilla, jalapeno and optional jalapenos.

Random Ingredients: chicken leg,english muffin,pork loin roast,philadelphia cream cheese,lemon pepper,cream chicken soup
title: Pork Chicken Melt
ingredients: 2 english muffins, split and toasted | 2 pork loin roast | 1 ounce cream of chicken soup | 1 ounce cream style chicken soup | 2 teaspoons lemon pepper | 1 1/2 lbs boneless chicken legs
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Insert sharp knife into the top of each bread split. Combine first four ingredients in a medium bowl, then add chicken legs and gently stir to coat chicken with dressing mixture. Place chicken in a shallow baking dish and cover with remaining dressing mixture. Bake in the preheated oven 20 minutes. Remove from oven and allow to stand five minutes.

title: Bleu Cheese Spread
ingredients: 100 g blue cheese | 1 green cardamoms, whole | 5 green cardamoms, crushed | 1 tablespoon cumin | 1 tablespoon white pepper | 1 teaspoon pepper
instructions: Remove gildes from the cheese with a sharp knife. Chop in desired size and keep in aside for upto 3 months. Dice the cheese into finely chunks. Take a deep curved pan. Heat on slow flame. Add in the cheese. Keep stirring over low flame till the cheese melts in the pan. Mix in all the ingredients and leave it on high flame for about a minute. Remove from flame. Serve immediately with thick breads. Enjoy.

title: Seared Pineapple With Tarragon Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 2 -3 pineapple slices | 2 teaspoons fresh tarragon vinegar | 1 teaspoon hot sauce | 1 teaspoon ground sesame oil | 2 cups whole wheat pastry flour
instructions: Preheat grill to high. Cut pineapple crosswise into 2 inch slices. Using a large spoon, scrape pulp and seeds into a small bowl. Add vinegar, hot pepper sauce and sesame oil. Stir to blend. Remove pineapple slices and arrange slices in a lightly oiled shallow baking dish. Serve at room temperature. Dipping sauce, toss pineapples with flour in a bowl just to thoroughly moisten, stirring frequently. Can be served chilled.

title: Jamaican Fried Macaroni in Shells
ingredients: 1 jumbo pasta shells | 1/2 tablespoon lard | 2 green cardamom pods, crushed with the blade of a knife
instructions: In a medium saucepan of salted boiling water, cook the shell macaroni 7 to 8 minutes or until al dente.

title: Spinach With Apple and Campari (Stovetop Friendly)
ingredients: 1 spanish onion | 1 golden delicious apple | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning | 4 -5 leaves of fresh baby spinach | 1 container campari
instructions: Heat a large frying pan over medium high heat and add the grated onion and saute until golden brown. Remove, add the tin of campari, and mix well. Slice the apple and add it and the rest of the campari sauce to the pan and mix the mix well. Simmer for 5 minutes. Add the cooked spinach, give it a stir, and cook a further five minutes or until the spinach seems tender. Note, you can add other vegetables, like runner beans, celery, zucchini, or any other veggie you like.

Random Ingredients: beef eye roast,sultana,cucumber,phyllo pastry,provolone cheese,filling,button mushroom,russet potato
title: Phyllo & Beef Roast for Two
ingredients: 1 tablespoon sultana | 1 tablespoon provolone cheese | 1 1/2 lbs beef eye roast | 10 puff phyllo pastry sheets, thawed in the freezer | 1 medium cucumber, peeled, halved lengthwise, and thinly sliced | 2 cups button mushrooms, thinly sliced | 1/2 lb russet potato, coarsely grated | prepared mustard & horseradish sauce ( or )
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees fahrenheit. Pound sultanas with pierce holes on several sides of roast so they can absorb the flavour of the sultana, if desired spread on a baking sheet. Bake roast for 20 minutes, then set aside to cool slightly. Cut each phyllo sheet in half vertically, and cut a large cross lengthwise slice down the length of the roast leaving 1 inch of the length. Unfold phyllo sheets, and place on a work surface.

title: Blueberry Garlic Seasoning for Fries and Crisp Fry
ingredients: 1 cup fresh blueberries ( or frozen and thawed, if frozen ) | 1/2 cup granulated garlic powder | 1/2 teaspoon baking powder
instructions: Place blueberries in a medium bowl. In a small bowl, stir together garlic powder and baking powder with a fork. Pour spice mixture over blueberries and berries, and stir to mix. Scoop out some of the blueberries and stir them into the bowl. Continue cooking blueberry garlic fritters until crispy, or to desired consistency.

Random Ingredients: picante sauce,wheat bread,plum jam,okra,baby potato,chicken bouillon granule,black bean paste,yeast
title: Quick & Easy Okra and Potato Pizza
ingredients: 12 ounces whole wheat bread | 14 ounces baby potatoes, cut into wedges | 1 can black beans in tomato sauce, drained and rinsed | 1 cup picante sauce | 1 teaspoon instant yeast | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon granules | 1/2 tablespoon black bean paste | 2 tablespoons plum jam
instructions: Place bread in a greased bowl and cover with warm water. Let sit for about 20 min, until the bread has absorbed all the water. Place all ingredients in the bowl with the bread and mix well. Then cover with plastic wrap and let rise for about 2 hrs to double in size. Preheat oven to 425 f. Grease two 8 pizza pan or pizza pans. After an hour add crust to pan and bake for 15 - 18 min, or until the crust looks nice and browned.

title: Danish Almond Soup(Sudelsalat)
ingredients: 10 ounces almond paste ( almond paste paste concentrate ) | 7 ounces canned green onions, sliced ( i don't use green onion ) | 1 cup buttermilk | 1/2 cup all-purpose flour ( approximately ) | 4 -6 tablespoons cornflour ( approximately )
instructions: Blend or process almond paste, green onions, buttermilk, flour, and cornflour until the mixture is smooth. Pour into a serving bowl or pot and set aside to cool for about 20 minutes. Chill until ready to use. For vegetarian use only the vegetable broth option of your choice.

title: Nectarine Oven Quesadillas
ingredients: 4 slices ripe fresh nectarines | 4 whole wheat tortillas | 1/4 cup brown sugar | 1/8 teaspoon ground mace
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Place one strip of each tortilla on a baking sheet. Combine the brown sugar, and mace. Brush the outside of the tortilla with the mixture. Top with the remaining tortilla strips and cut into triangles. Repeat with each tortilla. Bake in the preheated oven until tortillas are golden brown, about 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: chicken thigh,rosemary leaf,allspice,jasmine rice,red chili,ricotta cheese
title: Mizeria Ruz - Moroccan Rice Balls
ingredients: 1 lb jasmine rice, raw, well rinsed | 1 lb chicken thigh, well rinsed | 1/2 cup ricotta cheese | 1 small red chili, deveined, seeded if needed | 1 -2 sprig fresh rosemary leaf | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon allspice
instructions: Place the raw rice in the blender with the chicken and ricotta and puree well. Cut the rest of the ingredients in half and stuff each half into the rice. Refrigerate overnight and up to 3 days. Bring to room temperature before serving and bring to room temperature before serving.

Random Ingredients: peanut oil,black olive,bow tie pasta,shallot,lemon zest,active yeast
title: Pasta Salad - No Bread Machine Needed
ingredients: 2 - 2 1/2 cups bow tie pasta ( or whatever pasta works best in your kitchen ) | 4 1/2 cups peanut oil ( or more to the desired depth of oil ) | 1/4 cup chopped shallot | 12 ounces chopped black olives | 1 1/2 tablespoons grated lemon zest | 4 teaspoons active dry yeast
instructions: Add oil and mix well. Dissolve yeast in warm water and add to oil/yeast/water/oil/yeast in a bread machine pan. Select basic/white crust setting. You may use 1 1/4 pound of pasta for less thin crusts. Add other ingredients as desired. For a firmer crust, add 2 1/2 cups pasta sauce..

title: Zesty Crab Pie
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups cooked long-grain rice | 1 tablespoon coarse grain rice or 1 tablespoon brown rice flour | 1 tablespoon cream of tartar | fresh dill weed or fresh chives, finely snipped, to garnish
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Mix the fluff and fluff mixture. Line a 9 inch pie pan or tart pan with crust, spreading the fluff evenly. Spread the rice on top of the fluff & fluff & sprinkle the cream of tartar over it. Sprinkle sparingly with chives or dill if desired. Bake for 30 minutes or until golden brown and bubbly. Serve hot or cold with a fresh fruit or ice cream topping. Note, for even better flavour use white wine. For a spicier dish omit cream of tartar or salt or use fresh dill or chives instead.

title: Bratwurst and Chile
ingredients: 12 bratwursts | 6 small poblano chiles
instructions: Wearing rubber gloves, slit the chilies lengthwise, but keep all the seeds. Soak in warm water for 10 minutes. Drain, and rub the chilies with the chilies. Let stand 30 minutes before cooking.

Random Ingredients: black olive,pecorino romano cheese,malt vinegar,coconut oil
title: Roasted Olive Salad With Pecorino Dressing
ingredients: 7 ounces pecorino romano cheese ( this can be bought in italian specialty stores ) | 2 tablespoons malt vinegar | 15 large pitted black olives or 15 large green olives | 1 tablespoon coconut oil
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a screw top jar. Shake to blend. Let cool until very light. Add more oil to coat salad if required. Serve. Store in refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: sesame seed,fenugreek leaf,port wine,white bread flour,beer,beef gravy,enchilada sauce,ginger
title: Beef Toast: Enchiladas Verde
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs ground beef gravy | 2 tablespoons dry fenugreek leaves ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon dried ginger | 6 slices white bread flour ( crusty ) | 2 cups enchilada sauce ( medium ) | 1/3 cup port wine ( optional ) | 1/3 cup beer | 1 tablespoon sesame seeds
instructions: In a large skillet, cook the ground beef over medium heat, stirring frequently until well drained. Add fenugreek and ginger. Continue cooking a few minutes until mixture is mostly dry. Break up the bread flour and mix into the meat mixture. Add enchilada sauce, port and beer. Mix thoroughly, but lightly for 3 minutes. Sprinkle with sesame seeds. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Spray 2 large baking sheets with nonstick cooking spray. Scoop 3 ladels of mixture into prepared baking sheets. Bake 40 - 45 minutes, or until golden.

title: Guinness, Cashews and Cranberry Orzo
ingredients: 450 g orzo pasta | 175 g cashews | 1/3 cup guinness stout | 1/2 cup dried cranberries
instructions: Cook orzo until tender drain and set aside. Cook cashews in a pan over a medium heat until golden about 5 mins on each side. Serve orzo on a bed of cashew halves topped with the chopped coriander.

title: Blueberry-Lime Jam
ingredients: 14 cups mixed blueberries | 2 tablespoons fresh lime juice
instructions: Mix the blueberries and lime juice together in a large bowl. Pour about 1/4 cup of the juice onto a plate, and roll a few teaspoons of the blueberries into the juice. Allow them to sit out on the plate for a few minutes so that they are plump. Then, take them out and roll into a jar. Repeat with the remaining juice. Once all the blueberries have been used, place the jars in a pot and warm over medium low heat until the juice reduces to about 10 cups.

title: Mexican Green Chile Eggs
ingredients: 4 hard-boiled eggs | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies, drained | 1 teaspoon crushed garlic powder | 1 teaspoon dried mint | 1/2 teaspoon sugar | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne, or to taste | 1/4 cup chopped fresh mint, or to taste ( optional ) | 1/2 cup sweet-sour-sweet calvados
instructions: Cut egg whites until they are a thickness of heavy duty paper, stopping just above the whites. Mash egg yolks in a bowl with a fork until mixture is creamy, using a fork. Stir in tomatoes, garlic powder, mint, sugar, cayenne, and chopped fresh mint. Cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours. Serve chilled.

Random Ingredients: brown rice,parmesan cheese,brussels sprout,self rising flour,enchilada sauce,green
title: Quick, Easy, and Delicious Enchilada Bread
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked brown rice | 2 tablespoons self-rising flour | 2 cups frozen brussels sprouts, thawed and sliced into thin half moons | 2 cans enchilada sauce ( i make my own ) | 1/4 cup shredded parmesan cheese | 2 tablespoons chopped green onions
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit. Spray a 9 by 5 loaf pan with nonstick cooking spray. Pour the rice out onto a clean surface. Sprinkle half the flour evenly over the rice and gently press with the back of a spoon to evenly coat the surface. Place the sprouts onto the bottom of the pan. Pour the enchilada sauce over them. Sprinkle with parmesan cheese and green onions. Cover with the top piece of bread, trimming the edges to fit if necessary. Try to leave enough space in the bread to allow for the liquid to be absorbed evenly. Bake for 30 to 35 minutes, until the bread is a golden color and the sprouts are tender. Remove from the oven and allow to cool for 5 minutes before removing from the pan.

title: Rutabaga Cheese With Limeade
ingredients: 1 medium rutabaga, peeled and cubed | 1 can frozen limeade concentrate | 1/2 pound provolone cheese, cut into cubes
instructions: Boil rutabaga in water until tender, about 20 minutes.

title: Polish Sausage and Preserved Fresh Tomatoes Appetizer (Ukha Kalitsounia)
ingredients: 3 pounds polish sausage | 2 jars chopped fresh tomatoes with juice | 1 1/2 tablespoons tomato paste | 1 3/4 cups dried currants | 1 package toothpicks
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Place the sausage links in a large, deep skillet, and cook over medium high heat, turning once, until evenly browned, about 10 minutes. Remove from heat, and slice into 1 1/2 inch chunks. Place the tomatoes with their juice in a saucepan with tomato paste, and raise the heat to medium, and bring to a boil. Return the sausage chunks to the skillet, and stir in dried currants. Transfer contents of skillet to a 9x13 inch baking dish, cover with foil, and bake in preheated oven until the sausage juices run clear and the topping is deep and richly browned, about 2 hours.

Random Ingredients: italian salad dressing,ice water,apple,grain rice,panir,rice vinegar
title: Rice & Crispy Panir
ingredients: 1 cup long grain rice | 2 cups water or 2 cups chicken stock | 1/2 cup apple or 1/2 cup red apple, finely chopped | 1/4 cup italian salad dressing | 1 1/4 teaspoons rice vinegar | fat, as required
instructions: Mix ingredients together and refrigerate for 1 - 2 hours. Boil rice and pour on some water to cover. When it comes to boil, stir a few times until the rice gets stuck to the bottom and the rice is soft. Lower the heat and cook for 20 minutes. Remove from heat. If you have leftovers, place a tray inside the pan to keep the pan from sticking. Sprinkle some fat onto the warm rice if you wish.

Random Ingredients: oil,mustard,jalapeno pepper,cardamom seed,ice cream,apple cider vinegar,golden raisin
title: Sweet Mustard Apple Ketchup
ingredients: 1 whole cardamom seed | 4 cups apple cider vinegar | 1/4 cup oil | 1 can or bottle jalapeno peppers, drained | 3 cups ice cream, cut into small pieces | 1/2 cup golden raisin | 1/2 cup minced jalapeno pepper
instructions: Place cardamom seeds in a small cup, and set aside. Bring the chopped apple cider vinegar, oil, jalapenos, ice cream, golden raisins, jalapeno pepper, and cardamom seeds to a boil. Reduce heat, and simmer the ketchup over low heat for about 10 minutes, stirring occasionally. Continue to simmer until cheese is melted and slightly thickened. Remove from the heat, and remove cardamom seeds. Chill to serve.

title: Grilled Pepperoni Pesto and Pepperoni Strips
ingredients: 100 g pepperoni, coarsely grated | 1/4 cup chopped pepperoni | 1 teaspoon dried chili flakes or 1 dried crushed chili pepper | 1/4 cup grated parmesan cheese | 2 teaspoons curry
instructions: In a serving bowl, combine the first 5 ingredients. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Divide among serving bowl. Sprinkle with cheese.

Random Ingredients: oregano leaf,garlic granule,corn kernel,thai red curry paste,tamarind paste,egg wrap,clove garlic
title: Easy Thai Red Curry Corn Rolls
ingredients: 1 package egg roll wraps | 1 can corn kernels, drained | 2 cloves garlic, peeled and finely chopped | 1 teaspoon tamarind paste | 1/2/3 cup thai red curry paste or 1/2-1 teaspoon hot red curry paste, as desired | 1/4 teaspoon garlic granules or 1/4 teaspoon garlic powder ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon dried oregano leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Grease a 4 cup baking dish. Place 2 wrappers on baking dish and press in lightly with a fork. Bake for 5 - 7 minutes, or until lightly browned. While the dough is baking, combine the next 7 ingredients in a blender or food processor and process well. To assemble, spread 2 tablespoons of the tamarind paste on a piece of wrapper. Place 1/4 cup of the corn cob along the edge of the paste. Top with 1/4 cup of the corn mixture. Use two toothpicks to make a cross at the top of the corn mixture. Fold the toothpicks together and roll the wrap loosely around the corn filling. Repeat with remaining wrappers and filling. Slice each wrap into 4 wedges. Serve at once.

title: Lobster Thermidor (Southern Style Chicken in Butter)
ingredients: 1 whole chickens | 2 tablespoons anise seed | 1 1/2 tablespoons marjoram, dried | 1 1/2 tablespoons anise seed | 1 glass jar with lid | 1 can baby clams, drained and juice squeezed from jars
instructions: Place the chicken in a large pot and fill with enough water to cover. Bring to boiling, reduce heat and simmer for 2 hours, skimming off any foam that rises to the surface. Remove chicken from the pot and set aside. Cover and keep warm. Skim chicken fat and discard. Cool. Pour off any foam that rises to the surface. Meanwhile, put anise seeds and marjoram in a mortar and grind into fine powder. Cover tightly with cheesecloth and refrigerate for 30 minutes, or overnight. Remove chicken from the refrigerator and remove cheesecloth. Place chicken in a separate container. Pour 2 cups of the soaking liquid and juices from the jar into a saucepan set over medium heat. Stir in the marjoram and anise seeds. Heat to boiling, then strain the mixture through a jelly strainer to clear any solids and discard the solids. Return the strained liquid to the pot. Stir in the baby clams. When the sauce is simmering, reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1 hour to flavor the sauce, then remove the cover and simmer for another 45 minutes to thicken the sauce and thicken the sauce a little more. Serve over boiled noodles or crackers.

title: Pepperoni Peach Brownie Pies
ingredients: 2 tablespoons chocolate, chopped | 2 tablespoons rice wine | 1 tablespoon soy sauce | 1/2 teaspoon hot pepper sauce | 1/2 teaspoon pepper sauce ( like tabasco ) | 2 ripe peaches, sliced | 3 ounces pepperoni, sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. In a small medium bowl, mix chocolate, rice wine, soy sauce, hot sauce, pepper sauce, and pepper sauce. Put peach slices onto a sheet of parchment paper. Top with chocolate mixture. Sprinkle with pepperoni slices. Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until golden brown and bubbly.

title: Kielbasa and Beans
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs kielbasa | 2 cans fat-free refried beans, undiluted | 2 tablespoons tamari ( or soy sauce ) | 1 cup tapioca flour
instructions: Cut kielbasa in 1 inch slices. Heat refried beans in a pot until bubbling. Add kielbasa. Heat 1 minute more. Sauce should thicken slightly, leaving kielbasa in chunks. Add tamari or soy sauce, stirring until it dissolves. Stir tapioca flour until dissolved. Pour over sausage and beans, stirring well to coat. Top with green onion tops for extra flavor.

title: Quinoa Stuffed With Honey (Or Blueberry and Blueberry)
ingredients: 10 -12 saltines crackers or 5 -6 blueberries, depending on size | 1 cup quinoa ( or whatever is on sale ) | honey or sugar ( to taste )
instructions: Prepare quinoa according to manufacturers instructions. Spray cookie sheet with cooking spray. Spread a small amount of quinoa onto cookie sheet and then top each cracker with about 2 teaspoons of blueberries or other fruit of your choice. Sprinkle with honey or sugar. Using a brush or brush, lightly apply honey or sugar on the tops of the quinoa. Bake at 350 degrees for 15 - 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: za'atar spice mix,nonstick cooking spray,asiago cheese,apple cider,spinach leaf
title: Cabbage and Asiago Salad With Za'atar
ingredients: nonstick cooking spray | 4 cups sliced cabbage | 1/2 cup asiago cheese, shredded | 1/4 cup frozen chopped spinach leaves, thawed | 1/4 cup apple cider ( or apple juice )
instructions: Wrap a pastry towel around the inside of a large bowl. Spray the inside of the bowl with oil. In a large skillet, bring 2 qts water to a rolling boil. Place cabbage in the skillet, then cover with lid and reduce heat to 10°. Reduce heat to low, cover and simmer cabbage for 15 minutes or until just tender. Remove from heat and allow to cool enough to handle. When cool enough to handle, transfer cabbage to the bowl of cold water and squeeze out any excess water.

title: BBQ Grilled Shrimp
ingredients: 1 small yellow squash, halved and thinly sliced | 1/2 apple, peeled, cored and thinly sliced | 1 tablespoon barbecue sauce | 5 slices white bread | 2 ounces shrimp, cooked, shelled and cut into chunks
instructions: In medium nonstick skillet, toss squash and apples with barbecue sauce. Place 6 slices of bread onto work surface. Place half of peeled shrimp onto bread.

title: Red Chile Red Sauce
ingredients: 1 jar red chili sauce | 0.5 package taco seasoning
instructions: Mix together and store in refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: parsley,self raising flour,chocolate cookie crumb,steak,red food coloring,bread crumb,marsala wine,gnocchi
title: Baked Swiss Steak
ingredients: 2 kg swiss steak, cut into 4cm slices | 1/4 cup self-raising flour | 1/2 cup plain bread crumbs | 1/2 cup parmesan cheese | 1 tablespoon parsley | 1 tablespoon marsala wine | 1 red food coloring | 1 chocolate cookie crumb ( or candy crumb of your choice ) | 3 -5 tablespoons dry bread crumbs
instructions: Put the sliced swiss steaks into a lightly greased ovenproof dish. Combine the self raising flour, plain breadcrumbs, parmesan cheese and parsley in a large bowl. Dip each swiss steak slice in flour and then into the parmesan/herb mixture. Place on top of the breadcrumb mixture. Pour the wine over the swiss steak. Cover the pan and bake at 180°c for 40 - 45 minutes or until cooked. Allow to stand for 5 - 10 minutes before serving.

title: Quick and Easy One-Pan French Bread
ingredients: 1/2 loaf day old bread ( can use french bread cut into bite size chunks of bread, i prefer country ) | 2 cans diced rotel, drained ( i find the brand i buy is king's or your own flavor ) | 10 large cloves fresh sweet pickled lemons ( or a mix of two lemons, lime, and or or or other lime juice ) | 1 -2 chicken bouillon cube ( or just use 3/4 cup per slice ) | 1 teaspoon peanut oil or 1 teaspoon butter | 1 cup fresh bread
instructions: Cut up bread into 1 inch chunks and put in crockpot. Stir in juice from pickled lemons, and rest of ingredients except for peanut oil or other flavorings. Cover and cook on low setting for 8 hours or until liquid thickens and bread becomes very mushy. Remove from heat and stir in peanut oil or butter..

Random Ingredients: fontina cheese,cream chicken soup,urad dal,ginger root,red onion,porcini mushroom
title: Mushroom Raita
ingredients: 2 large red onions, sliced | 4 fresh porcini mushrooms, sliced | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh ginger root | 8 ounces condensed cream of chicken soup | 2 tablespoons urad dal ( split black lentils ) | 1 cup shredded fontina cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. In a medium bowl, mix together the onions, mushrooms, ginger, cream of chicken soup, and urad dal. Spray a 9x13 inch baking dish with cooking spray. Spread the soup mixture evenly over the top. Top with fontina cheese. Bake in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until golden.

title: Dressed Chilean Sea Bass
ingredients: 1 cup dry quinoa | 8 ounces pacific sandwich steaks | 6 teaspoons tapenade ( low sodium ) | 3 teaspoons rice vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Soak quinoa for an hour. Drain and rinse, then put in large serving bowl. Toss with tapenade. Cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour. Heat grill pan to medium. Remove steaks from marinade and grill for 3 minutes per side for medium rare or 1 minute per side for medium. Cool and then cut into strips. Serve on warm plates with rice.

title: Mexican Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1 package pasta ( linguine, bowtie, macaroni ) | 1/2 english cucumber, diced | 1 cup salsa | any italian dressing
instructions: Dice the pasta or mix it up with the salad. Mix the salsa and dressing together. Pour over the pasta mix and mix well. Refrigerate for a few hours to develop the flavors before serving.

title: Parmesan Pea Focaccia Bread (Abm)
ingredients: 1/2 cup sunflower oil | 2/3 cup egg substitute | 2 tablespoons grated parmesan cheese ( optional ) | 1 package frozen mixed pulses, defrosted according to package directions
instructions: Add first six ingredients to the breadmaker in the order suggested by the manufacturer. Select the french bread setting, press start and check the check for doneness. Serve bread immediately.

Random Ingredients: corn kernel,pineapple chunk,grape tomato,carrot,puff pastry,tart apple
title: Carrot Fruit-Veggie Quiche
ingredients: 4 cups sweet corn kernels ( frozen, popped or fresh ) | 3 small tart apples ( granny smith's are good ) | 1 cup grapes tomatoes ( can be fresh or canned. ) | 1 cup carrot ( grated ) | 1/2 cup grapeseed oil or 1/2 cup grapeseed oil | 3 unbaked puff pastry ( i've even used homemade )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400f degrees. Boil all the vegetables together for 5 minutes so they don't overcook. Set aside and let cool a bit. Place mixture into a pie plate. Cover with puff pastry and poke holes in the pastry with a fork to make holes, and brush them with the oil. Bake for 45 - 50 minutes, until it is firm. Note, i love to bake these with green olives and pineapple and it goes well with the fruit and veggie dishes. I also like to add a sweet and sour mix for this one instead of the sweet and sour. The recipe is easily doubled and makes a large or small amount, and you can even make half small balls. Serve with a green salad.

Random Ingredients: milk,mustard seed,peanut oil,beef bouillon cube,chili flake,sherry,catsup
title: Hot Spicy Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup milk | 1 beef bouillon cube | 1 tablespoon mustard seeds | 1 teaspoon hot chili flakes | 1/4 cup dry sherry | 1/2 cup catsup | vegetable oil, for deep frying
instructions: Mix all ingredients in small saucepan and heat over medium heat to boiling. Reduce heat to low, stirring occasionally.

Random Ingredients: pork tenderloin,chili sauce,garlic,olive,white bread,red chile pepper,cumin seed,tamari
title: Pan Roasted Pork Tenderloin
ingredients: 5 cloves garlic, peeled | 1 tablespoon cumin seeds | 2 red chile peppers, coarsely chopped | 1 pound pork tenderloins | 1 sprig fresh red chile pepper, coarsely chopped | 1 cup chili sauce | 1 tablespoon tamari | 2 slices white bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Line a large baking sheet with aluminum foil, and spray with cooking spray. Place garlic, cumin seeds, red chile peppers, and pork tenderloins in a large, resealable plastic bag. Pour chili sauce and tamari over the pork. Lay bread slices on top of the marinade, and press the garlic into the bread with your fingers. Bake in the preheated oven, turning occasionally, until a meat thermometer inserted into the thickest part of the pork registers 145 degrees f, about 1 hour.

title: Cabbage Loaf With Fiery Bean Sprouts
ingredients: 2 cups finely chopped white cabbage | 1 cup colman's seasoned stuffing mix | 1/2 cup bean sprouts
instructions: Combine cabbage and stuffing mix in bowl. Shape into 3/4 inch thick oval loaf. Place loaf on greased baking sheet. Bake at 350°f for 1 hour. Remove from oven and turn on broiler. Spread sprouts on top of loaf. Drizzle with olive oil. Place loaf under broiler just long enough to steam the sprouts.

Random Ingredients: garlic clove,green bell pepper,hot chili pepper,enchilada sauce,pork shoulder
title: Cheater's Enchilada
ingredients: 1 lb pork shoulder, butt ends trimmed | 1 pint enchilada sauce | 1 medium green bell pepper, diced | 1 garlic clove, minced | 1 dried hot chili pepper, chopped
instructions: Remove any rind from the pork and place in a large skillet. Brown the pork on all sides in enchilada sauce, remove from skillet and place in a large saucepan. Wash and clean the saucepan, add the green pepper, garlic and chille. Cut the pork pieces into 1 inch cubes and place in the saucepan. Cover and cook over medium heat until tender and flavors are blended, about 1 hour.

title: Grilled Mango Croissant
ingredients: 1 mango - peeled, seeded and chopped | 4 croissants, split | 1 can chopped green chili peppers
instructions: Preheat grill to medium heat and lightly oil the grate. Place mango and croissant halves in a baking dish. Sprinkle with green chiles and drizzle with olive oil. Grill croissants 10 to 15 minutes, until lightly browned and croissants are melted.

title: Smoked Garlic and Pepper Macaroni and Cheese
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh parsley, leaves only | 4 medium yukon gold potatoes, cut into 1/2-inch dice | 1 1/2 tablespoons dried chipotle powder | 8 ounces whole wheat pasta, such as rotini de canola
instructions: Fill a large pot with 3 quarts hot water and bring to a boil over high heat. Stir in the parsley, bring back to a boil, immediately remove immediately from heat, and let sit until tender, at least 10 minutes. Place potatoes with chipotle in a colander over the boiling water, cover, and let drain until they are cool enough to handle, about 30 minutes. Cut potatoes into 1/4 inch slices with scissors, and transfer to a bowl. Stir with a small spoon to wash off the starch and any large pieces of potato that may have begun to stick together. Place the sliced potatoes and 2 quarts water in a large pot and bring to a boil over moderate heat. Reduce the heat and simmer, stirring often, until potatoes are soft, about 25 minutes. Taste for salt. While the potatoes are cooking, bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add pasta and boil until al dente, about 8 minutes. Drain pasta, reserving 1 cup of pasta cooking water before draining. When potatoes are cool enough to handle, slice about 1/4 inch slices and transfer to a bowl with parsley and chipotle. Stir to combine. Cook egg in a small saucepan of boiling water over moderate heat until slightly softened, about 2 minutes. Drain pasta and transfer to a large bowl. Add potato/chipotle mixture and 1/2 cup cooking water and toss to combine.

title: Camarones de Carne
ingredients: 1 pound fresh shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1 can great northern beans, drained and rinsed | 1 teaspoon onion powder | 1 teaspoon anise seed | 1 tablespoon chopped pecans | 1 small jicama, julienned | 1 avocado - peeled, pitted and sliced
instructions: Cook and stir shrimp in a large skillet over medium heat until opaque, about 3 minutes. Stir in beans, onion powder, anise seeds, pecans, jicama, and avocado. Cook until shrimp is bright red and beans are heated through, 30 to 60 seconds.

Random Ingredients: self raising flour,rum,whipping cream,red onion,ladyfinger,veal,gouda cheese
title: Danish Christmas Pudding Balls
ingredients: 250 g ground veal | 250 g grated lean gouda cheese | 125 ml whipping cream | 2 large red onions, finely chopped | 125 g ladyfingers | 3 tablespoons dried rum | 2 tablespoons self raising flour or 2 tablespoons plain flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 °c. In a large bowl mix together, veal, cheese, cream, onions, and dried ladyfingers. Place 1 level teaspoon of the mixture into the base of a greased shallow, large ovenproof dish. Place 1 level teaspoon full of the puddings on top of the puddings. Bake for approximately 35 - 45 minutes, until very light brown and firm. Serve warm, sprinkled with rum or lemon juice. If you do this the day before intending to serve, allow 30 minutes for cooling in the oven before refrigerating.

title: Swiss Dip with a Beer
ingredients: 1 can rotel tomatoes | 1 package cubed swiss cheese | 1/2 spanish onion, chopped | 1 tablespoon fresh ginger ale, or to taste ( optional )
instructions: Spread the rotel tomatoes and swiss cheese cubes onto the counter or in a lightly greased 9 or 10 inch clear glass baking dish. Sprinkle the chives and onion onto top of the tomatoes and spread out using your fingers so that the toppings don't get stuck together. Pour the beer over the top and sprinkle with gingerale.

title: Chickpea and  Olive Ragout
ingredients: 1/2 lb green beans | 1/3 lb veal shoulder, chopped | 1 can chickpeas | 1 fresh red chile, seeded and chopped
instructions: Soak the beans and veal in cold water for 2 hours or until soft.

title: Egg Nog
ingredients: 1 teaspoon hot mixed spices | 2 tablespoons nonfat dry milk powder | 1 1 lb italian sausage, lean and casings removed | 2 tablespoons mild chilies, chopped | 1/4 cup mirin | 1/4 cup rum | 1 loaf rye bread, sliced 1/4 inch thick
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. In a small bowl, stir hot spice mix, milk and dry milk powder together. Set aside. In a skillet, brown sausage in butter over medium heat 5 minutes, or until cooked through, breaking up into small pieces with a spoon. Transfer to a paper towel lined plate. Add chilies, mirin and rum to skillet.

title: Tarragon & Feta #5FIX
ingredients: 1 package pre-made simply potatoes diced potatoes with onion | 1 jar sliced mushrooms | 1 package reduced-fat feta cheese | 1 teaspoon dried tarragon
instructions: Heat a large nonstick skillet. Cook the simply potatoes diced potatoes with onion in the microwave for 15 - 20 minutes.

title: Hot Pies
ingredients: 4 cups self-raising flour ( or 1 cup for plain flour ) | 2 tablespoons chili-garlic sauce
instructions: Heat oven to 200°c. Measure the flour into a large mixing bowl, add the chili sauce and mix well. Cut about half a teaspoon full of the mixture into 4, roll each teaspoonful and press out into 5 greased circles using a 2 inch pastry cutter. Place on a greased baking sheet. Allow to rest for 5 minutes. Repeat on the remaining pastry circles then prick top with the tines of a fork and bake for 25 - 30 minutes.

title: Easy Chicken
ingredients: 800 g chicken breast fillets, skinned, boned and fat removed | 2 cans condensed tomato soup | salt
instructions: Place the tomato soup can or soup can on the bottom of the stew pot. Place chicken on top. Add salt. If possible, place lid on pot and simmer on low for about 1 hour or until chicken is cooked. This can also be done in crock pot on high.

Random Ingredients: penne,pomegranate molasses,stewing beef,beef rib,cardamom pod,whipping cream
title: Slow Cooker Persian Beef and Pomegranate Stew
ingredients: 2 lbs stewing beef, cubed | 4 lbs stewing beef rib, cut into 2 inch chunks | 1 jar roasted pomegranate molasses, in tomato sauce | 1 cup whipping cream | 2 cardamom pods | 1/2 lb penne or 1/2 lb rigatoni pasta, cooked
instructions: Brown stew meat in large skillet with pomegranate molasses. Stir frequently. Put lid on slow cooker. Cook on low 7 - 10 hours or on high 2 - 5 hours until meat is tender when pierced with a fork. Turn off cooker. Add pasta to broth and heat. Stir in cream and simmer for 2 minutes, or until mixture thickens. Serve over hot pasta.

title: Cottage Cheese Curd
ingredients: 1 lb cottage cheese | 5 tablespoons oil ( olive or canola ) | 1 teaspoon orange peel, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon ginger | 1 pinch ginger ( optional )
instructions: Mix all ingredents and chill in refrigerator 2 hours or overnight until needed.

Random Ingredients: vidalia onion,cardamom seed,celery heart,cumin powder,sauce,grain rice
title: Ersal" Spanish Rice
ingredients: 1 large vidalia onion | 2 teaspoons ground cumin powder | 1 teaspoon cardamom seed | 1 teaspoon dry minced celery heart ( optional ) | 3 cups short-grain rice | 1/4 cup steak sauce ( sweet soy sauce, kikkoman sweet soy sauce )
instructions: Chop onion in to 1/4 inch dice. Heat a heavy non stick frying pan to medium heat. When hot, put onions & spices in the frying pan & stir well. Sauté on low heat for 5 minutes. Now add all rice & stir constantly until all rice is covered with oil. Do not let it get soggy & it will take on a golden brown colour. Serve w/steamed vegetables, sour cream, sliced avocados or pineapple rings as a garnish.

title: Crock Pot Chilled French Onion Soup (Easy)
ingredients: 24 ounces cream of chicken soup | 1/2 cup red wine
instructions: Combine all ingredients and cook covered on low heat for 4 - 6 hours or on high heat for 4 - 5 hours, until soup is thickened. Cool to room temperature, cover and refrigerate overnight to chill and develop flavor.

title: Piselli
ingredients: 3 cups quinoa ( about 2 quarts ) | 1 cup rice vermicelli | 1 cup shredded gruyere
instructions: In a stockpot with the rim of your saucepan about 2 inches deep, combine the quinoa and quinoa. Bring to a boil, reduce the heat and simmer 3 minutes. Cover and set aside to steep for 20 minutes. In the meantime, bring 1 1/4 cups of salted water to a boil. Add the vermicelli and cook 3 to 4 minutes, stirring gently to break apart the strands. Drain the quinoa.

title: Sweet Mushroom-Infused Molasses
ingredients: 12 cremini mushrooms, cleaned and trimmed, trimmed | 1/2 cup dark molasses
instructions: Rinse mushrooms and remove tough stems. Slice caps into 1/4 inch slices, removing any loose strings. Place mushrooms in a bowl with the molasses and mix to combine with the mushrooms. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour before serving.

title: Linguine With Tomato Sauce and Cardamom Crushed Oil
ingredients: 1/2 cup dry linguine | 8 ounces tomato sauce, canned | 4 ounces beef bouillon cubes | 4 teaspoon dried marjoram | 1 teaspoon cardamom seed | 1/3 cup sun-dried tomatoes in oil
instructions: Cook linguine according to directions on the package. Drain and return to the cooking pot. In a small bowl, combine the tomato sauce, bouillon cubes, marjoram and cardamom seeds. Pour into the pot. Stir in the sun dried tomatoes right before serving.

title: Alfredo Sauce
ingredients: 4 egg yolks | 2 teaspoons capers | 1/2 lb feta cheese, crumbled
instructions: Combine the egg yolks with the capers and the feta cheese. Pour sauce on the bread or toast and bake on top of a hot grill until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: pea,gravy,pork sausage,italian herb seasoning,pork loin,baking powder,cardamom powder
title: Scotch Pea Stew
ingredients: 1/2 lb pork loin | 6 links pork sausage | 1/4 cup frozen peas | 2 1/2 cups gravy, any flavor | 2 teaspoons baking powder | 1 teaspoon cardamom powder | 1 teaspoon mixed italian herbs, dried ( see my recipe )
instructions: Cut pork loin into 1/2 slices. Cut pork sausage into 1/2 lengths. Set aside. Bring large pot of water to boil. Add peas. Remove from heat when peas are cooked and transfer to ice water to stop cooking. Drain. In small bowl add gravy powder, baking powder and cardimon and mix. Add peas to pot. Add dry spices to pot. Reduce heat and cover. Heat to just below simmering. Simmer for 20 - 25 minutes.

title: Australian Corn & Oat Casserole
ingredients: 450 g canned kernel corn, drained | 225 g quick-cooking oats | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace | 300 ml double cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 170°c. Grease a 6 cup capacity ovenproof casserole dish. Beat corn, oats, mace and cream together in a bowl. Spoon equal amounts of mixture into prepared casserole dish. Repeat layers with remaining mixture and oat mixture. Bake for 45 minutes, or until cooked and golden.

title: Creamy Vegetable Souffle
ingredients: 1 can cream of celery soup | 1/2 cup mayonnaise | 6 ounces tri-colored zucchini, cut into sticks | 1 medium egg, beaten | 1 tablespoon dried savory | 8 corn on the cob, cut into thick spears | 4 skewers | 1/2 cup triple sec
instructions: Combine soup, mayonnaise, zucchini, egg, and savory in a bowl and set aside. Grill corn, egg, and corn on a baking sheet at the highest heat possible. Turn every 10 minutes to prevent burning and stir soup mixture into egg mixture to thicken. Serve in soup bowls or on crackers.

Random Ingredients: lemon zest,black bean,wonton skin,malt vinegar,no salt tomato,white chocolate chip,baking powder
title: No Salt Tomato and Black Bean Stacks
ingredients: 1 box wonton skins | 14 ounces no-salt-added diced tomatoes | 1/4 cup no-salt tomato paste or 1/4 cup crushed canned tomato | 1/2 cup malt vinegar | 2 tablespoons grated fresh lemon zest | 1/2 teaspoon baking powder | 1 1/2 cups low-sodium black beans
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Place the novegetable skins onto a baking sheet and place in the oven. Place the tomatoes on top of the skins and then top with the diced tomatoes, the tomato paste, vinegar, lemon zest and baking powder. Place the skins on the baking sheet and bake for 20 minutes. Remove from oven and top the skins with black beans and bake for 5 additional minutes or until black beans and vegetables are tender and crisp. Allow to cool slightly and serve.

title: Mexican Linguica
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups canned sliced clams with juice | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla | 1/4 cup picante sauce
instructions: In a heavy saucepan, combine clam juice, parsley, and vanilla.

title: Wild Rice and Celery Seed Kebabs
ingredients: 1 tablespoon wild rice | 1 tablespoon celery seed | skewer
instructions: Cook wild rice and celery seed in a pot of boiling salted water for about 30 minutes or until tender. Drain well and set aside to cool. Grind the mixture into a fine powder using a mortar and pestle. Brush skewers with a little beaten egg and thread onto skewers. Let the kababs sit for 20 minutes before grilling.

Random Ingredients: pear,cream coconut,ancho chile powder,beef shank,date,onion soup mix,tamari soy sauce,heavy cream
title: Quick 'n Easy Shredded Beef Skewers
ingredients: 2 lbs beef shank | 2 cans cream of coconut ( 398ml ) | 1 envelope dry onion soup mix | 4 tablespoons teriyaki soy sauce | 3 tablespoons tamari or 3 tablespoons light soy sauce | 1/2 teaspoon whole ancho chile powder | 1 pear, halved cored and sliced into 1/4 inch thinn slices | 1 can light cream of coconut | 3 pitted dates
instructions: Soak beef shanks in cold water 30 minutes to 1 hour before cooking, remove and discard shanks from the marinade. Slice beef into 1/2 inch pieces. Thread beef onto skewers. Cook on preheated grill or broiler rack 3 minutes a side, or until browned and crispy. In saucepan, blend coconut, onion soup mix, teriyaki or light soy sauce, and chile powder. Bring to simmer over medium heat, stir occasionally. Pour over meat in saucepan. Bring to simmer, stir occasionally, cook for 2 to 5 minutes, or until slightly thickened. Serve with sliced carrot, sliced apple and sliced pears. For quick 'n easy 'n easy'beef skewers, place meat in shallow baking dish. Spoon curry sauce over, and bake just until heated through on top.

title: Mexican Hamburgers (Puerco a La Queso)
ingredients: 2 lbs lean hamburger | 1 lb fresh meat, cut into 1-inch cubes | salt water | 4 tablespoons cajun seasoning | 2 tablespoons lime zest, minced | 1 medium bell pepper
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well. Shape into patties. Broil until done about 7 - 8 minutes each side.

Random Ingredients: extra virgin olive oil,dark soy sauce
title: Ahi Shami
ingredients: 1/4 cup dark soy sauce | extra virgin olive oil
instructions: In a bowl, whisk the soy sauce and two tablespoons of water. If you’re not using ahi shami drizzle olive oil onto a sheet of tin foil or parchment paper and drizzle over the oil. Spread out the shami and coat with the sauce.

title: Mexican Green Bean, Shrimp and Bacon Rollups
ingredients: 3 slices bacon ( or use two slices chopped ham ) | 1 package sazon goya, seasoning mix ( or use 1 1/2 tsp. chile powder if you use powder or chili powder ) | 1 cup half-and-half ( optional ) | 1 package frozen white beans, thawed | 1 1/2 lbs medium shrimp | 4 6-inch tortillas or 4 6-inch flour tortillas
instructions: In a large saucepan cook the sliced bacon or ham till browned, remove bacon from pan. Using a slotted spoon drain fat and discard all but 2 tsp. Fried bacon or ham will save on fat frying in pan. Add 1 1/2 pkgs. Sazon to pan stirring until completely mixed in. Add half and half and chile powder to pan. Stir. Bring to a boil, lower to simmer. Cook 10 minutes stirring occasionally or until thickened and reduced to about 3/4 cup. Stir in bacon and cooked beans. Add shrimp, heat through. Heat the tortillas to soften. Spoon 3/4 cup filling into tortilla. Roll up, place seam side down in baking dish. Cover with foil and bake @ 350 for 15 - 20 minutes or until heated through. Serve with cheese or sour cream, salsa if desired.

title: Danish Smoked Salmon Linguinguine With Mushrooms and Cream Gravy
ingredients: 1 lb smoked salmon fillet | 2/3 cup creme fraiche | 1 1/2 teaspoons tabasco sauce | 1 1/2 cups basmati rice | 6 small fresh mushrooms | mixed mushrooms | 6 ounces smoked linguine | marshmallows
instructions: Start by poaching the mushrooms in salted water for about 8 minutes. The mushrooms should be slightly wrinkled, which should give the dish a silky texture. Drain and reserve. Cut the salmon into 1/4 inch thick chunks. Slice in half lengthwise and then into 1/2 inch slices. Lay out 1 large platter. Start layering the fish with mushrooms, starting with half the mushrooms. Start layering until you have used all of the fish add creme fraiche and tabasco. I like to pour a small amount all at once into the creme fraiche and when it starts to emulsify the sauce will settle to the bottom. This can take a little time, so keep an eye on it add more creme fraiche. It will almost boil out of the salmon if not covered. Taste for seasoning. If you need to add extra salt, you can add it now. You will need to cook the sauce on low heat. At this point, i normally add in a splash more of the tabasco, but i don't measure it as i will be deviating by putting the whole thing in the center for the dinner. When all of the ingredients are just below the level of the salmon mixture, turn the stove to high. At medium low, slowly add a cup of water covering the fish completely. Stir the liquid until the liquid is absorbed. Simmer for 2 hours or more until the rice is cooked and the fish is floating. After 2 hours, it will be ready to serve, so remove from heat when dinner time is done. While the salmon is still cooking, start cooking your linguine, put a pot of water to boil. Right before it hits a boil, add the linguine. Cook according to package directions. Drain thoroughly under running water and let dry. Put a serving platter on top of the linguine and cover it with the linguine. Top the linguine with smoked salmon and mushrooms and scatter the marshmallows into the top. Serve immediately.

title: Norwegian Finnish Onion Pancakes
ingredients: 4 ounces dried currants | 2 -3 green onions, sliced | 2 cups all-purpose flour
instructions: Soak the currants in hot water for 20 minutes or so. Drain and set aside. Preheat over to 400°f. Melt the butter or margarine in a medium skillet or frying pan, and stir in the onions. Cook on low for about 10 minutes, stirring often. Turn the heat up to medium high and add the flour. Stir with a spoon until it forms a doughy mixture that pulls away from the sides of the skillet/dish. Turn off heat. Spoon the mixture into a large, thin circle on one side of a plate, and place it on top of the currants. Gentle peel off the outer paper layer and spread the batter in an even circle to cover the batter all over. Serve hot, with lemon wedges.

title: Lazy Lazagna
ingredients: 3 lbs sirloin | 2 tablespoons dill, chopped
instructions: The night before cooking the meat, trim the excess fat off the meat. Cut into the length of slices about 1/4 inch thick. Sprinkle generously with dill and mix lightly. In a shallow dish, place meat, then spoon or stuff of the dill dill mixture over it. Place under the broiler until meat is no longer pink. Let rest 30 minutes, then slice into thin strips or shred the meat and serve.

title: Mini Potato Wedges
ingredients: 1 pint yukon gold potato, scrubbed | 3/4 cup prepared sweet and sour sauce | 1 jar sliced pimiento, drained | 1 tablespoon grated fresh ginger | 2 tablespoons chopped scallions | 1 package dessert topping mix
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place yukon gold potatoes in a pot with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil, and cook until tender, about 15 minutes. Drain, and cool in the pan. Slice into 1/4 inch thick slices. Mix sweet and sour sauce, pimiento, ginger, and scallions until thoroughly mixed. Spoon equal amounts of pimento mixture into the center of each piece of potatoes. Spoon dessert topping over the pierogi, and place pieces on a baking sheet. Bake until topping is bubbly, about 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: tortilla chip,golden raisin,green chile pepper,italian sausage,sea salt,cumin seed,baby spinach
title: Italian Sausage Salad
ingredients: 1 pound mild italian sausage | 2 teaspoons sea salt | 1 teaspoon ground cumin seeds | 6 cups torn fresh baby spinach | 1/2 cup golden raisins, chopped | 1 cup chopped green chile peppers | 6 tablespoons crushed tortilla chips
instructions: Cook and stir sausage in a skillet over medium high heat until browned and crumbly, about 10 minutes. Season with salt and cumin. Mix in spinach, raisins, green peppers and tortilla chips. Cook and stir 2 minutes or until heated through.

title: Italian Salami Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup orange juice, freshly squeezed | 3 tablespoons low sodium soy sauce | 8 ounces salami, sliced thin | 6 ounces red cabbage, shredded | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh dill | 1/4 lb shaved sweet chocolate, curls for garnish ( optional )
instructions: In a small saucepan over medium low heat, stir the orange juice, soy sauce, and salt. When the soy sauce is bubbling, remove from heat.

title: Spicy Butternut Squash With Chili and Honey
ingredients: 1 large butternut squash, halved | 1/2 teaspoon red chili powder | 1 tablespoon dry sherry | 1 tablespoon honey | 1/2 teaspoon chili powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c/400°f/gas place butternut squash halves in a baking dish and sprinkle with half the chilli powder. Roast in oven until just tender when pierced. Transfer to a serving dish. Boil liquid in a saucepan over medium high heat. Simmer for 5 minutes, then stir through 1 tablespoon of honey and the remaining chilli powder. Drizzle over the squash and serve.

title: Japanese Eggplant Rollups
ingredients: 2 cups eggplants, unpeeled, unpeeled, thinly sliced | 2 cups flour | 3 eggs, lightly beaten | 12 sheets pie shells | 1/4 cup dark sesame oil
instructions: Place eggplant slices between 2 sheets of waxed paper, using toothpicks so they don't bleed from the eggplant. Spread eggplant slices out on a clean paper towel lined counter, to dehydrate and allow excess moisture to drain off. Place 3 or 6 slices of eggplant in center of each pastry sheet, and sprinkle with salt. Fold one edge of pastry over to creat a seal along the edges. Brush with the beaten eggs, and using a fork, press the beaten egg into the beaten egg along the edge of the pastry. Roll up the pastry in all directions, beginning with the folded edge. Repeat with remaining slices. Preheat a grill pan or small skillet over high heat. Brush saute pan with sesame oil. Add rolls to the pan. Cook, turning once, until golden, about 3 minutes per side.

Random Ingredients: skirt steak,parmigiano reggiano cheese,green salsa,pie shell
title: Cuban Steak
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs skirt steaks | 1 package refrigerated pie shells | 1/2 cup shredded parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 2 cups green salsa
instructions: Place steak on a cutting board. Using sharp paring knife, cut into thick, 2 inch long strips. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Heat a 10 inch nonstick skillet over high heat until a bead of water vaporizes within one minute of contact. Add half of skirt steak to pan. Cook 2 - 3 minutes per side or until medium rare. Set aside in a warm place. Repeat process until remaining 1 1/2 lbs steak is cut into 4 thin strips. Set steak aside. Cook and stir salsa in a medium sauce pan, stirring to loosen browned bits at bottom of pan, 1 minute. Add remaining 2 tbsps. Of parmigiano reggiano. When cheese melts, add remaining 1/4 cup green salsa. Cook and stir 2 - 3 minutes, until heated through. Cook and stir steak for 2 minutes on each side. Serve with potato wedges if desired.

title: Chipotle Adobo
ingredients: 3 -6 tablespoons chipotle chiles in adobo | 1/2 teaspoon msg ( optional )
instructions: First remove the hard bottom end from the chiles. Then slice the pepper into 1/4 inch/ 1/2 inch slices that is around 2 inches/4 inches/3 inches thick. Set aside. Use a very sharp knife to cut the chipotle chile into matchstick size slices. Do not slice each piece into 1/4 inch/1/2 inch pieces on the horizontal. If you leave them intact, the adobo will be soggy. Heat a non stick or cast iron skillet. Add the chiles and some of the sauce. Let the ingredients sizzle for a few minutes or until the sauce thickens. Stir and turn heat up until it's just a little less smoke appears. Serve.

Random Ingredients: green enchilada sauce,havarti cheese,oat,bisquick,chicken wing,italian sausage link,cocoa,parmesan cheese
title: Bizcochito (Cheesy, Italian-Style Deep-Fry)
ingredients: 1 lb boneless chicken wings, cut in half | 1/4 lb sweet mild italian sausage link, cut in 1/2-inch pieces | 1/2 cup bisquick | 1/2 cup grated havarti cheese | 1/2 cup grated parmesan cheese | 1/4 cup cocoa | 6 cups red and green enchilada sauce | 2 cups oat spoons green enchilada sauce, heated
instructions: Pound chicken wings until thin. Brown sausage in oil in large deep pan.

title: Djs
ingredients: 1 teaspoon garam masala | 1/2 cup cola | 1/2 cup rum
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Serve.

Random Ingredients: almond paste,adzuki bean,pie shell,butterscotch schnapps,flat leaf italian parsley,ra el hanout spice mix,lard,almond extract
title: Almond & Raisin Tartlets With Butterscotch
ingredients: 4 ounces blanched almonds | 2 tablespoons melted lard | 1 large ready rolled pie shell ( store bought is okay ) | 4 ounces adzuki beans, rinsed and drained | 4 tablespoons ra-el hanout spice mix | 4 teaspoons almond extract | 3/4 cup butterscotch schnapps ( homemade or from a can purchased at italian grocer ) | 2 teaspoons dried lard | 1/4 cup slivered almonds | 1 tablespoon chopped flat-leaf italian parsley, for garnish
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Spread the almonds onto a cookie sheet and bake until toasted. Set aside to cool. Heat the lard in a small bowl. Brush the rinsed and drained beans onto the prepared pastry shells. Combine the ra el hanout spice mix with the almond extract in a small bowl, then add the blended schnapps. Remove the shell from the oven and fill the pastry shell with the bean mixture. Replace the shell and bake in a 375 f oven for 8 - 9 minutes, or until the filling is hot and the filling is golden. Remove from the oven and spread the toasted almonds on the pastry or return the crust halves to the oven for a few more minutes until they look toasted and crisp. Remove them from the oven and set on a plate. To serve, cut tarts or serve tartlets with a slice or two of the italian bread, sprinkled with chopped italian parsley.

title: Green Onion Lasagna
ingredients: 5 -6 green onions, including tender green tops | 1 cup whole milk ricotta cheese
instructions: Using a hand grater, grate scallions to yield 2 tablespoons. Combine green onions and ricotta cheese in mixing bowl and mix well. Spread a thin layer of olive/cornstarch mixture on the bottom of a 13 x9 baking tray.. Spread a second layer of the same filling on top of the first layer of scallions. Cover with foil and refrigerate overnight or up to 48 hours. Bake at 375f degrees for 45 - 50 minutes. Allow to cool slightly before slicing.

title: Chicken Olive and Beer
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sunflower oil | 1 tablespoon cumin | 600 g chicken, diced into thin strips | 150 ml beer | 100 g sliced pitted black olives, drained | 1 pinch nutmeg
instructions: Heat the oil in a large frying pan over a high heat and add the cumin. Cook for 1 - 2 minutes then add the chicken and cook for about 5 minutes. Pour over the beer. Cook for 8 - 9 minutes until the chicken is cooked through, stirring occasionally. Add the olives and pinch of nutmeg and mix well, or place on top of the chicken and bake in the oven at 180c/fan 160c/gas 4 for 15 - 20 minutes, or until the chicken is golden and the sauce has thickened slightly. Serve the chicken straight from the pan.

Random Ingredients: peanut,chili powder,kielbasa,green apple,green chile pepper,yellow cornmeal,pork tenderloin
title: Polish Pork and Apple Kielbasa
ingredients: 2 pounds pork tenderloin, cubed | 2 small green apples, chopped | 10 ounces chopped green chile peppers | 12 ounces chopped kielbasa | 1/2 cup chopped peanuts | 1 teaspoon chili powder | 1 cup yellow cornmeal
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. In a large bowl, stir together pork tenderloin cubes and green apples. Fold in chiles, kielbasa, peanuts, and chili powder until evenly coated with the spice. Transfer the Kielbasa to a shallow baking dish. Bake in the preheated oven on a middle rack until the internal temperature reaches 145 degrees f, about 25 minutes. Remove from the oven, let cool 5 minutes, and slice into 1/2 inch slices.

title: Easy Black Bean Filling for Beef and Pork Empanadas
ingredients: 2 cans black beans, drained rinsed and patted dry | 1/2 cup lemon curd ( or lemon juice, 2 tablespoons ) | 24 small beef eye round, trimmed of all visible fat ( about 12-inch diameter if using an empanada ) | 36 mint leaves
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°f generously butter a medium baking sheet. Place the black beans in a medium bowl and cover with cold water.

title: Lestimal Ricotta (Lemon and Vanilla Pasta)
ingredients: 12 lasagna noodles, about 1 lb | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla
instructions: Soak noodles in warm water until ready to use. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Meanwhile, in a bowl, combine the vanilla and 2 tablespoons of water. Stir the vanilla and water mixture together. Drain the linguine noodles and rinse. Add to the boiling water. Simmer 2 minutes or until al dente.

title: Roasted Vegetable Puffs (Healthy)
ingredients: 1 small leek, thinly sliced | 1 tablespoon leek, minced | 1 small eggplant, thinly sliced | 1 cup green peas, frozen | 1 cup kalamata olives ( optional ) | 1/2 cup graham cracker crumbs | 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. To prepare the vegetables, place leek, eggplant, green peas and olives in a large bowl. Drizzle with olive oil and toss to coat. Sprinkle crumbs over vegetables and toss to combine. Transfer vegetable mixture to a baking sheet and bake until vegetables are warmed through and beginning to brown, 20 to 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: pear,lemon wedge,mint leaf,chicken stock,corn flake,penne pasta
title: Pasta with Pear and Lemon Pilaff
ingredients: 500 g penne pasta | 3 pears, roughly chopped | 1 1/2 cups chicken stock | 1 tablespoon lemon juice | 250 g pears, peeled, seeded and roughly chopped | 2 tablespoons finely chopped mint leaves | lemon wedge, to serve
instructions: Cook pasta in a large saucepan of boiling, slated overwater for 5 mins or until just tender and drain. Add pears and chicken stock to the penne and gently heat through, about 1 minute. Meanwhile, season to taste with salt and pepper while the pasta is cooking. Drain pasta, then return to the pan and toss with pears and mint. Serve with lemon wedges.

title: Seared Steak With Quinoa and Orange Pea Nuggets
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa, rinsed and drained | 600 -800 g sirloin blade steaks | 150 g bacon | 150 g dark chocolate, such as crisp | 12 tablespoons orange juice or 6 tablespoons lemon juice
instructions: Prepare 2 large frying pans with a heavy layer of oil. Prepare all your steaks, trimming fat if necessary if necessary and cut crosswise into 6 pieces. Place each piece on a board or baking sheet and flatten so they flatten slightly. Score two thickness of kitchen string 2cmx 1 cm and a little deeper. Cover the steaks with a piece of parchment paper, allowing extra to hang over the sides. Place a baking sheet on the bottom rack of your oven and place a large, heavy frying pan of your desired high heat for steaks. Place bacon, chocolate and 1 tablespoon of orange juice in a wide, shallow frying pan and stir over a gentle heat for 3 minutes. Drain the steaks carefully, reserving the bacon fat. Fry in the hot fat until golden brown, about 3 minutes, remove and place on a paper towel lined warm serving dish, sprinkle with orange juice and dust with the remaining chocolate, if using. Serve immediately.

title: Cauliflower With Chicken and Cauliflower
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs boneless skinless chicken breasts | 1 head cauliflower floret
instructions: Cut the chicken into 1 1/2 inch bite size pieces. Core and peel the cauliflower. Place 4 inches of water on the bottom of a saucepan. Cover and bring to boil. Meanwhile, in a skillet fry the cauliflower for 5 minutes, then drain and add to the chicken. Heat a little oil on the stove set to very low and cover. Cook, stirring regularly, until the cauliflower is crisp tender, then serve over the chicken and cauliflower.

title: Basic Herbed Scented Condiments
ingredients: 2 containers herb flavored store-bought salt-free herb flavored store-bought salt-free store-bought salt-free store-bought salt-free salt-free store-bought salt | 2 -4 tablespoons fresh lime zest
instructions: Combine 3 tablespoons herbed flavored salt and 2 tablespoons lime zest in small bowl and mix thoroughly. Sprinkle 1/4 cup herb flavored salt all over each slice of herbed cheese. Wrap in plastic wrap and refrigerate until chilled, about 2 hours. Serve with toasted pita bread, crisp pita chips or as a topping for pita chips.

title: Easy Quinoa Salad
ingredients: 1 cup cooked quinoa | 1 cup chopped turnip | 8 ounces crumbled goat cheese or 8 ounces other firm cheese | 3 tablespoons chopped pepperoncini peppers | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract
instructions: Place the quinoa in a large bowl, add the turnips, and cheeses. Sprinkle on the pepperoncini peppers, and stir well. Drizzle with olive oil, if desired.

Random Ingredients: cooking spray,sauerkraut,pinto bean,hot green chili pepper,picante sauce,wheat tortilla
title: Cheesy Green Chile Bean Burritos
ingredients: cooking spray | 1 can pinto beans, rinsed and drained | 1 cup sauerkraut, drained ( about 2 ounces, well rinsed and drained ) | 4 tablespoons picante sauce ( mild salsa or hot salsa verde ) | 1/2 hot green chili pepper, minced | 16 whole wheat tortillas, warmed
instructions: Adjust oven rack to middle and heat oven rack to lowest setting. In a medium bowl, combine beans, sauerkraut and picante sauce. Stir in chile and tortillas and transfer to a sprayed 11 by 7 inch baking dish, spreading evenly. Bake, covered, about 17 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes then serve.

Random Ingredients: baby spinach,lamb shoulder,saffron,rotel tomato,red wine,wheat flour,ginger garlic paste
title: Slow Cooker Shish Kabobs with Kidney Beans
ingredients: 3 lbs boneless lamb shoulder, cut into 1-inch dice | 2 packages fresh baby spinach | 12 ounces rotel tomatoes | 2 ounces red wine | 1 teaspoon saffron | 1 package whole wheat flour | 1/2 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste
instructions: Place diced lamb in crock and set to the side.. Add frozen baby spinach and rotel to crock. Add red wine, saffron and ginger garlic paste. Mix and chill to blend flavors. Spray a skillet with cooking spray and heat over medium high heat until very hot. Add flour and cook 1 minute. Place kabobs in the skillet, brown on all sides and serve immediately with rice of your choice. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: pork shoulder,butterscotch chip,onion soup mix,poppy seed,green pepper,cider vinegar
title: German Sausage (Pigs, Pigs & Pigs)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon butter | 2 lbs pork shoulder | 1 medium onion soup mix | 1 jar chopped green peppers, undrained | 1 package butterscotch chips ( mini if you want extra spice ) | 2 tablespoons poppy seeds
instructions: Cut pork across grain in 1/2 inch slices. Brown in butter. Remove pork with slotted spoon or slotted spoon to a bowl. Brown onion soup mix in remaining butter. Add peppers and butterscotch chips. Add meat back to skillet and pour liquid over all. Cover and simmer 10 - 15 minutes. Remove from heat. Sprinkle on dry poppyseeds.

title: Wilde Okra, Okra Stew

instructions: Place okra, cherries, celery, ginger, currants, and sea salt together in a large pot. Cover, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low, and cook slowly about 8 hours, stirring occasionally.
