title: White Pepper Queso
ingredients: 1 jar whole milk ricotta cheese | 1/4 teaspoon white pepper powder | 1/8 teaspoon red bell pepper, ground | 1/8 teaspoon tulsi roasted red peppers, crushed | 2 large ripe plum tomatoes, thinly sliced
instructions: Combine ricotta in a small bowl and set aside. Combine white pepper, red pepper, and tulsi.

title: Penne Pasta
ingredients: 1 pound penne pasta | 1 tablespoon shortening
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Stir in the penne, and boil until tender, about 10 minutes. Drain, and return to the pot. Meanwhile, melt the shortening in a skillet over medium heat. Stir in the cooked pasta, and cook until lightly browned. Serve immediately.

title: Chili Prawns (Shrimp) With Pistachios -
ingredients: 4 prawns, shelled and deveined, tail left on | 1 teaspoon cayenne ( optional ) | 1/2 cup pistachios, coarsely chopped | 2 green chili peppers, sliced | 2 tablespoons peanut oil | 1/2 cup fresh oyster, chopped
instructions: Heat half of the peanut oil in a wok over low heat and add the pistachios and chilies stirring as soon as the oil starts to sizzle. Add half of the shrimp and cook, stirring occasionally, for 5 minutes. Heat the other half of the oil in the wok over high heat and add the other half of the shrimp and pistachios. Cook for 3 - 6 minutes, stirring constantly. Push to one side and add the oysters, cooking for 3 - 4 minutes. Stir and add the remaining shrimp and pistachios to the sauces. Keep stirring until the shrimp are well cooked and the sauce is thick. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: gruyere cheese,yellow squash,wheat flour,chili pepper flake,pine nut,green pea,cream mushroom soup,sugar
title: Stuffed Yellow Squash With Green Peas
ingredients: 6 yellow squash, halved | 1/2 cup whole wheat flour | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1/4 cup sour cream | 2 teaspoons chili pepper flakes | 3/4 cup green peas | 3/4 cup gruyere cheese, grated | 1/4 cup pine nuts, toasted
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Place squash halves cut side down onto greased baking sheet. Bake for 20 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean. Remove from oven, let cool for 20 minutes, then peel off skins. Place squash halves in a bowl. Set aside. In a bowl, combine the flour, cream soup, sour cream, and chili flakes. Beat until smooth. Stir in the peas and green peas, mixing lightly. Place the squash back into the squash shells, brush with the mushroom soup mixture, sprinkle with the cheese. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes or until the cheese is melted.

Random Ingredients: apple,carrot,spanish olive pimento,baking soda,orange juice,parmigiano reggiano cheese
title: Parmigiano-Reggiano, Apple Carrots, and Orange Juice
ingredients: 6 large carrots, peeled and chopped, or more to taste | 1/4 cup orange juice | 3 tablespoons apple-flavored olive pimento, drained | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 1/2 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 2 tablespoons freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano, or more to taste
instructions: Blend carrots, orange juice, olive pimento, and baking soda together in a blender until smooth.

title: Old Fashioned Parsnips and Avocado Fritters
ingredients: 6 parsnips, peeled | 1/2 lb margarine or 1/2 lb butter, for frying | 2 1/2 fluid ounces dry port wine | 1 cup sifted cake flour | 1 cup roughly chopped fresh basil leaf
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 f. Bash the parsnips in boiling water for a minute, then peel, core, and finely grate them. Heat the margarine in a frying pan and fry the parsnips for a couple of minutes until browned. Add the port and bring to the boil, simmer for several minutes. Remove from the heat and add the sifted flour and basil and mix well. Scoop out a heaped spoonful and roll into balls. Put them on a greased baking sheet. Cook for 10 minutes. Serve hot or cold with lemon wedges for squeezing over the fritters.

Random Ingredients: bamboo skewer,maraschino cherry,curry paste,arborio rice,beef roast,coconut
title: A Different Shredded Beef
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs beef roast ( lean ) | 1 tablespoon curry paste | 6 -8 bamboo skewers | 3/4 cup shredded coconut | 1 cup arborio rice - cooked | 3 maraschino cherries, drained | coconut, shredded
instructions: Drain the roast and trim off any excess fat. Place roast and maraschino cherries inside a casserole dish or baking pan. Toss meat with curry paste and pour marinade over meat. Cover tightly and chill for 24 hours. Remove meat from the fridge, remove any excess marinade. Drain meat again. Reserve marinade. Cook meat under broiler until cooked to your liking. I prefer to serve with red rice, a nice red plumbly top and some coconut or shredded coconut. I enjoy this with some chopped carrots and basil, though not a part of the original dish.

title: Ajiaco - Turkey (Or Chicken) Stuffing
ingredients: 2 pints ground turkey or 2 pints ground chicken | 3 lemons, zest of
instructions: Dip the turkey or chicken into the zest.

Random Ingredients: oregano,horseradish,poblano chile,gouda cheese,pesto sauce,red chili pepper
title: Pesto Quesadillas
ingredients: 2 large poblano chiles, with seeds | 1/2 lb gouda cheese or 1/2 lb swiss cheese, cut into 1/4 inch cubes | 1/2 cup purchased pesto sauce | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano | 1/8 teaspoon ground red chili pepper | 1/4 teaspoon horseradish
instructions: Preheat griddle or heavy frying pan over medium heat. Line griddle or skillet with parchment, oil, or spray with cooking spray. Remove chiles from food processor.

Random Ingredients: cumin,almond extract,italian bread,tortilla chip,corn syrup,basil leaf
title: Cumin-Basil Chips Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup slivered almonds ( or sliced almonds, toasted if desired ) or 1/2 cup slivered almonds ( or sliced almonds, toasted if desired ) | 3/4 cup light corn syrup | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract | 1/4 teaspoon ground cumin | 1 loaf italian bread, toasted and cubed | fresh basil leaf ( optional, to garnish )
instructions: In small bowl, combine all dressing ingredients. Toss with toast and garnish with basil leaves if desired.

Random Ingredients: parsnip,carrot,plain yogurt,garlic oil,salt black pepper,white mushroom,dill
title: Easy Parsnip-Mushroom Bruschetta
ingredients: 2 lbs parsnips, peeled and halved lengthwise | 1 teaspoon salt | 2 tablespoons garlic oil | 1 cup plain yogurt, greek style with live cultures | 1 cup carrot, peeled and diced | 1 cup white mushroom, sliced | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon dried dill | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f combine all ingredients except the parsnips in a food processor and grind until desired texture is achieved. You can substitute white mushrooms for the dried mushrooms. Transfer parsnips, carrots and mushrooms to a large bowl. Toss with a little oil to ensure a uniform texture. Season with salt and pepper. Cover and refrigerate for one hour or up to 12 hours, stirring every so often, to develop flavors. Serve chilled.

Random Ingredients: almond meal,italian seasoning,pea,apricot,bacon grease,chili seasoning mix
title: Easy Pea Chili Filling for Baked Pastries
ingredients: 2 teaspoons bacon grease | 1 packet dry chili seasoning mix | 1 package frozen peas | 1/3 cup almond meal | 1 teaspoon dried italian seasoning | 1 cup italian-seasoned chopped fresh apricots
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Lightly grease four 9 x 13 inch cake pans and set aside. In a large skillet, melt bacon grease. Drain chili powder mix well.

title: The Best Honey Crumbs
ingredients: 450 g bread crumbs, coarsely chopped | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 1 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 1/4 cup worcestershire sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 220c/fan 200c/gas mix all ingredients together in a large bowl, leaving some breadcrumbs as mixture should have thick consistency of fine crumbs. Roll mixture into balls. Place on greased oven tray.

Random Ingredients: apple,dark soy sauce,coriander,vegetable oil cooking spray,mustard seed
title: Roast Apple Spices
ingredients: 2 large apples, peeled, stoned, cut into eighths | vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 teaspoon ground mustard seeds | 1 teaspoon ground coriander | dark soy sauce
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200°c or 400°f. Place apple and any spices into a large roasting tin. Add enough dark soy sauce to cover the apple, and mix thoroughly. Roast in the centre of the oven for 30 minutes, reduce heat to 150c and continue to roast, stirring every 20 minutes for a further 5 - 15 hours until apples are soft and cooked. Allow to cool completely. To freeze, place apple and spice into a plastic bag and seal thoroughly, or transfer to an airtight container and put into the freezer for up to 3 months.

title: Carrots (Champaign) Welsh
ingredients: 1 lb carrot, peeled, cut in 1/8-inch thick rounds, washed | 1/8 teaspoon mace
instructions: Fill a large pot with water and bring to a boil. Add the carrots, mace and salt to taste. Place over low to medium heat and simmer over medium heat, stirring often, until the carrots are tender, about 20 minutes for medium carrots, 15 minutes for well cooked carrots. Makes 6 servings.

title: Hacienda (Mexican Beans)
ingredients: 2 dried red chili peppers ( or to taste ) | 1/2 cup dried pinto bean or 1/2 cup chickpeas, soaked overnight | 1 medium white onion, chopped | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon crushed red chili pepper, to taste
instructions: Heat a medium size pot over medium heat. Add the red chilies and cook them until they begin to soften. This will take approximately 2 minutes. Add the soaked beans and let them stew on top for about 10 minutes. In a food processor or blender add the onion and red chilies and pulse until the onion is fully minced. Add the ground red chilies and pulse a few times until everything is combined. Remove the mixture from the processor and form into a small pattie patties. Cook the patties over medium high heat for about 8 minutes per side, or until they are browned on both sides. You should hear small pieces of pbq. This usually takes about 6 - 8 minutes. Serve on a plate and top with your favorite mexican condiments such as sour cream, cachupas, mexican beans, cheese.

title: Easy Low Fat  "french Style" Beans
ingredients: 8 ounces small vegetarian refried beans | 4 ounces fat-free shortening | 2 garlic cloves, crushed | 4 ounces fresh pimiento, chopped
instructions: Melt shortening in pan. Add garlic, stir fry 1/2 minutes. Add refried beans, stir fry 1 minute. Add pimiento, stir fry 2 minutes. Serve hot or cold.

Random Ingredients: canadian bacon,cinnamon,vanilla,sun tomato,bulb garlic,half cream,yellow bell pepper,dark chocolate
title: Warm Chocolate Spiced Peppers With Crisp Garlic & Canadian Bacon
ingredients: 1 slice canadian bacon ( can be a dark green also ) | 3 ounces sun-dried tomatoes ( any dried red tomato will do ) | 3 ounces semi-sweet dark chocolate, chopped | 2 tablespoons canadian bacon drippings or 2 tablespoons dark balsamic vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla | 1/4 teaspoon cinnamon | 1 large bulb of garlic, cloves peeled | 1 can fat-free half-and-half cream
instructions: Preheat broiler. Place the canadian bacon slices, sundried tomatoes, chocolate, vinegar, cinnamon and garlic in the bottom of a small dish. Add the drippings or balsamic to the saucepan. Place pan in a preheated oven and broil for 2 minutes on each side. Top with cream and a bit of grated cheese if you desire.

Random Ingredients: italian parsley,black tea,pork tenderloin,baby pea,maple syrup,cherry tomato
title: Pork Tenderloin Medallions
ingredients: 1 can baby peas, rinsed and drained | 1/2 cup diced canned sweet pickled cherry tomatoes | 2 teaspoons maple syrup | 1 teaspoon dried italian parsley | 1 beef minute lean pork tenderloin, trimmed | 2 teaspoons black tea, brewed
instructions: Combine peas, tomatoes, maple syrup, parsley, and pork tenderloin in a gallon sized freezer bag.

title: Easy French Onion Soup
ingredients: 1 package dry onion soup mix | 1 celery rib, finely diced
instructions: Combine all ingredients in saucepan on medium heat bring to boil.

Random Ingredients: green olive,basmati rice,chili powder,green onion,cayenne pepper,coconut water
title: Oriental White Rice
ingredients: 1 cup basmati rice, rinsed | 1/2 - 3/4 cup coconut water | 2/3 cup green olives, chopped | 1/4 tablespoon green onion, minced | 1/2 teaspoon chili powder ( or more to taste ) | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper, to taste
instructions: Place the rice, coconut water, olives, onion, and chili power in a saucepan over medium high heat. Bring to a boil. Cover, reduce heat to low, and simmer until the liquid is absorbed, about 15 minutes.

title: Swedish Smoked Salmon
ingredients: 4 salmon steaks or 1 1/2 kg salmon | 1 tablespoon vanilla | 1 tablespoon allspice | 1 tablespoon tabasco sauce
instructions: Place all ingredients in a large pan and simmer until the mixture thickens slightly. Place the salmon in a lightly oiled casserole dish and pour the marinade over. Cover with greased reynolds wrap aluminium foil and bake in a preheated oven at 180ºc for 1 hour. Remove the aluminum foil and bake further 15 minutes. Remove from oven and allow to stand for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Mexican Vegetable Wontons
ingredients: 1 jar sweet vegetables, drained ( such as bell peppers, zucchini, carrots, mushrooms ) | 2 tablespoons diced canned fire-roasted tomatoes, drained ( or salsa, if desired ) | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 1 package wonton wrappers, thawed if frozen | fresh lime wedge ( to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Heat oven to 375°f. Drain vegetables and tomatoes, reserving juice. Place chopped vegetables in a small bowl, then mash with a fork or potato masher. Stir in chicken granules or reserved juice, if desired. Place 1 heaping tablespoon of filling in centre of each wrapper, and press two opposite edges together, pressing together. Place wontons on a cookie sheet. Bake for approximately 10 minutes or until crisp or golden brown. Remove to wire racks.

Random Ingredients: cream cheese,dark soy sauce,ginger,tomato,romano cheese,hard egg
title: Eggplant (Aubergine)  Rollups (Vegetarian)
ingredients: 12 eggs ( or 6 egg whites ) | 3 tablespoons light cream cheese | 1/4 cup romano cheese, grated ( pref. fresh grated cheese ) | 1 tablespoon dark sweet soy sauce | 1 tablespoon fresh ginger, chopped fine ( optional ) | 6 -8 ripe tomatoes, sliced
instructions: Mix the cream cheese, romano, sweet soy sauce, and ginger together. Cut the tomatoes in half lengthwise, scoop out the pulp and seeds, then arrange them in a rectangle on a lightly greased baking sheet. Dollop about half the creamy mixture onto each slice of eggplant, spreading the cream cheese mixture in an even layer across the entire surface. Broil lightly, about 5 minutes and remove the tomato skins, but do not burn them. Allow to cool and serve at room temperature. Variation, for a very simple variation for a vegetarian main dish, replace the cream cheese with tofu.

Random Ingredients: rum extract,green chili pepper,beef broth,farfalle pasta
title: Spicy Rum Mac & Beef
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef round | 1 can beef broth | 2 tablespoons rum extract ( can use 1/2 tsp. to 3/4 tsp. of your favorite extract ) | 1 package farfalle pasta
instructions: In skillet over medium high heat, brown the ground round about 5 minutes. Drain, add beef broth to skillet and let cook about 10 minute. Reduce heat, add rum extract, stir and cook about 3 minute serve over mac & beef.

title: Souper Okra
ingredients: 1 lb okra, fresh if possible | 1 package frozen chopped okra
instructions: Cook okra until tender.

title: Golden Syrup for Dipping
ingredients: 1 teaspoon asafoetida powder, powder | 1 teaspoon sunflower oil or 1 teaspoon ghee | 1 teaspoon grated romano cheese
instructions: Heat the agave nectar or the ghee on medium, low heat to almost a simmer. Add the asafoetida powder and the romano cheese. Let simmer for 2 minutes. Add the ghee and mix well.

Random Ingredients: chambord raspberry liquor,white mushroom,egg white,spinach leaf,hash brown,kosher salt
title: French Mushroom and Spinach Pie
ingredients: 6 ounces fresh white mushrooms ( sliced or finely chopped ) | 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt | 1/2 lb frozen frozen hash browns, thawed thawed | 3 tablespoons chambord raspberry liquor | 1 egg white | 1 cup whole spinach leaves, thawed
instructions: Mix the potatoes, chambord and egg white on medium heat for a couple of minutes.

title: Slow Cooker Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 4 whole beef tenderloin steaks, about 4 to 6 pounds. each | 1 cup apple cider | 1/2 cup orange sugar
instructions: Place steaks in slow cooker, positioning them 2 inches apart. Pour cider and sugar over steaks. Cover, and cook on low setting until meat has fallen into the slow cooker, 8 to 10 hours.

title: Indian Corn Salad
ingredients: 1 cup frozen sweetcorn, thawed | 1 can chopped unsweetened canned pineapple, drained and juice reserved | 1 tablespoon fresh-grated ginger paste | 1/3 cup chopped pimiento | 1/4 teaspoon savory | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh dill
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the corn, pineapples, ginger paste, pimiento, savory and dill. Spoon in pineapple juice and gently stir. Cover and chill in the refrigerator 1 to 4 hours before serving.

title: Cheese Pockets
ingredients: 3 cups grated cheese ( i like cheddar and swiss cheese ) or 3 cups shredded cheese ( i like cheddar and swiss cheese ) | freshly chopped chives or 2 teaspoons dried chives, to garnish ( optional )
instructions: Heat oven to 400º. Spray cookie sheet with olive oil or spray foil. In medium bowl, stir together 1 1/2 cups grated cheese & 1/4 cup cheese mixture & set aside. Sprinkle chives over 1/3 cup cheese mixture, pressing to adhere. Cut into 12 pockets, place on cookie sheet & bake for 12 - 15 minutes, until golden brown & heated through. Cool for 2 minutes on cookie sheet. Use scissors to split & serve, if desired.

title: Filling for Peruvian Steak
ingredients: 1 large onion soup mix ( envelope ) | 1/2 cup canned sliced limes and wedges | 12 squares filling, thawed for dipping
instructions: Spray a deep skillet with nonstick spray. Combine onion soup mix, lime juice and drained peruvian steak.

Random Ingredients: pineapple,turmeric,chicken breast,breadcrumb,red curry paste,vanilla pudding mix,cilantro leaf,white wine vinegar
title: Curry Chicken on a Stick
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts | 8 ounces crushed pineapple, drained | 1/4 cup dried breadcrumbs | 1/4 cup finely chopped fresh cilantro leaves | 1/4 cup dry white wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon vanilla pudding mix, instant | 1 teaspoon reduced-sodium red curry paste, mild | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric
instructions: Using a meat mallet, pound chicken breasts to 1/4 thickness and then cut them into strips 3 to 4 wide. Drain Pineapple, then cut it into chunks. Place it in a bowl with pineapple chunks and breadcrumbs, and mix with hand to combine. Mix the cilantro, vinegar, pudding mix, curry paste and turmeric in a small bowl and set aside. Sprinkle both sides of chicken with the spice mixture, then coat both sides with the spice mixture. In a large skillet, bring 3/4 inch water to a boil and lower the heat, placing your chicken in the water. Allow the chicken to cook until the coating is quite dry, about 5 minutes on each side. Remove from pan, and set aside. Continue warming the drippings until you have about 3/4 cup. Transfer the skillet to an oven safe pan and set the pan in your oven. Heat the drippings until they are almost smoking, then transfer them to the chicken. Cook in the oven for 20 minutes, until the chicken is cooked through and the topping is golden and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: lard,lime juice,beef rib,brown rice,coffee,cream mushroom soup,seashell pasta,cocoa powder
title: Spanish Chocolate Pasta - Fast and easy
ingredients: 3 lbs beef short ribs | 4 tablespoons cocoa powder | 1 cup sour cream | 1/2 cup packed brown rice | 1/2 cup prepared instant coffee | 1 lime, juice of | 4 cans condensed cream of mushroom soup | 4 boxes seashell pasta
instructions: In large pot brown ribs and remove meat and discard bones. Pour off excess fat and return meat back to pot. In small bowl combine cocoa, sour cream and instant coffee, mix well then pour over meat and stir in lime juice, soup and seashells. Cook at low temp until noodles are tender. Serve over hot noodles.

title: Mexican Bean Soup
ingredients: 6 cups hot chicken broth | 2 cans kidney beans, drained ( white kidney beans are best ) | soy sauce
instructions: Warm the chicken broth in a pot until heated through. Add the beans to the broth and simmer over low heat for about 20 minutes or until beans are tender. Add soy sauce to taste and serve at once.

Random Ingredients: clear honey,curry powder,bay leaf,guajillo chilies,vegetable stock,filet beef
title: Quick Beef Curry
ingredients: 2 cups vegetable stock | 4 slices filet of beef | 1 cup guajillo chilies, seeded and sliced lengthways into thick chunks or 1 cup cayenne pepper | 1 bay leaf | 1/2 teaspoon curry powder | clear honey, to drizzle
instructions: Bring the stock to the boil and bring to the boil. Add the beef and turn down the heat immediately and cook for about 10minutes. Drain meat and set aside. Strain stock through a sieve into a clean pan, setting up in the stock. Add chillies and bay leaf and simmer for about 2 minutes until the chillies have softened. Add the curry powder and stir to combine. Drizzle with honey and serve.

title: Mascarpone Filling for Ravioli or Bakes
ingredients: 3 lbs mascarpone | 5 -6 lemons, juice and zest of
instructions: Whisk mascarpone and lemon zest in a bowl until mixture resembles fine breadcrumbs, about 2 minutes. Strain through a fine sieve to remove any impurities. You may be able to use an immersion blender with this. Gradually add the lemon juice and continue to whisk until mixture becomes slightly thicker and lighter in color. Do not overprocess. Pour over desired filling and refrigerate.

Random Ingredients: parmigiano reggiano cheese,red enchilada sauce,tamari,blueberry,lemon pepper,cheddar cheese soup
title: Blueberry and Tamari Chili Cheese Dip
ingredients: 1 can condensed cheddar cheese soup | 1 can red enchilada sauce ( or your own ) | 1 can blueberries, rinsed and drained | 1 lemon pepper | 1/4 cup tamari ( or soy sauce ) | 1/2 cup unsalted parmigiano-reggiano cheese or 1/2 cup romano cheese
instructions: In a casserole place all ingredients, stir well and heat on low heat for 20 - 30 minutes. Serve with crackers or bagels, if desired.

title: Mandarin Sourdough Loaf
ingredients: 2 cups bread flour ( i use ap flour ) | 1 can mandarin oranges, drained and chopped
instructions: Add all ingredients in a bowl or food processor. Process until smooth. Spray a 5 x 3 loaf pan with cooking spray. Pour mixture into pan. Bake at 350°f for about 45 - 55 minutes until browned about 15 - 20 minutes. Serve warm with fruit.

Random Ingredients: mango chutney,sea salt,liquid smoke,gouda cheese,sugar syrup,green bell pepper
title: Smokin' Hot Grilled Cheese!
ingredients: 1 tablespoon light sugar syrup | 1/4 cup mango chutney ( you can find in asian or mexican stores ) | 1 small green bell pepper, roasted, peeled and chopped finely ( fresh, not canned ) | 1/2 teaspoon liquid smoke | kosher sea salt, for garnish | 1/2 cup gouda cheese, shredded
instructions: Prepare grill. Lightly brush a baking sheet with oil and arrange your grill rack in that order. Pour about two teaspoons of the chutney in the middle of your grill. Sprinkle a scant 1/4 teaspoons of the green chutney evenly on top of the chutney and sprinkle with salt. Put the grill on low and add the bell pepper. Cook until the bell pepper is softened, 3 - 8 minutes. Remove from grill. Using a sharp knife, cut the cheese into eight equal slices. Transfer the cheese to a serving platter. Garnish with the additional green chutney. Serve with your favourite barbecue sauce. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: green chilies,splenda sugar substitute,red chili pepper,golden syrup,egg,mozzarella,dill
title: Green Chilies Muffins - Homemade
ingredients: 2 eggs | 8 ounces green chilies, roasted and seeded | 1 1/2 cups shredded mozzarella | 1/4 cup splenda sugar substitute | 2 tablespoons golden syrup | 1/3 cup fresh dill, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon crushed red chili pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. In a large bowl mix together eggs, chilies and cheese. Add splenda, syrup, dill and red pepper if desired. Pour mixture into lightly greased 12 muffin cups. Bake for 12 minutes or until brown and set.

Random Ingredients: taco shell,white kidney bean,herbes de provence,madeira wine,cachaca,chocolate cake mix
title: Mexican Chocolate Torte
ingredients: 1 box potato cake mix | 1 can white kidney beans, rinsed and drained | 1/4 cup herbes de provence | 2 tablespoons herbes de provence | 1/2 cup madeira wine | 1 prepared tacatillo taco shells | 1 piece bittersweet chocolate covered banana chocolate square or 1 piece semi-sweet chocolate-covered chocolate kisses, optional
instructions: Dump the potato cake mix and all of the beans into a large bowl. Add the herbes de provence, herbes de provence, and madeira. Pour the wine over just the top until the mixture is moist. Sprinkle on the taco shells. Sprinkle the top with chocolate and top with the torte. Place in a 450° oven for approximately 15 minutes. Turn on the broiler and broil for an additional 5 minutes.

title: Baked Irish Stew
ingredients: 1 lb lamb shoulder, cut 1 inch cubes | 1/4 cup kraft 2 % cream or 1/4 cup sharp cheddar cheese, shredded | kosher salt, 1 tsp | 16 waffles, warmed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Combine lamb, cheese, and salt in a bowl. Arrange 1 waffle in 6 individual baking dishes. Layer meat mixture on half of the waffles, then spread rest of the waffles on top. Bake in oven until golden brown, 20 - 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: shiitake mushroom,white flour,kosher salt pepper,pork loin
title: Homemade Beef Stock
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs pork loin, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 teaspoon kosher salt and pepper | 1 1/2 pounds fresh shiitake mushrooms, cleaned and stemmed | 1 1/2 cups unbleached white flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. In a medium bowl, combine the pork, salt, and pepper. Place into a roasting pan, and roast until browned. Remove from oven, and set aside. Remove the stems of the shiitake mushrooms, and chop the caps into large pieces. Place the mushrooms into the roasting pan. Add the broth to the pan, and add the flour. Shake the pan often, so the cornmeal settles around the edges of the pan. Cover the pan, and bake in the preheated oven until the meat is tender this will take about 1 hour. You can remove the roast from the oven, and place it into a deep platter, cover with foil, and allow to rest about 10 minutes before serving. Note, if you use fresh shiitake mushrooms, remove the stems, and slice off the bottom of the caps. Serve hot or warm.

title: Macaroni and Peppers and Potatoes
ingredients: 1 box elbow macaroni | 2 medium potatoes | 2 cups sugar ( optional )
instructions: Cook macaroni until tender.

Random Ingredients: cod fish fillet,onion soup mix,cherry tomato
title: Cod Fish with cherry Tomato
ingredients: 1 can cherry tomatoes, drained and juice reserved | 1 packet dry onion soup mix | 4 cod fish fillets, cut into cubes
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees celsius. Place all ingredients except red fish, in a roasting dish. Sprinkle with red fish and bake 40 minutes or until fish is cooked through and sauce is bubbling.

Random Ingredients: green onion,poblano chile,deli roast beef,bean,fennel seed,mirin,celery rib,garlic salt
title: Beef and Bean Burritos
ingredients: 3 cans refried beans | 4 poblano chiles, roasted, peeled and sliced into 1/4 inch thick strips | 2 cups celery ribs, thinly sliced | 2 cups thinly sliced green onions | 1 teaspoon garlic salt | 1 teaspoon ground fennel seed | 1/4 cup mirin ( sweet rice wine ) | 1/2 lb deli roast beef
instructions: In a large skillet, warm the refried beans over medium heat until well heated, about 5 minutes. Add the poblano chiles and celery, saute for 3 - 4 minutes. Remove from the heat, cover, and set aside. In a small bowl, combine the green onions, garlic salt, fennel seed, and mirin. Heat oven to 500 degrees. Place the roast beef on a large baking sheet which has been sprayed with nonstick cooking spray. Roast about 20 minutes or until the meat registers 160 degrees on meat thermometer. Using your hands, spread the meat out evenly in the pan. Pour the vegetable mixture over the roast beef and spread evenly. Bake for 5 - 10 minutes or until vegetables are tender. Top with the roasted, peeled, and sliced green onions.

title: Fried Noodles
ingredients: 3 tomatoes, diced | 1 serrano chili, de-seeded and chopped | 1 pinch saffron, crushed ( optional ) | hot cooked meat ( shrimp or chicken, as desired ) | cooked rice noodles
instructions: Combine the tomatoes, chile, and saffron in a medium non stick pan over medium, stirring occasionally. Reduce heat to low. Simmer, stirring often, for about 10 minutes or until most of the liquid has evaporated. Stir in the meat and cook over medium heat to heat through and cook through. Stir frequently. Serve over rice noodles.

title: Kritikakia - Parsnip and Feta Mushroom Fritters (Bifernia Bkaila)
ingredients: 8 ounces parsnips, peeled, cut into 2-inch cubes | 12 ounces portabella mushrooms, cleaned and cut into 2-inch cubes | 2 hard-boiled eggs, chopped | 3 ounces cashew nuts, chopped | 2 tablespoons dry white wine | 1 1/4 teaspoons baking soda | 1 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1/2 cup crumbled feta
instructions: Place the parsnips in a steamer and wilt in boiling water until they are cooked through. Reserve 1 cup of the cooked parsnips, then drain well. Place vegetables in an oven proof baking dish. Melt butter over medium low heat in a skillet. Stir in the sauteed parsnips, mushrooms, and chopped hard boiled eggs. Sprinkle the cashew nuts over the vegetables. Dissolve the baking soda in the wine and pour over the vegetables. Sprinkle the nutmeg all over. Bake in a 325 degree f oven until the tops are browned and the parsnips start to turn tender. Sprinkle crumbled feta on top to serve.

title: Potatoes in a Mushroom Sauce
ingredients: 6 -8 medium potatoes ( about 2 pounds ) | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 can plum tomatoes, drained | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace | 1 1/2 teaspoons cornstarch | 1 can pitted ripe cherries in tomato sauce, undrained
instructions: Coat a large skillet with cooking spray. Place the potatoes in the skillet. Add enough water to cover the potatoes.

title: Creamy Maple Pork Loaf
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds ground pork | 3/4 cup crushed graham cracker crumbs | 3/4 cup maple syrup | 1/3 cup mirin | 1 cup heavy cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Spray a 9x5 inch loaf pan with cooking spray. Mix ground pork, graham cracker crumbs, maple syrup, and mirin together in a bowl until well mixed. Press into the prepared pan. Bake in the preheated oven until well browned and slightly crisp, 35 to 45 minutes. When the loaf is nearly cool, cover it with a tea towel and refrigerate until cold, about 3 hours. When ready to serve, remove from the refrigerator and cut into slices about 1/2 inch thick. Lay flat in a mound on a serving plate, then drizzle with cream to serve.

title: Persian Yogurt
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups plain yogurt, drained ( full fat recommended ) | 1 tablespoon fresh lemon juice | 1 teaspoon turmeric ( optional )
instructions: In a serving bowl, mix together the yogurt, lemon juice, and turmeric. Chill well in refrigerator.

title: Hake
ingredients: 1 package pre-shredded hake fillets | 1 cup half-and-half cream | 1 clove garlic
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. In a 9x13 inch baking dish, spread half and half cream. Smear on hake fillets with garlic. Bake in the preheated oven for 10 to 15 minutes to finish a fish fillet's cooking. Serve right away.

Random Ingredients: red pepper,tomato green chile pepper,nonfat cream,jumbo pasta shell,horseradish,salt
title: Red Pepper Enchiladas
ingredients: 10 jumbo pasta shells | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chile peppers | 1/3 cup diced red pepper | 1/4 cup nonfat sour cream | 1 tablespoon prepared horseradish | 1/2 teaspoon salt
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Stir in the jumbo pasta shells, and return to a boil. Cook the pasta uncovered, stirring occasionally, until cooked through but still slightly firm, about 12 minutes. Drain well in a colander set in the sink. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Spread the diced tomatoes with green chile peppers on the bottom of a baking dish that has been sprayed with cooking spray. Layer the jumbo pasta shells evenly with diced red pepper and jumbo tomato mixture. In a bowl, blend the sour cream with horseradish and salt.

title: Pecan Spice
ingredients: 1 cup pecans | cooking spray | freshly ground black pepper to taste | 2 green bell pepper, sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Prepare a baking sheet with cooking spray. Spread pecans onto the baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until nuts become fragrant, about 4 minutes. Remove them from oven and shake off any excess pecans. Return pan to oven.

Random Ingredients: endive,fish stock,louisiana sauce,fritos corn chip,marsala wine,pineapple chunk,caper
title: Marinated Endive
ingredients: 1/2 cup bottled fish stock | 1/2 cup catalina steak sauce | 1/4 cup capers | 1 can pineapple chunks, drained | 2 tablespoons dry marsala wine | 1 pound endives, leaves cut into 1-inch pieces | 1 pound fritos corn chips | 1/4 cup louisiana-style hot sauce
instructions: In a medium bowl, stir together fish stock and catalina steak sauce. Pour into a saucepan, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat, and simmer until sauce is reduced by 1/, 15 to 20 minutes. Place pineapple and capers into a separate bowl, and pour into the sauce. Add marsala wine, and toss with endives. Cover, and refrigerate 1 to 3 hours. To serve, sprinkle fritos and hot sauce on serving plates, and spoon some sauce over each.

title: Baked Beans
ingredients: 1 lb dried ham, cut into 1/2 inch pieces | 1 package dry bay leaf | 1/2 teaspoon dried savory, crushed | 1/2 cup brewed coffee, cooled | 1 teaspoon grainy mustard | 1 1/2 cups medium carrots, sliced
instructions: Place meat and bay leaf in a large bowl. Stir in the other ingredients. Cover and refrigerate overnight, turning occasionally. Remove the cover before serving.

title: German Chocolate Barbecue Hamburger Helper
ingredients: 1 box hamburger bun | 1 package german chocolate cake mix | 1/2 cup vinegar ( not soda, use white sweetener )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Drain hamburger mixture well and place in greased 2 1/2 to 3 1/2 quart or bigger dutch oven or other deep oven proof skillet with a tight fitting lid. Prepare the following ingredients while cooking, 1 cup water, 1/4 cup vinegar, 1 teaspoon sugar or 1/2 teaspoon brown sugar. Mix together well. Pour mixture on top of browned hamburger in skillet. Cook for 5 or 6 minutes on stove top. Pour hot syrup, vinegar, brown sugar over all. Close lid and bake for 5 to 10 minutes, or until top of loaf is browned.

title: Choclovers' Chocloaf
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs chocloafs, cut in half | 3 lbs ground pork or 3 lbs ground veal | 2 teaspoons chambord raspberry liquor ( optional ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons orecchiette ( or other small pasta shape ) | 1 1/2 cups cut green peas
instructions: Mix cooked chocloaf ingredients together. Shape into 1 1/2 meat loaf loaves. Bake, uncovered, in a 350° oven for 35 minutes. Or bake a loaf and bake in a 350° oven for 3 1/2 minutes,. Let cool on a baking rack. Remove top foil and bake for 20 minutes. Loosen with a knife, cut loaf into wedges, or cut on diagonal into 1/4 slices. Arrange on large serving platter and put fresh salad on the side.

Random Ingredients: marjoram,dark rum,sesame seed,drambuie,romaine lettuce,purple onion,mustard seed,pine nut
title: Rum Salad with Toasted Sesame Seeds
ingredients: 1 head romaine lettuce, rinsed ( about 1 cup packed ) | 1 package fresh rambuie rolls, cut in half | 1/4 cup dark rum | 3 tablespoons sesame seeds | chopped purple onion | chopped marjoram | 2 tablespoons sesame seeds | 1 tablespoon dark rum | 1/4 cup thinly sliced rinsed drained roasted pine nuts
instructions: Arrange rinsed romaine in a glass salad bowl, and top with the dried rolls. Whisk 1/4 cup rum, 3 tablespoons sesame seeds, and chopped onion in a small bowl. Gently pour over romaine, and toss to coat evenly. Sprinkle with marjoram and sesame seeds. Drizzle on a little extra dark rum and toss to coat evenly. Serve immediately. Makes 2 sandwiches.

title: Tilapia Fillet With Dates
ingredients: 4 tilapia fillets, approx 5 ounces each | 1 ounce butter | 8 -10 pitted dates, stoned and sliced | 1/4 cup white wine vinegar | 5 tablespoons double cream | 2 teaspoons dried marjoram | 3 ounces thin spaghetti
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300°f melt the butter in a frying pan and cook the tomatoes over a medium heat for 4 - 5 minutes. Remove the tomatoes, and then leave to cool. Dry the tilapia fillets between kitchen paper using a brush. Put the dates in a bowl and cover with water, put in a microwave and on high power for 1 minute until soft. Break up with your fingers, and drain. Add the vinegar to the tomatoes, bring to the boil, and then simmer for 2 minutes, until syrupy. Add the cream and marjoram and stir. Season with salt and pepper. Pour over the tilapia fillets, and then drizzle with the marjoram sauce and cook for 6 - 7 minutes, until the fish just turns opaque. Serve at once, or keep warm in the oven. Cook the spaghetti until al dente, drain. Whip the cream and fold through the drained spaghetti, top with the tilapia, and serve with the sauce.

Random Ingredients: simple syrup,pomegranate,almond extract,part mozzarella cheese,port wine,ginger paste,rom tomato
title: Pomegranate Almond Tart Sent by Angels
ingredients: 1 pomegranate, seed removed and patted dry | 3 tablespoons simple syrup, warmed | 1/4 cup ground almonds or 1/4 cup whole almonds, toasted | 2 slices roma tomatoes | 3 -4 tablespoons grated fresh ginger paste | 1 1/2 tablespoons pomegranate | 1/4 cup part-skim mozzarella cheese, finely shredded
instructions: Prepare tart shells and arrange them in circles on a baking sheet. Arrange tart shells in a circle in a circle around the rim of two of the baking sheets. Preheat oven to 375°f. In a small saucepan, heat the syrup, almond extract, ground cinnamon and ground ginger with warm pomegranate, stir in grated cheese and remove from heat. Spoon the pomegranate mixture into the tart shells and place tart shells on top of them. Bake until the crust is lightly golden and the filling is slightly puffed or golden brown, 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Spinach With Tomatoes and Oregano
ingredients: 1 lb spinach leaves | 4 medium tomatoes, thinly sliced
instructions: Wash and clean spinach leaves, removing any stems or other tough pieces of tough stems. Separate leaves and then cut in half. Prepare tomato slices with a slotted spoon. Place sliced ingredients in a large dish, sprinkling each piece with tomato, and toss thoroughly. Serve immediately, at room temperature.

title: Mexican Chocolate Mousse
ingredients: 1 lb mexican chocolate, grated | 1/4 lb demerara sugar
instructions: Cut chocolate into small bits and place in a pan of hot water. Cook for 2 mins or until soft. Pour into bowl and roll in sugar, stirring well to dissolve sugar. Serve in small dishes.

title: Creamy Bulghur Wheat Patties
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked bulgar wheat | 1 can sliced cremini mushrooms | 1 cup shredded cheddar cheese | 1 teaspoon ground black pepper
instructions: Heat a skillet over medium heat. Cook and stir bulgur in the hot skillet until lightly browned, about 5 minutes. Stir mushrooms into bulgur. Sprinkle cheddar cheese over mixture. Gently mix into bulgur mixture just until cheese is melted. Cook until heated through, 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Vegetarian Manicotti
ingredients: 1/2 lb penne | 1 package manicotti shells ( frozen ) | 8 cups assorted fresh vegetables ( sliced ) | 1 cup swiss cheese, grated | 6 teaspoons diced fresh poblano chiles ( diced ) | 1 bell pepper, diced
instructions: Cook penne in boiling water for 10 minutes or until al dente. Drain and set aside. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Cut a slit into the side. Remove the cap from manicotti shells so they will sit upright on the pan. Place stuffed pasta shells on the boiling water and cook 5 - 7 minutes, or until the shells are tender. Drain well and place back into the pan. Add enough water to the pasta mixture to barely cover the shells. Cook noodles in boiling water for 3 - 5 minutes or until al dente. Drain well. Reserve a small amount of the pasta cooking water to make the stuffing later. Place a little pasta water in a bowl and toss with some drained manicotti until just mixed. Place half the uncooked manicotti shells into the pasta bowl. Add half the vegetables. Sprinkle each with 1/4 cup swiss cheese. Add 1/2 cup poblano pepper and another 1/2 cup poblano pepper. Toss to combine. Top with the remainder of the manicotti pasta mixture and mozzarella cheese. Place in a 12x8 casserole dish. Top with remaining cheese. Cover with foil. Bake at 350 degrees f for 30 minutes or until hot all the way through.

title: The Perfect Pork Cake
ingredients: 500 g ground pork | 500 g icing sugar | 2 cans water | 1 tablespoon baking soda | orange peel ( optional ) or lemon peel ( optional )
instructions: Mix everything together in large bowl. Pour into greased oven dish. Heat oven until top layer is dry and bubbly at centre of oven. About 80 minutes into baking time, remove from oven. Turn out cake onto an oven tray and bake for about 1 hour. Turn out. Let cool. Cut cake. Enjoy.

title: Spiced and Spicy Chowder
ingredients: 1 cup pasta sauce with mushrooms | 1 pound sliced andouille sausage | 1 jar pasta sauce with mushrooms | 1/4 cup chili oil | ground cinnamon, or to taste
instructions: Place a dutch oven or large skillet over medium heat. Bring a pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add pasta sauce, and swirl the hot sauce mixture in the boiling water, stirring to blend. Reduce heat, and simmer 1 hour, stirring occasionally. While the pasta is cooking, slice andouille sausage into 3/4 inch slices with a sharp knife. Place sausage slices in another bowl, and mix with pasta sauce. Heat chili oil in a small skillet over medium heat, and sprinkle with ground cinnamon. Add cooked andouille sausage and cook until lightly browned, 4 to 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: beet,meatless spaghetti sauce,chicken stock,artificial sweetener,winter squash
title: Artificial Sweetened Oranges
ingredients: 4 large beets | 1 pound frozen cooked winter squash | 1 cup chicken stock | 1 can no-salt-added meatless spaghetti sauce | 2 teaspoons artificial sweetener
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Place beets in a large pot with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil.

title: Italian Chicken Wings
ingredients: 1 lb chicken wings | 1/2 cup honey mustard | 12 ounces rigatoni pasta
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Spray 13x9x2 baking dish with veggie spray. Place chicken wings in dish, brush and coat with honey dressing. Bake in oven for 1 hour and 20 minutes. Cook pasta according to package directions. Remove from oven and toss with remaining cooked chicken wings.

Random Ingredients: poblano chile,fish,celery rib,pesto sauce,peppercorn,pepper sauce,strawberry preserve,cashew
title: Smoked Fish and Strawberry Jam Salad
ingredients: 1 tablespoon pesto sauce | 4 poblano chiles - seeded and halved lengthwise | 1 tablespoon crushed pepper sauce | 10 pimento stuffed olives | 3 tablespoons chopped celery ribs | 2 packages smoked fish | 1/2 cup chopped fresh strawberries with stems and pieces, or to taste | 2 tablespoons chopped cashews
instructions: Heat pesto sauce in a small skillet over medium heat. Remove from heat and pour into a large bowl. Add poblano peppers and coarsely chop into chunks. Stir pepper sauce into pesto, then add pimento stuffed olives and celery. Let stand 10 minutes to marinate. Cut smoked fish into bite sized wedges and layer into bowl. Pour strawberry jam over fish, then drizzle with fruit dressing. Sprinkle with chopped cashews. Serve with pita chips.

title: Lemon Pork Tenderloin
ingredients: 4 thick slices bacon | 6 tablespoons rolled oats | 1 teaspoon grated lemon peel | 12 ounces pork tenderloin, trimmed | 1/2 cup milk
instructions: Cook bacon until crisp, remove to paper towel to drain, leaving fat in pan. Saute bacon just until browned, remove from pan. Add to pork. In large bowl, mix oats, lemon peel and 1/4 cup water, add to pork. Place pork in crock pot, bake low 8 – 10 hours or until cooked.

Random Ingredients: icing sugar,tomato ketchup,roquefort cheese,raisin,heavy whipping cream,veal roast,tabasco sauce
title: Veal Chops With Raisins and Tomatoes
ingredients: 3 lbs veal roast, trimmed | 1 cup raisins | 1/3 cup icing sugar | 2 pints heavy whipping cream, whipped | 1/3 cup tomato ketchup | tabasco sauce, to taste | 2 tablespoons roquefort cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place the raisins in a small bowl and add ½ cup of liquid from the raisins. Cover with plastic wrap, then press the raisins and soaked raisins into the cream, then refrigerate overnight. Line a roasting pan with foil and line it with a large roasting pan. Cut two long strips of bacon around the center of the roasts, then place on top of the bacon wrapped trivet over the lamb. Place a roasting pan into the oven, and set the oven to 300 degrees f. Bake for 1 - ½ hours. Remove foil and sprinkle roasts with ½ cup of icing sugar. Return to the oven and bake 15 minutes more. Remove from oven and set aside until ready to serve. To serve, place ½ cup of cream in a small bowl and microwave for 20 seconds to warm the cream.

title: Irish Beef
ingredients: 1 kg piece stewing beef | 1 large savoy cabbage
instructions: In a large saucepan, cover the stewing beef with water and add it to the pan. Cover and simmer on medium for about one hour or until beef is completely tender. Remove the beef and cabbage and place into large soup bowls, cover with cold water and refrigerate overnight. Place the cabbage in the crockpot, cover it with water and cook on high for about two hours or until shredded cabbage is very tender.

title: Easy Chicken Parcels - Skewers
ingredients: 1 lb beef stew meat | 1 tablespoon margarine or 1 tablespoon olive oil | 2 ounces chocolate curl ( optional ) | 3 -4 tablespoons chicken tenders, cut into 1/4-inch slices | chocolate shavings ( optional )
instructions: In a saucepan cook the meat with the margarine or oil over medium heat until the meat is browned on all sides.

title: Robust Apple and Broccoli Gratin
ingredients: 8 ounces shredded jarlsberg cheese | 2 medium heads broccoli, bottoms trimmed and thick stems reserved | 3 large apples, eg.granny smith, peeled pared of all traces of peel | 1 tablespoon crushed dried oregano leaves | 3 tablespoons simple syrup
instructions: Pre heat oven to 400°f. In a medium size baking dish, distribute cheese evenly over the bottom. Arrange broccoli around cheese on top of cheese. Sprinkle with oregano leaves and pour over syrup. Bake about 45minutes until tender to the tooth. Serve warm.

title: Spicy Corn and Capsicum
ingredients: 1 can creamed corn | 1 can creamed corn, with herbs | 500 g green capsicums ( or use 2/3 cup capsicum ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons cornstarch
instructions: Combine all ingredients together in a bowl or blender. Blend until smooth.

title: Pea Soyri Kebabs, Miso Ginger Drink
ingredients: 150 g pea | 200 g fresh gingerroot | 4 tablespoons miso
instructions: Grind or process pea, ginger and miso in a blender. Pour soda water into blender and mix well so ginger dissolves. Pour into glass and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: yam,pizza sauce,celery leaf,yeast,vegetable broth,yellow onion,mint leaf,cream
title: Yam and Onion Chowder
ingredients: 1/2 cup yellow onion, coarsely chopped | 1 tablespoon dried yeast | 1 1/2 cups low sodium vegetable broth | 2 cups yams, chopped ( about 1 large yam ) | 1/2 cup sour cream | 4 teaspoons dried mint leaves | 1 can pizza sauce | 2 teaspoons chopped fresh mint leaves
instructions: Toast the onion in the microwave until translucent, about 3 minutes. Add the yeast and stir just until the yeast is dissolved. Add the broth, yams, sour cream, mint, and the pizza sauce, and stir to combine. Heat to boiling over medium high heat, then reduce heat to medium and simmer until very thick.

title: Chilli Tea
ingredients: 4 dried red chilies | 2 cups boiling tea, warmed
instructions: Place chili pods directly into a microwave safe bowl. Cover and microwave on high power for 3 minutes. With an electric mixer, beat tea until very hot and soft. Remove and discard chili pods. Stir tea into hot tea until evenly mixed. Cool to room temperature.

Random Ingredients: yeast,pork chop,lime juice zest,broccoli,bread crumb,kosher salt
title: Cuban Pork Chops
ingredients: 10 ounces boneless pork chops | 2 cups bread crumbs | 1/4 teaspoon powdered dry yeast | kosher salt to taste | 4 ounces broccoli, trimmed | fresh lime juice and zest
instructions: Heat a heavy skillet over medium high heat. Sprinkle pork chops with salt. Brown each side until nicely browned, 5 to 7 minutes total. Transfer to a baking sheet. Add bread crumbs and yeast to skillet. Mix well, scraping up browned bits. Stir in water until dough is about 2/3 of the crumbs are absorbed. Pour over pork.

title: Homemade Ice Cream
ingredients: 1 can non-dairy topping, i've found mine in a health food store
instructions: Empty contents of can with a big bowl on your counter and into freezer bag, fill and freeze. When all ingredients have been frozen, put back in freezer. When the mixture is ready to be eaten, put in the freezer bags, place in freezer and cook about 30 - 45 minutes. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: golden raisin,cilantro,italian parsley,chili powder,tomato sauce,lemon juice,fenugreek seed,grain mustard
title: Chakchouka (Curried Tomato Salad)
ingredients: 5 lbs firm tomatoes | 1 cup golden raisin | 3 tablespoons chopped cilantro | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh cilantro | 1/2 cup packed finely chopped fresh italian parsley | 2 cups tomato sauce | 2 tablespoons coarse grain mustard | 1 1/2 teaspoons chili powder | 1 teaspoon crushed fenugreek seeds
instructions: Remove stem and top half of each tomato from underside. Cut each tomato in half lengthwise. Remove the core and cut off top half. Cut tomatoes crosswise into 1/2 inch slices or quarters. In a large bowl, combine remaining ingredients with any remaining tomato sauce ingredients and mix well. Place tomato slices on serving plate or serving platter and cover tightly with plastic wrap. Refrigerate covered for 2 hours turning the plate at least once. Drain tomato slices and serve with dipping sauce. Sauce is best made at least 8 hours before serving or up to 2 days ahead.

title: Marie's German Breakfast
ingredients: 1 lb skirt steak | 2 spring onions, thinly sliced | 12 -14 ladyfingers, halved, lengthwise | 1/2 lb smoked kielbasa, cut into 1/2 inch wide slices | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh tarragon | sea salt, to taste | 1 tablespoon grand marnier | 1 teaspoon allspice
instructions: In a large frypan or a griddle combine the steak, onions, and 1/2 cup water and bring to a boil over medium high heat. Reduce the heat to medium low and simmer, covered, for about 4 to6 minutes or until the meat slices are almost done, turning once or twice. Season with salt and the remaining tarragon. Place the cooked meat in the center of each ladyfinger half, and arrange the sausage over the meat. Sprinkle with the grand marnier and any additional seasonings.

title: Shrimp on Prosciutto
ingredients: 4 tablespoons prosciutto, thinly cut | 1/4 fresh pineapple, thinly sliced and then cut into 1/8-inch slices
instructions: Arrange 2 slices of prosciutto on each large shrimp, using a sharp knife. Place 3 tablespoons of sliced and cut pineapple on the top. Fold the shrimp over the two slices and continue rolling the shrimp in the prosciutto. Refrigerate until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice,soy sauce,black pepper,artichoke,yeast,poblano pepper,chili sauce,lamb
title: Mexican-Style Roast Lamb Loof
ingredients: 4 1/4 lbs whole-wheat bread slices | 1 teaspoon yeast | 1/2 teaspoon lemons ( juice of 2 lemons ) | 1/4 cup chili sauce | 1/4 cup olive oil or 1/4 cup canola oil | 1 1/2 cups chicken stock or 1 1/2 cups bottled roasted tomato sauce | 1 poblano pepper, seeded and sliced | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 1 teaspoon soy sauce
instructions: In bread machine pan, put 4 1/4 pounds of the slices of bread in order listed and make a row, creating a total of 4 columns. Sprinkle the yeast over the bread.

title: Spiced Roast Beef Twirls
ingredients: 2 crusty pastry dough sheets, thawed | 120 g chilled sunflower seeds | 200 g pumpkin puree | 2 tablespoons fresh rosemary sprigs, leaves trimmed | 5 lbs sirloin, cut into 1/2-in cubes
instructions: Preheat oven to 190°c using a sharp knife, trim pastry to 24x21cm rectangles. Place 1 tablespoon of sunflower seeds in the centre of each rectangle. Place 1 tablespoon pumpkin purée in a large, shallow oven proof dish. Add 2 tablespoons rosemary and stir. Place 1 onion and 1 carrot in the dish. Place beef in the dish. Sprinkle with 1 tablespoon rosemary. Tuck remaining sunflower seeds between slices of beef and place on top of roasting onions and carrots. Bake for 45 minutes. Remove beef to a plate. Reduce oven temperature to 140°c. Reduce oven temperature to 180°c. Bake for 12 to 15 minutes. Remove beef from oven and place on a chopping board.

Random Ingredients: pumpkin,quinoa,gouda cheese,creole seasoning,active yeast,hazelnut,lemon juice zest
title: Buckeyes
ingredients: 1/2 cup quinoa, finely ground | 1 1/2 teaspoons creole seasoning | 1 1/2 cups cooked quinoa | 1/2 teaspoon lemon juice ( zest of 1 lemon ) | 1/2 teaspoon grated lemon, zest of 1 lemon | 4 cups diced cooked pumpkin | 1/4 cup hazelnuts, toasted and coarsely chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. In a medium bowl, combine quinoa, creole seasoning, and quinoa. Stir to mix well. Add the remaining ingredients just until moist but not completely sticky. Spread into a single layer on a jelly roll pan or cookie sheet and bake in the preheated oven until a spoonful inserted into the center of a cube of meat feels just firm when touched, 20 to 25 minutes. Let cool for 5 minutes. Turn out on a cutting board.

title: Spicy Sauerkraut With Bread, Fritters & Cream
ingredients: 12 small sauerkraut, rinsed thoroughly ( see note below ) | 1/2 cup creme fraiche | 6 ladyfingers | 6 slices gruyere cheese | 1 teaspoon mild sweet masala, ( i use dijon ) | 1 teaspoon cider vinegar | 3/4 teaspoon pepperoni, slices
instructions: To cook the bread, heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a non stick skillet over a medium high heat. Fry the bread, one at a time, until crisp on the outside but inside is still crunchy, 3 to 5 minutes per side. Keep warm in a 200 degree oven until all bread is cooked. Keep warm, covered with foil. Heat the remaining tablespoon of olive oil in the pan over medium low heat. Drain the sauerkraut and cut the sauerkraut diagonally into 4 equal portions. Scoop out 1 portion of bread, leaving about 1 1/2 inch of crusty bread in the pan. Set aside. To the reserved bread portion in the pan, stir in the creme fraiche until smooth. Spoon about 2 tablespoons of the sauerkraut mixture on top of the bread portion. Place several pieces of the gruyere cheese on top of the creme fraiche. Spread about 2 tablespoons of the creme fraiche mixture on each layer of sauerkraut. Sprinkle 1 teaspoon of sweetmasala and 1/2 teaspoon of vinegar on each layer of sauerkraut. Arrange the ladyfingers in the pan next to the sauerkraut mixture on the cheese and top with remaining gruyere cheese. Drizzle the remaining 1/2 teaspoon of sweetmasala over all, followed by the pepperoni slices. Bring to a simmer and continue simmering until the sauerkraut mixture is warmed through, about 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: farfalle pasta,extra virgin olive oil,cauliflower,chipotle chile
title: Chili with Cauliflower and Farfalle Noodles
ingredients: 12 ounces farfalle pasta ( bow tie ) | 1 cup cauliflower, chopped | 6 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 2 canned chipotle chiles, chopped
instructions: Cook pasta until al dente. Strain and set aside. Meanwhile, heat oil in skillet. Add peppers and cook until soft. Drain pasta and stir into chipotle sauce.

title: Italian Shell With Fresh Fruit
ingredients: 12 ounces uncooked medium pasta | 3/4 cup fat free soymilk | 1 egg yolk | 1 teaspoon dried marjoram | 6 toothpicks | 12 maraschino cherries, quartered
instructions: Cook pasta as directed on package. Drain and return to kettle with remaining ingredients. Toss well.

title: Sausage and White Sugar in Foil
ingredients: 1 pound pork sausage | 1/2 cup white sugar
instructions: Brown the sausage meat in a skillet over medium heat. Drain excess fat, season with sugar and place inside a plastic bag.

title: Spiced Roasted Spice Chips
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | spices, eg salt, cumin, cinnamon, nutmeg, cloves
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees fahrenheit. Spray your fingertips with vegetable oil, and press them into the tray with a pastry bag cut into 3/4 inch lengths. Spray with vegetable oil. Roast until golden for about 10 minutes, then transfer to a tray. Spray with vegetable oil and return to oven to roast until toasted. Store in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: cocoa,beef stew meat,white mushroom,coriander,italian plum tomato,yellow squash,catsup,lemon extract
title: T- Bone Beef Mole
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless beef stew meat | 2 cans italian plum tomatoes | 1/4 cup catsup | 1/4 - 1/2 cup unsweetened cocoa | 1 1/2 tablespoons italian spices ( for heat ) or 1 1/2 tablespoons dried anise extract ( for heat ) | 4 teaspoons ground coriander | 1 cup fresh sweet white mushroom, sliced | 1/2 teaspoon lemon extract
instructions: Heat 1/2 can of tomatoes in microwave on high 10 seconds or till hot remove from microwave and set aside. Meanwhile, cut meat into 1/2 inch cubes. Put 1/4 cup of cinammon sauce in 1 cup can and heat at lowest simmer for 30 minutes. Set aside. Set mushrooms aside. Heat remaining can of tomatoes in sauce over low heat for 15 minutes or till hot add to meat and brown, remove from heat then put in casserole dish. Add catsup, cocoa, spices and beef to tomato mixture and stir til well coated. Spoon over meat. Sprinkle with remaining anise extract. Cover and bake at 375 degrees for 30 minutes or till meat and sauce is hot and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: poblano pepper,black bean,ice water,baby spinach leaf
title: Vegetarian Poblano and Black Bean Soup
ingredients: 4 large poblano peppers or 4 large anaheim chilies | 4 teaspoons ice water | 7 cups baby spinach | 2 cans black beans, drained and rinsed
instructions: Blend the poblano chilies and water in a blender until smooth, about 30 seconds per batch. Add the spinach and blend until the spinach is finely chopped. Add the chile mixture to the refried beans and stir. Re heat and serve, if desired, with corn chips or other mexican toppings such as sour cream or low fat sour cream.

title: Napa Dave's Beef Sirloin
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs sirloin | 1 teaspoon fennel seed | 1 teaspoon pepperoni, chopped | 1 1/2 tablespoons mirin | 1 1/2 teaspoons peppercorns, crushed
instructions: Cut beef into strips. Mix remaining ingredients. Roll in mixture and tie with toothpicks.

Random Ingredients: dark brown sugar,pork roast,cajun seasoning,colby monterey jack cheese
title: Cheesy Sweet Pork Sandwich (No Pills!)
ingredients: 5 slices colby-monterey jack cheese | 1/2 cup dark brown sugar, firmly packed | 1/2 teaspoon dried cajun seasoning | 3 lbs boneless pork roast, from a rotisserie pork cutlet
instructions: Spray two pie pans or other pie dishes with nonstick cooking spray. Heat oven to 350 degrees f. In bowl, stir together brown sugar, cajun seasoning and pork roast. Transfer pork roast to pie pans or sprayed pie pans. Bake 5 minutes, turn over and bake until meat thermometer registers 160 to 155 degrees f, or internal temperature registers 160 to 180 degrees f again. Meanwhile, cover and refrigerate remaining 2 sandwiches. Split sandwiches between two prepared pie plates and top with sandwiches. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: cocoa powder,sausage,mango powder,vodka,ice cube,brown rice,dark soy sauce,olive
title: Mango and Chocolate Rice Balls
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/4 kg good quality pork sausage, ground or 2 large chicken | 1 cup freshly cooked brown rice | 1 1/2 tablespoons unsweetened unsweetened cocoa-cola powder | 3 tablespoons vodka | 1 -3 teaspoon mango powder | ice cube | 2 tablespoons chopped mixed ripe olives ( optional ) | 2 -4 tablespoons dark soy sauce
instructions: Place rice in a medium bowl with the meat, cocoa powder, mango powder and coconut powder. Taste and adjust any other spices you like, add sugar if necessary if you don't add any, and refrigerate overnight. Form into small balls and place on an ice tray, cover with cling film and freeze for about 1 1/2 hours. When ready to serve, remove the meat balls from the freezer and put the cooked rice balls in a serving dish. Cover with plastic wrap and leave for at least 15 minutes. Remove the plastic wrap and sprinkle with dark soy sauce and olives or coconut if using. Serve with lots of yoghurt as an accompaniment.

Random Ingredients: idaho potato,cider vinegar,herring,beef tip steak,fettuccine,rice,chipotle chile
title: Chipotle Beef Bowls
ingredients: 1 beef tip steak, cut 1/2-3/4 inch thick | 1 jar chipotle chiles | 1 jar herring | 1 tablespoon cider vinegar | 1/2 cup rice | 1 1/2 cups idaho potatoes, cut into 1/2-inch cubes | fettuccine
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Arrange meat on wire racks set on rimmed baking sheet. Insert meat thermometer into center of meat and sprinkle with salt, if desired. Cook in preheated oven 1 hour to 1 hour and 15 minutes or to desired desired doneness. Meanwhile, heat chipotle chiles in saucepan over low heat and pour into food processor or blender.

Random Ingredients: liquid smoke,baking soda,banana,pimento,chili sauce,angel hair pasta,scallop,pastry
title: Crispy Deviled Bananas
ingredients: 1 package pastry shells, pre-made | 3 ounces angel hair pasta, cooked | 6 bananas, cut lengthwise into quarters | 1 can shrimp or 1 can sliced scallops, drained | 1/2 jar sweet chili sauce | 1/2 cup pimento | 2 tablespoons liquid smoke | 1 teaspoon baking soda | chili sauce ( optional ) or salsa ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400. Pour hot tomato sauce into shallow 2l baking dish. Spray large cookie sheet with cooking spray. Set aside. Spray large deep frying pan with cooking spray. Arrange shrimp or scallops in pan, and arrange in a single layer over the tomato sauce.

title: Cottage Cheese With Okra
ingredients: 1 container cottage cheese ( cottage ) | 1/2 teaspoon cauliflower seeds or 1/4 teaspoon caraway seed | 1/2 teaspoon anchovy paste | 1/4 cucumber, cut into 1/4-inch pieces lengthwise ( about 2 cups ) | 1/4 cup chopped fresh cherries | 1/8 teaspoon canola oil or 1/8 teaspoon vegetable oil, for brushing
instructions: Combine all the ingredients, except the oil, and toss into a large bowl. Let sit for 10 minutes at room temperature or refrigerate overnight. Brush the okra generously with oil and grill over direct high heat, turning occasionally, until evenly brown.

title: Moroccan Cumin Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup cumin seeds | 2 cloves lettuce or 2 limes
instructions: Place cumin in a skillet over medium heat and, stirring often, toast and shaking the pan, until fragrant and beginning to color, about 2 minutes. Pour into a bowl or ziplock bag, cover with plastic wrap to keep mixture in a warm place, and shake until the seeds start to release their fragrance, about 30 seconds. Drain cumin from skillet and pat dry with paper towels. Grind the cumin seeds in a mortar and pestle or spice grinder. Toss the cumin seeds together with the lettuce and lime juice. Serve at once.

title: Pizza Beans
ingredients: 1 can baked beans | 1/4 lb chocolate, chopped | chocolate ( optional garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°, spray cookie sheet with nonstick cooking spray. Spread the baked beans in a thin layer on cookie sheet. Dissolve the chocolate in the chocolate. Bake at 375° for 10 minutes or until golden brown..

Random Ingredients: cream mushroom soup,red capsicum,white pepper,coffee chicory,sirloin
title: Hot & Sweet Beef Burger
ingredients: 8 sirloin, patties | 8 white pepper | 2 tablespoons cream of mushroom soup | 2 tablespoons coffee chicory, finely chopped | 2 red capsicums, chopped
instructions: Season meat patties with salt, pepper and brown on both sides. Remove and leave to one side. Add soup, chicory, capsicums and red capsicum to the meat patties. Heat for 5 minutes or until heated through.

Random Ingredients: broth,cold water,golden syrup,sea salt,tamari,ginger garlic paste,onion,spaghetti
title: A Fully-Baller Spaghetti
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon sea salt | 1 tablespoon fresh ginger-garlic paste | 1/2 cup chopped onion | 3/4 cup unsalted dry spaghetti | 6 cups broth | 1/3 cup golden syrup ( karo sugar syrup ) | 6 cups cold water | 6 drops tamari, to taste
instructions: Cook the spaghetti til al dente. Do a final cooking of the spaghetti. Reserve 1/2 cup of the pasta water in a small pot. Drain the cooked pasta and set aside. In the pot add the drained spaghetti and the stock. Cover and bring to a simmer. Cook for about 20 minutes over medium heat or until it thickens slightly. In a small sauce pot, bring the syrup to a boil for 5 minutes and then add the water and tamari powder. Pour the syrup over the hot spaghetti immediately and toss to combine.

Random Ingredients: chicken broth,artificial sweetener,tomato green chilies,vanilla bean,white cabbage,american cheese
title: Bubble & Squeak
ingredients: 3 cans chicken broth | 2 cans diced tomatoes with green chilies | 3 ounces american cheese, cut into small cubes | 1/2 cup artificial sweetener | 1 vanilla bean | 4 medium small white cabbage, shredded
instructions: Combine all ingredients, except cabbage, in a large pot and bring to a boil over medium high heat. Reduce heat, cover and simmer for 45 to 50 minutes. Remove the vanilla bean and discard. Stir in a bowl and serve.

title: Mochi Don
ingredients: 12 ounces bamboo shoots, cut bite size | 1 cup raisins
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a bowl. Serve with rice.

Random Ingredients: tortilla,taco seasoning mix,black peppercorn,dijon mustard,green curry paste,caster sugar
title: Green Curry Wraps
ingredients: 12 tortillas | 1/2 cup green curry paste ( green curry paste mix ) | 1 teaspoon caster sugar | 1/2 teaspoon dijon mustard | 1 teaspoon black peppercorns, lightly crushed | 1 teaspoon taco seasoning mix
instructions: Spread a little curry paste on 2 slices of the tortillas. Sprinkle with some caster sugar, then top with another tortilla and roll up.

title: Easy Microwave Chocolate
ingredients: 12 ounces dark chocolate, roughly chopped | 2 tablespoons yellow onions, chopped | 1 can tomato sauce
instructions: Place chocolate, onion, and tomato sauce in microwave dish and cook on high for 3 minutes or until melted.

title: Saffron Marinated Chicken and Linguine
ingredients: 1 teaspoon saffron threads ( can take from a few ) | 1 lb linguine | 1/2 lb sliced salt pork, cut into 1-inch cubes | 16 ounces chicken bouillon cubes ( preferably organic ) | 16 ounces marmalade or 16 ounces marsala
instructions: Place the saffron threads in a small bowl and add enough hot water to cover. Let steep for 20 minutes. Boil linguine in a pot of salted water until al dente.

Random Ingredients: havarti cheese,pinto bean,beef bouillon cube,pineapple chunk
title: Easy Refried Beans
ingredients: 100 g dried pinto beans | 1 tablespoon beef bouillon cube | 50 g havarti cheese ( optional ) | 50 g pineapple chunks ( optional )
instructions: Soak beans in water overnight. Drain beans and put in large saucepan. Add water as much as you like. It should be boiling. Cover and simmer on low till tender, about one hour. Add remaining ingredients and keep simmering till heated through. Serve as topping for refried beans.

Random Ingredients: raspberry jam,black bean sauce,gorgonzola,mint leaf,pesto sauce,sugar syrup,jalapeno chile
title: Gorgonzola Salad With Raspberry-Pesto
ingredients: 2 tablespoons raspberry jam | 3 tablespoons black bean sauce | 3 tablespoons pesto sauce | 3 tablespoons sugar-free syrup | 3 tablespoons grated gorgonzola | 1 -2 minced jalapeno chile | 1 tablespoon minced fresh mint leaves ( optional )
instructions: In a bowl, stir together jam and black bean sauce. In a small saucepan, heat pesto sauce, sugarfree syrup, and chili. Heat until warm throughout. Combine hot sauce mixture and cheese in small bowl. Stir until cheese melts. Pour cheese mixture over jam and black bean sauce mixture. Stir to combine. Sprinkle with mint leaves, if desired.

Random Ingredients: wheat flour,water chestnut,yellow onion,juniper berry,sage,pistachio,wheat lasagna noodle
title: Warm Pesto Cheese Lasagna
ingredients: 1 package whole wheat lasagna noodles | 2 bunches fresh sage ( or 1 teaspoon dried sage ) | 5 -6 juniper berries, coarsely chopped | water chestnuts, cleaned and sliced thinly ( optional ) | 1 small yam ( or 3/4 cup dehydrated yam ) | 1 medium yellow onion, chopped | 2 tablespoons finely chopped pistachios, optional garnish ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°. Cook lasagna noodles to desired doneness in a saucepan of boiling water for about 7 minutes. Drain, rinse with cold water and drain again. Place in a large mixing bowl and coat with a little water. In a small nonreactive teapot, heat the chille pepper flakes. Pour over noodles and toss to coat. Place on a piece of foil and bake for about 10 minutes or until desired doneness. Remove from the oven, sprinkle with sage or sage powder, stir and let cool.. Rinse and dice the yam. Place the diced yam, chopped onion and chopped pistachios in a mixing bowl. Spread 1 1/2 cups pesto mixture over bottom of 8 x 8 x 2 inch baking dish. Top with 1/2 cup pasta mixture. Repeat layers, using two more pans. Bake for 40 minutes or until bubbly and top is browned. Allow to sit for 10 minutes before cutting.

Random Ingredients: pepperoni sausage,dark soy sauce,date,white sugar,jerk sauce,raisin
title: Rae's Hawaiian Bob2
ingredients: 10 fresh dates, divided | 1/4 pound raisins | 1 1/2 tablespoons hot jerk sauce | 1 1/2 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 1 tablespoon white sugar | 2 teaspoons dry jerk sauce | 1 teaspoon prepared jerk sauce | 1 pound thinly sliced pepperoni sausage
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Arrange dates, raisins, 2 cups hot jerk sauce, dark soy sauce, sugar, 1 teaspoon jerk sauce, and 1 teaspoon jerk sauce in one layer in a 12x9x2 inch baking dish. Arrange pepperoni slices in a cross over the top.

title: Rosemary Tea Butter
ingredients: 1 cup margarine | 1/2 teaspoon chili powder | 1 teaspoon dried rosemary | 1/4 teaspoon ground sage
instructions: Melt margarine in microwave until margarine is melted. Add chili powder, rosemary and sage. Enjoy you can play with this recipe but it does not taste as good in my house.

Random Ingredients: mango,white mushroom,brussels sprout,lettuce leaf,extra beef,artichoke heart
title: Mango and Artichoke Burger
ingredients: 1 green giant fresh mango, peeled, seeded, coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup fresh white mushrooms, coarsely chopped | 1/8 - 1/4 cup bottled roasted salted brussels sprout, coarsely chopped ( about 1 ) | 5 leaves lettuce leaves | 12 ounces extra lean ground beef | 8 slices artichoke hearts, trimmed of top ( about 1/2 cup, or 10 to 12 slices marinated artichokes in marinade and brine )
instructions: Combine first five ingredients in a small bowl. Shape mixture into four patties. Heat a griddle or large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Brush patties with equal amounts of the mango mixture.

title: Salami Salad
ingredients: 2 poblano chile, roasted, peeled and sliced lengthwise and on the diagonal 3/4-inch thick | 1 bunch spinach, stemmed | 2 celery ribs, sliced | 1 small jalapeno chilies, sliced into thin rings, seeded if desired | 4 slices salami | 2 -3 tablespoons chopped fresh spinach, rinsed
instructions: Cut the poblano peppers into 1/4 inch thick rings.

title: Currant Paste
ingredients: 1/2 cup dried currant | 3 -4 tablespoons tamari
instructions: Put the currants into a food processor. Add tamari and pulse until finely chopped.

title: Chile-Lipped Catfish With Strawberries and Cream Cheese
ingredients: 1/4 cup light molasses | 1/4 cup amaretto | 4 fillets catfish, 2-inches long | 3 cups sliced chinese cabbage, halved | 1/2 cup coarsely chopped fresh strawberries | 1/4 cup light cream cheese, cut into 4 pieces | 12 small dried ancho chiles, finely chopped
instructions: In a small bowl, combine molasses and 1/4 cup of the amaretto. Set aside. Brush catfish lightly with molasses and let stand 2 minutes. Place a cabbage sliver in the center of each plate. Arrange a few fillets alongside the slivers and place about two tablespoons of the cabbage sliver on top and then top with the remaining cabbage sliver. Garnish with the strawberries and cream cheese.

Random Ingredients: rosemary,napa cabbage,milk chocolate,green chili pepper,extra virgin olive oil
title: Mexican Style Cabbage With Milk Chocolate
ingredients: 2 bunches napa cabbage | 4 -6 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 1 lb freshly ground green chili pepper | 1/4 cup chopped fresh rosemary | 1 can sweetened condensed milk chocolate
instructions: Slice the cabbage head into 1/4 inch slices. Cut the leaves from the center out, discarding the remaining core, then cut the leaves in half lengthwise. Over medium high heat, heat the oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Saute the bell pepper until it begins to soften, then stir in the cabbage in small pieces.

title: Cuban Green Olive Coffee (Cola)
ingredients: 1 1/2 ounces coffee | 7 ounces small green olives
instructions: Pour coffee, and plenty of green olives into a mug. Stir and pour into warm coffee cup.

Random Ingredients: part mozzarella cheese,chipotle pepper adobo sauce,cabbage,coconut
title: Baked Cabbage Rollups
ingredients: 2 lbs shredded cabbage | 1 can chipotle peppers in adobo sauce | 2 ounces shredded part-skim mozzarella cheese | 8 tablespoons shredded unsweetened flaked coconut
instructions: Preheat oven to roll out cabbage and chipotles into 4 inch circles. Place cheese, coconut, and 1/4 cup of cilantro in each circle. Bake for 20 minutes. Serve immediately.

title: Chinese Beef and Egg Rolls
ingredients: 7 cups lean boneless pork shoulder | 1/3 cup salad oil | 6 tablespoons lard | 1/2 teaspoon crushed szechuan peppercorns | 1 egg substitute
instructions: Wash and cut beef into thin slices and place in large bowl. Sprinkle with water. Cover with towel and refrigerate for about 1 hour. In blender, mix water and oil and pour over meat and vegetables. Season with chili powder and szechuan pepper. Cover and blend at high speed for 10 seconds. Heat a large skillet or deep fryer. Dunk meat and vegetables in egg substitute and place on hot skillet or deep fryer. Fry until brown and crisp.

title: Homemade Seasoned Salt for Fish
ingredients: 4 teaspoons garlic powder | 1 teaspoon kosher salt, or to taste
instructions: Mix together.

title: Apple Ketchup
ingredients: 2 lbs granny smith apples, peeled and very thinly sliced | 1 cup soy sauce | 2 packages frozen whipped topping, thawed ( cool whip )
instructions: Place slices of apple and soy sauce in a large, resealable gallon freezer bag. Cover and shake until apples are well coated. Remove apples from bag and place in large resealable freezer bag.

Random Ingredients: curry powder,spanish onion,gruyere cheese,yellow squash,yellow rice,kaffir lime leaf,spaghetti,sea scallop
title: Seafood Geeyères (Yellow Rice and Scallops in Caramelized Onion Sauce)
ingredients: 1 lb spaghetti, of medium diameter length, ends snapped, boiled | 1 cup yellow rice, uncooked | 1 spanish onion ( sliced thin ) | kaffir lime leaf ( optional ) | 2 -3 tablespoons spanish curry powder or 2 -3 tablespoons curry powder, as you prefer it | 1 cup kwerir lime zest ( can also substitute 1 lemon ) ( optional ) | 1 large yellow squash ( chopped into bite size peices ) ( optional ) | 20 medium scallops | 1 cup gruyere cheese, shredded | 1/3 cup swiss gruyere cheese, grated
instructions: Sauce, in a medium saucepan, place rice and 1 cup water. Cover with lid and bring to boil over medium heat. Reduce heat and simmer partially covered for 18 minutes or until rice is tender. Remove from heat and let rest, covered, for 5 minutes. Transfer rice to a large skillet. Place onion slices in the pan. Pour 1/4 cup of water over the onion slices. Cover and place over medium low heat. Cover and simmer 10 minutes turning once, or until onions are soft but not brown. Remove lid. Stir in curry. Cover and simmer 30 minutes. Add kaffir lime leaves and squash if using. Continue on low heat until rice is tender, about another 10 minutes. Remove from heat. Set aside. In a small skillet, cook spaghetti as per package directions, adding about 1 cup of water to the carrots and 2 cups of water. Cover and cook over medium low heat until spaghetti is tender, about 5 minutes. Stir spaghetti often during that time. If pasta is a little dry, add a little water. Serve spaghetti, rice, onion mixture over noodles in saucepan, topped with sauce, and sprinkle with grated gruyere cheese. Serve with additional grated swiss cheese if desired.

title: Penne Alla Napolitana
ingredients: 1 boneless pork chop | 1 lb penne rigate
instructions: Rinse and dry chops. Place in baking dish.

title: Chinese Five Spice
ingredients: 4 ounces roasted red chilies, roughly chopped | 1/4 teaspoon chinese five spice powder | 1 1/4 cups chicken stock or 1 1/4 cups stock
instructions: Place the chillies, five spice and stock or stock into a medium saucepan and bring to the boil. Reduce the heat, partially cover and simmer for 5 minutes or until it is reduced by 1/. Remove from the heat, remove the chillies from the stock and place into an ovenproof bowl or jug that is similar in size to the chinese five spice powder. Stir through the chillies and leave covered for 20 minutes or until the chillies are tender.

Random Ingredients: beef chuck,cauliflower,graham cracker crumb,lime juice,asiago cheese,fettuccini noodle
title: Spaghetti Fettuccini With Grilled Beef
ingredients: 1 bag refrigerated dry fettuccini noodles | 1 lb boneless beef chuck, cut into 1/2 inch pieces | 1 jar sliced cauliflower, rinsed and drained | 1/2 cup lime juice | 1/4 cup shredded asiago cheese or 1/4 cup parmesan cheese | 1/2 cup graded fresh grated asiago cheese or 1/2 cup pecorino romano cheese
instructions: Bring 10 cups of water to boil. Add 1 tsp salt and fettuccini noodles. Cook as directed on package. Meanwhile, heat grill to medium. Add beef to a 3 qt cooking pan.

Random Ingredients: red pepper flake,enchilada sauce,clear honey,lemon peel,crouton
title: Cheesy Red Pepper Hummus
