ingredients: 2 cups croutons ( about 4 large ) | 1 jar sweetened enchilada sauce | 1/4 cup clear honey | 2 teaspoons finely grated lemon peel | 1 1/2 teaspoons grated lemon pepper flakes
instructions: Place the bread crumbs in a bowl and let stand for at least 20 minutes. Spread the enchilada sauce in the bottom of a shallow, shallow casserole, and top with the honey. Sprinkle the 1/4 teaspoon grates of lemon peel all over the sauce and top with the croutons. Drizzle with the 1 teaspoon grated lemon pepper flakes. Bake in a 350°f oven for 1 hour until bubbly and golden.

title: Beef Raki
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg sirloin, cut in medium size cubes | 2 tablespoons white wine | 1/4 cup yoghurt, strained | 2 tablespoons coriander seeds | 150 g almond paste | 1 tablespoon rice wine or 1 tablespoon vermicelli roni powder
instructions: Mix the meat, yoghurt, half the coriander seeds and salt together in a bowl. Leave for 30 minutes. Place the almond paste in a mortar and grind well to a paste with the remaining coriander kernels. Wear gloves, as this will make the almonds more aromatic. Place the meat and the paste in a roasting tin and bake in a moderate oven for 45 minutes. The raki should have an oil, consistency of slightly thick cream. Remove from the oven and serve hot with salad.

title: White Wine and Wheat Tortillas
ingredients: 4 slices whole wheat bread, toasted and cut into triangles | 4 tablespoons white wine, divided
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Spray a large, medium baking sheet with cooking spray. Toss bread triangles with half of the wine in a bowl to coat. Arrange the bread in a single layer on the baking sheet. Top bread triangles in a single layer with remaining wine. Spray tops with cooking spray. Bake bread triangles in the preheated oven for 10 minutes, then remove bread from oven. Top bread triangles with remaining wine and sprinkle with remaining wine. Return to oven, and bake for 20 minutes.

title: Pumpkin-Pumpkin Vinegar
ingredients: 1 can pumpkin puree | 5 teaspoons wine vinegar ( or use white wine vinegar for vegan version )
instructions: Place the pumpkin puree and the vinegar into a bowl, stir, cover and refrigerate for a few hours or overnight. Serve chilled.

title: Glogg (Greek Olive Nuts)
ingredients: 2 cups greek olives | 1 cup hazelnuts | 1 cup pistachio nut ( pistachios ) | 1 cup olive ( with a bit of oil )
instructions: Put the olives and hazelnuts in a food processor and process until very fine. Add the pistachios and pistachios to the nuts and blend well. Add the olive oil into the food processor and process until all the ingredients are well combined. Store in a covered jar for up to one week.

title: Baked Chicken
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs chicken meat | 1/2 teaspoon mixed herbs ( mrs dash herbs )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Mix together all ingredients and place in a casserole dish. Cover with aluminum foil. Bake in a preheated oven for 50 - 60 minutes. Remove from oven and serve.

Random Ingredients: cashew nut,cilantro,white flour,tomato juice,spinach leaf,creamy peanut butter
title: Creamy Spinach and Cashew Noodles
ingredients: 2 cups spinach leaves, cooked, drained, & chopped fine | 1/4 cup creamy peanut butter | 1/4 cup cashew nuts or 1/4 cup peanuts | 2 tablespoons tomato juice, from the tin | 1/4 cup fresh cilantro, finely chopped | 1 cup white flour
instructions: Heat the peanut butter in a small saucepan, then stir in the cilantro & tomato juice bring to the boil then reduce the heat & simmer until thickened. Stir in the cooked spinach & set aside to cool slightly. Put the flour in a bowl & add the cooled peanut butter mixture & mix well. Preheat the oven to 180c. Shape the spinach mixture into walnut sized balls or smaller & roll them in the flour. Place balls a couple of cm apart on a lightly oiled baking tray & bake for 15 minutes or until golden.

title: Cumin Covered Pork Roast (Tahini Goma Yum Goma)
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless pork shoulder | 1 cucumber, peeled and thinly sliced | 1/2 cup chopped onion ( i've used a mix of onions and leeks ) | 1/2 cup light brown rice or 1/2 cup brown rice, steamed | 1/4 cup tamari | 2 teaspoons cumin powder ( i use mexican seasoning seasoning mix or try kikkoman's tamari ) | 1/2 tablespoon dry sesame or 1/2 tablespoon tahini
instructions: Set oven to 350 degrees. Line a 5 - ½ qt dutch oven with foil. Spread sliced pork atop the foil. Top with sliced cucumber, sliced onion, rice, tamari, cumin and sesame. Wrap tightly with the foil. Bake, uncovered, for 55 minutes. Remove from oven and cut into 6 serving pieces.

Random Ingredients: cream chicken soup,romaine lettuce,onion,lime juice,salt pork,chicken thigh,celery
title: Crock Pot Chicken Caesar Salad
ingredients: 10 boneless skinless chicken thighs | 1/2 lb salt pork, well cut | 1/2 cup onion, finely chopped | 1/2 cup celery, finely chopped | 1 can cream of chicken soup | 2 tablespoons lime juice | 2 heads romaine lettuce ( about 2 cups ) or 2 heads red cabbage, shredded | salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Place chicken thighs in slow cooker. Add remaining ingredients except lettuce. Cover and cook on high about 4 hours.

Random Ingredients: rigatoni pasta,baking powder,date,red chili powder,tomato green chilies,cashew,sirloin
title: Cashew Nut Beef Pasta
ingredients: 8 ounces rigatoni pasta or 8 ounces rotini pasta | 1 1/2 lbs sirloin, cut into thin slices | 3/4 teaspoon baking powder | 7 ounces rotel diced tomatoes and green chilies | 1/2 teaspoon crushed red chili powder | 1/2 cup cashews, roasted, coarsely ground | 3 tablespoons roasted unsalted cashews
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. Drain pasta, reserving 1/2 cup of pasta water. In a large nonstick skillet, add pork and stir fry for 2 minutes or until browned. Add tomatoes, red chilli, and cashews. Drain pasta, add to skillet along with reserved broth. Simmer, uncovered and stirring occassionally, for 20 minutes or until thickened and creamy.

title: North Indian Style Leeks
ingredients: 2 lbs leeks | 1 1/2 teaspoons turmeric powder ( use less, as turmeric and chili powder will not be all the same )
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees fahrenheit. Rinse leeks under running water and pat dry with paper towels. Cut ends off of leeks, trim about 2 1/2 inches of rind, leaving about 2/3 of stalks.

title: Rabo Con Pescado (Rabo W- Brandy)
ingredients: 1 ounce sofrito sauce | 1/4 lb bacon, thinly sliced crosswise and cut crosswise into 3/8 inch pieces | 2 tablespoons brandy | coarse sea salt
instructions: Bring a 4 quart pot of water to boil, add a pinch of salt, then drop in the sofrito. If the sofrito sauce does not melt before the sofrito is done, add a pinch of sugar or water, and simmer briskly until it is slightly reduced. Set aside to cool slightly, then whisk in the brandy until thoroughly incorporated. Add more sofrito, if desired. Dump the sofrito into a jar with a tight fitting lid, add the bacon pieces, and shake gently to mix. Transfer the bacon to paper towels to drain, then season with salt to taste. Refrigerate the rabo con pescado, covered, for at least one hour, then shake well again before serving..

Random Ingredients: celery salt,asian chili sauce,mandarin orange,tea,vegetable stock,pecan,parmesan cheese
title: Thai Pumpkin Soup!
ingredients: 1 can mandarin oranges, drained ( or use juice packed oranges ) | 1 pint vegetable stock | powdered celery salt | 1/4 cup pecans or 1/4 cup peanuts, finely chopped | 4 tablespoons thai sweet chili sauce ( i use sriracha ) | 2 tablespoons teabags ( store brand ) or 1 tablespoon any dry asian fragrant herbal tea ( i use sriracha ) | 1/4 cup parmesan cheese ( optional ) or 1/4 cup romano cheese ( optional )
instructions: Bring about 4 quarts of water to boil in a 4 quart saucepot. Pour boiling water over mandarin oranges, cover and remove from heat when it floats to the top of the water. When it's finished, drain oranges in a sieve until there's no more liquid in the water, then discard all the oranges' juice. Remove pulp/soda from can and discard. Return pulp to saucepan. Add remaining ingredients and stir. Heat again, stirring occasionally, until mixture becomes thick, bubbling and smooth. Serve hot, as optional garnish, or cold, as a side dish.

title: Red Wine Almond Sauce
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cornflour | 1 teaspoon almond extract | 2 tablespoons dried tarragon | 2 tablespoons red wine
instructions: Mix all of the ingredients until they are well blended.

Random Ingredients: mustard seed,cooking oil,leaf lettuce,italian tomato,milk ricotta cheese,golden raisin,mayonnaise,cayenne
title: Creamy Italian Salad
ingredients: 1 head leaves of mixed lettuce, cleaned and dried well | 1 can whole tomato, halved ( strained, drained ) | 1 -2 cup whole milk ricotta cheese | 1/4 lb brown sugar-flavored mayonnaise | 1 1/2 teaspoons mustard seeds | 1 teaspoon ground cayenne | 3/4 cup golden raisin ( optional ) | 1/4 cup quick-cooking oil
instructions: Place lettuce into glass bowl. Top each with a scoop of whole tomato. In small bowl, combine ricotta cheese, brown sugar, mayonnaise, mustard seed and cayenne. Pour mixture over whole tomatoes, stirring to combine.

Random Ingredients: garlic clove,sage,apricot preserve,pineapple juice,pecorino romano cheese
title: Cheese and Pineapple Skewers
ingredients: 2 cans crushed pineapple with juice | 1/3 cup chopped pecorino romano cheese | 1/4 cup apricot preserves | 2 garlic cloves, minced | 1/4 teaspoon dried sage
instructions: Place pineapple and juice in a blender and blend until it reaches the consistancy of sauce. Stir in remaining ingredients.

title: Yogurt Sauce
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs onions, chopped ( about 4 large ) | 1 pint plain low-fat yogurt | 1 teaspoon kosher salt and pepper
instructions: Place onions in a large mixing bowl. Mix in the yogurt and mix well. Season with salt and pepper, adjusting the seasoning and yogurt as desired. Chill for about 3 hours before serving to allow flavors to blend.

title: Simple and Deliciously Thai Fish (Tirk Khai)
ingredients: 3 lbs of fresh fish ( such as mussels, monkfish, and or halibut will also be great for flavour, your tastes ) | 4 tablespoons curry paste ( thai kitchen brand )
instructions: Take the fish out of its packaging and cut off any excess head or any fins. Cut the pieces into 1 inch cubes and put aside. In a wok, heat up some water and coat each piece with some of the curry paste until it begins to brown. Immediately drain off excess oil and pour it into a clean dish. Heat the remaining curry paste in the wok to a boil, constantly stirring, so that the paste does not burn. If you have a lid to keep this simple dish warm while you make the fish, transfer the curry paste from the heat to small individual oven safe dishes. Place the fish in the curry. Cover tightly and bake at 300°f on the center shelf of the oven for about 30 minutes. Serve warm. Variation, after dicing all the fish and returning it to the oil, toss it into the curry for an additional 25 - 30 minutes. Variation, i sometimes add a little garlic or ginger to the curry, as i like.

title: Irish Leek Tea Recipe from Food Network
ingredients: 1 cup low sodium beef broth | 1 lb leek, white and light green parts only, thinly sliced | 1 tablespoon fresh tarragon, minced | 1 1/2 tablespoons pesto sauce, purchased ( a mild enough brand ) | 1 teaspoon dry mustard | 1 cup teapsoon orange pekoe tea ( i use lipton )
instructions: In medium saucepan, combine broth, leeks, tarragon, salad dressing and mustard. Bring to boil over high heat. Reduce heat to medium.

title: Finnish Christmas Cabbage Leaves
ingredients: 1 head chinese cabbage, shredded | 3/4 cup sherry wine | 1 ounce unsweetened cocoa | 1 tablespoon mustard seeds | 4 ounces golden raisins | 2 tablespoons cocoa | 2 tablespoons dry mustard seeds | 2 tablespoons sherry wine vinegar or 2 tablespoons rum
instructions: Put cabbage in a saucepan, pour in sherry, cover, reduce heat and simmer until cabbage is tender. Meanwhile, combine 2 oz each of unsweetened cocoa and mustard seeds, then toast the raisins in the oven until light brown, stirring frequently. Add raisins, 2 oz cocoa, and 1 tsp mustard seeds to cabbage and cook until hot. Drain cabbage leaves, add cabbage to mixture. Stir to coat evenly with sauce. Cover and set aside to macerate at least 3 hours and up to 6 hours before serving. Remove cabbage leaves from marinade and use to pack about a teaspoonful of cabbage mixture into each cabbage leaf. Roll the leaf in remaining cocoa, then roll again to make a coil. Keep the roll in the fridge until service.

title: Puff Shells With Seafood
ingredients: 1/2 lb lobster tail, shells on | 1/2 cup fresh dill, cut into 1/4-inch dice | 2 serrano chili, thinly sliced | 1/4 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 2 teaspoons fresh oregano leaves | 1 package frozen small escarole ( about 12 cups ) | 3 large egg yolks | 1 package soft bread crumbs
instructions: Heat oven to 400°f. In a 5 to 6 quart ovenproof nonstick skillet, combine lobster, dill, chiles, and 2 teaspoons oregano. Cook over high heat, stirring often with a wodden spoon, until bottom is puffed and just beginning to brown, 1 to 2 minutes. Transfer lobster mixture to medium bowl, cover, and chill. Meanwhile, in a medium bowl, whisk egg yolks with 1/8 teaspoon salt until thick and pale, about 5 minutes. Gradually stir in 1 cup of crab juices. Remove crusts from food processor, and set aside 1 cup of paste. Pat shells dry, and cut into 24 strips. Spread remaining paste on wax paper, then arrange shells over paste. Let stand until shells have cooled, about 20 minutes. Using scissors, cut squid crosswise into thin strips. Arrange squid on top of paste, and sprinkle with remaining 1/2 teaspoons oregano and remaining 2 teaspoons oregano. Coat jelly roll pan with cooking spray, and set pan in large roasting pan. Fill with water to reach 2 inches above shell. Bring to boil. Drop puffed shells into boiling water and blanch 3 minutes. Transfer to towel lined bowl, and drain. Cover and chill jelly rolls, covered, until jelly is set, about 6 hours. Meanwhile, in a small bowl, combine hard crumbs and 1 tablespoon oregano.

title: Irish Oven-Fried Pork
ingredients: 3 -4 lean pork chops, 1 inch thick ( boneless chops work best for this ) | 1 -2 tablespoon kahlua ( i use hershey's dark milky way ) | 1 -2 tablespoon raisins | 1 -2 tablespoon powdered milk or 1 -2 tablespoon powdered egg
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees. In large, heavy oven proof frying pan or dutch oven, brown pork chops lightly in olive oil. Drain off any fat. Mix together 1 - 2 tablespoons of the kahlua, 1 1/2 tablespoons of the raisins and powdered sugar and stir well. Spread over pork chops, coating all sides and letting the excess drip off. Sprinkle more of the kahlua mixture on top. Cover tightly and bake for 1 1/2 hours, or until the pork is no longer pink on the outside. Serve piping hot.

Random Ingredients: beef stock,golden raisin,caster sugar,pistachio,red wine vinegar
title: Pistachio and Raisin Hot Pot
ingredients: 2 tablespoons golden raisins | 1 1/2 tablespoons pistachios | 1/2 cup red wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon caster sugar | 5 tablespoons beef stock
instructions: Place the raisins, pistacchios and vinegar into a heavy bottomed saucepan, bring to the boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 5 minutes, stirring constantly to make sure the mixture doesn't colour. Stir in the sugar, cover and increase heat to high, cook stirring every 2 mins until mixture thickens. Transfer hot mixture to a warm bowl and chill for at least 30 mins to set and intensify flavours. Serve hot or cold.

Random Ingredients: salmon fillet,tomato paste,almond,chicken,head romaine lettuce,basil,heavy whipping cream,garlic powder
title: Salmon with Salad
ingredients: 1 jar anchovy-flavored slivered almonds | 1/2 cup chicken fat, rendered fat | 1/2 head romaine lettuce, chopped | 1 can salmon fillets, undrained | 1 1/2 teaspoons basil | 2 cloves garlic powder | 3 tablespoons tomato paste | 1/4 cup heavy whipping cream
instructions: Place almonds in a small skillet over medium low heat. Roast, stirring twice, until golden, about 15 minutes. Transfer with a slotted spoon to a bowl of paper towels. Wipe fat from pan with a paper towel and melt in fat. Toss lettuce, salmon, beans, basil, garlic, tomato paste, and hot almonds in oil. Spoon on top of salad. Drizzle with cream.

title: Pineapple Basil
ingredients: 1/2 cup pineapple juice | 1/2 cup parmesan cheese | 1 1/2 pinches pepper | fresh basil ( to garnish )
instructions: Combine pineapple juice, grated cheese, pepper, and dried basil in a jar with a tight fitting lid. Shake well, pour over sliced fresh basil, or put in refrigerator for up to 24 hours. Store any leftover sauce in the refrigerator.

title: Asian Prawn and Aubergine
ingredients: 1 aubergine | 1/4 pound kielbasa | 2 tablespoons teriyaki sauce | 1 teaspoon red chile powder | 2 pounds uncooked prawns
instructions: Preheat an oven to 350 degrees f. Place aubergines into a bowl of water, and fill 3/4 full with water. Soak until tender, about 15 minutes. Rinse with cool water, then cut into chunks. Place the meat into a skillet with the teriyaki sauce and red chile powder. Mix well, then place the aubergines into the sauce, and cook over medium heat for 15 minutes. Rinse the kielbasa, and pat dry with paper towels. Place into a casserole dish, and cover with the grated kielbasa. Mix the prawns with the hot aubergines, then pour the hot teriyaki over. Bake in the preheated oven until the prawns have turned pink and the flavors have blended, 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Moroccan Sweet Spiced Chilies: Tasting for a Rainy Night
ingredients: 12 large dried red chilies ( i use a little less | 3/4 teaspoon saffron
instructions: Pit chilies lengthwise. Pull chilies apart with your fingers. Place whole or sliced chilies in a large, shallow dish. Sprinkle saffron over this surface as well as a little water. Mix all the ingredients well. Allow to become saturated with the fragrance. Allow to sit 20 minutes for the flavors to absorb each other before serving, but if you have time, allow 2 - 4 hours or the mixture to marinate up to 3 days. To cook, allow a little over 50 minutes per pound of meat in the marinade to sit overnight in a cool, dry place. Drain meat and arrange on a large, shallow tray to dry, dry day or several hours in advance. Allow to dry and dry very well in the oven or at room temperature until just a little less than 1/2 hour before serving.

title: Salsa con Queso on the Side
ingredients: 1 jar chunky salsa ( not salsa verde ) | 1/2 cup chopped scallion
instructions: In medium bowl, combine salsa and scallions. Chill until ready to use.

title: Gluten Free Golden Gate Delight (Taudisian)
ingredients: 1 cup cake flour or 1 cup cake flour | 1/2 cup cold olive, chopped with skin on | 1/2 cup palm sugar or 1/2 cup light brown sugar | 1/2 cup pistachio nut, finely chopped | 1 cardamom pods | 1 -3 tablespoon olive, toasting ( optional )
instructions: Grease a 25cm x 30cm / 11 inch baking tin. Combine flour, palm sugar, pistachios and cardamom pods in a food processor until fine. Add olive oil, if using, and process until smooth. Pour into tin. Bake in a moderate oven for 35 - 40 mins or until golden. Turn onto an ungreased oven tray and cook opposite side for 5 mins or until golden. If using cake flour, sift cake flour/flour mixture then sift again to loosen cake flour mixture and then sift. Add brown sugar, sifted nuts and cardamom and mix well.

title: Pudding Spinach Salad with Spinach
ingredients: 1 package vanilla pudding mix | 1 package frozen chopped spinach, thawed | 1/4 cup vinegar
instructions: Mix together the prepared pudding mix and spinach according to package directions. Pour over salad and refrigerate until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: cooking sherry,extra virgin olive oil,herb,frog leg,rice,mustard powder
title: Baked frog legs
ingredients: 4 frog legs | 1 1/2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 1 tablespoon ground mustard powder | 2 tablespoons finely chopped fresh herbs | 1 tablespoon cooking sherry | 1 2/3 cups rice, cooked
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Put frog legs in a deep casserole dish. Combine olive oil, mustard powder, herbs and sherry and pour over frog legs. Cover with lid or foil. Bake for 2 hour or until golden brown.

title: Citrus Pomegranate Okra Salad
ingredients: 1 cup frozen okra, thawed ( try to use fresh pack okra if they're too hard to roll ) | 1/2 cup fresh cranberries ( from 1/2 cup ) | 1/4 cup pomegranate juice | 2 tablespoons vinegar | 2 tablespoons maple syrup | 2 -3 tablespoons chopped garlic | 1 tablespoon vanilla | 1 cup finely chopped pecans
instructions: Wash okra, chop off ends, then cut in half lengthwise. Put into a bowl, cover with water and set aside. Bring next four ingredients to a boil, reduce heat and simmer for about 10 minutes, or until liquid is reduced to 1 cup. Meanwhile, prepare fruit, if using cranberries, place in food processor or blender with 1/4 cup of the cooked cooking liquid, pomegranate juice, vinegar, maple syrup. Process until all nuts are chopped. Add to okra mixture and stir. Just before serving sprinkle with a little more pomegranate juice. Serve at room temperature or chilled.

title: Cocoa Herb Mix
ingredients: 2 cups sweetened cocoa | 1/2 cup dried marjoram | 1 cup fresh basil leaves
instructions: Stir all together in a small bowl. Keeps in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: golden delicious apple,brown rice,icing sugar,ginger,rum,feta cheese,ice water
title: Apple & Feta Crumble
ingredients: 4 golden delicious apples, eg. granny smith ( about 2lb ) | 2/3 cup light brown rice, uncooked | 100 g reduced-fat feta cheese, crumbled | icing sugar, for dusting cake & topping | ground ginger, to serve | 1 tablespoon rum ( optional ) | ice water ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c. Cut apples into quarters and remove cores. Cut apples in half lengthways. With their skins intact, carefully remove the stalks and any fibrous core you can find in your kitchen. Cut apple quarters into quarters then set aside at room temperature while making crumble. In a large shallow bowl, combine the white breadcrumbs and half the feta cheese. Mix with a fork until it resembles coarse breadcrumbs. Add in the ginger and stir in the rum or rum if using. Dump half the crumble mixture into greased and lined ovenproof dish. Scatter with the remaining crumb mixture and top with crumbled cheese. Bake for 45 - 50 minutes, until top turns golden brown and crumb topping is crisp and toasty and golden.

title: Raspberry-Pepper Spread I
ingredients: 8 ounces bacon, cooked until crisp & chopped finely | 1 tablespoon cumin seed | 3 tablespoons pecorino romano cheese, finely grated | 1/4 cup raspberry jam or 1/4 cup soy sauce | 1/2 teaspoon allspice | 1/4 teaspoon ground cumin
instructions: Place bacon & cumin seeds in a small food processor, process until finely chopped & then transfer to medium bowl. Add cheese & raspberries, mix thoroughly & then let sit for 15 minutes. Stir in allspice & cumin, if using. Cover & refrigerate for several hours.

title: Simple Chili Con Carne
ingredients: 1 can red chili pepper flakes | 1 jar thick & chunky salsa
instructions: Put the chile flakes in a bowl, pour on the salsa & mix. Serve over any other type of meat or vegetables you like, they are great with nacho chips too for dipping.

title: Good for Health Kidney Beans in Coconut Milk
ingredients: 4 cans kidney beans ( not drained ) | 1/4 cup desiccated coconut
instructions: Cook the beans in a little water along with the desiccated coconut for 1 hour, adding water as necessary. It should be tender. You can also use rice beans instead of kidney and you can add more desiccated coconut. When done, let sit for 5 minutes or it may become bitter.

title: St. Patrick's Day Curd
ingredients: 8 ounces spaghetti | 1/4 cup frozen onions & shallots, thawed | 1 envelope unflavored gelatin | 4 1/4 cups spaghetti, broken into pieces | 1/2 cup sprite, or as needed | 1/2 teaspoon onion salt
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, stir in the rice, and return to a boil. Cook the rice uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the rice is cooked through but still firm to the bite, about 13 minutes. Drain well in a colander set in the sink. Preheat the oven to 300 degrees f. Lightly grease a 9x13 inch baking dish. Bring a pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add the pasta and stir. Cook the pasta uncovered, stirring occasionally, until slightly tender, about 12 minutes. Drain well in a colander set over the sink. Sprinkle gelatin over gelatin, then stir to dissolve. Set aside and keep warm. Pour one cup of spaghetti into a medium bowl. Sprinkle on one teaspoon of onion salt. Dilute the gelatin in a little water, about 1 tablespoon at a time, until it is dissolved. To serve, spoon about 1/2 cup of the hot sauce into the center of a dinner plate or warm shallow bowl. Top with 1/2 cup of the drained hot sauce, then sprinkle with 1/2 teaspoon of onion salt.

title: Fiery Mango Juice
ingredients: 1 large mango, peeled and coarsely chopped | 6 1/2 fluid ounces espresso, hot or cold
instructions: Blend all ingredients in a blender until smooth.

title: Chilean Pista (Shrimp Cocktail) #5FIX
ingredients: 1 jar sweet potato flour | 16 ounces can baby shrimp | 36 -36 ladyfingers | corn chips, to decorate | refried beans, to decorate
instructions: Drain shrimp and set aside. Break up sweet potato flour in a food processor and blend until a rough paste forms. You may need to add a couple of tablespoons or so of water to achieve a smoother texture. Set aside. Split ladyfingers in half length ways and roll in corn chips. Chop remaining shrimp roughly. Fry shrimp shrimp in a large frying pan until almost done. Serve with pista and refried beans.

title: Japanese Vegetable Salad (Tonkatsu)
ingredients: 2 bunches radishes, white and green parts, about 1 3/4 pounds each | 1/4 cup ketchup
instructions: Wash and peel the radishes. Cut off the hard top part of them. Slice the radishes 1/4 inch thick. Slice the sections into thin half moon shaped slices. Arrange them on a serving dish large enough to hold them in one layer. Whisk the ketchup and pour it over the radish slices. Cover and marinate in the refrigerator for at least 3 hours, up to 24 hours. Bring to room temperature before serving.

Random Ingredients: pie shell,pizza dough,nutmeg,fennel seed,white wine,chicken bouillon cube,chipotle chile adobo
title: Chipotle Pizza
ingredients: 1 pre-baked pie shell | 1 cup leftover pizza dough ( from the freezer section of pizza dough, can use the ready made pizza dough ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons fennel seeds | 1 cup dry white wine | 1 1/2 chicken bouillon cubes | 1 1/2 chipotle chiles in adobo, minced or 4 teaspoons minced canned chipotles ( i leave the seeds in if they aren't available and i use the chipotles ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground nutmeg
instructions: Preheat oven to 400. Place pie shell on a cookie sheet or pizza screen and make a hole in the center with your thumb and finger. Pour in the dough and poke holes in all around the edge of the shell. Lightly sprinkle the flour over the crust. Sprinkle the seeds, wine and chipotle into the hole in the crust around the perimeter of the crust. Drizzle the chipotle into the crust with your fingers. Drizzle the spices on top of the crust. Sprinkle the nutmeg on top. Bake for 15 mins until crust is puffed and golden. Let cool for 5 - 10 mins before cutting. Excellent with a side of green beans drizzled with extra virgin olive oil.

title: Cranberry Cheese With Blue Cheese, Cabbage, and Parsley Casts
ingredients: 2 medium head of cabbage, cored and shredded | 1/3 cup cranberries | 3/4 cup heavy cream | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley sprigs | 2 ounces crumbled blue cheese | 1 garlic, sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Place the cabbage in a large roasting pan. Combine the cranberries, cream, parsley, crumbled blue cheese, and garlic in a small bowl and stir to combine. Pour mixture over cabbage.

title: Spaghetti and Salsa Pizza
ingredients: 300 g frozen puff pastry | 400 g spaghetti | 4 tablespoons thick & chunky salsa | 1 teaspoon dried oregano | 200 g red potatoes, diced
instructions: Cook the spaghetti as per instructions on the package and set aside in a colander. To make the pizza base, remove the pastry from the package and place into a greased ovenproof dish, then bake according to the directions on the packet. When the pastry is cooked, spread the spaghetti onto the base and then spread the spaghetti on top. Top with the salsa, then spread the oregano on top and sprinkle with the diced potatoes. Place in a pre heated oven and cook for 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: mint,red chili powder,lettuce leaf,yellow onion,tarragon vinegar
title: Green Salad (Lettuce)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon tarragon vinegar | 1 teaspoon red chili powder | 1/2 teaspoon fresh mint, finely chopped | 2 -4 lettuce leaves ( to garnish ) | 1/2 cup yellow onion, finely chopped
instructions: To prepare the dressing, whisk the vinegar and chilli powder in a small bowl. Stir in the mint and add the onion, mixing well. Transfer to a serving dish and sprinkle over the salad leaves. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: lemon peel,alfredo sauce,baby carrot,sharp cheddar cheese,asparagus spear,okra
title: Asparagus and Okra Cheese Rollups (Cook's Il Forno)
ingredients: 6 asparagus spears, tough ends on | 1 package frozen cut okra, thawed | 1 package of sliced fresh baby carrots, cut asparagus diagonally in half | 1 jar of your favorite jarred alfredo sauce | 1/4 cup finely grated lemon peel | 3/4 cup shredded sharp cheddar cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Line a baking sheet with foil. Bring a saucepan of water to a boil, and after a few minutes plunge the asparagus, okra, carrots and asparagus pieces into boiling water, cooking 1 minute or less on each side, draining only as many as possible. Transfer to a large bowl of ice water for 10 - 15 minutes to halt cooking. After the water is boiling, remove the asparagus and okra from the pan and let cool, then place aside in a large bowl. Add alfredo sauce and lemon peel, stirring to combine. Add the cheeses and set aside. Roll the mixture into about 18 rolls. Place the rolls seam side down in the baking pan, cover with foil and bake for 12 to 15 minutes, until golden. Enjoy with a green salad for a complete meal.

title: Faux Hot-and-Sour Stir Fry
ingredients: 6 baby bok choy, stalks trimmed | 1 inch piece orange peel, peel only
instructions: Snap off the ends of the leaves of the bok choy. Using a rolling pin or regular knife, slice crosswise into 1/8 inch wide slices. Cut slits across the leaves at 1 inch intervals. Wrap slits with orange peel. Using a large, heavy duty steaming rack, toss bok choy slices in a microwave safe bowl until coated with the orange peel and salt to taste. Cover bowl and heat in the microwave on the high setting until the leaves are bright green, about 3 minutes. With a slotted spoon, transfer the bok choy with the orange peel to a serving platter. When the sauce's juices run clear, stir. Serve with cooked egg noodles.

title: Croustades
ingredients: 1/2 cup crouton | 1 pinch allspice
instructions: Mix the croutons and allspice together, then roll into tiny balls and fry in butter, a few at a time, until crisp.

title: Easy Sour Cream Salmon
ingredients: 1 lb salmon | 1 -2 tablespoon red wine vinegar | 1 package egg noodles ( uncooked )
instructions: Wash salmon. Cut into 1 inch pieces. Place in a baking dish and bake in a 375°f oven for approximately 15 - 20 minutes until cooked through. Meanwhile, bring a large pot of water to boil. When water is boiling, cook noodles until al dente. Drain and toss with 2 tbsp of vinegar and a tbsp of oil mixture. Garnish with lemon slices and additional lemon and a few parsley flakes. Enjoy.

title: Chili Rellenos
ingredients: 1 can garbanzo beans | 1 can diced tomatoes | 1/2 cup sliced water chestnuts | 1 cup diced leeks or 1 cup green onion | 1/4 cup agave tequila
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and heat on very low heat. Serve on hot flour tortillas.

Random Ingredients: pork loin chop,pea,lemongrass,fish sauce,sharp cheddar cheese,fajita seasoning mix,vanilla vodka
title: Tropical Pork Loin
ingredients: 5 garlic clove | 1 tablespoon fish sauce | 1 tablespoon lemongrass, chopped ( frozen or fresh ) | 3 tablespoons thai roasted fajita seasoning mix | 1/2 cup frozen peas | 5 large pork loin chops | 1 tablespoon vanilla vodka
instructions: Slice the pork loin into 1/2 inch thick slabs about 1 1/2 inches wide by 1/4 1/2 inch high. Slice the lemon grass lengthwise into 2 inch lengths. If it does not get completely cut, slice the top 1/4 inch up, and chop the lemongrass into 3/4 inch pieces. Combine both the fish sauce and the lemongrass and set aside. Heat oven to 300°f. Place garlic in glass or plastic bag and pour boiling water around it to coat. Add the fish sauce and lemon grass and mix well. Add the fajita seasoning mix, peas, and pork slabs and seal with foil. Place in oven and roast for 20 minutes. Turn off oven and let the pork slice rest in the oven for the remaining 10 minutes. After the internal temperature reaches 160°f the internal temperature should be 180°f you can serve this with rice, and it is wonderful.

Random Ingredients: green bean,chili oil,beef brisket,puff pastry,hoisin sauce,champagne,extra beef,clove garlic
title: Chinese Beef and Green Bean Pies
ingredients: 2 sheets frozen puff pastry, thawed | 1/2 cup hoisin sauce | 1/2 cup hoisin sauce | 2 cups beef brisket, trimmed and sliced on the diagonal | 1 lb frozen green beans | 3/4 lb extra lean ground beef | 1 minced clove garlic | 1 bottle champagne ( preferably chablis )
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f unfold pastry sheets, and roll between two sheets of wax paper into 12 x 8 inch rectangles. Press seams together so that if pastry is used less than 1/2 inch between sheets. Spread 1/2 cup hoisin sauce over bottom of 3 pastry rectangles, and layer with 1/2 of the beef, 1/2 of the beans, 1/2 of the beef and 1/2 of the garlic. Roll down edges to seal. Brush tops of pastry with remaining 1/2 cup hoisin sauce. Bake 30 minutes. Turn oven down to 375°f. Return pastries to oven and bake an additional 15 to 20 minutes, or until golden. Remove from oven and tent with foil. Serve at once.

title: Apple and Hazelnut Tortilla
ingredients: 1 canned mushroom stems and pieces, drained, reserving 1 cup liquid | 1 jar diced pimientos, drained | 2 large apples, peeled, cored and cut into 1-inch pieces | 1 cup chopped hazelnuts | 1 cup gruyere cheese, shredded | 1 can refrigerated fat-free egg filling, warm ( optional ) | tortilla chips
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Coat a 9x9x2 inch baking dish with cooking spray. Blend mushroom liquid, chopped pimientos, and apples in a blender until smooth.

title: Fried Beans With Cheese
ingredients: 1 can kidney beans, undrained | 1 can cream of chicken soup | 4 ounces bacon, cubed | 2 tablespoons breadcrumbs
instructions: Cook bacon until crisp but not crisp. Drain on paper towels. In a medium sauce pan combine the beans, soup and bread crumbs and heat through stirring frequently. Serve hot with crackers.

title: Cherry Soda Bread
ingredients: 1 lb rigatoni pasta, cooked | 1 can cherry soda
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit. Grease a 9 x 5 x 2 loaf pan. In a large bowl, combine cooked rigatoni, cherries, and soda. Place in prepared pan. Cover. Bake for 1 hour or until firm.

title: Italian Grilled Cheese
ingredients: 1/2 ounce grated emmenthaler cheese | 2 tablespoons lime juice
instructions: Pound cheese with a mortar or the blade until smooth. Put in a hot, greased grill to make 4 or 5 thin slices. Grill over high heat until golden brown. Turn slices and grill the other side until golden brown.

title: Tart Cherry Crunch
ingredients: 1 tart cherry | 1/4 cup pineapple, canned or 2 tablespoons crushed pineapple, drained | 1/4 cup mandarin orange, drained | 1/4 cup italian parsley, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon tahini | 1/2 teaspoon light italian seasoning ( i prefer zesty italian seasoning ) | 1 dash salt | 1 loaf crusty bread, cut into 1 inch cubes and toasted | 1 package spaghetti or ( 16 ounce ) package macaroni, cooked
instructions: Cut cherry in half, place in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: milk ricotta cheese,sugar,alfredo sauce,greek yogurt,carrot,sausage,chili sauce,chocolate chip
title: My Sausage-Chocolate Casserole
ingredients: 1 package dried lasagna noodles | 1 package sliced smoked sausage | 1 jar alfredo sauce | 2 large carrots, grated | 1 container whole milk ricotta cheese | 14 ounces sweet chili sauce | 1 cup sugar | 2 ounces bittersweet chocolate chips ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees. Heat a large pot of lightly salted water to boil. Add lasagna pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente. Drain. Meanwhile, heat a large skillet over medium high heat. Add the sausage and cook for 5 to 6 minutes, or until browned. Drain off excess fat. Stir in the alfredo sauce. Transfer to a medium sized casserole dish. Sprinkle noodles with carrots and set aside. In a medium bowl, combine ricotta and remaining sauce ingredients. Spread over the sausage mixture in the casserole dish. Sprinkle with chocolate chips. Cover and bake for 30 to 40 minutes, or until heated through.

title: Bacon Wrapped Beef
ingredients: 2 - 3 lbs beef roast | 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 12 bacon | 1/2 cup sweet corn chips ( i prefer the multi-coloured kind )
instructions: Dredge the steak well in the flour and brown in a fry pan. Remove from the fry pan and place in a large casserole dish. Put the corn chips on top. Put the fry pan on the stove and melt the bacon in the fry pan. When it is nice and melted, sprinkle over the meat and corn chips. Cover the casserole and bake in a moderate oven 35 - 40 minutes or till the meat and chips are cooked.

title: Raspberries and Tomato Cream
ingredients: 750 g ripe raspberries | 1 liter half-and-half cream | 3 medium tomatoes | 5 ounces raspberry jam
instructions: Place raspberries, half and half, and tomato halves into a food processor. Pulse 5 times or until the purees are as smooth as you want your cream to be. Place into a casserole dish and spread out to cover. Cover, bring to the boil, and bake for 30 - 40 minutes. Stir with a spoon every 15 minutes to make sure that the cream doesn’t stick to the bottom of the pot. You need to stir occasionally to make sure there is always something going on. Stir in the raspberries if they have dried out, and return to the oven for a further 15 minutes or so – this is very important remove the raspberries from the heat. Leave to cool completely in the pan, then cover and refrigerate overnight.

title: Onion "Miseria" (Waldorf Salad)
ingredients: 1 head iceberg lettuce | 4 tablespoons sherry
instructions: Toast the lettuce leaves in a heavy skillet over low heat, taking care not to burn them, for about 30 seconds, and giving off a gentle shake and shake with a spatula as you go. Immediately remove and discard the lettuce leaves and spread them out onto the baking sheet lightly with the sherry. When cool, toss with the sherry before refrigerating.

title: Easy Cocoa Mac
ingredients: 1 box macaroni | 4 teaspoons unsweetened cocoa powder
instructions: In a large pot of boiling, salted water, cook the macaroni according to package directions. Drain. Return to the package, and stir in the cocoa powder. Serve warm.

title: Artichoke and Broccoli Phyllo Triangles
ingredients: 5 cups fresh broccoli, chopped | 4 ounces artichoke hearts, packed in oil, drained and minced | 1/2 cup frozen artichoke hearts, thawed | 12 sheets phyllo dough
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Prepare a baking sheet by spraying with non stick cooking spray. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to boil and cook phyllo sheets for one minute or less than specified on package. Remove and place on baking sheet. Toss the chopped fresh broccoli with minced artichokes and frozen artichoke hearts to coat, then fill each phyllo with about 1/4 of the broccoli and artichoke mixture. Top each stack with a phyllo sheet. Bake in the preheated oven for 15 - 20 minutes, or until phyllo is crispy and the broccoli is tender.

title: Mushrooms and Corn Chips
ingredients: 12 corn tortillas | 1 cup mushroom, finely chopped, or more if desired
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Cut 3 or 4 slit in each tortilla. Insert each slit into a teaspoon sized hole. Fill each tortilla with some of the mushroom, and sprinkle with some more of the fried vegetables. Wrap each in a piece of aluminum foil.

title: Tunisian Cheese
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs prosciutto or 1 1/2 lbs mozzarella cheese ( cut into 1-inch cubes ) | 1 teaspoon italian herb seasoning ( or use 1/2 tsp dried herbs of your choice )
instructions: Preheat oven to 450f degrees. Cut cheese in cubes of equal size, and then toss with remaining ingredients. Place on greased cookie sheets. Bake for 15 - 30 minutes, or until hot.

title: Rice Crab Fettuccine
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups long grain rice | 2 1/4 cups crabmeat | 3 slices rye bread ( or other thin, crusty bread ) | fettuccine pasta
instructions: In a large pot, stir up the rice and crab meat. Cook for 15 minutes over medium heat. Turn heat to low, and cook the rice until heated through, about 15 minutes more. Meanwhile, cook the bread slices on a cookie sheet in the oven for a few minutes until crisp. Remove, and cut into bite size pieces. Set aside. When the rice is done, stir in the crab and bread pieces. Serve over hot, cooked fettuccine.

title: Cranberry and Spicy Sausage Caribbean Sausages
ingredients: 1 lb hot italian sausage | 2 large ripe avocados, cut in 3/4-inch chunks ( about 1 pound ) | 1/2 cup cranberries or 1/2 cup other fresh cranberries, coarsely chopped | 2 medium green chili peppers or 2 medium serrano peppers, seeded and finely chopped | 1/2 teaspoon real vanilla | 3/4 cup granulated sugar | 1/4 teaspoon ground cloves
instructions: Remove meat from sausage casings, crumble and set aside. Remove seeds from peppers, cut into 1/4 slices. Combine all ingredients in a large shallow bowl, toss to mix well. Divide among 4 - 12 inch skillet, cook and stir over medium heat until edges begin to brown, about 10 minutes, turning once, basting occasionally. Serve warm with pita chips.

title: Easy Pistachio Bread
ingredients: 1 bag shelled pistachios | 1/2 cup ketchup | 1 loaf focaccia bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Spread sliced pistachios in a single layer onto baking sheet. Place baking sheet into oven and bake for 20 minutes. Remove, and turn over onto a cutting board. Dry nuts on baking sheet for 5 minutes. Use a knife to cut through top of pistachios, then slice through the slits in the bread. Return bread to baking sheet and spread ketchup over bread.

title: Low Sodium Deviled Eggs
ingredients: 4 eggs | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 1 cup chopped cherry tomatoes | 1 dash nutmeg
instructions: Melt a little margarine or oil in a skillet over medium heat. Cut whites in half. Place 1 egg to cover bottom of an 8 ounce skillet. Sprinkle with salt and nutmeg. Fry until eggs are set and whites are lightly browned. Serve immediately and sprinkle with chopped tomatoes.

Random Ingredients: wheat tortilla,plain flour,walnut,tomato puree,green bell pepper,vodka,sunflower oil
title: Spanish Tortilla
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sunflower oil | 1 tablespoon vodka | 1 green bell pepper, seeded and chopped into strips | 2 tablespoons tomato puree | 2 tablespoons walnuts, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon plain flour, mixed with | 1 tablespoon sunflower oil | 4 whole wheat tortillas
instructions: Heat a frying pan until really hot and fry the tortillas briefly on each side. Spread the sunflower oil to cover 2 x 2 inch shallow patty pans. Heat 1 tablespoon oil in another pan, and stir-fry the pepper for 4 to 5 minutes until softened. Add the tomato puree, walnuts, flour, and vodka and mix. Leave to simmer for 5 minutes, or until the sauce is thick. Scatter the tortilla strips over the sauce and serve immediately.

title: Shiitake Mushroom and Lime Salad
ingredients: 1 package sliced shiitake mushrooms | 1 cup fat-free lemon-lime beverage | 2 teaspoons prepared english-style mustard | 1/3 cup prepared fat-free prepared nonfat topping
instructions: Place mushrooms in a medium bowl, and pour lemon-lime flavored soda over them. Toss well. Cover, and refrigerate up to 2 hours. Remove mushrooms from the brine, and chop, or to desired size. Add mustard to the chopped mushrooms, and mix. Set aside. Spread nonfat topping on the chilled salad, and place mushrooms on top. Chill 2 hours before serving.

Random Ingredients: bean,cheddar cheese,taco sauce,yellow cake mix,cream cheese,nori
title: Sunchy Taco Bars
ingredients: 16 ounces sour cream cheese ( i use reduced fat ) or 16 ounces plain yogurt yogurt ( i use reduced fat ) | 1 package yellow cake mix | 1 can refried beans | 1 jar taco sauce ( i use mild and spicy ) | 12 -20 nori, triangles ( toasted ) | 1 cup cheddar cheese ( shredded )
instructions: Grease and flour a 13x9 baking pan and set aside. Preheat oven to melt cake mix in top of saucepan until thoroughly moistened. Dissolve taco sauce in a litle water and pour into batter, stir well. Spread mixture evenly in pan. Sprinkle nori on top of batter. Bake for 20 - 30 minutes to set. Remove from oven and top with cheddar cheese, return to oven and bake for an additional 10 - 15 minutes. Cool a few minutes before cutting and serving.

title: Homemade Yoghurt (Kheen Ka Saak)
ingredients: 1 kg yoghurt | 1 pinch cayenne pepper | maraschino cherry
instructions: Whip yoghurt and add cayenne pepper to taste. Serve the gilled yoghurt on flat bread, pita bread, rice, raita chips, etc. Or you can add finely sliced cucumber, tomatoes if required. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: sesame seed,pastry crust pie,walnut,red enchilada sauce,sea salt,veal
title: Spicy Roast Veal Empanadas
ingredients: 3 tablespoons sesame seeds | 1 pinch flaked sea salt | 1 lb ground veal | 1 cup chopped walnuts | 3 cans red enchilada sauce, divided | 2 prepared pre-made pastry shells
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f put sesame seeds in a bowl, sprinkle with sea salt. Mix in ground veal. Add walnuts and 1 can enchilada sauce. Mix well. On a cookie sheet, put your pastry shells on the top. Put your filling in the center by pressing the pastry with a fork. Pinch sides and seams. Place on top of the pastry shells. Place the rest of your enchilada sauce on top of the enchiladas. Bake for 30 to 40 minutes. Serve with plain white rice.

title: Vanilla Bean Farls
ingredients: 100 g white flour, white all purpose | 1 teaspoon vanilla | 1 vanilla bean, split length-wise
instructions: Put the flour in a bowl and mix in the vanilla and vanilla bean. Using your hands, quickly rub the flour into the seeds and the vanilla bean until the dough starts to stick to your hands. The idea is to get a fine, compact dough. If it doesn’t, then your dough will be runny. Keep adding flour and kneading until it looks like a cohesive mass of dough that clings together until no traces of flour remain. Continue to work and knead until it becomes soft and smooth, adding more flour as needed. Roll the dough out on the floured surface and cut into about 5 wide strips. Heat a non stick pan until very hot, put a few strips of dough at a time into the hot pan and fry until they are golden brown. They only take about 2 to 4 minutes or so depending on your heat level. Turn them over and brown them on the other side. Remove them and keep warm until all are cooked. Serve immediately.

title: Krakas Untimate Parisian Meat Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb meat, meat | 1 shallot | 1 piece cinnamon stick | 14 ounces stewed tomatoes | 8 ounces finely shredded cucumbers | 2 ounces finely shredded gingerroot | 1 ounce wondra flour | 1 ounce walnuts, ground
instructions: Cut meat up into bite sized pieces. Boil the meat until they are very tender, drain off any excess water. Cook shallot and cinnamon stick in the same pan. After you have cooked the meat until they are brown. Add all the other ingredients except the ground walnuts. Cook until the stew starts to thicken, about 15 - 20 minutes. Mix to smooth a paste and add 1/2 cup water while continuing to cook. Serve over pasta, rice or potatoes.

Random Ingredients: corn oil,extra virgin olive oil,mango chutney,mango,cornmeal
title: The Gambas
ingredients: 1/2 cup cornmeal ( stone ground or instant masa harina in mexican can be substituted ) | 1 1/2 cups mango chutney ( can use mango chutney or try mango chutney ) | 1 tablespoon corn oil | 1/2 mango, cut into chunks ( to taste ) | extra virgin olive oil ( to taste )
instructions: Combine all the ingredients in a bowl, cover and set aside. If using a canning ring, fill it with water twice the jar. If using a can, fill the can with water twice the jar and set upside down. Cover and let sit for at least an hour. To make in a blender or food processor, process all ingredients until smooth. Add water until mix reaches desired consistency. If too thick, add water, 1/4 cup at a time. Taste then adjust seasoning. You may need to adjust the amount of mango chutney or chutney you like. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: vinegar,cooking oil,salt pepper,cottage cheese,celery seed,red chili pepper flake
title: Ajiaco (Cottage Cheese) Dip (Spanish-Yukon gold)
ingredients: 16 ounces cottage cheese ( or ricotta ) | 1 tablespoon salt-free vinegar | 1 tablespoon cooking oil | 1/2 teaspoon crushed red chili pepper flakes | 1 teaspoon celery seed | salt and pepper, to taste
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine cottage cheese cubes, salt free vinegar, oil, chili pepper flakes, celery seed and pepper. Whisk well. Let stand 20 minutes at room temperature. Strain through cheesecloth, pressing as much air out of the mixture to remove solids. Serve chilled or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: plain nonfat yogurt,brown lentil,nori,dark soy sauce,cumin seed,lebanese cucumber,crabmeat
title: Lebanese Crab on a Roll in Yogurt-Yogurt
ingredients: 1/4 cup brown lentils | 1 cup plain nonfat yogurt | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce | 1 teaspoon chopped cumin seed | 40 g crabmeat | 1 lebanese cucumber, seeded and chopped | 1 sheet nori, torn into 24 strips
instructions: Place lentils, yoghurt, soy sauce, cumin in a shallow, non stick baking dish. Season with salt and pepper. Cover and refrigerate for 4 hours or overnight. Mix cucumber, nori and crab meat with remaining ingredients to make a dip for the cucumber. Serve dip on the side.

Random Ingredients: turmeric,rice powder,self rising flour,white bread,anchovy,baking potato,orange blossom honey
title: Orange Blossom Honey & Anchovy Pull Apart Bites
ingredients: 3 ripe baking potatoes, sliced in half lengthwise | 3 anchovies, filleted, chopped coarsely | 3 tablespoons orange blossom honey | 2 tablespoons rice powder | 2 cups self rising flour | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric
instructions: Place potatoes in a saucepan with cold water and a pinch of salt. Cook over medium heat until potatoes are just tender. Drain and place in a bowl. Meanwhile, place anchovies in a dry frying pan over medium heat and fry for 1 minute or until crispy. Set aside. Add honey, baking soda, rice, flour and turmeric and mix well. Place warm potatoes on a sheet tray, spray with cooking spray and spread evenly. Pour topping evenly over potatoes and sprinkle with cinnamon.

title: Sauerkraut (German Plum Tomato Jam)
ingredients: 200 -200 g ripe plum tomatoes | 100 g powdered ginger | 2 pinches vanilla sugar | 1/2 cup warm sauerkraut, drained
instructions: In a large saucepan, stir tomato pulp with ginger and sugar over low to moderate heat, stirring constantly. Cook for 5 more minutes, stirring. Let jam cool and blend into hot hot jars, leaving 1cm space at the top. Seal with nylon tie or a tight fitting lid. Put in a cool dark place for 3 days or more. Leave jam in the jampan for a further 3 weeks. The amount of time in which the jam will marinate the food will change from yellow to clear. If the sauerkraut turns brown before it's ready, seal before it passes the desired colouring. The sauerkraut is ready when you can smell the aroma of the jam, it has reduced to a thick paste.

title: Lemongrass Sweet Couscous
ingredients: 1 package mori nuong curry sweet potatoes with shell | 1 package quick-cooking couscous | 1 tablespoon lemongrass, chopped | 1 tablespoon ghee | 1/4 cup miracle whip | 2 unbaked pie shells
instructions: Microwave mori nuong on high until hot, about two minutes. Place the sweet potato and couscous in a bowl and cover with plastic wrap with a lid and microwave on high for two minutes. Remove from the microwave and let sit for five minutes, then fluff up with fork or fork. Heat ghee in a skillet over medium heat. Stir in sweet potato and lemon grass until heated through. Add the sweet potato, couscous, and miracle whip and stir to combine. Place filling on each pie shell and serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Thai Stuffed Yellow Squash
ingredients: 2 large yellow squash | 4 -6 slices bacon | 3 -4 tablespoons thai fish sauce | 2 -3 tablespoons sweet white mushroom
instructions: To prepare filling, finely chop a slice of bacon. Bring a large pot of water to a boil, add squash and cook until soft. Remove from heat. Drain and rinse with cold water. Slice lengthwise and scoop out seeds using a spoon. Do not stuff the squash into the pot. Remove the pulp with a spoon or small spoon. Set aside. To prepare stuffing for stuffing, in a small bowl, combine fish sauce and mushroom. Stuff the squash with 1 teaspoons of the stuffing and place on a plate. Drizzle with the remaining fish sauce mixture on top of the squash. Serve immediately.

title: Taco-Mango Chutney
ingredients: 4 ounces mango chutney | 3 1/2 tablespoons low-fat taco seasoning mix | 3 1/2 tablespoons cornflour
instructions: Mix everything together. Store in a jar in the fridge for up to 2 weeks. Shake the jar often and keep at a near room temperature. This is especially tasty with baby vegetables and prawns.

Random Ingredients: white bean,iceberg lettuce,radish,meatball,linguine,thai red chili pepper
title: Thai Cold Noodle Salad
ingredients: 3 hard-cooked frozen meatballs, thawed | 1 package linguine, cooked and drained or ( 16 ounce ) package other thin spaghetti | 1 head iceberg lettuce, rinsed and chopped | 8 radishes, sliced thinly and divided, lengthwise | 1 small dried thai red chili pepper | 3/4 cup white beans, cooked
instructions: On a large platter or in a salad bowl, arrange the meatballs evenly spaced evenly. Place the cooked pasta on top. Place 3/4 the radishes on the noodles. Top with 1/4 of the chili pepper. Sprinkle with the remaining 3/4 of the radishes. Mix all these ingredients together. Drizzle dressing over and over the salad. Place the platter under the broiler until the salad is nicely browned on the edges and the chili pepper is lightly colored.

title: Warm Brown Sugar Potatoes
ingredients: 1/4 lb yukon gold potato, peeled and diced into 1/2-inch cubes ( about 2 3/4 pounds ) | 4 teaspoons dark brown sugar | 1 teaspoon unrefined dark brown sugar
instructions: In a 2 to 2 1/2 to 3 qt casserole, toss the potatoes with the dark brown sugar, the brown sugar, and the sugar in 1 generous amount of water.

Random Ingredients: cottage cheese,apple juice,oyster sauce,beef stock,yeast cake,pistachio
title: Pistachio Rolls
ingredients: 1/3 cup honey ( preferably agave syrup ) | 3 cups sifted cottage cheese ( or low-fat plain yogurt, or yoghurt or gluten-free curd ) | 1 1/2 cups hot beef stock ( such as swanson certified angus beef stroganoff or swanson organic low sodium ) | 1 egg, lightly beaten | 1 tablespoon water ( reserved from beef broth ) | 1 1/2 cups fresh yeast cakes | 1 1/2 tablespoons dried salted pistachios, coarsely chopped
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together honey and ¼ cup hot beef broth.

Random Ingredients: dark chocolate,chicken broth,black peppercorn,dijon mustard,chili flake,sea salt pepper
title: Chocolate Black Pepper Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 200 g dark chocolate, roughly chopped | 125 ml chicken broth | 2 tablespoons dijon-style mustard | 1/2 teaspoon fresh ground black peppercorns | 1/2 teaspoon chili flakes ( or to taste ) | salt & pepper
instructions: Place all ingredients in a pot and bring to simmering boil over medium heat for about 5 minutes, until sauce thickens slightly. Turn down heat to low and leave to simmer for 5 minutes. Pour over your favourite food and serve.

Random Ingredients: black pepper,wheat bread,pecorino romano cheese,parmesan cheese,beef base,cayenne pepper,chuck,white pepper
title: Pepper Cheddar - Italian Burger With Croutons #5FIX
ingredients: 1 boneless chuck | 1/4 cup freshly shredded pecorino romano cheese | 4 tablespoons freshly shredded parmesan cheese | 1/4 tablespoon beef base | 1/4 teaspoon white pepper | 1/4 teaspoon black pepper | 2 slices whole wheat bread | cayenne pepper
instructions: Grill chuck on all sides in a skillet until medium rare / rare to medium / 4 to 6 minutes, depending on thickness of piece of meat. Set meat slices aside. Toast bread & cut into quarters. Using a meat mallet or rolling pin or other heavy skillet, hold the slices slightly flattened in your hand. Remove the flattened bread from your skillet & place in a bowl. Mash up some of the cheeses slightly by using a fork or a wooden spoon. Place the shredded cheeses in a bowl & add the beef base, white pepper, black pepper. Stir well to combine. To assemble, place a piece of cheese on top of each piece of toast. Sprinkle each with a few dashes of cayenne pepper. Place another piece of toast on top of each piece of cheese & top with the beef. Finally, top with the last piece of cheese & close with a wooden board. Wrap in foil or a piece of foil & place on a plate. Microwave on high for 2 minutes until cheese is melted & beef is hot, but not screaming hot. Serve as a sandwich with the hearty hamburgers & garlic bread.

title: Basic Polenta
ingredients: 2 cups cornmeal | 2 tablespoons italian seasoning
instructions: Preheat the oven on the highest setting. Mix your dry ingredients with your kitchenaid and then add to a large well in order using a big wooden spoon to incorporate the cornmeal. Turn your mixer on medium and mix with the dry ingredients. Transfer the mixture to a lightly oiled, non stick pan. Sprinkle the top with additional italian seasoning. Slide it back onto the preheated oven. Bake for 25 minute.

title: Quick & Easy Baked Penne Pasta
ingredients: 4 -5 small baking potatoes | 1 lb dry penne pasta
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Bake penne pasta until al dente, and drain well. Pierce potato skins with a fork so that some can fall off. Cook potatoes in boiling water for about 8 minutes, then drain. In a large nonstick skillet fry potatoes with olive oil and some seasoning until tender. Combine cooked pasta, potato/vegetable mixture, and cooked penne in a large casserole dish. Cover and bake at 400 degrees for 25 - 30 additional minutes.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray,lemon pepper,nut,arborio rice,savoy cabbage
title: Leerio's Vegetable Fried Rice
ingredients: 1 head savoy cabbage, cut into 1 inch squares | vegetable oil cooking spray | 2 cups arborio rice | 1/4 cup sliced nut ( optional ) | 1 dash lemon pepper
instructions: Spray a nonstick skillet with oil spray. Heat skillet over medium heat until it starts to smoke. Add cabbage, stir fry for 1 minute. Add remaining ingredients. Stir fry for 1 additional minute on medium heat.

Random Ingredients: swiss cheese,mushroom,sea bass fillet,arborio rice,vegetarian bean,part mozzarella cheese,taco seasoning
title: Mediterranean Sea Bass and Veggie Bake
ingredients: 3 cups cooked arborio rice | 2 tablespoons vegan ground beef and beans ( morningstar farms reduced sodium or organic ) | 1/4 cup part-skim mozzarella cheese | 1/4 cup swiss cheese ( grated ) | 1 can vegetarian baked beans ( healthy choice ready to bake ) | 1 teaspoon taco seasoning | 2 2 tuna steak or 2 sea bass fillets
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Rinse and set aside the rice. In a sprayed 9 x 3 inch baking dish, layer in the following order, rice, vegan ground beef, meatless beans, mozzarella, swiss cheese, tuna fish and top again with the dry rice. Spray a baking sheet with non stick cooking spray and bake, uncovered, for 45 minutes. Uncover and sprinkle with taco seasoning. Continue baking, uncovered, for approximately 15 minutes longer. Top with a sprinkle of cheese before serving.

title: Kalaat (Paste of Salmon)
ingredients: 2 whole skinless, boneless salmon | 1/2 teaspoon asafoetida powder, or as desired | 1/2 teaspoon harissa, or to taste | 1/4 cup sunflower oil | 1 pound skinless, boneless chicken wings, crushed, or more to taste
instructions: Place salmon in a shallow bowl and coat each piece with asafetida. Heat sunflower oil in a cast iron skillet over medium high heat until it shimmers. Place salmon in pan and sprinkle with sea salt. Cook until fish flakes easily with a fork, 5 to 9 minutes. Reduce heat to low and continue cooking until fish flakes easily and asafetida powder is no longer cloudy, 2 to 3 minutes more. Remove salmon and place in a shallow bowl. Toss fish pieces with asafetida and harissa in the oil. Arrange the asafetida and chicken wings around the salmon, and allow to saute until the curry comes to a boil. Reduce heat to low and cover the dish until the curry is ready, about 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: horseradish,lime juice,rice,thyme sprig,matzo cake meal,lime wedge,pistachio nut,dark chocolate
title: Matzoh With a Romantic Touch!
ingredients: 2 1/3 cups matzo cake meal | 1/4 cup dark chocolate or 1/4 cup other chocolate milk chocolate, melted | 1/4 cup lime juice | 2 tablespoons horseradish | 1 tablespoon minced fresh thyme sprig | lime wedge | pistachio nut, curls ( optional ) | cooked rice or cooked brown rice, cooked for topping
instructions: Place the matzo cake meal in a large bowl. Add the melted chocolate, lime juice, horseradish, thyme and lime wedges and mix. Using your hands, form the mixture into 2 - ½ inch diameter balls. Toss lightly to coat. Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour. Prepare the rice and serve along with the matza.

title: Chili Powder Grape Beans
ingredients: 1 lb red grapes ( about 4 medium ) | 1/2 cup peanut oil or 1/2 cup other neutral oil | 1 teaspoon chili powder
instructions: Cut grapes in half, remove the seeds and discard the ends. Cut grapes into 1/2 inch dice, or just larger pieces, if using a smaller quantity. Place the grapes in a skillet over medium heat and saute about 5 - 10 minutes, until the grapes begin to darken and soften. This should take about 5 minutes. Remove grapes from heat and set aside to cool completely. Heat oil in a small saucepan until hot. Remove grapes from the skillet, shaking to coat. Add chili powder and stir well to combine. Return grapes to skillet and stir for about one minute more to coat. Allow grapes to cool slightly and transfer to your serving container for freezing.

Random Ingredients: broccoli,apple juice concentrate,potato,mandarin orange,cayenne powder,caster sugar
title: Gramma's Irish Breakfast
ingredients: 8 -10 medium size gold potatoes, like granny smith or 8 -10 medium size gold potatoes | 1 can mandarin oranges ( with a homemade concentrate in it ) | 1/2 - 3/4 cup apple juice concentrate ( with a bit of apple concentrate ) | 1 bunch broccoli, cut into thick ribbons ( optional ) | cayenne powder ( optional )
instructions: Heat up the apple juice and concentrate in a small pan and bring to boil. Cut up 3 potatoes very thinly and toss with 1/4 of the mandarin oranges and 2/3 of the mandarin oranges. Pour the apple juice mixture evenly over the potato slices and stir to coat. Cook for about 3 - 10 minutes or until it is nice and bubbly. Add 1/4 of the broccoli and cook for an additional 2 - 3 minutes, or until it is almost crispy. Repeat with remaining ingredients and toss. Sprinkle a dash of cayenne powder over everything, and serve with a nice helping of fresh irish bread. Note, if you make a double batch or two, you can freeze half of the rest of the mix and half for another meal.

Random Ingredients: gingerroot,chili sauce,taco sauce,mint sprig,red chili pepper
title: Korean Spicy Beef
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs fresh skirt steaks, cubed | 2 tablespoons chili sauce ( korean kim chee ) | 1 tablespoon grated gingerroot | 1 red chili pepper, thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons minced of fresh mint sprigs | 3 -4 tablespoons sweet chili sauce, for dipping
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a large zip top plastic bag. Add beef and marinate in refrigerator overnight. Preheat oven to 450f and cook beef on high for 10 to 15 minutes, or until desired doneness has been reached. Drain beef well. Place meat in a broiler safe casserole dish. Pour marinade over meat. Place a large platter over the meat and pour the sweet sauce over. Garnish as desired with fresh mint sprigs, and if desired, green onions.

title: Sumac and Cilantro Toasts
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons sumac | 1 1/2 teaspoons finely chopped cilantro | 2 slices rye bread, toasted | 1/4 - 1/2 lemon
instructions: Dry the toast generously on both sides. Put 3 - 4 tablespoons of sumac in toasted bread slices and put a couple of slices on top. Top with remaining toasted bread slices and sprinkle with lemon juice. Eat with salad leaves, pickles and a side salad. Variation on lemon, substitute 3/4 tsp dried red pepper flakes for sumac and add more zest towards the end of prep time. Variation on arabic bread, sprinkle with dried orange and lemon, chopped parsley and cilantro before adding oil or water.

title: Pasta with a Bordelaise Sauce & Fennel
ingredients: 1 lb pasta shells | 1 lb mixed greens, such as swiss chard or 1 lb french frisee | 1/2 cup dry red wine | 1 pinch ground fennel | 2 teaspoons quatre-epices
instructions: Cook the pasta according to the directions on the packet, drain and return to the pot. Meanwhile, place the greens in a dry frying pan and add the wine, a pinch of fennel and a few drops of the quatre épices, plus a pinch of the quatre epices. Bring to the boil, stir, then cook for 30 - 45 seconds. Add the reserved pasta, the greens and the remaining fennel powder to the pot. Bring to the boil and cook over low heat for 3 minutes. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: american cheese,season salt pepper,green bean,vegetable oil cooking spray,nut,irish cream
title: Shamrock Green Beans #5FIX
ingredients: 6 ounces soft fresh green beans, trimmed | 1 cup irish cream | 1/2 cup vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 tablespoon maggi seasoning salt or 1 tablespoon salt | 16 ounces shredded irish cream | 1/2 cup mixed nuts, coarsely chopped
instructions: Prepare 8 x 12 pan or 9 x 12 in square pans by lightly spray with vegetable cooking spray. Cook green beans with 1 tbsp of vegetable oil. While hot, sprinkle 1 tsp of maggi seasoning or salt over green beans. Cover and keep warm. Place remaining 1/2 tsp of maggi seasoning in pan. When it starts to bubble, add 1/2 cup mixed nuts to pan and toast, stirring constantly. Stir in green beans. Spoon green bean and nut mixture over beans. Sprinkle with remaining 1/2 tsp of maggi seasoning. Allow the green beans to warm through and flavors blend, about 5 minutes. Spread on a baking sheet lined with non stick paper. Allow to cool slightly.

Random Ingredients: basil leaf,maraschino cherry,cheddar cheese,dark brown sugar,vodka,olive juice,salmon fillet,black eyed pea
title: Black Russian Blush
ingredients: 2 skinless salmon fillets | 1/2 cup vodka | 3/4 cup olive juice | 1/2 cup sliced pitted ripe olives with juice | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh basil leaf | 1/2 cup shredded cheddar cheese | 1 tablespoon dark brown sugar | 2 maraschino cherries
instructions: Place salmon in 9x13 inch baking dish. Combine vodka and olive juice with basil, cheese, brown sugar and cherries. Pour over salmon and marinate in the refrigerator for 2 hours. Preheat ove to 350 degrees f. Bake in preheated oven for 25 to 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: garam masala,vegetable shortening,topping,natural almond,pork shoulder,kosher salt,milk
title: Shredded Pork
ingredients: 4 teaspoons vegetable shortening | 2 pounds boneless pork shoulder, diced | 2 cups milk | 1 1/2 teaspoons kosher salt | 1 package frozen whipped topping, thawed | 1/2 cup blanched, salted whole natural almonds, or other nuts | 1 teaspoon garam masala, or to taste
instructions: Line the bottom and sides of a large slow cooker with slices of aluminum foil. In a large bowl, sprinkle the shortening over the pork and mix well. Add the milk, salt, and whipped topping, and stir until well combined. Layer the meat on the foil in layers, beginning with the almonds, and finishing with the whipped topping. Microwave on high until the meat is hot and beginning to soften, 2 to 3 minutes.

Random Ingredients: sourdough bread,italian tomato,sun tomato oil,shiitake mushroom
title: Baked Tomato & Sun-Dried Tomato Bruschetta
ingredients: 4 cups sliced peeled italian tomatoes, chilled | 1/2 cup thinly sliced unpeeled shiitake mushroom, sliced | 1 tablespoon sun-dried tomato packed in oil, sliced thinly | 16 slices sourdough bread, toasted
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line baking sheet with parchment paper. Arrange tomato slices on baking sheet. Cover with sliced mushrooms. Combine sun dried tomato oil and blackened tomato and drizzle over tomatoes and mushrooms. Bake for 40 minutes or until tomato topping is golden and mushrooms are tender.

title: Gingery Onion Dip
ingredients: 3 tablespoons yogurt or 6 ounces sour cream | 1 packet onion soup mix | 6 ounces ginger ale or 6 ounces ale
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Serve with your favourite veggies you have around to dip.

Random Ingredients: ginger,fajita seasoning mix,grain mustard,heavy whipping cream,almond extract,butter bean
title: Almond Garlic Butterscotch Beans
ingredients: 1 pint heavy whipping cream | 3 tablespoons fajita seasoning mix | 3 tablespoons whole grain mustard | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground ginger | 1 teaspoon almond extract | 15 ounces butter beans, drained with juice reserved
instructions: Combine cream, fajita seasoning mix, mustard, ginger and almond extract in a saucepan. Simmer, stirring frequently, to blend flavors, about 3 minutes. Toss warmed beans with cream mixture. Serve immediately.

title: Hungarian Goulash
ingredients: 2 lbs steak, cut into strips | 1/2 lb kielbasa or 1/2 lb spicy italian sausage, cut into strips | 1 can red enchilada sauce | 1/2 cup sweet hungarian paprika | 4 tablespoons hot oil
instructions: Brown meat in hot oil. Add kielbasa or sausage, enchilada sauce, sweet paprika and oil. Simmer on low for about 45 minutes until meat is done.

title: Beer and Turnip Dressing Dip
ingredients: 1 beer, or as needed | 2 boxes instant vanilla pudding with seasoning | 2 tablespoons cajun seasoning | 1 container prepared pizza crusts | 1 large turnip ( peeled and diced )
instructions: Pour beer into a large, resealable plastic bag. Squeeze around the inside of the bag to remove any air bubbles. Add the vanilla pudding mix, cajun seasoning, and turnip.

title: Spaghetti Alla Genovese
ingredients: 500 g ripe tomatoes puree | 100 g grated provolone cheese | 20 black cardamom seeds
instructions: Grind cardamom seeds with the back of a tablespoon until they are very fine. Mix the grated provolone with the ground cardamom powder until the mixture is soft. Cut the ripe tomatoes into thick circles and scoop out the seeds. Arrange the sliced tomatoes on the top of the provolone mixture and sprinkle with pepper to taste. Sprinkle provolone mixture on top of the tomato mixture. Turn heat on to very low and leave the ingredients to simmer. Turn off heat and leave the covered for one hour or longer. Serve right away.

Random Ingredients: salt black pepper,cream cheese,beef chuck steak,spaghetti,wasabi powder,beef chuck,leek,golden raisin
title: Philly Cheesesteak and wasabi Cheesesteak
ingredients: 1 pound lean beef chuck steak, cut 1/2-inch thick | 1/2 package cream cheese, cut into cubes | 1 pound trimmed and thinly sliced leeks | 1/4 cup golden raisins | 1 teaspoon wasabi powder | 1 pound uncooked spaghetti | 1 tablespoon salt and ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium high heat.

title: The Most Simple and Flavious Gebhardt Kafta
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs finest grind berbere ( or 3 1/2 oz. ground mixed spice ) | 1/2 cup grated parmesan cheese, preferably a blend of both
instructions: If you can't find the berbere italian spices italian spices is called gebhardt gebhardt, 1/4 teaspoons = 1/4 tsp = 1/2 tsp = 1/4 tsp, or 2 tsp = 1 1/2 tsp = 1/2 tsp. You can also use 2 tsp. Of ground cinnamon and 3/4 tsp = 2 tsp = 1/2 tsp. If you could not find italian spice, you could add 1/4 tsp of ground cloves. Place in a plastic bag and mix well. Cover and leave in the refridgerator for 2 to 3 days before using. It freezes well, and is great for sandwiches, etc. Note, i tried some combination of this and other recipes to replicate morgon's gebhardt gebhardt and others i tried.

Random Ingredients: black peppercorn,sharp cheddar cheese,onion salt,thyme,coffee,apricot,almond paste
title: Hot and Creamy Aubert
ingredients: 1/2 cup apricot | 3 tablespoons prepared strong coffee | 1/2 teaspoon ground black peppercorns | 1/4 teaspoon onion salt | 1/8 teaspoon dried thyme | 1 tablespoon almond paste | 1/8 teaspoon shredded sharp cheddar cheese or 1/8 teaspoon other strongly flavored cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees. Place apricots, coffee, peppercorns, onion salt, thyme, almond paste in a food processor or blender and blend into a fine paste. Spray a 2 quart baking dish with nonstick spray. Pour paste into baking dish and sprinkle with cheese. Bake at 300 degrees for approximately 1 hour or until bubbly and edges are nicely browned.

title: Sweet Potato and Pasta Bites With Rose Syrup
ingredients: 1/3 cup light rose syrup | 4 cups cooked mashed sweet potatoes | 1 tablespoon active dry yeast | 4 cups breadcrumbs | 1/2 cup dry breadcrumbs | 3 tablespoons vanilla essence
instructions: Dissolve the yeast in the warm water. Beat in the sweet potato and sweetner. Stir in the breadcrumbs, and mix well. Add the vanilla and mix well. Turn into greased baking pans. Sprinkle with extra 1 tbsp of your favourite breadcrumbs and 1 tbsp of your favorite bread crumb mixture. Bake at 400 deg f/210 deg celsius for 15 - 20 minutes or until golden brown, stirring once. Turn out onto a wire rack to cool.

title: Kangaroo and Maple Whisky Baked Pot Stacks
ingredients: 2 tablespoons maple syrup ( for brushing ) | 1 tablespoon amaretto | 500 g kangaroo fillets, cut crossways in 1cm pieces | 50 g smoked sausage, thinly sliced | 300 g small red potatoes, cut into 2cm cubes | 50 g leeks, cut into 6cm lengths | 100 g red bliss puff pastry, defrosted
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°c. To make a smooth surface, brush the base surfaces and sides of the muffin tin with maple syrup. Dividing evenly across the bottom and up to the top, arrange the kangaroo fillets on top. Top with sausages, potatoes and leeks. Use a pastry brush to dables lightly over the pastry to lift the vegetables, and to ensure the kangaroo is evenly coated with some of the maple syrup. Bake in the centre of the oven for 45 minutes. Remove from oven and leave in the oven for 15 minutes longer, until the top is crusty and the fish flakes easily with a fork. Serve straight from the baking tin with plenty of sauce.

title: Beet Sandwich
ingredients: 1 small beet | 8 ounces ciabatta | 4 tablespoons dark rum | 3 -5 teaspoons hot red pepper sauce ( or to taste ) | 8 -12 tiny new potatoes ( or small desire ) | sliced hazelnuts | 1 lb fresh spaghetti noodles ( or toasted or toasted or your choice, can use more to serve )
instructions: If using the new potatoes, boil them until fork tender. If using fresh potatoes, boil them until fork tender. Once they are cooked, remove the potato skins but retain for later. Slice ciabatta lengthwise into two pieces, but not all the way through. You will have to slice them back inches. Slice the ciabatta lenghtwise into two 3 lengths, cutting through each piece into a single sandwich, then making a sandwich cut. The length of the sandwich should be no more than 2 inches thick, and the shorter the cutout, the better your sandwiches will taste. Set aside. Mix all the rum ingredients together in a small bowl or jar and add the nut slices, making sure they don't overpower the flavor of the beets. Heat frying pan on medium heat, add 1/2 cup of water, the sandwiches, sprinkle top of bread with remaining spice mixture and fry for 1 - 2 minutes, turn over, fry for another 1 - 2 minutes and check for doneness. Serve sandwich with garlic bread or fresh pasta if using, and enjoy. Serves 1 to 2. Yummy hot sauce or chutney can be added to the rum for a kick.

Random Ingredients: heavy whipping cream,matzo meal,onion flake,green chili pepper,fryer chicken,cherry,cream tartar,spaghetti sauce
title: Easy Passover Chicken
ingredients: 1 fryer chickens | 1 1/2 tablespoons onion flakes | 2 tablespoons dried onion flakes | 3 tablespoons sour cream, divided | 1 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1 jar spaghetti sauce | 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream | 1/4 cup diced green chili peppers | 8 -10 fresh cherries ( to decorate )
instructions: Separate the chicken and rub salt, pepper and dried onion flakes over the chicken, patting lightly in the salt, pepper, and onion flakes. Wrap each piece chicken in plastic wrap, set aside. Mix 1 1/2 tbsp of the sour cream, cream of tartar and a pinch of salt, blend well in a bowl for about 2 minutes whisk in 1/2 cup of the sauce and set aside. In a frying pan, heat the remaining sauce mix, stir in the chili peppers and cherry half. Sear the chicken on both sides, remove and set aside. Pour 1/4 cup of the sauce mixture over the chicken in the frying pan, cover and simmer over low heat until the chicken is done. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: kosher salt,roast,cornmeal,italian sausage,caraway seed,dark soy sauce,scallion,salmon fillet
title: The Big Dipper for Baked Salmon
ingredients: 2 cups fine cornmeal | 1/2 cup kosher salt | 1 tablespoon caraway seed | 4 turkey roast | 4 teaspoons kosher salt | 2 scallions, chopped | 2 boneless skinless salmon fillets, bones removed | 2 teaspoons dark soy sauce | 12 -16 slices hot italian sausage
instructions: Mix the cornmeal, 1/2 cup salt and caraway. Rinse the roast and pat dry with paper towels. Cut into 12 - 15 bite size pieces. Place in a large bowl with 2 tsp salt and scallions. Sprinkle a third of the mixture on top. Turn the pieces over to coat evenly. Place on a large baking sheet. Bake at 450f for 45 minutes or until the outside turns slightly golden brown. Turn the pieces over once then bake another 5 minutes more or until browned and tender. Allow fish to rest on the baking sheet for 15 minutes before removing from the pan to a platter. Slice fish on the diagonal. Arrange on a platter, pour remaining 1/2 cup of salt over them and top with slices of italian sausage. Serve with crusty bread or your favorite pasta.
