Random Ingredients: hot pepper,kaffir lime leaf,red onion,apple juice,gingerroot,nigella seed
title: Apple Onion Juice Jalfrezi
ingredients: 3 large red onions | 1/4 cup nigella seeds | 10 pieces fresh gingerroot | 3 hot peppers | 14 ounces apple juice | 1 tablespoon kaffir lime leaf
instructions: Bruise half the fresh ginger root, peel and slice the other half thinly. Combine the sliced ginger, hot pepper and the apple juice to make the marinade. Trim and core the remaining onions. Trim and finely slice.

title: Mexican Beetroot Dip
ingredients: 1 large beet, cooked | 1/2 cup shredded mexican blend cheese | 1/3 cup nonfat milk | 1/2 cup dried oregano | 1/3 cup mixed spice, store bought is okay | 1/4 teaspoon dried oregano | spicy syrup or your favourite syrup, to dip
instructions: Slice whole beetroot into 2 - 4 inch chunks. Place in blender with cheese, milk, oregano, mixed spice and dried oregano. Blend on high until well mixed. Pour into serving dish and drizzle with spicy syrup, if you wish.

title: Sticky Capsicum Snack
ingredients: 1 medium red capsicum, halved and thinly sliced | 125 g graham cracker crumbs | 1/2 cup splenda granular ( sugar substitute )
instructions: Preheat oven to 180c. Line a 20cm x 30cm swiss roll tin with baking paper. Combine red capsicum, crumbs, and splenda in a medium bowl. Press mixture evenly into prepared tin base, leaving 2cm border. Bake in oven for 30mins or until golden brown. Let stand for 5 mins then transfer to a wire rack to cool.

title: Tassari-Style Beef
ingredients: 4 anchovies | 1 pound beef flank steak | 1 cup coconut, flamed
instructions: Preheat an outdoor grill for hot, medium, and medium high heat. Grill the anchovies and beef 5 to 7 minutes per side, or to desired doneness. Remove the beef from the grill and drizzle with coconut.

Random Ingredients: tomato green chilies,vegetable broth,garam masala powder
title: Saag Channa (Indian Hot Bean Stew)
ingredients: 6 tablespoons vegetable broth | 3 cans diced tomatoes with green chilies, undrained | 2 teaspoons garam masala powder
instructions: Stir broth, tomatoes with green chilies, and garam masala powder together in a large pot. Heat to boiling.

Random Ingredients: hot chili powder,rutabaga,chicken,green enchilada sauce,vegetable shortening,head cabbage,prune
title: Mexican Hot Chicken Stew
ingredients: 1 -2 lb chicken or 1 -2 lb turkey, cut into bite size cubes | 1 package green enchilada sauce, divided ( i use mild ) | hot chili powder, i use paul prudhomme's hot chili powder | 2 cans red pinto beans, drained and rinsed | 1 large rutabaga, peeled and cubed | 1 large head of cabbage, thinly sliced ( optional ) | 1/3 cup vegetable shortening or 1/3 cup butter, melted
instructions: Heat 1/4 cup of veggie shortening or butter and 1 tablespoon of chili powder with a little hot water in a small stock pot.

Random Ingredients: baby carrot,savoy cabbage,gingerroot,kaffir lime leaf,green chilies,champagne
title: Green Chutney
ingredients: 2 cups baby carrots, cut into 2cm pieces | 2 cups savoy cabbage, finely shredded | 1 tablespoon grated gingerroot | 1 green chilies, finely chopped ( bird's eye chile ) | 2 tablespoons champagne | 1 fresh kaffir lime leaf, torn in half
instructions: Place the carrots in a microwave proof bowl, cover with water, and microwave on full power for 5 and 1/2 minutes until tender. Meanwhile, combine the remaining ingredients in a large bowl and fold in the vegetables. Season with salt and pepper.

Random Ingredients: chestnut mushroom,couscous,red wine,red chili powder,rhubarb,cider vinegar,soy sauce,coconut milk
title: Rhubarb & Mushroom Curry With Coconut Milk Nuts
ingredients: 600 ml coconut milk | 2 tablespoons red wine | 1 tablespoon cider vinegar | 3/4 teaspoon red chili powder | 1 teaspoon soy sauce | 200 g rhubarb | 2 tablespoons chopped chestnut mushrooms | 1 tablespoon flaked coconut flakes
instructions: Cook coconut milk, vinegar, chili and soy in a wok over medium heat, stirring, for 3 minutes or until it boils. Remove from heat. Cut rhubarb stalks into 1cm slices. Add to coconut curry and simmer, uncovered, for 5 minutes. Add chestnuts and mushrooms and cook, covered, for about 5 minutes. Stir in cooked coconut. Serve hot over steamed rice.

title: Rice With Kaffir Lime and Aromatic Risotto
ingredients: 1 cup arborio rice | 1 piece kaffir lime leaf, 4-6 inches in length
instructions: Wash the rice thoroughly in several changes of water and transfer it to a rice cooker. Close a heavy, large sieve and shake out any excess water clinging to the rice. Add about 1/2 cup of water to the sieve and, using the flat side of a broad metal spoon, press the rice through the holes in the rice with a wooden spoon, extracting as much liquid as possible. Repeat this process until you have used all the rice. You may need up to 1/2 cup of water if your machine runs on the coarse sides. Transfer the rice to the sieve, cover, and let drain for about 20 minutes. Place the lime leaves in a small, nonstick skillet over medium heat. When they begin to wilt, pour about 1/3 cup of strained liquid into the skillet and return it to medium high heat. Add about one fifth of a cup of cold water, spreading it all the way around the rice, and cover. When the water boils, immediately remove the rice mixture from the sieve. Ladle the remaining liquid into a bowl and set it over the cooked rice and set it aside. Fluff with a fork, top with a little freshly ground black pepper about 1 tablespoon at a time, then stir until the rice is well coated in creamy, grainy brown rice, and the aroma is apparent. Taste the rice for yourself, and add more freshly ground black pepper if you like, and serve at once.

title: Lebanese Vegetable Hot-Pepper
ingredients: 4 -5 tablespoons vegetable broth | lemon peel | allspice
instructions: Put all ingredients in the blender and puree until smooth.

title: Garlicky Almond Mayo
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons arrowroot ( or rice flour ) | 1/2 cup almonds, ground or roasted until fragrant | 4 cups iceberg lettuce
instructions: Mix all ingredients together with clean hands and let sit for 15 mins at room temp.. Use as a dip for vegetables, pita bread, bread or toast.

Random Ingredients: italian herb,baking potato,candy sprinkle,shrimp,balsamic vinegar,no boil lasagna noodle
title: Roasted Shrimp and Balsamic Shrimp With Lighter Lasagna
ingredients: 1 lb shrimp, cleaned deveined and peeled | 6 no-boil lasagna noodles | 1 tablespoon dried italian herb, divided ( basil, oregano or marjoram ) | 12 ounces frozen small whole-milk sweet potatoes with peel cut into 2-inch pieces | 1/2 cup low-sodium balsamic vinegar | 1 cup low fat italian-style herbs, divided | 1 jar baking sprinkles, coarsely crushed
instructions: Preheat oven to 375º°f. In a large baking dish coated with cooking spray, combine shrimp with 3/4 teaspoon mixed dried herbs. Cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes to 1 hour. Rinse shrimp inside and out under cold water, dry with paper towels and pat dry with paper towels. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil over high heat. Add noodles and cook for 3 to 5 minutes or until tender. With tongs, transfer shrimp from the shrimp shells to a paper towel lined plate and pat dry. Arrange shrimp in a single layer over bottom of baking dish or baking dish. Top with 4 uncooked lasagna noodles. Set aside. In a small bowl, combine vinegar and 1 teaspoon mixed dried herbs. Arrange 2 shrimp in the center of the noodles. Cover with a layer of sweet potatoes. Sprinkle with 1/2 cup of mixed herbs. Arrange another 2 shrimp on top of the sweet potatoes. Top with 3 more lasagna noodles, shrimp, sweet potatoes, sweet potatoes and shrimp. Top with remaining sweet and shrimp. Top with remaining 1 tablespoon of mixed dried herbs. Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour. Remove from refrigerator 30 minutes before baking. Remove top layer of herbs and sprinkle with remaining 1/2 cup of mixed dried herbs. Bake covered for 30 minutes or until shrimp are cooked through and vegetables are tender. Remove cover, sprinkle with baking powder and bake 5 to 10 minutes longer. Remove from foil and let sit for 5 minutes. Drizzle remaining 1 tablespoon of mixed dried herbs over the top.

title: Italian Sausage and Barley
ingredients: 1 lb italian sausage ( lean and casing removed ) | 1/3 cup pearl barley | 1/2 cup molasses | 3 cups raw barley, soaked in water for 40 minutes
instructions: Remove casings. Cut sausage into 1/4 inch pieces and brown in a large dutch oven over medium heat. Add pearl barley, sausages, and molasses. Pour in enough water to cover. Reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes. Remove cover and continue cooking, covered, until barley is tender, approximately 1 1/2 hours. Remove pot from heat and serve. Note, this may be easily made in a crockpot. You may need to cook at least 30 minutes per pound of sausage and barley.

title: Mexican Style Gravo (Aka Gravadito)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon adobo sauce | 1 teaspoon pure dried juniper berries | 2 tablespoons heinz tomato ketchup
instructions: Combine ingredients if using the tomato ketchup and mix well.

Random Ingredients: green bell pepper,coconut,vanilla extract,chicken breast half,beef tenderloin,rice flour,beef cube
title: Coconut Beef and Pineapple Strips
ingredients: 1/2 cup coconut, shredded | 2 tablespoons rice flour | 2 green bell peppers, seeded and cut into strips | 2 large boneless beef cube steaks, sliced into strips | 2 1/2 tablespoons sesame oil or 2 1/2 tablespoons coconut oil, divided | 3 cups sliced cooked boneless beef cubes | 1 tablespoon pure vanilla extract
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400° and arrange the coconut strips on a baking sheet. Bake for 5 minutes, then stir to evenly distribute coconut on the coconut strips. Bake for 7 minutes or until crispy. Add the strips of steak. Sprinkle each strip with sesame oil and bake another 7 - 8 minutes or until browned and crisp. Combine the beef and pineapple strips in a large bowl. Serve immediately.

title: Chow Mein Noodle Salad
ingredients: 2 cups chow mein noodles | salt and pepper
instructions: Combine all ingredients in bowl. If using hot chili sauce then add to bowl. Serve chilled.

title: Irish Cream Lamb Chops
ingredients: 4 boneless lamb chops | 10 fluid ounces irish cream
instructions: Sray the lamb and fat on both sides with kitchen spray. Place a small roasting tin in the oven and add enough water to come halfway up the side of the chops. Cover and bake in a moderate oven for about an hour or until cooked and tender. Remove the chops, reserving the liquid in the roasting tin and place a lid on the pan. Return to the oven for another 30 minutes or until the lamb is completely cooked. Serve with mash and potato. Irish cream is the most coveted ingredient in the meal, but you can also use an asian style style accompaniment such as currant jam.

title: Irish Potato Bread
ingredients: 1 medium head cabbage, coarsely shredded | 1 1/2 lbs russet potatoes, peeled and chopped | 1 1/2 tablespoons finely shredded kerrygold irish gold sweet potato traditional irish carribean cajun crumbled sweet potato ( irish sweet potato-carribean cheese-toss with vegetables ) | 6 lime wedges
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. In large bowl, combine cabbage, potatoes and kerrygold irish sweet potato cheese. Toss to mix and coat. Place bread on baking sheet and bake 15 to 20 minutes, stirring often, until lightly toasted, cool slightly, and serve warm with lime wedges for an additional touch. Yields about 1/3 cup per bread.

title: Mom's Best Gravlax (Stewed Veal)
ingredients: 1 pound boneless veal, cubed | 4 cups vegetable broth | 2 cans chicken stock | 1 cup graham cracker crumbs | 1 jar chopped roasted red peppers
instructions: Place the veal in the bottom of a large slow cooker. Place the chicken stock, and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat. Pour the vegetable broth over the meat. Sprinkle the crumbs over the mixture, and stir to evenly coat. Cover and cook on high until the gravy has reached the desired thickness, 5 to 5 1/2 hours.

Random Ingredients: fruit juice,red chili pepper flake,parsley,ziti pasta
title: Ziti With Fruit and Zaffron
ingredients: 6 ounces ziti pasta ( orzo ) | 1 can fruit juice | 1 teaspoon red chili pepper flakes ( or to taste ) | 3 tablespoons parsley, minced
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add the ziti and cook until just tender but firm to the bite, stirring occasionally. Drain well and combine with the rest of the ingredients in a large bowl, toss well. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: radish,green olive,dijon mustard,green chili salsa,marsala wine,kiwi fruit,curly french fry,graham cracker crumb
title: Kiwifruit and Cheese Crumb Parfait
ingredients: 1 kiwi fruit, peeled | 1 green chili salsa ( like pace ) | 12 ounces curly french fries, thawed | 1/2 - 1 cup grape flavored radish, thinly sliced ( i used rainbow ) | 2 teaspoons dijon mustard | 1/8 cup marsala wine | 1/2 cup shaved swiss cheese ( i used the kraft brand ) | 8 -10 crumbed graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Cut the kiwifruit up, slice into 2 - 3 sections then slice into 8 - 10 wedges, or use 1 or 2 large fruit chutneys. Cut the french fries into about six 1 1/2 squares. Lay out a single layer of french fries across the bottom of your medium sized clear glass bowl. Using your fingers, place a row of the kiwifruit slices, a row of green chili salsa, a row of thinly sliced radishes, and a row of shaved cheese. Fold the french fries over and gently press to blend. Repeat to make 12 bread triangles. Garnish with shaved swiss cheese and crumbs, or leave a few extra for sprinkling over the top. Cover and refrigerate over night or longer. Cooking, preheat the oven to 425°f place foil on the top of the baking dish or cookie sheet. Use a baking tray so as not to spill oil into the oven. Place baking sheet on top of microwave and cook on high for just a few minutes until cheese is melted. Sprinkle top with shredded cheese and return to oven to broil. Bake until lightly browned. To serve, place parfait in a serving dish and spoon over the hot cheese.

Random Ingredients: jalapeno pepper,porcini mushroom,potato,pistachio nut,meyer lemon,cod fish fillet,yeast
title: Fish and Mushroom  Pot #2
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups mashed potatoes | 1 egg | 1 1/4 cups frozen yeast | 2 cups porcini mushrooms, roughly chopped ( about 1 pound ) | 2 1/2 - 3 lbs cod fish fillets, cubed ( about 2 1/2-ounce ) | 20 -25 g fresh meyer lemons ( about 10 ) | 1 - 1 1/2 1 -1 1/2-3 cup minced pistachio nut
instructions: In a large bowl, mix mashed potatoes and egg, until well blended. In a large greased bowl, stir together the yeast and mushrooms, then add the cod and lemons. Add the yeast mixture to the mixture and beat vigorously with a wooden spoon. Stir in half of the pistachios and add more if desired. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and let rise in a draft free warm place until doubled in volume. Deflate the dough, knead it briefly a few times and let rest for about 15 minutes. Shape the dough into a ball and place in an oiled mixing bowl. Cover with plastic wrap and set aside in a warm place to rise until doubled, about 1 hour. Preheat oven to 425â°f degrees. With floured hands, press the dough out flat on lightly floured baking sheets. Divide into quarters and form each piece into a 5 - 6 inch long flat circle. Spread the remaining pistachios all over the dough, then spread the meyer lemon evenly over the top evenly. Roll the circle into a sausage shape on each piece of dough and press the edges closed. Brush the top of the dough with a bit of beaten egg and sprinkle with remaining pistachios. Bake for 20 minutes. Remove from the oven and lower the oven temperature to 400â°f degrees. Continue to bake until golden brown on top, about 20 more minutes. If the fish is browning too quickly, tent loosely with foil or brown paper that has been rubbed with vegetable oil, and bake for 5 minutes. If the fish cooks too quickly, continue baking until it is firm, about 15 more minutes. Serve with a hot green salad over rice.

Random Ingredients: sage,ice cube,chinese cabbage,sun tomato oil,sage leaf,mace,red curry paste
title: Spicy Cabbage Slice
ingredients: 1 iceberg chinese cabbage ( large ) | 3 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil | 1 tablespoon red curry paste ( or a mix of thai red curry and green ) | 2 sage leaves, crushed | 1 dash ground mace | 1 dash ground sage | 1/2 teaspoon ground sage | 1 ice cube
instructions: Cut large leaves from the cabbage so it hangs on the outside but is still slightly waxy. Slice each leaf vertically into 2 triangles. Heat a non stick frying pan at medium high heat until oil is starting to smoke. Remove the cabbage from the fry pan with a slotted spoon leaving just a bit of the head on. Place into hot pan and sauté, stirring now and then, just to make the slaw a little softer. When everything is fragrant, place the cooked cabbage onto a slice of parchment paper. Top with the sun dried tomatoes and drizzle over the red curry paste, making sure to coat all of the leaves and/or sun dried tomatoes. Sprinkle over mace, sage and sage. Add ice. Serve immediately.

title: Sesame Snacks
ingredients: 1 2/3 cups vanilla ice cream, softened | 1/4 cup toasted sesame seeds | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground cinnamon
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. In a medium bowl, stir together the ice cream, sesame seeds, and cinnamon. Spoon the mixture evenly onto a baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until the filling is firm, but will melt as it cools, about 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: bay scallop,szechwan pepper,scallion,crawfish tail,spiral pasta,chuck,fine breadcrumb
title: Shanghai Spaghetti
ingredients: 12 ounces szechwan pepper ( bird's eye chilies in a can ) | 12 ounces ground chuck | 12 ounces shanghai bay scallops | 1 lb peeled crawfish tail | 1/2 cup fine dry breadcrumb | 6 ounces spiral shaped pasta, cooked | 1/4 cup fine dry breadcrumb | 1 green scallop
instructions: Cut off chiles, remove ribs and seeds from head of chilies and place them in a small saucepan. Place over medium heat. Toast chiles until golden. Remove from heat and place in an oiled bowl. When cool, remove stems and cut in half crosswise. Set aside. Toast pepper for about 15 minutes. Remove and set aside. Combine ground chuck, shrimp, scallops, crumbs, and 1/2 cup bread crumbs in a large mixing bowl. Mix well. Fill noodles with meat mixture, toss to moisten and let stand while preparing sauce. Heat remaining 1/4 cup breadcrumbs in a medium nonstick skillet, stir fry pasta just until it begins to crisp.. Drain pasta and place in serving dish. Add sauce and toss gently. Sprinkle with scallops. Garnish with fresh green scallop.

Random Ingredients: emmenthaler cheese,grain bread,celery,black pepper,tomato paste,marmalade,cardamom pod,sirloin steak
title: Swiss Steak & Bread Pies
ingredients: 2 onions, chopped | 2 stalks celery, chopped | 1/4 cup sliced pickled carrot | 4 1/2 ounces tomato paste | 1 loaf long grain bread | black pepper | 1/4 cup marmalade | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom pod | 1 - 1 1/2 lb sirloin steak, thin, cutlets, lean
instructions: Place vegetables in crockpot. In sml bowl stir together tomato paste, bread crumbs, pepper, marmalade, cardamom and spices. Stir into vegetables. Add steak and mix. Cover and cook on low setting for 8 - 10 hours or till steak is very tender. To serve, warm slices of bread and top each slice of bread with a slice of steak.

Random Ingredients: tarragon vinegar,lime juice zest,thai fish sauce,romaine lettuce
title: Easy Vietnamese Salad
ingredients: 3/4 cup tarragon vinegar or 3/4 cup white balsamic vinegar | 1 -2 tablespoon fresh lime juice and zest | 1 tablespoon thai fish sauce | 2 romaine lettuce, leaves separated
instructions: Combine the vinegar, zest and thai fish sauce in a small bowl and whisk thoroughly. Place each leaf of lettuce into a lettuce leaf and drizzle with the sauce. To serve, cut each leaf crosswise into six wedges.

title: Tomato Sesame Seed Cookies
ingredients: 1/2 cup whole wheat flour ( all-purpose not bread flour ) | 1 teaspoon sesame seeds, crushed and toasted | 1 teaspoon dried currants | 1/2 cup cherry tomatoes, cut in half ( with stems ) | 6 serrano peppers, in 1 inch pieces seeded
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Mix flour, sesame seeds and currants, making a well in the centre. Add tomatoes and peppers, mixing well. Shape the dough into 1 inch balls, about 3/4 inch thick, and place on greased cookie sheets. Bake in centre of oven, for 10 - 15 minutes, switching and rotating pan halfway through baking, until golden brown. Cool on racks.

Random Ingredients: thai red curry paste,red bell pepper,white sugar,dark soy sauce
title: Spicy Thai Red Curry Sauce
ingredients: 1 red bell pepper | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce | 1 tablespoon thai red curry paste, or more to taste | 1 teaspoon white sugar, or more to taste
instructions: Preheat your oven's broiler and set the oven rack about 6 inches from the heat source. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil, and place red bell pepper on the prepared baking sheet. Stir red peppers with the dark soy sauce, Thai red curry paste, and sugar together in a bowl and drizzle the sauce in with a thin stream. Cook peppers under the preheated broiler until the sauce has become toasted and peppers have become fragrant, about 5 minutes. Allow to rest for about 5 minutes.

title: Quick Kahlua Sauce
ingredients: 5 tablespoons salted butter ( or margarine ) | 1/3 cup low-fat buttermilk | 2 tablespoons palm sugar
instructions: Place butter or margarine in a small saucepan and over medium low heat, stir occasionally until the butter is melted and the mixture is smooth. Remove from the heat. Whisk buttermilk and palm sugar in a small bowl to develop the flavors. Slowly whisk it into the melted butter mixture. Simmer for 2 minutes. The sauce will thicken and become translucent again as it cools. This should take about 5 minutes. Turn off the heat. Let it cool completely before adding it to your favorite kahlua recipes.

title: Plum and Veggie Faux Freeze
ingredients: 2 packages chocolate ice cream, softened | 1 liter milk | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 8 plum, halved and sliced thinly | 100 g frozen peas ( optional ) | 1 small cauliflower, broken into flowerets
instructions: Place the ice cream, milk, worcestershire sauce, sliced plums and frozen peas in a blender. Blend them until they form a smooth paste, adding pepper and more milk if necessary. Spoon this through a funnel into a freezer proof dish. Freeze until solid, around 2 hours. To cut, remove from freezer and thaw overnight in the fridge, or pop into hot, slightly greased, non stick frying pan. Add a tiny knob of butter, and cook over medium heat. Put a large piece of foil on top of the pan, and bake for 10 minutes. Remove from the oven, and carefully remove the foil. Spread the frozen vegetables down the middle of the fanned freeze, and sprinkle with a little more butter, or a little salt and pepper. Return to the freezer at this stage for 30 minutes, until the frozen veggies are firm. Remove from the freezer, and spread the frozen fanned vegetables on top. Return to the oven for a further 30 minutes. Serve warm or cold.

Random Ingredients: granny smith apple,corn cob,grand marnier,shortcrust pastry,tamarind paste,white breadcrumb,breadcrumb
title: Caramelised Apple Cob Crumbs
ingredients: 1 tablespoon tamarind paste | 12 ounces granny smith apples ( granny smith or similar cut into 8 segments ) | 1 1/2 lbs fresh breadcrumbs | 1 granny smith apple ( large wedge, or similar cut into 8 wedges ) | 1 1/2 lbs stale white breadcrumbs | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh corn kernels ( not from the cob ) | 1/2 cup grated unseasoned dry breadcrumbs | 3 sheets ready-made shortcrust pastry
instructions: Place the tamarind paste in a small saucepan and add 2/3 cup of water. Cook for about 3 minutes, then stir in the apples. Allow to stand for a few minutes, then drain them. Preheat the oven to 190°c. On a plate, mix the breadcrumbs, corn, breadcrumbs and lemon peel together. Roll out the pastry between two sheets of soured kitchen paper into 24 circles. Use a 5 inch round biscuit cutter to cut 12 circles from the pastry. Place the apple pieces in the centre of each circle. Fold pastry over the apple slices, ensuring all is in the centre. Using a knife or scissors, firmly press and seal the pastry edges. Place, seam side down, on a buttered baking tray. Press down lightly with your hands. Make sure the pastry doesn't go into the centre of the tray until the oven is ready. Once the oven has risen, bake for 10 minutes, then check, and bake for a further 10 minutes before popping out the pastry and placing it on a plate to cool. Serve warm or cold.

title: Pickled Octopus
ingredients: 1 lb octopus | 1 cup frozen corn
instructions: Combine the octopus, corn, and salt in a large bowl. Let stand 2 - 3 days, shaking the bowl from time to time to ensure that all of the salt is dissolved. Refrigerate for several weeks.

Random Ingredients: italian herb seasoning,white rice,baby back pork rib,kaffir lime leaf
title: Crock Pot Portuguese Pork Ribs
ingredients: 3 1/2 lbs baby back pork ribs, frozen | 1 teaspoon dried italian herb seasoning ( or 1/2-1 tsp. of each ) | 1 packet dried kaffir lime leaves ( or 2 tablespoons of lime or lemon lime flavored liqueur ) | 2 -3 cups cooked white rice ( can also use white rice )
instructions: Mix seasonings and lime leaves in a bowl. Sprinkle mixture on ribs. Place rib in crock pot. Turn to low. Cook for 8 hours or until falling off the bone. If using dried kaffir lime leaves, pour half into a small measuring cup and fill in with your boiling water to cover.

Random Ingredients: nutmeg,virgin olive oil,egg yolk,daikon radish,stewing beef,paprika,oregano
title: Dakkavi
ingredients: 1 kg stewing beef, cubed | 200 g masarena ( daikon radish ) | 200 g vadouvan sugar or 20g sugar | 1 tablespoon paprika | 3 egg yolks | 100 g virgin olive oil | 1/2 teaspoon nutmeg
instructions: Cut daikon into cubes. Boil stew meat until soft, adding water to avoid scorching. When water is absorbed take pot off the stove and let meat cool. Add daikon cubes. In a bowl, mix yolk and sugar till sugar is dissolved. Set aside for 15 minutes and then add paprika, vinegar, nutmeg and olive oil. Stir to mix. Boil mixture for a few minutes, stirring continuously. Pour mixture into serving dish and sprinkle top with paprika and bake at 300f for around 45 mins or until mixture is dry.

Random Ingredients: cream cheese,chicken broth,baby spinach,rice noodle,fish sauce,red bell pepper,cilantro,cardamom
title: Thai Noodle and Spinach Soup
ingredients: 1 package uncooked rice noodles | 6 cups chicken broth | 1/4 cup fish sauce | 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro | 1/4 cup sour cream ( optional ) | 1/4 cup chopped red bell pepper ( optional ) | 1/8 teaspoon ground cardamom ( optional ) | 1 cup chopped fresh baby spinach
instructions: Place rice noodles in a large pot, cover with cold water, and let soak. Bring chicken broth to a boil over high heat. Stir in fish sauce, and return to a boil. Stir in cilantro, sour cream, red bell pepper, cardamom, and cooked noodles. Reduce heat to medium, cover, and simmer 4 minutes. Remove from heat, and stir in baby spinach. Ladle hot soup into bowls to serve.

title: Stuffed Parsnips

Random Ingredients: beef brisket,duck,red apple,water chestnut,parmigiano reggiano cheese,cinnamon,monterey jack cheese,apricot preserve
title: Fruity Baked Goose
ingredients: 1 goose | 12 small onions | 1 can sliced water chestnuts | 1 jar apricot preserves | 2 cans sliced duck pieces, drained | 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon | 4 ounces parmigiano-reggiano cheese, grated | 2 ounces monterey jack cheese, grated
instructions: Cut goose into 8 sections and remove bone. Rinse goose inside and out with cold water and pat dry with paper towels. Sprinkle goose with 1/2 tsp cinnamon and 1/8 tsp salt. Arrange on a rack in shallow pan. Sprinkle both sides with cheese. Pour apricot preserves over top. Heat oven to 325°f. Cook uncovered at 325 f for 1 hour. Strain goose and place in a baking dish. Bake uncovered for 1 3/4 hours or until juices run clear, basting several times during cooking. Spoon sauce around bird and remove all solids.

title: Easy English Peas With Spaghetti and Steak
ingredients: 1 cup soymilk | 2 tablespoons chili oil | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric | 2 cubed cube steaks | 1 english pea, thawed if frozen | 1 package frozen english peas, thawed if frozen | 2 slices frozen english muffins | 5 slices frozen english peas
instructions: Toast under broiler or grill, until lightly browned. Sauce, over medium heat in a saucepan, mix the soymilk, chili oil, turmeric and steaks. Bring to a boil and cook 2 minutes. Stir in 3 frozen peas. Remove from heat, stirring occasionally, and set aside. Toast frozen peas. Arrange peas evenly on a platter, with the meat on the side.

title: Pennsylvania Dutch Barley Soup
ingredients: 1 pound pearl barley | 1 pound boneless beef chuck, diced | 1 tablespoon caraway seeds | 4 teaspoons baking powder, or more to taste
instructions: Place pearl barley in a large pot, and cover with water. Bring the water to a boil, reduce heat to medium low, and simmer until tender, about an hour. When tender, drain and discard any remaining liquid. Combine beef and caraway seeds in a saucepan over medium heat, and cook and stir until the meat is completely browned, about 10 minutes. Remove from heat, and stir in the barley. Stirring occasionally, simmer until soup has reduced, about 15 minutes.

title: Herbed BBQ Marinade (Bbq)
ingredients: 1/4 cup horseradish | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 6 -8 leaves fresh sage, with stems
instructions: Stir together the rd. Of the boullion and the sage. Place in a saucepan over low heat, stirring with your hands to break up lumps in the broth. Cook for 15 minutes stirring often. Stir in remaining ingredients. Cook, stirring, until thickened, about 5 - 10 minutes, stirring frequently. Enough for four lbs. Remove meat from saucepan, place in refrigerator for up to two weeks.

title: Hot Cocido
ingredients: 1/4 lb bulk sweet italian sausage | 3/4 cup hot coffee | 1/4 cup gin or 1/4 cup whiskey | 1 1/2 teaspoons fresh ginger ale, crushed
instructions: Remove the casings from the sausage. Cut the sausage meat into chunks. Put the sausage and hot coffee in crockpot and cook on high for 4 hours. Add ginger ale just before serving. Note, it is believed that ginger ale will be added to the hot coffee, thus causing a sweeter beverage.

title: Beef, Cauliflower & Green Bean Pie
ingredients: 500 g cauliflower | 500 g green beans | 500 g beef chuck, trimmed of all fat | 500 ml buttermilk | 10 sheets phyllo pastry | 1 tablespoon molasses
instructions: Heat oven to 200°c. Put a steamer rack above the top of the stove. Break cauliflower and green beans into florets boil in lightly salted water for 10 minutes drain the cauliflower, bring to the boil. Meanwhile, put beef in a medium saucepan with enough cold water to cover. Bring to the boil, reduce heat and simmer for 30 - 40 minutes or until just tender. Drain well. Preheat oven to 190°c. Mash cauliflower and green beans, mix with beef. Set aside. Roll out 5 sheets of phyllo pastry to fit the size of the pie plate. Spoon meat mixture into bottom of pastry and top with remaining sheets. Brush with molasses. Top with remaining 7 sheets of phyllo pastry. Cut steam holes in the pastry with the tip of your finger if required. Bake in the preheated oven for about 30 - 40 minutes.

title: Broccoli Salmon (Or Chicken) With Lettuce and Smoked Salmon
ingredients: 1 head broccoli, cut into wedges | 2 salmon | 1 tablespoon canola oil | 1 tablespoon mirin ( sweet japanese cooking wine ) | 1 tablespoon golden syrup | lemon pepper
instructions: Put broccoli into boiling water. Cook until tender crisp. Put cut up salmon, cut up into bite sized pieces, into large casserole dish. Heat up canola oil on med. Heat in microwave. Stir fry broccoli for 2 - 3 mins, remove veggies, place in a bowl. To make glaze, put honey, golden syrup and lemon pepper in a pan and stir until sugar dissolves. Pour this over broccoli. Garnish with chopped parsley or cilantro if desired.

title: Yogurt With Tomato Gravy
ingredients: 1 tablespoon white flour | 1 tablespoon greek yogurt | 2 tablespoons tomato paste | 1 tablespoon rose water | 4 slices bread, crusts trimmed
instructions: Combine flour, yoghurt, tomato paste and rose water in a shallow plate. Dip the bread slices in the mixture, coating both sides. Heat a non stick pan over medium high heat. Add the bread. Cook slices for 2 mins each side, or until golden. Serve with tomato gravy.

title: Pine Nuts and Zucchini Sprouts
ingredients: 100 g fresh bean sprouts, trimmed and cut into 3cm lengths or 1 1/2 inches lengths | 200 g zucchini, washed, ends trimmed and sliced diagonally | 40 g pine nuts, dry-roasted | 2 tablespoons mirin ( japanese sweet wine )
instructions: Boil the 2 litre of water in a large frying pan or wok with the pine nuts. Turn down the heat and simmer the zucchini for 5 minutes or until they are soft and tender. Drain and rinse well with cold water. Set aside. Toast the bean sprouts on a dry frying pan or wok until golden in colour. Pour boiling water into the saucepan. Cover and simmer for 3 - 4 minutes or until the liquid has reduced. Ladle the vegetables into a serving bowl. Drizzle with the sauce and sprinkle with the pine nuts. Serve straight away.

title: Rice Flour Snow Peas With Snow Peas
ingredients: 200 g snow peas, cut in half | 1 tablespoon rice flour
instructions: Clean snow peas under running water. Place on a baking tray with cold oven gas about 200º celsius. Bake for 10 minutes then sprinkle rice flour on and mix well. Microwave snow peas for 2 minutes on high. Stir, remove strings and mix well. Pour over rice flour stir and serve.

Random Ingredients: black eyed pea,walnut,salad oil,parmesan cheese,cannellini bean,bicarbonate soda
title: Roasted Bean and Walnut Patties (Gluten-Free)
ingredients: 5 ounces dried cannellini beans | 14 ounces black-eyed peas, drained and rinsed | 3 ounces chopped walnuts | 2 teaspoons bicarbonate of soda | 2 tablespoons salad oil | 2 tablespoons grated parmesan cheese
instructions: Place beans and walnuts in a microwave safe dish and cover with water. Cover and microwave on high for 4 - 6 minutes, until the nuts and walnuts are roasted. Drain the nuts and walnuts in a sieve and return to the microwave for 20 - 30 seconds or until beginning to give off a nutty smell. Allow to cool slightly then put the nuts and nuts through a food processor with the baking soda, oil, bicarb and parmesan cheese. Season with salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste. Mix well and check for seasoning if required. Shape into patties and brush with oil. Grill on a griddle pan for about 8 - 15 minutes turning once until cooked through.

title: Easy Peanut Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup butter ( i use margarine ) or 1/2 cup margarine ( i use margarine ) | 1 cup pasta sauce ( i use classico florentine cream sauce ) | cayenne ( optional )
instructions: Melt butter in skillet with a bit of salt over a medium heat. Stirring constantly, add sauce and stir. Cook until sauce thickens slightly. Add peppers and/or rice. I prefer spicy so I add cayenne for more spice. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: basil,orange juice,red chili,watercress leaf,soya sauce,italian breadcrumb,marmalade
title: Italian Breadfruit Patties With Basil and Mozzarella
ingredients: 2 packets of orange basil dried tomato paste or 2 packets marmalade ( 1 package ) | 4 italian breadcrumbs | 2 cups basil | 2 tablespoons soya sauce | 1/4 cup watercress leaf | 1/2 teaspoon crushed dried red chili | 1 tablespoon grated fresh orange juice
instructions: Place the dried tompsones or basil in a large bowl. Sprinkle with the italian bread crumbs, basil, soya sauce, red chili and orange juice. Mix well and shape into 24 balls. Coat well with olive oil, then with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 1 hour or longer. Remove from the fridge at least 20 minutes before cooking in your grill. Cook over high heat until the tomatoes have blackened. Serve with lots of sauce in and lots of crusty italian bread.

Random Ingredients: french bread italian,colby monterey jack cheese
title: Cheese Sticks
ingredients: 1/2 lb colby-monterey jack cheese | 1 loaf french bread or 1 loaf italian bread
instructions: Slice cheese into strips approximately 1 x 1/2. Cut french loaf crosswise through to within 1/2 of the top of bread without slicing through to within 1/2 of the bottom. Stick cheese strips into bread, going around the inside edges. Seal with toothpicks. Place on a baking sheet and place in the freezer over easy, if making ahead use only 2 day old fries.

title: Potatoes With Garlic
ingredients: 4 medium red potatoes | 1/2 cup fresh grape leaves
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium heat. Add potatoes, and cook until tender, about 25 minutes, turning once. Slice potatoes into wedges and arrange on a warm platter. Wrap the grapes in a piece of cheesecloth, secure with a toothpick, and place around the edge of the platter. Pour a small amount from the skillet, or add a handful to a soup bowl and add a little water to the pan. Continue cooking until the potato wedges are cooked. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: double cream,island dressing,chinese five spice powder,red potato,butter cracker
title: Potato Crunch
ingredients: 10 small red potatoes, each potato halved and thinly sliced | chinese five spice powder | 4 tablespoons butter flavored crackers, to serve | 1 fluid ounce double cream | 1 fluid ounce thousand island dressing
instructions: Place the potatoes in a large pan, with about 3/4 of water. Bring to the boil, then turn down to a simmer and cook for 15 to 20 minutes, until tender. Drain, and mix with a little chinese five spice powder. Melt the butter and cream together. Spread to cover the potato base and sides with the crackers. Dot with a little butter and drizzle with the dressing. Refrigerate for 30 minutes before serving.

title: Tisima's Spiced Beans
ingredients: 1 can cannellini beans | 2 tablespoons herbs, any kind ( dried or presoaked ) | 2 tablespoons maple syrup | 2 -3 tablespoons smoked mustard | 2 -3 teaspoons canned chipotle chiles, minced | 1 teaspoon ground asafoetida powder ( aka msg ) | 16 ounces vermicelli
instructions: Drain the beans and rinse if necessary. Place in a food processor or magic bullet, and blend. Add the rest of the ingredients. Blend until creamy and smooth. Place in a bowl, cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate until ready to use. It should keep for at least a week if stored in the fridge. It is best to let it sit out a few hours before use if you may find it harsh. Bring back to room temperature before serving, and bring to room temperature before eating. It keeps for up to 4 days.

Random Ingredients: white wine vinegar,coriander powder,linguine,taco seasoning mix,russet potato
title: Linguine Potato Salad
ingredients: 1 russet potato, peeled | 1 cup dry white wine vinegar | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 1/2 teaspoon coriander powder | 1 package linguine, cooked
instructions: Cube potato.

title: Chocolate Mushrooms
ingredients: 2 ounces unsweetened baking chocolate | 12 large mushroom stems, stems removed, caps quartered | 1 can fresh blueberries
instructions: Melt chocolate in a large, heavy saucepan over low heat, stirring until smooth. Add a handful of the mushroom stems, and toss to coat and soften slightly. Repeat with remaining stems. Add mushrooms, blueberries, and 1 tablespoon of the melted chocolate to each serving glass.

Random Ingredients: chicken tender,irish whiskey,tart cherry,lemon juice zest
title: Irish Lemon Chicken
ingredients: 4 chicken tenders | 1 lemon, juice and zest of | 1 ounce irish whiskey | 2 tart cherries, preferably fresh
instructions: Pound the chicken tenders until they're flat, but not too thin. Put in a large nonreactive baking dish and sprinkle with the lemon zest and the whiskey. Bake, turning once, for about 30 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through, but is not too dry. Remove the chicken to a serving platter. Tear off the cherries and spoon them into a bowl, or scatter them around over the chicken.

Random Ingredients: yellow pepper,lime,rice vinegar,tomato puree,arborio rice,white flour,cantaloupe,cream corn
title: Aussie Tomato Rice Salad
ingredients: 1 yellow sweet pepper, chopped | 1 can cream-style corn | 1 can white flour, divided | cooked rice, to serve | 1 packet arborio rice | 4 tablespoons sour cream or 4 tablespoons greek yogurt | 3 tablespoons tomato puree | 2 limes, cut into wedges, to serve
instructions: Heat 1 tbs oil in a frying pan over a medium heat. Cook the sweet pepper for 3 - 4 minutes, or until softened, stirring. Transfer to a bowl, then stir in 2 tbs of the flour. Add the corn and gradually stir in the remaining flour and stir until well combined. Stir in the rice and cook for 2 minutes, or until heated through. Divide the rice mixture among 4 plates, top with the corn mixture and drizzle with the yoghurt or yogurt, garnish with lime wedges.

Random Ingredients: cauliflower floret,sharp cheddar cheese,green bean,potato,chicken bouillon cube
title: Irish Potato & Cheese Cauliflower Pot
ingredients: 1/2 cup sliced green beans | 1/4 cup sliced cauliflower floret | 1 cup instant mashed potatoes | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 1/4 cup irish cheddar cheese, grated
instructions: In a large frying pan, saute frozen green and black beans, cauliflower and potatoes in 2 tbs. Olive oil until vegetables are just beginning to soften. Dissolve bouillon cube in boiling water, add to vegetables and bring to boil. Serve.

title: Ammonia Baked Red Potato-Amchur Mashed Potatoes
ingredients: 8 large russet potatoes, scrubbed | 2 tablespoons amchur powder | 1 drop red food coloring ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Boil the potatoes in salted water until tender and transfer them to a bowl. Add the amchur and food coloring and mash well. Transfer the potato mixture to a greased 2 1/2 qt cake pan. Bake in a preheated oven until golden brown, about 45 minutes.

Random Ingredients: nonfat cream,peanut butter,fryer chicken,vidalia onion,maraschino cherry
title: Chicken Satay
ingredients: 2 large fryer chickens, cut into 1 1/2 inch pieces | 1 jar maraschino cherries | 1 vidalia onion, sliced | 1/3 cup peanut butter | 1/2 cup nonfat sour cream
instructions: Preheat grill for high heat. Sprinkle chicken with salt and freshly ground black pepper. Place chicken on preheated grilling rack and bake at high heat for 5 minutes, until chicken is no longer pink and juices run clear. Remove from grill and set aside. Place cherries in a small bowl and cover with water. Let stand 1 minute.

title: Iraqi Cauliflower
ingredients: 1 cauliflower, cut into florets | 1 green bell pepper, cut into strips | 1/2 teaspoon moroccan seasoning | 1 teaspoon rock salt
instructions: Steam the cauliflower until desired tenderness.

title: Duck Sauce
ingredients: 1 bunch english mixed soft bread | 1 large spanish onion | 150 g whole blanched almonds | 1 tablespoon chilies, chopped | 1 tablespoon cold water | 100 ml soymilk | 150 g plain flour, sifted | 1/2 teaspoon fresh ground mace
instructions: For the mace.

title: Quick and Easy Baked Beans
ingredients: 1 can baked beans | 3/4 cup apricot preserves
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. In a medium baking dish, stir together the baked beans, apricot preserves and cheese sauce. Bake in the preheated oven 45 minutes, until bubbly.

title: Kurdish Style Tikka Sauce (Dukka)
ingredients: 1/2 cup ketchup | 2 tablespoons yoghurt
instructions: Mix well and refrigerate for at least two hours or until needed.

title: Truffles
ingredients: 200 g ground almonds | 200 -300 g ladyfingers | 1 dried chili pepper flakes | 1/2 teaspoon dried sage
instructions: Drain any excess water from meat and place in serving bowl. Whip up your truffles and dip them in the spices. Dry the truffles on paper towel and decorate with slices of the dried chili. Eat with toothpicks.

title: Spicy Noodles
ingredients: 1 package uncooked penne pasta | 3 cups hot sauce, or to taste | 1/2 teaspoon ground turmeric
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook penne in boiling water until slightly underdone, about 11 minutes.

Random Ingredients: cabbage,pancetta,topping,ricotta cheese,velveeta cheese,soy sauce,russet potato,green bell pepper
title: French Potato & Bacon Casserole
ingredients: 24 ounces velveeta cheese, cubed | 12 ounces ricotta cheese | 12 ounces bacon, cooked & crumbled, drained | 1 1/2 lbs lean ground round | 4 large russet potatoes, peeled & sliced 1/4-inch thick | 1 large sweet green bell pepper, chopped | 2 teaspoons soy sauce | 1/2 head cabbage, shredded
instructions: Preheat oven to combine the velveeta, ricotta & bacon in a large bowl. Stir in the ground meat. Combine the bell pepper and celery. Toss with potatoes.

Random Ingredients: pumpkin,barbeque sauce,water,parsley sprig,ginger beer,sesame oil,poblano chile,thyme
title: BBQ Pumpkin Soup With Sesame Molasses and Chiles
ingredients: 8 cups water | 1 1/2 cups pumpkin, peeled, seeded, cut into 1-inch cubes ( about 1 pound ) | 1 1/2 poblano chiles ( fresh or canned ) | 2 cups dry sherry wine or 2 cups beer | 2 tablespoons sesame oil, dark | 2 tablespoons barbecue sauce ( your choice ) or 2 tablespoons barbecue sauce ( your choice ) | 1 tablespoon fresh thyme, chopped | 1 tablespoon fresh parsley sprig, chopped
instructions: To make the broth,. Place the water in a large saucepan, add the pumpkin cubes and bring to a boil. Cover and reduce heat to medium. Simmer for 45 minutes. Place the poblanos in a small dry skillet, add 1/4 cup of the water, bring the water to a boil and lower the heat. Simmer for 10 minutes or until the flesh is very soft enough to easily shred with your fingers. Transfer the poblanos and water to a food processor and purée using some of the cooking liquid to make a smooth paste. Discard any remaining solids. Transfer the puree to a large glass or stainless steel pot. Add the sherry or beer and warm over medium low heat, stirring often. Add the oil, bbq sauce, thyme, chicken stock and pumpkin mixture. Bring to a boil then cover and simmer over low heat for 35 minutes or until the pumpkin is very tender. Taste to check for salt. Add more water if necessary. Stir in the parsley.

title: White Truffles
ingredients: 5 white truffles packed in oil, softened | 1/4 cup walnut halves
instructions: Place the walnuts in a mixing bowl, and mix in the truffles. Cover, and refrigerate for 2 hours, or until soft. Shape the truffles into balls about 1 1/2 inches in diameter. Place 1 1/2 tablespoons of truffle mixture on a plate, and roll onto the nuts to coat. Cool completely before storing in an airtight container.

title: Baked Chicken Lasagna
ingredients: 2 skinless, boneless chicken breast meat - cut into strips | 1 1/2 cups watermelon, cored and chopped | 9 uncooked lasagna noodles
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add chicken, and cook until no longer pink, 10 to 15 minutes. Drain, and set aside. Reduce heat to low, and add 1 1/2 cups watermelon, and 1/2 the pasta. Simmer until pasta is al dente, about 10 minutes. Transfer chicken mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish. Sprinkle with remaining 1 cup watermelon, and top with remaining tortillas. Bake in preheated oven until bubbly, about 20 minutes.

title: Pear Soup
ingredients: 6 cups pears, cored, peeled & diced | 2 cans campbell's tomato soup | 1 1/2 cups raspberry, fresh, frozen, chopped
instructions: In a large saucepan, combine pears and soup. Bring to boiling.

title: Simple Noodle Beef Kebabs
ingredients: 1 egg | oriental-flavor instant ramen noodle or ( 7 ounce ) packet oriental-flavor ramen noodles | 3 tablespoons oriental-flavor instant ramen noodles
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, beat the egg. Dip each noodle in the egg on both sides and then in the ramen noodle mixture, coating both sides. Thread onto skewers. Cook on nonstick grill or broiling pan over medium high heat about 2 minutes per side until they are golden brown and crisp.

title: Lentils
ingredients: 2 cans lentils ( green & red recommended ) | 2 teaspoons cinnamon
instructions: Wash lentils thoroughly, soak in warm water for 20 minutes. Drain. Remove 1/3 to 1/2 cup water from lentils, add enough water to cover by 1/2 and bring to boil. Lower heat and simmer gently for 15 – 20 minutes, or until lentils are al dente, stirring occasionally.. While the lentils are cooking, make the cinnamon stick by placing the cinnamon sticks in a dry frying pan over medium heat. When the cinnamon sticks turn golden, add a little cooking spray or 1 tablespoons cooking oil, and continue to fry the cinnamon, stirring until golden. Drain the lentils thoroughly of all excess water. Heat the 2 teaspoons of oil in a large skillet, and add the lentils.

Random Ingredients: garlic clove,green bell pepper,mozzarella cheese,parsley leaf,veal,grape leaf
title: Quick and Easy Vegetarian Lasagna
ingredients: 1 lb ground veal | 1/4 lb ground chicken or 1/4 lb ground turkey | 1 small green bell pepper, diced ( or more if you like ) | 1 large garlic clove, minced | 1/4 cup shredded mozzarella cheese or 1/4 cup provolone cheese | 1 jar grape leaves ( or whatever container they are purchased in ) | 1/4 cup fresh parsley leaves
instructions: Pre heat oven to 375°f. In a large skillet, brown meat until cooked through add bell pepper and garlic.

Random Ingredients: bulk italian sausage,pork shoulder,lobster tail,tarragon leaf,jalapeno chile,puff pastry
title: Grilled Lobster Tassie
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs bulk italian sausage or 1 1/4 lbs hot italian sausage | 2 pork shoulder, fat removed, coarsely chopped | 4 jalapeno chiles, slit lengthwise, seeded | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh tarragon leaf | 1 package frozen puff pastry, thawed | 2 sheets puff pastry, thawed
instructions: Cook italian sausage over medium heat, stirring occasionally, for about 10 minutes or until no longer pink. Break the sausage into small bits when cool. When the sausage is cool, break into small pieces. Heat the oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit. Coat a large baking sheet with cooking spray or grease with a few pats of olive oil. Add the meat to the pan and brown over medium heat, stirring occasionally, for about 10 to 12 minutes, or until an instant read thermometer inserted into the thickest part of one side of the pork rind reads 165 degrees fahrenheit. Remove sausage from skillet with a slotted spoon and put into a warm bowl, reserving any drippings in the skillet. Add jalapenos and tarragon to the pan and cook, stirring frequently, for 5 to 7 minutes or until fragrant and fragrant. Cool slightly. Stir sausage mixture into skillet. Cut each sheet of pastry into four pieces. Working with 1 piece of dough on the work surface, arrange the cut side of a pastry circle over the bottom of the dish. Spoon 2 teaspoons sausage mixture into the center of the pastry, leaving 1 1/2 inch border along the edge of the circle. Fold it over the sausage mixture and press slightly to seal. Sprinkle the top of the pastry with the remaining 3 tablespoons sausage mixture. Bake in the oven for 18 minutes. Remove from oven and let rest 8 minutes before serving.

title: Spinach and Chives Stuffed French Toast
ingredients: 1 lb baguette, about 1/2 inch thick | 6 large egg whites, room temperature | 1/4 cup rice wine vinegar | 8 cups baby spinach, finely chopped | 6 tablespoons shallots, minced | 1/4 cup fresh chives, minced
instructions: Cut 6 slices from baguette, to use for garnish. Place baguette on a baking sheet, and lightly brush on both sides with egg whites, and set aside. Mix remaining ingredients together in a bowl. Divide spinach among 6 slices of baguette, leaving one third in the middle. Divide spinach mixture evenly among spinach. Place 1 to 3 tablespoons of egg whites on top of spinach, and top with another 4 slices of baguette, and gently push on the filling with the back of a spoon. With your hands, push in any air pockets that form, and then press the bread edges together to seal in the filling. Slice each sandwich diagonally, in half, and serve at once. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: sun tomato oil,beef oxtail,banana,superfine sugar,walnut oil,egg,turnip
title: Pancake from Chef Fabio
ingredients: 2 lbs beef oxtails | 1 ounce superfine sugar | 2 tablespoons walnut oil | 4 eggs | 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil | 1 large turnip, peeled and finely chopped | 1/4 cup banana, sliced into fours
instructions: Pulverize the oxtails by first cutting them into 3 inch pieces and putting them in the cuisinart. Make the oxtail, in a frying pan, fry the beef in a tablespoon of salt and superfine sugar for 2 minutes. Cover and set aside. Make the batter, beat the eggs and oil together in a bowl. Add the sundried tomatoes, turnip, and banana and beat until mixed. Make a hole in the oxtail flesh and drop into the batter. Cover with cling wrap and leave for 5 minutes. Break the lid while the oxtail cooks and serve in the dish.

Random Ingredients: pasta sauce,pistachio,strawberry,chili pepper flake,chicken,butternut squash,lime wedge,bean
title: Soupy Pistachio Chicken
ingredients: 1 whole chickens, quartered | 1 tablespoon chili pepper flakes ( optional ) | 4 cups pasta sauce | 1 large butternut squash, peeled and cubed | 1 bag frozen strawberries | 1 container pistachios, shelled | 4 lime wedges | 1 can baked beans ( with or without fruit )
instructions: Rinse out the chicken cavity and set it aside. Use two forks to remove any excess fat around the chicken bones. Set it aside. Pour your favorite sauce into a large soup pot. Add the remaining sauce ingredients from the bag, except the pistachios, and bring to a simmer over medium heat. Let the flavors meld in the pot for about 10 minutes. Add the pistachios when the mixture begins to simmer, then add the squash and chicken breasts, and return to a simmer. Turn down to simmer and cook until the chicken is done, about 20 minutes. Turn on oven to broil and toast pistachios. Serve chicken and sauce in a large shallow pie dish, garnished with chopped pistachios and additional pistachios for garnish.

title: Chicken, Peppers & Calzone (Calzones)
ingredients: 2 1/2 - 3 lbs whole chickens | 1 whole squid, washed, cleaned and cut into pieces ( tubes or small ones ) | 1 1/2 cups freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | pepperoni, sliced, or to taste, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Rinse the chicken under running water and pat dry with paper towels. Cut the body part from the chicken, right through the body and legs, and discard any excess fat from the chicken. Rinse the chicken under running water and pat dry. Rub the inside of one of the chicken's legs with salt and pepper on both sides of the legs. Lay the whole chicken on a flat surface, and lay the tentacles on it. Starting at the narrow end, roll up, tucking them under to shape. If you can't find rolled legs, you can use 2 large toothpicks or thin strips of chicken breast. Lay the rolled chicken, seam side down, in a deep baking pan. Tuck toothpicks through the chicken. Sprinkle the outside of the chicken with grated cheese, then pour about 1 1/2 cups water into the pan, so that it comes 1/2 inch up the side of the chicken. Cover tightly and refrigerate overnight. Preheat the oven to 475 degrees f. Uncover the chicken and cook for about 45 minutes, or until the chicken is tender. Remove from the oven and tent loosely with foil. To serve, put a piece of chicken on each plate and top with a spoonful of sauce.

Random Ingredients: red chili powder,swiss cheese,sauvignon blanc wine,cooking brown rice,caraway seed,green chilies
title: Cajun Rice on the Skillet
ingredients: 2 cups cooked quick-cooking brown rice ( may use a mexican-style brown rice ) | 2 cans chopped green chilies | 1 tablespoon red chili powder | 2 teaspoons caraway seeds, crushed | 1/2 lb thick slice swiss cheese, such as vacherin or 1/2 lb oaxaca cheese, cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 1/4 cup sauvignon blanco wine ( can use other dry brandy )
instructions: Prepare the quickcooking brown rice according to package directions. Set aside to cool. Cut chilies into quarters. Place chilies and crushed caraway seeds in a large skillet. Cook over low heat, stirring often, for 3 minutes, or until fragrant. Add rice, cheese, and sauerkraut.

title: Chipotle Sauce
ingredients: 1 fresh chipotle chile | 4 tablespoons freshly ground oregano leaves
instructions: Place chile on a cutting board and flatten slightly with a mallet. Place chile in a food processor with the oregano. Puree until smooth. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Cover and store in the refrigerator until ready to use.

title: Jicama Salad
ingredients: 4 lbs of peeled jicama, cut into large chunks | kirschwasser | 1/4 cup vinegar | 1/2 - 1 quart dry port wine | 1/4 - 1/2-1 quart turbinado sugar | 1 lb linguine ( or spaghetti, cooked as directed on package ) | 1 lb grated pecorino romano cheese
instructions: Place the jicama in a large roasting pan, pour boiling water over them, cover tightly, and bake for 1 1/2 hours, checking occasionally. Remove lid and stir in kirschwasser, vinegar and sugar until sugar is dissolved and sauce is creamy. Heat to boiling and simmer 30 to 45 minutes, uncovered, stirring occasionally, until slightly reduced. Add pasta and simmer 6 to 8 minutes, or until tender. Stir in cheese just before serving.

title: Hot and Sour Cabbage Revelation
ingredients: 1 pastry for a 9 inch double-crust pie, thawed | 1 cup chopped red cabbage | 2 tablespoons hot peppers, chopped | 2 teaspoons msg ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Roll out your pastry and put it on greased oven tray. Mix cabbage, hot pepper, and msg in a bowl. Sprinkle over the pastry the entire top. Pierce pie through bottom crust and sprinkle top with cheese. Bake for 20 minutes, or till golden brown and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: asparagus spear,extra virgin olive oil,vanilla essence,kosher salt
title: Quick Fruit Salad
ingredients: 6 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 6 tablespoons fresh minced asparagus spears or 6 tablespoons thawed frozen asparagus spears | kosher salt | 4 teaspoons vanilla essence
instructions: In a bowl whisk together 1 tbls of the oil and the 2 tbls of minced asparagus. Mix in the garlic 1 tbls. At a time. Add the remaining oil and whisk again.. After all, you have added the remaining ingredients and mix. Serve at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: sea salt,liquid smoke,garlic paste,taco seasoning mix
title: Fajita Seasoning
ingredients: 3 tablespoons salt | 3 tablespoons taco seasoning mix ( lawrys ) | 4 1/2 teaspoons garlic paste | 1/2 teaspoon liquid smoke
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a small bowl until well combined and evenly distributed. Use as desired.

title: Indian Plum Jam and Tomato Soup
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups chicken broth | 1 1/2 cups plum jam | 1 cup mango chutney | 2 tablespoons dried parsley | 1 pint cherry tomatoes, cut in half
instructions: Heat chicken broth in a small saucepan over medium heat. Stir plum jam and mango chutney together in a saucepan.

title: Algerian Frijoles (Fried Beans)
ingredients: 7 tablespoons saffron strands | 300 800 g pinto beans or 300 800 g pinto beans, drained | 2 tablespoons lemon rind, finely shredded or 2 tablespoons grated lime peel ( optional )
instructions: Make a deep slit on the bottom of each bean. Add a 1 tablespoon saffron, 1 tablespoon of lemon rind and 1 tablespoon of cold water. Bring to the boil, then simmer for 25 minutes. The frijoles should be a little crispy and a little mushy. Turn out onto a lightly oiled plate and sprinkle with remaining rind and juice. Serve hot.

title: Chow Chien - Cold Smoked Peanuts
ingredients: 4 cups peanut oil | 2/3 cup mirin ( japanese sweet wine ) | cooking spray
instructions: Heat oil in a deep fryer to 375 degrees f. Wet hands to remove excess oil. Using a plastic cup, dip the hands into hot oil and then into sesame oil and fry until the color darkens, about 5 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, transfer to paper towels to drain. Cooks' note, chien can be eaten straight away or cold. Store in airtight glass bowl in refrigerator.

title: Easy Sausage Rollups(Yummo, Loosemeat)
ingredients: 2 lbs italian sweet sausage | 1 tablespoon sesame seeds, toasted | 15 sheets phyllo dough | fresh mixed vegetables ( optional ) | prepared stuffing ( optional ) ( optional )
instructions: Slice sweet sausage crosswise into 1/8 pieces. Remove casing from sausage.

Random Ingredients: red chili pepper flake,lettuce leaf,oregano,couscous,baby carrot,achiote seed
title: Caribbean Couscous Salad
ingredients: 2 cups couscous | 7 large baby carrots | 1/2 of achiote seed | 2 teaspoons achiote seeds | 1 teaspoon oregano | 1 red chili pepper flakes ( or to taste )
instructions: Rinse the couscous in a strainer until well moistened. In a glass or porcelain bowl, place half the carrots, all of the chili flakes and 1 tsp/oregano. Drain the couscous and add enough water to cover. Let stand 20 minutes or longer. Transfer to a large dish and set aside. Repeat in step 2 to make another 2 cups. The rice should just be sitting in the water. Set aside to cool. Meanwhile, in a dry frying pan, dry roast the achiote seeds until they begin to turn brown on the outside. Stir constantly so it doesn't burn. As soon as the seeds begin to pop, add the remaining 2 tsp/oregano. When rice is dry to a dark brown color, break into 2 cup portions. Add to the carrots and mix well. This is where i recommend a lower heat but not a burn. Let cool down before serving. Garnish with remaining carrots.

title: Creamy Fontina Cheese Souffle
ingredients: 1 cup fontina or 1 cup gruyere cheese | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 3 eggs | 3 tablespoons plain yogurt
instructions: In a bowl, mix together cheese and soup. In a measuring cup, make a well in the cheese mixture and add eggs. With hand held, mix eggs and yogurt together until smooth. Pour mixture into a 9 x 13 inch glass baking dish. Cover bottom of dish with a damp cloth or foil. Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Bake for 80 minutes, or until top is golden brown.

Random Ingredients: chili pepper flake,potato,chicken thigh,nutmeg,banana,wasabi paste,red onion
title: Wasabi Chicken
ingredients: 1 lb skinless chicken thigh | 1 lb potato | 1 medium red onion, cut in 1-inch wedges | 1/4 lb chopped peeled banana | 6 tablespoons wasabi paste | 1 teaspoon smoked chili pepper flakes | 1/4 teaspoon grated nutmeg
instructions: Boil chicken thighs until almost cooked through and tender. Cut chicken into 1/2 inch bite size pieces. In a large pan or wok, cook carrots 1 minute. Stir in sliced onion then cook 1 minute longer. Add potatoes, browning and stirring for 3 minutes. Add the chicken, chilli flakes, wasabi paste, and smoked chili and heat. Add hot wasabi paste mixture and bring to boil. Cover and cook for 15 minutes.

title: Mexican Parsnips
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups parsnips, peeled and coarsely chopped | 1 3/4 cups buttermilk or 1 3/4 cups yogurt
instructions: Mix the parsnips and buttermilk in a saucepan over medium heat. Cover and cook until the parsnips are tender but not mushy and the liquid has cooked down a bit, about 5 minutes. The parsnips should still be slightly crisp.

Random Ingredients: mustard seed,turmeric powder,savoy cabbage,ketjap manis,chicken broth,blackberry,carrot
title: Ginjal Ka Mushi
ingredients: 1/2 savoy cabbage | 2 ounces carrots or 1/2 ounces cornichon | 2 tablespoons ketjap manis | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds | 1 teaspoon korean mustard powder | 2 tablespoons chicken broth | 1 cup blackberries ( optional )
instructions: Cut the cabbage into squares, and place the squares on a steamer on a sheet of foil. Wrap the top of the foil completely around the contents and steam them over high heat for 2 to 3 minutes. Remove from the steamer, and carefully peel away the foil and place the cabbage squares on a paper towel to drain excess liquid. Combine the sauce ingredients in a small bowl, and serve at once. Ginjal kamikarikayen. Boil all the ingredients for 5 - 7 minutes, stirring all the time.

title: Lamb Kabobs (Low Fat and Low Sugar)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs lamb ( ground or cubed ) | 5 okra | 2 cans chunk pineapple chunks, drained ( reserve 1/2 cup juice ) | 1/2 cup margarine | 3 cups soymilk | 1/2 cup black pepper | 1 small cardamom pod
instructions: Chop raisins and reserve juice. Toss lamb with okra. Pour half of margarine, and reserve juice. Brown lamb with remaining margarine in a non stick skillet. Drain if desired. Add juice and reserved juice from pineapple, and soy milk. Heat and stir until mixed. Add black pepper, cardamom, pepper, and okra. Simmer for about 15 minutes, stirring occasionally. Serve over rice. Note, if you cannot find okra, make several small slits in the meat with a sharp knife, cutting along the grain, and using a skewer, cut the meat into slices.

title: Coconut Surprise
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 teaspoons italian salad dressing | 2 tablespoons coconut oil or 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1 inch piece fresh vanilla pod
instructions: Mix together. Pour over ice cubes and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: ziti pasta,bicarbonate soda,black mustard seed,worcestershire sauce,lettuce,cumin,mozzarella cheese
title: Ziti With Zesty Zesty Mozzarella and Mustard and Spices
ingredients: 4 ounces ziti pasta ( fresh for baking ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons black mustard seeds ( yellow ) | 1/2 teaspoon cumin or 1/2 teaspoon fennel seed ( cumin seeds ) | 150 g mozzarella cheese | healthy lettuce | worcestershire sauce | 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | freshly made cheese, for topping
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 c or 400 degrees fahrenheit. Bring a large quantity of salted water to the boil in a large frying pan. Boil the ziti for 8 to 10 mins in the boiling water then drain. Meanwhile, heat a frying pan on the stove and using a sharp knife, make diagonal cuts across the ziti to make diagonal slices about 3cms or about 5cm in diameter. Tip the drained pasta into the hot frying pan and toss with the black mustard, cumin and fennel seeds. Spread half of the ziti mixture over half the mozzarella in a shallow greased ovenproof dish. Spread with half the mozzarella. Spread with the rest of the ziti in a similar way. Put the frying pan on the stove and bring the liquid up to boiling. Turn the heat down to 100c or 400f and stir in the worcestershire and the sauces. Cook for 5 to 7 mins or until the top is golden brown. Leave to cool slightly and serve topped with freshly made tasty cheese. Tip, ziti can be cooked up to this point 1 day ahead. Cover and refrigerate. Just before cooking, cover and return to the oven for a further 15 - 20 mins to firm or reheat.

title: Grilled Pork Loin
ingredients: 1 boneless pork loin | 1/4 cup breadcrumbs | 1/4 cup finely chopped green pepper | 1/4 cup finely chopped onion | 1/2 cup broth | 1/3 cup horseradish
instructions: Slice loin crosswise into 1 in slices. Mix together bread crumbs, green pepper, onion, broth & horseradish well, spoon over loin. Place the loin on oiled rack of broiler pan. Cover and broil about 10 minutes a side, until browned. Serve with dipping sauce.

title: Glamorgana (Greek Hard Sauce)
ingredients: 1 large egg white | 2 tablespoons dry red wine | 1 tablespoon grated lemon peel
instructions: Beat the egg white until soft peaks form. Slowly add the red wine and beat until completely incorporated. Stir in the grated lemon peel. Serve over the greens of your choice.

Random Ingredients: brown rice,onion soup mix,cumin powder,tomato paste,hazelnut butter,chicken part,wonton wrapper
title: Spanish Chicken With Rice
ingredients: 1 bag of sliced hazelnut butter | 2 lbs chicken parts, skinned | 1/2 cup chopped onion soup mix | 1 jar tomato paste | 1 box wonton wrappers | 1 tablespoon cumin powder | 2 cups brown rice, cooked
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Melt butter in large skillet. Add chicken and brown well on all sides. Add onion soup mix and tomato paste. Simmer about 15 - 25 minutes. Remove chicken and set aside on plate. Place one wrapper on work surface. Place rice in the center of wrapper. Place a heaping tablespoon of chicken along the rice. Scoop some of the egg mixture over the chicken. Dip the bottom of the wrapper in boiling water and transfer it over the chicken and rice. Scoop some of the cooked egg onto the rice mixture. Dip the corner of the wrapper in cumin powder. Place the wrapper on top of the chicken and rice. Scoop some of the egg mixture atop the chicken and rice. Roll the wrapper up carefully. Place on baking sheet. Repeat until all wrappers are gone. Bake on 350 for 10 - 15 minutes.

title: Roasted Salmon and Honey-Honey Glaze
ingredients: 4 salmon fillets | 1/4 cup honey, warmed
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Place salmon fillet on a nonstick baking sheet and coat with the honey. Roast 25 minutes or until fish flakes easily with a fork. Remove from oven and allow to cool slightly. Meanwhile, heat a serving platter in preheated oven. Drizzle 2 tbsp olive oil over the salmon and return to the oven for approximately 5 minutes or until the fish flakes easily with a fork.

title: Scallops with Squash, Zucchini, Mascarpone Filling, and Dill
ingredients: 1/2 cup mascarpone cheese | 1/4 cup chopped onion | 2 tablespoons finely chopped fresh dill | 1 tablespoon shortening | 1 cup chopped yellow squash | 12 scallops | 1 medium zucchini, halved lengthwise and sliced
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. In a small bowl combine the mascarpone and chopped onion.

Random Ingredients: peach preserve,japanese eggplant,black olive,dill,yellow onion,white button mushroom,wheat pita bread,dill sprig
title: Mushroom Pita Chips With Pickled Eggplant
ingredients: 1 medium japanese eggplant, sliced into 1/2 inch rounds | 1/4 cup canned sliced black olives | 3 yellow onions, sliced into 1/2 inch rounds | 1/4 cup peach preserves | 1/4 cup dill sprig | 8 fresh dill sprigs | 12 white button mushrooms, sliced lengthwise in half | 8 whole wheat pita bread | dill sprig ( optional )
instructions: Place whole eggplant slices in a colander for 1 minute. Drain eggplant. Pat dry. Dice one of the sliced onions. Layer sliced eggplant in one layer on a small serving platter.

title: Quick and Easy Crock-Pot Beef Steak
ingredients: 1 lb beef sirloin | nonstick cooking spray
instructions: Trim excess fat from sirloin. Cut beef into bite size pieces. Wear nonstick cooking spray in one bowl or other on low heat. Lightly spray both sides of steak with nonstick cooking oil. Place onion in the bottom of the crockpot. Spread the meat over the onions. Cover. Cook on low heat 6 to 8 hours or high heat 2 to 3 hours. Remove from crockpot, slice and serve with rice.

Random Ingredients: spicy enchilada sauce,garam masala,double cream,red bell pepper,black cardamom pod,whipping cream,vegetable
title: Spicy Chile Nuts
ingredients: 2 cups whipping cream | 2 tablespoons double cream | 2 tablespoons spicy enchilada sauce | 1 teaspoon garam masala | 1 black cardamom pod | 2 small red bell peppers ( chopped ) | 2 tablespoons vegetables ( chopped )
instructions: Heat cream, enchilada sauce, garam masala and cardamom to boiling over medium flame. Immediately add peppers, cook 5 - 6 minutes or until tender. Remove cardamom and discard. Spread cream mixture evenly in 9 inch glass oven safe glass baking dish. Cool slightly. Stir cream mixture into remaining cream.

Random Ingredients: white pepper,purpose white flour,poblano chile,cajun seasoning
title: Fiery Poblano Chile Chips
ingredients: 3 poblano chiles | 2 teaspoons white pepper | 1 1/2 teaspoons all-purpose white flour | 1 1/2 teaspoons cajun seasoning
instructions: Wearing rubber gloves, peel each chile and slice on the bias into about 1/4 thick strips. Place chili strips on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and sprinkle with white pepper. Cover with plastic wrap or paper towels and set aside for 1 hour. Preheat the oven to 325 degrees f. Mix flour and cajun seasoning together until well incorporated. Brush both sides of poblano chiles with seasoned flour and arrange on baking sheet. Bake until charred and the inside is browned, 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Antipasto Biscotti
ingredients: 12 slices prosciutto ( about 2 ounces each ) | 1 1/4 cups mixed salad oil | 1/4 cup diced leeks | 2 tablespoons snipped fresh chives | 2 tablespoons canned maraschino cherries, drained and chopped | 1/2 teaspoon baking powder | 1/2 teaspoon grated lemon zest | 2 cups leftover marinade | 12 maraschino cherries
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f place prosciutto in a large skillet and cook over medium heat, turning occasionally, until evenly browned, about 8 minutes. Remove from heat and slice into 1/2 inch thick slices, set aside. In a large mixing bowl, combine oil, leeks, chives, cherries, baking powder and lemon zest. Add prosciutto and marinade and stir to blend. Fold in reserved prosciutto and stir to combine. Spoon the mixture evenly into ungreased 8x8 pan. Bake in the preheated oven for about 25 minutes. Serve warm, hot or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: quinoa,dill weed,pork,california chile pod,carrot,ladyfinger,caraway seed,vidalia onion
title: Chile Con Queso
ingredients: 1/2 cup quinoa | 4 pounds lean ground chuck | 4 ounces ground pork | 1/2 cup diced vidalia onions | 1 can california chile pods | 3 1/2 ounces diced carrots | 2 1/2 tablespoons caraway seed | 2 1/2 teaspoons dried dill weed | 1 package ladyfingers, split
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees f. Grease an 8x4 inch baking dish. Place the quinoa in a medium saucepan over medium heat and bring to a boil. Cover with a lid and place in the preheated oven. Cook the quinoa in the preheated oven until the quinoa is tender and the liquid has been absorbed, stirring occasionally, 20 to 25 minutes. Meanwhile, combine ground chuck, ground pork, onions, california chiles, carrots, caraway seed, and dill weed in a large bowl. Spoon the meat mixture into a 2x8 inch baking dish, and sprinkle with the quinoa. Cover with aluminum foil, and bake in the oven for 1 hour. Remove aluminum foil, increase the temperature to 375 degrees f, and continue to bake for 15 minutes, or until filling is hot and bubbly.

title: Fish with Cucumber and Gherkins (Evin's Recipe)
ingredients: 1/2 lb firm white fish fillet, cut into 2 x 1/4-inch rectangles | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 3 medium english cucumbers, peeled but peeled
instructions: In small bowl stir baking soda into 1/2 cup cold water. Rinse fish and pat dry with paper towels. Sprinkle fish with baking soda mixture. Dip into water, then gently press into cucumber halves. Arrange in nonstick broiler pan. Broil 5 inches from heat, turning once, 10 - 15 minutes or until fish flakes easily when tested with a fork.

title: Broiled Cod II
ingredients: 1 package cod, cleaned and frozen for later use | 1 1/2 cups buttermilk | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder | 1/4 teaspoon white pepper | 4 cups cooked white rice
instructions: Preheat an outdoor grill for high heat, and lightly oil grate. Tear cod into large chunks. Mix buttermilk, garlic powder, and white pepper together in a bowl. Coat cod chunks with buttermilk mixture, and grill in the preheated grill until easily flaked with a fork, 3 to 5 minutes per side.

title: Pasta with Mashed Apple and Golden Onion
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds rigatoni pasta | 1 quart half-and-half cream | 1 golden delicious apple, chopped
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook rigatoni in the boiling water, stirring occasionally, until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 11 minutes.

title: Irish Pot Roast
ingredients: 3 tablespoons olive oil | 8 white potatoes, cut into quarters | 1 rutabaga, peeled and cut into 3/4-inch slices | 2 lbs beef brisket ( fat trimmed and tied ) | 1/4 cup irish whiskey | 1/4 cup chopped of fresh mint | 1/2 cup chopped walnuts
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f. Toss the potatoes with 2 tablespoons of the oil in a bowl. Place the rutabaga slices on a sheet of foil and set aside. Rub remaining 2 tablespoons oil onto the beef. Using a slotted spoon, transfer the potato strips to a roasting pan. Fold the potatoes around the rutabaga and place the pan on the center rack of the oven. Bake, uncovered, for 1 hour or until tender. Meanwhile, place the remaining 2 tablespoons oil in a heavy large dutch oven over medium heat. Add the remaining 2 tablespoons oil and the irish whiskey. Bring to a simmer and boil, scraping up any bits clinging to the bottom, for 2 minutes. Reduce heat to low. Add the mint and walnuts. Cook and stir until melted, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Remove rutabaga strips from the pan. Season with salt and pepper, to taster. Arrange on a serving platter.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon cube,mirin,italian flat leaf parsley,baking powder,pistachio,rose petal
title: Japanese Style Nuts (Tomeko Chanpuru)
ingredients: 1/2 - 3/4 teaspoon dried rose petals | 3/4 cup chopped mixed nuts ( about ) | 1 tablespoon chopped pistachios | 1 tablespoon mirin ( japanese sweet wine ) | 2 teaspoons instant chicken bouillon cubes | 1 1/2 teaspoons baking powder | 1 - 1 1/2 tablespoon chopped italian flat leaf parsley
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Spread on a cookie sheet and bake for about 10 - 15 minutes or until light brown and crisp. Serve immediately. Store in an airtight container at room temperature for up 2 - 3 days..

Random Ingredients: green pepper,lemon juice zest,beef steak,corn tortilla chip,manchego cheese,mint,brussels sprout
title: Beef and Brussels Sprouts Salad
ingredients: 1/2 lb lean boneless beef round steak, thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice, divided | 1/2 teaspoon grated lemon zest, divided | 1/8 teaspoon dry mint, divided | 2 cups brussels sprouts, thinly sliced | 1/2 cup thinly sliced green sweet pepper | 1/2 cup grated manchego cheese or 1/2 cup asiago cheese | tortilla chips ( optional )
instructions: Sprinkle beef with 1/4 teaspoon lemon juice, 1/8 teaspoon lemon zest and 1/8 teaspoon dry mint. Divide brussels sprouts, green pepper and remaining 1/8 teaspoon lemon zest among 4 plates. Top with beef mixture.

title: Chocolate Chilled Penne
ingredients: 1 package uncooked dried penne | 1 package sliced sweet chocolate
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook penne for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

title: Lebanese Pork Gyros
ingredients: 1 boneless pork shoulder - washed, patted dry | 16 ounces greek yogurt | 1 loaf french bread
instructions: Trim fat from pork with some silver skin leaving about a 1 inch border and a narrow strip of fat on one side. Remove from refrigerator and rinse thoroughly. Refrigerate for 1 hour. Cut 2 inch pieces and set aside. Squeeze excess moisture from pork using your hands. Place pork on the counter and pat down to flatten. Take the pork and flatten so that you have diamond shapes on each side. Using your fingers, press a piece of bread to make a flat surface for the crust. Cover with the meat and roll the meat up like a jelly roll. Repeat with bread, filling, and meat on the second side until all the meat is used up. Wrap the rolls in foil and refrigerate for at least 6 hours or overnight. Place in refrigerator to chill thoroughly. Preheat grilling pan on medium heat.
