When hot, place a piece of bread on the grilling pan and use a wet pastry brush to lightly brush each side with oil. Grill until bread is bubbly, about 2 to 4 min per side. Serve with lemon wedges.

title: Pepperoni and Spinach Pie
ingredients: 1/2 cup self-rising cornmeal | 1/2 cup double cream | 1 tablespoon sherry | freshly grated lemon zest | 1/4 cup finely chopped dried peperoni | 1/2 cup chopped cooked spinach ( about 2 bunches ) | 1 lemon, cut into wedges to serve
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°f. Put the cornmeal in a bowl, add the cream and mix until smooth. Add the sherry, lemon zest, peperoni and spinach and stir until they are evenly coated. Transfer the mixture into a 8 inch baking dish and place it in the oven for 15 - 20 minutes until the pie begins to bubble and looks golden around the edges. Remove the pie from the oven and add the lemon wedges. Serve warm with crackers. Variation, use 1 1/2 cups chopped cooked spinach instead of peperoni and 1 1/2 tsp dried oregano, and sprinkle with the chopped pepperoni.

title: Cucumber and Black Bean Salad
ingredients: 3 tablespoons tamari soy sauce | 1 cucumber, peeled and thinly sliced | 12 ounces black beans | 1/2 cup shredded gruyere cheese
instructions: In a glass bowl, combine the tamari and cucumber. Mix in the black beans and sprinkle over with the cheese. Cover and refrigerate until serving.

Random Ingredients: coconut cream,purpose flour,plum tomato,rye bread,onion,arugula,pork butt
title: Irish Coconut Pork Tostada
ingredients: 1 cup coconut cream or 1 cup cream, for dipping | 2 lbs boneless pork butt, trimmed | 1/4 cup all-purpose flour | 2 tablespoons dehydrated minced onion | 7 plum tomatoes, sliced into strips | 12 ounces arugula | 8 slices rye bread, toasted
instructions: Heat 1 cup of coconut cream or cream over low heat in a saucepan. Add the pork tenderloin and stir to coat. Cover and cook for 3 minutes or until pork is no longer pink. Remove pork from pan and set aside. Add 1/4 cup of the coconut cream or cream and the flour, then stir to combine. Turn heat up to medium high and cook for 3 to 4 minutes, stirring occasionally. Remove from heat and stir in minced dried onion. Slice pork into bite size slices and stir into the pan. Heat until the pork is heated through. Slice tomatoes into thin strips and stir into the pan. Season with salt. Cover and simmer for 10 minutes. Turn off heat and let stand while preparing the toasts. Toast rye bread in oven until golden brown, about 10 minutes. Spread toasted bread with remaining coconut cream. Spoon pork mixture onto toasted bread. Top with tomato strips and arugula.

Random Ingredients: scallion,fontina cheese,plain nonfat yogurt,grape tomato,sirloin,taco seasoning
title: Tex-Mex Steak
ingredients: 1/2 lb boneless sirloin, trimmed of fat | 1/2 cup plain nonfat yogurt | 1/4 cup shredded low-fat fontina cheese | 1 scallion, sliced thin | 1/2 teaspoon taco seasoning | 12 grape tomatoes, halved
instructions: Slice the sirloin into thin strips. Combine the yogurt, pepper jack cheese, scallion, and taco seasoning.

Random Ingredients: golden syrup,quinoa,linguine,spaghetti noodle,italian plum tomato,garlic paste
title: Linguine with a Spicy Tomato, Zesty and Zesty Sauce
ingredients: 4 tablespoons red-wine spicy golden syrup | 1 tablespoon garlic paste, chopped | 2 cups zesty linguine | 1/2 cup dry quinoa | 3 cups italian plum tomatoes, coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup cooked spaghetti noodles
instructions: In a saucepan, slowly heat the spicy golden syrup and garlic paste. Cook for 1 minutes over medium heat. Add the linguine and quinoa. Mix well and cook for 3 minutes, uncovered. Stir in the tomatoes and cook covered 4 minutes, stirring every so often. Serve warm.

title: Gramma's Homemade Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 1 tablespoon canola oil | 1 lb ground meat ( for breakfast, beef, turkey ) | 1 lb tofu, preferably extra firm, cubed small | 2 lbs russet potatoes, peeled, cut lengthwise into 8 wedges
instructions: In medium saucepan, heat oil over medium high heat. Add ground meat and break into small chunks. Cook, stirring often, for 3 minutes. Add potatoes and cook 6 minutes or until tender. With fork, press mixture to remove excess moisture. Add tofu, cover and cook 5 minutes or until potatoes are tender. Stir in remaining ingredients. Place in lettuce wraps. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: vodka,fish sauce,saffron strand,blue cheese,spaghetti squash,fruit,cranberry juice,green olive
title: Nettie Cronish's Spaghetti Squash and Fruity Olive Spread
ingredients: 16 ounces spaghetti squash | 1/4 cup saffron strand | 4 ounces blue cheese, crumbled | 3 tablespoons vodka | 1 tablespoon fish sauce | 1 1/4 cups cranberry juice | 1 teaspoon fruit, pulp | 3 -4 green olives, chopped
instructions: Put spaghetti squash on to boil, and place on a steamer, over hot water, steaming until tender. Test for doneness at 45 minute. While the squash is steaming, combine cheese chunks, wine, vodka, and fruit pulp in a saucepan over medium heat, until cheese has melted. Remove from the heat. When squash is tender, remove it from steamer, and slice into 1 to bite sized chunks, set aside. When the spaghetti squash has finished steaming, place in the serving bowl with cheese chunks, pour cheese mixture over top, and garnish with green olives.

Random Ingredients: butter,pearl barley,poblano chile,shell pasta,red wine,mustard,head broccoli
title: Pasta Mexicana
ingredients: 1 head broccoli, cut into florets | 1/4 cup butter | 4 poblano chiles, roasted, peeled, seeded, and diced | 1 1/2 cups dry red wine | 2 poblano chiles, roasted, peeled, seeded and diced | 1/2 cup pearl barley | 1 1/2 teaspoons dry mustard | 1 pound shells pasta
instructions: In a large stockpot, saute broccoli in butter until tender. Sprinkle with garlic powder, and add poblanos. Stir to combine. Add wine, bring to a boil, cover and cook over medium heat for 20 minutes. Add barley and poblano mixture, and cook over medium for 25 minutes. Cook pasta according to package directions. Serve with crumbled red pepper sauce.

title: The Easiest Quesadillas
ingredients: 1 flour tortilla ( i like to use the 4-6-inch range ) | 1 teaspoon chili oil ( or equivalent ) | 5 slices sandwich bread
instructions: Preheat a dry medium skillet or griddle set to medium high. If using the chili oil, add a drop of oil into the pan. Ifusing, sprinkle chili oil over both sides of the tortilla. Place the tortilla on the hot skillet. As soon as the underside of each side has browned, flip it over and brown the other side. When finished, place the tortilla on a large piece of waxed paper and slice into quarters. Serve as is or on a bun with your favourite toppings. Variation, replace chili oil with a small amount of honey to thin the honey mustard or as desired with a little extra chili oil and some garlic. Other variations may be made as follows. Add hot chili oil into chili oil before adding the honey mustard. Add bread slices to the skillet and turn them over to make sure both sides are turning golden. Turn the slices over while flipping them and brown other side. Served warm with salsa, guacamole, salsa or sour cream. Note, may be served with salsa as a dip for tortillas or serve with refried beans as a side dish.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon granule,raspberry,sourdough bread,confectioner ' sugar,english cucumber
title: Confectioners' Creamy Raspberry Cucumber Soup
ingredients: 2 slices sourdough bread | sourdough bread | 1 english cucumber | 1 teaspoon dried raspberries, or to taste | 2 cubes chicken bouillon granules | 1 tablespoon confectioners'sugar, or to taste
instructions: Fill a microwave safe bowl with hot water.

title: Red Bell Pepper Stew
ingredients: 4 red bell peppers, halved and seeded | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 1 tablespoon tomato ketchup | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh thyme | 2 cups unbleached bread flour, plus extra bread flour ( for kneading )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 degrees celsius. Wash, core, and halve the bell peppers, then cut each half into chunks, discarding the seeds. Combine the cornstarch and tomato ketchup in a bowl, then stir in the thyme. Stir in the bell peppers and then add 2 cups of the bread flour and mix thoroughly. Transfer to a bowl, then knead gently so the dough comes together. Form the dough into a disc, dust with flour and then turn out onto a baking tray. Pat the top of the dough out with your hands to about a 5cm thickness. Cut into wedges using a plain round or round cutter. Bake for 15 - 20 minutes, turning the peppers halfway through cooking to ensure they are cooked through. The flour will thicken up as the red peppers cool. Serve the stew hot as is or drizzle over a little extra bread, or serve with ketchup.

Random Ingredients: yogurt,risotto rice,tequila,mexican tomato,plain yogurt,self rising flour
title: Yogurt Rice Bread
ingredients: 4 cups self-rising flour | 1 cup plain yogurt | 1/2 cup tequila | 1 tablespoon mexican-style tomato, diced | 4 cups risotto rice, cooked, cooled | 1/2 cup low-fat plain yogurt
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c and line a 9 x 5 loaf tin with a baking paper, ensuring an overhanging edge of the tin. Sift the flour into a bowl, add the yoghurt and tequila and stir until the mixture is smooth. Add the diced tomato, rice and mix lightly. Spoon into the baking tin and sprinkle with the flour. Bake in oven for 40 - 45 minutes or until cooked, and lightly browned. Allow it to cool in the tin for 10 minutes. To unmold, run a knife round the edge to create a well. Release and cool on a cooling rack.

Random Ingredients: red leaf lettuce,tequila,bell pepper,zucchini,white wine vinegar,triple sec
title: Margarita
ingredients: 1 large bell pepper, sliced thin | 1 medium zucchini, sliced thin | 1/4 small red leaf lettuce, torn into small pieces | 1/4 cup dry white wine vinegar | 1/4 cup tequila | 1/8 teaspoon triple sec ( optional )
instructions: Place all ingredients in a glass salad or on a platter or decorative salad bowl. Add salt and pepper to taste.

title: Saucy Microwave Burritos
ingredients: 3 large beans, mashed | 1 pinch ground mace
instructions: Combine the beans and mace in the microwaverowave safe bowl. Cook in the microwave, using 600w, on high power for 2 minutes, stirring twice.

title: Avocado Kale Salad
ingredients: 500 g fresh kale ( about 25 mature bunches ) or 500 g swiss chard leaves ( about 25 mature bunches ) | 1 large ripe avocado | 1/2 cup rice, such as jasmine if you can find it | 1/4 cup cornflour | 1/4 cup gluten free plain silken tofu | 1/4 cup double cream ( or milk ) | 1/4 cup bottled marinade | iceberg lettuce, to garnish
instructions: Cook rice, drain if necessary. Drain tofu and press it through a sieve or sieve into a bowl. Blend cornflour and rice together in a food processor until creamy, then stir into the tofu. Whisk the dairy free silken tofu with a little bit of milk until smooth and pour into the tofu and rice mixture. Garnish with iceberg lettuce and serve.

Random Ingredients: tomato green chile pepper,leek,blue cheese,red cabbage
title: Smoky Garlic Chilies
ingredients: 4 leeks, rinsed and chopped | 8 ounces blue cheese | 4 ounces chopped red cabbage | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chile peppers, drained
instructions: Place green beans and leeks in a microwave safe bowl, and microwave on high for 4 - 5 minutes or until the leeks are tender, stirring to prevent leeks from burning. Mash blue cheese with a fork, then add diced tomatoes and chilies.

title: Homemade Japanese Flavor Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 4 cups ketjap manis | 4 carrots
instructions: Wash and peel carrots and cut into julienne lengths. Place the strips in a blender for approximately 30 seconds. Start adding kecap manis and blend until smooth.

Random Ingredients: broccoli,anise seed,chinese five spice powder,guacamole,cotija cheese
title: Chinese Five Spice Broccoli Salad
ingredients: 1 lb broccoli, trimmed, cut in halves | 2 tablespoons cotija cheese, crumbled ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon anise seed | 3/4 teaspoon chinese five spice powder | 2 tablespoons guacamole
instructions: Cook broths in boiling salted water 10 to 12 minutes, or until crisp tender.

title: Koshary
ingredients: 4 cups marinated arborio rice noodles | 1 cup rice flour | 1 bunch french style coleslaw mix | 2 teaspoons harissa ( or to taste ) | 2 teaspoons lemon juice | 2 teaspoons cornflour ( cornstarch ) | 1 teaspoon dry breadcrumbs | 1/2 teaspoon dried marjoram
instructions: Place in 2 bowls the arborio rice noodles, rice flour, coleslaw mix, harissa and lemon juice. Mix the cornflour with the breadcrumbs in a bowl. Sprinkle bread crumbs on noodles and mix well. Sprinkle the bread crumbs on the noodles and toss to mix. Serve with your favourite vegetables or pass around for a more substantial meal.

title: Italian Sausage Stuffing
ingredients: 2 lbs italian sausage, casings removed ( or 1/2 lb. ground sausage ) | 4 eggs | 1 1/2 cups quick-cooking oats
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Combine first 6 ingredients.

title: Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 4 -6 lettuce leaves | 4 button mushrooms ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons basmati rice | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon grated nutmeg | 8 slices bread
instructions: Wash, steam or steam the lettuce leaves. Mash the rice with a tablespoon of water or knead gently. If you wish to serve the wraps individually, make a small hole in the middle of the wrap with a spoon dipped in cold water, and fill with the rice mixture. Top with grated nutmeg. Serve as little or as much as you want.

title: Greek Style Stew Meat
ingredients: 1 lb stew meat | 1 container plain greek yogurt | 1/4 teaspoon oregano flakes
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit. Place stew meat in a large roasting pan. Add 1/4 cup of water, and 1/8 teaspoon of oregano flakes. Toss meat to coat. Cover pan with foil, and bake in the oven for 1 hour.

title: Simple Fresh Fettuccine With Cream
ingredients: 10 ounces fresh mixed vegetables, such as dandelion or baby lima beans, washed well and dried | 7 ounces heavy cream
instructions: Cook fettuccine in salted boiling water for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

title: Lamb & Cashew Raita
ingredients: 12 serrano chilies | 1/2 cup cashews, roasted ( unsalted ) | 1/2 lb lean ground lamb | vegetable oil or sunflower oil, for shallow frying ( 375 to 380 degrees ) | 1/3 cup whole cashew pieces
instructions: Cut the stems off the sergium and break it into pieces. Put the leaves on a cutting board and chop them roughly. Set aside. Place a nonstick frying pan on high heat, add oil and heat until a cube of brown in colour appears. Drain the rasind from one serrano chilies and roughly chop them. Combine 2 sergium, cashews, lamb, and chiles in a food processor and process. Add cashews and process till well mixed. In a large saucepan, heat just enough oil to submerge the meat. Form the mixture into small balls. Fry in hot oil till golden, then remove each from the oil, drain and transfer to a plate covered with foil. Sprinkle with freshly ground black pepper, to taste. Serve immediately. Notes & tips. • you can substitute any other type of meat for the lamb or beef as desired. • you can substitute any type of onion for the pork or chicken for the lamb if you prefer. • you can also use 1/2 cup cashews for 3 rasins soaked in warm water for 1 hour 30 minutes. You may also substitute 1 teaspoon of turmeric for 1/2 teaspoon of coriander in the cardamom powder recipe, if desired.

title: Mock Lasagna
ingredients: 1 can sliced water chestnuts | 4 ounces uncooked lasagna noodles
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Spread a layer of cooked lasagna noodles onto a large pot of lightly salted boiling water. Repeat with another layer of noodles, and cover with a third of the water chestnuts. Repeat layers once, then cover pot with a lid or two of aluminum foil. Bake for 45 minutes in the preheated oven. Remove the foil, or the last 30 minutes of baking remove the noodles from the oven and top with cheese. Return to oven and bake 30 minutes or until noodles are tender and the tops turn golden brown.

title: Cashew Nut  Ham Salad
ingredients: 500 g ham, thinly sliced | 5 -6 tablespoons dark raisins, soaked in warm water and drained | 200 g cashews, roughly chopped | 4 -6 tablespoons bacon drippings | 400 g snow peas, trimmed
instructions: Mix dressing ingredients together except the bacon drippings, cashews and peas in a large salad bowl. Add cooked ham and toss gently to coat. Serve with some warmed cashews and sprout bits from the peanuts on top.

title: Pumpkin Loaf
ingredients: 1 cup pumpkin puree | 1/4 cup gluten-free baking powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Put a large pan of water on the stove to boil. When the water comes to boil put it on to boil, add the pumpkin paste and mix it. When it starts to soften, put the pan back onto the stove and stir. When it comes to a boil, remove the pan from the heat. Mix the pumpkin with the baking powder. Put the pan into a large loaf tin, or two loaf pans and put the loaf on a baking tray. Spray with a little olive oil spray and sprinkle some sea salt over the loaf so that it won't stick to the pan.. Bake for 55 - 60 minutes, or until a skewer comes out clean. Let cool before cutting as desired for a better texture. The pumpkin will get a little harder as it cools in the oven.

Random Ingredients: grapefruit juice,currant,poblano chile,pink grapefruit juice,ramen noodle,white onion,vegetable
title: Pomegranate Flavored  Vegetable Noodles With Grapefruit Juice.
ingredients: 1 lb sliced mixed vegetables ( such as red leaf lettuce, bell pepper, broccoli etc ) | 1/2 white onion, chopped | 2 poblano chiles, chopped ( seeds removed if desired, but remove if desired ) | 1 cup cubed cooked chicken or 1 cup cooked poultry | 1/2 cup fresh grapefruit juice | 1/3 cup currants ( or any dried fruit ) | 1 package ramen noodles ( or other flavored noodles )
instructions: Slice vegetables or rinse in colander. Mix the grapefruit juice with the currants and place in medium bowl. Add the mushrooms and onion, cover with plastic wrap, and marinate for 1 hour. Combine with veggies or chicken and serve over noodles. Garnish with orange slices or slices of lemon if desired.

title: Tuna and Bean Sprouts in Ham-And-Queso Fresco
ingredients: 500 g canned tuna, undrained | 200 g bean sprouts | 200 g queso fresco | 1 package active dry yeast | 2 teaspoons salt
instructions: In a large bowl, measure the tuna, bean sprouts, cheese and yeast powder into a large pot of boiling water. Let the mixture sit for 10 to 15 minutes or until the mixture reaches a boil. Place in a warm area and let cool to warm to 37 f to 38 f, or until it forms a creamy mass. Pour into a 9 x 9 inch loaf pan, cover tightly with plastic wrap and put in a draft free spot to rise until doubled in size about 40 minutes. Bake in a preheated 200 f oven for 15 to 25 minutes, or until golden brown on top.

Random Ingredients: vegetable carrot,caper,cream cheese,avocado,saffron strand,golden delicious apple,pimiento,white sugar
title: Aunt Fran's Foolproof Applesauce
ingredients: 12 ounces cream cheese | 12 tablespoons white sugar | 1 1/4 pounds mixed frozen vegetables, such as carrots, pea pods, and baby corn cobs | 3 golden delicious apples - peeled, cored, and diced | 1/4 cup drained capers | 1 jar fried pimientos, drained and chopped | 15 saffron strands | 12 large, piquillo-stuffed avocados, halved | 14 saffron threads | 2 tablespoons dry white sugar | 24 saffron strands, or more
instructions: To make the applesauce, place the cream cheese and 1 1/4 cups sugar into a food processor.

Random Ingredients: double cream,dark rum,barbecue sauce,pear,anaheim chile pepper,plain flour,basil,pomegranate juice
title: Spicy Pomegranate and Banana Sticks
ingredients: 4 pears, peeled, seeded and cored | 4 tablespoons light dark rum | 2 tablespoons barbecue sauce | 1 tablespoon plain flour | 1 tablespoon fresh basil, snipped | pear, sliced | 2 tablespoons pomegranate juice | 1/2 cup double cream, to taste
instructions: Place the pears inside a medium size saucepan, add just enough water to cover and bring to the boil. Boil for 30 to 45 seconds, just until the pears are just tender. Drain and cool. Place the rum, bbq sauce, flour, basil leaves, pears and pomegranate juice into a small saucepan. Cook over low heat for 1 to 2 minutes, stirring constantly, until the sauce thickens slightly. Add the cream to the saucepan and cook for a minute, stirring the cream. Transfer the sauce to an ovenproof dish, place under a a preheated grill and cook over medium heat for 3 to 5 minutes, or until toasted and starting to bubble with a caramelized glaze. Serve with toast or toasted baguette slices.

title: Fresh Tamarind Salsa
ingredients: 7 fluid ounces tamarind paste | 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro
instructions: Combine tamarind paste, cilantro and cayenne pepper mix in a small container. This keeps in the refrigerator for up to 2 weeks.

title: Penne Con Le Vino Riso
ingredients: 1 package frozen puff pastry, thawed | 2 tablespoons ginger paste | 4 ounces lemons or 4 ounces lime juice | 12 ounces superfine sugar | 12 ounces linguine pasta | 1 pinch fresh savory
instructions: Thaw out puff pastry and place in freezer. Thaw out pastry dough. Slice into 12 slices, place about 2 tablespoons of sliced pastry onto a parchment paper lined pizza pan, lay flat in freezer. After two hours, preheat oven to 425 degrees fahrenheit. Place lemons in a ziploc freezer bag and squish around the bag to get lemons as much as possible out of the bag, this will make them easier to mix later later on with the pasta. If they are already squashed all the way through, remove that portion of the bag. Cut pastry into 12, then cut each into 24 pieces. Place lemons/lemon/lime juice in a large bowl. While lemon is juicing, bring sugar to a boil and while it is simmering, add ginger/ginger paste to lemon juice and cook on high until golden brown. Then add 2 to 3 tablespoons of hot syrup and mix well. Add 1/4 of the lemon mixture to lemon/lime juice and mix well. Pour syrup/lemon/syrup mixture onto flour pastry. Dredge pastry and add to bowl. Repeat until all ingredients are used. Pour syrup mixture into 13x9 pan. Sprinkle savory over pastry. Cover with parchment paper. Bake at 425 degrees fahrenheit for 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: tomato green chilies,red chile pepper,nutmeg,colby monterey jack cheese,kaiser,lobster,pasta,ranch bean
title: Lobster and White Bean Burgers
ingredients: 12 ounces boneless linguine pasta | 1 can chopped tomatoes with green chilies | 1 can kidney beans, rinsed and drained | 1 can medium shrimp or ( 8 ounce ) can lobsters, drained | 1 can southwestern-style beans | 1 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1 tablespoon dried red chile pepper | 8 kaiser rolls | 1/2 cup shredded colby-monterey jack cheese
instructions: Prepare pasta according to package directions. Meanwhile, meanwhile, cook linguine according to package directions, adding chopped tomatoes and undrained beans. Stir in shrimp or lobster, cooked beans, nutmeg, and chile pepper. Divide and arrange cooked pasta onto rolls. Top with seafood mixture and cheese.

title: Indian Beef and Veggies
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger | 1 teaspoon ginger powder | 1 carrot | 1 cup fresh corn | 1/2 cup golden raisin ( optional )
instructions: Grill or saute hamburger, carrot and raisins until cooked. Add vegetables and brown.

Random Ingredients: spice,orange juice,chili flake,italian dressing,no salt tomato
title: Baked Italian Vegetables
ingredients: 4 cups mixed fresh italian vegetables, peeled, halved lengthwise ( like turnips or turnips, parsnips, sweet potato, pepper sprouts, carrots or potatoes ) | 2 cups no-salt-added whole canned tomatoes or 1 cup tomatoes and basil, pureed | 2 cups low-fat bottled italian dressing | 1/2 cup orange juice | chili flakes
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f spray a 9 x9 baking dish with cooking spray. Place vegetables on dish. Combine tomato puree, italian dressing, orange juice and chili flakes. Pour over vegetables and bake in centre of oven for 15 minutes or until vegetables are crisp tender, stirring occasionally. Stir and serve.

title: Grilled Cheese-Pearched Stuffed Winter Squash (Greece)
ingredients: 8 ounces winter squash, halved lengthways and cut into 4 wedges | 6 ounces mozzarella cheese, cut into 4 pieces | 2 medium ripe peaches, peeled and roughly diced | 1/2 cup oatmeal | 3 -4 large tortillas
instructions: Preheat grill to medium heat. In a medium bowl mix the squash, mozzarella and peaches. Take a slice of half of the cheese mixture and add to the cheese, being careful not to mash it. Roll it up, jelly roll style, encasing the slices of cheese. Take a slice of the foil and fold that ends of the foil up around the vegetables and cheese, secure by pressing the ends firmly. Place on grill, close lid and cook until cheese is slightly melted and golden brown about 10 minutes. Grill the rest of the veggies until tender and cheese has melted, taking care not to overcook them. Cut them into 4 wedges and spoon on as much of the cheese sauce as you can. Serve with hot, baked bread.

title: Hanoi Style Shrimp
ingredients: 1 lb shrimp, cooked and peeled | 3/4 cup picante sauce | 1/2 small shallot, minced ( or 1/2 small scallion ) | 2 teaspoons dried oregano | 1 tablespoon tomato puree | 1 can baked beans | 1 small daikon radish, grated
instructions: Spray the inside of a large saucpan with nonstick cooking spray. Place shrimp in the bottom of pan. In a jar with a tight fitting lid, combine salsa, shallot and oregano. Stir well and add tomato puree and baked beans. Mix well. Stir in radishes. When ready to serve, place on plate with shrimp and onions and spoon bean mixture over the shrimp and onions.

title: Baked Horseradish Potatoes
ingredients: 2 tablespoons prepared horseradish | 1 1/2 pounds baby potatoes, cleaned and chopped | 1/4 cup capers, drained and rinsed
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees f. In a medium bowl, mix together the horseradish and the potatoes. Spray a large baking dish with cooking spray and pour the potatoes into the dish. Bake in the preheated oven for 45 minutes. Turn potatoes, sprinkle with the capers and bake for an additional 15 minutes, or until potatoes are tender.

title: Irish Bread and Butter Pudding
ingredients: 1 cup raisins | 1 3/4 cups unbleached white flour, divided | 8 cups leftover cooked spaghetti or 8 cups shortbreads
instructions: Place raisins in a bowl. Place 3 cups of flour in a large bowl. Stir in the raisins, then quickly add the hot water in tiny amounts until dough pulls away from the bowl. Knead quickly and place on a flat surface, kneading as needed, to shape into a thick loaf about 1 1/2 inches thick. Cut a cross 1/2 inch deep into the top of the bread. Turn a few times to make sure it is evenly covered. Cover and let rise until doubled, about 45 to 60 minutes. Meanwhile, cook the spaghetti in boiling water until al dente. Drain and return to the pot. Sprinkle with remaining flour and add the drained spaghetti. Preheat oven to 425 degrees fahrenheit. Bake until top is nicely browned, about 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: marsala wine,lemon peel,taco seasoning,chili seasoning mix,flat leaf italian parsley,stock,rice noodle
title: Mexican Red Rice Noodle and Beef Packets
ingredients: 5 ounces dried rice noodles | 1/2 cup dried stock | 1 package taco seasoning | 1 envelope chili seasoning mix | 2 teaspoons shredded lemon peel | 2 tablespoons chopped flat-leaf italian parsley | 2 tablespoons dry marsala wine
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Spread rice noodles in a single layer in a large baking dish. Bake in the preheated oven until barely starting to turn golden, about 8 minutes. Remove from oven, cool, and break into pieces as directed on package. Combine rice noodles with stock, taco mix, chili seasoning, lemon peel, parsley, and marsala wine in a separate bowl. Pack each rice noodle packet into a resealable bag. Pour the wine mixture onto the rice noodles.

title: Low Fat Spicy Afghan Meatballs (Nieyama)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons yoghurt | 2 1/2 pints quick-cooking oats ( nieyama or burnt i use 1 cup ) | 1/8 teaspoon cardamom | 1 small beef bouillon cube ( more for gravy if desired ) | 1/8 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1/8 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1 lb lean italian sausage or 1 lb sweet italian sausage link
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees. Prepare quick cooking oats according to package directions. Drain. Combine first 4 ingredients with hands. Shape into 1 inch balls with hands. Place on greased and parchment lined cookie sheets. Bake, uncovered, for 25 minutes or until no longer pink. While still in oven, fry sausage until evenly browned. Drain, crumble and mix well with cooked meatballs. Note, if you make this dish using a cashew filling, it can be frozen to use later. Freeze for later use.

title: Easy Mexican Barbecue
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cider vinegar | 1 tablespoon ketchup | 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme sprig | 2 tablespoons taco sauce ( mild, med or hot ) | 1 tablespoon oats
instructions: Combine all ingredients, except oat crumbs, in a small bowl. Add oat crumbs and toss well until coated. Pour into a small skillet coated with cooking spray and bake 15 - 20 minutes, brushing occasionally with any extra barbecue sauce.

title: Sue's Capon Beef
ingredients: 2 large yellow bell peppers, cut into 1/4-inch strips | 2 -3 lbs beef tenderloin, cut into 1/2-inch pieces | 1 jar capers, drained | 1/4 cup chia seeds ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees. Brush a baking sheet with cooking oil. Arrange bell peppers in a single layer in a single layer on the sheet.

Random Ingredients: nonstick cooking spray,lime juice,green chilies,poblano chile,flat bread,white bean
title: White Bean and Chiles on Toast
ingredients: 1 cup cooked white beans | 1/3 cup green chilies | 1/2 cup fresh lime juice | 2 tablespoons chopped flat bread | 2 inches piece roasted poblano chiles | nonstick cooking spray
instructions: Heat nonstick skillet and add poblano. Briefly fry chilies. Drain and add to bean mixture. Heat beans mixture. Toast flat bread and dip into mixture. Spray with cooking spray and enjoy.

title: Chili Powder
ingredients: 1 teaspoon ground fennel | 1 can chopped green chile peppers, drained
instructions: Combine fennel and chile peppers in a small bowl. Mix well.

title: Sesame Potato Wedges
ingredients: 1 egg roll mix or 1 hash brown potato | 1/2 onion | sesame seeds ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to mix hash and onion together. Using a pastry bag or floured hands, stuff potato until it is all filled.. Sprinkle with sesame seeds. Bake at 375 for 40 - 50 minutes until golden brown and cooked through.. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: creme fraiche,purpose flour,corn syrup,dark soy sauce,leaf lettuce,red jalapeno chile
title: Creamy Jalapeno Shortbread
ingredients: 1 cup all-purpose flour | 1 tablespoon pure maple syrup | 1 1/2 tablespoons creme fraiche ( or sour cream ) | 1 tablespoon coarse-grained dark soy sauce | 1 teaspoon finely chopped small dried red jalapenos or 1 teaspoon chopped small dried hot red chile ( such as a pimento pepper ) | 2 tablespoons whole leaf lettuce
instructions: Preheat your oven to 350°f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper and set aside. In a medium bowl, stir the flour and maple syrup with a fork, until just combined. Stir in the creme fraiche, soy sauce, jalapeños, and half of the green olives until well blended. Cover the bowl and refrigerate for at least 1 hour, up to up to 8 hours. Add the remaining olives to the dough. With your hands, form the dough into a long log and wrap in parchment paper. Refrigerate for 1 hour. Line a medium baking sheet with foil with parchment paper. Slice the log of shortbread into 1/2 inch slices. Working on a lightly floured surface, with a quick press, press the shortbread slices against the paper to flatten slightly. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes until the lightly golden. Transfer the cookies to a wire rack and let cool completely. Once baked, place the cooled cookies on a parchment paper lined cookie sheet. Slice the cookies and serve. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon cube,italian herb seasoning,serrano pepper
title: Lecheri-Pimento for Tacos
ingredients: 1 serrano pepper, seeded and minced | 1 lb ground round | 4 teaspoons mixed italian herb seasoning, divided
instructions: In a large bowl combine serrano pepper, ground round, 2 teaspoons of the italian herb seasoning and 1 teaspoon of the mixed spice. Divide into 8 portions. Shape each portion into a ball and then flatten slightly. Place on a cookie sheet and refrigerate for 1 hour or longer. In a large skillet, cook over moderate heat for 8 to 10 minutes, turning 2 or 3 times, until browned. Transfer to a paper towel lined plate and let cool. When cool, break into pieces and serve with any remaining italian seasoning.

Random Ingredients: cream,rhubarb,kosher salt,tart apple,parsley flake,alfredo sauce,lime peel,white vinegar
title: Raspberry Rhubarb Applesauce and Dressing
ingredients: 1/2 lb tart apple ( see note ) | 1 lb rhubarb, stems removed | 3 cups light sour cream | 1 cup alfredo sauce ( see note ) | 1 tablespoon white vinegar | 1 teaspoon lime peel, grated | 1/2 cup parsley flakes | kosher salt
instructions: Wash apple and rhubarb together, cutting the stems away at the stem end and the bottom by 3 inches long. Peel off tough ends and cut the fruit crosswise into 1/4 inch slices. Cut rhubarb slices crosswise into 3 inch lengths. Place rhubarb slices on a platter with the stem end facing toward you. Cut 2 1/2 inch pieces of apple and rhubarb lengthwise into 1 inch pieces. Place the sour cream in a medium bowl. Add the alfredo sauce, vinegar, and lime peel and whisk until smooth. Stir in parsley until well blended. Season with salt and drizzle on top of the rhubarb pieces. Serve chilled or at room temperature. Note, alfredo sauce is available at health food stores, pouches, and larger serving sizes. Dressing directions, place sour cream in a small mixing bowl and beat until creamy. Gradually add the alfredo sauce. Pour dressing over sour cream and stir gently until combined. Pour immediately and refrigerate for at least 3 days or up to 3 weeks.

Random Ingredients: plum tomato,chickpea flour,arborio rice,pork tenderloin,broth,white sugar,paprika,ice
title: Paella
ingredients: 2 cups arborio rice | 2 1/3 cups chicken stock or 2 1/3 cups broth | 1/3 cup chickpea flour ( besan ) | 1 tablespoon paprika | 1/2 lb pork tenderloin, cut into 1/3-inch cubes ( about 1 1/2 lbs ) | 6 tablespoons white sugar | 1 cup tomatoes with roasted garlic and rosemary | 2 cups ice
instructions: Place the rice and stock in a medium saucepan and bring to a boil over high heat. Cover and reduce heat to medium low and simmer until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed, 20 to 25 minutes. Stir the dry flour into the rice and cook over medium low heat, stirring, until fragrant, about 1 minute. Gradually add the chickpea flour and paprika and cook until the flour is absorbed, about 1 minute. Cut the pork into cubes and add them with its marinade to the rice and stir to coat. Cover and cook over medium heat until heated through, 7 to 10 minutes. Remove from heat and add the sugar and tomatoes.

Random Ingredients: dark rum,parmesan cheese,beef sirloin steak,white chocolate,cauliflower,salt black pepper,pork
title: Beef and Cauliflower With Chocolate
ingredients: 500 g beef sirloin steaks, trimmed, cut into 4cm cubes | salt & freshly ground black pepper | 400 g pork fat or 400 g bacon, trimmed, cut in 2 cm pieces if large | 400 g cauliflower, trimmed, washed, ends trimmed and cut into florets | 300 -400 ml white chocolate or 300 -400 ml sweet vermouth | dark rum
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180c/160c fan oven. Season the beef with salt and pepper. Heat a large flameproof casserole dish. Cook the beef in batches, adding a little oil if needed, if the beef browns too quickly. Remove the beef to a plate. Fry the pork fat or bacon in the dish or the pan which cooked the beef, stirring, over a low heat until coloured. Add the cauliflower florets and stir, coating the cauliflower until they soften, for another 5 minutes or until tender. Remove the vegetables from the pan and place in a large bowl. Pour over half the chocolate or vermouth and rum and stir over a medium heat until melted, then pour over the beef and beef. Scatter over the remaining chocolate or vermouth. Season with salt and pepper and cover tightly with foil. Stir to combine. Pour into a large warmed ovenproof dish and bake in the preheated oven for 1 and 1/4 hours. Remove from the oven and sprinkle over the remaining chocolate or vermouth. Leave for 10 minutes, then serve.

title: Pepitas Chips
ingredients: 500 g dried pepitas | 1 bunch fresh par-popped onion | cooking oil, approximately | 8 slices prosciutto
instructions: Wash pepitas well. Cover and soak overnight in water. Drain off water. On the morning of preparation, pat dry with paper towel. Spray with cooking oil. Fry pepitas on each side for 3 minutes depending on your desired crispiness. Cool on paper towels. Slice thin and place on a plate with a little crispy onion and a prosciutto. You can also sprinkle with chopped tomato. We do this in a bread maker too. Enjoy.

title: Beef Short Rib Stew(Crock Pot)
ingredients: 4 lbs country-style short rib of beef ( about 1-1/2 pounds ) | 1/3 cup winter squash or 1/3 cup acorn squash pieces ( about 15 or 12 ounces ) | 1/3 cup plum tomato, chopped ( about 1 large plum ) | 1 tablespoon ground cloves ( or more if desired ) | 1 tablespoon dried savory ( or more if desired ) | 2 tablespoons dried savory ( or more if desired ) ( optional )
instructions: Trim off excess fat from beef and cut into 1/2 inch pieces. Arrange the beef in the crock pot and top generously with squash, tomato, cloves, savory or any seasonings that you like. Pour remaining crock pot contents over all. Cover and cook on low 8 hours, or until beef is tender..

Random Ingredients: almond extract,vanilla pod,vanilla extract,caster sugar,cheese,kalamata olive,rom tomato
title: Almond Jelly With Tomato and Romanes
ingredients: 12 roma tomatoes or 12 plum tomatoes, halved and seeded | 125 g caster sugar or 125 g sugar | 1 vanilla pod, split | 3 tablespoons almond extract | 2 teaspoons pure vanilla extract | 6 kalamata olives, pitted and halved | 250 g tasty cheese ( grated )
instructions: Cut the tomatoes in half lengthways, remove the seeds. Remove the pulp from the vanilla pods and cut into pieces about 3cm wide by 2cm across. Put the sugar, split vanilla pods and the half of the vanilla pod down the middle of a double thickness of foil and place on a chopping board. Punch down the garlic and add the rest of the vanilla pod. Cut the vanilla pod into pieces about 3cm wide. Spread the paste into the foil and bake gently in a slow oven for 30 minutes. After 30 minutes, put the tomatoes in a sieve and run under running water to clean off the little black inside of the skins. Pour off all the water, then remove the vanilla skin. When cool, break the flesh apart into chunks. Place the tomatoes, skin side down, into a preserving pan. Add the rest of the skin and sugar and bring to the boil, stirring. Simmer for about 20 minutes. Strain, reserving the cooking liquid. Place all the ingredients into a large bowl and whisk until dissolved. Return to the pan and bring to the boil and boil for about 10 minutes. Remove the pan from the heat and stir in half the olives. Spoon onto hot, sterilized jelly jars. Seal and place in a cool dark place for 2 weeks before using to store. Note, the jelly should not leave any water on it for more than a couple of weeks or until the jelly has absorbed all the liquid. It will keep for up to 5 days in the refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: pear,spaghetti sauce,bamboo shoot,cod fillet,broth,bacon dripping,double cream
title: Spaghetti With Baked Pear & Black Prawns
ingredients: 8 pears | 8 slices bacon drippings | 2 cod fillets | 1 jar spaghetti sauce | 300 ml chicken stock or 300 ml canned low-sodium broth | 75 ml double cream | 300 g bamboo shoots, drained
instructions: Preheat oven to c. Place the pears on a large baking tray. Heat the bacon drippings in a frying pan over medium heat and brown the pears and cod. Place in a 2 litre ovenproof dish. Pour the wine over the pasta, making sure it is well covered, and bake for 4 hours. Add the broth and cream and simmer for 15 minutes. Spoon over the pears and bake for a further 30 minutes, until hot and bubbling. Garnish the spaghetti with the sliced bamboo shoots and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: red capsicum,star anise,white chocolate chip,cream chicken soup,lasagna noodle,sea salt,beer,baguette
title: Czech Beer & White Chocolate Nachos
ingredients: 12 lasagna noodles | 420 g cream of chicken soup | 2 tablespoons white chocolate chips ( white melts ) | 3 star anise | 2 teaspoons sea salt | 1 liter beer ( guinness is best, just make sure it fits over the pasta when in the fridge ) | 115 g golden sizzled red capsicums, finely diced ( or use a jar of poblanos )
instructions: Boil the noodles until cooked according to your preference, then drain and allow to cool slightly. Combine the cream of mushroom soup, dark chocolate chips, star anise and salt in a small bowl, place in fridge to soften. Combine the beer and diced capsicum in a deep skillet, or a deep pot and bring to a boil. Lower heat, cover and simmer very gently for about 20 minutes until the beer is reduced slightly by half and the flavours are incorporated. Place the noodles in a large shallow ovenproof bowl and ladle the hot mixture over, then toss to coat them evenly. Sprinkle over the melted white chocolate chips and cover with plastic wrap. Cook in a preheated 315f/160c oven for 45 - 50 minutes until the cheese is bubbly and everything is warmed through. Remove from the oven, cover to rest for 10 minutes to set the cheese for easier handling and serving.

Random Ingredients: mustard seed,sugar,cake flour,self raising flour,curry paste,basmati rice,yellow pepper
title: Yellow Pepper & Rice Cake
ingredients: 1/2 cup yellow sweet pepper | 3 tablespoons curry paste | 1 pinch sugar | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds | 1 1/2 cups basmati rice | 1 1/4 cups self-raising flour | 3 cups cake flour | 2/3 cup sugar | 1/2 cup sifted cake flour | 1 tablespoon curry paste
instructions: First make the rice. Place all the ingredients in a bowl & mix well. Line a baking tray with baking parchment or greaseproof paper & pre heat the oven to 160c. Mix the rice mixture in to a smooth dough. Pour into the prepared tray & bake for 35 - 40 minutes, or until the centre is slightly puffed. Cut the cake into slices & turn on the plates, decorate with mint sprigs & serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: self raising flour,sun tomato oil,milk,phyllo dough,dark soy sauce,lime juice,salad oil,broth
title: Thai Tomato Filled Baklava Rolls
ingredients: 8 large fresh spinach leaves | 1/2 cup salad oil | 1/4 1/4 cup dark soy sauce or 1/4 cup tamari | 3 tablespoons lime juice or 3 tablespoons lemon juice | 1/2 cup stock or 1/2 cup chicken stock | 1/2 cup selfraising flour | 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained chopped | 2 tablespoons skim milk | 1/2 cup shredded low fat fresh bread or 1/2 cup low fat greek yogurt
instructions: Bring a large saucepan of water to the boil. Gently spray a sheet of cling film with cooking spray. To make the baklava dough, place the spinach leaves on the sheet of cling film and sprinkle with salt and pepper. Cover loosely with a piece of parchment paper to prevent over drying out. Place on a baking tray and lightly brush with cooking oil. Roast in the oven for 3 - 5 minutes, until just wilted. Stir once or twice, as it can burn you if necessary remove from the oven, but leave covered and stand 10 minutes or until warm. Meanwhile, while waiting for the baklava, in a small bowl, combine all the dressing ingredients and stir until well combined. Drain the spinach leaves and pat dry, then transfer to a small bowl. Add the dressing and mix to combine. Using a clean knife or pastry bag fitted with narrow plain tip, roll each piece of baklava onto a piece of greaseproof paper. Fold the paper over the spinach and then roll again. Continue rolling until all of the baklava are coated. Place each roll on a large tray lined with baking paper, and spread out to allow for a few minutes to dry out. Repeat process with the remaining baklava. Arrange the baklava rolls on a serving tray, then spread the filling on them. Chill at least 1 hour until warm and firm.

Random Ingredients: vegetable stock,italian salad dressing mix,curry paste,ginger ale
title: Curry Soup
ingredients: 2 cups vegetable stock | 2 cups ginger ale ( unfiltered variety ) | 1 cup curry paste ( or 2 tsp of jamaican hot curry powder ) | 1 ounce good seasons salad dressing mix ( or store-bought mix )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a pot and bring to boil. Cover and simmer gently for about 4 minutes. Stir and serve. Variation, instead of ginger ale, use 2/3 cup white wine/brandy instead.

Random Ingredients: topping,brown onion,date,thai red chili pepper,pine nut,fruit,celery seed,green chili pepper
title: Sweet Chili Relish
ingredients: 1 lb dried fruit, finely chopped | 1 cup crumbled soft brown onion | 1 cup chopped celery seed | 1 1/2 cups chopped green chili peppers | 1 1/2 cups chopped dates | 1 can chopped mild green chili peppers | 1/4 cup toasted pine nuts | 1/4 cup thai red chili pepper seeds or 1/4 cup other dry crushed red pepper
instructions: Add all ingredients to a medium size saucepan, and simmer over medium heat while bringing to a boil. Reduce heat, and simmer, stirring frequently, for 10 minutes. Cool. Stir in the pine nuts and chilies.

title: Gruyere Cheese Spread
ingredients: 500 g gruyere cheese, grated | 1 teaspoon cider vinegar | 4 -5 fresh oregano sprigs
instructions: Place cheese in a medium size bowl. Pour vinegar over, mix and let sit at room temperature for 15 - 20 minutes. Grate the cheese with a coarse grater or electric hand held grater, stirring continuously until the mixture becomes creamy. Add the oregano and mix well. Refrigerate in an airtight container for up to a week.

title: Chicken Tassos With Roasted Red Lentils
ingredients: 2 tablespoons instant red lentils | 2 tablespoons red chilies, finely chopped | 2 large chicken tenderloins | chocolate bar, grated ( or use a firm melting chocolate bar ) | 1 1/2 cups dates, chopped | 1 small firm banana, sliced
instructions: Heat oven to 400°f in a large baking pan combine the lentils and chilies, stirring to coat evenly. Place chicken tenderloins in pan and scatter the chicken lightly with salt. Roast 20 minutes, turning once, until cooked through. Remove from oven, increase oven temperature to 400f and continue to roast until chicken is cooked through. Remove from oven and set aside in a serving platter. Remove chicken from oven and let rest about 5 minutes. Thinly slice and then place on top of lentils in platter. Spoon chocolate over chicken. Serve hot. Mangia bene.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast fillet,vanilla extract,carrot,black peppercorn,cheese,cheddar cheese,limeade concentrate
title: Easy Chicken Margherita
ingredients: 1/2 cup frozen limeade concentrate | 2 teaspoons vanilla extract | 1/2 teaspoon black peppercorns | 6 chicken breast fillets | 500 g grated carrot | 1 bunch shredded tasty cheese | 2 tablespoons grated cheddar cheese
instructions: Combine 1/2 cup limeade concentrate, vanilla extract, peppercorns in shallow casserole dish. Add chicken & carrots. Cover & chill for 2 hours. Preheat oven to 180c. Divide chicken mixture among 4 serving dishes. Sprinkle with cheddar & rest of cheese.

Random Ingredients: pimiento,cannellini bean,napa cabbage,rom tomato,italian sausage,maraschino cherry,methi seed
title: Cabbage Rolls II
ingredients: 1/2 cup napa cabbage, shredded | 1 medium roma tomato, diced small | 1 tablespoon pimiento, drained and chopped | 1/4 teaspoon methi seeds | 1/8 teaspoon mustard seeds | 1 can cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 10 small napa cabbage rolls | 1/4 cup italian sausage ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. In a bowl, combine napa cabbage, roma tomato, pimento, and mustard seeds. Spread bean filling down the center of each napa cabbage roll. Place rolls seam side down in a baking dish. Add shredded napa cabbage to the baking dish and surround with sausage. Bake in preheated oven until the rolls are browned and filling is hot, about 40 minutes.

Random Ingredients: garbanzo bean,whiskey,cream cheese,grain white rice,pork rib
title: Baked Garbanzo Beans and Beef
ingredients: 32 ounces garbanzo beans ( chick peas ), drained and rinsed | 8 ounces country ham, cut into 1/2 inch pieces ( about 3 cups ) | 1 package cream cheese, softened | 1 cup long grain white rice, uncooked | 1 -2 tablespoon sweetened whiskey ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees. Spread the beans out in the greased 9x13 inch baking dish, and sprinkle with ham. In a bowl, mix the cream cheese, rice, and whiskey. Spread mixture over the ham. Bake for 30 minutes, or until heated through and lightly browned on top.

title: Dilly Italian Breadcrumbs
ingredients: 8 -12 ounces italian seasoned breadcrumbs | dill weed ( optional )
instructions: You can also mix the crumbs with a hand held blender or food processor or a food processor. Form the bread crumbs into 8 balls and roll in the dill weed if using. Place them on a foil lined baking sheet. Bake at 400 degrees for about 15 minutes. Take the foil off the bread and bake another 15 minutes until golden brown. If baking them right away they should take longer.

Random Ingredients: food coloring,thai basil,dark sesame oil,spice,curry powder
title: Crispy Thai Basil Powder
ingredients: 1/2 cup dark sesame oil | 3 tablespoons curry powder | 1 tablespoon mixed spice ( curry paste, garlic powder, chilli powder, curry powder ) | 1 teaspoon dried thai basil | food coloring ( optional )
instructions: In a glass bowl add, sesame oil, curry, mixed spice and thai basil. Stir until they are blended inches add food colouring after that if desired, stir. Sprinkle on foods and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: marinade,muscovado sugar,red chili pepper,havarti cheese,sharp cheddar cheese,golden raisin
title: Delicious Cheddar Dip
ingredients: 2 lbs havarti cheese | 5 tablespoons shredded extra sharp cheddar cheese | 1/2 cup grated havarti cheese | 1/2 cup sliced marinated red chili peppers | 1/2 cup golden raisin | 1/2 cup pickled red chili peppers | 1/3 cup molasses or 1/3 cup dark cane syrup
instructions: In a 6 quart casserole, mash together cheese, hoagie crumbs, cheddar cheese, marinated chilies and raisins. Stir in molasses. Bake, uncovered, in 400 degree f oven for 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: shortening,cornflour,beef sirloin,garlic powder,cumin seed,gruyere,ramen noodle,mint leaf
title: Cheddar Flavoured Beef Kabobs
ingredients: 1/4 cup cornflour | 1 tablespoon garlic powder | 1 tablespoon cumin seed | 3 tablespoons dried mint leaves | 2 cloves garlic, minced | 1/3 cup shortening or 1/3 cup olive oil | 6 ounces lean beef sirloin, cut into 3 thick bite sized pieces, trimmed of excess fat ( or use 1 1/2-lb beef top sirloin, trimmed and thinly slice across grain into 1/2-inch strips ) | 2 lbs fresh ramen noodles, cooked as per package directions
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f lightly brush or spray or brush the inside surface of a baking sheet with 2 tsp or olive oil. In a small bowl, combine all of the dry ingredients and set aside.. Place the garlic and shortening/olive oil in a large skillet. Over high heat, place the beef in the oil. Cook the beef in batches, browning the meat on all sides, about 3 minutes per batch. Transfer the beef to a plate.. Reduce oven temperature to 400°f and toss the noodles with the remaining dry ingredients. Divide the beef among 4 serving bowls. Divide the noodles among the 4 serving bowls along with the beef and garnish with the cheese note, i divide the noodles among the 4 plates, i make an 'batter' with the cornflour, garlic powder and cumin and a drizzle of olive oil to finish the dish. Note, the ingredients used for the dry meat were removed before prep and cooking. Any leftover beef in the refrigerator can be used for another purpose.

Random Ingredients: leg lamb,egg noodle,steel oat,almond extract,margarine,flat rice noodle,sun tomato
title: Scotch Mouton or Runtael Ray's English Pea, Lamb and Noodle Casserole (Hsn Sarn)
ingredients: 16 ounces dried egg noodles | 4 ounces steel cut oats | 1/2 cup slivered almonds, slivered or 2 tablespoons sliced sun-dried tomatoes | 4 tablespoons margarine | 1 1/2 lbs boneless leg of lamb | 3/4 teaspoon almond extract | 2 pints store bought chicken stock or 2 pints canned beef stock
instructions: Pre heat oven to 300 degrees. To begin with, bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and add noodles all at once and cook according to package directions, about 3 - 4 minutes until tender but still firm to the bite. Drain well and set aside. To start with, heat 2 tbsp margarine in a large dutch oven over medium high heat. Brown lamb on all sides, but do not allow to brown. Drain fat and place meat in lightly oiled baking dish. Sprinkle almonds and sun dried tomatoes over the meat. In a medium size bowl, combine the oats and almonds. Add the browned lamb at this stage and mix well. Add the 3 pints stock or the last 1/2 cup of stock and mix well again. Place half of this mixture over the meat and mix well. Place the next half over the meat. Dot with the remaining margarine. Cover dish with foil or a lid or a large piece of aluminum foil just slightly smaller than your teapot. Cook in center of 300f for 25 - 35 minutes until meat is falling off the bone. Remove foil and ladle out meat and serve over noodles.

Random Ingredients: cumin powder,coconut,salad oil,grain rice,arborio rice,green chili pepper,jasmine rice
title: Rice With Spiced Basrascos
ingredients: 2 3/4 cups rice | 1/3 cup arborio rice or 1/3 cup carnaroli rice, uncooked | 1/3 cup long-grain rice | 1/2 teaspoon cumin powder | 1 1/2 - 2 tablespoons salad oil | 1 fresh green chili pepper | shredded coconut, to garnish ( optional ) | minced fresh green chili peppers ( optional )
instructions: In a large cooking pot, rinse and rinse the rice. Add the rice, stir to coat, cover, and cook over medium heat for 5 minutes over low heat. Pour oil into a frying pan. When very hot, add the sliced green pepper.

Random Ingredients: french bread,romaine lettuce,iceberg lettuce,lamb,baby bok choy,cardamom,red capsicum,barbecue sauce
title: Spud Sandwich
ingredients: 1/2 australian honey barbecue sauce, sauce packet | 200 g ground lamb or 200 g beef | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1 teaspoon dry crushed red capsicum ( optional ) | 100 g baby bok choy, washed | 1/2 small head iceberg lettuce, core removed, washed and roughly broken | 1 head romaine lettuce | crusty french bread
instructions: For the condiment, combine all of the condiments in a bowl. Keep aside while preparing your condiments. Remove any excess fat and sinew from the lamb or beef and finely mince, or use a food processor to make meatballs. Mix everything together in a bowl. Preheat the barbecue on the stove top to medium. Grill the lamb or beef until cooked, breaking up large pieces as you go. Allow meat to stand until the liquid is reduced approximately 5 to 7 minutes, stir. Serve meat in a shallow dish with a little condiment on top. Top meat with the lettuce and bok choy. Spoon the condiment onto the sandwich and serve.

title: Dressing Made With Shredded Beef!
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs shredded lean center cut beef or 1 1/2 lbs leftover lean ground beef | 1/3 cup dressing | 2 beef bouillon cubes | 2/3 cup milk
instructions: Mix all ingredients well and store in a tightly lidded container or freezer container.

Random Ingredients: beef chuck roast,garlic paste,cooking spray,nutella,italian sausage,spinach leaf,parsnip,tahini
title: Mushroom and Sausage Pot Roast
ingredients: 3 pounds boneless beef chuck roast, fat trimmed | cooking spray | 2 links fresh italian sausage | 1 can tahini | 2 pounds fresh spinach leaves | 3 pounds peeled parsnips | 1 package herb-based nutella
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Cover pork with water in a 3 to 4 quart dutch oven or roasting pan large enough to fit roast into dish. Roast in preheated oven until beginning to brown, about 2 hours. Cool and cut into thin slices. Meanwhile, crumble sausage in a large skillet. Cook over medium heat, stirring frequently with a wooden spoon, until well browned, about 10 minutes. Drain off any excess fat. Mix in tahini, spinach, parsnips and nutella. Continue roasting until meat reaches an internal temperature of 145 degrees f, about 1 hour longer.

Random Ingredients: worcestershire sauce,salami,hot green chili pepper,italian salad dressing,bacon,golden mushroom soup,monterey jack cheese
title: Salami, Green Chili and Cheese
ingredients: 3 slices bacon, cooked until crisp ( about 6 strips ) | 1/2 lb hot green chili pepper, halved | 1 package monterey jack cheese, shredded | 1/2 cup italian salad dressing | 1 can condensed golden mushroom soup, undiluted | 1 teaspoon worcestershire sauce | 1/2 cup hot italian green chili pepper, chopped
instructions: Cook bacon in a 10 inch skillet over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until crisp. Using a slotted spoon, drain bacon on paper towels.

title: Pecan Shrimp Empanadas
ingredients: 2 lbs jumbo shrimp, shelled | 1/2 lb turnip, peeled & grated | 1/2 cup margarine or 1/2 cup butter | 2 1/2 cups marshmallows | 2 cups velveeta cheese | 1 cup shredded coconut | 1/2 cup chopped pecan nuts | 1 teaspoon dry paprika
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees. Spray cookie sheet with cooking spray. Place shrimp in medium bowl. In medium saucepan melt margarine. Remove shrimp from shells. Sauté in margarine until just tender. Transfer shrimp to large bowl. Add mrsn, cheese, coconut, and nuts. Mix well. Stir in shrimp. Shape into 12 thin rounds using 1/3 c shrimp mixture each. Arrange empanada on cookie sheet. If desired, place 1/2 c pecan nuts in bottom of oven and broil 4 - 5 minutes or until lightly browned on top. You may set them in the casserole for a few minutes with a toothpick and remove toothpick before serving and placing in oven.

Random Ingredients: asiago cheese,chicken soup base,mozzarella cheese,cherry,pork shoulder,rotel tomato chilies
title: Crockpot Pork Chile Con Queso
ingredients: 2 lbs pork shoulder, cut into 2-inch cubes | 1 can rotel tomatoes & chilies | 6 canned jalapeno-flavored chicken soup cubes, undiluted | 1/2 cup asiago cheese, shredded | 1/2 cup shredded mozzarella cheese | 3 cups cherry tomatoes, halves on the unheated side, sliced thin
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine meat, tomatoes, soup and cheese. Add hot peppers and soup cubes and stir until cheese is melted. Cover and place in crockpot on low heat for 7 to 8 hours, stir occasionally to mix ingredients and ensure even cooking. Serve topped with tomatoes and lettuce.

title: Lone Star Cafe Beef Nachos
ingredients: 1 lb sirloin, cut in thin slices | 1 tablespoon butter | 1/2 cup horseradish, prepared | 2 tablespoons creamy peanut butter | 1 1/2 cups crushed corn tortilla chips | 1 bottle liqueur
instructions: Heat butter in skillet until melted. Add noodles, horseradish and peanut butter. Cook over medium high heat, stirring constantly until melted, about 5 minutes or until noodles are crisp. Spread chips evenly on flat metal or glass plate. Spoon hot beef mixture over noodles. Drizzle liqueur over top.

Random Ingredients: brown sugar,aubergine,ginger,sugar snap pea,kalamata olive,vodka,eggplant,peanut oil
title: Aubergine (Eggplant) and Peanuts
ingredients: 2 large eggplants ( large ) | 2 tablespoons peanut oil | 2 tablespoons brown sugar | 2 tablespoons fresh ginger ( grated ) | 5 large pints peanut oil ( for deep frying ) | 2 large aubergines, sliced, peeled, into 1/2-inch rounds | 20 white sugar snap peas, trimmed | 1 cup kalamata olive | 4 cups good quality vodka
instructions: Peel the aubergines longways and cut into 1 1/2 long sticks across. Cut the eggplant sticks into sticks about 5 inches long at the ends, and set aside. Cut the pecans or almonds into large dice. Toss them in the sun with the brown sugar to get them tan colored and slightly dry. Bring the peanut oil to 350 degrees. Fry the eggplant in batches, turning regularly so they are browned all over. Remove and blot dry on paper towels. When both sides are browned, remove each batch with a strainer to absorb as much oil as you can. Drain on paper towels. In the same pan you used to fry the brine, add 2 tablespoons of peanut oil and fry the aubergines, turning regularly until they are soft and begin to brown. Remove and drain on paper towels. In a large soup pot, heat the remaining peanut oil until smoking and fry the sugar snap peas and almonds with the aubergine and orange sections. Add the vodka and continue frying until the liquid is reduced to about 1 1/2 cups. Slice the aubergine slices and stir them into the sauce. Cover and simmer for 40 minutes. Check seasoning, taste, and serve.

title: Summer Squash With Raisins
ingredients: 1 medium summer squash, halved and cut into 1/4 by 1/4 pieces | 1/2 cup raisins
instructions: Preheat broiler or gas grill. Place squash on a foil lined baking sheet coated with cooking spray. Arrange raisins on top and sprinkle with a little salt and pepper. Broil for 10 minutes or until golden. Remove from oven and serve warm or cold.

title: Creme Fraiche
ingredients: 5 egg whites | 300 ml double cream | 50 ml light whipping cream | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1 teaspoon dried mint or 2 tablespoons of fresh mint
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 degrees celsius grease 10 inch cake pan. Draw an 18 cm round from a circle of butter paper. In a bowl, beat egg whites with electric hand mixer until foamy, gradually beat in the double cream. Add cardamom, dry mint, and the half pints of double cream. Transfer this filling to the cake pan. Bake in the oven for 30 - 40 minutes. Serve sprinkled with remaining fresh mint leaves.

title: Red Chile Chiles
ingredients: 2 small dried red chiles, rinsed | 1/2 cup packed finely shredded lime zest
instructions: In a nonreactive bowl, combine the chiles and lime zest. Cover and let stand for 30 minutes. Strain the chile mixture through a fine mesh sieve. Discard the excess liquid. Line a baking sheet with cheesecloth.

Random Ingredients: orange peel,yellow onion,yoghurt,cinnamon bark,sesame oil,glace cherry,pecorino romano cheese,jalapeno jack cheese
title: Yogurt Cheese Fondue
ingredients: 500 ml yoghurt | 1 yellow onion | 1/2 - 1 cup sesame oil | 1 cinnamon bark | 1 piece orange peel ( about 2 x 1 cm long ) | 120 -150 g jalapenos ( remove the seeds ) or 120 -150 g jack cheese, sliced ( remove the seeds ) | 60 -75 g pecorino romano cheese | 1/2 pint warm milk or 1/2 pint warm double cream
instructions: Start by mixing the yoghurt with the finely chopped onion, the sesame oil, cinnamon bark, orange peel, jalapenos, grated cheese and milk. Stir well, and keep in the fridge until served. Drain the yoghurt well and place back into the yoghurt. Cut the ouzo into 4 5cm lengths, about the size of a matchstick. Dip the ouzo into the warm milk, which will sink in a few seconds just prior to dipping the cheese in it to make it easier to remove it from oil. Place the yoghurt mixture into a warmed mould or pot and place into the warming milk. Heat the milk over gentle flame until bubbles form and the whey has been absorbed. Do not boil, as this can quickly make it tough. Grate the pecorino romano and place in the mould or pot. Allow the cheese to melt and bubble and rise again. Once all the cheese is completely melted, turn up the heat a little, then pour in enough cream to reach the top of the fondue. This should make about 10 glasses of cream floating on top or about 35 - 40 fondue forks which have been soaked in warm water for a while, before serving to your unsuspecting victim.

title: Chinese Hot Red Pepper Pickle
ingredients: 1/2 lb red pepper | 1/2 cup dark sesame oil ( dark )
instructions: Clean and wash the red pepper. Slit the pepper lengthwise. Remove the stem part from this pepper. Rinse the pepper with cold water. Cut the pepper in half lengthwise. Slit along the slit with scissors. Place the red pepper, cut side down, in a bowl of cold water. Let it stand 5 to 10 minutes or until the skin starts to wrinkle. Cut off and discard the stem peel. Trim the loose peel. Rinse the pepper with cold water. Drain it well. Place in small, sterilized jars in which the peanut oil has been added. Pour about half this hot pepper brine over the peppers, then seal with lids and screw on rings. Chill for at least 3 days or over night in the refrigerator. This pickle will keep, refrigerated, for up to a month.

title: Garlic Cream Cheese Dip (Fiber Version)
ingredients: 16 ounces greek yogurt | 1 package cream cheese ( light is ok ) | 2 -3 cloves garlic | 6 dried corn flakes, crushed
instructions: Blend everything in food processor or blender, until creamy and smooth. Serve with pita chips and veggies. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: saffron,wide egg noodle,japanese eggplant,raspberry syrup,buttermilk pancake mix,seasoning salt
title: Eggplant-Sweet Pancake Soup
ingredients: 1 package wide egg noodle, the long skinny kind ( this is about 2/3 c total ) | 3 japanese eggplants, cut on a baking tray, about 4-6 ( can also use regular japanese eggplant ) | 1 package raspberries in syrup, canned | 1 packet japanese gogi egg noodle, flavor packet | buttermilk pancake mix | seasoning salt
instructions: Rinse out soup cans on dish. Cut a 1/4 slice from top of each eggplant, leaving a 1/4 inch shell. Put in cold water, cover and set aside for 30 - 45 minutes. Meanwhile, cut the eggs in 1/2 inch slices, and rinse out soup cans. Take one large eggplant slice, and cut the other in half. Cut the scoop of eggplant with a very sharp knife into approximately 5 to 6 small chunks. Heat a large sauté pan over medium heat. Quickly cook the 4 slices of eggplant in the sauté pan in a single layer. The pieces should have nice little browning on the outside, and should not be cooked all the way through at this point. Place one eggplant piece in the soup while the pieces are cooking. When the pieces are cooked through, remove the pieces of eggplant to your serving platter. Drain off the excess water and set aside. In the same pan, add a little water. When the water boils, add the flavor packet. If you got enough flavor packet, take a piece of eggplant and put it in the soup pot to cook. Then add about 1/4 c. Water to the soup. Add enough raspberries into the soup pot to warm through. Place one eggplant piece in the soup to warm through. Add some raspberries into the soup pot and add 2 1/2 c. Of milk and seasoning salt to taste. You may wish to use a canola oil spray to lightly coat the bottom of your pan. It is not necessary if you get a mixture of sweet and sour, and has a little bit of oil in it. You could also use a bagel or other flavor packet for the flavor and texture. Diners can eat these without themselves, with the flavor packet out, or with a scoop of pancake mix. This is a tasty soup that can be stuffed into your fancy ramikomita shells, etc.

title: Chokolate Shrimp Patties
ingredients: 1 lb ground chuck | 1/2 lb bulk shrimp, cooked and minced | 6 large shrimp, peeled but tails intact, deveined, heads removed | 3 ounces dark chocolate, grated ( or cocoa or other chocolate ) | 4 ounces bean sprouts | salt
instructions: Sauté the beef and shrimp in a large skillet to your preferred temperature. Stir frequently to keep from sticking. Add all the remaining ingredients except for the bean sprouts and cook until the shrimp is opaque and the meat is a dark pink color. Stir in the shredded shrimp to heat.

title: Dukkah
ingredients: 2 lbs lemons, zested and juiced | 1 1/4 cups vegetable oil | 3/4 cup tahini | 1 teaspoon salt | 1 teaspoon sea salt | 1/2 cup rice wine | 1/2 cup apricot, pitted and finely chopped
instructions: Combine the lemons, oil, tahini, salt, and sea salt in a small container with a tight fitting lid and shake vigorously until the mixture is homogenous. Pour in the rice wine and apricots, and stir to combine. Cover tightly and refrigerate at least 1 hour before serving. Keep refrigerated for up to 3 days.

Random Ingredients: red chili powder,bean,cajun seasoning,double cream,red pepper flake,quinoa,tortilla chip
title: Tortilla and Bean Casserole
ingredients: 2 cups quinoa | 1 cup refried beans | 2 cans whole red chili peppers, drained | 2 tablespoons red chili powder | 2 tablespoons red pepper flakes | 1 tablespoon cajun seasoning | 2 cups double cream | 1/2 cup crushed tortilla chips
instructions: Combine and bake on a cookie sheet at 400 degrees fahrenheit for 12 minutes. Let sit on wire rack for 10 minutes before serving. Mix the quinoa with refried beans and chilies. Set aside. Topping with cream. Topping with crushed tortilla chips. Casserole ingredients. Top each serving with quinoa and cream.

Random Ingredients: serrano chile pepper,rye bread,green food coloring,white peppercorn,cumin seed,catsup,hot chili pepper
title: Korean Sanguinjods
ingredients: 3 slices rye bread | 1 green food coloring | 1 tablespoon cumin seed | 1 tablespoon white peppercorns | 20 small dried hot chili peppers | 1 serrano chile pepper | 2 teaspoons catsup
instructions: Place all the ingredients into a small skillet. Bring to a boil, cover and reduce heat and simmer until the liquid is reduced to nearly 1 cup, stirring occasionally. Cool 5 minutes. Rinse out the skillet and dry. Spoon 1 inch of batter onto 1 slice of rye bread. Leave about 1/2 inch between each. Use a knife or spatula to flatten the rounds out to approximately 1/2 inch thick. Place on two cookie sheets or wax paper, cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour before cooking.

Random Ingredients: green olive,olive oil cooking spray,sharp cheddar cheese,scallion,rigatoni pasta,center pork chop,red chile
title: Pasta With Pork Chops - Giada De Laurentiis
ingredients: 3 cooked rigatoni pasta or 3 cooked ziti pasta | 3 lbs center cut pork chops, 1/2 inch thick, 6-8 ounces | olive oil flavored cooking spray | 4 scallions, sliced | 6 large dried red chiles, stemmed, seeded, cut into 2 strips | 1 cup green olives | 3/4 cup shredded sharp cheddar cheese
instructions: In a large saucepan of salted boiling water, cook the rigatoni pasta until just tender but firm to the bite, stirring occasionally. Drain. Coat a 7 x 11 inch glass baking dish or shallow frypan with cooking spray. Cut a slit along the side of each chop to create a pocket. Place the pork in skillet with 1/4 cup water. Simmer until water is absorbed, stirring occasionally. Drain and set aside. Stir the scallions, chili strips and olives into the pasta mixture. Pour pasta mixture into prepared pan and top with cheese. Bake at 300°f for 45 minutes, or until heated through and bubbly.

title: Beef and Tahini Marinade
ingredients: 1 tablespoon tahini paste | 1/2 cup beef stock | 1/2 teaspoon spicy mustard
instructions: Mix together, pour into jar, and refrigerate. Shake often for 20 minutes before using. Makes about 1/2 to 1 cup.

title: Mock Beef Rolls
ingredients: 175 g ground beef | 2 -3 green spring onions, finely chopped | 1 pinch white flour
instructions: Pre heat oven 230° celsius. Roll large patty tin size to about 5 to 8 cm thickness. Place 1 tsp of beef through base on a piece of greaseproof paper, roll up and place, top side down, on the paper, then roll the patty to seal the end.. Repeat with rest of the beef in the same manner, laying roll on paper. Cook in an oven for about 20 min, till browned but not burnt. Place on a warmed plate and cover with foil,. Re heat for about 10 min in 200° oven. Serve with a side salad.

Random Ingredients: pasta,chili paste,green olive,cream tartar,buckwheat flour,pork loin roast,nutmeg
title: Sauza
ingredients: 3 lbs boneless boneless pork loin roast | 1 cup buckwheat flour | 1 teaspoon cream of tartar | 2 teaspoons chili paste | 1 cup green olives or 1 cup other black olives | 1/2 teaspoon ground nutmeg
instructions: Place loin roast in large sealable plastic bag and add buckwheat flour, cream of tartar, chili paste, olives, pepper and ground nutmeg. Marinate in refrigerator 8 to 12 hours. Remove pork from bag and slice into 1/4 inch slices using a very sharp knife. Arrange pork slices in baking pan. Drizzle with remaining marinade. Cover loosely with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 6 hours, or until ready to cook. Preheat oven to 375°f. Bake covered for 1 hour or until meat thermometer registers 325°f for thickly sliced meat. Remove meat and cut across grain into 1/4 inch slices. Serve with pasta and salsa.

Random Ingredients: tofu,ro tel tomato,tomato green chilies,cottage cheese,orange juice concentrate,israeli couscous
title: Smooth Curried Tofu Israeli Style
ingredients: 1 package firm tofu, drained and pressed | 2 cans ro-tel tomatoes, drained and chopped ( 398 ml total weight ) | 10 ounces cottage cheese | 1/3 cup fresh orange juice concentrate, thawed | 1 cup r ( israeli ) rice, such as nishiki | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies
instructions: Cut tofu into cubes and arrange on baking sheet, pressing gently. Bake tofu in oven at 300°, stirring occasionally, 25 minutes. Transfer tofu to resealable plastic bag. Drain tomatoes. Heat ro tel in medium saucepan over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until hot. Drain cottage cheese and stir into tomato mixture with drained tofu, drained tomatoes, orange juice concentrate and rice. Transfer to a 9x13 baking dish. Pour contents of food processor into dish and sprinkle with diced tomatoes. Cover and bake 15 minutes or until heated through. Serve warm or chilled.

Random Ingredients: granny smith apple,dark soy sauce,mango chutney,cocoa powder,orange
title: Easy Chocolate Chutney Apple Dip
ingredients: 1 cup granny smith apple, chopped | 1/3 cup unsweetened cocoa powder | 1 teaspoon grated orange rind | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce | 2 tablespoons mango chutney
instructions: Combine apple, cocoa powder, orange rind and soy sauce. Spoon mixture into serving dish and top with mango chutney.

title: Grand Marnier Rice
ingredients: 1 cup rice, uncooked | 1/2 cup grand marnier
instructions: Cover rice with water and cook on high in a 3 quart saucepan until all the water has been absorbed. Lower temperature and simmer covered with a tight fitting lid until the water is absorbed and the rice has absorbed all the water. Serve warm or cold. Note, any cooked rice will give you some dry spots and irregularities.

Random Ingredients: radish,tangerine,flour tortilla,pine nut,flat leaf italian parsley,olive oil,cucumber
title: Chilli, Radish, Pine Nut and Tangerine Wraps
ingredients: 1/2 cup pine nuts | 1/2 cup chopped flat-leaf italian parsley | 8 radishes, trimmed | 2 cucumbers, halved, seeded and sliced | 1/2 cup tangerine, juiced | 20 flour tortillas, warmed | sliced fresh tangerine ( to garnish )
instructions: Combine the pine nuts with the parsley in a small bowl, stirring to thoroughly mix. Brush the tops of the tangerines with the tangerine juice, and sprinkle with the pine nut mixture. Wrap a tortilla with a piece of plastic wrap, enclosing the filling. Cut the wrap into 1/2 inch wide strips, and set aside. Bring 1/4 gallon of water to a boil in a skillet. As soon as water comes to a boil, add the tortillas.

title: Baked Eggs With Chips and Hard Boiled Eggs
ingredients: 1 hard-boiled egg | salad oil | pita chips
instructions: Peel the hard boiled egg and slice it into very thin half moons. Put the egg and hard boiled egg on a cookie sheet. Make sure that they are completely coated. Pour the salad oil over them, using all of them. Bake in a 400°f oven until the egg is cooked and slightly crispy on the outside. Serve immediately with the pita chips on the side.

title: Eggs in Olive Oil
ingredients: 6 large egg whites | 1/2 cup water chestnut | 1 cup kalamata olives, pitted
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Pour egg whites into a small saucepan of boiling water, and stir to form stiff peaks. Gently push the mixture down into the water with your fingers. Cook for about 30 seconds, then remove from water. Cut the eggs into four smaller, heart shaped wedges. To serve, place a few wedges in each serving pitcher. Melt just enough oil in a skillet over medium heat to coat the outside. Place stuffed egg wedges into the skillet.

title: Lettuce Wrapped in Pineapple and Tuna
ingredients: 2/3 cup pineapple tidbits | 1 1/2 tablespoons taco seasoning | 1 1/2 tablespoons kahlua ( optional ) or 1 1/2 tablespoons other coffee liqueur ( optional ) | 4 rolls | 4 tablespoons chopped fresh coriander | 3 large eggs, lightly beaten
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl and stir to combine. Serve in the rolls, top with coriander.

title: Roasted Green Poblano Peppers
ingredients: 4 poblano peppers | 1 tablespoon grapeseed oil | 4 tablespoons mustard powder | 1 tablespoon brandy ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 500 degrees f. Line a rimmed baking sheet with aluminum foil and spray with cooking spray. Wash the peppers and cut them in half lengthwise. Remove seeds and veins. Heat the grapeseed oil in a large ovenproof skillet over medium high heat until the oil shimmers, about 1 minute. Add the mustard powder and brandy and stir until the powder is evenly distributed. Add the peppers and turn them with tongs to coat thoroughly with the flavorings. Roast peppers in oven, turning occasionally and sprinkling with salt, until skins are charred and peppers have softened and started to brown in spots, about 1 hour. Remove from heat, uncover and let peppers rest for 10 minutes, before serving.

Random Ingredients: farfalle pasta,dark sesame oil,lentil,broth,baby green,pandan leaf
title: Lentils, Greens and Radish Soup
ingredients: 1 cup dried lentils or 1 cup green beans | 1 quart prepared broth | 1 cup small radish, chopped | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 3/4 cup thinly sliced fesh pandan leaves or 3/4 cup fresh curly leaf lettuce | 1/2 cup light wild sesame oil | extra dark sesame oil, for drizzling
instructions: Place the lentils in a soup pot with the broth. Bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce the heat to medium low and simmer for 20 to 30 minutes, or until the lentils are tender. Drain and discard the liquid, add the radishes, sesame oil and pandan, and stir well. Set aside. Serve the soup with plenty of extra sesame oil on the side for diners to drizzle a little as they eat.

title: Easy Easy Chicken Noodle Dinner
ingredients: 1 lb small penne pasta | 1 package taco and chili seasoning blend | 4 -6 cooked chicken ( or turkey )
instructions: Mix seasoning together. Pour seasoning over hot cooked pasta and toss. Serve with additional salsa or sour cream.

title: Fruit & Apricot Mash
ingredients: 3/4 cup dried apricot, chopped | 1/3 cup sweetcorn, chopped
instructions: Drain fruit & mix with sweetcorn to make a firm mash. Serve with grated cheese & hot biscuits.

Random Ingredients: red cabbage,red wine vinegar,lemon juice zest,mirin,tomato,milk chocolate,pineapple
title: Makoto With Pineapple and Red Cabbage
