ingredients: 4 large tomatoes, sliced | 6 slices red cabbage, separated into thin slices | 4 slices pineapple | 2 lemons, juice and zest of, fresh | 1/4 cup fresh milk chocolate, coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup red wine vinegar | 3 tablespoons mirin
instructions: Put the tomatoes, pineapple, and zest into a bowl and add the lemon juice and the vinegar. Toss well and set aside. Heat a griddle pan or frying pan over medium heat.

title: Easy Italian-French Dressing
ingredients: 1/4 cup prepared mustard | 1/4 cup prepared mustard | 1 teaspoon instant coffee granules | 1/4 teaspoon dried dill pickle slices or 1/4 teaspoon dill pickle slices | 1/4 teaspoon dry italian seasoning
instructions: In a small glass mixing bowl, combine the first five ingredients.

title: Furitas
ingredients: 2 lbs boned boneless lamb | 2 cups potato starch | 1 habanero pepper
instructions: Place lamb and habanero pepper in a baking dish. Mix potato starch with a little water, pour over meat and vegetables and sprinkle with more flour. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight. Preheat oven and bake for 2 hours. Turn meat and bake for 45 minutes.

Random Ingredients: beef tenderloin steak,tortilla,green pepper,yellow bell pepper,chickpea
title: Grilled Pepper and Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 2 tablespoons canned chickpeas | 1 1/4 lbs beef tenderloin steaks | 1 yellow bell pepper ( cut into thin strips ) | 1 green pepper ( cut into thin strips ) | 8 slices tortillas
instructions: Combine chick peas and pepper pieces in food safe bowl.

title: Quick and Easy Spiced Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cumin seed | 2 tablespoons butter, melted | 1 1/2 lbs hamburger | 1/3 cup sake | 1/4 cup lemon juice | 1 1/2 teaspoons tabasco sauce
instructions: Crush cumin seeds with a mortar and pestle. Stir in melted butter or margarine. Mix well. Shape mixture into 8 hamburger patties, 2 1/2 inches thick. Saute over low heat in a large nonstick skillet, turning once 5 minutes, until crisp. Drain on paper towels. Pour off all but 1 tablespoon fat from skillet. Stir in sake, lemon juice and tabasco. Cook over low heat, stirring, until alcohol evaporates. Serve with buns.

title: Easy Sausage Turkey Stuffing
ingredients: 1 lb hot italian sausage ( or use sweet breakfast sausage ) | 2 tablespoons fresh parsley ( or cilantro ) | 3 cans chicken ( or turkey broth ) | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1 teaspoon red chile
instructions: Brown sausage breaking up. Once cooked add parsley. Remove and drain sausage, then drain out any fat. Using the same pan on medium heat add broth. Chop pepper into bite sized pieces i like alot and add to the broth. Boil until liquid is reduced by half. Stir in pepper and chilies and turn down to simmer until heated through. Serve with crackers or bread.

Random Ingredients: basmati rice,beef bouillon cube,beef broth,edible flower
title: Egg Drop Soup
ingredients: 1 large beef bouillon cube ( like minor's ) | 1/2 cup basmati rice | 1 cup beef broth | 1 tablespoon fresh edible flowers, crushed ( optional )
instructions: Add bouillon cube to simmering water in saucepan.

Random Ingredients: picante sauce,lobster meat,brown onion,beef stew meat,french onion dip,lemongrass
title: Lobster Dip
ingredients: 1 pound cubed beef stew meat | 2 pounds cooked lobster meat | 2 jars french onion dip | 1 1/2 cups picante sauce | 2 tablespoons minced fresh lemongrass | 3 tablespoons thinly sliced brown onions ( optional )
instructions: Place cubed meat into a large pot and cover with 1 1/2 to 2 inches of water. Bring to a boil and then reduce the heat and simmer over low heat for 2 hours. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Open the cans of french onion dip and spread them in a 10x15 inch baking dish. In a medium bowl, stir together the onion dip, picante sauce, lemon grass, brown onions and reserved sauce. Pour the mix over the browned onions. Cover the dish with an aluminum foil or a lid secured with toothpicks. Bake in the preheated oven for 90 minutes. Remove the toothpicks, and bake for an additional 15 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: arborio rice,chicken thigh,canola oil,soya sauce,turmeric powder
title: Chicken With Rice
ingredients: 4 chicken thighs, boneless | 1 tablespoon canola oil | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1 teaspoon soya sauce | 1 cup arborio rice or 1 cup carnaroli rice
instructions: In a small bowl, mix soya sauce and turmeric powder and set aside. Rub oil on chicken and marinate over night in refrigerator. The following day, drain excess marinade from chicken. Boil stock, reduce to 1/2, and let it cool. Add rice to broth and bring liquid to boil. Add chicken and marinade to broth and bring back to boil. Cover with lid and cook for 20 minutes or until chicken is cooked and rice is tender.

title: French Style Sauerkraut - Bread Machine
ingredients: 1 whole wheat flour | 1 cup sauerkraut ( frozen or dried ) | 1/3 cup prepared mustard | 1 package yellow split peas
instructions: Combine all ingredients and process on the whole wheat bread setting. If needed, additional dry mustard can be mixed in with. Serve with vegetables of your choice.

title: Cashew and Bacon Tarts
ingredients: 4 slices sandwich bread, cut in half lengthwise | 1 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1/2 cup cashews, coarsely chopped | 8 slices bacon, cooked | 2 1/2 cups chicken stock or 2 1/2 cups canned low sodium broth
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Place 2 bread halves on a baking sheet. Brush tops with cream of tartar. In a mixing bowl, combine cashews, bacon, and 3 tbs. Of the chicken/broth mixture. Spread mixture evenly over one side of each bread half. Place the remaining bread halves on another baking sheet and top with cashew mixture. Bake for 14 minutes. Switch the oven on to broil and broil for another 10 minutes or until bread is golden. Serve warm.

title: Feuerto Rico Beans
ingredients: 1 lb navy beans, drained | 1 medium green pepper ( diced ) | 6 ounces gin | 1/2 ounce dried rosemary, crushed | 1 teaspoon sugar | 1 -2 banana ( sliced )
instructions: Cook beans according to directions on canner. Rinse beans under cold water and drain. In separate saucepan, add remaining ingredients.

Random Ingredients: venison,dill,acinus di pepe pasta,pasta,chicken bouillon cube,lebanese cucumber,penne
title: Beef Pasta & Noodle Soup
ingredients: 1 lb ground venison ( or any other combo of meats ) | 1 small lebanese cucumber, finely chopped | 8 cups penne, cooked & drained | 4 cups penne, cooked & drained ( can also use spaghetti or spaghetti ) | 16 ounces boneless skinless chicken breasts or 16 ounces boneless skinless chicken breasts, cut into small pieces | 1 chicken bouillon cube, with onion, salt, pepper & garlic in it ( or 2 tsp of chicken bullion mixed with | dill | 1 bunch fresh dill ( approx. to taste ) or 1 bunch fresh cilantro ( approx. to taste )
instructions: In a large soup pot, add the venison and the chopped cucumber and cook over medium heat until the venison has browned. Add the pasta, stir and cover. Let simmer for about 20 minutes. Add the chicken and dill to the soup pot and stir in the bouillon cube & the broth. Cover and let simmer 10 more minutes. Taste and adjust seasonings if necessary. Serve topped with dill or cilantro.

title: Cafe Rio Hot Chocolate
ingredients: 1 package ladyfingers ( savoiardi ) | 2 cans pinto beans, drained and reserved | 3 tablespoons coffee flavored liqueur | 6 ounces vegetable oil
instructions: Arrange savoiardi on a plate. Rinse and drain pinto beans and add to a small saucepan with 3 tablespoons of coffee liqueur and 3 ounces of oil. Bring to a boil, stir and cook until thickened and fragrant, about 1 - 2 minutes. Remove from heat and transfer into a warmed serving container. If desired, sprinkle with scallions and garnish with chopped cilantro.

title: Hot Italian Sausage With Mustard Seeds (Kisielagi)
ingredients: 1 lb hot italian sausage, casings removed | 2 teaspoons mustard seeds
instructions: In a large non stick frying pan, saute sausages in mustard seeds until browned on all sides, about 7 minutes. Remove sausage with a slotted spoon and place on paper towels to drain. Increase heat under pan. Poke sausages a few times with a fork and add them to the pan. Reduce heat and simmer, uncovered and stirring frequently, until the casings are browned and the mustard seeds are popping, 15 minutes.

title: Peruvian Quinoa Ice-Cream Cake - Yucatan
ingredients: 2 2 cups cake flour | 1 cup quinoa or 1 cup long grain rice | 1 cup white sugar | 2 teaspoons cumin powder or 2 teaspoons paprika | 3 cups milk
instructions: Heat the oven to 325°f. Put the cake flour into a bowl, stir in the rice and sugar, add the cumin, and mix until well blended. Beat the milk, mix with the dry ingredients. Pour the mixture into an oven dish and bake it for 40 minutes or until it is just starting to brown. Cool in the oven for 30 minutes. Turn it out onto a cutting board and cut in squares.

title: Champagne With Champagne
ingredients: 1/2 ounce dry champagne | 4 fluid ounces vodka | chambagne
instructions: Stir in sugar and serve.

title: Cashew Crunch
ingredients: 1 lb vegetable shortening | 1/2 cup icing sugar | 2 teaspoons beef bouillon ( or 2 tablespoons granules dissolved in a little water ) | 1 cup smooth cashews, roasted
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 f. Melt shortening and mix with sugar. Add beef bouillon and nuts and mix well. Drop by heaping t heaping tablespoons on the greased cookie sheet. Bake for 10 - 12 mins or until lightly browned. Enjoy as you would any biscuit.

Random Ingredients: kielbasa,sherry wine,ginger garlic paste,lemon juice zest,monterey jack cheese,quinoa
title: Quinoa and Kielbasa
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups quinoa | 14 1/2 ounces diced canned kielbasa | 2 teaspoons ginger-garlic paste | 3 tablespoons sherry wine | 1 teaspoon grated lemon juice ( from 1/2 lemon ) | 1/2 cup shredded monterey jack cheese
instructions: Place quinoa, kielbasa, ginger garlic paste, sherry and lemon juice in a 2 quart saucepan. Cover and over medium heat, cook for 5 minutes, or until heated through. Turn onto platter and sprinkle with cheese.

title: Grape Juice Beef Roll
ingredients: 1 cup fresh grape juice ( from about 6-7 grapes with juice ) | 10 ounces extra lean ground beef | 1/2 cup minced salami or 1/2 cup pepperoni | 1 tablespoon minced peeled fresh ginger root | 1/2 teaspoon ground turmeric powder | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala | 1 bunch watercress, chopped
instructions: Preheat grill for high heat and lightly oil grate. Squeeze the excess juice from the grapes with your hands, and place grapes in a bowl. Add the ground beef, salami, ginger, turmeric, garam masala, and watercress.

title: Pollo Con Chocolat (Mexican Hot Chicken)
ingredients: 1 whole rotisserie-cooked chicken, meat removed from the bones ( about 1 1/2 lbs ) | 1 dried red chile ( or 1 medium red jalapeno chile, seeded and finely chopped )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place chicken meat in a large roasting pan and set aside. Place chile in remaining 1/2 cup cold water. Cut chile into small pieces and place in blender. Add 1 cup cold water and blend until smooth. Repeat with remaining water and chile mixture. Transfer chile mixture to a large bowl and stir in the chicken. Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour. Stir well and arrange chicken on a rack in a baking dish. Bake for 30 to 45 minutes or until chicken is cooked through. Remove from oven and pour sauce over chicken.

title: Green Chili and Lime Grilled Chicken
ingredients: 3 boneless skinless chicken breasts | 3/4 cup cuervo tequila | 1 3/4 - 2 ounces chopped green chili ( such as jarred jalapenos ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons cayenne pepper
instructions: In a gallon freezer bag or a large crock, place the chicken breast, the cuervo tequila, green chili, cayenne pepper and 2 tablespoons of the cayenne pepper.

title: Holiday Noodles
ingredients: 8 ounces frozen egg noodles | 1 jar dried cherries
instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions, but not over salted. Drain well, and toss with cherries. Serve.

title: Homemade Pastry
ingredients: 3/4 cup all-purpose flour, sifted | 1 1/2 teaspoons chicken stock powder
instructions: Mix flour and chicken stock powder on top of a mixing bowl. Knead for about five minutes, adding the flour a tablespoon at a time. Roll on a floured surface into a sausage that is 3/4 inch thick. Cut sausage into 1/2 inch slices. Roll back and forth with your hands into a sausage shape, about 1 inch tall. Let rest for 15 minutes, then roll into a circle that is 2 to 3 inches in diameter from the edge and 3 to 4 inches in diameter. Repeat. Store in an airtight container or an air tight container.

title: Spicy Cajun Taco Salad
ingredients: 2 -3 tablespoons cooking oil | 1 tablespoon taco seasoning | 2 teaspoons chopped tarragon | 1 tablespoon marinara sauce | 1 tablespoon tequila
instructions: In a small skillet, heat oil over medium high heat. Add taco seasoning, marinara sauce and tequil. Stir well and heat until hot. Pour over salad as desired.

title: Rigatoni With Beans, Serrano Peppers and Beans
ingredients: 1/2 lb rigatoni pasta ( long tube shaped or tubular pasta ) | 2 cups cooked kidney beans | 3 -4 serrano peppers | black pepper
instructions: Cook pasta according to pkg. Directions. While it cooks heat 3 - 4 serrano peppers in oil over medium high heat till soft. Add pepper to taste. Drain pasta and return to pot. Mix peppers and beans together and spoon over the top. Serve.

title: Spanish-Mexican Chicken Bowl
ingredients: 1/2 lb boneless skinless chicken breast | 4 ounces dry brown lentils, rinsed and picked over | 1/2 cup salsa, verde
instructions: Cut chicken into bite sized chunks, about 1 inch wide and 1/8 thick. Cut into 2 inch chunks and dump in a bowl. Rinse the lentils and put in another bowl. Place all ingredients except salsa in another bowl. Taste and adjust seasoning before serving. Serve with spanish rice and fresh tortillas.

title: Steamed Lemons
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh lemons ( not the large type of zested ones, the ones sold in the asian aisle of your supermarket produce, like the ones pre-soaked in the asian aisle of your supermarket produce ) | 2 1/2 cups fish sauce | 2 tablespoons ground anise extract
instructions: Using a vegetable peeler remove outer layers of zest from lemons and cut a lengthwise slit down the length of each, without cutting all the way to the lemon. The lemons need to be completely covered with the citrus juice so as to keep them flat. Wash the lemons under cold water and dry thoroughly with lemon rinsing between paper towels. Place lemons in a large steamer over barely boiling water and steam, uncovered, stirring occasionally, until soft, 7 to 10 minutes. Using a slotted spoon or slotted spoon, transfer lemons, drained of all but 1 cup of the water, to a bowl. Wipe the steamer cap well from lemons with a brush. Bring 1 cup of the reserved juice to a simmer in a 5 to 6 quart pot. Add fish sauce and ground anise extract and simmer, undisturbed, until fish sauce is reduced by half, about 10 minutes. Stir in lemons and remove from heat. Season with salt and pepper, to taste. Cover and refrigerate until cold.

title: Curry Soup
ingredients: 1 can beef broth | 1/4 cup curry powder ( indian curry is a must imho as its quite a strong brand ) | 1/2 cup ice water ( or substitute water ) | pepper ( optional )
instructions: Add beef broth to a sauce pan or crockpot. Add curry powder, cook on low to medium heat until curry is fragrant, taking about 3 minutes, being careful not to scorch as it will turn bitter. Add ice water, pepper, if using. Remove from heat. Note, if using water reduce and stir until curry is well mixed through. Return to low heat once again and do not boil until all of the broth has been absorbed. You may also add more of the curry powder.

Random Ingredients: vanilla pudding mix,extra beef,tortilla,ginger garlic paste,flavor fruit jelly,chicken wing
title: Jerk Chicken Wings
ingredients: 1 package frozen meaty tortilla | 2 packages vanilla instant pudding mix | 1 lb extra lean ground beef | 2 teaspoons ginger-garlic paste | 2 lbs chicken wings, tips removed | 1 1/2 cups flavor-added fruit jelly
instructions: Thaw the tortillas overnight, drain and wrap each strip tightly in plastic wrap and refridgerate. Bring the contents to room minus 6 inches and put in bowl of a double broiler. Remove from oven and add the remaining ingredients. Mix thoroughly and set aside. Put the chicken wings in a steamer over the boiling water and allow to steam for an hour or more. You want the meat mixture to be frozen to be completely thawed but not frozen solid. Turn off the heat and take the chicken wings out of the broth. You are ready to serve them, or serve them as an entree along side a spicy style sauce.

title: Black  Mushroom and Asparagus Stir Fry
ingredients: 1 can whole black mushrooms | 4 corn on the cob, cut away from the cob and cut off the cob | 4 asparagus, peeled and cut in half | 2 cloves garlic, crushed
instructions: Heat a frypan on high and add asparagus and balsamic vinegar and stir fry until tender crisp. Allow to cool. Place drained mushrooms and asparagus on plate, top with black mushroom mixture. Serve with crusty bread and salad of your choice.

Random Ingredients: green capsicum,red enchilada sauce,purpose flour,heavy cream,cashew,peanut oil vegetable,madeira wine,pimiento
title: Enchilada Pasta Sauce (Sauce for Pasta)
ingredients: 30 g roasted peanuts | 50 g shelled cashews | 50 g green capsicum ( chopped and seeded ) | 25 g roasted red capsicum ( chopped and seeded ) | 30 g all-purpose flour | 1/2 cup heavy cream | 10 g dry madeira wine | 2 tablespoons hot red enchilada sauce
instructions: Toast nuts on a baking tray in an oven for 3 - 4 minutes. Place the cashews in a bowl and add 300ml boiling water. Leave aside. Boil the wine for 10 minutes and drain. Put all the sauce ingredients in a skillet and heat on a medium until the sauce boils. Simmer for 5 minutes. Drain the cashew cashews. Add 3t of cashew oil, chopped nuts and capsicum and stir well. Heat a frypan and add 3t of the sauce. Dip each pasta noodle in the sauce and deep fry until golden. Drain on clean kitchen paper towels. Repeat with other pasta. Serve immediately.

title: Crispy Fish Chips
ingredients: 4 white fish fillets | 2 hard-boiled eggs | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar, or as needed to cover
instructions: Place a fork in a piece of fish with a large pinch or two of chopped egg, and slide gently over the top of the egg to allow the egg to run underneath. The remaining eggs will help the crisp coating on top of the fish once cooked. Sprinkle with balsamic vinegar, and place the chips on a large, non stick frying pan or griddle over medium heat. Cook until golden brown and fish are hot, but not completely cooked through, about 4 to 6 minutes per side.

title: Grand Marnier Cream
ingredients: 250 g icing sugar | 100 g good quality icing sugar
instructions: Heat the oven to 180 c. Grease a 20cm springform tin. Line the base with parchment paper or baking baking paper. Sprinkle 1/2 icing sugar evenly over the base of the tin and dust with a little of the icing sugar before placing the tin in the oven. Cook for 35 - 40 minutes or until the mixture is bubbling and slightly browned. Leave to cool and set. Repeat with the remaining icing sugar, icing and filling. Spoon over the reserved icing and serve straight away.

title: Bergie's Halibut
ingredients: 2 celery ribs, cut into 1/2-inch slices | 1 1/2 lbs halibut fillets
instructions: Rinse the celery thoroughly and pat dry with paper towels. Place the celery in one layer onto a plate or shallow container and cover each slice with about 1/4 cup of the celery slices, tossing to coat with celery. Place 1 piece of the halibut onto a dinner plate or shallow container, placing remaining celery over the top. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate the halibut for 2 hours or overnight. Using a sharp knife, cut the halibut into 1/4 to 1/2 slices. Arrange on a platter and serve.

title: Farfalle (Chocolate Dessert)
ingredients: 1 package farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta, cooked and drained | 1 container milk chocolate | 1 package dill pickle spears, drained
instructions: Place the bow tie pasta and 3/4 cup of water in a large saucepan, and cook until the water is absorbed.

Random Ingredients: white vinegar,lebanese cucumber,head garlic,linguine,liquid smoke,puff pastry,pork loin,green bean
title: Beef Pasties
ingredients: 20 sheets puff pastry, thawed | 3 -6 ounces loin lean ground chuck | 1 lebanese cucumber ( about 24 small cucumbers ) | 6 tablespoons white vinegar | 2 tablespoons liquid smoke | 12 slices smoked pork loin ( thin slices ) | 7 ounces green beans, sliced into 1/4-inch pieces | 1 large head of garlic, blanched, peeled, and cut into thin rings
instructions: To make filling, in a non metallic bowl, gently mix together the pork loin, cucumber, vinegar, liquid smoke, and garlic, breaking into bits. Place the beef and pork mixture into a medium bowl and gently mix it inches do not over mix. Wash your hands and work the filling into the meat, and it should be moist but still crumbly. Wrap the pastry sheets in plastic wrap, dampen with water, and refrigerate until ready to use. Remove each sheet of pastry to a floured work surface, trimming to a thickness of about 1/4 inch and keeping the unused sheets covered with warm parchment. Roll out the dough lightly on a floured board to a 7x3 inch rectangle, about 6x8 inches. Spread the beef and pork filling evenly over the dough. Top with the green beans, slices of garlic and a thin ring of sliced onion. Starting with the long side, roll up the bottom pastry sheet to form a log about 12 inches long. Tuck the pastry over the filling, pressing gently. Cut the roll into 8 1/2 inch thick slices. Transfer the pasties to a parchment lined baking sheet, spacing them about 1 inch apart. Bake for 30 minutes or until the filling is hot, about 15 minutes.

title: Danish Beer
ingredients: 20 ounces lager ( dark beer ) | kosher salt | 5 roma tart apples | 1 cup dried cranberries | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1/2 teaspoon ground allspice | minced kosher salt | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh chervil
instructions: Put a beer mug in the freezer. Combine salt & top with a layer of apple zest. Place half of the apple zest in a blender & puree until smooth, blending till smooth of any lumps. Repeat with another layer of apple zest. Pour the puree into another large bowl. Using a spatula, press puree through the strainer lined with several layers of cheesecloth. Discard all solids except for chervil. Return beer to the beer mug. Add another layer of apples & cranberries, season with kosher salt & sprinkle top with chervil. Put back in the freezer for 4 hours or till thick & icy. You can put it back in the freezer for a day before serving to blend the flavors.

title: Sauced Chicken
ingredients: 8 chicken quarters or 8 chicken legs | 2 tablespoons ghee ( or clarified butter ) | 12 green beans, ends trimmed, cut into 6 inch lengths | 1/4 cup golden raisin
instructions: Brown chicken pieces in the butter or ghee until golden brown, about 10 to 15 minutes. Stir in the beans and raisins and remove from heat. Cover and place in the refrigerator to marinate at least 4 hours. Bring the pot of water to a boil and add the chicken pieces. Reduce heat to simmer and cook 20 minutes or until chicken is no longer pink and juices run clear.

Random Ingredients: olive,cherry tomato,part mozzarella cheese,flour,balsamic vinegar,dark chocolate,dark soy sauce
title: Omega's Famous Cherry Tomato Mozzarella
ingredients: 2 tablespoons olive oil | 1/4 cup flour | 2 pints cherry tomatoes, halved | 16 ounces shredded part-skim mozzarella cheese | 12 ounces dark chocolate pieces | 1 1/2 - 2 teaspoons balsamic vinegar | 2 teaspoons dark soy sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. In a heavy baking pan, heat 2 tablespoons oil over medium heat and cook cherries, covered, for 20 minutes. Meanwhile, in a medium saucepan over medium heat, stir together flour, mozzarella cheese and dark chocolate. Cook, stirring constantly, 4 minutes to blend. Stir in 3/4 teaspoon balsamic vinegar and 2/3 teaspoon soy sauce. Remove from heat and transfer to an oven proof bowl. Stir remaining balsamic vinegar, dark soy sauce, remaining 1/4 teaspoon balsamic vinegar and remaining 1/4 teaspoon balsamic vinegar into mozzarella cheese. Spread on top of tomato mixture. Bake uncovered for 35 minutes, stirring once or twice. Let stand for 10 minutes, then cool in pan.

title: Auntie Lori's Low Fat Low Calentara
ingredients: 1 lb red lentil, rinsed and picked over | 2 cans cannellini beans, drained | 2 large egg whites, lightly beaten
instructions: In a large soup pot, saute red rinsed and picked over lentils in a splash of olive oil until well browned, about 20 minutes. Add cannellini beans and bring to a boil. Reduce to a simmer, cover and cook for an hour. In a food processor or blender, whip together egg whites and some of the soup or milk.

title: Quick and Easy Slow Coated Beef Brisket
ingredients: 2 teaspoons vegetable oil, or as needed | 2 star anise pods, crushed | 1/4 cup vegetable oil, or as needed | 2 pounds beef brisket, trimmed and cut into 2-inch pieces | 2 fennel bulbs
instructions: Pour 2 teaspoon vegetable oil into a large resealable plastic bag. Add star anise pods. Seal bag.

title: Maraschino Refrigerator Fat-Free Refrigerator Buns
ingredients: 2 cups fat-free refried beans ( about 3 c., see note ) | 4 teaspoons fast rise yeast ( or envelope dry yeast ) | 1 maraschino cherry, for topping
instructions: Dissolve yeast in a little warm water. Mix in sugar and set aside. Dissolve refried beans in warm water and add to sugar/yeast mixture along with the maraschino and mix until very well blended. Cover and let rise until bubbly. Drop buns by tablespoonfuls onto greased baking sheet, flatten slightly and bake at 350 degrees for about 20 minutes. Note, this recipe doubles easily when chilled. Note, for breakfast, i use a 5 lb. Shallow container.

title: Chinese Sweet Chili Marinade
ingredients: 3/4 cup pineapple juice | 1/2 cup ketchup | 1 tablespoon lemon pepper | 2 tablespoons chili oil
instructions: Combine all ingredients.

Random Ingredients: broccoli rabe,black bean sauce,italian seasoning,globe eggplant,shortening,wonton skin
title: Beef & Eggplant Pot Stacks
ingredients: 2 globe eggplants | 1 lb lean ground beef or 1 lb turkey | 6 tablespoons shortening | 1 teaspoon italian seasoning | 20 -40 wonton skins | 6 cups fresh broccoli rabe, steamed ( about 6 cups ) | 1/2 cup black bean sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Trim each eggplant so it resembles regular eggplant. Slice eggplants lengthwise into 1 inch wide slabs, lengthwise. Cut each slab into 1/2 inch wide slabs, again lengthwise. Slice the strips into 1 inch wide slabs. Cut a slit in each eggplant slice through the top side of the slab, stopping about 1/2 inch each time to scrape out the tender pulp of the eggplant. Repeat until all 12 slices have been cut into 1 inch square rounds. Repeat procedure with remaining slices. Place beef or turkey in a large nonstick skillet or wok. Cook over medium high heat, stirring to break up meat. Cook until evenly browned. Add italian seasoning and stir to mix. Remove from heat. Place one or two squares of plastic wrap on a work surface. Place eggplant slices in center of wrap and place 1/2 cup of beef mixture on top of it. Cover with another square of plastic wrap, leaving one inch at the top. Flatten the center of the meat using a rolling pin. Cut a 3 inch slit in the center of the eggplant to remove the flesh. Continue creating a 1 inch slit, to open a hole in the center of the meat mixture. Repeat with remaining eggplant. Place 2 or 3 filled won ton wraps on a large baking sheet.

title: Chinese Crispy Birds
ingredients: 1 chicken
instructions: Cut chicken into pieces and then wash thoroughly. Remove the skin or any parts of the skin and bones from the chicken. Then pat dry with clean cloth or clean paper towels. Sprinkle all over with salt. Marinate in refrigerator for 12 hours. Bring to room temperature before cooking. Bake in a preheated 375f oven for about 40 minutes until brown.

Random Ingredients: xanthan gum,pasta,lemon juice zest,rice vinegar,radish,vanilla bean
title: Vegan Arrabiata
ingredients: 500 g pasta, rigati ( mini rigati ) | 1 lemon, juice and zest of | 1 vanilla bean | 6 small radishes, sliced thinly | 2 -3 teaspoons xanthan gum ( gluten-free ) | 1 teaspoon rice vinegar
instructions: Cook rigati in boiling water with zest a couple of minutes less than the package directions until it has softened. Drain well. Meanwhile combine the lemon, lemon juice and zest, vanilla bean, radishes, xanthan gum and vineger in a large bowl, stir thoroughly until well combined. Toss rigati with sauce. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: filet beef,lemon wedge,collard green,hot italian sausage
title: Italian Style Beef and Collard Greens
ingredients: 5 pounds filet of beef, diced | 4 links hot italian sausage, casings removed | 12 large leaves collard greens, coarsely chopped | 2 lemon wedges
instructions: Place beef, sausage, and collard greens in a large pot, and cover with water. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to medium low, and simmer for 90 minutes, stirring occasionally. Drain well. Place two pieces of the beef on each of four dinner plates, and top with croutons. Spoon some cooked meat mixture onto one side of the croutons, and roll the other side. Spoon any remaining meat onto a plate, and place plate on table on table for guests to help themselves.

Random Ingredients: active yeast,bamboo shoot,bulk italian sausage,baguette,black pepper,gin,swiss chard
title: Breadsticks With Sausage, Chard and Shredded Swiss Chard
ingredients: 12 cups swiss chard ( about 12 ounces ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons active dry yeast | 3/4 cup chilled smoked gin ( such as cabernet sauvignon ) | 3/4 lb bulk sweet italian sausage ( preferably turkey ) | 1/2 lb sliced bamboo shoot | 1/2 teaspoon fresh ground black pepper | 1 baguette, cut into 3/4-inch thick slices
instructions: Scrub chard leaves, trim coarse ends, cut chard leaves crosswise into 1/4 inch slices, then coarsely chop coarsely. Place chard leaves in a 2 quart bowl.

Random Ingredients: greek yogurt,corn kernel,floury potato,tomato basil oregano garlic,almond milk
title: Greek Corn Mash
ingredients: 6 ounces gram floury potatoes | 1 1/2 cups frozen corn kernels | 3 ounces reduced-fat greek yogurt | 1 ounce almond milk | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh tomato basil oregano ( or 4 teaspoons dried ) or 2 teaspoons dried oregano
instructions: Cook the potato in a large saucepan of boiling water, uncovered, until tender. Then drain and mash with the olive oil in a large bowl, adding milk, and season with salt. When well mixed add the yoghurt and then stir in the tomatoes, basil or oregano. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: irish cream,sunflower oil vegetable,pasta sauce,golden raisin,beef medallion,chipotle chile adobo
title: Smokey Beef Skillet
ingredients: 4 medium beef medallions | 1 cup pasta sauce ( your choice ) | 2 tablespoons chipotle chiles in adobo, minced | 1 1/2 cups sunflower oil or 1 1/2 cups vegetable oil | 1/2 cup golden raisin | 1/2 cup irish cream or 1/2 cup light rum ( approx )
instructions: Place beef medallions between plastic wrap and pound until 1 1/2 inch thick. Place each piece between wax paper and pound, using mallet or rolling pin lightly, until very thin. While the beef is pounding, combine sauce ingredients with wire wisk or cheesecloth. Place beef in the sauce. Cover tightly and marinate in a cool place at least 6 hours or overnight. Turn the beef and marinade once. Heat oil over high heat in a large skillet until almost smoking. Fry the coated beef until golden brown, turning once. Drain the beef well on a plate lined with paper towels. Serve.

Random Ingredients: corn cob,parsley leaf,green chili pepper,peanut,extra virgin olive oil,portabella mushroom
title: Portabella-Mushroom & Peanut Stir-fry
ingredients: 2 portabella mushrooms | 4 corn on the cob | 1 green chili pepper, deseeded | 1/2 cup peanuts | 1/2 cup finely chopped fresh parsley leaves | 2 -3 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Dice the mushrooms and corn and put into a large bowl. Cut the green chili pepper in half from top to bottom, place on top of the mushrooms, leave it on the cob to remove the seeds. Heat a small frying pan over medium. Add 1 tbsp butter and let it melt. Once butter has melted, carefully add the mushrooms and corn, fry for 4 - 5 minutes, stirring regularly until the corn starts to crisp up. Then, add the peanuts and let them cook in the oil for another 1 2minutes. Carefully pour onto the mushrooms and remove the green chilie. Stir to mix well, serve straight away. Enjoy.

title: Ginger Paste
ingredients: 4 cloves, peeled | 1/2 teaspoon minced fresh ginger root | 2 chicken bouillon cubes, or to taste
instructions: Place the whole cloves into a mortar with the ginger.

title: Garlicky French Bread
ingredients: 2 -3 tablespoons sea salt ( or salted sea salt ) | 1 orange peel, cut into thin slices ( or a combination of slices )
instructions: Put a sheet of parchment or waxed paper under it to catch fat. You can use foil to help it keep from sliming. In the event that you wish to use a paper towel, grease paper, lightly. Place a piece of orange peel in the paper on the dry surface. Sprinkle with the sea salt in 2 or 3 additions, moving it over the top of the peel as though you were sprinkling a little more of the salt onto the peel. Carefully lift up the parchment and, using your fingers, rub the salt all over the peel, leaving it a little chunky. Turn the paper round side up onto a clean surface. Cut the piece of orange peel in half and place on top of the parchment, pressing lightly. Sprinkle with the remaining salt. Cut with a serrated knife or other heavy knife.

Random Ingredients: green bell pepper,cabbage,green olive,tahini,monterey jack cheese,pork butt,confectioner sugar
title: Cheesy Pork Pot Candy
ingredients: 2 1/2 pounds lean pork butt, trimmed | 4 cups shredded cabbage | 1 cup shredded monterey jack cheese | 1 cup mayonnaise | 1 cup chopped green olives | 3 tablespoons tahini | 1 tablespoon confectioners'sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Place pork butt in a large skillet with 2 1/4 cups of cabbage, the cheese, mayonnaise, and 1/4 cup olives. Mix thoroughly with your hands. Place on a sheet of aluminum foil. Bake in preheated oven for 90 minutes, turning frequently. Remove from oven, and sprinkle with confectioner's sugar. Set aside until cool, about 20 minutes. Cut into 1 inch squares.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon,beef bouillon cube,ketchup,dark soy sauce,kidney bean,egg yolk
title: Baked Beans
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs dried kidney beans ( about 8 cups ) | 6 cups fat free ketchup or 6 cups tomato sauce | 2 teaspoons finely chopped dark soy sauce | 1 beef bouillon cube | 2 large egg yolks | 1 beef bouillon cube | 2 teaspoons finely chopped dark soy sauce | 1/2 cup ketchup or 1/2 cup tomato sauce | 1/2 cup ketchup or 1/2 cup tomato sauce | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon finely chopped dark soy sauce | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon finely chopped green onion ( to garnish ) or 1/8-1/4 teaspoon finely chopped green onion ( to garnish )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Combine all ingredients except ketchup, tomato sauce and 1/4 to 1/2 tsp soy sauce in a casserole dish. Cover and bake for 1 hour stirring occasionally. Uncover and bake an additional 45 minutes or until cooked through. Place cooked beans in a bowl. Combine ketchup, remaining 1/2 tsp soy sauce and the beef bouillon cube in the same pot and add to the beans and ketchup mixture. Pour over beans to coat. Sprinkle with the rest of the soy sauce and chopped green onion. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: vegetable stock chicken,pork baby back rib,almond extract,shortening,anise seed
title: Baby Back Ribs
ingredients: 1 3/4 - 2 3/4 lbs pork baby back ribs | 2 tablespoons vegetable stock or 2 tablespoons chicken stock | 1 tablespoon shortening | 1 teaspoon almond extract | 1 teaspoon anise seed, crushed
instructions: Preheat oven to 325f degrees. Cut ribs into individual ribs. In a bowl, mix together.  stock, almond or anise seeds.

title: Mexican Stuffed Cauliflower
ingredients: 1 package dried rice | 1 head cauliflower, trimmed and broken into florets | 1 can tomato paste | 1 - 1 1/2 cup shredded mexican blend cheese
instructions: Cook rice in water specified on package. Add cauliflower, cover and cook 10 minutes. Drain. Combine drained rice, tomato paste, and 1 1/2 to 2 cups of the shredded cheese. Stuff the cauliflower. Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Place stuffed cauliflower in 3 large covered baking pans, or large casseroles if you use them, and top with the remaining cheese. Bake, uncovered, for 45 minutes. Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Mango Chutney Beer Can Chicken
ingredients: 5 cups chicken stock | 1 cup mango chutney | 1 cup dark chocolate | 1/2 cup beer
instructions: In a large pot add the chicken stock and bring to boil. Turn the heat down and add the mango chutney and dark chocolate to the pot. Melt the beer and slowly pour into the pot. Turn heat back on when simmering. Cover with lid, turn heat back to low and continue to simmer till the liquid is almost gone. Let sit off the stove until the chutney is gone.

title: Quesadillas (Quesadillas)
ingredients: 2 flour tortillas, 8 to 10 slices | 1 hot red chili pepper, finely chopped or 1 teaspoon chopped seeded and deveined hot red pepper into chili powder
instructions: In medium skillet on medium high or 8 inch diameter nonstick griddle, toast tortillas on both sides until golden or about 3 to 5 minutes. Remove to a flat work surface. Spray hot nonstick cooking spray over pan. Toast chile in heated nonstick skillet until fragrant, about 1 minute. Stir or stir chile and chili powder. Transfer to plate. Toast warm tortillas 3 to 4 minutes on each side or until soft. Transfer to platter and slice into 4 large squares. Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Gandules and Vegetables
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs small asian broccoli cuts | 1 lb acorn squash, peeled and cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 8 cups mixed veggies, such as cucumbers, bell peppers, sweet red pepper, zucchini and cauliflower
instructions: Bring water to a boil in a dutch oven. Add squash and cook, uncovered, for 10 minutes. Add veggies, cover and remove from heat. Cover pot and let stand 15 minutes. Fluff and enjoy.

title: Lemon Smasing Salt
ingredients: 2/3 cup lemon flavored liquid smoke | 2/4 cup coarsely crushed unsalted butter
instructions: In a large glass or plastic bowl or clean tea towel, combine liquid smoke and butter. Mix well and add salt gradually, tossing a few times. Let mixture sit for 5 minutes. Break into small portions and store in an airtight container.

title: Aubergine and Aubergine Crisp
ingredients: 1 aubergine, cubed | 2 cups vegetable shortening | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil, for greasing
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Grease a 2 cup muffin tin with butter, or butter and sprinkle with flour. Sprinkle the cubed aubergines over the butter, add enough oil to cover. Set aside to marinate for 20 minutes. Bake for about 35 minutes in the preheated oven, until a toothpick inserted in center of a cube of bread comes out clean.

Random Ingredients: tofu,pork tenderloin,egg white,fenugreek seed,orange zest,cane sugar,baking powder,tea
title: Tofu Muffins
ingredients: 12 ounces firm tofu | 1 1/4 cups cane sugar | 1 1/4 cups orange zest | 1 1/4 cups dried fenugreek seeds | 6 ounces pork tenderloins | 1 tablespoon mild fire roasted mustard mustard | 1 egg white | 2 teaspoons baking powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Drain tofu of its excess liquid and press on paper towels. Chop tofu and set aside. In a food processor, pulse together the sugar, orange peel, fenugreek seeds and pork or meat tenderloins. Transfer pork/pear mixture to a large bowl and add the finely grated tofu. Stir in the mustard, egg white and baking powder. Pulse until well blended. Divide among 12 muffin cups. Sprinkle tops lightly with additional toasted and ground nuts and bake until lightly browned, 10 to 15 minutes. Cool in pan, remove, and cool completely on a wire rack.

Random Ingredients: red wine vinegar,lemon zest,onion,chili oil,pear,bulgur wheat,herbes de provence
title: Onion Tabbouleh
ingredients: 1/2 cup bulgur wheat, rinsed | 2 small onions | 3 pears | 1/2 cup red wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon herbes de provence | 1 teaspoon lemon zest | 1/4 teaspoon chili oil
instructions: Heat the oil over medium low heat in your electric skillet. Add the bulgur wheat and cook it, stirring constantly, until it becomes very mushy. Add the onion and pears. Mix them together with the bulgur wheat until no watery grains remain. Sprinkle in the herbs de provence, lemon zest, and chili oil. Toss until all ingredients are mixed in. Serve warm or at room temperature. Yield, 2 cups.

title: Kielbasa Toast
ingredients: 2 pints mayonnaise ( i use hellman's but they really are the healthiest choice. ) | 1/2 lb sliced kielbasa ( cut in 2-inch slices ) or 1/2 lb pancetta ( cut in 2-inch slices ) | 8 leaves lettuce ( torn in 2-inch pieces ) | 1 star anise, whole | 2 sprigs thyme sprigs | 1/2 lb butter | 1/2 cup dark rum ( such as jameson's ) | 1/2 cup chopped pecans
instructions: Combine mayonnaise and kielbasa and refrigerate for at least 1 hour. Heat butter or margarine in pan until just beginning to foam. Add rum and thyme and bring to a boil. Add kielbasa and lettuce stir to coat with the juice. Place in a shallow, warm dish and garnish the top with cheese. Serve or cover and refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Duck Breasts with Lemon
ingredients: 2 duck breasts | 1/2 cup fresh lemon rind, grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. In a plastic bag, pour in 1/2 lemon rind. Remove as many air as possible from the chicken. Wipe off excess chicken rind. Place chicken in roasting pan coated with cooking spray. Rub remaining 1/2 lemon rind around cavity of each breast. Sprinkle remaining 1/2 lemon juice over chicken. Roast in middle of preheated oven, for about 30 minutes or until thermometer reads 175f. Remove and let stand for 10 minutes, turning once.

Random Ingredients: onion soup mix,adobo sauce,date,flour,cheddar cheese,penne,grain rice
title: Arroz con Pollo (Crock Pot Spanish Rice
ingredients: 1 lb penne or 1 lb rotelle pasta | 4 cups cooked long-grain rice | 1 1/2 cups diced onions ( one large onion ) | 1/2 cup flour | 2 packages dry onion soup mix | adobo sauce, as needed | shredded cheddar cheese
instructions: Drain pasta and rinse under cold water to cool to a manageable consistency. You may have to do this at least in batches, i used two pans to the batch. Cook rice as preferred. Slice onion as thinly as possible and set aside. In a 5 - 7 quart crockpot brown rice in a small amount of oil, seasoning with adobo sauce as desired for extra flavor. Add onion and continue to cook on low for at least 3 hours. The end. Add 1 cup of cheese and stir through until melted. Cook pasta according to package directions. Combine cooked pasta with hot rice and remaining ingredients in a serving bowl. Mix together. Serve warm or cold.

title: Pasta With Kielbasa, Kielbasa and Pesto
ingredients: 2 cups pasta, i like whole wheat penne | 2 cups shredded mexican cheese | 3/4 lb kielbasa, cut into 1/4-inch slices and cut into 1/4-inch slices | 1/4 cup pine nuts, toasted | 1/4 - 1/2 cup finely chopped jalapeno
instructions: Fill a large pot of lightly salted water and bring to a boil on high heat. Add pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente. Drain. Toss pasta with 1 cup cheese and kielbasa.

Random Ingredients: nonstick cooking spray,vegetable broth,mozzarella ball,red capsicum,chipotle chile,espresso powder,mole
title: Mole and Chipotle Refresher
ingredients: 400 g instant espresso powder | 150 ml vegetable broth | 2 tablespoons ground chipotle chiles | 150 -200 g shredded low-fat mozzarella ball | mole | red capsicum, sliced thinly ( your choice ) | nonstick cooking spray
instructions: Stir 'ch' into espresso' and let cool for one minute. Stir through remaining ingredients and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: yellow squash,shiitake mushroom,syrup,lasagna noodle,italian sausage,oregano leaf
title: Italian Sausage and Veggies
ingredients: 1/2 lb italian sausage, links | 32 ounces mixed mushrooms, sliced | 1/2 cup miracle whip light | 1 package lasagna noodles | 1 cup yellow squash, sliced | 1 tablespoon dried oregano leaves
instructions: Heat oven to 375°f. Brown italian sausage links in oven until cooked through. Drain, remove sausage. Set aside. Add mushrooms, miracle whip, and dried oregano. Heat through. In a greased 9x9 pan, place 2 cups of the sausage mixture in the pan. Cover with 1 cup of uncooked yellow squash. Pour 1 cup of the sauce over the mixture and spread evenly, then repeat layers. Cover with foil, and bake for 45 minutes or so. Remove foil, and bake an additional 15 - 20 minutes or until sauce is bubbly and the squash is tender.

title: Spicy Cheese Dip
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds hot pepperjack cheese, cubed | 1 package taco seasoning | 12 ounces guacamole, warmed
instructions: Heat skillet over medium heat. Sprinkle pepperjack cheese over the bottom of the skillet. Sprinkle taco seasoning over the cheese. Spoon guacamole evenly over cheese. Cook about 2 minutes, or until slightly browned.

title: Saffron Saffron-Glazed Smoked Salmon from Morocco
ingredients: 8 cups vegetables bouillon | 1/2 cup saffron threads, roughly ground | 8 -10 small whole salmon | 24 ladyfingers, the kind with pith
instructions: In a large deep skillet, place the spices and saffron and bring to a boil. Add the warm water, cover and simmer for about 15 to 20 minutes or until the bouillon is syrupy and the saffron has melted. Preheat the broiler. Remove the skillet from the heat. Lift out the ladyfingers and dry them on a linen towel set over a bowl or cloth towel. Remove or blot gently with a paper towel and put 2 tbsp of saffron mixture along the bottom of each ladyfinger. Arrange the saffron side up over the tops of the fish and press to submerge. Arrange some ladyfingers in a circle around the fish, placing more saffron at the top of the fish and on top of the stuffing. Put the frying pan under the broiler for 3 to 4 minutes or until the tops of the fish are puffed and very slightly crisp. Slide a spatula underneath the fish and turn the fish over. Return to the broiler and quickly brown the top side. Remove the pan from the heat, cut the fish in 4 or 5 pieces. Pour the remaining saffron glaze over it, and serve hot.

title: Easy Cornbreadsticks
ingredients: 1 box cornbread mix | 1/2 teaspoon white sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. In a large bowl, mix together the cornbread mix, sugar, and white sugar until thoroughly combined. Shape into 2 inch balls, using wet fingers. Arrange on the prepared baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until crisp and lightly toasted, about 20 minutes. Cool on a wire rack. Use a metal spatula to roll the cooled cornbread sticks into pretzel shapes. Return to baking sheets and cool completely.

title: Applesauce Substitute
ingredients: 1 can kaffir lime leaves ( about 20 kaffir lime leaves or lime concentrate, not the bitter lily buds ) | 1 cup apple juice ( or use white grape juice )
instructions: Place the lime leaves in a blender with the apple juice. Puree until smooth. If the mixture is too thick, add a bit of apple juice. If it is too thin add a bit of water. Store in airtight container for up to two months.

title: Veal or Sausage Slighly with Mustard
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dry french mustard | 3 tablespoons crumbled pork sausage | 1 tablespoon garlic paste | 4 tablespoons reduced sodena keg keeg jaggery | 3 tablespoons dry grated palm sugar | 1 teaspoon vegetable ghee or 1 teaspoon butter | 1 1/2 lbs veal or 1 1/2 lbs sausage, sliced thinly
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together in a baggie and crush. Cut the meat into 2 strips about 5cm long. Heat the oil in a pan and fry the meat until browned. Pour in the wine and leave to simmer over a moderate heat until syrupy. Remove and keep warm. Add the remaining ingredients and simmer for an additional 20 minutes. Serve with salads and rice.

title: Yogurt With Chicken
ingredients: 4 chicken thighs or 4 chicken breasts | 2 cups natural yoghurt
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190°c/375°f place the chicken in a baking dish. Pour half of the yoghurt into a large jug. Mix well. Pour over the chicken, spreading evenly around. Cover with aluminium foil and bake for 1 1/2 hours until chicken is tender and juices run clear.

Random Ingredients: ketjap manis,tamari,plain nonfat yogurt,sirloin steak,baking soda
title: Asian Style Sirloin
ingredients: 1 lb boneless sirloin steak | 1 jar ketjap manis ( or soy sauce of choice ) | 1/4 cup low-fat plain nonfat yogurt or 1/4 cup reduced fat yogurt | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 1 teaspoon ketchup or 1 teaspoon soy sauce
instructions: Slice meat into very thin slices and place in a medium sized casserole dish with 1/4 cup ketchup. Mix the baking soda, baking powder and marinade and pour over meat. Cover pan with plastic wrap and bake at 350 degrees f for 45 minutes. Mix together the yogurt with a large spoon, check for salt.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon cube,hot chili sauce,raspberry,baby spinach,quinoa
title: Tortilla Triangles
ingredients: 5 cups baby spinach, washed and drained | 4 cups quinoa | 4 teaspoons instant chicken bouillon cube | 1 teaspoon hot chili sauce | 3/4 cup raspberries or 3/4 cup orange juice
instructions: Combine together quinoa, chicken bouillon, and hot pepper sauce in a large bowl. Stir in the raspberries or orange juice. Add the spinach mixture. Chill for at least 1 hour. Roll into 1/4 inch balls, wrap in plastic wrap, and freeze or refrigerate until solid.

title: Pasta Primavera Salad
ingredients: 5 ounces extra firm tofu | 10 ounces extra firm tofu | 12 ounces rigatoni pasta | fresh baby, dressed with | italian dressing
instructions: Slice the extra firm tofu into very thin slices. Rinse rigatoni in warm water, drain and then cook, in salted water until tender. Meanwhile, spray the oven or broiler rack with a non stick spray and preheat barbecue or grill. Place the extra firm, silky tofu on a cutting board with the ends of the tofu facing you. Take the slices of tofu out of the plastic and cut into thin strips. Cut the extra firm tofu into thin slice sticks if it is exceptionally large and about 1 inch across. Put 1/2 cup of dressing in a large bowl and toss with the pasta. Next, pile the pasta with the green olives and tofu into the bowl with the dressing. Gently toss the remaining dressing into the salad. Cook the pasta in plenty of rapidly boiling water until tender, this only takes about 10 minutes for the pasta, which should be al dente. Drain, add to the salad and mix well. Season with pepper and italian seasoning.

title: Capers and Poisines
ingredients: 1 jar seedless pitted prunes, drained | 1 package napa-piri-piri chat masala | 1/2 cup drained capers
instructions: Combine all ingredients together. Place in sterilized jars. Seal, and store at least a week before using.

Random Ingredients: white bean,red curry paste,pecorino cheese,tortilla chip,vinegar,sea salt,cream mushroom soup
title: Chunky White Bean Dip
ingredients: 1 can white beans, drained and rinsed | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 tablespoon red curry paste | 1 tablespoon vinegar | 1 1/2 cups grated pecorino cheese | 1/3 cup tortilla chips, or as needed | sea salt to taste
instructions: Process the white beans, cream of mushroom soup, red curry paste, and vinegar together in a blender in batches until chunky. Stir 1 cup of cheese, tortilla chips, and sea salt into the chunky bean mixture. Serve warm with tortilla chips.

Random Ingredients: spinach,salt pepper,ham hock,italian sausage,golden caster sugar,canadian bacon,mustard powder,chili sauce
title: Spinach With Chilli Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 lb cooked ham hock | 1/2 lb ground italian sausage | 1/3 cup canadian bacon, finely choped | 1 1/2 cups spinach, fresh | 1 teaspoon mustard powder | 1 tablespoon golden caster sugar or 1 tablespoon brown sugar | 2 tablespoons sweet chili sauce | salt and pepper
instructions: Fry the ham hock, sausage and bacon and remove from the pan. Brown the beans and drain fat. Add to the beans the rest of the ingredients and mix. Pour the mixture into a shallow oven proof dish. Bake at 325 for 30 mins covered. Uncover for a few mins and bake the rest of the way.

title: Coconut Potatoes
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cooking oil | 1 lb red cabbage, shredded | 1/2 cup dried apricot, finely chopped | 2 lbs yellow potatoes, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1/2 cup sweetened flaked coconut | 3 tablespoons coconut rum, may be substituted for the apricot rum may be substituted for the coconut rum
instructions: In a large skillet, heat oil over medium heat. Add cabbage and apricots.

title: Aji - Meat and Cheese
ingredients: 1 kg lean lamb or 1 kg buffalo | 1 liter watermelon | 1 kg winter squash | 1 ripe plum tomato | 2 cups water | 60 g roasted cashews | 1 tablespoon chocolate syrup ( optional ) | 80 g enchilada sauce ( optional )
instructions: Wash your lamb or buffalo, and chop it to bite size. Mix your marinade ingredients in a large pot and bring to simmer until everything is soft.. Meanwhile, mix everything together in a big bowl. Once meat has simmered for 1 hour, check if it's ready and turn it over. When you're happy with how it is, stir in your sauces. If it's too liquidy, let it sit off the heat for a few minutes to cool before removing from the heat, and you're done.

title: Turnip Soup
ingredients: 2 stalks celery, julienned | 1 turnip, julienned | 5 tablespoons oyster sauce | 5 tablespoons prepared mustard | 1/4 cup chili paste | 6 flour tortillas, cut into 1 inch long strips, or as needed
instructions: Mix celery and turnip together in a bowl. Whisk oyster sauce, mustard, and chili paste together in a separate bowl. Pour oyster sauce marinade over turnip in the bowl.

Random Ingredients: part mozzarella cheese,phyllo pastry,hot water,roquefort cheese,cream cheese,carrot
title: Quick Cheese and Carrot Phyllo Rolls
ingredients: 12 phyllo pastry sheets ( each phyllo sheet is approximately 9x12 inch ) | 4 medium carrots, finely grated | 2 packages cream cheese, room temperature | 8 ounces roquefort cheese or 8 ounces ricotta cheese | 1 cup hot water | 1 1/2 lbs part-skim mozzarella cheese or 1 1/2 lbs swiss cheese
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the carrot, cream cheese and roquefort cheese. Stir in hot water, just until the carrot is melted. Preheat the oven to 375°f. Working with one sheet per sheet, brush it lightly with melted mixture on one side and the other. Repeat until the two sheets are layered. Place one sheet on a board and lay it on top of the other. Sprinkle generously with mozarella or swiss cheese. Sprinkle the top with mozarella or swiss cheese. Repeat until all the ingredients are used, finishing with one sheet of phyllo. Cut the top sheet of phyllo in half and cut each half diagonally. Fold and make a half moon roll. Repeat with remaining sheets and half the filling. Bake the rolls for approximately 45 minutes to an hour or until golden brown.

title: Nuts and Bolillos (Mongo Pansy)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cayenne, or more to taste | 1 tablespoon flaked coconut oil | 1 tablespoon chimichurri-anise liqueur, such as tarragon | 2 tablespoons basil pesto | 1 tablespoon mexican-style minced onion | 1 tablespoon chopped red cabbage, or more as desired | 1 teaspoon ground anise | 1/2 teaspoon chopped tarragon | 3 leaves cabbage, shredded
instructions: Stir cayenne pepper, coconut oil, chimichurri anise, pesto, mexican style minced onion, red cabbage, and tarragon together in a small bowl. Allow mixture to stand 1 hour or more to allow flavors to blend.

title: Grilled Sweet Corn
ingredients: 1 can corn | 1 fluid ounce pineapple juice
instructions: Cut corn kernels off the cob. Place the corn, pineapple juice and salt in a grill pan and grill for 10 - 15 minutes, turning occasionally, until cooked through. Serve warm.

title: Scottish Royalty Mincemeat
ingredients: 2 lbs beef stew meat or 2 lbs other lean beef | 1 cup rolled oats | 3/4 cup icing sugar | ice
instructions: Put meat in large pot and cover with cold water. Bring to rapid boil until tender. Remove from heat, and skim off any foam. Cool to blood pressure, and refrigerate overnight. After meat has cooled, strain. Save meat liquid through a fine sieve or colander lined with cheesecloth into a bowl. Squeeze all of the liquid into a clean container. Add the oats, icing sugar, and enough cold water to cover the mincemeat. Mix well. It should be of paste like consistency that sticks to the mash when stirred well. Add more cold water to thin if necessary. Shape into patties and fry in butter over moderate heat until browned on all sides. Serve hot.

title: A Fantastic American Mac and Cheese
ingredients: 3 lbs hamburger | 1 cup catsup ( not catsup, this has to be sweet ) | 4 cups elbow macaroni | 1/4 cup of grated orange peel | 2 tablespoons fennel seeds | 1/2 - 3/4 cup strong coffee | 1/4 cup grated provolone cheese
instructions: Brown hamburger meat and set aside. Fried noodles and spread out in 9x9 greased pan. Sprinkle with cheese first, then hamburger. Mix well. Pour coffee on top. Top with noodles. Bake at 400°f for about 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: no salt corn,semolina,seasoning salt,sauerkraut,pink grapefruit juice,thyme,chuck roast,onion
title: Sharon's Sauerkraut and Corn on the Barbecue
ingredients: 3 lbs chuck roast | 5 -6 quarts semolina | 1 1/2 cups no-salt-added corn | 1 1/2 cups fresh pink grapefruit juice | 1 large onion, diced | 1 1/2 tablespoons fresh minced thyme | 2 tablespoons seasoning salt | 1 1/2 quarts sauerkraut ( drained )
instructions: Trim all visible, excess fat, and dark brown bits from the roast. Slice the roast and place in a 5 qt crock pot. Combine the rest of the ingredients in a bowl or food processor and mix well over the roast. Turn the roast over in the crock pot, and pour the juice over the roast. Add the salt and pepper, if desired. Cover and cook on high heat for 4 hours, checking after 4 hours to see if the liquid has reduced. Remove from heat, stir gently and serve over noodles, rice, or with boiled potatoes.

Random Ingredients: cocoa powder,garlic granule,dark soy sauce,lemon juice zest,eggplant,granny smith apple,manchego cheese,soymilk
title: Apple Cheese Manchego Gratin
ingredients: 3 large granny smith apples | 1 garlic granules | 1 lemon, juice and zest of | 2 teaspoons garlic granules | 15 ounces manchego cheese, grated fine | 1/2 cup soy milk | 2 -3 tablespoons cocoa powder | 2 tablespoons dark soy sauce ( kecap manis ) | 1 cup light soymilk
instructions: Slice off a small piece of the bottom and then stud it with a few slices of granny smith each of the same size. Slice off the top and most of the base of the gratin. Wash, peel and core the apples, cut them into 1/4 slices, remove any core bits. Mince the garlic and combine it with the grated cheese. In a small bowl mix all other ingredients with grated cheese and milk into a smooth paste. Layer the gratin into a greased casserole dish and top with the cheese paste. Place the rest of the bruschetta ingredients on top of cheese mixture and bake in a 375 degree oven until the bruschetta bread is brown and bubbly.

title: Fried Rice With Sweet Corn and Grape
ingredients: 2 cinnamon sticks | 2/3 cup rice ( not instant ) | 2/3 cup grape, seedless variety ( seedless arabic ) | 1/3 cup corn, kernels ( fresh kernels cut off corn cobb ) | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla bean, seeds scraped out | 1 tablespoon chili oil | 2 teaspoons breadcrumbs ( or bread crumpled )
instructions: In a large pot bring rice, grape seeds and seeds, corn and vanilla bean seeds to a boil. Cook the rice covered till translucent, about 10 minutes. Add chile oil and mix well. Cover and let it boil for one minute. Remove the lid and put the lid back on and cover. Let it cook till the rice is almost translucent. It will crackle immediately. This will take between 5 - 20 minutes on medium heat. Remove from heat and let it sit covered for 15 - 20 minutes. Fluff with a fork.. Serve warm topped with plain crackers. Note i like to dice up some sweet corn kernels and get them fried with some chopped up strawberries. This is also great with a little olive oil and a sprig of fresh mint.

title: Spinach on Rye and Smoked Sandwiches
ingredients: 2 tablespoons fresh baby spinach, sliced | 6 tablespoons light rye bread, buttered
instructions: Toast 2 - 3 tablespoons of the bread, cut in half, and then use a teaspoon to squeeze out excess water. Spread each of the other halves with a tablespoon of the spinach. Slightly warm both halves of the bread, and put on the same sandwich. Remove the sandwich and cut into 5 pieces.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon granule,baking soda,yeast cake,golden raisin,white mushroom,sage,jalapeno
title: Johnny Cakes
ingredients: 3 1/2 cups strong white mushrooms | 1 cup golden raisins | 1 teaspoon dried rosemary | 1 teaspoon ground sage | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 1 1/2 teaspoons instant yeast cakes | 1 teaspoon instant beef bouillon granules
instructions: Place mushrooms, raisins, rosemary, sage, baking soda, yeast cakes, bouillon, and enough water to make a soft dough. Divide into 6 equal portions. Put two portions of dough on each of the 8 pans. Mix together and press a piece of dough to fit onto each pan. Let rise until doubled, 20 minutes. Bake at 400 degrees f for 40 minutes.

title: Poblano Chiles a la Huanchaina
ingredients: 4 poblano chiles | 1/2 cup purple onion, minced | 500 g ground lamb | 120 g ham, coarsely grated
instructions: Bring 3 cups of water to a boil and add the poblano chilis. Boil for 1 minute and then drain. Chop the chilis and place in a strainer over a bowl. Stir in the onion and garlic and then drain the water out. Add the lamb and gently mix together with your hands. Place the mixture on a sheet of heavy foil on a solid platter. Roll it up, starting on the sides and place the foil on top. Refrigerate for 30 minutes. Unwrap and cut the ham in 1 cm cubes. Heat about a 1 tblsp olive oil in a large skillet, and saute the poblano onion. Remove from heat and stir in the bacon and crumbled ham. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: caster sugar,white wine vinegar,black eyed pea,spanish onion,rigatoni pasta,coconut
title: Pasta With Black-Eyed Peas Salad
ingredients: 1 large spanish onion, chopped | 1 cup cooked black-eyed peas | 2 1/2 cups cooked rigatoni pasta | 1/4 cup white wine vinegar | 3 tablespoons caster sugar | 3 tablespoons desiccated coconut
instructions: Cook rigatoni as directed. Combine remaining ingredients. Add to rigatoni.

title: Auntie Theresa's Easy Fruit Couscous and Sauerkraut
ingredients: 1/2 - 1 cup sauerkraut ( not supermarket stuff ) | 1 cup couscous ( i prefer white pearl wheat ) | 1/2 cup fruit, chopped ( any combination of fresh, dried fruits are fine )
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. You may wish to use more or less sauerkraut depending on what kind of ingredients you are using. Serve over couscous and enjoy. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: tamarind juice,cake flour,lasagna noodle,thai rice noodle,bulgar wheat,salmon fillet,turkey breast,fennel bulb
title: Fennel Rice Noodle Sandwich
ingredients: 4 cups cooked lasagna noodles ( about 24 sheets ) | 1 cup bulgar wheat ( cracked wheat ) | 1/4 cup dried shucked turkish-style fish flakes ( available in asian grocery stores ) | 1/2 cup dried shrimp ( available in asian grocery stores ) | 2 large fennel bulbs, julienned | 3 tablespoons sesame oil or 3 tablespoons tamarind juice | 1 cup cooked turkey breast, thinly sliced | 12 thin slices thin-sliced salmon fillets ( available in asian grocery stores )
instructions: Cook lasagna noodles according to package directions, omitting any oil. Drain noodles and place in a large bowl. Add bulgar and turkish shrimp. Toss to coat well. Toss with fennel, sesame oil and tomato. Arrange strips of turkey over noodles to cover. Top with noodles and spread with salad dressing. Garnish with thin strips of salmon. Cover and refrigerate several hours or overnight to combine flavors.

title: Quick & Easy Carrot Sauce
ingredients: 3 large carrots, peeled & grated | 1 cup tomato juice, your preferred
instructions: Put grated carrots in a medium saucepan, add tomato juice & water. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat& simmer for 15 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Lettuce Salad
ingredients: 1 head lettuce, large leaves separated | 1 teaspoon pure vanilla extract | 8 tablespoons parsley, coarsely ground | 2 ounces dark sesame oil
instructions: In a small shallow dish, mix the vanilla& parsley. In another small dish, mix together 4 tablespoons of sesame oil, 2 ozs sugar and 1/2 teaspoon of salt. Slice the lettuce into thin strips. On a plate or platter, drizzle a few teaspoons of sesame oil on the bottom of the lettuce, followed by half the sesame oil mixture& finally half the sugar mixture. Top with remaining leaves or salad greens. Drizzle remaining sesame oil& sugar to taste. Chill before serving.

Random Ingredients: white fish fillet,pearl barley,tomato juice,spinach leaf,hard egg,stout beer,sirloin steak
title: Beef and Barley Soup (BBQ)
ingredients: 16 ounces stewed tomatoes with juice | 16 ounces steak, sliced thinly | 16 ounces white fish fillets, cut into cubes | 8 ounces pints raw pearl barley | 1 cup fresh spinach leaves | 3 hard-boiled eggs, sliced | 16 ounces stout beer
instructions: Cook and stir tomatoes and their juices, steak, and pearl barley in a large pot over medium heat in just enough water to just cover the barley and tomato mixture. Bring to a simmer, then cook, stirring occasionally until barley begins to soften, about 20 minutes. Add spinach, and boil until cooked through, about 5 minutes, then stir in eggs, and beer. Cook 2 to 3 more minutes.

title: Artichoke Dessert Bake
ingredients: 1 package rotini pasta or ( 16 ounce ) package bow tie pasta, cooked and drained | 1 can artichoke hearts, drained, marinated, chilled and drained, reserving 8 tablespoons marinade | 1/2 cup marshmallows or 1/2 cup other decorative candies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Pour pasta into greased 2 quart baking dish. Arrange artichokes around the edge of the pasta leaving some space between the artichokes. Sprinkle with reserved marinade and sprinkle with marshmallows. Bake 45 - 60 minutes or until top is golden and bubbly. Serve warm.

title: Ginger Beefballs
ingredients: 5 lbs fresh italian-style meatballs | basil leaves | 2 inches gingerroot, grated | 1 tablespoon baking soda
instructions: Combine the meatball crumbs, basil leaves and grated ginger in a bowl. Make an indentation in the center of the mixture and insert a meatball. Drop the meatball into a large quantity of rapidly boiling water. Boil rapidly until meatballs float to the surface. Remove and drain. Use as desired.

Random Ingredients: salmon,green lentil,pasta shell,german chocolate cake mix,pea
title: German Chocolate Split Salmon & Lentils in Pasta
ingredients: 1 package german chocolate cake mix | 4 ounces salmon, chopped | 1/4 cup green lentil, cooked | 1/2 cup cooked tiny peas | 1 can canned salmon, sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Spray large casserole dish with nonstick cooking spray. Combine cake mix, sliced salmon, and lentils. Spread evenly in dish. Top with tiny peas and canned salmon.

Random Ingredients: poppy seed,salad oil,tomatillo salsa,iceberg lettuce,mushroom,cream mushroom soup
title: Cheater's Mexi Salad
ingredients: 2 cups shredded iceberg lettuce | 3/4 lb fresh mushrooms, sliced | 6 ounces cream of mushroom soup | 4 tablespoons salad oil | 1 jar tomatillo salsa | 1/3 cup poppy seed
instructions: In large bowl, combine lettuce, mushrooms, soup, oil, salsa and poppy seeds. Chill several hours.

title: Black-Eyed Pea Hotwater Remedy
ingredients: 1 cup black-eyed peas ( fresh or frozen ) | 2 tablespoons finely chopped onions and 1/2 teaspoon finely grated gingerroot | 1 1/2 - 2 cups hot tea ( or 7 cups hot water, just not boiling ) | 1/2 teaspoon onion powder
instructions: Place peas in a 1 quart glass crockpot. Mix the rest of the ingredients together. Pour over the peas. Cover and cook on low for 8 to 9 hours. If you want a thinner gravy, thicken with 2 to 3 tablespoons of water and 1/2 teaspoon of onion powder dissolved in it. Serve warm or chilled.

title: Tofu With Chipotle Croutons (Arrosto Di Cacei)
ingredients: 16 ounces extra-soft tofu | 4 slices chipotle chiles ( thin ) | 6 slices prosciutto | 4 tablespoons semolina | 1 tablespoon gingerroot ( finely grated ) | 1/4 teaspoon orange zest ( finely grated ) | 1/4 cup cabbage ( shredded cabbage )
instructions: Drain tofu and place on plate. Mix chipotles in with 1/4 cup water and bring to boil. Dip each slice of tofu in chipotles, coating each side. Fry each slice of tofu over medium heat 3 - 4 minutes, flipping once. Remove tofu and place on plate lined with paper towels to absorb excess oil. Wrap prosciutto around each slice, securing with a toothpick to hold them together. Sprinkle with grated ginger and orange zest and serve immediately.

title: Quick and Easy Queso Dip
ingredients: 3 1/2 pounds roast beef brisket | 3 avocados - halved, pitted, and peeled | 1 1/2 cups half-and-half, or as needed | 1 1/2 cups tahini, or as needed | 1 1/2 cups kahlua ( dark mexican coffee liqueur ) | 3 jalapeno chile peppers, halved lengthwise and seeded
instructions: Place brisket in a shallow pan. Drizzle with olive oil and season with salt and pepper. Place pan over medium high heat, and sear brisket on the outside using tongs. When the meat reaches 160 degrees f, or reach 185 degrees f on a meat thermometer, about 2 hours. When cool enough to handle, cut from the bones, shred, and set aside. Pour half and half and tahini into a saucepan. Slice the avocados into 1/2 inch pieces and drop into the saucepan with the half and half. Stir until incorporated, adding more half and half or tahini as needed to make an smooth consistency. Season with salt and pepper. Simmer until heated through. Place chopped beef back into the saucepan, and fill with remaining half and half. Stir until incorporated. Cover and refrigerate until flavors meld, at least 2 hours, and as long as overnight. When serving, garnish with chopped avocado.

title: Cheese Ball
ingredients: 2 lbs velveeta cheese | 2 slices bacon | 1 bunch fresh basil
instructions: Put the bacon in a frying pan. Sear it for a couple of minutes, then throw in the cheese and fry until it's melted and the outside starts to dry out. Put in a big bowl, take the bacon bits out, and put them over the cheese in the bowl. Add the basil, and then put in the velveeta about 2/3 full, stirring the cheese until it starts to melt. Put in the oven for 20 minutes at 400 degrees, and serve warm.

title: Mexican Kale Salad
ingredients: 4 cups coarsely chopped kale ( about 6 bunches ) | 1 tablespoon cilantro and bottled lime juice ( about 4 limes ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons garlic powder or 1 1/2 teaspoons garlic powder | 1/2 teaspoon dry sherry ( optional ) or 1/2 teaspoon port wine ( optional )
instructions: Combine kale, cilantro/lime juice, garlic powder and sherry in a medium serving bowl. Toss to blend well. Cover and chill for at least 2 hours. Serve at room temperature with chips or as a side salad with grilled seafood.

Random Ingredients: celery seed,egg yolk,vegetable stock,filet beef,pizza sauce,seasoning,spring water,apple
title: Beef and Apple Stir-fry
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vegetable stock | 1 shallot, finely chopped | 2 teaspoons celery seed | 200 g beef rump, trimmed of all fat and sinew | 2 spring onions, sliced into 2 cm lengths | 2 fresh apples, peeled, cored, thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons pizza sauce, of your choice | 1 tablespoon fresh egg yolk
instructions: Combine stock, shallot, celery seed, and beef in a pan over medium heat. Turn to high heat and bring to the boil. Reduce heat to low, cover and simmer for 20 minutes. Remove beef, cover and continue to simmer until almost tender, for about 20 minutes or until most of the liquid has evaporated and beef is very tender. Remove from heat. Add spring onions to pan. Cover and simmer until tender, about 5 minutes. Return beef and any accumulated juices to pan. Stir in apple and pizza sauce. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Cook until heated through.

Random Ingredients: scallion,bulk pork sausage,phyllo pastry,italian tomato,green bean,chicken breast
title: Creamy Italian Chicken and Shredded Sausage Rolls
ingredients: 16 ounces bulk pork sausage | 8 ounces green beans, thawed | 1 can italian-style diced tomatoes, drained | 2 scallions, thinly sliced | 1 1/2 cups shredded cooked chicken breasts | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh italian-style tomatoes ( for extra flavor ) | 10 sheets phyllo pastry
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Place sausage in a large skillet. Cook over medium high heat until evenly brown. Drain. Combine sausage with remaining ingredients except phyllo. Divide sausage mixture among pastry sheets. Wrap phyllo sheets lengthwise to form 10 squares. Place 2 triangles of sausage mixture in center of each pastry square. Fold opposite corners of pastry over the sausage mixture, then fold each corner into a triangle.

title: Easy Breakfast Wraps
ingredients: 10 ounces cheese tortellini | 12 ounces firm tofu, drained | 1/2 cup golden raisin | 1 pinch saffron | 1 egg white, beaten
instructions: Cook tortellini according to package directions, or, if using other ingredients, cook in large pot of salted boiling water for 8 to 10 minutes. Reserve 2 tablespoons of the pasta cooking water. Meanwhile, combine tofu, raisins, saffron and reserved cooking water in a mixing bowl. Cut tofu into 1 inch cubes. Stir egg white into tofu mixture. Fold tofu mixture into tortellini. Divide among tortellini shells or tortellini cups. Serve warm.

title: Pinchudaprika Powder
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon sweet hungarian paprika | 1/4 teaspoon baking soda | 1 yellow bell pepper, seeded and minced
instructions: Combine paprika, baking soda, and bell pepper in a small bowl. Let stand 2 to 3 minutes. Stir in paprika mixture until completely coated with spiced oil.

title: Lemonade Syrup
ingredients: 2 ounces frozen yogurt ( no substitutes ) | 3 -4 1 cup lemonade concentrate ( no substitutes ) | 1 stalk celery leaves ( optional ) | 4 small serrano chilies | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar ( optional )
instructions: Stir the yogurt and juice concentrates with a whisk. Add the celery leaves and chiles with a little bit of water added to keep the blades moving. Add balsamic vinegar, if desired. Mix well and serve warm, either in a glass pitcher or cup.

Random Ingredients: garlic clove,cardamom powder,beef chuck,turmeric,flour tortilla,red cherry,curry paste,brown gravy mix
title: Curried Beef Burritos (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 1 3/4 lbs beef chuck | 12 flour tortillas, warmed | 1 cup chopped red cherry ( or halved cherry cans ) | 1 tablespoon curry paste | 1 teaspoon garam masala | 1 teaspoon cardamom powder | 1 teaspoon turmeric | 1 package brown gravy mix
instructions: Cut the meat into 1 inch cubes. Spray a 7x11 glass baking dish with nonstick cooking spray. Place meat in a 5 quart slow cooker. Mix remaining ingredients except gravy mix in a small bowl.

Random Ingredients: chili pepper flake,kaffir lime leaf,white wine vinegar,basil pesto,liquid smoke,berry
title: Homemade English Pesto
ingredients: 15 cups mixed berries | 2 tablespoons chili pepper flakes | 2 tablespoons dried basil pesto | 1/4 cup white wine vinegar | 3 kaffir lime leaves | 1 cup unsweetened berry liquid smoke
instructions: Drain berries. Combine with remaining ingredients.

Random Ingredients: kaffir lime leaf,yukon gold potato,ice cube,raisin,black cardamom pod
title: Indian Potato-Kaffir Kaffee
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs yukon gold potatoes, peeled and quartered | 1/3 cup raisins | 6 whole black cardamom pods | 12 garlic kaffir lime leaves, coarsely torn | ice cube | 1 quart ice cube
instructions: Cook potatoes in boiling water until tender, about 20 minutes. Drain and transfer potatoes to a bowl. Rinse with cold water until no longer cloudy. Transfer potatoes to a colander and run under hot water until completely cold. Transfer potatoes to a serving bowl and refrigerate. Dry the kaffir lime leaves in a clean towel or paper bag until very dry. In a food processor, coarsely grind the garlic and the kaffir lime leaves to a fine powder. Remove kaffir lime leaves from the water. Dice the potatoes and set aside. Toss together the potatoes with the garlic kaffir lime leaf mixture and refrigerate for 1 hour. Serve chilled.

Random Ingredients: ramen noodle,green chile,beef stock,red chili pepper,button mushroom,dark rum
title: Chile Mushroom Soup
ingredients: 1 cup shiitake mushrooms or 1 cup button mushroom, chopped | 3 cups beef stock | 1/2 cup dark rum | 1/4 cup fresh red chili pepper, thinly sliced | 2 cans diced green chiles | 1 package ramen noodles, crumbled ( optional )
instructions: Dice mushrooms and toss with remaining ingredients except ramen noodles.

Random Ingredients: cumin powder,seasoning salt,boursin cheese,red chili pepper,chicken bouillon,garam masala,salmon fillet
title: Spicy Boursin Salmon
ingredients: 4 boursin cheese, cut in half | 1/2 teaspoon cumin powder | 3 -4 lbs skinless salmon fillets | 2 tablespoons garam masala | 1 tablespoon seasoning salt | 1 -2 teaspoon chicken bouillon | 1 fresh red chili pepper
instructions: Place all ingredients except fish in small bowl. Cover with plastic wrap. Refrigerate at least 2 hours meanwhile. Place salmon fillets on baking sheets and set aside. Preheat oven to 400°. Bake for 8 - 10 minutes per inch of thickness, or until done. Flake with fork and serve.

title: Pfeffernusse
ingredients: 5 tablespoons sifted confectioners'sugar | 1 1/4 teaspoons ground cumin powder | 1 teaspoon garlic salt ( optional )
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together the confectioners' sugar, cumin powder, and garlic salt. Make sure to stir in enough water so that the mixture doesn't burn. Stir in the sifted mixture just until evenly mixed. Serve immediately. Store in an air tight container.

title: Muesli
ingredients: 2 cups thick sultanas | 1 1/3 cups full fat half-and-half | 1/2 teaspoon instant hot pepper flakes | 2 tablespoons cocoa powder
instructions: Place sultanas in fine mesh strainer. Mix all ingredients together, but stir until mixture just begins to firm. If mixture is too soft, add a little more half and half. Place in freezer. Place in small tupperware containers with plastic wrap attached, and freeze about 3 hours.

title: Spicy Eggplant Salad With Clams
ingredients: 4 medium eggplants ( about 2 1/8 lbs ) | 5 tablespoons ketchup | 2 tablespoons coriander powder | 1/2 red chile, minced | 1 lemon peel, grated zest and juice | 4 ounces fresh clams, chopped ( or baby clams ) | 2 tablespoons lettuce, chopped | 1 cup raspberries
instructions: Pre heat broiler with rack on one side. Cut eggplant in half lengthwise, about 1/2 inch thick. Brush eggplant with oil, place on a cookie sheet and broil. Turn once only.
