Cook until golden, 3 - 5 minutes per side. Remove from oven. Set aside, cut eggplant in half then cut into 1 1/4 inch slices. Toss salad in a bowl with ketchup, coriander and chilies, zest, juice and clams. Divide evenly among 2 serving plates, top with eggplant pieces, garnish with lettuce and berries.

title: Chinese Cabbage Rolls
ingredients: 2 cups shredded chinese cabbage ( about 2 large ) | 12 slices sandwich bread
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium temperature. In a large bowl, toss the cabbage with 1 - 2 tablespoons water. Stir until the cabbage is coated with water. Place a slice of sandwich bread on a work surface. Cover the bread with 2 - 3 tablespoons of the shredded cabbage, then top with another slice of bread, pressing down to compact the cabbage roll a little. Repeat with all 12 sandwiches. Place the rolls on the grill and grill about 4 minutes per side, or until the bread is golden brown. Repeat with remaining sandwiches.

title: Vodka Lemon
ingredients: 2 cups chicken stock | 1 tablespoon vodka | 1 lemon wedge ( optional )
instructions: In a saucepan over low heat, bring chicken stock to a boil. Stir in vodka, then bring to a boil again, stirring constantly. Remove from heat and pour vodka into glass or ceramic cups or ramekin dishes. Serve with lemon wedges, if desired. These are good served over steamed or steamed carrots or zucchini.

Random Ingredients: baking potato,pecorino romano cheese,monterey jack cheese,mustard
title: Italian Potatoes
ingredients: 3 baking potatoes, rinsed and sliced | 1/2 cup shredded monterey jack cheese | 1/2 cup shredded pecorino romano cheese | 1 teaspoon dry mustard
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees fahrenheit. Line a 9x8 inch baking dish with aluminum foil. Place potatoes cut side down in bottom of dish. Sprinkle with 2/3 each of the cheeses, mustard and remaining cheeses. Bake, 40 minutes or until potatoes are tender.

title: Cashew and Asparagus
ingredients: 1 lb asparagus spear, cut into 1 inch pieces | 1 1/2 cups sliced raw cashews | 1 bottle lager beer
instructions: Cook asparagus, asparagus spears and cashew nuts until crisp tender. Serve immediately.

title: Steamed Steak With Melon and Fresh Fruit (Kalhore Tsefono)
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 lbs flank steaks | 1 1/2 - 2 lbs seedless watermelon
instructions: Slice steak into 1 - 1 1/2 inch slices. Arrange slices in a steamer basket or on a rack in a baking pan, and surround with the remaining ingredients. Place over medium heat.

title: Rigatoni Pasta Bake
ingredients: 1 lb mostaccioli pasta or 1 lb other tubular pasta | 1 large baking potato | 1/2 cup chopped green pepper | 1/4 cup roasted green pepper mixed with | 2 tablespoons dry crushed italian seasoning ( mccormick italian seasoning )
instructions: Boil the noodles in salted water until al dente, drain and rinse with cold water. Cut the potato in half and then crosswise into bite size chunks, i like the size of a ping pong ball, so the peices make a total of 2 peices. Combine the bread crumbs and seasonings and toss with the pasta until they are well coated. Spread on a large baking pan that has been coated with cooking spray and sprinkle on top and around the dish. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: cola,chili powder,caster sugar,sage leaf,cream cheese,catsup,red pepper powder,pancetta
title: Mock Beef Nuts
ingredients: 2 slices pancetta ( finely minced and browned ) | 12 sage leaves | 1/4 cup caster sugar | 1 cup cola ( can omit any alcohol for sweet n ) | 1/2 cup catsup ( can substitute with soy sauce ) | 1 teaspoon red pepper powder | 1 tablespoon chili powder | 1 package cream cheese ( neufchatel )
instructions: Brown pancetta over medium heat and stir in cashew nuts, sage and sugar. In saucepan combine cola, catsup and chili powder and stir to combine. Pour over pancetta mixture and mix well. Cover and cook over medium heat for 10 to 15 minutes, or until hot, stirring occasionally. Serve on toasted bagels brushed with oil or butter or use in a sandwich.

title: Crispy Thai Pesto Rice Flakes
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups rice flour | 1/3 cup chunky salsa | 2 tablespoons rice flour | 1 tablespoon prepared mustard | 1 tablespoon pesto | 1 tablespoon drained strawberries | 1 tablespoon sliced fresh mint
instructions: Whisk together rice flour, salsa, mustard and pesto in a bowl. Add yogurt and strawberries and stir gently to incorporate. Scoop about 1 1/2 tablespoons of mixture onto a dry surface and shape with the palm of your hand to form a criss cross pattern. Bake on an ungreased cookie sheet at 400 degrees for 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown. Cut into 12 portions.

Random Ingredients: sesame oil,lite olive oil,stevia,greek yogurt,halibut fillet,bicarbonate soda
title: Halibut With Yoghurt
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs halibut fillets | 1 pinch bicarbonate of soda | 1 1/4 teaspoons stevia | 5 fluid ounces plain thick greek yogurt | 2 teaspoons sesame oil | 1 3/4 fluid ounces lite olive oil
instructions: If all ingredients are measured dry, stir the mixture until it combines. Place the trout onto a large dish, and pour over the mixture, making sure the fish is well coated. Set aside for 20 minutes. Preheat the broiler and/or the barbecue on high. Remove the halibut from the marinade, shaking off the excess. Brush the halibut fillets with the yoghurt mixture. Place under a hot grill for 3 to 5 minutes on each side, depending on the thickness of your fillets. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: onion soup mix,rye flour,salmon fillet,chinese five spice powder,wheat flour,cheese
title: Quick & Easy 5-Spice Salmon
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg whole wheat flour, plus extra for dusting | 1 1/2 teaspoons chinese five spice powder | 300 g salmon fillets, skinned & boned, bones left on and cut into 2 cm pieces | 35 g onions soup mix | 30 g cheese, grated or 30 g mozzarella cheese, grated | 25 g rye flour
instructions: Preheat the oven to 230c/450f/gas sprinkle the flour with the 5spice powder and roll into two equal sized balls. Tear off large pieces of greaseproof paper, one for the work surface, the other for the chopping board. Using the rolling pin, press a circle of parchment or baking paper across each piece of pastry to about 6mm thickness. Turn each piece of dough over and continue making 'dough' until all the rounds have been used. Sprinkle a little more flour onto one side of each round and lay the rounds flat on a lightly floured baking sheet. Make sure the baking sheet is large enough, otherwise the pastry will spit at you when cooking the first batch. Place in the oven, and immediately turn the oven off. Leave the oven in there for about 20 minutes, or until the pastry is cooked and has puffed up slightly. Once the oven is turned down to 200c/450f/gas remove the pastry from the oven and place it on a chopping board. Return the un cooked round to the oven. Sprinkle the salmon with some more flour and cook it until it is coloured, about 2 - 3 minutes, then drain excess water off. Place on a plate and drizzle over some oil, sprinkle with grated cheese and serve.

title: Chops of Beef
ingredients: 1 tablespoon tamari | 1/3 cup triple sec ( or other good liquid sweetener ) | 1 tablespoon dried thyme leaves | 1 tablespoon walnuts, ground | 1 beef eye round, trimmed of all visible fat, sliced ( approx 750g )
instructions: Mix the first 5 ingredients in a small shallow casserole dish set over a medium heat and cook, stirring for 1 minute. Add the meat slices, spreading evenly and turning to coat evenly with the marinade. Reduce the heat to medium low. Cook for 15 minutes. Remove the pan from the heat. Cover and cook for another 15 minutes, shaking the pan to help the meat brown. Transfer the meat to a warmed serving platter or plates. Sprinkle with nuts and serve with your favourite side dish.

title: Spicy Asparagus & Coconut Ricotta Dip
ingredients: 1 cup low fat milk ricotta cheese | 1 bunch fresh asparagus, trimmed & cut into slices | 1/4 cup curry powder | 1/2 cup water | 1/3 cup fresh dill, chopped or 1 teaspoon dried dill | 1 tablespoon reduced-fat milk or 1 tablespoon non fat milk powder
instructions: Combine ricotta & asparagus in a bowl. Stir in curry powder, curry water & dill weed. Cover & refrigerate several hours, stirring well after each serving. Serve with french bread, crackers or other hearty crackers.

title: Fusion Red Bean Salad
ingredients: 250 g red beans, rinsed and drained | 1/2 teaspoon celery salt | 1 tablespoon dried tarragon | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace | 1/8 teaspoon ground mace
instructions: Place beans in a bowl. Sprinkle with celery salt, tarragon, mace and any other seasoning that you choose. Mix well. Chill before serving.

Random Ingredients: garlic salt,grape tomato,pasta sauce,liquid smoke,ramen noodle,jicama
title: Fiesta Pasta Salad Noodles
ingredients: 3/4 lb medium pasta sauce ( i use prego's parmesan'brand ) | 12 ounces ramen noodles, broken into small pieces ( about 1 1/2 cups ) | 5 small jicama, peeled and diagonally cut into thin julienne strips ( about 1 1/2 cups ) | 1/2 cup grape tomatoes, cut into thin slices ( about 2 cups ) | 1 teaspoon liquid smoke | 2 teaspoons sodium-reduced garlic salt
instructions: Place pasta and 1 - ½ to 2 cups water in large, shallow baking dish. Bring to boil.

title: Homestyle English Cauliflower Soup
ingredients: 4 tablespoons extra-virgin olive oil ( about 3 tablespoons ) | 1 lb spaghetti noodles, broken in half | 4 tablespoons honey | 2 tablespoons fresh tarragon or 2 tablespoons chopped fresh flat-leaf italian parsley | 1 head cauliflower, chopped | 1 lb american cheese, sliced | 8 cups torn iceberg lettuce ( about 3 large handfuls ) | 1/2 lb grated parmesan cheese | 8 sprigs fresh parsley, to garnish ( optional )
instructions: Melt the 2 tablespoons of the olive oil in a large saucepan and stir in the spaghetti, 3 tablespoons honey, and tarragon. Simmer, uncovered, 5 minutes, stirring occasionally. Add the cauliflower, and heat until just tender, about 5 to 10 minutes. Drain the pasta, stir into the soup, and cook over medium heat until it's warmed through. Taste for salt, and adjust the sweetness of the soup if necessary. Transfer the soup to individual bowls, or divide among 6 large bowls. Top each bowl with a generous handful of the cheese, lettuce, and 1/4 cup per portion of soup. Garnish each bowl with a sprinkling of parmesan or parsley, if desired.

Random Ingredients: beef chuck,flour tortilla,cashew nut,urad dal,dark soy sauce
title: Beef Gumbo Wraps
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs beef chuck | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce | 1/2 teaspoon ground urad dal | 1 tablespoon cashew nuts | 4 soft flour tortillas
instructions: Place meat, soy sauce and urad dal in a small pot. Heat over medium heat until mixture is warm. Pour warm mixture onto meat. Let stand for about 20 minutes or longer. Meanwhile, toast cashews. Preheat oven to 400°f brush one side of each tortilla with oil. Place a heaping tablespoon of beef, 2/3 cup cashew nuts and 1/2 tablespoon of the soy sauce mixture on each tortilla. Fold and seal with wet hands. Place in a large oven proof baking dish, seam side down. Bake at 400 f for 5 to 7 minutes or till beef is brown and heated through. Serve with hoisin sauce or as an accompaniment to rice.

Random Ingredients: shiitake mushroom,lime,baby carrot,queso fresco,banana,chicken stock,beef tenderloin,vanilla bean
title: Tibetan-Style Beef Medallions
ingredients: 1 lb lean beef tenderloin, filet or 1 lb sirloin steak | 12 ounces baby carrots | 12 ounces guano shiitake mushrooms, chopped | 1 lime, zested, juiced and zested | 2 teaspoons pure vanilla bean paste or 1 teaspoon pure vanilla extract | 2 cups chicken stock | 1/4 cup crumbled queso fresco | 1/4 cup thinly sliced banana
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Combine beef, carrots and mushrooms in a large bowl. Add juice and zest from lime and vanilla and stir well to combine. Coat a large baking or baking pan with cooking spray. Add meat mixture and toss to coat. Place on the rack in the center of oven to bake for 15 to 20 minutes. Turn meat.

title: Polenta Pizzas
ingredients: 3 cups polenta ( whole cornmeal ) | 1 cup white wine ( we like a dark grape juice type ) | 3/4 cup pineapple juice | 2 -3 teaspoons allspice | 1 tablespoon kitchen bouquet | 1/3 cup tamari | 2 pinches cheese ( you can use up to 1/2 cp. )
instructions: If your sauce is watery, you should have enough to cover. Otherwise, if you are very low in liquid, you can omit this step. In a 3 quart bowl, combine all the dry ingredients. Mix well making sure you can work the mixture into your hands, using all the dry ingredients. Take a pizza cutter and cut the circle of dough into about 1/4 cubes. This is important so it doesn't stick to the cutter. Place the dough in your hands and shape the dough into a ball. Place the balls on a parchment lined pizza pan and put the pizzas on a rack for about 20 minutes or until they are nice and golden brown. Allow 3 pizas per person while making the sauce. When the first batch is done, drizzle over the sauce and serve with mozzarella cheese.

Random Ingredients: vegetarian sausage,brown sugar,garlic clove,breadcrumb,caster sugar,lima bean,peach
title: Jamaican Chilli-Spiced Peppered Bean Sausages
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vegetarian sausage ( such as bangers or morningstar farms ) | 2 large crusty breadcrumbs | 100 g chopped fresh peaches or 100 g frozen peaches, thickly sliced | 2 -3 garlic cloves, crushed | 1 tablespoon brown sugar | 1 tablespoon caster sugar | 2 teaspoons vegetarian baked beans, warmed in microwave for 2 minutes or 1/2 teaspoon instant espresso ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c. Spray a shallow casserole dish with non stick oil spray. Mix all ingredients together except for baked beans. Spoon sausage mixture into coated dish and bake for 30 minutes, or until lightly browned. Serve as topping with warm baked beans.

title: Chewy Orange Sauce
ingredients: 2 oranges | 1 cup dark brown sugar | 1/3 cup dark molasses
instructions: Place the orange on a cutting board with the cut side of the knife parallel to it. Slice it in half, removing peel and pith as possible. Cut off ends and any bitter pith in the side of the orange. Cut away peel and use a knife to scrape out as much white pith as you can of the dark pith. Using a vegetable peeler or sharp paring knife, remove as much of the bitter pith as possible. Slice the membrane into long, thin strips. Place the orange strips in the bowl of a food processor fitted with a metal blade and grind to a pulp. Add the sugar and molasses and pulse until creamy. Chill.

Random Ingredients: onion powder,chipotle chile adobo,yellow onion,jalapeno chile pepper
title: Fajita Seasoning Mix in a Jar
ingredients: 4 yellow onions, chopped | 1/2 cup chipotle chile in adobo, finely chopped ( from can of chipotles ) | 1 tablespoon jalapeno chile pepper, finely chopped ( from jar of jalapeno chile peppers ) | 1 teaspoon onion powder
instructions: Heat an ungreased large frying pan or skillet over medium heat. Stir in onions and cook, stirring, until wilted. Stir in chipotles, jalapeno pepper, and onion powder.

Random Ingredients: chili oil,sun tomato oil,white breadcrumb,chunky salsa,mint,white hominy,cocoa,salt black pepper
title: Hot Mexican Poppers
ingredients: 2 tablespoons chili oil | 2 medium white hominy, drained well | salt & freshly ground black pepper | chopped of fresh mint, to garnish | 1/4 cup chunky salsa | freshly grated rind of one good red table pepper ( about 1 tablespoon ) | 2 tablespoons toasted whole wheat breadcrumbs | 2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa or 2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees. In a large, ovenproof skillet that has a lid, heat the chili oil over medium high heat until hot. Add the hominy, mint, salsa and rind.

title: Chocolate Fudgy Bread
ingredients: 5 cups bread flour | 6 medium sized carrots, grated | 1/3 cup red chilies | 2 ounces unsweetened chocolate cake, cut into squares
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees. Place the flour and all ingredients in a bowl. Mix with a wooden spoon until a soft dough forms. Roll out on a clean cloth, knead briefly and then pat out as thinly as you can. Use a pastry cutter to cut a 3 inch circle or circle. Bake in the oven for approx 20 minutes. Remove and cool, cut into small squares and store in an airtight container.

title: Grilled Chicken with Leg of Lamb
ingredients: 8 chicken legs with thigh, wings attached | 1 ounce lemongrass, peeled and cut into 2 inch long chunks | 12 dried figs, 1 quartered | sirloin | 1/2 lb red snapper fillet
instructions: Place the chicken legs in a saucepan or dutch oven that has a tight fitting lid. Pour 1 quart water around the legs, add the lemongrass and figs, and bring to a simmer. Cover and cook over low heat until chicken is soft, about 1 hour. Remove the thighs and figs, cut into bite sized pieces. Remove the skin and flesh from the legs, and return the chicken and figs to the pan. Cover and cook over low heat until almost tender, about 30 minutes. Preheat grill or broiler, placing coals on rack 4 inches from grill. When ready to serve, brush both sides of the chicken with oil and season with salt and pepper.

title: Red and Green Habanero Jelly
ingredients: 5 lbs baby spinach, fresh | 1/2 cup coarsely chopped habanero pepper ( about 12 whole habanero peppers ) | 7 -8 drops green food coloring ( optional )
instructions: Remove stems from green beans. Remove and discard green beans from pods. In a large saucepan of boiling water, blanch spinach for 15 seconds, just until it begins to wilt, then transfer to a colander and rinse under cold water. Immediately transfer to ice water to cool slightly. Peel off the burned green parts with a vegetable peeler. Cut pods lengthwise into 1/4 inch slices and set aside. Dip greens into hot water to soften, then transfer to jelly jars and coat in green food coloring. Store in the refrigerator until ready to use. Will last several weeks.

title: Rhubarb and Almond Frijoles
ingredients: 400 g pinto beans, drained | 450 g rhubarb | 4 -5 tablespoons blanched whole almonds
instructions: Place the pinto beans and rhubarb into a large bowl. Add the sliced almonds and mix. Wrap the pasta in foil and bake in a casserole in a medium heat for 2 hours.

Random Ingredients: red capsicum,white wine vinegar,extra virgin olive oil,bamboo shoot,dark sesame oil,escarole
title: Jade With Peppers in Vine Ripened Water
ingredients: 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil | 1/4 teaspoon dark sesame oil | 3/4 cup chopped red capsicum | 1/2 cup chopped cooked escarole | 1/2 cup chopped bamboo shoot | red wine vinegar, juice of, splash
instructions: Combine first four ingredients, set aside. Place remaining ingredients in a non metallic frying pan. Heat through. Ladle mixture into salad bowls and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: red chilies,dill weed,sun tomato oil,rye bread,orange juice zest
title: Spanish Crunch Bread Dip With Oranges and Red Chilies (Rachael Ray)
ingredients: 1 loaf rye bread, cut into 1-inch thick slices ( about 4 cups ) | 2 cans thinly sliced sweet red chilies | 2 oranges, juice and zest of | 1/2 cup finely chopped dill weed | 4 tablespoons finely minced sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained
instructions: In a large bowl, toss together the sliced bread, chilies, orange zest, dill weed and tomatoes. Spoon evenly into 4 to 6 small mason jars, leaving 1/4 inch headspace. Adjust rimmed tops.

title: Lamb and Mizurek Sandwiches
ingredients: 8 ounces rib eye steaks | 1 lb lamb | 1 teaspoon mixed italian seasoning | 5 green cardamom pods | 10 -12 savoiardi ladyfingers | 2 1/2 ounces mascarpone | 3 tablespoons lemon maple syrup
instructions: Cut the steak into thin slices. Cut the meat into strips about 1/2 x 1 - 2 long. Mix together the italian seasoning with the green cardamoms and spread on both sides of the meat slices. Set out 6 samll ladyfingers and place each one on a skewer. Spread 1/2 oz of mascarpone on both sides of the meat slices. Spread the remaining 1/2 oz of mascarpone on the meat, then fold in the ends. Wrap the sandwiches in parchment and place in the freezer for 1 hour, this will make them easier to remove from freezer.

Random Ingredients: chickpea,monterey jack cheese,creole seasoning,black bean paste,marjoram,shrimp,bacon grease,chili sauce
title: Chili Poppers (Cape Breasts Stuffed With Shrimp)
ingredients: 36 shrimp ( peeled ) | 8 pieces smoked bacon grease | 1 can black bean paste | 3 tablespoons creole seasoning | 3 tablespoons marjoram ( chopped ) | 1/2 cup sweet chili sauce ( kikkoman sweet plum ) | 1 1/2 cups monterey jack cheese ( shredded ) | 2 cans chickpeas ( drained )
instructions: Saute shrimp in bacon grease for 3 minutes on medium high heat, remove from heat and add black bean paste, creole seasoning, marjoram and sweet chili sauce. Place 1/4 cup of shrimp mixture along the outside of each shrimp. Place a piece of cheese on top and repeat with another shrimp mixture and cheese. Place under broiler and turn to brown cheese. Sprinkle with paprika or sprinkle with oregano if desired and enjoy.

title: Homemade Yogurt
ingredients: 2 cups plain yogurt, starter of choice | lemon peel, from 10-12 lemon
instructions: Mix together. Cover with a towel and chill for 2 to 24 hours before serving.

title: Brazilian Style Chili Con Carne
ingredients: 4 cups water | 1 package dry grated cheese | 1/4 cup parmesan cheese | 1/4 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 1/4 teaspoon cocoa ( optional ) | 3/4 cup gin | 1/4 cup bell pepper, diced ( or sliced )
instructions: In a soup pot or sauce pan add water, cheese, red pepper flakes, cocoa, and heat. Bring to a boil, stirring occasionally. Add bell pepper, stirring often. Remove from heat and stir often.

Random Ingredients: white balsamic vinegar,brown rice,steak,colby monterey jack cheese,brown mustard
title: Santa Fe Steak
ingredients: 1/2 cup white balsamic vinegar | 1/2 cup brown mustard | 2 pounds flank steak | 1/2 cup shredded colby-monterey jack cheese | 1/3 cup white balsamic vinegar | 1/2 cup brown mustard | 1 cup brown cooked steak
instructions: In a small bowl, combine 1/2 cup of the balsamic vinegar, 1/2 cup of the brown mustard, and the 4 pound of flank steak. Cover, and marinate in the refrigerator for 2 hours, turning and tossing. Drain liquid from steak and reserve. Grill steak over high heat for 1 minute per side, or to desired doneness. Slice diagonally across the grain, and arrange on a platter. Place 1/3 cup of the cheese and 1/3 cup of mustard in a small dish or bowl, and combine. Heat 1/3 cup brown mustard in a saucepan over low heat, stirring constantly for 1 minute. Stir in 1/3 of the vinegar and the reserved steak marinade. Heat through, about 1 minute. Spoon sauce over steak, and serve.

Random Ingredients: garlic salt,chili oil,orange peel,soy sauce,russet potato,bread
title: Panfried Grilled Whole Potatoes With Soy Glaze and Orange Peel
ingredients: 4 russet potatoes, unpeeled | 2 bunches orange peel, washed and patted dry | 1/4 cup unsweetened soy sauce | 1/2 cup chili oil | 1/2 cup freshly grated orange peel | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt
instructions: Preheat an outdoor grill for high heat and lightly oil the grate. Wash the potatoes, dry well, and prick the peel several times with a fork. Place the potatoes on the oiled grate and grill until softened and tender, about 20 minutes. Turn the potatoes over, sprinkle with the soy sauce and cook until crispy all the way through, about 2 minutes. Whisk the orange peel, chile oil, orange peel, garlic salt and orange peel in a bowl. Drizzle over the potatoes and serve.

Random Ingredients: prosciutto,hot salsa,brown sugar,fennel bulb,za'atar spice mix,turmeric powder,beef steak,fine salt
title: Shish Kebab  (Za'atar Burgers)
ingredients: 1 lb good quality beef round steak ( cut into 1 inch cubes ) | 2 tablespoons fennel bulbs, chopped | 4 tablespoons za'atar spice mix | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1/2 teaspoon hot salsa | 1/2 tablespoon brown sugar | 1/2 tablespoon fine salt | 8 slices prosciutto or 8 slices deli ham, thin slices
instructions: Heat a large fry pan or grill pan. Place the beef cubes in the pan/skillet. Sprinkle on the fennel, then add a pinch of the za'atar. Stir and cook the beef until no longer pink. Remove meat to a bowl, cover it and set aside. Season the oil with brown sugar, salt and pepper. Brush a skillet lightly with oil. Place the pan/skillet in the oven until the meat is to desired tenderness. Brush the pan/skillet with more oil now, as this step can take literally a full 20 minutes. Meanwhile, line a baking sheet with tin foil or use foil liners. Place the meat on the baking tray/foil. With a spatula, spread all of the vegetables on the meat evenly. Using your spoon, spread another 1/8 of the za'atar on, and press down carefully, making sure to leave a large gap in the ground beef. When meat has browned, spread the za'atar on the meat to completely cover the top of the meat. Place in oven at 350 degrees, then top with the ham slices. Bake for 20 minutes, or until the cheese is bubbly. Serve at once, with any other favorite topping.

title: The Best Polish Shrimp Balls
ingredients: 1 lb large jumbo shrimp | 1/4 cup vodka | 1 small yellow onion, diced | 1/2 cup breadcrumbs | 1/2 teaspoon baking powder | 2/3 cup unseasoned breadcrumbs, divided | 1/3 cup unsweetened cocoa powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. Rinse shrimp with cold water and pat dry with paper towels. Place shrimp in boiling water for 2 seconds and remove with a slotted spoon. Drain shrimp well and pat dry. In a large bowl, combine shrimp, vodka, onion, 1/4 cup bread crumbs, and baking powder. Mix well with a small spoon. Shape into 1 balls and place on a baking sheet with sides. In a second medium size bowl, combine 1/3 cup bread crumbs, cocoa and ciabatta crumbs. Sprinkle mixture over shrimp, pressing in crumbs as you go. Bake for 12 to 12 minutes until golden brown and bubbly.

title: Linguine Con Linguine Ed Il
ingredients: 16 ounces linguine, refrigerated | 1/4 cup golden raisin ( use more if you like raisins ) | lettuce leaf ( optional )
instructions: Cook linguine.

title: Easy Parsnips in Foil
ingredients: 1 tablespoon ground cumin | 1 ounce parsnips, peeled and grated | 1 medium white onion, peeled and finely minced | fresh rosemary sprig ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large non reactive bowl and mash with a fork until mixture resembles coarse breadcrumbs. Add seasoning and mix in well. Coat pan, preferably non stick. Over medium heat, toast for 2 or 3 minutes or until breadcrumbs are lightly browned. Turn breadcrumbs over and place in an oiled ovenproof dish. Bake in a 400f oven for 10 minutes or until lightly browned.

title: Portuguese Pot Pie
ingredients: 1 prepared pie crust ( see below ) | 1 can rotel tomatoes ( regular tomatoes may be used ) | 1 jar madeira wine | 1 bottle of a portuguese wine ( inexpensive to make your own )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Pour olive oil into a medium saucepan and place over medium heat. Pour wine in sauce pan into a small bowl. Drain excess liquid, but reserve. Combine ro tel, madeira and port and pour 1/3 of the liquid in pie crust. Stir gently, making sure rinsing the pan of tomatoes and tomato is not sticking. Pour the remaining liquid into a small pot and boil, stirring constantly. Reduce heat, cover and cook for 30 - 60 minutes. Check after 25 minutes, adding a little more liquid if necessary,. Spoon the hot sauce over the baked tomatoes and serve.

Random Ingredients: yellow pepper,tamari,peanut butter,crouton,mango,plain flour,baby spinach,italian sausage
title: Prawn Pesto
ingredients: 240 g pre-made homemade pesto sauce or 3 -4 teaspoons prepared basil and garlic pesto | 2 tablespoons plain flour | 40 g chopped peanuts or 40 g crushed peanuts | 60 g butter | 2 tablespoons tamari | 4 red ripe mangoes or 4 green mangoes, peeled and diced | 1 small yellow pepper, diced | 1 cup fresh baby spinach, washed
instructions: Place the pesto sauce in a pan and heat gently. Whisk in the flour. Remove from the heat and stir in the peanuts, butter, tamari, hot pesto and diced mango or green mango. Add the diced, peeled chilli and diced bell pepper. Pour into a mould or springform pan and cook over a medium heat for 3 - 5 minutes, stir frequently to prevent burning. Serve immediately on fresh baby spinach.

title: Kale and Spinach
ingredients: 8 ounces frozen spinach | 2/3 cup soda water ( sprite )
instructions: Thaw the spinach over paper towels. If using fresh, remove the excess liquid from it. Break the spinach up into bite size pieces and boil in a nonstick skillet with a teaspoon of olive oil. Reduce heat, cover the skillet, and simmer over low heat for about 10 minutes. Remove the spinach pieces from the pan using a slotted spoon. If using fresh water, add it now. Return the spinach to the skillet and reheat until warm.

title: Mexican Mango Chutney
ingredients: 1 can papayas nectar | 1/2 cup old fashioned oats | 1/2 cup chunky salsa, or more to taste | 1/2 cup grated parmesan cheese, plus more to taste | 6 tablespoons sliced almonds | 1 tablespoon sweet hungarian paprika
instructions: Pour the papaya nectar into a microwave safe bowl. Heat microwave on high until warm, about 5 minutes. Stir in the oats, chunky salsa, parmesan cheese, almonds, and paprika until well mixed.

Random Ingredients: pesto sauce,sesame seed,asparagus,chocolate ice cream,salmon fillet,basmati rice,kielbasa
title: Crispy Salmon and Asparagus Skewers
ingredients: 8 ounces salmon fillets, cut into 4 equal pieces | 2 tablespoons sesame seeds, toasted | 4 ounces asparagus, trimmed and cut in 1 inch pieces | 2 ounces kielbasa or 2 ounces other sausage, cut into 1 inch pieces | 1/3 cup pesto sauce | 6 -8 ounces chocolate ice cream, softened | basmati rice or couscous, cooked
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°f. Thread the seafood onto 4 skewers. Put half the sesame seeds on a baking sheet, place in the oven for 15 - 20 minutes, or until golden. Remove from the oven and cool for 5 minutes. Set aside. Place the asparagus, kielbasa and pesto sauce in a food processor and blend to a chunky paste. Spoon onto 4 serving plates. Serve with the kebabs, skewers and drizzle over the remaining sesame seeds.

Random Ingredients: cold water,red food coloring,flour,cream chicken soup,whiskey
title: Whisky Whiskey Dumplings
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1 cup cold water | 1/2 cup whiskey ( or brandy or bourbon, of course ) | 1 1/2 cups flour | 1 1/2 - 2 1/2 cups powdered instant flour or 1 1/2-2 1 1/2 cups cornstarch, mixed with | 1 1/2 cups cold water
instructions: Mix all the ingredients in a bowl, roll 1 cup of the flour/water mixture into the mixture until it's completely mixed inches. On a floured surface, roll the dough out to 1/8 or 1/4 inch thickness and cut into desired shapes.. Place in a pot of boiling water and cook for 10 minutes. The dumplings will rise to the surface and expand as they cook. Serve hot with ice cream.

Random Ingredients: red curry paste,egg yolk,cream,red pepper flake,peanut,beef hot dog,ginger root,pork shoulder
title: Spicy Hot Dogs for Two
ingredients: 3 large pork shoulder, trimmed of fat | 2 cups cubed cooked pork neck or other hot pork, meat | 1 tablespoon minced fresh ginger root | 1/2 teaspoon red curry paste | 3 large egg yolks | 1/3 cup cream | 1/4 cup peanuts, finely chopped | 1/4 teaspoon red pepper flakes | 1/4 cup shredded red bell pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place pork in baking dish with enough space to cover all sides. Roast in preheated oven until almost cooked through, about 15 minutes. Drain pork, reserving juices. Cool and refrigerate. When cool, shred meat. Whisk egg yolks, cream, peanuts, red pepper flakes, and red pepper together in large bowl. Dice pork and add to egg mixture, stirring until ingredients are thoroughly mixed. Transfer to 9x13 inch baking dish. Bake in preheated oven until hot and hot, about 35 minutes.

title: Roasted Chickpeas
ingredients: 1/2 cup dry roasted hazelnuts | 1 can chickpeas | 1/3 cup of chopped green pepper | 1/3 cup dried breadcrumbs
instructions: Roast the hazelnuts in a 400 f oven until golden and smelling delicious. Place the chickpeas whole in a large pot of water. Bring to a boil. Drain well. Mash the chickpeas with some water to remove any bad chunks. Strain and add chickpeas, green pepper, pepper, and bread crumbs to the pot. Stir well to combine. Cover tightly and place in the oven. Place on the middle rack of a 325 degree oven for 30 - 45 minutes. The chickpeas will be soft and mushy. Let stand for 5 minutes, then serve.

Random Ingredients: red cabbage,plain nonfat yogurt,stock,lettuce,angel food cake mix,arborio rice,curry leaf
title: Vegetable Risotto
ingredients: 1 cup chicken stock | 2 tablespoons plain nonfat yogurt | 3 3/4 ounces plain nonfat yogurt | 1 tablespoon curry leaf | 6 3/4 ounces arborio rice dishes | 2 large red cabbage ( about 1 cup ) | 1 small cos lettuce
instructions: Place the stock and yoghurt in a pan and simmer for 3 minutes. Add the curry leaf and rice. Cook over low heat for 5 minutes or until the rice is just tender. Divide the rice between four bowls. Place the cabbage on top and top with the rissotto. Serve topped with fresh coriander.

title: Hot Strawberry Oyster Sauce for Pasta or Sandwich
ingredients: 1 jar whole-grain strawberries, drained and chopped | 1 small tart pan | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce, to taste | 4 tablespoons good season salt, to taste
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine strawberries, oyster sauce and sweet seasoning. Cut a hole in the bottom of the tart pan, fill the hole with cold water. Using a spoon, get a small, thin slice of the mixture into the water, tap the bottom of the tin on the counter to release all of the sand from the bowl. Dunk the pastry tip in, tap the bottom on the tin and remove the pastry tips, as well. Repeat this process until the mixture is gone, whichever comes first. Fill the rest of the tin with water, and place tart pan on top, or put a baking sheet in the freezer for later use if you prefer it. Cook for 45 minutes at 220°c/425°f. Eat while hot, or place in the fridge while the other components are heating up. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: kalamata olive,gherkin,watermelon,purpose flour,topping,golden syrup,palm sugar,olive oil
title: Mosaic With Watermelon and Olives
ingredients: 40 g all-purpose flour | 1/4 - 1/3 cup warm water | 1 kg watermelon, seeded and cubed | 250 g greek yogurt or 250 g sour cream | 4 kalamata olives, sliced | 1/4 cup golden syrup | 45 g palm sugar or 45 g light brown sugar | 30 g fresh gherkins
instructions: Dissolve the sugar in a little water. Add the syrup and sugar and cook gently, stirring occasionally until the syrup has thickened slightly. Take off the heat and cool to room temperature. Add the yoghurt and mix well. Add the olives, olives and gherkins to the yoghurt mixture and gently mix again. Set aside until ready to use. You can make this in advance and refrigerate for up to 3 days. Place the flour in a bowl and add just enough cold water to form a stiff dough. Turn out the dough on a floured surface and knead briefly until smooth. Divide the dough into 40 equal parts. Roll each part on a floured surface until about 5 mm thick and then cut into 4 equal portions. Roll each portion into a circle. Bake on a greased tray covered with parchment for about 10 minutes at 150 °c or on a greased oven tray for about 25 minutes until they begin to colour. Spread the yoghurt in each circle and then the watermelon and olives mixture. Keep a piece of foil, but you can wrap around the sandwich while it cools down to allow for easier separation later. Serve at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: serrano chilies,cayenne pepper,dill weed,bulk pork sausage,anchovy fillet,button mushroom,green bean
title: Hungarian Sausages and Veggies
ingredients: 1 lb bulk pork sausage | 8 ounces mixed green beans, trimmed | 4 medium fresh mushrooms, sliced | 1/3 cup fresh dill weed | 6 garlic-flavored anchovy fillets, mashed ( i use regular ) | 2 jalapeno serrano chilies, seeded and finely chopped | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to in a large skillet, fry sausage over medium high heat until crumbly and no longer pink, breaking into crumbles. Drain and set aside. In same skillet, saute remaining ingredients and sausage over medium heat until sausage is no longer pink, breaking up sausage with a wooden spoon. Spoon mixture into a casserole and cover tightly with aluminum foil. Bake 1 hour or until vegetables are soft, stirring frequently. Note, if sausage mixture is too dry, add a little water or potato masher to aid the dough. May be served hot or warm.

title: British Macaroni Salad
ingredients: 2 lbs macaroni, fresh | 2 ounces lemon rind, unwaxed, finely chopped | 1/4 cup golden syrup | 1 small free-range anchovy, drained and crushed | 4 ounces soft smoked salmon, sliced | 2 hard-boiled eggs, hard cooked | 4 ounces raspberries ( to garnish )
instructions: Cook macaroni following label directions. Rinse under running water, and drain. Cook rind in golden syrup in a small pan until golden, remove from heat and cool, crush the flakes with a pestle. Drain macaroni in a sieve and place under cold water, drain. instructions: Bring stock to boil. Add pickles on top and cook for 2 minutes. Remove and allow to cool. Mix sesame seeds with pickle liquid.

instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Spray a baking sheet with cooking spray or line it with parchment paper. In a medium bowl, mix graham crackers, lettuce and tortilla pieces. Spoon mixture onto tortillas and roll them up. Serve right away.

Random Ingredients: lamb fillet,french bread,white chicken meat,crouton,aubergine,head romaine lettuce,tomato paste,jalapeno pepper juice
title: Hogao
ingredients: 4 lamb fillets | 1 large head romaine lettuce | 6 cubes french bread | 2 large ripe aubergines, cubed | 1 can white chicken meat, drained | 2 fresh jalapeno peppers, sliced | 2 tablespoons tomato paste | crouton
instructions: Combine lettuce, aubergine, jalapenos, tomatoe sauce, and tomato paste in a large pot. Tear off 3 inch lengths of french bread from bottom of baguette. title: Tuscany Sausages

instructions: Using an outdoor grill that has been soaked in water, grill the salt pork to desired doneness. Remove from grill and let cool slightly. While cooling, break salt pork into small chunks. instructions: Drain, rinse, and soak 16 ounces of navy beans for 24 hours. Mix vinegar, salsa, and italian seasoning in a large bowl. Drain soaked beans again and mix with vinegar mixture. Refrigerate at least 2 hours before using.

title: Sautéed Carrots - Carrots in Sherry
ingredients: 2 carrots, peeled, washed, and shredded | 1/4 cup dry sherry, or to taste
instructions: Place carrots in a shallow glass or ceramic bowl. Stir together sherry and enough ice water to make one cup.

title: Chilli Beet & Corn Chowder
ingredients: 3 tablespoons unflavored gelatin | 5 1/2 cups sliced beets, drained ( about 3 ears ) | 1 1/2 cups sliced canned beets, chilled | 2 cups sliced canned beets, chilled | 1/4 cup sweet chili paste | 1 bunch fresh rosemary, chopped ( leaves only )
instructions: In a saucepan, sprinkle gelatin over 1 cup water.

title: Almond Glaze

title: Chipotle Sauce

instructions: Place the chiles and tomato paste in a mortar and pestle or whirl in a food processor until smooth.

title: Thai Sweet and Sour Chicken Wings from the Microwave

title: Vindaloo (Tamarind Celery)

instructions: Pick through the celery stalks and remove the tough stalks from the celery. Tie each stalk in a bundle with kitchen string or string. Place in a pan or bowl. Random Ingredients: sugar,cilantro leaf,canola oil,dressing,cocoa powder,garlic paste,sun tomato oil,vinegar
title: Chilean Sun-Dried Tomato and Cilantro Salad

instructions: Pour oil into a dry 12 inch skillet over low heat, swirling the pan until absorbed. instructions: Shake in cocktail shaker, strain into 2 stemmed shot glasses and serve.

instructions: Place drained barley into a large bowl. Cover generously with cold water and leave until tender. Drain. Add white onion, coriander and ground coriander, mix well. Add ricotta, orange and grapes. Mix lightly. Cover and refrigerate for several hours or overnight. Serve chilled.

title: Spinach, Chard, or Taters to Die For
ingredients: 1 lb ground veal | 2 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained ( or use sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained ) | 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar | 1 cup hot green lentil, drained | 2 cups bite-size whole wheat pasta ( or similar pasta with a vinaigrette )
instructions: Brown the ground meat and drain any excess fat. Add the vinegar and stir to combine. Add the lentils and green olives and mix well. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add the pasta and cook until al dente, about 8 to 10 minutes. Drain well and return to the pot. Toss lightly to coat. If you prefer your sauce slightly thicker, just add a little water. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Serve hot.

title: Mexican Onion Rings
ingredients: 1 spanish onion, peeled | 1 cup fresh lime juice | 1/2 teaspoon chili powder
instructions: Cut the tops off the onion, leaving about about 3/4 inch of the top. Scrape the top and most of the inside of the onion with a teaspoon or so of lime juice into a saucepan. Scrape the bottom into the saucepan, cover and set the lid on. Bring the mixture to a hard boil, then place it on the stove over low heat and skim off any foam that rises to the surface. Reduce heat and simmer until the onions start to caramelize, about 30 minutes. Stir occasionally. Remove the pan from the heat, stir in the chile powder, and taste to adjust seasonings. Transfer onion rings to sterile containers, cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight. To use, place a fried onion into a bowl, pour in 1 tablespoon of onion liquid and toss to coat evenly. Serve on a sunny side up with cornbread.

title: Yogurt Dip
ingredients: 600 g potatoes, peeled and cut into small wedges | 150 g sauerkraut, drained | 2 tablespoons spicy chili oil | 150 ml greek yogurt | 1 tablespoon muesli
instructions: Bring a large pan of water to the boil. Add the potatoes and cook for 8 to 10 minutes until tender. Drain well. Place potatoes in the bowl of an electric blender, or food processor with the sauerkraut, chile oil and yoghurt. Process until smooth. Remove and discard the skins before adding to the potato mixture. Serve warm with muesli to garnish.

title: French Toast a La Toast
ingredients: 1 loaf bread | 2 tablespoons wheat germ | 1 yellow squash | hot sauce | 2 -3 tablespoons confectioners'sugar
instructions: Cut bread into cubes. Spray pan with cooking spray. Sprinkle with wheat germ. Cut squash in half, remove seeds, and then cut into wedges. Dip each piece of bread into hot sauce to thoroughly coat. Add a tablespoon or two of confectioners' sugar over the french toast. Cook in pan over medium to medium high heat until golden brown. Cut into triangles when finished.

title: Mediterranean Beef & Bean Burritos
ingredients: 2 lbs ground sirloin or 2 lbs ground round | 1 bag burrito-size flour tortillas or ( 6 inch ) bag corn tortilla | 2 cups long grain white rice, cooked | 2 serrano chilies, chopped | 1 can black beans, rinsed and drained | 1/2 cup light nutella | storebought or homemade mole, sauce ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons vinegar
instructions: Bring 1 1/2 cups water to a boil and add burrito or corn tortillas, or fryer tortillas according to package directions. Meanwhile, brown meat in a 10 inch skillet over medium high heat. Reduce heat to low. Drain fat and stir in meat, rice and serrano chilies. Add beans and heat through. Remove from heat. Spoon mixture into tortillas and top with meat mixture if desired. Top with nutella or mole sauce and serve.

title: Curried Crab Balls With Pickles
ingredients: 1 poblano chiles, roasted, peeled, seeded, and cut into slices ( or serrano chiles ) | 1/4 cup coarse medium-fine dry breadcrumb | 1 pinch white pepper powder | 1/4 cup finely chopped fresh dill pickle | 1 tablespoon grated fresh curry leaf | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce | confectioners'sugar | 1 lb crab meat, picked through for shells or small shrimp, rinsed and picked clean
instructions: Line a baking sheet with foil. Lay the poblano slices on it, brush with the oil and roast in a dry, preheated oven 450 degrees f, flipping once, until lightly blistered and shrunken, about 15 minutes.
