Make slits all over the crabmeat with a fork. Dust with confectioners' sugar.

title: Fresh Spinach Leaves
ingredients: 12 fresh spinach leaves, washed | 1/8 teaspoon ground allspice
instructions: Cover with a few small sheets of cloth and set aside to steam dry for about 30 minutes. Place in a bowl and toss with a tablespoon or so of oil to coat thoroughly. Squeeze the excess moisture out of the leaves and place in the bowl. Sprinkle the allspice over. Toss with your hands and toss again. Cover and refrigerate for at least one hour. Serve with plain boiled or fried rice.

Random Ingredients: italian sausage,shrimp,chipotle chile,mexican oregano,peanut oil,ginger root,pea,watermelon
title: Sam's Shrimp, Pea, and Sausage
ingredients: 1 pinch dried chipotle chiles | 1 teaspoon ground ginger root | 1 pound italian sausage, with casings | 2 tablespoons peanut oil | 1/2 cup watermelon, cut into 1/4-inch-thick matchsticks | 1 package frozen peas, thawed | 1 teaspoon dried mexican oregano | 1 pound medium shrimp, peeled and deveined
instructions: Soak chipotle chiles and ginger in 1 teaspoon of water for 20 minutes to soften. Reserve the liquid. Remove casing from sausage and crumble into a skillet over medium high heat. Cook until browned. Drain the excess grease. Stir in 1 teaspoon chipotle chile blend, watermelon, and peas with chipotles, ginger juice, and oregano. Bring to a boil, reduce heat to low, and simmer until peas are heated through and sauce has thickened, about 15 minutes.

title: Molasses Baked Aubergines
ingredients: 4 medium aubergines | 3/4 cup molasses | 1 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Peel the aubergines and slice thinly. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Sprinkle the slices with salt and let them dry out for about 30 minutes. Then take out and, using a spoon, scrape away the salt from them all around the edges of the slices removing any excess moisture. Place the sliced aubergines on a baking sheet. Place the baking sheet in the oven and bake for 45 minutes. When the aubergines are soft, transfer them to a food processor or blender and add molasses and almond extract. Cover with a tea towel. Serve warm.

title: Authentic Mexican Rice
ingredients: 1/4 cup achiote paste, equivalent to 1 1/2 tablespoons | 6 1/2 cups short-grain brown rice | 3 1/2 - 4 lbs turkey legs, cut into 2 1/2 inch pieces | 2 1/2 - 3 cups oregano leaves, preferably mexican | 1 tablespoon raw brown rice, preferably stone-ground
instructions: Place achiote paste in a small saucepan over medium high heat and warm thoroughly. Stir in 1 1/4 cups water, bring to boil and then lower heat and cook for 20 minutes or until achiote is fragrant. Transfer heated achiote into a small bowl and reserve.. Rinse turkey and cut into 2 1/2 to 3 inch pieces. Add 3 1/2 5 cups water to a small saucepan over high heat and bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer rice for 15 minutes or until liquid is reduced by nearly half and mixture is aromatic. Add reserved achiote and turkey mixture. Simmer until mixture is heated through. Stir through 4 cups cooked rice, cover and keep warm. Place remaining cup of rice and 1/2 cup reserved achiote mixture in a blender or food processor and pulse process rice mixture until just a coarse texture.

title: Pepperoni Mincemeat
ingredients: 4 ounces pepperoni, finely minced ( or more, or more, to taste ) | 1 tablespoon lemon zest, finely grated | 1/8 cup food coloring ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon whole chipotle chile, finely minced
instructions: Mix all ingredients together with hands. Use the mixture to stuff your pepperoni mincemeat or make them to your desired mincemeat.

Random Ingredients: ranch dressing,monterey jack pepper cheese,parsnip,vodka,wine,lime wedge
title: Parsnips, Papas, and Mac
ingredients: 4 large parsnips, peeled and cut diagonally in half ( about 2 pounds ) | 2 cups leftover wine or 2 cups water | 1/4 cup vodka | 1 cup monterey jack pepper cheese, grated | 1/4 cup ranch dressing | lime wedge ( optional )
instructions: Place parsnips in a steamer basket in a saucepan with cold water to cover. Set over boiling water, cover, and steam parsnips until tender with fork, about 15 minutes. Drain and reserve liquid. Remove parsnips from steamer basket. Toss potatoes, parsnips, and cheese together. Divide among 4 - 6 plates. If desired, drizzle ranch dressing on top. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Garnish with lime wedges.

title: Homemade Cheese
ingredients: 2 lbs whey | 4 lbs cottage cheese | 6 tablespoons yoghurt ( see description )
instructions: Dissolve yoghurt and yeast in 1/2 cup warm water. Place in large bowl and add cottage cheese. Let rise until double. Punch down, stir and knead 1 - 2 minutes. Place in greased loaf pans, cover and set in a warmroom free place until doubled. Bake at 375 f for about 20 minutes or til edges are light golden brown. I've made these using a french onion bread loaf. Yield, about 8 servings with 1 loaf loaf or 4 breads.

Random Ingredients: kielbasa sausage,sauce,beef brisket,marinade,apple cider,orange peel,burrito flour tortilla
title: Kielbasa and Apple Tacos with Crispy Onion, Apple Cider and Orange Peel
ingredients: 3 sweet apples, peeled | 2 tablespoons orange peel, grated | 1 1/2 teaspoons hot sauce | 1 lb kielbasa sausage | 3/4 cup a.1. original sauce | 1 tablespoon steak sauce | 8 soft burrito-size flour tortillas | marinade, for brushing
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees. Put apples in an oven proof skillet and stir in the grated orange peel and hot sauce. Bring to a simmer. Simmer for 20 minutes, stirring often. Remove from the heat. Add the sausage directly into hot skillet. Stir until well browned. Pour a 1 1/2 cups a&ouille® original sauce into a small bowl. Stir in the steak sauce. Put 1/4 cup of the sausage mixture over the sausage in the skillet. Turn the heat to high and heat to medium or until the sausage is no longer pink, stirring often. The sausage mixture should simmer with no visible liquid inside of the skillet. Spread 1 tablespoon of the a&ouille® original sauce over the top of the hot sausage mixture. Place the tortillas on a baking sheet, sprayed with cooking spray or pam. Sprinkle with 1 cup salt. Bake at 400 degrees for 10 minutes. While the tortillas are baking, remove the toothpicks from the apple slices and cut in half lengthwise. Arrange on a serving plate. Spoon the rest of the a&ouille® sauce over top of the sliced apples. Serve the tacos with your favorite toppings.

title: Napa Goat's Feet
ingredients: 200 g rocket | 1 -2 jalapeno chile pepper, deseeded and finely sliced | 2 teaspoons celery seeds
instructions: Wash the rocket, and divide it among 4 serving bowls. Put the chili into a frying pan over medium heat, and stir for 5 minutes, or until the chili starts to color slightly. Stir in the celery and season with salt. Spoon the chili over the rocket. Serve warm or cold.

title: Spicy Japanese Salad Dressing
ingredients: 2/3 cup rice vinegar | 2 tablespoons tomato juice | 1/4 - 1/2 cup pizza sauce ( i recommend my light swiss roll )
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together rice vinegar, tomato juice, and hot pepper sauce until thoroughly blended. Slowly mix in remaining ingredients.

title: Guacamole and Eggplant With Prawns
ingredients: 4 avocados, peeled, flesh cut off, and sliced | 1/2 cup cooked king prawns, coarsely chopped | 2 large eggplants or 2 large zucchini | 1/4 cup roasted peanuts, coarsely chopped
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°c. Put the avocado flesh in a large bowl, then add the prawns and toss. Cut the eggplants lengthways into 1cm thick slices and toss through with the peanuts. Tear or break apart the zucchini in half. Cut the rind off the garlic with kitchen scissors, then slice crossways into long sticks. Put into a dish with the peanuts and toss with the prawns. Put into the oven and cook for 25 - 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: pineapple ring,egg noodle,part mozzarella cheese,pumpkin puree,bread,pork,lime juice
title: Stuffed Pork Loaf
ingredients: 1 package dried egg noodles | 1 1/2 cups canned pumpkin puree | 1/4 cup lime juice | 2 lbs ground pork | 2 cups shredded part-skim mozzarella cheese, divided | 1 large loaf, cut in half lengthwise and toasted ( or more ) | 10 thin fresh pineapple rings, coarsely chopped
instructions: Cook egg noodles in a large pot of boiling salted water until just tender, about 8 minutes. Drain and rinse under cold running water, then drain again. Preheat oven to 400°f. Butter a 10 by 10 inch baking dish or an 11 by 121 by 121/2 inch baking dish. In a large bowl, combine pumpkin puree, juice and 2 cups of the mozzarella with 1 cup of the mozzarella and set aside. Spread the egg noodles onto a large baking dish, then spread about 1/3 of the pumpkin mixture over noodles. Top with the pork and 1 1/2 cups sauce. Sprinkle with 1 1/2 cup the cheese and 1 1/2 cups of the sauce. Sprinkle with 1/2 of the remaining mozzarella and 1 cup of remaining sauce. Bake until cheese melts and bread is toasted, about 45 minutes. Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: beet,pimiento,italian bread,part mozzarella cheese,quinoa,gruyere cheese,purpose flour
title: Quinoa-Wwasserole
ingredients: 2 cups quinoa | 2 cans beets, drained and coarsely chopped | 4 slices italian bread, such as quesadilla | 8 ounces dry shredded part-skim mozzarella cheese | 8 ounces gruyere cheese, shredded | 1/4 cup chopped pimiento | 3 tablespoons all-purpose flour
instructions: Spread quinoa on a microwave safe plate, and set aside in the microwave for 3 minutes on high, stirring occasionally. Remove from microwave, let sit for 2 minutes. Meanwhile, spread canigots equally on 4 slices of bread, and place the remaining 4 slices on the other slices. Place the quinoa, beets, and mozzarella on 4 bread slices, and drizzle with olive oil and a sprinkle of gouda. Sprinkle with pimiento, and top with remaining bread slices. Sesame seeds also work nice if you can pop them in a little bit before baking. Place microwave safe plate on high, and heat for 5 minutes. Place in a 9x13 baking dish, and press out excess air. Cover, and keep for at least 35 minutes or up to 3 hours. Remove and allow to cool for 5 to 10 minutes before cutting slices. Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Rick's Famous Roast Beef Sandwiches and Gravy
ingredients: 2 lbs rump roast | 2 lbs beef stew meat | sugar
instructions: Cover meat with water. Bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer over low heat until meat is tender. About 1 1/2 hours. Remove meat and skim off grease. Add sugar to taste. Slice meat and pull meat from bones before serving. I usually leave slices on the bone.

title: Apple Kielbasa and Cognac
ingredients: 1 kielbasa or 1 other mild italian sausage, about 2 1/2 lbs ( or 1/4-1/2 lb sausage ) | 1 1/2 cups strong tea | 1 cup sugar | 1 lb grated peeled apple ( about 1 1/2 cups ) | 1 medium vanilla bean, split in thirds lengthwise | fresh curry leaf, leaves | 2 teaspoons baking powder ( optional ) | 1 -2 teaspoon vanilla sugar ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 f. In a large dutch oven or skillet, combine sausage with 1 cup water. Bring to boil over moderate heat. Drain sausage, reserving liquid, pour off fat. Cut sausage into 1/4 inch slices, add to liquid in the dutch oven. Add remaining ingredients, except vanilla sugar. Bring to boil, transfer to baking dish, making sure all sausage is moistened with liquid. Cover tightly and bake until apples are tender, about 35 to 40 minutes. Using slotted spoon, transfer sausage and liquid to bowl. Cover and return to oven while preparing dish. Boil juices in sauce pan until thick and syrupy, about 5 minutes. Pour 1 teaspoon vanilla into each cup of skimmed milk. Divide juice among each bowl, then pour over sausage and serve.

title: English Muffins Italian Style
ingredients: 2 cups prepared mustard seeds | 2 english muffins, split | 2 tablespoons crisp crisco | 1 teaspoon cinnamon | 1 teaspoon mixed italian parsley | 1/4 lb pepperoni, in thin strips
instructions: Preheat the broiler. Place mustard seeds in a small saucepan and cover with hot water. Bring to a boil, reduce the heat and simmer, covered, for 10 minutes. Drain and set aside to cool. Line a broiler tray with foil, leaving 3/4 of the space at the top. Place muffins on the prepared tray and coat with crisco. Sprinkle with the cinnamon, italian parsley and pepperoni. Place mustard seeds on top, and broil until pepperoni is bubbly, about 2 minutes.

Random Ingredients: cooking spray,allspice,barbecue sauce,heavy cream,poblano pepper,spanish onion
title: Portasteos de Pobres (Portuguese Onion and Pepper Sauce)
ingredients: 1/2 cup spanish onion, diced | 2 poblano peppers, seeded and diced | 1/4 cup spicy barbecue sauce | 2 tablespoons heavy cream | 1/2 teaspoon allspice | cooking spray
instructions: Coat a medium skillet with cooking spray. Over medium high heat, combine the onions, poblanos and poblano peppers. Season with sweet barbecue sauce. Cook and stir until most of the liquid evaporates, about 10 minutes, then stir in the cream and allspice. Continue cooking and stir until the sauce has the consistency of a sauce on a scrambled egg. Remove from heat and serve.

Random Ingredients: italian sausage,italian breadcrumb,garam masala,jalapeno,mustard powder,chicken cutlet
title: Baked Turkey Cutlets
ingredients: 1 lb jalapeno, chopped | 1 lb fresh italian sausage or 1 lb hot italian sausage, cut in 1 inch pieces | 1 tablespoon fresh mustard powder | 1 teaspoon garam masala | 1 teaspoon garam masala | 1 3/4 cups italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 2 lbs chicken cutlets, pounded to equal 1-inch thick
instructions: Preheat broiler. Combine jalepenos, sausage, mustard powder and garam masala in medium bowl.

title: Mexican Pasta With Nuts and Cashews
ingredients: 1 lb medium pasta | 2 bunches hazelnuts | 12 ounces monterey jack cheese, grated | 1 navel orange, peeled and grated | 2 tablespoons lard, heated | 1/2 cup cashews, chopped | 1/2 cup dried cranberries
instructions: In large pot of boiling water, cook, uncovered, macaroni until al dente. Meanwhile, heat oven to 375 degrees. Spray baking sheet with cooking spray. Cut hazelnuts in half, remove stems, and discard. Cut hazelnuts in half again, remove seeds. Using 1/4 cup hazelnuts and 1/4 cup cheese for the chips. Roll and place on sheet.

Random Ingredients: mustard green,bean,extra virgin olive oil,breadcrumb,orange zest,ice cream,beef brisket,lemon wedge
title: Beef Brisket Poached in Mustard
ingredients: 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 2 beef brisket | 2 cups breadcrumbs ( plain ) | 2 lemons, zest of, only, minced | 8 -12 mustard greens ( such as spinach, kale or mustard greens or your favourite greens ) | ice cream ( optional ) | 1 can refried beans ( such as guiness or lowfat ) | lemon wedge ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven on the broiler setting. Rinse the brisket well under cold water. Slice crosswise at the 1 inch intervals and place in a heavy oven proof pan. Drizzle each slice with 1 t of the olive oil. Sprinkle with 1 t bread crumbs, 1 lemon zest and 1 t minced garlic. Place a weight on top of the brisket and place under the broiler. Cook until the meat is browned and almost crispy, about one hour. If desired, garnish with a squeeze of lemon juice and serve with ice cream, sour cream, rice or potatoes.

Random Ingredients: lard,mustard powder,dill pickle,kielbasa,buttermilk,risotto rice,corn oil,orange zest
title: Kielbasa and Rice
ingredients: 1 tablespoon corn oil | 1/4 bag round dry mustard powder | 1 tablespoon grated orange zest | 1 tablespoon grated kielbasa | 1 1/2 cups risotto rice | 1/4 cup buttermilk | 1/2 cup canned mustard greens, drained and rinsed | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh dill pickles, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: In a saucepan, heat the oil over medium low heat. Gradually stir in the mustard powder until it starts to stick to the bottom. Stir in the grated orange zest. Add the kielbasa and stir to coat with the mustard powder, about a minute. Cook the kielbasa for about 5 minutes, stirring to soften, until browned and slightly crisp. Stir in the rice and buttermilk until the rice is coated in the mustard. Gently mix in half of the mustard greens and half of the pickles.

title: Tikka Mums
ingredients: 350 g lamb ( boneless diced ) | 1/2 cup yogurt ( low fat ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons chili bean | 1 tablespoon agave nectar ( or honey ) | 1/4 teaspoon chili powder or 1/4 crushed dried chili pepper flakes | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric | 3 chicken bouillon cubes | 3 tablespoons walnuts or 3 tablespoons pecans | 1 teaspoon agave nectar ( or honey ) | 1/4 teaspoon chili bean | 1/4 teaspoon garlic or 1/4 teaspoon garlic powder
instructions: Cut the lamb into small cubes. In a glass bowl, mix together yogurt, dried chili, ground coriander, chinese peppercorns or chilli paste, chopped garlic and agave nectar. In a saucepan, pour in 1/4 cup water and add stock cubes. Let simmer for 5 minutes, then lower to simmer and add lamb cubes. Cook for approx 1 hour or until the meat is tender. Add nuts/pecan pieces. If you like your meat crunchier, add a few tablespoons of honey and a teaspoon of agave/honey in the pot. Add more spices. Serve or allow to cool and refrigerate. Goes well with cooked rice.

Random Ingredients: cornflour,soy sauce,green chili,red curry paste,sunflower oil,spanish olive,beef tenderloin
title: Red Thai Beef Rolls
ingredients: 1 beef tenderloin | 2 ounces red curry paste or 2 ounces thai chiang mao red curry paste, available from asian food stores or 2 -3 dashes red pepper flakes | 4 tablespoons low sodium soy sauce | 2 tablespoons cornflour | 2 teaspoons sunflower oil | 12 ounces spanish olives or 12 ounces sicilian olives | red chili, strips to garnish
instructions: Make the curry paste by combining curry paste and 1/2 cup water and set aside for 20 minutes. Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a pan over medium high and add the beef and stir fry for one minute until cooked to your liking. Take it off to a plate and slice thinly. Heat the remaining tablespoon of oil in a pan over medium high heat and add the green chili strips or sicilian olives. Stir fry briefly until cooked. Mix the cornflour with a little water and add to the pan. Stir continuously until thick and bubbly then remove from heat. Cut the steak into 1/2in thick slices. Heat the remaining oil in a frying pan, add the beef and stir fry for 1 - 2 minutes. Add the curry paste and soy sauce and stir for 1 minute until the oil is starting to separate out of the gravy. Remove from heat and set aside to cool for one minute or two. Add the olives and chilli to the beef and fold in to combine. Serve with boiled rice and steamed greens.

title: Indian Pork Loin
ingredients: 1 kg boneless pork loin | 1/4 cup garam masala | 1 -2 green chili pepper | 4 -5 tablespoons raisins | 1 -2 fresh fruit
instructions: Marinate the pork loin overnight in 1 tablespoon of the garam masala along with 2 tablespoons water. Next morning, take pork out of marinade and add the other half of the garam masala. Place pork on tray and bake at 150 degrees c for 2 hours, basting the pork frequently.

title: Mexican Dipping Sauce - Simple and Simple!
ingredients: 1 cup mayonnaise | 1/2 cup mexican crema ( cream substitute ( for mexican crema substitutes ) | 1/2 cup tahini ( mayonnaise substitute ( for mexican crema substitute ) ) | 1 teaspoon red pepper flakes | cooking spray
instructions: Combine both ingredients and mix well. Cover and refrigerate until ready to use. Note, it can be prepared ahead and frozen for up to a month or over night. If preparing for a party, defrost the refrigerated mayonnaise dip and stir in it before serving. You can also refrigerate the dip until served cold for a healthier alternative.

Random Ingredients: white rum,pea,sherry wine vinegar,red bell pepper,pesto sauce,lettuce,rice flour
title: Pesto & Peas Salad With Wine Vinaigrette
ingredients: 1 cup pea, rinsed and drained | 2 cups lettuce, torn | 1 red bell peppers ( optional ) or 1 green bell pepper, sliced ( optional ) | 1/2 cup white rum | 1/3 cup prepared pesto sauce | 1/4 cup dry sherry wine vinegar | rice flour, for dusting salad
instructions: Combine pea, lettuce and bell peppers in a large bowl. Using a wooden spoon, stir in rum and pesto. Add vinegar and stir until blended. Sprinkle with rice flour. Stir until well combined.

title: Klefto
ingredients: 1 liter meat stock | 2 cardamom seeds
instructions: Put the stock in the pressure cooker. Add spices and stir to combine. Close the lid and set to medium heat for at least 30 minutes. Remove lid and stir through until you see little oil bubble up. Take off the heat and let sit for 10 minutes. Take out cardamom before serving.

title: Mom's Chop Suey
ingredients: 1 lb velveeta cheese | 2 -3 bunches bok choy ( depending on size ) | 1/2 cup frangelico | 1 1/2 cups flour
instructions: First we want to trim off tough ends of bok choy. Cut off top stem for veggies and wash well. I also chop bok choy roughly in a food processor, it really makes the job less clean. Heat oven to 325°f cut velveta into 1/2 1 inch cubes, use a food processor if you have a ratio for 1/2 meat to 1 cheese cube for each cube of velveta. Cut bok choy into 1/2 inch pieces, use a food processor if you have a ratio for 1/2 meat to 1 cheese cube for each cube of cheese. Cut off tops of bok choy and set aside. Cut off tops of bok choy and set aside. Boil water in a large pan, add veggies and boil covered for about 15 minutes, stir often. Stir in flour until well mixed together and return veggies to pan. Heat through, taste to see if you think it needs more salt. If it isn't, add extra cheese. If not, stir in frangelico. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: button mushroom,catsup,red capsicum,coconut milk,white sugar,lemon peel,icing sugar
title: Coconut Chicken
ingredients: 2 cups thick coconut milk | 1/2 cup shredded coconut ( plain rice milk can be used ) | 1 lemon peel, grated | 1/2 teaspoon melted soft butter ( optional ) | 1 medium red capsicum, diced ( bell pepper can be used too ) | 1/4 cup white sugar | 1 cup chopped button mushrooms
instructions: Combine all ingredients except mushrooms in medium bowl. Cover and refrigerate for half an hour or longer. Heat griddle or frying pan over medium heat. Cook chicken mixture, turning occasionally, until no longer pink, about 30 minutes. Transfer chicken to warm serving plate. Stir mushrooms into chicken mixture. Spoon sauce over chicken. Serve.

title: Zesty Pepper Dipping Sauce - Salsa Verde
ingredients: 1 can poblano peppers or 12 ounces canned piquillo peppers, chopped | 1/2 cup half-and-half | 3 tablespoons lemon pepper | 3 dashes tabasco sauce
instructions: Dissolve tabasco sauce and lemon pepper in half and half in a medium bowl.

title: Mushroom Teriyaki Steak
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs skirt steaks | 1 large egg yolk | 12 dried shiitake mushrooms | 1 tablespoon canned crushed red pepper
instructions: Place the steaks in a dish and cover with water. Refrigerate for 1 hour. Preheat oven to combine the egg yolk, mushrooms, red pepper and pour over the steaks. Cover the pan and place in the oven. Reduce temperature to 325 degrees, bake for 55 minutes turning steaks halfway through.

title: Easy Delicious Easy Tomato Soup
ingredients: 9 cups homemade chicken broth | 11 ounces stewed tomatoes ( undrained )
instructions: Combine ingredients in a 5 quart crock. Heat on high for 5 - 6 minutes or low for 5 minutes stirring occasionally. For a thicker sauce, you can use vegetable or potato broth with it.

Random Ingredients: salt black pepper,risotto rice,bacon,white vinegar,cranberry,whipping cream,cream cottage cheese,beef stock
title: Saucy Cranberry Risotto
ingredients: 5 slices bacon, chopped | 2 cups risotto rice | 2 cups sour cream ( i use low fat ) | 1 3/4 cups double cream-style cottage cheese | 1/2 cup white vinegar | 1 1/2 cups beef stock | salt & freshly ground black pepper | 3 ounces bacon-cooked bacon, cut into 1/2 inch pieces
instructions: Fry the bacon with the 2 cups rice until light brown. Drain off the excess fat. Set aside. Mix all of the ingredients, except bacon, into the remaining 2 cups rice, making sure to coat everything in the mixture evenly. Put the bacon pieces in the frying pan, and fry over fairly low heat for approx five minutes, stirring continuously. Pour the drained rice mixture into the pan, and stir until the mixture is well mixed. Heat through. Serve in warmed soup bowls with lots of crunchy bacon on top for garnish, if desired.

title: Apricot and Green Onion Salad
ingredients: 2 spring onions, thinly sliced | 1/4 cup apricot jam, warmed | 1/2 cup pitted and sliced ripe olives
instructions: Arrange spring onions on serving plate or platter. Arrange apricot and green onion over top. Serve warm with warm, not hot, breadcrumbs. Makes 4 servings.

Random Ingredients: caper,cheddar cheese,stilton cheese,yellow onion,shortcrust pastry,chili paste,carrot
title: Stilton Pizza
ingredients: 2 sheets shortcrust pastry | 1 medium yellow onion | 1 medium carrot | 50 g cheddar cheese | 150 g stilton cheese | 1 pinch chili paste ( to taste ) | 1 - ounce capers or 1 - ounce speckled caper
instructions: Finely dice onion and carrot, and finely dice stilton or speckled capers. Preheat oven to 400 degrees, or if not using cheddar, grate or crumble chedder cheese with the appropriate ingredients. On a floured surface, roll out one sheet of pastry to about 10x12/1 cm. Place on top of other sheet and cut out four circles with a pizza cutter. Place on a lightly greased baking sheet and cook according to the times of your oven's temperature's. If using cheese, use an oiled cookie cutter, and place the pizza in it. The pizza needs to be cooked but not soft and dry. Add the onion, carrot, and capers to the cooked pizza, if using chedder or speckled capers. Add a little hot water or a little extra flour to just make sure the cheese is melting. Cook for 10 - 15 minutes, or until the base of the pizza is slightly browned. Allow 10 - 15 minutes to cool before adding the topping or topping. This recipe can be made quite quickly before serving, but be aware that the topping often falls off the edge of the pizza base, forming an airtight container for your toppings to melt alongside.

Random Ingredients: cream cheese,sultana,bread crumb,apricot preserve,cranberry,lemon juice zest,cremini mushroom
title: Tasty Cranberry Dressing
ingredients: 3 packages cream cheese, room temperature | 1 cup chopped dried apricot preserves | 1 lemon, juice and zest of, grated | 3/4 cup dried cranberries | 1/2 cup sultana | 1/2 cup dried cremini mushroom, halved | 4 cups dry bread crumbs
instructions: Cream the cream cheese until it is the texture of cream cheese. Blend in the apricot preserves lemon juice and zest, cranberries, sultanas, mushrooms and crumbs. Refrigerate.

title: Italian Heirloom Heirloom Tomatoes
ingredients: 18 ounces fresh ripe heirloom tomatoes | 12 -14 fresh figs ( about 2 pounds ) | 1/3 lb ground pork | 1/3 cup fresh basil leaf, chopped
instructions: Prepare the tomatoes before using. Cut the tomatoes in half crosswise and discard the core. Remove the seeds and the membrane but do not seed them. Slice the tomatoes, remove the pulp and stems but leave them intact. Lay them out on a clean flat surface and lay a few slices of the fresh figs on each slice. Place each fig in a small saute pan and sprinkle them with salt or pepper. Grill the figs until they are lightly toasted and turning the figs over until they're glazed about 5 to 10 minutes. Serve the toasted figs piled on top of each fig and fig tomato on a platter. Sprinkle with chopped basil.

title: Chipotle Shrimps
ingredients: 24 tiger shrimp, peeled | 1 cup semolina flour, or as needed | 12 stalks escarole, chopped | 3 chipotle chiles, chopped
instructions: Place tiger shrimp halves, cut side down, in a blender. Pour black sesame seeds, 1 tablespoon chipotle chile pepper sauce, 1 tablespoon semolina meal, 1 tablespoon semolina flour, or as needed to coat shrimp. Blend until coarsely chopped, about 45 seconds. Set shrimp aside. Heat 1 tablespoon chipotle chile pepper sauce, 1 tablespoon semolina meal, 1 tablespoon semolina flour, or as needed, in a large skillet over medium high heat. Cook and stir shrimp until golden brown and beginning to show pink color, about 3 minutes. Transfer to a warmed platter. Repeat with remaining shrimp, remaining chile pepper sauce, and remaining semolina meal mixture. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: white sugar,cream chicken soup,basmati rice,chuck steak,lettuce leaf,green bean
title: Slow Cooker Beef Banh Mi
ingredients: 1 lb chuck steak, cut into cubes | 2 cans condensed cream of chicken soup, undiluted | 1 1/2 cups basmati rice, uncooked | 1/2 pound fresh green beans, trimmed | 1 packet frozen chopped green beans | 8 large lettuce leaves | white sugar, sprinkled over top
instructions: Combine chuck and soup in a 3 1/2 to 6 quart slow cooker. Stir in rice, green beans, and green beans. Cover.

title: Walnut and Olive Puffed pumpkin With Maple Syrup
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 1 teaspoon caster sugar | 500 g butternut squash, peeled, staled and cut into 3cm chunks | 1/2 cup walnuts, coarsely chopped | 3/4 cup pimento stuffed olive, chopped | 1/4 cup pure maple syrup
instructions: Combine the cornstarch and caster sugar in a large bowl and slowly whisk in the walnuts and olives until evenly coated in the syrup. Drain the pumpkin and add to the walnut mixture. Stir well to combine and transfer to the baking tray. Bake in a preheated hot oven 180c for about 30 minutes or until the pumpkin has puffed up and cooked. Stand about 5 minutes and carefully unmold onto a serving platter.

title: Easy Salsa II
ingredients: 1 can stewed tomatoes with green chiles | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chiles, drained
instructions: In a saucepan over medium heat, combine stewed tomatoes with green chile and diced tomatoes with juices. Simmer 25 minutes. Remove from heat.

Random Ingredients: egg yolk,sea scallop,vegetable shortening,sambal oelek,nonfat milk,plain yogurt
title: Sea Scallops With Sweet Yogurt Cream
ingredients: 1 lb sea scallops | 1/8 cup nonfat milk | 2 egg yolks | 1 tablespoon vegetable shortening ( or melted butter ) | 3 tablespoons plain yogurt ( plain or greek yogurt ) | 1 pinch ground sambal oelek ( optional )
instructions: If using an egg substitute, whisk together yolks and shortening until blended. Place scallops in a nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Brush the scallops with milk. Bake in the hot skillet until the flesh is no longer translucent, about 5 to 7 minutes. Turn, and bake 5 to 7 minutes more. Remove from the skillet, and set aside to cool slightly. Remove the scallops from the skillet, and place in the container with the yogurt. Refrigerate until chilled but not mushy. If desired, sprinkle sambal oelek over the top before serving, to spice up the cream.

title: Corn Chips (Cookn' Chips)
ingredients: 2 cups whole kernel corn | 3 cups flour | 3/4 cup cooking oil
instructions: Put all into a deep pan in a single layer. Mix well. Pour oil all over them. The idea is that you don't touch corn mixture with fingers or a fork. Sprinkle corn chips between the palms of your hands. Fry till the corn chips are soft and crispy. Store in airtight bottles.

Random Ingredients: bread machine yeast,kaffir lime leaf,puff pastry,milk chocolate chip
title: Chocolate Chip Kaffir Lime Tarts
ingredients: 2 1/2 teaspoons bread machine yeast | 1 cup milk chocolate chips | 1/4 cup kaffir lime leaf, finely shredded | 1/4 cup thawed frozen puff pastry
instructions: Place the yeast in a large bowl. Place the chocolate in an electric mixer with the kaffir lime leaves, and slowly add the milk chocolate chips. Beat until smooth, and set aside for 10 minutes, then stir in the dough. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface, and knead in the dough at least 2 times. Divide the dough into 3 pieces. Press the dough into muffin tins to about 3/4 inch thick. Allow the dough to rise in the refrigerator for about 30 minutes. Preheat the oven to 400°f. Carefully transfer the dough pieces onto a baking sheet. Bake the tart shells for 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until they appear to be puffed and lightly golden. Allow to cool for a minute or two before removing the tart shells from the tin. Cool completely on a wire rack.

Random Ingredients: red cabbage,deli roast beef,leek,white wine vinegar,onion soup mix,chicken breast,green chilies,sugar
title: Roast Beef and Leek Salad
ingredients: 1 cup diced chicken breast | 1 cup thinly sliced leek | 1 medium red cabbage, shredded | 1/4 cup dry white wine vinegar | 1/4 cup sugar | 1 tablespoon onion soup mix | 1 can diced green chilies | 8 slices deli roast beef
instructions: Pre heat oven to 400 degrees. Mix ingredients in order above. Put on a lightly greased baking pan. Bake for 30 minutes.

title: Homemade Cumin Powder
ingredients: 1/4 teaspoon cumin powder | 1/4 teaspoon chinese five spice powder
instructions: Heat dry ingredients together in a nonstick pan over medium low heat. Stir as needed until the smoke rises or the spice begins to darken around the edge. Transfer the ground spices to a small air tight container. Allow 10 minutes to cool. Store in an air tight container.

Random Ingredients: barley,white rice,lime juice zest,rigatoni pasta,taco seasoning mix,sushi rice,vanilla extract
title: Sweet Stuffed Rice Balls(Sushi)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups japanese sushi-style rice | 1/2 cup uncooked white rice ( japanese rice is best ) | 2 tablespoons granulated garlic ( or more, to taste ) | 1 lime, juice and zest of | 2 1/2 tablespoons taco seasoning mix | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1 1/2 cups cooked barley ( japanese rice rice must be in the bag ) | 1 package raw rice balls ( about 26 small-size balls ) | 1 package raw sushi rice
instructions: In a saucepan with about 2 inches of water, bring the rice to a boil and cover. Reduce heat to low and simmer, cooking 15 to 20 minutes, or until tender and liquid is absorbed. Let cool, then fluff with a fork. Set rice aside and cover. For the sushi, in a medium saucepan, combine the rice, granulated garlic and lime zest. Cook over medium heat until aromatic and the garlic is soft, about 5 minutes. Transfer to a bowl to cool completely. In separate bowl, whisk together the taco seasoning mix, vanilla and lime juice. Stir the rice into the spice mixture until completely coated. Preheat a griddle or large frying pan over medium high heat. Take 1/3 cup rice and make sure it is well coated. Dip each grain in the hot rice to cover completely. When the rice has softened a bit, remove from the heat, but leave some rice on the bottom. Spread a teaspoonful of the rice mixture in the palm of your hand, leaving a 1/4 inch border around the edge. With your thumb, wet the rice and spread a 1inch mound in the center of the rice from the sides. Turn the rice in the palm. Add about 1 1/2 tablespoons of the rice mixture to the rice in the mound, spreading the rice with about 1 teaspoonfuls of lime juice. Make another mound in the center. Now, using your thumb, wet the rice with about 1 teaspoonfuls of lime juice. Spread about 1 1/2 tablespoons of the rice mixture in the center of the rice mound, leaving a generous mound of rice on the bottom. Repeat with another 1/3 cup rice and rice mixture. The rice sticks to the fingers. Cook the rice balls for 2 to 3 minutes, until the rice is warmed through and the balls have a firm touch. Remove from the griddle and keep warm. Turn the rice balls upside down on a paper towel lined rack to dry slightly. Transfer the rice balls to a serving platter. Meanwhile, in a large saucepan, cover the sushi rice with water and bring to a boil. Cover, reduce heat, and simmer 15 to 20 minutes, or until completely tender. Drain and keep warm. Cook the raw rice balls according to the package directions. Set aside. When the rice balls are cool enough to handle, remove and let cool completely on a clean, dry surface. Cut into 1/4 inch wide strips and divide among 4 serving plates.

Random Ingredients: pork roast,mint leaf,yellow onion,lemon juice zest,coffee,brown lentil,green chilies

title: Mandarin Orange Salad
ingredients: 1 can mandarin oranges, drained | 2 tablespoons vinegar | 1 dash hot pepper sauce
instructions: Drain oranges. Arrange oranges in a salad bowl.

title: Tortellini Wrapped in Shiitake Mushrooms, Tortellini

instructions: Rinse the mushrooms, and set aside. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook the tortellini according to the package directions. title: Kahlua Green Pea Avocados

title: Crock Pot  Whole Stove Top Ricotta With  Chicken
