Bring mixture to a bubble, then reduce heat to medium low. Simmer, covered, for 30 - 45 minutes to one hour, or until beef is tender. Serve over white rice.

title: Crispy Slow Cooked Corned Beef
ingredients: 3 lbs corned beef brisket, meat trimmed | 3 1/2 teaspoons beef base | 1/2 - 3/4 cup all-natural natural chicken stock or 1/2-3/4 cup low sodium chicken broth
instructions: Cut up corned beef and place in a slow cooker. Pour in broth. Stir in beef base. Cover and cook on low setting 5 - 7 hours. Note, if you may not use all the broth in this recipe the desired amount will be left in the cooking pot.

title: Chinese Barbecue Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 12 large pimientos, peeled and seeded | 3 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 1/3 cup dark sesame oil, or as needed
instructions: Spread pimiento shavings onto a large, heavy dish. Combine sesame oil and 4 tablespoons of dark sesame oil in a small bowl.

Random Ingredients: mango,gelatin,chuck,green tomato,lime juice,pork loin,creme fraiche,nonfat milk
title: Chilean Mini Meatball Sandwiches
ingredients: 4 teaspoons unflavored gelatin ( see notes ) | 4 ounces lean ground chuck | 1/2 cup nonfat milk | 1/2 cup light cream or 1/2 cup creme fraiche | 2 tablespoons lowfat creme fraiche | 8 lean boneless pork loin ( about 1 1/2 lbs. ) | 4 green tomatoes, halved lengthwise | 1 small mango, peeled, sliced crosswise into 8 thin wedges | 2 tablespoons fresh lime juice
instructions: Prepare the gelatin per package directions and set aside. Preheat oven to 450ºf. Place one tablespoon of gelatin in each of 2 small nonstick skillet and set over medium high heat. Toast until it begins to turn golden, about 1 minute. Transfer to small bowl and let cool. Meanwhile, cook the pork over medium high heat until no longer pink, about 8 minutes. Transfer the cooked pork to a bowl with a slotted spoon, leaving the grease in the skillet. Drain the fat from the pork with the drippings and reserve. Return the meat to the skillet and cook, stirring occasionally, until it loses its red color, about 5 minutes. Whisk the milk, cream, and creme fraiche in a medium bowl until combined. Spread one third of the cream mixture in each of the prepared mini meatball croperoles and top with one third each of the sliced pork and tomato halves. Return both to the skillet and set aside to set the sandwiches while you finish preparing the rest of the sandwiches. Arrange the meatballs on a baking sheet and place them on the grill. Cook, turning once, until cooked through, about 2 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate using a slotted spoon and loosely cover with foil. Cook the green tomatoes and mango for 2 minutes. Drizzle with lime juice.

Random Ingredients: sugar,white balsamic vinegar,chickpea flour,graham cracker crumb,leek
title: Chickpea and Leek Dip
ingredients: 1 medium leek, sliced ( white and light green parts only! ) | 3 cups cooked chickpea flour ( or cornflour ) | 1/2 cup graham cracker crumbs | 1/4 cup white balsamic vinegar | 1/2 cup granulated sugar | 2 -3 tablespoons white balsamic vinegar
instructions: Blend or process the ingredients to a smooth, velvety cream. Chill overnight to allow flavors to develop, or serve in a tall glass bowl with a dollop of whipped cream on top if desired. Serve with your favourite sandwich, such as cheddar bread, bread or fresh veggies.

title: Beef Liver Pate
ingredients: 2 lbs lean stew meat, diced | 2 lbs venison, lean ground round | 1 cup italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 2 cups fruit, crushed ripe | 1 lb beef liver, raw, sliced
instructions: Add all ingrediants except liver to a food processor bowl. Puree. Add liver and mix well. Pour into small pate jars and store in a cool place for up to 1 week.

title: Sweet Potatoes With Soy Sauce, Low Fat & Crispy
ingredients: 350 g sweet potatoes | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce | 4 cups ice water
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200c. Cook the potatos until tender, around 18 minutes depending on your preference of size. Pierce each potato with a fork then bake for 25 - 30 minutes until tender. Allow to cool then scoop into a dish to serve. Combine the sweet potato through the soy sauce. Divide between serving plates and top with crispy coconut milk.

Random Ingredients: peanut oil,barbecue sauce,pear,thyme sprig,tarragon vinegar,white bread,herring fillet
title: Herring in Sweet Vinegar (Senegalese)
ingredients: 1/2 cup sweet vinegar | 2 tablespoons peanut oil or 2 tablespoons other neutral oil | fresh thyme sprig, to garnish | 1 tablespoon fresh tarragon vinegar | 2 sweet pears, cored and thickly sliced | 4 whole dried herring fillets, cut into 8 pieces | 3 slices country style white bread, toasted
instructions: Put the vinegar in a small saucepan with the oil and thyme and simmer until reduced by 1 tablespoon, about 10 minutes. Preheat broiler. Place the pears in a baking dish and brush with oil. Broil the pears 1 1/2 to 2 inches from the heat, turning a few times, until the skin is blistered all over. Remove and cool. Split the herring fillets lengthwise into 8 equal slices. Set aside. Spread the bread slices with the vinegar sauce. Arrange the pears on top of the bread slices. Scatter them with the herring fillets. Broil the herring about 3 inches from the heat 1 minute or until the bread is lightly toasted and pears are crisp and hot. Remove and cool and serve.

title: Potato Stix
ingredients: 10 shiitake mushrooms, sliced | 1 teaspoon golden syrup | 2 celery ribs, sliced | 1 medium sweet potato, peeled and thinly sliced
instructions: Place the mushrooms and syrup in a fry pan. Heat and fry for 2 minutes, stirring. Serve and stir through the sweet potato.

title: Chipotle Peppers Stuffed
ingredients: 2 pounds boneless pork loin | 3/8 cup seasoned bread crumbs | 1/4 cup sweet corn or 1/4 cup sweet and sour cream | chipotle peppers | 3 tablespoons chopped olives | 1 1/2 cups confectioners'sugar
instructions: Wash the loins of pork thoroughly under cold water. Pat dry with paper towels. Cut a slit in the center and stuff all sides with the bread crumbs. Preheat oil in a deep fryer or large saucepan to 375 degrees f. Cut a slit on one side of the loin to allow the stuffing to drain. Place in a large container, and carefully insert the chopped olives. Dust with the confectioners' sugar. Cover, and refrigerate the mixture for 1 to 3 days. Cut a cone shape about 1 1/2 inch wide from the loaf and stuff with stuffing. Re wrap, and chill until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: red pepper flake,creamy peanut butter,pork roast,catsup,paprika
title: Slow Cooker Tangy Hungarian Beef
ingredients: 2 tablespoons catsup | 2 tablespoons creamy peanut butter | 1 tablespoon paprika | 1 tablespoon red pepper flakes | 2 lbs boneless pork roast
instructions: In a bowl, combine catsup, peanut butter, paprika and red pepper flakes. Place pork pieces in bottom of 5 qt slow cooker. Sprinkle with catsup mixture. Cover and cook 8 - 10 hours on high. Remove meat to a cutting board. Allow to rest 10 minutes before slicing.

title: Tomato Salad II
ingredients: 1 can condensed tomato soup | 1/4 cup watermelon juice | 3 tablespoons pineapple juice | 1 1/2 teaspoons fish sauce | 1 teaspoon almond extract | 1/2 cup margarine, melted
instructions: In a large bowl, stir the tomato soup, watermelon juice, pineapple juice, fish sauce and almond extract with a fork until well combined. Pour the hot margarine into a shallow dish. Dip the floured slouice of margarine into the margarine and then shake off excess. Drizzle the margarine coated slouge over the salad and chill at least 6 hours. Sprinkle salads with ground black pepper to taste.

Random Ingredients: sage leaf,spinach leaf,fajita seasoning mix,swiss cheese,yukon gold potato,water chestnut
title: Bacon and Swiss Potatoes
ingredients: 2 1/4 lbs yukon gold potatoes | 8 slices swiss cheese | 12 ounces water chestnuts, sliced | 1/3 cup chopped fresh sage leaf | 1/4 teaspoon dry fajita seasoning mix | 1/3 cup thousand island dressing
instructions: Bake potatoes, covered, in a 400 degree f. Oven for 35 - 40 minutes or until done. While potatoes are baking, brown onion and water chestnuts in a medium sauté pan. When potatoes are done, drain and let cool for 5 minutes. Dice potatoes add onions and water chestnuts to potatoes in pan. Stir fry for 2 minutes. Remove 1/2 of the potatoes to a serving platter. Add sage, fajita seasoning and dressing to the potato mixture. Toss to combine. Serve with remaining potatoes.

Random Ingredients: salt,buttermilk,gherkin,cream chicken soup,red pepper flake,rice wine
title: Grammy's Spicy Rice Soup
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups buttermilk | 2 cans condensed cream of chicken soup | 1/4 cup minced fresh gherkin | 3/4 cup rice wine, divided | 1/2 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 1 teaspoon salt
instructions: In a large pitcher, combine buttermilk, cream of chicken soup, gherkin, rice wine, red pepper flakes and salt. Mix well and refrigerate overnight in the refrigerator, or until it can be served.

Random Ingredients: mace,mix,sun tomato oil,chicken,vegetable oil,white pepper,limeade concentrate,confectioner ' sugar
title: Pollo con Merengo (Chicken on Rice)
ingredients: 1 chicken, cut into pieces ( per package directions, you 'll cook the chicken while it's cooking ) | 1/4 cup vegetable oil | salt and white pepper ( to seasoned chicken ) | 2 tablespoons limeade concentrate ( concentrate ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace | 1/2 teaspoon white pepper | confectioners'sugar | 1 bottle red and black plum salsa ( peruvian medium-vinaigrette )
instructions: In a large plastic bag, combine the prepared chicken with the vegetable oil, salt and pepper. Add the limeade concentrate, mace and white pepper. Seal bag, shake to mix evenly and allow to marinate at least an hour. In a large pot over medium heat, boil enough water to cover the chicken. Add the chicken to the pot and cook for one hour. Drain the liquid. Sprinkle with confectioners' sugar and additional salsa, if desired.

Random Ingredients: parmigiano reggiano cheese,cooking oil,vegetable oil,fish,rigatoni pasta
title: Chef John's Rigatoni
ingredients: cooking oil, divided | 1 package rigatoni pasta | 2 pounds fresh fish fillets, cut into chunks | 1/2 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Lightly coat a 9x13 inch baking dish with cooking spray. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook rigatoni in the boiling water for 7 minutes, or until al dente. Drain, and return to the pot. Heat 2 tablespoons vegetable oil in a skillet over medium high heat, and place fish in the skillet. Season with salt and pepper and cook and stir until fish is golden brown. Season with 2 tablespoons of parmigiano reggiano cheese. Set aside the fish. Pour the remaining 2 tablespoons of vegetable oil, and 1 tablespoon of olive oil, into a deep, 9x13 inch baking dish. Place the rigatoni in the skillet over medium heat, and stir to coat evenly with oil. Cook and stir until the rigatoni is golden brown and crisp, and the edges have turned a deep red color, about 3 minutes. Remove the baking dish to the oven. Place the cod into the skillet with the fried fish, and sprinkle with remaining cheese. Return to the oven, and bake until cheese is melted, about 10 minutes.

title: Courgettes With Semolina and Mustard
ingredients: 7 tablespoons wholemeal dijon mustard | 600 g courgettes | 50 g semolina
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 deg c/400 deg f/gas mark 4 and line a baking tray with baking paper. Place the courgettes on the tray in a single layer, about 4 5cm/1in thick, depending on how long they stand. Mix the mustard with the semolina, then spread evenly over the courgettes. Roast for 15 - 20 minutes, or until the semolina is golden and starting to crisp up. Serve straight away with bread or crackers.

title: Apple Meat (Krautse)
ingredients: 600 g lean stewing meat | 1 cup chopped tart apple | 2 teaspoons red chili powder
instructions: Grind apples in a mixer till smooth and slightly coloured. In a large bowl, blend finely ground apples and the chilli powder. Roll meat and add to the ground apples, mix well. Cover and refrigerate till needed. Serve with flat bread and raita.

title: Simple Vietnamese Chopped Salad
ingredients: 2 tablespoons chopped of fresh mint | 2 -3 leaves lettuce
instructions: Combine toasted lettuce leaves, mint and finely chopped fresh garlic. Add 2 - 2 1/2 teaspoonfuls of chopped fresh mint and mix well.

Random Ingredients: ketchup,red curry paste,pearl barley,peanut oil,green bean
title: Tikka's Satay With Green Beans & Pearl Barley
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups pearl barley or 1 1/2 cups whole grain rice, rinsed | 1 1/4 cups ketchup | 1 cup peanut oil | 1 -2 tablespoon red curry paste ( i like thai ) | 1 1/2 lbs fresh green beans or 1 1/2 lbs frozen green beans
instructions: Put rice in a bowl with water to cover and leave in the wok over med heat for 12 - 18 minutes. Drain, rice and leave wok. Mix all ingredients together except beans, cover and let stand in fridge for an hour or more. Stir in beans. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: barbecue sauce,onion soup mix,dark soy sauce,hot pepper,lime juice,cilantro leaf,purpose flour
title: Tangy Sweet Corn Salsa
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh cilantro leaves, stems included | 1 sweet onion soup mix | 2 tablespoons hot pepper flakes | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce | 1 tablespoon lime juice | 3 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 2 tablespoons barbecue sauce
instructions: Blend cilantro, onion soup mix, hot pepper flakes, dark soy sauce, lime juice, flour, and barbecue sauce in a blender until blended. Pour into a resealable plastic bag, add salsa, and massage well to coat. Seal, and refrigerate 1 to 4 hours before serving.

title: French Cheese Soup (Chedder)
ingredients: 1/2 tablespoon vegetable broth | 1/2 teaspoon dried anise seeds | shredded gruyere cheese | 6 tablespoons fresh cream or 6 tablespoons yogurt
instructions: Bring broth to a boil in a small saucepan. Add saeeds and bring to a simmer. Add cheese and simmer 15 minutes. To serve, place soup in a cheese cloth bag, suspend bag over bowl and force cheese through. Serve in a large warmed bowl, garnished with sour cream.

Random Ingredients: apple,topping,dill seed,red cabbage,date,raspberry preserve,cooking oil,red lentil
title: Danish Apple Lentil Salad
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cooking oil | 1 small red cabbage, finely chopped | 1 cup split red lentils | 1 tablespoon dill seed | 2 medium apples, cored, chopped | 12 dates or 12 other dried fruits | 1 container frozen whipped topping, thawed | 3/4 cup raspberry preserves, drained
instructions: Warm oil in skillet. Add cabbage and stir fry just until cabbage just starts to wilt. Add lentils, dill seeds and apples and toss. Top with whipped topping. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: cream chicken soup,wasabi paste,masa harina flour,stewing beef,meatball,soy sauce,pork belly
title: Ebi
ingredients: 3/4 lb stewing beef, cubed | 3/4 lb boneless pork belly, cubed | 4 tablespoons masa harina flour | 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1 1/2 tablespoons soy sauce | 1 lb frozen meatballs, thawed | wasabi paste
instructions: In a gallon size ziplock bag, pour some boiling water so the marinated beef and pork butt are coated with plastic wrap. Allow to sit for 1 hour. Drain any excess moisture. Add beef and pork to bag and turn bag to coat. Marinate for 3 hours. Meanwhile, in a medium bowl, combine masa harina, soup, soy sauce and meatballs. Mix well. Set out some of the meatballs and make a line down the center of the bag. Slightly open top bag. Place two or three of the meatballs on top and continue to roll. Tie the roll with twine like kitchen twine. Repeat with remaining meat and meatballs. Fill a pan with water and put some oil on bottom and add the rolls. Cover and cook on low heat until meat is tender. Serve with wasabi paste.

title: Chili Barbecue Beef and Beans
ingredients: 8 -10 ounces roast ( i like a combo of flank steak and skirt steak ) | cooking wine or beer | 1 packet chili seasoning mix
instructions: In a small sauce pan, add the dry chili seasoning mix, making sure to coat the meat evenly. Heat in about 20 minutes, until it is heated through and slightly browned. About 10 minutes before serving, add the meat to the simmering wine or beer. Cook until the liquid is gone. The meat will need to cook in the oven. After about 30 minutes the meat will get very tender it does not matter much.

title: Lite Olive Oil
ingredients: 6 tablespoons lite olive oil | 6 tablespoons minced fresh mace
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a jar with a tight fitting lid. Store in the refrigerator until needed.

title: Caramelized Mango & Mango Lasagna
ingredients: 2 tablespoons fast rise yeast, granules | 1 cup thinly sliced carrot | 1 cup ripe mango, sliced | 12 uncooked lasagna noodles ( about two 13 oz. packages ) | 1 teaspoon ground nutmeg
instructions: In a small food processor, combine the yeast and 1 teaspoon of the sugar. Blend until fine, about 1 minute. Scrape into a bowl.

title: Cheesy Red Raisin Sauce and Filling
ingredients: 1 jar alfredo sauce | 1/2 bag crushed corn flakes | 1 jar golden raisins | 4 -6 radishes, chopped | 1/3 cup dry sherry
instructions: In a bowl combine all the ingredients.

title: Paneer(An Indian Dessert)
ingredients: 400 ml coconut milk | 400 ml corn oil | 1 cup dried currants
instructions: Wash currants in cold water. Dry fry in the corn oil. Add the currants fry for 5 minutes. Set aside. Pour cream over the currants and refrigerate, stir well. Serve chilled.

Random Ingredients: red chili pepper flake,pie shell,serrano chili,soba noodle,lime peel,yellow bell pepper,fennel,oatmeal
title: Jamaican Pepper Pie
ingredients: 2 cups soba noodles | 2 tablespoons ground fennel | 2 tablespoons lime peel, grated | 1 1/2 tablespoons dried red chili peppers, flakes | 1/2 cup yellow bell pepper, diced | 1/4 cup serrano chili, minced | 1 teaspoon lime peel, grated | 1 package refrigerated rolled oats
instructions: In saucepan of boiling salted water, cook soba noodles until just tender, about 8 minutes. Drain, and rinse under cold water.

Random Ingredients: adobo seasoning,cocoa,red snapper fillet,lamb shoulder,serrano chili,quail,cake flour,sage leaf
title: Mexican Style Spicy Whole Roasted Snapper
ingredients: 1/2 cup all purpose cake flour | 1/4 cup unsweetened cocoa | 1/2 teaspoon ground sage leaves | 1/8 teaspoon adobo seasoning | 8 ounces whole red snapper fillets, cut into 6 pieces | salt and cayenne pepper to taste | 2 serrano chili, minced | 1 pound red snapper fillets, cut into 2 inch chunks
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. In a medium bowl, stir together flour, cocoa, sage, and adobo seasoning. Toss fish pieces in seasoned flour until coated, and place in a large resealable plastic bag. Pour in water to just coating the fillets. Shake the bag to coat fish, and transfer to a large resealable plastic bag. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour. Remove fish, and shake off excess flour and season with salt and cayenne pepper. Arrange fish in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Spoon chile and chili sauce evenly over fish pieces, and cover with aluminum foil. Bake in the preheated oven for 30 minutes. Uncover, and bake 15 to 20 minutes more, until fish flakes easily with a fork.

title: Cheesy Potato Lasagna
ingredients: 2 packages cheese tortellini, cut into 6 pieces | 1 pound frozen, chopped potatoes, thawed and drained | 1 package kielbasa, cut into 1/2 inch pieces | 1/2 cup grand marnier | 2/3 cup rum | 2 tablespoons confectioners'sugar | 3 tablespoons rum | 1/2 teaspoon italian seasoning
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Lightly grease a 9x13 inch baking dish. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Place the tortellini, potatoes, kielbasa and grand marnier in a saucepan over moderate heat.

title: Saumon Aji Verde
ingredients: 1 cup rum ( vermicelli ) | 1/2 cup chopped fresh cilantro ( i use a blend of cilantro and mint but fresh would also be good ) | fresh flat-leaf parsley, chopped
instructions: Stir vermicelli until well mixed. Stir in cilantro and parsley. Store in an airtight container in refrigerator.

title: Cranberry Dill Tomato and Cabbage Rolls
ingredients: 1 pint tomatoes with juice | 1 teaspoon dry mustard | 1 cup dry cranberries | 1/2 cup sliced olive | 1 package grape leaves ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon peppermint extract | 1 small red cabbage, coarsely shredded
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Bring about 4 cups water to a boil. Add the tomatoes with their juice and stir in the mustard. Continue to boil until the liquid is reduced by half, about 10 minutes. Combine the cranberries in a small bowl and set aside. Lay the grape leaves out on a clean dry towel and stretch over the rim of a 9x13 inch baking dish. Arrange tomato mixture on the grape leaves. Cover the leaves with the olives. Top with the peppermint extract and a few more grape leaves so the leaves don't touch the sides of the dish. Cover with a tight lid (no head ) and bake for 50 minutes. Uncover and bake for 20 minutes more.

title: Sweet & Sour Sour Whipped Cream
ingredients: 1 cup sour cream | 2 tablespoons honey
instructions: In a bowl whisk sour cream & honey together. Chill in the refrigerator for at least 2 hrs before serving.

title: Mongolian Lettuce Wraps (Chicken or Pork)
ingredients: 1 lb pork loin, cut into thin strips across the grain | 2 tablespoons brown sugar | 1 tablespoon bouillon | 1/4 cup oyster, drained and coarsely chopped | 4 large lettuce leaves | 1/4 cup blue curacao ( or to taste ) ( optional )
instructions: To make the marinade, mix the sugar and bouillon in a bowl.

title: Pork Balls in Sherry (Bon Appetit)
ingredients: 1 cup italian-style breadcrumbs | 1/4 cup sherry wine, more if you wish
instructions: Combine the bread crumbs and the sherry in a bowl. Dip the pork balls in the crumbs, and deep fry in a large frying pan or fryer to test how tender they are, turn frequently. Remove the balls from the pan and drain on paper towels. Serve warm with lemon wedges for squeezing, and a drizzle of sherry if desired.

Random Ingredients: beef brisket,graham cracker crumb,couscous,curry powder,olive oil,cinnamon sugar,nutmeg
title: Curried Corned Beef and Cheese With Nuts in a Muffin Loaf
ingredients: 1 corned beef brisket | 1 cup graham cracker crumbs | 2 teaspoons curry powder, i use a little less | 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg ( optional ) | 1 pinch ground cinnamon ( optional ) | olive oil ( for drizzling ) | 1/2 cup greek spices, mix ( see note ) | 1/3 cup couscous, i use jasmine rice, can use brown rice | cinnamon sugar
instructions: Remove beef from refrigerator and allow to come to room temperature. Trim fatty end off of brisket and score an internal temperature of about 115 degrees. Cut brisket with steak knife into 1 1/4 inch slices. Dry roast in oven with minimal fat drippings. While meat is drying, mix rice, spice mix in small bowl. Coat inside of 2 - 8 inch or larger muffin cups with olive oil, then sprinkle spice mixture over meat, making sure to coat all sides. Add crust mixture and toss to coat. Place brisket on top of couscous, sprinkle with cinnamon and top with more of the crumbs and more spice mix. Bake for 30 minutes or until crust is golden brown.

title: Lime Truffle Salad
ingredients: 1/4 cup lime juice, fresh | 1 tablespoon truffle, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon salad oil | 1/4 cup pimiento, chopped
instructions: Combine lime juice and truffle in bowl.

title: Ginger-Laced Hazelnuts
ingredients: 1/4 cup hazelnuts, ground | 1 -2 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 1 pinch kosher salt | 2 tablespoons fresh orange juice | 2 teaspoons maggi seasoning, spice | 2 teaspoons ghee
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. In a medium sized pot add all ingredients to a medium sized bowl, stir and let sit for five minutes. Pour mixture into an oven safe 9 x 13 baking dish. Turn over over and spray with oil. Put in oven and bake for thirty minutes, or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: beef strip,ice water,celery salt,applesauce,pearl barley,yellow pepper,poblano chile
title: Maurie's Crockpot Pepper-Beef Striped Barley
ingredients: 1/2 cup unsweetened applesauce | 1 carton plain pearl barley | 1/2 teaspoon celery salt | 1/2 teaspoon poblano chile, finely minced | 1/2 teaspoon yellow pepper, minced | 1 carton ice water, or as needed | steamed frozen cut beef strips, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: In a large bowl, stir together applesauce, barley, celery salt, poblano chile, and yellow pepper until well blended. Pour in ice water, stirring until water is absorbed. Cover, and cook on low heat for 11/2 hours, stirring every 5 to 7 hours.

title: Tossed Swiss Chard with Sweet Potato Flour
ingredients: 4 stalks fresh swiss chard, ends trimmed and leaves chopped | 1/2 cup potato starch | 1/4 cup tamari | 1/2 cup confectioners'sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Place the chard leaves in a saucepan with enough water to cover them and bring to a boil. Cook for 3 to 5 minutes and drain. Place the potatoes in a large bowl. Sprinkle with the chard and mix gently. Add the cornstarch, tamari and confectioner's sugar, tossing until you have a spreadable consistency. Drop by spoonfuls onto a baking sheet or line with parchment paper.

title: Pasta with Red Pepper Sauce
ingredients: 1 pound small pasta shells | 1 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes
instructions: Prepare pasta according to package directions. Meanwhile, bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook elbow macaroni in the boiling water, stirring occasionally, until cooked through but firm to the bite, 10 to 12 minutes. Drain. Cook red pepper flakes in a dry skillet over medium heat until fragrant, about 1 minute. Pour hot pepper flakes into a blender.

title: Cardamom Cherry Tomatoes (21 Day Wonder Diet: Day 2 )
ingredients: cooking spray | 100 g sliced almonds | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom seed | 250 g cherry tomatoes, halved | 1/4 cup coriander, chopped ( cilantro )
instructions: Heat oven to 190°c. Place almonds and cardamom in a shallow baking dish. Spray with oil and bake, stirring, for 5 minutes or until toasted. Combine cherry tomatoes and coriander. Place almonds on a large plate and drizzle with cherry mixture.

title: Delights
ingredients: 24 sheets whole wheat lasagna noodles, cooked | 3 tablespoons coarsely chopped fresh parsley | 1 1/2 fluid ounces malibu rum
instructions: Preheat broiler. Place one sheet of lasagna noodles on a cookie sheet, and brush with oil. Sprinkle with parsley. Place remaining noodles on another sheet, and then top with the remaining one sheet of noodles, brush with oil. Broil lasagna noodles until brown, bubbly and crisped on top, 4 to 5 minutes. Remove from the oven, and keep warm. Heat malibu rum in a small nonstick skillet over low heat until hot but not smoking, about 2 minutes.

Random Ingredients: tomato green chile pepper,pea carrot,garlic salt,spanish onion,hellmann mayonnaise,yellow pepper,nutmeg
title: Spanish  Pea and  Carrot Salad
ingredients: 1 cup hellmann's mayonnaise | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chile peppers | 3/4 teaspoon garlic salt | 1/8 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1/2 cup finely chopped spanish walla walla onion | 1/2 cup finely chopped yellow pepper | 1 cup frozen peas and carrots, thawed | 1/4 cup finely chopped yellow pepper
instructions: In a bowl, mix the mayonnaise, tomatoes with green chile peppers, garlic salt, nutmeg, onion, and yellow pepper. Cover, and refrigerate until ready to serve. Stir in the vegetables.

title: Spinach Wrapped in Chocolate
ingredients: 500 g spinach | 100 g brown rice, washed and drained | 3 -4 tablespoons currants | 2 1/2 tablespoons cornflour | 100 g grated chocolate ( sem ) | 4 teaspoons turmeric | 1 tablespoon ghee or 1 tablespoon butter
instructions: Wash and chop the spinach into small pieces. Rinse the spinach with water and drain. Keep aside. Combine the rice, cornflour and turmeric in a small bowl. Stir in the grated chocolates. Heat the ghee and fry the spinach for a minute or two. Put the spinach on a plate covered with cling film. Spread the chocolate on the spinach and sprinkle on the turmeric. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: coconut extract,white bread,celery,spring onion,italian bread crumb,beef brisket,apple,corn chip
title: Beef Brisket  Croquettes With Apple Dip
ingredients: 1 corned beef brisket, trimmed | 4 ounces italian seasoned bread, crumbs | 2 ounces baby corn chips ( optional ) | 2 ounces chopped celery | 2 ounces chopped spring onions | 1 small apple, peeled, cored and chopped | 1 teaspoon coconut extract | 2 ounces coarsely crumbled white bread crumbs | 1 packet dry italian bread crumbs
instructions: Preheat the oven to 275 degrees f. Rub the corned beef with 1 ounce of bread crumbs, and set aside. Season with salt and pepper. Place all the remaining ingredients except the bread crumbs into a saucepan and place over a medium heat.

title: Herbed Edible Flowers from Edible Flower Preserves
ingredients: 20 red and white fresh edible flowers, cleaned | 2 tablespoons dry sherry or other dry white wine | 1 1/2 cups bottled marinara sauce, heated
instructions: In a large bowl stir together the flowers. Remove the flowers from the bowl and rinse under cold water. Drain and pat dry with paper towels. Sprinkle with sherry. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least six hours or until just before serving, toss with warmed marinara sauce.

Random Ingredients: cottage cheese,lime,italian sausage,bean sprout,mustard,red chili paste,sea salt
title: Italian Cream Stuffed Dumps With Fresh Italian Sausage!
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs italian sausage ( about 2 links ) | 3/4 lb small bean sprouts, cleaned | sea salt | red chili paste | 1/3 lb cottage cheese | fresh coarse ground mustard | 1/4 lime, halves for garnish
instructions: Pre heat oven to 325°f. Remove casings from sausages, and remove the casings if desired. Using your fingers, cut sausage lengthwise down the center, and then cross the length again so it makes about 1 inch slices. Try to leave 1 inch of sausage at one end of each sausage slice and cut off casing. If the sausage is connected, you might need to trim the sausage slightly. Cut off each sausage slice and pat it dry with paper towels. Set aside. In a mixing bowl combine the sausage meat, bean sprouts, salt, chili paste according to directions, and put aside. On a baking sheet lined with parchment, bake the sausage for 12 to 15 minutes or just until no longer pink, stirring once or twice, until lightly browned. Remove them from the oven, and transfer the sausage meat to a clean chopping board. Place on the cutting board and chop coarsely. In a medium bowl, blend together cottage cheese with the prepared mustard and lime. Spoon cheese mixture into an ice cream scoop tray with approximately 1 tablespoon of cheese mixture per dumpling. Dip the dumplings in mustard, then coat with the remainder of the cheese mixture. Serve warm or warm, garnished with fresh lime halves.

Random Ingredients: habanero pepper,kielbasa,serrano chili,rice,endive,salt black pepper,cider vinegar
title: Hot Sausage or Kielbasa
ingredients: 3 1/2 lbs kielbasa or 3 1/2 lbs other sausage | 6 -8 endives | 3 habanero peppers | 4 serrano chili | 1 serrano chili | 3 tablespoons cider vinegar | salt & freshly ground black pepper | 1/2 cup cooked rice
instructions: Trim sausage of the rind and cut into 1/2 inch slices. Slice endives lengthwise. Remove seeds from chiles and cut into 1 inch lengths. Remove core and cut into 1 inch wide wedges. Set aside. Remove stems from habanero peppers and cut into fine pieces. Place in a bowl of warm water and let soak for about 15 minutes, then drain. Remove seeds, stem ends, and skin from chiles. Place in a large heavy pot along with endives, habanero peppers, chile, vinegar, salt and pepper. Bring to boil then reduce heat to low. Simmer for 10 minutes, skimming as necessary. Remove from heat and carefully stir in rice.

title: Skewered Nuts (Nitir Bati)
ingredients: 4 1/4 lbs small bamboo skewers or 4 1/4 lbs any small vegetable skewers | 1 tablespoon mixed fenugreek seeds ( ajwain ) | 1 tablespoon olive oil or 1 tablespoon light olive oil
instructions: Rinse, then soak wooden skewers in warm water for 1 hour. Drain well, and cut into squares. If using wooden skewers, soak them in cool water for 30 minutes. Rinse and pat dry with paper towels. Using a sharp knife, cut each square into long slivers about 2 inches wide. Brush each square with olive oil. Place nuts on skewers and allow to sit for 1 to 2 minutes. Turn and brush with more oil. Turn again and brush with more oil. Grill or broil nuts for 3 - 5 minutes, or until they have blackened and are browned. Serve hot or cold.

Random Ingredients: red onion,pork loin roast,eggplant,red food coloring,garlic salt,water artichoke heart,pizza sauce,cooking sherry
title: Italian Pork
ingredients: 1 bone-in pork loin roast | cooking sherry, or as needed | garlic salt to taste | 10 ounces water-packed artichoke hearts, diced | 1 cup diced red onion | 1 eggplant, diced | 1 cup pizza sauce | 1 teaspoon red food coloring
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Place the pork loin into a 9x12 inch baking dish. Season with garlic salt, and coat pork completely with cooking sherry. Roast in the preheated oven until a meat thermometer inserted into the center registers 145 degrees f, about 3 1/2 hours. Allow to cool, then remove pork from skillet, and allow to cool completely. Wash, peel, and dice the artichoke hearts. Place into a small saucepan, and add enough water to almost cover the bottom. Bring to a boil, then remove from heat. Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Once boiling, stir in the diced eggplant, and return to a boil. Pour the eggplant into the water, and cook for 1 minute. Drain, and mash the eggplant with a potato masher. While mash is cooling, pour some cooking sherry into a skillet over medium high heat, and cook until a bit browned. Mix in the tomatoes and cook for a few minutes to combine, then pour the tomato sauce into a saucepan. Place the saucepan over medium/low heat, and stir in the food coloring. Remove from heat, and stir in the food coloring. When the meat is cool, shred with some forks.

title: French Twist
ingredients: 2 lbs beef roast | 2 -3 tablespoons margarine
instructions: Use a sharp knife to cut and remove the chain from the roast. Rinse off as much fat as possible. Put the roast into a large roaster. Sprinkle the kosher salt in the bag, seal, turn the roast and coat well with the kosher salt. Place into a 325 degree f oven for 3 - 4 hours. When done, pull the roast out onto a board and let rest 15. When cool enough to handle, pull meat and shred with a fork or two. You can use either a food processor or a hand held blender. Use your fingers to mix the shredded meat in a bowl. Use the slotted spoon to mix in the butter. Strain the juices and reserve. Use this juice for a filling for a french dinner for a cold french dinner.

title: Caribbean Steak Sauce
ingredients: 500 g thick white flour | 250 ml tequila | 6 tablespoons ketchup, with a smidgen in the asian food aisle. ( or whatever your like to drink ) | 2 teaspoons garlic cloves, minced | 1 -2 teaspoon roasted garlic foil ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients and use as your base for steaks. Use on hamburgers and other steak dishes.

Random Ingredients: kidney bean,lime jell o gelatin,clove,fennel bulb,salsa,leek,beet
title: Beet Salad
ingredients: 3 -4 green sweet peppers ( red, orange, etc. ) or 3 -4 yellow sweet peppers, of your choice ( red, orange, etc. ) | 2 cups peeled and diced beets | 1 cup minced fresh fennel bulb | 1 1/2 packages lime jell-o gelatin, not sure-cook ( or 2 tbsp. jelly crystals for a firmer texture ) | 1 jar salsa | 1 can kidney beans, rinsed and drained | 1/4 teaspoon ground cloves
instructions: Cook and stir sweet peppers until tender crisp. While they're cooking, combine beets, fennel, and salsa in a large bowl with the jelly. Toss until mixed well. Transfer to a small microwave safe bowl with tight fitting lid.

title: Wakame Chips
ingredients: 1 pound wakame, trimmed | 1 teaspoon green chiles, or more to taste
instructions: Place wakame in a large plate and cover with several inches of cool water.

title: Shrimp With Red Curry Sauce
ingredients: 400 g shrimp paste | 2 tablespoons sunflower oil | 1 tablespoon red curry paste | 2 tablespoons yoghurt
instructions: Mix all together with a whisk or spoon into a saucepan and bring to a boil. Add the yoghurt and simmer for 2 minutes to thicken this lovely creamy sauce.

title: Aarti's German Herb Salad
ingredients: 1 romaine lettuce | 3 -4 sprigs fresh sage leaves | 1 teaspoon dried sage ( approx. 1 large handful ) | 1 teaspoon sweet allspice | 2 tablespoons apricot jam ( approx. 2 tablespoons ) | 2 tablespoons water ( approx. )
instructions: Wash and dry lettuce. Slice thinly. Prepare a large bowl of cold water. Add the fresh sage, allspice and half of the jam and enough water to just cover the salad. Place in the fridge, covered, for 1 hour. The salad may be made in advance and refrigerated until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: elbow macaroni,palm sugar,thai red curry paste,salmon
title: Deluxe Macaroni & Salmon Pasta
ingredients: 200 g elbow macaroni | 200 g salmon, chopped into small cubes | 100 g palm sugar, finely grated | 1 teaspoon thai red curry paste
instructions: Cook the pasta in salted wqt water following the instructions on the packet. Drain, rinse. Cook the salmon in a pan with the palm sugar. Add the red curry paste, stirring for 2 minutes. Drain the pasta and add to the salmon mixture. Toss to mix thoroughly. Serve.

title: Coriander and Beef Brisket over Rigatoni
ingredients: 1 coriander, coarsely chopped | 8 ounces rigatoni pasta, fresh ( or small shells ) | 1 coriander, roughly chopped | 4 -6 small beef brisket | 1 pint fresh cranberries
instructions: Put coriander in a pestle and mortar with a a generous pinch of salt and grind into a fine powder. Cook rigatoni in plenty of salted, boiling water for 8 minutes or until tender. Meanwhile, pat brisket dry with paper towels. Trim and trim ends and sinew from the brisket. Cut brisket into cubes about 1in long, 1in wide and about 2 in thick. Place 1/2c of coriander into a bowl with 3 tbsp water and 2 of the remaining coriander and season with salt and pepper. Taste, and seasoning with salt and pepper, and set aside. Put oven on. Turn oven down to 180c/350f. Put brisket in the oven and roast for 1 3/4 hours, or until the meat falls off the bone. Strain broth into a saucepan.

Random Ingredients: cotija cheese,triple sec,serrano pepper,beef tenderloin,baking potato
title: Mexican Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 1 center cut beef tenderloin | 1/2 cup triple sec | 1/4 cup grated cotija cheese | 2 roasted serrano peppers, rinsed and patted dry | 2 lbs small baking potatoes or 2 lbs medium potatoes
instructions: With a small boning knife or sharp chef's knife, cut the tenderloin into 1 x 2 inch sticks. Place the beef sticks in a shallow 12 x 7 or 1 cup glass baking container. In a small bowl, blend together the triple sec, cheese and peppers, leaving 1/4 cup of cheese mixture. Sprinkle the beef sticks with the remaining cheese mixture. Cover tightly, and refrigerate at least 6 hours, turning meat occasionally. Preheat the oven to 450 degrees. Spread the potatoes in a 9 x 12 casserole dish or roasting pan. Place the meat sticks in a single layer on top of the potatoes. Pour the reserved pepper mixture on top of the meat, then cover tightly with foil. Bake for 45 minutes, or until the beef and potatoes are tender.

title: Brandy Covered Spaghetti
ingredients: 8 links spaghetti | 5 cups brandy, cognac flavored
instructions: In a deep dish, combine brandy and cognac. Reserve 3/4 cup of the cognac. Place the remaining 1/2 of cognac in a small bag, seal and place the spaghetti in the bag. Pour brandy flavored brandy over the spaghetti until covered. Place bag in a large, deep pan of boiling water. Boil for 30 seconds, then remove from water and place the spaghetti on paper towels to drain. Serve hot.

title: Lamb Cutlets - Stove Top or Bangers, Stainless Steel Cutlets, and Pies
ingredients: 4 lamb cutlets, or more to taste | 1 pound cubed boiled ham | 1 tablespoon baking powder, or as needed | 2 teaspoons cold water
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Coat cutlets with baking powder and water in a large plastic zipper bag. Place cutlets onto a baking sheet using your fingers or a blunt object or other object that will not break or tear. Lightly spray pam in a large oven safe skillet with nonstick spray. Lightly sprinkle cutlets with more baking powder and set aside to dry. Place ham into a small skillet or saute pan, and add about 1 teaspoon salt. Stir ham into the ham, and cook until ham is crispy. Do not overcook. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: black sesame seed,mexican oregano,broccoli,wide rice noodle,plum tomato
title: Chinese Noodle Salad With Fresh Tomatoes and Broccoli
ingredients: 4 cups cooked wide rice noodles | 1/3 cup black sesame seed | 1 medium plum tomato, chopped | 1 -2 tablespoon mexican oregano | 12 ounces fresh broccoli, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f line a 9x13 inch baking dish with aluminum foil or parchment. Combine the black sesame seed and tomatoes in a baking dish. Sprinkle with oregano, breaking apart any lumps of dried tomatoes. Roast at 375°f for 30 to 45 minutes or until tomatoes are soft and begin to give off their aroma. Add the broccoli, turning halfway through cooking. Cool until just warm to the touch. Serve or refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Tuna Macaroni Withgemelli
ingredients: 2 tuna steaks | 1/2 cup gemelli pasta ( small shell )
instructions: Preparation, cook macaroni according to its directions and drain. Cut the tuna into small pieces, remove excess oil. Place in a preheated oven proof dish. Crush the gemelli with a fork and sprinkle over the tuna. Cook in the oven for 20 minutes, then remove from oven and serve immediately.

title: Paprika Aka Italian Mayo
ingredients: 1 -2 tablespoon whole-grain mayonnaise | 1 - 1 1/2 tablespoon italian seasoning
instructions: Whisk together all ingredients until combined. Let stand for a few minutes before serving and taste.

Random Ingredients: margarine,garlic flake,guinness stout,venison,ginger garlic paste,black eyed pea
title: Beef on Weck (Slow Cooker)
ingredients: 1/2 cup cubed venison ( use beef chuck roast cut into 1-inch cubes, or use brisket cut into 1-inch cubes ) | 2 tablespoons guinness stout ( or substitute stout beer ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons margarine or 1 1/2 tablespoons butter | 1 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 1 1/4 teaspoons black-eyed peas, thawed | 1/2 teaspoon granulated garlic flakes
instructions: Place meat in large mixing bowl. Add remaining ingredients and stir until just mixed. Pour into crock pot over meat.

Random Ingredients: green chili,pesto sauce,glace cherry,apple,flat leaf parsley,sirloin,rice krispies,green enchilada sauce
title: Green Chili, Apple and Crispy Beef Jerky
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs sirloin, trimmed and cut into 1 1/2 inch cubes | 1/2 cup green enchilada sauce ( bottled ) | 3 tablespoons pesto sauce | 2 green chili, halved lengthwise and seeds scraped out | 12 -16 cups rice krispies | 28 ounces reduced-sodium green enchilada sauce ( red or green brand ) | 1 large green chili, halved lengthwise and seeds scraped out | 1 medium apple, unpeeled and cut into 1 1/2 inch cubes | 1/3 cup flat leaf parsley, chopped
instructions: To prepare beef, combine 1 1/2 pints water with 2 t red pepper flakes in medium saucepan. Bring to boil over high heat. Reduce heat to medium.

Random Ingredients: chili pepper flake,udon noodle,raclette cheese,monterey jack cheese,harissa
title: Raclette & Yakisoba Noodles
ingredients: 200 g raclette cheese | 200 g monterey jack cheese | 1 tablespoon harissa | 1 pinch dried chili pepper flakes | 300 g udon noodles
instructions: Rinse the noodles and cook them in a water bath until they are cooked. Chop the cheese into 2 to 3 centimeter cubes. Combine the cheeses and harissa in a small bowl. Drain the noodles and toss into the cheese/harissa mix. When cheese has fully melted, toss the noodles into the cheese/harissa mix. Serve immediately.

title: Cilantro Risotto Cakes (Gluten Free)
ingredients: 1 large white onion, finely diced | 1 bunch fresh cilantro leaves, stems finely chopped | 1 bag fresh ricotta cheese | 2 cups jasmine rice | scallion, jumbo pieces, minced
instructions: In a frying pan, saute onion and cilantro in olive oil until onion is translucent. Set aside. Strain 1/2 cup raisins from the remaining can of raisins and save the rest for use in the next part. Add the rice, stir to coat rice with oil and salt and cook rice mixture until rice becomes opaque. Reduce heat to low and add a large portion of the rice and cheese mixture stirring until cheese is melted into rice. Repeat process until all of the cheese has been added. Toast the 2 count of scallion in a small skillet until limp. Do not brown. Serve sprinkled with a dash of salt, if desired, garnished with minced scallions.

title: Roasted Potatoes and Spinach
ingredients: 2 -3 baking potatoes | 12 ounces baby spinach
instructions: Preheat oven to cut the ends off the peeled and washed potatoes and wash them thoroughly. Spread the spinach and garlic onto a baking tray. Place into oven on 400 f/190 c until brown and crisp.

title: Italian Pesto
ingredients: 1/4 cup freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1 1/2 teaspoons garlic salt
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl. Chill in the refrigerator until ready to serve.

title: Avocado Salad
ingredients: 3 avocados | 3 tablespoons tamarind paste | 3 -4 tablespoons sake
instructions: Cut avocados in two slices. Scoop out the avocado flesh with spoon leaving about 2 1/2 cm slices. Cut avocados into fine wedges. Place avocado wedges, one at a time, in a bowl, add the tamarind paste and sake. Mix well together. Cover bowl with plastic wrap. Refrigerate to chill thoroughly. Serve immediately.

title: Cherry Bombs
ingredients: 1 cup cherries or 1 cup grape tomatoes, cut in halves | 1 tablespoon chicken bouillon | 2 teaspoons hot canned tomatoes and cherry soup mix for topping on a serving ( optional )
instructions: Make sure that all of the cherries, or grape tomatoes and chicken bouillon are cut in half before stuffing the cherry tomatoes with soup or soup mix. Dump them out on paper towels, sprinkle with sugar, or eat plain, you may add a dash of salt to the dressing.

title: Not so Universal Coleslaw
ingredients: 1 head iceberg lettuce, shredded | 1 large sweet onion, sliced | 2 tablespoons brown sugar, or to taste | 1/2 teaspoon onion powder, optional. | 1/2 cup crushed iceberg lettuce, for dipping
instructions: Mix brown sugar and onion together in a bowl. Add lettuce, toss, sprinkle, and serve.

title: Eggplant & Corn
ingredients: 1 large onion, chopped | 1/2 cup sliced eggplant ( optional ) | 1 can kernel corn, drained of liquid | 1 package prepared couscous | 3/4 cup tequila | 1/2 cup grand marnier | 1/4 teaspoon poppy seeds | 1/4 teaspoon onion salt
instructions: In a skillet over medium medium high heat, saute the onion and eggplant in the tequila until the eggplant is tender and onions are translucent. Stir in the rest of the ingredients except for the poppy seeds and allow to heat through. Serve hot over uncooked couscous, garnish with poppy seeds.

Random Ingredients: green pea,chinese five spice powder,active yeast,raisin,salt cod fish,pepper sauce
title: Chinese Five Spice Baked Salt Cod
ingredients: 2 ounces dry active yeast | 1 cup warm water | 2 teaspoons salt, divided | 1 tablespoon chinese five-spice powder | 1 cup green peas | 1 teaspoon hot pepper sauce | 36 ounces salt cod fish, cut into 3x3/4-inch pieces
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water in large bowl. Stir in 1/2 teaspoon of the salt and the remaining 1/2 teaspoon of salt, chinese five spice powder, peas, and hot sauce.

title: Hawaiian Beef
ingredients: 1 lb pork tenderloin, cut into 1 inch pieces | 1 can black beans ( in water ) | 1 teaspoon pepperoni, minced | 6 -8 drops hot pepper sauce
instructions: Place all ingredients, except for the beef, in a slow cooker and stir well. Cover and cook on high for 4 - 5 hours or on low for 8 - 10 hours. Serve over your favorite rice, egg noodles or as a side vegetable on a green vegetable.

title: Lobster tail with brown rice and green chilies in a pot
ingredients: 3/4 cup brown rice, washed ( not instant ) | 1 1/2 - 2 cups lobsters ( tails-on ) | 20 ounces anaheim chilies, chopped | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon caraway seed
instructions: Soak 6 wooden skewers in water for 15 minutes. Place chiles into bowl and drizzle with olive or canola oil. Sprinkle with salt, pepper, garlic powder or a few dashes of your choice. Place on broiler and broil or grill or bake 4 - 5 minutes, turning halfway through. While still hot, remove from broiler or grill and sprinkle with caraway seeds.

title: Jamaican Skewers
ingredients: 2 cans artichoke hearts, drained and finely chopped | 1/2 yellow onion, finely chopped | 1 -2 tablespoon prepared horseradish | 2 -3 tablespoons red curry paste | 1 tablespoon dried sage
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl. Marinate for at least 2 hours in refrigerator, or up to overnight. Thread onto skewers.

Random Ingredients: seasoning,danish pumpernickel bread,sesame oil,prosciutto,turmeric powder,coconut milk,garlic clove,zinfandel
title: Pretend Fried Fish With Coconut-Sesame Sauce
ingredients: 2 lbs firm fish, cut into 6 equal portions ( i like haddock, cod etc ) | 2 slices prosciutto ( about 2 x 4 ) | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1 garlic clove, finely chopped | 1 1/2 tablespoons sesame oil | 8 ounces coconut milk | 1 1/2 tablespoons dry danish pumpernickel bread ( or dry whole wheat pumpernickel ) | 2 tablespoons sesame oil | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1 tablespoon paprika, powdered ( if using regular paprika, omit this! ) | 1 teaspoon seasoning ( you may not use all of the seasoning )
instructions: Place a frying pan to heat up and add 1 tbs oil. When oil is hot, add a piece of prosciutto and fry until crisp, and golden brown. Remove and drain on paper towels. Add more oil to pan and fry the fish pieces until nicely browned, about 3 minutes on each side. Cut the salmon into 4 portions and place on serving platter. Add the rice to the same skillet and turn heat to medium. Stir in the turmeric and saute, stirring constantly until the turmeric is fragrant. Add the coconut milk to the pan with the turmeric. Bring to boil, stirring to dissolve the coconut. Let simmer until the liquid is reduced, about 5 minutes or more. Transfer the sauce to a serving dish and arrange the fish on top. Serve the fish warm with the sauce poured on top.

title: Japanese Simmered Sausages, With Glaze
ingredients: 24 links pork sausages ( approx )
instructions: Make sure the sausages are not stuck, or the pan will lose any remaining fat. Remove the sausages. Place the sausages on a rack or a tray, and bake them at 160°c / 350°f / gas mark 3 for around 30 - 45 minutes. If the sausages seem to be sticking to the pan and are starting to dry out, reduce the heat as low as possible.

title: Moroccan Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 jar somen noodles | 3 tablespoons margarine | 1 tablespoon shortening | 1 leek, minced | 1 tablespoon harissa | 1 1/2 teaspoons celery seeds | 2 cups salsa | 1/2 cup shelled peanuts
instructions: Cook soman noodles according to package directions and drain. In a large frying pan, melt margarine and shortening over medium high heat. Add leek.

title: Egg Beaters  (French Breakfast)
ingredients: 15 ounces egg substitute | 1 teaspoon sage ( use fresh or dried )
instructions: Beat eggs with sage. Serve warm. Note, use fresh or dried sage. Make sure to add a spoonful of egg substitute when mixing the egg eggs with sage just before serving.

Random Ingredients: onion salt,chicken drumstick,cornflour,tomato puree,chocolate milk,fillet tilapia,green curry paste,saffron
title: The Best Chicken in the World
ingredients: 24 chicken drumsticks, skin removed | 24 fillets tilapia ( boneless, skinless chicken breasts may also be used ) | 3 tablespoons green curry paste | 1 can condensed tomato puree | 7 1/2 tablespoons green curry paste | 1/4 cup tomato puree | 1 pinch saffron | 1 teaspoon onion salt | 1/4 cup chocolate milk ( for dip )
instructions: Pre heat oven to 350º. Place chicken drumsticks, skin side down, in a non stick baking tray. Using a fork, poke some holes in the skin on each, then poke a few holes in the top of the thighs before taking them out. Pour 2 litres of tomato sauce into a large saucepan. Season with onion salt and saffron. Simmer uncovered for 20 minutes until thickened, stirring occasionally. While this is baking, pour 3 litres of green curry paste into a frying pan. Heat over a medium heat until saffron begins to melt and become aromatic. While this is going on, spread the remaining green curry paste on a plate. Place each chicken piece in the saucepan, skin side down. Place the chicken pieces in a single layer on top of each other. Place the two fillets under the hot water in the saucepan. When the skin is blackened and the fillets have turned golden brown, remove from the pan and put on a baking tray. Using a large spoon, remove all the pieces of skin and keep them aside. To make the dip, pour the condensed tomato purée and green curry paste into a microwave safe bowl. Microwave for 3 - 5 minutes. Remove from the microwave and pour into a bowl. Stir in the tomato puree and season with onion salt and saffron. Dip the fillets in the mixture ensuring that they are well coated. Cover with plastic wrap and keep aside for 30 minutes. After 30 minutes the chicken is ready to serve. Pour the remaining sauce and the chocolate milk into a serving dish and place the fillets in the center. Spoon the dip on top of his hot sauce. For serving, cut each fillet into strips and arrange on individual plates. Serve with fresh bread or steamed greens.

title: Spaetzle II
ingredients: 2 pounds fresh shiitake mushrooms, stemmed and halved | 1 can chickpeas, drained
instructions: Place shiitake mushrooms in a saucepan with enough water to cover by 2 inches, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium low, and simmer until shiitake mushrooms are tender, about 20 minutes. Drain, and set aside. Bring chickpeas and 1/4 of the mushrooms to a boil in a saucepan over medium heat. Cover, and reduce heat to low until chickpeas are soft and sauce has thickened, about 15 minutes. Place remaining shiitakes into a separate bowl, cover with water, and refrigerate until ready to use. Stir rice wine vinegar, chickpeas, and remaining 1/4 of mushrooms into the saucepan, and simmer until heated through, about 2 minutes. Serve immediately.

title: Lebanese Grape Leaves
ingredients: 3 lbs grape | 1 cup sweet unsweetened dried shredded coconut | 1 cup chopped peanuts | 1 tablespoon anise seed | 1/3 cup fresh lemon juice | 2 -3 lbs flour
instructions: Wash, drain, and dry the grape leaves. Place in large pot of boiling water. Cook until leaves float to the top. Remove from pot and dry well. Combine coconut, peanuts, and anise in a food processor or blender.

title: Peach & Hazelnut Pudding
ingredients: 8 peaches, pared & halved, about 3 cups | 1 tablespoon hazelnuts | 1 1/2 cups milk or 1 1/2 cups half-and-half
instructions: Using a mandoline, cut peeled peaches crosswise into 1/4 inch thick slices. Place in a large shallow baking dish & sprinkle evenly with hazelnuts. Set aside. Bring milk or half & half to boil over medium heat. Remove from heat & add peaches to milk, stirring to coat. Cover & let sit approx 5 minutes. Remove from heat & stir gently to spread peaches around. Top with a dollop of vanilla ice cream or serve in individual dessert bowls with a spoonful of whipped cream or whipped cream on top. Serve immediately while still warm or chill for up to 2 days.

Random Ingredients: garam masala,garlic clove,parmigiano reggiano cheese,white bread,ginger garlic paste
title: Authentic Garlic Toast
ingredients: 2 garlic cloves, unpeeled | 1 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala | 4 slices thick white bread, cut diagonally in 1/2 | parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Slice the cloves in half lengthwise and crosswise. Arrange slices on a baking sheet. Combine the garlic paste and spices and brush onto the slices of bread. Place under the broiler until golden on both sides.

title: Deviled Macaroni & Tomato
ingredients: 400 g tomatoes ( tinned ) | 150 g long grainy mustard | 4 teaspoons mustard powder ( mild, med grind ) | 3 teaspoons stevia powder | fresh coriander seed ( optional ) | pasta
instructions: Remove skins from tomatoes, cut tomatoes into 4 wedges. Place into a food processor or chopper with tomato, mustard powder, stevia, coriander and coriander seeds. Pulse to a medium consistency. Cook the macaroni following package directions, drain.

title: Homemade Mexican Spice Mix
ingredients: 1 small onion powder | 1 teaspoon caster sugar | 1 -3 teaspoon jalapeno pepper, finely chopped ( from a jar of jalapenos ) | 1 -3 teaspoon apple cider ( optional )
instructions: The night before dinner heat up the grill to medium or medium high place all ingredients into a small saucepan and simmer for 8 - 10 minutes to infuse flavours before placing in a bowl add sugar, apple cider to taste, mix well and then leave overnight you can also add more of your favourite mexican seasoning to these and keep for a week or so.

Random Ingredients: vodka,corn tortilla,mushroom,bailey irish cream,heavy whipping cream,sesame seed,pecorino cheese
title: Irish Cream-Smoked Tortilla Pintos
ingredients: 1 dozen corn tortilla | 1 teaspoon toasted sesame seeds | 3 -4 ounces smoked paprika mushrooms | 4 ounces beni light tasting vodka | 2 ounces baileys irish cream | 1/2 - 3/4 cup heavy whipping cream | 1/4 cup grated pecorino cheese
instructions: Take the first 3 ingredients, spread them on a baking sheet. Grill until light brown, turn. Grill the second side until golden. Let cool. While the tortillas are cooling, take the puff pastry shells out of the pouch. Take a small, oval shaped tortilla and place it between 2 sheets of wax paper. Roll paper around tortillas and place in freezer for 1/2 hour. Roll tortilla through pastry package and place on baking sheet. Cut into pieces. Take a small amount of smoked paprika on your work surface and then sprinkle on the smoked paprika. Next, place two slices of the smoked smoked paprika on top of smoked paprika. Then place a puff pastry piece on top of that one. Then place 4 ounces of smoked smoked paprika on top of smoked paprika. Add a bit of the vodka at the sides of the puff pastry. Next, take two pieces of puff pastry and place them on your work surface. Cover with wax paper and then with parchment paper. After 2 minutes, remove the puff pastry piece with a spatula and onto your work surface. On top of the puff pastry, place about 5 tablespoons of the smoky smoked paprika in a wide, diamond shaped puff pastry or similar. Top with 2 1/4 ounces of smoked smoked paprika and 2 1/4 ounces of smoked smoked smoked puff pastry. Continue rolling the puff pastry into a log, cigar shaped or similar. Cut away paper and crimp the dough slightly. Place the puff pastry log onto parchment paper and place it on top of smoked paprika and smoked puff pastry. Repeat process for remaining puff pastry. Place the pastry log onto a baking sheet and cover with wax paper and then lightly oil the top of the pastry log with olive oil. Preheat your smoker or your oven to 500 degrees and smoke the puff pastry. When the puff pastry puffs up and looks nice and smokey, place it onto a cooking rack to cool down. Cut into 2 equal pieces and serve.

title: Pasta with Pork and Tomatoes
ingredients: 3 lbs beef short ribs, cut into 2-inch pieces or 3 lbs pork ribs, cut into 2-inch pieces | 1 can condensed tomato soup, undiluted | 1/2 cup toasted nuts, crushed ( i prefer pecans or pecans instead ) | 2 packages dried tubular pasta, cooked and drained | 1 loaf focaccia bread, cut into 6 long wedges
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. In a 12 inch skillet, heat ribs over medium high heat until well browned and tender.

title: Toffee Nests
ingredients: 3/4 lb firm but firm-ripe semi-sweet chocolate-sweet bix | 1/8 teaspoon saffron thread, crushed | 3/4 teaspoon instant espresso powder | 2 1/2 cups snow peas, diagonally cut on bias into 1-inch pieces | 2 packages toffee nests with spareribs ( 4x1/2-inch nests )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Line two cookie sheets with parchment or aluminum foil.

title: Crispy Vietnamese Pork
ingredients: 2 tablespoons rice vinegar | 1 pound pork shoulder, trimmed
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Stir rice vinegar and pork shoulder together in a bowl. Spread skin on a baking sheet and roast pork in the preheated oven until tender, about 2 hours.

Random Ingredients: buttermilk,egg white,hazelnut,beef stew meat,apple juice,soy sauce,sirloin steak,turnip
title: Apfel Mit Rahm (Beef and Turnip Applesauce)
ingredients: 1 teaspoon minced fresh beef stew meat | 1 tablespoon unsweetened apple juice | 1/2 cup beef stock or 1/2 cup low-sodium beef broth | 1/2 tablespoon soy sauce ( optional ) | 1 large egg white | 1 cup buttermilk | 2 cups chopped peeled turnips ( about 2 medium ) | 1/3 cup chopped hazelnuts, toasted
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine broth and soy sauce.

Random Ingredients: anchovy fillet,parmesan cheese,cream soup,red enchilada sauce,chinese five spice powder,soy sauce
title: Creamy Caesar Beef Dip
ingredients: 3/4 cup light sour cream or 3/4 cup low fat cottage cheese | 1 can red enchilada sauce | 3 anchovy fillets, mashed | 1 teaspoon chinese five spice powder | 1 teaspoon low sodium soy sauce | 2 tablespoons grated parmesan cheese
instructions: Combine cream cheese, enchilada sauce, anchovies, five spice, soy sauce, and parmesan in bowl. Cover and chill 30 - 60 minutes.

title: Tasty Mushroom Spheres on Spareribs
ingredients: 2 1/2 - 3 lbs mushroom stems | 1/2 fluid ounce sriracha hot sauce ( i also use sriracha sauce )
instructions: Heat broiler. Line roasting pan with foil and grease well with vegetable or canola oil. Wrap each mushroom cap with a strip of foil that is about 16 long and 8 inches wide. Seal foil securely. Place on cookie sheet or sheet with a weight on the foil. Sprinkle mushroom caps with sriracha hot sauce. Broil about 10 minutes or till tops are lightly browned, turning to brown evenly.

title: Phyllo Stuffed With Dates, Onions and Bread - Staple Pudding
ingredients: 2 -3 tablespoons finely chopped pitted dates | 1 small white onion, finely chopped | 1/2 loaf french bread, cut into 1/2 to 1/2 slices | 1 loaf french bread, loaf cut into 1/2 to 1/2 slices | 12 sheets phyllo pastry, frozen thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. If you would like to make individual phyllo cups or larger, cut the 4 thick french bread or challah pieces into 1/2 slices and then cut the loaf into 1/2 slices. If you would like to make a larger quantity, cut about half of the crusts. Place the sliced bread into a bowl with the dates, onion and 1/4 cup water, and let soak for about an hour. Grease a baking dish with a little of the beaten egg from the 6 sheets of phyllo dough and spread on the bottom and 1/4 inch up the sides of the dish. Cut the phyllo dough in half crosswise. Spread one sheet of phyllo dough out thinly, and spread it over the top. Repeat until the 3 sheets are used. Top with the remaining phyllo sheets and cut a slit in the top 3 layers of phyllo dough to form a small bowl. Carefully lift out the phyllo bowl from the dish, letting the excess water run off. Spoon the date mixture into the bottom of the baking dish. Sprinkle the bottom layer of dough with some of the chopped leaves. Using the back end of a knife, score the top layer of dough, making diamond cuts across the top layer of dough, forming diamonds and then cross cuts down the length. Lay the phyllo stuffed loaf over the top layer of phyllo dough in the baking dish, and sprinkle the top layer of whole phyllo dough over the top of it. Repeat until there is 3 layers of layered phyllo dough, using more sheets and leaving a 1 inch gap between. Sprinkle the top with any remaining chopped leaves and bake for 45 minutes or until the phyllo is golden brown and the french bread is cooked. Allow the bread to cool for about 10 minutes then remove the baking dish from the dish and cut into 2 pieces. Serve with ice cream. The bread can be eaten warm or at room temperature.

title: Provençal Pepperoncini Confits
ingredients: 1 jar pepperoncini peppers | 1 fresh thyme sprig ( or 1 teaspoon dried )
instructions: Place the peppers in a plastic bag and crush using a rolling pin or rolling pin. Add the thyme and salt and pepper to the crushed peppers. Mix well.. Let rest for 10 minutes. Transfer to an air tight container and use within 1 month.

title: Lazy Eggs on the Macerate
ingredients: 8 ounces egg noodles, cooked and drained | kosher salt and pepper ( to taste )
instructions: In a large bowl, toss the pasta with the salt and pepper. Transfer to a serving bowl and serve. Enjoy.

title: Roasted Beef
ingredients: 1 -2 lb sirloin steak, cut into 1-inch thick slices | sea salt, to taste
instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan on medium heat until it begins to smoke. Lightly coat the grate with oil. Transfer beef to the pan. Sprinkle with salt. When the smoke dies down, loosely cover with foil and roast until most of the liquid cooks away, about 25 minutes. Be careful it doesn't burn. Serve.

Random Ingredients: beef broth,baby spinach,pear,paprika,mini chocolate chip,mozzarella cheese,chicken wing,tomato soup
title: Spinach and Chicken Casserole
ingredients: 5 -6 chicken wings ( whole ) | 16 ounces tomato soup ( or equivalent ) | 32 ounces beef broth ( swanson ) | paprika, ground | 2 teaspoons paprika | 12 ounces mini chocolate chips | 2 cups baby spinach | 1 cup mozzarella cheese | 1/2 cup miniature chocolate chip
instructions: Put half each of the chicken wings, tomato soup, beef broth, and paprika in a roasting pan. Cover with plastic wrap and bake in a preheated 350 degrees f oven for 30 minutes. Bake until chicken has an internal temperature of 170 degrees f. Cool chicken on a cutting board for 15 minutes. Remove chicken from marinade and slice into long pieces. Put chicken and marinade into a large pot and add 1 can condensed tomato soup. Stir and heat on stove over low heat for about 10 minutes. Arrange the spinach on top of sauce and gently stir. Top with 1 cup of mozzarella cheese. Sprinkle with another cup of mozzarella cheese and another 1/2 cup of mozzarella cheese. Repeat until all ingredients are used. Bake for 30 minutes until bubbly and lightly browned. Sprinkle last cup of mozzarella cheese on top and return to oven.

Random Ingredients: graham cracker crumb,plain yogurt,red bell pepper,rye bread,urad dal,watercress,pork tenderloin,sunflower seed
title: Kebab-Inspired Pork Gyros
ingredients: 1 cup plain yogurt | 2 cups prepared roasted sesame-seed bread | 1/2 lb boneless pork tenderloin, cut into very thin strips | 1 cup watercress, chopped | 1 red bell pepper, chopped | 1/2 cup sunflower seeds, coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup graham cracker crumbs | 2 tablespoons urad dal, ground ( split red gram ) | 2 tablespoons plain yogurt
instructions: Mix together the yogurt and the sesame seeds in a bowl. Add the pork strips and knead them together making sure they get coated evenly. Cover and refrigerate for about 30 minutes. Thread the pork onto 12 long skewers and grill over medium heat, turning occasionally, until done.

title: Indian Apricot Sauce
ingredients: 1 2/3 cups low sodium chicken stock | 1 - 1 1/2 cup apricot preserves | 1/2 teaspoon ground turmeric, plus extra for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Combine the stock and preserves in a medium saucepan over medium high heat.

title: Easy Veal Pate
ingredients: 1 lb veal | 1 container cool whip
instructions: Finely mince your veal and place in bowl. Stir in your favorite veal cheese. Cover with cool whip. Serve with boiled new potatoes or fresh veggies.

Random Ingredients: naan bread,mexican oregano,limeade concentrate,spaghetti sauce mix,cake flour,sugar syrup,picante sauce
title: Tex-Mex Snack
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups spaghetti sauce mix | 1 teaspoon mexican oregano | 1 1/2 cups nane's cake flour | 1 tablespoon granulated sugar syrup | 1 can frozen limeade concentrate, thawed | 6 -8 naan bread | picante sauce
instructions: Preheat broiler. Place spaghetti sauce mix and oregano in large bowl. Place flour in a separate bowl. Add sugar syrup and limeade concentrate to sifter in second bowl and mix well. Place nane's in a third bowl and the second bowl. Cut 3 slices of bread in half. Remove crusts from 1 bread piece and cut in half and place bread in bowl with spaghetti sauce mix. Sprinkle bread with 2 tsp lime marjoram and top with the noodle mixture. Place on cookie sheet and broil 5 - 10 minutes, till golden brown. Add picante sauce to a serving dish and top with remaining bread piece. Serve with extra picante sauce.

title: Potato Salad
ingredients: 1 lb white potato | 1 lb frozen vegetables, thawed | 1 cup frozen raspberries, thawed | 1 cup chopped kalamata olive | 8 ounces frozen cherries | 1/4 teaspoon vanilla bean ( optional ) | 8 ounces chopped thai basil | 1/4 cup sliced almonds
instructions: Cook and mash potatoes till crisp tender and slightly browned. Add frozen, thawed vegetables, raspberries, and olives. Mix well. Add thawed vanilla beans, thawed thawed cherries, and thawed basil and mix well. Cover and chill until ready to serve.

title: Tasty, Tasty Crispy Quinoa Burritos
ingredients: 2 cups water | 1 cup instant quinoa | 1 tablespoon ground cumin | 1 tablespoon ground coriander | 1/3 cup tamari | 1/4 teaspoon ground cumin | 1 cup shredded cheddar cheese | 1 can chicken breasts, drained and cut into strips | 1 bag mixed salad greens
instructions: In a saucepan, bring the water to a boil. Stir in the quinoa, 1 tbsp of ground cumin, and coriander. Cover and reduce heat, and simmer for 15 minutes until quinoa is tender and liquid has been absorbed. Set aside. In a small bowl, mix tamari and 1/4 tsp cumin. Set aside. In a large bowl, combine the remaining ground cumin with the cheese, shrimp or chicken slices, 1/4 tsp cumin, and 1/4 tsp tamari. To serve, spoon 1/4 of the quinoa mixture into a large, shallow platter. Arrange the salad greens in a circle around the quinoa, then arrange the chicken over it. Spread the cheese and spice mix over the salad greens, and serve warm.

title: Faux Couscous
ingredients: 600 g couscous | 1 pinch dried marjoram
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together and leave overnight. The next day, put the couscous in a large bowl, add a little more water if needed, then cover and leave to swell for 15 minutes on very gentle heat. This will give you a fluffy porridge like texture to the couscous, but a softer crunch. When ready, fluff up if needed with a fork and serve topped with a sprinkling of chopped fresh dried marjoram.

title: Salmon and grape tomatoes
ingredients: 8 medium salmon | 12 grape tomatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place salmon on a wire rack over a baking dish. Slice into 5 wedges each. Toss with tomatoes and bake 30 minutes, until the tomatoes are tender.

Random Ingredients: superfine sugar,italian herb,worcestershire sauce,turmeric,rye cocktail bread,new potato
title: Welsh  Potato Salad
ingredients: 2 lbs new potatoes | 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 1 teaspoon turmeric | 1 tablespoon mixed italian herbs | 1/4 cup superfine sugar | rye cocktail bread, to serve
instructions: Put the potatoes in a pot, cover with cold water, bring to the boil and boil for 20 to 30 minutes or until very tender. Transfer to a bowl, cover and leave in a cool place for 2 hours, or until cold. Drain the potatoes, dry with kitchen paper and then toss well with the worcestershire sauce. Add the turmeric, mixed herbs and sugar, season and stir to combine. Leave to stand for 5 minutes. To serve, remove the potatoes, slice into 1/4 inch rounds and mound on a serving platter. Serve warm.

title: Grilled Swedish Venison Sandwich Filling
ingredients: 2 lbs venison tenderloin | 1/4 cup sour cream | 1 tablespoon heavy cream | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1/3 cup green cardamoms, crushed | 2 -3 pinches ground cardamom
instructions: Place the venison tenderloin in a 12 inch nonstick skillet. Mix sour cream, cream, cardamom and ground cardamom well.

title: Spicy Sausage Salad
ingredients: 2 green chili peppers, chopped | 1 large orange bell pepper, chopped | 1 large italian sausage, cut in 1-inch cubes ( about 1 pound ) | 1 can italian plum tomatoes | 1/2 cup roasted peanuts, chopped | 1 teaspoon five-spice powder | 1 teaspoon madras curry powder | 1/4 cup honey
instructions: Combine chili peppers, orange pepper, and sausage in a large bowl. Arrange tomato slices over sausage mixture in an even layer.

title: Duck in Broccoli
ingredients: 1 duck | 1 1/2 cups fresh broccoli florets, rinsed and dried
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Place duck in a baking dish and brush with melted butter. Roast in the preheated oven until duck is golden brown, 30 to 40 minutes. Remove duck from the oven and let stand 10 minutes. Discard any bones or skin. Cut into quarters if desired. Place broccoli in a bowl and cover with cold water. Let sit 5 minutes, then drain well. Place duck, broccoli, and any juices that have collected on the bowl into the dish and mix.

title: Tunisian Style Lamb
ingredients: 3/4 cup cremini mushrooms, finely chopped | 3 dried red chilies, soaked and chopped | 4 lamb fillets, frenched
instructions: Mix the chilie and mushroom mixture with the lamb. Heat a heavy based pan. Fry the lamb until well browned. Serve over rice or noodles.

title: Cheese Won Tons
ingredients: 1 package refrigerated four-cheese wonton wrappers ( about 4-oz. ) | 3 cups whole milk ricotta cheese | 1/2 cup buttermilk | 1 tablespoon poppy seed ( toasted in a dry skillet ) | 1 tablespoon nutritional yeast | 2 teaspoons dark soy sauce | 1 garlic clove, minced | 1 teaspoon worcestershire sauce
instructions: Dough, add all ingredients to a medium bowl, except the wrappers, excluding wrappers, to a food processor, stirring until smooth with small chunky bits of zing. Place 2 tablespoons of the mixture, a few dashes of sea salt and fresh black pepper, 1 tablespoon of water and a pinch of salt into the center of the wonton wrappers by folding the edges of the wonton over them, pressing them out into the center with your fingers. Place remaining mixture on a floured work surface and, with a pastry brush, brush the edges with water to a depth of 4 inches. Repeat with remaining wonton wrappers, placing them about 2/3 full, on a lightly floured work surface. Using your fingers, make 2 indentations into the center of each won ton, pressing down to seal. Place won ton on a lined baking sheet. Using a very sharp knife, make three diagonal slashes on top of each won ton. Lightly oil a griddle or heavy skillet and cook won tons until golden brown on both sides, flipping when necessary. Cool 5 minutes, then remove from baking sheet. Serve warm.

title: Green Kale (Achiote)
ingredients: 1/2 cup chipped kale | 1/2 yellow pepper, chopped | 1 teaspoon dried minced garlic ( optional )
instructions: Place the chipped kale and chopped yellow pepper in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: onion soup mix,mexican cheese,creme fraiche,curry powder
title: Spicy Cheese Dip
ingredients: 1 package shredded mexican blend cheese | 1 can condensed onion soup mix | 3/4 cup creme fraiche | 1 tablespoon curry powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In an 8x8 inch baking dish mix together the cheese, soup mix, creme fraiche, and curry powder. Bake in preheated oven for 30 minutes, or until bubbly and heated through.

title: Peach and Pecan Baklava - Baklava
ingredients: 1 fresh peach, pitted and sliced | 1 package phyllo pastry, thawed in refrigerator if frozen, defrosted if frozen | chopped pecans ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 f. Place sliced peaches in a small baking dish and bake until softened, about 10 minutes. Transfer the peaches to a bowl of cold water to cool, about 15 minutes. Remove peaches with a slotted spoon and put on a work surface. Brush with melted butter to preserve moisture. Place remaining phyllo pastry sheets on a lightly floured work surface and with a sharp knife, stretch and fold phyllo sheets together to make small squares until they measure about 8x8 inches in circumference. Place peach slices in a square of phyllo and top with chopped pecans, if using, if using. Fold in the edges of the phyllo sheets once more, and repeat process with remaining phyllo and peaches, placing each piece on a lightly greased and floured baking sheet. Bake until phyllo is puffed up and browned and the pit is barely beginning to flake, about 25 minutes. Let cool for 5 minutes then cut into squares.

title: Alfredo Mushrooms
ingredients: 5 ounces fresh shiitake mushrooms | 1/8 teaspoon instant coffee | 2 cups strong brewed coffee | 1/8 cup chopped fresh shiitake mushroom | 4 eggs | 4 tablespoons dried instant alfredo sauce | 2 teaspoons smoked turmeric powder | kosher salt and black pepper
instructions: To prepare alfredo sauce, soak dried mushrooms in at least half an inch warm water for 15 minutes. Soak mushrooms in 1/8 c of the coffee on a foil lined baking sheet in the refrigerator. Bring remaining 1/8 c of coffee to a boil in a small saucepan. Add the shiitake mushrooms and cook for about 2 minutes until softened. Drain the mushrooms and cool them in the coffee and coffee. To prepare eggs, using a fork, beat the eggs and the alfredo sauce until nice and fluffy. Dice the cooled shiitake mushrooms and transfer them to a bowl. Add egg mixture and the turmeric and mix together to combine. Season to taste with salt and pepper. To prepare alfredo mushroom soup, heat 2 tbs olive oil in a saucepan set over medium heat and cook dried mushrooms for 7 minutes, or until soft. Drain the mushrooms and add to the egg mixture. Gently stir in the alfredo sauce. Transfer to a bowl and garnish with fresh shiitake mushrooms.

title: Chocolate Faint Fingers
