instructions: Place the crushed wafers in a bowl. Add the coco powder. Mix thoroughly. Dip finger with the cocoa powder. Keep in the fridge till the next day. Tip, if you have any wafer left, you may dip your finger in it and then in the morning make small finger fingers. Enjoy.

title: Jalapeno and Shrimp in Chocolate
ingredients: 4 ounces dark chocolate | 1 1/4 lbs shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1 bunch jalapeno, seeded and sliced | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon granules | 1/8 teaspoon red pepper | 1 teaspoon shrimp bouillon granules
instructions: Warm chocolate with half of jalapeños and the chicken bouillon in metal bowl. Melt chocolate, stirring frequently, and transfer to saucepan. Add remaining jalapeños, jalapenos, and remaining chicken bouillon. Heat until chocolate is melted, stirring occasionally.

Random Ingredients: sesame seed,ice water,alfredo sauce,bay leaf,lemon juice zest,lobster tail,honey mustard,ham
title: Lobster Thermidor
ingredients: 8 lobster tails | 24 ounces alfredo sauce | 2 teaspoons honey mustard | 2 tablespoons sesame seeds | 1 tablespoon lemon juice | 1/8 bay leaf | shredded cooked ham ( optional ) | ice water
instructions: Rinse lobster tails under cold water and snip the bottoms, and if using fresh lobsters, shell them. Cut out the claws and set aside. In a mixing bowl combine the alfredo sauce, honey mustard, sesame seeds, lemon juice, and bay leaf. Stir well. Add the lobster tails, and gently roll them in the sauce. Place on a sheet of reynolds wrap aluminum foil, and place in the freezer to chill for several hours or overnight. The longer the tails are frozen, the more tiome they will be able to handle without falling off. Once chilled, remove the tails. Heat the oven to 400 degrees f. Take out the shrimp and set aside in a bowl. Slide a knife around the edge of the foil so that the shrimp can slip off the shell easily. Place shrimp onto the sheet of foil. Bake for 5 minutes to heat through. Slice open the shrimp and discard the skin. Carefully remove the top shrimp shell portion of shell and discard with a knife. Set aside in a serving bowl. Pour some of the olive oil in a skillet, and cook the lobster tails until golden brown or until they just begin to curl around the edges and turn opaque. Remove half of the tails per shrimp and return to the skillet. Drain the tails on paper towels. Place tails onto a serving dish. Drizzle the pan with some of the remaining oil. Top with shredded cheddar cheese or your favorite cheese. Serve with a bowl of your favorite alfredo sauce. Note, if you aren't planning on serving the lobster as an appetizer, you can add sliced ham to the olive oil when you saute the lobster.

title: Lemon-Lebanese Noodles
ingredients: 1 package lasagna noodles | 1/2 lemon peel
instructions: Heat a large skillet over high heat. Cook and stir lasagna noodles until they begin to soften, about 1 minute. Stir in the lemon peel. Remove from heat. Let stand 30 seconds, then pour into a large bowl, or cover with a damp paper towel.

title: Tostones (Giant Salsa Di Tonno)
ingredients: 1 lb beefsteak tomato ( or equivalent in size ) | 1 head iceberg lettuce ( can be frozen ) | 2 cups chicken stock
instructions: Thaw tomato overnight. Wash the lettuce very well in a couple of changes of cold water, as the outer water will be the bitter taste of the coro. Cut the tomato off the stem but, with a sharp knife, slice the outer layers of the tomato just like you're slicing the rind. Using a vegetable peeler, peel away any green or a little bit of the skin from the tomato. It doesn't peel evenly, so try to use a small knife only for the best slices, which can take literally 20 - 30 seconds each. The tomatoes will also be easier to remove, so be prepared where the cut side of the tomato you cut off is facing upwards, otherwise they might be skinned. Drain the tomato and discard. Place the tomato in a bowl and toss with the chicken stock until the tomatoes are soft. The tomato mixture should be just covering them, but if not, add more chicken stock and gently stir. Cut off the ends of the coro, and slice off the hard, thin part around the base, being careful not to tear the large leaves, then toss with the iceberg lettuce. If you want to be fancy, drizzle a few drops of oil or water onto the top, and serve with your favorite tostada toppings. Serve cold for that matter.

Random Ingredients: basil,hot italian sausage,lemon juice zest,nori,ketchup,pico de gallo
title: Pita Burgers
ingredients: 1 lb hot italian sausage | 1/3 cup lemon juice or 1/3 cup lime juice | 1/2 cup ketchup | 1/4 cup fresh basil, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon ketchup | 1 package pico de gallo
instructions: Slice the hot italian sausage into 1/8 inch slices. Place in a medium bowl. Add the other ingredients. Mix well with hands. Spray a nonstick pan with cooking spray. Over medium high heat, place 3 to 5 patties on pan. When they are all hot and crispy, flip and cook other side until cooked through and meat is cooked through again.

title: Sweet Potato, Spinach, Raisin Patties
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs sweet potatoes | 12 large fresh spinach leaves | 2 eggs | 1/4 cup worcestershire sauce | 1/4 cup mirin | 1/2 cup golden raisin | 1/4 cup vegetable oil
instructions: Place the sweet potatoes in a medium saucepan and cover with cold water. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce the heat to medium low and simmer until the potatoes are soft, about 15 minutes. Drain and allow to steam dry for a minute or two. Halve the sweet potatoes lengthwise, scoop out the seeds with a potato masher, and coarsely mash. Stir the mashed sweet potatoes with the spinach leaves, eggs, worcestershire sauce, mirin, raisins, and oil into the mashed potato mixture. Spoon the mixture out onto a large plate to cool. The patties can be frozen at this point for up to 10 days.

title: Aji
ingredients: 2 1/2 ounces semi-sweet chocolate | 1 garlic clove
instructions: Place the garlic in a pestle that has been slightly brushed with oil. Heat up the griddle, adding a little more oil if you need to. When the garlic starts to turn golden brown, take it off the hob. Add the grated chocolate and continue frying for a minute or two, until the chocolate has melted and all the garlic has begun to caramelise. Scrape the chocolate onto a plate to serve.

title: Nuclear Nachos

instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Brush taco shells with almond extract, or as desired. Arrange on a baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until crisp, 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Sun-Dried Tomato, Green Chile and Chilli Jam
ingredients: 1/2 cup fresh sun-dried tomato packed in oil, minced | 1/2 cup diced green chili pepper
instructions: Combine all ingredients in saucepan.

title: Cheesy Sage Nesto Dressing

instructions: In a blender or food processor, combine the sage, cheddar cheese, water chestnuts, apricots, half and half, pesto, tarragon, sea salt, and black pepper.

title: Perfect Rice for Meals
ingredients: 1 1/2 1 1/2 cups basmati rice or 1 1/2 cups wild rice
instructions: Sieve or process all ingredients. Serve immediately in a shallow bowl.

title: Aceitifique
ingredients: 2 cups brown rice flour | 2 cups hot brewed tea | 1/2 cup mangoes or 1/2 cup papaya ( chopped ) | 1/2 cup shallot ( chopped ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1 red chile pepper | 1 tablespoon brandy or 1 tablespoon rum
instructions: Mix rice flour and hot tea. Add mango, shallots, cardamon, red chili pepper and brandy. Mix well. The batter should be of thick porridge consistency. Let stand for 5 minutes in the refrigerator. Serve with crushed ice and a sprig of fresh mint.

title: Simple Tuna Salad
ingredients: 2 lbs beef tenderloin | 2 tablespoons fat-free mayonnaise
instructions: Cut the tuna from the block it should resemble a block. If you like a lot of texture, just put the block of tuna on a plate. Cut the block of tuna into smaller bits so it will fit the serving plate. Spread the mayonnaise on the tuna and enjoy.

title: Aegean Apricot Crumbs
ingredients: 1 cup panko breadcrumbs | 1 cup apricot preserves ( i use solo brand )
instructions: Soak apricot preserves for 10 to 15 minutes prior to making crumbs. Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Spray baking sheet with cooking oil spray. Mix panko and bread crumbs in separate bowl. Dunk fruit into bread crumbs using a fork. Arrange evenly on baking sheet in a single layer. Bake 15 to 10 minutes, turning only once. Remove and place on baking sheets. Bake 5 to 10 minutes. Cut into wedges.

title: Stuffed Mushrooms
ingredients: 12 medium mushrooms ( about 2 lbs ) | 4 -5 cups cooked meat | 1 can pumpkin puree | arborio rice or other short-grain rice ( for serving )
instructions: Rinse the mushrooms under cold water to remove the sand and dirt. Drain well. Set mushrooms aside. Place 3 cups cooked meat on each mushroom, top with ¾ cup raw rice and a tablespoon of pumpkin puree. Roll lightly and secure the ends. Steam filled mushrooms for about 20 minutes at a medium fire. You may need a little water during steaming, to keep from getting burned. Serve with a spinkled, flavored cream if desired.

instructions: Place curry powder into a mortar and grind to a powder with a pestle until fine. Add apples, garlic, sirloin, cream and vanilla. Mix in shredded chicken and cucumber. Heat and serve over jasmine rice, or other grain of your choice.

instructions: Place the meat in a bowl and make sure the beef cubes are well coated. Pour the beef stock into a bowl with the egg yolks and pepper. title: Corned Beef With Anchovies, Lettuce and Trotters

title: Beef and Beans

instructions: In a slow cooker, combine the meat, beans, onion, cherry halves, and maraschino cherries, if desired. Cover, and cook on low 1 hour.

title: Rhubarb and Red Onion Preserve Style Jar

instructions: Clean and peel rinds from onion using a vegetable peeler or a vegetable peeler. Cut red onions into thirds. Remove stems from rhubarb. Cut rind, then cut into 1/8 wide wedges. Dip rinsed onions into 1/2 cup boiling water and let stand 5 minutes. Squeeze rinds and onions into a jar and combine with rhubarb in layers over contents. Bake in a preheated oven for 1 to 3 hours, or until rhubarb is tender.. Remove foil about 1/2 cup of juice every 15 minutes and stir..

title: Chocolate, Broccoli & Orange Chili Sauce
ingredients: 2 ounces cocoa sol chipped chocolate | 10 tablespoons double cream | 1 tablespoon hot sauce ( or to taste ) | 1 tablespoon double cream | 1 tablespoon fresh cilantro stem, chopped | 1/2 orange, zest of, coarsely grated | 1 cup broccoli, halved crosswise | fresh cilantro stem, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: In a food processor or blender, combine the chocolates and cream and pulse until smooth, then process until blended. Stir the hot sauce, cream and cilantro into the chocolate mixture. Whisk in the orange zest and the broccoli. Refrigerate until ready to serve. Garnish with additional sprigs of fresh cilantro sprigs, if desired.

title: Rice With Black Pepper
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked rice | 1 bunch green tops rinsed under cold running water | 1/2 teaspoon fresh ground black pepper
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions. Cover rice with very hot tap water for 2 minutes or until water is almost clear. Drain. Place rice in a serving dish. Sprinkle with remaining ingredients. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: sesame seed,soymilk,red chili pepper,spring wrapper,bamboo shoot,cranberry sauce,raspberry
title: Salmon & Raspberries Spring Rolls
ingredients: 2 spring roll wrappers | 1/2 cup raspberries | 12 slices fresh ginger ( thin-sliced ) | 1 teaspoon sesame seeds | 1 cup light soymilk | 2 tablespoons low-fat soy milk | 1/8 red chili peppers or 1/8 green hot chili pepper, seeded and chopped | 1 -2 stalk fresh red chili pepper, seeded | 1 tablespoon dried cranberry sauce
instructions: Rinse the spring roll wrappers dry and place them on a lightly oiled baking sheet or on a cookie sheet with a rim that fits just over 2 inches in diameter. Cover with a large plate. Place the slice of raspberries in a mini chopper along with the ginger, sesame seeds, 1 cup of light soy milk and the chili. Puree or process until smooth using an electric blender or a regular blender. Stir the pureed raspberries and chopped ginger into the yogurt. Refrigerate for 8 - 10 hours. When ready to serve, spread 1/2 tablespoons of the yogurt mixture on the wrapper and spread out evenly. Lay 6 pieces of ginger, a bit of raspberries and a tablespoon of red chilly on top of the yogurt mixture. Roll from the bottom up, and roll from all sides to the top if needed. Serve immediately. Repeat with the rest of the yogurt mixture.

Random Ingredients: sun tomato,red burgundy wine,mexican cheese,sauerkraut,farfalle pasta,orange juice
title: Grandma's Baked Pasta
ingredients: 1 box farfalle pasta or ( 16 ounce ) box bow tie pasta | 1 cup sauerkraut ( drained and rinsed well ) | 1/4 cup orange juice | 1 sun-dried tomato ( rinsed well if using regular tomatoes ) or 1 large fresh tomato ( rinsed well if using regular tomatoes ) | 1 cup red burgundy wine | 1/2 cup shredded mexican blend cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Pour pasta into a 3 quart baking dish. Stir together sauerkraut, orange juice, sun dried tomatoes, red burgundy wine and cheese, spread over pasta. Cover loosely with foil, bake for 25 minutes. Uncover, pour sauerkraut mixture evenly over the top and bake for an additional 25 minutes, or until heated through.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice,whipping cream,veal,cranberry juice cocktail,water chestnut,chorizo sausage,crisco shortening,banana pepper
title: Veal, Chorizo & Banana Pepper Casserole
ingredients: 1/4 cup crisco shortening | 3 ounces chorizo sausage, casing removed | 1 lb ground veal or 1 lb ground beef | 1 cup cranberry juice cocktail | 2 tablespoons lemon juice, freshly squeezed | 3/4 cup water chestnuts, drained and chopped | 2 bananas, sliced and cooked, but not mushy | 1 package whipping cream, chilled to soften
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Pour 2 tablesp of the shortening into a 9x13 baking pan. Over medium heat, melt chorizo in the melted cheese and butter. Add meat and cook until lightly browned. Add cranberry juice, lemon juice, water chestnuts and bananas. Continue cooking until bananas are heated through. Spread mixture in baking pan. Top with remaining shortening. Bake 40 - 45 minutes or until heated through and the filling is slightly browned on top. Serve over rice.

Random Ingredients: apple juice,vanilla essence,kraft mayonnaise,meat,hoagie,self rising flour,flat rice noodle,cayenne pepper sauce
title: Apple Meat Casserole
ingredients: 1 cup cooked meat, shredded | 3 hoagie rolls, cut in half on the diagonal | 2 tablespoons mayonnaise | 1/4 cup kraft mayonnaise | 1/4 cup apple juice | 1/4 cup kraft lowfat mayonnaise | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne pepper sauce | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: Mix the meat with the hoagie cut side open, spread out it evenly on the bottom half of each roll halves. Mix the mayonnaise, kraft mayonnaise, mustard and apple juice in a bowl. Sprinkle the cayenne pepper sauce and vanilla essence over the meat mixture. Spread the cheese mixture evenly on top of the meat mixture, place the roll in a baking dish. Bake in a 425°f oven until hot and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: mango chutney,beef broth,sponge cake,green apple,bay seasoning,green cardamom pod,almond flavoring
title: Apple Meatballs in Mango Chutney
ingredients: 4 slices sponge cakes ( cut 1/2 inch round ) | 1 can condensed beef broth ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon mango chutney ( or curry chutney ) | 1 teaspoon almond flavoring | 1/2 teaspoon bay seasoning | 1/4 teaspoon green cardamom pods or 1/4 teaspoon cumin seeds, crushed | 1/4 teaspoon green apple, finely chopped
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well. Shape into 1 1/2 inch diameter balls. Place on waxed paper and chill until firm, about 30 minutes. Meanwhile, prepare spiced meatballs recipe, place bread slices in shallow dish. Cover and let stand 30 minutes. Preheat broiler and position rack 6 inches from heat. Remove bread from dish, reserving for later use. Add meatballs to beef broth and simmer 5 minutes, turning over. Transfer cooked meatballs to bowl with any accumulated broth. Return broth to heat. Place bay and cardamom seeds in small skillet.

title: Chilled Halibut With Faux Herb and Salt Crust
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dried sweetened mint leaves | 5 lbs halibut fillets
instructions: Dry leaves and coarsely grind them in a spice grinder or mini food chopper. In a bowl mix mint and mint mixture. Spread mixture over fish. Wrap well and refrigerate for a minimum of 12 hours preferably overnight. Light the grill. Cook, basting with marinated fish occasionally, over direct heat and turning once, until fish flakes easily when tested with a fork. Serve.

title: Easy Burgers
ingredients: 3/4 cup texturized veggie burger | 1 tablespoon chili paste | 1 tablespoon fresh thyme | 1/2 cup fresh italian parsley, chopped | 1 cup fresh blueberries
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the burger/vegetable burger patty, chili paste, thyme, parsley and blueberries. Serve immediately.

title: Lamb with Cranberry Vinegar
ingredients: 1 lb boneless lamb, cut into 2-inch x 1-inch pieces | 2 cups cranberry juice | 1/4 cup wine vinegar | 1 1/2 teaspoons baking powder | 3 tablespoons sugar | 1/2 cup chopped fresh cranberries or 1/2 cup craisins, raisins and craisins | 1/4 cup coarsely chopped fresh coarse grain
instructions: Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium heat. Sprinkle lamb pieces with salt, and sear in the oil on all sides. Combine the vinegar and baking powder in a small bowl, and pour in 1 cup of the juice, stirring to blend. Add the sugar, cranberries, and raisins.

title: Red Onion Tomato Sauce for Focaccia
ingredients: 1 jar marinara sauce | 1/2 medium red onion, thinly sliced
instructions: Place onion slices into a medium bowl, pouring the marinara sauce over the top.

title: Spinach and bell peppers for the BBQ
ingredients: 10 large fresh spinach leaves | 1 green bell pepper, diced | 1 tablespoon mixed spice
instructions: Wash and dry the spinach thoroughly. Place the washed spinach in a bowl and add the diced bell pepper. Sprinkle the mixed spice over the spinach and mix well. Cover with a lid and put the lid on the bowl. Keep the bowl in the microwave for 10 minutes to steam the mixture. The steam will help you get the cooked spinach. This is one of those things that makes it so easy to clean the spinach and bell peppers. Allow it to steam for an additional 9 - 10 minutes. Serve the spinach and pepper mixture with ketchup or plain yoghurt on the side.

title: Stuffed Hoagies
ingredients: 2 slices prosciutto | 1 cup dry garbanzo beans, soaked overnight | 1/4 cup corn syrup | 1/2 cup white onion, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons cornstarch | 1/3 cup light corn syrup | 1/3 cup pecans, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. In a saucepan, saute prosciutto in 1 t. Of corn syrup over medium heat until prosciutto is crisp, about 4 minutes. Drain on paper towels. Place the beans in a bowl, cover with water, and let stand for 10 minutes. Drain beans and add to bowl with prosciutto, garbanzo beans, and 1 t. Corn syrup. Mix well. Place dough on a lightly floured surface, and knead for 2 minutes, adding more corn syrup or flour if necessary. Cover dough and chill. Roll dough out on a lightly floured surface to 1/8 inch thick. Using a 3 inch round cookie cutter, cut out a hole.

Random Ingredients: tea,cumin seed,dark soy sauce,curry,beef brisket,mexican oregano,rotel tomato chilies,water chestnut
title: Tex-Mex Brisket
ingredients: 5 lbs beef brisket | 1 tablespoon coriander/2 teaspoon cumin seed, crushed | 5 ounces dark soy sauce | 1 tablespoon teapsoon tea or 1 tablespoon other strong tea | 2 cans ro-tel diced tomatoes & chilies | 1 large can sliced water chestnuts, drained and coarsely chopped | 1 teaspoon mexican oregano
instructions: Make marinade by placing the soy sauce, teapsoon tea, 1/2 can ro tel diced tomatoes & chilies, water chestnuts & oregano into a large zip lock bag. Add brisket and marinate for at least 3 hours in refrigerator. Cook brisket on a hot grill for approx 15 minute per side, turning until tender and falling off the bones. Remove from grill, and cool to room temperature then slice. Keep in freezer until ready to use.

Random Ingredients: teriyaki sauce,zucchini,basil leaf,buckwheat flour,sunflower oil,broth,pizza crust,tortilla
title: Breaded Zucchini Triangles with Basil and Tortillas
ingredients: 1 pizza crust ( boboli recommended ) | 2 tablespoons sunflower oil | 1 cup buckwheat flour | 1/2 cup chicken stock or 1/2 cup broth | 1/2 cup tater tots or 1/2 cup shredded zucchini | 1/3 cup teriyaki sauce | 1/2 cup minced fresh basil leaf | 1 cup sliced zucchini, ends discarded, thinly sliced
instructions: Preheat broiler. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Press pizza crust into a 12 inch nonstick skillet. Brush with oil. Cut pizza crust into four wedges. Arrange wedges on prepared baking sheet. Broil for five to ten minutes. Let cool slightly. Combine flours, broth, tater tots, and basil. Spread over crust. Top with zucchini slices. Broil five to ten minutes more or until zucchini are tender. Serve, passing toppings at table.

Random Ingredients: ice water,kernel corn,bell pepper,lemon zest,red chilies
title: Spicy Mexican Corn
ingredients: 1 cup frozen whole kernel corn, thawed | 2 large red chilies, finely chopped | 4 tablespoons lemon zest, finely grated | 2 tablespoons chopped peeled bell peppers | 2 tablespoons ice water
instructions: Drain corn kernels well on paper towels. Combine corn, chillies, lemon zest, bell pepper, and ice water in a microwave safe bowl. Microwave on high 8 - 10 minutes until heated through, mashing with a fork. Cover and let stand 5 minutes or longer to heat through. Serve immediately, or refrigerate until serving.

Random Ingredients: broth,mirin,green chili pepper,tamarind paste,chuck,olive oil,parsley flake
title: Japanese Beef in Tamarind Sauce
ingredients: 3 lbs chuck, in 1 1/2-inch cubes ( you may also substitute round steak ) | 2 ounces tamarind paste | 2 tablespoons mirin | 1 -2 hot green chili pepper | 1 -2 tablespoon coarsely chopped parsley flakes | 1/2 cup broth ( optional or to taste ) | 2 tablespoons olive oil
instructions: Cut meat into 5 to 6 pieces. Remove seeds if necessary and cut tamarind into 1/2 inch cubes. Soak meat in cold water 10 to 15 minutes, covered, until softened. Shake in tamarind water for 30 minutes until soaking is smooth. Drain excess liquid from meat and reserve. Put meat in a large pot with cold water to cover. In a small bowl, combine mirin and chile pepper. Bring to boil and boil 3 to 4 minutes. Drain, reserving liquid and discarding chile pepper. Drain meat and combine with marinade in pot. Cover, bring to boil and cook 1 hour on low. If necessary, raise cooking heat to high to bring level of liquid to cover meat. This will take 30 to 45 minutes. Add tamarind water, broth, if you wish and heat, gently, uncovered, until meat is very tender. Remove meat from pot and let it stand for 10 minutes then slice into thin slices. If you like a thicker sauce, remove sauce from heat and whisk until all solids have been disolved. Serve over rice or noodles.

title: Peanut Butter Muffins
ingredients: 1/2 cup peanut butter | 1/2 teaspoon oregano | 1/2 teaspoon italian seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon baking powder | 1 cup fresh mushrooms, sliced
instructions: Dump italian seasoning and peanut butter in a medium bowl.

title: Simmered Sugar Snap Peas
ingredients: 2 lbs sugar snap peas | 2 tablespoons white vinegar
instructions: Fill a 6 1/2 to 8 quart pot 1/3 with water and bring to a boil. Snap the ends from the snap peas and blanch in the boiling water for a minute or two, then drain well.

Random Ingredients: dark soy sauce,chicken thigh,brown lentil,chili paste,berry,wide egg noodle,yellow food coloring,bay leaf
title: Spicy Lentil & Noodle Dish
ingredients: 8 ounces wide egg noodles | 1 1/2 cups brown lentils ( or purple or yellow lentils ) | 1/2 cup chili paste | 2 1/2 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 1 tablespoon yellow food coloring | 1 bay leaf | 4 1/2 lbs chicken thighs ( trimmed skin removed, bone left intact ) or 4 1/2 lbs drumsticks ( trimmed skin removed, bone left intact )
instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions. While noodles cook, heat 1 tablespoon chili paste, dark soy sauce, food coloring, and bay leaf in a large non stick skillet over medium heat, stirring frequently, until heated through. Add the chicken and stir to coat with pan sauce, breaking up the meat with the back of a spoon. Transfer the chicken to a dish, cover and cook in a 350 degree oven until the chicken is cooked through and juices run clear, about 45 minutes. Transfer the chicken to a plate.

Random Ingredients: spinach leaf,port wine,puff pastry,quinoa,corn syrup,cream cheese,pork loin roast,catfish
title: Shirred Catfish Wrapped in Pot With Spinach and Quinoa #RSC
ingredients: 3 -6 quinoa | 3 lbs boneless pork loin roast | 1 tablespoon corn syrup | 1/2 cup port wine | 1 package spinach leaves | 1 container softened cream cheese | 1 teaspoon corn syrup | 2 puff pastry sheets, thawed and frozen | 1 1/2 cups catfish, fresh cooked
instructions: Cook quinoa according to package directions for 2 cups of water and a tablespoon of cornstarch. Set aside... Place pork on an unlined grill and grill until browned on the outside but not cooked through, about 10 minutes. Remove from grill and allow to sit for 10 minutes to allow meat to brown a little. In large pot, add enough water to cover the meat and bring to a boil. Add the cooked quinoa, cover, and simmer until the liquid has dried to a glaze, about 20 minutes. Remove meat from the pot and place on a platter.. Remove pork from the pot and set aside. In a medium saucepan, add the pork broth and bring to a boil over medium heat. Add the spinach and cook for about 5 minutes. Remove the pan from the heat. Add the cream cheese and bring to a simmer for about 3 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in the corn syrup and the reserved 1/2 cup of water. Put the spinach mixture on a large plate or individual serving bowls. Roll each pastry sheet to a 13x9 inch rectangle and fold pastry near the center, leaving about 2 inches at the side on the side nearest to you. Place 1/4 of the cream cheese mixture onto the cream cheese, then fold the left 3/4s over that and the right 3/4s over that, leaving about 1 1/2 inches at the edge. Cut the left side of the pastry into thin strips that are long enough to encorporate the filling evenly. Fold the left and right sides into the filling and place on top of your prepared pastry strips. Roll the edges into tight film like logs and tie with kitchen twine. Place on a lightly oiled baking sheet and cut a slit along the bottom of the rolls to allow steam to escape while baking. Lightly brush with cornstarch and bake at 400 degrees f for about 25 to 30 minutes or until well browned on the outside and the rolls are heated through. Serve the wrapped catfish on a large platter with a generous cup of chutney alongside.

Random Ingredients: rice noodle,ale,red bell pepper,cayenne,brown rice,applesauce,garlic paste
title: My Favourite Easy Vietnamese Noodle Bowl
ingredients: 1/2 cup brown rice | 1/2 cup rice noodles, soaked in water for 20 minutes ( rice sticks work great ) | 1 red bell pepper, chopped chopped | 1 tablespoon garlic paste | 1 tablespoon apple sauce ( i used kame dark apple sauce ) | cayenne or other hot red pepper sauce, to taste ( optional ) | applesauce or soy sauce, to taste
instructions: Drain all water from the rice noodles, cover with boiling water and let sit for 20 minutes. Drain and rinse with a mixture of a small amount of cold water and your desired amount of salt. Cook noodles in boiling water for 2 to 3 minutes. Drain in a colander and rinse well with cold water. Drain the excess water off. Saute or rinse bell pepper in a little olive oil in a large pan until soft and slightly crisp. Add the garlic paste and saute until fragrant. Add the brown rice, red bell pepper and hot pepper sauce and a little more salt and pepper and cook until the rice is a little bit glazed. Remove from heat. Add applesauce or soy sauce and mix well. Pour mixture into bowls and top with parmesan cheese if desired.

title: Simple Chinese Gluten-Free Chicken
ingredients: 6 chicken drumsticks | 3/4 cup soymilk | 1/4 cup dry graham cracker crumbs | 1 teaspoon cinnamon
instructions: Put all ingredieints in a 2 quart pot and boil for 10 minutes. Turn the pot off heat and let it cool. Pour in the glaze and let sit for an hour or two. Taste and adjust seasonings. Let cool completely before putting into fridge.

Random Ingredients: kaffir lime leaf,thyme leave,silken tofu,anise seed,cider vinegar,sauerkraut
title: Sauerkraut & Tofu(India)
ingredients: 3 tablespoons cider vinegar | 1 tablespoon pure anise seed | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh thyme leaves | 1 teaspoon sauerkraut, drained | 1 tablespoon kaffir lime leaf, crushed | 1/4 teaspoon cider vinegar | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh thyme leave
instructions: Combine the first 8 ingredients in a jar, making sure the ingredients are evenly distributed. Cover and shake to combine. Store covered at least one hour, shaking the jar occasionally. Serve immediately with sauerkraut crudites. Note, recipe doubles as an ice yogurt topping or can be stirred together.

title: Tacos
ingredients: 2 lbs ground veal | 1 lb ground pork sausage | 2 teaspoons ground cardamom | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 1 can petite diced roma tomatoes
instructions: Combine veal, pork sausage, cardamom and taco seasoning mix. Shape into patties. Fry on a skillet sprayed with pam sprayed with pam, until browned and cooked through, about 8 minutes per side. Goes well with beans and rice.

title: Easy Cheesy Beef Ring
ingredients: 1 package refrigerated crescent rolls | 1 1/4 lbs sirloin steaks | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 cup carrot, grated | 1 tablespoon superfine sugar | 1/4 cup cilantro leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 350ºf. Unroll crescent roll dough. Separate dough into 4 triangles. Place onto greased cookie sheet. Press seams together. Pierce top crust several times with a fork. Bake in preheated oven for 8 - 10 minutes or until golden brown. Meanwhile, slice meat and combine with soup and carrots. Divide meat mixture evenly among dough triangles. Sprinkle with sugar and cilantro. Roll dough triangles up with the pointy end facing the bottom crusts. Poke a toothpick through the tops to help seal. Bake at 350ºf for 30 minutes or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: penne pasta,green cardamom,feta cheese,albacore tuna water,green peppercorn,french vanilla pudding
title: Pasta and Tuna (Feta) With Pine Nuts
ingredients: 1 lb penne pasta or 1 lb ziti pasta | 2 cups bottled french vanilla pudding, chilled ( from your box ) | 1/4 cup albacore tuna in water, drained & flaked ( from your box ) | 1/4 cup green peppercorn, coarsely chopped | 1 green cardamoms, crushed lightly | 1/2 cup feta cheese, crumbled
instructions: Cook pasta in a large pot of boiling water as directed on the box of pudding.

title: Homemade Smoked Salmon
ingredients: 4 salmon fillets | garlic powder ( for rub ) or lemon ( for rub )
instructions: Preheat oven to in a shallow baking dish, rub salmon with garlic powder or lemon. Bake for 30 minutes, turning once or twice until done. Serve with horseradish sauce.

title: Vegetable Medley
ingredients: 1 whole bunch fresh parsley and a handful fresh fenugreek or half a bunch fresh spearmint, washed and tied with cotton kitchen twine | 1 lb fresh string bean, trimmed and cut in two | 5 cups hot cooked corn ( or use canned corn mixed with about 1 cup cooked ) | 1 1/2 cups vanilla flavored vermicelli or 1 1/2 cups chopped fresh spinach, washed and trimmed for garnish
instructions: Cut the green leaves off each bunch of fenugreek. Snap off the stems and the hard bottom layer. Slice the ends from the fenugreek leaves and discard. Rinse all the leaves and cut them up into pieces similar to the parsley and fenugreek leaves. Cut the string bean pieces into about a 1 inch pieces to make long skinny noodles. Put half the fenugreek leaves in a large bowl. Drain the corn into a colander over a bowl, then rinse out the colander. Add the fenugreek leaves and the string beans to the bowl and toss to mix well.. Add the remaining fenugreek leaves and the corn and toss again. If you need to leave the fenugreek leaves whole, leave them whole. When ready to serve, pour the vietnamese vermicelli and spinach into bowls and garnish with the remaining vermicelli.

title: Broccoli and Turnips
ingredients: 1 bunch broccoli, trimmed and cut into small florets | 3 turnips, peeled and cut into chunks
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place broccoli and turnips in a 1 1/2 quart baking dish. Toss to coat. Bake 15 to 20 minutes until vegetables are tender and topping is golden.

Random Ingredients: red chilies,cherry,chocolate shaving,red chili powder,rump steak,rice noodle,crepe,basmati rice
title: Shredded Beef Satay
ingredients: 24 slices rump steak | 1 cup sweet rice noodles | 1 teaspoon red chili powder | 6 cherry bombs, halved | 1 cup red chili, chopped or 12 chili flakes | 1/2 cup dried currant cherries or 1/2 cup golden raisin | 1 tablespoon crepe, powder and marinade | chocolate shavings, to serve
instructions: Heat grill to high. Place steak in shallow dish, season with chili powder, cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or up to 3 hours. Meanwhile, place rice noodles on heated grill and cover and grill for 5 minutes, turn and cook for another 6 minutes for medium or until the noodles are tender and cooked through. Keep warm. Remove beef from the marinade and roll up. Place beef rolls in separate bowls. Remove strings from cherry halves. To serve, place 1 piece of beef on the plate and top with cherry or chili flakes and 1 tablespoon of currants or raisin.

title: Angel Hair Pasta With Noodles With Alfredo
ingredients: 1 package angel hair pasta, cooked | 1 cup alfalfa sprout, thawed if frozen | 1 tablespoon fine dry breadcrumb
instructions: In a large bowl combine pasta, sprouts, bread crumbs and 1 tablespoons of the butter. Toss to coat. In a medium size skillet coated with cooking spray, cook pasta mixture at 400°f stirring often, until hot and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: mexican cheese,beef stock,turmeric,oatmeal,beef stew meat,almond extract
title: Almond-Coated Beef W- Oatmeal Topping and Toppings (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef stew meat | 2 1/2 cups coarse oatmeal ( not instant ) | 2 1/2 cups beef stock | 1 teaspoon turmeric | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract | 2 cups mexican blend cheese, shredded
instructions: Cut beef into 1 1/2 inch cubes. Place in crock pot. Top with oatmeal, beef stock, turmeric, and almond extract. Cover and cook on low heat setting for 3 hours. Serve over hot tostada shells or sourdough bread. Top with grated cheese.

title: Grilled Eggplant Salad
ingredients: 2 medium eggplants, sliced horizontally | 1/2 lb lettuce, fresh leaves | 1/2 cup mild chili sauce | 1/2 cup currants ( or raisins if they are large ) | 1/2 cup celery
instructions: Place eggplant slices on grill or in roasting pan and grill or broil with skin side down, turning with tongs, until tender and light brown or just blackened, 7 - 10 minutes. Remove from grill and cool. Slice into 1/2 inch wide strips. Arrange lettuce on plates. Place 2 eggplant strips on each. Spoon chili sauce over or around each and top with currants, celery and/or raisins. Serve immediately.

title: Garlic Loose Herbed Pizza
ingredients: 6 hoagie rolls | 12 fresh flat leaf parsley, chopped | 1 can sliced olives, drained | 4 tablespoons olive, drained
instructions: Preheat the oven to lightly oil an oven proof dish. Set the rolls flat in the dish, and bake about 10 minutes, until golden brown on top. Remove from the oven, and sprinkle with parsley. In a medium bowl, mash olives with the olive oil. Top the rolls with olive mixture, and transfer to the oven. Bake 15 minutes, until bubbly and brown.

title: Cheater's Pepperoni Jellies
ingredients: 1 envelope unflavored gelatin | 1/2 cup sweet pepperoni, diced | 1/2 cup palm sugar | 1 teaspoon jalapeno pepper, finely diced
instructions: Sprinkle the gelatin over the sweet pepperoni and set aside. In a microwavable bowl, cook the pepperoni in a bit of water for about 20 seconds, stirring constantly. Remove from the pan. Drain off the liquid in the pan. Add the pepperoni to the pan of jello and combine well. Return to the microwave oven for 4 minutes, stirring constantly. Turn into a greased and floured 9x13 inch glass pan and cool on metal foil. Store in a cool dark place for up to 3 weeks.

Random Ingredients: curry powder,macadamia nut,cannellini bean,pork steak,tomato puree,asian dressing,cornflour
title: Macadamia Crusted Spiced Pork
ingredients: 300 g pork steaks, trimmed | 1 teaspoon cornflour | 2 teaspoons curry powder | 2 teaspoons asian dressing | 1 can cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 1 tablespoon tomato puree | 2 tablespoons macadamia nuts ( roasted, peeled and crushed )
instructions: Preheat oven to 190 degrees c. Cut the pork steak to 3cm/1 inch pieces. Dust with the cornflour. Heat a large non stick frying pan. Stir fry the pork in batches for 1 minute or until browned. Remove each batch from pan. Add the curry and stir fry for 1 minute. Stir in the beans, tomato puree, macadamia nuts and seasoning and mix well. Place the pork and bean mixture in an oven proof dish, cover with the remaining cake mixture and bake in the oven for about 30 minutes or until cooked through and golden.

Random Ingredients: yeast,butter bean,red currant jelly,halibut fillet,soymilk,hot red pepper flake,parmigiano
title: Baked Halibut With Soy Milk
ingredients: 4 cups cooked soymilk | 4 teaspoons melted butter | 2 1/2 cups fresh grated parmigiano | 1/2 teaspoon hot red pepper flakes | 1 teaspoon instant yeast | 2 tablespoons red currant jelly | 2 tablespoons butter beans, drained
instructions: Place a 5 inch depth of oil in a medium sized pan and set over medium heat. Add the soy milk, butter, pepper flakes, yeast, and currant jelly. Cover and place in a warm area of the refrigerator to rise. In a saucepan, melt the butter and combine with the beans. Cook over medium heat until butter is melted and sauce is well combined.

title: Quick Beef Salad from Chile Valley Restaurants
ingredients: 2 lbs shin beef or 2 lbs rib eye steaks | 2 teaspoons corn oil | 1 tablespoon rice vinegar | 1 grapefruit
instructions: Heat oil in a medium saucepan until it shimmers and immediately starts smoking. Trim fat from meat and slice into thin strips about 3/4 inch wide. Add meat to pan and stir to coat thoroughly. Cook, stirring, 4 - 5 minutes or until meat is browned to your liking. Remove meat to a bowl and tent with foil. Add rice vinegar. Toss lightly until well mixed and to coat. Divide among two plates. Cut grapeseed away from seeds and place on top. Garnish with slivered oranges. Serve with sticky rice.

title: Authentic Supper Risotto for a Crowd
ingredients: 200 -275 g sauerkraut ( canned is fine, just enough to cover ) | 1 cup frozen corn ( or 1 small tin of corn ) | 400 g of plain low-fat yogurt, greek style ( or the healthier greek style to taste, see step # 3 ) | 4 -7 ladyfingers | 4 -8 slices beef roast | 1/4 cup vinegar | 2 -3 tablespoons sauerkraut ( optional ) or 2 -3 tablespoons drained canned sauerkraut ( optional ) | 2 -6 tablespoons arborio rice or 2 -6 tablespoons carnaroli rice
instructions: For the dressing, combine the yogurt and 2 tablespoons of garlic granules in a jar with a tight fitting lid. You want the garlic to be chopped finely, too, but if not, add another tablespoon or two of garlic. Shake well and set aside. Rinse the saurkraut well. Heat a small saucepan with just enough boiling water to cover and stir in the rice. Bring to the boil, then turn down the heat and simmer for 15 min or until the rice is soft. Stir the rice occasionally, and add a little more water if the consistency is too watery. It should also be fairly soft, but not mushy. Drain off most of the water. If the rice is too soft, add more water.. For the meat and sausages, mix the sauerkraut into the yoghurt and garlic granules and chill in the fridge for about an hour. If using beans, rinse them and cut them in half. Trim the meat into large chunks, cut into small dice, and season well with a little good salt and pepper. Put them on a baking tray in a single layer. If using canned brine, add 2 - 3 cups boiling water as needed and leave to simmer for 1 hour, until completely cooked. Strain the meat into a small dish, discarding all the liquid and any leftover broth. Heat the wok, add 2 - 3 tablespoons of olive oil and swirl around the base until very hot. Add the meat, then pour in the warm water, and stir so that the meat cooks through. Pour in the yoghurt/garlic granules, mix, and gently stir to combine. Add the rice, if using, and stir briefly until combined. Turn heat up to high and add the vinegar, followed by the sauerkraut. Toss briefly until the rice is coated in the hot oil. Pour it over the rice, stirring for a minute. Taste and taste for seasoning, adding more sea salt, and/or more garlic granules if desired. It should still be a little salty, and there should be quite a bit of peppery garlic in it. Serve with a generous scoop of arugula, freshly crusted fresh strawberries, etc. Enjoy immediately.

title: Cheese Puffs
ingredients: 1 cup gruyere, shredded | 2 tablespoons apricot preserves
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°. Mix gruyere, apricot preserves, and some pepper and mix together. Place on a parchment lined baking sheet. Bake in the centre of the oven for 25 minutes or until puffed up and lightly brown.

title: Chunky Rum Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup mayonnaise | 3/4 cup raisins | 1/3 cup papaya, peeled and finely diced | 1/4 teaspoon baking soda
instructions: Combine all the ingredients in a medium sized bowl. You may add 1 teaspoons water if desired.

title: Roasted Red Chile Red Potato Wedges
ingredients: 6 red potatoes | 2 fresh red chilies, seeded and chopped ( use mild chili peppers if you don � t like spice )
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c. Grease a shallow ovenproof dish with oil. Scrub potatoes, cut in wedges and transfer to oiled dish. Scoop off any excess water. Sprinkle chiles over potatoes and bake for 40 - 45 minutes or until tender.

Random Ingredients: yellow bell pepper,pesto sauce,red curry paste,basmati rice,farfalle pasta,pork chop
title: Capellini Pesto Pork Chops
ingredients: 4 pork chops | 1 package uncooked farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta | 1/2 cup pesto sauce, prepared | 1 red curry paste | 1 yellow bell pepper, chopped | 1 teaspoon basmati rice, or as desired
instructions: Place the pork chops in a slow cooker and sprinkle with salt. Pour about half of the pesto sauce over the pork chops and turn the chops as needed. Spread the farfalle pasta slices over the pork chops. Cover and cook on high for 8 hours, or until the macaroni and pasta are cooked and liquid has been absorbed. Stir the red curry paste and yellow bell pepper into the skillet with the pork chops. Cook an additional 5 minutes to heat through.

Random Ingredients: pineapple tidbit,buttermilk,coffee,beef bouillon,olive oil cooking spray,spring onion
title: Pineapple Beef and Onions With Buttermilk
ingredients: 500 g boneless lean top sirloin steaks, cut into 2cm thick slices | olive oil flavored cooking spray | 2 tablespoons instant coffee | 2 tablespoons unsweetened pineapple tidbits, canned, drained | 1 -2 spring onion, sliced thinly | 1/2 cup buttermilk
instructions: Grease an 8x8 glass casserole dish with a coating of cooking spray. Place the steaks in a single layer in the dish and put any excess fat in the dish. Spray the steaks with olive oil. Pour instant coffee into the dish, add pineapple tidbits and spring onions and cover with the remaining sauce. Cover dish and place in an oven and bake for 30 minutes, or until the meat is tender. Serve sprinkled over the buttermilk.

title: Mashed Okra With Pepitas (Okra Snack)
ingredients: 150 g okra, in 1 | 100 g pepitas, cut in half lengthwise ( known as malayso in hindi ) | 1 pinch asafoetida powder | 2 tablespoons liquid honey
instructions: Wash okra, remove stem and ends, wash and cut into half, lengthwise. Cut lengthwise into equal size pieces. Mix salt content and honey in a nonstick skillet, cook okra in it over medium heat till light brown colour, pour it into a colander and remove excess liquid. Add 2 tablespoons water in it, mix well and cover. Cook on high heat till all water is absorbed. Stir every ten minutes and as you stir, remove from heat. Cover and keep aside for 30 minutes. Transfer a tablespoonful of okra mixture to a bowl, top with 100 grams pepitas. Enjoy.

title: Carne de Queso (Chorizo) Carne
ingredients: 2 lbs spanish chorizo, cut in 1/4 inch slices ( you can buy chorizo from the deli, if chorizo is not available in your area ) | 12 ounces gran marnier ( or other brandy, if your chorizo isnt chorizo ) | 4 -10 tablespoons vegetable oil, for frying
instructions: Heat 3 tbsp oil in skillet on medium heat. Pour the carne de queso into saucer or serving dish and toss to coat. Set aside. Break the bacon up on a paper towel, slice into 1/2 inch pieces and set aside in a small bowl. Put the chorizo in a small heavy skillet on medium to high heat and sprinkle generously with salt and pepper, making sure both sides are covered. Once the chorizo is browned, toss it in a large bowl. Add the rest of the oil to the same pan you have set aside. When the oil is hot but not smoking, add the chorizo and bacon. Stir everything together, cooking on high heat until it is a crumbly mess and begins to crisp. Once the chorizo is browned on all sides, transfer to bowl, toss through the cooked bacon and set aside. If there are any bits of bacon remaining in the pan you were using, put that into the bowl you set aside earlier. The bacon fat will help the pan to get your ingredients into the bowl. I put this in a bag or ziploc bag, add the entire contents and shake it around to mix well. Once the fat is solid, remove from heat and set aside. If you didn't use the skille, just put all your fried veggies in the same bowl with the bacon fat. I make a second bag of veggies if a third bag of veggies are to your liking.. Serve with crackers or other crackers of your choice for dipping.

title: Korean Chicken (Vietnamese)
ingredients: 24 large dried chilies
instructions: Roast them on a foil lined baking pan or under a broiler, just until dark black spots are loosened, 5 to 7 minutes. Put them in a plastic bag and tightly seal. Store in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: honey mustard,seasoning,wonton wrapper,serrano chilies,nonstick cooking spray
title: Mexicalli
ingredients: nonstick cooking spray | 1 package wonton wrappers | 1 lb sliced jalapeno-flavored pickled serrano chilies | 1 cup honey mustard
instructions: Spray a large nonstick skillet with oil. Place a teaspoon of the corn pickles, 1 tablespoon mustard, and 1/2 teaspoon of water in the skillet. Cover and cook over medium high heat for 3 - 5 minutes or till veggies are tender. Place each wonton wrapper on a hot surface. Place 1 1/2 3 tablespoons of the veggie mixture in the center of the wonton wrapper. Fold the wonton wrapper around the filling, sealing edges well with a fork. Place in a large, nonstick bowl. Repeat 4 times, using remaining mixtures.

Random Ingredients: bamboo shoot,dough,cream chicken soup,vanilla,egg,kahlua,chili garlic sauce,white bean
title: Fiesta Doughnuts
ingredients: 4 ounces cans white beans, drained | 1 can bamboo shoots, drained | 3 cans cream of chicken soup | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla | 3 -5 tablespoons chili-garlic sauce ( i use la victoria brand ) | 2 egg, slightly beaten | 1 tablespoon kahlua | 14 1/2 ounces refrigerated dough twists
instructions: Cook and drain beans. Combine drained beans, sliced bamboo shoots, cream of chicken soup, vanilla, chili garlic sauce, egg, and kahlua in a large bowl. Let stand overnight at room temperature. Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Roll out doughnuts on lightly floured surface to about ¾ inch thick. Cut doughnuts into circles about 3x8 on the length of the doughnuts. Put 1 tablespoon filling on center of each circle, fold doughnut in half and crimp edges with a fork. Bake until golden, about 25 - 30 minutes. Remove doughnuts from oven and let cool a few minutes. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: seasoning salt,nutmeg,kidney bean,oregano leaf,tahini,red chili pepper
title: Jamaican Red Kidney Beans - Vegan
ingredients: 1 lb kidney bean, dry | 1 tablespoon tahini | 1/4 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1/4 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1/2 teaspoon red chili pepper
instructions: Rinse and drain kidney beans and combine with rest of ingredients. Chill in refrigerator overnight. Serve with a dollop of fresh crusty bread and fresh green salad.

title: Easy Chicken Noodle Kebabs
ingredients: 2 packages chicken noodle soup mix | 1/3 cup prepared instant au jus sauce ( i prefer kikkoman, but any will do ) | 1/3 cup prepared sweet-and-sour mix | 1/3 pear, diced
instructions: Preheat to 250 degrees f. Wash chicken noodles, drain them and put noodles in a glass dish. In a bowl, combine the soups mix, au jus, sweet and sour mix. Add the pear to a small saucepan over medium heat and heat until hot, but not boiling. Pour sauce over noodle noodles in dish. Put under grill until tops are slightly browned and noodles are crispy on the outside. Use a meat pounder to flatten chicken slightly. Cut into cubes. Serve with your favorite accompaniments.

title: Apple Sherbet
ingredients: 6 ounces frozen apple juice concentrate, defrosted overnight in the freezer | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: Simply combine all the ingredients in a food processor and process or mix until mixture is very smooth. Store in an airtight container in the freezer.

title: Gordita Marinade
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups pomegranate juice | 2 green onions with tops, thinly sliced | 1 tablespoon minced jalapeno pepper | 1 teaspoon ground coriander sprigs
instructions: Whisk pomegranate juice, green onions, jalapeno pepper, and coriander seasoning mix together in a bowl. Refrigerate the unused amounts.

title: Baked Korean Sweet and Spicy Sesame Honey Wedges
ingredients: 1 kg sesame oil | 550 g honey
instructions: Pre heat oven to 375°f. Grease and line a baking tray with baking paper. Heat the sesame oil in a large pot over medium high heat, approximately 1 minute, until it begins to shimmer. Turn the heat down to medium, allow oil to warm to 180°c. While it is heating through pour in the honey slowly, stirring briskly, into a warm honey mixture. Place in the oven for 15 - 20 minutes until honey is caramelising and starting to brown slightly. Toss the wedges gently to coat thoroughly.

Random Ingredients: pecorino romano cheese,cooking oat,white sugar,rice wine
title: Oats on the Half Shell
ingredients: 1 cup quick-cooking oats | 1 cup white sugar | 2 tablespoons pecorino romano cheese, grated | 2/3 cup rice wine | 3 tablespoons pecorino romano cheese, grated
instructions: Combine dry ingredients then add 1/3 of the oatmeal to make a crumbly consistency. Toss with rice wine until evenly coated. Shape into walnut sized balls. Place on baking sheets and then top with grated pecorino cheese. Bake in 300 degree oven for 30 minutes, or until golden brown.

title: Spicy Onions (Coxinhas De Carne Cauda)
ingredients: 1 -2 onion, peeled and cut into halves | 1 can refrigerated biscuits
instructions: Cut the top of each onion half off with a sharp knife. Cut the onions into halves, and scoop out the inside about 1/2 inch thick, leaving the hard pulp in the center. Cut each onion half into very thin slices. Put a biscuit, cut side up, onto a greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350 degrees 10 - 15 minutes or until golden brown. Break apart the biscuits. Fill a large saucepan over medium heat and add just enough water to come 2/3 of the way up the sides of the biscuit. Place the biscuit pieces into the saucepan and bring the water to a boil. Turn off the heat. Stir the biscuit pieces a few or several times with a slotted spoon into the boiling water. Cover, and store in the refrigerator until ready to serve.

title: Viennese Pastry
ingredients: 350 g fresh white flour | 200 ml meat stock | icing sugar ( see note )
instructions: Melt the milk and stock in a bowl in a saucepan. Mix in the flour and make a well. Using a pastry cutter, cut the dough, working out any large lumps. Knead very lightly on floured work surface and divide in half. From one half, roll each half into an oval shape, about 1 1/2' wide and 1/2 thick. Repeat with the second half of dough. Place each oval, on a pastry cloth, making sure each is well covered with a pastry cloth, and pinch ends closed. Place pastries on a greased baking tray and brush with melted milk and stock. Bake in preheated oven 200c/400f/gas 5 for about 25 minutes, or until golden.

title: Quick Enchilada Soup
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 3 cans enchilada mix | 1 1 cup milk | liquid smoke | 1/4 cup grape cuts ( optional )
instructions: Pour the cream of chicken soup in a soup pot and heat on medium to low. Stir in the enchilada mix, milk, and liquid smoke. Slowly stir in the grapes. Chill until serving.

title: Grilled Tomato-Rubbed Tomatoes
ingredients: 12 cherry tomatoes | 1 tablespoon grated fresh ginger
instructions: Cut a slice off the top of the cherry tomatoes at the stem end and carefully remove the shells. Carefully loosen the tomato from the shells and discard. Using a thin slice, scrape out the seeds. Set aside. Remove the stem from each tomato. Season the tomato flesh with salt and freshly ground black pepper. Rub each slice with salt on one side of each. Place on a sheet of greased aluminum foil. Place in a 350 degree f oven for 15 minutes. Remove a tomato from the foil and rub with ginger. Return the tomatoes to the foil, close the foil and continue baking until the tomatoes are puffed and cooked, about 20 minutes.

title: Pasta Fresca
ingredients: 3 cups rotini pasta | 3 green bell peppers, sliced into 1/4 inch thick pieces | 1 bunch fresh sage sprigs
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook rotini in boiling water until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 11 minutes.

title: Italian Panini, Bread Cracker, Cheese, and Anchovy Spread
ingredients: 1 loaf bread, crust discarded | 2 packages pepperoni halves | 1/4 cup molasses | 1 teaspoon anchovy paste | 1 teaspoon coarse salt
instructions: Cut bread into 1 inch cubes. Place a cheesecloth in a plastic food storage bag and add the bread cubes.

title: Shhhhh Shhhhh
ingredients: 1 can crabmeat | 2 teaspoons fresh lemon zest | pistachio nuts, chopped
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a glass casserole dish. Cook in a 375 degree f oven until shrimp is bubbling and tender, 20 to 45 minutes.

Random Ingredients: lamb chop,veal stock,worcestershire sauce,plain flour,sauce,oatmeal,matzo meal
title: Matzoh Bread
ingredients: 1 cup sifted dry oatmeal | 1 cup matzo meal | 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 1 cup veal stock ( or water ) | 1 tablespoon hot sauce ( optional ) | 1 cup lamb chop, diced | 1 tablespoon plain flour or 1 tablespoon breadcrumbs
instructions: Soak bread in tap water until soft. Mix oatmeal, matza meal, worcestershire sauce, stock/water, hot sauce and lamb in large mixing bowl. Knead to combine. Transfer to a shallow ovenproof dish or roasting tin. Turn to coat evenly. Cover tightly with foil and bake at 220°c/425°f for 1 hour 20 minutes to 1 hour 15 minutes. Remove foil and bake for a further 15 minutes. Set aside to cool slightly before serving.

title: Spaghetti With Chicken Soup
ingredients: 350 g spaghetti | 250 g polish sausage or 250 g other spicy sausage | 3 tablespoons chicken bouillon or 3 tablespoons vegetable stock | 3 tablespoons double cream ( optional ) | 425 g low-sodium canned chickpeas, drained | 440 g canned corn, drained
instructions: Cook the pasta in plenty of salted boiling water until al dente. Meanwhile, heat a wok over high heat, add the sausage and cook stirring occasionally until cooked through. Drain the sausage on kitchen paper. Add the stock, cream, chickpeas and corn and heat through for 2 minutes. Transfer to a warmed jug and season with freshly ground black pepper, to taste.

Random Ingredients: thyme sprig,yeast,dark chocolate,red chilies,beef sirloin steak,vanilla extract,vanilla sugar,coriander
title: Beef Rolls from the Spice House
ingredients: 600 g strong beef sirloin steaks | 1/2 ounce fresh yeast | 3 small red chilies, finely chopped to taste | 2 teaspoons vanilla sugar or 2 teaspoons sugar substitute | 1/4 teaspoon ground coriander | 1 fresh thyme sprig, finely shredded | 1/4 teaspoon vanilla extract | 12 ounces good-quality dark chocolate, chopped to roughly equal 3 tbsp
instructions: Preheat the oven to 160c/fan 160c/gas mark 1 / gas mark cut the sirloin steaks on the diagonal into 2 cm long strips. Place them into a shallow glass, ceramic or ceramic container. Remove any excess fat from the steak strips. To make the marinade, place the yeast in a small bowl that has the beef juices. In a small bowl, mix together the chillies, vanilla sugar, coriander, thyme and half the vanilla. Pour over the meat and toss to coat all the meat. Cover the meat with plastic wrap and place into an uncovered container in the top third of the oven. Leave for 45 minutes, or until the beef is very tender and the marinade has reduced a little. Turn the meat onto a chopping board and, using a meat pounder, pound the meat very gently and evenly at the thickest part for 8 to 10 minutes or until it is very thin. Use the flat side of a knife, cut 8 - 10 slashes across the top of the meat to allow for shrinkage during cooking. Slice all the way through the meat, about 6 - 8 slashes. The remaining vanilla will make a wonderful sauce. Place the meat in a deep bowl, cover with plastic wrap and leave in a cool place for at least 20 minutes. Remove the meat from the bowls, reserving the marinade. Place the reserved marinade on an empty baking tray and set aside. Place the dish on the oven shelf and bake for 10 minutes, until the sauce has reduced slightly.

Random Ingredients: onion seed,jicama,chicken liver,rice wine,pepperoni,au jus sauce
title: Quick and Easy  Italian  Salad
ingredients: 1/2 lb chicken liver | 1/2 lb onions, sliced | 1/2 lb jicama, thinly sliced | 3 ounces pepperoni, thinly sliced | 1/4 cup rice wine | 2 -3 tablespoons of your favorite favorite hot sauce
instructions: Combine the first 5 ingredients in a large salad bowl. Add rice wine. Add hot sauce.

title: Mexican Yellow Squash
ingredients: 2 lbs yellow squash | 1 cup extra virgin olive oil, plus 1 tbsp. extra virgin oil | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 20 toothpicks
instructions: Preheat a grill pan or broiler. Cut the squash in half lengthwise and lengthwise, scoop out most of the white fibers. Place the cut squash cut side down in a mixing bowl and drizzle over 3/4 cup of the oil. Season with the cumin, and season to taste with salt. Tear off 3 toothpicks and toss them into the remaining oil. Spread the squash onto the grill or broiler rack and roast until the squash is golden and sticky, about 20 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Homemade Almond Scones
ingredients: 1 cup self-rising flour | 2 teaspoons almond extract | 1 teaspoon hot pepper sauce ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. In a small bowl, stir the flour, almond extract, and hot pepper sauce until just blended. Stir in the flour mixture until just mixed. Knead for about 1 minute on a lightly floured surface. Pat dough into to 1/2 inch thick, 3/4 inch thickness. Cut into wedges. Place on a baking sheet and brush tops with a little more hot sauce. Bake for 12 to 15 minutes, or until lightly golden.

title: Carnation Pone
ingredients: 1 kg mutton, cut into small pieces | 1 kg carrot, cut into small strips | 1 liter pinto beans, drained weight | 250 g white flour | 150 grimes
instructions: Mix the meat, flour, lime rind and seasoning in an oven dish until all ingredients are mixed. Place in low oven and leave overnight. Bake covered in the oven 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: biscuit,zucchini,dill,cream tartar,baby carrot,red food coloring,green chilies
title: Fiesta Zucchini Casserole
ingredients: 1 package refrigerated biscuits ( such as pepperidge farm ) | 1 can diced green chilies, undrained | 2 baby carrots, shredded | 1 large zucchini, shredded | 1 teaspoon dried dill ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar | 3 -4 cups powdered sugar | 3 -4 drops red food coloring
instructions: Heat oven to 375 degrees. Remove biscuits from package. Separate biscuits into 8 pieces. Press the flat side of each biscuit into a 13 inch x 9 inch baking dish and place in oven until biscuits turn golden brown, 7 to 10 minutes. Remove from oven and remove the biscuits from the baking dish. Place the chilies in a small bowl and add enough water to cover. Let them soak for 10 to 20 minutes. Drain and set aside. In a large bowl, mix together the shredded carrots, zucchini, dill and cream of tartar. Add enough powdered sugar to make the mixture fluffy but not soupy. In a small bowl, mix together the food coloring and food color according to the color of the food color. Pour the desired amount of jelly onto the baking dish. Cut biscuit pieces into squares and lay across the jelly in rows. Add enough red food coloring to red in the rows to your desired coloring. Top with shredded carrots. Bake in middle of oven for 20 minutes or until golden.

title: Tortilla Chip Cookies
ingredients: 1 can stewed tomatoes | 1/2 cup red pepper, diced ( canned ) | 3 tablespoons currants | 2 tablespoons cocoa | 1/2 teaspoon crushed red pepper | 2 tablespoons tortilla chips
instructions: Combine tomatoes with next 4 ingredients in a medium saucepan and cook until heated through. Divide mixture into 4 equal portions and roll each one into a ball. Cover each ball of dough with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 1 hour and then shape into a 1 inch diameter circle. Place on parchment paper lined cookie sheets and flatten into 2 inch thick discs. Place a tortilla on top of each disk and lightly press around the tortilla with back of a fork. Place a heaping teaspoon of the tomato mixture on top of each tortilla and place under broiler for 4 minutes.

Random Ingredients: ricotta cheese,chicken broth,beef chuck,lemon juice,garlic clove,beef tenderloin,spinach leaf,cornbread
title: Greek Beef, Spinach and Ricotta Patties
ingredients: 4 1/2 ounces chicken broth | 2 ounces beef tenderloin, cut into thin strips about 1-inch wide | 1 ounce fresh spinach leaves, trimmed and roughly chopped | 2 garlic cloves, chopped | 2 teaspoons lemon juice | 1 ounce ricotta cheese | 1 package cornbread, cut into 24 slices | 2 ounces creamed corn ( optional )
instructions: Place chicken broth and beef in medium sauce pan and bring to a boil over medium heat. Add beef, cover and simmer for 20 minutes. Remove from heat. Meanwhile, in food processor fitted with metal blade, add spinach, garlic, lemon juice and ricotta.

Random Ingredients: parmesan cheese,risotto rice,kidney bean,oyster,irish cream,port wine,green salad
title: Dublin Seafood Risotto
ingredients: 1 cup risotto rice | 1 cup dry kidney beans ( rinsed and picked through ) | 2 -3 cups mixed green salad | 1 cup irish cream | 6 -8 pieces steamed whole oats | 2/3 cup grated parmesan cheese | 1 liter prawns & prawns, cooked or 1 liter lobster meat ( cooked and peeled ) etc
instructions: Wash the rice in warm water until water runs clear. In a pot, bring the beans, water, 1/2 cup plus a teaspoon of salt to the boil, adding the rice and all but a little more water. Once it boils, add the remaining salt and stir. Reduce the heat and simmer, covered, stirring occasionally, until tender, about 45 minutes but up to 1 hour longer. Once the risotto is tender, add the greens to the pan and toss until limp. Add the cream, then stir in the cooked rice, prawns and cooked or peeled prawns. Pour over the rest of the cream and serve warm.

title: Faux Glazed Pork Tenderloin
ingredients: 8 -12 ounces pork tenderloin | 1 celery rib, finely chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a small bowl, combine the pork tenderloins with the celery. Spread a coat of cooking spray on a large baking sheet. Bake pork tenderloins for 10 minutes, turning once, until cooked through. Remove from oven. Cut into slices and serve.

title: Shrimp Lasagna
ingredients: 12 uncooked lasagna noodles | 2 pounds cooked shrimp, peeled
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Prepare lasagna noodles by lining a colander with a damp cloth or paper towels, and letting drain a few minutes. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Place drained noodles in the boiling water, and cook for 4 to 5 minutes, until al dente. Drain, and immediately mix in shrimp. Arrange noodles in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Spread shrimp and sauce over noodles, and sprinkle with additional shrimp. Bake in preheated oven for 20 minutes, until shrimp is hot and bubbling.

title: Sopa Seca (Braised Spanish Onions)
ingredients: 12 spanish onions, halved | 2 1/2 cups chicken stock or 2 1/2 cups broth
instructions: In a large pot, saute onions in broth until golden brown and caramelized. Remove from heat and allow to cool slightly and then cut in 1/4 thick slices and place on a plate. Sprinkle with salt & pepper stir them gently into hot broth and serve hot.

title: Juanos-Style Breakfast Sandwich (Fritos de Ham)
ingredients: 1 slice white bread | 2 tablespoons apple juice | 1 -2 slice jicama ( small slices ) | 4 slices ham ( small slices ) or 4 slices deli ham | 2 green onions | 1/2 teaspoon allspice
instructions: Place a slice or two of bread on a plate and spread with apple juice. Layer with two slices of jicama, then two slices of ham. Add a few thinly sliced green onions on top. Sprinkle a dash of allspice and a sprinkling of salt. Repeat with remaining slices of bread.

title: Hot Fruit Salad--Spritters' Night
ingredients: 3 large shrimp ( peeled and cooked ) | 2 tablespoons sugar | 1/2 lb blueberries | 1 ripe mango chutney | 2 tablespoons turbinado sugar | 2 tablespoons gin | 1 tablespoon wine
instructions: Shrimp should be cooked and not raw with shell. Combine all ingredients. Serve chilled.

title: Kelp
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups ketchup | 1 1/2 teaspoons fast rising yeast | 1 1/2 tablespoons ketchup
instructions: In large bowl, mix 1 1/4 cup ketchup and yeast. Allow to stand for 5 minutes. Stir in remaining 3/4 cup ketchup and mix well. Cover and let rise in warm place for 1 hour. Drain excess water. Stir in rest of ketchup.

Random Ingredients: peanut butter,lipton onion soup mix,garam masala powder,green,plain nonfat yogurt,oil lard,pepper
title: Lebanese Onion and Peanut Butter Dip
ingredients: 1/2 cup peanut butter ( i prefer a thick one ) | 1/2 cup plain nonfat yogurt | 3 tablespoons oil or 3 tablespoons lard | 1 envelopelipton dry onion soup mix | 1 teaspoon garam masala powder | 1/2 teaspoon freshly ground pepper | 1 green
instructions: Mash peanut butter with a fork or fork. In a blender, combine yogurt, oil or lard, the dry onion soup mix, garam masala powder, and pepper. Blend until smooth. Stir into remaining peanut butter or mix with a wooden spoon. Serve sprinkled with green onions.

title: Peanut Butter Chicken
ingredients: 1 cup chicken stock | 8 ounces peanut butter
instructions: Boil the stock for 3 minutes. Place a tablespoon of peanut butter in the pot on heat. Slowly stir the peanut butter into the stock for 5 minutes, or until the sauce thickens. Season with salt and then serve.

Random Ingredients: cilantro,chuck roast,picante sauce,chorizo sausage,almond,spinach,dark chocolate,cream cheese
title: Mexican Beef (Or Pork) or Sausage With Spinach & Dark Chocolate
ingredients: 2 chorizo sausages ( cooked weight ) | 1 -1 1/2 lb fresh spinach | 1 ounce dark chocolate ( i prefer semisweet ) or 1 ounce white chocolate, chopped ( i prefer semisweet ) | 2 ounces sliced almonds | 8 ounces low-fat cream cheese ( room temperature ) | 1/2 cup sour cream | 2 -3 tablespoons fresh cilantro | 2 teaspoons cilantro
instructions: Heat oven to 350°f. Slice or dice the chorizo into 2” pieces, set aside. Separate the leaves from the spinach, stems the spinach and finely chop it. Place spinach in a bowl and set aside. Melt chocolate in small pan over low flame. Remove from heat and add chopped chorizo. Place a baking dish or 9x13 pan in oven and bake for 5 - 10 minutes or until chocolate is almost melted. Combine chorizo and spinach and set aside. Wash the spinach thoroughly, dry and finely chop, set aside. Melt the cream cheese, stir through the sour cream, cilantro and chocolate mixture. Place mixture back on low heat, stir until the cheese is melted. Spread chocolate mixture on a preheated slice of chorizo or sausages. Sprinkle on chopped spinach and place back in oven, bake for another 5 - 10 minutes until chocolate and spinach are warmed serve hot.

Random Ingredients: saffron,orange juice zest,carb tortilla,chuck,dark red kidney bean,tofu
title: Tofu, Bean and Meat Taquitos
ingredients: 1 pound lean ground chuck | 1 package firm tofu, cut into 1 1/2-inch cubes | 1 can dark red kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 1/4 cup orange juice with 2 tablespoons orange zest | 1 pinch saffron | 2 low-carb tortillas, cut into 6 wedges
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Mix ground chuck and tofu in a bowl. Stir kidney beans, orange juice, saffron and orange zest into the meat mixture until coated. Place meat mixture in a separate bowl.

Random Ingredients: iceberg lettuce,cajun seasoning,green pea,steak,tahini,yeast,thyme leaf,pink grapefruit juice
title: Spicy Beef With Veggies and Tahini Sauce
ingredients: 400 g minced steak | 1 1/2 teaspoons yeast | 1 tablespoon cajun seasoning | 50 g golden ray's ray's tahini | 1 teaspoon orange blossom water or 1 teaspoon canned pink grapefruit juice | 1 teaspoon fresh thyme leaves or 1 teaspoon dried thyme | 100 g green peas | iceberg lettuce
instructions: In a mixing bowl, add the minced steak, yeast, cajun seasoning and olive oil, mixing very well. Add the tahini in a slow, steady trickle. Add the grapefruit juice, thyme and peas. Mix thoroughly. Turn the mixture into a baking mold with a dough hook or a large glass, lid. Cover with plastic wrap and leave to mature in a cool place for about 1 1/2 hours, or until the meat is soft and falling apart. Cut into small cubes and serve with the shredded iceberg lettuce.

title: Beef Kabobs
ingredients: 1/2 cup peanuts ( chopped ) | 2 tablespoons peanuts ( chopped fine ) | 1 teaspoon cocoa | 1 teaspoon palm sugar ( powdered ) | 1/2 teaspoon teriyaki sauce ( teriyaki sauce ) | 1 beef roast
instructions: Slice the beef roast into long, thin strips. Mix all of the ingredients in a large ziploc bag and add the beef. Marinate in the fridge for 5 hours or better overnight for best results. Grill over the hottest coals until desired doneness, turning frequently for even browning. Serve over spaghetti noodles.

title: Caravella - Brazilian Beauty - St. Vincent Rum Cocktail
ingredients: 1/2 ounce coconut, toasted | 1/2 ounce rose water | 1/2 ounce liquid honey | 4 ounces dark chocolate | 1 teaspoon dark rum | 1 teaspoon grenadine
instructions: Garnish with coconut, fresh rose water, rum, and a sprinkle of coconut.

title: White Cheese Spread
ingredients: 1 lb white american cheese | salt & freshly ground black pepper, to taste
instructions: Use a cheese grater or a food processor to grate the cheese. It should be fine not to use a food processor. Season with salt and pepper. Store in refrigerator.

title: Indian Beef Stew
ingredients: 1 lb beef stew meat | 2 teaspoons red curry paste or 2 teaspoons madras curry powder | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin | 1 can water, dilute with | 5 tablespoons water | 1 green onion, finely chopped | 3 pounds potatoes, cut unto wedges, depending on how hungry you are
instructions: Trim or peel the excess fat from the stew meat. Combine curry paste or curry powder and ground cumin in a large bowl. Drain beef, discarding marinade, and add to the bowl.

title: Brazilian-Style Fresh Mango Salad
ingredients: 1 fresh mango, peeled and diced | 1 pound bean sprouts
instructions: Toss the mango with the bean sprouts, and serve.

title: Quick & Easy BBQ Beef Strips
ingredients: 1 cup barbecue sauce | 1 cup tapioca starch, in package of dry ( optional )
instructions: Dissolve the tapioca starch in the barbecue sauce. Heat skillet to medium high. Dip each strip of meat in tapioca starch, letting excess drip off. Cook on oiled skillet for about 4 minutes.

Random Ingredients: yellow pepper,arborio rice,white onion,italian bread,tart apple
title: Apple Risotto
ingredients: 1 small white onion, peeled and chopped | 2 cups arborio rice | 1 yellow pepper, seeded and chopped | 2 tart apples, peeled and chopped | 1 loaf italian bread, cut into 1-inch cubes
instructions: In a medium saucepan, boil water. Add rice. Reduce heat, cover and simmer 20 minutes or until rice is tender. When the rice is tender, fluff with a fork and transfer to a large serving bowl. Add the chopped onion, chopped pepper and apples.

title: Delicious Black-Eyed Peas in the Microwave
ingredients: 1 can black-eyed peas or ( 16 ounce ) can other white beans, drained, rinsed and shaken to clean ( 16-ounce can ) | 1 large bag vegetables ( like onions, zucchini, carrots and/or mushrooms, can use a combination of these )
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in microwave safe bowl.

Random Ingredients: parmesan cheese,yellow squash,chicken stock,red chili pepper,scallion,italian seasoning,balsamic vinegar,cumin powder
title: Roasted Yellow Squash With Balsamic and Italian Seasonings
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups chicken stock | 1 cup balsamic vinegar | 1 teaspoon italian seasoning | 1 teaspoon ground cumin powder | 1 teaspoon dried red chili pepper | 1 medium yellow squash or 1 medium red bell pepper, roasted | 1/2 cup chopped scallion, green parts only | 1/3 cup freshly grated parmesan cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. In a medium saucepan over medium heat, whisk all the ingredients except squash and scallion together. Bring to a boil. Add the squash and top with scallion whites. Cover tightly and place in the oven for 45 minutes. Remove from oven and place on a rimmed baking sheet. Drizzle with remaining olive oil and sprinkle of cheddar cheese. Replace the cover and bake 15 - 20 minutes, until tender and all the liquid has evaporated.

Random Ingredients: italian parsley,tomato juice,hot green chili pepper,cheddar cheese,celery,saffron thread,molasses,pecorino romano cheese
title: Chile Con Queso (Mexican Bread Dip)
ingredients: 1/2 cup molasses | 1 cup grated aged cheddar cheese | 1/2 cup pecorino romano cheese | 2 tablespoons celery, minced | 1 tablespoon fresh italian parsley, minced | 1/2 cup tomato juice | 1 hot green chili pepper, finely minced ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon saffron thread
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together the molasses, cheeses, celery, parsley, tomato juice, green chili, saffron and pepper. Serve warm.

title: Quick and Easy Tilapia
ingredients: 1 pound tilapia fillets, cut into 2 inch chunks | 1/3 cup oil for frying | 3 water chestnuts, sliced
instructions: Heat oil in a skillet, and fry tilapia until dark brown, about 3 minutes.

title: Mexican Style Cheese Ball
ingredients: 1 package mexican cheese, shredded | spices, to taste
instructions: Combine all ingredients, roll into a ball, and serve.

Random Ingredients: onion powder,french bread,bicarbonate soda,crabmeat,lemon juice zest,pepper
title: Crab-Smoked Bread Dip
ingredients: 1 lb stale french bread | 1 1/2 cups crabmeat | 2 teaspoons lemon juice, zest of | 1 tablespoon lemon juice | 1/2 teaspoon onion powder | 1/8 teaspoon pepper
instructions: Cube bread, place in medium sized casserole dish. Cover with crabmeat. Add remaining ingredients, mix. Bake at 350 for 30 minutes to an hour.

title: Paprika Paste
ingredients: 2 large yellow onions | 1 teaspoon red chili powder or 1 teaspoon hot paprika | olive oil or vegetable oil ( for frying )
instructions: Finely chop one large onion and set aside in a large bowl. Place a heavy frying pan on medium heat. Add enough olive oil or vegetable oil to cover onions and place pan into preheated oven until the onions are translucent and caramelized. Carefully peel the onions from the frying pan to a bowl. Remove the onions and set aside. Wipe out the frying pan and place a small amount of olive oil in the frying pan until it reaches the desired level of fragrance. Carefully add the onions to the skillet. Cook until the onions are a dark brown color.. Remove the pan from the heating element and allow mixture to cool for about 5 minutes. Using a strainer, remove onions and set aside in a large bowl. Chop the reserved onion into cubes.

title: French Vanilla Brownie
ingredients: 2 lbs russet potatoes, peeled and sliced thinly ( about 8 ) | 1 milk chocolate, such as lindt
instructions: Slice peeled potato to 1/4 inch thick. Arrange potato slices on wax paper lined cookie sheet, sprinkle generously with sea salt, and weight with heavy cans. In a double boiler, melt chocolate over very low heat and stir until melted and smooth. Pour in melted chocolate, increase heat to moderate, and continue stirring occasionally until lightly thickened, about 5 minutes. Pour over potatoes and allow to stand at room temperature, then cover and refrigerate at least 8 hours or overnight. When ready to serve, heat in the microwave for 45 - 1½ minutes or until mixture is just beginning to turn golden. Use a long match or long bar whisk to cut chocolate into squares and place on parchment, then drizzle chocolate over squares.

Random Ingredients: water,salmon fillet,tuna fillet,cocoa,butter lettuce,pumpkin puree,mango chutney,plain flour
title: Tropical Mango and Ginger Grilled Salmon With Crunchy Hazelnut Crunch Crumble
ingredients: 100 g smoked salmon fillet | 3 tablespoons pumpkin puree | 3 tablespoons mango chutney | 300 g butter lettuce, quartered | 500 g raw cashew cauliflower or 5 cups torn romaine lettuce | 2 teaspoons butter lettuce | 1 teaspoon cocoa | 1 teaspoon plain flour | 1/4 cup water
instructions: Put the salmon, pumpkin and chutney in a bowl and stir together. Put the butter, lettuce torn or torn lettuce in a large serving bowl or bowl with the nuts. Make the crumble topping, mix together all of the ingredients together. Spoon over the salmon mixture, sprinkle over the crumble crumbs and set aside for 10 - 15 minutes at room temperature to allow the flavours to develop. Bake in a moderate oven for 15 - 20 minutes the crumble topping is crisp and golden.

title: Creamy Saffron Potato Casserole
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs potatoes | 7 ounces mexican blend cheese, shredded | 1 teaspoon saffron | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1/2 vegetable broth, can use vegetable broth
instructions: Place the potato's in a pot with salted water and boil until tender. Remove with a slotted spoon, drain and save the water. Preheat oven to 300°f.
