Mix together the cheese, saffron and cayenne pepper in a medium bowl. Drain the potato's and mash. Stir into the cheese mixture with vegetable broth and the reserved potato cooking water. Grease a 2 1/2 quart casserole dish. Sprinkle cheese over the top. Bake in center of oven for about 1/2 hour.

Random Ingredients: vegetable shortening,red bell pepper,purpose flour,pearl barley
title: Barley-Stuffed Red Bell Peppers
ingredients: 1 large red bell pepper, cut into strips ( or you can mix red bell pepper and green bell pepper ) | 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour | vegetable shortening or butter | 3 tablespoons pearl barley
instructions: Cut a slit in the thickest part of the bell pepper, removing most of the seeds. Insert a wooden skewer through the center of the pepper at 1/4 inch intervals, then cut through the center lengthwise in three or four equal sized strips. Sprinkle flour over the strips, and roll each strip into a loose log. Cut in half from side to side until evenly distributed. Arrange the strips on a baking sheet. Repeat with the remaining strips. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Dredge in the pearl barley. Bake until tender, about 25 minutes. Serve warm. These can be frozen or reheated, and reheated just before serving.

title: Horseradish Free Coconut Milk
ingredients: 150 ml coconut milk | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon of grated horseradish
instructions: In a saucepan, combine all ingredients, except the cheese. Heat gently.

Random Ingredients: jam,lentil,green bean,red lentil,vanilla pod,shell pasta,garlic clove
title: Lentil-Studded Pasta
ingredients: 1/2 red lentil | 2 green beans | 4 garlic cloves | 1/2 liter shell pasta | 1 vanilla pod | jam | lentils
instructions: Wash and wash lentils. Cut beans in slices lengthwise and cut diagonally in half or quarters. Slice vanilla pod lengthwise and scrape out seeds. Rinse and dry lentils. Cut up the garlic and add to lentils. Wash shells and cut into 2 - 3 pieces each. Add about half a liter of water to pot, add the vanilla pod, cover and leave for an hour. The next day, bring water to a boil, and add shell pasta. Return to boil, turn down heat, and simmer for 20 minutes. Add lentils for the last 5 minutes, remove from heat. Leave for about 10 minutes to let lentils absorb any extra liquid. Stir a few times while simmering, ladle into large serving bowl. Serve with jam and slices of red onion. You can add more flavour in the next 15 minutes if desired.

Random Ingredients: purple plum,ice water,pasta,ricotta cheese,chili paste,beef liver
title: Pasta-Stuffed Fernitas
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked pasta | 1 pound beef liver | 1 cup grated ricotta cheese | 1 tablespoon chili paste | 3 tablespoons ice water | 1 purple plump plums, pitted and sliced ( optional )
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add pasta, and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

title: Scotch Broiled Salmon Pitas
ingredients: 1 can condensed tomato soup, undiluted | 1 tablespoon minced suet | 1 1/4 cups shredded cooked salmon | 6 slices processed wheat pita bread | chutney, or other sauce to serve
instructions: In bowl, mix soup with suet.

title: Crock Pot Texas Style Shredded Chicken
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs beef brisket | 1 can chicken breast, fat removed | garlic powder ( optional ) | 1 can rhubarb, drained and chopped | 1/2 cup elbow macaroni
instructions: Cut brisket into serving size pieces and place in crock pot. Sprinkle all with garlic powder or your favourite spices. Layer rhubarb on top of brisket. Combine cooked macaroni and jar of liquid from the can, pour over other ingredients. Cover and cook on lo heat for at least 4 hours.

title: Cafe Rio White Beans
ingredients: 1 can cannellini beans ( white navy beans ) | 2 cans green or red chili peppers | 2 liters half-and-half | 12 fluid ounces frozen limeade concentrate | 1/2 cup dry sherry ( optional )
instructions: Drain the beans. Place the beans in the bottom of a slow cooker and top with a layer of the beans, then 2 of the chilies, 1/2 of the limeade concentrate and 1/2 of the dry sherry. Cover and cook for 2 hours on high. When ready, serve over crushed tortillas, fresh green onions and salsa.

title: Paneer With Sour Flour
ingredients: 500 g all-purpose flour, sifted | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom powder | 1/3 teaspoon cardamom powder or 1/3 teaspoon ground cardamom
instructions: In a separate bowl, mix together the flour and cardamom powder. Once it comes together, knead gently on a floured surface until the dough is smooth and elastic. Form into a ball and chill in the fridge for 1 hour. Divide the dough into 12 - 15 equal portions. Roll each portion into a thin circle. Put 2 tbsp of sour cream on top and roll out carefully. The sour cream is to be able to stick to the tortilla later on. Heat up a flat griddle on the stove on a medium heat.. When the griddle is hot, cook each roll until golden brown, flip over, and cook on the other side. Serve hot. Store the cooked paneer covered in the refrigerator.

title: Jhol Khhay (Lebanese Pork or Beef)
ingredients: 1/2 lb pork shoulder ( cubed 1cm or 1/2 cm thick ) | 1/2 cup raisins or 1/2 cup dried currants | 6 cardamoms ( split in two or a little cassia, optional ) | 1 tablespoon anise seed ( crushed ) | 3 cups long grain rice ( to serve or to serve )
instructions: Rinse meat and pat dry with paper towels. Brown meat in oil in pot. Stir in raisins and cinnamon. Add cardamom pods. Add 3 cups or to taste some water if needed. Bring to boil. Cover. Cook at slow boil for about 2 hours or until meat is tender. Turn meat occasionally. Add more water if not thick enough. Add any vegetables or nuts if desired. Serve over cooked white rice.

title: Fruit Chutney Indian Rice Bread
ingredients: 2 tablespoons icing sugar, plus extra | icing sugar, for dusting | 8 ounces long grain white rice | 2 ounces mango chutney
instructions: Preheat oven to 375f/190c. Grease and line 2 baking trays with baking parchment. Sprinkle rice over paper, and press rice into 2 long slices over the paper to line. Dip mango chutney into the icing sugar, then place into a shallow dish. Drizzle rice with the chutney. Bake rice in oven for 15 minutes, then turn off oven, and leave for 10 minutes more. Serve the bread with extra icing sugar.

title: Bacon, Blueberry & Mint Breakfast Sausages
ingredients: 500 g blueberries or 500 g mixed fruit, of your choice | 125 g canadian bacon, of your choice cut into small cubes | 1 tablespoon dried mint | 3 teaspoons chili powder
instructions: If using blueberries cook with the canadian bacon and dried mint. If using mixed fruit cut into small chunks cook with the rest of the ingredients or add with the cooked blueberries, sprinkle with the dried mint and serve hot or cold with hot toast.

title: Chipotle and Whiskey Braised Red Cabbage
ingredients: 1 bunch red cabbage, cored and shredded | 1/4 cup whiskey ( to taste ) | 1 beef bouillon cube | 1/4 teaspoon ground chipotle pepper, or more to taste
instructions: Combine cabbage, whiskey, bouillon cube, and chipotle pepper in a saucepan over medium heat.

Random Ingredients: cilantro,passion fruit pulp,lettuce leaf,pesto sauce,pineapple,gruyere cheese
title: Cheese and Passion Fruit Salad
ingredients: 250 g gruyere cheese | 1 tablespoon pesto sauce | 12 large lettuce leaves | 1 passion fruit pulp, pulp of ( optional ) | 1/3 fresh pineapple | 1/2 bunch cilantro
instructions: Cut the cheese cross way into thick slices. Cut the passionfruit in half, remove the pulp and the skin and seeds and cut away the ends of the grapefruit segments and the central flesh. Roughly tear into chunks using a knife or the back of a knife. Toast the cheese slices in a dry frypan over a moderate heat, turning them over frequently during this, until they become a lovely, golden colour. Pour on a little hot pesto and scatter with one of the cheese slices, and set to one side. Spread the lettuce leaves with some of the pesto and arrange the slices all over the dish in a decorative pattern leaving a bit of the goat cheese border on the top. Put the passionfruit pulp in a medium pan over a medium heat and, stirring constantly with a wooden spoon, simmer for 5 to 7 minutes, then remove the pulp and put aside. Peel the pineapple flesh and cut into 4 thick slices. Slice the pineapple flesh into thin wedges. Wash the cilantro and chop roughly. Add a little more oil to the pan, then add the pineapple, passionfruit pulp and the remaining pesto and heat through. Remove from the heat and toss through the sliced cheese and serve immediately.

title: Crock Pot Caramelized American Cheese
ingredients: 8 ounces penne pasta | 4 tablespoons golden syrup | 6 ounces american cheese, cubed | 4 cups chicken stock | 1 teaspoon dried oregano
instructions: Place penne pasta in crock pot and add enough water to cover. Mix sauce ingredients together, and place in crock pot. Stir in the cheese and top with remaining sauce. Cover and cook on low heat 3 hours. Serve with fresh chopped green part mozzarella and sliced pepperoni.

Random Ingredients: apple cider,corn kernel,crab,apple juice,chuck roast,rice cereal,sesame oil,saffron
title: Sweet and Sour Beef Bake
ingredients: 350 g pork butt, boneless chuck roast | 3 tablespoons sesame oil | 1 cup instant rice cereal | 1/2 cup apple cider ( apple juice is essential ) | 1 pinch saffron | 1 cup corn kernel | 1/2 cup apple juice | 2 apples, cored and shredded
instructions: Trim fat from the beef and cut into 1cm cubes. Heat a large ovenproof frying pan over a high heat until it starts to smoke. Brush with the oil and add the beef and cook, stirring frequently until the beef is browned. Transfer the beef and contents of the pan to a casserole dish. In the same pan, mix the rice cereal with the apple cider and saffron. Pour over the beef mixture in the casserole dish, then sprinkle with the corn kernels, apples and any juices that have collected on the kitchen wall. Cover and bake at 180c for 1 hour or until the corned beef is tender. Serve in the warm dish with the juices poured over.

Random Ingredients: curry powder,soymilk,peach liqueur,red chile powder,hot italian sausage,tabasco sauce,corn oil
title: Spiced Sausage With Peaches and Cream
ingredients: 1/4 cup corn oil | 2 tablespoons peanut oil or 2 tablespoons olive oil | 1 1/2 lbs firm white-meat hot italian sausage or 1 1/2 lbs mild hot italian sausage, casings removed | 2 teaspoons red chile powder | 2 1/2 tablespoons curry powder | 3 tablespoons peach liqueur | 1 cup soymilk | 1/2 teaspoon tabasco sauce, to taste
instructions: Heat the corn oil in a deep skillet over medium high heat to medium high heat.. Sprinkle the sausage with chile powder, and cook until browned, breaking it into small crumbles as it cooks. Do not over cook. Remove the sausage with a slotted spoon, and set aside in a medium bowl. Add the oil to the pan. When there is very little oil in the pan, add the hot italian sausage. If you think it is sizzling, move the sausages to the side of the pan, and cook until it starts to brown. When it is browned, remove to a paper towel lined plate. Discard all but a couple of tbls. Of the oil except 1 cup. Return skillet to low heat. Add the remaining tbls. Of oil and the peach liqueur. Stir well. Drain the sweetened soymilk from the sausage, and add to the pan. Heat and stir until the sauce thickens slightly. Add in the hot sausage crumbles, and toss carefully. Transfer mixture to a platter, remove the sausage from its oil. Taste for seasoning, and serve with the sweetened soymilk.

title: Easy Mexican Rolls
ingredients: 1 pound lean ground turkey sausage | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 1 large can refrigerated crescent dinner rolls
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Prepare a large, deep frying pan by coating entire surface with cooking spray. Cook turkey sausage in skillet until no longer pink.

title: Pepperoni Walnut Biscuits
ingredients: 36 pepperoni slices | 36 walnut halves ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees f. In a small bowl, cover the tops of the pepperoni slices with pepperoni. Place half of the walnut halves on a baking sheet. On top of the walnuts, place the remaining pepperoni slices. Bake in the preheated oven until lightly set and warm, about 10 minutes.

title: Chick-Pea Pesto Mushrooms
ingredients: 12 button mushrooms, sliced | 1 cup canned chick-peas ( garbanzo beans ) | 1/3 cup quick-cooking pesto sauce | 1/4 cup chopped dried apricots
instructions: Add all ingredients to a bowl, toss until mixed. Cover and let stand at room temperature at least 1 hour before serving, stirring every now and then.

title: Baked Apple and Watermelon Salad
ingredients: 2 apples - peeled, cored, and sliced | 1 watermelon, sliced into 8 wedges | 1 can white or black olives, cut in half | 1 cup shredded provolone cheese | 1/4 cup orange juice | 1 tablespoon brown sugar | 1/2 cup chopped fresh basil
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Arrange watermelon, sliced apples, sliced olives, and provolone cheese in a 9x13 inch baking dish. In a bowl, whisk orange juice, brown sugar, and basil. Pour juice mixture over layered vegetables. Bake in the preheated oven 30 to 40 minutes, or until vegetables are tender and apples are lightly browned.

Random Ingredients: dark brown sugar,beef chuck roast,chestnut,chicken meat,pistachio,kaiser
title: Pepperidge Farm Hot Pot
ingredients: 2 1/2 pounds boneless beef chuck roast, trimmed of excess fat | 1 jar chestnuts, sliced and coarsely chopped | 2 tablespoons dark brown sugar | 3/4 cup pistachios, coarsely chopped | 32 kaiser rolls | 3/4 cup dark brown sugar | 8 ounces chicken meat, cut into cubes
instructions: Place the beef chuck roast, chestnuts, sugar, sunflower seeds, dark brown sugar and pistachios into the crock of a slow cooker, and stir to blend. Pour in enough cold water to cover the beef, making sure to scrape the bottom of the pan. Cook on high for 3 to 4 hours, or low for 6 to 8 hours. Add more water during cooking if necessary. Serve hot.

title: Spicy Basil Chicken
ingredients: 500 g chicken ( pieces, about 1lb ) | 2 tablespoons lime juice | 2 tablespoons basil leaves ( fresh or frozen ) | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon chili oil
instructions: Place chicken pieces and salt in a pan. Pour lime juice over, cover and bake in a moderate oven for 1 hour. Stir in basil, chilli oil and continue cooking uncovered for 10 minutes until chicken is tender and cooked through.

title: Maple Molasses Butter for Sushi
ingredients: 6 1/2 - 7 ounces maple syrup | 1 1/2 tablespoons molasses or 1 1/2 tablespoons maple syrup
instructions: Bake maple syrup in a small pot over low heat. Allow it to cool slightly then beat with electric mixer till creamy and frothy. Place molasses in a large microwavable bowl and warm it with molasses in microwave. Place melted butter, maple syrup, and rum into a glass jar with a tight fitting lid, then snap on the lid and mix well. Seal the jar, then refrigerate. It will keep for about a week. Note, i store a jar of this butter in a jar and use it for making sushi.

Random Ingredients: red chili pepper,green bell pepper,lemon,velveeta cheese,espresso powder,mango powder
title: Maggie's Tiramisu (Copycat Recipe)
ingredients: 1 jar of mango powder ( see my mother-in-law's recipe ) | 1 box velveeta cheese | 2 -3 tablespoons red chili peppers or 2 -3 tablespoons jalapeno peppers, seeded and minced | 3 lemons, juiced | 3 tablespoons espresso powder or 3 tablespoons instant coffee granules, see note ( optional )
instructions: Drain mango and chili spice blend into mixing bowl. Add cheese, lemon juice and espresso powder to cheese and mix with wire wisk. Beat egg whites until they start to stiffen then pour a small amount into cheese mixture.. Add a few drops of tobasco if desired. Transfer to a serving bowl and sprinkle with additional chocolate, papaya and fresh basil as garnish.

Random Ingredients: chunky salsa,yellow pepper,ginger juice,great northern bean,apple juice,sauce,double cream,vanilla extract
title: Crock Pot Green & White Bean Salad (South Beach Diet Phase 2)
ingredients: 3 tablespoons chunky salsa | 1 tablespoon apple juice or 1 tablespoon apple cider ( i actually like apple cider ) | 1 can great northern beans, drained and rinsed ( not drained ) | 1 yellow pepper, sliced ( a mix of red and green peppers, and or one combination ) | 1 tablespoon hot sauce ( i use tabasco brand ) | 1 teaspoon reduced sodu sauce ( i normally leave this out, but we like it very hot ) ( optional ) | 1 dash fresh ginger juice | 2 tablespoons double cream
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in crock pot on low for 4 1/2 hours until beans are heated through. Top with cream and serve.

title: Pasta Beans With Farfalle
ingredients: 1 lb farfalle pasta, such as bowtie | 1/4 cup black beans, rinsed | 2 bay leaves | 1 teaspoon fresh coarse ground celery seed
instructions: Bring 4 quarts of water to a boil, add pasta and salt, and stir a few times. Add beans, bay leaves, and celery seeds. Reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 10 minutes or until pasta is just tender. Drain and pass through a large fine mesh sieve.

title: Brazilian Pea Soup
ingredients: 1 package frozen green peas, thawed and drained | 1 cup thick coconut cream, divided | 1 teaspoon ground coffee
instructions: In a blender or food processor, combine the frozen peas and 2/3 cup of the coconut cream. Blend until smooth. Transfer the remaining coconut cream to a saucepan and bring to a boil over high heat. Pour the hot cream and coconut cream into the pan and stir to combine. Allow the soup to bubble and thicken then remove from heat. Cover and let stand for 1 minute. Ladle into serving bowls and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: oyster sauce,vinegar,taco sauce,clam juice,caster sugar,puff pastry
title: Spicy Clam Pie
ingredients: 1 cup seafood, chopped ( or seafood of choice ) | 1/4 cup clam juice | 1 packet frozen puff pastry sheet, thawed | 2 teaspoons caster sugar | 1/4 cup oyster sauce | 1 1/4 tablespoons vinegar
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c. Mix seafood with clams. Roll out pastry on a lightly floured surface. Pile on top of seafood and cover with pastry lid. Combine sauce ingredients. Prick pastry with a fork. Bake for 30 - 35 mins until pie pastry is golden and flakey.

Random Ingredients: chicken,baking potato,italian seasoning,chipotle chile,asafoetida powder,ketchup,lime wedge
title: Chipotle Chicken Stir Fry and Grilled Onions
ingredients: 1 tablespoon finely minced chipotle chile | 2 tablespoons ketchup | 4 teaspoons asafoetida powder | 2/3 lb thinly sliced chicken | 1 medium baking potato, peeled and cut into 1/4 inch slices | lime wedge, for serving
instructions: Combine all ingredients except oil and marinade in medium bowl. Add chicken and potato and stir to coat well. Cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours. Prepare grill or broiler. Remove chicken and potatoes from bowl. Brush grill with oil. Thread vegetables onto skewers and grill, turning over once, until cooked through, about 7 minutes for side. Transfer to plates and serve with lime wedges.

title: Rocket Salad
ingredients: 1 tablespoon raspberry flavored jam, spread | 1 tablespoon rocket, rocket
instructions: Place jam in a serving bowl. Arrange rocket leaves on top. Chill for 30 minutes.

title: Spinach with Cashews
ingredients: 1 package spinach, rinsed | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chile peppers | 1/4 cup cashews | 1/4 teaspoon pepper
instructions: Cook spinach according to package directions, omitting the salt and excess moisture. Drain well, rinse with cold water and set aside. Place tomatoes and green chile peppers in a small saucepan, cover and cook over medium high heat until heated, then stir in cashews. Add spinach, mix well, and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: yellow squash,ginger,garlic powder,beef mince,edible flower,parsley,ginger garlic paste,rom tomato
title: Quick Microwave Beef and Vegetables
ingredients: 1 teaspoon garlic powder | 1/2 lb boneless beef mince | 2 roma tomatoes, thinly sliced | 2 small yellow squash, cut into 1/4 inch cubes | 2 teaspoons fresh ginger, minced | 1 teaspoon fresh ginger-garlic paste | 2 -3 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley ( optional ) | 1/4 cup edible flower, crushed ( optional )
instructions: Combine garlic powder, meat, tomatoes, squash, ginger, garlic paste, parsley, and edible flowers in a microwaveable dish. Cover and microwave on high 100% power 3 - 4 minutes.

title: Baked Beans Sprouts With Jasmine Rice
ingredients: 2 cups jasmine rice | 1 1/2 teaspoons flax seeds ( roasted, in a skillet with a little bit of the water, for about 45 minutes ) | 1/2 cup fresh bean sprout
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Cook the rice according to its directions and line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Spread the flax seeds in a bowl while hot, shaking the bowl to redistribute them. Drizzle the seeds over the rice and spread out into a circle approximately 4 inches deep. Let the rice cool, about 5 minutes. Place the bean sprouts in another bowl, pour the cooled rice liquid over them, and toss the rice a couple times to mix. Transfer the rice to the prepared baking sheet and bake for about 45 to 60 minutes, stirring occasionally, until crisp and well browned. Serve the rice topped with bean sprouts and crumbled crisp baked beans sprouts.

Random Ingredients: green chilies,egg,beef bouillon granule,cooking apple,macaroni noodle
title: Mac and Beef Bake
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef round | 2 tablespoons fresh minced green chilies | 1 package macaroni noodles | 2 teaspoons beef bouillon granules | 1/2 package frozen egg, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. In nonstick skillet, cook beef and chilies over medium high heat, stirring frequently, about 3 minutes or until beef is no longer pink. Stir in pasta and bouillon. Cook and stir until pasta is coated with cooking spray and is to desired tenderness. Spoon into 1 1/2 quart casserole sprayed with no stick cooking spray. Stir in eggs.

title: Simple Charcoal Mixtures
ingredients: 3/4 cup dark brown sugar | 1/2 cup dates, pitted and finely chopped
instructions: Preheat an ovenproof nonreactive briquettes on a foil lined baking sheet for about 5 minutes. Spray each briquette with cooking spray and sprinkle each with the brown sugar. Spray the tops of the briquettes with cooking spray and sprinkle with the dates. Allow the mixture to cook in the oven for 20 to 25 minutes or until the sugar is melted and the filling is set.

title: Kielbasa in Pesto & Apples
ingredients: 2 tablespoons lite olive oil | 1 lb kielbasa, sliced | 1 1/2 cups unsalted fresh shelled fresh fruit ( such as prunes, pears, apples, grapes, etc. ) | 10 pinches canned whole limes ( i use the juice of 2 limes ) or 10 pinches each lime juice ( i use the juice of 2 limes ) | chopped fresh fruit ( optional ) | freshly crushed pesto sauce, to garnish
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet. Add kielbasa.

title: Cheesy Mustard Spread
ingredients: 1 can condensed cheese soup | 1 1/2 teaspoons dry mustard
instructions: Add the dry mustard to the cheese soup. Mix well. Use when making potato soup.

title: Kheer (Rice and Lemon Pudding)
ingredients: 1/2 lb whole wheat | 1 lemon peel | 5 ounces basmati rice, soaked until tender
instructions: The day before, rinse the wheat in a seive, picking out any excess water. Bring 3 cups of water to a boil, add the rice, and continue boiling until tender, usually 15 - 20 minutes. Take out the lemon peel. Slice the lemon peel into very thin strips and set aside. Drain most of the rice from the wheat. Add 2 tablespoons of the melted wheat and lemon peel and stir. Cover and refrigerate. The next day, put the rice in the microwave, covered, for 2 minutes. Stir until well coated and heated through. Serve either hot or cold.

title: Simple Masala Paste
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups chili oil | 1 cup masala ( all purpose paste )
instructions: Place chili oil through sieve or coffee filter into a small plastic bowl and reserve. Dissolve masala in warm water until you have a smooth paste consistency. The chili oil can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 1 week. If using coffee filter cut the mixture into small pieces and boil in microwave for about 1 minute.

title: Hot German Potato Salad
ingredients: 6 medium potatoes | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil or 1 tablespoon canola oil | 1 lb thinly sliced roast beef or 1 lb sausage, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 package roasted kielbasa ( optional )
instructions: Cook potatoes in salted boiling water until tender when pierced with a fork, 10 to 15 mins or until tender but still firm. Drain on paper towels and let cool slightly. Meanwhile, heat oil in large nonstick skillet just to smoking. Add meat and sausages.

title: Chicken and Macaroni Withwalnuts
ingredients: 750 g elbow macaroni | 500 g chicken breast fillets | 250 g shelled walnuts
instructions: Boil the pasta and cook in salted water until done. Drain well. Cut the chicken into little pieces. Spray with oil and fry it, stirring occasionally, until it is cooked. Add the chicken and nuts and combine. Serve with salad and your favourite green vegetable.

title: Peachy French Toast
ingredients: 12 ounces frozen peaches, thawed | 12 ounces frozen garlic bread | 1 large orange bell pepper | 1/2 cup cake flour ( cornmeal )
instructions: Defrost, thaw and drain the peaches. Combine the peaches, bread, and garlic in a 13x9 inch baking pan. Sprinkle with cornmeal. Bake, uncovered, at 350 degrees for 35 minutes, or until lightly browned and bubbly. Let stand 5 minutes before cutting.

title: Cherry Pepper Potato Pancakes
ingredients: 4 medium baking potatoes, such as russets, very finely grated | 1/2 large green pepper, finely chopped | 1 clove garlic, crushed | 2 1/2 tablespoons sunflower oil or 2 1/2 tablespoons other cooking oil | salt and freshly ground black pepper, to taste
instructions: Place grated potato in a bowl. Add grated pepper, garlic, sunflower or other fat. Mix well. Heat a large nonstick frying pan over a high heat. Spray the pan with a little oil. Pour in 1/4 cup of potato mixture and smooth out evenly, using a spatula. Add just enough water to cover the mixture. Stir occasionally until boiling, then cover and simmer for 10 minutes until potatoes are starting to soften but are still holding their shape. Turn the heat down to the lowest possible and cover the pan with a lid to steam the potato mixture for another 3 - 5 minutes, stirring occasionally. Season generously with salt and pepper. Serve hot with salsa and sour cream.

Random Ingredients: mexican cheese,rice,hot red chili pepper,clam juice,puff pastry,lemon lime beverage,poblano pepper
title: Pimento Chicken
ingredients: 1 sheet puff pastry | 5 tablespoons lemon-lime flavored carbonated beverage | 1 can chopped clams with juice | 1/4 cup prepared hot red chili pepper | 1/4 cup finely diced mexican-style cheese | 4 teaspoons finely chopped pimento stuffed green chile peppers | 4 cups cooked rice, for dipping ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. On a lightly floured surface, roll out the puff pastry to a 16 inch circle. Cut into 4 squares. Cover the bottom of 2 large baking sheets with a double layer of parchment paper or silpats. Place one square of pastry on a well oiled pizza pan, forming a 13 inch circle over the top of the pastry. In a medium bowl, combine the clams and their juices with the chiles, cheese and pimentos. Pour the mixture over the pastry, leaving several inches around the perimeter. Top with the remaining pastry square, tucking the edges under the filling. Bake for 25 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown and fragrant and the filling is hot.

title: Lemon Thyme Roasted Thyme Snacks
ingredients: 20 lemon twists, 2 inch long | 20 fresh thyme sprigs
instructions: Snails, scrub under water to remove any air bubbles. Wrap the thyme in aluminum foil and place on a baking tray. Drizzle with some oil. Bake at 220c/425f for 15 - 20 mins until they are golden and cooked. Cut a slit into each snail and serve with fresh salad.

title: Blue Cheese Stuffed Irish Bread
ingredients: 12 loaves unsliced country bread or 12 loaves unsliced sourdough bread | 12 ounces blue cheese, crumbled or sliced thin | 12 ounces sweet unsweetened beer | 2 teaspoons italian parsley, finely chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 f or 160 degrees celsius. Line a loaf pan with foil. Slice top, hollow out and insides of bread. Combine remaining ingredients together except for the bread and bread mixture. Pour cheese mixture into loaf pan, covering evenly evenly. Bake for about 1 hour or until slightly browned and top is golden brown.

title: Persian Coffee
ingredients: 1 teaspoon coffee or 1 teaspoon espresso | 1 -2 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1/2 teaspoon paprika
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and enjoy ~ if you don't drink coffee, you could enjoy a little bit of fresh mint or ginger.

title: Flax Seeds Chicken
ingredients: 2 chicken breasts | 2 tablespoons flax seeds
instructions: Dry chicken with paper towels and sprinkle each side with 1 tablespoon flax seed. Place chicken on a baking sheet and bake at 375 degrees fahrenheit for about 45 minutes, or until chicken is well browned and juices run clear.

title: Anise Toast
ingredients: 2 eggs | 1 tablespoon spice | 16 ounces white beans | star anise | 2 slices bread
instructions: Beat eggs, spice and beans together. Soak bread with egg mixture on the counter. Spread mixture on bread slices and put a row of soaked bread on top of each stack. Press into a well towell. Bake in a heated toaster until light brown. Serve hot with curry and other indian condiments.

title: Greek Kielbasa With Zucchini and Snow Peas (Zwt3)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs turkey kielbasa | 3 ripe tomatoes | zucchini | 1 cup zucchini | 1 can navy beans, drained and rinsed | 1 cup yellow zucchini | 8 ounces snow peas | 1 cup greek yogurt
instructions: In large skillet, cook kielbasa over medium heat for 20 minutes, turning often so it browns all over evenly. Drain kielbasa, reserving 1/4 cup drippings. Chop tomato, zucchini and and cook in drippings for 5 minute stirring often. Remove kielbasa from skillet and place in bowl. Sprinkle zucchini, yellow zucchini and sun dried tomatoes on top. Place bowl in larger skillet over medium high heat and saute for about 5 minute. Remove skillet from heat and stir in the rinsed navy beans. Spread tomato mixture over kielbasa on top and serve with greek yogurt.

Random Ingredients: artichoke heart,snow pea,baby pea,tortilla,prosciutto,molasses,head bok choy,nutmeg
title: Tortilla Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup frozen baby peas | 1/2 cup frozen baby peas | 1 tablespoon molasses | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh marinated artichoke hearts, drained | 1/2 package thinly sliced prosciutto, cut diagonally into 1/4-inch slices | 4 large tortillas, cut into strips | 1 sprig fresh nutmeg | 6 baby bok choy, chopped | 1 small head bok choy, trimmed and sliced diagonally | 2 ounces snow peas, trimmed and washed in cold water
instructions: Cook frozen and baby peas, peas, molasses, and artichoke hearts in a large skillet over medium heat, 1 to 2 minutes, stirring constantly. Stir in prosciutto strips and cook 1 minute longer, until crisp. Add bok choy strips and snow peas, and continue to cook and stir until crisp tender, about 3 minutes. Taste for seasoning and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: brown gravy mix,swordfish fillet,hazelnut liqueur,chunky peanut butter,saffron thread
title: Peanut Butter Crusted Swordfish with Fiery Peanut Gravy
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds swordfish fillets | 1 cup coarsely ground hazelnut liqueur | 1/2 cup chunky peanut butter | 1 package brown gravy mix | 1 saffron threads
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Spray the foil with cooking spray. Place fish fillets on the baking sheet, and cut in half lengthwise. Place 2 halves on top of each other on top of the foil, cut side down. Pour hazelnut liqueur over fish fillets, and spread peanut butter on top. Sprinkle with brown gravy mix. Cover the baking sheet with aluminum foil. Bake in preheated oven for 25 minutes, or until fish is easily flaked with a fork.

Random Ingredients: button mushroom,brandy,ancho chile powder,kielbasa,almond milk,cake flour,tilapia fillet,banana
title: Tilapia Florentine
ingredients: 1/2 cup blanched almond milk, divided | 1 lb kielbasa, thinly sliced | 1 lb tilapia fillet, cut into eighths | 2 tablespoons brandy | 1/8 teaspoon crushed dried ancho chile powder | 1 lb button mushroom, thinly sliced | 3 tablespoons cake flour | 1 small banana, sliced into 2-inch pieces
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f in a heatproof bowl, blend half the almond milk with the remaining almond milk until smooth. Spread the mixture evenly over the tilapia fillets. Using the back of a fork, poke holes in the kielbasa to deeply imprint the meat. Brush with brandy. Bake for 15 - 20 minutes until cooked through, and firm, but not browned. Meanwhile, sprinkle the sesame powder over the mushrooms in a small bowl and toss to coat. Spread the mushrooms on a plate. Arrange the bananas slices over the mushrooms in a thin layer. Transfer the tilapia slices with a spatula or tongs to a cutting board and sprinkle with flour. Toss them gently with the tilapia.

title: Chinese Cabbage in Season
ingredients: 2 cups shredded fresh chinese cabbage | 1 tablespoon crushed basil or 1 tablespoon dried basil | 4 whole cloves | 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 1 1/2 teaspoons italian seasoning
instructions: Place cabbage in a colander or strainer and shake to drain off excess water. Place cabbage in a serving bowl and toss with seasonings. Cover and refrigerate overnight or up to 1 day.

title: Egg Noodle "shrooms"
ingredients: 1 lb stew meat, finely diced | 1 package egg noodles, cooked and drained | 1/2 cup sirachi hot chili sauce
instructions: Place the ground meat, cooked noodles, and thai hot sauce in a large saucepan. Heat over medium heat so it simmers gently. Cook, covered, stirring occasionally, 5 - 10 minutes until the meat is hot and noodles are tender, stirring frequently so they do not break apart. Serve.

title: Cajun Fondue
ingredients: 2 cups margarine, melted | 1 tablespoon arrowroot or 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 8 tablespoons rye bread, crumbs | cayenne ( to season )
instructions: Place margarine in a medium bowl, whisk in arrowroot and mix to smooth paste. Add bread crumbs, mixing well. Add cayenne to season. Coat with flour, dip in melted margarine, and serve. Store in refrigerator in medium container.

title: Homemade Flank Steak Gravy
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons cornstarch | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon | 1/2 cup grand marnier ( an orange flavored liqueur )
instructions: Mix cornstarch, bouillon and grand marnier in a bowl. Add meat and mix well. Pour about half of gravy in a skillet. Heat on medium high heat. Cover and cook until meat reaches 165 degrees.

Random Ingredients: liquid smoke flavoring,tomato juice,white flour,pepper,pasta sauce,peanut oil,chicken breast half,black bean
title: Chicken Picnic Pasta
ingredients: 2 tablespoons tomato juice | 1 tablespoon white flour | 1/2 teaspoon liquid smoke flavoring | 1/2 teaspoon pepper | 8 ounces low-sodium chicken breast halves | 3 ounces canned black beans, drained, rinsed and drained | 2 cups pasta sauce ( your favourite ) | 2 tablespoons peanut oil, for fry | 1/2 tablespoon crushed roasted peanuts, for topping
instructions: Cut chicken in bite size pieces and place in a medium saucepan with the tomato juice, flour, water, liquid smoke and pepper. Bring to boiling.

title: Taco Meat Seasoning Salt Free Option for Dogs Only
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons mccormick grill seasoning | 3/4 cup whole wheat flour
instructions: In a medium size bowl mix 2 teaspoons of grill seasoning with flour until the mixture is a coarse powder. Use the reserved dry steak seasoning for your favorite taco/mexican meat recipe. For more sauce, use the same seasoning. If you want your chips to be crispy, just roll them first in the flour before rolling them. They should be light and crispy. Bake at 400 degrees f until crispy crisp.

title: Homemade Tamari
ingredients: 2 tablespoons tamari | 3 tablespoons sweetened condensed beverage ( e.g. coca cola ) | 3 1/2 ounces tequila
instructions: Pour the tamari in a tall jar. Add the soda and shake vigorously to mix. Pour the tequila into a tall glass and serve.

Random Ingredients: cauliflower,dark sesame oil,green enchilada sauce,pork roast,romano cheese,bisquick,corn
title: Santa Fe Pork and Cauliflower
ingredients: 3 1/2 - 4 lbs pork roast, trimmed of strings if necessary ( can also use pork shoulder ) | 3 1/2 cups dry bisquick | 1 cup chopped cabbage | 1 1/2 cups grated romano cheese | 3 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 1 can green enchilada sauce | 1 1/2 teaspoons dark sesame oil | 1 1/2 lbs cauliflower, broken into florets, can sub other vegetables
instructions: Place pork roast in a small dutch oven or large bowl. Add enough water to moisten the meat, cover, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat, cover and simmer for 1 hour. Remove roast and drain off the broth. Cool to at least room temperature before you use it in your recipe. Return stock to the dutch oven, season to taste with salt, set aside to cool, about 1 1/2 hours. To make the cheese filling, combine the bisquick, cabbage, cheese, 1 tablespoon of the sesame oil and remaining ingredients in a bowl and mix well. Grease a 10 inch cast iron skillet with the remaining 1 tablespoon sesame oil. Stir the bisquick mixture into the hot stock. Bring just to a boil, reduce heat and simmer, stirring and breaking up any lumps, for about 20 minutes. Remove pork from the pan and set aside, covered, until it's cool enough to handle, about 15 minutes. Meanwhile, cook the cauliflower in boiling water in a separate pot until just tender, and drain very well. Place the pork in a baking dish and pour the reserved broth over. Top with the cauliflower and cover. Bake the pork, covered, in a 350°f oven for about 1 hour or until cooked through. Serve with the cheese sauce.

title: Tomato and Kidney Bean Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup kidney beans, drained and rinsed ( use the 1/4 can to measure if you're fond of kidney beans ) | 1 tablespoon cognac ( or more to taste ) | 2 tablespoons finely chopped fresh basil leaves ( or 1 teaspoon dried ) | 1/2 cup cherry tomatoes
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large skillet and bring to a boil over medium high heat. Reduce heat to low and simmer, stirring occasionally, stirring often and adding water if necessary, just until slightly thickened and hot. This can be kept warm in a 300 degree oven until ready to use. Serve over your favourite pasta.

title: Easy Tomato Prune & Tomato Jam
ingredients: 500 g ripe tomatoes | 500 g pitted prunes
instructions: Peel, deseed and roughly chop the tomatoes. Place all ingredients into a saucepan together with a litre of hot water and bring to the boil. Reduce heat and simmer uncovered for 15 minutes. The mixture should be fairly dark and have a bit of watery texture, but this can easily take down to half the quantity. Leave to cool. Refrigerate for 2 days if any can be used. Keep in the refridgerator for up to 3 months.

title: Soy and Chilli Chicken Cakes
ingredients: 1 large zucchini | 2 large yellow onions, peeled, washed and finely chopped | 2 teaspoons palm sugar | 2 -3 tablespoons chicken meat, chopped
instructions: Cut the zucchini and onions into about 1 cm pieces. Place in a blender and add the sugar, chicken and mix to a smooth paste. Form patties with the mixture about 3/4 cm thick. Heat a non stick pan or griddle, and cook the patties until brown and crispy on both sides.

title: Southern Style Peach Dip
ingredients: 12 fresh pears - peeled, cored and coarsely chopped | 2/3 cup ketchup | 1/4 cup white bread, crumbs | salt and ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Place the pears in a bowl, and stir in the ketchup and crumbs. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Cover, and refrigerate for at least 1 hour before serving. Serve with toothpicks.

title: Fruit Chutney
ingredients: 1 cup mango chutney | 1/2 cup molasses | 2 teaspoons cornstarch | 1/4 cup catsup
instructions: Add all ingredients to medium skillet, stir gently, heat until mixture thickens. Pour into hot sterilized pint jars or any lids and seal. Process for 40 minutes in boiling water or in a boiling water bath for 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: swiss cheese,mayonnaise,apple juice concentrate,water,chili pepper flake
title: Elswet's Baked Swiss Cheese Applesauce
ingredients: 3 cups swiss cheese, grated | 1 teaspoon apple juice concentrate, dissolved in | 1/2 cup water | 1/4 teaspoon chili pepper flakes | 1 cup mayonnaise
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. In a large bowl combine cheese, apple juice concentrate and water. Stir well and refrigerate. In a small bowl combine chili pepper flakes with mayonnaise. Spoon mixture into a baking dish and top with cheese mixture. Place dish in oven.

title: Kahlua Butterscotch Mashed Potatoes #5FIX
ingredients: 5 1/2 cups vegetable broth | 1 tablespoon lemon juice | 8 ounces butterscotch chips | 1 cup dry grits | 1/2 cup milk | 1/3 cup kahlua | 14 ounces sweetened condensed milk | 30 ounces canned olives, drained | 30 ounces of your favourite sweet olives | 1 box of uncooked small pasta shells
instructions: Over medium heat in a large sauce pan, saute diced butterscotch chips in milk until toasted and then set aside. Combine vegetable broth, lemon juice, butterscotch chips, grits, and 1/3 cup kahlua in a large saucepan. Heat on low until warm, mix until smooth, then stir into pot with broth mixture. Add condensed milk, olives, and pasta and stir until mixed but not hot. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: corn cob,tabasco sauce,cake flour,cauliflower floret,macaroni,brazil nut,monterey jack cheese,rice paper
title: Macaroni Squash and Cauliflower Cheese With Shellfish
ingredients: 1 cake flour, sifted | 1 large cauliflower floret, coarsely chopped | 2 corn cobs, kernels cut off, each cob reserved | 2 cups grated monterey jack cheese, divided | 1 cup macaroni ( preferably whole or small tube, but fine to use as needed ) | 8 -10 sheets rice paper, each about 6 inches in diameter | tabasco sauce, as needed | 1/4 cup macaroni salad mix ( to be found near packet brand ) | 1/4 cup shredded monterey jack cheese
instructions: Boil 4 quarts of water and salt generously. Add cauliflower, cover and let stand 20 minutes. Drain off water and mash cauliflower into a chunky puree with a fork. To assemble, top a sheet of rice paper with a few tablespoons of shredded monteray jack cheese. Place a sheet of rice paper onto a large board or platter. Spread a small amount of the macaroni sauce on the rice paper. Sprinkle generously with about 1/4 cup grated monterey jack cheese. Spread a layer of cauliflower mixture on top of the cheese. Top with a sprinkling of remaining sauce, followed by the grated nutmeg, rice paper and extra grated cheese. Repeat. When finished layering, cut on the diagonal into serving slices. Serve with tabasco hot sauce for dipping.

title: Yellow Pea Stuffed Kiwi Fruit
ingredients: 1 lb yellow peas ( or green and yellow or white or all or part of one ) | water | 2 cups long grain white rice | 1 large kiwi fruit
instructions: Peel kiwi fruit and pierce the surface with a fork. Cut the peel from the kiwis using a sharp knife or a knife cut down the side of the membrane to remove the kiwi stalks through the membrane. Place peas in a saucepan with water and half the rice, cover and simmer gently for 40 minutes until tender, stirring occasionally and adding a little water if necessary. Remove from heat and chill. When ready to serve, split the kiwi fruit in a wedge on serving dishes, remove the seeds and pulp, and cut each half into quarters. Fill the hollowed centre of each piece with rice and fill with rice halves. Serve with whipped cream and honey.

Random Ingredients: saffron,rom tomato,beef brisket,lamb loin chop,dark soy sauce,shiitake mushroom,yogurt,green chili pepper
title: Lamb With Shiitake Mushrooms and Yogurt
ingredients: 1 cup shiitake mushroom | 2 dried shiitake mushrooms | 6 beef brisket ( trimmed, not tied ) | 1/2 cup plain yogurt | 3 medium roma tomatoes, coarsely chopped | 3 green chili peppers, coarsely chopped | 1 pinch saffron | 2 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 1/8 cup dark soy sauce | 2 teaspoons grated fresh ginger
instructions: Rinse shiitake, dried shiitake mushrooms, and corned beef with cold water. Soak in warm water for at least 1 hour. Drain, remove stems, and cut slits into each cap. Rinse with cold water. Trim brisket.

title: French Onion Confit
ingredients: 2 lbs spanish onions, peeled | 1 cup pure maple syrup | 1/2 cup cognac
instructions: Place the onions in a saucepan, cover with hot water and cook over medium high heat until the onions begin to caramelize about 15 minutes. Drain and place in a food mill or blender. Grind the onions through the coarse disk. Combine the maple syrup and cognac in a glass or ceramic bowl. Add the onions and mix until coated. Cover and refrigerate for up to 2 days.

Random Ingredients: sherry wine,tomato paste,vanilla,beef chuck,green curry paste,chicken stock beef
title: Green Spicy Curry
ingredients: 2 lbs beef chuck, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 1/2 cups chicken stock or 1 1/2 cups beef stock | 1 can chicken stock or 1 can beef bouillon | 2 tablespoons green curry paste | 1 tablespoon tomato paste | 1 teaspoon vanilla or 2 teaspoons lemon juice | 1 tablespoon dry sherry wine
instructions: In crockpot or large heavy fry pan, combine all ingredients except beef. Cover and cook on low for 12 - 14 hours, stirring 2 - 3 times.. Serve over your favourite rice, if desired.

Random Ingredients: chicken leg,chinese eggplant,sugar,sirloin tip roast,ham,double cream,hamburger
title: Chinese Chicken With Pork on Toast (Sau Siu)
ingredients: 8 -12 chicken legs ( or just legs ) | 8 -12 chinese eggplants ( or 1 large eggplant ) | 4 slices ham | 1/2 lb sirloin tip roast, lean, diced | 4 ounces cooked ham, cut into thin strips ( or more if you wish ) | 6 -12 tablespoons double cream ( or 1/4 cup of cream of mushroom soup mix mixed with water ) | 1/2 - 3/4 cup sugar
instructions: Wash and peel eggplant and cut into 1 inch slices or cubes. Slice ham. Lay sirloin in a flat wide shallow dish. Layer eggplant slices evenly over sirloin. Top with ham slices. In a skillet, combine cream or soup mix with water. Heat thoroughly over low heat. Add sugar and stir. Pour over chicken, eggplant and ham. Let stand covered for 1 to 1 1/2 hours to marinate. Turn on griller. Place chicken on grill and cook until done, about 5 to 10 minutes. Remove from grill and cut into strips and serve immediately.

title: Beef Tacos
ingredients: 3/4 lb sliced deli roast beef | 1 package taco seasoning | 1 package kielbasa | 4 anise-flavored corn chips
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees. Combine roast beef, taco seasoning, kielbasa and anise flavoring. Spoon into shallow, round pan. Layer with corn chips until coated. Bake 10 minutes or until meat is heated through.

Random Ingredients: marshmallow,grain rice,ra el hanout spice mix,chicken leg,great northern bean
title: Maggie's Seven Week Rice
ingredients: 4 -6 chicken legs with thigh, skinned | 6 ounces ras el hanout spice mix | 1/2 lb good northern bean, cooked | 1/2 lb miniature marshmallow ( or more ) | 2 cups long grain rice, cooked
instructions: Brown chicken legs in olive oil. Place in oven safe casserole dish that has been sprayed with nonstick cooking spray. Combine remaining ingredients in small bowl and pour over chicken. Sprinkle with parmesan. Cover and bake at 350f degrees for 45 minutes or until tender.

title: Bassape Malagueta
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups vinegar ( sweet but not burnt ) | 1 tablespoon anise seed ( if you can see them, the seeds are for me )
instructions: Combine the vinegar and anise seeds and allow to get quite hot over a medium heat. Boil until the sugar dissolves.

title: Jicama and Cabbage Batter
ingredients: 1/2 head cabbage, coarsely chopped | 500 g jicama, peeled, cut into chunks | 4 tablespoons unbleached white flour
instructions: Using a fine julienne blade, pound and shred cabbage into long strips. Place jicama in a bowl and stir in 500g of the cabbage. Sprinkle flour over and mix. Place remaining cabbage shreds on top and toss lightly. Taste and season with salt and pepper. Serve hot or at room temperature.

title: Welsh Peanut Stew
ingredients: 2 pints shelled peanuts | 2 cups brown lentils | 1 tablespoon green cardamom pods, split | 1 teaspoon worcestershire sauce | 1 teaspoon sugar, or to taste
instructions: Rinse the peanuts under warm running water to remove the skins and excess moisture. Rinse the lentils under warm running water and set aside. Slice in half and place in a large pot with plenty of water to cover. Bring to boil, reduce heat to medium, and cover. Simmer until thick, about 25 minutes. Add the rest of the ingredients, except the sugar, and simmer until the lentils are tender and liquid is almost evaporated, about 20 minutes.

title: Quick & Easy Easy Vermouth Pasta - Quick & Easy!
ingredients: 1 lb pasta, your choice of shape ( i prefer penne or rigatoni, as i am partial to penne etc. ) | 1 tablespoon onion powder | 1 can low fat sauerkraut ( half a can, no additives ) | 1 teaspoon hot sauce or 1 teaspoon tabasco sauce
instructions: Cook pasta according to directions on box. When pasta is ready, drain. While waiting for the pasta to drain, combine all the ingredients and stir together. Drain the pasta and mix with the sauce. Serve.

Random Ingredients: celery rib,chili paste,clear tequila,chinese cabbage,red bell pepper,linguine,vegetable stock,white bread
title: Chilli Cheese Noodle Soup
ingredients: 4 slices firm white bread, crust removed | 1/4 cup red bell pepper, roasted, seeded, thinly sliced | 1 celery rib, roughly sliced | 1/2 cucumber, peeled, seeded, thinly sliced | 6 cups vegetable stock | 2 tablespoons chili paste | 6 fluid ounces clear tequila | linguine, to serve
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a large saucepan over a medium heat. Add the bread and cook for 2 - 3 minutes, stirring. Pour in the roasted bell pepper, celery and cucumber and stir. Tip in the stock, chili paste and tequila and bring to the boil. Simmer for 10 minutes. Place the noodles in a large heatproof dish and cover with boiling water. Stand in a turned off oven for 20 minutes until tender.

Random Ingredients: greek yogurt,iceberg lettuce,chicken broth,egg noodle,cinnamon,guacamole,cointreau liqueur,whipping cream
title: Crunchy Noodle Soup
ingredients: 1/2 cup egg noodles | 1 carton chicken broth | 3/4 cup guacamole | 1 tablespoon cointreau liqueur | 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 1 cup shredded iceberg lettuce | 1 cup greek yogurt | 1/2 cup whipping cream
instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions. Drain and run under running water. Set aside. In 2 - 3 quart dutch oven, combine broth, guacamole, liqueur and cinnamon. Cook and stir over medium heat 5 minutes or until heated through. Combine noodles, broth mixture and cheeses.

title: Noori Keema With Sesame Oil
ingredients: 2 cups sesame oil | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 2 -3 teaspoons dried fenugreek leaves
instructions: Put all of the ingredients into a small pan, and place over a medium heat until it bubbles. Bake the noori keema in a preheated oven at 150°c for 45 minutes, then remove from the oven when browned all over serve.

Random Ingredients: garlic salt,red chile,thyme,flour tortilla,tomato soup,water chestnut,kaffir lime leaf
title: Quick Easy Shredded Beef Tostadas
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs skirt steaks, cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 16 ounces condensed tomato soup | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh thyme | 1 teaspoon chopped red chile | 1 tablespoon flour | 1/4 teaspoon garlic salt | 12 -15 large flour tortillas | 10 water chestnuts, drained ( optional )
instructions: Heat oven to 400°f. Spread 1/2 teaspoon of the tomato soup over all sides of steak in large baking dish. Sprinkle with the thyme, chile, and the flour. Cover. Bake for 20 minutes. Meanwhile, warm tortillas and water chestnuts over medium high heat in 10 inch nonstick skillet 30 seconds or until beginning to crisp. Divide meat among the tortillas and serve.

title: Pasta With Ham and Spinach
ingredients: 2 tablespoons oil | 1 1/2 lbs sweet ham or 1 1/2 lbs prosciutto, cut into 1/2 inch slices ( 4 1/2 inch squares ) | 1 medium onion, chopped | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried onion flakes | 2 cups fresh baby spinach leaves, washed ( i use baby bok choy, stems removed ) | 1/4 cup thawed baby spinach leaves
instructions: In large nonstick skillet, heat oil over medium high heat. Add ham and cook, stirring occasionally, until lightly browned and crisp, about 4 minutes. Add onion flakes and cook briefly. Remove ham from skillet and set aside. In the same skillet, heat remaining oil. Add spinach and cook, stirring often, until it swells, about 2 minutes. Stir spinach and spinach into fat in skillet and cook until spinach is heated through and spinach is hot, about 5 minute.

title: Cocoa Mix
ingredients: 1 cup parmesan cheese, grated | 1/2 cup dried basil leaves | 2 tablespoons dried crushed red chilies | 2 teaspoons poultry seasoning
instructions: Mix all together, stirring regularly. Apply to roasted or fried chicken, fish or vegetables. Note, this can be made up to 4 hours in advance and kept covered.

title: Easy Vegetable Tetrazzini Recipe
ingredients: 1 can spaghetti sauce ( or spaghetti sauce of your choice ) | 1/2 cup grated parmesan cheese | roasted unsalted plantains or 1/2 cup sliced black pecan, if desired ( 4 ) | broccoli, if using | sliced blanched fresh coconut ( optional ) | nutty sprinkles ( optional )
instructions: Heat a large saucepan of water to boiling. Mix the grated cheese and minced plantains together in a bowl. Drain the spaghetti sauce and add to the cheese with the remaining items and mix them well. If the pasta is dry and runny, add a small amount of water. Add macaroni and toss. Remove from heat and serve.

title: Quinoa and Roasted Veggie Crumble
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa | 1 1/4 cups pinto beans ( a mix of white ) and black-eyed peas, rinsed and drained ( a mix of black ) | 1 bulb of garlic, roasted | 4 eggsplants ( a mix of both ) or 4 plum tomatoes ( a mix of both ) | 1 small courgette or 1 small zucchini, sliced ( a mix of both ) | 2 cups fresh raspberries | 1 eggplant | 2 teaspoons white flour
instructions: Preheat the oven to 220°c / 425°f / gas mark boil the quinoa, beans and garlic for 15 minutes until almost tender. Remove the garlic and mash the garlic together with 1/4 cup of water and set aside to cool. Scatter the roasted vegetables on a large, shallow ovenproof dish. Douse with the cooled quinoa mixture and stir to combine. Scatter over the eggsplants on the top with courgettes and raspberries. Cover with foil and bake for 15 minutes, remove from the oven and set aside for a few minutes to crisp up the eggs. Slice and serve in slices.

Random Ingredients: garlic salt,sage,mint sprig,egg white,monterey jack pepper cheese,lime zest,yukon gold potato,cocoa powder
title: Potato, Chile and Pepper Jack Cheese Muffins
ingredients: 3 medium yukon gold potatoes, cut into 1/4 slices | 1 1/3 teaspoons minced lime zest | 1/3 cup coarsely shredded monterey jack pepper cheese | 2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder, divided | 1/2 teaspoon dried mint sprigs | 1/2 teaspoon dried sage | 1 large egg white, lightly beaten | 1/4 teaspoon garlic salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line 12 muffin cups with paper liners. In a 5 quart mixing bowl, toss potatoes with lime peel and 1/4 cup the cheese.

Random Ingredients: hamburger,kernel corn,pecan,green apple,mustard powder,liquid honey,rice vinegar
title: Hot German Style  - Nacho Dip
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger | 32 ounces sweet whole kernel corn, do not drain from cob | 1 green apple, chopped | 3/4 cup chopped pecans, lightly toasted | 1 tablespoon mustard powder | 2 tablespoons rice vinegar | 1/4 cup liquid honey
instructions: Brown hamburger. Drain. Add, drained corn, green apple, pecans, mustard, etc. Topping, sugar maple syrup and honey.

title: Guilt-Free Beef and Asparagus With Dates
ingredients: 2 lbs beef chuck, cut into 1/2-inch slices | 1/2 cup apple juice | 3/4 cup diced yellow onion | 1/2 cup chopped raw dates, pitted and chopped | 1 tablespoon fresh ground cardamom | 1 small aubergine peeled and diced small | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh asparagus, ends trimmed | guacamole
instructions: Combine apple juice, onion, dates, cardamon, and asparagus in crockpot. Pour meat over mixture. Cover.

title: Piggy (Malaysian Pork Salad)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons galanga root, peeled and sliced ( about 1 cup ) | 2 tablespoons freshly grated lemon rind, divided ( or lime rind ) | 1/2 teaspoon caraway seed, ground | 2 1/2 - 3 lbs pork tenderloin, trimmed of fat and cut into 1 1/2-inch cubes ( about 1.5 lbs ) | lettuce leaf | pistachios, slivers ( optional ) or peanuts, lightly toasted ( optional )
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine the ginger and lemon zest. Toss the ginger and lemon zest with the caraway for 1 minute. Add pork and toss to coat. Set aside. Cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour or as long as overnight. Cook pork over medium high heat until browned. Remove from heat.

title: Baked Okra, Sweet Oranise and Barley Spread
ingredients: 1 package philadelphia cream cheese, at room temperature | 2 packages frozen whole okra, thawed | 1 tablespoon anise seed | 1 cup pearl barley
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Split cream cheese in half and place in a bowl with barley. With an electric mixer, beat cheese until lightly browned. Stir in 1/2 of the chopped okra. Spread evenly over cream cheese mixture. Sprinkle with aniseed and remaining okra. Transfer to a lightly greased 9x13 inch baking dish and cover with aluminum foil. Bake 35 to 40 minutes, until light golden brown. Serve at once or refrigerate to keep smooth.

Random Ingredients: barley,garbanzo bean,mushroom,phyllo pastry,ginger juice,rice vinegar,stock,natural yoghurt
title: Quick & Easy Baklava & Chickpea Samosas
ingredients: 12 sheets phyllo pastry ( thawed if frozen, thawed if frozen ) | 2 cups cooked garbanzo beans or 2 cups canned chickpeas | 1 cup mushroom, sliced | 1 tablespoon ginger juice | 1/4 cup natural yoghurt | 1/2 cup rice vinegar | 2 teaspoons stock | 2 teaspoons fresh ginger juice, to taste
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Tear off four sheets of phyllo dough and roll to 8 x 9. Place on a lightly greased baking sheet. Brush with butter and bake in a preheated oven at 400°f for 10 - 12 minutes.

Random Ingredients: plain yogurt,new mexico chile powder,allspice,salmon fillet,tomato sauce,cheddar cheese,red curry paste,french bread
title: Spiced Salmon Steak
ingredients: 2 cups plain yogurt, divided | 4 teaspoons red curry paste | 14 ounces tomato sauce | 1 1/2 lbs boneless skinless salmon fillets | 1/2 teaspoon ground allspice | 1/4 teaspoon old bay seasoning ( or other mild curry powder ) | 4 slices french bread ( or other thin bread ) | 1 cup fresh shredded cheddar cheese
instructions: In a large shallow dish, mix 1 cup yogurt with 1 teaspoons curry paste. Rinse salmon under cold water.

title: Pebbles
ingredients: 5 tablespoons fennel seeds, crushed | 1/4 cup barbecue sauce | 1 tablespoon fennel seed, crushed
instructions: Mix the fennel seeds with the barbecue sauce. Spread the mixture on and around the barbeque cubes and grill.

title: Cod Fritters #5FIX
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs cleaned cod, cut into 4 pieces ( may use frozen or fresh cut or fresh cut fish ) | 3 -6 slices of thick cut bacon bits | 1/4 cup hot sauce ( optional )
instructions: Place cailors in pot with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer uncovered for 20 minutes or until fish is very tender. You can drain water, if needed. Cut cod into 4 pieces to make 4 servings. Wrap fish in bundles of 4 pieces, 1 piece of bacon may be added to each, if desired.

Random Ingredients: spaghetti sauce,cream tartar,merlot,chocolate,red chili powder,bamboo shoot
title: Green Sauce
ingredients: 1 can spaghetti sauce | 1 can bamboo shoots, sliced and drained | 1 teaspoon ground red chili powder | 1 tablespoon sour cream or 1 tablespoon cream of tartar | 1 tablespoon grated chocolate | 1/8 teaspoon prepared red chili powder | 1 jar merlot, chilled
instructions: Blend all ingredients together. Transfer to a glass bowl, or jar and refrigerate several hours. Serve with any grilled seafood, meat, or poultry.

title: Lamb and Polenta Wrapped in Yoghurt
ingredients: 400 g leg of lamb | 200 g polenta | 140 ml sweet chili sauce | fresh edible flowers
instructions: Preheat oven to 220 degrees centigrade. Cut the leg of lamb into small strips and then use a knife to cut across the grain of the meat about 5 mm thick. This should leave you with a sharp and even slice. Rinse the meat and put into oven for 15 minutes to rest for 15 minutes. Put the polenta in a colander and press with your fingers until it's really well coated. This may be a bit watery. Cut the polenta into 4 5cm lengths and place on a baking tray along with a drizzle of sweet chili sauce. Put into the oven and when it's cooked, the lamb will still be quite moist in places. Check after 15 minutes and take it out with a slotted spoon. Leave to stand for further 10 minutes and then cut into slices. Serve with edible flowers.

Random Ingredients: lemon grass,vanilla pudding mix,cilantro root,cumin powder,sumac
title: Vegetable Curry Powder
ingredients: 1 quart fresh cilantro roots, peeled, washed and trimmed | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 4 -6 teaspoons dried lemon grass | 1 package vanilla pudding mix | 1 -2 teaspoon sumac ( or to taste )
instructions: Using a mortar and pestle, grind together the cilantro roots, cumin and lemon grass. Mix well with the other ingredients. Use to season puddings, or other vegetables to spice up salads. Great for curry fritters.

title: Carrots in Stock
ingredients: 4 carrots, with the larger ends of the carrots cut off the ends | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 375ml boiling water
instructions: Heat water in a pan with a lid on, add carrot to boiling water and let it boil for 5 - 10 minutes. Take out carrot and let cool slightly. Discard water and cut up the remaining carrots into 1 inch sized pieces and add to the pan with the salt. Let carrots cook for 15 - 30 minutes, until the carrots have fully softened and smell slightly of raw garlic. Stir regularly. Add chicken bouillon. Pour in 500ml boiling water stir well. Let the carrots cook for 10 minutes then put pan in the fridge. After five minutes add 1cm at a time of your favourite veg. Enjoy and have a glass with a glass of your favourite wine.

title: Linguine With Ham and Spicy Carrots on Caramelized Eggplant
ingredients: 1 medium hamburger or 1 medium prawn, cleaned but not peeled | 1 medium eggplant ( i use small one ) | 3 carrots ( i use about 2 cups ) | 1 package linguine, your choice ( not tubetti, or you will also substitute other pasta ), cooked | 1 teaspoon vinegar | 1 teaspoon coconut extract | 1/2 teaspoon chili, red | 1/2 cup baby eggplant, slices
instructions: Shell crab meat, and slice meat thinly if available. Brown hamburger in skillet with eggplant and carrots in a large skillet on medium high heat, stirring often till meat is no longer pink. While hamburger mixture is browning put your pasta in a large salad bowl. Add the browned meat, vinegar, coconut extract, and chili. Taste, and add more spices to taste. Put cooked linguini in salad bowl and toss lightly. Spoon meat sauce onto eggplant slices and top with some baby eggplant slices, also top with some spanish olives and a sprinkle of shredded cheese. If you use spanish olives, it makes for a pretty colorful dish. Enjoy.

title: Indian Spinach Prawns With Okra
ingredients: 1/2 lb okra, washed | 1/2 cup chopped spinach leaves | 2 tablespoons dates, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon cumin | 1/2 teaspoon liquid smoke
instructions: Wash okra and remove loose stems. Cut into bite size pieces. Add spinach leaves to okra, add date, liquid smoke and cumin. Leave to marinade for 30 minutes or to 3 hours. Cook over high, or medium heat until okra starts to crisp. Serve immediately.

title: Beef Cutlets
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef | 1 green onion, chopped | 6 teaspoons fine semolina | 3 teaspoons dried basil | 1 teaspoon ground green cardamom pods | 1/4 cup dried currant
instructions: Combine everything except flour in large bowl, mix well. Make cutlets about 1 1/2 inches thick. Cover and chill 2 hours or until firm.

title: Grilled Chile Poblano With Pineapple, Sage and Pecorino Cream Sauce
ingredients: 1 poblano chile, halved lengthwise | 2 tablespoons light cream | 2 tablespoons heavy cream | 1/8 teaspoon season-all salt | 1/8 teaspoon ground sage | 1/4 cup light pernod chile, with flesh
instructions: Set over a grill or grill pan set to high. To make the sauce, line a rimmed baking sheet with foil. Put poblano halves on foil and cut 4 slits across the top of the poblano, then place them directly under the hot grill. Turn frequently, or the skin will crackle and spit. Grill until poblano flesh is blackened and blistered, 3 to 5 minutes per side. Be careful, hot peppers don't throw away the heat. Move the poblanos to a baking sheet and drizzle with 1 tablespoon cream on each one. Wrap foil around poblanos, place in oven and heat to 400°f remove foil and poblanos from oven and cool the poblanos at least 15 minutes. Place the remaining cream and the cream in a saucepan and bring to a boil over medium high heat. Reduce heat to medium, season with salt, and stir in the sage and process 5 to 10 seconds. Strain the liquid into a small dish and reheat. Pour the sauce over the poblanos and garnish with the pecan halves, if using, and serve. The cream sauce can be reheated in the microwave wrapped in foil, in a saucepan over low heat until slightly thickened.

title: Fresh Raspberry Tres Leches Soup
ingredients: 5 cups fresh raspberries | 3 cups low sodium chicken broth or 3 cups vegetable broth | 1/8 teaspoon saffron | 1/4 teaspoon dried savory | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves
instructions: Place raspberries on a medium to large baking sheet. Add broth and saffron to taste. Roast until berries become slightly shriveled and reduce liquid slightly. Then add savory and oregano and continue to simmer. Remove from heat. Ladle into serving bowls. Serve with fresh bread, diced raw onion, diced avocado, and/or corn tortilla chips on the side.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack cheese,gorgonzola,trout,grand marnier,sun tomato oil,salmon,bell pepper
title: Smoked Trout and Gorgonzola Sandwiches
ingredients: 4 cups hot smoked trout | 4 pieces smoked salmon | 4 pieces gorgonzola, slices ( chewy block is good for this type ) | 4 slices bell peppers | 2 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained of oil | 1/4 cup grand marnier | 3 tablespoons minced sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees and line a jelly roll pan with foil. Cut the tops off the smoked trout & fish & arrange on the foil lined pan. Cover with foil & bake for 15 minutes. Remove foil for last 10 minutes to crisp the gorgonzola. Remove trout from the oven & let cool slightly. Combine the gorgonzola/cheese sauce ingredients. Using a slotted spoon, carefully remove the tuna pieces from the foil & place the smoked salmon pieces on a plate lined with a clean dry towel to absorb excess moisture. Wipe the pan clean to return the tuna & place in the refrigerator. Heat the broiler. Line the bread or roll pan with your slices of cheese. Place the sliced smoked trout & grilled pieces of smoked salmon on top of the cheese. Cover the pan with the slices of chopped sun dried tomatoes and drizzle over the grand marnier. Serve immediately. Note, to make the grand marnier it takes only a few minutes and you can add a touch of saffron or maraschino acid and/or a few drops of lemon juice to the sauce. Note, if you prefer a thicker fish mixture, you can use up to 1/3 cup of the grand marnier or a mixture of 1/3 cup balsamic vinegar and 2/3 cup of white sugar.

title: Breadsticks With Vodka
ingredients: 1 1/4 teaspoons active dry yeast | 3 cups plain italian breadcrumbs | 2 cups finely chopped seeded jalapeno peppers | 1 bottle vodka
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together the yeast, bread crumbs and 1 cup water. Knead the dough on a floured surface for about 10 minutes, or until smooth. Place the dough into a greased bowl, cover with a towel, and set aside in a warm place to rise. When the dough is double and risen, divide it into 16 equal portions. Roll each piece into a 3 inch long log. Place the log pieces on a baking sheet, cover with a towel, and let rise for 30 minutes. Preheat the oven to 425 degrees f. Slice the log into 1/4 inch thick slices, and place on a baking sheet. Bake for 20 minutes in the preheated oven, or until the tops are lightly browned.

title: Spice Rub
ingredients: 1/2 cup allspice | 1/2 cup finely ground black pepper
instructions: Combine allspice.

Random Ingredients: celery,vegetable oil cooking spray,cold water,curry leaf
title: Soup Stock
ingredients: 1 1/2 liters cold water | 1 kg celery, thinly sliced | vegetable oil cooking spray | 2 -6 fresh curry leaves, sliced ( optional )
instructions: Make a stock of water that just covers the top of the celery leaves. Place celery and water in souppot over low heat. Simmer, covered, for 40 - 50 minutes, or until celery is tender but not mushy. Remove celery with slotted spoon and discard liquid. Spray souppot with vegetable oil cooking spray. Add curry leaves and cook for 10 - 15 minutes, stirring frequently. Remove souppot from heat and keep covered on stovetop.

Random Ingredients: english mustard,chili powder,vanilla,spaghetti sauce,superfine sugar,sugar orange marmalade,pastry pie crust
title: Super Easy Spaghetti Pie
ingredients: pastry for a 9 inch pie crust | 1 1/2 pounds spaghetti sauce blend | 1 1/2 cups superfine sugar-free orange marmalade | 1 1/2 tablespoons chili powder | 2 tablespoons prepared english-style mustard | 1 1/2 teaspoons vanilla | 1 tablespoon powdered sugar or slivered orange marmalade
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Unroll pastry on a baking sheet or in a pie pan, and refrigerate for at least 5 minutes. Roll out pastry on a lightly floured surface. Use a floured rolling pin to keep the dough chilled. Fit into a 9 inch pie plate or pie pan, and line the bottom with parchment paper. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Place the dough in the boiling water, and cook according to package directions for the pastry. Drain, refrigerate for 10 minutes, then roll out on a floured surface. Line pie pan with the pastry, and fill with sauce. Cover the pan with a tea towel, and bring the water to a boil. Set the lid on, and steam the pastry for 20 minutes. Remove the lid, and place on a baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until the pastry is golden. In a small bowl, combine the powdered sugar or slivered orange marmalade, chili powder, mustard and vanilla. Drizzle over the warm pastry. Allow the pie to cool at room temperature for 20 minutes, and then refrigerate for 2 hours, or until firm.

title: Crostini
ingredients: 1 jar corn | 1/2 lb gouda cheese, shredded | 1/2 lb gouda cheese, shredded | 1/4 lb gouda cheese, melted | 4 lbs eggplants, sliced
instructions: Mix all ingredients together except eggplants and heat in pan until boiling. Reduce heat and simmer for 2 hours covered. Spoon mixture into oven proof casserole. Top with eggplants. Bake at 400 for about 25 minutes to brown.

title: Italian Dumpling Soup W-Gorgonzola
ingredients: 16 wonton wrappers | 1 lb gorgonzola ( fresh or dried ) | 8 cups cooked cannellini beans | 4 chopped celery ribs | 4 chopped parsnips | salt & pepper | 3 -4 sliced button mushrooms
instructions: Start with the filling. First, prepare the dumpling wrappers by covering the wonton wrapper with dampened towel and rolling up and placing each wrapper on a baking sheet. Start by making the dumplings and placing on baking sheet, bake at 375 degrees for 10 - 12 minutes. Remove from the oven and set aside until cool enough to handle. Combine all ingredients except the wrappers in a large soup pot. Let this simmer for 10 minutes. Drop wrappers into the soup and simmer for 10 more minutes, they should resemble small pebbles in size. Garnish with additional drizzle of goat cheese at the table.

Random Ingredients: dark rum,chicken thigh,green capsicum,mace,brandy,mexican oregano,portabella mushroom
title: Island Portabella-Mushroom Chicken Skewers (Cookies-Light)
ingredients: 125 g dried portabella mushrooms ( or other small mushrooms such as chard or spinach, capsicum or black mushrooms ) | 1 green capsicum | 4 -6 chicken thighs | 2 -4 tablespoons brandy | 1 tablespoon mexican dark rum or 1 tablespoon rum-flavored brandy | 1 teaspoon mexican oregano, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace
instructions: For best results, make your soaked mushrooms from scratch. Soak mushrooms in a small amount of warm water for 15 minutes while making and washing other ingredients. Using a small frying pan, add the mushrooms and capsicum on a medium heat and cook for anther 2 minutes. Add brandy, rum or brandy and add oregano and mace. Turn down the heat to low, and allow to gently warm up a little. Slice chicken thighs into approximately 5 to 6 pieces. Place the chicken thighs on a foil lined tray and pour the brandy mixture and mushrooms on top. Allow to warm through and the mushrooms to sweat off naturally. Using a skewer, poke several holes into the chicken with a toothpick. Grill chicken for approximately 15 to 20 – 25 minutes, turning once, just enough to sear the chicken. Serve chicken skewers straight from the tray with a drizzle of the remaining pan juices from the mushrooms and capsicum mixture on top. Allow to rest for 5 minutes then serve topped off this with a mushroom dip or a thick slice of bread.

title: Japanese Vegetable and Soy sauce Side Item
ingredients: 1/2 lb japanese squash, sliced | 2 medium zucchini or 1 medium eggplant, sliced | 2 tablespoons light molasses | 1 tablespoon sake
instructions: Combine all ingredients, in a small saucepan and boil over medium heat for 10 minutes and serve. Store in an airtight container. Use the amount of soy sauce or salt required to season fried vegetables.

title: Baked Honey Danish Pastry
ingredients: 1 sheet puff pastry shell | 1/2 cup honey
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Roll out the puff pastry shell and cut into 1 inch squares. Place squares on an ungreased baking sheet. Bake for 10 to 15 minutes. Serve the hot danish.

Random Ingredients: orange peel,chinese cabbage,triple sec,coriander seed,penne,bay leaf,dark sesame oil
title: Penne With Vietnamese Cabbage
ingredients: 1 lb thin-cut chinese cabbage | 2 tablespoons coriander seeds | 4 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 1 bay leaf | 3 cups fresh chinese cabbage or 3 cups shredded napa cabbage, of your choice | 1/4 cup triple sec | 1 teaspoon dry orange peel
instructions: Scrub cabbage with a knife and cut into 2 to 3 inch long wedges. Using a mortar and pestle or a wood corer or strong kitchen mallet, crush coriander seeds with 2 tablespoons water. Heat sesame oil in very heavy bottomed 6 cup saucepan over medium high heat. Add bay leaf. Saute cabbage for about 2 minutes until golden brown. Add shredded cabbage and sesame oil and saute for an additional 2 - 3 minutes. Transfer to a bowl. Cover and set aside. Pour remaining 1/4 c oil off to drain cabbage. Combine the triple sec and remaining 8 cups cabbage in a large nonreactive bowl, season with salt and pepper to taste. Combine cabbage with remaining sauted cabbage and serve.

Random Ingredients: egg white,tortilla chip,tabasco sauce,chipotle chile adobo
title: Chipotle Nachos
ingredients: 1/4 cup fresh chipotle chile in adobo | 1/4 teaspoon tabasco sauce | 1 egg white | tortilla chips
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. In medium bowl, combine chiles, tabasco sauce and egg white. Using a pastry brush, coat chile mixture with egg white. Spray a 9 inch baking pan with cooking spray. Sprinkle with tortilla chips. Bake for about 12 minutes or until golden brown. Cool for 5 minutes. Cut into quarters and serve.

title: Al-Marnier Beef
ingredients: 1 lb of cubed lean roast beef or 1 lb roast beef | 1 cup watermelon ( cubed ) | 1/3 cup dark raisin | 4 green cardamoms ( cracked in a mortar from a mortar ) | 3/4 cup grand marnier
instructions: Marinate the roast or beef with the 1 cup of watermelon, raisins and 1/2 cup grand marnier for at least one hour. The watermelon will soften and flavor the beef. Preheat oven to 350°f. Remove meat from marinade. Place meat in a casserole dish.

title: Puff Balls
ingredients: 1 lb sliced fresh mushrooms ( not reconstituted! ) | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract ( optional, but recommended )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees. Place mushrooms in a bowl & mix with the vanilla. Put mixture in 9 x 9 x 1 1/2 inch greased pan. Bake in oven for 30 minutes, then turn the oven to broil, & broil until tops are golden brown. I like mine slightly darker so it can brown as well, but this isn't necessary, too.

title: Nigella's Special Stuffing
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cumin seed | 1 teaspoon marjoram | 1/4 teaspoon cumin seed | 2 cups golden raisins ( golden ) | 1/4 teaspoon dried basil
instructions: Grind the cumin, marjoram, cumin and a pinch of salt into a fine powder. Stir in raisins. Toss with warm water, coating all surfaces. Seal well. Taste for seasoning, adding remaining salt, or more cayenne if desired.

title: Quick and Easy Pizzas
ingredients: 4 pizza dough, split | 1/2 cup canned mushroom | 1/4 cup frozen peas | 1/4 cup commercial sweetened condensed milk or 1/4 cup evaporated milk | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon white pepper | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh cilantro ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400ºf. Split each pizza dough into two pieces. Roll out each piece to a 12 inch circle on a lightly floured surface. Using a 9 inch round cutter or pizza cutter, cut out circles to make the pizzas. Place 1 tablespoon of mushroom and peas inside of each round. Place 1/4 cup sweetened condensed milk in a shallow bowl. Place 1 teaspoon of white pepper on each round. Gently press the pepper into the mushroom mixture. Repeat with remaining rounds, using more milk, white pepper and mushrooms if desired. Place pizzas on a baking sheet and brush the tops of the pizzas with any remaining sweetened condensed milk mixture. Bake at 400ºf for 8 to 10 minutes, or until golden and bubbly.

title: Cranberry Indian Pumpkin Powder
ingredients: 1/4 cup cornstarch | 1 pound small white pumpkin
instructions: Stir the cornstarch into 1/4 cup cold water in a small bowl to make a paste. Cut a piece of peel from the pumpkin, removing the membrane as you cut with a sharp knife, about 1/4 inch wide. Cut the peel into 1/4 inch thick slices with scissors. Drop the pumpkin slices into the cornstarch mixture in a circular motion, coating thoroughly. Transfer the coated pumpkin pieces to a baking sheet, cover, and refrigerate for several hours. Preheat an oven to 400 degrees f. Once the pumpkin is cool enough to handle, remove and discard the pit. Cut pumpkin lengthwise into 1/8 thick rings, and arrange on a parchment lined baking sheet.
