Cover and bake in the preheated oven until golden brown, about 30 minutes. Set aside to cool completely. Once cool, place the pumpkin rings on a serving plate. Remove the parchment, drizzle with the coconut flavored extract, and serve.

title: Dump Cake
ingredients: 1 cup gluten flour | 1 cup pecans, finely chopped | 1 cup dried cranberries | 1 teaspoon oregano
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Bake for 40 - 45 minutes.

Random Ingredients: salt,chipotle powder,sherry,pea,beef stew meat,ranch salad dressing,boursin cheese
title: Santa Fe Beef Stew
ingredients: 4 1/2 pounds boneless beef stew meat | 2 ounces dried peas, rinsed | 1 pinch salt | 2 packages boursin cheese | 1 1/2 cups dry sherry | 1 1/2 tablespoons chopped chipotle powder | 1/4 cup ranch salad dressing
instructions: Place the meat on a cutting board and use your paring knife or tenderiser to pound it to flatten it and remove some of the fat. Sprinkle meat with salt. Bring a large pot of water to a boil. When it boils, add the peas and cook until they are tender. Drain. Reserve the cooking water. Cut the cheese in half horizontally from corner to corner, then cut crosswise into 1/2 inch slices, each slice slightly smaller than the others. Toss the slices and cheese with the drained peas, sherry, chipotle powder, and the ranch dressing until evenly coated. Cover and refrigerate for up to 2 days. The stew is best served the next day.

title: Guilt Free Banana Bread
ingredients: 2 bananas | 1/4 cup plain yogurt | 2 cups white flour | cheesecloth or kitchen twine | 1 teaspoon unbleached white flour
instructions: Peel the bananas and cut them in half. Then cut each half crosswise. Pre heat oven to 400f degrees. Put the flour into a large plastic bag. Slice the bananas lengthwise. Put one half of a banana half on the flour and use the other half to lightly dust the banana with flour. Slice the banana 1/2 to 3/4 times. Place the banana cut side down on top of one sheet of white flour, and repeat until all bananas are in and out of the bag. Put the bananas in a large bowl and cover with a cheese cloth or kitchen twine. Place in the oven and bake for 40 minutes or until golden brown. Let cool for five minutes before removing the twine.

title: Easy Chinese Restaurant Eggs
ingredients: 4 hard-cooked eggs, peeled | 2 tablespoons chicken giblets ( optional ) | 4 teaspoons spicy hot chili sauce ( i like kikkoman ) | 4 teaspoons liquid smoke ( optional )
instructions: Slice each hard cooked egg in half and discard the yolks. Cut all the yolks into quarters and place them in a small bowl. Add the rest of the ingredients to the yolks and stir to combine. Add the sliced egg halves and stir once more to combine. If you like, you can sprinkle some chopped up dried hot chili sauce on top.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon granule,cucumber,caster sugar,lemon extract,red chili pepper,limeade concentrate,taco seasoning
title: Crispy Cucumber Beef
ingredients: 1 small cucumber, peeled, seeded and thinly sliced | 1 teaspoon lemon extract | 1/2 teaspoon hot red chili pepper, finely sliced | 500 g minced corned beef or 500 g minced beef | 1 tablespoon taco seasoning ( i use ortega brand ) | 8 tablespoons limeade concentrate | 1 tablespoon beef bouillon granules
instructions: Place all ingredients except limeade concentrate. Stir to combine and pour over sliced cucumber. Cover and marinate in refrigerator for at least 30 minutes. Bake at 160 degrees celcius for 20 minutes or until onions are soft.

Random Ingredients: pineapple juice,black sesame seed,oregano leaf,green olive
title: Fantastic Pineapple Olive Tapenade
ingredients: 12 green olives | 1 canned crushed pineapple in juice | 1 tablespoon fresh oregano leaves ( or 2-3 tablespoons dried minced ) | 1 -2 tablespoon black sesame seed, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Add all ingredients to blender, blend thoroughly, strain & refrigerate if necessary.

title: Easy Easy Italian Seasoned Fondue
ingredients: 1 cup ice ( or mineral water ) | 10 sprigs fresh parsley leaves | 1 sprig fresh rosemary
instructions: Using an 8 ounce glass, empty 1 cup of ice in a jar or a large pitcher. Add 10 sprigs of parsley, 1 sprig of rosemary and 1 teaspoon of salt. Stir for a minute, then add the remaining 1 cup of ice. Shake vigorously to help dissolve the salt, then add 3 or 4 teaspoons of water. Stir for a final 20 to 30 seconds or just to heat through. Transfer the bottle of fondue to a container, seal and keep in the fridge. Use within 3 weeks.

Random Ingredients: chili paste,parsley,sherry,tomato soup,serrano pepper,vegetable shortening,sugar cube,black salt
title: Sopa De Ajo (Sopa De Tomate Y Queso)
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 lbs ripe tomatoes ( peeled, seeded, and diced ) | 1/2 cup dry sherry ( spanish vermouth would work, too ) | 1 tablespoon sugar cube | 1 tablespoon vegetable shortening | 1 chili paste ( like tabasco ) | 1/4 cup parsley | 1/4 teaspoon red chili paste ( like tabasco ) | 1 bunch fresh parsley | 1 1/2 teaspoons salt
instructions: Combine all ingredients in blender and blend just until well combined. Cover with plastic wrap in a bowl and marinate in refrigerator, about 1 hour or overnight. Strain mixture through a fine mesh sieve into a pan, discarding solids, and bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer 20 minutes, uncovered. Remove from heat. Stir in remaining ingredients and divide among 6 bowls to serve.

Random Ingredients: peanut butter,dark sesame oil,black peppercorn,purpose flour,cold water,pearl barley
title: Korean Barley Cookies With Peanut and Black Pepper
ingredients: 4 cups pearl barley | 2 cups cold water | 2 tablespoons peanut butter | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 1 tablespoon all-purpose flour | 1 pinch ground black peppercorns
instructions: Bring the 2 cups water to a boil in a large saucepan and stir in the barley. Reduce heat to low and simmer until rice is just tender, about 20 minutes. Drain, transfer the barley to a bowl and cover with cold water. Let stand until liquid is absorbed, about 10 minutes. Rinse the barley under cold water until cool. Remove and discard the cloudy water. Cover with a cloth and set aside for 20 minutes. Dry the peanut butter in the top of a double boiler over medium heat until melted and beginning to darken, about 3 minutes. Remove from the heat and stir in the sesame oil. Mix in the flour and black pepper and mix well. Set aside to cool. Preheat the oven to 300 degrees f. On waxed paper, pat 2 tablespoons of the barley batter into the bottom of each of the 12 indentations in the barley mixture. Dip your fingers into the flour and spread the peanut butter mixture evenly over the barley batter. Use a large baking stone or sharp knife to cut off pieces of barley with a sharp knife to make diamond shapes. Arrange them in the muffin tins. Bake the cookies until the tops and bottoms are dry with a light brown, about 30 minutes. Remove and cool on a wire rack.

title: Aguado De Chili - the Real Thing!
ingredients: 1 tablespoon chili oil | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1 tablespoon hot chili oil
instructions: Make the chilie in a coffee mug or heavy mug. Stir one teaspoon of vanilla into one teaspoon of chile oil. Pour the other teaspoon of vanilla onto top of one teaspoon of chile oil. Serve with warm cookies. Variation, use fresh or hot chili oil, or add cumin, cinnamon or cardamon.

Random Ingredients: balsamic vinegar,chicken thigh,vanilla,salt pepper,marjoram,hot green chili pepper,sesame oil,kale
title: Balsamic and Mustard Chicken
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs boneless chicken thighs | 4 -6 cups kale, stems and leaves chopped fine | 5 -6 hot green chili peppers | 3 tablespoons sesame oil | 1/2 cup balsamic vinegar | 1/4 cup marjoram | 1/2 teaspoon salt and pepper | 3 teaspoons vanilla
instructions: Heat sesame oil and saute green chili peppers until just beginning to brown. In a large bowl put chicken thighs, hot peppers and kale. Sprinkle with salt, pepper, sugar, vinegar and marjoram. Mix gently. Cover, cook at 325°f for 1 hour and 30 minutes stirring a few times. Serve.

Random Ingredients: sesame oil,pico de gallo,raisin,nonfat milk,dill seed,potato flour,picante sauce,grain rice
title: Rice & Potato Pancakes (Mexican)
ingredients: 6 cups nonfat milk | 4 medium potatoes, peeled and thinly sliced | 4 tablespoons sesame oil | 1/4 cup whole grain rice, plain-style ( or other short grain rice such as jasmine ) | 1/2 cup raisins ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon dill seed ( optional ) | 1/2 cup picante sauce ( mexican-style salsa ) | 1 tablespoon pico de gallo
instructions: Put 1 1/2 3 cups of the milk in a large saucepan of boiling water and cook over medium heat, uncovered, stirring occasionally, for 5 - 10 mins, or until just thickened slightly. Meanwhile, cook the potatoes in an 8 inch nonstick skillet over medium heat for about 10 - 15 mins, stirring, until very tender. Cut into thin slices. Heat the 1 1/2 tbsp. Of sesame oil in skillet and cook the potato until golden brown in spots and crisp, 3 - 5 mins on each side. Put in a bowl and set aside. In a separate skillet or wok, heat the remaining 1/4 tbsp. Of sesame oil over medium heat and add the rice. Toast, stirring constantly, until it turns pale golden, about 1 minute. Add the raisins and dill seeds and cook, stirring until warm, about 2 mins longer. Add the rice mixture, stirring to coat with the sesame oil. Return to a boil, then put off the heat. Heat a griddle or cooking oil until very hot or using tongs transfer 2 pancakes in half to make 4 thin cakes. Cook until they are golden and crispy on the bottom. Turn and repeat. Drain on absorbent paper. Spread the 2nd pancake on a warm serving plate, then top with the remaining pancakes. Serve with the picante.

title: Raspberry Macaroni & Berry Noodles
ingredients: 8 ounces macaroni noodles | 2 1/4 cups frozen raspberries
instructions: Cook macaroni according to package instructions. Meanwhile place frozen raspberries in a pot of water and bring to a boil. Continue boiling for 2 - 3 minutes or until thawed. Drain raspberries and return raspberries to the pot. Stir in macaroni, raspberries and salt to taste. Continue to boil for 3 - 5 minutes or until noodles are heated through.

title: German Kale
ingredients: 24 leaves kale | 1/2 teaspoon onion powder | 2 1/2 teaspoons white pepper | 1 medium onion, chopped
instructions: Wash and remove stems of kale. Wrap together in 2 pieces of heavy duty aluminum foil. In a large skillet, or electric skillet, combine onion powder, onion and pepper.

Random Ingredients: skirt steak,berry,buttermilk baking mix,strawberry,peanut oil sesame,tamari,beef brisket,kernel corn
title: Beef With Strawberries and Corn
ingredients: 6 lbs skirt steaks | 6 ears fresh sweet corn | 1 bunch fresh strawberries | 2 cans whole kernel corn, drained | 1/2 cup buttermilk baking mix | 3 -4 tablespoons tamari | 1/2 cup peanuts or 1/2 cup sesame seeds | 2 tablespoons peanut oil or 2 tablespoons sesame oil
instructions: Place the steak in a large pan and add enough water to cover. Bring to the boil and skim off any scum. Reduce heat and simmer, uncovered for 30 minutes. Remove from the heat and strain and set aside as much water as you can, but be sure it doesn’t get too salty. Cut down the hard bottom of each ear of corn and clean carefully by carefully removing the husks. If you don’t have this, trim back the husk too. Place the steaks in a large pot and add cold water to cover. Bring to the boil and cover and simmer for 3 hours. Meanwhile, place the rest of the ingredients in a blender and blend until very smooth. Remove from the heat and allow to cool to room temperature. Remove steak and discard bones and any visible fat. Cut off the twigs and discard, and cut the steak across the grain about 1/2 thick. Place on skewers and brush with the olive oil. Prepare the bbq, heat oil on medium high until very hot. Place the steak in the oil and cook for 3 - 4 minutes on each side or until the outside turns dark brown. Place the steak on a wire rack and brush with olive oil and cook for 4 - 5 minutes. Grill over hot coals for 2 - 3 minutes on each side until cooked through. To serve, place in a s bowl and dress with a little sweet mustard and a little sour cream. Garnish with fresh strawberries, and drizzle with a little more sesame seeds.

Random Ingredients: beef broth,plain flour,extra tofu,roasting chicken,vanilla extract
title: Delicious Tofu Rissoles
ingredients: 8 ounces extra firm tofu, drained thoroughly and cut into 1/2 in. cubes | 5 fluid ounces low sodium beef broth ( low sodium ) | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract | 2 1/2 cups plain flour | 1 roasting chickens, cut up
instructions: Process 1/2 cup of the flour in a food processor until combined and finely chopped. Add tofu, beef broth and 1/2 t of the vanilla and process until mixture is combined but smooth. Shape dough into 4 evenly sized patties and chill in the refrigerator for 1 hour. To make rissoles, preheat the oven to 425 deg f. Place flour on a plate and dip each patty in the flour, then gently tap the patties on the counter and gently stretch the flour until it is completely covered. Place the patties on a tray and bake for 12 minute. Turn over and bake the patties for 1 - 3 minutes more. To make ro tel, place chicken pieces in a roasting tin and fill with water until it reaches 2 cm above the chicken. Bake in the oven for 45 min. Flip the patties and bake for another 15 min. Meanwhile. Turn oven to 400 deg f. Serve patties with the rissoles. Note, if the tofu is really soft, remove the pieces from the cooking tin and squeeze out excess liquid. If it is actually very firm, it will soften up by the time it is baked. If the tofu is really thick, add a little water, to thin it out a bit. This recipe goes really well with rice.

title: French Herb Seasoning
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dried dill sprigs | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried savory | 1 teaspoon poultry seasoning
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Use immediately as a seasoning for french foods.

title: Chinese Buffet
ingredients: 2 bunches bok choy, chopped | 2 jars picante sauce
instructions: Place bok choy and picante sauce in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: bell pepper,coconut milk,cooking onion,dark brown sugar,maraschino cherry,focaccia bread,cream cheese frosting
title: Coconut Nuts for Two
ingredients: 1 package cream cheese frosting | 8 ounces canned low sodium coconut milk | 1/4 cup white biancan quick-cooking onions ( such as vidalia ) | 1/3 cup chopped bell pepper ( green onion ) | 1/4 cup chopped maraschino cherry | 1/4 cup chopped dried focaccia bread, torn | 1/4 cup dark brown sugar, packed
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add the bread and cook until just toasted, about 3 minutes. Cut into 1 inch or smaller squares. Spoon 1/2 cup of cream cheese frosting over bread. Drain the coconut milk, reserving 1/4 cup of each, and add to cream cheese mixture in a medium saucepan. Place over moderate heat. Stirring constantly, cook and stir until heated through, about 2 minutes. Spread evenly, then sprinkle with the onions, peppers, and cherries. Spoon remaining cream cheese frosting over the top and sprinkle with brown sugar. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: head cabbage,virgin olive oil,cherry tomato,thyme sprig,turkey breast,swiss cheese
title: French Turkey Sandwiches (Low Fat or Both!)
ingredients: 2 turkey breast | 10 -12 ounces low fat swiss cheese | 1 tablespoon virgin olive oil | 1 tablespoon fresh thyme sprigs ( or 1 teaspoon dried ) | 1 small head of cabbage, rinsed and shredded ( about half of a small head ) | 1 pint large cherry tomatoes or 1 pint cherry tomatoes, halved
instructions: Slice the turkey into 1/4 inch thick slabs if possible then slice into 8 slices. Wrap half of a cheese slice with the thyme and roll up and fasten with toothpicks. Cut the turkey slices into thin slices. Heat the olive oil in a large nonstick frying pan. Fry the turkey rolls until browned and cooked through, about 5 - 10 minutes. Arrange on a warm serving platter. Spoon on the mustard greens, tomatoes, and crudites and serve.

title: Indian Shrimp Fry
ingredients: 1 lb raw shrimp, unpeeled, deveined, and cleaned | 2 cups frozen peas | 1 1 tablespoon garam masala | 1 teaspoon powdered nutmeg | 2 teaspoons sugar | 3 teaspoons brown rice | 1/2 teaspoon jumbo shrimp ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Microwave on high for 1 minute, stirring 3 times to prevent burning. Serve warm with warm naan bread.

Random Ingredients: chive,epazote,margarine,flour,bulk hot italian sausage,lard,almond meal,phyllo pastry
title: Hungarian Style Bika (Skillet Bread)
ingredients: 100 g ground almonds meal | 200 g lard ( or substitute with butter, clarified butter and olive oil ) | 100 g margarine | 20 epazote | 12 sheets phyllo pastry ( or just use one sheet per recipe ) | 2 -3 tablespoons flour ( use flour if needed ) | 8 -10 tablespoons chopped chives ( or more ) | 1 lb bulk hot italian sausage
instructions: In a medium sized pot melt the margarine and the clarified butter over medium heat. When it's melted add the almond meal and mix well. Add in the cooked chlies. Add the hot meats and mix well until cooked through. In a clean bowl, mix the almond meal and chives well. If it seems dry add a little more flour. In a large frying pan, grease with lard and then lightly film with a thin film of oil that just covers the entire pan. Once the pan is hot enough, add the pastry and let each piece smoke until puffed and golden. Flip one sheet over and continue to do the same on the other. Add more oil if needed. Lay the bika on clean buttered paper towel, or a piece of wax paper that has been on the counter with the edges touching each other on the sides. This will help seal the dough. Let the bika cool before adding more oil or margarine next. Once it is room temperature spread out one sheet of dough. On the dough, cover all of the dough with the almond meal and chives/meat mixture. Fold the pastry in half and then roll out to make it as long as possible. Place on a lightly greased baking tray lined with parchment paper or foil making sure the paper doesn't overlap the bika. Repeat steps 5 - 6 until all bika are used. Place in the oven at 180 degrees centigrade for 30 minutes. Turn off the oven and leave the bika in there for another 20 - 25 minutes. Remove from oven and cool off the tray on its side. Repeat the wrapping process while the bika is still warm to help remove excess butter and moisture.

title: Homemade Teriyaki Sauce Base Base
ingredients: 4 cups tamari | 2 teaspoons juniper berries, crushed
instructions: Combine ingredients in an airtight container and store in a cool dark place.

Random Ingredients: cayenne,bamboo shoot,garlic clove,almond extract,garlic powder,mexican cheese,garlic
title: Shredded Mexican Cheese Balls
ingredients: 2 cans bamboo shoots, drained and sliced | 1/3 cup mexican blend cheese, shredded | 1/8 teaspoon garlic powder | 1/8 teaspoon garlic powder | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne | 1/8 teaspoon almond extract | 1/8 teaspoon salt
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large nonstick skillet. Cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally until cheese is melted, about 5 minutes. Roll into balls and serve warm.

Random Ingredients: lamb stock,curry powder,picante sauce,pearl barley,provolone cheese,feta cheese
title: Barley Lamb
ingredients: 2 lbs lamb bones or 2 lbs lamb shins, cleaned | 1 jar of picante sauce | 1 cup frozen pearl barley | 2 teaspoons curry powder | 1 cup feta cheese | 2 1/2 cups provolone cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Cut lamb into 2 inch cubes. Place in a large oven proof casserole or roasting pan. Add a bit of water, close with lid and bake for one hour or until liquid comes to a boil. Reduce the oven temperature to 300f and stir the barley into the hot lamb. Cover the casserole with foil. Bake for 2 1/2 hours, stirring occasionally. Remove foil, add the curry powder, and bake for another hour. Sprinkle with feta and bake uncovered for another hour. Remove the casserole from the oven and stir. Serve on it's own. If making for a party, let guests scatter the goat's cheese on top and place in a large bowl as a garnish.

Random Ingredients: beef chuck,horseradish sauce,pineapple chunk,veal,tomato juice,rump roast,lemon peel
title: Beef Carnita
ingredients: 1/2 lb lean ground veal | 1/2 lb lean beef chuck, cut into 1-inch cubes | 3 cans tomato juice, divided | 1 tablespoon grated lemon peel | 2 teaspoons prepared horseradish sauce | 1 can pineapple chunks ( reserve juice ) | 2 -3 lbs rump roast
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f. In shallow dish, stir together veal, beef, 1/2 of tomato juice, lemon peel, horseradish and remaining tomato juice. Place beef mixture in large roasting pan.

Random Ingredients: tomato soup,butter,garam masala,duck breast,chunky peanut butter,pumpkin puree,almond flavoring,peanut butter
title: Indian Chicken
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless duck breasts | 1/2 cup smooth peanut butter | 2 tablespoons butter | 1/4 cup chunky peanut butter | 1 can condensed tomato soup | 1/4 cup unsalted sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained | 2 teaspoons garam masala | 1/4 teaspoon almond flavoring
instructions: Heat oven 350 f. Place chicken in a 13x9x2 inch baking dish coated with cooking spray. Combine peanut butter, butter, peanut butter, tomato soup, sun dried tomatoes, garam masala and almond flavoring. Mix well. Spoon over the chicken. Tuck wings and thighs under. Bake 25 minutes. Bake 10 minutes longer.

Random Ingredients: french bread,head iceberg lettuce,meat,wine vinegar,swiss cheese,hamburger,pita bread,rice vinegar
title: Chef Scott's Hearty Beef Club Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 large head iceberg lettuce, washed, dried, and torn into bite sizes | 1/2 cup seasoned rice vinegar | 1/3 cup wine vinegar | 1 slice french bread, toasted | 1 cup diced cooked lean hamburger | 1 1/4 cups shredded swiss cheese | 1 1/2 cups leftover cooked beef ( from cooked lean ground beef ) | 1 pita bread, cut into 4 slices
instructions: In medium bowl, mix rice vinegar, seasoned rice vinegar, french bread slices, hamburger and cheese. Spoon evenly over top of toasted slice of toasted side of pita.

Random Ingredients: self rising flour,pepper,chipotle chile,corn tortilla chip,cheese tortellini,mozzarella cheese
title: Cheese and Pepper Enchiladas
ingredients: 12 ounces cheese tortellini, dry | 1/2 cup self-rising flour, plus extra for coating | 2 ounces chipotle chiles, from can | pepper, to taste | 2 1/2 cups shredded mozzarella cheese | 12 corn tortilla chips
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Line a 9x13 inch baking dish with a lightly greased aluminum foil, leaving a couple of inch overhang so they don't burn while baking. Bring a large pot of water to a boil, and cook the tortellini until soft, about 10 minutes. Drain and set aside. Place a small amount of oil in a large nonstick skillet and cook the tortellini until crisp, about 3 minutes.

Random Ingredients: curry powder,bicarbonate soda,black pepper,baguette,icing sugar,maple syrup
title: Roasted Garlic Syrup Crunch (Bread & Butter Croquettes)
ingredients: 125 g icing sugar | 250 g plain breadcrumbs | 125 g curry powder | 1 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 1 teaspoon ground black pepper | maple syrup
instructions: Preheat the oven to 220°c/425°f. Put the icing sugar in a bowl & mix with the bread crumbs.

Random Ingredients: picante sauce,cranberry,manicotti pasta,cauliflower floret,hazelnut,peanut,grain white rice,cooking spray
title: Napa Dave’s Sweet N' Spicy Rice and Cranberry Manicotti
ingredients: 14 ounces manicotti pasta | 2 cups uncooked long grain white rice, divided | cooking spray | 1 jar picante sauce | 1/2 cup chopped hazelnuts | 1 package small cauliflower florets, coarsely chopped | 2 cups dried cranberries | 1 cup chopped salted peanuts
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add the pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

title: Lentil and Bok Choy
ingredients: 2 cups brown lentils | 2 bunches bok choy | 1 star anise | 1 head chinese cabbage ( about 5 pounds ) or 10 medium cabbage | 1/2 cup chopped salted peanuts
instructions: Place lentils in saucepan, add enough water to cover. Bring to boil, reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes. While lentils boil, trim stems and cut bok choy stalk diagonally into 3 inch pieces. Slice cabbage crosswise into thin wedges. Wilt leaves gently in hot water until softened, about 3 minutes. When lentils have absorbed water, place in large bowl with bok choy. Place star anise on top. Add peanuts, cover and let sit for 10 minutes. Add cabbage, cover and let sit 5 minutes or longer. To let lemongrass and peanuts combine, gently squeeze the lemongrass and peanuts together with lentils. Note, if lentils are to sour, taste and balance, as lemongrass is bitter, add more water.

title: Pork Chilaquiles
ingredients: 4 cups shredded lean pork ( not extra lean ) | 6 tablespoons salsa | 3/4 cup of fresh mint, chopped ( about 2 small heads, chopped, or 10 -12 leaves ) | saltine crackers, crushed | 4 sheets phyllo dough
instructions: Mix pork, 3 tbsp salsa, mint and cracker crumbs in a bowl. Line a baking sheet with waxed paper or foil. Place 2 sheets of phyllo in a row on top of the waxed paper forming a square sheet. Brush the sheet with remaining 2 tbsp salsa and top with 4 sheets of phyllo. Place one final sheet of phyllo on top. Cut each stack with a sharp knife into 5 strips. Place strips in center of the phyllo strips leaving 4 strips of phyllo in the centre. Fold phyllo strips to meet in the centre and tightly roll and cut. Repeat with remaining strips. The finished chilaquiles should have a long, tapered edge and should be folded over the strips in a diamond pattern. Cut remaining strips into 10 squares or diamonds. Arrange on a platter and serve with remaining salsa and crumbled chips.

Random Ingredients: cream cottage cheese,vegetable juice,green coriander,chocolate chip,salad green
title: Vegetable Colcannon
ingredients: 6 ounces mixed salad greens, washed | 2 tablespoons salad greens | 10 -12 ounces reduced fat cream-style cottage cheese | vegetable juice | 2 ounces salted chocolate chips ( optional ) or 2 ounces dark chocolate chips, coarsely grated ( optional )
instructions: Combine salad greens, 1 tbsp of the dressing and cottage cheese in a large bowl. Pour in enough vegetable juice to cover the greens in 2 1/2 3/4 cup increments, tossing well. Pour into another bowl and add other tbsp of dressing and chopped chocolate. Top with remaining 1 tbsp dressing and grated chocolate if desired. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: red wine vinegar,oregano leaf,vanilla wafer,lemon juice zest,cornstarch
title: Greek Restaurant Red Wine Jelly
ingredients: 7/8 cup red wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons cornstarch | 1 lemon, juice and zest of | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 24 vanilla wafers
instructions: In a small saucepan, combine the vinegar, cornstarch and lemon rind.

Random Ingredients: potato traditional,mix,sherry wine,broccoli floret,anaheim chilies,tart green apple
title: Green Apple Chutney
ingredients: 2 -4 large fresh tart green apples, such as granny smith | 1 large fresh anaheim chilies or 1 large dry red chilies | 1/2 cup sweet potato traditional chutney | 2 1/2 cups broccoli florets, steamed until tender and finely chopped | 1/2 cup prepared sweet-and-sour mix | 1/4 cup dry sherry wine
instructions: Preheat the oven to 275 degrees f. Core the apples, slice each lengthwise and then into half inch thick slices. Place them in a bowl with a tight fitting lid and pour boiling water over them to soften. When the apples are soft, drain the water, remove the stems and seeds, and tear the apples into bite size chunks with your hands. Pour the salsa in a medium saucepan. Place the pan over medium heat and add the chilies. Stir frequently and cook just until the chilies soften, then, a little at a time, add the apple mixture to the skillet. Turn the heat to low. Add the sweet potato traditional chutney. Stir the mixture well. Add about 1 1/3 cups of the broccoli, the sherry, and the remaining broccoli. Stir well. Transfer the mixture to a shallow baking dish. Bake at 275 degrees f for 1 hour, stirring often, until thickened.

Random Ingredients: sun tomato,peanut butter,pork loin chop,vanilla bean,white vinegar,italian dressing,creme de cassis
title: Creme De Cassis With Sun Dried Tomato and Pork
ingredients: 2 pork loin chops | 1/4 cup italian dressing, i use kraft | 1 teaspoon white vinegar | 2 tablespoons creme de cassis | 2 tablespoons crunchy peanut butter | 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato ( roughly chopped ) | 6 sun-dried tomatoes ( roughly chopped )
instructions: Dry pork chops on both sides. Combine italian dressing, vinegar, creme de cassis, peanut butter, sun dried tomatoes and chopped italian sun dried tomatoes. Pour over pork and marinate at least 8 hours in the fridge, turning often. Remove pork from marinade, reserving marinade. Grill pork on medium high grill, brushing with reserved marinade till tender.

Random Ingredients: kale,dark brown sugar,red chilies,red chili pepper,red chili powder,chili paste,chili oil
title: Green Mango Burger
ingredients: 1 cup green mango, chopped ( about 1 large ) | 1 red chilies, chopped | 2 1/2 teaspoons red chili powder | 1 teaspoon dark brown sugar | 1 teaspoon hot chili oil | 1 teaspoon red chili pepper, crushed | 2 teaspoons dried red chili pepper | 1/2 teaspoon chili oil
instructions: Place all of the mango ingredients in a large bowl, and mix well. Heat the chile, red chili and both of the chili oil in a non stick frying pan.. When the oil is hot, add the red chili, red chili and dried red chili. Saute briefly, then mix in the mango mixture. Add just enough water to loosen the mixture. Cover and cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, for about 7 minutes or until the mixture is thick. This should take about 8 minutes before removing from heat. Serve hot with your favourite burger and pickles.

title: Olive Garden Fettuccine With Gorgonzola and Dill
ingredients: 12 ounces dried fettuccine ( or fettuccine of your choice ) | 2 tablespoons olive oil flavored cooking spray | 2 tablespoons cider vinegar | 1/4 cup gorgonzola, crumbled | 1/4 cup fresh dill, thinly sliced
instructions: Cook fettuccine according to package directions, omitting salt, fat and water. Drain. Set sauce aside. While pasta is cooking, prepare grill. Lightly coat a skillet with cooking spray.

Random Ingredients: sugar snap pea,fine breadcrumb,green chile pepper,kosher salt
title: Stove Top Chile Sausages
ingredients: 1 lb fresh green chile pepper, seeded, chopped | 4 cups fine dry breadcrumbs | 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt | 3/4 lb sugar snap pea, trimmed and cut diagonally in half
instructions: Preheat the broiler. Place the chiles on a broiler pan and cook in preheated 400 oven until blackened in spots, turning and rearranging them as necessary, about 5 minutes. Transfer the chiles to a bowl and cover tightly with plastic wrap.

title: Pumpkin and Oyster Noodle Kugel
ingredients: 8 poblano chiles | 1/2 cup yummy's oyster cream ( or cream or half your cream ) | 3 tablespoons sweet liquid smoke | 1/2 cup cooked frozen egg noodles ( egg noodles can be substituted ) | 1 pinch vanilla essence | 1 poblano chile, grilled ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350f. In a non stick skillet, layer poblano peppers, oysters and liquid, breaking up clumps of oysters with the back of a spoon. Cover pan tightly and cook for 7 minutes. While skillet is heating, bring cream to a boil and add noodles. Cook, stirring frequently, for 3 - 5 minutes or until noodles are al dente. If there are any clumps, pour cream into a little bowl and stir a little, then return to pan. Taste, add vanilla and serve.

title: Focaccia Chips
ingredients: 1 package semi-sweet chocolate chips | 1 cup packed fresh basil
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place basil in a large glass baking dish. Melt semi sweet chocolate in a microwave safe bowl in the microwave. Stir in melted chocolate. Drop the basil leaves about 1 tablespoon onto the melted chocolate. Pour on a sheet of aluminum foil to prevent the chocolate from overheating or sticking. Allow to cool to room temperature. Break into small pieces and serve. Store in refrigerator for up to 3 days.

Random Ingredients: pistachio nut,scallion,chicken bouillon,artichoke heart,chicken broth,broccoli,curry leaf
title: Curried Broccoli with Pistachio Nuts
ingredients: 1 tablespoon curry leaf | 1 chicken bouillon | 1 tablespoon chicken broth | 1 bag frozen broccoli, thawed | 2 scallions, sliced | 1/2 cup sliced artichoke heart | 1 tablespoon pistachio nuts, chopped
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium heat. Remove and discard the stems from the broccoli.

Random Ingredients: lemon peel,penne pasta,monterey jack cheese,dark sesame oil,flour tortilla,philadelphia cream cheese,pea
title: Cheese Quesadillas
ingredients: 2 cups penne pasta ( pre-cooked weight depends on the pasta ) | 1 package philadelphia cream cheese ( about 4 ounces cream cheese ) | 1/2 cup shredded monterey jack cheese | 2 tablespoons lemon peel | 3 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 0.5 can peas, drained ( optional ) | 8 flour tortillas
instructions: Cook penne in boiling water for about 7 minutes, then drain and set aside. Reserve 1/2 cup of the pasta water. Meanwhile, heat the cream cheese to soften slightly. Add the rest of the ingredients, except the peas, and mix well. Add the peas during the last minute of cooking the pasta or the cream cheese will be too liquid. Meanwhile, place a tortilla in a small pan and warm a few seconds on each side before adding the cheese and the other tortilla. Flip it over and add the rest of the cheese and the peas. Repeat until all the ingredients are used up, ending with the cheese on top. Serve with any salsa or sour cream.

Random Ingredients: stone mustard,sesame seed,raspberry jam,chicken bouillon cube
title: Sesame Seed and Mustard Jam Jar
ingredients: 8 ounces stone ground mustard | 1 1/2 cups sesame seeds, toasted and cooled | 1 teaspoon instant chicken bouillon cube | 1 package raspberry jam
instructions: Prepare jars according to instructions on jar, shaking out any unclumped seeds.

title: Beef and Veal (Kao Tome) in Spicy Spicy Red Curry
ingredients: 2 tablespoons red curry paste | 2 lbs ground beef | 1 lb veal | 1 teaspoon baking powder
instructions: Combine ground meat and curry paste. Mix meat thoroughly by hand and let sit 5 minutes to marinate. Pour meat mixture into a colander and shake out excess moisture. Allow to drain completely, about 30 minutes. Return meat mixture to pot. Cover and simmer 1 hour, stirring occasionally. Add salt according to taste. I usually use 2 tablespoons of curry paste. If you prefer to do one, you can substitute one small can of anchovies for the veal for the red curry paste. If you prefer to leave out the curry powder, you can substitute 1/6 cup of curry paste with 1/2 cup of water and use this instead.

title: Roasted Parsnips
ingredients: 4 medium parsnips, peeled and quartered | 1 cup mango puree
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Combine the parsnips and mango puree in a roasting pan or baking dish. Cover and bake about 1 hour to 1 hour, or until tender.

Random Ingredients: corn oil,blackberry,mint sprig,tomato green chile pepper,chili oil
title: Spicy Blackberry Chili
ingredients: 7 ounces dried blackberries | 3 1/2 tablespoons corn oil, or more as needed, divided | 1/2 teaspoon chili oil | 3/4 cup canned diced tomatoes with green chile peppers, drained | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh mint sprigs, or more to taste ( optional ) | 1 pinch chili oil, or as needed ( optional )
instructions: Place blackberries in a bowl and cover with cold water.

title: Mexican Cheese Ball
ingredients: 1 pound cottage cheese | 1 jar diced pimiento | salt and ground black pepper to taste | 1/2 cup catsup | 1 jar guacamole
instructions: Blend cottage cheese, pimentos, salt, black pepper, catsup, and guacamole in a food processor until smooth.

Random Ingredients: kidney bean,butternut squash,baguette,rice wine vinegar,canola oil,spaghetti sauce
title: Squash & Beans Crostini
ingredients: 2 tablespoons canola oil | 1 butternut squash, halved and seeded, cut into 1 inch pieces | 1 baguette, sliced | 1 jar spaghetti sauce | 2 tablespoons rice wine vinegar | 2 cans kidney beans, drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 400º. Heat oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat. Place squash in the oil, cook 3 minutes or until tender. Place bread slices in the skillet and drizzle with 1 tablespoon oil. Arrange in a single layer on the bread. Top with 3/4 cup tomato sauce, remaining tomato sauce, rice wine vinegar and beans. Cover skillet and bake at 400º for 20 minutes or until bread absorbs the tomato sauce.

title: Orange Peel and Pork Barbecue
ingredients: 2 racks of lamb | 4 teaspoons dried orange peel | 1 teaspoon worcestershire sauce | 1 teaspoon dried garlic or 1 teaspoon garlic powder, to taste
instructions: Pre heat grill to medium heat. Slice racks diagonally 1/4 inch thick. Place rack of lamb on greased and slightly flattened flat grill tray, meat side down. Brush both sides with remaining ingredients. Grill for 20 - 25 minutes turning with tongs. The pork is done when it reaches an internal temperature of 140 degrees.

title: Bunuelos Con Chipotle
ingredients: 6 chicken legs, thighs, and drumsticks | 12 ounces toor dal | 4 cups unsalted butter lettuce | 1 medium shallot
instructions: Cover chicken legs with water, add salted water to cover and bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat and simmer about 1 hour. Remove from heat and drain, return chicken to pan and refrigerate for 1 hour. Cut each chicken portion into 4 pieces with poultry shears or better yet a sharp knife. Slice chicken legs into 1/4 inch thick pieces. Place dal in a saucepan, add enough water to cover the chicken, bring to a boil over high heat, reduce heat and simmer until chicken is tender but still slightly chewy. Shred or tear apart chicken.

Random Ingredients: beef stock cube,yellow squash,flour tortilla,dill,green mango,corn tortilla,baby spinach
title: Green Mango Soup
ingredients: 500 g green mangoes | 100 g yellow squash, chopped | 100 g baby spinach ( chopped in small pieces ) | 1 tablespoon dill, chopped | 1 beef stock cube | 10 flour tortillas | corn tortilla ( optional ) | 1 dash flour tortilla, extra ( optional )
instructions: Cut vegetables into chunks and place in large pot with stock cube. Boil til vegetables are tender but not mushy. Fry tortillas briefly to make them soft. Drain. In bowls place all of the above. Sprinkle with dill, extra flour, chopped mango or coriander. Add a dash of flour tortilla if desired, serve.

title: Black Eyed Peas - Oriental
ingredients: 1 cup dried black-eyed peas | 5 cups water | 2 tablespoons curry powder, divided | 1 teaspoon salt | 1 1/2 tablespoons rice wine or 1 1/2 tablespoons dry sherry | 1/2 teaspoon ground sage
instructions: Rinse and sort the black eyed peas. The water will have soaked up some before you go to make them. In a large bowl, mix the dry ingredients with enough water to cover. Let stand overnight, drain, and rinse if necessary. Bring the soaked water to a boil and add the peas. Return the water to a boil and cook until crisp tender, about 5 minutes. Drain on paper towels and reserve. Heat a large heavy frying pan over medium heat. Add the cooked peas and 2 tablespoons curry powder.

Random Ingredients: banana,garlic clove,dark sesame oil,red chili pepper,swiss cheese,vodka,celery seed
title: Carolina Swiss Cheese and Barbacoa Dip
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs swiss cheese | 1 tablespoon celery seed | 1 teaspoon garlic clove | 1 teaspoon crushed red chili pepper | 1/2 teaspoon dark sesame oil | 1/4 cup vodka | 1 medium banana, sliced thin
instructions: Cut cheese into 8 slices or smaller. Remove rind from garlic. In food processor melt sesame oil over moderate heat. Add onion garlic and red chili and continue to cook until onion is transparent. Add cheese slices to the skillet with the onion mixture and stir until melted and all of the cheese pieces are coated. Add the vodka and keep stirring until the mixture is creamy but not thick. Transfer to serving bowl and serve warm or chilled.

title: Pineapple Salad from Leftovers!
ingredients: 1 can pineapple chunks in juice | 6 tablespoons fresh parsley, chopped
instructions: Drain juice from can of pineapple and discard any fruit juices. Using a food processor or blender, add pineapple chunks, parsley, and salt, to taste.

Random Ingredients: coconut milk,chive,sourdough bread,bread,beef bouillon cube,cabbage,grain mustard
title: Danish Sourdough Soup
ingredients: 500 g cabbage, sliced | 250 ml coconut milk | 400 g sourdough bread, cubes | 4 beef bouillon cubes | 2 teaspoons whole grain mustard | 3 teaspoons fresh chives, finely chopped | 60 g bread, torn into small pieces
instructions: Add coconut milk, sourdough bread cubes, beef boullion cubes, mustard and chives to a large saucepan. Cover with water.

title: Aussie Breaded Capsicum
ingredients: 2 large red capsicums | 2 -3 large carrots | 1/4 cup amaretto | 1/2 cup dry breadcrumbs
instructions: Cut capsicums in half and peel off any black spots. Cut into thin strips. Peel carrots, then cut along their length about ¼ inch thick. Cut carrots into 1 inch lengths. Place capsicums in a bowl of cold water and rinse under cold water. Drain well and set aside. Cut capsicums in half and clean out any excess moisture with a kitchen knife. Place in a bowl of cold water and soak for half an hour or until they are almost dry. Cut them in half and wash out any extra water. Set aside and place carrot and dry breadcrumbs in a large bowl. Drain capsicum well and gently rub mixture into dry breadcrumbs. Heat oil in a large frying pan over high heat and fry capsicum for 10 minutes or until golden on all sides. Place on absorbent paper to allow excess oil to drain off. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: chicken drumstick,onion soup mix,pecan,chive,fish,orange juice zest,chipotle chile
title: Easy Crockpot Chicken Drumsticks
ingredients: 1 envelope dry onion soup mix | 1 chicken drumstick, skinned | 1/2 cup fresh orange juice or 1/2 cup lemon juice | 1 orange, zest of, finely grated | 1 teaspoon dried chives | 1 chipotle chile, minced | 1/3 cup pecans, coarsely chopped
instructions: Rinse chicken, pat dry with paper towels. Using fingers, rub the surface of the breast meat with both the onion soup powder, and the salt and pepper. Turn chicken over in the mixture, and set the breast meat in the crockpot. Pour the orange juice or lemon juice over the chicken so that it is completely submerged into the chicken. Cover, and set on low for 5 hours. Remove chicken from pot about halfway through. Remove skin and ribs. Make small slits in the chicken with a fork, and pull a knife or small sliver of orange zest into each slit. Sprinkle chives over the top. Sprinkle with chipotle chile. Turn crockpot on high, and set for 2 hours. Strain cooking juices, pour into separate saucepan, and serve over chicken.

title: Easy Lemon Yogurt Dressing
ingredients: 1 cup vanilla yogurt | lemon juice | parsley sprigs, to garnish
instructions: Mix together and serve over salad leaves.

Random Ingredients: beef tenderloin,button mushroom,cream tartar,soya sauce,soymilk,chili seasoning mix,grain rice,kielbasa
title: Beef Stroganov (Korean Style Beef Stroganov)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef tenderloin, sliced 1/4 thick | 20 -35 button mushrooms, quartered | 2 packages refrigerated reduced fat sour cream-style topping thawed reduced fat sour cream-free | 1/4 cup soya sauce ( reduced sodium ) | 1/4 cup light soya milk ( reduced sodium ) | 2 tablespoons chili seasoning mix | 2 tablespoons chili seasoning mix | 1 teaspoon ground wheat gluten free seasoning ( such as mccormick's whole wheat ) | 2 -3 cups cooked long-grain rice
instructions: Using a meat tenderizer, pound beef to 1/4 thick. In a medium size bowl combine sour cream, soya sauce, soya milk, chili seasoning mix, and ground round gluten free seasoning.

title: Homemade Mayonnaise for Shrimps, Steak, Pork Roast or Chicken
ingredients: 100 g dijon mustard | 1 pinch vanilla essence
instructions: Mix mustard with vanilla essence to develop flavour. Dip pork roasts into mustard, then coat with extra mustard, adding a little of the extra extra mustard if desired. Refrigerate and leave to marinate for at least a couple of hours before using. When serving the meal, place on the table with a crusty bread.

title: Lime-Dill Churros
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dried coriander seeds, toasted and crushed | 2 tablespoons fresh lime juice | 2 pounds pork tenderloin, trimmed and cut crosswise into very thin strips | 1 bunch fresh dill leaves, chopped, or as needed
instructions: Grind coriander seed with an electric spice grinder or mortar and pestle until mixture forms fine powder. In a bowl, mix coriander with lime juice and stir well. Add pork strips and marinate in refrigerator for at least 1 hour. Preheat over to 400 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Cook pork strips in hot oil over medium high heat until golden, about 5 minutes. Transfer to a plate as they cook, and sprinkle with dill.

title: Italian Baking Powder
ingredients: 1 cup unsweetened cocoa | 6 tablespoons italian seasoning
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 f. Mix all together, and put in a paper baking pan lined with parchment. Sprinkle with extra dry cocoa to cover the surface and let dry for 10 minutes. Do not make this too hot, and the fat from the cocoa will begin to melt into the cocoa mix. Bake for approximately 40 minutes at 300 f, until a toothpick or a cake tester comes out clean. Let cool for 5 minutes, then cut while still warm.

title: Cauliflower With Macaroni
ingredients: 2 heads cauliflower ( or small to medium-sized cauliflower depending on size ) | 2 tablespoons cooking oil | 2 teaspoons mexican chili powder | 2/3 cup plain yogurt | 4 cups cooked macaroni
instructions: Boil some water in a large pan and add the macaroni noodles. Once water is boiling, add the cauliflower to the water and cook until tender. Drain pasta and then return to the pan. Mix the macaroni noodles, cauliflower, chilli powder to combine and then mix with the yogurt. Serve with any type of bread and cheese.

title: Manchego Cheese, Pepperoni, and Mozzarella Casserole
ingredients: 8 ounces dry shell pasta | 3 ounces part-skim mozzarella cheese, shredded ( or more, if needed ) | 10 -12 slices pepperoni, sliced thin | 1 ounce manchego cheese, shredded
instructions: Place a kettle of salted water on the stovetop or in the microwave for 2 - 3 minutes to boil. In a 2 to 3 quart baking dish, combine the mozzarella, pepperoni, and manchego cheese. Pour pasta into boiling water and bake, uncovered, in a 425 degree oven for 12 - 15 minutes, or until hot. Spoon hot pasta into the warm mozzarella cheese mixture, top with the remaining mozzarella cheese, and bake in preheated oven for 8 - 10 minutes until cheese is melted and bubbly.

title: Sliced Green Onion
ingredients: 4 -6 green onions, white parts only, cut into 2. 5 cm pieces | 3 red capsicums
instructions: Cut each green onion into half. Halve the red capsicum. Wash green onions and wash well with cold water. Drain on clean tea towel. Place green onions and capsicums in a glass dish. Refrigerate for at least one hour. When serving, squeeze the green onions to remove all the seeds. Drizzle with lime juice or a good twist of lemon juice. This dish also looks great at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: veal scallop,green chilies,thyme leaf,rosemary,icing sugar,okra,guinness stout
title: Veal & Okra in Guinness With Herbs & Rosemary (Guinness Chicken & Okra Starter)
ingredients: 2 lbs boned veal scallops, cut into 3/4 inch dice | 1 1/4 cups guinness stout ( or other dark beer ) | 1 tablespoon icing sugar | 1 teaspoon dried thyme leaves, crushed | 2 green chilies | 1 bunch fresh rosemary | 20 okra, trimmed
instructions: Put the veal in a large saucepan and add cold water to cover. Heat to boiling, then reduce the heat and simmer covered for 30 - 40 minutes or until tender. Remove the veal to a wide warmed platter, cover loosely with thickened tea towels, and set aside to cool. Pour the guinness into a small bowl, then stir in the icing sugar, thyme, chili, rosemary and half the quantity of okra. Leave to stand until ready to use. Dry the okra on paper towels, then put them in a large, heavy based saucepan. Pour in enough water just to cover them. Cover and boil gently until soft and golden, about 40 - 50 minutes. Drain and stir in the rest of the okra. Season and serve at once.

Random Ingredients: apple,salt pork,yellow squash,mexican oregano,ginger garlic paste
title: Chef John's Fruity Spiced Yellow Squash
ingredients: 4 large yellow squash, peeled and cut into 1/2-inch cubes | salt pork, diced | 1 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste ( can also use ginger-garlic powder ) | 1/2 cup ground apples | 1/2 teaspoon mexican oregano
instructions: Place squash in a microwave safe dish with 1 tablespoon salt and cover with plastic wrap. Microwave on high for 2 minutes, flipping the pieces every minute, until squash is soft, about 3 minutes more. Let stand on a plate covered with plastic for 15 minutes. Transfer the squash to a cutting board and, using scissors or a very sharp knife, cut squash into thin slices. Add to a large serving bowl. Add 1 tablespoon ginger garlic paste and 1/2 tablespoons chili powder. Stir to combine, then stir in apple and oregano. Store in refrigerator in an airtight container until ready to use. To store, place pieces on a baking tray in a single layer and set aside to dry for an hour. Stir every once in a while, and spoon the spice mixture into warmed serving dishes to serve.

title: Homemade Nicoise Olive Stew
ingredients: 3 pounds boneless pork shoulder, cubed | 1 package sliced pepperoni | 1 can nicoise olives, drained
instructions: Toss pork with pepperoni in a bowl until well coated. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add the pork.

title: German Chicken (Baked)
ingredients: 1 loaf crusty hamburger roll | 6 -7 lbs chicken thighs | 1/8 - 1/4 cup horseradish ( to taste )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Cut rolls in half lengthwise. Place the rolls on parchment lined jelly roll pan. Bake for about 45 minutes. Meanwhile, clean your chicken and sprinkle generously with horseradish powder. If it falls apart, blot it lightly with a paper towel. Set the chicken aside and let it dry. Boil your chicken for about 20 minutes drain the juice and place in an oven safe pot. You can put the pot on the burner if it cooks very fast it gets a lot hotter than normal or if your burner gets hot, let it cook until the first side is a nice dark caramel color.

title: Focaccia
ingredients: 1 packet active dry yeast | 1/2 cup ice water | 3 tablespoons cream of tartar | 2 tablespoons cornflour | 1 tablespoon tabasco sauce | 8 frozen mixed vegetables, thawed | 1 teaspoon cornflour, for dusting
instructions: Dissolve yeast in plenty of cold water. Add ice water, cream of tartar, cornflour and tabasco sauces. Stir. Cover and place in a warm spot for about 1 hour. While waiting for dough to rise, slice frozen vegetables into thin slices. Heat a frying pan to very high and add 1 tbsp oil. Stir fry vegetables about 1 minute. Remove from pan and place on a plate lined with paper towels. Dust with a pinch of cornflour. When dough rise to the top, coat it with flour. With your finger, make an indentation in the top. Drop in a spoonful of vegetables. Fry until golden. Repeat with remaining vegetables when all dough has been used. Drain on a paper towel and serve warm. Yummy warm. Store any leftover focaccia in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: wheat flour,avocado,tamarind paste,red cabbage,beef stew meat
title: Tamarind Beef Salad
ingredients: 1 can tamarind paste | 1 lb beef stew meat | 1 tablespoon whole wheat flour | 1 red cabbage | 1 large avocado, peeled and cubed
instructions: Prepare tamarind according to instructions then crush till it breaks into small bits using your hands. Combine tamarind with the chuck beef, beef and flour. Chop the cabbage into long pieces. Peel and cube avocado. Combine with beef and cabbage.

Random Ingredients: red capsicum,lasagna noodle,wheat egg noodle,kaffir lime leaf
title: Maurice’s Easy and Delicious Noodle Lasagna
ingredients: 225 g dried lasagna noodles or 250 g egg noodles | 3 kaffir lime leaves | 1 red capsicum, diced | 400 g whole wheat egg noodles
instructions: Start by washing the noodles and soaking them in cold water for about 15 - 20 minutes. Then boil them for about 15 minutes, drain them and let dry out. Preheat the oven to 220c/425f/gas mk place the kaffir lime leaves in a plastic bag, pour in boiling water and let chill for about 1 hour. Drain the noodles and rinse them well. Mix everything together and put aside for 15 minutes. Then spread 1/2 the noodles in the bottom of a casserole dish. Top with half the capsicum and half the egg noodles. Repeat with the other third of the noodles. Add the rest of the noodle and capsicum on top and top of the noodles. Then spread the rest of the egg noodles on top of this layer. Cover the whole thing with foil and bake for about 45 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Roasted Chicken on Vine
ingredients: 2 roasting chickens, cleaned | thyme
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Place clean, dry, whole chickens on rack in roasting pan. Season with a little salt and pepper. Sprinkle with thyme. Cover with more thyme. Bake for 45 minutes to 1 hour, basting with roaster juices every 10 minutes.

title: Italian Cannellini Bean Dip
ingredients: 1 can cannellini beans | 1/2 cup cottage cheese | 1 teaspoon onion powder | 1 teaspoon steak sauce | 1 teaspoon oyster sauce
instructions: Drain and rinse the cannellini beans. Mix all ingredients together in a bowl. Serve with crackers or crusty bread sticks.

title: Green Beans With Radish, Beans & Radishes
ingredients: 1 lb green beans | 1/4 lb radish, thinly sliced
instructions: Trim and remove the thick green beans from the tips of the ends. Break into 2 or 3 pieces, depending on the size. Steam or steam the beans until crisp tender, about 4 or 5 minutes, depending on the size they are cut into. Drain. Arrange the beans on a serving platter. Sprinkle the radishes over the top. Serve with crusty italian bread.

Random Ingredients: turmeric,red chili powder,rom tomato,white onion,tamarind pulp,scallop,flat leaf parsley,vegetarian beef
title: Indian Seabream
ingredients: 100 g scallops | 3/4 cup low-fat vegetarian beef, sliced thinly or 3/4 cup vegetarian fish sauce | 1 small red chili powder | 1/2 small white onion, sliced thinly | 2 tablespoons tamarind pulp, soaked in 3 3/4 c boiling water or 2 tablespoons tamarind sherry | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric | 1/2 cup chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley
instructions: In a shallow bowl, combine the scallops with 1/2 teaspoon of turmeric. Add 1/2 cup boiling water and allow to stand for 10 minutes. Rinse with cool water, then drain well in a colander. Drain liquid from scallops if desired. Set aside. In a nonstick frying pan, add the white onion slices and sauté over medium heat, stirring for 2 minutes or until onion is slightly browned. Add tamarind pulp and cook 1 minute. Add the scallops, chinese vegetable paste, and remaining turmeric and stir to coat evenly. Fry 2 minutes. Add the parsley, lower heat, cover and simmer until the scallops are just heated through, about 3 minutes. Serve at once or allow to chill in the refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: coriander powder,peanut butter,aubergine,rice krispies,chili sauce,double cream
title: Charred Aubergine (Eggplant) Kebabs
ingredients: 2 large aubergines, sliced | 175 g peanut butter | 2 tablespoons double cream | 1 tablespoon coriander powder | 2 tablespoons sweet chili sauce | rice krispies
instructions: Trim the eggplant and cut into 2cm slices. Place them on a baking tray, brush with a little of the peanut oil and grill under a very hot grill for about 10 mins, until they have blackened and are golden brown on both sides. Meanwhile, make the sauce by combining the all the ingredients in a pan. Bring to the boil and simmer for 5 mins, stirring occasionally. Arrange the eggplant slices on a serving platter with the sauce and sprinkle with the coriander.

Random Ingredients: grainy mustard,maraschino cherry,sesame seed,taco sauce,pine nut,almond
title: Zippy Zippy Sushi
ingredients: 2 tablespoons toasted sesame seeds | 1 tablespoon pine nuts | 1/4 cup shredded maraschino cherry | 2 teaspoons light grainy mustard | 2 cups prepared taco sauce ( your favorite ) | 2 tablespoons slivered almonds, toasted on the grill ( optional )
instructions: Place the sesame seeds in a ziplock bag and close. Give a quick toss to coat. Set aside. In a small bowl, mix the pine nuts, sesame seeds, cherry, dijon mustard and taco sauce. In another, non stick skillet, toast the nuts over a low heat until golden, about 3 - 5 min. Stir frequently and cool slightly. Stir the pine nut mixture and the toasted sesame seeds into the toasted nuts. Serve warm.

title: Smashida (Japanese Vegetable Stew)
ingredients: 1 lb red new potato, washed and diced ( you may have to use packaged smaller ) | 5 ounces sliced bamboo shoots, washed well and drained | 2 -3 green cabbage, washed and thinly sliced
instructions: Place all vegetables in a saucepan or sauce pan with water on low heat and cook until tender until the potatoes are slightly browned. Remove veggies with a slotted spoon and set aside. Heat the sauteed vegetables with water. Simmer for a few minutes or until vegetables are crisp tender. Pour hot potatoes over them and eat.

title: Cremini Mushrooms
ingredients: 8 ounces cremini mushrooms | 1/3 cup lime juice | 3/4 teaspoon dried thyme leaves
instructions: Remove stems of mushrooms. Cut cremini mushrooms into 1/2 inch slices on a diagonal. In a large shallow glass bowl, combine remaining ingredients and stir to blend. Add mushrooms and toss to coat. Cover and refrigerate 5 to 10 minutes. Serve immediately.

title: French Apricot, Peach and Cumin Dessert
ingredients: 2 large apricots, halved lengthwise, pitted | 2/3 cup heavy whipping cream | 1/4 teaspoon cumin powder | 1 large peach, halved, cored, stone removed, thinly sliced
instructions: Adjust oven rack to middle position and preheat oven to 325 degrees positioning rack in the center of oven. Arrange apricots on a baking sheet and bake until puffed, pale golden and tender, about 40 - 45 minutes. Transfer apricots to a plate. Add remaining cream with cumin and 1/4 teaspoons salt and gently swirl to combine. Set aside to cool 5 minutes. Add cream and apricots to a serving bowl and fold in peaches. Adjust seasonings with salt and remaining 1/4 teaspoons salt. To serve, transfer to a shallow dish, cover and cool to room temperature or refrigerate overnight.

title: French Pork Loin With Fondant Variation
ingredients: 3 lbs boneless pork loin | 1/2 teaspoon white pepper | 1/2 loaf french bread | 6 ounces beef broth
instructions: Place meat in slow cooker. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Cover and cook on low 8 hours. Remove meat and discard strings. Cut meat into 2 - 3 inch pieces. Add beef broth.

title: Chocolate-parsley Treats
ingredients: 2 tablespoons grated raw bittersweet chocolate | 24 parsley sprigs | 8 tablespoons unsalted butter or 8 tablespoons olive oil
instructions: Using a small knife, make a lengthwise slit in the upper layer of each square of bitter orange zest. Remove the center piece of orange peel, then cut in half lengthwise. With a sharp knife, cut the orange peel lengthwise into very thin, 1/8 inch wide strips. Place 1 chocolate strip into the slit between the bitter orange sections.

title: Caramelized Pearl Barley Salad
ingredients: 1 cup pearl barley, cooked and cooled | 1 cup canned cannned chopped olives, drained or 2 ounces sun-dried tomatoes, lightly oiled and chopped | 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme sprig | 1 head lettuce, shredded | 1/2 cup shredded coconut
instructions: Combine cooked barley and olives. Sprinkle with thyme. Add lettuce and coconut to center of serving dish.

title: Simple Mexican Cookies
ingredients: 1/2 cup self raising flour | 1 packet taco seasoning mix
instructions: Preheat oven to 180c/375°f roll out flour onto a floured surface to a rectangle about 3/4cm thick. Use two baking trays to make as many biscuits as possible out of the packet. Use 2 teaspoons of the taco seasoning to generously coat each biscuit. Place biscuits on the lined trays and bake for about 10 minutes, or until well risen and lightly golden brown. Cool and store in an airtight container. Variation, after baking one biscuit, sprinkle a packet of cheddar or monterey jack on top of the biscuits before they have cooled and/or have been taken out of the container. This is a very soft biscuit, so you should be able to roll them out.

Random Ingredients: stewing beef,sharp cheddar cheese,cilantro leaf,milk cream,tamarind paste
title: Jamaican Beef Nachos
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef | 1 cup whole milk or 1 cup light cream | 1/2 cup chopped cilantro leaf | 1 tablespoon tamarind paste ( optional ) | 1/4 - 1/2 cup shredded sharp cheddar cheese
instructions: Cut the meat into 3 1/2 to 4 slices. Place in a large bowl and stir together the remaining ingredients.

title: Poppy Seeds Tea
ingredients: 5 tablespoons plain flour | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1 1/4 teaspoons poppy seeds | 4 teaspoons strong black tea
instructions: Place flour, cardamom and poppy seeds in a food processor or mix with your hands to a fine powder. Add tea leaves and mix well, until the mixture resembles fine breadcrumbs. Divide mixture into four balls the size of walnuts. Place each between 2 tea tins, and cook at 160°c for 15 minutes. Allow the tea to cool completely. Place between clean greaseproof paper and flatten slightly. Allow tea to cool completely before popping off parchment.

title: Italian Sausage & Snow Peas
ingredients: 3/4 lb bulk italian sausage | 1/2 lb fresh snow pea | 1/4 - 1/2 cup finely chopped pecans
instructions: In a heavy skillet, over medium low heat, cook the sausage until it is browned. Remove from skillet and drain off all excess fat. Add the snow pea pods to the drippings in the skillet, cover and cook until all is tender. Remove snow peas from skillet. Remove sausage from skillet and drain thoroughly, discarding any fat on the skillet. Saute the sausage over medium heat 2 - 3 minutes, being careful not to over brown. Sprinkle the sausage with nuts and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: chile,salt black pepper,tomato ketchup,green cabbage,rose water,milk,hot dog,red chili pepper
title: Spicy Dog and Cabbage
ingredients: 4 hot dogs | salt and ground black pepper to taste | 1 sweet red chili pepper, crushed | 1 tablespoon minced fresh chile, or more as desired | 2 teaspoons crushed rose water | 1 can condensed ketchup | 1 can tomato ketchup | 1 1/2 cups milk
instructions: Preheat an oven to 350 degrees f. Score the top of a hot dog with a sharp knife. Cook hot dogs in a skillet over medium heat until well browned, 3 to 5 minutes per side. Transfer the warm dogs to a plate and slice into bite size pieces. Place hot dogs in the preheated oven, and reduce heat to low. Cook hot dogs in the preheated oven until warmed through, about 10 minutes. Remove onions and browned bits from the hot dogs. Return hot dogs to the skillet and stir in red chili, chile, rosewater, ketchup, and tomato ketchup. Pour hot dog mixture into a 9x13 inch baking dish. Cover with aluminum foil. Bake in the preheated oven until hot dogs are hot and flavors have mingled, 30 to 45 minutes. An instant read thermometer inserted into the center should read 160 degrees f.

Random Ingredients: sun tomato oil,date,couscous,head iceberg lettuce,almond,part mozzarella cheese,pearl barley
title: Low Fat, Sticky Moroccan Cheesecake
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups pearl barley, pre-soaked | 1 cup dates, pitted and thinly sliced ( i used pepitas ) | 1 cup part skim mozzarella cheese, shredded | 1/2 cup dates, finely chopped | 3/4 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained and chopped | 1/2 cup almonds, finely chopped | 1 head iceberg lettuce, shredded | 1/4 cup part-skim mozzarella cheese, shredded
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Spray a 9 springform pan with cooking spray. Combine pearl barley, dates, 1 cup mozzarella, and sun dried tomatoes in a large bowl. Fold in almonds and then coarsely diced part of both monterrey’s mozzarella cheeses. Spoon into prepared pan. Bake for 35 to 40 minutes until set and starting brown around the edges. Serve warm with remaining mozzarella cheese sprinkled on top.

title: Prawns & Bacon on a Baked Pot Au Jus
ingredients: 4 large cooked peeled prawns | 1 red onion, finely chopped | 1 finely green pepper, finely chopped | 15 biscuits, depending on size, i use biscuits of your choice ( such as biscuits ) | 1 ounce arrowroot | 1/4 cup fresh parsley sprig, to decorate
instructions: Preheat oven to 190c degrees. Remove the skin from prawns & set aside. Cook the onion & pepper in a large skillet until softened – around 5 minutes. Stir in the prawns, stir & cook for another 5 minutes. Place biscuits in a large casserole dish or individual biscuits. Top with the prawn mixture & pour over enough water to come halfway up the side. Bake for about 25 - 30 minutes or until golden & crispy. Sprinkle with parsley and serve with a bowl of guacamole and crusty chorizo breads.

Random Ingredients: oregano leaf,spinach,champagne,green onion,mushroom stem,butter,pecan,extra sharp cheddar cheese
title: Mushroom Spinach and Cheese Casserole
ingredients: 1 package frozen chopped spinach, thawed, drained | 2 tablespoons butter | 2 teaspoons minced fresh oregano leaves, divided | 12 ounces extra-sharp cheddar cheese, divided | 1 jar quartered mushroom stems and pieces, drained | 1 bottle chilled champagne | 1 1/2 cups mixed green onions, sliced | 1/2 cup chopped pecans
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Butter a 9 inch pie plate. Line the pie plate with plastic wrap and dampen the wrap with water. Arrange half of the spinach in the pie plate. Place half of the spinach over the spinach and then half of the cheese. Repeat layers. Grate half of the cheddar cheese over the spinach mixture. Mix the oregano with half of the cheddar cheese, reserving half for topping. Spoon cheese mixture over the cheese. Grate remaining cheddar cheese over the spinach mixture. Drizzle remaining half of the cheese evenly over cheese. Spread 1 1/2 cups green onions over cheese. Bake in the preheated oven until cheese is bubbly, about 25 minutes. Sprinkle remaining 1 1/2 cup green onions over casserole, then continue cooking.

title: Balsamic Cheese Straws
ingredients: 12 ounces goat cheese ( or other aged sharp cheese ) | 1 teaspoon aged balsamic vinegar
instructions: Use a melon baller to remove the rind from 4 ounces of the goat cheese. This is not necessary and will not give you a wider slice of cheese. Rinse the cheese under cold water and trim any excess moisture. Break up roughly and set aside. Wrap the cheese in the olive oil and place on a small sheet of aluminium foil. Sprinkle over the vinegar and press lightly. Wrap the cheese loosely with the tin foil and leave for 15 minutes. Remove the cheese from the foil and press into an 8 inch square tin. Turn over carefully. Brush the cheese with more oil and leave uncovered for a further 15 minutes to set. Remove the cheese and slice into 4 pieces. Serve.

title: Fish Taco Chips
ingredients: 1 lb canned mixed dried meatballs, drained | 4 ounces shredded old el paso taco meat, drained of liquid | 1/2 teaspoon onion salt | 1 teaspoon fresh parsley, minced or 1/2 teaspoon dried parsley | food coloring | corn tortilla chips
instructions: In medium bowl, combine the meatballs, taco meat, onion salt, 1 1/4 teaspoon parsley, and food coloring or an orange food color. Mix together well. Put in small dish or bowl and chill. Dip tortilla chips in warm water and arrange on plates. Spoon desired amount of meat mixture onto tortilla chips. Serve with sour cream or guacamole.

Random Ingredients: beef chuck,lentil,dark sesame oil,spice,chipotle chile,thyme sprig,portabella mushroom,cheese
title: Smoked Hash (Mexican Hash)
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef chuck | 8 portabella mushrooms ( sliced ) | 1 cup lentils | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 1/8 teaspoon ground chipotle chile | 1/8 teaspoon thyme sprig | fresh oregano thyme sprig, for garnish ( optional ) | spices, for serving
instructions: Put the beef and mushrooms in a frying pan or dutch oven with the lentils. Add the oil, sesame, chipotle, & thyme. Break up any lumps & spices with fingertips as you go & keep on stirring over medium heat, till oil starts to burn. It is important not to burn the spices. Drain the beef & mushrooms then add to meat mixture, turning evenly. Sprinkle with spice to taste. Simmer on low heat until the meat is heated through.

title: Tasty Beet Krakesh
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs beets, cooked | 1 pint greek yogurt | 2 jars pickled beets, drained and chopped | 1 cup shredded mexican cheese | 2 cups raspberry flavored frozen yogurt, thawed
instructions: Grate fresh beets coarsely. Pour yogurt into a medium size bowl. Add beets, pickles and 1/4 cup of the cheese. Toss with yogurt. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours to develop flavor. Serve immediately or refrigerate overnight. Drain yogurt before serving over beets if you wish.

Random Ingredients: celery salt,yellow food coloring,pepper flake,lime leaf,spice,tofu
title: Vegan Delight (No Eggs)
ingredients: 1/4 lb firm tofu, rinsed and drained | 1/2 teaspoon dried lime leaves or 1 tablespoon fresh lime juice | 1/2 teaspoon hot pepper flakes | 1 teaspoon celery salt | 1/2 teaspoon curry mixed spice | 1 -2 minute yellow food coloring
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small bowl. Press mixture over a wax paper lined surface to flatten. Allow tofu to set while preparing other ingredients. Cut into 2 inch squares or cut into 2 inch squares and cut each square diagonally into 6 wedges or even smaller triangles.

title: Persian Cottage Cheese Pastries
ingredients: 500 g dried lentils | 1 teaspoon cardamom seed | 1 teaspoon paprika | 1 teaspoon honey | 100 g cottage cheese | 2 tablespoons dried dill or 2 tablespoons dill flakes
instructions: Rinse & drain lentils. Mix with spices. Shape mixture into walnut sized pieces & sprinkle with dried dill or dill flakes. Let bake at 220c for 20 - 30 minutes or until edges are light brown in color. Place on cooling rack.

title: Napa cabbage with beef sirloin
ingredients: 1 pound beef sirloin, cut into thin slices | 1 pound napa cabbage, cored and sliced
instructions: Preheat a large skillet over medium high heat. Saute the beef slices in the hot skillet until they are browned and no longer pink, about 3 minutes per side. Remove the beef slices from the skillet, and set aside. Wash the napa cabbage, and cut into wedges. Place the cabbage in the skillet with the meat, and cook and stir for 1 minute. Remove from heat. Place a large handful of cabbage in a bowl, and pour the beef over it. Toss, and garnish with the remaining cabbage.

Random Ingredients: poblano pepper,beef chuck roast,tamarind juice,asparagus spear,wine vinegar,daikon radish
title: Steamed Beef With Daikon Radish, Asparagus & Poblano Peppers
ingredients: 8 beef chuck roast, trimmed ( about two lbs. total ) | 1/3 cup vietnamese wine vinegar | 1/3 cup tamarind juice | 2 jars fresh asparagus spears, steamed 6 to 8 minutes | 1 large garlic clove, very finely minced | 1 large red jalapenos or 1 large poblano pepper, coarsely chopped
instructions: Place the meat, vietnamese vinegar, tamarind juice, and garlic in a large resealable plastic bag. Seal and turn to thoroughly coat. Place the bag in a saucepan and cover with water. Bring to a boil over high heat. Cover and reduce heat to low. Simmer until meat is tender and just cooked through, about 1 1/2 hours. Remove the garlic from the meat and place in a plate. Cover and set aside. Using tongs, transfer the meat to a cutting board. Slice and set aside. To serve, arrange the asparagus on a platter. Top with the meat and drizzle with some vietnamese vinegar. Sprinkle with some chopped asparagus. Garnish with chile if desired.

Random Ingredients: coffee ice cream,onion powder,white onion,yogurt,panko breadcrumb,parmigiano reggiano cheese,cayenne pepper,adobo sauce
title: Chipotle's Indian Onion Dip
ingredients: 4 cups thinly sliced white onions | 3 tablespoons instant coffee ice cream | 1/4 cup panko breadcrumbs | pepper-flavored chipotle adobo sauce | 1/2 teaspoon ground cayenne pepper | 1/2 teaspoon onion powder | 3 tablespoons grated parmigiano reggiano cheese | fat-free yogurt, as filling for dipping
instructions: Line a large platter with 4 large sheets of tinfoil. Place onions on top of tinfoil and drizzle with cooking spray. Roast at 400 degrees for 45 minutes. Remove from oven and stir, coating onions evenly with cooking spray. Spread the unpeeled onions on top of parchment paper and allow to cool. Preheat oven to 375 degrees. In a medium bowl, stir together ice cream, panko bread crumbs, ground black pepper, cayenne pepper, and onion powder. Spoon about 1/4 cup ice cream mixture onto the center of each onion slice.

Random Ingredients: parsley leaf,lemon wedge,beef bouillon cube,bread flour
title: French Diable and Quick Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 4 1/2 - 5 cups fresh bread flour | 1 cup bread flour ( about ) | 1 small beef bouillon cube | 1 cup chopped fresh parsley leaves | lemon wedge, for garnish
instructions: Mix 4 1/2 cups bread flour and 5 cups of bread starter in a large bowl or in a food processor until mixture forms a dough. Turn well and knead very gently until dough does not stick to hands. Transfer dough to a lightly floured surface and knead quickly. Divide dough into 6 portions and roll each into an 8 long cylinder. With a rolling pin, roll cylinder into a flat cylinder about 3/8 inch thick. Wrap well in plastic wrap and refrigerate until dough is chilled, about 2 hours. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Working on a floured surface flatten cylinder into 3/4 inch thick thick discs and transfer to a parchment lined baking sheet. Lightly press each disc into a lightly greased 2 1/2 cup size rectangle. Using a pastry brush, lightly spread about 1 1/2 tablespoons of the chilled dough in all six corners of circle. Sprinkle flour over dough and gently press dough into the corners. Cut each dough disc into wedges and place on top of the remaining dough wedges, smoothing edge and pressing edges with hands so as not to compact pieces of dough. Garnish with parsley and serve warm.

title: Matzeh or Nakkake
ingredients: 4 matzos meal, squares | 1 tablespoon poppy seeds, or as needed ( optional )
instructions: Place the matzos onto a baking sheet with a thick side nearest you. Sprinkle with poppy seeds. Brush with a little water, and press a square into the meringue using the back of a teaspoon. Bake at 400 degrees f for 15 to 20 minutes, depending on size of squares used. Keep checking for doneness at the end. Scoop out with a paper towel, and cool for about 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: pita bread,pork sparerib,russet potato,enchilada sauce,green pepper,beef tenderloin steak,flat leaf parsley,wheat flour
title: Pinchitos De Ajo
ingredients: 1 teaspoon whole wheat flour | 1 beef tenderloin steak, sliced ( about 1 lb ) | 2/3 lb country-style pork spareribs, cut into 2-inch lengths | 1 can enchilada sauce ( mild, medium or hot and use salsa verde ) | 1 green pepper, cut into thin julienne strips | 1 large russet potato, cut into eighths | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley | pita bread ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place the flour in a shallow dish. Dredge the steak in the flour, shaking off any excess. Transfer the fillets to a large, rimmed baking sheet. Insert a meat thermometer into the center of the fillets. Bake until the internal temperature reaches 180 degrees f, about 10 minutes. Transfer the fillets to a cutting board and cover with foil. Set aside to rest for 10 minutes. Meanwhile, bring the enchilada sauce to a boil in a saucepan over medium high heat. Remove from the heat, and set aside. Arrange the ribs on their sides on a large baking sheet. Bake in the oven until cooked through and beginning to brown on the outside, about 10 minutes. Transfer the meat to a cutting board and let cool slightly. Using a slotted spoon, transfer the meat and onions to a bowl, and stir in the chile verde. Let cool slightly. Slice the meat into 1/2 inch strips. Return the meat and onions to the pan. Spoon half the enchilada sauce over the meat, and stir to combine. Top with peppers, potatoes and parsley. Top with remaining sauce. Top with the cheese if desired and serve with pita bread.

Random Ingredients: apple juice concentrate,flat leaf parsley,egg yolk
title: Celestial Muffins
ingredients: 8 large egg yolks | 1/2 cup frozen apple juice concentrate, thawed | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Lightly grease a 4 quart muffin tin or line with paper muffin liners. In a large bowl, beat egg yolks and liquid concentrate with salt and pepper to taste. Stir in parsley. Stir in apples and bake for 10 to 12 minutes, until tester inserted into center of muffins comes out clean. Transfer muffins to a rack to cool.

Random Ingredients: ear corn,mexican tomato,golden raisin,taco seasoning,leek,bailey irish cream,black bean sauce,ancho chile
title: Vegan Mexican Corn and Bean Soup
ingredients: 2 ears corn, shucked and kernels cut off if necessary | 1 small leek, white and part of green chopped | 1 can mexican-style tomatoes | 1 can black beans in tomato sauce | 1/4 cup light golden raisin | 1 packet taco seasoning | 2/3 cup aji irish cream | 1 dash old bay seasoning
instructions: Place corn kernels, and the remaining ingredients in a large pot over a gentle heat, making sure they are all heated thoroughly. Strain as much of the liquid out as possible and place the corn in the pot in the slow cooker to warm. Serve topped with aji and a splash of old bay.

title: Horseradish Tomato Sauce - Microwave Recipe
ingredients: 2 tablespoons horseradish | 1 can tomato sauce or ( 14 ounce ) can tomato paste ( 1.7 oz )
instructions: Mix thoroughly and store in a glass container for up to 5 days.

title: Barbecue Beef & Lentil Stew
ingredients: 1 lb boneless sirloin or 1 lb sirloin, cut into 2/3-2-inch cubes | 4 cups cubed peeled ripe plum tomatoes | 4 cups cooked brown lentils | 1 cup beer | 1 cup raisins | 12 large scallops
instructions: Combine all stew ingredients in crockpot. Cover and cook on low heat 8 - 9 hours, or high heat 4 - 5 hours. Remove scallops from stew and discard. Stir well to thicken. Serve over brown rice.

Random Ingredients: candy sprinkle,nonfat plain yogurt,baking potato,green chili,red leaf lettuce,linguine,mayonnaise,pine nut
title: Oriental Lettuce Wraps #5FIX
ingredients: 1 package linguine, cooked | 3 medium baking potatoes | 1 green chili, chopped | 1 bunch red leaf lettuce | 1/4 cup fat-free mayonnaise | 1/4 cup nonfat plain yogurt | 3 tablespoons nonfat plain yogurt | 1/4 cup pine nuts, toasted | assorted green chili ( optional )
instructions: Cut cooked pasta in half.

title: Ground Fenugreek (Fenugreek-Spice) crumbles
