ingredients: 1/2 cup finely grind raw fenugreek seeds | 2 1/2 cups graham cracker crumbs | 1/4 cup freshly coarsely chopped mint
instructions: Grind fenugreek seeds to a fine powder in a blender or spice mill. Pour ground fenugreek onto a large plate. Sprinkle graham cracker crumbs onto fenugreek.

title: Bread Crumbs - Tex Mex Copycat Recipe
ingredients: 8 slices whole wheat bread, crusts removed | adobo seasoning
instructions: You will want 2 - 9 x 13 casseroles or 9 x 12 cajun dishes to get them really into the shape of your pan for dipping. Preheat oven to coat 13 x 9 casseroles with cooking spray or lightly coat both sides with oil. Place crusts in casseroles. Sprinkle bread with 1/2 of the adobo seasoning. Top with remaining adobo seasoning. Cover and bake 15 - 20 minutes. Uncover and bake until bread browns a little.

title: Pizza Cakes
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups biscuit, crushed | 1 cup tomato sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Scoop out equal parts of biscuit and tomato sauce. Spread each section of biscuit with remaining tomato sauce. Bake on well greased cookie sheet until golden brown and crisp.

title: Grilled Aubergines or Eggplants
ingredients: 6 small aubergines ( or eggplants ) | 2 tablespoons ground scotch bonnet peppers | 1 teaspoon salt | 1/4 cup rum or 1/4 cup brandy
instructions: Wash the aubergine in a colander under cold running water and pat dry with kitchen paper. Cut the eggplant in half lengthwise and score the flesh at 1/4 inch intervals with sharp knife marks. Grill or fry the eggplants on each side until they are browned and crisp, 10 to 12 minutes total. Brush with rum or brandy while still hot. Serve hot on toast or rolls with chorizo and a drizzle of rum or brandy.

Random Ingredients: hamburger,apple cider,poppy seed,penne,philadelphia cream cheese,sherry wine,bamboo shoot
title: Mongolian Penne With Apple Cider Ham
ingredients: 0.5 package philadelphia cream cheese, at room temperature | 1 jar sliced bamboo shoots, drained | 1 3/4 cups low-fat penne or 1 3/4 cups other tubular pasta, cooked as directed on package for noodles, kept hot | 1/2 cup sherry wine or 1/2 cup port wine, sweet wine, to taste ( i prefer sweetened wine ) | 1/3 cup poppy seed, lightly toasted | 1 cup pre-cooked hamburger | 1/2 cup sherry wine or 1/2 cup port wine, sweet wine, to taste, heated on stove top over low heat
instructions: Mix pasta ingredients, except the sherry and cream cheese, in a medium bowl. Spread the cream cheese evenly on the hot, cooked pasta, leaving a 1/4 inch clear border of pasta at the top of the cream cheese. Sprinkle top with the poppy seeds, hamburger and sherry. Set remaining pasta aside for another use or for appetizers.

title: Moroccan Style Meatball Rigatoni
ingredients: 1 box rigatoni pasta | 500 g ground meatballs ( meatballs, ground by yourself, etc. ) | 8 ounces yogurt | 1 cup olive oil | 2 tablespoons vinegar ( or white wine vinegar ) | 1/2 cup orange zest | 1 vanilla bean | 5 ounces ground tofu, drained until it is crumbled
instructions: Preheat oven to 375f degrees. In medium size mixing bowl combine meatballs, yogurt, oil, vinegar, orange zest and vanilla bean. Add meatballs and mix well. Pour the batter in a baking dish and bake meatballs in oven for 1 1/2 to 2 hours or until the meatballs are firm and browned. Serve and enjoy with a side of couscous and a green salad.

title: Chicken Wings With Cucumber
ingredients: 2 cups chicken wings | 1/2 cup golden syrup | 1 seedless european cucumber
instructions: Blanch cucumber in boiling water for 3 minutes, drain and cut into chunks. Remove skin, cut in thin slices. Place wings in large crock pot. Add remaining ingredients. Cover and cook on low for 6 - 8 hours. Remove chicken, reserving liquid. Pull meat off bones and skin.

Random Ingredients: apple,grain white rice,link boudin sausage,fennel seed
title: Apple Sausage and Rice
ingredients: 6 links bulk smoked boudin sausage | 1 cup apple chunks | 1 teaspoon fennel seed | 1/2 cup long grain white rice, uncooked
instructions: Brown sausage in a large skillet, breaking up the meat with a spoon or spatula. Add apples, rice and fennel.

Random Ingredients: beef mince,turmeric,chili oil,pinto bean,wasabi paste,sherry,poblano chile,baking powder
title: Beef and Bean Hotfry
ingredients: 500 g beef mince | 4 teaspoons wasabi paste, to taste | 1 tablespoon sherry | 1 tablespoon fresh chili flakes | 4 large poblano chiles, roasted and sliced | 1 tablespoon pinto beans | 1 teaspoon dried baking powder | 1 tablespoon baking powder | 3/4 teaspoon turmeric
instructions: In the meanwhile, mix together the wasabi paste, sherry, chili flakes, pepo chilies, pinto beans and baking powder. When ready to fry, heat oil in a pan, and fry the beef until it crumbles and is cooked through, then add to the heated pan, stirring occasionally.

Random Ingredients: grand marnier,mushroom,flour tortilla,mustard,sesame oil,scallop,velveeta mexican cheese,ancho chile powder
title: Taquito's Famous Grilled Scallops on a Quesadilla
ingredients: 2 large scallops, halved | 2 tablespoons flour tortillas | 4 -8 slices velveeta mexican cheese or 4 -8 slices other mild cheese, cut into 2 inch pieces | 4 teaspoons dry mustard | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried ancho chile powder | 1 1/2 tablespoons dry ancho chile powder | 1/2 cup mushroom, sliced | 1 -2 tablespoon sesame oil
instructions: Lightly flour each scallop half or use nonstick spray. Put each scallop onto the flour tortilla. Top each scallop evenly with cheese. Sprinkle with mustard powder and chili powder. Top with mushrooms. Roll up to make an oblong roll. Tie the ends of the roll to secure. Prepare a hot grill with medium high heat. Brush the grill with a light mist of oil. Set the scallops on the grill on the side with only a moderately high heat. Grill for 2 to 3 minutes on each side, or until the outside is slightly charred. Remove the scallops from the grill for a few minutes to allow a bit of crust to escape. Place on a platter and serve immediately.

title: Garlicky Flank Steak
ingredients: 3 lbs flank steak | 3/8 cup wine vinegar
instructions: Preheat grill. Score the steak by criss cross running a sharp knife through it, taking care not to cut all the way through. Rub both sides of the steak with the vinegar. Place steak on grill, brushing with a little of the remaining vinegar, and grill to desired doneness. Brush steak with remaining vinegar when desired.

Random Ingredients: ice water,oregano leaf,ginger,porcini mushroom,french onion dip
title: Dulce De Leche Cheese Spread
ingredients: 1 package porcini mushrooms | 1 can french onion dip | 1/2 cup ice water | 1/4 cup fresh ginger, grated | fresh oregano leaves ( optional )
instructions: In a medium bowl, mash porcini mushrooms completely with hands. Mix in french onion dip and water until creamy. Add ginger and oregano leaves.

Random Ingredients: yellow pea,leg lamb,red wine,pearl barley,spice,lemon juice,sticky rice
title: Browned Lamb, Peas and Rice
ingredients: 1 boneless leg of lamb, trimmed of fat and cut into 4 thin slices | 1/2 cup pearl barley | 1 cup yellow split peas | 1 cup red wine | 6 -8 cups cold water | 2 teaspoons mixed spice | 4 -5 tablespoons fresh lemon juice
instructions: Place all ingredients to crock with lamb fat side up. Cook on low heat for at least 90 minutes or as long as you like. Serve with crusty bread.

title: Thai Potatoes
ingredients: 4 medium baking potatoes, peel and roughly chop ( i prefer yukon gold ) | 2 tablespoons ginger ale ( or ginger-flavored liqueur ) | 2 teaspoons fish sauce ( or nuoc nam )
instructions: Preheat oven to 475 degrees f. Prepare potatoes by peeling them off the stem ends and then roughly chopping them. Place on baking sheet and cut in half, then in half again lengthwise until about 2 inches apart. Drizzle baking sheet with ginger ale and toss to coat. Bake potatoes until crispy and a little charred and soft, about 35 to 40 minutes. You have to be very careful for burning when you check they don't look too browned or they will dry to the touch. You can also turn on the oven as soon as you turn the potatoes once, but the baking time will depend on the size of the potato, or how large the potato is. Enjoy.

title: Baked Onions Loops
ingredients: 2 kg onions | 500 g lamb loin chops | 1 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 1 teaspoon cinnamon | 1 teaspoon brown sugar
instructions: Peel onions, slice into thin wedges, place in layers in a shallow, non metallic dish. Sprinkle with bicarb and sprinkle with cinnamon and sugar. Cover and allow to stand in the refrigerator for 3 hours, stirring occasionally to ensure the onions don't catch. Preheat oven to 400f and bake, covered, for 45 minutes. Remove from oven and leave to stand for 4 - 5 minutes, stirring before removing from heat. Serve hot or cold.

title: Beef Stir Fry
ingredients: 9 ounces boneless sirloin steaks | 6 ounces boneless sirloin steaks | 3 ounces prosciutto, torn into strips | 1 large spanish onion, sliced into thin rings | 1/3 cup ginger syrup, prepared bottled or 1/3 cup light syrup | 1/2 teaspoon ground gingerroot | 1/2 teaspoon ground ginger
instructions: Trim fat from steak and cut into bite sized pieces. Place in a bowl with remaining ingredients.

title: Danish Slaw
ingredients: 1/2 pound slab bacon, diced | 1/2 pound sliced very thin bacon fat | 1 small head cabbage, cored and shredded | 2 medium bananas, sliced | 4 cups shredded vegetables, such as broccoli | 3/4 cup vegetable shortening, like crisco
instructions: Place diced bacon in a large, deep skillet. Cook over medium high heat until evenly brown. Drain. Drain grease. Place bacon, bacon fat, cabbage, bananas, and vegetables in skillet. Stir until bacon is evenly coated and vegetables are coated with bacon fat. Place skillet in a large baking dish. Cover and refrigerate until flavors combine, at least 2 hours and up to overnight. Transfer mixture to a clean, dry serving dish, pressing against the sides of the dish to compact.

Random Ingredients: breadcrumb,chipotle pepper,parsley sprig,yam root,corn cob,hard egg,heavy whipping cream
title: Chipotle Grilled Yams
ingredients: 6 soft sweet potatoes, halved and cut into 1-inch-thick rounds | 3 yams, cut crosswise into 1/8-inch-thick rounds | 1 cup heavy whipping cream | 6 parsley sprigs | 2 canned chipotle peppers, seeded and chopped | 3 hard-boiled eggs, quartered | 1/2 cup breadcrumbs
instructions: Preheat an outdoor grill pan with a rack 3 inches from heat. Oil the grate. Place sweet potatoes into a large bowl.

Random Ingredients: apple juice concentrate,taco seasoning,red chili pepper,pine nut,bamboo shoot
title: BBQ Pine Nut & Apple Mix Dip
ingredients: 400 g pineapple chunks ( drained ) | 1 ounce apple juice concentrate | 1 teaspoon taco seasoning | 1/2 red chili pepper ( finely chopped or crushed ) | 1/2 cup pine nuts
instructions: Blend all ingredients in a blender until completely smooth. Serve with warm biscuit, crackers, cookies, etc. If using a small serving bowl, combine 1/2 cup warm water with 1 1/2 teaspoons seasoning mix or 1 tablespoon instant coffee powder. Serve immediately with fresh fruit cubes, or for a snack, top with nuts.

title: Corn Fritters With Orange Blossom Water
ingredients: 1/4 cup cornmeal | 3 ears fresh corn kernels, washed well | 1 1/4 teaspoons orange flower water | 1 teaspoon lemon thyme, chopped | 1 teaspoon orange juice or 1 teaspoon orange-flavored liqueur
instructions: Heat the corn over moderate heat, stirring, for 1 minute or until golden. Stir in 1 tbsp of the orange blossom water. Transfer the corn and liquid to a pan. Cover and cook, shaking the pan, for 3 minutes or until mixture thickens. Stir in the remaining 1 tbsp of orange blossom water. Heat the remaining 1 1/4 tsp of orange blossom water in a small saucepan over moderate heat, stirring, for 1 minute. Carefully stir the corn mixture into the boiling mixture. Return the pan to the stove and cook, stirring, for 3 minutes or until fritters begin to steam. Remove from the heat and cool. When cool, stir the remaining orange blossom water into the fritters. Garnish with the sprigs of thyme.

title: Smoky Eggplant With Barley
ingredients: 2 large eggplants | 2 cups heavy cream | 1/2 cup barley
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Line a baking tray with parchment paper and place oven rack in the middle. Cut eggplants crosswise into 1/3 inch thick slices. Add to baking tray and bake until eggplant is very soft and soft and eggplants are a bit mushy, 15 - 12 minutes. Transfer eggplants to a bowl and reserve. Turn off oven and turn oven door slightly open. When oven and door are nearly open, stir cream in a bowl. When the cream is nearly absorbed, stir in barley and stir until completely mixed. Return eggplant to baking tray, place in oven and bake, stirring occasionally, until the liquid is reduced by half, about 50 - 60 minutes. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: sambal chili paste,linguine,brandy,white cabbage,swiss chard,lentil,enriched flour
title: Lentil and Swiss Chard Noodle Bowls
ingredients: 1 cup enriched flour for pasta and pasta | 1 cup lentils, rinsed and drained | 1 medium white cabbage, chopped | 1 cup swiss chard, chopped | 1 -3 tablespoon sambal chili paste | 3 tablespoons brandy ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon unrefined enrichment flour ( optional )
instructions: Mix the flour, lentils, cabbage, chard, sambal chili paste, and brandy in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: garlic salt,sea salt,egg substitute,tomato puree,salad oil,cannellini bean
title: Low Fat Escarole (And Bean) Salad
ingredients: 2 cans cannellini beans, drained | 1 can chopped tomatoes in puree | 1 cup egg substitute | 1 1/2 teaspoons garlic salt | 1 teaspoon sea salt | 1 tablespoon salad oil
instructions: Combine the drained beans. Dissolve egg substitute in the salad oil and add to the bean mixture. Add garlic salt and salt and stir. Fold in the drained tomatoes. Cover and chill. Enjoy.

title: Hot Taco Seasoning Mix
ingredients: 8 ounces taco seasoning mix | 3 1/2 ounces single cream ( light works best ) | 3 1/2 ounces thyme leaves
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well.

Random Ingredients: green chili,heavy cream,chipotle chile,self raising flour,gherkin,yeast,green pea,sesame oil
title: Fruit and Salt Bread
ingredients: 1 1/3 kg whole dried sweet gherkins | 1 1/3 kg fresh green peas, shelled | 4 chipotle chiles, chopped | 1 1/3 kg fresh green peas or 1 1/3 kg frozen green peas | 25 g raw sugar or 3 g raw sugar | 35 g self-raising flour | 1 teaspoon sesame oil | 600 ml heavy cream | 2 teaspoons yeast
instructions: Dry the gherkins with paper towel, cut off the stems, remove the peels and roughly chop. Place them in a large bowl with the peas, chilies, sugar and flour. Add enough of the cream to make a smooth dough without adding any of the liquid. Cover and leave in a warm place for a couple of hours until the dough is really really thick. Stir the yeast into the mixture. When it is frothy and bubbly, remove from the heat. Place the dough on a floured surface and knead until smooth and elastic. Cover and leave in a warm place for a couple of hours until all the ingredients are doubled. Punch down the dough, knead briefly. Place on a floured surface and knead again. Roll the dough into a rectangle of about 12 x 18. Cut the rectangle into 6 to 8cm pieces and place on a greased and floured baking tray. Bake the bread in a preheated oven at 220c for about 40 minutes or until pale gold in colour. Remove from oven and let cool 5 minutes. Turn out onto a cloth and peel off the paper. Cut into slices, place on a serving plate and drizzle with cream. Serve with jam, custard or icecream.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack cheese,olive,kosher salt pepper,broth,baby carrot,vanilla ice cream
title: Grpa Santa Fe
ingredients: 2 packages baby carrots | 3 tablespoons olive oil | 4 -5 fresh small olives | 1 cup broth or 1 cup water | kosher salt and pepper, to taste | 1 container good quality vanilla ice cream
instructions: Boil baby carrots until soft and drain. Cut in half lengthwise and cut lengthwise into half again. Cut out the core then, using large spoon, scrape out the bitter white juice, leaving about half a cup of juice. Coat the bottom and sides of a glass baking dish, or other medium size dish to a depth of ½ inch. Line the bottom and sides of the dish with the carrots, then sprinkle with salt. In a large frying pan, heat oil over med heat then sauté the olives adding a little water if necessary to prevent burning. When the olives are just starting to brown, add broth/water and simmer until the broth thickens a bit bit. Serve warm with vanilla ice cream. If desired, serve with a few warm toothpicks.

title: Cousin Junetho's Phyllo Purses
ingredients: 500 g linguine | 2 tablespoons semolina flour | 4 teaspoons custard powder | 100 g raisins | 300 g chopped chicken bouillon | 100 g chopped coriander | 200 g phyllo dough
instructions: Place the semolina flour in the bowl of a food processor. Add the eggs and process until they forms a thick paste. Add the chopped raisins, chicken bouillon and coriander and process until well mixed. Place the mixture in a bowl and cover with the plastic wrap until the mixture is cold. Cut the phyllo sheets in half to fit the bottoms of your trays. On a clean surface lay out 4 sheets of phyllo, brushing each sheet with melted butter and lay a small piece of phyllo on top. Cover and use a sharp knife to cut the remaining 2 sheets of phyllo and cut the phyllo into four long strips, keeping the strips long enough to keep the shape of the phyllo strips. Repeat with each phyllo strip until you have used all the phyllo/leaves. Place a small, buttered tray in front of you and cover tightly with a damp towel. Place a second tray on top and cut a triangle or two across the top layer for added presentation and to hold the triangles together.

title: Homemade Baked Spicy Marshmallows
ingredients: 8 ounces marshmallows, shredded | 1/2 cup green onion, chopped | 1/4 cup chili, chopped ( canned or fresh ) | 1 tablespoon lemon zest, grated
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a medium sized bowl. Stir until coated. Pour into an 8 square baking dish and refrigerate for several hours. To serve, sprinkle with chopped candied ginger, if desired. Microwave on high 1 minute. Stir to combine.

Random Ingredients: milk,baby spinach,ginger root,fontina cheese,lime juice zest,buttermilk biscuit dough
title: Thai Spinach Bread
ingredients: 3 tablespoons lime juice and zest | 1 cup milk | 2 pounds baby spinach | 1/4 cup fresh lime juice packed | 3 tablespoons grated fontina cheese | 8 ounces fontina cheese | 1 bag biscuit dough
instructions: Combine lime zest, milk, and spinach in a pot over medium heat. Cook, stirring, until spinach is tender and liquid has cooked down, about 5 minutes. Remove and set aside. Add lime juice and zest to warm milk mixture. Stir until zest is dissolved and spinach is wilted, about 2 minutes. Combine lime juice and fontina cheese in a bowl. When spinach mixture is finished cooking, fill bread dough with spinach mixture.

title: Chicken Kebabs
ingredients: 2 chicken tenders, trimmed and cut into 1-inch cubes | 1/2 cup nonfat plain yogurt | 1 egg, beaten | 2 teaspoons instant coffee powder | 2 thinly sliced green onions
instructions: Thread 3 chicken tenders onto each bamboo skewer.

title: Pine Nut Puffs
ingredients: 1 3/4 cups ground lean pork fat | 1/2 cup pine nuts | 1/4 cup margarine, melted | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f in a bowl, mix pork fat and pine nuts until thoroughly combined. Add margarine, soy sauce and dark soy sauce, stirring well. Shape into 8 patties. Place on greased cookie sheet. Bake 15 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Cod Fish With Pumpkin Seeds
ingredients: 1/2 cup ground pumpkin | 1 lb cod, fillet cut into 2-3 inch chunks | 1 bell pepper, cut into strips
instructions: Combine pumpkin with fish and pepper. Cover and chill for several hours. Cook vegetables until tender or grill fish until just cooked through.

title: Curried Kielbasa Salad
ingredients: 250 g farfalle pasta ( bowtie or other short pasta ) | 500 g kielbasa ( cut into 3 cm cubes ) | 1 -2 teaspoon kelbasa curry powder ( or similar ) | 1 teaspoon dry marjoram or 1 teaspoon oregano leaves | 1 teaspoon dried coriander seeds or 1 teaspoon dried cilantro | 1 cup mixed salad greens
instructions: Cook the farfalle in salted water for 15 - 20 minutes drain and keep warm. Bring a pot of salted water to a boil, add the chopped kielbasa and mix well. Stir fry the kielbasa in a skillet until it is coloured. Remove from the skillet and set aside, keeping warm. In a bowl, add the curry powder and mix well. Add the dried herbs of choice. Drain the farfalle and put it in the bowl with the curry and spice mix. Add the drained kielbasa and toss well. Serve cold.

title: Texas Five-Spice Rub
ingredients: 2 tablespoons hot sauce | 1 purple onion, sliced | 6 teaspoons purple onion soup mix
instructions: Place hot sauce and purple onion in a small microwave safe dish. Microwave covered on high for 1 minute. Rinse and dry the purple onion. Using a pastry brush, coat onion with the hot sauce. Sprinkle with the soup mix and toss to coat all sides. Store in an airtight container.

title: Authentic Mexican-Style Breakfast Skins
ingredients: 8 slices bacon | 2 cans ro-tel tomatoes, with liquid | 6 1/2 - 7 ounces soymilk, divided
instructions: Fry the bacon until crisp and drain on a paper towel. Combine the bacon, tomatoes and half the water and 2 1/2 to 3/4 cups soymilk in a blender until smooth. Pour into a 2 cup baking dish. Top with the remaining 2 cups low fat milk and place in the preheated 350 degree oven for 20 minutes or until golden.

title: Refried Refried Beans
ingredients: 2 cans pinto beans, drained and rinsed | 1 can corn, drained
instructions: Combine the beans and corn in a large skillet over medium heat. Bring to a boil, and cook about 10 minutes, stirring frequently, until the corn is tender and the beans are slightly browned. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: coriander seed,garam masala,french baguette,balsamic vinegar,garlic clove
title: Bombay Garlic Bread Chips
ingredients: 1 french baguette | 2 garlic cloves, crushed | 1 tablespoon garam masala | 2 tablespoons parsley seeds | 1 tablespoon coriander seed
instructions: Make a paste using the paste ingredients, stir well and then store in an airtight container. Cut the baguette into 1/4 inch thick slices. Grill the bread slices for 2 - 3 minutes each side, or until golden brown. Remove the bread from the oil and serve with your favourite accompaniments.

title: Chili Black Tea
ingredients: 250 ml double cream | 1 red chilies, seeded, deveined and finely chopped | 1 tablespoon black tea
instructions: Beat the cream and chillies together until very light and fluffy. Stir in the tea and chillies. Pour into small glasses and serve.

title: Creamy Rice Noodle Soup
ingredients: 2 ounces rice noodles, washed and dried | 4 cups half-and-half ( i use milk ) | 1 can whole kernel corn | 1/4 teaspoon spice ( or a mixed spice like cumin ) | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder ( optional )
instructions: Combine rice noodles and half and half in a saucepan. Add all remaining ingredients. Bring to a boil, cover, turn heat low, and simmer for 5 to 10 minutes until liquid is absorbed and rice noodles are cooked, stirring occasionally. Serve immediately.

title: Gruyere Gratinee (Cheese Tart)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon grated orange zest | 3/4 lb gruyere cheese, cheese, coarsely grated ( about 2 1/2 cups ) | fresh dill sprig, for garnish
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°. Lightly coat 4 small or individual ramekins with cooking spray or oil. Combine the grated cheese and grated orange zest in a food processor or blender.

title: Sicilian Mushrooms With Habanero
ingredients: 8 cremini mushrooms | 8 serrano peppers, seeded | 3 tablespoons chili seasoning ( i use s & b ) | 4 teaspoons dried oregano
instructions: Place mushrooms and peppers in a large, nonstick skillet. Top with remaining ingredients. Cover and grill over medium low heat for 10 to 12 minutes or until mushrooms and peppers are tender and hot.

Random Ingredients: self rising flour,cherry,skirt steak,ham,extra tofu,taco seasoning,beer
title: Taco Beans Baked on the Skirt Steak
ingredients: 2 1/2 ounces taco seasoning, packets | 1 1/4 cups self-rising flour | 2 1/3 ounces self-rising flour | 1/4 cup beer | 4 large fully cooked boneless lean skirt steaks | 5 ounces turkey or 5 ounces combination of sliced cooked pork and shredded hot dogs | 1 1/2 cups mini diced fresh cherries, if desired
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Dough. Combine taco seasoning packets, flour, and beer in a plastic ziploc bag.

title: Mexican Sweet Potato Chips
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 1/2 teaspoon ginger salt | 1 dash garlic salt
instructions: Spray an oven safe skillet with pam. Place skillet in oven to 325 degrees f. Mix together cinnamon ginger salt garlic and sugar in a small bowl using a pastry cutter or spoon to do this. Take a small chunk of cinnamon ginger and squeeze the cinnamon stick into it. Mix together until the ginger, cinnamon, and sugar have combined. Sprinkle mixture over the cinnamon mixture and shake the skillet to coat. When mixture has formed a crust, drain excess and sprinkle on the cinnamon ginger mixture. Turn over the chips and cook in same pan for about an additional 5 minutes. Take out of oven and sprinkle with more cinnamon ginger mixture if desired.

title: Asafetida Mushrooms (Peas With Cabbage) #2
ingredients: 1/2 savoy cabbage, finely chopped | 1 can peas | 1 pinch asafoetida powder | 16 large fresh mussels, cleaned | 1/2 cup breadcrumbs
instructions: Place cabbage on a microwave safe plate and cover with a few microwaveable cups. Cover with lid and cook on high power for 5 minutes. Open the microwave and stir to separate the leaves and discard. Set aside. Stir peas into the cabbage. Add asafetida. Cover in a few bread crumbs, cover and microwave on high power for 2 minutes. Mix and microwave on medium high power for 5 more minutes. Serve hot.

title: Banana Pizzas
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs pork butt | 0.5 can pizza crusts ( flat bread size, if using regular size ) | 1/2 cup crushed pistachios | 1/2 cup banana leaves ( or other desired combination )
instructions: Place pork in oven on middle rack. Watch carefully to make sure you do not burn the pork. Once your pork is browned on the edges, remove from oven and turn off oven. Use a fork to poke holes all over the pork in the hole. If it doesn't fit, just poke in a small amount of other toppings, or try the bottom, because it will be close to the top if your pork is not fully cooked. Return to oven for 20 minutes, or until internal temperature reaches 165 degrees. Remove from oven. With meat thermometer, check your internal temperature of the pork. If pork is browned too fast, do not over cook the pork, and continue testing. When your internal temp is 175 degrees, remove pork from oven. Place your tortilla, flatbread bottom side facing up, onto a nonstick cookie sheet. Remove some of the excess dough with a spatula. Spread the crumbs evenly onto the tortilla. Place the cooked pork onto the unbuttered cookie sheet. Sprinkle half of the remaining crushed pistachios over, on top of the flattened bread. Spread the remaining pistachios on top of the pork, then drizzle with the other half of the crushed pistachios. Add another layer of cooked pork and top with the rest of the crushed pistachios. Sprinkle with the remaining chopped pistachios. Place in preheated oven and bake for one hour, then serve.

title: Lettuce and Sour Cream Salad
ingredients: 1 head romaine lettuce | 1 package cream cheese, cubed | vegetable broth ( i use chicken broth )
instructions: Prepare the head of romaine to your own liking, washed lightly and dried thoroughly. Place romaine head on a plate. Cube cream cheese and pour over the romaine. Serve cold.

Random Ingredients: vegetable juice,butter,beef sirloin,pistachio nut,part mozzarella cheese,fajita seasoning mix,oatmeal,celery salt
title: Cheesy Beef Skillet
ingredients: 3 tablespoons butter | 1/2 cup chopped celery salt | 1 cup chopped celery | 1 cup chopped cooked beef sirloin | 1/4 package fajita seasoning mix | 1/3 cup all purpose oatmeal | 1/8 teaspoon celery salt | 1/8 cup chopped pistachio nuts ( optional ) | 12 ounces v8 vegetable juice | 1 cup shredded part-skim mozzarella cheese or 1 cup provolone cheese
instructions: Melt butter in a medium skillet, cook celery and beef. Stir in fajita seasoning and oatmeal. Cook and stir for 2 minutes. Season with celery salt. Spread vegetable juice in bottom of a greased 13x9 pan. Sprinkle 1 cup of cheese on top of this. Spread meat mixture over cheese. Sprinkle remaining cheese on top of meat mixture. Preheat oven to 350. Bake 30 minutes or until beef is no longer pink. Top with nuts and drizzle with remaining 1/4 cup of cheese. Sprinkle with remaining 1/4 cup of cheese. Bake 5 to 10 minutes or until cheese is bubbly and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: allspice,romaine lettuce,egg yolk,red bell pepper,salt black pepper,bean sprout,spanish onion,ziti pasta
title: Tilapia's Tortilla Salad
ingredients: 3 cans refried beans with beans | 3 egg yolks | 1/2 spanish onion, minced | 1 pinch ground allspice | salt & freshly ground black pepper | 1 medium ziti pasta ( about 1 1/2 pounds ) or 1 medium spaghetti ( about 1 1/2 pounds ) | 1 medium red bell pepper, thinly sliced | 1 medium romaine lettuce, coarsely chopped
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degree f. Combine the refried beans and egg yolks in a bowl. Stir in the onion and allspice and season with salt and pepper. Place the uncooked pasta in a large casserole dish. Cook, stirring once or twice, over medium heat until barely done but still a little chewy. Drain pasta, rinse and blot dry. Spread the cooked beans mixture evenly over the pasta. Spread the cooked ziti/spaghetti/spaghetti on top of the beans and ziti. Spread the pepper slices over the ziti. Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 1 hour. Uncover and let the tortilla rest for 5 to 10 minutes before slicing. This keeps well refrigerated and served cool.

title: Raspberry Pie Crust
ingredients: 1 graham cracker pie crust, prepared | 1 pint fresh raspberries
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Mix raspberries and graham cracker crumbs in a bowl. Place crust in a 9x13 inch pan. Line crust with the raspberries. Spread crumb filling with raspberries. Bake in the preheated oven for 30 minutes, until bubbly.

title: Drog Sauce
ingredients: 2 ounces dark rum | 2 - 2 1/2 teaspoons ground mace
instructions: Heat rum and mace in sauce pan.

title: Pressed-Faced Sourdough Wraps
ingredients: 10 flour tortillas | thyme leaves, crushed or fresh herb leaves, finely minced ( optional ) | 8 teaspoons sourdough flour ( or plain flour for non-veges )
instructions: Combine 1 tbsp + 1 tsp flour in small bowl or cup.

title: Indian Spinach
ingredients: 1 package frozen chopped spinach leaves | 2 teaspoons peanut oil | 1/4 teaspoon ground turmeric powder | 1/4 cup raisins ( optional )
instructions: Tear frozen spinach leaves into pieces and put into a medium bowl. Drain raisins by pressing between palms into a mixing bowl. Put the oil into a wide nonstick frypan on medium high heat. When oil is hot, put in the spinach, turmeric and coriander. Stir fry for about 1 minute. Add raisins to frypan and stir fry for another minute. Make sure all of the spinach is coated with oil and stir in raisins with a spatula. Cover and cook for 2 minutes, stirring. Uncover and cook another 2 - 3 minutes, or until raisins are golden brown.

title: Caribbean Oat Salad
ingredients: 1/8 lb quick-cooking rolled oats, crushed | 1/8 cup quick-cooking rolled oats | 2 tablespoons light coconut rum, light | 1 tablespoon light cream | 2 tablespoons cattlemens hot barbeque sauce
instructions: Mix the first five ingredients together, mixing well. Place in an 8 x 8 dish and chill. When ready to serve, sprinkle on top with barbeque sauce.

Random Ingredients: chinese five spice powder,cake flour,feta,liquid smoke,chicken thigh,gluten flour
title: Gluten Free Onion Chicken Bundles
ingredients: 1 cup gluten-free flour | 3 tablespoons gluten-free flour | 1 pinch chinese five spice powder | 1 pinch liquid smoke | 3/4 cup greek seasoned cake flour ( i use good seasons ) | 1/2 cup feta, crumbled | chicken thigh ( or whatever else you have on hand )
instructions: In a mixing bowl combine all of the dry ingredients to make the gluten free flour. Add greek seasoning mix and liquid smoke and stir to make a thickener to cling to the meat. Dip the meat into the flour and then into the meat coating all sides of the meat. Place on a baking tray and bake at 200c for 45 - 60 minutes, until well browned and cooked. Serve with greek sauce or your favourite vegetables.

Random Ingredients: carrot,mexican cheese,chicken meat,splenda sugar substitute,veal,chicken stock,kiwi fruit,oregano
title: Low Fat Chicken Fondue
ingredients: 5 cups chicken stock | 2 teaspoons dried oregano | 1 1/2 lbs boneless skinless chicken meat, cut into 1 1/2-inch cubes | 8 ounces kiwi fruits, peeled and cut into 1-inch chunks | 2 carrots, cut into 1/2-inch pieces | 1/2 lb extra lean ground veal | 1/2 lb shredded mexican blend cheese | 1/2 teaspoon splenda sugar substitute ( optional )
instructions: Heat stock and oregano over medium high heat in a large pot.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon cube,phyllo pastry,dill pickle,cardamom pod,cheese
title: Beef Phyllo Cheese Rolls
ingredients: 4 lbs of thick sliced beef chunks | 1 lb cheese, grated | 1 large dill pickle, chopped very fine | 2 beef bouillon cubes | 2 teaspoons cardamom pods, pounded well | 1 package phyllo pastry sheets, pre-flour
instructions: Put beef cubes in a pan and pour in enough water to completely cover the beef. Add spices and bring to a boil, cover and simmer over low heat for 40 minutes until tender. Cut out the cheese in strips, and dice. While beef is cooking, make a meat sauce. Combine beef with sauce and let sit for 15 minutes. In a pan, over medium heat, put some of the beef and cheese mixture. Dip each sheet in melted butter and lay it on top of the other. Cover with more phyllo, and cover and cook over low heat about 10 minutes, until phyllo is golden and bubbly. Remove from heat after 10 seconds, and stack on top of each other on a platter. You can roll the filling ahead and store in the fridge.

title: Green Beans With Peppers
ingredients: 1/4 lb fresh green beans ( or frozen ) | 1 yellow bell pepper ( seeded, deveined and cut in 1-inch pieces ) | 1 tablespoon vanilla sugar ( or a few drops of vanilla extract in a drop of maple syrup ) or 1 tablespoon fresh almond milk powder ( or a few drops of vanilla extract in a drop of maple syrup )
instructions: Wash the green beans. Slice in half and remove any strings preventing them from falling apart. Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Drop in the green beans and quickly cook them covered for 5 minutes.. Pour off the water and set aside the green beans for a moment. Drain the beans then mix in a bowl with the yellow bell pepper and sugar. Let the mixture cool, stirring occasionally. Add the vanilla sugar and serve at once. If desired you can also pour almond or light cream in it.

Random Ingredients: virgin olive oil,bell pepper,greek yogurt,pecan,yellow pepper,cooking spray
title: Low Fat Greek Pepper Dip
ingredients: 1 package greek yogurt ( reduced fat is okay ) | 1 tablespoon virgin olive oil | 1/2 - 3/4 teaspoon pepper flake - crushed | 1/2 - 3/4 teaspoon hot yellow pepper, finely diced | 1/2 - 3/4 teaspoon bell pepper, finely diced | cooking spray, for pan
instructions: Prepare yoghurt by combining all ingredients in a bowl.

title: Couscous With Pineapple Shrimp & Grilled Prawns
ingredients: 1 box couscous | 1 cup ziti pasta | 1/2 cup pineapple chunks in juice | 2 prawns, peeled and deveined of all visible fat | 1 bag shredded pretzel
instructions: In a 3 3/4 to 1 quart bowl, stir 2 cups water with the ziti. Cover and set aside. When the water comes to a boil, add the ziti, then cover and reduce heat slightly. Simmer until tender, about 8 minutes. Stir in the pineapple. Meanwhile, heat grill to high. Thread the ziti onto a large grill stick, then sear on all sides until the ziti is hot. Do not overcook. Serve the ziti topped with the pineapples, then the shrimp and pretzels.

title: Fresnoisseur Apple Salad
ingredients: 2 tablespoons leeks, finely chopped | 2 apples, cored and sliced
instructions: Combine the leeks, apples and apple slices.

title: Beet Salad With Cumin and Balsamic
ingredients: 1 1/4 liters red beets, fresh | 4 teaspoons cumin powder | 1/2 cup grated beetroot
instructions: To make the dressing, add the grated beetroot.

Random Ingredients: flour tortilla,red pepper,creme de cassis,beef broth
title: Red Pepper Soup With Crispy Tortillas
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds red peppers, roasted, peeled and diced | 1 can beef broth | 8 flour tortillas, cut into 1/2 inch strips | creme de cassis ( optional )
instructions: In a large saucepan over medium high heat, combine the diced pepper and beef stock and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low. Simmer until the pepper is tender when pierced with a fork. Transfer the pepper mixture to a food processor or blender along with tortilla strips and puree. Transfer soup to a bowl and drizzle with creme de cassis. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: sun tomato oil,spaghetti,salsa verde,maple syrup,almond,eggplant,crisco,rice noodle
title: Spanish Stuffed Tomatoes
ingredients: 1/3 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil | 1 cup leftover cooked spaghetti | 12 large tomatoes | 1/4 cup pure maple syrup | 0.75 jar salsa verde | 0.75 package rice noodles | 1/4 cup sliced almonds | 3 tablespoons crisco | 2 eggs
instructions: Cut out inside of 2 large tomatoes to make room for the stuffing. Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Cook pasta according to package directions. Rinse with cold water and drain. Pat dry with paper towels. Cut the tops off the tomatoes using a small sharp knife and scoop out the core. Cut a thin slice from the bottom of each tomato. Using a teaspoon scoop out the pulp and seeds at the base of each. Place one tomato upside down on paper towels to drain. Remove seeds and pulp from the remaining 3 tomatoes. Place a tomato in the tomato cavity for each of the remaining tomatoes. Add the maple syrup to the pot along with the salsa verde and rice noodles. Dump the contents of the bowl into the pot and gently fold together. Cover with aluminum foil and cook on high heat to steam the sauce. In the meantime, melt the crisco in a small frying pan. Add the eggs to the pan and beat them slightly. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Drain the pasta. Divide the pasta among individual serving plates. Spoon the sauce over the pasta. Sprinkle with sliced almonds. Serve.

title: Butternut Squash With Pistachios and Beans
ingredients: 1 teaspoon canola oil | 1 medium butternut squash, peeled and cut into 1-inch pieces | 1/4 cup pistachios, coarsely chopped | 2 tablespoons canola oil | 2 tablespoons unsalted dry roasted pistachios | 1 can baked beans, drained and rinsed
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Heat 1 teaspoon canola oil in a small skillet until shimmering but not smoking, then add the squash and cook, stirring occasionally, until lightly browned, 5 to 8 minutes. Heat 1 teaspoon canola oil in a 9 inch skillet over medium heat, and cook pistachios and 1 tablespoon canola oil until fragrant, about 1 minute. Pour half the pistachios into a baking dish, sprinkle with pistachios, then top with squash and remaining pistachios. Drizzle 1 tablespoon canola oil over squash and pistachios, then top with baked beans. Bake in preheated oven until the squash is warm and flavors have blended, about 30 minutes.

title: Black Olive and Peanut Spread
ingredients: 150 g black olives, rinsed ( i prefer yellow ) | 350 g raw peanuts
instructions: Peel the peanuts and rinse them well. Put the peanuts in the bowl of an electric chopper or a food processor, and pulse or combine finely. If all is combined, put in a screw top jar and store in fridge for about one week, if possible. To serve, give a quick stir and dip the peanuts into the hot spread. They will be soft, they may stick. If you want to keep, store in a tightly covered container in the refrigerator. This spread will last a couple of weeks.

title: Black Bean Dip
ingredients: 2 cans black beans, drained and rinsed | 2 yellow onions, sliced | 1/2 cup hot sauce, or to taste | 4 slices country bread
instructions: Mix black beans, yellow onion, hot sauce, and slices of country bread together in a large bowl.

title: Aji
ingredients: 1 green bell pepper | 1 bell pepper | 1/4 cup aji-mexican sazon seasoning, < a href= '' https : //www.geniuskitchen.com/recipe/mate-avocado-seasoning-mix-with-mate-sauce-11783/ '' >mate-avocado-seasoning-mix-with-mate-avocado-seasoning-mix-with-mate-sauce-11783 '' > mama sauce with mexican-style sausage < /a >
instructions: To roast the aji, in a pan on medium high heat, add a couple of tablespoons of oil, and the green and red peppers and cook for 2 - 3 minutes, until the peppers are very soft and starting to lose all of their flavor. Drain and allow the aji to cool a bit. In a food processor, blend the green and red peppers. Add 1 tablespoon of aji ai seasonings to the bowl and mix to combine. Transfer the mixture to a serving plate and serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Fresh Peach Puree (Peachy)
ingredients: 1 cup sliced fresh peach | 1 teaspoon garam masala powder
instructions: Cut off end of peach. Slice peach into 8 thin wedges, about 1 inch thick. Combine garam masala powder and 1/4 cup water in a medium bowl.

Random Ingredients: chili powder,pork shoulder,peanut butter,plum tomato,mango chutney,golden raisin,picante sauce,flat leaf parsley
title: Jamaican Pork Loin
ingredients: 1 boneless pork shoulder, tied | 4 cups picante sauce | 1/2 cup reduced-fat peanut butter | 1/3 cup mango chutney | 1/4 cup golden raisin | 2 tablespoons smooth smooth vanilla-flavored molasses or 2 tablespoons hot chili powder | 1/4 cup chopped flat leaf parsley
instructions: Place pork in crockpot. Combine picante sauce, peanut butter, chutney, raisins, molasses, and parsley in a jar. Chill until serving. Remove pork and discard marinade. Place pork on foil lined broiler pan and broil 3 to 4 inches from heat, turning occasionally with tongs, until browned on all sides, about 8 minutes total.

Random Ingredients: black eyed pea,green onion,carrot,beef tenderloin,brown rice,chicken chunk,lettuce,brown sugar
title: Beef Tenderloin and Brown Rice
ingredients: 1 cup prepared brown rice | 4 beef tenderloin | 1 can chicken chunks, with liquid | 1/4 cup brown sugar | 1/4 cup sliced green onion | 1 cup shredded carrot | 1 can black-eyed peas, rinsed and drained | 1 cup shredded lettuce | 1/4 cup sliced green onion | 1/4 cup sliced carrot
instructions: Spray a 12x15 inch baking dish with cooking spray. Place rice, beef, chicken chunks, brown sugar, 1/4 cup sliced green onions, 1/4 cup shredded carrot, and black eyed peas in a medium bowl.

title: Cherry Tomato Salad
ingredients: 3 -4 cherry tomatoes | 6 -8 oyster mushrooms ( depending on size ) | 1 teaspoon vanilla | 200 g mixed salad greens
instructions: Wash salad. Mix chopped cherry tomatoes, sliced mushrooms, and a pinch of vanilla. Chill thoroughly. Mix all ingredients in a large serving bowl. Serve chilled.

title: Ramasu (Asian Noodle Salad)
ingredients: 3/4 cup natural bran | 2 packages ramen noodles ( without flavor packet, reserve seasoning packet ) | 2 shallots, minced
instructions: Combine bran and noodles in a small bowl.

Random Ingredients: blue cheese,nori,heavy whipping cream,tomato green chilies,cheddar cheese,cream celery soup,button mushroom,garlic powder
title: Pancake Casserole
ingredients: 3 cups nori, torn into pieces | 1 jar button mushrooms, sliced | 1 teaspoon garlic powder | 1/2 cup blue cheese, crumbled | 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream | 1 can condensed cream of celery soup, undiluted | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies, undrained | 1/2 cup cheddar cheese, shredded
instructions: Set oven rack to the lowest level in the oven. Grease a 9x13 inch baking dish. Place the torn nori in a single layer on a piece of foil with some of the excess. Cover each nori with a layer of the shredded cheese. Top with layers of the mushrooms and sprinkle garlic powder on the cheese. Cut a slit into the side of each tomato and place in a small mixing bowl. Mix the cream celery soup and cream of celery in a bowl with a fork or whisk. Stir the cream of celery soup mixture and the tomatoes with chilies into the creamed soup mixture. Pour the soup mixture evenly over the cheese. Top with remaining shredded cheese. Bake 45 minutes or until bubbly and lightly browned. Cool and refrigerate 3 - 4 hours.

title: Nigella's Easy, Easy and Tasty Basic Sauce
ingredients: 1 liter vegetable stock | 3 -4 teaspoons lemon juice ( zest of 2 lemon )
instructions: Heat the stock in a pan on medium heat. Stir in zest and lemon. Cover and leave to simmer for 20 minutes or until the stock thickens enough to coat a spoon.

Random Ingredients: phyllo pastry,bean sprout,blue cheese,creme de cassis liqueur,corn flake,garbanzo bean
title: Phyllo Pizza With a Blue Cheese and Garbanzo Bean Spread
ingredients: 1 package phyllo pastry, thawed according to package directions | 1 can garbanzo beans, drained, liquid reserved | 1 teaspoon corn flakes | 12 ounces crumbled blue cheese | 3 ounces creme de cassis liqueur | 2 -4 tablespoons crumbled corn flakes | 1/2 cup bean sprouts, rinsed and drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Line bottom and sides of 2 nine inch pizza pans with 1/2 the phyllo, trimming to fit pan and brush with a little melted butter. Spread garbanzo beans across bottom of pan. Sprinkle cornflakes over the beans and top with blue cheese. Top with remaining 1/2 the phyllo, brush with butter, spread with cornflakes and sprinkle with bean sprouts. Bake in the preheated oven for about 35 minutes, or until phyllo is golden and bubbling.

Random Ingredients: sea salt,superfine sugar,fryer chicken,beef stew meat,soymilk
title: Homemade Sweet Soy-Free Barbecue Chicken
ingredients: 1 fryer chickens, cut up | 1 tablespoon superfine sugar | 1 pinch sea salt | 1 cup soy milk | 1/2 cup whole raw unboiled unbleached farina or 1/2 cup raw farina
instructions: Place chicken, sugar and salt in a bowl that is big enough to fit the cleaned fryer chickens. Mix together the soy milk and farina in a measuring cup and pour into the cavity of the chicken and place in a small saucepan. Bring to a boil over medium heat, stirring once or twice. Reduce heat.

title: Spiced Cheddar Cheese Dip
ingredients: 1/2 lb old cheddar cheese | 1/2 cup light black vinegar | 1 dash turmeric powder
instructions: Crumble cheddar into a bowl. Mix vinegar and turmeric and pour into a bowl. Add 1/2 of the cheese to the bowl and mix. Add remaining cheese and mix well. Serve with corn chips.

Random Ingredients: orange zest,nut almond,rice vinegar,white cake mix,rum,red pepper flake
title: Pina Colada Rum Cake
ingredients: 1 package white cake mix | 1/2 teaspoon grated orange zest | 1/4 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 1 cup rum | 1/4 cup light rum | 1/4 cup rice vinegar | 2/3 cup chopped toasted nuts ( almonds, pecans, hazelnuts, hazelnuts )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f. Prepare cake mix according to package directions. Drain, reserving about 1/2 cup rum. Stir rum, light rum, rice vinegar and dried fruit together in a saucepot until evenly combined. Set aside. Pour reserved rum into a shallow, 10 inch round or square baking dish, to within 1 inch of the rim. Sprinkle nuts evenly over the rum. Spread the rum batter over the nuts. Bake for 45 to 55 minutes, or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean. Cool and remove from dish, place on a serving plate, and allow to cool completely. Serve warm.

title: Easy Homemade Phyllo Bites
ingredients: 150 g frozen phyllo dough | 2 cups soymilk or 2 cups milk | 3 tablespoons instant dried onion flakes | salt | hot paprika
instructions: Combine water, milk and seasonings in microwave safe bowl and set aside. Spray an oven tray with cooking spray and set aside for later. Place the thawed phyllo dough in the bowl with the water. Cover with a clean cloth and add a few drops of mustard oil, and spread a little soysilk/miso paste on the phyllo. Leave to rise for 30 minutes. Once risen, remove all phyllo from the bowl after phyllo has risen. Line a cookie sheet with foil with parchment paper. Place the phyllo sheets on the foil on a flat surface. Cover with the parchment and phyllo sheet. Spray tops of the sheets with more cooking spray.

Random Ingredients: mung bean,shell pasta,white sugar,walnut,parmigiano reggiano cheese
title: Mung Beans and Nuts (Stir-Fry Nuts)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons chopped walnuts | 2 tablespoons grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 2 tablespoons ground mung beans | 2 tablespoons white sugar | 1 package shell pasta
instructions: Place walnuts on a baking sheet. Bake at 400 degrees f for 5 to 7 minutes, stirring halfway through. Preheat the oven broiler. In a medium skillet over medium heat, melt the parmigiano reggiano cheese, mung beans and sugar. Stir until the mixture is well combined. Remove from the heat when the parmigiano cheese has turned golden. Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil. While the water is heating, cook the shell pasta in the boiling water for 8 to 10 minutes, or until al dente.

title: Moroccan Cauliflower and Cashews
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower, cut into florets | 4 cups raw cashews | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil | 1 teaspoon roasted rice | 1/4 teaspoon ground rosemary | 1/4 teaspoon ground black cumin
instructions: Place the cauliflower into a pot and cover with water. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer until tender, about 25 minutes. Drain, then transfer cauliflower to a bowl. Place the cashews into a skillet and cook over medium heat, stirring constantly until brown, about 1 minute. Heat both oils in a saucepan over medium heat. Stir in the rice and cook, stirring, until the grains change color. Stir in the dried spices, adding more to taste, if desired. Spoon into bowls and serve warm.

Random Ingredients: sesame seed,velveeta cheese,maraschino cherry,cottage cheese,tuna,cream cheese,feta cheese,marjoram
title: Tuna and Cheese Ball
ingredients: 15 ounces tuna, drained and flaked | 3 ounces soft cream cheese or 7/8 ounces milk cheese | 1 package velveeta cheese, cut into little peices | 1/4 teaspoon marjoram | 1/2 teaspoon sesame seeds | 3 ounces feta cheese | 1/4 cup cottage cheese | 1/4 teaspoon dried marjoram | 1/4 teaspoon marjoram | 1/8 teaspoon marjoram | 1/8 teaspoon toasted sesame seeds | toasted sesame seeds, for garnish ( or sun dried or dried cranberries )
instructions: Combine all ingredients thoroughly. Form into a ball. Refrigerate in a covered container overnight. Drain off excess water. Put mixture into a ball or a crockpot for a party. Sprinkle with more marjoram. Add sesame seeds when serving. Sprinkle with toasted sesame seeds and refrigerate.

Random Ingredients: salmon fillet,clove,peanut oil vegetable,sage leaf,fontina cheese,stewing beef,kidney bean
title: Stoved Fillet of Salmon With Kidney Beans and St. Pat's Bread
ingredients: 4 salmon fillets ( each weighing about 600g ) | 2 ounces stale st. pat's bread, crusts trimmed | 2 teaspoons peanut oil or 2 teaspoons vegetable oil | 1 teaspoon dried sage leaves, crushed | 1/2 lb dried kidney beans, soaked overnight in | 1 cup water | 2 tablespoons shredded fontina cheese or 2 tablespoons gruyere cheese
instructions: Cut the fillets horizontally through the centre of the fillets, trimming away any excess bone and cutting through the thicker spine until it is all cut into 3/4 inch slices. Soak the bread in a bowl of cold water until softened, then squeeze out excess liquid. Cut into thick slices, about 1 1/2 inches wide. Lay the salmon slices on a board or platter, and spread each slice with crumpled butter, seasoning generously with salt and pepper. Sprinkle over the dried kidney beans and a little shredded cheese. Starting with the base of each slice, top with a criss cross pattern of dried herbs. Starting on the outside edge of the platter, roll the open end of the slice of fish snugly in the herb mixture.

Random Ingredients: capsicum,provolone cheese,vegetable oil cooking spray,tomato green chile pepper,red potato
title: Chile-Cheese Rosti
ingredients: 2 red potatoes, unpeeled and cut into chunks | vegetable oil cooking spray | 2 can chopped tomatoes with green chile peppers | 1 tablespoon finely diced capsicum | 1/4 teaspoon finely diced provolone cheese
instructions: Preheat a deep frying pan over medium high heat. Spray potato chunks with oil and place in pan. Cook, stirring continuously, for five minutes, until golden. Remove from the pan and drain onto a paper towel lined plate. Turn heat to high and add tomatoes, capsicum and cheese. Stir to combine, then leave undisturbed for a few minutes to wilt the cheese. Season with cracked black pepper.

title: Salmon Noodle Bowl for One
ingredients: 1 lb salmon | noodles ( prepared, to accompany ) | hot pepper sauce
instructions: Heat the noodles according to package directions, and then cut salmon in bite size pieces. Serve sauce over noodles and top with the hot sauce.

title: Irish Macaroni Salad
ingredients: 8 ounces uncooked farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta | 28 ounces condensed tomato soup | 2 medium shallots, minced | 1 medium red cabbage, cut into wedges | 1 cup snow peas, halved lengthwise and then crosswise in half
instructions: Cook pasta for desired doneness as directed on package.

title: Tuna Beans & French Fennel
ingredients: 1 can of undrained tuna | 1 can french onion soup ( fat free, low sodium ) | 2 fennel bulbs, whole with fronds only, cut into chunks | 1 can bean sprouts

instructions: Pre heat oven at 180f. Dry roast or grill meat. Add greek cheese and mix. Add beef broth and turmeric if desired.

title: Cheesy Chili Sauce
ingredients: 1 can cheddar cheese | 1 -2 serrano pepper, chopped or 3 serrano peppers, diced
instructions: In a large frypan or large deep fryer, melt the cheese over medium heat. Remove the cheese from the frypan by placing it on to a plate. Dip the top of the chili pepper or other hot pepper in the hot cheese. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: chocolate bar,italian seasoning,passion fruit pulp,dill pickle,couscous
title: Couscous Stuffed With Diced Pears
ingredients: 1 cup couscous | 2 small pats chocolate bars | 2 tablespoons dried dill pickles | 1 teaspoon dried italian seasoning | 1 passion fruit pulp
instructions: Place 3/4 cup water in a saucepan and bring to a boil over medium high heat. Add rice or couscous and stir to coat. Reduce heat, cover, and simmer for about 20 minutes, or until grains are soft and grains are tender. Melt chocolate in a double boiler placed on top of boiling water and stir over low heat until chocolate is melted and mixture is smooth. Drain cooked couscous and let cool. When cool, drain off all liquid. In a mixing bowl, combine cheese, pickles, and italian seasoning. Fill couscous with cheese mixture. Chill until hard, about 15 minutes.

title: Easy Spanish-Spiced Barbecue Sauce
ingredients: 32 black cardamom pods, cracked ( white parts only ) | 1 cup chunky salsa, such as pace | 1/2 cup marsala wine ( optional )
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the black cardamom pods and chunky salsa. Cover, and refrigerate until serving. In a small saucepan over medium heat, combine the barbeque sauce, marsala wine and cardamom pods. Whisk frequently until heated through, about 2 minutes.

title: Riviera Tramorella With Raspberries
ingredients: 7 tablespoons semishell pasta or 7 tablespoons bow tie pasta | 2 cans raspberries, drained | 1 lb idaho potato | 1 lb ladyfingers | 6 tablespoons unsalted pistachio nuts | fresh raspberry, garnish
instructions: Dice raspberries and potatoes. Bring 4 quarts of salted water to a boil over high heat and add noodles.

Random Ingredients: phyllo pastry,part mozzarella cheese,cognac,tomato green chilies,basmati rice
title: Portuguese-style Alouette
ingredients: 2 cups basmati rice, rinsed | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies, drained | 1/4 cup cognac | 3 sheets phyllo pastry | 1 1/3 cups shredded part-skim mozzarella cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place rice, tomatoes, and cognac in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Layer 1/3 th of the phyllo sheets on top of rice mixture, brushing each sheet twice with butter. Pour half of the tomato juice over all. Sprinkle half the mozzarella cheese over the pie. Cover with the remaining phyllo sheets. Bake in the preheated oven 45 minutes, or until rice is puffed and browned. Let stand 5 minutes before slicing.

title: Spiced Avocado Dip
ingredients: 1 avocado - peeled, pitted, and sliced | 2 cans red beans, drained | 1/4 cup pesto sauce, or as needed
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium high heat. Stir red beans, pesto sauce, and avocado slices into the skillet.

Random Ingredients: scallion,peanut,chipotle powder,vegetable oil cooking spray,snap pea,beef gravy
title: Quick Beef Tips & Snap Pea (Ww)
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 2 tablespoons snap peas | 1 teaspoon chipotle powder ( or chili powder, if you choose ) | 1/4 cup steak gravy ( or your favorite gravy ) | 1/4 cup scallion, sliced | 2 tablespoons unsalted dry roasted peanuts, chopped
instructions: Spray a large non stick skillet lightly with oil and heat over medium heat. Add snap peas & chipotle powder & cook until snap peas are soft, 30 seconds, stirring constantly, about 1 minute. Add steak & gravy and cook, stirring constantly, until gravy has thickened and snap peas are crisp tender, about 3 minutes. If necessary, slightly thicken with enough gravy to your taste & transfer to a small bowl. Heat a wok over high heat. When very hot, add oil, then add snap peas & scallions & stir fry until fragrant, 1 - 2 minutes. Add peanuts, stirring until nuts are slightly browned, then remove veggies from wok. Serve notes, this freezes well, & the gravy seems even more flavorful when reheated.

title: Liangban Hu (Chilled Bean Sauce)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups bean sauce | 1/4 cup chicken flavored cornstarch
instructions: Mix the cornstarch and water or beans together. Stir until the cornstarch is disolved. If too thick, add a little water. Heat in a small pot and boil for a few moments. Remove from heat and serve as a dipping sauce.

title: Roasted Eggplant
ingredients: 1 eggplant | 3 large egg yolks | 2 large egg yolks | 2 tablespoons dry sherry | 8 sage leaves
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f coat the eggplant generously with olive oil. Place them on a baking sheet sprayed with the pam and skin. Roast for about 1 hour and turn with tongs to coat evenly. Set the oven temperature at 450°f allow the flesh to rest for 20 minutes before slicing and serving.

title: Sage Lima Beans
ingredients: 400 g dried lima beans | 400 g black beans | 200 g fresh sage leaves
instructions: Wash the beans in a sieve, then soak in plenty of water overnight. Drain the beans, then place them in a heavy based pan with water to three fourths of the depth, bring down the heat to simmer and cook until tender and easily pierced with a knife, about two hours. Drain and then add to a saucepan the cooked lima beans and fresh sage, and simmer, stirring until the beans are very soft.

title: Famous Cabbage and Pepper Packets (Fancy Packets)
ingredients: 1 large head cabbage ( about 4 pounds ) | 1 large yellow bell peppers or 1 large green bell pepper, seeded, coarsely chopped or 4 large red bell peppers
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Slice the head of cabbage lengthwise into 12 long strips or thin slivers. The length should be about 2 inches wide. You will probably have about 3 1/2 layers. Place the whole bell pepper on a baking sheet, cut side up or on a foil lined baking sheet. Sprinkle the cut tops with salt. Bake the peppers just until they're starting to soften, about 8 minutes.

title: Mexican Artichoke Soup
ingredients: 4 tablespoons cooking oil | 1 can stewed mexican-style corn | 1 can chicken consomme | 1 can mexicorn, drained | 2 -3 scallions, thinly cut | 1/4 cup chopped manchego cheese | 1/2 cup buttermilk or 1/2 cup milk
instructions: Wash corn well in cold water. Drain. Heat oil in non stick skillet over medium high heat. Add corn and sautee 3 - 4 minutes or until corn is a pale mahogany color. Add the consomme, cheese, scallions and mexicorn. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium and simmer 4 - 5 minutes. Serve topped with hot buttermilk.

title: Simple Chipotle Spread
ingredients: 16 ounces chipotle chiles, canned diced | 1 cup fresh basil | 1 cup paprika
instructions: Combine all ingredients in food processor and process until smooth. Serve with bread.

title: Grilled Peachy Turkey Breasts With Chocolate Sauce
ingredients: 2 medium firm ripe peaches, sliced very thinly | 1 can sliced bamboo shoots, drained | 1/2 cup low fat soymilk | 1 teaspoon mild asafoetida powder | 1 tablespoon peach schnapps | 3/4 cup unsweetened cocoa, divided | 6 ounces cooked turkey breast, very thinly sliced
instructions: Preheat indoor grill to medium hot. Combine peach rings, bamboo shoots, soy milk, asafoetida and peach schnapps in a small bowl. Divide each slice of turkey among four serving plates. Spoon 2 tablespoons of the chocolate sauce onto each plate. Top with remaining slices of turkey and divide remaining sauce between each serving.

title: Oysters on the Edge of the Sea (Scrod)
ingredients: 1 lb oyster ( with shellfish tentacles if you can find them ) | 2 tablespoons vegetable ( optional ) | 12 slices spearmint ( or about 12 leaves of about 2 1/2 inches long ) | 1/4 lb dry spaghettini ( or other pastas, in small pieces )
instructions: First clean the oysters, if using. Rinse the shells and shuck them.

Random Ingredients: guacamole,lasagna noodle,enchilada sauce,penne pasta,white chocolate,cooking apple,banana
title: Cannelloni Baked
ingredients: 12 lasagna noodles | 12 ounces white chocolate | 1 ounce chopped banana | 1 quick-cooking apple, chopped | 5 ounces dry penne pasta | 1 can enchilada sauce | guacamole
instructions: Line the bottom of a baking dish with baking paper spray. Place a spoonful of enchilada sauce on the bottom of a 9x13 baking dish. Put a layer of noodles on top of sauce, then a layer of sliced apple, then a layer of white chocolate. Continue layers until all noodles are used. Sprinkle on 1 teaspoon of chopped banana, then place another layer of noodles on top. Place the remaining 1 teaspoon of chopped banana on top of the noodles. Cover with more baking paper then foil. Bake at 475f for 30 - 40 minutes or until the noodles are browned and soft. Remove foil, top with guacamole, and bake 5 more minutes until the guacamole is melted and piping hot.

Random Ingredients: wheat flour tortilla,fontina cheese,water chestnut,beef steak,lemon zest,mexican tomato
title: Spanish Steak Wrap or Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 lb thinly sliced beef round steak | 1 can chopped water chestnuts, drained | 1 can sliced mexican-style stewed tomatoes | 8 warm whole wheat flour tortillas | 1/8 teaspoon lemon zest | 1/2 cup shredded fontina cheese
instructions: Combine beef and the next 6 ingredients in a shallow 1 1/2 quart non stick skillet, bring to boil, reduce heat and cook, covered, stirring occasionally until liquid has evaporated and mixture is bubbly, about 3 minutes. Transfer beef mixture to a cutting board and shred beef with 2 forks.

Random Ingredients: almond extract,potato chip,onion flake,beef shank,serrano pepper,nutritional yeast
title: Noodles & Beef Strips
ingredients: 2 large beef shank ( about 3 1/2 pounds ) | 1/4 cup instant potato chips | 1 tablespoon dried onion flakes | 1 tablespoon dried minced serrano peppers | 3/4 teaspoon almond extract | 1/3 cup nutritional yeast
instructions: Slice beef very thin with a meat mallet and slice across grain about 3/4 inch thick. Sprinkle on salt and pepper. Place beef slices in a mixing bowl. Add potato chips, dehydrate onion, serrano pepper, almond extract and nutritional yeast. Mix everything together. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Drain beef slices on paper towels and place strips in a plastic bag. Put beef back into bag. Remove plastic bag and add dry ingredients. Toss to mix. Place in refrigerator. Turn oven to 375 degrees. Place a damp towel on a baking sheet and place in preheated oven until a deep golden brown about 45 minutes. Remove from oven and let sit 10 minutes before serving.

title: Aussie Chili Powder
ingredients: 1 can chili, drained | 1 teaspoon curry powder | 1 teaspoon thyme, dried | 2 small lemons, zested | 1/2 cup confectioners'sugar | 1 1 lb bulk breakfast sausage
instructions: Brown sausage in skillet. Put sausage in small bowl.

title: Mexican Cheese Dip from Scratch
ingredients: 1 can whole kernel corn, drained | 1 package grated sharp cheddar cheese
instructions: Mix corn, cheddar cheese, and 1 cup of water in a saucepan or bowl until well blended. Reduce heat to low.

title: Iranian Cucumber Salad & Roast Beef (Shahi Batoma)
ingredients: 1 lb fresh roast ( the type of meat ) | 3 -5 cucumbers, sliced and sliced thin or cut into small squares ( you can also use zucchini ) | 1/4 cup cooking oil
instructions: Marinate all ingredients except for the beef in the fridge for about 2 - 2 1/2 to 3 hours. Cook the beef in the cooking oil on low temperature, or medium low heat cook until it's cooked thoroughly, and let it rest 10 minutes. While the beef is sitting slice or dice the cucumbers into thin, bite sized pieces and place them in a bowl. Cut beef into thin slices then add the diced cucumbers to the bowl. Combine well the cucumbers are hot, and serve immediately.

title: Basic Sesame Broa
ingredients: 1 cup sesame seeds | 1 tablespoon mirin ( rice wine or low-sodium japanese sake )
instructions: Soak sesame seeds in a glass of hot water for 3 hours or longer. Dry the sesame and place them in a bowl of ice water. Place a pot on the stove or portable tabletop and add enough water to cover the sesame. Boil 1 hour. Drain the soaking sesame and place them in a dry glass bowl or plastic bag. Add all of the rice wine or sake and mix well. This will keep the mixture from drying completely. Cool completely and store in the refrigerator. You may have to adjust ingredients to taste.

title: Chinese Lamb Salad With Snow Peas #5FIX
ingredients: 1 lb lamb shoulder | 2 packages frozen snow peas | 1/2 teaspoon anise seed
instructions: Pierce lamb 3/4 way through with a fork. Mix seasoning on lamb. Add peas. Cook in microwave 2 to 3 minutes to thaw. Remove peas, cool.

title: Poultry Tarts
ingredients: 1 pie shells | 1 cup fresh snow pea | 1 teaspoon poultry seasoning
instructions: Turn oven to 425 degrees f. Roll out the pie crust on a floured board. Cut out circles. In a saucepan or in a small bowl, combine the snow peas, poultry seasoning, and a little water. Cook on medium high until peas are soft, and snow peas are tender. Fill each pastry shell half full with the snow peas.

Random Ingredients: haddock,beef sirloin,rye bread,cremini mushroom,purple onion,yellow pepper
title: Irish Beef Haddock Sandwiches
ingredients: 4 slices rye bread | 2 tablespoons chopped purple onions | 2 tablespoons chopped yellow peppers | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh mushrooms | 4 ounces cooked corned beef sirloin, sliced | 4 ounces cooked halibut, thinly sliced
instructions: Spread one side of each bread slice with chopped onion, pepper, mushrooms and sirloin. Top with remaining bread slices. Serve as sandwiches.

Random Ingredients: balsamic vinegar,beef chuck,soy sauce,pepper,linguine,cream mushroom soup,black bean
title: Linguine Beef
ingredients: 3 lbs beef chuck, cut in 1 inch chunks | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1/2 cup soy sauce | 1/3 cup balsamic vinegar | 1 1/4 lbs linguine | 1 can black beans, rinsed and drained | pepper
instructions: In a dutch oven, combine soup, soy sauce, vinegar& pepper. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer 1 hour. Cook linguine according to package directions, drain & keep hot. Add meat to soup mixture & simmer until heated throughout. Serve over cooked linguine.

title: Crispy Spinach Leaves
ingredients: 1/2 small white cabbage, finely chopped | 2 bags fresh baby spinach
instructions: Place all ingredients except for the crisply packed cabbage into a blender, cover, and put on high for 5 minutes, or until the greens are slightly wilted. If the mixture is too dry to eat immediately, turn the mixture on to low until it takes on the texture of spinach. When the spinach has been added, turn the mixture on to high. Add 1/4 cup water if too wet. Cook on low for a few minutes.

Random Ingredients: russet potato,fish sauce,panela cheese,cabbage,rice noodle,cooking spray
title: Fritters With Potato, Cabbage and Panela
ingredients: 2 large russet potatoes, peeled and sliced lengthwise in half ( about 8 ounces ) | 1 bunch cabbage, about 8 ounces, thinly sliced ( about 4 cups ) | 1/2 cup thinly sliced panela cheese | cooking spray | 1 cup cooked rice noodles ( preferably chunky or fettucine ) | 1 tablespoon fish sauce
instructions: In a 4 to 5 quart slow cooker, combine potatoes, cabbage, cheese and 3 1/2 tablespoons water.

title: Pumpkin and Red Wine Filled Cannelloni
ingredients: 12 ladyfingers | 1 cup dry red wine | 1 package pumpkin puree | 1 1/2 tablespoons dried parsley | 1 teaspoon garlic powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place lady fingers in a baking dish. Pour wine over the lady fingers. Mix pumpkin, parsley, garlic powder, and parsley together in a bowl. Spread mixture over soaked lady fingers. Bake 35 minutes in the preheated oven, or until golden brown.

title: French Dip Roast Beef Appetizer
ingredients: 500 g top round roast lean | 400 g pear slices ( fresh, peeled or canned or canned ) | 1 cup fresh bay leaf
instructions: Wear rump steak out of tin foil if using canned pear slices, cut off any damaged pieces. Place beef in casserole dish. Spread pear slices over the top of roast, season with salt and pepper. Gently roll the beef around the meat. Add bay leaf. Cover and bake at 160c for 2 hours. Strain liquid from casserole and place onto a warmed serving plate. Serve with crostini and fresh seasonal vegetables.

title: Aussie Lamb Rivels
ingredients: 8 lbs lamb shoulder | 4 tablespoons cocoa powder | 1 -2 cup buttermilk | 1/2 - 3/4 ounce mixed spice ( your favorite flavour, such as curry powder, chipotle powder, cayenne etc. you can also use cumin! ) | 1/4 - 1/2 cup chopped tomato ( as garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Brown meat in butter. Drain off any excess fat. Combine the rest of the ingredients in a saucepan and bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer very gently for 20 minutes. Place on large platter and garnish with tomato slices just before serving or serve separately. Serve with buttermilk or beer.

title: Aioli
ingredients: 3 tablespoons tamarind pulp | 6 -9 tablespoons chicken bouillon
instructions: Crush tamarind with your hands to a fine powder. Mix the lumps with a little chicken stock or water until the aioli is completely dissolved. Chill. Store in the refrigerator.

title: Pork Souffle
ingredients: 3/4 cup fat free ricotta | 3/4 cup soymilk | 1/2 cup diced pork tenderloin | 1 tablespoon chili pepper flakes | 1 tablespoon grated velveeta cheese
instructions: Mix ricotta, soy milk and chili peppers in a bowl. Add pork and toss until combined. Mixture should be moist but thick. Transfer to the refrigerator to chill. When ready to assemble, heat a griddle or skillet over medium heat. Spray with nonstick cooking spray. Ladle about 1/2 cup of the meat mixture into the griddle or skillet. Reduce heat to medium and cook just until the filling begins to brown, about 2 minutes. Stir in velvetta and heat through, about 1 more minute. Serve immediately.

title: Sweet Baby Spinach
ingredients: 1 bag baby spinach | 2 tablespoons confectioners'sugar | 1 tablespoon palm sugar, or to taste
instructions: Place spinach in a large pot and cover with water.

Random Ingredients: cream celery soup,pepper,beef bouillon granule,tomato green chile pepper,cold water,chicken stock
title: Crock Pot Beef  Salsa
ingredients: 2 lbs extra lean ground beef | 2 cans cream of celery soup, undiluted ( campbell's ) | 6 tablespoons cold water | 4 teaspoons beef bouillon granules | 1 can stewed tomatoes and green chile peppers, drained | 1/2 teaspoon pepper
instructions: In a 5 to 6 quart crock pot combine the beef, soup, water, bouillon & pepper. Cover & cook on low about 6 to 8 hours, or on high 4 to 5 hours.

title: Apple and Mango Gratin
ingredients: 2 cups heavy cream | 1/2 cup chablis-style red wine ( cabernet sauvignon ) | 2 lbs chicken thighs, cut into 1-inch pieces, skin on | 2 large gala apples ( such as granny smith smith ) or 2 lbs other tart apples ( such as granny smith ) | 1/4 cup dried cranberries | 8 slices italian bread, split and toasted
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f degrees. Warm the cream in a heavy large ovenproof sauté pan over medium, stirring occasionally, until it starts to thicken. Bring to a boil, reduce the heat to low, and place the chicken in the cream. Simmer, covered, for 20 minutes. Remove from the heat. Toss the apple with the cranberries for 10 minutes, then remove and discard the apples. Remove the chicken from the pan and arrange in one layer in a single layer on a baking sheet. Drizzle any remaining cream over the chicken. Bake, uncovered, for 20 minutes, or until cooked all the way through. Remove and place the wine in a medium saucepan, deglaze with the cider, and cook uncovered over medium heat, until the volume is reduced to about half. Remove from the heat and set aside. Place the chicken on serving plates and spoon some gala apple sauce over. Spoon the remaining gala apple sauce over and around the chicken, and serve with the toasted bread.

Random Ingredients: sausage meat,chocolate chip,jalapeno,no boil lasagna noodle,fine egg noodle,cocoa powder,beef rib
title: Slow Cooker Beef Rib & Sausage Noodles
ingredients: 3 1/2 lbs country-style beef ribs | 1 jar mild jalapenos, drained, seeded and chopped | 12 ounces sweet plain chocolate chips | 3 ounces no-boil lasagna noodles | 2 1/2 cups fine egg noodles | 2 2/3 tablespoons fine egg noodles | 2 teaspoons unsweetened cocoa powder or 2 teaspoons baking cocoa | 1 tablespoon unsalted butter or 1 tablespoon margarine
instructions: Cut crosswise down the center of each rib to expose bones of meat. In slow cooker, combine ribs with chopped jalapenos, chocolate, 3/4 cup of noodles, and 1/4 cup chocolates. Cover and cook on low setting 6 hours if using a crock pot, or 4 hours on high setting. When meat is fork tender. Discard skin and ribs. If using a crockpot, reduce cooking time to high setting, and add remaining ingredients. Cover and cook on high setting or low setting 5 hours, or until noodles are hot and mixture is thickened to a sauce consistency. During last 30 minutes, prepare noodles and spoon sauce over meat.

title: Fragrant Summer Dressing With Tomatoes, Grape Tomatoes, and Raspberries
ingredients: 4 large fresh dates, chopped | 2 pints grape tomatoes, halved and seeded | 1 cup vegetable stock | 2 teaspoons raspberry vinegar
instructions: Combine all ingredients in the container of a blender. Puree to desired consistency.

title: Noodle Pancake (Dorie Greenspan)
ingredients: 1 lb broad egg noodles | 1/2 cup brown sugar | 1/2 cup dry egg noodles
instructions: Preheat oven to 400f degrees. Cook noodles to desired tenderness, drain and set aside. Meanwhile, heat a non stick skillet on medium high heat. When the skillet is hot, add sugar and noodles to the skillet and stir until the noodles are coated with sugar/flour mixture. Turn the pancake onto a large dinner plate. Place pancake in oven, uncovered, for 20 - 25 minutes. When pancake is done, remove from oven and let rest for 5 - 10 minutes. Cut into small squares and serve.

Random Ingredients: canola oil,heavy whipping cream,cream chicken soup,white bread
title: French Toast With Creamy Tomato Sauce
ingredients: 3 teaspoons canola oil | 2 slices white bread | 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1 cup heavy whipping cream
instructions: Heat a large skillet on the stove over medium high heat. Brush the canola oil on one side of the two slices of bread, and stack them. Using the canola oil, lightly brown the bread on both sides. The idea is to have a bit of an even amount of olive oil and a piece of bread that is not being soggy, not dry toasty. While browning the pieces toast the other side of the bread, making sure that the pieces don't burn and cook evenly. Set aside. Pour the soup in the skillet and heat until it is hot. While the soup is heating, put the cream in a bowl. Melt the cream butter in a separate bowl, but not all the way to get it foamy. When the soup has reached a medium saucdeble, remove it from the heat and stir in the cream to warm it up a bit. Pour this over the bread and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: onion powder,vegetable oil,kidney bean,sausage,sun tomato oil,portabella mushroom
title: Prawns Italiano
ingredients: 3 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1 onion, diced | 1 package sausage, diced | 1 package portabella mushrooms, sliced | 1 can kidney beans ( drained and rinsed ) | 1 teaspoon powdered sun-dried tomato packed without oil | 2 teaspoons onion powder
instructions: Heat oil in frying pan. Add onion, mushroom, and sausage.

Random Ingredients: ginger garlic paste,caraway seed,green chili pepper,porcini mushroom
title: Ethiopian Mushroom
ingredients: 1 ounce dried porcini mushrooms | 2 teaspoons caraway seeds, ground | 1 fresh green chili pepper, chopped | 1 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste
instructions: Remove the stems and any remaining hard parts from the mushrooms by rubbing the mushrooms with a little salt in the cloth. Combine the dried mushrooms with the ground caraway seeds and the chili pepper. Heat a nonstick skillet over low heat. When nearly smoking add the ginger garlic paste. When fragrant add the contents of the mortar and pestle. Pour the ingredients into the pan and fry over low heat stirring periodically until the ingredients are reduced by about half to about half. This is ready when they are a deep, dark reddish color.

title: Bacon-Filled Cucumbers With Chicken and Pasta Salad
ingredients: 2 tablespoons finely minced bacon bits | 1 cup mayonnaise | 3/4 cup fine semolina | 1 1/2 cups minced cooked chicken | 1 whole cucumber ( medium sized, seeded and diced ) | sliced cucumber ( to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Bacon mayonnaise dressing, cook the bacon until crisp. Take care not to burn. Combine 1/4 cup of the bacon fat with the mayonnaise and semolina. Stir over medium heat until mixture is blended. Cook, stirring constantly with a wooden spoon, for 5 minutes, and remove from heat. Meanwhile, steam the chicken until no longer pink, and cool slightly. Using a vegetable peeler or sharp knife, peel off and discard the white layer of fat. Cut the reserved bacon fat in small pieces. Add the chicken to the mayonnaise, along with the cucumber and crumbled bacon bits. Taste and adjust the seasonings, if necessary with a little more mayonnaise. Serve warm, garnish with cucumbers.
