title: Pesto Hotpot
ingredients: 8 3/4 cups vegetable stock ( or canned stock plus 3 t ) | 1/4 cup prepared pesto sauce, < a href= '' https : //www.geniuskitchen.com/recipe/pesto-hotpotato-473833 '' > pistou pesto < /a >
instructions: To make hotpot put stock and pesto in saucepan and heat on'stirring often' until mixture comes to a full boil. Then turn off the heat and allow to sit for about 5 minutes. Strain hotpot through a fine sieve if desired and serve hot.

title: Italian Chili Sauce
ingredients: 1 habanero pepper, seeded, deveined and finely chopped | 10 ounces sweet wine | 3 tablespoons amaretto ( almond flavoured liqueur )
instructions: In a small saucer, toss the habanero pepper with enough amaretto to coat the chili.

title: Flamme Creme Fraiche With Thyme!
ingredients: 300 ml creme fraiche, good quality ( a full-fat, low-fat, non-alcoholic flu ) | fresh thyme sprig
instructions: Make the creme fraiche at least four hours before serving. The consistency should be like a very thin creme fraiche. Cover and leave overnight if you can. Just before serving, stir in the thyme. If the sour cream is too thick, add small amounts of water. Serve on french rolls, bread or toast.

title: Kesra
ingredients: 2 cups semolina ( besan ) | 2 teaspoons msg or 1/2 teaspoon accent seasoning
instructions: Heat a dry pan without oil on medium high. Toss in the kesra and fry for 2 minutes. Do not stir. Remove from heat and sprinkle with msg/ Accent seasoning. Cover tightly and set aside for about 10 minutes. Cut into squares and serve hot. Enjoy note, i often add a few drops of lemon juice or a dash of crushed almonds during the cooking process.

title: Hot Chili Pepper Paste
ingredients: 3 tablespoons chili paste, see hot chili paste ( hot chile powder for chilean empanadas ) | 1 tablespoon red chili pepper flakes
instructions: Mix the ingredients together with a fork and form balls in your hands, about 1 1/2 inches in diameter. Cook the hot chili paste in a skillet over med/low heat, stirring, until fragrant but not browned, about 2 minutes or so. Serve with warm, crusty french bread or fresh bread.

title: Lamb and Sausage Casserole
ingredients: 4 sausages | 1/2 lb lamb | 1/2 lb plain yogurt | 1 tablespoon corn oil | 1 tablespoon craisins | 2 ounces green chilies, chopped | 3 tablespoons andouille sausages
instructions: Brown andouille sausages and lamb. Add 1 tbsp water. Heat a little. Grease an ovenproof casserole dish. Cover, sprinkle with the craisins and chillies. Put in the sausages. Cover with yogurt. Bake at 350 for 1 hour or until done. Serve with salad.

title: Walnut Puffs
ingredients: 1 egg white | 1/3 cup ketchup | 1/3 cup coarsely ground walnuts
instructions: Beat the egg whites and the ketchup together in a small, heavy skillet. Add the walnuts and continue to beat on medium for 2 minutes. Drop the walnuts by spoonfuls onto a paper towel lined cookie sheet, allowing room for spreading. Bake at 375°f for 20 minutes. Turn off heat and allow the nuts to dry at room temperature for up to 3 hours. Store in an airtight container.

title: Rosemary Bananas
ingredients: 4 medium bananas ( ripe, peeled, sliced as if you were from a rotisserie ) | 1 tablespoon oil ( you will need more ) | 1/2 cup jalapeno ( diced ) | 1 teaspoon fresh rosemary ( or 1/2 t dried ) | 1 cup cooked jasmine rice ( about 1 c )
instructions: Heat oil. Heat to 375°f with a slotted spoon, add bananas and sliced jalapenos to skillet & saute till golden brown. Add rosemary & rice, stir. Add 1/3 cup water, cover & continue the saute for 10 minutes. Serve immediately, or you may serve right away. The rice, if served in an air tight container, is nice accompaniments.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon cube,tomato green chilies,cayenne pepper sauce,orecchiette,grain rice,spinach leaf,shiitake mushroom
title: Orecchiette With Shiitake Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 package orecchiette | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon cube | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper sauce | 1 can diced tomatoes and green chilies, undrained | 2 cups fresh spinach leaves, chopped | 1/2 lb fresh shiitake mushroom, sliced | 1 tablespoon dried oregano
instructions: Cook orecchiette according to package directions. Meanwhile, bring 2 cups water to boil in a medium sauce pan. Add chicken bouillon.

title: Chinese-Mango and Turnip Stir Fry
ingredients: 6 ounces baby portabella mushrooms | 6 ounces sweet turnips or 6 ounces peeled and deveined turnips | 1 tablespoon szechuan peppercorns, crushed | 1/4 cup mango, diced
instructions: Drain excess moisture from the mushrooms, and slice the mushrooms into halves or quarters according to your preference. Trim the celery root ends and remove the hard stem part from the celery. Using a spoon or melon baller or other knife, or melon baller, mash the mushrooms against the side of the pan about 1/3 of an inch deep with the peppercorns. Add the mushrooms to the pan and stir. Reduce the heat of the pan slightly, and simmer until the mushrooms are soft, about 15 minutes. Add the mango and stir well. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: black mustard seed,kaffir lime leaf,splenda sugar substitute,cabbage,enchilada sauce,apple cider
title: Apple Slaw
ingredients: 1 head cabbage | 2 cans enchilada sauce | 12 kaffir lime leaves ( not kaffir lime leaves ) | 2 tablespoons green and white bell peppers or 2 tablespoons jalapeno peppers | 1 teaspoon splenda sugar substitute | 1 teaspoon black mustard seeds ( not powder )
instructions: Boil cabbage, drain well then slice into chunks or shred into strips. To prepare dressing ingredients, heat a few tablespoons of enchilada sauce with one or two kaffir lime leaves just until slightly smoking. Pour about half the prepared dressing into a salad bowl. Add cabbage and stir to coat. Continue to coat cabbage with rest of the sauce until desired crunchiness is achieved. Top with green bell pepper strips and drizzle of remaining enchilada sauce.

title: Maple Glazed Parsnips
ingredients: 2 parsnips, scrubbed | 2 tablespoons maple syrup | 4 teaspoons sweet chili sauce | 2 teaspoons sweet chili sauce, such as < a href= '' https : //www.geniuskitchen.com/recipe/sauce-135453 '' > golden sauce < /a > | 1/3 cup pearl barley, cooked
instructions: Microwave parsnips in microwave on high for 2 - 3 minutes, until just tender. Drain and immediately toss with maple syrup. In a small bowl, combine sweet chile sauce with 1/3 cup pear juice. In serving bowl, combine remaining pear juice, sweet chili sauce and barley. Pour over parsnips. Serve with additional maple syrup if desired.

Random Ingredients: beef broth,red potato,thai fish sauce,rice,chive,avocado,shiitake mushroom,egg yolk
title: Avocado Beef Stew
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef | 1 tablespoon thai fish sauce | 1 can beef broth | 1 tablespoon rice | 1 medium red potatoes or 1 medium yam, cut into 1 inch cubes | 2 medium avocados, chopped | 1 tablespoon fresh chives, chopped | 2 egg yolks
instructions: Brown the beef in medium size saucpan, breaking it up while it browns for about 5 minutes. Drain the beef in a colander, leaving most of its fat in the pan. Saute the potatoes until tender in the same pan. I prefer them medium potatoes so they'll be easy to peel when cooked. Drain all but about 1/4 cup of fat. Combine beef, potatoes, and avocado in a bowl. In a small bowl, combine the fish sauce and broth and whisk well. Put the beef broth mixture in the pan and stir. Add the rice, cover and cook for about 10 minutes or until the potatoes are just warmed through. Stir the rice occasionally while it cooks, so it doesn't stick. Meanwhile, make the yolks in a medium size mixing bowl. Whisk the egg yolks just until you're able to get frothy peaks, but not runny. Spray a 8 x3 glass baking dish with nonstick cooking spray and pour the egg mixture in with the shrimp mixture. Mix well. Spoon mixture evenly over the beef stew. Cover and bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until heated through.

title: Tequila-Rubbed Cheese on the Side
ingredients: 1 jar tequila | 1 package frozen whipped topping | oil or cooking spray
instructions: Combine tequila and whipped topping. Pour into a covered container. Cut cheese into 6 - 12 equal squares. Spray inside of each square with cooking spray. Chill in fridge for 2 hours until bubbly and hot.

title: Quick Non-Alcoholic Cowboy Caviar
ingredients: 1 can ranch-style beans | 4 lime wedges | 1 pinch salt and pepper to taste
instructions: Pour beans into a large, resealable plastic zipper bag, and pour in enough water to cover. Squeeze the lime juice from a couple of lime wedges into the bag, being careful not to pierce. Place bag in a bowl of ice, and set aside at least 10 minutes, or overnight in the refrigerator. Remove bag from refrigerator, mix in salt, and set aside to soak overnight in the refrigerator. After you have soaked the beans, stir them into the bowl with the salt and pepper, and refrigerate for 2 to 3 hours before serving.

title: Smoked Salmon on Skewers for Alton Brown
ingredients: 1 cup half-and-half | 1 pinch tahini paste | 1 tablespoon smoked salmon fillets, finely shredded
instructions: Combine half and half and tahini paste in a small saucepan. Bring to boil, whisking constantly. Add smoked salmon and stir to coat well.

title: Rum and Coriander (Semen) Snacks
ingredients: 1 kg coriander seed, cracked to release their aroma | 1 liter dark rum
instructions: Crush the coriander seeds and mix them well until they dissolve. Place in a bowl and pour over the rum. Cover and leave to soak in the fridge overnight. Remove the coriander seeds from the rum, strain, discard the seeds, and serve as snack with coriander chips.

Random Ingredients: beef broth,jalapeno,coffee granule,peel,caramel ice cream topping,hazelnut
title: Mexican Pies
ingredients: 1 cup chopped hazelnuts | 1 cup instant coffee granules | 1 pound ground beef round | 2 cups caramel ice cream topping, divided | 1/3 cup hot strong coffee | 1 jalapeno, seeded and minced ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Mix hazelnuts and instant coffee granules in a bowl and set aside for 10 minutes. In a large, heavy skillet over medium heat, cook ground beef until browned, stirring frequently and breaking it up with a spoon. Drain any accumulated fat from beef and add 1 cup caramel topping and hot coffee to beef and mix together. Spread the nuts evenly into a 9x13 inch baking dish and top with ground beef mixture. Bake in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until toasted and caramelized. Serve warm with jalapenos if desired.

Random Ingredients: red lentil,granny smith apple,french bread,peach schnapps,ricotta cheese,whipping cream
title: Schnapps Raisin Bread Spread
ingredients: 1 cup red lentils, rinsed and picked over ( you can also use red kidney beans ) | 1 1/2 cups low-fat ricotta cheese | 1 cup whipping cream | 1 tablespoon peach schnapps | 1 loaf french bread ( about 8x10 slices ) | 8 ounces granny smith apples, halved, cored and chopped
instructions: Combine the drained lentils, ricotta, cream, schnapps, and chopped apples in a food processor, process until smooth, about 30 seconds. Spoon into a medium bowl and set aside while the bread soaks up some of the liquid. Serve topped with the bread slices on a round of french bread and sprinkle with additional granny smith apples.

title: Beef and Rice Loaf
ingredients: 1/4 cup brown rice | 1 tablespoon szechuan peppercorns | 1 1/2 cups beef stock ( or chicken stock ) | 3 ounces tortellini | 1 serrano pepper, cored and chopped | crusty bread, for passing at table
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300°. In a small ovenproof dish, toast the peppercorns in the oven for 10 minutes or until fragrant. Remove from oven and set aside to cool. Heat a sauté pan on medium high heat. When the pan is hot, sear the tortellini the minute they start to soften, add the peppers and cook until the peppers are tender crisp. Drain the water and then transfer the vegetables to your slow cooker. Season with salt and pepper. Add the rice and the reserved peppercorns to the pan along with the stock and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to high and cook, uncovered, 1 1/2 hours until very tender. Stir the rice around in the pan for about 5 minutes so it is evenly moistened, remove from heat and let stand 5 minutes before slicing thinly. Serve in chunks with crusty bread.

title: Capellini With Chili Sauce
ingredients: 3/4 lb capellini | 2 tablespoons fresh minced green chili peppers
instructions: Cook capellini in boiling water until almost al dente, but still with a bite. Drain, and while still hot, stir in the minced chili peppers. Serve immediately.

title: Barbecue Kiwi and Kiwi Roast Lamb
ingredients: 1 tablespoon reduced-sodium beef stock | 10 ounces kiwi fruits | 1 lb cooked australian leg of lamb
instructions: Preheat barbecue to med high. Combine stock and kiwi fruit and pour over lamb and turn so all is covered evenly. Cook, basting frequently with pan juices until the lamb is golden brown and the kiwi fruit is tender. Serve with salad.

title: Cauliflower With Green or Yellow Paprika
ingredients: 1 package cauliflower | 1 medium green bell pepper, diced
instructions: Boil cauliflower for 12 to 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: baking powder,dill weed,taco seasoning,fish sauce,pink peppercorn,toothpick,vegetable oil cooking spray
title: Chef John's Thai Fish Rolls
ingredients: vegetable oil or cooking spray | 1 can unsalted pickled pink peppercorns, coarsely chopped ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon instant minced dried dill weed ( optional ) | 2 packets taco seasoning | 1 tablespoon fish sauce | 1/4 teaspoon baking powder | 2 toothpicks, soaked in water for 20 minutes
instructions: Prepare an electric fryer or deep pan according to manufacturer's directions. Heat vegetable oil in a small saucepan until hot, about 1 minute.

Random Ingredients: chocolate,bread machine yeast,white vinegar,pecan nut,chickpea,tamarind paste,irish whiskey
title: Chickpea Bread
ingredients: 3/4 cup tamarind paste ( available at health food stores ) | 1/4 cup white vinegar | 1 cup white vinegar | 3 tablespoons chickpeas, soaked until soft ( about 1 lb ) | 1 teaspoon bread machine yeast | 1 cup finely chopped pecans, toasted, coarsely chopped | 1/4 cup semisweet chocolate, melted
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk tamarind pulp with 1/4 cup vinegar and beat until creamy. Stir in the chickpeas. In a separate bowl, dissolve yeast in the remaining 3/4 cup vinegar. Stir in the sugar and beat in the warm vinegar and the molasses. Let stand until foamy, about 5 minutes. Scrape mixture into bread pan or bread machine pan and add enough hot water to reach the loaf and toppings. Cover and set in the bread machine according to your manufacturer's instructions. Set bread to dough programme, light crust, white bread and start. When the bread is done, remove from pan. Punch down loaf, place on a board and allow to cool and harden a little before slicing.

title: Onion Scented Marzipan
ingredients: 4 tablespoons flour | 5 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 1 1/2 teaspoons onion salt | 1 cup marzipan, chopped
instructions: Mix flour, soy sauce, onion and marzer in saucepan. Bring to boil, stirring constantly. Cook for several minutes over slow heat. Add chopped marzer. Boil, stirring. Cook over medium heat until thick and reduckish. Pour into greased moulds cover with plastic wrap. Leave undisturbed in warm place for 25 - 30 minutes. Let stand a few minutes then carefully unmold onto plates or tray and serve.

Random Ingredients: white sugar,celery,cilantro,ginger garlic paste,yellow bell pepper
title: Asian Sizzle Roasted Yellow Pepper Pepper Skewers
ingredients: 1/4 cup white sugar | 1 cup minced celery | 1 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh cilantro | 6 large yellow bell pepper, seeded and cut into strips
instructions: Stir sugar, celery, ginger garlic paste, and cilantro together in a bowl. Add pepper strips.

Random Ingredients: hash brown potato,white bean,green chili,thyme,red cabbage,garam masala
title: Tandoori Potato and White Bean Salad
ingredients: 2 cups instant hash brown potatoes, unseasoned | 1 can white beans, drained and rinsed | 1 red cabbage, shredded | 2/3 cup chopped green chili | 1 teaspoon garam masala | 1/4 cup chopped fresh thyme
instructions: In a small bowl mix together potato, beans, cabbage, chilies and masala. Cover and chill in the refrigerator for at least an hour. Add garnish.

title: Coconut and Pesto Brochettes
ingredients: 16 ounces bok choy, shredded | 2 teaspoons sweet pepper, roasted | 8 ounces pesto sauce | 3 ounces flaked coconut, toasted | 4 teaspoons splenda granular
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together bok choy, sweet pepper, and pesto sauce. Top with coconut and spoon a dollop of the sauce over.

title: Mexican-style half and half
ingredients: 1 cup half-and-half | 1 whole white green bell pepper, very thinly sliced into 1/4-inch-thick strips | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh cilantro leaves
instructions: In a medium bowl, whisk together half and half and green bell pepper strips. Stir in cilantro leaves.

title: German Pear and Baking Powder Mix
ingredients: 3 tablespoons baking powder | 1 1/3 pounds firm pears, rinsed and patted dry ( about 4 pounds )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl, then mix with clean hands. Store covered in refrigerator for up to 1 week.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil,lime wedge,green chartreuse liqueur,crepe,rice wine
title: Lime Crepes
ingredients: 3 large crepes | 1 teaspoon vegetable oil | 2 cups cooked rice wine ( not glutinous rice ) | 2 tablespoons green chartreuse liqueur ( or to taste ) | lime wedge ( optional ) ( optional )
instructions: Brush crepes with oil. Layer with rice wine and liqueur. Roll up crepes loosely and cut into strips. Serve with lime wedges.

title: Swedish Veal Baste
ingredients: 1 lb lean meat | 1 tablespoon vanilla sugar | 1 tablespoon canola oil
instructions: Combine all ingredients with a fork and let sit in the refridgerator overnight. Grill over medium heat for 10 - 12 minutes depending on heat of gas until desired doneness. Serve with fresh vegetables, rice and bread.

title: Persian Egg Bites (Framakti)
ingredients: 2 hard-boiled eggs | 2 1/2 tablespoons walnut oil
instructions: Heat the oil in a small pan, then crackle egg in very small chunks, removing with slotted spoon when it's just cooked through. Drain on paper towels. Garnish with finely chopped hard boiled eggs and walnuts. Variation, substitute a hard boiled egg for the hard boiled eggs. Note, if doing by hand, avoid touching your hands and using metal utensils. For convenience, you could even lightly beat the eggs into a bowl to form a 'well' for shaping the egg bites.

title: Saffron Noodle Kugel
ingredients: 4 tablespoons margarine, melted | 1 package dry egg noodles | 3 slices cremini mushrooms, sliced | 1 pinch powdered saffron | 1 pinch cayenne pepper | 2 egg whites, beaten for egg wash
instructions: Set 3 tablespoons margarine in a skillet over medium heat. Cook mushrooms until golden brown. Stir often. Transfer to a bowl and toss in remaining melted margarine. Remove pan from heat. Soak eggs in milk for 3 minutes. Combine egg whites and saffron in a shallow dish. Dip egg whites in egg whites and then place on top of mushroom mixture. Sprinkle with cayenne pepper. Bake in a 350 degree f oven for 20 minutes. Set kugels onto a baking sheet in a single layer. Beat remaining egg. Brush evenly over kugels.

title: Coco-Cola
ingredients: 4 navel oranges | cornmeal | 1 large milk chocolate piece ( or 2 small squares ) | 1 teaspoon white wine vinegar
instructions: Prick oranges with a knife in a few places. Place in a bowl of hot water and soak for 40 minutes. Drain. Remove oranges and peel with a melon baller and reserve.. Pour juice of the oranges into a bowl. Put grated chocolate into another bowl. Squeeze juice of oranges into chocolate and whisk until smooth. Add the eggy orange mixture to the orange juice mixture. Beat vigorously until all the egg mixture is incorporated and the ingredients are well blended. Fill 8 clean paper candy glasses half full, sprinkle each with cornmeal. Fill each mold 1/2 full with orange mixture. Wrap with plastic wrap. Chill thoroughly.

title: Swedish Rye Bread
ingredients: 2 cups rye flour | 1 package sharp cheddar cheese
instructions: In a large bowl, stir together the rye flour and sharp cheddar cheese. Pour 1 cup of dry mix into a greased 2 quart or 3 qt. Baking dish. Using about half of the dough per loaf, turn each cutout onto your hands and spread it out into a round or rectangle shape. Repeat until the mixture is no longer sticky. Do not scrape the edges of the dough off. Cover with a towel, and set the baking dish in a cool dry place to rise. Preheat the oven to 480 degrees f. When you have about half the dough hanging over the edge of the baking dish, lift the dough out of the bowl and place on top of the other, making sure to keep the excess. Poke each cutout with a fork and place on the baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Bake until the loaf starts to set and is deep golden brown, about 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: wheat flour,silver tequila,heavy cream,baking powder,chili oil,ricotta cheese
title: Creamy Ricotta Pie
ingredients: 2 ounces silver tequila | 1/2 lb ricotta cheese | 1/2 cup heavy cream | 4 tablespoons whole wheat flour | 4 tablespoons baking powder | 1 dash chili oil
instructions: First, make white cake batter, sieve cottage cheese and blend it into the white flour. Mix the heavy cream into the cream and mix it in with the flour/white flour. Keep it aside. Beat the batter in 2 or 3 tablespoons of oil on high speed. When the batter begins to get stiff, pour it into pie pan, which is large enough to handle the pie. Bake at 350&deg.

Random Ingredients: yellow onion,semolina flour,sharp cheddar cheese,golden syrup,pecorino romano cheese,beef tenderloin
title: Pecorino Beef in Pastry With Semolina
ingredients: 2 slices aged sharp cheddar cheese, roughly chopped | 2 slices yellow onions, finely chopped | 4 tablespoons pecorino romano cheese | 1 1/2 tablespoons golden syrup, warmed | 1 1/2 - 2 lbs beef tenderloin | 1 1/4 cups semolina flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees. Place beef in a large shallow dish. Top with onion, cheese, romano and syrup. Toss well and pat it into the cuts. Pour enough boiling water over to be an inch or two deep in the dish. Cover and place on a large sheet pan. Place in oven. Bake until well browned, for about 4 hours. Remove beef to a cutting board, then slice to desired serving size. Use slicing board to remove the excess fat and gristle left from beef. Serve on its own or at room temperature with a salad. The beef is best rare and the cheese is not really needed. It does not require salt to be added while cooking. If the sauce becomes too thick for your taste, whisk in a little water.

Random Ingredients: chinese five spice powder,sun tomato oil,part ricotta cheese,fish sauce,pork steak,oyster,graham cracker crumb
title: Quick and Easy Poached Seafood
ingredients: 1 package frozen cooked small lobster, head shrimp and shell removed | 1 bag fresh fish, snipped ( optional ) | 1/4 cup dried sun-dried tomato packed in oil, snipped into strips | 1 tablespoon low sodium soy sauce | 1/2 teaspoon chinese five spice powder | 1/2 cup part-skim ricotta cheese | 1/2 cup graham cracker crumbs
instructions: To make dipping sauce, in a small bowl combine lobster, fish, sundried tomatoes, soy sauce, five spice powder and ricotta cheese. Mix well. To prepare rice dish, place a large nonstick wok over medium high. Add 1/3 cup of water. Bring to a boil. Add seafood, if desired. Quickly stir and cook for 3 minutes. Drizzle with sauce and sprinkle with crumbs.

title: Amaretto Colcannon
ingredients: 1 fresh green cabbage ( very large head, cut into 4-inch wedges ) | 3/4 cup amaretto ( almond-flavored liqueur )
instructions: Put cabbage wedge into a large bowl, and pour the amaretto over it. Shake the bowl until the liqueur has melted. Refrigerate 30 minutes or up to a day, or serve immediately.

title: Candied Fruit
ingredients: 3 lbs ripe fruit | 2 tablespoons garlic powder | 2 tablespoons dried fruit flakes, i recommend chunky, apricot
instructions: Cut a cone shaped piece into the side of each apple and put in a heavy kettle or other covered container. Add garlic and dried fruit. Cover and cook for an hour or until fruit is very tender. Remove the lid and continue cooking for 30 minutes. Drain fruit and serve.

title: Korean Wheat (Japjangang) Dumplings
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon korean red pepper powder | 1 cup whole wheat flour | 1 cup frozen peas, thawed
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well. Drop tablespoons of dough 1 inch in hot water in a pot. Cover and cook on low heat for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Mussels in a Simple Sauce
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups plain nonfat yogurt | 3/4 lb mussels, cleaned if opened | 1/8 teaspoon ground red pepper | 1 canned tomato sauce
instructions: Place mussels on a small saucepan and pour about 1/4 cup water over them. Cover and cook over high heat until all liquid has evaporated. Scrub mussels and remove shell to a bowl. Discard any mussels that have cracked shells. Rinse mussels with cold water. Discard any that have sunken. Place mussels in a bowl, cover with hot water and set aside to cook for about 20 minutes or until mussels have opened. Discard any mussels that have sunken. Stir in hot tomato sauce. Serve over brown rice or noodles.

title: Salmon Rice Creamer
ingredients: 1 salmon steak | 1/4 cup half-and-half cream ( cream if you wish to make a creamier soup ) | 3 cups cooked brown rice
instructions: Place salmon in the microwave safe dish. Pour in half and half and cream and stir. Cover dish, and microwave for 8 - 10 minutes or so on high. Stir. Cover again, and microwave for 2 minutes on high. Remove salmon and flake the cooked rice. Mix well, return to microwave, and microwave on high, uncovered, for 3 - 4 minutes, or just until liquid is absorbed, and salmon is flaky. Serve with steamed greens for dipping. You may also wish to serve this soup with a salad for a heartier flavor.

title: Budget Pate, Quebec Style
ingredients: 75 g pork belly, cut into small cubes | 50 g gruyere cheese, shredded | 175 g beef gravy, chilled | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard | 1/4 cup fresh strawberries, shredded or cut up fresh fruit
instructions: Place meat in bowl. Sprinkle with cheese. Stir in gravy, mustard and strawberries. Add a little milk if you prefer, but stir to combine. Spoon into 4 x 1 1/4 inch moulds, refrigerate until set. Serve with a little freshly whipped cream or buttermilk.

Random Ingredients: spinach leaf,cod fillet,puff pastry shell,tomato,cream celery soup,tawny port
title: Smac
ingredients: 1 package frozen puff pastry shells | 2 cups chopped spinach leaves | 2 cans condensed cream of celery soup | 2 pounds cooked cod fillet | 1 can stewed | 1 can whole peeled tomatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Fit 1 puff pastry shell into a 9x13 inch baking dish. Mix spinach with soup until well blended, about 1 minute. Add spinach mixture to pastry shell. Place cod fillet over mixture and pour stewed tomatoes evenly over fish.

title: Pear-Pear Compote
ingredients: 6 large pears, peeled, cored & roughly chopped | 2 tablespoons arrowroot ( optional )
instructions: Place the pear, & arrowroot in a pan & add enough water to almost cover the pears. Simmer gently for 40 min, making sure the fluid covers the pears. You may want to add more water if the liquid evaporates too quickly & continue to simmer until the pears are firm & translucent. Serve with your favourite cheese & a nice crisp bread roll or crusty loaf.

Random Ingredients: yellow pepper,maraschino cherry,parsley,lemon pepper,vegetable stock,almond,pickling spice
title: Cherry Vinaigrette
ingredients: 2 bottles merlot wine | 1 bottle vegetable stock | 1 teaspoon lemon pepper | 1/2 teaspoon pickling spices | 1/2 cup blanched almond, roasted | 1/2 cup slivered yellow sweet pepper | 1/2 cup chopped fresh parsley
instructions: In a large clear glass jar, combine wine, vegetable stock and lemon pepper.

title: Lori's Citrus Roast Lamb
ingredients: 1/2 cup dried chile peppers, coarsely chopped | 1 jalapeno pepper, coarsely chopped | 1/4 cup orange zest, freshly grated | 1 tablespoon dried basil | 2 tablespoons shredded lettuce | 1 1/2 lbs boneless leg of lamb
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Combine chile peppers, jalapeno and zest in a small bowl. Stir in basil and spread mixture on the inside of the leg of lamb. Place the lamb on a foil lined roasting pan. Roast 1 hour or until meat thermometer inserted in thickest part registers 130 degrees for medium rare, brushing occasionally with remaining mixture. Slice and serve.

title: Quinoa-Rice Medley
ingredients: 1/2 cup quinoa | 1 teaspoon molasses | 1 fresh thyme sprigs | 1/4 cup pasta sauce with herbs | kale, for serving | radicchio, for serving
instructions: Place the quinoa in a small saucepan with 1/2 teaspoon salt and the molasses. Cover with 2 cups of boiling water and bring to a boil. Reduce the heat, cover and simmer until all of the water has absorbed. Fluff with a fork and stir in the thyme. Wash, drain and dry the quinoa well if you have it. Add the pasta sauce and kale and season to taste with salt. Serve immediately or refrigerate.

title: Indian Grilled Veggies
ingredients: 1/4 cup light muscat chili sauce ( or your hot chili sauce ) | 1/4 cup catsup | 1/2 teaspoon freshly ground cardamom seed ( or one 1-1/2 tsp. cardoon powder ) | 1 cup cauliflower floret, coarsely chopped | 1 tablespoon fresh rosemary sprig, minced | 1 small head lettuce, outer leaves removed, cut in half lengthwise and separated | 15 ounces light coconut milk | store-bought sweet and sour chutney, for serving ( optional )
instructions: Place the chile sauce in a shallow dish. Add the remaining ingredients. Cover and marinate the veggies in the refrigerator overnight. Preheat grill to medium high. Grill veggies until they are tender and lightly charred, about 3 minutes per side. Serve immediately and the sweet and sour chutney on the side.

Random Ingredients: sherry wine,greek yogurt,curry paste,anaheim chili,water chestnut,great northern bean
title: Spicy Indian Smoothie
ingredients: 2 cans great northern beans, drained ( reserve 1/3 cup of the liquid ) | 1 cup water chestnut, coarsely chopped ( reserve 2 tablespoons for garnish ) | 1 cup mild curry paste ( i recommend rogan josh curry paste # 2 ) | 1 medium anaheim chili, coarsely chopped | 1 cup greek yogurt, stirred to blend well | 1 tablespoon sherry wine ( or dry sherry or additional sherry or honey )
instructions: Mix everything together. Cover. Refrigerate overnight, or can be frozen for later use.

Random Ingredients: pecorino romano cheese,ice,french onion soup,lamb,chickpea,red bean paste,rutabaga,green chili pepper
title: Easy Meaty Potato Curd
ingredients: 2 lbs ground lamb | 1 rutabaga, peeled and diced | 1 can french onion soup | 1 can red beans paste | 1 can chickpeas, drained | 1 can diced green chili peppers ( one diced and one diced ) | 2 tablespoons pecorino romano cheese, grated | ice
instructions: Place the beef, rutabaga and both cans of french onion soup. Combine well. Place the beef mixture into a 1 quart casserole dish. Pour the beans, peppers and cheese over the beef mixture. Bake uncovered in a 350 degree oven until the cheese browns.

Random Ingredients: yellow curry powder,parsnip,chicken thigh fillet,garlic powder,bean sprout,olive oil cooking spray,pimento olive
title: Curry Chicken
ingredients: 2 tablespoons olive oil flavored cooking spray | 1 tablespoon yellow curry powder | 1 tablespoon freshly chopped parsnip ( optional ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons garlic powder | 4 chicken thigh fillets, halved | 2 tablespoons chopped pimento stuffed olives | 1 can baked beans sprouts
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c. Place oil, curry powder, parsnip, garlic powder and chicken in a small baking dish and stir in olives and sprouts. Bake in oven for 15 - 20 minutes or until chicken is cooked.

title: Spinach Salad With Marsala and Mint
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs baby spinach leaves | 2/3 cup of fresh mint leaves, chopped | 4 -6 ounces of shaved cheese | 2 tablespoons tamari ( japanese soy sauce ) | 2 -4 tablespoons of chinese sweet sake ( or sherry wine )
instructions: In a large bowl combine the spinach, mint leaves and cheese and toss well. Add the tamari and sriracha and toss just to get them mixed inches.

Random Ingredients: active yeast,cumin seed,prosciutto,vinegar,currant,green cardamom pod,mango chutney
title: Mango Chutney Sandwich With Cumin
ingredients: 12 ounces cucumbers, peeled, seeded and sliced 3 inches | 4 green cardamom pods ( pods ) | 2 teaspoons cumin seeds or 2 teaspoons coriander seeds | 1/2 cup chopped dried currant | 1/3 cup mango chutney | 1/2 cup vinegar | 4 ounces prosciutto, thinly sliced
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add the cucumbers and whole green cardamom pods, cover and heat to very soft. Drain and then place in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: vanilla essence,buttermilk,fish sauce,mushroom cap,white vinegar,seasoning salt,egg substitute,tabasco brand chipotle pepper sauce
title: Sauce and Chipsotle Mushrooms
ingredients: 2 cans mushroom caps, drained well and sliced | 1 cup egg substitute | 1/4 cup buttermilk | 1 teaspoon pure vanilla essence | seasoning salt | 2 -3 drops tabasco brand chipotle pepper sauce, to taste | 1/4 cup white vinegar
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Place on large serving platter, and cover with plastic wrap. Refrigerate until ready to serve. Serve cold.

title: Baked Mackerel and Sprouts Salad
ingredients: 1 lb mackerel, cut into small pieces, skinned | 2 lbs brussels sprouts, cut into small pieces, peeled | 1/2 cup vinaigrette dressing ( may use ranch or almond dressing ) | 1/2 cup shredded green onion | 1/2 cup shredded vanilla sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f, grease a 9x9 inch pan.

title: Bethany's White Beans
ingredients: 1 can cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 1/2 red onion, diced | 1 jar hot sauce | 1 teaspoon anise seed | 1 teaspoon aleppo pepper | 1 teaspoon louisiana ground annatto seeds
instructions: In a large skillet combine beans, onion, sauerkraut and hot sauce. Mix well. Add anise and anise seeds. Cover and simmer for 1 hour and 15 minutes or until hot.

title: Baked Caraway Cakes
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups graham cracker crumbs | 1 1/2 cups roasted dried mint, coarsely chopped | 1 tablespoon caraway seed | 1 tablespoon mustard oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Combine dry graham cracker crumbs, mint, caraway, and mustard oil in a bowl. Turn dough out onto lightly floured surface. Form into a ball. Gently, with a rolling pin, flatten slightly. Roll out to ¼ inch thickness. Repeat with remaining dough. Transfer to parchment lined baking sheets. Using a spatula, coat tops of cakes with melted margarine. Bake in the preheated oven until golden brown, 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Cherry Sour Dessert Whip
ingredients: 3 cups whipping cream, divided | 1/3 cup diced celery | 1 1/2 cups dried cherries, chopped
instructions: In medium bowl, whip 1/2 cup whipping cream on high speed until soft peaks form. Fold 1/2 cup whipped cream into 3/4 cup whipping cream. Stir in celery. Fold in dried cherries. Refrigerate until serving time. Serve chilled.

Random Ingredients: soy sauce,ajwain,vanilla,black forest ham,lime wedge,italian salad dressing,veal,catsup
title: Korean Fusion Veal and Ham Salad.
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless veal, cut into 1-inch-thick slices | 1/2 cup soy sauce | 1/2 cup catsup | 1/2 cup italian salad dressing | 1 tablespoon prepared japanese-style catsup | 1 tablespoon fresh lime juice | 1 1/2 teaspoons pure vanilla | 1 teaspoon ajwain | fresh ground black forest ham, to taste ( optional )
instructions: Heat large skillet over medium high heat. Working in batches, cook the veal 4 to 5 minutes per side or until light golden and tender. Remove with slotted spoon and drain on paper towels. Stir together soy sauce, catsup, and mustard. Add chili powder, catsup mixture, juice, and vanilla and stir until well mixed. Stir in cooled veal. Add green beans. Serve on platter or in individual serving bowls, garnished with slices of cooked ham and a drizzle of japanese or korean catsup mixture.

title: Eggplant and Broccoli Pizza
ingredients: 1 pizza crust, thawed if frozen | 1 eggplant, peeled and julienned | 1 teaspoon dried marjoram or 1/4 teaspoon dried sage | 10 -15 ounces frozen broccoli, thawed if frozen | 2 1/2 tablespoons rum extract | 1 1/2 cups grated cheese ( mozzarella, provolone, parmesan ) | 1 tablespoon milk | 1 pinch red pepper flakes, to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Line a pizza pan with parchment paper or foil. Place eggplant on a paper lined baking sheet. Sprinkle with salt and pepper.

Random Ingredients: hawaiian sea salt,monterey jack cheddar cheese,tortilla chip,bread flour,parmigiano reggiano cheese,wheat penne,seasoning,celery
title: Noodley Bread Bowl
ingredients: 3 1/2 cups bread flour | 1 1/4 teaspoons turmerici seasoning | 1 1/2 teaspoons hawaiian sea salt | 1 cup grated monterey jack and cheddar cheese blend | 8 ounces thinly sliced celery | 1 1/2 cups shredded parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1 cup shredded parmigiano-reggiano cheese or 1 cup asiago cheese | 3/4 lb whole wheat penne | 2 1/4 ounces tortilla chips, coarsely crushed
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the flour, turmerici seasoning and sea salt.

title: Quick Brisket
ingredients: 1 corned beef brisket, fat removed | 1 2 teaspoons cornstarch | 1/2 cup graham cracker crumbs | 1 tablespoon cornstarch
instructions: Place brisket on foil in a cold oven. Set oven control to 350 degrees f. Roast, uncovered, until easily pierced with a knife, 45 to 55 minutes for medium rare meat. Cool, and remove all but 2 tablespoons of fat. Remove meat from oven.

Random Ingredients: oil black olive,vanilla bean,egg yolk,basil,garlic powder,baby rocket
title: Garlic Bezazza Salad
ingredients: 250 -300 g baby rocket ( baby bok ) | 250 g oil-cured black olives | 2 large egg yolks | 1/8 teaspoon garlic powder | 2 garlic cloves ( minced ) | 1 ounce basil ( sliced or shredded )
instructions: Blanch or chill rocket. Drain and rinse in cold water. Beat egg yolks until smooth then mix in oil, garlic powder, garlic powder and basil. Chill. Mix in rocket. Top with olive paste.

title: Asparagus Chips 2007
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh asparagus or 2 lbs frozen asparagus, thawed | 1 teaspoon white wine vinegar | 1 cup taco sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Cut asparagus lengthwise into 1 1/4 slices. Arrange in lightly salted and boiling water. Cook for just 1 minute. Drain. Brush with vinegar.

Random Ingredients: strawberry,cod fish fillet,anaheim chili,dark rum,chili pepper,bamboo shoot,chocolate syrup
title: Tropical Fish
ingredients: 400 g fish fillets or 400 g other firm white fish fillets | 1 fresh chili pepper ( fresh or thai, to taste ) | 2 bamboo shoots ( canned ) | 150 g chocolate syrup | 1/2 fresh anaheim chili ( to taste ) | 100 g dark rum or 100 g rum syrup | 1 jar strawrawberries
instructions: Remove all the bones from the fish by slicing along the spine at the end of the spine. Rinse with cold water and drain again. Cut the fish in small pieces and set aside. Heat a large, heavy non stick frying pan. Add 2 tablespoons of chocolate syrup, the chile pepper and 1 teaspoon of rum to the pan. If the sugar dissolves, stir in a pinch of honey now, then pour the syrup mixture over the fish. Stir fry 3 minutes or until the fish is just cooked.

title: Beef Filets With Dill
ingredients: 1 teaspoon dried dill sprigs ( optional )
instructions: Cut 1 large slit in the beef tenderloin with a long sharp knife to form a pocket. Combine the dill and the optional ingredients and rub over the meat. Cook steaks 4 to 6 minutes for medium rare.

title: Hokkien Nasi Goreng (Pepper Nuts) from Cooking.com
ingredients: 4 cups peanut oil | 1/4 cup sesame seeds | 1 1/2 cups toasted pistachios | 3/4 teaspoon sea salt | 2 teaspoons finely ground pepper
instructions: Heat the oil over low heat in a large, heavy heavy bottomed frying pan. Spread the sesame seeds out to darken, and cook over low heat, stirring occasionally. Remove seeds from the oil with a slotted spoon, and set aside. Sprinkle the sesame seeds onto the pan. Using the back of a knife, crush the seeds with the back of a spoon to a fine powder. Combine the pistachios with salt and pepper by pinching them together in a crisscrossed pattern. Using a teaspoon, carefully drop the pistachios onto the oil by letting them fall into the hot oil. Let the nut oil boil over moderate heat, stirring frequently, until they begin to turn golden brown on the bottom. Turn and brown the second side, then remove them onto absorbent paper towels or waxed paper to drain. Turn the pan again and cook the nut oil over medium heat for about 1 minute per side. Transfer the fried nuts onto a rimmed platter and serve warm.

title: Potatoes With Chilies
ingredients: 8 ounces hash brown potatoes | 3 fresh chilies, roasted, peeled and sliced in 1/4 inch rounds ( from a jar or can ) | 3 tablespoons white vinegar | 1/4 cup shredded lettuce
instructions: Place potatoes in a large pan of salted water and bring to the boil. Reduce heat and simmer until tender, 18 to 25 minutes. Drain, cool slightly and slice potatoes into 1 1/8 inch slices. Place 1 piece of potato, each long side up, on a serving plate. Top with 1/2 slice chilies and 1/3 t oil.

title: Quick Fajitas
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs hamburger | 1 teaspoon dried taco seasoning mix | sunflower seed oil | realisienne steak spice or cognac
instructions: Brown up brown hamburger until well browned, drain excess fat. Sear the taco seasoning mix in a pan, use the same pan for deglazing the pan. Add the oil for frying up the fajitas. Add the meat and sear until well browned on both sides. Enjoy i prefer using fajita seasoning on my meat, because it gives a different flavor.

title: Poventé Sauce
ingredients: tahini | 1 tablespoon dark brown sugar | 1/2 teaspoon anise extract | cheesecloth
instructions: Mix together all ingredients and store in an air tight jar. Stir again before use as needed.

title: Roasted Parsnip Chips (Miso Glazed Parsnips)
ingredients: 1 large parsnip | 1/8 cup pepitas ( or white pumpkin seeds ) | 4 tablespoons miso ( dark green, white rice flour ) | 1 teaspoon garam masala powder | 1/8 cup pine nuts or 1/8 cup slivered almonds, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons dark-grain alcohol
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Place parsnips on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Roast for about 35 minutes, turning occassionally. They should be tender when pierced with a knife. When all of the parsnips are roasted, rub them out and place them in a baking pan sprayed with a little nonstick spray. Roast in oven for about 40 minutes, stirring occasionally. Let cool, then remove and discard giblets and parsnips. Place pepitas in a bowl of iced water and set aside. In large bowl, combine pepitas, miso, garam masala and pine nuts. Remove parsnips from oven and place on serving dish. Spread miso mixture on top and sprinkle with nuts. Serve with kulcha or tamarindlis.

Random Ingredients: guacamole,savory,vegetable broth,parmigiano reggiano cheese,midori melon liqueur
title: Guacamole Soup With Armadillo Mushrooms
ingredients: 2 quarts homemade vegetable broth ( or canned if you don't own homemade ) | 7 tablespoons guacamole | 2 tablespoons midori melon liqueur | 1 tablespoon savory | 1 ounce parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Pour the vegetable broth into a pot or soup pot. Place in the freezer for approximately 35 minutes. Place all ingredients into your food processor or blender and grind and remove as much liquid as possible from the armadillo mushroom. Then place this into the pot you are going to use in the soup. Let this simmer for approximately 20 minutes. You should have a thick, very rich armadillo mushroom soup. Pour onto a plate and serve. Note, this soup can also be made without the armadillo mushrooms. They have the same thick texture and are tasty, and can be used in other recipes. If your armadillo mushrooms are too small, you may want to boil them with the other ingredients.

title: Simple Beef Short Ribs on the Slow Cooker Recipe
ingredients: 2 pounds beef short ribs | 1 package uncooked lasagna noodles, broken in half
instructions: Place the short ribs in the bottom of a slow cooker, and cover with about one third of each of the broken noodles. Cover with another third of the broken noodles. Cover, and cook on high until the beef juices run clear and the noodles are tender, 2 1/2 to 3 hours.

title: Beef Round Steak Skewers
ingredients: 1 1/3 lbs round steaks, cut into bite sized pieces | 1 tablespoon mustard | 1 ounce chocolate piece ( i usually just use a high quality semi sweet chocolate chip ) | 14 1/2 ounces canned green chiles, drained | 1 teaspoon steak seasoning ( or to taste ) | 2 teaspoons coconut oil
instructions: Prepare grill as directed on package. Mix together mustard, chocolate pieces, chilies, steak seasoning and oil. Thread beef onto skewers. Baste with sauce if desired.

title: Spicy Seafood Fingers
ingredients: 2 lbs cooked seafood, flounder, squid, shellfish, shrimp, scallops or 2 lbs shrimp, shelled deveined shrimp | 1 1/2 lbs meat, squid, shellfish, mussels, crab or 1 1/2 lbs chicken wings, cut into 2 inch lengths | 1 slice hard salami, thinly sliced and cut into thirds | 1 lb sweet eating italian pork sausage, cut into 1/2 inch cubes or 1 lb hard salami, cut into 1/2 inch cubes, cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 1/4 cup fine dry breadcrumb | 1/8 teaspoon ground cloves | 1/2 1/2 cup tomato juice or 1/2 cup canned tomato juice | parsnip, peeled and cut into 2 inch long wedges
instructions: Cook fish or seafood separately if necessary. Drain. Place in a large bowl. Crumble sausage over fish or seafood. Mix well. Combine bread crumbs, cloves, tomato juice and seasonings. Stir into seafood mixture well. Pat dry ingredients onto dry bread mixture. Roll in parsnips. Deep fry in 375f degrees oil or deep fry bacon fat. Drain. Serve warm and with your favorite green salad and tomato juice. Note, recipe can also be done in a deep fryer using 2 pound or similar product.

title: Nectarine Lapinata
ingredients: 2 cups uncooked farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta | 1 cup apricot nectar | 2 tablespoons rice wine, or amount to taste
instructions: Fill a pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, stir in the farfalle, and return to a boil. Cook the pasta uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the pasta has cooked through, but is still firm to the bite, about 11 minutes. Drain well in a colander set in the sink. Whisk the apricot syrup, rice wine, and cooked farfalle in a skillet over medium high heat until the fruit is warm, about 5 minutes.

title: Olive-Zippy Spread
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons chocolate chips | 3 tablespoons kalamata olives, chopped | 1 tablespoon coriander powder
instructions: Place all ingredients in a blender and process them until smooth.

title: Grillin' Groggy Bombay Chicken Livers
ingredients: 3 -4 lbs chicken livers | 6 -8 ounces fresh tomatillos, soaked for at least 30 minutes and drained | 1 tablespoon paprika or 1 tablespoon brown sugar | 4 -5 teaspoons chopped tarragon | 1 teaspoon curry powder | 1/4 teaspoon garlic salt or 1/8 teaspoon black pepper | 1 cup champagne or 1 cup sparkling wine | 1/2 cup finely snipped pitted dates or 1/2 cup chopped raisins
instructions: Rinse livers and pat dry with paper towels. Make a slit in the liver with the center vein facing you down. Rinse all blood puffs and veins with cold water and repeat this procedure 5 times. Fill a large, deep soup pot 3/4 full with water. Add the liver, tomatillos, paprika, tarragon, curry powder, garlic salt and pepper. Bring to a boil over medium heat for 5 minutes. Turn off the heat. Stir in the champagne or sparkling wine and place the lid on the pot. Let this sit at a slight bubble for about 30 minutes, shaking the pot occasionally. Add the dates and raisins and serve.

title: Lardons
ingredients: 1 gallon lardons or 1 gallon butter | 4 cups salsa ( medium or hot, as hot as you want ) ( optional )
instructions: To make the lardons, wash lemons and poke with fork several times through the tops with a sharp knife. Place lemons in a glass dish with the side of a cleaver. Pour salsa or other hot salsa over lemon and allow to stand for a day or two before enjoying.

title: Mexican Pumpkin Seeds
ingredients: 1 cup pumpkin seeds or 1 cup paprika seeds | 2 cups grape tomatoes or 2 cups cherry tomatoes
instructions: Wash the pumpkin seeds and put them in a bowl. Pour boiling water over them and leave to soak for 10 minutes. Then drain the seeds and pat dry with clean paper towel. Sprinkle with salt. Roast the tomatoes on a grill and cook just until they are black. You can add a few drops of lemon juice at this point, to your taste.

title: Balsamic Glaze or Glaze
ingredients: 1 cup balsamic vinegar ( low sodium, about 3/4 cup ) | 2 teaspoons baking soda | 1 cup barley ( i used brown or red )
instructions: Pour the vinegar, balsamic, and 1/2 teaspoons baking soda in a small bowl and let soak at least 20 minutes.

title: Spicy Indian Snacks on a Dutch
ingredients: 2 cans refrigerated crescent dinner rolls | 1 tablespoon curry | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom | 2 anaheim chilies, roasted, peeled and sliced ( can substitute your favorite )
instructions: In a small bowl or ziplock bag, combine curry, cardamom and roasted chilies. Resour any excess water from baking sheets. Remove from bag, fill with curry mixture. Spray a non stick frying pan with non stick spray and cook mixture over medium heat for 8 - 10 minutes until rolls are lightly browned. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: sugar,nori,cilantro leaf,focaccia bread,butterscotch chip,sesame oil,watermelon,peanut butter
title: Watermelon Sushi Rolls
ingredients: 3 cups seedless watermelon, cut into 1 inch chunks | 1/3 cup peanut butter, unsweetened | 1 teaspoon sesame oil | 1/3 cup nori, dry seaweed sushi seaweed sheets with silken tofu, 1 2 inches in length | 1 3/4 tablespoons sugar | 1 cup focaccia bread, 1-inch cubes | 1/3 cup butterscotch chips
instructions: Prepare the watermelon, remove the stem and outer stone of the watermelon and cut into 1 inch chunks. Place the chunks in a small microwave safe bowl along with the peanut butter and sesame oil. Cover and microwave on high for 10 to 12 minutes or until the watermelon is tender. Remove from the microwave and stir well to combine. Add the nori and sugar and mix well until the sugar has dissolved. Set aside. Prepare the filling, preheat a grill pan over medium heat. Add the focaccia and stir to break it apart. Remove the crusts from the butterscotch chips, then cut each piece into about 3 or 4 pieces and set aside. Add the cereal to the watermelon mixture and stir well to mix. Place a scoop of the watermelon filling inside the focaccia roll and pinch the sides closed to make a seal. Place the filled rolls on a plate. To store, wrap it in plastic wrap and refrigerate for up to 24 hours. Cut the rolls in half to serve.

Random Ingredients: red pepper,farfalle pasta,poblano chile,red curry paste,thai basil
title: Sweet Heat Pesto Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb farfalle pasta ( bowtie ) | 1 poblano chile, chopped | 1/2 roasted red pepper, chopped | 1/2 cup red curry paste or 1/2 cup thai curry paste | 1/4 cup chopped fresh basil
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil over high heat. Add the pasta, and stir just until the pasta floats to the top of the water. In a small bowl, mash the poblano pepper, red pepper and red curry paste together. Add to the pasta and quickly toss. Add the basil, and toss until everything is coated in the paste. Serve immediately. Cooks note, this pasta recipe yields only 2 servings, so substitute any other filling you have on hand.

title: Queso Cracker Cakes With Caramelized Vegetables
ingredients: 3 ounces salt pork, shredded | 1/2 cup grated monterey jack cheese | 1/2 teaspoon grated lemon peel
instructions: Put the shredded salt pork into a bowl. Sprinkle half of the monterey jack cheese on top of that. Add the lemon peel. Mix everything. Use hands to mix everything, but don't be afraid to squish it with your fingers until everything is evenly distributed. Form into 8 patties. Wrap each patty in plastic wrap. Refrigerate about 30 minutes. Preheat your oven to 450 degrees. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: cinnamon raisin bread,rum,superfine sugar,russet potato,yogurt,mirin,raisin,thyme sprig
title: Lamb Shank
ingredients: 3 lbs russet potatoes, peeled and cut into 2-inch chunks | 1 cup raisins | 12 teaspoons superfine sugar | 1/4 cup spiced rum | 10 1/2 ounces fat-free yogurt | 4 3/4 teaspoons cinnamon-raisin bread or 4 1/2 teaspoons cinnamon raisin bread | 4 teaspoons chopped fresh thyme ( or 1 teaspoon dried thyme ) | 5 1/2 ounces cinnamon-raisin bread or 5 1/2 ounces cinnamon raisins | 2 cups good quality prepared low-fat yogurt ( optional ) or 2 cups prepared fat free miracle whip-style yogurt ( optional )
instructions: Place potatoes in a 12 inch saute pan with a lid. Combine sugar, rum and 1/4 cup water in a small cup or measuring cup. Heat mixture to boiling, stirring. Reduce heat to low and simmer until potatoes are tender, about 20 minutes. Do not overcook. Drain excess liquid. Transfer potatoes to a bowl and toss with remaining ingredients. Makes 8 servings. Note, you could also choose to use 1 1/2 lbs of lamb to make this recipe.

title: Broccole Filled Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger | 2 tablespoons white sesame seeds | 1 tablespoon broccoli, chopped
instructions: Combine hamburger, sesame seeds and broccoli in a bowl. Use 1 teaspoon to make a meat filling about 3 inches in diameter. Close top of bowl with wet fingers and make shallow indentation in top of meat mixture. Cover with a paper towel and let sit at room temperature, stirring occasionally, for 30 minutes to marinate filling. Can be prepared up to 6 hours ahead to make sandwiches.

title: Peanut Baked Pasta
ingredients: 1 package farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta | 1/4 pound unsalted dry-roasted peanuts | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano, or to taste
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook pasta uncovered, stirring occasionally, until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 12 minutes. Drain and transfer to a bowl. Mash the peanuts with a fork in a mortar and pestle, then stir in the dried oregano. Place about 1/2 teaspoon of the peanut mixture in the uncooked pasta, top with about 1/3 cup of the remaining peanut mixture and 1/2 teaspoon each of the peanuts and oregano.

title: Mango and Olive Parfait
ingredients: 1/2 pound mango chutney | 1/2 cup light whipping cream | 1/4 teaspoon accent seasoning | 3/4 cup seedless raisins | 1/4 jar sliced black olives, drained and chopped | 1/2 cup chopped pimiento | 1/2 cup chopped drained canned peaches | 1 can light plump pitted and drained wild blueberries
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Stir the mango chutney, whipping cream, accent, raisins, olives, pimentos, and peaches together in a bowl. Arrange half of the fruit mixture in the bottom of a 2 quart baking dish. Top with half of the remaining fruit mixture. Repeat layering with remaining fruit and fruit mixture. Bake in the preheated oven until the center is puffed and fruit is hot and the fruit is bubbling, 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Rosemary Rose Liqueur
ingredients: 6 sprigs fresh rosemary | ice | whipping cream | fresh rosemary, to garnish
instructions: Wash the rosemary sprigs under cold water. Split the sprigs, remove the leaves and cut the sprigs into smaller pieces. Place the rosemary in a small bowl or preserving jar with a little juice. Place the rosemary and 4 tbsp of salt in a small saucepan and cook slowly over low heat, stirring frequently, until the leaves are soft and the liquid has reduced to 1 cup, about 45 minutes. Remove the rosemary and discard before using. To serve, add extra rosemary sprigs to each glass, drizzle with a little cream and pour over the rosemary flavored syrup. Add more cream and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: lebanese cucumber,water chestnut,lemon juice,ginger garlic paste,potato,green chilies,white vermouth,italian parsley
title: Green Gazpacho
ingredients: 500 -700 g boiling potatoes ( medium sized ones ) | 1 lebanese cucumber | 1 bunch italian parsley | 3 -5 green chilies | 3 -5 water chestnuts ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon lemon juice | 1 pinch ginger-garlic paste | 1 tablespoon water chestnut ( optional ) | 2 -4 teaspoons white vermouth or 2-4 teaspoons dry white wine
instructions: Peel and finely dice potatoes. Finely chop cucumber and parsley. Mix well. Cut chilies in thin half lengthwise, seeds and membrane removed for a garnish. Dice water chestnuts into small chunks. Combine all the above ingredients and mix well. Chill at least half an hour before serving to allow flavors to develop. Serve sprinkled on top of gazpacho or with sliced bread. Garnish with a few small, dusted with powdered sugar and dried cilantro if desired.

title: Texas Chocolate Cake
ingredients: 1 package taco seasoning mix | 1 cup chopped pistachio ice cream | 2/3 cup unsweetened cocoa
instructions: In a medium size mixing bowl combine taco seasoning and cacao. Beat until all ingredients are well blended. Pour into greased and floured 12 inch cake pan. Slice cake at 1 inch intervals. Bake at 350 degrees fahrenheit for 40 to 45 minutes or until a toothpick comes out clean. Let cool slightly, then carefully unmold onto a serving plate.

Random Ingredients: water,hominy,black mustard seed,cream tartar,coconut oil,chocolate coffee bean,brown rice
title: Namibian Mafe
ingredients: 1/2 cup brown rice | 2 cups water | 1 can hominy, drained and rinsed ( reserve juice ) | 2 tablespoons coconut oil | 1/3 cup low-fat sour cream or 1/3 cup tartar | 1/3 teaspoon black mustard seeds | 1 can chocolate-covered coffee beans ( drained )
instructions: Place rice in a 2 quart casserole dish. Warm water over medium high heat until just boiling, stirring to make a slight boil in center of dish. Turn heat to low.

title: Oystershells Shoofly Pie
ingredients: 1 puff pastry sheet, thawed | 1 cup half-and-half | 4 tablespoons mayonnaise ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon oyster sauce | 1 cup shredded smoked mozzarella cheese | 3 tablespoons icing sugar | 1 tablespoon butter
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees f. Roll out the pastry sheet on a lightly floured work surface. Transfer the dough to the work surface, and roll it into a 24 inch circle measuring about 1/8 inch thick. Cut the dough into 4 wedges, and place about 2 tablespoons of the cheese and 1 tablespoon of juice from the oyster sauce in the center. Fold the corners into the center, and crimp the edges firmly with a fork. Bake in the preheated oven until the edges are golden brown and the crust edges feel dry, about 11 minutes. Let cool. Melt the butter in a small saucepan over medium heat. Stir in the icing sugar, and pour in the hot butter, and stir until the icing has thicken. Pour the caramel sauce over the top, and bake until the cream has dried slightly, and the cheese is bubbling, about 1 to 2 minutes. Cool, remove the triangles from the pan, and place on a plate or platter. Spread the remaining oyster sauce over the top, and top with the cheesy scallions.

title: Grilled Steak with Vegetables (Vegan Friendly)
ingredients: 2 lbs sirloin, thinly sliced ( or use a top sirloin steak that is cut into 4-6 slices with the skin ) | vegan margarine ( to brush the grate ) | kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Place the slices of meat in a large bowl and sprinkle generously with salt and pepper. Spread the margarine on the surface of the meat and then with your hands, roll up the meat jelly roll style, pressing firmly into the liquid. Place the meat on the grill rack and brush with a little more oil. Cover with plastic wrap and allow to sit at room temperature for 20 minutes. During the second 20 minutes, remove from grill and grill the meat.

Random Ingredients: liquid smoke,sunflower seed oil,chili powder,tart apple
title: Spicy Sunflower Seed Apples
ingredients: 2 large tart apples, such as granny smith, granny smith, red and orange | 1 cup toasted sunflower seed oil | 2 tablespoons chili powder | 1 tablespoon liquid smoke
instructions: Peel and core apples and cut into 3/4 inch thick slices. In a deep skillet, heat oil to 375 degrees. Cook apples over medium high heat until light golden brown, stirring frequently, about 5 minutes. Add spices and cook until fragrant, about 30 seconds. Immediately remove apples from skillet and serve.

title: Baked Sesame Bread and Chips
ingredients: 4 slices white bread | 1 teaspoon sesame oil | 2 slices guacamole | 1 teaspoon vinegar | 1 teaspoon sesame oil | 1 1/2 cups quinoa, rinsed
instructions: Cut 1 slice from the top to bottom of each piece of bread to make a lid. Carefully remove the bread from top shell. Cut from top shell to make a lid. To use, wrap the top cap tightly with string or foil. Microwave on high power for 8 minutes. Remove from microwave and replace top cap. Microwave for 10 minutes or leave aside for up to 10 minutes. Remove from microwave and place onto another rack. Repeat process with remaining slices. To serve, heat 1 teaspoon of sesame oil in a non stick, ovenproof, heavy skillet over medium high heat. Add 2 slices bread to the hot oil and fry on both sides until crisp. Turn over. Arrange a few chips in a ring on each plate and top with guacamole, remaining sesame oil and vinegar. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: topping,cheddar cheese,parsley flake,black tea,cream celery soup,beef chuck,cake flour,red cabbage
title: Best Ever Cottage Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 lb lean boneless beef chuck, cut into 1/2 inch slices | 1 can cream of celery soup | 1/2 cup strong black tea, divided | 1/2 cup cake flour or 1/2 cup unbleached cane syrup | 1/2 cup sliced red cabbage | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley flakes | 8 ounces cheddar cheese, grated | mrs. dash dried parsley flakes
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Mix soup and 1/4 cup of dill weed in a large bowl.

title: Microwave Swiss  Beet Salad
ingredients: 1 cup shredded swiss cheese | 3 cups all-purpose flour | 4 cans beets | 12 ounces grape tomatoes, halved
instructions: Cook beets in microwave at high, covered, until tender, about 3 minutes. Cool and cut beets at regular intervals about 3/4 to 1/2 inch thick. Place flour in a 2 quart casserole.

Random Ingredients: vanilla ice cream,serrano pepper,chocolate chip,cardamom seed
title: Chocolate Chip Ice Cream
ingredients: 3/4 cup chopped semisweet chocolate chips or 3/4 cup chocolate chips | 1 tablespoon ground cardamom seeds or 1 tablespoon ground cardamom powder | 1 large serrano peppers or 2 jalapeno peppers, thinly sliced | 1 scoops vanilla ice cream
instructions: Line 2 baking sheets with foil or waxed paper.

Random Ingredients: green olive,hot red pepper flake,malt vinegar,plain yogurt,chicken quarter,chicken breast half
title: Chicken in a Pot With Greek Green Olives
ingredients: 1 lb skinless chicken breast half | 1 teaspoon hot red pepper flakes | 4 small red onions ( about 1 1/2 cups ) or 4 small shallots ( about 1 1/2 cups ) | 1 tablespoon light-colored malt vinegar | fat-free plain yogurt | 2 tablespoons low-fat sour cream or 2 tablespoons greek yogurt
instructions: Place chicken, skin side up in 1 3/4 quart, heavy pot. Sprinkle with red pepper flakes. Add onions. Turn over in pot and cover with water. The pot should be rinsed. Place over high heat.

Random Ingredients: cornstarch,vegetable oil cooking spray,salsa verde,dijon mustard,coffee,teriyaki sauce,salt
title: Mongole Roasted Nachos
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vegetable oil or 2 tablespoons cooking spray, plus extra for greasing | 1 1/2 teaspoons prepared dijon mustard | 1 1/2 teaspoons instant coffee | 1 teaspoon lawry's seasoned salt | 1 tablespoon teriyaki sauce or 1 tablespoon soy sauce | 1 cup salsa verde ( roasted green salsa ) or 1 cup diced tomato, with liquid | 1 teaspoon cornstarch
instructions: Heat oven to 350 degrees f. Spray cookie sheets with vegetable spray. Mix together mustard, coffee, teriyaki sauce, and salt. Spread on cookie sheets. Bake 12 minutes, stirring occasionally. Meanwhile, heat oil in a medium skillet. Spread tortilla with salsa verde. Lay one or two roasted nachos on top, and spoon equal amounts of mustard mixture over them. Cover, and bake 7 minutes or until crispy and hot. Cut each nachos into halves or quarters to serve.

title: Sole-Wrapped Calamari
ingredients: 1/2 lb thin spaghetti | 2 1/2 lbs pork shoulder, bone-in and skin-on, trimmed of excess fat | 2 -3 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 1 tablespoon coriander, ground | salt & freshly ground black pepper | 1 1/2 - 2 lbs firm white fish fillets, such as halibut, sole, tilapia or other firm-fleshed fish | 3/4 lb prosciutto, thinly sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 400f degrees. Place a large baking sheet in oven. Add the bay leaf, if using, and any excess fat to the bottom of the baking sheet. Arrange the pork on the baking sheet, breast side up. Toss the fish fillets with the dark soy sauce and ground coriander, salt and pepper, to taste. Place on top of the pork, skin side down. Slice the prosciutto thinly across the grain. Carefully insert the prosciutto slices and the slices of prosciutto across each fillet. Top the fillets with the sliced fish and brush with the dark soy sauce. Put the baking sheet with the fish in the oven and bake the fillets until the sauce is bubbling and the fish is barely cooked through, about 25 minutes. About 10 to 15 minutes before the fish is done, transfer the fillets to a platter and slice them crosswise into 4 portions. Serve the calamari alongside the cooked pasta..

title: Chinese Takeout Vegetables
ingredients: 2 cups bamboo shoots, rinsed, seeded, cut in thin julienne 1/4-inch strips lengthwise
instructions: Arrange half of the bamboo strips lengthwise in a single layer in a flat bowl. Sprinkle each layer with 1/8 cup soy sauce. Continue to top with remaining bamboo strips, spacing them about 2 inches apart. Cover bowl tightly with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours and up to overnight. Working quickly or handling the vegetables, peel off plastic. Cook vegetables in boiling water with kosher salt 12 to 15 minutes, until tender. Rinse under cold water.

title: Canadian Maple Ribs
ingredients: 4 1/2 cups maple flavored syrup | 2 pounds country-style pork ribs, shank | 1 can sliced ripe olives, drained
instructions: In a large bowl, combine maple syrup and pork ribs. Let marinate in refrigerator for at least half and hour. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Remove meat from marinade. Place on a roasting rack in a roasting pan. Roast in preheated oven for 45 minutes to 1 hour, until internal temperature of the ribs reaches 145 degrees f when measured with a meat thermometer. Reserve remaining marinade. Place olives in a bowl, and pour a small amount of reserved marinade over the olives. Drizzle additional olive over the top, if desired. Increase oven temperature to 450 degrees f, and cook for 1 more hour. Serve on warm plates.

Random Ingredients: heavy whipping cream,crabmeat,potato starch,green chili pepper,pumpkin seed
title: Creamy Crab and Sweet Potatoes
ingredients: 6 large sweet potatoes | 1/2 cup fresh pumpkin seeds | 1/2 - 3/4 cup heavy whipping cream | 2 -3 teaspoons finely chopped green chili peppers | potato starch, as needed
instructions: Place sweet potatoes in a large pot of cold water until tender, about 15 minutes. Drain potatoes and cool completely. Peel potatoes, cut in half, and scoop out and discard center pulp. Cut each half into 1/2 inch thick slices and set aside. Combine pumpkin and mush in a large mixing bowl and add whipping cream, chili pepper, and potato starch, stirring until thickened.

Random Ingredients: tabasco sauce,sesame seed,sherry,poblano chile,cream tartar,rum,clove garlic,buckwheat flour
title: Smoky Ripe Chile
ingredients: 28 ounces poblano chiles or 28 ounces new mexico chiles | 1 cup sour cream | 1/2 cup sherry | 5 tablespoons rum | 1 1/2 teaspoons sesame seeds | 2 whole cloves garlic, minced | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground cloves | 1/2 teaspoon ground cloves | 1/2 teaspoon cream of tartar
instructions: Roast the chiles directly over flame or griddle or under broiler as close to the heat as possible, turning, until skins blister and blacken, about 10 minutes. Immediately slit chiles open along side of stem, and remove stems. Leaving stems intact, slit chiles lengthwise in half, remove seeds, leaving 1/4 inch thick shells. Cut remaining chiles in 1/4 inch slices. Place the chiles, chile skins, sour cream, sherry, rum, sesame seeds, ground cloves, garlic, ground cloves, and cream of tartar in food processor, process until blended and smooth, about 1 minute. Pour into chile shells, cover and chill 1 hour or overnight, stirring occasionally. Store sealed in airtight container at room temperature in refrigerator for up to 1 week.

title: Polish Style Rotisserie Chicken Wings
ingredients: 2 lbs chicken wings, tips discarded | 1 package polish sweet sausage | 1 large leek, chopped | 1 head green cabbage, chopped | 1 package mixed frozen stir fry vegetables | 1 packet prepared sweet-and-sour mix
instructions: Slice the turkey wings lengthwise and place them face in freezer. Cut sausage to fit the size ziploc bag, and place in a large pot with 4 quarts water to cover. Bring to a boil and reduce heat to medium. Simmer for 20 minutes, then drain. When cool enough to handle, discard casing and rinse chicken wings under cool water. Shred or cut chicken wings into strips with poultry shears or scissors. Transfer chicken to the freezer in a gallon sized zipper bag. Cut cabbage and leeks crosswise into 2 inch pieces. Place in a large pot with remaining 1/2 water, and cook 4 minutes on medium heat. Add turkey wings, sausage, and leeks. Cook covered about 15 to 30 minutes, until meat is no longer pink near the bone. Add vegetables and mix throughly. Remove from heat and mix together well enough to heat through. Serve with crusty italian bread.

title: Linguine With Green Olives, Olives and Green Linguine
ingredients: linguine
instructions: Fill a large pot with water and bring to a boil over high heat. Once the water boils, stir in the linguine and return to a boil. Cook the pasta uncovered, stirring occasionally, until it has cooked through but is still firm to the bite, about 10 minutes. Drain the linguine and transfer to a large platter, reserving 1 cup of the cooking water. Stir the linguine into the reserved linguine cooking water and pour over the linguine.

title: Coconut Beef Stew
ingredients: 1 lb beef chuck steak | 1 can unsweetened coconut juice | 1 1/2 large yellow squash, cut in half
instructions: Brown chuck flank steak on all sides in lg skillet. Add coconut juice and yellow squash. Cover and simmer for 30 minutes.

title: Olive Oil Vinaigrette
ingredients: 7 1/2 teaspoons canola oil | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves
instructions: Stir canola oil, oregano, and salt together in a bowl. Cover bowl with dampened lettuce paper and refrigerate until well chilled, at least 2 hours.

title: Potato Sticks With plum tomatoes
ingredients: 2 lbs plum tomatoes, chopped ( about 2 pounds ) | 1/2 cup potato starch | 1/2 cup dijon-style mustard
instructions: Mix together the tomatoes the potato starch and mustard, stir until smooth. Brush 1/4 cup mustard on each potato stick and grill, turning often, until golden and crisp, 30 minutes to 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: confectioner ' sugar,serrano pepper,flat leaf parsley,pear,brown sugar,allspice
title: Pears with Pearl Sugar
ingredients: 2 teaspoons ground mixed candied pear | 2 tablespoons sour orange-glaze or 2 tablespoons brown sugar | 2 tablespoons chopped flat leaf parsley | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground allspice | 1/2 teaspoon minced fresh serrano pepper | 1 cup confectioners'sugar, for dusting
instructions: Place the pear, sour orange glaze, parsley, allspice, and serrano pepper in a food processor or blender. Process until smooth. Spoon pear mixture between your hands into paper small cups. Dust with additional confectioners' sugar, if desired.

title: Garlicky Cheese with Herbs
ingredients: 2 ounces salt pork, diced | 3 tablespoons mixed italian herbs, such as dill, tarragon, chives and mint, minced | 2 tablespoons double cream
instructions: Put the salt pork into a pan with the herbs, and cook over a low heat, stirring, for about 10 minutes, or until the salt pork is melted and slightly colored. Stir in the cream and remove from the heat.

title: Homemade Beef Wellingtons
ingredients: 1 sheet puff pastry | 1 lb ground beef or 1 lb ground turkey
instructions: Roll out puff pastry on lightly floured board until it is very thin and not very thick. Cut out circles from the pastry with a 3 by 3 inch round cutter, the size of a biscuit cutter. Place one tablespoon of beef or turkey in the center of one of the circles. Fold the unfilled circle over and crimp the edges with a fork. Prick the top and sides with a fork several times to vent steam. If using a fork, use a tooth pick to poke a few holes in the pastry. Place the puff pastry on a baking sheet and cook in your oven at 450 degrees for about 20 minutes. Remove from oven, cool slightly and remove toothpicks. Store in an airtight container for up to 2 weeks.

Random Ingredients: chile pepper,broiler fryer chicken,fast rising active yeast,taco seasoning
title: Quick and Easy Mexican Broiler-Chicken
ingredients: 1 broiler-fryer chickens, cut up | 1 cup hot prepared chile pepper, chopped | 1 tablespoon taco seasoning | 10 packets fast-rising active dry yeast
instructions: Place the chicken in a greased baking dish. Mix the hot pepper with taco seasoning, and sprinkle over the chicken. Bake, uncovered, in a preheated 375 degrees f oven for 90 to 120 minutes, or until the internal temperature of the chicken is 165 degrees f.

Random Ingredients: espresso powder,string bean,french bread,basil,yeast,celery rib,green olive
title: Green Olive and String Bean Grilled Loaf
ingredients: 1 cup fresh green olives, pitted and quartered | 2 slices french bread | 1 celery rib | 1/2 ounce dried yeast | 1 tablespoon instant espresso powder | 5 -6 cups bread, loaf | 2 cups string beans ( fresh or frozen sliced-optional )
instructions: Place all ingredients in a food processor except for the bread and string beans and process until well combined. Transfer to a greased loaf pan and place in a warm spot. Let rise till doubled. Preheat grill to high or preheat broiler pan. Brush loaf with the espresso, broil loaf until warmed through and lightly toasted on top. Slice to serve.

Random Ingredients: guajillo chilies,baby spinach,pork roast,orange zest,worcestershire sauce,blood orange juice,pork shoulder
title: Mexican Pork Sandwiches (Pulled Pork Carnitas)
ingredients: 1 orange, zest of | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 1 tablespoon guajillo chilies, roasted, seeded, chopped ( or 2 serrano chilies depending on heat desired ) | 1/2 lb baby spinach | 1 1/2 lbs boneless pork shoulder, cut in 2 portions | 16 ounces fresh blood oranges in juice | 20 small dried guajillo chilies
instructions: Marinate pork with all the marinade ingredients in a sealed plastic container, refrigerate covered. Drain juice from blood oranges into a skillet. Bring pan to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer 2 - 3 minutes. Stir in the chilis and remove from heat. In a greased skillet, brown pork over medium heat 2 - 3 minutes, turning to brown on all sides. Add pork to hot marinade and bring to low boil. Reduce heat to simmer, cover, and cook 35 - 45 minutes or until pork is tender. Remove and slice into 1 thick slices. Serve with thick slices of avocado.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon cube,mustard powder,cabbage leaf,feta cheese,chunky peanut butter
title: Crispy Feta Cheese Chicken (With Peanut Sauce)
ingredients: 1 -2 cabbage leaf | 1/2 cup thick & chunky peanut butter | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 1/2 - 3/4 teaspoon mustard powder ( not salt ) | 2 teaspoons crumbled feta cheese
instructions: Cut slits in cabbage leaves to form slaw shape. Remove core from cabbage and discard. Combine peanut butter with broth cube, mustard and pepper. Stir well. Pour cheese sauce over cabbage leaves and toss together so peanut butter coat all the leaves. Place in steamed basket for 2 minutes. This will make your little ones droppin them like a bird's hat and it will cook fast at the table.

title: Enchilada Soup
ingredients: 2 slices bacon, chopped | 2 cups frozen peas, thawed and drained | 1 cup fat-free refried beans | 1 cup chopped brocolli squash | 1 cup chopped butternut squash | 1 can red enchilada sauce | 1/2 cup beef stock or 1/2 cup canned low sodium chicken broth | 6 cups arugula leaves
instructions: Place bacon over medium heat in a large pot or dutch oven. Cook until brown, 3 - 4 minutes. Remove bacon from pot with slotted spoon and set aside. Add peas and 1 tablespoon oil to pot and cook until the peas are lightly browned and tender, 30 - 45 seconds. Add brocolli, squash, and enchilada sauce and cook 3 - 4 minutes more. Add beef stock and bacon. Bring to boil and add arugula. Reduce heat and simmer, uncovered, for 5 minutes, or until arugula wilts.

title: Japanese Vinegar Ginger Dressing
ingredients: 1/2 cup rice vinegar | 2 teaspoons lemon juice | 1 teaspoon fresh ginger juice
instructions: Pour over ice in an empty jar or jar that has been properly disposed of the ginger. Close tightly and shake well. If you can wait that long, refrigerate before shaking, it will be very hot.

title: Fennel-Cheese Pasta
ingredients: 8 ounces macaroni or 8 ounces rotini pasta, uncooked | 1/4 teaspoon fennel seed | 2 cups shredded monterey jack cheese or 2 cups queso fresco
instructions: Cook macaroni according to package directions, drain and rinse with cold water. Cool slightly. Dissolve fennel seed in 1/4 cup boiling water. Place in 3 quart casserole and let stand for 15 minutes. Add the remaining ingredients and mix well. Cover and bake at 350f for 40 minutes until heated through.

Random Ingredients: hard egg,gold tequila,spring onion,swiss chard,oatmeal,herb,pork loin,pepper
title: Oatmeal Tacos
ingredients: 4 ounces swiss chard, stems removed | 6 hard-boiled eggs, coarsely chopped | 1 spring onion, finely chopped | 1/4 cup golden tequila | 2 teaspoons dried herbs ( parsley, thyme, rosemary ) | 2 teaspoons rolled oats | 1 tablespoon ground pepper | 1 lb pork loin, thinly sliced
instructions: Place chard leaves in colander over 1 cup cold water, and let stand 15 minutes. Drain. Meanwhile, place eggs in a 2 cup glass measure.

title: Shrimp Jumbo Shrimp
ingredients: 1/4 cup apple juice | 1 tablespoon oyster sauce | 1 lb jumbo shrimp, deveined and shelled | 2 tablespoons snipped fresh chives ( optional )
instructions: Mix apple juice, oyster sauce and chives in small bowl.

title: Korean Soy Beef and Pork Strip
ingredients: 1 beef cube steak | 4 pork tenderloin
