instructions: Slice beef and pork tenderloins 1/4 inch thick. Heat oil over high heat. Fry beef and pork tenderloins until meat is browned and cooked. Remove meat and pork strips and set aside on paper towels to drain excess oil. Save pan drippings. Serve meat over jasmine rice.

Random Ingredients: purpose flour,spaghetti,thai red curry paste,dark brown sugar,green pepper,shallot,anise seed
title: Thai Spaghetti (Red Curry Pasta)
ingredients: 10 ounces uncooked spaghetti | 1 tablespoon light-colored anise seed | 1/2 cup shallot | 1 green pepper, cut into thin strips | 1 tablespoon all-purpose flour | 2 tablespoons thai red curry paste | 1/4 cup dark brown sugar
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add spaghetti and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

Random Ingredients: corn,cabbage,pancetta,chili sauce,golden syrup,orange juice,dark brown sugar,oil
title: Souper Corn and Bacon Salad
ingredients: 2 tablespoons oil | 250 g shredded cabbage | 250 g shredded pumpkin or 250 g chopped frozen potatoes ( 50g ) | 3 tablespoons golden syrup | 2 tablespoons orange juice | 1/2 tablespoon chili sauce | 2 tablespoons dark brown sugar | 375 g corn, drained | 4 slices pancetta, torn into bite sized pieces
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a large non stick frying pan. Add the cabbage, pumpkin, golden syrup, orange juice and chili sauce. Saute over a high heat for around 2 minutes or until the cabbage becomes wilted. Cool slightly and then mix in the sugar and corn. Serve with slices of pancetta.

Random Ingredients: tamari,hamburger,beef stew meat,thai chile,egg noodle,red bell pepper
title: Beef Burgundy
ingredients: 2 pounds beef stew meat | 1 red bell pepper | 1 jar tamari | 1 package egg noodles, cooked and drained | 1 tablespoon minced thai chiles | 1 teaspoon tamari
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Spray a large baking dish with nonstick cooking spray. Place the beef stew meat, cayenne pepper, red pepper, and tamari in a slow cooker. Place the cooked egg noodles in a strainer and pour 1/2 cup water into the sink. Rinse with the hot water until cool. Rinse with cold water until the water runs clear. Cut the beef into 1 inch cubes. In a bowl, stir together the meat mixture and the noodles until well blended. Cover and refrigerate for 1 to 8 hours. To serve, heat the reserved liquid in the slow cooker.

title: Onion Relish (welsh Fondue)
ingredients: 1 large onion, chopped | 1/2 cup ketchup, or to taste ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce, or to taste ( optional )
instructions: In a saucepan, stir onion and ketchup together until onion is translucent and warm, about 5 minutes. Transfer onion mixture to a fondue pot, adding worcestershire sauce and simmer 1 minute. Serve with applesauce if desired.

title: Berry Barley Beans
ingredients: 1 can great northern beans ( undrained ) | 1 can blackberries ( undrained ) | barley ( to garnish )
instructions: Mix all ingredients except berry barley in a 3 qt casserole. Cover and bake at 350°f 45 - 55 minutes, until barley is tender and beans heated through. Sprinkle with barley.

title: Pork Medallions with Raisins
ingredients: 1/2 cup orange marmalade | 12 ounces pork tenderloin, cut crosswise into 1/4 inch slices | 1 package fresh white mushrooms, sliced | 1/4 cup raisins | 1/4 cup salami | 1/4 cup chopped confectioners'sugar
instructions: Place the marmalade in a shallow bowl for dipping the pork. Add the pork, mushrooms, raisins, and salami. Toss to coat, cover, and refrigerate for 1 hour. Preheat an oven to 350 degrees f. Line 2 baking sheets with parchment paper. Arrange the pork on the prepared baking sheets. Bake in the preheated oven until the pork is no longer pink on the outside, about 20 minutes. Remove the pork to wire racks to cool completely. Sprinkle the outside of the pork medallions with confectioners' sugar, then transfer to a serving dish, and serve.

title: Lazy New Year's Shrimp Barley Cake
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs large shrimp, peeled ( cleaned ) | 1/4 cup white vinegar | 1/3 cup coarsely chopped pearl barley | 3/4 cup cake flour, sifted
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Bring a medium saucepan of water to boil over high heat. Add the shrimp and cook until pink, 1 - 2 minutes. Drain shrimp through a medium mesh strainer, then transfer to another pot. Add vinegar to skillet and cook until just warm through, about 3 - 4 minutes. Stir in barley. Transfer to a medium bowl and cool to room temperature. Stir in the flour, cover, and refrigerate for 2 hours.

title: Cincahu's Pasta
ingredients: 250 g pasta, whole wheat, penne or 250 g other short pasta, of choice | 2 tablespoons peanut oil | 1 -2 teaspoon cumin, to taste | 1 -4 teaspoon yellow food coloring or 1 -4 teaspoon green food coloring, to desired colour | 1/3 - 1/2 cup coco lopez or 1/3-1/2 cup other brandy | 2 -3 tablespoons cointreau liqueur or 2 -3 tablespoons other orange liqueur
instructions: Cook pasta and rinse. Drain pasta.

Random Ingredients: bay leaf,pie crust,peanut butter,rice krispies,ice,red chile pepper
title: Thai Peanut Butter Rice Krispies Squares
ingredients: 1 package pie crusts | 3 tablespoons peanut butter | 12 cups rice krispies | 2 1/2 cups peanut butter | 2 cans red chile peppers, chopped | 5 whole bay leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Open rice krispies cereal and crumble into a bowl, and reserve 3 cups in a separate bowl. In a separate large bowl, mix together 1 cup peanut butter and rice krispies cereal and 1/2 cup of chile sauce. Pour rice krispies mixture into the bowl of peanut butter. Add the 2 cans of red chile peppers and bay leaves. Stir mixture together. Pour into the prepared pie crust. Bake in preheated oven until lightly browned, about 35 minutes.

Random Ingredients: tahini,pork chop,red food coloring,beer,spanish onion,garlic,vegetable stock,provolone cheese
title: Pork Chop Saute With Beer
ingredients: 1/3 cup vegetable stock | 1/3 cup beer | 1 1/2 tablespoons tahini | 1 teaspoon minced garlic | 1/8 teaspoon crushed red food coloring | 1/8 teaspoon crumbled provolone cheese ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons shredded provolone cheese | 16 thin slices pork chops | 2 slices spanish onions
instructions: Combine vegetable stock, beer, tahini, garlic, crushed red food coloring, and provolone cheese together. In a 12x9 inch nonstick skillet, coat pork chops with meat mixture. Saute for 5 to 7 minutes per side, or until cooked through. Serve with sliced swiss cheese and additional red food coloring, if desired.

title: Irish Cream (Taste and add more salt or lemon juice if desired )
ingredients: 3 -4 tablespoons irish cream | 1 tablespoon cider vinegar | 1 -2 tablespoon cream topping | 1 tablespoon dried mixed italian herbs ( any dried herbs is fine )
instructions: Place all ingredients into a blender. Cover and blend until smooth. Chill. Serve with your favourite fruit crackers or french bread. Note, make sure it is cold with a bit of baking soda at the bottom.

title: Bacon & Eggplant Casserole
ingredients: 1/2 lb turkey ham ( not crumbled ) or 1/2 lb bacon, chopped ( not crumbled ) | 4 small eggplants, sliced in rounds, lengthwise | 4 tablespoons canadian bacon fat ( or bacon drippings ) | 4 tablespoons superfine sugar ( or brown sugar ) | 6 ounces canadian bacon, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 325f / 200c / gas mark arrange ham and eggplant in a lightly greased casserole dish, brushing with butter or dripping over the pieces. Sprinkle with sugar and bacon or other chosen optional ingredients. Bake for about an hour or until the pieces are golden and cooked through. Serve warm, with crusty bread.

title: Simple Sausage Rolls
ingredients: 500 g puff pastry, thawed | 1 cup chunky salsa
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c. Put the sausage balls 2cm/1/2in apart on a lightly greased & floured baking tray. Bake in the oven for about 15 mins, stirring a few times, until cooked through and golden. Spoon sausages onto baking sheets & keep warm. To serve, spoon salsa onto the sausages & top with the pastry. Serve with crusty bread or as appetisers snack.

title: Texas Turkey Salad
ingredients: 2 cans sliced pineapple, drained | 1 can sliced bamboo shoots, chopped | 2 pounds boneless turkey breast, thinly sliced | 2 jar salsa | 2 cups fresh strawberries, halved
instructions: Preheat the oven broiler. Arrange the pineapple slices evenly on a small baking sheet. Place the bamboo shoots among the pineapple slices. Top with turkey slices. Arrange the mango slices alongside the turkey. Pour salsa over everything. Place in the preheated oven, and broil for 8 minutes, or until the topping is golden brown. Chiffonade, stir ingredients together in a bowl until thoroughly mixed. Chill, for flavors to blend, for a few hours.

title: Lemon Ice Cream (Cream)
ingredients: 250 300 g lemon rinds or 250 g lindless lemons, grated ( a little less than 1 tbsp of grated rind ) | 250 300 g double cream or 250 300 g fresh cream, whipped until thick ( you can also use whip-meats if you like )
instructions: Using a metal spoon, scrape the grated lemon rind into the cream. It should be the consistency of whipped cream and the juices should be visible.

Random Ingredients: cream mushroom soup,lasagne noodle,vanilla essence,head cabbage
title: Low Fat Lasagne Cream-Mushroom Vegetable Bake
ingredients: 1 medium head of cabbage, finely chopped | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence | 1/4 kg light cream of mushroom soup | 15 dry lasagne noodles, cooked
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a medium deep frying pan. Mix well and cook over a medium heat for aprox 1 hour or until thick and creamy. Serve warm over your favourite pasta.

Random Ingredients: penne pasta,american cheese,black lentil,kosher salt,chili sauce,yeast
title: Danish White Lentil-Cheese Pasta Pizza
ingredients: kosher salt | 1 1/2 cups white lentils | 2 1/2 - 3 cups penne pasta, uncooked | 1 cup chili sauce | 1 cup of grated american cheese | 1 teaspoon yeast
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together the white lentils and the kosher salt. The water should be about 2 above the lentils. Soaking them separately helps bring out their flavor and moisture. Add the chili sauce and stir to combine. Let the lentils and liquid rest for about 5 minutes so they're not sticking together. If needed add more water to get rid of any of the lentils and liquid that's floating to the surface. Drain the pasta in a colander, and return the pasta to the pot. Add the sauce onto the pasta in the bowl, and mix to combine. Sprinkle the cheese on top, cover and let rise for about 30 minutes. Cook the pizza as you would normally. This makes enough to feed a pizza approximately 20 to 30 minutes, depending on what kind of pasta you’d like baked in.

Random Ingredients: italian plum tomato,portabella mushroom,potato,chuck steak,orange liqueur,pineapple juice,tomato puree
title: Beef Steak Sweet (Sweet or Savory)
ingredients: 1 lb chuck steak | 2 sweet potatoes | 1/2 cup orange liqueur | 6 ounces italian plum tomatoes | 6 ounces pineapple juice | 2 tomatoes puree | 5 portabella mushrooms
instructions: Slice steak thinly, and place in crockpot. Cut sweet potatoes into wedges, place in crockpot. Slice mushrooms, and place on top of meat. Mash plum tomatoes on top of meat. Mix tomato puree with pineapple juice until well combined. Pour over top of vegetables. Cook on low 2 hours. Serve with crusty bread and plenty of freshly steamed vegetables.

title: Gourmet Asadero Cheese Ball
ingredients: 1 lb asadero cheese, cut into 1-inch squares | granola cereal
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. In a large bowl or storage container, combine cheese and granola until uniformly distributed. On a parchment lined baking sheet, using small bits of cheese mix, roll each piece in the granola to coat evenly. Place balls onto prepared baking sheet. Bake until the edges are browned and cheese is melted, about 25 minutes.

title: Chef John's Vegetable Biscotti
ingredients: 1 container frozen mixed vegetables | 1 tablespoon baking soda | 1/3 cup coarsely chopped pistachio nuts
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Line baking sheets with parchment paper or aluminum foil. Squeeze out the excess moisture from the frozen vegetables. Place the vegetables in a colander, and rinse them under cold water. Place the vegetables in a large bowl, and toss with the baking soda. Spread the pistachios over the top of the vegetables, and use your fingers to press the pistachios into the vegetables. If the dough sould hold the shape of a stick, toss it now, and then if necessary, to keep it from sticking to your hands. The vegetables should be slightly chunky. Line two baking sheets with parchment paper, and place 1/2 cupfuls of the vegetable mixture in them. Bake the dough on the prepared baking sheets until the top is golden brown and very sticky, 12 to 15 minutes. Let cool on the baking sheets, and carefully peel off parchment paper from the sheets. Place a clean cloth over the top of the biscotti, and let cool on a wire rack. Store in an airtight container for up to 3 weeks.

Random Ingredients: lamb loin chop,coriander seed,caster sugar,tequila,mayonnaise,cream chicken soup,chipotle chile adobo
title: Mexican Lamb Chops
ingredients: 4 lamb loin chops ( total weight 90g total is equivalent. ) | 1/4 cup light mayonnaise | 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1/2 lb tequila | 3 chipotle chiles in adobo, seeded and chopped | 1 cup chopped fresh coriander seeds | 1 teaspoon caster sugar
instructions: Mix together mayonnaise, soup, tequila, chillies, coriander and sugar in a shallow baking dish. Coat chops in this mixture. Bake in oven on 350f for 20 mins turning once or twice until cooked through.

title: Cape Inn Gluten Free Applesauce for Noodles
ingredients: 1 egg noodles | 2 tablespoons golden syrup | 1 tablespoon apple cider vinegar
instructions: Prepare noodles according to package directions. While cooking, in a small bowl, stir together golden syrup and vinegar. Drain cooked noodles in a colander until all remaining liquid has run out. Combine noodles with syrup mixture, and serve.

Random Ingredients: bell pepper,rigatoni pasta,pinto bean,tomato sauce,white pepper,cornflour,dark rum,cream cheese
title: Rigatoni con Carne With Pinto Beans and Rum.
ingredients: 250 g rigatoni pasta | 150 g pinto beans | 500 g tomato sauce | 4 ounces cream cheese | 1 - 1 1/2 fluid ounce dark rum | white pepper | 6 -8 bell peppers | 2 tablespoons cornflour
instructions: Boil, then add the pinto beans and fry for 5 minutes. Boil the tomato sauce for 10 minutes and then add the cream cheese and rum, blend well and let it melt for few minutes. Add the bell peppers to the sauce. Cook the rigatoni at the same time you fry the pinto beans. Drain them and mix them with the sauce. Season to taste and then pour in the sauce in to a glass dish. Sprinkle the top of the rigatoni with pepper powder and let it sit in a cool place for 25 to 35 minutes before serving. Serve either alone, with or without the garnishes.

title: Gosht
ingredients: 3 ounces dried green lentils | 9 ounces cashews ( salted, cashews coarsely chopped ) | 1/4 teaspoon dried sage
instructions: Rinse the lentils well, and dry them thoroughly again. Add to a large saucepan or pot along with cashewnuts and sage. Bring to a boil and simmer gently over low heat for 2 to 2 1/2 hours, until lentils are very tender and the liquid is absorbed. If the lentils are drying out, simmer uncovered until very tender. Add water if they are drying out. Transfer the hot gosht to a serving bowl and chill until cold for several hours so the gosht will keep its flavour and texture. Serve cold with bread.

title: Spicy Finnish Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 can whole shiitake mushrooms | 1 small onion, finely chopped | 1/8 teaspoon ground cardamom pod | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
instructions: Place the mushrooms, onion, cardamom, and vanilla into a small saucepan or skillet over medium heat. Stir occasionally until the onions are slightly wilted. Pour the mixture into a blender or food processor and blend until smooth. Transfer to a small bowl and serve. Store at room temperature for up to 3 days.

title: Finnish Potato Salad
ingredients: 1 package simply potatoes & reg ; shredded hash browns, partially frozen | 1/2 cup fresh cranberries or 1/2 cup crushed dried cranberries | 1 teaspoon garlic powder ( or to taste )
instructions: Place the frozen hash browns in a non metallic bowl. Sprinkle with the dried cranberries and garlic powder to taste. Cover and chill the potatoes for an hour or so before serving. Serve cold or warm with butter flavored crackers, crumbled wheat toast, or crispbreads. Store in refrigerator.

title: Bengali Sushi
ingredients: 2 tablespoons channa dal | 2 teaspoons lime juice | cherries, as required
instructions: Heat up a griddle. Grind dal in a mortar & pestle. Place into heated griddle. When a few splatters appear on the surface, add 2 tsp lime juice and mix well. Allow to cool for about 10 minutes before grinding in food processor. Roll up into a ball and store in airtight container until needed. This will keep for 3 - 4 days.

Random Ingredients: orange peel,bread flour,taco seasoning,lemon zest,vegetable oil cooking spray,banana liqueur
title: Crunchy Mexican Banana Bagels
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups bread flour ( multigrain ) | 1/4 cup taco seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon lemon zest | 1/2 cup vegetable oil or 1/2 cup cooking spray | 5 firm bananas ( or can bananas ) | 1 cup orange-flavored liqueur ( your choice, i prefer grand marnier )
instructions: Combine the flour, taco seasoning and lemon peel, mix with an electric mixer. Cut bananas in half lengthwise, then lengthwise into thirds. Spray a 9x5x3 or rectangular baking pan with cooking spray. Coat the bread with oil. Cut the bananas crosswise into thick fingers, like your fingers. Arrange the banana fingers in the pan. Coat the bananas with the orange liqueur. Put in the fridge till needed. When you are ready to bake the bagels, heat oven to 400 degrees. Bake the bagels for 18 - 20 minutes.

title: Beef With Cannellini Beans
ingredients: 1 tablespoon shallot, minced | 1/2 lb boneless bottom round steak, sliced thinly | 4 ounces cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 1 ounce chicken stock | 2 ounces canned whole canned chilies, undrained | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace | 2 firm ripe bananas, halved lengthwise, peeled, cut lengthwise in half
instructions: Heat a skillet until very hot. Add the shallot and cook over high heat until browned, about 1 minute. Transfer shallot to a plate and stir in remaining ingredients. Bring to a boil, cover, and cook over low heat until beef is tender, about 8 minutes. Spoon beef and bean mixture into a 2 qt. Dutch oven.

title: Macaroni Spinach and Prosciutto Pasta
ingredients: 1 package macaroni | 1 package farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta, cooked and drained | 2 cups baby spinach leaves | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne pepper, or to taste | 1/4 cup thinly sliced prosciutto, chopped
instructions: Preheat an oven to 350 degrees f. Place the pasta in a large baking dish.

Random Ingredients: italian herb,sunflower oil,chocolate,dark sesame oil,navel orange,orange
title: Grilled Orange Roughy
ingredients: 50 g grated chocolate | 150 g orange roughy sticks | 2 cups mixed italian herbs | 1 cup sunflower oil | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil | 1 navel orange, halved
instructions: Place the chocolate and orange roughy sticks together in a microwave safe bowl, cover with clingfilm and cook on high for 1 minute, stirring occasionally. Leave to stand until cool enough to handle, then cut into 1/4 inch cubes. Remove skin that has formed over the orange, then cut into quarters, removing the membrane and seeds. Combine the oil and sesame oils in a small saucepan and simmer over a gentle heat for 3 - 5 minutes until golden. Cool slightly before adding the orange sections. Remove skin from orange, then cut across the grain into segments. Pour the orange sauce into serving glasses and place the orange sections of orange and chocolate cubes together and place on a plate or tray to serve.

title: Sopa De Dexter
ingredients: 14 ounces bok choy | 12 ounces sliced ham | 2 large green olives | 2 1/2 tablespoons cracked black peppercorns | 4 tablespoons salsa | 16 1/2 fluid ounces fat-free topping ( optional ) | 6 -10 leaves fresh green olives, trimmed
instructions: Cut away the hard central stem from the bok choy. Halve lengthwise and remove the root end of the bok choy. Cut into thin slices, then into 1/2 inch wide slices. Toast the black pepper powder lightly in a small skillet and set aside. Trim the ends of the leaves and cut down into the stalk part of the bok choy. Trim the hard shell from each bok choy stalk but leave only the bright green leaves. Cut lengthwise into about 1/2 inch wide slices. Wash and dry the ham slices. Cut them into 1 inch squares using scissors. Cut the green olives in half lengthwise and remove all the green leaf tops.

title: Simple Oyster Sauce French Toast
ingredients: 1 baguette | 2 cans oyster sauce
instructions: Take baguette bread and cut into 1 1/2 inch thick slices and then into 1 1/2 to 2 inch strips. The goal is for a medium slice of bread that will sit out in the freezer and is slightly crunchy. You may have to work your way around, however, it is fun trying anything, especially crostini. Place bread in oven or on griddle and when bread has warmed up, top with oyster sauce. Cook until bread is browned.

title: Khoresht Halwa
ingredients: 1 cup feta | 1 cup white flour | 1 teaspoon anise
instructions: Whip the feta in a mixer with a pinch of salt, until fluffy. Knead flour on a floured surface. Add anise. Make into dough with hands. Keep covered with damp cloth. Keep refrigerated for 4 hours. Cut into 3/4 inch pieces. Serve with tomato sauce. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: basmati rice,island dressing,saffron,apple juice apricot,red cabbage,whipping cream,capsicum
title: Island Risotto
ingredients: 1 cup basmati rice | 1/2 cup capsicum ( chopped ) | 1/4 cup red cabbage ( chopped ) | 400 g island dressing | 1/4 cup apple juice or 1/4 cup apricot juice | 25 g chilled whipping cream | 1 pinch saffron, crushed
instructions: Cook rice in lots of boiling water for 10 minutes until tender and rinse under cold water drain. Add capsicum, cabbage and dressing to rice and continue cooking. Add cream, saffron or sugar and saffron and toss to combine. Serve.

title: Crispy Goat Cheese Polenta Rounds #2
ingredients: 1 cup cornmeal | 1 1/4 cups shredded mozzarella cheese | 1/2 cup crumbled goat cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Lightly grease a 9x13 baking pan. Combine cornmeal, shredded cheese, and goat cheese in a mixing bowl. Spread mixture evenly into prepared pan to form a 2 cup mark for polenta slices.

Random Ingredients: plain flour,soba noodle,broccoli slaw mix,pumpkin pie spice,pumpkin,shortening
title: Harry's Pumpkin, Pasta and Broccoli Noodle Casserole
ingredients: 1/4 cup shortening | 1 cup plain flour | 1 teaspoon pumpkin pie spice | 500 g chinese broccoli slaw mix | 350 g pumpkin ( pumpkin cut up pieces ) | 300 g soba noodles
instructions: Preheat oven 200degc. Grease an oven proof dish. Use 1/4 cup shortening to grease a 20cm x 30cm casserole dish. Heat shortening in a frying pan then add flour and stir for a minute stir in pumpkin and then return to pan. Mix in the soba and cook for a minute or two until golden brown and all the liquid is absorbed. Spread in dish and bake for 45minutes or until golden and firm to touch. Serve with a side dish for vegetables, or make biscuits with the pumpkin, peas and noodles. If you prefer as i do, cut them into smaller pieces and sprinkle over during the last 10 mins of cooking. Also, i like to slice up a carrot and grate it. Yummmmm and that's it.

title: Ramen Snow Peas & Snow Peas
ingredients: 1 package ramen noodles | 12 ounces frozen snow peas | 1/4 cup frozen margarita dressing
instructions: Cook and drain noodles according to package directions. Remove from heat and drain. Meanwhile, snap peas into 1/4 inch pieces. Put noodles in a large bowl with peas and dressing and toss to mix. Serve immediately.

title: Holiday Salad
ingredients: 4 tablespoons parmesan cheese | 12 ounces bacon, cooked chopped into small pieces | 1 medium parsnip, peeled and cut into small chunks | 1/2 lb veal, chopped | 1 orange, sliced | 4 cups broccoli, cut into small florets
instructions: Drain the bacon pieces in a large skillet or wok. Cook until crisp and golden brown, then drain on paper towels. When you do this, put into a plate with a small slotted spoon or kitchen paper to drain. Chop bacon into small pieces, and put in the skillet with bacon bits, parsnips, and veal. Cook for approximately 5 minutes or until it starts to change color. When it's finished, add the orange slices. Turn on the broiler. Put broiler on high, then shut off. You want your food hot so your broiler is just going to burn it. After about 10 minutes, sprinkle the remaining cheese over the top. Put into the oven for 5 - 10 minutes before serving.

title: Mashed Beans with Asparagus
ingredients: 10 ounces fresh asparagus, trimmed | 1/4 cup butter beans | 1 1/2 cups skim milk ricotta cheese
instructions: Place asparagus and butter beans in a microwave safe casserole dish. Cover and cook on high 3 to 5 minutes, depending on thickness of spears. Top with ricotta.

Random Ingredients: caramel sauce,green bean,red pepper flake,vegetable oil cooking spray,almond,caster sugar,garam masala,nutmeg
title: Chana Saag
ingredients: 3 teaspoons vegetable oil ( or just a splash of oil in a pan ) | 450 g green beans ( cut on the diagonal into 2cm lengths ) | 1 teaspoon vegetable oil ( or just a splash of oil in a pan ) | 1 teaspoon minced garlic | 1/2 cup roasted almonds | 1/2 cup vegetable oil ( or just a splash of oil in a pan ) | 1 cup caramel sauce ( or a couple of drops of caramel powder, i use bertolli caramel ) | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon garam masala | 1 pinch of grated fresh nutmeg | 1/2 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes ( or to taste )
instructions: Heat the oil in a heavy based pan, stirring all the time to prevent browning. Add the garlic and cook stirring continuously until it turns golden around the edges and the garlic darkens to the blond stage, approximately 3 minutes. Remove pan from heat. Cut beans into 2cm lengths and lightly fry in the hot oil until browned, stirring regularly so not to burn the garlic. Remove the beans and set aside. Stir the garlic into the pan and cook over high heat until golden. Reduce to medium high heat until the garlic turns golden around the edges. Add beans to the pan, in batches, and mix through for about 1 minute. Dissolve the caramel in the boiling water and add, stirring through, to the pan. Continue cooking over high heat, stirring through. Stir through the reserved garam masala powder and add the nutmeg and crushed red pepper flakes. The liquid should become thickened.

title: Coconut Carrot Sauce
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups shredded carrots | 1 tablespoon coconut milk | 2 tablespoons cornstarch
instructions: Place carrots in a colander and toss with a bit of corn starch to prevent browning. Heat nonstick skillet over medium heat for 2 minutes. Add coconut milk and cook for about 2 more minutes. Serve over cooked rice.

title: Salmon on a Stick
ingredients: 1 salmon | 2 tablespoons cheese oat cereal | 2 tablespoons bacon
instructions: Place the salmon on a board or cutting board, spread out the salmon and crumble down the spine between the bones, then cut the fish in the shape of a small stick. Sprinkle cheese over the top, roll up and serve.

title: L'abissimo (St. Patrick's Day Breakfast
ingredients: 15 baby carrots | 50 g baby dates | 80 ml tamari | 2 teaspoons unflavored gelatin | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Rinse the carrots with cold water and dry on paper towel. Slice up the dates and place into a bowl with the tamari. Pour half the tamari into the bottom of a frypan over medium heat. Sprinkle gelatin over, and warm for a couple of minutes, or until slightly softened or slightly set. Remove from heat, toss in the carrot mixture, and allow carrots to set a little in the pan. Drizzle half the remaining tamari over the top of this dish, add 2 tbsp of the olive oil to frypan, and cook the carrot mixture on a medium for 2 - 3 minutes, or until they are coated in the gelatin/dollostof and begin to soften or crisp.

title: Ravioli With Vegetables-Sauce
ingredients: 1 package frozen cheese ravioli | 1/2 cup canned tomato soup ( or a little of your favourite )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Place ravioli in a baking dish and cover with tomato soup. Place in the oven and bake until ravioli are tender and ravioli are heated through. Add cheese ravioli to the pan and mix well. Serve with fresh garlic bread.

Random Ingredients: marinara sauce,beef sirloin steak,dark brown sugar,kosher salt,iceberg lettuce
title: Steak and Fresh Herb Salad With Soft-Boiled Eggs
ingredients: 2 tablespoons packed dark brown sugar | 1 tablespoon kosher salt | 2 1/2 lbs beef sirloin steaks, trimmed of fat | 3 medium heads iceberg lettuce - rinsed, dried, and torn into thin strips | 1 jar marinara sauce, well chilled
instructions: In a large covered saucepan, combine the first 5 ingredients. Bring to a boil over high heat. Lower the heat to medium. Cook for 1 minute. Add beef.

title: Pasta With Farfalle Croutons
ingredients: 400 g farfalle pasta ( bowtie pasta ) | 8 cups mesclun, steaky fresh greens, washed, dried and torn into large, even sized pieces
instructions: Cook pasta in plenty of salted water according to packet directions, adding a small splash of olive oil if necessary. Put pasta into a large serving bowl along with the greens, toss to mix.

title: Cauliflower Tzatziki
ingredients: 1 large cauliflower floret | 2 cucumbers, peeled and diced
instructions: In a steamer set over boiling water, cover and steam the cauliflower and cucumbers for about 10 minutes or until softened.

Random Ingredients: italian parsley,lemon juice,watercress,burgundy wine,breadcrumb,szechuan peppercorn,orange peel
title: Hot Burgundy Wine Salad With Oil and Orange Peel
ingredients: 10 ounces burgundy wine | 2/3 cup orange peel, finely julienned with peel | 1/4 cup lemon juice | 1/4 cup watercress, thinly sliced | 3 tablespoons italian parsley, minced | salt & cracked pepper | 1 pinch szechuan peppercorns, cracked into very tiny bits ( more if desired )
instructions: Toss all ingredients together in a bowl. Taste and adjust seasonings. Cover and refrigerate for at least two hours or up to 24 hours.

title: Poultry Magic
ingredients: 1 bottle dry red wine | 2 tablespoons poultry seasoning
instructions: Pour wine through a large holed strainer into a large, clean, dry bottle. Discard any large particles of wine or liquid that have collected on the rim of the bottle. Sprinkle with poultry seasoning. Wipe any residue off of wine with a clean, dry cloth. Store in the refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: cinnamon,mustard powder,chicken drumstick,red chili powder,pasta sauce mushroom,broccoli
title: Noodles in Broccoli and Hot Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons red chili powder | 1 teaspoon mustard powder | 1/4 teaspoon cinnamon | 2 tablespoons prepared pasta sauce ( mushroom, pepper, hoisin sauce ) | 1 1/4 lbs chicken drumsticks | 1 head broccoli, cut into florets
instructions: Mix chilli powder, mustard, cinnamon powder and pasta sauce. Rinse and drain chicken. Put into a large casserole pan. Bake in a preheated 350 degree oven for 1 and 1/2 hours. Add broccoli pieces. Continue baking until chicken juices run clear.

title: Thai Steamed Fish
ingredients: 2 pieces fish or 2 lbs firm white fish | cooking spray | 1 tablespoon cornflour
instructions: Remove skin and thick portion of fish from shell and cut into 2 pieces each. Cut fish into chunks. Dissolve cornflour in warm water and add to water in the pan. Bring to boil, stir, and cover. Steam for 10 minutes. Heat a lightly oiled wok, add fish and stir fry quickly. Pour in boiling sauce and serve with steamed rice.

Random Ingredients: french ladyfinger cooky,catsup,ham,peanut oil,ear corn cob
title: French Honey Maid-Oh-So Easy Chicken
ingredients: 4 french-style ladyfinger cookies | 2 ears corn on the cob | 1 1/2 - 2 ounces ham | 2 tablespoons catsup | peanut oil
instructions: Cook the corn on the cob in a non stick skillet so it will be ready when your finger leaves the cob when you make the bread. If you are making your own, start to prep your own french style biscuits, by first getting them out of a box of frozen bread with a plastic bag. Cut the ham into bite size pieces. When you are ready to assemble, take your cookie, take 1 inch of the corn and then cut a slit in it, place it on your left end of your cookie, remove the husk and stuff it with your ham, then start to stuff the ham with the ham. Place in a deep skillet with a couple of tablespoons of oil. Add the entire head and cook on medium high heat until it is brown. The corn should be ready when it is tender, after the first few minutes, take it out of the skillet and place in a plate. Serve the bread with the stuffing spooned under and around the cookies.

Random Ingredients: sausage,szechuan peppercorn,corn,red cabbage,sirloin steak,ear corn cob
title: Chinese New Year Beef Salad
ingredients: 3 beef stew meat ( sirloin, rib eye, etc. ) | 2 ears corn on the cob, shucked and sliced into 1 1/2 inch squares | 1/2 lb sweet sausage | 3 tablespoons szechuan peppercorns, crushed | 1 large red cabbage, shredded | 1 lb fresh sweet corn, cooked
instructions: Cut the beef into 1 - 3 inch cubes, and place in a mixing bowl. Slice the ears of corn and set in a second serving bowl. Sausage should be cooked and browned slightly. Drain the meat well and chop into 1 inch pieces. Place the chopped beef, corn, sausage, sichuan peppercorns and cabbage in the bottom of a very large bowl. Toss the dressing well with the beef and vegetables. Chill thoroughly at least 3 hours.

Random Ingredients: cream mushroom soup,lemon,chive,pearl barley,onion powder,walnut,enchilada sauce
title: Vegetarian Barley Mushroom Barley Enchiladas
ingredients: 2 cups chopped onions | 2 cans condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 cup uncooked pearl barley | 1 teaspoon onion powder | 2 tablespoons lemon rind, grated | 1 cup enchilada sauce | 1/4 cup chopped walnuts
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees fahrenheit. In a medium stock pot saute onion in olive oil until translucent, about 5 minutes, then add soup, barley, onion rice powder, and lemon rind and stir together. Remove from heat. Spread about 1/2 cup of enchilada sauce in a 9 x 13 inch baking dish. Divide the barley mixture evenly among the tortillas and roll up and place seam side down in the baking dish and repeat. Pour remaining enchilada sauce over the rolled tortillas and sprinkle with nuts. Bake for 30 minutes, then cover and bake another 30 minutes, or until heated through. The sauce can be served warm or chilled and re heated for serving.

title: Raspberry Pie
ingredients: 15 ounces frozen unsweetened raspberries | 16 ounces cream cheese, softened | 30 sheets frozen phyllo dough, thawed | peel, if desired
instructions: Defrost the frozen raspberries in the microwave and press out the liquid. Put the cream cheese in a mixing bowl and whip with electric mixer till smooth. Add raspberries, raspberries and lemon peel, if desired. Take a sheet of phyllo dough and trim to fit the bottom of a standard size pie pan. Place 1 1/2 tablespoons of the filing in the bottom of the pan. Spoon 1 1/2 tablespoons of the cream cheese mixture over the filling. Continue layering like this till all of the filling is used, excepting phyllo and phyllo with the cream cheese mixture. Unroll phyllo dough and place on top of the pie filling. Sprinkle with coarse salt. Pierce with a fork and bake at 375 for 30 mins.

title: Lettuce Rollups
ingredients: 1/2 cup butter | 6 medium lettuce leaves | 2 tablespoons cornstarch
instructions: Roll lettuce leaves individually, cut each roll into 6 slices, with the long ends hanging over the sides. Heat butter and cornstarch in a 12 inch skillet over medium high heat, until sauce boils and thickens, about 3 minutes. Lay lettuce slices in prepared skillet. Add butter and thickening mixture. Cook and stir until heated through, about 3 minutes.

title: Cardamom-Shrimp-Chicken Kebab
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless skinless chicken breast halves, cut in 1-inch cubes | 1 1/2 lbs medium raw shrimp, shelled ( tails removed ) | 6 teaspoons cardamom seeds | 1 cup toasted slivered almonds or 1 cup pistachios
instructions: Marinate the chicken and shrimp in all of the marinade for 15 minutes or so. Thread and thread each piece on a skewer. Barbecue the kebabs over medium high heat until done, about 3 - 5 minutes per side. When done, remove and set aside on a serving platter. Place the pistachios or slivered nuts on individual plates or in a food processor and pulse or pulse until finely chopped. Use to dip kebabs into as much of the reserved marinade as desired.

title: The Best Lemon Scented soymilk and Sauce
ingredients: 2 cups fat-free soymilk | 1 teaspoon dried onion flakes | 1/2 teaspoon fresh lemon juice
instructions: Pour all ingredients into a blender and blend until smooth, about 25 seconds or just a few minutes long enough to get any of those ingredients blended into the soy milk mix until creamy again. Keep in refrigerator.

title: Pasta With Cucumber and Orange Peel
ingredients: 3 cups loosely-packed sliced cucumbers | 1/2 teaspoon grated orange peel | 1 package farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta
instructions: Place cuke in a microwave safe bowl. Add orange peel.

title: Spicy Red Curry Paste
ingredients: 14 -16 ounces thai red curry paste | 2 tablespoons olive oil
instructions: Warm oil in a saucepan. Add curry paste and saute until fragrant about 1 minute. Add red curry paste once blended and cook over low heat stirring constantly for 3 - 4 mintues. Remove from heat and store refrigerated.

Random Ingredients: natural yoghurt,phyllo pastry,brandy,kosher salt black pepper,superfine sugar,chicken part
title: Chicken & Yoghurt Pie
ingredients: 4 medium free range chicken parts, skin scored | kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper, to taste | 400 g natural yoghurt | 3 tablespoons superfine sugar | 85 g brandy | 8 sheets phyllo pastry
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200c / 240f / gas mark arrange the chicken parts skin side up. Sprinkle the chicken with salt and pepper, then place the chicken in a roasting tin that is of the same size. Combine the yoghurt, sugar, brandy and 2 teaspoons of water in a medium saucepan over a medium heat and heat until the sugar has dissolved. Transfer to a pie dish. Cut out 40 sheets of filo and brush generously with oil. Working from one end, gently roll in some of the remaining oil to cover halfway of each piece. Lay them on top of the yoghurt mixture. Using the back of a spoon, gently push the yoghurt mixture down to the side of the dish. The yoghurt mixture will form a thick crust on top. Spread 3 tablespoons of the yoghurt mixture over the yoghurt layer. Repeat with the remaining 10 sheets of filo, keeping the yoghurt mixture between the layers until all have been used. Place a baking sheet on top of the pie and preheat oven to 200c /445f / gas mark 5, or until the pastry has been turned a nice golden brown.. Cook the chicken on a hot grill for 10 minutes, then turn over, pour over the last of the yoghurt mixture and continue cooking for another 10 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and the juices run clear in the chicken juices. Transfer to a serving platter and serve.

Random Ingredients: fennel bulb,rum extract,maple syrup,lime wedge,sharp cheddar cheese,zucchini,grain white rice
title: Fennel-Zucchini-Rice Casserole
ingredients: 3 medium zucchini, cut crosswise in 1/2-inch thick slices | 1 fennel bulb, trimmed and fronds reserved, fronds reserved | 3/4 cup pure maple syrup | 2 tablespoons rum flavored extract | 1 1/4 cups cooked long-grain white rice | grated sharp cheddar cheese | lime wedge ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Using vegetable peeler, peel long, thin strips from the zucchini.

title: Prosciutto and Chia Seed Mussels and Salted Caramelized Mussels
ingredients: 10 large mussels or 10 large manila clams, scrubbed | 6 slices prosciutto ham | 1 tablespoon chia seeds, lightly toasted | 1/2 teaspoon freshly grated nutmeg | 1 -2 teaspoon sifted chia seeds
instructions: Put 2 cups water in a large saucepan, add clams and cook over medium high heat with lid slightly ajar, for 3 - 4 minutes or until the water just starts to steam. Stir clams with a slotted spoon into the pan of steaming water. Keep the pan with water on low heat and keep the covered so as not to steam any additional clams. Stir chia seeds in and cook just until lightly colored, about 1 minute. Remove clams with a slotted spoon and place in a serving bowl.

title: Authentic Mexican Spaghetti
ingredients: 1 pound boneless beef stew meat, cubed | 2 cans diced poblano chiles, drained | 2 cans diced jalapenos, drained | 1 container sour bread | 2 jars spaghetti, sauce | 4 cups water
instructions: Place the cubed beef into a large pot and pour in enough water to cover. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat to medium low, cover, and simmer for 30 minutes. Drain the water from the meat and stir the meat into the pot. Add the poblano, jalapenos, and soup canning jars. Set aside to soak while you prepare the noodles. Soak the bread in a bowl of warm water for 20 minutes. In a separate bowl, crumble the soaked bread, and mix with sour cream.

title: Mexican Spices - a Traditional Flavorful Gift.
ingredients: 1 -2 cup whole coriander ( i used about 6 c. fresh coriander and a little mint, which i had ) | 1 jalapeno | 2 star anise
instructions: Wash the coriander well, dry with paper towels, place in a mortar & crush with a pestle. You can now use the mortar & pestle to add the whole spices, although it's not necessary because of the coriander. Place the spices in a jar with a tight lid and push the lids inches. Add 2 to 4 c water and heat up. Leave the spices to infuse for at least 24 hours. You can use it immediately, after a couple days the oil will change from green to white.

title: Chile Cream Sauce
ingredients: 2 cups heavy whipping cream | 2 cups chopped seeded medium tomatoes | 1 can chipotle chiles, finely chopped with seeds | 3 tablespoons sherry wine
instructions: Combine cream and tomatoes in a medium saucepan. Heat to a boil over high heat. Reduce the heat to low and hold, stirring occasionally, until the sauce thickens, about 10 minutes. Remove from the heat, transfer the mixture to blender and puree until smooth. Return it to the saucepan uncovered and cook over medium low heat until thickened, about 20 minutes. Stir in the chiles and add the sherry. Cool the cream mixture.

Random Ingredients: brown lentil,black pepper,cooking oil,pork chop,soya sauce,cake flour
title: Tibetan Kebabs
ingredients: 2 cups brown lentils | 3 tablespoons soya sauce | 1 tablespoon cooking oil | 1/4 teaspoon black pepper | 2 tablespoons cake flour | 8 pork chops
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c rinse lentils in cold water and drain well. Combine soya sauce, oil, black pepper and cake flour together and stir well. Pat into tray lined with greaseproof paper and place on preheat tray. Cut each pork slice into 3 pieces to make 2 kebabs. Barbecue kebabs for 2 minutes each side. Allow to stand 3 minutes then serve with dipping sauce and sticky rice.

Random Ingredients: canadian bacon,orange,key lime juice,peanut oil,hard egg,olive oil
title: Canadian Bacon Salad With Key Lime
ingredients: 1 teaspoon peanut oil | 2 tablespoons olive oil | 1 slice canadian bacon, cut into 1-inch pieces | 2 tablespoons orange rind, finely grated | 2 tablespoons key limes or 2 tablespoons key limes, juice of | 3 hard-boiled eggs, sliced thick | 3 tablespoons peanut oil | 1 small orange, thinly sliced
instructions: Combine oil, canadian bacon, orange rind, lime juice and eggs and place in a salad bowl. Stir fry bacon and egg, adding sugar, cooking, salt, and pepper. Arrange bacon and egg on lettuce leaves, garnish with slices of hard boiled egg, and serve.

title: Spicy Sweet Potato Salad (Vegetarian-Yum-Yum)
ingredients: 1 kg sweet potato, peeled | 1 large onion, chopped | 2 -4 cm ginger, finely chopped | 1/2 red chile, deseeded and finely diced | 1/2 - 3/4 cup shoyu | 3 -4 slices canned tomatoes | salt
instructions: Peel sweet potato. Cut into 1cm cubes. Boil in salted water for 10 minutes, then drain immediately on absorbent paper. Meanwhile, fry onion and ginger in 1/2 cup shoyu for a few minutes. Put sweet potato in a large bowl and stir in 2/3 cup shoyu, the tomato, chilli, and chopped onions. Taste and season with salt. Add the reserved shoyu and stir till heated through. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: white wine vinegar,english cucumber,pea,rhubarb,corn,bamboo shoot,pork fillet
title: Rhubarb Pork Stew with Peas
ingredients: 600 g lean pork fillets, diced | 1 cup frozen peas | 200 g peas, thawed | 600 g young rhubarb, sliced | 1 english cucumber, coarsely diced | 1 liter white wine vinegar | 4 slices bamboo shoots, rinsed & halved
instructions: Add pork to crock Pot, and add remaining ingredients except bamboo shoots. Serve over wok, rice or salad.

title: Red Chili Penne
ingredients: 1 can of chopped red chili | 1 small bacon | 1 package penne or ( 16 ounce ) package rotini pasta | 1 large carrot, diced | 1 can frozen mini corn kernels | 1/2 cup alfredo sauce
instructions: In a large sauce pan saute bacon until crisp remove bacon drain drippings. Place in a casserole dish top with diced carrots, chili, pasta and corn. Pour alfredo sauce over penne mix all ingredients together bake in 350 degree oven 40 - 45 minutes or until pasta is done enjoy.

title: Pork-Fontina-Caciole
ingredients: 2 lbs pork shoulder, coarsely chopped | 2 tablespoons peanut oil | 1/2 lb fontina cheese ( or other favorite fontina cheese )
instructions: Heat oil in cast iron skillet on medium heat. Add meat, and allow to lightly brown. After browning, add cheese. Continue to brown cheese, stirring frequently until cheese is melted and bubbly..

title: Roasted Orange Pepper Chips
ingredients: 1 red bell pepper, stemmed, seeded | 2 tablespoons caraway seeds or 2 tablespoons dried chipotle peppers
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees. Halve the bell pepper lengthwise. With a thin slice, cut a 3 1/2 inch slit down the seeds all around, and remove the stem and seeds in the middle of the pepper. Insert a thin slice of pepper in the hole of the pepper. Repeat for all the peppers. Spread the caraway seeds on a cookie sheet with the tip of a large oven knife. Drizzle the oil over the peppers to coat evenly. Sprinkle over the chips and move the pan. Roast the peppers for 7 to 10 minutes, until the pepper is roasted and the outside of the pepper is lightly browned. Let stand 5 minutes. Remove from the oven and immediately place the peppers on a paper towel lined plate to drain off the excess oil. Cool and store in an airtight container at room temperature for up to 2 weeks.

title: Simple Calamari
ingredients: 24 calamari | herb and cheese marmite
instructions: Pit the calamari, and slice the body lengthways into thin 2cm slices. Sprinkle with herbs and marmite. Roll up in plastic wrap and put into a shallow tin.

title: Aloo Chuka (Potato and Onion Dish)
ingredients: 2 lbs potatoes | 1 large spanish onion ( or a mix of both ) | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala | seasoning
instructions: Peel potatoes and cut into medium squares. Cut into quarters. Place in a well buttered pan with onions sprinkle with garam masala. Cover with salt/pepper. Place under a fairly low oven until potatoes are about done. When done place into a bowl and mix together. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: spelt,gouda cheese,heavy cream,nutmeg,chile adobo sauce,white vinegar
title: Spelt Cheese Pudding
ingredients: 1/4 lb spelt | 1/2 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 3 tablespoons white vinegar | 3 tablespoons white vinegar ( optional ) | 1 cup heavy cream | 1 tablespoon chile in adobo sauce | 1 ounce gouda cheese, shredded
instructions: Boil spelt for just a few minutes. Drain and cool. Place in a bowl and squeeze out as much moisture as possible. Add nutmeg, vinegar and cream and mix gently to blend. You can also add any type of cheese you like, depending on what you like. Pour into a greased 5 cup mould. Sprinkle each layer with chile adobo sauce and add gouda cheese to melt over top. If using a regular mould, cover the top with aluminium foil and bake, stirring regularly, for 50 minutes. When the 50 minutes are up, remove from the oven and leave in a warm place for 15 - 20 minutes until firm.

title: Panch Phoron Bengali (Green Chilies in Gravy)
ingredients: 1 teaspoon cumin seed | 2 large green chilies, slit vertically into halves
instructions: Heat a small amount oil in a saucepan over medium heat. Add cumin seeds and allow to crackle, about 45 seconds. Stir in whole green chilies. Stir fry for 30 seconds, then lower heat to medium. Cover and cook for 2 to 3 minutes, stirring constantly, or until the chilies turn dark red in color. Remove from heat and serve warm.

Random Ingredients: quinoa,new potato,fontina cheese,chicken breast half,italian sausage
title: Italian Sausage-Stuffed Chicken Breasts and Potatoes
ingredients: 6 cooked chicken breast halves, cut into serving size pieces | 1/2 cup fontina cheese, shredded | 1/2 cup quinoa, cooked according to package directions | 1/2 cup italian sausage, crumbled | 8 -10 small new potatoes, washed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400f degrees. In med bowl combine cheese, quinoa, sausage and cooked chicken and place on a greased cookie sheet. Cover with sausage/cheese mixture and bake for 20 - 25 minutes or until chicken is cooked through. Meanwhile, cut the potatoes into wedges, set them aside. When chicken is done, slice off top half of each piece and place on a cutting board. Cut top halves into 1/4 inch slices then scoop out inside of the chicken and reserve. Replace top half of each potato and place in a small baking dish. Sprinkle with remaining cheese and bake for 1 more minute or until cheese is melted.

Random Ingredients: barbecue sauce,pork sausage,green tea,maraschino cherry,halibut fillet,tomato juice
title: Beer Stuffed Fish
ingredients: 12 halibut fillets | 2 tablespoons green tea | 1 can beer-flavored barbecue sauce | 1 teaspoon prepared maraschino cherry, cut into halves | 1 can diced tomatoes with juice | 1 pound pork sausage slices
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line a rimmed baking sheet with aluminum foil. Prepare an aluminum foil baking pan by layering fillets in baking pan and brushing with green tea mixed with bbq sauce. Season with maraschino cherry halves, diced tomatoes with juice, and pork sausage links. Bake stuffed fish in preheated oven until fish flakes easily with a fork, about 15 minutes.

title: Crispy Banana Chips
ingredients: 4 firm bananas | mustard seeds
instructions: Slice the bananas in half diagonally and remove the seeds. Mix with mustard seeds. Place in a bag and seal. To crisp, melt on a baking tray lined with non stick cooking spray. Remove when they start to pop and crisp slightly.

Random Ingredients: baking potato,tomato green chile,tamarind pulp,italian bread,mustard powder,black olive,chicken thigh
title: Bread Dipping Fish
ingredients: 1 lb baking potato | 1 cup chopped canned tomato and green chiles | 1/2 cup italian style bread, cut into cubes | 1 cup canned black olives, sliced | 3 tablespoons pickled mustard powder | 1 1/2 lbs boneless skinless chicken thighs | 1 tablespoon tamarind pulp, mixed with | 1 tablespoon water
instructions: In a large bowl, combine potatoes, tomatoes, chilies, bread, olives, mustard and tamarind mixture. Toss to blend and coat. Add chicken and toss to coat. Let stand 1 hour or longer, turning occasionally to marinate. Preheat broiler. Discard marinade.

title: Tilapia Spaghetti
ingredients: 4 -6 links dried spaghetti | 1 package pepperoni, sliced | 3 cans mushrooms, drained
instructions: Preheat oven to cook spaghetti. Spread a layer of pepperoni on an unheated cookie sheet. Put one can of mushrooms on each slice of pepperoni. Repeat with another layer of pepperoni and mushrooms. Bake for 20 minutes. This makes enough for two 9x13 inch loaf.

title: Macaroni and Cheese With Tomatoes and Peppers
ingredients: 1 lb macaroni ( medium ) | 1 large bell pepper ( red, if any ) | 1 can tomatoes with oil ( chopped )
instructions: Cook macaroni following directions on the packet. Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in skillet. Add 1/2 cup water, bell pepper and tomatoes and simmer for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally. Add cooked macaroni and heat through do not boil.

title: Pear and Jicama Sandwiches
ingredients: 3 pounds ripe pears - peeled, cored and diced | 1 large eggplant, peeled and diced | 8 squares graham cracker crumbs | 3 cups shredded jicama
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees f. In a medium bowl, mix together the pears, eggplant, graham cracker crumbs and jicama. Spread the mixture into the bottom half of a toasted sandwich or large piece of aluminum foil. Carefully fold the sides and ends tightly over the filling and secure with a toothpick. Place the sandwich on a large baking sheet. Bake for 45 minutes in the preheated oven, until golden brown.

title: Jalapeno Peanut Butter
ingredients: 1 cup peanut butter | 1 -2 tablespoon tabasco jalapeno sauce
instructions: Blend all ingredients. Serve hot or cold.

title: Frijoles Negros (Pinto Beans)
ingredients: 1 lb dry pinto beans | 1 green pepper, deseeded and sliced | 3 tablespoons vinegar | 1/2 lb cottage cheese ( may use sour cream or yogurt )
instructions: Soak beans overnight. Simmer until tender, approximately 1 - 1 1/2 hours. Drain and reserve liquid. Place beans in a small but heavy saucepan and add enough reserved liquid to cover the beans. Bring to boil on high with heat, cover, and cook over low heat for approximately 1 1/2 hours. Add pepper and continue to cook for 10 minutes to crisp the pepper. Drain and place in serving dish and set aside. Add 1 tbsp vinegar and the cottage cheese to the beans and heat gently. Spread the remaining 1 tbsp vinegar over the top and serve. Note, if the beans break the shape a little more while cooking. This will make them more rigid.

Random Ingredients: apple,taco sauce,cumin seed,maraschino cherry,pineapple tidbit,chili paste garlic,nori
title: Quick Tuna Salad
ingredients: 1 can pineapple tidbits | 1 teaspoon cumin seed | 1 teaspoon dry maraschino cherry, crushed | 1 slice apple | 1/4 cup taco sauce | 2 tablespoons chili paste with garlic | 6 sheets nori, cut into thin strips ( dry seaweed )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. In a medium bowl, combine the pineapple chunks, cumin seeds, and cherries. Spread the mixture all over the top of the pineapple chunks, and sprinkle with taco sauce. Place a slice of apple on the pineapple, and wrap it up with nori strips. Repeat with the remaining tuna, cherry mixture, and tomato slices. Slice each wrap into strips, and place onto baking sheets. Bake for 5 minutes in the preheated oven, until the nori is lightly browned.

Random Ingredients: confectioner sugar,ginger ale,lobster meat,rice,chocolate syrup,mozzarella cheese,peanut
title: Lobster and Rice Sandwich
ingredients: 1 package smoked fish sticks ( sliced in half width wise ) | 1 package grilled lobster meat | 2 cups cooked rice | 1/2 cup confectioners'sugar | 1 tablespoon peanut, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon chocolate syrup | 2 slices mozzarella cheese
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees f. Line baking sheet with plastic wrap. Arrange sliced fish sticks in baking sheet. Place on prepared baking sheet. Bake in preheated oven until fish sticks start to brown, about 15 minutes. Flip fish sticks and bake until crisp and lightly browned, about 5 minutes longer. Slice hot fish sticks into rings. Spread confectioner's sugar atop toast. Sprinkle hot seafood sticks over seafood and cream.

title: Tahini Parsley Cheese Spread
ingredients: 2 tablespoons tahini | 1 tablespoon grated pecorino romano cheese
instructions: Combine all the ingredients and serve over crackers or bread.

title: Angel Food Spumoni
ingredients: 2 cans anchovy paste | 7 ounces angel food cake | 1 can angel food cake | 8 ounces brandy
instructions: Drain anchovy paste off of can of anchovy paste can. Cut angel food cake into 2 inch squares. Heat angel food cake over medium heat to about 3/4 of an inch up. Pour 1/4 cup of anchovy paste into cake pan. Spread angel food cake over anchovy paste. Place angel food cake on plate and pour 1/4 cup of brandy over angel food cake. Drizzle angel food cake with remaining brandy. Serve at once.

title: Mushroom Soup
ingredients: 4 cups mushrooms, sliced | 6 cups ice water | 2 tablespoons saffron threads, crushed | 1 tablespoon fresh basil leaf, chopped | 1/4 teaspoon pepper | 1/2 cup buttermilk
instructions: Bring mushrooms, 2 cups ice water, saffron, basil and pepper to a boil. Lower heat and simmer 10 minutes. Stir in buttermilk and warm through for 5 minutes.

title: Paprika Chicken II
ingredients: 2 pounds boneless, skinless chicken pieces | 1/4 cup golden syrup | 1 1/4 cups paprika | 2 tablespoons maple syrup | 1 jar sliced apples | 2 bell peppers, chopped | 1 1/2 cups graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Preheat an oven to 350 degrees f. Place the chicken in a 9x13 inch baking dish, and sprinkle with golden syrup, paprika, and maple syrup. Cover, and set aside. To prepare the apples, place the apples cut side down onto the baking dish. Sprinkle with pepper and salt, and evenly pile some of the apple mixture on top. Bake in the preheated oven until the chicken is no longer pink in the center, and beginning to show browned marks, about 45 minutes. Serve over boiled potatoes.

Random Ingredients: lemon,taco seasoning,mango chutney,achiote paste,cream mushroom soup,cremini mushroom,baby clam,ricotta cheese
title: Agua De Lima (Mushroom Soup W-Lemon Dip)
ingredients: 2 lbs cremini mushrooms, cleaned, stems removed, sliced thinly | 1 1/2 cups baby clams, washed, shelled and reserve juice | 2 cans condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 packet taco seasoning | 4 ounces achiote paste, i use mccormick's | 1/2 ounce achiote sauce ( i used contadina's ) | 1 lemon, juice of | 1 small mango chutney
instructions: Saute mushrooms in a little oil over medium heat for about 5 minutes, being careful not to brown. Drain on paper towel. Remove all of the liquid from the mushroom liquid and set aside. In a large bowl or food processor combine the reserved mushroom liquid and cream of mushroom soup, the taco seasoning and achiote paste and blend well. Add the mushroom liquid to the soup mixture and stir to combine. Add the reserved clam juice and the reserved baby clam shells. Let stand until the flavors are blended. Transfer mixture to a large soup crockpot. Add mango chutney and stir to combine. Let sit about 5 minutes to blend flavors, stir to combine then serve. Sauce can be served on the side, as an accompaniment for cooked or fried plantains or other small cakes.

title: Pasta With Cherry Bombs
ingredients: 20 pasta shells | 1 1/2 tablespoons cajun seasoning | 1/4 cup catsup | 1/4 cup olive oil | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne | 200 g glace cherries, drained
instructions: Boil water in a large pan. Add pasta shells. Cook until tender, approximately 5 minutes. Drain and refresh with cold water. Place in a large bowl. Add cayenne, worcestershire sauce and catsup. Toss to coat well.

title: Greek Style Hot Dish
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon bark, divided | 1/2 cup dry marsala wine, divided | 1 can kidney beans, undrained | 1/3 cup dried apricot nectar | 8 ounces couscous, uncooked | fresh parsley, chopped | of fresh mint ( optional )
instructions: Place cinnamon bark and 1/2 cup marsala wine in small saucepan.

title: Mexican Tomato and Molasses Spread
ingredients: 16 large ripe tomatoes, halved and seeded | 2 tablespoons molasses | 1/4 cup confectioners'sugar, sifted | 1/4 package shredded monterey jack cheese, divided
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Wash, core and slice tomatoes. Place each tomato cut side down onto ungreased foil, and bake for 10 minutes, then turn over, and bake an additional 10 minutes. Remove from oven, and cool tomatoes completely. Place ripe tomatoes into a mixing bowl, and add molasses, and 1 tablespoon of confectioners' sugar. Mix thoroughly, then stir in 1/4 package of monterey jack cheese. Place tomato mixture onto the prepared cheese cloth, and allow to set at room temperature. Spread remaining 1/4 package of cheese over the top of the tomato mixture, and press down slightly. Serve at room temperature.

title: Pesto
ingredients: 2 cups fresh pine nuts ( or walnuts or pecans ) | 2/3 cup packed light-grain cinnamon
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. In a bowl, combine the pine nuts, cinnamon, and 1/3 cup dry bread crumbs. Mix well. Drop the pesto into the baking dish, 2 tablespoons at a time, making sure that all the nuts are submerged. Pour the remaining 1/2 cup of dry bread crumbs over the pesto. Sprinkle additional 1/3 cup of dry bread crumbs to coat. Bake in the preheated oven until bread crumbs are lightly browned and pesto is bubbling, about 30 minutes.

title: Mint Salad With Mint
ingredients: 1/4 cup caster sugar | 3 tablespoons chopped of fresh mint
instructions: Place sugar and mint in a bowl. Stir gently to coat with sugar. Let sit until syrup is syrupy, about 10 minutes. Pour onto salad and serve either cold or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: pesto sauce,apricot,vegetable oil cooking spray,cardamom seed,tomato puree,beefsteak tomato,rack lamb
title: Tatties with Tomato Crumble
ingredients: 2 beefsteak tomatoes, thinly sliced | 2 racks of lamb ( about 2lb each ) | vegetable oil cooking spray | 2 tablespoons pesto sauce | 2 teaspoons tomato puree | 1 teaspoon cardamom seeds or 1 teaspoon sun-dried tomato paste | 400 g ready to serve stewed tomatoes, drained if canned
instructions: Preheat oven to 150°c, 200°c fan forced. Wrap a rack of lamb in greaseproof paper, use paper to secure paper tight. Place tomatoes on tray, spray with pan mist and roast for 20 min. Stir once, remove and keep warm. Baste with oil and then return lamb to oven for 25 min, brush with pesto and roast a further 10 minutes. To serve place tomatoes onto plate, top with crumble, drizzle with tomato puree.

Random Ingredients: black peppercorn,plain flour,white sesame seed,mango chutney,chicken stock cube,oregano leaf,brown rice
title: Lily Kwok's Mango Rice
ingredients: 350 g brown rice | 1 cup chicken stock cube, dissolved in | 4 cups hot water | 4 tablespoons white sesame seeds | 2 tablespoons black peppercorns | 1 tablespoon dried oregano leaves | 115 g mango chutney
instructions: Put the stock into a large pan, add the rice, bring to the boil then reduce to a simmer and cook for 30 to 40 mins until all the water has been absorbed and the rice is tender and fluffy. Stir in half the sesame seeds and black peppercorns and cover for ten minutes and then stir in one cup of hot water to steam if necessary. When the rice is tender, stir the contents of the pan into the rice and add the oregano and chutney.

title: Homemade Beef Broth
ingredients: 1/4 cup golden syrup | 1 beef marrow, trimmed
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Combine the golden syrup and the marrow bones in a roasting pan.

title: Jicama and Shredded Beef on Skewers
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs sirloin or 1 1/4 lbs sirloin tips | 1 jar roasted jicama, drained and cubed | 3 slices lemons
instructions: Cut beef into 1 wide strips. Thread beef onto skewers.

Random Ingredients: pork shoulder,coconut,walnut oil,sherry wine vinegar,cannellini bean,cornstarch
title: Coconut Pork and Beans
ingredients: 1 can cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 1/4 cup chopped walnuts oil | 1 1/2 tablespoons sherry wine vinegar | 1 1/2 tablespoons cornstarch | 2 lbs boneless pork shoulder, trimmed of fat | 3 cups sweetened flaked coconut, toasted
instructions: In a lrg skillet, combine undrained cannelloni beans, walnuts oil, vinegar & cornstarch. Cook & stir about 1 minute or until sauce is thick & syrupy. Meanwhile, cut pork into 1/2 inch cubes. In seperate skillet, cook pork with coconut over med heat until just seared on outside & browned on surface. Stir pork into the sauce, & simmer 4 - 5 minutes, or till pork is cooked through. Serve immediately.

title: Asparagus Salad III
ingredients: 1 pound fresh asparagus, rinsed and trimmed | 1 apple - peeled, cored and chopped | 1 large loaf of ciabatta, cut into cubes | 1/2 white onion, chopped | 1 can sliced bamboo shoots, drained | 1/2 cup raisins | 1/2 cup chopped apple,
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Drain asparagus, and place in the boiling water, and cook until tender, 5 to 10 minutes. Slice each piece in half, and scoop out and discard any tough spears. Mix together in a large salad bowl with chopped apple, raisins, and chopped asparagus. Toss with dressing, and serve.

Random Ingredients: taco seasoning mix,ham,hot pepper,golden raisin,button mushroom
title: Hot Mexican Mushrooms
ingredients: 8 -10 button mushrooms, sliced | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 1 tablespoon chopped hot pepper | 2 tablespoons golden raisins | hot cooked rice
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl and mix well. Place in a greased casserole dish or crockpot. Cover and cover. Cook on high for 1 hour. Turn heat to high. Cook for 30 more minutes. Serve over hot, cooked hot rice.

Random Ingredients: cooking spray,wasabi paste,flour tortilla,manchego cheese,active yeast
title: Cheese and Wasabi Fajitas
ingredients: cooking spray | 1 package active dry yeast | 12 large flour tortillas | 2 cups grated manchego cheese | wasabi paste, to taste
instructions: Heat oil over medium heat in a large heavy bottomed saucepan. Remove from heat. Stir in yeast. Let yeast mixture stand until luke warm. Stir in just enough water to make a soft dough. On a floured surface, knead dough until smooth and elastic, about 5 minutes. Cover and let rise in a warm place until doubled about 1 hour. Mix cheese with wasabi paste and brush tortillas with sauce. Bake at 400 degrees fahrenheit until well browned on each side.

title: Nuts With a Twist
ingredients: 3/4 cup chicken stock or 3/4 cup water | 1/3 cup nuts, chopped
instructions: Boil stock for 5 minutes. In another saucepan, add 3/4 cup water and nuts. Cook over medium heat until nuts begin to soften. Turn off heat and add remaining water. Pour boiling soup into bowls and serve.

title: Rio Bravasi (Homemade Rotel W- Tomatoes)
ingredients: 6 -8 medium green tomatoes | 2 cans rotel tomatoes | 1 tablespoon whole allspice berry
instructions: Boil tomatoes until soft. Drain and place in large bowl. Add allspice seeds and whole spices to tomatoes and mix. Chill for at least 3 hours. Serve over your favorite grain, pasta, or couscous.

title: Grilled Tahini and Kielbasa
ingredients: 2 tablespoons tahini | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard | 1 tablespoon minced fresh ginger | 8 ounces kielbasa | 1 large green olives, pitted | 4 -5 cups cooked rice | 1 tablespoon dried sage | 1/2 cup pimento-stuffed green olives
instructions: Prepare grill or broiler and/or preheat broiler. Stir tahini, mustard and the ginger in a shallow dish. Slice kielbasa into 1/4 inch pieces and arrange 1/2 of the slices on grill or in a small casserole. Layer with 1/2 the sliced kielbasa and 1/2 the chopped green olives. Stir well to coat. Sprinkle with dried sage. Grill or broil kielbasa 2 minutes minutes on each side, or until just cooked through. Serve warm. To serve, place the keielbasa on a serving platter and top with the remaining sliced green olives and the pimento stuffed olives. Serve warm.

title: Guacamole Rice with Marinated Vegetables
ingredients: 1 medium zucchini, halved lengthwise and sliced | 2 medium parsnips, halved lengthwise and sliced | 1 medium guacamole | 6 tablespoons rice wine vinegar | 6 tablespoons rice wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons chicken bouillon | 1 cup grated cheddar cheese | 3 tablespoons sliced almonds
instructions: Spray a large saute pan with cooking spray. In a very large bowl, combine zucchini, parsnips, guacamole, 6 tbls. Rice wine vinegar, 5 tbls. Rice wine vinegar, and 1 1/2 tbls. Chicken bouillon. Stir to blend. Gently stir in 1 cup grated cheddar cheese. Transfer to a platter and sprinkle with almonds. Serve warm or chilled. Variation, substitute sliced celery for parsnips.

title: Chocolate Chips
ingredients: 50 g roasted salted peanuts, chopped | 250 g dark chocolate | 3 tablespoons ground allspice | 1 tablespoon fresh marjoram | 3 tablespoons peanut oil
instructions: Boil the chocolate chips in the water and the oil until melted. While the chocolate is cooking, take the peanuts out of the heat. Crush the peanuts with your hands. Mix them with the chocolate in a bowl. Add the allspice and marjoram. Mix well. Take the chip mixture onto paper lined baking sheets. Leave some space between the chips which will allow them to spread during the cooking process. Put into the fridge and leave in a cool dry place for 10 minutes. The longer it sets the better. Take them out and place on plates. Sprinkle with more marjoram and serve with milk.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon,black eyed pea,tomato soup,yellow tomato,halibut fillet,basil leaf,brown sugar,vinegar
title: Halibut Picnic Soup
ingredients: 1 lb halibut fillet | 1 can condensed tomato soup | 1/3 cup vinegar | 1/3 cup firmly packed brown sugar | 2 teaspoons dried basil leaves | 2 teaspoons instant beef bouillon | 1 can yellow tomatoes, cut up, undrained ( hunts ) | 1 can black-eyed peas, rinsed and drained
instructions: Spray crock pot with cooking spray. Rinse tomato soup and add to crock pot, stirring until tomato soup is well incorporated into soup. Sprinkle with basil, brown sugar and bouillon powder. Add undrained tomatoes, and peas. Stir. Cover and cook on low heat setting for 20 minutes. Stir once or twice.

title: Chickpea Flour Tortillas
ingredients: 1/2 cup chickpea flour, sifted | 1/4 cup chappea flour | 1 anaheim chili, seeded and roughly chopped | 1 cup white flour
instructions: Mix the chickpea flours, chili and white flour in a bowl. Heat a cast iron frying pan or griddle over medium heat. Using a teaspoon, form 8 evenly sized chunks of the mixture and flatten to form a disc about 5'' wide. Cook each tortilla, in batches, for about 1 1/2 minutes on each side, until golden brown and cooked through. Serve with sour cream, salsa and tomato if desired.

Random Ingredients: red cabbage,lettuce,basil,portobello mushroom,serrano pepper,chicken stock,rice wine,chorizo sausage
title: Portobello Mushroom Soup With Chorizo and Lettuce
ingredients: 16 serrano peppers, coarsely chopped | 5 cups chicken stock | 1 1/2 lbs portobello mushrooms, caps thickly sliced ( about 16 large ) | 1 cup red cabbage, coarsely chopped | 1/4 cup rice wine | 12 leaves lettuce | fresh basil, if desired
instructions: In food processor or blender, puree peppers and 1 cup stock. Set puree aside. In heavy pot, heat remaining 1 cup stock and mushroom liquid over medium heat. Cover and cook until mushroom liquid is reduced to 2 cups, about 25 minutes. Discard mushroom liquid. Heat remaining 1/2 cup stock and chorizo mixture in large pot over medium heat until warm, stirring occasionally. Add remaining ingredients, except lettuce and basil. Cook and stir 5 to 10 minutes until mushrooms are just tender.

title: Rotel Salsa
ingredients: 6 cans rotel | 1/2 cup water | 1 package uncooked spaghetti
instructions: Mix together the rotel, water, and spaghetti in a large pot. Cover, and cook on low heat for one hour.

Random Ingredients: garlic herb seasoning,chile pepper,ale,chocolate syrup,rye bread,purpose flour,beef shank,buttermilk
title: Grilled Beer Shank Rye
ingredients: 4 pounds boneless beef shank | 8 tablespoons chile-garlic herb seasoning | 4 tablespoons ale or water, or as needed | 4 tablespoons beer or beer syrup, if desired | 2 cups buttermilk | 1/4 cup all-purpose flour | 1/4 cup beer or beer syrup, if desired | 16 chile pepper slices | 4 ounces unsweetened chocolate syrup | 8 slices rye bread
instructions: Combine herb seasoning and ale in a bowl, and stir until well blended, about 2 minutes. Place the beef shank into the beer mixture, cover, and allow the meat to marinate for 5 hours or overnight if desired. Discard liquid, and discard water. Preheat an outdoor grill for high heat, and lightly oil grates or line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Place the beef shank onto the prepared baking sheet, and sprinkle with the chile garlic herb seasoning. Pour beer over the shank, and cover the barbecue, cooking the shank about 5 minutes per side, until it is medium and shank is tender. Remove beef from the grill, and place on the prepared baking sheet. Pour beer or water into a bowl, and mix in the buttermilk. Cover, and refrigerate for about 20 minutes. Warm oven to 450 degrees f. Stir flour and beer into the beer mixture to thicken. Remove from heat, and spread chocolate syrup on top. Wrap slices of rye bread in cheesecloth, and place on baking sheets. Bake in the preheated oven 10 minutes, or until the melted cheese has melted and begun to brown. Serve hot.

title: Sun-Dried Tomato Dressing
ingredients: 1/2 cup catalina or salad dressing | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried tarragon or 2/3 teaspoons fresh tarragon | 1 teaspoon vanilla
instructions: In small bowl, stir salad dressing, tarragon and vanilla. Chill.

Random Ingredients: mint,green chilies,cilantro leaf,beer,corn kernel,cardamom pod,bailey irish cream
title: Cowboy Black and Green Salsa
ingredients: 10 sprigs fresh mint | 1 ounce fresh cilantro leaves | 12 small frozen corn kernels | 12 whole cardamom pods, split | 1/2 cup light beer | 2 cans diced green chilies, drained | 1 tablespoon baileys irish cream ( optional )
instructions: Place mint sprigs in a small bowl. Cover mint with boiling water in separate bowl. Set aside until leaves are softened, about 5 minutes. Drain mint leaves in colander set over tea towel. Set leaves aside. Place corn kernels in another small bowl. Cover whole cardamom pods with boiling water in tea towel. Allow water to release from pods. Set aside until cardamom pods are soft and easy to grind, about 2 minutes. Set aside. In a tall glass, combine mint, cilantro leaves, frozen corn kernels, beer, green chilies, and irish cream if using. Stir. Sprinkle with mint sprigs.

title: Roasted Chile Shrimp
ingredients: 1/2 pound peeled, deveined shrimp | 2 tablespoons yellow mustard seed, or to taste | ground chile peppers, or to taste, crushed to a coarse textured paste
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Spread the shrimp onto the prepared pan. Place the unpeeled shrimp onto the aluminum foil.

title: Rice Cakes With Rice - Rice Cooker
ingredients: 500 g rice, boiled and cooled | 2 tablespoons plain flour | 1/2 stock, powder | 1/2 cup left over rice from cooking rice
instructions: Add dry rice, flour and 2 cups of boiling stock powder to rice. Blend until it forms dough. Add remainder of hot stock until mixture is sticky consistency is achieved.

title: Fried Chicken - Caldillo
ingredients: 500 g stewing chicken, cut in pieces | 2 -3 fresh red chilies | 1 onion, sliced | 1/4 kg cauliflower or 1/4 kg broccoli, cut into small florets | cooking oil | 50 g mozzarella cheese, grated
instructions: Fry the chicken pieces with chopped fresh chillies and sliced onion in oil until a thick layer is seen on the sides of the pan. Continue stirring in the chillies and onion until the chicken is brown. Add the cauliflower or broccoli and stir. Continue cooking on medium heat until all the liquid has been absorbed. Cover the cover with a lid and leave on heat. Cook on low heat, stirring occasionally, until vegetables are tender and chicken is cooked. Season to taste with salt and pepper and stir in cheeses and serve hot or cold.

title: Kielbasa
ingredients: 1 lb kielbasa or 1 lb other sausage | 1 package tortillas | 2 packages shrimp, uncooked | 2 tablespoons parsley | 1 teaspoon chili pepper | 4 tablespoons cumin | 2 teaspoons seasoning salt
instructions: Brown sausage, drain. Add shrimp and kielbasa and brown. Combine all other ingredients. Spray frypan with pam. Add sausage mixture and simmer for 20 minutes. You may add shrimp, if necessary.

Random Ingredients: pork shoulder,sharp cheddar cheese,mini marshmallow,frying chicken
title: Grilled Chicken and Nests
ingredients: 3 -4 lbs pork shoulder | 4 large nests | 1 pint frying chicken | 12 mini marshmallows
instructions: Trim fat and connective tissue from the pork. Cut pork into 6 to 8 pieces. Prepare grill. Place pork, nests, and chicken breasts on grill. Cover and cook over high heat for 15 minutes. Turn nests and brush with a little water. Continue cooking for another 15 minutes, covering grill surface loosely with foil. Remove from grill. When ready, remove chicken and let stand. Turn and brush with more water. Close lid and let stand about 10 to 15 minutes more until chicken is cooked. Slice into quarters. Prepare fettuccine according to package directions. Garnish with mini marshmallows.

Random Ingredients: cream mushroom soup,shiitake mushroom,kielbasa,salmon fillet,chili powder,quinoa,pecan,potato starch
title: Smoked Salmon and Quinoa Casserole
ingredients: 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1/2 cup finely chopped dried shiitake mushrooms | 1/2 lb smoked kielbasa or 1/2 lb other smoked sausage, diced | 3/4 cup quinoa, cooked | 1 package frozen potatoes starch mixed with 1/2 cup water, mix well | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon chili powder | 1 1/2 cups sour cream | 1 cup chopped fresh pecans
instructions: Mix all ingredients well except for sour cream, pecans and casserole. Layer finished casserole in three bowls as follows. Mix sour cream, sour cream and pecans in a bowl until blended well. Top with sour cream and chopped pecans. Cover and refrigerate on very low heat overnight. The next morning remove cover. Heat oven to 375 degrees. Cook covered for 30 - 45 minutes, then remove cover. Continue cooking for another 15 minutes then remove from stove and let sit 5 minutes before serving.

title: Cottage Cheese Dip.
ingredients: 500 g cottage cheese | 4 spring onions, finely chopped | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together in a food processor or with a wooden spoon. Refrigerate until required.

Random Ingredients: picante sauce,chicken,dark beer,italian sausage,cognac,turmeric,pearl onion,vegetable stock
title: The Easiest Sausage Soup
ingredients: 2 bags frozen pearl onions | 1 can stewed vegetables ( veg-all ) | 1 bottle picante sauce | 1 jar dried hot italian sausages ( kroger brand ) | 1 teaspoon ground turmeric | 1 liter chicken stock | 1 liter dark beer
instructions: Heat the stock, beer and seafood guy up in the food processor till it's boiling. Place the onions and sausages into a large soup pot, mix well. Place the frozen sausages, vegetables and liquid into the pot add the dark beer. Bring to the boil, lower to a simmer and cook for aprox 20 - 25 min till onions are tender, stirring every so often.
