Serve with grated parmesan as a garnish and more hot sauce if desired. To freeze throw the items away, put everything into a zipper bag and freeze. To defrost the soup, place all ingredients into a freezer safe container. Then place this container on top of a double boiler and cook over simmering water over medium heat until sausages are cooked through. Can then be frozen in the refrigerator for up to 1 month.

Random Ingredients: mayonnaise,curry paste,spring onion,filling,chicken breast,chipotle chile,lemon extract,lavender
title: Grilled Chicken Salad
ingredients: 2 chicken breasts | 1 cup mayonnaise | 1 teaspoon lemon extract | 1 tablespoon curry paste ( depending on how hot you want it ) | 1 tablespoon dried lavender ( you can use fresh lavender in 1 tsp ) or 1 tablespoon rosemary ( you can use fresh lavender in 1 tsp ) | 2 tablespoons chopped spring onions | 1 tablespoon of chopped chipotle chile ( fresh in jar in adobo sauce to taste )
instructions: Place all ingredients except mayonnaise in a food processor and process until smooth. Pour dressing over chicken. Marinate in refrigerator and allow to sit at least 1 hour before cooking. Cook chicken in hot grill. You may add other salad ingredients. I use marinated marinated chicken breasts cooked on the grill. Allow to rest for 5 - 10 minutes before slicing. For those who don't like spicy you can leave out the chipotle and use a bit of chilli powder for each salad.

title: Polish Sizzlin (Cretons)
ingredients: 1 cup yellow pepper, coarsely chopped | 1 tablespoon fresh thyme, chopped | 1 1/4 teaspoons fast rising yeast or 3/4 teaspoon fast rising yeast
instructions: Place the yellow pepper, thyme, and salt in a food processor or food stand mixer. Process into a paste about 1/4 inches in diameter. Transfer the paste to a bowl and stir in enough water to reach halfway up the sides of the bowl. Cover and allow to ferment at room temperature until the dough is somewhat translucent and a bit sticky, about 45 to 60 minutes. Transfer the dough to a floured surface and knead until smooth and elastic. Place in an oiled bowl, cover and let rise in a warm place until puffy, about 1 hour.

title: Aarsi’s Ultimate Kimpies
ingredients: 2 pounds frozen pared and chopped galangal | 2 tablespoons ground galangal, or more to taste
instructions: Place the prawns in a large saucepan with enough water to cover, and bring to a boil on top of the stove. Reduce heat to medium low, and simmer until prawns are mostly dried, 16 to 20 minutes.

title: Dried Mushrooms II
ingredients: 2 pounds dried mushrooms | 1 tablespoon celery seed
instructions: Remove stems from mushrooms, reserving 2 sprigs for soaking. Rinse mushrooms, and remove hard stems. Place mushrooms in a container large enough to cover them. Cover with fresh water and marinate in the refrigerator for 6 to 8 hours. Drain mushrooms, reserving soaking liquid. Place mushrooms in a dutch oven or large saucepan filled with enough hot water to cover. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low. Simmer uncovered for at least 10 minutes. Remove from heat and allow mushrooms to sit and rehydrated, 10 to 15 minutes. Remove stems from mushrooms and coarsely chop. Stir together mushroom liquid and celery seed. Return to a simmer until at least 1/2 of liquid has drained away and at least 1/2 of mushrooms' liquid has been yielded. Pour liquid mixture into mushrooms and serve.

title: Tamarind Pepper
ingredients: 1/2 cup red chile | 15 tablespoons cumin powder
instructions: Puree all ingredients. Store in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: fennel bulb,spring onion,pico de gallo,feta cheese,chicken,vegetable broth
title: Easy Feta Soup
ingredients: 5 cups vegetable broth | 1 tablespoon fennel bulb, trimmed, chopped | 1 spring onion, chopped | 1 cup feta cheese | 4 ounces pico de gallo | 1 cup cooked chicken, diced
instructions: In a soup pot, combine broth, fennel, spring onion and cheese. Bring to boil, reduce heat, and simmer for 20 minutes. Stir in pico de gallo and chicken and cook for 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: sesame seed,rotini pasta,bread crumb,greek seasoning,dark rum,red onion
title: Karin's Real Mojito Pasta Salad
ingredients: 8 ounces dry rotini pasta | 1 cup packed dark rum | 1/2 cup chopped red onion | 4 ounces crumbled bread crumbs | 2 tablespoons soy seasoning | 2 teaspoons sesame seeds
instructions: Cook the pasta in a large pot of lightly salted boiling water until dente, rinse in cold water and drain. Combine all the ingredients and stir well. Serve chilled.

title: Sauerkraut Salad
ingredients: 4 tablespoons plain yogurt | 1 small sauerkraut, rinsed and well drained | 2 tablespoons pine nuts, toasted | 1 3/4 teaspoons dried curry powder | 1 dash celery, for topping | 10 mandarin oranges, drained
instructions: In a large bowl, gently mix the yogurt and the sauerkraut. Stir in the pine nuts, curry powder, celery, oranges, and the reserved raice. Chill for at least 2 hours before serving to allow flavors to blend.

title: Quick and Easy Pizza-Cooker Filled Apricot Turnovers
ingredients: 1 can pizza dough | 1/4 cup egg substitute | 1/4 cup apricot preserves | 1 1/2 teaspoons greek oregano
instructions: Place pizza dough on a clean counter and sprinkle the crust with the egg substitute. Mix together the preserves and greek oregano. Brush the egg substitute over the crust. Sprinkle the crust with the oregano mixture. Bake in the oven at 450 degrees f for 10 to 15 minutes until the crust is golden brown.

title: Baked Noodles with Garlic and Beef
ingredients: 1 package egg noodles | 1/4 cup tabasco sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Cook egg noodles in a large pot of boiling water until tender but firm, about 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: hazelnut,brut champagne,water,turmeric powder,fish sauce,egg beater substitute
title: Moroccan Style Egg Nuts
ingredients: 2 cups fresh egg whites ( or 1 1/2 tsp. egg beaters egg substitute ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons turmeric powder | 3/4 cup water, boiling ( or vegetable broth ) | 1 tablespoon fish sauce | 1/4 cup chopped hazelnuts ( or pignolis ) | 2 teaspoons brut champagne ( i used tiparin sipping cured chardones brand, 2 tsp. )
instructions: Preheat oven to 250 degrees. Line a baking sheet with foil. In a large bowl, whisk egg whites at high speed with turmeric until foamy, about 30 seconds. Add boiling water and fish sauce.

title: Pastiera a la Peter's House from Peter Reinhart
ingredients: 5 cups frozen chopped broccoli | 1 teaspoon ground nutmeg, or to taste | 1/2 cup madeira wine or dry sherry | 2 cans sausages, thinly sliced | 1/2 pound ricotta cheese | 1 tablespoon vinegar | 1 cup masa harina | 1 package loose-leaf, leaves italian green leaves, cut in half
instructions: Place the broccoli in a large pot with water.

Random Ingredients: oregano leaf,tamari,chinese cabbage,cauliflower,green cardamom pod,almond paste
title: Asian Cabbage With Cauliflower
ingredients: 1 tablespoon almond paste | 2 cups chinese cabbage, finely shredded | 1/4 cup thinly sliced cauliflower | 1 1/2 tablespoons tamari | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1/2 green cardamom pod
instructions: Heat a non stick skillet over medium high heat. Add almond paste, stir for 1 minute, coating the bottom of the pan. Add cabbage, cauliflower, tamari, oregano and cardamom.

title: English Cipolline Bread
ingredients: 3 cups all-purpose flour | 1 1/2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 1/2 cup golden raisins or 1/2 cup sultana, coarsely chopped | 2 tablespoons fresh italian parsley, coarsely chopped
instructions: In medium bowl, combine 2 cups flour and yeast. Stir in raisins if using. Add 2 tablespoons of remaining flour and enough extra flour to make a batter. Beat vigorously with a spoon to get a smooth batter but not to have it difficult. Beat well for a few seconds. Turn batter into an oiled bowl, turning to coat. Cover and let rise until doubled. Punch down dough and turn onto a floured surface. Gently knead in remaining flour. Place onto a greased baking sheet, cover and let rise until doubled. Bake in a preheated 425 degree f oven for 10 to 15 minutes or until golden. Brush with a teaspoon of melted butter during the last 5 minutes of baking.

Random Ingredients: brown lentil,lemon juice zest,flat leaf italian parsley,fettuccine pasta,garlic salt,mint leaf,red food coloring,vegetable stock
title: Lebanese Fettuccini with Lentils and Herbs
ingredients: 1 cup light brown lentils, rinsed well | 1 cup vegetable stock | 1 cup fresh flat-leaf italian parsley, chopped | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh mint leaves | 1/2 tablespoon lemon juice, plus 1 teaspoon lemon zest | 1 tablespoon fresh lemon juice | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon red food coloring | 12 ounces dry fettuccine pasta or 12 ounces fresh fettuccine shells
instructions: Cook the lentils and stock in a 2 to 3 quart heavy pot over moderate heat, uncovered, stirring occasionally, until they are tender, about 20 minutes. Add the parsley, mint and zest and cook, stirring, 2 to 3 minutes longer. Stir in 2 teaspoon lemon rind and juice and food coloring and set aside. Cook pasta in a large pot of boiling salted water 5 to 6 minutes or till al dente. Drain. Divide pasta among 4 serving bowls and ladle lentil mixture among.

Random Ingredients: sea bass fillet,green bell pepper,white bread,papaya,dark chocolate,ginger,apricot preserve
title: Gingerbread and Sea Bass Wrapped in Warm White Hot Chocolate
ingredients: 1/2 white bread, crust removed, cut into chunks | 1/2 papaya, cut into chunks | 1 green bell pepper, cut into chunks | 1 tablespoon minced peeled fresh ginger | 24 fresh apricot preserves | 1/2 cup dark chocolate, grated | 1 1/2 lbs fresh sea bass fillets
instructions: Process gennaro ginger until finely minced and reserve. Place bread chunks in a skillet and toast over medium heat for 3 - 5 minutes, scraping bottom of skillet with spatula as needed, until golden, about 1 to 2 minutes total. Remove bread from skillet and place in a strainer and discard it. Mash bread with a fork. Add papaya, green pepper and ginger to bread mixture. Spread apricot preserves evenly over both fish and pat down lightly. Arrange fish in a baking dish lined with parchment paper. Spoon gennaro ginger mixture over each piece of fish and sprinkle top with grated chocolate. Bake at 400° fahrenheit until fish is hot and bubbling, about 40 minutes.

Random Ingredients: chicken leg,cream,red pepper flake,worcestershire sauce,curry powder,philadelphia cream cheese,pine nut
title: Roast Chicken Drumsticks
ingredients: 4 chicken legs, with the thigh attached | 1/4 cup worcestershire sauce | 2 tablespoons chicken curry powder | 1 tablespoon crushed red pepper flakes | 3 tablespoons pine nuts | 1 package philadelphia cream cheese, cubed | 2/3 cup sour cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. In a resealable plastic bag, combine the worcestershire sauce, chicken curry powder, pepper flakes and toasted pine nuts. Add the cubed cream cheese and stir until smooth. Add the sour cream and stir until combined. Transfer to a roasting dish. Bake in preheated oven 40 to 45 minutes, or until chicken is cooked through. Remove from oven and allow to cool completely. Serve with vegetables or bread sticks. Serve with dipping sauce.

title: Mexican Cheese Rice Bowls
ingredients: 1 cup long grain rice or 1 cup basmati rice ( 1/3 cup per bowl ) | 1 teaspoon garlic salt | 1 teaspoon chili flakes | 1/2 cup cotija cheese or 1/2 cup other mexican cheese, grated | 1 teaspoon dill, dried
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions. Rinse rice under cold water, drain and spread out to cool it slightly. Set aside. Toast cheese. Combine cheese with dried dill. Use as garnish for green salads, enchiladas, and others.

title: Savory Artichoke, Olive & Chili Mascarpone
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups kalamata olives, pitted | 1/3 cup salad oil | 8 ounces artichoke hearts, drained ( packed in oil, drained ) | 1/3 cup salsa | 1 cup pimiento slices, drained | 1/4 cup snipped fresh chives or 1/4 cup green onion | 12 -14 ladyfingers, room temperature
instructions: Combine olives, salad oil, artichoke hearts, salsa, pimento, chives, and snipped green onions. Place 1/2 cup artichoke mixture on each lady finger. Wrap and refrigerate any unused marinated artichoke mixture.

title: Scroggin' Hot Pepper Fritters(Vegan)
ingredients: 1 can chopped plum | 8 tablespoons unsweetened tahini | 1/2 cup molasses | 1/2 cup cider vinegar | hot pepper ( i like lots of, especially red hot ones! ) | white flour ( for dredging, if it doesn't already come in a can for frying ) | 16 ounces raspberry preserves, jam
instructions: Using 1/2 to 1 cup water, mix all the ingredients together. Then just let it rest for a few minutes. Then heat a large pan, or fryer to medium to medium high. Drop the hot pepper fritters in and let them cook for about 5 minutes. Drain well. When cool, place on a plate and store covered. These freeze very well.

title: Chai Concentrate for Tea
ingredients: 6 - 8 tea bags | 6 tablespoons peanut butter | 2 1/2 1/2 tablespoons black tea or 2 1/2 tablespoons green tea concentrate
instructions: Pour 4 cups of hot water directly in the bottom of a pot. Put the pouch in the pot, fill the rest of the way with water, and let steep for about 15 minutes. Add peanut butter in a stream through feed tube while stirring. Strain and serve cold. Note, if you like a more mellow, more pleasant concentrated concentrate, like tea with mint, and/or water, like the chai, you can also add 2tbsp of jaggery in the recipe.

title: Lek and Leek Soup
ingredients: 2 leeks | 1/2 cup red wine | 1 cup milk | 1 tablespoon heavy whipping cream | 1 tablespoon tomato ketchup ( optional )
instructions: Wash leeks thoroughly and separate them at the green and the pale green part of the scallion. Cut in half crosswise. Rinse and chop well. Blanch leeks briefly in salted boiling water before drain. Chop leeks into quarters. Reserve 1/4 cup of the liquid. Bring white liquid, milk, cream and tomato ketchup to boil. Cover and simmer 20 minutes. Add leeks, cover and simmer a further ten minutes or until leeks are just tender. Puree mixture in hand blender then return to pan or processor. Reheat before serving.

title: Prairie Rice and Beans
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked short-grain rice | 1 cup dried cannellini beans, drained ( about 25 oz. ) | 2 anaheim chilies, chopped | 1 tablespoon margarine or 1 tablespoon butter | 1 tablespoon poultry seasoning
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions. While rice is cooking, rinse beans and cut into 1/4 inch slices. Place in medium saucepan with enough water to cover and bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer uncovered 15 minutes or until beans are tender, stirring frequently. Drain and add to cooked rice, beans and chilies. Heat through. Pour into bowl and sprinkle with poultry seasoning.

Random Ingredients: caster sugar,mushroom,loaf french bread,ranch dressing mix,salsa,swiss chard
title: Salsa and Swiss Chard Wedges
ingredients: 4 tablespoons salsa | 4 tablespoons mushrooms, sliced | 4 tablespoons swiss chard, coarsely chopped | 1 packet dry ranch dressing mix ( jarls amino acapulco ) | 1/2 cup caster sugar | 1 loaf french bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c. Cut 4 5cm slices from 3/4 of the bread. Using your hands, squeeze out excess bread from the bread slices. Place the bread in a baking tray and spread each with 1tsn of the salsa. Scatter the mushrooms over the salsa. Top with the swiss chard and swiss herb mix and sprinkle with the remaining 1tsn of salsa. Cover and bake for 15 minutes. Remove from oven and toss gently to coat.

Random Ingredients: celery salt,neufchatel cheese cream,thai red chili pepper,mint leaf,chickpea,red cabbage,olive,cooking spray
title: Creamy Italian Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups crumbled neufchatel cheese or 1 1/2 cups cream cheese | 1 cup fresh chopped celery salt | 3 cups thinly sliced red cabbage | 1 can chickpeas, rinsed and drained | 2 fresh thai red chili peppers, minced ( use one small ) | 1 - 1 1/4 cup chopped ripe olives | 1/3 cup chopped fresh mint leaves | cooking spray
instructions: Prepare salad, combine first 7 ingredients in a large bowl.

Random Ingredients: ketchup,tomato basil pasta sauce,vegetarian bean,cream milk,corn oil
title: Quick Bean Soup
ingredients: 1 can vegetarian refried beans | 1 can tomato and basil pasta sauce | 1/2 cup ketchup | 1/4 cup vegetarian sour cream ( optional ) | corn oil ( for frying )
instructions: In a saucepan, add bean sauce, ketchup and sour cream. Heat through. Stir frequently for 2 minutes. Pour into pot with refried beans and mix well. Adjust spices to taste.

Random Ingredients: white wine,hazelnut,savory,sun tomato oil,rice wine vinegar,swiss cheese,pastry shell
title: Easy Swiss Cheese Tart.
ingredients: 2 sheets frozen pastry shells | 2 cups grated swiss cheese | 2/3 cup chopped sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained | 1 teaspoon dried savory | 1/2 cup finely chopped hazelnuts, toasted | 1 teaspoon rice wine vinegar | 1/4 cup white wine
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Place pastry shells on two baking sheets, and bake for 17 to 20 minutes, or until puffed and crisp. Cool.

Random Ingredients: salt pepper,caraway seed,sesame oil,beef consomme,shallot,ice cube,hot red chili pepper
title: Smoked Shallot Soup
ingredients: 4 cups sliced shallots, white parts thinly sliced ( white onions ) | 6 cups beef consomme, low sodium | 4 tablespoons toasted sesame oil | 1 3/4 teaspoons caraway seeds | 1 cup shredded ice cube ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon ground hot red chili pepper ( optional ) | salt & pepper, to taste
instructions: Place sliced shallots in a bowl. Add beef consomme, 3 tablespoons sesame oil, caraway seeds, 1 cup ice and hot pepper. Stir to combine. Cover and refrigerate for up to 8 hours. Place soup in a food processor or blender.

title: Quinoa and Chive Kale Salad
ingredients: 1/3 cup quinoa | 1/2 cup baby spinach | 1 1/2 cups kale leaves | 1/3 cup minced chives | 2 tablespoons tamarind paste | 1 tablespoon grated parmesan cheese
instructions: Toasted quinoa and chives can be found at many supermarkets, or in specialty food stores. Bring large pot of water to boil, then add quinoa and return to boil. Cover, reduce heat to low, and simmer until tender and liquid is absorbed, 10 to 12 minutes. Remove from heat and cool. Remove stems from kale and coarsely chop into bite size pieces. Heat a small nonstick skillet over medium heat. Cook quinoa in the hot skillet until golden brown, stirring frequently, about 3 minutes. Rinse quinoa with cold water and drain. Mix cooked quinoa, spinach, kale, chives, tamarind paste, and parmesan cheese together in a bowl. Cover and refrigerate several hours before serving.

Random Ingredients: red chili pepper,marsala,kidney bean,broccoli,tea,tamari,roasting chicken,rosemary leaf
title: A-Plus Roasted Chicken
ingredients: 1 roasting chicken | 500 g broccoli, cut into 2-inch florets | 1 red chili pepper, chopped | 1 tablespoon fresh rosemary leaf, chopped | 3 packets steamed tea | 1 tablespoon marsala or 1 tablespoon brandy | 400 g kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 125 ml roasted tamari
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200c. Line a roasting tray with baking paper. Place the chicken, then top with the broccoli and capsicum. Sprinkle with the rosemary and wrap in the baking paper. Bake for 45 minutes the chicken should be cooked and firm to the touch. Remove the chicken from the oven and discard the wrapping paper. Pour the steamed tea into a pan and stir in the marsala/brandy/water. Place the chicken on top of the vegetables and bring to the boil. Turn the heat down and simmer. Meanwhile, place the beans in a large saucepan and cover with cold water. Bring to the boil and cook for 3 - 4 minutes or until just tender. Drain. Arrange the ingredients in a roasting pan and season to taste. Pour over the chicken and bake 5 minutes to crisp the meat and serve.

title: Quick and Easy Red Curry Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons red curry paste | 4 fluid ounces heavy whipping cream | 1 jar pickles
instructions: In a medium saucepan over medium heat, combine curry paste and cream. Bring to a boil, then remove from heat. Place 1 cup of the pickles into the cream and let them sit for 15 to 20 minutes. Drain off the liquid and set the pickles aside to cool. The cream will keep in the refrigerator for a couple of weeks.

title: Black Olive Spread
ingredients: 1 can pitted black olives, drained and coarsely chopped | 1/4 teaspoon celery salt
instructions: In a small salad bowl, stir together black olives, celery salt, and any remaining dressing ingredients until well combined. Cover, and chill for up to 3 days before serving. This spread can be refrigerated for up to 3 days.

Random Ingredients: lemon peel,sage,swiss chard,red potato,angel hair pasta
title: Swiss Chard and Pasta for Two
ingredients: 10 leaves swiss chard | 6 red potatoes | 4 teaspoons grated lemon peel | 3 cups torn swiss chard ( about 3 bunches ) | 2/3 cup chopped fresh sage | 8 ounces angel hair pasta, cooked
instructions: Cut green leaves from chard and set aside. Separate leaves from stems and chop. Set leaves aside. Snap potatoes into small pieces and bring a large pot of water to boil. When water returns to rolling boil, add potatoes and stems. Cover and cook 4 minutes. Drain and place on paper towels. Meanwhile, cut green leaves from chard. Place chard, green leaves and sage in a large bowl. Add pasta and toss to mix. Divide pasta among 4 warmed shallow serving bowls and top with reserved green leaves until serving.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray,peach,active yeast,yukon gold potato,wine,port wine,green pigeon pea,salt water
title: Port Potatoes With Peach and Pea Chard
ingredients: 2 packages active dry yeast | 1 1/2 cups salt water | 4 1/2 cups coarsely cubed yukon gold potatoes | 1 cup vegetable oil or 1 cup cooking spray, such as pam | 4 cups coarsely cubed peeled peaches | 1/2 cup dry port wine | 3 1/2 cups dry bordeaux bordeaux wine | 1 package frozen green pigeon peas, thawed according to package directions
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 1/2 cup of the salt water. Add potato and oil. Stir in peaches, port, wine and remaining salt. Add bread cubes and mix thoroughly. Place in large greased bowl, turning as needed. Cover and let rise in warm place until doubled, about 1 hour. Brush with oil. Bake at 400 degrees f for 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: thyme sprig,green cardamom pod,puff pastry,clear honey,vanilla,chicken broth,olive
title: Caramelized Onion Tarts
ingredients: 1/2 cup low-sodium chicken broth | 3 green cardamom pods | 3 fresh thyme sprigs | 4 tablespoons clear honey | 24 sheets frozen puff pastry | 1/3 cup finely chopped ripe olives or 1/3 cup other brine-cured black olives, coarsely chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. In small saucepan, heat broth, cardamom pods, and thyme until broth is just absorbed, about 3 minutes.

Random Ingredients: serrano pepper,black red pepper,beef stew meat,cinnamon
title: Caribbean Jerked Chilean Steak
ingredients: 2 pounds beef stew meat | 32 whole black and red peppers | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground black and red peppers | 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon
instructions: Preheat grill for high heat. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Cut beef into 1/2 inch thick strips. Place beef strips onto the prepared baking sheet. In a bowl, combine black and red peppers, ground black and red pepper and cinnamon. Pour marinade over beef strips and vegetables. Turn over once to coat evenly. Place beef strips onto the prepared grill, close lid, and grill for 30 minutes. Turn off grill and allow to sit for 5 minutes while you continue to prep the rest of the meal. Serve.

Random Ingredients: whipping cream,green chili pepper,spinach,wild rice,double cream
title: Wild Rice & Spinach
ingredients: 300 g wild rice | 8 tablespoons double cream | 150 g spinach ( coarsely chopped and packed ) | 2 teaspoons green chili peppers ( deseeded and chopped ) | 150 ml double cream
instructions: Cook rice and chilli in boiling water for 20 mins, until water is absorbed and grains are tender. Meanwhile, preheat oven to 180c. Place 5 tablespoons of the cream and the spinach into a heatproof bowl and microwave for 1 minute. Stir to combine with rice. Pour rice mixture into a deep, large, ovenproof dish. Smooth top evenly. Cover with foil and bake in oven, in oven, for 30 minutes, until rice is cooked. Remove foil and bake, uncovered, for further 5 minutes. Cool slightly. Stir together remaining cream and chilies. Spoon over rice. Serve with chilli.

title: Date Syrup
ingredients: 2 -3 large dates, pitted | 1 cup orange juice
instructions: Put all in a small pan. Heat gently. Bring to boil. Pour into sterilized jars and leave in a cool place for 6 weeks.

Random Ingredients: turmeric powder,romano cheese,chicken breast half,mostaccioli pasta,garlic clove
title: Pasta With Chicken or Turkey
ingredients: 1 lb mostaccioli pasta or 1 lb penne pasta | 4 chicken breast halves, sliced thin | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1 tablespoon grated romano cheese | 2 garlic cloves, minced
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. Meanwhile, remove chicken from freezer and slice very thin. Add garlic and turmeric/tumeric to chicken and cook over medium heat until chicken is done to preference and not too brown. Remove chicken from pan and set aside. Return pan to burner and add enough water to the pasta to just barely cover. Bring to boil and cook until al dente, drain pasta and add it to chicken/turmeric mixture. Toss with romano cheese and serve.

title: Coriander Chops & Kielbasa
ingredients: 500 g fresh kielbasa | 1 bunch coriander seed, pounded to a powder | 6 -8 heads bok choy | seasoning | milk chocolate chips or white chocolate chips, for garnishing
instructions: Heat grill or fry pan with kielbasa on very high, so kielbasa is only slightly charred. Sprinkle coriander seeds over the surface, and cook for a few seconds on one side until they begin to change colour. Turn the kielbasa and repeat until all sides remain same. Add coriander and continue roasting on other side while the kielbasa is cooking, just until the outside of the kielas starts to change colour. Remove the kielbasa from grill, and place in a plate lined with kitchen paper to soak up any excess oil. Cut tops off bok choy and tear leaves into rings. Set aside. Slice kielbasa into rounds. Spread coriander powder over one side of each slice of kielbasa, and sprinkle liberally with one slice of kielbasa on top, then roll up starting with the leaves and beginning on the outside. Repeat, until ingredients are used up. Brush the remaining sliced kielbasa on top and grill until brown on both sides. To serve, place one slice on a plate and top with 2 tablespoons milk or white chocolate chips, if desired. Garnish as desired.

title: Grilled Chard
ingredients: 5 cups mixed chard leaves | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 2 tablespoons ground cinnamon | 4 pieces pita bread
instructions: In a large bowl, combine chard leaves, balsamic vinegar and cinnamon. Cover and let sit for 15 minutes. Preheat grill for high heat. Thread leaves onto skewers. Place on hot grill, close lid for 2 - 3 minutes. Turn and close lid for 2 - 3 minutes more. Repeat with remaining leaves. Serve immedately.

title: Capellini II
ingredients: 2 teaspoons cooking oil | 1 1/4 teaspoons fast rising yeast | 1 medium avocado - peeled, pitted, and diced | 1 pound uncooked asparagus, cut into 2-inch pieces
instructions: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Sprinkle in the yeast, and cook until foamy. Stir in the avocado. Cook and stir until creamy, about 5 minutes. Cool slightly. Fold in the asparagus, and heat until the asparagus is bright green and almost dry, 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: romano cheese,plain flour,basmati rice,tarragon vinegar,clam,hard egg,cumin
title: Italian Style Clam Rice
ingredients: 3 cups plain flour, sifted | 500 g small clams in shell or 450 g cockles | 4 hard-boiled eggs | 1 cup romano cheese | 1 cup basmati rice | 1 tablespoon red cumin | 1 tablespoon tarragon vinegar
instructions: Combine flour and salt in a large plastic bag. Open up clams and place in bag. Dry clams well on paper towels. Shell, devein, add eggs and cheese to bag. Close up bag to make all clams inside evenly. Shake down to expel as much of the water as possible. Remove clams using toothpicks. Do not place in too long bag. Bake at 160c for 15 minutes. Remove from bag and shake out water. Place uncooked rice inside of rice. Place on a medium plate or tray. Top with clams and bread crumbs. Place under hot grill for 10 - 12 minutes until lightly golden brown.

Random Ingredients: onion soup mix,bacon dripping,onion,garlic paste,chili oil,cider vinegar,pita bread,green food coloring
title: Pita Chips
ingredients: 6 1/2 pita bread rounds with pita bread attached | 3 tablespoons onions, finely minced | 1 onion's soup mix, dry | 2 tablespoons garlic paste | 1/2 teaspoon bacon drippings or 1/2 teaspoon turkey drippings | 2 tablespoons cider vinegar | 1 tablespoon chili oil | 1 -2 drop green food coloring
instructions: Prepare the onions, fry them in bacon drippings or turkey drippings. Add the dry onion soup mix.

Random Ingredients: lentil,vanilla essence,monterey jack cheese,cherry,golden raisin,jalapeno pepper,halibut,navy bean
title: Zwt Three Fat Baked Halibut With Frijoles Mexicano and Berritos Mexicano
ingredients: 1 can canned navy beans, drained and rinsed | 1 can lentils | 1/3 cup golden raisin | 1/3 cup cherry or 1/3 cup grape kernels, canned | 1 jalapeno pepper, seeded | 1/4 cup halibut, cooked, halved lengthwise and cut into four portions | 1/3 cup low-fat monterey jack cheese, shredded | 1/2 tablespoon vanilla essence
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Combine the beans, lentils, raisins, cherries and chili pepper in a large bowl. Spread the halibut evenly in a 2 quart baking dish. Top with the bean mixture, sprinkle with cheese and bake, covered, for 30 minutes or until the halibut is tender.

title: Coconut Chicken
ingredients: 4 lbs chicken thighs | 4 ounces amaretto | 1/2 cup water | 1/8 cup pineapple juice | 1/8 cup chopped fresh parsley
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f, lightly grease an 11x7x2 inch glass baking dish. In a large resealable bag, combine chicken and remaining ingredients. Remove skin and any excess fat from the chicken and discard, then shake off the excess. Rinse the chicken and pat dry. Place the chicken in the dish, and turn at least once, coating all sides with marinade. Cover tightly with foil. Bake in preheated oven for 30 minutes. Increase the oven temperature to 350 degrees f and continue cooking, basting with pan juices every 30 minutes, until chicken is thoroughly cooked, about 1 1/2 hours more. An instant read thermometer inserted into the thickest part of thigh registers 165 degrees f, about 1 hour more. Remove from oven, cover loosely with foil, then place in a warm place for 15 minutes. Transfer to a warmed platter. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: garlic red chile paste,chicken thigh,kosher salt,watercress leaf,orange juice,chili sauce
title: Spicy Chicken and Orange-Spice Salad
ingredients: 3/4 cup watercress leaf | 1 tablespoon chili sauce ( or cayenne pepper ) | 1 tablespoon garlic and red chile paste | 1 tablespoon chili sauce | 1/2 cup orange juice ( or lemon juice ) | 1 teaspoon kosher salt | 1 large chicken thigh ( about 2 pounds )
instructions: Combine watercress leaf, chili sauce, garlic, chile sauce, orange juice, and kosher salt in a bowl.

title: Sizzlin' Rigatoni With Ground Beef, Peanuts and Ginger
ingredients: 1 lb rigatoni pasta | 2 lbs ground sirloin ( or turkey ) | 1/2 cup smooth peanut butter | 1/2 cup prepared prepared sweet-and-sour mix | 1/2 cup beef stock | 2 teaspoons ground ginger | 1/4 cup graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Cook rigatoni for 15 minutes, according to package directions. Meanwhile, heat a large skillet on medium/medium high heat and add ground sirloin/turkey. When meat is browned, drain any excess fat. Return meat to skillet, add peanut butter and hot beef stock. Add sour mix. Cover and simmer for approx 10 minutes, or until meat is cooked through and sauce is creamy. Sauce should thicken slightly. Add graham cracker crumbs. Stir until completely combined and evenly distributed. Serve meat and sauce over hot pasta.

title: Sopa Seca Y aceite (Sopa Seca Y E Molada)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons tomato and garlic oil, divided | 1 1/2 cups soup bones | 1/2 large whole vanilla pod
instructions: Place the tomato and garlic in a blender with about one cup of the soup bones and the pureed mixture.

title: Basic Thai Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup tamarind paste ( soaked in 2 tablespoons water ) | 1/2 cup thai fish sauce | 2 tablespoons peanut oil
instructions: Drain tamarind and mix tamarind with fish sauce. Heat oil in a small skillet over medium heat. Let it burn, then add paste mixture to skillet and cook, stirring frequently, until thickened. Spoon into hot dipping glass and serve.

title: Alfalfa Sprout and Hot Pepper Dip
ingredients: 1 cup bulgar wheat | 1/2 cup soymilk | 1 small roasted chili pepper ( sliced or crushed ) | 2 tablespoons fresh basil or 2 tablespoons coriander, chopped
instructions: Mix everything together in a bowl. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: peanut butter,trout,streaky bacon,coriander seed,banana,corn oil,taco sauce,ketchup
title: Smoked Trout & Bacon Skewers
ingredients: 1 packet smoked trout, descaled with head removed | 4 large ripe medium ripe bananas, halved lengthways, scored on skewers | 1 tablespoon coriander seed, plus extra to sprinkle | 2 teaspoons corn oil | 200 g chopped smoked streaky bacon | 2 tablespoons peanut butter | 3 tablespoons ketchup | 1/4 cup crushed sweet taco sauce
instructions: Place the trout on skewers, then season to your taste with salt and black pepper. Mix together the coriander seeds and oil, then put the banana slices on top of each piece of fish. Place the skewers on a tray and rub with the coriander oil. Pre heat your grill. Sprinkle the bacon and ketchup on the skewers. Grill over hot coals for 3 to 4 minutes, until the bacon is crisped and the fish is just cooked through. To serve, add the peanut sauce to the pan, then spoon over the skewers.

Random Ingredients: plain flour,pine nut,chile pepper,yellow pepper,salt black pepper,cream cheese,pickapeppa sauce,dark sesame oil
title: Sour Party Appetizers
ingredients: 125 g low-fat cream cheese | 75 g plain flour or 75 g cornflour | 2 -5 canned sweet chile peppers ( or substitute 1 fresh hot pepper or 1 jalapeno chile, if you want ) | 60 g yellow peppers ( or substitute a fresh yellow pepper or other mild pepper ) | 1 tablespoon pickapeppa sauce | 3 -5 drops dark sesame oil | salt & freshly ground black pepper ( to taste ) | chopped toasted pine nuts
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180°c. Mix ingredients very well with wet hands in large bowl. Roll the mixture into long, thin fingers or a log. Place on an oiled baking tray. To make the topping, mix the ingredients very well in a small bowl and set aside. Bake for 15 minutes, keep in an open oven for 5 minutes, stir. Serve warm sprinkled with the garnish. Variation, mix all the ingredients with just a small amount of oil or butter. Variation, add dried chili flakes to taste. Variation, add fresh, chopped red chile and jalapeño peppers to taste. Variation, add dried black peppers to taste. Variation, add 1 or 2 tablespoons paprika to the tomato puree or the juice. Variation, to taste the saltiness of the chiles, replace with 1 or 2 tablespoons of juliennes of juliennes. Variation, add 1 to 1 1/2 teaspoons of coarsely grated horseradish or 1/4 teaspoons of grana padano or 1/2 teaspoon of dry horseradish powder to the tomato puree or the juice. Variation, add 2 tablespoons of finely chopped fresh cilantro to the tomato puree or juice.

title: Spice Island Spray
ingredients: 2 packages vanilla instant pudding | 2 teaspoons lemon pepper
instructions: Put in a glass bowl or a disposable towel in the sun. Let it get to the right temperature. Sprinkle with the lemon pepper. Keep in a dry place.

Random Ingredients: corn,kidney bean,asafoetida powder,orange juice concentrate,chicken stock,curry sauce
title: Super Quick Slow Cooked Mexican White Bean Soup
ingredients: 1 can coconut beans ( plain or flavored ) | 1 can kidney beans | 3 cans corn ( drained and rinsed ) | 1/2 cup canned orange juice concentrate | 2 envelopes curry sauce ( i usually use hot ) | 1 pinch asafoetida powder ( optional )
instructions: Place everything in your slow cooker and mix everything up. The longer the better the texture. I usually just put it all in the slow cooker on low for about 8 hours or until it is all hot. It takes about 15 to 30 minutes to reach the desired consistency.

title: Cherry Cream
ingredients: 2 pounds sweet spanish sweet cherries, pitted and cut into 1/2-inch chunks | 1/2 cup hot paprika | 1 cup heavy whipping cream
instructions: Place cherries in a small bowl. Add paprika and cream.

Random Ingredients: topping,green curry paste,pork tenderloin,cardamom pod,cardamom seed
title: Thai Pork Curry Appetizer
ingredients: 1 pork tenderloin | 1 tablespoon green curry paste | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom seeds | 1 cardamom pod | 8 fresh cardamom pods | 1 package frozen whipped topping, thawed
instructions: Trim fat from tenderloin. Cut crosswise into 1/4 inch slices. Place slices between 2 sheets of wax paper on a lightly floured surface. Using a meat mallet, pound each slice to tenderize. Spread curry paste on both sides of tenderloins. Place 1 cardamom pod and two whole cardamom pods on top of meat. Lay strips of frozen whipped topping in a zigzag pattern over beef and pork. Roll in plastic wrap directly on the rack. Refrigerate in plastic wrap for at least 2 hours. Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Bake in preheated oven until meat is deep to the touch and beginning to brown, about 1 1/2 hours. Turn off oven, and let dish stand in the turned off oven until cool. Store in airtight container.

title: Filipino Beef Jerky
ingredients: 2 lbs baby carrots | 1/2 cup gin ( or alcohol for a sweeter taste ) | 1 tablespoon light soy sauce | lettuce, for coating ( optional ) | toasted sweetened soy sauce
instructions: Cut a large x on the top of each carrot. Place in a plastic bag. Add all the other ingredients, except for the meat and lettuce, into a blender or food processor and whirl on high until well blended. The mixture should be somewhat thick, but fairly stiff. Transfer the mixture to the bag and place on the dehydrator rack in a steamer over 1 1/2 liters of boiling water. Cover and let sit for 10 - 15 minutes, until the carrots are soft and pliable. Wipe the bag slightly with the damp cloths and set the dehydrator rack in a 4 quart dutch oven or other large nonreactive casserole dish and warm the oven to 150 degrees f. Remove the bag of carrot mix from the oven and toss in the salad ingredients until coated with a thin layer of spicy sauce. Place the contents in the dehydrator and dehydrate according to the manufacturer's instructions. Remove the beef jerky from the refrigerator and place on a rack to cool for several hours. The next day, drain and store in a container in the refrigerator until well drained and refrigerated.

Random Ingredients: chuck steak,soya sauce,cottage cheese,corn,cashew nut,orange juice concentrate
title: Cottage Cheeseburgers (Gluten Free Beef Rolls)
ingredients: 1 kg chuck steak, cut into 1 inch pieces | 250 g cottage cheese | 2 tablespoons soya sauce | 1/4 cup freshly squeezed orange juice concentrate | 3 tablespoons cashew nuts, grated | 1/4 cup corn, nibbles
instructions: Marinate the chuck steak with soya. Squeeze it to extract all the juice and dissolve the meat and keep aside. Add cashew nuts and grated orange into the meat. Form into small meat balls. Roll them in the remaining corn nibbles. Heat oil in a pan. Deep fry meat balls for 3 - 4 minutes or until golden brown. Drain on clean paper towel and serve hot with chutney or rice.

Random Ingredients: worcestershire sauce,garlic clove,soy sauce,beef bouillon cube
title: Basic Beef Gravy
ingredients: 1/3 cup soy sauce ( kikkoman is good ) | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 3 garlic cloves, chopped very finely | 3 beef bouillon cubes
instructions: Mix all ingredients and serve over steak or other veggies.

Random Ingredients: brown rice,chili oil,cooking oil,flat leaf parsley,canola oil
title: Easy Brown Rice Crispy Baked Chicken
ingredients: 1/2 cup cooked brown rice ( i used basmati ) | 1/4 cup canola oil | 1 1/2 tablespoons canola oil | 1 teaspoon dried chili oil | 2 tablespoons whole flat leaf parsley | 1 tablespoon quick-cooking oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Drain rice in fine mesh strainer over bowl.

title: Quick and Easy Fried Plantains
ingredients: 2 plantains | 2 cans cream of mushroom soup
instructions: Pierce plantains with a fork. Fry in about 1 teaspoon of vegetable oil. When slightly brown, place on paper towel. Pour undiluted soup over the plantains or they will be too soft. Serve as a side dish.

Random Ingredients: rutabaga,balsamic vinegar,chipotle chile,lime juice zest,garam masala
title: Chipotle and Raspberry Mashed Rutabagas
ingredients: 3/4 1/2 cup rutabaga or 3/4 cup green potato, cooked and diced | 2 -4 tablespoons balsamic vinegar ( may sub red wine vinegar ) | 1/4 teaspoon chipotle chile, crushed ( may sub hot pepper sauce ) | 1 tablespoon garam masala | 3 tablespoons fresh lime juice and zest
instructions: Saute the vegetables in a large saucepan over medium heat, stirring frequently, until crisp tender. Meanwhile, in a medium bowl, whisk together the remaining ingredients until well blended and warm. Pour the sauce from the pan into the vegetables and heat thoroughly. Transfer the salad to a platter and serve at once.

Random Ingredients: jumbo shrimp,cauliflower floret,pork shoulder,garlic salt,italian seasoning,butter bean,oregano,italian sausage
title: Roasted Italian Sausage and Shrimp
ingredients: 12 ounces italian sausage | 1 lb fresh raw pork shoulder | 2 lbs jumbo shrimp | 1 pound jumbo shrimp, shells on | 1 teaspoon dried oregano | 2 teaspoons italian seasoning | 2 teaspoons garlic salt | 1 large head cauliflower florets ( you can buy them in a vacuum container )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees. Line the bottom and up the sides of a roasting pan with aluminum foil. Place all dry ingredients in a medium roasting pan in the order listed. Shrimp, sausage, scallions, garlic salt and oregano together with all the liquids from shrimp and sausage. Add the vegetables to the pan, turning over until coated evenly. Cover and roast at 375 degrees for 45 - 50 minutes. Shrimp should be cooked through and tender.

title: Beef Risotto With Peppercorns
ingredients: 2 cups rice wine ( not cooking wine ) | 1 can sweetened condensed milk of pouring cream of pouring cream | 3 teaspoons pink peppercorns, cracked in grinder | 1/4 cup heavy cream | 1 1/2 lbs ground beef | 1 lb ground veal | arborio rice, cooked & cooled
instructions: Note, the meat mixture can be frozen for up to three months. To make the risotto, combine the rice wine, sweetened condensed milk, and peppercorns in a heavy saucepan and bring to a boil over medium high heat. Stir, cover, and transfer to refrigerator as directed. Strain mixture through a cheesecloth lined sieve set over a bowl. Discard solids from sieve through another sieve. Reserve 3/4 cup of the liquid in a separate large bowl. Add the beef, veal, and 1 3/4 cups of rice wine mixture to the risotto. Stir well, breaking up clumps as the mixture cooks, until thoroughly mixed. Cover and refrigerate the risotto for 2 hours.. Serve the risotto with the reserved cream and peppercorn liquid. Note, i use a 4 - ½ cup capacity round rice for this recipe, 3 - ½ pound of ground meat, ½ lb of ground pork, ½ lb ground cheese, 3 ounces of sliced provolone cheese, and ½ pound of diced ham. You may need to add more of this mixture. Store refrigerated, covered for several days before using.

title: Miso Dip
ingredients: 1 cup raw quinoa ( arborio or risi ) | 1 cup frozen cut apples with juice | 3/4 cup mild cheddar cheese | 2 tablespoons instant miso ( or soy beans ) | 1 cup skim-milk natural sour cream ( or plain )
instructions: Rinse the quinoa. Over high heat, toast quinoa in a single layer. The quinoa will swell and become mushy. Add the apples and cheddar. Remove from heat, cover, and let sit for 10 minutes. Take the quinoa out and place it in a microwave safe bowl.

title: Rice With Daikon Radishes with Apples and Radishes
ingredients: 2 cups basmati rice | 2 teaspoons anise seeds | 1 large red apple, cored, peeled and diced | 4 cups thinly sliced daikon radishes, such as yucca, white, and purple light | 1 pound arugula, stemmed
instructions: Place basmati rice in a large bowl. Fill with boiling water over the rice. Cover with heavy plastic wrap and set aside for 20 minutes to soak. Drain. Meanwhile, bring about 3 1/2 cups water to a boil in a large pot. Add anise seeds and rice. Cook, uncovered, over medium high heat until rice is just beginning to firm, about 5 minutes. Uncover, and boil rice, uncovered, until it is tender, about 25 minutes more. Remove from heat, and cool to room temperature. Transfer to a large bowl and set aside. Cover with plastic wrap and set aside. Toss apple and radishes with anise seeds in a bowl. Divide radish mixture evenly among 4 serving dishes. Sprinkle top of radishes with anise seeds. Heat a large skillet over medium heat. Douse rice with warm water and cook until the water is absorbed, 2 to 3 minutes. Fluff rice with a fork.

title: Cranberry Ginger Beef
ingredients: 1 package beef tenderloin steaks | 1/2 cup dried cranberries, divided | 1 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste
instructions: Place the meat in a ziplock bag. Place 1/2 cup cranberries into the bag, close the bag, and squeeze out excess air. Place the bag into the refrigerator. Place the ginger garlic paste and remaining 1 tablespoon of cinnamon in a small bowl. Coat each tenderloin steak with the marinade, and refrigerate in a preheated 500 degrees f oven for at least 30 minutes, turning once. Grill steak on a preheated outdoor grill for 30 to 35 minutes, or for desired doneness.

Random Ingredients: vanilla extract,egg,heavy cream,cilantro leaf,golden raisin,maple extract,poblano pepper
title: Spicy Poblano Fudge
ingredients: 2 poblano peppers, roasted, peeled, seeded and diced | 3/4 cup golden raisin | 1/4 cup heavy cream | 2 eggs | 1/2 cup pure maple flavored extract | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1/2 cup cilantro leaf, finely chopped, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 250 degrees f. Butter a 15x10x1 jelly roll pan. Place the diced poblano peppers on a foil lined baking sheet. Toss with the raisins and place in the oven to roast for 20 minutes or until beginning to soften. Cool for 5 minutes, then remove and discard the stems from chiles, slit open and scrape out the seeds. Combine the poblanos, raisins, cream, eggs, maple flavoring, vanilla and 1/2 cup chopped cilantro in a blender. Process on high until smooth, about 30 seconds. Pour into the prepared pan, cover and refrigerate for at least one hour to set. Remove paprika from heat and sprinkle with the reserved 1/2 cup cilantro.

title: Quick & Easy Coconut Beans
ingredients: 1 can coconut flakes | 1 can pinto beans
instructions: Rinse and drain the beans.

title: Spicy Barbecued Pinto Beans(Cook's Country)
ingredients: 3/4 cup molasses | 1 3/4 cups pinto beans, drained and rinsed | 1 1/2 cups bottled alfredo sauce | 1 1/2 tablespoons gelatin powder or 1 1/2 tablespoons gelatin granules | 1 teaspoon worcestershire sauce | 1/4 cup chopped dried fruit ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon molasses, for flavor, if desired
instructions: In a small saucepan, combine molasses, beans, enlada sauce, gelatin and worcestershire sauce.

Random Ingredients: heavy whipping cream,raspberry jam,sirloin tip roast,allspice,shiitake mushroom,black peppercorn,tomato sauce,hot chili pepper

instructions: Note, 1 teaspoon allspice can be used in place of the dried chili. Also, dried chili can be used for a spicier smoke. Rub all of the seasoning mix into both sides of the steak. Put the steak into a large zip top bag.

title: Walnut Oil
ingredients: 1/2 lb walnuts | 1/2 bunch fresh sage leaf
instructions: Punch down walnuts with a mallet or the blade of a knife. Using a food processor chop the nuts into a fine powder.. Add the sage leaves and process until they are finely chopped. Form the walnut mixture into walnut sized balls and roll them in to flour.

title: Blueberry and Rice Rice
ingredients: 1 cup glutinous rice, cleaned | 4 cups fresh blueberries | 1 cup ghee or 1 cup vegetable oil | pepper
instructions: Rinse the rice well under running water. When done, mix with the berries and heat through.

title: Su-Ye-Gee Vietnamese Pork
ingredients: 1 loaf loaf breadcrumbs | 1/2 teaspoon ground pepper sauce | 2 teaspoons baking powder | 2 spring onions, sliced thinly | fresh lettuce leaf
instructions: Mix breadcrumbs, pepper sauce and baking powder together in a bowl. Gently toss in the spring onions. If breadcrumbs aren't holding their shape yet, just mound some on a plate. Transfer to a serving plate and serve with a crisp, crisp lettuce leaf.

Random Ingredients: rice wine,white vinegar,pecorino romano cheese,ginger,rye bread,black eyed pea
title: Black-Eyed Peas With Rice Wine and Pecorino Risotto
ingredients: 1 tablespoon minced peeled fresh ginger | 1 cup uncooked rye bread, torn into fine pieces | 1 cup frozen black-eyed peas, thawed | 4 tablespoons white vinegar | 1/2 cup coarsely grated pecorino romano cheese | 1/4 cup rice wine ( not cooking wine! )
instructions: In a small bowl combine the ginger and rye bread and toss well. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate it for 30 minutes. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Rinse the black eyed peas in cold water and drain and pat dry. If using fresh peas, put in a baking dish. Drizzle the vinegar on the pecorino romano in a small dish or bowl. Add the cheese and stir to combine. Dip the bread and peas in the vinegar, then transfer them to an ovenproof dish, being careful not to tear them. Bake in the oven for 15 to 20 minutes, stirring every 5 minutes. When the peas are bubbling and the cheese is golden brown, take them out and spoon over toasted pecorino romano.

title: Italian Egg Drop Butter
ingredients: 8 egg whites | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh italian parsley
instructions: Heat a nonstick skillet over medium heat until it is hot but not smoking. Brush egg whites with warm water.

Random Ingredients: season salt,cumin,oil enough,pecorino romano cheese,jicama,cream tartar
title: Jicama in Pecorino Oil
ingredients: 3 cups cubed jicama | 1/2 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1/2 teaspoon season salt | 1/2 teaspoon cumin | 5 tablespoons freshly grated pecorino romano cheese | oil ( enough for frying )
instructions: In medium bowl, combine romano cheese, cream of tartar, salt, cumin and peppcorino romano. Squeeze in enough oil to cover jicama, about 3/4 cup. Place in refrigerator for about 5 minutes. Stir gently to coat evenly. Drain well.

Random Ingredients: beef eye,ginger,bread flour,red pepper flake,baby arugula,chicken breast half
title: Spicy Asian Chicken
ingredients: 2 teaspoons grated ginger | 8 ounces boneless skinless chicken breast halves, cubed | 2 teaspoons red pepper flakes ( to taste ) | 2 cups baby arugula, leaves ( i substitute about 6 ounces ) | 2 teaspoons plain bread flour | 2 tablespoons reduced sodium chicken broth or 2 tablespoons other reduced-sodium broth
instructions: In a large resealable bag combine the ginger and the chicken and mix well. Add the red pepper flakes and arugula and shake until evenly coated. Add the flour and shake again. Pour the chicken broth or broth into the bag, coat well. Seal the bag and marinate in the refrigerator for at least an hour and up to one day. Heat a large nonstick skillet or grill over medium heat. Add the chicken to the skillet and sear, turning once, for 10 minutes. To serve, divide the chicken among serving plates. Drizzle with any remaining marinade.

title: Pancakes for the Adventurous (Devil) Eaters
ingredients: 1 teaspoon ancho chile powder | cooking oil ( for frying ) | assorted ground roasted vegetables ( any optional ingredient, such as corn or zucchini )
instructions: Place the ancho chili powder and cooking oil into a mortar or a blender and pound to a paste. Sprinkle the mixture into small bowls and add chopped vegetables to them to make an eclair. Roll the eclairs in the chile powder. Place the eclairs on a serving tray and chill for 2 - 3 hours. Makes about 5 eclairs.

title: Italian Sausage Gravy for Spicy Meatballs
ingredients: 1 lb mild italian turkey sausage ( or 1 lb bulk mild sausage that has been sliced ) | 1 cup self rising flour | 2 teaspoons ground coriander | 1/2 teaspoon dried sage
instructions: If using italian sausage or bulk mild sausages, cut into 1/2 inch pieces. Put italian sausage pieces into a large bowl with the flour, coriander, sage and 2 t. Of water. Mix all ingredients together. Using your hands form the wet mixture into walnut size balls.. Bake sausages or turkeyballs in a preheated 375 degree f oven for 30 minutes or until fully cooked. Alternatively, cook, bake or fry the meatballs until done, turning frequently.

Random Ingredients: onion,lemon pepper,apple cider,brie cheese,blueberry,enchilada sauce,yellow pepper,wheat flour
title: Apple Blueberry Brie Cheese Spread
ingredients: 1 container frozen blueberries, thawed ( or fresh ) | 1/2 cup chopped onion | 1 -2 minced ( use red or green onions if you prefer ) | 1/4 teaspoon lemon pepper | 1 can enchilada sauce | 1 1/2 cups cubed brie cheese | 3 tablespoons whole wheat flour | 1 medium chopped yellow sweet pepper
instructions: In a medium nonstick skillet, combine the blueberries, onions, lemon pepper and enchilada sauce. Cover and cook on medium heat 3 - 4 minutes or until most of liquid is absorbed. Remove from heat. Stir and set aside. In a mixing bowl gently blend the cheese cubes with the flour until they are coarsely shredded. Stir in the blueberry mixture. Season with salt and pepper. In a 9 by 12 inch baking dish sprayed with pam spread the blueberry mixture evenly in the dish. Cover the blueberry mixture with the cubed brie cheese. Bake in the preheated oven at 375° for 25 - 35 minutes or until the cheese is bubbly and browned. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: tamarind paste,egg,black cardamom pod,white wine vinegar
title: Bengali Paste
ingredients: 10 black cardamom pods, pods | 2 tablespoons tamarind paste | 1/2 cup dry white wine vinegar | 2 eggs
instructions: Heat a skillet over medium heat, add tamarind paste. Cook until fragrant, about 1 minute. Add vinegar and cook until reduced to 1/4 cup, 1 to 2 minutes. Remove from heat. Add eggs and cook until set, about 5 minutes. Serve with chapatis.

Random Ingredients: lime juice,chicken breast half,parsley flake,red pepper sauce,white pepper
title: Chicken With Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 9 boneless skinless chicken breast halves | lime juice | 2 tablespoons parsley flakes | 1/2 teaspoon white pepper | 1/4 cup bottled red hot pepper sauce
instructions: Arrange chicken in lightly oiled 13x9x2 inch baking dish. Combine remaining ingredients in bowl.

Random Ingredients: graham cracker crumb,colby monterey jack cheese,thai chili paste,vanilla essence,arborio rice,kale,sun tomato oil
title: Gran's Risotto With a Kick
ingredients: 3 cups arborio rice, cooked ( i prefer white ) | 4 cups colby-monterey jack cheese ( shredded ) | 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, chopped ( drained ) | 2 bunches kale, washed stems removed & thinly sliced | 2 teaspoons sun-dried tomato sauce from jar or 2 teaspoons thai chili paste | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla essence | 1/2 cup graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Blend all ingredients except the crumbs in a food processor until smooth. Spoon into a dish, sprinkle with crumbs, & refrigerate for at least 20 minutes. Enjoy.

title: Easy Chicken Cholesterol Cholesterol
ingredients: 20 ounces boneless skinless chicken thighs ( or your chicken breasts, defrosted if frozen ) | 4 ounces bacon bits ( i use bacon bits as they are salty-reduced fat ) | 1 cup egg yolk ( this is the hard yolk )
instructions: Use about a cup of chicken fat or less according to the size of your chicken breasts. They should be about the same thickness of a bread loaf and need less for baking. If they are thicker, then cut them in half. Heat up the fat in a skillet. Cut the chicken up in bite sized pieces as you like, and add them to the skillet. If they are thinner, then you may need to add more fat. You want the chicken to be a bit of a soupy consistency, and there will no discernable pieces of the fat until it is all coated. Once all pieces are cooked, put the skillet back on the burner, and wait until the fat has started to smoke up and the pieces are no longer red. Dip your egg yolks in just enough egg yolk to start breaking, and then mix them in and then add in the bacon bits until you have nice, and creamy consistency. You may need to add more egg yolk if it is too thick for your taste. It should be a bit of a thick. Serve over rice and enjoy.

title: Pumpkin and Almond Chiles Stew (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 1 kg ripe pumpkin | 250 g baking powder | 1 small dried ancho chile, seeds removed | 350 g new potatoes | 1 cup almond meal | 1 lime
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c. Cut your pumpkin into quarters and use a mandolin to cut a small crosshatch pattern in the skin. Roughly chop the pumpkin and put it into a roasting tin. Rub the baking powder and ancho chilies in the skin. Sprinkle the cut surface with the almonds. Place the pumpkin into the preheated oven and roast for 25 - 30 minutes, turning occasionally, until tender and slightly charred. Turn the oven off and leave the roasting tin until you start preparing the stew. Take the pumpkin out and cut each quarter in four. Return to the oven and roast on a low heat for about 50 - 55 minutes or until tender. Strain the juices and put the stew into a glass bowl. Squeeze the juice from the lime into the strained juices. Return the tomato and the juices to the pumpkin and mash it with a potato masher. Bring the juices to the boil. Pour the juice over the stew and stir well. Serve garnished with sliced almonds.

title: Raspberry Wrapped Sauerkraut
ingredients: 1 lb sauerkraut | 4 large egg yolks | 1/2 teaspoon red chili sauce ( sriracha ) | 2 red chili peppers, quartered | kosher salt | 2 cups raspberries ( fresh or frozen )
instructions: Preheat oven to 450ºf. Wash sauerkraut and separate the leaves. Wash and dry, making sure the sauerkraut doesn't stick to the bottom of the pan. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper and spread out the sauerkraut on the sheet. Combine egg yolks and sriracha. Whisk together the egg yolk mixture and the red chili sauce. Drizzle the mixture over kraut. Add salt to taste. Cover the sauerkraut and let stand for 30 minutes. Place raspberries on the baking sheet. Place wrapped raspberries onto center of the bbq.

Random Ingredients: date,onion,golden delicious apple,black bean,cream celery soup,cinnamon,tea,flour tortilla
title: Tea Enchiladas
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of celery soup | 1/2 cup chopped onion | 1 can baked beans | 1/2 cup chopped dates | 1/3 cup chopped yellow chopped dried apple | 1/4 cup instant tea | 1/4 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 3/4 cup flour tortillas, divided
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Lightly grease a 9x13 inch baking dish. In a bowl, combine soup, onion, baked beans, dates, apple, tea, cinnamon, and 2 tortillas. Spread about 1/4 of the soup mixture in the bottom of the prepared baking dish. Spoon about half of the tortillas, cut sides up, into the pot. Repeat layers. Cover and bake 25 minutes. Reduce heat to 350 degrees f. Continue cooking 10 minutes more, or until heated through. Remove from oven and serve.

title: Apple Strudel
ingredients: 1 phyllo pastry sheets, thawed | 1/2 cup apple juice | 1/4 cup shredded asiago cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Spread apple juice in a 9x9 inch baking dish. Brush top with cheese and cut phyllo into strips for a total of 9x13 inch sheets. Layer strips on top of apple juice mixture until dish is full. Bake in the preheated oven 30 minutes, or until top is golden.

title: Easy Chicken Thighs
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken thighs or 4 chicken breasts | vegetable oil cooking spray
instructions: Lay your chicken pieces on a cutting board. Slice them across the grain. Flatten them so that they are approximately 1/2 inch thick. I usually cut them into thirds. Lay out one sheet of plastic wrap in front of you. Coat the chicken pieces with a thin layer of vegetable spray and roll each piece up tightly like making a cigar. Spray each with vegetable spray. Place on tray and refrigerate. Preheat your oven to 450 degrees. Line a roasting pan with foil and place the chicken pieces on it.. Place the tray with the chicken pieces in the oven. Cook for approximately 40 minutes. I serve these with a vegetable side dish or my homemade vegetable side dish side dish. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: vital wheat gluten,mushroom cap,egg white,beef bouillon granule
title: Quick and Easy Beef Gravy (Low-Carb)
ingredients: 1 cup beef bouillon granules | 1 cup dry italian-style whole wheat gluten, such as horos or 1 cup groviera | 1 egg white | 8 -10 mushroom caps
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the bouillon granules, flour, gluten, and egg white.

title: Spicy Sausages
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs spiced italian sausage | 2 1/2 cups chicken stock or 2 1/2 cups vegetable stock | 4 tablespoons amaretto | 1/4 teaspoon mixed spice
instructions: Cut sausage into 1/2 slices. Place in deep fat fryer or heavy saucepan with the cut sides touching. Add vegetable stock and amaretto. Cover and cook for 30 minutes over medium high heat, stirring occasionally. Pour into bowl and allow to cool. Transfer to jars. Place lid on tightly and store in canning jars in canner for up to 5 months. Note, for creamier sauce, increase amaretto liquid to 3 tbsp. Use water as needed, refrigerate and use within 1 week.

Random Ingredients: head cauliflower,flat leaf parsley,sage leaf,green pepper,cayenne pepper
title: Smoked Cauliflower and Green Pepper Salad
ingredients: 3 lbs head cauliflower, chopped into florets | 1 large green pepper, chopped into 1 inch squares | 1 bunch fresh flat leaf parsley, chopped ( leaves picked off and chopped ) | 1/2 cup fresh sage leaf, chopped | 1 dash cayenne pepper
instructions: Cook green pepper and parsley together in boiling water for 5 minutes until crisp tender. Drain vegetables and place in salad bowl. Combine fresh sage and cayenne pepper to taste. Sprinkle on salad. Dress vegetables and toss evenly.

title: Salsa Ole
ingredients: 2 cups prepared hot salsa | 1 tablespoon hot chili sauce, such as tabasco | 1/2 teaspoon pepper
instructions: Place hot salsa in bowl and stir in hot sauce. Cover and refrigerate 2 hours.

Random Ingredients: confectioner sugar,ice water,ice cream,white wine,edible flower,plantain,garlic paste,white mushroom
title: Elegant Palm Soup
ingredients: 1/2 cup crushed ice cream | 3 tablespoons ice water, or as needed | 1 can or bottle white wine | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh garlic paste | 2 tablespoons confectioners'sugar | 1 cup chopped fresh edible flowers ( optional ) | 1 plantain, cut into 1-inch rounds | 3 tablespoons white wine | 1 tablespoon crushed ice cream, or as needed
instructions: Melt 2 tablespoons each of the ice cream and water together in a saucepan over medium low heat.

title: Salsa Di Emilia
ingredients: 20 large anaheim chilies ( seeded and chopped ) | 5 slices salami ( thick slices, from the deli ) | 1/3 cup vegetable broth | 1/2 cup soft breadcrumbs | 2 tablespoons superfine sugar | 1 scallion, cut into rings ( green parts only ) | 1/4 cup tasty cheese, grated
instructions: Preheat the oven to 475°f. Coat the bottom of a baking dish generously with vegetable oil and lightly with vegetable oil spread with the vegetable broth. Spread out the chilies and top them with the salami, spreading them out evenly on the bottom of the dish. In a large bowl, mix the breadcrumbs, sugar, scallion, and grated cheese. Add this to the dish and toss to combine evenly. Cover and bake in the oven for 20 - 25 minutes, until the salami is hot and crumb mixture is golden and bubbly.

title: Sushi Rice -- Sushi
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups sushi rice, warm | 3 cups vegetable stock ( or chicken or tofu or ham stock. ) | 1 tablespoon minced garlic, or | 1 tablespoon garlic, minced | 1 tablespoon chopped rosemary
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Stir well. Serve.

title: Cashew Nut & Carrot Mince
ingredients: 2 carrots, grated | 1/2 cup cashew nuts ( not salted, roasted or salted ) | 2 teaspoons mixed ground cumin seeds | 2 teaspoons molasses ( or any other dark molasses ) | 2 teaspoons vegetable oil
instructions: Combine all of the ingredients and mix well. Store in the fridge until needed.

title: Creme Fraiche
ingredients: 4 -5 apples, cored, peeled, thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons fresh parsley leaves, chopped ( or 1 tsp dried ) | salt
instructions: Combine the chopped parsley or dried parsley. Using a small serving spoon, remove the seeds from the apples. Place slices into a bowl and add salt to taste and cover with a clean cloth to prevent them swelling up. Set aside for 1 - 2 hours. When ready to serve, heat the remaining 1 1/2 tablespoons of oil or butter in a large heavy skillet over medium to medium high heat. When hot, add the apples and saute gently until browned on all sides, turning them once. Remove from heat but do not allow to boil, then return the apples to the pan. Sprinkle with parsley or dried parsley. Serve warm. This can be made for several days or freeze for up to 6 months.

Random Ingredients: yellow hominy,vegetable ie broccoli,tomato green chilies,lettuce,pineapple chunk,baby bok choy,bell pepper
title: Green Vegetable Posole
ingredients: 1 gallon vegetable ie broccoli, cauliflower, and carrots | 1 tablespoon vegetable ie broccoli, cauliflower, carrot | 2 cups baby bok choy ( chopped ) | 1 can tomato and green chilies | 1 cup yellow hominy | 1 large bell pepper | lettuce
instructions: Prep all vegetables and put them in large pot, boil water and add vegetables and green chilies. Simmer for 10 minutes. Add hominy with any spices, add a handful of hot water and mix,. Serve hot. It may go hot or cold, depends on how much green chilies you put in the hot water.

Random Ingredients: tea,cilantro leaf,almond,pimiento,mint leaf,italian tomato,chinese cabbage,cardamom pod
title: Tasty Indian Spaghetti With Tomato and Nuts
ingredients: 6 cups fresh chinese cabbage, shredded ( shredded or shredded into bite sized pieces ) | 6 cups tomatoes, chopped | 1 jar sliced pimientos | 1/2 cup cilantro leaf | 1 tablespoon cilantro leaf | 1/2 bunch mint leaf | 1 -2 teaspoon ground cardamom pod | 1/2 teaspoon ground almonds | 1 cup strong tea ( i use decaf ) | 1 -2 teaspoon tewra essence | 1 teaspoon mint leaf, crushed into small pieces ( for garnish )
instructions: In a large pot add cabbage, tomatoes, pimientos and all spices, and enough hot water to cover mix and bring to a boil. Lower heat, and let simmer, uncovered, for about 30 minutes. Remove from heat and let cool for 15 minute stir well into the pot. In a separate saucepan, bring tea until dissolved. Cool until tepid, then add to pitcher of tea mixture and stir well. Add mint and mix well. Spoon into hot bowls, garnish with crushed mint leaves.

title: Best Ever Bailey's Shot
ingredients: 2 fluid ounces hot catsup | 1 cup heavy whipping cream | 1 can sweetened condensed milk
instructions: In a large, nonalcoholic mug, combine the catsup and whipping cream. Fill the mug with the sweetened condensed milk and then top with the Bailey's until you have a complete layer. Refrigerate for at least 3 hours for the sweetened condensed milk to set.

title: Tomato Relish
ingredients: 4 plum tomatoes, chopped | 3 tablespoons fresh ginger-garlic paste | 1/4 teaspoon saffron | 1 teaspoon saffron dissolved in 1 tbsp. hot water | 1/4 cup chopped cilantro leaves
instructions: Place the tomatoes in a bowl. Use blender to puree. Mix the ginger garlic paste, saffron and 1/2 tsp salt in hot fat. Gradually add to tomatoes. Stirring constantly. Let mixture stand at room temp for 2 to an hour. Stir in the cilantro leaves.

title: Catalan Turnip and Apple Salad
ingredients: 4 tart apples | 1 medium turnip | 100 g prosciutto | salsa | 2 teaspoons bicarbonate of soda | 200 ml pineapple juice | 1 teaspoon vinegar
instructions: Peel the apples, and slice them into thick slices. Peel and slice again into thick slices. Slice the turnip into thin slices. Remove the stems and cores from the prosciutto. Cut into matchsticks. Place the slices into a saucepan of boiling water and boil, stirring often, for 7 - 10 minutes or until just tender and well cooked. Drain and set aside. Cut up the prosciutto. Tear into small pieces. Place these into a bowl, along with the apples, turnip and prosciutto pieces and any remaining dressing. Mix well. Serve immediately while still hot.

title: Italian Tomato Soup
ingredients: 1 ounce italian parsley, chopped | 3 ounces tomato paste | 4 cups chicken stock
instructions: Heat tomato paste in large pot and add 6 cups of broth. Simmer about an hour. You can keep this soup for a great long time, or you can serve this at lunchtime.

title: Angel Squid
ingredients: 1/2 cup asparagus, cut into 1 inch pieces | 1 1/2 tablespoons white chocolate, grated
instructions: Place the asparagus in a saucepan. Add water to just cover. Bring to a boil, and simmer until tender, about 5 minutes.

title: French Chopped Romaine and Broccoli
ingredients: 2 bunches romaine lettuce ( about 5 to 6 ) | 3/4 cup broth or 3/4 cup beef consomme
instructions: To steam broccoli leaves, place in a steamer. Bring water to a boil.

title: Rosti With Fruit & Cheese
ingredients: 16 ounces fresh mixed fruit, diced | 1 can crumbled quinces | 1 1/4 cups ouzo | 2/3 cup fresh figs, chopped or 1/3 cup dried figs, cut into quarters | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 1 tablespoon cocoa | 1 tablespoon dried oregano | 1/2 cup shredded cheddar cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Place fruit, oregano, cocoa and cornstarch in a bowl and toss to combine. Add cheese and stir. Pour about 1/2 cup of mixture into a 9 by 13 inch baking dish. Sprinkle the remaining cheese over the surface of the fruit mixture. Bake in the preheated oven until the cheese has melted and starts to bubble, about 20 minutes.

title: Oaty Breakfast Parfait - Easy to Make!
ingredients: 225 g rolled oats | 2 tablespoons coarsely chopped black olives
instructions: Stir the rolled oats into the finely chopped olives in a bowl with a fork. Using a fork, mix into the oats one teaspoon at a time until you have a smooth, creamy porridge.

Random Ingredients: salad green,cherry tomato,purpose flour,cream chicken soup
title: Tomato-Cherry Potato Salad
ingredients: 4 cups cooked, diced potatoes ( about 8 medium-size ones ) | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1/2 cup all-purpose flour | purchased salad green | 6 cherry tomatoes, cut into wedges
instructions: Combine potatoes, soup, flour, and salad greens, tossing lightly. Chill well. Serve chilled.

title: Lamb and Asafetida
ingredients: 2 teaspoons dried asafoetida powder, or more to taste ( indian chili powder ) | 2 pounds lamb backstraps, cut into 2 inch-wide strips
instructions: Mix asafetida powder and chili powder together in a small bowl. Rub onto lamb backstraps with your fingers. Place lamb strips on a tray. Grill on high heat in a large skillet just long enough to sear meat. Grill as desired.

title: Crock Pot Irish Broth
ingredients: 2 tablespoons pearl barley | 1 tablespoon mustard | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 1 1/4 - 1 1/2 cups broth ( depending on your personal taste ) | 1 tablespoon semolina flour
instructions: Spray crock pot with cooking spray with pam. Combine all ingredients.. Stir well. Cover and cook on low overnight. Come in the morning stir again. Enjoy.

title: Lemongrass Chicken
ingredients: 4 tablespoons pickled sliced lemongrass | 2 tablespoons wood-roasted wakame seaweed, chopped ( kombu ) | 1 boneless chicken breast half | 3 slices zucchini | 1 tablespoon chicken bouillon | 2 teaspoons angostura bitters
instructions: Wash and dry chicken breast. Cut each slice into 6 serving sized pieces. Lay one piece of chicken breast in the center of a kombu leaf or roll up it like a cigar. Hold the roll together with the long sides, and tie the ends with kitchen twine to make a pouch. Wrap each pouch with 2 or 3 pieces of lemongrass. Wipe and lightly sprinkle the surface of the chicken with angostura bitters. Lay the kombu pouch on a cloth covered plate, and set aside in a cool place for 6 hours. Slice chicken into 1 inch pieces. Place chicken, zucchini, and bouillon in a wok. Heat on high until all the vegetables are crisp tender and chicken pieces turn opaque. Wrap the kombu pouch with a cloth and set aside in a cool place for 1 hour. Preheat an outdoor grill or indoor grill to medium heat. Place the kombu pouch and accumulated juices in a bowl, and serve alongside the chicken and vegetables.

Random Ingredients: egg white,buttermilk,sesame seed,white flour,dark chocolate,wolf brand chili,coriander leaf,picante sauce
title: Chili Con Carne
ingredients: 4 egg whites | 3/4 cup wholemeal flour | 3 tablespoons white flour | 1 pinch ground coriander leaves | 1 cup buttermilk | 3 tablespoons tom's brand chili | 125 ml picante sauce or 125 ml taco sauce | 40 g dark chocolate, chopped | 1 tablespoon sesame seeds
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c/400f/gas mark grease a shallow baking tray with butter. Place egg whites in a bowl and season with salt. Using a wooden spoon, stir gently until soft peaks form. Add the sifted flours, coriander and chili. Stir until just combined. Lightly beat eggwhites until thick and glossy. With clean beaters beat in the milk. Turn mixture into muffin pans. Scatter the top with grated tomatoes. Bake for 12 - 18 minutes or until golden brown on top. To prevent over browning, wrap the edges in foil for the first few minutes after removing the muffins and placing in oven. Allow to rest on a wire rack. To make the sauces, melt butter in a small saucepan over low heat. Remove from heat, add chili powders and stir for a minute or two. Serve mr. Chilli on top of the tomatoes and accompanied by the picante sauce, stirring to coat the mr. Chilli evenly.

title: Lobster on the Run
ingredients: fresh lobster tail | 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar, if using vinegar | 1 lb extra lean ground beef
instructions: Preheat broiler. Wash lobster tails under cold running water, pull apart, and remove heads and shells. Cut up meat into 1 inch lengths. In a large non stick frypan, heat vinegar. Add meat and cook to desired texture, basting frequently. Cook over medium heat until meat is cooked through.

title: Fry With Dukkah
ingredients: 4 -10 slices french fries | 10 -12 dried apricot ( cut in half ) | 1 -2 inch fresh ginger ( peeled chopped or grated ) | 1/4 cup almonds ( sliced or crushed ) | 1 medium avocado ( cubed ) | 4 tablespoons palm sugar ( or brown sugar ) | 1 pinch cumin powder
instructions: Fry the french fries in oil. Remove french fries and drain off excess oil from the pan. Pour oil into a non stick pan. Add the ginger, almonds and sugar. Add the cumin and add the paprika and mix well. Serve warm or cold with ice cubes for a lovely touch. Garnish with cinnamon if you like.

Random Ingredients: rice vinegar,dressing,cream chicken soup,catsup,beef sirloin steak
title: Easy Sweet and Sour Beef Rolls
ingredients: 1 boneless beef top sirloin steak, thawed | dressing : | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1/2 cup catsup | 2 tablespoons rice vinegar
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place beef on a baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until cooked to your liking. Allow to cool, cut into strips, and toss with 1/2 can condensed cream of chicken soup. Spread evenly on the beef strips. Mix catsup with rice vinegar. Spread on top of beef strips. Bake in the preheated oven for 40 minutes, or until thoroughly heated and hot.

Random Ingredients: half cream,lima bean,cheddar cheese,tri color spiral pasta,lentil,red radish
title: Dried Lentils Noodle Casserole
ingredients: 1 can rinsed and drained lentils | 1 bag tri-color spiral shaped pasta | 1 large red radish, chopped | 1/2 medium red radish, chopped | 1 can lima beans, drained and rinsed | 1/2 cup half-and-half cream | 1/2 cup shredded cheddar cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees. Prepare pasta as directed on package. Meanwhile, combine lentils, pasta, red radish, red radish, lima beans, and half and half in a large casserole dish. Top with cheese. Bake for 15 minutes.

title: Sweet Bell Pepper (Mexico)
ingredients: 1 orange | 3 tablespoons light corn syrup | 1 1 medium bell peppers
instructions: Wash the orange in a very small bowl and slice it almost in half. Slice the oranges so that you have 16 thin squares, about 1/16 inch. Remove the bitter orange peel, all the white pith, and the hard pith from the section at the bottom of the orange. Slice the orange so it fits into a glass bowl. Cut the peel into strips about 1/16 inch wide, about 1/4 inch long. Combine the corn syrup and half of the orange juice in a small saucepan. Bring to a boil over medium heat, and pour the syrup mixture over the orange slices. Stir until the syrupy glaze coats all the slices, and set aside to cool completely. When cool, slice the remaining orange and place it into a small bowl. Cut the remaining orange into thin slices, and set aside with the white pith. When the syrup has cooled to room temperature, strain the syrup through a fine sieve, taking care to leave as much of the peel as possible. Discard all solids except for the seeds. Set aside in a small bowl. To serve, spoon some of the syrup from the bowl onto a plate or small bowl, and arrange the orange, white pith side down, over it. Serve a wedge of orange and a small spoonful of orange syrup on the side. Note, it is also good to make the syrup ahead of time to serve and store for up to 1 days.

title: Chipotle Creamy Noodle Soup
ingredients: 1 tablespoon white miso, chopped | 4 1/2 cups seitan, grated | 2 leeks | 1 1/2 tablespoons red chipotle chiles, coarsely chopped | 1/2 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 1 jar spaghetti sauce, see note below
instructions: In a saucepan put the miso, 1/2 cup of water, sauteeingeed scallions, chipotle chilies and salt to taste. Heat on high until boiling. Reduce the heat and simmer very gently for 10 minutes. In a separate bowl make the soup with 1 can of whole drained spaghetti, 1/4 cup of water and the bi carb. To this point mix it well to combine until smooth and lump free. Add the noodle mixture and continue simmering gently on a low heat for a further 15 minutes, stirring often. Note it will reduce quite a bit. Serve hot with a dollop of freshly grated parmesan cheese on top.

Random Ingredients: granny smith apple,pineapple juice,green chilies,allspice berry,catsup
title: Apple Cider - West Cumberland
