ingredients: 15 cups pineapple juice | 2 bunches green chilies, deseeded, deseeded, halved lengthways and deseeded | 1 1/2 pounds granny smith apples, unpeeled, cored | 1/3 cup catsup, or more to taste | allspice berries, to taste
instructions: In a large bowl, mix the pineapple juice, green chilies, apples and catsup. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Remove from the refrigerator 30 minutes before serving.

title: Ribmacks  Roasted Red Pepper Relish
ingredients: 1/4 cup sultanas or 1/4 cup dried fruit | 2 tablespoons red pepper flakes
instructions: Toast sultanas and red chili flakes until dark brown. Stir in sultanas and red chilies before removing from heat. Allow relish to cool.

Random Ingredients: parmigiano reggiano cheese,plain yogurt,egg noodle,confectioner sugar,tomato ketchup,simple syrup,kalamata olive,jalapeno chile
title: Chef John's Noodle Salad
ingredients: 2 cups plain yogurt, at room temperature | 1/2 cup confectioners'sugar | 3 tablespoons tomato ketchup | 3 tablespoons simple syrup | 1 jar kalamata olives, drained, pitted, and sliced | 2 jalapeno chiles | 6 eggs noodles, cooked and drained | 3 tablespoons grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Toss all ingredients together in a large bowl. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour to mellow flavors.

title: Steak Steak Served in a Bag
ingredients: 8 steaks | 3 tablespoons raisins | 1/2 cup brandy | 1/2 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 2 tablespoons fish, sauce
instructions: Combine raisins, brandy, red pepper flakes and fish sauce. Cover and marinate steaks in brandy mixture for at least 1 hour. Grill steaks over high heat for 5 - 6 minutes on each side for medium rare or to desired level of doneness and serve with the raisin sauce.

Random Ingredients: red chilies,clear honey,allspice,coriander leaf,mushroom soup mix,white onion,chicken bouillon,green enchilada sauce
title: White Pepper Enchilada Sauce
ingredients: 250 g white onions, chopped | 1 cup red chilies, chopped | 1 packet dry mushroom soup mix | 2 cups canned green enchilada sauce | 375 g chicken bouillon | 2 tablespoons clear honey | 1 teaspoon ground allspice | fresh coriander leaves
instructions: Put all the ingredients in a pan, except coriander leaves, and simmer until onions are translucent and mushroom soup soup is reduced. Add coriander leaves and simmer for a few minutes.

Random Ingredients: kosher salt black pepper,almond extract,nutmeg,apricot jam,white wine vinegar,picante sauce,basil leaf,lamb stock
title: Tunisian Lamb Stock Salad W- Warm Apricot Jam
ingredients: 2 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 1/2 cup apricot jam | 1/2 cup picante sauce | 2 tablespoons finely chopped fresh basil leaves | 2 cups lamb stock | 3/4 teaspoon kosher salt and black pepper, to taste | 1/8 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Combine all the ingredients in a bowl, stirring thoroughly. Seal in the refrigerator to blend flavors. This will keep in the fridge for up to 2 days.

title: Microwave Sweet and Spicy Soused Beef and Cretons
ingredients: 4 -5 lbs beef brisket, trimmed of excess fat | 3 tablespoons chutney | 3 tablespoons finely chopped cremini mushrooms and or 3 tablespoons chestnut mushrooms | 1/3 lb fully cooked ham hock
instructions: Pierce the beef numerous times with a fork. Spoon chutney over meat, coating well. Heat a large uncovered casserole dish on the stovetop.

title: American Halaguels
ingredients: 1 head boston lettuce | 1 bag macaroni
instructions: Place all ingredients into a large pot of boiling water. Reduce heat to low and cover, cook until ready to serve. Cut the bagels into 1 by 9 slices. Toast bagel slices in a bread iron until the brown bread will be crispy and the cheese will melt.

Random Ingredients: chunky peanut butter,cod fillet,plantain,chicken bouillon,marinade,red wine vinegar,brown sugar
title: Plantain Peanut Cod
ingredients: 2 plantains | 4 tablespoons smooth chunky peanut butter | 1/2 cup chicken bouillon | 1 tablespoon brown sugar | 1 teaspoon red wine vinegar | 1/4 cup marinade | 5 ounces cod fillets
instructions: Peel plantains and cut crosswise into 1/2 inch slices in a food processor pulse to yield 2 tablespoons puree.

title: Prunes With Croutons
ingredients: 2 -3 bag pitted prunes | 12 -14 croutons
instructions: Drain prunes, reserving juices, leaving pits and stems intact. Add prunes to a greased oven safe dish. Sprinkle with a little of the reserved juices to coat. Cover with croutons and bake for about 30 minutes or until prunes turn golden. Serves.

title: Japanese Eggplant (Aubergine) Side Item
ingredients: 2 japanese eggplants | carrot ( aubergine )
instructions: Cut off top and middle portion of eggplants from top to bottom. Turn the eggplants upside down on the cut surface and slice into slices about 3/8 inch thick. Brush a non stick spray on the cut surface. Lay slices out on a parchment lined baking sheet. Bake in a preheated oven at 400 degrees until the eggplant is slightly browner, about 10 minutes.

title: Oriental Pasta Salad
ingredients: 4 cups farfalle pasta | 2 mandarin oranges, peeled and segmented | 2 cups unsalted roasted peanuts, chopped | 1 tablespoon wasabi paste
instructions: Drop the noodles into boiling, salted water and cook until just tender, about 7 to 8 minutes. Drain. While the noodles are still hot, toss with the oranges, peanuts, wasabi paste and dressing. Taste and adjust seasoning, if necessary.

title: Easy Low Fat Spiced Sausage-Sausages With Savory Jasmine Rind and Scallions #RSC
ingredients: 1 package manicotti, uncooked | 1 can soymilk | 1 tablespoon sweet spiced hungarian paprika | 2 tablespoons rose water | 2 tablespoons low-fat soymilk or 2 tablespoons other non-fat milk | 3 -4 tablespoons of extra virgin jasmine rice or 3 -4 tablespoons other non-fat milk | 9 ounces lean ground pork | 1 tablespoon of extra virgin olive oil or 1 tablespoon other light flavor oil | 1/8 teaspoon ground cayenne
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 and spray a 10x28 inch pan with cooking spray. In a large bowl, or strainer, rinse the manicotti well, place in a colander and toss in enough soymilk to rinse the cheese off them and let drain for 10 minutes. Remove the manicotti from the colander and set aside. In the saucepan on medium heat, add 1 tbsp olive oil, paprika and 2 tbsp of rose water. Stirring constantly, cook 1 minute. Add 3/4 cup low fat soymilk and stir to blend. Turn heat down to a simmer and add the uncooked manicotti. Cook until the noodles soften and are mostly heated through. Stir frequently for 2 minutes. Remove noodles from heat and place in a large casserole dish. Drizzle 1 tbsp olive oil over the noodles and sprinkle with cayenne. Cover casserole with aluminum foil and bake in preheated oven for 90 minutes. Uncover and fluff with a fork. While the manicotti is baking, make the savory sausage. Brown the sausage in a frying pan on medium heat breaking up it into small, rough pieces. When the sausage is brown, drain fat well. Add a pinch of ground himaly seasoning and stir to mix, cook for another minute. Add the chopped scallions and stir. Remove lid from oven and turn stove off. Wait 10 minutes or so while manicotti/sausages steam. You don't want them to dry out. Stir and stir the meat mixture gently so that the sausage starts to mix with the noodles. Cover with aluminum foil and bake for another 15 minutes. Remove from oven, stir, and let cool slightly bit. Serve with sour cream or a salad.

title: Simmered Shiitake Mushrooms and Pine Nuts
ingredients: 1/2 lb ground lean pork | 4 -6 fresh shiitake mushrooms | picante sauce, to taste | toasted pine nuts ( for garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Preheat a skillet over medium high heat until very hot.. Spray the pan with nonstick spray. Add and brown the ground pork until no longer pink. Add shiitake mushrooms and stir fry about 5 minutes until the shiitakes soften. Remove the shiitakes from the skillet with a slotted spoon and transfer to a bowl. Add picante sauce to pan. Gently combine the pork with the shiitakes and pour over the sauce.

title: Ducumber Rice Salad
ingredients: 3/4 cup dried barley | 1 cup uncooked instant egg noodles | 1 medium cucumber, chopped | 1/2 cup light corn syrup | 1/2 cup salad oil | 3 tablespoons pine nuts, toasted
instructions: Stir the barley in a medium bowl, and set aside. Put the noodles and cucumber in a colander, and rinse, then drain well. Combine the noodles, cucumber, corn syrup, salad oil, and pine nuts in a large bowl.

Random Ingredients: beef,brownie mix,turmeric powder,white fish fillet,amarula cream liqueur,shiitake mushroom,eggplant
title: Fish Mousse
ingredients: 1/2 cup sliced dried shitake mushrooms | 1/2 lb fresh white fish fillet | 2 tablespoons amarula cream liqueur | 2 eggsplants | 8 ounces fresh shiitake mushrooms ( halved ) | 5 teaspoons brownie mix | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder
instructions: Bring a pot of water to a boil. Put 3/4 of the dried shitake mushrooms in a blender or food processor with a small pinch of salt and puree. Set aside. Place the rest of the dried mushrooms in the blender or food processor, along with the fish fillets and amarula. Blend well. Cut a slit in an eggplant at the center of each quarter it will open like an open eggplant. Fill each slit with about two tablespoons of the fish mixture and fold in half toward the center. Then fold into half again toward the top. Seal edges with a little water. Place on a baking tray, sprayed with cooking spray or parchment for about 30 minutes at 425°f. When done, remove from oven, remove papery wrappings from the top. To serve, put a small mound of rice or fried potatoes in the center and pour the amarula cream around it and serve with slices of plantain.

Random Ingredients: lemongrass,ginger root,pimiento,steak,lime zest,apple pie filling,pork loin,cilantro leaf
title: Grilled Beef Satay
ingredients: 1/4 cup pineapple-flavored pie filling | 1 tablespoon fresh ginger root, grated | 2 cloves garlic, minced | 2 tablespoons lemongrass, peeled, split and chopped | 3 teaspoons minced fresh lime zest, divided | 2 pounds boneless pork loin, thinly sliced | 1 cup chopped ripe, cored apples | 1/4 cup freshly chopped fresh cilantro leaves
instructions: Mix pineapple pie filling, ginger, garlic, lemon grass, and 2 teaspoons lime zest in medium bowl. Add onion.

title: Baked Green Chiles (Alcapurrias Con Chiles)
ingredients: 2 pounds boneless beef chuck, trimmed of fat and cut into 1 '' pieces
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place green chiles and meat into a baking dish. Bake in the preheated oven for about 1 hour, or until meat is tender.

title: Filled Quinoa Squares
ingredients: 3/4 cup quinoa | 1/2 cup fat-free plain yogurt | 1/4 cup grated cotija cheese | 1/4 cup part-skim mozzarella cheese, shredded | 1/3 cup fat-free yogurt | 2 tablespoons fat-free oat milk | 2 teaspoons garlic | 2 teaspoons prepared low-fat buttermilk | 1 tablespoon fat free evaporated milk | 1/2 teaspoon garlic, mashed
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Prepare quinoa by first soaking in water for 30 minutes in a bowl, then using your hands, squeeze out the grit. Rinse the quinoa until most water has drained. Place in a large bowl, along with 1/4 cup yogurt, 1/4 cup cheese, mozzarella cheese, and 2 tablespoons buttermilk in a mixing bowl. Mix until all ingredients are incorporated. Form into a rectangle on a parchment paper lined baking sheet. Bake at 350 degrees for 20 minutes, sprinkle with remaining cheese and bake for 10 minutes longer. Turn off oven broiler and spray with cooking spray. Cool quinoa for 5 minutes. Remove quinoa from oven, cool to room temperature, and chill in refrigerator for 15 - 10 minutes. Meanwhile, combine glaze ingredients in a small bowl. To serve, remove the quinoa from the refrigerator, fill with sauce and top with cheese.

Random Ingredients: graham cracker crumb,ketchup,cauliflower floret,flat leaf parsley
title: Baked Cauliflower
ingredients: 2 cups cauliflower florets, blanched | 3 tablespoons ketchup | 1 tablespoon flat leaf parsley or 1 tablespoon cilantro | 2 cups graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Line a large baking sheet with foil. Combine cauliflower, ketchup, parsley and crumbs. Spoon into baking sheet and place in oven. Bake for 45 minutes or until cauliflower is tender, and topping is golden brown.

title: Venezuelan Prawns
ingredients: 200 g cooked peeled unpeeled king prawns ( prawns or langoustines ) | 100 g dark brown sugar | 12 small red and green fresh chilies ( preferably green )
instructions: Place the prawns and sugar in a large skillet, bring to a boil, and simmer until the prawns are just cooked through but the prawns are still pink and the sugar has dissolved. Stir once or twice, and remove from heat. Spoon the prawns into a warm serving dish, cover, and set aside in the refrigerator until ready to serve.

title: Italian Tilapia Filetes
ingredients: 2 lbs tilapia fillets | 1/2 cup pepperoni sausage, sliced | 2 teaspoons fresh horseradish, grated ( may add black pepper ) | 1 tablespoon rose water | 2 teaspoons brandy | 1/2 teaspoon coarse kosher salt | 4 slices prosciutto
instructions: Spray a large skillet with vegetable oil spray. Heat until hot. Sear tilapia fillets on both sides. Remove to baking sheet. In skillet brown garlic for about 2 minutes or till fish is just opaque and slightly crispy. Spoon in 1/2 cup of the brandy mixture. Sprinkle on top of fish and broil tilapia for 1 to 2 minutes per side or until fish is done. Remove from skillet and slice very thin. Lay out prosciutto slices on flat plate and place on top of fish slice. Sprinkle with pepperoni and rose water. Mix the remaining brandy and the crumbs together and sprinkle over fish. Garnish with sprinkling of remaining crumbs if desired. Enjoy.

title: Apple Shrimp (Prawns) Appetizer
ingredients: 2 tablespoons active dry yeast ( or 2 packages active dry yeast ) | 3/4 cup mayonnaise ( hellmans or best foods ) | 1 cup apple ring, diced ( pears-canned, diced ) ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon dried oregano | 1/2 cup romano cheese ( grated or 1/2 cup parmesan cheese if not using a cheese-blend with a fork ) | 1 lb uncooked jumbo shrimp, shelled and deveined
instructions: Dissolve yeast and 3/4 tsp sugar in a bowl of warm water. In a medium bowl, mix the mayonnaise, apple slices, oregano, and cheese until well blended. Add the shrimp and stir to coat. Let stand 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: gingerroot,raspberry,egg yolk,club soda,taco seasoning,parmesan cheese,four cheese ravioli,maple syrup
title: Raspberry Ravioli
ingredients: 1 gallon-size raspberry raspberries, divided | 3 packages four-cheese ravioli | 3 tablespoons maple syrup | 12 ounces club soda | 11 teaspoons taco seasoning | 4 egg yolks, beaten | garlic and gingerroot, grated | parmesan cheese, for sprinkling
instructions: Pour 1 cup of raspberry raspberries in a large bowl.

Random Ingredients: green bell pepper,italian plum tomato,lime wedge,lemon juice zest,five spice powder,sausage meat,almond extract,red chili pepper
title: Sausage Lovers Chili
ingredients: 1 lb ground sausage meat | 1 medium red chili pepper, cored, seeded and minced | 1 medium green bell pepper, seeded and minced | 1 1/2 teaspoons five-spice powder | 1/4 cup almond extract | 2 teaspoons dried lime wedges | 1/2 teaspoon lemon juice, fresh juice and zest of | 1 can italian plum tomatoes, drained of all liquid
instructions: Brown sausage in a large heavy skillet over medium high heat. Drain off fat and add chili and peppers and sauté 10 - 15 minutes, stirring constantly until peppers are tender and flavors are blended. In a medium bowl, combine almond extract, lime juice, lemon juice, and zest. Add to pepper mixture and stir to blend. Add tomatoes and stir to combine. Turn off heat and cover and let stand for 20 minutes. Chill and serve over hot cooked rice. Variation, if using pita chips instead of sausages, use two pita triangles, or two rolls.

title: Quick Applesauce and Rye Crisp Pita Crisps
ingredients: 1/2 cup red enchilada sauce ( your favorite brand ) | 2 1/2 cups pita bread rounds | 1/2 cup frozen rye flour | 1 tablespoon butter
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Stir together enchilada sauce and 1 cup pita crisps in a small bowl. Spoon ¾ cup of the mixture into 1 pita crisp shape in the center of the pita rounds. Top with ¾ cup each of the red and blue enchilada sauce and ¾ cup each of the rye flour. Bring the two pita crisps and the remaining ½ cup of pita crisps to a boil. Bake until crisp and golden, about 5 - 8 minutes. Cut into ¾ inch wedges and serve warm.

Random Ingredients: ear corn,oregano,bay scallop,taco seasoning mix,white sugar
title: Mexican Corn and Scallop With Black Beans
ingredients: 4 ears fresh corn, cleaned and cut away from the cob | 1 lb bay scallops or 1 lb sea scallops | 1 teaspoon dried oregano | 1/2 teaspoon taco seasoning mix | 1 teaspoon white sugar
instructions: In a large saucepan, add the chopped corn and cook over high heat, uncovered, stirring occasionally with a wooden spoon for about 5 minutes, or until the corn is lightly colored.

Random Ingredients: olive oil,beef sirloin,spaghetti sauce,tomato green chilies,chive,streaky bacon
title: South American-Fried Beef With Spaghetti Sauce
ingredients: 4 slices streaky bacon | 2 tablespoons olive oil | 1 1/2 lbs cubed beef sirloin | 3 cans spaghetti sauce ( i use hunt's ) | 1 can diced tomatoes with mild green chilies, undrained | chopped fresh chives ( to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f fry the bacon in a heavy large ovenproof saucepan over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until golden, about 10 minutes. Remove bacon pieces with a slotted spoon and reserve. Add the oil to the pan and cook the beef over medium heat for 5 minutes, stirring. Add the sauce and tomatoes and bring to a slow boil. Transfer the contents of the pan to a 2 1/2 qt slow cooker. Add bacon, if using, and bring to a boil. Cover and cook on lo heat for 7 hours. Sprinkle the reserved bacon pieces over the top and serve.

title: Hreesha (Lebanese Cracked Chicken Dish)
ingredients: 12 bone-in skin-on chicken thighs | 1 whole black peppercorn | 4 slices white bread, cut into chunks
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Rinse chicken thighs, and place into a large bowl with plenty of water. Cover, and refrigerate for 8 hours or overnight. Drain, discard excess water, and discard excess water. Rinse chicken with cool water, and pat dry. Place the peppercorns into a dry frying pan, and use their cracked peppercorns to coat chicken pieces on all sides. Add the bread chunks, and fry, turning with tongs, until lightly toasted. Reserve a portion of bread chunks for garnish, and reserve rest for garnish.

title: Canola Oil & Thyme Oil
ingredients: 1/4 cup canola oil | 8 fresh thyme sprigs
instructions: Wash thyme sprigs in hot water. Wash again, pat dry with paper towels. Heat canola oil in a heavy bottom frying pan over high heat until smoking, about 2 minutes. Immediately place thyme sprigs in hot oil, and let cook, shaking pan frequently, until browned all over, about 10 minutes.

title: Kahlua Whole Wheat Flatbread
ingredients: 3/4 cup white flour | 1/4 cup kahlua | 12 ounces whole wheat pita bread
instructions: Mix flour, kahlua and bread together throughly. Heat oven to 400 degrees. Form dough into a ball. Sprinkle with more kahlua. Place on a parchment lined cookie sheet. Flatten into a circle to size of the cookie sheet. Cook at 400'f for 8 minutes. Cut into wedges and eat enjoy.

Random Ingredients: chili sauce,linguine,salsa,chili powder,simple syrup,fajita seasoning mix
title: Easy Nacho Pasta
ingredients: 1 package linguine | 1 cup bottled salsa ( or other hot ) | 3 tablespoons chili sauce ( such as aji dulce ) | 1 package fajita seasoning mix | 2 teaspoons chili powder | 2 tablespoons simple syrup
instructions: Boil linguini until al dente. Drain and quickly rinse with cool water, keeping in cold water until ready to serve. Meanwhile, in medium bowl, mix salsa and hot sauce. Toss linguine with salsa mixture until coated and refrigerate at least 2 hours or overnight, tossing several times. Mix fajita seasoning with chili powder. Top with aji and optional hot sauce if desired.

title: Porchetta (Irish Pottery Stuffed Potatoes)
ingredients: 2 pounds rutabagas, peeled and cut into chunks | 1 teaspoon oregano leaves | 2 tablespoons ground coriander seed | 3 tablespoons paprika | 2 bunches fresh spinach leaves, washed and chopped | 2 bunches fresh coriander seeds | 2 bottles guinness stout | 1/2 cup flour for rolling
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place rutabagas in a medium bowl and fill with hot water to cover.

Random Ingredients: masa harina flour,cooking rice,watermelon,ziti pasta,guajillo chilies,sesame oil,red capsicum
title: Puerto Rican Sesame Cheese Pasta With Fresh Fruit Sushi (Pasta-Sushi)
ingredients: 4 cups watermelon, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 teaspoon sesame oil | 1 bag mozarrella masa harina flour | 1/2 package ziti pasta or 1/2 package other sushi fettuccine | 5 guajillo chilies, chopped ( about a teaspoonful ) | 1 red capsicum, coarsely chopped | 3/4 cup quick-cooking rice
instructions: To make the sushi, place the mazarrella masa and watermelon cubes in a medium saucepan.

title: Tender Beef Cubes
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef sirloin tip ( trimmed of fat ) | 1 cup bamboo shoot, sliced on the diagonal ( canned ) | 1 tablespoon pure vanilla essence
instructions: Heat a skillet over high heat. Add the drained beef and bamboo slices and sauté for 2 minutes. Stir in the vanilla essence and pour ½ cup of water over the top of the beef. The meat will be very tender and very hard. Once meat has cooked for 2 - 3 minutes, transfer to a bowl and pour remaining liquid over meat. Allow to cool for a few minutes and serve.

title: Scrabet Eggs on Rye
ingredients: 1 package rye bread, cut in 1 inch cubes | 12 eggs | 4 teaspoons coconut extract ( optional )
instructions: Crack the eggs into a medium size bowl. Stir in the coconut extract of your choice. If you like, make sure the dip is of desired consistency. Dip the bread into the egg, coating it well, and then set it in the bowl with the dip. Leave for 10 minutes or longer. Preheat the broiler. Place the eggs on a baking sheet. Place under the broiler until the yolks turn a beautiful light brown. Remove them, leaving the eggs on the baking sheet. Serve when the yolks are slightly hard and the whites are firm.

Random Ingredients: red chili pepper,whipping cream,tarragon,curry powder,chicken leg,red potato,cornstarch,artichoke heart
title: Chicken, Sweet Potato and Curried Artichokes
ingredients: 1/2 lb medium red potatoes, sliced as thinly as possible | 2 lbs peeled roasted chicken legs, cut into bite size pieces | 1 container marinated artichoke hearts | 1 jar chopped crisp red chili peppers or ( 4 ounce ) jar hot red pepper rings, with liquid | 1/4 cup snipped fresh tarragon | 2 tablespoons good quality curry powder | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 2 tablespoons whipping cream
instructions: Cook and stir potatoes in boiling salted water until just tender, about 25 minutes. Drain and transfer to large bowl. Toss remaining ingredients with potatoes. Season with salt and pepper. Cover and refrigerate until well chilled, about at least 3 hours. Stir occasionally when serving.

title: Super Simple Microwave Thai Ramen With Parsley and Rice and Fresh Ramen Noodle Skillet (Nhieu K
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups basmati rice or 1 1/2 cups jasmine rice ( i use the long english grain jasmine rice ) | 12 ounces of fresh ramen noodles ( any flavor, i use the flavor packet already prepared ) | 5 -6 tablespoons fresh flat leaf parsley, chopped
instructions: Put the rice and 3 cups water in a microwavable bowl. Cover with plastic wrap and microwave on high power for 13 minutes. Remove the lid. Stir noodles and return to microwave. Cook for 3 more minutes until heated through. Add parsley and stir, then serve immediately with hot ramen noodles.

title: Salsa Verde
ingredients: 1 vidalia onion | serrano chili ( optional )
instructions: Peel onion, cut into rings and chop into small pieces and fry on low heat until it just begins to color. It won't take long, and when onions are fully done, they will blend together nicely. Once mixture has turned color, add serrano chili, stir. Cover, and simmer for 15 minutes or until flavors blend.

Random Ingredients: lettuce,tomato paste,onion soup mix,green chili pepper
title: Easy Delicious Green Chili Salsa
ingredients: 1 can green chili peppers | 1 packet dry onion soup mix | 1 tablespoon tomato paste | shredded lettuce
instructions: Open red pepper can, but don't drain completely as it adds lots of water to the recipe. Drain excess juice off of the peppers, then cut them up with a knife blade, or use a food processor. It helps the salsa not break apart as you go along. In a large bowl, blend the peppers, onion soup mix, and tomato paste, seasoning to taste. Stir into the salsa the lettuce gets mixed into it, and let it chill for a few hours before serving. Store in the refrigerator once chilled.

title: Kathy Hirdler's Famous Baked Potatoes
ingredients: 6 potatoes, cubed | 2 tablespoons diced onion powder | 1 cup butter, melted | 2 tablespoons cider vinegar
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. In a large bowl, toss potatoes with onion powder. Place butter, vinegar, and onion powder into a saucepan. Bring mixture to a boil, then simmer until the liquid has evaporated and the potatoes are tender. Pour melted butter mixture into the potatoes.

Random Ingredients: pistachio,snow pea,red pepper,pecan,whipping cream,red chili,cashew,tamarind paste
title: Red Pepper and Nuts for Tamarind-Cream
ingredients: 2 tablespoons roasted red chili | 1/2 cup cashews, divided | 1/4 cup pecans, split | 4 1/4 ounces chopped roasted pistachios | 1/4 cup thawed tamarind paste | 8 ounces snow peas, trimmed | 1/2 cup whipping cream | 1/4 cup slivered roasted cashews
instructions: Grind chilies, cashews and pecans together in food processor until coarsely ground. Add tamarind paste and process until smooth. Bring cream to boil in medium saucepan over medium heat. Reduce heat and simmer for 3 - 4 minutes. Add snow peas to heat through and stir constantly. When peas are tender, stir in cream. Continue to stir for several minutes so snow peas stay bright green. Remove from heat.

title: Cheater's Enchilada Sauce
ingredients: 1 can enchilada sauce | 1/4 - 1/2 cup dried parsley flakes | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon kosher salt ( or to taste )
instructions: Heat oven to 350°f. Open enchilada sauce can and put in blender with parsley and cayenne. Blend till smooth and well blended. Add salt, if desired. Pour all into 3/4's disposable baking pan, pour remaining sauce over top. Bake for 15 minutes, stirring after 15 minutes. Enjoy.

title: Smoked Salmon, Pressed Tomatoes and Molasses
ingredients: 400 g smoked salmon | 350 ml milk | 1 large red bell pepper, seeds removed | 4 plum tomatoes | 2 teaspoons tomato paste | 1 teaspoon molasses | 200 g smoked pork
instructions: Wash and remove scales from the smoked salmon and skin. Cut the flesh into slices about 1 cm thick, 1 - 4 cm wide and 4 5cm long, depending on how you like your sandwich. Cut a slit down the middle of each slice, about 2cm deep, to create a cross. Arrange them so that they stick together forming a ring. Heat up the grill to high. Arrange the smoked salmon slices in separate piles together. Wrap the chillies and tomato base around the salmon. Heat the milk in a saucepan over medium high heat for 1 - 2 minutes. Add the pepper and tomato paste. Cook, stirring constantly until the milk thickens and the juices simmer. Add the molasses. Remove from the heat. Meanwhile, arrange the smoked pork on a grill or baking tray and sprinkle on top of the salmon slices. Place under the grill for 6 - 8 minutes, until crusty and glistered. Turn out and place on a serving dish.

title: Quick Slow Cooker Pork Roast
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless leg of lamb | 2 lbs lean boneless pork roast | 12 cups cold cooked wild rice | 1/2 cup soy sauce | 1/2 cup sweet soy sauce
instructions: Trim any visible fat from the outside of the roast and cut into two pieces. Place the pork in a crock pot. Rinse and drain the wild rice well. Add 2 cups of cold cooked wild rice to the crock pot. Toss the pork in the soy sauce to coat. Add the browned pork to the wild rice. Cover and cook on the low heat setting for 8 to 10 hours or the desired temperature until the meat is tender and falling off the bone. Remove the roast to warm plates, remove the pork from the slow cooker and discard any accumulated juices. Skim off any fat remaining in the pan. Pour the remaining juices into a gravy boat or serving platter and serve along with the remaining wild rice. Accompany with a salad and a platter of french fries. Note, if you can't find the quick slow cooker, you can use an 11 1/4 5 lb meatloaf mixture.

title: Escarole in a Parmigiano-Reggiano (Sardo Gratineata)
ingredients: 1 head escarole, cut into four eighths | 1/8 teaspoon baking soda | 1/4 cup freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to boil. Add the escarole and cook until tender, about 15 minutes. Drain and allow to cool to room temperature. When cool enough to handle, pat dry with paper towels. Break the escarole into bite sized pieces and add to the hot water. Add the baking soda and stir to release the flavor. Continue to cook for 2 minutes until all the liquid is absorbed. Stir in the cheese and season to taste with additional salt and pepper.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray,monterey jack cheese,beer,asiago cheese,sunflower oil,mango,roast
title: Aussie Rind Steaks With Mango, Asiago & Smoked Beer
ingredients: 1 medium ripe mango | 5 slices of good smoked roast ( about 5 oz each ) | 2 -3 asiago cheese | 1 slice monterey jack cheese, 1/4 inch thick | vegetable oil cooking spray | 1/2 cup beer, your favorite | 4 tablespoons vegetable oil | 2 tablespoons roasted sunflower oil
instructions: Cut melon sticks from top to bottom so they will stand level while slicing steak diagonally across grain. Arrange meat on a tray and spray meat with oil. Cover with cling film, place in refrigerator for 20 minutes while slicing. Grill as desired and place in a warmed serving bowl and garnish with mango.

title: Chili-Stuffed Chickpeas-Rice
ingredients: 4 ounces uncooked rice ( preferably jasmine ) | 1 can chickpeas ( not drained ) | 1 cup picante sauce | 1/2 cup cheddar cheese, shredded
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Lightly grease a 2 1/2 quart casserole dish with oil. Cook rice according to package directions. Meanwhile, put drained chickpeas into a strainer and rinse. Place drained chickpeas into a saucepan and add picante sauce. Simmer until salsa is reduced by half. Spread rice on a large platter,. Sprinkle with shredded cheese and place stuffed chickpeas on top over the rice. Serve hot or cold. This recipe yields approximately 5 servings.

Random Ingredients: olive,margarine,lime juice,whipping cream,bean,coriander seed,plain nonfat yogurt,lemon juice zest
title: Yogurt-Spiced Bean Salad
ingredients: 1 cup plain nonfat yogurt | 1 1/2 tablespoons lime juice | 1 1/2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice ( not that bottled stuff, but a lemon is better ) | 2 tablespoons chopped coriander seeds ( optional ) | 3 tablespoons light olive oil | 1/4 cup low-fat margarine or 1/4 cup butter | 1 can baked beans ( drained & rinsed well & split in half ) | 1 can solid beans, drained & rinsed ( drained & rinsed well )
instructions: For dressing, combine yogurt, lime juice & zest and stir to combine. In a small sauce pan, heat the coriander seeds over medium high heat until just fragrant. Immediately add the olive oil & stir to combine. Remove from heat and set aside. Place beans in a small bowl & pour in enough yogurt mixture to coat. Place over medium high heat & stir constantly until thickened, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat & set aside. For salad, place margarine in a small pan & set over low heat. When melted, remove from heat & set aside. Assemble salad by placing half the beans on the bottom of a salad bowl & sprinkle on half of the remaining beans. Spread yogurt mixture over the top. Top with remaining half beans & the rest of the yogurt mixture. Garnish with coriander seeds, & serve.

title: Pork Mushrooms
ingredients: 3 slices of very thin salt pork ( i use country-style smoked salt ) | 8 -12 mushrooms, large | 2 -3 drops vanilla | 1 teaspoon peppercorn ( or more, to taste ) | 2 tablespoons flat-leaf italian parsley
instructions: Wash and remove thick stems from mushrooms. Wash out mushroom caps, if any and remove any loose ends. Using a spoon, scrape out the hairy mushroom caps and the soft outer membrane of each mushroom cap. If the mushrooms are thick, you may want to cut the tops off before you slice into them. Using a fine grater or fine blade, coarsely shred the salt pork or use a food processor to finely shred the salt pork. Combine the pork with the remaining ingredients and refrigerate for 2 hours or longer. Arrange the mushrooms, if using, in a casserole dish and bake at 250f for 25 - 30 minutes, or until a deep golden brown crust forms on top. Serve on individual toast points, if desired.

title: Homemade Flour Tortillas
ingredients: 3 cups all-purpose flour | 1 1/2 tablespoons poultry seasoning
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Mix the flour, poultry seasoning, & salt together with a fork. Shape the mixture into a ball. If it's very wet, you may need to add a little water. If it's dry, add more flour. Knead well for 10 minutes. Divide dough into 6 to 8 balls. Place each ball on a lightly floured surface. Roll 1 ball out on a lightly floured surface to a thin circle about 1/8 inch thick. Cut the circle with a 3 inch floured cutter. Place a heaping teaspoon of filling on the center of each dough circle. Gently press the edges of the circle together. Place the heaping teaspoons on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Bake 15 to 20 minutes in the preheated oven. Serve warm.

title: Kielbasa and Rice Burritos
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups long-grain white rice | 2 slices kielbasa | 2 flour tortillas, warmed | 1 package shredded kielbasa
instructions: Preheat an oven to 200 degrees f. Spread the rice a layer into a baking dish. Lay the kielbasa slices over the rice. Drizzle the top with a few drops of cooking spray or water. Cover with foil. Bake for 45 minutes in the preheated oven. Open the foil and bake for 5 minutes more.

title: Tropical Chestnut Pecan Balls
ingredients: 1 lb raw chestnuts | 1/2 cup toasted pecan halves | 2 teaspoons peanut oil or 2 teaspoons canola oil | 1 tablespoon oyster sauce | 1 packet dried fondant | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh mint leaves
instructions: If you have the time, cook the chestnuts in the microwave for 3 minutes, or until softened to your liking, and cool. Remove the hard skin from the chestnuts by slicing a chestnut down the center using a large hole on the back of a knife. Then, using a teaspoon, scrape down all the black cavities and mash all the green to a paste with a fork or pestle. Reserve a tbsp. Of the pecans for garnish. Dip the chestnuts into the oil, and set aside. Heat a non stick frying pan to moderately high heat. Add the peanut/oil mixture and stir fry over moderate heat for 2 - 3 minutes. Add the oyster sauce, and stir fry for another minute, tossing all the while. Add the chestnuts and mint, and toss until the chestnuts are coated with oyster sauce, and warm through. Transfer to a serving bowl or platter. Serve warm.

title: Smoked Tuna and Mushroom Riesling
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups low sodium beef broth | 1/2 cup soymilk | 3 tablespoons dried tawny port | 1 tablespoon dried dill | 1 teaspoon ground turmeric | 1 slice smoked gouda cheese or 1 slice other smoked cheese, cut into small squares | 1 cup romano cheese, grated | 1 can tuna, drained
instructions: Combine the broth, soy milk, port and dill in a nonstick frypan. Heat over low heat until the broth boils, stirring occasionally. Stir in the turmeric. Place the cheese in a shallow bowl. Dip 2 pieces of the tuna into the hot broth and then press into the cheese until coated. Place the tuna on a plate. Top with the riesling, and place under the broiler until the cheese is browned and the tuna has crisped up a little, and is just beginning to set up. Serve hot.

title: Nonna's Vietnamese Onion Salad
ingredients: 1/4 teaspoon onion powder | 1/4 teaspoon nam pla ( fish sauce ) or 1/4 teaspoon fish sauce, to taste | 2 tablespoons chopped chives or 2 tablespoons chopped flat leaf parsley
instructions: Whisk the onion powder and nam pla together. Add chives/parsely and adjust seasoning. Serve at room temperature.

title: Ziti With Figs, Tomatoes and Achiote
ingredients: 1/2 lb ziti pasta | 6 -7 medium ripe plum tomatoes | 6 -10 fresh figs, stemmed and halved | 2 -3 teaspoons achiote paste | 1 cup bulgur
instructions: Bring salted, boiling water to boil. On high heat in dutch oven, cook ziti until al dente. Drain pasta and add to boiling water along with all its contents. Cook until all excess water is gone but still has a bite, about 20 - 25 minutes. Meanwhile, slice off tops of plums and dice into bite size pieces. Squeeze out liquid before adding to ziti. In small bowl, mix 1/2 tsp achiote paste into the reserved juice and set aside. Slice each fig into quarters and slice into wedges. Place in a bowl with 1/2 tsp achiote and add the reserved juice. Drain ziti but do not rinse. Add ziti, olives, figs and tomatoes to skillet with reserved juice from ziti. Cook for 3 - 4 minutes over medium heat, adding reserved achiote paste when they are just beginning to wilt. Garnish with reserved achiote. Serve with extra achiote juice.

title: Chinese Broccoli Rabe and Vegetable Mix
ingredients: 1 large broccoli rabe, preferably stem end trimmed | 1 small tomatoes ketchup | 1/4 lb ground veal | 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro leaves
instructions: Cut rabe, tomato and veggie mix in half and cut each half into thirds. Spray broiler pan with olive oil cooking spray and place on burner. Place a portion of the mix at the bottom of each rabe half. Drizzle ketchup over each rabe half, and sprinkle cilantro over top. Set broiler pan of vegetables in an oven or boiler over boiling water and cook, covered, for 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: seasoning salt,sirloin,pesto sauce,silken tofu,soymilk,hot italian sausage
title: Savory Beef and Sausage Patties
ingredients: 1 lb ground sirloin | 1 lb hot italian sausage | 1 package thick silken tofu | 1 pint soymilk | 1/2 cup pesto sauce | 2 teaspoons seasoning salt
instructions: Mix together the ground beef, sausage and tofu in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: bean sprout,vegetable oil cooking spray,salsa,green onion,cremini mushroom,white bread flour,red wine,kosher salt
title: Mushroom & Wine Fritters
ingredients: 1 bag white bread flour, approximately | vegetable oil cooking spray, for frying | 4 ounces cremini mushrooms, sliced | 1/3 cup red wine | 12 round pitted cremini mushrooms, sliced thin | 2 green onions, sliced | 1 ounce shredded kraft mexican cheese blend or 1 ounce cheddar cheese | kosher salt
instructions: Mix bread flour, mushrooms, wine and green onions in a large bowl. Spray a 5 1/2 or 6 quart electric frying pan with veggie oil, sprinkle pan with 1/2 teaspoon seasoned salt. Set over medium high heat. Drop batter by tablespoonfuls into small batches of 3/4 inch size. Cook fritters until golden on bottom, brown on the adjacent side, about 2 minutes per side. Transfer fritters to a plate and cover with foil to keep warm. In a small saucepan, bring 1 1/2 cups water to a boil with 1 tablespoon salt. Add 2 teaspoons salt and stir in fritters. Reduce heat, cover and simmer 2 minutes or until fritters float. Transfer to a large platter and sprinkle with cheese. Drizzle with salsa.

Random Ingredients: ginger root,sauerkraut,tarragon,cumin powder,coffee,black eyed pea,coconut cream
title: Black Eyed Peas and Sauerkraut Curry
ingredients: 3 ounces sauerkraut, drained and rinsed but not drained | 1 tablespoon finely chopped fresh tarragon | 1/3 cup coconut cream ( or other natural fat-free variety ) | 1/3 cup coconut cream | 1 -2 teaspoon cumin powder | 1/2 teaspoon ground ginger root | 1 -2 dash fresh turkish coffee ( shaker, available from any indian or middle eastern store ) | 1 dash fresh tarragon | black ( green, purple, or other seasonal fruit )
instructions: Combine all ingredients, except coffee and tarragon, in slow cooker. Cover. Cook on low for 6 - 8 hours or until thickened and flavors are well blended. Serve over steamed rice.

title: Vanilla Rice Noodle Filler
ingredients: 100 g rice stick noodles, soaked in very hot water ( optional ) | 1/8 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: Put half the rice stick noodles into a bowl and pour over enough boiling water to cover. Leave for 30 seconds then drain and mix with the vanilla, salt and remaining 1/2 cup water, if using. Pour into a buttered shallow ovenproof dish, and bake in a moderate oven, about 15 minutes, until hot and golden brown. Leave in the oven a few minutes more before attempting to remove it.

Random Ingredients: flour tortilla,white onion,mandarin orange,stock,ice cube,cream mushroom soup,shell pasta,sauerkraut
title: Sauerkraut & Noodle Casserole
ingredients: 12 flour tortillas | 1 packet sauerkraut | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 2 1/2 cups stock | 1 packet small shell pasta, cooked and drained ( your fav. can't remember the name, just use a small package! ) | 1 white onion, chopped | 1 can mandarin oranges, drained | 4 ice cubes
instructions: Prepare pasta, then boil noodles until al dente. Set aside. Drain sauerkraut, reserving one cup of liquid. Brown onion, in reserved juice from one can. Drain noodles and reserve. Combine soup, reserved liquid, sour cream, noodles and saurkraut. Fold in pasta, onion, and oranges. Mix well and place in casserole dish. Cover with ice cubes. Bake at 180c for 30 minutes, serve hot or cold.

title: Nacho Sauce (Homemade Dressing)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons mustard | 1 chili pepper flakes, crushed | 1 can tomato puree | 1 teaspoon coarse sea salt
instructions: Combine all ingredients. This dressing can be saved for another use to use.

Random Ingredients: beef roast,green chili pepper,ladyfinger,cream chicken soup,fennel seed,chili oil,peppercorn
title: Easy Slow Cooker Sour Cream Garlic Chili
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless beef roast | 1 green chili pepper, seeded and chopped | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 2/3 cup sour cream | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon fennel seed | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon chili oil | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon peppercorn
instructions: Place roast, green pepper, soup, sour cream and seasonings in bowl and thoroughly coat roast with seasonings. Spray cooker with nonstick cooking spray, put meat into slow cooker. Use 1/8 to 1/4 inch of oil in pan to cover top completely. Turn cooker to high. Cook on low for 7 hours, or until done. Remove beef from slow cooker.

title: Quick Swedish Lobster
ingredients: 4 live lobsters | 2 cans stewed tomatoes | 1 tablespoon vanilla
instructions: Slice off the top of the lobster shell and take the meat out of the shells. Clean off the claws and set them aside. Pull the claws out of the shells and set all aside. In a small skillet, brown the lobster meat with a little salt. Set them aside. In the same skillet you used to brown the lobster meat, place the tomatoes onto the skillet in small chunks. Scrape the pieces of tomatoes into the skillet with the pork meat and cook for a few minutes. Add the sugar to the meat and cook. Continue cooking until the tomatoes are cooked and thickened. Remove from heat. Place the meat and sauce back into the pan. Mix and heat until the lobster meat is warm. Serve with fresh steamed greens.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice zest,beef sirloin steak,tomato green chile pepper,butter,anise seed,jerk sauce marinade,taco seasoning mix
title: Mexican Steak
ingredients: 1 package taco seasoning mix | 1/2 cup lemon juice | 1 teaspoon minced fresh lemon zest | 2 tablespoons butter | 2 tablespoons canned diced tomatoes and green chile peppers | 1 tablespoon jerk sauce ( or your favorite marinade ) | 2 pounds boneless beef top sirloin steaks, cut diagonally across the grain into 1/2 inch slabs
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a small bowl, mix the taco seasoning mix, lemon juice, lemon zest, butter, tomatoes, jerk sauce and a dash or two of marinade. Spread mixture over both sides of steak and marinate at least 30 minutes. Preheat grill for medium heat. Lightly oil the grate. Place steak on the hot grate.

Random Ingredients: pepper sauce,saffron thread,blueberry,colby cheese,curry paste,asafoetida powder,parsley,italian sausage
title: Blueberry and Italian Sausage Spread
ingredients: 1 cup dried blueberries | 1 bag fresh asafoetida powder | 1 teaspoon hot pepper sauce | 1/2 cup colby cheese, shredded | 1 can italian-style sausage, sliced | 1 tablespoon curry paste | 1/4 teaspoon saffron threads | 2 tablespoons fresh parsley, chopped
instructions: Cover the blueberries with cold water and soak for an hour or so, then drain. Place the the asafoetida and hot pepper sauce in a large bowl. Cut the sausage into 1/2 inch slices and add to the bowl. Heat the remaining sausage in a skillet over medium heat for about 6 - 10 minutes or until cooked through. Stir in the kale and continue to cook 2 - 3 minutes. If the mixture is still loose, you may wish to add more hot pepper sauce. Place the blueberries in a food processor or blender and process until no large chunks of blue remain. This may take a few minutes, but the final texture should be creamy and a nice creamy texture is achieved. Add the cheese, sausage and any remaining water to the saffron and puree. Transfer to a bowl and stir in the saffron mixture and parsley.

Random Ingredients: veal scallopini,green cardamom pod,cumin,yellow bell pepper,prawn,cold water,red bell pepper
title: Aussie Cape Malay Prawns
ingredients: 16 prawns | 2 red bell peppers, finely chopped | 300 g yellow bell peppers, finely chopped | 2 teaspoons ground cumin | 2 green cardamom pods, cracked | cold water or fish stock | 2 teaspoons ground cumin | 5 tablespoons fresh green cardamom pods, cracked in a mortar
instructions: Shell and devein the prawns. Toss in the crushed red bell peppers, yellow bell peppers, cardamom pods and the 2 teaspoons ground cumin. Place in a shallow baking dish and pour over enough cold water or fish stock to cover. Seal and refrigerate for 1 to 3 hours or overnight. Preheat the oven to 200°c. Place in a baking dish and bake for 20 minutes. Spoon the prawns into a serving dish and sprinkle over the cumin. Return the baking dish to the oven and continue to cook for a further 10 to 15 minutes until prawns are just cooked. Serve immediately.

title: Vinaigrette Dressing
ingredients: 1 cup heavy whipping cream | 1/4 cup wine vinegar
instructions: With a hand mixer on medium speed, combine the cream and vinegar until smooth. Refrigerate until ready to use.

Random Ingredients: white wine vinegar,hazelnut,golden raisin,pepper flake,coffee crystal,jasmine rice
title: Moroccan Rice Salad with Coffee Nuts
ingredients: 4 cups cooked jasmine rice ( or white rice ) | 1 cup dark roast ground coffee crystals ( not instant or instant coffee powder ) | 1/2 cup ground nuts if using hazelnuts | 2 teaspoons instant coffee crystals | 2 teaspoons white wine vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon hot pepper flakes
instructions: Combine rice, ground coffee, nuts and 1 teaspoon instant coffee crystals in a large bowl.

title: Cajun Mushrooms With Poblano Chile
ingredients: 5 ounces cremini mushrooms, trimmed and sliced | 1 pinch cayenne | 1/4 teaspoon black pepper | 2 poblano chiles, seeded and sliced into thin strips
instructions: Place a nonstick skillet over medium heat, and add the mushrooms. Cook, stirring often, for about 10 minutes until the mushrooms have released their liquid. Season with cayenne and black pepper. Stir in the poblano peppers. Cover, and cook for about 5 minutes. Serve immediately.

title: Homemade Black Pepper Jelly
ingredients: 3 1/2 fluid ounces tomato paste | 2 tablespoons cracked black peppercorns
instructions: Heat a clean, dry frying pan. When it is hot, but slightly cooler than normal, add the tomato paste. Cook uncovered over low heat for 10 minutes, stirring to prevent any burning. When the water has reduced by approximately half, remove the pan from the heat and place the lid into a cold bath. Leave the pan on the heat. This will facilitate the jelly to thicken and flavor. Pour the warm jelly into a clean jelly bag and put into the refrigerator up to 2 days. After 2 days, remove the bag from the refrigerator and place in a clean, dry jelly jar. Store in the refrigerator for up to 1 month. Store in this warm, dry jelly or cold storage area to keep the jelly a wetter texture.

Random Ingredients: tilapia fillet,black cardamom pod,mace,vital wheat gluten,acorn squash,baby spinach leaf
title: Alu Brine
ingredients: 1/4 cup vital wheat gluten | 2 tablespoons shredded fresh lemon-garlic blend ( or 1 tsp. dehydrated dried ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons whole black cardamom pods ( lightly crushed ) | 2 lbs tilapia fillets ( bone-in or boneless, i prefer boneless & skinless ) | 1 can acorn squash, undrained ( about 2 cups, can use 2 cups whole canned squash ) | 6 8 cups baby spinach leaves or 8 cups fresh kale
instructions: Heat oven to 375 degrees and grease baking sheet. In a medium bowl, stir together vital wheat gluten, lemon garlic blend, black cardamom and crushed peppercorns. Coat tilapia fillets with the spice mixture, and set aside. Place squash in a 9x13 inch baking dish, and arrange over the squash. Bring the water and milk to a boil over high heat in a large dutch oven. Pour 1 cup of the water over the tilapia, and put the lid on dutch oven. Bake in oven for 25 minutes, then remove from oven and set aside. Place the spinach in a blender, and process. Return spinach to dutch oven and bring to simmering, stir in the acorn squash and remaining water. Continue cooking on low power, covered, until spinach has wilted, at least 15 minutes. Serve steaming hot.

Random Ingredients: pretzel,cooking oil,green chili pepper,red curry paste,stew meat,cucumber,tarragon,green bean
title: Sweet & Sour Beef and Vegetable Samosas
ingredients: 2 lbs stew meat, cubed | 12 small pretzels, crushed, | 1/2 cup fresh tarragon, chopped | 1/2 cup cucumber, sliced ( fresh or frozen ) | 1 green chili pepper, chopped | 1/2 cup fresh green beans, sliced ( or frozen ) | 1 tablespoon cooking oil | 2 tablespoons red curry paste | 2 tablespoons prepared green chili peppers ( canned )
instructions: Heat the oil in a large skillet and add curry paste and stir over medium heat until fragrant. Add stew meat, garlic, red chile peppers and red potatoes. Cook until meat is brown and potato is almost tender. Add pretzels, tarragon, cucumber and green beans. Cook until the vegetables are tender. Serve over steamed jasmine rice.

Random Ingredients: dashi stock,sun tomato oil,tomato sauce,coconut extract,chili sauce,chipotle chile,rosemary,eel
title: A Different Restaurant Style Sweet and Sour Eel in Coconut Chipotle
ingredients: 100 -250 g eel ( a type of white stalk ) | 1 teaspoon dried chipotle chile, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon dried rosemary, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon shado beni rice wine or 1 tablespoon karashikari rice cooking wine | 1/2 liter dashi stock | 300 g sweet chili sauce ( ketjap manis or similar brand ) | 1/2 teaspoon unsweetened sun-dried tomato packed in oil, finely chopped | 1/2 teaspoon coconut extract ( optional )
instructions: Place eel on a piece of greaseproof paper or lightly grease a baking sheet with olive oil. Brush or spray eel with olive oil. Add dried chiles, dried rosemary, shado beni rice or karashikari rice cooking wine or shado beni sauce, sun dried tomatoes, coconut extract, chilli sauce. Bake in a moderately hot oven until eel is just cooked, about 40 minutes. Serve warm. Makes enough to serve 2+ to 3 servings, depending on your eel age and type. Sauce,. Shaoji brand sweet and sour sauce.

title: Homemade Zahtar(Liqueur for Dipping foods)
ingredients: 1 cup mustard | 1/2 cup amaretto liqueur | 1/4 cup mustard
instructions: Add all ingredients in a clean jar with a tight fitting lid. Shake or stir well. Let stand one day before using this. Keep in the refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: triple sec,onion flake,shiitake mushroom,cream chicken soup,green cardamom,pumpkin puree,hard egg
title: Sierra Leone Mushroom Soup
ingredients: 32 ounces cream of chicken soup | 12 ounces pumpkin puree ( not pumpkin pie filling ) | 6 ounces dried shiitake mushrooms | 1/2 onion flakes ( optional ) or 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom ( optional ) | 8 hard-boiled eggs, beaten | 3 tablespoons triple sec or 3 tablespoons honey | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried shaoxing wine or 1 1/2 teaspoons powdered rose water
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large saucepan or dutch oven. Bring to a slow boil, reduce to simmer. Cook, stirring frequently, until eggs are set. Ladle into bowls or a soup bowl. Serve hot. Note, the soup can also be made by soaking the shiitaki mushrooms in water for 5 - 10 minutes and then removing them after reconstituting the water.

Random Ingredients: tarragon,heavy whipping cream,sultana,flat leaf parsley,red bean,white pepper,ricotta cheese,soya sauce
title: Sans Rösti With Tarragon & Beans & Cream
ingredients: 1 pint heavy whipping cream | 1 cup sultana | 1 cup ricotta cheese | 1 tablespoon soya sauce | 12 leaves tarragon ( dry ) | salt & white pepper | 1 cup red beans, cooked & drained | 1 tablespoon tarragon ( fresh ) | 2 tablespoons flat leaf parsley ( fresh )
instructions: Place the cream, sultanas, ricotta, soya sauce & fresh herbs in a blender & process to a smooth, thick paste. Season to taste with salt & pepper, then transfer into a shallow dish or individual serving dishes & set aside to cool. Cover & refrigerate for at least an hour, & the longer it sets the better the flavour. To serve, slice the red beans into 1 cm & arrange over the cream. Scatter over the tarragon & sprinkle over the freshly ground black pepper before serving.

title: Beef Loaf
ingredients: 2 lbs ground round | 1 jar beef broth ( can use more, depends on how much meat you like ) | 1/2 teaspoon mustard powder ( try a bit of basil, dijon )
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f. Brown meat in a skillet. Season with mustard powder. Pour in beef broth. Transfer to a 2 qt loaf pan. Mix together. Bake 1 hour. Let rest for about 10 minutes before slicing.

title: Camarones a la Mexicana
ingredients: 24 jumbo shrimp, peeled and deveined | 4 teaspoons lemon pepper | 1 teaspoon white pepper
instructions: Wash shrimp and pat dry. Cut a slit all the way through one side of shrimp. Score the slit with a sharp knife. Squeeze the lemon pepper into the slit. Fill a large, heavy skillet with water. Bring to a boil. Add the shrimp. Return to a boil, and reduce heat to medium. Cook, uncovered, for about 15 minutes. Add shrimp to water, then quickly remove them with a slotted spoon to a platter. Reduce heat slightly, and add lemon pepper to the shrimp liquid. Continue to cook, stirring frequently, for approximately 10 minutes, or until shrimp turn pink and are curled. Add white pepper to liquid. Serve over rice.

title: Garden Vegetables and Pasta
ingredients: 1 bunch broccoli floret | 1 bunch asparagus | 1 teaspoon five-spice powder | 9 sheets lasagna noodles
instructions: Break broccoli into small chunks, washing it well. Slice asparagus into 1 inch chunks, removing stem ends and woody parts too. Heat 1 tspn of oil in saucepan. Brown asparagus, broccoli, 5 spice powder, and remaining 1 tspn of oil. Place 1/8 inch layer of the vegetables over the base of a 9 x 12 metal baking dish. Pour about 3/4 cup of water over the top. Cover and cook over medium low heat for 35 - 40 mins, until vegetables are tender. Place the remaining vegetables over the veggies and bake for 10 - 15 mins or until crisp on the top.

title: Sausage and Reuben Soup
ingredients: 8 ounces pork sausage, cut into 4 x 1/3-inch slices | 6 cups watercress leaves, washed and patted dry | 1 medium carrot, thinly sliced | 1 medium escarole, coarsely chopped | 1 can sauerkraut, drained and rinsed well | 1 lime wedge, cut into 8 wedges | 8 leaves mussels, washed
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of olive oil in a large heavy saucepan on medium high heat. Add the sausages, and fry until the casings are evenly browned, about 12 minutes. Remove from the pan and set aside. When cool enough to handle, slice each sausage into 8 thick slices on a cutting board. Return all the sausages to the saucepan. Add the watercress, carrot and escarole and bring to a boil, scraping the bottom of the pan with a wooden spoon. Lower the heat, partially cover the pan, and simmer until the vegetables are very tender, about 20 minutes. Meanwhile, rinse the sauerkraut under cold running water until the water runs clear. Drain in a sieve and squeeze out as much liquid as possible. Transfer the sauerkraut to a large bowl. Add the sauerkraut including liquid. Squeeze the juice of half a lime wedge over the sauerkraut, then add the sauerkraut and remaining lime. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Cover and refrigerate for at least 4 hours, or overnight. Bring to room temperature after 30 minutes. Discard the lime wedge in the soup and discard the lime juice. To serve, line 6 soup plates with mussels. Ladle in the soup, and pile a mussels atop each plate.

title: Aztec Granita
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa | 2 cups soymilk | 1/2 teaspoon of tequila
instructions: Place all the ingredients in a blender and puree. Enjoy.

title: Rice Stick Salad
ingredients: 6 -8 cups lettuce, washed and trimmed but fresh | 1/4 cup canola oil ( optional ) | 1 package rice stick noodles, cooked and drained
instructions: Place a lettuce leaf on a lettuce leaf. Top with the noodles, then a sprinkling of canola oil and toss thoroughly. Serve immediately. Note, these are very easily made vegetarian using the vegetable oil used in place of canola oil.

title: Caramelized Potatoes With Carrots and Rice
ingredients: 3/4 cup dry red wine | 3/4 cup good quality red rice | 2 1/2 lbs baking potatoes, scrubbed and sliced on mandoline into very thin half moons | 1 1/2 cups white rice, lightly toasted | 2 carrots, peeled, sliced crosswise on mandoline into thin half moons | 8 sprigs fresh rosemary, roughly chopped | coarsely chop rosemary leaves, optional as garnish
instructions: Bring wine and 2 cups water to boil in a medium saucepan. Add 1 tsp salt. Add potatoes & cook uncovered on medium heat just until fork tender, about 10 minutes. Using tongs lift potato dry, reserve wine in a sieve over bowl, reserving 1/2 cup liquid. Cut reserved potato liquid into 1/4 cup pieces and set aside. When potatoes are cool enough to handle, transfer to a cutting board and slice thin on the large side with slicer. Arrange potatoes in a single layer on a plate lined with plastic wrap. When all are sliced, arrange on top of potatoes, overlapping slightly. Drizzle reserved wine in a separate bowl over potatoes. Sprinkle with remaining salt. Place in refrigerator until flavors blend, 2 to 3 hours. Preheat oven to 400°f. Sprinkle rosemary sprigs over top. Set baking sheet in middle of oven. Bake potatoes until well browned and tender, 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Cafe Rio Blend Blue Cheese Spread
ingredients: 8 ounces refrigerated espresso | 16 ounces crumbled blue cheese
instructions: Pour everything through a food processor, setting into a bowl. Add a little micro and 1 tsp of coffee to give it a little kick. Chill the mix for about 3 hours before serving cold with slices of cold espresso.

Random Ingredients: almond,half cream,bread flour,chipotle chile adobo,beef broth
title: The Best Chipotle Sour Cream
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs ground beef ( or use ground pork or beef ) | one can chipotle chiles in adobo, with the liquid | 4 1/2 cups beef broth | 2 cups bread flour | 1 1/2 cups whole milk or 1 1/2 cups half-and-half cream
instructions: Mix everything together and divide between 2 pans. Bake at 350 for 45 - 60 min, stirring after 30 minutes. Serve with sour cream and chopped fresh cilantro. This recipe is a key ingredient, it is so versatile and it can be made the way you like it.

Random Ingredients: pecorino romano cheese,palm sugar,red chili powder,marmite,rice flour,pepperoni,cucumber
title: Cucumber-Pepperoni Balls
ingredients: 2 -3 cucumbers | 150 g good quality salted pepperoni | 1/4 cup palm sugar | 2 tablespoons rice flour | 1/2 teaspoon red chili powder | 1/2 teaspoon powdered marmite ( optional ) | 1/2 cup freshly grated grana padano or 1/2 cup pecorino romano cheese or 1/2 cup pecorino romano cheese, mixed together well
instructions: Wash and chop the cucumbers fine. Place them in a bowl with the walnut and pepperoni. Add all other ingredients and mix together. Divide into balls. Wash hands and knead to make the balls manageable. Flatten slightly. Place on tray and let firm slightly. Repeat until all the balls are made. Dust with white sugar while the tray is dry. Serve with fresh pita bread, or a simple pizza sauce.

title: Sesame Sage Daffee
ingredients: 1 quart chicken broth | 1 cup water | 2 tablespoons fresh sage leaves, chopped | 1 tablespoon toasted sesame seeds, plus more for garnish | 1/8 teaspoon ground mixed spice | 2 teaspoons toasted sesame seeds, plus more for garnish | 1 quart fresh raspberries
instructions: Combine chicken broth, water, sage, sesame seeds, mixed spice and sesame seeds in a large saucepan. Bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer, uncovered, for 20 minutes. Strain broth. Stir in raspberries. Garnish with whole toasted sesame seeds.

title: Chinese Steamed Endive With Coriander and White Pepper
ingredients: 1 teaspoon coriander seed | 3 star anise | 1 teaspoon onion powder | 1 teaspoon instant coffee | 1 teaspoon fresh coriander, chopped | 1 tablespoon roasted peanuts, coarsely chopped | 1 endive, peeled, ends trimmed
instructions: Combine coriander, star anise and onion powder with coffee in a small frying pan and allow to brew for 5 - 10 minutes. Cool to room temperature. Add coriander, peanuts, and mixed endive. Cover and chill for 1 - 2 hours. Remove the endive from the steamer and steam for 5 - 6 minutes until tender.

Random Ingredients: chicken wing,red pepper flake,confectioner sugar,golden syrup,mexican tomato,baking soda
title: Tomato Wings
ingredients: 6 ounces chicken wings, thawed | 1 3/4 cups crushed california-flavored tomatoes, with their juice | 2 tablespoons confectioners'sugar | 1 1/2 teaspoons cornstarch | 1/4 teaspoon baking soda | 1/8 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a medium deep dish, combine the crushed tomatoes, confectioners' sugar, cornstarch, baking soda and red pepper. Mix well until well blended. Place the coated drumsticks on a clean, flat surface. Rinse and dry the chicken on all sides. Dip the coated drumsticks in the tomato onion mixture for a few seconds until coated. Arrange them on a lightly oiled rack to cool slightly. Arrange the coated drumsticks, flat side down, in a baking dish. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes in the preheated oven, until chicken is cooked through and very lightly browned. Remove from oven and cool wings until you can handle them easily.

Random Ingredients: vinegar,amaretto,thyme,self raising flour,potato chip,iceberg lettuce,egg noodle
title: Creamy Potato Chips Salad
ingredients: 1 large potato chip | 2 1/2 cups self-raising flour | 4 eggs, lightly beaten | 15 1/2 fluid ounces amaretto ( almond flavoured liqueur ) | 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme | 1 carton frozen baby cos lettuce, thawed and drained | 1/2 cup flaked iceberg lettuce
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c/fan 160c/gas bash potato chips until the mixture resembles fine breadcrumbs. Set aside. Place flour, eggs, amaretto and thyme in a bowl and stir with your hands until mixture forms a stiff dough that doesn't clump. Turn onto a lightly floured surface and knead until ingredients are well blended, about 5 times. Divide dough into 4 balls. Roll out each ball into a circle about 25cm in diameter. Place each potato chip onto baking paper and prick all over with a fork. Bake for 15 minutes or until lightly browned. Remove, remove paper and biscuits from oven and set aside. Using a slotted spoon, pile cooked biscuits onto 4 plates and top with baby cos lettuce. Drizzle with some of the flaked coconut. Serve warm with cream.

Random Ingredients: spanish onion,nigella seed,balsamic vinegar,pie shell,italian herb seasoning,unsulphured molasses
title: Spicy French Onion Pie
ingredients: 1 teaspoon nigella seeds | 1/2 teaspoon italian herb seasoning | 1 1/2 pounds sweet spanish onions, sliced | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 1 tablespoon unsulphured molasses | 6 unbaked pie shells
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Toast nigella in a dry skillet over medium heat for a few minutes to release excess oil. Combine nigella, italian herb seasoning, and slivered onions in a large bowl. Mix the vinegar and molasses together until dissolved. Pour into a small casserole dish, and cover with plastic wrap. Place over medium low heat, and simmer for 90 minutes to one hour. Remove from heat and allow to cool to room temperature. Line a pie plate with the unbaked pie shells, and place in a preheated oven. Bake in the preheated oven for 30 minutes. Remove from oven, and cool completely. Slice cold pie into 8 slices.

Random Ingredients: dark soy sauce,poultry seasoning,butter,creamy peanut butter,yellow pepper,wheat flour,cointreau liqueur
title: Peppered Peppers on a Baked Dessert Platter
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 cups whole wheat flour | 1/2 teaspoon poultry seasoning | 1 large yellow pepper | 2 tablespoons creamy peanut butter | 2 tablespoons cointreau liqueur | 2 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 2 tablespoons butter, softened
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f. Slice pepper into 12 1/4 thick rounds. Place on large, ungreased jelly roll pan. Cut in half. Drizzle both sides, cut side of each round with 2 teaspoons olive oil or light vegetable shortening. Bake in oven for 15 to 20 minutes, until lightly brown. Remove from oven and place on greased cookie sheet, brown around 15 minutes. Repeat until all peppers are baked and remove from pan. Combine peanut butter, cointreau, soy sauce and butter. Spread mixture over top of peanut butter mixture. Bake in 350 f oven 10 to 15 minutes or until butter is melted and top is lightly browned, stirring every 5 minutes. Cool for 5 to 10 minutes and turn out onto a warmed platter. Spoon onto wax paper. Serve with fresh fruit.

Random Ingredients: green bean,pearl barley,coconut milk,oil black olive,soy sauce,sauce hot
title: Vegetarian Chinese Barley & Green Beans
ingredients: 1 cup pearl barley ( or rice vermicelli ) | 1 cup green beans, snapped on the diagonal and tipped ( or a combination ) | 1 cup soy sauce | 1 1/2 cups coconut milk ( light or coconut milk ) | oil ( black olive or canola oil works to ) | 1 dash hot sauce ( to taste )
instructions: Add the soy sauce and green beans and fry until the green beans start to soften up. Add the rice vermicelli or rice noodles and stir for about 3 minute add coconut milk and hot sauce and stir again until the noodles are tender.

Random Ingredients: dark soy sauce,white pepper,hoisin sauce,broccoli,cold water,chili flake,lemon peel
title: Chinese Vegetables & Broccoli (Geng Yu Bing)
ingredients: 1 lb broccoli, trimmed and cut into 4-inch florets | 1 lemon peel, cut into 4 pieces | 2 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 1 tablespoon hoisin sauce | 1/4 teaspoon white pepper | 1/4 teaspoon hot chili flakes ( optional ) | 1/2 cup cold water
instructions: Place the broccoli into a large saucepan of rapidly boiling water, then cook over low heat, covered, stirring occasionally, until just tender, about 3 minutes. Drain and reserve the cooking water. Rinse the vegetables with cold water until cool enough to handle. Remove and discard the stalk ends, then cut the broccoli in half lengthwise, then cut each half into 8 wedges. Arrange on a serving platter or individual plates, then sprinkle with lemon peel. Combine the remaining ingredients in a small bowl, and set aside. To serve, place a cupful of the vegetables at the table, then spoon the sauce over. Serve immediately.

title: Indian Dessert Sauce
ingredients: mint leaf, to garnish | 3 tablespoons cold water | 1 teaspoon garam masala
instructions: To make the sauce, take about one third of a teaspoon of cold water, stir and put it into a small saucer. When it starts changing colour, pour out over the mint leaves and stir. Add one teaspoon of fresh garam masala and stir.

Random Ingredients: apricot preserve,canola oil,porcini mushroom,wheat bread,artichoke heart,coffee,sea salt,parsnip
title: Vegetable Pizzas
ingredients: 2 tablespoons brewed coffee | 1 teaspoon sea salt | 1 teaspoon canola oil | 1 1/2 lbs parsnips, halved lengthwise, cut into 1/2-inch slices | 1/4 lb dried porcini mushrooms, reconstituted in hot water and drained | 1 jar artichoke hearts, drained and roughly chopped | 1/4 cup apricot preserves | 8 slices whole wheat bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Combine coffee, salt, and oil in a small glass measuring cup. Microwave or heat in microwave on high, covered, 1 minute. Add parsnips to coffee mixture and microwave or stir, covered, 1 minute. Combine mushrooms and artichoke hearts in a medium bowl. Stir into coffee/salt mixture and top each pizza with bread slices. Heat a small, nonstick skillet over high heat until foam subsides. Add pizzas and cook 1 minute or until bottom is browned. Turn and cook until other side is browned. Transfer to paper towels to drain.

Random Ingredients: black bean,green cardamom pod,linguine,swiss cheese,black bean sauce
title: Swiss Cheese, Beans and Linguine
ingredients: 1/2 cup canned black beans, rinsed and drained | 4 frozen cut green cardamom pods | 12 tablespoons black bean sauce ( or more ) | 1 cup grated swiss cheese | 3/4 lb linguine
instructions: In a large bowl, pour enough water to cover the bottom of a pan about 1/2 inch deep. Place black beans and green cardamom pods in bowl and stir to coat the beans. Drain the drained beans, reserving 1/2 cup. Add black bean sauce to the beans and add to the bean mixture along with the 1 cup of swiss cheese. Toss well. Meanwhile, cook pasta according to package directions, just until al dente. Drain well, toss with reserved bean mixture and top with remaining swiss cheese.

Random Ingredients: gingerroot,russet potato,sultana,beef broth,lemon essence,chili powder,white sugar,sake
title: Lemon Ginger Beef Soup
ingredients: 7 russet potatoes | 2 cans condensed beef broth | 3 tablespoons sultanas | 1 tablespoon lemon essence | salt and sugar | chili powder | chopped gingerroot ( optional ) | gingerroot ( optional )
instructions: Wash and peel the potatoes. Wash well and leave whole. Dice 3/4 of them coarsely and set aside. Do the same with the sultanas and lemon essence. Add salt to taste and 1 - 2 cups of the broth. Simmer gently for 1 hour, until the potatoes are tender. While the meat is simmering, place the remaining potatoes, ginger, and any meat juices, along with any vegetables you like, into a blender along with about 1 1/4 cups of the remaining broth. Process til smooth. Add the chili powder, lemon juice and sugar. Process again til thick. Stir in the sifted flour and ginger. Place the bowl with the potato mixture back in the soup or on top of a low heat and stir in a 1/2 cup of water to thin the soup slightly. The potatoes can be eaten immediately, sprinkled with a thin layer of lemon. They will improve in flavor. Ladle the soup into 2 bowls, and top with the extra gingerroot. Serve with lemon slices.

title: Kielbasa in Italian Breadcrumbs
ingredients: 8 ounces kielbasa, cut into 3/4 inch slices | 2 1/2 tablespoons dried italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 1 bag fresh baby spinach
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Arrange sausage on a foil lined baking sheet and bake for 15 to 18 minutes or until lightly browned. Remove from oven and set aside. Drain fat from pan. Lightly spray skillet with oil and return to medium heat. Add bread crumbs and spinach and mix well. Pour mixture over sausage and toss until evenly coated and heated through. Serve hot.

title: Fruit Sizzle With Chive
ingredients: 500 g apples | 200 g dark brown sugar | 1 tablespoon chives | 1 tablespoon marjoram | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1 pinch vegemite
instructions: Peel the apples and cut into four lenghtwise slices and then into thin slivers. Mix together. Heat up the vegetable/vegemite in a non stick pan, and fry the apple slivers for 5 minutes on ea side till they are golden in color. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: pineapple chunk,brown basmati rice,plain yogurt,ladyfinger,vanilla bean,icing sugar
title: Pineapple Rice Pudding With Vanilla Beans and Ladyfingers
ingredients: 1/3 cup plain yogurt | 1 medium vanilla bean, split lengthwise | 1 package ladyfingers ( ladyfingers ) | 1 can pineapple chunks, drained, juice reserved | icing sugar | 8 ounces brown basmati rice, cooked and kept warm
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a large bowl, combine yogurt and vanilla. Place half of the ladyfingers in a greased 9x13 baking dish, overlapping slices to form a circle. Reserve remaining ladyfingers for another use. Spoon half of the yogurt mixture over the ladyfingers, followed by the pineapple chunks. Spoon remaining yogurt mixture over pineapple and sprinkle with icing sugar. Bake in pre heated oven for 20 minutes, or until golden.

title: Cornstarch Dessert With Red Bell Peppers
ingredients: 1/2 cup cornstarch, more as needed | 1 1/2 cups pure maple syrup, divided ( i use organic ) | 1/2 cup red sweet bell pepper, roasted, peeled and chopped | 1/2 cup red bell pepper, roasted, peeled and chopped ( any color ) | 12 slices fresh strawberries ( can sub frozen, thawed ) | 1/4 cup unsalted butter or 1/4 cup unsalted margarine, melted
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f lightly oil 3 - 8 inch round cake pans or line them with parchment paper. In a medium bowl, mix the cornstarch with 1/2 cup of the maple syrup. Add the remaining sauce ingredients and mix well. Add the roasted bell peppers and stir to coat. Pour the mixture into the prepared cake pans, placing the berries in the centre. Dot the top of the cakes with the melted butter. Bake 40 - 45 minutes, or until cooked and golden brown. Note, the syrup can be made in advance and baked the next day, and the strawberries can be served immediately before baking.

title: Chinese Cranberry Gravy
ingredients: 1/2 cup dried cranberries in juice | 2 tablespoons cooking oil | 4 tablespoons oyster sauce | 1 teaspoon fenugreek seeds
instructions: Place all ingredients in crock until well combined. Cover. Cook on high for 2 hours, stirring occasionally. Add water to thin the gravy to desired thickness.

Random Ingredients: yellow pepper,spice,vanilla bean,honey,graham cracker crust,asafoetida powder,corn
title: Peachy Peppers
ingredients: 6 large yellow peppers, seeded, cleaned, seeded and cut into quarters | 1 jar dark sweet corn, drained | 3 tablespoons honey | 1/2 vanilla bean, split, scraped and scraped | freshly grated asafoetida powder | spice | 6 graham cracker crusts
instructions: Line a large baking sheet with foil. Place yellow pepper quarters, cleaned of stems and seeds, in the pan along with the corn, honey, and vanilla bean scrapings. Sprinkle with anise seeds. Bring to a simmer on medium heat, then immediately remove from the heat. Allow to cool. Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Score tops of the graham crackers with a sharp knife, taking care not to tear the crust. Stir together the vanilla bean and spike with a pinch of asafoetida. Spoon peach mixture into the graham crackers. Bake in the preheated oven until the filling is the desired quantity, about 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Bacon and Water Chestnut Salad
ingredients: 1/4 cup water chestnut, chopped ( canned ) | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 1/2 lb bacon, cooked and crumbled ( about 12 slices )
instructions: Mix the dressing ingredients together and chill a few hours or overnight. Add the salad to the crumbled bacon and toss until everything is evenly coated. Serve immediately.

title: Beef, Blueberry and Mint Pasta
ingredients: 500 g farfalle pasta | 400 ml beef stock | 1 ounce thinly sliced bacon | 1/2 cup roughly chopped mint leaf | 1/4 cup roughly chopped blueberries ( optional ) | 1/2 cup torn portabella mushroom ( optional )
instructions: Cook pasta according to pack instructions or package directions. Meanwhile, heat a little oil over a low heat in a large frying pan, add bacon, cover, and cook for 2 - 3 minutes, then stir in beef stock and mint and cook for 2 - 3 minutes, then add pasta and blueberries, if using, and cook for a further 5 minutes or so until heated through, adding fresh mint leaves for garnish if desired. Serve and enjoy.

title: Tortellini Cheese Taco Shells
ingredients: 8 ounces cheese tortellini | 1 tablespoon xanthan gum
instructions: Mix the xanthan gum in a small bowl. Place about 1/4 teaspoon of gum in the bottom of a tortellini block and microwave for 1 minute until very hot. Drain the tortellini, and put them in a bowl. Add the cheese and xanthan gum. Mix throughly, and fill into your tortellini shells.

title: Authentic Thai Coconut Dip for Dipping
ingredients: 1 can coconut cream | 1 tablespoon garlic paste
instructions: Mix together all ingredients in a bowl. Serve with crispy bread sticks.

title: Simple Alfredo Sauce (Aligue de Pina)
ingredients: 1 cup heavy whipping cream ( whipping cream ) | 1 - 1 1/2 cup prepared alfredo sauce
instructions: In a medium saucepan over medium heat whip cream until thick. Stir in 1 cup of alfredo sauce. Serve immediately over favorite pasta.

Random Ingredients: tart shell,egg noodle,oregano,russet potato,chili garlic sauce,tomato juice,fettuccine pasta
title: Quick Italian Stuffed Potatoes
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs russet potatoes, peeled | 1 package thin egg noodles | 1 jar chili-garlic sauce | 6 ounces canned peeled tomatoes with juice | 4 ounces dry fettuccine pasta, cut into bite size pieces | 1 tablespoon dried oregano | 1 cup prepared tart shell, such as jiffy
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Cut each potato in half lengthwise. Cut each potato in half again lengthwise. Cut a crosswise slit down 1 side of each potato. Set shells in a shallow glass baking dish. Insert a piece of meat thermo­meter in each potato half so it sits upright in the dish, about 1 tbsp per potato. Drizzle the chili garlic sauce all over the potatoes, and then spoon enough of the liquid in to cover by 1/2. Stir the tomatoes and dry pasta into the pan. Pour pasta mixture over the potatoes. Stir oregano into the liquid in the pan and then pour over the potatoes. Cover with aluminum foil. Bake 45 - 55 minutes. Carefully remove the foil. Cover with aluminum foil after 15 minutes if it starts to brown. Turn heat back up under the baking dish to a low flame and cook for 15 minutes more. Remove the potatoes and place in a serving dish. Stir well and serve.

Random Ingredients: red beet,red chilies,wheat pita bread,chicken broth
title: Skinny Red Beet-Chile Pita Chips
