ingredients: 8 ounces fresh red beets, trimmed, cooked and thinly sliced or 7 ounces canned small red beets, drained and rinsed | 2 tablespoons reduced sodium chicken broth | 1 -2 small red chilies, finely chopped or 1 -2 jalapeno, finely chopped | 4 whole wheat pita bread, split
instructions: Microwave the beets for 3 - 4 minutes, stirring until beginning to soften.. Remove and cool. Microwave broth and chiles in a small microwave safe bowl on high for about 30 seconds, or until hot. Stir chilie mixture into beet mixture, and stir to combine. Cover with plastic wrap and microwave on high for 3 minutes, stirring once or twice. Stir in 1 tablespoon at a time of chips and stir until incorporated.

title: Lomo Yergin
ingredients: 2 lbs sirloin, thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons fresh parsnips, minced | 1 cup fresh cranberries, finely chopped | 1/4 cup pomegranate molasses | 3 tablespoons tomato ketchup | 1 fresh chili pepper, deseeded, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons fresh thai basil, finely chopped
instructions: Mix beef, parsnips and cranberries together and marinate meat in this mixture, refrigerate for at least 1 hour. Mix pomegranate molasses, tomato ketchup, garlic, chile and basil together. When ready to serve, grill or broil meat and vegetables, turning them over. Serve with rice.

title: Lekhali
ingredients: 1 lb leekshimala ( french or italian style leekhimala ) | 1/2 lb raisins
instructions: Peel and chop leekshems crosswise, then fry in 2 tablespoons of oil with raisins in 2 tablespoons of oil heated until they darken and are soft. If it looks like it needs more oil, turn up the heat. Serve with pita bread, or as a side dish.

title: Beef & Shrimp Jerky
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs top round steak, cut into 1/4 inch thick strips | 2 -3 red chilies, minced with seeds | 2 -3 roma tomatoes, coarsely chopped | 1 dozen jumbo shrimp, shelled ( tails left on ) | 1 cup granulated sugar | 1 cup syrup
instructions: Cut steak into 1/8 inch strips. Place strips in medium glass bowl. Add chilies, tomatoes and shrimp, with seasonings. Toss to coat evenly. Cover tightly, set aside to marinate for one hour. Remove shrimp and set aside. Sprinkle shrimp with sugar. Cover. Refrigerate for 24 hours. Uncover and let stand for another 60 - 90 minutes. Sprinkle with remaining sugar. Store in refrigerator.

title: Sweet Chilli Sauce
ingredients: 1 teaspoon cornflour | 1 teaspoon honey
instructions: Blend all ingredients together in a bowl. Serve with meat and vegetables.

title: Barbecue Salmon
ingredients: 2 -4 lbs salmon | 4 celery ribs, chopped | 8 drops tabasco sauce
instructions: Clean the salmon fillets carefully. Cut off any excess bones & cut a fillet out of the center vein. Cut the fish across the grain into about 6 - 8 equal slices. Arrange the slices in 6 to 8 serving bowls. Add the celery & tabasco. Sprinkle with additional tabasco as desired.

Random Ingredients: phyllo dough,pork tenderloin,arborio rice,gingerroot,green lentil,yeast,coconut,poppy seed
title: Thai Rolls
ingredients: 12 phyllo dough | 100 ml shredded coconut ( optional ) | 150 g minced pork tenderloin | 200 g green lentils ( green chili vermicelli ) | 1 teaspoon dried gingerroot | 150 g arborio rice | 2 tablespoons poppy seeds | 15 g gingerroot | 100 g coconut ( optional ) | 50 g fermented arborio rice
instructions: Mix all the ingredients for the filling, chill for 10 minutes add more water if necessary and mix. Cut all the rolls into 8 equal portions.

title: Ceviche Di Con Ong (Pine Bean Spread)
ingredients: 1 can kidney beans, drained | 4 slices prosciutto, chopped | 1 teaspoon italian parsley, finely chopped | 1 dash coconut extract
instructions: In a food processor, combine beans, prosciutto, parsley& coconut extract. Process until mixture forms a coarse paste, stopping to scrape down the sides, about 40 seconds. Transfer to an ice filled large bowl.

title: Lamb and Spinach Tapioca Stew With Le
ingredients: 2 lbs lamb or 2 lbs beef, cut into 1 1/2-inch cubes | 2 cups spinach leaves, chopped fresh | 1/2 cup fresh coriander roots, chopped | 1 cup canned chopped tomato | 1 teaspoon dried rosemary, crushed | 1 teaspoon dried tapioca | 1/2 cup sweet wine | 1/2 lemon ( sliced, optional )
instructions: Simmer meat and vegetables over medium heat, covered 1/2 hour or until meat is tender. Remove meat and stir in broth from pan. If using frozen spinach, thaw it and squeeze out all excess liquid. Stir in remaining ingredients. Bring to a boil, reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, 1 hour 15 minutes.

title: Cuban Chicken
ingredients: 1 can campari tomato sauce or ( 28 ounce ) can campari tomato basil tomato paste | 1 can pineapple juice ( or 2 fresh cans ) | 3 lbs chicken pieces ( i use bone-in, whole-milk thighs ) | 1 cup balsamic vinegar
instructions: Mix tomato sauce and pineapple juice.

Random Ingredients: black olive,ketchup,cake flour,cooking sherry,swiss cheese,mango chutney,italian salad dressing,egg white
title: Italian Mango and Olive Croquettes
ingredients: 1/2 cup ketchup | 1/4 cup italian salad dressing | 2 tablespoons quick-cooking sherry | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh mango chutney | 1 egg white | 2 1/2 cups cake flour | 20 stuffed black olives | 1 cup shredded swiss cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. To make the filling, stir together the ketchup, salad dressing, sherry and mango chutney. Spread over the cut side of each of 24 - 8 inch springform pan muffins. Place 1 springform pan on a baking sheet. Whisk egg white in a large bowl into a stiff paste.

Random Ingredients: tangerine juice,topping,pizza sauce,chicken breast half,dark soy sauce,mexican oregano,tahini
title: Shanghai Chicken
ingredients: 1/4 cup tangerine juice | 1/4 cup chicken breast half, chopped | 2 teaspoons dark soy sauce | 1 teaspoon mexican oregano, crushed | 2 teaspoons tahini | 2 tablespoons pizza sauce | 1/2 cup frozen whipped topping
instructions: Combine the tangerine juice, chicken, soy sauce, oregano and tahini.

title: Crescent Sticks
ingredients: 1/2 cup yellow sweet pepper, minced | 1/2 cup feta cheese, crumbled | 1 jar picante sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Cut in half crosswise. Place dough on floured surface. Kneed and roll out 2 - 3 times or each side. Place on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 400f degrees for 20 minutes or until golden. Cut each dough into 4 wedges. Serve warm or cold.

Random Ingredients: white rice,elbow macaroni,grand marnier,thyme sprig,green capsicum
title: Oven Baked Mac & Cheese
ingredients: 4 5 cups elbow macaroni, cooked and drained | 1/4 cup green capsicum, finely chopped | 4 tablespoons white rice | 2 teaspoons fresh thyme sprigs, chopped | 1/4 cup grand marnier
instructions: Pre heat oven to 200c/400f/gas mark in a large baking dish, combine the macaroni, capsicum, rice, thyme and grand marnier. Pour over any leftover mixture, stirring well to combine. Cover and bake for 30 minutes, or until heated through.

title: The Best Capsicum Recipe
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dried dill, picked over | 1 tablespoon dried thyme, picked over | 1 red capsicum, sliced into thin rounds
instructions: Roast the capsicum over a hot grill or bbq and spread with fresh herbs. Leave to cool, then pack into clean plastic bags. Refrigerate to mellow flavours for at least 1 hour or up to three days.

Random Ingredients: carrot,swiss cheese,peanut,white bean,arborio rice,hazelnut extract,yeast,green cardamom pod
title: Rice, Bean, and Swiss Cheese Bread
ingredients: 1 packet yeast | 1 1/4 cups warm water | 2 cups arborio rice | 1 1/2 teaspoons salt | 3 cloves garlic, chopped | 1/2 cup chopped fresh carrot | 4 extra large green cardamom pods, chopped, plus | 4 large green cardamom pods, seeds crushed | 1/4 cup chopped hazelnuts ( optional ) | 2 1/4 cups shredded swiss cheese
instructions: Dissolve the yeast in 1/4 cup of the warm water, and set aside in a warm place until frothy, about 10 minutes. To the warm water in the bowl, add the rice, salt, garlic, carrots, cardamom pods, and hazelnuts. Stir and set aside until the rice and vegetables are tender, about 30 minutes. Stir in the cheese until blended. Transfer to a lightly oiled 2 1/2 quart casserole on a baking sheet or parchment paper, and place under a preheated broiler. Broil, turning once, until golden and bubbly, about 5 minutes. Makes about 10 servings.

title: Quick & Easy Hummus (Tabbouleh)
ingredients: 1 cup hummus ( homemade or from your favorite store-made ) | 1 cup low-fat coconut milk ( from a carton, not from a container of canned coconut ) | 1/4 cup pine nuts, toasted ( optional )
instructions: Spread hummus on baking sheet in single layer. Top each with remaining ingredients. Bake in middle of 350 for 10 minutes, until heated through. If you like a little kick, sprinkle with toasted pine nuts or dried fruit before serving.

Random Ingredients: double cream,red chili powder,sesame oil,bamboo shoot,meat stock,italian sausage,rigatoni pasta
title: Capellini Bolognese
ingredients: 1 red chili powder | 300 g sweet italian sausage | 2 liters meat stock | 1 tablespoon sesame oil | 120 g bamboo shoots, chopped | 150 g rigatoni pasta | 300 ml double cream
instructions: Heat the sesame oil in a heavy based pan and add the chilli powder. As soon as aromatic, add the sausage. After a few minutes add the stock and simmer for 30 - 50 minutes until the sausage is cooked and brown. Add the bamboo shoots and rigatoni and simmer until pasta is cooked. Drain the pasta and stir through the sauce. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: pork,green chilies,dark raisin,catalina dressing,garam masala powder
title: Shahi Gilawat (Fried Pork Skewers)
ingredients: 3 -4 lbs pork ( i prefer leg or butt ) | 1 1/2 - 2 tablespoons dark raisins | 2 1/4 - 1 1/2 tablespoons hot red chilies ( mild and hot. i use pepitas ) or 2 1/4-1 1/2 tablespoons hot green chili powder ( mild and hot. i use pepitas ) | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala powder | 3 -4 tablespoons catalina dressing
instructions: Cut the meat into 2 inch squares. Combine all ingredients. Thread cubes onto metal skewers. Place on baking sheet and refrigerate overnight to marinate. Turn occasionally. We had about 8 skewers per day. These were served with fresh yogurt and hot sauce.

title: Rhubarb Grilled Beef
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs rump roast | 2 teaspoons prepared mustard | 2 teaspoons pure amaretto | 2 cups fresh rhubarb, cut into 1-inch pieces ( about 5 medium )
instructions: Trim fat from beef. Using poultry fat, pound or otherwise flatten beef slightly. Combine mustard and amaretto, rubbing into grain. Score beef on both sides with a sharp serrated knife. Spread mustard mixture over fat. Spread rhubarb over top of roast and sprinkle tops with reserved mustard mixture. Place on a rack in a baking pan. Cover and bake in a 350°f oven for 1 1/2 hours or until roast is very tender.

title: Tofu and Bean Snack
ingredients: 1/2 package firm tofu | 1 1/2 cups black-eyed peas
instructions: Drain and rinse the black eyed peas. Place the black eyed peas in a bowl and smash with a fork. Cut the tofu block into 1/3 inch slices. Place the tofu block in the bowl with the black eyed peas. Make sure that the tofu block and peas are not touching too much surface. Pour about 1/4 cup water into the bowl or tofu block. Mix, cover and store in the refrigerator if using this method.

title: Chili Sauce
ingredients: 6 canned green chilies, coarsely ground | 1 teaspoon grenadine | 1/2 cup orange juice | 5 cups ice water | 2 tablespoons fresh thyme sprigs
instructions: Mix chilies, grenadine, and orange juice together in a bowl.

title: Hot Veal With Coir Sauce
ingredients: 1 kg veal roll | 1/4 cup cornmeal | 1 cup mustard greens ( spring mixed greens ) | 2 red chili peppers ( minced ) | 1/2 cup cointreau liqueur | 2 tablespoons dry sherry ( optional )
instructions: Slice veal into 5 slices crossways. Place on a lightly oiled rack to drip excess fat. Place the cornmeal in a roasting tin. Wash greens thoroughly and place in roasting tin. Mix the cointreau, sherry and chili pepper. Brush evenly over the rolls. Bake at 450°for one hour 20 minutes or until the veal is well browned and crisp. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: vanilla schnapps,chickpea,london broil beef,nonstick cooking spray,ice water,hash brown,vegetarian chili,edamame
title: Edamame Beef Hash Browns
ingredients: 6 ounces london broil beef, cut into 1/4 inch slices | 1 cup frozen hash browns | 1/2 cup frozen shelled edamame | 1/4 cup frozen vegetarian chili | ice water | 4 tablespoons nonstick cooking spray | 1 tablespoon vanilla schnapps | 1/2 cup frozen nonstick cooking spray
instructions: Spray pan with non stick spray. Add meat, hash browns, edamame, veggie chili, and 4 t ice water. Shake pan until ingredients are distributed evenly. Cover. Microwave uncovered on high until heated through, about 4 minutes. Spray a shallow baking dish with nonstick spray. Add hash browns and bake at 400 for about 10 minutes, until golden and hot and crunchy. For best results, cook the hash browns 5 to 10 minutes in skillet, until crisp and dark brown on the outside and warm on the inside. For low sodium, cook hash browns 10 to 15 minutes at 350 degrees, until golden and hot. Add 1 t extra ice water if needed. Store in refrigerator.

title: Baked Horseradish Lamb Shank
ingredients: 8 lamb shanks | 8 ounces rigatoni pasta | 1 ounce grated horseradish, to taste ( optional ) | 1 pint milk
instructions: Cut the lamb shanks into 2in cubes. Arrange shanks on a baking dish, cover and refrigerate for 6 - 8 hours. Preheat the oven to 200c or 400f. Place the rigatoni, horseradish and milk in a large roasting tin. Place over high heat until boiling. Reduce heat to moderately low and cook, uncovered, for 15 - 20 minutes until the rigatoni is tender and sauce thickened. Preheat the grill too high, and place the lamb on the grill. Cook to your liking, turning to brown all sides. Serve with the remaining horseradish sauce.

title: Perfect No-Yeast Pasta
ingredients: 3/4 cup uncooked rice vinegar | 2/3 cup molasses | 2/3 cup buttermilk or 2/3 cup low-fat milk | 1 cup fine semolina ( not quick rising ) | 1/3 cup rye flour or 1/3 cup barley starch ( not quick rising ) | cooked pasta ( as desired ) ( optional )
instructions: In a small nonstick saucepan, combine vinegar mix and molasses stirring until well blended. Pour into a microwave safe bowl and heat, stirring occasionally, on high for 4 - 5 minutes until hot. Stir. Add buttermilk, stir and cover, set aside to stand for 4 minutes. In a small bowl, combine the semolina and rye flour. Stir into buttermilk mixture, stir well and set aside. In a large skillet, heat until hot but not smoking, add cooked pasta and stir.

title: Oaty Pokey
ingredients: 1 cup quick oats | 1 can sliced green olives | 1 can sliced bamboo shoots, drained | 1 can sliced ripe olives, drained
instructions: Drain and blend rolled oats and olives. Put all ingredients into a large bowl, cover and refrigerate overnight for best results. When ready to use, remove from fridge 30 minutes before serving.

title: Shrimp Dogs from the Farmhouse
ingredients: 8 ounces cream cheese, at room temperture | 1 lb cooked shrimp, shelled | 2 tablespoons chopped coriander seeds | 2 teaspoons catsup | 1 teaspoon tabasco sauce | 2 cups salad greens | meat, to top
instructions: Pre heat oven to 350°f. Combine cream cheese and shrimp in food processor. Season with coriander, catsup, tabasco and salt and pepper. Pulse to combine. Divide the mix into 3 portions. Set one portion aside for later use. Place the other portion for later use. Place salad greens on a tray lined with foil. Place the shrimp mixture on top. Repeat with the remaining shrimp mixture. Bake for approximately 10 to 15 minutes until hot.

title: Pesto Cheesecake Squares
ingredients: 8 ounces crescent, unrolled | 1 cup sour cream or 1 cup reduced-fat sour cream | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup, undiluted | 1/4 cup reduced-fat pesto sauce
instructions: Heat oven to 350 degrees. Sprinkle bottom of a lightly greased 12 inch x 3 inch pan with a thin coating of cooking spray. Roll out 1 c of pastry dough at a time. Line out with a 9 inch circle of parchment paper, making sure there is at least 1 inch of pastry at each side. Set aside. Remove remaining pastry from the pastry sheet. Press out to fit the pan. Line the dough with the crust and trim to fit. Press in the corners. Fold over the short edges and crimp the edges well to seal. In a small bowl combine the sour cream, mushroom soup and pesto.

Random Ingredients: jalapeno chile,lard,plum jam,sausage,self rising flour,bean sprout,green cardamom pod
title: Jamaican Bracken Nachos
ingredients: 12 plum jam rolls | 200 g pork sausages, about 200g | 200 g self-rising flour | 1 can refried beans with herbs and jam | 1 teaspoon green cardamom pod, capsules seeded and crushed | 2 dried jalapeno chiles, finely sliced | 5 tablespoons lard, about
instructions: Place jam rolls in a large, shallow baking dish, turning to coat each layer. Place the sausages in a pan with water, cover and simmer over low heat until the sausages are cooked through, about 15 - 20 minutes. Drain the sausages and set aside in a bowl. Remove the pork from the fat and brown the sausages on a hot griddle or frying pan, about 8 minutes on each side. Remove the sausages from the pan, drain and set aside. In a bowl, sift the flour with the spices and refried beans over the sausages and mix well. Add the sausages, green cardamom pod, and the pricked lemon slices to the dip and coat the nachos with the batter. Melt lard in a frying pan and fry the nachos until puffed up and golden. Serve with salsa.

Random Ingredients: pesto sauce,leek,golden syrup,sesame oil,parma ham,orange zest
title: Parma Ham Skewers
ingredients: 1 leek ( white portion only ) | 1/4 teaspoon sesame oil | 200 g parma ham, roughly chopped | 1 orange, zest of | 3 tablespoons golden syrup | 1/4 cup pesto sauce, from a jar of sunday's worth
instructions: Wash the leek thoroughly and trim the ends. Wash in sieve, shake dry and cut into rings. Put the leek in a bowl and cover with sesame oil and add chopped ham. Stir in zest and the golden syrup. Refrigerate for around 3 hours. Thread onto skewers and brush with pesto during cooking. Serve with freshly chopped parsley or seasonal fresh herbs.

Random Ingredients: caster sugar,chickpea,potato,champagne vinegar,cardamom powder,grain white rice,phyllo pastry
title: Tajine Baildi
ingredients: 5 sheets phyllo pastry | 2 cups cooked chickpeas | 3 potatoes, roughly chopped | 1/2 cup short grain white rice | 2 tablespoons champagne vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom powder | caster sugar
instructions: Place the chickpeas in a saucepan & cover with cold water. Bring to the boil over medium heat then simmer for 10 minutes. Drain through cheesecloth then set aside. Place the rice in a pot & cover with cold water. Bring to the boil over medium heat & then reduce the heat to low & simmer for 10 minutes. Drain through a fine mesh sieve & set aside. Place the chickpeas, potatoes, rice & vinegar in a microwave safe bowl & microwave on high for 5 minutes. Stir to combine & place the mixture aside for 15 minutes. Remove from the microwave & stir in cardamom powder & caster sugar. Preheat a broiler / barbecue or char grill to high heat. Brush 1 sheet of phyllo with egg & brush with egg. Repeat layering & brushing with egg. Spoon half the chickpea mixture into the centre of each sheet, leaving a film of chickpea mixture around the edge. Fold the edges into the centre & then roll up until the pastry comes together.

Random Ingredients: ginger,green king prawn,oregano leaf,lemon juice zest,tabasco sauce,cheddar cheese soup,blueberry
title: Gran's Favorite Prawn Chowder
ingredients: 1 can condensed cheddar cheese soup | 1 cup blueberries or 1 cup strawberry | 6 -8 green king prawns, cooked, shelled, cleaned and chopped | 1/2 teaspoon ground ginger | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 3 dashes tabasco sauce or 3 dashes other hot sauce | 1 grated lemon, juice and zest of
instructions: In large saucepan combine soup, cheese, berries, ginger, oregano and hot sauce. Bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer covered for 5 minutes. Add lemon juice and zest and adjust seasoning to taste. Serve hot.

title: Delicious Chilli and Cheese Appetizer
ingredients: 200 g deli ham, lean & cut into cubes | 3 tablespoons sweet chili sauce | 1 tablespoon herbs, mix | 1 tablespoon spicy blend spices | 1/4 cup sharp cheddar cheese
instructions: Mix ingredients and put to one side. Bake in a covered, small frying pan in moderate oven for 20 minutes. Variation, add onions, celery and tomato, chopped hot pepper or chillies. Cut all ingredients into small slices, serve with a little extra spice. Also, substitute any other vegatable ingredients, such as carrots, celery, mushrooms and mushrooms for the ham.

title: Baked Papaya Bean Bread
ingredients: 2 tablespoons ghee | 4 cups pinto beans | 1 cup papaya, peeled, seeded, finely diced | 1/2 cup canned cherry tomatoes, finely chopped | 1/4 cup raw unpeeled avocado, cut into thin slices | 1/2 cup self rising flour
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350f and line a 2 1/2 cup or 6 cup loaf tin with parchment paper, allowing the excess paper to overhang. In a saucepan cook the pinto beans over medium heat until soft. Remove the pan from the heat and then add the papaya, cherry tomatoes and avocado and mash together. Sift the flour over the papaya mixture just enough to moisten it, then gently fold it in to the mashed bean mixture. Spoon the mixture into the prepared loaf tin and bake in the preheated oven for 30 minutes, or until it is a golden brown.

title: Easy Chickpea Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup chickpeas, soaked | 1/2 cup white wine vinegar
instructions: Cook chickpeas in boiling water for 8 minutes, or until tender. Drain, and rinse under cold water. Dry well. Stir together chickpea and white wine vinegar in a serving bowl. Serve immediately.

title: Escarole and Eggs for One
ingredients: 3 cups escarole, shredded | 1 tablespoon sambal oelek | 1 tablespoon queso fresco, grated | 1 tablespoon egg substitute | 1 dash chili powder
instructions: Mix all ingredients together until well mixed.

title: Tropical Fruit Salad
ingredients: 1 cup fresh spinach leaves | 1 cup miniature marshmallows | 1/2 cup raisins | 1/2 cup bamboo shoot, sliced | 1/2 cup fresh mango powder | 1 tablespoon golden syrup
instructions: Stir together spinach, marshmallows, raisins, and sliced bamboo shoot. Stir in mango powder. Stir in golden syrup.

title: Lobster Cakes (Lobster) Filling
ingredients: 200 g chopped lobster tail | 1 tablespoon cooking oil | 2 tablespoons quick-cooking oil | 1 teaspoon baking powder
instructions: Saute lobster in hot cooking oil in a medium sized skillet. Remove and drain grease and reserve. Remove lobster shell from liquid and shred. Mix with reserved lobster liquid. In a bowl, mix together baking powder with the oil. Add baking soda to lobster liquid, stir. Heat a pan to medium high heat, add 2 tbspn of cooking oil for each shell and pour a spag. Of hot cooking oil on top. Place shell and fry in small batches. Serve.

title: Avocado Roasted Chicken Fajitas
ingredients: 4 cups halved cauliflower | 1 whole rotisserie roasted chicken, meat stripped | 1 teaspoon creole seasoning | 2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder | 2 avocados - peeled, pitted and sliced | 12 cherry rolls, cut in half | 2 cans sliced cremini mushrooms, drained
instructions: Place the cauliflower and rotisserie chicken in a roasting pan large enough to hold them snugly on your hands. Sprinkle the creole seasoning evenly over the chicken. Roast, uncovered, in a preheated 375 degrees f oven 45 minutes or until the cauliflower is tender and no longer crunchy. Place a wire rack over a baking sheet. Brush the roasting pan with oil. Place roasting pan in oven, then reduce temperature to 300 degrees f and continue to roast until chicken is cooked through, about 30 minutes more. Remove chicken from oven and allow to rest for 10 minutes. Meanwhile, toss the avocados with the cherry rolls, mushrooms and 1/2 the roasted cauliflower mixture in a bowl. Arrange the fajitas on a platter and serve.

title: Apple Chip Wontons
ingredients: 1 box wonton wrappers | 2 cups apple butter ( softened ) | 2 -4 tablespoons honey | 1 teaspoon sugar | adobo sauce
instructions: In a mixing bowl, mix all ingredients. Spread about 2 tablespoons of the mixture onto a wonton wrapper, and use 2 teaspoons of butter towards the outside of the wonton wrapper. Wrap the wrapper around the filling and fold into the remaining wrappers. Deep fry approximately 15 inutes or until golden brown.

title: Salsa for Canning
ingredients: 1 jar fresno chile peppers | 1/2 yellow onion, diced | 1 can cider or ( 12 ounce ) can water, chilled
instructions: Dice the fresno chiles and the onion. Bring beer bottles and cups to a boil in a covered pot. Meanwhile, add the chopped pepper and onion to a bowl, and toss.

title: Vaca Burnt Cream Rice Pudding (Rice Cooker)
ingredients: 1 liter milk ( i use reduced fat ) | 1 tablespoon vanilla sugar | 1 package cheese ravioli ( you can use more or less depending on how creamy or savory you want them ) | 2 tablespoons rice flour ( or corn starch )
instructions: Put all the ingredients in the rice cooker. Put the rice cooker on the lowest setting, stir, and cook until the rice cooker stops stirring. Don't worry if the rice becomes brownish in color at about 10 minutes, it will be completely cooked and the mixture will be creamy again, no dry spots. Leave the rice cooker on off the heat for another 10 minutes,. Serve plain, or with a little cheese, chopped pistachios, or fresh berries. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: glace cherry,tortilla,vanilla pudding,sesame seed,cabbage leaf,ciabatta,cooking oil,white flour
title: Tortilla and Jelly Rolls With Sesame Seeds
ingredients: 12 slices ciabatta or 12 slices bread | cooking oil | 8 large cabbage leaves | 1/2 cup sesame seeds, toasted | 500 g short-grain vanilla pudding ( or equivalent flavour ) | 2 tablespoons cooking oil | 300 g short-grain vanilla pudding ( or equivalent flavour ) | 100 g glace cherries, chopped | 1/2 cup clear honey
instructions: Pre heat your oven to 180c/140c fan forced. Cut each sandwich into 8 equal pieces. Put two pieces of bread on your work counter and place each piece of bread on top. Sprinkle 1 tablespoon of sesame seeds on the bread and roll the bread into a sausage shape or into a cylinder shape. Spray the roll lightly with oil. Prick the rolls with the tines of a fork and fry in a hot frying pan for 2 - 3 minutes each side until golden and firm and crispy. Allow to cool slightly. Cut each roll into 8 individual rolls. Keep the oven relatively low, cover with a tin foil or oven proof dish, and put the rolls on the tray and bake for 15 minutes until the rolls are golden and springy to the touch to the touch. While the rolls are baking, prepare your roasting and the jelly sauce. Place the 3 tablespoons of oil in a pan, add the 2pkt vanilla pudding and warm on low heat stirring often until a pudding is dissolved. Place the roasting tray on another shelf in the oven for 5 - 10 minutes until almost dry. Remove the tray immediately and spread your jelly on each piece of the roll. Place a few cherry halves along the top of the jelly and top with a roll of bread. Put the sheet on a stand on top of a double thickness of oven proof dish. Spread the jelly onto all of the bread and bake for 2 minutes. Allow to cool slightly, but while still warm, drizzle the roll with the remaining sesame seeds and the chopped sesame seeds. Allow to cool slightly then serve.

Random Ingredients: marinara sauce,tamarind pulp,green cabbage,mirin,cornstarch,pork roast,spinach leaf
title: Japanese Shoyu Pork
ingredients: 4 teaspoons pure tamarind pulp, strained | 2 lbs boneless pork roast | 1/2 cup mirin or 1/2 cup sweet wine | 2 cups marinara sauce | 2 1/2 cups green cabbage, sliced | 2 teaspoons cornstarch | 2 cups fresh spinach leaves, torn
instructions: Soak the tamarind pulp in enough cold water to cover for 10 minutes. Remove from the water and pat dry with paper towels. Cut the pork into 4 inch pieces and rub with the tamarind water. Let soak a minimum of 4 hours or overnight. Heat a large dutch oven or wok over medium heat until smoking. Add the pork. Stir fry with a wooden spoon about 1 minute. Reduce heat to medium. Add the mirin and let it boil about 1 minute. Stir in the marinara sauce, cabbage, and cornstarch. Cover and cook for 15 to 20 minutes or until cabbage is tender. Lift lid, increase heat to high, and continue cooking, stirring, until pork is slightly browned. Stir in the fresh spinach, lower heat to very low. Cover and simmer for 15 minutes more.

title: Red Chili Bread
ingredients: 2 cups bread flour | 1 tablespoon sweet red chili sauce
instructions: Cut the mixture into four equal sized pieces. Take two of them and roll it into an �x” on the outside. Place it on a parchment covered baking tray. Repeat with the rest of it. Allow you to bake the bread in a preheated oven at 200c/400f/gas 6 for 40 minutes.

title: Cardamom Cranberry Nuts
ingredients: 1 jar cranberry | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom powder
instructions: Combine all the ingredients in a medium sized sauce pan and heat until heated, but do not bring to a boil. Boil for 1/2 an hour or until the consistency of your Nuts is reduced and the flavors have absorbed the liquids. Allow for 3 - 5 minutes to chill before serving.

Random Ingredients: asparagus spear,french bread,lamb shoulder,baby spinach,tarragon,granny smith apple
title: Lamb Shoulder Sandwich With Asparagus
ingredients: 1 bunch asparagus spear, tough ends, ends trimmed | 1/2 lb lamb shoulder, trimmed and cut into narrow strips | 1 granny smith apple, peeled, cored and sliced | 10 ounces mixed baby spinach, torn | 3 tablespoons fresh tarragon, chopped | 12 slices toasted french bread, toasted
instructions: Preheat grill to medium. Lightly oil grill grate. Combine asparagus and remaining ingredients in bowl. Heat 1/4 inch salt in heavy large skillet over medium high heat. Working in batches, add asparagus and cook, turning, until browned and tender, about 2 minutes per side. Transfer to baking sheet. Grill until just beginning to flake, stirring once, about 2 minutes per side. Remove asparagus from grill.

title: Spicy Pork Mince and Apple Rice Bowls
ingredients: 4 1/2 lbs pork mince | 8 tablespoons country style spareribs, coarsely chopped | 8 tablespoons sweet chili pepper flakes | 4 large firm apples, chopped | 1 1/4 cups long grain rice | 4 large soft loaves bread, such as ciabatta | 1 can crushed pineapple, drained
instructions: Combine pork mince, spareribs, chili flakes, apples, rice and pineapple in large bowl. Combine thoroughly. Shape mixture into 6 even sized meatballs. Refrigerate several hours. Drain meatballs, reserving liquid, from bowl. Place meatballs in a large baking dish. Spoon reserved liquid over, turning to coat all sides and meat evenly. Cover loosely. Bake in a 275' oven for 1 1/2 hours. Add meatballs to soup bowls.

title: Spicy N'awlins
ingredients: 1 cup tahini | 1 red chili pepper
instructions: In a large bowl, blend tahini and chili pepper together. Strain sauce into a jar with a lid. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate at least 2 hours before serving. Serve hot or cold.

title: Black and White Chocolate Frijoles
ingredients: 100 g dark chocolate, chopped | 200 g canned black beans, drained
instructions: Heat chocolate and black beans in a small pan together for 5 minutes. Cool. Melt chocolate over a bowl of hot water for 1 minute. Quickly pour, leaving about 4mm of water in the bowl. Pour the chocolate into a piping bag with the back of a knife, tip in the piping bag, and snip an opening from the corner into the chocolate mixture. Continue to pour black bean mixture into the bowl until the mixture is filled. Serve at once.

title: Louisiana Potato Chips
ingredients: 1 package potato chips | louisiana hot sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Place potato chips in a large bowl. Pour hot sauce over chips, and coat evenly with sauce. Bake in preheated oven until chips are golden brown, 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Spinach Rolls - Italian Beef Rolls
ingredients: 1 bag baby spinach | 1/4 cup kraft | 1/4 cup romano cheese, shredded | 2 -3 tablespoons light ketchup | 1/2 yellow sweet pepper, diced | 1/2 cup green pepper, chopped | 1 lb lean rump steak, trimmed of fat | 8 -10 fresh grape leaves
instructions: Wash and trim spinach and cook in 4 quarts of water for 10 - 12 minutes. Combine greens, 1/4 cup Kraft, 1/4 cup romano, ketchup, red and green pepper. Slice beef across grain of thin strips. Sprinkle 1/4 c cheese onto each grape leaf and cover with another grape leaf. Seal roll and let set in refrigerator for at least 30 minutes before serving. These rollers will serve up to 6 for appetizers, 15 - 18 for rolls.

title: Italian Chocolate Chips
ingredients: 1/2 cup dry chocolate chips | 1/2 cup chopped green bell pepper | 1/2 cup chopped onion
instructions: In a glass bowl, stir together the chocolate chips, green bell pepper and onion. Chill until serving.

Random Ingredients: tuna olive oil,heavy cream,chicken bouillon granule,black olive,sirloin
title: Tuna, Black Olive & Chicken Cacciatore Sirloin Steaks

instructions: Cut lengthwise slit through each steak about 1/2 inch deep. Open each steak and spoon some of the juice onto each steak. Arrange beef slices in a ziploc bag. Combine olive, tuna and bouillon granules in a frying pan or skillet. Over medium heat, melt oil in frying pan, saute garlic for 1 minute. Add cream, simmer, stirring about 5 minutes until mixture is thickened. Pour over meat and serve.

Random Ingredients: tomato ketchup,yeast,ghee,stew meat,celery rib,chicken bouillon powder
title: Aloo Gosht
ingredients: 2 kg stew meat ( i have used venison but any beef-beef/lamb will work ) | 1 tablespoon chicken bouillon powder | 2 tablespoons ghee or 2 tablespoons butter ( for frying ) | 1 tablespoon tomato ketchup ( i use heinz ketchup ) | 1 celery rib ( chopped ) | 2 teaspoons yeast
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water and set aside to proof. Cut meat into cubes. Pour ghee or butter into a large pot & place over medium high heat till melted. Add meat pieces and saute. Add more butter if needed and brown meat. Add tomato ketchup. Mix chicken bouillon in a little water and add to pot. Add celery. Add salt to taste. Cover and leave to cook till meat starts to rise, about 30 minutes. Serve & enjoy.

title: Danish Steak  (Skewered)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless round steak | 1 fresh dill ( optional )
instructions: Pound meat with hand a few times or to tenderize. Sprinkle with dill just before serving. Sprinkle with a little paprika if desired. Broil quickly until browned.

title: Kangaroo & Cheese Tortellini Soup
ingredients: 1 can cream of chicken soup | 2 tablespoons ouzo | salt and pepper | 1 dash mixed spice ( add more to taste ) | 20 -24 ounces kangaroo meat, in bite-size pieces | 1 package cheese tortellini ( can omit this if desired ) | 1 head romaine lettuce, diced | 15 -20 wonton wrappers
instructions: Cook the pasta as per package directions, drain and cool slightly. Combine soup, ouzo, salt, pepper and spice. When soup is cold, stir in meat and tortellini. Serve piping hot with garnishments on the side.

instructions: Combine the salad ingredients. Combine the taco seasoning into the salad. Allow the jalapeno peppers to soften before serving.

title: Red Cabbage Slaw

instructions: Cut about 5 to 6 large slabs of cabbage. Place cabbage in a large salad bowl.

title: Pine Nut Dipping Sauce

instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Enjoy.

title: Spanish Pepper-And-Chile Meatloaf
ingredients: 1/2 lb pork fat or 1/2 lb ground beef | 1/2 lb yellow sweet pepper | 4 large egg yolks | 3 tablespoons sherry wine or 3 tablespoons sweet rice wine | 2 teaspoons garlic salt
instructions: Heat oven to 375°f. In food processor, process all ingredients except beef until finely minced. Add beef and process until mixture is smooth, about 5 seconds. Shape mixture into loaf. Place loaf in lightly greased 13x9 inch baking dish. Press beef mixture lightly over top of loaf with thumb. Bake loaf until thermometer inserted into center registers 160°f, about 50 - 60 minutes. Remove loaf from oven and let it stand 5 minutes before slicing with knife.

ingredients: 1 pie shell, baked | 2 tablespoons honey | 1/2 ounce chili sauce | 2 ounces red wine vinegar | 1/2 ounce italian seasoning | powdered sugar | salt and pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c. Mix ingredients together in a bowl. Pour mixture into pie shell. Cover with top crust. Bake for 20 minutes or until golden brown.

ingredients: 1 package uncooked shell pasta, any shape, cooked and drained | 2 tablespoons margarine, softened | 1/4 cup dry marsala wine | 1 can condensed cream of potato soup | 1/4 teaspoon ground turmeric | 1/8 teaspoon black mustard seeds | 1/2 cup frozen whipped topping, thawed | 2 ounces dark chocolate, melted ( optional )
instructions: Cook macaroni in boiling salted water according to package directions.

title: Moroccan Fish
ingredients: 2 lbs sea bass or 2 lbs salmon | 2 1/2 cups fresh mint leaves | 4 teaspoons sweet spanish paprika
instructions: Scale the fish and cut the fillet to the size you would like. Remove and discard the scales. If using salted fish, leave them on. While fish is cooking, put the mint leaves and sprigs in a small bowl. Sprinkle the sprigs and mint well with the paprika. Drizzle over the top of the fish fillets. Serve immediately.

title: Easy Rice Vinegar Pie
ingredients: 2 cups rice vinegar | 1 cup sweet chili ( mild hot or hot to taste ) | 1 teaspoon unbleached plain rice vinegar | 0.5 can pie shells
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Measure first 4 ingredients in a pie plate. Dot with a pastry brush or a glaze of your choice. Bake uncovered for 25 minutes. Pour vinegar mixture over top and bake for 5 to 10 minutes more.

title: Rigatoni With spring onions

instructions: Break the spinach from spines, wash, then drain. Cook until water has evaporated, stir in onions and cook until soft. Pour over pasta and cook another 5 mins or until creamy. Nice with a nice green salad and some freshly grated parmesan sprinkled over the top.

title: Mexican Pork Loin
ingredients: 1 poblano pepper | 1 tablespoon prepared mustard | 4 tablespoons lemon juice and zest | 1 teaspoon ground black pepper | 2 lbs boneless pork loin
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Roast poblano on rack of broiler pan until lightly browned. Place in foil pie plate. Roast poblano in oven until easily pierced with a fork, 30 to 45 minutes. Transfer to cutting board and with a sharp knife slice to desired thickness, about 1/2 inch. Combine mustard, lemon juice, black pepper, mustard mixture and poblanos in medium bowl. Cover and refrigerate until ready to serve. Place pork loin between 2 sheets of heavy plastic on a lightly floured surface. Using a rolling pin or melon baller roll meat into a uniform 1/2 inch thick rectangle. Roll up tightly starting at edges. Wrap tightly in foil and refrigerate until serving time. Serve with salsa, if desired.

title: Cheesy Steak
ingredients: 1 cup shredded swiss cheese | 1 cup pepperjack cheese, grated
instructions: Spread each slice of beef with 1/2 cup cheese spread.

title: Beef Shanks in Romaine Salad

instructions: Place beef shanks in a large roasting pan. Drizzle 1/2 cup of the bottle of italian dressing over them and stir, making sure it coats each piece evenly. instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f line a baking sheet with foil and put aside. Brush parsnips with 2 tablespoons of liqueur and turn around a few times. Using a slotted spoon, transfer the parsnips onto a serving platter and drizzle with remaining 2 tablespoons sherry. Sprinkle with chopped toasted cashews and freshly grated cheese.

Drain, remove skin, and mash beans. Return to pot and add remaining ingredients. Let stand 30 minutes before serving.

title: Green Onion Quiche or Muffins With Horseradish
ingredients: 2 lbs green onions, including tender green ends | 2 large eggs | 1 teaspoon horseradish
instructions: Preheat an oven to 200°f. Cut the greens from both ends, leaving just a little of the white and light green portion. Reserve the white parts too. Separate both eggs. In a mixing bowl, whisk together the whites, horseradish and reserved green onions. Scramble the whites into the reserved greens, reserving about 1 tbsp of white and green sections. Add them to the greens and set aside. Pour the prepared egg mixture into a nonstick, well buttered muffin tin. Top evenly with the reserved whites. Bake for 25 - 30 minutes or until a tester comes out clean.

title: Lamb Kugel
ingredients: 1 package whole wheat egg noodles | 1 pound ground lamb shoulder | 2 tablespoons wheat egg noodles | 3/4 cup fat-free cottage cheese | 1/2 cup tahini | 1/2 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1/4 cup chopped pitted dates
instructions: Cook and stir egg noodles in a large pot of boiling water for 6 to 8 minutes, or until tender. Drain, and set aside. Cook lamb in a large skillet over medium heat, breaking into crumbles as it cooks. Cook until no longer pink, about 10 minutes. Remove from heat. In a medium bowl, mix together the ground lamb, cooked egg noodles, cottage cheese, tahini, nutmeg, and dates. Spread noodles mixture in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Sprinkle with cesame seeds if desired. Bake at 350 degrees f for about 40 minutes. Let cool before serving.

title: Garlicky Garbanzo Beans
ingredients: 1 can garbanzo beans, drained and rinsed | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon extra virgin olive oil | 2 -4 tablespoons fresh breadcrumbs ( or bread torn bread with hands ) | guacamole, for topping ( optional, if desired ) ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Combine garbanzo beans and olive oil in bowl. Mix well. Add more olive oil if needed to make sure mixture is moist but not greasy. Add breadcrumbs. Gently form bean mixture into 4 patties. If desired, toast on a lightly oiled casserole dish over medium heat for 5 - 7 minutes or until lightly browned. If desired, top each patty with guacamole and/or bread crumbs.

title: Nectarine Coffee Biscotti
ingredients: 4 tablespoons ghee ( clarified butter ) | 1 large nectarines or 1 large orange, cut into wedges | 1 1/4 cups hot black coffee, divided | 1 tablespoon tomato paste | 1 teaspoon liquid smoke | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 3/4 cup unsweetened chopped dried apricots or 3/4 cup chopped pecans, toasted
instructions: Heat butter in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat. Add nectarines and 1/4 cup of the hot coffee. Cook, stirring often, until softened, about 3 minutes.

instructions: Mix your ground beef and seasoning salt. Shape mixture into 12 patties. Lightly brown the patties in butter and let cool a bit until you can handle them. Add to your baking dish the spinach and cheese. Bake at 375 for about 25 minutes. Serve with your favourite accompaniments.

instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Spray 11x7x2 inch glass baking dish with cooking spray with cooking spray. In a large bowl, mix beef, 3/4 teaspoon Accent seasoning and 1 teaspoon chili sauce. Dot with 3/4 teaspoon accent. Bake 30 minutes. To make thawed phyllo dough, remove one sheet phyllo dough from the sheet pan.

title: Nutella Espresso Biscotti
ingredients: 4 ounces brussels sprouts, chopped into 1/2 inch pieces | 10 ounces sour cream, room temperature | 2 tablespoons brewed espresso, cooled | 1 tablespoon walnut halves
instructions: Place all the ingredients except nuts in the bread machine in the order specified by the manufacturer. Set for the regular or rapid bake. If your machine's bread machine has a solid feature, set for dough cycle and start the machine. Remove when the machine starts proving, 5 minutes. Remove bread from the bread pan. Place the nuts in a small dish and drizzle over the melted nuts, stirring well to prevent the nuts from sticking. Using a long handled knife, cut into 12 slices. Arrange them decoratively on a baking sheet and let them dry out at room temperature for about 15 minutes before serving.

title: Rick's Easy Beef & Beans
ingredients: 1 can refried beans ( regular size ) | 1 can pinto beans ( regular size ) | 2 -3 lbs stew beef chunks ( stew meat ) | 1 cup white wine
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees. Get a baking pan large enough to hold the beef chunks in a single layer and fit the beef inches. In a heavy bottomed frying pan or crockpot, heat up the beans and brown meat on medium heat for about 5 minutes.. Drain the grease from the skillet if desired but reserve 2 tablespoons or so from the meat. Add the beef and the two cans of beans back to the frying pan and bring to a boil. Add the wine and allow to simmer about a minute to reduce the liquids. Put the meat and the beans back in and cook for an hour or so, breaking up the meat as it simmers. This will make the beans creamy and moist so it doesn't stick. You can leave the beef chunks in and remove them easily if you like, but i prefer to do it with a fork.

title: Jazzed up Clam Dippers
ingredients: 12 clams in shell, scrubbed, reserving the sand ( discard the sand cap ), and well washed | 3 tablespoons clarified butter | 1 cup chopped walnuts | 1 large habanero pepper, finely chopped | 1/2 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 3 cans kidney beans, drained
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium low heat until hot. Add the clarified butter, and melt. Add the walnuts, stirring until lightly toasted. Stir in the chili and nutmeg, and simmer until the chili is fragrant, about 30 seconds. Strain the clam shells from the sand cap, and reserve them. Rinse them under warm water to cool. Transfer the mussel meat to the skillet, reduce heat to low, and add the kidney beans. Simmer, covered, until the sauce thickens and the flavors are incorporated, about 10 minutes.

title: Fryer Chicken
ingredients: 1 fryer chickens, cut up | 1 1/2 teaspoons baking powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. In a small bowl stir together baking powder and baking soda. Rub chicken pieces well with the baking powder/baking soda mixture. Cook chicken in preheated oven for 15 minutes. Turn pieces over.

instructions: Place all ingredients in a zip lock bag or container. Mix well. Cover and let marinate for at least two hours. When ready to serve, place on a hot grill, with a few splashes of red chili powder and a sprinkling of the black pepper.

instructions: Place apples in a pot. Cover with water, bring to a boil and cook until apples are soft, about 15 minutes. Drain apples reserving cooking water in a small dish or cooking cup.

title: Shiitake Mushroom Soup

instructions: Place shiitake mushrooms in small pot and cover with water. Bring to boil and cook until tender, about 10 minutes. Cool to room temperature. title: Idaho Country Style Shredded Potatoes

instructions: Peel and shred potatoes, making sure to wash excess water in colander from the shredded potatoes. Set aside. Heat oven to 400f degrees. Mix shredded potato with flour. title: Cafe Rio Chicken Wings

Bake at 325 degrees for 45 minutes, flip the chicken and peppers over. Pour the last cup of water into the roasting pans when they are done and set aside to cool while you prep the other stuff…otherwise, you can do a quick stir and dip everything in the water and mix it up with a fork. After they have cooled a little, put the bags on a cookie sheet, close with foil, and pop them under a broiler to heat them up a little and get them bubbly and some brown.

title: Nando's Banana Bananas
ingredients: 2 firm bananas | 2 orange, juice and zest of
instructions: Slice bananas so that the bottom is thicker. Insert a toothpick through the center of each piece. Put the orange zest into the middle of the banana. Squeeze the orange juice into the bananas so that it adheres. If the nando's original way of making this is, cut out the ends, rinse them a cup or so of orange juice, and wrap the banana around the orange zest so it can stick in the juice without burning. Let them sit for half an hour or more to cool down a bit. You want the oranges to be saturated with orange juice, but not mushy.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray,tomato basil feta cheese,beef brisket,salt pepper,red pepper
title: Slow-Cooked Brisket With Tomato-Basil Pesto Sauce
ingredients: 2 lbs beef brisket | vegetable oil cooking spray | 2 cups tomato basil feta cheese, crumbled | 1/4 teaspoon finely diced red pepper | salt and pepper, to taste
instructions: Place brisket in a dutch oven or large roasting pan. Spray brisket with vegetable oil cooking spray. Add basil feta cheese to the brisket, sprinkle with red pepper, and pour the tomato basil pesto sauce over brisket. Cover and cook, in a slow oven, on medium temperature approximately 3 1/2 hours, or until meat thermometer reads 130° for rare, 140° for medium, or hot, and 175° for medium. Transfer brisket to a platter.

title: Gramma's Phyllo Pizza
ingredients: 1 boneless pork roast, and 1 pound of meat | 12 sheets miniature phyllo pastry | 1/2 cup yogurt | 1 cup cottage cheese | 1 can crushed pineapple, drained | 1 can chopped clams, drained
instructions: Put pork roast and half the yogurt in a freezer bag and freeze. Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Remove meat from freezer and shred into small pieces, about 1/4 inch wide. In a small bowl, combine the cottage cheese, remaining yogurt and pineapple with half the cloves. Mix well with meat. Unroll pastry sheets on a clean, flat surface and lightly with a rolling pin. Working with 1 sheet at a time, coat dough with the goat cheese mixture. Place a scoop of meat mixture at the end of one of the sheets, roll up, and place on top of the first sheet. Repeat with remaining sheets, meat mixture and dough mixture. Place pizza on a baking tray and brush with remaining goat cheese mixture. Bake in the preheated oven for 15 minutes, or until top is bubbly and a little crispy. Serve hot.

title: Cobb Filled Asparagus With Hot Peppered Garlic and Spring Onions
ingredients: 1/2 lb thick asparagus, ends trimmed, trimmed and cut in 1-inch pieces | sauce | 1 medium hot chili pepper, cut in half | 20 fresh spring onions, tops trimmed, washed and cut into 1-inch slices | 4 large skewers, soaked in water
instructions: Steam asparagus for 1 minute, or until just tender.

title: Homemade Scones (Biscuits)
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups self-raising flour | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 220°c. Sift the dry ingredients together in a large bowl. Make as many large scone shapes as you can, but aim for about 10cm diameter on the top. Slash the top of the scone down the center a few times while baking. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes or until very lightly browned and tinged with brown. Cool, then wrap in plastic wrap, store in a cool dark place until needed.

Random Ingredients: mozzarella cheese,mushroom stem,sage leaf,lime juice,green chilies,bacon
title: Crazy Green Chili Cheese Rollups
ingredients: 3 green chilies | 2 tablespoons lime juice, freshly squeezed | 2 tablespoons bacon fat or 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 12 mushrooms stems, trimmed, washed and sliced | 2 teaspoons fresh sage leaves, minced or 2 teaspoons dried rubbed sage | 1 cup shredded mozzarella cheese
instructions: Place a large cast iron skillet of about 1 to 2 inches in diameter over moderately high heat until hot. Add green chilies and 1 tablespoon lime juice and cook, stirring, until the chilies are softened and the lime juice is absorbed into the chilies, about 30 seconds. Add bacon fat or vegetable oil and mushrooms stems. Saute over moderate heat, stirring occasionally for about 5 minutes, until wilted but not browned, about 6 to 7 minutes. Add sage and season to taste with salt and pepper. Roll up the chilies and transfer to a plate. Sprinkle the mozzarella cheese evenly over the tops. Cover and chill until serving time, about 4 hours. Unwrap.

Random Ingredients: lime juice zest,cardamom,chicken stock,parmesan cheese,hazelnut,macaroni,onion powder,turkey bacon
title: Macaroni With Smoked Turkey (Macaroni and Ground Turkey) and Hazelnuts
ingredients: 1 box macaroni | 2 tablespoons chicken stock | 2 tablespoons lime juice, juice and zest of | 1/2 teaspoon onion powder | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom | 4 slices smoked turkey bacon, chopped | 2 tablespoons grated parmesan cheese ( fresh or part-skim ) | 2 tablespoons sliced hazelnuts, toasted
instructions: Cook macaroni in well salted boiling water as directed in the package. Drain and return to the pot. Meanwhile in small saucepan, combine stock, lime juice, zest, onion powder and cardamom.

Random Ingredients: oregano leaf,cornflour,pistachio,blue cheese,curry powder,lime juice,vanilla bean,ginger garlic paste
title: Cousin Pete's Greek Flavoured Fried Moghlaiya or Blue Cheese
ingredients: 250 g blue cheese ( bobolives preferred ) or 250 g firm goat cheese ( bobolives preferred ) | 1/2 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1 tablespoon cornflour ( cornstarch ) | 1/2 teaspoon mild curry powder ( or to taste ) or 1/2 teaspoon curry powder ( or to taste ) | 1/8 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1 -2 tablespoon lime juice | 1/8 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1/2 tablespoon ground pumpkin seed or 1/2 tablespoon pistachios
instructions: Mix cheese into dry ingredients. Put cheese into a serving bowl, and put bowl into fridge to firm. Cut cheese into strips, then cut again into strips, so you have four squares. Put a small piece of bread on top of a square of cheese, and press and coat bread in cornflour, then curry powder or dried oregano leaves. Put in fridge, and shake often. When ready to serve, add lime juice, or to taste, and dried oregano to taste. Sprinkle with ground pumpkin, or chopped pistachios, or other nuts and enjoy. Note, prep time does not include time to refrigerate cheese.

title: Gingery's Spicy Strawberry Sausage
ingredients: 1 pound sweet italian sausage, casing removed | 1 1/2 cups plain soymilk | 1 package frozen strawberries, hulled and quartered | 2 tablespoons minced fresh ginger root | 4 whole cloves | 1 teaspoon taco seasoning | 20 slices bacon | 1 cup strawberry, halved
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Place sausage in a baking pan. Bring soymilk to a boil in a saucepan over medium heat.

Random Ingredients: butternut squash,blueberry,italian seasoning,garlic clove,kiwi fruit,peach,chicken bouillon granule
title: Squash and Kiwi Salsa
ingredients: 1 butternut squash | 2 tablespoons chicken bouillon granules or 2 tablespoons chicken bouillon powder | 1 can crushed peaches | 1 can diced peaches | 1 small sweet potato, peeled and cut into 3/4-inch cubes | 4 fresh kiwi fruits, peeled and very thinly sliced | 1 tablespoon dried italian seasoning ( found in the mexican section of the store )
instructions: Cut butternut squash in half and scoop out seeds and the pulp, reserving the shells. Place squash shells in a casserole dish and sprinkle with 1 tablespoon of the chicken or bouillon powder and 1/4 cup of canned peaches and half of the diced kiwi fruit. Cover and bring the mixture to a boil, reduce the heat, and simmer until the squash pieces are softened and the sauce is thick, stirring frequently, about 20 - 25 minutes. Meanwhile, heat the remaining 1 tablespoon of chicken or bouillon in a medium nonreactive skillet over medium low heat. Add 1/8 cup of the peach liquid, if desired. Bring to a boil. Stir in the kiwi fruit, italian seasoning, and remaining peaches. Serve over squash.

title: Southern Style Hash Browns #5FIX
ingredients: 1 package simply potatoes & reg ; shredded hash browns | 1 1/2 tablespoons dried currants ( optional )
instructions: Heat oven to 350°f. Mix together hash browns and dried currant if using. Put into a greased 9x13 pan. Bake for 30 minutes. Remove from oven and sprinkle with more fresh chopped nuts, or any other favorite topping you desire.

Random Ingredients: radish,mango chutney,button mushroom,beef sirloin,dark chocolate,pepper,wheat flour
title: Chocolate Beef Burgers
ingredients: 4 slices dark chocolate ( i used a semi-sweet chocolate ) | 24 button mushrooms, very thinly sliced ( use red or green ) | 500 g beef sirloin | 1 tablespoon dark chocolate, melted | 2 teaspoons pepper | 1 tablespoon wheat flour | 2 radishes, very thinly sliced
instructions: Preheat 180c. Cut each piece of beef in half lengthways and then slice diagonally into 3 pieces. Using the flat side of a knife, gently tear up the small bits until all the beef is gone. Spread each piece on one side of each of the four slices of beef. Put the chocolate in a small bowl. Add the mushrooms. Season with pepper, stir to combine. Place a piece of beef onto each of the four beef pieces on a plate. Spoon the melted chocolate over all. Garnish with a sliced radish.

title: Grilled Salmon
ingredients: 1/2 cup ketchup | 1/2 lb salmon, skin on
instructions: Pour 1/2 cup ketchup into an 8 x 8 inch square pan and spread as evenly as possible. Sprinkle on the salmon and cover with the remaining ketchup. Let stand at room temperature for 20 minutes at room temperature. Fire up the grill, or turn out the salmon on the grill rack over the rack. Cook for 12 minutes, then turn the salmon. Let stand for 5 minutes, then flip again. Let stand 10 minutes longer.

Random Ingredients: date,mustard seed,self rising flour,red cabbage,berry cranberry sauce
title: Mustard-Cranberry Baked Red Cabbage
ingredients: 500 g red cabbage ( shredded or shredded ) | 1/4 cup self-rising flour | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds | 1/4 cup dates ( fresh or frozen ) | 1 tablespoon berries ( fresh or frozen )
instructions: Place the cabbage in an oven tray lined with baking paper and bake at 180oc for 25 minutes or until a tender. Place the flour, mustard seeds and dates in a food processor or blender and pulse until they are finely chopped. Tip, the cabbage can be placed on the work surface with your fingers as you roll it. Roll the dough with your hands to flatten it as much as possible. Remove the cabbage from the oven and spread 1 tablespoon of the prepared mustard cinnimon or cranberry sauce on each piece with a teaspoon. Spread the remaining mustard cinnimon or cranberry sauce on the cabbage evenly and roll up like a swiss roll. Slice the rolls into thick diagonal slices and serve warm.

Random Ingredients: saffron,marinade,chili oil,flat leaf parsley,lasagna noodle,part mozzarella cheese
title: Luxurious Saffron Lasagna
ingredients: 2 tablespoons chili oil, or as needed | 1/4 teaspoon saffron | 1 box lasagna noodles, broken in half | 1 carton part-skim mozzarella cheese, shredded | 1 1/4 cups jarred marinade | 1/1/4 cup flat leaf parsley, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Combine the chili oil and saffron in a small bowl. Spray a 12x18 inch glass baking dish with cooking spray.

Random Ingredients: hot pepper,cottage cheese,tilapia fillet,vodka,cocoa powder,yellow squash,kosher salt
title: Polish-Style Tilapia
ingredients: 1 package tilapia fillets, thawed | 1/4 cup unsweetened dutch-processed cocoa powder | 1 can diced hot peppers | 1/4 teaspoon kosher salt | 2 1/2 cups shredded yellow squash | 1/2 package low fat cottage cheese | 1 package instant potato sticks
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Coat a 9x13 inch baking dish with cooking spray. Line the bottom with aluminum foil. Arrange tilapia fillets on the pan, skin side up. Reserve the remaining ingredients. Cover with 1 cup of chopped squash and 1/2 of cottage cheese. Spread the mashed potato sticks over all, leaving a 1/4 inch border of potato on the sides. Cover with aluminum foil, and bake for 20 minutes. Sprinkle with remaining chopped squash and cottage cheese, and continue baking for another 10 minutes, until the tilapia is cooked through and potatoes are tender and lightly golden brown.

title: Homemade Indian Spice Rub
ingredients: 1 teaspoon five-spice powder | 1 teaspoon garam masala or 1/2 teaspoon almond powder | 6 pinches salt and pepper
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a gallon sized zip lock bag. Add to a container. Store in a pantry.

Random Ingredients: cornmeal,cracker,brown mustard seed,bread flour,milk ricotta cheese,portabella mushroom,white breadcrumb,chicken bouillon
title: Cheesy Risotto With Mushrooms
ingredients: 1/2 cup portabella mushroom, chopped | 2 tablespoons soft brown mustard seeds | 1/3 cup soft bread flour | 1/4 cup whole milk ricotta cheese | 1/3 cup fresh white breadcrumb | 1 teaspoon instant chicken bouillon | 1 tablespoon stone ground cracker | 1/2 teaspoon cornmeal
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f degrees. In a mixing bowl combine the mushrooms, mustard seeds, and bread flour. Combine ricotta cheese, bread crumbs, chicken bouillon, cracker crumbs, and the 2 tbsp of stone ground cracker crumb and add to the bowl. Pour into a 9 x 12 baking dish. Sprinkle top with some of the cracker crumbs. Bake 25 - 30 minutes until crust is crisp. Enjoy.

title: Bibb and Green Bean Wraps for 2
ingredients: 1 head bibb lettuce or 1 head boston lettuce, stemmed well, washed and dried | 1 package frozen shelled green beans, thawed well, thawed | 1/4 cup triple sec ( optional )
instructions: Thaw the green beans just until the water runs clear. Cut into thin shreds, about 1 1/2 inches long. Wrap the green beans around each piece of lettuce in a large, very tight serving platter. Spoon the blueberry dip over and around the greens. Top with triple sec.

title: Auntie Theresa's Onion Ginger Relish
ingredients: 1 large white onion, peeled and cut into chunks | 1/2 cup minced fresh ginger root | 1/2 cup brown sugar
instructions: In a medium size bowl combine the white onion, ginger, brown sugar and 1/2 teaspoon salt. Stir together. Use to top hot meat, pork or chicken meat or vegetables. Store in refrigerator.

title: Vidalia Onion Lime Shreds
ingredients: 12 pieces vidalia onions | 1 fresh lime | 2 cans canned bamboo shoots, drained
instructions: Using a fork, core the onions and slice into very thin slices. Place in a medium sauce pan with enough water to cover. Add a pinch of salt, bring to a boil and simmer for 35 minutes. Remove from heat. Drain juice of the fresh lime into a small bowl and add the lime juice. Drain the onion slices and slice into very thin matchsticks. Place on serving plates and top with the sliced onion and diced or grated orange juice to create a fresh and colorful color.

title: Indian Style Subru Uncle Ham
ingredients: 10 slices deli ham | 10 -15 green cardamom pods
instructions: Pre grind enough finely crushed green cardamoms into 10 to 15 pieces of ham. Using the same, heat butter in an iron skillet. Add sliced ham on top and close lid. After 2 - 3 minutes, mix well together and allow to cook on medium heat until mixture looks dry and golden. Add green cardamoms. Cover with lid and allow to turn the contents on. Serve with hot rotis or bread.

Random Ingredients: hot red chili pepper,basmati rice,kahlua,whipping cream
title: Nif's Kahlua-Glazed Rice Bowls
ingredients: 1 cup basmati rice | 2 tablespoons kahlua | 2 cups whipping cream, to yield 1 cup | 6 dried hot red chili peppers | 1 small hot red chili pepper, seeded
instructions: In rice cooker, add all ingredients through chili peppers, and stir to coat. Set rice cooker on. Close lid, and allow rice to steam for 1 hour. Fluff rice with fork. Garnish with more kahlua. Serve hot or warm.

Random Ingredients: hamburger,garlic,sea scallop,galangal,brussels sprout,beef sirloin,cilantro leaf,coriander seed
title: Sarasota's Phatak Thit Kho
ingredients: 1 lb lean ground beef sirloin | 1 teaspoon coriander seed, freshly ground | 4 -5 leaves fresh cilantro leaves, chopped | 1 clove garlic, chopped | 2 -3 tablespoons coarsely chopped galangal, to taste | 10 ounces brussels sprouts, cleaned and cut into 1/8-inch-thick peices | 1 lb fresh brussels sprout, trimmed | sea scallops ( to garnish )
instructions: In a large skillet, heat enough oil to cover the bottom evenly. Add the coriander seeds and saute for a few seconds to awaken the flavor. Add the chopped garlic and stir fry for a few seconds until the garlic becomes fragrant. Add the ground beef and the ground beef and brown on top. Add the coriander, basil leaves and galangal, stirring to mix well. Stir in the brussels sprouts, reduce the heat, cover and cook until they're done. Adjust the seasoning and serve hot over hot cooked rice with crusty french or italian bread.

Random Ingredients: coconut milk,panela cheese,corn,suet,blueberry,artichoke heart,cauliflower,chicken stock cube
title: Baked  Artichoke Hearts and Stuffed Cauliflower
ingredients: 2 medium cauliflower | 175 g panela cheese ( cut in thin slices ) | 25 g branston drained sourdough bread ( roughly torn ) | 125 ml coconut milk | 2 chicken stock cubes ( one packet of ) | 1 can artichoke hearts ( drained ) | 2 tablespoons corn ( fresh or canned ) | 225 g blueberries
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c peel cauliflower and discard tough fibrous stems. Cut off and discard cauliflower base and discard the eyes, and the thick stalk. Chop the cauliflower stalk at a slight angle into small 1cm slices, then combine all the cauliflower in a large bowl and set aside. Place bread and breadcrumbs in processor container, add coconut milk and stir until breadcrumbs are well combined. Add crumb mixture gradually, beating until combined, then add stock cubes, artichokes and the can of corn and stir just until combined. Divide mixture between the 2 halves of the ovenproof dish or tin, then place dish in hot oven, uncovered, for 40 - 45 minutes. Remove from oven, then spoon the topping evenly over the top, then return to oven for a further 15 to 20 minutes or until topping is golden and the bread mixture has crisped. Allow to stand for 10 minutes before cutting.

Random Ingredients: dark sesame oil,spice,sage leaf,breadcrumb,crabmeat,mozzarella cheese,chicken thigh,cherry juice
title: Easy Cheesy Garlic Chicken
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken thighs | 1/2 cup mixed dried breadcrumbs ( plain or crusty ) | 1/2 cup cherry juice | 1/2 teaspoon hot mixed spice | 1/2 teaspoon dark sesame oil | 1/2 teaspoon dried sage leaves | 1 1/2 cups low fat mozzarella cheese, shredded | 2 cups fresh crabmeat, chopped
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°. Mix all the ingredients together except the mozzarella until the mixture is well blended. Put this into a 8x8 inch baking dish. Put the mozzarella on top of the mixture and bake for 30 - 45 minutes. Unburrow the chicken, and top with the crab and bake for 5 more minutes, or until the cheese is melted. Serve as a side dish, or in a bun.

Random Ingredients: coriander,walnut half,wheat germ,fig,alfredo sauce,vanilla,brown rice,ginger garlic paste
title: Fruited Brown Rice
ingredients: 1 cup brown rice | 1 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste or 1 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste, more according to taste | 1 jar alfredo sauce | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla | 1/4 cup walnut halves, grated or 1/4 cup almonds, divided ( to taste ) | 1/4 cup poppy seed halves, toasted | fresh coriander or parsley, minced ( to taste )
instructions: In a pot heat the olive oil on medium high heat and add 1 tbls. Sliced fresh ginger garlic blend. Then add the rice and 1 tbls. Deglaze with the alfredo sauce then add 1/4 tbls. Toasted walnut halves and 1 tbls. Grated fresh parsley. Mix well, and then add the rest of the sifted ingredients. Stir, and bring to a boil on high heat. Cover and let it cook on medium high heat for about 15 - 20 minutes or until the liquid is mostly absorbed. Fluff and serve over brown rice. Serve with fresh fruit or other fresh fruit.

title: Lentils With Sage (Belgian Endive & Chard)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons lentils | 1 belgian endive, large stalks chopped | 3 1/2 ounces chopped rindless smoked ham or 3 1/2 ounces smoked streaky bacon, diced | 3 1/2 ounces chopped canned tomatoes with green chilies
instructions: Cook lentils. Dice endive. In a large skillet, heat 1 tbls of fat over low heat, then cook bacon or ham 4 - 5 minutes. Rinse lentils and add to skillet. Increase heat to medium high, add chopped endive and saute for 5 - 6 minutes. Add tomatoes and chiles, stir and heat 1 minute.

Random Ingredients: guacamole,pumpkin seed,brown mushroom,ginger,coriander,pork bean,tuna olive oil
title: Pumpkin Seed Turkey Burger
ingredients: 1/2 cup raw pumpkin seeds | 400 g ground pork and beans | 1 teaspoon coriander | 2 teaspoons ginger | 4 teaspoons guacamole | 4 teaspoons coriander | 2 tablespoons brown mushrooms, sliced | 2 tablespoons canned tuna in olive oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c. Soak the pumpkin seeds in warm water for 10 - 15 minutes. Drain and dry. Combine the pumpkin seeds, pork, beans, spices, ginger and mushrooms, using your hands. Divide mixture into 8 burgers. Place on a sheet tray and brush with oil. Cook for 15 minutes. Transfer to a plate and serve.

title: Hazelnut-Crusted Chicken Wings
ingredients: 10 chicken wings | 1 cup hazelnuts
instructions: Cut each wing in half. Separate each section between the wing tips and wing tips. Wash the tips and remove any excess fat. Crush some hazelnuts and set aside. Cut the tips into four pieces each. Heat a skillet/griddle/broiler. Place the wing pieces skin side up on the hot pan/griddle/broiler. Toast the joints a few at a time until browned and crisp. Transfer to a paper towel lined plate. Place the hot skillet/broiler under a medium hot grill/broiler. Grill the wings until cooked through. The wing tips should not be charred. Remove from grill or broiler, drizzle with 1/4 cup melted butter and sprinkle with 1/4 cup chopped hazelnuts. Top with remaining hazelnuts to serve.

title: Spinach and Spinach
ingredients: 1 kg baby spinach leaves | 1 cup flour | 2 tablespoons pickling spices
instructions: Wash the spinach well and remove some of the liquid that has run off. Place in a pan with just enough water to cover. Bring to the boil, reduce heat and simmer until tender. Drain. Toss in the flour and pickling spice. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: chicken seasoning mix,hoisin sauce,spring wrapper,ranch dressing mix,egg yolk,creme de banane,chicken breast fillet,lime
title: Easy Crock Pot Hoisin Chicken Fajitas
ingredients: 500 g chicken breast fillets | 1/2 packet hidden valley & reg ; original ranch & reg ; dressing mix | 1/2 packet hoisin sauce | 1/2 teaspoon chicken seasoning mix | 50 g creme de banane | 1 large egg yolk | 1 tablespoon lime juice | 1/2 cup spring roll wrappers | 1/4 cup thai sweet red pepper crema and/or creme de paprika ( for fan )
instructions: Place the chicken fillets in the slow cooker with the creme de banane. Top with the ranch seasoning mix and a little more creme de banane on top. Beat the egg yolk and lime juice together and brush onto the chicken, then add the creme de banana mix and thai sweet red pepper. Cook on high for 2 hours, then switch to low for a further 10 - 15 minutes to thicken up slightly, then serve with your favourite toppings. Serve with a side of thai sweet red pepper creme and/or creme de paprika.

Random Ingredients: parsley,ham,shrimp,ice water,red food coloring,bottom roast,extra virgin olive oil,rosemary sprig
title: Baked Shrimp
ingredients: 4 lbs bottom round roast, cut into 8 pieces | 1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil | 1/4 cup fresh parsley, chopped | 4 cups ice water | 5 thin rosemary sprigs | 4 tablespoons red food coloring | 1 lb cooked shrimp or 1 lb cooked small shrimp, shelled
instructions: Place the oven rack in the middle of the oven. Grease a 13x9 baking dish. Place the beef in the dish and sprinkle the bottom of the dish with salt and pepper. Pour 1/2 cup water into the dish. In an 8 to9 quart kettle or 2 to 3 quart pot, dissolve the food coloring in 1 cup water and bring to a boil over medium high heat. Transfer the liquid to a bowl and add the rosemary, shrimp or shrimp, and remaining water, and bring to a boil over high heat. Simmer uncovered 15 - 20 minutes or until the sauce is moderately thick. Transfer the shrimp or shrimp sauce to a 1 quart dish or 1 quart baking dish which holds a trivet for easy lifting. In the dish. Spread the shrimp or shrimp mixture evenly over the top of the shrimp. Sprinkle with flour, drizzle with 2 tablespoons of olive oil, and arrange the remaining shrimp and parsley around the shrimp. Spread 1/2 tablespoon of olive oil over the shrimp and bake in a 300°f oven for 3 to 3 1/2 hours, or until the shrimp turn pink and the sauce is bubbly.

title: Chinese Spaghetti Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb linguine | 1 lb ground veal | vegetable oil or sesame oil | 2 teaspoons cumin seeds | 1 teaspoon sesame oil | 1/4 cup dried pineapple, chopped | 1/8 cup fresh cilantro leaves ( coriander )
instructions: Cook linguine.

title: Teddy Bear
ingredients: 1 pound thinly sliced round steak | 4 yukon gold potatoes, peeled and cubed | 1 large roll lettuce
instructions: Brown hamburger in a large skillet over medium heat. Drain off any excess grease. While meat is cooling, cook the potatoes in a large pot of boiling salted water until tender. Drain and set aside. Place the rolls into the skillet. Dice the meat and potatoes to 1/2 inch cubes. Add beef and potatoes, and roll into a ball. Wrap in plastic wrap and put into a plastic bag and refrigerate until set, 15 to 20 minutes. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Unwrap the plastic wrap and place onto a shallow baking dish. Bake in the preheated oven until browned, 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Czech Style Russian Salad
ingredients: 1 lb ground sirloin or 1 lb ground turkey | 1 medium yellow squash | 1 english cucumber, peeled, seeded, and sliced | 1 tablespoon instant beef bouillon
instructions: In a large skillet, brown the sirloin meat over medium heat, breaking it up. When the meat has no more pink left drain well and return to the stove. Add the squash and cucumber and cook over low heat until it's soft, about 10 to 15 minutes. Stir in the beef bouillon. Heat through serve warm or chill for up to 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: angel hair pasta,chuck roast,parsley,cheddar cheese,mango chutney,snail
title: Roast Beef With Macaroni and Mango Chutney
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs top sirloin roast | 1 cup low-fat cheddar cheese, shredded | 1/3 cup fresh parsley, minced | 1/3 cup light mango chutney ( i use libby's ) | 4 ounces uncooked angel hair pasta, cooked | 24 snails
instructions: Heat oven to 325°f in 6 - 8 quart ovenproof skillet, heat beef to medium rare and place in a medium baking dish in roasting pan, fat side up. Bake uncovered, 30 - 35 minutes or until thermometer registers 170f for medium rare, remove from oven and allow to stand 10 minutes. Remove roast from pan and slice about 1/4 inch thick and return to pan. Top with cheese, parsley and chutney and place on a rack in a broiler pan. Broil 3 - 4 from heat until well browned, about 3 minutes serve and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: carrot,tamarind paste,green olive,vidalia onion,almond flavoring,almond,monterey jack cheese
title: Mexican Cheese
ingredients: 6 ounces monterey jack cheese, grated | 4 ounces carrots, grated | 4 ounces vidalia onions, finely chopped | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground blanched almond extract or 1 1/2 teaspoons almond flavoring | 1/2 teaspoon almond flavoring ( optional or to taste ) | 1/4 cup green olives, sliced or jarled olives ( use the oil packed variety ) | 1/2 cup tamarind paste, dissolved in a little water
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl. Taste to adjust seasoning note, this makes quite a large quantity cheese. Pack in the corners of a casserole. Cover tightly and chill in the refrigerator.

title: Chili Fried Eggs
ingredients: 8 hard-boiled eggs | 1 can chopped green chile peppers, drained
instructions: In a large bowl, mash the hard boiled eggs with a fork. Stir in the green chile peppers. Keep refrigerated until served.

title: Zwiebelkuchen  (Zwiebelkuchen Kielbasa
ingredients: 1 lb kielbasa, sliced in 1/2 inch rounds | 1 egg whites egg white ( yolk ) | 2 containers sour cream
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil, add salt to taste and add the kielbasa. Cook for 20 minutes or until the casings are well removed from the kielbasa. Drain the kielbasa. Whisk the egg white into the sour cream. Add sour cream mixture to the kielbasa. Serve warm.

title: Creamy German Dressing
ingredients: 1 cup plain yogurt | 2 teaspoons white wine vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together yogurt and vinegar. Stir in cream of tartar. Chill until ready to serve.

title: Pesto Croutons Appetizer
ingredients: 1 baguette, sliced thin | 1 cup purchased basil pesto | 1/4 cup cream | 1 1/2 tablespoons dark sesame oil
instructions: Place sliced thick french baguette in a paper lunch basket. Cut baguette diagonally in half lengthwise to form a crust. Cover with plastic wrap. Place on counter and set aside. In a large bowl, combine pesto and cream. Dip each baguette slice 1 or 2 at a time into pesto cream mixture. Place on a lined baking sheet and brush with some of the sesame oil. Broil about 3 - 4 inches from heat and until toasted and bubbly, about 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: chuck roast,russet potato,rose water,yellow pepper,mayonnaise,parsnip,sugar syrup,corn tortilla
title: Beef and Pepper Potatoes
ingredients: 4 lbs chuck roast | 4 large russet potatoes | 4 cups packaged sweet potatoes | 1 yellow sweet pepper | 3 lbs parsnips | 3 tablespoons mayonnaise | 2 tablespoons rose water | 1 tablespoon sugar syrup | 12 corn tortillas or 12 -16 flour tortillas
instructions: For the meat and vegetables. For the corn tortillas or tortillas. Wash meat and cut into 1 inch slices.. For the peppers. Peel, wash and dice the sweet potatoes and julienne the parsnips. In a large covered casserole or dutch oven, add the pepper, sweet potatoes, and meat. Sprinkle with rosewater and sugar syrup. Cover and cook for about 10 to 15 minutes, or until the meat is done. For the peppers. In a medium food processor, mix mayonnaise and mayonnaise. Stir in the rose water until well blended. Place a large spoonful of the meat mixture near the edge of a corn tortilla. Wrap like a burrito and then roll up to form the tortillas. Continue until all of the meat is used. In a large frying pan, fry the tortillas until golden brown. Drain on paper towels. Roll the tortillas into a warm burrito and place on a platter. Serve with the mayonnaise mixture, as an appetizer, or a side dish.

Random Ingredients: ricotta cheese,poblano chile,lime peel,hamburger bun,broth,sherry,oregano,apple juice
title: Smoky Chilaquiles
ingredients: 6 poblano chiles ( about 8 ounces ) | 1/2 cup unsweetened apple juice | 1/4 cup dry sherry | 1 teaspoon dried oregano | 1 package low-fat ricotta cheese | 2 tablespoons grated lime peel | 1/2 cup chicken broth | 4 hamburger buns
instructions: Roast poblanos over open flame in a small dry skillet over moderate heat, turning with tongs, until charred all over and blistered and softened, 10 to 12 minutes. Transfer to strainer and let drain until cool and scrape all of the charred flesh off the shell, then place in a blender with apple juice, sherry and oregano and puree until very smooth. Add the tomato puree and ricotta, blending until just blended. Combine with the chile mixture. Place in a bowl and chill thoroughly. To make salsa con carne, using 2 forks, shred the rinds of 2 small oranges, removing white pith.
