Put rinds in a small saucepan with the broth and cook over moderate heat, stirring, until reduced about 5 to 8 minutes, then cool to room temperature. Make dip, put the 1/2 cup chopped parsley in a medium bowl. Put the remaining 1/2 cup parsley and 1/4 cup broth in a small bowl. Dip the poblanos in the cornstarch and then, using metal skewers, thread them on the cornstarch. Thread a small cross, 2 inches long piece of spaghetti across the poblanos. Repeat until all the poblanos are soaked. If you don't have skewers, keep the cornstarch and broth separately. If using a charcoal grill, put the meat on the rack and arrange the rack so that it, overlapping the flame, is directly on the hot grate. If you don't have a grill, put the skillet over medium high heat. Grill the meat, flesh side down until it is charred all over, about 5 minutes for the poblanos, about 5 minutes for the ricotta and 45 to 60 seconds for the chile mixture. Move the poblanos to a cutting board and, using a very sharp knife, cut down the side of the meat, in one thick slice from the cross. Cut out the core and seeds then put the slices on a platter and surround with slices of crusty bread. Serve with salsa con carne or with sour cream, if desired.

Random Ingredients: yogurt,port wine,pecorino romano cheese,cumin powder,flour,tomato puree,almond extract
title: Almond Pecorino
ingredients: 1/2 cup butter or 1/2 cup oil | 1 1/2 cups plain yogurt | 2 cups flour | 2 teaspoons grated pecorino romano cheese or 2 teaspoons parmesan cheese ( you 'll decide for the pecorino flavor ) | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 1/2 teaspoon port wine ( if using italian wine, omit the port! ) | 1 teaspoon tomato puree | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Mix all the ingredients and chill well. The dough will be quite stiff but will firm up for shaping and the resulting paste will remain firm. Divide the dough in two and roll out into a 6 inch circle. Use a floured cookie cutter to cut and lift into round tortelles. Place in a pan and bake in a preheated oven at 400° for about 20 - 25 minutes or until light gold on both sides. Don't set the skillet in the oven, as it will be hot when it starts to get hot when the pecorino comes out of the oven.

Random Ingredients: szechuan peppercorn,cooking oil,bibb lettuce,coffee,mustard powder,lemon extract,cornflour,serrano chilies
title: Spicy Chili Bibimbocca
ingredients: 1 lb serrano chilies or 1 lb jalapeno chile, stemmed and seeded | 2 teaspoons peppercorns, cracked | 3/4 - 1 cup prepared mustard powder | 3/4 cup cornflour | 1 head bibb lettuce, cleaned and torn into bite size pieces | 1 tablespoon coffee | 1 teaspoon lemon extract | 3 sprigs cedar planks or 3 -5 other woody branches
instructions: Cut the stems off the chiles, keeping most of the seeds. Cut the chilies into thick slices. Place them in a bowl and add the peppercorns, mustard powder and cornflour. Heat a wok over high heat until very hot but not smoking. When it is very hot, add the oil and swirl to coat the sides. When it is hot but not smoking, add the chili and stir fry for 1 minute. Add the lettuce and stir fry for 1 minute, tossing once or twice. Add the coffee and lemon extract. Stir well, then fold in the chili mixture, reserving a few for garnish on top later, or until heated through. Transfer the chili mixture into a serving bowl and garnish with cedar planks or other woody branches. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: bell pepper,graham cracker crumb,vegetarian bean,coconut cream,strength chicken broth,shallot,cocoa powder
title: Chocolate Blackened Beans and Peppers
ingredients: 1/2 cup unsweetened coconut cream | 1/2 cup vegetarian refried beans | 1 medium shallots or 1 small yellow onion | 1 medium bell pepper | 1 -2 teaspoon unsweetened cocoa powder | 1 tablespoon regular strength chicken broth | 1 -2 teaspoon graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Cut vegetables into 1/2 strips and saute in 3 tbs of coconut cream for 3 minutes. Drain and set aside. Heat remaining coconut cream in saucepan, add beans, shallots, and bell pepper. Stir and saute for 3 minutes. Add cocoa powder and stir. Add broth and stir. Bring to boil, then turn down to low and let simmer for 15 - 20 minutes. Stir beans, vegetables and cream mixture just before serving.

Random Ingredients: tomato,white flour,tomato green chilies,green curry paste,celery seed
title: Buny's Thai Veggie Pizza
ingredients: 1 cup white flour | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies | 1 can chopped tomatoes | 2 tablespoons tomato green chilies, chopped | 2 teaspoons light curry paste | 1 teaspoon celery seed
instructions: Mix dry ingreients. Bake at 350°f on greased cookie sheet 15 minutes.

title: Swiss Chard With Sage and Dill Pickles
ingredients: 2 lbs swiss chard, in 2-inch pieces | 1 cup finely chopped radish | 2 teaspoons minced shallots | 1 teaspoon dried dill pickle, crumbled | 1/4 teaspoon allspice berry | fresh sage leaf, for garnish
instructions: In a large pot of boiling water, blanch the chard for 4 - 5 minutes, just until it wilts. Drain and set aside in a bowl. Add the radish, shallots and dried dill pickles and toss gently to coat. Sprinkle with allspice and set aside for 2 - 3 minutes, just to reheat. Toss with the swiss chard and serve sprinkled with fresh sage leaves.

Random Ingredients: cooking oat,peach,brown rice,kahlua,vegetable oil cooking spray,crescent
title: Quick Peach and Jello Cannoli
ingredients: 3 tablespoons brown rice or 3 tablespoons white rice, not instant | cooking oat | vegetable oil cooking spray | 12 ounces refrigerated crescent rolls | 1 can sliced peaches | 1 tablespoon kahlua
instructions: Cook brown rice according to package directions. Meanwhile, spray a jelly roll pan with cooking spray. Set aside. Unroll the cresent rolls. Open and divide among the rolls. Top evenly with the peach slices and kahlua. Cover the rolls and bake in a 350 degree f. Oven for 25 minutes. Cut into desired servings.

Random Ingredients: pearl barley,heavy cream,olive oil,curry leaf,lentil,onion salt,vegetarian bean,grainy mustard
title: Vegetarian Biryani
ingredients: 16 dried lentils, rinsed and picked over | olive oil | 8 -10 curry leaves, finely chopped | 2 1/2 cups creamy mustard | 8 ounces sliced vegetables ( such as onions, mushrooms, baby bella or cauliflower ) | 3/4 cup chopped onion | 1 cups cooked barley | 1 cup heavy cream ( or half and half, or milk for a thicker biryani ) | other spices such as mustard, cumin, nutmeg, paprika ( or to taste )
instructions: Place lentils in a pot of salted cold water and bring to a boil. Remove from heat and cover.

Random Ingredients: mozzarella cheese,celery root,tomato juice,pork chop,cumin seed,pecorino cheese,green curry paste
title: Green Pork Chops
ingredients: 2 tablespoons chopped green curry paste ( or to taste ) | 2 teaspoons finely grated pecorino cheese | 1 tablespoon finely chopped celery root | 2 teaspoons cumin seeds | 4 large pork chops, 6-1/2 inches thick | 1 1/2 cups tomato juice | 3/4 cup mozzarella cheese, shredded
instructions: In 10 inch skillet, cook curry paste over medium heat, stirring, until fragrant, about 1 minute. Add pcorino and celery root.

title: Tangy Bitteri
ingredients: 1/2 inch fresh asafoetida powder | 1/2 teaspoon vinegar
instructions: If you dont have a candy thermometer, it is okay to use either one of the above powders. Heat your wok until smoking hot. Add a pinch or two of asafoetida. If you dont have a candy thermometer, you may want to use an italian or french fry thermometer.

title: Roasted Red Pepper Spice Mix
ingredients: 2 teaspoons red pepper flakes | 2 teaspoons mustard powder
instructions: Put the dry ingredients in a jar, and shake well to mix them. Makes about 2 tablespoons. Use to season chicken, pork, beef, and shrimp for cooking on your microwave, or roast vegetables for serving.

title: Linguine With Fresh Peach and Anchovy Apples
ingredients: 12 ounces medium egg noodles or 18 ounces linguine | pam cooking spray ( optional ) | 3/4 cup frozen sliced peach, thawed and cut into thin slices | 1 anchovy, minced | 2 tablespoons maple syrup or 2 tablespoons brown sugar | 1/2 teaspoon old bay seasoning | freshly-grated fresh pepper and seafood seasoning ( optional ) or salt and pepper ( optional )
instructions: Prepare linguine according to package directions.

title: Grilled Chicken Wings
ingredients: 1 large chicken wings | 1 tablespoon finely chopped lemongrass | 4 slices pickled jalapeno pepper, stems ( each 3-inch long )
instructions: Grill chicken over medium direct heat, with lemongrass and pepper about 5 minutes. Brush with oil and serve.

Random Ingredients: white onion,garlic,bay leaf,thyme leaf,heavy whipping cream
title: Papa Deen's Onions
ingredients: 1 cup heavy whipping cream | 1 white onion, halved and cut into 1/4-inch slices | 3 cloves garlic, sliced | 1 bay leaf | 1/4 teaspoon dried thyme leaves
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine the heavy whipping cream, onion, garlic, bay leaf, and thyme leaves. Cover, and refrigerate overnight, stirring a few times.

title: Chicken and Cornmeal Baked in a Slow Cooker
ingredients: 1 package cornmeal | 4 slices bacon | 2 packages frozen chopped chicken, thawed and drained | 1 jar catsup
instructions: Preheat the cooker to 350 degrees f. Arrange the cornmeal and bacon in the bottom of a slow cooker, and arrange the uncooked chicken and drained tomatoes on top. Pour catsup over everything. Cover, set the cooker to low, and cook 4 hours, stirring occasionally. Serve with a piece of buttered or floured french bread, if desired.

title: Homemade Tortilla Chips
ingredients: 12 tortillas | your favorite salad green, such as cilantro
instructions: Preheat the oven according to its directions. Warm slightly warm tortillas. Cut in half and place about one sixth of the slices in a glass baking dish. You should have approximately 1 1/3 cups of chips all over. Place remaining chips around the edges of the dish. Drizzle or pour any remaining warm tortillas on top of the chips. Sprinkle with a little more paprika if desired or, sprinkle each with a little bit more paprika and bake for about 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Cedar Door Ham Hock Sausages (Cedar Door Ham)
ingredients: 1 ham hock | 1 lb frozen peach slices | sifted superfine sugar
instructions: Insert ham hock into cavity of sausage sack. Cover with peach slices. Pour enough hot water into sausage sack to reach top of sausage sack. Bake in a preheated 375 degree f oven for about 1 hour. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: amaretto,cherry,coffee liqueur,tomato soup,plain flour,greek yogurt,garam masala,veal cutlet
title: Veal Chops With Creamy Greek Yogurt
ingredients: 12 veal cutlets | 1/4 cup plain flour | 1/2 cup greek yogurt | 1/4 cup light cream of mushroom soup | 1 teaspoon amaretto | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala | 2 tablespoons coffee liqueur
instructions: Mix the flour, yogurt, cream of mushroom soup sauce, amaretto and garam masala in a bowl and add veal cutlets. Mix until well coated. Refrigerate for 15 - 20 minute drain marinade off. Dip cutlets in the marinade and grill till golden brown. Serve with the greek yogurt.

title: Easy and Delicious Beef Brisket
ingredients: 300 g flank steak | 2 teaspoons chili flakes ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon dried arbol chile | 20 ml hot pepper sauce or 20 ml tabasco sauce
instructions: Cut steaks into 3/4´´´´´´s length. Make sure to remove all the fat and sinew. Combine pepper sauce and chile flakes. Brush on both sides of flank steak. Heat up fry pan over high heat. When it is very hot, place beef in the pan. Sprinkle with about a 1 - 2 tablespoons chilli sauce when finished cooking.

title: Ranch Beef
ingredients: 1/2 lb lean trimmed beef tenderloin | 6 cups russet potatoes, pared, quartered | 3 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1 1/2 cups cranberry juice | 1/2 cup chopped fresh meat
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 f. Trim beef and cut into 3/4 inch cubes. Combine meat and potatoes in large, shallow baking dish. Pour oil over meat and potatoes. Cover and bake 30 minutes. Add cranberry juice. Bake 15 to 20 minutes longer, until meat is browned. Serve on large platter with tomato salsa and shredded carrots. Salsa, simmer the broth and juice in saucepan until reduced by half and carrots are tender.

title: Coconut Carrots
ingredients: 1 can coconut milk | 1 can condensed beef broth | 2 pounds carrots, sliced thin
instructions: Blend the coconut milk, beef broth, and carrot slices in a blender. Continue cooking at least 30 minutes to an hour, until carrots are tender and mixture is creamy. Mash the mixture.

title: Chocolate Turnips and Chips
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs turnips or 1 1/2 lbs parsnips, peeled ( i like turnips ) | 1 tablespoon sea salt | 1 tablespoon baking chocolate, chopped | mustard powder | basil leaves ( fresh is best, but curly will work )
instructions: Boil, peel and remove the peel from the turnips. Slice the turnips thinly on the diagnol. Place slices on a parchment paper lined pan. Bake until just tender apprx 15 minutes. Remove the wrap, spread the chips on a large cookie sheet & bake at 425 till golden brown..

title: Baked Tempeh
ingredients: 1 can tempeh | 2 cups shredded colby-monterey jack cheese | 1/4 cup low-fat yogurt | 1/4 cup catsup | 1 tablespoon instant coffee | 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Lightly grease a 9x13 baking dish. Slice tempeh in half horizontally.

title: Vegetable Burgers
ingredients: 1/2 cup vegetable protein powder ( korma ) | 2/3 cup finely cut fresh mushrooms or 2/3 cup canned mushrooms, drained | 2/3 cup finely snipped water chestnut, drained | 1/2 cup fresh breadcrumb | 1 cup finely chopped zucchini | 1 cup sliced fresh mushrooms, drained ( optional )
instructions: Combine vegetable protein and next 4 ingredients in a medium bowl. Cover and chill mixture while preparing other ingredients. Shape mixture into eight 1/4 thick patties 1 inch thick. Combine bread crumbs and zucchini in another medium bowl. Dip patties into bread crumb mixture. Spray a 12 inch nonstick skillet with nonstick spray or add patties and cook over medium heat 3 to 5 minutes per side or until no longer pink.

Random Ingredients: portobello mushroom,garlic salt,italian bread,beef,brown basmati rice,green pepper,banana pepper
title: Beef and Banana Pepper Stuffed Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef | 1 cup brown basmati rice, uncooked or 1 cup brown rice, uncooked | 1 teaspoon garlic salt | 1/4 cup green pepper, sliced | 1/4 cup sliced portobello mushroom | 1 cup sliced bananas and pepper, julienned | 1/4 cup italian-style bread slices, crumbed
instructions: In medium skillet, brown beef, breaking into small pieces, in a small bowl with a fork, drain fat. Combine rice, mushrooms, bananas, and pepper. Place mushrooms on a cutting board, spoon about 1/2 cup rice mixture into each mushroom and sprinkle with garlic salt. Roll mushrooms up, secure with toothpicks or two skewers. Spoon beef mixture onto bottom half of mushrooms. Top with remaining rice mixture and crumbs on top. Cover and set aside to rest for 15 minutes. Preheat the broiler. Place mushrooms, open side up, on a broiler tray. Broil 10 to 15 seconds or until browned and the tops are browned. Serve immediately.

title: Italian Gorgonzola (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 1/2 lb bulk italian sausage | 3/4 cup fat free sour cream | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1 1/2 cups reduced fat sour cream | 1/2 cup gorgonzola, crumbled | 2 large tomatoes, seeded and cut into eighths
instructions: Brown the italian sausage in a 10 inch skillet over medium heat for 5 minutes, breaking it up as it cooks, for about 10 minutes, or until it is no longer pink. Drain any fat from the skillet and add the sour cream, mushroom soup, sour cream, gorgonzola and tomatoes to the sausage. Stir to combine and cook on low 4 hours or high 4 hours or until heated through. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: hot italian sausage link,amarula cream liqueur,brown sugar,spinach,brandy,sunflower oil,wheat pasta
title: Spinach Caramel Sausage Pasta
ingredients: 1/3 cup sunflower oil | 1 1/2 lbs hot italian sausage links, casings removed ( the links can vary in size ) | 1 package fresh spinach, washed ( loose leaves and tender stalks ) | 2 cups brandy, divided in half ( or to taste, can use rum if you wish ) | 1 cup soft brown sugar | 1/3 cup amarula cream liqueur | 4 cups hot cooked whole wheat pasta, pasta recommended ( dreamfields'recommended ) | brandy or rum
instructions: In a large pan over medium heat add the oil and sausage links and cook until the sides have dark golden color. Stir the spinach and half the brandy or rum into the sausage cooking, then remove from the heat. In a 2 qt. Saucepan add the remaining half of the brandy or rum and cook until the brandy is reduced by half. Toss the cooked pasta with the sausage and remaining rum. Add the drained spinach and remaining brandy. Cook until heated through and heated through again. Season with remaining sugar to taste. Serve warm or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: noodle,shiitake mushroom,celery root,oregano leaf,lime juice zest,polish sausage
title: Lomo Saltado
ingredients: 1 package thin noodles | 2 lbs polish sausage, sliced 1/4 inch thick | 2 1/2 lbs dried shiitake mushrooms | 2 1/2 tablespoons white lime juice, from a large lime | 3 stalks celery root, cut in 1/2 inch slices | 2 teaspoons finely chopped fresh oregano leaves
instructions: In a large pot with a tight fitting lid add the noodles, mushrooms, lime juice zest and celery root. Place the lid on top of the pot and on the heat to high, making sure the lid is completely closed. As soon as the lid is open, place the pot of noodles in the freezer. When the noodles are almost done, drain them and rinse them under cold water. Put them back in the pot that they were cooked in and bring to a boil. Cover the pot and transfer the pot to the lowest possible heat. Cook the noodles until they are tender but not falling apart. When the noodles have cooled a bit and they are cool enough to handle, cut them in thirds. Note, you may put the sliced sausage up to 5 days in the freezer and then store the bags in the freezer bags. When ready to serve, reheat the noodles. You can also heat them in the oven. Serve the noodles warm, with salt, pepper, and lime juice.

Random Ingredients: cucumber,liquid honey,vanilla,broccoli,white raisin,red currant jelly,spanish onion
title: Welsh Cucumber Salad
ingredients: 1 seedless cucumber, finely shredded | 1/2 small red currant jelly, softened | 1/4 cup white raisins | 1 spanish onion, sliced thinly | 1 1/2 cups mixed greens ( such as spinach, kale, or bibb ) | 1 teaspoon fresh vanilla ( optional ) | liquid honey
instructions: Cut cucumber into matchstick strips on serving platter. Place red currant jelly, raisins, and onion in a med. Sliced crosswise.

title: St. Patrick's Day Chicken
ingredients: 8 chicken cutlets ( i use 3 boneless strips and 4 bone in, i cut them at least 3/4 inch thick ) | 24 ounces dried cranberries | 0.5 can artichoke hearts ( drained ) | celery salt
instructions: Rinse the chicken pieces and place in a large zip lock bag. Pour cranberries and artichokes over the chicken. Sprinkle lightly with celery salt. Seal the bag and turn over to coat the chicken evenly. Refrigerate overnight. Cook on the grill. I grill the chicken until cooked. I also remove after the last 15 minutes of cooking time and top with my favorite salad vegetables. You can also add cooked carrots, mushrooms or even spinach if you like,.

title: Puerto Rican Espresso Snack (Tasti Espresso Ciabatta)
ingredients: 2 teaspoons instant espresso | 1/2 - 1 loaf portuguese bread
instructions: Prepare espresso, espresso machine or coffee maker according to manufacturer’s instructions. Cut the loaf in half lengthwise and hollow out the bread leaving 1/2 inch shell. Using a melon baller, scrape out the outside of the shell and make a cavity using your fingers. Spoon in espresso. Serve immediately and let cool. Refrigerate for up to 2 day.

Random Ingredients: sesame oil,lemon pepper,cumin seed,dill seed,oat,pork tenderloin,caster sugar,sourdough bread
title: Lori's Pork Kebabs
ingredients: 1 pork tenderloin, cut into 1 inch cubes, then cut into 1 inch cubes | 1/2 teaspoon cumin seed | 1/2 teaspoon dill seed | 1/4 teaspoon lemon pepper | 1/4 teaspoon dried dill seeds | 1/4 teaspoon caster sugar | 3 slices hearty rolled oats | 1 -2 tablespoon sesame oil | 1 -2 tablespoon caster sugar | sourdough bread, to serve
instructions: Place all of the ingredients in a medium dry frying pan and cook over a medium heat on the stove until the pork is cooked, stirring occasionally. Turn off the heat and allow to cool for five minutes. Place the cooled pork into a large bowl and pour over the spices. Serve or keep warm until serving.

title: Garlic Bread on the Half Shell
ingredients: 4 loaves french bread | 1/2 small garlic clove, cut in half
instructions: Remove crusts from four loaves of bread and discard. Split the loaf by scoring each half of loaf on the diagonal. Cut a slit down the middle of each loaf to within one inch of where the loaf was sliced. Insert the garlic clove into the cut of bread. Wrap the bread in heavy duty foil.

title: Quick Black Beans in Tortillas
ingredients: 1 can white beans, drained and rinsed | 12 flour tortillas | salt & pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Place 1 tortilla in the bottom of a glass baking dish. Spread beans on top. Layer half of the tortilla. Spread remaining beans on top of tortilla. Spread salt & pepper on. Repeat two more times. Bake at 350 degrees for 25 minutes, until well browned.

Random Ingredients: beef stock,turmeric powder,red potato,red wine,icing sugar,blueberry
title: Blueberry Scented Red Potatoes
ingredients: 8 red potatoes | 6 tablespoons icing sugar | 250 ml beef stock | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 150 ml red wine | 150 g blueberries
instructions: Peel the red potatoes in 1cm strips. Cut each strip lenghtways into 4 equal portions. Place 2 tbsp of icing sugar, 5cm/3/4 cups red wine & 1/2 tsp of turmeric in a bowl. Place potatoes in a bowl & cover with saran wrap. Place the remaining wine & the 4 portions of icing sugar in another bowl. Add the butter & cream lightly.

Random Ingredients: serrano chili pepper,eggplant,mccormick seasoning,cardamom pod,rotel tomato,red food coloring,muenster cheese
title: Mexican Eggplant and Chiles
ingredients: 1 large eggplant | 1/2 cup chopped serrano chili pepper | 1 1/2 teaspoons mccormick's montreal brand steak seasoning or 1 1/2 teaspoons maggi seasoning | 4 cardamom pods | 4 drops red food coloring ( optional ) | 1 can rotel tomatoes ( 1-1/2 cups ) | 1/2 cup shredded muenster cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Brush both sides of the peeled eggplant with seasoning and place in large baking pan, sprayed with cooking spray. Bake until eggplant is tender, stirring occasionally, 15 - 20 minutes. Stir in tomatoes and simmer 2 minutes. Sprinkle cheese over the top.

title: Sweet Potatoes Casserole
ingredients: 2 lbs baking potatoes, peeled | 1 tablespoon cream of tartar | 2/3 cup brown sugar | 2/3 cup double cream | 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon or 1/2 teaspoon nutmeg ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place potatoes in a saucepan of boiling water and boil for 20 minutes, or until just tender. Drain potatoes and let cool under running water. Remove any skin and grated rind and mash with cream of tarter and sugar. In a small mixing bowl, beat the cream of tartar with the cinnamon or nutmeg until stiff. Fold into the potato mixture gently. Spread in a greased and floured oval or square baking dish. Bake 30 minutes. Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

title: Hot Cheese, Pear & Swiss Steak Fritters
ingredients: 4 large cucumbers, seeded and sliced 1/8 inch thick | 4 medium pears, cored, peeled, and sliced ( about 5 cups ) | 7 ounces swiss cheese, grated | 1/2 cup fat-free swiss cheese ( about 5 ounces ) | 2 packages refrigerated biscuit ( about 12 1-ounce packages ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons finely grated lemon peel
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Grease 2 large nonstick skillet or wok. In one bowl combine the cucumbers, pears, cheese, swiss cheese, and lemon peel. Stir to blend. In each of 2 bowls place 1 biscuit package, 1 1/2 tsp lemon peel, and about 1/4 cup cheese mixture. Top with 1/2 cup cheese mixture. Repeat process with remaining ingredients. Use a slotted spoon or a long handled spatula to transfer to the hot platter. Serve immediately or refrigerate until service.

title: Cauliflower and Salmon Cocktail
ingredients: 6 salmon fillets, cut into four pieces | 1 can red kidney beans | 1 head cauliflower | 1 can clams with juice
instructions: Place all ingredients in a large ceramic casserole dish. Cover and cook in a moderate oven for approximately 40 minutes.

title: Mexican Chocolate Truffles
ingredients: 350 g plain flour | 35 g cocoa | 1 teaspoon coriander seed, freshly crushed | 25 300 g extra plain flour | 35 g triple sec or 3 -4 drops rum extract ( optional )
instructions: Place all the cake ingredients in food processor and process. With mixer running slowly, add all the treacle mixture and process again. Turn onto lightly floured surface. Knead lightly and roll out thinly. Use to line and lightly greased trays. Place on the tray and score top with a knife. Bake in a moderately hot oven for 10 - 15 minutes. Serve with melted butter, cream or ice cream.

title: Creole Chicken Fingers
ingredients: 1 tablespoon corn oil | 1/2 cup chopped onion | 600 g chicken thigh fillets, cutlets | 2 teaspoons molasses | 150 g pimientos, drained | 1 packet ladyfinger cookies
instructions: Heat oil in heavy pan over medium high heat. Add onion and cook gently, stirring, for 3 minutes. Increase heat. Add chicken and stir fry for 5 minutes or until browned. Add molasses, pimentos and biscuits and stir just until biscuits and pimentos are heated through. Serve immediately with a rice dish and green salad.

title: Macadamia and Chicken Skewers
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs chicken thighs, trimmed of fat | 10 ounces broccoli florets | 2 ounces roasted macadamia nuts | 8 ounces prosciutto | 1 large apple, cored and cut into 8 slices | 7 fluid ounces hot golden syrup, made from 2 tablespoons of honey
instructions: Soak the dried wooded mushrooms and macadamia nuts in 3 cups boiling water for 10 minutes. Cut each piece of chicken in half lengthways, then cut into 3 pieces. Thread the chicken and the broccoli onto skewers, placing them between 2 sheets of greaseproof paper, allowing 1cm between. Cut the apple into 8 slices. Wrap the ham and bacon around the chicken skewers. Combine the golden syrup and honey in a small bowl and pour into a pan. Bring to the boil and slowly bring the liquid into the sauce, whisking all the time. Cook over medium heat for 3 - 5 minutes, or until the sauce has reduced slightly and is very thick. Spoon onto the chicken and broccoli skewers and serve.

title: Papa cabbage with chilies
ingredients: 5 fresh green chilies, chopped | 3 heads napa cabbage
instructions: In a large pot with enough water to cover, boil the napa cabbage for 30 minutes or until it begins to wilt. Drain. Place the napa cabbage in a serving bowl and toss with chilies. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: taco seasoning mix,kiwi fruit,bread,egg yolk,whipping cream,tart apple
title: Apple Crunch
ingredients: 1 ripe tart apple, peeled, cored, and cut into small chunks | 1 kiwi fruit, peeled and cut into large chunks | 1 packet taco seasoning mix | 5 cups shredded bread | 1 carton whipping cream | 2 egg yolks
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place the apple chunks into a small bowl. Sprinkle with taco seasoning. In a separate bowl, combine the bread with the cream. When the oven is nearly to temperature, place the egg yolks in a small metal bowl and whip with a fork until fluffy. Pour the egg batter into a 10x14 inch baking dish, about 1/3 cup per layer. Sprinkle top with taco seasoning coating. Pour fruit over bread batter. Bake for 30 - 40 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Jamaican-Style Kale
ingredients: 1/2 pound kale - washed, stemmed and coarsely chopped | 1 cup pitted, chopped dates | 1/3 cup extra-virgin olive, drained | 2 jalapeno chile peppers, seeded | 4 cups egg substitute | 1 tablespoon chopped pitted olives, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add kale and cook until wilted, about 3 minutes. Drain, squeezing out excess water. Tear kale into pieces or shred. In a large bowl, combine kale, dates, olives and chile peppers. Heat remaining 2 cups of water to boiling in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the cabbage mixture, bring to boil, and cook 2 to 3 minutes, or until slightly thickened. Spoon mixture over kale mixture. Garnish with additional chopped olives if desired.

title: Pineapple Swiss Steak
ingredients: 5 thin slices prosciutto | 1 bottle picante sauce | 1/2 cup pineapple juice
instructions: Place one slice of the prosciutto on a cutting board. Place it between two sheets of heavy plastic wrap, and pound with a mallet to 1/2 inch thickness. Spread one side of each slice of cheese with half the picante sauce, and top with the other slice of cheese. Place the top of the cheese on the prosciutto, and roll into a sausage shape.

title: Habanero Jelly
ingredients: 2 cups sweet habanero sauce ( i've even used jalepeno! ) | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon pure vanilla essence ( or to your taste- i keep mine in the fridge for at least 2 hrs. )
instructions: Mix habenero sauce and puree until smooth. I use my magic bullet. You can add vanilla extract also if you like it sweeter. Pour hot jelly into jelly jars, cap on and rotate for storage. Keep in the fridge and use as directed.

Random Ingredients: spice,rice vinegar,heavy cream,tomato ketchup,horseradish,red pepper,cream tartar
title: Tomato Cream Sauce
ingredients: 16 ounces tomato ketchup | 14 ounces sour cream or 14 ounces creme fraiche, sour cream | 14 ounces heavy cream | 3 tablespoons rice vinegar | 2 teaspoons horseradish | 1 teaspoon mixed spice | 1 pinch red pepper | 1/2 teaspoon cream of tartar
instructions: Mix everything together. Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.

title: Chocolate Mousse
ingredients: 4 cups chopped chocolate | 8 cans chopped red chilies | 8 ounces grated cheddar cheese
instructions: Place everything in a blender, and process until a thick paste is formed. Chill until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: green bean,thyme sprig,salsa,tomatillo salsa,banana pepper,strawberry jam
title: Fresh Green Bean Salsa
ingredients: 3 cups cooked green beans ( about 8 cups ) | 2 medium ripe tomatillos, husked, rinsed, and coarsely chopped | 1 medium ripe banana pepper, chopped | 1/3 cup green salsa ( mild or medium ) | 2 large fresh thyme sprigs or 1 teaspoon dried thyme | mango salsa, garnish ( optional )
instructions: For salsa, in a blender, purée the tomatoes in the green salsa until thick. For guacamole and topping, with a knife, coarsely chop the guacamole. To other ingredients, stir in the salsa. Serve immediately, on the side of a warm lettuce leaf with a dollop of salsa on the side.

title: Crown Beef
ingredients: 1 teaspoon cointreau liqueur | 1 celery rib, halved | 1 1/2 lbs stewing beef, cut into 10 cubes
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°. Combine cointreau and celery.

title: Egyptian White Beans
ingredients: 1 lb dried navy beans | 1/4 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 1 dash ground cinnamon
instructions: Wash and sort beans. Soak in a large dish of water for a few hours. Drain and put in a large crockpot with lots of water. Add a dash of ginger garlic paste and a dash of cinnamon. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Cook on high for 4 hours or on low for 8 hours.

Random Ingredients: sage,thai red curry paste,chili pepper,horseradish,vegetable oil cooking spray,apple cider,brown onion,mango
title: Apple Cider Sauce With Dipping Sauces and Mango Mango Chips.
ingredients: 1 tablespoon minced fresh thyme or 1 tablespoon minced fresh sage, plus 2 tablespoons to serve | 2 teaspoons thai red curry paste | 1 cup apple cider, cider ( not apple juice ) | 2 tablespoons minced fresh gingerroot or 3 tablespoons grated fresh ginger | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil or 2 tablespoons cooking spray | 2 tablespoons minced brown onions or 2 tablespoons red shallots | 1 -2 tablespoon chopped chili peppers ( can be omitted if using chili peppers that have a kick ) | mango slice, to serve
instructions: In a small bowl combine the thyme, curry paste and apple cider and let sit at room temperature. In a 1/3 cup measure combine the gingerroot, oil, onions and chiles. Mix all together well and set aside. In a small bowl combine the apple cider/liquid and stir with the curry paste mixture. Set aside. In a medium bowl combine the cider mixture and the mustard mixture. Mix to combine. Serve with the mango slices.

title: Simple Stuffed Shells
ingredients: 10 ounces jumbo pasta shells | 2 tablespoons finely chopped pecans | 2 slices prosciutto | 20 toothpicks
instructions: Heat oven to 450 degrees. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook pasta shells in boiling water for 10 to 12 minutes, or until cooked through. Drain. Meanwhile, stir pecans into prosciutto. Stuff shells with 1 teaspoon pecans mixture. Place a toothpick on top of each shell, and place in the oven. Bake 10 minutes in the preheated oven, until golden, and juices run clear.

title: Golden and Bleu Chicken
ingredients: 1 whole chicken, cut into 8 pieces | 8 ounces beef tenderloin, cut into 8 pieces | 8 tablespoons golden syrup | 2 teaspoons asafoetida powder | 2 teaspoons italian parsley, chopped
instructions: Place chicken, beef, golden syrup, asafoetida, and chopped parsley in crockpot. Cover and cook on low for 8 hours. Drain off fat through a sieve. Serve warm.

title: Cornmeal Crisp With Sweet and Smokies
ingredients: 1 large beef brisket | 1 bunch asparagus, cut in 2 | 2 apples, chopped | 1/2 cup baby carrots | 1 package firm tofu | 1 1/2 teaspoons kosher salt | 1 tablespoon garlic salt | 1 cup cornmeal
instructions: Season brisket with garlic salt. Place cornmeal in ziploc bag with 1/2 cup cold water. Shake bag so it goes all the way around the meat. Place in skillet and cook indirectly for 1 1/2 hours. Use a meat thermometer to check for doneness. While meat is cooking, make sweet and smokies. Sauté the apples and carrots in a bit of oil over medium high heat for about 5 minutes, stirring the carrots and apples a few times.

Random Ingredients: chili pepper,whipping cream,nutmeg,cod fish fillet,sauce,bamboo shoot
title: Cod in Green Sauce
ingredients: 4 cod fish fillets or ( 6 ounce ) haddock fillets | 1 cup whipping cream | 1/4 cup chopped bamboo shoot ( canned, drained ) | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon fresh grated nutmeg | 2 teaspoons hot sauce | 1/4 teaspoon worcestershire sauce
instructions: Wash and dry the fish fillets. Place in a baking dish. Mix sour cream, bamboo shoots, worcestershire sauce, chili pepper and nutmeg in small bowl. Pour over fish. Cover and marinate in the refrigerator 1 to 12 hours, shaking the fish 2 or 3 times. Sprinkle with remaining nutmeg before serving, if desired.

Random Ingredients: fontina cheese,cake flour,white flour,half cream,chickpea flour,celery
title: Creamy Chive Soup With Cream
ingredients: 6 ounces fontina cheese, grated | 6 ounces chickpea flour | 8 ounces white flour | 4 ounces half-and-half cream | celery, finely diced celery for garnish
instructions: You will probably have to do this in batches. This is just to thin the soup a bit. Mix the three milks together, adding the fontina cheese. When your cheese mixture is lukewarm add the chickpea, flour, half and half into soup and beat well. Heat slowly to boiling point, but not boiling. Pour into bowls and top with celery if desired.

title: Champagne Lovers
ingredients: 4 slices prosciutto | 1 bottle orgin
instructions: Place prosciutto into hot small, heavy skillet over low heat. Cook until lightly brown, about 2 minutes on each side. Pour orgin into serving platter. Ladle hot gin on platter. Serve immediately with fresh french bread.

title: Avocado Fried Rice
ingredients: 1/2 cup rice wine or 1/2 cup dry sherry | 4 medium sized hass avocados, sliced | 1 small unpeeled orange, peeled of membrane and cut in half | 1/2 teaspoon baking powder
instructions: Peel avocados and place in shallow dish. Add orange peel and seasonings and cover tightly. Set aside for 30 minutes. Place rice wine or sherry in a small pot, set to simmer over med heat. Add avocados and heat through. Ladle hot rice into small ovenproof dishes and serve.

title: Vanilla Creme
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups whipping cream | 1/4 cup sweet vermouth
instructions: In a saucepan over medium heat, stir cream and vermouth together. When cream has warmed, divide cream into 24 equal portions, each portion equally. Using a slotted spoon, transfer each portion to a bowl of ice water.

title: Tex-Mex Vermicelli With Vermicelli
ingredients: 5 cups water | 2 1/2 lbs vermicelli | 12 celery ribs | 1 cup mild picante sauce
instructions: In a medium skillet, bring 1 cup water to a boil, add vermicelli, stir and remove from heat. Let stand 5 minutes. Place in bowls, draining the pasta well, and toss with remaining tablespoon of water. Rinse with cold water until dry.

title: Beef Tenderloin Sticks
ingredients: 1 can or bottle beer | 2 teaspoons garlic salt | 16 beef tenderloin, scored well
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. In a medium bowl, mix beer and garlic salt together. Brush roast with beer mixture.

title: Bolo De Lima (Mango Barley Drink)
ingredients: 2 cups fresh mango, cut into chunks | 1 can barley ( or brown rice )
instructions: Put mango chunks in blender. Add 1 1/2 1/2 cups of barley, or brown rice, and blend for about 4 seconds, until everything is combined.

Random Ingredients: molasses,vegetable stock,cream mushroom soup,blueberry preserve,italian bread,horseradish,aromatic bitter
title: Creamy Italian Bread Salad Recipe
ingredients: 1 loaf italian bread ( or 2 cups sourdough, rustic bread ) | 2 cans condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 1/2 cups vegetable stock | 1/4 cup molasses | 1/3 cup prepared horseradish | 1/2 cup blueberry preserves ( or any preserves of your choice ) | 1 tablespoon aromatic bitters ( optional )
instructions: Slice bread lengthwise into thick slices and arrange on baking sheet. Bake at 350 degrees, uncovered, for about 5 minutes per side, until lightly browned and slightly crusty. Allow to cool slightly then transfer bread and cool. Combine remaining ingredients until well blended. Drain bread slices and top with cheese mixture and bread. You may have to add more olive oil and/or milk if bread has been sliced thinly. Serve with sour cream.

title: Cheesy Fondue
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1 tablespoon italian seasoning | 1 1/2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa ( optional ) | 8 slices french bread, cut into 3/4 inch slices | 8 slices fresh mushrooms ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa ( optional ) | tortillas, heated
instructions: Heat soup, italian seasoning and cocoa in medium saucepan. Toast french bread.

title: Salmon Fillets With Hazelnut-Glazed Quinoa and Mashed Hazelnut Cheese
ingredients: 600 g salmon fillets, skin on | 3 teaspoons vegetable oil | 2 cups buttermilk | 250 g quinoa, rinsed | 600 g smoked pork loin, thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons sour cream | 200 g hazelnuts, roughly chopped | 1 cup roasted salted hazelnuts
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200c/180c fan and gas cook the salmon fillet in the oil for 2 - 3 minutes each side until the salmon is just cooked through. Rinse the quinoa and add it to the pan and stir. Bring to the boil and then reduce the heat, cover and simmer for 15 minutes. While the quinoa is cooking, prepare the hazelnut cheese sauce. Blend the hazelnuts and roasted hazelnuts until they are very roughly chopped and then transfer them to a pestata. Once the salmon is cooked, transfer the salmon fillet into an ovenproof dish and drizzle over the hazelnut sauce. Season well and bake for 15 - 20 minutes until golden brown on top. Serve with the grilled quinoa and remaining hazelnut sauce.

Random Ingredients: creme fraiche,creole seasoning,pineapple juice,tomato puree,tofu,green onion
title: Tofu Crepes
ingredients: 12 ounces soft tofu, drained and cubed | 1/4 cup creole seasoning | 1 cup pineapple juice | 2 tablespoons tomato puree | 1 small green onion, chopped | 1 1/2 cups creme fraiche
instructions: Combine all ingredients except for the creme fraiche in a medium bowl. Add the creme fraiche and mix until the mixture is smooth. Heat a non stick pan over low heat, drizzle with oil and pour about 1/4 cup of the mixture into the pan. The idea is to make one thin pancake at a time and add to the pan as you go. Each one should take about 1 minute per side, but you don't have to be exact.

title: Spaetzle Tacos
ingredients: 2 packages taquitos or ( 6 ounce ) packages taco shells | 1 jar low-fat tamari, reduced-fat is fine | 1 lb ground beef | 2 cups low-fat frozen whipped topping, thawed
instructions: Heat oven to 375 degrees. Spray 13x9x2 inch glass baking dish with cooking spray.

Random Ingredients: dark brown sugar,pea,chocolate pudding mix,craisins,green bean
title: Creamy  Chocolate  and Raisin Peas Casserole
ingredients: 1 package chocolate pudding mix | 1/2 cup seedless raisins | 1 can green beans, drained and rinsed ( about 2/3 1/3 pound ) | 1 package frozen peas ( about 1 pound ) | 2 teaspoons dark brown sugar, packed
instructions: Arrange green beans and peas in a lightly buttered 11x6x2 inch glass baking dish. Sprinkle gelatin mix over the peas. Pour gelatin over the top of the other ingredients. Mix brown sugar with a wooden spoon or whisk to blend. Sprinkle gelatin mixture over the top, and press evenly over the top of the fruit mixture. Cover the dish tightly with plastic wrap. Refrigerate overnight to set, stirring occasionally. Serve plain or mix with whipped cream, if desired.

Random Ingredients: grain white rice,coconut extract,green bell pepper,coconut
title: Coconut Rice
ingredients: 1 cup long grain white rice ( about 1.5 ounces ) | 1 green bell pepper, chopped | 1 can flaked coconut | 1 teaspoon coconut extract
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions.

Random Ingredients: pineapple chunk,white cake mix,baby clam,coriander powder,poblano chile,lime juice zest,cardamom
title: Grilled Clam Cake
ingredients: 12 baby clams, scrubbed, with liquor left in dish | 10 poblano chiles, halved | 3 fresh poblano chiles, halved | 1 container pineapple chunks, drained | 1 1/2 cups white cake mix | 1 1/2 tablespoons lime juice or 1 1/2 tablespoons lemon juice | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom
instructions: In a large skillet, place the clams with their liquor on medium heat. Discard any clams that do not open. Turn up grill heat to high and place poblanos in a single layer on hot grill. The skin may scorch on the top. Cook for 3 minutes. Turn, rearranging poblanos. Spread the poblanos out on a piece of paper towel in a large paperbag. Cover with another paper bag and press out excess moisture from the skillet with paper towels. Grill 3 or 4 minutes or until done, turning once. Remove from grill, cool 5 minutes and remove skins with a large spoon. Place unopened clams in a food processor fitted with the metal blade and process until minced. To open clam shell, place on a plate, shell side down, and set aside. Place chiles in pan with reserved clam liquor. Cover and let chill 15 minutes. Remove rinds with rubber gloves to remove excess moisture. Remove membrane and discard. Slice each chile in half lengthwise and scrape out the veins and seeds. Place the shell on a plate, spread with about 6 tablespoons of the reserved clam liquor mixture. Grill poblanos, chiles side by side, until tender and lightly charred, 15 to 20 seconds total. Transfer to a plate and set aside. To prepare the clams, add pineapple chunks to a food processor and pulse til very smooth. Set aside. In a mixing bowl, combine cake and lime juice. Whisk in the cardamom. Sprinkle the clams with the mixture, pressing down slightly. Add the clams in their shells. Spray grill rack with vegetable oil. Remove paper bag and plate. Place rack over grill and close lid. Grill clams, turning until clams open and topping is light grill marks, 4 to 5 minutes. Transfer to a platter and cover lightly with foil. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: black pepper,onion soup mix,taco seasoning mix,cocoa,sesame oil
title: Taco Cookies
ingredients: 1 package dry onion soup mix | 1 packet dry taco seasoning mix | 2 tablespoons cocoa ( optional, or use 1 tbsp instant coffee powder or coffee flavored instant tea ) | 1/2 teaspoon black pepper | 1/2 teaspoon sesame oil
instructions: Combine all ingredients in medium bowl, using one tablespoon at a time for a thicker, richer sauce. Form into desired number of smaller, thinner cookies on the larger side of the cookie, or place small portions on parchment, wax paper, or silpat. Place in warm oven, close the door, and bake for about 20 minutes, or until edges are dark brown. Flip the cakes over, and bake for another 5 minutes, just until golden brown on the tops.

title: Indian Spiced Carrots
ingredients: 1/2 kg carrot ( peeled and quartered ) | 1 bunch fresh coriander ( leaves picked, stalks reserved for garnish )
instructions: Peel the carrot and cut the stalk into 1cm cubes. Place it in a bowl, add the coriander stalks and toss to combine. Place the carrot and coriander stalks on a baking paper lined tray and sprinkle with salt. Bake at 190oc for about 20 minutes, or until tender.

title: Guacamole Crust
ingredients: 1 tablespoon quick-rising yeast | 1 cup guacamole | 1/2 cup madeira wine or 1/2 cup port wine | 1 teaspoon coriander
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a mixing bowl. Work dough until smooth, about 5 minutes. Pour into a greased 8 or 10 pan. Press dough evenly over bottom and up the sides of the pan. Cover with waxed paper and allow to rise in a warm area until doubled in size, about 90 minutes. Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Poke holes in loaf with a fork. Bake until brown, about 15 minutes.

title: Lettuce and Broccoli Salad (Julia Child)
ingredients: 1/2 cup fresh broccoli florets | 3/4 cup chilled apricot, chopped | 2 tablespoons brandy or 2 tablespoons cognac | 1/4 cup unsweetened apple cider or 1/4 cup water | 1 1/2 tablespoons peppercorns, whole ( use 1/4 teaspoon if very very spicy ) | 1 head chicory lettuce, cut into 2-inch wedges
instructions: Combine all ingredients in salad bowl, serve right away.

Random Ingredients: veal,chickpea,yellow onion,lime juice zest,colby monterey jack cheese,thyme sprig,brown gravy mix
title: Holiday Glazed Veal With Chickpeas
ingredients: 1 lb veal, in 1 1/2 inch slices ( can sub a combination of both ) | 12 ounces brown gravy mix ( i like liptons ) | 12 ounces chickpeas, canned drained and rinsed ( can sub white chickpeas ) | 1 medium yellow onion, chopped | 1/4 cup fresh lime juice ( i use the juice from 1/4 ) | 1 tablespoon dried thyme sprig | 4 -6 ounces colby-monterey jack cheese, shredded ( or other cheese of choice )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°. Combine gravy mix, chickpeas, and chopped onion in a large baking dish. Bake, covered, for 15 minutes. Combine lime juice and lime rind in a small bowl. Drain chickpeas in colander, rinse with cool water, and mash with fork. Stir into gravy mix. Sprinkle with thyme. Place veal slices in dish. Scatter cheese over top, and bake, covered, for about 25 minutes, or until veal is browned and cheese is bubbly.

title: Roasted and Shred Red Cabbage
ingredients: 2 lbs red cabbage | 1 zucchini, halved lengthwise
instructions: Cut the cabbage in half crosswise. Remove stem and leaves. Slice crosswise, about 1/4 thick. Toss with zucchini. Place in an ovenproof casserole, cover and bake at 375°f to 1 hour.

title: Cherry Macaroni
ingredients: 2 pounds whole wheat spaghetti | 4 eggs | 1 pound fresh basil, chopped | 4 maraschino cherries, halved
instructions: Cook the spaghetti in a pot of boiling water until tender, about 12 minutes. Drain, and mix with the eggs, basil, and maraschino cherries. Place in a lightly greased 1 1/2 quart baking dish.

Random Ingredients: caper,basil leaf,guajillo chilies,black bean,parsley flake,fruit,beef stew meat
title: Easy Beef Fondue
ingredients: 2 lbs of any size beef stew meat | 1 can black beans ( you can also use pinto or other mexican beans ) | 10 ounces frozen mixed fruit ( or use fruit that is prepared 'charcoal ) | 1/2 cup of thinly sliced drained capers | 2 -3 guajillo chilies, stemmed and seeded ( i use an anaheim-style ) | 1/2 tablespoon dried parsley flakes | 1 tablespoon dried basil leaves
instructions: Drain beef, put them in crockpot. Top with all of your other ingredients. Add water to barely cover. Cook on low for a few hours, stirring a few times with a wooden spoon to make sure there is enough liquid to keep the beef moist. Enjoy.

title: Sausage and Farfalle
ingredients: 750 g stewing beef, sliced | 500 g hot sandwich bread, cut into 1 cm cubes | ice, for serving | 2 tablespoons horseradish, grated | red capsicum, sliced, for serving | pepper, for serving | 350 g farfalle pasta, cooked, drained and kept warm
instructions: Place beef in a large frying pan with a little crushed ice. Cook quickly over high heat until lightly browned. Remove beef and slice into strips and place in a large bowl. Add some horseradish, red capsicum, pepper and some pepper. Toss with farfalle pasta just before serving.

title: Radish, Onion & Lime Soup
ingredients: 1 package golden mushroom soup | 1/2 bunch fresh radish, sliced | 1 lime, zest of ( or lime zest )
instructions: Place all the ingredients in a large microwave safe bowl and cook for 5 minutes on high. Serve.

title: Easy Orzo Salad
ingredients: 3 1/4 cups orzo pasta, dry | 1 bunch scallion, chopped | 1 teaspoon black cardamom pod, crushed | 1/2 cup crumbled feta
instructions: Prepare orzo by bringing 4 cups water to a boil. Let cool slightly. Meanwhile, combine the scallions, cardamom, and feta in a large bowl. Drain the orzo to remove excess water and transfer to the bowl. Add scallions and feta and toss to combine. Serve warm or cold.

Random Ingredients: fettuccine,ricotta cheese,dijon mustard,yellow mustard seed,candy sprinkle,bread flour,french onion soup
title: St. Paddy's Day Fettuccine Bites
ingredients: 2 cups bread flour | 1/4 cup yellow mustard seeds | 1 teaspoon dijon mustard | 1/4 cup french onion soup ( i prefer mushroom style ) | 12 ounces ricotta cheese | 1/3 cup low fat sour cream or 1/3 cup light sour cream | 6 -8 ounces ready made french-fried onions
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. In large bowl mix, bread flour, mustard seed, onion soup, and ricotta cheese together. Make a well in center and pour batter in well. Add french fried onion and combine well. Pour mixture into 2 greased pie pans or cookie sheets, or a 14 x 9 x 2 inch pan. Bake for 30 minutes or until golden.

title: Homemade Enchilada Sauce
ingredients: oil for frying | 1 can enchilada sauce, divided
instructions: Heat oil in a skillet over medium heat, and pour 1/2 can of enchilada sauce into a blender. Pour in remaining can of enchilada sauce and stir. Pour enough sauce into a large bowl to almost fill up the can. Tear chunks of the reserved enchilada sauce from the can and place into the blender. Blend to make a sauce. Once thoroughly mixed, pour the sauce into a saucepan and simmer. Pour remaining enchilada sauce into a shallow bowl, leaving about 1 inch of headroominess at top. Cover with a cloth, and place into the refrigerator. Stir sauce every so often to keep the sauce from sticking, and to help remove any remaining liquid. Serve with shredded cheese of your choice.

Random Ingredients: green curry paste,ketjap manis,cheddar cheese,lettuce leaf,black bean
title: Quick Thai Cheese Salad
ingredients: 2 tablespoons ketjap manis | 2 -3 tablespoons green curry paste | 6 leaves lettuce leaves, washed and dried | 2 cans black beans, drained and rinsed | 1 cup aged cheddar cheese, shredded
instructions: Place in a mixing bowl.

title: Margarita Ladyfinger Sandwiches
ingredients: 2 cans sliced beets | 1 cup crushed fresh tomatoes with lime | 24 ladyfingers | 1/2 cup olive oil, divided | 1/3 cup finely chopped red onion | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 1/3 cup lime juice, divided
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Slice beets in half lengthwise, remove stems, and cut into 6 to 8 thin slices. Place beets into a bowl and mash with a fork until thoroughly mashed. Stir in crushed tomatoes. Spread 1 1/2 tablespoons crushed tomatoes into bottom of a 13x9 inch glass baking dish. Layer 2 ladyfingers with beet mixturter, 2 to 3 tablespoons of olive oil, and a handful of crumbled tomato. Arrange 4 to 5 tablespoons of mashed potato on potato. Arrange remaining ladyfingers on top of beet mixture. Drizzle with 1 1/2 tablespoons lime juice.

title: Hot German Applesauce
ingredients: 1 small ham hock | 1 can broccoli sauce | 6 -10 medium tart apples | 1 cup nonfat sour cream | 1 1/2 cups dry wine
instructions: Combine all ingredients except for the sour cream in the crockpot on high and stir. Once the crockpot auto ups, allow the apple to cook in 4 to 5 hours, stirring occasionally. The longer the longer it cooks the thicker it will become. Serve over noodles or potatoes. Note, for those adding a touch of extra vegetables try the addition of fresh herbs or other favorite topping.

title: Samoan Beef Ketchup for Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 lb ground sirloin | 1 cup heavy whipping cream | 3 teaspoons ketjap manis
instructions: Combine beef, cream and kecap manis in heavy duty zip top plastic bag. Turn bag over so meat is saturated. Refrigerate, covered, 2 hours, turning bag occasionally. Prepare bbq grill. Remove from bag. Discard marinade. Cook on covered grill 4 - 6 minutes per side for medium. Remove from direct heat. Slice across grain and serve warm.

Random Ingredients: canola oil,dark sesame oil,corn syrup,tomato soup,chili oil,salt pork
title: Tammy's Spicy Sausages
ingredients: 4 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 4 tablespoons canola oil | 1 tablespoon corn syrup | 1 teaspoon dark sesame oil | 6 slices salt pork | 8 ounces condensed tomato soup
instructions: In a small bowl, combine dark oils, corn syrup, sesame oil and salt pork. Using a fork, prick 1 side of each slice of salt pork. On heated oiled skillet, add sausages and coat with sesame mixture. Fry over medium high heat until just cooked through. Pour condensed tomato soup over sausages and serve.

Random Ingredients: green enchilada sauce,taco sauce,serrano chilies,red thai chile,onion powder,chinese cabbage,lemon zest
title: Chile Enchilada (Tastes Authentic)
ingredients: 2 cans green enchilada sauce, divided | 1 teaspoon lemon zest | 1 teaspoon onion powder | 1/4 teaspoon red thai chile, minced | 1 small onion, finely diced | 2 cans red thai chiles, sliced in circles | 2 cans green enchilada sauce | 1/2 lb chinese cabbage, shredded
instructions: Mix all ingredients, except cabbage. Boil approximately 5 minutes, then stir in cabbage. Simmer for 10 more minutes. Serve hot.

title: Pistachio Short Steak for Two
ingredients: 2 rib eye steaks | 1/4 cup lemon juice and zest, fresh, about 3 tablespoons ( about 2 lemons ) | 1/4 cup coarsely chopped toasted shelled pistachios | 4 slices cooked ham ( about 3 ounces )
instructions: Pound steaks to desired thickness. Place steaks in a greased shallow dish. Sprinkle evenly with lemon zest and pistachios. Pour remaining lemon juice over steaks, cover and refrigerate at least 30 minutes to marinate. Preheat grill and grill for 5 minutes. Turn steaks and continue cooking until desired doneness, 3 1/2 to 5 minutes longer. Transfer steaks to a carving board and let rest 5 minutes. Sprinkle with additional lemon juice. Discard marinade. Slice into strips. Serve with a green salad.

Random Ingredients: portabella mushroom,green cardamom pod,strawberry,red potato,feta cheese,italian spice,shortcrust pastry
title: Strawberry & Roasted Red Potatoes
ingredients: 2 large red potatoes, cut into wedges | 1 package frozen strawberries, quartered | 1 jar sliced portabella mushrooms | 1 lb red fat free feta cheese | 2 -3 teaspoons dried italian spices | 2 -3 teaspoons green cardamom pods | 1 package frozen ready-rolled shortcrust pastry, thawed | 1 package reduced fat thawed puff pastry
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Using a large pot, bring a medium pot of salted water to a boil. Add potatoes and boil until soft, about 12 - 15 minutes. Drain and cool. Meanwhile,. Drain strawberries and mushrooms in a strainer.

Random Ingredients: rice wine,baby bok choy,cream cottage cheese,kosher salt black pepper,seasoning salt
title: Smooth Egg Rolls
ingredients: 3 packages baby bok choy | 2 tablespoons seasoned salt | 1 bottle fat-free cream-style cottage cheese | 1/4 bunch chinese green onion top | 1/4 teaspoon kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper | 1 teaspoon rice wine
instructions: Remove the hard stems and leaves from the bok choy, cutting off any large leaves of the woody outer leaves. Place into a colander, rinse and pat dry with paper towels. Cut off the bottom 1/4 inch from the top. Cut out the core and cut off the tough tops with a sharp knife. The leaves will be about 6 inches long and the tops 1 1/2 inches thick. Break off the hard bottom stems only and discard. Carefully trim away and discard the green onion tops. Cut a large slit in each side of each leaf and set aside. In a large bowl, combine the bok choy leaves, seasoned salt, cream style cottage cheese, green onion tops, kosher salt and pepper. Stir until thoroughly combined. Place a teaspoonful of the mixture into the center of each leaf, forming a roll. Wrap the roll into a secure link, place in a shallow baking dish and refrigerate for 2 hours, or until firm. Remove from the refrigerator 30 minutes before cooking, and allow to sit at least 20 minutes before cooking. This can also be done on a grill. When ready to cook, heat an empty wok over high heat for about 2 minutes. Spray with nonstick cooking spray. When it's very hot, add 2 or 3 slices of egg roll mixture, turning to coat with batter. Fry until the egg rolls have browned on all sides, 5 to 10 minutes. Transfer to plates, sprinkle with chinese green onion tops and drizzle with rice wine.

title: Fusilli
ingredients: 1 tablespoon paprika | 1 pound fusilli pasta | 1 can or bottle light beer | 2 1/2 cups heavy whipping cream, divided
instructions: Cook pasta in a large pot of salted boiling water until tender but firm to the bite, stirring occasionally. Drain. While cooking, combine paprika and 1 cup of cream in a small bowl. When pasta is done, drain and return to pot. Add liquid and blend well. Stir in remaining cream, and season with the remaining 1 1/2 cups cream. Serve topped with parsley.

title: Chargrilled Asparagus
ingredients: 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar | 2 teaspoons balsamic vinegar | 2 teaspoons asparagus tips, minced | 2 teaspoons fenugreek seeds | 1 chicken stock cube
instructions: Combine all ingredients except fenugreek in a non metallic bowl. Add the fenugreek seeds and mix thoroughly. Cover with plastic wrap or cling film & leave to sit for 30 minutes or longer. Heat a griddle, or heavy frying pan on medium to high heat. When hot, add the asparagus and cook until golden brown on both sides. Remove asparagus from cooking sheet & set aside in a warm place. Remove the skin & any remaining fennugreek seed from the asparagus using a pestle and mortar. Rinse the asparagus in plenty of water. Place the asparagus on your favourite plate. Pour the vinaigrette over the asparagus. Serve with bread or crackers.

Random Ingredients: lump crabmeat,celery rib,farfalle pasta,parsley,garlic powder,kaffir lime leaf
title: Quick Crab and Kaffir Lime Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb fine egg noodles or 1 lb linguine | 2 cans lump crabmeat or 3 1/2 ounces shredded crabmeat | 1 large celery rib, chopped ( can use onion as well ) | 4 -6 kaffir lime leaves, to taste | chopped fresh parsley, to taste | garlic powder, to taste
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. When drained, set aside in a bowl. Drain crab meat from its liquid in a second bowl. Return pasta to the pot and add crab, celery, kaffir lime leaves and parsley. Mix well. Serve or cover and refrigerate for several hours or overnight. Serve with garlic powder sprinkled on top.

title: Quatre-Egend (Almond Spiced Salad)
ingredients: 350 g ground almonds | 2 teaspoons coriander | 4 teaspoons saffron threads | 1 teaspoon mustard | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne
instructions: Combine the ground almonds, coriander, saffron, mustard and cayenne in a bowl, and mix well. Serve in bowls with chutney to dip.

instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place frozen blueberries in a microwave safe bowl. Microwave on high for 5 minutes, stirring every 30 seconds. Stir in paprika. With a fork, gently stir in chicken bouillon.

instructions: Place coconut, ginger paste, and ½ cup water in food processor and process until smooth. If needed, additional ½ cup water may be added at a time. Serve immediately or refrigerate.

instructions: Place the carrots and 5 quarts of stock in a wide soup pot or dutch oven. Cover and bring to a boil. When the soup begins to foam, simmer slowly and continuously, stirring occasionally, until the soup is very thick and the carrots are very tender, about 20 minutes. Transfer the soup into a blender or food processor. Cool, then refrigerate until chilled, at least 1 day.

title: Japanese Style Sushi Noodles
ingredients: 4 fresh parsnips | 1 cup japanese soy sauce | 1/2 teaspoon chili powder | 1/4 teaspoon saffron | 1 cup golden raisins
instructions: Peel parsnips, being careful not to cut all the way through, and slice them thinly into julienne strips. Stir the noodles into boiling water and cook until al dente, 7 to 10 minutes. Drain in a colander and place on a warmed plate to keep warm while cooking the remaining noodles at the same time. Serve hot, with or without saffron.

title: Tortillas With Dates, Hot Sauce and Mint (Pane Integrale)

Heat until everything is hot and mixed together. Fill each tortilla with the mixture. Place 3 toothpicks in the middle of the tortilla. Fry both sides until golden brown. Serve with hot sauce.

instructions: Toast the poblano in a dry frying pan until lightly blackened on all sides, about 10 minutes. Let cool. Peel it. Cut in half and remove all seeds. Chop coarsely. Toss lightly and serve.

ingredients: 2 lbs baking potatoes ( do not peel or scrub ) | 1/2 teaspoon mustard powder
instructions: Slice potatoes 1/4 to 1/16 thick. Spray cookie sheet with cooking spray. Place potatoes on cookie sheet in one layer.

instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c roll out pastry into a rectangle about 18 x 18 cm. Mix together herbs, rum and baking powder. Spread a thin layer on one half of pastry. Serve hot with warm chinese tea, sweet chilli sauce and sweet pepper or marmalade.

title: Easy Spicy Mashed Potatoes

instructions: Saute quinoa in 3 tbsp oil or clarified butter and 1/2 tsp. Of garam masala till light brown, then fluff with fork stir in rest of ingredients. Simmer on medium low heat till potatoes are soft. Serve hot.

ingredients: 8 slices french bread ( the small thick slices ) | 1 fluid ounce peach schnapps | half-and-half cream
instructions: Toast the french bread. Spread the peach schnapps on the toast. Top the schnapps with half and half cream and enjoy.

instructions: Preheat the oven's broiler and set the oven rack about 6 inches from the heat source. Lightly spray a baking sheet with cooking spray. Flip the tomatoes, then broil for about 1 minute more. Remove from the oven, and let cool slightly. When cool enough to handle, remove the grape tomatoes from the oven and cut into wedges. Remove the grape tomatoes from the oven, and coat with bourbon. Spoon equal amounts of the marinara onto each tomato wedge to cover, and sprinkle generously with strawberries.

title: Penne with Shrimp
ingredients: 200 g penne | 25 g shrimp | 20 g hot szechwan peppers, seeded and coarsely chopped
instructions: Cook the pasta in plenty of boiling water according to the packet instructions. When it is almost cooked, add the shrimp and chilli, and bring to the boil. Once it is, stir in the drained pasta, give a good stir and cook for 3 minutes. Serve.

instructions: In a medium sauce pan with a lid, combine quinoa and half and half. Bring to a simmer, cover and cook over low heat for 10 minutes. Remove from heat. Stir in cherries and set aside. Serve immediately.

title: Baked Lobster with Corn

instructions: Remove shell from lobster and set shell aside. Boil the shells rapidly in a pan with 5 - 7 cups water. Remove tails and claws carefully cut lobster shells in half. Drain. instructions: Slice the shittake mushrooms into 1/4 inch pieces. Slice the chili bean paste into 1/2 inch pieces. Lay shittake mushrooms onto a large platter and top with chili bean paste and chilies.

instructions: Preheat the oven to 300°f. Cut the chicken joints with the grain into three pieces. Cover the platter with foil. Bake until the onions are very tender, about 1 hour 15 minutes. Sprinkle the pork with additional vinegar. Let stand until pork is cooked through, 15 minutes.

instructions: Soak the brisket or pork in cold water overnight. Pat dry with a paper towel or clean cloth and cut in 2 or 3 sections so that you get 8 individual pieces. This will make it even more difficult to consume when you're ready to eat. Make sure to dip the pretzels before your new pretzels. These will need to be kept covered with good icing.

Random Ingredients: pecorino romano cheese,lemon,milk chocolate,marsala wine,rice bran oil
title: Charcoal Griddle Filler
ingredients: 50 ml rice bran oil | 50 ml milk chocolate, grated | 50 ml grated pecorino romano cheese | 25 ml marsala wine | 1/4 teaspoon lemon rind, grated | 2 -4 lemons, cut in wedges
instructions: Brush hot non stick grill pan with non stick cooking spray. Combine rice bran oil and milk chocolate in small saucepan and melt over low heat. Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until mixture is creamy and has thickened slightly. Cool slightly. Add cheese, lemon rind and marsala. Mix well. Cut lemon wedges into 4 to 6 wedges. Fill non stick griddle with hot mixture. Close lid and cook indirectly on grill about 6 minutes or until desired temperature is achieved. Remove from griddle and let rest 2 to 3 minutes. Transfer griddle to plate and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: tri tip steak,beef sirloin steak,eggplant,mustard powder,clove
title: Beef & Eggplant Sandwiches
ingredients: 1/2 cup low-fat beef sirloin steak, sliced | 2 tablespoons red food coloring or 2 tablespoons prepared mustard | 1/2 teaspoon ground cloves | 1 eggplant, sliced into 8 wedges ( about 1 lb. ) | 1 lb beef sirloin steak, sliced | 2 tablespoons fat free egg noodles or 2 tablespoons rice noodles
instructions: Combine marinade ingredients. Add beef slices and leave to marinate in the refrigerator for 30 minutes. Heat a nonstick griddle or pan to a medium high heat. Brush eggplant with glaze and grill, turning once, until browned, about 5 minutes per side. Meanwhile, cook pasta according to package directions. Serve beef over pasta with the eggplant. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Brined Country Style Steak
ingredients: 4 tablespoons creme fraiche | 4 ounces medium barbecue sauce
instructions: Pre heat your oven to 200 degrees c. Put the creme fraiche in an oven proof pan large enough to place the steaks in it. Place the pan in the oven and cook for 10 – 12 minutes or until cooked to your liking. Remove the pan from the oven and turn the steaks over. Place the pan back onto the oven and reheat just until warm. Tip the sauce onto the steaks and allow them to warm up a bit. Turn the slices back in to the pan and serve with mashed potato or vegetables.

Random Ingredients: pineapple chunk,kikkoman teriyaki sauce,chocolate candy bar
title: Pineapple Teriyaki Bars
ingredients: 2 canned pineapple chunks, drained | 2 cups sweetened condensed milk teriyaki sauce | 1 box kikkoman teriyaki sweetened condensed milk & chunks, chilled | 2 cups chocolate candy bars, melted
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Mix the pineapple, sweetened condensed milk and teriyaki sauce together in a bowl until well blended. Arrange the chilled sweetened condensed milk mixture in a 9x13 inch baking pan and smooth the top. Mix the melted chocolate and melted margarine together in a bowl. Drop the bar mixture by tablespoons onto the top of the condensed milk mixture so the bars are coated evenly. Bake for 25 minutes, until the topping is beginning to brown.

Random Ingredients: purpose flour,baking potato,boston lettuce,lite olive oil,thyme sprig,salsa,pork leg,fruit
title: Pork and Potato Dinner
ingredients: 1/4 cup lite olive oil | 1 1/2 lbs pork leg, cut into 1. 5-1/2-inch cubes | 2 large baking potatoes, peeled and cut into 1. 5-1/2-inch cubes | 1/3 cup all-purpose flour | 1 teaspoon all-purpose flour | 3/4 teaspoon dried thyme sprig | salsa ( optional ) | fresh fruit ( optional ) | baby greens ( optional )
instructions: In a large, heavy skillet, warm the oil over moderate heat. Add the pork, increase the heat and cook, stirring occasionally, until it loses its pink color, about 7 minutes. Stir in the salsa and cook, stirring frequently, until the sauce has thickened slightly, about 5 minutes. Remove from the heat. Transfer the pork mixture to a serving dish and garnish with the remaining 1/4 cup of flour and a sprinkle of pepper and serve on top of the rice. Serve with lettuce, greens and salsa.

Random Ingredients: kosher salt black pepper,tzatziki,red curry paste,pork shoulder
title: Spicy and Salty Roasted Pork W. Tzatziki and Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb boneless pork shoulder, trimmed of excess fat | kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper | 1/2 cup kraft tzatziki or 4 tablespoons homemade greek yogurt | 2 teaspoons red curry paste | 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt or 1/2 teaspoon freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit. With a sharp knife, make shallow cuts in the pork shoulder about 1/3 to 1/2 inch deep and almost even the sides. Season each cut with salt and black pepper and place on a large baking sheet. Place the tray in the oven and roast until the pork is falling apart and crispy on the outside but still a little bit pink inside, about 1 hour 10 minutes depending on your oven and desired crispiness, but not too crispy. Meanwhile, make the dipping sauce. In a bowl, stir together tzatziki paste, curry paste and kosher salt. Use a wooden skewer to rub the rub all over the pork, ensuring that the pork gets fully coated. Set aside. Remove the reserved drippings from the oven and dry roast the pork, about 1 hour 20 minutes per pound. Transfer the roast to a platter and serve with dipping sauce.

title: Thai Stir-Fry With Pumpkin
ingredients: 1 cup peeled cubed pumpkin | 2 tablespoons red curry paste | 1 1/2 cups cooked brown basmati rice
instructions: Toss together pumpkin and curry paste in nonstick skillet. Heat over medium high heat until fragrant, about 1 minute. Add half of pumpkin and 1/2 cup water.

Random Ingredients: stove stuffing mix,gruyere cheese,ranch dressing mix,chuck,bread,garnish,jalapeno pepper
title: Texas Beef Fondue Pie from Leftovers!
ingredients: 3 lbs chuck, cooked and shredded | 2 boxes stove top stuffing mix | 1 envelope hidden valley & reg ; original ranch & reg ; dressing mix | 2 1/2 cups shredded gruyere cheese | 2 -3 jalapeno peppers, sliced | 4 slices bread, buttered ( use any hearty bread ) | favorite garnish
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Mix meat, stuffing mix and cheese together, mix until combined well. Spray a 9 inch pie plate with cooking spray or use a 9 x 13 inch baking dish. On each half slice of toast place a slice of cheese and then some of the meat and stuffing mix, top with a drizzle of any favorite ranch dressing or other desired stuffing mix. Random Ingredients: pine nut,beef chuck roast,nicoise olive,garlic clove,adobo seasoning,corn
title: Beef Nicoise With Nicoise Olives and Corn
ingredients: 3 lbs boneless beef chuck roast | 1/2 cup corn, drained | 1 teaspoon adobo seasoning ( i like emeril's southwest seasoning ) | 1/3 cup nicoise olive, stuffed olives soaked in water 10 minutes | 1/2 cup nicoise olive, stuffed olives drained well | 1 -2 garlic clove, minced | 3 tablespoons pine nuts
instructions: Place beef in ovenproof pan and cover. In bowl, mix adobo with 3 tablespoons of the olive oil. Pour over beef and roast in remaining oil and water. Take beef out of oven and cool completely before slicing against the grain of the meat.

Random Ingredients: salt pepper,cilantro stem,almond extract,chicken leg,poblano chile
title: Sensational Chicken Wings
ingredients: 4 chicken legs with thigh | salt and pepper | 2 tablespoons almond extract | 1 poblano chile, roasted ( or canned ) | fresh cilantro stem ( optional )
instructions: Season chicken legs with salt and pepper. Spread almond extract on both sides. Place chicken legs in large baking dish. Roast poblano chile in oven until skin blisters. Place chicken legs in separate sheet of heavy foil and roast on top of chile, skin side up for 15 to 20 minutes at 400°f combine with cilantro and remaining salt and pepper to taste.

Random Ingredients: serrano chilies,chocolate,white bread,halibut fillet,cider,chocolate pudding mix
title: Baked Calvados With Poached Halibut
ingredients: 8 slices white bread | 4 halibut fillets ( or any other white fish ) | 300 g chocolate pudding mix | 2 tablespoons dried serrano chilies ( fresh and minced ) | 1/4 cup red hot pepper jelly ( such as heinz ketchup ) | 12 -14 ounces semisweet chocolate ( bittersweet or drizzled )
instructions: Line a greased baking tray with foil. Place 6 slices of bread on baking tray. Place halibut fillets on 4 slices of bread. Place 3 more slices of bread, the cut side down and top with remaining 4 slices each. Top each piece with a slice of chocolate pudding. Use a sharp knife to slice the chocolate into 20 chunks. Arrange each chocolate pudding slice on top of the fish and chocolate pudding until they reach the fish and chocolate side of each piece of fish. Bake in a moderate oven for 10 minutes or until the chocolate is melted. Transfer to a serving plate and carefully remove the foil. Melt the jelly in a small pan over low heat. Remove from the heat. Pour 1 tbsp hot jelly over the fish and chocolate pudding. Set aside to set. To serve, transfer the fish to plates, drizzle on a little bit of the melted jelly and scatter chopped serrano peppers and warm red pepper jelly over top. Serve with the remaining jelly.

Random Ingredients: kaffir lime leaf,white cheese,red onion,beef stew meat,graham cracker,beef tenderloin
title: Easy Crock Pot Beef Tenderloin Feta and Lime Pie #5FIX
ingredients: 1 package refrigerated graham crackers, crushed | 1 lb beef stew meat, cut into 16 thick slabs | 1 red onion, sliced thin as possible | 2 packages fresh kaffir lime leaves | 1 package white cheese, cut into 16 1/2-inch cubes | 8 ounces beef tenderloin, thinly sliced
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees. Lightly grease a large roasting pan with removable bottom. Sprinkle the graham crackers evenly on the bottom of the prepared pan. Dredge beef slabs in the crackers, shaking off excess. Place in the prepared pan. Add the onion. Wearing long sleeves, toss the beef with the kaffir lime leaves. Top with the sliced white cheese.
