title: Gramflowers
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 kg fish, cut in serving-size pieces | 1 - 1 1/2 kg za'atar spice mix | 2/3 cup dark soy sauce
instructions: Mix kesar and dark sauce together. Add fish and marinate 30 minutes. Preheat oven to 220' celsius. Add za'atar mixture to fish and bake in the oven 15 - 20 minutes on 140' c until golden.

title: Kellymag (Yogurt Cheese)
ingredients: 2 slices white bread, crusts removed | 1/2 teaspoon chili pepper flakes
instructions: Cut the crusts off all bread. Roughly chop the bread.

title: Easy Mushroom and Potato Cabbage Rolls
ingredients: 1 cabbage, head and outer leaf removed | 2 shiitake mushrooms, sliced | 1 can condensed tomato soup | 1/2 cup ketchup | 1/3 cup applesauce
instructions: Cut a piece of cabbage to be round or square in length of outer leaf. Spread cut out square of cabbage with your finger, to the center, like you would an idaho potato. You can cut this in small slices using a kitchen shears or any knife. Lay shiitake mushrooms on top of cabbage on one side of cabbage so they are not laying flat but rather flat. Spread tomato soup and ketchup on top of shiitake mushrooms, using applesauce to cover. Spread sliced ketchup onto tomato soup and ketchup mixture in another layer. Layer cabbage at the bottom of the saucepan, leaving the empty layer uncovered on top. Lay shiitake mushroom slices on top with other layer uncovered. Close cabbage tightly over top of mushroom slice. Close lid and heat over medium low heat for 30 minutes. Open cabbage and let it get warm in the oven for 15 minutes. Cut in serving pieces.

Random Ingredients: sake,morel,cardamom seed,dark brown sugar,corn syrup,edible flower,cayenne pepper,black eyed pea
title: Fresh Fruit Sushi
ingredients: 12 dried black-eyed peas | 3 tablespoons kikoman dark sweet white rice or 3 tablespoons yellow sweet rice ( 3 1/2 cups ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons sweetened sake | 1 tablespoon light corn syrup or 1 tablespoon light corn syrup | 2 cardamom seeds | 1 teaspoon whole yellow dried edible flower ( mai funji ) | 2 tablespoons cayenne pepper ( or other hot pepper ) | 2 tablespoons dark brown sugar | cornstarch, for dusting
instructions: Wash and strain the black eyed peas. Place the beans in 3 cups of boiling water and boil for 2 - 3 minutes. Drain and set aside to cool until just warm. Remove the beans from the water and add 1 cup of cold water to the beans to make a liquid, about 3 cups. Stirring well to break up any clumps. In a medium sized, heavy pot over low heat or in a double boiler, melt 1 tablespoon of the dark brown sugar with the corn syrup. Stir and cook for about 5 minutes, until the sugar is completely dissolved. Add the remaining dark brown sugar mixture to the beans and add the cardamom seeds, mai funji and the drained black eyed peas, stirring well to coat well. Cover and bring to a low boil. Continue to cook over simmering until the beans are tender. In a small bowl, combine 1 tablespoon of the bean liquid with enough hot water so that the mixture just covers the beans. Remove the lid carefully and drop the mixture back into the rice in the pot, stirring until everything is well mixed and hot. Return to a low boil, cover and bring to a boil again, then remove from the heat. Let stand for about 15 minutes, or until all of the liquid is absorbed. Place a large sieve over the rice, pour the bean liquid into it and reserve. Transfer the strained bean mixture to a large serving bowl. Using your hands, thoroughly mix everything well, using the coarse side of a long handled wooden spoon. Cover and set aside to rest for at least 15 twenty minutes. If you have any leftovers, gently mix them before serving to keep them warm. Just before the sushi is served, dissolve the remaining 1 tablespoon sweetened sake in a couple cups of boiling water so that it reduces a little. Remove from the heat and set aside. Remove 1 tablespoon of the bean liquid, stir it into the bean mixture, then refrigerate. Just before serving, sprinkle the rest of the brown sugar on top. The sushi will keep at room temperature for a day but can be enjoyed right away or chilled for a day. It can also be eaten immediately or chilled for up to a week.

title: Angel Hair and Peppers
ingredients: 16 ounces angel hair pasta | 8 whole yellow peppers
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. When pasta is done, drain and toss with peppers. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: chicken seitan strip,cooking oil,lemon juice,green plantain,eggplant,curry powder,apple cider
title: Curry Fried Vegetables
ingredients: 1/2 cup cooking oil | 1 teaspoon curry powder | 1 lemons, juice and rind of or 1 orange, juice and zest of | 2 tablespoons apple cider ( or apple cider vinegar ) | 1 green plantain, peeled and cut into thin slivers | 2 eggplants, cut into 1-1/4-inch slices | 1 chicken seitan strip
instructions: In large skillet heat oil over medium heat. Add curry powder, lemon rind and juice and vinegar. Cook 2 minutes or until curry is fragrant. Add plantains and cook another 2 minutes. Add eggplant and chicken strips and stir to cover with curry. Cook 3 - 5 minutes until chicken is no longer pink in outside. Serve and enjoy.

title: Lebanese Pork Tenderloin (Khoresh Badet)
ingredients: 500 g white whole wheat flour | 200 g dried fruit | 1/2 pineapple | 200 g dried currants | 2 tablespoons herbs, dried ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 2 lbs pork tenderloin
instructions: Soak fruit, pineapples and currants for a minimum of 6 hours or overnight in plenty of cold water. Mix together the dried spices. Drain liquid from fruit and cut into short slices. Cut the tenderloins in half vertically and put them in a saucepan with water. Cover the pan and simmer for 20 minutes. The longer it simmers the better it will taste and the better it tastes. The longer, the flavor gets. While it cooks, heat a tbsp of the liquid and mix the corn starch in a small amount of water and then add it in the slow cooker and cook on high setting for 60 - 90 minutes. Serve with pita bread.

title: Yummy Hot Sauce (For Dipping)

instructions: Empty contents of the rotel into a large crock pot. Add a can of salsa and chilies. Add rotel. Stir to mix contents. Let them simmer together in the crockpot on low for about 8 - 10 minutes. Take it out of the crockpot. If you like your hot sauce more spicy, you can add a little bit more jalapeno.

Random Ingredients: seasoning salt,radish,garlic paste,basil leaf,mung bean sprout,apple juice,sherry wine
title: Mung-Mung Sprouts Salad

instructions: Boil up the mung bean sprouts for about 8 minutes, until a little softer. Drain and rinse under cold water, drain again. In a large mixing bowl combine all remaining ingredients. title: The Only Way You'll Eat These!  (No Eggs)

instructions: Heat the vegetable oil or olive oil in a large frying pan and gently stir fry the powdered sugar in it. instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Spread bread crumbs on a large cookie sheet. Coat a large nonstick skillet with cooking spray.

title: Korean Potato Salad

instructions: Spray a 9 x 13 baking dish with cooking spray. Combine all the ingredients listed under salad. Toss well to coat. Cover and chill overnight. Cut potatoes in half lengthwise, and score 1/4 inch with a sharp knife that goes directly through the skin.

title: Crispy-Crusted Pork With Kimchi
ingredients: 4 lbs pork tenderloin, boneless | 10 ounces dried apricots | 12 ounces cabbage kimchi ( kimchi packed in water, drained ) | 3 1/4 ounces pecorino romano cheese, fresh grated | 4 cups plain bread flour | 16 ounces triple sec | 1 1/4 lbs yukon gold potatoes, washed, peeled, quartered

title: Pepper Steak Sandwich

instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Spread orange section inside each slice of the deli roast beef. Wrap each slice of beef with a slice of the beef.

instructions: Arrange the bread on a rack in a baking pan just large enough to accommodate it without letting the bread fall up to the touch. Remove to a cutting board or board, and cut into slices. Arrange them on skewers, and brush with additional hot water as needed. title: Simple Oatcakes
ingredients: 2 cups all-purpose flour | 3 cups old fashioned oats | 1 cup fresh shredded coconut | 3 cans rotel tomatoes and green chilies | 1 can chopped corn, drained

title: Baked Feta Nests
ingredients: 1 package fetta | 1/2 teaspoon jamaican jerk spice | 12 ounces dry farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta, cooked and drained | 2 tablespoons sesame seeds
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Crumble the feta into a mixing bowl. Sprinkle in the jerk spice and chopped jamaican jerk spice. Set aside. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

title: Apple Salad With Cinnamon

title: Taco Bell Mexican Style Salad

instructions: Stir together all ingredients except for the cheese. Put the salad into a decorative serving bowl or on a lettuce leaf, and top with cheese.

title: Italian Herb Mix

title: Mace Chicken

instructions: Combine mace boullion and 1/2 tablespoon of cooking oil in a bowl. Place in large bowl. Add 1/2 cup of cooking oil and mix. Add 1/4 cup of cooking oil and lime. Add 2 teaspoons of mace powder and 1/4 teaspoon of ground mace. Mix the mace powder into the oil and stir together. Turn off your microwave and set aside until serving. title: Thai Butternut Squash Squash Soup
ingredients: 1 medium butternut squash | 2 -4 medium cloves, freshly ground | 1 head green cabbage | 1 cup coconut, freshly grated | 1/4 cup fish sauce ( or use 1/2 teaspoon soy sauce and 1/4 teaspoon fish sauce ) | 1 teaspoon salt | 1 teaspoon dried cilantro | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning salt | crushed ice ( optional )
instructions: Cut squash down to the core. Scrape out the seeds while slicing. Peel if you like butternut squash, and cut into half inch cubes. title: Portobello Mushroom Soup
ingredients: 10 portabella mushrooms | 1 quart chicken broth | 4 kiwis | 1 pint heavy cream | 1/2 cup raspberries, freshly chopped
instructions: Clean the mushroom stems and remove the seeds from the caps and slice finely. Wash thoroughly and slice finely, if necessary. Heat the broth in a pot on the stovetop, preferably non stick. Add the mushrooms and saute until all the water has released. Stir in the kiwis, heavy cream and raspberries and heat thru.

Random Ingredients: orange flower water,chuck,tomato soup,cranberry sauce,marjoram,coriander powder,cooking spray,thai seasoning
title: Easy Beef Noodle Soup
ingredients: cooking spray | 2 lbs ground chuck | 2 teaspoons thai seasoning | 1 teaspoon dried marjoram | 1/2 teaspoon coriander powder | 1 teaspoon orange flower water | 1 can condensed tomato soup or ( 10 3/4 ounce ) can beef broth | 3/4 cup thai cranberry sauce
instructions: Heat oil in large saucepan on medium heat. Add ground meat, cover and brown meat until no blood pink remains. Add remaining ingredients except cranberry sauce. Cover and reduce heat to low. Cook until soup comes to simmer.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack cheese,walnut oil,sea salt,orange,red potato,red capsicum,green onion
title: Microwave Wisconsin Capsicum and Grilled Cheese Wedges
ingredients: 1/2 medium red potato, grated | 1/2 medium red capsicum, grated | 2 tablespoons walnut oil | 1 green onion, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon walnut oil | 1 teaspoon sea salt | 1/2 orange, juiced | 100 g monterey jack cheese, grated
instructions: Preheat a grill. Combine the potato, capsicum, 2 tablespoons of the walnut oil, green onion, 1 tablespoon of walnut oil, salt and orange juice in a medium bowl. Spread the potato mixture onto a foil lined baking sheet, leaving 2cm overhang on the edges. Cook in the microwave on high for 4 - 5 minutes, or until the potato mixture has just set and feels firm to the finger. Transfer to a chopping board and slice thinly. Top the slices with cheese and bake in a microwave on high for 3 - 4 minutes, or until the cheese has melted and is bubbling underneath. Allow to cool for 5 minutes, then serve warm.

title: Apple and Feta Salad
ingredients: 1 can chickpeas ( drained and rinsed ) | 1 large apple ( peeled, cored and cubed ) | 1/4 cup sweet chile sauce | 1/4 cup white vermouth | 1/2 cup chili sauce | 1/4 cup apple cider | 1/4 cup crumbled feta | black pepper ( to taste )
instructions: In large bowl combine chickpeas, apple and chile sauce. Cover and refrigerate for 2 hours. Stir in vermouth and chili sauce. Cover bowl and refrigerate for 1 hour. Just before serving sprinkle with feta and pepper.

Random Ingredients: anchovy,italian tomato,farfalle pasta,taco cheese mexican,semolina flour,baby spinach
title: Pasta with Soya Sauce and Feta Cheese - Kota Chi Piadina
ingredients: 1 package farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta | 1/2 pound baby spinach | 12 ounces italian-style crushed tomatoes | 2 anchovies, optional, or to taste | 1/3 cup semolina flour, or as needed | 1/2 package crumbled taco cheese with garlic and italian herbs, divided
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add farfalle pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

Random Ingredients: beef stock cube,rose water,simple syrup,adobo seasoning,italian plum tomato,flour tortilla,allspice,sharp cheddar cheese
title: Beef Enchiladas Verde
ingredients: 3 lbs italian plump plum tomatoes | 3 beef stock cubes ( can be bought in can or you just like it saucy ) or 3 beef base cubes ( can be bought in can or you just like it saucy ) | 2 tablespoons italian quick-rise seasoning ( i like mrs. dash seasoning for this ) | 1 teaspoon dried rose water | 1 teaspoon adobo seasoning | 2 -3 tablespoons simple syrup | 8 flour tortillas | 3 1/2 fluid ounces sharp cheddar cheese, grated ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Cut tomatoes in half if necessary. Reserve a small portion of tomato flesh and reserve. Add beef cubes and spices to a small bowl. Add tomato flesh to bowl, reserving juice. Reserve remainder of tomato flesh. Coat 3 qt. Flour tortillas with oil, then lightly coat with oil. Spread tortilla slices in a single layer over a 10 x 11 baking dish which has been sprayed with pam. I use a 12 x 16 x 2 baking pan. Arrange tortillas evenly over pan. Add tomato paste to same pan. Sprinkle cheese evenly over tomato paste. Bake uncovered at 400 degrees until cheese is completely melted, about 25 minutes. Cut into 10 serving size pieces and serve.

Random Ingredients: five spice powder,thyme sprig,chili paste,burgundy wine,mayonnaise
title: Sauce Five-Spice Burgundy
ingredients: 1 cup mayonnaise | 1 1/2 teaspoons five-spice powder | 1 teaspoon chili paste | 1 1/2 teaspoons dry thyme sprigs ( plus extra chopped sprigs for garnish ) | 1/4 cup burgundy wine
instructions: In a small bowl, combine all ingredients and mix well. Taste and adjust seasoning to your own taste.

title: Quick and Simple Spicy Noodles with Peaches
ingredients: 375 g linguine | 2 tablespoons sunflower oil | 1 tablespoon fresh gingerroot, chopped | 2 medium ripe freestone plump peaches, peeled, chopped | 1 tablespoon roasted chopped sun-dried tomatoes with chilies, chopped ( from a pack of roasted chilies ) | 1 teaspoon fish sauce
instructions: Cook pasta according to packet directions but rinse under cold water to stop the cooking. Heat the oil in a frying pan and fry the gingerroot for 1 minute, until softened. Mix the peaches, sun dried tomatoes and fish sauce together in a small bowl and add to the frying pan. Stir over a low heat until heated through. Drain the pasta and add to the pan, tossing together. Serve topped with the peaches and sun dried tomatoes.

Random Ingredients: mustard,rotini pasta,crabmeat,dark sesame oil,black bean,basmati rice
title: Quick Vietnamese Crab and Crab Salad
ingredients: 2 cups uncooked basmati rice | 1 can black beans, drained and rinsed | 1 pound imitation crabmeat, sliced | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil | 1 teaspoon dry mustard | 2 cups cooked rotini pasta
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions. Add black beans and crabmeat to the cooked rice. Cover and let stand 10 minutes. Stir in sesame oil and mustard. Serve cold garnished with hot cooked pasta.

Random Ingredients: jalapeno pepper,gravy mix,pork tenderloin,white wine vinegar,pistachio,white vinegar
title: Spicy Pista Pork Tenderloins W-Gravy
ingredients: 6 -8 pork tenderloin, trimmed | 1/3 cup dry white wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons sweet glaze prepared gravy mix, divided | 1 tablespoon white vinegar | 1 teaspoon minced jalapeno pepper | 1/3 cup unsalted shelled pistachios, coarsely chopped or 1/3 cup pine nuts
instructions: Cut tenderloins between 2 sheets of waxed paper.

Random Ingredients: soymilk,soup meat,radish,serrano chilies,monterey jack cheese,heavy cream,cream cheese
title: Real Mexican Cream Cheese Spread
ingredients: 1/2 cup low-fat sour cream ( eggaholive oil-packed type ) | 3/4 lb soup bones with meat ( ground meat, chicken, or pork, etc. ) | 1/2 lb monterey jack cheese ( shredded ) | 1/3 lb low-fat cream cheese | 1/3 cup soymilk ( dairy-free ) | 1/2 cup crushed radishes | 4 -5 sliced serrano chilies
instructions: Heat cream cheese in microwave on high for 5 - 10 seconds. Stir together well until all butter chunks are evenly distributed. Set aside. Combine milk, sour cream, and soymilk in bowl and mix thoroughly. In small bowl, combine cheese and radishes. Add cheese to the sour cream mixture, stirring gently. Stir in the chilies, if desired. Spread the cream cheese mixture into a 2 quart baking dish and top with remaining cheese. Bake in 350f oven, uncovered, for 30 - 40 minutes until bubbly and heated through.

Random Ingredients: maple syrup,beef sirloin steak,cheese,beef mince,pepper,oregano leaf,leek,chicken portion
title: Spaghetti Bolognese
ingredients: 1 lb beef mince | 2 beef portions | 1 large leek | 1 tablespoon oregano leaves | 1/4 teaspoon pepper | 1 can chicken portions or ( 15 ounce ) can beef mince | 1/4 cup maple syrup | cheese, to serve ( optional )
instructions: Slice the leek into very thin slices. Cube the beef portions. Place the beef, leek and spices together in a large, high sided pan and put on the stove top. After about 5 minutes, turn down the heat to medium don't overcook. Add the meat, lemon and maple syrup and continue to stir for another 5 minutes, until leek softens a bit. Serve with your favourite sauce, cheese, whatever you desire.

title: Thai Chicken Pesto Recipe
ingredients: 1/2 cup peanut oil | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom | 3/4 teaspoon chopped fresh basil pesto | 1/2 lemon, halved | 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 4 chicken strips, cut in strips
instructions: Stir peanut oil, cardamom, basil pesto, lemon, and cinnamon together in a bowl until the ingredients are blended. Stir in the chicken strips. Cover bowl, and marinate chicken strips in refrigerator for at least 1 hour to allow flavors to blend before serving at once.

title: Gurkensalat: European Vegetarian Pumpkin Pickles
ingredients: 2 lbs seedless european cucumbers | 1 lb pumpkin, peeled and cut into 1/4-inch rounds | 1 cup white wine vinegar
instructions: Cut cucumbers in half. Slice into thin slivers. Bring a large pot of 1/2 cup water to a boil. Drop in squash, and gently boil for 20 minutes. Drain well, and set in a bowl. In a small bowl, mix vinegar and remaining 1/2 cup water. Pour vinegar/water mixture over pumpkin, coating all vegetables. Cover, and chill for 1 hour at room temperature, then place in sterile jars leaving 1/2 inch headspace. Process in a hot water bath for 5 minutes, or until no longer soft and beginning to soften when tapped. Remove from heat and drain well, reserving cooking liquid. Cover and refrigerate for up to 1 month.

Random Ingredients: farfalle pasta,lobster meat,scallop,cremini mushroom,bacon grease,grainy mustard,sushi rice,phyllo dough
title: Jorge's Seafood Roll-Ups
ingredients: 3 tablespoons bacon grease | 2 cans seafood cocktail-style stewed lobster meat | 12 ounces cooked sushi-style rice, chilled | 12 ounces cooked farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta, cooked | 12 scallops, cleaned | 1 package sliced cremini mushrooms | 2 tablespoons grainy mustard | 12 sheets phyllo dough, thawed
instructions: Heat the bacon grease over medium heat in a large nonstick pan. Drain and reserve 2 t. Of the bacon grease. Add the lobster meat, seafood cocktail style stewed shells, and rice. Stir until well blended. In a large plastic zipper bag, cut the farfalle into 6 slices each. Divide the pasta evenly among the 12 pieces of phyllo dough. Add a crab claw and a few shrimp to each piece of dough. Spoon the seafood mixture into the center of the farfalle. Cut four strips of phyllo dough crosswise into 3 1/2 inch wide strips. Lay the phyllo pieces on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and top with parchment paper. Poke all 8 strips with a fork. Sprinkle with pepper. Lightly oil your work surface and set aside. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Bake for 30 minutes or until the pastry is puffed and golden brown. Serve the roll ups hot.

Random Ingredients: canola oil,phyllo pastry,chili pepper flake,red wine,double cream,yellow squash,rice wine
title: Sweet-Sour Squash Phyllo Triangles
ingredients: 1 green sweet potato, roughly chopped | 1 medium yellow squash, roughly chopped | 1 teaspoon chili pepper flakes | 1 tablespoon rice wine | 1 tablespoon double cream | 1 tablespoon dry sherry wine | 1/2 cup sweet red wine ( such as salsas ) | 1 lb phyllo pastry, halved | 2 tablespoons canola oil
instructions: Place the sweet potato and the yellow squash in a saucepan of salted water and bring to the boil. Simmer for 10 minutes. Drain well and set aside. Heat the chile flakes and rice wine and stir in cream and the sherry until well blended. Set aside. In a separate frying pan, heat oil. As soon as the mixture starts to smoke, add the sweet potato mixture. Fry over high heat for a minute or two, until golden brown colour. Set aside on a paper towel lined plate. Preheat the oven to 200°c heat a large ovenproof pan over low heat. Brush lightly with oil. Spray lightly with oil and place a sheet of phyllo on each. Brush with more oil and repeat this step until all of the phyllo has been used. Place in the oven for eight minutes until the pastry is crisp and golden. Remove to a dish with a slotted spoon and cut in thirds. Serve immediately. Note. I often add 2 tbsp of chopped green pepper for added flavour & colour. For variation i can add 3 tbsp of finely chopped ham for a twist on the hot pepper flakes and serve along side the squash phyllo.

title: Dill Pickle Soup
ingredients: 500 g dill pickles, roughly chopped | 1 liter corn oil | 1 liter tomato soup ( not the one with the dried tomato flavour ) | kosher salt
instructions: Add about 3 - 4 tablespoons of kosher salt to the oil and add the chopped dill pickle. Fry until you get a dark golden color. Place back on the oil and fry the tomato soup for about 3 minutes. Pour tomato soup into a large, heavy saucepan and add the rest of the kosher salt. Bring to the boil and then simmer until the pickle is very soft.

title: Moussaka
ingredients: 8 ounces plain yogurt, plain fat free greek yogurt | 1 egg white, lightly beaten | 3/4 cup low-fat milk | 3 tablespoons almond paste | 2 teaspoons parsley flakes
instructions: Put yoghurt in a large bowl, add the egg white and add milk to give extra flavour.

Random Ingredients: steak,tomato green chile pepper,beef stew meat,coconut milk,serrano pepper
title: Crock Pot Thai Beef Curry
ingredients: 3 lbs beef stew meat, cut into 1 to 1 1/2 inch pieces | 32 ounces undrained canned tomato and green chile peppers | 3 cans coconut milk | 5 serrano peppers, seeded and finely diced | 2 tablespoons minced serrano peppers ( from a jar ), with liquid ( optional )
instructions: Place beef in bottom of crock pot. Stir in remaining ingredients. Cover crock pot and cook on low for 8 hours. Discard serrano peppers from liquid.

title: Minted Fruit Salad
ingredients: 1 ripe peach, peeled, stoned & sliced | 1/2 cup fresh mint, finely chopped | 1/2 cup brewed coffee | 1 can sliced bamboo shoots, drained | 1 small carrot, sliced
instructions: Place peach, mint & coffee in a bowl. Cover with plastic wrap & set aside to marinate for about 15 mins, or until very cold. Meanwhile combine the remaining ingredients & mix well. To serve, mix half of the salad into the fruit & serve.

Random Ingredients: self raising flour,cannellini bean,gruyere cheese,tea,salt pork,graham cracker,vanilla bean,red chilies
title: Pancakes With Cheese and Beans (Pissaladiere de Pissaladiere)
ingredients: 100 g salted pork, finely ground | 100 g self raising flour | 1 teaspoon salt | 1 teaspoon vanilla beans ( scraped and scraped ) | 6 red chilies | 100 g friulle cheese | 100 g shredded gruyere cheese | 2 tablespoons tea or 2 tablespoons strongly flavored coffee | 24 graham crackers
instructions: Chop the pork into small, thick slices, and set aside. Sift the flour with the salt, and beat the flour into the pork lightly with the vanilla beans and 2/3 cup water. Put the chillies in a blender with the remaining water if required and blend finely with a spoon. Pour the mixture into a greased oven proof dish, and lightly press the cheese against the surface, smoothing it out with a spatula so that all the slices of the cheese have been covered. Pour the tea over the cheese and press the cheese into the dough, using a fork. Bake the pancake on a 180 c bq or a hot griddle for 10 - 12 minutes, until lightly browned and crisp. To serve, divide the cheese between the pancake and beans, sprinkle with the remaining gruyere, and roll up. Arrange the rolled pancakes on a warmed serving dish, and serve with coffee.

Random Ingredients: palm sugar,anise seed,ginger,irish cream,curry powder,plain yogurt,lemon juice zest,superfine sugar
title: Anise Caramel Yogurt
ingredients: 10 cups plain yogurt | 1 cup sugar | 4 teaspoons curry powder | 1 1/2 tablespoons anise seed | 1 lemon, juice and zest of, grated ( peel if necessary ) | 1 tablespoon lemon oil ( if necessary ) | 2 teaspoons grated ginger | 1/2 cup light rum or 1/2 cup other good-quality dark rum
instructions: Heat the yogurt to very warm. Add the sugar and curry powder. Place the oven on to 300°f line 2 baking sheets with a silicon pad. Stir the anise seeds, lemon zest and juice together. Add this to the yogurt as well as the oil and lemon rind. Transfer to a bowl and beat with an electric hand mixer until light and creamy. If too thick, with a little water, add a few tablespoons at a time. Place in the refrigerator about 6 hours before serving. You can also prepare a day ahead of time, by pouring the yogurt into a bowl, cover and put in the refrigerator.

title: Spiced Bean Sprouts
ingredients: 1 package bean sprouts | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh oregano | 1 tablespoon curry leaves, or more to taste
instructions: Bring a small pot of lightly salted water to boil. Cook bean sprouts in boiling water until bright green, about 3 minutes.

title: Baked Vermicelli and Cauliflower
ingredients: 200 g vermicelli | 50 g cauliflower | 1 tablespoon thyme sprigs | 2 tablespoons chili oil | 2 slices pumpernickel bread
instructions: Steam the vermicelli over a high heat for about 8 - 10 minutes until crisp. Remove from the heat and drain on kitchen paper and leave to cool slightly. Trim the cauliflower and cut into florets. Combine the thyme with the oil in a small frying pan and cook for 3 - 4 minutes until the oil starts to smoke. Add the cauliflower to the frypan and cook for about 5 minutes on each side until the cauliflower is crisp tender. Sprinkle with black pepper and serve with the bread.

title: Apple Juice Chicken
ingredients: 1 can chicken chunks | 2 1/2 cups apple juice
instructions: Place chicken chunks, apple juice, and chicken in crock of a slow cooker. Set to high.

Random Ingredients: brown rice,maraschino cherry,mussel,baking powder,self raising flour,cream,shallot,honey
title: Baked Mussels in Honey-Glazed Crisp
ingredients: 5 mussels | 1/4 cup sour cream | 1/4 cup shallot, roughly chopped | 1/4 cup brown rice, measured | 1/4 cup honey | 1 teaspoon baking powder | 1/2 cup self-raising flour | 1/8 cup maraschino cherry, roughly chopped
instructions: Heat oven to 200°c. Scrub the mussels with a knife. Scrub the shells under water and remove beard if any. Remove and discard beards under running water. Remove heads from mussels. Wash mussels thoroughly and remove beard. Discard any mussels that remain closed. Rinse and pick out any cracked shells. Set the mussels aside. Combine the sour cream, shallots, rice, honey, baking powder and flour in a medium bowl, add mussels. Stir in the cherries. Using an electric mixer, beat on medium speed for 3 minutes. Place the mussels in a baking dish, arrange in the single layer. Spoon the topping mixture evenly over the mussels. Bake in the oven for 5 minutes, or until heated through. Serve with crusty bread or a side dish of your choice.

Random Ingredients: phyllo pastry,italian bread,veal cutlet,red wine vinegar,eggplant,sage leaf,raspberry
title: Raspberry Meat Loaf
ingredients: 1 lb veal cutlet, 1/2-inch thick | 1 eggplant, 1 slice | 1/2 cup red wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon rubbed sage leaf | 1 loaf italian bread, sliced 1/2-inch thick ( 8-9-inch ) | 10 large fresh sage leaves | 1 package frozen raspberries, thawed | 1 loaf red wine vinegar | 1 package frozen phyllo pastry, thawed
instructions: Place cutlets between 2 sheets of lightly moistened plastic wrap and make 4 thin, 15 x 2 inch long slices. Beat eggplant, 1/3 cup vinegar and sage in medium bowl with fork until combined.

title: Sautéed Rommons and Herbs With Chured Steak (Avec Eric)
ingredients: 1/4 cup watercress, stalks finely chopped | 4 tablespoons virgin olive oil | 1/4 cup leek, finely chopped | 2 cups seedless grapes, halved | 2 large skirt steaks or 2 large sirloin steaks | cooking oil, as needed
instructions: Toss together the watercress stalks, olive oil, leeks and grapes in a large bowl. Add the skirt steak. Toss to coat and let marinate at room temperature, stirring occasionally, for 3 hours. Preheat the broiler. Brush the steaks with oil and sprinkle them with salt and pepper. Place the steaks on a rack in a roasting pan. Broil the steaks 4 minutes per side or until they are lightly charred on the top. Let stand to rest for 1 minute and serve hot.

title: Mediterranean Beef Burgers
ingredients: 1 cup bulgur wheat | 1 1/2 lbs thinly sliced roast beef | 3 teaspoons harissa | 2 teaspoons poppy seeds | 12 12 inch flat bread rolls or 12 inch refrigerated biscuits | 2 slices feta or 2 slices provolone cheese | 1 medium cucumber, peeled and thinly sliced | lime wedge
instructions: In a small baking dish, place the bulgur and allow it to stand for an hour. Drain off the liquid. In a nonstick skillet, heat the meat and marinade over high heat, breaking up meat with a wooden spoon or spatula, until meat is cooked through. Set aside and allow to cool. Preheat the broiler. When the broiler is very hot, place the unopened biscuit on a tray. Carefully top each biscuit evenly with meat and cheese. Broil for 1 to 2 minutes or until cheese is melted. Place the bun over medium high heat and spray with cooking spray.

title: Glazed Caraway Seeds
ingredients: 1 cup dark brown sugar | 1 cup caraway seeds ( optional )
instructions: Place sugar in a large pot over medium heat. Quickly stir in caraway seeds. Bring mixture to a boil and boil for 5 minutes. Pour caraway seeds into hot glaze and place in a double boiler over simmering water. Steam the caraway seeds for 12 - 16 mintues, then turn off the heat. Allow to cool completely before storing.

title: Taco Salad III
ingredients: 1 head romaine lettuce, chopped | 1/4 teaspoon onion powder | 1/4 teaspoon chili | 1/4 cup cooking oil
instructions: In a large bowl, combine lettuce, onion, chili and oil. Stir well.

title: Easy Carrots
ingredients: 6 large carrots ( peeled ) | 1 1 tablespoon all purpose greek seasoning
instructions: Preheat your oven to 425°f. Place washed unpeeled carrots in a large bowl and add greek seasoning. Toss to mix. Using a potato masher smash the carrots with the back of a spoon or with a rice paddle. Place carrots on a large cookie sheet lined with parchment paper. Bake for 45 - 50 minutes. Turn over and roast for an additional 15 minutes until the desired degree of tenderness.

title: Chinese Five Spice Beef
ingredients: 4 lbs beef roast | cornmeal
instructions: Mix five spice powder with 6 pints of water. Add the roast and leave for 12 hours. The next day add cornmeal to the water. Cover and bring to the boil and then lower the heat and simmer on the stovetop for 1/2 1 hour. The meat should be cooked through and the juices run clear when the beef is tender. Remove the beef from the pan and leave to rest before carving. Serve with steamed rice.

title: Asian Peppers
ingredients: 2 lbs green peppers | 2 teaspoons spanish paprika | 2 cups teriyaki sauce
instructions: Cut the pepper into thin strips. Place in a plastic bag with the paprika, and marinate for 20 minutes at room temp or in the refrigerator. Remove the pepper strips from the bag, and set aside. Remove the paprika from the bag, and set aside. In a large skillet or wok, heat the teriyaki sauce over high heat until hot, about 2 minutes. Spoon the sauce over the peppers in your pan, and cook for 10 minutes, turning and stirring. Serve on buns.

title: Sweet Indian Semolina
ingredients: 1 cup whole coriander seed | 2 cups semolina, rinsed | 1/2 cup finely chopped red wine vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon ground allspice
instructions: Place the coriander seeds in a 2 quart pan. Add 3 cups of water, and bring to a boil. Cover, and reduce heat to medium. Cook 45 minutes, or until all of the water has been absorbed. Remove husks at the top, and remove the seeds. Set aside. Meanwhile, bring remaining 1 1/2 cups water to a boil in a medium saucepan and stir in the semolina. Reduce heat to low, and cook, stirring frequently with a rubber spatula, until the semolina begins to pull away from the sides of the pan, 10 to 12 minutes. Stir in red wine vinegar and allspice. When the semolina has come to a boil, remove from heat, and stir in the seeds. Let stand 20 minutes, then transfer to a serving dish. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: topping,sea salt,purpose flour,vodka,heavy whipping cream,jalapeno chilies
title: Frozen Spicy Jalapeno-Lavovas
ingredients: 12 large fresh jalapeno chilies ( preferably a large one ) | 1 cup vodka | 2 cups heavy whipping cream | 1 cup all-purpose flour, divided | 1/2 teaspoon sea salt | 1/2 cup confectioners'sugar for dusting, for serving
instructions: Rinse the chilies and pierce them all over with a fork, being careful not to tear them. Insert a sliver of cheddar cheese in a slit along the sides. Set the chilies in a bowl of ice water until softened, 20 to 30 minutes. Drain the chilies and pat them dry with paper towels. Place the chilies in a baking dish skin side up. Pour enough vodka to cover the chilies completely. Pour about half of cream over the chilies and refrigerate until chilled, about 1 hour. Meanwhile, whisk together 1 cup flour and 1/2 teaspoon salt in a medium bowl. Make a well in the center and stir in 1/2 cup confectioners' sugar until smooth. Add remaining cream and continue whisking until the mixture is just thick enough to roll. Divide chilled dough between 12 - 12 plates. Roll each plate tightly and place a chile on top of the cream cheese. Refrigerate until chilled, 20 minutes to blend flavor.

title: Guacamole II
ingredients: 1 large avocado | 1 ripe green chile pepper, chopped | 1 tablespoon juniper berries
instructions: Combine avocado, chile pepper, and juniper berries in a bowl.

title: Greek Yogurt Cheese
ingredients: 1 cup sour cream or 1 cup greek yogurt | 1/4 teaspoon garlic powder | 1/8 teaspoon cinnamon ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon chopped red onions or 2 teaspoons other sweet chopped red onion
instructions: Mix all ingredients together thoroughly.

title: Steak Pizza With Molasses-Mascarpone Cream Sauce
ingredients: 1 package refrigerated spaghetti | 12 ounces boneless beef steaks ( or tenderloin ) | 1 container cool whip | 1 cup mascarpone cheese | 1/4 cup dark molasses | 1/4 teaspoon pepper
instructions: Cook spaghetti according to package directions, drain.

title: Escarole and Green Beans
ingredients: 1 lb whole-wheat escarole | 1 cup sour cream
instructions: Trim green beans and cut a cross on the top of the beans about 1/2 inch wide. Place beans on foil on a rimmed baking sheet. Combine scallions and sour cream in a food processor. Process until pureed. Spread sour cream mixture over green beans and place under broiler. Broil 5 minutes or until lightly browned.

title: Tortillas in the Oven
ingredients: 3/4 lb tortilla, cut in 1/8 inch slices | 2 tablespoons shortening or 2 tablespoons oil | 1 can refried beans
instructions: Heat oven to 450°f. Coat cookie sheet with cooking spray. Arrange tortillas on cookie sheet, overlapping as necessary. Spread refried beans in a 3 x 3 inch strip on a tortilla, leaving a 1 inch overhang on each side to cover, covering the refried beans. Cook 8 - 10 minutes, or until golden brown. Remove from oven. Place tortilla on a cookie sheet and bake 5 minutes, or until crisp. Serve warm.

title: Saffron Spareribs and Canadian Bacon
ingredients: 4 tablespoons olive oil | 1 package country canadian bacon | 1 package country spareribs | 2 teaspoons saffron | 1 1/2 teaspoons chicken bouillon | 2 slices white onions, toasted | 2 pieces fresh asparagus, ends trimmed
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium high heat. Add bacon pieces.

Random Ingredients: cream cheese,white rice,fennel bulb,fruit preserve,egg white,apricot,cardamom,onion
title: Cheese Gremolada
ingredients: 2/3 cup dried apricot | 1/3 cup chopped dried fruit preserves | 4 tablespoons diced onion | 4 egg whites | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom | 2 teaspoons minced fennel bulbs | 1/3 cup cream cheese, softened | 2 cups cooked white rice
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place apricots and dried fruit preserves in a small bowl. Cover with boiling water and let stand 10 minutes. Drain and pat dry with paper towels. Set aside. Place egg whites in a large glass or metal mixing bowl. Mix in cardamom, onion, and fennel. Using a clean whisk, beat egg whites slowly until thick and glossy, gradually adding cream cheese. Stir in apricots and fruit preserves. Remove 1/4 cup of cream cheese liquid and stir into egg whites. Spread cream cheese mixture in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Bake 20 minutes and top with uncooked rice. Return to oven and bake an additional 15 minutes until hot and bubbly.

title: Indian Spice
ingredients: 1 package frozen whipped topping ( such as cool whip or whipped whipped sugar ) | 1/2 cup fresh coriander leaves ( or chopped coriander )
instructions: Beat the ingredients together with an electric mixer on speed until very smooth. Place in a plastic or glass dish cover and refrigerate for 2 to 3 hours.

title: Oven-Baked Banana Split Pea With Cracker Crumbs
ingredients: 1 package of shell pasta ( i like spaghetti ) | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda or 1/2 teaspoon baking powder | 1 cup half-and-half | 2 cups sliced ripe bananas | 1 prepared graham cracker crumb
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Line the bottom of a large, oven proof serving dish with aluminum foil. In a large bowl, combine 1/4 cup half and half, the bananas, crumbs and baking soda. Dip each potato slice into the mixture, then shake off excess. Roll into the graham cracker crumbs and place on the prepared dish. Repeat with the remaining potato slices. Bake covered for 30 minutes. Remove from oven and let cool for 10 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: spring onion,rice vermicelli,pork,green bell pepper,salad oil,soy sauce,arborio rice,white flour
title: Lori's Chinese Noodle Salad
ingredients: 500 g pork ( in thin slices ) | 100 g rice vermicelli | 500 g rice vermicelli | 1 green bell pepper | 100 g salad oil | 1 spring onion | 1 tablespoon soy sauce | 200 g arborio rice or 200 g carnaroli rice, cooked
instructions: Put rice noodles on to boil in boiling pan of water. While they are cooking, cut green bell pepper into thin strips. Slice spring onion diagonally, then cut onion into small slices. Put pork and noodle pieces in a bowl, pour rice noodles over and add spring onion and soy sauce. Mix well. Pour water over to cover. Allow to rest 5 - 10 minutes drain noodles, reserving water for later. Chop noodles into fine julienne strips, then mix with pork mixture. Add salad oil and mix. Put in fridge for at least 20 minutes to allow flavours to mix. Serve with warm crispy salad leaves.

title: Italian Sausage and Rice Salad
ingredients: 1/4 cup shortening | 1 head leaf lettuce, washed and chopped | 8 scallions, chopped | 2 -3 pimientos, diced | 2 cups short-grain white rice ( short or long grained rice ) | 1 head leaf lettuce, washed and shredded
instructions: In a large skillet, melt the shortening. Add the lettuce, scallions, pimientos, and rice. Heat over medium heat, stirring until hot.

title: Quick Swedish Meatballs
ingredients: 2 lbs ground veal | 4 cans condensed condensed mushroom soup | 4 cans sliced bamboo shoots | 1 package french dressing
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a crockpot. Cover and cook on low 8 - 10 hours.

title: French Pita Burgers
ingredients: 1 whole wheat pita bread | 1/2 cup low-fat milk, chilled | 2 tablespoons whipping cream, chilled | 1/4 cup shredded lettuce
instructions: Heat a grill. Grill the pita. Cut into 1 slices. Spoon about 2 tablespoons of milk onto the pitas. Place the bread into large, shallow baking dish. Top each with a second slice and top with remaining milk. Cover and chill in refrigerator for about 1 hour. Heat the cream in a small saucepan over medium high heat. When it is hot, stir in the lettuce. Serve the burgers in the pita. Makes 6 servings.

title: Apple Butter
ingredients: 600 ml apple juice | 10 cardamoms
instructions: In an oven proof container, put the apple juice, cardamom and a little water and stir well. It will bubble up. Let stand for a couple of hours, stirring every 10 minutes or so. When the butter has completely settled to the top, it will be easier to mix and pour into individual sized individual ramekins. Leave in the fridge, and it will harden up as it ages.

title: Hedgiehog's Shawarma
ingredients: 4 slices bacon | 4 tablespoons tahini | 2 tablespoons dried lemon rind | 1 1/2 teaspoons garlic powder | 1 teaspoon white pepper | 1 beef bouillon cube
instructions: Fry bacon until crisp. Remove bacon from pan and set aside. Drain the rendered fat off of the bacon, reserving the bacon grease in the pan. Crumble bacon into the pan, crumble and sprinkle over the tahini, lemon rind, garlic powder, white pepper and beef bouillon cube. Stir well to combine everything and bring to a boil. Cover with lid and place on medium heat for 12 minutes. Do not uncover when timer goes off remove the lid and raise the timer to keep steam going into the liquid. Let cook for 5 more minutes. Remove lid, stir and serve warm. For variation, instead of 1 beef bouillon cube, i sometimes add 3 cloves of crushed garlic, 1/4 cup of finely minced onion and 1/2 cup of minced fresh or ground roasted garlic. Feel free to add more lemon rind until desired taste is achieved.

title: Chocolate Chip Delights
ingredients: 250 g plain sweet biscuits, broken into large pieces ( or 1 packet of regular biscuits ) | 250 g milk chocolate chips | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon ground green cardamom pod, lightly crushed
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190°c. Place the biscuits into a large bowl with the broken biscuits& milk chocolate chips. Stir until the chocolate has melted. Fold the ground cardamom into the mixture. Line a large baking tray with non stick baking paper. Drop into the oven, allow to bake for 10 - 15 minutes. Allow them to cool in the baking tray for 2 - 3 minutes then transfer onto a peel lined with silicone paper. Store in an airtight container.

title: Spinach Tea With Almonds and Hazelnuts
ingredients: 1 ounce hazelnuts | 10 ounces spinach ( washed ) | 6 ounces tea | 2 teaspoons tabasco sauce | 2 ounces sliced almonds | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil cooking spray
instructions: Toast hazelnuts by placing them in a small piece of breadcrumb and pressing them gently into hot hazelnuts. Allow them to cool and then coarsely grind them. Put the tea, tabasco and nuts into a saucepan. Bring to a boil.

Random Ingredients: red pepper flake,herbes de provence,self rising flour,heavy cream,carrot juice,pistachio nut,sea salt
title: Carrot Pudding with Pistachio Crumble
ingredients: 1 tablespoon herbes de provence | 1 cup heavy cream ( whipping cream ) | 1 1/2 cups self-rising flour | 1 teaspoon sea salt | 1/2 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 1/4 cup grated carrot ( about 2 medium carrots ) | 3 tablespoons shelled pistachio nuts, coarsely chopped
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together herbes de provence, cream, flour, sea salt and red pepper flakes. Pour equal amounts of the cream mixture into the batter in a large, deep bowl. Sprinkle the carrots with pistachios and toss until they are evenly coated. Place the bowl onto a cookie sheet lined with parchment paper or plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 1 hours or up to 3 days. Preheat the oven to 350°f grease a 9 x 9 inch baking dish. Transfer the pancake batter on to the baking sheet and bake in the middle of the oven until puffed and golden brown, about 60 minutes. Remove pudding from oven and let cool just a few minutes, then break into pieces and serve.

title: Prawns in Yoghurt
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs large raw shrimp, peeled, de-veined and butterflied | sea scallops | 60 ml vodka | 3 teaspoons vanilla essence
instructions: Remove shells from the scallops keeping them about ½ inch long and a half inch wide. Melt butter in a medium size saucepan on low heat and add the scallops and vanilla essence. Simmer for approximately 10 to 15 minutes or until the scallops turn a little pink remove the scallops from the pan, and place on a serving plate, spoon over the sauce and serve. Serve hot with french fries, fresh bread or a light beer.

title: Beef Stew With Quark
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless beef stew meat, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 can chickpeas, drained | 1/2 cup quark | 1 tablespoon chopped dried juniper berries | 6 teaspoons fish sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients in slow cooker. Cover.

title: Ladyfingers for the Grill
ingredients: 1 lb ground veal | 1 tablespoon canola oil, if using veal oil | 1 egg yolk | 1 envelope ladyfingers
instructions: Mix veal with egg yolk, and roll into 1 inch logs. Cut diagonally into 1 inch lengths. Brush with canola oil as you cook them.. Preheat grill to medium high. Place ladyfingers in a shallow dish. Top with meat. Season lightly with salt. Lightly sprinkle with canola oil. Grill over moderate heat, turning frequently, until meat is done, about 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: veal,chutney,shrimp,thai chile,pizza dough,italian salad dressing,soymilk,olive oil
title: Baked Pizza
ingredients: 1 lb ground veal | 10 ounces shrimp | 10 ounces italian salad dressing ( i use a light version but use your favorite ) | 1 tablespoon chili powder or 1 tablespoon fresh crushed red pepper flake ( more if desired ) | 16 ounces ready-made pizza dough | 3 ounces soymilk ( skim can be used for extra flavor ) | 1 tablespoon olive oil | 1 tablespoon chutney or 1 tablespoon chopped tomato ( if unavailable, use a splash of sweet-and-sour yogurt instead of vegan )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. In a large bowl, mix together the burger and shrimp. Form the meat mixture into 2 patties. Brush the pizza dough with oil. On a lightly floured surface, roll out the dough to a 12 inch circle. Arrange them in 3 separate 9x12 inch baking pans and bake for 15 to 20 minutes, or until crust is golden brown. Cool for 1 minute before removing from pans to cool on a wire rack. In a medium bowl, mix together the chili powder, chili powder mixture and soy milk. Pour over pizza crusts.

title: Homemade Lemon Batter
ingredients: 1 cup white sugar | 1 tablespoon grated lemon zest
instructions: Place sugar and lemon zest in an 8x8 inch pan. Stir until sugar is completely dissolved.

title: Quick Broccoli Coleslaw
ingredients: 3 cups chopped fresh broccoli coleslaw mix | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce, or to taste
instructions: Place broccoli coleslaw mix into a bowl of cold water. Cover the bowl and refrigerate until the broccoli slaw is very watery, at least 30 minutes. Toss the broccoli slaw with worcestershire sauce.

title: Horchata (Greek Rice Pudding)
ingredients: 100 g corn ( canned is fine if your corn is frozen ) | 100 g arborio rice | 1 can sweetcorn ( drained ) or ( 400 g ) | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence | 8 sheets phyllo pastry
instructions: Boil 4 cups water, bring to a boil, add rice and corn. When the rice is at a boil, remove from heat and stir until all the water has been absorbed. Mix the vanilla essence into the rice mixture. Unfold sheets of phyllo pastry and brush with melted butter. Top with another sheet of pastry, brushing with more melted butter. Then spread a teaspoon full of rice mixture on the pastry, leaving a 1 cm thick border. Cut away the border and place the whole thing under the rice mixture. Wrap and put on cookie sheet and bake in a preheated oven at 190c for 15 20minutes on top shelf.

title: Chile and Halloumi Parfait With Fresh Coconut and Provolone Fours
ingredients: 1/2 - 1 1/2-1 cup fresh coconut cream | 1 anaheim chilies, seeded ( or other red chili ) or 1 jalapeno chile | 6 ounces halloumi cheese, sliced 1/4-inch thick ( or more, if preferred ) | 2 1/2 tablespoons good quality kasseri cheese, grated
instructions: Heat oven proof griddle over medium heat. Arrange halloumi slices on griddle. Spread coconut evenly over slices. Place chile slices on griddle and continue to heat for 1 minute, just until coconut begins to melt. Remove to a plate. Toast under broiler for 1 - 2 minutes, until crisp and marked. Turn chile slices over & toast other side. Sprinkle halloumi over the top, and sprinkle with kasseri.

title: Enfrijoladas
ingredients: 4 soft flour tortillas | 4 tablespoons sunflower oil, plus extra for greasing
instructions: In a large frying pan, fry the tortillas in 2 tablespoons of oil over medium heat. Drain on paper towels and spread one side of each tortilla with a teaspoonful of sunflower oil. Roll up to enclose the filling and place in a large baking dish. Heat oven to 200 degc f. Brush with a little olive oil and bake for 10 - 15 mins or until golden and crisp. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: vanilla,button mushroom,lemongrass,pepperoni,kaffir lime leaf,malt vinegar,bulgur,golden syrup
title: Veggies Stolen from Heaven
ingredients: 1 cup bulgur or 1 cup other quick-cooking rice | 1/2 cup chopped button mushroom | 2 slices golden syrup, such as syrah or 1/2 cup brown sugar | 2 kaffir lime leaves, finely chopped | 2 finely chopped lemongrass | 1/8 teaspoon ground pepperoni | 1/2 teaspoon malt vinegar
instructions: Place the bulgur in a large microwave safe bowl. Add the mushrooms and cook in microwave on high for 5 minutes, stirring well after every minute. Add the syrup/brown sugar, lime leaves, lemongrass, pepperoni and malt vinegar to the vegetables and stir until all of ingredients are combined. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: feta cheese,red pepper,tahini,cardamom,taco seasoning,brown basmati rice,turmeric powder,cumin seed
title: Feta Cheesecake Ala Tikka
ingredients: 1 box brown basmati rice ( jasmine white rice is the best ) | 2 teaspoons turmeric powder | 1 teaspoon cumin seed | 1 teaspoon saffron blackened seasoning ( sazon con azafran ) | 2 1/2 tablespoons tahini | 1 package taco seasoning ( i use mccormick's spicy taco seasoning ) | 1 tablespoon ground red pepper | 3 tablespoons feta cheese, cut into pieces
instructions: Place rice in a large bowl or serving plate. Pour 1 1/2 cups water and the turmeric over the rice in the bowl. Sift dry spices and cumin seeds into a small bowl or plate. Dissolve saffron and sazon in tahini in a small cup of water. When the rice is half way cooked, add the red pepper, taco seasoning, and ground cumin seeds to the rice, and mix thoroughly. Pour mixture in a greased 9 inch pie pan and bake at 350 degrees for 35 - 40 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted in center comes out clean. Remove the cheesecake from oven and spread cheese evenly over the top. Bake 5 minutes longer or until melty. Let cool for 5 minutes before slicing and eating.

Random Ingredients: cilantro,masoor dal,pearl barley,bell pepper,vegetable oil,maple syrup,green chili pepper,vegetable oil cooking spray
title: Masoor Dal With Peppers and Maple Syrup
ingredients: 1 cup masoor dal, coarsely ground | 2 tablespoons pearl barley | 1 green chili pepper, minced | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 1 bell pepper, cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 1/2 cup maple syrup | 1/4 cup maple syrup | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 2 teaspoons minced fresh cilantro | vegetable oil cooking spray
instructions: Prepare masoor for the cooking on the stove. Place ground masoor in a wide dish and add the green chili, cooking oil, bell pepper cubes, and maple syrup. Stir to combine. Spray skillet with cooking oil flavored cooking spray. Place over medium heat. Spread the ground masoor mixture into the skillet. Cook on the stove top to a dry brown color. Pour the maple syrup mixture over the masoor and continue cooking for 5 minutes or until the liquid has been absorbed. Place the cashew nuts on a plate and use a fork to toss the nuts into the prepared masoor. Serve immediately.

title: White Distilled White Wine Vinegar
ingredients: 6 teaspoons white wine vinegar | 6 teaspoons instant espresso coffee, dissolved
instructions: Place the vinegar, espresso and 1 teaspoon of water in a cup. Heat a 12 inch nonstick skillet over medium heat until hot. Add the liquid and heat until it boils, then immediately lower the heat to very low. Stir vigorously until it is absorbed.. Transfer the mixture to a glass jar or bowl.

Random Ingredients: tortellini,pepperoncini pepper,purpose white flour,red snapper fillet,lemon peel,shortening,cider vinegar
title: Tortellini Soup II
ingredients: 1/2 cup cider vinegar | 1/2 cup shortening | 1 package frozen tortellini | 1 pint canned red snapper fillets | 3 cans sliced pepperoncini peppers, drained | 2 lemons, zested | 2 1/2 cups all-purpose white flour
instructions: In a small saucepan, cover the vinegar with about 1 cup water and boil until clear. While the liquid is cooking, combine the shortening and tortellini in a saucepan. Add the red snapper, pepperoncini and remaining 2 cans of tomatoes, except the juice, and bring to a boil. Reduce the heat and simmer for at least 30 minutes, or until the tortellini are tender. Transfer the tortellini to a clean bowl and add the lemon zest and enough of the juice to make the soup a thick and creamy. Sprinkle the flour on top and mix well. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: dark brown sugar,bicarbonate soda,ginger paste,egg yolk,blackening seasoning,date
title: Date and Ginger Cake
ingredients: 375 g dates | 300 g dark brown sugar | 4 egg yolks | 2 teaspoons dark ginger paste | 1 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 1/2 teaspoon ginger and blackening seasoning
instructions: Pre heat oven to 160 degrees celsius. Beat egg yolks and sugar in a bowl with electric mixer until pale and thick, 2 - 3 minutes. Add ginger oil and blend again. Fold in dates, spice and date mixture. Grease and line a round cake tin with greaseproof paper. Pour mixture into tin and bake for 35 - 40 minutes. This should only fit on a standard xmas size plate. Serve warm with ice cream, cream or ice cream if you wish. This is just for fan/convection portions and makes 250 - 200 g.

title: Guacamole
ingredients: 1/4 cup flour | 1/3 cup mexican beer, like corona
instructions: Combine everything except flour in bowl and mix well. Make more filling, depending on what the recipe is. To the flour.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast half,chili garlic sauce,straw mushroom,cumin powder,vanilla bean,oatmeal,pork shoulder,lemon juice
title: Crispy Prawns (Zuccotto)
ingredients: 2 pork shoulder, cut in half ( or equivalent weight ) | 2 boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 1 lemon, juice of | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 5 ounces dried mushroom | 1 tablespoon dried shrimp garlic sauce | 3 tablespoons oatmeal | 1 vanilla bean
instructions: Mix together lemon juice and spices then add pork and chicken breasts then marinade for at least 10 minutes. Wash musrooms then soak in water for 10 minutes then drain. Combine with 1/4 cup water and marinade in sauce pan then bring to boil. Reduce heat and add cooked prawns and cook for 1 - 2 minutes. Drain and add to prawns & simmer for 2 - 3 minutes. Toss with oatmeal and serve.

title: Salmon With Raspberry and Quinoa
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs salmon | 12 ounces spinach | 11 ounces frozen raspberries | 1/4 cup raisins | 1/4 cup queso fresco, crumbled | 1 teaspoon dried oregano
instructions: Combine salmon, spinach, raspberries, raisins and oregano in a bowl. Cover and refrigerate 2 hours. Remove salmon and vegetables from refrigerator. Place salmon mixture in a lightly greased 9 inch pie plate or other oven proof dish. Sprinkle with queso fresco and dot with a little bit of oil or butter. Bake uncovered in a 375 degree oven for 40 minutes.

Random Ingredients: liquid smoke flavoring,savoy cabbage,beef shank,vegetable juice,black olive
title: Smoky Beef Stock
ingredients: 1 lb beef shank | 1/2 cup vegetable juice | 1 tablespoon liquid smoke flavoring | 1 -2 cup savoy cabbage, shredded | 1/2 cup black olives, sliced
instructions: Combine all ingredients and let it sit in a crock pot for at least 6 hours. Strain and discard solids.

title: Easy Red Enchilada Mix
ingredients: 1 cup pearl barley ( not instant ) | 1 can red enchilada sauce | 1/4 cup canola oil
instructions: Prepare barley in microwave or water. Drain, place in a bowl and add red enchilada sauce. In a microwave safe bowl, mix enchilada sauce with barley. Heat oil in a small saucepan over medium heat until hot and sizzling. Pour the heated oil into a small bowl or cup, and pour about 1/2 cup of prepared red enchilada sauce into the bowl. Place bowl over a pot of simmering water to make sure the bottom of the pot does not touch the water. This is important because if you put it too close to the hot water it will steam. Once the bottom of the pot just touches the top of the pot, turn the pot to low. Cook barley in the boiling water for 10 minutes, and stir. When you remove the bowl from the water, pour into a clean container, cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate for at least 4 hours. The longer you refrigerate, the better the results will be.

title: Strawberry Manchego and Manchego Stuffed Cherry-Slices
ingredients: 8 ounces manchego cheese, cut in 8 halves | 1 cup sliced strawberry | vegetable oil, for frying | 1/2 cup panko breadcrumbs, for topping ( japanese breadcrumb ) | 1/2 cup margarine, melted | 3/4 pound ground lamb ( optional ) | 3 tablespoons margarine, melted
instructions: Cut out the top 4 or 5 cherries from the manchego and save the rest for next stage. Fill the hollowed out cherry halves with manchego cheese halves and top with the sliced strawberries. Drizzle the 1/2 cup panko crumbs over the top or on the outside of the stuffed cherry. Melt 1/2 cup of the 2 tb melted margarine in a skillet over medium heat. Stir in the ground lamb, then stir in the 2 tablespoons of margarine. Cook the sauce while you cook the stuffed cherry shells until the lamb mixture is no longer pink, about 10 to15 minutes. Stir the 2 tablespoons margarine again into the lamb mixture. Remove the stuffed cherry shells and stuff the stuffed cherry with the lamb mixture. To serve, drizzle the warmed panko crumbs on top.

title: Greek Sticky Rice Cookies, Cooked in Foil and Caramel
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups brown rice or 1 1/2 cups white rice | 1/2 teaspoon mixed spice | 1/2 teaspoon herbes de provence | 1/3 cup walnuts, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon grated lemon peel
instructions: Place all ingredients in the bowl of a food processor and process to a fine consistency. Pour into a small glass bowl. Cover and refrigerate about 12 hours, stirring a couple of times, until set. Break off chunks of rice, roll into small balls, and store in an airtight container or in a jar for up to 6 months. Bring to room temperature before using.

Random Ingredients: prawn,tomato puree,apricot,vanilla bean,tomato green chilies,soy sauce,phyllo pastry,red bell pepper
title: Apricot Prawn Wraps
ingredients: 1 large red bell pepper | 4 ounces tomato puree, plus extra for serving | 1 tablespoon tomato puree | 1/2 vanilla bean, split in half | 1 small red paprika or 2 teaspoons paprika | 1 tablespoon reduced sodium soy sauce | 10 sheets phyllo pastry | 1/2 cup dried apricot, chopped | 400 g raw king prawns, large
instructions: Cut the bell pepper in half and remove the stem and seeds. Rinse and pat dry with kitchen paper. Place the bell pepper in a roasting tin and scatter half the tomato puree across the. Split up the remaining bell pepper thinly with a sharp knife. Scrape out the seeds and any pith and add the seeds and half the vanilla bean to the tomato puree. Wash the paprika and dry them thoroughly with kitchen paper. Place over medium heat and cook gently until the pepper starts to soften. This should take about 10 minutes, then add 1 tablespoon water and stir continuously until the pepper has softened slightly and reduced – about 20 minutes. The liquid should be syrupy and the flavor should deepen. Add a pinch of the soy sauce, season to taste, add a good pinch of paprika and cook briefly, stirring up the paprika. Transfer the pepper mixture to a chopping board and finely chop. Mince half the prawns and combine with the chopped pepper, pepper mixture, half the apricots and 1/2 cup of the reserved puree. If the sauce seems thick, add some water. Place 4 sheets of pastry on a clean work surface. Using one sheet, spread half the puree in a thin layer. Add another 4 sheets on top and spread the rest of the puree over the sheets. Cut the sheets in half and lay two sheets in the centre. Sprinkle with some water, then spoon a third on the surface and roll up the pastry to enclose the stuffing and smooth the edges. Trim off any excess pastry with a knife. Place the wraps on a baking tray and chill for at least 20 minutes, up to 48 hours, for the flavours to develop, basting with the remaining puree. Cut 2 or 3 strips 2 x 2, for the garnish. Cook the prawns, skin on, over high heat in a large frying pan. When they change colour, add the reserved pureé, cover and simmer for 4 minutes. Season. Divide the prawn mixture among the wraps and sprinkle with apricot halves. Garnish with remaining chopped scallions and serve with rice.

Random Ingredients: avocado oil,tomato soup,feta,puff pastry,cheddar cheese,yellow cornmeal,ghee,chipotle chile
title: Tex Mex Pizza Crust
ingredients: 5 tablespoons yellow cornmeal | 1 cup shredded cheddar cheese | 1/3 cup cubed feta | 2 tablespoons gulden's chipotle chile | 1 tablespoon canola oil or 1 tablespoon canola oil | 1 can condensed tomato soup | 1 package frozen puff pastry sheets ( 1 1/2 x 9-inch sheets )
instructions: In medium bowl, combine cornmeal with 1/4 cup cheese, feta and chiles. Sprinkle with remaining 1/4 cup cheese. Heat oil in 10 inch nonstick skillet over medium heat. Working with approximately 2 tablespoons of dough at a time, put 2 tablespoons of filling in center. Roll in long, thin, strip like cylinder. Transfer to plate, tent with foil, and refrigerate 4 hours or overnight. Bake at 450°f for 15 to 20 minutes until center is slightly golden brown. Top with tomato soup.

title: Queso Content
ingredients: 1 pound four-cheese mexican blend cheese, shredded | 1 jar marinade, divided
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. In a small bowl, combine half the shredded cheese and half the marinade.

Random Ingredients: black peppercorn,mirin,balsamic vinegar,red snapper fillet,puff pastry,pecan,banana
title: Balsamic Glazed Fish
ingredients: 1 lb red snapper fillet | 3 tablespoons aged balsamic vinegar | 4 pecans | 3 teaspoons black peppercorns, smashed | 2 teaspoons cracked black peppercorns | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 2 teaspoons mirin | 1 sheet puff pastry
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Remove skin from fish fish and place on non stick baking pan or in shallow glass dish with a 1/3 cup of water. Brush fish with balsamic vinegar. Sprinkle with peppercorns, corns, and black peppercorns. Bake for 7 minutes. Reduce oven temperature to 200°f. On top of fish, spread with 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar. Sprinkle with paprika. Cut puff pastry sheet into 8 squares. Roll each square to 1/8 inch thickness. Press edges firmly to seal together well. Bake for 10 - 12 minutes until crisp and golden.

Random Ingredients: brussels sprout,vegetable oil,white tequila,worcestershire sauce,spinach leaf,olive oil,chicken bouillon powder,poblano chile
title: Spinach and Smoked Chile Tacos W-Crispy Vegetables for One
ingredients: 2 cups fresh spinach leaves | 8 large flat poblano chiles, 1 inch-thick ( about 1-2 cups ) | 1 tablespoon olive oil | 1 tablespoon chicken bouillon powder | 2 teaspoons worcestershire sauce | 2 teaspoons vegetable oil | 2 teaspoons white tequila ( optional ) | 24 fresh brussels sprouts ( about 2 pounds )
instructions: Bring 4 quarts of water and 1 tbs of salt to a boil in a 6 - 8 quart kettle. Add the spinach leaves, and cook over medium low heat, stirring often, until just wilted, about 4 minutes. Drain and allow to cool slightly then squeeze between paper towels and coarsely chop using 2 tbsp of the liquid from the spinach. Cut 2 or 3 chile slices in half crosswise and place them cut side down on the cutting board with the flat side of a cleaver or sharp knife or other heavy knife. If the chiles are large, tear off some of the green stem at the bottom of each half. Cut them crosswise into 2 or 3 chile pieces. Heat 1 tbs oil in a 12 inch skillet over moderately high heat until hot but not smoking, then cook the chiles, stirring frequently, until lightly coloured with deep brown, very pale gold undersides, about 6 minutes. Stir in the bouillon powder, worcestershire and vegetable oil. Remove the skillet from the heat. Add the brussels sprouts and cook, stirring frequently, until they just start to soften, about 5 minutes longer. Add the chile mixture and the tequila and stir to mix. Place 2 or 3 sprouts on each of 4 warm or toasted or lightly floured hot taco shells, then divide the filling among the toasted or lightly mashed shells. Serve immediately, passing the lids and toppings separately.

title: Green, Poached and Barley Wedges
ingredients: 2 slices prosciutto, chopped | 1 can chopped green chilies | 1 1/2 cups cherry | 1 cup white wine | 1 cup pearl barley, washed | 1 teaspoon dried dill
instructions: Cut the prosciutto slices into 1 inch cubes. Drain, and set aside. Place the green chilies, cherry, and wine in a large saucepan. Boil over high heat, stirring often, until the wine has reduced by half. Add the rice and dill to the boiling liquid, and mix well. Cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to medium low. Simmer for 30 minutes, or until most of the liquid has been absorbed. Remove from heat, and allow to sit for 5 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: rosemary,escarole,plain flour,red wine vinegar,serrano pepper,lentil,oregano sprig
title: Lentil and Escarole Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup lentils, rinsed, picked over, and drained ( a combination of pulses ) | 2 cups escarole, washed, drained and sliced thin | 1 tablespoon oregano sprig, washed and dried | fresh rosemary, cleaned, trimmed and sliced thin | 1 -2 serrano pepper, sliced | 1 tablespoon red wine vinegar | plain flour, for coating | fresh rosemary, for garnish
instructions: Cook lentils in salted boiling water until tender, about 15 minutes. Drain and set aside. In a large glass or plastic bowl, mix together, lentils and escarole. Sprinkle in oregano, rosemary, peppers, vinegar and coarsely chopped rosemary. Toss well. Serve at room temperature if desired.

title: Quick and Easy Sour Cream Enchiladas
ingredients: 24 corn tortillas | 1 can condensed cream of potato soup
instructions: Soften tortillas in microwave for 10 seconds per tortilla. Dip each tortilla in soup, then roll it in sour cream. Serve with salsa or guacamole.

title: Parsley (Saint James's Bread of the Dead)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs brown mustard seeds | 3 ounces shelled unsalted pistachio nuts
instructions: Toast the mustard seeds in an intense, high heat oven for about 10 minutes. Remove seeds from the oven, and allow to cool. Grind both to a fine powder. Place half of the pistachios in the center of a serving bowl. Sprinkle the remaining pistachios on top. Use a coffee grinder to grind the other half of the pistachios. Press coarsely on to the pistachios using the flat side of the grinder. Using your hands, roll the pistachios. Serve. Can be served over fresh rye bread or on its own or as a topping for bread as an accompaniment.

Random Ingredients: salt pepper,pearl onion,sesame oil,veal,molasses,beef chuck steak,sirloin
title: Lola's Kebabs
ingredients: 3 lbs sirloin, cut into 1 inch cubes | 12 ounces beef chuck steaks, cut into 1 inch cubes | 12 ounces veal, cut into 1 inch cubes | 10 ounces frozen pearl onions | 1/4 cup molasses | 1/4 cup sesame oil | salt and pepper
instructions: Place beef, veal and onions into a large bowl. Drizzle with oil, then add molasses and sesame oil. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Let stand 10 minutes. Pour half the mixture over the meat evenly. Cover and marinate in refrigerator for 1 - 12 hours, flipping over about half way through. Grill over medium heat, turning occasionally, about 20 to 30 minutes, or until meat is tender and glazed.

Random Ingredients: lemon,breadcrumb,ancho chile,bulb garlic,taco seasoning mix,cocoa powder
title: Salsa Fresca
ingredients: 2 small bulbs of garlic | 1 can whole canned ancho chiles | 1/2 cup taco seasoning mix | 1/2 cup soft breadcrumbs | 1/3 cup unsweetened cocoa powder | 1/4 cup lemon rind
instructions: In a food processor, drop whole garlic cloves into simmering water and cook until the cloves are soft enough to crush but not mushy. Remove garlic cloves and keep hot in a bowl. Remove tops of chilies and discard stems. Slice garlic cloves on a slight bias, leaving stems on, discard ends and seeds if desired. You can leave the garlic whole and use it in tacos, burritos, enchiladas, as an accompaniment. If you would like salsa fresca, stir together ingredients in a bowl and transfer mixture to a container or resealable plastic bag. Refrigerate for at least an hour. When ready to serve, add salsa fresca, shredded cheese, sour cream and a sprinkle of cilantro for a festive kick.

title: Blue Cheese Beef Roast
ingredients: 1 1/2 1 1/2 lbs beef steaks, cut into 1-inch cube | 1 cup golden raisin | 2 tablespoons fresh peppercorns, cracked | 1 lb fresh oyster mushrooms, sliced | 1 cup fresh raspberry ( or raspberry jam if jam is not halal ) | 8 ounces blue cheese, crumbled
instructions: Place beef in roasting pan, sprinkle with cracked peppercorns. Stir in mushrooms, berries and blue cheese. Turn the steak over, then cover the pan. Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Bake meat, uncovered, for 45 - 50 minutes, until meat reaches an internal temperature of 140°f.

Random Ingredients: pizza crust,red wine vinegar,tomato puree,ham,grand marnier,chicken breast half,tempeh,monterey jack cheese
title: Poulet Basquaise (Chicken)
ingredients: 1 pre-baked, baked pizza crust | 4 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves - pounded to 1/4 inch thickness | 1 package tempeh | 1 1/2 cups red wine vinegar | 1 cup grand marnier | 1 can tomato puree | 2 tablespoons grand marnier | 1 cup shredded monterey jack cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Spread the baked pizza crust with equal amounts of pizza sauce, tempeh, red wine vinegar, grand marnier, tomato puree, and cheese evenly on the crust. Bake in the preheated oven until the crust is golden, 5 to 7 minutes.

title: Red Curry Beet Soup
ingredients: 1 small beet, unpeeled and sliced | 2 tablespoons red curry paste | 1/2 cup nonfat evaporated skim milk
instructions: Combine the beet, curry paste and milk in a saucepan.

title: Pear and Pear Scaloppine
ingredients: 2 ripe pears | 1 tablespoon kosher salt | 1 baguette, sliced into 1 1/2-inch round slices | 2 fillets tilapia | 1/2 cup apricot jam
instructions: Wash pears and remove core, but leave intact. Cut in half, remove seeds and dice. Sprinkle salt over loaf slices on baking sheet. Place bread slices in bowl of micro safe bowl with a pinch of kosher salt & mash on high for 1 second to release flavor. Turn bread slices over & salt, mix for 1 minute more. Arrange slices on bread slices, spreading with jam, and cover with plastic wrap. Microwave at high power for 6 minutes. Remove plastic wrap & remove bread slices from microwave & let stand for 3 minutes. Stir. Serve bread slices with pear mixture spooned over, and some sauce on the side. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: lemon balm,red wine vinegar,kidney bean,topping,mace,mint leaf,toothpick
title: Kidney Bean Salad
ingredients: 6 ounces tomato-pepper kidney beans | 6 ounces thin-sliced fresh mushrooms | 1/2 teaspoon dried mint leaves | 1/4 teaspoon dried lemon balm | 1/8 teaspoon ground mace | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar | toothpick, for serving
instructions: Soak beans over low heat to tenderise slightly for an hour or two. Drain and cool under running water. Meanwhile, place beans in a bowl. Add remaining ingredients and mix until well combined. Garnish with tooth picks.

Random Ingredients: purpose flour,beef rib,water chestnut,filling,green cardamom pod
title: Koshary
ingredients: 2 pounds beef short ribs, cut into 2 inch pieces | 3/8 cup water chestnut, sliced | 5 green cardamom pods, crushed | 3 cups all-purpose flour | 1 package filling for meat | 2 tablespoons water
instructions: In a bowl, mix together short ribs, water chestnuts, green cardamom pods, and flour to form a thick batter. Divide the mixture into 4 portions, and form each into a small crescent. Place a piece of meat at the bottom of one of those portions. Fold over the short ribs, and shape them into crescents. Repeat with the remaining pieces of meat and crescents. Place crescents on a platter, and cover with a damp cloth. Let sit at room temperature for 20 minutes to absorb the flavors. Dredge in flour, shaking off excess. Heat a large cast iron skillet or griddle over medium heat. Cook 1 batch of meat over medium heat until browned, turning once. Top each piece with 1 tablespoon of water per side.

Random Ingredients: hot water,caster sugar,mango powder,dark soy sauce,coconut
title: Mango and Coconut Balls (Bhaji)
ingredients: 1 cup shredded coconut ( kerni ) | 3 tablespoons caster sugar ( maida ) | 2 tablespoons hot water | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce | 1 1/2 teaspoons mango powder ( optional ) or 1 1/2 teaspoons kamaal olek ( optional )
instructions: Soak the coconut in hot water for 10 minutes. Drain and squeeze out excess water. Combine all ingredients except the mango powder or kamaal olek and mix thoroughly. Add the coconut to the mixture to make small balls, and then shape them in the palm of your hand. Refrigerate overnight. When serving, remove balls from their containers, and serve with hot curries.

title: Porchetta (Prawns and Bean Salad)
ingredients: 3 ounces shelled prawns | 1 lb cooked ham | 12 ladyfingers | 1 1/2 cups cooked kidney beans | 1/2 cup green beans
instructions: Bake prawns and ham on a greased oven tray. Mix cooked beans with green beans and prawns. Cut into quarters. Arrange on a serving platter.

title: Polly Welby's Harvest Salad Recipe
ingredients: 1 savoy cabbage, thinly sliced diagonally | 50 -75 g sliced walnuts | 1 pint fresh raspberry | 1 teaspoon dried cherries or 1 teaspoon cherries juice | 2 tablespoons mayonnaise
instructions: Mix mayo with the mayo, chill, enjoy.

title: Toad in the Hole
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs lean ground chicken | 1 lb italian sausage, removed from casing | 1 pint nonfat dry milk powder | 1 pint double cream | 1 can fruit, drained, rinsed and chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. In a large mixing bowl, add all the ingredients through the top of the milk and cream. Mix well. Spoon into a large casserole dish and bake in the preheated oven for 90 - 90 minutes, or until a knife comes out clean. Drain the excess fat. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: hard egg,eggplant,black cardamom pod,beef chuck,sparerib,grape tomato,chicken bouillon cube
title: Eggplant and Beef Soup
ingredients: 1 lb eggplant, peeled cut in half, lengthwise, cut in 1/2 inch slices | 1 1/2 lbs small beef chuck, in 1/2 inch dice, weigh after removing skin | 1 can beef bones with marrow, including marrow, with marrow | 6 cups chicken bouillon cubes | 1 small hard egg, chopped | 8 cups fresh tomatoes, washed cut into 1 1/2 inch wedges, not drained | 1/2 teaspoon cracked black cardamom pod ( optional )
instructions: Place eggplant over a bowl for 30 minutes. After eggplant is thoroughly cooked, peel off skin and discard. Chop coarsely in grinder or food processor. Cut beef and place in 2 soup tins or soup pot. Add bones, chicken, hard boiled egg and all of the tomatoes. Simmer about 30 minutes or until tomatoes are soft but not mushy. Turn off heat. In a large pot, bring 6 cups of water to a boil. Add crushed black cardamom pods and remaining ingredients. Return to a boil and then reduce heat and simmer for 3 hours or until eggplant is very tender.

title: Grilled Sweet Corn on the Cob
ingredients: 1 fresh sweet corn, husks and silk removed | 2 tablespoons creole-style seasoning
instructions: Cut off the top half of the corn husk and spread it very lightly with the creole style seasoning, as if you were running a knife around the inside of the corning husk. Open it up like a book, and spread it out evenly on the corn. The cut off kernels should be in a single layer, no more than 1/2 inch thick. Cover tightly with aluminum foil.

title: Indian Style Baby Green (Fooze)
ingredients: 4 bunches mixed fresh baby greens | cumin powder or a generous pinch of cayenne pepper ( optional )
instructions: If preparing fresh greens, wash and separate them into leaves and flowers. Tear off the bottom of each pile. Place greens in shallow glass or ceramic dish, sprinkle with cumin and/or cayenne, then add about one tbsp. Water. Turn over once to coat. Cover, and let sit for about 15 minutes. Uncover and serve at room temp. Or chill for several hours and serve on a toasted or toasted baguette.

title: Homemade Perfected Italian Parsley Sauce
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons flat-leaf italian parsley | 4 teaspoons cold water
instructions: Place the italian parsley on a cutting board and cut away the root ends. Wrap loosely and let sit for 15 to 20 minutes. Trim off the stem and leaves and discard. Using a small spoon, gently squeeze between your fingers to extract the juice and discard the pulp. Combine with the other ingredients in a small bowl or jar with a tight fitting lid and mix well, adding more water if needed to form a somewhat thick sauce. Seal, and store in the refrigerator for up to 1 month, shaking the jar daily to mix the sauce, and adding more water if needed.
