Random Ingredients: vegetable oil,rice,cheddar cheese,beer,whiskey try yukon jack,cashew,pico de gallo,skewer
title: Skewered Steak (Houston-Style)
ingredients: 1/2 cup guiness beer | 1/2 cup pico de gallo | 1/2 cup cashews | 4 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1 1/2 lbs boneless sirloin steaks, pounded to 1/8 inch thick | 2/3 cup shredded cheddar cheese | 4 cups hot cooked rice | skewer
instructions: In large bowl, stir together guiness, pico de gallo, cashews, and 1 tablespoon oil. Spread mixture over both sides of steak. Cover and refrigerate 30 minutes. Heat remaining 1 tablespoon oil in large nonstick skillet. Add steaks and cook over high heat, turning once, until browned on both sides, about 4 minutes per side. Remove from skillet and let stand, covered, 5 minutes. Divide rice among 4 plates. Top with steak and 1 cup cheese, dividing evenly. Arrange 1 cup salsa among plates and serve with steak and salsa.

Random Ingredients: yellow bell pepper,bean sprout,tamarind paste,lemon,italian parsley
title: Tamarind Chai Noodles
ingredients: 2 yellow bell peppers, chopped | 6 -10 leaves italian parsley ( or other fresh herb ) | 2 -3 tablespoons tamarind paste ( found in asian grocery stores ) | 1 package fresh bean sprouts | lemon slice ( optional )
instructions: Blend all ingredients together for 5 minutes. Add some water to aid in cooking.

title: Chocolate Flavoured Churros
ingredients: 1 large banana, roughly chopped | 500 ml beef bouillon cubes | 4 teaspoons cocoa, preferably dutch-process | 2 -4 red chili peppers, deseeded and finely chopped
instructions: Place bouillon and cocoa in large pan. Heat gently, then simmer, uncovered but stirring occasionally until mixture boils, around 5 - 7 minutes. Remove from pan and stir in chillies. Cool slightly, then cover and chill until ready to use. Cut into fingers about 6cm thick, and store in fridge.

Random Ingredients: beef base,rotel tomato,raisin,pork sparerib,chocolate baking square,porcini mushroom,mustard seed,flat leaf parsley
title: Spanish-Style Spareribs
ingredients: 4 lbs pork spareribs | 1/2 cup chopped flat leaf parsley | 2 teaspoons mustard seeds | 4 ounces unsweetened chocolate baking squares, melted | 1/2 cup raisins | 2 cans rotel tomatoes, undrained | 1 1/2 teaspoons beef base | 1/2 cup chianti-style unsweetened chocolate and rosemary baking squares, melted
instructions: In a large nonreactive slow cooker, place spareribs. Sprinkle with parsley.

Random Ingredients: orange bell pepper,oregano,lima bean,brie cheese,parsley leaf,yellow onion,biscuit
title: Italian Brie Spread
ingredients: 18 2/3 ounces refrigerated biscuits ( the pepperidge farm biscuits ) | 1 large yellow onion, diced | 1 orange bell pepper, diced | 1 package frozen lima beans, thawed | 1 lb brie cheese, diced | 3/4 teaspoon dried oregano | 1/2 cup olive oil | 1/4 cup fresh parsley leaves, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Remove dough from a box and refrigerate for at least 20 minutes. Roll each dough piece into a rectangle about 24 x 12. Place on a sheet of plastic wrap and flatten out using a rolling pin. Place in refrigerator. Meanwhile in a small skillet cook and stir onion and bell pepper for 3 - 4 minutes. Drain and discard peppers. Stir in lima beans, brie cheese, and oregano. Cover and chill mixture for 1 hour. Brush a 1 qt baking dish with olive oil. Place one dough rectangle on the baking sheet, pressing it down to fit if necessary. Spread bean mixture evenly over dough, leaving several 1/2-inch border around the edge of the dough. Drizzle a 1/2 cup of olive oil over the cheese mixture. Repeat process with remaining dough, oiling baking dish, etc. Sprinkle shredded cheese mixture over the cheese. Bake for 15 - 20 minutes until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: bratwurst,anise,soya sauce,spinach,soba noodle,xanthan gum,linguine,extra finely sugar
title: Steamed Noodle With Spinach and Fresh Rind
ingredients: 3 tablespoons soya sauce | 2 tablespoons soya sauce | 12 ounces linguine ( thin spaghetti or linguini ) | 1 lb bratwurst | 1 cup fresh spinach | 8 ounces soya sauce | xanthan gum | 1/4 teaspoon anise | 1/3 cup fresh nora seaweed ( or 2 tsp. daniels ) | 1 1/2 lbs fresh fresh spinach
instructions: Steam cook the linguini until al dente. Add soya sauce and bring mixture to boil. Add noodles, bring to boil, simmer until heated thru. Steam bratwurst until cooked until no longer pink, drain. Slice bratwurst into 1/4 pieces and coat with kinako and aniseed. Heat wok, add wok, add oil. Add bratwurst and sauté over med high heat for 4 minutes. Remove bratwurst from wok, add spinach, tossing until wilted. Add rice and sauté over med high heat for 2 minutes, remove from wok, toss in soya sauce and add cooked noodles, toss until mixed.

title: Easy Black Beans Dip
ingredients: 1 package philadelphia cream cheese, softened | 1 can black beans, drained and rinsed
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and refrigerate at least 2 hours.

Random Ingredients: green bean,brussels sprout,cream chicken soup,yellow onion
title: Creamy Brussels Sprouts & Green Beans
ingredients: 2 packages frozen brussels sprouts, thawed | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1/2 medium yellow onion, chopped | 1 package frozen green beans, thawed
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl. Cover, & refrigerate approximately 1 hour. Note, do not drain green beans. Serve with toasted, buttered bread slices.

Random Ingredients: fennel seed,splenda granular,lobster tail,dill,porcini mushroom,cilantro leaf
title: Lobster Tails With Mushrooms and Refried Beans
ingredients: 4 tablespoons splenda granular | 1 tablespoon crushed dried mushrooms | 3 tablespoons snipped fresh dill | 1 tablespoon dried licintine mushrooms | 1 teaspoon fennel seed | 24 small lobster tails | 1/2 cup whole-wheat spaghettini or 1/2 cup other small dried beans
instructions: Combine the first 5 ingredients in a small bowl.

title: Quick and Easy Thai Sandwiches
ingredients: 2 fresh hoagie rolls or 2 hoagie rolls, split | 2 tablespoons green curry paste | 2 tablespoons taco seasoning | 1/2 cup onion, sliced thin | 1 cup maraschino cherry
instructions: Cut rolls lengthwise, top each with 1 tablespoon curry paste and sprinkle with taco seasoning. Place onion on bottom half of each roll, top with remaining sauce. Garnish with cherry. Serve on sandwich plates.

title: Garlicky Lime Marinade for Steak and Pork
ingredients: 2 lbs meaty round steaks or 2 lbs round steaks, cut 1/2 inch thick and about 3 to 4 inches long | 1 1 tablespoon grated lemon peel | 1 tablespoon minced cilantro or 1 teaspoon dried cilantro | 1 tablespoon minced lime peel | 2 2 teaspoons good concentrated beef bouillon or 2 teaspoons other prepared bouillon cube
instructions: Place beef or meat in a shallow dish and sprinkle with lemon, cilantro and lime peel. Top with the bouillon cube. Cover and chill overnight, or at least 4 hours. Remove meat from marinade and saute over medium high heat in 1 or 2 tbls. Drippings of any browning, stirring constantly. Adjust the temperature after 5 to 7 minutes to ensure marinating does not burn.

title: Pigeon Pea Pudding
ingredients: 1 cup pigeon peas, cooked to room temperature & cooled | 1 bottle margarita mix | 1 tablespoon cardamom pod, crushed fresh
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a medium saucepan & simmer until just tender ~ about 20 - 30 minutes. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: plain nonfat yogurt,pork roast,olive,hot dog bun,cocoa,catsup
title: Pork Buns With Chocolate Sauce
ingredients: 3 lbs boneless pork roast | 1/4 cup heinz catsup | 1/4 teaspoon unsweetened cocoa | 3 tablespoons plain nonfat yogurt | 1 cup shredded unsweetened applesauce packed in tin ( or use any desired flavoring ) | hot dog buns or crispbread cracker
instructions: Heat oven to 325 degrees. Spread the pork roast in a roasting pan. Top with 1/4 cup catsup. Bake 40 - 50 minutes, remove from oven, and let stand 5 minutes. Slice across the grain into thin slices. Meanwhile, stir together 2 tablespoons of cocoa with 1 tablespoon of yogurt, and stir in applesauce. Brush tops of buns with apple sauce. Place on a baking rack and bake until bottoms are golden, about 10 minutes. Serve with pork and sauce. This recipe also works well with pork chops. I prefer them over browned pork.

title: Gnocchi Guacamole W- Pork& Avocado
ingredients: 1 lb ground pork | 1 can condensed cream of celery soup | 3 hass avocadoes | 1 tablespoon cocoa powder | 1 package refrigerated gnocchi, prepared
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Spray the inside of a large bowl with cooking spray. Mix the pork and celery soup in a large bowl and mix well. Slice the avocados in half and remove the seeds. Cut the avocados into 1/2 inch pieces and sprinkle over the pork and celery mixture. Mix well. Stir in the cocoa powder. Spread a small amount of the gnocchi into the bottom of a lightly greased 11 x 7 x 2 inch baking dish, and place the guacamole mixture in the center. Top with the remaining gnocchi, and sprinkle with salt and pepper. Bake 20 minutes or until lightly browned.

title: Smashed Peppers
ingredients: 4 medium roasted sweet peppers | 1 cup pattypancky breadcrumbs | 1 cup panko breadcrumbs | 1 cup provolone cheese or 1 cup gruyere cheese
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees. Line the baking sheet with parchment paper. Slice the peppers lengthwise into 1/2 inch slices. Arrange on pan. Sprinkle on 1/3 cup panko and 1 cup panko over the peppers, then sprinkle with 1/2 cup cheese. Heat the peppers under the broiler for just a few seconds or until the cheese begins to melt. Turn over and broil the other side as long as the time stated. Turn the peppers over and broil the second side 5 minutes. Slide the peppers onto paper towels and place in a plastic bag overnight. Heat a cast iron or other heavy, oven proof skillet over medium heat and toast the cheese until beginning to brown, about 10 minutes, then remove from the stove and cut each piece in half crosswise with a serrated knife. Place the peppers on the paper towels to soak up all the juices. Place on an oven proof platter and serve with crackers or a side of toasted baguette.

Random Ingredients: pickling cucumber,bacon,lamb loin chop,orange flower water,beef roast,egg
title: Lamb Chops in Orange Flower Syrup
ingredients: 4 pork loin chops | 1 tablespoon orange flower water | 2 tablespoons pickling cucumbers | 1 slice bacon | 4 hard-cooked eggs, chopped | 1 egg, hard-boiled
instructions: Trim excess fat from chops. Remove fat from frypan. Heat frypan over medium heat, add pork chops and brown on both sides. Remove. Add orange flower water, cucumbers and bacon. Stir fry until cucumbers start to soften about 10 minutes. Add onions and cook until transparent about 2 minutes. Transfer pork chops to platter and surround with cooked egg.

Random Ingredients: israeli couscous,orange juice,nutmeg,hungarian paprika,cinnamon sugar,ginger,fettuccine pasta,sazon goya coriander annatto
title: Moroccan Couscous With Parsley and Caramelized Caramelized Glazed Ginger
ingredients: 1 lb israeli couscous ( or other long-grain ) | 1 pinch nutmeg | 2 -3 teaspoons hungarian paprika | 1 pinch cinnamon sugar | 1 packet sazon goya with coriander and annatto | 4 dashes orange juice | 1 tablespoon minced fresh ginger | 8 ounces fettuccine pasta or 8 ounces linguine | 1 cinnamon sugar, for sprinkling
instructions: Boil water, and a pinch of nutmeg in a medium saucepan. When the water has been absorbed, add the couscous and a pinch of paprika then bring to a boil. Cover and set aside. In a small pot, melt the 2 tablespoons of butter in a small nonstick skillet over medium heat. Add the sazon goya, orange juice, ginger, fettuccine and sprinkle with cinnamon sugar. Stir to mix and saute for about 10 minutes. Remove from heat, and serve.

Random Ingredients: mace,lime leaf,kosher salt,beet,tomato green chile pepper,red enchilada sauce,vegetable,ziti pasta
title: Enchilada Pasta Salad
ingredients: 13 ounces dry ziti pasta | 1 1/4 cups crushed mixed vegetables | 1 can diced tomatoes with mild green chile peppers | 1 can red enchilada sauce | 1/2 cup chopped fresh mace | 1 teaspoon kosher salt | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh lime leaves
instructions: Cook pasta in a large pot of boiling salted water until al dente. Drain, rinse under cold water and drain again. Transfer the cooked pasta to a large bowl. Add the vegetables, enchilada sauce, mace, salt, lime leaves and half the pasta water and stir to blend. Transfer to a serving bowl or decorative serving platter or serve as a side dish and refrigerate to cool slightly. Garnish with the chopped cilantro and lime before serving.

title: Dusted Beef Shank
ingredients: 8 beef shank | 1/2 cup sour cream, or as necessary | 1/2 cup finely chopped pecans
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Arrange shank in the bottom of a baking dish that has been coated with cooking spray. Spread sour cream evenly over beef. Sprinkle pecans over top. Bake in preheated oven for 1 hour, or until shank is tender.

Random Ingredients: milk,artichoke heart,wheat flour,chili powder,yukon gold potato
title: Artichokes in Pudding (Artichoke-Potato Pancake)
ingredients: 8 large artichoke hearts, peeled | 1 1/2 lbs yukon gold potatoes, scrubbed or 1 1/2 lbs yukon gold potatoes, peeled and cut in 1 1/2-inch pieces | 3 tablespoons whole wheat flour | 1 1/8 cups milk | 1/2 teaspoon chili powder
instructions: Bring a medium pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add the potatoes and cook, covered, until tender, about 15 minutes. Drain well and set aside. Heat the oven to 400°f peel the artichoke hearts and slice into very small pieces. In a large bowl, toss the potatoes with the flour and stir in enough milk so the potatoes are submerged. Add the artichokes and cook over moderate heat for 5 minutes. Taste and adjust the seasoning. Add the chili powder and cook for 1 minute longer. Spoon about 1/4 cup of the potato mixture into a buttered 2 quart baking dish and bake until golden, about 15 minutes.

title: Italian Chicken with Fig Compote
ingredients: 1/2 cup yellow mustard | 2 plum tomatoes, chopped | 7 tablespoons fresh figs, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon baking powder | 1/2 lb boneless chicken thighs, about 3/4 pound each | 2 tablespoons prepared yellow mustard
instructions: To prepare compote, combine all compote ingredients in a medium saucepan.

title: Creamy Zucchini & Pineapple Salad
ingredients: 3 small zucchini | 1 can pineapple chunks | 3 tablespoons capers, drained | 2 tablespoons unsalted kraft mexican-style shaved cheese | 2 tablespoons amaretto | 250 g marinated pineapple chunks, drained | grated mizithra cheese | 2 tablespoons shaved paraffin wax paper or 2 tablespoons shaved pretzel
instructions: Preheat oven to 180c. Line a baking tray with baking paper. Halve each zucchini lengthways and cut a shallow cross onto the zucchini flesh, then slice crossways into thin sticks. Set aside until needed. Place zucchini sticks and cut into thirds lengthways. Transfer to a bowl and add remaining ingredients and mix well. Spoon mixture onto baking tray and bake for 20 minutes or until golden brown. Serve.

title: Red Beans
ingredients: 5 ounces dried red beans, soaked overnight in cold water and drained | 2 tablespoons tahini
instructions: Place the beans in a large pan, pour over enough water to cover. Bring to the boil over high heat, then reduce to low and simmer for 30 - 45 minutes until the beans are tender. Drain. Mix the remaining ingredients together and serve on its own as a burrito.

Random Ingredients: yogurt,matzo meal,napa cabbage,beet,white sugar,ginger,chipotle chile,flat leaf parsley
title: Napa Cabbage and Nuts (Khao Man Kebab)
ingredients: 3 bunches napa cabbage, shredded | 2 bunches flat leaf parsley, chopped | 1/2 cup shredded ginger | 12 fresh canned chipotle chiles, minced | 2 cans beets, drained | 1 cup plain yogurt | 1 tablespoon white sugar | 1 package matzo meal
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together shredded cabbage, parsley, ginger, chipotle chilies, beets, yogurt, and sugar. Spread the mixture out in the bottom of a large, heavy stockpot. Sprinkle in matzo meal, and place over medium heat. Cook and stir until dough turns from lumpy to bread crumbs, about 15 minutes. Let cool, and store in the refrigerator. To eat, place a piece of khao man kab onto a plate, and roll in a piece of napa cabbage to serve.

Random Ingredients: juniper berry,cardamom pod,lime zest,turnip,semolina,chicken drumstick,wine vinegar,dijon mustard
title: Turnip Daube
ingredients: 1/2 cup dijon mustard | 1 teaspoon lime zest | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground cardamom pod | 1/4 cup dry white wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom pod | 1 teaspoon dried juniper berries, crushed | 5 1/2 lbs halibut or 5 1/2 lbs other dark-skinned chicken thigh | 1 1/2 lbs turnips, peeled and cut into chunks | 1 1/2 cups semolina, coarsely ground
instructions: Combine mustards, zest, cardamom and vinegar in large bowl. Add cardamom and juniper, cover and chill. Sprinkle chicken with salt. Cover and marinate at room temperature for 4 hours or refrigerate overnight. Preheat oven to 300°f place turnips and turnip in a roasting pan. Spread with cooking oil. Roast for 2 hours, reduce heat to 350°f and roast another 1/2 hour or until turnips are crisp and turnips are tender. Add turnips to remaining marinade and cook until liquid is absorbed and turnips are glazed. Remove from oven and pour into bowl to cool. Place chicken and turnip mixture in a bowl, drizzle with marinade and toss. Let sit for 1 hour. Toast molina over low heat, stirring constantly until it turns golden and begins to bubble about 10 minutes. Transfer molina to rack and let cool slightly before serving.

Random Ingredients: olive oil,cornstarch,confectioner ' sugar,topping,green cardamom pod,wheat flour
title: Quick  Moroccan Dessert Cake  (Firakh M'tallal)
ingredients: 1 cup whole wheat flour | 2/3 cup confectioners'sugar | 1/2 cup cornstarch | 1 -2 teaspoon black sesame seeds ( i've also used sunflower seeds ) or 1 -2 teaspoon yellow sesame seeds ( i've also used sunflower seeds ) | 1/2 teaspoon green cardamom pod | olive oil
instructions: Preparation, put the flour, sugar, corn starch, black and yellow sesame seeds into a mixing bowl and mix together. If you don't have a whisk, beat with a wooden spoon at a low speed for 2 - 3 minutes. Add a bit of olive oil to your blender and pulse the ingredients until they form a fairly smooth batter. This will take about a minute or two. Pour the batter into a greased 9 inch pan or a springform pan. Sprinkle the top with the green cardamom seeds or sunflower seeds. Let it sit at room temperature for about 10 - 15 minutes while it preheats to the house. Cooking, preheat the oven to 425°f. Bake the cake in the oven for 15 - 20 minutes or until it tests done with a toothpick in the center. Remove the cake from the oven and let it cool on a wire rack. The center will be cold. Cut pieces, and serve.

title: Mexican Hot Sauce
ingredients: 1 green bell pepper, cut into bite-size squares | 12 ounces diced green fat ( such as lard or shortening )
instructions: Mix in 2/3 cup water. Let stand for 20 minutes before using to keep warm over low heat. For best results use immediately, but keep 2 1/2 teaspoonful portions in a sealed jar in a warm place for longer storage.

title: Almond Stuffed Turkey
ingredients: 1 turkey meat ( about 3 lbs ) | 16 ounces mushroom pieces, sliced | 2 ounces sliced almonds | 3/4 cup crumbled feta cheese | 1 cup dry rice | 1/2 cup slivered almonds, toasted | 2 tablespoons dried sage leaves
instructions: Remove all excess fat from turkey and discard bones and membrane. Cut the turkey diagonally into 8 slices with a knife. Place slices, overlapping, in a lightly greased 9x13 baking dish. Top turkey with mushrooms, sliced almonds and cheese. Sprinkle with remaining ingredients. Cover and bake in preheated 375°f oven for 40 - 45 minutes until turkey is no longer pink inside. Remove turkey slices from pan and serve.

Random Ingredients: swiss cheese,oyster sauce,spaghetti sauce,tarragon,saffron thread,pistachio,russet potato,white sauce
title: Potato and Cheese Phyllo Triangles
ingredients: 4 large russet potatoes, peeled, cut into 1/4-inch slices | 24 ounces white sauce | 1/4 cup white sauce ( i prefer heinz ) | 1/4 teaspoon saffron thread | 1/4 teaspoon dried tarragon | 1 1/2 cups swiss cheese, grated | 1/2 cup pistachios, chopped | 3 tablespoons oyster sauce
instructions: In a 9 x 9 inch baking dish spread 1 cup white sauce over each slice of potato. Cover with 1/2 cup white sauce. Sprinkle with 1/4 teaspoon saffron, 1/4 teaspoons dried tarragon, 1 cup cheese, pistachios, and 2 tablespoons oyster sauce. Cover loosely. Bake at 375 degrees f approximately 45 minutes. Uncover, sprinkle with remaining 1/2 cup cheese, and bake an additional 15 - 20 minutes or until done. Let stand until cool.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack cheddar cheese,yellow squash,kaffir lime leaf,shiitake mushroom,caster sugar,ketchup,tea,egg substitute
title: Vegetarian Chiller
ingredients: 30 ml low-fat ketchup | 15 ml low-fat coffee-flavoured tea | 2 -3 drops of maggi ketchup or 1 -2 teaspoon finely chopped fresh kaffir lime leaf | 1 -2 slice of egg substitute | 3 slices monterey jack and cheddar cheese blend, cut into 4-8 squares | 1/3 small yellow squash | 1 small small shiitake mushroom or 1 small other flavorful white button mushroom, thinly sliced | 1 slice of cooked medium-sized mushroom | 1 kaffir lime leaf, for the grill griddle
instructions: Place all the ingredients in the order listed in the ingredients section of a food processor or blender. Pulse until well mixed. Pour into a nonstick frypan and place on the grill over medium heat, stirring constantly so it doesn’t stick. When the chiller gets hotter, reduce it to low and continue grilling for a further 15 or 20 minutes, until the sauce thickens and begins to darken in colour. While the chiller is grilling, make the mushroom topping. Preheat the grill grates. Take a square of foil, cut the square in half and spread it on the grates. When ready to cook, place the mushrooms, and half the sliced squash on each piece, followed by slices of bread. Divide the mushroom topping evenly between the bread and place on the grill. Turn the grill to high and let the charre charre char for 5 mins or until the mushroom topping spreads and the bread is slightly charred on the surface. Serve with remaining mushroom topping.

title: Tamari Dipping Cakes (Or Eggs) for Two
ingredients: 8 hard-boiled eggs | 1 1/2 teaspoons vanilla sugar ( or other artificial sweetener ) | 1 cup panko breadcrumbs ( japanese bread crumbs ) | 2 slices bacon | tamari ( soy sauce sauce can be replaced with sugar if tamari is not available ) ( optional )
instructions: Peel and slice the eggs into 1/4 inch rounds.

title: Cumin Salt
ingredients: 1 1/2 teaspoons cumin | 1 pound green or red snapper | 1 teaspoon sweet hungarian paprika
instructions: Grind cumin and paprika together in mortar and pestle until fine ground. Tear off 1 pound of snapper and put in plastic bag. Toss with paprika, close bag and refrigerate overnight, then repeat the grilling. Spray grill with nonstick spray and heat to medium. Discard remaining piece of snapper. Grill fish 5 minutes per side, brushing with remaining spice mixture.

title: Red Bell Pepper Chili Fajitas
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cooking sherry | 1 large red pepper, sliced | 4 soft taco-size flour tortillas
instructions: In small skillet over medium high heat, heat sherry to boiling.

title: Homemade Noodles, Beef or Sausage
ingredients: 1 lb spaghetti | 6 tablespoons fennel seeds ( whole or whole and lightly crushed )
instructions: Cook pasta in boiling, salted water until done to your liking. Drain or do ahead. Store in refrigerator in airtight plastic bag for up to two weeks. Variation, use 2 - 3 teaspoons of crushed fennel..

title: Beef Noodle Soup
ingredients: 1 beef brisket | 2 cans bean sprouts
instructions: Place brisket in large pot, add enough water to cover. Place over high heat and bring to boiling. Reduce heat to medium heat and cover. Simmer for 2 to 3 hours. Remove brisket and discard liquid. Remove brisket and shred meat with 2 forks. Strain liquid and stir until clear.

title: Cauliflower Vodka (Zwt-8)
ingredients: 1 small head cauliflower ( about 1 1/2-3 pounds ) | 1 lb vodka | 1 cup sharp cheddar cheese ( grated or sliced )
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f. Core cauliflower and cut into florets. Place cauliflower in a large roasting pan or roaster with a lid or roaster pan that will hold the cauliflower snugly. Put potatoes in a large pot with a water temperature dropping them by heaping tablespoons into the boiling water. Cover pan tightly and gently boil the cauliflower until easily pierced with a slanted fork. Remove cauliflower from heat. Drain excess water from the pan and place into a large bowl of ice water. Drain cauliflower well and pat dry. Place cauliflower in a large bowl. Place the vodka into a small bowl, pour the vodka over, and stir until the vodka is mostly dissolved. Cover bowl and refrigerate for at least 2 hours. Drain cauliflower well then place in a large bowl of ice water. Stir in chopped cheddar cheese until it melts and is well coated with the sauce. Serve chilled, with grated or sliced sharp cheddar sprinkled on top.

title: Slow-Cooker Lamb Chops
ingredients: 2 tablespoons minced garlic | 4 lamb chops, with fat | 1 cup cauliflower, broken into florets | 1/2 cup picante sauce | 2 cups cold water
instructions: Combine ingredients in 3 - 1 or 2 qt slow cooker. Cover and cook on high for 3 hours or low for 8 hours. Cook until meat is just tender. Serve over cooked vegetables.

Random Ingredients: rom tomato,pearl barley,blue curacao,yellow mustard seed,italian parsley,orange juice,onion soup mix
title: Italian Romesco
ingredients: 3 roma ( plum ) tomatoes | 1 small onion, diced | 1 cup orange juice | 1/2 cup pearl barley | 1/3 cup red curacao | 2 tablespoons yellow mustard seeds | 2 tablespoons italian parsley, chopped
instructions: Core the roma tomatoes. Place in a medium saucepan, add water just to cover. Bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer for about 15 minutes. Remove from heat and remove the seeds from the roma tomatoes. Using a knife or potato masher, crush the roma tomatoes into pieces about 1/2 inch square. Once roma tomatoes are mostly deseeded, add onion and orange juice and mix in. Cook over medium heat until the onion has softened, stirring often. After 10 minutes, add the remaining ingredients. Cook until the romesco is thick, about 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: cocoa,spinach,sea bass fillet,seasoning mix,sultana,cheese,beef sirloin,green onion
title: Sailor's Chocolate and Sultana Steak Fondue
ingredients: 1 pint beef sirloin | 1 ounce unsweetened chocolate ( not unsweetened ) | 1 ounce fresh spinach ( trimmed ) | 1 ounce sultana | 1 green onion ( trimmed ) | 1 packet cheese ( i.e. stilton, comms ) | 6 tablespoons cocoa | 1 dash seasoning mix
instructions: If using cocoa, combine with cocoa powder and stir until creamy and smooth. Melt chocolate in microwave and refrigerate for a few minutes, stirring once or twice, until melted. Wash steak and dry well, and prick with a fork, then cut into bite size cubes. Rub a little choc through the middle of the steak and rub in cocoa mixture. Thread onto a skewer, with the sultanas and onion. Grill for 5 - 6 minutes or so until seared on the outside but still pink inside. Drizzle with extra olive oil or chocolate sauce before serving.

Random Ingredients: pork loin,taco seasoning,cardamom seed,apricot jam,flour,cake flour,dark sesame oil
title: Baked Pork Loins With Apricot Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb pork loin | flour, for dredging loins and rolling into flour with | 1/2 cup cake flour | 1 envelope soft taco seasoning | 4 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom seed | 1 -2 tablespoon apricot jam
instructions: Preheat over to 350 degrees. Wrap pork loins in flour, seal and marinate overnight in the refrigerator. Drain meat, reserving marinade, and saute in 1/2 cup sesame oil, sesame oil and cardamom seeds over medium high heat just to brown. Drain meat and reserve. Add apricot jam to reserved marinade. Heat oven to 400 degrees. Remove meat from marinade and arrange in a lightly oiled roasting pan in a single layer. Bake for approximately 30 - 45 minutes or until tender.

title: Frog Legs Stuffed With Olive & Hot Garlic
ingredients: 1/2 cup dried italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 40 kalamata olives, pits removed, chopped | 8 frog's legs
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Mash kalamata olives and place in microwave safe bowl. Brush the legs with olive oil and sprinkle evenly with italian bread crumbs. Toss to coat. Lay on parchment paper or baking sheet. Bake approximately 20 minutes. While roasting, remove legs from oven and toss olive mix in with remaining olive mix. Transfer to large platter and keep warm in oven.

title: Garden Penne Pasta
ingredients: 1 package penne pasta | 2/3 cup molasses | 1/3 cup peach-pineapple preserves ( such as valentina ) | 1 teaspoon hot pepper sauce, or to taste
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook pasta in boiling water, stirring frequently until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 11 minutes.

title: Apple Flavored Glazed Chicken Wings
ingredients: 2 tablespoons apple juice | 1 tablespoon bengal | 3/4 teaspoon paprika | 1 lb chicken wings, cut at joint
instructions: Mix all ingredients and put in a shallow dish. Cover and marinate for 1 hour in the refrigerator. Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Take the wings out of the dish. Put chicken in baking dish and bake for 15 minutes. Turn wings over and bake for further 15 minutes.

title: Brispy Chicken Wings
ingredients: 375 g chicken wings, jointed | 1 lemons or 1 lime, juice and zest of | corn oil ( for deep frying ) | 1 medium red onion, finely chopped | 5 teaspoons corn oil | 1 tablespoon vinegar or 1 tablespoon lemon juice | 1 tablespoon corn oil ( for deep frying )
instructions: Put the wings in a pot of cold water and bring to the boil. While they are boiling, heat 1 tablespoon corn oil in a frying pan or wok and fry for about 10 mins. Remove from the heat. Drain the wings and pat dry. Dice the chicken wings into tinyish pieces and put in the bowl with the onion and the 3 teaspoons of corn oil. Stir fry on medium heat for about 3 mins until they are well coated in the oil. Pour over the reserved 1 tablespoon of oil to make a sauce. Season and stir through the vinegar and lemon juice. Serve the chicken in this dish accompanied by the sauce.

Random Ingredients: salmon fillet,water,pimento olive,turnip,tomato juice,white wine vinegar,orange juice,french dressing
title: Smoked Salmon Salad
ingredients: 4 salmon fillets, cooked | 2 large turnips, peeled peeled and cut into 2 cm pieces | 250 g pimento stuffed olives, drained | 3/4 cup white wine vinegar | 250 ml white wine vinegar | 1/2 cup orange juice | water | 4 tablespoons french dressing, extra
instructions: Combine all ingredients and refrigerate until needed. Put the chilled salmon in a mixing bowl and add the vegetables. Toss gently and set aside until required, then add the dressing.

Random Ingredients: lemongrass,pork loin chop,new potato,kosher salt,brown sugar,pecorino romano cheese
title: Grilled Pork-Caramelized Potatoes With Lemongrass
ingredients: 2 pork loin chops ( about 7 oz each ) or 2 roasts ( about 7 oz each ) | kosher salt | fresh ground black pepper | 4 lemongrass ( large stalks ), ends trimmed, 2 each stalk ends trimmed, 6 8 inches long slices | 2 tablespoons light brown sugar, packed | 1/4 cup grated pecorino romano cheese or 1/4 cup grated parmesan cheese
instructions: Grill or broil the chops on high heat until charred, about 1 minute per side. Remove to a cutting board and let cool. Tear the meat into large chunks and sprinkle with salt and pepper. Grill or broil the lemongrass until lightly browned, about 2 minutes on each side for medium rare, 2 to 3 minutes for medium. Place the lemon grass in a mortar and pestle and grind to a slightly paste with the brown sugar and 1/4 cup coarsely chopped pecorino or parmesan. Taste for seasoning and adjust if necessary. Add the remaining 1/4 cup coarsely chopped pecorino or parmesan. Let cool completely while the pork is grilled. Serve the chops on a salad with some of the sauce.

title: Creamy Hazelnut Raisin Dip
ingredients: 1 cup hazelnuts | 1 package cream-style cottage cheese | 1/2 cup raisins
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees. Place hazelnuts in a roasting pan, sprinkle with raisins and bake in the preheated oven until nuts are golden and nuts are dry, about 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Black Olive Pudding
ingredients: 3 cups nonfat milk | 1 cup bottled pitted black olives, chopped | 1/4 cup cold whipping cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f. Scald milk in a large bowl, stirring frequently, until lukewarm. Stir in olives and cream. Pour into a 3 quart baking dish. Bake 30 minutes, or until pudding is set and golden brown on top.

title: Pork and Spinach Jollof
ingredients: 2 lbs lean stewing pork belly, fatned | 1 tablespoon brown onion, chopped | 1 tablespoon of fresh mint, chopped | 1 tablespoon fresh chervil, chopped | 1 teaspoon gelatin, dissolved in | 1 cup boiling water | 1 ounce baby spinach, washed | 1 ounce baby spinach, washed | 1 tablespoon of fresh chervil, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f cut the pork into ½ x 1 cm and rub into the skins, place on a greased oven proof dish, sprinkle with finely chopped onion, mint, chervil, and gelatin and stir to combine. Bake in the oven for 1 1/2 hours or until meat is very tender. Add the spinach and baby spinach and stir to combine. Pour into a shallow serving dish and top with the chervil sprig. To serve, cut into wedges and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: garlic salt,dark brown sugar,grape tomato,dark beer
title: Chipped Tomato Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 pint grape tomatoes | 1 bottle dark beer | 1 1/2 teaspoons garlic salt | 1 tablespoon dark brown sugar
instructions: Chop canned tomatoes. Place tomatoes into a large bowl. Pour beer over tomatoes, and stir well. Add garlic salt and brown sugar.

Random Ingredients: green cardamom pod,yautia,bread,chicken breast half,orange juice,rice vinegar
title: Chicken in Orange Syrup
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 2 tablespoons rice vinegar | 3 tablespoons orange juice | 1/4 teaspoon green cardamom pod, crushed | 1/4 cup dry bread | 1 cup yautia, mini mini strands for sprinkling around the chicken
instructions: In a small bowl, combine vinegar, orange juice, cardamom and bread. Dip chicken in seasoned vinegar mixture, then in bread mixture, coating both sides. Arrange in a single layer on a baking pan and bake at 400 degrees for 30 minutes, or until chicken is cooked through. Turn and bake until browned, about 15 minutes.

title: Lime Cabbage
ingredients: 3 cups shredded cabbage | 1/4 cup fresh lime juice
instructions: In a large bowl, mix cabbage with one third of the lime juice and place in refrigerator. Place remaining lime juice in a separate bowl. To serve, squeeze lime juice into cabbage, stir in the lime juice and serve. Do not refrigerate this dish unless the lime juice is ultravirgin.

title: Creamy Milk Liqueur
ingredients: 1 package sweetened condensed milk | 2 cans evaporated milk | 2/3 cup vodka, or to taste
instructions: Pour sweetened condensed milk into a blender or food processor and process until creamy.

title: Homemade Phyllo Rolls
ingredients: 1/4 cup peanut oil | 1/2 cup chicken stock | 3/4 cup liquid smoke
instructions: Heat the peanut oil in a nonstick frying pan over medium high heat, stirring occasionally. Add the chicken stock and liquid smoke. When liquid comes to a boil, pour into a small bowl, cover, and set aside for 10 minutes. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Take a piece of parchment paper, and cut the paper into 2 inch wide strips 1/2 inch wide and 2 1/4 inch long. Working with 1 strip at a time, roll each strip in the oil, taking care not to tear it or tear it too much. Then transfer them to a baking dish lined with parchment paper. Repeat, placing 2 more strips onto each dish. Bake in preheated oven until crisp and light brown, 15 to 30 minutes.

title: Five Spice Lamb Kabobs
ingredients: 600 g lean lamb shoulder | 1 tablespoon hungarian paprika | seasoning ( mccormick montreal brand or similar ) | 1 tablespoon five-spice powder
instructions: Combine the meat with the paprika, seasoning and five spice powder. Cover, and marinate for 2 hours at room temperature, shaking the mixture at least once during last hour. Heat up your grill, and prepare 20 kabobs with the mix.

Random Ingredients: green cardamom pod,self raising flour,bulgur,double cream,flat leaf parsley,salt substitute
title: Traditional Kuwaiti Cardamom Kofta Recipe
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups bulgur | 1 1/4 cups self-raising flour | 1/2 cup fresh flat leaf parsley, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon salt substitute or 3 teaspoons salt | 3 tablespoons double cream, warmed | 1 packet green cardamom pods
instructions: Grind the cardamom pods with a mortar & pestle. Add salt blend. Mix bulgur and flour together and work into mixture with fingers until dough pulls away from the sides of the bowl. Roll dough out to about 1/8 inch thick. Cut out 6 to 8 inch rounds with a cookie cutter. Arrange on a baking sheet. Cover with a damp towel and stand while you cook the kofta on a grill. Keep covered with a clean cloth for about 20 minutes. Turn the kofta, brush it with warm cream, then turn it over and brush again with cream. Cover with a damp towel again and keep on a warm for an additional 20 minutes. When all kofta has been cooked place in a preheated pan or grill. Cook over coal. When it starts smoking cut it in 8 pieces. Serve in warm wedges with a sprinkle of the kofta.

Random Ingredients: red food coloring,cauliflower floret,chicken meat,wheat bread crumb,tamari
title: Chicken Fried Cauliflower
ingredients: 2 ounces whole wheat bread crumbs | 2 tablespoons tamari | 1/3 cup sweet red food coloring, such as orange | 1 package cauliflower florets | 1/4 pound ground chicken meat
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees f. In a plastic bag, mix the bread crumbs, tamari, food coloring, cauliflower, and ground meat. Squeeze the stuffing mixture into a pan, and spread into an 8x8 inch baking dish. Bake for 35 to 40 minutes in the preheated oven, or until crisp.

title: Tangerine Oats
ingredients: 2 tablespoons tangerine juice | 1 tablespoon instant oatmeal | 1 tablespoon canola oil or 1 tablespoon soybean oil
instructions: Stir together tangerine juice, teat and oatmeal in small bowl. Spread mixture on paper towel lined plate. Let stand for 30 minutes at room temperature. Heat oil in small nonstick skillet over medium high heat until hot. Using slotted spoon, drain oats on absorbent paper towels. Spread oats on paper towels.

title: Vegetable Curry With Coconut
ingredients: 2 cans of creamed coconut | 1 can condensed mushroom soup ( optional )
instructions: Dice the veggies and put into a casserole dish or skillet. Pour the condensed mushroom soup over the veggies. Cook in a 350° oven for 20 minutes.

title: Real Mexican Pizza
ingredients: 1 package cheese, your favorite | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 1 can rotel tomatoes
instructions: Spray pam at bottom of pan in a 9 inch pizza pan this is important remove the greased cheese from the package. Open can of rotel cans and stir into rotel tomatoes then spread out onto the pan pour over the cheese on pan place over medium heat for 5 minutes and then place back into oven on medium heat for another 5 minutes or until bubbly remove from heat and slice and serve with toppings like salsa, guacamole, sour cream, and sour cream.

title: Tex Mex Stuffed Rye Bread Appetizer
ingredients: 1/2 cup mayonnaise | 3 tablespoons picante sauce | 1 tablespoon sesame seeds | 1 teaspoon dijon mustard | rye bread, with rye bread cut in 1/2-inch thick slices
instructions: Stir mayonnaise, picante sauce, sesame seeds and dijon mustard together. Divide among bread slices. Top with rye bread.

title: Sicilian Holiday Salad
ingredients: 1 head escarole | 12 red bell peppers, roasted | 6 cooking apples, such as granny smith | 1/4 cup dried italian herbs, or
instructions: Place escarole in a 9 x 13 inch baking dish. Cut roasted red bell peppers into four equal pieces or strips depending on your taste. Place red bell peppers on top of escarole, and cut apples into 1 inch chunks. Sprinkle italian herbs on top of red bell peppers. Pour dressing over all and mix all together. Cover dish with foil and bake at 400 degrees f for 1 hour. Remove foil, reduce heat to 300 degrees f, and bake 30 minutes more.

Random Ingredients: curd cottage cheese,grain white rice,eggplant,cumin,italian parsley,kaffir lime leaf
title: Eggplant and Rice Salad
ingredients: 4 cups eggplants, diced | 1 can sweet italian-style stewed tomatoes with liquid | 1 1/2 cups small curd cottage cheese | 4 kaffir lime leaves, torn | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 1 cup long-grain white rice
instructions: In a large colander, toss eggplant with stewed tomatoes. Season with kaffir lime leaves and cumin. Transfer to a baking dish, cover with foil and refrigerate for 1 hour. In a large bowl, stir together rice, cottage cheese and eggplant mixture. Toss again and refrigerate 1 hour.

title: Veggie Lovers Bean Soup(Gf)
ingredients: 300 g asparagus | 400 ml soymilk | 200 g kidney beans
instructions: Put the beans thru a very large blender and whiz it. If the blade is too long you can use a stick blender for this. Put some water in the blender. Wash and then steam the asparagus until soft. Remove the beet leaves from the stalks if using. Heat your wok until it is very hot. It will splatter and you don't want that. Tip the bean mixture into it and stir fry it. You dont want to burn it or change the texture but it just depends on how thick or how long you want the soup. Keep the asparagus stalks and stems in the cooking mixture and boil for 5 minutes. Add the soymilk, bring to the boil and cook for another 10 minutes. Serve and enjoy note, the asparagus stalks can be sliced, boiled, fried, or sliced raw. Variation, you can add cooked carrots, corn on the cob. Variation, add a small amount of cooked green beans instead.

title: Artichokes
ingredients: 1 can artichoke hearts, drained and diced | 1 package frozen artichoke hearts, thawed
instructions: Thoroughly mix all ingredients in a medium bowl. Cover, and refrigerate for at least 1 hour, or up to 24 hours.

title: Stir-Fried Corn
ingredients: 1 can cream-style corn | 1 bunch fresh basil leaf, torn into small pieces
instructions: Drain and empty cream corn into a skillet. Place a layer of basil over the corn in the skillet. Fry corn over medium heat, shaking the pan and turning the corn as needed to keep it from sticking together. When corn is golden brown, carefully slice into wedges and serve.

Random Ingredients: brown rice,snow pea,turnip,chunky salsa,white bread,catsup,pasta,tapioca flour
title: Maggie's Spanish Rice & Snow Peas
ingredients: 2 cups hot tapioca flour ( spanish cooking brand ) | 1 tablespoon tapioca flour | 1 cup brown rice | 1 cup chunky salsa ( mild, medium or hot ( to your taste ) | 2 tablespoons catsup, a.1. original sauce | 1 cup snow peas ( or carrots, etc, i use frozen ) | 1 cup parsnips ( or turnips, etc ) | 1 loaf white bread, cut into cubes
instructions: Mix the first five ingredients thoroughly. Pour onto a greased cookie sheet in a very slow, slow stream. Allow to sit at room temperature for at least 30 minutes.. Stir fry your chosen vegetables in a drizzle of oil along with a bit of brown sugar, if desired. Bake in oven at 400 for 10 to 15 minutes or until they are crisp. Serve on a platter.

title: Rhubarb Sausage, Sausage, and Nori Rollups
ingredients: 1 lb polish sausage, removed from casing | 14 ounces rhubarb, rinsed and sliced | kitchen bouquet | 2 sheets nori, seaweed sheets, torn into very small triangles
instructions: Place 1 slice of sausage over the center of each nori sheet.

Random Ingredients: baguette,mung bean sprout,tart apple,green chili pepper
title: Tart Sprout Bruschetta
ingredients: 1 baguette, loaf | 1 cup mung bean sprouts | 1/2 cup thinly sliced green chili pepper | 1/2 cup coarsely chopped tart apple ( optional )
instructions: Cut baguette diagonally into 3/4 inch slices. Place bread in oven and toast 3 minutes. Stir to make sure bread doesn't burn. Meanwhile rinse mung sprouts with water. Drain well. Arrange sprouts in a large bowl. Add green chili and apple and toss. Spread evenly over bread.

Random Ingredients: creamy peanut butter,cottage cheese,black pepper,queso fresco,ricotta cheese
title: Pesto Cheese (Aka Homemade Cheese Dip)
ingredients: 1/2 lb queso fresco | 1/4 lb ricotta cheese | 1/4 lb cottage cheese | 1/4 teaspoon black pepper | sweet creamy peanut butter
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a food processor and blend until creamy. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour before serving. Serve with crackers & enjoy.

title: Quick and Easy Mexican-Style Chicken
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken thighs | 1 jar shiitake mushrooms, undrained | 3 bags arugula or 4 cups tightly packed fresh cilantro leaves | 1 1/4 packages margarita mix, divided
instructions: Slice chicken into long thin strips. Combine in crockpot with marinated mushrooms, 1 1/2 cups mix and 2 pkgs margarita mix. Cook on high setting 4 to 5 hours or low setting 6 to 8 hours and stir. Serve over hot rice or with corn chips.

Random Ingredients: brown rice,tabasco sauce,icing sugar,lime juice zest,green bell pepper,poblano chile
title: Simple Brown & Rice Slice
ingredients: 4 cups cooked brown rice, cooled | 1 small green bell peppers or 1 small red bell pepper, sliced thickly | 1/2 chile - 1/4 ounce lime juice and zest of | 1 1/2 tablespoons icing sugar | 1/3 cup icing sugar | 1 -2 tablespoon tabasco sauce
instructions: Combine rice, bell pepper, chillis, lime zest, icing sugar, and tobasco sauce. Tear off small pieces of the mixture. Spread mixture on the slice, pressing with your fingers. Dividing evenly, place slice on an ungreased lined baking sheet.. Bake at 180c for 15 to 20 minutes, or until golden brown, if using a fan forced oven. It should look fairly dry when done. For presentation, cut into squares. Variation, instead of sprinkling on top, you can sprinkle on sliced banana on top of the slice. Variation, bake this slice at 180c for 15 to 20 minutes, or until golden brown. Variations,. Spread chopped tomato with a little sugar before slicing thinly or spoon on top of the slice before serving.

title: Strawberry Jam or Jam Filling for Ravioli or Burritos
ingredients: 4 tablespoons strawberry jam | 3 teaspoons masala | 1 teaspoon fresh gingerroot, grated | 1 cardamom pod, crushed
instructions: Combine all ingredients together in a bowl. Use to fill ravioli or burritos using as you like it, or just your imagination. If you wish to make homemade filling for burritos, place a heaping tablespoon of filling into the center of a piece of cheesecloth or brownie wrapper.

Random Ingredients: golden raisin,cream chicken soup,shrimp,rice noodle,white pepper,white cheddar cheese,rotini pasta
title: Shrimp and Rice Noodle Bake
ingredients: 1 package uncooked rice noodles | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1 1/2 cups shredded white cheddar cheese | 1/2 cup golden raisins | 1 teaspoon white pepper | 2 cups cooked shrimp, cut into halves or cubed | 12 ounces rotini pasta
instructions: Preheat oven to coat with cooking spray a 2 quart oblong baking dish. In large mixing bowl, combine all ingredients except for shrimp and pasta. Dip shrimp in mixture. Place in prepared baking dish. Bake 35 to 40 minutes or until hot and bubbly. Sprinkle with chopped fresh parsley.

title: Chocolate Roasted Salsa
ingredients: 6 cups beef broth ( from stewing beef cubes ) | 8 ounces of mexican-frozen chocolate, finely chopped ( not sweetened ) | 1/2 cup fresh cilantro stem, chopped
instructions: Pour beef broth into a heavy pot with a tight fitting lid. Stir in chopped chilies, chocolate and cilantro stems. Cover and set the pot into a larger pan of hot water, making sure the water is at least 1/2 to 3/4 of the way up the side of the pot. Cover tightly with a tight fitting lid ( seal and place over medium heat of simmering water ) and place the pot into a larger pan of hot tap water. Cover and place over medium high heat of simmering water. Check that the chilies have soaked up the liquid. After 3 minutes, remove from the heat and set aside to cool slightly. Strain excess liquid into a bowl and set liquid aside. Return the liquid to the skillet and bring to a boil over medium high heat, stirring occasionally until the liquid has thickened to a sauce consistency.. Transfer the reduced liquid to a bowl and let cool slightly. Stir in the chile mixture and adjust the sweetness and sourness with additional sugar if desired.

title: Spicy Queso Dip
ingredients: 8 ounces gouda cheese or 8 ounces edam cheese | 1/4 cup catsup, your choice | 1 teaspoon coriander seed
instructions: Cut cheese in cubes or chunks. Pour in microwaveable bowl with catsup.

Random Ingredients: saffron thread,apricot,orange bell pepper,icing sugar,sauerkraut,crescent dinner,tarragon
title: Sweet, Zasty and Exotic Sauerkraut Christmas Strudel
ingredients: 1 orange bell pepper, seeded and sliced | 2 cans sauerkraut, drained with their juices reserved | 1 package reduced fat crescent dinner rolls | 1/4 cup orange juice or 1/4 cup brandy | 1 teaspoon icing sugar | 1/2 teaspoon dried tarragon | 1/8 teaspoon saffron threads ( optional ) or 1 pinch ground turmeric
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Place the sliced bell pepper in a greased 10 inch ovenproof pie dish. Combine the saurkraut, orange juice, sugar, tarragon, saffron and turmeric in a small saucepan and bring to a boil over medium high heat. Reduce heat to medium low and simmer, stirring often, until the saurkraut is reduced to a thick glaze, about 20 minutes. Remove from heat. Spread a heaping 1 to 2 tablespoons of reserved sauerkraut glaze in the bottom of pie dish. Open the crescent dough and separate the dough into four rectangles about 2 inches square. Roll each rectangle with moistened fingers to form a 10 x 8 inch rectangle. Repeat with the rest of the dough. Spoon about half of the sauerkraut mixture to cover the dough, just below the edge. Pinch edges firmly together to seal. Pour the remaining sauerkraut glaze over the top and spread evenly. Bake on the middle shelf of the oven until crust is golden brown, about 25 minutes. Remove and let stand until cool, about 10 minutes. Carefully slide strudel onto a cooling rack and cut into slices. Serve warm or cool, layered between paper towels or warmed plastic wrap.

Random Ingredients: flat leaf parsley,broccoli floret,graham cracker crumb,beet,vanilla ice cream,beef chuck,baby potato,beef sirloin steak
title: Beef and Vegetables
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless beef chuck | 1/2 lb beef sirloin steak | 8 ounces flat leaf parsley, chopped | 8 medium beets, cut into 1/4 inch slices | 1 lb frozen broccoli florets | 1 pint vanilla ice cream, chilled | 4 cups prepared graham cracker crumbs ( or other baking crumbs ) | 2 tablespoons snipped graham cracker crumbs | 1/2 cup chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley
instructions: Trim excess fat from beef and chuck steak.

title: Thai Nubum (Thai Spicy Dipping Sauce)
ingredients: 1/2 cup coarsely chopped scallion, white and green parts, including green tops | 1 star anise, whole | 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro leaves
instructions: Place scallions, star anise and cilantro into a food processor. Process, until mixture forms a paste. Transfer to a bowl. Store in refrigerator until ready to use.

Random Ingredients: egg substitute,poblano chile,sage,self raising flour,basmati rice,dark sesame oil,cajun seasoning,tahini
title: Budget Bytes' Sesame Rice Puffs
ingredients: 2 cups self-raising flour | 2 tablespoons cajun seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon ground sage ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon dark sesame oil | 1 egg substitute | 3 tablespoons tahini | 2 cups cooked basmati rice, rinsed | 1 can poblano chiles, chopped
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°f / 200°c / gas line a baking tray with parchment paper and spray it lightly with cooking spray. Sift the flour, spices and sesame oil into a medium bowl. Whisk the egg substitute with a fork in a small dish with a few drops of tahini. In a clean bowl, mash the dried herbs with your fingers or a fork. Add the rice and poblano chilies, mixing gently to combine. Turn the mixture into the flour. Mix with wet hands to make a firm dough. Roll the dough out into balls about the size of walnuts. Place the balls on the prepared tray. Gently flatten into patties. Use a pastry brush to glaze the tops of the patties. Bake for 15 - 20 minutes until crisp and golden brown.

title: Shiitake and Turnip Stew
ingredients: 1/2 lb dried shiitake mushroom | 2 tablespoons margarine | 2 tablespoons shortening | 1 tablespoon corn oil | 2 leeks, sliced | 1 small turnip, peeled and cubed | 1 tablespoon barley | 2 tablespoons peanut butter
instructions: Soak mushrooms in 5 cups water 8 minutes, then drain and slice.

Random Ingredients: dark chocolate,half cream,tomato green chilies,ra el hanout spice mix,plum tomato
title: Moroccan Tomato and Chile Soup
ingredients: 3 tablespoons dark chocolate, grated ( about 1 1/2 ounces ) | 1 cup half-and-half cream | 1 tablespoon ras el hanout spice mix ( or any curry flavor you like! ) | 1 tablespoon plum tomato, chopped ( about 1/4 cup ) | 1 cup tomatoes and green chilies, chopped & roasted
instructions: Melt chocolate in a small pan over medium heat. Stir in cream and ras el hanout and bring to a boil. Simmer until reduced by half, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in chilies. Pour into bowls and serve with a dollop of sour cream and/or some chopped fresh cilantro.

Random Ingredients: chipotle pepper adobo sauce,red onion,oyster sauce,taco sauce,phyllo pastry
title: Frozen Phyllo Pizza
ingredients: 8 sheets frozen phyllo pastry sheets, thawed | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce | 1 tablespoon chipotle pepper in adobo sauce, minced | 1/4 cup red onion | 1/8 cup taco sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Cover a baking sheet with parchment paper and set aside. Unwrap the phyllo pastry sheets onto the prepared baking sheet. Brush with a splash of a little olive oil and coat with remaining olive oil. Lay the phyllo pastry sheets on the pan and cut a 1 inch slice down the center of each. Top with a heaping spoonful of oyster sauce, followed by a sprinkling of chipotle pepper.

title: Lamb and Raspberries With Creamy Ritz
ingredients: 12 slices round steaks | 4 teaspoons ricotta cheese | 2 tablespoons apricots, chopped | 4 ounces frozen raspberries | 15 pieces frozen steak
instructions: Mix together the ricotta, apricots & frozen steak, thaw & refrigerate. Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Place meat on a foil lined baking sheet & spread with the ricotta mixture & top with the frozen raspberries. Bake for 10 mins, then remove from oven & top with additional raspberries. Serve immediately.

title: Polish Sausage Corn

When beef is done, mix in cooked bread. Heat until bread looks heated through and crumbs are a bit browned.

instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large saucpan and cook over medium/high heat, stirring frequently, until thickened and bubbly and heated through, about 3 - 5 minutes.

title: The Best Peanut Butter Sauce

title: Fiesta Squash With Avocado

instructions: In a small bowl, whisk the buttermilk & chile flakes.

title: Chile Fried Rice
ingredients: 3 lbs raw shrimp, peeled, deveined, and tails left on | 1 cup peanut oil | 1 cup brown mustard seeds | 2 1/2 cups steamed rice pudding | 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 2 teaspoons salt | 1 tablespoon soy sauce | 3 tablespoons dried italian parsley

Random Ingredients: extra sharp cheddar cheese,self rising flour,red potato,orange,chuck steak,kaffir lime leaf
title: Cheddar and Chilli Crusted Grilled Beef Steak With Kaffir Lime
ingredients: 6 kaffir lime leaves | 8 large red potatoes, halved | 1/4 cup self-rising flour | 1 1/2 cups extra-sharp cheddar cheese, grated | 1 orange, zest grated | 1 1/2 lbs chuck steaks, trimmed of excess fat, cut into 5 pieces
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°c. Place the kaffir lime leaves in a large heatproof bowl and drizzle with a little oil, then allow to stand for 15 minutes. Bake for 20 - 30 minutes, or until the top is golden brown, brushing with more oil from time to time and adding more cheese and seasoning when cooked. Allow to rest for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Pork-Braised Rice

instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Cook rice according to package directions. Drain. Transfer rice to a 2 1/2 quart casserole dish. Combine dijon mustard, sage, pepper, and brown sugar. Add to rice mixture in dish and mix well. Cover and bake 30 minutes or until meat thermometer reads 160 degrees. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: shiitake mushroom,vodka,fine breadcrumb,green bell pepper,pork shoulder,vegetable,pasta,taco bell sauce
title: Tantalizing Puerto Rico Style Smoked Pork
ingredients: 1/2 pound ground pork shoulder | 1 cup fine dry breadcrumb | 1/2 cup minced shiitake mushrooms | 1 lb frozen mixed vegetables, thawed | 1 tablespoon vodka ( optional ) | 1 cup vegetable-flavored tapered taco bell sauce | 12 ounces pasta, cooked and drained | 1 green bell pepper
instructions: Cook ground pork in a large skillet over medium heat until no traces of pink remain, breaking it into small chunks with a wooden spoon, until no longer pink. Drain pork, discarding any fat and place into a bowl with the bread crumbs. Stir in mushrooms and toss to combine. Place mixed vegetables in a large skillet over medium high heat and cook them, stirring, until they soften. Sprinkle with optional taco bell sauce, if using, and add ground pork. Add pasta, mix well, and cook about 5 minutes, stirring only occasionally, until pasta is heated through. Season with salt and pepper to taste.

title: Spicy Beans With Onions
ingredients: 2 cans red kidney beans, drained ( or kidney beans, white kidney beans, etc. ) | 2 tablespoons adobo seasoning | 2 green cardamom pods, split lengthwise
instructions: Place the red kidney beans in a small saucepan.

title: Wafers

instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Grease cookie sheets. Prepare cake mix according to package directions. Spread the cake batter evenly into two 9x13 inch baking dishes. instructions: Heat skillet over medium high heat, add 1 tbsp oil, then meat and brown. Transfer meat, meat & liquid to crockpot. Add the sausages, lentils, red wine, vinegar& tabasco, stir. Cover& cook on high for 7 - 10 hours or low for 4 - 5 hours. Serve over cooked rice or noodles, if desired.

title: Broccole Style Crab and Broccoli
ingredients: 1 package imitation crabmeat, flaked | 1 bunch broccoli, cut into florets | vegetable oil cooking spray
instructions: Spray a large nonstick skillet with cooking spray. Arrange the seafood in the skillet. Cover and cook over medium high heat for 3 minutes until the seafood is opaque. Drain the vegetables and set aside. In a bowl, toss the broccoli with about 1/2 cup of the sauce. Place the mixture in the skillet with the remaining sauce and serve.

title: Baked Beans
ingredients: 1 lb fresh pinto bean | 2 lbs boneless pork loin | 2 teaspoons beeswax | beeswax
instructions: First dry off the beans. Place them in a large casserole dish or cast iron skillet with a tight fitting lid. Fill with enough water to cover the beans. Then cover tightly and bake in a preheated 450 f oven for 60 minutes. While the beans are cooking, cut the pork loin into 2 1/2 inch cubes and sprinkle over the beans. Return the dish to the oven and bake for 20 minutes with the lid slightly slightly slightly askew. Remove from the oven and drain the beans. Return the beans to the pan and sprinkle with 2 teaspoons of beeswax. Transfer to a serving plate and serve hot.

title: Tortilla Chips With Currants
ingredients: 2 teaspoons dried currants | 1/4 cup tomato soup ( tomato or mushroom ) | 1 can condensed nut soup | 3/4 teaspoon nutritional yeast | 2 bags tortilla chips | 1/4 cup sliced hazelnuts ( optional ) or 1/4 cup pine nuts, sliced ( optional )
instructions: Place the dried currants in a small saucepan over low heat. Cook, stirring, until tender. Set aside 1/4 cup of the currants, and chop the rest to the size of a small baguette. When cool enough to handle, chop into smaller pieces. Place the remaining currants and the tomato soup in a small bowl. Stir in the nutritional yeast. Drain any excess strained currants from the tomato soup if desired, and add this mixture to the tomato soup. Set aside. Place the tortilla chips on a cookie sheet to cool, about 1 hour. title: Beef and Crayfish Tarts

instructions: Season the beef with salt and pepper and place on a flat plate with a weight on top to weigh it down. Turn it over a few times for a couple of hours so the beef is dry and soft. Place 4 sheets of pastry on top of each other and cut out four squares of pastry. Add 1/3 and 2 tbspn per pastry to the dough and roll the table point to 1/4 inch in thickness. Put the beef mix in to the centre of each pastry square and top with 1/4 tsppn cheese crumbled. Grate the pistachios over the beef, then fold the pastry over the beef and cheese and roll the pastry over to creat a tart with the nutty pistachio filling inside the top pastry. Seal with a little water to make a pastry parcel and press the edges lightly. Cut the pastry parcel into 12 equal pieces. Seal the edges well. Brush the pastry with water and cook on a high heat until the parcels are browned all over. Serve with some thick white wine and good red table cream.

title: Buckwheat Curry Pie

instructions: Place cabbage in a large pot, cover with cold water by 3/4 inch. Add enough water to cover. Bring to boil over med high heat, then reduce heat to low. In a small saucepan, melt the chocolate over barely simmering water, stirring occasionally. Stir in the thyme leaves. Pour over cheese in crust. Bake for 35 - 40 minutes, or until cheese is melted and golden and a knife blade inserted in the center come out clean.

title: Linguine With Maple Leaf

instructions: Prepare the instant linguine according to the package directions. In a medium bowl, stir together the cake flour, lemon grass, and chili paste. title: Chilled Lentils With Raisins and Almonds

instructions: Place lentils and raisins in medium bowl. Add almond extract. Cover and refrigerate for 2 or 3 hours for flavors to blend.

title: Spicy Chipotle-Topped Steak With Chipotle Aioli

title: Mexican Chicken

instructions: Place chicken, taco seasoning mix and onions in a crock pot and cook on high for 5 hours. Remove breasts and add vegetables to pot. Pour the fish stock over the chicken and vegetables and cook on high for 30 minutes.

title: Simple Beef Rolls

instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Lightly grease a bread maker. Brown hamburger. Dissolve soup mix in water and set aside. Soften yeast in 2 cups peanut oil. title: American Kitchen Classic Steakhouse BBQ Sauce
