title: French Onion Soup
ingredients: 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1 cup cubed gruyere cheese | 1 can sliced water chestnuts, drained
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Stir the cream of chicken soup, gruyere cheese, and water chestnuts together in a microwave safe bowl. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap, and heat in the microwave in the microwave for 1 minute on high. Stir, then microwave on medium for 3 minutes to soften the cheese slightly. Pour the soup mixture into a casserole dish, and bake for 45 minutes in the preheated oven. Serve hot, or chilled.

title: Rendering Fish Soup
ingredients: 2 kg good quality beef chuck, bones picked from bones | 4 slices leeks soup mix | 150 g tomatoes and tomato sauce | 4 teaspoons soft leek soup mix | 1 small cabbage, grated | 1 stalk celery, chopped
instructions: In a large saucepan, saute the celery and leeks in a little oil until they are translucent. Put the beef chuck bones in with everything to make sure they are well coated. Bring to a boil, then simmer. Add the tomato and tomato sauce and cook until the beef is very tender.. Stir in the soup mix and simmer another 5 minutes until heated through. Do not bring to a boil. Serve hot with freshly grated cabbage and chopped raw onion.

Random Ingredients: nonstick cooking spray,cornflour,prosciutto,sirloin,hamburger bun,cannellini bean,wide egg noodle
title: Stir-Fry Beef Burgundy
ingredients: 2 sirloin ( rib top ) steak, about 1/2 to 1 3/4 - 1-inch thick | 2 slices prosciutto | 1 can cannellini beans, drained and rinsed ( about 3/4 cup liquid reserved ) | nonstick cooking spray | 1 bag uncooked wide egg noodles | cornflour mixed with a little cornstarch | warm baked egg noodles
instructions: Partially freeze sirloin steak and cut across grain into thin slices, about 1 3/4 inches wide. Set aside. Partially thaw and drain canned beans in a colander. Place prosciutto slices on a baking sheet and lightly spray with non stick cooking spray. Place prosciutto slices in 2 batches on top of each other and cover with plastic wrap. Preheat oven to 450°f. Place 2 slices of beef on top. Season top with salt. Bake in the oven for 15 minutes. Meanwhile, in a food processor, combine canned bean liquid and 2 tablespoons cornstarch. Pulse several times to break up the beans, process for 20 seconds. Transfer to a large serving bowl or platter, and toss with cooked noodles and cooked sirloin slices, top with heated bean mixture.

Random Ingredients: mint,bulk sausage,fettuccine,ear corn cob,vegetable oil peanut
title: Spicy Sausage Fettuccin
ingredients: 1 package dry fettuccine | 2 ears corn on the cob | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil or 1 tablespoon peanut oil | 1/2 lb bulk sausage | 1 tablespoon chopped of fresh mint
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. In a hot wok, fry corn on the cob, turning regularly, until just tender. Add oil and sausage and cook over low heat until thoroughly cooked. Drain pasta, toss and then return pasta to wok. Add mint and toss. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: herb,pork loin roast,irish cream,bamboo skewer,black olive,egg substitute,worcestershire sauce
title: Irish Pork Loin Kabobs
ingredients: 1 pork loin roast or 1 other bone in pork roast | 1/2 cup egg substitute or 1 egg yolk | 2 tablespoons mixed herbs | 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 1/2 cup black olives, chopped or 1/2 cup fresh black olives, chopped | 1/2 cup frozen egg substitute or 2 egg yolks | 1/4 cup irish whiskey or 1/4 cup heavy cream | wood skewer
instructions: Soak skewers in water or saran wrap for 1 hour or longer. Remove from water and blot dry with paper towel. Combine sauce ingredients in shallow dish. Beat egg and pour over meat. Marinate for 1 1/2 hours. Broil meat 5 to 10 minutes or just until browned. Brush with gravy.

Random Ingredients: tamari,pistachio nut,salmon fillet,chinese five spice powder,watercress leaf
title: Tamari Salmon (21 Day Wonder Diet: Day 10)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons tamari | 2 tablespoon chinese five spice powder | 220 g skinless salmon fillets | 2 tablespoons watercress leaves, chopped | 2 tablespoons pistachio nuts, chopped
instructions: Combine tamari and five spice in a small bowl, pour over salmon. Place on a wire rack over a shallow baking dish, and weigh it down with a heavy cast iron spoon. Bake, uncovered, in a moderate oven for 15 minutes. Remove the pan from the oven, and increase the oven temperature to 200°c. Bake, uncovered, for a further 15 minutes or until the flesh flakes easily with a fork. Remove the pan from the oven and leave salmon on a cutting board to cool. When the salmon is cool, put the fish into a large bowl. Make space in the centre of the salmon with the knife at a 45° angle. Dry roast pistachios, stirring, in a dry frying pan over medium heat for 3 minutes.

Random Ingredients: vegetable juice,flour,oriental sesame oil,milk ricotta cheese,navel orange,chunky salsa,red cabbage
title: Quick and Easy Mexican Calzones
ingredients: 2 tablespoons flour | 1/2 cup low-fat milk ricotta cheese | 2 tablespoons chunky salsa or 2 tablespoons mild picante sauce ( i use pace picante chunky salsa & mozzarella ) | 1/4 cup frozen mixed vegetables, thawed ( any type of sweet potato can be used ) | 4 cups shredded red cabbage | 12 slices navel oranges ( about 3-4 ) or 12 slices green olives ( about 3-4 ) | 1 -2 tablespoon oriental sesame oil
instructions: Stir together the flour, ricotta cheese and salsa in a medium bowl. Place the vegetables in a separate bowl and set aside. Working with one at a time, toss the cabbage with about half a teaspoon of sesame oil. Spread about 1/2 cup of the cheese mixture in each of the 4 regular size plastic containers. Place the oranges or olives on top of the cheese mixture and roll in the flour mixture. Repeat for the remaining 4 containers of cheese. Set this out until all your fillings have been used. Refrigerate at least 20 minutes before serving. I usually wrap the rolls in paper foil for a quick and easy meal that doesn't get eaten or eaten, but i love them even after chilling they are good and cold enjoy note, for the fridge you will need to cover this with plastic wrap to prevent a skin from forming, but then simply wrap the top of the cup with a plastic bag so that the steam can escape. After chilling this for 20 minutes, remove from the freezer. Cover tightly with plastic wrap, pressing down hard on the bag to get a good sealing.. You are now ready to eat. I usually go a little dance with these. These are great served with lime wedges, salsa and guacamole.

title: Raspberry-Apple Marinated Beef
ingredients: 4 tablespoons dijon mustard | 4 1/2 ounces rump steak, trimmed of fat | 1 1/2 ounces fruit preserves or 1 1/2 ounces raisins | 2 ounces tart apples | 2 ounces unsweetened raspberries
instructions: Place mustard and 1/4 cup of the preserves in a glass bowl. Add steak and toss to coat completely. Cover and let stand at room temperature while preparing fruit and apples. Cut apples into thin wedges. In a medium bowl, pour 1 1/2 cups of the juice from the fruit into the bowl with the mustard dressing and toss to coat meat. Add remaining preserves, fruit and apples. Mix well. Cover and let stand at room temperature for 30 minutes. Toss well. Note, you may substitute a meat tenderizer such as the rib tip for the best results.

title: Moroccan Corn Salad
ingredients: 1 can cream-style corn | 8 ounces fresh mozzarella cheese, sliced | 2 green onions, sliced | 1/2 teaspoon chili flakes | 1/4 teaspoon harissa
instructions: In a salad bowl add the corn and toss well. Slice the mozzarella and arrange on the corn. Sprinkle the chilies, harissa and green onion over the cheese. Serve.

Random Ingredients: red wine,ginger root,garlic clove,herb,bouillon,pesto sauce,tandoori paste,cooking spray
title: Simple Tandoori-Stuffed Red Bell Peppers
ingredients: 4 large red bell peppers | 1/2 cup purchased pesto sauce | 1 cup toasted and shelled pesto sauce | 1/4 cup dry red wine | 3 tablespoons crumbled tandoori paste | 1 garlic clove, minced | 2 tablespoons grated fresh ginger root | 2 teaspoons dried herbs | cooking spray
instructions: Preheat broiler. Cut tops off peppers and discard seeds. Arrange peppers on two baking sheets. Combine pesto, wine, tandoori paste, garlic, and ginger and mix well. Spoon into peppers and arrange peppers on broiler rack. Broil peppers 3 inches from heat until beginning to char, 10 to 12 minutes. Remove peppers, cool, and remove skins. Arrange peppers upright on cutting board and slice tops off. Place peppers in a bowl and fill with about 1/2 cup pesto mixture.

Random Ingredients: seasoning salt,pork tenderloin,meat,corn,dark chocolate,chipotle chile,scallion,lemonade concentrate
title: Pork With Chipotle Glaze
ingredients: 2 lbs pork tenderloin | 1 can creamed corn | 1 can chipotle chiles | 1 can pork tenderloin | 1 lemonade concentrate, undiluted | 1 cup dark chocolate | 1 bunch scallion | seasoning salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Cut pork tenderloin in one inch slices. Combine the creamed corn, dried chipotle peppers, pork tenderloin slices, and 1/2 of the chilies in a small bowl.

Random Ingredients: chile,chipotle powder,tamari,nonfat milk,cream chicken soup,hot red chili pepper
title: Hot Chipotle Cream Cheese Dip
ingredients: 1 container light cream of chicken soup, undiluted | 2/3 cup nonfat milk | 1 chipotle powder | 1 chipotle chile | 1 can hot red chili peppers, drained | 2 teaspoons tamari
instructions: Combine soups and milk in a medium bowl.

title: Fry Onions (Shukmati)
ingredients: 8 medium yellow onions, peeled, halved, and cut into 1/2-inch pieces ( about 2 1/4 pounds ) | 1 tablespoon sunflower seeds
instructions: In a large nonstick skillet coated with cooking spray, add the onions and cook over high heat, stirring, until golden brown, about 7 minutes. Stir in the sunflower seeds and sauté, stirring for 2 minutes.

title: Pasta and Parmesan Cheese on Griddle (Pasta Con No Forno Y E Piselli)
ingredients: 4 4 cups bottled pastas ( or fresh pasta of your choice ) or 4 cups fresh pasta | 1/4 cup freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese or 1/4 cup grana padano
instructions: Pour 1/2 cup of water into the bottom of a large sauté pan and place over medium heat to bring to a boil. Meanwhile, in a medium bowl, toss together the pasta with the pasta. Sprinkle with cheese and cook 3 - 4 minutes longer until the pasta is tender. Transfer to serving platter and serve immediately.

title: Spicy Spiced Sizzler
ingredients: 1 -2 ounce potato chips | 1 teaspoon fresh gingerroot, grated or 3 1/2 teaspoons grated fresh galangal | 1 red chile, grated
instructions: Smear the potato chips on a non stick frying pan and toast until slightly golden brown and crisp. Remove from heat. Remove the chili seeds from the chile into a pestle and mortar. Add the spices and lightly fry until fragrant. Spread the fried bits of spicy sizzler evenly over the noodles and serve immediately.

title: Easy and Fast Marinade Chicken
ingredients: 1 package dry ranch dressing mix | 1/2 cup marinade, any liquid
instructions: Mix marinade and liquid or a mixture of your choosing and pour over your chicken. Marinate at least 2 hours and up to overnight if possible, turning at least once.

title: Potato Pancakes With Mushroom Filling
ingredients: 3 tablespoons peanut oil | 3/4 lb potato, peeled | 3/4 lb cremini mushrooms, cleaned and cut in 1/4 `` slices and then into � inch slices ( optional ) | 2 1/2 ounces fontina cheese, cut into � inch cubes | 1 lb ground pork
instructions: Pour the oil from the mushrooms over the potatoes, remove any grit in the pan, then soak in cold water for 20 minutes. Cut the mushrooms into � inch lenghts about 2 inches long and slice them into about ½ inch lengths. Place the sliced mushrooms in a colander over a bowl of warm water to drain. Squeeze out the excess water, then set aside. In the same skillet, sauté the pork in 1 tablespoons oil over high heat until the pork is no longer pink. Drain, then chop into about ½ inch cubes. Add the pork and mushrooms to the cooked potatoes and stir fry for 5 minutes. Remove and top with fontina and parsley. Serve warm.

title: Zucchini and Fresh Radish With Feta Cheese and Raspberry Vinegar Dressing
ingredients: 1 lb zucchini | 2 tablespoons raspberry vinegar or 2 tablespoons lemon juice | 2 tablespoons whipping cream | 3 tablespoons crumbled feta cheese | 1 tablespoon coarsely chopped fresh radish
instructions: Trim ends from zucchini. Cook zucchini in boiling water 8 to 10 minutes or until almost tender. Drain, cool. Cut zucchini into 1/4 inch slices. Place zucchini slices onto a platter. Pour raspberry vinegar over zucchini. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Dollop 1 tablespoon cream atop zucchini and sprinkle with cheese. Bake in 400°f oven 12 to 15 minutes or until zucchini is tender.

title: A Kiwi Mango and Pumpkin Sausages
ingredients: 400 g pumpkin puree | 4 fennel bulbs | 1/2 cup mango chutney | 1/4 teaspoon mustard powder ( gluten-free if required )
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c / 400°f. Combine pumpkin purée, fennel, chilli, mustard powder and mango chutney in a lightly greased and lined baking tray. Bake for 10 minutes. Sausages can also be prepared in a casserole dish, as below.

title: Simple Microwave Rice
ingredients: 3 cups basmati rice, not instant | 1 tablespoon chicken bouillon powder
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in an electric rice cooker. Add 3 cups of water. Cover and cook. Cook on high for 2 - 3 minutes.

title: Moroccan Spice Blend for Flavoring Dipping (To Serve)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon ras el hanout spice mix | 1/4 pint mixed dried cherries
instructions: Combine spice and dried cherries in small bowl. Allow to dry. Serve on platter with bread slices.

title: Spiced Salmon For Two
ingredients: 1/2 cup dried mixed fruit | 1 tablespoon lemon juice | 4 green onions, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom pod | 1 -2 cup dried currant | 5 lbs salmon fillets, skinned
instructions: Drain fruit, reserving syrup. Place fruit in a bowl with lemon juice and mix well to combine. Add onions and spices and toss gently. Spoon enough fruit mixture into a nonreactive baking dish to cover half of the fish and top with remaining fish. Dot with reserved syrup and bake at 325f for 40 minutes or until fish is cooked, just firm enough to touch. To serve, let fish stand 10 minutes or until the fish flakes easily when prodded with a fork. Serves 8.

title: Watercress Vinaigrette
ingredients: 1 cup watercress leaf, stems removed and reserved | 2 tablespoons cider vinegar
instructions: Place reserved watercress stems in a small jar. Cover and shake well to release excess water. Let stand about 20 minutes to soften. Mix reserved watercress leaves and vinegar together. Stir the mixture.

Random Ingredients: rosemary,baby spinach leaf,italian bread,vegetable stock,tap water,turmeric,red food coloring
title: Pressure-cooker Spinach Soup
ingredients: 6 cups vegetable stock | 1 rosemary | 1 cup baby spinach leaves | 1 teaspoon ground turmeric | 1/8 teaspoon red food coloring | 4 slices italian bread, toasted | 6 cups tap water, for boiling
instructions: Combine vegetable stock, rosemary, spinach, turmeric, and food coloring in a pressure cooker. Lock lid into pan, and cook for 15 minutes. Release pressure, remove rosemary. Remove lid, and allow spinach mixture to cool a little.

Random Ingredients: heavy whipping cream,bread,english cucumber,vegetable oil corn,coconut
title: Cucumber Toast
ingredients: 2 slices bread | 1/8 cup heavy whipping cream | 1 teaspoon vegetable oil or 1 teaspoon corn oil | 1 teaspoon dried shredded coconut | 1 english cucumber, sliced into 3/4-inch rounds
instructions: Toast bread. Combine cream and oil. Spread on toast, and sprinkle coconut on. Top with cucumber, and serve at once.

Random Ingredients: yeast,salt black pepper,red potato,adobo sauce,basmati rice
title: Chipotle Copycat Pizza (No Waffles)
ingredients: 3 1/2 lbs red potatoes, washed, cut into small pieces or 3 1/2 lbs idaho potatoes, cut into 10 chunks | 2 1/4 cups adobo sauce, divided ( see description ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried yeast | 1 1/2 teaspoons salt & freshly ground black pepper, divided | 8 cups arugula or 8 cups salad greens
instructions: Add potatoes to a large pan of cold, salted water and bring to a boil. Lower the heat and bring potatoes to a boil about 4 - 5 minutes until tender. Drain the potatoes and return them to the pan, adding half the adobo sauce. Add yeast. Cover the pan and set aside to rise until the potatoes have doubled in bulk. Stir to remove any remaining adobe or other bacteria. Transfer the mixture to a large bowl that has been floured and let rise until at least 1/2 inch of liquid is absorbed. Add the remaining adobe sauce, 1 1/2 teaspoons black pepper, 1/2 teaspoons salt, and 1/4 cup more of the adobo sauce. Spread the arugula leaves on a baking sheet. Spread the mixture over the leaves.

title: Chive Pork and Vegetable Muffins
ingredients: 100 g lean pork or 100 g lean ground beef | 100 g self raising flour | 30 g salsa | 1 bunch chives | 2 tablespoons self-raising flour | 1 carrot | 1 bunch endive
instructions: Put the meat into a frying pan with the salsa and a dash of salt. If using beef and veg, dice them finely. Mix the flour and chives together. Add the dry ingredients into the meat and mix well. Mince 1 carrot and 1 endive. Put meat mixture into to prepared muffin tin. Pour the salsa over each piece of mince and endive. Preheat the grill to medium. Place the tin on the grill and cook for 10 minutes, until pork is cooked through and vegetables heated through.

title: Gravlax
ingredients: 1 -2 cup cooked meat (, such as salmon, cod or other flakey fish ) | lemon juice | smoked salmon ( optional ) or salmon ( optional )
instructions: Cut some thin slices from the smoked salmon if using. I prefer to leave the skin on the salmon for added flavor, then i like to lightly spray the slices with a non stick spray for the flakey type of material. If you are not strictly in a hurry, leave them on. In a tall glass, add half of the lemon juice to make a dipping sauce.

title: Sabzi Pil Pil
ingredients: 200 g baby corn | 125 g black olives | 100 g white raisins | 1 tablespoon cardamom seed
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a sauce pan. Add cardamom and fry for a few seconds. Add chopped babycorn, raisins and olives. Stir continuously until the mixture is boiling and a little oil sprinkled on top starts to leave. Turn down heat to low and cover. Keep warm until rice is ready.

Random Ingredients: liquid smoke,garlic herb seasoning,vanilla sugar,carrot,pork tenderloin,saffron
title: Pork Tenderloin With Saffron
ingredients: 1 pork tenderloin, trimmed of excess fat | salt and fresh ground pepper | 1 pinch saffron | 1 tablespoon light vanilla sugar or 1 tablespoon raw sugar | 1 tablespoon garlic and herb seasoning ( see my note ) | 1 -2 tablespoon liquid smoke, preferably ka-1
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Cut fatty part of tenderloin almost to the bone with a sharp knife just to make slicing easier. Cut tenderloin into 1 1/2 wide strips. Season both sides with salt and pepper and a pinch or two of saffron. Place beef or poultry tenderloin strips under the loin. Place on a rack in a shallow roasting pan. Roast uncovered for 10 minutes. Turn to roast for an additional 15 minutes or until desired doneness and meat thermometer registers 155ºf. Remove meat from pan and let stand for 5 minutes. Place a rack in oven to keep warm. Turn burner to medium low. Deglaze pan with 1 tbsp of saffron, followed by the vanilla sugar and any flavoring of your choice, adding 2 tbsp liquid smoke if desired. Allow to reduce for 1 minute. Adjust seasonings if needed. Serve with rice and seasonal vegetables.

title: Italian Tomato and Cheese Salad
ingredients: 2 lbs grape tomatoes | 12 ounces pineapple-apple flavored tomato juice | 1 ounce shredded pecorino romano cheese | 1 tablespoon desiccated coconut
instructions: Core and slice tomatoes. Slice pineappleapple. In a large bowl, mix all ingredients. Chill several hours before serving.

title: Unbelievable Shrimp Bites
ingredients: 1 cup tamari | 1 teaspoon cayenne | 1/4 teaspoon cinnamon | 1/4 cup maple syrup | 1/2 lb hot italian turkey sausage | 1 lb shrimp, peeled and deveined | 20 large artichoke bottoms, sliced
instructions: Whisk tamari, cayenne, cinnamon, maple syrup, and sausage together in a bowl. Add shrimp and artichokes.

title: Spinach 'n Cheese - Swiss Cheese and Spinach
ingredients: 1 tablespoon peanut oil | 1 package baby spinach, rinsed | 2 slices smoked gouda cheese | 2 slices swiss cheese
instructions: Heat the peanut oil in a large skillet over medium high heat. Add the spinach, gouda, and swiss to skillet, and cook until cheese is melted and spinach is heated through. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: parsnip,beef bouillon,black tea,floury potato,kelp,turmeric powder,white bread
title: Czech Chowder
ingredients: 1 cup black tea | 1 tablespoon fresh parsnip | 2 teaspoons minced kransky gold medal beef bouillon, powder or 2 teaspoons beef base | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1 large floury potato, boiled and chopped | 4 slices white bread, dipped in milk for 20 minutes in the milk | 1 tablespoon flour or 1 tablespoon cornstarch
instructions: Place tea in a tea pot and bring to a boil. Add parsnips and bouillon powder.

Random Ingredients: white sugar,pearl barley,espresso powder,goat cheese,salt pepper,wild mushroom,italian seasoning,gnocchi
title: Gnocchi and Wild Mushrooms in Espresso (Pressure Cooker)
ingredients: 3/4 cup dried wild mushroom | 3/4 cup pearl barley | 4 ounces soft sweet goat cheese ( i prefer soft soft white ) | 1/2 cup white sugar | 1/3 cup instant espresso powder | 1 teaspoon italian-style seasoning | salt and pepper, to taste | 1 package gnocchi
instructions: Rinse mushrooms and remove any dirt and sand. You don't have to use all of the mushrooms, but they should be quite dry. Place dried mushrooms in a small bowl with boiling water. Soak for 10 minutes, then strain through a double thickness of cheesecloth. Discard soaking liquid. Place the barley, goat cheese, sugar, espresso powder, and italian style seasoning in the pressure cooker. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Lock lid onto cooker and bring up to pressure over medium heat. Insert a piece of heavy foil on the outside of the lid to prevent sticking. Cook for 25 minutes and release pressure according to package directions. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: endive,sherry wine,white wine vinegar,cream celery soup
title: Creamy Boursin' Endive
ingredients: 1 package of chopped endives | 2 medium cans condensed cream of celery soup, undiluted | 1/4 cup sherry wine or 1/4 cup red wine vinegar | 1/4 cup white wine vinegar
instructions: In a glass bowl, combine endives and soup. Cover and chill in the refrigerator. Serve chilled.

Random Ingredients: sherry,garlic,sea salt black pepper,sweetcorn,butterscotch chip,pimento olive,chicken taco seasoning mix
title: The Best Chicken Taco Ever Pakistani Style
ingredients: 1 box chicken taco seasoning mix | 1/4 cup minced pimento stuffed olive | 1/4 cup dry sherry | 1 teaspoon minced garlic | 1 teaspoon butterscotch chips | 1 teaspoon crushed sweetcorn | sea salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix together the taco seasoning mix, pimento stuffed olives, sherry, garlic, butterscotch chips, sweetcorn and salt and pepper to taste. Mix in the chicken until well coated with the spice mix. Wrap and refrigerate for the flavors to meld, about 1 hour. When ready to cook, remove from the refrigerator halfway through the soaking time to let the flavors meld. Cook to desired doneness, remove from the oven, break apart, and allow to sit for 5 to 10 minutes. Serve in warm tortillas with jalapenos and salsa.

title: Grilled Chicken With Lime and Parsley
ingredients: 1/3 cup fresh parsley sprig | 1 teaspoon finely chopped lime wedge | 2 tablespoons bread flour | 1 kg chicken breast
instructions: Pre heat oven to 200 degrees celcius. Spread parsley and lime on grated rind of the chicken on a cutting board and cut away the dark membrane. Sprinkle with flour and place on an oiled baking tray. Place chicken on pre heated grill and cook until golden. Serve with lime and fresh parsley on the side.

title: Apple Sherbet
ingredients: 3 cups dry white wine | 4 tablespoons apple cider vinegar | 1 cup ice cubes | 1/2 cup butter, melted
instructions: Place wine, vinegar, and ice cubes in a blender, and pulse until ice is crushed. Pour in butter.

Random Ingredients: ghee,ketchup,white mushroom,white bread,ham,blueberry syrup,coconut oil,chicken breast half
title: Blueberry Honey Coconut Chicken
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 2 slices firm white bread | 1 tablespoon coconut oil | 1/6 cup ketchup | 3 tablespoons blueberry syrup | 2 tablespoons white balsamic vinegar or 2 tablespoons lemon juice | 3 tablespoons ghee | 1/4 lb ham, diced | 1/4 lb white mushroom, sliced on a mandolin, for each breast half ( optional )
instructions: Combine ketchup, blueberry syrup, balsamic vinegar, and ghee, and set aside. Brush a grill lightly with oil and grill chicken over moderately high heat until cooked through and beginning to brown, about 10 minutes, turning once. Meanwhile, tear up a piece of bread and tear into 2 or 3 chunks. Brush both sides of breasts with oil and season. Toast bread in oven until lightly browned and crisp and set aside. Add 2 tbsp of butter or ghee to saucepan and whisk to combine and set aside. Cook mushrooms over moderate heat for about 5 minutes, turning mushrooms. Slice ham and saute until brown and crispy. Stir sauce into pan and simmer until it thickens a little and chicken is cooked through. Toast bread briefly. Top bread with ham and chicken, pour sauce over and serve.

title: Pineapple Sunrise
ingredients: 1/2 cup orange-flavored liqueur | 8 ounces pineapple juice
instructions: Layer into a crystal glass with ice, liqueur and pineapple juice. Shake and serve.

title: Beef Carne Assada
ingredients: 1 lb flank steak | 2 tablespoons cumin seeds | 1/12 cup freshly grated cotija cheese | 1 bunch fresh jalapeno pepper
instructions: Preheat an oven to 250°. Pierce the flank steak with a sharp knife and put it on a greased baking sheet. Bake in the oven for 60 minutes, and turn it over twice during the baking process. It should burn quickly. Place the flank steak in a plastic bag or plastic bag, and freeze for at least 4 hours, or overnight. After the meat has frozen for at least 24 hours, drain the meat. While the meat is frozen, roast the cumin seeds in a dry skillet over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until fragrant and light brown. Spread the seeds in a bowl and let cool to room temperature. When the meat is cool, slice it into 1 inch strips. Combine the cumin and cheese in a medium bowl.

Random Ingredients: kosher salt,brown sugar,green olive,sharp cheddar cheese,italian seasoning,ziti pasta,swiss cheese,red pepper
title: Cheesy Ziti
ingredients: 12 ounces ziti pasta | 1 1/2 tablespoons kosher salt | 20 ounces sharp cheddar cheese, shredded | 3/4 cup swiss cheese, shredded | 1/4 cup green olives, chopped | 1/4 cup italian seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon red pepper, dried | 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt
instructions: Cook ziti, drain, and set aside. Spray a 2 1/2 quart casserole with nonstick cooking spray. In a small bowl, combine cheeses. Sprinkle top with salt. Bake ziti, uncovered, at 400f for 10 to 12 minutes or until cheese is melted. Sprinkle with italian seasoning, red pepper, and kosher salt.

title: Spinach & Lime
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh spinach | 1 bamboo shoot, cut into strips | 1 lime, juice and zest of | crushed ice
instructions: Heat a wok over a high heat for 2 minutes. Pour in a handful of the spinach into the wok and saute for 2 - 3 mints, stirring to keep the spinach from burning. Remove the spinach with a slotted spoon and place into a large bowl. Repeat with the remaining leaves, adding more mints, zest and juice to the wok as required. Serve warm with crushed ice.

Random Ingredients: edamame,granny smith apple,red cabbage,elbow macaroni,vanilla pod
title: Sweet Macaroni and Edamame
ingredients: 7 ounces elbow macaroni | 4 tablespoons fresh edamame ( or 1 tsp. dried instant delivery yeast ) | 1 granny smith apple, unpeeled, peeled and grated | 5 ounces thin red cabbage, shredded | 1 vanilla pod, split lengthwise
instructions: Cover the macaroni with cold boiling water for no more than 4 minutes. Drain well, rinse with cold water and drain again. Place the prepared macaroni in a large skillet with a lid. Add just enough boiling water to cover and cook over high heat, stirring once, until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 2 minutes.

Random Ingredients: white pepper,portobello mushroom cap,golden raisin,orange zest,green chilies,pickle relish,tomato,channa dal
title: Moroccan-Spiced Tomato Chutney
ingredients: 6 cups tomatoes, coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup pickle relish | 1/2 cup golden raisin | 1 can channa dal | 1 small portobello mushroom caps, chopped | 1 sweet white pepper | 1/2 teaspoon grated orange zest | 3 cloves white peppers | 1/2 teaspoon grated orange zest
instructions: Combine tomato, relish, raisins, yellow pepper, orange zest, and 3 cloves of white pepper in a large bowl.

Random Ingredients: rice vinegar,asparagus,okra,spicy brown mustard,chilies,irish cream,baby green,almond
title: Wild Rice Salad
ingredients: 1 cup cooked rice vinegar | 1 1/2 tablespoons spicy brown mustard | 4 tablespoons spicy chilies, cut in half | 1/2 cup almonds, sliced | 1 lb fresh okra, cut in 1/4 inch wedges | 1 1/2 lbs baby greens | 1/2 lb fresh asparagus, halved lengthwise in two directions | 3/4 cup irish cream
instructions: In a large salad bowl, combine cooked rice vinegar, dijon mustard, chilies, almonds, okra, and greens. Cover, and let sit 30 minutes. Right before serving, stir in asparagus spears and orange sections.

title: Polish Delights
ingredients: 2 tablespoons condensed cheddar cheese soup | 4 slices prosciutto di parma
instructions: Place 2 slices of prosciutto di Parma on a microwave safe plate. Spread the cheddar cheese soup over the prosciutto. Place a second slice of prosciutto di Parma over the cheddar. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: sriracha chili garlic sauce,dark sesame oil,cannellini bean,cumin seed,cherry tomato
title: Quick and Easy Hummus
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil | 1 teaspoon cumin seed | 1 can cannellini beans | 1 1/2 tablespoons sriracha chili-garlic sauce | 1 cherry tomatoes, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Heat a skillet over medium heat for 1 minute. Add sesame oil, cumin seeds, and beans. Cook, stirring occasionally, for 2 minutes. Stir in chili and cook 3 additional minutes. Stir in tomatoes and cook until tomatoes are heated through. Serve with pita chips.

Random Ingredients: kaffir lime leaf,tequila,chicken leg quarter,lemon peel,turnip
title: Margarita Potatoes
ingredients: 2 chicken leg quarters | 2 large turnips, peeled, cut into chunks | 6 kale leaves, chopped | 1/3 cup tequila | 1 lemon peel, grated for garnish
instructions: Place each chicken leg quarter between two sheets of plastic wrap and flatten with a rolling pin to a 1/4 inch thickness. Arrange into a 12x6 inch glass baking dish. Gently toss the turnip chunks with the chicken legs and turnip chunks in the mix. Pour the tequila over the chicken until the dish is about 1/2 inch deep. Chill. The next day, remove plastic wrap from the baking dish and score the top. Drain the chicken and discard it. Arrange it on top of the tequila in a single layer. Sprinkle with lemon peel. Cover the dish with a kitchen towel and refrigerate for 2 to 3 hours. Garnish with lime wedges.

title: Steamed Beef Ribs With Pecans
ingredients: beef rib eye roast ( about 4-5 lbs. ) | 1 package thai fish sauce | 1 container vanilla greek yogurt | 3 tablespoons chopped pecans | 2 lbs oxtails ( steamed )
instructions: Place ribs in 5 qt saucepan 1/2 full of water and 1/2 teaspoon salt. Bring to a boil and cover. Reduce heat. Simmer for 3 hours or longer until ribs are tender, stirring halfway through cooking. Cool completely in pot and slice into 3 pieces. Arrange ribs in single layer. Refrigerate 1/2 cup liquid remaining in pot for later. Bring remaining liquid to simmer in pot. Add fish sauce. Simmer 4 to 5 minutes or until sauce has slightly thickened slightly. Spoon over hot ribs.

title: Coconut Orzo and Veggies
ingredients: 1 package orzo pasta | 1 can coconut milk | 2 green peppers, cut into chunks
instructions: Prepare orzo according to package directions. Drain and return to pan. Add coconut milk. Add green peppers.

Random Ingredients: green pepper,avocado,virgin olive oil,sponge cake,kidney bean,chunky salsa,mango pulp,bay leaf
title: Mexican Pancake Salad
ingredients: 1 cup chunky salsa, homemade or prepared | 1/2 cup diced avocado ( optional ) | 1/2 cup diced green pepper ( optional ) | 1/2 cup diced ripe mango, fresh ( optional ) | 4 -6 slices sponge cakes | 1 can kidney beans, rinsed and drained | 1 bay leaf | 2 tablespoons virgin olive oil
instructions: In a medium serving bowl, mash the salsa and avocados with fork until smooth. Stir in green peppers, mango or prawns, beans, bay leaf, and olive oil. Slice the cakes crosswise into thick slices. Arrange a bed of bean and avocado salad onto each slice of toast. Serve immediately.

title: Swedish Rye Bread (Pumpernickel) in Syrup
ingredients: 1 rye bread | 2 tablespoons sugar
instructions: Cut the rye bread into squares, about 3 or 4 inches square, and place one on each serving plate. Brush with egg yolk or milk. Heat 1 tablespoon of the sugar in a small saucepan. Add the bread and cook over high heat, stirring constantly, for 2 minutes or until dry. Turn out onto a hot plate, sprinkle with sugar and serve warm.

Random Ingredients: parmesan cheese,tabasco sauce,lemon juice zest,dark rum
title: Hot Chocolate With Grilled Shrimps
ingredients: 1 lemon, juice and zest of | 2 ounces dark rum | 7 ounces shaved parmesan cheese ( or parmesan, grana, or romano ) | tabasco sauce ( optional )
instructions: To make a shrimps, pour 2 oz of shaved parmesan into a glass bowl and add 1/4 1/2 a shot of dark rum. Mix the shrimps with the other 2 oz shaved parmesan and sprinkle with a few drops of tabasco. Serve straight away.

Random Ingredients: cremini mushroom,pie crust,part ricotta cheese,vanilla yogurt,allspice
title: Crepes
ingredients: 2 unbaked pie crusts | 1/3 cup part-skim ricotta cheese | 3/4 cup reduced-fat sour cream or 3/4 cup plain low-fat yogurt | 1/3 cup sliced cremini mushroom | 1/8 teaspoon allspice
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f if necessary, lightly oil an 8 inch nonstick frying pan. Separate crust pastry dough into eight pieces and flatten into four 3 inch circles. Set aside. Roll out pastry until 10 in diameter. Carefully place each circle on pastry dough circles. Cut a 1/4 inch slit in the center of each circle. Spoon approximately 1/8 of sour cream/yogurt in a thin horizontal line down center of each pastry circle. Sprinkle a pinch of allspice on top of yogurt. Brush a 1 inch edge with water. Fold in opposite edges and pinch with a pinch of salt. Press edges to seal. Repeat with remaining pastry and filling. Place on a baking sheet. Bake for 10 minute or until edges are golden brown. Serve immediately. For variation, after removing from oven, top each crepes with 1/2 cup fat free plain yogurt and 1/4 cup diced nonfat swiss cheese. Add 1/8 teaspoon ground cinnamon on top. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: dark brown sugar,rice wine vinegar,leek,baking chocolate,cocoa,baking soda
title: Chocolate Glazed Leeks
ingredients: 1/4 cup dark brown sugar | 3 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa | 2 tablespoons rice wine vinegar | 2 lbs leeks, white and light green parts only, washed, trimmed, chopped, and halved crosswise | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 1 1/2 teaspoons unsweetened dutch-processed cocoa | 1/2 cup sweet baking chocolate
instructions: Position rack in center of oven and preheat to 450°f combine golden brown and unsweetened 1 1/4 cups of dark brown sugar in a small bowl and set aside. Add 2 tablespoons cocoa, vinegar, leeks and baking soda. Arrange coated leeks, white parts only, side by side in a 13x9x2 inch glass baking dish that has been coated with cooking spray. Spread remaining 1 1/4 cups brown sugar mixture evenly over leeks and bake in center of oven until just tender, about 40 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside. In a small bowl, combine 1 1/2 teaspoons cocoa with remaining 1/2 teaspoons cocoa and cool to room temperature. Drizzle cooled caramel over scallions and cool. Chill.

Random Ingredients: taco seasoning,chicken breast half,onion powder,broccoli rabe
title: Healthy Chicken Taco
ingredients: 1 pound skinless, boneless chicken breast halves | 1 can or bottle beer | 1 envelope taco seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon onion powder
instructions: Preheat an oven to 350 degrees f. Pour beer into a large resealable plastic bag. Place chicken into the beer. Squeeze out any excess beer from the bag, and toss chicken into the beer mixture until coated. Spread chicken into the bottom of a large roasting pan.

Random Ingredients: chicken wing,broccoli floret,bacon dripping,bow tie pasta,blueberry,extra virgin olive oil
title: Broccoli Chicken Wings With Bow Ties
ingredients: 2 tablespoons bacon drippings or 2 tablespoons canola oil | 1 1/2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 8 whole chicken wings | 1 cup fresh broccoli floret | 2/3 cup blueberries | 1 1/4 cups bow tie pasta
instructions: Heat bacon drippings until smoking. Add 1 1/2 tbsp of the oil to the skillet and heat to high. Add the wings and cook for 3 minutes per side or until golden brown and no longer pink inside. Add salt and pepper to your taste, cover, reduce the heat to medium and cook for about 4 - 5 minutes, or until the sauce coats the back of a spoon. Add broccoli and blueberries. Stir and cook for 2 more minutes, or until the broccoli is tender. Remove from heat and drain the broccoli. Serve over your hot pasta for a fresh lunch or dinner.

title: Kook-Ish Nachos (Korean Nachos)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs idaho potatoes, cooked and cubed | 1 can crabmeat | 1 cup ketchup | 1 tablespoon paprika chili powder | 2 tablespoons cooking oil | 1/2 cup ground almonds
instructions: Cook potatoes in boiling, salted water until soft. Drain and mash. Add crab meat, ketchup, paprika and chili powder. In large frying pan, heat the oil. In batches, add the nachos and fry until golden brown and crisp. Transfer onto heated serving plate. Serve with a small bowl of your choice.

Random Ingredients: bay scallop,fennel seed,button mushroom,half,beer,tamari,dark sesame oil
title: Beer-Baked Scallops With Mushrooms and Beer
ingredients: 1 teaspoon dark sesame oil | 4 large button mushrooms, sliced | 1 1/2 teaspoons fennel seeds, crushed | 2 bay scallops | 1 cup light beer, such as negra modelo or 1 cup non-alcoholic beer | 1/2 cup half-and-half | 1/2 cup tamari
instructions: Preheat oven to 350° and adjust oven rack to middle position. Heat oil in medium nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Add mushrooms and fennel seeds. Season with salt. Brown mushrooms for about 5 minutes, stirring often, until moisture in mushrooms evaporates and mushrooms release their liquid. Stir mushrooms and liquid into beer and simmer about 5 to 10 minutes until liquid reduced by half. Transfer mushroom mixture and beer mixture to small mixing bowl and set aside. Arrange scallops on large baking sheet. Divide mushroom mixture among the scallops. Top evenly with reserved beer mixture. Bake 10 to 12 minutes, just until heated through and lightly browned. Sprinkle with tamari and toasted sesame seeds and serve immediately.

title: Chile Pudding
ingredients: 3/4 cup molasses | 1 cup catsup | 3 -4 chilies, minced | 1/2 cup confectioners'sugar | 1 tablespoon dried oregano leaves | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace | 2 1/2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 1/3 cup walnuts, chopped
instructions: In a small saucepan, combine the molasses, catsup, chilies, confectioners' sugar, oregano, mace, and yeast.

Random Ingredients: lemon peel,vegetable oil cooking spray,fontina,italian herb,fruit,balsamic vinegar,american cheese,red curry paste
title: Balsamic Cheesecake
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 1/2 lbs cheeses, finely grated ( swiss or gruyere ) | 1/2 cup italian mixed herbs, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon fresh lemon peel, grated | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 1 1/2 tablespoons red curry paste | 1 1/2 lbs dried assorted fruit, peeled ( i prefer blueberries, strawberries, kiwi, mandarin oranges ) | 1 lb white american cheese, sliced thinly
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f. Coat the bottom of an 8 x 10 inch glass baking dish with cooking spray and set aside. Combine cheeses and herbs with lemon peel, vinegar, and red curry paste in a medium bowl. Spread 1/2 of the cheeses in prepared pan and top with 1/2 of the fruit, leaving one third of the cheese uncovered all the way around. Repeat with the remaining cheeses and fruit. Cover and bake in a 300°f oven for 1 hour or until the cheeses are melted and bubbly. Remove from oven and let sit for 20 minutes before serving. Cut into squares and serve warm.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack cheese,cooking oat,stewing beef,chicken stock better,oil,large shrimp
title: Honeysuckle Stew
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef or 1 lb hen | 2 ounces quick cooking oats | 2 tablespoons oil | 1 1/2 cups chicken stock | 12 ounces of precooked large shrimp | 1 package shredded monterey jack cheese
instructions: Heat oil in a pot and cook shrimp, langgette and stew beef. Drain in collander and sprinkle with cheese. Put back on stove and steam for an additional 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: japanese eggplant,rice,shallot,lemon zest,wheat pasta shell,garam masala powder,sausage
title: Indian Spiced Eggplant (Aubergine) Rolls
ingredients: 3/4 lb fresh italian sweet sausage | 1 medium japanese eggplant ( or 2 medium ones ) | 2 teaspoons lemon zest | 1 1/2 teaspoons garam masala powder | 1/2 teaspoon dried shallots | 1 box whole wheat thin spaghetti shells | 2/3 cup rice
instructions: In large skillet, cook sausage over medium heat until no longer pink, breaking up into small pieces. Drain fat. Slice into 1/8 inch thick pieces. Stir into sausage drippings in skillet. Stir in zest, garam masala powder, shallots. Add eggplant, and cook over medium heat until vegetables are soft, about 5 minutes. Fill pasta shells with mixture. Place several tablespoons of sausage mixture into each shell. Sprinkle tops with cheese of your choice. Bake for 10 minutes at 350 degrees, then turn down oven to 325 degrees and bake until filling is done, about 20 minutes longer.

title: Homemade Lemon Oil for Roasted Veggies
ingredients: 1 cup fresh lemon zest | 8 cups extra virgin olive oil
instructions: In a wide, shallow roasting pan, mix the lemon zest with the olive oil. Place vegetables in an oven with the pan sides touching on the stove. Let the vegies roast at 300°f for about 8 to 10 minutes, until tender and turning golden brown. Remove the vegies from the pan and let them cool for 10 minutes, then refrigerate them. They should not be completely dry.

Random Ingredients: mango,cream,guinness stout,texas toast bread,barley,caesar salad dressing,chicken thigh,tart green apple
title: BBQ Chicken Appetizer With Lime & Fruity Mango Barley Salad
ingredients: 3 ounces chicken thighs, boned and skinned, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 cup guiness style beer or 1 cup beer | 1 cup low-fat sour cream | 1/3 cup catalina salad dressing | 2/3 cup barley | 2/3 cup dried tart green apple | 1 1/2 cups guinness stout | 1/3 cup mango, cubed ( about 2 cups ) | 1/3 cup mango, sliced ( about 2 cups ) | sliced lime and orange slice ( to garnish )
instructions: In a small bowl, stir the beer until combined.

Random Ingredients: cumin,cannellini bean,no boil lasagna noodle,daikon radish,monterey jack cheese,shiitake mushroom,chili flake
title: Mushroom Vegetable Lasagna
ingredients: 2 packages no-boil lasagna noodles | 2 bags shiitake mushrooms, sliced | 1 can cannellini beans ( drained ) | 1/2 cup minced daikon radish | 1 teaspoon cumin | 2 -3 tablespoons chili flakes | 1 1/2 cups grated reduced-fat monterey jack cheese
instructions: Combine all, together in a 9x13 baking dish. Bake, uncovered at 400 degrees fahrenheit for 30 minutes, or until heated thoroughly. Cover with aluminum foil if cooking in oven. Uncover when browned.

title: Hominy and Rice
ingredients: 1 can hominy, drained | 1/2 cup heavy cream | 1 teaspoon turmeric | 1/2 teaspoon dried rosemary ( or thyme ) | tortilla chips ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a pot and simmer, uncovered on low heat until hot and flavors have been blended. Serve topped with tortilla chips, if desired.

title: Chutney and Sage Rice
ingredients: 4 1/2 ounces vegetable suet ( like crisco or swiss or organic ) | 4 1/2 ounces smoked spanish chutney | 1 1/2 ounces jalapeno pepper, finely chopped | 4 3/4 ounces rice | 4 5 ounces mixed fresh sage leaves
instructions: Heat oven to 200c, 400f, gas mark combine all ingredients to a saucepan and bring to the boil, stirring from time to time. Remove from heat and transfer to an ovenproof dish. Cover with a tight fitting lid and bake for 45 minutes, stirring every 10 - 15 minutes to crumble. Serve with a green salad if wished.

Random Ingredients: italian salad dressing,romano cheese,red pepper,green chile pepper,grenadine,onion powder,demerara sugar
title: Puerto Rican Cheesy Chili Peppers
ingredients: 1 bottle italian-style salad dressing | 1 cup diced red pepper | 1 can chopped green chile peppers | 1 tablespoon grenadine | 1 tablespoon onion powder | 1 tablespoon demerara sugar | 1 1/2 cups grated romano cheese
instructions: Stir together the salad dressing, peppers, chiles, grenadine, onion powder and sugar in a large bowl. Cover and chill, stirring occasionally, for 20 to 30 minutes. Spoon into hot jars and close jars. Process in a hot water bath for 15 minutes, or as directed on the bottle.

Random Ingredients: feta cheese,ketchup,onion soup mix,brown sugar,molasses,leg lamb
title: Lamb Grilling
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless leg of lamb, trimmed of fat | 1 cup ketchup | 1 tablespoon molasses | 3 envelopes onion soup mix | 1 teaspoon brown sugar | 1/4 cup feta cheese
instructions: Preheat your grill to medium, high heat. In a ziplock bag, mix together all of the ingredients. Seal tightly and put on the grill. Grill the lamb until a meat thermometer reads 145 degrees or reaches a temperature of your choosing about 135 degrees. Cook longer until it reaches desired doneness. I like mine medium rare. Top with your choice of sauce.

title: Quick Beef and Water
ingredients: 2 lbs stewing beef | 1 can water chestnuts
instructions: Place beef in crock pot and add water it should have a thick gravy consistency. Cover. Cook on low 6 hour.

Random Ingredients: icing sugar,cucumber,cooking oil,chinese five spice powder,pinto bean,cardamom pod,rigatoni pasta,red wine
title: Yorkshire pudding bowties
ingredients: 1 lb rigatoni pasta or 1 lb rotini pasta | cooking oil | cucumber, cut in wedges | icing sugar | 1 cup pinto beans | 1 cup red wine | 1 teaspoon chinese five spice powder | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom pod
instructions: Boil noodles until tender. Drain and toss in cold water to stop the cooking. Toss noodles in hot cooking oil, a tablespoonful of cooking oil per bowtie. To serve, add a wedge of cucumber and some icing sugar. Add another tablespoonful of oil per bowtie, garnish with a few pats of crushed chuncks of crushed garlic and serve.

Random Ingredients: potato starch,beef chuck,cardamom seed,shiitake mushroom,lamb shank,italian bread crumb,mace,margarine
title: Meat-Stuffed Shiitake Mushrooms
ingredients: 4 tablespoons margarine, melted | 2 tablespoons potato starch | 3 pounds boneless lamb shank | 1 pound cubed beef chuck | 1 pound mushrooms | 1/4 cup ground cardamom seeds | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace | 2 cups italian seasoned bread crumbs
instructions: Preheat the oven's broiler and set the oven rack about 6 inches from the heat source. Heat the margarine in a skillet over medium high heat. Sear the shank, beef chuck, and mushrooms in the margarine until the meat is no longer pink inside, about 10 minutes. Drain excess fat. In a bowl, toss the ground cardamom seeds with the ground mace. Reserve about 1/2 cup of the stuffing for a garnish after stuffing. Stuff the reserved stuffing into the mushroom caps and place on a baking sheet. Place the stuffed mushroom caps onto the baking sheet. Cook the mushrooms in the preheated oven until the stuffing is no longer pink inside and the mushrooms are tender, about 15 minutes. Spoon reserved stuffing into a bowl. Sprinkle with bread crumbs, and serve.

Random Ingredients: flour tortilla,dungeness crab,frangelico,fish sauce,pork loin,corn oil,iceberg lettuce
title: Easy Filipino Tacos
ingredients: 200 g minced pork loin | 1 tablespoon corn oil | 1/2 tablespoon fish sauce | 1/2 bunch fresh dungeness crab, cleaned and chopped | 1 cup shredded iceberg lettuce | 1 tablespoon flour tortilla | 4 tablespoons heinz catalina fish sauce
instructions: In a nonstick skillet, lightly sauté minced pork, stirring until pork has browned. Add the fish sauce and stir for 1 minute. Add the dungeness crab mix and top with shredded lettuce and crumbled iceberg lettuce. Top with crumbled chia. Serve over a bed of jasmine rice.

Random Ingredients: grain white rice,orange peel,ginger garlic paste
title: Orange Ginger Rice
ingredients: 1 cup long-grain white rice, such as arborio | 4 tablespoons ginger-garlic paste | 3 tablespoons finely grated orange peel
instructions: Place the rice in a strainer and rinse under cold water before adding to a medium size saucepan. Add the ginger garlic paste and orange peel and combine thoroughly. Add about a cup of hot water and bring to a boil. Cover and simmer over medium low heat for 20 minutes, or until thick and creamy.

title: Roasted Red Pepper
ingredients: 1 medium red pepper, roasted, seeded, and cut in strips | cooking spray
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Line cookie sheet with parchment paper. Toss red pepper, on the parchment paper, and spray with cooking spray. Roast until just starting to crisp, about 15 minutes.

title: Duck and Chips
ingredients: 1 lb duck breast, fat trimmed | 5 tablespoons baking soda, heaping | 4 packages assorted coloured crystal sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 500°f in a non stick frying pan, brown the duck breasts and transfer to a roasting pan. Drizzle with remaining tbsp of baking soda and sprinkle with coloured crystal sugar. Bake for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally. Duck and Chips should be slightly crispy and golden.

title: Romaine, Romaine and Herbs Salad
ingredients: 1 head romaine lettuce, washed, dried ( about 5 1/2 pounds ) | 12 cups chilled chopped romaine lettuce
instructions: In a large bowl, combine half the chopped or torn romaine. Cover the salad ingredients with the other half of the romaine. Toss just before serving. May be served warm or cold.

title: Beer and Sesame Seed Dip
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups sesame seeds ( see note ) | 1/2 teaspoon dried italian herb ( see note ) | 4 cups light beer or 4 cups dark beer, at room temperature
instructions: Place all ingredients in a blender or food processor.

title: Mango & Sauerkraut Patties
ingredients: 1/2 cup sauerkraut | 3 tablespoons cornflour | 1 tablespoon parsley leaves | 1 mango, chopped ( or 3 to 4 small mango balls )
instructions: Place all ingredients in a bowl and mix well. Form into patties and fry in oil for about 3 minutes each side until browned and heated through. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: dark brown sugar,green bell pepper,red chili pepper,extra sharp cheddar cheese
title: Chili Cheese Stuffed Bell Peppers
ingredients: 6 medium green bell peppers | 1/4 cup extra-sharp cheddar cheese, shredded | 1 teaspoon dark brown sugar | 1 teaspoon ground red chili pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 f. Wash bell peppers, and place in a lightly greased 13x9 inch baking dish. Sprinkle each pepper evenly with cheese, brown sugar, and red chile pepper. Bake in preheated oven 25 minutes, until peppers are warmed through and cheese beginning to brown around edges.

Random Ingredients: egg white,cumin seed,plain yogurt,cayenne powder,balsamic vinegar,arborio rice,wild mushroom
title: Wild Mushrooms and Balsamic Risotto
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups plain yogurt ( whole milk or non-fat ) | 4 cups cooked arborio rice | 1 lb wild mushroom, quartered ( chanterelles, crimini, shitake, oyster or white ) | 2 1/2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 1 tablespoon cumin seed, toasted, ground | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne powder | 1 large egg white
instructions: Place the yogurt in a bowl. Pour half the strained yoghurt into another large bowl. Add the remaining strained yogurt. In the last bowl, combine the rice, mushrooms and herbs and mix gently. Add the vinegar and cayenne, and stir gently with your hands. Set aside. Beat the egg yolk lightly with a fork in a small bowl. Stir in the whisked egg white and pour into the rice mixture. Using a rubber spatula or fork, quickly fold until the mixture is smooth and creamy. Add a little of the reserved yogurt if it seems too dry. You can either leave plain or mix in a few drops of water if the mixture seems too creamy. Cover and refrigerate until serving time.

Random Ingredients: cayenne pepper,rosemary leaf,coriander seed,tomato paste,prune,kombu,peanut oil corn
title: Nuked Tomatoes With Prunes
ingredients: 2 lbs ripe tomatoes | 8 ounces fresh prunes, pitted | kombu, peelings ( or kelp ) | 3 tablespoons chili paste with kombu ( or hot pepper paste ) | 1 tablespoon coriander seed | 1 tablespoon dried rosemary leaves | 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 3 tablespoons oil or 3 tablespoons corn oil
instructions: Chop the tomatoes into eighths. Add the prunes to the pan of water to cover and cook until the prunes turn red around the edges, about 5 - 7 minutes. Remove the prunes with a slotted spoon and allow to cool. Peel the tomatoes discarding the core. Place the remaining ingredients in a food processor and process to form a smooth paste. Pour the paste into a clean jar and let stand at room temperature for a few hours until the flavors combine. Pour the mixture into an airtight container and store in the refrigerator. Variation, the tomato paste can be made into a paste by soaking a piece of parchment or waxed paper in water for 15 minutes. Bring a large pot of water to boil, remove from the heat, and drop in the parchment. Stir well and add the peanut paste. Cover and steam over medium heat for about 10 minutes. Meanwhile, fry the kombu in a dry skillet over medium heat until fragrant. Add the chopped tomatoes and bring to a boil, breaking up any lumps. Lower the heat, cover and cook over medium heat 5 - 10 minutes to soften the tomatoes.

Random Ingredients: heavy cream,nonfat milk powder,chicken stock,ladyfinger,white wine vinegar,cooking oil,kernel corn,amaretto
title: Lori's Homemade Italian Crock-Pot Cream Cheese Pasta
ingredients: 4 ounces nonfat dry milk powder ( no substitute ) | 4 ounces heavy cream, whipped | 4 1oz. cans chicken stock or 4 1oz cans reduced-sodium chicken, undrained | 1 teaspoon white wine vinegar | cooking oil, to coat crock pot | 8 ounces frozen whole kernel corn, thawed | 4 ounces frozen nonfat milk chocolate chips or 4 ounces bittersweet chocolate chips | 8 ladyfingers, for dipping
instructions: In a mixing bowl, combine all the dry milk powder, cream and stock powder. Transfer the mixture to the crockpot and add the vinegar and oil and set to warm. If you are intending to make this in advance and would like to freeze for future consumption, freeze the mixture to solidify when cold, then use as directed in the description above. Pour over the cornstarch mixture and mix well to coat. Cover and cook on low for 3 - 4 hours or until the sauce has thickened, stirring occasionally throughout cooking time and heating time.. Serve with dipping bread of choice. Note, if desired, freeze the cream cheese mixture in a small airtight container for up to one week after baking. Sauce can be frozen for up to one week or frozen for up to three months. If you make a crock pot cream cheese pasta sauce, reduce the crockpot to low and cook on low for 6 - 8 hours. Drain the corn and return the corn to the crock pot. Stir in the chocolate chips and return to low to warm. Add more vinegar or cream as desired. Note, i usually make this with frozen corn kernels and using the reconstituted corn instead of the pure milk powder method of using the chicken stock or reduced sodium chicken broth.

title: Beef Jerky
ingredients: 1 beef brisket | 1 package catsup | 3 tablespoons chicken bouillon granules | 1/8 cup catsup
instructions: Place brisket in 9 x 13 inch pan. In 3 quart saucepan over low heat, stir together catsup, bouillon granules and catsup.

title: Beef and Beer Soup
ingredients: 1 lb andouille sausage | 1/2 lb extra firm tofu | 1/4 cup extra dry sherry | 1 can chickpeas, drained | 10 cups chicken stock or 10 cups beef broth | 8 ounces lager beer, such as duvel | 1 1/2 tablespoons beef bouillon, powder | 3 ounces fresh spinach
instructions: Brown sausages. Drain in a colander and cut into bite size pieces. Blanch tofu separately in boiling water for a few minutes. Drain in colander and cut into bite sizes pieces. Drain and cut spinach into bite size pieces. Bring stock and sherry to boil. Add meat and tofu.

title: Miso Chips (Tori Sushi)
ingredients: 6 tablespoons miso | 6 tortillas, cut into 1-inch slices ( may sub fresh seaweed ) or 6 pita bread
instructions: Mix the miso into the hot water to form a paste. Place on a plate or in a bowl and put some nori in it. Microwave or place in a bag with a lid. Toss or shake until all the nori has been used. Spread the miso on a piece of plastic wrap or in a tortilla. Arrange the pita or seaweed on top. Microwave for 1 to 2 minutes or until heated.

title: Spinach, Artichoke & Beef With Oyster Sauce
ingredients: 2 slices pork loin, lean | 1 tablespoon oyster sauce | 2 tablespoons ice cream, to serve | 1/4 cup light cream or 1/4 cup light cream | 12 frozen artichokes, thawed ( about 1 lb. ) | 1 small summer squash | 1 small red bell pepper, cut into thin strips for presentation
instructions: Place pork in a nonstick saute pan over medium low heat. Place oyster sauce in small, nonstick skillet. Cook, stirring, 1 minutes or until fragrant. Remove from heat. Using a double thickness of aluminum foil, place 1 or 2 artichoke hearts in the center of the pork.

Random Ingredients: lard,espresso,chili pepper flake,mango chutney,strawberry,pearl barley,passion fruit,heavy whipping cream
title: Chili, Sweet Potato and Chutney Barley Salad
ingredients: 14 ounces fresh strawberries, hulled | 14 ounces passover mango chutney | 1/4 teaspoon chili pepper flakes | 1/4 cup chestnut pearl barley | 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream | 1/4 cup chilled whipped ice cream | 1/4 teaspoon instant espresso | mango chutney
instructions: Combine strawberries, passover mango chutney and chili flakes in a large bowl and set aside. Bring a medium pot of water to a boil. Add barley and cook 2 to 3 minutes or until al dente. Drain the barley in a sieve. Transfer to a serving bowl, chill and chill until cool. Combine cream, ice cream and espresso in a bowl and beat until thick and creamy. Add chilled barley and mix. Top with mango chutney.

Random Ingredients: clove,hard egg,blueberry,pineapple chunk,pine nut,nonfat milk,broccoli,ricotta cheese
title: Baked Vegetable Cheese Pie
ingredients: 2 cups broccoli, chopped | 1 can pineapple chunks ( drained ) | 1 cup unsweetened pineapple-sweetened pineapple chunks | 2 hard-boiled eggs, chopped | 1 container nonfat milk | 2 containers low-fat ricotta cheese | 1/2 cup pine nuts | 1/2 teaspoon ground cloves
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Mix broccoli, pineapple chunks, pineapple, eggs, nonfat milk, ricotta cheese, and pine nuts in a large bowl. Pour into lightly greased 2 1/2 quart casserole dish. Bake uncovered for 35 minutes, stirring halfway through.

title: Apricot & Onion Pizza Appetizer
ingredients: 1 packet dried yeast, quick quick rises yeast | 1 cup pizza sauce | 1 tablespoon onion salt | 1 1/2 cups apricot jam
instructions: Mix yeast and warm sauce in medium bowl. In separate bowl mix onion salt and 1 cup cooled pizza sauce. Stir in yeast mixture. Spread into ungreased 8 pizza pan. Cover with aluminum foil and let rise 45 minures until doubled in size. Pre heat oven to 400 degrees. Remove foil and spread jam over pizza. Bake at 400 for 5 minutes or till cheese is melted.

title: Quick Black Beans (Vegan)
ingredients: 11 ounces black beans or 11 ounces pinto beans | 3 celery ribs, sliced | 1 tablespoon liquid smoke
instructions: Add the beans to boiling water and let boil until tender. Drain the beans and add the celery. Add the liquid smoke and simmer covered, until the beans are tender and the celery is crisp.

Random Ingredients: italian salad dressing mix,pork loin roast,nutmeg
title: Italian Crusted Pork Loin
ingredients: 2 tablespoons italian salad dressing mix | 2 tablespoons groundnutmeg | 2 1/2 pounds pork loin roast
instructions: In a large bowl or resealable plastic bag, mix together the salad dressing mix, groundnutmeg, and pork loin roast. Seal, and refrigerate overnight to marinate. Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Lightly grease a roasting pan with cooking spray. Arrange pork roast in the pan, and drizzle with marinade. Roast for about 2 hours in the preheated oven, until an internal temperature of 145 degrees f is met. Allow to sit for a few minutes before slicing. Let stand for a few minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: pesto sauce,caster sugar,fish,lemon lime beverage,cayenne powder,orange zest
title: Golden Fish from Baked on the Day!
ingredients: 600 g firm fish ( such as halibut, cod or sole ) | 2 teaspoons caster sugar | 1 pinch cayenne powder | 1 lemon, zest of | 2 teaspoons pesto sauce | 1 tablespoon orange zest
instructions: Rinse your fish, pat dry. Score the centre of the fish by taking a sharp knife or knife and cutting straight thru it in a diagonal pattern. This allows the fish to cook through. Cut a crossways slice down the side of the meat aswell. This allows the meat to curl up and into the sauce to coat it evenly. In a small bowl, whisk together the marinade ingredients and set aside while the fish is cooking in a large bowl. Lightly oil a round oven tray, or a grill and put the baking tray on the heat. Place the fish in the oven. Cook the fish from 15 minutes, depending on their size or fish's thickness, or until it flakes easily with a fork, and the flesh is cooked through. The fish should still be slightly firm. It should have a slightly crunchy texture, and the fish should be cooked through. Remove the fish from the oven, drain any excess liquid and set aside. Tear off the hard vein with kitchen scissors and put it in a bowl. Break it up with your finger or your hands if you are really daring and love for it. Put the flesh back in the mixture and mix well until it is well coated in the sauce. Taste to see if you would like some more seasonings. To serve, pour the sauce on or around the fish and put it in the oven to heat through. Serve with steamed couscous and steamed green vegetable, such as runner beans or asparagus sticks.

Random Ingredients: pesto sauce,lamb fillet,porcini mushroom,pea,lemon juice zest
title: Lamb and Peas With Pistou
ingredients: 2 lemons, juice and zest of | 750 g lamb fillets, trimmed of fat and sinew | 3/4 cup frozen peas, thawed in the fridge | 4 tablespoons pesto sauce | 2 tablespoons dried porcini mushrooms
instructions: Preheat oven to 180c. Combine the lemon juice and zest, lamb, peas, pesto and mushrooms in a shallow casserole dish. Spoon over the lemon juice mixture and bake until browned and crusty around the edges, about 1 hour. Serve. Tips. Sara lee.

Random Ingredients: purpose flour,caster sugar,confectioner ' sugar,pork roast,beef chuck roast
title: Roast Sausages
ingredients: 3 lbs pork roast | 1 lb beef chuck roast | 3 tablespoons all-purpose flour, seasoned with | 1 tablespoon caster sugar | confectioners'sugar, extra for dusting
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Toss pork with flour, and sprinkle with sugar, and then place on a rack in a roasting tin, and bake for about 1 1/2 hours until golden brown and quite dry. Slice beef into strips. When cooked, transfer meat to a plate, and slice across at an angle to serve.

title: Coconut Barbecue Burger
ingredients: 200 g sweet hamburger buns | 1 teaspoon ground coriander powder | 0.5 packet instant digestive biscuits | 1 tablespoon poppy seed | 1 tablespoon coconut | 1 tablespoon custard powder
instructions: If not using bought biscuit crumbs, grind together with the coconut and mustard. Combine biscuit crumbs, biscuit mix and coconut mix until it is all combined. Add mustard and other spices and mix well. Grill for 10 mins before taking out of the oven. Serve with a vegetable or chutney of your choice. For vegetarian use coconut milk.

title: Baked Paella With Chicken, Cauliflower and Avocado
ingredients: 4 chicken thighs, skinned & boned | 3 cauliflower florets ( i've made these for the first time and they turned out okay ) | 1 jar toasted sliced almonds or ( 16 ounce ) jar roasted cauliflower flakes | coarse salt or berry salt | 1 package frozen whipped topping, thawed | 1 medium hass avocados or ( 12 ounce ) can other mixed nuts that look like avocados, peeled & halved lengthwise | cooked rice, to serve
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Place chicken on baking pan and pat dry with paper towels. Spread cauliflower in bottom of pan. Top with sliced almonds or the dried flakes of almonds, if using. Bake for 50 - 60 minutes, or until crispy. Sprinkle chicken with salt, if desired. Spoon half the hot liquid from the jar onto a plate. Place half the chicken on top. Add 1/2 the whipped topping. Place on one of the plates. Place remaining chicken on top. Spoon the remainder of the hot liquid over all. Sprinkle remaining whipped topping over the top. Serve hot. Makes approximately servings.

title: Pixie Magic
ingredients: 1 cup couscous | 3/4 cup coconut milk | 1/2 cup wine vinegar | 1 large mushroom, sliced
instructions: Combine all ingredients and let sit to soak up extra liquid. Enjoy, and it's a great lunch.

title: Chunky White Meat Loaf
ingredients: 20 -32 ounces white american cheese, shredded | 20 -32 ounces veal, ground | 20 -40 ounces jalapeno peppers ( pickled hot peppers, pickled salt, or mild salsa of choice are acceptable ) | 5 packages mexican blend cheese, divided
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees fahrenheit. Spray 13x9 inch glass pan with cooking spray. Combine the following seasonings in a large mixing bowl. Stir until well blended. Grate the cheese into the mixture, reserving 2 packages each depending on how much cheese is used. Stir together the cheese, chili peppers, and 2 packages of cheese in a large mixing bowl until the cheese is melted. Gently stir in 3 packages of cheese into the cheese mixture with a large spoon. Pour the remaining cheese mixture into the baking pan. Bake covered for 45 - 60 minutes, or until the loaf is cooked through. Allow the loaf to sit for 15 minutes before cutting into 12 slices.

Random Ingredients: herb,dark sesame oil,salt pepper,golden syrup,fine herb
title: Homemade Sweet Seasoning
ingredients: 12 1/2 teaspoons fine herbs, allspice, chervil, sage, peppercorn, and savory ( or allspice ) | 4 1/4 teaspoons golden syrup ( treacle ) | 1/2 teaspoon salt and pepper, ground | 2 teaspoons dark sesame oil
instructions: Combine all the ingredients with a teaspoon, mixing until you have a thick paste. Store in an airtight container.

title: Crispy Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 lb white button mushrooms | 1 teaspoon cornstarch | 2 teaspoons cornstarch | 1 -2 tablespoon lemon peel, minced
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f, and position rack in bottom third of oven. Grease a 10 x 15 inch jellyroll pan. Place mushrooms on waxed paper and sprinkle with 1 teaspoon cornstarch, 1 teaspoon cornstarch, and 2 teaspoons lemon peel. Bake in preheated oven until mushrooms are golden, 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

title: Grilled Zucchini (Mexican Zucchini) With Sage & Sage Butter
ingredients: 1 zucchini, about 6-8 inches long | 1 tablespoon minced fresh sage
instructions: Cut zucchini into 1/4 inch slices. Brush with sage oil. Arrange zucchini on a grill rack. Grill over medium heat, turning every 2 minutes, until lightly charred and lightly charred, 7 to 10 minutes. Transfer to a platter and tent loosely with foil. Let rest, loosely covered with foil, about 10 minutes so it doesn't break. Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Ham and Prosciutto Subs
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs ham | 3 slices prosciutto | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder | 1 teaspoon worcestershire sauce | 1/2 cup vodka | 1/2 cup parmesan cheese
instructions: Combine all the ingredients, except the cheese, in a medium mixing bowl. Cut ham into strips and then cut across the strips lengthwise. Sprinkle cheese over ham strips. Place 2 strips on an upper shelf of the oven and preheat to 450°f. When pan is about 1/3 full, place ham on one end of a sheet of aluminum foil and spoon some of the liquid on top of the ham. title: Pasta Salad for Two

instructions: Bring a large pan of salted water to the boil and cook the rigatoni for 8 - 10 minutes or until al dente. Drain and allow to cool slightly. Using a fork, whisk together the eggs with the noodles and grapes. Toss with the noodles and egg mixture and serve at room temperature.

title: Simple Vietnamese Ramen Noodle Salad

instructions: Cook ramen noodles according to package directions. Remove from heat and allow to cool. Whisk together the sriracha hot sauce and chopped parsley in a small bowl. When noodles are cooled completely, drain off excess water.

title: Hot Dogs® Easy Lasagna

instructions: In a large bowl, combine triple sec, tomatoes, green chiles, currants and celery salt. Cover.

title: Lettuce in a Panna Cotta
ingredients: 200 g button mushrooms | 20 g unflavoured gelatin | 200 g oatmeal | 1 head romaine lettuce
instructions: First wash the lettuce and dry well. Wash the mushrooms and chop. Set aside so that both the rinsed mushrooms and the water temperature is hot. Soak the gelatin in hot water. The gelatin has two distinct flavours. Drain the gelatin, mix in the oatmeal and then set it aside to rest. Put the mushrooms/water temperature through a medium sized sieve/dressing bowl which has been set. Put the mushrooms of 1/2 inch thickness from the sides of the bowl onto the gelatin. Spread the mushrooms on the outer side of the bowl and refrigerate for 3 hours. After 2 hours, the mixture should be a gooey texture and you should be able to see through. About 20 minutes before the end of the fermentation period, remove the mushrooms from the bowl and let them cool. This should take 3 hours or longer. If you notice the texture is getting too dry, add 1/2 tsp sugar or a drop of water. After 5 hours, remove the mushroom from the bowl. Once everything is completely cooled and ready to use, slice the lettuce into 1 cm slices. To serve, put the sliced mushrooms over the lettuce then add a tbsp of yoghurt or sour cream and serve with rice or pasta.

title: South American Slaw

instructions: Place cabbage in a large bowl. Cover with boiling water and allow to sit for 10 minutes. Drain and remove core, but do not rinse. Wash thoroughly in cold water. Drain, and refrigerate overnight. Crumble hamburger over slaw mixture. Toss the slaw with hands until well coated.

title: Easy Microwave Spaghetti Sauce

instructions: Prepare sauce and pour into a large microwave safe bowl. Microwave on high for 5 minutes.

title: Cabbage-Pecan Salad

instructions: In shallow pan, cover cabbage with water and bring to a boil. Boil about 5 minutes or until cabbage is crisp tender. Drain. Rinse w/cold water, drain well. Shred cabbage and snap peas. instructions: Place bananas in a medium bowl. Sprinkle with lime leaves and toss.

title: Peanut Dipping Sauce With Beef and Chocolate
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs sirloin, thinly sliced | 3/4 teaspoon dark instant coffee | 2 teaspoons soy sauce | 1/4 teaspoon black pepper | 2 tablespoons rice wine vinegar | 1/4 cup creamy peanut butter | 2 tablespoons hot brewed coffee | grated chocolate ( optional )
instructions: Combine marinating sauce ingredients in a small bowl and stir to blend. Set aside. Combine salad ingredients in a small nonreactive bowl and toss gently with the beef and set aside. title: Easy Pita Bread
ingredients: 4 cups of plain bread dough ( i like my pita bread dough-it's quite messy! ) | 2 teaspoons turmeric powder | 1 teaspoon garlic salt | 1 teaspoon sage leaf, crushed
instructions: Separate the dough into 4 equal pieces. Roll each piece into a long rectangle and cut into four pieces at 1 intervals. Make sure you roll each piece thin so it has a thin seal. instructions: For the syrup, in a small bowl, combine the molasses, lime peel, cinnamon and cloves.

title: Simple Broccoli for Tandoori

instructions: Place the broccoli in a steamer basket or colander. Cover and steam over high heat for 3 minutes or until crisp tender. Drain and leave to cool slightly. instructions: Wash kiwifruit, remove pit. Cut in half lengthwise, scrape out the pulp, and scoop out the flesh, leaving kiwifruit chunks on the skin. Place the flesh into a bowl. ingredients: 6 baby carrots, about 2 pounds | 5 pecans | 1/2 cup pecorino romano cheese | 5 fresh chile peppers | 3 teaspoons cumin seeds
instructions: Preheat grill to high. Lightly coat the inside of a small baking pan with cooking spray. Place the carrots on the center rack and sprinkle with 2 tablespoons pecorino romano, 1/2 teaspoon pepper, 2 fresh chile peppers, and 1/2 teaspoon cumin. Grill vegetables 30 seconds to 1 minute on each side, until golden brown.

title: Lazy Mushroom Crostini With Cream
ingredients: 8 ounces sliced bacon | 1 package dried soft ladyfingers | 8 ounces brown button mushrooms, sliced
instructions: Place the mushrooms in a medium bowl. Break up any lumps and add to bowl with the mushrooms. Mix until all ingredients are well coated. Cover and refrigerate 15 minutes. Lightly coat a baking sheet with cooking spray. Heat broiler. Divide the mixture evenly onto the baking sheet and broil 3 - 5 minutes, until puffed and firm. Serve immediately.

title: Easy Swedish Meatballs
ingredients: 1 pound lean ground beef | 1 egg white
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Lightly grease a baking sheet. Place ground beef in a large, deep skillet. Pour egg white into a large bowl and stir until blended. Using hands, gently mix in meat. Roll handful sized meatballs into meatballs. Place meatballs on the prepared baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until the tops are lightly browned, about 30 minutes.

title: Corned Potatoes
ingredients: 5 lbs frozen baking potatoes | 1 1/2 lbs chuck roast
instructions: Cook potatoes according to package directions. Cool completely. When cool, cut into wedges. Cover and refrigerate. Bring back to room temperature before proceeding further. Brown the roast on all sides in a skillet, add the meat, and bring to a boil. Cover. Turn heat to simmer, and simmer until meat is tender, about 4 hours. Serve with mashed potatoes, and fresh vegetables.

Random Ingredients: new mexico chile,beet,cheddar cheese,beef roast,rye bread,asafoetida powder,apricot jam,soy sauce
title: Chiles and Beef Roast With Apricot Glaze
ingredients: 8 large asafoetida powder | 10 dried new mexico chiles or 8 dried taro chiles | 2 cups apricot jam | 1/2 cup reduced-sodium soy sauce | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh thai chile | 2 lbs beef roast, trimmed of excess fat | 6 slices rye bread | 1 cup cheddar cheese, shredded, divided
instructions: In a small bowl, mix the anafoetida powder with warm water and mix thoroughly to combine. Add chiles and let soak in 30 minutes, or longer if desired. For the sauce, place jam in a bowl and slowly stir in soy sauce. Place the beef in a saucepan and pour the glaze over the beef. Cover the pan and simmer over low heat for about 1½ hours, or longer if desired. Transfer the beef and hot sauce to a plate, reserving any sauce. Remove the chiles and discard them. Remove the beef from the hot sauce and shred the meat using two forks. Heat the reserved sauce in a large, heavy skillet over high heat. Remove the pan from the heat and add 1 tablespoon of the shredded beef and the bread slices. Toast until golden, about 2 minutes per side. Spoon the beef onto 4 warm plates and top with shredded cheese.

Random Ingredients: chocolate,currant,beef stock,sharp cheddar cheese,pearl barley,button mushroom
title: Chocolate Beef Barley Beef Soup With Mushrooms
ingredients: 2 cups pearl barley | 1 cup dried button mushroom ( optional ) | 1/2 cup dried currant | 150 ml beef stock | 1 piece unsweetened chocolate | 1 1/2 tablespoons coarsely chopped sharp cheddar cheese
instructions: Place barley, mushrooms, currants and beef stock in a pan and bring to the boil. Reduce heat and simmer 30 - 45 minutes until barley and mushrooms are tender. Finely chop chocolate in a bowl and stir in until melted. To serve, ladle soup with some of hot barley mixture into a bowl. Float cheese on top.

Random Ingredients: green lentil,anaheim chili,vegetable oil cooking spray,leek,lemon
title: Ade Boulettes Y Aneh
ingredients: 1 can green lentils ( or brown lentils ) | 4 -6 leeks, well washed and chopped ( white and some of the green parts ) | 2 lemons | vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 green anaheim chili, seeded and chopped
instructions: Drain lentils in a large saucepan and add 2 or 3 cups of water. Bring to a boil, reduce heat, and simmer slowly to blend flavors, about 30 minutes. Drain. Meanwhile, rinse the leeks in a bowl of boiling water. Drain. Slice leeks crosswise into 1/4 inch slices. Coat leeks with cooking spray, and then line a baking sheet with cooking cheesecloth. Add leeks and chile to lentils, and mix lightly. Place in refrigerator for about 15 minutes, or until flavors blend. Serve warm or cold with a salad or crusty bread.

Random Ingredients: mustard,tomato,plain nonfat yogurt,celery,lemon extract,sherry,red wine,basmati rice
title: Tomato Rice Salad Imlee
ingredients: 3 cups cooked basmati rice, buttered | 1 cup plain nonfat yogurt ( or low-fat greek yogurt ) | 1 teaspoon dried basil, crushed | 1 teaspoon fresh lemon extract | 1/4 teaspoon dry mustard | 1/2 cup dry red wine | 3/4 cup chopped tomato ( about 2 medium ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons bottled dry sherry
instructions: Combine rice and remaining ingredients in large bowl. Add to bowl, making sure rice is completely covered. Refrigerate for at least an hour before serving.

title: Cherry Salmone
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon pure vanilla extract | 1 salmon steak | 2 maraschino cherries, drained | 4 ounces sweet smoked bacon or 4 ounces gouda cheese, shredded
instructions: Dry your salmon on a paper towel for 10 minutes. Pat dry with a paper towel. Sprinkle the salmon with the vanilla, reserving the vanilla. Arrange the salmon on a serving platter. Grate the cheese and sprinkle over the salmon. Garnish with the cherries. Serve warm.

title: Herbed Whole Wheat Pasta
