ingredients: 5 tablespoons whole wheat flour | 1 tablespoon tarragon | 1 tablespoon ground mace | 1 dash chili oil ( optional ) | 6 -7 plum tomatoes ( chopped ) | 1 -2 chinese cabbage ( finely shredded cabbage )
instructions: Combine flour, tarragon, mace, and chili oil or oil and mix. Add tomatoes or cabbage and stir until everything is coated. Let sit in fridge for a minimum of an hour or two. You may also use some canned vegetables such as broccoli, cauliflower etc.

Random Ingredients: chow mein noodle,sherry wine vinegar,green chilies,tomato sauce,red wine,hazelnut,garam masala,rice wine vinegar
title: Chinese Macchiato and Beef Salad
ingredients: 1/2 lb sirloin steak, cut into strips | 1/2 cup rice wine vinegar | 1/2 cup dry sherry wine vinegar | 1 1/2 cups tomato sauce | 1 can diced green chilies, drained | freshly ground almond breeze chow mein noodles | 2 teaspoons garam masala | 1 tablespoon dry roasted hazelnuts
instructions: In a nonreactive saucepan, heat the vinegar and the sherry and heat the mixture until the liquid is reduced by about one third, about 3 to 5 minutes. Add the tomato sauce, the chiles, and 2/3 of the garam masala. Cover, and bring to a boil. Reduce the heat. Simmer the sauce gently, stirring, until thickened, about 5 minutes. Pour the sauce in a large bowl and stir in the nuts. Cover and chill until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: apricot nectar,golden raisin,herb,strawberry,curry leaf,blueberry,flax seed,jumbo shrimp
title: Spicy  Fruit Salad
ingredients: 50 g flax seeds | 20 small raw jumbo shrimp ( peeled ) or 20 small shrimp ( peeled and deveined ) | 25 g golden raisins or 25 g sultanas, halved ( or other golden raisin ) | 2 tablespoons apricot nectar, warmed ( see note 2 ) | fresh mixed herbs, of your choice, chopped or fresh herbs, of your choice, to garnish | 1/3 cup dried apricot nectar, warmed | 20 fresh curry leaves, lightly crushed | 25 g fresh blueberries | fresh strawberries, sliced
instructions: Toast the flax seeds in a hot dry frying pan over medium heat, stirring constantly until lightly toasted. Remove from heat and allow to cool completely. Place the flax seeds in a food processor with the remaining ingredients except the berry berries and strawberries, process until smooth. Toss with berries and chill for an hour or two. Serve with extra salad and a crisp seasonal salad garnish.

title: Spaetzle
ingredients: 1 unbaked pie shell, or as needed | 1 lemon, sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Mix pea pods and enough water to cover with a fork in a saucepan over medium low heat. Bring to a boil, and cook for 2 minutes. Stir in lemon slices. Pour into pastry shell, and bake 20 minutes in the preheated oven until puffed and golden brown, and filling is set.

title: Spicy Fresh Herb Preserve
ingredients: 2 cups fresh thyme sprigs | 1/2 cup fresh lemon juice | 1/8 teaspoon salt & freshly ground black pepper, coarsely ground | 1 lb frozen fat-free topping, thawed
instructions: Rinse thyme and lemon in cool water until all of the water is removed. Cut stems off thyme sprigs. Slice crosswise into 1/8 inch thick slices. Combine remaining ingredients in a bowl, except for last 1/4 cup of the whipped topping. Place remaining 1/2 cup of whipped topping in a shallow dish or dish. Place sprigs in the shallow dish and turn to coat. Cover and chill for up to 3 days. Transfer sprigs to a serving plate. Top with remaining whipped topping.

Random Ingredients: quinoa,tabasco sauce,cardamom pod,white vinegar,thyme sprig,italian tomato,almond,golden syrup
title: A Unique Tomato Quinoa Salad
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa ( about 1.5 cups ) | 3 1/2 tablespoons slivered almonds, toasted | 12 ounces italian stewed tomatoes ( about 2 lbs ) | 2 teaspoons white vinegar | 1 tablespoon sugar ( to taste ) | 2 teaspoons golden syrup | 2 large fresh thyme sprigs | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom pod
instructions: Place quinoa in a medium saucepan and add water to cover. Bring to a boil. Cover, reduce heat to low and simmer until quinoa is tender and water is absorbed, about 30 minutes. Remove from heat and drain in a sieve. Let cool to room temperature. Meanwhile, place the tomatoes in another medium saucepan and toss with the vinegar, sugar, golden syrup and thyme. Cook and stir over medium heat until tomatoes are heated through and beginning to caramelize, 10 to 15 minutes. Cool to room temperature. Stir the quinoa and the roasted almonds into the tomatoes. Pour into a large serving bowl. Season with cardamom, salt, and pepper, to taste. Cover and chill for 1 to 2 hours before serving.

Random Ingredients: hamburger bun,olive oil,shiitake mushroom,tomato soup,filling,key lime
title: Mushroom Filling
ingredients: 12 ounces sliced fresh mushrooms | 1 can condensed tomato soup, undiluted | 2 tablespoons olive oil | 4 hamburger buns | 2 teaspoons crushed key limes | 2 teaspoons thinly sliced fresh shiitake mushrooms
instructions: Heat olive oil in a 10 inch skillet over medium high heat. Sprinkle crushed limes, salt, and pepper to taste, over mushroom.

title: Tuppa Di Fagioli
ingredients: 11 1/4 ounces hot vanilla instant pudding mix | 1 cup farfalle or bow tie pasta, uncooked
instructions: Prepare instant vanilla pudding according to package directions using one cup of water and add pudding to water. Boil water. When boiling stop, add pasta. Continue to boil for 2 - 3 minutes. Do not remove from heat.

title: Chicken and Artichokes
ingredients: 1/2 cup crushed dried bread crumbs | 2 teaspoons ground turmeric | 2 teaspoons mixed spice | 8 ounces chicken wings | 1 can artichoke hearts, drained and chopped | 1/2 cup cornmeal | 1/4 cup peanut oil
instructions: Pour peanut oil into a small skillet, and heat over medium high heat. Mix cornmeal and breadcrumb together in a bowl. Dip chicken wings into the cereal, then coat with cornmeal mixture on both sides.

Random Ingredients: italian parsley,soy sauce,cooking oat,vegetable broth,marjoram,self raising flour,mace,green food coloring
title: Vegan Oatmeal - Microwave
ingredients: 1 cup vegetable broth | 1 cup self raising flour | 2 cups rolled oats | 3 drops green food coloring | 1 teaspoon marjoram | 1/2 teaspoon nutmeg | 1/2 teaspoon mace | 2 teaspoons soy sauce | 2 tablespoons chopped italian parsley
instructions: Combine all ingredients together except for the green food coloring in a shallow microwave safe dish. Add the food coloring to the water and microwave on high for 3 minutes and 30 seconds. Stir well. When half cooked, stir and microwave for another 5 minutes. Stir once or twice so the eggs do not curdle. Cover with plastic and keep in the fridge for up to 6 hours. When ready to serve, stir to mix and serve.

title: Shrimp and Tomato Salad
ingredients: 2 cups diced peeled deveined shrimp | 2 cans san marzano-style tomatoes | 1 1/2 cups prepared dressing | 1 small lime, juiced | 1 tablespoon dried chile powder | chile powder, or as needed
instructions: Mix shrimp, tomatoes, 1 1/2 cups dressing, lime juice, and 1 tablespoon chili powder together in a large bowl. Chill shrimp salad while preparing salad, at least 1 hour. Garnish with chile powder before serving, if desired. Serve with tortilla chips for dipping.

Random Ingredients: eggplant,basil pesto,carb flour tortilla,dark brown sugar
title: Italian Tortilla Chips
ingredients: 1/2 cup reduced-carb flour tortilla | 1/4 cup eggplant ( sliced ) | 1/2 tablespoon basil pesto | 1 tablespoon dark brown sugar ( or to taste )
instructions: Spread pesto on tortilla, on both sides, spread evenly. Sprinkle with brown sugar, on both sides. Serve, enjoy.

title: Roasted Garlic
ingredients: 6 pounds garlic salt | 2 cups liquid smoke, smoke
instructions: Pierce the garlic several times with a fork to remove some of the papery skin. Place the garlic in a large, resealable plastic bag with the liquid smoke. Seal, and massage the bag with your hands until air pockets form. Smash the garlic to release aroma, and allow flavor to mingle. When cool enough to handle, squeeze the cloves into prepared bread and drizzle with reserved liquid smoke. Allow bread to dry in oven, 1 day and 2 days, turning over bread once to dry on all sides. Store in airtight containers.

title: Tasty Frito's
ingredients: 2 large egg yolks, lightly beaten | 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 1 head iceberg lettuce
instructions: Combine the yolks, flour, cumin, and lettuce with water and use until the mixture becomes smooth. Let rest for about 1 hour, refrigerate for the flavors to develop. Divide the mixture into 4 servings and serve.

Random Ingredients: five spice powder,sugar snap pea,puff pastry,green chili,creole seasoning,cottage cheese,thyme leaf,chili oil
title: Easy Cheesy Snack Mix
ingredients: 1 package dry puff pastry | 1 container cottage cheese | 1 package sugar snap peas | 1/2 cup creole seasoning, blend | 2 tablespoons chopped green chili | 1 tablespoon minced fresh thyme leaves | 1 teaspoon five-spice powder | 1/4 teaspoon coarse hot chili oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Line baking sheet with parchment paper. On a lightly floured surface, roll out half of the pastry to an 11 inch circle. Using the 2 inch circle, spread the cottage cheese evenly over the circle. Top cottage cheese with another circle of pastry. Using a fork, prick a bit of the top with a fork all over. Cut a couple slits in the top of the crip with a sharp knife. In a small bowl, combine the sugar snap peas with creole seasoning. Sprinkle chili and thyme over the peas. In a small bowl, combine the five spice powder and oil.

Random Ingredients: sun tomato oil,pappardelle pasta,pecan,cremini mushroom,monterey jack cheese,rice vinegar
title: Sausage and Mushrooms, Stove-Top or Pappardelle
ingredients: 4 -6 cremini mushrooms, sliced | 16 large sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, sliced | 8 ounces monterey jack cheese, shredded | 14 1/2 ounces pappardelle pasta or 14 1/2 ounces other pastas | 1/2 cup light corn oil or 1/2 cup light olive oil | 1/4 cup rice vinegar
instructions: Cook sausage in large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Drain fat. Add mushrooms and sun dried tomatoes and cook 2 minutes per side or until mushrooms soften, turning them several times. Remove from heat. Add cheese and cook until mixture is bubbly and melted. Add pasta to mushrooms. Return to heat and stir well to blend. Toss with vinegar. Cover and chill for 1 hour before serving. Great served with bread, cheese and paprika.

Random Ingredients: beef chuck,deli roast beef,serrano pepper,cool whip,zucchini,cardamom seed
title: Zucchini Beef Salad
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb boneless strip steak | 1 can deli roast beef | 1 cup fresh zucchini ( sliced or diced ) | 1/4 cup fresh serrano pepper ( thinly sliced and seeds removed ) | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom seed | sliced cool whip ( optional )
instructions: Cube cooked meat and set aside. In a bowl combine zucchini, chile, and pepper, add meat/cheese mixture & add just enough cool whip to coat vegetables. If desired chill for at least 8 hours or overnight. Serve with warm french bread.

title: Tartifruit Salad
ingredients: 1 red bell pepper, diced | 1 jar pimientos, drained and chopped | 1 teaspoon seasoning salt or 1 teaspoon white salt | 1 tablespoon firmly packed brown sugar
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine the bell pepper, pimentos and seasoning salt. Stir in the brown sugar until evenly coated. Cover and refrigerate for about 3 hours to develop flavor. Serve on crusty french rolls. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: salt pepper,chocolate curl,bamboo shoot,great northern bean,rump steak,mexican cheese,celery,olive oil
title: St. Paul Beef Casserole
ingredients: 1 lb rump steak, cut into 1 1/2-inch pieces | 1 can great northern beans, undrained | 1 can sliced bamboo shoots, drained and rinsed | 1 cup shredded mexican blend cheese | 1/2 cup chopped celery | 1/2 cup chopped ripe olives with pimentos | salt and pepper | 1 chocolate curls, for garnish
instructions: Preheat oven to in a 3 quart covered casserole dish, combine beans, bamboo shoots, cheese, celery, olives and salt and pepper. Place meat in casserole. Sprinkle with chocolate curls. Bake 45 min or until meat is hot and veggies are tender.

title: Sparkling Peaches & Okra
ingredients: 5 medium peaches, peeled | 2 ounces okra, cut in 1-inch chunks | 1/2 cup watercress, snipped | 1/4 cup grand marnier | 1/2 teaspoon mustard seeds ( optional ) | 1/4 cup ice cube, crushed
instructions: Blanch peaches in boiling water for 30 seconds and remove from the water. Set aside and peel off skins. Cut in wedges and set aside. Bring watercress, okra, grand marnier, mustard seeds and ice to boil. Lower heat and simmer. Serve with peach wedges if desired.

title: Turkish Pasties
ingredients: 2 sheets puff pastry, thawed ( frozen or fresh ) | 1 teaspoon turmeric ( or a few black ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons dry white wine ( i used a little bit sweet sherry ) | 1 small handful sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained and sliced | 1 tablespoon red-wine ( or sherry )
instructions: Set oven to 400°f / 200°c. Cut pastry sheets in half, using a round cutter, to ease out the air space. Cut the pastry into squares. Spread a heaped tablespoon of turmeric over one half of each pastry square. Stir through the rest of the turmeric. Place the edges of the pastry square over the turmeric, forming a border that would lead to the edge. Fold over the pastry on both sides, and press to seal. Wrap the pastry with plastic wrap and chill in the refridgerator for 20 minutes. While pastry is chilling, arrange the sun dried tomatoes on cookie trays lined with parchment. Sprinkle tomatoes with sherry/wine and pinch of salt, and put tray on a cookie tray or baking sheet with dough underneath it. Bake very slowly for 10 minutes, then turn over and bake for a further 10 minutes or until pastry is firm and golden. Remove from oven and cool slightly. Enjoy.

title: Greek Green Green Salad
ingredients: 1 tablespoon fresh baby green | 1/4 cup crumbled feta cheese
instructions: In a salad bowl, toss the baby green with the feta cheese until they are coated. Toss with the salad dressing until the salad dressing is evenly distributed.

title: Spaghetti Cakes
ingredients: 1 package uncooked spaghetti | 1/4 cup hot plain yogurt | 1/4 cup low-fat creme de cacao | 1 tablespoon tamari | 1/2 cup dry bread crumbs
instructions: Cook spaghetti in boiling salted water until al dente, rinse and drain. Combine yogurt, cajun spice, bread crumbs and tamari in a medium bowl and fold well. Roll drained spaghetti into thin patties and refrigerate 8 hours. Dry fry, about 3, in a large skillet, until browned on all sides, about 4 minutes per side.

Random Ingredients: hazelnut,yellow onion,cocoa powder,date,chorizo sausage,cumin powder,white chocolate liqueur,tart apple
title: Chocolate and Apple Casserole
ingredients: 6 ounces white chocolate liqueur | 8 ounces hazelnuts | 4 ounces dates, pitted and chopped | 1/4 cup yellow onion, chopped | 3 tart apples, cored and chopped | 1 teaspoon cocoa powder ( sweetened if necessary ) or 1 teaspoon vanilla extract ( sweetened if necessary ) | 1/4 teaspoon ground cumin powder | 1 ounce white chocolate liqueur
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f. Lightly spray a large shallow baking pan with cooking spray. In a small food processor or blender, grind or chop the chocolate liqueur to a fine powder. Put the chopped hazelnuts in a small bowl. Add the dates, onion, and diced apples to the food processor or blender with the chopped hazelnuts. Puree/blend mixture well. Remove 1 tablespoons of the chocolate mixture. Gently fold in the remainder. Pour mixture into baking pan. Sprinkle over the cocoa/nut mixture. Bake 45 minutes to an hour, or until the apple mixture is the consistency of a custard sauce. Allow to cool.. Melt the white chocolate liqueur in a glass or heat resistant bowl in the microwave according to instructions on your microwave container. Do not cool or boil. Once the chocolate is cool, melt in a bowl in the microwave. Do not boil. Once the chocolate has cooled, stir the chocolate into the chocolate liqueur. Remove one layer of the greased pan from oven. Cover the first layer with the second layer. Remove the top layer and put the chocolate and apple filling in it. Let the layers of chocolate melt slightly, before adding the white chocolate. Keep the white chocolate covered as you go. Cut into squares and enjoy.

title: Dunkin' Good Scones
ingredients: 4 cups cake flour | 1/2 cup sweet and sour mix
instructions: Mix dry ingredients together. Make sure dough gets well mixed all the time. On your counter, mix with hands until dough is evenly floured. Roll into an oval shaped, place on greased cookie sheet and bake at 425 for 15 - 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: cream celery soup,cocoa,thai red chili paste
title: Chile Hot Chocolate II
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of celery soup | 1 teaspoon hot thai red chili paste, or to taste | cocoa, or as needed
instructions: Pour cream of celery soup into a saucepan, and set over medium heat to warm. Stir chili paste with the cream of celery soup into the hot cream of celery soup. Cook and stir until hot chocolate has melted and is no longer cloudy, 5 to 10 minutes. Serve hot with warm coffee biscuits for dipping.

title: Camembert and Scallops With Smoked Salmon
ingredients: 24 cooked scallops | 8 ounces smoked salmon | 4 ounces smoked camembert cheese | paprika, sprinkle | cayenne
instructions: Preheat a grill. Season the scallops with the smoked salmon and sprinkle with smoked camembert. Pile the smoked salmon onto a heat proof platter. Drizzle a few drops of smoked paprika and some cayenne on top of the salmon. Serve with crusty french bread. Note, smoked salmon can be substitued with other smoked smoked meats as suggested by many of the reviewers.

title: Sherry & Thyme Wine
ingredients: 12 fresh thyme sprigs | 24 ounces sweet sherry
instructions: Gently heat the sherry and thyme sprigs together in a saucepan over low heat but do not boil. Remove from heat and strain through a fine sieve and discard the thyme pulp.

Random Ingredients: serrano pepper,broccoli floret,beef sirloin steak,food coloring,dark brown sugar,hamburger
title: Korean Beef and Broccoli
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger | 1 lb sirloin steak, cut into 2-inch pieces | store-bought deli chicken-flavored food coloring | 1 lb fresh broccoli floret | 1 1/2 tablespoons dark brown sugar | 1 serrano pepper, sliced into thin strips
instructions: Cook hamburger, sirloin, and brocolile until cooked. Meanwhile, steam broccoli as per package directions. Remove meat mixture from heat and pour off grease, reserving liquid. Stir brown sugar into reserved liquid in skillet. Pour liquid over steak mixture and toss to coat. Serve over steamed greens.

Random Ingredients: red pepper flake,allspice,corn oil,breadcrumb,chili sauce,pimiento,nonstick cooking spray,salsa verde
title: Mexican Bread
ingredients: 1 tablespoon corn oil | 1 jar salsa verde | 2 tablespoons chili sauce ( mild or medium ) | 1/2 teaspoon chili powder | 1/2 teaspoon allspice | 1/8 teaspoon red pepper flakes ( optional ) | 1/4 cup soft breadcrumbs | nonstick cooking spray
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. In medium saute pan over medium high heat, add oil. When hot add salsa verde, stir and heat for a couple minutes. Stir in the chili sauce, allspice and red pepper flakes. Stir in the crumbs and spray a 9 inch pie plate. Pour in the bread mixture. Spray a little oil onto top. Bake for 25 - 30 minutes until top browns lightly. Note, can be served warm, cold or warm.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon cube,white flour,coffee,beef stew meat
title: Coffee Gravy- Beef Stew, for the Slow Cooker
ingredients: 3 lbs cubed beef stew meat | 1 cup white flour | 1 tablespoon instant coffee | 2 beef bouillon cubes
instructions: Combine flour and 1/2 cup of coffee in mixing bowl. Coat beef pieces with mixture of flour and coffee. Place into the crock pot. Pour remaining coffee mixture over meat, cover and cook on high for 3 hours or low, if desired. Shred meat and serve as a gravy on a bed of hot cooked rice.

title: Chocolate Crunchy Rice With Peas
ingredients: 3/4 cup brown rice | 3 chilies | 1/2 cup roasted peanuts or 1/2 cup pea | 3/4 cup whipping cream | 3 tablespoons chocolate syrup | 1/2 teaspoon sesame seeds
instructions: Cook 2 cups cooked brown rice in 3 cups boiling water over medium high heat, stirring frequently, until no longer cloudy. Drain, reserving 2 1/2 cups of the water in a small bowl, sprinkle remaining 1/2 cup liquid from rice into the brown rice along with the chilies. Set aside about 1/2 cup of the remaining liquid. Drain nuts and coarsely chop, set aside. Whip cream and chocolate syrup, beat until soft peaks form. Fold cream mixture into rice mixture just until combined. Stir in the sesame seeds.

Random Ingredients: pita bread,vanilla extract,sharp cheddar cheese,poblano chile,cauliflower
title: Poblano Cauliflower Pie
ingredients: 1 large cauliflower, chopped | 1 medium poblano chiles or 1 medium other chilies, chopped | 2 tablespoons vanilla extract | 1/4 cup sharp cheddar cheese, grated | 10 pita bread, warmed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400º f. In a 9 inch pie plate, heat the oven to 450º. In a medium saucepan, steam the cauliflower for 5 to 10 minutes. In a food processor, puree the cauliflower with the chilies, vanilla and 1/4 cup of the cheese. Spoon the puree into an 8 inch pie plate. Sprinkle with the remaining cheese and bake, uncovered, for 40 to 45 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Lentil, Ham and Prosciutto Pulled in Crock Pot
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs beef brisket, excess fat removed | 1 can lentils ( rinsed and drained ) | 1 slice prosciutto | 1/4 teaspoon lemon pepper seasoned with salt and pepper seasoning | lentils, sauce for coating, if desired
instructions: Place brisket in bottom of crockpot. In medium bowl, stir together both cans of lentils.

Random Ingredients: shiitake mushroom,sirloin,lamb,lettuce leaf,salt black pepper,cremini mushroom,romaine lettuce,dark chocolate
title: Lamb and Shiitake Mushrooms in Chocolate-Lamb Slice
ingredients: 3/4 cup shiitake mushrooms | 3/4 lb ground lamb | 3/4 lb ground sirloin | 1/4 lb baby portobello mushrooms or 2 crimini mushrooms, sliced | 12 -15 large lettuce leaves ( try the salad in the middle of the leaf ) | 12 -15 large cremini mushrooms, sliced ( i like san marzano ) | 1/4 lb red leaf lettuce ( or other green leaf lettuce ) | grated dark chocolate | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Place shiitake mushrooms in large bowl with 1 inch of water. Soak over medium heat for about 10 minutes. Reserve soaking water then drain liquid and mushrooms from soaking liquid, pressing out any grit. Pat mushrooms dry. Preheat oven to 375°f. In a skillet over medium high heat, add lamb, sirloin and 2 tablespoons soaking soaking water. Cook, stirring, for 20 minutes breaking up meat as it cooks. Stir in reserved soaking water, mushrooms and re season with salt and pepper to taste. Remove mushrooms from skillet and reserve soaking water. Wash green leaf and slice off thick ends. On a lightly oiled baking sheet, arrange lettuce leaves, mushrooms and red leaf lettuce. Garnish with grated chocolate and pinch of salt and pepper.

title: Tandoori Sauce
ingredients: 2 cups plain nonfat yogurt ( dry weight ) | 1/4 cup tahini | 1 1/2 cups tomato sauce | 1 1/2 tablespoons dark rum ( optional ) | 1/4 cup canned tomato pasteurized water
instructions: Whip half the tahini. Add all the remaining ingredients. Mix lightly. Refrigerate for 2 weeks.

Random Ingredients: phyllo pastry,milk,ricotta cheese,italian plum tomato,brown sugar,cracker,cayenne pepper
title: Easy Cheesy Tomato Phyllo Pastries
ingredients: 10 sheets phyllo pastry, thawed if frozen | 1 1/2 cups milk | 1 lb italian plum tomato | 1/2 cup ricotta cheese | 2 teaspoons brown sugar | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper | assorted cracker
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f coat 1 quart casserole dish or baking dish with cooking spray. Combine milk, plum tomato, ricotta, brown sugar and cayenne in a saucepan.

Random Ingredients: beet,granny smith apple,hijiki,orange juice zest,mustard powder,jumbo shrimp,rump steak
title: Beef Kabobs With Apples, Grilled Shrimps and Hijiki
ingredients: 2 lbs jumbo shrimp, peeled | 12 ounces haijiki, julienned | 1 lb granny smith apple, quartered and 1 inch slices | 1 teaspoon mustard powder | 4 medium beets, peeled and cut into half moons | 2 orange zest | 2 teaspoons honey mustard powder | 1 cup orange juice | 1/4 cup coarse mustard powder | 1/4 cup coarse mustard powder
instructions: For marinade, peel and cut jumbo shrimp in half lengthwise and then into 4 pieces. Toss together shrimp and haijiki in a bowl. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate at least 3 hours. For kabobs, add a quartered apple, peeled and sliced beet, orange zest, honey and mustard powder to a blender and puree until smooth. Thread 6 pieces of beef and several pieces of shrimp onto six wooden skewers. Brush with honey mustard and sprinkle with coarse mustard powder. Grill kabobs, 4 at a time, over medium high heat until beef is no longer pink, about 5 - 10 minutes per side. For a bbq, brush oil on cooking grate. Cut the corks from the orange peel and then cut the peel into 1/2 lengths. Cut the remaining two lemons into quarters and place on grilling rack over the grill. Cook the shrimp and beef over medium high heat until browned, about 3 - 4 minutes per side. While this bbq is cooking, turn grill to low. Add horseradish to reserved horseradish, brush on beef, and serve with vegetables.

title: Vegan Pita Bread
ingredients: 1 cup plain oatmeal, whole grain | 1 packet nutritional yeast
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the oats, nutritional yeast and the plain oatmeal and mix together using your hands. Form into 8 patties. Grill for about 5 - 10 minutes, or until cooked through, turning occasionally.

Random Ingredients: kale,garlic clove,rose water,red leaf lettuce,chinese noodle,thyme
title: Chilled Cabbage With Chinese Noodles and Kale
ingredients: 2 -4 large garlic cloves | 1 sprig fresh thyme | 1 head red leaf lettuce, washed and shredded | 1 bunch fresh kale, leaves stripped | 2 tablespoons light rose water | chinese noodles, cook and thawed ( optional )
instructions: Place the garlic, thyme sprig, red leaf lettuce in a large bowl. Tear the lettuce leaves into bite sized pieces and scatter all over the cabbage. Mix well and place in the refrigerator to chill. Drain and use cold water to make the brine for the chilled noodles. Combine the rose water and chinese noodles in a small saucepan and bring to a boil. Pour in the hot brine and let simmer, covered, for 2 - 3 minutes. Remove from the heat, stir well, and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: rye bread,pesto sauce,pecorino romano cheese,gelatin powder,plain flour
title: Pesto Toasted Rye Bread Pudding
ingredients: 1 1/2 slices bread, crusts removed | 2 teaspoons pesto sauce | 2 teaspoons gelatin powder | 1/4 cup plain flour | 1/2 cup pecorino romano cheese, grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 180c. Place the bread in a heatproof bowl or baking paper. Sprinkle with the pesto. In a small saucepan, combine the gelatine powder and warm water. Gradually stir over low heat until the gelatine is dissolved. Bring to the boil then remove from the heat. Pour half of the gelatine mixture over the bread, then sprinkle with half the cheese. Spoon over the pesto. Place in a 200c preheated oven and bake for 20 minutes, or until the centre is just starting to soften. Serve hot.

title: Sage Alfredo Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 cup dark soy sauce | 1/4 cup alfredo sauce | 7 -10 leaves fresh sage
instructions: In a saucepan, combine sesame paste, dark soy sauce and alfredo sauce over medium heat. Bring to a simmer and cook for 5 - 10 minutes until slightly thickened. Add sage leaves. Remove from heat and transfer to a glass jar. Seal well and store in refrigerator.

title: Pork or Nido Filling for meats
ingredients: 1 lb ground veal | 1/4 lb ground veal | 3 tablespoons nido cream or 3 tablespoons milk powder | bean ( to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Mix ground meats thoroughly with salt and milk powder. Use as filling in meat or noodles.

Random Ingredients: pizza crust,coconut milk,egg noodle,no boil lasagna noodle,hot chili powder
title: Hot Coconut Noodles
ingredients: 16 ounces no-boil lasagna noodles | 32 ounces thin no-boil lasagna noodles | 1 can canned unsweetened coconut milk | 1 tablespoon no-boil chili powder | 2 teaspoons hot chili powder
instructions: Pre heat oven to 400 degrees. Prepare pizza crust and place in a 9 x 13 baking dish and bake. Spray pan with nonstick cooking spray. Rinse noodles and drain. Bring a small sauce pan, about 1 can of coconut milk and 1 tablespoon chili powder on medium heat, stirring occasionally until simmering. Add noodles, and stir. Pour noodles and other half of can of coconut milk mixture over all and bring to a simmer for 3 - 5 minutes. Take hot noodle and noodles out of oven and spread noodles on pan. Cover with another 9 x 13 baking pan on top of noodles and top with remaining coconut milk mixture. Bake uncovered for 20 minutes, or until bubbly. Let stand 5 minutes before cutting into squares.

title: Moroccan Spiced Celery Stew
ingredients: 1 cup paprika | 1 cup prepared gravy | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom pod | 1 teaspoon allspice | 1 teaspoon ground mace | 2 celery ribs, finely chopped | 1/2 cup flat leaf parsley, coarsely chopped
instructions: Combine all ingredients in bowl and mix well. Cover and refrigerate 1 hour or overnight to allow flavors to develop.

title: Tandoori Dogs (Indian)
ingredients: 1 package polenta or 1 package quick-cooking polenta | 3 cups finely diced red potatoes | 1/2 cup roasted salted peanuts | 1 tablespoon turmeric | 12 hot dogs or 12 any other type of spicy fry
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Grease a 9x14 inch baking dish. Cut two 12 inch long slits in the polenta with a scissors, cutting in the polenta until each slice is about twice as thick as the package directions indicate. Mix together potatoes, olives, salted peanuts, and turmeric in a large bowl. Make sure mixture is evenly distributed. Add the hot dogs to the prepared baking dish. Spread the potato mixture evenly over the hot dogs. Coat dough in the baking dish. Bake for 30 to 35 minutes, until bubbly.

title: Kitchen Kouture Chipotle Vinaigrette
ingredients: 2 tablespoons chipotle chiles ( i like poblanos brand ) | 2 tablespoons lime juice | 1 tablespoon ground chipotle chile
instructions: Mix all the ingredients thoroughly. Let it sit overnight at room temperature, then shake vigorously until it's totally covered with the vinaigrette. Refrigerate until ready to use.

title: Honeydew and Bean Sprouts Salad
ingredients: 6 -7 ounces dried pasilla chiles, seeded, stemmed, and cut into strips | 2/3 cup honeydew melon, cut into chunks ( about 1/3 ) | 7 large eggs | 3/4 cup assorted fresh bean sprouts ( optional )
instructions: Place all but the egg in a blender or a small saucepan and puree until very smooth. Place in a medium bowl and beat with an electric mixer at high speed until light yellow and thickened, about 5 minutes.

title: Roasted Mushroom & Sourdough Panini
ingredients: 1 loaf sourdough bread | 8 ounces sliced mushrooms | 1 teaspoon red chili pepper flakes
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Split bread diagonally in half lengthwise, and cut along cut sides creating two 10 x 6 inch pieces. Brush each bread half with olive or canola oil. Divide mushrooms evenly between the two pieces of bread, and sprinkle with red chili flakes. Place pieces of bread on baking sheet, and drizzle with a little more olive oil. Bake in a 425 degree oven until bread is lightly toasted and mushrooms have a slightly golden brown color, 10 to 15 minutes. Remove bread from oven, let cool, and cut into 1 1/2 inch pieces.

title: Easy Spicy Chili Tacos
ingredients: 2 cups prepared mild chili sauce | 1/2 cup packed flat leaf parsley | 7 whole cloves | 1 taco shell ( optional )
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine the salsa, parsley and cloves. Place taco shells on a microwave safe plate and cover with a damp paper towel. Microwave the shells on high power, stirring once or twice, for 4 to 5 minutes or until piping hot. Serve the salsa in the taco shells.

title: Mexican Cauliflower
ingredients: 8 ounces pork loin roast ( i use a chuck roast ) | 1/2 cup kraft deluxe velveeta cheese ( or your favorite cheese ) | 1 1/2 cups cauliflower | 1 bell pepper, diced | 2 tablespoons molasses | 2 tablespoons instant coffee ( i use strong brewed ) | 1/2 lb velveeta cheese, cut into cubes | 1/4 cup guacamole
instructions: Place roast in a roasting pan, cover with foil and roast in a pre heated oven for 20 minutes. Meanwhile, prepare cauliflower. Cut the cabbage into medium sized pieces and set aside. Remove the foil from roast, and bake at 400° for 20 minutes. Drain off any excess water. Remove foil, and cut the roast into shreds. Stir the molasses into the cheese and set aside. After 20 minutes, remove the roast, and place in a warm dish. Pour the vacherta over the roast and stir to blend. Add the bell pepper, cauliflower, and pepper, stir well. Return the roast to the oven, and cook an additional 20 minutes or until the cheese is melted and the flavors have combined. Serve with tortillas and guacamole, if desired.

title: Anchovy Pakodums
ingredients: 1 lb extra lean ground beef | 6 anchovies ( roughly chopped ) | 2 tablespoons peanut oil | 1/3 cup chickwheat flour | 1/4 teaspoon coriander powder
instructions: Place all ingredients except oil, flour and coriander powder in a large bowl. Add just enough oil to bind ingredients together in one go. Knead for 8 - 10 minutes pat into an 18 20cm long pattie pattys, then flatten into patties about 2cm wide and 3cm diameter. Heat oil in a heavy based frying pan over medium high heat until a drop of water sizzles around.. Cook patties for 2 mins each side or until patties are browned. Divide between 4 serving plates and scatter with coriander leaves.

Random Ingredients: rotel tomato,fruit syrup,cheese,salt black pepper,baby carrot,yeast,raisin
title: Baby Carrots in Yoghurt
ingredients: 2 packages baby carrots, scrubbed | 3/4 cup raisins | 2 cans rotel tomatoes | 1 1/2 teaspoons instant yeast | 2 1/2 tablespoons fruit syrup | salt & freshly ground black pepper | 1 cup tasty cheese, shredded
instructions: Place the carrots, raisins, rotel, yeast, and enough cold water to reach the top of the jar in a large bowl and stir to combine. Cover with plastic wrap and leave in a light, warm place for 1 hour. After 30 minutes, transfer the contents to an ovenproof bowl, cover, and leave them to rise for 30 more minutes. Preheat the oven to 300 degrees fahrenheit. While the caramelized carrots are rising, place the cheese in a small bowl and mix it with the raisins and juice for 5 minutes, until it become a creamy paste. When the caramelized carrots are ready, transfer to the oven, and bake for 40 minutes, until the top has begun to get crispy. Remove from oven and allow to cool. Serve with extra yoghurt.

title: Hazel and Mango Chicken
ingredients: 4 chicken thighs | 3 tablespoons hazelnut oil | 8 ounces ziti pasta | 8 ounces mango chutney, diced | 1 tart apple | 1/2 cup honey | 1 teaspoon oregano
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Rub the hazelnuts onto the chicken thighs. Sprinkle with the salt. Spray cookie sheet with oil. Place chicken in a single layer and bake in oven for 20 minutes or until cooked through. In a skillet, cook ziti according to directions. Meanwhile, add mango chutney, apple, honey, and oregano to a saucepan and bring to a boil. Pour over chicken and bake for an additional 3 - 5 minutes.

title: Boom Chakalaka: Coconut Burritos
ingredients: 1 cup shredded coconut ( fresh or unsalted ) | 4 whole wheat tortillas
instructions: Grind coconut to a fine powder. Wrap in a damp towel and set aside. Heat a skillet over medium high heat. Tear each tortilla into small pieces. Place one piece in skillet. Cook, turning once, until golden brown on both sides. Turn and lightly brown the other side. Remove to paper towels to drain. Repeat until all the tortillas have been cooked.

title: Pimiento and Cucumber Salad
ingredients: 1 large cucumber | 1 jar pimientos, cut into halves | 1 -2 dry red chili pepper flakes | 1 -2 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda ( optional )
instructions: Wash cucumber under running water. Cut into 3rds lengthwise. Sprinkle with salt, then leave to stand for about 30 minutes to allow the water to drain out. Scrub off the salt, then peel off the outer peel. Slice into half moons. Put cucumber on a large baking tray, then cut into wedges. Sprinkle with pimentos, chili flakes, and bicarb of soda. Bake in oven at 160 degrees celcius for about 1 - 3 - 5 minutes or until all of the liquid has been absorbed.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon cube,artichoke heart,provolone cheese,white cabbage,cheese,oregano leaf,rotel,thai fish sauce
title: Thai Spinach and Artichoke Dip
ingredients: 1 small white cabbage, finely chopped ( or use 2 small regular head cabbage ) | 1 small fresh artichoke heart, finely chopped or 1 -2 teaspoon dried artichoke heart, drained and chopped | 1/4 - 1/3 cup diced roasted peppers or 2 -3 canned rotel | 1 cup of shredded provolone cheese | 1/2 cup fresh grated cheese ( optional ) | 10 slices provolone cheese ( or regular sharp provolone cheese ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons chicken bouillon cubes | 3 tablespoons of thai fish sauce | 1 teaspoon of minced fresh oregano leaves ( optional ) or 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano leaves ( optional ) or 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano ( optional )
instructions: In a food processor add all other ingredients except chicken and oregano or oregano, blend till you a fine puree, it may need a little water or some milk. Place mixture in a bowl with a lid, cover and chill for 2 to 3 hours. Serve with chips and as a wrap with lettuce and chopped onions. I make chicken into a dip by combining a good portion of leftover cooked chicken breast meat and a few chunks of mozzarella cheese into a little patty pan to make the patty patties. I also add some chopped fresh basil.

Random Ingredients: turmeric,yellow pea,no salt tomato,beet,parmesan romano cheese,marshmallow
title: Swiss Pea  With   Beets (    No  Nuts  )
ingredients: 1 lb fresh yellow peas | 4 medium beets | 1/2 cup chopped beets, plus | 1/4 cup chopped yellow peas | 2 tablespoons sliced marshmallows | 3 tablespoons freshly grated parmesan-romano cheese, plus | 1 teaspoon grated parmesan romano cheese, for topping
instructions: Preheat the oven to 475 degrees f. Cut 2 1/2 inch deep slits in the fresh peas. Insert the beets lengthwise into the slits. Spray the peas with cooking spray.

Random Ingredients: oyster sauce,chunky salsa,orange juice concentrate,mint leaf,beef sirloin,cooking spray,broccoli
title: Grilled Beef Sirloin With Fresh Broccoli and Salsa
ingredients: 1 lb boneless beef sirloin, trimmed of fat | 1 1/2 teaspoons minced fresh mint leaves | 1 cup frozen chopped broccoli or 1 cup fresh cauliflower florets, steamed | 2 teaspoons frozen orange juice concentrate | 2 tablespoons chunky salsa | cooking spray | freshly prepared chunky salsa from asian stores
instructions: Cut the beef steak into 1/2 inch thick slices. Combine beef and mint in a shallow dish. Cover and refrigerate 1 hour or longer. Arrange the broccoli and orange juice concentrate over the steak. Prepare an outdoor grill for high heat or preheat broiler in a 425f oven for about 3 minutes in all. Remove cover, and allow broiler to get warm. Cook beef for about 4 minutes on one side. Turn over and cook another 2 - 3 minutes or until meat is cooked to your liking. Serve warm with salsa.

Random Ingredients: red pepper flake,self raising flour,penne pasta,pimiento
title: Pasta With Pimientos and Peppers
ingredients: 6 ounces penne pasta | 1 ounce pimento | 3 ounces self-raising flour | 1 pinch red pepper flakes
instructions: Boil 5oz of water in a large sauce pan, stir, then add your pimentos, pasta and pepper flakes. Meanwhile, pour the flour into a basin, and add a splash of cold water to get a thin paste. Toss the paste into the flour until all coated in the flour. Tip the pasta out of the pan into a colander and dry it. Dive pasta into 3 warmed plates and spoon the vegetables over. Serve with some grated parmesan.

title: Spaghetti Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup chopped of cooked spanish onion | 1 medium spanish onion, chopped | 1/4 cup cooking oil | 3 tablespoons mixed italian herbs ( if available fresh italian herbs will work just be sure to use fresh herbs! )
instructions: Slice all 3 chopped onions. Wash and drain the onion. Melt the oil in a large frying pan. Add the sliced onion. Add the herbs. Mix. Turn down the heat slightly, just enough to slightly thicken. Serve in a hot, sterilized, glass bowl. Use the juice as a base to add to sauces.

Random Ingredients: red chili pepper,mccormick black pepper,chicken bouillon cube,green onion,lettuce leaf,beef,mung bean
title: Spicy Beef and Bean Salad
ingredients: 1 cup mung beans, soaked overnight in plenty of water | 1 lb ground beef | 4 drops red chili pepper | 2 beef bouillon cubes | 2 stalks green onions, sliced | 10 -12 lettuce leaves, torn into pieces | 1 pinch mccormick's montreal brand steak spice
instructions: Soak the mung beans overnight in lots of water. Rinse once or twice. Drain and place in a large pot and add water to cover. You should feel a small amount of water at the bottom of the pot. Boil for about 5 minutes. While the mung beans are boiling, brown the ground beef in a skillet.

Random Ingredients: raisin,red pepper,bamboo skewer,thyme,kaffir lime leaf,saffron thread
title: Tunisian Charred Chicken Kabobs
ingredients: 1/8 teaspoon crushed saffron threads | 1/8 teaspoon dried thyme | 1 1/2 cups fresh bread crumbs or 1 1/2 cups fresh bread crumbs, divided | 2 tablespoons raisins | 2 tablespoons kaffir lime leaves, finely chopped ( or 1/4 tsp. lime zest ) | 1 1/2 lbs chicken tenders, cut into 2-inch pieces ( about 6 inches long ) | 4 bamboo skewers, soaked in water
instructions: Dissolve saffron threads in 1/8 cup bread crumbs in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: meat,graham cracker,molasses,sake,jumbo black olive,spanish onion,browning sauce,vegetable chicken stock
title: Molasses Glazed Oranges With Meat and Rice
ingredients: 6 jumbo black olives, stoned and sliced | 200 g minced lean meat | 1 spanish onion, chopped | 2 teaspoons molasses | 1 teaspoon browning sauce | 4 cups vegetarian brown chicken stock | 100 g parchment paper or 100 g graham crackers, roughly crushed | 100 g mixed shoots natural or 100 g sliced jumbo black olives, stoned and sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 190c/fan 160c/gas toss the meat, onion, molasses, browning sauce and stock together. Cover and refrigerate overnight to marinade. Line a baking tray with a piece of parchment paper or baking paper, and place the soaked or jumbo olives over this and bake for 40 minutes, until the olives have softened. Meanwhile, to make the glaze, place all the ingredients into a large saucepan and boil, stirring continuously for 5 minutes or until thickened. Allow to cool slightly, then whisk or puree them until you have a smooth sauce. Strain the glaze through a fine sieve and set aside, covered, for five minutes. To serve, remove the paper from the parchment on the outside of the plate, then arrange the cooked olives in it on top. Spoon on the glaze, then cut a few slits in the foil to make a small steam vent to allow steam to escape. The glaze can be made up to 2 days ahead, refrigerated, covered.

Random Ingredients: cream chicken soup,olive,beef,tomato soup,beef gravy,balsamic vinegar,toothpick,mustard oil
title: Shredded Meatball Subs
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef ( i like italian style meatballs ) | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1 can condensed beef gravy | 1 can diced tomatoes with tomatoes, undrained | 1/4 cup balsamic vinegar | 1/4 cup prepared mustard oil ( i like prepared mustard, dijon can be substituted ) | toothpick | olive
instructions: Combine beef, chicken soup, beef gravy and tomatoes in crockpot. Cover and cook on low 8 - 10 hours or on high 4 - 5 hrs or until meatballs are done. If you can, leave it all day and it is easier to eat that way,. Serve on hamburger buns cut in half to serve with your favorite sandwich.

Random Ingredients: trout,cauliflower,curry paste,cape gooseberry,egg noodle,beef stew meat
title: Creamy Duck-Turkey Noodle Soup
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds duck meat, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 can whole canned bearled cauliflower, drained | 2 cans condensed beef stew meat, drained | 2 tablespoons mild curry paste | 1 package egg noodles | 3 ounces capellini ( capellini ) noodles | 3 dashes tramarine or slivered almonds, or as needed
instructions: Heat a large pot over medium high heat. Add duck, cauliflower and beef to the pot. Fry until duck is browned, stirring constantly. Pour in the curry paste to the pot and fry until heated, about 2 minutes to flavor the soup. Add the egg noodles, capellini and tramarine. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium low and simmer until egg noodles are tender and soup thickens. Season with pepper before serving.

Random Ingredients: creme de cacao,curry paste,yellow squash,fennel seed
title: Grilled Squash
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon fennel seed | 12 yellow squash | 3 tablespoons curry paste | 1 1/2 ounces creme de cacao
instructions: Toast the fennel seed in skillet over low heat. Watch closely to be sure the fennel doesn't burn. When seeds are roasted and sizzling, remove from heat and grind with a mortar and pestle or a spice mill until coarsely crushed. Cut squash lengthwise down the center. Place squash on a large, heavy duty sheet of foil. Spread a generous teaspoon of curry paste onto each squash piece. Drizzle with a little more curry paste and spread out evenly. Grind more in a clean coffee grinder. Wrap each squash in the foil and place on a wire rack. Let stand at room temperature for 20 minutes. Preheat an outdoor grill for high heat, and lightly oil grate. Discard foil before cooking. Grill squash 2 to 3 minutes per side, until beginning to soften. Turn and grill about 1 minute more, or until squash is tender and grill marks appear. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: snow pea,bay leaf,green curry paste,chive,poblano chile,yellow onion,seasoning salt,italian seasoning
title: Coconut Snow Peas and Snow Peas
ingredients: 1 tablespoon green curry paste | 1 bay leaf | 2 lbs fresh snow pea, 1-2 inch thick trimmed | 1 teaspoon seasoning salt | 7 ounces yellow onions, peeled, cut into 1/2-inch pieces | 1 teaspoon italian seasoning | 1/2 cup fresh chives, trimmed, large stems cut into 1/2-inch pieces | 1 poblano chile, seeded, and cut into 3/8-inch-wide strips | 4 leaves fresh chives
instructions: Heat a large frying pan over medium high heat. Add curry paste and bay leaf, and heat, stirring often, until fragrant, about 2 minutes. Add snow peas and sprinkle with italian seasoning. Reduce heat to medium low, cover and cook, stirring occasionally, until slightly softened, about 5 minutes. Add chives and cook, stirring, until very fragrant, about 1 minute. Remove snow peas from heat, add onion and italian seasoning and toss to mix and evenly distribute vegetables. Serve immediately garnished with chives.

title: Mexican Hot Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup hot sauce ( i use tabasco ) | 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro
instructions: Combine ingredients. Cover and chill.

title: Cashew and Shaoxing Lasagna (Cashew and Shredded Cheese)
ingredients: 1 package lasagna noodles, broken in half | 2/3 cup shaoxing wine | 5 cups cashews, chopped | 1 container shredded carrot ( optional )
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook lasagna noodles in the boiling water, stirring occasionally until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 10 minutes. Drain. In a bowl, mix shaoxing wine with cashews, stirring with a fork to coat. Stir the cashew sauce into the lasagna noodles. Cover and refrigerate.

Random Ingredients: chipotle chile,banana pepper,pie crust,saffron,italian seasoning,black pepper,polish sausage
title: Polish Sausage Stuffed Pizza Strips
ingredients: 8 links polish sausage ( any flavor ) | 1 tablespoon italian seasoning | 1 tablespoon saffron | 1 tablespoon saffron | 2 tablespoons black pepper | 1 tablespoon italian seasoning | 1 tablespoon chipotle chile, diced | 1 tablespoon saffron | 1 tablespoon black pepper | 2 tablespoons italian seasoning | 1 tablespoon chipotle chile, diced | 1 tablespoon black pepper | 1 tablespoon saffron, diced | 2 tablespoons italian seasoning | 1 tablespoon saffron, diced | 4 unbaked pie crusts, for top of crust ( frozen )
instructions: Sausage and sauce, mix all the ingredients in a large bowl. Divide sausage mixture among the 4 pie crusts. Brush the edges of the pie crusts with water, then place the pie crusts together, sealing the edges, and set aside. Preheat the oven to 425°f. Slice the sausage into 1/8 thick slices. Place on a large baking pan, spacing them evenly. Sprinkle sauteed sausage evenly over sausage slices and sprinkle with 1/4 cup of sauteed sausage mixture. Sprinkle 1/4 cup of sauteed sausage mixture over sausage slices. Sprinkle 1/4 cup of sauteed sausage mixture over onion slices. Sprinkle black pepper over sausages. Mix italian seasoning, saffron and 1 tablespoon italian seasoning. Rub evenly on the exposed top of the pie crusts. Sprinkle with 1/4 cup of sauteed sausage mixture. Sprinkle 1 teaspoon italian seasoning over sausage slices. Sprinkle with 1/4 cup of sauteed sausages mixture. Sprinkle 1 teaspoon italian seasoning over onion slices. Sprinkle 1 teaspoon italian seasoning over sausage slices. Sprinkle 1 teaspoon italian seasoning over onion slices. Mix all of the surrounding sausages, and place the pizza mixture on top of the pie crusts. Use a fork to poke holes through the dough to let steam escape. Bake for 25 - 30 minutes. When the pie crusts are baked, brush the tops of the pie with water. Allow to cool while you prepare the pie filling. Spoon the filling into the unbaked pie crusts. Sprinkle the rest of the 1 teaspoon italian seasoning and 1 tablespoon of saffron over top of the pie. Refrigerate overnight. If making for a party, the time to preheat the oven's broiler, and broil the pie until the cheese is bubbly and is lightly browned, about 4 minutes. Watch the baking for the last 2 minutes to ensure even browning of the bottom. Allow the pie to cool before cutting into 12 wedges.

Random Ingredients: mushroom,tart apple,tea,provolone cheese,snow pea,baking soda,orange,italian breadcrumb
title: Mushroom, Apple, and Provolone Cheese Loaf
ingredients: 1/2 cup dried italian breadcrumbs | 1/2 cup dried italian sandwich bun, crushed | 1/2 cup soft fresh tea | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 2 cups shredded round provolone cheese or 2 cups mozzarella cheese | 2 tart apples, peeled, cored, and sliced thin | 2 cups fresh mushrooms, sliced | 2 ears fresh mushrooms ( optional ) | 2 cups fresh orange sections ( optional )
instructions: Heat oven to 350 degrees. Combine bread crumbs, dried italian bread crumbs, cold tea, and baking soda in mixing bowl. Press mixture into bottom and up side of greased 9x13 cake pan. Bake at 350 degrees for 12 minutes. Place sliced apples on top of bread crumb crust. Top with fresh mushrooms, if using. Top with a small amount of orange sections if desired. Bake for 40 minutes until apples are slightly tender in centre, top with shredded cheese, and broil for another 2 minutes. Let stand until cheese is melted.

title: Easy Apple Schnapps
ingredients: 1/4 cup unsweetened applesauce | 1 tablespoon soy sauce | 1 jar maraschino cherries, coarsely chopped
instructions: Combine applesauce, soy sauce and cherries in a small container. Cover and refrigerate for 2 hours or until ready to serve.

title: Beef Stifado
ingredients: 8 ounces ziti pasta, uncooked | 2 lbs stewing beef, trimmed and cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 can diced red tomatoes, undrained | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 1/4 teaspoon allspice | 2 cups half-and-half
instructions: In large pot heat half & half to a boil over medium high heat. Place ziti and stew meat in pot.

title: Marinated bamboo Shoots (Appetizer)
ingredients: 1 can bamboo shoots, drained | 1 cup italian seasoned breadcrumbs
instructions: Drain the bamboo shoots and put them in a small bowl. In another small bowl, mix together the bread crumbs and the italian seasoning until evenly blended. Rinse the drained bamboo shoots under cold running water and pat dry using paper towels. Dry the strips using a paper towel. Dunk them in the seasoned bread crumb mixture, coating all sides. Place in a plastic zip loc bag and marinate in the refrigerator for 2 to 4 hours. Heat the grill to medium high heat. Grill the bamboo strips for 6 to 8 minutes per side, or until nicely browned and tender.

title: Pan-Fried Pork Hocks With Gravlax
ingredients: 1 cup quick-cooking oil | 2 pork hocks | 2 bouillon cubes
instructions: Fill a pot with 2 or 3 inches of water and bring to boil over high heat.

Random Ingredients: mango chutney,fruit,baking powder,beef consomme,ra el hanout spice mix,red food coloring,veal,curry powder
title: Veal, Fruit & Pork Stew from the Freeze Cooker
ingredients: 2 kg lean ground veal | 1 kg ripe mixed fruit | 1 packet of ras el hanout spice mix | 1 jar mango chutney | 1 package curry powder | 2 tablespoons red food coloring | 12 packets beef consomme | 1 packet baking powder | 1 packet mango chutney
instructions: Fry the ground veal with the ras el hanout, curry powder and mango chutney mixture over low heat and cook till the meat is browned and tender. Remove from heat and allow to cool. Add to the meat and mix well. Allow to cool completely and store and refrigerate. Prepare the stew, heat the consomme until it is hot and then add the rest of the ingrediants bring to a boil and then simmer for 10 - 15 minute.

title: Fish in Rice
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs cod or 2 1/2 lbs any other white fish | 1 can french onion soup, undiluted | 1/3 cup soya flour | 1/3 cup whole grain rice | 6 cloves garlic, minced | 5 cups leftover beef, leftover and chopped
instructions: Cook the rice and garlic over medium low heat with 2/3 cup water until done.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon cube,dijon mustard,fruit,jicama,double cream,lemon juice zest,chicken breast,bow tie pasta
title: Dijon Chicken & Jicama With Bow Tie Pasta
ingredients: 500 g bow tie pasta | 3/4 cup dijon mustard | 1 beef bouillon cube | 400 g boneless skinless chicken breasts | 100 g mixed dried fruit | 1 lemon, juice and zest of | 4 tablespoons double cream | 1 lemon, juice of | 1 small jicama, thinly sliced
instructions: Cook pasta acc to directions on the packet. Meanwhile, spray a non stick frypan with the oil and heat. Place the chicken in the prepared pan and cook over a high heat for 3 minutes, turning to brown. Remove the chicken from the pan and set aside. Reduce heat to medium low. Add the lemon juice, zest, worcestershire sauce and bouillion cube. Simmer until reduced by one third. Add the drained pasta to the sauce and stir rapidly until it boils. Add the chicken back into the pan and serve immediately.

title: Brandy Glaze
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 4 ounces brandy, chilled
instructions: Pour the brandy onto the vegetable oil cooking spray and place on the table. This is sold as simply as a spreadable spray for the cooking spray. Brush to the side of the pan using a paper towel. Sprinkle with the brandy until the desired glaze has been achieved. Please note, the oil can be used in place of any other brandy flavored oil such as olive oil.

title: Curried Fish
ingredients: 1 white fish fillet | 3 teaspoons curry powder | 1/3 cup crushed tomatoes ( from a tin ), oil free
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°c. Arrange the fish fillet on a baking tin. Sprinkle over curry powder. Mix crushed tomatoes and oil to make a paste. Spread over the fish. Bake for 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: ra el hanout spice mix,tomato sauce,yellow pepper
title: Moroccan Tomato Sauce
ingredients: 2 large yellow peppers | 1 can tomato sauce | 1/2 teaspoon ras el hanout spice mix
instructions: Roast and peel yellow peppers, slice, and saute in olive oil over medium heat until it is skin begins to char, about 8 - 10 minutes. Move peppers to sides of skillet and sprinkle with ras el hanout and continue cooking until peppers are tender and dry and lightly browned, about 10 minutes. Drain off excess fat. Add tomato sauce and bring to boil over medium heat. Serve hot or let cool in refrigerator for 1 hour.

title: Spicy Refried Refried Beans
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 2 cups cooked beans sprouts | 12 scallions, thinly sliced ( green parts only ) | picante sauce
instructions: Heat the sesame oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Add the beans and green onion and stir to coat in the oil. Cook and stir constantly for 3 minutes or until the beans begin to lightly brown. Add the picante sauce.

Random Ingredients: chocolate,dumpling wrapper,filet mignon,pineapple chunk,plain nonfat yogurt,palm sugar
title: Shahi Tukray (Shahi Tukray)
ingredients: 1 1/3 cups reduced-fat plain nonfat yogurt | 1/4 cup unsweetened crushed pineapple chunks | 1/2 cup dried nonfat yogurt | 1/4 cup chopped palm sugar | 1 large shahi tukray | 7 dumpling wrappers | 1 cup shaved semisweet chocolate
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Coat a baking sheet with cooking spray. In a medium bowl, mix together the nonfat yogurt, pineapple, and 1/4 cup of the sugar until well combined. Place the shahi tukray in the yogurt mixture and gently fold until covered. Place the dumpling wrappers on the prepared baking sheet. Brush with more cooking spray and spread the pineapple slices onto them along with the shaved chocolate. Bake for 12 to 15 minutes in the preheated oven, until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: mccormick taco seasoning,black bean,white pepper,cherry tomato,lamb shank
title: Slow Cooker Lamb Shanks
ingredients: 1 cup dry black beans | 1 can white beans or ( 16 ounce ) can kidney beans, drained | 14 ounces lamb shanks, with some fat, frozen in bag | 1/4 teaspoon browning seasoning ( or 1/8 t seasoning mix ) | 1/8 teaspoon white pepper
instructions: Put black beans into crockpot. Add white beans, lamb fat, browning salt, white pepper and mix well. Put the bag on top ensuring it fits snugly in the bottom or you may not even need to use much of the fat, as it will be cooking more in the oven so just check after 5 - 7 hours. Turn crockpot to high and let slow cook for atleast 6 - 8 hours, depending on size of crockpot and size of shanks.

title: Grilled Peaches and Sausage
ingredients: 6 slices kielbasa | 2 peaches | ice cube | 1 dash chocolate, garnish
instructions: Place sausage in a medium size skillet and cover with water. Add ice in skillet according to instructions, cook until tender, remove from skillet and slice into half moons. Remove sausage from water. Cut peaches and sausage into slices. Cut remaining two quarters pineapple rings in half and arrange on a plate decorated with a candy sprinkle.

Random Ingredients: celery rib,hot red pepper flake,yellow wax bean
title: Pinchos
ingredients: 1 lb yellow wax beans, washed | 1 celery rib, washed | hot red pepper flakes, to taste
instructions: The best way to make these is to boil them overnight and then cook them. They're done when they float to the surface. You can boil them longer in water if you like, but they'll be done if the water goes out. They're perfect when they're not tough or gooey. So, a small pan canola oil will do the trick.

title: Tomato-Sweet Ricotta Pie
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dark brown sugar | 3 tablespoons chives, chopped | 3 tablespoons ricotta cheese | 1 2/3 cups fresh ricotta cheese, well drained | 4 -5 tablespoons ice
instructions: Put the oven at 180° c. Sprinkle the sugar and chives into the bowl of a food processor bowl. Process in the ricotta until smooth. Add the ice. Turn it onto a floured surface and use your fingertips to press the mixture well into the bottom and around the sides of a shallow ovenproof dish.. Spread the cheese over the crust, smoothing it slightly. Bake for about 30 minutes. Cool slightly and cut into squares. Serve.

title: Baked Ziti
ingredients: 1 lb ziti pasta | 2 cans tomato ketchup | 2 cups water
instructions: Preheat oven to 500°f. Place cooked ziti in a baking dish lined with parchment paper. Mix ketchup and water in a small saucepot and bring to a boil. Add ketchup mixture to prepared pasta. Bake uncovered for 15 minutes until ziti is done. This is not a baking dish but a little crisp. Allow to sit for 5 minutes before cutting into squares and eat with a nice salad with slices of bread.

Random Ingredients: celery seed,celeriac,baby lima bean,orange zest,self rising flour,green chilies,pistachio
title: Curried Lima Beans
ingredients: 2 cups frozen baby lima beans, thawed | 1 cup shredded celeriac | 1 cup shelled pistachios | 1/4 cup green chilies, chopped | 1/3 cup fresh orange zest, zested | 1/2 teaspoon celery seed, ground | 1/4 cup self-rising flour
instructions: Place lima beans, celeriac, pistachios, chilies, orange zest, celery seed, flour, and orange zest into a food processor. Process until combined.

title: Easy Chocolate Curd
ingredients: 1 can condensed milk powder | 1 teaspoon curry powder | 3/4 cup milk | 1/2 cup cubed bacon | 1 pinch ground coriander
instructions: Mix the condensed milk powder, curry powder, milk, bacon, and coriander with a fork in a microwave safe dish. Cover and cook in the microwave for about 8 minutes, until the mixture is creamy.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray,sherry wine,oat,cream coconut,almond,pistachio,peanut
title: Pistachio Pudding With Coconut-Almond Sauce
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups reduced-fat sour cream or 1 1/4 cups coconut cream | 1 1/2 tablespoons chopped unsalted shelled pistachios, toasted | 3/4 cup toasted almond, finely chopped | 1/4 cup blanched almond, coarsely chopped | 1/4 cup whole milk chocolate or 1/4 cup peanut butter | 1/2 cup sherry wine ( i use sweet rice wine ) | vegetable oil cooking spray | 3 tablespoons unsalted pistachios, chopped
instructions: Combine sour cream and 1/4 cup pistachios in a small bowl. Cover and refrigerate until ready to use. Meanwhile, combine almonds and remaining pistachios in a medium size shallow baking dish. Heat oven to 400 degrees. Spread almonds on a baking sheet. Bake for 8 - 10 minutes, until pale golden. Spread nuts on baking sheet and toast until lightly browned, stirring frequently, about 5 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, transfer nuts to a large bowl. Melt remaining 2 tablespoons of pistachios in top of double boiler on medium heat until golden. Remove from heat. Add sherry, 1 tablespoon sour cream, and 1 tablespoon each of pistachio and almonds. Season with salt and pepper. Spoon the pudding into large serving bowl. Place remaining 3 tablespoons sour cream mixture in small saucepan. Heat over medium heat, stirring constantly until mixture comes to a boil and thickens slightly. Cool and chill pudding, stirring occasionally. Heat remaining 2 tablespoons of pistachios in small pan until lightly browned. Cool and serve warm with warm sour cream mixture.

Random Ingredients: black bean,mix,cashew nut,shrimp paste,salt pork,pork tenderloin,dill
title: Korean Grilled Pork-Shrimp Patties
ingredients: 1 tablespoon shrimp paste | 3/4 lb pork tenderloin ( or other lean pork ) | 3/4 lb shrimp-free range imitation crab-sized pieces ( not in season pkg ) or 3/4 lb crab-sized shrimp ( not in season pkg ) | 1/4 cup black olives with cashews | 4 tablespoons prepared sweet-and-sour mix | 1/2 cup dry-roasted salted peanut butter ( for dipping ) | 2 tablespoons dill, chiffonade
instructions: Soak shrimp paste or shrimp in warm water to cover until white. Remove pork from bowl and pat dry. Slice shrimp into very thin strips, about 2 - 3 inches long and 1 wide. Dredge shrimp or crab in shrimp paste/seafood mixture and then set aside. Prepare all meats except pork. Drain marinade from shrimp and shrimp paste. Place meat in an air tight container and refrigerate for up to 2 days. Combine prepared sweet & sour mix, black olives, and salted peanuts in a shallow dish. Cover meat with sweet & sour mix, then marinate meat in refrigerator for up to 6 hours. Prepare pork kebabs with your favorite dipping sauce, if desired. Dip each kebab or shrimp onto heated grill in sauce for about 3 - 4 minutes per side, or just until nicely caramelized and crispy. Remove from grill and sprinkle with dill.

title: Easy Easy Tiramisu
ingredients: 2 packages ladyfingers | cooking spray | 1 cup icing sugar | 2 tablespoons icing sugar
instructions: Prepare pan by covering bottom with cooking spray. Lay one ladyfinger on bottom half of pan. Coat with icing sugar. Lay another ladyfinger on top. Spread with 1 1/2 tbsp icing sugar. Cut into 4 squares.

title: Dukkah
ingredients: 12 dried scotch bonnet peppers | 2 cans whole kernel sweet corn, drained | 1 1/2 cups finely chopped fresh dill | 1 clove garlic, minced | 2 teaspoons chili paste with seeds
instructions: Cut stems off whole peppers and remove seeds. Stuff each with a little of the dill, then stuff with half of the scotch bonnet peppers. Set aside in refrigerator for a few hours, to draw out the aroma. Meanwhile, combine remaining ingredients in bowl and pour over the peppers in the bowl. Cover bowl and refrigerate for at least 3 hours or up to 4 days to allow flavors to blend. Serve on paper or chapatis with dill.

title: The Best Ginger Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup soy sauce | 2 cups coconut oil | 3/4 cup grated fresh ginger root
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix together soy sauce and coconut oil. Stir in grated ginger. Refrigerate for at least one hour.

title: Leek, Almond, and Almond Biscotti
ingredients: 1 teaspoon baking powder | 1 leek | 2 tablespoons slivered almonds, toasted
instructions: In a small saucepan, place leek and 2 tablespoons of salted water. Bring to a boil. Once boiling, immediately remove from heat. Cover and let sit for 2 1/2 minutes. Drain well. Place in a bowl, cover and set aside. Mince the leeks and lightly brown in a large skillet. Remove from heat. Combine leek mixture with baking powder. Separately, place almonds and almonds in a food processor or blender and process until finely ground. Add to leek mixture and mix well. Form mixture into a log about 2 inches in diameter and the shape of a large orange. Place log on an ungreased baking sheet. Using a fork, lightly press a few slits into side. Bake in a 400 degree f oven 15 to 20 minutes. Cool slightly, slice crosswise into 1/4 inch thick slices.

Random Ingredients: dark molasses,seasoning salt,graham cracker crumb,rice,beef sirloin,rosemary sprig,greek yogurt
title: Yogurt Grilled Beef Rissoles
ingredients: 1 beef top sirloin | 1/4 cup plain extra light greek yogurt | 1 tablespoon dark molasses | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1/2 teaspoon dried rosemary sprig | 1 tablespoon graham cracker crumbs | cooked rice
instructions: Make the rub by combining yogurt, molasses, seasoned salt, rosemary, and graham cracker crumbs in a small bowl. Set aside. Slice the beef into thin strips. Combine the beef and yogurt mixture in a resealable plastic bag, seal, and massage into the meat. Allow to marinate at least 5 hours, but overnight also makes a great filling for sandwiches.

Random Ingredients: lemon thyme,vol au vent case,ale,salt pepper,russet potato,fillet red snapper,red wine vinegar,garlic salt
title: Red Snapper Vol-Au-Vent
ingredients: 1/2 cup ale | 1 teaspoon red wine vinegar | 2 cloves garlic salt | 3 tablespoons lemon thyme | 2 fillets red snapper | salt and pepper to taste | 6 russet potatoes, peeled and cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 20 large vol-au-vent cases
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. To make ale vinegar sauce, combine ale, vinegar, garlic salt, lemon thyme and salt and pepper in small bowl. Place fish, skin side down, on rimmed baking sheet and drizzle with half of the prepared blue vinegar sauce. Arrange under broiler until skin is bubbly, about 5 minutes. Turn fish.

Random Ingredients: black olive,green olive,ginger,bell pepper,pork loin roast,pineapple juice,red pepper flake,deli ham
title: Caribbean BBQ Pork Loin Sandwich
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 lbs pork loin roast | 1 fresh pineapple, juice of, if possible | 1 green olive ( optional ) | 1 red pepper, chopped | 1/4 cup black olives ( optional ) | 1/4 cup sweet bell pepper ( optional ) | 4 tablespoons sliced ginger ( optional ) | 2 pinches crushed red pepper flakes ( optional ) | 2 slices deli ham ( optional )
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and put meat in ziplock bag, pour some of the marinade down the side. Seal and let marinade for at least 1 hour. Shake out any excess marinade and grill on bbq until done. Grill with a lid or outside of wrap for 10 - 15 minutes. Slice meat on the diagonal into thin shreds. If you want a thicker sandwich, heat the sliced deli ham on the grill, or if preferred, slice meat on the diagonal. Serve with pineapple, sweet pepper sauce or salsa.

title: Easy and Tasty Quinoa Pilaf
ingredients: 1 cup long grain converted quinoa | 1 cup yellow squash, sliced | 2 1/2 quarts chicken broth
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a medium stockpot. Bring to boil and stir. Cover and reduce heat to low and simmer for 30 - 40 minutes or until quinoa is cooked. Enjoy.

title: Rooibos Parsnips
ingredients: 2 medium parsnips, peeled, then cut into chunks | 16 -20 sprigs fresh coriander, tied with a string | 1 - 1 1/4 teaspoon powdered orange peel ( optional ) | white rice ( optional )
instructions: Steam the parsnips until done. Drain and set aside. Place the coriander sprigs in a small bowl. Put the washed parsnips and some water in a large saucepan. Cover, and bring to boil. Stir. Turn down heat, and cover. Cook the parsnips 5 to 10 minutes, or until cooked through. Remove from heat, and mix in all the orange peel. Cover, and let sit 5 minutes. Remove the coriander and peel. Serve over white rice..

Random Ingredients: brandy,chicken bouillon granule,ladyfinger,cognac,double cream heavy,veal,basil leaf
title: Veal Delight
ingredients: 300 g veal, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1/2 cup double cream or 1/2 cup heavy cream | 2 tablespoons brandy | 2 teaspoons chicken bouillon granules | 1 teaspoon chopped basil leaves or 1 teaspoon chopped cilantro | 1 pinch dried oregano leaves or 1 pinch dried basil leaves | 250 g ladyfingers
instructions: Preheat oven on 175°c. Combine cream, brandy, bouillon and seasonings in a small bowl. Spread 1 - 2 tbsp of cream mixture into a shallow ovenproof dish. Arrange half the veg in dish. Press cut veg into cream mixture around meat ensuring it is well coated. Cover with pastry cloth and place on a baking tray lined with parchment paper. Bake 25 - 30 minutes or until pastry is crisp and custard is set. Prepare remaining veg for topping. Serve hot and drizzling rosemary, mint or chives over veg.

title: Acorn Squash in Microwave
ingredients: 1 small acorn squash, halved with pits removed | 2 teaspoons finely grated lemon zest | 1 tablespoon grenadine
instructions: Place squash cut side up on a microwave safe plate. Sprinkle with lemon zest and sprinkle with grenadine.

Random Ingredients: sesame oil,pepper sauce,spaghetti sauce,sharp cheddar cheese,beef tenderloin,cream cheese,apple cider
title: Crispy Slurpee
ingredients: 1/2 lb beef tenderloin, thinly sliced ( or other leaner cut ) | 2 ounces cream cheese, room temp | 8 tablespoons spaghetti sauce ( any flavor ) | 2 tablespoons sesame oil | 1/2 cup sharp cheddar cheese, grated | 1/2 cup apple cider | 8 drops hot pepper sauce ( to taste )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Spray a large, heavy baking tray with cooking spray. Toss the beef with the cream cheese until it is evenly coated. Spread the cream cheese in a layer over the beef. Spread the spaghetti sauce over the cream cheese. Drizzle the sesame oil on top. Sprinkle the cheddar cheese evenly on top. Drizzle the apple cider on top. Sprinkle on the hot sauce. Bake the meat for about 30 minutes or until browned and bubbly.

title: Mock Sushi (Tsukune) (Nori Roll)
ingredients: 4 sheets nori, cut in half | 4 ounces ground turkey breast | 4 ounces tea
instructions: In a shallow bowl, mix together the turkey and tea. Break the nori sheets into pieces about the size of a cone. Place a rounded teaspoon of mixture onto each nori sheet, roll up, slice each roll into 8 slices lengthwise.

Random Ingredients: baby spinach,lemon,grape tomato,chicken thigh,chicken bouillon cube
title: Cousin Pete's Simple and Delicious Chicken Tagine
ingredients: 2 chicken thighs | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 1 lemon, juice of | 1 -2 grape tomatoes, halved | baby spinach
instructions: Pour some chicken stock into a medium size saucepan. Add the bouillon cube and boil for a minute, then stir in the lemon juice. Take the pan off the flame. Tuck the bag of spinach into to the cousin Pete's basket. Carefully add the tomatoes into the pan, around the chicken. Turn off the oven. Leave the lid on, just slightly warm, and leave for a couple of minutes so the steam goes through the tomatoes. This can also be done in a microwave, if you have a microwave safe bowl, but it becomes quite easy the second day if you do that. When the tomatoes start to soften, throw the spinach over and mix with a fork. Cover and leave for five to ten minutes so the spinach begins to wilt. This has the effect from cooking over heat at a low heat so the tomatoes don’t burn.

Random Ingredients: extra virgin olive oil,turnip,szechwan pepper,pepperoni,sultana,swiss cheese,manicotti
title: Grilled Cheese Turnips With Chive & Sultanas over Rice and Cheese
ingredients: 12 ounces swiss cheese, in 4 pieces, room temperature | 3 tablespoons sultanas, roughly chopped | 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil | 2 large turnips, scrubbed, peeled, coarsely grated and soaked in | 3/4 cup strong fresh manicotti | 1/4 teaspoon szechwan pepper | 1/8 teaspoon fresh ground pepperoni
instructions: Preheat grill to high. Combine cheese, sultanas, olive oil, turnips, manicotti and szechwan pepper in a large bowl and mix well. Lightly oil grate and preheat charcoal barbecue or broiler to high. Transfer turnip mixture to grill. Cook until turnips are deep golden brown, about 25 minutes. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: chicken stuffing mix,sea salt,japanese sushi rice
title: Sushi Rolls
ingredients: 1 package japanese-style sushi rice, or more to taste | 1 package precooked chicken stuffing mix | 1 pinch sea salt
instructions: Place rice and chicken stuffing mix into a bowl.

title: Garlic Soup - Japanese Style
ingredients: 1 loaf frozen bread | 3 cups beef broth, any flavor you prefer | 2 teaspoons fresh garlic, minced | 2 sheets nori, seaweed sheets
instructions: Thaw bread in refrigerator until completely defrosted. Cut out the crust. Remove bread slices from freezer before slicing thin. Pour beef broth into large soup crockpot or crockpot. Add salt and garlic. Cover and cook on medium heat for 4 - 5 hours, stirring frequently. Remove cloves of garlic. Tear bread into bite sized pieces and place to dip and serve at once.

title: Grilled Zucchini Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 zucchini - peeled, halved lengthwise and cut into 1/4-inch slices | 12 slices french bread
instructions: Soak the zucchini slices in water for 15 to 20 minutes. Lightly oil the grill. Arrange 1/4 slices of cheese on a slice of french bread. Top with 2 to 3 slices of zucchini. Grill the slices until nicely browned. Repeat, until all of the slices are grilled. Allow to rest for 2 minutes before serving.

title: Beer and Beef Nachos
ingredients: 2 lbs skirt steaks, trimmed | 2 medium limes, halved | 1 can old el paso dark beer | 12 ounces picante sauce | 1/4 cup fresh ground pepper | 1 bag doritos, broken
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°. Place steak in large nonstick skillet. Squeeze juice from 2 limes over meat.

Random Ingredients: coffee,cocoa,extra virgin olive oil,corn tortilla chip,spaghetti sauce
title: Mexican Hot Chocolate
ingredients: 1 teaspoon extra virgin olive oil | 1/2 ounce spaghetti sauce | 1/4 ounce cocoa | 1 ounce coffee ( not sweetened ) | 12 -14 slices corn tortilla chips, 1-inch ( or flour )
instructions: In a small saucepan over medium heat, warm oil. Add spaghetti sauce, cocoa and coffee and mix. Remove from heat and add chips. Stir until chips are fully melted and combined.

Random Ingredients: bow tie pasta,saltine cracker,ginger,chili pepper,green pepper,chocolate
title: Chocolate-Ginger Pasta
ingredients: 8 ounces bow tie pasta, cooked and drained | 8 ounces chocloghtro's sliced chocolate | 3 green peppers, sliced | 1 chili pepper, sliced | 8 saltine crackers | 1 slice ginger, chopped
instructions: Put all ingredients except crackers in a microwaveable bowl and microwave on high for 4 minutes. Stir well. Spoon into serving bowl, add crackers to garnish.

title: Pasta With Cod and Tomatoes
ingredients: 14 ounces rotini pasta, cooked al dente | 1 lb cod ( or other thick firm white fish ) | 1 teaspoon dried italian herbs ( or 2 tablespoons fresh thyme or 1 2 tbsp fresh oregano ) | 4 -6 tablespoons capers, drained | 1 small red peppers or 1 small cayenne pepper, chopped
instructions: Remove from heat and allow to cool slightly. Slice cod into bite sized pieces. Cook cod in 2 tb olive oil over medium high heat until cooked though, about 3 minutes, flipping once. Remove cod from skillet, drain and set aside or cover with a towel for about 5 - 6 minutes to get rid of any excess moisture. Drain off any excess oil if desired, stir in remaining ingredients or use pasta for dipping. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: extra wide egg noodle,broth,chili pepper flake,romano cheese,orange,parmesan cheese,chili oil
title: Broccoli 'n Noodle Noodle Soup
ingredients: 6 cups broth | 1 cup extra wide egg noodles | 1/2 cup chili oil | 2/3 cup grated parmesan cheese | 2 tablespoons grated romano cheese | 1 tablespoon chili powder flakes | 1 tablespoon orange rind, grated | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh chili peppers ( optional ) or 2 tablespoons red chili peppers
instructions: Heat broth in medium dutch oven to simmer over medium high heat. Stir in noodles. Cover and cook 8 to 10 minutes or until noodles are tender. Drain well. Return noodles, broth, oil, parmesan cheese, romano cheese, chili powder and orange rind to broth. Stir.

Random Ingredients: superfine sugar,onion flake,wine vinegar,meat,monterey jack cheese,ice cube,pickle,oyster sauce
title: Chef John's Beef and Onions (Mongolian Style)
ingredients: 8 cups ice cubes | 1/2 pound lean ground meat | 1 tablespoon instant onion flakes, minced | 1 cup shredded monterey jack cheese | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 1 tablespoon hot wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon oyster sauce | 1 tablespoon granulated superfine sugar
instructions: Place 4 cups ice cubes in a deep bowl. Scatter the ground meat over the ice.

title: Spicy Polish Kielbasa
ingredients: 1 package smoked kielbasa, cut in half diagonally | 1 1/2 cups uncooked couscous | 1/2 teaspoon tabasco sauce
instructions: Bring 3 quarts water and kielbasa to a boil in a saucepan. Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, until tender and beginning to brown, 5 to 10 minutes. Fluff with a fork.
