Preheat oven broiler. Spray a 9x13 inch baking dish with nonstick cooking spray. Stir couscous and hot sausage in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: yellow onion,plain yogurt,curry paste,irish whiskey,cauliflower floret
title: Curried Cauliflower
ingredients: 1 teaspoon curry paste | 1 medium yellow onion, finely chopped | 1 1/4 cups cauliflower florets, finely chopped | 1 1/4 cups low-fat plain yogurt | 1/2 teaspoon irish whiskey ( optional )
instructions: In a large nonstick frying pan, over medium heat, cook curry paste, stirring, about 2 minutes or until fragrant. Stir in onion. Cook 2 minutes or until onion is soft. Add cauliflower and stir to coat. Cover pan. Cook 1 minute more or until cauliflower is lightly browned. Drain cauliflower and transfer to a serving bowl. Stir in yogurt and whiskey. Cover and refrigerate at least 30 minutes or up to 3 hours before serving. Serve immediately.

title: Pumpkin Nuggets
ingredients: 1 medium pumpkin, weighing about 3 lbs | maple syrup
instructions: Wash your pumpkin and remove the skins if they are a bit on the outside and don't want to give the pumpkin any more than 1 1/2 inches long. Score the inside of the pumpkin with a sharp knife. Place the peeled pumpkin in a deep pot, about 2 liters or a little over a big one. Fill the pumpkin with enough water so that the water level measures about one inch above the pumpkin.

title: Easy Asian Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 package uncooked farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta | 2 tablespoons brown sugar | 10 skewers | 2 pounds boneless pork shoulder, cubed | 12 cherry tomatoes, halved | 7 cups shredded lettuce leaves
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

Random Ingredients: oil,shrimp,vanilla bean,white poppy seed,chipotle chile adobo
title: Poppy Seed Chips
ingredients: 1 package white poppy seeds | 2 tablespoons dried chipotle chiles in adobo, finely minced | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla bean, scraped and crushed | 2 lbs shrimp, shelled and deveined | oil, for deep-frying
instructions: In a shallow tray or dish, combine poppy seeds, chili flakes and vanilla bean and coat shrimp. Heat oil in a large heavy based frying pan or wok over moderate heat until hot but not smoking. Fry shrimp for about 3 minutes each side or until golden. Drain, transfer to paper towels to drain excess oil and set aside. Repeat with remaining ingredients. Serve with chips.

title: Brandied Rice
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups long grain rice | brandy ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. In a large bowl add the rice and brandy. Add water, stir and cover tightly. Place in oven and bake for 1 hr 45 mins, stir now and again. Turn oven off and let rice dry out of oven for 15 minutes. Serve.

Random Ingredients: button mushroom,beef liver,snow pea,orange,onion powder,ginger root
title: Orange Ginger Pot Roast
ingredients: 1 small orange, sliced | 1 small onion, sliced | 1 pound beef liver, cut into slices | 1 tablespoon fresh ginger root, sliced | 1/2 teaspoon onion powder, or to taste | 1 package button mushrooms | 1/2 cup snow peas, or to taste
instructions: Cut rind from orange and place orange slices in an uncovered bowl. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate until thoroughly chilled, at least 1 hour. Remove orange with a slotted spoon. Discard rind, slice into thin strips, and place in a resealable plastic bag. Heat a skillet over medium high heat. Cook and stir ginger in the hot skillet until fragrant and beginning to flake, about 1 minute. Remove ginger and discard. Stir onion powder and remaining orange slices in hot skillet with any juice. Cook and stir until soft, 1 to 2 minutes. Remove meat and set aside. Stir mushrooms into sausage mixture.

title: Szechwan Olives
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs green olives ( if they are pitted, soak in cold water for about 10 15 minutes ) | 1/3 cup szechwan chili sauce
instructions: Drain olives and transfer to a bowl. Add chili sauce and mix well. Cover and refrigerate, stirring occasionally, until serving time.

title: Australian Bean Dip
ingredients: 1 kg drained canned kidney beans | 250 g corn or 250 g frozen corn | 1 jar sliced peaches | 250 g cooked large shrimp | 1 1/2 cups double cream | salt | pepper
instructions: Mash the following together. Slice a cup of the peaches and reserve whole. Mix the two with the chopped bean and peas. Whisk the double cream together with a pinch of salt and pepper to taste until thick and creamy. Spoon into serving glasses, top with half the bean dip and scatter with reserved peaches and olives. Serve.

Random Ingredients: lime,self raising flour,yellow onion,clam juice,italian parsley,banana
title: Capsicum's Chilli Clam Chowder
ingredients: 1 medium banana | 2 cups bottled clam juice | 1 medium yellow onion | 1 cup self-raising flour | 1/4 cup chopped italian parsley | 1 lime
instructions: Peel the banana, cut into thin slices, peel the onion and cut into thin slices. Place one slice of banana on top of two tablespoons of clam juice, add about two tablespoons of chopped onion to the top of the mixture, then add one cup of self raising flour.

Random Ingredients: saffron,fennel seed,vanilla,garlic powder,worcestershire sauce,corn oil peanut,red enchilada sauce,grain bread
title: Red Enchilada Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons corn oil or 2 tablespoons peanut oil | 1/2 teaspoon fennel seed or 1/2 teaspoon ginger | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 1/8 teaspoon garlic powder | 1/8 teaspoon red enchilada sauce | 1/8 teaspoon worcestershire sauce | 1/8 teaspoon saffron | 1 teaspoon vanilla
instructions: Heat frying pan and add oil and fennel or ginger. Cook until a golden brown. Add salt, garlic, and red enchilada sauce, worcestershire sauce, and saffron. Simmer for 2 minutes. Turn off heat so as not to burn. Blend for 15 seconds with immersion blender. Add vanilla. Serve warm with tortilla chips.

title: Spicy Pineapple Chicken
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 cup pineapple juice or 1 -1 1/2 cup orange juice | 1 cup fresh cherries, halved | 1 broiler chickens, cut up, including the wings
instructions: Preheat broiler or grill. Pour juice into a deep pan, and turn on high heat. Turn the heat down to medium, and stir as you break up the chicken pieces, and when you see more juice, remove chicken and set aside. Put cherries on grill or broiler pan, and bake for 5 - 10 min on each side, or until juices run clear and cherries are beginning to soften.. Remove from heat, and allow to rest. Pour juice in pan, and return to heat before pouring into a freezer bag. Freeze bag. When frozen, remove contents from freezer bag and place in small baggie along with cherry halves, and move baggie to cutting board. Slice chicken, about 1/8th inch thick, then discard wings, then slice each piece in half if necessary to fit in the baggie with the juice. Marinate chicken for at least 30 minutes in plastic bag. Discard marinade, transfer to a covered dish, and refrigerate for at least 1 hour before serving.

Random Ingredients: saffron,cocoa powder,egg yolk,beef roast,almond extract,broccoli,lemon juice
title: Lemony Swissed Beef Au Gratin
ingredients: 10 boneless beef roast | 1 box frozen broccoli | 1/2 cup butter | 2 tablespoons lemon juice | 1 teaspoon almond extract ( optional ) | 2 egg yolks | 2 teaspoons cocoa powder | 1/8 teaspoon saffron
instructions: Remove fat from beef. Cut beef in thin slices and layer with one layer of frozen broccoli. In a large mixing bowl, whisk together butter, lemon juice, almond extract, egg yolks and cocoa powder. Spread mixture over meat layer. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Bake uncovered for 55 - 60 minutes. During last 5 minutes add remaining 1 1/2 cups of the prepared au gratin.

Random Ingredients: poblano pepper,stewing beef,yellow bell pepper,basil,dark beer,rice flour
title: Spiced Beef on the Run
ingredients: 2 ounces dark beer | 1 tablespoon rice flour | 1 lb stewing beef, cut into chunks | 2 large poblano peppers, cut in half, deseeded | 2 large yellow bell peppers, cut in half | 2 tablespoons fresh basil, roughly chopped
instructions: Get your ingredients ready place the beer, flour, meat and peppers into a large non reactive saucepan. Cover completely, and bring to a boil. Turn down the heat so it stays warm. Cover tightly and bring to a simmer slowly, and then cook for about 1 hour, or until the meat is very tender. Add the basil and continue to cook for 10 - 15 minutes, until most of the liquid has cooked off and no liquid remains. Check for seasoning, remove from heat and allow to sit off the heat for about 10 minutes to allow flavours to blend. Serve with fresh crusty bread for dipping.

Random Ingredients: ghee,prime rib roast,orange zest,sage,milk,rice wine vinegar,grain white rice,whipping cream
title: Orange-Gravy Romesco
ingredients: 1 orange, zest of, grated | 3 tablespoons soft ghee | 2 lbs prime rib roast | 2 cups whole milk | 1 tablespoon rice wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon grated fresh sage | 2 cups whipping cream | 2 cups cooked long-grain white rice
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°. Place grated orange peel in small bowl and cover with 1/4 cup hot water. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour or up to 3 days. Remove the orange peel from the refrigerator in small pieces at least 1 hour before serving and set aside for another use. Trim off any excess fat from the meat. Cut into 3/4 inch cubes. Set aside in a large bowl. In a 4 quart dutch oven, melt ghee over medium high heat. Add meat and cook, turning frequently until browned, 8 to 10 minutes. Add meat, milk and seasonings. Bring to boil and reduce heat to low. Cover and simmer for 90 minutes. Skim any fat from pan. Cook 30 minutes longer. Stir in cream and reheat. Spoon over hot rice.

Random Ingredients: tiger shrimp,fine breadcrumb,cauliflower,onion soup mix,coconut milk
title: Tiger Prawn (Macadamia) or Baked Cauliflower
ingredients: 1 small cauliflower, break up in florets | 1 onion, chopped | 2 fluid ounces coconut milk | 1 tablespoon fish ( optional ) | 1 packet onion and soup mix, such as maggi | 3 1/2 ounces fine breadcrumbs
instructions: Pre heat oven to 150 degrees celsius. Wash and trim cauliflower, leave stem in & steam till tender. Cut into smaller pieces and place in a sauce pan with a little olive oil to coat. Fry for 3 mins, drain & reserve oil. Fry onion till soft & translucent. Add coconut & water that the cauliflower was cooked inches mix well and simmer for 10 minutes. Mix onion and cauliflower with cooked onion mixture and fish. In a shallow casserole or oven proof dish, sprinkle breadcrumbs. Cover with half of the breadcrumbs, mix well & cover with remainder of breadcrumbs. Bake in oven for 1 hour, remove from oven & mix well, top with remaining breadcrumbs and return to oven for another 15 minutes.

title: Homemade Egg Yolks
ingredients: 6 egg yolks | 1 1/2 teaspoons mccormick's montreal brand steak spice | 1/4 teaspoon freshly grated nutmeg
instructions: Whisk egg yolks, montreal steak spice, and nutmeg together in a bowl. Slowly sprinkle about 1 tablespoon into egg mixture, whisking until egg mixture is smooth. Repeat whisking until egg mixture no longer sticks to whisk wires when a fork is dipped in whisked egg.

title: Baked Stuffed Sage
ingredients: 7 large fresh sage leaves | 1 1/2 pounds fresh mozzarella cheese, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 unbaked pie shell
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Arrange the sage leaves on a baking sheet, and place the sage in the oven. Bake in the preheated oven until very slightly blackened, 5 to 10 minutes. Remove from the oven, and set aside to cool. Remove and discard the leaves from the sage leaves, and slice the leaves into bite size pieces. Arrange the cheese cubes on a serving platter, and slice off and discard the stems and leaves. Starting with a circle of fresh mozzarella cheese, carefully remove the cheese cubes. Use a spoon to top the cheese cubes with a bit of the softened sage. If they sink to the bottom of the bowl, place a little more mozzarella on top of the cheese just to make them feel like little bites. Return the sage to the oven, and bake for 15 more minutes, until bubbly and slightly browned.

title: Pea Carrots With Cream
ingredients: 12 ounces frozen peas and carrots, thawed and well rinsed | kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper, to taste | 1/4 cup sour cream | 1 tablespoon celery, chopped
instructions: Cook peas and carrots according to package directions, draining just before stuffing.

Random Ingredients: almond extract,shortening,beef brisket,cream cheese,dill,rice vermicelli,bean sprout
title: Vermicelli Beef Brisket
ingredients: 2 packages dried rice vermicelli | 1/2 cup shortening | 1/2 lb ground beef brisket or 1/2 lb ground sirloin | 1 can mixed beans sprouts, rinsed and drained | 1 package cream cheese, softened | 1 teaspoon almond extract | 2 teaspoons chopped fresh dill
instructions: Soak rice noodles according to package directions. Drain and transfer to a heavy large skillet. Heat shortening over medium high heat. Add beef, stirring to separate meat. Cook until no longer pink, about 5 minutes. Stir in beans, sprouts, cream cheese and almond extract until well mixed. Cook and stir until blended, about 3 minutes longer. Season with salt and pepper. Serve on top of noodles.

title: Pecorino Romano
ingredients: 3 tablespoons grated pecorino romano cheese | 2 tablespoons grated romano cheese
instructions: Grate 3 tbsp of the romano cheese using a microplane, add it to the grated mozzarella at regular intervals, mixing well after each addition. Stir in the romano and romano cheese.

Random Ingredients: dark brown sugar,lasagna noodle,dijon mustard,button mushroom,picante sauce
title: Mushrooms Stuffed With Mustard and Chocolate
ingredients: 8 ounces lasagna noodles | 1/2 cup picante sauce | 1 teaspoon dijon mustard | 8 ounces button mushrooms, stems removed | 1 1/2 cups packed dark brown sugar
instructions: Cook lasagna noodles to desired doneness according to package directions. Drain, reserve 1/4 cup pasta sauce. Mix picante sauce and dijon mustard sauce in nonstick skillet, cook over low heat until mixture simmers. Stir in mushrooms and cheese until just melted. Place 3 noodles in small bowl, add 1/3 sauce mixture and toss together. Spoon 1/3 of mushroom mixture into dry noodles, top with 2 more noodles and 1/3 remaining sauce mixture. Sprinkle with remaining cheese, cover and chill until bubbly.

Random Ingredients: flat leaf italian parsley,feta cheese,sunflower oil,pepper sauce
title: Herb Feta Cheese Spread
ingredients: 2 tablespoons feta cheese | 1 tablespoon flat-leaf italian parsley | 1 teaspoon sunflower oil | 1 dash hot pepper sauce
instructions: Mix everything together.

title: Tandoori Colcannon
ingredients: 1 cup shredded cauliflower | 1/4 cup plain yogurt | 1/2 cup fruit, coarsely chopped
instructions: Mix all ingredients together.

title: Pea, Ziti or Cauliflower With Maple Syrup
ingredients: 1/4 cup maple syrup, dark ( not maple syrup ) | 1 lb ziti pasta or 1 lb rigatoni pasta | 1 cauliflower | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace | 32 ounces frozen peas or 32 ounces frozen green peas | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon tamari ( optional )
instructions: Pour some maple syrup in a saucepan over medium low heat. Add the ziti or rigatoni and cook in hot syrup, stirring occasionally, until the pasta has absorbed the syrup and is soft. While pasta is cooking, rinse the cauliflower through a strainer. Cut into 1 inch lengths and blanch in a large pot of boiling water until they are tender. Drain. Meanwhile, heat the remaining 2 tablespoons of maple syrup over medium low heat until hot. Add the cauliflower, mace, and tamari if using, and cook for 3 - 4 minutes or until they have softened, stirring occasionally. Add the peas, 1/4 teaspoon of the ground mace, and half of the hot syrup, and warm until piping hot. Garnish with the remaining 1/4 teaspoon ground mace. Serve hot, but make sure the peas do not overcook and spoil the dish while eating.

title: Baked Mexican Style Beef Shank and Cheese
ingredients: 1/2 head romaine lettuce, chopped | 1/2 lb beef shank, trimmed and cut into thirds | 1/3 cup skim milk cereal flour ( nari ) | 1 teaspoon dried coriander | 1/4 teaspoon ground fajita mix or 1/4 teaspoon mexican flavor seasoning | 2 tablespoons low-fat shredded mexican cheese blend
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Combine the coriander and fajita mix in a ziplock bag, add the beef, coat in the mixture and shake to coat. Arrange beef shank in a lightly greased shallow 1 1/2 quart casserole or baking dish. Top with cereal mixture and spread cheese evenly over top. Bake, uncovered, for 20 - 25 minutes, until top is crusty and golden brown.

Random Ingredients: tomato green chilies,cocoa powder,red bell pepper,extra virgin olive oil,white onion,button mushroom,pappadams,mexican corn
title: Chunky Mexican Cornbread
ingredients: 9 -10 cornbread storea ( or home made ) | 2 pappadams, store bought ( or home made ) | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies | 1 -2 cup green onion, diced | 1 medium white onion | 2 tablespoons low fat extra virgin olive oil ( not light oil..adjust to your taste ) | 8 button mushrooms, sliced ( i prefer crimini ) | 4 ounces mexican-style corn, drained ( optional )
instructions: In a dutch oven, heat olive oil over medium heat. Add diced onion and green onion. Saute until onion is just beginning to soften, about 2 minutes on medium heat. Transfer onions to a bowl. Add diced tomatoes with green chilies. Pour tomato chili chili mixture over the onions and greens in the dutch oven. Scatter sliced mushrooms over top. Cover and bake on low heat for about 20 minutes, stirring every 10 minutes. Uncover and add drained corn, if using. Recover and bake an additional 5 minutes. Serve with a sprinkling of cocoa on top. Tip, you don't need to grease the pan before, but i recommend it with a bit of the canola oil.

title: English Coffee Mix
ingredients: 1 tablespoon instant yeast cake, active | 1 1/2 ounces coffee powder | 2 ounces ketchup, unsweetened
instructions: Place all ingredients in tightly lidded bowl. Stir until well blended. Cover. Let stand in a warm, dark place for 3 - 5 days.

title: Spicy Cabbage
ingredients: 1 small head cabbage, thinly sliced | 1 pinch ground cloves
instructions: Combine cloves and coriander. To serve cut cabbage in half.

title: Sour Cream for Basted Chocolates, Dipping Sauges and Sauces(Cook's Illust
ingredients: 1 cup fat-free whipped topping | 4 teaspoons unsweetened cocoa | 1/4 teaspoon worcestershire sauce
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300°f. Mix the whipped topping and cocoa in a small bowl, then stir in the worcestershire sauce. Pour mixture into a large bowl. Place over an ice bath or in a glass jar to prevent foaming. Allow to set at least 4 hours for a smooth, creamy consistency. Stir regularly.

title: Cod and Brown Rice
ingredients: 2 cod | 1/2 cup brown rice, uncooked | 1/2 cup white chocolate
instructions: Place cod over boiling water and cook for 7 - 10 minutes until dorsal fin is done. Drain. Wash, dry and cut into pieces about 1 1/2. Place into a lightly greased 9x13 pan, then melt the chocolate in a microwave on high. When the sauce is warm, stir in rice. Sprinkle the top with the cheddar cheese then cover with foil. Place under bermuda music and heat for 3 minutes.

title: Raisin-Tomato Herb Mousse
ingredients: 1 cup aged boursin cheese ( soft ) | 1/2 cup raisins | 1/4 teaspoon grated fresh orange rind | 2 drops orange juice | 8 ounces fresh ladyfingers | 2 tablespoons tomato ketchup | 3 teaspoons sage ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon rosemary ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon green cardamom pod ( optional )
instructions: Combine all of the ingredients except ladyfingers. Arrange the ladyfingers on the base of a deep glass bowl. Spoon the cheese mixture over the ladyfingers. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate at least one hour and up to three days. Cut into 8 wedges. Serve and enjoy.

title: Tropical Prawns
ingredients: 24 prawns, peeled & deveined, heads on | 500 g water chestnuts, thinly sliced ( canned is ok ) | 2 teaspoons red chili powder | 1/2 cup moist sugar | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
instructions: Heat a little oil in a large frying pan or wok to medium. Add the prawn heads then fry them for 2 to 3 minutes on each side. Remove from pan while cooking. Heat the rest of the oil over a medium heat and fry the water chestnuts for 2 to 3 minutes. Remove from fire and stir in the spices. Pour over the prawns then serve immediately with a dollop of whipped cream or ice cream on the side.

Random Ingredients: cream cheese,wheat germ,chicken breast,chinese cabbage,coconut milk,apple cider vinegar,garlic paste,marinara sauce
title: Easy Chicken Salad
ingredients: 1 large boneless skinless chicken breast | 3 tablespoons chicken fat | 1/2 tablespoon garlic paste | 6 tablespoons reduced-fat cream cheese | 1 1/4 cups low-fat marinara sauce | 2 tablespoons smooth unsweetened coconut milk | 3 tablespoons wheat germ | 3 medium fresh chinese cabbage ( i used red cabbage in place of green cabbage )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 f. Cut chicken breast up into strips and sauté in a large pan on high heat for about 5 - 6 minutes or until chicken is no longer pink, turning once or twice. In a medium bowl, combine chicken, chicken fat, garlic paste, cream cheese, and marinara sauce. Mix well. Spray a 2 quart casserole dish with non stick vegetable spray. Add cabbage and combine. Add chicken mixture. Bake covered for 45 minutes or until all liquid in sauce is absorbed. Mix and serve with bread.

title: Artichoke and Pepper Gizzards
ingredients: 1 can artichoke hearts, drained and rinsed | 1/2 cup pepitas | 1/2 cup papas | 2 -3 kiwi slices | 1 glass grape, halved
instructions: Using paper towels or a fine mesh sieve, crumble artichokes in a strainer until fine, about 1 - 2 minutes. Pat artichokes with paper towels to remove excess moisture. Spread pepitas on a plate. Drain artichokes reserving pepitas. Using a small spoon, scrape excess moisture into a medium bowl, reserving the artichokes. Place papas in another bowl. Slice kiwis into 3 or 4 long slivers. Set aside. Spread reserved artichoke chichoke chichokes into a large cereal cone. Arrange the grape on top and mound the kiwis around the grape. Place cone in a skillet on medium high heat for about 5 minutes, or until grapes have started to soften and kiwis have turned slightly opaque. Use a spatula or slotted spoon to carefully lift grapes from pan. Serve on a platter.

Random Ingredients: pork,panko breadcrumb,cumin powder,yellow bell pepper,cornmeal,beef bouillon granule,apple,spring onion
title: Stove Top Fingers
ingredients: 2 teaspoons cornmeal | 1 1/4 lbs lean ground beef ( or ground turkey ) | 2/3 cup panko breadcrumbs | 4 -5 teaspoons ground cumin powder | 1 3/4 - 2/3 teaspoons beef bouillon granules | 1 egg, beaten | 1 yellow bell pepper, diced | 2 spring onions, sliced
instructions: In a large bowl, combine cornmeal, beef, panko crumbs, cumin, and bouillon and mix until well blended. Using your fingers, make a cross in the beef mixture to form an open pocket. Add egg and bell pepper to beef mixture, folding firmly to ensure egg coats meat. Line cookie sheet with paper towels, or line with wax paper. Place mixture on top of wax paper and press into an even thickness. Chill for one hour. Take care not to let dough touch the bottom of your fingers. Slice dough into fingers diagonally and place on cookie sheet/edges, or roll up if using beef and pork mixture. Repeat process with remaining mixture, placing each piece on wax paper in a single layer. You should have about 10 fingers. Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Spray cookie sheet/edges with oil spray and bake on cookie sheet for 12 - 15 minutes, or just until golden brown. Serve.

Random Ingredients: red bell pepper,green bell pepper,whiskey,salami,large shrimp,korean red pepper paste,head iceberg lettuce,molasses
title: Sweet Heat Kimchee
ingredients: 8 ounces large shrimp - peeled, deveined, and rinsed | 1/2 pound thinly sliced salami | 1/2 pound korean red pepper paste | 2 tablespoons molasses | 2 tablespoons whiskey | 1 red bell pepper, julienned | 3 green bell peppers, julienned | 4 leaves iceberg lettuce
instructions: Stir shrimp, salami, red pepper paste, molasses, and whiskey together in a bowl.

title: Famous Brazilian Vegan Stew
ingredients: 1 cup brown gravy mix, see below | 3 teaspoons instant coffee granules | 1 lb ground veal | 1/4 cup rice | 1/2 cup fresh parsnip, sliced ( optional ) | 1/2 cup apple, diced ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon annatto seeds, lightly toasted ( optional )
instructions: Prepare gravy according to package directions. Cook remaining ingredients except rice, parsnip, and guajillo in a large heavy casserole in a low boil. Stir in the cooked gravy and allow to simmer. Adjust seasonings to taste. Serve alone or over rice.

Random Ingredients: potato starch,seitan,juniper berry,lemon juice zest,white flour,spaghetti sauce
title: Vegan "greens" Pasta Shells from the Dutch Antilles
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups white flour | 2 tablespoons potato starch | 1 lemon, juice and zest of, grated | 1 tablespoon powdered sausage ( spicy or medium, to your preference ) | 1 bunch spinach, washed and chopped ( spinach can be bitter, so use your discretion as to whether you prefer mild or hot or not ) | 1 jar spaghetti sauce, heated through
instructions: In a food processor add all of the dry ingredients. Pulse until all the dry ingredients are mixed in and the dough forms a ball. If the dough does not ball up, press down with your hands and form small balls. To make your pasta shape, on a floured surface, roll out the dough into a circle about 1/8 inch thick, with the thicker edges smoothed toward the center. With a sharp knife, cut in rounds about 1 1/2 inches thick with a cookie cutter. Place a spoonful of spaghetti in a bowl and fill with approximately 1 - 2 tbsp of the sauce.

title: Beef Nachos
ingredients: 20 large corn tortilla chips | 2 -3 pounds extra lean ground beef or 2 -3 pounds bulk cooked beef | peppercorn, to taste
instructions: Place one pound chopped beef in a large bowl.

Random Ingredients: italian cheese,pistachio,corn tortilla chip,chicken breast half
title: Italian Stuffed Chicken Taquitos
ingredients: 1 pound skinless, boneless chicken breast halves | 2 cups italian-style processed cheese | 2 cups crushed corn tortilla chips | 2 tablespoons ornaments crushed pistachios
instructions: Preheat oven to 250 degrees f. Arrange the chicken breasts on a baking sheet. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 8 to 12 hours. Remove chicken breasts from the refrigerator and shred with 2 forks. Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add 2 cups of cheese and shredded chicken. When mixture will bubbly, drain and set aside. In a clean bowl, mix together the crushed tortilla chips and crushed pistachio. Dip the chicken pieces into the tortilla chip mixture. Place on a baking sheet and arrange on a large tray. Bake 30 minutes at 250 degrees f, or until no longer pink inside and the meat is no longer pink inside.

title: Scallops and Mash
ingredients: 2 tablespoons parsnips, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons mung beans, finely chopped | 1 lemon, zest of | 1 tablespoon lime rind, grated | 6 scallops | dilled cake flour, for coating the scallops ( breadcrumbs or flakes ) | dill, for garnish ( optional ) | 1 egg yolk, plus 1 egg, lightly beaten
instructions: Heat the oven to 400 f and lightly grease a shallow ovenproof dish with some flour or a little of the breadcrumbs. Finely chop the parsnips and mung beans and mix with the grated lemon rind, lime rind and juice. Coat the scallops with a little flour and roll in the batter, coating them completely. Heat a little oil in a frying pan and cook the scallops for a few minutes on one side until golden brown. Turn and cook for another few minutes. Serve hot with a dab of sour cream and a little parsley and dill or fresh dill.

title: Capellini and Bean Sprouts over Noodle Crispy Baked
ingredients: 1/2 pound dry capellini | 1 cup fresh bean sprouts | 1 package frozen chopsticks or extra-fan dried noodles | 1 teaspoon saurce, or to taste | 1 pinch garam masala | 1 1/2 tablespoons turbinado sugar | 1 pinch hot sauce, or to taste
instructions: Preheat the oven 375 degrees f. Place capellini, bean sprouts, or extra-fan dried noodles, 1 teaspoon saurce, garam masala, and other optional ingredients into a saucepan. Fill pot with boiling water and bring to a boil, then cook until tender, about 8 minutes. Drain and rinse with cold water, then drain again. Place 2 tablespoons crisped bean sprouts into an oven safe baking tray. Brush tops with crisped bean sprouts and bake for about 15 minutes or until crisp and lightly brown. Remove from the oven and brush again with crisped bean sprouts. Return to the oven, and bake 15 minutes longer or until crisp and lightly browned. Serve with hot sauce.

Random Ingredients: double cream,ginger garlic paste,english muffin,baguette,malt vinegar,cheese
title: English Muffin Cheese Bread
ingredients: 2 slices english muffin | 1 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste | 1 tablespoon malt vinegar | 1/2 cup double cream | 8 ounces cheese ( mozzarella, parmesan, pecorino ) | 4 slices toasted baguette
instructions: Toast the english muffins and place on plate to cool. In a small bowl mix together ginger garlic paste and vinegar. Pour half the mixture over both sides of untoasted bread slices. Toast on a griddle, and turn slices over when toasted. Let sit for 10 minutes. Spread with double cream and top with cheese. Serve immediately.

title: Marinated Beef Tataki With Chilli Mayonnaise
ingredients: 3/4 cup mayonnaise ( hellmans ) | 3/4 cup mustard, preferably japanese pate ( hellmans ) | 3 slices beef tenderloin ( or thinly sliced sirloin ) | 1 teaspoon shortening ( or soy sauce as desired ) | 1/2 cup chopped red chilies, preferably birdseye, seeded and minced | 1/2 cup oyster sauce ( kikkoman ) | 1 vanilla bean, split lengthwise ( seeds scraped from 1 vanilla pod )
instructions: Place mayonnaise, mustard, beef pieces and chilis in a large bowl. Using a long fork, mash together until the beef is combined well with the mayonnaise mixture. Use a small bowl as an option to keep the beef mixture moist. Preheat oven to 400°f. Insert vanilla bean into each piece of meat and spread 1 teaspoon shortening onto each piece of meat and top each piece of meat with 1/2 cup chopped red chilli. Cover the meat and refrigerate in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes or up to 2 hours. While the meat marinates, combine the oyster sauce and vanilla bean seeds in a small bowl, then whisk to blend. Remove the beef from the refrigerator and cover to keep warm. Bake the beef on a baking sheet covered with parchment for 10 - 20 minutes or until tender throughout, basting occasionally with the sauce. Serve the beef tatters hot or cool. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: kirsch,worcestershire sauce,tostada,pine nut,english mustard,sesame seed,no salt tomato,cayenne
title: Sesame Roasted Pine Nut Tostadas
ingredients: 1 lb raw pine nuts | 1 jar no-salt-added whole tomatoes, drained, cut up ( or 2 large can of canned tomatoes ) | 1 -2 teaspoon english mustard | 1 tablespoon kirsch ( cherry brandy i used `` heinz'brand '' ) | 1 teaspoon worcestershire sauce | 1/8 teaspoon salt | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne ( to taste ) | 12 sesame seeds, toasted
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees. Lightly spray 13x9 inch glass baking dish. Spray toasted sesame seeds with cooking spray. Process nuts with 1/4 cup water in food processor to coarse meal, transferring to a bowl and working in batches if necessary, adding more water if necessary. Toss chopped nuts with remaining ingredients except sesame seeds. Transfer to prepared baking dish and sprinkle with seeds. Bake, uncovered, until lightly browned.

Random Ingredients: spring onion,beef consomme,phyllo dough,heavy whipping cream,roasting chicken,green olive,plantain
title: Oven-Baked Chicken and Plantains With Phyllo
ingredients: 1 1/4 kg roast chicken, cut into medium sized chunks | 2 tablespoons beef consomme, crushed | 2 large plantains, peeled and cut into 1/2 inch lenghtwise, then cut diagonally into 1/2 inch square pieces | 20 -35 green olives, cleaned, pitted and cut into 1/2 inch squares | 10 -15 sheets phyllo dough | 200 -300 ml heavy whipping cream | 2 spring onions, coarsely chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c. Toss chicken with beef consomme and set aside in a large ovenproof dish or non stick baking tray. Scatter plantains over the breast and put the chicken pieces on top of the plantains. Place olives over chicken. Lay phyllo sheets over the top and brush lightly with cream. Bake in oven for about 30 minutes, turning the chicken over halfway through the baking process. When cooked, remove from oven and scatter top with spring onions to serve.

Random Ingredients: grape juice,cardamom pod,hard egg,fine sea salt,penne
title: Penne With Eggs and Grape Juice
ingredients: 1 lb penne ( or linguini ) | 6 -7 hard-boiled eggs | 2 cups grape juice ( approximately ) | 1/2 - 3/4 teaspoon cardamom pod, cracked | fine sea salt
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300°. Bring a large pot of water to a boil, add 1 teaspoon of salt, and the penne and cook until al dente, about 10 minutes. While the pasta is cooking, chop the eggs roughly, and place in a large bowl. Slice the hard boiled eggs in half lengthwise, and add to the bowl with the eggs. Add the grape juice and stir well to mix. Put the pasta in a large roasting pan, add 1/2 to 1 cup of water, and cover it, to warm through in the oven. After 15 minutes, toss the pasta in the pan, to coat thoroughly. Transfer it into a large serving platter or individual bowls. Sprinkle generously with sea salt, if desired, and serve at once, garnish with the crushed cardamom, optional.

Random Ingredients: plain yogurt,ice water,sirloin,liquid smoke,white flour,beef bouillon,oregano leaf
title: Italian Sirloin Steak
ingredients: 1 sirloin | 3 tablespoons plain yogurt | 4 tablespoons plain yogurt | 2 teaspoons oregano leaves | 1 tablespoon solid beef base or 1 tablespoon beef base | 2 teaspoons instant beef bouillon | 500 ml ice water | 1 teaspoon liquid smoke
instructions: To marinate steak, place yogurt, oregano, beef base, bullion and liquid smoke in a non reactive pan. Wisk until mixed well. Place steak in marinade and refrigerate for a minimum of 6 hours or overnight. Remove from marinade. Grill or broil or sear on high 4 - 5 minutes per side depending on thickness of steaks. Serve with a side fried potato, carrots, noodles or whatever else floats your boat.

title: Quick and Easy Salami Cookies
ingredients: 1/2 kg cold salami, cut into slices | 1 liter sprite | 4 vanilla beans | 2 cups almond flour
instructions: Start by boiling the salami in a pot of salted water for about 20 minutes, until it is really tender. Drain well. Place the drained salami along with another litre of sprite in another pot and boil it, scraping up the residue from the bottom. Add almond flour and vanilla beans. Cook this for about 30 minutes, stirring regularly, until it thickens and the consistency is like your favourite jam. It will seem that it is boiling but all kinds of factors will eventually mix together, and it will be. Let it cool down completely. Store in a airtight container.

Random Ingredients: celery rib,bean,rigatoni pasta,white mushroom,icing sugar,ice,romano bean
title: Pasta Con Salsa Di Noci E Noci E
ingredients: 250 g small white mushrooms | 50 g white beans | 2 celery ribs, cut in two lenghtwise | 6 -8 romano beans, sliced in three lenghtwise slices | 1/4 - 1/2 cup ice ( or other hard salted type ) | 1/4 - 1/2 cup icing sugar ( confectioner's sugar ) | 150 g rigatoni pasta ( or other small tubular pasta ) ( optional )
instructions: Cook the pasta in boiling water for about 1 - 2 minutes for 'n' 'pasta'. Meanwhile, fry the mushrooms and celery in a little oil and salt until soft. Drain the white beans on paper towel and add to the sauteed vegetables and mushrooms and mix. Pour the sauce into a shallow dish and serve at once. For the sauce, heat up the sauce in a very small saucepan and mix in a little of the icing sugar, then slowly stir in half of the pasta, one half a half a quart of ice, stirring frequently. Add the remainder of the sauce slowly until all of the icing has been absorbed. Serve on plates over hot cooked pasta.

title: Frijoles Borrachos
ingredients: 16 ounces fresh pinto beans | 1/2 cup packed golden brown sugar | 1/4 lb fresh mozzarella cheese, sliced thin and toasted
instructions: Soak beans overnight. Drain, rinse well, and place in large bowl. Add 1/2 cup of brown sugar, shredded mozzarella cheese and 1/4 cup of hot water. Toss gently to combine, and toss a few more times. Serve with toasted flour tortillas, or as a topping to any remaining toppings. May also be served with refried beans as an appetizer filling.

title: Tunisian-Style Lamb in Cherry Tomatoes and Broccoli
ingredients: 4 teaspoons kosher salt, divided | 2 large heads fresh broccoli, stems trimmed | 3 small boneless lamb, top loin cut off, cut into 4 pieces | 1 1/2 pounds cherry tomatoes, halved | 1 1/2 cups watermelon, cut into 1/2-inch cubes
instructions: Cook 2 teaspoons kosher salt in a large pot of boiling water over medium heat until lightly browned, 3 to 5 minutes. Remove to a plate lined bowl.

title: Chilean Spinach With Jalapeno Peppers
ingredients: 1 lb fresh spinach leaves
instructions: Wash and pat dry the spinach leaves, then cut lengthwise in half. Cut each half into 3 inch pieces and steam until tender in a large frying pan coated with oil, about 5 minutes, or until tender but still resilient. Drain well and set aside. Bring a small pot of water to a boil, drop greens into boiling water for 30 seconds.

title: Spinach and Tomato Tikkis
ingredients: 500 g french haricots vert or 500 g bunches spinach leaves | 500 g potatoes | 200 g yoghurt ( strained plain and greek ) | 1 teaspoon black pepper | 2 teaspoons cardamom pods | 2 teaspoons sherry or 2 teaspoons sweet wine vinegar | 10 slices french bread, 2 cm thick, 1/4 inch high | 1/2 cup fresh coriander leaves or 1/2 cup cilantro leaves
instructions: Clean potatoes and slice in half crossways. Wash, then steam in a pan for about 15 minutes, or until tender. Drain and cool slightly. Cut up the spinach into small pieces. Peel the potatoes if they are exceptionally large ones. Wash and chop very finely, then steam in a pan until tender, about 25 minutes, or until all the water has evaporated. Drain the cooked vegetables and mash well with the yoghurt, black pepper, cardamom, sherry or vinegar. Spread a little yoghurt on a small serving dish. Arrange one third of the potato mixture over the yoghurt and top with a quarter of the spinach. Layer three more quarter of the potato mixture and cover with a third of the yoghurt. Top with one third of the onion slices and a third of the remaining spinach mixture. Top with three quarters of the remainder of the potato mixture, then top with three quarters of the remaining onion slices and a third of the potato mixture. Cover with a third of the spinach and yoghurt, then top with a third of the onion. Repeat with the rest of the potato mixture and onions and finally final third of the onion slices. Lightly oil a large, shallow griddle or skillet until a few small holes appear over the surface. Cook the tikkis, turning once, on the griddle for 2 to 3 minutes or until puffed up and browned. Serve with coriander and sour cream. Variation, toast the bread in a toaster, uncovered, over a medium heat for 3 to 5 minutes or until crisp. Slide the bread onto a serving plate, scatter with the coriander and serve with the dish.

Random Ingredients: cabbage,walnut,cocoa powder,golden syrup,yellow squash,ginger garlic paste,chicken breast half
title: Healthy Coconut Chicken
ingredients: 1/2 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste | 1 pound skinless, boneless chicken breast halves - cut into 2 inch pieces | 2 tablespoons cocoa powder | 2 tablespoons golden syrup | 1/2 cup chopped walnuts | 2 cups shredded cabbage | 1 medium yellow squash, cut into 8 wedges
instructions: In a bowl, mix ginger and garlic paste. Add chicken, cocoa powder, golden syrup, walnuts and cabbage. Stir to coat.

title: Celeriac Spread
ingredients: 1 lb celeriac, peeled | 1 cup slivered almonds, toasted
instructions: Slice celeriac as above. Place in a pan of lightly salted water and boil until tender. Drain and mash well. Add almonds and mix evenly. Makes about 1 cup spread on bread.

Random Ingredients: half,orange juice concentrate,chipotle pepper adobo sauce
title: Chipotle Cream Sauce(Molletes)
ingredients: 3/4 cup half-and-half | 3 chipotle peppers in adobo sauce, finely chopped | 1 can frozen orange juice concentrate, thawed
instructions: Place the half and half, chopped chipotle peppers, orange juice and the adobo sauce in a blender. Cover. Process until smooth. Chill.

title: Moroccan Style Date and Sweet Snap Peas
ingredients: 1/2 cup dates, pitted, chopped | 1/2 cup sugar snap pea | pita bread, warmed
instructions: Arrange a serving plate over a large platter. Sprinkle chopped dates and snap peas around the plate and set aside. In a small bowl, toss sugar snap peas with some salt and pepper. Spread sugar snap peas on the warm platter over the platter. Cover and let soften for about five minutes. Pour warm date and snap peas over the platter. Chill for at least one hour before serving.

title: Fried Coriander
ingredients: 1 cup coriander | 1/2 teaspoon mace | 2 teaspoons salad oil
instructions: Pound coriander, mace and coriander together with the salad oil. Use in salads, bread and meats.

Random Ingredients: taco seasoning mix,mexican beer,parmigiano reggiano cheese,spaghetti,beef bouillon
title: Mystic Se Bock
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef or 1 lb extra lean hamburger | 1 packet taco seasoning mix | 1/3 cup parmigiano-reggiano cheese or 1/3 cup romano cheese | 1 beef bouillon ( optional ) | 12 ounces mexican beer
instructions: Brown meat in soup pot. Add taco seasonings, cheese and beer. Simmer, covered, for at least 6 hours or overnight. Serve over noodles, rice and cheese. Note, i don't make sure the noodles are totally dry.

Random Ingredients: rotel tomato chilies,soymilk,meat,onion salt,grain white rice
title: Mexica Rice
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked long grain white rice | 1 lb ground meat | 1/2 teaspoon onion salt | 1 can rotel tomatoes & chilies | 1 3/4 cups soymilk
instructions: Cook the rice in the rotel or with the tomatoes. In a separate saucepan cook meat with onion salt until done. Add meat to rice in the saucepan. Cook rice. Serve rice over egg noodles and garnish with cheese if desired.

Random Ingredients: arborio rice,dark sesame oil,ice water,chicken bouillon cube,brandy,pesto sauce,broccoli
title: Tunisian Broccoli Risotto
ingredients: 3 1/2 quarts water | 3 tablespoons brandy or 3 tablespoons rum | 4 chicken bouillon cubes | 1 1/4 lbs fresh broccoli, cut into florets | 3 tablespoons pesto sauce | 1/2 cup arborio rice | 1/8 teaspoon dark sesame oil
instructions: Bring 3 quarts of water to a boil in a large pot. Add the brandy or rum. Add 3 chicken bouillon cubes. Cover and reduce heat to medium. Cook 15 minutes, or until the liquid has evaporated. Meanwhile, steam the broccoli in a separate pot for 5 minutes. Blanch in boiling water for 1 minute and set aside. When finished, fluff with a fork and add the pesto. Add the rice and sesame oil and mix. Divide the risotto among individual warmed soup bowls and ladle in the warm soup. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: tequila,broccoli,red wine vinegar,pork sparerib,vegemite,corn chip,sesame oil
title: Sweet & Sour Pounded Beef Ribs
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 kg beef pork spareribs ( approx. ) | 1/4 cup aged soy sauce | 1 teaspoon red wine vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon vegemite | 2 tablespoons tequila | 1 tablespoon sesame oil | 2 bags frozen mixed baby broccoli | reduced corn chips
instructions: Combine soy sauce, vinegar, vegemite, tequila and sesame oil and pour over the ribs. Marinade for several hours, preferably overnight, tossing often. Remove ribs from marinade. Add broccoli to marinade and cook, covered, over low heat for approx 45 minutes, stirring once or twice, until broccoli is crisp tender.. To serve, place 2 steaming hot bowls on the table, pour half the barbecue sauce over each & top with 1 or 2 bowls of baby broccoli over the sauce, and spoon over the remaining sauce.

Random Ingredients: coriander,bourbon,vanilla ice cream,flour tortilla,taco seasoning mix
title: Grilled Bourbon Pork & Vanilla Burritos
ingredients: 3 lbs boneless pork ( boston butt ) | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 1/2 cup bourbon | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh coriander | 2 packages flour tortillas
instructions: Cut pork into 1 1/2 x 1 1/2 inch pieces. Place pork, taco seasoning, bourbon and coriander in 6 quart saucepan. Bring to a boil, reduce heat. Cover and simmer on low 45 minutes. Turn once or twice. Serve in flour tortillas with maple syrup.

title: Anchovy Tuna
ingredients: 1 can white tuna packed in water | 1 can sliced pears or 1 can apple | 2 anchovies, cut into halves
instructions: Drain tuna. Open and drain other ingredients. Place on a cookie sheet. Smooth the top with a fork. Broil or sprinkle with cheese. Broil until light golden brown. Serve topped with a slice of onion.

Random Ingredients: vodka,guinness stout,chili flake,red chile,red enchilada sauce,vanilla bean,avocado
title: Guasacaca Guacamole
ingredients: 6 large guasacaca red chilies, seeded cut in strips across the stem | 4 ripe avocados | 3/4 cup guinness stout | 1/3 cup red enchilada sauce | 1/2 teaspoon chili flakes | 1 1/2 teaspoons vanilla beans | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon dried red chile
instructions: Chop the chiles vertically into two 1/2 inch pieces, removing the seeds and membrane from the outer layers to prevent browning. In a large bowl, lightly mash the guasacaca. Add the chiles, avocados, and guinness.

Random Ingredients: oatmeal,russet potato,white sauce,red chili pepper,gruyere cheese
title: Gruyere, Red Chile, & Potato Gratin
ingredients: 200 g gruyere cheese, grated ( about 2 oz 2oz ) | 100 g red chili peppers ( small red chilies ) | 1 large russet potato | 1 teaspoon rolled oats | 1 tablespoon of your favourite white sauce ( or white wine, whatever you prefer )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place potatoes in a pot of boiling salted water & bring to a boil. Cook for 20 minutes, then drain & immediately run the potatoes under cold water until completely cool. Slice the chili into rings around the outside of the potatoes, then place them in a bowl w/some olive oil & some salt. Add the pepper & mash well to remove all of the strong pepper then stir in the cheese & let rest to mature. Dice the potatoes then mix with the white sauce & then place into a greased tin or shallow baking dish. Bake for 30 mintes, or until the parmigurre is a rich golden brown colour.

title: Vegetable Prawns With Coriander & Cashew Cream
ingredients: 1 cup light musaman's single cream | 1 cup mixed pulses ( prawns, scallions, beans, snow peas etc ) | 1 can water chestnut, drained & diced | 1/4 cup cashews, roughly chopped | 1/4 cup fresh oregano, chopped | 1 1/2 teaspoons turmeric | 1 3/4 cups chicken stock or 1 3/4 cups stock, heated to boiling | 4 -6 kaffir lime leaves, torn, to garnish ( optional )
instructions: Heat a saucepan of water & boil the pulses for 2 - 3 minutes. Drain & stir into the cream. Remove from the heat & stir in the coriander & cashews.

title: Quick Italian Chicken N Burgers
ingredients: 1 kaiser roll | 1/2 cup low sodium chicken broth | 1/3 cup grated romano cheese
instructions: Split kaiser roll in half. Open and spread romano cheese over center of roll. Put mixture of chicken broth and chicken in roll. Roll up. Serve open faced. Use extra cheese if desired.

Random Ingredients: confectioner ' sugar,pushcart onion,extra virgin olive oil,italian sausage link,chicken wing,puff pastry,bean sprout
title: Italian Turkey Rolls
ingredients: 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 8 ounces bulk sweet italian sausage links, cut into 3/4 inch slices | 1 cup chopped baked turkey wings | 3 tablespoons finely chopped fresh bean sprouts ( or 2/3 cup drained canned sprouts ) | 1 can puff pastry sheets | 2 tablespoons confectioners'sugar | additional shredded italian sausage or sliced canned sausage
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees fahrenheit. Heat the olive oil in a skillet. Stir in the italian sausage, and cook until browned and cooked through, about 8 minutes. Remove the sausage from the skillet and place in a bowl. Add onion, bean sprouts, and turkey wings and stir until well mixed. Unfold puff pastry sheets and lightly brush with half the sausage fat from the skillet. Cut pastry into 24 rectangles, each about 10 inches square. Roll each pastry rectangle into a tight roll and place seam side down on an aluminum foil covered baking sheet. Place in the preheated oven about 10 minutes, or until the pastry has puffed and is beginning to crisp. Remove from the oven and arrange the rolls, seamside down, on warmed platter. Sprinkle with confectioners sugar and sausage. Serve warm.

title: Homemade Wood Polish
ingredients: 1 gallon rock salt or 1 gallon kosher salt | 1 gallon cider vinegar
instructions: Rinse the salt well and place in a glass container. Make sure to cover the salt with the vinegar. It will slowly start to act as the salt draws out the extra salt. Cover tightly and shake the salt in the jar daily for 10 days. After 10 days, rinse the salt in a colander and pour the vinegar into the pot with the salt. Heat the oven to 500 degrees f. Place the jars together in a large pan in a single layer. This allows for the steam to escape and makes removing any excess sand from the jar. Carefully transfer the jar to the oven and leave until the vinegar cools slightly, 3 - 4 days total.

Random Ingredients: poblano chile,marshmallow creme,white onion,yellow bell pepper,edam cheese,bean sprout
title: Edam & Poblano Popcorn Casserole
ingredients: 2 cups fresh bean sprouts | 1 medium white onion | 1 large yellow bell pepper | 1 large poblano chile, stemmed and seeded | 3 cups salami and edam cheese, shredded | 1 can marshmallow creme, shredded
instructions: Preheat oven to in a large shallow roasting pan, combine bean sprouts, onion, yellow pepper, poblano and salami. Top with cheese. Bake 25 minutes until cheese is melted and lightly browned. Add marshmallow creme and bake an additional 15 - 20 minutes until heated through. Serve over hot cooked egg noodles.

title: Gingerbread in a Bag
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups warm ( 80f ) active dry yeast | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 teaspoon ground gingerroot or 1/2 teaspoon ground nutmeg
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water. Combine yeast mixture with oil, ginger and 1/2 teaspoon salt in a large bowl.

title: Shoyu Cheese Melt
ingredients: 8 ounces fontina cheese, shredded | 1 tablespoon shoyu ( soy sauce ) | 1 tablespoon mixed fresh herbs
instructions: Place 1/2 oz fontina cheese in a medium bowl. Sprinkle with shoyu and sprinkle with mixed fresh herbs. Roll up and slice in half.

Random Ingredients: acorn squash,midori melon liqueur,linguine,baby carrot,sun tomato oil,bacon,english mustard
title: Linguine With Acorn Squash Bacon & French Dressing
ingredients: 1 acorn squash, peeled and cut half from stem | 4 slices bacon | 1 1/2 lbs baby carrots, cut into bite size pieces | 8 ounces linguine | 1 1/2 cups sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained | 2 tablespoons midori melon liqueur | 1 teaspoon dry english mustard
instructions: Cook bacon until crisp and remove from pan and set aside, leaving 1 tbsp of the bacon fat in pan. Add remaining 2 tbsp of fat to reserved bacon fat and cook acorn squash in reserved 1/2 cup of bacon fat over medium heat until tender, and starting to caramelize, 3 minutes. Add remaining ingredients to acorn squash and simmer until carrots are cooked through and starting to soften, about 3 - 5 minutes. Toss bacon pieces in olive oil with acorn squash mixture and serve.

Random Ingredients: cumin seed,milk,apricot,almond extract,bread,part mozzarella cheese,wild rice,noodle
title: Wild Rice and Apricots
ingredients: 5 cups milk | 4 tablespoons almond extract | 2 tablespoons cumin seeds | 1 1/2 cups wild rice | 1 cup sliced almonds | 1 can apricots, drained and minced | 1 cup mozzarella cheese, shredded | 1 lb medium noodles, cooked and drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. In large saucepan, combine milk, almond extract, and cumin seeds. Bring to boil. Add rice, reduce heat to medium low, cover, and simmer 20 minutes. Stir in chopped apricots and cheese. Set aside and keep warm. In 9x13 pan, combine rice pudding with remaining 1 cup of milk mixture, cover and bake until hot and bubbly. Sprinkle with almonds and bake 5 - 10 minutes. Serve on platter with a sprinkling of mozzarella cheese on the top.

title: Trout and Crab Sushi
ingredients: 2 cups freshly cooked crabmeat | 1/2 cup trout, chopped | 1/2 cup nori, soaked | 2 teaspoons garam masala | 1 lb chopped fresh kale | 2 ounces smoked trout, chopped
instructions: Mix all ingredients except trimmings. Spoon mixture into a baking sheet. Bake at 350 f for 20 minutes or until done.

title: Mustard Glazed Quince
ingredients: 3 3 large scotch bonnet peppers or 3 large jalapeno chiles, seeded and diced | 1 can tomato paste | 2 tablespoons dried mustard powder | 1 tablespoon rendered mustard fat or 1 tablespoon rendered quince fat
instructions: Heat a heavy 10 or 12 inch skillet over medium high heat. Add all of the ingredients and simmer for 5 minutes, or, for a darker, more fiery flavour, for about 15 minutes. Remove from the heat and allow to set. Cut into small squares and store in an airtight container in refrigerator.

title: Pasta With Lemons and Lemon
ingredients: 3 lemons, wedged | 5 1/2 ounces farfalle pasta
instructions: Heat a large cast iron skillet or electric frying pan over medium heat. Add about 2 tbls. Oil to the pan. Squeeze 1/2 of the lemons, and squeeze 1/2 over the lemons for a sweeter taste. Add the farfalle, and toss.

title: Spiced Mint Appetizer
ingredients: 3 cups fresh mint sprigs, stems removed | 1 cup frozen whipped topping, thawed
instructions: Place the mint sprigs upright in a decorative container. Sprinkle half of the whipped topping on top.

title: Tasty Low Fat Tacos
ingredients: 1 lb sausage ( i usually use mild for this, can also use ground beef or venison ) | 3 teaspoons vanilla sugar | 8 -16 taco sauce ( i usually use la choy )
instructions: Brown the sausage.

title: Spinach and Spinach Ladyfingers
ingredients: 4 packages fresh spinach, washed | 1 package ladyfingers | 1 teaspoon white pepper, ground
instructions: Place frozen spinach on the counter for about 10 minutes after defrosting. When defrosted, squeeze out excess moisture. Remove spinach from bags after defrosting. Rinse spinach thoroughly and dry with a clean cloth towels. Arrange a layer of ladyfingers on the spinach. Cover ladyfingers with spinach and sprinkle with white pepper. Repeat this pattern for another layer. Place in a microwave safe dish and cook on high heat in the microwave for 1 minute. Cover tightly and cook on high for 3 minutes, until dough is soft and puffy. Turn out onto a serving platter and let cool for 5 minutes.

title: Artichoke and Leek Corn Relish (Tayracha)
ingredients: 2 lbs ears of corn, in the husks | 1/2 lb leek, sliced very thin | 1 cup artichoke, in marinade | 1/4 teaspoon old bay seasonal salt | 1 teaspoon fresh chili, chilie de arbol
instructions: Place whole corn in pot and cover with cold salted water. Bring to a boil and boil uncovered for 10 minutes, then drain. Bring corn back to a boil, cover and cook over low heat for 30 minutes. Remove from heat and cool completely. Cut kernels off the corn. Combine all ingredients except garnishes in blender.

Random Ingredients: prosciutto,button mushroom,egg white,garlic powder,apricot,ginger garlic paste,red wine,sugar
title: Champagne Champagne Gratin
ingredients: 7 egg whites | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder | 4 -6 slices prosciutto | 4 -6 button mushrooms | 3 -4 medium portobello mushroomes ( if you're lucky ) | 1 -2 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 1/3 cup red wine | sugar
instructions: In a bowl, place egg whites and garlic in bowl with dry ingredients. Stir to form a paste. In a small saucepan, add red wine until the wine has almost completely absorbed it. This will take about five minutes. Keep stirring so that the paste doesn't stick to the bottom of the bowl. Cook for five minutes without boiling. Cut mushrooms into small slices but leave whole. Cut prosciutto in half. Arrange all of the above in a 6x8 pan. Do not slice mushrooms into strips just over the bottom of the pan. Keep at least two of the slices on top. Pour wine paste mix over mushrooms. Let sit covered with foil. Preheat oven to 200 degrees fahrenheit. Put pan in the oven. Cook for 20 minutes. Remove foil, stir a few times and cover the gratin for additional 10 minutes. Serve with some cream on the side.

Random Ingredients: tip roast,italian flat leaf parsley,roasting chicken,swiss cheese,allspice,port wine
title: Quick Chicken, Cheese and Port Wine Crock Pot
ingredients: 4 lbs small round tip roast or 4 lbs rump roast | 1/2 cup port wine ( i use a little less ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground allspice | 3 tablespoons dried italian flat leaf parsley | 1/4 cup swiss cheese, grated | 1 roasting chickens or 1 chicken quarter
instructions: Place in a slow cooker.

title: Calzones (Spanish Yellow Squash & Capsicum Fritters)
ingredients: 1 large yellow squash | 1/4 red capsicum ( capsicum may be very finely diced ) | 1/2 cup nonfat milk
instructions: Cut the yellow squash in half and discard the pulp, cut in half and cut into cubes. Slice the capsicum into thin slices on the angle. Blanch and dry the fritters in boiling water for a few seconds, drain well. Heat the nonfat milk and fry the vegetables for 3 - 4 minutes. Pour into a serving bowl and serve either hot or cold.

Random Ingredients: gruyere cheese,chili pepper flake,chicken stock cube,vegetable oil,coriander powder,tomato puree,thyme,mustard
title: Lentil Soup
ingredients: 2 teaspoons vegetable oil | 500 g ground chicken or 500 g ground turkey | 2 teaspoons mustard | 1 teaspoon thyme | 1 teaspoon chili pepper flakes | 125 ml tomato puree | 300 ml chicken stock or 300 ml vegetable stock cubes | 3 tablespoons freshly grated gruyere cheese
instructions: Heat oil in a large pan, add the chilies and cook for 1 min, then add the mustard and thyme and cook for 1 minute. Add the ground meat, mix well and add the tomato puree and stock. Bring to the boil, lower heat and simmer 15 mins, stirring frequently. Season to taste and stir in the cheese. Ladle into warmed soup bowls and serve with slices of crusty bread to dip.

Random Ingredients: garlic salt,cashew,anaheim chilies,salsa,fruit,sharp cheddar cheese,taco seasoning mix,yeast
title: Salsa and Cheese Croissants
ingredients: 1 tablespoon instant yeast | 1 cup salsa | 1 cup shredded sharp cheddar cheese | 1/2 teaspoon instant yeast | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt | 1/2 teaspoon taco seasoning mix | 1/4 cup dry roasted cashews, chopped | 1/2 cup chopped dried mixed fruit
instructions: Dissolve the yeast in 1/2 cup hot water. Add salsa and mix until smooth. Set aside in a warm location till frothy. In a separate bowl, mix the next seven ingredients till well blended, except cashews and dried fruit. Add the yeast mixture to the salsa and stir well. Cover and let rise in a warm place till bubbly. Stir in the cashews. Drop by a tablespoon onto a greased and floured cookie sheet. The idea is to flatten the dough out till it is about 1/2 inch thick. Spread bean curd evenly over each cookie, being careful not to disturb the dough. Bake at 400 till done, 15 - 20 minute. Serve warm. Enjoy.

title: Fish With Sultanas and Horseradish
ingredients: 4 white fish fillets | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 2/3 cup sultana, mixed with | 1 teaspoon horseradish
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees centigrade. Cut each fillet lengthways into 1 cm wide slices, brush with oil, then place on a lightly oiled oven tray. Sprinkle sultanas and horseradish on it. Bake 35 minutes. Increase oven temperature to 180 degrees centigrade. Cook fish for another 15 minutes or until cooked. Serve with seasonal vegetables.

title: Posh Vegetarian Beef Salad
ingredients: 2 vegetarian beef strips | 1 tablespoon tahini | 1/2 teaspoon allspice | 1 tablespoon sesame seeds | 1/3 cup spinach
instructions: Sauté the meat in 1/2 tbs olive or vegetable oil and the allspice in a large salad bowl. Drain the meat and add it to the salad bowl. Drain the remaining oil if needed. Sprinkle with sesame seeds and spinach.

title: Omani Rice
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups long grain rice | 1/2 cup green food coloring | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried leaf thyme
instructions: Combine the rice, food colorings, and thyme in a 2 cup non stick saucepan over medium heat, stirring often, until hot and bubbly, 8 to 10 minutes. Cover and remove from the heat. Allow to sit 10 minutes. Fluff with a fork and serve warm.

title: Seared Pork Chops With Green-Onion Vinaigrette
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless pork chops, about 3/4-1-1 inch thick | 2 cups mayonnaise, divided | 1/4 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1 teaspoon finely chopped fresh cilantro | 3 tablespoons fresh lime juice | 2 green cardamoms | salt and asafoetida powder, to taste
instructions: For the vinaigrette, whisk together 1/4 cup of mayonnaise, asafetida, cilantro, lime juice and cardamom in small bowl. Brush a 10 inch nonstick skillet with cooking spray.

title: Easy Baked Beans
ingredients: 6 cans cannellini beans, undrained | 1 package onions and a few dry flakes | 1 can hot sauce | shredded fresh cream cheese or melted imitation bacon | toothpicks
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Combine beans with salt, pepper and hot sauce. Spray a 9 x 13 casserole dish with pam. Sprinkle with 1/2 a package of crumbled or crumbled imitation bacon.

Random Ingredients: dark corn syrup,extra virgin olive oil,kelp
title: Kelp
ingredients: 20 pounds extra-virgin olive oil | 1 cup dark corn syrup | 5 pounds finely ground kelp
instructions: In a large saucepan over low heat, warm the oil, corn syrup, and kelp to near boiling. Reduce heat, and simmer, stirring frequently, just until all the syrup is completely absorbed. Using a funnel set into a jar, gradually pour the kelp through the funnel and pour into a clean jar.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon,savoy cabbage,salt pork,bread flour,sirloin,cheese,cream chicken soup
title: Cream of Chicken Stuffing
ingredients: 1 head savoy cabbage, shredded | 1/2 lb salt pork | 1 1/2 lbs sirloin, chopped | 2 cans cream of chicken soup | 1 1/2 teaspoons salt-free instant chicken bouillon | 1 cup bread flour | 1/2 cup cheese, grated
instructions: Set aside 1/3 of the shredded cabbage. Dice up salt pork and place in crockpot. Add cream of chicken soup and bouillon. Stir in salt free shredded cabbage. Cover and cook on low setting for 6 hours, stirring at least once. Remove the shredded cabbage to a serving platter and place in serving bowl. Take the remaining shredded cabbage and chop it up, place in serving bowl. Add salt free shredded cabbage to bowl of cabbage. Pour the sauce over mixture. Mix well. Serve on top of chicken stuffing. Sprinkle bread crumbs on top, and then sprinkle with grated cheese.

Random Ingredients: white vinegar,brandy,red chili pepper,hamburger bun,sherry wine,yogurt,sea salt,crescent dinner
title: The Real Deal Cuban Burgers
ingredients: 2 cans refrigerated crescent dinner rolls | 1 1/4 cups thick yogurt | 1 tablespoon dry sherry wine | 1 1/2 cups shredded cooked hamburger buns ( about 3 ounces ) | 2 tablespoons white vinegar | 1/2 - 1 tablespoon light brown sugar or 1/2-1 tablespoon dark brown sugar | 2 -4 fresh red chili peppers or 2 -4 thai red chili peppers, minced in a mortar | 1/4 - 1/3 cup brandy
instructions: Heat can of crescent rolls in microwave for 3 - 4 minutes. Remove and unroll, keeping remaining can of rolls warm. Combine yogurt and sherry in a small bowl. Stir in 1 1/4 cup brown sugar, cheese, chili peppers or chili pepper juice from chile pepper. Cut crescents into 16 strips or thin slices and add to yogurt mixture. Stir well to mix. Place breadcrumbs in a large bowl. Divide mixture into 16 equal portions, then sprinkle with remaining 1 teaspoon white vinegar. Mix lightly and shape into patties. Place on a greased grill, or on a hot pan. Grill for 15 minutes or until cooked through and browned, about 5 minutes per side. Transfer to a cutting board and let stand 10 minutes. Spoon giardiniera, a spoonful of giardiniera on each one and a toothpick through the middle of the slice to serve. Serve hot.

title: Pineapple-Covered Lasagna
ingredients: 1 can bamboo shoots, drained | 1 teaspoon table salt | 2 teaspoons vanilla essence | 12 lasagna noodles, cooked and drained | 1 bunch fresh dill, chopped | 2 cups pineapples, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees. Mix together the bamboo shoots with salt. Lightly grease a baking dish and put half the sauce in the bottom of dish. Put half of the noodles on top of the sauce sprinkle half of the dill, half of the pineapple, half of the nuts, half of the pineapples. Repeat and finish with 2nd layer. Bake for 45 minutes.

title: Tropical Shrimp With Grapes and Grape
ingredients: 2 cups large shrimp, peeled | 2 cups red seedless grapes, halved on the diagonal
instructions: Preheat ove to 400°f line a baking sheet with parchment. Combine shrimp, grapes, and 6 tbsp of water in a medium bowl. Toss to coat.

title: Ginger Crouton Chips
ingredients: 1 cup seasoned garlic croutons | 1 teaspoon ground ginger | 1/3 cup prepared yellow mustard
instructions: Mash garlic croutons with ginger in a mortar and pestle over medium heat. Remove the mixture with a spatula and slowly mix in the mustard. Store croutons in a dry container.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast,baking potato,french baguette,okra,portabella mushroom,corn oil,grand marnier
title: Grilled Sweet Bread on the Grill
ingredients: 1 fresh french baguette, sliced crosswise into 1/2-inch thick thick slices | 2 1/2 tablespoons corn oil | 1 -2 tablespoon grand marnier | 1 lb fresh okra, trimmed, rinsed and coarsely chopped | 1 cup fresh sliced portabella mushroom ( or other fresh mushrooms ) | 1 chicken breast, thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons fresh minced garlic
instructions: Brush a grill basket or baking sheet with some oil. Arrange the bread slices on a cutting board. Place 2 or 3 slices of okra and 1/2 t. Grand marnier in the center of 4 pieces of bread. Brush around the edges of the bread with some of the remaining oil. Add some of the remaining okra slices or mushrooms. Top with more okra slices or mushrooms. Using 1 t. Grand marnier or a little more, brush around the insides of the bread to help keep it from sticking. Using a serated knife or the back of a large spoon, slice an x on the top of the bread slices.

Random Ingredients: red potato,coriander powder,mint,fish sauce,lime wedge,bread,balsamic vinegar,pimiento
title: Thai Stuffed Red Potatoes
ingredients: 4 small red potatoes | 200 g bread, thickly sliced ( or a packet of toasted bread pieces ) | 2 tablespoons chopped coriander powder | 2 tablespoons fish sauce | 1 tablespoon lime wedge, to serve ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon red wine vinegar | 1/4 tablespoon chopped of fresh mint, to garnish | 1 jar sliced pimientos, drained
instructions: Boil potatoes until tender, drain. Meanwhile, in a bowl, mix together coriander and fish sauce until well combined. Slice each potato lengthways into quarters and scoop out as many pulp as possible. Set aside. Brush the potato skins with a little oil and bake in a hot pan, turning a few times, until golden brown, about 10 minutes. Topping, arrange bread on serving plates, drizzle with any juices and chopped coriander, then top with the potato slices. Drizzle with any remaining liquid, garnish with mint and pimentos, serve immediately. Tip, if using toasted bread pieces, toast the bread in a dry frying pan, turning several times, until golden brown.

title: Madeira Smoked Farmer Cheese Ball
ingredients: 2 packages farmer cheese ( farmer cheese ) | 1/2 cup chopped leeks ( white part only ) | 2 tablespoons madeira wine or 2 tablespoons marsala | 2 cans condensed cream of chicken soup | 1/2 cup crumbled feta
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Heat a small amount of oil in a non stick skillet over medium heat. Add the leeks and cook, stirring frequently for 2 minutes. Add the smoked farmer cheese and fry until it is browned and crumbly. Remove the bacon and set aside. Stir together the soup, leeks and crumbled farmer cheese in a bowl. Place in a small casserole dish and sprinkle with the crumbly cheese. Smear with the bacon fat and bake until the topping is golden, about 40 minutes.

title: Pan Poached Halibut in Mango and Green Beans
ingredients: 4 medium red potatoes, halved | 12 ounces halibut fillets, cut into 3 x 1/2, 1/2 inch cubes | 8 ounces green beans, trimmed and cut diagonal slices on bias | 2 scallions, cut on bias | 8 ounces penne | 5 ounces mangoes, cut into 1/2 inch slices | 1/2 cup wine | 1/2 cup fresh bread, cut into slivers
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f. In a large glass or plastic baking dish, toss potatoes with halibut, green beans, scallions and penne. Season with salt and pepper. Arrange bread on top. Combine mango, wine and enough liquid from mango mixture to moisten. Bake 30 minutes until fish is just cooked. Remove from oven. Place fish in serving dish, add mango mixture. Garnish with slivers of scallions and serve.

Random Ingredients: port wine,bulgar wheat,sesame oil,marmalade,dijon mustard,cornstarch,italian parsley
title: Steamed Tasty Bulgur
ingredients: 1 cup bulgar wheat | 6 cups steamed port wine, divided ( not boiled ) or 6 cups broth ( not boiled ) | 1 cup minced italian parsley | 1 cup sesame oil | 1/4 cup marmalade or 1/4 cup almond flavoring | 2 tablespoons dijon mustard | 1/2 cup cornstarch
instructions: Rinse and drain bulgur, if any. Place bulgur in large bowl of cold water for a few minutes while water is seeping across bowl. Drain 1/2 cup. Combine and toss with a pinch of salt. Set aside. Repeat steps 3 to 5 with rest of wheat, pour about ½ cup boiling water into large pot. Add remaining 1 cup port, parsley, sesame oil, marmalade or almond flavoring and mustard. Stir until well blended. Cover and place in steamer. Bring to boil over high heat, reduce heat, cover.

title: Quick and Easy Pad Thai
ingredients: 4 ounces flat rice noodles | 2 tablespoons peanut butter | 1/4 teaspoon hot sauce
instructions: Cook the noodles according to pack directions. Drain and rinse with cold water or rinse rice mat, if desired. Combine peanut butter with hot sauce. Dip noodles in mixture and stir until all are covered. Serve with chili, soy sauce and green bell pepper strips.

Random Ingredients: vanilla bean,watercress leaf,brown basmati rice,prosciutto,baking powder,cardamom,dense white bread
title: Prosciutto-Wrapped Sandwiches With Brown Basmati Rice
ingredients: 1/2 cup brown basmati rice | 4 1/4 fluid ounces boiling water | 4 slices dense white bread, unsliced | 1 sprig fresh dallions or 3 sprigs fresh green onion, trimmed and cut into 5 thin slices ( to garnish ) | 4 -6 slices prosciutto ( thin slices ) | 1/4 cup coarsely chopped watercress leaf | 2 teaspoons baking powder | 1/8 - 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom
instructions: Soak the rice in 1 cup boiling water for 20 minutes. Drain before using. Heat the remaining 3 ounces boiling water in a small saucepan over low heat. Working in batches, add the bread and let them soak, turning occasionally with tongs, until both sides are toasted. Remove the bread from the water and tear into pieces.

Random Ingredients: cream mushroom soup,red chili pepper,garlic,capicola,shell pasta,carnation milk,vanilla extract,pineapple juice
title: Pasta With Red Chili and Pineapple Cream
ingredients: 1 bag small shell pasta | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 4 tablespoons carnation evaporated milk | 1 can crushed pineapple in juice | 1 jar capicola ( drained ) | 2 tablespoons red chili peppers, minced | 1/2 teaspoon garlic, minced | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
instructions: Cook pasta until tender, drain. Mix remaining ingredients, pour over pasta and toss. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour. Serve chilled.

Random Ingredients: red lentil,salami,bok choy,enchilada sauce,green bell pepper,parsley leaf,manchego cheese
title: Red Lentils and Cheese
ingredients: 1 cup red lentils, rinsed and drained | 2 bunches bok choy, chopped | 1 green bell pepper, chopped | 3/4 lb salami, chopped | 1/2 cup enchilada sauce | 4 ounces manchego cheese, shredded | 1/2 cup fresh parsley leaves, chopped
instructions: Place the lentils, bok choy and bell pepper in a large skillet. Over medium heat, cook the salami until it has softened. Add the salami mixture to the lentils and vegetables. Add the enchilada sauce and stir well. Simmer for a few minutes until the cheese is melted. Garnish with parsley and serve right away.

Random Ingredients: chili pepper flake,green bell pepper,pear,black pepper,dark rum
title: Pear and Hot Pepper Cocktail
ingredients: 2 red peaches ( ripe ) | 3 green bell peppers | 3 -3 tablespoons dark rum | 1 -2 tablespoon fresh chili pepper flakes ( or to taste ) | 1 pinch black pepper ( optional )
instructions: Peel, slice, and pit the red and green peppers. Cut the peppers in half and remove the core so you don't lose the pith. Slice each half on the diagonal into 1/4 inch slices and discard the hard core. Peel the green peppers and slice in half lengthwise. Remove the seeds from the peppers and cut the rest into wedges. Place the sugar in a small bowl by placing the pepper wedges in a sieve and pressing hard on the seeds with your fingers to release the fruit juices. Place the rum in a small saucepan and slowly begin heating over medium heat, until it just starts bubbling around the edges. Remove from heat and add the hot pepper juice. Taste for salt, stir and add pepper flakes if desired. Pour over the fruit and serve.

title: Cranberry Potato Wedges
ingredients: 1/4 cup shredded red potatoes | 1/2 cup chopped fresh cranberries | 1 teaspoon dried italian seasoning | 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour
instructions: In a small mixing bowl, thoroughly combine all ingredients except flour. Toss to coat. Cover and chill 4 hours. Coat a baking sheet with non stick cooking spray. Dredge potato wedges in flour, shaking off excess. Arrange wedges in a single layer in a single layer on the pan and scatter lightly with potato mixture. Bake in 400f degree oven for 12 to 15 minutes or until cooked through.

title: Sesame-Stuffed Biscotti-Cookers
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups all-purpose flour | 1 medium cinnamon stick | 1/2 cup sesame seeds, toasted
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degree f. Mix flour and cinnamon stick. Stir sesame seeds into the flour mixture. If dough is too dry, add 1 t. Of water a little at a time. Turn dough onto lightly floured board. Using hands, shape dough into 4 long logs. Flatten logs with the bottom of a drinking glass. Cover dough with plastic wrap and transfer to cookie sheets. Bake in preheated oven until golden brown, about 20 minutes. Remove from sheets and cool slightly, about 10 minutes. Transfer biscotti to a wire rack. Using a serrated knife, cut each log crosswise into 1/4 slices. Serve warm.

title: Pesto-Sun-Dried Tomato Pasta
ingredients: 4 ounces sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained | 1 teaspoon sun-dried tomato oil | 1 cup thick tomato-flavoured pesto sauce
instructions: Place the pesto sauce in a blender. Pulse 4 times or until smooth, adding olive oil gradually if necessary. Toss the sun dried tomatoes with 1 teaspoon of the sun dried tomato oil and pour into the blender. Pulse 8 times or until you have a pesto sauce that is bright and smooth. Transfer to a serving dish and top with the fresh pesto. Saudies and rissole.

title: Grammy's Special Corn Dogs and Spicy Patties
ingredients: 5 cups leftover cooked ground pork | 1 package chopped fresh fruit | 1 large radish, coarsely chopped | 1 cup graham cracker crumbs | 2 teaspoons mustard seed, or as needed
instructions: Place all ingredients except graham cracker crumbs in a large bowl. Mix thoroughly. Place 1 tablespoon of filling into prepared gyro skillet, and cook over hot coals. Cook until the meat begins to pull away from the edge of the pan, and the filling is hot. Serve with fruit or guacomole for dipping.

title: Chickpea Flour Pizza Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 cup chickpea flour | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 1 tablespoon sherry wine | 1 carton fresh frozen topping, thawed
instructions: Combine the flour, worcestershire sauce, sherry, and beef base. Stir. Drop the pizza dough by spoonfuls onto pre greased pizza pans or place on baking sheets. Press down lightly. Brush surface with a thin film of oil. Bake at 400 degrees for 1 - 15 minutes, or if it fries out of the oven you may need to stir the pizza halfway through the cooking time. It can also be left on pan until the last few minutes of baking.

Random Ingredients: steak fillet,active yeast,whipping cream,green onion,parmigiano reggiano cheese,pork,tahini,pita bread
title: Pita Bagnat
ingredients: 2 cups whipping cream, divided | 2 1/4 teaspoons active dry yeast, separated | 1/4 teaspoon active dry yeast | 2 lbs lean top round roast or 2 lbs pork fillets, cut into 3/4 inch cubes | 2 cups fresh parmigiano-reggiano cheese, grated | 1/4 cup tahini, stirred, plus | 2 teaspoons tahini, divided | 1 1/2 cups whipping cream, divided | 2 green onions, thinly sliced | 2 -4 pita bread, warmed | green onion, sliced
instructions: Mix 1 cup whipping cream with 2 1/4 teaspoon active dry yeast, and stir in 1/4 cup grated cheese until smooth. Stir in remaining 1 1/4 cup grated cheese except for green onions. Let dough rise uncovered in a warm place until doubled in bulk, about 1 hour. Preheat oven to 500 degrees. Lightly grease a 12x18 inch pan with cooking spray. Spread bread cubes in prepared pan.

title: Sweet Chilli Rice
ingredients: 1 2/3 cups basmati rice | 1 -2 tablespoon tamari | 2 -4 red hot peppers, finely diced and threaded onto skewers ( any variety of hot pepper is preferred ) | 300 g red capsicums, sliced thinly on two long metal skewers | 1/2 cup roasted red currant jam ( also labelled as'sambal oelek') | 1/2 cup finely chopped fresh coriander
instructions: Rinse the rice in a strainer and drain well. Bring a large saucepan of water to the boil, add the salt, rice and all the seasoning to a boil. Cover and reduce heat, simmering for 20 minutes. Remove from heat and leave for 5 minutes. Transfer the rice to a large, warmed serving dish. Add all remaining ingredients to the rice and mix together, adding a tablespoon of water per serving if necessary.

Random Ingredients: sherry wine,green bell pepper,lettuce leaf,orange juice
title: Mangolian Spaghettini (Gado Gado Yum)
ingredients: 1 head lettuce leaves ( romaine, mesclun or chard leaves ) | 1/3 cup fresh orange juice | 3 green bell peppers, sliced | 1/4 cup sherry wine ( optional but good ) or 1/4 cup white wine vinegar ( optional but good )
