instructions: Wash and dry the lettuce. Cut into small, even size pieces. Toss together the lettuce, orange juice, bell peppers, and sherry. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: golden syrup,confectioner sugar,green cardamom pod,yellow bell pepper,vegetable protein,corn,white vinegar,ranch bean
title: Ethiopian Sweet Potato and Bean Soup
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups textured vegetable protein ( like goya ) | 10 tablespoons distilled white vinegar | 1 cup golden syrup | 40 red-skinned yellow bell peppers, cut into 1-inch strips | 2 tablespoons corn, divided | 10 large green cardamom pods | 3 1/2 cups sweet potatoes with shell and tender green outer skin, cut into 1/2-inch dice | 1 can navy beans, drained | 1 package confectioners'sugar
instructions: Place the tvp in a large pot over medium high heat, then stir in the vinegar, golden syrup, yellow peppers, and half of the cardamom pods. Place the sweet potatoes in a large saucepan, and fill with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil, then simmer over low heat for 15 minutes. Drain, and place the sweet potatoes back into the pot, along with the sweet potatoes. Stir in the beans, and add more water to just cover the sweet potatoes. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low, and cook 30 minutes, or until the sweet potatoes and vegetables are tender and the flavors have blended. Serve hot topped with confectioners' sugar, and serve hot.

title: Ziti With Peanuts, Ham Hocks and Vegetables
ingredients: 1/2 lb ziti pasta | 6 -8 medium ripe bananas ( cut in half and into half rounds ) | 1/2 lb smoked ham hock | 1/4 cup half-and-half | 1 cup sour cream | 1/2 teaspoon crushed dried mace | 2 tablespoons canola oil
instructions: In a medium sauce pan bring water to a boil. Add 1/2 teaspoons salt, ziti and peppers. Cook until al dente, and drain. Wipe down the pan with a clean towel. Return water to a boil, add the honey, sour cream and nutmeg to taste then heat to a simmer. Set aside and keep hot. Meanwhile heat oil in a large frying pan and brown ham hocks. Mix the reserved meat with the warmed honey mustard dressing to warm. Add the ziti, pepper mixture, and banana rounds, mix well and bring to a boil. Lower heat and simmer for about 15 minutes or until ziti is al dente. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: kidney bean,shrimp paste,muscovado sugar,onion soup mix,balsamic vinegar,herbes de provence,pork sparerib,bell pepper
title: Sweet and Sour Spareribs
ingredients: 6 pork spareribs | 1/2 cup chopped onion soup mix | 3 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 1 tablespoon herbes de provence | 2 1/2 teaspoons shrimp paste | 2 teaspoons herbes de provence | 1 tablespoon dried herbes de provence | 2 tablespoons muscovado sugar | 1 onion, chopped | 1 small bell pepper, chopped
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees f. Place the ribs in a shallow baking dish. In a bowl, mix together the onion soup mix, vinegar, herbes de provence, shrimp paste, herbes de provence, muscoshire cheese, onions and bell peppers. Pour over the ribs. Bake, covered, in the preheated oven until very tender, about 2 hours. Remove from the oven and let stand for 15 minutes to cool before serving.

title: Lettuce Wrapped Tilapia
ingredients: 20 ounces tilapia fillets, cut in half horizontally | 1 tablespoon chopped celery rib | 1/4 cup light cream | 1/4 cup light cream | 2 tablespoons dry sherry | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh sage | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1/4 cup toasted cashews ( optional )
instructions: Preheat broiler. Place tilapia fillets on a broiler pan. Spread celery on top of fillets, and broil over high until lightly browned and flakey, about 5 minutes. Meanwhile, combine the remaining ingredients in a small saucepan. Remove from heat and stir until heated. Place the sprinkel in a small serving bowl with a lid. Spread tilapia fillets with the sprinkel, top with the cashews and sour cream, drizzle dressing over, and serve immediately.

title: Linguine Al Limone (Linguine With icing sugar)
ingredients: 1 box linguine ( about 1 pound ) | 1 cup icing sugar ( confectioner's sugar ) | icing sugar
instructions: Cook pasta al dente in salted water until al dente. Drain and while still hot, transfer pasta to a large platter. Spread icing sugar on top of pasta, and sprinkle with icing sugar to coat evenly.

title: English Mustard Cheese Spread
ingredients: 1 cup shredded mozzarella cheese | 2 tablespoons prepared english mustard
instructions: In a bowl, mix together the mozzarella cheese, french mustard and the mustard. Cover and refrigerate the spread for at least an hour for the flavors to combine. Serve in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: vegetable shortening,cardamom seed,black mustard seed,cilantro,tamarind pulp,caper,pineapple chunk,beef stock
title: Capejack
ingredients: 2 cups tomato-based stock | 3 tablespoons vegetable shortening | 1 tablespoon fresh-crust black mustard seeds | 2 tablespoons tamarind pulp, crushed with hands | 1 tablespoon crushed cardamom seed | 2 tablespoons drained capers | 1/2 cup shredded pineapple chunks | 1/2 cup roughly chopped cilantro, or more to taste ( optional )
instructions: Bring 1 cup of tomato stock and 1 tablespoon shortening to boil in a saucepan over medium heat.

title: Gorgonzola Roast Nips With Parsnips
ingredients: 5 parsnips, trimmed, quartered | 1 package gorgonzola, crumbled | 2 1/2 tablespoons triple sec | parsnip, sliced crosswise into fourths
instructions: Preheat oven to 400'f. Pour boiling water into baking dish large enough to submerge the gorgonzola and parsnips. Add gorgonzola/sugar/triple sec/parsnip mixture to dish and toss to combine. The gorgonzola parsnips should be just barely covered with liquid. Transfer to the oven and roast until tender and golden brown, about 25 minutes. When the roast nips are done, toss with parsnips to combine.

Random Ingredients: orange juice zest,apricot preserve,red potato,raspberry vinegar
title: Fruit Salad With Grape-Spice Dressing
ingredients: 1 medium red potato, cooked and shredded | 1 1/4 cups apricot preserves | 2 tablespoons raspberry vinegar | 1 teaspoon orange juice, orange blossom water or 1 teaspoon zest of about 1 orange
instructions: Put the potatoes, apricot preserves, vinegar orange blossom water or orange zest in a bowl. Toss lightly to coat. Serve on lettuce leaves.

Random Ingredients: green bell pepper,dark brown sugar,cilantro stem,broccoli floret
title: Chinese Style Broccoli Salad
ingredients: 1 lb broccoli floret | 1/2 cup green bell pepper, chopped | 1/4 cup fresh cilantro stems, chopped | 1/4 cup dark brown sugar ( packed )
instructions: Cook broccoli until tender crisp, about 3 minutes. Drain well and rinse with cold water.

Random Ingredients: jalapeno juice,leek,fish sauce,pear,phyllo pastry,rice wine vinegar,pecan half,serrano pepper
title: Thai Pear Sambal
ingredients: 2 pears, finely chopped | 12 phyllo pastry sheets | 3 leeks, halved lengthwise and sliced thinly crosswise | 1 jalapeno pepper, minced | 1 1/2 tablespoons fish sauce ( thai dio kway teow ) | 2 tablespoons rice wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons minced pickled jalapeno juice | 2 tablespoons toasted pecan halves
instructions: Place chopped pears in a small bowl and add enough water to cover. Let sit for 10 minutes, drain and chop well. Preheat oven to 375°f. Mix leeks, jalapeno, fish sauce, rice wine vinegar, and minced pickled jalapeno juice in a small bowl.

Random Ingredients: cottage cheese,almond extract,salt,cremini mushroom,orange juice,korean red pepper paste,tahini,currant
title: Spicy Almond-Stuffed Mushrooms
ingredients: 4 lbs cremini mushrooms, cap | 1 cup orange juice ( about 6 oranges ) | 3/4 cup tahini | 3/4 cup cottage cheese | 1 teaspoon salt | 1 teaspoon orange extract | 1 teaspoon korean red pepper paste ( gochujang ) | 1 teaspoon dried currants or 1 teaspoon sherry wine vinegar
instructions: Preheat the oven to 250 degrees f. Trim the mushrooms of stems if desired. Remove the caps of each mushroom if they're large. Starting at the stem end, carefully open them. Cut off the center ribs of each mushroom. Stuff the mushroom caps with the orange juice from the oranges. Use a spätzle or a spoon to stuff the reserved mushroom caps. Place them in a 3 to 4 quart crock. In a medium bowl, stir together the tahini, cottage cheese, salt, extract, chile paste and red pepper. Pour evenly over each mushroom cap. Spread the currants evenly over the top of the mushroom caps. Place the mushrooms in a large roasting pan. Roast for 45 to 55 minutes, basting often, until the meat is crisp and the liquid has reduced to a sauce consistency.

Random Ingredients: wheat germ,topping,italian plum tomato,raisin,cumin seed,beer,bread,orange peel
title: Smoky Tomato and Raisin Sandwich
ingredients: 8 slices bread, toasted | 16 ounces beer | 1 small italian plum tomatoes, chopped | 3/4 cup raisins | 2 tablespoons mixed light-colored wheat germ | 1 tablespoon ground cumin seed | 1 teaspoon grated orange peel | 3/4 cup fat-free whipped topping, such as cool whip, or as desired
instructions: Spread bread with beer. Layer with plum tomatoes, raisins, wheat germ, cumin, and orange peel. Top with whipped topping. Eat with a vegetable, or serve with a snack with a crisp green salad.

title: Lemon Chicken
ingredients: 16 chicken wings | 1 whole lemon, zest of
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Cut wings into 2 inch pieces. Place onto oven rack. Sprinkle with lemon zest on top. Bake for 40 minutes.

title: Pot-Roasted Beef & Quinoa Casserole
ingredients: 1 lb beef stew meat, cubed | 1 package refrigerated biscuits mix | 1 1/2 cups crumbled fontina or 1 1/2 cups mozzarella cheese | 20 cherry tomatoes, halved | 1 package instant quinoa, uncooked | 1/4 cup granulated sugar | 2 cups seasoned store-bought flour ( see recipe below )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Place all ingredients inside a shallow 2 1/2 or 3 quart baking dish. Mix the flour with 1/2 cup water in a bowl, or by hand. Make a well in the center, add the flour mixture, stir until the dough comes together, and comes away from the sides of the bowl. Do not overmix.

Random Ingredients: graham cracker crumb,rice,white pepper,guacamole,honeydew melon,pecan,jellied cranberry sauce,molasses
title: Robyn's Hawaiian Grill Corned Beef
ingredients: 1 package graham cracker crumbs | 1 tablespoon white pepper | 3/4 cup molasses | 1 lb corned beef, thinly sliced | 14 ounces jellied cranberry sauce | 1 cup finely chopped unpeeled pecans | 1 cup finely chopped guacamole | cooked rice
instructions: In a 1 1/2 or 2 quart crock pot, sprinkle Graham cracker crumbs with white pepper. Stir in molasses. Add corned beef and cranberry sauce. Cover and cook on high 3 - 3 hours or on low 5 - 7 hours. Mix pecans, guacamole and warm through. Serve over rice.

title: Crowded Brussels Sprouts
ingredients: 1 pound brussels sprouts | 2 tablespoons asafoetida powder
instructions: Put brussels sprouts in a pot and cover with water. Bring to a boil, then simmer over medium heat until tender, about 15 minutes. Drain. Transfer to a bowl. Mash, or press through a sieve, until finely chopped. Return brussels sprouts and liquid to pot and simmer until flavors are blended, about five minutes.

Random Ingredients: cottage cheese,graham cracker crumb,allspice,grain bun,herb,curry powder
title: Curried Cheese Loaf
ingredients: 3 1/2 cups cottage cheese | 1 cup whole grain breadcrumbs | 1/2 cup chopped fresh herb ( such as dill, parsley, or coriander ) | 1 teaspoon salt | 1 teaspoon mixed dried herbs ( such as dill, parsley, or coriander ) | 1 teaspoon curry powder | 1/2 teaspoon ground allspice, divided
instructions: In a medium bowl, stir together cottage cheese, bread crumbs, herbs, salt, curried powder, and allspice until evenly combined. Spoon into a loaf pan. Place loaf pan on rack in an oven. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Bake loaf on a baking sheet until center no longer jiggles when tapped, 30 to 35 minutes. Cool loaf in pan on a rack. Cut into 1 inch thick slices.

title: Mustard and Beer Wings, Beer Can S
ingredients: 10 -12 chicken wings | 6 ounces dark beer | 2 tablespoons whole grain mustard
instructions: Line a baking tray with parchment paper. Put wings in, cover with beer. Bake at 425 degrees f. For about 40 minutes or until soft. Remove wings from baking tray and let cool. Discard marinade. Combine mustard and remaining beer. Pour over wings, coating top.

title: Chocolate Quesadillas
ingredients: 1 cup semisweet chocolate | 1/2 teaspoon sea salt or 1/2 teaspoon regular salt | 1/2 teaspoon celtic sea salt or 1/2 teaspoon regular salt | 1/4 fresh turmeric, pod scored or 1/4 tsp ground roasted decorinated sea salt | 3 -4 pita bread, warmed ( for sandwich ) | sesame seeds
instructions: Grate semisweet chocolate over the smallest bowl that you can manage. Use a fine screen of vegetable peeler, vegetable peeler or grater to remove all of the white lumps. Combine remaining ingredients in a bowl. Use as a dip or spread for warmed pita chips or bread slices. Toast pita on both sides in a toaster or under the broiler until lightly browned and patted dry, 3 - 5 minutes depending on how light brown it looks. Sprinkle lightly with toasted sesame seeds. Enjoy.

title: Pork Salad with Spaghetti
ingredients: 8 ounces uncooked spaghetti noodles | 1 cooked pork shoulder | 2 tablespoons brewed coffee | 3/4 cup mixed salad greens | 1/4 cup dried fruit, soaked in hot water to cover
instructions: Cook pasta until just tender but still firm. Drain and run cold water over it. Place pork in a large salad bowl. Toss with the beans and 1 tablespoon of the brewed coffee. Toss with pasta.

Random Ingredients: italian parsley,maraschino cherry,puff pastry,pork chop,mix,beef stew meat,canola oil
title: Pork and Beef Wellingtons
ingredients: 1 lb boneless pork chop, cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 1/2 lb beef stew meat | 4 tablespoons italian parsley, minced | 2 tablespoons canola oil or 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 3 tablespoons canola oil or 3 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1 package frozen puff pastry sheets | your favorite sweet pickle relish ( optional ) | 2 maraschino cherries, halved
instructions: Preheat oven to 500 degrees. Combine pork and beef in bowl of cold water until just pink, about 3 minutes. Drain. Add parsley, 2 tablespoons oil and 1 tablespoon vegetable oil. Mix well. Place on greased baking sheet. Bake for 10 minutes. Remove from oven. While pork mixture is baking, roll out puff pastry puff sheets on a lightly floured surface to a large rectangle. Place on top of meat mixture. Bake for 10 - 15 minutes, remove and cut through center of dough. This makes it a perfect heart shaped pastry dough. Repeat with the rest of the dough. This dough is delicious and doesn't taste sweet. When pork mixture is done, place on serving platter and top with sweet pickle relish. Serve with warm crusty bread.

title: White Chocolate Chicken
ingredients: 4 ounces cream cheese or 4 ounces ricotta cheese | 4 ounces white chocolate, melted | 4 ounces dried white bread, crusts removed | 1 small chicken ( cut up )
instructions: Melt the choc. Stuff the chicken with the melted choc. Wrap the outside of the bread with the cream cheese or ricotta cheese. Place in a foil lined pan. Bake at 300 degrees. When cooked serve topped with the chocolate..

title: X-Rated Quesadilla (Or "tortilla Chip " Using the Freezer " Easy Home Oven Frying " )
ingredients: 1 bag tortilla chips, such as x-rated ( about 1 cup ) | 2 teaspoons of x-rated fusion liqueur ( or any other liqueur ) ( optional ) | 0.5 can libby's plain celtios ( optional ) or 1/2 - 3/4 cup of diet x-rated zatar ( optional )
instructions: Line the bottom of a deep fryer with aluminum foil.. Wrap the tortilla chips around a handful or small plate, pushing them down with your hands. Dip them into the reaming or re packing the chips. Repeat with the other handfuls, pressing down as necessary. Dump the contents into your freezer bag and freeze until ready to use. You'll have about 3 - 4 frozen tortilla chips in total.. In the same pan, add fusion and 2 tsp of zatar. Stir once or twice until the zatar dissolves. If using, simply mix it into the mix as well. If this is too bland, add the remaining 2 tsp of zatie's. Turn the heat up slightly at this point to get a caramelized liquid. If it gets too thick, add more orange juice, stirring up every so often. Note, if using your own chips, i like to make sure everything is covered in the zatie's and no zatie's on the bottom. If you make these without the fusion or fusion, add more of the zatie's or none of the zatie's. If you make the mix at dinner, simply microwave it on high for about a minute to melt the zatie's. Pour the mix onto your chips and sprinkle generously with the zatie's. Let the chips set for a few minutes until a light coating appears on the chips. Place in an air free dish. If you have an airtight bowl or cookie tin, this would be good for 2 - 3 days. Enjoy.

title: Chicken Jumbo Shrimps
ingredients: 24 jumbo shrimp, peeled | 1 1/2 cups seasoned chicken meat | 1 package chili seasoning mix
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Line a cookie sheet with foil. Place shrimp in a single layer in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Prepare the jumbo shrimp with the seasoned chicken meat in a resealable plastic bag. Shake off excess food from bag. Arrange shrimp in a single layer in the baking dish. Sprinkle the chili seasoning mix over the shrimp. Bake in preheated oven until shrimp are opaque and no longer transparent in the center, 25 to 30 minutes. Cool shrimp on a wire rack.

title: Chinese Grilled Steak
ingredients: 1 tablespoon coconut oil | 1 rib-eye steak, cut into 10 thin slices | 1 egg yolk
instructions: Heat coconut oil in a large skillet or wok over medium high heat. Dip meat in egg yolk, then into coconut oil.

title: Glogg
ingredients: 2 quarts swanson chicken stock or 2 quarts alison rice | 1 bunch broccoli | 1 hard-boiled egg, peeled | 1 cup whole almond milk | 1 teaspoon kosher salt | cooked rice
instructions: Bring chicken stock to a boil in a large saucepan or dutch oven, and simmer on the lowest possible heat for 30 minutes. Cut the broccoli into spears and cut them into bite size pieces and place them all into the broth on the lower heat. Cook at the same temperature for 15 minutes. Meanwhile, prepare the egg noodles. Remove the broccoli from the hot stock and drop into a bowl of cold water. Drain and pat dry with paper towels. Place a large scoop of the hard cooked egg onto the egg, and gently pull the egg into the bowl with the egg. Repeat with the remaining eggs. Place the blanched egg onto a flat tray and sprinkle the outside of the clamed egg on it. Sprinkle with salt, and allow the claming egg to set up at room temperature for 10 to 20 minutes before serving. When serving, place the clamed egg on top of the boiled rice and serve at once. Note, the egg noodles can also be added to the broth for a more substantial meal just substitute 1 cup white rice for alison rice. Makes about 4 servings if kept in the fridge for a few days.

title: Amarena's Creamy Mushroom Gravy
ingredients: 2 cans condensed cream of mushroom soup | 2 teaspoons amaretto, or as needed ( optional )
instructions: Stir cream of mushroom soup and amaretto together in a saucepan.

title: Baked Shering Fillets
ingredients: 4 beef shank | 4 chili peppers | 4 ounces herring fillets
instructions: Preheat oven to 190°c, 400°f, and spray or oil a large baking tray. Wash the fillets, cut off any membrane and slash the thickest portion on each side with a sharp knife. Place the fillets in the tray. Put in the oven and cook for about 20 minutes. When cooked, drain all but a few tablespoons of the juices from the tray and stir the liquid into the shank. Cover and leave to stand in a warm place for about 30 minutes. Remove the fillets from the tray and slice into large chunks. Place a small slice of tomato on each dinner plate, place the herring chunks over this, drizzle with the herring cooking liquid and serve.

Random Ingredients: beef stew meat,lemon juice,lime,icing sugar,margarine,taco seasoning
title: Lime Beef Tips
ingredients: 3 tablespoons lemon juice | 3 tablespoons margarine | 1 packet taco seasoning | 1/2 cup icing sugar | 3 lbs beef stew meat | 1 packet taco seasoning | 2 lemons, juice of
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together the lemon juice, margarine and 1 packet of taco seasoning. Set aside. Cut the beef and stir them in the bowl. Stir in the lemon juice and taco seasoning mix. Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour. Boil water and add 2 taco seasoning packets. Turn heat down. Slowly pour in the beef. Simmer uncovered until meat is cooked through. While beef is simmering, prepare the icing. Put the sugar in a bowl. Add 5 tbsp of water to the sugar, and add 1/2 tbsp lemon juice. If the sugar is too hot, the sour flavor will darken. When the water is boiling, stir it into the sugar until it dissolves. Set aside. When beef is ready, drain off any grease. Pour icing onto the beef cubes and serve.

title: Caribbean Coconut Cheese Ball
ingredients: 1 package sharp cheddar cheese | 1/2 cup canned bamboo shoots, drained ( optional ) | 1/4 cup canned jalapeno slices, drained | 2 cans unsweetened coconut milk | 3 tablespoons catsup
instructions: Shred cheese into chunks using 2 forks. Place in a bowl and stir in remaining ingredients. Chill in the refrigerator approximately 30 minutes. Note, for a thicker cream, stir cream in a small amount of water as needed to moisten cream.

title: Oven Baked Spaghetti
ingredients: 12 ounces spaghetti sauce | 1 tablespoon catsup | 1 tomato bouillon or 2 chicken bouillon cubes
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Brown spaghetti. Mix all ingredients in saucepan. Pour sauce into a casserole dish. Bake for about 45 mins until bubbly and hot.

Random Ingredients: accent seasoning,sun tomato oil,green cabbage,topping,yogurt,wheat flour,beef
title: Picnic Beef, Cabbage & Cheese Skillet
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef | 1/2 cup shredded green cabbage | 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, chopped | 1 tablespoon all purpose yogurt | 2 tablespoons quick oats or 2 tablespoons regular oats | 1/2 teaspoon accent seasoning | 1 cup low fat natural yogurt, not low fat | 1 cup fat-free whipped topping, thawed
instructions: Cook beef in a large nonstick skillet on medium high heat 5 to 7 minutes or until browned. Remove from skillet, leaving drippings in skillet. Add cabbage and the sun dried tomatoes. Stir to combine. Cook and stir about 6 minutes or until heated through. Stir in yogurt, oats and accent. Cook 1 to 2 minutes more or until mixture bubbles. Stir in beef mixture. Sprinkle remaining topping over. Heat through. If you don't have a skillet, cook your macaroni, oat bran, & breads separately using the same method just make sure to remove cooked noodles before you serve. If not using a bread machine, use a meat thermometer if it does not reach desired temperature. This recipe can be made in a nonstick skillet. Heat until hot but not smoking. Pour picnic beef vegetable mixture over noodles and toss in hot skillet until cheese is melted and bubbly. Serve immediately, topping with yogurt & fat free whipped topping. Yum note, i used the 2tbsp of oat bran that you can find in the health food section of most grocery stores.

title: Couscous
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups finely ground cracked crackers ( panko is used in some places ) | 1 red onion, finely grated or finely diced | 1 tablespoon paprika | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
instructions: Combine all ingredients, and store in a glass jar with a tight fitting lid for up to 2 weeks.

title: Gruyere Cheesecake
ingredients: 1 package gruyere cheese, chopped | 1 can lemonade concentrate
instructions: Line the bottom of an unbaked 7 1/2 x 11 1/2 inch loaf pan with plastic wrap. Spread gruyere cheese evenly across the bottom of the pan and sprinkle with lemonade concentrate. Top with the remaining cheese. Pour remaining lemonade over cheese. Place the loaf pan on a dish towel and cover the dish. Refrigerate for 8 hours. The cheese may break into smaller pieces.

title: Dressing for Hamsters
ingredients: 1 bag vanilla ice cream | 1 -2 tablespoon icing sugar ( confectioner's sugar )
instructions: Put all ingredients in a large jar or bowl and shake until the icing is all disolved. Spread over hamsters and bake for 15 minutes in a 350 degree oven. Cool for a few minutes before eating.

Random Ingredients: cayenne,red pepper flake,vegetable oil,rom tomato,corn oil
title: Tomato Fajita Fritters
ingredients: 4 roma tomatoes, coarsely chopped | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne, to taste ( optional ) | vegetable oil, for frying | 24 corn oil for frying | 1 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes
instructions: Stir the tomatoes, cayenne, and red pepper flakes together in a bowl. Heat deep fryer to 350 degrees f. Line a plate with paper towels. Dip fritter into hot oil. Carefully remove from the oil using a slotted spoon.

title: Crock Pot Caraway Onion Soup
ingredients: 2 medium onions, sliced 1/2 inch thick | 1 1/4 teaspoons caraway seeds | 6 1/2 cups good beef broth ( homemade ok ) | 2 tablespoons applesauce
instructions: Add onions.

Random Ingredients: pecorino romano cheese,gruyere,balsamic vinegar,cauliflower,ziti pasta,sirloin,green bean
title: Pasta Primavera With Grilled Beef Strips and Vegetables
ingredients: 14 ounces ziti pasta or 14 ounces penne pasta | 3 bunches green beans, each cut into three | 1 lb ground sirloin | 2/3 cup balsamic vinegar or 2/3 cup white wine vinegar | 1 cup pecorino romano cheese, loosely packed | 1 head cauliflower, separated into leaves and tips cut in 3/4 inch thick pieces | 1/3 cup fresh grated gruyere, about 1/4 cup, plus more for sprinkling
instructions: Bring 4 quarts of water to a boil over high heat. Cook pasta until al dente, but still firm to the bite, stirring occasionally, about 8 - 10 minutes.

title: Aubergines in Noodles
ingredients: 4 aubergines ( small, each weighing about 1/2-1/2 inches in diameter ) | 4 tablespoons dried dill weed ( or 3 - 3/4 tbsp. chopped fresh dill ) | 1 teaspoon sweet paprika ( i use smoked paprika ) | 4 tablespoons chow mein noodles
instructions: Slash aubergines lengthwise. Cut diagonally into 2 - 4 slices lengthwise to make four slices. Place on paper towels. Place a wire rack over a foil lined tray. In a small mixing bowl, stir together dill weed, paprika and chow mein until well mixed. Spread chow mein over each aubergine slice on the rack. Put tray in the fridge for an hour or two. Bake in an oven pre heated to 275ºf. Bake for 45 - 50 minutes or until crisp and brown. To serve, place some chow mein noodles on top of the aubergines. Spoon some of the browned bits over the top.

title: Broiler Fried Chicken
ingredients: 2 teaspoons whole white peppercorns | 1 tablespoon dried thyme sprigs | 4 -6 lbs broiler-fryer chickens
instructions: Combine peppercorns and thyme.

title: Easy Vegetable & Dried Eggplant Bake
ingredients: 1 lb eggplants | 14 ounces frozen mixed vegetables | 5 eggs ( for veggie mix ) | 1 cup milk | maple syrup
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Trim sliced vegetables of all excess moisture. Place cut vegetables in glass baking dish. Beat together seven eggs and blend in milk or so until mixed. Pour over vegetables. Bake for 25 mins, then top with a little maple syrup. Serve warm.

title: Namurrah
ingredients: 1 large fish ( about 500g weight ) | 1 bunch fresh baby spinach leaves
instructions: Cut fish into eight pieces and remove the skin, bones and any thick skin clinging to it. Rinse and remove any remaining bones and scales with a brush dipped in a little water. Place fillets and torn spinach on a large tray and bake in a 180º c oven for about 10 - 15 minutes or until fish is cooked. Serve with hummus.

Random Ingredients: beef stew meat,oyster sauce,soymilk,catsup,purple onion,southern comfort
title: Vegetable Pudding
ingredients: 1 small purple onion, finely chopped | 1/2 cup catsup | 1/3 cup soymilk | 2 tablespoons dark southern comfort | 1 tablespoon oyster sauce | 1 1/2 lbs beef stew meat
instructions: Combine the onion, catsup, soy milk, southern comfort and oyster sauce in a bowl. Add meat, stir to coat and refrigerate for 4 hours to marinate. Cook in a covered 9x13 inch baking dish, covered, at 350°f for 1 hour. The longer it marinates, the better.

title: Indonesian Coconut Salad
ingredients: 8 limes or 8 lemons | 1/2 cup unsweetened flaked coconut
instructions: Juice the limes or lemons, keeping the juice. Bring just enough water in a small saucepan to barely cover the citrus. Bring just to a boil. Dip each piece of lime or lemon into the boiling water on both sides, then immediately remove and plunge into ice water. When it stops slumping, let sit for at least 30 seconds. Drain onto paper towels to drain as much liquid as possible. Sprinkle lime or lemon peel into a clean dry salad bowl. Place all in a single layer, tossing to coat. Add the coconut to the water in the pan and stir until just melted and evenly distributed. Drizzle over the salad. Serve warm or chilled.

title: Lolah's Barbecue Honey
ingredients: 1 cup honey | 1/4 cup packed brown sugar
instructions: Pour the honey into a large pan and cover with the sugar. Simmer for 10 minutes. Remove from the heat. Cool completely. Stir in remaining ingredients. Let cool completely.

title: Rotel Fried Noodles
ingredients: 1 lb noodles ( rotimini or linguine ) | 6 tablespoons tomato and chilies ( your choice ) | 6 tablespoons salsa | 1 tablespoon garlic paste | 1/2 teaspoon msg | 2 eggs, separated | 1/4 cup dry breadcrumbs
instructions: Cook noodles following package directions. Drain and rinse with cold water. Drain and rinse again with cold water. Heat 1 - 2 tablespoons oil in a skillet. Add onion & garlic pastes. Sauté until onion wilts & garlic browns a little. Remove from heat & combine all ingredients. Pour half over noodles. Mix well. Add rest of mixture. Crack egg whites in bowl and beat well but do not add yolks. Stir egg whites into noodle mixture. Add salt if desired.

title: Crawfish Stuffed With Feta
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh crawfish | 1/2 lb feta cheese
instructions: Wash crawfish and remove heads and blemishes. Dice up crawfish into small pieces. Mix crawfish, feta and cheese in a dish and cook on low on lowest setting for about 20 minute, stirring occasionally to prevent cheese from burning. The filling can actually be served warm.

title: Chicago Style Hoagie
ingredients: 4 hoagie rolls, split | 1/4 lb genoa salami, sliced | 1 package kielbasa or ( 1 1/2 ounce ) package other hot dogs | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon granules
instructions: Place bottom halves of rolls in 9 inch fry pan. Cover with 1/4 pound salami and 1 pound kielbasa. Sprinkle with chicken bouillon. Place top halves on pan and cover with remaining 2 rolls. Heat thoroughly, 3 to 4 minutes, or until bread is golden brown.

title: Spicy Beef Tenderloin Medallions
ingredients: 1 beef tenderloin | 3/4 cup chunky salsa | 1/2 cup chopped yellow fresh chile, seeded | 1/4 cup chopped fresh thai basil | 4 strips red chile
instructions: Heat a large nonstick skillet over high heat. Season both sides of tenderloin with salt and pepper.

title: Quinoa and Apple Apples
ingredients: 1/2 cup quinoa | 1 -2 medium tart apple | 4 tablespoons kitchen twine | 3 tablespoons dijon mustard | 1/4 teaspoon garlic powder | 1 large avocado
instructions: Combine the dry quinoa, apple, twine, mustard and garlic powder together in a covered saucepan. Cook covered on high for 15 minutes, then reduce the heat to low and cover for an additional 15 - 20 minutes, or until all the liquid is absorbed and the quinoa is tender.

Random Ingredients: white sugar,leg lamb,chili,cabbage,wine vinegar,canola oil,egg substitute
title: Maggie's Lamb Meatballs in Sweet Vinegar
ingredients: 1/2 lb ground lean leg of lamb | 1/2 lb ground cabbage | 1/2 cup egg substitute | 1/4 cup white sugar | 1/4 cup canola oil | 1 teaspoon chili | 1 teaspoon wine vinegar
instructions: Mix all ingredients together together well in a large bowl. Form meatballs with a small amount for each, dropping in hot fat as needed. Drain well on paper towels. Brown on all sides.

title: Homemade Croutons
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups beef stock or 1 1/2 cups canned beef broth | 1 1/2 tablespoons active dry yeast | 2 egg whites | 1 lb beef short rib, cut in 1-inch cubes
instructions: Place beef stock, yeast, and egg whites in the pan of a blender or food proccesor. Blend at medium speed for about 30 seconds, or until mixture is very smooth. Add short ribs and continue blending until the short ribs have turned colour a nice golden colour. Put mixture into an empty plastic food storage bag. Place in a warm room and allow it to rise to room temperature. When ready to bake, preheat oven to 400°f. Grease a baking sheet or line with a round layer of parchment paper or grease it with melted butter. Drop the warm mixture by the tablespoonful onto the baking sheet. Allow it to rise a second time. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes until crust is slightly puffed. Remove.

title: Mom's Italian Semolina (Sooze Bread)
ingredients: 1 lb unsalted margarine or 1 lb butter, softened or 1 lb butter, softened | 2 large onions, finely chopped | 1/2 cup light golden syrup ( like karo ) | 1 cup semolina flour or 1 cup regular-meal flour | 2 tablespoons dry-roasted crushed almonds | 1/2 teaspoon onion powder | 2 teaspoons grated grated fresh lemon rind | 1 lemon, juice of
instructions: Cream together all the ingredients till creamy, and then adjust the flavor as desired with salt, pepper, and sugar. Set to the side. Grease a 9 or 10 inch loaf pan, cover the bottom with sliced loaf, and press up the slices well. Spread half the melted butter over the top. Dot with the rest of the melted butter, then cover with the remaining sliced ingredients. Place the loaf in a pre heated oven. Bake for 40 - 45 minutes at 325 degrees, or till toothpick comes out clean. Cool and serve cold.

Random Ingredients: ancho chile powder,chevre cheese,butter,pinto bean,soymilk,basmati rice
title: Pinto Bean Baked With Goat Cheese (Rajma Muka)
ingredients: 1 cup pinto beans, soaked overnight | 1/4 cup unsalted butter, melted | 1/4 teaspoon ancho chile powder | 2 teaspoons cashews or 2 teaspoons raw cashews, roughly chopped | 1 1/2 tablespoons soymilk ( optional ) | 3 cups basmati rice | 1 1/2 teaspoons goat cheese, roughly chopped ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Combine the pinto beans, butter, chili powder and cas peanuts. Place rice in a large baking dish and pour the soaked beans into it. Make sure to put pinto beans on top of the rice. Cover with foil and bake for 20 minutes and then remove the foil. Cover again and bake an additional 10 minutes or until cooked through. Remove from heat and let rest for 5 minutes. Fluff rice with fork, and sprinkle with goat cheese, if using. Return to oven for 5 - 10 minutes longer, or until the cheese is melted and the topping is slightly browned.

title: Grilled Pork and Smoked Caramelized Pork
ingredients: 2 lbs pork belly | 1 jar mayonnaise | 32 slices smoked pork
instructions: Pour the canola oil into a large heavy duty aluminum foil sack. Insert the top of the foil sack into the roasting pan with the pork belly. Combine the mayonnaise with a teaspoon or two of the smoked pork fat, adding more if necessary. Spread the pork belly evenly with the caramelized mayo. Using a serrated knife, flatten the pork by firmly pressing on the bottom of the foil sack with your finger tips to flatten the meat. Fold the top of the foil sack over the pork and crimp tightly with a twist tie. Place the roasting pan in a large resealable plastic bag. Gently lift or pull the foil sack in half, leaving enough space to gently squeeze out the air. Place your first 3 pounds of pork on the top of the foil in the plastic bag and refrigerate over night, turning occasionally. After 5 days of refrigerating, remove the pork from the plastic bag with the plastic bag and unwrap. Seal tightly and remove the meat from the foil bag. Place the meat in a single layer on a wire rack over a baking sheet or a heavy duty freezer proof platter. Cut 4 diagonal slits into the skin of the meat, leaving a 1½ inch border on each side of the meat. Spread the smoked pork out thinly with the candied mayo. Cover the meat with aluminum foil and refrigerate another 2 hours. Remove from the foil bag and slice into 1/8 inch slices.

title: Champagne Chops (Champéones)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons red chile powder ( or more if desired ) | 2 teaspoons chicken bouillon cubes | 1 bottle dry champagne
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together. Pour over chicken and marinate for at least 30 minutes until fully cooked.

Random Ingredients: chili pepper flake,green onion,bean sprout,beef bouillon powder,salmon fillet,corn kernel
title: Quick and Easy Fish or Beef on the Bean Sprout Side
ingredients: 1 can salmon fillets or ( 1 lb ) can beef bouillon cubes | 1/2 teaspoon dried chili pepper flakes | 1/4 teaspoon instant beef bouillon powder | 1 can sliced corn kernels ( approx. 1-1/2 cups ) | 4 green onions, sliced | 1 cup bean sprouts, fresh
instructions: In a medium sized bowl mix the fish or beef and seasonings. Add the corn, green onions and bean sprouts and mix well. Serve.

title: Rum Cabbage
ingredients: 1 head cabbage, shredded | 4 ounces dark rum
instructions: Boil the cabbage in salted water until soft. Drain and cool. Once cooled, add the rum and mix well.

title: Basil Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 2 packages active dry yeast | 1/2 pound fresh basil | 3 tablespoons tamari ( japanese soy sauce ) | 1/2 cup sweet chili sauce | 2 tablespoons dry sherry | 1 1/2 teaspoons minced fresh ginger root
instructions: In a large container with a tight fitting lid, combine and dissolve yeast with warm water. Cover and allow to proof for 10 minutes. Scald tamari in a large saucepan, stirring constantly. Pour in basil, tamari, sweet chili sauce, sherry and ginger root. Cool to room temperature. If using in a sandwich, refrigerate until serving.

Random Ingredients: vanilla extract,seasoning salt,raspberry jam,cognac,baby carrot,rice krispies,pecorino romano cheese,barley
title: Raspberry & Rice Krispies Cookies
ingredients: 2 packages baby carrots | 1 can raspberries | 1 jar raspberry jam | 8 ounces grated pecorino romano cheese or 8 ounces parmesan cheese | 1 1/2 teaspoons vanilla extract | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1 box rice krispies | 1 cup cognac or 1 cup other brandy
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. In a large bowl, combine carrots, raspberries, jam, cheese, vanilla and seasoning salt. Blend well. Roll into balls. Dip balls into rice krisps and coat with cognac or other brandy. Place on parchment lined cookie sheets. Bake at 350 degrees for 17 minutes.

title: Sweet Glazed Fig Rolls
ingredients: 2 tablespoons ground figs | 4 pork sausage links, casings removed | 5 sheets frozen phyllo dough, thawed according to package directions
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Lay the figs lengthwise onto a work surface. Top each one with a link of sausage. Place 2 sheets of phyllo on top of the sausage, and roll up tightly. Repeat with remaining sheets and phyllo, pinching ends to seal in the roll. Spray a baking sheet with cooking spray. Arrange the rolls in a single layer on the baking sheet. Bake in preheated oven until the sausage is bubbling and the phyllo is lightly browned, about 20 minutes. Transfer to a cutting board, cut in slices, and serve.

title: Garlic and Coriander Seed Chicken
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme | 1 teaspoon coriander seed | 1 large red pepper, coarsely chopped | 1 1/2 ounces dried minced garlic chives | 4 scallions, thinly sliced | 1/2 cup reduced-sodium chicken broth
instructions: In a mortar, pound together the thyme and coriander and rub evenly over the red pepper. Stir in the chives and scallions and pound until the spices become a paste. Stir in the broth and adjust seasoning. Cover and refrigerate the chicken at least 3 hours or overnight before baking.

title: Somerset Style Mice Pies
ingredients: 12 frozen puff pastry sheets, defrosted | 1 apple, peeled and chopped finely | 4 small swedes, peeled and chopped finely | 1/4 cup crumbed graham cracker crumbs | 300 ml good strong brandy or 300 ml madeira wine
instructions: Pre heat oven to 180c. Place pastry sheets on a board and roll out to a thickness of 3cm or less. Cut each sheet into 6 - 12 squares. Transfer the pastry squares to a lightly floured baking tray. Place the apple bits and chopped swedes on top of the pastry squares, sprinkle the crumb topping on top. Add any dry ingredients you have on hand and make sure all the crumb topping has been used. Bake for around 15 minutes or until golden brown. Serve immediately with yoghurt.

title: Homemade Mexican Espresso Dream Cafe
ingredients: 2 ounces reosado tequila | 1 ounce irish cream | 1/2 ounce suseitan | 1 orange ( to garnish ) | 1/4 ounce brewed espresso powder | 1/8 ounce craisins or 1/8 ounce sultana
instructions: Shake & strain into a martini glass to your liking. Garnish with an orange piece and sultana, if desired.

Random Ingredients: white bread,red chilies,italian salad dressing,caster sugar
title: Crispy Chillies Toast
ingredients: 1 red chilies ( deseeded & roughly chopped ) | 4 slices white bread | 2 tablespoons italian salad dressing | 1 tablespoon caster sugar
instructions: Combine chillies, chopped italian dressing & sugar in shallow dish & leave to marinate for 30 minutes. Dunk each slice of bread in dry mix & coat in dry mix. Cook under a hot griddle until golden brown on both sides & serve.

title: Steak and Peas - Real Simple
ingredients: 1 lb sirloin or 1 lb top round steak, cut very thin | 2 cans green peas ( frozen is ok ) | 2 tablespoons dark rum | 2 hoagie rolls
instructions: You may also use your oven to make this recipe. Put the cut sirloin in the crock pot. Strain the juice from the green peas into the crockpot, making sure it is well in the bottom of the cooker, if there is not use a spoon or hands for doing something about the juice and juice. Put the peas on top of the sirloin. Sprinkle the rum over the peas. Cover the crockpot and cook high for 2 hours. Turn the crockpot to low and leave for 15 more minutes. Toast the hoagie rolls. This part may depend on what type of meat you are using. I prefer to grill them over hot coals. Remove the meat from the crockpot and arrange on serving platter. Wrap each meatball in the hoagie rolls. Variation, i made a lot of modifications to the rum based on reviews, the rum and the peas were the only variations i had tried. I used a mixture of rum, rum extract, rum extract and brown sugar instead of honey and i used only 2 tbsp of rum extract. If you like more flavor use 2 tsp of brown sugar instead of honey.

title: Chicken With Garlic Butter & Garlic Root Onions
ingredients: 10 -12 garlic cloves, slivered, whole, unpeeled | 12 -14 chicken drumsticks
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees. Wash your hands, put on garlic clove and make a hole in the center by squeezing the garlic cloves into the holes. Lay the chicken on a rack about 6 inches from the oil. Rub the outside of the chicken with garlic butter and place on a foil lined baking sheet. Bake for 30 minutes, turn the chicken over and bake for an additional 30 - 40 minutes. After chicken is done, take out the foil and bake to desired crispiness. Remove all of the garlic cloves and set aside until you are ready to serve. Serve the chicken with the garlic butter and lots of garlic. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: soy sauce,italian parsley,chicken bouillon cube,picante sauce,yogurt,yellow onion
title: Pizza Sauce
ingredients: 1 large yellow onion, chopped | 1 cup plain yogurt | salt & pepper | 1 chicken bouillon cube, disolved in | 1 cup picante sauce | 2 tablespoons soy sauce
instructions: Saute onions until onions are light tan, add soy sauce. Add salt and peppere to taste. Add 1 cup plain yogurt, boullion dissolved in picante sauce. Keep on low heat, stirring occasionally until mixture thickens slightly. Take off heat, cool, and refrigerate until ready to use. Enjoy.

title: Noori
ingredients: 2 ounces sunflower seeds | 1 large white onion, peeled and sliced thinly | 2 dried shallots, peeled and sliced thinly
instructions: Heat sunflower seeds in a dry frying pan for 10 - 15 minutes until they pop, then remove from pan. Grind the sunflower seeds using the coarse blade of a food processor or mortar and pestle. Place the sunflower seeds in a bowl with sliced onions and shallots. Mix all together. The noori is ready when the coating darkens. The noori stays crisp for several days.

title: Crispy Spinach with Mustard and Greens
ingredients: 6 cups green cabbage | 10 leaves fresh spinach leaves, trimmed | 3 teaspoons dry mustard
instructions: Place cabbage, spinach leaves, and mustard in a large pot. Cover with cold water.

Random Ingredients: onion salt,new mexico chile powder,barbecue sauce,french bread
title: Mexican Cheese Slices
ingredients: 1 french bread, cut into 1/4-inch slices | 1/4 cup barbecue sauce ( your favourite brand ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons new mexico chile powder | 2 tablespoons chopped onions or 2 tablespoons coarsely chopped yellow onions
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together barbecue sauce, chile powder, onion and salt. Pour barbecue mixture evenly over bread slices and let stand at room temperature 30 minutes. Preheat broiler. Place bread slices on a broiler pan and broil 3 - 4 minutes, or until just golden on the edges. Slice cheese diagonally in 1/2 thick slices. Serve with salsa.

Random Ingredients: bell pepper,chicken stock,lentil,italian herb,salad oil,apple,cremini mushroom,beef roast
title: Beef & Lentil Stuffed Peppers
ingredients: 8 medium sized bell peppers | 1/2 cup chopped fresh italian herbs | 4 cups cubed beef roast | 2 -3 tablespoons salad oil | 2 cups cooked lentils | 2 teaspoons apple stuffing oil | 4 cups chicken stock | 3/4 lb cremini mushroom
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees. Wash and stem the bell peppers. Remove the white part from the inside of the peppers. Chop the remaining white parts of the peppers. Seed the meat and chop it into 1in cubes. Put the salad oil in a pan and brown the meat on all sides in the oil. Set aside and cover with water. Bring to the boil and simmer for 20 minutes. When time is up, drain the water. Save the broth and set aside. Set aside 1 cup of the lentils for later. Add chicken stock and diced bell peppers to the broth and cook another 20 minutes. Add the lentils to the stew and heat until the beans are tender. While the stew is heating up, chop the mushrooms. Drain the meat and put the stew on a plate and chop it into small chunks. Add this meat and the reserved lentils to the stew. Stir over high heat for about 5 minutes until the gravy thickens. Add the apple stuffing oil to the stew and stir until thickened. Add the chopped mushrooms and cook another 2 minutes. Remove from heat and serve hot.

title: Coconut Chayotes With Chayote
ingredients: 1 sweet chayotes | 3/4 cup low-fat greek yogurt | 1 tablespoon pure unsweetened coconut milk | 1 medium vidalia onion, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees f. Wash and cut the chayote in half and then crosswise into 1/2 inch slices. Place cut side down on an oven proof dish or on a lightly oiled baking sheet. Bake the chayote until the flesh is easily pierced with a fork and the flesh is just tender, 30 to 40 minutes. Cool completely, remove the flesh and seeds and chop roughly. Combine the chayote, yogurt and coconut milk in a large bowl and gently toss to combine. Serve with the onion.

title: Shrimp and Pasta Stir Fry
ingredients: 1 lb raw shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1/2 cup simple syrup, sweet < a href= '' https : //www.geniuskitchen.com/recipe/simple-sugar-493976 '' > simple syrup < /a > | 16 ounces penne pasta | 2 cups cabbage, julienned | 1/2 cup radish, julienned, can use other vegetables | 1 teaspoon fresh ground pepper | 1 1 lb thin rice noodles
instructions: In a large bowl, toss the shrimp, sweetener, and 1/2 cup of the syrup. In a large skillet or wok, mix the pasta, cabbage, radish, pepper and the remaining 3/4 cup of maple syrup. Cook and stir, until it's coated in syrup.

title: Crock Pot Lazy Red Cabbage
ingredients: 1 red cabbage | 1 cup low fat yogurt | 1/2 cup broth | 1 tablespoon cocoa | 3 spring onions, sliced into rings | 1/2 teaspoon cocoa | 1 tortilla, cut into wedges | 1 -2 cup noodles
instructions: Slice the cabbage in thin long slices. Arrange slices on the bottom of the crock pot layer the yoghurt, broth, onion rings, cocoa, salt and pepper until covered. Add more cabbage for layers or put a few smaller portions of cabbage in the crock pot. Cook on low for 6 hours or on high for 3 hours.

title: Blueberry Curry
ingredients: 200 g blueberries | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil | 2 teaspoons turmeric powder
instructions: Heat the sesame oil and turmeric powder together in a pot. Add the blueberries in a slurry, stir them over fire until the blueberries start to burst in a bit, and then just take them off fire. Enjoy.

title: Lentils and Ham With Bread Crumbs
ingredients: 1 lb lentils, rinsed, picked over, soaked in | breadcrumbs | 4 slices serrano ham
instructions: Cover lentils with cold water in a medium saucepan. Bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat to low. Cover, and simmer until lentils are tender but still resistant to bite, about 30 minutes. Drain. Season with salt and pepper. Drain. Place ham on a large piece of foil. Spoon lentils into center. Sprinkle with bread crumbs.

title: Beef Satay (Beef Satay)
ingredients: 4 boneless beef round steak, cut into strips | 1 1/2 - 2 lbs chicken wings | 8 -10 large green cardamom pods
instructions: Trim beef of fat. Cut meat into long, thin strips. Thread 1 of the strips onto 4 bamboo skewers. Set on a broiling rack, and broil at least 20 minutes before you want to serve.. To serve, place meat on skewers, and broil the meat, turning often, until it is browned all over. Remove meat from skewers, and keep warm in a low oven. Warm sauce, if desired, over low heat, if desired.

title: Pappardelle With Coffee Sauce (Cappardelle Con Caffe)
ingredients: 1 lb veal ( use a thick cut ) or 1 lb chicken breast ( use a thick cut ) | 1/2 lb velveeta cheese | 1/2 lb cooked drained of excess milk fattening ( if using store bought cheese ) | 1 cup chicken stock | 1 tablespoon cornstarch or 1 tablespoon potato starch | chopped italian parsley ( to garnish )
instructions: Chop up meat into pieces no larger than 1/4 inch thick and roll into patties. Brown in a hot frypan using a little oil or butter, then set aside and let cool. When ready to plate, boil stock for 10 minutes. Toss cheese with 1/2 the hot cream or milk and stir till cheese is melted. Return to pan and stir in cooked meat and any spices. Pour in remaining cream or milk and bring to a boil, stirring. Stir in cornstarch until blended. Pour into a small baking dishes, sprinkle with parsley, cover with plastic wrap and bake at 450 degrees f for about 20 minutes, remove wrap and bake for 15 more minutes.

title: Hot Cheese Soup With Kidney Beans and dates
ingredients: 375 g swiss cheese, diced | 250 g red kidney beans, drained and washed | 1 carrot, chopped | 500 g dates, stoned and chopped
instructions: Place cheese, kidney beans& carrot in a saucepan, cover with cold water and bring to boil. Reduce heat& simmer for 3 - 5 minutes until mixture is just tender.

Random Ingredients: raisin,cumin seed,pickling spice,button mushroom,mincemeat,pizza crust,icing sugar,chow mein noodle
title: Sicilian Mincemeat Pizza
ingredients: 500 g mincemeat | 3 teaspoons raisins | 5 teaspoons pickling spice | 1 teaspoon cumin seed | 1 tablespoon icing sugar | 400 g pizza crust | 1/2 cup chow mein noodles | 1 piece pizza crust, for pizza dough
instructions: Combine mince with raisins, pickling spice, cumin seeds and icing sugar in a bowl. Roll out dough and use to form a 5cm round pizza. Brush pizza dough with egg wash and top with mince mixture. Add a piece of pizza dough on top and seal edges under. Brush top with egg wash and score a pattern with a knife. Cook in a pre heated oven at 230 c for 10 - 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: red bell pepper,lamb,golden syrup,chicken thigh,lemon grass,lemon,asafoetida powder,rice flour
title: Golden Filled Lemon Meatballs
ingredients: 1 lb lean ground lamb | 3/4 cup rice flour | 3/4 cup golden syrup | 1/2 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1/2 lemon, juice of | 2 teaspoons fresh lemon grass, finely sliced | 1 red bell pepper | 1 1/2 lbs boneless skinless chicken thighs, cut into 1 x 1/4 1 1/2 inch thick slices
instructions: Place all of the ingredients except the meat into a food processor and process to form a smooth paste. Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Make meatballs by rolling them between 2 sheets of wax paper in the skillet with minimal space between them. Make sure that they are evenly spaced. In batches, add the meatballs to the pan, brown on all sides and remove from the pan. Spray the pan with nonstick cooking spray. Return the meatballs to the pan. Place the red bell pepper in the pan. Pour the sauce into the pan and simmer for 20 minutes until thickened.

title: The Best Chicken and Pork Sandwich Ever
ingredients: 3 lbs lean boneless skinless chicken | 2 1/2 lbs ground lean pork butt | 4 tablespoons grated cheese ( any kind ) | salt and black pepper | 1 1/2 large head lettuce leaves ( optional ) | 2/3 cup hazelnuts ( optional ) ( optional ) or 2/3 cup chopped almonds ( optional )
instructions: Place chicken and pork over a medium hot fire and cook until browned well and juices run clear. You don't want to burn the meat and it will cook in the residual heat from the grill. Remove the meat from the grill and mix with all the other ingredients until well mixed. Allow mixture to cool slightly and set it aside. Place lettuce leaves on serving platter, if desired. ingredients: 2 cups pearl barley or 2 cups rice | 1 cup fine breadcrumbs
instructions: Soak the pearl barley in warm water for 30 minutes. Drain well. Dip each barley cube in water for 30 seconds on each side. Then press into bread crumbs and fry well at medium heat.

title: Peanut Butter Dressing (Sourdough bread)
ingredients: 2/3 cup chunky peanut butter | 2 teaspoons white vinegar
instructions: Mix the peanut butter with one teaspoon of vinegar until well blended. Keep in tight container. Serve over sourdough bread.

Random Ingredients: vanilla essence,lemon,corn syrup,green chili pepper,oregano leaf,sharp cheddar cheese,farfalle pasta
title: Pasta With Three Colour Chilli and Three Colour Cheese
ingredients: 1 lb farfalle pasta, washed and trimmed of any excess fat | 1 lemon, juice of | corn syrup ( approx. 1/3 cup ) | 3 -4 green chili peppers, deseeded and finely chopped | 1/4 teaspoon freshly grated nutmeg | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 3/4 cup sharp cheddar cheese, grated
instructions: Put the pasta in a large pan, preferably non stick, and add 2 - 3 cups of water. Bring to the boil, then immediately turn the heat down to medium. Add lemon juice and bring back to the boil, partially cover and cook for 10 minutes. Drain the pasta. Keep the pasta warm in a low oven, preferably with a lid on. Now heat a little corn oil in a wok, or a deep fryer. Add half the chillies to it, one at a time, keeping the rest for later. Heat until you can smell the chillies. Do not let them smoke before the chillies get brown. Add the pasta to the wok. Add another cup of water and cook for 5 - 10 minutes, or until the pasta is cooked as desired, but still has a bit crisp texture. Add the remaining chillies and spices and stir well. Add the grated cheddar and stir thoroughly. Serve immediately.

title: Peppered Peaches (W- Vegan Options)
ingredients: 1 cup canned sliced peaches or 1 cup canned other white peach | 1 teaspoon unsweetened cocoa powder | 1/2 cup thawed whipped topping ( optional! ) | 1/4 cup canned sliced water chestnuts ( optional ) | 1/2 cup sliced cucumbers ( optional ) or 1/2 cup other vegetable ( optional ) | sliced bread, pieces ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a mixing bowl. If the mixture is too thick add a little more whipped topping to make a thinner consistency.

Random Ingredients: hunt tomato sauce,active yeast,saltine cracker,center pork chop,wooden skewer,rye bread,tomato soup
title: Slow Cooker Swedish Meatballs on Skewers
ingredients: 1 can condensed tomato soup | 1 can hunts tomato sauce | 1 tablespoon active dry yeast | 1/2 teaspoon saltine crackers, crushed | 6 large center cut pork chops | 8 skewers | 3/4 cup crushed rye bread
instructions: In 3 1/2 to 4 quart slow cooker, combine tomato soup, tomato sauce, yeast and salt. Arrange pork chops in one layer. Arrange crushed crackers evenly over pork. Top with remaining pork, spoon tomato mixture around chops. Cover and cook on low 5 to 6 hours or on high 2 to 3 hours, until pork is cooked through. Remove pork with slotted spoon from slow cooker and place on platter and set aside. Skim fat from cooking liquid. Skim off any fat remaining in liquid. Spoon over meatball mixture and serve.

title: Khaaijaw (Curried Calamari)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs squid, tubes cut into 1 inch rounds | 1/4 cup bottled salad dressing | 1 tablespoon dark rum, such as jw brand | 1 tablespoon cider vinegar | 1 pinch garam masala | 1 -2 tablespoon thai-flavored broth
instructions: Arrange the squid in 2 or 3 1/2 quart shallow salad bowl. In a small bowl blend the salad dressing, rum, vinegar, garam masala and a small amount of the reserved broth. Pour over squid. Cover and marinate in refrigerator for at least 30 minutes. Remove squid from marinade and arrange under hot broiler. Broil, turning squid occasionally until cooked through, about 2 minutes per side.

title: Nectarine Noodles With Honey and Mustard Seeds
ingredients: 1 large nectarine ( about 1 pound ) | 1 teaspoon prepared mustard seeds | 4 teaspoons honey | 2 tablespoons unsweetened applesauce | 1 teaspoon honey | 1 teaspoon instant chicken bouillon | 1/2 teaspoon sea salt | 12 lasagna noodles
instructions: Preheat oven to 400º. Trim 2 or 3 from bottom of nectarine. Cut into 1/2 inch pieces. Place in a small deep bowl and add 1 teaspoon mustard seed and let stand 20 minutes. Meanwhile, place honey, applesauce, honey, boullion, and remaining 1 teaspoon mustard seed in a small saucepan and cook over medium heat, stirring frequently, until hot. Spread 1/4 cup noodles in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Fill noodles with the nectarine mixture and top with remaining noodles. Drizzle with honey mixture. Bake until noodles are crisp and golden around edges and sauce around noodles, 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Creamy Mushroom Soup
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1/2 cup margarine
instructions: Mix together. Melt margarine in a frying pan. Pour into hot skillet, making sure it coats every pan. Cook until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: espresso powder,kosher salt,japanese eggplant,mustard seed,velveeta mexican cheese
title: Chef Pierre's Eggplant Puree
ingredients: 2 japanese eggplants | kosher salt | 8 ounces velveeta mexican cheese | 2 tablespoons mustard seeds | 2 teaspoons instant espresso powder
instructions: Cut a slit through the tops of the eggplants and remove the fibers from each piece by carefully piercing several holes and leaving the shells intact. Cut lengthwise into slices 1/4 inch thick. Sprinkle liberally with salt, and let rest for 30 minutes. Meanwhile melt the velvetta escoachi in a pot over low heat, about 2 tablespoons or so, until it is a soft, smooth consistency. When the eggplant slices are cool, peel them and cut into 1/4 inch thick slices. In another pot, heat water to a rolling boil. Dip the eggplant slices right in, one at a time, and place them in the boiling water. If needed, remove the slices when they reach the desired stage of cooking. When the sauce is almost ready, add the dippable mustard seeds to the cheese mixture and stir. Once cheese is melted, transfer to a container and freeze in the freezer until ready to use. Store in the refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: olive bread,italian breadcrumb,russet potato,spanish onion,celery,apple juice,chicken broth
title: Apple Potatoes
ingredients: 1 large russet potato, scrubbed | 2/3 cup italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 1/3 cup italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 1/3 cup spanish onion, chopped | 1 large apple, cored, peeled and chopped | 3/4 cup chicken broth | 3 tablespoons olive oil
instructions: Cut russet potato into 2 wedges each. Place potato wedges on a rimmed baking sheet. In a large bowl, combine 1/3 cup bread crumbs, italian style bread crumbs, onion, apple, and 2/3 cup olive oil. Using a rubber spatula, spread crumb mixture and potato wedges into a large, shallow patty type pan. Top the potato wedges with 1/2 cup bread crumb mixture, press crumb firmly over potato pieces and flatten the crumb mixture over the crumbs. Bake in a 400°f oven for 15 minutes, sprinkle crumbs over and return to oven for 5 more minutes, or finish baking and breading all of the potato wedges. Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Cheese Dip II
ingredients: 1 package sliced american cheese | 1 jar taco sauce, or to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Spread the cheese slices in the bottom of a pie dish that has been coated with cooking spray. Layer sauce over the cheese. Bake in the preheated oven until the cheese has melted, about 15 minutes.

title: Spicy Pomegranate Condiment
ingredients: 1 cup mayonnaise | 2 tablespoons cognac | 2 tablespoons pickled jalapenos, finely chopped | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom seed | 2 ounces pomegranate seeds | 1 1/2 cups vegetable stock, heated
instructions: In medium bowl, stir together the mayonnaise, cognac, jalapenos, cardamom, pomegranate seeds, and vegetable stock. Pour into a small jar, cover, and refrigerate until ready to use.

title: Tofu Rice Balls With Toasted Orange Glaze (Vegan)
ingredients: 2 ounces firm tofu, in one piece, pressed ( about 1 lb ) | 1/2 cup orange juice, from the can, divided | 1 1/2 cups yellow rice, cooked according to package directions ( i use a white rice mat, to make it easier to work with ) | 2 tablespoons sweet cream of tartar | 3/4 cup golden raisins
instructions: Combine tofu, 1/4 cup orange juice, and rice in a bowl. Toss gently. Let sit 10 minutes, and then fluff with a fork, pressing tofu against the grain. Stir sour cream and cream of tartar into remaining orange juice. Add to the rice mixture, along with raisins. Mix gently. Cover and chill 10 minutes, or overnight. Scoop out as much balls as desired from the tofu mixture with a spoon, making sure to coat all sides. If the mixture is too dry before the glaze is added, add more orange juice or warm water. Enjoy.

title: Sauce for Polish Dogs
ingredients: 1 pound kielbasa, cubed | 1 cup hot sauce, or as needed
instructions: Combine kielbasa in a large pot over medium heat. Pour in hot sauce.

Random Ingredients: pistachio nut,cauliflower floret,tomato juice,chicken bouillon powder,wheat pita bread
title: Cauliflower Pita Bread Salad
ingredients: 4 whole wheat pita breads | 1 small cauliflower floret | 1/2 cup chicken bouillon powder | 1 tomato juice | 1 teaspoon pistachio nut, or more to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil, and spray with cooking spray. Spread pita breads flat, and slice on an angle to make thinner sandwiches. Arrange cauliflower florets on pita bread, and top with sliced tomato.

Random Ingredients: icing sugar,iceberg lettuce,tortilla,orange,cream chicken soup,cheddar cheese
title: Easy Party Wrap
ingredients: 1 bag of tortillas | 1/2 head iceberg lettuce, shredded | 4 ounces cheddar cheese | whole grain sour cream for topping | 3 tablespoons icing sugar | 1/2 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1 egg
instructions: Place the tortilla on a cookie tray, and toast for about 45 seconds. Remove from the oven, and tear into chunks as much as you need. Add the rest of the ingredients and mix well. Roll the wraps with your hands, and place back on the cookie sheet. Once you have rolled all 24 wraps, refrigerate until needed. Serve with sour cream and lettuce.

Random Ingredients: garlic powder,veal,fennel seed,green chili pepper,vanilla sugar,artichoke
title: Authentic Italian Marinated Meat Canapes
ingredients: 1/2 lb ground veal | 8 ounces canned artichoke | 3/4 cup chopped green chili pepper | 1/2 cup raw artificial sweetener | 3/4 cup pure vanilla sugar | 1 -2 teaspoon garlic powder
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a jar with a tight lid. Shake a large canning funnel in canning to get all ingredients into the jar. Be careful getting the mixture to hang onto the spoon if it separates, shake more often. Place the canning funnel into a larger canning funnel if you can get it to hang onto the spoon. Place canning funnel in canning funnel. If your canning funnel is too big, you will miss out on the flavor of the marinade once the canning funnel is out. After you release the jar, the mixture will keep indefinitely in the canning funnel. After 24 - 36 hours, the marinade will slightly firm if pressed. Once that is done, place in a covered container and refrigerate for up to 3 weeks. To use, remove meat from marinade and pat dry with paper towels. Take a piece of meat and flatten a bit using your palm and roll it up into a tube shape about 1/2 1 to 1 1/2 thick. Place the rolled up meat into a plastic bag and refrigerate. You can also use fresh fruit, dried pineapple slices, dried apricots, etc. You may also use a fresh fig if desired. When ready to cook, place the canning funnel into a pan with water and about half a quart of water. You can use a tall canning funnel if you wish. Put the canning funnel into the water. Place on medium heat and bring to a boil. Once the canning funnel goes into the water, remove from heat. After one hour of simmering, open the canning funnel and remove the canning funnel. You may need to open the canning funnel about 3 to 4 times to get all the air out. Once the oil is removed from the canning funnel, use the funnel to gently pierce the dried fruit, vegetable, or dried cherry tomatoes with a fork. Place onto a baking tray covered in parchment paper if you wish. When all candies are cut and placed on the baking tray, cook for about 10 minutes on 350 degrees or until slightly browned on the outside.

title: Taro Root Stuffing for Baked Potatoes
ingredients: 1 large taro root, peeled | 1 loaf white bread, crusts removed | 3 quarts water at least
instructions: Cut the rind from the taro root. Cut the roots into 3/4 inch slices and place in a large pot with enough water to cover the taro. Bring to a boil, and boil until the rind is easily pierced with a fork. Add the bread pieces, return to a boil, then cover and simmer to mash the bread pieces into the soup. Continue cooking until the bread is tender and the mash is thick enough to be mashed. Strain and cool until easily handled.

title: Brandy Wine
ingredients: 12 ounces brandy | 2 -4 ounces dried marjoram | 20 white bread
instructions: In a heavy saucepan combine all ingredients and bring to a boil. When it begins to boil, reduce heat to a very gentle simmer and cook for at least an hour and a half, until the wine has reduced by half. Serve immediately.

title: Rice Fruit Salad
ingredients: 2 fresh mangoes, peeled, pitted and diced | 2 1/2 cups cooked jasmine rice | 1 cup confectioners'sugar
instructions: Place the mango and rice in a salad bowl. Place confectioners' sugar on a plate and roll the fruit in the sugar. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: corn kernel,plum tomato,golden syrup,chili flake,cheddar cheese,tomatillo,vegetable
title: Sweetcorn and Tomato Bake
ingredients: 400 g firm tofu, cut into cubes | 50 g cheddar cheese or 100 g gruyere cheese, grated | 6 plum tomatoes, coarsely chopped | 400 g mixed vegetables, chopped into 1cm pieces ( such as broccoli, lima beans, cauliflower, zucchini, carrot, bell peppers, zucchini, zote, mustard, broccoli or beans ) | 3 tablespoons chili flakes | 1 can tomatillos, drained and coarsely chopped | 1 tablespoon golden syrup
instructions: Preheat oven to 180c line two 4cm deep, deep, heavy based shallow ovenproof dishes with baking paper. Cut tofu into cubes. Place in a bowl, sprinkle with cheese, then stir in tomatoes, vegetables, chilli flakes and tomatillos. Season with oil and plenty of cracked pepper. Mix well to combine and spoon mixture into dishes. Bake in the preheated oven for 45 minutes until heated through and golden.

Random Ingredients: okra,green cardamom pod,sourdough bread,salad oil,cellophane noodle,ham,red chili pepper,fennel seed
title: Okra on Toast
ingredients: 2 pinches fresh red chili peppers, seeds discarded or 2 pinches fennel seeds, crushed | 1 pinch green cardamom pod, crushed | 4 slices sourdough bread | 2 slices ham | 4 tablespoons salad oil | 1 teaspoon fennel seed | 1 tablespoon salad oil | 1 1/3 lbs okra | 1/2 lb cellophane noodles
instructions: Rinse okra under running water and drain, set aside. Chop the okra into 1/4 inch slices. In a small bowl combine, chillies, oil and fennel seeds.

title: Wild Rice-Au Granny Smith Applesauce
ingredients: 1 ear of corn, canned | 2 granny smith apples, peeled and cored | 1 grapefruit | 1 kiwi fruit | 2 stalks kokra | 1 package frozen okra, thawed | 2 tablespoons cornstarch
instructions: Combine corn kernels with apples, grapefruit and kiwi in a bowl and set aside. Cut kokra in half lengthwise. Remove stalks and leaves, split the stems in half, scrape out the white membrane between layers, cut the flesh into 1/2 inch cubes. Rinse okra in a colander, drain well. Dredge in cornstarch, coat with cornstarch and shake off excess. Drop apple mixture into corn, turning to coat lightly.

title: Waldorf Coleslaw II
ingredients: 4 cups coleslaw mix | 1/4 cup raisins | 1/4 teaspoon salt | 1/8 teaspoon white pepper
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix together the coleslaw mix, raisins, salt and pepper. Pour dressing over the slaw mixture, gently stirring to coat. Cover and chill for 1 to 2 hours before serving.

title: Crispy Chilled Corned Chicken Wings With Packed Cotija Cheese
ingredients: 2 cups chickpeas | 2 inches piece dried yeast | 3 tablespoons tamarind juice | 8 -10 ounces chicken wings, tips and tips removed | 1 1/2 cups half-and-half | 1/4 cup cotija cheese | 1 fresh mint sprig ( to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Drain beans, and place in mixing bowl. Soak yeast in 1/2 cup warm water for 10 minutes, and stir to dissolve the yeast. Add tamarind and 1 cup of the remaining warm water. Stir to dissolve the yeast and add 1 1/2 cups of the chickpeas. Cover and leave in a warm place for about 15 minutes. Rinse wings under cold running water and transfer to a bowl. Add the remaining 2 cups of chickpeas, chickpeas, buttermilk, salt, and 3/4 cup of the cheese and mix thoroughly. Cover and leave in a warm room to rise until the wings have doubled in bulk, about 1 hour. Heat a grill pan over a medium high heat until very hot, and brush with oil. Stir the wings and continue to toss with just enough oil so that the wings will be brown by the time the second batch is tossed into the pan. When the wings are brown on one side, turn over and brown the other. Remove from the grill and drain on paper towels. Pile the fried wings in a deep platter and serve the hot sauce along with the fried wings.

title: Crazy Calzone
ingredients: 1 tablespoon chopped shallots or 2 shallots, to your taste | 4 tablespoons shredded parmigiano flavored pecorino cheese | 4 tablespoons chopped fresh parmigiano-reggiano cheese, divided | 2 packages refrigerated crescent dinner rolls | 1 teaspoon italian seasoning | 1/4 cup chopped unsalted pistachios
instructions: Heat oven to 375°f grease a shallow cookie sheet or jelly roll pan. Mince shallots. On a baking sheet, mix shallots and 2 tablespoons each of the cheeses together. Open crescent rolls and separate each roll into 4 triangles each, using a rolling pin. Spread dough onto cookie sheet. Sprinkle with italian seasoning. Bake 25 minutes or until golden brown and puffed. Spread pistachios on tops. Serve with a side of pasta. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: fennel bulb,bulk pork sausage,beef brisket,bok choy,grain rice
title: Rice Pilafe (Meat Pilaf)
ingredients: beef brisket | bok choy | 1 lb bulk pork sausage | 1 fennel bulb | 2 1/2 tablespoons short-grain rice
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Place beef brisket and pork sausage in a roasting pan, piling them high on top of each other. Add fennel and boil in enough water to cover the meat by 1/2 inch or so. Boil brisket for 1 hour, or until tender. Pour off some of the liquid before serving. While the meat is braising, slice the rest of the vegetables into very thin slivers. Bring a medium skillet with enough water to cover the bottom of the pan to a boil. Cook vegetables for 1 to 2 minutes while brisket is simmering. Lift the meat out of the pan and place on a sheet pan, draining off any fat. Rinse pan with cold water and drain off any excess liquid from pan, letting the rice rest in there to get sticky. Place the brisket, drained vegetables, sliced meat on a platter and spoon the broth over them.

title: Basic Japanese Seasoned Salt
ingredients: 1 tablespoon mirin ( japanese sweet wine ) | 1/2 cup fresh minced italian parsley
instructions: Combine the mirin and minced parsley in a small bowl.

title: Picante Cellophane Noodles
ingredients: 2 packages cellophane noodles | 1 can vegetable broth | 1 cup picante sauce | 2 teaspoons liquid smoke
instructions: Soak cellophane noodles in warm water 5 minutes, then drain. Bring vegetable broth to boil in a saucepan and stir in picante sauce.

Random Ingredients: black pepper,ricotta cheese,parmigiano reggiano cheese,soy sauce,cannellini bean,rice noodle,pea
title: Rice Noodle Casserole
ingredients: 1 package dried cannellini beans | 3/4 cup chopped fresh peas | 3 tablespoons low sodium soy sauce | 1/4 teaspoon black pepper | 1 lb fresh ricotta cheese | 1 jar low-sodium low sodium soy sauce | 1 lb fresh rice noodles or 1 lb fresh fettuccine pasta | 1/4 cup freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Soak beans in water for at least an hour before cooking pasta as instructed, just to make them super easy to cook. The beans will have softened and become pliable. Add peas and a couple of tablespoons of soy sauce to bean and peas while beans are still hot. In a large bowl, add the drained pasta, ricotta and 1/4 cup soy sauce. Mix thoroughly with a rubber spatula. Cover with aluminum foil and let sit at room temperature for about 45 minutes to allow ricotta to cool. Add noodles into the serving dish and mix well. Sprinkle with remaining 1/4 cup soy sauce and freshly ground black pepper. Top with parmigiano reggiano. Cover with foil again and let sit in a warm oven until pasta absorbs most of the soy sauce. Bake at 425 degrees fahrenheit for 10 to 15 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Beef on Macaroni in Chocolate Sauce
ingredients: 400 g stew meat ( boneless, cut into strips ) | 2 tablespoons brandy | 1/2 cup snipped fresh sage (, or use sage sprigs, to garnish ) | cooking spray | 400 -500 g macaroni ( i used 1 packet of spirals ready to eat noodles ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons chocolate syrup | 2 tablespoons brown sugar
instructions: Place meat into a lrg non stick pan and add brandy, sage, and brown sugar. Heat & stir until sugar dissolves, about 3 minutes, then add the macaroni, stir to combine, then cook, covered, over a very low heat for about 20 minutes or until the meat is tender. Discard the bay leaves & sprinkle w/the chocolate mixture. Serve warm with steaming hot steamed seasonal vegetables.

Random Ingredients: yellow bell pepper,green chili,yoghurt,artichoke,cocoa powder,chicken stock
title: Champinones
ingredients: 2 artichokes | 2 yellow bell peppers | 2 tablespoons cocoa powder | 3 tablespoons yogurt | 3 tablespoons chicken stock | 1 green chili | 2 tablespoons yoghurt
instructions: Trim artichoke stalks. Chop the artichokes and green chillies. Cut the bell peppers into chunky pieces. Grind the chicken stock. In a bowl, combine the two powders and whisk until creamy. Add the yogghurt to it and whip. Pour this mixture over the artichokes and bell peppers. In an 8 - 10 cm non stick frying pan, put 1 tbsp oil on the top and heat until smoking hot. Spoon the artichoke mixture into the hot oil and cook in a circular motion. Turning each artichoke as the artichoke and bell pepper is cooked. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: black pepper,pastry crust pie,turmeric,dark rum,red cabbage,pancetta
title: Red Colcannon Tart
ingredients: pastry for a double-crust pie ( 9 inch pie or 9 inch pie dish ) | 2 tablespoons dark rum ( recommended ) or 2 tablespoons rum flavoured rum ( recommended ) | 1 -2 teaspoon ground turmeric | 1/2 teaspoon cracked black pepper | 1 red cabbage ( about 12 oz. ), cored and shredded | 8 ounces pancetta, cut into thin strips
instructions: Pre heat oven to 400°f. Cover pastry crust with plastic wrap or aluminum foil and bake for 8 - 10 minutes until golden brown. Remove the wrap and set aside a small amount or two of the pastry to use as a lattice layer for the tart. Mix rum or flavoured rum with turmeric and pepper in a jar. Slice cabbage thinly and place in a bowl with the rum and toss with the cabbage until coated. Pour the cabbage mixture into the pre baked crust. Add the pancetta strips and bake for 30 minutes, until the filling has puffed up and golden brown. Serve hot, room temp or chilled.

title: Peanut-Tomato Dip
ingredients: 2 cans condensed cream of celery soup | 1 can stewed tomatoes, drained | 1/2 cup tomato sauce with roasted garlic or 1/2 cup tomato paste | 1/3 cup peanut butter
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large dish, microwave on high 5 to 7 minutes, stirring occasionally.

title: Green Mango Sausage Pasta
ingredients: 500 g whole wheat spaghetti | 500 g green mangoes, peeled, cut into chunks | 450 -500 g yellow peas, peeled and cut into chunks | 3 -4 carrots, finely diced | 2 celery ribs, finely diced | 150 g prosciutto, chopped, finely chopped into 1 cm pieces | 150 ml water
instructions: Cook spaghetti with lots of salt and a little oil, according to packet instructions. Cook the mango until all pink has disappeared, then add the cooked mango, peas, carrots, celery and prosciutto. Add half the water if you feel it needs it. Drain pasta as soon as it’s so tender. When pasta is done, mix all ingredients together in the same pot and check to see how everything is cooking. If it’s still a little crunchy, mix in some more water.

title: Nooka Popsicles
ingredients: 24 small dried red chilies | 100 g small dried fruit | 2 tablespoons icing sugar | 2 tablespoons finely chopped fresh cilantro | 1 teaspoon ground turmeric | chopped fresh cilantro
instructions: Place the red chilies and dried fruit in a heatproof bowl, cover, and leave to stand for 10 minutes. Make the icing by mixing the icing sugar with the cilantro and turmeric and adding gradually so as not to curdle the icing. Stir until all the liquid is absorbed and the icing is drizzled. Transfer to an airtight container and leave for 2 - 3 hours to develop its flavour. When ready to serve, use 2 teaspoons to scoop 1 teaspoonful of icing from the bowl and spread over the top of each dried fruit. Sprinkle with extra chopped coriander to serve.

title: Yoshidas (Yellow Squash With Sweet Chili and Sugar)
