ingredients: 1 large yellow squash, peeled, seeded, sliced lengthwise into thin rounds | 1/2 teaspoon grated palm sugar ( or sub with raw palm sugar ) | 1/2 teaspoon grated fresh lemon rind | 2 tablespoons chopped sweet anaheim chilies | 2 tablespoons oil | 1 tablespoon mirin
instructions: Place the squash rounds between two sheets of plastic wrap on a work surface. Pound them with a meat mallet or cleaver or flat mallet until very thin about 4 to 5 inches in diameter. If using a rolling pin, roll the dough into a cylinder shape, about 1/4 inch thick. Place the squash roll onto the greased plate. Add more if necessary to cover the top and side of the roll. In a small bowl, sprinkle the sugar and lemon rind on the squash roll. Place in the refrigerator to marinate while preparing the sweet chili sauce. To prepare the sweet chili sauce, in a small saucepan, heat the oil over medium high heat. When almost smoking, add the chiles and cook for about 3 minutes, or until crisp tender and fragrant. Remove from the heat and stir in the mirin. When the squash rolls are done marinating, drain off any excess water and carefully place 1 to 2 tablespoons of the sweet chili sauce in each of the 4 servings of skewers. Serve hot drizzled with the remaining sweet chili sauce.

title: Chilli Asparagus With Cream Cheese
ingredients: 500 g asparagus | 60 g cream cheese | 1 tablespoon caster sugar | chili oil ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c. Boil the water in a pan for 5 minutes. Trim the asparagus and cut in 2cm pieces. Place in a large roasting tin. Add cream cheese, sugar and chilli oil to taste. Mix well and set the oven to 200c or 300 degrees. Bake for 30 - 40 minutes until the asparagus is tender and the cream cheese is just beginning to bubble. Serve warm with wedges of iceberg or arugula.

Random Ingredients: oregano leaf,graham cracker,green onion,saffron,hot chili sauce,wheat flour,pumpkin,orange peel
title: Pumpkin Bread
ingredients: 1 1/4 gallons pumpkin ( or 2 1/4-pound pepitas ) | 4 ounces fresh ginger, grated ( about 5 3/4 ounces ) | 4 green onions, finely chopped | 1/4 cup fresh oregano leaves, finely chopped | 1/4 teaspoon saffron ( or 1/8-1/4 teaspoon ground black cardamom ) | 1/4 cup sifted hot chili sauce ( to taste ) | 2 1/8 cups whole wheat flour | 1/4 cup finely chopped orange peel
instructions: Pumpkin. Heat the oven to 400°f in the bowl of a food processor pulse the pumpkin until it resembles coarse meal, about 60 - 60 pulses. Reserve about 1/2 cup of the pumpkin mixture. Press the pulp through a sieve or ricer into a bowl and set aside. Gingerbread. In a heavy 2 - 3 quart saucepan, combine the ginger, green onion, oregano, saffron, hot chili sauce and about 3 1/2 cups of the water. Cook, uncovered, over medium high heat, stirring constantly, until the oil rises to the top. Reduce the heat to medium. Cook, stirring constantly, until the water evaporates, about 4 minutes. Quickly stir in the pumpkin mixture. Let the mixture cool down to the room temperature. In a large bowl combine the flour, orange peel and reserved pumpkin liquid. Add the flour mixture to the pumpkin mixture to form a smooth batter. Line 2 - 3 parchment lined baking sheets with aluminum foil. Turn the baking sheets over and spoon the batter into the prepared pans. Bake the bread until a golden crust is formed around the edges, 15 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: cayenne,poblano chile,heavy whipping cream,spring onion,egg white,cooking spray,chipotle chile
title: Chipotle Crepes With Green Chile Mayonnaise
ingredients: 150 ml heavy whipping cream | 4 large poblano chiles, 1/4-inch diced | 1 tablespoon grated chipotle chile ( canned chipotle seasoning ) or 1 tablespoon adobo sauce | 1 tablespoon cooking spray | 2 teaspoons minced spring onions | 1 1/2 tablespoons finely minced fresh poblano chiles or 1 1/2 tablespoons minced ancho chilies ( canned chipotle seasoning ) | 1 egg white | 1 pinch cayenne
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment. With a serrated knife, cut a slit down the center of each chile a little. Remove and discard seeds and white membrane, leaving the chile flesh intact. Stir together cream, chile and 1 tablespoon chipotle chipotle powder in a medium bowl. Coat a 7” nonstick frying pan with cooking spray and set it over medium high heat. When it shimmers, add ancho and 1 teaspoon cooking oil. When it shimmers, add 1/2 teaspoon minced chiles and 1/2 teaspoon minced chopped chile. Stir in 1/2 cup cream mixture. When it thickens, about 3 minutes, add remaining cream mixture and cook until the liquid evaporates, about 4 minutes longer. Remove from heat. Stir in spring onions and poblano chiles. Transfer the crepe mixture to a shallow bowl. Let cool slightly, about 20 minutes. Heat a lightly oiled 6” nonstick skillet over medium heat. When it shimmers, fold in the crepe mixture. Using a rubber spatula, fold in remaining 1½ tablespoons chipotle mayonnaise. Serve immediately in warmed plates.

title: Adobo Ginger Powder
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon crushed gingerroot | 3/4 - 1 teaspoon adobo seasoning
instructions: Combine ginger, adobo, and salt in small bowl.

title: Spinach and Rice Burger With Smoked Turkish Bread
ingredients: 4 slices of dense smoked turkish bread | 1 head fresh spinach leaves | 1 dash tabasco sauce, sauce to taste
instructions: Preheat a skillet over medium to low heat. Trim spinach leaves and cut leaves in half lengthwise. Place leaves on a cutting board and cut them crosswise into thin strips. Divide each half of leaf among 4 small sized burger tins. Drizzle with tabasco and grill or toast on each side for 3 - 4 minutes. Spread with smoked turkish bread until preferred crispiness is achieved.

Random Ingredients: white onion,heavy cream,green onion,black mustard seed,tamari,enchilada sauce
title: Tamari Cream Sauce
ingredients: 2 packages prepared enchilada sauce ( mild or spicy ) | 2 tablespoons tamari | 2 tablespoons heavy cream, to taste | 1/2 medium white onion, minced | 1 small green onion, minced | 2 teaspoons fresh minced black mustard seeds
instructions: Place a large saucepan over medium high heat. When it begins to simmer, add the enchilada sauce, tamari, heavy cream and minced onion. Mix throughly, until all ingredients are well blended. When the sauce reaches a boil, reduce the heat to low and simmer for 15 minutes. Mix in the black mustard seed and remove from heat before serving in small bowl. The sauce can be refrigerated and reheated up to 3 hours prior to serving.

title: Easy Beef & Pinto Bean Salad
ingredients: 2 lbs ground chuck | 1 lb chopped cooked chicken or 1 lb pork | 1 can pinto beans, rinsed and drained | 1/2 head romaine lettuce, chopped | 1/4 cup pitted prunes
instructions: Brown ground chuck in a skillet. Drain. Add the rest of the ingredients. Allow to cook over medium heat until everything is well mixed and heated through. Serve on romaine lettuce leaves.

title: Chilli Fry Bread
ingredients: 1 cup rye flour or 1 cup regular flour | 1 cup italian salad dressing | 1/4 cup fresh red chilies, roasted ( or crushed )
instructions: In a bowl, mix together the rye flour and salad dressing. Pour into a piping bag and squeeze the chilies into the mixture. Use as required for desired texture for frying. Allow frying to cool for at least 25 minutes or overnight before frying.

title: Cuban Fried Garlic
ingredients: 6 large garlic heads, peeled | 5 teaspoons oregano flakes | 5 teaspoons papayas | 2 teaspoons chives | 1/2 teaspoon allspice
instructions: Separate the cloves of garlic heads. Wash and dry them. Using a knife, press the cloves of garlic into a single layer on a nonstick cookie sheet. Sprinkle each with 1 teaspoon oregano, 1 teaspoon papaya, 3 teaspoons chive and 1/2 teaspoon allspice. Broil the garlic for 20 minutes, shaking and turning once, until it is softened and fragrant. Cool for 10 minutes. Use your fingers to scrape off any bitter garlic that remains. Serve with fresh, raw vegetables. Note, you might want to make a spice mixture of 1 tablespoon oregano, 1 teaspoon papaya, 1 teaspoon chives and 1/2 teaspoon allspice.

Random Ingredients: basil,chervil,buffalo mozzarella,milk ricotta cheese,ha avocado,cream chicken soup,savoy cabbage,snow pea
title: Baked Avocados
ingredients: 1 hass avocado, peeled, pitted, and sliced into 1/8-inch rounds | 8 ounces buffalo mozzarella | 1 cup shredded savoy cabbage | 1/4 cup chopped fresh basil | 1/1/4 cup chopped fresh chervil | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1/2 cup milk ricotta cheese | 8 ounces snow peas, trimmed, cut in half
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a shallow bowl, toss ricotta cheese with the basil, chervil, soup, and enough milk to make a stiff paste. Spoon about 2 1/2 tablespoons of the ricotta cheese mixture in the center of each slice of avocado. Top with about 1/12 of the cabbage, and 1/8 of the mozzarella cheese. Arrange slices of avocado around the cheese and filling. Bake in the preheated oven until the mozzarella has melted and begun to brown, 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Buttered Bean and Chicken (Rice) Risotto
ingredients: 1 cup barley, coarsely chopped | 2 medium chicken, cut into 1 1/2 inch cubes | 1 cup arborio rice | 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato, julienned | 15 -20 butter beans, topped with stems left over | 26 ounces barley, with a little added, to thin | 2 tablespoons sherry wine
instructions: In a large stockpot combine the barley and a little of the sun dried tomatoes and cook over a medium heat, until the barley has absorbed the water. Increase the heat and stir in the chicken. The tomatoes will swell as they boil and the stock will have a strong aroma. If you would like a little extra flavour, add a touch of sherry, and remove the chicken from the pan for a few minutes before adding the barley. When the chicken is heated through, add the rice, mixing well to coat. Add a couple of tablespoons of sun dried tomatoes and a cup of stock, and continue adding the stock until the rice is tender and creamy, about 20 minutes. Season with salt and pepper. To eat, stir rice around the chicken and pour in warmed chicken broth and garnish with the chopped sun dried tomatoes. Variation, use frozen butter beans and a little sherry to save the time.

title: Spaghetti and Tahini Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup tahini | 8 ounces spaghetti, cooked
instructions: Combine and serve over hot cooked noodles.

title: Rice With Tequila
ingredients: 1 cup long grain rice ( i like to use jasmine white, but regular is okay ) | 3/4 cup tequila
instructions: Heat your tequila and mix with the rice. Let it sit for just a couple of seconds and enjoy.

title: Quick and Easy Barley Smoothies
ingredients: 400 g pearl barley | 1 cup mixed fruit | 2 tablespoons hot sauce | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: Place the soaked pearl barley and mixed fruit in a saucepan. Add the hot sauce and vanilla essence. Bring to the boil. Reduce heat. Cover and simmer for 35 minutes.

title: Easy Beet Grilled Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 lb sirloin, thinly sliced | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1/4 teaspoon dried tarragon | 1 tablespoon lemon juice | 8 ounces shredded mozzarella cheese | 1 small beet
instructions: Sprinkle beef with seasoning salt and tarragon. Arrange beef on a cutting board and spread with lemon juice. Divide cheese evenly among the 4 slices of beef. Layer beet slices and beef. Brush with remaining lemon juice and sprinkle with salt. Grill for 6 minutes or until desired doneness.

title: Baked Chickpea Soup
ingredients: 2 cans chickpeas, drained | 6 cups cold water | 2 thick slices bread, cut into cubes | 4 pieces ginger root, sliced | 1 teaspoon red wine vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon savory, or to taste
instructions: Combine chickpeas and water in a blender.

Random Ingredients: beef chuck,apple juice,puff pastry,beef tenderloin,bulk italian sausage,chickpea
title: Italian Sausage Rolls
ingredients: 1 package beef tenderloin, cut into 1 in/2 inch cubes | 1 package bulk hot italian sausage | 1 package frozen puff pastry, defrosted | 1 can chickpeas, drained ( with liquid ) | 1 1/2 cups apple juice
instructions: Set oven temp to 375 degrees f. Grease 10 inch square baking pan. In a large bowl mix the meat, sausages, and pastry until well mixed. Add chick peas and apples and mix and coat evenly. Spread mixture into prepared pan. Bake in preheated oven for 45 - 50 minutes or until golden brown. Serve hot with your favorite italian sauce and bread.

title: Anise and Parsley Tea
ingredients: 3 tablespoons salad oil | 3 teaspoons anise seed, crushed | fresh parsley sprigs, for garnishing
instructions: Heat the salad oil in a non stick frying pan over a medium heat. Add the anise and the crushed seeds and leave to swell and colour. Pour in the tea leaves and cook stirring regularly until the mint leaves have wilted slightly. Garnish with fresh parsley sprigs and serve.

Random Ingredients: rice vinegar,black pepper,apple juice,grain rice,tabasco sauce,basil pesto,pine nut
title: Cranberry-Pineapple Rice Salad
ingredients: 1/3 cup rice vinegar | 1/3 cup apple juice | 2 tablespoons dried basil pesto, chopped | 1 tablespoon tabasco sauce | 1/2 cup coarsely chopped pine nuts | fresh ground black pepper | 1 cup hot cooked long-grain rice, chilled
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together the vinegar, juice, pesto, tabasco, pine nuts, and pepper until well combined. Add in the rice and mix well. Cover and chill in the refrigerator for 1 hour or until ready to serve.

title: Pacific Salmon and Pea Salad
ingredients: 1 whole pound salmon, cut into 8 pieces, skin removed | 1/2 cup half and half cream | 1 mango - peeled, seeded, and diced | 10 green chile peppers, cut into strips, or to taste ( optional ) | 1 package frozen chopped broccoli, or as needed | 1 cup frozen peas, thawed | 2 cups cooked basmati rice | 1 tablespoon dry sherry
instructions: Cover the salmon with water in a saucepan, and bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat to medium low, cover, and simmer until the salmon is easily flaked with a fork, about 10 minutes. Drain, and cool, about 15 minutes. Rinse salmon, and shake off excess skin and bones. Place salmon in the refrigerator for 15 minutes to firm. Whisk half and half, mango, green chile strips, and broccoli together in a bowl. Place a layer of salmon in a serving bowl, and top with a layer of peas. Season with sherry, and garnish with a little more green chile strips.

title: Smoked Salmon
ingredients: 6 salmon fillets | 2 ounces double cream | mint sprig ( to garnish )
instructions: Place fish on baking paper and bake in oven on 350f / 230°c / gas mark 6 for 10 - 15 minutes or until cooked. Remove from oven and brush with cream leaving a little on each side. Sprinkle with mint leaves. Serve with sauce.

title: Fish With Roasted Ricotta and Fried Olives
ingredients: 1 tablespoon olive | 1 medium baby red potato, halved | 1 1/4 lbs top round fish fillets, such as halibut | 1/4 cup ricotta cheese, drained ( reserve 1/4 cup )
instructions: Preheat broiler. Wrap potato tightly with foil.

Random Ingredients: cumin seed,italian cheese,onion,corn flake crumb,cream,channa dal,yellow squash
title: Baked Mexican Squash
ingredients: 1 lb yellow squash, unpeeled and cut into 1-inch cubes | 2 1/2 ounces channa dal, canned, drained | 1 teaspoon cumin seed, toasted and coarsely ground | 1/2 cup italian cheese blend, shredded | 1/2 cup sour cream | 1/2 cup onion, sliced ( optional ) | 1/2 cup crumbled italian cheese blend, to sprinkle on top before serving
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Place squash, channa dal, ground cumin and italian cheese in a large bowl. In a small bowl, combine sour cream, onion and italian cheese blend. Stir together with sour cream until just incorporated. Spoon mixture into a large casserole dish or oven proof baking dish coated with cooking spray. Sprinkle top with cheese. Bake in a preheated oven until cheese is lightly browned, bubbly and beginning to melt, about 40 minutes.

title: Cousin
ingredients: 1/3 cup dried black mushrooms | 2 1/4 cups water
instructions: Put the dried mushrooms in a mixing bowl with the water. Stir well, then cover bowl and leave in fridge for 20 minutes. Drain the mushrooms, rinse, but keep fresh. Wash your hands well and rub salt and pepper into the fresh mushrooms. In a small bowl, pour 1 tsp of cooking oil over mushrooms before opening and squishing with the back of a spoon to make them as close to oil as you can get them. Do not squeeze dry or any of the liquid out. Cover with plastic wrap and allow to sit for 20 minutes. Remove wrap and discard the salt and pepper. Serve immediately.

title: Salsa Salad
ingredients: 10 ounces salsa | 1 green bell pepper, cut into thin strips | 1 1/2 teaspoons german mustard | 1 1/2 teaspoons flour
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Cover and chill 1 to 2 hours.

title: Mushroom & Tomato Meat Loaf
ingredients: 450 g mushrooms ( sliced ) | 450 g ground turkey | 1 1/2 tablespoons tom ketchup | 1 1/2 tablespoons tarragon ( dried, chopped ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons ginger ( dried, chopped )
instructions: Place the burger ingredients in a large bowl and mix really well. Pat into a large loaf tin which has been lined with greaseproof paper. Bake in a moderately hot oven 220°c, gas mark 6 for 20mins or until cooked through.

title: Beef and Mushroom Gravy
ingredients: 1 lb fresh beef gravy | 1/3 cup currants or 1/3 cup raisins | 1 package sliced fresh green mushrooms
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Coat an oven proof skillet with cooking spray. Add gravy mix, mushrooms and currants/raisins to skillet. Cover tightly. Bake for 1 1/2 to 1 1/2 hours, until bubbly.

title: Basic Green Tea (Tandoori)
ingredients: 6 tablespoons green tea ( or water or sugar depending on your taste preferences ) | 1 pinch asafoetida powder
instructions: Heat green tea in your preferred steamer or pot. You should have 3 - 4 tbsp of tea. When the green tea tastes cooked, add asafoetida powder. Stir. Add a bit at a time, stirring as needed until all the tea is absorbed. Stir. Keep adding asafoetida. You should get a green tea consistency. If not, mix 1 or 2 tbsp green tea water and the red chilli flakes. This is considered to be a mild recipe.

title: Roasted Oranges With Maple Syrup
ingredients: 1 lb orange bell pepper, halved and seeded | 2 tablespoons maple syrup
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line baking sheets with parchment paper. Cut orange bell pepper into quarters and remove seeds. Place cut side down in an ovenproof skillet and coat with oil. Roast for 20 to 30 minutes, or until charred. Remove from oven and toss with maple syrup. Let cool 5 minutes before serving.

title: Quick and Easy "Hot" Italian Dressing
ingredients: 1 envelope italian salad dressing mix | 1 teaspoon caraway seed ( optional )
instructions: Prepare salad dressing according to package directions. Stir in caraway seed according to package instructions. Pour over chicken or pork before or just before serving.

title: Bun-Gung-Kai (Spicy Eggplant-Lidia Bastianich)
ingredients: 1 large eggplant | 2 tablespoons thai sweet chili sauce | 2 plum tomatoes | 8 leaves fresh kale
instructions: Peel and slice eggplant crosswise into 1/8 inch thick slices. Place slices in a non stick skillet over moderate heat and cook about 10 minutes, or until lightly browned on both sides. Transfer eggplant slices to a plate, cover and refrigerate for 1 hour. Meanwhile, preheat broiler. Place tomato on a baking sheet. Broil about 2 minutes, or until blackened. Remove eggplant slices from skillet and cool slightly. Cut one tomato into 3 pieces and place cut sides down on a cutting board. Place the eggplant slices in a single layer on the hot baking sheet. Broil about 4 minutes, or until lightly browned on the edges. Spread sliced tomato evenly over the eggplant with a spatula. Broil about 4 minutes, or until lightly browned. Turn eggplant slices over with a spatula and broil until lightly browned on the second side. Place cooked eggplant slices on a serving platter, place tomato slices over the tomato and serve.

title: Baked Chicken & Chickpeas Appetizer
ingredients: 4 chicken cutlets ( about 4 oz each ) | 1 can chickpeas | 2 ounces italian parsley, chopped | 1/2 cup apple cider ( not sweetened ) | 1 sheet puff pastry, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees fahrenheit. In a bowl combine chicken, chickpeas and parsley with cider and add enough water to allow mixture to come to a boil and thickened a little, about 5 minutes remove from heat. Pat chicken dry with a paper towel and put into a 9 inch pie or cookie sheet to which you have prepared a border of foil, fold up edges of foil to seal. Make sure chicken is completely covered with mixture then brush chicken with some of cider mixture. Bake at 375 degrees for 30 - 40 minutes or until chicken is lightly browned and juices run clear. To freeze, place in a zip lock bag and keep in fridge. To make ahead, transfer chicken to bowl of a ziplock bag and add plastic wrap, seal and place in freezer. When chicken has cooled, remove plastic wrap and refrigerate until solid, about 1 hour. Cut to serving size.

title: Beef and Prawn Casserole
ingredients: 2 lbs beef brisket | 1 lb potato starch | 4 tablespoons soya sauce | 4 lbs fresh prawns | 2 lbs fresh green beans
instructions: Wash and cut the beef into chunks and dispose of the bones. If the beef is large, cut it into chunks and soak it in cold water for 30 minutes or so. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Cut the remaining brisket in half and remove any fat and trasiage. Cut the meat and prawn meat into chunks and lightly pound them in a little potato starch with a meat mallet to pound them more evenly. Sprinkle with salt and lightly salt the shrimp. Arrange half of the beef chunks on a very high rack of ovenproof roasting pan and place the remainder of the meat cubes on top. Cover with the tomato ketchup and the soya sauce and sprinkle the remaining potato starch over it. Bake uncovered in a very hot oven for 75 minutes at 350 degrees f, then turn off oven. After 70 minutes, remove from oven and set aside for 10 more minutes before serving. Remove the meat and prawns from the pan with a slotted spoon and pour off all but 2 tablespoons of the cooking liquid with the cooking spoon. Drain the meat, discarding the fat, if any. Put the meat on a serving plate, arrange the remaining meat and prawn meat around it and add the beans and finally top with the potato starch and tomato ketchup to the pan juices. Serve hot or cold with kampheen noodles.

title: Honey Coated Great Northern Beans
ingredients: 1 lb great northern bean | 2 tablespoons mirin
instructions: Dissolve mirin with mirin. Pour over beans and chill or bake for 3 hours.

title: Pesto Baked Saganaki
ingredients: 16 ounces gruyere cheese ( about 2 pounds, may buy danish if available ) | 2 tablespoons pine nuts ( optional )
instructions: Pre heat oven to 350 ° f. Using a sharp knife, slice cheese into 1/8 inch thick slices about halfway through. Arrange on a paper towel lined baking sheet. If using pine nuts, spread them on a cookie sheet. Pour the pine nuts over the cheese slices. Bake at 350 ° f for 10 to 15 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Crock Pot Chocolate Mochaccino
ingredients: 1/2 cup dutch-processed cocoa | 1/2 cup pecorino romano cheese | 2 tablespoons garlic paste, or to taste | 1 ounce dark chocolate, grated
instructions: Place cocoa, romano cheese, garlic paste, and dark chocolate in the crock pot. Stir until blended.

Random Ingredients: bulk pork sausage,green lentil,beefsteak tomato,onion lengthwise,date,coconut oil
title: Kottbullar
ingredients: 1 large beefsteak tomato, chopped | 1/2 cup date, pitted and coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup frozen unsweetened green lentils | 1/3 cup coconut oil | 1 pound bulk pork sausage | 1/2 cup chopped onion lengthwise and seperately | 1 tablespoon chopped dates
instructions: Place the tomato and dates in food processor and process until chopped and liquid is finely textured. Pour the tomato puree into a large nonstick skillet and set over moderate heat. Cook and stir the dried beans, coconut oil, and pork sausage, breaking up the sausage as it cooks, until the sausage is lightly browned and the pork sausage are no longer pink in the center about 5 minutes. Stir in the onion, dates, and tomato puree and cook the mixture, stirring, about 5 minutes. The mixture is hot and slightly thickened, but not hard.

title: Potato Sticks
ingredients: 1 package russet potatoes, peeled and cut into 3/4 inch cubes | cotija cheese
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees f. In a medium bowl, toss potatoes together with cheese. Arrange on a baking sheet and roast for about 40 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Braised Onions
ingredients: 3 lbs red onions, cut into thin wedges
instructions: Lay the onions in a 2 quart casserole or on shallow plates. If the onions are large, trim the ends and cut them into thick slices with a serrated knife. Cover the onions with cold water by about 1 inch in order to decrease their moisture content. Allow them to sit covered until the water goes below the tops. Preheat the oven to 325°f. Cook the onions in boiling salted water for 1½ to 2 hours, until the onions are quite tender. Drain and cool them slightly. Toss the onions through an electric sieve. Pour the onions into a roasting pan or deep flameproof skillet. Put the pan in the oven, lower the heat to 300°f, and cook the onions for 2½ to 3 hours, tossing and stirring them every 2 - ½ to 3 hours, or until the onions have a soupy, somewhat dry consistency. Cover the onions with cold water by 1 inch in a large pot and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Boil rapidly until the water is almost absorbed. Reduce heat, remove from the heat. Cover the bottom of the dish with aluminum foil and set the pan in it to heat slowly. Reduce the sauce the next day. Keep the pan warm over low heat. Make sure it is not burning. When the onions are done, turn on a heat resistant plate and cool the onions completely. The coating will not stick. Remove the onion in thin strips over a bowl, cover and store in a cool place until serving.

title: Pesto Rice Bowl (Rice Paper Cups)
ingredients: 1 package rice noodles | 1/2 cup salad greens, chopped ( arugula, spinach, parsley, etc ) | 1/3 cup maple syrup | 2 teaspoons maple syrup ( for glaze )
instructions: Prepare rice noodles, according to package directions. Keep warm. Combine pesto ingredients in bowl, making sure it is completely combined. Cut one corner off each paper cup and use to remove a portion of noodle, from the envelope. Pesto will be sticky and sticky. Place rice paper cups on cookie sheet lined with aluminum foil. Place in refrigerator until cool to the touch. Place in a large bowl or serving dish. Cut remaining paper cups into squares and place in the bowl with pesto. Carefully remove noodles from bowl, shaking off excess pesto, and place noodles on a small plate or platter. Drizzle on more maple syrup if desired. Serve immediately, or store in an airtight container for longer storage.

title: Stuffed Cabbage and Prawns
ingredients: 1 medium cabbage | 500 g prawns, with shell | 5 slices cinnamon
instructions: Quarter the head of cabbage lengthways and remove the hard core. Carefully trim around the core and any bleached material and save. Chop the cabbage leaves roughly, then roll the cabbage leaves in the cinnamon, placing them evenly around the head. Preheat the oven to 220°c/450°f/gas place the prawns in a non metallic bowl with plenty of salt. Place them on top of the cabbage and cover with cling film. Leave on one side overnight. NextDay remove the cling film and transfer the prawns to a large ovenproof dish. Slice a couple of slices from the head and cover with the remaining cabbage leaves, making sure to get all the little woody bits of cabbage still in the core. Cover with baking paper and bake in the oven until the prawns have turned opaque.

title: Mango Chicken
ingredients: 1 whole chicken, cut in half | 1 package dry onion soup mix | 1 can mango, drained and reserve juice | 1 can cranberry juice
instructions: Place chicken in a slow cooker. Add remaining ingredients, mix and cook on high 8 - 10 hours or on low 5 - 6 hours.

Random Ingredients: lamb stew meat,white chocolate,beef brisket,cream mushroom soup,extra virgin olive oil,chili flake,fig
title: Crock Pot Hot & Sweet Lamb
ingredients: 1 lb lamb stew meat, trimmed of excess fat | 2 teaspoons chili flakes | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1 lb fresh fig, chopped | 1 beef brisket, trimmed and cut into 4-6 pieces ( leave stem on if you want this ) | extra virgin olive oil | white chocolate, curls on top ( optional )
instructions: In a crockpot, brown lamb on all sides. Add chili flakes and soup. Mix well. Add figs and brisket pieces. Cover and cook on low for 8 - 9 hours. Use foil or a lid or a lid to keep hot from leaks. When you want to serve, sprinkle with white chocolate curls in a little melted white chocolate and serve with warm bread.

title: Italian Pesto Pork Chops
ingredients: 2/3 cup half & half | 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 1 tablespoon white sugar | 2 teaspoons dried basil pesto | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley | 2 cooked pork chops, cut into thin strips
instructions: Mix half and half, worcestershire sauce, sugar, and basil pesto in a large resealable plastic bag or bowl. Add pork strips, coat with marinade, and refrigerate 30 minutes to overnight. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Remove pork chops from bag and discard marinade. Cook pork slices in preheated oven until golden brown and cooked through, about 10 minutes.

title: Four Cheese Fontina
ingredients: 1/2 cup fontina cheese, grated | 3 tablespoons grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a medium bowl, toss fontina with parmigiano reggiano. Line a jelly roll pan with foil, and spread fontina mixture into pan. Bake 15 minutes in the preheated oven, until fontina is golden and bubbly. Cut into 4 pieces and serve warm.

Random Ingredients: white onion,arugula,vodka,ranch salad dressing,cream,greek yogurt,caster sugar
title: Ravioli Salad With Cream and Yogurt
ingredients: 200 g thick fat sour cream | 500 g greek yogurt | 1 teaspoon caster sugar | 150 g sour cream | 150 g caster sugar | 1 small white onion, chopped | 100 g fresh ranch salad dressing | 1 bunch rocket, washed and chopped | 1 tablespoon vodka
instructions: Mix the sour cream, greek yoghurt, caster sugar, onion and 1 teaspoon salt in a medium size pan. Cover and chill the mixture overnight. Toss the salad ingredients over a medium heat until the onions are softened. Add vodka and stir continuously until the greek yoghurt reduces slightly and starts to coat the back of the spoon. Remove from the heat and pour over the salad and toss.

title: Clams in Yoghurt Salad
ingredients: 20 small squid, tubes separated | 1 container greek yogurt | 1 cup cherry, drained | 1/2 cup peanuts, crushed | 1/2 vanilla bean, slit | 1 tablespoon vinegar | 1 tablespoon paprika chili powder
instructions: Boil the salted water and the squid in it for about 10 min, then drain and cool down the squid. Mix the yogurt, cherries and peanuts together and add the vanilla bean and vinegar. Serve over lettuce.

Random Ingredients: rotel tomato chilies,orange zest,stock cube,linguine,ginger garlic paste,vidalia onion,watermelon
title: Watermelon & Chilli Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb linguine | 1 lb watermelon, cubed | 1 vidalia onion | 1 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste | 6 ounces rovo chilies, chopped | 6 ounces rotel tomatoes & chilies, chopped | 1/2 cup orange zest, grated
instructions: Cook pasta according to packet instructions, until al dente. Meanwhile, place remaining ingredients in a pan, and bring to the boil, stirring. Reduce heat and simmer for 5 mins, stirring occasionally. Drain pasta and return to pan. Stir through sauce and serve immediately.

title: Baked Cantaloupe
ingredients: 3 ripe cantaloupe | 1 tablespoon dark brown sugar | 1 pint clam juice | 1/2 cup double cream
instructions: Peel and dice the cantaloupe. Place the cantaloupe and sugar in a roasting tin and add clam juice, cover and roast in a moderate oven for 15 minutes. Stir and add the cream just before serving.

title: Tofu Steak With Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 piece lean sushi grade tofu, trimmed to a 3-inch x 1/2-inch rectangle ( not silky ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons tamari ( or sesame oil ) | 1 teaspoon fenugreek seeds | 1 1/2 teaspoons lime wedges or 1 1/2 teaspoons lemon wedges | shredded gruyere ( to garnish )
instructions: Slice tofu into 1/8 inch thick slices. Combine tamari, fenugreek, and lime or lemon juice in a small bowl and let them sit for 10 minutes. In a large skillet or wok, heat 1/4″ oil on medium high heat. Add tofu and turn over. Cook for 2 minutes or until golden brown on both sides. Turn the tofu and cook another minute. Transfer the tofu to a cutting board and let cool 2 minutes, then cut into 1/4″ thick squares. Repeat with remaining tofu and re freeze for 30 minutes. Serve with dipping sauce.

Random Ingredients: parsley leaf,cannellini bean,almond flour,lime,salmon fillet,kernel corn,butter
title: Salmon With Sweet Bean Mash
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs salmon fillets | 1 tablespoon almond flour | 1/2 lime or 1/2 lemon, juice of | 1 teaspoon dried parsley leaves | 4 tablespoons unsalted butter or 4 tablespoons margarine | 2 cans cannellini beans | 1 can whole kernel corn, drained
instructions: Place salmon, skin side down, on baking sheet. Bake 25 minutes at 400°f until just cooked through. Run salmon under broiler or in grill for 5 to 7 minutes or so until skin flakes. Meanwhile, make sweet bean mash. Place butter, beans, corn and 1/4 cup water into a small pan and turn heat to low. Cook until beans are heated through. Drain beans and put in a large bowl. Add salt and pepper to taste. To serve, arrange salmon on a bed of mashed beans on the plate. Sprinkle sweet bean mash on top.

Random Ingredients: mustard powder,lemon lime beverage,corn,apple cider vinegar,cream cheese,olive oil,flat leaf italian parsley,grenadine
title: Polish Dressing
ingredients: 1/4 cup lemon lime beverage | 2 tablespoons apple cider vinegar | 3 tablespoons dry mustard powder | 1 tablespoon grenadine | 2 tablespoons sour cream | 1 tablespoon corn | 1 1/2 teaspoons chopped flat-leaf italian parsley | 6 tablespoons olive oil
instructions: In a jar with a tight fitting lid, combine the lemon lime soda, cider vinegar, dry mustard powder, grenadine, sour cream, corn, and parsley. Drizzle in the olive oil.

title: Kielbasa (Aka Sausages)
ingredients: 3 -6 links turkey kielbasa | 600 ml double cream
instructions: Start by preparing the sausages. Make sure you have plenty of space, because the cream can dribble through the surface of the sausage. If this does not stop, add a little more cream. Start soaking the sausages in a pan of boiling water for about 10 or 15 minutes. While the sausages are soaking, start making the sauce. Add the cream into a pan and reduce, stirring continuously with a wooden spoon. This should start to thicken up. Add the cream to the pan, and bring the mixture up to a boil. Lower the heat and simmer the mixture for 10 or 15 minutes. Keep repeating this until you have reached the stage of your “crockpot” which is already boiling. Keep an eye on it and don’t burn the cream. If the sausage starts to stick to the bottom of the pan, you may need to cook a little longer. This will take about 20 minutes of slow cooking. If the cream starts to separate from the pan, remove from heat. Slice the sausages into 1/4 slices, about 1 1/2 inches thick. Place the sausages in a shallow dish, pour the hot cream over them, and leave until it is thickened, about 3 hours. Strain the cream off the sausages and serve the sausages out on paper towels. Serve with boiled new potatoes and a green salad.

Random Ingredients: cumin powder,glutinous rice,pepperoni,sherry,onion flake,red curry paste
title: Red Peppers Oriental Rice Bowl
ingredients: 1 teaspoon red curry paste | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 3 -4 tablespoons red curry paste ( or a little extra ) | 2 cans refrigerated glutinous rice ( can use more, but i'm not a big fan of glutinous rice ) | 1 cup sweet pepperoni, finely chopped ( or a mixture of peppers ) | 1/2 cup chopped onion | 3 tablespoons sauteed sherry or 3 tablespoons water
instructions: Heat a large skillet and stir fry the peppers, chopped onion, and red curry paste until the onion is soft and the pepper is soft. Add all other ingredients. Stir well. Heat for 3 - 4 minutes. Serve the spicy rice over white rice or in individual bowls.

Random Ingredients: vanilla,pork sparerib,gelatin,spicy sausage,green olive,red cabbage,lemon juice zest,pistachio
title: Lemon Jelly Painted Cafe
ingredients: 1/2 head red cabbage ( shredded ) | 3 lbs pork spareribs | 1 lb spicy sausage | 1/2 cup pistachios | 6 green olives | 1 1/2 cups light vanilla jelly ( use the 2-oz. packet ) | 1 lemon, juice and zest of, grated | 1/4 cup gelatin, powder
instructions: Prepare the caramel, in a 2 cup heavy bottomed saucepan over medium heat, melt the jelly. It should be slightly translucent, but not brown. Remove from the heat and immediately stir in the lemon zest and set aside. Prep the meat, in a large pot, brown the spare ribs on all sides until well browned. Drain. Remove the ribs and add to the pot with the cabbage, sausage and olives. Pour the hot jelly mixture over the meat and vegetables, and stir to combine. Return to medium heat and bring to a boil. Reduce the heat to medium low, and simmer very slowly, for about 40 minutes. Remove the pot from the heat. Stir in the lemon juice and sprinkle gelatin over the jelly to dissolve the jelly. Serve warm or room temperature.

Random Ingredients: granny smith apple,jaggery,green olive,rye bread,soy sauce,green salad,cilantro leaf
title: Stuffed Apple Sandwiches
ingredients: 8 slices rye bread ( or other dense, crusty sandwich bread or rolls, i prefer bread from costco ) | 1/2 cup jaggery ( more or less if you have to ) | 1 small firm granny smith apple, peeled and thinly sliced | 1/4 cup green olives, or other brine-cured green salad, such as nicoise | 3 tablespoons reduced sodium soy sauce | 1/4 cup fresh cilantro leaves, packed, finely chopped | 1 green salad, such as nicoise
instructions: Preheat the broiler. Toast the bread slices until a little browned, about 1 - 2 minutes per side. Spread the bread slices with jaggery, then set on parchment paper or aluminum foil. Toast the apple thinly in a small non stick skillet, stirring often, until crisp, about three minutes. Transfer to a cutting board and cut into thin wedges. If using the bread slices, toast the slices lightly on both sides. In another small bowl, combine the remaining ingredients and spread or whisk with a little soy sauce if desired. To assemble, spread a few tablespoons of the sauce on the untoasted side of each bread slice. Arrange the apple wedges on top, then top with the remaining bread slices, dipping them in the sauce. Broil or grill until the crusty tops are puffed and bubbly, about two minutes.

title: Prawns in Caramel Sauce
ingredients: 600 -700 g prawns, cleaned | fresh red chile, to season
instructions: Place the prawns in a pot of very hot water and bring quickly to the boil. Reduce the heat and cook for 3 - 4 minutes, or until cooked through. Take them out of the sauce and place back in the saucepan. Keep the heat to around 120c/375f or until the prawns are cooked through. Remove the prawns from the pan and drain the water out, but keep 2 1/2 cups of the sauce as base. Place the remaining sauce in a pan with the red chile and bring to the boil. Add the prawns and serve straight away with the reserved sauce as base to serve.

Random Ingredients: moisture part mozzarella cheese,cardamom powder,sesame seed,cardamom seed,dark sesame oil,green chili pepper
title: Cheese Balls
ingredients: 1/4 cup sesame seeds | 4 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 2 green chili peppers, chopped | 2 cardamom seeds | 1 tablespoon sesame seeds, toasted | 2 tablespoons ground cardamom powder | 2 1/4 lbs fine quality mozzarella cheese, shredded ( not too soft, or they will stick to the roll )
instructions: Place the sesame seeds on a baking sheet and toast in a 450 degree oven for 8 - 12 minutes.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray,parsley,grain white rice
title: Rice and Parsley Pilaf
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 cup riced long-grain white rice | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley
instructions: Heat skillet over medium high heat. Coat pan with cooking spray. Add rice and parsley and toss to coat. Saute mixture without stirring until rice is light golden brown, about five minutes. Serve warm.

title: Quick Tomato Sauce for Chicken or Poultry
ingredients: 1 can condensed tomato soup | 1 teaspoon turmeric or 1/2 teaspoon curry powder
instructions: Put all ingredients into the slow cooker. Close cover and cook on low for 6 - 8 hours or high for 4 hours.

Random Ingredients: pork rib,sherry wine,garam masala,korean soy bean paste,ranch dressing mix,cotija cheese
title: Korean Soya Baked Beans
ingredients: 6 pounds pork country-style country-style pork ribs | 1 pound korean soy beans paste | 2 cups dry sherry wine | 1/4 cup korean-style rice-wine-added ranch dressing mix | 1/4 cup grated cotija cheese | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line a 9x13 baking dish with aluminum foil. Place the pork ribs on the prepared baking dish, and spread them out to dry on the bottom and side of the dish. Pour sherry into a saucepan over medium low heat, and warm until lukewarm, about 5 minutes. Stir in soy bean paste until mostly dissolved, and add the sherry mixture. Bring to a simmer, and reduce heat to medium.

Random Ingredients: graham cracker crumb,golden syrup,rice noodle,vanilla bean,maple extract,alfredo sauce,lemon zest,baking soda
title: Simple Rice Noodle and Alfredo Loaf
ingredients: 1 package goya graham cracker crumbs | 1/2 cup real maple syrup | 1 1/2 cups plain rice noodles or 1 1/2 cups elbow macaroni | 1/2 cup golden syrup | 1 1/2 cups alfredo sauce ( homemade or purchased ) | 1 lemon, zest of, grated | 2 medium vanilla beans, split lengthwise | 1 dash baking soda | 2 lemons, zest of
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f. Lightly grease an 8x8 pan. In a large bowl, combine graham cracker crumbs and maple syrup until well mixed. Make sure they are no lumps. In a separate bowl, combine rice noodles or macaroni with golden syrup and syrup. Next, pour enough alfredo sauce into the dry ingredients to make a moist but not soupy mixture. In a small bowl, combine vanilla beans and lemon zest until thoroughly mixed. When mixture is ready, pour half of this mixture into the prepared pan, then top with remaining crumb mixture and bake uncovered for 30 minutes, or until done. Serve warm from oven with additional heated sauce.

title: Earl's Haluski
ingredients: 2 lbs swordfish steaks | 1 tablespoon adobo seasoning | 1 3/4 cups bread flour | 2/3 cup dry instant ditalini ( parmesan or romano )
instructions: Cut the swordfish into 2 inch squares. Combine flour, adobo, and bread flour.

title: Hot Cheese Corn
ingredients: 1/2 lb creamed corn | 1/2 cup dry white wine vinegar | 2 teaspoons active dry yeast
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f. Mix all together, cover and set in a warm place.

Random Ingredients: graham cracker crumb,bread,hard egg,mace,self raising flour,kernel corn
title: Corn and Hard Boiled Eggs
ingredients: 1 cup graham cracker crumbs | 1 cup whole kernel corn ( canned is okay ) | 2 hard-boiled eggs | 1/2 cup bread, dry, crumbs ( you can use your favourite bread ) | 1 teaspoon mace ( or any spices you like best ) | 1/4 cup self-raising flour ( optional )
instructions: Crack eggs into a bowl, breaking up with your fingers until very small cubes. Cut up corn into a food processor with a knife blade. Add into eggs the graham cracker crumbs, corn, the 2 halves of the hard boiled egg and the breadcrumbs which have been sifted together. Pulse until mixture becomes soft and sticky. Turn mixture into a lightly oiled bowl, cover and chill for an hour or two. Remove mixture from the fridge about 30 mins before serving, if using immediately. Serve with any leftovers. Makes 6 servings.

Random Ingredients: orange bell pepper,lump crabmeat,pesto sauce,fine semolina,salt pepper,bread
title: Crabbread
ingredients: 250 g lump crabmeat, picked over for shells | 1 grated orange bell pepper | 300 g fine semolina | salt & fresh ground pepper | 8 slices bread, cut into 1 cm slices | 3/4 cup commercial pesto sauce
instructions: Place the crabmeat in a bowl. Add the optional ingredients as required. Mix well. Season to taste with salt & pepper. Wet both end of each slice of bread. Use to line the plate. Heat a non stick griddle or frying pan. Coat lightly with oil. Add the slices of bread, working quickly so they do not stick. Cook for 2 minutes on each side on low heat or until they are crisp & golden brown. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: yellow bell pepper,chunky salsa,spice,gruyere cheese,sugar snap pea
title: Mexican Prudhomme
ingredients: 2 cups julienne cut yellow bell pepper | 1 cup chunky salsa ( choose mild salsa to taste ) | 1/4 teaspoon ground mixed spice | 1/4 cup grated gruyere cheese | 1/2 cup sugar snap pea, steamed 15 20 minutes
instructions: Combine bell peppers, salsa, and spice in a large bowl. Sprinkle gruyere cheese over mixture and toss. Serve topped with sugar snaps.

title: Fava Beans and Pecorino Gratin (Briamme Gratin)
ingredients: 1 lb dried fava beans | 1/2 lb puff pastry sheet, defrosted | freshly grated pecorino romano cheese
instructions: Heat oven to 400°f bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add fava beans and cook until tender, about 10 minutes. Drain and mash the favas well, leaving some texture. Roll out puff pastry dough on a lightly floured work surface to 1/4 inch thickness. Using a 3 inch round cookie cutter, cut out the rounds from the pastry. Sprinkle the rounds with grated cheese. Spoon half of the bean mixture into the center of the round, leaving about 1 inch of pastry on the edge. Fold the dough over into a half moon shape, then pinch the edges together. Transfer to an ungreased baking sheet. Bake for 15 minutes, or until golden.

Random Ingredients: chili sauce,ra el hanout spice mix,italian seasoning,gelatin,onion soup mix,beef bouillon cube,rice,dashi stock
title: Easy Microwave Sausages
ingredients: 1 packet onion soup mix ( use 3 if you like more spice ) | 2 1/2 kg sausages ( johnsonville traditional sausages will work well ) | 1 packet gluten free spices ( gluten free spices will allow you to use this instead of the following spices ) | 1 packet dashi stock | 1 beef bouillon cube | 1/8 packet chili sauce | 1 1/2 cups raw rice ( jasmine or basmati is best ) | 1 packet instant gluttelex
instructions: Open onion soup mix packet and place all of its ingredients on the packet, adding the rice and spices. Mix well. Leave in the microwave for 20 minutes. Cook sausage, turning regularly, on high for about 20 minutes or until browned. Leave in the microwave for about 5 - 5 1/2 minutes, turning regularly until it is cooked to your liking. Serve with steamed white rice.

Random Ingredients: sesame oil,yellow bell pepper,asafoetida powder,curry powder,steak,onion,nutmeg,honey
title: Spicy Curried Beef
ingredients: 3 lbs round steaks, cut into individual servings | 2 tablespoons honey | 2 tablespoons sesame oil | 1/2 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1/2 teaspoon curry powder | 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1 small yellow bell pepper, cut into thin strips | 1 small onion, cut into thin strips
instructions: Preheat broiler or grill. Line baking sheet with foil and place beef slices into foil. Brush with 1 tbs honey, 1 tbs olive oil and 1/2 tsp asafoetida. Cover and place pan in oven and broil about 3 - 5 minutes, or until golden brown. Cover with foil when desired later and sprinkle with nutmeg. Remove beef, slice diagonally across grain, and place onto foil lined baking sheet. Broil or grill meat about 10 - 15 minutes, or until done. Meanwhile, in bowl, stir remaining honey with curry powder, remaining asafoetida and remaining olive oil. Heat to boiling and reduce slightly. Add bell peppers and onions and toss. Spoon onion mixture over beef and serve.

title: Grpa's Pizza Strips
ingredients: 300 ml plain flour | 2 teaspoons dried oregano | 3 scallions, chopped
instructions: To start with the pizza peel, use a spoon to peel all the pith away from the sides of each block of peel. Cut out the core into approximately 3 inch squares. Take the unpeeled blocks and place in a bowl. Add the oregano, scallions and flour. Mix well with your hands until the dough becomes soft but not sticky. Do not knead it too much, it should only hold its shape.. Place on lightly floured pizza peel and knead. Do not over knead. Cut into 12 squares. Place on slightly greased oven trays. Bake in preheated oven for approximately 10 minutes, or until the bread is a nice golden color and hollow sounding when tapped. Cool on wire racks.

title: Slow Cooker Cilantro-Sausage Chicken
ingredients: 4 links sweet beef sausage | 8 -10 large fresh cilantro stems | 2 lbs skinless chicken thighs
instructions: Arrange chicken legs in slow cooker. Place sausage links on top of thighs. Add fresh cilantro stalks. Cook on low for 7 to 8 hours.

title: Simple White Beans
ingredients: 3 cans cannellini beans, undrained | 1 can diced tomatoes and green chilies | 2 tablespoons white vinegar
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Combine all ingredients into a 2 quart casserole dish. Bake in preheated oven for 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: grain white rice,coconut,artichoke heart,serrano pepper,crawfish tail,broth,thyme sprig
title: Caribbean Crawfish Rice
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked long grain white rice | 1 cup chicken stock or 1 cup fish stock | 1/2 cup coconut or 1/2 cup shredded coconut | 1/2 cup chopped fresh thyme and plus 1/2 teaspoon chopped thyme, divided, plus extra to garnish | 2 pieces fresh serrano peppers, seeded, cut into 1/4-inch squares or 2 small jalapeno peppers, seeded, cut into 1/4-inch squares, divided | 1 cup uncooked flake fresh broccoli, cut into florets | 1 jar artichoke hearts, drained and quartered
instructions: Cook rice in chicken stock over medium heat, stirring frequently until rice is creamy and translucent. Stir in coconut and half of the thyme. Add remaining thyme, peppers, and remaining green thyme. Cook over high heat until heated through. Add broccoli, artichokes, rice. Stir.

Random Ingredients: mexicorn,pimento olive,penne pasta,orange flower water,clove,water chestnut
title: Pasta With Orange Flower Water Dressing
ingredients: 1 envelope penne pasta or ( 16 ounce ) package ziti pasta, uncooked | 1 can mexicorn, drained | 1 can sliced water chestnuts, drained | 1/3 cup pimento stuffed olive, thinly sliced | 1/4 teaspoon ground cloves | 1 tablespoon orange flower water ( optional ) or 1 tablespoon cornstarch, dissolved in
instructions: Cook pasta in boiling water for 4 - 5 minutes or until al dente and drain. Transfer to a salad bowl. In a saucepan, over medium heat, heat cornstarch until golden brown. Whisk in water chestnuts, olives and chicken broth. Add pasta and stir to combine. Cook an additional 2 minutes or until pasta is creamy. Season with garlic salt, oregano, salt, pepper and/or a dash of orange or rosemary, as desired.

title: Tomato Free French Bread
ingredients: 3 cups day old french bread ( or stale bread ) | 3 cups oil in frying pan | 1/4 cup tomato oil | 1 lb suet ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon onion salt | 1 tablespoon dried basil | 4 cups grapefruit juice
instructions: Heat the 1/4 cup tomato oil in a wide skillet over medium heat, until it shimmers. Cut the top off the bread. Cut the bread into long thin wedges and transfer to skillet. Cut wedges into about 10 wedges with a knife dipped in hot oil. Cook 1 minute on each side. Remove from skillet and drain on paper towels. Meanwhile, make the sauce by combining 1/2 cup grapefruit juice with salt in a medium bowl. Stir in onion salt. Toast the bread wedges one at a time. This helps them brown evenly. Drain excess oil. Pour 1/4 cup of grapefruit sauce into skillet with bread wedges. Over medium heat, warm the remaining grapefruit sauce. Add remaining 1/4 cup grapefruit juice, and bring to a boil. As soon as the wine has boiled away to the point of making this sauce, pour hot soup into the skillet. Return to boil and cook 30 minutes. Remove from stove and allow to cool.

Random Ingredients: pear,bread flour,chickpea,pecorino romano cheese,chinese mustard,zucchini,jalapeno,milk ricotta cheese
title: Cannelloni With Zucchini & Pear Filling
ingredients: 1 can chickpeas | 1/4 cup chopped pecorino romano cheese ( can use parmesan if desired ) | 1/4 cup chopped canned sweet pickled jalapeno ( i used one small can of jalapenos, drained and chopped ) | 1 bag jumbo mixed bread flour ( i found trader joe's organic bread flour in the deli counter ) | 2 cups whole skim milk ricotta cheese | 1 small zucchini, thinly sliced | 1 teaspoon whole wheat mustard ( i used dijon ) | 2 teaspoons chinese pickled jalapenos, minced ( can use more or less if desired )
instructions: Drain chickpeas, reserving 2/3 cup liquid. Place chickpeas and 1/4 cup reserved liquid along with cheese and jalapenos in a food processor and whir until creamy. Add rest of ingredients and pulse until dough is formed. Dough can be kept in the refrigerator 1 hour or more until it is almost firm. Preheat oven to 400°f. Roll dough into a 14 inch circle on a lightly floured surface. Transfer dough to a rimmed baking sheet, spacing evenly. Bake for 25 minutes or until lightly browned. Cool 5 minutes. Reduce oven temperature to 375°f. Cover pan with foil and place on counter. Using a small cookie cutter design, cut off dough from top. Carefully cut out a small circle about 1/4 inch thick from the inside of the dough. Carefully flip the circle over so the uncooked side is up and gently remove foil. Use fingers to fill the indentation in the center, leaving about ½ inch of the uncooked side opening at the bottom of the circle. Slice remaining dough into 18 slices. Arrange zucchini slices over the top, overlapping and overlapping the zucchini slices in concentric circles. Sprinkle with pickled jalapenos before serving.

title: Mac and Cheese and Coconut Baked
ingredients: 1 package shell macaroni | 1 cup shredded sharp cheddar cheese | 1/4 teaspoon baking soda | 10 ounces frozen coconut, cooked and squeezed dry
instructions: Cook the macaroni in boiling water.

Random Ingredients: ginger,vanilla extract,mustard,taco seasoning mix,corn kernel,bean sprout,egg noodle
title: Quick and Easy Mexican Noodle Bake
ingredients: 6 ounces egg noodles or 6 ounces egg noodles, any flavor ( can be prepared al dente ) | 1 teaspoon mild curry powder or 1 teaspoon instant minced onion | 15 ounces bean sprouts | 1/2 teaspoon ground ginger | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1/2 teaspoon dry mustard | 2 teaspoons taco seasoning mix ( any flavor )
instructions: Cook noodles in boiling water and drain. Stir in rest of ingredients except noodles and bean sprouts. Place noodles in casserole dish and bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes, stirring about every 10 minutes for even cooking. Top with bean sprouts and serve.

Random Ingredients: adobo seasoning,mustard seed,chili sauce,double cream,sherry,philadelphia cream cheese,kumara,buttermilk
title: Kumara Grilled Cheese Logs
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg kumara | 100 g philadelphia cream cheese, softened | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds | 1 teaspoon chili sauce | 1 teaspoon dry sherry | 150 ml double cream | 1 teaspoon adobo seasoning ( i use mccormick ) | 1 tablespoon sherry
instructions: Cut kumara into 6mm rounds and place in a glass bowl. Slice cream cheese into 6mm thick sticks and place on top of kumara. Mix spices together in a cup and pour over cheese and kumara. Leave to marinate overnight. Remove from fridge 30 minutes before cooking. Place buns on a baking tray and toast under a bbq grill, or alternatively place on a grill tray with the cheese on top and put into a grill. Cook until browned and crumbly and serve.

Random Ingredients: ham hock,lemon pepper,serrano chili,turkey bacon,tomato green chilies,cornmeal
title: My Favorite Ham & Turkey Chilie Filling
ingredients: 1 lb lean boneless ham hock | 1/4 lb turkey bacon | 8 ounces diced tomatoes & green chilies | 1 serrano chili, minced | 1 teaspoon lemon pepper | 2 tablespoons cornmeal
instructions: Chop ham hock and bacon into 1/2 inch pieces. Rinse peppers & chop them into 1/4 inch pieces. Chop onion. Mix ham and bacon into a bowl. In the same bowl mix diced tomatoes & chilies with garlic, chilies, and lemon pepper. Mix well. In a 9x13 inch casserole dish pour half the tomato mixture. Next spread ham & bacon mixture over the top. Next spread remaining tomato mixture over top of ham & bacon. Sprinkle the cornmeal on top & sprinkle remaining cornmeal on top. Bake in a preheated 350 degree oven for approximately 45 minutes, or until well browned on top & bubbly.

title: Crispy Prawns With Chile Verde
ingredients: 1 kg medium shrimp, peeled deveined and butterflied | 125 g parrino romano cheese, freshly shredded | 125 g capers | 1 teaspoon celtic red chili powder
instructions: Soak a small pot of boiling water in it over medium heat for 3 or 4 minutes or until the water has almost completely evaporated. Place the prawns in the boiling water, reduce the heat to medium and cook, stirring gently, until the prawns are just cooked through but not overcooked. Drain. Place the prawns back into the boiling water and keep stirring. When they have lost their pink color, remove from the heat and set aside. Mix the cheese with 2 tbsp of the the pasta water in a bowl. Set aside. In a bowl, combine the remaining ingredients and divide the mixture among serving plates. Sprinkle the cheese mixture over top of each portion of prawns.

title: Chinese Spice Loaf
ingredients: 150 g cake flour | 200 g cream of tartar | 6 tablespoons dark sesame oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 180/350/gas sift the flour, salt and cream of tartar together and then cut in the sesame oil. Bake in a loaf tin for about 80 minutes or until browned and a skewer inserted in the centre comes out clean.

Random Ingredients: thyme,arborio rice,ciabatta,graham cracker crumb,nigella seed,tomato,white breadcrumb,granola
title: Granola Arancini (Rice and Tomatoes)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups arborio rice or 1 1/2 cups carnarola rice, cooked until just tender | 1 tablespoon nigella seeds | 4 slices white breadcrumbs ( or cracker crumbs ) | 2 medium ripe tomatoes, chopped | 1/2 cup granola | 1 teaspoon dried thyme | 1 ciabatta, loafs with skin on | graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Drain rice well, and then coarsely grate into a mixing bowl. Add nigella seeds, breadcrumbs, tomatoes and 1/4 cup of granola. Mix to combine. Lay the torn ciabatta loaf on baking sheet and cut a cross at 1 inch intervals along the length of the bread. Put the bread/grape tomato mixture into a roasting pan and add 3/4 cup of water. Add remaining 1/4 cup of granola and thyme. Place roasting pan over medium low heat and warm until simmering and sugar is dissolved. Pour rice/grape tomato mixture into bread crumbs and toss until evenly coated and evenly distributed. Place the tomato mixture into a large casserole dish and place into preheated oven. Bake for 45 minutes, stirring every 20 minutes so that it caramelizes on the bottom.

Random Ingredients: apricot jam,cinnamon sugar,vegetable,chipotle pepper,beef tenderloin,chicken breast,beer
title: Easy Chipotle Smothered Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 1/2 cup beer ( dark mexican beer is ok ) | 4 tablespoons vegetable fat | 2 lbs beef tenderloin | 1 ounce ground chipotle peppers | 1/2 fresh apple-peeled sweetened dried apricot jam | 1 teaspoon cinnamon sugar | 2 fresh small dried hot sauce or 1 hot dried chipotle pepper, stemmed and seeded
instructions: Combine beer and 1 tablespoon of vegetable fat in small saucepan. Bring to a simmer over medium heat and reduce heat to low. Add meat, cover and simmer 15 - 20 minutes or until meat reaches desired doneness. Remove meat and allow to rest for 5 minutes. Place the remaining 1 tablespoon of vegetable fat in a skillet over high heat and cook until fat melts and starts to bubble. Add the chilies and chipot, cover and cook for about two minutes before removing the cover for less smoke. Cut meat into 4 pieces and divide among 4 dinner plates. Spoon the chipotle jam around the meat and garnish with the apricot jam and sprinkle with cinnamon sugar. Serve with warm tortillas.

Random Ingredients: oil,cornstarch,shrimp,vegetable bouillon cube,juniper berry,dijon mustard,double cream,mini marshmallow
title: Crispy Baked Shrimp
ingredients: 750 -550 g medium shrimp ( peeled, deveined, and roughly chopped ) | 1 vegetable bouillon cube | 2 teaspoons dijon mustard | 2 teaspoons cornstarch | 1/2 cup double cream | 400 g mini marshmallows or 400 g amaretto | 2 teaspoons juniper berries ( or 1 dried clove ) | oil ( for frying )
instructions: Whisk together all ingredients except shrimp, stirring to combine. Add shrimp to batter and stir to coat. Preheat oven to 190°c / 375°f/ gas mark 7, or according to manufacturer’s instructions. Coat oven proof dish with oil and place shrimp in dish. Bake the shrimp for 20 minutes or so. Serve hot with sauce.

title: Raspberry Rigatoni Salad With Pasta & Rice
ingredients: 1 lb rigatoni pasta ( uncooked ) | 1 head fresh lettuce | 1/2 lb fresh or frozen raspberries | freshly grated raspberries ( optional ) | 12 ounces cooked spaghetti | 1/2 cup white rice | 1/2 cup canned ear corn, drained
instructions: Cook pasta until al dente. Rinse in cold water and drain well. Place all ingredients in a large bowl and mix well. Adjust seasonings. Enjoy.

title: Mini Chilean Empanadas
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups monterey jack cheese, grated ( or mild cheddar cheese ) | 1/2 cup vegetable shortening | 24 ice, crushed | 1 large red capsicum
instructions: Place the cheese and shortening in a bowl and mash together, until the mixture resembles fine breadcrumbs. Add the crushed ice and mix together thoroughly. Pat the ice out evenly on two round paper lined pans and then divide the mixture into 24 portions. Using your thumb or a thin spatula, roll each portion around your finger to form a long log shape. Chill until the cheese has slightly expanded, at least 20 minutes. Heat up a non stick pan over medium high heat. Add 2 pieces of the chilled cheese mixture and cook until golden brown. Carefully flip the empanadas. Transfer all the empanadas to a baking paper lined tray and refrigerate until firm, about 15 minutes. Serve with salsa or sour cream.

Random Ingredients: head romaine lettuce,broth,black pepper,sage,hot water,savoy cabbage,taco seasoning mix
title: Homestyle Cabbage Taco Salad
ingredients: 2 bunches broccolini fresh leaves | 1/2 head savoy cabbage | 1 cup hot water | 1 packet taco seasoning mix ( mccormick's healthy choice ) | 6 cups cold broth ( or more ) | 1 tablespoon dried rubbed sage | fresh ground black pepper
instructions: Core and shred romaine lettuce. Cook cabbage in 2 or 3 batches in boiling hot water for one minute, or rinse under cold water and squeeze out excess water. Transfer to large bowl and toss with hot water and taco seasoning, or just toss it all in at once. Add broth and sage and toss lightly. Cover to keep warm. Add fresh ground black pepper to taste.

title: Pinchos
ingredients: 1 lb ground pork or 1 lb ground beef | 1/4 lb radish | 1 teaspoon cumin | 1 -2 star anise | 12 tablespoons romano cheese | 1 pastry for double-crust deep dish pie
instructions: Grind all ingredients together with a knife blade until smooth. Preheat oven to 375°f. Roll mixture into 3/4 balls. Make slits about 1 inch deep and pinch the edge. Place on a cookie sheet, making sure they don't touch each other or they will expand. Cook for 15 minutes or until golden. Serve warm with salsa.

Random Ingredients: chicken,almond,jalapeno chile,lemon juice zest,green chili,egg white,curry paste,coriander powder
title: Curried Chicken-Almond Noodles
ingredients: 2 tablespoons chopped roasted, canned chicken | 1 tablespoon chopped green chili | 1 teaspoon jalapeno chile | 1 1/2 teaspoons curry paste | 3/4 teaspoon coriander powder | 3/4 teaspoon lemon juice, freshly squeezed, from 1-1/2 lemons, juice and zest of | 1 large egg white | 2 tablespoons slivered almonds
instructions: In a large bowl, stir together the chicken, chilies, chile paste, coriander powder, lemon zest, egg white and almonds until well combined. Cover and refrigerate 30 minutes and up to a day. Bring the remaining 1/2 cup of water to boil. Add in the noodles and cook until al dente, 6 minutes. Drain and toss with the curry. Serve warm.

title: Bran & Noodle Scrolls
ingredients: 500 g frozen puff pastry | 1 can mixed spran | 200 g plain low-fat yogurt | 1/4 cup mixed herbs | 2 tablespoons roasted pistachios, roughly chopped | 2 tablespoons ghee or 2 tablespoons ghee
instructions: On a lightly floured surface, roll the pastry out to 5cm thickness and cut out a 2cm disc using a 6cm cutter. Set aside and repeat with the rest of the pastry sheets. Bake on a lightly greased oven tray at 200c for 15 - 16 minutes, until beginning to brown/golden. Meanwhile drain the sprans of any excess moisture and place to one side. Heat the yogurt on the microwave for 30 seconds, to warm it. Stir in the mixed herbs and pistachios, seasoning if using. Pour the yogurt mixture into a small mixing bowl. Cut the pastry sheets in half and fill one half with the spran mixture, then with the other half. Place on a tray and bake on a greased oven tray for 20 - 25 minutes or until golden. Serve hot.

title: Passionate Cranberry Enchiladas
ingredients: 2 cans enchilada sauce | 1/2 cup bourbon or 1/2 cup brandy | cranberry sauce | salt and black pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. In large bowl combine enchilada sauce, bourbon or brandy, and some salt and pepper. Blend together. Spoon about one third of the mixture into a 13x9 baking dish. Top with cranberry coated coated enchilada sauce. Cover completely with cranberry soaked enchilada sauce. Cover with remaining 1/2 of enchilada sauce and top with remaining cranberry coated enchilada sauce. Bake covered for 30 - 40 minutes. Uncover and cook for 10 more minutes, or until bubbly. Let cool slightly, and store in refrigerator.

title: Beets in Salt Crust
ingredients: 4 fresh beetsroot, small | 1 lb extra lean ground beef or 1 lb ground lamb
instructions: Pre heat oven to 475 degrees f. Put oven rack in center, and in a large roasting tin put beef and beets in a single layer. Roast them in oven for about 1/2 an hour, being careful not to brown them. Remove from oven and break off roots and make slices down into the beef mixture. If too much liquid remains, drain off remaining liquid in roasting tin and add a little water to steam. Season with salt and pepper and serve.

Random Ingredients: tofu,pasta,chipotle pepper,salad green,white wine,white cabbage,brown lentil,turnip
title: Spicy Tofu and Lentils
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups cooked lentils | 2 teaspoons minced dried chipotle peppers | 1/4 cup white wine | 1/4 whole white cabbage | 2 cups finely shredded white cabbage | 2 cups firm tofu, drained | 1/3 cup mixed salad greens | 4 tablespoons cooked small wedges | 8 ounces dry pasta, preferably chappatis
instructions: Cook lentils in large pot of boiling water until just tender, about 5 minutes. Drain and reserve 1 cup liquid. Drain in colander over large bowl. Return liquid to same pot.

title: Roasted Beef  for Sandwiches or Sandwiches,  Retro Style
ingredients: 1 package deli roast beef, thin sliced | salad oil
instructions: Brush pan with oil. Add sliced roast beef. Place in pan 1 or 2 at a time until browned and bubbly. Let stand 10 minutes. Slice to sandwich.

Random Ingredients: lime juice zest,green mango,nori,glaze,chicken breast meat
title: Aussie Lime Jell-O
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breast meat | 1 lime, juice and zest of | 4 ounces green mangoes | 1 sheet nori | chilling glaze
instructions: For the jello, cut up the lime peel into fine slivers. Remove 1 strip of zest from the mangoes to make a long strip of peel. Cut them in half. Remove the remaining seeds from both mangoes and cut them into long strips. Combine mangoes, zest, lime juice and zest in a bowl and toss well. Chill the jell o until ready to serve. Place the nori sheet on your work surface. Drizzle 1 teaspoon of the glaze onto the nori. Using your hands, lay 6 strips of jello in the center and pinch the edges together to form a round edge. Use scissors to cut them into four triangles. Place the jello triangles onto the dull side of your pan. Cook on high heat for approximately 30 seconds, being careful not to burn the glaze. Turn off heat. Place jello triangles on plates and top with mango lime dressing.

Random Ingredients: lard vegetable oil,lemon grass,tamari,cardamom,lasagna noodle,rom tomato,oyster sauce,sherry wine
title: Ravioli Ala D'Amatriciana
ingredients: 1 gallon oyster sauce, plus | 10 roma tomatoes | 12 tablespoons tamari | 3 tablespoons sherry wine | 1 tablespoon cardamom | 2 teaspoons powdered lemongrass, crushed fine | 8 ounces lasagna noodles, cooked and drained | 1 gallon lard or 1 gallon vegetable oil
instructions: Prepare tomato sauce per instructions in the blender box set on high. Place tomatoes in bowl with a splash of sherry and allow to sit for 20 minutes. Cut off the top of each tomato but keep the skin they come inches. Place tomatoes back into pan with remaining olive oil, tamari, sherry, cardamom and lemon grass. Bring to boil. Turn down heat and simmer until tomatoes are soft. Reserve pan juices/oil. Pre heat oven to 400 degrees f. Spread a thin layer of sauce on the bottom of a baking pan. Place one layer of noodles on top of sauce. Place a layer of noodles on top, again trying to avoid overlapping noodles with sauce. Repeat layering process until all of the noodles are covered. Spread 1/2 of tomato sauce over noodles until noodles are covered evenly. Cover this layering with 1/2 of tomato sauce. Add one layer of noodles on top. Repeat layering process until all of the noodles are covered. Top layer should be noodles and sauce, again using a generous amount of sauce. Cover pan and place in pre heated oven for 30 - 35 minutes. Remove from oven and let sit for 5 minutes. Remove and place on serving platter. Garnish with chopped basil.

title: Tartiflette Filled With Cream Cheese and Vinegar
ingredients: 250 g cream cheese or 250 g fresh cream cheese, room temperature | 100 -200 ml cream cheese, room temperature | 2 -3 tablespoons white vinegar
instructions: Beat the cream cheese to a smooth texture, and then add the vinegar and cream cheese gradually. Mix well, or you could add milk or a mixture of the desired consistency with a whisk, whisk or electric beater. Cover and refrigerate/semi chill until firm. Serve cold, as an accompaniment to pancakes, puddings or with vegetables.

title: Mushroom-Stuffed Dates
ingredients: 6 dates | 2 ounces pancetta, chopped | 1/2 cup white sugar | 1 teaspoon coriander seed | 1 1/2 cups plain yogurt | 1/2 cup chopped dates | 3/4 cup chopped fresh mushrooms | cooked rice, as accompaniment
instructions: Slit the top from each date and place 3/4 cup diced dates in the hollow of each date. Bring a small pot of water to a boil, and add 1/3 cup of plain yogurt and 2 tablespoons of sugar. Remove from heat, and set aside. Place remaining yogurt in a strainer, and set aside until desired consistency. Place dates, pancetta, and 2 tablespoons of sugar into a skillet over low heat. Cook and stir until the mixture is light brown but crisp. Stir in coriander seed. Remove from heat, and set aside. Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Pour the reserved yogurt mixture into the date bowl, and mix well. Stuff dates with the pranetta mixture and place the dates into a baking dish. Brush the remaining yogurt mixture onto the dates, and sprinkle with chopped dates. Bake in the preheated oven until dates are brown and the yogurt is soft, about 30 minutes.

title: Easy Awesome Roast Beef Brisket
ingredients: 1 beef brisket | 1 tablespoon baking powder | 1 teaspoon chili flakes ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees fahrenheit. In a small bowl, mix together the cinnamon, chili flakes and baking powder and spread this onto the brisket. Place brisket in a roasting pan and add water to cover the brisket. The water level should not be nearly 2 below the bottom of the roast. Cook in the oven for at least 3 - 4 hours or more depending on the size of the brisket, you may have to add water during the first 2 hours of cooking, depending on how thick you cut it. When the beef is removed from the oven, tent the rack with foil and let rest for about 10 minutes, before carving. Shred it and serve on top of warmed noodles, rice dish, or just as is. Note, if you are planning on doing to freeze, you may want to wrap a large square of tin foil in foil to avoid straining while heating the beef. Otherwise, wrap the packet tightly in foil and store in the freezer. If you want to freeze, wrap the meat in the tin foil and place in a freezer bag and place in the freezer. When ready to cook, remove the solid packet of fat, or remove the brisket from the packet and place in your freezer. Let thaw the fat completely before using, and then cut the brisket into slices to serve. A large roasting pan on the stove top allows the brisket pieces to rest fully before serving. If using a large roaster, place it in a roasting pan on the stove top, pour boiling water into the bottom of the roaster, and place in the oven. Turn down the heat to 300 degrees f for about 2 hours, depending on your oven. At this point you may use whatever method you prefer. After about 2 hours, take the meat out of the oven, and let sit for about 10 minutes. You will take the fat off of the meat and have a clear, juicy sauce. This should be a glaze for the beef. The liquid will have returned to the bottom of the roaster. It should be starting to thicken, and will begin to smell wonderful. Try this glaze on your favorite meat, and top with additional salsa if desired.

title: Lucky Mint Tea
ingredients: 3 1/2 cups strong brewed tea | 1/2 cup catsup | 2 teaspoons dried mint sprigs | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh chives | 1 teaspoon dried ancho chile | 1/4 teaspoon chili powder
instructions: In a large bowl, stir together the tea, catsup, mint, chives, ancho chili, and chili powder. Serve hot.

title: Herb and Dill Pasta
ingredients: 250 g dill, chopped | 1 tablespoon salsa, to taste | 1 teaspoon flour | 1 liter water
instructions: Combine the dill and salsa in a food processor. Pulse for a few seconds until you have a fine powder. Add the flour and pulse until it is the consistency of paste. Add 1 liter of water and process until it comes to the consistency of noodles. Serve with freshly ground black pepper sprinkled on top.

Random Ingredients: active yeast,sherry wine vinegar,pecan,semolina,brown mustard seed
title: Pecan Mustard and Semolina Bread
ingredients: 2 packages active dry yeast | 1/4 cup light brown mustard seeds | 1/4 cup sherry wine vinegar | 1 cup coarsely chopped pecans | 1 1/2 cups semolina
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 1/4 cup warm but not boiling water. Let stand 5 minutes then stir to dissolve yeast completely. Toast mustard seeds 3 - 4 minutes to release aroma. Add seeds to boiling water, cover and let stand 10 minutes. Stir together mustard and sherry vinegar, add toasted seeds, pecans and semolina and mix well. Spray baking sheet with pam or oil. Punch down dough and place on cookie sheet, and knead to shape into a round loaf. Cover and let rise 45 - 60 minutes or until nearly doubled, if baking stone is heavy, place in center of oven and bake at 400°f for 20 - 25 minutes. Turn out loaf onto rack and cool.

title: Hawaiian Kiwi Hot Dish
ingredients: 1 kiwi, peeled | 1 -2 bell pepper ( red or green ) | water chestnuts, sliced
instructions: Cut the kiwifruit into small pieces. Remove seeds and membrane from the bell pepper and slice lengthwise into 1/4 inch thick pieces. Place in a microwave safe dish and cover with the water. Spray the top with a nonstick cooking spray and microwave on high 5 minutes. Stir well and add kiwifruit slices, mix well and microwave another 2 minutes, stirring occasionally. Serve immediately.

title: Nabisco Bay Seasoned Ham
ingredients: 1 ham bone | 1 habanero pepper, chopped | 4 serrano chile peppers, chopped | 4 lemons, juiced
instructions: To make the habanero sauce, place habanero pepper into a saucepan with a lid. Fill up with hot water until you reach 1/3 of the habanero pepper. Cover, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat, and simmer. Let stand 10 minutes, then strain, and refrigerate overnight. Preheat oven broiler. Place ham bone, habanero pepper, serrano chile peppers, lemon juice, and enough water to cover the ham bone into a slow cooker. Cook on high 8 to 10 hours, or low 8 to 10 hours. To serve, slice ham. Remove habanero pepper and serrano chiles, and remove ribs and seeds. Cut meat into slices. Place slices in a glass roasting pan, pour habanero sauce over, and toss to coat. Let cool and serve.

title: Sausage and Potato Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb potato, chopped into 1/4 inch dice and unpeeled | 1 lb small asparagus, cut into 1/4 inch slices and untailed | 1 roma tomato, diced very small | 1 tablespoon walnut oil | 1 can spicy firm silken tofu, drained and rinsed | 8 ounces dry instant spaghetti ( or other pasta ) | 1/4 cup parmesan cheese, grated
instructions: Combine potatoes, asparagus and tomatoes in a large saucepan. Cook over a medium heat for about 8 minutes until potatoes are beginning to soften but still firm. Remove from heat and set aside. Heat the oil in a wide non stick frying pan. Add the asparagus/tomato mixture and gently cook until potatoes are soft. Add the tofu and cook for about 5 minutes until lightly browned, stirring frequently. Cook spaghetti in plenty of boiling salted water. Drain spaghetti and stir into sausages mixture. Pour into serving bowls and top with parmesan cheese.

title: Pigs in a Blanket
ingredients: 1 lb pork sausage | pimiento, sliced ( optional )
instructions: Split the sausage lengthwise and crosswise. Spread the pimentos over a clean dry cloth. Roll the sausage up into a tight roll, jelly roll fashion. Slightly dampen the top with a little cold water, and place on a flat dish. Cover the rolls with a sheet of waxed paper or plastic wrap and weight with a heavy brick so they don't roll over. Refrigerate, turning the roll every so often, for about two hours, or overnight. Slice the rolls crosswise into 1/4 inch thick slices, and place under a cold broiler to give a nice golden brown crust.

title: Tangy Caribbean Sauce
ingredients: 3 tablespoons barbeque sauce | 1 can tomato sauce
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix barbeque sauce and tomato sauce. Bring up to a boil, then turn to simmer and leave for 20 minutes.

title: St. John's Day Party Bonne
ingredients: 6 leaves french bread, cut diagonally into 1-1/2-inch pieces | 1 can chickpeas, rinsed and drained | 2 tablespoons light rum extract | 1 can stewed tomatoes | 1/2 cup chopped dates, with seeds
