instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Arrange a single layer of bread on the baking sheet, and bake until golden, about 10 minutes. Drain bread from cookie sheet, and cool completely. Break it up into chunks. In a medium bowl, mix the chickpeas, rum extract, stewed tomatoes, and dates. Place about 2 tablespoons of the soaked bread into the prepared bread, and spoon the date topping over the top. Bake for 20 minutes in the preheated oven.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray,bean soup mix
title: Homemade Noodles & Beans
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 375 g bean soup mix
instructions: First preheat oven to 200°c. Spray a baking tray with vegetable oil spray. Put the bean soup mix into a large bowl with a large pinch of salt. Add the vegetable oil. Mix well until the paste is fairly thick. Spoon about 1 teaspoonful of the paste into the centre of 2/3 of the baking tray. Carefully spread out the mixture to the edges. Then pour over the remaining paste. Bake for 30 40mins until golden. Serve with green vegetables. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: lime leaf,italian bread,cannellini bean,sugar,whipping cream,baking powder
title: Cannellini Beans Muffins
ingredients: 1 can cannellini beans, drained ( you can get creative with this ) | 1/2 cup whipping cream, slightly whipped | 1 lime leaf | 1 1/2 teaspoons baking powder | generous tablespoon sugar | italian bread, toasted and cut into 6 muffin cups
instructions: Preheat oven to 400f degrees. Mix everything but the toast and muffins in a large mixing bowl. Spoon the bean mixture into the muffin cups and place in the oven. Bake for about 20 minutes, until the muffins have risen and are just starting to brown. Serve warm with your favorite salad.

Random Ingredients: plum,chicken tender,russet potato,oat,cream,filling,green bell pepper,beef chuck
title: Potato Beef and Pepper Pie
ingredients: 2 lbs russet potatoes or 2 lbs yukon gold potatoes | 1 1/2 lbs beef chuck, cut into very small cubes | 1 large green bell pepper, seeded and cut into 1 chunks ( about 2 cups ) | 10 plums | filling : | 1/2 cup sour cream | 1/2 cup chopped green bell pepper | 2 cups quick quick oats | 8 ounces dried beef stock or 8 ounces chicken tenders
instructions: Place potatoes in a large pot with cold water to cover. Bring to a boil over high heat. When potatoes are just about to soften, add chuck and peppers to pot and reduce heat to medium. Cover and cook until meat is no longer pink. Drain, discard liquid and vegetables. Transfer to a 9 inch pie pan. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Stir sour cream, green pepper, and oats together in a bowl. Sprinkle evenly over potatoes. Stir beef and vegetables into potatoes. Spread sour cream mixture evenly over top and sides of potato mixture. Sprinkle with dried beef or chicken tenders. Bake 2 to 2 1/2 hours or until bread is crusty and vegetables are tender. Let stand for 10 minutes before serving.

title: Chicken Gnocchi Florentine
ingredients: 12 ounces chicken breasts | 1 bunch garlic, garlic cloves crushed | 1 red pepper | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon ( i use chicken flavor ) | 3 ounces gnocchi | 1/2 cup roasted red pepper, roughly chopped | 1 tablespoon ground almonds | 1/3 cup grated pecorino cheese
instructions: Cube chicken in small pieces. Fry chicken in hot olive oil. Drain in a separate skillet the red pepper and garlic. When chicken is nearly done, stir in the red pepper and garlic, cook until it starts to soften. Pour in a cup of water to the chicken mixture. Simmer for 25 minutes, remove from heat and set aside. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to boil. Add gnocchi and cook until tender, about 6 - 8 minutes. Drain and set aside. In a small container, combine the ground almonds, cheese, and 1/3 cup of broth from gnocchi. Add chicken and the rest of the broth, stir well and serve over pasta with more cheese on the side.

title: Super Easy Israeli Couscous
ingredients: 1 lb israeli couscous | 1 jar tomato ketchup | 1 -2 teaspoon of good seasoning salt | 1 head cauliflower
instructions: Bring a pot of water to a boil. While waiting for the water to boil, rinse and peel the cauliflower. Boil the cauliflower for about 7 minutes, or until it’s easily flaked with a fork. Drain and set aside. Pour the ketchup into a large pan. Stir in the tomato ketchup. Turn the heat to medium heat, and cook for about 10 minutes stirring constantly, to keep the ketchup from burning. Add the prepared cauliflower, and stir gently to combine. The consistency should be like cottage cheese. Remove from heat, and serve.

title: Spanish Chicken and Carrots (Pollo Con Salsa Verde)
ingredients: 3 lbs baby carrots, peeled | 1 1/2 lbs chicken pieces | 1 1/2 teaspoons allspice | 1/4 teaspoon nutmeg, freshly ground
instructions: Cook the chicken pieces in a saucepan of boiling water for two minutes. While the chicken is cooking, peel the carrots and cut them into rounds. When the chicken is done, return the pan to the stove and add the carrots and simmer over moderate heat, stirring or tossing, until the carrots are tender, about 7 minutes. Remove half of the pan mixture to a food processor fitted with the blade and process or use a vegetable peeler to remove the excess fat and grated carrot pieces. Return this carrot mixture to the hot pan and simmer over moderate heat, stirring or tossing constantly for 3 minutes. Stir in the saffron and nutmeg and remove the pan from heat.

title: Chile Con Queso (Tastes With Fish)
ingredients: 2 lbs fish, of your choice, cleaned skinned, scaled and cut into 2 inch pieces | 2 -3 habanero peppers, sliced or diced, to taste | 1 -2 ounce pure unrefined brandy | 6 tablespoons pure salsa verde ( or chile verde, if you don't like things hot )
instructions: Mix the chili peppers, fish, habanero or pure unrefined brandy together. Pour into a deep fry pan, or heat up your stove. Heat over medium high heat, stirring to coat the bottom of the pan, until the drops evaporate. When the drops of liquid are starting to subside, turn the heat down to medium high. Heat for a couple of minutes or so more, until the mixture starts to turn a slight brown color. Add 1 cup of water if the chili becomes very dry. Drain the fish and place it in the chili in the pan, add 1 - 2 teaspoon of salt. Cover and let it boil, stirring frequently. Lower heat and let the chili simmer for 5 - 6 minutes, until the fish is cooked through. If the fish starts to stick, remove it from the pan. Stir in the salsa to taste at this point. Cover tightly and let rest for 1 - 2 minutes, until the sauce thickens enough to coat the fish. Serve immediately, or store and reheat in a 250°f oven. Re heat it again if necessary to serve.

Random Ingredients: russet potato,greek yogurt,salt seasoning,cake flour,kaiser,raisin,marsala wine
title: Kosher Fondue for Children
ingredients: 4 cans petite diced russet potatoes, well drained | 1 1/2 cups raisins, plumped | 3/4 cup dry marsala wine | 3/4 cup cake flour | salt and seasoning | pancake flour or cornstarch, for dusting
instructions: In a heavy bottomed saucepan, combine the potatoes and raisins. Pour in the wine and bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes. Transfer the fondue to a fondue pot and return to high heat. Stir in the cake flour and heat, stirring constantly, for a few minutes to make a paste. Add 1 cup water and continue stirring. When the mixture is thick enough to handle, remove the pan from the heat and stir in the salt and a pinch of seasoning. Spoon the fondue into a bowl or platter and keep warm in a 200f oven until ready to serve. Dust with pancake flour, cover and keep warm for 10 minutes to prevent excess browning.

title: Artichoke Dip
ingredients: 1 can refrigerated artichoke hearts, drained and chopped | 1/4 cup hot salsa | 1 pinch asafoetida powder ( optional )
instructions: Mix hot salsa and asafoetida with a fork.

Random Ingredients: swiss cheese,chinese five spice powder,almond extract,sofrito sauce,cocoa powder,pumpkin seed
title: Chinese "pop-Pop" Dip
ingredients: 1 lb grated swiss cheese | 1/4 cup sifted cocoa powder | 1 pinch chinese five spice powder | 1 - 1 1/4 teaspoon almond extract ( or almond powder ) | sofrito sauce, to coat | sofrito seeds, to coat | 1/2 - 3/4 teaspoon pumpkin seeds ( or any nut of choice )
instructions: Place all ingredients together in a bowl and beat with a whisk until all ingredients are blended, adjust to taste. Put mix into a 9x13 pan and refrigerate for at least 1 hour or over night. Before serving, spread extra sofrito on chips and drizzle extra sofrito on tops of the dip. Serve with your favourite crackers or as a garnish to a meat or game.

title: Tunisian Meat Salad
ingredients: 1 can minced meat | 1 loaf bread | lettuce | roasted pine nuts | 1/2 bunch fresh salad green lettuce
instructions: Cut bread in 1 inch slices, then cut slices in half and toast in oven on cookie sheet at 400 degrees for 5 minutes. While bread is toasting, saute the minced meat until heated through and browned to your liking. Warm meat in bowl you will be serving it on. Cut lettuce leaf crosswise into 6 thin wedges. Slice meat crosswise into 1/8 inch thick slices and arrange at the end of salad. Ladle on meat, sprinkle pine nuts over salad and drizzle cheese over the salad. The salad can be served immediately, or chilled.

Random Ingredients: vanilla bean,sharp cheddar cheese,coconut milk,dark rum
title: Real French Cheese With Coconut Milk
ingredients: 1 can coconut milk | 1 teaspoon vanilla bean, crushed ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons dark rum ( optional ) | 2 ounces shredded sharp cheddar cheese ( or your favourite cheese )
instructions: Combine coconut milk and vanilla beans in a saucepan and bring to simmering over medium heat. Let simmer for 30 seconds to 1 minute, or until mixture is heated though. Add rum and remove from heat, and pour mixture over cheese. Sprinkle on cheese.

title: Pasta with Tuna, Ziti and Tuna
ingredients: 2 cans tuna steaks | 1 1/2 tablespoons distilled white vinegar | 12 ounces ziti pasta | 3 tablespoons olive oil
instructions: Cook ziti according to package directions. Meanwhile, drain tuna and cool for about 10 minutes. While ziti is cooking, heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. Spray a large baking sheet or baking dish with nonstick spray. When oil just begins to bubble, toss ziti with tuna. Transfer to pan. Stir in vinegar and allow flavors to meld together until all the pasta is coated with oil. Serve.

title: Pecorino-Romano-Scented Raisins
ingredients: 1 lb golden raisin | 1 cup pecorino romano cheese, grated
instructions: Combine raisins with cheese in a large pot. Cover tightly and refrigerate 2 to 3 days. Use as needed.

Random Ingredients: black eyed pea,salt pepper,bread,tamarind paste,rice vinegar,cajun spice,ginger,poblano chile
title: Alicante Beans
ingredients: 3 cups cooked black-eyed peas | 3 cups crispy plain bread | 2 tablespoons tamarind paste | 2 tablespoons fresh ginger, minced | 2 poblano chiles, seeded and chopped | 1 cup rice vinegar | 1/4 cup cajun spices | salt and pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. In large bowl, combine the black eyed peas, bread, tamarind paste, ginger, poblano chilies, rice vinegar, cajun spices, salt and pepper. Toss to mix. Place mixture into a 9x13 inch baking dish. Bake, stirring occasionally, for 25 to 30 minutes or until heated through. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: arborio rice,barbecue sauce,wheat pita bread,red bean
title: Red Beans and Rice Pizzas
ingredients: 2 cups commercial pre-sliced red beans | 1 cup barbeque sauce | 1/2 cup uncooked arborio rice | 8 whole wheat pita bread
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Spread each pita onto a baking sheet with aluminum foil or parchment paper,. Brush each pita with barbeque sauce. Spread 1/2 cup of rice over pita, followed by about 1/3 cup of red beans and 1/2 cup of barbeque sauce. Bake in the preheated oven until the rice is golden, about 20 minutes. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: chinese five spice powder,purpose flour,pomegranate seed,green chili pepper,fruit,sage leaf
title: Vegetables Chapati (Cook's Illustrated)
ingredients: 2 cups all-purpose flour | 8 ounces pomegranate seeds | 1/2 teaspoon chinese five-spice powder | 1/8 teaspoon dried sage leaves, crushed | 1 teaspoon finely diced green chili pepper | 1/2 cup candied mixed fruit, chopped
instructions: In a medium bowl, stir flour, pomegranate seeds, 5 spice powder, sage, chile pepper and candied fruit to blend. Knead dough, 1 inch, until dough forms. Transfer dough to prepared cooking pan, cover loosely with foil, and set aside to let dough relax, about 30 minutes. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. On lightly floured surface, roll dough into a 8 inch round. Using a floured 1 1/2 inch round cookie cutter, cut out 12 rounds, making as many chapati as necessary. Place 1 tablespoon of dough, cut side down, in center of each chapati. Top with another 6 tablespoons of dough, cut side up, and cut out 12 more chapati. Repeat with remaining dough, making as many chapati as needed to fit ungreased 8 x 8 inch pans. Arrange chapati on the prepared pans, cut sides up. Bake in the preheated oven until puffed and golden, 15 to 20 minutes. Serve warm, loosely covered with foil, if desired, and let stand 10 to 15 minutes before serving.

title: Easy Beef Curry
ingredients: 300 g beef mince | 1 packet of curry paste ( i use mr. gordon's curry paste made with beef mince ) | 1 can cream of celery soup
instructions: Heat wok or frypan over med/high add curry paste and stir fry on high for 1 minute. Add mince stirring until meat is browned lightly and add soup stir until mixed. Serve with salad or fried plantains.

title: Garlicky Broad Beans (Fasolakia Yahlaiyya) #5FIX
ingredients: 1 can garbanzo beans, drained and rinsed | 2 cans italian-style stewed tomatoes | 3/4 cup dry broad bean, cut in half
instructions: In a large skillet, saute the garlic in olive oil until golden. Add the garbanzo beans, stewed tomatoes and broad beans, and heat to boiling. Reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes. Season to taste with more salt and black pepper.

title: French Onion Soup
ingredients: 8 -10 small spring onions | 1/4 cup ketchup | 4 tablespoons vegetable broth | 1 tablespoon garlic paste | 1 tablespoon ketchup | 1 tablespoon dry mustard | 1 tablespoon vegetable broth | 1 tablespoon ketchup | 2 tablespoons dry mustard | 2 tablespoons vegetable broth
instructions: Blanch onions in boiling water for one minute then drain. Remove and place in strainer or colander. Rinse under cold running water. When cool enough to handle remove outer layers with your fingers. Reserve liquid until later use. Bring the vegetable broth or water to boil in a large pot. Blanch and stir the ketchup, garlic paste and dry mustard into the liquid. Add the onions and heat through, about 5 minutes. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: pork tenderloin,lime wedge,french onion,heavy whipping cream,pita bread,sea salt black pepper,apple cider
title: Pork Tenderloin Sweet and Sour
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon sea salt and ground black pepper to taste | 1 pork tenderloins | 1 can french-fried onions | 1/4 cup apple cider | 1/4 cup light whipping cream | 4 soft pita bread rounds, warmed | 2 tablespoons heavy whipping cream | 1 lime wedge, or as desired ( optional )
instructions: Bring a water temperature to a boil. Reduce heat to medium low, cover, and simmer until tender, about 1 hour. Cool, and cut into 1/2 inch dice. Stir French fried onions, cider, and 1/4 cup cream into the pork. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add pork, and return to a boil. Cook for 2 minutes, then remove from heat, and allow to steam for 20 minutes. Pour pork onto a serving plate, cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate until chilled, about 35 minutes. Preheat grill for medium heat. Remove pork from refrigerator, and discard plastic wrap. Brush the pita dough with 1/4 cup cream. Lightly coat with olive oil. Warm the pita bread on the preheated grill for 2 minutes per side, then set aside. Remove pork from foil, and sear on the preheated grill until well browned and crispy, 3 to 5 minutes per side. Turn meat over, and continue cooking until internal temperature of the meat registers 160 degrees f, about 10 minutes. Cover the pita bread with warm pita slices, and continue cooking until warmed. Garnish with sour cream and cilantro if desired.

title: Asian Coleslaw (Cabbage)
ingredients: 1 chinese cabbage, shredded | 1/3 cup creamy peanut butter | 1/3 cup cashews, roasted, skin-on | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric powder
instructions: In a large bowl, combine cabbage with peanut butter, cashews, and turmeric powder. Refrigerate at least 20 minutes before serving. Garnish with green onions as a garnish before serving.

title: Chinese Five Spice Powder
ingredients: 20 dried red chilies, roughly chopped | 1 tablespoon chinese five spice powder
instructions: Place the chilies, 5 spice powder and one tablespoon of water into a bowl and stir together. Heat a nonstick frypan over a medium high flame. Pour in 1 tablespoon of oil. When the oil is very hot, scatter the red chillies into the oil and scatter over the red chilies. Add the remaining tablespoon oil. Fry over a medium high flame until the chillies are crisp. Add 1 - 2 teaspoons of cold water. Cover and cook for a minute over a low flame. Check the seasoning, and serve hot.

title: Grilled Capsicum with Bacon & Vanilla
ingredients: 12 small red capsicums ( or any small peppers ) | 2 tablespoons dry sherry or 2 tablespoons apple juice | 50 g diced bacon, rind cut into 1 cm dice | 3 tablespoons light mayonnaise | 1 teaspoon pure vanilla extract
instructions: Preheat grill to high. Cut a slit in each capsicum half using the flat side of a cleaver. Place the bacon in a frypan. Add the capsicum halves, capsicum rinds and juice, mayonnaise and vanilla, stir to combine and simmer, stirring until the bacon is hot. Reduce the heat to medium and cook until the capsicum is hot. Remove from heat, place in large serving bowl and serve warm.

title: Zucchini Orzo Bake
ingredients: 1 cup zucchini, coarsely chopped | 1 package uncooked orzo pasta, uncooked | 1 cup mozzarella cheese, shredded | 1 garlic clove, minced ( from jar )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Lightly grease a 2 quart baking dish. Cook orzo until al dente, according to package directions. Drain, add zucchinis, orzo and cheese to the baking dish, and mix well.. Sprinkle the top with salt and pepper as desired. Bake in preheated oven, until topping is lightly browned and cheese is bubbly, about 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: vegetable broth,jalapeno pepper,chinese rice wine,cumin powder,grain rice,mustard powder,lime zest
title: Chinese Spiced Rice With Peppers
ingredients: 4 fresh jalapeno peppers, seeded and sliced | 2 tablespoons vegetable broth or 2 tablespoons chicken broth | 2 tablespoons chinese rice wine ( i used a dry sherry ) | 1 pinch mustard powder | 1 teaspoon ground cumin powder | 1 tablespoon fresh lime zest ( optional ) | 2 cups cooked short-grain rice
instructions: Bring a saucepan of water to a boil. Add rice and turn heat down to medium low. Cover and simmer until water is absorbed, about 20 minutes, stirring occasionally. Meanwhile, heat broiler. When water boils, remove from heat. Drain peppers and place in a roasting pan. Broil them until charred on all sides, turning as necessary. Let cool. Place rice with spices in a large bowl. Add peppers and lime zest and toss to blend. Serve sprinkled with salt and pepper if desired.

title: Tori Kara Age (Tobiko-Japanese Savoy Cabbage) Salad
ingredients: 1 savoy cabbage | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies, drained and crushed | 1/2 cup mirin
instructions: Wash and trim the cabbage and remove the outer leaves and core. Cut the cabbage into bite sized pieces. In a large salad bowl, mix together the drained tomatoes, cabbage, and mirin. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: lebanese cucumber,oyster mushroom,white wine,ham,salmon,coriander powder,pesto sauce,green chilies
title: Prawns W-Earl Green Chile Relish
ingredients: 2 lbs prawns, raw and prawns, peeled, tails left on | 2 slices ham, cut into thin strips | 1 lebanese cucumber, chopped | 1 teaspoon coriander powder | 1 teaspoon salt | 3 tablespoons pesto sauce | 3 fluid ounces dry white wine | 3 tablespoons green chilies, seeded and finely sliced
instructions: Put all ingredients except prawns and ham into a large frying pan, bring to the boil and simmer gently, covered, for approximately 20 mins or until they have turned opaque. Towards the end of cooking time, cook the prawns until just cooked, this depends on how hungry you are. Add the prawns and ham and heat through, stir in the lemon balan and serve immediately with rice.

title: Dijon Bread and Butter With Parsley
ingredients: 6 -7 slices bread, cut in half diagonally | parsley flakes
instructions: Spread some fresh parsley flakes on cut side of each bread slice. Arrange slices of bread around the edge of a square of cheesecloth or cheesecloth. Bring up the cheesecloth or cheese cloth over the bread. Refrigerate a few hours or overnight.

title: Cabbage & Basil Soup
ingredients: 1 head of cabbage ( the huge head, not the small green leaves ) | 1 can condensed tomato soup | 1 fresh basil leaves, chopped
instructions: Wash and core the cabbage and cut into 1 1/2 inch slices. Place all ingredients in a saucepan and bring to the boil, skimming off any scum that rises to the top. Reduce the heat, cover and simmer until ready to serve. Remove the basil before serving.

title: Easy Spicy Salsa Fettuccine from the Crock Pot
ingredients: 16 ounces tomato sauce | 12 ounces chunky salsa ( i use pace medium ) | 1/4 cup cornstarch | 3/4 cup instant tea | fresh fettuccine
instructions: Combine all ingredients in the crock pot, cover and cook on high 8 to 10 hours. Cook on low for 24 hours, then serve with fresh fettuccine.

title: Spicy Baked Beans
ingredients: 8 ounces pinto beans, rinsed and drained | 12 ounces ground turkey | 1/2 cup orange slices or 1/2 cup lemon juice | 3 tablespoons vinegar
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Put the beans and the turkey into a greased 5 quart casserole dish. Combine the orange juice and the vinegar and pour over the contents of the casserole dish. Cover and bake for 45 to 55 minutes, or until the meat is browned. This should need to be accompanied with a large salad to get the crunchy juices out of the beans.

title: French Toast
ingredients: 2 -6 slices whole wheat bread | 1/2 cup whole wheat breadcrumbs | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 4 scoops vanilla ice cream
instructions: Coat the bread slices with the vanilla extract. Spray a very hot nonstick griddle with cooking spray, then heat until a bread slice starts to brown. Turn over the slices to brown the other side. Serve with extra maple syrup. Variation, toast using pumpernickel breads, roll each slice into a cigar like roll. The more you fill the toast, the more filling your croissants will be tasty enough. Variation, toast using cinnamon rolls which is nonfatty flavored but they are far more traditional.

title: Scottish Oatcakes
ingredients: 200 g oats | 200 g icing sugar | 50 -75 sifted icing sugar, for topping
instructions: Heat oven to 200c/gas mix all the topping ingredients together in a large bowl and spread out on a baking tray. Put in the oven for 15 - 20 minutes until golden. Remove from the oven and leave to cool. Use a sharp knife to cut the top of the tins of the scottish oatcakes from corner to corner and remove as many air bubbles as possible. Leave to cool completely. Once cooled, dip the scottish cake tins in the icing, one by one.

Random Ingredients: white pea bean,mustard seed,yam,shrimp,orange bell pepper,braising steak
title: Yachouse (Peeky) Beef Stew
ingredients: 3 lbs braising steak or 3 lbs sirloin steak | 8 ounces white peas, defrosted | 1 lb yam, peeled and diced | 1 orange bell pepper, seeded and diced | 1 tablespoon mustard seeds | 1 lb medium shrimp, peeled and deveined
instructions: Cut the beef into thin strips about 1/4 to 1/2 inch wide and 3/4 inch long. Sprinkle the beef with 3 tablespoons salt and pepper. Place in a heavy, deep pot and drizzle with oil. Add the peas, yams, and bell pepper. Cover and cook over a low heat for about 1/2 hour until the yams are tender and the green beans are tender. Meanwhile, pull back the outer leaves of the yams and cut away the hard stalks. Cut the shells into 1/2 inch pieces. When the meat has cooked about 1/2 hour, add the shrimp and continue cooking until the shrimp turn bright orange, about 5 minutes longer. Serve over rice.

title: Peanut Butter and Aromatic Beef Salad
ingredients: 1 head iceberg lettuce, shredded | 1/4 cup peanut butter
instructions: Mix together and serve.

Random Ingredients: madras curry powder,salami,hot italian sausage,white vinegar,irish cream,eggplant,cake,mexican chocolate
title: Grilled Sausage and Eggplant Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 lb hot italian sausage, cut lengthwise into 1/4 inch slices | 1 medium eggplant, sliced thinly | 1/4 lb salami, thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons madras curry powder | 1/4 cup prepared irish cream | 3 tablespoons white vinegar | 1/4 lb cake, cut 1/2 inch thick | 4 pieces mexican chocolate
instructions: Preheat grill or broiler. Combine sausage and eggplant with salami and curry powder. Brush each slice of salami with half a teaspoon of cream. Grill or broil until heated through, and eggplant is crisp tender. Remove from grill, slice in half lengthwise, then into 3 pieces. Place cut side of tortillas, cut side down, on grill or broiler pan. Spread 1 1/2 tablespoons cream on tortillas. Top with 2 slices sausage mixture, 1 slice eggplant, 1/3 slice of salami, 1/3 slice of chocolate, and 1/2 tablespoon of cream mixture. Cut into 6 portions, and serve hot, with extra cream.

title: Veal Sandwich
ingredients: 500 g veal, thin cut | 4 slices swiss provolone cheese | 12 slices cheddar cheese | 1 small orange peel, grated and sprinkled over each slice of veal | 1 serrano pepper, thinly sliced and sprinkled over each of the rolls
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c. Put the veal cutlets under a hot grill and lightly roast for 3 - 6 minutes on each side. Put the provolone slices on the bread. Slice the pepper into small strips and sprinkle over each slice of veal. Top with the orange and serrano pepper, then the bacon. Serve with lots of french toast.

title: Spaghetti with Sesame Oil
ingredients: 8 ounces spaghetti sauce | 2 tablespoons sesame oil
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Place spaghetti sauce into a bowl, and stir in the sesame oil. Put a large baking sheet into the oven, and pour sesame oil into the center. Turn the oven to broil. Place spaghetti in the oven, and broil 5 minutes, or until beginning to crisp. Remove from heat and stir until completely hot. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray,romaine lettuce leaf,garlic powder
title: Grilled French Bread Wedges
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 head romaine lettuce leaf | 1 pinch garlic powder
instructions: Preheat grill to medium. Spray bread with veggie oil spray and sprinkle with garlic powder. Grill bread 3 minutes to desired degree of doneness, turning once. Cut bread diagonally into 8 wedges. Cut wedges in half and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: liquid egg substitute,apple,mango powder,chocolate square,apple juice,balsamic vinegar,sauerkraut
title: Applesauce Reuben Muffins
ingredients: 1 cup apple juice | 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar | 5 apple, cored and sliced | 2 mangoes, cubed | 1 pound sauerkraut | 1/2 cup liquid egg substitute | 1/3 cup apple juice | 1 cup sweetened mango powder | 1 square unsweetened chocolate square, grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Grease 12 muffin cups. In a small bowl, stir together apple juice, balsamic vinegar, and apple and mango. Place apple mixture into the prepared muffin cups, and fill with about 2/3 to 1/2 of each fruit. Bake in the preheated oven until topping is lightly browned and fruit is hot, 15 to 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: cane syrup,cornstarch,beef stew meat,green food coloring,dijon mustard,apple juice,monterey jack cheese
title: Santa Fe Meat Loaf
ingredients: 1 carton sour cream or ( 1 3/4 lb ) carton low-fat sour cream | 2 tablespoons reduced fat dijon mustard | 1/2 cup apple juice | 2 tablespoons cornstarch | 2 lbs boneless beef stew meat | 6 -18 drops green food coloring ( optional ) | 2/3 cup mild monterey jack cheese, shredded
instructions: Line 2 1/2 in. Round cake pan with plastic wrap extending over pan. Set aside. Whisk first 5 ingredients, stirring until cornstarch dissolved. Add beef.

title: Passion Pea & Vegetable Melody
ingredients: 1 lb fresh bean sprouts | 1 lb peas | 1 jar cheese sauce | 1 cup dark corn syrup | 2 tablespoons lard
instructions: Cook and stir beans and peas over medium low heat in 4 quart saucepan over medium high heat until beans are just tender, about 7 minutes. Stir in cheese sauce, corn syrup and lard.

Random Ingredients: garlic powder,graham cracker crumb,olive oil,thai fish sauce
title: Thai Grilled Crackers With Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons olive oil | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder | 1 cup graham cracker crumbs | 1 1/2 teaspoons thai fish sauce
instructions: Heat oil in a skillet over medium high heat. Stir in the garlic powder and mix well. Stir in the graham cracker crumbs and fish sauce. Turn onto a plate and spread evenly with the dipping sauce. If desired, cover and refrigerate for an hour or more. If desired, grill in a hot pan until crumbs are golden on the edges.

title: Beef and Shrimp Patties With Chutney
ingredients: 1/2 cup mango chutney ( i just eyeball it ) | 1/2 cup stewing beef, thinly sliced | 2 teaspoons crushed cardamom seeds | 4 ounces shrimp, peeled and deveined | 4 ounces turnips, peeled and cut into 3/4-inch cubes | 2 teaspoons ground coriander | 3 -5 cups rice krispies
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and use a slotted spoon to evenly distribute it evenly over the beef slices. Set aside. Stir fry both the patties on high just until they are a bit pink on the outside and the meat is nicely browned on the inside. Note, if the meat is partially frozen and partially frozen, it won't cook as well. Stir fry each pattie in peanut oil on high just to heat through and crisp. Put the patties on a plate. In a microwave safe bowl, cover the bottom of the bowl with water. Place it on the microwave, cook on high for one minute. Stir and microwave for one more minute, remove, cover and set aside. Keep warm in the microwave. Mix rice krispies until evenly mixed into the patties. Put 1 tbl. Of batter on the patties, close the lid, and microwave for 90 seconds. Flip the patties over, close the lid, and microwave for an additional minute. Remove from microwave and serve.

Random Ingredients: cashew,spinach leaf,habanero pepper,ginger paste,corn oil,dark chocolate,onion soup mix
title: Spinach With Spicy Red Chilies
ingredients: 2 tablespoons corn oil | 2 tablespoons ginger-ginger paste | 500 g spinach leaves | 3 tablespoons dry onion soup mix | 2 teaspoons mild indian dark chocolate ( optional ) | 6 -8 basil leaves ( to garnish ) | 1 habanero pepper ( to garnish )
instructions: Chop the basil and chilies as finely as possible. Heat oil in a frying pan or wok and add chopped ginger and fry for 30seconds, until it turns dark brown. Add chopped spinach and stir fry for another 10 seconds. Add dried onion soup mix and fry until it starts to dry slightly. Add the chocolate and cook for 1 2min longer. Add cashews and mix. Pour the mixture in a serving bowl and garnish with basil and basil leaves.

title: Mexican Corn With Apple
ingredients: 1 can mexican-style corn | 4 -5 ripe ripe apples, peeled, cored and sliced in thin wedges | 2 cups gluten | 2 teaspoons vanilla
instructions: Spray your skillet with oil or spray with cooking spray. Add apple wedges. Stir with a wooden spoon to mix, being very careful not to cook into mushy mush. Stick a spatula under apple to ensure that the corn sticks and gets slightly charred on the bottom. The goal is to not let the corn get mushy. Cover, and let cook until the apples are done. Stir in the flour, and mix with hands until it is a bit like crumbs, not cornmeal. Taste and season with salt and pepper. Serve warm or chilled. Serve with pita chips, or with tortilla chips. Tip, i like my mexican style corn to be with the mexican style corn on the side. I also like to add a handful and a half of mexican style corn to the meal. The way i do it is by cooking it for only 1 - 2 minutes, stirring after, then repeating until it is thoroughly mixed, then adding more corn to the meal. If you add too much corn, you will over cook the dish and it will become mushy. I also sprinkle the top with 1 table. Omit vanilla if using plain corn.

Random Ingredients: allspice,chicken breast,amaretto,pistachio,green chili pepper,mace,apple,cream chicken soup
title: Grilled Jamaican Chicken With Nuts
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb boneless chicken breast | 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1/4 cup amaretto ( almond flavor if you can get it ) | 2 teaspoons allspice | 1 teaspoon grated nutmeg | 1/2 green chili pepper, chopped | 1 teaspoon ground mace | 1/2 apple, sliced thinly and cut into thin strips
instructions: Combine the soups, nutmeg, chile powder, mace and allspice. Stir in the chicken and place in refrigerator for up to 1 hour. Heat outdoor grill to medium high heat and lightly oil grate. Remove chicken from bag. Strain soup mixture into non metal bowl. Stir in chicken, apple and nuts. Pour over chicken. Put lid on bowl, and grill for 25 minutes. Serve.

title: Creme De Puff (Zucchini and Swiss Cheese Quiche from the web at rachael.com
ingredients: 1 can sweetened condensed cream | 1/4 cup heavy cream | 3 cups grated swiss cheese | 3/4 teaspoon paprika
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f.

Random Ingredients: amaretti cooky,spinach leaf,coffee,italian salad dressing mix,cider vinegar
title: Italian Spinach Coffee
ingredients: 1 package dried amaretti cookies ( about 4 c ) | 1 cup thinly sliced fresh spinach leaves | 1 envelope dried italian salad dressing mix | 1 tablespoon coffee | 1 tablespoon cider vinegar
instructions: Cover cookie sheet with foil.

title: Chorizo With Snow Pea
ingredients: 1/2 lb chorizo sausage | 1/2 lb snow peas, trimmed | 1/2 teaspoon white vinegar
instructions: Heat a skillet over medium high heat. Add the chorizo and cook until browned but not cooked through, stirring frequently. Add the snow peas and cook until tender crisp, about 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: red chili pepper flake,pecan,anchovy,cauliflower,mango chutney,cotija cheese,spanish onion
title: Crunchy Cauliflower
ingredients: 2 heads cauliflower | 1/2 cup chopped spanish onion | 1 jar stuffed anchovies, drained | 4 tablespoons chopped pecans | 1 teaspoon red chili pepper flakes | 3 tablespoons mexican blend cheese | 1/4 cup mango chutney
instructions: Steam cauliflower until very tender. Cool completely under running water. Chop cauliflower and set aside. Mash anchovies and chilies in a small bowl. Combine cauliflower, anchovies mixture, cheese and chutney in a large bowl and mix well. Cover and chill about one hour before serving.

Random Ingredients: pearl barley,anaheim chile pepper,basil,cheese,oyster sauce,cardamom seed
title: Barley and Cheese  Mushroom  Filling for Peroshky
ingredients: 1/2 cup dried banana or 1/2 cup dried portabella mushrooms | 1 cup pearl barley | 1/4 cup grated processed cheese | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh basil | 1 teaspoon cardamom seed, crushed | 1 teaspoon oyster sauce ( optional )
instructions: Place the mushrooms in a bowl and cover with water. Soak and steam the mushrooms over a low heat for at least 20 minutes, or up to an hour. Remove the mushrooms, reserving some water. Drain and cut them into small pieces while still warm. Add the remaining ingredients except for the cheese and bring to the boil. Turn the heat down to a simmer and cook for 5 minutes, or until the rice is tender and liquid absorbed. Add the cheese, remove from heat and stir quickly to blend thoroughly. If desired, you can chill the mixture to finish chilling before filling. Use filling sparingly though as it has a slightly tart flavor. Store in an airtight container in the refrigerator.

title: Smothered Mushrooms and Coffee
ingredients: 2 tablespoons kosher salt | 4 lbs mixed mushrooms, such as baby shiitake, cremini and shitake | 32 ounces hot strong coffee, chilled | 2 tablespoons korean soy sauce ( gochujang )
instructions: Wash mushrooms well, remove stems and cut stems into 1 inch pieces. Place mushrooms, soaking liquid, coffee, and soy sauce in a large container and stir to combine all ingredients. Cover tightly and refrigerate at least 2 hours, up to several hours. Unwrap mushrooms, placing mushrooms on rimmed baking sheet and bake on middle rack at 350°f, turning mushrooms once, until dark brown and crispy about 20 - 30 minutes. Transfer to a large serving platter or heatproof bowl and sprinkle with korean soy sauce.

title: Swiss Stuffed Egg Fondue
ingredients: 3 eggs, hard-boiled, shelled, rind removed | 3 ounces swiss grated jarlsberg cheese ( swiss or gruyere ) | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1/2 teaspoon ground coriander | 1/2 teaspoon sugar
instructions: Break open the egg yolks with a spoon and place in a medium size bowl. Add the remaining ingredients, minus the egg whites. Stir until mixed, then slowly beat in the whites. The mixture will become more frothy when mixed. Transfer the mixture into a fondue pot or other wide frying pan. Set over medium heat. As soon as the mixture boils, remove from heat. Hold up the edge of the fondue pot with a wooden spoon dipped in warm water, tipping the pot and carefully back and forth to loosen the mixture into the pot or into a serving dish. Turn off heat. Do not reboil. Pipe fondue into small decorative serving dishes. Serve at once, or store in the fondue pot in the refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: pork roast,grainy mustard,self rising flour,halibut fillet,breadcrumb,phyllo dough,large marshmallow,ice
title: Sweet and Savory Pork and Roasted Marshmallows
ingredients: 1 tablespoon grainy mustard | 1/2 cup self-rising flour | 1/2 cup self-rising flour | 4 ounces pork roast, cut into 16 1inch pieces | 4 ounces unpopped large marshmallows | 2 packages frozen phyllo dough, thawed and patted dry | ice | 1 cup dry breadcrumbs
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f heat the mustard in a small nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Add the 1/2 cup flour and cook, stirring constantly, until the mixture turns a golden brown color, about 2 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in the pork. Add the marshmallows and stir well. Separate the sheets of phyllo dough into 2 equal halves. Place one half of the phyllo in a 9 x 13 x 2 inch baking dish with the bottom completely covering. Drizzle with 1/2 cup of the mustard mixture. Arrange half of the pork mixture over the phyllo, then top with half of the marshmallow mixture. Repeat the layers, ending with the remaining half of the marshmallow mixture. Spread bread crumbs evenly over the top. Bake for 40 to 50 minutes or until golden brown, and juices run clear.

title: Cremini Mushrooms With Vinegar
ingredients: 3 ounces cremini mushrooms | 2 tablespoons vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 2 tablespoons black olives, coarsely chopped
instructions: Clean the mushrooms with a thin wipe and cut them lengthwise into 4 pieces, remove the stems. Wash them with fresh water in a bowl. In a large frying pan put the olive oil and heat over high heat. In small batches put 3 oz. Of mushrooms in frying pan and fry them in olive oil until golden, put aside. Clean the frying pan the same way you fried the mushrooms and put it back on the high heat. Stir once in a while. In medium bowl put the vinegar and salt and black pepper and vinegar in the frying pan. Dip the mushrooms into the egg wash for the first time and then place them into the mixture of vinegar and olive oil and fry until they are done. Then remove them from the frying pan with a strainer and put back on the high heat. Add in olives for more flavor and color.

title: Lamb Racks
ingredients: 1 1/3 lbs lamb racks | 1 1/2 tablespoons chili powder with herbs ( we used chipotle ) | 1 teaspoon garlic salt | 15 ounces diced tomatoes | 1 jar beef gravy | 1 small dried ancho chiles ( they are stronger and hotter in this dish ) or 2 dried pasilla chiles ( they are stronger and heavier in this dish )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375^f. Place rinsed lamb racks on a rack in a shallow glass baking dish and sprinkle with chili powder and garlic salt. Top with diced tomatoes, dried chiles or dried pasilla chiles. Bake at 375f for about 1 hour and 45 minutes or until internal temp is 140 degrees f. During last 20 minutes of baking, pour beef gravy over top for a crispier crust. Variation, if you have the time and inclination, cover meat tightly with foil and bake at 300 for 2 hours before serving.

Random Ingredients: red food coloring,mayonnaise,brown rice,water,kingfish,green bean,cream mushroom soup
title: Fish Stuffed Onions
ingredients: 3 cups cooked brown rice | 1 package sliced kingfish or ( 3 ounce ) package other white fish, skinned and cubed | 3/4 cup mayonnaise, can use less | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup, undiluted | 1/2 cup water | green beans, chopped | red food coloring
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit. Mix rice, fish, mayonnaise and soup together in bowl with green beans and food coloring. Stuff each onion with fish mixture. In an oven safe baking dish, pour soup mixture over each onion. Broil the onions just until the tops are browned and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: maple syrup,onion seed,orange,almond extract,flat leaf parsley,penne
title: Sweet N' Sweet Pasta
ingredients: 4 tablespoons maple syrup | 1/2 teaspoon onion seeds | 1 tablespoon blanched slivered almond | 4 tablespoons finely chopped flat leaf parsley | 8 ounces penne | 1 orange, thinly sliced
instructions: Heat a large non stick frypan over medium heat. Add the maple syrup and add the onion seeds. Stir for 20 seconds. Add the almonds and parsley. Cook, stirring every minute, for 5 minutes or until the almonds start to color. Meanwhile, bring a kettle of salted water to a boil. Add the pasta and return to the boil. Cook, stirring every few minutes, until the pasta is al dente, which will take about 8 minutes. Drain well. Tear the orange slices into long, thin slices. Place the pasta in a large serving bowl. Top with orange slices. Add the maple syrup and toss.

Random Ingredients: cake flour,green cardamom pod,gouda cheese,baking chocolate,pork shoulder
title: Gouda and Chocolate Pull-And-Beards
ingredients: 4 ounces smoked gouda cheese, cut into strips about 2 to 3 inches long and 1 1/2 inches wide ( about 4 ounces ) | 4 ounces fresh shaved gouda or 4 ounces unsweetened baking chocolate, cut into strips about 2 to 3 inches long | 4 ounces cake flour | 4 ounces green cardamom pods, crushed | 1 lb boneless pork shoulder, trimmed of excess fat
instructions: For the gouda.

title: Anchovy Puffs - France
ingredients: 2 tablespoons bourbon | 3 eggs | 1/3 cup dried flaked coconut
instructions: Preheat oven to 400º fahrenheit. Combine bourbon and eggs. Mix well. Add coconut and mix. Place 1 tbsp of mixture on a cookie sheet. Sprinkle tops with a little more coconut. Bake at 400º fahrenheit for 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: frosting,coriander powder,lime jell o gelatin,mandarin orange segment,pisco
title: Pisco Oranges With Pecans & Marshmallows
ingredients: 2 pisco | 2 packages unflavored gelatin | 1/2 cup chopped coriander powder | 1 package mandarin orange segments | 1 bag frozen lime jell-o gelatin | 1 1/2 cups chopped crystallized ginger
instructions: Prepare martini glasses as directed on package. Cool completely. Sprinkle gelatine over remaining ingredients until dissolved. Gently stir until mixture is smooth. Line 12x18 pan with plastic wrap on both ends extending over sides of pan. Dip each gelatine orange in gelatin mixture, holding orange slice in plastic so it adheres. Dip in chocolate crumbs shaking off excess. Refrigerate until set, about 30 minutes. Garnish with mandarin peel if desired.

Random Ingredients: guajillo chilies,fenugreek seed,vegetable oil cooking spray,chile de arbol pepper,egg white,mustard powder,brown lentil
title: Spicy Lentils in Chile-Enchil
ingredients: 1 cup brown lentils | 1 egg white, lightly beaten | 1 -2 lb red guajillo chilies, stemmed and deveined | 8 dried chile de arbol peppers | 1 teaspoon vegetable oil or 1 teaspoon cooking oil | 1/2 teaspoon mustard powder | 2 tablespoons fenugreek seeds
instructions: Mix all ingredients in non reactive bowl. Let stand 10 minutes. Heat grill. Line baking sheet with foil. Place 2 cups of lentils on foil on grill.

title: Raspberry and Curry Chutney
ingredients: 500 g raspberries | 1/3 cup grapeseed oil or 1/3 cup canola oil | 4 green chilies, thinly sliced ( or jalapeno peppers ) | 1 teaspoon gingerroot, freshly grated ( or grated fresh ginger )
instructions: Put the raspberries in a bowl and put to one side whilst preparing the rest of the recipe. The chutney is best made just before serving with the curry. Heat the oil in a large frying pan. Add the chillies and ginger and fry for 5 minutes, or until fragrant and starting to soften. Add the raspberry mixture and stir fry until raspberries are reduced and heated through. Serve hot or cold.

title: Fidelproof Veal
ingredients: 4 lbs veal schnitzels | 1/2 lb salt pork | 1 tablespoon dried oregano leaves | 1 1/4 fluid ounces beer
instructions: Place salt pork and oregano in a large pot and cover with water. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and cover. Simmer until pork is tender. Let meat cool. Remove from pot, discarding bones. Slice meat across the grain. Drain liquid. Mix meat and liquid in the container of a food processor to form a coarsely puree. Do not process at high speed. Pour in beer and cook slowly until heated through.

Random Ingredients: cucumber,red wine vinegar,spanish rice mix,bean,garlic clove,cumin seed,dark chocolate chip
title: Mexican Cucumbers and Beans Stuffed With Chili Nuts & Chocolate Chips
ingredients: 1/2 - 1 lb fresh beans | 1 -2 large cucumber, peeled, seeded and sliced lengthwise into thin strips or 1 -2 bunch english cucumber, peeled, seeded and cut into thin strips | 2 tablespoons chopped garlic cloves | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons dark chocolate chips | 1/2 teaspoon cumin seed, toasted and crushed | 1 teaspoon red wine vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon ground cumin seed
instructions: Soak fresh beans in water of cold water for 20 - 30 minutes, until the beans are very tender. Drain. In a large salad bowl, toss the beans, cucmber and garlic with 1 - 2 tbsp oil. Add 2 tbsp white wine vinegar, 2 tbsp dark chocolate chips and 1 tsp cumin seeds.

Random Ingredients: active yeast,black olive,chicken stock,chuck,portabella mushroom,white balsamic vinegar
title: Pizza Rustica from the Gehos Comfort Food
ingredients: 3 gallons chicken stock | 2 packages active dry yeast | 5 lbs chuck | 1/2 lb portabella mushroom | 2 ounces black olives | 1 tablespoon white balsamic vinegar | 1/2 lb portabella mushroom
instructions: You should be using a crock pot for this recipe. Add the salt and water to the salt until it is mostly clear. Then put the chicken into the crock pot. Do not rinse with water that covers the chicken. Leave in the sink for about 30 minutes. Add the yeast to the stock. Scrub the chuck of beef of all visible fat and cut it into 6 1/4 to 1 1/2 inch cubes. Cut all of the mushrooms in small pieces. Put the mushroom pieces in a colander inside the crock pot that you have sprayed a little olive oil. Drain the meat and rinse them really thoroughly. Add the yeast mixture to the pork. Add the beef to the crock pot on top of the meat. Leave about an hour or so on the heat. After about an hour or so check to make sure that the flavor is balanced. Add the balsamic and let it finish mixing. If it looks dry, add some more of the chicken stock. If it tastes too dry add some more of the stock. When the time is up to you, remove the lid to put the pizza back on and turn off the heat. The dough will be ready to be turned into a giant oven safe pot and ready to go later. It can be made in advance and frozen on the grill. If you want to go fancy, double the amount of balsamic, olive oil, and basil on the dough, and add a good drizzle of balsamic to each of these little pizzas. Serve hot with lots of toppings. The great thing about it is the bread takes out a bit of the air and it goes really nicely with the garlic and other flavors of the ingredients. You just can't overdo it, but it lets the flavors meld.

Random Ingredients: romaine lettuce,baby shrimp,purpose flour,fire tomato,lemon curd,avocado,red chili pepper
title: Shrimp and Smoked Garlic Muffins
ingredients: 1 1/3 cups baby shrimp, chopped | 1/2 cup fire-roasted tomatoes, chopped | 1/4 cup lemon curd, chopped | 2 teaspoons all-purpose flour | 1/2 teaspoon red chili pepper ( or to taste ) | 1 avocado, chopped | 1/4 cup romaine lettuce, shredded
instructions: Combine shrimp, tomatoes, lemon curd, flour and chile pepper in a bowl and mash with a fork. Add avocado and mix to combine. Spoon mixture into 12 buttered muffin cups. Top with lettuce. Bake at 400° for 15 - 17 minutes or until warm and bubbly.

title: Salsa Cruda (Mexican Pomon)
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh plum tomatoes | 2 cups cold water | 1 tablespoon ground cumin
instructions: The day before serving, place a plate over a large pan of boiling water to create steam. Trim stem ends off plum tomatoes and, using a grapefruit peeler, peel a thin slice off the top of each tomato from the top until only the bottom shell remains. Carefully scoop out the plum tomato and discard. With a spoon, scrape out the pulp and discard the seeds with the tomatoes and discard. Cut reserved tomato flesh into thin slices and place in a bowl with the water and cumin. Stir to combine. Taste for seasoning, adding salt and pepper at the table. Taste for sweetness to balance out the spice.

title: Bok Choy With Soy-Sesame Oil
ingredients: 4 -5 ounces bok choy, very clean and tightly packed | 4 tablespoons dark sesame oil
instructions:
Wash bok choy and trim off the root ends and the woody stalk. If using bok choy that has been washed well with a white vinegar or with a soy 
    - soy sauce you may wish to use less sesame oil. Shred the bok choy and put it in a bowl with a generous amount of the dark sesame oil.

title: Wild Rice With Sprouts
ingredients: 1 1/2 teaspoons turmeric powder | 1 cup unsweetened applesauce, canned | 200 g small bean sprouts | 1 cup spring onion, finely chopped | 1 red onion, grated | 2 tablespoons fresh tarragon, chopped
instructions: Soak the beansprouts for 1 hour in the microwave. Drain and dry the beansprouts. Combine the ground spices in a wide, shallow bowl. Add the applesauce. Mix well. Heat a griddle over a medium heat and spray with oil. Add the grated onion and grated tarragon and saute lightly for 3 - ½ minutes on low heat. Add the rice and stir to coat the grains. Add the cooked beansprouts and stir gently, adding the hot sauce. Serve immediately.

title: Rice Salad With Lemon and Preserved Lemon (Lebanese)
ingredients: 3 cups risotto rice or 3 cups arborio rice, cooked | 1/2 cup white vinegar | 1 preserved lemon peel, rinsed, finely chopped ( about 2 tablespoons preserved lemons ) | 1/2 teaspoon lemon zest, grated
instructions: Place the rice with 2 cups of water in a bowl with a tight fitting lid. Cover tightly and set aside to soak for 30 minutes. Drain. In a nonreactive bowl, add 2 tablespoons of water and the vinegar. When the rice is soft, add the cooked rice and preserved, preserved lemons, lemon zest. Mix well. Let sit for at least 2 hours. title: Phyllo Wrapped Fish Fillets W-Haddock - Vegetable Etc!
ingredients: 6 sheets phyllo pastry | 2 large eggplants, sliced length-wise into strips | 1 cup cooked rice wine ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon dried tarragon ( or 1 tblsp. fresh-chopped ) | 6 sheets puff pastry ( i use trader joe's ) | extra fish stock or bottled tabasco sauce ( optional ) | 1 lb haddock fillet, skinned and cut into thin strips ( or any other white fish you may like )
instructions: Note, you can prepare fish a day ahead and keep it covered with cling wrap, ideally in the fridge. Thaw sheets and phyllo and brush generously with extra tarragon if desired. Stack 5 sheets of 1/4 each phyllo on top of each other. Spread fish fillet strips over phyllo sheets and top with remaining phyllo sheets and brush with extra tarragon to adhere to pastry. Fold top 2 sheets of phyllo over fish and brush top and sides with extra tarragon if desired. You should now have three layers. Keep the phyllo sheets covered with a dishtowel and refrigerate 30 minutes. Preheat oven to 425°f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Lay phyllo on pastry and top with pastry leaves overlapping as you go, brushing each stack of sheets with more of the remaining extra virgin olive oil so they stick to the bottom of the dish. Bake until crisp and golden, about 10 - 15 minutes. Take from oven. While preparing fish, if using fish flakes, slice each piece lengthwise into four wedges. If you are using a firm fish fillet, do not press them down against the flesh side and cut them in half, so they can stand on their own. Place the fish on the baking sheet, close the oven door and bake for 10 - 15 minutes or until the fish flakes easily with a fork. Allow to rest for 5 minutes before serving. Spoon fish flakes onto the side with cooked rice and serve immediately or set aside for other uses. Enjoy. Serves 2 as a condiment.

Sprinkle with chopped green onions or green peppercorns to serve.

instructions: Chop the chicken into small pices, or large chunks. Add the chopped capsicum with the chopped tomato in a large frying pan. Add the tomato sauce and stir. Add a generous 1/2 liter of water, and bring to the boil. Cover and cook on low for 40 minutes. Stir and serve straight away.

instructions: Place potato flakes in a large heat proof bowl. Using a fork, stir the potato flakes and the 2 cups of polenta into the potato flakes. Turn refrigerate for 15 to 30 minutes, refrigerating at least 1 hour and up to 12 hours.

title: Grilled Tri-Tip Beef Rolls With Coconut Milk (Vegan)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs sirloin, thinly sliced crosswise | 1 tablespoon espresso | 1 1/2 tablespoons soymilk or 1 1/2 tablespoons low-fat milk | 2 tablespoons fresh cilantro, minced | 2 packages frozen phyllo dough, thawed | 1 can unsweetened coconut milk
instructions: In a skillet, broil the beef. Sprinkle the beef with 1 tablespoon espresso. Place the beef in a saucepan. Cover and cook over medium heat, stirring to crumble the beef. Uncover and cook until desired doneness, about 5 minutes, depending on your preference. Remove the beef from heat, stir in the milk and cilantro. Set aside. Lightly brush a 10x15 inch baking dish with water. Brush one sheet of phyllo pastry with water. Place another sheet of phyllo on top, brush with water, and repeat until the dish and phyllo are used. Fold the short sides of the phyllo over the top of the beef and pinch the edges a little. Repeat with remaining strips and filling. Place seam sides down in the greased baking dish. Brush tops with water and cover with oiled plastic wrap. Place dish in a medium saucepan and pour in water to cover. Turn down heat just enough to maintain a simmer and cook the rolls for about 45 minutes or until they are browned. Cool completely before cutting into squares or diamonds. Serve warm.

title: Roast Aubergine With Roasted Walnuts and Orange

instructions: Preheat the oven to 190°c/375°f/gas cut the aubergine into 8 thick rounds, trim off the root ends and cut the rounds into 1/2in thick slices. Reduce the heat, cover and gently simmer for 20 minutes or until tender. Add more water if necessary and remove the cover. Allow to stand for 5 minutes. Turn out onto a large serving platter and scatter with toasted walnuts and orange zest.

instructions: Pour 8 cans of milk into a pan, bring to a boil and cook until liquid is reduced to about 2 1/2 cups. Remove the mixture from the heat. Mix the remaining milk into the gingerroot. Press the ginger mixture into an ungreased 13 x 9 cake pan. Bake in a 325 degree f oven for 30 minutes.

title: Guilt-Free Kiwi Salad (Abm)
ingredients: 2 packages dry yeast | 1 1/2 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 1 cup shaved lean hamburger | 1/4 cup vegetable oil | 1 kiwi fruit | ice, as required | 1 cup parmigiano, grated
instructions: Soak the kiwi in warm water until soft. Mix the bread flour in a bowl of luke warm water. Dissolve yeast in 1 cup rum and mix into bread flour. Drain and put the yeast into a large glass bowl. Add the sugar, 1/2 cup of water and a teaspoon of salt. Set the bowl in a warm place for about 15 minutes. In the meantime, mix the bread flour and the rest of the rum in a large bowl and stir into the yeast mixture. Make a well in the centre and put the dough in the middle of the well. Add the oil into the well and stir quickly to make a firm dough. Knead the dough on a lightly floured board for about 7 minutes until dough is too stiff to knead. Cover with a towel and leave in a warm place to rise for about 30 minutes. Wash the kiwi, pat dry and cut into strips approx 1/4 inch wide. Brush with a little oil and arrange on a bed of ice. Put another tablecloth on the bed of ice. Punch down the balls of dough.

title: Vietnamese Vegetable Crumble

title: Courgettes (Courgettes in Lemon)

Top up with further boiling water and some grated lemon peel, and simmer gently for two or three more minutes. Serve with lemon wedges.

title: Breadcrumbs for Ravioli or Stuffed Ravioli

instructions: Soak saffron strand in some warm water for 15 min to soften. Drain. Preheat oven to 400ºf. Mix together bread crumbs and saffron. Form mixture into 12 patties. title: Ricotta and Chocolate Sticks
ingredients: 1 lb ricotta cheese | 2 ounces dark chocolate, melted
instructions: Mix the ricotta, dark chocolate and melted butter together. If the mixture begins to curdle, stir in more chocolate, if desired. Refrigerate until chilled.

title: Quick Coiled Eggs
ingredients: 2 egg whites | 1 teaspoon cinnamon oil
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Beat the egg whites and cinnamon oil into a medium bowl using an electric mixer just until they thicken, about 1 minute. Add the egg yolks one at a time. Gently blend in enough whites to blend. Place the baking sheet in the preheated oven. Immediately sprinkle the baking sheet with a little more cinnamon oil. Bake until puffed and eggs are set in the center, about 10 minutes. Remove from the oven and allow to cool for several minutes. Remove the parchment and, using a knife, remove the inside of the egg whites to form a bowl. Break the eggs into one large serving bowl and serve hot. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: chipotle pepper,vanilla extract,white bread,bouquet garni,vegetable stock,lime wedge,pork shoulder
title: Carnitas De Cerdo
ingredients: 2 lbs pork shoulder, boned, cubed | 1 liter vegetable stock | 1 tablespoon chipotle pepper, chopped | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1 bouquet garni ( see note ) | 4 slices white bread, toasted | lime wedge, to serve
instructions: Place the pork, stock, and chipotle in a heavy based pan and over a medium high heat, bring to the boil. Lower the heat, and simmer covered, for about 1 to 1 1/2 hours, or until the pork is very tender, stirring once or twice during cooking. Remove the pork and set aside to cool slightly. When it has cooled, discard the bones and shred. Return all the meat to the pan, and mix in the vanilla and bouquet garni. Serve with the toast and lime wedges.

title: Green Lentils With Figs
ingredients: 4 figs or 4 -6 dried figs, chopped | 1 cup green lentil
instructions: Bring water to boil and add lentils and figs. Cook 15 minutes or till lentils are cooked.

title: German Meat & Potatoes (Sandwiches)
ingredients: 2 lbs hamburger | 2 -3 lbs stew meat | 1 lb veal top or 1 lb round steaks | pitted green peppercorn ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon dried marjoram | 4 -5 lbs hash brown potatoes
instructions: Place all ingredients in crock pot. Cover and cook on low for 10 to 12 hours, depending on desired quality of meat and potatoes.

Random Ingredients: heirloom tomato,part mozzarella cheese,self raising flour,peanut butter,canola oil,artichoke heart
title: Artichoke - Artichoke Hearts Roll-Ups
ingredients: 3/4 lb heirloom tomato | 1 can artichoke hearts | 3/4 lb part-skim mozzarella cheese | 1/2 cup peanut butter | 3/4 cup self-raising flour | 1 teaspoon canola oil
instructions: Wash and slice tomatoes into long strips or bite sized chunks. Heat oil in frypan or large, deep skillet over medium high heat. Drain tomatoes, reserving fat. Put tomatoes, artichoke hearts, mozzarella cheese, peanut butter, flour and oil into food processor with ¾ cup reserved oil. Blend until mixture is like course meal. Add liquid ingredients, mixing till well combined. Cook for 15 - 20 minutes on medium heat until bubbly and hot.

Random Ingredients: yellow onion,cream chicken soup,chicken breast half,eggplant,water chestnut,peanut butter
title: Crock Pot Chicken
ingredients: 2 medium eggplants, sliced into rounds | 1/2 cup peanut butter | 2 cups cubed skinless chicken breast halves ( about 2 breasts ) | 1 can sliced water chestnuts, drained | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1 medium yellow onion, chopped
instructions: Layer eggplant, peanut butter, chicken, water chestnuts and soup in the bottom of a 3 1/2 or 4 quart slow cooker. Top with onion and sprinkle with remaining peanut butter. Cover and cook on high setting setting for 3 to 5 hours.

title: Chocolate Sticks
ingredients: 225 g bread flour, all-purpose | 35 g mustard powder | 75 g low-fat monterey jack cheese, shredded | 25 g melted chocolate
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c. Line a baking tray with baking paper. Mix the flour and mustard and season well with salt and pepper. Add the cheese, making sure it is well blended. Pour into prepared tray. Smooth the top with a fork or knife and bake for 20 - 25 minutes, until crust has darkened and base is cooked, if not, cook for a further 5 minutes. Allow to cool. Cut sticks into slices and cool on sheets of tinfoil. Sprinkle melted chocolate over the sticks.

Random Ingredients: dark rum,italian sausage,cocoa powder,yellow onion,wide egg noodle,sherry wine,chicken stock
title: Overnight Bratwurst
ingredients: 1 lb sweet italian sausage ( casings removed ) | 2 yellow onions | 4 cups chicken stock | 1/2 cup sherry wine | 1 tablespoon cocoa powder | 1 tablespoon dark rum | 1 package wide egg noodles
instructions: Cut and saute sausage in skillet with a bit of water until no longer pink. Add onions and cook until they are soft and transparent just a bit darker.. Add chicken stock, sherry, cocoa, rum, and cocoa powder and bring to a boil stirring frequently. Pour hot brats onto a baking sheet pan or cookie sheet and coat well. Bake at 300 degrees for 20 minutes, stirring often. Cook wide egg noodles in boiling water for 8 minutes or until al dente.

Random Ingredients: feta cheese,chestnut puree,flour,green onion,dark sesame oil
title: Chestnut Filling for Sesame-Sesame Noodles
ingredients: 1/2 cup chestnut puree | 1/4 cup green onion, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons flat leaf feta cheese | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil | 1 tablespoon flour
instructions: Preparation, mix together ingredients except flour and stir in the flour. Refrigerate 1 hour, until mixture is firm. Add flour last 15 minutes, stirring after every 5 minutes. Note, store chestnut puree in the refrigerator in small amounts until desired consistency is reached.

title: Pounded and Grilled Lamb Skewers With Gouda
ingredients: 1/2 lb lamb, diced | 2 slices smoked bacon, sliced | 1 tablespoon fresh ginger paste | 2 tablespoons instant espresso powder | 2 ounces gouda cheese, shredded
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine all ingredients except oil. Add oil and stir to mix well. Add meat and mix again. Soak skewers in mixture for no more than 10 minutes, then rub off excess. Preheat grill on medium high heat. Grill skewers 10 - 12 minutes until done. Serve with a gouda.

title: Cashew Chicken Fingers
ingredients: 1 lb ground chicken | 1 ounce cashews ( raw ) | 1 ounce unsweetened coconut oil | 2 teaspoons fresh gingerroot, grated | 2 teaspoons splenda granular | 2 tablespoons dates, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon dried guacamole
instructions: Combine the first seven ingredients in a bowl. Shape into finger sized fingers with a fork. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes or until crisp and beginning to brown sprinkle on top when serving. Garnish with guacamole.

title: Spiced Lamb Shank
ingredients: 1 lamb shank | 1 jar pitted prite soft variety red jam-almond jam-almond stuffing mix | 1 teaspoon mixed spices | 1/2 cup dry white wine | 1 package cornbread stuffing mix
instructions: Trim any excess fat from the lamb shank and cut into pieces about 1 1/2 inch wide and 2 to 2 1/2 inches long. Place lamb shank into a large, heavy duty ziplock bag, seal bag and shake to coat thoroughly. Add in prite stuffing mix, mixed spice and wine and shake to evenly coat the lamb shank pieces. Refrigerate overnight, turning bag once or twice to distribute evenly. The next day remove lamb to a roasting pan, placing about 1/4 cup of stuffing in the center of each one. Pour remaining stuffing on top. Cover pan with foil, place in 400 degree oven and bake for 2 hours 45 minutes or until internal temp of meat reaches 165 degrees. Remove lamb shank and let rest for 20 minutes. Using a paring knife, carefully remove any bones from the bones and shred them. Use stuffing to pull out extra stuffing.

title: Beet and Sausage Muffins
ingredients: 250 g fresh asparagus or 250 g frozen asparagus | 350 g good quality pork sausage or 350 g good quality sausage | 500 ml heavy whipping cream | 2 tablespoons flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 230 degrees celsius and place asparagus in the bottom of greased muffin tray or muffin pans. Top asparagus with your sausage of choice, making sure they are well covered. Whisk the cream and flour together, then pour over sausage and bake in the oven for 20 minute.

Random Ingredients: deli ham,red wine vinegar,beer,italian salad dressing mix,white flour
title: Italian Ham - Beer Can
ingredients: 1 package dry italian salad dressing mix or ( 3 ounce ) package dry italian salad dressing mix | 2 cups very firmly packed white flour | 1 1/2 cups good light beer | 1 cup deli ham, thinly sliced ( about 6 slices ) | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. In a medium bowl, mix salad dressing mix, flour and beer together until thoroughly combined. On a baking sheet, alternate ham slices between sheets of wax paper that are approximately 6 inches long and 1/3 inch thick. Dot each slice with 1 tablespoons red wine and vinegar and bake until top is crusty and crisp and ham is golden brown around edges, about 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: grain brown rice,onion powder,penne pasta,cod,savoy cabbage
title: Cabbage Pasta With Cod and Onions
ingredients: 1 package penne pasta | 1 head savoy cabbage, cut into thin slices | 1 onion, sliced | 1 can cod, drained | 1 tablespoon dried onion powder
instructions: Cook the pasta according to package directions. Drain, and return to the pot. Meanwhile, place the cabbage and onion into a large skillet over medium high heat. Cook, stirring frequently, just until the cabbage starts to soften, but before it collapses, stir in the cooked pasta. Add the cod to the skillet with the onion mixture. Cook, stirring, until the cod turns orange, about 3 minutes. Pour the pasta mixture over the pasta mixture, and mix in the dried onion powder. Cover, and continue to cook the mixture over low heat until the pasta is done, about 5 minutes.

title: Garlic Paste
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups white sugar | 3/4 teaspoon garlic cloves, finely chopped
instructions: In a non metal bowl, stir together 2 cups of the sugar, the garlic, and salt. Transfer to a spice grinder or mini mini chopper. Let stand until mixture is dry, about 2 hours. Stir in remaining 1 cup sugar to loosen paste.

Random Ingredients: ancho chile powder,french bread,raspberry,hot pepper flake,lettuce leaf,salmon,sea salt
title: Lettuce Wrapped Salmon on Toast
ingredients: 9 slices french bread, or more to taste | 1 can salmon | 1/4 cup cold sweet corn or 1/4 cup sweet banana-pepper blend | 1 tablespoon dried ancho chile powder | sea salt, or to taste | 1 tablespoon hot pepper flakes | 2 cups lettuce leaves
instructions: Cut each slice of bread diagonally and spread with a thin layer of sweetcorn. Top with salmon, hot pepper blend, ancho powder, and sea salt. Put the lettuce leaves on one of the pieces of bread. Roll the bread up and slice. Repeat with other piece of bread. Serve immediately.

title: Cured Fish Fillets
ingredients: 1 white fish fillet | 1/4 cup dry sherry ( optional ) | 1/4 lb kielbasa, sliced 3/4 inch thick
instructions: Preheat 1/2 inch of water inside a medium skillet. Trim all excess fat from the fish and slice it crosswise in the thickest part of the fillet. Place the fish in a large glass dish, sprinkle with kosher salt, cover with plastic wrap, and set aside while you prepare the rest of the ingredients. If using sherry, add it at this point. Let the fish sit so the water can get in there more easily. The platter should be covered by at least 1 inch of water. Place a sheet of foil onto the work surface and place the fish on it. Spread with about 1/4 to 1/2 cup of the sherry. Add a layer of sliced bacon over the fish. Sprinkle with about 3/4 to 1/2 teaspoons salt. Repeat with another layer of bacon, sherry, bacon, sherry, and salt, ending with the top third of the fish. Roll up the ends and seal the fish. Preheat an outdoor grill such as an old one which will hold the fish in a single layer for up to 2 hours. When ready to cook, place the fish on the hot grate, close the lid, and cook until the bacon is cooked and the fish is firm and flaky, about 3 - 5 minutes on each side. Transfer to a platter, loosely tent with foil, and serve at once.

Random Ingredients: avocado,self raising flour,cider vinegar,mediterranean black olive,coriander seed,mustard seed,shallot
title: Avocado Salad - Neil Perry
ingredients: 4 avocados | 250 g mixed salad greens ( i just used salad bibb lettuce. large lettuce leaves. ) | 2 large shallots, finely chopped | 400 g sliced mediterranean olives | 40 g mustard seeds | 80 g ground coriander seed | 35 g self-raising flour
instructions: Peel, pit and slice avocados lengthways. Mix together all ingredients and place into a large bowl. Sprinkle with coriander. Cover and chill for 30 minutes. Preheat the barbecue for a high heat and then lightly oil the griddle for grilling. Remove the avocados from the bowl and place on the hot griddle and cook for about 5 minutes each side or until golden and cooked through.

title: Spanish Chicken and Cauliflower
ingredients: 2 1/2 pounds skinless, boneless chicken breast halves | 4 1/2 pounds spanish chorizo, cut into 1 1/2-inch thick slices | 1 package frozen cauliflower
instructions: Rinse chicken breasts under cold water and pat dry with paper towels. Place chicken breasts in a large saucepan and cover with water. Bring to a boil.

Random Ingredients: hot italian sausage,chicken bouillon granule,beef bouillon cube,sesame oil,orange peel
title: Italian Sausage and Orange Peel Soup
ingredients: 2 beef bouillon cubes | 3 teaspoons chicken bouillon granules | 2 tablespoons sesame oil | 1 1/4 lbs sweet italian sausage | 2 oranges, peel of
instructions: Place the bouillon, sesame oil and the sausage into a large saucepan. Heat over low heat and simmer for 15 minutes, depending on the thickness of your sausage. Remove the sausage and set aside. Add a few tablespoons of the reserved cooking liquid into a blender and blend on high speed, scraping the sides and bottom of the container while the mixture is hot. Strain the pureed broth through a fine sieve and return to the pan. Return the strained solids to the pan. Add the orange peel and remove from heat. Reheat, adjust seasonings to taste and serve.

title: Border Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1 package farfalle pasta | 1/2 cup dry red wine | 1 package sliced bibb lettuce | 4 tablespoons chili powder
instructions: Place farfalle into a large pot with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil, cook 3 minutes, and drain. In a large bowl, toss with wine, lettuce, and chili powder. Chill in the refrigerator for 30 minutes or up to 2 days before serving.

Random Ingredients: meatball,pumpkin puree,phyllo dough,cooking tapioca,great northern bean,tamari,caper
title: Chef John's Pumpkin Pizza Pie
ingredients: cooking tapioca | 14 ounces pumpkin puree | 14 ounces great northern beans | 14 ounces frozen meatballs, thawed | 8 sheets fresh phyllo dough | 2 teaspoons capers, drained | 2 teaspoons tamari, soy sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Spray a baking sheet with cooking spray. Prepare quick bake according to package instructions, then spread tapioca out evenly onto the sheet. Bake until lightly browned and fragrant, 10 to 15 minutes, then remove from oven to cool completely on baking sheet. Coat a large, non stick skillet over medium heat with cooking spray, then place pumpkin into the skillet and heat through to a bubbling point. Add beans and meatballs, then stir in the 2 sheets of phyllo dough, then cover and bake until phyllo dough begins to soften and fibers of phyllo begin to soften, about 15 minutes. Remove from heat, transfer to a large bowl, and spread out meat mixture into an even rectangle. Sprinkle top of dough with capers, and top with an even layer of capers. Sprinkle bottom crust with soy sauce and a drizzle of tamari, and cut into wedges to serve.

Random Ingredients: barley,red potato,purple onion,hamburger,red chilies,lettuce leaf,garlic salt,chuck
title: Hot Beef and Potato Salad
ingredients: 4 medium red potatoes | 1/2 lb hamburger | 1 pinch garlic salt | 4 large purple onions ( sliced thin ) | 1/8 cup barley | 3 chopped red chilies ( hot or mild ) | 4 medium red hot red chilies | 4 -8 lettuce leaves | 4 -8 slices medium hamburger | 4 -8 slices medium hamburger
instructions: Prepare your salad dressing by combining the ingredients minus garnish greens. When ready to serve, rinse your potatoes through a clean, damp towel then slice on the diagonal into large chunks. Add to your dressing, toss well then let stand for 25 minutes or longer to allow the flavors to combine.. In a pan add a little oil, a pinch of garlic salt and red chilies. Pan fry your potato slices until you brown them on both sides, remove them and set aside. Add remaining oil to the pan and sauté your onions until they cook down. Add the bacon and sauté. Drain grease from the pan, add back the potato chunks and mix with onion and bacon. Serve with some of the lettuce leaves tossed until they are well coated, top with your salad and enjoy.

title: Saffron Beef With Saffron-Chive Sauce
ingredients: 1 2 lbs beef flank steak | 6 cups milk | 4 tablespoons green chili, fresh, chopped | 3/4 teaspoon hungarian sweet paprika | 2 links saffron threads or 2 tablespoons dried saffron | 4 cloves garlic, peeled & crushed | 2 tablespoons fresh chives, chopped
instructions: Cut beef into 1 cubes. Place milk, chilies, paprika, saffron threads, garlic, and chives in large pot, and simmer slowly until desired thickness is achieved. Remove beef from milk and saute in remaining fat for 8 - 10 minutes, then return all to pot. Add sauce to desired thickness and simmer slowly for 1 hour or more, stirring occasionally.

Random Ingredients: salmon,green pepper,mustard powder,sesame oil,ketchup,beef sirloin steak
title: Sliced Beef Jerky
ingredients: 1 lb salmon, cut into chunks | 2 lbs beef sirloin steaks | 1/2 cup green pepper, sliced | 2 tablespoons mustard powder | 1/2 cup ketchup | 1/4 cup sesame oil
instructions: Place salmon in a large bowl. Cut the beef steak into long strips, about 3 inches long. Arrange beef over salmon. Combine remaining 2 ingredients, pour over beef, and chill.

title: Tiella's Hot Daube
ingredients: 1 whole baby bok choy or 2 bunches baby bok choy | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace | 1 -2 bay leaf | 1/2 vanilla bean, split lengthwise | fresh basil ( optional )
instructions: Wash the bok choy. Trim any leaves from the leaves and top leaves with the stems cut off just below the eyes. Slice off the base and discard. Cut off the bottom and scrape out the seeds, then slice off the stem and discard. Cut the stalk part of the vanilla bean into thin strips. Rinse the bok choy leaves and remove the leaves. If using, add a little of the bean liquid to the bottom of the pan for extra flavor. Add the mace, bay leaf, and vanilla bean to the pan. Turn on the heat to medium high and allow to boil for about 5 minutes.

title: Tomato Crust Bread
ingredients: 1 loaf whole wheat bread, cut into 1/4 inch cubes | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt | 1 can baby grape tomatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Lightly oil a baking sheet. Place bread cubes in a bowl. Sprinkle with garlic salt. Turn bread cubes on the baking sheet. Bake at 350 degrees f for 2 to 4 minutes, or until bread cubes are golden brown.

title: Ginger Greek Yogurt
ingredients: 1 cup plain greek yogurt | 1/2 cup ginger-garlic paste | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
instructions: Pour greek yogurt into a large glass or plastic container. Top with ginger garlic paste. Whisk the vanilla extract and paprika together in a small bowl, and pour over yogurt. Cover and chill. To serve, place in freezer for 1 hour or until yogurt is frozen.

Random Ingredients: seasoning salt,fast rising active yeast,pea,lima bean,taco sauce,manicotti,puff pastry,fish fillet
title: Fish Tacromatic
ingredients: 1 pizza crust, at room temperature | 1 can frozen peas | 2 tablespoons dried lima beans ( thawed ) | 1 fish fillet | 1 pinch seasoning salt | 2 teaspoons fast-rising active dry yeast | 1 -2 teaspoon taco sauce | 1 package frozen puff pastry for taco shells
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Place frozen peas in a microwave safe bowl and microwave for 4 - 5 minutes, on high, until thawed. Place the frozen beans in a medium bowl, stir in the lima beans, salt, yeast, and taco sauce. Dredge the fish fillet in the mixture, and then transfer to a cookie sheet lined with parchment paper. Bake in the preheated oven for 10 - 12 minutes, turning once. Slice the pizza crust into 4 squares, and place one on top of each other, and make several small slits on the top of the crust with a pizza cutter if desired. Bake for three to four minutes, or until crispy. Place one scoop of the taco mix on top of the pizza crust, and spread out evenly. Add a scoop of the peas on top of that, and place the second pizza on top. Slice the second piece of dough, and place it on top of the other piece. Cut the crust, place it in the oven, and cook for 12 - 15 minutes, or until the fish just flakes when tested with a fork.

title: Nana's Temptation of Home
ingredients: 1 red capsicum | 1/2 teaspoon monosodium glutamate ( optional )
