instructions: Cut red capsicum in half. Remove seeds and membrane from bell pepper half and place face down on absorbent paper. Dry peppers lightly in a hot oven or grill and set aside. Dry bell pepper well and rub with monosodium glutamate until evenly coated. Keep peppers in airtight container away from heat and light.

title: Chili Powder
ingredients: 1/2 cup vanilla ( solid ) | 2 sprigs fresh tarragon | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1/2 pinch dried tarragon | 2 whole plum, sliced thin | 6 ounces chipotle peppers, sliced ( the `` pre-chopped '' type ) | vanilla ice cream
instructions: Combine all ingredients except ice cream, except ice cream, in a heavy medium saucepan.

title: Linguine With Basil
ingredients: 14 ounces linguine | 6 -8 fresh basil leaves, sliced | 2 green apples, peeled and cut into large chunks
instructions: Cook linguine in simmering salted water according to package directions. While linguine cooks, place basil and apples into a salad bowl or skillet or pan sprayed with cooking spray. To save time, toss with cooked linguine.

Random Ingredients: onion powder,chili paste garlic,habanero chile pepper
title: Habanero Chile Marinade or Hot Sauce
ingredients: 4 habanero chile peppers, stems and seeds removed | 2 tablespoons chili paste with garlic | 1 tablespoon onion powder
instructions: Place habeneros in a large container. Mince haberos. Stir together haberlos, sauce, chili paste, and onion powder. Marinate in refrigerator for 30 minutes, or overnight, until flavors blend.

title: Kolokurian Sauce (Sauce for Vegetables)
ingredients: 1 head fresh coriander leaves ( the larger the stalks the sauce ) | 4 tablespoons sweet sweet and sour sauce | 1 teaspoon italian seasoning
instructions: Chop coriander leaves into small pieces. Place in a medium saucepan with sweet sour sauce and italian seasoning. Place over medium high heat and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer 10 minutes. Serve over vegetables.

Random Ingredients: baking potato,rum extract,vegetable oil cooking spray,ham steak,walnut,peanut oil
title: Pate' #1
ingredients: 4 medium baking potatoes, peeled and cut into quarters | 4 tablespoons walnut spreadable oil cooking spray | 4 ham steaks | 4 ounces roasted salted peanuts, chopped fine | 2 tablespoons light rum extract or 2 tablespoons rum extract | 1/2 cup walnuts, chopped
instructions: Place potatoes, walnut spread and oil in a sprayed baking dish. Add salt and pepper to taste. Bake at 400 degrees f for 30 minutes, covered. Allow to cool 10 minutes then cut into quarters. Prepare grill for direct preparation of ham. Place ham steaks on preheated grill. Sprinkle with peanuts. Grill for about 3 to 5 minutes on each side, turning once, or until ham is medium rare. Pour rum over ham and serve at once.

title: Tacique Smoked Ham
ingredients: 3 -4 tablespoons smoky ham ( or any other smoked deli ham ) | 1/2 cup ripe olives, sliced | 2 -3 chipotle chiles de arbol, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Preheat broiler or grill. Slice the ham into long, thin pieces about 1/2 inch square, about 2 inches long. Spread a layer of cheesecloth over a large baking sheet. Sprinkle the ham with the chilies, if using. Place the baking sheet under the broiler/grill for a few moments only to lightly brown the cheesecloth. Remove the baking sheet from the broiler/grill and remove the cheesecloth. Spread the ham with the cheese mixture. Return to the broiler or grill to lightly brown the cheese, this time just a few moments closer to burning. Slice to serve. Can be served hot or cold. Can be frozen.

Random Ingredients: orzo,coffee bean,shiitake mushroom,apple cider vinegar,pineapple chunk,romaine lettuce,grain white rice
title: Apple-Bavarian Stuffed Rice With Orzo
ingredients: 2 cups uncooked long-grain white rice | 4 cups pineapple chunks, drained ( reserve juice ) | 1/2 cup orzo ( cooked ) | 1 cup unsweetened pineapple chunks ( reserved pineapple juice ) | 5 ounces shiitake mushrooms, coarsely chopped ( reserve liquid ) | 6 dried shiitake mushrooms, reconstituted and chopped ( reserve liquid ) | 3/4 cup coffee beans | 1 tablespoon packed fresh romano cheese or 1 tablespoon shredded parmesan cheese, if desired | 1 tablespoon apple cider vinegar
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions. Drain rice & rinse under cold water to cool. Remove stem & roughly chop. Set aside 4 cups of rice. Put in large bowl & mix with orzo, 1 reserved tomato juice & pineapple juice. Using floured hands, shape rice mixture into a cylinder about 2 inches thick. Wrap tightly in plastic wrap & refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or up to 2 days. Remove orzo from refrigerator & carefully transfer wrapped rice to a baking sheet or large bowl. Use fingers to lightly press orzo into rice shapes with your fingers. Heat about 1 tablespoon of the reserved tomato juice in a large sauce pan until just bubbling. Add 2 cups water or enough to cover rice, plus 4 tablespoons more water if necessary. Stir in 4 ounces of the shaved orzo & about 2 teaspoons of the orzo soaking liquid. Bring to boil, reduce heat & continue to cook over low heat, uncovered, for about 25 minutes or until liquid is absorbed & orzo is tender. Carefully remove pan from heat, uncover, & let stand, covered, for 10 minutes. Stir in remaining tomato juice & remaining orzo soaking liquid. Sprinkle with remaining 1/4 cup orzo soaking liquid, then top with cheese. Cover tightly & let stand for 10 minutes. Enjoy note,. For variety & texture, or more flavor, sprinkle with more orzo soaking liquid before serving. Note, for a more mellow flavor, use 1/2 tsp of dried shiitake mushrooms. For a firmer flavour, stir in 1/2 tsp dried shiitake mushrooms. For a spicier taste, stir in 1/4 tsp ground cloves or a few dashes of ground black pepper. Note, if desired, use a combination of dried shiitakes and rehydrated pineapple chunks or orange segments.

Random Ingredients: olive oil,spring onion,purpose flour,salt,yellow bell pepper,flour,pasta noodle
title: Peppers, Onions and Focaccia
ingredients: 8 ounces dry pasta noodles | 2 tablespoons olive oil, plus | olive oil, for cooking pasta | 1 large yellow bell pepper, halved and thinly sliced | 2 spring onions, sliced into rings | 2 1/2 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 2 tablespoons plain all-purpose flour | 4 tablespoons olive oil | 1/2 teaspoon salt
instructions: Cook pasta in boiling water according to packet instructions. Meanwhile, heat the olive oil in a frying pan over medium heat. Add the onion rings and fry gently until soft and lightly coloured. Add the bell pepper rings and fry for a few minutes more. Drain the pasta and add to the onion mixture. Add the flour and mix well. Drain the pasta and add to the mixture. Mix well and divide between 4 large frying dishes. Bake in a preheated oven on 200oc/400of for about 15 minutes, or until puffed and golden.

title: Easy-Peppered Fruit Pastries
ingredients: 1 can mangoes, cut in half ( with seeds in if you want your fruit to's own') ( optional ) | 2 sheets phyllo pastry | sun-dried tomato oil, for drizzling if you want this
instructions: Preheat oven to 400f degrees. Place mangoes with seeds in a bowl with a fork, mix well, and set aside. Brush the bottom half of each sheet of phyllo pastry lightly with dried cut sun dried tomatoes and drizzle lightly with a little sun dried tomato oil. Place 1 sheet of phyllo pastry in a bowl of cold water and set on a clean counter with some damp cloth cloth on your damp cloth. Spray pastry with a dry, nonstick spray or oil, and lightly sprinkle with a little sun dried tomato oil. Put 1/2 of the fruit in the center of the phyllo, leaving about 1/4 of an inch of room uncovered on each side, then place another 1/3 of fruit on top. Brush the pastries with a little sun dried tomato oil. Place the top of the phgyllo pastry over the top and fold the left side with the phyllo pastry over the top and sides of the phyllo pastry. Fold the left side with the phyllo pastry over the bottom and up the left side. The top left, too, and the left should still be exposed. Brush with a little sun dried tomato oil, and place on a baking sheet, or put in an 8 circle on a cookie sheet. Cut into 4 wedges, or 6 triangles if your tray doesn't have enough. Bake for 35 minutes or until golden brown. Let cool for 10 minutes on wire rack before cutting.

title: Brats With Brats and Garlic - Crock Pot
ingredients: 12 bratwurst | 1 1/2 cups margarita mix
instructions: Put brats into the bottom of a 3 1/2 or 4 quart crock pot. Combine margarita mix with garlic mix and pour over brats. Cover and cook on low for 7 - 9 hours or on high for 4 - 5 hours.

title: Sweet Potato Medley
ingredients: 2 cups grated peeled sweet potato ( about 3/4 of a large or small head of cabbage ) | 2 tablespoons pimento-stuffed canned pimento peppers ( drained and coarsely chopped ) | 1 tablespoon maple syrup | 2 tablespoons coarsely chopped kalamata olives
instructions: Cook the sweet potato in boiling water for 18 minutes or until tender. Drain.

title: Mountain Rice
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef ( or ground turkey ) | 1 jar cherry tomatoes, cut in halves | 1/4 cup coarse pearl barley, soaked in water and drained | 1 teaspoon garam masala | 1 apple, diced ( optional )
instructions: Heat wok, add oil and then ground beef. Brown ground beef with tomatoes, adding remaining ingredients and cook until barley is tender and liquid is absorbed.

Random Ingredients: italian seasoning,confectioner ' sugar,pork loin,mace,fennel seed,tea,asiago cheese,soymilk
title: Pork Loin of Asiago, Mace and Asiago Cheese
ingredients: 1 lb boneless pork loin, trimmed to be 1-inch thick | 2 cups soymilk | 1 cup italian sausage'n sausages-and-sausage spread ( like parma ham ) | 2 cups confectioners'sugar | 1 tablespoon italian seasoning | 1 1/2 teaspoons fennel seeds | 1 teaspoon mace, ground | 1 1/2 cups asiago cheese, shredded
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Cut pork into 3/4 thick slices, 1/4 thickes. Mix soymilk and sausage spread. Place slices of pork in a 1 cup glass baking dish. Spoon meat mixture over the pork, sprinkle with italian seasoning, fennel seeds and mace. Cover and bake for 30 minutes. Uncover and bake for additional 20 minutes and remove cover. Continue cooking until pork is cooked through. Remove from oven and mix together the shredded cheese. Serve with warm bread.

title: Ancho Marinade Steak With Ancho Chilies
ingredients: 4 ancho chilies, stemmed | 1 tablespoon dried marjoram | 1 tablespoon ground ancho chilies or 1 tablespoon dried pasilla chilies | 1 tablespoon lemon juice and zest | 2 tablespoons margarine or 2 tablespoons olive oil | 1 1/2 teaspoons poultry seasoning
instructions: Place each ancho chile, marjoram, ancho chilies, lemon juice, margarine, or olive oil into a zip top bag and marinate 12 - 24 hours, turning frequently. Remove meat from refrigerator 15 minutes before marinading again. Coat grill with nonstick cooking spray and place ancho chilies on grill, cooking 4 - 6 minutes.

Random Ingredients: italian plum tomato,ricotta cheese,pink grapefruit,extra sharp cheddar cheese,cornmeal,cooking oil
title: Grapefruit Polenta
ingredients: 1 cup stoneground cornmeal | 1 cup leftover polenta or 1 cup polenta | 1 pound italian plum tomatoes | 1 pound extra-sharp cheddar cheese, grated | 2 tablespoons cooking oil | 1 pink grapefruit, cut into wedges
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Spread cornmeal on a rimmed baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until golden, 30 to 45 minutes. In a saucepan, combine the polenta, tomatoes and cheese and bring to a simmer over medium high heat. Simmer until thick and the flavors have blended, about 10 minutes. Dip some of the tomato wedges into the cornmeal. Place into a serving dish and cool, about 20 minutes before serving.

title: Ginger-Tomato Dressing
ingredients: 1/4 cup tomato juice | 1/4 cup red wine vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon finely minced ginger | 1 small serrano pepper, minced | 2 teaspoons minced fresh parsley
instructions: Combine ingredients in a jar with a lid or tightly sealed lid. Shake well to combine. Chill several hours before using.

Random Ingredients: butter bean,sugar,mexican cheese,sharp cheddar cheese,paprika,sage,black bean,french bread
title: Cuban Sandwiches
ingredients: 3 tablespoons unsalted butter beans, soaked overnight, drained and rinsed | 1 1/2 cups drained canned black beans, rinsed | 1 tablespoon finely chopped fresh california sun-dried tomatoes or 1 tablespoon snipped sun-dried tomato | 1/4 teaspoon dried sage | 1/4 teaspoon paprika | 1 tablespoon granulated sugar | 1/4 cup shredded reduced-fat sharp cheddar cheese | 8 slices low-fat french bread, toasted and cut in half crosswise ( about 6 inches in diameter )
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Cook beans, stirring to combine, in a 2 to 3 quart heavy saucepan over medium heat.

title: Burger Salad
ingredients: 1/2 box couscous | 4 stalks celery, chopped | 4 -5 leaves iceberg lettuce, shredded | 1 tablespoon fish sauce
instructions: Sauté celery and fish sauce in oil until soft. Add couscous, and cook. Add lettuce leaves and heat through. Cool for a few minutes. Chill and serve over salad.

title: Clams and Apples (Tapas)
ingredients: 3 apples, very ripe | 100 g pickled shelled clams | 1/2 teaspoon fresh epazote, chopped | 1 dozen bocconcini ( small balls )
instructions: Remove seeds from peaches and discard the stones on the peel. Using a peeler, remove the peel on an angle, leaving a 2 cm thick shell at the base of each peach with a few small holes. Cut the peaches into 1 cm cubes and place in a deep frying pan. Cut an x with scissors into half a inch width of paper. Drain the clams, reserving shells. Using a slotted spoon, remove any open bits with the peel. Discard any clams that remain. Put the peaches into the hot pan and stir once or twice. Add the epazote and toss to combine. The mixture should be quite dry. Add the reserved shell peaches and stir well to coat them with the contents of the pan. Cover and simmer gently for 20 minutes. Uncover, add the bocconcini and toss again. Serve immediately.

title: Couscous Lasagna (Yogurt Cheese)
ingredients: 8 lasagna noodles | 1 container plain yogurt | 1 package couscous, heated
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Place lasagna noodles on a baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until tender, about 20 minutes. Remove and allow noodles to cool. When cool, remove the soft noodles to a strainer or colander that has been coated with cooking spray. Place noodles on a serving board. Rinse with cool water, and drain. In a large bowl, mix yogurt and couscous using a fork. Cover the noodles with yogurt mixture. Spray a 9x13 inch baking dish with cooking spray. Layer noodles on the dish with the yogurt cheese mixture. Pour remaining yogurt cheese mixture over noodles. Garnish with parsley. Bake in the preheated oven until bubbly and cheese is browned and brown on top, about 30 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes before serving.

title: Tomato Cocktail Sauce
ingredients: 2 cans tomato juice, chilled | 3 tablespoons steak sauce | 1 teaspoon garlic paste, minced ( or crushed )
instructions: Serve over ice.

title: Traditional Japanese Style Noodles
ingredients: 300 g meat ( mince ) | 150 g carrots ( cut into 2 cm lengths ) | 1 lebanese cucumber ( cut into 6 cm lengths ) | 2 vegetable bouillon cubes | 1 tablespoon sake | 1 tablespoon brandy
instructions: Take a heavy pan or wok and heat it in its own fat on medium heat. Cut a slit lengthwise down the center of the lebanese cucumber and take one slice of this and cut it lengthwise in four pieces. Remove this slice after 5 mins, keep it aside. Now cut mince meat into small pieces. Take the pan, heat it on medium heat and add the carrot and meat. You can leave it on medium heat for a few minutes. Turn off heat. Add a little bit of kikkoman teriyaki sauce. You need to mix it well to prevent lebanese cucumber from turning brown. Remove the lid and turn the heat up to medium and cook for 5 minutes. You do not want to stir too much. It is best to cook it for a few minutes so that the oil does not burn in the pan.. Add vegetable boullion cube and kikkoman teriyaki sauce. Make sure it mixes well. Now, take the meat. Now, slice the cucumber lengthwise very thinly. Take one sliced cucumber and cut it in four pieces. Repeat steps 7 and 8, until all you have cut up your vegetables. You now have 4 sets of four. You have to keep an eye on this. Cut the meat. Make sure it is evenly divided. Place the meat onto the hot pan / wok and cook for 10 mins on high heat. Do not overcook in any way. You can cook it in batches if needed. Remove from heat and stir. You now have 4 layers of noodles. Each person gets different pieces. I use a small hand blender to process all the noodles in the wok/ pan. The idea is to add one noodle at a time to the wok as it is cooking. You should not be able to mix the sauce well in the pan/ wok/ the noodles. Add kikkoman teriyaki sauce, if you are using it. Add brandy. It should mix well. It should even turn a little pink. The goal is to give it a good flavor.. You do not have to let this go long because it will take longer to cook.. You can eat this all at once. You can keep it for a few days, if serving at room temperature. It keeps well in the fridge.

Random Ingredients: celery seed,vegetable oil cooking spray,coconut,chicken base,leek,cheese
title: Cocktail Onion Chicken Skewers
ingredients: 4 -6 small leeks | vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 lb skirt steak, cut into 1/4 inch pieces | 1 teaspoon coconut | 1 1/2 teaspoons celery seed | 1/4 cup grated cheese
instructions: Trim any dark spots from leeks, then cut into 1/2 inch lengths. Cut each leek lengthwise in half lengthwise, then cut crosswise into 1 inch pieces. Spray a shallow dish with cooking spray, and place the leeks in the dish, then stir in some oil. Cover, and refrigerate for 30 minutes. Heat a grill or grill pan to medium. Thread the chicken, weaving each piece between your hands as it cooks, until very well browned and no longer pink inside, about 4 to 5 minutes per side. While the chicken is cooking, stir together the coconut, celery seed, and cheese in a small bowl and brush on the skewers. Continue to turn skewers, brush with the coconut mixture, cook until the kebabs have been heated through and the coconut has turned a light golden brown, 1 to 2 minutes.

title: Fish 'n' Spuds
ingredients: 1 teaspoon lemon rind, finely grated | 1/2 teaspoon onion salt | 1/8 teaspoon fresh lemon rind, finely grated | 1 lb fish fillet, boned and butterflied | 1/2 lb waxy potato | 10 ounces cottage cheese | 1/4 cup tea
instructions: Mix all ingredients, except cottage cheese, potato, tea and fish, and marinate meat over night or at least 8 hours. Boil potatoes until tender. Cut potatoes into 1 1/2 by 3 long sticks and dip them into boiled potatoes. Set potatoes on a parchment lined baking sheet in a 375 degree oven for 15 minutes. Turn potatoes over and bake 5 - 10 minutes longer or until golden.

title: Watermelon Chutney Salad
ingredients: 2 cups cubed, seeded cucumber | 3 cups cubed, seeded mango chutney | 1 cup mayonnaise | 1 1/2 cups watermelon, drained with the skin on | 1/4 cup italian parsley, chopped | 1/4 cup pineapple-infused brewed tea | 2 teaspoons grated lemon zest
instructions: Mix cucumber, chutney, mayonnaise, watermelon, chutney mix, italian parsley, pineapple flavored brewed tea, and lemon zest in a bowl. Cover bowl with plastic wrap in a layer of aluminum foil. Refrigerate for at least 2 hours to blend flavors.

title: Hot Chocolate Sandwich (No Eggs)
ingredients: 3 slices bread | 3 tablespoons chili paste | 3 tablespoons chili peppers, of your choice
instructions: Spread chili paste onto bread slices. Place cheese slice on top of chili paste. Garnish with chopped coriander leaves and chilies. Serve.

Random Ingredients: vanilla bean,chipotle pepper adobo sauce,chile pepper,walnut,lemon pepper,bourbon whiskey
title: Marinated Chipotle Pepper
ingredients: 1 lemon pepper | 3 chile peppers, seeded and chopped | 2 ounces chipotle peppers in adobo sauce, finely chopped | 1/4 cup bourbon whiskey | 1/4 cup chopped walnuts | 1 dash vanilla bean ( optional )
instructions: Finely grate the lemon peel. Rinse the chilies and finely chop, set a fine side. Combine all ingredients in a large sealable container with a lid. Mix well. Let mixture marinate in refrigerator one to two hours. Remove the cover, shake the container, strain the chipotle pepper mixture through a fine sieve for excess salt. Strain the resulting puree through a wire mesh sieve or several changes of cold water, discarding solids.

title: Beautiful Bowls (Hazelnut Cakes)
ingredients: 4 1/4 tablespoons hazelnuts | 4 ice cubes
instructions: Put hazelnuts in blender, add ice cubes, blend for 30 seconds or until well blended.

title: Faux Phyllo
ingredients: 1 package corn tortilla chips, coarsely chopped, or as needed | 1 1/2 cups alfalfa sprouts
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Spray an 11x7 inch baking dish with cooking spray. Blend tortilla chips with alfalfa sprouts in a food processor. Spread filling in the baking dish to within 3/4 of the edge. Bake in the preheated oven until filling is hot, about 50 minutes.

Random Ingredients: red cabbage,baking powder,chili flake,parmigiano reggiano cheese
title: Spicy Red Cabbage Coleslaw
ingredients: 1 head red cabbage, finely chopped ( about 300g ) | 4 ounces parmigiano-reggiano cheese, grated | red chili flakes | 1/2 teaspoon baking powder
instructions: Cook cabbage and place in a bowl, sprinkle with the cheese, and mix well. Sugar the vinegar, a splash of vinegar and chili flakes.

Random Ingredients: mustard seed,soya sauce,grain white rice,black bean,bread crumb,potato starch
title: Black Bean Risotto
ingredients: 2 cans black beans, rinsed and drained | 1/4 cup chopped potato starch | 4 tablespoons soya sauce | 4 tablespoons dry bread crumbs | 2 teaspoons mustard seeds | 1 teaspoon bread crumbs
instructions: Stir together the black beans, potato starch, soya sauce, dry bread crumbs, mustard seeds and bread crumbs in a bowl. Divide mixture evenly in two equal portions. Flatten one portion into a flat shape and sprinkle with one teaspoon of bread crumbs to color the top. Repeat with other portions. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place rissotto on a cookie sheet. Bake for 10 to 15 minutes, or until golden brown.

title: Curry Vinaigrette
ingredients: 1 lb vinaigrette dressing | 3 tablespoons mirin | 3 tablespoons dijon mustard or 3 tablespoons spicy brown mustard | 2 tablespoons grated romano cheese or 2 tablespoons parmesan cheese | 1/4 teaspoon curry powder
instructions: Combine all ingredients except salad dressing into a glass bowl. Cover salad dressing with plastic wrap and shake to blend. Pour vinaigrette over salad mixture and refrigerate salad until ready to serve.

title: Apricot Smoked Hash
ingredients: 1 kg red potatoes ( small ) | 25 g apricot jam | 1/2 teaspoon black pepper powder | 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg
instructions: Pre heat the grill to hot, place red potatoes and apricot jam in a baking dish and place in it over a moderate heat. Smash with a fork, mix in pepper powder and nutmeg, pour this onto the hash, spreading with a spatula until all the ingredients are evenly used. Grill for 3 - 5 minutes or until golden and crispy.

Random Ingredients: dark sesame oil,pepperoni,beef brisket,icing sugar,sun tomato oil,cream mushroom soup
title: Quick Beef Brisket
ingredients: 1 beef brisket, fat trimmed | 1 can cream mushroom soup | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil | 1 tablespoon icing sugar | 1 1/2 tablespoons shredded pepperoni, drained | 3 tablespoons sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained
instructions: Place brisket in a 10x15x1 inch roasting pan. Mix soup, sesame oil, icing sugar, pepperoni and sun dried tomatoes. Pour over brisket. Cover and let stand 3 hours or until fat is tender. Roast uncovered, in a preheated oven, in a 325 degree f oven, basting periodically with soup mixture, until tender when pierced with a fork and fork and an instant read thermometer inserted in center registers 135 degrees f, about 1 1/2 hours. Note, if using a gas grill, cook brisket on the rack of the electric grill or in a foil lined roasting pan on the preheated rack. Set rack aside and allow to rest for 10 minutes before carving.

title: Chili Garlic Roasted Lamb
ingredients: 1 tablespoon chili paste | 1 tablespoon baking cocoa | 1 tablespoon dried marjoram | water chestnut | 4 pieces lamb, leg | 45 g cherry tomatoes ( optional )
instructions: Place ingredients with 2 - 3 tbsp of flour in a bowl and mix with hands to combine well. Wash lamb and pat dry. Heat oven to 160c/375f/gas in a roasting pan on the hob place lamb on top of the flour mixture, and pour over enough water to come about 2/3 way up the side of the lamb. Leave to rest in there for 30 minutes. Place in oven for 2 hours or till lamb has cooked, turning lamb twice throughout cooking. Pour roasted chilli paste and marjoram into a bowl then add a little water to give a thick consistency for the sauce. Taste and add sugar if desired, then serve with warm roast chicken breast and steamed spinach and red cabbage.

Random Ingredients: chicken wing,poblano pepper,red wine vinegar,kalamata olive,swiss chard,udon noodle,hazelnut,beef brisket
title: Maurice's Hot Dogs for Two!
ingredients: 8 chicken wings ( i prefer the flap of the whole bag, but feel free to use a large bag ) | 1/4 cup red wine vinegar, white and light green grape juice juice | 2 teaspoons hazelnuts ( i prefer to grind a bit of hazelnuts, but nutmeg works as well also ) | 14 ounces beef brisket ( can use more, if it has the fat ) | 1/2 lb swiss chard, cleaned and cut in 1 or 2 thin ribbons | 1/2 lb udon noodles | 8 poblano peppers | 8 kalamata olives
instructions: Remove skin and fat from the beef brisket.. Remove bones from the beef and slice across the grain into long thin strips. If you're using boneless brisket slice it diagonally into very thin slices. If you're not using a beef flank steak it should be sliced 1/4 inch thick. Place the chicken wings and red wine vinegar in a saucepan, and stir in the juice of 1/4 cup or red wine vinegar. Bring to a boil over medium heat, turn off heat, and simmer for 10 minutes, or until thickened slightly. Add the hazelnuts. In a separate pot, cook the udon noodles according to package directions. Drain, and toss in a clean kitchen towel. Cut the chard crosswise into 1/4 inch wide, 2 inch long strips. Wash the chard crosswise in very hot water. Add salt to taste. Remove stems from chard leaves. Trim off woody parts.. Cut chard crosswise into 6 sections, then separate the sections and set aside. Slice the bell peppers crosswise. Remove the seeds, if desired. Slice stems into 1/4 inch wide, 2 inch long strips. Heat up the grill. Place the poblanos skin side down over medium hot coals or broiling element over medium heat. Cook until the flesh has turned slightly black in places and is starting to curl when the edge of the pepper is lightly touched. Put the pepper strips in a bowl covered with a damp paper towel. Slice off just the very top 1/4 inch of the stems before slicing. Don't slice all the way through the pepper, but slice through the stem end, and cut across the pepper, just the stems. Slice the entire pepper into 1/4 inch thick half moons, removing the peelings before slicing the pepper quarters into thin slices. Drain the spaghetti on a colander, then combine with the chard. Add salt and pepper to taste. To serve, place each hot dog on a plate. Divide noodles among the hot dogs. Spoon on the beef sauce to serve.

title: Carambola Stuffed Salmon
ingredients: 4 ounces fresh white breadcrumbs | 2 ounces carambola | 1 salmon fillet
instructions: Cut skin from fish on outside of fillet.

Random Ingredients: pork,walnut,taco seasoning mix,mexican oregano,white vinegar,vegetable shortening
title: Mexican Walnuts
ingredients: 2 pounds ground pork | 1/2 cup distilled white vinegar | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 1/4 cup chopped walnuts | 1 teaspoon dried mexican oregano | 1 tablespoon vegetable shortening
instructions: In a large skillet, saute the ground pork in the vinegar until crumbly. Add taco seasoning mix, walnuts, oregano and shortening. Mix well. Place the pork mixture in a large casserole dish or loaf pan and bake in refrigerator at least 1 hour, stir every 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Oriental Mayo-Pour Barbecue
ingredients: 12 ounces marinated pickled mandarin oranges | 1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil | 32 ounces low fat soymilk | 6 tablespoons chopped fresh dill or 3 tablespoons chives | 1/4 cup beer | lettuce ( optional ) | extra virgin olive oil, as desired, as desired ( optional )
instructions: Place a mandarin orange in a bowl. Drizzle about 2 tablespoons oil over the orange and gently stir in with hands to evenly coat fruit. Let sit 15 minutes or longer until all is soft and mushy. Peel, pit and roughly chop mandarin oranges. Put into a food processor or blender, along with remaining ingredients except the olive oil and pulse until smooth. With motor running, add olive oil. Refrigerate until ready to serve. Serve with optional lettuce, olive oil and/or additional soy yogurt.

title: Rice & Garlic Pasta With Arrugi Sauce
ingredients: 1 tablespoon garlic, chopped | 1 cup arborio rice | 3/4 cup virgin olive oil | hot sauce, to taste | 3 cups cooked zesty linguine
instructions: In a medium saucepan, bring 2 tbls. Of olive oil to a boil. Add the garlic, cook 1 minute. Add the rice and stir over medium heat until coated with oil. Add hot sauce, stir. Stir. Lower heat. Cover tightly. Simmer 20 minutes. Remove from heat. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: dijon mustard,garlic red chile paste,thyme,mint sprig,marinara sauce,onion,cherry tomato
title: Cherry Tomato-Yardin Sauce
ingredients: 25 grape tomatoes | 1/4 cup dry minced onion | 3/4 tablespoon dijon mustard | 1/2 tablespoon minced dried marjoram leaves | 1 tablespoon garlic and red chile paste | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh thyme | 1 jar cherry tomatoes, halved | fresh mint sprigs, for garnish
instructions: Place the tomatoes on a plate. Mix together the onion, dijon and marjoram leaves, garlic pepper paste, thyme and chile paste. Pour over the tomatoes. Serve with the cherry tomatoes. Garnish with mint.

title: Tahini Baba Ganoush
ingredients: 2 potatoes starch ( cornstarch ) | 6 eggs ( for frying ) or 6 whole eggs ( for frying ) | 1 cup confectioners'sugar ( for dusting ) | 2 tablespoons ketchup | 1 cup tahini | 2 tablespoons pure tahini
instructions: Start with 1/2 cup of confectioners' sugar. Then, 1 cup of ketchup. Mix all these together in a large bowl. Then add 3 whole eggs to the bowl and mix them together with your fingers. Set aside and refrigerate for an hour or so. If it's time, it should be time to get comfortable with your hands. Heat oil in an 8 inch frying pan for frying. While still hot, dip the eggplant in the egg batter, then in the potato starch to coat, and then back in the potato starch to coat. Deep fry in batches until golden brown. Remove and dust with confectioners' sugar. Serve drizzled with toum sauce or tahini.

title: Pumpkin Stuffed Beef Wraps
ingredients: 1/2 kg stewing beef, cut into thin strips | 1/2 kg daikon | 2 kg pumpkin puree | 100 g chopped pecans | 2 tablespoons mango chutney | 8 large lettuce leaves | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom ( optional ) | 150 g finely chopped pecans | 250 g coarsely chopped lettuce leaves
instructions: First, prepare the marinade. Cut away and then slice off any very thick layer of rind from the daikon. Slice thinly on the diagonal. Combine the masala ingredients and rub onto the strips. Add in beef and allow to marinate in the fridge for at least 30 minutes, preferably overnight. If using the optional ingredients, soak pecans in hot water and press out as much water as possible. Grill or roast finely, about 10 minutes on each side. Slice diagonally on the diagonal. Set aside. To make the salad, heat 50g of the pumpkin puree in a heavy based pan. Add 1/2lb of the pecan nuts and allow to simmer for approximately 5 minutes. Add in the remaining ingredients and mix well. Serve with the meat, topped with the remaining pecan nuts.

title: Cabbage Crisco
ingredients: 1 tablespoon crisco shortening | 3 heads savoy cabbage
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Place the crisco in a large baking dish. Slice the savoy cabbage head into thick slices. Place them over the crisco. Add salt and pepper. Bake for 20 minutes in the preheated oven. Turn the oven off. Leave in there for another 20 minutes to crisp up the cabbage.

Random Ingredients: red onion,beef stew meat,pistachio nut,orange zest
title: Pistachio Beef
ingredients: 3 1/2 lbs boneless beef stew meat, cut in 1 1/2 x 1 1/2 inch strips | 1/2 cup finely minced small red onion | 3/4 cup chopped pistachio nuts | 2 teaspoons grated orange zest
instructions: In a bowl, combine beef with onion, pistachios, and orange zest. Let stand 5 minutes. Add enough water so beef mixture just barely covers. Heat to boiling, reduce heat, and simmer 1 hour. Remove beef from liquid. Remove onions. Place meat, and any accumulated juices in gravy pot. Cover and simmer 30 minutes. Discard onion, pistachios, and orange zest. Serve.

title: Couscous Salad
ingredients: 1 tablespoon all-purpose flour | 2 cups mixed salad greens | 1 cup yellow sweet pepper | 1 cup couscous, dry | 1/2 cup small vegetable pieces or 1/2 cup chopped cooked veggies
instructions: In a bowl, combine the flour and sugar. Add the vegetables.

Random Ingredients: tomato basil oregano garlic,phyllo pastry,corn flake,fish stock
title: Crispy Fish Rolls
ingredients: 3 cups fish stock | 1 cup corn flakes | 2 cups crushed corn flakes | 1 package frozen phyllo pastry sheets, thawed | 1 can diced tomatoes with basil oregano and garlic
instructions: In a large pot over medium high heat, stir together fish oil and stock. Stir in corn and cornflakes. Remove from heat. In a baking dish with a cover, place three phyllo sheets in the bottom of the dish. Cover with about 1/4 cup of the fish mixture and 1/4 cup of the crushed corn flakes. Repeat layers until all ingredients have been used, ending with fish flakes and some crushed cornflakes. Cover and refrigerate for about 30 minutes. Preheat an oven to 350 degrees f. Uncover phyllo sheets and brush with beaten egg. Bake in the preheated oven for 15 minutes. Remove from oven and turn oven to broil. Lightly spray or brush with olive oil. Place filo sheets on a baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven for 12 minutes. Turn over, brush with olive oil and broil, until golden and fish flakes are cooked through. Serve hot.

title: Pickled Fresh Vegetables (Kung Pao Kway)
ingredients: 12 ounces mixed fresh vegetables, sliced 1 inch to 1/8 inch thick | 1/2 cup vietnamese fish sauce or 1/2 cup light soy sauce | 2 teaspoons sugar
instructions: Place sliced vegetables in a large bowl. In a small mixing bowl, stir vietnamese fish sauce or light soy sauce and sugar until sugar is dissolved. Pour hot sauce over vegetables and toss until warm.

Random Ingredients: peppermint extract,cauliflower floret,carrot,pecorino romano cheese,pearl barley,pork shoulder,parsnip,celery rib
title: Italian Pesto and Barley Soup - 4 Weight Watchers
ingredients: 1/4 cup pearl barley | 1 1/2 lbs lean boneless pork shoulder, cut into 1-inch cubes | 2 celery ribs, coarsely chopped | 3 medium carrots, peeled, coarsely chopped | 1 medium parsnip, peeled, coarsely chopped | 1/4 cup fresh parsley, packed coarsely chopped | 1 teaspoon peppermint extract | 1/2 lb cauliflower floret, broken into florets
instructions: In a large dutch oven, combine the barley, pork, celery, carrots, parsnip, and parsley. Stir in the peppermint extract and bring to a boil. Reduce the heat and simmer, covered, for 2 1/2 hours, or until the pork is very tender. Remove the pot from the heat, cover, and let the broth stand, uncovered, for 20 minutes before serving. Remove the pork from the broth and set aside to cool slightly. Pour the cooled broth through a sieve into a bowl and reserve 1 cup of the remaining cup. Return the broth to the pot, bring to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer until the barley is tender, about 25 minutes longer. Taste and adjust the seasoning with salt, stirring occasionally,. In a serving bowl, combine the cauliflower florets with the reserved broth. Ladle the soup into bowls and serve.

title: Gramma Sayadia (Stuffed Baked Eggs)
ingredients: 4 slices bacon | 16 prawns | 2 egg whites | 3 tablespoons prawn pulp, drained
instructions: Place bacon on a tray, which has been lined with a cloth. Cut a slit lengthwise in each rasher and remove the core, intestines and intestines. Cut the rinds into 1/2 inch bits. Break the eggs into a bowl, put the egg whites into a small pan and a little water, stir, bring slowly to boil, stirring gently until it thickens and drops. Put a handful of egg into each rasher. Put the rims into a piping bag fitted with a 1/2 teaspoon of stuffing between each rasher. Turn the rims onto a metal foil covered tray. Bake in a 180 degree c oven for 15 minutes or until the shells are browned. Remove from the oven. Serve at once with a sauce or pickled beets.

Random Ingredients: water,bean sprout,lasagna noodle,marshmallow,double cream,dark chocolate,brown rice,brandy
title: Brown Rice Casserole With Brandy Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup brown rice | 1 1/2 cups water | 1/2 cup brandy | 300 g dark chocolate | 1 package shredded marshmallows | 1 1/2 cups double cream or 1 1/2 cups heavy cream | 9 lasagna noodles, sheets | 1/2 cup shredded dark chocolate
instructions: Heat first 3 ingredients in a pan, stirring until sugar has dissolved. Remove from heat and add brandy, marshmallows and half the cream, stirring to heat through. Pour over noodles and sprinkle with chocolate. Bake at 180oc for 20 minutes until set, then allow to stand for 5 minutes before cutting to serve. This is really good reheated the next day with the remaining cream and sprinkling a little of the shredded chocolate at the end.

Random Ingredients: jalapeno pepper,chicken breast half,soymilk,arborio rice,natural bran,mexicorn,molasses
title: Mexican Chicken & Rice
ingredients: 1/3 cup natural bran | 2 tablespoons molasses | 3 tablespoons jalapeno pepper, seeded and chopped | 2 boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 1/2 cup arborio rice | 1 1/2 cups non dairy milk | 1 can mexicorn, drained
instructions: In a saucepan, mix bran, molasses and jalapenos. Cut chicken into 1 inch cubes. Brown chicken over medium heat in a saucepan until lightly browned. Add rice and rice milk to the saucepan and stir. Cover, and reduce heat. Simmer 20 minutes. Stir in corn and mexicorn. Simmer 15 to 20 minutes longer.

Random Ingredients: cannellini,lemon zest,pizza dough,applesauce,white bread,pork chop,chili powder,molasses
title: Pork Schnitzel
ingredients: 1/2 cup white bread, crumbs | 2 tablespoons molasses | 1 tablespoon lemon zest, finely grated | 1 1/2 teaspoons chili powder | 3/4 lb thin pork chop | 1 can cannellini, drained well | 1/2 cup apple sauce ( i use ketchup ) | 1 1/2 cups pizza dough, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. In shallow casserole dish, combine bread crumbs, molasses, lemon peel, chili powder, pork chops and cannelini. Spread apple sauce over mixture. Sprinkle with remaining crumb mixture. Bake, uncovered, 15 to 20 minutes or until pork is cooked. Meanwhile, prepare dough. Turn dough out onto large surface. Pat into 15 inch circle. Top with pork, pancake side down. Gather sides and tuck under. Poke several holes in top with a fork. Cut each circle into 6 wedges and set aside. Return schnitzel to oven and bake until schnitzel is puffed and crisp and bread crumbs are golden, about 10 minutes longer.

title: Creamy Lime Rice
ingredients: 2 ounces basmati rice ( washed and drained ) | 2 tablespoons cream ( plain or sweet soured cream ) | 1 lime, rind of, finely grated
instructions: Place half the rice in a deep, heavy bottomed frying pan. Heat the cream and half the lime rind in a small saucepan until just boiling and then pour over the rice and stir until all the rice is coated with cream and lime rind.

Random Ingredients: french bread,coconut oil,bulgar wheat,chat masala,white mushroom,egg,alfredo sauce
title: Mushrooms Stuffed With Briam
ingredients: 250 g white mushrooms, cleaned & stems removed | 1 cup bulgar wheat | 2 eggs, separated | 1 tablespoon coconut oil | 6 small pieces french bread, crusts removed | 300 g ready made alfredo sauce | 1 tablespoon chat masala or 1 tablespoon mild curry powder | 3/4 cup creamy coconut oil
instructions: Cut the mushrooms in half, discarding the stems. Cook the wheat in boiling water for 7 minutes, then drain it, let cool for 1 minute, then mash the wheat well with a fork. Mix yolks in a bowl. Beat the egg whites until they form stiff peaks, and fold them into the wheat mixture. Divide the stuffing into 12 - 12 equal portions. Flatten the slices of bread lightly and then dip them in the egg white mixture. Drain, then lightly coat them with the coconut oil. Line a baking dish with bread slices. Fill half the slices of bread with this stuffing. Pile the stuffing in the middle of the bread slices. Cover this stuffing layer with the rest of the bread, spread with the alfredo, and top with the grated cheese and a sprinkle of chaat masala. Bake in a 180 degrees celcius oven. Eat as you would eat it but serve with a spoonful of cream cheese in the middle, if desired.

title: Cabbage Slaw
ingredients: 1 lb chayote, peeled, deseeded, chopped | 1/2 lb cabbage, shredded | 1/8 lb dried apricot jam | 1/8 lb smoked paprika or 1/8 lb smoked sweet paprika | 6 -12 juniper berries | black pepper | 1/8 lb maggi seasoning | 6 -8 tablespoons liquid smoke ( or other condiment )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small saucepan. Add enough liquid smoke to cover. Cover and simmer gently for 30 minutes or until heated through and vegetables are tender. Season with additional seasoning and pepper to taste.

Random Ingredients: grain white rice,dark brown sugar,baby bok choy,baking soda,loaf italian bread,tamarind juice,poultry seasoning,bay leaf
title: Sweet & Savory Bok Choy Soup
ingredients: 1 package loaf italian bread, crusts removed, cut into bite-size pieces | 1 1/4 cups water | 1 pound baby bok choy, peeled and cut into 1-inch pieces | 1 tablespoon dark brown sugar | 1 tablespoon dark brown sugar | 2 tablespoons tamarind juice, or more as needed | 1 tablespoon poultry seasoning, or to taste | 1/4 teaspoon baking soda | 1 bay leaf
instructions:
Preheat the oven's broiler and set the oven rack about 6 inches from the heat source. Cover a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Place the bread pieces in a large bowl of water, and let soak for 10 minutes. Mix the bread and water in a blender until they are the color of yellow grape juice, about 2 minutes. Reserve any remaining slices to add after the bread has soaked. Bring the bok choy and 1 1/4 cups water to a boil 
 ## Cooking instructions ##
 Stir in 1/4 pound of the sweet brown sugar, 1 tablespoon of dark brown sugar, 1 tablespoon of tamarind juice, poultry seasoning, and baking soda. Return the bok choy mixture to a boil, cover, and reduce heat to low. Poach the soup, stirring frequently, until the bok choy is tender and the broth is reduced by 3/4, about 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Wakame Salad
ingredients: 3/4 cup wakame seaweed | 1/3 cup apricot preserves | 1/4 peach, diced | 2 medium tomatoes, diced | 1 medium tomatoes, diced | 1/2 cup apricot preserves | 1 tablespoon tomato paste | 1 tablespoon corn oil
instructions: Soak the wakame in several cups of hot water until softened, about 30 minutes. Drain well. Transfer the wakame to a serving dish and drizzle with preserves. Sprinkle diced peach and diced tomato with diced tomato. In a small microwave safe bowl, combine the tomato paste with the corn oil. Microwave on high for one minute. Stir and microwave one minute longer, or until smooth. Pour the tomato tomato mixture over the wakame, stir, and serve.

title: Swiss Appetizer Prawns With Fruit and Chive S
ingredients: 1 lb prawns | 1 1/2 cups grated swiss cheese | 1/2 cup pitted dates | 1/2 cup dried cranberries | 2 tart apples, cored and thinly sliced
instructions: Boil the prawns in boiling water for a few minutes until pink, then drain and rinse. In a large bowl, mix the swiss cheese, dates, cranberries and apples.

Random Ingredients: chipotle chile,limeade concentrate,dark rum,colby monterey jack cheese
title: Grilled Cheddar-Monterey Jack Cheese Queso Dip
ingredients: 2 lbs colby-monterey jack cheese, shredded | 3 cans frozen limeade concentrate, thawed and squeezed to remove as much liquid as possible | 3 tablespoons dark rum | 2 -3 chipotle chiles, to taste
instructions: Heat grill to medium high heat, and lightly oil grate. Using two large sheets of aluminum foil, generously coat each piece of cheese with melted cheese. Arrange 2 to 3 slices of cheese in a 9x12 inch pan on work surface. Sprinkle a scant 1/2 teaspoon chipsotle chile over cheese. Arrange 3 or 4 chunks of cheese atop chile. Pour limeade concentrate over cheese, then sprinkle a scant 1/2 teaspoon chipotle chile over chile. Cover with aluminum foil. Grill cheese, cheese can quickly burn and turn black. Remove foil and continue grilling cheese until it is well and pleasantly chewy, 12 to 15 minutes. Turn off heat and add rum, remaining 1/2 teaspoon chipotle chile, and 1/3 cup lime juice. Serve warm with tortilla chips.

Random Ingredients: scotch bonnet pepper,pie shell,molasses,bean,beef broth,coconut juice,green lentil,baby spinach leaf
title: Thai Spiced Beef Lentil Soup
ingredients: 12 ounces frozen green lentils or 12 ounces brown lentils, rinsed well ( 1 lb ) | 2 cans beef broth | 3 tablespoons maple molasses or 3 tablespoons treacle | 2 cans baked beans ( i use bush's ) | 6 ounces baby spinach leaves | 14 -14 scotch bonnet peppers, minced ( remove ribs and seeds for less heat ) | 2 -3 cups canned low-fat coconut juice | 2 ready-made pie shells
instructions: Place everything but the baked beans in crock pan, add a little water and stir. Cook on medium heat for 1 hour stirring frequently to prevent sticking. Reduce heat if it looks dry. Stir in baked beans and simmer for 15 minutes over medium heat. Turn off heat and let cool, then stir in greens and serve.

title: Sausage and Cranberry Stew
ingredients: 1 large spanish onion, chopped | 1 lb bulk italian sausage | 8 ounces cranberry pieces | 1/2 cup spanish style chopped spinach, with stems | 1/4 teaspoon cumin | 2 ounces cubed cooked and frozen fatback meat
instructions: In a dutch oven brown sausages, onion and cranberries. Add spinach and cumin. Stir. Cover and simmer 30 - 40 minutes until thickened, stirring occasionally.

Random Ingredients: green olive,lime,caper,cooking spray,puff pastry,superfine sugar,serrano chile pepper,sea scallop
title: Spicy Scallops Bites
ingredients: cooking spray | 10 slices frozen puff pastry, thawed according to package directions, and cut into 12 squares per dough | 1/2 cup superfine sugar, plus additional for sprinkling | 1/2 cup green olives, pitted and sliced | 1/2 cup drained capers, rinsed and drained | 1/2 cup sliced green olives | 2 limes, juiced | 1 small serrano chile pepper, minced
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Coat 3 ovenproof ramekins with cooking spray. Cut each pastry square from center to bottom, and place in center of a large sheet of plastic wrap. Cover with another sheet of plastic wrap, and pound to flatten pastry with rolling pin, pressing seams to seal. Place the prawns on a work surface, and sprinkle each with 1/2 cup superfine sugar. Place 1/4 of the olives and capers in the center of each pastry square. Spoon in 1/2 of the prawn mixture. Sprinkle with 1/4 of the remaining olives and capers. Fold the four sides of the plastic wrap inward, and press corners together to seal. Place on a baking sheet, and refrigerate until firm, 15 to 20 minutes. Brush ramekins with olive oil, and set aside until ready to bake. Bake in the preheated oven until prawns are cooked through and golden brown, about 20 minutes. Drizzle with more sugar, if desired.

Random Ingredients: banana leaf,pork tenderloin,pesto sauce,cornish hen,cashew,garam masala powder
title: Pesto Pork Tenderloins With Bananas and Cornish Hens
ingredients: 4 cornish hens | 4 -6 firm fresh banana leaves, chopped | 16 -20 fresh basil leaves, chopped | pesto sauce | 4 -6 large firm tandoori-type hens | 1 lb pork tenderloin | 2 -3 tablespoons garam masala powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees fahrenheit. Place hens evenly apart in a large, deep roasting pan. Pound to 1/4 inch thickness. Place hens on board, and pound lightly to flatten. Lay hens on top of one banana leaf, and top with basil, and sprinkle with pesto sauce. Tuck ends around the hens, and tie with toothpicks. Arrange on rack in shallow roasting pan. Make garam masala sauce by combining 2 - 3 tsps. Water and 2 tsps. Cornish spices, and pour over the hens. Cover, and cook for 35 minutes. Turn hens onto serving platter, and serve with gravy or sauce.

title: Fig Jam & Baileys Truffles
ingredients: 1 lb fig jam | 1 tablespoon dried thyme sprigs ( optional ) | 1/2 cup baileys irish cream
instructions: Warm up the fig jam to boiling point using a strainer, heat the bahies if using. You need to keep a close eye on the mixture. When the heat is at boiling point, take off the heat and stir in the figs. Stir until the jam is completely smooth. Take off the heat and refrigerate for at least two hours, or until your finger leaves the trail of liquid at the bottom of the jar. When you're ready to use your truffle use a knife until you are able to remove the mixture to a bowl, or use your fingers to form truffle shapes. Place the bowl in upside down on your kitchen counter, and when it has cooled a little, dip your fingers in the warm fig jam. Then dip the fingers in the warm jam to coat the entire surface. The idea is to coat most of the surface. Place the truffles in a glass dish lined with parchment paper or plastic. Cover with plastic wrap and stash in the fridge until served. Store in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: grand marnier,chili flake,fish,thyme sprig,apple juice,chipotle chile,red wine,asiago cheese
title: Chili-Lavished Grilled Fish
ingredients: 1/3 cup apple juice | 1/3 cup dry red wine | 1 teaspoon snipped fresh thyme sprigs | 2 tablespoons grand marnier | 1 dried chipotle chile | 1/4 teaspoon chili flakes | 1 1/2 lbs skinned & boned firm white fish fillets | 1/3 cup grated asiago cheese
instructions: Combine apple juice, wine, thyme, grand marnier, chipotle chile and chili flakes in a large, nonreactive bowl, and stir until well combined. Add fish and toss to coat. Cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour, or up to 4 days. Let the fish sit at room temperature for 20 minutes before grilling. Preheat grill to medium high, or heat broiler to high. Lightly oil grill grate. Remove fish from marinade and arrange, flesh side down, side by side, on the grill. Grill fish, skin side up, until flesh flakes easily, about 5 - 6 minutes. Turn fish over, sprinkle with grated cheese, and close the lid. Cook until fish flakes easily with a fork, about 10 - 12 minutes longer. Serve fillets.

Random Ingredients: onion soup mix,nonstick cooking spray,tabasco sauce
title: Easy Baked French Onion
ingredients: 1 sweet onion with 8 ozs. fat, diced ( not that small onion or you won't really get it ) | 2 teaspoons onion soup mix ( wildtree onion soup mix ) | 1/2 teaspoon tabasco sauce
instructions: Spray a 3 1/2 quart baking dish with nonstick cooking spray. Mix all ingredients together including the dry onion soup mix. Spread evenly in the dish. Bake at 325 degrees for 45 - 50 minutes. The onions will be brown and crunchy.

title: Raspberry Quesadillas
ingredients: 2 tortillas, cut into 1-inch wide strips | 1 tablespoon ground coriander | 1/2 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1 teaspoon ground white pepper | 2 ounces frozen raspberries, thawed
instructions: Combine coriander, nutmeg and white pepper in a small bowl. Spread about 1/4 cup crumb mixture onto each tortilla and top with raspberries. Roll up and place, seam side down, in a skillet.

Random Ingredients: linguine,red pepper paste,red bell pepper,pita bread
title: Seared Pita Bread Pizzas With Roasted Red Pepper Peppers
ingredients: 12 ounces linguine or 12 ounces spaghetti, cooked | 1 jar roasted red peppers, drained and chopped | 1 -2 tablespoon red pepper paste or 1 -2 tablespoon bottled red pepper sauce | 8 slices pita bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Mix all ingredients in a large bowl. Cook pasta according to package directions. Spoon 1/2 cup pasta mixture onto bread slices and top with 1 - 2 teaspoons roasted red pepper peppers.

Random Ingredients: anchovy fillet,taco seasoning mix,cream,italian turkey sausage,asiago cheese,bay leaf
title: Homemade Taco Dip
ingredients: 1 can italian-style turkey sausage with casings | 1 packet taco seasoning mix | 1 bay leaf | 1/4 cup sour cream | 1/4 cup shredded asiago cheese | 2 tablespoons minced anchovy fillets
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Drain the casings from the sausage.

title: Guava and Ham Soup
ingredients: 3 large guavas | 3 cups low fat sour cream | 4 -5 tablespoons canola oil ( or more. oil is fine here ) | 1/8 teaspoon turmeric powder | 2 1/2 tablespoons diced ham or 2 1/2 tablespoons bacon | 1/2 cup finely diced celery | 1 green onion, finely chopped
instructions: Preheat a large, shallow soup pot on the burner and add the diced bacon. When crispy, remove the bacon, but keep a few slices so the fat remains in the pan, then throw the fat away if you don't want it. You can use something else if you like but don't use too much oil. Once the fat has solidified, drain out almost all of it. Add in the sour cream. Turn the heat up to medium, add in turmeric and stir well to combine. Add the diced ham or bacon, celery and green onion. Turn off heat and stir well. Note, soup bowls vary in their heat. Add 1 teaspoon oil to each bowl. Serve at once. This soup tastes best prepared 1/2 hours before serving. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: extra virgin olive oil,bacon,pearl barley,fruit,banana,pecorino romano cheese,fennel seed,cumin powder
title: Fennel Barley Risotto With Banana
ingredients: 1 tablespoon pure whole mixed fruit | 3/4 cup pearl barley, soaked for an hour ( or white and whole grains ) | 1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 300 g bacon, sliced thinly | 1/2 cup pecorino romano cheese, grated | 1/2 cup of shredded banana | 1/4 teaspoon fennel seed
instructions: Put the lentils in a bowl, then add the whole mixed fruit. Add salt and pepper to taste. Let sit for an hour. Drain the lentil mixture and put the drained soaked barley in a saucepan with a tight fitting lid. Cover with water. Bring to a boil on high heat, then simmer for 20 minutes, stirring frequently, until the barley is quite soft and the liquid has been absorbed. Meanwhile, heat the olive oil over medium heat in a separate pan. When the oil is very hot, add the cumin. Stir well and add the patted dry barley. Cook for about 2 minutes but do not stir too long that the mixture will release any oil. You can always turn off the heat later. Remove from the heat. When ready to serve, place a scoop of smoked bacon across the top of each bowl of risotto. Sprinkle with grated cheese and the sliced banana. Finally, scatter the fennel on top. Serve with slices of french bread. Serves two.

Random Ingredients: allspice,kraft pizza cheese,cardamom pod,curd cottage cheese,lemon,fennel bulb,yellow pepper
title: Low Calorie Pierogi Filling
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs small curd cottage cheese ( i use whole milk ) | 1 small yellow sweet pepper, chopped | 1 small fennel bulb, chopped | 1 can yellow ready-made prepared pizza cheese | 1/2 tablespoon ground cardamom pod | 1 large lemon, juice of | 1/2 teaspoon allspice
instructions: Drain liquid from can of the curd cottage cheese. Place drained cottage cheese in medium bowl and mash to a fine texture, set aside. In medium skillet, sauté chopped pepper with fennel in 1 tablespoon oil for 5 minute. Stir in drained curd cheese and remaining ingredients. Mix well. Do not let mixture boil. Put in a bowl, refrigerate for 1 hour serve warm.

title: Crispy Pear and Bamboo Shoot Biscuits
ingredients: 2 pears, peeled and finely shredded | 3 ounces canned bamboo shoots, diced | 1/4 teaspoon baking soda | 1 bunch fresh thyme | pepper and rosemary
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Combine shredded pears and chopped bamboo in large bowl. Cover with baking soda, then add thyme, pepper and rosemary and mix together. Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls onto a lightly greased sheet of aluminum foil. Bake in 400 F oven for 25 to 35 minutes or until crisp and golden brown.

Random Ingredients: hot red pepper flake,turmeric powder,stone dijon mustard,seasoning salt,vodka
title: Tasteful Russian Recipes on Gas Grill
ingredients: 20 -24 1/2 inches thick steel-cut dijon mustardstone speciality grill marks ( see the photos below ) | 1 teaspoon vodka | 1/2 teaspoon instant hot red pepper flakes ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder
instructions: In a medium saucepan stir together the mustardstone speciality grill marks, vodka and red pepper flakes. Cook on medium heat for about 20 mins or until well mixed and bubbly. Remove from heat and beat vigorously until smooth.

title: Coconut Shrimp With Jicama Crust
ingredients: 1 large uncooked medium jicama, peeled | 1/2 cup tahini | 1 tablespoon dry sherry | 1/4 teaspoon ground allspice | 1 package refrigerated pie crust sheets | 1/3 cup light coconut cream
instructions: In a small bowl stir together the coconut cream and tahini. Cut jicama into strips. Toss with coconut cream mixture. Place pie shell on a baking sheet. Spoon jicama mixture evenly over the top. Bake at 400 degrees for 20 minutes or until shrimp are pink. Serve with a spoonful of warm coconut cream.

Random Ingredients: spinach leaf,extra virgin olive oil,tabasco sauce,corn flake crumb,peanut butter,parmesan cheese,feta cheese,yellow pepper
title: Spinach Nachos
ingredients: 1 package frozen chopped spinach leaves, thawed and squeezed dry | 1 teaspoon crushed dried red pepper flakes | 1/3 cup feta cheese, crumbled | 1/3 cup peanut butter | 3/4 cup finely crumbled corn flakes, or as needed | 2/3 cup shredded parmesan cheese | 1 dash tabasco sauce, or to taste | 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Stir the spinach, red pepper flakes, feta cheese, peanut butter, corn flakes, parmesan cheese, and tabasco together in a bowl. Spoon onto a baking sheet to 1/2 inch from the edge of the pan. Drizzle on olive oil. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Bake in the preheated oven until the nachos are golden brown on the edges, 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Moroccan Chicken With Hazelnuts
ingredients: 300 g chicken | 500 g eggplants | 1 tablespoon hazelnut oil | 2 tablespoons coarsely chopped roasted cumin seeds | 2 tablespoons coarsely chopped bok choy | 600 ml raspberries, frozen
instructions: Trim chicken of any excess fat. Cut the skin and bones from each side of each breast using kitchen shears into 1 cm slices. Cut all the eggplants into 1 cm dice and arrange on a baking tray. Brush with olive oil. Place under a hot grill until slightly charred and just tender, turning once. Meanwhile, place the hazelnuts in a saucepan with some lightly salted water. Cover and bring to the boil. Simmer for 30 minutes or until just tender. Drain and cool. Cut the chicken breasts into 2 3cm pieces. Rinse and dry. Combine both eggplant halves in a colander. Pat dry with paper towels. Sprinkle with salt and leave to stand for 20 minutes or until just soft. Rinse well and dry with water. Place both eggplant halves in a tray. Combine water, olive oil, cumin and bok choy in a small pan and bring to the boil. Reduce heat and simmer until the vegetables are tender. Add chicken pieces and simmer for 10 minutes. Arrange chicken on a platter. Remove skin and bones from the chicken. Add half the hazelnuts, bok choy and raspberries to the chicken. Spoon over the chicken and serve with raspberries and honey.

title: Roasted Chilli Coffee
ingredients: 10 ounces fresh chili peppers | 2 tablespoons brown sugar | 2 tablespoons prepared horseradish | 1 tablespoon instant coffee | 1 teaspoon paprika
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees f. Wash and coarsely chop the chillies. Mix together with the brown sugar, horseradish, coffee, and paprika. Roast the chillies for 15 to 25 minutes until the sugar dissolves and the flavour intensifies. Cool. Serve.

title: Spicy Fish and Veggies
ingredients: 1 medium onion, diced | 4 fresh chinese mushrooms, diced | 1 lb red snapper, cut 1 inch wide by 2 inches long | 1 lb red snapper, cut crosswise into 1/4 strips | 1 package frozen mixed vegetables, thawed | 1 can kidney beans, drained | 1/2 teaspoon italian seasoning
instructions: Combine onion, mushroom, snapper and red snapper in a large ziploc bag. Add all other ingredients and toss lightly to combine. Place in the freezer for 4 hours. Remove snapper from bag and drain any remaining liquids.

title: Korean Soy-Anchovy Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 cup anchovy, cut into small pieces | 1/2 cup white sugar | 1/4 cup lite olive oil | 1/4 cup dry sherry, plus additional as needed | 1 1/2 tablespoons soya sauce
instructions: In a bowl measure anchovies.

Random Ingredients: curry leaf,extra virgin olive oil,lobster tail,italian plum tomato,barbeque sauce
title: Lobster Barbeque Style
ingredients: 8 ounces lobster tail, cut into halves | 3 tablespoons barbeque sauce | 8 ounces italian plum tomatoes, cut into chunks | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 1/4 cup barbeque sauce, or to taste | 2 curry leaves
instructions: Place lobster halves into a medium pan.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack cheese,italian sausage,savoy cabbage,silken tofu,lime juice,cardamom seed,worcestershire sauce,mint leaf
title: Spicy Saag Sandwich
ingredients: 1 medium head savoy cabbage | 2 teaspoons worcestershire sauce | 2 tablespoons fresh lime juice | 1 tablespoon minced fresh mint leaves | 1/4 teaspoon toasted cardamom seed | 2 lbs italian sausages, casings removed | 4 ounces silken tofu | 2 ounces monterey jack cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line a large baking sheet with parchment paper. Core cabbage, and cut out the thick core from the center. Cut out leaves as well, if desired. Place in large bowl, and toss with worchestershire sauce, lukewarm lime juice, mint, and cardamon seeds. Arrange sausage, sausages, and cheese in a single layer on baking sheet. Bake saag in preheated oven 40 minutes, or until cheese is lightly browned. Serve hot.

title: Mushroom and Vegetable Ploy
ingredients: 200 g shiitake mushrooms, thickly sliced | 2 tablespoons vegetable stock | cooking spray | 1 -2 tablespoon vegetable stock ( i use a flavoured stock cube )
instructions: Preheat the broiler to medium. Heat a saucepan over medium high heat. Add the mushrooms, stock and seasoning. Bring to a simmer, and cook for 7 - 8 minutes, or until the mushrooms soften. Serve the stew with freshly grated parmesan cheese or serve with baked potato dumplings.

title: Iranian Baba Ghaen (Eggplant with Meat)
ingredients: 2 large eggplants ( about 2lb ) | 4 tablespoons icing sugar | 2 lbs ground turkey | 2 tablespoons finely chopped of fresh mint
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees f, or the hottest temperature you are comfortable to find. Line a roasting pan with aluminum foil and set aside. Peel eggplants, cut lengthwise into 1/8 inch slices. In a bowl, mix 4 tablespoons of icing sugar, 3/4 lb ground turkey and 2 tablespoons of mint. Spoon turkey mixture into eggplant slices. Wrap foil tightly around this, place in roasting pan and bake for 20 minutes. Remove foil, bake for an additional 20 minutes more, until eggplant is tender. Remove from oven and let sit until cool enough to handle, 2 to 3 minutes. Slice crosswise into 1/4 inch slices.

title: Creme Carciofi (Garlicky Creme Carlico)
ingredients: 2 ounces cream-style half-and-half | 1/4 teaspoon paprika | 1 maraschino cherry
instructions: Pour the cream style half and half into a heavy 2 lb. Skillet over medium heat until bubbles form around the edge. The cream should just be warm. Do not boil. Add a pinch of paprika, a quarter maraschino cherry, and paprika powder. Cook just until fragrant, about 30 seconds or so, depending on heat. Pour into a serving bowl.

title: Ginger Turkey Dogs
ingredients: 12 hot dogs | 1 tablespoon ginger paste | 1/2 lb sweet italian turkey sausage
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. In large frying pan, brown the turkey sausage. Remove turkey sausage from pan. Place hot dogs in the same frying pan. Sprinkle ginger paste on top of them. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes over medium high heat, stirring occasionally. Serve immediately. May also be served with ganache if desired.

Random Ingredients: onion soup mix,maple syrup,red onion,cinnamon,jicama,greek yogurt,oyster sauce,cayenne pepper
title: Jicama Onion and Bacon Cakes
ingredients: 3/4 cup fat free greek yogurt | 1/2 cup fat free onion soup mix | 2 tablespoons olive oil or 2 tablespoons canola oil | 2 -4 small red onions, finely diced | 1/3 cup maple syrup | 1 tablespoon minced raw onion soup mix | 1 dash cayenne pepper, to taste ( or to taste ) | 1 dash cinnamon
instructions: Combine yogurt and onion soup mix with wire wisk, then whisk in oil until creamy and well blended. If mixture is difficult to stir, stir in a small amount of water. Stir in onions and maple syrup until evenly mixed. Add cayenne, cinnamon, and onion mixture.

Random Ingredients: allspice berry,italian sausage,wasabi,golden raisin,mint sprig,green onion
title: Spicy Sausage & Onions
ingredients: 1 package johnsonville italian sausage | 1 cup golden raisin | 1/2 cup green onion, thinly sliced | 1 teaspoon ground allspice berry | 1 1/2 cups italian-style prepared wasabi | 1 bunch fresh mint sprigs ( optional )
instructions: Slice sausage into 1/2 inch thick rounds & remove casings. Pat dry and sprinkle with raisins & green onions. Sprinkle with allspice & italian seasoning. Arrange on a well oiled baking sheet. Bake at 400 degrees f for 15 minutes. Remove from oven & cover with a damp cloth. Let stand for 5 more minutes. Serve hot.

title: Chipotle Radish Salsa
ingredients: 2 bunches radishes | 1/4 cup green onion | 1 canned chipotle chile in adobo, chopped | 1 tablespoon hot chili paste | 1 1/2 tablespoons sugar | 1 teaspoon ground nutmeg
instructions: Slice the radishes crosswise into thin rounds.

Random Ingredients: okra,mustard powder,green enchilada sauce,baking powder,flat leaf parsley,turnip
title: Sticky Yellow Okra Guisado
ingredients: 1 lb green enchilada sauce, canned | 1 lb sweet okra, washed, stems cut off and cut into 1/2-inch pieces | 1 tablespoon baking powder | 1/2 teaspoon baking powder | 1/4 teaspoon mustard powder | 1 1/2 - 2 cups chopped flat leaf parsley
instructions: In a small mixing bowl combine all ingredients except okra, parsley, and sauce. Mix well. Place 1/3 cup okra mixture in centre of a platter. Spoon remaining sauce around okra. Serve warm.

title: Eggplant (Aubergine) Nuggets
ingredients: 1 eggplant | 1 lb hamburger bun | 10 slices bacon, chopped | 1/4 cup sugar | 1/4 teaspoon ground allspice
instructions: Quarter eggplant lengthwise. Wash thoroughly. Cut away and discard stem. Rinse the peel from eggplant. Peel off outer membrane from the eggplant and discard. Slice in half crosswise, lengthwise, and slice into thin half moons. Lay out on a baking sheet that has been brushed with oil. Let stand overnight in the refrigerator. Remove any remaining eggplant from the marinade and pat dry with paper towels. In a double broiler heat bacon over high heat until crisp. Remove bacon from heat. Drain on paper towels. Add 1/4 cup of bacon grease to a skillet or wok. Brown eggplant nuggets. Remove from skillet. In the same skillet, add remaining 1/4 cup bacon grease or some of the reserved fat from the frying pan and heat over medium high heat. When pan is hot, add eggplant halves. Fry to desired tenderness. Remove eggplant and drain on paper towels. Spread 2 tablespoons of the remaining marinade on the hot cookie sheet. Place eggplant halves on each of the bread halves in a criss cross manner of the bacon. Return to the cookie sheet. In a small skillet, heat 1/4 cup of the remaining bacon grease, or more if needed, over high heat to form a glaze. Pour onto bread crusted nuggets. Garnish with a sprinkling of sugar and a pinch of allspice. Allow to sit 1 minute before serving.

title: Tikki
ingredients: 3 large egg yolks | 300 ml soymilk | 1 small red chile | 7 tablespoons good quality rose water | 1 1/2 lbs ground beef
instructions: In a bowl make the egg yolks with the rose water and chilli. Take a small amount of the soy milk to thin out the mixture and in four batches, whisk in the egg yolks so that they are thick and smooth and then slowly add them to the rest of the milk and blend, stirring in the chilli. Add the ground beef and mix again. Chill and then leave in the fridge for 30 minutes for flavours to develop. Break off pieces of roughly 2 oz of chilled beef and flatten out into a large patty shape about 3/4 cm thick. Cut and serve on skewers.

title: Homemade Chicken (No Canning)
ingredients: 1 kg meat ( chicken, beef, or any other kind of meat you prefer. i like chicken breasts ) | 1 tablespoon molasses
instructions: Mix the dry ingredients together. Dip your choice of meat in the mixed dry ingredients. Spray large lidded jar with cooking spray. Place 2 - 3 cups of the mix into the jar and seal. If you don't have any lidded jar you can get some pretty coloured sugar, cinnamon and nutmeg on you. It can be hard to tell when the mix is ready to eat, they will probably get a better coat with the molasses. I haven't tried trying this method, but people have been caught out by jerky that stuff. It is still delicious.

Random Ingredients: pecorino romano cheese,coffee,thai red curry paste,sauce,mint leaf,ancho chile,hamburger,lime juice
title: Spiced Beef Burger With Cointreau Mint Chili Mint Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons ground coffee | 2 teaspoons cointreau mint tea leaves or 2 teaspoons equivalent dried mint ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon thai red curry paste | 1 lb hamburger | 1 ounce smoked hamburger | fresh mint leaves | 2 tablespoons fresh lime juice | 1/2 cup pecorino romano cheese, shaved | fresh mint leaves
instructions: Preheat a grill to medium. To make cointreau mint mint sauce, put the first 4 ingredients in small saucepan with 4 cups of water. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to medium low and simmer for 20 minutes. Whisk in lime juice to taste. Add coffee and cook another 2 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside until needed. Lightly oil grill grate or heat a nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Lightly pack burger using a slotted spoon and discard marinade. Grill burgers until done to your liking. Top with mint leaves and shredded cheese.

title: Spicy Aioli
ingredients: 1 tablespoon garlic flavored olive oil | 1 package frozen whipped topping, thawed and drained
instructions: Heat the olive oil over medium heat in a small saucepan. Pour the frozen whipped topping into the heated oil and stir to coat. Cool and serve.

Random Ingredients: annatto seed,ham hock,poblano chile,pork leg,papaya,bamboo shoot
title: Guayabate
ingredients: 10 small poblano chiles, seeded and cut into thin strips | 3/4 lb dried banana ham hock | 1 lb pork leg | 12 ounces canned bamboo shoots, drained and broken into pieces | 1 tablespoon smoked papaya, pulp chopped | 1 tablespoon annatto seeds
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f place poblano and banana ham hocks in a roasting pan. Add enough water to cover the hamhocks. Bake for 1 to 1 1/2 hours, basting occasionally. Remove hamhocks to a plate when cooked. Remove vegetables temporarily from the pan. Save pan liquid, skim off fat. Place poblano and banana ham hocks in blender jar with the reserved pan liquid and remaining ingredients. Blend until chile is chile puree. Serve as a side dish or as a garnish at the table.

title: Roasted Red Pepper Soup
ingredients: 5 large red peppers | 12 ounces vegetable broth
instructions: Preheat the oven to 500 degrees f. Roast the peppers in the oven while preparing the other ingredients. They should be black spots on the outside but not black spots so just pop them into some hot oil on the stove. Remove the peppers from the oven, peel off the skins, and cut into thin strips. title: Spicy Orange Beef and Noodle Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef sirloin | 1 jar organic marinara sauce, divided | 1 teaspoon orange zest ( from 1 orange ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons cumin powder | 1 package fresh large cheese ravioli, cooked and drained or | 1 package frozen cheese ravioli, thawed according to directions | 1/4 cup chopped hazelnuts or 1/4 cup peanuts, toasted
instructions: Spray 10 skillet with cooking spray. Cook beef and drain off fat. Add 2 tsp oj. Marinara sauce, orange zest and cumin. Mix well and simmer on low heat just until heated through. Meanwhile, add ravioli to boiling sauce. Cook 3 - 5 minutes or until tender. Drain and rinse under cold water to cool, drain and set aside. Put remaining sauce in bowl. Add cooked and drained ravioli to sauce and stir to coat. Add half of the toasted and chopped nuts. Spoon into baking dish and sprinkle on beef mixture all around. Sprinkle on cheese and remaining nuts. Bake, covered, for 25 - 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: vegetable protein,espresso,green tomato,steak,white pepper,pimento olive,butternut squash
title: Beef and Butternut Squash in Espresso-Parmesan Mousse
ingredients: 1 cup chopped green tomatoes | 1/2 cup chopped pimento stuffed olive | 2 lbs round steaks, cut into 3/4 inch cubes | 1/4 teaspoon white pepper | 1 1/3 cups vegetable protein | 1 1/2 teaspoons instant espresso, dissolved in | 1 1/2 tablespoons hot water ( optional )
instructions: Place the tomato, cheese olives, and olives on a shallow platter. Season beef with pepper.

Random Ingredients: black bean,romaine lettuce,french bread,vegetable stock chicken,chive,sugar,pear
title: French Pear Soup
ingredients: 4 large roma lettuce, stemmed, washed and coarsely chopped | 1 can black beans | 2 medium pears, pared, cored and cut into eighths | 1/4 cup vegetable stock or 1/4 cup chicken stock | sugar ( optional ) | 6 -8 slices french bread, toasted on the bias | parsley, to garnish
instructions: Place the lettuce in a large bowl. Slice the pears in half and remove their seeds.

title: Aromatic Rice Wine Pasta
ingredients: 1/4 cup rice wine ( i use semolina ) or 1/4 cup white grape juice ( i use semolina ) | 2 medium portabella mushrooms, sliced | 7 green onions, sliced | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1 tablespoon semolina
instructions: Cook mushrooms and onions in boiling water until tender, stirring occasionally. Drain off excess liquid except 1/2 cup. Stir in rice wine, oregna and oregano. Salt and pepper to taste.

title: Spanish Shrimp in Casa
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs frozen raw shrimp, unpeeled, peeled | 1 1/2 cups shredded mexican blend cheese, divided | 1/4 cup golden raisin | 2 limes, wedged ( to garnish )
instructions: Combine shrimp and 1/4 cup cheese in medium bowl. Stir in raisins. Spoon shrimp mixture into 13x9 baking dish, spreading evenly. Sprinkle top with remaining cheese. Bake, uncovered, in a 400 degree f oven until cheese is melted and golden, about 20 to 25 minutes. Serve immediately with lime wedges. Tip, use 2 shrimp per serving if desired.

title: Tinara
ingredients: 2 fresh spinach leaves | 1 cup of fresh chopped basil leaves
instructions: Wash spinach well in salted water and dry well. Dip spinach leaves in boiling water for approximately 3 seconds and let drain. Place spinach leaves in a heavy bottomed vessel. Sprinkle chopped basil leaves over the stems. Cover with a tight fitting lid. Steam for 20 minutes on medium flame, steaming the leaves and using a fork to toss until spinach is softened and leaves are softened. Serve warm with fresh paratha.

title: Peanut Butter Walnut Ham Sliders
ingredients: 1 medium deli ham | 1/4 cup walnut pieces | 8 ounces low-fat peanut butter | 1 teaspoon dark sesame oil
instructions: Place walnuts in a food processor and process until finely chopped, about 1 minute. Set aside. Cut ham in thick slices and place in a medium bowl. Mix walnut pieces with peanut butter and sesame oil. Spread walnut mixture onto ham slices then cover surface with plastic wrap to prevent drying. Refrigerate at least 2 hours or overnight. Cut in 1 inch pieces and serve cold.

title: Chinese Yogurt Cabbage
ingredients: 5 bags chinese cabbage, in thin slices | 2 cups plain yogurt | 1 cup heavy whipping cream
instructions: In a bowl, toss together the yogurt and cream. Place cabbage in the refrigerator to chill, about 3 hours. To serve, place cabbage on a plate and place in serving bowls. Top with yogurt mixture and serve.

title: Peanut Butter Chili (Peanut Sauce)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups chunky smooth peanut butter | 1 1/2 ounces serrano peppers or 1 1/2 ounces red jalapeno chiles
instructions: Blend peanut butter and 1 cup of your favorite hot sauce in small saucepan over medium heat until mixture is smooth.

Random Ingredients: serrano chilies,baby spinach,bok choy,green chile pepper
title: Chili with Greens
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh baby spinach | 1 large fresh green chile pepper | 1 bunch fresh bok choy | 7 serrano chilies, or more to taste
instructions: Put spinach on a salad plate and layer with chile pepper, bok choy, and serrano chilies. Drizzle with cooking spray and serve immediately.

title: Welsh Rarebit #5FIX
ingredients: 6 fluid ounces whole wheat flour | 5 fluid ounces tomato ketchup | 1 1/2 ounces cherries
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Sift the flour into a mixing bowl and rub in the tomato ketchup. Stir to blend and then add the cherries. Knead the dough gently on a board or counter top. If you want to shape into round sausages, roll it out to 1/4 inch thickness and then transfer to a baking sheet. Prick the surface with a fork, brush with olive oil and bake for 25 minutes, or until crisp.

title: Ziti with Bell Peppers
ingredients: 1 package medium ziti pasta, broken into 1-inch sections | 1 yellow bell pepper, cut into strips with stem intact
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add ziti, and cook for 3 to 5 minutes or until al dente.

title: Italian Zucchini Fingers
ingredients: 6 small zucchini | 16 ladyfingers
instructions: Slice zucchini lengthwise into 1/8 inch slices.. Soak zucchini in cold water 3 - 5 minutes, or until softened but not browned. Combine zucchini in a colander and sprinkle on a little bit of salt. Shake well. Drain excess water to drain. Arrange zucchini on a serving plate & cover with a generous amount of fresh mint.

title: Baked Beef and Mushroom Risotto
ingredients: 4 cups cooked beef, minced | 4 cups fresh shiitake mushrooms, sliced | 1 jar arborio rice | 1/2 cup catsup | 1/3 cup salsa ( we use my a-1 salsa ) | 1 -2 lb rhubarb, cut into 1-inch pieces
instructions: Pre heat oven to 375 degrees. Combine rice, mushrooms and beef. Stir in beans, salsa and rhubarb. Cover and place in a lightly greased 9x13 pan. Cover with foil and bake for 40 - 50 minutes. Uncover and bake for 10 minutes longer.
