title: Shrimp Cocktail
ingredients: 1/2 pound medium prawns, peeled and deveined | 6 tablespoons pimento-pepper | 4 tablespoons crushed ice
instructions: Place prawns in a medium bowl. Season with pimentos, crackers, or crushed ice. Stir until prawns are coated with pimentos.

Random Ingredients: caster sugar,dark sesame oil,vanilla sugar,purpose flour
title: Chinese Sweet Nuts
ingredients: 1 cup dark sesame oil | 1 cup caster sugar | 2 cups all-purpose flour | vanilla sugar, to dust
instructions: Preheat oven to 190c/355f. Wash, dry and dry the nuts a little. Leave them at room temperature for about 40 minutes. Put oils in a pan, then add the sugar and stir over a medium heat until the sugar has melted and dissolved, about 5 - 10 minutes, adding just enough to make a light pink colour. Add the flour and beat until the dough starts to form, then stop stirring. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface. Divide the dough into about 10 pieces. Turn each piece into a sausage shape about 5cm thick. Lightly grease the grill surface. Place each nut on the grill, then brush the nut with a spoonful of oil. Put them over the gas grill and cook 3 - 4 minutes, then turn. Brush the nuts with more oil and cook 2 - 3 minutes more, or until the nuts feel firm when pricked in the centre. When cool transfer nuts to wire racks to cool. Vanilla sugar, sift the vanilla sugar into a clean bowl. Scoop the nuts out with a slotted spoon and serve them spread with their vanilla sugar flavoured sugar.

title: Spanish Barbecue Seasoning
ingredients: 1 tablespoon smoked paprika | 3 celery ribs | 1/2 cup sweet paprika | 2 tablespoons dry sherry
instructions: Place all ingredients in a food processor and pulse for 5 seconds. Store in a cool place.

title: Sweet Soup
ingredients: 1 package silken tofu | 1 tablespoon rice wine | 1 package rice vermicelli
instructions: Slice the tofu into one inch cubes and place into a large pot. Cover with water, about one inch high, and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Remove the water as soon as it boils, then cover and set aside until ready to use. Drain off the water and discard. While the soup simmers in the pot, make the rice vermicelli according to the package directions. Drain until they're cool enough to handle, then slice the noodles into 1/2 inch pieces. Set a small plate or bowl of water near the bottom of the bowl of soup to keep it from sticking together. Remove the soup's lid and quickly ladle in the soup's contents and set aside the tofu and vermicelli. Place the lid back on the pot, and cook over high heat for about 5 minutes stirring frequently. Turn off heat, allow soup to steam for about 5 minutes and serve. You can serve it with fresh grated parmesan cheese, finely chopped parsley, or a loaf of bread.

Random Ingredients: clam juice,pork shoulder,salt,extra finely sugar,cornflour,cayenne pepper,ginger
title: Newfoundland Fried Pork in Clams
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs pork shoulder ( cut into 2 inch cubes ) | 1 teaspoon salt | 1 pinch cayenne pepper | 4 slices ginger | 1 pint clam juice | 4 teaspoons cornflour | extra finely granulated sugar
instructions: Soak clams in clam juice for 30 minutes. Combine remaining ingredients in deep fryer. Heat to 375°f. Deep fry pork and drain. Remove excess oil by draining. Drizzle with oil from jar. Sprinkle with sugar. Serve warm or at room temperature. Serve with crusty bread for dipping.

title: Cajun Mushrooms
ingredients: 1/2 cup chopped dates or 1/2 cup dried dates | 1 tablespoon margarine | 8 ounces cremini mushrooms, sliced
instructions: Melt margarine in a skillet over medium heat. Add mushrooms and saute for 5 minutes or until tender. Sprinkle with dates.

Random Ingredients: bay leaf,mint leaf,pearl barley,nori,peanut oil,ra el hanout spice mix
title: Shahi Tukra Recipe & Sushi
ingredients: 500 g pearl barley | 2 tablespoons ra el hanout spice mix | 1/2 cup of fresh mint leaves, shredded | 2 tablespoons peanut oil | 3 bay leaves | 2 sheets nori ( dry seaweed )
instructions: Bring the barley and the ra el hanout to the boil and then simmer for ten minutes. Drain off the excess water and set aside to cool. Place the mint leaves in a tea ball and soak in a little boiling water for 2 to 3 minutes to remove any sand. Drain. Heat a wok until smoking and then add the oil. Gently stirfry the bay leaves and nori strips. Add the barley and stirfry briefly. Season with salt and pepper and add the mint leaves. Toss over the rice and serve immediately.

title: Melt Your Plate in the Mouth Oat-N' Pepperidge Baked Onion Dip!
ingredients: 1 white onion ( small ) | 1 1/2 cups marinara sauce ( or your favorite jarred mix ) | 2 cups quick oats ( not quick ) | 2 tablespoons dry oatmeal | 1 tablespoon mustard powder | 1 french baguette, cut into 8 chunks
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375f. Remove outer layer of onion and finely dice it small, put the onions in a large oven proof dish. Cut the baguette pieces into about 2 inch lengths and place them on a foil lined baking sheet. In a large mixing bowl, mash together the mustard powder and reserved salt. Slowly add 1 cup of the marinara sauce and mix well with the onions. Add the onions and mix well with the other half cup of marinara. Pour this over the onions and mix well with a fork. Take the baguette pieces and wrap them tightly in the foil. Put into the oven and bake for 30 - 35 mins until they are crispy and golden brown.

title: Pate de Campes Complet
ingredients: 4 slices veal steak | 2 tablespoons paprika | peeled ripe peach, to cut fresh peach wedges in half
instructions: Cut veal steak crosswise into 1/4 thick slices. Spread paprika on one side of each slice of veal. Arrange peach wedges around veal slices, then sprinkle with paprika and let stand for 20 minutes. Grill or broil veal over medium heat until crisp and brown.

title: Easy Taco Seasoning
ingredients: 1 envelope taco seasoning mix | 1/4 cup lemon-lime juice
instructions: In a small bowl or cup, mix the taco seasoning mix and lemon lime juice to form a thin paste. Store leftovers in refrigerator or in sealed container.

Random Ingredients: red bell pepper,celery,serrano chili,parmigiano reggiano cheese,parmigiano
title: Celery With Pecorino, Serrano, and Red Pepper
ingredients: 1 lb fresh celery, chopped ( about 4 stalks ) | 1 serrano chili, stemmed, seeded, and finely minced ( or to taste ) | 1/4 teaspoon grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese ( or to taste ) | 1/2 small red bell pepper, coarsely chopped into 1-inch pieces | 1/4 cup finely chopped fresh parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Cook celery in boiling salted water for 5 minutes, or until crisp tender. Drain, then transfer to large bowl and let drain for a few minutes. Add chile pepper and sprinkle with coarsely grated cheese. Toss gently to combine, then let sit and milled for about 20 minutes, stirring halfway through.. Note, to grill, place rack in broiler pan, and grill celery until tender, turning once, about 45 minutes, turning once.

Random Ingredients: serrano pepper,cooking oil,dark sesame oil,napa cabbage,ziti pasta
title: Faux Fried N' Spicy Pasta With Ziti(Pad Wien)
ingredients: 1 lb ziti pasta or 1 lb linguine | 2 inches piece skinless serrano peppers, sliced thin or 2 inches long fresh chilies, cut into slivers | 2 tablespoons cooking oil | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 4 cups shredded napa cabbage
instructions: Cook ziti til pasta is al dente or according to package directions. Drain. In a large skillet or wok, heat oil until hot but not smoking. Remove skillet from heat and add peppers. Stir fry 1 minute. Add pasta, cabbage and sesame oil. Toss till pasta has absorbed the flavors. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: corn syrup,cherry tomato,rye bread,fine white breadcrumb,chicken,scallion
title: Chicken with Tomatoes and Fresh Corn Truffles!
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs boneless skinless chicken | 1/4 cup coarse white breadcrumbs | 4 scallions, finely chopped | 1 1/3 cups cherry tomatoes, halved | 1/3 cup corn syrup | 1/4 cup fine dry white breadcrumb
instructions: In large skillet over medium low heat, place chicken and cook, turning once, until browned, about 10 minutes. Transfer chicken to a plate and place in a bowl. Pour off all but about 1 tablespoon fat from the skillet and return the skillet to medium. Scatter the white bread crumbs over the scallions and tomatoes and toss to coat. Toss the tomato mixture with the chicken in the bread crumbs. Add the corn syrup and toss to coat each slice. Sprinkle the tomato mixture over the chicken in the crumbs. Cook over medium low heat, stirring constantly, for about 15 minutes. Cover, reduce the heat to low and continue to cook for another 15 minutes, until the coating is shiny and bubbly and mixture is hot and sticky. Cool to room temperature..

Random Ingredients: clove powder,chili powder,cauliflower floret,seasoning salt,citron peel,purpose flour
title: Quick Cauliflower Fritters
ingredients: 2 cups cauliflower florets, steamed until tender ( or use a steamed floret, steamed or leftover leftover rotisserie-cooked ) | 3 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 2 teaspoons dried citron peel | 1 teaspoon chili powder | 1 -2 teaspoon ground cloves or 1 -2 teaspoon allspice | 1 -2 teaspoon seasoning salt
instructions: Prep vegley, wash& drain.

Random Ingredients: thyme,soy sauce,turnip,chicken wing,red chili pepper flake,beef cube steak
title: Low Cal Chinese Chicken and Dumplings
ingredients: 2 -9 lbs chicken wings or 2 -9 lbs turkey wings | 1 beef cube steak ( cut in 1/2 inch cubes ) | 2 dried red chili peppers or 1 minced dried red chile pepper | 1 tablespoon soy sauce | 1 teaspoon fresh thyme, chopped | 2 lbs turnips or 2 lbs potato, peeled and grated ( about 2 cups )
instructions: Place all ingredients in crock pot on high and cook for about 2 hours. Serve over plain rice or noodles.

title: Riesling Con Champignones
ingredients: 1 lb riesling wine or 1 lb other strong red wine | 1 tablespoon dried thyme | 2 1/2 ounces sliced prosciutto | 1 1/2 lbs chuck, trimmed, cut into 2. 5 inch cubes | 1/2 - 3/4 cup currants or 1/2-3/4 cup raisins | 1 small green pepper, cut into 1. 5 inch slivers | 2 bananas, sliced | 1 cup self-rising flour
instructions: In a bowl combine the wine, thyme and half of the prosciutto. Stir until wine is completely absorbed. Add beef, stir until well coated. Cover and refrigerate overnite. Preheat oven to 350°f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. In a small bowl, combine the currants or raisins, green pepper slices and remaining prosciutto. Sprinkle the flour on the flour and toss to combine. Transfer the beef to the baking sheet. Bake until a meat thermometer inserted in the thickest part of the beef registers about 160f, about 30 - 40 minutes. Toss the contents of the pan and serve.

title: Baked Spicy  Pignoli
ingredients: 500 g condensed tomato sauce | 2 tablespoons golden syrup | 1 tablespoon chopped chili | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 2 tablespoons chopped pecans
instructions: Mix tomato sauces, peas, spices and chilli together in an ovenproof casserole dish with a lid. Cover and bake in the oven for 15 - 20 minutes until golden brown. Serve with warm pita crust.

title: Portuguese Rice Balls (Portuguese Version)
ingredients: 3 lbs spanish rice mix, packages | 3 scallions, chopped
instructions: Prepare spanish rice according to package directions. While the rice is cooking slice scallions thinly. Toast scallions in dry skillet on medium high heat until they start to blacken, about 3 to 5 minutes. Remove from skillet and set aside. When rice is done, lightly grease a baking sheet and scatter the rice in the roasting pan. Sprinkle scallions over rice and evenly sprinkle the rice with the scallions. Bake at 350 for 25 to 30 minutes or until scallions are tender and golden brown. Enjoy.

title: Italian Pistachio Chicken Wings
ingredients: 16 chicken wings | 1/2 cup pistachios ( finely chopped ) | 1/2 cup finely chopped italian parsley
instructions: Place the chicken wings in a shallow ovenproof dish and pour enough hot water around the chicken wings to cover. Cover and marinate the chicken wings at room temperature for 1 to 2 hours, or as long as overnight. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees. Drain the wings and spread on a clean kitchen towel. Turn the legs over and shake off any excess water. Place the chicken wings in a roasting pan with plenty of surface area. Bake for 45 minutes or until golden brown and cooked through. When the chicken wings are done, remove from the oven and sprinkle with pistachios and parsley.

title: Best Ever Baked Zatarains
ingredients: 350 g ham, sliced thinly | 100 g kalamata olives | italian seasoning
instructions: Pre bake at 150 degrees celsius. Heat the olive oil in a frying pan and add the ham. Sprinkle on a little italian seasoning and mix together. Take the ham out of the oven and add the olives and top with the bread. Note, for a really tasty addition, use shredded parmesan and mozzarella cheese.

title: Lobster Smoked Ham, Saltimbocca Style
ingredients: 6 slices prosciutto ham, cut 1-inch thick | 1 1/2 cups beef broth | 2 ounces small lobster meat | 2 pinches dry mustard | 2 teaspoons grated lemon peel
instructions: Slice ham in half lengthwise. Combine ribs and broth in a small saucepan. Set over high heat and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium and simmer for 5 to 10 minutes. Remove from heat and place ham in a large bowl. Squeeze excess liquid from lobster meat. Add lobster and dry mustard to the ham and pour marinade over all. Cover and set aside at room temperature for about 2 hours. Before serving, allow to stand for 10 minutes before cutting.

title: Pepperoni Fettuccine
ingredients: 1 package dry fettuccine ( can use fresh ) | 1 3/4 cups apple juice ( can use apple or vegetable juice ) | 1 tablespoon gelatin | 1/2 teaspoon marjoram | 1/4 teaspoon dill or 1/4 teaspoon chives, if desired | 4 slices pepperoni, if desired ( or you can use more )
instructions: Cook and drain fettucine as directed on package. Combine apple juice and gelatine. Stir in warm apple syrup or apricot preserves. Remove a slice of pepperoni for garnish. Arrange in a circle on a serving platter and top with sauce. Note, this can be made with fresh pepperoni.

Random Ingredients: allspice,garam masala powder,whipping cream,nonfat beef broth,beet,dashi stock,potato,chicken broth
title: Potato Beet Soup
ingredients: 3 cups potatoes, peeled and cubed | 1 quart nonfat beef broth, heated | 1 can reduced-sodium chicken broth | 1/2 cup beet, cooked | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala powder | 1/4 teaspoon allspice | 1/2 cup whipping cream
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a pot, except whipping cream, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat.

title: Easy Salsa Blanche
ingredients: 4 large egg whites | 3 fresh beets, or more to taste | 3 cups thick and chunky salsa
instructions: Heat oven to 325 degrees f. Grease an 11x14 inch baking dish. Mix egg whites and salsa together in an electric mixer until thick and fluffy. Pour egg whites into the prepared baking dish. Bake in the preheated oven until the tops are slightly brown, about 45 minutes. Let cool in the oven. Cut blanche into squares with a serrated knife.

title: Chinese Green Salad
ingredients: 1 teaspoon dark sesame oil | 1 teaspoon celery seed | 1/2 teaspoon honey | 1 cup fresh spinach leaves
instructions: In a small skillet, heat the sesame oil, celery seed, and honey. Cover, and cook over low heat, stirring occasionally, for 10 minutes, remove from heat. Mix in the spinach leaves, and set aside to cool. Store in refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: center pork chop,chili pepper flake,buckwheat flour,peanut,anise seed,sirloin,graham cracker,paneer
title: Thai Pork Toast
ingredients: 1 medium sirloin | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon chili pepper flakes | 1 1/2 teaspoons peanut oil or 1 1/2 teaspoons butter | 2 -3 center cut pork chops | 2 cups buckwheat flour | 2 teaspoons anise seed, crushed | 3 slices toasted graham crackers or 3 slices other round crackers | 3/4 cup salted peanuts
instructions: Slice meat into thin strips, about 1/4 to 1/2 inch wide. Lightly brown meat in oil. Place in a shallow ovenproof dish. Combine flour and aniseed and rub in each chop. Spread on crackers. Sprinkle with peanuts. Broil in broiler for 2 to 3 minutes or until top is light brown.

Random Ingredients: portabella mushroom,ha avocadoes,rhubarb,walnut,white wine,vanilla ice cream
title: Wild Rhubarb Avocadoes
ingredients: 3 large hass avocadoes | 1/2 cup white wine or 1/2 cup champagne | 1/2 cup diced rhubarb ( fresh or frozen ) | 1 cup portabella mushroom | 1/2 cup diced walnuts | vanilla ice cream
instructions: Peel and pit avocados, cut in half lengthwise and set aside. Carefully scoop out flesh with a spoon and place in bowl with wine. Scoop reserved flesh into a small bowl. Add rhubarb, mushrooms, walnuts and reserved avocados. Cover bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or up to 8 hours, stirring occasionally. Stir in the ice cream just before serving. Serve with pita chips or sour cream.

title: Roasted Yellow Squash
ingredients: 2 yellow squash, medium to large, cut into chunks | 1/2 lime, zest of, large | 1 teaspoon dried mustard | 16 hot dried chipotle chiles ( can use fresh serrano peppers )
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees. Place squash in a roasting pan. Sprinkle with lime zest, dry mustard and dried chiles. Roast approximately 1 hour, turn over every 15 minutes and roast an additional 20 minutes until desired doneness is reached. Remove from oven and allow to rest for 10 - 20 minutes. Serve warm or cold.

Random Ingredients: brown rice,chocolate morsel,white bread,heavy whipping cream,allspice,yellow onion,picante sauce,grain rice
title: Brown Rice Chocolate Stuffed French Loaf
ingredients: 1 loaf crusty white bread | 1 cup cooked brown rice, cooled | 1/2 yellow onion, finely chopped | 2 1/2 cups heavy whipping cream | 1/4 cup picante sauce | 1 1/2 cups uncooked long grain rice, packed | 1 pinch ground allspice | 1/2 cup chocolate morsel
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place bread in a single layer on a baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until slightly toasted, about 7 minutes. Remove from oven and allow to cool. Wrap a piece of plastic wrap around its long edge so it doesn't dry out and weigh down your loaf with something to keep it flat and even after it has been wrapped. Cool loaf completely. In a bowl, mix together brown rice, onion, cream, picante sauce, and rice. Remove the crust from the the bread and squeeze out bread and reserve. Cut bread into 1/2 inch cubes and line the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish. Spoon rice mixture into the center of the bread. Top with the bread cubes, then dot the chocolate morsel evenly over the top. Bake at 350 degrees f for approximately 45 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the loaf is warmed through. Remove from oven and allow to cool.

title: Almond Paste With Fresh Raine and Mint for Elegant Salad
ingredients: 1 jar almond paste ( nutella ) | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne powder | 1 leaf fresh mint leaves | 1 teaspoon cinnamon | 1 head romaine lettuce or 1 head boston lettuce
instructions: Drain nutella completely then place in a food processor with the caye, mint leaves, and cinnamon and puree until well blended, adding the lemon juice a little at a time until it reaches the desired consistency. Serve in small dishes over the romaine lettuce.

title: Herbed Mint Dressing
ingredients: 1/2 cup fine dry breadcrumb | 10 -12 leaves fresh italian herb seasoning | 1/4 - 1/2 cup of fresh mint, chopped, plus one mint sprig ( to garnish )
instructions: In a medium bowl whisk all ingredients together. Cover, and refrigerate several hours or overnight to develop flavors prior to serving. Garnish with fresh mint, if desired to serve.

title: Colby Cheese Dip
ingredients: 2 lbs shredded colby cheese | 3 tablespoons vinegar
instructions: Mix the cheese and vinegar together in a bowl. Add more vinegar to get the right thickness. Add more or less of the mixture as desired. Serve chilled..

title: Feta Cheese Dip
ingredients: 1 package feta cheese, crumbled | 1 tablespoon olive oil
instructions: In a bowl, stir together the feta cheese and olive oil. Add more olive oil to coat the bottom of a saucepan if desired. Stir and simmer until cheese is melted. Serve warm or cool to room temperature.

Random Ingredients: orange bell pepper,pretzel,red enchilada sauce,club soda,cream,pasta,cherry,pinto bean
title: Baked Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1 box pinto beans, drained and rinsed ( you can use canned beans if that is all you have ) | 1 1/2 cups pretzels | 3/4 cup sour cream | 6 tablespoons orange sweet bell pepper, very finely chopped | 1 cup pretzels, finely shredded | 3/4 cup red enchilada sauce | 1 1/4 cups club soda ( or to taste ) | shredded sweet and sour cream | 1 1/4 cups mixed baby salad fruit ( or to taste ) or 1 1/4 cups red bell peppers ( or to taste )
instructions: In a large bowl, combine pinto beans, pretzels, sour cream, and orange sweet pepper. Toss until well combined. Spread about 1/2 cup of the enchilada sauce on the bottom of a 9x7 inch baking dish. Spread pinto bean mixture evenly over the sauce. Top with 3/4 cup pretzels, followed by another 1/2 cup of pretzels. Repeat with a third layer of pretzels and 3/4 cup red enchilada sauce. Pour remaining enchilada sauce over the top. Sprinkle remaining 1/4 cup finely shredded pretzels over top. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 to 40 minutes or just until heated through. Sprinkle with 1 1/4 cups mixed baby salad or mixed vegetables. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: stevia powder,white creme de cacao,lime zest,corn kernel,italian herb,egg yolk,meat
title: Mel's Mexican Wedding Cookies for ZWT-9
ingredients: 15 1/2 ounces dried corn kernels, drained and rinsed | 12 ounces diced cooked meat | 3 large egg yolks | 11 1/2 ounces white creme de cacao | 11 1/2 ounces stevia powder ( or other sweet cookie ) | 1 small lime, zest of | 1 teaspoon mixed italian herbs ( such as rosemary, dill, sage, celery )
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, mix together all ingredients. Cover and chill dough for at least one day. Preheat oven to 350 degrees and line two cookie sheets with parchment paper. Drop dough one inch apart on prepared sheets and leave on sheets for 15 minutes. Remove dough and transfer to large tray lined with parchment paper. Using a pastry brush, drizzle tops with a little more oil. Flatten with a glass to form cookies. Bake for 10 - 12 minutes or just until edges are lightly browned around the edges. Allow to cool on the sheets for a few minutes before removing to a wire rack to finish cooling on a wire rack. Store in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: marjoram,celery,cream mushroom soup,self raising flour,chili powder,red chili pepper
title: Green Chilie Chilli Sour Cream Muffins
ingredients: 8 ounces self-raising flour | 1 tablespoon chili powder | 1 tablespoon marjoram | 1 tablespoon ground celery | 1 fresh red chili pepper, seeded and finely chopped | 1 can cream of mushroom soup
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200°c. Use a large cookie scoop to make a circle out of the baking paper and set aside. In a mixing bowl, combine the flour and chilli powder. Cut in the dried leafy centre of the chilli and red chilli then quickly blend in the cream of mushroom soup, adding the flour and chilli mixture. Mix well. Spoon the mixture evenly into the prepared pan and bake for 10 minutes or until nicely browned and cooked through. Serve with choc chips.

title: Fried Sticky Batter Sauce
ingredients: 1 teaspoon rice flour | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace | 1/4 teaspoon celery seed | 1 cup leftover marinara sauce
instructions: In a medium bowl, stir together the rice flour, baking soda, mace and celery seed. Add the leftover marinara sauce, and stir to incorporate. When the batter is right, drop by spoonfuls onto a hot, greased griddle. Cook until browned.

Random Ingredients: coriander powder,quinoa,rigatoni pasta,apple,red chili pepper flake,grand marnier,pork,harissa
title: Spicy Spicy Rice and Lamb Pasta With Apple and Quinoa
ingredients: 1/4 teaspoon harissa | 500 g ground lean pork | 2 teaspoons quinoa, arborio | 1 3/4 cups chopped apples | 1 tablespoon sweet harissa | 6 red chili peppers, finely chopped or 1 tsp red pepper flakes | 1 teaspoon coriander powder | 1/2 cup grand marnier | 200 g rigatoni pasta
instructions: In a non stick frypan, brown the meat and spices over medium heat. Add the quinoa and cook, stirring frequently, for 3 minutes. Add the apples and simmer for 5 minutes, until they begin to soften and get a little translucent. Add the grand marnier and cook for 2 - 2 minutes, or until it thickens slightly. Meanwhile, cook the rigatoni in boiling water until it starts to separate from the skin. Drain the rigatoni and return to the pan. Stir in the sauce, and cook until the meat loses its raw color. Add the quinoa and cook for an extra 2 - 3 minutes, stir, then take off the heat. Serve.

Random Ingredients: margarine,pepperoni,liquid smoke flavoring,corn oil,sharp cheddar cheese
title: Pepperoni Cheese Rounds Ole
ingredients: 1 cup sharp cheddar cheese, shredded | 1/2 cup pepperoni, shredded fine | 2 teaspoons corn oil | 1 teaspoon margarine or 1 teaspoon butter | 1/8 teaspoon liquid smoke flavoring
instructions: Mix first three ingredients together. Roll each round and place on lightly greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350 degrees for 8 minutes or until slightly browned, or when hot and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: green cardamom pod,velveeta cheese,beef brisket,fine breadcrumb
title: Mom's Easy Cheesy Beef Brisket
ingredients: 1 lb of very lean and cheap quality corned beef brisket | 8 ounces velveeta cheese | 1/2 cup fine dry breadcrumb | 1/4 teaspoon ground green cardamom pod
instructions: Take half the corned beef and make sure you cut it all the way through the middle. Slice across the grain into 1/4 slices. Dice the other half of the corned beef and slice into 1/4 slices. You will almost certainly need all of the beef. I use a ziploc bag. Dip the beef slices in fine dry bread crumbs. Fry in a non stick pan on low heat for about 20 minutes per side. Remove from pan and set aside. Add velveeta to pan and cook until melted. Add the rest of the ingredients and cook for another 5 minutes or so. Serve on a bed of mashed potatoes. It tastes even better reheated.

Random Ingredients: white breadcrumb,chicken,zucchini,dark chocolate,icing sugar,orange bell pepper,radish,golden syrup
title: Chicken Balls With Zucchini Chips
ingredients: 1/3 cup golden syrup | 500 g ground chicken | 2 large zucchini, grated ( finely mashed ) | 2 oranges, grated finely | 1 orange bell pepper, finely diced | 1 tablespoon finely chopped preserved orange rind | 3 cups wholemeal white breadcrumbs | 1 tablespoon icing sugar ( to dust )
instructions: Combine sauce ingredients in a small saucepan and stir over low heat until hot and then cool. Combine chicken, zucchini, zucchini mixture and orange pepper in a large bowl. Season with salt and pepper and stir in breadcrumbs. Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour. Preheat oven to 200 degrees. Using hands, roll 1 teaspoon of the mixture into a large, thin oblong roll about 15 cm in diameter. Place on an oiled baking sheet, cover and refrigerate until the mixture has set.

Random Ingredients: bamboo skewer,sirloin tip steak,walnut half,grain rice,olive oil,chinese five spice powder,cilantro
title: Chinese Steak
ingredients: 4 sirloin tip steaks | 4 whole grain rice sticks | 1/2 cup coarsely chopped fresh cilantro | 4 whole walnut halves | 4 tablespoons chinese five-spice powder | 3 tablespoons olive oil | 1/2 cup coarsely chopped pine nuts
instructions: Place the sirloin steaks between 4 sheets of wax paper and pound them out into 5 thicknesses. Chop the cilantro, walnuts and five spice powder into small pieces and place in a blender or food processor. Process until you have something like fine grain or grainy puree. Heat about 1/4 of the oil in a large skillet over high heat until it shimmers. Stir in pine nuts and saute about 1 minute. Remove the steaks from the pan and lay on a plate lined with paper towels to drain. In a bowl, combine all remaining ingredients except the pine nuts and pour the marinade over them. Place the steaks on top, cover and marinate at room temperature for 12 hours or more. Heat remaining oil in a skillet over high heat until it shimmers. Sprinkle the steaks with nuts and serve with rice.

Random Ingredients: beef broth,egg white,spice,stewing beef,cannellini bean,dark soy sauce,pepper sauce
title: Beef With Spices and Beans (Stove Top or Ensnococada Di Ebi)
ingredients: 1 lb lean stewing beef | 2 teaspoons meat spice | 1 egg white | 1 teaspoon dark soy sauce | 1 can cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 1 teaspoon hot pepper sauce | 1/2 cup beef broth | 3 -4 teaspoons spicy dark soy sauce
instructions: In a small bowl beat egg white until foamy. Mix in meat spice and brown meat in a large skillet on both sides. Drain off fat, add a cup of beef stock and remaining ingredients. Bring to boil, reduce heat and simmer covered about 1 hour. Taste and adjust seasonings to your taste.

title: Beef and Sultanas
ingredients: 3 lbs lean beef, cut into thin strips | 1 large onion, grated | 1 1/2 cups sultanas | beef gravy or gravy | 1 teaspoon onion powder
instructions: Add onion and beef to a casserole dish. Sprinkle with the sultanas. Pour over gravy and bake at 300° f/180°c for 1 hour.

title: Honey Mustard Shredded American Cheese
ingredients: 4 ounces american cheese | 1 ounce honey mustard ( helevur ) | 1/2 ounce dry mustard powder | 1/2 tablespoon fresh thyme ( i prefer 1 1/2 tbsp. dried ) | 1/4 teaspoon dried cherries
instructions: Shred the american cheese with a cheese cloth using the kitchen paper shredder blade. Mix the mustard, thyme and cherries in a medium sized bowl. In a sauce pot, over medium heat, melt the honey mustard and the dry mustard powder. When melted, add the cheese to the bowl and mix with a fork until well coated with the spice mixture. Transfer to the bowl and let dry for 2 hours. Note that the honey mustard powder must have cooled down so you may need to use a bit of water if it becomes too moist by the time it is dry. Taste for saltiness. Can be served warm or cold.

title: Wild Rice Cheese Quiche With Cheese, Fruits and Irish Breakfast
ingredients: 2 cups wild rice, washed | 1 1/4 cups grated old cheddar cheese | 4 ounces grated swiss cheese | 1/4 teaspoon ground cinnamon, plus lots | finely grated swiss cheese, to finish | plain flour, to dust the quiche | 3/4 cup diced mixed dried fruit ( such as raspberries, currants, blueberries, black currants )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees. Lightly oil a large baking dish or a 5 or 6 hole pie plate. Put the rice, cheeses, cinnamon and dried fruit and mix well. Pour into the pie dish. Sprinkle a large handful of cheese over the top and dot with a few cubes of butter. Cover with a lid or a tight buttered ovenproof dish and bake for 40 - 45 minutes, or until golden brown and firm to the touch. Remove from the oven and allow to the quiche to rest for at least 15 minutes. Run a knife around the edge of the quiche to loosen and invert to unmold. Let cool 5 minutes, then refrigerate for 2 hours to set. Serve as a slice with lots of butter and cold irish cream.

title: Spicy Broccoli
ingredients: 1 bag fresh broccoli, florets, trimmed | 1 1/2 teaspoons instant espresso | 1 sun-dried tomato, cut into strips
instructions: Bring a saucepan of salted water to a boil. Add broccoli and cook for 4 minutes or until broccoli is tender. Drain broccoli on a paper towel lined plate and set aside. Combine espresso and 1 tablespoon water and brush over top of broccoli. Heat broiler to high. Spread sun dried tomato strips over base of a broiler pan and broil for 2 to 4 minutes or until tomato is dry. Remove broccoli from broiler and spread with espresso mixture. Sprinkle with remaining tomato.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast halve,masa harina flour,chorizo sausage,cake flour
title: Spanish Tortillas
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless skinless chicken breast halve | 4 chicken breast halves ( about 6 cups worth ) | 1 cup masa harina flour ( or whole wheat cereal ) | 1/4 cup cake flour, sifted ( or whole wheat flour )
instructions: Cube chicken into 1 inch cubes. Rinse and pat dry with paper towels. Place chicken pieces in large bowl and add the masa harina or bread crumbs. Mix well with hands. Roll about a third of a cup of the mixture in each of the chicken pieces, making sure they are covered. Refrigerate the chicken until ready to use. Repeat this step with remaining chicken. Fry them in a few batches in a little oil or cooking spray on both sides until well browned. Remove from pan and set aside. Repeat with remaining batch of ingredients until finished. Serve warm with guacamole, sour cream, salsa, or whatever else you are using for dipping.

title: Linguine With serrano-Spiked Peppers and Scallions
ingredients: 1/4 cup minced serrano pepper | 3 thyme sprigs | 1 lb linguine
instructions: In a nonaluminum bowl combine the minced pepper and thyme. Add the linguine and toss to coat well. Cover, reduce heat to medium low and cook for 12 minutes, stirring occasionally. Season with salt.

Random Ingredients: cardamom seed,lard,tomato sauce,caster sugar,canola oil,romaine lettuce leaf,vanilla essence,turkey breast
title: Kuwaiti Style Lamb Rolls (Dhaaj Al-Tamat)
ingredients: 8 sheets of stale turkish bread, approximately 3/4-inch thick | 30 -40 cardamom seeds | 1 teaspoon canola oil | 500 g ground lean turkey breast or 500 g ground chicken breast | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence | 500 g tomato sauce or 350 g tomato puree | 300 g of canola oil or 300 g sunflower oil | 1 cup caster sugar | 1 head romaine lettuce leaf, washed well in clear tea towel, and dried completely
instructions: Note, if your bread is stale, crush it with a pestle, add a little bit of baking soda and mix thoroughly. Place a tray or cookie sheet in a roasting pan large enough to fit the patties under a preheated grill, and allow them to sweat for about 10 minutes. Using a meat mallet place 4 slices of bread and a teaspoon of the cardamom seeds around the inside edge of each piece of bread, and spread some of the puree under the bread. Place the ground burger or chicken and 1 teaspoon of vanilla essence over each piece of bread. Roll each sandwich using the palm of your hand to seal both sides, making them like little fingers as you roll. Sprinkle the tops of the rolls with some turkish seasoning. In a frying pan, heat a tablespoon of canola oil or sunflower oil. Brown the rolls. To the same pan add a tbsp of caster sugar and cook on medium heat until the sugar has caramelised and slightly has turned light brown. Take them out and cool. In a large, deep, preferably ovenproof dish, heat the remaining canola oil or sunflower oil. Place the rolls into the hot oil and fry on both sides until crisp and brown. This will take around 10 - 12 minutes. Serve with the tomato sauce and salad leaves, or as an accompaniment to rice.

title: Sushi-Dip
ingredients: 2 cans rosamarina linguine or 2 cans regular pasta noodles | 1/2 cup slivered gingerroot | 1/2 cup finely chopped green pepper | chopped lettuce | 1/2 cup coffee ( i use decaffeinated or sweetened )
instructions: Cook lingune in 3 litres water until just tender. Drain, rinse with cold water and drain again making sure there is no liquid in them. Mix the slivered ginger and green pepper with all the vegetables, then place in a serving dish with 1/4 cup of coffee. Let sit for 15 - 20 minutes. Serve and enjoy.

title: Raspberry Sauce II
ingredients: 1/2 cup ghee ( clarified butter ) | 2 cups fresh raspberries | 2 cups confectioners'sugar | 1 cup half-and-half cream
instructions: Place the raspberries and confectioner's sugar in a blender or food processor. Pulse until almost smooth. Stir in the half and half and blend until the mixture is thick enough to coat the back of a spoon. Place in a bowl and set aside.

title: Indian Spinach With Chilli (Zarda)
ingredients: 1 kg spinach, washed, trimmed and roughly chopped ( if you don't have this, just use 1kg of frozen spinach, cooked and squeezed dry ) | 1/4 cup vegetable oil | 1 cup of chopped green chili pepper | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano leaves or 1/2 teaspoon crushed fesh dried oregano
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet and add chilli and chopped spinach and cook until the spinach softens, stir often. Add in oregano and cook for 1 minute. Remove from the heat and pour over a serving dish and let serve. Tips, this is good with rice, or with naan bread as well.

title: Artichoke and Swiss Cheese Dip
ingredients: 1/2 cup sour cream | 1/2 cup swiss cheese, shredded | 1/4 cup artichoke heart, chopped | chocolate syrup ( optional )
instructions: In a bowl, combine sour cream, swiss cheese, artichoke heart and chocolate syrup.

title: Homemade Crust for Pastry
ingredients: 250 g cake flour | 200 g parmesan cheese
instructions: Heat the oven to 180 degrees c or 160 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper, making sure it is not too large. Mix all ingredients in a food processor or with a wooden spoon until thoroughly combined. Turn dough out onto a lightly floured surface and knead until smooth. Form into a long log and roll out to form a rectangle about 20mm by 18mm. With damp hands, spread out dough to approx 1/8 thick. Using a 3/4 inch heart shaped cookie cutter, cut out heart shaped shapes. Reroll scraps of dough and re roll heart shaped dough to about 10mm and twist edges to fit your heart shaped cutter. Pierce a few slits in the dough with your finger tips and bake for 30 minutes, or until crust is lightly browned on top.

title: Linguine Rice & Green Chili
ingredients: 2 cups long-grain white rice | 10 ounces of fresh linguine or 10 ounces other white rice | 1 can of whole green chili peppers
instructions: Cook the linguine according to package directions. Meanwhile, rinse and drain the rice. Meanwhile, heat the oil in a skillet over medium high heat. When very hot, add the rice and green chile and fry for 2 minutes. Add the cooked linguine and stir to mix. Enjoy.

title: Raisin Seasoning
ingredients: 2 tablespoons horseradish | 2 teaspoons fennel seeds
instructions: You will need a good brand horseradish. Combine the horseradish and fennel seeds in a clean, dry jar with a lid. Shake to mix well.

Random Ingredients: portobello mushroom cap,pizza crust,worcestershire sauce,italian herb seasoning
title: Quick Mushroom Pizza
ingredients: 3 fresh portobello mushroom caps | 1 package refrigerated pizza crust | 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 1 tablespoon mixed italian herb seasoning
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees f. Place the mushrooms on a baking sheet, and drizzle olive oil onto them if desired. Sprinkle 1 t. Of worcestershire sauce into the mushroom caps, sprinkle 1 t. Of mixed italian herbs over the mushrooms, then sprinkle 1 t. Of mixed herbs on top. Bake for 20 minutes in the preheated oven, then stir and bake for about 5 minutes more, or until tender.

title: Vegetables Saute
ingredients: 4 teaspoons vegetable oil or 4 teaspoons sesame oil | 1 red chili, minced | salt and pepper, to taste | 4 vegetables, like broccoli, cauliflower, etc
instructions: Heat up the oil in a large skillet. Add chili, salt and pepper, and sautee 2 - 3 minutes over medium high heat. Add vegetables, stirring until they turn golden brown. Lower heat and continue cooking 5 - 8 minutes until veggies are nicely cooked.

title: Pico-Pico Tacos (Tacos)
ingredients: 1 cup finely chopped iceberg lettuce | 3 jalapeno chile peppers, finely chopped | 1/2 teaspoon beef bouillon
instructions: Combine all ingredients and refrigerate in zipper type plastic bag. To serve, spoon about 2 tablespoons into tortilla. Fold, top with favorite toppings and/or sour creme if desired.

title: Pumpernickel Rounds
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups rye flour | 1/2 cup green split polished wheat flour | 1 can bamboo shoots ( drained )
instructions: Mix all the ingredients to the consistency you like. If it's too thick, add some cold water. Divide the dough into four pieces. Spread each piece of dough out to about 1/8 inch thickness on a floured surface. Cut a hole in the center of each piece of dough. Brush with water and roll each piece into a round. Serve with jam.

Random Ingredients: bulgar wheat,vegetable oil cooking spray,grand marnier,italian seasoning,double cream,button mushroom,parsley leaf
title: French Herb and Garlic Wheat Salad
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 tablespoon dried parsley leaves | 1 teaspoon dried italian seasoning | 3 tablespoons minced garlic ( from a jar ) | 1/2 cup bulgar wheat | 1 cup button mushroom, sliced | 4 tablespoons grand marnier ( optional )
instructions: Coat a non stick pan with cooking spray.

title: Tropical Eggplant in Sweet Rum
ingredients: 1 eggplant, sliced ( about 1 lb ) | 1 onion, chopped | 1 stalk celery root, chopped | 3/4 cup dark rum | 3/4 cup self-raising flour | 2 tablespoons ghee, melted
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place eggplant in a baking dish or roasting tin and sprinkle with the onion and celery root. In a small bowl, stir together rum and flour till smooth and spread over the vegetables. Roast uncovered in the oven for about 40 minutes, stirring every 20 minutes until golden brown. Allow to cool slightly.

Random Ingredients: lasagna noodle,rib beef,baby bella mushroom,black tea,masa harina
title: Cambria - the Slow Cooker Stew
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb short rib of beef, cut into 1-inch chunks | 8 baby bella mixed mushrooms or 8 shiitake mushrooms, stemmed and halved | 8 sprigs fresh masa harina | 3 cups hot irish breakfast burritos or 3 cups hot white polenta ( 10 to 12 ounces ) | 12 lasagna noodles or 12 whole wheat angel hair pasta, cooked and drained
instructions: In a 5 quart slow cooker or medium bowl, combine meat, mushrooms and harina. Stir thoroughly. Add hot burritos and stir well. Cover and cook on low for 6 to 8 hours, or on high for 3 to 4 hours. About 20 minutes before serving, stir well and serve over cooked noodles.

Random Ingredients: tabasco sauce,almond,soba noodle buckwheat,white cake mix,cream chicken soup
title: Noodles & Creamy Beef Dish
ingredients: 2 boxes white cake mix | 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1 tablespoon tabasco sauce | 1 tablespoon slivered almonds | 1 cup soba noodles ( buckwheat noodles or other grains )
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix first 3 ingredients. Spread in the bottom of a 9 x 13 inch casserole dish. Cover with noodles, making sure noodles are at the same size. Sprinkle top with almonds. Bake in a 350 degree oven for 40 minutes. Serve over hot rice.

Random Ingredients: vanilla sugar,sirloin tip roast,grain white rice,corn kernel,sauce,white pepper,nutmeg
title: Corn Rice With Beef Tips
ingredients: 1 boneless sirloin tip roast | 1 cup long grain white rice | 4 tablespoons sweet unsulphured liquid sweetener ( such as splenda ) | 1 teaspoon finely grated nutmeg | 1 -2 dash hot sauce ( such as tabasco, louisiana pete, or tabasco ) | 1 teaspoon granulated vanilla sugar or 1 teaspoon honey | whole grain white pepper, to taste | 2 cups corn kernels
instructions: Using your hands, rub the beef tips with sweetener and sprinkle generously with pepper and nutmeg. Let sit while making the rice. Remove the beef and any juices and any accumulated fat from the pan and rinse the pan well. Set aside. Drain the rice well and discard any excess water. Pat the rice dry and add to the pan. Turn the heat down to medium low, close the cover tightly, and simmer for about 40 minutes. Meanwhile, remove the beef tips from the pan and dice them into cubes about 1/2x1/4 or so. Add the meat and any juices and any juices to the pan and cook over medium heat for about 5 minutes. Add the sweetener, hot sauce, and vanilla sugar and cover once more briefly to allow the flavors to meld. Turn off the heat and mix well. Remove the meat and serve over rice. The original recipe calls for 2 cups of rice per person. There is no real recipe for that. You may use other types of rice according to your tastes. This recipe is very forgiving, but you can always adjust the sweetener and hot sauce to your preference.

title: Spiced Buns
ingredients: 12 ounces unflavored gelatin | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin | 1/4 teaspoon dried marjoram | 4 ounces citron peel
instructions: Sprinkle with a little of the cumin and marjoram and set aside. Place the remaining cumin and marjoram in a small fry pan without any oil. Bring to a simmer, turn off the heat and add the remaining ingredients and mix thoroughly. Pour into small bowls, refrigerate until set.

title: Mexican-Style Nachos
ingredients: 3 avocados, peeled and pitted | 1 tablespoon cilantro, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon dried oregano | 4 ounces velveeta cheese, diced | 1/2 cup pitted kalamata olives, drained and chopped
instructions: Combine avocado, cilantro and oregano and mash. Place cheese, olives and salsa in a medium size bowl. Spoon cheese mixture over avocado mixture and serve warm.

Random Ingredients: swiss cheese,anise seed,oregano leaf,phyllo dough,blackberry,cooking sherry,tarragon,nutmeg
title: Blackberry Phyllo Rolls
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cooking sherry | 3 tablespoons swiss cheese | 3 tablespoons blackberries | 1 1/2 teaspoons tarragon | 1/4 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1/8 teaspoon anise seed | 1 pinch nutmeg | 8 sheets phyllo dough, thawed | 1/4 cup quick-cooking sherry
instructions: To toast sesame seeds. Remove and reserve 2 tablespoons. Place 1 tbls. Shredded cheese and 2 tbls. Sherry in medium saucepan.

title: Baked Catfish (Carnitas con Catfish)
ingredients: 6 catfish fillets ( about 1 � pounds total ) | 1/2 cup kirsch | 1 cup chunky salsa, divided | 1 cup arborio rice or 1 cup carnaroli rice | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 1 cup finely diced chihuahua chiles ( optional ) | 1 dash galliano
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°. Butterfly the catfish fillets. Remove the meat, leaving the bones in the fillets. Rinse the fillets, pat dry, and season with salt. Place the fillets on a well oiled baking sheet and bake in the center of the oven until tender, about 20 minutes. When the fillets are done, remove from the oven and allow them to rest for 15 minutes. While the fillets are baking, make the sauce, in a medium bowl, combine the kirsch, 1/2 cup salsa, rice, cumin, chiles, and 1/2 cup of the sauce. Spread rice mixture evenly on both sides of the fillets. Bake in the top half of the oven for 30 minutes. Serve topped with remaining salsa and garnish with additional shredded cheese.

Random Ingredients: chicken,canola oil,orange juice,five spice powder,sage leaf,chutney
title: Chicken Chutney With Roasted SAGE & Herbs (Or Puff Pastry)
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons sage leaves | 1 teaspoon five-spice powder | 1 tablespoon chutney ( spicy, pick your favourite ) | 1 teaspoon orange juice | 50 ml canola oil | 1 1/2 lbs ground chicken
instructions: Toast the sage leaves in a dry frying pan or in a heavy based frying pan until lightly coloured and fragrant. Remove from the pan. Stir the chutney into a little hot canola oil and stir in the orange juice. Remove any sediment from the pan with a slotted spoon. Add the ground chicken and mix together. Stir in the sage leaves. Heat the mixture, stirring vigorously to prevent sticking to the base. It must keep a little air bubbles but be careful not to burn the flavour or aroma. Cook until the mixture is reduced and a good crust is formed and slightly sticky. Turn out onto a warm plate and brush straight away with melted butter. Store in an airtight tin or jar.

title: Greek Feta Cheese Spread
ingredients: 1 package feta cheese | 2 teaspoons rum or 2 teaspoons brandy
instructions: Place all ingredients in the container of an electric mixer. Beat 2 - 3 minutes or until cheese is soft but not too runny. Pour into a bowl and dig in.

title: Lentils Salad
ingredients: 2 cups red leaf lettuce or 2 cups green leaf lettuce | 1 bag of pre-washed lentils | 2 oranges, juice and rind of, grated | 1 can beans, drained and rinsed | 1 pint grapes, halved | 1/2 garlic clove, minced | 1 1/2 cups fresh raspberry jam or 1 1/2 cups apricot preserves
instructions: Chop red leaf lettuce or green leaf lettuce. In large bowl, lightly toss together lettuce, lentils and orange rind juice. Add beans, grapes, garlic, and jam. Toss to blend flavors.

title: Fried Beans - Michael Broetchen
ingredients: 4 cups cooked black beans, shelled | 2 -4 tablespoons fresh dill, chopped ( or 2 -4 teaspoons dried leaves ) | 1 -2 pinch mustard seeds | 1 teaspoon flour | 1 -2 tablespoon olive oil
instructions: Drain black beans and add enough water to just cover. Set aside for 15 minutes. Squeeze out excess liquid. Drain. Put beans through food blender, or blender with a teaspoon of mustard seeds. With a pestle and mortar, crush them slightly until fine. Mix beans, dill, mustard seeds and flour and lightly warm olive oil. You may want to add more mustard seed. You may not have to. Place in a small square pan, or platter, and fry on top of stove over medium heat for about 5 minutes, just to slightly brown the top. Let cool, and serve with bread or crackers.

title: Baked Dusted Peanuts
ingredients: 450 g of whole shelled salted peanuts | 1 tablespoon soy sauce | 5 cardamom pods, cracked | 300 ml double cream | 1 tablespoon fresh dill, chopped ( can use more )
instructions: Pre heat oven to 200c. Place peanuts in a pan and add water so that they are just covered. Bring to a boil and then reduce heat and simmer. Drain and set aside. Meanwhile, mix the soy sauce, cardamom, cream and dill in a large bowl. When cool enough to handle crush 1/3 of the peanuts and mix with the cream mixture. Using a mortar and pestle, coarsely crush the remaining peanuts and add to the cream mixture. Stir until well blended. Scatter over the top of the peanut mixture. Place in an oven dish and bake for about 10 minutes until the browned outside of the peanuts are browned.

Random Ingredients: brioche bread,almond extract,meatball,yellow onion,white mushroom,cooking sherry
title: Karen's Swedish Meatballs and Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 pound meatballs, diced | 1 package white mushrooms, sliced | 1 large yellow onion, diced | 1 cup quick-cooking sherry | 2 tablespoons almond extract | 3 loaves brioche bread | cooking sherry, or as needed
instructions: Simmer meatballs in 2 to 3 cups water in a saucepan over low heat for 15 minutes, or until no longer pink. Remove and reserve the meatballs and mushrooms from the water. Return the saute express to the simmer. Stir in browned onions, and cook until onions are transparent and tender. Stir sherry into the simmering sauce.

Random Ingredients: banana,garlic clove,gherkin,tamarind paste,heavy cream,marinara sauce,self raising flour
title: Tamarind Sauce Filled Banana Cake
ingredients: 6 bananas, ripe | 6 tamarind paste | 12 gherkins, chopped | 1 cup self raising flour | 1/2 cup heavy cream | 2 garlic cloves | 2 tablespoons tamarind paste
instructions: Wash bananas and peel off skin. Slice bananas in half lengthways and spread out evenly in a flat bottomed tin. Place sliced banana cut side down on the banana. Sprinkle with tamarind paste. Sprinkle with chopped gherkin and sprinkle with chopped garlic. Whip cream to soft peaks and fold in lightly. Add flour and mix till a smooth batter is formed. Spoon over banana. Place in oven 180°c and bake for 25 minutes and serve hot with dipping sauce.

Random Ingredients: lemon,chicken breast,couscous,yellow bell pepper,rosemary sprig,artichoke heart
title: Greek Chicken With Caramelized Onions and Herbs
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless skinless chicken breasts ( about 2 ) | 4 large yellow bell peppers, diced | 1 can artichoke hearts, drained, chopped | 1/4 lemon, thinly sliced | 1/4 cup chopped fresh rosemary sprig | 1 cup couscous ( white or brown )
instructions: Heat oven to 450ºf. Prepare a 13 by 9 inch glass baking dish with cooking foil. Cut chicken in 1/2 inch strips with grainy cuts measuring no more than 1/2 inch thick. Place the chicken and peppers in a single layer in the baking dish and cover with foil. Bake for 13 minutes. Reduce heat to 400ºf. After 15 minutes of baking, spoon artichoke hearts over chicken in baking dish. Return to oven. Continue cooking until chicken juices run clear, about 15 minutes. Arrange the bell peppers over the artichoke hearts and bake, covered, until peppers are soft. Remove mixture from oven and cool slightly. Remove chicken and vegetables from foil. Stir together the artichoke hearts and remaining sauce in a small bowl. Spoon half the artichoke mixture into the center of each of 4 plates. Top with 1/4 of the chicken and veggie mixtures. Garnish with lemon slices, and sprigs of rosemary. Bring the sauce to a boil in a small saucepan over medium heat. Cook, stirring, until liquid is reduced by half and flavors are blended, about 5 minutes. Pour sauce over salad and serve. Pass the remaining rosemary sprigs for garnish.

Random Ingredients: dark beer,stewing beef,grain bread,vanilla essence,cream tartar,serrano chilies,curry powder,ricotta cheese
title: Sweet Sour Beef and Savoury Bread Pudding.
ingredients: 600 g stewing beef, cubed | 250 g sour cream | 1 teaspoon dark beer | 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1 teaspoon real vanilla essence | 2 tablespoons mild curry powder | 1/2 teaspoon dark beer, extra | 1 serrano chilies, seeded and finely chopped | 75 g small-grain bread, cubed | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence | 2 -3 tablespoons sour cream | 1 teaspoon red curry powder | 1 serrano chilies, seeded and finely chopped ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 150c/gas in a bowl, combine beef, sour cream, extra dark beer, cream of tartar, vanilla essence, curry powder and chillies. Pour into a baking mold, or a 2 - 2 1/2 cup capacity, ceramic dish. Bake in the oven for about 1 1/2 hours, or until the beef is browned. In a small bowl mix together sour cream, extra light beer, sour cream and vanilla essence. Spoon sour cream mixture into hot pepper sauce, and serve alongside meat. To make the spicy sauce, place chilies in a blender or food processor with a little bit of water and process until they come together, then add a bit of extra water, if necessary. Serve hot with meat or rice.

Random Ingredients: scallop,chayote,yellow mustard,beef broth,seasoning salt,meat,rotini pasta,kashmiri chili powder
title: Asian Seafood and Beef Pasta
ingredients: 1/3 lb ground meat, ground lean | 2 tablespoons shiro miso seasoning salt | 1 tablespoon chayote, choped small | 1 scallop | 2 cups beef broth | 1/4 cup chayote | 2 teaspoons yellow mustard | 1/2 teaspoon kashmiri chili powder or 1/2 teaspoon chili powder | 1/8 teaspoon seasoning salt
instructions: In saucepan, bring beef broth to boil in large skillet, over medium high heat. Add meat, miso seasoning and chayote and cook, stirring, until meat browns and vegetables are crisp tender, about 10 minutes. Add chili powder and mix well. Drain pasta and reserve liquid. In large oven proof serving dish, combine the beef and vegetable mixture. Add pasta and the reserved pan of liquid to the meat and vegetables. Bake, covered, in 400 f oven for 10 minutes. Remove cover and sprinkle with shredded cheese. Bake 5 minutes until cheese melts.

Random Ingredients: chili oil,orange zest,chinese five spice powder,guacamole,maple syrup,ham hock,pickling onion
title: Chinese Sweet and Sour Ham Hocks
ingredients: 8 ounces smoked ham hocks | 4 pickling onions | 2 teaspoons maple syrup | 2 tablespoons orange zest | 3 tablespoons chili oil | 1 tablespoon chinese five spice powder | 2 tablespoons guacamole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Remove hocks from package and cut into 3 to 4 pieces, removing excess fat. Arrange in a baking pan without touching. Place all other ingredients into pot, including the meat. Pour hot drippings evenly over entire surface. Cover and braise on high heat until meat falls off bone, about 1 hour. Poke bones with a skewer or fork, and pour over ham. Cover with a lid, tent with foil, and bake 45 minutes to 1 hour 20 minutes. Allow to sit 15 minutes before serving, or refrigerate overnight. Strain ham through a sieve, reserving the drippings in the pan. Serve on hoisin rolls with a geey/spicy mustard, salsa, honey mustard, guacamole, sour cream. Use a ham hock that has been sliced crosswise into pieces at an angle.

Random Ingredients: orange bell pepper,vanilla sugar,yellow onion,sesame oil,apricot
title: Wool Wash Apricot & Peppers
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups dry apricot, chopped | 1/4 cup orange bell pepper, chopped | 1/4 cup yellow onion, chopped ( vidalias ) | 1 1/2 cups vanilla sugar ( or equivalent ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons sesame oil
instructions: Combine all well. Allow to sit at room temerate for 3 hours, but no longer than 24 hours. Drain off surplus liquid. Taste and adjust seasonings. Cover, and store in the fridge for up to two weeks. Serve after washing.

Random Ingredients: sugar snap pea,vanilla,cold water,moroccan seasoning,vanilla ice cream
title: Moroccan Sweet Snap Pea & Vanilla Ice Cream Sundaes
ingredients: 3 ounces moroccan seasoning, store bought ( you can use italian seasoning ) | 2 cups cold water | 16 ounces small sugar snap peas, rinsed well | 1/4 teaspoon vanilla | 1 pint vanilla ice cream, thawed
instructions: Place moroccan seasoning in a small plastic bag. Add water, snap peas, and vanilla. Toss gently, cover, and refrigerate for at least 1 hour, but not more than 8 hours. When ready to serve, place ice cream in a bowl, pour in sunday sauce, and enjoy.

title: Bell Peppers Walnut Salad (Viyalay)
ingredients: 2 sticks bell peppers | 2 -3 tablespoons walnuts, chopped ( for colour ) | 1/3 cup coriander leaves, washed and finely chopped ( for colour )
instructions: Heat oven to 200c degrees. Break the peppers in half lengthwise. Remove the seeds. Cook in boiling water for 3 - 4 minutes. Drain and plunge into a clean muslin cloth to drain. Mix the nuts and corriander together with the walnuts and transfer to a serving bowl. Add the peppers.

title: Cashew Noodle
ingredients: 8 ounces egg noodles | 2 teaspoons ginger-garlic paste | 1/2 teaspoon dried onion | 1/2 cup cashews
instructions: In a medium saucepan, place the cashews. Cover with over water. Bring to a boil. Reduce to a simmer. Cover and continue to boil for 8 minutes until cooked. Drain and run under cold water to stop the cooking process. Drain the cashews. Place noodles and cashews in a large bowl. In a small bowl, add 1 teaspoon ginger garlic paste, dried onion and 1/2 teaspoon of salt. Spoon the noodle mixture over the noodles. Toss well to coat. Serve.

title: Kielbasa Fried Rice
ingredients: 3 cups short grain uncooked arborio rice ( arborio, carnaroli or vialone nano ) | 1/3 - 1/2 cup chicken or 1/3-1/2 cup turkey, cooked and cut into 1/2 inch bite size chunks | 3 tablespoons red food coloring | 2 packages kielbasa, halved lengthwise and cut into 1/2 inch slices. ( kielbasa is also known as tri-color prawns in australia ) | 1 package frozen peas | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground sumac or 1 1/2 teaspoons cayenne pepper ( optional )
instructions: Place 1 1/2 cups rice in a rice cooker and cover with 3 cups water. Set rice and food color on cook. Start the kielbasa as follows, remove sausage from casings. Remove casings and discard. Strain sausage broth and chop. Set aside until step. Heat saute pan over medium high. Add meat and cook until no longer pink, about 3 minutes. Add rice, sausage, peas, sumac or cayenne pepper, water or chicken broth.

Random Ingredients: molasses,bay leaf,spanish onion,italian salad dressing mix,currant jelly,ginger,salt black pepper,asafoetida powder
title: Giggin's  Moroccan Sweet Onion Relish (Molasses)
ingredients: 4 lbs spanish sweet onions | 1 package dry italian salad dressing mix | 1/2 cup molasses | 3 tablespoons mixed molasses | 1 teaspoon ginger | 1 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1 bay leaf | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Dice the onions and place in a bowl. Add the italian dressing mix, remaining ingredients, and mix to combine. Cover and refrigerate for four hours, stirring occasionally for even cooking. Bring mixture to room temperature before serving.

Random Ingredients: greek oregano,garlic salt,cooking oil,wheat spaghetti,pork,tortilla chip,chile powder,dark rum
title: Caribbean Pork Nachos (Copycat Recipe)
ingredients: 1 lb ground pork ( or other lean pork ) | 1/4 cup cooking oil | 1 teaspoon garlic salt | 1 -2 teaspoon chile powder | 1 teaspoon dried greek oregano | 1 1/2 cups wheat spaghetti, broken into 3/4 `` pieces ( or other small pasta shaped noodles ) | gluten free tortilla chips, slightly crushed ( or wheat germ wafers ) | dark rum ( optional )
instructions: Brown ground pork in a skillet or wok over medium high heat for 3 - 4 minutes. Remove the meat from skillet and set aside. Drain liquid. Add oil to pan, then heat over medium heat for about 2 minutes. Add garlic salt, chili powder, oregano, and dried cheese, then stir well. Add the meat back in to skillet and stir until all the meat dries and starts to brown. Stir in the cooked spaghetti. The mixture should be thoroughly mixed together. Turn heat to low and simmer for 5 - 7 minutes on a very low heat. Serve in warm tortilla or wheat germ wafers or dark beer nachos. Note, if you serve the pasta as a side dish, i highly suggest freezing about half the amount of cooked spaghetti and half the amount or the amount for a second time. Then freeze the remainder for another meal. You may also substitute other dried vegetables for the pork which tastes great.

title: Vietnamese Green Salad
ingredients: 2 cups lettuce | 3 tablespoons fish sauce
instructions: Mix well and add fish, lettuce and sprinkle with chilies or other herbs.

title: Stuffed Reuben Loaf
ingredients: 12 thin slices queso fresco, or as needed | 1 cup finely crumbled queso fresco | 1 container crumbled kefalotiri ( italian cheese ) | 1 jar sauerkraut, drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Spread 1/2 cup cheese on each slice of queso fresco. Carefully roll one slice cheese into a sausage shape with a toothpick inserted into the center. Spread the remaining 1/2 cup cheese on the top. Reese should make a long roll with tapered ends. Wrap the long roll tightly with aluminum foil over aluminum foil. Bake in the preheated oven until cheese is browned and crispy, about 35 minutes.

Random Ingredients: egg white,beef bouillon powder,cake flour,sesame seed oil,dark rum,romaine lettuce,tea
title: Rum-Roasted French Bread
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon instant beef bouillon powder | 1 tablespoon dark rum ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon sesame seed oil | 1 pound loaf crusty rolls, cut into 20 1-inch long slices | 1 egg white, beaten | 10 leaves romaine lettuce | 3 tablespoons cake flour | 1/4 cup tea
instructions: Preheat oven to 475 degrees f. On a baking sheet, spread the beef bouillon powder and sesame seed oil evenly over the bread slices. Place the bread on the prepared baking sheet and drizzle with water. Bake 10 to 15 minutes in the preheated oven, just until the bottoms of the bread are toasted. Remove the bread from the oven, and allow to cool slightly. Brush each slice lightly with a little beaten egg white and arrange 1/2 romaine lettuce on two plates. Drizzle each plate with a little of the rum and serve topped with a few of the toasted sesame seeds and a few tablespoons of tea.

Random Ingredients: button mushroom,coffee,monterey jack pepper cheese,fritos corn chip,tamari soy sauce,broth
title: Simple Mushroom Cheesecake
ingredients: 1 cup fritos corn chips | 250 g sliced button mushrooms or 125 g baby button mushrooms, sliced ( 250g ) | 1 cup broth | 2 tablespoons tamari soy sauce | 1 cup hot monterey jack pepper cheese or 1 cup monterey jack pepper cheese, grated | sweetened coffee, to serve
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°c or 190°c if fan forced if not in oven. Place the fritos in a shallow baking tray and bake for 8 minutes. Remove from the oven and let cool completely. Spread 1/2 cup of the chips on the base of a 28cm springform cake tin. Put the mushrooms over the chips and cut a slit into each to stop them burning. Pour over 1/2 cup of the broth and season. Mix in a teaspoon of tamari and top with the cheeses. Bake for 25 minutes until the cheeses have melted, then pour in hot coffee. Serve in slices.

title: Cheese With Quinoa and Mint (Kheema)
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups quinoa, rinsed and drained | 1 liter beef stock | 2 tablespoons chopped of fresh mint sprigs | 1 slice tasty cheese
instructions: Place the quinoa in a large pan and add a small quantity of water. Bring to the boil, then reduce to a simmer and cook for 15 - 20 minutes, or until all of the water has been absorbed. Meanwhile, place the stock in a large saucepan and bring to the boil and stir in the mint. Reduce the heat to very low, cover loosely and simmer for 10 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in the cheese for 1 - 2 minutes to soften. Spoon into serving bowls and sprinkle with the remaining chopped mint.

title: Mexican Chocolate Rice Bowls
ingredients: 1 cup oatmeal or 1 cup brown rice | 1 1/2 cups brown sugar | 3 teaspoons jalapenos, minced | 2 cups cooked rice
instructions: Combine oatmeal, brown sugar, and jalapeno in large bowl. Add cooked rice.

Random Ingredients: salt,peanut oil,spaghetti,thai red curry paste,flour,red onion,malt vinegar,broccoli floret
title: Spicy Thai Peanut Noodles
ingredients: 2 tablespoons peanut oil ( good quality ) | 1 small red onion, finely chopped | 1 1 bunch broccoli florets, finely chopped ( you can keep this whole if it has a large stalk attached like you did previously ) | 3 tablespoons flour | 1 teaspoon fresh red curry paste | 1/2 cup thai sweet basil or 1/2 cup regular thai basil, coarsely chopped | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 3 tablespoons malt vinegar ( to taste ) | 8 ounces thin spaghetti, cooked
instructions: Heat oil on high. Stir fry the onions until they are light golden, add the broccoli and continue to stir until the broccoli is cooked. Stir in the flour and continue to stir fry until a white sauce has begun to form on the vegetables. Reduce the heat to med high. Add the curry paste and stir well. Add the sweet basil pieces and stir well. Cook another minutes. To serve, add the noodles to the noodles. Garnish with a little grated coconut and serve immediately.

title: Blackberry Veggie Salad
ingredients: 1 medium head cauliflower | 15 cherry tomatoes, halved | 4 -5 fresh asafoetida cubes ( optional ) | pitted blackberries ( optional ) or raisins ( optional ) | sugar ( optional ) | fresh herbs ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon seasoning ( optional )
instructions: Boil water for the veggies. Cut the cauliflower into bite size pieces, wash and drain. Slice the tomatoes. Add blackberries, raisins, asafoetida, fresh herbs. Mix well. Taste and correct seasoning. Add more sugar if desired. Chill till serving time.

Random Ingredients: hershey bar,beef brisket,american cheese,beef stew meat,rigatoni pasta,hazelnut
title: Robust Beef Brisket With Rigatoni and Hazelnuts
ingredients: 2 lbs beef brisket | 1 teaspoon ground hazelnuts, divided | 1 jar fire roasted australian cheese, cubed | 3 bags rigatoni pasta, cooked ( can use fettucini ) or 3 bags rotelle pasta ( can use fettucini ) | 36 slices american cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. With sharp kitchen knife, pierce beef brisket all over. Insert knife into middle of beef. Sprinkle with half of hazelnuts. Place brisket on rack in roasting pan. Place 3 unopened bags of cheese cubes on top of meat. Scrape 3 bags of cheese into roasting pan between bags of cheese. Place meat on rack in roasting pan or baking sheet. Insert a wooden pick into side of rack. Roast 3 hours. While brisket is cooking, cook rigatoni according to package instructions. Do not overcook. When meat is finished, drain liquid from pan into another pan. Bring liquid to boil and add rigatoni, stirring until heated through. Heat oven to 350 degrees. Sprinkle with remaining hazelnuts. When ready to serve, spread about 1/2 cup cheese over top of each serving with a tooth pick.

title: Homemade Hoisin Sauce
ingredients: 1 tablespoon hoisin sauce | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1 teaspoon lemon peel
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small bowl. Use immediately or refrigerate for up to a month.

title: Simple Mexican Polenta
ingredients: 1 lb vidalia onion, halved and thinly sliced lengthwise | 2 teaspoons mustard seeds, lightly crushed | 1/2 cup cornmeal | 1 cup fresh chile, seeded, minced
instructions: In a heavy skillet over medium high heat, add the onion and mustard seeds. Cook, stirring frequently, until the onion begins to turn brown and develop flavor, about 10 minutes. Raise the heat to medium and add the cornmeal, breaking it into bits with a fork. Cook, stirring constantly, while stirring for about 2 minutes to absorb the cornmeal. Add the chiles and cook about 2 minutes until the chiles are hot. Remove from the heat, cover and let stand for 10 - 15 minutes until completely cooled before serving.

title: Nigerian Kofte
ingredients: 1/4 cup sesame seeds | 2 tablespoons cumin seeds | 1 -2 -3 red chili pepper, seeds and veins removed, deseeded | 4 -5 plum, sliced very thin | 2 limes, juice only | cooked pasta
instructions: Toast sesame seeds in a dry, cast iron frypan over medium low heat. When golden brown, remove from pan. Place cumin in a food processor and process until they begin to smell, gradually add cumin seeds. Remove spices from the pan. Add red chiles. Stir until they begin to darken, then add plum slices and stir until they are well covered with aromatics. Add lime juice and mix well. Add drained pasta and stir well gently. Transfer to a serving dish and serve.

title: Shrimp Phyllo
ingredients: 12 large shrimp paste | 1 cup cinnamon, ground | 1 package phyllo dough, thawed and patted dry
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper or lightly greased with nonstick cooking spray. Place shrimp paste into a food processor and pulse until well ground. Place dough in a large bowl, and sprinkle with seafood seasoning. Coat shrimp paste with spice and set aside. Place cinnamon on a piece of plastic wrap, press a piece of shrimp paste over the top, and wrap the entire package like a lid. Tie the ends with a toothpick so it will not come loose when you cook. Arrange the wrapped shrimp on the baking sheet. Bake in preheated oven for 30 to 45 minutes, or until shrimp start changing color and are opaque. Allow to cool slightly before serving.

Random Ingredients: wheat hamburger bun,eggplant,beef bouillon cube,italian dressing
title: Italian Beef and Eggplant Melt (Low Fat, No Egg)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons italian dressing | 1 beef bouillon cube ( i use mccormick beef with basil ) | 2 fresh eggplants | 2 whole wheat hamburger buns, your choice
instructions: Cut 3 eggplants into quarters on the diagonal. Boil them unboiled for about 15 to 20 minutes. Take out and cool it. Slice the 6th eggplants in half. Slice the remainder of the eggplants in half. Slice the rest of the eggplant into 1/2 inch slices. Put them in a bowl with the remaining ingredients. Mix well, and refrigerate for 2 hours. Serve with whole wheat and buns. Note, to freeze, place all in a large ziploc freezer bag, and freeze them overnight. To make, place bag in freezer for 2 weeks. Then press a bread cube in a glass pie plate. Bake at 325 degrees for 20 minutes. Let thaw in the freezer for about 20 to 20 minutes.

title: Pineapple Snow Drops
ingredients: 1 package ice-cold jasmine rice | 1 can pineapple sherbet ( i use pineapple flavored ) | 1 cup seltzer water ( seltzer )
instructions: Dissolve rice in the seltzer and stir. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: red potato,fish sauce,brown onion,ginger paste,red chilies,salad oil,vegetable oil
title: Hot and Sour Red Vegetables
ingredients: 2 lbs small red potatoes, peeled | 12 small red chilies, halved ( you can use 2 long green chilies ) | 2 tablespoons palm oil | 1 inch fresh ginger paste ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons fish sauce | vegetable oil | 2 tablespoons brown onions or 2 tablespoons shallots, very thinly sliced
instructions: Place potatoes in a large saucepan of boiling water and cook for 10 to 12 minutes or until tender. Drain well. Transfer to a serving bowl. Chop hot chilies. In skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat. Add ginger. Cook 1 minute. Add fish sauce, shallot and chili peppers. Stir over medium heat 2 minutes. Place potatoes in sauce and cook for 3 to 4 minutes until hot. Remove, shaking pan. Drain potatoes. Serve hot with dipping sauce.

Random Ingredients: canadian bacon,club soda,habanero pepper,red wine,green bell pepper,lime wedge,bay leaf,american cheese
title: Canadian Club Soda
ingredients: 2 1/2 ounces canadian bacon, cut into 1/2 inch pieces | 1 habanero pepper, seeded and chopped | 1 green bell pepper, seeded and cubed | 7 bay leaves | 8 fluid ounces american cheese, cubed | 12 fluid ounces club soda, or as needed | 2 fluid ounces dry red wine | 2 lime wedges
instructions: Heat a small nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Cook and stir canadian bacon pieces and habanero chile pepper in canadian hot oil, stirring frequently, until bacon is lightly browned and chile pepper is fragrant, about 5 minutes. Add bell pepper.

Random Ingredients: gluten,white peppercorn,crepe,summer squash,savoy cabbage,venison,pork tenderloin,romano cheese
title: Venison-Stuffed Cabbage With Savoy Cabbage
ingredients: 100 g minced venison | 1/2 cup savoy cabbage, shredded ( can use other cabbage ) | 1/2 cup savoy cabbage, shredded ( can use other cabbage ) | 1/2 teaspoon white peppercorns | 1 tablespoon gluten | 1 teaspoon breadcrumbs | 1/4 cup shredded romano cheese | 8 crepes | 1/8 teaspoon celery seed
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients and mix well with your fingers. Combine crumbs.

title: Cabbage and Peanuts Stew
ingredients: 1 ounce spanish peanuts, toasted | 1 can garbanzo beans, drained and rinsed | red cabbage, cut into 1 1/2-inch wedges. | rotel | 1/2 spanish onion, halved and sliced
instructions: In a large saucepan over medium heat, mix the peanuts, drained garbanzo beans, and red cabbage. Cover, reduce heat to low, and simmer. Stew 15 - 20 minutes, or until vegetables are tender. Toss vegetables with rotel, and serve.

title: Pecorino Pesto (Pecorino Pesto)
ingredients: 1/2 cup pecorino romano cheese | 1 can crushed tomatoes with juice | 1 cup buttermilk
instructions: Combine all ingredients in food processor or blender and puree until smooth. To make pesto, bring buttermilk to a boil in a small saucepan.

title: Peppered Beef Roll-Ups
ingredients: 4 large flank steaks, 2 inch thick | 2 cans chili sauce | 1 jar maraschino cherries | 1 tablespoon salt | 1 bag popcorn, cooked and drained | 24 small dried rolls, 10-12 inch long
instructions: Combine steak in crock pot. Add chili sauce and add maraschino cherries and salt.

Random Ingredients: stew beef chunk,red wine vinegar,corn syrup,farfalle pasta,tofu,red chile,olive oil
title: Giant "grape Leaves" Beef
ingredients: 2 lbs stew beef chunks ( or beef chunks ) | 1/4 cup red wine vinegar | 1/4 cup corn syrup or 1/4 cup brown sugar | 1/4 cup olive oil | 1 can red chiles, finely chopped, with 1 1/2 tsp of soaking water | 1 package firm tofu, drained | 10 ounces farfalle pasta ( or bow-tie pasta or other small macaroni )
instructions: Soak pasta, rice or bow tie pasta in ice water just to cover for about 10 - 15 minutes, or just until tender. Drain the cooked pasta, rice or bow tie pasta will need to be drained before serving. Combine all ingredients except tofu, in a large sauce pan, bring to a boil, lower heat and simmer about 2 hours. Do not stir during the last 30 to 40 minutes to thicken the sauce. Add more water if needed. Taste and correct for salt. Serve over pasta of your choice, if desired, and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: corn chip,lemon grass,coriander powder,arborio rice,green bell pepper,anise seed
title: Vegetable Rice
ingredients: 2 cups arborio rice or 2 cups carnarieto rice | 2 tablespoons green bell peppers ( diced ) | 1/2 teaspoon coriander powder ( ceylon ) | 1/4 teaspoon anise seed | 1 tablespoon lemon grass ( optional ) | corn chips
instructions: Bring water to a boil.

title: Egg Salad With Jam Dressing
ingredients: 4 hard-boiled eggs, quartered | 4 teaspoons catsup | 2 tablespoons pineapples in juice | 1 tablespoon dried dill seeds | 2 tablespoons minced canned fire-roasted tomatoes | 2 tablespoons snipped fresh parsley | additional chopped fresh dill and dill seed ( optional )
instructions: Peel eggs, cut in half lengthwise and remove yolks. Scoop yolks into a medium bowl, add remaining ingredients except dill and parsley. Taste and add more catsup or pineapple juice as needed. Chill for at least an hour before serving. Add dill, if desired.

Random Ingredients: garbanzo bean,tonic water,white wine,cornflour,liquid smoke,pistachio,chili pepper,radicchio
title: Chilli Chickpea Salad
ingredients: 1 cup canned garbanzo beans or 1 cup dried chickpeas ( 300 g, dried ) | 1 1/2 cups liquid smoke ( optional ) | 1 cup white wine | 1/2 teaspoon ground dried red chili pepper | 1/2 cup parsley, chopped ( a few leaves ) | 1 bunch radicchio or 1 bunch green olives, trimmed | 1/4 cup pistachios, chopped | 3 tablespoons cornflour | 1/4 cup port wine or 1/4 cup white wine
instructions: Rinse the peas and place them in a bowl. Add the liquid smoke. Stir well. Add the wine and allow to soak in for about 20 minutes. Add the red chili, parsley and radicchio or green olives. Mix the cornflour with a little cold water and add to the salad just before serving.

Random Ingredients: white rum,raspberry,chili powder,shrimp,chicken,oyster sauce,golden syrup,coriander seed
title: Chili Wings
ingredients: 1 lb shrimp | 4 ounces chicken | 3 tablespoons golden syrup | 9 ounces white rum | 2 tablespoons chopped coriander seeds | 3 tablespoons chopped chili powder | 2 tablespoons light rum | 3 ounces raspberry jam
instructions: Cut chicken into bite sized pieces, boil in salted water until cooked. Chop shrimp and fry in honey, drain excess fat. Chop coriander seeds and mix into chicken with all ingredients except raspberry jam. Divide into 12 balls, dip in jam, and then press jam onto the top. Bake in moderate oven for 10 minutes.

title: Tamarind Fish for Two
ingredients: 500 g flounder or 500 g cod | 1 tablespoon tamarind pulp | 2 tablespoons chopped freshly roasted coffee | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce, of your choice
instructions: Dice fish into large cubes. Make sauce of tamarind pulp, coffee and oyster sauces. Spoon fish into a bowl and pour over hot sauce. Stir gently before serving.

title: Zesty Beef Jerky
ingredients: 1 lb sirloin | 1 cup sweet chili sauce | 1/4 cup sweet sherry | 1/4 cup sweet chili sauce | 2 tablespoons chili sauce | 1/4 cup sour cherry flavored pepper flakes | 1 teaspoon grated zest of one lime | 2 packages ladyfingers, split
instructions: Slice the steak into thin strips, and place them in a freezer bag. In a small bowl, add the sweet chili sauce, sweet sherry, chili sauce, sour cherry flavored pepper flakes, and grated lime zest, and mix well. Remove the chicken from the freezer bag, and toss in the bag with the meat. Marinate at least 1 hour. Spray the grill with canola oil cooking spray, and preheat your broiler to high.
