When the broiler is ready, thread the strips of meat onto the skewers lengthwise, and set them on a rack. Put the rack under the broiler and broil about 6 minutes, or until the meat is a nice golden brown color and no longer looks raw outside. Serve warm or at room temperature with a dipping sauce.

title: Beef Brisket & Eggs
ingredients: 1 beef brisket, well trimmed | 2 egg whites | 1 cup beef stock
instructions: Place brisket in 9x13 inch pan. Beat egg whites to hard boiled stage. Pour egg whites over brisket. Bake in preheated 350° oven for 1 hour. Let stand ten minutes before carving. Slice across the grain. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: self raising flour,goat meat,dark chocolate,garlic,beer,sage,hamburger bun
title: Chile Colorado III
ingredients: 4 fluid ounces beer | 8 fluid ounces self-raising flour | 1/2 fluid ounce goat meat | 2 ounces dark chocolate chips | 1 clove garlic | 3 leaves fresh sage | 1 hamburger bun, toasted
instructions: In a measuring cup, mix beer, flour, goat meat, chocolate chips, garlic, sage and mushrooms. Fill buns with meat mixture.

title: Homemade Dressing
ingredients: 1 tablespoon garlic paste | 1 tablespoon dry mustard ( coleman's preferred, but the flavor will not be the same )
instructions: Use the garlic paste and mix thoroughly with remaining ingredients, using just enough to get the mixture right. Refrigerate for 24 hours to allow flavors to blend. Enjoy.

title: Candy Melts
ingredients: 24 pineapple rings | 2 pounds lean ground buffalo meat
instructions: Preheat oven to 250 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Place the pineapple rings on the prepared baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until the pineapples become golden brown, about 15 minutes. Remove from oven, and set aside. Increase oven temperature to 375 degrees f. Place ground buffalo meat in a large bowl. Break the pineapple meat apart as needed, to release and distribute seasonings. Drain grease from the pineapple. Arrange pineapple rings on a baking sheet. Cover, and bake in the preheated oven until the meat is browned and the pineapple is soft, about 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: garam masala,italian salad dressing mix,fish sauce,ginger,active yeast,celery
title: Thai Pizza Dip and Chips
ingredients: 1/4 teaspoon active dry yeast, active dry | 1 teaspoon garam masala, sweetened | 1 teaspoon ginger | 1 packet italian salad dressing mix | 2 tablespoons fish sauce | 1 can canned chipotle-flavored stewed fish | 1/4 cup chopped celery
instructions: Dissolve yeast and 1 teaspoon garam masala in enough lightly salted water to make a soft but not runny paste, about 5 minutes. Stir together yeast and 1 teaspoon garam masala in a small bowl. Stir in ginger, dressing mix, fish sauce and 3 cups of the liquid from the canned chipotle chilies in a bowl. Stir into bread mixture and set to the side. Bring remaining cup of the reserved liquid to boil in a skillet. Add celery and 1 tablespoon garam masala.

title: Ricotta Pasta With Chili Oil and White Wine (Pasta Con Vino E Pancetta)
ingredients: 1 lb farfalle pasta ( bowtie pasta ) | 1 package white american cheese, cut into 1-inch chunks | 1 cup ricotta cheese or 1 cup low fat cottage cheese | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon chili oil, to taste | 1/2 tablespoon white wine or 1/2 tablespoon red wine vinegar
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. Drain pasta and reserve a cup of the water, it will not be used immediately. In a large bowl, mix together the cheese and chile oil. Add the pasta to the cheese mixture and stir to coat the pasta. Pour the reserved pasta water into the cheese and pasta mixture. Dump in the pasta and toss lightly with a fork to combine. Serve piping hot.

Random Ingredients: liverwurst,brown mustard seed,banana,shrimp,italian salad dressing mix,heavy whipping cream,oregano,raisin
title: Liverwurst, Shrimp and Banana Salad
ingredients: 1 package liverwurst ( or other lean sausage ) | 1 tablespoon italian salad dressing mix | 1 teaspoon italian salad dressing mix | 1 teaspoon brown mustard seeds | 2 bananas, sliced | 8 -10 fresh shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1/4 cup raisins | 1 dash italian dried oregano | 1 carton large heavy whipping cream
instructions: In heavy skillet, bring cream just to a boil. Remove from heat. Add mustard seed.

title: Beer and Egg Drop Beef With Cabbage Rice
ingredients: 6 pork chops | 3 cups long grain rice | 1 small head green cabbage | 1/4 cup low-sodium mirin | 1/2 cup light beer ( use beer if you use beer but not low sodium ) | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon hot pepper flakes | 5 ounces bittersweet chocolate
instructions: Place pork chops in a 3 qt. Dutch oven or dutch oven and lightly spray with shortening. Sprinkle with salt. Cook over med high heat, turning once, until browned. Transfer to a platter and cover with foil. Remove all but 1 tbsp of water from the pan. Heat remaining fat in the skillet. Drain rice and discard. Add cabbage, mirin and beer, stir to blend and cover and cook over med. Heat, stirring often, over med. Heat until cabbage is just beginning to brown, around 5 minutes. Stir pork and cabbage mixture into rice and bake uncovered, stirring occasionally, until rice is tender and pork starts to flake when thickest part of the chop is cut into half or quarters, about 3 - 5 minutes. Reduce heat to low and place covered platter over rice for 5 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, remove pork and cabbage mixture to a platter and serve.

title: Italian Spinach on the Side
ingredients: 2 bags fresh spinach | 1 bottle zesty italian salad dressing
instructions: Place the spinach in a pot of salted water, and cook over medium high heat for 2 to 5 minutes, or until just wilted. Drain, and allow to cool. Blend in a blender the zesty italian dressing, and spinach until all of the greens are mixed. Chill 4 to 8 hours before serving.

title: Rice and Tomato Risotto
ingredients: 1 cup basmati rice | 1 can italian-style crushed tomatoes with juice | 1/3 cup chopped milk chocolate or 1/3 cup semisweet chocolate | 2 cups milk chocolate
instructions: Cook rice as instructed above. Let cool completely. Topping, melt chocolate in metal bowl and pour over top of rice. Place a large serving plate on top. When chocolate is melted, swirl melted chocolate on top of rice and set aside.

title: Käsemmeln (Käsemmelbraed)
ingredients: 3 lbs beef short ribs, cut in pieces | 3 tablespoons caraway seeds ( optional )
instructions: Heat oven to 350°f rub caraway seeds into ribs, about 1/2 a teaspoon is the amount of fragrance the caraway seeds gives. Bake ribs, turning occasionally for 15 minutes. Cool, then cover and refrigerate for at least 3 hours, or overnight. Transfer ribs to a serving dish and cover with hot water, making certain that water covers the ribs. Bring to a simmer and reduce heat to low. Cover and bake for 1 to 1 1/2 hours, or until ribs are tender and the liquid thickens slightly. Remove from oven and let rest for 10 minutes. Slice and serve.

title: Tender Fluff Bread
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cream of tartar | 1 tablespoon turbinado sugar
instructions: Set oven rack into middle position and preheat the oven to 275 degrees f or 200 degrees c. Lightly grease a large baking sheet and set aside. Random Ingredients: green bean,kielbasa,golden raisin,leek,greek yogurt,green chili,celery leaf
title: Greek Kielbasa, Green Beans & Leeks
ingredients: 8 ounces green beans, cut in 1 inch slices | 2 stalks leeks, split in 1-inch pieces | 1 cup halved green beans | 2 tablespoons greek yogurt, plain greek style | 1 leek, white part only, sliced | 1/4 lb kielbasa, cut across the grain into small chunks | 1 teaspoon green chili, minced | 1 teaspoon golden raisin, dried, crushed
instructions: Cook kielbasa and onion in nonstick skillet on medium heat about 5 minutes or until crisp. Stir in green beans, leeks, green beans and yogurt. Cover and reduce heat to low. Cover and cook for 8 - 10 minutes or until the sauce is thickest. Uncover and sprinkle with chili, stir before serving.

title: Spicy Shrimp Bites
ingredients: 1 medium shrimp | 1/8 teaspoon annatto oil | 60 wonton wrappers | 1/4 cup raspberry jam or 1/4 cup strawberry jam | 1 tablespoon mirin | 1 piece white bread or 1 piece dry bread, crust
instructions: Shell and devein the shrimp. Place a heaping teaspoon of the shrimp, not quite all the way though, in the center of each wonton wrapper and pinch in the edges. Brush the edge with a little of the jam and place a finger on the top of the wonton. Fold the filled wonton over the shrimp and crimp it shut with a fork. Cook the bites according to the instructions on the package, adding more jam to the sauce if desired. Serve hot. Keeps well in the refrigerator for a few days. Shrimp are not recommended for consumption outside of the family.

title: Soup Stock
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups dried shiitake mushrooms | 2 tablespoons sifted cake flour | 2 teaspoons dried dried dried onion flakes | 10 fresh mint leaves
instructions: Wipe out the mushrooms with damp cloth, and coarsely chop the caps. Set aside to dry. Put the mushroom caps in a heat proof bowl, pour over boiling water, and let swell for 5 minutes or so. Drain and remove the stems, and finely chop the caps. Remove any hard parts, and finely chop the onion. Turn on the stock pot to low heat, and stir in the flour, dried onion flakes, and chopped mint leaves. Cook for a few minutes, then remove from the heat. Store in a cool place for up to 6 months.

Random Ingredients: cake flour,pistachio,american cheese,za'atar spice mix,rum,plain yogurt,red chile
title: Za'atar Party Fritters
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups plain yogurt ( regular or light ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons sesame or 1 1/2 teaspoons instant chocolate-flavored instant coffee granules | 3/4 lb american cheese, grated ( use the type of american cheese you like best or a combination of your choice, such as a white cheddar and gorgonzola ) | 1 red chile, finely sliced ( to taste ) | 2 teaspoons rum ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon za'atar spice mix | 1/2 cup chopped pistachios, toasted ( optional )
instructions: Combine all filling ingredients in a bowl. Place mixture in the fridge until ready to use. When ready to prepare, spoon into a nice glass dish and add some pistachios if you like.

title: Rosemary Red Beans for Two!
ingredients: 1 can red kidney beans, drained | 1 tablespoon confectioners'sugar | 1 sprig fresh rosemary
instructions: In a large bowl, mash beans with sugar with a fork, until soft and bubbly. Tear rosemary needles from stems and add to beans along with remaining rosemary. Transfer to serving dish and sprinkle with confectioners' sugar.

Random Ingredients: red food coloring,basmati rice,ancho chile,ziti pasta,white rum
title: Ziti Al Piño (Puerto Rican Ziti)
ingredients: 1 package ziti pasta ( uncooked ) | 3/4 cup white rum | 2 tablespoons dried ancho chiles ( ground ) | 2 tablespoons dried ancho chiles ( ground ) | 2 1/4 - 1 3/4-1 cups basmati rice, rinsed and drained | 1 -2 drop red food coloring
instructions: Prepare ziti and drain. Preheat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit. Coat a 9x13 baking pan with cooking spray. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add ziti and cook for 8 minutes, or until cooked through, stirring occasionally. Drain. Transfer to a large mixing bowl. Add rum, ground ancho and rice, mixing thoroughly. Pour into baking dish. Dot with a fork. Pour hot water into baking dish to reach at least half a cup height. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes, or until golden. Turn off oven and allow ziti to sit for a few minutes and then turn off oven and allow to sit for a few more minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: celery leaf,ham,bouquet garni,thyme sprig,caper,strawberry preserve,lumpia skin
title: Lumpia
ingredients: 1/4 lb raw ham ( about 20 slices ) | 2 tablespoons pickled capsicums or 2 tablespoons pickled jalapeno peppers, minced | 2 tablespoons fresh thyme sprigs ( about 5 small fresh ) | 1 bouquet garni | 4 lavender cups or 4 other mixed salad greens, such as boston berry-flavored greens like arugula, oak berry-sauce or boston berry-flavored greens, such as boston berry-sauce | 12 frozen miniature lumpia skins | 1 tablespoon finely snipped fresh thyme or 1 teaspoon dried thyme
instructions: Use quick or storebought shears to cut the ham into pieces about 1/4 by 2 inches. The key is quick cuts and dullness in the color. Slice the ham into 3/4 to 1/2 by 1/4 strips about 3/4 inch wide. Combine the ham and capsicum in a small bowl and sprinkle with the thyme, bouquet garni and lavender or other herbs. Cover and chill 15 minutes. Arrange the lumpia rounds on a baking pan or tray large enough to hold them. Ladle 2 heaping tbsps mixture in a straight line down the center of each round. Bake 15 - 18 minutes or until golden, turning the rounds once. Remove from the oven. Place a small spoonful of jam or preserves onto the roll. Garnish with thyme or other herbs.

title: Shrimp and Macaroon Quinoa Risotto
ingredients: 4 cups whole milk ( or skim if you prefer ) | 4 ounces quinoa, rinsed | 2 ounces baby shrimp | 1/4 lb macaroons or 1/4 lb sliced deli cheese | 1/3 cup marsala wine | 1 cup cooked small shrimp ( or 1 cup uncooked shrimp )
instructions: Note, i think this looks like you'll need 4 quinoa or 4 cup arborio. Cook half the shrimp while the quinoa is rinsing up to help thaw out raw sugar. Place quinoa in a medium saucepan and pour 2 cups hot water directly over it. Set aside. Drain the shrimp, if using, and set aside. Cook the rest of the shrimp in the 2 cups hot water. When they are just pink and slightly firm, remove them from the saucepan with a slotted spoon and place them back into the saucepan with the shrimp. Repeat until quinoa is cool enough to handle. This step can take anywhere between 10 to 15 minutes. I like to leave the shrimp a bit firm so it can cook without getting mushy. If using a pan of water, simmer quinoa according to package directions. Add macaroons and cook on medium, stirring constantly until hot, but not browned. Add the shrimp and continue to stir. Turn off the stove. You should end up with a thick creamy white sauce. If you feel like a whiffs of shrimp in your mouth, go ahead and stir in a little cornstarch or milk a few tablespoons at a time until you have the right texture. Taste for any other adjustments, adding more cheese, marsala or shrimps if needed. Rice should be a bit cheesy and slightly soft and creamy. Add the rest of the hot tap water and let it come to a boil. The rice shouldn't be soggy.

title: Irish Style Worcestershire Sauce
ingredients: 1/3 cup worcestershire sauce | 1/2 cup dry parsley | 2 1/2 cups water | 1/4 teaspoon white pepper
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large jar. Close lid and shake vigorously. Store in refrigerator. Note, the worcestershire sauce will keep for up to 8 days in fridge.

title: Mango Creme Fraiche
ingredients: 1 large ripe mango, peeled, seeded, and chopped | 10 cardamom pods, bruised | 1/2 teaspoon allspice | 6 fluid ounces double cream
instructions: Place mango, cardamom pods, and allspice in a blender with the cream. Puree until desired consistency is achieved. Pour into serving glasses and refrigerate until cold.

title: Khao Salami (Indonesian Condensed Spices)
ingredients: 1 cup light coconut extract | 8 lettuce leaves ( to garnish )
instructions: In a small saucepan, combine coconut extract and ¼ cup water. Cook over medium heat until mixture comes to a boil and remove from heat. Line a serving platter with lettuce leaves, leaving a narrow side of the lettuce leaves on the edge. Carefully pour a scant ¼ cup of the hot liquid over the leaves. Serve immediately. Note, serve as a condiment to a food or veggie dippers.

Random Ingredients: italian dressing,allspice berry,rice vermicelli,veal,phyllo pastry,beef chuck,coffee
title: Veal Triangles (Beef Noodle-Beef Phyllo Pie)
ingredients: 12 ounces frozen phyllo pastry ( thawed ) | 2 lbs boneless beef chuck, cut crosswise into 1/2 inch slices | 1 packet dried italian dressing | 1/2 teaspoon ground allspice ( may use 1 t salt or 1 t sugar ) | 1 tablespoon instant coffee, warmed | 4 1/2 cups steamed rice vermicelli, cooked according to package directions ( about 3/4 cup uncooked and cooled ) | 8 sheets phyllo pastry
instructions: Place sheets of phyllo on lightly greased parchment. Brush with 2 t l dressing and sprinkle with 2 t of allspice. Place 1 slice of beef between 2 sheets of phyllo and pound with a meat tenderizing mallet. Repeat with layers of phyllo, meat and another 1/2 t of allspice and 1 t of ground coffee. Continue using phyllo sheets, brushing each stack with more dressing and pounding with meat tenderizing mallet and remaining spice. Top with thawed noodles. Cover with 2 sheets of phyllo and continue making phyllo stacks until there are 8 sheets of phyllo. Repeat. Cut each stack into 12 portions and arrange on a lightly greased baking sheet. Cut each stack in half crosswise and place 3 phyllo halves under each square. Spread with remaining dressing and top with remaining phyllo pieces. Sprinkle top with remaining 1 tsp of allspice. Bake in a preheated 375 degree f oven 35 to 40 minutes until phyllo is golden and crisp.

title: Pinchies
ingredients: 1 lb phyllo pastry, defrosted | 20 leaves fresh sage ( or 1/2 tsp dried ) | 1 teaspoon sage, for sprinkle on pie ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Put the leaves of fresh sage in a bowl and mix in a tiny pinch of sage. You can also put them into a food processor along with the sage. Cut the sheets of phyllo into 5 sheets, roll each one into a tight roll with the long edge facing you. Brush each with a little sage and place on a baking tray lined with parchment paper. Pinch or roll to a 12 by 10 inch rectangle. Sprinkle with salt and pepper if desired. Brush with a little sage. Prick the pastry all over with a fork. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes or until golden brown. Serve with butter.

Random Ingredients: vanilla sugar,cream tartar,avocado,green chili salsa,granny smith apple,brown mustard seed,red wine
title: Baked Apples With Creamy Chipotle Creamy Sour Cream
ingredients: 2 lbs gourmet apples ( cortland is my favorite ) | 3/4 cup green chili salsa ( mild, medium or hot ) | 1/4 cup dry red wine | 1 tablespoon instant brown mustard seeds | 1 tablespoon cream of tartar | 1 1/2 teaspoons vanilla sugar ( or another sugar substitute ) | avocado ( optional )
instructions: Wash apples and remove ends. Core apples, cut in half and transfer to nonstick baking pan in a single layer. Set aside. Combine salsa, wine, mustard seeds and cream of tartar and set aside. Pour sour cream mixture over apples and bake 30 to 40 minutes or until apples are soft. Top with guacomole, avocado and sour cream.

title: Fish Stew With Tomatillos and Sauteed Green Beans
ingredients: 3/4 lb rutabaga, peeled and diced | 1/2 lb green beans, trimmed and cut in half diagonally | 1 cup chopped tomatillo | 3/4 teaspoon anise seed | 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme leaves | 1/2 cup fish stock ( or water ) | 1 ripe avocado, sliced
instructions: In a large skillet, saute rutabaga in oil about five minutes over medium heat. Meanwhile, in another skillet, saute tomatillos and mustard seeds for 1 - 2 minutes about 2 minutes. Then add the thyme and stock, cook for 10 minutes over medium heat. Put skillet back on medium high heat. Arrange rutabaga in skillet and cook about 5 minutes or until lightly golden. When rutabaga is nicely browned, add tomato mixture. Cook about 2 minutes another over medium heat. Serve hot.

title: Cafe Mexi Picadillo
ingredients: kosher salt | 12 ounces fish fillets | 1 ounce butter, melted | 2 tablespoons olive oil | 1 jar pitted kalamata olives | 1/2 cup drained drained capers, rinsed | 8 ounces mozzarella cheese, shredded | 4 teaspoons snipped fresh cilantro leaves
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium high heat. Coat with cooking spray. Dip the fish fillets 3 - 4 times in olive oil and season with salt. Add the butter and olives.

Random Ingredients: butternut pumpkin,pepperoni,dark soy sauce,tomato basil garlic
title: Warming Sun-dried Tomato Soup
ingredients: 1 lb butternut pumpkin, peeled and cubed | 1 package refrigerated pepperoni, cubed | 1/2 cup dark soy sauce | 1 can chopped tomatoes with basil garlic
instructions: Cook squash in a large pot with water to cover for 10 minutes or until tender. Drain and mash. Add pepperoni, soy sauce and tomatoes. Heat soup and serve.

title: Nacho Beef Burgers
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger | 1 teaspoon vinegar
instructions: Fry the hamburger, drain, put back in pan, put on paper towel and sprinkle with salt and pepper. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: gin,ketjap manis,sourdough french bread,hoisin sauce,caster sugar,cilantro
title: Hoisin Bread and Sourdough Salad With Hoisin
ingredients: 1/2 cup hoisin sauce | 1 1/2 tablespoons sweet sourdough french bread ( half a loaf ) | 2 tablespoons ketjap manis ( sweet soy sauce ) | 2 1/2 tablespoons caster sugar | 1 tablespoon gin or 1 tablespoon dry sherry | 1 tablespoon chopped cilantro
instructions: To make dressing, combine hoisin sauce, sugar & soy in a small bowl and stir until sugar dissolves. Add gin & cilantro and then add dressing to bread and add to bread. Toss to combine.

Random Ingredients: chicken thigh,cream mushroom soup,chicken thigh fillet,ra el hanout spice mix
title: Easy Delicious Crock Pot Chicken and Ra el Hanout
ingredients: 6 skinless chicken thigh fillets ( approx 1 lb ) | 12 ounces sour cream ( light cream is a good substitute ) | 3 cans cream of mushroom soup ( use low fat if you wish ) | 1 -2 tablespoon ras el hanout spice mix ( optional )
instructions: Lay out the chicken fillets and lightly sprinkle all over with a 1/2 tsp of the ras el hanout powder. Mix the soup and sour cream together and drizzle over the chicken. Add the chicken and any juice to the crock pot and cook on low for 6 hours. When ready to enjoy, check the thickness the chicken is going to need and add more soup, sour cream and seasoning according to your taste.

title: Dynamite
ingredients: 1 bag dixie roast beef ( about 8-12 pounds ) | cinnamon or salt
instructions: Trim any large pieces of fat from the roast. You don't matter how big the pieces are. Sprinkle the surface of the roast with cinnamon, salt or other spices. Heat on grill for about 20 - 30 minutes, or until the fat has become caramelized and browned enough to coat the meat. Serve with potatoes, as a sandwich, or with a salad.

title: Fantastic Fajitas
ingredients: 1 cup lard | 1/4 cup grated orange zest | 1 tablespoon taco seasoning | 3 teaspoons baking soda | 2 cups lard, melted
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. In a medium bowl, beat 1 cup lard with 1/4 cup zest until light. Stir in taco seasoning powder and baking soda until lard is completely melted and well blended. In separate medium bowl, combine the remaining tablespoon of lard with melted butter. Stir egg white into the melted butter. Add the white sugar, if using. Dip 1/4 cup fajitas into the melted butter and coat with the white sugar/butter mixture. Place on a baking sheet and bake for 10 minutes.

title: Quick and Easy Flank Steak
ingredients: 6 pounds boneless round steak, pounded thin | 6 pounds squash, peeled and cut into long thin slices
instructions: Lay the steak flat on a cutting board and poke holes in it with a fork. Press each piece in the holes for a criss cross pattern. Place the squash slices in a large pot and cover with water. Bring to a boil over high heat, then cover and simmer until tender, 30 to 45 minutes. Drain and discard any remaining liquid. When cool enough to handle, cut the steak into strips about 1/4 inch thick and 3x3 inches long, and thread onto long, thin bamboo skewers. Broil or grill for about 3 minutes per side, brushing with additional cooking liquid as necessary.

Random Ingredients: pesto sauce,pork shoulder,american cheese,basmati rice,baby carrot,asafoetida powder
title: Cheese Stick With Carrots
ingredients: 3 1/2 ounces american cheese | 14 -16 ounces baby carrots, shredded | 1 teaspoon crushed asafoetida powder | pesto sauce | 2 -4 ounces basmati rice, cooked, cold | pesto sauce | 1 tablespoon white american cheese, grated
instructions: Put all ingredients, except rice, in a blender and pulse until smooth. Put in a dish. Sprinkle top with freshly grated cheese. Serve on its own or in a bowl. If you have any leftover cheese sticks, just cut a small piece of cheese into strips or cubes to serve as a garnish.

Random Ingredients: graham cracker crust,sunflower oil,spice,hazelnut,parmigiano reggiano cheese,beef
title: Pastel De Noci (Ground Beef and Hazelnut Patties)
ingredients: 1 package refrigerated graham cracker crusts | 1 tablespoon sunflower oil | 2 cans sliced hazelnuts, well drained | 1 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1 lb lean ground beef or 1 lb ground turkey | 1 tablespoon roasted mixed spice, see note
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit. Roll out one graham cracker crust into an 11 x 7 inch rectangle and place into a 12 nonstick baking sheet. Trim the crusts of the crust from top to bottom. Lightly spray crust with cooking spray. Using a large wooden spoon, spread the sliced hazelnuts onto the crust and sprinkle evenly with parmigiano. Using your hands, press down hard. The nut butter will melt and bind it with the cheese and moisten it while pressing down. Repeat with the remaining crust and hazelnuts. In a large nonstick frying pan, heat oil and brown hamburg, stirring to crumble. Drain if needed, then transfer to food processor and add the ground beef. Pulse nuts until finely crumbly and season with the roasted mixed spice. Press this mixture into the dough and allow to rest at room temperature for approximately 20 minutes or until crust has cooled slightly. Place in refrigerator to firm up. Using a 1 lb. Weight, roll out the other graham cracker crust and cut into squares or triangles. Place patties on lightly greased baking sheet and bake for about 20 minutes or until lightly browned on the edges. Let cool for 5 minutes on baking sheet, then remove to warm plate, covering. Continue cooking until all patties are done keeping in a warm oven. Serve family style.

Random Ingredients: bouquet garni,red bell pepper,broccoli,chicken bouillon cube,purpose flour,lager beer,beef brisket,walnut
title: Steak With Broccoli, Walnuts, and Red Pepper Pot
ingredients: 4 lbs beef brisket | 1 teaspoon instant chicken bouillon cube | 1 teaspoon all-purpose flour | 3 cups frozen broccoli | 3/4 cup chopped red bell pepper | 1 bottle lager beer or ( 750 ml ) bottle pale ale, of mod | 2 tablespoons walnuts, chopped | 1 bouquet garni
instructions: Rub meat with bouillon cube thoroughly, inside and out. Place beef in large dutch oven or roasting pan and cover with water about 1/2 way up the side of the meat. Bring to a boil and cook over medium heat about 20 minutes, or until beef is easily flied with a fork. Remove beef and keep warm. Skim fat from liquid remaining in pan. Blanch broccoli 5 minutes, drain and set aside. Add red bell pepper, onion and walnuts to pan and toss. Return beef and any accumulated juices to pan and simmer 4 - 5 minutes or until reduced by half. Strain liquid evenly, and remove thick stalks and any bones. Serve the steaks with the broccoli mashed potatoes. Note, if using frozen broccoli, defrost and remove stalks and reserve. Makes 6 servings. If using fresh broccoli, defrost and remove stalks and reserve. Serve steaks with mashed potatoes and garnish with slivered almonds and parsley if desired.

Random Ingredients: red wine,red kidney bean,corn,italian parsley,french bean,thyme sprig,bicarbonate soda,spice
title: Baked Beans and Veggies
ingredients: 2 lbs red kidney beans | 2 cups corn | 2 cups french beans | 1 1/2 cups fresh italian parsley | 4 cups sweet mixed spice | 1 cup red wine | 1 tablespoon bicarbonate of soda | 1 tablespoon thyme sprigs
instructions: Pre heat oven to 200c/400f degrees celsius. Place everything into a roasting tin and place into the oven for 2 - 3 hours. The tomatoes should be tender and the beans soft and crunchy. I also added a little sherry to give crunch.

Random Ingredients: cheddar cheese,brown sugar,vanilla ice cream,cool whip,anchovy fillet,gruyere cheese,confectioner sugar,chive
title: Anchovy Gratin Appetizers
ingredients: 1/2 cup brown sugar | 1/4 cup confectioners'sugar | 4 ounces shredded cheddar cheese | 1/4 cup shredded gruyere cheese | 3/4 cup shredded swiss cheese | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh chives | 2 teaspoons chopped fresh chives | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla ice cream | 1 can anchovies in water or anchovies, drained and minced | 4 cups prepared vanilla ice cream | 1/2 cup confectioners'sugar | 1/8 teaspoon ground cinnamon
instructions: Combine the brown sugar and confectioners' sugar in a bowl of an electric mixer on low speed until well blended. Increase speed to high and add cheddar and gruyere cheeses, swiss cheese, green chives, chives, vanilla, and ice cream. Beat on low speed until smooth. Place 6 scoop of vanilla ice cream on each of 4 serving plates. Spoon 1/2 teaspoon of anchovy flavored ice cream onto each of the 4 ice cream cups. Spread 1 tablespoon of cinnamon on each of scoops of the scoops and serve.

title: Raspberry Crumble-Munch
ingredients: 1/3 cup whole wheat flour | 1 teaspoon ground ginger | 1 package frozen raspberries, thawed | 1 cup part-skim mozzarella cheese, shredded
instructions: Preheat oven to 375f degrees. Sprinkle flour, ginger and mozzarella cheese into a large bowl. Stir in thawed raspberries. Spread mixture evenly into a greased 8x8 x2 inch baking dish. Bake 30 minutes or until top is just lightly golden brown and topping is bubbly.

Random Ingredients: cumin powder,jalapeno,italian sausage,cream cheese,catalina dressing,romano cheese,dijon mustard,chili bean
title: Mexican Cat Chili
ingredients: 2 lbs mild italian sausage ( remove casings ) | 2 packages cream cheese | 6 jars chili beans, undrained ( i prefer the spicy beans ) | 1/8 cup catalina dressing ( or to taste ) | 3 tablespoons dijon mustard or 3 tablespoons spicy creole mustard | 1/3 cup grated romano cheese | 1 -2 tablespoon cumin powder ( depending on how much heat you want ) | 1 jalapeno, seeded and chopped
instructions: Brown the sliced sausage and drain excess fat. Add all the remaining ingredients and simmer 30 minutes for a thicker chili. Serve with crushed tortilla chips or tortilla chips.

title: Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 1 lettuce leaf | 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon
instructions: Open and wipe off the head of lettuce. Pull the outer leaves out of the lettuce and tear them into manageable pieces. Spread a scant 2 tablespoon of cinnamon on top of the lettuce. Roll the lettuce up and eat with your fingers or a fork. Place in a napkin shaped serving bowl and sprinkle with a generous pinch of ground cinnamon.

title: Pasta With Snapper, Avocado and Parmesan
ingredients: 1 1 lb medium red snapper, cleaned and scaled | parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1 avocado, ripe, peeled, pitted and cut into 4 wedges
instructions: Heat oven to 350 degrees. Rinse and dry off both snappers.

title: Sweet Sushi Rolls
ingredients: 1 tablespoon mirin | 1 tablespoon sugar | 2 1/2 teaspoons baking powder
instructions: Mix all ingredients together, and brush over cold tops. Allow to cure.

title: Rosemary French Toast
ingredients: 12 thick slices bread, buttered | 1/2 cup lemon juice | 1 jar of chopped preserved rosemary
instructions: Place one round of bread on counter. Mix together lemon juice and rosemary. Dip bread to make bread into egg. Fry on both sides. Serve hot. Makes one large bowl of egg bread stuffing for a stacked french toast.

Random Ingredients: asparagus,green chile,corn syrup,almond extract,oyster sauce,port wine,beef,beef bouillon cube
title: Spiced Steak With Asparagus
ingredients: 1/2 cup corn syrup | 2 tablespoons corn syrup | 1 tablespoon beef bouillon cubes | 1/3 cup port wine ( or other dry white wine ) | 2 1/2 lbs top sirloin steaks, cut into thin strips | 1 1/2 teaspoons almond extract | 1 1/2 cups medium cut asparagus | 4 green chiles, sliced thin
instructions: Prepare the marinade, in a heavy 2 to 3 qt. Saucepan, whisk together the corn syrup, corn syrup, bouillon, and port. Add beef strips and marinate at least 8 hours or overnight. In another 2 to 3 qt. Saucepan, cook asparagus in hot water until crisp tender, about 2 to 3 minutes. Drain and then shake asparagus to dry. Set aside. In a bowl, combine the almond extract, asparagus, chilies and corn syrup mixture tostado and blend well. Serve the beef mixture with asparagus mixture.

title: Easy Light Skillet Beef Stroganoff
ingredients: 1/2 - 1 lb ground beef | 1 cup fat free vegetable broth or 1 cup low sodium vegetable broth | 4 slices rye bread | crushed ice
instructions: In a 12 - 12 inch skillet.

title: Garam Masala
ingredients: 10 whole black peppercorns | 1/4 cup parsley leaves, washed and finely chopped | 1 teaspoon cardamom seed
instructions: Grind the black peppercorns to a coarse powder in a clean coffee grinder/mixer. Keep aside. Heat a non stick frying pan using medium flame. Add cardamom seeds. Once they crackle, add the parsley leaves and cook until aroma is gone. Stir in the ground peppercorns. Now, add the ground peppercorns mixture. Mix well. Allow to cook for 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Allow to cool for few minutes. Transfer the garam masala onto a serving plate and serve.

title: Mexican Skillet Halibut
ingredients: 4 ounces halibut fillets | 1/2 cup nonfat milk | 1/4 teaspoon msg ( or to taste ) | 1/2 teaspoon dry lemon zest | 1/4 cup mexican blend cheese | 1/2 medium bananas or 1/2 medium egg product | macaroni
instructions: In a shallow dish, combine all but fish. Add fish. Cover and marinate on refrigerator 12 hours or overnight. Cook macaroni according to package directions. Drain and top with sauce. Add shredded cheese. Serve.

Random Ingredients: oil,green chilies,bay leaf,black bean sauce,arrowroot,wensleydale cheese,ladyfinger,plain yogurt
title: Vegetable and Black Bean Fritters or Loaf Cakes
ingredients: 1 tablespoon oil | 1 packet ladyfingers, split | 1 can chopped green chilies | 1 bay leaf | 150 g reduced-fat plain yogurt | 3 1/2 cups black bean sauce | 1/4 cup worcestershire sauce | 1 1/4 cups 2 % low-fat milk or 1 1/4 cups 2 % low-fat milk
instructions: Heat oil in a frying pan and fry ladyfingers in batches, cooking gently on each side until golden and crisp. Drain on kitchen paper. Heat sauce, worcestershire sauce and milk in a saucepan, stirring over medium heat. Bring to boil, stirring until boiling. Pour over hot cooked ladyfingers. Serve with grated cheese, sprinced green chilies and a dollop of plain yoghurt.

Random Ingredients: lemon zest,coconut milk,dark chocolate,red potato,french lentil,cream cheese
title: Rich Lentils and Potatoes With Chocolat
ingredients: 1 cup french lentils, washed ( approximately ) | 1 sweet potato, washed and cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 small red potatoes or 1 small other sweet potato, washed, peeled and cut into 1-inch cubes | 7 ounces light cream cheese, peeled, washed and cubed | 4 ounces desiccated coconut ( unsweetened ) | 2 tablespoons lemon zest | 100 g dark chocolate, coarsely chopped
instructions: Boil the french lentils and sweet potato in water to cover until the lentils are just tender. Drain and set aside. Cut into 1 - ½ inch cubes. Combine the lemon rind, 1/4 teaspoon salt and coconut in a bowl. Mix all well and allow to rest for 15 minutes. Drain off any excess water from the lentils and sweet potato. Transfer to another large serving bowl, add the cream cheese cubes and stir well to form a smooth paste. Add the lentil mixture, sweet potato cubes and coconut mixture. Mix lightly and evenly. Sprinkle with the dark chocolate pieces. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: iceberg lettuce,anaheim chilies,white flour,catsup,chinese wine,bacon dripping
title: Chilies in Garlic With Bacon and Wine
ingredients: 1 head iceberg lettuce, cleaned and shredded | 2 -3 anaheim chilies, roasted, peeled and seeded | 250 g white flour | 1/2 cup catalato hot bean sauce or 1/2 cup catsup | 100 g bacon drippings | 1/2 cup chinese wine
instructions: Place the shredded lettuce in a small bowl and cover with cold water and microwave for 10 - 12 minutes or until tender, but still bright green. Drain well and cool then place the lettuce in a large bowl. Peel the anaheim chilles leaving the stem intact. Place the chilies in the blender or food processor with one third of the flour and 1/2 cup water or if using fresh chilies with 2 tablespoons of water just enough to make a paste. Blend. Place a third of the paste in a blender or processor and process to form a paste. Repeat twice more. Add 1/2 cup water or brandy and blend. Set aside. Place 1 tablespoon of the bacon drippings in a small saucepan and cook over a moderate heat until the oil is absorbed. Add a third of the paste and cook over a medium heat for 5 - 6 minutes stirring to make sure that the oil does not burn. Place all the sautéed paste and chopped vegetables into a clean blender. Add the vinegar and process in a food processor, food processor or blender. Add the remaining flour and water or brandy and process until desired consistency is achieved. To serve, place a lettuce leaf on each plate. Place 2 tablespoon of the chalese sauce on top of the lettuce and then top with the bacon drippings and slices of bacon.

Random Ingredients: nigella seed,english muffin,cocoa,leek,extra virgin olive oil,chili sauce,orange bell pepper
title: Chili Muffins
ingredients: 1 teaspoon extra virgin olive oil | 12 english muffins, grilled, toasted | 1 -2 tablespoon mild chili sauce, sriracha | 2 leeks | 1/4 red bell pepper, julienned | 1 orange bell pepper, julienned | 1/2 teaspoon nigella seeds ( optional )
instructions: Seed leeks and slice into 1/4 pieces lengthwise. Set leeks aside to sweat for 15 minutes or so in the microwave. Heat up olive oil and heat chili sauce in small frying pan.

title: Swiss Cheese & Olive Tapenade (No-Messy)
ingredients: 3 ounces cream cheese, softened | 1/4 cup turbinado sugar | 1/4 cup finely chopped coriander or 1/4 cup coarsely chopped flat leaf parsley | 1 jar medium green olives, drained and chopped | assorted fresh herb pickling spices, such as chervil, dill, parsley, dill pickle, rosemary and crushed red pepper flakes
instructions: In a medium bowl, cream together the softened cream cheese and sugar. Beat in coriander. Stir in olives and herbs. Cover and refrigerate 8 hours or overnight. Serve chilled or room temperature.

title: Asparagus Peking Pork With Peach Salad
ingredients: 1 boneless pork tenderloin, trimmed | 2 1/2 cups mixed asparagus, trimmed | 3 1/4 cups romaine lettuce ( webb lettuce preferred ) | 1 peach, fresh quartered, halved and sliced to fit into the center of the pork ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f score the surface of the pork, on one side only, with knife marks, using paring knife or sharp knife. Cut a slit lengthwise down the center, at 1 1/2 inches intervals, making sure to cut deeply. Open out center cut with a knife, but not through the bread. Place pork in roasting pan and rub pork with 1/2 of the asparagus, all of the cut vegetables, and 1/2 of the torn basil into the cuts, using a large spoon. Place beef on top of pork and place roasting pan on center rack in oven. Bake for 40 minute or until pork is just cooked. Cool on rack. Remove fat from the roasting pan. Add remaining asparagus, lettuce, peach slices, and remaining 1/2 of torn basil. Toss and serve atop pork.

title: Spicy Beef & Swiss Skewers
ingredients: 12 ounces cooked swiss cheese, cut in small chunks | 1 lemongrass, stalk about half inch long | 1 bunch rosemary ( leaves only ) | 1 teaspoon chopped chili-garlic sauce | 1/2 teaspoon honey | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne | 4 cups corn
instructions: Trim the top of the corn, and break into thirds for easy removal after seeding. Trim off the root end of your lemongrass stalk, and discard. Slice the lemongrass stalk into 1 inch pieces, removing the white bulbs and the remainder of the stalk. Cut the lemongrass bulb into 1 inch lengths, keeping the leafy portion,. Cut the swiss cheese into cubes about 1 inch long, removing any hard outer layers or damaged ones. Combine all ingredients, except the corn, in a medium bowl and blend. Add the corn and mix well. Cover and refrigerate overnight to allow the corn to absorb the flavors. Soak wooden skewers for a few hours or overnight in boiling water. Heat a cast iron grill or an electric stovetop griddle over medium heat. Grill corn for 2 - 4 minutes per side or until the cheese is melted. Takes about 2 minutes per side for rare, or 8 - 10 minutes for medium.

title: Roasted Peppers Vinaigrette
ingredients: 4 medium green peppers | 4 red peppers | 2 tablespoons vinegar | 1 tablespoon grated horseradish | 2 teaspoons crushed anise seeds
instructions: Wash and dry peppers. Place in a heavy skillet. Add remaining ingredients. Cover and roast 20 to 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: crabmeat,italian tomato,orange flower water,cocoa,turmeric powder,almond extract
title: Chocolate Crab Stomach Recipe - Easy Version
ingredients: 8 ounces crabmeat ( or fresh ) | 14 ounces italian-style crushed tomatoes | 1 tablespoon almond extract | 2 teaspoons unsweetened cocoa | 2 teaspoons orange flower water | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric powder
instructions: Mix together the crushed tomatoes, almond extract, cocoa, orange water, and turmeric in a bowl. Add the crab meat. Mix until mostly covered with the liquid. Pour into a small baking dish and refrigerate for an hour or two to set the liquid.

title: Chicken Drumsticks in French Dressing
ingredients: 20 chicken legs, drumsticks | 1/2 cup french dressing, homemade is best, or as needed ( use 2 tbsp of prepared dressing per chicken ) | 5 hard-boiled eggs, peeled, quartered
instructions: Preheat the oven to 475 degrees fahrenheit. Line a rimmed baking sheet with aluminum foil. Spread the chicken legs onto the foil and coat them with the french dressing.

Random Ingredients: apple cider vinegar,red pepper flake,granny smith apple,greek yogurt,chili paste,spice,arugula
title: Grapefruit & Red Pepper Dip
ingredients: 500 g greek yogurt ( thick or greek style ) | 250 g red peppers, finely chopped | 150 g granny smith apples, finely chopped | 1 splash chinese rice wine or 1 splash apple cider vinegar | 100 g arugula, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon spices ( or your favorite spice ) | 2 -3 pinches red pepper flakes, if preferred
instructions: Mix all ingredients together, taste adjust seasoning, and pour into a bowl as a dip or dressing. Serve with fresh tomatoes, apricots, or sweet plantains. May also be served with fresh fruit, and sweet bread.

Random Ingredients: button mushroom,olive oil,creole seasoning,bengal,arborio rice,kumara,glace cherry
title: Baked Mushrooms, Kumara and Peppers
ingredients: 1 lb kumara ( peeled, diced ) or 1 lb pumpkin ( peeled, diced ) | 1 tablespoon olive oil | 1 tablespoon creole seasoning | 8 button mushrooms ( sliced ) | 12 glace cherries ( cut in half ) | 1 cup arborio rice | 1 cup of freshly steamed sweet bush ( drained ) or 1 cup bengal rice
instructions: Place the kumara on a baking tray lined with baking paper, sprayed with oil and bake in a preheated oven at 350 degrees for about 40 minutes, until tender. Meanwhile add the olive oil to a separate pan over medium high heat and add the mushrooms and cook for 5 minutes, stirring frequently. Add the cherries to the mushrooms and cook a further 2 or 3 minutes. Stir in the rice, cherries and seasoning. Cook for a further 3 minutes. Serve topped with the kumara and cherry halves.

title: Fresh and Simple Fish
ingredients: 1/2 kg white fish fillet | 2 tablespoons plum tomatoes, chopped
instructions: Place a large knob of butter on a large plate. Season the fish fillets on both sides and scatter over the chopped tomatoes. Bake on a flat shelf on the centre shelf of the oven for 20 minutes, then reduce the temperature to a low setting and cook for 10 - 15 minutes, or until the fish is cooked. Allow to stand for 5 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: citron,baking potato,lasagna noodle,bamboo shoot,cream chicken soup
title: Mom's Amazing Vegetarian Lasagna
ingredients: 2 lbs baking potatoes ( about 2 medium ) | 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1 can sliced bamboo shoots | 1/2 cup crushed citron | 4 sheets lasagna noodles
instructions: In a large bowl, mix the cream of chicken soup, drained bamboo shoots and citron. Place noodles in a 9 x 13 inch baking dish and layer with soup mixture. Place sliced mushrooms on top. Cover with foil and bake at 375 degrees for 30 minutes or until hot.

title: Mim's Gluten Free Golden Syrup
ingredients: 1 tablespoon plain gluten free brown sugar ( gluten-free ) | 1 tablespoon white sugar | 2 teaspoons vanilla
instructions: Heat oven to 300 degrees f. Mix together brown sugar, sugar and vanilla in a small pot over low heat. Cook until the vanilla melts and gets a bit of a light amber color. Add the warm water to the mixture and stir to dissolve the sugar. Bring to a boil. Pour mixture into a well buttered dish, pouring some onto the sides. Let cool and set. You can store in an airtight container at room temperature for up to 5 days.

Random Ingredients: rice vinegar,tuna water,thyme,chili oil,cannellini bean,penne pasta,red wine
title: Tuna and Pasta in Chili and Beans
ingredients: 1 can cannellini beans ( drained canned beans ) | 1 tablespoon chili oil | 1 cup dry red wine | 1 tablespoon rice vinegar | 1 teaspoon dried thyme | 1 can tuna in water, drained and flaked | 1 lb penne pasta, cooked
instructions: Saute the cannellini beans in the chili oil until the beans are cooked through and beginning to dry out. When the beans are fully cooked, add the wine, vinegar and thyme and cook for about 15 minutes. Toss the drained tuna, cooked beans and cooked penne with the sauce. Serve warm.

title: Nerdle's Mint Beer Chips
ingredients: 24 ounces light beer, room temp | 1/2 cup bottled chopped fresh mint | 6 ounces shredded italian cheese blend | 1 tablespoon chipotle powder | 4 large lime wedges
instructions: To make mint beer, combine all ingredients in an airtight container.

title: Peach Barbecue Sausages
ingredients: 1 can peaches | 2 tablespoons liquid smoke
instructions: Mash or blend the peach with the liquid smoke. Remove the peel from the peaches. Heat your smoker on the highest heat and place the sausage links in for 2 minutes per side, or until nicely browned on the outside.

title: Italian Peppers and Slices
ingredients: 8 red bell peppers | 4 tablespoons balsamic vinegar
instructions: Preheat grill to medium heat. Place peppers on grill. Brush both sides with vinegar to coat. Grill peppers for 25 to 35 minutes or until peppers are slightly charred. Place on paper towels to dry. Serve cool or at room temperature.

title: Veal Pate
ingredients: 500 g veal | 200 ml milk | 1 cup milk ( to make pate )
instructions: Pound the veal until it is very fine. Sprinkle a little milk over and grind again until the mixture resembles bread crumbs. Beat egg and milk together in a bowl. Add a tablespoon of this mixture to the veal on a plate until it is all well coated. Place in the microwave oven for about 45 seconds or until cooked. Leave in the microwave and do not use a fork to mash. Add a teaspoon full of mixture onto a hot plate, spread with butter and leave until set. Cut into squares or small rectangles, place on top of a bowl of milk and top with another teaspoon full of this mixture. Microwave for about 15 minutes or until warm and crispy on the outside and a little firm on the inside.

Random Ingredients: beef gravy,blueberry,yellow onion,porcini mushroom,curry powder,oregano,pecorino cheese,monterey jack cheese
title: Roasted Blueberry and Pepper Porcini Mushroom Spread
ingredients: 3 1/2 ounces dried porcini mushrooms | 1 lb blueberries, cleaned & picked over | 1 cup thinly sliced yellow onion | 1 cup beef gravy | 1/4 1/4 cup crumbled monterey jack cheese or 1/4 cup gouda cheese | 1/4 cup grated pecorino cheese or 1/4 cup parmesan cheese | 1/4 teaspoon oregano | 1/8 teaspoon curry powder
instructions: Rinse & drain mushrooms. Put the mushrooms in a small bowl with ice water and let soften. Drain well, chop coarsely and set aside. Place the blueberries in a microwave safe bowl. Add the yellow onion and microwave on high 3 - 4 minutes, stirring once or twice, until softened. Remove the bowl from the microwave, and stir in the mushrooms, beef gravy, 1/4 cup the cheese, oregano and curry. Microwave the mixture uncovered for about 2 minutes, stirring once or three times, until heated through. Stir well & set aside. When ready to serve, stir in the peas and 1 tablespoon of the cheese. The cheese will begin to melt. Spoon the vegetables into 4 dinner plates, dividing evenly. Sprinkle with remaining cheese. Spoon the hot mixture over them, then serve.

title: Creamy Broccoli Spinach
ingredients: 1 lb fresh spinach leaves | 1 tablespoon garlic salt | 1/3 cup light rum flavored extract | 20 ounces broccoli florets
instructions: Preheat the oven at 400°f. Put the spinach leaves into a large pot of salted water. Bring to a boil and cook for 2 minutes. Remove from the heat and drain. Place the spinach stems in a colander. Rinse well in cold water to remove the sand that has started to form on top. Repeat this procedure 2 more times. Place each one on a large flat cutting board and cut into 2 ribbons by folding the two pieces over the opposite points of the spinach. The ribbons will be attached to the spinach by the steam produced. Place the florets in the steamed spinach. Spoon half of the rum over the top of the spinach. Serve immediately.

title: Cherry Chimichurri (Brisket)
ingredients: 3 lbs beef brisket | 1 tablespoon canola oil, divided | 1 cup chervil, coarsely chopped | 1 tablespoon chervil, stems and leaves chopped | 4 -5 tablespoons chili oil
instructions: Slice brisket on the diagonal into 1/2 inch slices. In a large bowl, combine 3 tablespoons of oil and 1 tablespoon of chervil. Add brisket, one at a time and toss. Cover and refrigerate overnight. The next day, drain brisket, and toss with 1 tablespoon of herb oil and 1 tablespoon of chervil. Heat remaining 1 tablespoon canola oil in a skillet. Place brisket in skillet. Add 1 tablespoon of cherry oil and 1 1/2 tablespoon of chili oil. Cover tightly and cook over low heat until brisket is cooked and tender, about 3 hours.

title: Beef Tenderloin With Ginger Barley
ingredients: 1 cup quick-cooking barley | 2 lbs beef tenderloin | 1/4 cup tamarind pulp ( soak for 25 minutes before using ) | 1/2 tablespoon onion soup | 1/2 teaspoon gingerroot, grated | 1 orange, juiced | 1/2 cup parsnip, peeled and cut into 1/2-inch wedges
instructions: In a small saucepan, combine the barley, tamarind pulp, onion soup, ginger and orange juice. Simmer for 20 minutes. Place beef tenderloin between 2 sheets of wax paper. Pat the tenderloin to an even thickness. Score 2 slits in the beef. Reserve marinade. Place in large plastic bag. Refrigerate for 20 minutes, turning to coat. Remove meat from bag. In a large frying pan, saute the marinade until the liquid thickens. Add the beef and brown on all sides. Add the vegetables and simmer until tender. Cut against the grain of the meat.

title: Mexican Brown Lentils
ingredients: 1/2 cup brown lentils or 1/2 cup brown lentils ( 1 1/2 cups ) | 1/2 teaspoon pure vanilla ( optional ) | 1 can anchovies ( optional ) | 2 medium yellow onions, peeled and chopped | 1/2 cup picante sauce
instructions: Rinse and drain brown lentils, discarding any damaged or damaged lentils or foreign matter. Cover and set aside. Combine all ingredients except picante sauce in a heavy pot. Bring to a boil, stirring gently to avoid scorching. Cover and simmer over low heat for 10 minutes, stirring frequently. Remove from heat and let sit covered, about 1 hour, stirring occasionally. Discard any remaining bean liquid in the pot. Serve hot. May be served cold or warm.

title: Zesty Pasta
ingredients: 4 ounces ziti pasta | 2 tablespoons unsalted dry roasted peanuts, chopped
instructions: Bring 4 cups water to a boil in a large pan. Add pasta and cook at a boil until al dente.

title: Kidney Bean Burger
ingredients: 1 pound ground round | 1 can kidney beans, drained | 2 hamburger buns, split and lightly toasted
instructions: Heat a skillet over medium high heat. Cook and stir ground beef in the hot skillet until browned and crumbly, 5 to 7 minutes.

title: Walnut Crumbs
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups bread flour | 1 cup walnut pieces
instructions: Toast the walnuts in the oven until they begin to blacken. This brings out the nutty smell of nutmeg. Cool. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Sift the flour into a large bowl and mix in the nuts. Use an electric mixer to mix until the mixture becomes lumpy. Add the walnut meal and mix again until the dough forms a small ball. Turn out onto a lightly floured surface. Knead for 5 minutes, then turn out onto a lightly floured work surface. Flour for 30 seconds if your hands are too dry. Roll the dough out into a 12 inch circle. Cut into two wedges. Press the wedges together. Repeat with the second loaf. Place on a lightly oiled baking sheet. Bake for 15 minutes on middle shelf of oven, or until lightly browned. Slice while still warm. Enjoy.

title: Frozen Stilton With Pineapple (Di Pina Colada)
ingredients: 6 ounces stilton cheese, crumbled | 2 tablespoons canned pineapple juice | 1 tablespoon simple syrup | 1 fresh jalapeno, diced fine ( optional ) | ginger juice
instructions: Fill a large freezer bag with cheese. Put jalapeno and ginger in bowl, add a tiny bit of lemon juice and mix well. Rub jalapenos and ginger with the paste. Freeze mixture until solid but still slightly firm. Serve and enjoy.

title: Beer Mustard Sauce - No Fail
ingredients: 2 tablespoons ketchup | 1 teaspoon rye flour ( the rye flour or corn syrup is the same thing ) or 1 teaspoon arrowroot ( the rye flour or corn syrup is the same thing )
instructions: Mix everything together. Keep your eye on your ketchup. If you have any leftover mustard you can add a little bit here,.

title: Mexican Eggplant (Aubergine) Meatloaf
ingredients: 2 small eggplants | 250 g beef mince, lean | 2 teaspoons taco seasoning | 1 packet taco seasoning ( with 1 tbsp water )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190c. Cut the eggplants in half and slice across in half. Use a teaspoon to scoop out the core once they are peeled, then slice about the size of a placemon. Cut the eggplants into similar sizes so it will produce a similar shape but with a thicker shell. Heat a shallow frypan over a medium heat and add the minced beef. Add a bit of taco seasoning and coat evenly, then fry for a further 2 minutes. Drain and mix this into the meat. Lay one layer of eggplant in a small loaf tin. Repeat until all of the ingredients are used. Top with taco seasoning and cook in the oven for 30 minutes or until cooked through and the eggplants are tender.

Random Ingredients: almond extract,gorgonzola,orange,rice vinegar,peanut oil,egg white,pearl barley
title: Gorgonzola and Barley Salad
ingredients: 4 cups pearl barley | 3/4 lb gorgonzola, cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 1 1/2 tablespoons rice vinegar | 2 tablespoons orange rind, grated | 2 tablespoons fresh oranges, juice | 1/4 teaspoon almond extract | 1 large egg white
instructions: In large saucepan, place rice vinegar, orange rind, orange juice and almond extract over medium high heat. Bring to boiling. Reduce heat. Cover and simmer 30 minutes, or until barley is tender. Remove from heat. Cool. Meanwhile, place egg white in bowl of electric mixer fitted with the paddle attachment. Beat on high 1 minute, scraping bowl often with rubber spatula. Slowly add hot barley.

Random Ingredients: campari,andouille sausage,italian tomato,rye bread,onion soup mix,parsley sprig
title: French Quarter Sausage & Tomatoes
ingredients: 4 lbs italian tomatoes | 1 lb andouille sausage | 1 package onion soup mix ( dry ) | 1 jar campari or ( 10 ounce ) jar balsamic vinegar | 1 package dry onion soup mix | 4 fresh parsley sprigs ( fresh )
instructions: Brown italian sausage according to package directions, about 10 minutes. Meanwhile, slice tomatoes and place in a 13 x 9 x 2 baking dish. Sprinkle with remaining dry onion soup mix and parsley. Bake 1 hour at 375 degrees, uncovered.

title: Pita Crisp
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked white rice | 1 package pita chips
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a large bowl, mix together the rice, pita chips, and 1 teaspoon ground black pepper. Bake in the preheated oven until golden brown, 10 to 20 minutes.

title: Drawn With Pineapple
ingredients: 1 can prawns | 200 g red pumpkins, chopped | 400 g tuna or 400 g other hard-cooked fish, chopped | 150 g green peas | 3 teaspoons paprika | 3 sheets penne or 3 sheets other pasta shapes
instructions: Shell the prawns, leaving the tail intact. Chop prawns finely. If using canned prawns, rinse in cold water. Combine the prawns with the prawns, pumpkinkin, tuna, peas, paprika and pasta to give a vivid green colour. Toss to coat with the mixture. Garnish with additional green pea pods which have been trimmed or rocket leaves.

title: African Peacock (Peanut) Salad
ingredients: 1 cup dried corn, soaked in water overnight | 1 cup peanuts, chopped | 1 banana leaf, halved
instructions: Drain corn and reserve 2 cups of the soaking liquid. In a pot, combine peanuts, reserved corn liquid, and corn mixture and bring to a boil. Cover and reduce heat. Simmer 2 to 2 1/2 hours until tender. Tunfold banana leaf over bowl and remove sides of leaf. Serve warm.

title: Simple and Delicious Nacho Spread
ingredients: 1 red onion, chopped | 1/2 cup peanut butter | 1/2 cup taco seasoning | 3 -4 tablespoons minced red onions
instructions: Chop up the red onion and put in a microwave safe bowl. Add the peanut butter, taco seasoning and stir it all together with your hands until blended. Cover and refrigerate for at least one hour.

Random Ingredients: sirloin,bread flour,shell pasta,sushi rice,hamburger,white wine vinegar
title: Sushi Rolls (Cerence Bogotano)
ingredients: 3 cups bread flour | 3 cups sushi rice | 5 cups white wine vinegar | 1/2 lb ground sirloin | 12 leaves the best sushi roll, or
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. In a large bowl, stir 3 cups of bread flour with 2 cups water to blend. Add sushi rice, and mix. Add vinegar and taste for seasonings. Season with a little more vinegar if you think it needs it. Make round balls the size of a walnut. Form each ball of dough into a circle about 24 inches to 1/8 inch thick. Place 1/2 inch apart on the baking sheet. Wrap the roll in the parchment, and place in the oven for 15 to 20 minutes. Check it after 15 minutes. It should take about 20 minutes for it to become browned. Remove from the oven, and while still hot, drizzle the roll with some of the reserved wine. Allow to cool. Cut a roll into 6 equal pieces, and put it on the baking sheet to cool completely. Slice the roll into 1/4 inch slices, and roll the slices again. If desired, place slices between plastic wrap to prevent soggyness. Allow the sizzling sound to escape, and enjoy.

title: Apple-Pecan Noodle Pie
ingredients: kosher salt, as needed | 1 lb spaghetti, cooked | 1 1/2 cups shredded yellow squash | 1 1/2 cups shredded unpeeled apples-jelly | 1 cup vodka | 1/4 cup apple jelly | 1 cup flour | pecan pieces, toasted, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Line a 9 inch deep dish pie plate with aluminum foil. Sprinkle the spaghetti with 1/2 teaspoon salt on the dry surface of the pasta. In a large bowl, mix the spaghetti, squash, apples, and jelly. In a small bowl, stir the flour with 1 tablespoon cold water. Stir the remaining 1/2 teaspoon salt with 1 tablespoon water until the salt is dissolved in the water. Turn the liquid into the bowl with the sauce. Pour the liquid over the coated pasta and coat with the flour and grated cheese. Bake until bubbly and the top is golden brown, about 1 hour.

title: Homemade Quinoa Chips for Chips Shop Nuts
ingredients: 1 cup ground quinoa | oil ( for frying )
instructions: Place a gallon size zipper bag in your processor.. Place quinoa, a couple tablespoons of the ground quinoa and a couple tablespoons of oil into a gallon size bag. If using a bag, make sure quinoa is air tight or kosher. Place air tight bag in fridge for about an hour but no longer than that. Then use your hands to break it so that it will mix the two.

Random Ingredients: salmon fillet,active yeast,plum tomato,hot water,orange juice zest,beef chuck,sausage,raisin
title: Breaded Steamed Salmon
ingredients: 2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 3/4 cup hot water | 3/4 lb smoked sausage | 1 cup raisins | 3 1/4 lbs lean boneless skinless beef chuck | 1 1/2 lbs lean boneless skinless salmon fillets ( about 4 1/2 pounds ) | 1 1/2 cups plum tomatoes, seeded and chopped | coarse sugar, for sprinkling
instructions: Light a fire in a 10 inch cast iron skillet. Dissolve yeast in hot water in large bowl. Add sausage, raisins, and beef. Combine well. Place meat mixture on cutting board with a 12 inch length of butcher's twine. Starting at 1 short end, tie the opposite ends of the meat toward you with a piece of twine. Place meat in a 6 to 8 quart kettle. Cover with water and bring to boil over high heat. Reduce heat to low. Cover and cook, gently, undisturbed, until meat pulls away from bones, about 2 hours. Carefully remove meat from kettle. Cover with lid and let cool to room temperature, about 30 minutes. Remove twine and bone. Place meat, skin side up, on work surface. Surround with 3 to 4 pieces of meat. Starting to end with that end, tie again with twine. Place meat on cutting board that has been dusted with coarse sugar. Cover with plastic wrap and let rise until slightly puffy, about 2 hours. Preheat an oven to 400 degrees f. Transfer baking pan over medium high heat. When ready to bake, slide the baking pan onto the baking sheet. Pour heated marinade into a shallow baking dish. Add meat and tomatoes. Cover and let rise until slightly puffy, about 20 minutes. Bake at 400 degrees f for 12 - 15 minutes. Remove to platter, sprinkle with sea salt, and serve.

title: Italian Baked Red Bell Peppers
ingredients: 2 bunches red bell peppers | 1 teaspoon marjoram | 1 teaspoon anise seed | 2 slices bacon bits ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Lightly oil an 11x15 inch glass baking dish spread peppers evenly in the baking dish, and sprinkle with marjoram, and anise seed. Bake in preheated oven, switching and rotating peppers every 5 minutes for 1 hour, or until peppers are tender and lightly browned, about 40 minutes.

title: Cauliflower With Chickpeas
ingredients: 2 cans chickpeas, drained | 1 tablespoon wine vinegar
instructions: Drain all liquid from chickpeas and mash well. Add vinegar. Chill completely.

title: Homemade Phyllo - Low Carb
ingredients: 1 sheet frozen phyllo pastry | 12 whole clove | 3 tablespoons ground cinnamon
instructions: First put the phyllo sheets on a baking tray lined with parchment paper. In a large bowl, mix together the ground cinnamon and ground cloves. Thaw the phyllo sheets and place them in the freezer. Then cut them into 2 by 2 inch strips and place them in a food processor. Turn on and off the processor until the dough becomes a ball. While still on the motor, add in the ground cinnamon and ground cloves. Taste and adjust seasonings if necessary. Turn on to an 11x5 baking dish. Cover dish with the phyllo sheets and let phyllo dry for at least 60 minutes before putting in preheated oven for 45 minutes at 400°f. Cut into squares to serve family style.

title: Faux Phyllo
ingredients: 1 box farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta | 3 packages cream cheese, softened | 3 kaffir lime leaves
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add farfalle pasta, and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

title: Sesame Green Chili Sauce
ingredients: 2 -4 tablespoons light margarine | 2 -3 green chili peppers, finely chopped ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon canola oil | 1/3 cup half-and-half | 2 tablespoons sesame oil | 2 tablespoons olives or 2 tablespoons other light green chili oil
instructions: Place sesame oil in a small sauce pan and heat till very warm. Add margarine and heat till melted. Add green chilies and green chili. Saute on medium low till green chilies turn dark green in color. Add half & half. When heated through, add sesame oil and allow to simmer on low for a few minutes, stirring continuously. Serve over your favorite pasta.

Random Ingredients: hot chili sauce,thyme leaf,green bell pepper,rotel,fig,pork tenderloin,italian sausage
title: Polish Sausage With Sweet Potatoes and Figs
ingredients: 4 links sweet italian sausage | 1/2 lb pork tenderloin, sliced into 1-inch pieces | 1 large green bell pepper, cut into thin strips | 4 small fresh figs, halved vertically ( about 1 pint total ) | 1/4 teaspoon dried thyme leaves | 1 tablespoon snipped fresh hot chili sauce | additional snipped thyme leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f place the sausage links on a large baking sheet and bake, turning and rearranging, until browned, 7 to 9 minutes total. Cooks' note, sausage can be made 3 days ahead and chilled, covered. Bring to room temperature before roasting, and store in refrigerator until ready to serve. Meanwhile, place the potaotes on a rimmed baking sheet and place on the middle rack of oven. Roast until darkly browned and very tender when pierced with a fork and cooked through, 20 to 35 minutes. Meanwhile, in a skillet, cook the sausage until browned and crumbly, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks, about 10 minutes. Transfer to plate, sprinkle with black pepper, and cool. When sausage is cool, remove and discard casings and slice into 1 inch pieces. Toss sausage, peppers, figs, and thyme in a large bowl. Add hot sauce, if desired. Serve with sausage and bell pepper mixture on the side.

title: Crispy Swiss Cheese With Dill Pickles
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs swiss cheese, shredded | 1/4 cup dill pickle, diced fine | 2 teaspoons cardamom seeds
instructions: In a bowl, mix the cheese with the pickle, the cardamon, and the dill until the cheese is creamy. Spread into a 10x12 inch baking dish. Cover the top with foil and bake at 350 degrees for 50 minutes.

title: Peach Lamb Stew
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs stewing lamb | 1 loaf french bread, cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 1/2 lb limoncello | 1 lb fresh peach, peeled, pitted and sliced | 1/2 teaspoon mustard powder | 8 -10 leaves fresh french bread ( it should be about 1/2 of the loaf! )
instructions: Cut a horizontal slit through each piece of lamb for easier removal, if desired. Open the french bread loaf and arrange the lamb pieces in it in layers. Mix together all other ingredients and pour over lamb. Place in preheated oven and cook, covered, for 1 hour, or until lamb is tender, basting occasionally. Serve immediately, or refrigerate overnight for quick, easy, and tasty sandwiches.

title: Mexican Kielbasa
ingredients: 1 package kielbasa | 1 large green pepper, chopped | 1 jar roasted pistachio nuts | 1 can tomato sauce | 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro stems
instructions: Place kielbasa in large deep skillet. Cook over high heat for 4 to 6 minutes on each side, turning frequently. Drain well. Combine green pepper, pistachios, tomato sauce, cilantro and sausage.

Random Ingredients: black peppercorn,malt vinegar,ranch dressing mix,grain rice
title: Montreal Steamed Rice
ingredients: 1 can black peppercorns, cracked in a mortar | 2 tablespoons dried ranch dressing mix ( mccormick montreal steak seasoning mix ) | 1 1/4 cups uncooked long grain rice ( arborio ) | 1 cup malt vinegar
instructions: Remove peppercorns from mortar and set aside. In a 2 1/2 cup glass measuring cup stir together the cracked peppercorns and ranch seasoning mix. Place rice, vinegar, and water in a 2 quart saucepan and set over medium high heat. Cook, covered, until the rice is tender, about 4 - 6 minutes. Stir and remove from heat. Serve warm or cool.

Random Ingredients: almond meal,salt black pepper,pie shell,oatmeal,dish pie shell
title: Maurice's Scottish Oatcakes
ingredients: 1 lb oatmeal, fine | 1/2 cup almond meal ( flake almond meal ) | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 3/4 cup flour | 1 pie shell, unbaked
instructions: Place pie shell into pie pan and fill with oatmeal. Sprinkle almond meal and flake almond meal on top, then sprinkle salt all over. Put the pie into an oven at 325f for 30 minutes. You might have to bake the oatcakes to get them ready for the next baking. If they get done, it should be done in 5 - 10 minutes.

title: Chicken ROasted on the Rhubarb
ingredients: 2 boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 4 -6 slices pork | 1 tablespoon rice, if using uncooked rice | 1 cup uncooked rhubarb | 1 cup broth | 1/2 cup cherries
instructions: Preheat oven to 375f degrees. Line a roasting pan with aluminum foil. Place the chicken and pork on the foil, in a single layer. Mix the rice with the rhubarb, broth and cherries. Pour evenly over the chicken and pork. Cover the roasting pan and place in oven. Bake 20 to 30 minutes until juices run clear and meat is just tender. Turn once during baking to ensure even browning.

Random Ingredients: flour tortilla,mushroom stem,salt black pepper,bean,white peppercorn,stewing beef,dark brown sugar,pomegranate
title: Beef and Bean Burritos (Pomegranate Based)
ingredients: 4 lbs stewing beef or 4 lbs chuck, cut into 2-inch cubes | 2 cans mushroom stems and pieces, undrained | 1 cup fresh pomegranate | 2 bags flour tortillas ( or 2 large burrito size ) or ( 16 ounce ) bags corn tortillas ( or 2 large burrito size ) | 2 cans low sodium refried beans | 10 large fresh pomegranate seeds | 1 tablespoon dark brown sugar | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Brown beef in non stick pan. Remove meat and reserve. Drain grease from pan and return to saucepan and add mushrooms and pomegranate seeds. Turn heat to low and cook, partially covered, stirring every 10 minutes or so, or until tender and liquid has evaporated and mushrooms are lightly colored. Return meat to saucepan and set aside. Heat saucepan on medium heat and add pomegranate seed oil. Add brown sugar to warm pomegranate mixture and mix well. Pour sauce over meat and serve over warm tortillas. Garnish with pomegranate seeds and pomegranate seeds.

title: Quick and Easy Tostadas - "the Tahini Freezer
ingredients: 1/2 cup kalamata olive | 1 1/4 cups green chili ( or to taste )
instructions: Drain all of the olives. I get about 1 3/4 cups. Pour this into a strainer lined with a coffee filter. Shake the drained olives until they are coated. Place in a large bowl. Use your fingers to squeeze the excess juice from the olives. This will thicken the mixture. Place olives into a food processor, pulse the olives until they are well chopped into small chunks.. If the mixture starts to look too thick, add more olive. You can sprinkle them into a bowl of ice water, or pour the mixture through a strainer lined with cheesecloth or a fine mesh sieve, or use immediately. Freeze for a couple of hours to firm. Add more olive, chillies, or a few more olives to this as desired.

title: Artichoke Applesauce
ingredients: 4 cans artichoke hearts, drained and liquid reserved | 1/3 cup molasses | 1/3 cup chopped celery
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Place artichoke hearts into an 8x8 inch baking dish or roasting pan in layers, or if you have a lid to fit, use a lid that's just large enough to hold the artichokes without tearing. Whisk together molasses, celery and reserved artichoke liquid. Pour mixture over artichokes, and cover tightly with lid. Bake 1 hour in the preheated oven, or longer, if desired.

title: Basic Pizza Dough Dipping Sauce (French Style or Italian Style)
ingredients: 2 lbs pizza dough | 1/2 cup dijon-style mustard
instructions: Take the dough out of the refrigerator and deflate it by stretching it back to the 1/2 1/2 lb mark. Cut the dough into 3 pieces, then stretch each piece to about a 12 inch round. Use a biscuit cutter to cut the rounds in half. Heat your cast iron skillet over medium low heat for 5 minutes. Using a pastry brush, coat the bottom half of the bread with the mustard. Quickly transfer the bread to the buttered skillet and turn the heat down to medium. If you don't have a pizza dough brush or pastry brush, you can use a pastry brush if you have one. Quickly press each round lightly with the spatula on top of the first, so it's not stuck to the sides of the pan. Turn the bread over and cook on both sides, adding more mustard at the beep if it starts to brown too quickly. Serve while the bread is hot with the sauce and cheese.

Random Ingredients: self raising flour,garlic crouton,cocoa,guacamole,monterey jack cheese,green cardamom,champagne
title: Chipped Cheese Balls
ingredients: 3 cups self-raising flour | 1 tablespoon unsweetened cocoa | 1/4 cup guacamole | 1 cup grated monterey jack cheese | 3 green cardamoms | 3 tablespoons champagne, chilled | 1 can chuffins, drained | 1 can garlic-flavored croutons
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 degrees c. Line a baking tray with baking paper. Using an electric mixer, combine the flour, cocoa and guacamole on low speed until the mixture resembles breadcrumbs. In a separate bowl, beat the cheese, cardamom and champagne with an electric mixer until well blended. Stir the cheese mixture into the flour mixture until just combined, and roll the mixture into small walnut size balls, about two tablespoons. Roll the balls in crushed garlic croutons to coat and transfer to an oven tray lined with baking paper. Bake for 20 minutes or until golden and firm.

title: Salsa Verde Dip With Tahini
ingredients: 1 can salsa verde ( homemade is best ) | 1 tablespoon tahini
instructions: Add salsa verde to blender or food processor. Puree the contents of the can into the salsa verde until it is creamy. Add tahini and blend on low until it becomes light and creamy. Serve as an appetizer.

title: Broccoli With Yellow Onions and Broccoli
ingredients: 1 tablespoon coarse-chopped yellow onion | 1 lb broccoli floret, tough stems removed
instructions: In a nonstick skillet, heat oil over medium low heat. Add onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until golden brown, about 10 to 15 minutes. Add broccoli to skillet.

Random Ingredients: chili pod,self raising flour,parmesan cheese,raisin,button mushroom,onion,tarragon,kaffir lime leaf
title: Mushroom Dumplings With Sherry and Raisins
ingredients: 1 lb button mushroom | 1/2 medium onion ( finely diced ) | 1/4 teaspoon dried tarragon | 1/4 teaspoon chili pod ( crushed ) | 1/4 cup raisins | 1/3 cup parmesan cheese ( grated ) | 1 teaspoon self-raising flour | 1 teaspoon dried kaffir lime leaf, finely crumpled ( optional )
instructions: Wash mushrooms and remove mushroom stems. Chop caps finely and set aside. Finely dice onion, and saute in a little oil until translucent. Add to mushrooms and saute for 2 - 3 minutes, or until onion is soft. Add 1/4 teaspoon dried tarragon, 1/4 teaspoon chilli pepper, raisins, 1/3 cup parmesan, and flour and stir to combine. Add 2 cups boiling water, bring to boiling, reduce heat, simmer for 8 minutes or until mixture is thick, stir in lime juice and continue to cook for 1 minute and serve.

title: Smoked Lamb Loaf
ingredients: 1 lb roast, bone in ( smoked lamb ) | 2 teaspoons black tea | 12 thin slices prosciutto, thinly sliced | 6 thin slices deli smoked turkey meat | 7 slices french bread, toasted on one side and then toasted on the untoasted side | 1 tomatoes, sliced and separated into seeds | 2 ounces smoked salmon steaks
instructions: Trim any excess fat from the roast, and slice into 5 long, 1 wide slices. Combine the black tea and sliced prosciutto slices with half of the meat. Place half of the bread on the untoasted side of a large, greased, rectangular baking dish, and pile the prosciutto and meat on top of it. Add just a bit of black tea if you do not like the flavor. Place half of the remaining bread ontop, then sandwich the turkey slices, overlapping the slices. If you can, place the slices neatly on top of the meat. To make sandwich, place remaining prosciutto and sliced deli ham on top of the toasted side of the bread, then top with a thin slice of tomato. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees. Cover the entire surface of the baking dish with aluminum foil, and bake for 90 minutes, or until everything is heated through and prosciutto is beginning to brown. Remove and cover with aluminium foil while finishing the loaf. After 45 minutes, remove the foil. Remove the loaf from the oven, and cut into slices, and serve at once. Cut all slices diagonally to serve.

Random Ingredients: stir fry vegetable,dijon mustard,turmeric powder,apricot,french onion,tomato puree
title: Spicy French Onion Soup
ingredients: 1 ounce dried apricot, rinsed and chopped finely | 1 small french onion | 8 ounces frozen stir fry vegetables ( like carrots ) | 1 can tomato puree | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder
instructions: Heat a large soup pot on the stove top, then dry fry the onion in it for a few minutes. Add the dried apricots, vegetables, tomato puree, dijon mustard, and turmeric. Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat. Cook for about 20 minutes. Stir to warm through and serve.

Random Ingredients: turnip,maraschino cherry,passion fruit pulp,sesame seed,gold tequila
title: Passion Fruit Turnip Fizz
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 cup gold tequila | 1 can passion fruit pulp ( in season or fresh ) | 1 tablespoon sesame seeds ( optional ) | 3 tablespoons maraschino cherries ( optional ) | 1 medium turnip ( cut into 4 pieces )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a cocktail shaker. Shake well. Pour into a covered cocktail shaker. Set in a cold fridge until ready to use. Turnip fizz should be firm and lightly browned. Serve with sweet potato wedges, chips, or in a shallow baking dish. Note for raisin, when adding raisins to batter, sprinkle sesame seeds over batter if desired.

title: Olive and Sultana Lasagne
ingredients: 9 lasagna noodles | 3 tablespoons half-and-half | 3/4 cup diced pimento-stuffed black olives | 1/2 cup sultana | 1/4 cup chopped pitted black olives | 1/2 teaspoon dried marjoram
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Combine half and half, olives and marjoram in shallow baking dish. Place 1 noodle on top of the other in a single layer. Cover with 1/3 of the olives, and spread evenly. Top with 1/3 of remaining olives, then 1/3 of the sultanas. Repeat layers with remaining ingredients. Bake 30 minutes in the preheated oven, until bubbly and beginning to brown.

title: Spinach with Ham, Apple and Cumin
ingredients: 50 g baby spinach | 50 g applesauce | 200 g cubed ham | 150 ml single cream | 1 bunch fresh sage, leaf | 1 dash cumin powder or 1 dash cumin powder
instructions: Prepare the spinach in the microwave for a 1 minute on high, then remove from microwave, cover and leave to stand for anther 4 minutes, then leave to stand anther 4 minutes. Prepare the sausage and ham in a clean wok and drain off all but 2 tbsp of the bacon fat. Add apple sauce and spinach to wok, cover and simmer for 3 - 5 minutes. Divide the spinach evenly and spread evenly.

title: Easiest Apple-Sesame Spread
ingredients: 1 package frozen english cheese blend | 1 1/2 cups apple juice | 2 teaspoons sesame oil
