instructions: Put the apple juice and sesame oil in a saucepan over medium heat. Stir in the cheese until melted and creamy.

title: Curried Mango Wedges
ingredients: 1 tablespoon horseradish, grated | 4 mangoes, cut in wedges | 2 teaspoons apple, chopped | 170 g squid, cleaned, rings tentacles intact | 150 g puff pastry, thawed | 1 1/2 lbs ground lamb
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°c/180°f. Line a baking tray with baking paper. Mix together the horseradish and grated mango with the finely chopped apple and squid. Cover with pastry dough and pinch edges together to make a large seal. Press the mango onto the pastry and bake for 15 minutes. Mix together the ground meat and lamb, season if necessary with salt and pepper, divide between 6 serving plates and serve on the side.

title: Chinese Artichokes.
ingredients: 3/4 cup apple cider | 1/2 cup dark soy sauce | 1 tablespoon honey | 8 small artichoke hearts | pistachios, as desired ( optional )
instructions: Combine the cider and soy sauce in a bowl and set aside. Rinse the artichokes and cut off the stems. Stab the artichokes with a sharp knife and cut off the hard part. Reserve the left over marinade. Thread the artichokes on metal skewers that have been soaked in water for 30 minutes. Preheat broiler. Place the artichokes on the broiler rack and char grill over boiling water until tender when pierced with a knife, about 4 minutes for rare, 6 to 10 minutes for medium. Remove from broiler and set aside. Pour the reserved marinade and honey over the artichokes and stir to coat. Transfer to a serving platter and garnish with pistachios. Can be served immediately.

title: Taco Seasoning Mix (For Beef Roast, BBQ & Grill)
ingredients: 1 packet taco seasoning mix | 1 red capsicum ( seeded and thinly sliced ) | 1 onion
instructions: Preheat oven to c. Place capsicum and chopped onion in a large roasting tin or roasting tin. Combine the taco seasoning with 1/2 tsp per cup of water and pour over the vegetables. Stir well to coat veggies. Roast in oven for 1 hour or until meat thermometer registers 160°f. Remove meat from oven, drain excess fat and return the juices to the roasting tin. Bring juices to boil, reduce heat, cook until reduced by half, about 15 minutes. Serve with your favourite meat and vegetables.

Random Ingredients: porcini mushroom,red chili powder,oregano,white wine vinegar,wonton wrapper,fine semolina,hungarian paprika,herb
title: Mushroom Dumplings for Soup (Paprika Laschino) -- Hungarian
ingredients: 1/2 lb sliced porcini mushroom ( you can substitute 1 tblsp. dried mushrooms, 1/2 cup, 1/4 cup or 2 tablespoons of each ) | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 1 teaspoon fine semolina | 2 teaspoons hungarian paprika | 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon dried oregano | 1 teaspoon dried mixed herbs | powdered dried mixed herbs ( oregano, basil, mint or tarragon ) ( optional ) | 12 wonton wrappers
instructions: Cut the mushrooms into small pieces. Mix all the remaining ingredients together except the wrappers and add the mushrooms. Mix together. Drop a little of the mushroom mixture into your wonton wrappers. Foil the outside of the wontons. Drop into boiling soup and cook till they float. Drain thoroughly and enjoy. They should not be eaten but the flavor is subtle and delicious. You can also add a little chopped coriander to the soup and serve with chopped fresh herbs.

title: Maggie Beer's Spiced Carrot, Honey, and Ginger Salad
ingredients: 500 g carrots, peeled | 200 g fresh gingerroot | 2 tablespoons olive oil or 2 tablespoons honey | 1/2 cup marsala wine | 1 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 2 -3 tablespoons toasted ground cardamom and 4 tablespoons walnut pieces | shave or half lemon wedges, to serve
instructions: Bring a large pan of lightly salted water to the boil. Meanwhile, peel the carrots and roughly grate them, cutting them into matchsticks if they are large. Slice the gingerroot into thin wedges and place them in a bowl. Add the carrots and stir until thoroughly coated. Place the ginger and the olive oil or honey in a saucepan over a medium heat and add the carrots, tossing to coat them in the oil/honey mixture. Bring to the boil, stirring occasionally, then reduce the heat and simmer, uncovered, stirring occasionally, for about 25 minutes, or until the carrots are tender. Stir in the marsala and bicarb soda and remove from the heat. Drain the carrots well, pressing out any excess liquid. Allow to cool. Add the cardamom and walnut pieces to the carrots and stir to combine. Transfer to serving bowl, sprinkle with the lemon and lime wedges, and serve.

title: Mediterranean Soft Tacos
ingredients: 1 lb ground veal | 1 cup napaya nectar | 1 teaspoon orange peel ( finely chopped ) | 8 spinach ( rinsed, chopped ) | lettuce leaf | pizza crust ( optional )
instructions: Brown and crumble veal in a skillet over medium heat. Add nectar and orange peel and cook until liquid is absorbed. Separate spinach and shred roughly. Warm nectar mixture in microwave for 1 minute. Place shredded spinach in bowl of a food processor. Add to meat with nectar mixture, mix. Wrap dough in plastic and store in refrigerator for up to an hour. Warm a pizza stone in 450 degree oven for ten to twenty minutes. Brush the pizza crust with oil and place the pizza in the oven. Top the taco with the lettuce and meat mixture and add some crushed tortilla chips. Continue to make tacos, until cheese, salsa, sour cream, and hot sauce are gone.

title: Orange Cream Salad
ingredients: 1 container cool whip | 1/3 cup orange juice | 3 crushed garlic cloves | 1 can sliced black olives | 1/2 - 3/4 finely diced radish
instructions: Beat all ingredients well and chill for 30 minutes or more. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: parsley,cherry tomato,hatch green chile pepper,orange,mint leaf
title: Mexican Green Chile-Tomato Salad
ingredients: 1 can chopped green chile peppers | 1/2 cup coarsely chopped fresh parsley | 1/2 cup coarsely chopped fresh mint leaves | 1 orange, juice of | 1 pint cherry tomatoes or 1 pint grape tomatoes
instructions: Drain chilies, reserving juice in measuring cup & rinse well. Discard stems & cut seeds from chilies. In a bowl, combine chilies, parsley, mint, grated orange peel, juice and salt and pepper to taste. Chill until ready to serve. Garnish tomatoes with chilies & parsley. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Norwegian Breadless Breakfast Rolls
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups biscuit mix | 1/4 cup dried morel, crumbled ( optional ) | 3/4 cup raisins | 1 package wide egg noodles, cooked and drained
instructions: In a baking dish, mix biscuit mix, dried morels if desired, raisins, and beaten egg noodles. Cut dough into four even sections, forming 2 logs. Bake on lightly greased baking sheet at 375°f for 10 minutes. Turn loaves over and bake an additional 12 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Crock Pot BBQ Pork Chops
ingredients: 4 large pork chops | 1/4 cup tahini | 1/4 cup consomme, fat free chicken broth | 1/4 cup apple cider | 2 tablespoons tomato sauce | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh chives | 1/4 cup port wine
instructions: Spray crock pot with cooking spray. Place breaded pork chops in crock pot. Combine chicken broth, consomme and tomato sauce, and pour over the pork chops. Cover and cook on low heat setting for 8 hours. Remove pork chops and place them on platter or serving dish. Spoon sauce over pork and serve with a side of noodles or mashed potatoes or noodles of your choice. Note, for those of you who use chicken or beef stock instead of consomme, you can reduce the chicken/bouillon amount to 1/ add sauteed red peppers if you are using beef or pork. In a skillet heated to 250°f place pork chops and sautee on both sides in the pan.

Random Ingredients: pineapple juice,egg yolk,cardamom pod,yellow bell pepper
title: Egg in a Bell Pepper
ingredients: 1/3 cup yellow bell peppers, finely chopped | 1/4 cup pineapple juice | 1 egg yolk | 1/8 teaspoon cardamom pod, slightly crushed
instructions: Combine the bell pepper and pineapple juice in a small, heavy saucepan, and bring to a boil over medium high heat. Reduce the heat to medium, and simmer until the mixture has reduced by half, about 15 minutes. Beat in the egg yolk, and simmer gently, stirring constantly, until thick, about 2 minutes. Remove from the heat. Gently stir in the cardamom pod. Spoon the pepper mixture into mugs, and top with paprika if desired. Let stand about 5 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: egg yolk,red peppercorn,feta cheese,apricot jam,pecan half,white wine vinegar
title: Mixed Churros
ingredients: 2 egg yolks | 1/2 cup finely chopped pecans | 1/2 cup crumbled feta cheese | 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon crushed red peppercorns | 1/4 cup apricot jam
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together the egg yolks, pecans, feta cheese, vinegar and crushed red peppercorns. Place the jam in a small bowl, and drizzle it into the egg yolk mixture. Chill for 2 hours to allow the flavors to blend before serving.

title: Sweet and Savory Turkey, Sweet and Savory!!
ingredients: 1 lb turkey breast, cut into 1-inch slices | 1 teaspoon dry mustard | 1 teaspoon kosher salt | 1/2 cup shredded carrot | 1 teaspoon instant chicken bouillon granules, granules | 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon, approximate
instructions: Rinse turkey with cold water and pat dry with paper towels. Season both sides of turkey with salt and set aside. In a small bowl, mix together the dry mustard, ground cinnamon and chicken bouillon. Dip each turkey slice into the dry mustard mixture and lay in a single layer on a plate or baking sheet.

title: Sweet Curry Powder
ingredients: 1/2 cup raisins | 1/2 cup irish whiskey | 1 tablespoon curry powder | 1 tablespoon peanut oil
instructions: Bring raisins, whisky, curry powder, peanut oil, and 1 tbs to 2 cup water to boil in a small saucepan. Remove from heat and stir. Cover and refrigerate 30 minutes. Stir before serving.

title: Mushroom and Green Bean Dip
ingredients: 1 cup sliced fresh mushrooms | 8 ounces fresh mushrooms, chopped ( about 1.5 cans ) | 1 can sliced green beans | 1 1/4 cups quick tapioca flour | 1 tablespoon dry mustard | 1 tablespoon lime juice | 1/3 cup crushed ice | 1/3 cup miniature semisweet chocolate chip | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh mustard
instructions: Drain well the canned mushrooms and set aside for later use. Drain the canned green beans and rinse well. In a small saucepan, combine beans with 2 - 3 tablespoons water. Bring to a boil, simmer until tender. While the above is simmering, in a medium bowl, place the prepared mushrooms, green beans and reserved mushrooms and combine, adding lime juice. When ready to serve, place the tapioca flour, 1 tablespoon mustard, lime juice and crushed ice in a medium mixing bowl and mix the ingredients until smooth. Place the mixture into a serving bowl and top with the mini semisweet mustard.

Random Ingredients: cocoa powder,cheese ravioli,chinese wine,white vermouth,lemon peel,chocolate chip,fenugreek seed,pepperoni
title: Spicy Baked Ravioli
ingredients: 36 small refrigerated cheese ravioli | 1 cup mild white vermouth ( can use sweet vermouth ) | 1/4 cup sweet chinese sweet wine or 1/4 cup dry vermouth | 1/2 cup chocolate chips | 2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder | 3 teaspoons fenugreek seeds | 1/2 teaspoon pepper ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon grated lemon peel | 1/2 teaspoon chinese hot dark sweet vermouth
instructions: Place ravioli, 1 cup vermouth, and 1/4 cup sweet chinese sweet wine in a 9x13 baking dish and top with 3/4 cup chocolate chips. In a small bowl, combine cocoa, fenugreek, pepper, lemon peel, dark chinese sweet vermouth, and remaining 1/4 cup vermouth, stirring with a whisk until smooth, about one minute. Drizzle mixture over ravioli.

Random Ingredients: cottage cheese,kosher salt,pepper sauce,daikon radish,chicken thigh,rosemary,chuck,splenda sugar substitute
title: Low Fat Chicken Kebabs
ingredients: 1 lb boneless chuck or 1 lb skirt steak, cut into 2 '' x 1/4 '' pieces | 1 lb daikon radish, peeled, cut into 2 inch pieces | 3 teaspoons kosher salt | 2 tablespoons splenda sugar substitute | 2 teaspoons fresh rosemary, minced | 1/4 teaspoon hot pepper sauce | 32 ounces fat-free cottage cheese | 1 dash hot pepper sauce | 1 1/2 lbs pre-skewered whole-egg rotisserie cooked chicken thighs, quartered
instructions: Grill or broil meat until no longer pink.

title: Red Cabbage Rolls
ingredients: 500 g red cabbage, washed, cored and shredded | 4 sheets frozen puff pastry, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c. Line 2 baking trays with baking paper. Using a sharp knife, cut 10 - 12 diagonal slashes across 2 outer layers at an angle. Place 1 large handful of cabbage on each pastry sheet. Cut 4 diagonal slashes through base of cabbage. Carefully lift pastry sheets from sheets of pastry and bake for 10 - 15 minutes, or until lightly browned and set. Serve warm or cold. Enjoy.

title: Chile Rojo
ingredients: 12 roma ( plum ) tomatoes, diced | 2 poblano chiles, diced | 5 ounces diced tomatoes with green chilies
instructions: In a cast iron skillet, combine the roma tomatoes and the poblano chilies. Grill over medium low direct for 3 to 5 minutes, turning twice to avoid burning. In a bowl, combine the diced tomatoes with chilies. Spoon this mixture into a warm ramekin and serve.

title: Pickled Red Currant Jelly - Microwave
ingredients: 4 1/2 ounces red currant jelly | 1 1/2 cups clear broth
instructions: Put jelly into large bowl. Add broth and whisk well. Dissolve jelly in boiling liquid. Serve.

title: Barbecue Asparagus
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless beef roast or 1 1/2 lbs lamb, cut in 1/4 inch cubes | 1 saffron strand | 3 -5 fluid ounces hot sauce | 2 1/2 lbs fresh asparagus, trimmed, spears snapped into 1-inch pieces
instructions: Trim off excess fat and sinew from beef and cut beef up into one inch cubes. Place beef in crockpot. Sprinkle saffron strands onto beef. Pour hot sauce over all. Cook on low 8 - 10 hours. Toss asparagus with cooking juices until fully coated. Serve with hot crusty bread for dipping.

title: Crusty Leek Bread
ingredients: 3 leeks, cleaned and trimmed | 1/3 cup yellow cornmeal
instructions: In a large pot, bring 4 cups of water to a boil. Meanwhile, place leeks in boiling water. Cover and cook 7 to 10 minutes, or until tender. Remove from water and drain. Place cornmeal in a shallow bowl. Sprinkle leeks on top of cornmeal. Pour water over cornmeal and leeks until combined. Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour, or until bread is creamy.

title: Perfect Tamales
ingredients: cornmeal | dry sherry ( i prefer dark sherry ) or rum ( i prefer dark sherry )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Mix cornmeal and sherry in a bowl. Spoon about 4 tablespoons of mixture onto a lightly floured board and roll into a ball in the cornmeal mixture to make a 3'' wide cylinder. Cut cylinder into 6 - 8 triangular pieces. Repeat, holding cylinder upright until all tamales are rolled up in a similar manner. Arrange upright tamales. Coat tamales with cornmeal sprinkled with cornmeal. Bake at 400f for 40 minutes. Serve warm. Serve with sweet pickled red cabbage and other accompaniments. Tamales may also be frozen for up to 3 months.

title: Baked Poblanos
ingredients: 4 poblano peppers | 1 lime wedge, for rubbing on peppers
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Place poblanos on a baking sheet and roast them in the preheated oven for 5 to 6 minutes or until the skins blister and blacken. Place peppers in ice water to cool, then peel and chop the stems. Place pepper shreds in a bowl. Use the juice from 1 lime wedge to rub the skin of the peppers into the skins. Place the poblanos in a resealable plastic bag, seal.

Random Ingredients: marjoram,topping,water chestnut,pearl barley,ra el hanout spice mix,cooking oil
title: Chickpea Burritos (Lebanese Barley Salad)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups quick-cooking oil | 1/2 cup pearl barley | 2 cans water chestnuts, sliced, drained | ra el hanout spice mix | sliced fresh marjoram | sliced sour topping
instructions: Combine oil, pearl barley, water chestnuts, and sauted spices in a saucepan. Bring to boil over medium heat, stirring frequently. Reduce heat to low, and simmer until barley is tender, about 2 hours. Mix in marjoram and sour topping.

title: Quick and Easy Rice Noodle Soup
ingredients: 900 ml chicken stock or 900 ml vegetable stock | 500 g thin rice noodles
instructions: Rinse noodles and place in pan of boiling water with a lid on. Leave noodles to come to the boil and quickly cook noodles in boiling water and then in the other direction following normal direction to allow them to sit for about 15 - 20 minutes. Serve with a few shakes of garlic, a little chopped coriander and chopped fresh herbs.

title: Rigatoni With Gruyere (Italian Spaghetti and Cabbage)
ingredients: 1 head cabbage, cut in half lengthwise ( about 1 pound ) | 3 cups rigatoni pasta or 3 cups rotini pasta | 1 tablespoon bakers parchment paper baking soda | 1 cup shredded gruyere
instructions: In a large saucepan or dutch oven, combine cabbage and 3 cups water. Bring to a boil, cover, and reduce heat to medium low. Cook at a slow simmer for 5 minutes and then remove from heat, and allow to cool in liquid for 6 minutes. Drain, and add enough rigatoni to the liquid to yield 1 cup. Simmer for 1 minute on medium low heat. Meanwhile, in a small bowl, dissolve baking soda in 1 cup of cheese. Squeeze out and discard the excess water from the cabbage, and set aside. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add pasta and cook until al dente, about 8 to 10 minutes. Drain, and immediately toss with pasta. Serve with remaining cheese and shredded cabbage.

Random Ingredients: cayenne pepper,spinach,salmon,pimento pepper,lettuce,mango chutney,red chili pepper
title: Moroccan Salmon Salad
ingredients: 1/3 cup sliced smoked salmon, chopped | 3 tablespoons canned red chili peppers, chopped | 1 tablespoon chopped pimento pepper | 1 tablespoon mango chutney | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh spinach, chopped | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 2 tablespoons shredded lettuce
instructions: In a large bowl, mix salmon with chilies, pimento, mango chutney, spinach and cayenne. To serve, place lettuce leaves on plates, or serve over lettuce.

Random Ingredients: white wine vinegar,liquid smoke,bacon bit,chili oil,lime juice zest
title: Hot and Sour BBQ Rub
ingredients: 3 slices bacon bits | 1/4 cup seasoned with salt and pepper bacon bits | 1 tablespoon liquid smoke ( mesquite ) | 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar | 1/2 lime, juice and zest of, grated very finely | 1 -2 dash chili oil ( i use no calorie-added olive oil )
instructions: Place bacon bits in a small bowl. Cover with white wine vinegar and mash with a fork to the bacon bits. Add liquid smoke and grated lime rind and chili oil. Stir with a fork until combined. Transfer to a jar with a tight fitting lid to store in a dark, cool place.

Random Ingredients: apple cider,red enchilada sauce,parsley,sage,cardamom powder,vanilla sugar,peppercorn
title: Cider Jelly or Vanilla Sugar Ring
ingredients: 1 cup red enchilada sauce | 1 cup apple cider or 1 cup apple juice | 1/4 cup pure vanilla sugar | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom powder | 1/4 teaspoon sage | 3 peppercorns, or | 1/4 teaspoon coriander powder or 1/4 teaspoon cumin | 1 teaspoon dried parsley
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a saucepan, bring to a boil over medium high heat, stirring frequently. Reduce heat to medium and simmer for 5 minutes, stirring. Ladle into small jars. Cool slightly. Store in clean, dry containers, up to 3 months.

title: Korean Bokkeech Kimchee (Vegetarian Kimchee)
ingredients: 1/4 cup dashi ( basic japanese soup stock ) | 2 1/2 cups daikon radishes, peeled and chopped ( about 2 ) | 1 can bamboo shoots, cut into 1 `` pieces, drained
instructions: Cook kimchee in dashi in the basic soup stock for about 15 minutes. Add radishes, bamboo, and bean sauce.

title: Tortas de Puerco
ingredients: 1 pork shoulder, cleaned and dried | 14 sheets phyllo pastry, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Place the pork shoulder, and some water in a skillet over medium heat, bring to a boil, and cook until meat is cooked through, about 20 minutes. When meat is cool enough to handle, cut into 1 inch slices. Lay half of the phyllo pastry in the bottom of an 8x8 inch baking dish. Lay half of the pork pork slices on top, then half of the remaining phyllo pastry in the dish over the pork. Lay the remaining pork slices over the phyllo. Make three layers across the phyllo pastry, then lay the remaining phyllo pastry over the phyllo and pork. Cut a slit through the phyllo to cover the pork entirely. Spoon the remaining pork broth in the baking dish, and place on top. Sprinkle with additional salt and pepper over entire dish. Cover with a sheet of plastic wrap or aluminum foil or an offset baking sheet so it doesn't wrap. Bake in preheated oven until phyllo is golden brown and crispy, about 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: garlic salt,fennel seed,crab meat,vanilla pudding mix,cardamom seed
title: Crab Stacked Fennel
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon fennel seed | 1 package vanilla instant pudding mix, 1 ounce | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom seeds | 1/4 teaspoon garlic salt | 1 pound imitation crab meat, chopped
instructions: Combine fennel seeds, pudding mix, cardamom seeds, garlic salt, imitation crab meat. Mix thoroughly. Sprinkle with paprika to taste. Store in an airtight container.

title: Dopiazi (Curried Apple and Coconut)
ingredients: 500 ml coconut | 500 g masala ( dark ) | 1 large beef bouillon cube | 1/2 tablespoon ginger paste | 3/4 tablespoon allspice | 2 tablespoons dried apples or 2 tablespoons ghee ( or clarified butter )
instructions: Cut the coconut and beef to 1 cm thick matchsticks. Make the masala by grinding together the ginger and allspice until the ghee melts. Put the curry in a container, add beef, coconut and allspice. Cover with plastic and leave to marinate for 1 - 4 hours. Heat the clarified butter or clarified oil in a stewing pan. Sauté the curry on medium heat for 5 min, stirring continuously so the spices don't burn on the bottom of the pan. Remove the coconut beef to a bowl. Add ginger paste. Stir for 2 min, removing from heat as soon as the oil comes out of the coconut beef. Add masala, apple powder, and coconut. Stir and fry for 4 - 5 min, stirring constantly. Do not let it boil.

Random Ingredients: purpose white flour,yukon gold potato,caster sugar,kidney bean,grand marnier,chili seasoning mix,green cardamom pod
title: Hot Garlic Potatoes With Kidney Beans
ingredients: 300 g yukon gold potatoes, diced | 1/4 cup chili seasoning mix ( spicy ) | 1/4 cup caster sugar | 4 large green cardamom pods | 1 tablespoon all-purpose white flour | 2 tablespoons grand marnier or 2 tablespoons other orange juice | 2 tablespoons chopped beans ( optional )
instructions: Sugar potato topping, in saucepan, add chili seasoning mix and sugar and heat over low heat until liquid boils.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon cube,hamburger bun,white wine,mahi fillet,raisin,lamb,chicken breast
title: Easy Indian Burger
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger bun | 2 chicken breasts, slices cut into thin slices | 1 lb lamb, thinly sliced pieces ( or lean pork chops ) | 1/2 cup raisins ( golden ) | 1 beef bouillon cube ( i prefer knorr brand ) | 1/3 cup white wine ( optional ) | 1/8 - 1/4 fluid ounce white wine
instructions: Heat a nonstick skillet with a little oil until smoking. Place ham, lamb or pork chops, raisins, and boullion cube in skillet. Cook, stirring to break meat up till desired thickness is reached. Add white wine and simmer till liquid is absorbed. Remove from heat and add your choice of toppings/condiments. Serve with warm rolls.

title: Bibianne's Special Ribs
ingredients: 3 lbs ribs, country style | 1 lb sugar snap pea
instructions: Cut all visible fat from the outside of the ribs, and place them in a shallow pan. Sprinkle with salt. The ribs should be at least 1 1/2 inches deep by the bone. Cover the ribs tightly with a very thin layer of salt so as not to over crowder the meat. Put the pan in the refrigerator, covered, to marinate for at least 6 hours. Remove all of the ribs from the brine and remove any bones or strings or fat between them. Rinse the sugar snaps and drain them well. Sprinkle the ribs with the salt. Preheat the oven to 300 degrees. Place the pan of ribs in the oven and cook for about 45 minutes. While the ribs are cooking, arrange the sugar snaps between two pieces of foil, and bake for about 10 minutes, or until the sugar snaps change color and are crisp and crunchy at the edges.

Random Ingredients: white vinegar,pepper sauce,brussels sprout,blue cheese,allspice,cherry,yellow squash,sauce
title: Beef, Blue Cheese and Vegetables Salad
ingredients: 1 lb lean ground sirloin or 1 lb round steak | 6 -10 cherry, halved | 1 large yellow squash ( about 1 pound ) | 1 lb brussels sprout, ends trimmed | 1 package blue cheese, crumbled | 1 1/2 tablespoons white vinegar or 1 1/2 tablespoons lemon juice | 1/4 cup hot sauce | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon hot pepper sauce | 1 dash allspice
instructions: Cut beef into 1/2 inch chunks. Cook beef in a 12 nonstick skillet over medium high heat until no pink remains, breaking up with back of spoon. Drain beef. Set pan aside. Reduce heat to medium and add remaining ingredients, except berries and sprinkle with crumbled blue cheese. Cover and cook for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally. Top with berries.

Random Ingredients: canadian bacon,red pepper flake,pepper,tea,flour tortilla,french bread,yogurt
title: Bacon & Canadian Roasted Sandwiches With Spicy Yogurt Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 1/2 cup canadian bacon or 1/2 cup canadian bacon, chopped finely ( 8 ounces ) | 3 tablespoons low-fat yogurt | 1/4 teaspoon dried red pepper flakes | 1/4 teaspoon pepper | 4 -5 large flour tortillas | 1/2 cup low-fat french bread, cut into 6 thick slices ( sandwich size ) | fresh ground pepper | yogurt, for dipping
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f and lightly oil a 6 x 13 x 2 inch baking dish. Combine the crumbled bacon with the yogurt and seasonings and set aside. Arrange the bread slices on the baking dish. Sprinkle lightly with pepper. Dividing evenly, spread half the yogurt mixture evenly over the bread. Arrange half the bacon mixture over the crumbles. Arrange 1/4 of the bread over the yogurt mixture and repeat. Top with remaining yogurt mixture. Sprinkle with pepper and serve right away with the pepper mixture.

title: Homemade Guacamole
ingredients: 1 packet mascarpone | 1/2 bottle guacamole ( or just use 2 tsp. of homemade guacamole and mix )
instructions: To make guacamole spread dip in microwave safe bowl at 50% power for 30 seconds or until warm. Add 1 tsp. Of mascarpone and mix. You can even spread over crackers if you like. Variation, use 3 tsp. Fresh guacamole and half tsp. Of guacamole for an extra kick.

Random Ingredients: pecorino romano cheese,black pepper,rigatoni pasta,liquid smoke,acorn squash,lemon lime soda,swede,pizza crust
title: Rigatoni & Squash Calabrese
ingredients: 1 medium acorn squash, quartered or 1 medium winter squash | 3 tablespoons lemon lime soda or 3 tablespoons lime flavored carbonated beverage | 1 teaspoon liquid smoke ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon pecorino romano cheese, grated | 1 pizza crust | 1/8 teaspoon black pepper | 1 can acorn squash ( reserve some reserved kernels ) | 1/2 cup swede or 1/2 cup green beans, cut into 1 1/2-inch lengths
instructions: Preheat oven to 400f. Place acorn squash in a steamer over 1 inch of boiling water.

Random Ingredients: egg,tilapia fillet,oregano leaf,mutton,nonstick cooking spray,cream coconut,baby spinach
title: Baked Tilapia With Coconut Sauce
ingredients: nonstick cooking spray | 3 tilapia fillets | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1 cup coconut, shredded, 2 1/2 coconuts | 3 cups baby spinach, coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup cream of coconut
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 °f. Spray a baking pan with nonstick spray. Sprinkle fillets with oregano. Place pan on baking pan. Bake for 5 - 9 minutes or until fish flakes easily with a fork. While fish is baking, combine coconut, spinach and cream of coconut in a food processor or blender. Process until smooth. Place fish on a serving plate. Brush with coconut sauce. Sprinkle top with oregano.

title: Chilli Bean Pasta
ingredients: 300 g dried refried beans | 1 tablespoon coriander seed, crushed | 2 green chili peppers, seeded and chopped | 200 g mixed vegetables, diced | 200 -280 g penne, cooked | 200 g dried apricots, chopped
instructions: Cook pasta in salted water according to pack instructions. When cooked, drain water. Wash and dry fry the coriander seed, the chillies and green pepper in a small frying pan for 2 - 3 mins until the chilies start to darken. Rinse and dry and transfer to a bowl. Place the beans in a non stick saucepan and heat for 5 minutes. Add the vegetables and stir. Cook for 1 - 2 mins. Mix the pasta with the chili bean mixture and sprinkle with the dried apricots.

title: Red Apple and Yellow Pepper Loaf
ingredients: 2 lbs tart apples, peeled and sliced | 1 lb yellow pepper, sliced | 1 egg white, lightly beaten
instructions: Combine apples and pepper in a large bowl. Sprinkle egg white over mixture. Mix well. Pour mixture into a loaf pan and smooth surface. Refrigerate 1 hour or overnight. Let stand 1 hour before slicing.

Random Ingredients: veal,parmesan cheese,ramen noodle,tamari,strawberry,salt pepper white,beef broth
title: Ramen Beef Noodle Soup
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb ground veal | 1 package ramen noodles | 4 cans beef broth | 1 can tuna, drained | salt and pepper and white | parmesan cheese, to sprinkle | strawberry, to garnish
instructions: Add the ramen noodles according to directions and set aside for 15 minutes. Heat oven to 375 degrees f. Brown the ground veal in a frying pan until just beginning to color. Add the beef broth, tuna, salt and pepper and heat for 5 minutes. Spray a large casserole dish with non stick cooking spray. Add the ramen noodles, stir to coat evenly, cover and bake for 35 - 40 minutes. To serve, top with the parmesan cheese, strawberries, and additional seasoning.

Random Ingredients: sea bass fillet,chicken stock cube,cherry,rice flour,red chili pepper,sesame oil,poblano pepper
title: Hot & Spicy Chilean Sea Bass
ingredients: 1 poblano pepper ( red, seeded & deveined ) | 2 tablespoons roasted rice flour | 2 cups chicken stock cubes | 2 tablespoons sesame oil ( sunflower ) | 2 tablespoons rice flour | 1 tablespoon sesame oil | 2 tablespoons cherry tomatoes ( sliced, may also use black or red ) | 1 small red chili pepper ( chargrilled ) | dried red chili pepper
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180c/350f. Cut peppers in half and deseed them. Cut the stems off, remove seeds & membrane. Place in a roasting tin & drizzle over 1 tbsp sesame oil. Roast in oven for 30 minutes, then remove from oven. Allow to cool slightly before opening foil. For the sauce, mix all the ingredients together, season to taste with salt & pepper. For the fish, combine the 1 tbsp sesame oil, 1 tbsp rice flour & the cherry tomatoes in a shallow dish. Coat the prawns with the sesame oil, then add them to the soy mixture in the dish. Place on the middle shelf of the oven for 15 - 20 minutes or until cooked through. Serve the prawns with the sauce.

Random Ingredients: red wine vinegar,yellow cake mix,pinto bean,sage leaf,ketchup,spring onion,onion
title: Fruit and Ketchup Bundt Cake
ingredients: 3 -4 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 1 cup ketchup | 2 tablespoons ketchup | 2 -3 tablespoons finely chopped onion | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh sage leaf | 1 tablespoon finely chopped red onion | 1 can pinto beans, rinsed and drained | 1 package yellow cake mix, such as jiffy | 1 spring onion, 1 1/2 inch wide, sliced diagonally in 2 inch lengths | 2 teaspoons finely chopped fresh sage leaves, for garnish. | 1/4 cup finely chopped spring onion, for garnish | 1 teaspoon finely chopped fresh sage, for garnish
instructions: In a medium bowl or a 2 quart sauce pan, stir together the vinegar, ketchup, onion, sage, and red onion. Bring to a boil over medium heat. Stir in the beans and cook for one minute, or until almost heated through. Remove from heat, and stir the mixture until well blended. Pour into a 9x13 inch pan, and cover with plastic wrap. Freeze overnight or until nearly all of the liquid is absorbed. To serve, preheat oven to 400°f remove plastic wrap from cake. Uncover the cake and spread the baked fruit and ketchup mixture evenly into the cake layer. Return the cake to the oven and bake until very firm, and a toothpick inserted into the center comes out dry, about 45 minutes. Remove from oven, and allow to cool before cutting. Serve sprinkled with onions, sage, and chopped spring onions.

Random Ingredients: apricot preserve jam,beef gravy,marjoram,hot chili powder,broth,dark sesame oil
title: Easy Microwave Dried Beef
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups beef gravy | 1 cup apricot preserves or 2 tablespoons jam | 1/3 cup prepared hot chili powder | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil | 3/4 cup broth | 1/2 cup prepared beef gravy | 1/2 teaspoon dried marjoram
instructions: Pour 1/2 cup gravy into microwave safe bowl. Microwave on high 5 minutes, or high 30 - 60 seconds, or until hot. Stir preserves into gravy. Microwave on high power 4 - 5 minutes to soft ball stage.

title: Simple and Creamy Mexican Salsa Dip.
ingredients: 8 ounces cream cheese, softened | 1 cup salsa | 1 teaspoon vanilla | 1/2 teaspoon salt and pepper | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne | 1 -2 tablespoon good seasonings mix
instructions: Mix cream cheese, salsa, seasoning mix and vanilla well together. Add salt and pepper and cayenne. Put in a bowl and refrigerate until ready to serve. I usually let this come to room temperature several hours after making this and stirring every so often.

Random Ingredients: chive,oyster sauce,chocolate square,green pea,beef stew meat,broccoli floret,salt black pepper,red lentil
title: Beef and Broccoli With Red Lentils
ingredients: 8 ounces beef stew meat, trimmed | 1 cup red lentil, rinsed and drained | 1 1/2 cups broccoli florets, chopped | 1/2 cup frozen green pea | 1/4 cup dried chives, snipped | 1 tablespoon oyster sauce | salt & freshly ground black pepper | 1 tablespoon unsweetened chocolate squares, shaved
instructions: In a skillet, cook the beef and the lentils over high heat, stirring constantly, until the meat is browned, about 5 minutes. Stir in the broccoli and peas. Sprinkle with the chives and bring to a boil. Cover, reduce the heat, and simmer, stirring occasionally, until the beef is tender, about 10 minutes. Transfer the beef mixture to a serving dish and stir in the oyster sauce. Season with salt and pepper. Melt the chocolate in a small bowl over warm water. Heat a skillet large enough to hold the beef and vegetables over high heat. Add the sauce to the pan and cook, and stir, scraping the bottom of the pan with a wooden spoon to loosen any browned bits. Remove from the heat and let cool slightly 5 minutes. Transfer to a serving bowl and garnish with the shredded chocolate.

Random Ingredients: soymilk,yellow mustard,anise seed,cauliflower floret,white bread flour
title: Cauliflower Cheese Bread for Persnickety People
ingredients: 1 large cauliflower floret | 2 1/3 cups unbleached white bread flour | 2/3 cup soymilk ( can use regular milk but it's far too dry ) | 2 tablespoons yellow mustard ( or use 2/3 tsp instant yellow mustard powder ) | 2 teaspoons anise seeds ( or use 1 tsp ground anise pods or 2 tsp ground cardamom )
instructions: Place the cauliflower floret in a heat proof bowl and cover with lightly sprayed plastic wrap. Refrigerate for 30 minutes or up to 8 hours. Preheat the oven to 400°f. If using a blender, combine the bread flour, milk, and mustard powder in a medium bowl. Toss to mix. Add the the anise seeds and florets and stir to blend. Remove the cauliflower from the fridge and lightly pat dry with paper towels. Using a small spoon, press the flakes between your fingers to get rid of as much of the liquid as possible. Cut out 5 inch rounds from the cauliflower with the bottom of a glass or biscuit cutter, using a 1 inch diameter cookie cutter or any small glass. Gently push the flakes through a sieve into a bowl and cover with the plastic wrap. Place on a baking sheet and bake for 20 - 25 minutes, stirring halfway through. When done, transfer to an oven profiler or heavy duty bowl to cool.

Random Ingredients: shell pasta,mint leaf,red pepper,taco sauce,parmesan cheese,caper,heavy cream,vanilla extract
title: Taco Pasta
ingredients: 2 packages shell pasta, such as cavatappi, broken | 1 jar taco sauce | 1/2 cup heavy cream | 2 teaspoons finely minced capers | 3 tablespoons grated parmesan cheese | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1/4 teaspoon ground red pepper | 1/4 cup chopped fresh mint leaves
instructions: Cook pasta in boiling water until al dente, about 7 minutes. Drain. Meanwhile, in a medium bowl, combine taco sauce, cream, capers, parmesan cheese, vanilla powder, ground red pepper and mint. Stir to blend. Pour over hot pasta until pasta is just coated. Sprinkle on top, and toss well.

title: Chipotle Steak for Tacos and Fajitas
ingredients: 3 teaspoons chipotle chile powder | 3 teaspoons marjoram or 2 teaspoons basil | 1 pound flank steak, cut into serving sized pieces
instructions: Combine chipotle powder, marjoram and marjoram pesto.

title: Simple Enchilada Sauce
ingredients: 1 can of good chili paste | 2 tablespoons of your choice maggi instant chicken bouillon | 1/2 teaspoon chili paste ( to your taste ) ( optional ) | adobo seasoning, any, depends on how much heat you like in the sauce
instructions: Pour sauce ingredients into small pan. Let it simmer until it reduces some of the chunky liquid down some. Add Adobo, heat up. Mix sauce until it is the consistency of gravy and put it back in your pan. If you like it thicker and thinner you can add some more chicken bouillon. Also, i often add more of my favorite adobo seasoning to mine. I like to add a little more sazon, paprika, etc. Enjoy.

title: Grilled Salmon With Preserved Lemons (Khoya Naramdil)
ingredients: 2 lbs salmon, sliced on the diagonal into 8 10 pieces | 2/3 cup khoya, crushed | 1 teaspoon dried khoroya | 1 tablespoon dried oregano leaves
instructions: Place 4 pieces of salmon on each plate. Pour 1/4 cup of kharoya, 1 teaspoon of dried oregano, and 1 tablespoon of crushed kha dhal on top. Wrap 3 pieces of foil around the salmon and place in a baking dish. Place in a preheated 475°f oven for 25 to 30 minutes or until the fish is done. Serve hot.

title: Healthy, Fat Free and Easy Spinach
ingredients: 2 packages fresh spinach | 1 can cream of coconut | 1 cup nonfat plain yogurt | 1 small piece fresh ginger, peeled and minced | 1 can baked pork or ( 14 ounce ) can turkey sausage | 1/3 cup tomato paste
instructions: Boil spinach until bright green. Drain spinach, and chop finely. Place spinach in a large bowl. Combine coconut, yogurt and ginger in a medium pan. Heat over medium, stirring frequently. Mix in tomato paste and coconut mixture. Stir in meat and sausage. Let simmer for 20 minutes. Pour sauce over spinach mixture and bake in oven at 350°f for about 10 minutes.

title: Ranch Salad
ingredients: 4 cups mixed romaine lettuce | 1 medium red capsicum, chopped | 2/3 cup light cream of celery soup | 4 tablespoons tahini
instructions: Tear or tear your lettuce and put in a salad bowl. Mix the rest of the ingredients and pour over the lettuce. Toss and serve.

title: Savoy Slaw Mix
ingredients: 2 teaspoons dijon mustard or 2 teaspoons spicy mustard | 1 teaspoontabasco sauce | 2 lbs savoy cabbage, washed and coarsely shredded
instructions: Prepare dressing the days before serving. Place cabbage in a large bowl and add dressing. Combine well. Store covered in refrigerator at least 2 days before using.

title: Liquo
ingredients: 1/2 cup brown rice | 1/2 lb mutton | 1 kg leg of lamb | 1 lb pork shoulder
instructions: Wash meat and cut into cubes. Put into the freezer. Cut lamb into 1 inch sized pieces. Wash rice. Put into freezer. When all ingredients are ready, put everything from the freezer into a crockpot and cook on low for 2 hours. You are aiming for a delicious sauce in a little wintery like the one used in step 1. Or you can leave it to cook on low for at least four hours.

title: French Bread II
ingredients: 2 cubes chicken bouillon | 1/4 cup maraschino cherries
instructions: Boil boullion in saucepan over med. Heat for 5 minutes then stir in cherries. This bread should be very dry so if necessary substitute some broth or water before serving or letting cool before serving.

Random Ingredients: bean sprout,dark beer,black tea,dark soy sauce
title: Cambodian Black Ale Jellybeans
ingredients: 3 cups strong black tea or 3 cups orange brew | 1 1/4 lbs brown beans sprouts ( can use white ) | 2 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 2 tablespoons dark soy sauce
instructions: Heat a 1 quart pot over low heat until hot. Stir in black tea or orange brew. Cover and let brew for 2 minutes. If using fresh black bean sprouts, rinse them before peeling. Pour the brew into the pot, cover and let brew about 30 minutes but not until beans are softened. Uncover, stir in dark soy sauce and dark soy sauce and return to warm. Let cool to room temperature before serving.

Random Ingredients: goat cheese,vinegar,bean sprout,beer,cilantro,sun tomato oil,corn oil
title: Hot Goat Cheese Salad with Cilantro Dressing
ingredients: 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, chopped | 7 tablespoons fresh cilantro, packed | 1/4 cup goat cheese, crumbled | 1/2 cup oil-packed sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained ( about 12 medium ) | 2 tablespoons distilled vinegar | corn oil or other neutral cooking oil | 12 whole wheat country beans sprouts
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the sun dried tomatoes and cilantro. With your hands, blend the sun dried tomatoes into the cilantro mixture until the mixture is chunky, about 10 seconds. Add the goat cheese and the oil, and blend until the cheese is melted. Place the sprouts in a small bowl, and mix with the vinegar. Stir in just enough corn oil or other neutral cooking oil so that they're not clump together. Drain the bean sprouts in a mesh strainer, then toss with the cheese dressing. Add the bean sprouts and refrigerate for 1 hour. Serve with the remaining dressing.

Random Ingredients: queso fresco,almond,tangerine,green bell pepper,egg noodle,ice,cheddar cheese,lettuce
title: Lettuce, Tangerines & Noodle Salad
ingredients: tangerine | 1/2 lb oaxaca queso fresco | 1/2 cup slivered almonds ( very coarsely chopped ) | 2 -3 ounces cheddar cheese, grated ( to taste ) | 6 large lettuce | ice | 1 green bell pepper, diced ( to taste ) | 4 eggs noodles, cooked ( to taste )
instructions: Peel tangerines from the tangerines and slice them into pieces that would be similar to coins/shapes. You can also dice them yourself if desired but i prefer not. Slice the cheeses into about 1/4 slices. Toss the cheeses with all the dressing except the noodles. Add the almonds to the salad right before serving. Arrange the lettuce on a large platter. Top with about 1/4 each of the egg noodles and the cheese dressing. The noodles will be crunchy if not used right away. You can serve the noodles, or if you prefer, top with the salad. You may also substitute another green bell pepper for the green pepper when serving. The cheese dressing is good on this but i prefer not.

Random Ingredients: phyllo pastry,natural peanut butter,white onion,chili paste,bailey irish cream
title: Phyllo Bites
ingredients: 1/3 cup white onion, finely chopped | 1/4 cup natural-style peanut butter | 2 tablespoons chili paste | 1 tablespoon baileys irish cream | 12 phyllo pastry sheets
instructions: Preheat oven 400f. Saute onions in a saucepan with a sprinkling of salt and simmer for 5 minutes. In a bowl mash the peanut butter with a fork. Add chili paste, baileys and stir until smooth. Place the phyllo in a work space and lightly spray with cooking spray. Pour hot butter mix over phyllo in the bowl. Brush top of phyllo with baileys/egg mixture, making sure the butter mix covers the mixture. Fold phyllo in half and place on baking sheet. Spray tops with cooking spray and cut a small slit in the corner. Bake until golden brown, approximately 15 minutes. Allow to cool.

Random Ingredients: tomato paste,black pepper,cream cheese,soymilk,ghee,kiwi,puff pastry,mexican cheese
title: Mexican Mango Cheese Rolls
ingredients: 1 teaspoon ghee ( clarified butter, or butter ) | 1 packet reduced-fat cream cheese | 400 g mexican blend cheese ( or monterey jack or mexican cheese ) | 7 tablespoons low-fat soy milk ( soy milk is best ) | 1 tablespoon tomato paste | 1 tablespoon grated kiwi ( optional, or other green chilies ) | 1/8 teaspoon ground black pepper | 2 sheets puff pastry, thawed ( approximately 20 sheets )
instructions: Mango cheesecake filling,. Preheat oven to 350°f melt ghee in a small saucepan over moderate heat. When it just starts to sizzle, add cream cheese and stir until blended. Remove from heat and allow to cool for 5 minutes. Transfer cream cheese mixture to a bowl. Add mexican cheese, soy milk, tomato paste, kiwi, pepper and mix well. Using a pastry brush, brush the top and bottom edges of each sheet of puff pastry with softened butter. Spoon mango cheese filling onto dough, leaving a 1/2 inch border along the edges of the pastry. Fold dough to form a half moon over the filling and brush top with butter. Repeat with the remaining puff pastry sheets, brushing each with butter as the cheese mixture is used up. Place prepared pastry on a nonstick baking sheet and bake 10 minutes, or until the pastry is set and golden. Serve hot, warm or room temperature.

Random Ingredients: hot water,beetroot,rye bread,portabella mushroom cap,parsley leaf,cream mushroom soup,basil leaf
title: Beetroot & Mushrooms With Red Wine Sauce
ingredients: 6 medium beetsroot, peeled and cut into chunks | 1/4 cup sweet breadcrumb | 4 portabella mushroom caps, sliced | 16 ounces condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1/4 cup hot water | 1 tablespoon fresh parsley leaves, shredded | 4 fresh basil leaves, shredded
instructions: Cover each beetroot with a slice of breadcrumb and roll tightly. Heat in toaster oven over medium heat until crusty. Stir fry beets in 1/4 cup of hot water on each side for 3 - 5 minutes, until crisp tender. Remove beets from water. Repeat and drain beets. Set beets aside. Stir soup, tomato basil & hot water in saucepan over medium heat until soup is well mixed. Add beets, mushroom caps and parsley.

title: Peachy Coconut-Cauliflower  With Peaches
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 lbs cauliflower | 2 cans unsweetened coconut milk | 2/3 cup sour cream | 1 yellow bell pepper, cut in 2-inch-long spears | 1/2 cup dried peach
instructions: Trim the cauliflower and remove the tough core from the lower leaves. Cut the small stalk into bite sized pieces, and cut the larger ones into bite sized pieces. Bring a large pot of water to a rolling boil, then add the cauliflower. Add the coconut milk. Boil for 10 minutes, then drain. Add the yellow, sour cream, bell pepper and peaches to your coconut milk and stir to combine. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to medium low and simmer slowly, stirring frequently. Continue to stir while you cook your cauliflower until just tender. When cool enough to handle, remove the cauliflower and puree in a food processor or blender, or use a hand held immersion blender. Return to the pot and heat through. Taste for seasoning, add salt or pepper. This can be served over the top of freshly cooked rice, if desired. Enjoy.

title: Arrabbiata #SP5
ingredients: 1 box spanish onion, sliced very thin | 4 eggs
instructions: Put the onion slices in a bowl of cold water. Pour water into bowl until submerge onions and water reaches the top of the onion pieces. Refrigerate 1 hour or until onion has been cooked. Drain onion in strainer, reserving water in bowl. When onion is watery but not dry, add a little water. Beat eggs well and add drained onion to egg mixture. Place spoonfuls of egg mixture in the bowl filled with water until all of the mixture is used up. Wrap in plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight or several hours. Heat oven to 325 degrees. Remove the wrap when ready to bake, and bake for 15 minutes. Remove from oven, and remove from bread pan. Brush top with a little egg mixture with cold water. Continue to bake until bread is dry and the egg appears to cook. Serve with lots of napkins and lotspunch.

title: Sun Dried Tomato and Yogurt (Abm)
ingredients: 1 package active dry yeast, 1 package | 3 cups warm water | 2 - 2 1/2 cups sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained and patted dry with paper towels | powdered sugar, for dusting, plus extra for dusting
instructions: In a small bowl, dissolve yeast in warm water. Stir well to blend. Cover and let stand in a warm place until bubbly about 15 minutes. While yeast is soaking, preheat oven to 450°f in a large bowl, stir together sun dried tomatoes and puffed sun dried tomatoes. Cover and set aside at room temperature for another 15 to 20 minutes. Using the back of the spoon, scrape down the sides of the bowl occasionally as the sun dried tomatoes break down until all the liquid is absorbed. Sprinkle with powdered sugar and stir just until combined. Spread dough onto a non stick cookie sheet lined with parchment paper or wax paper and bake for 12 to 14 minutes, until golden. Serve warm. Note, baking times may vary for oven, ovens, etc. Make sure ovens do not open door to door while baking.

title: Temptation of Heaven
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs chicken meat | 1 egg white ( about 2 whole ) | 1/2 cup gin
instructions: Cut up the meat and beat it with a fork. Beat in the egg white. Pour in the gin. Cover the pan and bake at 375º f for 45 minutes until bubbly.

title: Pork Spaghetti With Pumpkin
ingredients: 12 ounces smoked pork | 1 can diced pumpkin | 1 can beer | 1 package frozen sliced beets | 6 ounces spaghetti, cooked and drained
instructions: In crock pot or stock pot, cook pork, pumpkin, beer and frozen beets until done. Remove pork and stir in cooked pasta. Serve.

Random Ingredients: anaheim chilies,tamarind pulp,active yeast,tabasco sauce,dark beer,ajinomoto,raspberry jam
title: Beer-Battered Buns
ingredients: 1/2 cup tamarind pulp, plus | 1 tablespoon tamarind pulp | 1 tablespoon agave nectar or 1 tablespoon dark beer | 1 teaspoon enaro hot curry powder or 1 teaspoon tabasco sauce | 1/2 teaspoon active dry yeast | 1/2 teaspoon ajinomoto ( chinese dried onion ) | 1/4 teaspoon active dry yeast | 1/2 cup dark beer | 2 tablespoons raspberry jam | 1 medium anaheim chilies
instructions: For the syrup, pour all of the syrup ingredients into a small pot and bring to a boil. Cool and remove skins from chiles and seed. Cut into 1/4 inch chuncks for buns. Place in a large bowl and add 1 ounce of tamarind pulp, agavenectar, hot curry powder, and yeast. Mix well and let sit for 20 minutes. For assembly, place the buns on a baking sheet and put in the freezer to freeze for at least 3 hours to soften the crust. Cut into small pieces and toast in a 350 degree oven for 10 minutes. Then take the bread pieces out of the freezer, stir them around a few times, and return them to the oven to toast. Assemble buns, add 1 ounce of tamarind pulp to 1 ounce of agave syrup and achiote. Stir the mixture until it dissolves. Add ½ cup dark beer, and stir well. Add a few cups of the syrup mixture. Spread the bread pieces in a single layer on the baking sheet and toast in a 360 degree oven for 10 minutes or until golden brown. Spread 1 ounce of jam onto each piece of buns. Garnish with ancho chiles and additional piece of buns.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice zest,spaghetti,extra virgin olive oil,vinegar
title: Pasta Salad Vinaigrette
ingredients: 1/4 cup lemon juice ( use zest of 1 lemon plus extra for seasoning ) | 1 tablespoon vinegar ( white ) | 1/2 cup extra virgin olive oil | 12 ounces spaghetti, cooked and drained
instructions: In a small bowl whisk lemon zest, vinegar and ½ cup of the olive oil together until smooth, then slowly add remaining oil while whisking. Add drained pasta and toss.

title: Irish Cauliflower
ingredients: 1 large cauliflower floret | 4 tablespoons walnut pieces or 4 tablespoons butter | 1 1/2 cups egg substitute | 3/4 cup vegetable stock or 3/4 cup guinness stout | 2 teaspoons salt | 1 -2 teaspoon instant minced garlic or 1 -2 teaspoon dry minced garlic
instructions: Wash cauliflower well. Cover and steam in microwave oven 4 - 10 minutes until tender crisp. While steaming, heat to boiling the walnuts for 3 mins until they turn golden brown. Drain well and cool to room temperature. When cauliflower is cold, remove cauliflower from shell and steam in blender until water is gone.. Set aside in a bowl. Whip egg substitute with salt and garlic. Spread the melted walnuts on a baking sheet and top with cauliflower. Pour egg substitute over cauliflower and walnuts. Serve with warm beer.

Random Ingredients: cardamom,oregano,buttermilk,italian salad dressing,green onion,curry leaf,beef gravy
title: Easy Curry Beef Gravy
ingredients: 1 lb top sirloin steak, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 tablespoon mild curry leaf ( indian store brand ) | 1 cup buttermilk | 1/4 cup fresh buttermilk | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried oregano | 2 teaspoons dried italian salad dressing | 3 -6 green onions, sliced | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom or 1/4 teaspoon ground cinnamon
instructions: Place cubed meat in a shallow dish and sprinkle with curry leaves. In a bowl, combine 1 cup and buttermilk.

title: Pineapple-Vietnamese Glaze on Fish
ingredients: 1/2 cup orange juice or 1/2 cup pineapple juice | 1/4 cup vinegar | 1/3 cup fish sauce ( nam pla ) | 1/8 teaspoon ground allspice ( optional ) | 1 small carrot, peeled and julienned | 1 ounce prosciutto or 1 ounce bacon, cut into 1/2 to 3/4 inch dice | 1/2 cup finely chopped fresh marjoram ( asian-style mayonnaise ) ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a medium saucepan and bring to a boil over medium high heat. Toss with fish sauce and marjoram. Stir well before serving, if desired.

Random Ingredients: cocoa powder,pork,pinto bean,cumin,pesto sauce,egg yolk,saltine cracker,rice paper
title: Alfredo Beans & Rice Paper Wraps
ingredients: 2 cups pinto beans, drained | 4 cups cooked rice paper sheets | 1 lb ground pork | 1 egg yolk | 1 teaspoon cumin | 2/3 cup pesto sauce, purchased or 2/3 cup commercial store-bought pesto sauce | paprika and salt, to taste | cocoa powder, to taste
instructions: Rinse beans. Place in a kettle on low heat, cover and simmer for about 1 hour and a half, until the beans become soft. Drain the beans. Bring the beans to a boil in water to cover in a saucepan. Add enough water to prevent burning. Cook rice papers according to package directions. Drain, rinse under cold water, soak a minute or two. Meanwhile, in a small bowl, mix the pork with the egg yolk, cumin and ¼ cup of the pesto sauce. Wet a wooden or metal ring, line it with 2 or 3 sheets of rice paper and place one eighth of the meat mixture near the center, near the edge of the rice paper. Wrap the rice paper up. Repeat wrapping with the remaining sheets and meat mixture, ending with the paprika and salsa. Arrange the wrapped beans on a serving platter and serve right away.

Random Ingredients: cinnamon,green curry paste,green cabbage,chipotle pepper adobo sauce,madras curry powder
title: Sweet Potato Chipotle Green Curry
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs green cabbage, chopped | 1 teaspoon madras curry powder ( or to taste ) | 1 -2 chipotle pepper in adobo sauce | 2 teaspoons green curry paste | 1 teaspoon cinnamon ( or to taste )
instructions: Blend everything together. Enjoy i serve this with brown rice and a side of fresh tomato.

Random Ingredients: bread,orange bell pepper,onion powder,elbow macaroni,asparagus spear,bean sprout,salmon fillet,bacon dripping
title: Baked Salmon With Asparagus and Macaroni
ingredients: 6 slices bacon drippings or 4 -6 slices cooked ham, chopped, divided | 1 cup shredded asparagus spear | 1 cup dry baked macaroni | 1 orange bell pepper, diced | 2 cups warm bean sprouts | 1 lb boneless skinless salmon fillet, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon onion powder | 1/8 teaspoon ground red pepper | 1 pinch salt and pepper
instructions: In a nonstick skillet, cook bacon drippings over medium high heat until crisp. Remove bacon from skillet and reserve. Saute asparagus for 3 - 5 minutes. Remove the asparagus and set aside. Pour off all but 3 t. Of the drippings. Add macaroni and orange pepper. Cover and cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, for 8 minutes. Add asparagus and cook an additional 4 minutes. Cover and remove from heat. In a separate skillet, cook macaroni and bean sprouts according to the directions. Drain and set aside. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Arrange salmon in a sprayed baking dish. Sprinkle with onion and ground red pepper. Drizzle with bacon drippings and toss. Bake for 8 - 9 minutes and top with reserved 2 t bacon drippings and chopped asparagus. Return to the oven for a few minutes to finish browning the salmon.

Random Ingredients: annatto seed,purpose flour,liquid smoke flavoring,green olive,pimiento
title: Spicy Fried Green Olives
ingredients: 2 cups pitted green olives | 1 jar pimento slices, or more to taste | 1 1/2 tablespoons liquid smoke flavoring | 3 1/2 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 1 teaspoon annatto seeds
instructions: Slice olives and place them in a bowl. Pour in liquid smoke and refrigerate 3 hours to macerate. Stir flour into olives and add annatto seed.

Random Ingredients: rye bread,halibut fillet,serrano pepper,maple syrup,chicken breast,garlic
title: Broiled Halibut With Maple Syrup & Serrano Peppers
ingredients: 1 large halibut fillet | 1/4 cup maple syrup | 2 slices rye bread | 2 tablespoons coarsely chopped garlic | 1 serrano pepper, minced | 1/8 teaspoon salt ( optional )
instructions: Coat a broiler pan with nonstick cooking spray. Cut a small slit in the side of the halibut fillet. Place halibut fillet. Reserve any leftovers. Combine remaining ingredients, except for the salt in a shallow bowl. Brush fish with glaze. Place halibut on broiler pan. Broil 20 minutes, basting once with glaze. Serve with reserved glaze. Cooks notes,. • the original recipe specified broiler pan, but i thought a 10 skillet would work as well as a grill basket in the oven for a crisp exterior.

title: Vanille Kooey
ingredients: 2 tablespoons brown sugar | 2 tablespoons pearl barley | 1 tablespoon vanilla sugar
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small saucepan, and bring to a boil. Then remove from heat and stir until the sugar is thoroughly mixed in and dissolved. Pour into a glass pan.

Random Ingredients: cabbage,kidney bean,bay leaf,salt pork,macadamia nut,pasilla chile
title: Cabbage 'taste' Beans
ingredients: 5 lbs cabbage ( about 11 inches long ) | 1 can kidney beans | 4 ounces salt pork | 4 ounces pasilla chiles, whole, dried, seeded and finely chopped | 2 bay leaves | 1/4 cup macadamia nuts
instructions: Rinse the beans and place in a large saucepan. Cover with cold water and bring to the boil over high heat. After 5 minutes, remove the water. Cover and simmer over low heat for about 1 hour, until all of the liquid is absorbed, and the beans are dark and somewhat thick. Drain the beans and measure out about 3 cups. Remove the beans from the heat and let cool. Chop the cabbage coarsely. Place the remaining ingredients in a large stockpot, and bring to a boil. Reduce the heat, cover, and simmer over very low heat for 1 hour, or until the beans are tender. Ladle the beans into bowls and ladle over any remaining juice. Serve at once.

title: Gravy Mix
ingredients: 1 teaspoon crushed cumin powder | 1 teaspoon spicy cajun seasoning
instructions: In a large glass or plastic container combine cumin powder, cajun seasoning, and spicy gravy mix. Store in the refrigerator.

title: Pebberlanas Fritters(Fritters)
ingredients: 1 kg raspberries, hulled | 200 g pepitas
instructions: Combine the pepitas and the berries and leave in the refridgerator for at least half an hour. Take out the pepitas and press the berries with your fingers. Keep covered with a wet towel. You're now ready to fry the fritters. Heat a large frying pan. Spoon a large amount of oil over the fritters and test. If the oil is too hot, the fritters will stick. They will puff and bubble up.

Random Ingredients: mung bean noodle,tarragon,catsup,swiss cheese,garam masala,bread crumb
title: Curried Mung Beans
ingredients: 2 cans mung bean noodles | 1/2 pound shredded swiss cheese | 1/4 cup dry bread crumbs | 1/2 cup catsup | 1 1/2 teaspoons minced fresh tarragon | 1 1/2 teaspoons garam masala ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Mix mung bean noodles, swiss cheese, bread crumbs, catsup, tarragon, garam masala, and hot pepper sauce together until thoroughly mixed.

title: Brazilian Margaritas
ingredients: 1 can or bottle sweetened orange juice | 3 cubes ice cubes, or as desired
instructions: Mix the orange juice, ice, and sweetened margarita mix together in a glass with a straw until the drink is well chilled, 2 to 3 hours. Strain the orange drink into a chilled cocktail glass.

Random Ingredients: apple juice,vinaigrette,dill pickle,parsnip,vanilla bean,allspice,mexican cheese,italian sausage
title: Pennsylvania Dutch Mirliton
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs fresh italian sausage | 1/2 lb sweet italian sausage or 1/2 lb sweet lite cooked sweet sausage | 2 lbs assorted parsnips, diced | 2 medium pints apple juice | 2 large vinaigrette | 1/2 cup diced dill pickle | 1/4 cup powdered italian cheese blend | 1/4 teaspoon allspice
instructions: Cut the sausages into pieces and cook until brown. Remove from skillet and drain and crumble. When cooled, chop the sausages into 1/2 inch cubes. Combine sausages, parsnips, apples, pints of apple juice and 2 tblspn of the dill pickle togehter. Mix well. Add the remaining dill pickle and mix well again. Add the sugar mixture and toss again. Cover the mixture and place in refrigerator. To serve, mix a scoop of sour cream with enough soured cheese to give it a nice creamy consistency. Slice the bread into 1/2 inch thick slices. Place some mixture on each slice of bread and then top with the sour cream mixture. Serve with a bottle of brandy sauce.

title: Oyster Sauce
ingredients: 1 teaspoon green curry paste | 1 1/2 cups wild rice, rinsed | 4 lime wedges, or to taste | 6 tablespoons prepared sweet-and-sour oyster sauce
instructions: Stir curry paste together in a bowl and pour into a small dish. Mix wild rice and lime wedges in a bowl until evenly coated. Set aside for 10 minutes, then add the spicy oyster sauce. The sauce should be thick enough to coat the back of a spoon. Stir gently until the rice absorbs the sauce.

Random Ingredients: mandarin orange,pistachio,vegetable stock,white flour,red onion,ginger,ravioli,corn niblets
title: Ravioli With Pistachios
ingredients: 1 cup white flour | 1 1/2 cups frozen mixed salad and vegetables niblets, thawed | 7 -8 mandarin oranges | 3 1/2 cups vegetable stock | 2 teaspoons grated fresh ginger | 2 tablespoons grated fresh ginger | 2 tablespoons grated red onions | 1 box ravioli ( such as jello ) | 1 tablespoon white flour | 1 tablespoon white flour, mixed with 1 tbsp. of flour
instructions: Note, this freezes well, if thawed thawing. Remove the zest from one of the mandarin oranges. Reserve the peel for sprinkling later. Using the back of a large spoon, scoop the flesh from the rind into a small bowl, and add about half of the juice, ginger, onion and reserved orange peel. Cut the flesh into 1/2 inch cubes. Combine the rind and juice, vegetable stock and ginger in a large saucepan or dutch oven with a lid on heat. Stir in remaining ingredients and simmer over medium heat for 20 minutes. The sauce will thicken slightly as it simmers. Remove the lid, and simmer slowly while boiling for 5 minutes. Stir in 1 tbsp flour, and cook for 1 minute longer. Taste for seasoning. Meanwhile, cook your ravioli per package instructions. They should be firm but firm in the center. As soon as the ravioli float to the surface with the tips, drain them, return to the pan with the sauce, and simmer for 5 more minutes. Place into a serving dish, toss with a little extra flour, and serve.

title: Dorie Greenspan Pasta Salad
ingredients: 250 g hamburger | 1/4 scallion, finely diced | 1/4 liter flat leaf parsley, leaves chopped | 1 vanilla bean, split ( optional ) | 250 g pasta ( linguetta, spiral or macaroni ) | 1 lettuce, roughly chopped | 2 -3 tablespoons prepared grain mustard | 1/2 tablespoon scallion, finely sliced ( optional )
instructions: Brown the hamburger, scallion, parsley, vanilla bean on high in a large dish/pitcher with a little oil. Add the pasta and cook until it is cooked to your liking. Drain off excess fat and cool slightly. Add the tomato and lettuce, season with mustard and scallion. Serve the salad with a bit of cheese on top.

title: Cashew and Red Onion Salad (Salata Saban)
ingredients: 500 g skinless roasted cashews, crushed | 1 red onion, finely chopped
instructions: Mix the cashews with the chopped red onion until all are covered. Refrigerate until serving time. Serve chilled.

Random Ingredients: tapioca starch,english mustard powder,heavy whipping cream,celery seed,fig,date
title: Couscous Fingers
ingredients: 1/4 cup tapioca starch | 1 cup heavy whipping cream | 1/4 teaspoon celery seed | 2 teaspoons english mustard powder | 1 cup finely chopped dates | 1/3 cup chopped crystallized figs
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine the cornstarch with 1 cup of the whipping cream. Stir in the celery seed, mustard powder and dates. Add the remaining 1/2 cup whipping cream. Place in a small bowl or mold and chill until needed. Cover and refrigerate until needed.

Random Ingredients: baby spinach leaf,liquid smoke,meat,white sugar,romaine lettuce
title: My Mom's "ultimate" Meat Kebabs
ingredients: 500 g minced meat, preferably london broil type or 500 g ground lamb | 4 roma lettuce, coarsely chopped | 1 tablespoon white sugar | 1 tablespoon liquid smoke | 1 cup baby spinach leaves
instructions: The meat is the mix of the worst meat in the world, gristle, bone, shredded lamb etc, it tends to be pretty hard unless you have it. If no meat it is a ratio of 1lb to lamb. It should be roughly equal in moisture and moisture. Combine meat with remaining ingredients in a bowl. If using frozen, just place the bag of meat into a ziploc bag and freeze for half an hour. Remove the meat from the bag. Place in the refrigerator for 6 hours. Preheat the grill to high heat or preheat a griller pan at medium high for 4 to 5 minutes. Remove meat from the freezer and put onto a plate. Slice meat as thinly as possible, 1 to an inch each. Brush each slice with the glaze, let sit until it is a little more glazed with glaze. Wipe meat with paper towel. Grill meat on the medium heat about 5 minutes a side or until meat is cooked through and crisp and brown. Serve with grilled greens. I usually add the baby spinach leaves and serve on lettuce leaves.

Random Ingredients: italian parsley,glutinous rice flour,potato starch,coconut milk,potato
title: Pancake Roll
ingredients: 2 cups glutinous-rice flour | 6 cups unsweetened coconut milk | 3 cups sweet potato starch | 1 cup potato starch | 2 cups chopped italian parsley
instructions: In a large bowl, stir together the rice flour, coconut milk, sweet potato starch and parsley. When everything is together evenly, make golf ball sized balls. Roll them in the egg beater, then roll in the glutinous rice flour then roll in the potato starch mixture. Heat 2 inches of oil in a fry pan or deep fryer. Fry them on each side until golden brown. Drain on paper towels and enjoy.

title: Nigella Lawson's Cheats for your Dogs!
ingredients: 6 ounces whole meal oats | 3 -4 teaspoons ground sage leaves | 8 ounces chicken thighs ( or a mixture of thighs, drumsticks and breasts ) | 4 g cashews ( or roasted peanuts )
instructions: Pre heat the oven to 350 degrees. Place the oats, sage and a little salted butter/margarine in a bowl, mixing to combine. Add the chicken/shrooms and turn to coat with the fat. Place the bowl on an oven tray and top with freshly ground baking soda. Bake for 25 - 30 minutes.. Serve straight away with a salad or with roasted plantains and garlic bread or pitta bread wraps.

title: Tortilla Española
ingredients: 1 head fresh broccoli, chopped | 1 pound ground pork | 1 can diced red chile peppers | 3 1/2 cups crushed iceberg lettuce, divided | 3 containers frozen whipped topping, divided
instructions: Bring a pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add the broccoli, and cook uncovered until tender, about 6 minutes.

Random Ingredients: iceberg lettuce,green tea powder,bow tie pasta,sea salt,chili pepper flake,red cabbage,juniper berry,egg noodle
title: Homemade Korean Pasta Salad
ingredients: iceberg lettuce | 1/2 red cabbage | 1/4 green tea powder | 5 1/2 ounces radish pickle chili peppers ( korean ) | 2 cups bow tie pasta | 1/4 teaspoon crushed juniper berries ( korean ) | 1 egg noodle | sea salt
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl and toss to coat. Pour into a large serving bowl and sprinkle with sea salt.

title: Spicy BBQ Chicken
ingredients: 24 ounces tomato sauce ( i use hunt's ) | 1 can tomato sauce ( hunt's ) | 1 cup mango, coarsely diced | 1 cup blueberries | 1 1/2 cups bea fat baked beans, cooked and well drained | 1 can baked chicken thighs | 2 tablespoons corn syrup
instructions: Place all ingredients in a crock pot and stir well. Cover and cook on low heat 8 - 10 hours. Remove chicken and bones, tear apart and return to crockpot.

title: Mexican Coleslaw
ingredients: 1 package coleslaw mix | 1 medium chunky salsa | 1/4 vanilla bean, split in half | 1/2 small fresh basil leaf
instructions: In a large bowl, toss well the coleslaw mix and chunky salsa. Split vanilla bean & scrap out the seeds. Add bean seeds and stir to combine. Garnish coleslaw with basil leaves and serve.

title: Cranberry-Yogurt Ice Cream Sandwiches
ingredients: 16 ounces plain yogurt ( i have used sour cream and buttermilk ) | 1 cup red onion, finely minced | 1/4 cup cranberries | vanilla ice cream
instructions: Mix yogurt, onion and cranberries. If you have a blender you do this for you can use the blender or blend it with the yogurt mixture. Place the mixture in a plastic freezer bag with a lid and place it in the freezer until the mixture is almost frozen. Remove from freezer and place in another plastic plastic freezer bag. Place in the freezer and freeze until firm. Once frozen, remove from freezer and place in a container or tray and keep in freezer. Once firm, remove from freezer, place in a bag and mix in yogurt and use as desired or serve in your favorite sandwich recipe. Feel free to add a little more yogurt to your favorite salad as you like.

Random Ingredients: portabella mushroom,topping,poppy seed,beef steak,french bread,white bean
title: Hot Beef Burgers II
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs lean beef round steak, cut into thin bite sized strips | 2 teaspoons poppy seeds, mixed with | 1 1/2 tablespoons flour, divided | 3 -4 portabella mushrooms, sliced | 2 cans white beans, rinsed and drained | 2 loaves french bread, split | 1 bag frozen whipped topping
instructions: In large plastic ziplock bag, combine beef strips, poppy seeds and 2 tablespoons flour mixture. Toss and marinate overnight. Remove beef slices from bag, reserving marinade. Place beef in a large skillet with marinating juices. Stir in mushrooms. Cook and stir until mushrooms are slightly browned. Place bread on grill, cut side down. Grill 3 - 5 minutes per side or until lightly browned. Top with a slice of beef, spoon some sauce over. Top with whipped topping.

title: Avgolemono
ingredients: 6 cups water | 1/4 cup tamari | 8 cups arborio rice | 1 mango, peeled and chopped | 1 cup fresh pearl onions, peeled | 1/4 cup sweet pepper sauce | kosher salt to taste | 1 package dry pasta
instructions: Bring the water to a boil in a large stockpot over high heat. Stir in the tamari and arborio rice until rice is evenly coated with oil. Reduce heat to low and simmer the rice uncovered until the liquid has been absorbed, 20 to 25 minutes. While the rice is simmering, bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Stir in the mango, onions, sweet pepper sauce, and salt. Cook the noodles in the boiling water, stirring occasionally, until tender yet firm to the bite, about 5 minutes. Drain and divide noodles into bowls. Place a scoop of noodles into each bowl using a spoon.

title: The Mountain and Happy Hour Turkey and Beans
ingredients: 1 hamburger | 2 tablespoons maple syrup | 1 package frozen lima beans | 7 ounces turkey, diced | black pepper or cayenne pepper, to taste | pistachio nut ( optional )
instructions: Brown hamburger. Add rest of ingredients except for pepper and nuts. Tear pita bread into pieces and toss with a little cornstarch dissolved in a little cold water. Serve on a plate with a lettuce leaf or toothpicks.

title: Green Pea Stew
ingredients: 2 cups fresh snow peas | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh rosemary | 1 teaspoon ground turmeric | 1 green onion, sliced
instructions: Preheat the oven to 275 degrees f. Place the snow peas into a baking dish. Bake in the preheated oven until tender, about 40 minutes. Cool, then coarsely chop. Place the fresh rosemary into a saucepan with just enough water to cover. Bring to a boil, reduce heat to low, and simmer for 10 minutes for the green onion. Drain. Place the chopped snow peas into a pot with the green onion. Pour the snow peas over the green onion. Place a lid on the pot, and let the stew steam gently for 5 minutes, then stir. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: candy sprinkle,extra virgin olive oil,salt pepper,radish,pork,pearl barley,apricot
title: Corn and Pearl Barley Salad
ingredients: 2 ounces pearl barley | 2 ounces ground lean pork ( i like to use lean deli meat ) | 3 1/2 ounces dried apricots, halved | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 2 teaspoons brandy or 2 teaspoons rum | 1/4 teaspoon salt and pepper | 1 small radish, chopped finely
instructions: Cook barley in two thirds of the boiling water for 25 minutes, until tender. Drain. Combine the pork, apricots, olive oil, brandy and salt and pepper in a bowl. Add barley and toss well, then leave to warm. Place remaining ingredients into a serving bowl, then toss well so all ingredients have mixed. Dish out and stir through salad.

title: Luscious Baked Chicken
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves ( one to six ounces per person ) | 1 cup whipping cream | 300 ml double cream
instructions: Preheat the oven at 190°c. If you are using boneless chicken, cut into 2 cm slices, then cut each slice into 2 cm long strips across a slit across the breast half. Put the chicken and cream in a large baking dish. Add the remaining ingredients to the baking dish, then pour the mix over the chicken. Cover it with foil and put it into the freezer for 1 hour or so. The chicken should come off the grill easily. Put the baking dish on a tray, then take out the foil and chicken with tongs. Put back in the oven for a further 30 minutes. Turn the chicken around and let it cook for a further 25 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and tender.

title: Frikadeller Salatasi
ingredients: 1 can coriander seeds | 1/2 cup ground allspice | 1/2 large apple, preferably fuji | 2 lbs lean ground beef chuck | 1 head romaine lettuce, coarsely chopped | fresh ground black pepper
instructions: In a small saucepan, toast the corriander and allspice over moderate heat, shaking the pan until the spices are fragrant and beginning to smell fragrant, about 3 minutes. Pulse the coriander mixture in an electric spice mill or heavy skillet over moderate heat, stirring, until smooth and well blended, 3 to 5 minutes. Transfer the ground beef to a bowl and mix with half the ground corriander mixture with the remaining ground corriander and ground beef. Roll the beef mixture into 1 inch balls, pressing them gently to compact it tightly. Chill until the fat has solidified, about 30 minutes and up to one day. Lightly oil a large skillet and heat until hot but not smoking and cook the patties 3 at a time, turning them over once, until golden, 6 to 8 minutes total time. Transfer to paper towels to drain. Arrange the patties on a platter and sprinkle with pepper. Serve at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: white wine vinegar,ice,chili flake,butter,green coriander,kalamata olive
title: Chilli Olives Stuffed (Cheriekels) (Zwt 1)
ingredients: 7 -8 pitted kalamata olives | 2 -3 drops chili flakes | 2 -3 drops white wine vinegar ( to taste ) | 2 tablespoons chilled butter, cut into pieces ( room temperature ) | 3 -4 tablespoons fresh green coriander ( optional, chopped ) | crushed ice ( optional )
instructions: Place olives on a plate and pour boiling water over them to cover. Let stand 10 - 15 minutes. Drain well and coarsely chop them into small pieces. Combine with other ingredients except chilled butter and mix well. Cover and chill 1 - 2 hours. Take a handful of the olives and lightly press them gently between your hands so as not to crush them. Then, on a large shallow tray lined with papere or waxed paper, mound the olives on the paper. Make a hole in the centre of the olives with your fingers. Using a skewer, poke holes in each olive. Put on a sheet of waxed paper that has been sprinkled with sugar and freeze until ready to use. Cut off the paper, remove the filling and discard, and, using a 1½ inch biscuit or round cutter, roll out the remaining olives. You might want to split them by hand. Remove the paper, and with a small spoon, make indentations through the centers of the olives. Sprinkle the frozen filling with more cheese, if desired.

title: Orange Vichyssoise
ingredients: 8 ounces plain yogurt | 4 ounces milk | 3 1/2 ounces orange peel, finely grated | 4 1/2 ounces dill pickles, finely sliced | 4 1/2 ounces toothpicks
instructions: Put the yogurt into a bowl, add the milk and stir until the mixture bubbles. Add the orange peel, pickles and salt and pepper to taste. Heat the grill to high. Brush a heatproof plate with some oil and put the orange slices over it in a circle. Place a toothpick in each piece of orange and put under the grill to lightly brown the toothpick. Serve hot or cold, with a dip or cocktail sauce.

Random Ingredients: graham cracker crumb,onion flake,italian sausage link,milk,garbanzo bean,adobo seasoning
title: Authentic Mexican Beans #RSC
ingredients: 1 lb sweet italian sausage link, ground, browned, drained and cooked | 1 can garbanzo beans, drained | 1/4 cup finely chopped onion | 1 teaspoon adobo seasoning, with or 1/4 teaspoon msg | 1/4 cup graham cracker crumbs | 1/4 cup milk or 1/4 cup buttermilk
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a casserole dish bake at 350 degrees farenheit 40 - 50 minutes.

title: Grilled Salmon on the Pot
ingredients: 1 piece salmon | 1 tablespoon dried parsley ( not dried! ) | 1 tablespoon ground paprika or 1 teaspoon celery seed | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 3 tablespoons water, to thin
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°f. Remove skin from salmon. Place salmon on greased grill rack directly over medium coals. Sprinkle with salt and paprika and cook for 7 minutes on each side. If desired, sprinkle with water.

title: Coconut Ginger Beer (Ginger Beer)
