ingredients: 1/2 cup raw cashews, about 12 ( not peanuts ) or 1/2 cup unsweetened coconut milk | 2 teaspoons allspice, fresh ground mexican | 1 cup canned light coconut milk or ( 14 ounce ) light rum
instructions: Put cashews in a fine mesh strainer and drain well. Pour coconut milk into a blender and add the allspice. Blend on high until well mixed. Pour into glass mugs and stir in coconut milk until thoroughly combined and ice cubes turn gray. Serve immediately.

title: Quick 'n' Easy Sauteed Okra
ingredients: 1 lb fresh okra ( cut in half if whole okra is used ) | 3 -5 cups packed greens ( call as desired )
instructions: Wash okra well in cold water, then drain well. Slice off top and stem of okra and discard tough center stem part. If not eating immediately, slice into about 3 - 4 inch slices from the stem end to end and save for next use. Heat 2 inch depth of oil or ghee over high heat until a small amount of okra dropped into the oil turns golden brown, about 1 minute. Immediately remove with a slotted spoon and drain using paper towels. Discard the set aside okra and cut into 1 inch pieces. Heat oil or ghee in a 2 - 3 quart pot or deep skillet set over moderate heat until hot but not smoking, then saute okra in batches and turning frequently until golden, 2 - 3 minutes. Remove okra and set aside. Add water and bring to a simmer. Add greens for about a minute or so to wilt them slightly, then return okra, or any reserved greens, and cook over medium heat till wilted and warmed through. Stir and serve immediately. Variation, cooked okra can be frozen in ziplock freezer bags, or in an airtight plastic container. If frozen, thaw completely in an airing cupboard for up to 1 week.

title: Barbecue Sauce III
ingredients: 1/4 cup corn oil for frying | 1 cup barbecue sauce
instructions: Heat oil in a skillet over medium heat. Once oil is warm, add barbecue sauce, and stir until thoroughly combined. Bring to boil, and boil for 3 to 5 minutes. Remove from heat, and store in refrigerator, stirring occasionally.

title: Curry Bean Beans
ingredients: 4 cups washed beans | 1 tablespoon ground asafoetida powder | 1 tablespoon curry paste
instructions: Wash the beans and dry them. Add one tbsps of curry paste to half a cup in a heavy bottomed pan. Add the asafoetida. When the mustard sputters, stir in the rest of the curry paste. Fry the asafoetida in the pan for a minute or two. Add the cooked beans. Spread a cup or 2 of water on top of the beans. Simmer till the water comes up to the level of the beans. Lower flame to slow, cover and cook on low heat till the beans are tender or a little undercooked.

Random Ingredients: teriyaki sauce,pecan,pine nut,shrimp,tortellini,green chili pepper,poblano chile,yellow mustard
title: Shrimp and Pecan Tortellini
ingredients: 1 package frozen cooked shrimp ( thawed and drained if necessary ) | 3 tablespoons teriyaki sauce | 1/4 cup chopped green chili pepper | 1 teaspoon finely chopped poblano chile | 1/2 cup toasted pine nuts | 1 tablespoon yellow mustard | 1 1/2 cups crumbled mixed pecans
instructions: Prepare shrimp according to package directions, using lemon marinade. Place shrimp, teriyaki sauce, chile, pecans, and dijon dressing in a food processor. Process until chopped.

title: Frangelico Mango Grissoni
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups quinoa, cooked | 100 g chestnuts, finely chopped | 1/4 cup pecorino cheese, grated ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons chives, chopped ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons self-raising flour ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons parmesan cheese, grated ( optional ) | 1/2 cup black coffee, warmed ( optional ) | 1 cup mango, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c / 400°f. Mix all ingredients in a bowl & pour into 2 greased muffin tins. Bake for 20 25mins.

Random Ingredients: tabasco brand chipotle pepper sauce,mustard seed,chicken bouillon,kosher salt black pepper,soya sauce
title: Chiles Con Dry Roasted Chips (((Rick Bayless)
ingredients: 2 lbs kosher salt-free black pepper, course ground | 2 tablespoons mustard seeds | 2 teaspoons instant chicken bouillon ( can be made ahead by bernardin's brand ) | 1 -2 teaspoon tabasco� brand chipeltty hot sauce ( optional ) | 1 - 1 1/4 cup light soya sauce
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f. In a mixing bowl, combine the salt and pepper by sprinkling the mustard seeds into the dry ingredients. Add in the bouillon and tobasco, mix thoroughly. Add the soya sauce and mix well. Put your hands in as a helpful hand as possible. Form the chips into a rectangle shape and place on a tray. The more and slower you work the chips, the more enhanced the flavors will be. Place in the oven and check for doneness after about 45 minutes. Be sure not to overcook, as they are done with chewy chips. I find that if i cook them too long, the chips will become tough. Do not take them out when cooked, but let them finish the cooking on the tray before removing them. After 30 minutes, transfer the chips to a dish and refrigerate until solid. Be sure to salt your hands as they will be very messy and dry. Store in a sealed container when completely cooled. This chip can also be baked in a 400°f oven, the chips should be fairly brown when done.

title: Homemade Vinegar
ingredients: 12 fresh curry leaves | 1/2 cup oil | 1/4 cup molasses | 2 tablespoons cider vinegar | 1 teaspoon dried sage leaves
instructions: In a small skillet, heat 1/2 cup oil over medium high heat. Reduce heat to low, then sprinkle in molasses and vinegar and cook, stirring, until most of the liquid has reduced. Add sage, stir, cover, and keep warm over low heat for a minute or two to let all the flavors blend.

title: Jicama and Orange Peel (Jicama Peeler.)
ingredients: 1 jicama ( about 1 pound ) | 4 1/4 teaspoons allspice ( divided ) or 4 1/4 teaspoons black pepper ( divided )
instructions: Slice jicama very thin and remove skin. Slice very thin on the diagonal with the grain. In a large bowl with a lid, put slices in, sprinkle with 1/4 teaspoon allspice or 1/4 teaspoon black pepper and half of the spice mix.

title: Basic Chinese Five-Spice Pastry Dough
ingredients: 1 tablespoon pastry flour | 1 1/3 cups chicken stock | 2 teaspoons oriental sesame oil
instructions: Add flour to the processor bowl. Add stock and sesame oil and process until well combined. Add all four ingredients and process until dough forms a ball. Turn dough out onto a floured surface and knead until ball forms. Divide the dough into balls and rest 15 minutes. Shape each ball into a thin circle. Brush pastry dough with 1/4 cup remaining pastry brush. Place on an ungreased cookie sheet. Cover with foil and let rest 10 to 15 minutes. Preheat oven to 425°f. Bake pastries about 20 minutes, until deep gold. Remove foil and bake 10 minutes more. Remove from oven and cool to warm to room temperature before wrapping in saran wrap or placing in plastic bags while still in freezer.

title: Blueberry Sausage With Peach Slices
ingredients: 12 mild italian sausages, 1 inch thick | 4 teaspoons corn oil | 1 cup sliced peaches, pitted, drained | 1 package frozen blueberries | 2 teaspoons cornflour | 3/4 cup ketchup | 1/2 - 3/4 teaspoon ground mace | 2 tablespoons ketchup | 2 tablespoons peach schnapps
instructions: Heat a non stick or cast iron skillet over medium high heat. Add the sausage and cook until well browned and crisp. Remove with a slotted spoon and set aside. Drain the fat from the pan. To the pan add the peaches and blueberries. Cook, stirring constantly, for 3 minutes or until the juice of the pan has cooked down and the blueberries are tender. Transfer to a bowl and allow to cool slightly. To make a slurry with the cornflour and ketchup, whisk together in a bowl the 2 tbsps olive oil, mace, and the 2 tbsps blueberry juice. Stir in the schnapps. Serve the sausages with the berry onion mixture and the sauted sausages.

title: Cafe Vienna Apricot French Breakfast
ingredients: 25 g apricot jam | 25 ml hot strong black coffee | 1 egg white | 500 ml vegetable stock
instructions: Place apricot cream over flameproof plate. Dip in coffee. Beat egg white in small bowl using electric mixer.

Random Ingredients: beef stock,applesauce,pink peppercorn,cider vinegar,mexican cheese,chunky peanut butter
title: Aussie Beef and Peach Cheese Soup
ingredients: 1 pint beef stock, chilled | 11 ounces chunky peanut butter | 1/2 pint applesauce | 1/2 pint cider vinegar | 1/2 pint fresh pepsi ( pepsi, nibs, or similar ) | 1 pinch pink peppercorns
instructions: Blend all ingredients thoroughly, except the peppercorns. Chill. If you have time, chill and use to thicken your soup, as this may be a bit soupy. Serve chilled.

title: Mexican Meat, Oatmeal and Chilies  Pudding
ingredients: 450 g stewing beef | 8 ounces oatmeal | 1 bunch green chilies | 300 g oats | 100 g caster sugar | 100 g bittersweet chocolate
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f/ 160°c. Chop chilies into chunks. Place grills in a roasting tin and roast over a high heat stirring continuously until it begins to char. Remove chilies from roasting tin and set aside. Place roast into the roasting tin and mix with other ingredients. Place in the oven and turn up temperature to 350°f/ 160°c. Roast for 1 hr.. Check after 30 minutes and stir. Continue cooking for 1 hour or until tender. Slice meat and serve with warmed cream and salsa or serve it with the chilies puffed up.

title: Easy Beef and Lentils (Ww 4 Points)
ingredients: 1 cup brown lentils | 1 lb ground beef
instructions: Prepare uncooked lentils the day before, and place in a casserole dish with a cover. Bake at 350°f for 1 hour and 30 minutes.

title: Cheese and Pepper Rounds
ingredients: 1/2 lb vegetable shortening | 1 3/4 cups grated cheddar cheese | 1 medium bell pepper
instructions: Cut shortening into flour and add pepper and cheddar cheese. Knead lightly for 10 mins. Roll into balls. Chill in the fridge for 1 - 2 hours. Cook in 1/2 c oiled pan with the bell pepper on all sides until golden and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: bread crumb,beer,monterey jack cheese,french bread,blackberry,pork chop
title: Pork Loaf
ingredients: 3/4 cup country style dry bread crumbs | 1/4 cup dry bread crumbs | 1/2 cup shredded monterey jack cheese | 1/4 cup chopped fresh blackberries | 2 boneless pork chops, cut 1-inch thick | 1 can beer | 18 ounces sliced french bread, divided
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients, crumbs, cheese and blackberries. Place into greased 1 1/2 to 2 quart shallow baking dish. Arrange pork chops over mixture. Pour beer over pork. Cover. Bake at 350 degrees f for 55 minutes or until meat thermometer registers 160 degrees f for medium. Remove loaf from dish and let stand 5 minutes. Cut 3 slices bread into 6 wedges. Arrange bread on a baking sheet. Bake 10 to 12 minutes or until toasted and browned. Spoon pork mixture over warm bread.

title: Summertime Hummus
ingredients: 2 tablespoons hummus | 2 1/2 cups fresh blueberries | 1 1/3 cups frozen black-eyed peas, thawed | 1 red and green cherry
instructions: Combine the hummus and remaining ingredients in a food processor and process until smooth, about 30 seconds. Serve immediately with pita chips.

title: Gingerbread Roll-Ups
ingredients: 2 ounces oat | 4 -6 tablespoons ginger ale | 1/2 cup sour mix | 1 cup guacamole | 8 slices rye bread
instructions: Mix the oat and ginger ale, sour mix and guacamole. Toast the bread.

title: Apple & Parsley Appetizer: Crisp Pita Pizzas
ingredients: 2 granny smith apples, thinly sliced | 1 large bunch italian parsley, leaves picked | pepper ( to taste ) | 2 tablespoons of fresh ground pepper, coarsely chopped in food processor
instructions: To make the pita crisp, place the parsley leaves on a chopping board and carefully separate them from each other. Trim the leaves and top the leaves with the sliced apples. Place a few spoonsful of the apple and parsley onto each pita, then add sprinkling with some ground pepper. Top each with a generous sprinkling of freshly chopped italian parsley. Cut into wedges.

title: Fifey's Beans
ingredients: 4 slices hard-boiled eggs, peeled and sliced | 1 can red kidney beans
instructions: Place egg slices into water to cover. Boil rapidly for 12 to 15 minutes or until whites are done but are not hard. Drain and cool. In a medium size mixing bowl, blend together hard boiled eggs, kidney beans and hot red kidney beans.

Random Ingredients: cinnamon sugar mixture,rice wine vinegar,chickpea,dark sesame oil,jicama
title: Sweet and Savory Jicama Salad
ingredients: 1 large jicama, peeled and grated ( about 4 cups ) | 1 can chickpeas, drained ( about 1 cup ) | 1/4 cup rice wine vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon dark sesame oil | cinnamon-sugar mixture
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add the jicama, chickpeas, and rice vinegar and simmer until tender, 3 to 5 minutes. Drain. Stir the sesame oil and cinnamon sugar mixture into the hot jicama. Serve warm.

title: Tunisian Catfish, Apricot and Cabbage Sandwich
ingredients: 2 catfish fillets | 1 cup dried apricot jam | 1 large head cabbage, cored and sliced
instructions: Arrange catfish fillets in the center of each slice of cabbage. Place 3 pieces of apricots in the center of the fish. Spoon jam and 1/2 cup water onto top.

title: Tostones
ingredients: 400 g eggplants | 350 g sirloin steaks | 150 g filet of beef | 100 g gluten-free breadcrumbs | 1 orange | 1 small cucumber
instructions: Halve the eggplants lengthways and finely chop them. Slice the sirloin steak roughly into thin strips lengthways and then slice into 2 cm lengths and thread onto soaked soaked wooden skewers alternating with 2 - 3 pieces each. Place on a plate. Place in a single layer on a hot barbecue griddle and cook for 4 - 5 minutes each side or until well browned and cooked to your liking. Remove from the barbecue using a slotted spoon. Make sure to remove all but a couple of slices of the orange flesh if using and set aside. Using the same barbecue, cook the eggplant in a large pan for about 8 - 10 minutes until they start developing a soft and tasty texture. Stir, scraping all the little browned bits from the bottom of the pan, until all the vegetables have softened and turned a bit over in the pan. Cut the beef up into strips, then place on the grilling surface and cook with the orange flesh, sliced sirloin, stringy cucumber, sunflower oil and some salt until the beef is cooked and browned all over. Take all the ingredients off the stove and add with a grinding of black pepper to taste the breadcrumbs. Roll each eggplant in the breadcrumb mixture and then cut them into 1 2cm lengths and then twist them into sticks. Serve them straight away.

title: Beets With Sauce
ingredients: 3 large beets, scrubbed, peeled | 2 tablespoons hot sauce
instructions: Heat broiler. If they are too large, place beets on a baking sheet. Place under broiler for 3 to 5 minutes, or until tender. Watch for steam, and do not burn. Transfer to a bowl and rub with hot sauce. Serve at once.

title: Guisados De Monterrey (Chile Cheese Beer Dip)
ingredients: 1/2 lb chile, red ( about 1/2 cup ) | 1 - 1 1/2 lb sour cream or 1 -1 1/2 lb light cream cheese | 2 -3 tablespoons minced chile, from a jar | 2 tablespoons minced ginger | 2 -3 ounces cooked chicken or 2 -3 ounces turkey, cooked and finely chopped ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon beer, such as stout | 8 ounces chinese fried rice sticks ( such as guisin shoga )
instructions: In a saucepan, combine the chiles, sour cream or light cream cheese, chile and ginger. Bring to a simmer and cook over moderate heat until the liquid has reduced slightly, stirring gently. Remove from the heat and stir in the beer or stout. Serve warm with grilled, slicked meats, or just with guisin shoga. Chill for several hours or overnight. Serve with hot chinese fried rice sticks.

title: Auberge Veal
ingredients: 1 lb ground veal | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil
instructions: Mix together. Cook over medium heat about 15 minutes. You might have to cover the pan with foil so it doesn't burn. Turn heat to low. When it turns brown on the other side, remove the pan from heat. Let meat cool, then remove fat from the meat. Mix in the oil. Roll into meatballs that can be cooked on both sides.

Random Ingredients: risotto rice,raisin,vanilla extract,cider vinegar,cornflour,chipotle chile,poppy seed,peach
title: Pear and Poppy Seed Risotto
ingredients: 100 g rice | 2 quarts of rapidly boiling vinegar | 2 large ripe peaches, peeled and sliced | 1/2 teaspoon pure vanilla extract | 500 g raisins | 1/2 teaspoon poppy seed | 3 chipotle chiles, seeded and chopped to desired size ( or more, to taste ) | 3 teaspoons cornflour
instructions: Cook the rice using the boiling vinegar/water combination, using 100 to 120°c more water if necessary. When almost cooked through, drain and leave to one side until later on in the cooking process. Add the peeled and sliced peach to the cooked rice and mix through the rice. The rice may also be cooked a couple of hours this way, or it can be kept overnight. Meanwhile, put the poppy seed in a bowl and pour just enough boiling water over the seeds to form a stiff dough. Drain the rice and spread out on a paper towel on a flat surface. Leave to stand a few minutes to cool. Dip a spoonful of the mixture in the poppy seeds and roll into a ball. Repeat until the filling is used up. Place on a plate and spread with the remaining poppy seed mixture. Top with chipotle chile flakes, if using. Serve immediately while hot.

title: Gramma's Baked Eggplant
ingredients: 1 eggplant, peel and cut into 1/2 inch slices | 1 jar olives, sliced | 2 slices italian sausage, cooked and chopped ( optional ) | 4 slices thick french bread, halved | 4 slices cabbage, shredded | 1 package corn tortillas, cut into halves
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Spray the inside of a 9x13 inch baking dish with cooking spray. Place eggplant slices in a large pot of water, and bring to a boil. Boil for 5 minutes, and drain. Meanwhile, heat 1/2 cup olive oil in a skillet over medium heat, and cook the sliced sausage until crisp. Remove from heat, and mix with the chopped, drained eggplant.

Random Ingredients: asparagus spear,black eyed pea,tahini,pie shell,grain rice,creole seasoning,bay leaf
title: Black-Eyed Pea and Rice Quiche
ingredients: 1 pie shell | 1 can black-eyed peas, drained | 1/3 cup chopped asparagus spears ( optional ) | 3 tablespoons tahini | 2 bay leaves | 2 1/2 cups cooked long-grain rice | 1/2 teaspoon creole seasoning
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Remove pie shell from pouch and sprinkle with 1/2 the rice and 1/2 the black eyed pea, if using. Combine remaining ingredients and pour into pie shell. Bake for 45 minutes, then remove and cool for 5 minutes.

title: Orzo-Vegetables
ingredients: 1/2 1/2 cup orzo or 1/2 cup couscous | 3 cups vegetable broth or 3 cups beef broth | 2 tablespoons cornmeal ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons chopped green chili ( optional ) | 1/2 - 3/4 teaspoon chopped jalapenos or 1/2-3/4 teaspoon hot green chili ( optional )
instructions: Heat orzo in broth until just tender. Stir in corn meal. Sprinkle with green chiles and jalapenos.

title: Crock Pot Carnitas
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs cubed pork shoulder | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 2 tablespoons salt | 2 1/2 cups beef stock
instructions: Preheat crock pot, put meat in crock pot and season with salt. Pour beef stock over meat. Turn crock pot on low and cook for at least 12 hours or on high until falling apart. Using two forks, pull meat apart into shreds. Serve with tortillas or with mexican rice.

title: Creamy Salmon Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 packet of noodles | 2 1/2 teaspoons salt ( or to your liking ) | 1/2 teaspoon red chili pepper flakes | 1/4 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Cook the noodles according to the package. While the noodles are cooking, dice up the salmon and mix with the noodles. Add the rest of the ingredients and mix well. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: raspberry,celery rib,sharp cheddar cheese,italian breadcrumb,romano cheese
title: St. Patrick's Day Raspberries
ingredients: 750 g fresh raspberries ( not frozen ) or 1 1/2 lbs frozen raspberries | 1/3 cup shredded sharp cheddar cheese | 1/3 cup shredded romano cheese | 4 tablespoons italian style breadcrumbs | 1 medium celery rib, diced
instructions: Rinse raspberries with a slotted spoon and set aside. Place all but the breadcrumbs, celery, shredded cheese and raspberries in large saucepan. Add enough water to cover rinds and gently cook over high heat just to boiling.

title: Rosemary and Kaffir Lime Butter
ingredients: 6 tablespoons rosemary | 6 tablespoons cardamom seeds, crushed | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom
instructions: Mix together. Store in an airtight container.

title: Veal Bolognese
ingredients: 2 ounces ground veal | 1 ounce raspberries and glace jam | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1 1/2 ounces finely chopped golden raisins ( optional ) | 1 lb rigatoni pasta
instructions: Brown the ground veal in a frying pan with the raspberries. Remove from heat and stir the raspberries and jam. Drain the pasta, and mix with the meat mixture. Serve with parmesan cheese.

Random Ingredients: cilantro,tomato paste,wax bean,tabasco sauce,mayonnaise,tea,yeast machine,chili sauce
title: Bean & Chutney Rolls
ingredients: 8 ounces frozen wax beans | 2 tablespoons teapsoon hot chili sauce | 1 tablespoon tomato paste | 1 1/2 teaspoons instant yeast | 1/2 teaspoon tabasco sauce or 1/2 teaspoon other hot pepper sauce | 1 tablespoon mayonnaise | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh cilantro | 2 pieces smoked toast ( thick slices )
instructions: Defrost and remove beans. Place the chutney in a microwave safe dish. Microwave on high for 2 minutes, or until heated through. Stir in chili sauce and tomato paste. Combine yeast, tabasco or hot pepper sauce, mayonnaise and cilantro in a small bowl. Stir to blend. Place about 1 teaspoon of the bean mixture into each toast slice. Roll up and secure with a tooth pick. Place seam side down in a lightly greased baking dish. Cover with plastic wrap and a damp cloth towel and let rise in a warm place until doubled in size. Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Bake rolls about 20 minutes or until the tops are browned. Cut each roll into 20 slices. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: jalapeno pepper,glace cherry,potato starch,dill weed,tomato puree,maraschino cherry
title: Nana's Cherry Potato Balls
ingredients: 8 cups mashed sweet potatoes ( or 2 2/3 cups leftover sweet potatoes ) | 1 jar cherry tomatoes | 3 tablespoons dried maraschino cherries | 3 tablespoons dried dill weed | 1 chopped jalapeno pepper | 1 package unflavored gelatin | 1 1/2 cups tomato puree ( or pure 1 1/2 cups canned tomatoes ), or as desired
instructions: Place potatoes and cherry tomatoes in a large pot. Pour enough water in the pot so that a 2 to 3 inch drop just covers the bottom. Bring to boil, and boil slowly, skimming when darkened. Ladle into small bowls to keep hot. Dissolve gelatin in 1 tablespoon water, let cool, stirring constantly. Stir cherry tomato puree into jalapeno pepper until dissolved. Drain potatoes, reserving liquid in pot, and cool slightly. Remove 1/4 cup of hot potato water, and mash with 2 tablespoons cherries, dill weed, and jalapeno. Cover potato/cherry mixture and set aside in refrigerator until serving time. Make tomato sauce and serve warm with gelatin mixture. Refrigerate leftover potato water, and serve cold.

Random Ingredients: ginger paste,broccoli floret,curry paste,white button mushroom,plain flour,soymilk,wheat spaghetti
title: Curry Spaghetti
ingredients: 5/8 cup plain flour | 1/2 cup low-fat soymilk | 1 tablespoon ginger paste | 1 teaspoon curry paste | 400 g broccoli florets, drained | 1 tablespoon low-fat soymilk | 100 -150 white button mushrooms, sliced | 200 g broccoli florets, drained | 450 g whole wheat spaghetti
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 degrees celcius. Combine flour, soy milk, ginger, curry paste and vegetable juice in a large bowl add all the vegetables and tofu and coat well. Heat the oven for approximately 10 minutes and bake spaghetti for a further 10 minutes remove from oven and add to sauce. Mix well and pour onto a platter. Serve with bread.

title: Easy T- Bone
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs lean lamb, cut into pieces 1 1/2 inches long | 1 1/2 tablespoons vanilla, divided ( or more to taste )
instructions: Pat the lamb dry with paper towels. Combine 3/4 tspn of vanilla.

title: Tahini Sauce for Roasted Veggies for Roasted Chips
ingredients: 1/2 cup tahini | 1/4 cup tamari or 1/4 cup soy sauce | 1 tablespoon mustard powder | 2 teaspoons water
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and set aside. If you have used salted oil, make sure it is completely covered with this. It will be very oily. If you use fresh ground chicken, use less salt and/or oil. You are probably left with olive oil because that is a salted oil. You can always add more olive oil and a little tamari to get that flavor. I have never been a big fan of tamari, so just adjust your taste.

title: Vegetarian Triangles
ingredients: 0.5 package frozen phyllo pastry ( i used 2 packs of frozen phyllo pastry, thawed and cut up. ) | 8 ounces frozen sauerkraut | 1 jar sliced straw mushrooms, drained | 1/4 cup light crunchy peanut butter ( not creamy ) | 1/3 cup ground coriander | 1 tablespoon almond extract | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh coriander, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375f degrees. Place thawed phyllo pastry sheets in two rows of four 3 x 1/4 x 1/2 sheets. Cover phyllo sheets with a damp clean cloth or a damp paper towel. Bake phyllo sheets in preheated oven until golden brown, about 10 minutes. Take phyllo sheets from oven and allow them to cool for five minutes. Open one wrapper at a time, and carefully place it in the center of a sheet of phyllo. Top with half of the sauerkraut, half of the mushrooms, half of the peanut butter, half of the ground coriander and half of the almond extract. Arrange the two sheets together on a parchment lined baking sheet. Sprinkle generously with more finely chopped coriander, if desired. Bake in preheated oven until golden brown, about 20 minutes.

title: Spiced Lettuce
ingredients: 2 cups fresh lettuce leaves ( washed & dried ) | 1/2 cup cornflour, mixed with | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric
instructions: Add the cornflour to a frying pan / kadai / pan and stir frequently for 10 - 15 seconds, then remove from heat & set aside. To this dry mixture add the turmeric & mix lightly, till well coated in flour & turn upside down to cool. This will take approx 20 minutes/180 degrees. Now make your lettuce leaves from the remaining ingredients and using a teaspoon or a flexible pastry bag, roll the leaf pieces into round circular shapes, pressing firmly at the edges. You need to have the leaves round & flat to the shape. Arrange the wraps either on a serving dish or on a tray, making sure they aren't touching, and refrigerate till ready to serve, but no longer than 2 hours. To serve, allow the wraps to completely cool before unwrapping & serving.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon cube,tuna,golden raisin,wheat lasagna noodle,red bell pepper,camembert cheese
title: Tuna and Roasted Pepper Lasagna
ingredients: 2 packages whole wheat lasagna noodles, cooked al dente | 1 can drained tuna, drained, 2 flake cans | 1 red bell pepper, roasted, peeled, sliced | 8 ounces camembert cheese, crumbled | 1/2 cup golden raisin | 2 -3 chicken bouillon cubes
instructions: Drain tuna in a colander. Mix with remaining ingredients except cheese slices. Grease a 1 quart casserole with cooking spray and layer ingredients in this order, lasagna, cheese mix, tuna, red bell pepper, and raisins. If you don't have a saucepan it can substitute a 9x13 baking dish with a regular or low sodium tomato sauce, use olive oil and garlic if you like. Bake at 400 degrees for 30 minutes or until heated through and cheese is melted.

Random Ingredients: basmati rice,chinese chili sauce,american cheese,tamari,tabasco sauce,beef stock
title: Cheese Rice
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups basmati rice, rinsed | 1 liter beef stock | 1 teaspoon chinese chili sauce | 1/2 teaspoon tamari | 4 slices american cheese or 4 slices mild swiss cheese | 1 teaspoon tabasco sauce
instructions: Place rice, stock, chili sauce, tobasco and tamari in saucepan and bring to boil. Remove from heat.

Random Ingredients: taco seasoning,red pepper sauce,cherry,rye bread,dark soy sauce,mozzarella ball,american cheese
title: Yummy BBQ Beef Pitas
ingredients: 1 lb lean boneless round steak, cut into thin slices | 1/4 cup dark soy sauce | 1 teaspoon taco seasoning | 1/4 cup taco bell taco seasoning | 1/2 cup sweet red peppers or 1/2 cup hot sauce | 1 pint cherry tomatoes or 1 pint grape tomatoes ( halved ) | 1 lb american cheese, thick slices | 1 package miniature cherry rolls
instructions: Combine the meat with soy sauce, taco seasoning, and taco bell seasoning. Place in a large nonstick skillet and brown on all sides. Meanwhile, heat the tomato, cheese, pepper halves with 1/2 cup water and cherry tomatoes to a boil, 3 - 5 minutes or until cheese is melted and warm. Split the pitas and remove centers. Fill each with 1/6 of the meat mixture, top with a little cheese and a cherry roll. Serve immediately.

title: Stolen Eggs
ingredients: 6 sunflower seeds | 3 tablespoons dry sherry
instructions: Rinse the seeds from the sunflower seeds, put in a colander, and drain for 20 mins or so. Put the sherry in a frying pan with just a dash of olive oil. Stir continuously until the sherry has mostly evaporated. Put the seeds in a sieve over a bowl, and pour in the sherry. Scatter over plenty of freshly grated black breadcrumbs if preferred.

title: Gnocchi With Crisp Apple Nuts
ingredients: 12 ounces shredded suet or 12 ounces vegetable oil | 1/2 lb suet ( ground fine ) | 1 lb jicama ( peeled and diced ) | 1 large apple cider vinegar | 2 tablespoons italian spices | 3 ounces vegetable oil | 8 ounces gnocchi
instructions: Heat 3 quarts of water to boiling and add suet, jicama, vinegar, and spices. Cook until meat has a nice firm texture, and noodles have popped off. Add gnocchi. Cook until al dente.

Random Ingredients: cannellini bean,chicken stock vegetable,savoy cabbage,tortilla,channa dal,mexican cheese
title: Garth's Chop'n' Bean Burritos
ingredients: 1 can cannellini beans | 1/2 cup channa dal ( small dice ) | 1/2 cup savoy cabbage, shredded | 1 cup chicken stock or 1 cup vegetable stock, mixed | 3 burritos | 1/4 cup mexican blend cheese, shredded
instructions: Mix everything together in an oven proof bowl. Place mixture in the microwave oven, cook for 40 seconds, remove and top with cheese.

title: Simple Baked Cabbage and Cheese Sandwich
ingredients: 1 head of cabbage | 8 ounces velveeta cheese
instructions: Core and slice the cabbage into 1/4 inch slices. Spray a 9x13 pan with pam or a nonstick or nonstick cooking spray. Layer in the following order, cheese and cabbage. Microwave on high until cheese is melted, about 7 to 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: pork shoulder,large shrimp,beef stew meat,carrot,mexican cheese
title: Crock Pot Shrimp and Shrimp
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless pork shoulder, cut into 1 1/2 inch cubes | 1 1/2 lbs medium shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1 1/2 lbs large shrimp, peeled, deveined and deveined | 1 1/2 cups shredded mexican blend cheese | 2 medium carrots, peeled and cut into 1 1/2 inch dice
instructions: Place all ingredients into crock pot. Cook on high 7 or 8 hours. Shred beef with two forks if using a potjie shredder shred it into shreds, or cut the shrimp into chunks and eat. This also makes wonderful taco fixings that can be used instead of store bought taco fixins.

title: Spiced Rice and Barbecue Sauce for Chicken With Shrimp
ingredients: 2 tablespoons barbecue sauce | 1 1/2 cups uncooked long grain rice ( uncle bill's or brown rice ) | 1/2 cup orange juice
instructions: Stir together barbecue sauce and rice, then pour over rice and marinate in the refrigerator for at least 3 hours. Drain rice and stir to distribute rice evenly. While rice is soaking, place about an inch of water in a medium saucepan and add barbecue sauce mixture. Place over medium heat, cover and simmer gently for about 20 minutes or until rice is cooked, stirring and occasionally. Keep covered occasionally during cooking. When rice is almost fully cooked, add remaining ingredients. Serve alongside chicken or shrimp in a small bowl.

Random Ingredients: garbanzo bean,green cabbage,anise seed,pita pocket bread,iceberg lettuce,lemon juice,wheat bread
title: Moroccan Pita Sandwich with Chickpeas
ingredients: 2 bags fresh green cabbage | 1 cup dried garbanzo beans, soaked overnight or can garbanzo beans, drained and rinsed | 1 teaspoon anise seed | 1/3 cup fresh lemon juice | 8 slices whole wheat bread | iceberg lettuce | pita pockets or pita chips
instructions: Core the cabbage and cut in four even pieces. Place half of the cabbage into large bowl & pour enough cold water over it to cover. Cover, and place in the refrigerator, about 1 hour. Drain & rinse the chickpeas, then rinse briefly, drain & set aside. Place the remaining cabbage in a large bowl & add the soaking liquid. Using your hands, mix the cabbage into the liquid. Add the aniseed seeds & lemon juice. Let sit for about 20 minutes, then drain & reserve liquid. Cut the remaining cabbage into bite size pieces. Place them in a deep skillet, and sprinkle with salt as desired. Drain the cabbage, discarding the liquid, & place in a salad bowl. Top with the chickpeas, lettuce & a drizzle of the additional lemon juice. Mix well, so that everything is nicely coated with the oil. Serve with pita or pita chips or pita chips.

title: Beef Stew Made Easy
ingredients: 1 lb beef stew meat, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 lb small curd cottage cheese
instructions: Place beef in a large frying pan and cover with water. Cover and cook over low heat 3 hours or until beef is tender. Drain beef and return it to pan. Add cottage cheese and a little water if needed. Cover and simmer 15 minutes or until cheese is creamy.

Random Ingredients: salad oil,yellow onion,dark red kidney bean,tamari,cauliflower,rice wine,boston lettuce
title: Asian Burrito
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower | 1 large yellow onion ( small ) | tamari, to taste ( optional ) | 1/4 cup rice wine | 12 ounces dark red kidney beans ( drained ) | 1 head iceberg lettuce | 3 1/2 cups salad oil
instructions: Clean the outer leaves of the cauliflower and remove their heads. In a food processor process cauliflower, onion to about the size of jalapenos. Pulse about 5 times. In a large saucepan add the vinegar and tamari and cook for 3 - 5 minutes or until it become translucent. Add the drained kidney beans and stir fry gently to mix. Wash the lettuce and cut off any tough leaves of your lettuce. Fill a large bowl with oil. Add the greens to the bowl and mix thoroughly. The mixture will be slightly wilted like a salad. If any sections of the lettuce are too large add a little water they will release some juice. Place the mixture on wooden skewers and roll them on the wooden skewers so they are secure. Skewer the burritos and serve immediately, or keep warm in a 350 degree oven on the grill.

title: Taco Salad Dressing 2007
ingredients: 2 ounces taco seasoning mix | 1 ounce cider vinegar
instructions: Combine all ingredients together, and shake.

title: Ziti With Sauce and Noodles (Rachael Ray)
ingredients: 1 lb ziti pasta or 1 lb rotini pasta, uncooked | 3 tablespoons prepared mustard powder | 1 jar bottled chili sauce | 1 cup prepared mustard powder | 1 cup prepared mustard powder ( not regular mustard )
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions.

title: Roasted Red Potatoes
ingredients: 3 lbs red potatoes | 2 tablespoons dried red pepper flakes | 1/4 cup dried basil
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Cut a circle in the center of each potato. Place the potatoes in a baking dish, and stud on all sides with the dried pepper flakes. Roast for 15 minutes, then turn the potatoes, drizzle with a little more oil, and roast until the potatoes are tender and the juices run clear, about 1 hour and 15 minutes more.

title: Pimm's Prunes
ingredients: 3 lbs prunes, with skins on | salt and pepper
instructions: Peel and rinse prunes. Cut in half and remove pits. Place prunes in a bowl and sprinkle generously with salt and pepper. Cover with dry cloth and let sit overnight in a cool place.

title: Grilled Fish Tacos With Creamy Apple Sauce
ingredients: 2 medium tilapia fillets, fresh | 1/4 teaspoon cumin seed, crushed | 12 ounces condensed cream of mushroom soup, undiluted | 1/4 cup applesauce | 1/4 teaspoon fennel, ground | 1/4 cup lightly packed fresh fennel, for garnish | 4 ladyfingers
instructions: Sprinkle the tilapia fillets with the cuminseed.

Random Ingredients: triple sec,ham,pasta,plain flour,vanilla bean,red onion,mint leaf
title: Pasta With Ham, Vanilla and Mint
ingredients: 600 g pasta ( i use wholemeal ) | 400 g diced ham ( i use lean ) | 1 red onion, finely chopped | 150 g triple sec | 1 vanilla bean, seeds scraped | 1 cup fresh mint leaves, coarsely chopped | 1/4 cup plain flour ( for dusting )
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200°c. Put the pasta, ham, onion, triple sec and vanilla bean seeds into a large roasting tin. Add a bit more olive or butter if needed to coat the pasta. Sprinkle the flour over everything and toss to coat everything. Season with salt and pepper and bake for 45 - 60 minutes until the ham is nicely browned on top and the pasta and the sauce is sticky and creamy.

title: Artichoke and Raisin Dip
ingredients: 1/2 cup sour cream | 1/4 cup chopped fresh parsley leaves | 1/4 cup feta, crumbled | 1 can artichoke hearts, drained and quartered | 1/2 cup ricotta cheese
instructions: Mix sour cream, parsley, and feta together. Add artichokes and ricotta cheese. Stir to blend. Serve warm or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: grape,garlic salt,red chili sauce,button mushroom,ginger garlic paste,onion juice,chinese five spice powder,egg yolk
title: Mushrooms With Chinese Five-Spice
ingredients: 2 teaspoons red chili sauce | 1 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 1 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste | 1/2 teaspoon onion juice | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt | 1 lb button mushroom | 1 egg yolk | 1 tablespoon grape
instructions: First, make the garlic paste. In a small bowl, mix the egg yolk and grape together. Stir the egg yolk into the sauce. Slice the mushrooms into 1/2 inch pieces and fry them in a small amount oil or butter.. Drain on paper towels. Add the garlic paste and onion juice to the hot mushrooms and mushrooms and stir. Turn off the heat and pour the garlic sauce over the mushrooms. Serve hot or cold.

Random Ingredients: queso fresco,cauliflower,mung bean sprout,dijon mustard,bell pepper
title: Noodles Mexicano
ingredients: 1 lb large mung bean sprouts, cleaned | 12 ounces queso fresco, crumbled | 1 small bell pepper, thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons dijon mustard | 3/4 lb cauliflower, cooked
instructions: Fill a large bowl with water. Drop in the mung bean sprouts and cook until tender but not mushy. Drain well. Transfer to a mixing bowl and toss with the queso fresco, sliced pepper, and dijon mustard. Toss well to combine. Spoon into serving bowls and refrigerate until firm, about 10 minutes.

title: Smoked Trout and Brown Rice  Pilaf
ingredients: 1 lb smoked trout, skinned and deboned, cut into chunks | 1 1/2 cups chicken stock | 1 cup brown rice or 1 cup white onion, washed, peeled and coarsely chopped into 1-inch pieces
instructions: Place trout pieces in a heavy skillet. Pour enough chicken broth over them to just cover them.

title: Blueberry Beef Wrapped Mushrooms
ingredients: 1/2 lb bacon, diced | 1/2 lb liver, sliced thinly | 8 ounces portabella mushrooms | 2 tablespoons chunky salsa | 2 tablespoons rice noodles, cooked | 3 tablespoons vegetable broth | 1 -2 tablespoon grenadine | 1 package frozen blueberries
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. In skillet over medium heat, cook bacon until crisp. Drain on paper towel and drain. Drain liquid from skillet, leaving 3/4 cup bacon drippings in the skillet. Add mushrooms and cook, stirring occasionally, until tender. Add salsa, and mix. Add rice noodles and stir until coated and heated through. Add broth and grenadine into skillet. Stuff mushrooms with the cooked egg noodles. Place mushrooms on a platter and garnish with fresh blueberries. Serve with mango dipping sauce for dipping.

Random Ingredients: radish,chinese five spice powder,grain white rice
title: Rice With Radishes & Five-Spice Powder
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups long-grain white rice ( or jasmine rice ) | 1 -3 teaspoon chinese five spice powder or 1 -3 teaspoon kosher salt ( to taste ) | 3/4 - 1 cup whole radish, with peel
instructions: Rinse rice thoroughly in lukewarm water. Drain and set aside a few radishes, cut the rest in half. Place the washed rice in a sieve and rinse under cold water until water runs clear. Repeat until all water is used. After draining thoroughly, pat the rice dry with paper towels. Pour the rice into a large shallow dish or platter. Sprinkle salt and five spice over the rice. Add the radish halves and radishes. Dot the top of the rice with any leftover radish halves. Dribble remaining radish tops over top. Cover and chill for at least 6 hours, and preferably overnight. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: tomato juice,green capsicum,sherry wine vinegar,cooking sherry,escarole,topping,cottage cheese
title: Cottage Cheese, Green Capsicum Salad
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups low fat cottage cheese, fat free | 4 tablespoons cooking sherry wine vinegar | 4 tablespoons tomato juice | 10 g green capsicums, chopped | 1 cup chopped green cabbage | 8 cups frozen topping, thawed | 1 tablespoon sherry wine vinegar
instructions: Mix together all the ingredients until well combined. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour. Serve drizzled onto salad bowls or lettuce leaves.

Random Ingredients: artichoke heart,snow pea,chipotle pepper,caramel topping,dark brown sugar
title: Snow Pea Puree with Artichokes
ingredients: 1 cup fresh snow pea | 1/2 cup packed dark brown sugar ( such as piloncillo ) | 3 tablespoons chipotle pepper | 1 can artichoke hearts, drained and sliced | 1 tablespoon caramel topping
instructions: Place snow peas in a pot, and cover with water. Bring to a boil, reduce heat to medium low, and simmer until tender, about 3 minutes. Drain, and set aside. Melt brown sugar in a skillet over medium heat, and cook until the brown sugar is slightly browned, about 1 minute. Stir the chipotle pepper into the brown sugar, and cook 1 minute. Stir the artichoke hearts into the brown sugar, and cook just until warmed through, about 1 minute.

title: Red Bell Peppers in Tomato Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb fresh snow pea, trimmed | 1 medium red bell pepper, seeded and sliced | 1 can tomato sauce | 1 dash cayenne ( optional )
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a medium nonstick skillet. Add cayenne if desired. Add snow peas with stems, and cook about 2 minutes. Add remaining ingredients to skillet.

Random Ingredients: plum tomato,broth,veal stock,filling,pesto sauce,hamburger meat,canola oil
title: Sausage Rolls With Pesto, Plum Tomatoes and Swiss Steak
ingredients: filling | 2 plum tomatoes, thinly sliced, each cut into 8 wedges | 1 lb hamburger meat, such as new york strip steaks | 1 tablespoon canola oil | 1 1/2 cups veal stock | 1 cup chicken stock | 1/4 cup purchased pesto sauce, drained bottled ( homemade pesto can be purchased at specialty food stores ) | 3 tablespoons canola oil | 4 -6 toothpicks or 4 -6 other round sausages, split lengthwise ( see below )
instructions: Pesto sauce, in a small bowl, combine pesto with oil. Sprinkle each slice of sausage with 1 teaspoon of pesto mixture. Set aside. In a large, deep skillet, cook sausage until cooked through, about 7 to 9 minutes. Drain. Sauce can be made 6 hours in advance and refrigerated until ready to use. Roll sausages, on a well floured board roll each piece of sausage into a flattened oval about 8 inches wide. Place one sausage on one end of each sausage.

title: Baked Ricotta
ingredients: 1 cup fresh ricotta cheese | 4 cups crushed ice
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. In a medium size bowl, mix ricotta cheese and 3 cups of crushed ice. Spread into 2 to 3 quart baking dish. Bake at 300 degrees f for 2 to 3 hours.

title: Chocolate Pretzels
ingredients: 1 cup confectioners'sugar | 1 square unsweetened chocolate
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Lightly dust a baking sheet with flour, and line it with parchment paper. Stir confectioners' sugar, chocolate, and flour together in a square of chocolate sprinkles over the top. Roll jelly roll style into balls, roll the balls in the sprinkles, and place the balls on the prepared baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until the tops are dry, but not brown, about 20 minutes. Run a knife or toothpick through the pretzels before removing from the baking sheet. Cool pretzels on the prepared baking sheet until hardened and sticky, about 5 minutes.

title: Mock Beef Barley Lettuce Cups
ingredients: 200 g pearl barley | 150 g desiccated coconut | 400 g low-fat plain yogurt | 1 teaspoon black peppercorns | 20 large lettuce leaves
instructions: Combine barley and 3/4 cup of water and bring to the boil. Cover and reduce heat and simmer for 30 minutes until tender and creamy. Drain. Place coconut, yoghurt, black peppercorns and 1 cup of the barley in a food processor or blender and process into a smooth paste. Transfer to a large bowl. Add remaining barley to bowl and season if desired. Place lettuce leaves on each lettuce leaf and spoon in the sauce.

Random Ingredients: potato,cheese,coffee liqueur,heavy whipping cream,hungry jack potato flake,onion soup mix,gelatin,thai chile
title: Cafe Vienna
ingredients: 1 envelope unflavored gelatin, dissolved in | 3/4 cup hot coffee liqueur | 1 package potato cakes or ( 18 1/2 ounce ) package potato pancakes, cut into 1/2-inch squares | 2 cups shredded cheese, divided | 4 ounces fresh sweet potato, cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh thai chiles | 1 cup heavy whipping cream, whipped | hot mashed sweet potato flakes, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Combine gelatin and hot coffee liqueur in a bowl, stirring, until the gelatin is completely melted. Set aside. Beat potato cake or pancake squares in a lightly greased 9 x13 baking dish with an electric mixer on medium speed for 4 to 5 minutes, or until the sides are a brown color. Add potato pieces and 2 tablespoons cheddar cheese.

title: Sauteed Green Onions
ingredients: 8 -10 medium size green onions | 1 -2 teaspoon sage leaves
instructions: Finely slice or chop onion. Saute in a small amount of butter until soft brown. Transfer to a bowl and sprinkle with sage leaves. Serve with fries and green beans.

Random Ingredients: green food coloring,oatmeal,celery root,baking soda,peach schnapps,peanut butter,lemon zest,feta cheese
title: Peachy Treat
ingredients: 2 ounces neufchatel cheese or 2 ounces cream cheese | 1 -2 tablespoon peanut butter | 1 teaspoon lemon zest, grated ( or 1/2 t. dried lemon if you don't have that ) | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 1 green food coloring | 2 ounces feta cheese | 1 cup quick oatmeal ( not quick cooking ) | 1/2 teaspoon celery root, diced finely
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f butter two 8 inch round cake bowls or one large one or two smaller one. In a bowl, combine the cheeses, zest, baking soda till nice and creamy. Add the softened cheese in small chunks till nice and creamy. Make sure to mix the cheeses well. Add in the food coloring till it forms a pale/whisten yellow or a little darker on the pinkish color but not too dark. Add in the peaches and celery and mix well. Fill the two prepared cake pans with the peachy mixture. Spread evenly. Bake at 350f until puffed and lightly browned. Remove from oven and cool on wire racks. Enjoy with a glass of chilled black tea, lots of napkins and a crisp apple or two.

Random Ingredients: grain rice,allspice berry,wheat bread,broccoli floret,rice flour,sun tomato oil
title: Rice Pilaf With Broccoli
ingredients: 3 cups broccoli florets | 1 cup long-grain rice ( basmati ) | 3 cups long grain rice | 2 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil | 1 cup rice flour | 1/8 teaspoon allspice berries, for taste
instructions: Heat oven to 350°f. Rinse and drain rice. In a medium bowl, mix the sun dried tomatoes and rice flour. Cut the broccoli into small florets and add to the rice mixture. Mix well and toss. Pour into a buttered 8 inch square casserole. Combine allspice berries with the 1/3 cup water and sprinkle over the rice mixture. Cover and bake for about 50 minutes, or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: creme de menthe,candy sprinkle,pearl barley,salmon fillet,phyllo dough,fruit,corn oil
title: Irish Whiskey Salmon Parcels with Nuts
ingredients: 5 salmon fillets | 5 sheets frozen phyllo dough, thawed if frozen | 1 can whole mixed nuts, including peels | 1 tablespoon corn oil | 1 tablespoon commercial creme de menthe | 2 tablespoons candy sprinkles | 1/4 cup coarsely chopped dried mixed fruit
instructions: Lightly coat a baking sheet with nonstick cooking spray. Place frozen phyllo dough onto a cutting board. Place 1 fillet on top of each phyllo sheet. Fold fillet in half lengthwise and then cross wise to form a half moon. Repeat with remaining fillets and phyllo sheets. Place 2 sheets fillets onto baking sheet. Coat each with cooking spray. Place a nut onto each fillet. Drizzle each with a little corn oil. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 1 hour. Preheat broiler. Place fish fillet on each phyllo sheet. Sprinkle nuts around fillets. Lightly brush tops of fillets with creme de menthe. Broil in oven for 8 to 10 minutes or until fish flakes easily with a fork.

title: Grilled Cremini Mushrooms II
ingredients: 1 pound fresh cremini mushrooms, stems and gills removed | 1/4 cup pine nuts
instructions: Preheat an outdoor grill for about 520 degrees f. Lightly oil the grate. Wrap a cheesecloth large towel around the inside of the mushrooms, and place it under the grill. Cook 1 to 2 minutes per side, until very dry and darkly browned. Spread mushrooms on a plate with a paper towel, and let cool. Place the mushrooms onto a grill. Cook mushrooms over the hottest possible heat for about 5 minutes on each side. Remove mushrooms from the grill, and place on wax paper, or plastic wrap to cool. Cut the mushrooms with a serrated knife into 1/4 inch thick slices, and arrange around the mushrooms. Serve in shallow bowls. Cooks' note, grill time is about 5 minutes per side in an iron skillet, or as needed.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil peanut,chili sauce,beef tenderloin,cashew,leek,tomato green chilies,salt
title: Vietnamese Beef Sticks
ingredients: 2 teaspoons vegetable oil or 2 teaspoons peanut oil | 2 teaspoons chili sauce | 2 teaspoons leeks, minced ( white part only ) | 2 teaspoons cashews, roasted lightly chopped | 1/4 teaspoon salt | 1 1/4 lbs beef tenderloin, trimmed of excess fat and thinly sliced crosswise into 1/4-inch strips | 1 can diced tomatoes and green chilies, undrained
instructions: Using 2 teaspoons of oil or peanut oil, coat a 9x15 inch baking dish. In a small bowl, combine the chili sauce, leeks, cashews and salt and set aside. Heat remaining 1 teaspoon oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat. Add the beef and saute until just barely cooked, about 3 minutes. Transfer to a plate and cover to keep warm. Add the tomatoes and chilies to the same skillet and increase the heat. Cook until the sauce is reduced by half and thick. Return the beef strips to the sauce, cover and cook until heated through about 2 minutes. Serve at once.

title: Sourdough Crusted Salmon Sandwich With Sourdough Crust
ingredients: 2 - 2 1/2 lbs fresh salmon, cleaned of blood & cut into 6 to 8 pieces | 1 cup sourdough baguette, cut into 6 x 3/4 inch squares.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees. Remove the bones from the salmon & place into a large bowl with the sourdough bread. Pour 1/2 cup water on top of the bread to moisten the bread if desired. Bake the bread for about 10 minutes. Take out of the oven & set aside to cool for about 30 minutes. Remove the sourdough pieces from the bowl & return to the container of a food processor. Toss the salmon pieces with the bread to coat well. Place in the refrigerator to set, about 15 minutes. While the bread is baking mix up the 2 tbsp of sourdough crumb topping. When the bread is time to serve tear the bread into pieces & place the pieces onto a baking sheet. Spread the crumb topping evenly over the bread & bake 5 minutes at 400 degrees or until crisp & browned. Cut into slices & serve.

Random Ingredients: chili pepper flake,olive oil,black mustard seed,roasting chicken,baking potato,lemon juice zest,beet
title: Lebanese Beet & Roasted Chicken-Pot Roasted
ingredients: 2 medium roasting chickens | 1 lemon, juice and zest of | 4 tablespoons olive oil | 3 tablespoons black mustard seeds | 6 teaspoons dried chili pepper flakes | 2 baking potatoes, scrubbed | 1 large roasting potato, scrubbed ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f. Cut a 6 x 6 inch roasting tin or other ovenproof, heavy bottomed, ovenproof dish as required. Heat half the oil in a large cooking pot or on the stovetop. Add the mustard seeds and chillies and roast over a moderate heat until the seeds have popped and the chillies are starting to caramelise. Place the chicken on the base of the prepared pan, skin side up, and spread with the mustard seeds. Drizzle over the remaining oil. Scatter the baking potato over the top and bake for about 40 minutes, covered with foil, until the potato is soft. Alternatively, place the chicken and potato halves between pieces of foil and bake in the oven, covered with foil, for about 30 minutes, turning them halfway through, until well browned all over. Alternatively place all the chicken and potato halves on large baking trays lined with baking paper. Bake the chicken and potato in the oven for at least 5 to 6 hours, or until tender and cooked through. Alternatively, it can be cooked as per your liking, but either way the chicken is much better with the potatoes. Remove the chicken flesh from the skin, leaving behind any fat and shredded or shredded vegetables. Cut the chicken and potato flesh into chunks. Heat the remaining oil in a large frying pan along with the cooking potato. Add the mustard seeds and red chilli flakes. Cook for a few seconds then add the chicken and potato chunks and stir in all the remaining ingredients. Turn the heat up to very high, then add the chopped herbs. Spread mixture evenly to serve.

Random Ingredients: sea salt,water,egg bread,cream wheat,ginger garlic paste,ginger,romano cheese
title: Cheese Bread Kebab
ingredients: 1 egg bread | 1 1/2 cups cream of wheat | 1/2 cup water | 1 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste | 1 tablespoon grated fresh ginger | 2 teaspoons grated fresh romano cheese | sea salt to taste
instructions: Place egg bread dough on a lightly floured surface and knead for about 3 minutes. Roll into a log about the length of the bread. Cut into 6 wedges. Repeat. Place in a medium bowl with a damp cloth on top. Let rise about 20 minutes. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line 2 baking sheets with wax paper. In a small bowl, stir together cream of wheat, water, ginger garlic paste, ginger, and grated cheese until blended. Spoon equal amounts of the mixture into each wedge of bread, spacing well apart. Transfer prepared bread to prepared baking sheets. Bake in the preheated oven 30 minutes, or until slightly browned on top. Allow bread and cheese to cool to room temperature before serving.

title: Cabbage Rice Pulao
ingredients: 1/2 cup basmati rice | 5 cups shredded cabbage | 2 cups short-grain rice | 3 1/2 cups chicken thigh or 3 1/2 cups turkey drumsticks, cut in bite size pieces | 1/2 teaspoon dried marjoram | 1/3 cup vanilla bean
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a saucepan, bring to a boil over medium heat, reduce heat. Cover.

title: Baked Dutch Potatoes
ingredients: 2 lbs potatoes, peeled and diced ( sweet potato will do ) | 10 -20 ounces baked duck
instructions: Prepare potatoes by putting them into a large bowl of cold water and set aside to sit until tender, about 25 minutes depending on size of potatoes. Drain well and then set aside until ready to cook. Duck should be warm and will hold its shape.. Put potatoes in a preheated 350°f oven and bake until brown. Place cooked duck into a roasting pan in a preheated 350°f oven until heated through, about 10 to 15 minutes. Serve hot or warm.

title: Prawns With Onion Vinaigrette
ingredients: 24 large prawns, cooked, shelled, and cut in half ( shelled don't overcook the prawns ) | 1 cup yellow onion, coarsely chopped ( about two large )
instructions: Cook onion in a large frying pan with a little bit of oil over medium heat, shaking the pan to coat the onion with oil. Cook, stirring, until the onions brown lightly, about 8 minutes. Pour the onion and oil into a bowl, pour in the vinaigrette, and stir to combine.

Random Ingredients: genoa salami,red chili pepper,marinara sauce,sharp provolone cheese,salt pork,raspberry,coriander,portobello mushroom
title: Rebecca's Antipasto Burgers
ingredients: 1 lb ground round | 1 lb portobello mushroom | 1/2 lb raspberries, halved | 1/2 lb genoa salami | 1/2 lb red chili pepper | 1 slice provolone cheese | 1/4 teaspoon ground coriander | salt | 2 tablespoons freshly grated sharp provolone cheese
instructions: Prehat your grill. Drain the mushrooms and slice them into halves or quarters. I find most of the time this is just a taste test for tenderness. Mix all the ingredients together in a bowl lightly. Form the mixture into 10 burgers patties about 3 inches in diameter. Put them on a hot griddle with a good amount of salt and pepper. I prefer medium fire for 5 - 7 minutes. Turn after 4 minutes and cook 5 more minutes. Take each burger out and top with fresh grated cheese.

title: Rice-Fried Chiles - Arrabiio
ingredients: 6 medium crisp dried arborio rice | 1 cup taco sauce | 1 -2 tablespoon chipotle chile, dried, seeded
instructions: Using tongs, lift and drain chile.

Random Ingredients: vinegar,sugar,hamburger,bow tie pasta,cayenne pepper,chipotle pepper adobo sauce,cilantro leaf,cooking oil
title: Chipotle Beef and Bow Tie Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger ( any kind will work, beef or pork work ) | 3 tablespoons cooking oil | 2 tablespoons fresh cilantro leaves | 1 chipotle pepper ( canned in adobo sauce - minced ( or pureed in blender ) | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1 teaspoon vinegar | 3 tablespoons sugar | 1 package bow tie ( farfalle ) pasta ( bow tie )
instructions: Saute hamburger meat until browned, remove and set aside. Save grease and add oil to oil. Add cilantro, chipotle puree, vinegar and cook until sauce is slightly thickend and has a sauce like consistency. Add meat back and cover. Simmer for about 30 minutes over low heat, or until meat is cooked, stirring occasionally. Add sugar and stir until dissolved. Cook pasta for about 6 - 8 minutes, drain and toss with sauce. Serve over noodles.

title: Spicy Rice
ingredients: 1 cup long grain rice or 1 cup arborio rice | 1/4 teaspoon dried chili pepper flakes ( add more or remove depending on heat preference )
instructions: Heat a nonstick frypan or wok on medium high and add all ingredients. Toss well and then wait 3 - 4 minutes, stirring constantly with a wooden spoon. Serve with extra chili pepper flakes as an garnish or with any vegetable side dish of your choice.

title: Skor English Toffee Beans
ingredients: 1 pound dry pinto beans | 1 pound leeks, sliced | 4 ounces skor english toffee bits
instructions: Place the beans in a large pot and cover with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil, then turn off the heat and cover pot. Leave the pot covered for about 90 minutes, shaking every now and then. Place leeks in a large pot and fill with enough water to cover. Add skor bits and bring to a boil. Cook the mixture for about 15 minutes, or until tender. Drain well and serve.

Random Ingredients: vanilla extract,nut,asparagus,apricot nectar,raspberry,vegetable oil cooking spray,tortilla chip
title: Apricot & Berry Tortilla Crisps With Apricot Compote
ingredients: 20 ounces frozen apricot nectar | 1/2 cup chopped nuts | 1 tablespoon pure vanilla extract | 8 ounces frozen asparagus ( thawed and drained ) | 12 ounces tortilla chips ( i use mexican specialty ) | vegetable oil cooking spray | fresh raspberry
instructions: Preheat oven to 400f degrees. Whisk the apricot nectar, nuts and vanilla extract in a large bowl. Cut the asparagus into 1/4 inch wide slices and add. Toss with a little bit of the apricot compote and set aside. Coat a 9 x 13 inches baking dish with cooking spray for easy cleanup. Using a teaspoon, scoop out 2 tablespoons asparagus mixture and set aside. Spread tortilla chips out on a clean surface and using tongs, place them on a baking sheet sprinkled with a little flour.

Random Ingredients: kalamata olive,gruyere cheese,cumin powder,cooking sherry,chicken thigh,tart apple
title: Apple-And-Cheese Tagine Chicken
ingredients: 6 chicken thighs, boneless, skinless | 2 tablespoons cooking sherry | 1 pinch cumin powder | 1/4 cup kalamata olive, pitted & halved | 16 thin slices gruyere cheese | 2 tart apples
instructions: Spray the tarragon pan with cooking spray and arrange the thighs. Sprinkle the cumin powder over the thighs and scatter the olives over. Add the cheese and stir around the sides of the pan. Turn the pieces over and add the cooking sherry and bring to a boil. Cover and reduce the heat to a slow simmer. Cook for 1 hour. Turn the pieces again and check on them after 30 minutes.

title: German Sauerkraut and Beans
ingredients: 1 can sauerkraut | 1 can black beans | 1/2 cup graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Pour the sauerkraut, black beans, graham cracker crumbs, and sauerkraut into a crock pot. Cook on low for 6 hours.

Random Ingredients: baby corn,cardamom seed,shrimp,black bean,fine sea salt,cornstarch
title: Spicy Shrimp With Black Beans #A1
ingredients: 1/2 lb shrimp, with skins on ( raw, frozen or defrosted ) | 1 pinch coarse sea salt ( to taste ) | 1 pinch cardamom seed | 10 ounces canned black beans, well drained | 4 ounces baby corn | 1 tablespoon fine sea salt | 2 tablespoons cornstarch
instructions: Peel and devein shrimp. Sprinkle salt over shrimp. Dump shrimp onto shrimp shells, leaving tails at tail end. Place beans on paper towel in cloth sack or in a bowl. Tie bag closed, and add enough water to bag to cover, and refrigerate shrimp 24 hours in fridge. Dump shrimp onto bag and marinate shrimp overnight in refrigerator. Heat oven to 400 degrees f, line a shallow baking pan with foil, and spray with cooking spray, and set aside. Remove bag of shrimp shells and bay leaves from marinade, drain and rinse shrimp thoroughly in a strainer while dry, then add to bag with beans, corn, and spices. Close bag and shake to combine. Taste and adjust seasonings.. Sprinkle with fine sea salt, and transfer to foil lined pan. Bake in preheated oven, until shrimp are pink, stirring often, 15 to 20 minutes, depending on thickness desired. Serve immediately with white rice.

title: Tripe Eggplant Salad or Eggplant Salad (Oamc)
ingredients: 2 medium eggplants | 1/2 cup tripe | 3 tablespoons parsley, chopped
instructions: Wrap each eggplant in foil and roast at 350 degrees farenheit for 40 - 45 minutes, stirring after 30 minutes. Slice in 1/2 to 3/4 inch thick slices. While the eggplant is cooking, make up the dressing by mixing the tripe and parsley in a bowl. When the eggplant has roasted for about 45 minutes, remove from oven. Drain and pat dry with paper towel. Place a portion of the eggplant in the bottom of a salad bowl. Season with salt and pepper and scatter over 1 tablespoons of the triple blend dressing and a portion of the chopped parsley. Spoon over the reserved dressing and sprinkle with the remaining parsley.

Random Ingredients: green cardamom pod,garlic clove,vegetable oil cooking spray,chunky salsa,dill pickle,watermelon,chicken
title: Green Chile Chicken With Watermelon and Pickles in Salsa
ingredients: 1 green cardamom pod | 1 garlic clove, smashed | 1/4 cup watermelon, cut bite size pieces | 1/4 cup chunky salsa | 1/2 lb ground chicken | vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 package frozen watermelon, unthawed, cut into thirds | 1/4 cup dill pickle, chopped and finely chopped
instructions: Remove and discard cardamom pod and garlic cloves. Coarsely chop green cardamom pod and use to tie into a knot around edge of canning jars. Add cardamom, garlic, 1/4 cup water, and salsa. Reserve 1 tablespoon tomato juice for salsa. Place chicken in a large nonstick skillet. Add watermelon. Cover, reduce heat to low, and simmer until chicken is cooked, about 10 minutes. Remove chicken from skillet and cool about 5 minutes. With scissors, slit open lid and remove and discard chicken. In a medium bowl combine chicken, remaining 1 tablespoon tomato juice and remaining watermelon. Cover and refrigerate until flavors combine, at least 2 hours and up to overnight. Remove lid from jar and place tomatoes on the inside of jars. Place a wooden popsicle stick or small metal skewer in center of each tomato. Top with reserved tomato juice and pickle. Return lid and screw on metal skewer. Place jars on a baking sheet and cover with foil. Place in a hot water bath for 10 minutes. Remove from water bath and transfer to a cooler. Leave at least 4 inches of space between jars in the canning process. Wipe jar tops and tighten canning process, if necessary. Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Remove the tomatoes from the canning liquid, then place on a parchment paper covered plate and place in refrigerator to cool. This could take up to an hour. Using a slotted spoon, transfer one tomato to a plate. Holding the tomato with a wooden skewer or metal spatula, push the fleshy part of the tomato toward the side of the jar and discard the tomato skin. Slip the tomatoe, meaty side down, onto a cutting board and cut into half moon slices. Place back into the canning jar.

Random Ingredients: baking soda,blueberry,nutmeg,kosher salt,salmon steak,ra el hanout spice mix,eggplant,green chili pepper
title: Moroccan Baked Salmon Tagine
ingredients: 4 salmon steaks or 4 any firm white fish, 1/4. in thick | 1 large eggplant, cut into 1/4-in thick slices | 3 -4 fresh green chili peppers, seeded and sliced | 3 tablespoons red sweet ras el hanout spice mix, spice | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 1/4 teaspoon nutmeg, ground | 1/4 teaspoon fresh ground black pepper | kosher salt, for seasoning | fresh blueberries or cranberry
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. Combine eggplant, peppers, ras el hanout, baking soda, spices and salt. Arrange eggplant mixture on a baking sheet and bake in oven, stirring once, about 15 minutes, until vegetables are tender and eggplant begins to brown. Toss veggies with pan contents. Sprinkle with fresh blueberries or cranberries.

Random Ingredients: chili paste,dark soy sauce,leg lamb,pork sparerib,red potato,soy sauce
title: Slow Cooker Barbecued Spareribs (Lamb or Pork)
ingredients: 4 lbs leg of lamb or 4 lbs pork butt | 1/2 cup red potatoes, sliced | 4 teaspoons dark soy sauce | 2 teaspoons chili paste | 2 teaspoons soy sauce | 1 teaspoon chili paste | 1 cup dark soy sauce | 1 teaspoon dark soy sauce
instructions: Trim ribs if using pork or pork butt, slice between joint bones and into thick slices. In a 4 - 6 quart slow cooker, combine lamb, potatoes, dark soy sauce, chili paste, soy sauce and chili paste and mix well. Cover and cook on hi heat setting for 3 - 4 hours. During the last 15 minutes of cooking, mix together dark soy sauces and chile paste. Serve with brown rice.

title: Ginger Cashews
ingredients: 1 lb fresh cashews ( or try almonds or hazelnuts, i don't recommend hazelnuts ) | 1 tablespoon chopped gingerroot ( about 2 teaspoons ) ( optional )
instructions: Blanch the cashews in boiling water for about 4 minutes, until they are beginning to turn golden in color. Rinse with cold water until the cashews are cool enough to handle, drain. Add the gingerroot and 1 tbs water to the cashews. Stir to mix. Transfer to a serving bowl. Serve at room temperature.

title: Chile Cream
ingredients: 1 large english cucumber | 1 container sour cream | 5 anchovy paste | 1/2 canned chipotle chile | 1 can tomato sauce | 1 can bush's tomato with sauce ( chipotle blanco salsa de san joaquin )
instructions: Peel and dice unpeeled cucumber into 1/4 inch cubes. Place into colander to drain off excess moisture while preparing the rest of the recipe. Mix together sour cream and anchovy paste in a bowl and set aside. Cut unpeeled cucumbers into 1/4 inch pieces and place into medium sized bowl, breaking apart with fingers when they start to stick together. Add chipotle chilies, tomato sauce and 1 can of tomato with sauce and stir to mix thoroughly. Chop avocado into 1/4 inch pieces and place into bowl with remaining can of tomatoes and remaining 1 can of tomato sauce. Chill for 1/2 an hour or so stirring occasionally to prevent cucumber from sticking together. Serve, topped with a pinch of sour cream to taste enjoy.

Random Ingredients: guacamole,chicken leg,orange peel,cheese,maple syrup,asparagus,soy sauce,nonstick cooking spray
title: Asparagus-Wrapped Chicken Legs
ingredients: 1 lb boneless chicken leg, cut into thin 2-by-3-inch slices | 1 lb fresh asparagus, trimmed and separated into 1-inch pieces ( or frozen ) | 1 tablespoon orange peel, finely julienned | 1/2 cup low sodium soy sauce | nonstick cooking spray | 1/2 - 1 cup pure maple syrup ( not sweetened ) or 1/2-1 cup maple syrup ( not sweetened ) | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon hot guacamole ( or other desired topping ) | grated cheese, to cover
instructions: Line the work surface with several sheets of plastic wrap. Place chicken slices in plastic, laying it into single layers. Place the asparagus in a steamer over a pot of boiling water, cover, and steam for 5 to 8 minutes or until cooked but firm to the bite. Drain, discard water and arrange on wax paper lined baking sheet. In a small bowl, combine the orange peel and soy sauce and set aside. Heat a large non stick skillet over medium heat, add the asparagus and cook and turn the chicken pieces over until they are beginning to brown on both sides. Spray the cooked side of the chicken with cooking spray and set aside. When the chicken is almost done, heat the maple syrup in the skillet. Stir in the hot guacamole. Toss the chicken and cooked asparagus briefly to coat and transfer to a serving platter. Drizzle the chicken with equal measures of the maple syrup mixture. Sprinkle the remaining cheese over and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: pork loin roast,lemon zest,oil,oregano leaf,bulk italian sausage,cottage cheese,fusilli,russet potato
title: Sweet Potato-fusilli Soup
ingredients: 3 lbs russet potatoes | 2 lbs pork loin roast ( optional ) | 2 cans cream of potato soup ( no. 82685 ) | 1 lb bulk italian sausage | oregano leaves | lemon zest, from 2 lemon, only | 1 gallon cottage cheese | 2 teaspoons oil
instructions: Cube potatoes into 1/4 inch pieces, boil until soft. In a bowl, mix cream of potato soup and cream of potato soup with pork meat or sausage, mix well and add oregano into soup mixture. Let soup simmer a few hours. While soup is simmering, fry the zest in oil in a deep fryer for a couple mins, add cottage cheese to soup mixture, stirring until cottage cheese is light and smooth. Simmer for 20 minutes, remove zest and add to soup. Simmer another 10 minutes. Season to taste with salt and pepper to taste. Soup may be made in advance and refrigerated overnight in an airtight container, this will give the flavors a chance to combine better and intensify. When ready to serve, simmer soup for 5 minutes, strain and serve. Garnish with more oregano or cheese, if desired, and serve with lots of crackers.

Random Ingredients: kidney bean,confectioner ' sugar,peanut,thai red curry paste
title: Easy Super Easy Kidney Beans
ingredients: 1 can kidney beans, drained | 1/2 cup confectioners'sugar | 2 tablespoons thai red curry paste | 1/4 cup peanuts, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Combine the kidney beans, sugar, red curry paste, and peanuts in a blender or food processor or mash and stir until well combined.

title: Italian Wedding Cakes
ingredients: 4 -6 ounces egg whites | 1/2 cup icing sugar | 1 teaspoon vanilla | 1 cup fontina, grated or 1 cup fontina, finely chopped | 1 1/2 teaspoons sage, finely chopped
instructions: Beat egg whites until stiff peaks form, then gradually add icing sugar and vanilla. Fold in fontina. Drop tablespoons of dough into cookie press on a greased baking sheet about 3/4 inch thick. Bake at 325 degrees until cookies feel dry, about 15 - 20 minutes. Transfer cakes to a rack, then wax paper or parchment paper and cool. Serve with butter, cinnamon or sugar.

title: Snow Peas
ingredients: 2 cups frozen snow peas | fresh ginger, peeled and thinly sliced ( i use bottled ginger, found in the ethnic aisle of the store, but any ginger would do. )
instructions: Place a steamer basket over boiling water. Heat for 1 to 5 minutes, remove and cut snow peas diagonally into long thin strips. Scoop out into a bowl. Add ginger and stir well to combine. Serve immediately.

title: Sautéed Mushrooms on a Bed of Bread
ingredients: 1 loaf frozen bread dough ( thawed ) | 1 cup fresh bread shredded mixed mushrooms caps | 1 clove crushed garlic
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Unfold dough on a floured surface, and cut into 8 pieces, or roll out to make 8 inch squares. Place 1 mushroom cap on each square. Sprinkle with 1 or 2 cloves crushed garlic. Roll up each piece of dough, and seal the edges firmly. You should have a roll about 4 1/2 to 6 inches across and long enough to form a sausage shape with tape at the top. Repeat with the other side of the dough. Place stuffed rolls onto a baking sheet, and bake for 20 minutes, or until golden brown.

title: Raspberry and Oregano Quesadillas
ingredients: 1 tortilla | 1 fresh raspberry, sliced | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves
instructions: Remove the stem from the raspberry and slice about 1/3 of the rounds. Sprinkle with oregano to taste, then set aside. Heat up a nonstick griddle or medium skillet over medium high. Wilt the tortilla in the skillet until softened. Place a large spoonful of the raspberry slices onto the center of the tortilla, top with about 1/2 teaspoon of oregano. Spread a thin layer of fresh raspberries on top. Fold the tortilla over the filling and press down to squeeze the moisture out. Cut into quarters and serve with maple syrup, sour cream, or any other toppings you like.

title: Chicken in a Roll With Potato, Peas and Lemon
ingredients: 4 cups mashed potatoes | 2 cups cooked chicken, chopped | 1 spanish onions or 1 red onion, chopped ( 6 ounces ) | 1 lemon peel, chopped finely | 2 teaspoons dry mustard | 8 sheets phyllo dough | chicken fat, for frying | 10 ounces cooked peas, chopped
instructions: Mix together the meat, potatoes, onion, lemon peel, mustard and 1 tablespoons of the butter. Place the four sheets of phyllo dough on the working surface, brush with a little melted butter and place another sheet on top. Cut three strips of the filo on a slight diagonal from the edge to the center and continue with the rest of the strips. Cut a 2 inch long slice off the base of each sheet, leaving a 1 inch width all around, and fold one of the strips over the other and repeat the folding process until all the dough is used. Wrap the phyllo bundles tightly in plastic and refrigerate while you finish preparing the filling. Heat the fat in frying pan to 375° and fry 10 bundles at a time until puffed, golden and crisp at the edges. As the bundles fry, turn the bundles from time to time so that they brown evenly. Transfer bundles to a draining tray and drain on kitchen paper. Place the bundles on a serving platter and sprinkle with peas. Serve hot.

title: Barbecue Seared Corned Beef Roast With Mustard Dijon Sauce
ingredients: 1 red-skin-on beef roast | 2 tablespoons mustard powder | 1 tablespoon dijon-style mustard | 1 tablespoon crushed dried mustard seeds | 1 1/4 cups cornflour | 3 lbs fresh corned swiss roll or 3 lbs baby corn creamed corn, shucked | 20 toothpicks, soaked in water
instructions: Prepare the barbecue for direct heat cooking or for indirect heat, as follows, make the barbecue sauce, mix the mustard powder, djon style mustard, crushed mustard seeds, cornflour and 2 3/4 cups of the water together in a pot. Bring to the boil. Simmer for 5 - 6 minutes until thickened, stirring occasionally. Pour the sauce over the roast or roast and set aside to marinate in the refrigerator or over night. Place a rack 4 inches from the heat and spray the rack with a nonstick cooking spray. Bake the roast on the rack for 25 - 35 minutes, depending on how well done you like your roast.

title: Emeril's Arroz Con Gandules
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups long-grain white rice | 1 cup arroz granules | 2 packages active dry yeast | 3 1/2 cups brewed coffee, chilled | 2 teaspoons espresso or 2 teaspoons coffee creamer, warmed ( optional )
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the dry yeast with 1 cup of the arroz, the 1 cup arroz, and the 3 1/4 cup arroz. Sift the remaining arroz over the yeast mixture, and add the brew. Set aside. In a large pot, bring 3 cups of water to a boil. In another large pot, bring 6 cups of water to a boil. In a small bowl, dissolve the espresso or creamer in 1 teaspoon each of water and espresso powder. Cool the remaining 1 cup arroz and arroz in the coffee water for 5 - 12 minutes. Drain, and then invert onto the yeast, cover and set it aside undisturbed for 24 hours. For a richer, more mellow flavor, stir in the espresso/cheese mixture. To serve, place 2 cup arroz mixed with the arroz on each of 4 small toasted breads, or serve 2 arroz per sandwich for one or more 4 servings. If desired, decorate with a shamrock if desired.

title: Coconut Lentil Cake Dessert - Vegan
ingredients: 400 g red lentils | 2 -3 cups coconut cream
instructions: Put coconut cream in a pot, bring to a boil. Add dried lentils. Reduce heat. Cover and simmer for 20 minutes or until the lentils are soft and tender. Remove from heat. Blend with an immersion blender. Pour into a bowl and cool. Cut into blocks. Top with lots of fresh coconut cream and serve with coconut.

Random Ingredients: ice water,italian breadcrumb,arrowroot,celery leaf,new mexico chile,hot paprika
title: Red Chile Sauce
ingredients: 2 dried new mexico chiles | 1 teaspoon arrowroot | 1 cup italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 1 teaspoon hot paprika | 1/2 cup fresh celery leaves | 1 cup ice water
instructions: Heat a small skillet over medium heat. Remove stems from dried chiles and place chiles in the hot skillet. Cook, turning chiles with tongs, for 10 minutes, or until chiles are tender and dark in patches with darker spots. Remove chiles and pour off all but about 1/2 cup of the grease. Place in a blender.

title: Chipotle Chili Powder
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dried chipotle chiles | 5 whole cloves
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix together the dried chipotle chiles and whole cloves. Store in a cool, dry place.

title: Oven Scallops
ingredients: 1/2 lb scallops | 4 teaspoons chicken bouillon granules | 4 teaspoons icing sugar ( confectioner's sugar ) | 1 white onion, grated
