instructions: Place the scallops in the bottom of a greased 9 x 13 inch baking dish and set aside. In a small bowl, stir the 2 teaspoons of broth granules into the icing sugar and set aside. Using a small, sharp knife, remove the center of the scallops from shells. Turn the shells around so that both sides of the shrimps have a slight depression on the top of the shells. Place the scallops on top of the shells and brush the tops of the scallops with the remaining 1 teaspoons of broth. Sprinkle with the reserved icing sugar mixture. Bake at 350 f. For 30 minutes, or until the scallops are lightly browned and the sauce is thick and bubbly.

title: Quinoa and Spinach Salad
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa | 1 cup fresh spinach leaves | 1 cucumber, diced | 20 pitted prunes
instructions: In a medium saucepan, bring 2 cups water to a boil. Add quinoa and cook, covered, until almost cooked, about 15 minutes. Transfer quinoa to a bowl, mix with spinach, cucumber and prunes.

title: Crock Pot Mushroom and Bean Dip
ingredients: 300 g small dried chestnut mushrooms | 80 g canned kidney beans, drained | 2 tablespoons finely grated fresh ginger root
instructions: Place the mushrooms in the bottom of a crock pot. Drain the kidney beans and add them to the crock. Cover and cook on high for 4 hours, stirring frequently. Serve with fresh flatbread or french bread.

Random Ingredients: kidney bean,coriander,sesame oil,cider vinegar,filet beef,chuck,red pepper,brown sugar
title: Beef Hash
ingredients: 2 slices sesame oil | 1 lb chuck, cubed | 1 cup canned kidney beans, rinsed and drained | 1 cup ground chuck | 1 cup chopped red pepper | 2 tablespoons cider vinegar | 2 tablespoons fresh coriander, chopped | 2 teaspoons brown sugar | 1 teaspoon sesame oil
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp sesame oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat, add beef, and sauté until well browned. Add beans, ground chuck, red pepper, vinegar, coriander, brown sugar and sesame oil. Reduce heat to low.

title: Sweet Red Pepper and Honey Mustard Bread  - Bread Machine
ingredients: 1 1/3 cups sour cream or 1 1/3 cups greek yogurt | 1 teaspoon honey mustard | 1 1/2 teaspoons dry yeast | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground red pepper sauce ( i prefer franks ) | 3 -5 scallions, chopped
instructions: Process all ingredients in your bread machine.

title: Sirloin Tip Roast (Slow Cooker)
ingredients: 3 lbs sirloin tip roast, trimmed | 2 pounds medium grain ( whole or cut-grain ) flour ( or as needed )
instructions: Trim fat from roast. Cut roast into 4 large pieces. Place two pieces each in slow cooker and spread 1/2 cup flour on top. Cover loosely with foil. Let sit 8 - 12 hours. Remove from slow cooker.

title: Cherry Barbecue Chicken
ingredients: 1 jar sweet cherries, reserve juice | 1 teaspoon mustard | 1 teaspoon crushed red chili powder | 1 carrot, grated
instructions: Drain cherries and save juice. Combine all ingredients in a saucepan. Bake in a 350f degrees oven for about 15 minutes. Serve with rice.

title: Hot Mexican Cheese Dip
ingredients: 4 ounces american cheese, cubed | 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato, slivered
instructions: Place cheese cubes in the bottom of a pie plate. Top with sun dried tomatoes. Dot with melted butter or margarine. Microwave for 1 - 1 1/2 minutes on high.

title: Italian Zucchini and Pepito Ravioli
ingredients: 1 lb zucchini, cut in rounds | 1 jar pimentos, sliced | 4 cups whole wheat flour | 1 jar instant coffee | 14 lasagna noodles, cooked
instructions: Cook zucchini on stove until tender.. Drain off liquid. Saute zucchini in butter over medium heat for 10 minute stirring frequently. Beat flour in a large bowl until combined. Add zucchini liquid. Cook over medium for 3 - 4 minute stirring frequently. Cook and stir until mixture thickens. Remove from heat. In a 9x13 inch pan place one layer of noodles. Spread with about 3 tbspn of cheese and 1/4 cup of the zucchini mixture. Roll up and place in pan. Repeat until all zucchini mixture is used. Pour remaining cheese mixture over top. Sprinkle with remaining zucchini mixture. Cover with foil. Bake at 375 for 40 more minutes.

Random Ingredients: grey poupon dijon mustard,vodka,buttermilk,corn tortilla chip
title: Quick and Easy One Cup Russian Chips
ingredients: 8 corn tortilla chips | 1/3 cup vodka or 1/3 cup vodka liqueur | 1/4 cup grey poupon dijon mustard | 1/4 cup buttermilk, or more as needed
instructions: Preheat the oven to 275 degrees f. Spray two 12x8 inch baking dishes or other baking dishes with non stick cooking spray. In a small bowl toss together the crushed tortilla chips, vodka and mustard. Pour the chips into the prepared dishes. Make sure each guest has a spoon. Bake the chips in the preheated oven for 45 - 60 minutes, until crisp and golden. Remove the baking dishes immediately to wire racks.

Random Ingredients: tomato paste,green onion,asparagus,sherry wine,chicken leg,tortilla,pineapple tidbit
title: Janae's Chicken and Asparagus Burritos
ingredients: 4 chicken legs with thigh ( or wings ) | 1 can pineapple tidbits, drained | 1 box pre warmed tortillas ( i use 6 large ) | 6 green onions, chopped | 1 cup fresh asparagus, chopped | 1 1/2 cups sherry wine | 1 can tomato paste
instructions: Place chicken legs or wings in crockpot. In a medium bowl, combine pineapple, green onions, asparagi, sherry and tomato paste. Pour over chicken and vegetables. Cook in crockpot on low 8 to 10 hours, or until chicken is cooked through. Serve with warm tortillas.

title: Root Beer & Turnips
ingredients: 1 bunch romaine lettuce, washed well | 2 turnips, peeled | 24 ounces beer, a favorite | 4 slices french bread
instructions: Slice the end from the turnip and peel if necessary. Cut out the main stem of the turnips so you have long slices. Cut into thick slices about 1/4 inch long. Remove the stem from the romaine and discard. Cut the cut strips into 1/4 or 1/2 inch wide strips the length of the rinsed, drained turnips. The strips will also be slightly longer. Remove the rind from the bread and place on a tray,. Lightly toast the bread and brush with the beer. Layer all of the turnips on the toast. Place in the oven for 10 minutes at 400 degrees, turn over and bake for another 10 minutes. Turn off the oven and open the door to let out the aroma that will have sunk to the bottom.

Random Ingredients: caraway seed,rutabaga,cream soup,golden raisin,coffee,cheese curd,chicken breast fillet
title: Irish Chicken & Roast Rutabaga
ingredients: 500 g frozen cheese curds | 500 g tasty cheese curds, grated | 1 cup instant coffee | 1 can condensed cream of potato soup | 2 tablespoons caraway seeds | 1 teaspoon instant coffee | 600 g chicken breast fillets, sliced | 1 cup golden raisin
instructions: Preheat oven to 150°c. Place cheeses in large baking dish, breaking into small pieces. Put soup, coffee, caraway seeds into a large saucepan. Heat until simmering. Pour over cheese and bake for 45 minutes or until cheese is melted and slightly bubbling. Stir every 15 minutes. Sprinkle raisins onto chicken. Spoon cooked chicken over cheese mixture for the last 15 minutes of cooking period.

title: Quick Tomato Soup
ingredients: 3 cups tomatoes, chopped | 1 stalk celery, chopped
instructions: Combine all the ingredients in your slow cooker. Cook on low for 6 - 8 hours, stirring occasionally.

title: Melon Salad With Lemongrass
ingredients: 10 mandarin orange segments | 2 cups polenta | 3/4 cup coarsely chopped white wine | 2 stalks lemongrass | black olives
instructions: Put mandarin orange segments into a pan and pour over the wine. Stir with a spoon until combined. Trim the edges from the polenta with a sharp knife and cut into long strips about 3mm/1 inch long. Slice the lemongrass into long, thin slices. Toss with polenta slices and olives. Serve at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: baking soda,golden syrup,red chili pepper,semolina,yellow onion,chocolate square
title: Chocolate Syrup Biscotti
ingredients: 8 ounces semolina | 2 ounces plain unsweetened chocolate squares, melted and cooled ( or milk chocolate chips ) | 1 large yellow onion, finely diced | 2 tablespoons golden syrup | 1 -2 dried red chili pepper, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon baking soda
instructions: Preheat oven to 325f and line baking sheet with parchment paper or silicon mat. Stir semolina, sugar, chocolate, onion, syrup, red chili, and baking soda together in large bowl. Press half the dough into prepared baking sheet. Drizzle with remaining chocolate mixture and the rest of the dough. Bake 25 minutes or until golden.

Random Ingredients: green bean,half,pepperoni,philadelphia cream cheese,beet,canola oil,white corn tortilla,chicken thigh
title: Easy Sour Cream Chicken Salad
ingredients: 1 package philadelphia cream cheese, cut into pieces | 1/2 cup half-and-half | 2 ounces canola oil | 8 thin green beans, cut into 2 inch pieces | 2 cans white corn tortillas, drained | 1 cup cooked chicken thighs, cut into chunks | 1/2 cup jarred pepperoni, sliced | 1 1/2 cups shredded
instructions: Cook and stir cream cheese in a small saucepan over low heat until melted. Remove from heat.

title: Roasted Cauliflower and Beef
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower, trimmed and broken into florets | 1 cup thinly sliced cooked ham | 1/3 cup brandy | 1 teaspoon orange zest | 2/3 lb stew meat, cut into 1/2 inch cubes
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Place cauliflower in a large bowl with salted boiling water.

title: Chef Bevski's Pasta Dough for the Ravioli
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups whole wheat flour | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 1 teaspoon dried oregano | 1/2 teaspoon black salt | 1 can tomato puree, drained of excess liquid | 2 tablespoons dried filling or 1 tablespoon granola
instructions: For the dough, in a large mixing bowl, stir together the flour, baking soda, oregano, and salt. Place the tomato puree in a saucepan over medium heat, and simmer for 10 to 15 minutes, stirring frequently, until reduced to about 3 tablespoons. Stir in the reduced tomato mixture, the filling, and simmer over low heat to thicken slightly, about 1 minute. Keep warm, stirring occasionally. Transfer the dough to a lightly floured surface and knead for about 10 minutes, or until smooth. Turn the dough out onto a floured surface, and knead several times for about 3 minutes.

Random Ingredients: grain white rice,vanilla extract,pistachio nut,lemon wedge,grape tomato,saffron
title: Rice With Grape Tomatoes and Saffron
ingredients: 2 cups grape tomatoes, halved and seeded, with the cut side down ( about 12 ounces total ) | 1/4 cup pistachio nut ( about 1/4 of a whole nut, ground ) | 1/4 teaspoon saffron | 1/4 teaspoon pure vanilla extract | 1 1/2 cups short-grain white rice | 1/2 teaspoon freshly grated lemon wedge ( optional )
instructions: Combine tomatoes, pistachios, saffron, vanilla, and rice in a medium saucepan. Cover and let stand at room temperature until rinsed, about 20 minutes. Bring 2 cups water to a boil in a large dutch oven over high heat. Add the lemon wedges if using. Add rice and salt. Return to a boil and cook until rice is tender and most of the liquid is absorbed, about 5 minutes. Reduce heat to medium.

Random Ingredients: vegetarian bean,extra virgin olive oil,sherry,lemon juice,french bean
title: French Bean Salad
ingredients: 1 packet french beans, trimmed | 1 can vegetarian baked beans | 100 ml sun-dried tomatoes packed in olive oil, drained and chopped | 3 tablespoons lemon juice | 1 -2 tablespoon dry sherry ( to taste )
instructions: Place beans in a bowl, pour over the tomatoes and toss. Combine the sun dried beans with the lemon juice and sherry. Add dressing and toss. Serve.

title: Pistachio Coconut Balls
ingredients: 1 cup pistachio nut, finely chopped | 2 cans sweetened condensed sweetened coconut, drained
instructions: Place pistachios, sweetened coconut, 1/2 can full cream of coconut, and 1 - 2 tbsp water together in a blender. Blend until well blended. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto a plate. Chill.

Random Ingredients: orange zest,sherry wine,asafoetida powder,tomato juice,parmigiano reggiano cheese
title: Saffron-Scented Tomato Soup
ingredients: 2 cups fresh tomato juice | 1/2 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1 teaspoon grated orange zest | 1 tablespoon dry sherry wine | 1 tablespoon finely grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Combine the tomato juice, asafoetida, orange zest, and sherry in a saucepan over medium heat.

title: Raisin Cauliflower and Cheese Salad
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower | 1 cup cucumber, cut into small chunks | 1 yellow onion, chopped | 1 cup greek yogurt | 1/4 cup raisins | 1/2 teaspoon chili powder
instructions: Wash and dry the cauliflower. Cut the head into small florets, cut them into small pieces and steam them over boiling water for about 5 minutes. Place cauliflower in a mixing bowl. Mix together other ingredients and pour over the cauliflower. Mix well. Place in the fridge and chill at least 2 hours for flavours to develop. Just before serving, sprinkle with a little more chili powder and serve.

title: Homemade Mockinghead Seasoning
ingredients: 1/2 cup lemon juice, freshly squeezed | 1 cup celery seed
instructions: Combine all ingredients in glass jar, and shake well for several hours.

Random Ingredients: hamburger meat,shrimp,hoagie,cherry pie filling,venison meat,garlic paste,cilantro leaf,pie crust
title: Kathy Brown's Venison Beef
ingredients: 3 lbs ground venison meat | 1/2 cup garlic paste | 2 tablespoons shrimp - peeled, deveined, and torn up | 2 packages refrigerated ready-to-use pie filling | 3 packages refrigerated ready-to-use pie crust | prepared sweet garlic mashed potatoes ( optional ) or mayonnaise ( optional ) | cilantro leaves ( optional ) | roasted shrimp ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees fahrenheit. Cook the venison in oven in a large skillet until no longer pink, about 20 minutes. Meanwhile, in a medium bowl, mix the garlic paste with shrimp.

Random Ingredients: bok choy,bacon grease,rigatoni pasta,tabasco sauce,italian seasoning,milk powder
title: Rigatoni with Choy and Bacon
ingredients: 1 lb bacon grease or 1 lb turkey bacon | 2 tablespoons italian seasoning | 2 teaspoons tabasco sauce | 8 cups shredded bok choy | 2 cups rigatoni pasta or 2 cups rotini pasta | 1 cup milk powder
instructions: Heat pan over medium heat. When pan is hot, add bacon and italian seasoning. Cook in skillet. When bacon begins to brown, add bok choy and cook until tender. Drain out any excess grease. Put the cooked mixture into a large mixing bowl and add the drained pasta or rotini. Put in bacon grease. Add remaining sauce and mix well. Pour mixture into a 13 x 9 inch baking dish and cover with foil. Bake at 400 degrees for 30 minutes, until bubbly. Remove foil and sprinkle the top with baking powder. Return to oven for 10 minutes. Remove from oven and allow to heat for an additional 5 minutes.

title: Easy Baked Beans
ingredients: 4 cans vegetarian baked beans ( i like bush's best comfort beans ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons ketjap manis ( or other brandy ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons garam masala
instructions: Place all ingredients in a non stick skillet. Cook over high heat until beans are tender, about 1/2 minutes, stirring gently. Serve immediately.

title: Carrabba's Famous Crumb Crumbs
ingredients: 2 egg yolks | 1 -2 teaspoon fine dry breadcrumb ( for a thicker crumb, use 1 teaspoon of dry bread crumbs mixed with 1 tablespoon bread crumbs mixed with 1 tablespoon plain bread crumbs ) | 1/2 teaspoon black peppercorns
instructions: Preheat oven to 150 - 200 degrees celcius. Beat the egg yolks with a splash of cold water in a bowl. Place the rest of the breadcrumbs in a separate bowl and add the peppercorns. Lightly grease a baking sheet. Place the crumbs in a wide, shallow bowl. Add the egg yolks to the crumbs and beat thoroughly together. Turn the crumbs into the bowl and mix well so the bread crumbs fall into the bowl. Sprinkle the crumbs lightly over the top and sides of the crumbs and bake in the oven for about 30 minutes. Keep an eye on the oven this depends mainly on your oven, so be sure the top of the crumbs don't burn. Remove from the oven and let cool. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: ketchup,arborio rice,shrimp,accent seasoning,jasmine rice,italian sausage,chicken breast,lettuce leaf
title: Spicy Grilled Baked Chicken Shrimp
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs shrimp, cleaned | 2/3 cup of jasmine rice, washed and drained well | 1/3 cup ketchup | 1 lb arborio rice | 4 -5 boneless skinless chicken breasts, cut into strips | 4 ounces italian sausage, sliced | 1 tablespoon accent seasoning | 1/2 - 3/4 cup grated lettuce leaf
instructions: Pre heat oven to 375 degrees. Mix 2 - 3 tbsps water with ketchup, rice, sausage, and accent to make 1/4 c sauce. Dice chicken and put on a large shallow, foil lined baking sheet and top with the rice mixture. Cover and bake for 40 minutes or so until the chicken is cooked through and cooked through. Serve over rice.

title: Russian Tea Powder
ingredients: 1 cup pecans | 1 cup dill
instructions: In a large bowl add all ingredients and stir together. Store in a dry container.

title: Sauerkraut Fritters
ingredients: 2 pounds fresh kale, rinsed and chopped | 4 tablespoons cooking oil
instructions: Place the kale in a large pot with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil, reduce heat, and steam until tender, about 1 to 5 minutes. Drain and rinse with cold water. Chop coarsely. Place in a bowl, and mash together with oil. Use two fork to mash the kale to thicken, if desired.

title: Swede Maple Leet and Leek Salad
ingredients: 1 large swede or 1 large turnip, grated | 1 leek, sliced | 3 tablespoons maple syrup | 2 tablespoons honey
instructions: Grind or process the swede until very fine. Place in medium bowl. Add remaining ingredients and toss. Serve.

title: Remoulade Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup remoulade sauce | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder
instructions: Place sauce ingredients in a bowl and refrigerate. When ready to use, place over a spoon into a microwave safe bowl. Cook in microwave for 1 minute and stir to coat.

Random Ingredients: onion soup mix,lamb,white wine vinegar,coriander powder
title: Baked Lamb or Pork Patties
ingredients: 1/2 cup fresh coriander and onion soup mix | 1 teaspoon white wine vinegar | 1 lb ground lamb or 1 lb ground pork | 1 small onion, finely chopped
instructions: Combine all the ingredients for the meat filling and knead them well. Divide the filling in half and form each half into a 6 inch patty. Place on an oven tray and bake in a moderate oven for approximately 20 minutes, or until cooked through.

title: Apple Surprise
ingredients: 2 tart apples, such as granny smith, peeled and shredded | 1/4 cup seasoning salt, or to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place shredded apples in a large bowl. Sprinkle in seasoned flour, and stir until coated.

Random Ingredients: zucchini,vegetable oil cooking spray,scotch bonnet pepper,blood orange,graham cracker crumb
title: Killer Zucchini and Blood Orange Peel
ingredients: 2 -3 zucchini, cleaned and thinly sliced | 1 blood orange | vegetable oil cooking spray | 4 graham cracker crumbs | 4 scotch bonnet peppers, minced
instructions: Place all ingredients in a food processor or blender, and process until fully smooth. Put mixture in a small bowl, and set aside for 30 minutes. Place plastic wrap directly on the surface to prevent a skin from forming for drying. Then, using a sharp knife, squeeze out the moisture. This allows the peel to become very tender. Place the zucchini in a large bowl along with the orange juice. Stir well, and refrigerate at least and hour. Preheat oven to 450°f. Line a baking sheet with lightly oiled foil. Stir the graham cracker crumbs into the zucchini mixture, then distribute the mixture evenly into the foil lined baking sheet. Place the zucchini mixture on the baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until the topping is golden brown, about 12 - 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: coriander powder,dashi stock,beef broth,shell pasta,peanut oil
title: Chilean Beef Soup
ingredients: 4 ounces shell pasta, such as omitting the salt | 400 g beef broth | 1/2 cup dashi stock | 1/2 teaspoon coriander powder | 1 teaspoon peanut oil
instructions: Put water on a high heat and add salt. Bring to the boil and cook for half an hour. Add the remaining ingredients. Stir well and simmer for at least 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: pepper,turmeric powder,white wine vinegar,cremini mushroom,red chili pepper,whipping cream,beet
title: Mushroom Beet Salad
ingredients: 3 1/2 ounces cremini mushrooms | 2 tablespoons dry white wine vinegar | 6 tablespoons whipping cream | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1 red chili pepper | 1/4 teaspoon ground pepper | fresh thinly sliced pickled beets
instructions: Trim, wash and cut beets into thin sticks. In a large bowl, combine all ingredients except beets. Arrange beets on top and serve at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: bamboo shoot,turkey,potato starch,apple,italian sausage,cream,pecorino romano cheese,garlic powder
title: Polpette With the Italian Sausage and Peppers
ingredients: 1/2 lb hot italian sausage, sliced on the diagonal | 1 can sliced bamboo shoots, drained | 2 tablespoons potato starch or 2 tablespoons cornstarch | 1/4 cup sour cream | 1 apple ( cut into 1/2 inch slices ) | 1/4 cup freshly grated pecorino romano cheese ( plus a little grated parmesan cheese for sprinkling ) | garlic powder | sour cream, for garnish
instructions: In a large bowl, toss the sliced sausage with the potato starch until lightly browned, tossing to coat evenly. Stir in the sour cream, apple slices, pecorino, and garlic powder. Set aside to cool. In a 10 inch skillet or saucpan, melt the remaining cheese over medium low heat, stirring frequently. Serve the sausage mixture on top of the cheese and drizzle with a little sour cream.

Random Ingredients: pork,salt black pepper,green olive,green cardamom pod,quinoa,italian seasoning,chili bean
title: Quinoa Con Gandules
ingredients: 2 cups quinoa | 2 cans pork fat | 3 green cardamom pods | 1 green olives ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon chili bean sprouts or 1 tablespoon green olives ( optional ) | 1 -2 teaspoon italian seasoning | 1 pinch salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: In a medium saucepan over medium low heat, cook quinoa until just tender then remove from heat. Pour 1/3 of the pork fat into the pan and set aside. Raise heat to medium then stir fry the sliced olives, and chili beans if using.

title: Italian Vegetable Soup
ingredients: 2 tablespoons butter | 1 jar italian-style vegetables | 1 can cannellini beans | 1 can hominy
instructions: In a large pot, melt butter. Saute veggies and beans. Add both cans of italian style vegetables except for hominy. Simmer 5 - 10 minutes. Add hominy and hominy to soup.

Random Ingredients: salmon fillet,chili oil,tomato puree,basil pesto,carrot,wheat germ
title: Tunisian Salmon
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sun-dried tomato puree | 2 lbs of small fresh boneless salmon fillets | 1 carrot, peeled and grated | 3 tablespoons whole wheat germ | 1 teaspoon basil pesto | chili oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit. Toast the sun dried tomatoes for 15 - 20 minutes until very dark green. Place the sun dried tomatoes in a medium saucepan and add 2 cups water then bring to a boil. Add the grated carrot and simmer for five minutes. Drain the water and pat dry. Trim the salmon fillets of any excess salt on both sides. Cut into approximately four long strips. Place the salmon strips on a foil lined baking sheet. Whisk the remaining 2 tablespoons of sun dried tomato puree with the pesto and spread evenly over the salmon. Sprinkle the salmon with salt and black pepper. Bake for about 10 - 12 minutes or until fish is cooked thru and the topping slightly browned.

title: Mixed Mushrooms
ingredients: 2 lbs whole mixed mushrooms | 1 cup margarine or 1 cup butter, softened | 1 can sliced beets, drained
instructions: Clean and dry mushrooms. Place mushrooms and margarine in mixing bowl. Cut beets into cubes, and pour into mushrooms. Mix well. Cover and refrigerate 8 - 24 hours, stirring gently at least twice. Sprinkle with powdered sugar before serving. The preparation is done as soon as you read the instructions.

title: Balls (Doughnuts)
ingredients: 1 package pretzels | 1 can green peppercorns
instructions: In a medium size bowl, mix together pretzels, green peppercorns and dry mustard. Drop on a hot, greased griddle or frying pan. Let the bottoms brown, about 3 minutes on each side. Sprinkle with more sugar if desired.

title: Guacamole II
ingredients: 3 tablespoons guacamole, fresh ( see guacamole ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons caraway seeds
instructions: Whisk together the guacamole and caraway seeds in a small bowl. Serve with pumpernickel bread slices or crackers.

title: Quick Low-Fat, Low Cal and Healthy Refried Beans-Low Fat!
ingredients: 1 tablespoon fat free refried beans ( low fat is fine ) | 1 tablespoon fat free olive oil | 1 tablespoon splenda sugar substitute, sugar substitute or 1 tablespoon all-natural sweetener ( or both, if you choose ) | 1/4 teaspoon ground coriander | 1 tablespoon low-fat dried shredded asiago cheese or 1 tablespoon grated asiago cheese
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoons of the oil in a heavy non stick pan. Add beans and stir, cooking until heated through. Add splenda or other artificial sweetener if using and toss until combined. Transfer to a small bowl. Top with cheese and/or dried asiago, if desired.

title: Chocolate-Arugula Truffles
ingredients: 4 ounces arugula leaves | 8 ounces good quality baking chocolate
instructions: Melt the chocolate in the microwave at 80% power.

title: Roasted Peach With Peppercorns
ingredients: 1 peach, peeled, halved, cored & seeded, if serving warm | 4 -5 peppercorns | 2 teaspoons cayenne | 2 teaspoons crushed peppercorns | 1 -2 tablespoon pine nuts
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Arrange peach halves on a baking sheet. Sprinkle peppercorns over peppercorns and cayenne. Bake on the middle shelf of the oven for 10 minutes to develop the flavor. While peppercorns turn crisp, sprinkle seeds with salt and coarsely crush in a mortar. Remove peppercorns & seeds from the oven and combine with crushed peppercorns & pine nuts, stirring. Spoon onto cooled bruschetta.

Random Ingredients: chicken broth,cardamom,clam juice,cajun seasoning tex mex seasoning
title: Cajun Clam Chowder
ingredients: 2 cans minced clams with juices | 3/4 cup chicken broth | 3 tablespoons cajun seasoning, or more to taste ( i prefer tex-mex-style ) | 2 tablespoons cardamom ( optional )
instructions: In a large pot over medium high heat, combine the clam juice, chicken broth, cajun seasoning, cardamon and clam seeds. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer until flavors have blended, about 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: red curry paste,cream mushroom soup,cognac,angostura bitter,rice wine
title: Simple Kickoff
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 cup sweet rice wine ( can use white sherry if you prefer ) | 2 -3 teaspoons red curry paste | 1 teaspoon angostura bitters | 1 teaspoon cognac
instructions: Mix first four ingredients in large mixing bowl and pour into high wine glass and glass bowl with a lid. Stir and drink as is preferred.

title: Spaghetti Alla Diavolo (Spaghetti in Peanut Crisps)
ingredients: 1 lb spaghetti | 1 1/2 teaspoons sesame oil | 1/8 teaspoon pepperoni ( optional ) | 1 slice pepperoni, thinly sliced ( optional ) | 1/8 teaspoon nigella seeds ( optional ) | oil, for deep-frying
instructions: Cook spaghetti in lots of salted, boiling water until al dente. While waiting for the water to boil, heat sesame oil in a small skillet. Add pepperoni and nigella seeds. Saute until pepperoni is soft. Drain and rinse spaghetti well in cold water and drain well on paper towels. Drain spaghetti and return to pot, add sauteed pepperoni mix and toss until well incorporated. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: portobello mushroom,plain nonfat yogurt,italian sausage,parmigiano reggiano cheese,chickpea,yellow onion
title: Spicy Sausage and Chickpea Patties
ingredients: 1/2 lb ground italian sausage | 1/4 cup chopped yellow onion | 2 tablespoons parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1 can chickpeas, rinsed and drained | 1/4 cup plain nonfat yogurt | 1/4 cup portobello mushroom
instructions: Preheat grill to medium high and grease grill with cooking spray. Cook sausage, onion and parmigianoreggiano cheese in a medium size nonstick skillet over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until sausage is cooked through. Add chickpeas and the yogurt and heat through, about 3 - 5 minutes. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Divide mixture into 6 patties. Grill patties 6 minutes per side or until heated through. Arrange on a platter and serve with yogurt sauce for dipping.

title: Maple Syrup Glaze for Corned Beef Fries
ingredients: 1 can corn syrup | 1/2 cup cold water | 1/2 cup light corn syrup | 3/4 cup cake flour | 2 tablespoons chopped parsley
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together corn syrup, water, and corn syrup. Cover, and refrigerate for at least 3 hours. Meanwhile preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Dredge beef in flour, drain, and place on greased rack of a baking pan. Bake for 25 minutes. Drizzle with maple syrup and sprinkle with parsley.

Random Ingredients: brandy,bean sprout,dark brown sugar,fish sauce,coconut milk,active yeast,shrimp
title: Sweet and Sour Shrimp in Thai Coconut Milk
ingredients: 14 ounces light coconut milk | 12 ounces light mussels | 1/4 teaspoon active dry yeast or 1/4 teaspoon yeast cakes | 2 tablespoons fish sauce | 2 tablespoons brandy or 2 tablespoons rum | 11 ounces shredded cooked and peeled medium shrimp | 1/3 cup light brown sugar, packed | 3 -4 tablespoons brandy, extra
instructions: Put the coconut milk, mussels, and yeast in the bowl of a food processor and process to combine. Add 2/3 cup of the coconut mixture, fish sauce and brandy. Process until thoroughly smooth and creamy. Put the shrimp in a bowl with remaining 4 cups of coconut milk. Cover and refrigerate overnight until the shrimp are ready. Put the shrimp in a large, shallow baking dish. Add the brown sugar and 1 tablespoon of brandy. Add 1 - 2 tablespoons of brandy or rum if you wish, or sprinkle with remaining 2 tablespoons of coconut mixture. Cover and refrigerate for up to 4 hours. Pour shrimp mixture over the tops of the shrimp in the baking dish and bake in a 350°f oven for 15 - 20 minutes, or until shrimp turn pink.

Random Ingredients: garlic clove,basmati rice,peanut butter,red cabbage,coriander seed,coconut milk,kidney bean,oatmeal
title: Pine Cabbage Baked in Coconut Milk
ingredients: 1 cup raw peanuts or 1 cup unsalted cashews | 3 cups red cabbage, shredded | 2 cans kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 2 garlic cloves, minced | 4 cups rolled oatmeal | 1 cup coconut milk | 1/2 cup crunchy peanut butter | 2 tablespoons ground coriander seed
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. In a cast iron casserole or ovenproof casserole dish, toast peanuts over medium heat, stirring often, until brown. Remove from heat, cool and chop. In large bowl, toss together peanuts, cabbage, kidney beans, garlic, oatmeal and coconut milk. Spread mixture in casserole. In small bowl, mix together peanut butter, coriander seeds and 1/2 cup of the peanuts. Pour peanut butter mixture over mixture in casserole. Bake until golden and bubbling, about 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Coconut Honeycomb Onion Coconut Dip (Chocloaf) (Gluten Free)
ingredients: 1 vidalia onion | 200 ml coconut cream | 1 tablespoon hazelnuts ( toasted and peeled )
instructions: Peel and slice the onion into 1/4 inch slices. Place in a microwave safe glass dish with the coconut cream and spread evenly. Sprinkle hazelnuts evenly over the top and allow to stand for a minute or two until lightly golden. Serve with your favourite vegetables.

title: Mexican Rice And  Onions (Baked or Not)
ingredients: 1 spanish onion | 1 1/2 cups arborio rice | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh italian parsley
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Chop the onion small and saute in a small amount of oil. Wash rice. Heat the remaining olive oil in your oven proof dish at 325°.. Dip the rice in olive oil and fry until it turns lightly browned. Set aside. Fry the onion until tender, set aside and cover. Add turmeric to onion and let it saute for about 30 seconds. Remove and cover. Add spanish rice to the onions and let cook at 350° on the stove top. The rice will absorb most of the water and will have absorbed most of the water. When the oven proof dish is hot, add the fried onion, dot with butter and arrange the fried rice on the top. Turn oven on broil and broil for 1 - 2 minutes until the edges are slightly browned. You can see the rice getting brown on the outside. Cover with aluminum foil if not using it immediately. When the baking starts to take shape, let it brown on the bottom. Place contents of the oven proof dish on a baking tray. Cut several slits into the rice then bake until crisp and golden.

title: Avocados in Creamy Prawns (Prawns) with Shiitake and Avocado
ingredients: 2 1/2 pounds fresh shiitake mushrooms | 1/2 teaspoon chopped fresh ginger root | 1/2 teaspoon marinade | 1 1/2 teaspoons snipped fresh herb | 1 cup vodka | 1 avocado, halved lengthwise and peeled | fresh herb sprigs | crushed ice and chopped fresh coriander sprig
instructions: Remove stems from mushrooms. Slice caps thinly. Slice caps thinly. Combine mushroom pieces, ginger root, marinade and 1 cup water in a medium bowl. Cover and let marinate in refrigerator for 1 hour. Drain mushrooms and reserve liquid. Place mushrooms in a processor or blender, blend until smooth. Season with salt and pepper. Strain marinade into a small pot. Add reserved mushroom liquid. Heat over low heat until mixture becomes a low boil. Reduce heat to its lowest setting, cover and let simmer for 20 seconds before removing from heat. Pour mushroom mixture into prepared avocado shells. Arrange avocado slices on top. Sprinkle each serving with fresh herbs and crushed ice.

Random Ingredients: horseradish cream,hot red pepper flake,poppy seed,green enchilada sauce,tofu,vegetable oil
title: Spicy Tofu on the Go
ingredients: 2 packages firm tofu, drained well ( about 1 1/2 cups ) | 1 tablespoon horseradish cream, creamy | 1/2 cup prepared green enchilada sauce | 4 teaspoons poppy seeds | 1/4 teaspoon hot red pepper flakes ( or to taste ) | 1/2 - 3/4 cup vegetable oil, for deep frying
instructions: Drain tofu well and blot dry with paper towels. Cut into 1/4 to 1/8 inch slices and set aside. In a shallow bowl, mix together horseradish cream, enchilada sauce, poppy seeds, and ground pepper.

title: Paneer Cheese and Panir Fritters
ingredients: 3 ounces panir, crumbled | 12 ounces sharp cheddar cheese, grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Combine the cheese with the panir in a small bowl. Shape into 4 patties. Coat a large non stick frying pan with oil and heat over a high heat until the surface is coated in hot oil. Add the patties and cook for 3 - 5 minutes on each side, until golden brown. Place on a cake rack to cool.

Random Ingredients: apricot preserve,miso soup mix,stuffing mix,rice vinegar
title: Sweet Onion Dip
ingredients: 3 tablespoons seasoned dry stuffing mix ( i like kraft 2.5 ) | 3 tablespoons miso soup mix ( i like kraft 2.5 ) | 1 tablespoon rice vinegar | 2 tablespoons apricot preserves
instructions: In small bowl, mix the 1 tablespoon of seasoning mix and miso soup mix. Sprinkle the 1 tablespoon of rice vinegar over the stuffing mix and stir to blend. Dip spoonfuls of stuffing mix onto the bottom of a small serving dish coated with cooking spray. Arrange in single layer, then cover with preserves. Serve with pita chips if desired.

title: Chocolate Fudge
ingredients: 10 ounces shortening | 2 tablespoons cream of tartar | vanilla sugar or vanilla sugar, to finish
instructions: Beat the shortening with cream of tartar until soft. Then add sugar and beat again. Add vanilla. Pour evenly into greased and flourless 20 x 30' baking tin. Bake in the center of the oven at 325 degrees for 10 minutes. Let cool, then invert onto plate and cut into squares.

title: Lenguia's Quick and Easy Fruit Ketchup
ingredients: 1 kg small green chili pepper | 3 -4 cups mixed dried fruit | 1 kg of artificial mixed spice
instructions: Wash and cut up kales or green chilie. Wash and dry your choice of vegetables. Grind all the ingredients together very fine. Put into a pan and keep on low flame. Stir often so that it doesn't become too dark. Keep stirring until all the kale pieces turn well brown. Stir in your mixed spice and let it cook for 1 minute. Serve hot with your favourite curry, curries and/or rice. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: parsley,white flour,cumin seed,rice flour,saffron,ice water,butternut squash,glaze
title: Golden Rice Squash With Saffron
ingredients: 1 butternut squash | 1 1/4 cups unbleached white flour | 2 teaspoons rice flour ( i used japanese's seasoned ) | 1/3 cup rice flour | 1 pinch saffron | 1/2 teaspoon powdered saffron ( i used 1 teaspoon ground turmeric powder ) | 1 cup ice water | 1 teaspoon cumin seed | glaze, mixed with | 1 tablespoon ice water
instructions: Pre heat oven to 400°f. Remove peel from butternut squash and cut in half lengthwise and into 1/8 inch thick wedges. Place squash wedges on a cookie sheet lined with parchment paper. Make a smooth paste of flour and spices and put in freezer to speed up the process. In a 2 cup measure mix the cornflake crumbs with ice water, mix with a fork, add about 1 cup ice cold water to form a runny paste. Repeat until all of the ice cold water has passed through the paste and mixture reaches the desired consistency, stirring every 2 - 3 minutes so as not to let it get lumps that form. When the batter gets to be a bit thick, stir well. Set aside in a bowl.

title: Quick Fix Beef Stew
ingredients: 1 can rotini pasta, drained and rinsed | 1/3 cup golden raisin | 1 pinch dried thyme | 1 pinch dried chervil | 1 lb beef short rib, cut into 2-inch cubes | 1 jar taco sauce | 1 can sliced rotini pasta | 1 can quartered fresh cod
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees. Pour the rotini into a 4 quart casserole dish. In a bowl combine the raisins, thyme, chervil, and beef.

Random Ingredients: white rice,oyster sauce,corn oil,kielbasa,coriander,shallot,bean sprout,port wine
title: Portuguese Rice & Bean Sprouts
ingredients: 2 port wine | 1 teaspoon corn oil | 1/4 lb kielbasa, sliced diagonally | 1 tablespoon dried coriander, finely chopped | 8 ounces fresh bean sprouts | 2 tablespoons fried shallots | 3 tablespoons oyster sauce | white rice
instructions: In a small sauce pan, simmer port until reduced to 2 tbsp, approximately 5 minutes. Set aside. Heat a wok over high heat. When hot, swirl in both the corn oil and kielbasa, cooking until well browned, approximately 4 minutes, then transfer to a plate lined with paper towels to drain. Reduce heat to medium, then stir in coriander. Add cooked port wine to wok. Return wok to burner, bring to a simmer, then stir in bean sprouts. Cook for 1 - 2 minutes, tossing over high heat until hot. To serve, place 4 to 6 ounces rice on serving plate along with bean sprouts. Drizzle sauce over.

title: Mixture Color
ingredients: 10 drops green food coloring or 10 drops orange color
instructions: Wet the rim with a little water and dip the rim into some green sugar. Color the entire outside of the prepared mousse. Refrigerate for an hour. Serve with cream or ice cream.

Random Ingredients: whipping cream,orzo pasta,wonton wrapper,red apple,fine sea salt
title: Swiss Wontons from Home
ingredients: 1 red apple, peeled and coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup uncooked orzo pasta | 6 fluid ounces whipping cream | 1/4 cup fine sea salt | 12 wonton wrappers
instructions: In a food processor, combine all the filling ingredients and process until fairly smooth. Place about 2 heaping tablespoons of the filling in the center of each wonton wrapper. Brush the edges of the wontons with water and press around the edges. Chill for an hour. Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Bake wontons until lightly golden, about 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: yellow bell pepper,chicken broth,jalapeno pepper,thai chile,italian plum tomato,seasoning salt,cream tartar,orange zest
title: Pepper Sauce
ingredients: 2 cans italian plum tomatoes | 1 yellow bell peppers or 1 orange bell pepper | 6 fresh jalapeno peppers | 5 thai chiles | 3 1/2 cups chicken broth | 3/4 teaspoon ground thyme ( you can also use fresh thyme ) | 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1 tablespoon orange zest
instructions: Combine all ingredients except the orange zest in a large pot with a pinch of salt and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes, stirring occasionally. When tomatoes are very heated, transfer all to blender or food processor. Blend until well mixed and sauce is smooth, adding in orange zest when mixture is well mixed so the mixture is smooth and not grainy. Cool to room temperature, and refrigerate if you may not want to serve right away. This does seem like a lot but you can serve it on it's own or to a dish later that night.

Random Ingredients: green pepper,xanthan gum,onion soup mix,mexican cheese,celery salt,provolone cheese
title: Velveted Green Pepper Bread
ingredients: 1/2 cup diced green pepper | 1 cup diced celery salt | 1 cup diced onion soup mix ( or onion ) | 2 cups shredded mexican blend cheese | 3/4 cup shredded provolone cheese | 1/2 teaspoon xanthan gum
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. In a bowl, combine all ingredients. Cover and place in a muffin pan. Bake for 15 minutes. Cut into four portions and serve.

title: Chinese Fried Cabbage and Beef
ingredients: 3 cups chinese cabbage, shredded | 1 lb sirloin, sliced | 1 lb crawfish, cleaned | 2 1/4 cups plain flour | 2 1/4 cups tamari | crushed ice
instructions: Mix the flour and tamari. Heat non stick pan. Coat with oil. Sear beef and add cabbage. Stir fry about 3 - 5 minutes. Add sirloin. Cook until the sauce bubbles and add crawfish. Toss. Serve.

Random Ingredients: baby carrot,white wine vinegar,szechuan peppercorn,head cabbage,gingerroot
title: Chinese Cabbage
ingredients: 1 head cabbage | 2 lbs baby carrots | 2 slices gingerroot | 2 teaspoons szechuan peppercorns | 2 teaspoons white wine vinegar
instructions: Wash cabbage, removing leaves and stems. Slice cabbages. Peel carrots and slice into rounds. Dry ginger root with paper towel, slice into thin rounds. In a hot wok, stir fry the cabbage with the ginger until barely wilted. Add the carrots, peppercorns, and vinegar. Fold and serve immediately.

title: Spicy Chicken Breasts
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 1/2 cup chicken stock or 1/2 cup broth | 2 tablespoons dark raisins | 2 tablespoons adobo sauce
instructions: Dry chicken on paper towels. Place chicken in a baking dish. Whisk together chicken stock or broth, raisins and adobo. Pour over chicken.. Cover and marinate in fridge for 3 hours or overnight. Preheat oven to 350 and bake covered for 45 minutes. Remove cover, bake uncovered for 15 additional minutes until juices run clear.

title: Sweet and Sour Potato Salad
ingredients: 1 lb red potatoes, cut lengthwise in half, then sliced 1/4-inch thick ( about 10 medium ) | 1 lb asparagus, trimmed | 1 can mexicorn ( drained ) | 0.5 packet good seasons roasted garlic dressing mix ( regular or light ) | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce | 1/8 cup fresh basil leaf, minced
instructions: Combine the potatoes, asparagus, corn, dressing mix and soy sauce. Cover, and refrigerate at least one hour or up to 3 hours. Sprinkle with minced basil just before serving.

title: Prawn and Rum Sesame Noodles
ingredients: 1 lb large raw prawns, peeled and deveined | 1 ounce dark sesame oil | 1/2 cup dark rum
instructions: Place the prawns in a dry frypan with the sesame oil, rum and sugar. Simmer over low heat for 10 minutes, stirring frequently. Serve immediately.

title: Creamy Italian Cube Steak
ingredients: 1 bone-in cube steak | 3 eggs | 1 tablespoon milk
instructions: Cut meat into cubes about 1/2 to 1 1/2 inches by 1/2 inches x 1 1/2 inches, or whatever shape your cube is inches. Beat eggs in shallow bowl for 20 to 30 seconds. Dip cube meat in egg, then coat with egg, pressing out excess water. Brown the cube steak in a large pot for 12 min., then turn over and brown other side.. Remove cube from pot and place in a warm serving dish. Add milk and heat for 5 minute.

title: Cafe Mix
ingredients: 1 1/2 teaspoons turmeric | 2 teaspoons instant coffee or 2 teaspoons coffee liqueur
instructions: Put into a glass mug or small jar with a tight fitting lid or filter. Shake well to mix. You can pour into hot water as you would coffee. Shake well to mix. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: tomato,turmeric,pepper sauce,greek yogurt,red chili pepper,sea salt,purpose flour,littleneck clam
title: Linguica
ingredients: 2 lbs littleneck clams | 3 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 1/2 teaspoon fresh ground pepper sauce | 1 cup plain greek yogurt | 1 1/2 cups plain greek yogurt | 1 red chili pepper, finely diced | 1 teaspoon ground turmeric
instructions: In a large pot, cover clams with water.

Random Ingredients: peanut butter,italian sausage,baby bok choy,head garlic
title: Sausage Sticks With Baby Bok Choy
ingredients: 1 lb sweet italian sausage | 1 head of garlic, peeled and minced | 1 1/4 lbs baby bok choy, trimmed | 8 ounces peanut butter | 1 small head of garlic, peeled and minced | 2 large heads of garlic, peeled and minced
instructions: In a large pot of boiling water, blanch the garlic for 2 minutes. Drop in the bok choy and cook for 2 minutes. Remove with a slotted spoon. Cut the heads of garlic lengthwise into halves about 1 1/2 inches wide. In a hot nonstick skillet, grill the brussels sprouts until browned on all sides. Remove the brussels sprouts and set aside with the sprouts. In a small saucepan, heat the peanut butter over moderate heat until it sizzles. Add the garlic and cook, stirring frequently, for 2 to 3 minutes or until the garlic is fragrant. Stir in the peanut butter mixture and bring to a boil. Remove from heat and stir in the brussels sprouts and a bit of the sauce. Cover and keep warm over low heat.

Random Ingredients: chili powder,italian seasoning,kalamata olive,flat leaf parsley,chicken bouillon cube,chunky salsa,white pepper
title: Easy Spanish Cilantro K-Jon
ingredients: 1 chicken bouillon cube | 1 teaspoon chili powder | 1/2 teaspoon white pepper | 1/2 teaspoon dried italian seasoning | 8 -10 kalamata olives or 8 -10 other brine-cured black olives, pitted | 1 jar chunky salsa ( hot or mild ) | 1 tablespoon chopped flat leaf parsley ( flat leaf )
instructions: Put everything except kalamata or olives in medium bowl. Add olives. Let sit for 1 - 2 hours, covered, in medium bowl. Serve over rice.

Random Ingredients: cajun seasoning,oyster sauce,taco seasoning,celery salt,salsa,heavy whipping cream,caper,tomato
title: Cajun Oyster Sauce
ingredients: 1 pint heavy whipping cream | 2 teaspoons minced fresh tomato | 1 teaspoon minced fresh celery salt | 1 teaspoon minced fresh cajun seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon salt-free cajun seasoning | 1 bottle salsa ( no flavor ) | 1/4 cup jarred sweet and sour pickled capers, drained and rinsed | 1 package taco seasoning
instructions: Put the cream in a saucepan over medium high heat. Whisk the cream just until it starts to bubble, then whisk in the tomato, celery salt, cajun seasoning, cayenne pepper, salsa, sweet sour pickles, and taco seasoning. Do not boil, as the cream will curdle as it simmers. Heat through, whisking often.

title: Cajun Seasoning Cream Substitute
ingredients: 1 package low fat sour cream or 1 package fat-free sour cream | 2 teaspoons dried chili pepper flakes ( optional )
instructions: In a small bowl, combine sour cream with chili flakes. Let sit at room temperature for 30 minutes. Serve as directed in recipes as a substitute for white sauce.

Random Ingredients: chow mein noodle,plain yogurt,tomato sauce,oyster sauce,spanish onion,soba noodle,bacon dripping
title: Chinese Bacon and Noodle Stew
ingredients: 2 ounces uncooked soba noodles | 1 package chow mein noodles | 1 tablespoon bacon drippings | 1 cup chopped spanish onion | 2 cans tomato sauce | 1 tablespoon oyster sauce | 1 cup plain low-fat yogurt
instructions: Boil soba noodles until tender.

title: Turnip and Cucumber Salad
ingredients: 3 large turnips, peeled and diced | 1 cup cucumber, peeled and diced | 1/2 cup sultana
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a bowl. Chill until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: green pepper,marshmallow,vegetable,mint sprig,greek olive,dark sesame oil,self rising flour,wild rice
title: Wild Rice and Mince With Olives
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups self-rising flour | 1 cup assorted fresh vegetables, chopped ( such as peas, mushrooms, potatoes, carrots ) | 2 cups cooked wild rice, cooled | 1/4 cup chopped green sweet pepper | 1/2 cup chopped greek olive, drained | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil | 1 cup miniature marshmallows | 2 teaspoons chopped of fresh mint sprigs
instructions: Place flour in a large bowl, and stir in vegetables. In a small bowl, combine remaining ingredients, and pour over flour mixture. Stir until just combined. Turn dough out onto a floured surface, and knead until just smooth. Roll dough out to 1/8 inch thickness. Cut into 12 circles, and place on a greased baking sheet. Brush tops with sesame oil. Bake in a preheated 375 degree f oven for 20 minutes, until lightly browned.

Random Ingredients: liquid smoke,green cabbage,porcini mushroom,onion soup mix
title: Easy Spicy Baked Cabbage
ingredients: 1 package dried porcini mushrooms | 1 teaspoon liquid smoke ( optional ) | 1 package dry onion soup mix | 2 large green cabbage, coarsely cut into wedges | 1/2 cup finely chopped fresh porcini mushrooms, or more to taste
instructions: Soak porcini mushrooms in hot water to cover 10 minutes, swishing mushrooms until softened. Drain well, squeezing out excess water. Set aside. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line a 9x13 inch baking dish with aluminum foil. Place mushrooms in a small saucepan and fill with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil and remove from heat. Place in saucepan, and let sit for 2 minutes to soften. Drain and pat dry with a paper towel. Pour enough water to cover mushrooms, and return to saucepan. Stir in onion soup mix and porcini to mushrooms. Arrange cabbage wedges in a layer in the prepared baking dish. Spoon mushroom/spice mixture on top. Bake in preheated oven until cabbage is tender, about 1 hour, adding more water as needed.

title: Cherry Tomatoes
ingredients: 8 -10 cherry tomatoes | 8 -10 gummy worms | 3 bay leaves
instructions: Slice them in halves. Fry in hot butter. Remove and put cherry tomatoes in the bowl containing the butter. Add pinch of fried bay leaves. Add the gummy worms and keep them on low flames until they boil.

Random Ingredients: ginger garlic paste,rice vermicelli,chocolate,garam masala,foie gras
title: Chocolate Stuffed Noodle Sandeshies
ingredients: 200 g rice vermicelli | 1 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste | 150 g grated chocolate | 1 tablespoon garam masala | 10 foie gras ( optional )
instructions: Boil water. Add the noodles and cook them with the ginger garlic paste in the water until they are semi cooked. Keep aside to cool. Whip the chocolate and add the garam masala powder. Break open the noodles. Drain them and spread them inside 4 to 5 greased moulds. Add the noodles and top with the grated chocolate mixture. Bake in the oven at 180°c for 20 to 30 minutes or until the noodles are light and golden brown.

Random Ingredients: bread crumb,noodle,dijon mustard,button mushroom,baking potato,amchur powder,coffee
title: Mushroom Noodles
ingredients: 1 pound button mushrooms, sliced | 12 ounces dry noodles | dijon mustard | 1/2 cup coffee | 4 baking potatoes, cubed | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard | 1 teaspoon amchur powder | 1/2 tablespoon ground espresso | 1/2 cup bread crumbs, divided
instructions: To prepare noodles, place mushrooms, noodles, 1 teaspoon mustard, coffee, potatoes, 1 tablespoon dijon mustard, amchur, and 1/2 tablespoon ground espresso in a large pot. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat, cover, and simmer 20 minutes or until potatoes are tender. To prepare topping, mix bread crumbs with 1/2 tablespoon ground espresso and remaining 1 tablespoon mustard. Place noodles in a separate bowl, pour remaining coffee over them, and mix. Place bread crumbs on a plate, and sprinkle remaining 1/2 tablespoon ground espresso across evenly. Cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate.

title: Sesame Seed Crusted Salmon
ingredients: 2 teaspoons sesame seeds ( kosher, not regular ) | 2 tablespoons shredded ranch-style salad dressing
instructions: Heat oven to 450°f. Place 1 teaspoon sesame seeds in center of an oiled 2 1/2 x 1 1/2 cup aluminum foil lined jelly roll pan. Drizzle with salad dressing. Bring up sides of foil 2 opposite sides. Using long, thin metal spatulas, press seeds into salt. Sprinkle tops with remaining sesame seeds and bake 5 to 7 minutes or until just golden. Serve plain or with pita chips, veggies, or seafood of your choice.

title: Cottage Cheese Cheese with nigella Seeds
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups cottage cheese ( or cream cheese ) | 1/8 teaspoon nigella seeds ( optional )
instructions: The night before intending to serve, in a bowl combine cottage cheese, nigella seeds, and pinch of white pepper. Serve.

title: Homemade Five-Spice Pasties
ingredients: 4 sheets puff pastry, thawed | 2 eggs, separated | 1 tablespoon chinese five spice powder
instructions: Heat oven to 220°c or 400°f line a baking tray with baking paper. Place pastry sheets on prepared tray. Brush with combined egg yolks and five spice powder. Brush pasties with egg whites, then sprinkle with a little more spice, if desired. Bake for 10 - 15 minutes until golden.

title: Cinnamon Sugar-Glazed Oranges
ingredients: 1/2 cup extra virgin olive oil, or more to taste | 2 tablespoons ground cinnamon sugar, or to taste
instructions: Place the olive oil and cinnamon sugar in a shallow dish. Place the oranges in the oil mixture, turning to coat, and let stand to soak, about 20 minutes. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Spray a large casserole dish with nonstick cooking spray. Arrange oranges in the dish. Bake in preheated oven until the edges of the oranges are dark brown, about 20 minutes.

title: Lazy Beef Brisket
ingredients: 1 beef brisket, trimmed and tied | 1 1/2 cups cake flour | 2 tablespoons prepared strong cream | 3 tablespoons vinegar
instructions: Pre heat oven to 425 degrees f. In a shallow dish or platter with a lip rub brisket with mustard. Place flour and vinegar on top and dip brisket to coat. Place brisket in oven and bake for 20 minutes or until browned. Transfer to gravy boat and serve with potato gravy.

Random Ingredients: clam juice,allspice,tamari soy sauce,milk chocolate candy bar,hot chili pepper,chili oil,chinese mushroom,cherry brandy
title: Chili Clam Balls
ingredients: 5 large fresh hot chili peppers | 6 dried chinese mushrooms | 3/4 cup cherry brandy | 1/2 cup clam juice, chilled | 4 milk chocolate candy bars, melted | 4 teaspoons tamari soy sauce | 4 teaspoons chili oil, or to taste | 1/8 teaspoon ground allspice
instructions: Fill a small bowl with warm water. Add chilies.

Random Ingredients: mirin,french dressing,orange flower water,beef chuck,baking cocoa
title: Beef Cubes
ingredients: 4 lbs boneless beef chuck or 4 lbs top sirloin steaks, cut 2-inch thick | 1 -2 cup french dressing | 3 tablespoons baking cocoa | 2 -3 tablespoons sweetened mirin ( sweet rice cooking wine ) or 2 -3 tablespoons soy sauce | 2 -3 tablespoons orange flower water
instructions: Trim outside fat of beef cubes and discard. Combine french dressing and cocoa in a glass bowl or resealable bag. Add meat and coat well. Refrigerate overnight. The next day, place meat in preheated 375° oven for approximately 2 1/2 hours. Remove meat from oven and allow to rest for 15 minutes. Serve with remaining french dressing mixture. Stir orange flower water into meat, cover and refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Bourbon Smoked Escarole
ingredients: 4 cans cream of chicken soup | 4 tablespoons bourbon ( optional ) | 1/2 cup olive, sliced ( optional )
instructions: Place the cream of chicken soup in the crock of a deep fryer, and set to high. Add bourbon to cream of soup, if desired. Stir often, just before removing foam from the soup, pour the sauce mixture carefully over the sliced olives in the crock. Serve with french fries, fresh fruit, crackers or pretzels.

Random Ingredients: splenda granular,kale,butter bean,berry,heavy whipping cream,vidalia onion,vermouth
title: Kale With White Beans, Vermouth, and Butterscotch
ingredients: 3 -4 lbs fresh kale, washed, stemmed, and chopped | 1 vidalia onion, chopped | 1 lb fresh strawberries, hulled and sliced ( or 2 cups berries of your choice ) | 1/4 cup dry vermouth | 3 cups heavy whipping cream | 1/4 cup splenda granular | 1/2 cup butter beans ( or corn )
instructions: Place half of the chopped kale and half of the chopped onion into a blender. Cover and blend on high speed until kale is finely chopped. Stir in remaining kale, and any remaining onion. If needed, add a little water to loosen the blending. In a blender, combine vermouth and remaining chopped kale. Blend, or process until well mixed, then stir into the kale mixture. Continue to add cream. Combine remaining chopped kale, remaining chopped onion, strawberries, and remaining chopped onion. Stir in the cream and splenda granules. Chill overnight. To serve, remove and discard fresh or frozen butter beans. Cut the top off the beans and discard. Use a spoon to scoop out the inside of the shells, discarding a few. Scoop out the meat mixture and put into a bowl. Discard shells. Garnish with additional chopped kale and onions, and serve.

Random Ingredients: kosher salt black pepper,macaroni noodle,white chocolate,beer,green chili,rotel,milk
title: Beer and Chile Mac and Cheese
ingredients: 1/4 cup finely chopped green chili | 1 carton beer, such as corona | 3/4 teaspoon kosher salt ( or coarse salt-free salt ) | 1 cup whole milk | 1 cup rotel, mexican style | 14 -16 ounces macaroni noodles | 3 ounces white chocolate
instructions: In a large nonstick skillet add the green chili, beer, and kosher salt. Bring to a boil and let simmer for 15 minutes. Add the milk, and stir to combine. Add the rotels and noodles and mix until combined. Let simmer for 30 minutes or to desired consistency. If making ahead of time, remove the noodles from the refrigerator during the final 15 minutes of cooking to allow an even thickness of cooking. If making ahead of time, stir the contents of the skillet into the noodles a few times during cooking to prevent burning.

title: French Beef Chicken Wings and Corn With Rosemary and Garlic
ingredients: 2 lbs beef tenderloin steaks, trimmed of all visible fat, then cut into 2 inch pieces | 1 bag frozen corn, thawed | 1 1/2 cups chicken stock | 2 tablespoons dried rosemary | 8 cups vegetable stock
instructions: Place steaks, corn, 1 cup of stock, and the rosemary in a slow cooker. Top with remaining stock and bring to a simmer. Reduce heat to low and cover the slow cooker. Cook 4 to 4 1/2 hours, or until thickened and tender. Remove from pan. Remove rosemary stem and discard. Skim fat from pan juices. Return pan juices to heat over medium heat. Add remaining 3/4 cup stock and bring to a boil. Transfer steaks to a platter and cover to keep warm. Add remaining stock and rosemary to pan juices. Reduce heat to low medium. Cook until thickened, about 5 minutes. Serve with steaks.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack pepper cheese,pumpkin pie spice
title: Mexican Cheese Spread
ingredients: 2 packages shredded monterey jack pepper cheese | 1 teaspoon pumpkin pie spice
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Spread pepper jack cheese on a 9x13 inch baking dish. Spread pumpkin pie spice over cheese. Bake in the preheated oven for 15 minutes. Remove from oven, and carefully stir to mix in the remaining cheese, and return to the oven. Continue stirring until melted and smooth.

title: Stove Top Indian Cornbread
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups yellow cornmeal | 12 tablespoons granulated sugar, divided
instructions: Preheat an oven to 400 degrees f. Lightly grease an 8x8 inch baking dish with vegetable oil cooking spray and set aside. In a mixing bowl, combine the cornmeal, 2 tablespoons of the sugar, and remaining 1/2 teaspoon salt.

title: Maple Syrup Roasted Onions
ingredients: 3 large yellow onions, halved cored | 2 tablespoons maple syrup | 4 teaspoons garlic & herb seasoning | 2 tablespoons ground dried coconut
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f mix maple syrup, garlic& herb seasoning with coconut and sprinkle on onion halves. Lightly oil a 12x18 inch or more shallow baking dish, and arrange onions in a single layer. Brush the tops of the onions with maple syrup mixture. Bake at 400f for 20 minutes, turn quarters, and bake for an additional 20 minutes or until dark brown and caramelized.

Random Ingredients: italian bread,romaine lettuce,parmigiano reggiano cheese,american cheese,veggie crumbles,graham cracker crumb
title: Garlicky Veg Burger
ingredients: 1/2 cup shredded italian seasoned bread, or as needed | 9 ounces american cheese, cut into 18 1-inch thick slices | 5 ounces vegetarian crumbles, such as morningstar farms | 6 slices romaine lettuce | 3/4 cup graham cracker crumbs | 1 tablespoon grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Preheat a large, nonstick skillet over medium high heat with a coating of cooking spray. Dip 1 slice of cheese into the bread crumbs, then press into the bread crumbs with your hands into a thin patty. Place 1 slice of the american cheese into a patty, and set aside. Coat the other slice of American cheese with the crumbs, and set aside. Heat the skillet over medium heat. Repeat with the second slice of cheese, so the burger has a crumbly texture. Stir the remaining bread crumbs into the crumbs, and set aside. Place the burger patty into the hot skillet. Use a spatula to flip the burger onto the other slice of american cheese, so the burger will form a slightly thin patty. Cook and flip until browned, about 2 minutes per side. An instant read thermometer inserted into the center should read at least 165 degrees f. Repeat with the remaining slices of cheese, and transfer the burgers to a warm plate. Sprinkle with the grated parmigiano reggiano cheese, and serve.

title: Tofu and Pine Nut Baskets
ingredients: 4 tofu, 1/2-1-inch cubed | 3 tablespoons pine nuts, toasted | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried thyme leaves
instructions: Sprinkle both sides of the cubes lightly with salt. Arrange tofu cubes on large foil lined baking sheet, and bake in 450 f oven for 5 minutes, turn, and bake an additional 5 minutes until desired browning occurs. Watch carefully, they burn easily. Heat pine nuts in 2 tbsps water in a small heavy saucepan over medium heat until beginning to brown. Remove from heat, and add thyme leaves. Place the cubes on a platter, and serve.

title: Easy French Onion Dip
ingredients: 2 cans condensed cream of mushroom soup | 2 tablespoons white sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. In a shallow baking dish, combine the condensed soup and sugar. Place a piece of wax paper on top. Turn the dish upside down. Place the baking dish in oven and heat for an hour. Do not stir or shake the baking dish. Cool completely before serving.

title: Red Chile Paste
ingredients: 1 pound dried red chile peppers | 3/4 cup simple syrup | 3 large red chile peppers, diced
instructions: Place 5 dried red chile peppers in a blender and add 3/4 cup simple syrup. Blend until smooth. Place remaining red chile peppers in a skillet over medium heat and cook until they soften, about 15 minutes. Transfer chile peppers to a medium bowl, cover with plastic wrap, and set aside to cool. When chile peppers are cool enough to handle, remove stems and seeds and place chile peppers in a food processor. Process until finely chopped. Add remaining simple syrup to chile peppers and blend until mixture is smooth again.

Random Ingredients: marshmallow,baby carrot,leek,dark brown sugar,plum tomato,salt pork
title: Sweet Potato - Moo-Fly
ingredients: 1 lb sweet potato, peeled | 2 lbs baby carrots | 1/2 lb thin salt pork | 8 ounces fresh mushrooms, trimmed | 1/4 lb dark brown sugar | 2 leeks, white parts only, cut into 3-inch lengths
instructions: Combine sweet potatoes and carrots, cover and store in refrigerator overnight. Next day, slice sweet potatoes and carrots slightly larger than the pork, discard pork. Rinse the sweet potatoes and carrots with cold water, drain. In a large skillet, add salt pork and mushrooms. Cook over medium heat 5 - 7 minutes, stirring to brown mushrooms and pork. Add sugar, leeks and green parts of leeks, turn heat up high and cook stirring occasionally for 2 - 3 minutes. Add sweet potato and carrots. Bring to a boil and cook until sweet potato is tender. Serve warm. This makes 1 large, 4 servings. If you want to freeze this, thaw at room temperature until just warm.

title: Bombay Crunch
ingredients: 1 medium head cauliflower, chopped | 1 kiwi fruit, peeled and diced | 2 tablespoons grainy mustard | 1 teaspoon turmeric | 1/4 teaspoon pepper | 2 tablespoons chocolate, melted
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Spray a glass baking dish with cooking spray. Stir the cauliflower, kiwifruit, mustard, turmeric, and pepper together in the prepared baking dish. Drizzle with the melted chocolate to taste.

Random Ingredients: kaiser,head cabbage,chicken thigh,onion soup mix,red chile
title: Chicken Cabbage Rolls
ingredients: 2 pounds boneless, skinless chicken thighs | 2 cups finely chopped onions with soup mix | 2 cans chicken-chicken soup cubes, undiluted | 1 large head cabbage, cored and finely shredded | 1 fresh red chile, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Combine chicken, onions with soup cubes, and red chile in a large pot.

Random Ingredients: blue curacao,spaghetti,snow pea,tortilla,mustard powder,lamb chop,chicken bouillon cube,turmeric
title: Lamb Spaghetti Casserole
ingredients: 12 ounces uncooked spaghetti | 1 cup frozen whole snow pea | 14 1/2 ounces boneless lamb chop, thawed | 1/4 cup blue curacao | 2 tablespoons mustard powder | 1 teaspoon turmeric | 1 chicken bouillon cube, crumbled | 1/2 cup tajind-flavored tortilla, cut in strips
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a large pot of boiling salted water cook spaghetti until just under done. Drain, transfer to a large bowl and refrigerate. Return pasta to pot and fluff with fork. Add snow peas, lamb and curacao to pork. Mix until the mixture is coated. Transfer meat mixture to a large casserole and sprinkle mustard powder, turmeric, bouillon cube and tortilla strips on top. Cover and bake until heated through about 30 minutes.

title: Rice Potatoes with Spicy Salsa
ingredients: 3 large baking potatoes | 1 cup spicy salsa | 1 cup semolina | 1 cup vodka | 2 tablespoons triple sec | 1 bell pepper, chopped | 2 tablespoons hot sauce | 1 tablespoon ground sumac
instructions: Place potatoes in a large pot, cover with water.

Random Ingredients: no salt tomato,sausage,beef bouillon granule,apple juice,cilantro stem,rice vinegar,hazelnut
title: Sausage and Apple Nuts Bar Rissoles
ingredients: 2 lbs lean ground sausage | 1 tablespoon instant rice vinegar | 1 tablespoon hazelnuts, chopped finely | 2 tablespoons apple juice | 1/2 teaspoon beef bouillon granules | 1 can no-salt-added whole tomatoes, drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Cook sausage in a non stick skillet over medium heat 3 - 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until crumbly but no longer pink. Add rice vinegar, hazelnuts, apple juice, and beef granules.

title: Baked Japanese Eggplant with Broth
ingredients: 1/3 cup rice vinegar ( not seasoned ) | 1 tablespoon broth ( or water ) | 1 japanese eggplant, about 3/4 pound peeled and sliced in rounds
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. In a large bowl pour boiling water over onion and vinegar and allow to soak about 1 hour. Drain and blot with paper towels. Lightly oil a 15 x 10 inch baking pan and arrange half of the eggplant in the bottom. Pour broth around the eggplant. Top with remaining eggplant and brush eggplant with remaining vinegar. Cover and bake until egg plant is tender and lightly browned about 25 minutes.

title: Quinoa White Bean, Cheese and Chilies Rissoles
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa | 3 cups baby spinach | 1 cup cannellini, rinsed | 1 cup roasted red whole chilies | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 1 cup light rye flour, plus more for dusting | parmesan cheese, for sprinkling
instructions: Boil the quinoa and water in a saucepan over moderate heat until the quinoa is tender, about 20 minutes. Remove from the heat. Cover and let sit until all the water has been absorbed, 5 to 10 minutes. Meanwhile, bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and spray with olive oil cooking spray. Drop half of the baby spinach in and run under cold water just until wilted. Drain and run under cold water just until wilted. Set aside. Set aside. Remove the stems from the roasted chilies and coarsely chop. Set aside in a serving bowl. Sprinkle the zucchini with salt in a frying pan over medium heat, shaking the pan, and add to the spinach. Cook and stir until the chilies have softened, about 3 minutes. Stir in the chopped chilies and roasted red peppers. Remove from the heat. Set aside. Preheat the oven to 350°f and flour a baking sheet or large baking dish. Stir the quinoa and chopped spinach mixture into the skillet and toss to combine. Turn the dough out onto the prepared baking sheet, and smooth the top. Bake for 20 minutes, until lightly browned. Gently shake the pan, and drizzle with a little olive oil before serving.

title: Melting Potatoes
ingredients: 5 medium limes | 2 packages shredded colby-monterey jack cheese
instructions: Cut limes into wedges.

title: Sara's Broiled Tomatoes and Fennel
ingredients: 8 medium tomatoes ( preferably roma ) | 1 tablespoon fennel | 1 package egg noodles | 1 cup cheddar cheese, shredded
instructions: Preheat broiler. Cut tomatoes in half lengthwise and sprinkle with the fennel.

title: Jalapeno Cream Snack
ingredients: 1 package croutons, cookies ( you can use any flavor snacks ) | 2 cans coconut cream | 12 -20 pickled jalapeno peppers | jalapeno and serrano pepper
instructions: In a large bowl combine coconut cream, peppers and prawns & combine thoroughly. Spoon into a shallow dish or baking dish and sprinkle with a little jalapeno and serrano over top.

Random Ingredients: tony chachere seasoning,spaghetti sauce,onion,cumin powder,hamburger bun,red bell pepper,lettuce,artificial sweetener
title: Burritos
ingredients: 1 lb hamburgerurger brounds ( lean hamburger with seasoning ) or 1 lb sirloin ground round ( lean hamburger with seasoning ) | 1 red bell pepper, chopped | 1 medium onion, chopped | 0.5 jar spaghetti sauce | 1/2 teaspoon cumin powder | 1/2 teaspoon tony chachere's seasoning | 2 soft soft taco-size hamburger buns, toasted | lettuce
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Mix all ingredients together in a bowl until well blended. Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Add meat mixture, and cook until thoroughly browned. To prepare your burritos. Put several slices of cheese in the center of each burger bun, and then top with condiments to serve.

title: Indian Filter Syrup
ingredients: 600 ml freshly squeezed lemon juice | 200 -210 g ground cardamom | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom powder
instructions: Combine all the ingredients through cardamom powder in a clean jar & refrigerate for about an hour to develop flavours. Use as required in indian desserts.

Random Ingredients: broccoli floret,table salt,ginger root,tomato puree,mini marshmallow,frangelico
title: Gourmet Broccoli and Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 cup broccolli frangelico | 2 teaspoons minced fresh ginger root | 1 3/4 cups canned peeled and diced tomatoes with puree | 1 teaspoon table salt | 2 teaspoons instant mini marshmallows | 1 1/2 cups broccoli florets, steamed ( optional )
instructions: Heat broccolli frangelico in medium high skillet. Cook until fragrant, about 30 seconds. Add ginger.

Random Ingredients: tomato,nut,black cardamom pod,ginger garlic paste,graham cracker crumb,dashi
title: Chef John's Tom Ka Halwa
ingredients: 600 g tomatoes, halved | 60 g ginger garlic paste | 250 ml dashi | 1/2 teaspoon black cardamom pod | 8 graham cracker crumbs, sifted | 1/4 cup chopped nuts, toasted ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the grill. Toss each tomato on a cutting board and using a sharp knife, slice into 1/2 centimetre thick wedges on the diagonal. Put the tomato wedges into a saucepan and drizzle with ginger garlic paste, cover with water and bring to the boil. Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes, stirring now and then until the mixture has thickened. Meanwhile, bring the dashi to the boil with the black cardamom, cover and place in the fridge to cool. Meanwhile, crush the graham cracker crumbs with some salt. Toast the nuts lightly. Place the halwa into the oven and bake, uncovered, for 30 minutes, until golden and bubbling. Serve the halwa topped with the dhal sauce and sprinkle with toasted nuts.

title: Homemade Chili Powder
ingredients: 1/2 cup chopped onion ( dehydrated or fresh ) | 1/2 teaspoon red chili powder
instructions: Dissolve dry onion with red chili powder in hot water. Let stand 10 minutes. Using a coffee filter or sieve, grind the onion powder into the desired consistency. Cool and store tightly covered at room temperature.

title: Capellon Tacos
ingredients: 8 ounces corn husks | 1/2 lb fresh pork tenderloin | 6 ounces ground chuck | 3 ounces polenta | 3 ounces cashews, chopped | 1 can rotel tomatoes | 1/2 cup pecans, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Soak corn husks in warm water for 10 minutes. Remove top layer of husk and soak on paper towel for about ten minutes longer. Trim excess dark fibers from tenderloins. Chop into long strips, about 1/2 inches across and 2 inches wide. Combine meat, onion, cashews, rotel and cornhusks. Form meat mixture into 8 balls. Wrap each peace in aluminum foil and tie securely with string. Microwave on high for 1 1/2 minutes, then cook on medium for 20 minutes, turning with tongs, making sure each side of the taco gets an even color. Turn over and cook for 8 to 10 minutes longer. Serve taco with any fixings or vegetables.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon cube,shrimp paste,taco seasoning,beet,white wine,fig
title: Garitos de Camarones (Fig-Bagnet Shrimp)
ingredients: 16 medium raw shrimp, peeled and cleaned | 16 medium dried figs | 1 can sliced beets | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon chicken bouillon cube | 3 tablespoons taco seasoning | 2 -3 tablespoons dry white wine
instructions: Preparation, saute the prawns in a little olive oil until golden. Cut them into bite size pieces and set aside. Put all of the shrimps and figs in a pan with a little bit of water, about 1/4 cup at a time, add the taco seasoning and white wine. Stir and add the chicken bouillon if you like. Cover the pan and simmer for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally. If you want to thicken up a little, turn down heat and add some cornstarch dissolved in a little water to thicken. Add the figs and shrimp and cook for another few minutes. Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley if desired.

Random Ingredients: cool whip,vanilla bean,pineapple juice,habanero pepper,chicken breast,chive,chili sauce
title: Pineapple Coconut Chicken Breasts
ingredients: 4 boneless chicken breasts | 1 cup pineapple juice, from a can of pineapple plus one cup pineapple juice, from a can of mandarin oranges | 1 teaspoon pureed habanero pepper | 1/4 vanilla bean, split | chives, chopped ( optional ) | 6 ounces cool whip ( optional ) | sweet chili sauce ( optional )
instructions: Combine the pineapple juice, habanero pepper, vanilla bean. Sprinkle a few drops of chives on each breast. Broil or grill the breasts until cooked through. When the chicken is hot remove from the grill and allow to cool slightly. Slice the chicken and add to the pineapple mixture. Top with some chopped chives. Top with your favorite dipping sauces. Serve with warm flour tortillas.

title: Spicy Maple Mousse
ingredients: 1 lb ground lean pork, uncooked | 1 can green food coloring | 2 tablespoons maple syrup | 2 teaspoons whipping cream | chilies or as desired
instructions: Mix all ingredients in large bowl until smooth. Spoon into mousse dishes or glasses.

title: Spaghetti Squash with Extra-Lean Ground Beef
ingredients: 1 spaghetti squash | 1/4 lb extra lean ground beef | 2 tablespoons olive oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Slice squash in half lengthwise and set aside. Brush the inside of a baking dish with olive oil and place in oven to cook. Brown the beef and set aside. In a large skillet over medium heat, add olive oil and cook the spaghetti squash until lightly browned, about 5 minutes. Remove spaghetti squash and drain. Stir the spaghetti squash into the beef mixture and cook until warmed through. Serve.

Random Ingredients: heavy cream,avocado,chipotle chile adobo,coconut extract,ginger garlic paste,strawberry,apple
title: Baked Mexican Avocado and Strawberry Jam
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups strawberries, hulled | 1 teaspoon ground chipotle chile in adobo, seeded and chopped ( from 1/4 of a canned chipotle pepper ) | 1/2 cup heavy cream or 1/2 cup yogurt ( 2 tablespoons ) | 2 ounces unsweetened dried unsweetened apples, chopped ( 1/4 c. ) | 1/4 cup sweetened flaked coconut ( 1/4 cup ) | 1/2 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 1/2 teaspoon pure apple extract
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f line two baking sheets with parchment paper or a silpat or lightly silpat or silpat. Arrange the strawberries in a small baking dish, drizzle with 2 teaspoons of the chipotle puree, turning them to coat. Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 15 minutes. Then remove the foil and bake for 10 to 15 minutes longer, until the strawberries are soft. Set aside to cool for 5 minutes. Then transfer the strawberry jam to a saucepan and heat over low heat until it is warm, stirring frequently. Meanwhile combine the remaining chipotle puree with the cream, apples, coconut, ginger garlic paste and apple extract in a small bowl. Add to the jam and stir until thoroughly incorporated. Transfer to a serving bowl and serve at room temperature or covered in plastic wrap and refrigerated for up to 1 week.

Random Ingredients: celery rib,lemon juice,provolone cheese,almond extract,golden raisin,campbell french onion soup
title: French Onion Cheese Spread With Almonds
ingredients: 1 container reduced-fat pepper jack and colby cheese blend | 2 teaspoons light golden raisins | 2 tablespoons prepared campbell's french onion soup | 1 small celery rib, coarsely chopped | 1 cup slivered almonds, toasted | 1 teaspoon lemon juice ( from 2 lemons )
instructions: In a small bowl, stir the cheese blend. Stir in the raisins and 1 tbls of the soup granules. Stir. Spread evenly in a lightly buttered 9 inch springform pan and sprinkle with the celery. Sprinkle with the remaining soup granules, almonds and rind.

Random Ingredients: sherry,cider vinegar,brandy,romaine lettuce,linguine pasta,rice noodle,orange bell pepper
title: Linguine with Sherry Wine Sauce
