ingredients: 1 package dried linguine pasta | 1 bottle dry sherry | 1 bottle brandy | 2 tablespoons cider vinegar | 1 onion, quartered | 1 orange bell pepper, cut into 1-inch strips | 2 romaine lettuce, chopped
instructions: Fill a large pot with water and bring to a rolling boil. In a medium saucepan, stir together the dried linguine and sherry until melted, about 10 minutes. Set aside. In a separate saucepan, pour in the brandy, sherry and vinegar. Heat until warmed through, about 5 minutes. Stir in the quartered onion and orange bell pepper. Cook the linguine in the boiling water, stirring occasionally until cooked through, about 12 minutes. Drain.

Random Ingredients: cayenne pepper,golden syrup,salad oil,bulk pork sausage
title: Pork Sausages in Peanut Butter
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs bulk pork sausage | 1 tablespoon salad oil | 1/4 cup golden syrup | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper
instructions: Remove the meat from the casings, leaving 1/4 cup of fat in the casings, and pound the sausage down into a 1/4 inch thick cylinder. Using a meat mallet or other heavy, flat meat mallet, pound the sausage to an even thickness even layer on all sides, and remove the casings before flattening the sausage with the heel of your hand. Roll the meat up into a sausage shape and tie it with kitchen string, using kitchen twine if necessary. In a skillet set over medium heat, warm the salad oil, golden syrup, and cayenne pepper. Working in batches, lower the sausages in the heated oil, turning as necessary, and place them in the pan. Cover the skillet tightly and reduce the heat to a slow simmer. Simmer the meat until very tender and most of the liquid is evaporated, about 30 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, transfer the sausage to a platter and let cool to room temperature. Serve warm, with vegetables or crackers.

title: Grilled Corn With Corn
ingredients: 2 tablespoons corn, roasted, chopped | 2 tablespoons green cardamom pods, crushed | 2 tablespoons fresh lime juice | 1 tablespoon honey | 1/4 cup grated cotija cheese
instructions: In a bowl, mix the roasted, chopped corn, green cardamom, lime juice, honey and cotija cheese. Grill in a pan or on a grill pan on medium high heat until the cheese starts to bubble. Serve warm.

title: Chopao (Spicy Noodles)
ingredients: 1 package flat rice noodles | 2 tablespoons poppy seeds | 1 pound chopped chocolates | 1/4 cup vegetable oil | 1/2 teaspoon ground turmeric
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook rice noodles in the boiling water, stirring occasionally until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 8 minutes. Drain, and set aside. Place poppy seeds in a mini chopper, and grind until coarsely ground. Sprinkle 2/3 of the ground powder into a small bowl, and mix in chocolates. Set aside. Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Stir fry poppy seeds until fragrant. Stir in turmeric, and continue to stir fry until it darkens, stirring frequently. Remove chocolates from heat, and mix with noodles to coat.

title: Bucatini All'Amatriciana
ingredients: 1 package bucatini pasta | 1 red pepper flakes
instructions: Cook bucatini according to package directions, drain and then return to pot. Add red pepper flakes. Mix well, but don't over mix. Serve.

title: Chilli Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb pasta, dried | 3 tablespoons chili paste
instructions: Cover pasta with cold water, bring to a boil, & drain. Slightly cook chili paste, stir into water.

Random Ingredients: red wine,jasmine rice,beef tenderloin,orange flower water
title: Beef Ryders
ingredients: 1 lb beef tenderloin ( cut into 1 inch cubes ) | 1/2 cup dry red wine | 1/4 cup orange flower water | 4 cups cooked jasmine rice
instructions: Place beef in roasting pan. Sprinkle with rose water and orange flower water. Spray baking dish with cooking spray and cover top with foil. Bake at 350°f for 1 to 1 1/2 hours or until meat is fork tender. Remove meat and serve over rice. Variation, i use the same recipe for making this dish # make a beef broth by using 2 cube servings of pork bones with water or chicken broth, and place beef cubes in broth until each cube is fully cooked. This step may be difficult with low sodium beef broth, but this will assure that the beef will not have too high of a high acidity. Instead of the orange flower water, i just make a cube of the dried parsley and place that into the broth. To make gravy, i brown the diced meat in frying pan with the wine. As sauce simmers, thicken the broth with a little water and flour dissolved in the 1/4 cup or so of water, stirring constantly until gravy is consistency you desire. You can use more or less water according to desired thickness of gravy.

title: Rice Wine Shortbread
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups rice flour | 1/3 cup brown rice flour
instructions: Line a baking sheet with parchment. Stir the rice flour and brown rice flour together. Cut in the brown rice flour. Form the dough into four rectangles about 6 inches long and 1 inch wide. Make a slit in each of the 4 rectangles with a sharp knife. Bake at 300°f for 25 minutes. Allow to cool on the baking sheet. Store in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: rye bread,cauliflower floret,cooking spray,puff pastry,noodle,stewing beef
title: Irish Beef & Cauliflower Pasties
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef, cut into strips | 2 sheets frozen puff pastry, thawed ( i had just made the frozen pkg and had to bake them ) | cooking spray | 1 can cauliflower florets, drained | 8 ounces rye bread, slices thawed | 21 g quick-rye breadcrumbs, fine
instructions: Preheat oven to 190c / 375°f. Spray a heavy non stick pan with oil spray then brown the beef.

Random Ingredients: cauliflower,sauerkraut,new potato,kielbasa,macadamia nut,hot red chili pepper
title: Sweet Potato & Cauliflower Salad With Sausage
ingredients: 300 g smoked sausage kielbasa, sliced into 2 centimetre x 1 centimetre slices and then cut into 2 long strips. heat a dry iron skillet with a little oil on the stovetop to medium heat. add the sausage strips and cook for a minute, then turn down the heat. cook sausages until golden brown on all sides, remove from pan and drain on kitchen paper. mix the sausages into the potato, with the sausages. stir to combine, season – cover and set aside to cool slightly. gently mix the cauliflower and sausage mixture. serve straight away with
instructions:
Name:- ##
 Sweet Potato & Cauliflower Salad With Sausage 
 
## Ingredients ##
 300 g smoked sausage kielbasa, sliced into 2 centimetre x 1 centimetre slices and then cut into 2 long strips. Heat a dry iron skillet with a little oil on the stovetop to medium heat. Add the sausage strips and cook for a minute, then turn down the heat. Cook sausages until golden brown on all sides, remove from pan and drain on kitchen paper. Mix the sausages into the potato, with the sausages. Stir to combine, season – cover and set aside to cool slightly. Gently mix the cauliflower and sausage mixture. Serve straight away with kielbasa rolls.

title: Pork (Chinese Pork) in Oyster Sauce
ingredients: 12 ounces pork, cut into thin strips about 2 x 3 inches long | 2 cardamom pods | 1 cup cooking wine ( shao hsing ) | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce
instructions: Soak the shao hsing in the cooking wine for about 1 hour. Put the pork in a large wok and stir fry over high heat until all sides are nicely browned. Add the wine and oyster sauce, stirring constantly over high heat until the wine has almost evaporated. Turn the heat to high and cover. Cook until the alcohol has evaporated. Remove the cover of the wok and stir fry over high heat for about 1 minute more. Transfer the pork mixture to a serving platter. Turn the heat to a simmer and pour the liquid into the wok. Place the platter on top of the pork and reheat to boiling. Pour the liquid over the pork and serve. Enjoy.

title: Greek Roasted Tomato-And-Cilantro Salad
ingredients: 1 lb ripe italian tomatoes | 1/4 cup minced fresh cilantro leaves | 1/4 cup crumbled feta cheese | 2 cups toasted oysters, chilled
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees f. Toss all ingredients in oven proof bowl. Arrange in a single layer, and sprinkle with feta cheese. Bake approximately 20 minutes, or until tomatoes and cilantro are brown.

title: Easy and Tasty Saucy Surprise
ingredients: 1 package andouille sausage | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1/2 vanilla bean
instructions: Split vanilla bean, scrape out inside and the vanilla bean halves then place inside the sausage. Dry fry in a frying pan until browned on both sides. Pour sausage and spice into a bowl. Add andouille to bowl mixing thoroughly.

title: Calypso (Crummy French Bread)
ingredients: 1 loaf round baguette or 1 loaf pita bread | 1/4 lb margarine or 1/4 lb butter, with 1/4 oz.melted | 2 celery ribs | 1 glass water
instructions: Slice baguette or pita bread in half, lengthwise, so the two halves are 2 to 4 inches long. Cut margarine into 4 to 6 slices. Put on baking sheet or in loaf pan, drizzle with olive oil and spread out evenly. Toast bread or pita about 10 minutes per side in a moderate oven that has a well fitting rim. Serve with celery garnish.

Random Ingredients: linguine,red potato,black cardamom pod,chicken breast half,sea salt black pepper
title: Chicken in Cardamom over Linguine
ingredients: 4 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves | sea salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste | 2 slices country-style red potatoes, cut into chunks | 1 teaspoon freshly ground black cardamom pods | 4 cups chicken flavored linguine, or as needed
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Season flour heavily flour chicken to taste with salt and pepper. Place chicken in a medium baking dish, and place on one half of the foil. Place slices of potato onto chicken breast slices, and top with the black pepper. Sprinkle the chicken breast with cardamom. Drizzle the chicken with flour, and close the oven door. Bake in preheated oven until chicken is just cooked and potatoes have turned golden brown, about 30 minutes. Remove chicken to a serving dish, and keep warm. Increase heat to 450 degrees f. Sprinkle chicken with more pepper. Reduce oven temperature to 350 degrees f. Simmer linguine in soup pot with enough chicken flavored water to cover. Cook until al dente, about 8 minutes. Drain, and serve over linguine.

title: Lolab (Lolab Marinated Sausages
ingredients: 4 lbs fresh polish sausages | 3 garlic cloves, crushed
instructions: Prick sausage with a fork and cut in half lengthways. Rinse the inside with clean, hot water and set aside. Rinse the garlic cloves and place into a mortar with the crushed garlic. P pound mixture until it is a paste. Place the sausages on a plate and sprinkle liberally with the marinade. Refrigerate for at least 2 or up to 8 hours to marinate. Remove the sausages from the marinade. Place in a skillet over medium low heat, cover and cook, turning frequently, until browned outside and tender inside, about 20 to 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: kidney bean,bread crumb,rice flour,coriander,mexican cheese,nutritional yeast,lemonade,red pepper flake
title: Rice Flour Kidney Bean-Rice Balls
ingredients: 1 cup dry bread crumbs | 1 cup rice flour | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 1/2 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes ( i used about a teaspoon, for my taste ) | 1/4 teaspoon ground coriander | 1/3 cup nutritional yeast | 2 cans kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 1 -2 cup shredded mexican blend cheese ( optional ) | lemonade ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Stir together dry bread crumbs, dry rice flour, salt, red pepper, coriander, nutritional yeast, and kidney beans in a large mixing bowl. Add the cheese and blend well with a fork. Stir in a little more bread crumbs, if desired. Roll 1 teaspoons of mixture into small balls and place on a parchment lined baking sheet about 2 inches apart. Bake 25 to 30 minutes or check for doneness. Serve with lemonade.

title: Gramma's Easy Sweet Pepper Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup yogurt | 1/8 cup light corn syrup | 1 1/2 tablespoons dry sherry | 2 tablespoons yellow bell peppers, seeded and finely chopped | 1/2 teaspoon dried sweet cherries, chopped
instructions: Whisk yogurt, corn syrup, sherry, sweet pepper and cherries in medium bowl. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Let stand 15 minutes.

title: Almond Chicken
ingredients: 4 chicken breasts, cut in quarters | 1 cup blanched slivered almond ( about 2 cups ) | 1/3 cup powdered powdered sugar ( confectioner's ), for dusting
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Dry chicken pieces on paper towels. Sprinkle with 2 tbsp powdered sugar. Arrange in a single layer on a baking sheet. Bake until golden brown, about 12 minutes. Transfer to a wire rack. Sprinkle pieces with remaining 1/3 cup powdered sugar. Serve.

title: Banana and Portabella Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 large portabella mushroom | 4 slices firm banana
instructions: Pierce the mushroom and remove any loose stems. If the mushrooms do not get cleaned, peel the mushrooms. If you don't want to use a mushroom cap, just slice off the mushroom tops. It will leave some of the juices into the bowl. Slice the bananas. Place the mushroom caps on a plate, and slice them into thin rings. Spoon the mixture onto the mushroom caps, and serve.

title: Swiss Chard Side Dish
ingredients: 1 box of shredded mexican blend cheese | 1 bunch swiss chard
instructions: Shred swiss chard. Add shredded swiss chard. I also like to cut the amount of cheese to your preferred taste and then sprinkle how much you like on top of the chard.

title: Pineapple Raisin Rice Pilaf
ingredients: 2/3 cup brown rice | 2/3 cup golden raisin | 1/3 cup diced tart apple | 2/3 cup fresh lime juice | 1 tablespoon dried sage, crushed | 1/2 cup plain rice
instructions: Combine 2/3 cup brown rice with raisin, diced apple, lime juice, sage and remaining 2/3 cup brown rice in a 2 quart bowl, stirring to coat grains.

Random Ingredients: shallot,beef roast,garlic red chile paste,rock salt,shiitake mushroom,demi glace,bean
title: Beef Cubes With Shiitake Mushrooms
ingredients: 4 ounces of shiitake mushrooms | 1 tablespoon rock salt | 1 teaspoon garlic and red chile paste | 1 tablespoon demi-glace | 1 tablespoon minced shallots | 1/2 lb beef roast, of choice | 1 can of fat and fat mixed vegetables
instructions: Wash and dry mushrooms with paper towel and put them on a dish to drain and dry them out. Combine rock salt, minced garlic and red chile paste, and minced shallots. Sprinkle the demi glace evenly over both sides of roast and lay it out on the dish, or put in ziploc bag and pour the demi glace over the roast in the bag and turn in a bag with the meat. Let sit a few minutes and put in fridge for about an hour before using. Boil water or a broth, throw in roast, then cover and simmer for 2 hours or until the beef is fully cooked at the end of the cooking. Mix vegetables in a roaster with the leftover meat, mix with the vegetables, pour into the crockpot, and cook for 6 hours on low. You can add some beef broth or water, if it's too thin..

title: Mushroom Penne
ingredients: 3 packages fresh white mushrooms, sliced | 2 red bell peppers, cut into thin strips | 1 package ladyfingers | 3 red sweet peppers, cut into thin strips | 1 package dry penne
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook penne in boiling water, stirring occasionally until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 11 minutes. Drain. While pasta is cooking, mix sliced mushrooms, sliced red bell peppers, and sliced sweet red sweet peppers in a large bowl. Arrange a few ladyfingers on the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish and arrange some of the vegetable mixture around the sides. Layer the penne over the vegetables. Arrange remaining vegetables around the pasta. Pour hot pasta over vegetables.

title: Apricots With Salsa
ingredients: 24 apricots | 1 cup chunky salsa
instructions: Place apricots on a baking sheet coated with nonstick cooking spray. Spoon salsa atop apricots and bake in oven, uncovered, at 350°f. Serve warm.

title: Gramma's Sage and Egg Drop Biscuits (Cookies)
ingredients: 2 cups vegetable oil | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground sage leaves | 2 cups sifted baking soda | sage leaves ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit. In a large bowl, mix together oil, sage leaves, and baking soda. When the oven is heated to 400 fahrenheit, drop the dough by heaping tablespoons onto the center of the baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven for 12 to 14 minutes.

title: Namasu (Sichuan Hot Wings)
ingredients: 6 ounces gochujang ( korean spicy chicken paste ) | 1 1/4 teaspoons dried tarragon
instructions: Heat a wok over high heat until just beginning to smoke, then pour in the korean spicy chicken paste. Stir the paste until it is evenly distributed. Stir once or twice, making sure each piece of paste doesn't burn. When it is bubbling, reduce heat to medium, and stir to loosen any browned bits stuck to the pan.

title: Spaghetti Tacos With Tomato Spread
ingredients: 250 g dry spiced spaghetti shells, boiled, drained and rinsed | 2 tablespoons tomato paste | peanut oil, for frying
instructions: Put the tomato paste in a pan over high heat until it starts melting, about a minute. Turn off the heat. Dip your spaghetti shells, one at a time, into the tomato paste then allow them to dry on paper towels for a few seconds. Heat 3 tablespoons of peanut oil in a frying pan until it is hot enough for a single drop of water to sizzle from a spoon. Drop a few of the spiced spiced spiced spiced spiced spiced spiced spaghetti into the oil or if you have two pans ready for serving, half a small bag of plain yogurt and half an egg with the yogurt added to create the creamy texture. Cook them until they are soft and have a nice colour and texture similar to fried spaghetti, 3 - 5 minutes. Serve at once.

title: Easy Mexican Alfredo
ingredients: 2 ounces philadelphia cream cheese | 2 teaspoons salsa | 1/2 cup broccoli, chopped | 1/4 cup jalapeno pepper, chopped
instructions: In a food processor blend the cream cheese, salsa and broccoli. Cover and pulse a few times until well blended. Serve hot or cold.

title: Easy Preserved Lemon Watercress Chiffonade
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs fresh watercress, stems removed
instructions: Wash and dry the watercress well. Remove the stems, discard stems and reserve. Place leaves in a large pot of boiling water just until wilted. When watercress begins to soften, drain watercress. Place leaves back in pot and stir well. Place in sterile jars leaving 1/2 inches headspace.. Remove stems from stems and discard. Fill with watercress and tie with kitchen string. Return to jar, pressing down to remove air bubbles. Wipe jar rim. Place a piece of wax paper on top of jars to prevent tops from touching. Place jar on a rack in a deep tray. Cover with a dish towel. Let chiffonade sit undisturbed for 1 week. Remove wax paper and paper and allow to cool for at least 6 hours before serving.

title: Baked Maggi Oranges Chips With Anchovy Paste
ingredients: 200 g egg noodles | 3 tablespoons anchovy paste ( optional )
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the anchovy paste and noodles. Leave in refrigerator for an hour or so to soften slightly. Preheat the oven to 200 degrees celsius or 180 degrees c if you have the time. Cut a thin slice from the side of each orange to free the flesh from the bitter white pith that floats on the outside.

title: Yogurt Pork Tenderloin With Kalamata
ingredients: 1 medium head of red cabbage, cored, coarsely chopped | 2 cups plain yogurt | 3/4 lb pork tenderloin, trimmed of fat | 20 green olives
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Line a large rimmed baking sheet with foil. Tear off 2 strips of aluminum foil about the size of your baking sheet. Center the red cabbage over the foil.

title: Cafe Rio Spareribs With Fresh Peach and Apple Cream
ingredients: 8 lbs pork spareribs | 1 cup of chopped fresh apple | 1 cup of chopped fresh peach | 1/4 cup brewed coffee | 2 tablespoons dried thyme leaves | 2 cans low-fat applesauce | 2 tablespoons powdered instant coffee | 2 tablespoons dried thyme leaves | 1 teaspoon dried thyme leave
instructions: Put each batch of spareribs in an 8 quart crockpot. Pour the applesauce over them and cover with the lid. Cook on low heat for 8 to 9 hours, or until the pork just falls off the bone. Remove the pork meat from the crockpot and keep warm, covered for the 2 hours. Strain the sauce and add the powdered coffee and 2 tablespoons of thyme leaves. Heat thoroughly. Pour about 1/4 cup of the sauce over each serving. Note, you can also add 1/2 cup of cold unsweetened apple juice to the sauce before dipping.

title: Sicilian Pork, Macaroni, and Lettuce
ingredients: 2 lbs pork tenderloin | 2 1/4 cups canned elbow macaroni | 4 soft lettuce leaves
instructions: Preheat grill. Cut tenderloin in half. Cut each half into 6 pieces. Put some fat from a 1/2 cup canola or other fat into a roasting pan. Place pork in pan and sear on all sides, about 5 minutes. Bake at 450 for 15 minutes. Add macaroni and return to oven for 30 minutes. Remove from oven and pour off any remaining fat. Place lettuce leaves on two plates and top with pork.

Random Ingredients: cotija cheese,catsup,paprika,self rising flour,double cream,golden syrup,cheddar cheese
title: Golden Caramel Cheesecake Bar
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups self-rising flour ( sifted ) | 1/4 cup grated cheddar cheese | 1/4 cup crumbled cotija cheese | 1/2 teaspoon sweet paprika | 1 1/2 tablespoons golden syrup or 1 1/2 tablespoons molasses | 3 tablespoons sweet catsup | 3 ounces of cheddar cheese, grated | 1 1/2 tablespoons golden syrup or 1 1/2 tablespoons molasses | 1 1/2 tablespoons catsup
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a large bowl using lightly salted hands, until a consistent dough is formed and no longer sticky, adding more flour if necessary. Roll a tablespoonful of the dough, press out to the size of a square 1/4 inch of greased or non stick baking paper. Spread on remaining dough and prick with a fork. Bake in a preheated oven at 400°f for 15 to 20 minutes, reduce heat to 300f and bake for an additional 15 - 20 minutes or until golden brown and firm in the center. Turn out of pan onto a wire rack. To make caramel, combine the ingredients in a saucepan, bringing to a boil. Reduce heat.

title: Pastry Strips
ingredients: pastry shells | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp oil and 2 tsp butter in frying pan on medium heat, add one teaspoon per pastry base, then lower the heat and cook for about 3 mintues. Remove pan from heat and place pastry shell on a plate. Pour in the olive oil and olive oil mixture. Roll dough out thinly and cut into strips, using a large biscuit cutter. You should have 18 strips. Bake in preheated oven at 400 deg c for 20 minutes or until light brown. Rolls a few strips at a time in pastry, then place on racks to cool.

Random Ingredients: lemon zest,kernel corn,peanut butter,chicken breast,balsamic vinegar,ketchup
title: Indoor Satay Chicken
ingredients: 1 lb boneless skinless chicken breast, fat trimmed, cut into 1 inch squares | 1 1/2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 1 tablespoon lemon zest | 2 tablespoons light peanut butter | 1 tablespoon ketchup | 1 cup whole kernel corn, undrained
instructions: Place chicken and next ingredients in a blender and process until smooth. Pour half of the marinade into a large nonstick frying pan and bring to a boil over medium heat. Add chicken and simmer, covered, for about 10 minutes or until cooked through and juices run clear. Spoon sauce over remaining chicken and serve with rice.

title: Cheddar & Dill on a Cheese Spread
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs aged sharp cheddar cheese, grated about 1 cup ( about 4 cups ) | 1 tablespoon dill weed, finely chopped
instructions: In a mixing bowl, combine the grated cheese, dill weed and finely chopped dill. Add the grated cheese a little at a time, combining it with your hands, until the mixture is smooth and soft. Refrigerate or freeze your cheese spread for up to 2 weeks or freeze up to 2 months.

Random Ingredients: chili flake,egg,chinese five spice powder,nonfat milk,liquid smoke,white breadcrumb,basil
title: Chinese Spiced Meatloaf
ingredients: 500 g ground white breadcrumbs | 1 egg | 1 tablespoon chinese five spice powder | 1 tablespoon chili flakes | 1 tablespoon dried basil | 4 1/2 teaspoons liquid smoke | 2/3 cup nonfat milk
instructions: Mix together breadcrumbs, egg, spice powder, chilli flakes, basil and liquid smoke. Mix together with hands until all mixed the breadcrumbs get absorbed by the crumb taste. If a lot of breadcrumbs are visible it may help with the drying out of the meatloaf. Pour half into a bowl, add the milk and mix until all the milk is absorbed. Place the meat in a loaf pan. Cover with breadcrumb mix. Bake in oven at 180°c for 1 hour or until cooked. Serve with rice, vegetables and pickles.

Random Ingredients: vegetable broth,whipping cream,golden raisin,goat cheese,flat leaf parsley,kielbasa,filling,ramp
title: Tartiflette Kielbasa Filled With Goat Cheese
ingredients: for muffuletta : | 1 package trimmed kielbasa, sliced into 1 1/2-inch thick slices | for filling : | 1/2 cup vegetable broth | 3/4 cup golden raisins | 1/4 cup fresh flat-leaf parsley, finely chopped | 1/4 cup finely crumbled goat cheese | 1/4 cup whipping cream, whipped
instructions: Cook and stir sliced kielbasa in 2 to 3 tablespoons vegetable broth in a skillet over medium heat until the sausage begins to color, 3 to 5 minutes. Add golden raisins.

title: Tahini Butter
ingredients: 8 ounces tahini | 1 garlic clove, peeled | 1 dried ancho chile | icing sugar
instructions: Using a mortar and pestle or a spice grinder place the garlic and chillies and mash together to make a paste. Add the tahini and work in the garlic/garlic mixture with your hands. The paste will be sticky, but not too sticky to work with. Once everything is mixed and smooth, knead some more. Once the butter is light and pliable, cover with plastic wrap, and leave in the refridgerator until needed. Use within a few weeks as it will harden a little over time. Tip. I've had this with roasted garlic, so use sparingly as it could become dry.

title: Spicy Yogurt Capsicum Slice
ingredients: 3 tablespoons soy yogurt ( or plain ) | 2 teaspoons worcestershire sauce | 1/2 red capsicum, chopped ( bell pepper )
instructions: Combine yoghurt and seasoning together in the container of a food processor and process until just combined, adding water or lemon juice as needed until the mixture is a smooth paste consistency. Spoon into an 8 x 15cm slice pan and sprinkle with chopped capsicum. Cut into 24 slices and store on the plate in the fridge until needed.

title: African Marinade (Marinade with Only Cayenne)
ingredients: 1/4 cup cider vinegar | 1/4 whole cayenne
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a jar with a tight lid. Close lid and shake to mix all ingredients. Marinate meat for at least 2 weeks before using as a basting mixture. Note, for extra flavor, may use 3 tablespoons of kosher kurkha paste or other berbere seasoning sauce. The cayenne can be replaced by chili powder. I used cumin instead of cumin. The mixture will last 6 months for 3 months. Note, if you can't use kosher kurkha paste it will not last as long.

title: Coconut-Vanilla Cream
ingredients: 6 ounces unsweetened coconut milk | 1 teaspoon pure vanilla extract | 1/2 white onion, minced | 1/2 teaspoon dried tarragon | 1 minced can water chestnuts, undrained
instructions: Place the coconut milk in the bowl of a blender or food processor along with the vanilla extract. Cover and blend until smooth and creamy, 3 to 5 minutes. Add the onion, tarragon and 2/3 cup of the water. Cover and blend until creamy, about 30 seconds. Add the water chestnuts and blend until thoroughly combined. Cover and store at room temperature until ready to use.

title: Pea-Pods-Baked With Tamari-Tamari Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 lb/ 1 pound pods split pea pods | 2 tablespoons tamari | 1 tablespoon/ 1 tablespoon/ 1 tablespoon thawed frozen sweet peas, thawed ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Cut pea pods lengthwise and scrape out the core. Place in a baking dish. Combine the tamari with 1 t olive oil and spread over the pea pods. Bake in preheated oven for 20 mins, stirring half way through baking. Remove the peas, return to oven and bake another 10 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Mustard-Crusted Spicy Scallops
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs scallops | 2 -3 tablespoons malt vinegar | 2 teaspoons mustard seeds, slightly powdered | 2 tablespoons canola oil
instructions: Set up a steamer. Clean, dry, and pat scallops dry with paper towels. In a small bowl, stir together the vinegar, mustard and oil.

title: Cherry and Cashew Salad
ingredients: 4 cups cashews, with skins on, coarsely chopped | 2 cups red wine vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon saffron | 1/2 jalapenos or 1 serrano chili, seeded and minced | 3/4 cup water | 1 bunch maraschino cherry, stemmed, halved | 6 large eggs, hard cooked, peeled and sliced
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together cashews, vinegar, saffron and jalapeno or chile.

Random Ingredients: philadelphia cream cheese,italian breadcrumb,garlic powder,mango chutney,wine
title: Mango Chutney Balls
ingredients: 2 packages cream cheese, softened | 1 - 1 1/2 cup italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 1 -2 tablespoon wine | 2 tablespoons mango chutney | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 375ºf. Combine cream cheese, bread crumbs, wine, mango chutney, garlic powder and a little cold water to form the texture of meatloaf. Shape into a ball and place on a cookie sheet. Bake 30 minutes or until just starting to brown.

title: Stained Crackle Toffee
ingredients: 600 g caster sugar, sugar | almonds | slivered almonds ( optional )
instructions: Place the sugar into a saucepan over a medium heat. Add the ground almonds. Cover the pan and let it bubble gently for about 5 minutes. Remove from heat, without stirring, and sprinkle in slivered almonds. Break up into small pieces and store for upto a week in an airtight tin.

title: Pizza Mexican Style
ingredients: 1 can rotel tomatoes & chilies, drained | 1 1/2 cups plain fat free greek yogurt | 12 ounces beer | 1 - 1 1/4 cup crumbled feta cheese | 1 - 1 1/2 cup frozen cherries
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. Stir rotel, beer, cheese and cherries together in a bowl til all is combined. Spread 1/3 of mixture over the bottom of a jellyroll pan. Roll up jellyroll style jellyroll style. Place rolled jellyroll seam side down on baking sheet. Pour remaining rotel mixture over rolled jellyroll and bake for 20 minutes. Serve with salsa and grated cheese if desired.

title: Grilled Sesame Nests for the Grill
ingredients: 3/4 lb sirloin | 2 ounces pepperoni | 1 tablespoonsesame seeds
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a nonstick skillet coated with cooking spray. Brush or oil on the meat, broil until done, stirring occasionally, 4 - 5 minutes.

title: Homemade Italian Meat Rub
ingredients: 1 pound pork ribs, fat removed | 1/2 cup italian seasoning
instructions: Combine pork fat, italian seasoning, and italian sausages in a sealable bag.

title: Ghana Pork Sausage Stir-Fry
ingredients: 375 g pork sausage | 2 tablespoons cornstarch | 1 bunch green cardamom pod | 5 scallions ( sliced thinly ) | 125 g bean sprouts | freshly boiled watercrisp chinese fried rice
instructions: Slice the pork sausages lengthways about 1 cm thick. Dice the scallions and bean sprouts into very thin slices. Combine the pork sausage sausage with a good pinch of cornstarch and add about a quarter cup of cold water to make a stiff batter. Set aside while making the stir fry. Combine the chili oil, cardamom and cinnamon together in a mortar making sure that it is thoroughly mixed. Add the scallions at the end of the sausages. Heat the stir fry pot over a medium high. Add enough hot water to just cover the base. Heat to boiling over a high heat. Toss in the bean sprouts and return to the boil. Reduce the heat to a simmer. When the water is boiling, add the bean sprouts. Cook for a further 2 - 3 minutes remove the pan from the heat. Place the stir fry into a bowl and serve with steamed jasmine rice.

Random Ingredients: seafood,tomato sauce,arborio rice,vanilla bean,red pepper paste,star anise,topping
title: Baked Wild Rice and Seafood With Topping
ingredients: 1 cup basborio rice | 1 cup frozen cleaned and deveined mixed seafood, thawed | 1 can stewed tomatoes with basil, garlic and oregano ( tomato sauce and tomato paste with garlic and oregano is best, but all other ingredients can be used ) | 1 small red pepper paste, seeded | 1 small star anise | 1/2 large fresh vanilla bean, seeds scraped | 1/8 - 1/4 fluid ounce red hot sauce ( depending on how spicy you want it! )
instructions: Bring 4 cups of water to a boil in a deep, heavy bottomed pot over high heat. Add rice, and stir. Add frozen seafood, and stir. Cover and reduce heat to medium. Cook rice until the water is absorbed and seafood is cooked through, about 5 - 20 minutes. Transfer rice and seafood to a large bowl or platter. Toss together stewed tomatoes, tomatoes, red pepper paste, star anise, and vanilla bean seeds in a blender until mixture is smooth. Pour over rice and seafood. Season with salt and pepper if desired. Sprinkle with hot sauce.

title: Tossed Cherry Tomatoes in Salt and Pepper
ingredients: 2 -3 fresh medium cherry tomatoes, washed, stems removed, each tomato cut in half crosswise | salt & freshly ground black pepper, to taste | 2 -3 teaspoons sea salt ( to taste ) or 2 -3 teaspoons coarse sea salt ( to taste )
instructions: Heat an iron griddle or heavy skillet over medium heat. Drizzle or brush on the oil and when foaming stops, add a few cherry tomatoes to the griddle. Turning as needed, cook for about 5 minutes on each side, or until the tomato skins are lightly browned and shriveled.

title: Chickpea Flour for Macadamia Nuts
ingredients: 2 cups chickpea flour | 250 g hazelnuts, shelled if possible
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180°c. Combine all ingredients very well and knead until smooth. Line a baking tray with baking paper. Roll out the dough to about 1 1/4 inches thick, using a 3/4 inch round cutter. Cut out 2 circles from the round biscuit dough. Place on the tray. Press the edges together at the top. Bake for 12 - 14 minutes, until lightly golden brown.

title: Yuzu (Sweet Chili Paste)
ingredients: 3 pounds spanish-style mixed, unsalted peanuts | 3 pounds kombu | 2 pounds dried kombu
instructions: Place 3 pounds of peanut pods, 2 pounds each of each ingredient, into a small pot, and add water. Bring to a boil over medium high heat.

title: Jow Gai Ji (Hot Chocolate)
ingredients: 2 cups baby spinach | 1/2 medium turnip ( cut in 1-inch pieces ) | 1 cup bok choy ( cut in 3-inch florets ) | 3 tablespoons oil | 1 tablespoon cocoa powder | 1 teaspoon sugar | 6 cups ice water ( or as needed to create a good consistency for freezing ) | 2 tablespoons ice water
instructions: Prepare the bok choy by washing and removing the tough leaves at the root ends. Cut off the roots using a sharp knife, removing what'splash' remains in the center. Break down the larger leaves with your hands. Cut the leaves in half, then cut a cross down the length of the leaves and cut again across the stalk. Cut the leaves into 1 pieces. Peel the turnip and cut into 1 inch pieces. Wash and cut the bok choy into 1 inch pieces. Wash and stir the spinach and add to a medium saucepan. Add water or ice water to cover. Stir fry over medium heat until the spinach wilts, about 5 minutes. Stir in the salt, cocoa powder and sugar. Serve hot. Makes at least 2 servings.

Random Ingredients: maraschino cherry,eggplant,teriyaki sauce,scallion,graham cracker crumb,cumin seed,lime juice
title: Eggplant (Aubergine) Casserole
ingredients: 2 large eggplants, peeled, cut in half lengthwise and thickly sliced | 3 scallions, white and green parts cut into 1/2 inch wide | 2 cups prepared teriyaki sauce | 1 can sliced ginger-garlic cloves | 1/2 cup fresh lime juice | 1 3/4 cups graham cracker crumbs | 3 teaspoons roasted cumin seeds
instructions: Fill a large pot half full with water. Add the sliced eggplant in layers into the water, covering the eggplant entirely. Add the scallions and bring to a boil over medium high heat. Cook uncovered for about 30 minutes then drain the eggplant. Allow the water to come to a boil again, then stir in the teriyaki sauce, ginger garlic, lime juice and 1/2 cup of the graham cracker crumbs. Remove from heat and allow to cool slightly. Once the sauce is cooled combine all the ingredients in a large casserole dish. Bake at 350 degrees f for 1 hour.

title: Blueberry Chocolate Balls
ingredients: 1 cup cottage cheese or 1 cup ricotta cheese | 1/2 cup blueberries ( i use frozen unsweetened raspberries with great results ) | 3 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa | 1/2 teaspoon anise seed | 1/2 teaspoon whole wheat flour | 2 tablespoons rum | 1 ounce aged english cheese, grated ( optional )
instructions: Line a cookie sheet with parchment paper. Soak chopped blueberries in 1/4 cup of orange or clear water to cover a few minutes till juicy. Drain excess liquid from the blueberries and pour into a bowl.. Stir together cottage cheese and blueberries in same bowl and set aside. Beat together cocoa, anise seeds and flour in small bowl. Add rum to cooled blueberry mixture. Gradually add milk into dry ingredients, a little at a time until dough is manageable. Knead dough briefly and divide into small balls measuring 2 oz. With balls placed on prepared pan. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate until ready to bake. Preheat oven to 350°f spray two baking trays with cooking spray and set aside. Dust each ball with remaining 1/4 cup of grated cheese if desired. Bake the balls for 8 - 10 minutes till golden brown.

Random Ingredients: sazon goya seasoning,butter bean,tomato sauce,cremini mushroom,dill pickle
title: Cremini Mushrooms
ingredients: 12 ounces butter beans | 18 ounces canned sliced mushrooms | 12 fresh cremini mushrooms, sliced | 3 cups chopped dill pickles | 1 tablespoon sazon goya seasoning
instructions: In a 12x12 inch non stick skillet, melt butter beans. Add the mushrooms and the pickles. Mix lightly. Mix well. Add the sazon seasoning. Cover and cook over low heat, stirring frequently, until the mushrooms are tender, about 25 minutes.

title: Polish Breakfast
ingredients: 200 g pork sausage ( i prefer pork belly ) | 200 g white mushrooms | 100 g sour cream
instructions: Slice sausage into small pieces, and fry until golden brown, remove sausage and set aside. Turn up the heat, add mushrooms, and fry until tender. Add sausages, and fry for one more minute. Add the sour cream and stir it until heated through. Enjoy.

title: Noodle and Chilies Breakfast
ingredients: 20 fresh green chilies | 3 ounces chopped fontina cheese | 5 -6 fresh small egg noodles | 6 fresh parsley | 3 ounces chopped fresh basil | 3 tablespoons fresh cream or 3 tablespoons mascarpone cheese
instructions: First, prepare the noodles. Slice the basil leaves, then chop parsley. Remove a small cup of the hot water from the chilies, and deseed and mince them. Rinse the chilies briefly then dry them by drying on paper towels over a bowl. To assemble, place a generous handful of the noodles in the bottom of 3 to 4 quart casserole dish. Sprinkle generously with chilies, then a layer of fontina cheese. Repeat, layering, chilies, fontina, fontina cheese, and noodle mixture finishing with the noodles. Top with cream or mascarpone cheese. Bake at 375°f for 15 minutes or until golden brown. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: coconut,spanish chorizo,thai fish sauce,mint leaf,cocoa powder
title: Minty Chorizo and Chile Sausage Rolls
ingredients: 8 ounces spanish chorizo, coarsely chopped | 1 tablespoon unsweetened cocoa powder | 6 leaves fresh mint leaves | 1/2 cup unsweetened coconut | 2 tablespoons thai fish sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Combine chorizo, cocoa powder, mint, and coconut in a bowl. Divide mixture into 4 equal mounds. Using wet hands, place a mound of stuffing on mounds of chorizo mixture on each mound. Wrap each mince in a piece of plastic wrap, pressing to seal. Place the mince rolls on baking sheets. Bake for 40 minutes.

Random Ingredients: beef chuck roast,bean sprout,manchego cheese,baby spinach,crouton,tomato salsa
title: Beef and Bean Sprouts Bake
ingredients: 1 boneless beef chuck roast, trimmed of fat | 1 jar tomato salsa | 1 bag fresh mixed sprouts | 1 bag fresh manchego cheese, grated | 1 bottle croutons | 1 bag fresh baby spinach
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place roast in a 9x13 inch baking dish, and drizzle with salsa. Arrange the mixed sprouts on top of the roast, and set aside. Heat a separate skillet over medium high heat, and stir in the manchego cheese, and cook until melted. Sprinkle the sprouts evenly over the top. Ladle cheese on top, and bake 30 minutes in the preheated oven. Sprinkle spinach over top, and bake 30 minutes, until heated through and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: rigatoni pasta,kaffir lime leaf,porcini mushroom,pepper,bamboo shoot,yellow onion,kale
title: Kale-Cocktail
ingredients: 1/2 lb collard greens | 1/2 lb kale or 1/2 lb red leaf lettuce | 1 cup bamboo shoot, frozen | 1/2 cup small-pitted kaffir lime leaf ( substitute fresh navel oranges for another variety or try other citrus as well ) | 2 tablespoons chopped yellow onions | kaffir lime leaf ( substitute fresh lemons if preferred ) | pepper
instructions: Slice vegetables, place in bottom of large bowl with a spoonfull of chopped kaffir lime leaves and kaffir lime leaves. Combine veggies with chopped kaffir lime leaves. Sprinkle pepper on top. Let sit in refrigerator for flavors to blend, about 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: broccoli,marinara sauce,lemongrass,salt pepper,icing sugar,tomato puree,wasabi,lemon juice
title: Tomato Based Broccoli Salad
ingredients: 1 head fresh broccoli | 1/4 cup lemon juice | 3 tablespoons chopped seeded fresh lemongrass | 2 teaspoons wasabi or 2 teaspoons granulated garlic | 1/4 teaspoon salt and pepper | 1/2 cup tomato puree | 1 tablespoon icing sugar | 2 - 2 1/2 cups marinara sauce
instructions: Wash the broccoli and cut into quarters. Cut each quarter into 1 inch chunks or smaller if its to thick cut pieces if it's to thin. Wash the stems and dry if not using fresh lemongrass. Place all the ingredients except the sauce in a blender and puree until smooth. Pour the sauce over the broccoli and toss well. Serve over lettuce leaves. Top with extra tomato slices if desired.

title: Kitchen Koutbane's Mexican Picante Sauce
ingredients: 2 cups picante sauce | 1 1/2 teaspoons lemon juice ( i like lemon zest )
instructions: In a small bowl, mix half of the picante with the lemon zest. In a blender combine the remaining picante with the lemon juice. Blend until desired consistency is achieved.

Random Ingredients: kosher salt,onion soup mix,tabasco sauce,nonfat cream,leaf thyme
title: Hot Dogs
ingredients: 1 package dry onion soup mix | 1/2 teaspoon coarse kosher salt | 2 teaspoons tabasco sauce | 1 -1 teaspoon dried leaf thyme, crushed | 1/4 cup nonfat sour cream
instructions: Stir the soup mix with the salt, tabasco, thyme and half of the sour cream until well blended. Place on waxed paper and roll up to make an 8 inch long sausage. Slide the sausage roll into the remaining sour cream and sprinkle with remaining sour cream. Wrap in waxed paper and refrigerate for a few hours or overnight.

title: Chocolate Salami
ingredients: 200 g dark chocolate ( roughly chopped ) or 200 g dark chocolate ( roughly chopped ) | 100 g white sugar
instructions: Place all the ingredients in a large bowl and mix together with a wooden spoon. The mixture should be creamy. Pour onto a well greased baking sheet and allow to set before slicing into 1 / 2 slice diagonally. Using a sharp knife cut diagonally for a very thin slice. Store in an airtight container.

title: Shrimp Daniels
ingredients: 32 large shrimp, peeled and deveined | 8 fluid ounces canola cooking sherry | 1/2 head garlic, cloves peeled and halved | 1 1/2 cups molasses | 1 cup chopped pecans | 12 ounces canola cooking sherry, heated
instructions: Place shrimp, 2 cups canola sherry, and garlic cloves into two 6 oz. Mushrooms in a 13x9x2 inch glass baking dish. Place mushrooms in dish. Bake uncovered in a 350 degree f oven for 25 minutes. Remove shrimp and garlic cloves with tongs. Spoon sherry into a small saucepan. Bring to a boil and add molasses and pecans. Heat over low heat, stirring occasionally, until mixture boils. Remove from heat and pour over cooked shrimp and garlic cloves. Serve at once.

title: Tahini
ingredients: 1/2 lb harissa, from harissa jar ( found at middle eastern market or store ) | 1/2 lb fresh anarnagalus root, in pod ( about 2 ) | 1 teaspoon kosher salt | 24 wonton wrappers
instructions: Place the harissa and root at the center of a large piece of waxed paper, then wrap the paper around the m'rie in a tight spiral, beginning on one section and the other near the end.

title: Lettuce and Ginger Appetizer Wedges
ingredients: 6 cups sliced peeled fresh ginger | 1/4 cup chopped fresh chipped fresh ginger | 10 cups shredded iceberg lettuce | 24 pieces firm, round, round or square waferware pieces
instructions: Prepare your own bread dough, store for up to 6 weeks in an airtight container in the refrigerator. Using a vegetable peeler, finely and evenly peel the outer rind from the ginger slices. Slice the ginger about 1/8 inch thick. Slice the cloves into thin slivers. Tear off rounded 1/2 inch pieces. Set aside one cup of ginger to use later if using. Combine the remaining ginger, chipped gingerroot, and finely diced ginger and set aside. Preheat your oven's broiler and set the oven rack about 6 inches from the heat source. Place the 8 cups ginger and chipped ginger into a colander set in a bowl. Break the remaining slicker pieces of ginger into pieces. Add the shredded lettuce, and toss lightly to combine. Place 1 tablespoon of the dough into each of 8 small ramekins. Place a piece of ginger and chipped ginger on a piece of bread. Close the crusts and top with a piece of cheese. Set the sandwiches on sturdy foil, and place them under the broiler for 3 to 5 minutes. Turn and broil until the cheese has melted and begun to crackle, about 3 more minutes. Allow the cheese to cool in the oven. Serve warm.

title: Tangerine Lamb Jerky  (Burgundi)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs lamb, cut into small cubes | 1 tangerine juice | 1 tablespoon margarine | 2 teaspoons cardamom seeds | 2 small yellow peppers, cut into strips
instructions: Soak all the ingredients except the beef until very cold, about 30 minutes. Strain and reserve solids. Rinse the meat and pat dry with paper towels. In a small skillet melt the margarine on medium heat and add the cardamom seeds. When they begin to pop, add the pepper strips. Cook until golden, about 5 minutes on all sides. Put meat on a lightly oiled rack set in a roasting pan, and brush the marinade onto the meat. Place meat on top of the peppers and pour remaining marinade over, making sure the meat is completely covered. Bake in the oven at 250 f or 300 f for about 1 and 1/2 hours, or until the meat is cooked through.

Random Ingredients: beef consomme,liquid smoke,nicoise olive,cinnamon,cashew,dark sesame oil,camembert cheese,clove
title: Smoked Nicoise-Cured Camembert Sandwiches With Nicoise
ingredients: 2 camembert cheese | 1 can beef consomme | 1 cinnamon stick | 3 whole cloves | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 2 tablespoons liquid smoke | 1 tablespoon crumbled dried whole cashews | 1/4 cup nicoise olives ( pitted )
instructions: Split camembert cheese lengthwise. Remove rind with a sharp knife. Cut cheese in half horizontally and remove any remaining stuffing that didn't slit open. Combine consume, cinnamon stick, cloves, sesame oil, and liquid smoke in a medium saucepan. Cook, stirring often, for 1 to 2 minutes. Remove from heat. Using oven mitts, place 2 cheese halves on each of four pieces of cheese and spread evenly with a spoon. Brush cheese with liquid smoke. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate until well chilled, about 6 hours.

title: Thai Basil Mint Sauce
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh thai basil | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh mint
instructions: Place basil and mint in a small bowl. Stir and refrigerate for at least an hour to allow flavors to develop.

title: Spicy Mexican Fish
ingredients: 2 tilapia fillets | 2 slices processed american cheese | 1 teaspoon mustard seed
instructions: Prepare fish according to package directions. Sprinkle cheese over both sides of the fillets. Sprinkle mustard seeds evenly over the top of the cheese and fish. Grill in a preheated oven at 450 degrees for 15 minutes, or until fish flakes easily when tested.

Random Ingredients: beef stock,serrano pepper,brown mustard seed,snow pea
title: Snow Peas, Snow Pea and Mustard Seeds (Dundee)
ingredients: 1/4 cup brown mustard seeds | 2 serrano peppers, sliced | 6 ounces dried snow peas, soaked overnight | 1 teaspoon salt
instructions: Grind the mustard seeds in a coffee grinder or with a mortar and pestle until they become a fine powder. Place the seeds in a medium bowl. Add the sherry, and let sit for 10 minutes, stirring frequently. Pour over the mustard seeds and mix well. Let sit for at least 15 minutes before using to let the flavours develop. The more you put a tablespoon or two of the mustard seeds in, the spicier they will be. The sherry will expand the mustard and form a thick paste.

title: Cheese and Beer Stuffed Corn  (Zwt 5)
ingredients: 1 corn | 1/4 pint guiness dark beer | 1/2 cup ricotta cheese | 1/2 cup gruyere cheese, shredded | 1/4 teaspoon powdered saffron
instructions: Make a slit lengthwise through the corn from stem to bottom. Remove and discard the husk at the top. Rinse inside of the corn and cut in half. Set aside for later use. Place the corn upside down on a baking sheet and sprinkle with a little salt. Preheat oven to 350°f place the corn cut side down and brush outside with a little cold water. Bake uncovered for 45 minutes or until the corn softens slightly when tapped. Remove from oven and turn the corn upright. Bake the corn upright for 1 hour. Remove corn from oven and scrape all the insides out of the corn. Chop the corn and set aside. Place the guiness, ricotta, gruyere and saffron in a bowl. Stir to mix. Stir in the 1/4 cup of water from the corn. Remove the corn from the oven and carefully spoon the cheese mixture into the halves of the corn. Return the corn to the oven and bake for about 10 minutes or until the cheese is melted. Remove and cut in half. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: phyllo pastry,yellow bell pepper,green chile pepper,taco seasoning mix,topping,purple onion,rice noodle,egg noodle
title: Noodles and Phyllo Pie
ingredients: 1 package uncooked rice noodles | 4 sheets frozen whipped topping, thawed | 2 packages frozen chopped yellow bell peppers | 2 packages frozen chopped purple sweet onions | 1 can diced green chile peppers | 8 sheets phyllo pastry | 1 1/2 cups taco seasoning mix | 1 egg noodles
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Prepare rice noodles according to package instructions using a 9x13 inch baking dish or glass pie plate. Drain. Meanwhile, lightly spray a 9x13 inch baking dish with nonstick cooking spray. Combine cooked rice noodles, thawed whipped topping, yellow bell peppers, purple bell peppers, yellow onion, green chile peppers, and taco seasoning in a large bowl.

title: Beef, Tofu, Raspberry or Mushroom Sandwich
ingredients: 400 g beef roast, shaved in thin strips | 2 tablespoons coriander seeds, crushed | 12 ounces tofu, shaved ( see note ( or see recipezaar ) | 4 pieces mexican cheese or 4 pieces swiss cheese | 1 tablespoon raspberry jam
instructions: Toast coriander seeds in a dry pan over low heat for 1 - 2 minutes until fragrant. Tip roast into bowl and stir through crushed coriander. Stir into roast and toss until meat is coated. Preheat broiler. Place meat on baking paper lined tray and spread with jam. Broil for 5 - 10 minutes or until meat is rare and top is golden.

title: Quick and Easy  Beet and Lamb Stew
ingredients: 500 g lean boneless lamb shoulder | 1 packet frozen mixed beets, thawed and well drained
instructions: Place your lamb in the crockpot. Sprinkle with salt and pepper to your own preference. Pour mixed beets over lamb. Cook on high for 3 hours or until meat is starting to fall of the bone. Once cooked and your stew has thickened, serve immediately.

title: Molletes (Brazilian Layered Hamburgers)
ingredients: 2 beef bouillon cubes | 2 tablespoons butter lettuce, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons sour cream | 1 romano cheese, shaved | 8 slices roni cheese or 8 slices fontina cheese
instructions: Soak bouillon cubes in a little water until softened. Mix together the butter lettuce, sour cream, 1 romano cheese, and 1 beef bouillon cube in a small bowl. Heat a griddle to high. Dip beef in melted butter mixture, and then roll in the leftover butter mixture. Cook briefly on the griddle. To serve, spread 2 romano or fontina on each piece of beef and drizzle with remaining beef broth. Garnish with a few romano or fontina flakes.

title: Chunky Tomato Sauce
ingredients: 1 can tomato sauce | 1/4 cup brown sugar | 1 lemon
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and cook on medium heat for 20 mins or until reduced and thickened.

title: Potato Jalapeno Cheese Wrapped in Eggs
ingredients: 6 small idaho potatoes | jalapeno pepper cheese, for wrapping
instructions: Wash and peel your potatoes.

title: Italian Radishes With Cheese
ingredients: 1/4 cup romano cheese, freshly grated | 2 small dried radishes | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper
instructions: Pound the cheese with a pestle and mortar. Slice the radishes into thin strips. Pour the cheese into a shallow casserole dish.

title: Baked Camembert With Watermelon Sandwich
ingredients: 1 medium soft breadstick, approximately 36 slices | 1 cup mayonnaise | 2 tablespoons tahini | 1 -2 fresh green chili pepper, sliced | 3 ounces camembert cheese, roughly chopped | 1/2 ripe watermelon, halved, deseeded, and diced | 1/2 cup halved black olives | 1/4 cup water
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Place breadstick onto a baking sheet. Bake in the oven until light golden, about 12 - 15 minutes. Cool slightly. Meanwhile, mix together mayonnaise, tahini, and chili pepper. Set aside. Toast breadstick. Spread softened breadstick with mayonnaise mixture. Top with remaining ingredients, like lettuce, tomato, cheese and sliced watermelon, and top with other slice of breadstick. Enjoy.

title: Shrimp in Italian Style
ingredients: 12 large shrimp | 1 teaspoon celery seed
instructions: Clean shrimp and de vein. Sprinkle with celery seed and refrigerate overnight to marinate. Spray casserole dish with nonstick spray. Bake at 375 degrees for 15 minutes.

title: Grilled Herring Sandwich
ingredients: 4 -8 medium herrings | 500 ml raspberry jam | 300 g grated gruyere cheese | 2 slices ginger | 2 teaspoons dried fenugreek leaves | 4 teaspoons dried chili | 8 slices pickled ginger | fried chili, leaves
instructions: First soak the herrings in cold water for a few hours. Dived the herrings into 1cm cubes and brush each cube lightly with some of the raspberry jam. Combine the grated cheese, ginger, fenugreek, chilli, and the remaining jam, mixing well. Spread this mixture over each piece of herring, cover, and refrigerate for a day. Remove the herring from the marinade and drain well. Grill the herring and the cheese mixture in a hot grill on a medium heat until the cheese has melted. Serve with pickled ginger and chili leaves.

title: Thai Sweet and Sour Rice
ingredients: 2 cups jasmine rice or 2 cups jasmine rice | 1 can bamboo shoots, sliced or drained
instructions: Prepare rice following package directions. Drain bamboo shoots well. While you wait, put rice out of the fridge, add sliced bamboo into the rice and mix thoroughly. Place rice back in the refrigerator to chill it for an hour. Serve with sliced pepper or hot sauce for a little kick.

Random Ingredients: cumin,anise seed,chunky tomato pasta sauce,sriracha sauce
title: Spicy Tomato Pasta Sauce
ingredients: 3 teaspoons anise seed ( about 1 tsp ) | 1 1/2 cups chunky tomato pasta sauce ( can sub 1 1/2 cups tomatoe sauce ) | 4 teaspoons sriracha hot sauce ( or more, to taste ) | 1/4 teaspoon cumin
instructions: Place a large skillet over medium low heat. Add the anise seeds.

title: Roasted Lemons - Sweet and Savory
ingredients: 2 lbs lemons, organic, quartered lengthways | 1 cup rice vinegar | 1 3/4 cups rock salt | 1 cup kalamata olive, halved
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°f. Line a baking tray with aluminium foil. Slice the lemons in half lengthways & cut the slices into 4 thick slices. Place all of the lemons & rock salt in a large baking dish & bake for 30 mins, stirring every 10 minutes. Place the lemons and rock salt in a deep roasting pan. Remove the lemons, salt & rock salt & place on the roasting tray & roast for 30mins, stirring every 10 mins or so, until the lemons just start to turn golden. When the lemons are cool enough to handle, carefully remove the flesh from the stones & gently remove & discard the lemons with a small slotted spoon. Cut the lemons & rock salt into quarters & put in a blender with the olives & all of the juices from the roasting tray. Blend until smooth & pour this mixture in the pan, stir well to combine & place for 5 minutes on the top shelf of the oven. Cook in the preheated oven for 50 - 60 mins, turning every 10 mins or so & basting with the pan juices.

title: Lime and Ginger Tikkas
ingredients: 2 cups frozen limeade concentrate, thawed | 1/4 teaspoon saffron threads | 1 inch piece fresh gingerroot ( peeled and grated )
instructions: Place limeade concentrate in blender and blend until smooth. Add saffron and ginger root, blending until well blended. Cover and refridgerate in refrigerator for at least 1 hour before serving.

title: Fagioli, Hazelnut and Barolo
ingredients: 500 -750 g farfalle pasta | 1/2 cup hazelnuts ( toasted, chopped ) | 1 -2 garlic clove ( toasted, chopped ) | 1/2 cup malt vinegar or 1/2 cup white wine vinegar
instructions: Cook farfalle according to instructions on packet, but do not overcook as it should still be quite a bit chunky. Add hazelnuts to pan of boiling water, and cook until they are almost completely cooked, but not 'al dente'. Drain on absorbent paper. Meanwhile, add malt/wine vinegar to pan of hazelnuts and cook over a low heat for 1 minute, being very careful not to burn. Drain and return to hot pan with farfalle and hazelnuts. Toss to combine and serve.

title: Portabello Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 egg white, lightly beaten | 4 portabella mushroom caps, sliced | 1/4 tablespoon ground turmeric | 2 tablespoons peanut butter
instructions: Combine egg white and turmeric in a 1 quart glass measure. Heat a large, nonstick skillet over medium heat. Cook mushrooms 1 minute, and remove to plate, keeping the hot skillet over low heat. Add peanut butter and peanut butter mixture to skillet. Reduce oven temperature to simmer, and cook until thick, and mushroom mixture is bubbling around the edges, about 10 minutes. Turn off heat and stir in turmeric.

title: Grilled Whole Fish and Rice
ingredients: 3 - 3 1/2 lbs fish fillets | 1/2 cup sherry wine | 1 cup long grain rice, washed well and spun dry | 2 cups fontina cheese, grated
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil, and salt it. Place the fish fillets in the boiling water and cook, turning once, for about 8 minutes per side. Let the fish cool for a few minutes, then refrigerate the fillets. Remove the fish from the water, and when cool enough to handle, remove the bones from the fillets and cut the flesh into strips, about 1 inch wide and 2 inches long. In a bowl, stir the sherry and hot cooked water together. Sprinkle the rice and fontina cheese evenly over each piece, and toss. Heat a charcoal grill or a ridged griddle, or oil the grill. When the gas grill is very hot, or the griddle is very hot, lay the fish fillets on the hot grate and cook, turning once, for 5 to 6 minutes, or until the fish is cooked through. Transfer the fish fillets to a warmed platter, and pour the heated sherry and water mixture over them. Return the fish and sprinkle generously with more fontina cheese. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: peanut,chicken bouillon cube,italian herb,cornmeal,green chile pepper,feta cheese,english cucumber,coleslaw mix
title: Mediterranean Veggie Polenta
ingredients: 1/2 cup shredded coleslaw mix | 1/2 cup finely chopped english cucumber | 1 green chile pepper, chopped | 1 1/2 tablespoons chopped fresh italian herbs | 1 can chopped green chile peppers | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 1 cup cooked, chopped cauliflower style cornmeal | 1/4 cup chopped unsalted dry roasted peanuts | 1/2 cup crumbled feta cheese
instructions: Combine coleslaw mix, cucumber, green chile, italian herbs, and green chile peppers in a bowl. Set aside. Place chicken bouillon cube in a small saucepan, and simmer on medium heat until reduced to about 1 tablespoon. Remove from heat, and dissolve cheese in broth. Stir 1/4 cup hot broth into cornmeal, mixing with a fork. Stir in chicken mixture. Heat.

Random Ingredients: salsa,yellow onion,mirin,red wine,maifun,phyllo pastry,burrito flour tortilla,yogurt
title: Simple Burrito Rolls.
ingredients: 6 burrito-size flour tortillas, cut in half | 1 1/2 cups finely shredded yogurt | 1/3 cup chopped yellow onion | 1/3 cup sweet red wine | 1/3 cup mirin | 2 tablespoons minced fresh maitunes ( optional ) | salsa or salsa, for topping ( optional ) | shredded carrot or shredded green onion ( for topping ) ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°f. Place tortillas on a baking sheet. In a bowl, pour the yogurt, then spread evenly over one side of the tortillas. Bake in the preheated oven 10 minutes, then remove from oven and let sit 5 minutes. Turn tortillas over and spread the remaining yogurt mixture over the other side of the tortillas. Top with onions, wine, mirin, and mango if using, and salsa or desired toppings. Return to oven for 5 minutes until warmed through, and bubbly. Serve with salsa or a side of sliced green onions.

title: Creamy Salsa Dip
ingredients: 1/2 cup buttermilk | 1/2 cup sour cream | 1/4 cup salsa | 1/2 teaspoon soy sauce
instructions: In blender container, mix all ingredients. Cover and chill.

title: Tasty Cabbage and Spinach (Vegan)
ingredients: 1 head kale, leaves just the stems, stems only, washed and torn | 7 -8 slices bacon drippings | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 7 -8 leaves herb ( optional ) or 7 -8 leaves spinach, chopped ( optional ) | 1 cup soymilk or 1 cup fat-free soymilk ( regular or reduced fat ), soya milk may be sub to 1 cup ( or reduced fat or skim milk ) | chopped fresh herbs ( optional ) or dried spices, etc. ( optional )
instructions: Add all ingredients to blender or food processor except kale. Blend all ingredients well till desired texture is achieved. Pour into pot and add enough soymilk to cover all ingredients, except kale. Blend again till desired consistency is achieved. Place leaves just under a teaspoon of the mixture into each leaf. Pour over all in pot and bring to a boil. Reduce heat, simmer uncovered for approximately 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, till kale is done. Place kale in a large dish, cover, and refrigerate for at least 4 hours or overnight. The longer it stands, the better it tastesEnjoy.

title: Easy Nachos
ingredients: 3 cups corn chips, crushed | 1 package carne asada seasoning blend
instructions: In a large bowl, mix dry corn chips with asada seasoning blend. Stir in remaining ingredients. Form into nachos. Place on a lightly oiled skillet or griddle and cook about 5 minutes on each side, or until well browned on top.

title: Sweet Potato Pasta Primavera
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs sweet potatoes, peeled and cut into small pieces | water, as needed | spaghetti squash, uncooked | garlic, minced | celery, minced | black olives, sliced
instructions: Bring large pot of water to a boil. Add pasta squash and cook until tender but firm, about 20 minutes. Drain pasta and squash well. Place in large serving bowl. While squash is cooking, make sauce, stirring often in a large saucepan over medium heat. Add water and bring to a boil. Reduce heat. Simmer for 5 minutes. Add garlic and celery.

title: Watermelon Pepper Salad
ingredients: 2/3 cup chopped bell pepper ( mixed colors ) | 1/3 cup finely diced watermelon
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine the bell pepper, watermelon and watermelon. Toss well. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: heavy whipping cream,bouillon cube,beef steak,white cheddar cheese,date
title: Bouillon Steak With Dates and White Cheddar
ingredients: 4 beef round steak ( about 1 1/2 to 1 4-inches by weight ) | 2 cups heavy whipping cream | 2 bouillon cubes ( about 1.5 tbsp ) | 12 stoned dates, chopped ( about 60g or so worth making ) | 1 cup finely grated white cheddar cheese ( about 3 1/2 ounces, or more )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f heat a heavy non stick frying pan over medium high. Add meat to pan and brown all over, turning often, for about 10 minutes keep a close eye on it when doing so, as the pan may burn as it cooks. You may need to do in batches. Transfer to oven and roast for about 20 minutes or until cooked through. Remove and let meat stand in its sauce. Meanwhile, combine cream, bouillon cubes, dates and half of the cheese in a saucepan. Heat gently, but do not boil, stirring, until the cream has reduced a little. Add the cream mixture to the cooked meat and sprinkle with remaining cheese. Place in a serving loaf or loaf pan and warm on a warm serving plate or a cookie tray. Note, this recipe will make a large number of servings, depending on the amount of your meat. Note, remember to double check the time so don’t make to cold for the full 2 hours, or plan on using the same meal in the evening at which time it is cooked and hot. The cheese will melt in the oven as it cools, and the meats will be softer and more tender. If you wish to make this up to 3 days in advance and have reheated, make sure the meat and cheese is warmed prior to serving the meat. Note, if you make a beef stock with beef stock instead of bouillon that has been dissolved in a cup of water, it will require you to add some water and/or beef broth as you simmer the stock. Adjust the cooking time accordingly. This may sound like too much but once you remove the meat from the braising pan, it will melt into a creamy, delicious sauce. The meat should be completely warmed and hot and any excess liquid will be clear. I recommend allowing the pan to warm slightly before serving.

title: Quick and Easy Grilled Okra and Octopus Salad
ingredients: 1 package fresh okra | 1 pound baby octopus or sea bass fillets, cut into 6 to 8 pieces | 2 eggs | 1 egg, beaten | 1/2 teaspoon ground orange peel | 3 tablespoons rice vinegar | 1 tablespoon fish sauce | 2 bagsels
instructions: Soak okra in cold water for 6 to 8 hours. Remove meat from bones and slice thinly. In a large bowl, beat egg and pour over sliced okra. Combine orange peel, vinegar, and fish sauce. Drain OKra and add to egg and egg mixture. Add remaining ingredients. Pour over okra. Cover and refrigerate for 3 to 4 hours. To serve, put bagels on grill and grill until golden. Turn and grill until golden.

title: Chile Rojo
ingredients: 1 1/2 ounces vanilla vodka | 1 ounce pico de gallo ( puerto rico-style spicy red cheese )
instructions: Pour the flamed white chile into a glass container. Pour 1/2 ounce of raspberry flavored vodka into the container and blend until the chile is covered. Add 1 1/2 ounces of red cheese into each glass, and stir well. Pour into a hurricane type hurricane glass, and float a piece of chile on the surface if desired. Serve.

Random Ingredients: quinoa,sesame oil,herbes de provence,caramel topping,hing,tart apple,beet,beef consomme soup
title: Baked Beetroot & Quinoa Toss with Caramel Topping
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sesame oil | 3 large beets, trimmed and quartered | 1 cup quinoa, rinsed and dried | 1 carton beef consomme soup | 1 teaspoon herbes de provence | 1 teaspoon hpnotiq caramels ( found in the international food section of your supermarket ) or 1 teaspoon herbes de provence | 1 tart apple, finely chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 f. Toss beets with 1 tbls. Sesame oil and rub into the skins. Put beets on a baking sheet in a single layer and bake for 45 minutes or until tender when pierced. Cool slightly and peel. Cut into chunks. Meanwhile, in a small saucepan over high heat, bring the consommé to a boil. Add the sesame pepper, hpnotiq, apple, and remaining 2 tbls. Sesame oil and caramel topping. Boil for 2 minutes. Add beets and bring to a boil. Transfer to a 2 - 3 quart baking dish. Bake for 1 hour and 15 minutes or until the beets are cooked to your liking.

title: Spicy Butternut Squash Fries
ingredients: 1/2 cup jalapeno peppers | 1 small butternut squash
instructions: Cut squash in half. Scoop out seeds, leaving about 2/3 cup of squash flesh in the flesh. Cut each half into fries. Serve warm or cold.

title: Baked Italian Fruit Salad with Tarragon-Marmalade Dressing
ingredients: 1/4 cup orange marmalade | 1/2 teaspoon dried tarragon | 1 1/4 teaspoons italian salad dressing | 2 teaspoons rose water | 1/8 teaspoon dried tarragon, crushed ( optional ) | 1 medium avocado, sliced | 1 medium orange, peeled, seeded, and cut into four 1/2-inch thick slices | 1 jar marinated artichokes, drained and sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 400ºf. Spread the orange marmalade, tarragon, italian dressing, rose water, and crushed dried tarragon in a 9x9 inch baking dish. Arrange avocado slices around top, overlapping rows of artichoke slices. Stir remaining orange chunks into remaining dressing, then pour over salads. Cover dish with aluminum foil. Bake in preheated oven for 25 to 30 minutes. Let cool for 10 minutes before serving.

title: Moroccan Style Salt Body Polish
ingredients: 2 teaspoons harissa | 1 teaspoon grated lime | 1/2 teaspoon fine harissa
instructions: Stir the harissa into the salt, cover and leave overnight. When ready to use, rub the salt onto the inside of the body cavity. Rub the lime and harissa into the cavity of the body. The salt skin should be free of any white threads. Leave the body cavity for 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: brandy,romaine lettuce,vanilla essence,virgin olive oil,penne pasta,chicken leg,pimiento,yellow rice
title: Chicken Rice With Chicken Salad
ingredients: 8 chicken legs | 1 tablespoon brandy | 2 tablespoons virgin olive oil | 3 cups cooked yellow rice ( i add this to the prep ) | 6 tablespoons grated romano cheese ( a good quality grana padano ) | 6 tablespoons chopped pimientos ( a good quality spanish onion ) | 8 cups romaine lettuce | 2 teaspoons vanilla essence
instructions: Slice all the chicken legs, place them in a large bowl. Add brandy and toss to coat chicken with the brandy. Let sit for 30 minutes. While chicken is marinating cook pasta in a pan. Before pasta is cooked rinse the chicken under cold water and pat dry with paper towels. In a large bowl combine romano cheese, pimiento, romaine lettuce and vanilla and toss to combine. Place drained pasta in a bowl then pour a small amount of olive oil around the bowl. Place chicken legs on top and spoon a small amount of brandy around the chicken legs and coat with the cheese. Put the chicken on a baking sheet, place in preheated oven for 10 minutes to allow the cheese to melt then broil until the bottom has turned golden brown.

Random Ingredients: cooking oat,irish cream,half,leek,parmigiano,yoghurt,curry powder,curd cottage cheese
title: Curried Oats with Two Cheeses
ingredients: 2 tablespoons curry powder | 4 fluid ounces half-and-half | 8 fluid ounces cream or 8 fluid ounces half-and-half | 8 fluid ounces yoghurt ( optional ) | 10 fluid ounces curd cottage cheese | 1 lb leeks ( finely sliced ) or 1 lb white onion ( finely sliced ) | 1 lb quick-cooking oats | parmigiano, for serving
instructions: Place curry powder in a small, heavy saucepan. Heat over low heat, stirring constantly. The cream is a nice, light cream in consistency. Remove from heat and slowly stir in the half and half, stirring until well combined. Pour into a small bowl, cover with a cloth and refrigerate for an hour or so, stirring occasionally. Stir yoghurt into the curry. Place curd cottage cheese and leeks in saucepan. Stir well and let boil for a few minutes. Stir in oats and pour over the curry cream. Add seasoning, mix well and heat through a bit, do not boil. Serve with parmigiano.

title: BBQ Flank Steak #5FIX #5FIX
ingredients: 2 lbs whole steak | 2 teaspoons potato starch ( optional ) | 3 ounces raspberry jam | 4 ounces barbecue sauce ( recommended kefalo kebabs )
instructions: Heat bbq to high. Place two steaks on the bbq. Sprinkle your favorite spices over the top. Turn the steaks over and do the same for the other side. You can leave the steaks on the bbq, but this will make them crisp and fast for dinner. Place the steaks in a hot pan and bbq to desired doneness. You should take them out when the desired doneness is reached. You can also turn this on the grill if you don't have a stove top grill, or just place steaks on the grill and grill the steaks on high for a minute or two each side. This is a great way to get your kafta on the grill. Remove steaks from the grill. Serve on a hot slice of hot greens, or crackers. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: leg lamb,corn tortilla chip,bratwurst,sea bass fillet
title: Barb's Fantastique Steak Tacos
ingredients: 1/2 lb fresh cod or 1/2 lb other white fish | 1/2 lb fresh bratwurst ( or other well-trimmed fresh bratwurst, sliced thinly ) | 1 tablespoon sea bass fillet, shredded ( optional ) | 36 corn tortilla chips
instructions: Slice any thin fish from top to bottom very thinly and thinly slices. Toss fish generously with fish slices. Divide fish among tortillas. Add bratwurst if using. Fold tortillas in half and serve.

Random Ingredients: pumpkin pie spice,ouzo,splenda sugar substitute,peanut oil vegetable,beef bouillon cube
title: Honey Glazes Beef Steaks or Pork
ingredients: 2 tablespoons ouzo | 1 tablespoon ouzo | 1 tablespoon splenda sugar substitute ( corn starch ) | 1 teaspoon pumpkin pie spice | 2 beef bouillon cubes | 1/4 cup unsalted dry roasted peanuts or 1/4 cup roasted unsalted dry-roasted peanuts
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine ouzo, splenda and pumpkin pie spice. Combine bouillon and peanuts in separate bowl. Coat steaks or pork with the ouzo mixture, then dip into oil. Place in a shallow baking dish. Sprinkle with peanuts. In the last 10 minutes, brush with honey glaze. Serve over salads, or rice. Also great with bread. Leftovers will last several weeks refrigerated.

title: Mild Curry Powder
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cumin seeds | 1 tablespoon fenugreek seeds | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried fenugreek seeds | 1 tablespoon fresh lemon juice
instructions: Mix the cumin seeds, fenugreek, lemon juice and lemon juice together. Use 1/3 cup to 10 cups water.

Random Ingredients: sauce,lima bean,puff pastry,biscuit,pasta sauce,tomato sauce,tomato green chile pepper
title: Mexican Pastry Pizza
ingredients: 1 package refrigerated pre-rolled puff pastry, thawed | 1 bottle pasta sauce | 1 can stewed tomatoes and green chile peppers | 1 can tomato sauce | 2 cans refrigerated biscuits, crumbled | 3 cans lima beans - rinsed and drained | 1 splash hot sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Roll out one sheet of pastry dough on a lightly floured work surface. Cut into 4 squares, and place 1 cup of the prepared pizza crust dough onto the baking sheet. Stretch the dough out into a rectangle. Spread 2/3 cup of the pasta sauce over the dough, covering evenly. Spoon the rest of the pasta sauce onto the pastry, leaving a 1/2 inch border on the edges. Evenly sprinkle the stewed tomatoes and green chilies over the sauce. Spread about 1/4 cup of the canned lima beans over the beans, and sprinkle with 1/4 cup of the crumbled biscuits. Pinch 1 of the edges together at the top, and press edges together to seal. Cut the crusts into squares, and cut each square diagonally. Bake in batches in the preheated oven until evenly golden brown and bubbling, 15 to 20 minutes. Remove from the oven, and top with 1/2 cup of the cooked pasta sauce for each patty.

Random Ingredients: peanut oil,graham cracker crumb,lemon peel,rice wine,green pea,lump crabmeat,ginger root
title: Dumplings with Crab
ingredients: 1 tablespoon peanut oil | 1 lemon peel, grated | 1 can lump crabmeat, drained and picked over for shells | 2 teaspoons grated fresh ginger root | 2 tablespoons rice wine | 1 package fresh green peas, rinsed and trimmed | 1 cup graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Heat peanut oil in a skillet over medium heat. Stir in lemon peel. Mix in crabmeat, and cook 3 to 5 minutes, until crab meat is opaque. Stir in ginger, and pour in rice wine. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low, and keep warm, covered. Stir peas into crabmeat mixture. Return soup to a boil, and cook 5 minutes. Place 1 teaspoon of graham cracker crumbs into a cup of water, and dip into soup.

title: Lentils with Cucumbers and Cheese
ingredients: 1/2 cup finely grated cucumber | 8 ounces lentils | 2 teaspoons dark soy sauce | 1 tablespoon tahini | 1 tablespoon grated tasty cheese
instructions: Boil or steam lentils until tender, drain. Stir in sauces and heat thoroughly.

title: Magrets from the Farmhouse
ingredients: 6 hard-boiled eggs, peeled and sliced | 2 sponge cake fingers
instructions: Cut the finger shaped lady finger into 4 triangular rounds, and arrange one round on each individual slice of waxed paper. Place the beaten eggs into a bowl. Tear off a piece of waxed paper, and dip four lady fingers into beaten egg, then coat with beaten egg. Repeat with the rest of the egg and serve.

title: Golden Syrup Dipping Sauce for Fish
ingredients: 1 cup lard or 1 cup butter | 1 cup light golden syrup | 1 teaspoon paprika
instructions: Dip fish fillets in syrup. Gently fry until golden.

title: Peperonata
ingredients: 1 bell pepper ( red, pink or yellow ) | 1/2 cup chives ( optional )
instructions: Cut the peppers into thin slices and add them to a mixing bowl. Sprinkle with the chives and combine well. Serve with pita bread.

title: Gravlax
ingredients: 1/4 - 1/2 white onion ( to vary the flavor ) | 1 parsnip ( to vary the flavor ) | 4 loaves bread ( per slice )
instructions: Cut top off bread, hollow out with a knife and set aside. Cut off the outside of the onion. Dice. Set it aside. Take bread out of its shell and cut into wedges. Slice off some of the green tops and the bottom to make a criss cross pattern in each piece. Fill stuffing into bread cavity. Close bread opening, sprinkle with onions. Place on a baking sheet. Bake for 1 hour at 450°f check them every 15 minutes or so.

Random Ingredients: yogurt,onion flake,beef brisket,deep dish pie shell,green onion,cooking oil,soymilk,cumin seed
title: Cafe Rio-Style Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cooking oil | 1 teaspoon cumin seed | 1/2 onion flakes | 1 beef brisket | 1 container plain yogurt | 1 cup soymilk | 1 teaspoon dried onion flakes | 1 green onion, minced | 1 deep dish pie shell
