instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Heat the cooking oil in a large skillet over medium high heat. Sprinkle in the cumin seed, and cook and stir until fragrant, about 1 minute. Brown the brisket on all sides, then remove it to a plate. Add the onion flakes and cook and stir until fragrant, 30 seconds to 1 minute. Add the beef to the onions in the skillet, and cook and stir until no longer pink. If it begins to burn, stir in a little more soymilk. Pour the yogurt into the skillet, and add the onion flakes, green onions, and a splash of soy milk. Stir until well mixed. Arrange the brisket on the bottom half of the pie shell, and top with the yogurt sauce evenly over top. Bake for 30 minutes in the preheated oven, until the filling is set and lightly browned.

title: Irish Corned Beef and Potatoes
ingredients: 2 lbs extra lean ground beef | 1 lb red potatoes | 2 lbs mixed dark dried fruit, chopped | 1/2 cup golden raisin
instructions: Brown hamburger over medium heat, breaking into small pieces. Drain. Add potatoes, fruit, raisins and remaining ingredients. Put into a sprayed 13x9 pan with a tight lid. Bake at 350 degrees for 45 minutes.

title: Easy Scallops
ingredients: 10 -12 scallops | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar
instructions: Rinse scallops under cold water. Cut each scallop in half lengthwise and then crosswise. Place on baking sheet. Drizzle over 2 tablespoons vinegar and season with salt and pepper to taste. Mix well and allow scallops to marinate at least 30 minutes at room temperature before serving. Note, if marinating the scallops, you may refrigerate them for up to 2 days, although the longer they marinate, the better the flavor gets.

Random Ingredients: cream tartar,beef chuck roast,date,pecorino romano cheese,wine,vegetable
title: Shredded Beef in a Pot
ingredients: 8 ounces cooked vegetables, drained ( fresh or frozen ) | 8 ounces low-alcohol sherry wine or 8 ounces balsamic vinegar | 2 -3 lbs boneless beef chuck roast, trimmed | 1 cup grated pecorino romano cheese | 1 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1/2 - 2/3 cup dry hot beef broth
instructions: For the vegetables, cook vegetables according to package directions. Remove and rinse the beef, being careful not to let them dry out. Add the drained meat to the pot with the remaining ingredients and simmer, covered, about 2 hours or until tender. Ladle into bowls, top with parmesan shavings and serve.

Random Ingredients: mirin,lard,chili pepper flake,white bread,red wine vinegar,egg white,coriander seed
title: Sweet Chilli Paste
ingredients: 2 lbs firm white bread, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 egg white, beaten | 1 1/2 cups grated fresh coriander seeds | 2 1/2 inches fresh chili peppers, chopped | 2 tablespoons mirin | 1 cup red wine vinegar | 1/3 cup lard
instructions: Place bread cubes in a bowl and pour cold water over them. Toss to mix. Place in the fridge for 20 minutes to moisten. Mix together egg white, corriander and chillies. Set aside. Place flour in a wide, shallow bowl. Add the sherry vinegar and lard. Mix until the mixture is smooth. Add bread mixture and egg white mixture to the flour. Work by hand until well blended. Place on a clean surface and knead with hands. Place in an airtight container or in your dehydrator for 3 to 5 hours. Dived the paste into 20 portions and use for soups, salads, cakes or as an accompaniment for meat, fish or vegetables.

Random Ingredients: vegetable,picante sauce,red thai chili pepper,wheat bread crumb
title: Spicy Fried Green Veggies
ingredients: 2 large red thai red chili peppers, seeded, peeled and minced | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil or 2 tablespoons cooking fat | 3 cloves roasted mixed vegetables | 1/2 cup picante sauce | 1 1/2 cups dry whole wheat bread crumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f or grill to medium high. Add chili peppers, oil and 3 cloves roasted veg. Toasted bread crumbs to a shallow bowl. Set aside. Dredge vegetables in dry breadcrumbs. Place mixture on a nonstick cookie sheet. Bake until crisp and nicely browned, about 15 to 20 minutes. Serve with picante sauce and desired garnishes.

Random Ingredients: brown rice flour,square,pizza sauce,asafoetida powder,cake flour,chili,baby spinach
title: Quick, Simple and Healthy Veggie Flatbreads
ingredients: 1 lb small patty dough | 100 g pizza sauce ( i use kraft pizza sauce ) | 1/2 teaspoon asafoetida powder ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon brown rice flour | 1/4 cup baby spinach | 1 teaspoon chili | 1 teaspoon square cake flour
instructions: Make a hole in the center of your patty dough and press to form a large flat or round cookie cutter. Place about a teaspoon of filling in the hole and sprinkle with a little more flour. Add a second patty dough and press with your fingers to form the dough. Repeat with the second patty dough and filling. Lightly cover and allow to rest on a clean surface for 20 minutes. Heat a pan to medium and add some vegetable oil, add the patty dough and fry for 3 to 4 minutes on each side until they are golden brown. Serve warm or cold.

title: Chicken Wings (Serves Many)
ingredients: 12 chicken wings | 12 slices prosciutto | 1/4 lb white bread, unsalted | 10 anchovy fillets, drained | 10 teaspoons rose water ( or 2 t. plain rose wine or cream ) | 1 tablespoon white ( optional )
instructions: Wash chicken wings under cold water.

title: Prosciutto Wraps
ingredients: 2 flour tortillas | 1/2 cup mango chutney | 4 slices prosciutto | 1 sliced deli-style ham ( optional )
instructions: Spread one side of the tortillas with chutney, then top with 1 slice of ham, and 1/2 slice of mango chutney. Roll up. Repeat with remaining tortillas, ham, and mango chutney. Cut each roll into 4 long strips.

Random Ingredients: canola oil,white sugar,coriander powder,honey,sesame seed oil,palm sugar,pimiento,extra virgin olive oil
title: Sweet (Seed, not Dios) Dipping Sauce for Lamb or Pork
ingredients: 1 tablespoon sesame seed oil | 3 tablespoons canola oil | 1/2 cup canola oil | 1 1/2 tablespoons dark sweet unsalted butter or 1 1/2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 3 tablespoons honey | 2 tablespoons palm sugar | 1 tablespoon coriander powder | 2 tablespoons ground pimentos | 1 teaspoon white sugar
instructions: In a small saucepan, add sesame seed oil and canola oil and simmer over medium heat until oil is reduced by about one half. While oil is cooling, prepare the dijon.

title: Mango Queso Dip
ingredients: 1/2 cup diced mango | 1/2 cup shredded sharp cheddar cheese
instructions: Preheat your oven to 400 degrees. Spread the mango evenly on a large piece of aluminum foil. Sprinkle with the cheddar cheese. Place onto your favorite pizza buns. Place under your oven for a few minutes until the cheese is melted and starting to brown on the edges. Let cool, cut into desired serving size servings.

Random Ingredients: mustard seed,banana,vanilla essence,beef brisket,grand marnier,egg yolk,walnut
title: Steaks Au Poivre (French-Canadian Beef Breakfast Bites)
ingredients: 2 cups finely chopped ripe bananas | 2 tablespoons minced walnuts | 2 tablespoons chopped walnuts ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons mustard seeds or 2 tablespoons sesame seeds ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon grand marnier or 1 tablespoon orange juice | 2 tablespoons grand marnier or 2 tablespoons orange juice | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla essence ( optional ) | 6 beef brisket
instructions: Stir together banana, walnut nuts and mustard seeds. Combine gran marnier and 1/2 cup water in a small heavy saucepan. Heat over low heat until boiling and simmer for 2 minutes or until thick. Remove from water and stir in vanilla. Place brisket in slow cooker, fat side up. Pour hot gran marnier mixture over brisket. Cover and cook on low 7 - 8 hours, or until tender. Place brisket in a cutting board and cut into thin slices. Transfer to plate. Cover with foil. Boil remaining liquid in crockpot on high for 2 minutes. Pour into saucepan. Bring to a boil. Boil until thickened.

title: Orange Onion Relish
ingredients: 1 can frozen orange juice concentrate, thawed
instructions: Mash orange juice concentrate with a fork until thick and creamy.

Random Ingredients: ladyfinger,salt black pepper,fennel bulb,lasagna noodle,corn oil,prosciutto
title: Lidia's Lasagna
ingredients: 12 lasagna noodles | 2 tablespoons corn oil | 1 small fennel bulb, chopped | 3 slices prosciutto | 1/2 cup chopped fennel leaves, or to taste | salt and ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, stir in the lasagna noodles, and return to a boil. Cook the noodles uncovered, stirring occasionally, until cooked through but still firm to the bite, about 11 minutes. Drain well in a colander set in the sink. Coat a large skillet with corn oil. Gently pan fry the fennel until just beginning to brown, about 5 minutes. Mix in the prosciutto and fennel fronds. Cook until the prosciutto starts to crisp over the edges, about 1 minute. Season with salt and pepper. Set aside to cool completely. Place 1/2 cup of the cooled fennel frank sauce in a pasta bowl. Drain the lasagna noodles. Place a layer of the noodles in the bottom of a large casserole dish, sprinkling a little of the fennel frank sauce over the noodles. Continue layering, sprinkling fennel frank cheese sauce just until ingredients are used. Sprinkle a little more fennel frank sauce over fennel franks, and top with 1/2 cup of sliced fennel leaves. Repeat layers, ending with a layer of fennel frank sauce and crumbled cheese on the top. Cover casserole with a lid, place in a water bath, and and bake in preheated oven until casserole is bubbling and the top is beginning to brown, about 1 hour.

title: The Real Thing!
ingredients: 4 -6 slices prosciutto di parma | 1 yellow squash | 2 cans beef consomme
instructions: Cut the rind off your squash. Slice the peel off so it can be easily cut in half. Cut the peel in half again. Cut the peels in half again. Pre heat the oven to 325°f. Take a square of aluminum baking sheet. Place the roasting pan on top of the baking sheets and place in the oven when they get hot, remove foil and the tray of peel from the peppers. Put your beef consumme over the peppers and put the oven on for 45 minutes or whatever you like, turning the heat on to low and allow it to simmer all day. If you want to eat it the day after, cook it right before the next day. It will be very hot, so you have a mess on your stove. Let it cool down, remove skin and discard before serving. This should last 3 - 4 weeks as it can be frozen in sealed containers.

title: CURRIED CURRY WITH BEATBON & GRATIN
ingredients: 1/4 cup grated gruyere or 1/4 cup emmenthaler cheese | 1 tablespoon good rice vinegar | 1 teaspoon beef base or 1 teaspoon instant beef bouillon cube | 2 ounces cooked crabmeat | 1 fresh small peach, thinly sliced | garlic clove, crushed | 1 teaspoon curry | 1 teaspoon caraway seed
instructions: Combine all ingredients except the cheese and serve on a platter with a sprinkling of chopped green onion tops.

title: Aeblegrod -- Dutch Corned Cream
ingredients: 1/2 cup corn oil ( for frying ) | 1/2 teaspoon cream of tartar ( heaping, to taste ) | 2 - 3 1/2 cups chicken stock ( vegetable or chicken bouillon may be substituted ) or 2 -3 1/2 cups vegetarian chicken stock ( vegetable or chicken bouillon may be substituted )
instructions: Heat the corn oil to 350° and in a 2 quart saucepan, mix the cream of tartar with a dash of salt and add the cream of tartar and vegetable or chicken stock. Bring to a boil and reduce the heat to half. Slowly add the corn oil.

Random Ingredients: corn tortilla,green pepper,kidney bean,red curry paste,head cauliflower,hoisin sauce,chili oil,sea salt
title: Capsicum Salad
ingredients: 2 corn tortillas, torn into 1/4 inch pieces | 1 head cauliflower, chopped ( about 2 cups ) | 1/2 green pepper, chopped | 1 can kidney beans, rinsed and drained | 2 tablespoons red curry paste | 1 tablespoon chili oil | 3 tablespoons hoisin sauce | 1 teaspoon sea salt
instructions: Place tortillas on work surface lightly sprayed with cooking spray. Spray tops of tortillas with cooking spray. Sprinkle with salt. Arrange cauliflower on a well buttered baking dish. Sprinkle with onion and green pepper. Combine beans and curry paste and add to food processor. Pulse until mixture resembles coarse meal. Combine chili oil and hoisin sauce in small bowl. Pour over vegetables. Toss to coat.

Random Ingredients: limeade concentrate,ginger garlic paste,brown sugar,kosher salt,tea
title: Ginger Ale
ingredients: 1 container frozen limeade concentrate, thawed | 3 cups strong coffee | 1/2 cup packed brown sugar | 2 tablespoons kosher salt | 1 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste, or to taste
instructions: Place the limeade concentrate, coffee, brown sugar, kosher salt, and ginger garlic paste in a large sealable plastic bag. Mix into the concentrate until well combined. Place the bag in a freezer, and freeze for an hour. Remove the concentrate from the freezer, and stir the mixture until it has been thoroughly mixed into the limeade. Serve cold.

Random Ingredients: sirloin steak,peanut oil,garlic,red wine vinegar,sausage,curd cottage cheese,red chile pepper,half
title: Prawn and Meatball Casserole
ingredients: 1 egg | 1/2 pound ground sirloin steak | 1/2 pound smoked sausage | 1 package small curd cottage cheese | 2 teaspoons garlic, chopped | 1 tablespoon red wine vinegar | 1 jar dried red chile peppers | 2 tablespoons peanut oil
instructions: Place the egg in a bowl, and set aside. Mix ground sirloin with sausage in a bowl, and form into a ball. Slice the sausage into small 2 inch cubes. Heat peanut oil in a skillet or wok over medium heat, and stir in the meatballs, and cook until browned on all sides, about 10 minutes. Remove meatballs and sausage from the skillet, and set aside. Mix cottage cheese, garlic, vinegar, and red chile peppers into the skillet until the cheese is melted. Return the meatballs and sausage back to the skillet. Cover the skillet, and cook over low heat until the cheese is melted, 2 to 3 minutes. Serve over hot cooked egg noodles.

title: Paella Style Shrimp
ingredients: 1 whole head cabbage, core removed and leaves shredded or shredded | 1/2 pound uncooked medium shrimp, peeled and deveined | 2 teaspoons monosodium glutamate | 2 cups uncooked long grain white rice
instructions: Place cabbage in a large pot, and fill with enough water to cover. Stir in shrimp, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low, and simmer until shrimp are firm, about 20 minutes. Drain, and squeeze excess water, separating heads from shrimp. Mix shrimp and cabbage in a large bowl using your hands, and set aside. Stir the monosodium glutamate into rice, and transfer to a pot, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low, cover and simmer 15 minutes. Do not allow to boil dry, just to absorb the flavor. Pour rice into a 9x13 inch pan, or divide into smaller servings. Top with shrimp mixture, and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: fennel seed,orange,self rising flour,corn muffin mix,stewing beef,kalamata olive
title: Beef 'n Corn Muffins
ingredients: 3/4 cup self-rising flour | 1/2 cup corn muffin mix | 1/2 teaspoon fennel seed | 1 cup fresh kalamata olives, chopped | 2 medium oranges, zest and juice only | 1 lb stewing beef, trimmed and cut in 1 inch cubes
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees. Lightly oil rack and then place on cookie sheet. In a medium bowl, stir together the flour, corn muffin mix and fennel seeds, then stir in the chopped olives and orange zest until well combined. Add beef and toss to coat. Spoon about 4 ounces of batter into each muffin cup and bake until golden brown, about 10 minutes.

title: Cocoa and Lime Muffins
ingredients: 1 cup self-rising cornmeal ( or masa harina cornmeal ) | 6 lime wedges, lightly crushed ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c. Lightly grease or grease 12 hole mini muffin tins or line with paper cases. Sift the cornmeal into a large bowl. Add the lime wedges, if using. Using a fork or a wooden spoon, gently stir the cornmeal into the dry ingredients until a soft, sticky dough forms. Turn out onto a lightly floured surface. Divide batter between the muffin tins, placing a few tablespoons of the batter into each hole. Bake for 12 to 15 minutes or until well risen and golden. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon,pork roast,pomegranate,ghee,soy sauce,lemon juice zest,wheat germ
title: Pomegranate Pork
ingredients: 1 large boneless pork roast, cubed | 1 large piece pomegranate, peeled and coarsely chopped ( optional ) | 3 tablespoons oil or 3 tablespoons ghee | 1/2 teaspoon chicken bouillon | 1 - 2 tablespoon low sodium soy sauce | 1 lemon, juice and zest of | 1/4 cup wheat germ ( optional )
instructions: Heat the oil with the pork in a sauce pan, on the lowest heat possible. Pour in the bouillon. Stir and let cook on medium high until most of it gets browned, about 2 - 3 minutes. If the meat is a bit dry just add a tablespoon or two of water. When everything is browned well remove all of it, saving the rest of it. Return the pork to the pan, and stir to coat well. Add the reserved juice, soy sauce, lemon zest and juice and pomegranate pods if using. The pomegranate seeds should be added right before the meat is done. Reduce the heat, cover and cook on medium low until the meat falls from the bones, stirring occasionally, about 1 hour. Check and stir occasionally to prevent burning and sticking.

Random Ingredients: chunky salsa,tomato green chilies,dark sesame oil,cucumber,vegetable oil peanut,lemon,tomato juice
title: Salsa-Tomato Salad
ingredients: 8 ounces chunky salsa ( mild, medium or hot, your choice. i like to use red ) | 1 1/2 cups tomato juice | 1 large cucumber, sliced very thin | 2 medium fresh tomatoes, sliced thin | 1/4 cup sliced cucumber | 1 -2 lemon, juice of, 1 | 1 teaspoon dark sesame oil | vegetable oil, for frying, peanut oil is a great option too
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a bowl and refrigerate at least an hour. This will keep in the refrigerator for weeks to allow the flavors to blend. Serve in a large, chilled bowl or just in individual serving bowls.

Random Ingredients: black pepper,curry leaf,apple juice,hamburger bun,date,blueberry,brown gravy mix,cake flour
title: Curried Apple and Date Burgers
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cake flour | 1 teaspoon curry leaves ( optional ) | 1/8 teaspoon black pepper | 2 teaspoons brown gravy mix | 4 slices apple pie cooked on a bbq ( thin slices ) | 8 slices cooked ham, cut into 24 pieces | 1 cup dried dates, chopped | 1/4 cup fresh blueberries or 1/4 cup frozen blueberries
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together flour, curry leaves, pepper and gravy mix. Brush the bbq with oil. To test for desired doneness, place 1 piece of apple, with a cut side uppermost, on each burger. Divide the brown gravy mixture among burger, and top with dates, blueberries and cooked ham. Close the burger and cook 1 minute on the first side, then press down with a fork.

Random Ingredients: egg white,pea,red kidney bean,sesame seed oil,hungarian paprika,maple syrup
title: Vegetarian Puff (Egg-White)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon sesame seed oil | 1 tablespoon maple syrup | 1 1/2 tablespoons hungarian paprika ( not hot, just hot enough to overpower the other flavors ) | 1 can red kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 1 1/2 cups dry peas, defrosted | 6 egg whites
instructions: Heat oil in a skillet over medium heat until very hot. Toss in the maple syrup. Stir in the paprika. Sprinkle the beans and peas overtop, and continue to stir fry. Beat egg whites until stiff. Place mixture into a small bowl. Stir a few drops of egg whites into the whites and drop them into the skillet. Cook until the puffs are set and no longer puffed. Drain on paper towels. Serve warm.

title: Mexican Corn Nachos
ingredients: 1 corn, husked | 1 bag tortilla chips
instructions: Soak husks in water for a couple of hours. Dry the chips on a paper towel and spread the chips thinly. Lay on a waxed paper lined plate. Spray with pam. Place the stack on top of a cast iron or heavy duty broiler pan. Broil the corn until the edges turn a rich golden brown, about three minutes. Using tongs, turn and place the corn nachos on a foil lined cookie sheet for 10 minutes. When the tortillas are done, spread the chips on the warm tortillas and use a spatula to toss them in the pan, coating them well. Serve immediately.

title: Mashed Potatoes II
ingredients: 1 package red potatoes | 1 cup heavy whipping cream
instructions: Place potatoes into a pot of boiling water, and cook for 15 or 20 minutes, or until tender. Drain, and place back into pot. Add cream, and mix well. Mash potatoes with potato masher, using reserved cream. If necessary, thin with some of the retained cream. The mashed potatoes should be a little chunky, because the cream will harden as it cools. Refrigerate any leftover mashed potatoes until cold.

title: Spicy Cranberry & Bacon Gravy for Two
ingredients: 2 sprigs juniper berries | 1/2 cup bacon grease | 2 -3 tablespoons oyster sauce | 1 tablespoon cranberry juice | 1 pinch nutmeg
instructions: In a small heavy saucepan or skillet, mix the cranberry juice and nutmeg and set aside. On medium heat, cook bacon until crispy. While sauce is heating up, place juniper berries and juniper into a food processor or blender and pulse until finely chopped. Add the oil and combine. When bubbling, pour in the oyster sauce. Stir to blend. When glaze begins to bubble, turn off heat. The cranberry juice mixture will have a slightly woody consistency. Add in cranberry juice. Use immediately or store in a glass jar.

title: Sour Sirloin Steak with Sultana and Ham
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless sirloin | 3 ounces sultanas | 3 ounces brown sugar | 3 tablespoons sweet sherry | 6 slices of thinly sliced smoked ham
instructions: Cut the sirloin steak into two portions, removing the fat from between the slices of meat, and then slice very thinly across the grain. Wrap sultanas around each slice of meat, ensuring each piece is completely covered as it cuts into the beef, trimming any fat remaining if necessary. Combine sugar and sherry in a small heat proof jug. Pour the sugar & sherry mixture into each piece of meat, pressing on the sultanas until well combined. Cover with cling wrap and leave to marinade for at least 3 hours or over night, turning over the meat several times. Transfer cooked sirloin steaks to a pan or barbecue grill and cook for about 10 minutes per side, or until cooked to your liking. Cut each slice of ham into 4 equal portions, and place on top of each steak piece. Serve with fresh green cabbage and vegetables.

title: Lemon Fritters
ingredients: 2 tablespoons lemon zest, grated and divided | 4 tablespoons sultanas ( toasted seeds can be used if not avalable ) | 1 teaspoon taco seasoning | 1 tablespoon rice flour
instructions: Combine the zest, 4 tbsp sultanas, taco seasoning and rice flour and mix well. Heat a very small, non stick frying pan or crepe pan.

title: Potted French Fruits
ingredients: 4 ounces mixed white and black grapes | 1 tablespoon dry white wine
instructions: Divide the grapes between 2 large soup plates, placing them close together with the juice. Sprinkle the wine over. The juice should just cover the tops of the grapes and season well with salt and pepper.

Random Ingredients: chicken stock,coconut milk,french bread,pineapple chunk,rice vinegar,swiss cheese,anchovy,tomato paste
title: Coconut Bread With Tropical Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 12 ounces french bread, loaf | 6 ounces pineapple chunks, drained and cut in half | 7 tablespoons light coconut milk | 1 1/2 tablespoons tapioca starch or 1 1/2 tablespoons cornstarch | 3 tablespoons rice vinegar | 2 tablespoons anchovies | 1/3 cup chicken stock | 8 ounces swiss cheese, shredded
instructions: Trim crusts from bread.

title: Lamb and Beans
ingredients: 1 pound boneless lamb shoulder - cut into 1 inch strips | 1 can pinto beans | 1/4 cup red wine vinegar | sour cream, for topping ( optional )
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium high heat. Brown the lamb in the skillet until a few chunks of lamb remain attached, and no traces of pink remain. Drain off any excess fat. Stir in the olives, and cook 2 minutes, or until heated through. Stir in the vinegar. Remove from heat, cover, and stand for 5 minutes before serving. Serve with sour cream if desired.

title: Peppered Ginger(Prawns)
ingredients: 2 lbs unpeeled hot pickled hot chili peppers | 1 cup minced unsroasted fresh ginger
instructions: Preheat oven 350 degrees fahrenheit. Lightly oil a shallow baking dish and place the peppers on it. Pour enough water into dish to cover the peppers. Bake 15 minutes, shaking the pan occasionally, until peppers are tender and the water has almost evaporated. Pour off water if necessary. Meanwhile, in a medium size saute pan, melt the ginger over moderate heat. Turn off the heat and add the hot peppers to the pan. Remove the pepper stems.

Random Ingredients: self rising flour,dark rum,chicken bouillon,pasta,vegetable,tomato juice
title: Calypso's Macaroni Grill Chicken
ingredients: 1/2 cup vegetable, chopped ( carrots, celery, onion ) | 2 cups self-rising flour | 2 tablespoons instant chicken bouillon | 1 can tomato juice | 1/2 cup dark rum ( optional or to taste ) | 8 cups cooked chicken in pasta,, shredded ( cooked chicken )
instructions: In a large bowl, blend flour and bouillon. Stir in tomato juice, rum and vegetables. Place chicken in a lightly greased 8x8 baking dish. Pour sauce over top. Bake in preheated 475°f oven for 15 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Spanish Hot Pepper Cream Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup nonfat sour cream ( for the whipped cream ) | 1/2 cup whipping cream ( for drizzling over finished dish, like a ) | 1 cup assorted chopped hot pepper | 1/3 cup olives, if desired
instructions: In a bowl, combine the sour cream, whipping cream and olives. In a bowl, combine hot pepper cream mixture and whipped cream. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours.

title: Crockpot Entree
ingredients: 2 lbs hamburger | 2 lbs escarole | 28 ounces cream of coconut | 28 ounces condensed buttermilk | 1/4 cup grand marnier | 1/4 cup tabasco sauce | 1 package frozen chopped spinach, thawed and squeezed dry
instructions: Brown meat and vegetables in a skillet. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Heat through, remove from heat and allow to sit at least 1/2 hour for flavors to meld. Serve on toast topped with additional sweetened sour cream if desired.

Random Ingredients: mace,steak,tuna water,kaffir lime leaf,lemon juice,corn tortilla chip,cabbage,red apple
title: Apple and Tuna Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs flank steaks | 2 tablespoons kaffir lime leaves, finely chopped ( or green ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace | 1 large head cabbage, shredded | 2 medium red apples, peeled, cored and shredded | lemon juice, and | 1/2 cup canned tuna in water, drained | crushed corn tortilla chips
instructions: Cut the meat across the grain into very thin strips. Combine the marinade ingredients in a bowl and marinate the meat. Toss the cabbage, apples, lemon juice and tuna in the salad plate. Top with cracker crumbs.

title: Capsicum and Broth Toss
ingredients: 1 green capsicum, chopped | 4 tablespoons vegetable oil or 4 tablespoons other fat | salt & freshly ground black pepper | 6 cups broth
instructions: Heat a few tablespoons of the oil or fat in a large pan over high heat. Add the capsicum and cook briefly. Stir in the broth and turn up the heat slightly to bring it to a boil. Add the mix to a wide shallow bowl and toss until combined evenly. Season with salt and pepper, if desired.

title: Macaroni With Creamy Pecan Penne and Coconut
ingredients: 1 cup penne pasta ( uncooked weight ) | 1 cup coconut ( shredded ) | 2 eggs | 1/3 cup wheat breadcrumbs | 1 tablespoon freshly ground cardamom
instructions: Bring a pan of water to boil and add 2 tbsp olive oil. Drain any excess water from pasta. In a deep bowl add the drained pasta.

title: Baked Mexican Tuna or Black Beans
ingredients: 10 medium canned tuna, drain, well ( about 2 cups ) | 1 tablespoon light browning sauce ( i use annie's ) | 1 tablespoon light browning sauce | herbs ( optional ) | 16 taco shells, warmed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Place tuna in a bowl. With hands, rub both sides of the tuna with dark tins of brown bean tins or an 8 x 8 inch baking dish. Pour all of the sauces over it. Sprinkle with herbs. Seal and bake uncovered 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Grilled Tomato and Bacon Skewers
ingredients: 1 pie shells | 1 tablespoon clear honey | 14 slices provolone cheese, cut into 24 thin slices | 6 thin slices sandwich bread | 2 1/2 teaspoons chopped fresh dill pickles | 1 tomatoes, cut crosswise into 16 slices | 4 slices bread
instructions: Preheat broiler. Line a baking sheet with foil. Pierce one edge of each pie shell with a fork. Brush tops of each pie crust with honey. Arrange 1 cheese slice, 1 slice of pickles, and a tomato slice on each pie bottom. Arrange 1 bread slice on top of each and brush with some more honey. Wrap a piece of foil around the sandwich and place into the preheated broiler. Broil for 10 minutes, or until the bread is toasted and the cheese is lightly melted.

title: Onion Chocolate Cannelloni-Melt
ingredients: 6 ounces german chocolate ( use lindt if you want to eat it plain ) | 1 cup chicken broth | 1 cup hominy ( frozen will work ) | 3 cherry tomatoes ( use your favourite ) | 1/2 teaspoon onion salt ( or to your tastes )
instructions: Put all ingredients except for the canneloni in the crockpot. Set the crockpot on low, cook for four hours.

title: Taco Pie #5FIX
ingredients: 3 5-inch fat free taco-size flour tortillas | 1/4 cup maple syrup ( your favorite ) | 1 teaspoon finely diced tarragon | 1 - 1 1/2 ounce triple sec | 2 cups potatoes, mashed or 2 cups shredded cheese, of choice
instructions: Heat oven to 375 degrees. Grease 9 x 10 inch baking dish with vegetable oil spray. Microwave 1/4 cup syrup in small bowl at a time for 15 second intervals and stir. Pour over warmed tortillas in baking dish. Sprinkle with tarragon. Top with mashed potatoes. Dot with 1 oz. Of cheese. Bake at 375 on middle rack for 20 minutes or until cheese is melted and golden.

title: Soy Chilli Sauce
ingredients: 1 tablespoon soy sauce | 1 tablespoon red curry paste | 1 tablespoon ghee or 1 tablespoon butter, for frying | 1 tablespoon reduced sodium sour cream | 1/2 cup light cream | 2 teaspoons ground cumin
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together and keep refrigerated until needed. Serve with fish.

Random Ingredients: maple syrup,icing sugar,kielbasa,creamy peanut butter,lemon pepper,chicken broth,chili oil
title: Quick and Easy Kielbasa Peanut Soup
ingredients: 1 lb kielbasa, cut into 1-inch slices ( or sweet white ) | 2 3/4 cups chicken broth | 1/4 cup creamy peanut butter | 1/4 cup maple syrup | 1/4 cup sour cream or 1/4 cup cottage cheese | lemon pepper, to taste | shredded icing sugar, to sprinkle over top of each bowl
instructions: In a saucepan add the chicken broth and bring to a boil. Add 1/4 cup peanut butter and whisk until smooth. Add the maple syrup, sour cream, and chili to the warm broth. Add the kielbasa slices, return to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer for 10 minutes, or until the kielbasa is tender. Serve sprinkled with lemon pepper, and drizzle more maple syrup on top. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: rye flour,cream mushroom soup,pumpkin puree,chinese cabbage,pimiento,tomatillo,water
title: Cabbage Rolls
ingredients: 12 small baby cabbage ( each about 2x14 1x1-inch ) | 8 large ripe tomatillos ( each about 1 pound ) | 2 cans cream of mushroom soup | 1 jar diced pimientos | 2/3 cup green giant natural pumpkin puree | 1 1/2 cups chopped spanish cabbage | 1/3 cup dry pepsi oats or 1/3 cup regular pepsi oats
instructions: Wash cabbage and remove outer leaves before tearing. Slice out center of each cabbage leaf and place on a wire rack. Stack, stem side down, and slightly open, leaving 2 or 3 good sized headsspace. Sprinkle ends with minimal flour. Place one tomatillo on each leaf. Place 1 can of cream of mushroom soup in a sauce pan and heat. Place 1 can of pumpkin mixed vegetables in a larger saucepan. Stir soup, pimiento and pepsi in saucepan. Pour 3/4 cup water into saucepan and stir with a wire rack to release lumps. Heat over low heat until soup is thickened, about 5 minutes. Do not boil. Wrap each cabbage leaf with a folded kitchen towel and place in saucepan on top layer. Pour hot soup mixture over cabbage and vegetables. Cover with lid. Cook over low heat until hot, about 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: turmeric,mirin,pearl barley,spring onion,dark beer,ranch dressing mix,ortega taco seasoning,oyster sauce
title: Beer and Coriander Flavoured Oranges
ingredients: 1/2 cup mirin | 1/4 cup dark beer | 1/2 cup oyster sauce | 1/4 cup miracle whip or 1/4 cup cream cheese | 1 packet hidden valley original ranch dressing mix | 1 tablespoon cornflower or 1 tablespoon flaked coconut, toasted | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric ( to taste )
instructions: Combine mirin, beer, oyster sauce, miracle whip or cream cheese, ranch dressing mix, and cornflakes in a microwave safe serving bowl. Cover and microwave on high for 1 minute, stirring halfway through cooking. Remove from microwave, stir in turmeric, and set aside. Prepare oranges according to package, and place in a medium size bowl. Pour dressing over oranges, toss gently to coat everything. Serve, or refrigerate for up to a day.

title: Tartiflette Au Gratin
ingredients: 1 aubergine, length-ways and cut into 5cm slices | 1/2 large yellow squash, sliced | 25 ml dry sherry | 150 ml plain low fat yogurt | 150 g low-fat cheddar cheese | 50 g shaved parmesan cheese, plus extra to serve
instructions: Preheat the grill to high. Place the aubergine slices on a plate and cover with plastic wrap. Place a plate on top to weigh it down. Heat the grill and cook the aubergines for 3 - 5 minutes. Remove from the grill and slice in half lengthways and diagonally. Place each slice in a lightly buttered baking dish. Brush with sherry and spread the sliced aubergine slices with a little of the yogurt and the cheddar. Grill for 5 - 7 minutes until golden and bubbling. Serve with shaved parmesan.

title: Swiss Chard & Yoghurt With Raw Chard (21 Day Wonder Diet: Day 13)
ingredients: 400 g swiss chard, stems washed and roughly chopped | 1 cup natural yoghurt | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace
instructions: Place swiss chard in a pan, sprinkle over the mace and cook over high heat for 2 - 3 minutes. Drain on paper towel and leave to cool.. Whisk yoghurt with the cooled swiss chard, stir in the mace and serve.

Random Ingredients: dark beer,bread flour,habanero pepper,balsamic vinegar,pumpkin seed,macaroni,snow pea,graham cracker
title: Macaroni, Ham and Pumpkin Seed Stew
ingredients: 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar | 1 tablespoon dark beer | 1/4 lb macaroni | 1/2 lb ham or 1/2 lb pancetta, chopped into 1/2 inch cubes, left whole | 2 tablespoons pumpkin seeds | 1/2 habanero pepper, chopped | salt and cracked black pepper ( optional ) | 1 bag bread flour | pumpkin seeds, lightly toasted ( optional )
instructions: In a medium pot over medium heat, add water and simmer the vinegar and beer until reduced by half, about 10 minutes. Meanwhile, cook macaroni in a large pot of boiling water until just tender but still firm. Drain, reserving 1 cup of the cooking liquid. Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Remove the pulp from the pumpkin seeds and coarsely chop. In a large bowl with a wooden spoon, toss the macaroni with the ham, pumpkin seed mush, habanero, and reserved cooking liquid. Season with salt and pepper. Place the flour in a large mound on a plate and make a well. Form a well in the center and quickly mix in 1 cup of flour. Using your hand, begin forming dough into a ball. Dip the ball into the flour and carefully press into the cornmeal in the well. Repeat with the rest of the dough, adding more flour or water as needed until the dough is the right consistency. On a large rimmed baking sheet, spread 1 cup of pumpkin seeds. Cook the stew in the 450°f oven until the crust has darkened slightly and the ham heated through, about 18 minutes, checking occasionally.

title: Santa Fe Chicken Salad
ingredients: 6 large skinless, boneless chicken breast halves | 2 heads romaine lettuce, coarsely chopped | 3 cups iceberg lettuce, coarsely chopped
instructions: To cook the chicken breasts in a skillet, boil them in a large pot of salted water with the tops off until the outsides are firm but tender. Remove the chicken with a skimmer and drain. Cook the chicken in oil in a large skillet over medium heat until no longer pink. Turn the heat down.

title: Worcestershire Sauce for Vegetables
ingredients: 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 4 cups baby arugula
instructions: Combine worcestershire sauce and arugula with 1 1/2 cup water and bring to a boil. Remove from heat and stir in remaining water to make a smooth dressing.

title: Baked Italian Tomatoes
ingredients: 4 large ripe italian tomatoes | 3/4 cup extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Preheat the oven to 250 degrees f. Lightly oil a shallow 5x9 inch baking dish. Slice the tops off of each tomato and gently squeeze out the juice to expose the insides. Place the tomato halves cut side down, in the prepared baking dish just large enough to hold them in one layer, cut the tops open, and press gently to flatten. Sprinkle the inside of the tomatoes with 1/4 cup of the olives. Drizzle the tomato tops with the remaining olive oil. Bake for about 1 hour, until the tomatoes are tender and the juices run clear.

title: Chinese Meatballs
ingredients: vegetables, of your choice | white sesame seeds, for sprinkling | 1 can pork-smoked ham ( or turkey ) | catsup ( optional ) | rices ( optional ) or rice krispies ( optional )
instructions: Heat up your smoker or gas stove. Put food mill in toaster oven on highest rack. Crush your food mill and add it gradually to the hot smoker, until everything is combined well using your hands. Smoke for approximately 20 minutes for meatballs, 30 minutes for stir meat mixture and 70 more minutes for veggies to brown. Add catsup, if using, in last 5 minutes of cooking time. If you like, at this point you can add any left over ingredients and continue to smoke until meat is done. If you want, for even more flavor, you can add either white or browned frozen vegetables. If not using immediately, store in crock pot on low until ready to serve.

title: Baked Potato and Roasted Cauliflower With Cheese
ingredients: 7 ounces russet potatoes, sliced in 1/4 inch slices ( about 3.5 ounces ) | 1 large cauliflower, cleaned and cut into florets | 1/2 cup frozen peas, thawed | 1 tablespoon fish sauce | 1/4 cup cheese, shredded
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f. Place the potatoes in a large bowl with the cauliflower, peas, and fish sauce. Toss to coat. Transfer to a 9 square baking dish. Bake for 45 - 55 minutes, until potatoes are tender and cauliflower is soft. Sprinkle with cheese, and bake for 5 minutes.

title: Antipasto Con Salami (Antipasto Salad)
ingredients: 250 g firm soft beans, such as arugula, baby beet, or small baby beetroots | 75 g sliced hard salami | 1 -2 tablespoon dried celery leaves, crushed lightly to release flavour
instructions: Place all ingredients in a large serving bowl. Dressing, mix all ingredients well, pour over salad and mix well again. Variation, use bread crumbs with a good strong flavour such as anchovy fillet.

Random Ingredients: baby arugula,caster sugar,chutney,sourdough bread,green cardamom pod,tamari,crabmeat
title: Steamed Crab Sandwich
ingredients: 600 g ground crabmeat | 1 tablespoon tamari | 2 teaspoons caster sugar | 2 green cardamom pods | 4 slices sourdough bread | 1/4 cup chutney, preferably major greys | 12 baby arugula
instructions: Combine all ingredients except coriander in a mixing bowl. Form into four patties. Wrap each patty on a piece of bread and tie with string. Place on a large steaming tray and refrigerate for at least 1 hour. Preheat oven to 180°c grease a baking dish and line it with parchment paper. Remove patties from the brine and place on prepared dish. Drizzle with the chutney and scatter over the arugula. Bake for 15 - 20 minutes or until cooked through and golden brown.

Random Ingredients: panko breadcrumb,cold water,taco seasoning mix,egg substitute,turkey,potato starch
title: Low Fat Taco Meatloaf
ingredients: 1/2 cup panko breadcrumbs | 1/2 cup potato starch | 1 1/4 teaspoons taco seasoning mix | 1/8 teaspoon salt | 1 egg substitute | 1/2 cup cold water | 2 -3 lbs lean ground turkey
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees. In a medium bowl, sprinkle panko crumbs on a plate. In a medium bowl, toss the potato starch with the taco seasoning mix with the egg substitute and add to the dry ingredients. Add the cold water and mix well with a fork. Add ground turkey and mix. Shape into a large meat loaf, placing the fat cap and fat layer on the top. Brush with egg. Bake for 1 hour, uncovered. During second 15 minutes, reduce heat to 325 degrees and bake for an additional 15 to 20 minutes, until internal temperature reaches 160 degrees. Take the loaf out of the oven and sprinkle with additional panko. Let stand for 20 minutes before slicing.

title: Mustard-Lingtons for the Slow Cooker
ingredients: 1 pound boneless beef chuck | 1 tablespoon dry mustard
instructions: Trim fat from beef. Combine dry mustard and 2 tablespoons mustard. Spread mustard mixture evenly over beef. Sprinkle on remaining 1 tablespoon mustard and 2 tablespoon mustard. Close lid of crock.

title: Brisket Steak for Two (Or more)
ingredients: 1 cup teriyaki sauce | 1 teaspoon garlic powder | 1 skirt steak
instructions: For best results, do not use a food grade steak. I use a small to medium sized heavy duty aluminum foil and spray it lightly with cooking spray. If you have a gas grill, just tent with aluminum foil and place it directly over the heat source. I place the foil in the hot spot, with the coals very hot. I turn the meat every 5 - 10 minutes as the gas grill gets hotter, so the grill stays hot for even cooking. Once the grill is hot, use your indirect setting about seven inches from the heat. While the door bizzes open, score the meat about three times on high with a sharp knife, cutting at eight times per inch in this way, it will literally become fast and hot. After your meat has been cut out and on the foil, sprinkle the top of it with the teriyaki sauce. Sprinkle the garlic powder on the meat and let it sit for about five minutes so that the garlic powder adheres. Use a spatula if necessary.

Random Ingredients: ranch dressing mix,coconut rum,green bell pepper,meat,filling,tuna steak,tortilla,pecan
title: Caribbean Steak
ingredients: 5 tablespoons coconut rum | 2 tablespoons pimento-stuffed green bell peppers | 3 tablespoons chopped pecans | 1 can tuna steaks, undrained | 1 can tuna steaks, undrained | 1 envelope ranch dressing mix | 1 package toothpicks or ( 5 lb ) package tortillas | filling for filling ( optional )
instructions: Pour rum in a shallow dish. Dry roast with paper towels and sprinkle with green pepper and nuts. Drain tuna well and reserve liquid. In a small bowl, combine tuna, dressing mix, and reserved tuna liquid, reserving any liquid. Spoon equal amounts of mixture onto toothpicks and roll into balls. Arrange in a baking dish and refrigerate for 1 hour, or until set. To serve, spoon equal amounts of tuna mixture onto each tortilla and roll up tightly. Arrange on a platter and top with desired filling.

title: Baked Apricot Mushrooms
ingredients: 6 ounces tirohi ( dark rye bread ) | 1 cup unsweetened apricot preserves | 2 cups chopped oyster mushrooms | 1/4 teaspoon onion powder | 1/2 cup yogurt | 1/2 teaspoon soy flour
instructions: Cut rind from tirohi. Place in a plastic bag with preserves and shake to distribute evenly. Lay out on a clean surface. Cut a 1 inch wide strip of paper towel about 1/4 inch wide and roll it into a ball to curl edges. Press to shape rind and excess liquid from rind, if desired. Combine mushrooms, onion powder, and soy flour in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: poblano pepper,portabella mushroom,red pepper flake,applesauce,dark red kidney bean,feta cheese,veal,red beet
title: Feta and Vegetable Kabobs
ingredients: 1 lb ground veal | 1 small portabella mushroom, chopped | 2 roasted red beets, peeled and shredded | 2 poblano peppers, chopped | 2 medium red beets, peeled and sliced | 2 tablespoons dark red kidney beans, undrained | 1 cup crumbled feta cheese | 1/4 cup unsweetened applesauce | ground red pepper flakes, to taste
instructions: Combine all ingredients, divide into two, and press down with hands until mixture is evenly distributed. Shape into 1 balls. Put onto sprayed skewers and broil on high for 5 - 10 minutes, turning halfway through the cooking time. Serve with a salad.

title: Mexican Cheese Dip
ingredients: 2 pounds mexican cheese blend, shredded ( such as queso fresco, monterey jack or similar ) | 1 can drained canned chile peppers, diced | 3/4 cup plain yogurt | 3/4 cup soda water, or as needed | 1 tablespoon cognac
instructions: Mix the mexican cheese blend, chile peppers, yogurt, soda water and cognac in a bowl. Cover, and refrigerate 30 minutes before serving.

title: Simple and Yummy Prawn & Rice.
ingredients: 600 g boneless skinless chicken thighs ( or chicken breast ) | 200 g small prawns, uncooked, defrosted and chopped | 200 g small white onions | 150 g chopped walnuts, lightly toasted | 3/4 cup quinoa | 2 tablespoons dry quinoa | 1 tablespoon mince meat, cooked
instructions: Combine chicken, prawns, onions and nuts in a large saucepan, cover with water and boil for 10 minutes then reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes or until prawns are cooked and prawn mixture is cooked through. Add quinoa to pan, reduce heat and simmer a further 2 minutes, then stir through mince meat. Serve with pitta bread, cucumber wedges or a mixed salad.

title: Midori Buns
ingredients: 1/4 ounce active dry yeast, such as rapid rise | 1 cup mashed midori melon liqueur, such as lindt | 1 inch gingerroot, peeled and thinly sliced
instructions: Dissolve the yeast in a large mixing bowl, and set aside until foamy, about 5 minutes. Stir in the mashed midori and enough ginger to make the mixture 1 pound. Set aside in a warm place to rise until doubled in bulk, about 1 hour. Punch down, and turn out onto floured board. Knead for 10 minutes, or as long as needed. Lightly oil a baking sheet, place in the oven, and lightly grease the top. Divide dough in half, and form each half into an oval loaf. Place on baking sheet and flatten the top.

title: Homestyle Gravy
ingredients: 1 onion, chopped ( i really like onion in this ) | 2 chicken stock cubes ( i like stolen oats in tablet so i double the recipe )
instructions: Soak the chicken base in water for 1/2 hour. Put chicken base into saucepan on medium heat. Turn down to low but keep stirring. Cook for 5 minutes or until liquid is reduced and gravy has thickened. This is tasty as a gravy with potatoes, carrots or whatever else you enjoy.

title: Dynamite
ingredients: 1/2 cup red food coloring ( `` jenever '' flavor ) | 1/2 cup pure vanilla extract
instructions: Pour over ice cubes in a tall glass. Garnish with a maraschino cherry. Enjoy.

title: Tomato Pudding - Easy!
ingredients: 500 g cake flour or 500 g all-purpose flour | 400 g tomatoes, finely chopped or 2 1/2 cups chopped canned tomatoes, pureed in a food processor or blender | 2 cups milk
instructions: Preheat oven to 190c or 170c if using a fan forced oven. Measure all ingredients into a large bowl and mix to combine thoroughly. Put mixture in a shallow ovenproof dish, spreading evenly. Spread tomato puree over top of the pudding. Sprinkle top with grated swiss cheese, bake for about 40 - 50 minutes or until the top is golden. Cool on a wire rack. Can be served warm or cold.

Random Ingredients: lemon,dressing,cannellini bean,red cabbage,mustard seed,baking powder,brown mustard seed,tomato juice
title: Boston Brown Bean salad
ingredients: dressing : | 1/4 cup brown mustard seeds, or more to taste | 1/4 cup dill pickle mustard seeds, or more to taste | 1/2 lemon, juiced, or more to taste | 1/2 can cannellini beans, rinsed and drained | 2/3 red cabbage, finely shredded | 2 tomatoes with juice, chopped ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon baking powder | 1 tablespoon chopped dill pickle mustard seeds
instructions: Mix brown mustard seeds, dill pickle mustard seeds, lemon juice, cannellini beans, red cabbage, and tomatoes together in a bowl to make the dressing. Whisk baking powder into mustard mixture.

title: Tropical Pineapple Frappe
ingredients: 1 can pineapple juice | 1 tablespoon citron peel
instructions: In a blender, combine pineapple juice and citron peel.

title: Swedish Meatballs (Peskoles)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs ground veal | 1/2 teaspoon white pepper
instructions: Mix all ingredients thoroughly, cover, and let sit overnight at room temp. Shape into meatballs. Heat 1/4 inch oil in deep 12 inch skillet. Saute over medium high heat, turning over and stirring with a slotted spoon for 8 - 10 minutes over medium heat, until nicely browned all over.

Random Ingredients: orange bell pepper,vanilla extract,kalamata olive,pine nut,cabbage,rye bread,tamari soy sauce,honey
title: Korean Cabbage Rolls
ingredients: 1/4 cup pine nuts | 2 tablespoons dried kalamata olives | 1/4 teaspoon vanilla extract | 2 tablespoons tamari soy sauce | 1 1/2 tablespoons honey | 24 slices rye bread | 1/2 cup shredded cabbage | 1 1/2 teaspoons orange bell peppers, minced
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Heat a nonstick skillet over medium heat. Drizzle pine nuts over the surface and cook, stirring frequently, until toasted, about 3 minutes. Transfer to a baking sheet and crush in batches to make peanuts. Place toasted pine nuts in a bowl of cold water and let sit 1 minute. Remove and drain, reserving liquid. Dry bread slices on racks that are paper towels and set aside. Spread kalamata olives on a baking sheet. Drizzle with vanilla and tamari soy sauce. Roast bread for 3 to 4 minutes, turning once, until lightly toasted. Spread toasted olives on a dinner plate. Place 6 slices of rye bread on top. Top with cabbage, caramelized peanuts and orange bell peppers. Serve remaining liquid from roasting pan and a drizzle of caramelized peanuts and onions. Enjoy.

title: Italian Cheese Salad
ingredients: 1 head iceberg lettuce, cleaned and finely shredded | 1 lb italian salami, drained and cut into thin strips
instructions: If the salami is large, tear into bite sized pieces. Wash the lettuce very well, making sure to break off the ends slightly if it looks like the stuffing is going to leak out. Arrange on serving plate. In a large bowl, mix the salami and cheese. The salad will be pretty garnish with the grated cheese. Serve.

Random Ingredients: vanilla essence,beef bouillon cube,french bread,salt cod fish,taco sauce,gingerroot,ginger
title: Crock Pot Caramian Beef Stew
ingredients: 1 lb salt cod fish, cut into chunks | 1 pint good quality taco sauce | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence | 8 beef bouillon cubes | 1 teaspoon grated fresh gingerroot | 1 teaspoon instant minced ginger ( add more if you want, i do ) | 1 loaf french bread, cut into thick slices
instructions: Put the fish chunks into a crockpot. Combine the taco sauce, vanilla essence, bouillon and spices in the crockpot. Stir well and let it simmer on low for 2 hours, stirring every so often. Turn off the heat and stir in the bread. Serve hot.

title: Cheesecake Greek Yogurt
ingredients: 2 cans greek yogurt | 4 ounces plain yogurt, strained ( strained strained yogurt ) | 4 ounces feta cheese, crumbled | 1 egg yolk | 2 tablespoons black fat, melted
instructions: Combine all ingredients together in a bowl, and mix together. Add more sugar if you like.

Random Ingredients: superfine sugar,salami,whipping cream heavy,beef chuck,cumin,green bean,almond extract,white flour
title: Creamy Swiss Salami & Green Bean Biscuits
ingredients: 4 ounces salami, chopped into 1/2-inch pieces | 2 ounces sliced almonds | 2 ounces thick slab sliced fresh green beans | 8 ounces thinly sliced fully fat-packed sliced lean beef chuck | 1/2 cup white flour | 4 tablespoons superfine sugar | 2 tablespoons ground cumin | 1 pinch of good quality almond extract
instructions: Preheat a grill pan with a rack set over a medium heat. Toast the almonds until lightly coloured and fragrant, then set aside, keeping the pan warm. Put all of the bacon fat in the pan and add the meat. Cook without colour, breaking it up, until the meat is lightly coloured. Then put the flour, sugar, cumin and almond extract in a clean tea bag, and shake well to combine. Remove any fat from the meat and gently stir in the meat mixture. Taste the sauce and add more sugar if necessary. Serve with toast, cheese, crackers or, poached egg, or simply with any other accompaniments. For best results, refrigerate the meat and biscuit overnight and bake the biscuit bread as per package instructions.

title: Hot & Spicy Italian Corn Salad
ingredients: 1 package frozen whole corn, thawed | 1 bottle zesty italian dressing | 1 tablespoon prepared horseradish sauce
instructions: Drain corn in a fine mesh colander until no more liquid is clinging. Set aside in a large bowl. Drizzle zesty italian dressing over corn. Toss corn salad with horseradish sauce to coat. Toss salad again with remaining dressing. Cover and refrigerate several hours or overnight.

title: Pasta With Spaghetti and Fettuccines
ingredients: 8 ounces fettuccine | 1 lb spaghetti, cooked according to package directions
instructions: Cook fettuccine as directed on package, usually 25 minutes. Drain. Meanwhile, cook spaghetti until al dente. Drain. Stir in drained pasta. Serve immediately.

title: Healthy Veggie Chapati
ingredients: 4 cups rolled oats | 2 cups sliced waldorf cabbage | 2 cups chopped leeks | 4 cups low-fat pizza sauce | 8 ounces chickpeas | ice cube | 1/4 cup chopped pecans ( optional )
instructions: Place the oats in a bowl, add the cabbage, leeks, and chickpeas. Seal the bag with your hands until it is well combined. Pour 1 inch of water into a skillet to a depth of 4 inches. Bring the water to a boil and add the bag of oats, then set the timer for 45 minutes. Drain and let cool slightly. Once the time is up, check that it's all cooked. If it looks like it’s getting too dry, cover the pan with a damp cloth to prevent drying out. Remove the bag of oats with a slotted spoon and spread out on a rimmed baking tray to cool the oats. Toast in the oven for 11 minutes, then remove from the oven and spread the crust with the pam. Spread both the breads with pizza sauce, pressing down to cover the pizza with the crust. Top with the pecans, if desired. Allow to cool and serve.

title: Baked Mince Rissoles
ingredients: 4 mutton chops, 1/2 inch thick | 4 tablespoons plain greek yogurt | 4 tablespoons breadcrumbs, divided
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Trim any excess fat from lamb chops, and cut in half lengthwise and crosswise. Place chops in a dish or deep roasting pan. Mix yogurt with bread crumbs. Dip the chops into yogurt, then coat with bread crumbs, pressing to coat. Arrange on a rack in a roasting pan, and bake in the oven for 45 minutes, or until cooked through, basting now and then. Let rest for 10 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: brown gravy mix,peanut oil,yeast,tea,beef eye,whipping cream,chicken bouillon cube
title: Nana's Russian Chicken
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef eye round, thinly sliced | 1 tablespoon peanut oil | 1 envelope instant yeast | 2 cups warm whipping cream | 2 tablespoons instant brown gravy mix | 2 chicken bouillon cubes | 1/2 cup brewed tea
instructions: In oven safe skillet, heat oil on medium heat. Roll sliced beef, no darker than 1/8 inch, in flour coated with yeast until evenly coated. Drain fat. Spread over bottom of oiled pan. Let rest for 10 minutes. Stir cream into yeast mixture. Cover skillet, let rise 1 hour, stirring halfway through. Punch down. Spread top with coffee and bake for 10 minutes. Serve with steamed greens.

title: Chile Con Carne
ingredients: 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 1 1/4 pounds ground meat | 1 can chopped green chiles
instructions: Heat oil in a skillet over medium high heat. Mix in ground meat, and cook for 5 minutes, or until meat has browned. Mix in green chiles, and cook for an additional 30 seconds, mixing continuously.

title: Texas Goulash I
ingredients: 4 large russet potatoes, peeled and cubed | 3 cups peeled fresh green beans | 1 tablespoon quick-cooking tapioca | 1 can molasses | 1/2 head lettuce, washed, dried and chopped | 1 cup chopped pecans
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add the potatoes, and cook until tender yet firm but still firm, about 20 minutes. Drain, and return the potatoes to the pot. Cook the green beans in the boiling water until tender, 5 to 7 minutes. Drain, and transfer the green beans to a salad bowl. Stir in the tapioca and molasses.

title: Cranberry-Taco Bread
ingredients: 8 ounces french bread, cubed | 1 bag frozen cranberry beans | 1 teaspoon vanilla | 2 tablespoons honey | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon sweetened taco seasoning | 1 teaspoon dried red chili
instructions: Place french bread and cranberry beans in food processor. Add spices. When it is about toasted stir in honey and taco seasoning. Let cool slightly. Top with favorite topping. Cut in 8 equal pieces. Serve right away.

Random Ingredients: mustard,vanilla custard,cooking spray,pistachio,hard egg,deep frying oil,pepper
title: Tiger Eggs, Pistachios, Egg and Pepper Spread
ingredients: 1 lb shelled hard-boiled egg | 1/2 cup toasted shelled pistachios | 1/2 cup finely chopped flat-leaf parsley | 1 1/2 tablespoons vanilla custard, chilled | 1/2 teaspoon dry mustard | 1/8 teaspoon pepper | 1/2 cup cooking spray
instructions: Slice eggs and remove hard boiled yolks only.

Random Ingredients: ginger root,feta cheese,shortening,serrano chile,black bean,heavy cream
title: Black Bean Ice Cream
ingredients: 4 tablespoons shortening | 5 cans black beans, drained and rinsed | 1 1/2 teaspoons minced fresh ginger root | 1 serrano chile, minced | 1/2 cup diced feta cheese, or as needed, divided | 2 cups heavy cream
instructions: Melt shortening in a large pot over medium heat. Add beans, ginger, chile, and 1/2 cup of feta cheese.

title: Maggie Beer's Wine
ingredients: 1 bottle dry marsala wine | 1 cup green olives, pitted | 2 cans orange sections, drained
instructions: In a large saucepan, combine the marsala, olives and oranges. Bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer, covered, about 25 minutes, until reduced to about 1 1/2 cups of liquid. Remove from heat. Serve over your favorite ice cream or with fresh bread.

Random Ingredients: pesto sauce,red wine vinegar,vanilla sugar,rom tomato,self raising flour
title: Pesto Vinaigrette Tomato & Tomato Damper
ingredients: 3 roma tomatoes, thickly sliced | 2 tablespoons pesto sauce | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 1/2 cup vanilla sugar | 60 g self-raising flour
instructions: Place roma tomatoes in a heatproof bowl. Add 2 tbsp pesto sauce and pour over vinegar. Leave to soak in the fridge for 30 minutes. Heat oven to 220c/fan 200°c. Place flour, sugar and the remaining pesto in a bowl and mix well. Divide mixture into 6 equal portions, shape each into a ball. Heat 1 tbsp oil in a shallow casserole dish/dry fry each damper on both sides until golden brown and cooked through remove to a wire rack and finish cooking under a grill until golden brown. Serve warm/cold. Note, i have also used the tomatoes at the same time as the pesto, but they have been warned that the tomato is a little bit acidic. I've also suggested using a small tomatoes like a pablano.

title: Peppered Steak With Avocado Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb sirloin | 8 ounces ricotta cheese | 1 avocado | 1/2 - 1 serrano pepper, minced | 1 tablespoon minced fresh basil leaf | 2 tablespoons liquid honey | 8 slices canned sweet pickled mountain cheese with lime, sliced into thin wedges
instructions: Cut steak into serving size pieces and place in zip lock bag. Mix together the ricotta cheese, avocado, serrano pepper, basil and honey. Pour herb garlic mixture over steak pieces. Seal and refrigerate overnight, turning bag over occasionally during last 10 minutes of cooking time. Remove steak onto a heated platter and place the pickled mountain cheese on top of the steak and sprinkle with the lime wedges.

Random Ingredients: creamy peanut butter,irish whiskey,lamb,bay leaf,brown rice,coffee powder
title: Irish Lamb Rice
ingredients: 1/2 cup creamy peanut butter | 2 tablespoons coffee powder | 2 teaspoons instant coffee powder | 4 bay leaves | 4 lbs lamb, cut into cubes | 2 cups brown rice, cooked or 2 cups rice, cooked
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients, set aside. Coat lamb with marind, place in slow cooker. Pour rice mixture over meat. Cover and cook on low 8 to 10 hours or until meat is tender. During last 30 minutes of cooking, stir occasionally to ensure meat is coated. Serve with slivered fresh green onions or chopped fresh parsley.

title: Italian Sausage Sandwich - Nigella Lawson
ingredients: 250 g swiss genoa salami, cut lengthways into thin strips | 40 g butter | 1 teaspoon cumin seed | 3 tablespoons fresh coriander, coarsely chopped | 1/4 teaspoon salt & pepper | 1/4 small grated fresh cheese
instructions: Pre heat a medium frying pan or griddle on a high heat. Add the salami pieces to the frying pan and cook for approx 8 minutes until crisp and golden brown on the outside. Remove from the pan & set aside. Stir the butter into the frying pan or griddle and add the cumin seeds. As soon as they start popping add the coriander, salt & pepper. Stir well, then return the salami to the pan. Stir in the grated cheese and let them bubble till nice and melted. Serve with crusty bread or your favourite type of bread.

title: Apple and Apple Spaghetti
ingredients: 1 jar spaghetti sauce ( recommended del monte brand ) | 1 tart apples ( i like granny smith ) or 2 lbs fresh apples ( i like granny smith )
instructions: Cut the apples into 1/4 inch slices. Heat up the sauce in a pan over medium heat and add the apples. Cook until they start to wilt, about 5 - 10 minute then stir in the spaghetti. The pasta should be cooked through, not mushy.

title: Alfredo Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup mayonnaise | 1 cup cornmeal | 1 1/2 cups white tequila
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix the mayonnaise and cornmeal. Gradually stir in the tequila. Use immediately.

title: Pesto Bread

instructions: Heat oven to 400 fahrenheit. Mix the baking soda, pesto, butter, and half of the butter. Bake for 10 to 15 minutes until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: idaho baking potato,purpose flour,golden syrup,sage,beef gravy

ingredients: 1 lb idaho baking potato, peeled and cut into chunks | 1/2 cup all-purpose flour | 1 cup beef gravy | 1/2 cup golden syrup ( or regular maple syrup ) | 1 teaspoon sage
instructions: Place the potatoes into a pot and cover with water. Put a lid onto the pot. Cook over medium heat until the potatoes are tender but not falling apart.

title: Famous New Zealand Limas Bean Puree
ingredients: 3 cans lima beans ( or any other white bean of your choice ) | 2 large ripe tomatoes, cored & coarsely chopped | 2 1/2 cups heavy whipping cream | 2/3 cup sour cream or 2/3 cup heavy cream | 1 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1 teaspoon gruyere cheese, grated ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a heavy pot, stir. Cover & bring to a boil. Reduce heat, simmer 20 to 30 minutes or until beans are tender and cream is thick. Ladle hot sauce over warm beans.

title: Roasted Sweet Onion With Balsamic Vinegar
ingredients: 2 lbs ripe sweet white onions | 2/3 cup balsamic vinegar | 2/3 cup parmesan cheese, finely grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 500 f or 70°c. Cut the onions lengthwise into thin slices.

title: French Green Beans With Tomatoes and Garlic
ingredients: 1 lb french style green beans, trimmed | 1 can stewed tomatoes
instructions: In a 2 quart slow cooker, place the french style beans.

title: Ginger Rice Pie
ingredients: 1 cup sour cream or 1 cup yogurt | 1 teaspoon vanilla pudding mix ( regular or spice flavor ) | 1 can cream of chicken soup ( regular or spice ) | 3 tablespoons ginger juice, divided ( bottled is fine, as is your own judgment. i used 1 teaspoon ) | 1 1/2 cups brown rice ( can use short grain ) or 1 1/2 cups white rice ( can use short grain ) | pepper, to taste | 1/2 - 3/4 cup soda water
instructions: Mix sour cream, vanilla pudding, cream of chicken soup, one teaspoon ginger juice, and pepper. Preheat oven to 350°f mix and pour over rice. Bake for 45 minutes. Note, i did not use ginger juice for this recipe at all.

title: Pine Nut and Beef Jerky!
ingredients: 2 pounds london broil beef, sliced | 1 cup pine nuts | 1 large red chili | 4 cloves | 1 jalapenos or serrano pepper | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup, undiluted | 1/2 cup dark corn syrup | 24 whole cloves | 3/4 cup dark corn syrup
instructions: Trim fat from meat and slice into 1/4 inch slices. Place the meat in a large, deep container. Sprinkle with pine nuts, chile peppers, cloves and jalepenos or serrano peppers. Push foil over meat, and bake at 325 degrees f for 3 hours. Brush with glaze every 15 minutes, and continue baking for another hour. Allow to cool, then slice. These can be frozen.

Random Ingredients: banana,cremini mushroom,beef bouillon cube,extra beef,sesame seed,parmigiano reggiano cheese
title: Italian Beef Wraps

instructions: Brown meat in a large non stick skillet over medium heat. Add mushrooms and cook over medium heat until mushrooms release their water and begin to shrink, about 2 - 3 minutes. Dissolve bouillon cube in hot water, then add to skillet. Reduce heat to low, and simmer until mushrooms are tender, about 5 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, remove mushrooms, and set aside. Remove meat from skillet and drain off any excess fat and fat from skillet. Set aside. Stir remaining ingredients together in the skillet, and bring to a simmer. Add meat and mushrooms, and spoon mixture into tortillas. Sprinkle with chopped sesame seeds and parmigiano reggiano cheese before rolling.

Random Ingredients: chili paste,margarine,lemon juice,vinegar,grain brown rice,lite olive oil
title: Japanese Style Rice
ingredients: 1 cup long grain brown rice | 2 tablespoons margarine or 2 tablespoons butter | 2 tablespoons lite olive oil | 1 1/2 tablespoons vinegar or 1 1/2 tablespoons wine vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon chili paste | 2 teaspoons lemon juice
instructions: Cook the rice in boiling water until tender.

title: Red Bean, Kiwi and Fresh Fruit Salad
ingredients: 16 ounces fresh red beans | 1 small acorn squash, halved and cut into chunks | 2 kiwi fruits, peeled | 1/4 cup fresh coriander seeds | 2 tablespoons olive, or to taste | 1 tablespoon fresh tarragon | 2 whole green onions, trimmed and thinly sliced | 1 tablespoon prepared mustard
instructions: Place the red beans, squash, kiwi fruit, coriander seeds and olive oil in a saucepan, and heat over high heat until warm, about 5 minutes. Stir in the tarragon, green onions and dijon mustard.

title: Hot Jam

instructions: Combine the clams, chile, pepper, and hibiscus and boil for 10 minutes. Add the olive oil and simmer for 10 minutes. Add water as needed to cover the ingredients. Stir frequently. Do not boil.

title: Sweet Banana and Plantain Fritters

instructions: Peel plantain and slice thinly. Cut bananas into about 1/4 inch slices and sprinkle with a small amount of sugar. Cover them with 1 quart of hot water. Bring to a boil and cook over moderate heat for about 2 minutes. Cover the bowl with foil or a lid, remove the lid, and cook the plantains over very low heat until tender but still holding its shape, about 12 minutes. Place the drained plantains in a bowl and mash with a wood spoon. Add banana, brown sugar, fennel, salt and pepper to taste and mix well. Serve the fritters warm or cold.

Random Ingredients: self rising flour,madras curry powder,maraschino cherry,snow pea,puff pastry
title: Madras Spring Rolls

instructions: Cut the pastry into 10 squares. Cut each square in half. Roll each half out into 8 square, and line baking sheets on either end with edges overlapping the top of the pastry. Cut out the center of each square and bake at 350 degrees for 25 to 30 minutes, or until pastry is golden brown. Remove and place on wire racks to cool. For the spring rolls, mix the curry powder and flour in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: mint sprig,lime juice,lump crabmeat,red wine vinegar,tofu,leek,courgette
title: Lump Crab With Leeks and Tofu Shiraz
ingredients: 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons lime juice | 200 g lump crabmeat | 200 g tofu, cut into four slices lengthways | 125 g leeks, trimmed, sliced | 200 g courgettes, quartered, cut into 4 wedgepons | fresh mint sprig
instructions: Combine the first five ingredients in a shallow bowl& set aside. Wash zucchini and courgettes. Cut each wedge into six even sized pieces. Slice leek, reserving white stalks for the garnish. Divide the crabmeat among 4 plates & pile the crab mixture alongside. Scatter leeks over the top. Garnish with the courgettes& mint sprigs& serve.

Random Ingredients: garam masala powder,topping,graham cracker crumb,italian breadcrumb,hazelnut oil
title: Baked Hazelnut Patties
ingredients: 1/2 cup graham cracker crumbs ( plain ) | 1/4 cup italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 2 -3 tablespoons garam masala powder | 1/3 cup hazelnut oil ( olive oil is really good ) | 1 - 1 1/2 cup light whipped topping
instructions: In a bowl, combine the dry bread crumbs and the garam masala powder. Add the oil and whip until smooth. Add some hazelnut oil until mixture is of spreading consistency. In a shallow baking dish, spoon about 2/3 cup of the cream mixture on the bottom of the dish. Dip the hazelnut halves in the mix until well coated. Add the remaining cream and the topping. Bake at 350 degrees f. For about 20 minutes, or until the top is browned, and crispy. Let cool and store in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: cilantro leaf,milk,grain rice,mirin,madeira wine,chunky peanut butter,iceberg lettuce leaf,parsley leaf
title: Peanut Sauce (For Salad)

instructions: In a small bowl, stir together evaporated milk, peanut butter and mirin until smooth. Pour into a small serving dish, and set aside. In another small bowl, stir together rice, cilantro, parsley and cilantro. Arrange lettuce on individual serving plates, and top with peanut sauce. Garnish with more toasted coconut, if desired, and garnish with green salad leaves.

title: Prawn With Noodle Sauce
ingredients: 3 1/2 - 4 1/2 lbs jumbo shrimp, fresh | 1/2 ounce fresh cilantro, leaves picked & coarsely chopped | 2 ounces parmesan cheese, freshly shaved | 1 teaspoon lime peel, fresh grated | 1 cup frozen peas, thawed if fresh and drained
instructions: Peel and devein the prawns, if using, and put into a large pot. Add all remaining ingredients except the peas. Simmer, covered, for 30 minutes, or until the prawns are pink and tender. Season with salt and pepper to taste and serve with warm noodles.

title: Mini Pepperoni-Muffins
ingredients: 150 g pepperoni, finely chopped | 300 g miniature marshmallows | 150 g blueberries | 100 g frozen peas | 1 cup whole wheat flour
instructions: Place pepperoni and marshmallows in a bowl. Put blueberries in microwave and microwave for 1 minute. Stir the peas into the bowl first then add the flour. Mix well. Fill muffin tin 3/4 full with mixture.

title: Homemade Italian Tomatoes

instructions: Place tomatoes in a 4 quart microwave safe bowl. Cook on high 1 to 1 1/2 minutes, stirring halfway through, to loosen the tomatoes. Transfer the tomatoes and bacon to a baking dish. Sprinkle with nutmeg. Microwave uncovered on center rack of the microwave for 10 minutes, or until the bacon is cooked, but not soft.

Random Ingredients: margarita mix,dressing,lime juice,baking potato,caster sugar,gingerroot,spaghetti sauce

instructions: Prepare 1 tablespoon margarita mix, 1 teaspoon grated gingerroot, ½ teaspoon caster sugar, 1 teaspoon lime juice and spaghetti sauce. Preheat oven to 140°c / 220°f lightly grease a 12 x 9 inch baking sheet.

ingredients: 1 brown rice | 1 bunch fresh kale, washed, stems left on | 1 piece limes, juiced | 1/4 cup oatmeal | 2 tablespoons rice vinegar | 1 tablespoon dark chocolate, grated | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne
instructions: Boil rice until tender. Cut kale into bite sized pieces and steam for about 3 minutes. Put kale in a medium sized pot with the lime juice, rice vinegar, chocolate and cayenne. Heat for about 3 minutes. When ready to serve, remove rice and kale from pot using a strainer.

Random Ingredients: prawn,red pepper flake,tomato soup,black eyed pea
title: Prawns & Black-Eyed Peas (Easy)
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs medium raw prawns, shelled and cleaned | 1 can condensed tomato soup | 1 can diced tomatoes with no added salt | 1/2 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes
instructions: Cook prawns till just cooked, add soup, chillies and broken up tomatoes. Simmer till heated through.

title: Easy Shrimp & Lamb Jerk Tacos
ingredients: 1/2 cup raw shrimp | 2 fresh lamb, skin removed and meat chopped coarsely | 1/2 teaspoon gelatin, unflavored | 1/2 teaspoon chili flakes | 1/2 teaspoon onion powder | 1/4 teaspoon chicken bouillon granules ( i use knorr chicken flavored chicken bouillon ) | 2 romaine lettuce hearts ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Place lamb, shrimp and onion in a bowl, and crush with your hands. Uncover and bake 10 minutes more, or until a knife inserted in the center of the meat comes out clean.

title: BBQ Garlic Naan Bread Roll Ups (21 Day Wonder Diet: Day 14)
ingredients: 24 ounces ready-made ready-made garlic naan bread ( 7 ounce ) | 3 cups self-rising flour | 2 tablespoons honey | 1/2 teaspoon ground ginger | 12 ounces cooked barilla plus deli-style sliced provolone cheese ( 2 ounces. ) | 1/2 teaspoon tabasco sauce | 21 large garlic ( from a 15-oz. box, see note )
instructions: Preheat an outdoor grill for medium high heat. Lightly brush one side of the naan bread with olive oil. Combine the flour, honey and ginger in a medium bowl.
