Top with half of the barilla cheese pieces, half of the bread pieces, half of the barilla cheese pieces and half of the peppermint sprigs and peppermint sprigs. Repeat with the remaining naan, cheese, peppermint and peppermint. Grill the rolls, turning once, until toasted, about 5 minutes. Brush remaining oil evenly over top of bread and serve.

title: Sweet and Spicy Mango Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 cup mango powder | 1 small green pepper, diced
instructions: Mix the mango powder with the green pepper to make the dipping sauce. Let it chill for 1 hour before serving. Serve with pita chips.

title: Totally Easy Baked Pasta.
ingredients: 1 large red cabbage, shredded | 1 medium cucumber, peeled and diced | 7 ounces whole wheat spaghetti, uncooked
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees f. Cook spaghetti per package directions. Mix together with the other ingredients in a lightly greased casserole dish. Toss with the drained spaghetti just prior to serving.

title: Zwt-8 Kale Tartlets - Poblano and Grape Cheese
ingredients: 1 poblano pepper, thinly sliced | 60 ml tzatziki, < a href= '' https : //www.geniuskitchen.com/recipe/tzatziki-dessert-102535 '' > tzatziki < /a > | 1 tablespoon pineapple juice | 200 g grape | 10 g pineapple in juice | 1 tablespoon grand marnier | 120 -250 g shortcrust pastry
instructions: Place poblano on a griddle, turning once or twice while grilling. Grill for 10 minutes, until charred and soft. Place poblano under a hot grill, turning until charred. Remove poblano, let cool slightly then chop into fine pieces. Place cheese in a bowl and cover with tzatziki and pineapple juice. Stir to combine, cover and refrigerate for 2 hours. Preheat oven to 425°f roll out pastry to 12 x 12 rectangle. Cut into 12 rectangles.

title: Chilly Rolls
ingredients: 6 frozen puff pastry sheets ( thawed ) | 1 can tomato soup, undiluted ( soup bones work too ) | 1 can bamboo shoots, drained
instructions: Preheat oven to place thawed pastry sheets on a cookie sheet pan and using a pastry brush, spread tomato soup over pastry. Sprinkle bamboo shoots over this mixture and top with remaining pastry sheet. Bake at 400f degrees for 25 minutes, until golden.

title: Peach and Black-Eyed Pea Salad
ingredients: 2 cans black-eyed peas, drained and rinsed | 1 cucumber, peeled, seeded and diced | 2 peaches, drained, pitted and diced | 1 jar sliced pimientos, drained | 3 tablespoons dry sherry | 1/2 cup dry red wine
instructions: In a large bowl, toss the black eyed peas, cucumber, peaches, pimientos and sherry with the sherry. Cover and marinate in the refrigerator at least one hour before serving.

Random Ingredients: marinara sauce,cinnamon,vegetable broth,thai fish sauce,cooking spray
title: Easy Vietnamese Chicken With Cinnamon & Dipping Sauce
ingredients: cooking spray | 2 tablespoons thai fish sauce | 1 cup reduced-sodium vegetable broth | 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 2 tablespoons thai fish sauce | 1 tablespoon ground cinnamon | 1/4 cup marinara sauce
instructions: Coat a large nonstick skillet with cooking spray and heat over medium high heat until hot.

Random Ingredients: pepper,chili pepper flake,lemon peel,garlic salt,kahlua,vinegar,white wine vinegar,vegetable oil cooking spray
title: Chili Pepper Chips With Kahlua
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 teaspoon dried chili pepper flakes ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon chili pepper flakes ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon garlic salt | 1 teaspoon lemon peel ( chopped fresh or dried peanut ) | 2 tablespoons vinegar or 2 tablespoons rice wine vinegar | 2 cups kahlua | 1/2 cup white wine vinegar, cooled | 1/4 teaspoon pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Coat a 12x6 inch baking dish with cooking spray. In a small bowl, combine chili, chili flakes, garlic salt, lemon peel, vinegar and kahlua or white vinegar. Gently stir in the pepper. Spread spice mixture into baking dish. Bake for about 15 to 20 minutes, until crisp and melted and slightly darkened around edges. Break into pieces when cool. Store in a covered container with a lid for up to 2 months, and up to 4 months.

Random Ingredients: ginger garlic paste,green lentil,milk,salad oil,shiitake mushroom
title: Green Lentils and Shiitake Mushrooms
ingredients: 1/4 lb green lentil | 1 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 1/4 teaspoon dried shiitake mushroom | 3 cups milk | 2 tablespoons salad oil
instructions: Wash and drain green lentils. Cover with water and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and cook for 8 minutes. Drain and reserve liquid. Wipe rice cooker well and use liquid. Add ginger garlic paste, salt and shiitake mushroom.

title: Alfredo's Ultimate Shrimp Fondue
ingredients: 4 pints refrigerated croutons | 2 medium yukon gold onions ( about 3/4 cup ) or 2 medium vidalia onions ( about 3/4 cup ) | 7 ounces cooked shrimp ( peeled, cooked, or pre-cooked shrimp ) | 12 ounces crème fraîche or 12 ounces crème fraîche | 4 ounces superfine sugar | tortilla | 2 -4 tablespoons hazelnuts ( optional ) or 2 -4 tablespoons walnut pieces ( optional )
instructions: Finely dice onions. In large pot bring just enough water to cover onions. Meanwhile chop the shrimp if using. Bring just enough water to cover shrimp. Bring just enough water to cover shrimp, bring just enough water to cover shrimp and bring just enough water to cover shrimp until shrimp are cooked. Do not overcook. Drain shrimp, set aside. In bowl set on table, combine all croutons and other fondue items. Set aside. Dip shrimp into water and dredge into crumbs. Place on cookie sheet or parchment paper until needed. Do not overcrowd the fondue or the fondue will darken when finished. Place in large freezer container or plastic container for up to 3 weeks. Dip shrimp into fondue, add to fondue mixture. Top with crème fraîche and finely diced hazelnuts or walnuts, if desired. Repeat until all fondue has been used.

title: Pumpkin Seeds from France
ingredients: 1 cup pumpkin seeds | 1/2 cup creme fraiche
instructions: Toast the pumpkin seeds in a cast iron skillet, shaking to turn once, until golden brown and fragrant. Watch the skillet carefully so it does not burn. Remove from heat and spread on a towel or in a paper towel lined baking dish towel lined with parchment. To make the crème fraîche, pour the crème fraîche into a bowl and gently stir in the pumpkin seeds. Let sit for a few minutes before serving.

title: Taco Chicken Appetizers
ingredients: 1 roasting chicken, cooked and shredded ( about 1 pound ) | 1 1/2 cups mayonnaise | 1/2 cup taco sauce | 1 scallion, chopped | 1 1/2 tablespoons oil | 1/2 teaspoon baking powder | 2 cloves scallions, sliced | 1 medium carrot, grated
instructions: In a bowl mix the chicken, mayonnaise, taco sauce, scallion, oil, baking powder, scallions, and carrot. Spread in a greased 9 x13 inch pan and bake in a preheated 375 degree f oven for about 40 minutes, or until golden brown.

title: Quick 'n' Easy Portabella Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 mushroom | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce
instructions: Remove the mushroom stems and slice mushrooms thinly. Heat a non stick frying pan over medium high heat until slightly smoking. Add worcestershire sauce.

title: Seasoned Goya Olives
ingredients: 6 green olives, washed, stemmed, and halved
instructions: Place the halved olives onto a square or paper towel under the sink. Soak the olives for 10 to 15 minutes or so. Cover the olives with a towel to keep moist. Heat the oven to 375 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil, and spray with nonstick cooking spray. Spray the olives with cooking spray. Bake in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until all the liquid has evaporated and the skins are slightly charred. Remove from the oven and sprinkle the skins with more seasoning salt to taste. Serve immediately.

title: Crispy Beef and Carrots
ingredients: 600 g beef or 600 g goat cheese | 200 g diced crisp tart apples | 1 tablespoon peanut oil or 1 tablespoon vegetable oil
instructions: Place some water on a high heat to boil. Add in the beef or goat cheese until the cubes are about half way cooked. Dice the crisp tart apples into small bite sized cubes, add to the beef to warm through. Add to the pan with the mixed spices. Continue to stir and let simmer for about 20 minutes, or until almost all the water has evaporated. Turn off the heat and allow it to stand for about 4 minutes before serving.

title: Mustard
ingredients: 3/4 cup plain flour | 1/4 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 1 1 teaspoon dijon mustard or 1 teaspoon other mustard | 1/4 cup coarsely chopped fresh mustard
instructions: Combine dry ingredients. Add mustard. Make sure there is a little oil in the jar. Turn out onto a lightly floured surface. Knead lightly until smooth. Cover and rest for 10 mins. Roll out to ½ inch thickness. Cut into circles using a 6 cm cookie cutter or drinking glass. Place on a baking paper lined baking tray. Cover and flatten with a fork. Mark a slit in center of each biscuit using a fork. Brush with mustard. Bake on a c for 10 - 15 mins, turning them halfway through cooking. They should not be browned. Cool on a wire rack. Store in an airtight container in the fridge.

title: Super Easy and Easy Fish Taco Filling
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs fish or 1 1/2 lbs chicken | 3 tablespoons taco seasoning | 1/4 cup red pepper
instructions: Wash and clean the fish or chicken. Cut the pieces in half and pat dry with paper towels. Pat dry with a clean cloth and coat evenly with taco seasoning. Cut the chili pepper in half and place in a small, non stick, frying pan about 6 - 8 inches long, with 3 - 4 sides. The cut side of the bird should be about three fourths inch from the bottom of the pan. Turn the heat down medium low and heat for about 5 minutes. Turn the heat if necessary. Add the fish pieces and pat them dry with a clean cloth. Place the fish in a lightly oiled non stick frying pan on the low setting and lightly fry until all of the pieces are browned and crisp, about 2 minutes. Turn the heat back up to medium high, add the red pepper to the pan and continue to fry until the peppers are blackened in spots and a little crispy about 1 minute more. Turn off the heat and serve. It can also be served at once.

title: Greek - Ancho Chicken Stew
ingredients: 4 lbs stewing beef | 2 cans anchovies, drained | 2 teaspoons mixed spice | 1 teaspoon marjoram | 2 teaspoons anchovies | 3 lbs stewing chicken, skin on | 20 cups frozen peas, cooked
instructions: Place the chicken in the pot on low heat and sprinkle the anchovies, mixed spice, marjoram and anchovies around the chicken and then add enough water to cover. Put the lid on, add the peas and simmer about 3 hours. If the liquid gets boiling too quickly, take the lid off, turn up the heat and simmer, stirring occasionally until the stew is thickened.

title: Pignoli Caramel (Sweet Martini)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons finely ground pine nuts | 1/3 cup finely crushed caramel solids
instructions: Combine pine nuts and 1/3 cup of grated peel in heatproof bowl. Gently stir in caramel. Cool completely, then store in refrigerator.

title: Halloween Spiced Brisket
ingredients: 3 lbs beef brisket or 3 lbs beef chuck roast | 12 dried figs, cut in half | 4 whole cloves | 1/2 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1 medium yellow squash, cut in half
instructions: Place brisket in large pot or roasting pan. Wash and strip the fat from the meat. Cut the figs into small pieces. Put figs into pan with meat. Stud the cinnamon sticks or whole cloves in the meat. Add remaining ingredients. Cover and simmer over low heat until meat is tender, about 3 hours or until beef and vegetables are very tender. Remove meat and discard the spices and fat from liquid and remove the meat and vegetables. Rinse with cold water and slice 1/2 inch thick. To serve, arrange slices on plate and cover with sauce. Garnish with a sprinkling of orange colored sugar.

title: Spiced Beef Strips
ingredients: 500 g beef mince | 1 tablespoon tom's soya sweet sherry | 2 teaspoons shiitake paste or 2 teaspoons chili paste | 250 g fresh breadcrumbs
instructions: Mix all ingredients together well in bowl except crumbs. Add crumbs and mix carefully together. Shape into 4 patties. Broil or grill until cooked and brown. Serve with steamed vegetables and hot chutney.

title: Rabri Roti (Cashew Roti)
ingredients: 3 1/2 cups sifted semolina flour | 1 1/4 cups finely crushed fried dried fruit ( prunes, dates, apricots, hazelnuts, figs or figs ) | 1 1/2 cups freshly-grated pecorino cheese | 2 tablespoons dijon mustard | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried oregano leaves or 1 1/2 teaspoons dried mixed fruit | 1 teaspoon saffron | 1/3 cup cashews or 1/3 cup walnut pieces
instructions: Sift semolina flour onto a clean kitchen cloth. Add 1 1/4 cup flour, nut and mustard to the semolina flour. Knead lightly. Add remaining ingredients and knead well. Do not overmix. Cover and allow to rest for 20 minutes. Divide the mixture into about 4 equal portions. Divide each into 4 equal portions. Flatten each portion. Press 2 pitillas in circular motion on a large clean cloth, to contain air pockets. Flatten each portion. Serve hot or cold.

title: Roasted Potato & Salmon With Variations
ingredients: 200 g red potatoes ( about 3 small ) | 50 g salmon ( cut into 4 portions and skin removed )
instructions: Place the potato on a medium tray with the skin side up. Score the skin of each piece of salmon using a very sharp knife. Place on a grill or in a grill pan. Cover with aluminum foil and bake in a preheated oven for about 20 - 30 mins, or until the skin has turned crispy & flesh has started coming off the skin.

Random Ingredients: curry leaf,cherry tomato,vegetable broth,farfalle pasta,cilantro leaf,linguine
title: Linguine with Spicy Tomato-Curry Soup
ingredients: 1 package linguine | 4 cups vegetable broth | 1 pound cherry tomatoes, halved | 12 fresh curry leaves | 3 cups chopped fresh cilantro leaves | 1 package farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta
instructions: Fill a large soup pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, stir in the linguine and return to a boil. Cook the pasta uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the pasta has cooked through, but is still firm to the bite, about 13 minutes. Drain well in a colander set in the sink. Bring the vegetable broth to a boil in a pot. Add the chopped cherry tomatoes.

Random Ingredients: canadian bacon,ra el hanout spice mix,peanut butter
title: Roasted Red, White & Black Canadian Bacon With Pecans
ingredients: 8 slices canadian bacon | 8 teaspoons canadian bacon fat ( reserved from canadian bacon slices ) | 1/2 cup peanut butter
instructions: Lay the slices of canadian bacon on a flat, rimmed baking sheet. Combine the black cavities of the canadian bacon and canadian bacon fat in a food processor and pulse until you have a coarse mixture. Spread the peanut butter on the crumb crust. Drizzle the pecan mixture evenly on the pepper butter.

Random Ingredients: swiss cheese,button mushroom,heavy whipping cream,farfalle pasta
title: Farfalle with Swiss Cheese and Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 package farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta | 1 package sliced button mushrooms | 1 package shredded swiss cheese | 1/3 cup heavy whipping cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook pasta for 8 to 10 minutes, or until al dente.

title: Quick Taco Soup
ingredients: 1 pound ground beef | 2 cups corn kernels | 1 package taco seasoning
instructions: Cook the ground beef and taco seasoning in a large pot over medium heat until meat is browned and crumbly, 10 to 10 minutes. Add corn and continue cooking, stirring occasionally, until the corn is hot, about 5 minutes. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: extra virgin olive oil,grenadine,mirin,puff pastry,cheese,custard powder,chilies,soya sauce
title: Chilli Puff Pastry (Gluten Free)
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons unflavored gelatin | 1 tablespoon olive oil | 1 teaspoon sweet soya sauce | 2 fresh chilies or 2 dried red chillies | 2 tablespoons light soya sauce | 2 teaspoons mirin or 2 teaspoons cooking sherry | 1 cup tasty cheese ( optional ) | 3 tablespoons pastry cream or 3 tablespoons custard powder, see note
instructions: Sprinkle gelatin over a small saucepan of boiling water and allow to soften for 1 minute. Dissolve the soy sauce in mirin. Dip chillies into warm water, set aside, until softened, drain. Cut pastry into 4 squares. Firmly press each square into the base of a 12 inch tartlet tin. Prick pie in the top of the tartlet tin to vent steam. Preheat oven to 350f degrees. Stir glaze ingredients into gelatin mixture and mix well. Pour mix into tartlet tin which has been sprayed with cooking spray. Bake for 25 minutes, or until golden brown. Serve with cheese, if desired.

title: E.Z. Spicy Glazing Sausages - Kielbasa
ingredients: 1 link sausage | 1/3 cup golden syrup
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Brown sausage in a skillet over medium heat. Pour the golden syrup into a baking dish. Cut the sausage in thirds diagonally with a very sharp knife. Cut in half diagonally to make 12 pieces. Lay sausage and syrup pieces in the baking dish. Bake sausage covered with aluminum foil for 25 minutes. Turn sausage over, and bake for 15 more minutes.

title: Chef John's Pita Chips
ingredients: 2 ounces fresh yeast | 3 1/2 cups beef broth | 1/2 cup queso anejo, crumbled ( or other mexican crumb ) | 6 cups plain crushed olives | 3 large egg whites | 3 1/2 teaspoons ground cardamom seeds until powder | 1/2 teaspoon ground allspice
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Dissolve yeast in 1/2 cup broth.

Random Ingredients: radish,ziti pasta,shallot,farfalle pasta,cucumber,snow pea,black mustard seed
title: Ziti Salad With Vegetables
ingredients: 1 lb uncooked ziti pasta or 1 lb other long tubular pasta | 1 cup shallot, coarsely chopped | 1 zucchini, chopped ( about 1.5 c. ) | 1/3 cup vegetable oil or 1/3 cup extra virgin olive oil | 2 tablespoons black mustard seeds | 1/2 lb snow peas, washed and cleaned | 1/2 cucumbers - peeled, seeded and thinly sliced or 1/2 english cucumber, peeled, seeded and thinly sliced
instructions: Cook the pasta according to the package directions, omitting any oil or cooking liguid, drain and place in large mixing bowl. Add the shallots, zucchini, oil, mustard seeds and snow peas. Toss to coat. Chill, covered, at least 4 hours and up to two days. Just before serving, toss with the vegetables. The dressing keeps well for up to several days, if refrigerated.

title: Brown Rice Broccoli for One With One
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups uncooked brown rice, steamed according to directions | 1 package frozen broccoli florets, thawed
instructions: Pierce all over with fork and reserve. Spray a 12 cup or larger, ovenproof skillet with cooking spray. Place rice in skillet, and coat with cooking spray. Sprinkle with vegetables. Bake 30 minutes in a 400° degree oven, covering loosely with foil halfway through cooking.

Random Ingredients: saffron strand,celery salt,serrano chili,peanut butter,jiffy cornbread mix,brown sugar,egg noodle,sun tomato oil
title: Vegetable Crunch
ingredients: 8 ounces jiffy cornbread mix | 3/4 teaspoon saffron strand ( if using dried saffron, break up the threads using a fork ) | 1 teaspoon celery salt ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil ( not oil packed ) | 1 tablespoon peanut butter | 1/4 cup brown sugar | 2 large eggs ( or 2 egg ) | 4 serrano chili | 4 -9 ounces egg noodles, cooked, drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. In medium bowl, combine cereal ingredients and mix well. Stir in tomatoes, peanut butter, and brown sugar until well combined. Transfer cereal mixture to a floured surface and knead well, adding more cereal at a time if necessary to form a firm dough. Shape into a ball, place on a lightly greased baking sheet, and flatten slightly. Bake for 15 minutes. Transfer to a rack and allow to cool.

title: Tilapia
ingredients: 2 tablespoons butter or 2 tablespoons oil | 1 can pinto beans, rinsed, drained | 1/8 teaspoon almonds, coarsely chopped | 1/8 teaspoon flour
instructions: Melt butter in a saucepan. Saute beans until heated through. Sprinkle in almonds, fry another minute or so. Sprinkle with flour and stir.

title: Tiramisu
ingredients: 25 g chopped fresh herbs, ie. such as tarragon, chives and basil | 35 g gin | 200 g whole milk ricotta cheese | 5 slices white bread, buttered and crusts removed
instructions: Put the chopped herbs into a bowl, add the gin and let it boil for a minute or two, then remove from heat and cool slightly. In a large bowl, mash the ricotta with a fork. Add the herbs and the cheese mixture, stir well to combine. Butter and flour the bread and cut a horizonal slice from one end, carefully, to keep the wedge from running off. Cut slices of bread in half and arrange them on a tray.

Random Ingredients: sharp cheddar cheese,dijon mustard,gruyere cheese,pizza sauce
title: Easy Pizza Cheddar
ingredients: 1/2 cup pizza sauce, your favourite | 2 tablespoons dijon mustard | 2 tablespoons grated sharp cheddar cheese | 1 tablespoon shaved gruyere cheese
instructions: Put pizza sauce in a small bowl and add mustard and cheddar. Add shaved gruyere and mix until you are happy. Spoon onto pizza base or onto stone if using stone put 1/4 pizza sauce in to preheated oven for 5 mins then sprinkle a little cheese over the top. Cook in oven for about 20 min at 200c for about 10 mins til bubbly.

title: Budjabi
ingredients: 3 tablespoons ginger-garlic paste | 1 1/2 teaspoons vinegar
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together in a small bowl. Add as many spoonsfuls of the marinade as you like to avoid lumps. Keep them covered in a cool place or in the fridge for 3 days before eating as a snack. Serve with your favourite vegetable of your choice.

title: Chile Crab
ingredients: 1/2 lb ground crabmeat | 1/2 cup chunky salsa
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. In a small skillet over medium heat, cook crab meat until firm. Drain crab meat, return to pan and stir in salsa. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: nutmeg,pepperoncini pepper,flour tortilla,stewing beef,egg substitute,sushi rice,white balsamic vinegar,soya sauce
title: Beef Teriyaki Wrap
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef | 12 ounces egg substitute | 1/2 cup soya sauce | 3 tablespoons white balsamic vinegar | 3 tablespoons soya sauce | 1 teaspoon pepperoncini pepper | 1/2 teaspoon nutmeg | 4 6-inch flour tortillas | cooked sushi rice
instructions: Place beef in a large saucepan and add broth, juice, vinegar, soy sauce, pepperoncini, nutmeg, and mix well. Bring to a boil and then lower heat to a simmer and cook for 2 1/2 hours. Shred beef and discard solids. Place meat and soya sauce in the fridge for 15 - 20 minutes to marinate. Place flour tortillas lengthwise on a work surface. Spread one side with 1 tbsp of meat marinade. Roll meat mixture lengthwise, tucking in each side as though you are rolling up. Place seam side down on paper towel lined baking sheet. Repeat until wraps are all filled and rolled. Heat vegetable spray in a nonstick pan over medium high heat until very hot. Quickly brown wraps on each side until lightly browned. Place on plate and drizzle with remaining marinade. Top with nori cheese if desired. Serve with your favorite oriental dish.

Random Ingredients: baguette,rice vermicelli,salt,pearl barley,lamb,black eyed pea,kernel corn
title: Lamb & Corn Baked in Rice Vermicelli
ingredients: 1 lb ground lamb | 1 cup pearl barley | 1 jar whole kernel corn, drained and rinsed, about 3/4 c | 1 baguette ( small thick slices ) | 1/2 teaspoon salt, divided | 1 can black eye peas, rinsed, drained | 1 baguette, slices cut into 1/2-thick slices, cut diagonally into 4 slices, about 32 pieces
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. In a large skillet, crumble lamb and cook over medium high heat until mostly cooked, about 5 minutes. Stir in pearl barley, corn and 2 cups water. Transfer to a casserole dish. Bake until barley is tender and most of liquid has been absorbed, about 40 to 45 minutes. Meanwhile fill baguette slices with about 1/2 cup cooled barley mixture. Carefully transfer to a baking sheet and top each with 1 slice diagonally. Bake until golden brown, about 5 minutes. Serve with remaining barley mixture.

title: Homemade Beef Stock
ingredients: 1 gallon vegetable stock | 1/4 cup fresh thyme, plus more for garnish
instructions: Prepare your chosen seasoning, mix, and let sit for 24 hours in a colander for easy handling and storage. Use within 1 month. If you must keep the neck of your roast in place, it should not be visible during cooking.

title: Mexican Party Cherry Salsa
ingredients: 1 can pitted sour cherry | 1 package taco seasoning | 1/2 jar pitted kalamata olives with pimento peppers, drained
instructions: Drain and stir cherry pieces with taco seasoning in a saucepan over medium heat until heated through, about 5 minutes. Pour cherry mixture into a serving plate. Top with Kalamata olives.

Random Ingredients: lasagna noodle,apricot jam,habanero pepper,marsala,cheddar cheese,extra virgin olive oil
title: Apricot-Habanero Lasagna
ingredients: 12 lasagna noodles, uncooked | 4 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 2 1/2 tablespoons apricot jam | 1 habanero pepper, minced | 1 marsala, scented ( sweet liqueur ) | 1 1/2 cups cheddar cheese, shredded
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Bring 2 quarts of salted water to a boil. Add pasta and cook until just tender, about 15 minutes. Drain and cool. Heat olive oil in a separate saucepan over medium heat. Stir in apricot jam and cook until it begins to bubble. Remove from heat. Place habanero pepper in a medium bowl. Add marsala and stir to coat. Spread a thin layer of olive paste atop each pasta half, and top with a layer of cheese. Repeat layers of pasta and sauce until baking dishes is full. Cover tightly with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes. Remove foil and bake 5 minutes more until cheese is browned and bubbly.

title: Cauliflower Beef Wraps
ingredients: 2 teaspoons garlic salt | 1 1/2 lbs flank steaks, thinly sliced | 1 1/2 teaspoons cilantro leaves, snipped | 1 package rice noodles ( such as conchiglie shells ) | 1 cup raisins | 1 can prepared salsa, divided | chopped fresh cilantro leaves ( for garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Sprinkle the garlic salt over the steak. Cover and refrigerate 12 hours or overnight. Meanwhile, drain the noodles or soak them in enough water to cover for 15 minutes or until tender. Drain well. Rinse under cold water. Drain again and allow to sit until ready to use. Bring a pot of water to a boil and drain noodles 3 or 4 at a time. Place noodles in a large bowl of ice water to stop the cooking process. Drain and transfer to a colander to drain. Wipe out the colander. Pat the steak dry with paper towels. Cut diagonally across the grain into about 1/4 inch to 1/2 inch wide shreds. Arrange the meat on a large serving platter. Douse with half the noodles or salsa. Top with half the raisins, 1/2 cup salsa, 1 tablespoon cilantro and more salsa. Using a slotted spatula, remove the meat to a serving platter. Slice across the grain in the other direction. Arrange the remaining noodles on a large platter. Repeat with remaining meat strips to make 4 wraps. Garnish with cilantro leaves, if desired.

Random Ingredients: red chili pepper flake,currant,baking potato,parsnip,chili sauce,egg white,rum
title: St. Patrick's Day Festive Hot Potatoes
ingredients: 2 lbs baking potatoes, peeled | 1 lb parsnip, peeled and cut into 1 inch chunks | 3 eggs, white & yolks well beaten | 1/2 cup dried currant, soaked in hot water for about 1/2 hour, drain and reserve | 1/2 cup fresh coriander or 1/2 cup basil, chopped | 1/2 cup sweet red chili pepper flakes | 2/3 cup sweet chili sauce | 3 tablespoons rum or 3 tablespoons brandy
instructions: Prepare potatoes, peel, dice and boil in a large pot of cold water until tender, about 20 minutes.

title: Roasted Red Pepper & Orange Peel Butter
ingredients: 2 large red bell peppers, washed, stems removed, roasted and peeled | 2 small oranges, peeled, ends trimmed, washed, pith removed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f and put 1/2 cup of the bell pepper seeds inside an oven safe saucepan. Cut the remaining peppers lengthwise into strips, place them on a baking sheet, drizzle with the reserved oil. Roast the pepper strips in the oven for 40 minutes, checking often to mix the peppers around. Remove from oven and turn the heat down to 375 degrees f and roast for an additional 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: chili pepper,saffron,cremini mushroom,marinade,oregano,potato,orange juice concentrate,pearl barley
title: Vegan Mexican Rice with Orange Barley
ingredients: 5 cups water | 1/2 teaspoon saffron | 1 teaspoon dried oregano | 1/4 teaspoon saffron | 2 small potatoes, peeled and chopped | 1/2 cup pearl barley, soaked | 1/2 cup frozen orange juice concentrate, thawed | 1 package sliced cremini mushrooms | 2 1/2 cups marinade, for stir-frying
instructions: Heat water, saffron, oregano, saffron, potatoes, and barley to a boil in a saucepan. Decrease heat to low and simmer, covered, until most of the liquid has been absorbed, 15 to 20 minutes. Stir in frozen orange juice concentrate.

title: Easy Baked Potato Squash Skillet #RSC
ingredients: 2 - 2 1/2 lbs yellow squash, peeled | 1 bunch sauerkraut, rinsed | 1/2 cup long grain white rice or 1/2 cup brown rice | 1 teaspoon coarse grain mustard | 14 ounces frozen blueberries
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Cut each squash lengthwise into 8 wedges. Place the wedges on a baking sheet in single layer. Bake at 450 degrees f. Meanwhile, bring a large pot of water to a boil over high heat. Add the rice and cook until golden about 12 minutes. Immediately drain. Immediately toss everything together in a large bowl. Place the sauerkraut in a shallow baking dish and cover with the crispy rice. Bake at 450 degrees f for 15 minutes or until heated through and bubbly around the edges.

title: Mushroom Bruschetta
ingredients: 8 cups button mushrooms, sliced, about 2 to 3 cups | 2 -3 lbs baguette | 2 -3 teaspoons hot pepper sauce ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Brush baguette with a couple tablespoons of hot pepper sauce. Place on baking sheet and cut baguette in half diagonally, about 8 to 10 slices per sandwich, depending on thickness of bread and the length of the baguette. Arrange mushrooms on baguette, sprinkle generously with pepper sauce and bake until baguette is light golden brown and bubbly, about 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Crisp Sausage With Thyme Rub on Sausages
ingredients: 2 links thick and link sausage | 1 teaspoon sea salt | 1 teaspoon coarse grainy mustard
instructions: First make the thyme rub by mixing all the ingredients together in a large dry bowl. When ready to cook, preheat the oven to 200c/180c /gas wash a large frying pan. Brush the sausages with a little oil and roast for 8 - 10 minutes until well cooked but not dark brown. Remove the sausages from the pan and transfer to a warmed individual dish. Spoon the thyme over the sausages allowing the excess to drip off. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: vanilla extract,navy bean,cayenne powder,beef brisket,poblano pepper,spring onion,cherry tomato
title: Mexican-Style Brisket With Beans and Tomatoes
ingredients: 1/2 1/2 lb beef brisket or 1/2 lb boneless pork butt | 2 cups cooked navy beans | 2 cups grape tomatoes | 1/4 cup minced spring onion | 3 poblano peppers | 1 1/2 teaspoons paprika ( smoked paprika is preferred for added color ) | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne powder | 1/4 teaspoon pure vanilla extract
instructions: Place beans on a double layer of cheesecloth, along with meat, and tie securely. The beans should be tightly sealed, but not too tight. Bring to a simmer in a large pot. Meanwhile, make the sauce. Slice the meat into thin strips, about 1 inch wide. Place meat in a 4 quart dutch oven, and add enough water to cover. Bring to a simmer over medium heat, and add tomatoes, and onion. Bring back to a simmer. Cover, and transfer to a double thickness of double thickness of aluminum foil. Bake for 30 minutes. Meanwhile, toast chilies in a dry skillet over medium heat, stirring constantly. Strain liquid from cooking liquid and set aside. After 30 minutes, remove meat from pot, saving liquid. Pour off liquid. Rinse chilies under cold running water, and set aside. Remove all of meat from pot. Remove seeds, and ribs from chilies, discard. Cut into strips about 1/4 inch wide and set aside. Dice chili pepper into small pieces. Remove seeds, stems, and veins with a spoon, and set aside. Add paprika, cayenne, and vanilla, if using, to beans and simmer for 30 minutes, stirring frequently. Meanwhile, toast and tear chilies into shreds, about 1 teaspoon. Stir into the pot and cook for 15 minutes. Serve over rice. Serve with hot pepper sauce.

title: Tamari Beef Burger Sauce
ingredients: 2 teaspoons tamari ( for dipping ) | 1 teaspoon garlic salt ( for dipping ) | 1 lean hamburger buns, split
instructions: Combine tamari in a shallow baking dish. Add garlic salt to cover. Dip each slice of buns in the mixture until both sides are nicely covered. Allow to sit for approximately 10 seconds before using.

title: Chick Pea Salad - Oriental
ingredients: 400 g chickpeas, fresh ( reserve any liquid ) | 2 teaspoons icing sugar ( confectioner's sugar ) | 2 teaspoons shoyu ( soy sauce ) | 2 teaspoons coarse grain dijon mustard
instructions: Boil water, add 1tsp rice flour and cook on low heat. Cook until chickpeas are fork tender and cooked through. Strain chickpeas and run through sieve to remove seeds and excess liquid or rinse in a strainer. Mix the chickpeas, icing sugar, shoyu, mustard and 3tsp of the reserved liquid. Put back on heat and stir until it boils. Turn onto a warm plate and sprinkle with remaining icing sugar.

title: Beef With Strawberry
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless beef chuck, cut into thin slices | 2 cups strawberries, halved | 5 scallions, cut into 1 inch lengths | 1 cup coriander leaves, roughly chopped | 1 lb pear, peeled, cored and roughly chopped | 1/2 cup capers, drained | 1/2 cup chicken thigh, cut into small cubes
instructions: Put the beef in a large flameproof casserole and scatter over the strawberries, scallions, coriander and pear. Pour enough boiling water into the dish to just cover the meat, and bring to the boil. Reduce the heat and simmer, covered, for 1 hour to 1 hour and 50 minutes to 2 hours. Add the capers and cook for a further 30 minutes. Serve with crusty bread.

Random Ingredients: apple cider,green pepper,red pepper flake,chicken drumstick,apple juice
title: Spanish Apple-Braised Chicken
ingredients: 2 tablespoons apple cider | 4 chicken drumsticks, split | 1/2 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 1/2 cup apple juice | 1/4 cup apple cider | 1/2 cup chopped green pepper | 1/4 cup finely chopped red pepper flakes
instructions: In a large nonporous glass dish, combine apple cider, drumsticks and crushed red pepper. Cover tightly with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight. The next day, remove chicken from marinade. Place chicken in foil lined 5x9 inch baking dish. In the morning, pour apple cerveice juice and apple cider over chicken and sprinkle with green peppers and red pepper flakes. Cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour, or until chicken is ready to be served.

Random Ingredients: italian tomato,lamb,lettuce leaf,cooking apple,heavy cream,asafoetida powder,stewing beef
title: Fried Stuffed Beef
ingredients: 1/2 lb stewing beef, sliced | cooking apple, diced fine ( about 1/2 ) | 1 teaspoon asafoetida powder, added to beef | 2 tablespoons heavy cream | 2 teaspoons italian crushed tomatoes ( i prefer hunts ) | 3 large lettuce leaves | 4 large lettuce leaves
instructions: In a small bowl, combine cream, salt and asafoetida. Mince beef and add to cream mixture. Stir and heat till beef begins to brown, a couple of minutes. Add tomatoes and adjust seasoning to taste. Heat a large skillet over medium heat and add beef mixture. Stuff each leaf with 1 1/2 to 3 tablespoons of beef mixture and arrange on a flat platter. Serve with lettuce.

title: Potato Pudding (Mark Bittman)
ingredients: 2 large baking potatoes | 125 g walnuts | 1 1/2 cups brown sugar
instructions: Peel and cube the baking potatoes. Bake the oven at 180 degrees celsius for approximately 45 - 60 minutes, depending on how large and crunchy they are. Add the walnuts and brown sugar into a pan. Cook for about 5 - 10 minutes until the sugars have melted. Pudding will have a bit of bite.

title: Italian Bread Pecan Tea Wraps
ingredients: 3 eggs | 3 cups unbleached flour tortillas | 1 cup italian bread crumbs | 1/2 cup light pecans | 2 tablespoons instant tea | 1 cup triple cream | mirin ( optional )
instructions: Combine eggs and 2 cups of water and set aside. In another bowl or deep plate, sift the flour, bread crumbs & tea. Set aside. Beat egg mixture in a 2 quart saucepan until blended. Gradually stir in the cream & pecans. Turn heat to medium. Cook for 3 - 4 minutes, or until thickened. Turn off heat. Spoon half the pecan mixture onto a tortilla. Roll tortilla with a wide, pointed spatula. Place in a large plate. Repeat with remaining tortillas, pecans and filling. Place 1 tortilla at a time on a plastic wrap & roll into a cylinder. Serve right away & refrigerate.

title: Healthy Sausage and Spinach Noodle Bake
ingredients: 1 lb bulk italian sausage | 2 jars pasta shells ( any type ) | 16 ounces frozen chopped spinach, thawed and drained | 1 package lipton noodles or ( 10 ounce ) package your favorite dry pasta | 1 package uncooked mini steaks, cut in 1/2 or 1/2-inch thick slices | 2 -4 teaspoons rice vinegar | 1 cup light cornmeal
instructions: Remove meat from casings and crumble into a large skillet. Stir in spinach, noodles, and steak.

title: Garlicky Roasted Poblano Chile (Skewers)
ingredients: 4 poblano chiles | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala | fresh thyme sprig | 1 teaspoon garam masala
instructions: Preheat the broiler to high. Brush poblanos with 1/2 tsp garam masala. Place peppers under broiler and char on all sides. Transfer the poblanos to a rimmed baking sheet. Drizzle with remaining 1/2 tsp garam masala. Place under the broiler and char until the chiles are charred, about 4 minutes. Sprinkle chiles with thyme and additional 1/4 tsp garam masala, if desired. Transfer to a wire rack to cool. Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Simple Baked Basket (Slow-Roasted Roast)
ingredients: 8 medium fresh beats | 2 lbs fresh pork roast
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Wash beats. Place meat in a large bowl with cold water, or enough to cover meat completely. Bring water to a boil and then immediately remove from heat. Place the basket on a rack in a roasting pan that has been sprayed with cooking spray. Fill the bowl with cold water until the water reaches about 1/2 the depth of the rack. Using a meat thermometer, carefully reach the top of the pan and quickly tap the surface of the meat to release steam. Continue testing the water level until the water is about 2/3 to 3/4 of the height of the rack above the surface of the meat. Bake until the meat is extremely tender and falls apart when pierced with a fork, about 2 hours. When the meat is almost tender, transfer the meat to a platter and cover loosely with foil. Continue to braise until the meat is very tender, adding cold water when necessary.

Random Ingredients: chili sauce,corn tortilla chip,self raising flour,blueberry,pork chop
title: Blueberry Pork Sausages With Blueberry Sauce (Can Be Gluten Free)
ingredients: 500 g pork chops | 2 teaspoons self-raising flour or 2 teaspoons gluten-free flour, combined with equal quantities of cold water to form a thin paste | 2 teaspoons sweet chili sauce or 2 teaspoons hot chili sauce | 100g baby fresh blueberries or 100g raspberry tomatoes, halved | 250 g self-raising flour or 250 g gluten-free flour, sifted | 2 tablespoons sweet chili sauce | 310 g corn tortilla chips
instructions: Spray an oven tray with oil and preheat to 200'c / 400'f / gas. Combine pork chops with the gluten free flour or gluten free mixture and stir until the pork is coated in the flour or gluten free flour. Heat a little water in a large frying pan or wok and cook the pork until browned. Use a spatula to transfer the pork to a plate and set aside. Reduce the heat slightly and add the sweet chilli sauce. Cook until boiling, then stir in the blueberries. Cook for 2 minutes or until the blueberry sauce has just set and then stir in the crumbled blueberry mixture. Return the pork to the pan and coat in the sauce and cook for 3 minutes or until heated through. Serve with plain boiled rice biscuits or gluten free bread.

Random Ingredients: white onion,deli ham,lima bean,creme de menthe
title: Lima Bean and Ham Salad
ingredients: 3 cans lima beans, drained and rinsed | 6 slices deli ham | 1 cup white onion, chopped | 1/2 cup creme de menthe or pancake syrup
instructions: Place lima beans in large bowl. Add ham slices and onion.

Random Ingredients: mustard seed,red curry paste,colby monterey jack cheese,rotel,salt
title: Santa Fe Curried Colby Jack Cheese
ingredients: 1 package colby-monterey jack cheese, sliced into rounds | 1 can rotel or other hot mexican-style stewed tomatoes | 1 1/2 tablespoons red curry paste ( or to taste ) | 1/2 teaspoon mustard seeds | salt
instructions: Put a large skillet over medium high heat. Pour all the ingredients into the skillet without breaking the cheese, and cook until cheese is melted, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Allow to sit 5 minutes, and slice into bite sized pieces.

Random Ingredients: mustard,urad dal,white rice,carrot,hot red pepper flake,olive,confectioner sugar,pineapple juice
title: Luscious Curry
ingredients: 1/2 cup olive | 1 1/2 cups white rice | 1/4 cup vegetable cooking oil or 1/4 cup olive oil | 1 tablespoon mustard or 1 tablespoon prepared mustard | 2 hot red pepper flakes, crushed | 1 1/2 cups diced carrots | 1 cup chopped drained canned fruit including juice | 1 cup unsweetened pineapple juice | 1 cup confectioners'sugar
instructions: Add a splash of olive oil to a very hot pan, then add the rice and mix in your spices and vegetables. Let saute for about 2 minutes. Add the pineapple juice and mix and allow the mixture to simmer until the rice and vegetables are tender and the liquids have fully absorbed into the rice. Pour the rice into a serving bowl then cover and chill.

Random Ingredients: mace,vanilla ice cream,vodka,tortilla,tortilla chip,green bell pepper,meat,green cardamom pod
title: Sailor's Tortilla Soup
ingredients: 1 pound ground meat | 2 green bell pepper, chopped | 14 green cardamom pods | 1/8 teaspoon ground mace | 2 tablespoons vodka | 2 containers meat flavored tortilla chips | 3 cups vanilla ice cream | 1 cup crushed tortilla chips
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add the ground meat, and cook, stirring frequently, until pork crumbles and is no longer pink, about 15 minutes. Drain excess fat. Stir in the bell peppers, cardamom pods, mace, and vodka. Simmer until flavors are well blended, about 20 minutes. Drain tortilla chip strips on paper towels. To serve, divide the tortilla chips among serving bowls. Ladle soup over the tortilla chips. Top with crushed tortilla chips.

Random Ingredients: pumpkin puree,swordfish steak,brown rice,pecorino romano cheese,baguette,quinoa
title: Pumpkin and Quinoa Gratine
ingredients: 1 baguette, cut into 5 thin slices | 1 1/2 cups pumpkin puree | 1 lb sweet potatoes, peeled and cut into 2 inch pieces | 1 1/2 cups cooked rice | 1 1/2 cups freshly grated pecorino romano cheese | 1/2 cup quinoa, prepared according to package directions
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Lightly oil a 1 pound bone in, 2 inch diameter skillet over medium heat. When pan is hot, add baguette slices and stir for 2 to 3 minutes.

title: Fusilli Salad With Tortilla Chips and Tuna
ingredients: 12 ounces fusilli, uncooked | 1 pinch salt | 1/2 cup cream of tartar | 12 ounces grilled and flaked salted tuna ( about 3/4 pound ) | 8 ounces sour cream | 3 tablespoons whipping cream | parmigiano-reggiano cheese or grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese ( to garnish )
instructions: Cook fusilli according to package directions.

Random Ingredients: red snapper,stewing beef,oil,lime wedge,bell pepper,lettuce leaf,green apple
title: Spicy Beef Stew-Dried Beef on a Dollar

instructions: In a heavy 8 - 10 skillet, heat oil over medium heat. Add beef and cook, stirring, until browned. Remove beef and set aside. Simmer, stirring occasionally, until the sauce is thick. Serve over lettuce leaves.

Random Ingredients: seasoning salt,italian parsley,walnut half,green capsicum,chive,dijon mustard,chicken thigh

Random Ingredients: bay leaf,stewing beef,parmesan cheese,shrimp paste,mace,almond extract

Serve from the pan. Variation, instead of beef, you can add lamb, chicken or veg to a soup and serve it as a meat stew.

Random Ingredients: vinegar,nonfat cream,thyme leaf,sea salt,pepper,garam masala,penne pasta,garlic
title: Baked Penne Pasta Salad

instructions: Preheat oven to cook pasta according to package directions, drain, and cool. In a large bowl, combine sauce ingredients and mix well or whisk until combined. title: Tart Apples and Tions Salad
ingredients: 3 small tart apples | 1/2 small onion, finely diced | 1 teaspoon sumac | 1 head iceberg lettuce | 2 tablespoons of melted sweeten condensed sweeten condensed sweetened condensed sweetened condensed condensed sweetened condensed sweetened condensed sweetened condensed sweetened condensed sweetened sweetened condensed sweetened condensed sweetened condensed sweetened sweetened condensed sweetened condensed sweetened sweetened condensed sweetened sweetened sweetened condensed sweetened sweetened condensed condensed sweetened sweetened condensed sweetened sweetened condensed sweetened sweetened condensed condensed sweetened condensed sweetened sweetened condensed sweetened sweetened condensed sweetened sweetened sweetened condensed sweetened condensed sweetened sweetened condensed sweetened sweetened sweetened condensed sweetened sweetened condensed sweetened condensed sweetens condensed milk | 6 slices prosciutto
instructions: Core and trim the apples and slice them into 8 thick slices. Cook the apples in boiling water for 6 minutes, remove and let cool slightly. Boil the apples with the onion, sweetened condensed sweetened condensed and sweetened condensed sweetened sweetener for about 10 minutes, remove and cool slightly. Place the lettuce on 6 plates, drizzle with the melted sweetened condensed sweetened condensed sweetened condensed sweetened condensed sweetened sweetened condensed sweetened condensed sweetened condensed sweetened condensed sweetened condensed condensed sweetened condensed sweetened sweetened condensed sweetened condensed sweetened condensed milk and the prosciutto slices. Roll up the apples and secure them with toothpicks or with cocktail sticks in a bag. Drizzle a small amount of the melted sweetened condensed condense sweetened condensed sweetened condensed sweet milk over the top. Enjoy.

title: BBQ Barley and Artichoke Dip
ingredients: 1 can artichoke ( marinated ) | 1/2 cup barley | 1 lime ( peeled & grated ) | 1 cup cheese ( shredded ) | 1 teaspoon hot sauce
instructions: Place all in crockpot and cook on low. Serve with tortilla chips or as a dip for veggies, meat crackers or veggies.

Random Ingredients: beet,raspberry,spinach leaf,plain nonfat yogurt,celery seed,ice cube,tomato green chile
title: A-Plus Vegetable Juice Salad
ingredients: 2 large tomatoes and green chiles, diced | 12 small fresh spinach leaves, rinsed and torn | 1/2 cup thinly sliced celery seed | 6 raspberries, cut in half | 1/2 cup diced pickled beet | 1/3 cup plain nonfat yogurt, beaten | ice cube
instructions: Place tomatoes, green chiles, spinach leaves, celery seed, raspberries, beet, yogurt, and ice into a blender. Blend to desired consistency, about 1 minute. Serve chilled.

Random Ingredients: date,vanilla extract,biscotti bread,chipotle chile adobo,golden syrup,rye bread,black eyed pea
title: Smoky Chipotle Black Eyed Peas
ingredients: 1 lb uncooked black-eyed peas ( rinsed under warm water ) | 3 -4 teaspoons pure vanilla extract ( or almond or rice extracts ) | 2 slices rye bread ( about 1-1/2 inches thick, diagonally sliced ) | 1 cup biscotti, very finely crumbled ( or rye bread cut into 1/2-inch pieces, but not in the bread ) | 1 jar old el paso chipotle chiles in adobo, drained | 8 pitted dates, very finely chopped ( about 2 cups ) | 1/2 cup golden syrup or 1/2 cup molasses
instructions: If using rinsed and dried black eyed peas, add to simmer pot and cover. While still simmering, pulse bread slices with 2 - 3 tablespoons of vanilla in a food processor until minced, then set aside.

title: Alsatian Apple Soup

instructions: In a small saucepan, heat cognac or liqueur over low heat until bubbles appear around the edge. Remove from heat and pour into a heatproof bowl. Toss apples and broth with the cognac or liqueur. Cover and place in a small pot over low heat just until mixture starts to warm, about 2 minutes. Do not allow to boil serve.

title: Nori Sushi Roll
ingredients: 2 sheets nori | 3/4 cup sea salt, to taste | 4 -6 tablespoons brown mustard seeds ( aka sushi ) | 3 -5 cups cooked farfalle pasta
instructions: Combine 1/3 cup of salt and 2/3 cup of brown mustard seeds in bowl of electric blender. Add 1/2 cup water. Blend to form a powder. Roll mixture into balls about 1 - 2 inches in diameter. Scoop out as many as you are able.

Random Ingredients: golden syrup,vegetable,sea salt black pepper,nonfat cream
title: Homestyle Fruit Salad
ingredients: 1/2 lb assorted fresh vegetable ( such as butternut, red currant, green beans, red grapes ) | 1/3 cup golden syrup | sea salt & freshly ground black pepper | 1 1/2 cups nonfat sour cream ( optional ) or 1 1/2 cups sour cream ( optional )
instructions: Rinse the vegetables under cold running water to remove grit. Thinly slice all the vegetables and place in a salad bowl. Scatter over the golden syrup. Add pepper and toss to combine well. In a small bowl, combine the nonfat sour cream and a generous dash of salt and black pepper. Spread the sour cream mixture over the salad just before serving.

title: Pistachio Samosas #5FIX
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger | 2 packages phyllo pastry sheets at room temperature ( thawed ) | ketjap manis ( optional ) | pistachios ( optional )
instructions: Brown hamburger in frying pan over medium heat. Remove from pan and add ketjap manis. Stir until well combined, then mix in 1 package of phyllo pastry sheets until well coated. Lay each sheet on a clean dry surface. Place about 2 tablespoons of the hamburger mixture in the center of each sheet. Sprinkle with about 1/4 teaspoon of the ground pistachios, if desired. Fold the phyllo sheet over the meat mixture, making sure to completely enclose it. Fold the other end into a triangle and pinch to seal the edge with a fork. Repeat with remaining dough and hamburger. Heat a large non stick frying pan at medium heat, lightly oil it or coat with cooking spray and arrange the samosas in a single layer. After 5 minutes, gently turn off the heat.

Random Ingredients: chicken wing,whipping cream,sherry,onion soup mix,garam masala
title: Chicken Wings with Creamy Dipping Sauce

instructions: In a saucepan or in a small crock pot, combine whipping cream and chicken wings. Cook on high heat, stirring frequently, until the cream begins to thicken, about 1 1/2 minutes. Pour into a bowl, and stir in onion soup mix, sherry, garam masala, and simmer, stirring occasionally, until sauce is thinened, about 10 minutes.

title: Italian Potato Corn and Pepper Casserole
ingredients: 1 envelope italian seasoning | 1 can whole kernel corn, drained | 1/2 pound small red potatoes | 1 can baby corn, drained
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Spread the dried seasoning sauce onto the bottom of a 9x13 inch pan. Layer the bottom of the pan with the frozen corn, and then with the potato pieces cut into chunks. Bake for 30 minutes in the preheated oven. Cover the top of the casserole with a layer of foil, and bake for 40 minutes, or until the potatoes are tender.

title: Wine & Parsnips With Red Wine
ingredients: 1 parsnip, peeled & diced | 1/2 cup low fat soymilk | 1/4 cup red wine ( any brand ) | 1 -2 tablespoon red wine vinegar
instructions: Cut the parsnips into chunks & cook until tender but still firm about 5 minutes. In a small bowl whisk together the soymilk, vinegar & red wine & then pour over the parsnips. Cook until the sauce has absorbed the liquid for about 5 minutes more. Season to taste with salt & serve immediately.

title: Chilled Cheeezy Chickpea Flour Chili
ingredients: 1 cup chickpea flour ( besan ) | 7 tablespoons tequila | 2 large ice cubes, or as needed
instructions: Place the chickpea flour, tequila, and ice cubes into a blender. Blend until smooth, about 30 seconds to a minute. Transfer chili flakes, or as desired, to a resealable plastic bag.

title: Alfredo Cheese
ingredients: 1 package neufchatel cheese | 2 cups chopped carrots
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place the neufchatel cheese in a baking dish and spread. Stir in carrots. Bake in the preheated oven for 40 minutes, until lightly colored.

title: Italian Chicken With Adobo
ingredients: 1 lb chicken thigh fillet | 3 tablespoons italian salad dressing
instructions: Combine chicken and italian dressing. Place in shallow baking dish or pan. Bake at 350 degrees for 25 minutes. Turn fillets.

Random Ingredients: garlic clove,wheat flour,heavy whipping cream,marinara sauce,corn oil,basmati rice,pork tenderloin,new potato
title: Pork and New Potatoes
ingredients: 2 tablespoons corn oil | 1 teaspoon marinara sauce | 8 ounces pork tenderloins, sliced into 1 inch cubes | 8 ounces new potatoes, sliced into 1 inch pieces | 2 garlic cloves, minced | 1 tablespoon whole wheat flour | 1/3 cup heavy whipping cream | 3 cups cooked basmati rice, kept hot
instructions: In a pan heat oil. Sauté the marinara sauce until bubbly. Remove from heat and mix in pork and potatoes. Cover and set aside. In a large skillet toss garlic with the flour and sauté until golden brown. Add the cream and boil for two minutes. Add hot sauce and bring to a boil, stirring constantly. Add the cooked rice and stir. Serve mixture over the hot rice. Enjoy.

title: Agnolotti (Italian Poppy Seed Cookies)
ingredients: 1 lb poppy seeds | 1 -2 cup whipping cream | powdered sugar, for dusting
instructions: Dissolve the poppy seeds in 1/2 cup of the whipping cream. Heat the remaining whipping cream, pour over the poppy seeds and stir until smooth. Drop spoonfuls of the poppyseed mixture into an ungreased bowl and press in lightly with your hands. Allow to dry out for 5 to 10 minutes. Sprinkle with powdered sugar and serve.

Random Ingredients: fennel leaf,bulgur wheat,basmati rice,whipping cream,red chilies
title: Fluffing Rice With Scented Chillies (Chutney) Pulao
ingredients: 1 cup fennel leaves | 2 tablespoons dried red chilies | 250 g bulgur wheat, cracked wheat | 3 tablespoons whipping cream | 200 g basmati rice
instructions: Remove and discard any excess water from the bulgur. Put rice in a bowl and pour boiling water over till soaked. Allow to stand for 10 minutes. Drain and fluff rice with hands. Keep aside. Place fennel, chillies, 1 tablespoon of rice powder and half cup of water in another pot. Bring to boil and cook, uncovered, over medium heat till water disappears and the rice is cooked. Add cream. Cook on high heat and stir continuously till it reduces by half or three fourths. Remove from heat and serve immediately.

title: Mexican Chicken With Chickpeas (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 1 package canned chickpeas, rinsed and drained | 1 can sliced mushrooms, drained | 3 guajillo chilies, roasted and peeled | 2 tablespoons vinegar | 2 tablespoons savory | 3 cups cooked farfalle pasta
instructions: Place all ingredients except for chicken, vegetables and pasta into a 4 - 2 1/2 quart slow cooker. Cover and cook on low heat for 8 - 10 hours. Remove chicken from crock, cut into pieces and add to slow cooker. Reduce heat to low and cook for an additional hour. Remove chicken from crock serving platter and serve over a bed of farfalle noodles. Serve hot with refried beans.

Random Ingredients: red cabbage,ricotta,cold water,fennel seed,soybean,no salt tomato,okra,beef bouillon cube
title: Sweet and Sour Okra and Vegetable Soup
ingredients: 2 cups red cabbage ( shredded ) | 1 tablespoon no-added-salt tomato ( no oil added ) | 8 cups cold water | 6 ounces fresh okra ( frozen, thawed ) | 1/4 cup low-sodium fat-free ricotta ( skim off milk fat ) | 4 beef bouillon cubes | 2 tablespoons soybeans ( soy flour ) | 1 teaspoon fennel seed
instructions: Saute cabbage and tomato in saucepan. Add cold water and okra. Season to taste with salt before serving.

Random Ingredients: italian seasoning,red pepper,anise seed,red potato,honey,vegetable oil cooking spray,cardamom pod,salmon
title: Olive Fish Packets #RSC
ingredients: 8 ounces salmon, cut into 6 equal pieces | 2 large red potatoes, cut into 6 equal pieces ( approximately ) | anise seed, crushed | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom pod | 2 1/2 teaspoons dried italian seasoning | 4 teaspoons honey | 2 teaspoons vegetable oil cooking spray | 1/4 teaspoon red pepper
instructions: Preheat your oven to 450 degrees. In a small bowl, mix the crushed anise seed with crushed cardamom and ground italian spices. Lightly coat a baking tray with cooking spray and place your pieces of fish on. Mix the crushed anise mix with the honey and coat the fish with this honey mixture. Place all 12 pieces of fish in the tray and top each piece with aniseed/spice mixture and the red pepper. Place the tray in the oven and bake for 20 minutes. The fish will be cooked when it flakes easily. Remove from the oven and let it sit for 5 minutes before unwrapping and serving.

title: Hawaiian Dogs
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower, cut into florets | 2 eggs | 1 can pineapple chunks | 1 cup coconut rum | 1/2 cup sweetened flaked coconut rum
instructions: Place cauliflower in a baking dish that has been brushed with cooking spray. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place eggs, pineapple, coconut rum and sweetened coconut rum into a blender. Blend until smooth, adding more rum if desired. Pour over cauliflower and toss to coat. Bake in the preheated oven for 40 minutes. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: dark brown sugar,cinnamon,cooking sherry,hamburger bun,quinoa,parsley flake,black eyed pea,frank red sauce
title: Stuffed Black-Eyed Peas
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger bun, thinly sliced | 1 can black-eyed peas, rinsed and drained | 1 tablespoon fresh parsley flakes | 1/4 cup crunchy quick-cooking sherry | 1/2 cup dark brown sugar | 1/4 teaspoon black hot pepper sauce | 1/4 teaspoon cinnamon | cooking oil or corn oil, for pan frying
instructions: In a large bowl, toss beef, peas, parsley, sherry, brown sugar, black hot pepper sauce and cinnamon. Stuff into the cavity of black eyed peas. In a large frying pan, heat the oil or corn oil until a 1 inch cube of bread browns in a few seconds on each side. Serve with dipping sauce.

Random Ingredients: pork sausage,white sugar,asafoetida powder,vanilla bean,green cardamom pod
title: Pork Sausages With Vanilla Bean (Punjab)
ingredients: 1/2 cup green cardamom pods | 1/2 cup plain white sugar | 1 tablespoon scraped vanilla bean | 1 pinch asafoetida powder | 1/4 teaspoon ground vanilla bean | 2 teaspoons finely chopped white sugar
instructions: Using a mortar and pestle or coffee grinder, grind the cardamom pods to a fine powder. Mix in the remaining ingredients. Store in a glass container.

title: Chayote (Indian Bread)
ingredients: 1 pound round steak, cubed | 5 cups mixed salad greens | 2 tablespoons ground roasted chayote ( chaat masala ) | 2 tablespoons chat masala | 1 1/2 teaspoons instant yeast
instructions: Place beef in a large bowl, and mix in greens, roasted chayote, chaat masala, and yeast. Cover, and refrigerate, 2 hours to overnight. Heat 1 1/2 cups water, or as needed, in a saucepan over medium high heat. When the pan is very hot, but not smoking, place in the bread, and let foam subside before turning. Let bread cool to warm, but not hot, about 5 minutes, then remove from pan and cut into quarters. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: buttermilk,onion soup mix,white kidney bean,puff pastry,pizza crust,hoagie,peach
title: Baked Peaches and Beans
ingredients: 2 unbaked pie crusts | 2 cans white kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 1 package dry onion soup mix | 1 cup hoagie roll, split open lengthwise | 2 cans sliced canned peaches, drained | 1 packet frozen puff pastry, thawed and chilled | 1/4 cup buttermilk
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Place the pie crusts on a baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until lightly browned, about 10 minutes. Set aside and keep warm. Stir the beans, undrained onion soup mix, and hoagie roll in a large saucepan over medium heat until heated through, about 3 minutes. Pour the peach mixture into the prepared pie crusts. Arrange the peaches over the bean mixture. Top with pastry, fold the edges over the peaches and place on a baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until the tops are golden brown, and the filling is bubbling, about 30 minutes.

title: Jamaican Crab and Beef Appetizers
ingredients: 1 package imitation crabmeat, cut into 1 '' pieces | 1 package toothpicks | 1 can mandarin orange segments ( reserve the juice ) | 1 package of wax paper
instructions: Mix all the ingredients except for toothpicks together. Roll out one sheet to form a 6 x 4 inch rectangle. Spread a thin layer of the crabmeat on top of the dough leaving one inch at the edges. Spread half the mandarin oranges on top of the crabmeat. Roll up jelly roll fashion starting on the long side of the rectangular dough. Place one toothpick on the seam side of the cylinder. The toothpick will make the tooth pick go around the appetizer like you did before, making sure the toothpick ends hang from the appetizer. Tie off any excess dough with 2 inch lengths. Wrap the rolls up in a wax paper wrap. Chill until the party requires it. You can then eat.

title: Basil-Easiest Baked Rigatoni
ingredients: 500 g dry rigatoni pasta | 1/2 teaspoon asafoetida powder | fresh basil leaves, to taste | bread flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 180 degrees celsius. Coat baking tray with oil or cooking spray. Pour boiling water into a big bowl and add rigatoni. Mix with hands to get all the pasta to the same size as the tray. Sprinkle asafoetida over. When the water starts to bubble, turn the rigatoni over. Mix well. When everything is moist, lightly coat the rigatoni with flour to prevent sticking. Spread them out on the baking tray,. Bake on the middle shelf of oven. Bake for about 30 minutes or for an hour. Cool the bread. Take out the cooked rigatoni and place on a big serving platter. Sprinkle with basil and serve.

title: Pimentos (Stuffed Peppers)
ingredients: 4 orange bell peppers | 2 tablespoons finely minced pimentos
instructions: Cut the tops off of the peppers and remove the seeds and ribs. Scoop the insides of peppers and set aside. Cook the peppers over a moderate flame, turning the peppers over and repeating the process until all sides are browned, about 15 minutes. Put 2 tablespoons of the fiesta fiesta fiesta fiesta fiesta fiesta fiesta and 3 tablespoons of the fiesta fiesta fiesta fiesta juice in a small bowl. Pour the fiesta juice over the peppers and mix until thoroughly coated. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least two hours before serving.

title: Basic Japanese-Style Crispy Chips
ingredients: 12 flour tortillas, 10-12 inches in diameter | 1 teaspoon mirin ( asian sweetener ) | topping ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Arrange 2 tortillas, overlapping if necessary, on baking sheets. Sprinkle lightly with mirin. Place another sheet over, top with next tortilla and cover with towel. Bake until bottoms of chips are slightly charred, 12 to 15 minutes. Turn chips out onto rack or baking sheet. Let cool completely and store in airtight container.

title: Carne Asada
ingredients: 4 lbs extra lean lean ground beef | 4 lbs boneless pork | 10 ounces amaretto liqueur | 5 large thai chiles, roughly chopped | 5 ounces candied orange peel, roughly chopped | 1 3/4 cups tamari or 1 3/4 cups braggs liquid amaretto
instructions: In a large pot with boiling water, combine the ground beef, pork, amaretto, thai chiles, and orange peel and place over very low heat. Let the meats simmer until meat is cooked through, about 3 hours. Add the tamari and keep stirring until the tamari has dissolved. When sauce is at the desired consistency, stir in the amaretto.

title: Mexican Pizza Bread
ingredients: 8 cups whole wheat flour | picante sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Pour flour onto a piece of kitchen paper or waxed paper. Place the flour onto the paper/seam on a pizza pan or cookie sheet. Spread the picante sauce onto the flour and layer the pizza toppings on top of the salsa. Bake for 12 - 16 minutes or until bubbly. Let cool 5 minutes before slicing and eating.

Random Ingredients: cherry pie filling,arborio rice,daikon radish,peanut butter,spice
title: The Perfect Aussie Rmove
ingredients: 1 cup arborio rice ( short grain or basmati could also be used ) | 4 cups cherry pie filling | 1 daikon radish, grated | 2 teaspoons spice mix ( like curry powder ) | 1/2 cup peanut butter
instructions: Bring a large stock pot of water to a boil. Drain rice into a strainer and rinse well. Place rice in a bowl, and set aside. Add 2 cups of cherry pie filling to the empty rice in the strainer, and then bring back to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer, covered, for about 30 minutes. When done add 1/2 cup of soy sauce and mix well. Place peanut butter in a small bowl and microwave for about 2 minutes on high. Stir until smooth. Drain rice into a colander, pressing and squeezing rice to remove excess water. Place rice in a large casserole dish, and cover with the peanut butter mixture. Bake at 300°f for approximately 40 minutes, or until peanut butter has melted. If too creamy, stir in a 1/2 cup of water.

title: African Mandarin Infused Creme
ingredients: 3 -4 cups mandarin orange segments ( from 12 oz can ) | 6 tablespoons amarula cream liqueur ( or other orange liqueur )
instructions: Blend all above ingredients in a blender, starting with the amount of mandarins and blending on high for 15 - 20 minutes. This will help you choose how thick you want your creme to be in a deep freezer container, or how easy your food to handle. Note, the more you blend, the thicker your final product will be, so use sparingly. Refrigerate overnight and then pour into glass trays. Serve chilled or, for extra depth of flavor, try using a dessert spoon to pour the creme into a wine dish or to serve on a chilled dinner plate.

title: Chipotle-Coated Beef and Chipotle Fonduta
ingredients: 1 -1 1/2 cup dried chipotle chile in adobo | 1/4 cup coriander seed ( or 1/4 teaspoon ground coriander ) | 1 lb flank steak, cut into 4 pieces | 1/4 cup pisco ( or brandy ) | 1 lb marshmallows, chopped ( or white sugar ) or 1 lb other sweet cream mixed with fruit, such as mousse or fudge | steak, cut into 4 portions
instructions: Place the chiles in a medium ovenproof skillet or a medium saucepan and cover with several inches of water. Bring the water to a boil over medium high heat, then remove from the heat and let sit until softened, about 15 minutes. Drain, then transfer the chiles and any oil in the skillet to a small bowl or bowl. Stir the coriander seeds into the chiles and set aside. Bring the remaining water to a boil. Add the flank steak and return to a boil. Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, until the meat is very tender, about 60 minutes. Remove from the heat, cover with a damp kitchen towel and let sit for 5 minutes. Pare and discard the strings from the steaks and cut them into 4, or larger portions, and place them in a bowl. Stir the pisco into the chiles and simmer until reduced slightly, about 5 minutes. Drain the meat, discarding the chiles and oil. To serve, invite your guests to break each piece of steak into 4 pieces and dip it in the pisco. Remove and arrange the steak on a heated platter or serve them whole.

Random Ingredients: yellow bell pepper,breadcrumb,white pepper,ice water,rum extract,cumin
title: Cuban-Style Steak Skewers
ingredients: 1/2 cup fresh breadcrumb | 3/4 cup sweet yellow bell pepper, finely diced | 1/2 cup minced yellow bell pepper | 1/8 cup water | 1/8 cup rum extract | 1/8 teaspoon ground cumin | 1/8 teaspoon white pepper
instructions: Soak wooden skewers in cold water overnight. Mix bread crumbs, 3/4 cup diced bell peppers, rum extract, cumin, and white pepper together in a bowl. Drain excess soaking liquid from skewers. Place bell pepper mixture in a resealable plastic bag and close the bag.

title: Salsa Queens Copycat Hot Sauce
ingredients: 2 limes, juice of | 2 jalapeno peppers, seeded and diced
instructions: Mix all ingredients well and add to hot sauce or sweeten if desired.

title: Mexi-Cheese for Dogs or Wedges
ingredients: 2 ounces mexican chocolate | 12 tablespoons chunky salsa
instructions: Grate the mexican chocolate over the chunky salsa.

title: Beefy Baked Rice Noodle Skins
ingredients: 3/4 lb boneless beef stew meat | 1/4 cup maple syrup | 1 package rice noodles ( i use japanese flat-leaf ) | 1/4 cup crumbled feta or 1/4 cup light cheddar cheese, divided
instructions: In a large bowl, cut beef into 1/4 inch cubes. Stir in maple syrup and noodles.

title: Swiss Chard - a Breakfast
ingredients: 2 cups thinly sliced or stemmed fresh strawberries | 1/2 cup crumbled german-style cheese | 1/4 cup vegetable shortening | 1 tablespoon minced candied ginger | 1 teaspoon dried tarragon | 1/8 teaspoon ground cloves
instructions: Combine the fruit. In a heavy medium skillet, melt the cheese and shortening or butter over high heat, stirring until melted, about 3 minutes. Stir in the ginger, tarragon and cloves. Remove from heat. Add the fruit and toss to coat. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: red lentil,bean sprout,tart apple,pineapple juice,brown sugar
title: Red Lentil Salad
ingredients: 1 cup lentils ( green or brown ) | 6 cups bean sprouts | 4 tart apples | 1/2 cup brown sugar | 2 cups pineapple juice
instructions: Cook lentils according to directions on package. Rinse and drain. Meanwhile, peel, core and cut onions. Add to lentils in a bowl. Add apple slices. Pour in pineapple juice. Mix all well. Let sit for at least 1 hour before serving, it brings out a great flavor.

Random Ingredients: aubergine,pepperoni sausage,thyme sprig,pork tenderloin,rice,pork shoulder,black bean
title: Pepperoni-And-Sausage Pork and Pork Paillards
ingredients: 2 tablespoons bacon fat | 6 pork tenderloins, halved | 1 lb pork shoulder, trimmed and cut crosswise into 1-inch pieces | 6 aubergines, peeled and halved lengthwise | 8 fresh thyme sprigs | 1 can black beans, rinsed and drained | cooked rice
instructions: Heat the bacon fat in a large, heavy pot over medium high heat. Working in batches, add the pork, turning once, and cook until well browned all over, about 10 minutes. Transfer some of the pork to a plate. Add the pork, aubergines, thyme, and black beans to the pot. Reduce heat to medium, cover, and cook until the pork is tender with small bite, about 30 minutes total. Transfer the pork and beans to a platter and shred using two forks. Add more pork fat to the pot, if needed, and cook until the pork is hot through, about 2 minutes. Return soup to the pot. Meanwhile, line a 1st round baking dish with foil. Place the roasting pan on top of the oven. Position the rack in the center of the oven and preheat to 400 degrees. Divide the pork mixture among the prepared baking dishes, and place on a foil lined baking sheet with a rimmed top. Bake until all of the pork is heated through, about 35 minutes. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: basil leaf,orange juice,orzo pasta,watercress,red pepper flake,basmati rice
title: Basmati Rice Pilaf with Orzo
ingredients: 4 cups watercress, chopped | 1/2 cup orange juice | 1 cup basmati rice | 1/2 cup dry orzo pasta | 1/4 cup crushed red pepper flakes | 4 fresh basil leaves, chopped
instructions: Mix together. Serve hot.

title: Ful Medames (Fava Bean Sandwich)
ingredients: 1 bag dried fava beans | 1 1/2 cups crushed cooked hamburger
instructions: Soak fava beans overnight. Drain, and rinse. Cook and mash fava beans. Heat 1 1/2 cups of the cooked beans in a skillet over medium high heat until heated through. Sprinkle hamburger over beans. Place remaining 1 1/2 cups of ground hamburger on top of hamburger. Place in preheated oven at 350 degrees f for 20 minutes, or until hamburger is well cooked.

Random Ingredients: roast,cinnamon bark,kosher salt black pepper,tarragon vinegar
title: Pan-Roasted Beef Sandwiches-Slow Cooker Option
ingredients: 1/2 cup tarragon vinegar or 1/2 cup salad dressing | 1 teaspoon minced fresh rosemary or 1 teaspoon minced fresh tarragon, plus more for garnish | 1 teaspoon kosher salt or 1 teaspoon fresh coarse salt | 1 roast beef or 1 other meat and vegetables, cut into 6 small pieces
instructions: Combine vinegar, rosemary, and salt in bowl. Add meat and vegetables.

Random Ingredients: green chilies,lipton onion soup mix,sharp cheddar cheese,apple cider,mustard,rice,red snapper,egg
title: Dutch Oven Fish
ingredients: 4 -6 pieces red snapper, or 8 to 10 pieces other white fish pieces | 1 cup sharp cheddar cheese, or more to taste, grated | 1 egg, beaten | 4 tablespoons fresh coriander or 4 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley | 1 envelope lipton onion soup mix | 1/4 cup apple cider | 1 can sweet whole green chilies, drained, but juice reserved | hot cooked rice ( optional )
instructions: Heat oven to 450 degrees f. Place the snapper pieces in an ungreased 12x18 inch baking dish. Sprinkle with cheese and cover loosely with foil. Bake 25 minutes. Bake 10 more minutes, or until the fish is hot and the cheese has begun to brown. Remove from oven and leave the fish in the baking dish. In a bowl, combine the egg and onion soup mix, vinegar. Add chilies and mix to blend. Stir in the cider and add enough extra juice from the can of chopped green chilies to make the broth. Pour over fish in the baking dish and bake 20 to 30 minutes. Serve over rice, if desired.

title: Greek Olives
ingredients: 2 tablespoons olive oil | 300 g pitted kalamata olives, drained | 100 ml double cream
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a small pan over the medium high heat. Add the olives and stir to coat. Place the pan of olives in a heatproof bowl, pour over the cream and let sit to soak for 20 minutes. Cut into wedges and serve chilled.

Random Ingredients: romaine lettuce heart,salmon,red wine vinegar,breadcrumb,pineapple chunk,large curd cottage cheese,barley flour,cauliflower
title: Savoury Salmon Salad
ingredients: 1 lb lean salmon, cut in strips | 1/2 head cauliflower, cleaned and separated into florets | 1 1/2 cups large curd cottage cheese | 1/2 large romaine lettuce heart ( large-bowl size ) | 6 tablespoons breadcrumbs | 3 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 1/2 cup water | 1 teaspoon barley flour ( optional ) or 1/2 teaspoon white rice flour ( optional )
instructions: Place the salmon, cauliflower and cottage cheese to the side in a large serving bowl. Mix the water, vinegar and seasoning in a measuring cup while the vinegar and water is coming to a boil. Pour over the salmon mixture. Gently stir to combine, and let cool to room temperature. Place the bread crumbs in a bowl. Dip the breadcrumbs into the water, then dip the bread crumbs into the crumbs again. Refrigerate until ready to serve, but not long.

Random Ingredients: beef,cheese,caper,tomato puree,cashew,cornflour,chow mein noodle,chicken bouillon granule
title: Beef Pasties and Spices - Aussie Chef
ingredients: 400 g minced beef | 4 -6 large soft cashews | 1 package cheese | 500 g chow mein noodles | 2 envelopes chicken bouillon granules | 1 can tomato puree | 1/2 cup cornflour ( corn starch is best ) | 3 teaspoons capers ( optional )
instructions: Chop cashews coarsely. Finely dice cheese. Fry cashews in 2 tablespoons of olive oil in a large frying pan until golden, and set aside on paper towel. Drain off the oil. Set aside on paper towels. Chop chow mein noodles into 3 or four small squares. Add the chicken, worchestershire sauce and 2oz of the cheese to the butter and sauté for a couple of minutes and set aside. In another pan, add cashew nut oil and cook the chow mein noodles for about five minutes and set aside. In a bowl, mix together cheese, tomato puree, cornflour, chilli sauce mix. Mix the fried cashews back in and divide mixture into three bowls, put one on top of other and one on the table until guests arrive. Put a small pat of butter on the table, so guests can help themselves and the guests to their own. Spoon the filling into bowls, the filling should not be bubbling and the filling will be heated through the next couple of minutes. Serve immediately and enjoy.

title: Mushroom With Rack of Lamb
ingredients: 3/4 teaspoon harissa, spice | 2 medium white mushrooms, chopped | 3 lbs racks of lamb, frenched | 1 package wonton skins
instructions: Combine all harissa paste ingredients in a large bowl, stir well. Pat contents of bowl onto lamb racks and sprinkle with spice paste. Lay rack on a rack in a shallow roasting pan and cover with foil. Pour 1 1/2 cups water into pan, making sure all surface fat collects on the top. Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 20 minutes. Do not overcook. Remove roast from oven, slice thinly, and serve.

title: White Christmas Stew
ingredients: 4 medium dried apricots | 1 can italian plum tomatoes | 1 can sliced black olives | 2 tablespoons reduced sodium mexican seasoning
instructions: Peel the apricots if using dried apricots then dice the apricots. Reserve them. Dice the olives. Chop the remaining tomatoes. Mix the chopped apricots, chopped tomatoes, olive mixture and seasonings. Serve warm or cool to eat.

Random Ingredients: tomato paste,blue cheese,liquid smoke flavoring,seasoning salt,sesame oil
title: Broiled Blue Cheese
ingredients: 1/2 pound blue cheese, cut into 1x2-inch pieces | 1 tablespoon tomato paste | 1 teaspoon liquid smoke flavoring | 1 teaspoon sesame oil | 1 teaspoon seasoning salt
instructions: In a small bowl, mix the blue cheese cubes with tomato paste, liquid smoke, sesame oil, seasoned salt and pepper. Cover and refrigerate for 1 to 24 hours. Broil in the broiler for 3 to 4 minutes or until the cubes are bubbly and lightly browned.

title: Veal, Aioli--Salsa Dip
ingredients: 8 veal medallions, trimmed of membrane ( about 2-1/2 pounds total weight, see note ( veal medallions can be a little bit over 2 pounds total weight ) | 1 jar salsa | canola oil, for frying
instructions: Cut each veal medallion lengthwise in half, then crosswise into ¾ inch wide slabs. Cut slabs crosswise into ¼ inch wide slabs. Place meat, covered tightly with plastic wrap, in large freezer bag. Freeze, turning every 30 minutes or so, for 4 to 6 hours. Remove meat from freezer.

title: Red Chili Tortilla Chips
ingredients: 3 corn tortilla strips ( or other thin strips ) | 20 red chili powder | 35 g cornstarch | 350 g spaghetti
