instructions: In a small bowl with a pinch of salt, combine chili powder and cornstarch until combined then add to the cornstarch mixture and stir to coat. Set aside. Cook spaghetti in a pot of boiling water for 10 - 12 minutes. Drain and toss in bowl with the chili powder mixture. Sprinkle with salt and serve.

Random Ingredients: green chili pepper,plum tomato,olive oil,artichoke,shrimp,tomato soup
title: Artichoke & Shrimp
ingredients: 16 ounces can condensed tomato soup | 2 cans diced plum tomatoes, undrained | 1 large green chili pepper, seeded and finely diced | 1 can artichokes, drained, liquid reserved | 2 lbs uncooked raw shrimp, peeled, deveined, if frozen | 1 tablespoon olive oil
instructions: Drain soup cans, reserving 1 cup of liquid. Combine tomatoes, chile and artichokes and set aside. Heat oil in a 5 - 5 qt. Dutch oven over med high heat until hot, then add shrimp and cook 3 - 4 minutes or until shrimp is done. Add tomato mixture, reserved liquid and reserved artichoke liquid.

title: Pea Carrots
ingredients: 1 lb fresh peas and carrots ( or frozen ) | 2 french rolls ( or any other roll of your choice ) | 1 tablespoon fish sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Place carrots in a greased casserole dish. Drain peas and carrots in a sieve, discarding peas, set aside. Place rolls on top of peas and carrots. Spread fish sauce evenly over everything. Cover with foil. Cook 20 minutes. Uncover top of rolls and bake an further 5 minutes. Serve with rice and vegetables of your choice.

title: Straw Mushrooms and Fresh Cherry
ingredients: 1 cup dry buttermilk | 1 pound fresh straw mushrooms, cleaned and trimmed | 6 maraschino cherries, halved
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Mix buttermilk and mushrooms in a bowl. Place the straw mushrooms in a glass baking dish, and spread them evenly. Sprinkle the mushrooms with maraschino cherries. Bake in the preheated oven until the cherries have softened and begun to burst, about 10 minutes.

title: Crispy Skirt Steak
ingredients: 2 small baking potatoes ( yukon gold ) | 2 lbs skirt steaks
instructions: Preheat the grill. If using a gas grill, remove the skin and silverskin from the potatoes. Tear the potatoes into 4 thick, long chunks and place in a bowl. Cut the steaks into diagonal slices about 1 x 1/2&#8260.

title: Mexican Pork and Potatoes
ingredients: 3 lbs pork tenderloin, cut into pieces | 1 can black olives, drained | 2 medium red potatoes, peeled and cubed | 1 can stewed tomatoes | 1 can diced tomatoes | 24 crescent rolls | 1 can serrano chilies, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Arrange pork and olives in a large, deep roasting dish. Bake for 2 1/2 hours until pork is cooked through, and vegetables are tender. Cool slightly. In a large bowl, combine the potatoes, tomatoes, and chilies. Spread mixture evenly over pork and vegetables. Drain pork. Spoon pork and vegetables over the top of the potatoes, and roll up the crescent rolls. Seal in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Bake at 375 degrees f for 30 to 35 minutes, or until all the filling is hot and rolls are lightly browned.

Random Ingredients: cider vinegar,black dal,pecan,queso fresco,shrimp,adobo sauce,coconut milk,cayenne
title: Rajma's Shrimp With Adobo and Coconut Milk
ingredients: 1 1/3 lbs shrimp, thawed if frozen | 1/2 lb queso fresco, cubed | 1/3 lb cayenne | 1/3 lb pecans or 1/3 lb walnuts | 2 tablespoons unsweetened coconut milk | 4 tablespoons cider vinegar | 1 tablespoon cayenne | 1/4 teaspoon fresh ground black gram ( malayas or red chilies )
instructions: Slice the shrimp in half lengthwise with a cleaver or other slicer. Place the crabmeat, pasley and nuts in a medium saucepan or dutch oven with enough water to cover them by 2 inches. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes. While shrimp are simmering, combine the coconut milk, vinegar, cayenne and black gram in a small non reactive saucepan. Simmer over low heat for 5 minutes. Remove from the heat and set aside. Strain the liquid through a fine mesh strainer into a clean saucepan, pressing nuts with the back of a spoon to extract all the liquid that has cooked off. Stir the shrimp and clam juice into the coconut mixture with the sauce. Bring to a boil over medium high heat and reduce heat to low. Simmer gently over low heat for one hour, stirring often to keep shrimp submerged. Serve with rice.

Random Ingredients: asafoetida powder,white sugar,tomato green chilies,almond extract
title: Sydney Chile Powder
ingredients: 2 tablespoons tomato and green chilies, pureed | 1 teaspoon almond extract | 2 teaspoons white sugar | 1 pinch asafoetida powder
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together and store in an airtight container.

title: Capellini De Porcio (Tropical Pork With Tomatoes)
ingredients: 1/2 cup coconut milk or 1/2 cup light cream | 2 lbs boneless pork loin, cut into 1-inch pieces, and cut into 1 slices, then crosswise into 1/2-inch wide strips and then crosswise into 1/2-inch slabs | 2 large eggs | 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 1 can cherry tomatoes, drained and chopped
instructions: Pour coconut or cream into large nonstick skillet over medium heat. Add pork and cook, stirring occasionally, until browned, about 5 minutes. Remove pork from skillet, discard any fat. Push pork pieces to one side, add eggs and cook, stirring, until just set, about 1 minute. Return pork to skillet, add cinnamon and tomatoes. Reduce heat to low. Cover, and simmer until pork is tender, about 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: creme fraiche,coriander leaf,salmon,lettuce,yukon gold potato,oregano,red thai chile
title: Salmon and Potato Wraps With Chilli
ingredients: 200 g salmon | 4 small yukon gold potatoes, halved | 1 red thai chile, deseeded and finely chopped | 1/2 cup coriander leaves | 1/4 cup creme fraiche | 1 tablespoon oregano ( freshly chopped ) | 4 lettuce, leaves to serve
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190c. Line two baking trays with baking paper. Cut the salmon in half lengthways and remove any bones and skin if you like. Using a teaspoon, scoop out the flesh from the salmon into a bowl. Rinse and pat dry. Place the potato halves under a hot grill and cook for 5 - 8 minutes or until tender. Meanwhile in a mixing bowl, place the chilli, coriander, creme fraiche and oregano. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Meanwhile put together the salmon and potatoes and spoon into the middle of each wrap. Serve with the chilli mixture.

Random Ingredients: almond,corn chip,mexican cheese,meat,mustard seed,sesame oil,baking powder,greek yogurt
title: Dried  Mexican  Meat Bread
ingredients: 1 lb ground meat or 1 lb ground turkey | 1 1/4 cups plain greek yogurt ( can use reduced fat ) | 1/2 cup corn chips, finely crushed | 3 cups mexican blend cheese | 1/4 cup sesame oil ( can omit the extra oil ) | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds | 1 teaspoon baking powder | 1/2 cup slivered almonds ( optional )
instructions: Brown meat till fully cooked or until liquid is absorbed. Drain grease if meat is too moist. Add greek yogurt, chips, cheese, sesame oil, mustard seeds, and baking powder. Mix well. Stir in almonds last, if desired, to make a soft and moist bread. Note, i had extra greek yogurt and then added the greek spices and was not very moist. If you find it too dry, just add a bit of water to thin it if it is too wet, i just add the extra yogurt. Preheat oven to 400°f. Form into a single loaf shape and bake until nicely browned, about 40 minutes.

title: Creamy Herbed Shortbread
ingredients: 2 2/3 cups white flour | 3/4 cup cream or 3/4 cup light cream | 1/4 cup dried tarragon
instructions: Heat oven to 350°f. Add all ingredients to medium bowl and mix well. With hands, form into two thick loaves, cut into two long pieces of dough on parchment lined baking sheets. Bake for 30 - 40 minutes or until they are light golden.

Random Ingredients: flour,coconut extract,linguine,snow pea,beef sirloin steak,self raising flour
title: Sirloin Steak and Snow Pea Cake
ingredients: 1 tablespoon self-raising flour | 2 tablespoons self-raising flour | 2 teaspoons coconut extract | 200 g beef sirloin steaks, thinly sliced | 3/4 cup snow peas or 3/4 cup carrot, julienned | 2 tablespoons rice flour | 2 cups steamed noodles, steamed
instructions: Combine both flours into a shallow mixing bowl. Coat steak with this mix and toss to coat. Heat a little oil in a large non stick frypan over medium heat. Cook steak in batches in oil 1 minute each side or until cooked to your liking. Remove to a plate. Pour off any fat from the pan and reduce heat to medium. Add snow peas or carrots and stir to combine. Cook for 3 - 4 minutes or until carrot is crisp tender and snow peas are just tender. Remove from heat. To serve, place half the noodles in a shallow ceramic or ovenproof bowl and top with steak and snow peas. Spoon in sauce.

Random Ingredients: garam masala,olive oil,cornbread,kaffir lime leaf,curry powder,ice cube
title: Curried Cornbread
ingredients: 1 package frozen cornbread | 1 cup cornbread | 6 tablespoons olive oil | 2 1/2 tablespoons curry powder ( or to taste ) | 4 tablespoons garam masala ( or to taste ) | 1 large kaffir lime leaf ( optional )
instructions: Defrost the cornbread and place it in the freezer so it is easy to work with. It is best to do this the night before. Cut the cornbread into 1/2 inch slices and place in a food processor with 3/4 of the coconut oil. Add, in 2 - 3 tablespoons of the curry powder and 2 tbsp garam masala. Process until you have a coarse bread that is a little crumbly like french bread. Repeat steps 2 - 4 until all cornbread slices are in. Add 1/4 c water and process again until all cornbread is crumbly like french bread. Add a little more water as needed until mixture becomes soft and somewhat dense. Add the rest of the curry powder. You may not need it all. It is okay if it remains a little dry. It makes for chewy bread that can be made with bread instead of cuppa and that does not need to be too moist. Add a little more water if it is too dry. Drain cornbread and combine with the coconut mixture and fold until all cornbread is covered. You can also use your hands to mix all the cornbread in and it will come out a little wet and somewhat dry. You could also press down on it with a metal spoon. Place the cornbread in a baking dish and spray with pam. Bake at 375° about 20 minutes, or until hot and crispy.

title: Blueberry and Dill Pickle (Golabki)
ingredients: 2 large yellow sweet peppers, halved ( i used yellow ones ) | 1 cup fresh blueberries or 1 cup frozen blueberries | 1/2 cup fresh dill weed | 4 ice cubes
instructions: Combine the peppers, blueberries, and dill weed in a large bowl. Pour in the ice cubes, and mix gently. Taste and add salt if desired.

title: Cheese Lasagna
ingredients: 1 can sliced water chestnuts, drained | 1 1/2 pounds ground veal | 1 pound ground cheddar cheese | 1 cup ketchup | 1/2 pound carrots, shredded | 1 cup egg yolks, slightly beaten | 8 lasagna sheets
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Combine the water chestnuts, veal, cheddar cheese, ketchup, carrots, and egg yolks in a large bowl. Spread about 1/4 of the meat mixture into the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish. Arrange half the lasagna sheets in a layer over the meat in the dish. Repeat layers with the remaining meat and the remaining lasagna sheets. Spread the ketchup mixture over top of the lasagna. Bake in the preheated oven until the top is golden brown and the top is bubbly, about 45 minutes.

title: Crunchy Zucchini-Zucchini Salad
ingredients: 2 medium zucchini, cut into 1/4-inch slices | 2 cups shredded lettuce | 2 teaspoons shredded lemon zest
instructions: Combine the zucchini and lettuce in a large, shallow baking dish. Add the zest. Bake at 325 degrees f for 20 minutes or until the zucchini is tender crisp.

title: Tikka Cucumber (Russian Mushroom Cukes)
ingredients: 2 large kirby cucumbers | 1 jar small fresh mushrooms
instructions: Slice each lengthwise into 1/2 inch slices. Lay cucumbers in a steamer over 1 inch of boiling water. Cover and steam until cucumbers are tender, about 10 minutes. Meanwhile, heat a small skillet over medium heat and stir in mushrooms. Cover and simmer until mushrooms are tender, stirring frequently, about 4 minutes. Stir rice, if desired, into mushrooms.

title: Easy Pot Roast
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs fresh roast beef | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1 can tomatoes, chopped | 1 package chopped ham ( i prefer dark ) | 2 cans great northern mashed potatoes | 1/2 cup golden raisin ( optional ) or 1/2 cup raisin seed ( optional )
instructions: Place beef in dutch oven or deep fryer. Add onions. Mix mushroom soup with ham. Add tomatoes. Add the can of potatoes. Add raisins. Stir it all together.

Random Ingredients: picante sauce,chicken thigh,rice vinegar,new potato,pasta sauce,milk,vidalia onion
title: Chicken Potatoes & Onions
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups chicken drumsticks or 1 1/2 cups chicken thighs, cut into 1-inch pieces | 1 1/2 cups tiny new potatoes, quartered | 3/4 cup picante sauce, divided ( i used the mild ) | 1 cup chopped vidalia onion | 2 tablespoons rice vinegar | 1/4 cup reduced-fat milk | cooked pasta, to serve
instructions: Heat oven to 400°f if using chicken drumsticks or thighs, place in single layer in shallow roasting pan. Top each with 1 1/2 cups potatoes. Drizzle 1/2 cup picante sauce over potatoes and sprinkle with onions and 1/2 cup picante sauce. Roast about 25 - 30 minutes or until potatoes are tender and chicken is no longer pink. Meanwhile, make salad dressing.

Random Ingredients: romano cheese,cream celery soup,scotch bonnet pepper,baby spinach,heavy whipping cream,center pork chop,vegetable,trout
title: Teddy Cordon Bleu I
ingredients: 2 center-cut pork chops, 2/3 inch thick, 1/2 inch thick | 1 can sliced vegetables ( i have used diced onions, lima beans, corn, etc, i think these would be nice ) | 2 cans whipped cream of celery soup ( regular or fat-free ) | 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream | 1/2 cup grated romano cheese | 1/4 teaspoon hot scotch bonnet pepper | 1 bag baby spinach | 1/2 cup grated romano cheese
instructions: Place pork chops between waxed paper and pound each side, about 1/4 inch thick. Spread the cream over pork chops and top with one can of condensed soup, one can of cream, cheese, sour cream and a sprinkle of scallions and pepper. Roll pork chops up and tie with string. Place in crockpot. Pour remaining soup evenly over pork rolls.

title: Spiced Beetroot & Apricot Chutney
ingredients: 1 lb beetroot, washed and sliced, with the tips kept separate | 2 tablespoons fresh ginger ale | 2 crushed red chilies | 2 tablespoons black mustard seeds | 2 tablespoons apricots, chopped
instructions: Mix together the ginger ale & crushed red chillies. Pour half the chutney into a saucepan. Add the beetroot slices, the green parts of the beetroot, & chopped apricots. Cover & simmer over a gentle heat until the fruit is very tender, about 40 mins. Drain, & serve piping hot.

title: Creamy Cauliflower
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower, cut into florets | 1/2 head cabbage, cut into florets | 1 cube vegetable bouillon | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Place cauliflower in pot, and boil uncovered for three minutes. Drain, reserving about 1 inch of the head. In a bowl, mix together vegetable bouillon and worchestershire sauce. Place cauliflower in a large pot with water to cover. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to medium low. Cook 25 minutes or until tender. Drain, and let sit five minutes before serving.

title: Coconut Flour Balls
ingredients: 1 cup corn syrup | 1 cup potato starch | 2 cans coconut cream | 1 cup canned mixed vegetables
instructions: Place ingredients in a 2 quart pan. Mix thoroughly. Drop by teaspoonfuls into the hot coconut cream. Turn down heat when bubbles rise to the top. Turn often to insure a light film doesn't stick. After 6 - 10 minutes, the coconut cream has risen to the top. Do not remove. Serve with any other dipping sauce. Can be eaten with a crunchy biscuit. Serve with toasted cashews, if desired.

Random Ingredients: plain flour,romano cheese,manchego cheese,part mozzarella cheese,white cooking wine,cremini mushroom
title: Crepes With Cheese, Mushrooms & Herbs
ingredients: 300 g mixed cremini mushrooms | 4 ounces manchego cheese | 4 tablespoons romano cheese | 2 tablespoons white cooking wine ( or wine ) | 4 tablespoons plain flour | 1/2 cup shredded part-skim mozzarella cheese
instructions: Wash and remove gill from mushrooms. Cut in half and clean them. If using chinese white wine add it now and stir fry over medium heat until almost almost all the water evaporates add the flour and stir fry until the flour mixture is completely absorbed. Add the wine and stir fry about 1 minute until some of the wine evaporates, add the cheese, stirring constantly until the cheese melts. Stir in the mushrooms. Place one heaped tablespoon of the cheese mixture in the center of an arame dish put some cremini mushrooms on top. Sprinkle on some more cheese. Sprinkle on some romano and some black pepper. Place the rest on top, sprinkle on some more romano and serve immediately.

title: Rice-Aduging Beef and Vegetables
ingredients: 3 lbs beef brisket | 1 box long grain rice | 1 lb swiss chard, chopped | 1 medium yellow squash, sliced | 1 small banana | 1 1/2 cups low-fat refried beans
instructions: Heat the oven to 350 degrees. Place brisket into a roasting pan. Combine the rice and chard and set aside. Wash and trim the beef, cut into 1/2 inch slices and set aside. Tear the chard into 1 inch pieces and place into a pot. Slice the squash lengthwise and add to the pot with the beef. Cook for an hour stirring frequently. Remove from the heat and stir in the bananas just before serving. Place in a large baking dish in a single layer. Pour the hot refried beans over and bake for an hour. I like to serve this over angel hair pasta with extra slices of avocado.

Random Ingredients: onion,cuban bread,beef stew meat,cider vinegar,broccoli floret,sirloin
title: Cuban-Style Steak Sandwich
ingredients: 1/2 cup finely chopped onion | 1/4 cup cider vinegar | 1/4 cup finely chopped onion | 1 1/3 lbs sirloin, trimmed | 2 lbs boneless beef stew meat, cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 1 jar sliced broccoli florets | 12 slices cuban bread, toasted
instructions: In 3/4 cup of the water in a nonreactive dutch oven, cook the chopped onion until tender. Set aside. In another nonreactive dutch oven brown the sirloin on all sides in the remaining 1/4 cup of the water. Add the 1/2 cup of the onion and 1 1/3 pound of the beef to the sirloin and stir for 1 minute over medium heat or until meat is well coated. Add the 2 cups of water, the remaining 3/4 pound of beef and the broccoli. Cover and simmer over medium heat for 45 minutes or until vegetables are tender, stirring twice. Serve at once over toasted bread.

title: Chilli Hot Dish
ingredients: 1 package instant vanilla pudding mix | 1 package chopped green chili peppers
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine pudding mix with chiles. Cover, and chill in refrigerator 3 to 6 hours before serving.

title: Papaya & Bean Dip
ingredients: 1 pound peeled papayas ( green or yellow ) | 1 pound canned pinto beans, drained | 2 tablespoons diced serrano peppers | 1 package italian cheese blend, shredded
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Arrange papaya, pinto beans, serrano peppers, and cheese in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Bake 15 minutes, or until cheese is melted and lightly browned.

Random Ingredients: green enchilada sauce,pineapple chunk,chocolate curl,romano cheese,molasses
title: Easy Pineapple Cheese Green Enchiladas
ingredients: 2 cans green enchilada sauce | 2 cups shredded romano cheese | 3/4 cup sweetened molasses | 1 can pineapple chunks, drained and juice reserved | chocolate curls | roasted sweetened condensed milk
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Prepare 1 13x9 inch glass baking dish with cooking spray. In a large bowl, mix enchilada sauce, romano cheese, molasses, pineapple juice, and pineapple chunks until well combined. Place mixture in the prepared dish. Sprinkle top with chocolate sprinkles, and drizzle with enough extra chocolate to coat. Bake 30 to 35 minutes, or until bubbly around the edges.

title: Linguine With Lamb and Goat Stew
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dried porcini mushrooms | 1/2 teaspoon lemon zest, grated | 4 -5 lbs lamb shoulder, cut crosswise into 1 1/2 inch slices | 2 tablespoons grated cheese | 1/8 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice | 1/4 lb linguine, cooked
instructions: Make a small incision in center of each dried mushroom and chop fine. Soak mushrooms in hot water 20 minutes, or until soft and pliable.

Random Ingredients: thai red curry paste,greek yogurt,walnut oil,chicken rice soup,chipotle chile,cabbage
title: Spicy Chipotle Colcannon
ingredients: 2 lbs cabbage ( about 8 cups chopped, about 1/2 of a 10 ounce package ) | 1 tablespoon walnut oil | 1 tablespoon thai red curry paste ( or to taste ) or 1 tablespoon curry powder ( or to taste ) | 1 can low sodium beef condensed chicken and rice soup | 1/4 cup shredded kraft greek yogurt | 1 can chipotle chiles, in adobo ( remove seeds, finely chopped )
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to boil. Add cabbage and cook until barely tender, about 1 - 2 minutes. Drain and set aside. While still warm, cut into 1/2 inch dice. Heat the walnut oil in a skillet over medium heat and stir in the curry paste. Add the curry and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute. Add the rice soup and cook for 30 seconds. Add the cabbage, cheese, tofu and chipotle to the pan. Taste, and adjust if needed. Scoop out about half of the mixture to serve.

title: Mock Pakistani Chillies (Curry Powder)
ingredients: 125 g green chilies, chopped | 15 ml chili paste ( indian hot red chili powder )
instructions: Dry fry the chillies until they are golden brown in colour. Take them out and put onto a greased tray and keep aside. Now for the curry powder. Grind the chillies and chili paste to a fine paste. This is the curry base and keeps in an air tight container for upto 3 months. Enjoy with any left overs, rice, curries and fruit.

Random Ingredients: yellow squash,water chestnut,pinto bean,iceberg lettuce,sunflower seed,italian sausage,sauerkraut
title: Sue's Super Duper Italian Sausage, Eggplant and Pumpkin Salad
ingredients: 5 links mild italian sausage, casings removed | 1 can pinto beans, rinsed and drained | 1/2 head iceberg lettuce, finely shredded | 1/3 lb sauerkraut, rinsed and drained | 1/4 - 1/2 cup sunflower seeds, toasted | 2 red ripe yellow squash, peeled, halved and sliced lengthwise | 1 can water chestnuts, drained and sliced
instructions: Cut rinds from the sausages, if using, and place in a large pot, pouring about half of the liquid from the can over the sausage. Let soak, covered, for at least 1 hour. Drain the sausage and discard the liquid. Cut sausages into 1/2 inch pieces and set aside. In a large bowl, place 1/2 the drained pinto beans, and add the rest of the ingredients. Add more liquid to reach the desired consistency, but not too much more than you would for your Italian salad. Place sausage in a large skillet over medium high heat and brown on all sides, about 10 to 15 minutes. Serve immediately.

title: Turnips, Cauliflower and Feta
ingredients: 1 cup turnip, chopped | 1 medium cauliflower floret, chopped | 200 g salami or 200 g feta cheese, small cubes
instructions: Boil the turnips until tender. Drain. Add the turnips and cauliflower.

title: Peach Salsa
ingredients: 1 lb baking potato | 10 jumbo pasta shells | 2 cans sliced peaches, drained
instructions: Bake potatoes in boiling salted water until tender, 25 minutes. Drain. Cut into 1/2 inch slices. Place in a skillet and cover with water. Stir in shellfish, cover and simmer over low heat for 5 minutes. Drain, reserving 1 cup liquid. Place 1 teaspoon peach slices on each shell. Serve with reserved poaching liquid and remaining panto. Tomato sauce. 1/4 cup tomato sauce.

title: Baked Beans
ingredients: 5 cans pinto beans | 3 tablespoons capers
instructions: Drain and rinse beans. Combine in a 6 quart casserole with about 3 inches of water. Bake covered at 275 degrees for 3 hours. Turn off for an hour more.

Random Ingredients: blueberry,orzo pasta,cannellini bean,turnip,scotch whisky,bay leaf,lime wedge,yellow rice
title: Citrus Orzo and Chilie Risotto
ingredients: 1 box dry white orzo pasta | 4 cups chicken or 4 cups vegetable stock | 5 ripe yellow rice | 2 cans cannellini beans | 1/2 cup orzo pasta | shredded swiss and locatelli cheese and dried blueberries ( garnish ) ( optional ) | juice of half a lime wedge | scotch whisky
instructions: Prepare the grains, in a large stockpot or dutch oven, bring 2 liters of salted water to a boil. Add rice.

Random Ingredients: pork rib,pimiento,herb,grain rice,demerara sugar,picante sauce,cilantro,vegetable shortening
title: Santa Fe Country Style Pork and Rice
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons vegetable shortening ( or more as needed ) | 2 lbs country-style pork ribs, trimmed, rinsed, dried and cut in 2-inch cubes | 2/3 cup picante sauce | 1 1/2 cups long grain rice | 1/2 cup demerara sugar | 1/2 cup snipped fresh cilantro | 1 cup sliced pimiento | 1/4 cup snipped fresh herbs
instructions: Heat shortening in a large heavy dutch oven over low heat. Add country pork and saute 3 minutes or until pork is lightly browned. Transfer to a bowl. Stir picante sauce into the skillet and heat. Stir in rice, breaking up any large lumps and cooking 3 - 5 minutes or until rice is lightly browned. Stir in 1/2 cup sugar, cilantro, pimentos, and remaining 1/2 cup sugar. Return pork to soup pot. Cover and bring to a simmer. Reduce heat and simmer gently, covered, for 20 minutes. Add pimiento and stir. Cover and cook 10 minutes longer, or until rice is tender, stirring occasionally. Remove soup from heat and stir in herbs.

title: Chickpea Flour (for Bread Machine)
ingredients: 2 cups chickpea flour | 1 1/2 teaspoons celery salt
instructions: Add all ingredients in pan and select for basic bread.

Random Ingredients: cream chicken soup,bottom beef roast,basil,plum tomato,baking soda,pepper sauce,ginger root
title: Slow Cooker Spicy Beef
ingredients: 2 1/4 pounds trimmed fat-trimmed bottom round beef roast | 3 cups crushed plum tomatoes | 1 teaspoon dried basil | 3/4 teaspoon minced fresh ginger root | 3/4 teaspoon hot pepper sauce | 1 tablespoon baking soda | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup
instructions: Place roast in a slow cooker coated entirely with cooking spray. Combine crushed tomatoes, basil, ginger, hot pepper sauce, and baking soda in a large bowl, and stir to combine. Pour cream of chicken soup over top of roast, and stir until well blended. Cover, and set aside overnight, or until cool enough to handle. Cover, and continue cooking in the slow cooker until meat is very tender, 3 to 4 hours. An instant read thermometer inserted into the center should read 140 degrees f before you slice, and meat should have a firm consistency.

title: Garlic Greek Chicken Lovers
ingredients: 7 -12 chicken legs ( depending on the size ) | 6 large greek olives
instructions: Preheat oven to 180 degrees celcius. Place chicken in a large, deep sided oven dish. Peel off any excess fat and slice onions into very thin half moons, approximately 3 or 4 pieces. Place the sliced onions, cut side up, in the bottom of the baking dish. Sprinkle the olives over. Cover with half the garlic and scatter over half the remaining onions. Dot with olive oil or with a pastry brush and bake for 40 minutes or so until the chicken is cooked. Allow to rest for ten minutes before carving, depending on the size of the leg you are using.

Random Ingredients: sweetcorn,bay leaf,german chocolate cake mix,oat,onion soup mix
title: German Chocolate Crunch
ingredients: 1 package sweetcorn ( frozen or canned ) | 1/3 cup quick oats ( can use instant or quick ) | 1 envelope onion soup mix | 1 bay leaf | 1 package german sweet chocolate cake mix ( i use nutella )
instructions: Mix both dry ingredients together. Pour into a greased 13 x 9 pan. Combine soup mix and bay leaf. Spread evenly over cake batter. Bake at 350 degrees for 50 minutes or until cake tests done.

Random Ingredients: liquid smoke,tea,pork shoulder roast,italian sausage,mango chutney,chive
title: Italian Chili Pork Roast
ingredients: 2 pork shoulder roast | 4 ounces mild italian sausage | 4 ounces canned mango chutney | 48 ounces chivney, sweet and sour | 2 tablespoons liquid smoke or 2 tablespoons whiskey | 1 tablespoon dried chives
instructions: Trim excess fat. Combine chivney and liquid smoke in a blender. Place pork in a large dutch oven or flameproof casserole. Pour chivney mixture over pork. Cover, roast at lowest heat for 2 hours, stir after 1 hour and return to oven for 30 minutes or until chops are golden brown and cooked to your liking. Use a meat thermometer for lean chops, remove bones. Remove from oven and slice, serve with chivier chutney.

Random Ingredients: serrano pepper,monterey jack cheese,cream chicken soup,lemongrass,anise,fruit
title: Lemon Grass, Green Chile, Dried Fruit Soup
ingredients: 1 package frozen mixed candied fruits, thawed or 1/2 cup thawed mixed dried fruit | 6 cups cream of chicken soup, undiluted, divided | 1/2 cup finely chopped lemongrass | 2 serrano peppers or 4 jalapeno peppers, seeded and finely chopped | 3/4 cup shredded monterey jack cheese
instructions: Place 1/2 cup of the soup in a blender, discarding the vegetables.. Blend remaining soup with lemon grass and peppers. Combine soup, lemongrass, cheese and 2 tablespoons soup mixture and remaining soup mixture. Pour into 6 bowls or ramekins. Top with remaining 3 tablespoons soup mixture. Grill over high heat, turning frequently with tongs, until hot and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: parsnip,orange juice zest,okra,bread flour,wasabi powder,rye bread,grain rice,kernel corn
title: Mock Rice and Okra Bread Kebab
ingredients: 1 cup long grain rice, uncooked | 1/2 - 2/3 cup frozen mixed sprouts | 1 1/2 cups sliced okra ( about 1 small bunch ) | 2 -3 tablespoons orange juice and zest of | 2 -4 teaspoons wasabi powder ( optional ) | 2 -3 tablespoons coarsely chopped parsley | 4 -6 tablespoons bread flour | 4 slices rye bread
instructions: If you are serving this on rye bread, toast the slices on the grill or over a baking sheet until they are light brown and soggy, this will take about 5 - 8 minutes depending on your grill. It's best to toast them about 10 minutes before serving. Prepare the rice according to package directions. The rice is only actually cooked when most of the water has been absorbed. When it is, remove from heat. Let them cool. Rinse the okra thoroughly. Slice into 1/2 chunks. Mix with the orange zest, wasabi, parsley, rice and okra. Shape into bread flour kabobs. Coat with bread flour. Wrap with the rye flour to keep closed. Place on a tray lined with wax paper and refrigerate until ready to bake or overnight. Bake at 400°f for about 30 minutes, until well browned on top. Serve with wasabi and wasabi mayo.

title: Hominy With a Kick
ingredients: 1 can yellow hominy, drained from liquid | salt ( optional ) or seasoning salt ( optional )
instructions: Rinse the hominy well. Cover the rim of a medium saucepan with water, and bring to a boil over medium high heat.

Random Ingredients: porcini mushroom,mexican cheese,vegetable oil cooking spray,sweetcorn,beer,mango chutney,wheat bread,ramen noodle
title: Cheesy English Pub Sandwich
ingredients: 8 ounces ramen noodles | 3 tablespoons vegetable oil cooking spray | 4 slices multicolored whole wheat bread | 1 tablespoon mexican blend cheese | 1/4 cup sweetcorn | 1/4 cup canned mushroom | 2 tablespoons porcini mushrooms | 1 tablespoon mango chutney
instructions: Cook the noodles according to package directions, then drain and set aside. Coat a non stick pan with cooking spray, and cook the noodles following package directions. Rinse the noodles with cold water, and place in a bowl, along with the rice, sweetcorn, mushrooms, and porcini mushrooms. Strain the noodles and return to the pan. Stir in the chute. Spray a skillet with cooking spray, and heat until hot. Remove the skillet from the heat, and add the contents of the bowl and noodle mixture. Place the bread on a baking sheet, and toast in the oven until slightly crisp and toasted.

title: Simmered Snow Peas
ingredients: 2 packages snow peas, trimmed and cut diagonally into 3/4-inch slices | 6 fluid ounces rice wine | 2 teaspoons adobo seasoning
instructions: Heat up the rice wine in a small saucepan. Sear the snow peas with adobo seasoning until they begin to soften and turn bright green. When all of the snow peas are done, drain off oil. Toss with rice wine sauce.

title: Prawns, a Beautiful Little Wonton
ingredients: 1 kg prawns, cooked | 3 tablespoons dry white wine
instructions: Pour the wine into a large plate, cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate overnight. Preheat over to 190 degrees celsius. When ready to eat, wash and dry prawns, and set aside in fridge. Place 3 tablespoons of your uncooked white wine into a glass jar or bowl. Shake the jar or bowl, until the prawns are well coated. Repeat with all of your prawns, leaving the wine covered in the jar or bowl. When ready to serve, drain any excess wine from the jar or bowl and transfer prawns to a serving plate. Drizzle any leftover wine over, and serve immediately.

title: Beef and Vegetable Bites
ingredients: 1 kg beef round steak | 1 envelope fresh yeast | 1 tablespoon oil ( olive or canola ) | 500 g romaine lettuce, washed | 500 g small fresh snow peas ( optional ) | celery rib, slices to decorate
instructions: Cut the steak into cubes. Place them in a bowl of water, add the oil and a pinch of salt and leave for 20 minutes to really soften the meat. Drain the meat and cut it into bite sized chunks. Place the meat, lettuce, snow peas and celery into a large bowl and use your hands to toss everything together to give it the right balance of flavour, colour and texture. Pour into a large casserole dish. Cover and leave in a warm place for an hour to heat through. Turn the oven down to 190c, remove the cover, and leave it in there for a further 20 minutes until the meat is browned in a rich sauce. Serve warm.

title: Chocolate Chip Beef Puff Pastry Triangles
ingredients: 1 lb extra lean ground beef | 1/2 cup bread, chopped fine | 1/2 celery rib, chopped fine | 2 tablespoons unsalted chocolate chips | 2 tablespoons broth | 1 puff pastry sheet, partially thawed
instructions: Heat oven to 350°f in a skillet over medium high heat, add the ground beef and brown beef breaking up with a spoon. Drain all. Place the bread in a food grade bowl and top with beef and bread crumbs. Stir until crumbly. Stir in celery and chocolate chips. Add broth to moist bread mixture and mix well. Roll out pastry to 1/8 inch thickness and cut out 3 circles. Place 2 heaping tablespoons of the meat filling on each pastry circle and roll up. Place formed pastries on a baking sheet and prick tops of pastries with a fork. Bake pastries until golden brown, 15 - 17 minutes.

Random Ingredients: lime,beef bouillon,orange liqueur,green chile pepper,black forest ham
title: Mexican Sandwiches for 2
ingredients: 1/2 cup prepared yellow mustard greens chile peppers, rinsed and drained, divided | 2 slices black forest ham, cut into thin strips | 1/4 cup orange liqueur, divided | 2 cubes beef bouillon, or more to taste | 1 teaspoon ground black chiles, or to taste ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 500 degrees f. Spread 1/4 cup mustard greens with 1/4 cup orange liqueur. Place 1 ham slice on each of 8 slices of mustard greens. Place 1/4 cup reserved mustard greens chile pepper strips in a bowl. Pour 1/4 cup orange liqueur sauce, 1 cube beef bouillon, and 1 teaspoon black chiles over cheese slices in a large skillet.

title: Tomats in the Bread
ingredients: 8 tomatillos, husked and rinsed | 1 loaf ciabatta
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Place tomatillos on a baking tray. Bake in oven for 3 minutes or until soft. Remove from oven and transfer tomatillos to oven with a lid. Bake 20 minutes. Remove from oven, peel off the lid and cut in half. Serve warm.

title: Spiced Mushrooms
ingredients: 1/2 cup creamy peanut butter | 1 can whole wild mushrooms, drained | 1/4 teaspoon almond extract ( optional )
instructions: Combine peanut butter and mushrooms in a microwave safe bowl. Cover tightly. Microwave on high power for 5 minutes, stirring half way through. Stir mushroom mixture. Microwave, uncovered, on high power for 5 minutes, stirring halfway through cooking time. Stir and set aside. Stir almond extract into mushroom mixture. Cover. Microwave on high power for 10 minutes, stirring halfway through cooking. Stir and set aside. Microwave, uncovered, on high for 5 additional minutes, stirring twice, until mushroom mixture is hot and slightly plump. Spoon over cooked noodles or rice and serve.

title: Beef and Chickpea Stir-Fry
ingredients: 1 can chickpeas, drained | 1 tablespoon asian fish sauce | 1/2 teaspoon ground cloves | 4 ounces beef tenderloin, cut into thin strips | 1 cup hot cooked brown rice | ice, for serving
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the drained chickpeas, fish sauce and ground cloves. In the beef, pour the chickpea mixture.

Random Ingredients: radish,rump roast,butter,dark sesame oil,nutmeg,vegetable stock,chili paste,couscous
title: Olive Oil Roasted Beef and Couscous
ingredients: 1 teaspoon vegetable fat or 1 teaspoon butter, extra virgin | 2 teaspoons dark sesame oil or 2 teaspoons dark brown sesame oil | 1 tablespoon chili paste | 1 tablespoon vegetable stock or 1 tablespoon chicken stock | 1/2 teaspoon grated fresh nutmeg | 2 -3 lbs rump roast, trimmed of fat | 7/8 cup couscous | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 10 -12 slices radishes, thin strips
instructions: Whisk together the oil, chili paste, and stock in a small bowl. Season to taste with nutmeg and pepper. Drain the beef, then pat dry with paper towel. Brush generously with the oil/sherry mixture. Wrap in plastic wrap and refrigerate for 30 minutes. Preheat the oven to 300°f. Place the beef, meaty side up, on a rack in a roasting pan large enough to accommodate it in an even layer. Drizzle any remaining fat from the pan and roast until just cooked through, about 30 - 45 minutes. Meanwhile, cook the couscous according to the package directions. Drain, then stir in 2 tbsp olive oil. Heat the remaining olive oil in a very large nonstick pan. When the beef is just cooked, transfer it to a warmed plate. Increase the oven temperature to 275°f lift off the beef slices and scatter over couscous. Spoon a pile of sauce over and around the beef. Scatter over the radish strips and drizzle with any remaining sauce.

Random Ingredients: orange peel,white vinegar,bitter melon,spaghetti sauce,herb,olive brine
title: Grilled Bitter Melon (Or Spaghetti) Salad
ingredients: 3 bitter melon | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil or 2 tablespoons olive oil | 1 jar spaghetti sauce ( ragu, prego, ronzoni, herbs, etc. ) | 1 teaspoon mixed herbs ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon white vinegar or 1 tablespoon lemon juice | 1/2 teaspoon grated orange peel
instructions: Slice melons crosswise, remove seeds, and place on a platter lined with plastic. Pour hot sauce over melon. Sprinkle mixed herbs or other desired spices over melons. Allow to sit at room temperature to marinate several hours. Serve immediately.

title: Spiced Dipping Sauce For Fruit
ingredients: 1/3 cup hazelnuts, roughly chopped | 2 teaspoons fish sauce | 4 teaspoons tamari ( or other soy sauce ) | 1 tablespoon dried dates, soaked in water and chopped into chunks
instructions: Place the nuts with the fish sauce in a shallow pan.

title: Dill Lentils with Tomatoes and Hot Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup green lentil, rinsed | 1/4 cup tomato ketchup | 1/4 cup low-sodium worcestershire sauce | 1/4 cup hot water
instructions: Put lentils and the tomato ketchup in saucepan and put over medium heat, stirring often. When the mixture has cooked until it reaches the texture of tomato ketchup. Turn the heat back on and add worcestershire sauce. When you can smell the ketchup in your eyes, turn off the heat and serve. This makes a great soup that is great for a fresh salad, and as an accompaniment. Makes a great snack for spring rolls.

title: Black Bean Salsa
ingredients: 1 can black beans, rinsed and drained | 1/2 yellow bell pepper, chopped | 1 tablespoon all-purpose flour
instructions: In a medium bowl, stir together the beans, bell pepper, and flour. Cover and refrigerate 1 to 2 hours before serving.

Random Ingredients: almond paste,chili pepper,ketchup,hot red chili pepper,guacamole,sun tomato oil,paprika,barbecue sauce
title: Spicy Barbecue Glazed Barbecue Chicken
ingredients: 2 tablespoons prepared barbecue sauce ( ketchup or honey maid-manual preferred ) | 1 tablespoon hot red chili pepper, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, finely chopped | 3 tablespoons almond paste, finely chopped ( kebobs preferred ) | 1 tablespoon ketchup | 1 tablespoon smoked paprika | 1 -2 teaspoon paprika | 1 hot chili pepper, finely chopped | 2 -6 small hot red chili peppers, finely chopped
instructions: In a large glass bowl, combine barbecue sauce, chopped hot peppers, sun dried tomatoes, almond paste, ketchup, smoked paprika and hot sauce. Stir vigorously to blend all ingredients. If using honey Maid manuals, preheat grill to medium. Thread the chicken onto skewers, brushing with remaining glaze. Grill on barbecue grill, brushing with remaining glaze for about 7 - 12 minutes or til done. Serve with sour cream and sliced onions, if desired.

title: Garlic Crock Pot Meat Sauce
ingredients: 2 cups of meat, minced ( i prefer leftover roast ) | 3 tablespoons parmesan cheese | 1 tablespoon crushed garlic | 1 teaspoon baking powder | 3/4 cup hot milk powder
instructions: Mix all ingredients with your hands. Use 1 - 2 tbls of the mixture to keep from sticking to the pot when cooking to keep the meat from sticking. If you can, keep it in a bag in the fridge for about 2 hours before using. You need to use your crock pot to keep the meat from sticking, but don't use it to saute until you are ready.

Random Ingredients: kumquat,sesame seed,sushi rice,marsala wine,hamburger bun,rice flour,water,green chilies
title: Sweet Burger - Sushi
ingredients: 400 g ground sirloin or 400 g ground hamburger | 1 tablespoon rice flour | 1 tablespoon sesame seeds, lightly roasted, and ground | 1 tablespoon rice flour | 2 tablespoons marsala wine, dark | 1/2 can green chilies | 2 cups sushi rice, cooked | 1 cup water | 4 slices kumquats or 4 slices pickled ginger | 4 hot cooked rice rolls or 4 hot cooked buns
instructions: Combine the meat, rice flour, sesame seeds, rice wine, chilies, and sesame oil in a large bowl and mix thoroughly. Add the meat mixture and mix until blended but not mushy. Heat a large non stick frying pan. Dip the rolls and the meat mixture each in the prepared rice. Cook the rolls until golden brown, then remove and set aside. Slice the burgers across the grain into thick slices. Heat a grill pan and cook the burgers for 2 to 3 minutes on each side, or until cooked through. Serve on toasted rolls and top each with a slice of kumquat, hot cooked rice, and a drizzle of sesame mustard. Repeat for other burger sandwiches.

title: Red Wine Pasta Salad
ingredients: 200 ml red wine | 1/2 cup grapes ( i like to use pears ) or 1/2 cup other citrus fruit | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | pasta, of your choice
instructions: Bring all ingredients to the boil and simmer for approx 30 mins. Serve in individual bowls. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: green bell pepper,lamb,cherry,black eyed pea,chocolate pudding mix,part ricotta cheese,pork loin roast,mushroom cap
title: Lamb and Black Eyed Pea Casserole
ingredients: 4 1/2 pounds boneless lamb, cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 1 pound pork loin roast | 1 package instant chocolate pudding mix | 1 jar sliced mushrooms with liquid | 4 cups canned black-eyed peas, drained and rinsed | 1 green bell pepper, chopped | 1 container part-skim ricotta cheese | 12 cherry fresh mushrooms with stems
instructions: Place lamb into a large pot and cover with water. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat to low. Cover, and simmer until lamb is tender, and easily shredded, about 1 1/2 hours. Reserve lamb cooking liquid, cut lamb and pork into 1/2 inch cubes.

Random Ingredients: romaine lettuce,farfalle pasta,monterey jack cheese,white pepper
title: Real Simple Italian Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1 lb farfalle pasta | 2 cups shredded romaine lettuce | 1 tablespoon white pepper | 2 cups shredded monterey jack cheese
instructions: Cook pasta according to pkg directions. Right before draining, add the remaining ingredients and toss. Add the cheese for topping.

title: Super Low Fat Chicken Gravy
ingredients: 2 packets chicken bouillon | 1 tablespoon cornflour
instructions: Place the chicken into a non metallic bowl and sprinkle with the cornflour. Leave until needed. Put a pot over medium heat. Add the chicken to the pan and stir until it browns. Pour in the chicken water and add the chicken bouillon. Cover the saucepan and leave to simmer slowly for about 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: vegetable broth,white wine vinegar,safflower oil,mango chutney,sunflower oil,sesame seed,artichoke heart,emmenthaler cheese
title: Artichoke and Sunflower Seed Dip!
ingredients: 1 tablespoon sunflower oil | 1 tablespoon sesame seeds | 1 1/2 cups vegetable broth, low fat | 3 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 5 tablespoons safflower oil | 1/4 cup sunflower oil | 1/2 cup emmenthaler cheese, grated | 1 -2 tablespoon mango chutney or 1 -2 tablespoon creme fraiche | 1 can artichoke hearts, drained and chopped
instructions: Heat sunflower oil in a small sauce pot over medium high heat. Add all ingredients except for sour cream, creme fraiche and artichokes. Blend until well combined and pour into a serving dish. Add in sour cream, creme fraiche and artichoke hearts to desired garnish. Serve with warm mini breads.

title: Beetroot Couscous Salad
ingredients: 2 tablespoons couscous | 1 large beetroot | 1 small serrano pepper, thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons dried basil | 1 pinch white pepper
instructions: Scrub the beetroot, cut off the stem, and trim the roots, taking off and keeping the beets attached. Remove the peel, remove the white membrane and tough outer layer. Slice off the root ends, then slice into 3 to 4 inch lengths. In a bowl, mix together the basil and pepper leaves. To assemble the salad, pour in 1 cup boiling water and cook the couscous for about 5 minutes, until al dente. Drain the beets, and toss with couscous. Top with remaining vegetables and basil, and drizzle with olive oil. Serve chilled.

title: Garlic Bread
ingredients: 1 head bulb of garlic | 1 loaf white bread
instructions: Wash and trim garlic cloves. Slice each clove into thick, oval slices. Put the garlic bulbs in a baking dish that has been sprayed with oil. Pour enough water into the dish to cover the tops of the garlic cloves. Cover and bake in a 375 degree oven for 45 minutes. Uncover and bake for an additional 45 minutes. While cooking, slice bread and toast. When removed from the oven, cut each clove into thick slices. Place on a plate, spoon garlic over, and let sit in refrigerator for 2 hours.

Random Ingredients: mint,guacamole,white wine vinegar,beef stew meat,golden raisin,soy sauce,icing sugar,pizza dough
title: Guaco
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless beef stew meat, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 cup plain pizza dough | 1/2 cup hoisin sauce | 1/4 cup white wine vinegar or 1/4 cup rice vinegar | 4 tablespoons light soy sauce | 1 cup golden raisin, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons icing sugar | 1/2 cup finely chopped mint | chopped of fresh mint
instructions: Place beef in bowl of food processor and pulse until finely chopped. Add next 5 ingredients and process until thoroughly mixed. Add beef and work until well mixed. Divide dough in half. Roll each half into a long baguette shape, about 10 inches long and 12 inches wide. Place loaves on ungreased baking sheet, cover with damp towels and let rise about 30 minutes. Preheat oven to 425°f. Place baguettes in oven and bake for 15 minutes or until slightly golden. Remove from oven and place on rack to cool slightly. Remove beef, cool completely and slice. Sift icing sugar and mint on each slice. Arrange raisin on top.

title: Nana's Grand Marnier Marinade for Pork Roast
ingredients: 2 tablespoons green onions ( chopped ) | 1 cup purple onion ( chopped ) | 1 1/2 cups grand marnier
instructions: In bowl, combine green onions and purple onion. Place seasoned meat into large, resealable plastic bag and pour out excess air. Squeeze out excess air and place bag in a large bowl. Pour the grand marnier over the meat and let marinate for at least 8 hours, turning bag over half way through cooking. Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Line a roasting pan with foil and coat with half the remaining marinade. Place in the oven and roast for 20 minutes. Reduce heat to 350 degrees and roast for 3 to 4 minutes, or until internal temperature reaches 165 degrees. Check meat periodically towards end of the cooking time. If it reaches 145 degrees then roast for 45 minutes. Let rest for 5 minutes before slicing. Use reserved marinade for meat.

title: Wasabi Green Onion Chilli Cream
ingredients: 1 tablespoon wasabi paste | 1 tablespoon cornflour | 1 tablespoon garlic | 1 serrano chilies or 1 jalapeno chilies, minced | 6 green onions, thinly sliced | 4 tablespoons salsa
instructions: Combine all the ingredients in a small bowl. Cover and chill until required. Serve cold with ice cream.

Random Ingredients: shallot,kiwi fruit,rice noodle,steak,baby back rib rack,onion powder,chickpea
title: Grilled Steak and Kiwi Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 beef top round steak | 1 kiwi fruit | 1 onion | 2 shallots ( i use 2 onions ) | 4 baby back rib racks | rice noodles | 1 can chickpeas
instructions: Marinate steak in marinade for 2+ hours. Grill on grill. Cut steak diagonally on diagonal for medium rare or to your preference. Let cool.

title: Spicy Corn
ingredients: 24 corn on the cob | 2 teaspoons coarsely crushed peppercorns | 1 teaspoon mild mexican spices
instructions: Place the peppercorn, mexican spice mix and tabasco sauces in a large roasting pan or crock. Broil the corn, 3 inches from the heat, for 3 minutes or until the corn just begins to brown. Spoon the hot corn onto a platter. Serve with a side of sour cream, sour cream, guacamole, salsa, corn chips, etc.

title: Broccoli & Tomato Saute
ingredients: 1 tablespoon grated fresh lemon rind | 3 cups broccoli florets | 3 cups chopped roma tomatoes | 1/2 cup chicken stock
instructions: Combine rind and stock. Heat broiler and add 1 tbsp, until hot but not boiling. Remove from heat and stir in lemon rind and tomato. Place on a serving platter. Sprinkle with chopped parsley or cilantro.

title: Corn Fritters
ingredients: 1 lb self-rising flour | 1 cup frozen corn kernels, thawed | 1/2 cup cornflour ( you may need more, or lower the amount if you use the cornflour in the batter )
instructions: Heat oven to c. Sift flour into bowl. Stir in corn kernels. Mix in corn flour until you have a smooth batter. Heat a flat cooking spoon, put a teaspoon of batter at a time of batter and let it spread out on a baking tray. Bake for about 10 - 15 minutes or until golden. Serve warm or cold.

title: Cajun Triple-Cajun Hot Bread
ingredients: 1/2 pound bacon, cut into 1/4 inch dice | 6 tablespoons poppy seeds | 3 1/2 cups triple sec ( orange liqueur )
instructions: Place bacon in a pot, and drizzle over enough hot water to cover about 3/4 to 1 inch. Stir together the poppy seeds and triple sec.

Random Ingredients: cheese,dill weed,spinach,cottage cheese,clear honey,balsamic vinegar,romaine lettuce
title: Spinach, Cheese & Dill Salad
ingredients: 2 cups fresh spinach ( packed ) or 2 cups thawed spinach ( packed ) | 1 cup low fat cottage cheese, drained | 1/4 cup shredded low-fat cheese | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh dill weed or 1/2 tablespoon dried dill | 2 tablespoons light balsamic vinegar or 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 1/4 - 1/3 cup clear honey | 1/2 teaspoon dried dill weed or 1/2 teaspoon dried dill | 1/2 romaine lettuce or 1/2 radish, torn in small pieces
instructions: Cook spinach over medium heat just until it wilts. Drain, chop fine and put in a bowl. In blender or food processor, process spinach with cottage cheese, cheese, dill, vinegar, honey and dill. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Refrigerate until serving time.

Random Ingredients: iceberg lettuce,snow pea,lamb chop,tamarind paste,sultana,oyster sauce
title: Lamb Shank
ingredients: 2 lbs lamb chops, trimmed of excess fat | 2 tablespoons tamarind paste | 1/4 cup water | 1/2 cup thick sultana ( sultanas ) | 3 cups iceberg lettuce ( torn ) | 1 cup snow peas ( finely diced )
instructions: Cut the lamb into cubes, and place them in a bowl, add the juice or tamarind paste, water and sultanas and mix well. Marinate for 1 hour, stirring occasionally. Line a baking tray with paper, and place the pork and marinade at the top. Roast the meat under a hot grill, or in a frypan, until crispy and lightly charred. Remove from the oven, and cut the meat into thin slices. Serve hot with greens and mint on the side.

Random Ingredients: celery salt,mango chutney,broccoli,cider vinegar,elbow macaroni,turmeric powder,nutmeg
title: Mango Chutney Macaroni and Broccoli
ingredients: 0.333 package elbow macaroni or ( 16 ounce ) package rotini pasta, uncooked | 3 cups fresh broccoli, coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup mango chutney | 1/4 cup cider vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon celery salt | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1/8 teaspoon nutmeg
instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions. While noodles are cooking, in medium saucepan, combine all other ingredients except for noodles, broccoli and chutney. Simmer for 5 minutes over med low heat. Serve hot over noodles. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: black eyed pea,blueberry,white cheddar cheese,maraschino cherry,beef bouillon granule,half cream,parmigiano reggiano cheese
title: Baked Bean Soup
ingredients: 3 packages dried black-eyed peas | 3 cups half-and-half cream | 1 beef bouillon granules, or more to taste | 8 ounces white cheddar cheese, grated | 3 ounces parmigiano-reggiano cheese, grated | 1 jar maraschino cherries, drained and juice reserved | 1/4 cup freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese, or to taste
instructions: Place the black eyed peas in a large pot, and fill with enough water to cover by 2 inches. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to medium low, and simmer until tender, 45 to 60 minutes to 1 hour. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Drain, then add half and half cream and simmer until hot, 15 to 30 minutes. Mix the beef bouillon granules into cream in a large bowl. Stir in 1 cup of cornstarch, then blend with remaining cream.

title: Okra in Okra With Soymilk
ingredients: 1/2 cup low-fat soy milk | 4 teaspoons sherry wine ( or up to 2 tbs. lime juice ) | 1 piece okra ( approximately 8 inches long, cut the stems into 1/8-inch thick slices, but leave the tails on if they have any ) | 1 tablespoon dark beer ( such as negra modelo ) | 1/2 cup frozen okra | 1 tablespoon frozen baby okra ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon frozen small crystalized okra ( optional ) | 0.5 can frozen whole figs, drained, rinsed | 2 cups frozen reduced sodena leaves or 2 cups mesclun ( available in the frozen section of most major asian grocers )
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together soy milk, sherry, and beer. Slice okra lengthwise into 1/4 thick slices. Place okra slices in shallow baking dish with soy milk mixture. Turn soysilk mixture so that both sides of okra are well coated with marinade. Cover baking dish and refrigerate overnight. Brush okra with soymilk mixture and arrange on a platter. Rinse okra well under running water and blot dry with paper towels. Place okra, crystalized okra, and fig in a large salad bowl. Drain okra and figs and add to salad. Cover and refrigerate until serving time. Serve with yoghurt if desired.

title: Spicy Pepper Jack Sandwich
ingredients: 6 fresh shiitake mushrooms, sliced | 1/2 green pepper, sliced | 2 tablespoons southern comfort | pepper, to taste
instructions: Place all the ingredients in a medium size sauce pan and cover with water. Simmer on low heat and cook for about 20 minutes. Cool. Spoon out onto a piece of bread. Roll into a ball and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: thyme leaf,fenugreek seed,parsley sprig,celery seed,shiitake mushroom
title: Mititei (Mushroom Stock)
ingredients: 4 -5 cups thinly sliced shiitake mushrooms | 1/2 - 3/4 cup dried fenugreek seeds | 1/4 cup dried parsley sprig | 1/4 cup celery seed | 1 teaspoon fenugreek leaves, crushed ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a blender or mortar and pestle. Blend until mixture becomes a smooth paste. You may need to reduce this to 1 cup or in larger batches. Use a food processor or hand blender to blend the soup or leave whole. Pour into hot sterilized jars with tight sealing lids.

title: Italian Chicken Legs
ingredients: 8 chicken legs
instructions: Put chicken legs in a big pot. Cover with water that will cover. Boil and boil until tender. Drain the chicken.

title: Chile Con Carne With Dried Cranberries and Chocolate
ingredients: 1 medium cauliflower, chopped ( aka savoy cabbage ) | 2 tablespoons cocoa | 1 teaspoon icing sugar | 1 tablespoon gingerroot, minced | 1/2 teaspoon dried cranberries ( optional ) | 1/4 cup vodka ( optional ) | 1/3 cup tomato ketchup | 15 ounces kidney beans, drained | 2 tablespoons cranberries, coarsely chopped
instructions: Cook cauliflower in boiling salted water approximately 15 minutes. Meanwhile, combine cocoa, icing sugar, ginger, cranberries, and vodka. When cauliflower has wilted, drain well. Put drained cauliflower into large bowl and toss with cocoa mixture. Stir in diced tomatoes and kidney beans. Add more cranberries, if desired.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast,white bread,tea,allspice,cayenne,lime,french onion soup mix,vanilla
title: Easy Spicy Chicken Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 package french onion soup mix | 4 chicken breasts, boneless and skinless | 10 slices white bread, 1/2-inch thick | 10 slices white bread | 2 cups crushed french onion soup mix | 2 tablespoons lime juice, fresh | 1 1/2 teaspoons tea, soy sauce ( or other flavourless soy sauce ) | 1/4 teaspoon allspice | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne
instructions: Mix french onion soup mix, and 3 cups of crushed french onion soup mix together. Coat chicken with this mixture and marinade at least 1 hour. Boil chicken in water until done. Remove chicken from water, and pour broth over chicken and marinade. Cover and simmer on low to medium low heat for 20 minutes until tender and cooked. While chicken cooks, preheat oven to 350 degrees. Dip both sides of bread into soup. Dip the bread in soup mixture and place on baking sheet. Place in oven and bake for 10 minutes. After 10 more minutes remove from oven and add remaining soup mix, soy sauce and allspice. Serve chicken over the bread.

Random Ingredients: peanut butter,mint sprig,wheat angel hair pasta,sherry wine,cream,pineapple,yukon gold potato,bread flour
title: Kittencal's Sweet Potato, Palm and Parsley Pasta With Peanut Butter
ingredients: 3 medium yukon gold potatoes or 3 medium yukon gold potatoes, washed and peeled | 1 1/2 cups bread flour or 1 1/2 cups bread flour | 1/4 lb peanut butter or 1/4 lb creamy peanut butter | 1/4 cup finely minced fresh mint sprig | 4 tablespoons peanut butter | 1/4 cup sherry wine or 1/4 cup white wine | 1/4 cup sour cream or 1/4 cup sour cream | 1/4 cup finely minced pineapple | mint sprig ( optional )
instructions: If using a sharp knife, peel the cooked sweet potatoes, slice them into 1/4 inch rings. Place in a large saucepan of boiling, salted water, and cook until just tender, about 7 - 9 minutes. Drain in a colander and let cool to lukewarm. Preheat oven to 350f degrees. Mash the potatoes with a hand mixer. Add the flour and beat well to combine. Add the peanut butter at a high speed until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Add a little warm water if too dry. Dumplings may be placed on a greased baking sheet. Spread the mixture out evenly in a single layer. Bake for about 1 hour, until golden brown. Stir once or twice while baking to make sure the crust does not burn. Stir 1/4 cup of the minced mint, 1 t. Of the peanut butter and the sherry into the sweet potato. Stir the sour cream into the sweet potato mixture. Spread the remaining 1 t. Of the peanut butter on each of the hot korean chili peppers, making it into a cross. Serve korean chili peppers garnish with mint sprigs.

Random Ingredients: maple syrup,tomato puree,palm sugar,cream mushroom soup,coleslaw mix
title: Sweetened Condensed Sugar and Creams
ingredients: 1 jar condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1/2 cup maple syrup | 1 tablespoon palm sugar | 1 package coleslaw mix | 1 tomato puree | 1/4 cup maple syrup
instructions: Heat all ingredients together until well combined and warm, but not boiling. Put in a small serving bowl and top with 1 slice provolone cheese, and 2 slices provolone cheese. You may also add a dash of caramel sauce or marmalade to the mix for a kick to the flavor if you wish.

Random Ingredients: double cream,fenugreek seed,tamari,arborio rice,spice,cranberry,chicken breast tender,vegetable
title: Mediterranean Chicken With Fresh Vegetables
ingredients: 2 ounces dried mixed pulses | 12 ounces mixed vegetables, such as broccoli, cauliflower, spinach or rutabagas, chopped | 14 ounces skinless chicken breasts or 14 ounces skinless chicken tenders, cut across the bones into thin strips | 7 1/2 fluid ounces double cream, 35g ( plus extra if needed ) | 7 1/2 fluid ounces vegetable broth or 7 1/2 fluid ounces chicken stock | 1 1/2 tablespoons tamari | 1 teaspoon mixed spice | 1 tablespoon dried fenugreek seeds | fresh flat bread, to serve
instructions: Combine the pulses and vegetables in a large pan, add 3 tablespoons cold water. Bring to the boil, then cover and simmer for 10 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside to cool. Meanwhile, preheat the oven to 200°c / 375°f. Stir together the cream, stock, tamari and spice in a large casserole dish. Season with salt and pepper. Add the chicken, reheat and cook for 10 minutes. Add the pulses, vegetables and stock. Bring to the boil, then cover and bake for 1 - 1½ hours. Add the fenugreek and fenugreek seeds and cook for 25 minutes until the vegetables are tender. Stir until heated through and serve with bread.

title: Sesame Swiss Chard
ingredients: 1 bunch swiss chard ( about 40 pounds ) | 1 teaspoon dark sesame oil | 1 teaspoon dried basil
instructions: Using scissors, cut chard crosswise into 1/8 inch thick slices. Slice crosswise into thin 1/8 inch wide slices. Combine sesame oil, basil and season with salt and pepper. Add chard and toss to coat thoroughly. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Remove stalks from chard. Bring chard leaves to room temperature and toss with oil and basil. Serve.

Random Ingredients: basmati rice,cheddar cheese,pink bean,vanilla,deli roast beef,cooking oat
title: Beef and Cheese Burritos
ingredients: 2 cups cooked basmati rice | 1 can pink beans, drained | 2 cups chopped cooked deli roast beef | 1 cup quick-cooking oats | 1/4 cup shredded cheddar cheese | 1 dash vanilla
instructions: Preheat outdoor grill. Spray foil lightly with cooking spray. Spread bean mixture on foil lined grate 7 inches from coals. Wrap up one third of rice in each foil wrapped packet. Place on grill. Close lid, cover and grill until light golden brown. Remove packet from grill. To serve place 2 burritos on each plate. Spoon browned beans, beef and cheese over burritos. Serve with additional topping if desired.

Random Ingredients: velveeta cheese,red potato,yellow pepper,elbow macaroni,plain flour,black peppercorn
title: Cheesy Beef Macaroni & Potatoes
ingredients: 500 g of good quality elbow macaroni | 1 can of deli velveeta cheese, cut into chunks ( or cubed ) | 1 medium red potatoes, cut into cubes | 1 medium yellow pepper, chopped | 40 whole black peppercorns | plain flour
instructions: Start boiling the elbow macaroni in a large pot of salted water. Meanwhile, boil the zucchini and peppers in boiling water for approximately 5 minutes. In a large mixing bowl, add the beef, cheese and all the spices and with a large fork stir through the flour, making sure all the cheese has completely mixed inches pour all of the sauce over the beef and pepper mix well. Now add all of the pasta mix through a sieve and place back in the pan and reheat. Serve with crusty bread or bread rolls and a salad.

Random Ingredients: cooking oat,white sugar,slab bacon,olive oil,mirin,parmesan cheese
title: Grilled French-Canadian Bacon With Oats
ingredients: 20 1/2 ounces cooked crisp-cooking oats | 3/4 cup shredded parmesan cheese | 3 1/4 teaspoons grated parmesan cheese | 1 tablespoon grated parmesan cheese | 1 tablespoon olive oil | 1/4 lb thick slab bacon ( or use cooked and crumbled bacon bits ) | 2 tablespoons mirin | 4 tablespoons white sugar | 1 tablespoon grated parmesan cheese
instructions: In a bowl, toss together the quick cooking oats and 2 1/2 tablespoons parmesan. Sprinkle with 3/4 cup parmesan. Heat a grill pan over medium high heat, and add the olive oil. When the oil is hot, toss the bacon well and quickly into the hot oil. Cook until the bacon begins to brown, about 4 minutes. With a slotted spoon, transfer the cooked bacon to a plate while you prepare your bbq. Combine the mirin with the sugar and remaining 2 tablespoons parmesan in a small bowl. Add the remaining mirin mixture to the skillet with the hot bacon. Bring to a boil, stirring constantly. Cook until almost all of the syrup has evaporated, 3 to 4 minutes. Pour the bbq sauce over the cooked bacon, and serve immediately. To make the bacon curls, slice the bacon crosswise into about 1 inch wide strips. Starting at the end of one strip, weave the strips from the short end through the bacon curl to create a little spiral curl. Place the curls back on the grill briefly to warm them up a little, about 2 to 3 minutes.

title: Lettuce Wrapped Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 1/2 lb beef tenderloin steak, sliced thin | 2 tablespoons flour | 1 1/4 cups reduced-fat tamari | 24 toothpicks | 24 lettuce leaves | 2 cups fresh baby spinach | 2 cups prepared dessert topping, to serve
instructions: Cook beef in hot lightly oiled a nonstick skillet over medium heat, 1 - 2 minutes or until browned. Transfer to plate. Cover. Pour 1/2 cup tamari in bowl. Squeeze juice from juice into bowl with meat. Stir in remaining 1/2 cup tamari. Serve on lettuce lined plates with spinach, baby spinach and topping.

title: Orzo Pasta With Orange Spoon Sweet
ingredients: 1 cup orzo pasta, uncooked | 2 teaspoons cornflour | 1 1/2 cups orange juice, freshly beaten | 2 tablespoons fresh basil leaves
instructions: Cook pasta in a large pan of boiling water until al dente, approximately 8 minutes. Drain well. Meanwhile, stir together cornflour and orange juice, then add to cooked orzo in saucepan.

title: Cantaloupe Melon (Asian-style Sandwich)

instructions: Note, you can purchase pre mixed melons from Asian or pakistani food stores. If you prefer, you may use fresh tofu for this recipe and refrigerate for several hours or overnight. Melt garlic in medium saucepan over medium heat until golden brown and fragrant. Add remaining ingredients and bring to a boil.

title: Chile Rellenos
