instructions: Wipe dry the peppers with a damp cloth or paper towel. Fill in the peppers with water. Let sit in the salted liquid for 45 minutes. Remove skin and seeds. Place black pepper in a bowl with a little water to moisten. Dice the egg yolk. Dissolve 2 cups of cocoa with 2 tablespoons cocoa into the cocoa. Add salt and pepper to taste. Mix egg with a wire whisk or a mortar and pestle. Heat pan or char grill to high. Brush pan, dry, with oil and sear all the peppers on both sides until they are a bit charred and slightly charred but not black. Place peppers in a warm oven to hold for 15 minutes. Serve on a bed of steamed basmati rice, accompanied by guava chile or chunky salsa.

Random Ingredients: irish cream,chicken breast,orange juice concentrate,salt pepper,pork shoulder,rotel,anise seed
title: Creamy Beer Chicken Breast from the Slow Cooker
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless pork shoulder | 6 -7 boneless pork shoulder | 12 ounces frozen orange juice concentrate ( or concentrate ) | 3 tablespoons anise seed, crushed | 2 tablespoons salt and pepper | 1 1/2 cups irish cream | 3 lbs rotisserie-cooked chicken breasts ( or equivalent )
instructions: Place all ingredients into the bottom of the slow cooker. Cover and cook on low 7 to 8 hours. Remove from slow cooker after 4 to 8 hours. Shred meat, discarding and discarding onion and other fat and any undesirable pieces of pork. Return meat to the sauce and simmer until thick and richly flavored, 1 to 2 hours.

Random Ingredients: baby spinach leaf,ham,farfalle pasta,cumin,rosemary,orange,angel hair pasta,chili pepper flake
title: Fusilli with Ham, Spinach and Goat Cheese
ingredients: 8 ounces farfalle pasta | 1 orange, zest and juice only | 1 tablespoon chili pepper flakes | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 1 tablespoon rosemary, chopped | 1 package fresh baby spinach leaves, washed in a large pan to cover | 8 ounces sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained and roughly chopped | 4 ounces smoked ham, sliced thin across the grain
instructions: Cook the farfalle according to directions until al dente. Drain. Meanwhile, heat a non stick frying pan, add the orange zest and juice, chilli pepper flakes, cumin and half of the rosemary. Bring to the boil. Toss in the spinach, then lower the heat and simmer, stirring occasionally, for about 5 minutes or until the spinach is just tender. Add sun dried tomatoes and smoked ham and toss for a further 3 minutes. Drain the pasta and toss well with the sauce, then season, with salt and pepper if desired. Serve immediately.

title: French Style Chicken
ingredients: 12 chicken thighs | 24 ladyfingers
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Remove skin from chicken, but leave visible fat in breasts. Rinse chicken in a bowl until no salt is left. Rub inside of chicken with 1/2 teaspoon of salt. Place 3 - 4 inch depth of oil in a large roasting pan. Place chicken in the pan. Pour enough water into roasting pan to reach at least 1/3 up sides of chicken. Bake at 375 degrees f for 45 minutes. Turn chicken over with fork. Continue baking for 15 minutes or until juices run clear.

title: Italian Cabbage Rolls
ingredients: 2 cups cooked rice flour | 1 1/2 pounds imitation crabmeat, drained | 1 1/2 pounds shredded red cabbage | 2 slices prosciutto
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Mix rice flour, imitation crabmeat, red cabbage, and prosciutto together in a bag. Divide the mixture into 8 portions. Roll each portion into a ball on the prepared baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until the tops are lightly golden brown, about 15 minutes.

title: Korean Potato Salad II
ingredients: 1 can frozen new potatoes | 1 can frozen lemonade concentrate, thawed | 1 bottle sweet chili sauce, or more as needed
instructions: Mix potatoes, lemonade concentrate, chile sauce, and hot sauce together in a bowl. Cover, and refrigerate 3 to 4 hours before serving.

Random Ingredients: sparerib,confectioner sugar,pizza sauce,lasagna noodle,dill,coconut cream,miso,white sugar
title: Miso Spareribs
ingredients: 1 pound spareribs, cut into pieces | 1 tablespoon white sugar | 10 tablespoons miso | 2 containers pizza sauce | 1 can light coconut cream | 1/2 pound shredded dried lasagna noodles | 3 tablespoons confectioners'sugar for dusting | 1 teaspoon dried dill
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add the spareribs, and cook until no longer translucent in the center, 6 to 8 minutes. Drain, and set aside to cool slightly. In a medium bowl, stir together 2 tablespoons sugar and miso paste to make a paste. Spread on the ribs, and refrigerate for 1 hour. Spread a half canful of pizza sauce over the bottom of a 13x9 inch baking dish. Layer half the noodle strips over the sauce. Spread the other half of the seafood sauce over that, and top with a layer of noodles. Spread half the remaining sauce over that, and sprinkle on a second layer of noodles. Spread on the remaining paste, then top with the coconut cream. Dust with confectioners' sugar and dried dill to serve.

title: Italian Shrimp Salad
ingredients: 1 cup red wine vinegar | 1/2 lb prawns, cooked, peeled, de-veined ( fresh or thawed if frozen ) | 1/2 lb spring green | 1/2 lb ripe cheese-filled pepperoni | 1/2 cup chopped green onion | 1 cup fresh sliced marsala or 1 cup dry white wine
instructions: Combine vinegar and prawns, stirring gently until coated with the marinade. Set aside to marinate at least 4 hours before serving. Combine prawns, spring greens, cheese filled pepperoni and green onion. Toss well.

title: Creamy Japanese Mushroom Salad
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs shiitake mushrooms ( about 5-6 mushrooms ) | 1 cucumber, peeled & halved | 1/2 cup margarine
instructions: Bring a small amount of water to a boil over high heat. Add mushrooms & simmer until tender, about 7 minutes. Drain, allow to cool a bit before handling. Cut the caps into very thin strips. Place cucumber strips on a serving plate & top with cucumber strips. Dot the top with margarine. Serve with katakataki, tonkatsu or sticky rice. Enjoy.

title: Rhubarb and Potatoes
ingredients: 1 kg rhubarb, washed peeled and cut into 2 cm pieces | 120 g unsalted almonds, sliced | 100 g mixed dried fruit | 120 g yukon gold potatoes, washed, peeled and quartered | 1 teaspoon grand marnier ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon pure almond extract | 4 tablespoons fresh parsley, chopped
instructions: Steam the rhubarb for 15 - 20 minutes under a steamer over water.

Random Ingredients: pepperoncini pepper,watercress,water chestnut,pine nut,milk,serrano chilies,caraway seed
title: Watercress and Pepperoncini Salad
ingredients: 1 lb of diced mixed greens such as red leaf spinach, red leaf lettuce and tender baby lettuce | 2 tablespoons evaporated milk | 1/4 cup minced water chestnut | 2 tablespoons pine nuts, toasted | 2 tablespoons minced caraway seed | 3 pickled pepperoncini peppers, chopped | 2 -3 serrano chilies, chopped
instructions: Combine all ingredients except for pepperoncini peppers and chilies in a large bowl. Toss well, then chill.

Random Ingredients: egg yolk white,sumac powder,mustard powder,cider vinegar,mango,peach,horseradish,balsamic vinegar
title: Mango Peach Salad
ingredients: 4 large ripe mangoes, peeled, chopped | 2 large ripe peaches, peeled, chopped | 3/4 cup balsamic vinegar | 3/4 cup cider vinegar | 2 tablespoons prepared horseradish | 1 2/3 teaspoons honey | 1/4 teaspoon dry mustard powder | 1 egg yolk ( white only, well beaten )
instructions: Mix mangoes, peaches, vinegar, and horseradish together in a bowl and set aside. In a small bowl, mix egg yolk with sugar and mustard. Beat in mustard and honey mixture. Fold into mango mixture. Refrigerate for up to 3 days before serving to develop flavor. Serve over hot greens.

Random Ingredients: pork chop,red curry paste,pumpkin puree,parsley,dashi stock,spinach,mustard seed
title: Pork Chop and Pumpkin Curry
ingredients: 2 tablespoons red curry paste | 200 ml dashi stock | 200 g fresh pumpkin puree | 1 bunch fresh spinach | 1 tablespoon mustard seeds, finely crushed | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley | 6 pork chops, cooked, shredded
instructions: To make the paste, place the coconut powder, stock, pumpkin purée, spinach, mustard seeds, parsley, and 1 tablespoon of curry paste into a saucepan over medium high heat. Bring to the boil and then reduce the heat. Simmer for 5 minutes or until the sauce is thick. Preheat the broiler to high. Spray the pork chops with oil and season with salt and pepper. Thread onto 12 bamboo skewers and place under the broiler for 5 mins or until golden and crispy. Serve immediately.

title: Angel Food Dessert
ingredients: 2 boxes devil's food cake mix | 1 small yellow pepper, diced
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Spray pan with cooking spray. Pour into pan and brown on bottom 15 min at 350 degrees.

title: Indian Spicy Mashed Oxtail
ingredients: 1/4 cup molasses | 1/4 cup mango chutney | 2 packages active dry yeast | 3 cups cottage cheese | 1 tablespoon cardamom seed | 3 pints salsa | 2 lbs oxtails
instructions: Mix together molasses, chutney, yeast, cottage cheese and cardamom seeds in a large bowl. Add 1 1/2 pints salsa and mix well. Add 1 whole oxtail and stir in by hand to coat all of the pieces of meat. Cover with plastic wrap and let rest at room temperature for 2 days. Prepare bbq for medium heat and cook meat until browned. Cut oxtail into 3rds and place on a sheet of foil and sprinkle meat with salt. Bake in the preheated oven about 20 minutes, until meat is browned and very tender.

Random Ingredients: dill pickle spear,cream chicken soup,purpose flour
title: Dill Dill Dill Potatoes
ingredients: 3/4 cup sour cream | 1 tablespoon all-purpose flour | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. In a bowl, mix together sour cream, flour, and soup. Spread mixture in a baking dish. Bake in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until bubbly. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: white breadcrumb,whipping cream,orange juice concentrate,sherry,thyme,green chilies,hot red chilies
title: Lance's Creamy Chile Rellenos and Chiles
ingredients: 36 green chilies, seeded, deveined and cut lengthwise in half ( i find the peppers, roasted, peeled, and slit in quarters vertically ) | 16 slices white breadcrumbs | 1 cup whipping cream | 1 tablespoon orange juice concentrate | 1 tablespoon dry sherry | 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme ( rubbed between fingers to release flavor ) or 1/2 teaspoon oregano leaves ( rubbed between fingers to release flavor ) | 3 tablespoons orange juice concentrate | 2 -3 tablespoons sweet hot red chilies, chopped
instructions: In a baking dish, lightly sprinkle chilies with bread crumbs. Cover with pepper halves and press lightly to coat with breadcrumbs. Bake in 450 degree f oven until golden, turning once. Cool. Whip cream, add remaining ingredients and serve at once or refrigerate until serving.

Random Ingredients: water,mayonnaise,caster sugar,curry leaf,skewer,ginger garlic paste,corn kernel,pam cooking spray
title: Baked Corn Chips With Curried Ginger & Garlic Dip
ingredients: 2 tablespoons curry leaves, crushed | 2 tablespoons ginger-garlic paste, grated | 1 teaspoon caster sugar | 1 cup water | 1 cup frozen corn kernels or 1 cup corn kernels | 4 skewers, halved crossways | 4 tablespoons mayonnaise | 4 tablespoons thick fat mayonnaise | 1 tablespoon water | cayenne pepper or sambal oelek ( to garnish )
instructions: To make the dip, place all ingredients except the mayonnaise, in a saucepan over medium heat and bring to boil. Simmer for 6 - 8 minutes or until the mixture is thick and creamy. Remove from the heat. Drain corn chips in a colander, then spread on kitchen paper to remove any excess water. Place corn chips on a baking paper lined baking tray or tin. Spoon hot liquid from the pan onto the corn chips while still hot. Cover the chips with a clean tea towel. Place into the fridge for at least 2 hours, preferably overnight. To make the dip, combine all the ingredients together in a bowl and mash gently with a fork. Serve with the dip.

title: Kosher Dressing for Fish and Chips
ingredients: 2 egg whites | 1 tablespoon vodka | 1 dash ranch dressing
instructions: Beat egg whites, vodka and ranch seasonings until fluffy. Fold in fish chips or vegetables.

Random Ingredients: fusilli,colby monterey jack cheese,sherry wine,margarine,green capsicum,milk ricotta cheese,pineapple chunk,soymilk
title: Fusilli and Pineapple
ingredients: 1/4 cup margarine | 8 fluid ounces soymilk | 1/4 cup dry sherry wine | 8 ounces green capsicums, chopped | 1 1/2 lbs whole milk ricotta cheese | 1/3 cup pineapple chunks | 16 ounces fusilli, cooked and drained | 1/2 cup colby-monterey jack cheese, grated | 1/2 cup fresh pineapple chunk, chopped
instructions: Melt margarine with soymilk and sherry and keep warm. In a bowl gently mix well ricotta cheese and pineapples, stirring until smooth. Stir cheese mixture into hot pasta. Divide pasta among serving bowls and top with pineapple chunks.

Random Ingredients: kidney bean,shortcrust pastry,sea salt pepper,veal,cake flour,shiitake mushroom,yogurt
title: Veal and Bean Pie
ingredients: 100 g shortcrust pastry | 100 g dried shiitake mushrooms | 1 fresh veal, cut into slices | 150 g smoked lard or 150 g bacon | 1 tablespoon dried shrimp or 1 tablespoon dried shrimp deveined, finely chopped ( optional ) | 150 g small cooked kidney beans, cooked | sea salt & freshly ground pepper, to taste
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200c / 400f / gas mk. Line a baking sheet with baking paper. Cut 1 piece of greaseproof paper large enough to enclose the pastry into a circle or circle the size of the oven dish you will be using. Cut out a circle of 6 cm / 7 inches around the perimeter of the paper. Place a slice of veal on top, then layer on half of the shiitake mushrooms and half of the smoked lard, if using. Cover with a layer of cooked beans. Repeat layers. Grate the remaining rind from the bacon, and scatter half over the pie. Season to taste with salt and freshly ground pepper. Place in the oven and leave for about 1 hour, until crust is crisp and browned. Slice and serve.

title: Homemade English Croutons
ingredients: 150 g cheese | 1/4 teaspoon ground celery | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace | 1/4 teaspoon chopped of fresh mint
instructions: Put the cheese in a food processor bowl. Using the pulse blade, process the celery, mace and pepper into a fine paste. Pour the cheese paste into a small pan and place over a medium heat. Cook, stirring occasionally for 10 minutes or until the mixture is soft and creamy. Take care not to break up the cheese too quickly. Remove from the heat, discard any celery germ. Drain the cheese.

title: Ginger & Eggplant-Melt-Cream Sauce
ingredients: 1 tablespoon instant dry yeast | 2 eggs, lightly beaten | 2 tablespoons ginger-garlic paste | milk chocolate ( to taste ) | 1 cup warm milk ( to taste )
instructions: Dissolve yeast in water and let sit 10 minutes. In a separate bowl, combine all ingredients. Stir vigorously. Cover with a cloth and leave in a warm place to rise, 1 - 2 hours until doubled in size. Pour into a fry pan, cover and cook over medium heat. When ready serve, spread on your favorite meats, and enjoy.

title: Healthy Oaty Mouthwatering Bread Salad
ingredients: 6 cups cold, crisp crusty bread | 1/2 cup old fashioned oats ( not instant or dried ) | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 2 -3 scallions, finely chopped and divided | 2 cups iceberg lettuce, thinly sliced, about | 1 cup low-fat greek yogurt
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Cut 1/2 from the loaf of bread. Scoop out toasted bread to measure 6 tablespoons. Place the remaining bread in a 9x13 nonstick cake pan lined with foil and bake about 30 minutes or until lightly toasted. Cut loaf in half through the middle horizontally. Remove bread from the croutons and let cool completely. In a bowl, whisk together the old fashioned oats, vinegar and about 1 tablespoon of the scallions. Tear the bread into the bowl. Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of scallions and toss gently. Using a wooden spoon, crush the bread a few times to give the bread a coarse texture, making the croutons more rustic. Spoon evenly into the prepared cake pan. Top with remaining toasted bread.

Random Ingredients: farfalle pasta,syrup,quinoa,coconut milk,yellow cornmeal,snow pea,dill pickle,puff pastry
title: Festive Quinoa and Pineapple Filled Cannelloni
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups quinoa | 1 cup farfalle pasta ( globe spinach and rice ) | 1 1/2 cups yellow cornmeal ( stoneground or homemade ) | 7 sheets ready-to-use puff pastry | 1 cup unsweetened coconut milk | 1/4 cup dill pickle, finely diced ( optional ) | snow peas ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon syrup ( sweetened, if desired )
instructions: If using dry quinoa, use it in your machine’s recipe description and rinse before you cook it. Otherwise, mix with 1 1/2 cups water. To prepare cannelloni, place cornmeal in a medium size bowl, add a scant 1/2 cup water and stir with a fork until the mixture turns into a smooth, wet, dry dough. Turn out onto a floured surface and knead for 2 to 3 minutes, being careful not to overwork the dough. Place dough onto a floured surface and cut it into 1 1/2 inch pieces. Roll each piece into a sausage shape about ½ inch in diameter and press gently with the heels of your hands to flatten them. Cut a small slit in the center of each sausage round and fill with a portion of cooked pasta. If using fresh pasta, follow the package directions, except substitute 1 cup cooked or frozen peas. Otherwise, cook the prepared cannelloni in boiling lightly salted water until just tender, about 1 minute. As the pasta cooks, cut each pastry sheet into 6 or 8 equal wedges. Brush each wedge with a little melted butter or margarine and bake at 400f for 2 minutes, or until golden brown. Spoon 1/2 cup of prepared quinoa onto a plate and arrange 2 to 3 cannelloni in the center. Garnish plate with dill pickles, if used. Yield, about 4 servings. Variation, for an extra kick of flavor dimension, you can spoon a tablespoon of the syrup over the cannelloni.

Random Ingredients: ear corn,caster sugar,olive oil,corn syrup,pasta,meat,salmon steak
title: Laurie's Cornbread Salmon and Salmon Grill (Pasta Fritters)
ingredients: 12 ounces pasta ( fritters, fritters or small pasta shapes ) | 1 lb salted steak | 5 ounces salmon steak ( or use fresh salmon sliced if you prefer as this is the meatiest meat to use ) | 1 small ear corn ( optional ) | 4 tablespoons corn syrup | 2 tablespoons olive oil | 1/2 cup caster sugar
instructions: Cook pasta in salted water according to packet instructions. Rinse and set aside to cool. Heat grill pan, lightly oiled if necessary, or cook steaks in hot pan. Remove from pan when cooked and set aside, keep warm. Mix corn syrup and olive oil together in a saucepan and cook to thicken. Add sugar and cook for 2 minutes more. When the pasta has cooled a little, drain it, return it to the pan and toss in the cornmeal mixture. Place the salmon in the centre and slice very thinly. Add the salmon and stir until just heated through. Serve immediately with the cooked pasta.

Random Ingredients: tamari soy sauce,ham,cake flour,toast,red bell pepper,green chilies
title: Toast and Ham Skewers
ingredients: 2 1/2 ounces dried ham, picked over | 4 green chilies, finely sliced | 1 tablespoon tamari soy sauce | 12 medium cake flour, sifted | toast, grilled
instructions: Dry the ham well but be careful if it sticks to your hands, they stick to the skewer. Thread 1/4 of the chilies onto each skewer and set aside. Add the tamari and salt in a small bowl and soak for 10 minutes. Put the sifted flour on a board and knead well but with care leaving them chunky. Roll the soaked, rolled ham into the flour. Thread it onto a grid and set aside while you cook the rest of the skewers. Keep the sifted flour on your work board under a cloth to collect any browned flour. Grill the skewers over medium hot coals or in a moderate oven until crispy and cooked through then remove them to a plate. Pour the soured flour into a large frying pan and, when it begins to bubble, add the oil. Heat and fry the soured flour until golden. You can tell when this comes to the end when you tap the side of the sausages it should take 2 - 4 minutes. As soon as this happens, remove it from the pan and leave it to cool. Slice the soured ham into 5cm pieces, dust them into the flour. Toss it into the soured flour and fry them in this way for 2 - 3 minutes, until they have a crisp, crispy crust. They will appear tough at first but you should be able to tell when they are cooked through. Slice up the grilled soured ham and arrange them on their own plates along with the soured ham. Serve the soured ham with grilled toast alongside.

title: Ciabatta Canapes With Ham and Spinach
ingredients: 1 ciabatta ( round or oval ) | 6 slices ham | 6 -8 cups baby spinach | 1 egg white | 1 tablespoon canola oil
instructions: Slice bread in half vertically and cut into eighths. Place 2 slices of ham on eighths of bread and top with a portion of the baby spinach leaves. Sprinkle top with egg white on slices. Heat a non stick frying pan over medium high heat. Brush egg white onto bread until it starts to puff up just slightly. Then transfer bread to pan with ham. Cook on both sides until golden all over. Serve hot.

title: Tropical Noodle Salad
ingredients: 3/4 cup spaghetti sauce | 1 ounce dried ramen noodles, seasoning packet | 1 cup lettuce leaf, torn | 1/4 cup finely chopped mango | 1 1/4 cups chopped walnuts, toasted | 1 orange, sliced thin for garnish
instructions: Fill a skillet with boiling water, add ramen noodles and cook until tender but still firm. Drain. Stir in lettuce, mango & walnuts. Toss well with noodles. Cover and let stand 5 minutes. Garnish with oranges.

title: Gourmet Mexican Meatballs
ingredients: 1 lb pork butt or 1 lb pork loin, cut into 1/4-inch cubes | 1/4 cup plain greek yogurt | 4 tablespoons salsa verde | 1 teaspoon dry cornstarch
instructions: Heat a large cast iron skillet or large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Add the pork and cook until well browned. Add the yogurt, salsa verde, and cornstarch and mix well to combine. Cook until gravy is thickened and the cheese is melted, about 2 - 3 minutes.

title: Spiced Portobello Mushrooms
ingredients: 1/2 cup portabella mushroom | 4 green cardamom pods, cracked | 2 -3 button mushrooms
instructions: Wipe the mushrooms and remove the hard stems of the hard stalks. Set aside. Clean the mushrooms and slice into a small bowl or other cup using a paring knife. Place a mushroom slice on the top of the mushroom and sprinkle with some green cardamom pods. Gently roll into a bundle with points being kept away from you. Repeat until all filling is used up. Place on a plate or in a serving dish. Refrigerate for several hours to allow flavours to combine.

Random Ingredients: basil,anchovy fillet,orange flower water,red chili powder
title: Spicy Oil - Di Trinacria
ingredients: 1/4 cup orange flower water | 1/4 cup red chili powder | 2 tablespoons fresh basil, minced | 4 anchovy fillets, minced
instructions: Combine all the ingredients in a small bowl and stir with a fork until smooth. Transfer oil to a funnel or funnel into a jar. Seal and refrigerate for 2 weeks.

Random Ingredients: kiwi fruit,chili paste,hungarian paprika,beef bouillon cube,hot red pepper flake,chicken breast meat
title: Baked Sweet Sliced Chicken Breasts
ingredients: 4 chicken breast meat | 2 1/2 teaspoons hot red pepper flakes, or more to taste | 2 3/4 teaspoons sweet hungarian paprika, or more to taste | 1 beef bouillon cube | 2 kiwi fruits - peeled, seeded, and chopped | 1 tablespoon sweet hungarian paprika for sprinkling
instructions: Place the chicken breasts into a deep pie dish with hot pepper flakes, 2 smoked paprika powder, beef bouillon cube, and kiwi chunks. Sprinkle sweet spanish paprika over the top. Drizzle sweet spanish paprika on top. Cover with aluminum foil. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Bake at 350 degrees f in the preheated oven for about 30 minutes, or until onions are translucent. Remove from oven, and let sit 5 minutes before serving.

title: Green Chili Sauce
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cooking sherry | 1 can green chilies, chopped
instructions: Combine ingredients.

title: Pomegranate Molasses Dressing
ingredients: 1/4 cup pomegranate pods | 1/4 cup dry mustard seeds | 2 tablespoons molasses | 1/4 cup pomegranate juice or 1/4 cup molasses | 1/4 cup olive oil | 3/4 teaspoon saltines ( optional )
instructions: In a screw top jar combine pomegranate seeds, mustard seeds, molasses, pomegranate juice, olive oil and saltines. Shake and toss to blend. Cover and leave in a cool place for up to a week.

title: Chunky Mexican Rice
ingredients: 1/2 cup basmati rice | 1 can diced serrano chilies | 1/2 cup pepperoni | 3 ounces sliced deli-style sun-dried tomatoes | 8 graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Rinse rice and drain. Chop peppers, tomatoes and rind add to rice along with salt and pepper to taste. Combine topping ingredients. Sprinkle on rice. Roll into balls and place on cookie sheet. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Grilled Provolone, Yellow Squash and Basil Stuffed Polenta
ingredients: 1 yellow squash, halved and seeded | 1 cup reduced-fat provolone cheese, shredded | 6 fresh basil leaves, chopped | 2 tablespoons fresh italian parsley, minced | 3/4 cup reduced-fat bottled salsa | 2 teaspoons light tamari ( or soy sauce ) | 3/4 cup dried dates, chopped
instructions: Arrange squash, cut side down, on work surface. Combine cheese, basil, parsley and salsa in small bowl. Spread each squash half with equal distribution of cheese mixture. Place 4 basil halves along 1 edge of each squash half. Roll up. Serve with remaining salsa and tamari. Note, if you plan to keep it, place on a parchment paper lined baking sheet. Cut squash rolls crosswise to serve.

title: Sour Cherry Tomato Sauce for Pasta or Chicken
ingredients: 1 can whole canned cherries in light syrup, drain | 2 1/2 cups half-and-half | 4 tablespoons onions powder | 1 -3 ounce vanilla bean, split lengthwise | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground table salt ( to taste )
instructions: In 2 tbsp. Slow steady simmering liquid, stir in cherries with their juice. Heat over medium heat to boiling.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon,cooking spray,salmon fillet,white vinegar,taco cheese,sharp cheddar cheese,chili oil,lemon extract
title: Smoky Salmon Packets
ingredients: cooking spray | 2 lbs boneless skin on salmon fillets | 1 package taco blend cheese | 1/2 cup quick-cooking spray | 1 1/2 teaspoons chili oil | 1 teaspoon taco seasoning or 1/2 teaspoon mccormick's fast & easy southwestern seasoning | 1/2 cup white vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon lemon extract | 2/3 cup sharp cheddar cheese or 2/3 cup monterey jack cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Prepare a 12 x 9 x 2 inch baking pan with cooking spray. Coat a 10 inch nonstick skillet with cooking spray. Arrange salmon fillets in pan and top with taco cheese. Using a kitchen knife, push down the cheese of the salmon to create pockets. Whisk together taco blend cheese, chili oil, and packet seasoning until smooth. Whisk together vinegar, lemon extract, and salt and pepper and pour over salmon pockets. Sprinkle top of salmon with shredded cheddar cheese.

Random Ingredients: caper,red capsicum,black pepper,peach,pepper,sazon goya coriander annatto,grain rice,egg beater substitute
title: Tajine De Peaches Paella
ingredients: 6 large hard-cooked eggs, chopped | 1 1/2 cups cooked long-grain rice | 3 tablespoons egg substitute | 1 can canned crushed peaches | 2 tablespoons capers, drained | 1/4 teaspoon ground pepper | 1 teaspoon sazon goya with coriander and annatto | 1/4 teaspoon ground black pepper
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the eggs and rice. Drain well, and fold in the peaches, capers, pepper, sazon and black pepper. Cover and refrigerate several hours before shaping.

Random Ingredients: italian sausage,maple syrup,balsamic vinegar,chili sauce,kidney bean,cilantro leaf,black bean
title: Easy Healthy Black Bean Chili Beans
ingredients: 1 lb kidney bean ( cooked weight ) | 1 lb sweet italian sausage ( removed from casings ) | 1 can black beans ( drained weight ) | 1/2 cup maple syrup | 1/2 cup chili sauce ( kikkoman sweet chili sauce ( kikkoman copycat recipe ) ) | 1/2 cup balsamic vinegar | cilantro leaf, to serve
instructions: Cook beans according to package directions. While waiting for other ingredients to be cooked, boil water in saucepan over high heat. Once beans are cooked, drain all excess liquid. Toss together all ingredients with a drizzle of a little of the maple syrup. Serve with fresh cilantro leaves.

title: Penne with Sausage and Ginger
ingredients: 1 package uncooked penne pasta | 1 pound sausage, cut into 1/4-inch slices | 1/2 cup chopped fresh ginger root
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook penne in the boiling water, stirring occasionally until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 11 minutes. Drain. While the pasta cooks, make the sausage. Place the sausage in a skillet or wok over medium high heat. Cook and stir until evenly browned. Drain excess grease and stir in the drained pasta with the sausage and ginger. Cook and stir until heated through, about 3 minutes.

title: A Winter's Walk for the Brave Sweet Potatoes
ingredients: 5 lbs small sweet potatoes | 1/2 teaspoon ground sage leaf | 1/2 teaspoon pure vanilla extract | 5/8 cup vinegar | 10 cherry tomatoes | 2 1/2 quarts good-quality vinegar, at room temperature | 1 can sliced bamboo shoots
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to boil and add the potatoes. When they are fork tender drain the water and cut the potatoes into wedges. Toss lightly with sage and vanilla extract and set aside for at least five minutes. While the potatoes are cooking make the sauce by heating the can of vinegars and bamboo shoots in a large pot over medium heat, stirring constantly until thickened about five minutes. Taste for sweetness and add more sugar if desired. Transfer the warm vinaigrette to the sweet potatoes and toss to coat. Serve with cherry tomatoes. Note, recipe can be made ahead and frozen and reheated just before serving.

title: Hummus No Fat
ingredients: 6 slices french bread | 1 can garbanzo beans | 4 teaspoons chili paste
instructions: Spread a thin layer of hummus on each of the slices of french bread. Spread each loaf with a little chili paste and cover with the remaining slices of bread. Cut each sandwich in half and serve.

Random Ingredients: kaffir lime leaf,caster sugar,lemon zest,red wine
title: Pareve Potted Lemons
ingredients: 5 tablespoons caster sugar | 10 -12 kaffir lime leaves, roughly torn into strips | 750 g punnet red wine, chilled | lemons, zest of or lime zest
instructions: The day before, place sugar in large frying pan. Add the lime leaves, lime zest, and half cup of the wine. Stir over medium heat until sugar has dissolved. Increase heat to medium high and bring to a boil, stirring constantly so as not to scorch the sugar. Once the mixture comes to the boil, reduce heat to simmer, without stirring, and cook gently until it has reduced by half. Remove from heat. Carefully strain the syrup into a colander or sieve lined over a bowl. Discard lime leaves and lime zest. Allow the syrup to cool further. You may serve this immediately or store indefinitely in the fridge. It should be consumed within a week or two. Keeps well.

title: Garlic Ziti
ingredients: 4 cups ziti pasta | 1 teaspoon garlic salt
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add ziti pasta, and cook for 13 to 17 minutes, stirring frequently. Drain pasta well. Place the ziti into a mixing bowl, turn heat to low, and cover. Cook 25 minutes. Remove ziti from heat, and cover. Let sit 10 minutes, fluffing with a fork.

title: Peach Chicken Parmesan - Arancini Risotto
ingredients: 1 package chicken legs, skin removed | 3/4 cup arborio rice or 3/4 cup carnarola rice | 3 large freestone peaches, sliced into eighths | 1/2 cup corn chips
instructions: Place chicken legs on the corn chips and arrange in one layer over the chicken. Sprinkle freestone peaches around chicken. In a large frying pan, cook rice with 2/3 cup water until heated through and beginning to brown, about 8 to 10 minutes. Add corn chips and 1/2 cup of tomato sauce from the marinade to the rice mixture and cook gently a minute. Place chicken legs in the rice and top with remaining tomato sauce. Toss gently, cover and let rest 5 to 10 minutes. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: wild rice,nutmeg,grain rice,olive,baby shrimp,baking soda,yellow zucchini,broccoli floret
title: Wild Rice and Broccoli Stir Fry
ingredients: 1 package long grain and wild rice blend | 1 yellow zucchini, cut into 1/4-inch slices | 1 cup broccoli floret, cut into bite-size pieces | 1 package baby shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1/4 cup ripe sliced ripe olives | 1 teaspoon nutmeg | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 2 cups hot cooked wild rice
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions, or until tender and all water is absorbed. Meanwhile, cook zucchini and broccoli in a pot of boiling salted water for 3 minutes. Drain and set aside. Cut cooked wild rice into 1/2 inch cubes. Add zucchini, broccoli, and shrimp on top of cooked cooked wild rice. Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Add olives.

title: Easy and Delicious Pasta
ingredients: 1 package active dry yeast | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon | 12 ounces linguine
instructions: Scald and add all dry ingredients. Drain pasta and let cool.. Put in bowl, cover and let rise until the pasta doubles. To serve, add sauce to each plate and top with a large spoonful of parmesan cheese.

title: Lizzie's Signature Meat Fries
ingredients: 1 sirloin | 2 medium baking potatoes | 1/3 lb currant jelly | 2 teaspoons clear honey | 2 teaspoons salsa | 2 teaspoons spaghetti seasoning ( optional ) | vegetable oil or peanut oil ( for frying )
instructions: Cut the meat into fries about 1 inch wide. Boil the potatoes until done, remove and let cool. If you're using frozen fries preheat your oven to 450 degrees fahrenheit. Wash, peel and mash the potatoes then add the meat to a large ziploc baggie or other storage container. Add the rest of the ingredients and stir. Refrigerate for 30 minutes. The meat fries need to be chilled at least an hour or more. If they are done at least 15 minutes or more, reheat the marinade and fry the meat up until cooked through. Drain and serve with the fries..

title: Soya Burritos
ingredients: 2 1/3 cups masa harina flour | 1 can beer ( mexican is best )
instructions: Mix masa with beer until it becomes a smooth dough about 1 3/4 – 2 minutes. Divide dough into 4 equal portions and roll out to 1 thick. Place each portion on a hot cast iron skillet and cook until bubbles form at edges. Cut each circle in half and carefully press on edge with fork. Keep each circle on hot skillet to ensure even browning. Remove from pan with spatula and serve.

title: Steakhouse Okra on Rye
ingredients: 1 lb prime rib steak, thinly sliced | 2 packages frozen okra, washed, drained, and sliced | 4 ounces plain flour | 1 package frozen chopped spinach | 3 1/2 ounces beef tenderloin, thinly sliced | 2/3 cup low sodium beef liquid smoke or 2/3 cup beer
instructions: Lightly dust steak with flour. Heat a non stick frying pan over medium high heat to high. Place meat slices in pan. Cook for 1 - 2 minutes on each side until brown and cooked. Remove from pan and set aside. Add okra to pan drippings and cook over medium high heat for 2 minutes. Place okra, cooked meat and spinach in a large casserole dish. Toss with beef liquid smoke or beer. Cover and bake at 190 c for 1 1/2 hours or until tender.

title: Pork Kebabs
ingredients: 600 g pork pate | 1 cup mustard, spicy | 1 cup marinara sauce, prepared
instructions: Soak wooden skewers in water for one hour. Cut meat into small pieces. Place meat in large bowl with the mustard. Drain the marinara sauce and add to meat. Mix well. Put meat on skewers. Prepare barbecue using medium hot heat and place on hot coals. Cook on high for 20 to 25 minutes or till meat is cooked.

title: Braised Butternut Squash With Tomatoes, Shallots & Shallots
ingredients: 4 medium butternut squash, trimmed | 1 teaspoon tamari | 3 plum tomatoes, chopped | 1/4 cup dry white wine | 2 tablespoons shallots, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon rose water
instructions: Place the squash on some paper towels to dry out. Pierce the flesh with a knife at 1 inch intervals. Combine the rest of the ingredients in a frying pan or heavy bottomed pan. Stir over very high heat for 2 - 3 minutes until the tomatoes start to soften. Add the butternut squash, and gently mix. Bring to a simmer and cook, covered, on medium for 40 minutes, or until squash is tender. Serve immediately.

title: Hot Roasted Hazelnuts
ingredients: 4 ounces hazelnuts, toasted and skins removed | 5 ounces unsalted butter, softened
instructions: Combine hazelnuts and butter in a heavy medium size mixing bowl. Beat until just mixed. Place hazelnuts in a food processor or blender with some of the butter and process for 1 minute. Using a large spatula, drop hazelnuts butter into mixture and process for 5 seconds. The hazelnuts will not be perfectly smooth and oily. Spread on a greased tray so that they can dry for about 10 minutes up to 6 hours later. Serve immediately.

title: Ponzu's Sweet Beef Short Ribs
ingredients: 6 lbs short-cut sirloin steaks | 1/2 cup ketchup ( japanese sauce ) | 2/3 cup brandy | 2 tablespoons cornstarch | 2 teaspoons lemon zest, grated | 1/2 cup white cornmeal, to coat | pepper, to taste
instructions: Place the steak in a large resealable zipper top plastic bag. Add the ketchup, brandy, cornstarch, lemon zest and pepper to the bag. Seal and massage all the ingredients throughout the meat. Add the meat to the bag before refrigerating for at least 1 hour. Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Remove meat from refrigerator and place on a plate for 45 minutes. Slice meat against grain into medallions. Arrange on a rack in a roasting pan. Bake for 75 to 90 minutes, basting each time with some of the pan juices. Turn meat once or twice during this, so that the meat cooks evenly. The meat will not be completely cooked, but if desired, a little moisture can be saved. Let meat stand for 5 minutes, then serve with the pan juices that have accumulated.

title: Thai Celery Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups celery hearts ( i use the larger inner stalks ) | 1 can crushed pineapple ( drained and mixed in a blender, with the pineapple ) | 1 tablespoon cumin seeds | 3 cardamom pods | 1/8 teaspoon celery salt | 1/2 cup buttermilk ( i add this to the mix the night before )
instructions: Put celery and pineapple in food processor and blend till they are chopped fine. Add the rest of the ingredients and blend till almost smooth. I don't measure the amount of water i pour in since it's how much the celery has. Serve with bread, crackers, vegetables, etc.

title: Date and Glazed Brussels Sprout & Potatoes
ingredients: 1 large potato, cut into matchstick size pieces | cooking spray | 1 tablespoon grated fresh ginger | 1 lb brussels sprout, ends halved or 1 lb baby brussels sprout, ends halved | 1/2 lb ground lean pork or 1/2 lb ground lean pork | 1/4 cup glace cherries, finely chopped | glace cherries ( to garnish ) | 1/4 cup pitted dates, coarsely chopped ( to garnish )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Spray large baking sheet with cooking spray. Place potato and ginger in medium saucepan.

title: Quick Lasagna Rolls
ingredients: 16 lasagna noodles | 1 1/2 lbs extra lean ground beef | 3 cups water
instructions: In a large pot of boiling, salted water remove the top layer of water from the lasagna noodles. Using your hands, break the noodles until they are broken down into thin ribettes about 1 1/2 1/2 inches long and 1 inch wide. Repeat until all the noodles are broken into noodle ribbons about 3/4 inch wide and 8 inches long. In a large non stick skillet cook the beef over medium heat and stir constantly with a wooden spoon, scraping browned bits of the pan bottom and sides until no red remains. Pour in the 3 cups of water and bring to a boil. Add the noodles and boil, stirring until just tender. Rinse with a little water and drain. Serve with garlic bread.

title: Goya Mojo Dressing
ingredients: 2 tablespoons mirin, or to taste ( rice wine vinegar ) | 1/2 cup vegetable fat | 1/2 cup palm sugar, or to taste ( optional ) | 1/2 cup garlic butter, chopped
instructions: Stir mirin with vegetable fat in a bowl until dissolved. Stir in palm sugar and garlic butter.

title: Flambéed Blueberry and Bacon Mini Quiches
ingredients: 120 g feta cheese, crumbled | 1 teaspoon fine dry breadcrumb | 65 g smoked streaky bacon | 2 tablespoons light cornflour | 1/2 teaspoon ground turmeric | 125 g blueberries | 1/2 cup tahini | 60 g fresh mozzarella cheese, finely grated
instructions: Finely grate the streaky bacon and fry in a large skillet, with a tiny pinch of seasoning, until it is lightly coloured. In a large bowl mix the feta, breadcrumbs, turmeric, yoghurt, and seasoning. Add the blueberries, fold through and set aside. Preheat oven to 220°c. Place a baking tray into the oven and position it under the baking tray. Smear the hot, lightly coloured bacon inside of each mini quiche tin. Bake for 15 minutes. Top with the grated mozzarella cheese and return to oven for another 5 - 10 minutes or until cheese has melted and the quiches are golden. Serve warm with salad.

Random Ingredients: beef tenderloin steak,duck leg,coleslaw mix,sauerkraut,star anise
title: Delicious Slow Cooker Sauerkraut
ingredients: 4 beef tenderloin steaks, about 1-1/2 inches thick | 4 duck legs | 2 cans sauerkraut | 1 star anise | 2 bags shredded coleslaw mix
instructions: Trim fat from meat.

title: Slow Cooker Irish Sausage and Apple Salad
ingredients: 2 lbs extra lean ground beef | 1 lb kielbasa, cut into 1/2 inch thick slices ( i like hillshire farm club ) | 4 medium apples, peeled, cored and shredded | 2 yellow bell peppers, seeded and chopped | 1/2 cup fresh parsley, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme | iceberg lettuce, coarsely chopped
instructions: Place the beef, kielbasa, apples, pepper, parsley, and thyme in a crockpot. Mix well and cook on low for 6 to 8 hours, or cook on low until the mixture is well browned. Remove from heat and serve over the iceberg lettuce as a side.

Random Ingredients: onion,pesto sauce,shallot,cumin,monterey jack cheese,chick pea,pearl tapioca,yellow pepper
title: Chickpea and Cheese Toss
ingredients: 1 can chick-peas, rinsed and drained | 1 shallot, chopped | 1 yellow pepper, chopped | 1 medium onion, chopped | 1 package frozen pearl tapioca | 1 tablespoon pesto sauce | 1 1/2 teaspoons cumin | 3/4 cup shredded monterey jack cheese
instructions: Cook chickpeas, shallots, yellow pepper, and onion in a large skillet over medium heat until hot, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Add tapioca, pesto sauce, and cumin.

Random Ingredients: blueberry,mexican tomato jalapeno pepper,apricot preserve,pepperoni,apricot,roast,apple juice,baby spinach leaf
title: The Best Roast,  Berry & Fruit Salad
ingredients: 2 medium whole-wheat roasted italian tomatoes with jalapenos and pepperoni | 1/2 cup apricot preserves | 3/4 cup cranberry juice | 1 cup cubed mixed baby spinach leaves | 4 cups cooked cooled deli roast | 1 package sliced dried apricots | 1/2 medium dried apricot | 1 jar good-quality commercial-quality brand apricot preserves | fresh cracked pepperoni, slices ( optional )
instructions: Heat oven to 325 degrees. In a mixing bowl combine canned tomatoes, 1/2 c apricot preserves, 1/2 c cranberry juice & spinach & mix well. Spread salad mixture in a 12 x 8 oven proof baking dish & top with roast, berries, apricots & apricots. Drizzle with remaining 1 tbsp apricot preserves. Sprinkle with cracked pepperoni slices. Bake at 325 degrees for 30 minutes, or until warm & bubbly. Serve warm or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: ginger garlic paste,lemon zest,chickpea,cinnamon sugar,egg yolk,salmon,plum tomato
title: Salmon With Tomatoes & Chickpeas - Norway
ingredients: 1 can chickpeas, drained and rinsed | 1 can canned plum tomatoes, crushed and chopped fine | 2 tablespoons lemon zest | 1 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste | 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon sugar | 1 egg yolk | 4 skinless salmon, cleaned & halved ( about 2lb 1-inch thick pieces )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. In a shallow baking dish, combine chickpeas, tomatoes, lemon zest, ginger garlic paste, and cinnamon sugar and mix well, breaking up tomatoes, until combined and well mixed.. In a bowl beat egg yolk and splash into tomato mixture, stirring to blend. Arrange salmon over tomato, then spoon tomato mixture over fish. Cover with foil and bake mixture for 55 minutes. Let stand for 10 minutes before serving.

title: Navy Bean Soup
ingredients: 1 lb navy beans, drained | 1/2 lb cheesecloth | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add the navy beans and cook uncovered for 5 minutes. Drain the beans and place in a large bowl. Add the cheesecloth and rub on the surface of the beans. Let it drain for 1 hour. Remove the cheesecloth and use it to sprinkle on the surface of the soup. Pour the water through a sieve and serve hot.

title: Basmati Seasoned Rice
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups basmati rice | 1 teaspoon seasoning salt
instructions: Place basmati in a saucepot. Add enough water to cover by 3 inches. Bring to a boil.

title: Beef Larb
ingredients: 1 package fresh cremini mushrooms, sliced | 12 slices sirloin, thin | 24 small lettuce leaves
instructions: Place sliced mushrooms on plate. Place 1 slice of beef over mushroom, top with 1 lettuce leaf using a sharp knife. Roll up loosely and secure firmly using toothpick. Repeat process using remaining beef. Serve with sour cream, if desired.

Random Ingredients: potato,sultana,whipping cream,lime leaf,beef stew meat,guacamole,plain gelatin,bean
title: Easy Beef and Potato Jellies
ingredients: 2 onions, large, chopped | 1 lb beef stew meat, chopped | 16 ounces mixed beans, drained and rinsed | 6 large potatoes, peeled & cut on an angle into quarters | 3/4 cup sultana, dark sweet | 12 ounces plain gelatin, melted | 1/4 cup whipping cream | 1 lime leaves, torn
instructions: Sauté onion in a large skillet for 9 minutes. Add beef and cook until browned, then add beans and potatoes. Place in a casserole dish and top with sultanas. Dissolve jelly in cream, then add to the pan with the milk and water to come to a boil. Pour over mixture and sprinkle remaining ingredients. Cover and freeze until ready to serve. To serve, remove from the casserole dish, remove the top of crust and place the casserole top back on. Place serving plate on top and carefully invert so casserole dish as upside down onto the serving plate.

Random Ingredients: red potato,lemon juice,guava nectar,yellow onion,golden syrup,turmeric powder,chili pepper flake
title: Guava Potato Wedges
ingredients: 1 large red potato | 4 teaspoons lemon juice | 2 teaspoons chopped yellow onions | 1/2 teaspoon chili pepper flakes | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1/2 cup golden syrup | 1 tablespoon sweet potato pickled hot chili pepper flakes
instructions: Peel potato then grate into a large mixing bowl. Add lemon juice, onions, chilli, turmeric, golden syrup and hot chili flakes. Mix well. Add potato wedges. Cover and leave in fridge until cold. Serve on a bed of lettuce.

title: Chicken Tuna and Black Bean Casserole
ingredients: 200 g chicken thighs, skin on | 100 g dark cocoa | 1 can black beans or 200 g red kidney beans, drained | 1 can tuna, drained | 25 g cashews, roughly crushed
instructions: Preheat oven to 180c/360f/gas line an 8 square pan with baking paper. Place the chicken thighs and about 3 tablespoons of the cocoa in a medium saucepan add the beans and bring to the boil until simmering. Remove from heat and set aside. Pour the remaining 1 tablespoon of cocoa into a bowl, place the tuna in a second bowl and stir in another tablespoon of the cocoa, the beans and tuna with a fork. Spread the bean mixture over the base of the prepared baking tin and top with the coconut. Bake for 35 - 40 minutes until the browned and crispy. Sprinkle over the cashew nuts during the last five minutes of baking, if using.

Random Ingredients: green chili pepper,wheat flour,egg yolk,ginger powder,brown lentil,self rising flour,tap water,monterey jack cheese
title: Chile Con Queso - Lentil Bread
ingredients: 2 cups white lentils | 1/4 cup brown lentils | 1 teaspoon ginger powder | 1 teaspoon green chili pepper ( optional ) | 1/4 cup teapsoon tap water | 1 egg yolk | 1/4 cup self-rising flour | 1 teaspoon whole wheat flour
instructions: Place all of the dry ingredients into the mixing bowl the brown lentils were soaked in. Pour the tap water into the mixture. Mix well. Pour a layer of the prepared batter onto the cookie sheet spread evenly with a fork. Make sure all of the dry ingredients fit in a layer. Top with remaining batter. Bake at 400 degrees for 15 minutes or until golden brown. Serve with your choice of dipping sauce.

title: Spicy Chili Vinegar
ingredients: 1 cup cider vinegar | 1 teaspoon chili flakes | 2 tablespoons tabasco sauce
instructions: Combine all the ingredients in a microwave safe container. Microwave on high for 12 minutes stirring twice. Store in the refrigerator, it will keep for up to a week. You can also use hot chili powder if you haven't got any leftovers.

title: Crock Pot Ginger Beef Kebabs
ingredients: 3 lbs boneless chuck roast, cut into 1 1/2 inch cubes | 2 tablespoons dark rum | 1/4 cup cranberry juice | 2 teaspoons ground gingerroot | metal skewer
instructions: Combine all ingredients except skewers in a slow cooker. Cover and cook on low until the meat is tender, about 7 hours. Remove meat to a bowl and shred or chop into cubes. Drain excess liquid, reserving some. Thread meat, beef, and any accumulated juices, onto metal skewers, about six pieces per skewer, reserving about a cup juice for brushing on the kebabs. Grill over hot coals 6 minutes, turning once, or until hot.

title: Spaghetti With Glazed Maple Syrup on Nuts (Gluten Free)
ingredients: 1/2 lb spaghetti | 1/2 cup fresh orange peel, sliced | 1/2 cup unsalted lard | 1/4 cup maple syrup | 3 tablespoons rice wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons ghee
instructions: Bring a pot of water to boil. Meanwhile, trim the orange peel, then cut into slices. In a large skillet, melt the lard. Add the orange peel and maple syrup and cook on low until all the liquid has evaporated. While the syrup is heating, cook the spaghetti in a large pot of boiling salted water until just tender but slightly firm, stirring to separate them. Drain the pasta, then place in a large serving bowl. Add the olive oil and ghee, along with the warm syrup, orange slices and maple syrup. Toss, and pour over the pasta.

title: Mexican Skillet Mac and Cheese with Radishes and Noodles
ingredients: 8 ounces chunky salsa | 1/3 whole grain rice noodles | 3 large radishes, thinly sliced | 1 1/2 2 cups shredded reduced-fat cheddar cheese or 2 cups colby cheese | 1 package shredded chunky salsa | 12 slices pepperoni
instructions: Cook rice noodles as directed on package. Set aside and keep warm. Meanwhile, in a large nonstick skillet, heat 2 tablespoons of the chunky salsa. Add half the radishes and season with salt and freshly ground black pepper. Sauté until the radishes are tender, about 3 minutes. Top the noodles with half of the radishes, half of the cheddar cheese, and half the chunky salsa. Spoon the noodles into bowls and top with the remaining radishes, cheese, and salsa. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: granny smith apple,spicy chili seasoning mix,tuna steak,asiago cheese
title: Spicy Apple Swiss Steak for Two
ingredients: 4 tuna steaks | 1 tablespoon spicy chili seasoning mix | 1 large granny smith apple | 2 slices asiago cheese
instructions: Pound steaks a few times to flatten. Rub spicy chili sauce evenly on both sides of the steaks. Lay 3 slices of apple on each steak. Place steaks in a baking dish large enough to hold steaks. Drizzle with remaining spicy sauce and top with asiago cheese. Cover and refrigerate for 20 minutes or until steaks are cooked to your liking about 20 minutes before serving. Remove from baking dish and serve.

title: Enchiladas a la Gasiov (Microwave Recipe)
ingredients: 2 cans evaporated milk | 2 tablespoons italian parsley, chopped | 12 corn tortillas, about 2-inch in diameter
instructions: Combine evaporated milk and parsley in a small, ovenproof bowl. Microwave on high for about 45 seconds. Transfer 1 1/4 cup of mixture to a small bowl. Dip corn tortillas in milk mixture until both sides are coated. Lay in a single layer on paper towels. Microwave on high about 45 seconds, or until heated through. Transfer 1/4 cup of the hot mixture on each fried tortilla to serve. Sprinkle with remaining cereal. Microwave on high about 1 minute or until cereal is well melted and the tortillas sound slightly hollow when knocked on the bottom.

title: Gluten-Free Mix for Pasta (Gluten Free)
ingredients: 2 cups oatmeal, plain or 2 cups gluten-free oats ( gluten-free ) | 1 tablespoon chili oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 180c or 170c. Mix together the oats, chili oil and the powder mix. Store in an airtight container until needed. Use in a recipe or as a topping for your pasta, or use as a topping for raw vegetables, etc.

title: Easy Yummy Pista-Scented Chiles
ingredients: 10 -12 fresh rosemary branches | 2 fresh green cardamom pods | 6 -8 small dried hot green chilies | 5 -6 tablespoons chopped pistachios ( or almonds )
instructions: Soak chiles in hot water for 2 - 3 hours, then rinse. If you have any water left, the chiles will absorb excess water. Remove stems, leaving just a bit of the green stalky bits. Place on a plate, cover and leave for 10 minutes. Drain. Place another plate on top and dry fry the mint leaves, stirring often. Take off heat and set aside. Remove stems from chiles, discard leaves, and slit open each slit slightly so as to open the chili without breaking the shells. Take 1 tbsp mint leaf from each chile and make a small slit through the base so that the chili remains intact. Add 5 tbsp of pistachios or almonds. Stuff 1 tsp of the chillie mixture onto the bottom portion of the chili. Place a second chili on top. Squeeze together all of the juice of the mint leaves and add to the top of the chili. Serve.

title: Grandma's French Toast
ingredients: 1 tablespoon oil | 1/2 cup spanish onion, sliced finely | 3 tablespoons dark rum | 1/2 - 3/4 cup molasses | 12 ounces dark rum | 2 -3 1/2 - 3 3/4 teaspoons juniper berries or 2 -3 1/2 teaspoons anise berries
instructions: Sauté onions in hot oil in frying pan with a splash of rum and molasses for 3 minutes.

title: Stuffed Feta Fritters
ingredients: 1 tablespoon unsalted butter | 2 ounces pancetta, finely diced | 1/4 cup low-fat salsa ( your choice ) | 1/2 teaspoon hot sauce | 1 cup cake flour | 1/4 cup feta, crumbled
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f in a medium skillet, melt butter over medium heat. Add pancetta.

title: Asparagus With Chicken & Asparagus
ingredients: 1 lb fresh asparagus, trimmed | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon
instructions: Cut off woody ends at the tips of the asparagus then cut off woody ends using a sharp knife or any scissors. Cut out the hard stalks of the asparagus. Boil asparagus in lightly salted water until crisp tender drain drain and set aside. In a small pan, saute the asparagus over medium heat until heated through add the chicken bouillon and saute 5 minutes. Stir the asparagus well before serving.

title: Italian Goya Sausages
ingredients: 8 links mild italian sausage, cut into 1-inch pieces | 1 cup molasses | 2 1/2 teaspoons paprika | 1 teaspoon celery salt | 3/4 teaspoon dried oregano
instructions: Place the sausage pieces in a large skillet. Dry fry the sausages, stirring constantly, until crumbly and no longer pink inside. Drain off the fat. In a medium bowl, stir together the molasses, paprika, celery salt, and oregano. Add sausage, and toss until coated. Pour into a 9x13 inch baking dish, or an 8x8 inch baking pan. Bake in preheated oven 325°f, until hot and bubbly, about 60 to 90 minutes.

title: Lebanese Lamb and Cinnamon Wrap
ingredients: 1 lb lean ground lamb | 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon | 2 flour tortillas
instructions: Brown lamb and cinnamon until lamb is brown and crumbly. Preheat the broiler and line a baking tray with foil or parchment paper. Using a fork, poke a series of small holes into the tortillas to allow steam to escape to fill holes. Carefully open each tortilla and drain excess lamb liquid. Spread about 1/2 tb of the lamb mixture over bottom of each tortilla, leaving about 1 tbsp of meat showing thru. Roll up each tortilla and enclose with your hands. Place the wraps in the oven and broil for about 10 minutes for the tortillas to lightly brown them. Note, if you serve your burritos this way, place in a warm oven to toast for a few minutes so the burrir can warm through and have wonderful flavors.

Random Ingredients: white wine vinegar,chili sauce,cheese tortellini,scotch bonnet pepper,meat,streaky bacon
title: Crispy Cheese Tortellini With Bratwurst (Beef)
ingredients: 8 slices streaky bacon, chopped | 1 1/4 lbs ground meat | 12 ounces fresh cheese tortellini | 3 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon sweet chili sauce | 1 scotch bonnet pepper
instructions: In a large frying pan, fry the bacon until it is beginning to render its fat. Add in the meat and fry for 5 minutes until the beef is browned, breaking it up as it cooks. Drain off any excess oil. Drain off any excess fat. Set aside. Meanwhile, cook the tortellini according to the packet instructions. Meanwhile, put the vinegar in a saucepan and bring it to the boil. Add in the sweet chilli sauce. Return the meat to the pan, add in the tortellini and some salt and pepper, to taste, and toss in the warm sauce until everything is coated and warm through. Serve immediately.

title: Spaghetti With Curry and Herb
ingredients: 4 -5 cups spaghetti sauce ( homemade or commercial ) | 1/2 head fresh white mushroom ( medium size or small ) | 1 package lemons and tricoloured candied peel | 3 tablespoons dried thyme | 12 sprigs fresh curry | 2 tablespoons instant tea
instructions: Boil spaghetti sauce. Add mushrooms and tricoloured candied peel. Heat through and add tea. Remove thyme sprigs. Sprinkle with lemon peel. Add 1/2 c curry leaves and 1/2 c fresh thyme. Serve.

title: Tilapia (Sweet Chili Candy )
ingredients: 1/2 pound fresh sweet red chile - sliced into thin strips | 12 ladyfingers, split lengthwise
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Spread red pepper slices onto a baking sheet. Break small pieces of ladyfingers into thirds, and place onto the hot cookie sheets. Bake for 15 minutes in the preheated oven. Remove from the oven, and immediately roll the ladyfingers in chile strips to coat.

Random Ingredients: inner pack saltine cracker,sun tomato oil,chicken bouillon granule
title: Sun-Dried Tomato Crusted Rounds
ingredients: 1 package frozen unsalted dry-roasted sun-dried tomato packed in oil, thawed and drained | 1 1/2 teaspoons chicken bouillon granules | 1 cup finely crushed cracker
instructions: Using a 2 qt slow cooker, combine 1 1/2 cups water, sun dried tomatoes, bouillon, and crackers.

Random Ingredients: egg,duck,spaghetti sauce,italian herb seasoning,oil,lime zest,beef stock
title: Tiny Roast Duck
ingredients: 1 duck | 3 tablespoons italian herb seasoning, divided | 1 tablespoon grated lime zest | 2 tablespoons dried italian herb seasoning | 3/4 cup beef stock | 3 tablespoons oil | 6 eggs, lightly beaten | 2 jars spaghetti sauce
instructions:
Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Brush the duck inside and out with half each of the 1 tablespoon of italian herb seasoning, the lime zest and the dried italian seasoning. Place on a rack in a roasting pan and roast for 45 minutes. Once in a preheated oven, reduce the temperature and roast for an additional 30 minutes, or until the internal temperature reaches 170 degrees f. Reduce head temperature to 150 degrees f and continue to roast for another 15 minutes. Remove from oven and allow to rest for 20 minutes. Rinse duck inside and out and pat dry with a paper towel. In a small bowl, mix the remaining italian herbs, stock and oil. Spoon 3 tablespoons of the spiced oil onto a toothpick in each breast cavity, and roll it in the herb mixture. Place the roll in a roasting pan skin side down. Brush the outside surface of the duck generously with the remaining spiced oil, sprinkle with remaining italian herb seasoning. Place the duck upright on the rack in the roasting pan. Roast 10 more minutes for medium rare or longer for medium well. For a lighter, longer duck, cook longer, or slower. Allow to rest for 15 minutes before carving. Cooks' notes, the oven can also be very hot. Make sure to check oven after 20 minutes for doneness after 10 minutes when the skin is starting to darken but the thick part of the duck is still

 If flare ups occur, roast the duck on a rack set in a baking sheet in a location that is slightly lower than the oven, to reduce flare ups. After 20 minutes, take the duck out of the oven and allow it to rest for 10 minutes, and check it for doneness. When the duck is almost cooked, take the toothpick out of the pan. Brush the inside of the breast with the remaining spiced olive oil. Heat the spaghetti sauce over medium heat in a pot until warmed through and slightly darkened. Slice the duck in half and serve with the sauce.

title: Jasmine Rice With Daikon and Caramelized Peanuts
ingredients: 1/2 cup jasmine rice | 4 cups daikon radishes, peeled and thinly sliced | 2 cups peanuts, toasted ( or roasted salted peanuts )
instructions: Spray a 9 x 13 inch baking dish with pam or lightly oil the pan. Place rice on the baking dish. Sprinkle daikon and peanuts over the rice. Place pan of water on the baking dish and add water to cover. Cook rice until water is mostly absorbed and rice is soft, about 30 minutes. Remove from pan. Heat a heavy skillet with a low flame, such as a cast iron stove, over medium high heat. Lightly brown the daikon and peanuts for 3 minutes. Remove from heat and place into a bowl. Cover rice and peanuts with water if mixture becomes too dry.

title: Spicy Portuguese Shrimp Salad
ingredients: 1 head romaine lettuce, washed and shredded | 6 ounces medium shrimp paste, thawed if frozen | 3 tablespoons roasted cumin seeds | 1 teaspoon dry mustard | 1 teaspoon prepared mustard | 2 pints sauerkraut, rinsed and drained
instructions: Place torn romaine lettuce in a bowl, toss with shrimp paste, cumin seeds, dijon and prepared mustard. Place in a large serving bowl and garnish with sauerkraut.

title: Polish Sausage and Roast Lamb
ingredients: 1 boneless leg of lamb, in 2 1/2 cm cubes ( or more, depending on size ) | 5 polish sausage | 3 cups self raising flour | 1/2 cup self raising flour | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 1 cup milk instant coffee or 1 cup hot water
instructions: Remove the meat from the fridge. You can also remove the rind if using a thick sausage or you can just use a foreman type or a leg of lamb. Pound the meat to about ¼ centimetre thickness. Season all over with salt. Mix the self raising flour and salt together. Put in the bowl and pour the milk or coffee over it. Mix well. Put in the fridge for about half an hour. When its ready to cook you can either do this over the coals or you can do this under the grill, etc. But be careful because the meat can burn very quickly if the coals are too hot put in to a warm oven and it will burn quickly. Bake slowly in the oven for around 90 minutes depending on how much meat you have. Take out of the oven when the meat is browned lightly and serve with mashed potatoes, or your favourite mashed potatoes.

title: Egg Noodles (Cook's Country)
ingredients: 1 1 cup egg noodles, fresh or dried | 5 fresh thyme sprigs
instructions: In a saucepan of boiling salted water, cook the egg noodles until just tender but firm, about 1 minute. Drain the noodles and transfer to a colander to drain the excess water. Rinse with cool water and drain well. Return the noodles to the saucepan, stirring to coat. Sprinkle with thyme. Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until the noodles are tender, about 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: rum,beef chuck roast,cooking spray,nutmeg,chili sauce,sesame oil,parsnip
title: Beef Stew With Parsnips and Rum (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 1 boneless beef chuck roast, trimmed of most fat | cooking spray | 1 1/2 tablespoons sesame oil, divided | 1 jar spaghetti sauce or ( 16 ounce ) jar chili sauce, if you prefer | 1 tablespoon light rum | 1 teaspoon ground nutmeg | freshly grated nutmeg | parsnips
instructions: Place chuck roast in slow cooker, cover with water, and scatter with salt. Place cooker on high for 5 hours until the beef falls apart and can be cut or pulled apart. Shred the beef with two forks on the diagonal, then return it to the slow cooker. In a small bowl, combine the remaining ingredients until well mixed and pour over meat. Cover and cook on low for 6 to 8 hours, stirring occasionally. Garnish with parsnips, if desired.

Random Ingredients: ginger garlic paste,pork,self raising flour,cooking oil,baking chocolate
title: Czech Dumplings
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 lbs pork, cubed | 1 lb self raising flour | 2 tablespoons ginger-garlic paste | 12 ounces baking chocolate or 12 ounces coconut milk | 6 tablespoons cooking oil
instructions: In a large bowl mix the pork cubes into the flour, ginger garlic paste, chocolate or coconut milk. Form round balls and fry.

title: Chinese Hamburgers
ingredients: 2 tablespoons beef bouillon granules | 1 dried ancho or dried ancho peppers
instructions: Combine the sugar, achi pepper and beef and bouillon in a medium bowl.

Random Ingredients: ice water,raspberry jam,cayenne pepper,barbecue sauce,tomato,cooking oil
title: Churros - Microwave  Recipe  for Pyros
ingredients: 1 tablespoon barbecue sauce | 1 teaspoon tomato, chopped | 4 tablespoons raspberry jam ( or jam of choice ) | 1 tablespoon water | 1 tablespoon cooking oil ( sunflower or olive ) | cayenne pepper ( more to your taste )
instructions: Combine the barbecue sauce, tomato and raspberry jam, and water. Heat for a minute or two on the slow ring in your microwave. This will make the churros creamy and very tasty. While waiting, brush the cut sides of a plate with oil. Put the plate into the microwave for a few seconds. Turn the plate back on, and pour the hot mixture over the plate. Swirl to coat the entire surface of the churros or if the plate is turning too hot, a spatula. Microwave for a couple of seconds or a quick stir until hot, or leave as is, just until warm, not hot. If it's hot enough, microwave for two seconds or so, but not so long that it's hot that your churros turn golden. This recipe tastes best when they are warm. Stir to help soften the churros if it gets cold. Note you can serve the churros warm or cold, or keep the churros in the fridge so they do not get soggy.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon cube,cake flour,turkey,sugar snap pea,black bean
title: Caribbean Beef N' Sugar Snap Peas
ingredients: 1 lb ground turkey | 3/4 cup cake flour | 1/2 cup sugar snap pea | 1 beef bouillon cube | 1 can fat-free vegetable broth or ( 14 1/2 ounce ) can reduced-sodium beef broth
instructions: In skillet over medium high heat, stir fry turkey 5 minutes or until juices run clear. Stir in flour remaining in skillet until well blended. Stir in sugar snap peas. Stir fry 2 minutes or until just heated. Stir in broth and boil 3 minutes or until bubbly. Stir in meat mixture, bring to a boil then remove from heat.

Random Ingredients: pepper,avocado,olive oil,spring onion,dark chocolate,navy bean,vegetable oil cooking spray,phyllo dough
title: Chokladakia
ingredients: 100 g dark chocolate | 150 g navy beans, cooked | 1 teaspoon olive oil | 1 small spring onion, chopped | 1 avocado, sliced | 1 package phyllo dough | vegetable oil cooking spray
instructions: Add the beans into a pan of boiling water and boil for 5 minutes or until the beans are soft. Drain and set to side. Heat the olive oil in a small frying pan and fry the bean mixture slowly, for around 2 - 3 minutes until cooked through. Season. Preheat the oven to 350°f. Brush two large sheets of aluminium foil with oil. Carefully place one over the base of your oven proof dish, spraying oil and oil with oil. Cut the phyllo dough into 4, 5 strips each, leaving some unused pastry for finishing later. Place 1/2 cup of the bean/cheese mixture onto the phyllo. Cover with another sheet to make a lid later. Repeat with the remaining sheets and filling. Brush with oil, place on the top of the lid and seal in the oven. Bake at 350f for about 30 - 40 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Greek Style Spinach
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon ground black pepper | 1 green bell pepper, sliced into 1/4-inch strips | 1 package fresh spinach, washed and trimmed
instructions: Heat a skillet over medium high heat, and spray with cooking spray. Sprinkle in the pepper and cook for 1 to 2 minutes, or until peppers become fragrant and beginning to brown. Add the spinach, and stir. Cover, and cook for about 5 minutes, until the spinach is wilted and heated through. This will serve as a filling for the burritos, or as a garnish for grilled chicken, turkey or other meats.

title: Mexican Fried Spices
ingredients: 2 teaspoons salt | 1/2 teaspoon spices | 2 teaspoons peanut butter | 1 tablespoon cocoa ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon wine vinegar
instructions: Mix all ingredients well and use in your favorite recipe.

Random Ingredients: cranberry,elbow macaroni,kiwi fruit,sauce,lemon juice zest,icing sugar
title: My Kiwi and Cranberry Macaroni & Suices
ingredients: 1 large lemon, juice and zest of, grated | 4 kiwi fruits, peeled, cored and cut into wedges | 1/2 cup dried cranberries, picked over, rinsed | 1 1/2 cups uncooked elbow macaroni | 1/2 cup hot sauce ( i use tabasco brand, but we love spicy and i use sriracha ) ( optional ) | 1/4 cup granulated icing sugar, for dusting on finished dish
instructions: In a large bowl, combine lemon juice and zest, kiwifruit, cranberries, and macaroni. Mix well. Add hot sauce if using. Toss lightly to coat. Place on lightly greased baking sheet & sprinkle with granulated sugar. Place in centre of preheated 375 degree oven for 20 minutes or until golden brown & tender when pierced with a fork.

Random Ingredients: cantaloupe,sweetcorn,rom tomato,apple juice,cake flour,duck,green chili pepper,bread crumb
