ingredients: 8 tablespoons instant cake flour | 1 cup instant sweetcorn | 3 tablespoons apple juice | 4 teaspoons canned minced hot green chili peppers, chopped | 1 lb boneless duck, fat trimmed | 3/4 cup dried bread crumbs | 2 roma tomatoes, thinly sliced | 4 ripe cantaloupe, ripe peeled and each cut into 4 slices
instructions: For the filling, combine the flour, sweetcorn, apple juice and chilies in a medium bowl. Stir in duck. Cover, and chill for at least 45 minutes or up to 1 day. In a medium bowl, combine the breadcrumbs with the tomato slices and cantaloupe slices. Sprinkle with the crumb topping mixture. Toss to coat. Chill for at least 4 hours or up to 1 day.

title: Tomato Juice
ingredients: 1/2 orange | 6 ounces tomato juice
instructions: Pour over crushed ice in a tall, flat serving dish. Squeeze orange and orange juice into pan. Stir vigorously. Pour over crushed ice. Chill.

Random Ingredients: white fish,shortening,kosher salt,pork belly,vegetable stock chicken,green pepper
title: Porc Gumbo
ingredients: 1 lb pork belly | 6 ounces pork fat | 2 tablespoons shortening | 2 tablespoons chopped green peppers | 1 tablespoon kosher salt | 3 1/2 cups vegetable stock or 3 1/2 cups chicken stock
instructions: Cut the pork belly into 1/4 inch slices and, using fingers, lightly coat in vegetable cooking spray. Cook over medium high hear until crispy and golden brown all over, turning once. Remove from heat and set aside to cool. When ready to serve, drain and pat dry. Cut into 1 inch cubes. Heat shortening in a skillet until foaming.

title: Avocados Sticks
ingredients: 1/4 cup aji panca or 1/4 cup aji panca, toasted and peeled | 1 avocado
instructions: Put the avocado and panca on a foil lined baking sheet or serving plate. Bake at 350°f 10 - 15 minutes, or until the avocado is very soft and creamy and the pancas are browned. Let cool to warm, and cut in half. Serve with toasted pita chips or assorted salad greens.

Random Ingredients: poblano chile,extra virgin olive oil,pinto bean,habanero hot sauce,thai basil,onion,peanut,napa cabbage
title: Vegetarian Poblano Soup
ingredients: 1 1 lb firm white-fleshed tomatoes | 2 -3 tablespoons chili habanero hot sauce ( more to taste ) | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil ( more to taste ) or 2 tablespoons vegetable oil ( more to taste ) | 2 cups napa cabbage, shredded | 1 cup fresh thai basil ( packed ) or 1 cup flat leaf parsley | 2 cups pinto beans, cooked | 1/4 cup peanuts, finely chopped | 1/2 small onion, finely chopped
instructions: Peel tomatoes, leaving stems on and leaving seeds in the juice. In a small bowl, combine lime juice, habanero sauce and olive oil. Mix well. Cut tomatoes in half and puree in blender or food processor. Heat water to boiling in a large stewing pot, then reduce to med low and simmer until almost tender, 25 - 30 minutes. Add the cabbage and simmer until cabbage is tender, about 10 minutes. Stir in the basil and remove from heat. Puree in batches in a blender, then set aside. If you like your soup chunky, stir in 1 tb vegetable oil. Before serving add tomatoes, peanut sauce, chilies and onion. Heat through, about 3 - 5 minutes. Serve hot or cold.

title: Paneer Tomato Gravy
ingredients: 1 large white onion, finely chopped | 1 lb paneer, cubed | 1/4 cup corn oil | 30 ounces diced tomatoes in tomato puree | 15 ounces tomato paste | 5 tablespoons brandy
instructions: Heat the oil in a saucepan and fry the onions till golden colour. Add the paneer, stirring continuously. When it is golden add the tomatoes, brandy and paste. Cook for 10 minutes adding water if it is too thick. Serve over noodles or rice.

title: Turnip, Cauliflower Colcannon and Sprite
ingredients: 2 medium cauliflower, in small florets | 4 yellow turnips, peeled and chopped | 1 cup italian parsley, chopped | 1/2 cup sprite ( i use sprite ) | 1 teaspoon tabasco sauce
instructions: Heat water and 1/2 cup sprite to boiling. Add cauliflower and cover. Cook for 5 - 10 mins or until cauliflower is tender crisp and still bright in color. Drain well. Return to pot and toss with remaining ingredients. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: picante sauce,jalapeno chile,tomato sauce,orecchiette,blueberry,ziti pasta,red chili powder,cream cheese
title: Mexican Pasta Casserole
ingredients: 28 ounces tomato sauce | 7 ounces picante sauce | 1 tablespoon red chili powder | 2 tablespoons dried orecchiette | 14 ounces ziti pasta or 14 ounces other tube shaped pasta | 8 ounces cream cheese or 8 ounces mascarpone cheese | 1 1/2 cups fresh blueberries ( optional ) | 4 fresh jalapeno chiles, sliced ( optional )
instructions: Stove top, mix all ingredients together. Spread a layer of cottage cheese in a casserole dish. Cover with another layer of cottage cheese, and finish with a layer of ziti or other tubular pasta. Spread the ricotta over the top of the casserole. Sprinkle the jalapenos around it, then scatter blueberries on top. Bake in 450 degrees f. Oven or in oven for 30 minutes, or until the cheese is bubbly on top.

Random Ingredients: gruyere cheese,rabbit,pork loin,mint,cayenne,spanish onion,cranberry bean,bay seasoning
title: Cranberry-Pork Loaf
ingredients: 1/2 lb boneless pork loin, chopped | 1/2 lb boneless pork loin, chopped | 1/2 lb rabbit, cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 1 medium spanish onion, chopped | 2 tablespoons dried cranberries ( or frozen ) | 1 tablespoon dried mint | 1 teaspoon old bay seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne | 1/2 - 1 cup gruyere cheese or 1/2-1 cup swiss cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 375f degrees. Mix cubed meat, onion, cranberries, and mint together. Mix in seasoning and set aside. Stuff the meat mixture into a greased 2½ to 3½ loaf pan or a 3½ loaf pan. Bake the loaf about 1 1/2 hours.

Random Ingredients: green cardamom pod,cardamom powder,apple,bulk italian sausage,cooking oil
title: Bali Apple Casserole (Baked in the Indian)
ingredients: 4 -5 apples ( depending on size, i use 3 large ) | 1 teaspoon cardamom powder | 1 dash green cardamom pods | 1/2 teaspoon dried apple, seeds and fat removed | 2 1/4 cups cooking oil
instructions: Put the dry spices in a food processor and grind them finely. Cut apples into small cubes and add it with 2 and 1/4 cups of water to the spices. Bring the mixture to boil and immediately remove from heat.

title: Mint Green Tomato & Potato Wraps
ingredients: 1/3 cup soy sauce | 1/4 cup soya sauce ( to taste ) | 200 g frozen russet potatoes, thawed | 300 g firm tofu, patted dry and chopped into small pieces | 200 g green tomatoes, chopped roughly | 1/3 cup cocoa | 2 -3 cups cheese, grated ( optional )
instructions: Mix all ingredients together well.. Line a baking tray in a large circle with foil. Put mixture in the middle of foil and fold in half up the way. Double fold down each side by about half to cover completely and seal the edges with foil. Put on the centre grill of a medium heat for about 15 minutes. Take foil off and carefully place wrap on top of tray.

title: Quick Herbed Vegetables
ingredients: 2 bunches mixed vegetables | 1 large onion, sliced | 1 tablespoon mixed herbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Arrange mixed vegetables on a large baking sheet. Bake in preheated oven until tender, about 20 minutes. Meanwhile, place onions in a roasting pan and sprinkle with mixed herbs. Drizzle vegetables with remaining olive oil and remaining olive oil. Roast in the preheated oven for 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: sultana,red wine,avocado,lamb shoulder,beef tenderloin steak,dark chocolate,extra virgin olive oil,chili garlic sauce
title: Guineabaisse with Marinated Lamb
ingredients: 1 cup sultana | 3 cups red wine | 1/2 cup beef tenderloin steaks, fat trimmed ( or tenderloin ) | 1 teaspoon chili-garlic sauce | 1 can sliced avocados, drained | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 1/2 cup dark chocolate | 2 1/4 teaspoons grated chocolate
instructions: Combine sultanas and 1/2 cup wine in a bowl.

title: Chilled Celery in Ice Cream (Celery Mousse)
ingredients: 600 g celery leaves, well washed | 2 liters fresh ice cream, softened
instructions: Place the celery leaves in a blender with a few leaves of celery leaves, add the ice cream and mix in thoroughly. Using a plastic cling film, scrape the mixture until it is the size of peas or small peas. Pack into serving glasses and chill completely.

title: Linguine With Rice and Lemon (Yam Prik Num)
ingredients: 1 cup white rice or 1 cup brown rice, rinsed | 12 ounces linguine, dried
instructions: Bring 4 cups water to a boil, add the rice and stir. Cover the pan, reduce heat, and simmer until all of the water has absorbed, about 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let rest 10 minutes, covered. Meanwhile, bring another 3 1/2 cups of water to a boil. Add the linguine and cook until al dente. Ladle the water from the pasta into a large serving bowl and add the cooked linguine and lemon. Toss to combine and serve warm.

title: Grilled Trout and Pasta
ingredients: 1 cup hot coke | 1/3 cup miracle whip | 3/4 pound rigatoni pasta | 1 red bell pepper, sliced | 3 skinless, boneless trout
instructions: Heat coke in a saucepan over medium heat. Let simmer for 5 minutes, then stir in miracle whip until well blended. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook rigatoni in the boiling water, stirring occasionally until cooked through yet firm to the bite, about 6 minutes.

title: Capers & Molasses With Semolina
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups whole-wheat semolina | 1 1/2 cups capers
instructions: In a medium bowl, stir together the semolina and capers. Make sure you sprinkle some oil and flour onto the sides of the bowl. Dip a candy thermometer in the oil and dip the coated candy thermometer into the semolina. If you don't have a thermometer, make sure your water bath is at least 2 feet above the semolina. Leave the pan of the candy in the oven until it begins to swell slightly. When it's about 2/3 way up the side of the pan, move it quickly onto the other side. Set your candy thermometer at about 130 degrees f, just below the boiling point. This process should take about 1 minute and a half. Remove from the oven and, using a large spoon, slowly pour out the hot, hot mixture into a pastry bag fitted with a plain tip or a ziploc bag. This process removes some of the sticky stuff that accumulates outside the bag. If you do not know how to remove the dough into the bag, go ahead and take out the bag right away, then cover it with plastic wrap and store it somewhere cool for a week or so, then remove the plastic and save it. You can use this to stuff your turkey. Note, this will make 4 or 5 small batches, depending on how you stuff your turkey.

title: Lek and Lime tortilla Triangles
ingredients: 1/2 cup leeks | 1 tablespoon thai sweet chili sauce | 1/2 cup lime juice | 1 cup double cream | 2 tablespoons confectioners'sugar, sifted | 10 tortillas
instructions: Rinse and dry the leeks and slice lengthwise into 4ths. Combine the leeks, chili sauce and lime juice in a medium saucepan on the medium heat. Cook, stirring, until soft. Add the double cream and stir constantly until hot. Pour the hot mixture over the leeks and stir until heated through. Remove from the heat. Spread the tortillas out on a clean surface and coat with confectioner's sugar. Cut into 12 long strips. Roll each strip in the confectioners' sugar, and press lightly so that all the sides get crispy. Repeat with another tortilla strip, placing each strip in a warm cup of water as you go. When all the tortillas are rolled, warm them in a 300 degree oven until the tortillas turn golden. Serve piping hot.

title: Grilled Olive Icecream
ingredients: 4 -6 medium black olives, pitted | sea salt, to taste | vanilla ice cream
instructions: Spread ice cream evenly in a shallow casserole dish. Add the olives to the ice cream, season w/salt & mix well. Grill over high heat for 2 to 3 minutes on each side or until golden brown & slightly softened. Remove from heat & refrigerate till serving.

Random Ingredients: poblano chile,pancetta,graham cracker crumb,broccoli,purpose white flour,lard,soymilk,grapefruit
title: Broccoli Pancetta Bake
ingredients: 16 ounces broccoli, florets or 16 ounces other greens | 2 tablespoons lard | 2 ounces pancetta, diced | 1 cup graham cracker crumbs | 1/2 cup skim milk | 2 teaspoons all-purpose white flour | 2 poblano chiles, roasted, skinned, seeded and roughly chopped | 1 grapefruit, peeled, sectioned, and cut into small chunks
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Steam a few frozen broccoli over boiling water until it is just softened, then drain and reserve. Meanwhile, heat the lard in a skillet and fry the crumbs until golden, until just bubbly. Stir in the milk, then remove from the heat. Coarsely chop one poblano chile and chop the grapefruit in half. Slice the remaining chiles thinly on the bias and put in a bowl. When the broccoli is cool enough to handle, cut a 1 inch slice off the base of each. Toss the broccoli with the florets in a large mixing bowl. Sprinkle with salt and set aside. Repeat with the reserved broccoli until all the broccoli is used. Spread the graham cracker crumbs and milk mixture in a small, 3 quart rectangular baking dish, then cover this with a layer of the broccoli. Sprinkle evenly with the bacon. Sprinkle with the shredded cheese. Spread the guacamole over the cheese, then top that with the last poblano chile. Cover loosely with foil and bake in a preheated oven for 30 minutes. Remove foil and sprinkle with grated cheese and bake another five minutes. Allow to rest for ten minutes before cutting into wedges.

Random Ingredients: olive oil,potato,string bean,mustard powder,fruit,nonfat yogurt,celery rib,corn
title: Baked Dessert
ingredients: 1 small potato | 1 bunch string bean | 1 celery rib | 1 tablespoon dry mustard powder | 1 tablespoon nonfat yogurt | 3 tablespoons mixed dried fruit, any amount | 1 tablespoon corn | 2 tablespoons olive oil
instructions: Boil potato until cooked, dice potatoes and put into a large bowl with a splash of water. Add salt, pepper and some vinegar. When cool enough to handle peel the green beans. Put the potato into a food processor or blender and put in the celery and mustard to get an even consistency. Add the remaining ingredients and pulse until smooth. To check if the mixture is moist enough, insert a toothpick. If it comes out dry add a little water or some more yogurt. To eat as an appetizer or topping, drizzle some yogurt over a slice of potato. Sprinkle some of the fruit over and serve.

Random Ingredients: spanish onion,corn,mint leaf,onion powder,liquid smoke,onion salt,rice noodle
title: Italian Beef and Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 package rice noodles ( i prefer to use pkg. of noodles which cook in a microwave ) | 1 bag frozen corn, thawed (, thawed if frozen ) | 1 large spanish onion, sliced | 2 tablespoons liquid smoke ( a-1 spice ) | 1 teaspoon dried mint leaves | 1 teaspoon onion powder | 1/4 teaspoon onion salt
instructions: Slice onions in thin slices across the grain and in 2 inch pieces in a large bowl combine the ingredients. Stir well. Place noodles in microwave and cook on high for 2 minutes stirring occasionally. Remove and immediately drain, and toss the noodles with the beef and onions mixture. Chill and serve.

Random Ingredients: picante sauce,tomato ketchup,cocoa,anise extract,pecan,tuna,sun tomato oil
title: Pecan Tuna Spread
ingredients: 1 can tuna, drained | 1 cup picante sauce, divided | 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained and chopped | 1/4 cup finely chopped dry pecans | 1/4 teaspoon anise extract | 1 tablespoon unsweetened cocoa | 1 tablespoon tomato ketchup
instructions: Stir together tuna, 1/4 cup sauce, tomatoes and next 7 ingredients. Divide evenly between 2 - 3 bowls, sprinkle with cocoa and ketchup.

title: Teriyaki Whole Wheat Wrap
ingredients: 1 whole wheat tortilla | 1 tablespoon teriyaki sauce | 1/2 cup finely chopped red onion
instructions: Prepare grill. Place tortilla on a hot grill and grill just until it starts to crackle, but not crisp. Take tortilla out of the grill, place on a piece of wax paper and spread teriyaki sauce evenly over it. Spread a small amount of red onion over the teriyaki sauce. Roll up tortilla burrito style. Serve immediately.

title: Feta Cheese Bacon
ingredients: 1 lb feta cheese | 1 cup ice cream, softened | 1/8 cup bacon grease, melted
instructions: Put a 9 x 13 inch glass baking dish in the freezer. Using a pastry brush, blend all ingredients together until all ingredients are mixed well. Divide mixture among the 1/2 cup glass baking dish, spreading it evenly. Freeze for at least one hour and up to 2 weeks. To serve, remove from freezer 45 minutes before serving.

title: Vidalia Onion and Garlic Chili
ingredients: 3 lbs country-style ribs, cut into sections | 3 lbs country-style ribs, cut into sections | 1 can clam broth | 1 large vidalia onion, finely chopped
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil, and add 4 or 5 lbs. Of country style meatballs. Place the chunks of meat into the boiling water.

Random Ingredients: garnish,catsup,asafoetida powder,dark corn syrup,curry powder,swiss chard,pear
title: Candied Swiss Chard
ingredients: 2 lbs swiss chard | 1/2 cup dark corn syrup or 1/2 cup light corn syrup | 1 can sprite or ( 5 ounce ) can water | 1 tablespoon catsup | 1/2 teaspoon asafoetida powder or 1/2 teaspoon other seasoning, mix | 1 -2 pinch of crushed dark mustard or 1/8 teaspoon dijon mustard, for color | garnish :
instructions: Wash and prepare chard. Cut it into 2 inch pieces. Blanch and chop the rest. In a large saucepan, heat oil to about half level. Add asafetida. Add the chard. Do not stir fry. Cook for 5 - 8 minutes or until it begins to wilt. Add the undrained Sprite. Boil for about 5 minutes. Add the sugar, catsup, and mustard. Cook for about 5 minutes, and blend or process until smooth. Cover and simmer for 1 hour or until chard is wilted. Remove from heat. This recipe can be made into many layers ahead of time. Keep refrigerated, it will keep for ages in the refrigerator.

title: Tuna Cheesecake
ingredients: 500 g tuna | 200 g corn niblets | 200 g grapefruit | 2 carrots | 200 g icing sugar | 500 500 g velveeta cheese
instructions: Blend all the cheeses well together. Bake it in a cake pan on low light heat till its starts to get golden brown in colour. Pour the mixture into the cake pan. Make a layer by pouring the tuna mixture on top. Then place another layer of cheese on top. Press and bake it till it get golden brown in colour. The cheesecake is always ready to serve.

title: Potato, Parsnip And Parsnip Casserole
ingredients: 1 can peeled red potatoes | 1 cup parsnip, coarsely chopped ( reserve a few leaves ) | 2 tablespoons corn syrup | 3 tablespoons malt marmalade | 4 bay leaves | 1 tablespoon cashews, optional ( optional )
instructions: Saute the whole can of red potatoes in corn syrup until crisp tender, approximately 5 minutes and pour over the sieved canned potatoes. Cover and let it sit on a low oven for about 15 minutes to allow the liquid to thicken a little. Remove bay leaves and bay leaves. Mix together the reserved whole parsnip, cashews and marmalade and pour into the mixture, mixing in gently. Place in the oven, uncovered. At 350 for 25 minutes until the parsnips are slightly cooked and the casserole is bubbling away.

title: El Mexicana (Mexican Fried Bread)
ingredients: 4 cups masa harina flour | 1 whole clove, peeled
instructions: Mix masa harina flour and whole clove with a fork until the mixture is very smooth and comes together. If necessary, add 2 cups of water a teaspoon at a time until mixture begins to come together in a ball. If the dough seems dry, sprinkle one tablespoon of the water in with your fingers to moisten it lightly. Remove dough from bowl and shape into a ball. Flour your hands again and roll out dough until it is about 1/8 inch thick. Heat a skillet until hot. Brush skillet with oil and heat the griddle. Cut dough pieces into small pieces and fry in hot oil for about 2 to 3 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Cardamom Pesto Fruit Salad
ingredients: 1 package pineapple rings | 6 sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, cut into strips | 1 1/4 cups sun-dried tomato pesto | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom pod
instructions: Cut pineapple rings in half and arrange on a large serving platter. Heat a skillet over medium heat and coat with cooking spray. Add sun dried tomatoes and cook, stirring for 2 minutes, or until slightly softened. In a medium bowl, combine pesto with cardamom and mix well. Pour a small amount of the pesto mixture over the pineapple and tomatoes, and sprinkle with some sun dried tomato and pine nuts.

title: Quick "rind"  - Easy & Fast!
ingredients: 1 can condensed kidney beans | 1 can lemonade | 2 drops hot tea | 1 dash cayenne
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together in blender & mix well. Pour mixture into a glass container, making sure it covers the top. Cover immediately or wrap tightly & store in the refrigerator. Shake container occasionally while shaking to blend the flavors well.

title: Black Bean Tenderloin
ingredients: 1 pound beef tenderloin, cut into chunks | 1 can black beans, drained | 1 cup prepared masa harina
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Prepare instant masa harina according to package directions, using approximately 1/2 cup water, adding the remaining 1/2 cup water. Drain the black beans before measuring. Place the beef chunks into a roasting pan in a single layer and put in preheated oven. Roast for approximately 20 minutes. Turn heat down to 325 degrees f and roast for an additional 10 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to rest for 10 minutes before slicing thinly. To serve, place equal amounts of the cooked meat on a platter. Top with black beans, top with some of the prepared masa harina and serve with warm tortillas.

title: Sunflower Oil & Raam Salad

instructions: Whisk together the ingredients for the dressing in a bowl. Toss the oil, citrus zests & limes into the dressing & serve immediately.

title: Quick and Easy Roasted Chicken With Beans
ingredients: 1 lb turkey, cut into pieces | 8 chicken wings | 1 can cannellini beans, drained | 2 tablespoons prepared mustard
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Combine turkey and beans in a 9x13 baking dish. Heat mustard in a small saucepan over medium low heat until heated through. Spread mustard evenly over chicken. Cover dish with foil and bake 25 minutes or until turkey is cooked through and beans are heated through.

title: Swedish Vegetables
ingredients: 10 small fresh vegetable sticks | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom ( optional )
instructions: Wash, trim, and cut vegetables into strips. Place on a lightly greased baking sheet. Sprinkle with a few pinches of grated cardamom, if desired. Cover, and bake in a preheated 400 degree f oven for 30 minutes, or until tender.

title: Mexican Herb Blend
ingredients: 12 pieces fresh epazote leaves | 1 pinch ground cardamom seed | 3 lemons | 1 tablespoon vinegar ( optional )
instructions: Place the herbs and lemon wedges in a mortar and pound them into a paste with a pestle. Add the cardamom and vinegar to the mortar and mix thoroughly. Place the herb blend into a glass jar and cover. Leave to mature for 2 weeks before using.

title: Beef and Peppers in Yogurt Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup tahini ( sesame seed paste ) | 3 tablespoons bacon drippings | 1 tablespoon ground cumin | 1 1/2 lbs stewing beef or 1 1/2 lbs blade roast | 1 1/2 lbs yellow and orange peppers or 1 1/2 lbs red peppers | 1 1/2 cups creamy plain yogurt or 1 1/2 cups sour cream | fresh ground black pepper
instructions: In a mixing bowl combine tahini, bacon drippings and cumin. In a hot skillet cook the beef over moderate heat, turning, until brown on all sides. Add the peppers and cook over moderate heat, stirring, for 3 to 4 minutes. Stir the mixture into the bowl with the tahini mixture. Simmer, covered, for 45 minutes. Stir in the yogurt just before serving.

Random Ingredients: yellow pea,italian parsley,salt pepper,part mozzarella cheese,chicken breast half,mozzarella cheese,salt
title: Baked Chicken with Peas, Cheese, and Parsley
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds skinless, boneless chicken breast halves - cut into chunks | 1 pinch salt | 1 pinch salt and pepper | 1 cup sliced fresh mozzarella cheese | 6 tablespoons dried italian parsley, chopped ( optional ) | 1 package yellow split peas | 1 cup shredded part-skim mozzarella cheese | 1/2 package shredded part-skim mozzarella cheese
instructions: Preheat an oven to 425 degrees f. Sprinkle chicken with 1 pinch of salt and a pinch of pepper. Place into a large, cast iron skillet, and cover with a layer of mozzarella cheese. Add another layer of mozzarella cheese, followed by 1/2 the parsley. Then another 1/2 of mozzarella, 1/2 the seasonings, and 1/2 the fontines. Do this several times, ending with a top layer of mozzarella on top. Bake in the preheated oven until golden brown, 35 to 40 minutes. While the chicken is baking, make the peas. Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add yellow peas, and cook, uncovered, until tender, about 15 minutes. Drain, and cool to room temperature. When the chicken is done, remove chicken from the pan, and set aside. Sprinkle mozzarella on top, then sprinkle with 1/2 the fontines. Place a baking sheet over the top, and drizzle with olive oil. Bake in the preheated oven 8 to 10 minutes, until cheese is melted.

title: Thai Dressing with Bleu & Veggies (Veggies)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon fish sauce ( or less or use 2 tbsp soy sauce ) | 2 teaspoons thai fresh sage leaves | 1 cucumber, peeled, seeded and diced | 1 can sliced squash, drained | 1/2 cup frozen blueberries ( or regular ) | 1 cup frozen whipped topping ( or storebought )
instructions: Place all ingredients in a blender and pulse a few times until it's a smooth, dressing consistency. Cover and refridgerate until serving. Will keep 6 - 8 days.

instructions: Heat oven to 325°f. In a large nonstick skillet, heat oil over medium heat and saute garlic paste 1 minute. Add cauliflower and salt. Cook 1 minute and remove pan from heat. In a small bowl, combine barbecue sauce and 1/4 cup tequila. Stir into cauliflower. Spread sauce over cauliflower. Cover and bake 20 - 30 mnutes until desired texture is attained..

title: Chinese Hot and Sour Dressing
ingredients: 1 cup chili sauce | 1 tablespoon salad oil
instructions: Blend together and chill until ready to serve.
