title: Corn and Pine Nut Pizzas with Coriander and Pecorino Pesto
ingredients: 1 whole head of garlic | 1 1/2 cups fresh coriander leaves ( aka coriander and cilantro ) | 2 cups fresh pine nuts | 1/2 cup grated pecorino romano cheese | 1 tablespoon coriander powder | salt and pepper | 2 drops green food coloring | corn kernels or 2 corn flakes, for pizzas
instructions: Remove top shell off garlic cloves. Remove as much skin as possible from head of garlic, but leave in the bulbs to tenderize. Mash or pulse garlic until it can be sliced easily with a knife blade to a pulp. Put garlic pulp and all the other ingredients into a food processor with the pulp and puree all together until it forms a fairly smooth paste. Spread mixture onto a cookie sheet, then place in the freezer until solid, about 20 minutes. This will depend on the size of your food processor. You can roll the food right away and slice it into thick rounds at the table or leave plain. Serve drizzled with a drop of green food coloring or chopped fresh herb for added color. Note, make sure the cheese is slightly thicker than you think it should, because you want your pesto to be creamy when it is made.

Random Ingredients: rose water,grain dijon mustard,mustard seed,peanut oil,lemon peel,pimiento,ginger powder
title: Ginger Mustard
ingredients: 1/8 cup dry mustard seeds | 2 tablespoons whole grain dijon mustard | 1 tablespoon lemon peel, finely grated | 1 tablespoon dry poppy seeds ( not ground ) | 1/2 teaspoon mixed ginger powder | 2 tablespoons oil or 2 tablespoons cooking fat ( for frying ) | 2 teaspoons rose water
instructions: First dry fry the mustard seeds and mustard together over low heat until they start to pop. Combine all the other ingredients in a bowl. Then heat the oil and add rosewater. Pour the hot mustard onto the mustard seeds. When cool, add them into a sterilized bottle. Store the mustard for later use. When serving, place on clean, dry bread, toast under a hot grill or broiler for the last couple of minutes on each side or until light brown.

title: Hot Dogs - Hot Dogs for Dogs, Both the Style and the Flavor!
ingredients: 1 hot dog, sliced into rounds ( i use mini dog ) | flat leaf parsley ( to garnish )
instructions: Place hot dog rounds on kitchen board, cover with plastic wrap and dry with tea towel. Place hot dog in heated skillet and cover with a clean kitchen towel. Fry over medium low heat until warm, approx 10 to 15 minutes, turning once or twice. Sprinkle with parsley and cut in half for fun.

title: Saffron Rye Bread Soup
ingredients: 1 cup molasses | 1 teaspoon fennel seed | 3 1/3 cups chicken broth | 1 teaspoon dried oregano | 1 pinch saffron | 2 sheets frozen phyllo pastry, thawed | 2 tablespoons molasses
instructions: Combine 2 cups water, molasses, fennel seeds, broth, oregano and saffron in medium saucepan. Bring to boil over medium high heat. Reduce heat. Simmer, covered, about 45 minutes. Meanwhile, preheat broiler. Lightly spray broiler rack with cooking spray. Spray 9x13 inch metal baking dish with cooking spray. Arrange phyllo sheets on sheet.

Random Ingredients: flour tortilla,plain flour,vanilla extract,beef tenderloin steak,red wine,semolina
title: Dolmathes (Steak Patties)
ingredients: 1 1/2 ounces plain flour | 1/4 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1 pinch salt | 8 ounces beef tenderloin steaks, thinly sliced | 3/4 cup dry red wine | 1/3 cup semolina ( farina flour ) | 12 flour tortillas
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients in a large bowl. Add beef and toss to coat well. Cover and chill for 45 minutes. Combine wine and semolina in shallow dish. Dredge each steak in flour, then wine, then semolina mixture. Place on a lightly oiled grill pan or grill pan and cook over high heat for 2 - 3 minutes on each side or until browned. Serve immediately.

title: Greek Pork Sandwich with Anchovies
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs pork shoulder | 1/4 cup capers | 4 kalamata olives or 4 other brine-cured black olives
instructions: Trim fat from meat, then place in a large pan & add enough cold water to cover. Bring to a boil & cover tightly. Cook for 30 minutes, then remove from heat & drain off liquid. Shred the meat & set aside in a warm place. Add capers to the drippings & mix well. Cover the pan & return to the boil. Cover & simmer for about 1/2 hr or until the meat is tender. Uncover & stir in olives. Serve.

title: Wild O' Gold (Black-Eyed Pea, or Shrimp)  Mix
ingredients: 1 can black-eyed peas ( you may use pinto beans ) | 1 teaspoon dried hollandaise or 1 teaspoon piri-piri ( or more or less ) | 1/2 cup ketchup | 1/4 cup sweet salted cashews ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon dried dill ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon dried sage leaf ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon ground piri-piri ( optional ) or 1 tablespoon fresh coriander ( optional )
instructions: Rinse and drain beans. Combine all ingredients in 2 quart container or jar. Cover and store in refrigerator for up to 1 month.

title: Grilled Shrimp and Watermelon Linguine Withpassion Fruit Butter
ingredients: 1 lb linguine | 2 tablespoons finely chopped passion fruit | 1 tablespoon instant coffee granules ( or to taste ) | 4 tablespoons icing sugar | 1/2 lb large shrimp, raw, peeled, halved lengthwise | 1 1/2 cups watermelon, cut into chunks
instructions: Cook the linguine according to the package instructions, drain and return to the pan. Meanwhile, stir the passionfruit and the instant coffee into the warm pasta. Add the icing sugar and stir until well combined. Add the shrimp and toss to coat well. Pour the pasta into a large saucpan. Cover, and grill the shrimp over a high heat for 2 - 3 minutes or until pink and cooked through. Transfer the shrimp & watermelon to a bowl and add the passionfruit butter. Toss until well combined. Serve immediately.

title: Madiya Gravy for Dahi or Aloo Gobi
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons ginger-garlic paste ( from ginger-garlic can ) | 2 teaspoons fresh rosemary leaves, thinly sliced ( or 1 t. dried rosemary sprig )
instructions: Mix well.

Random Ingredients: celery,pie shell,rotini pasta,plain flour,almond extract,salt,spring onion
title: Pasta Filled With Almonds and Spring Onions
ingredients: 1 cup rotini pasta or 1 cup penne | salt | 2 spring onions, trimmed, chopped | 3 spring onions, trimmed, chopped | 1 bunch celery, trimmed, chopped | 1 tablespoon plain flour | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract | 1 pinch salt | 1 pie shell ( bought or frozen )
instructions: Cook rotini in boiling salted water until al dente. Drain and rinse under cold water, set aside. In a large pan, saute onions and celery over medium heat for 8 minutes. Mix flour, almond extract and salt and mix well. Add flour mix and stir just until mixed then add rotini and water, stir until combined. Bring to boil stirring constantly. Remove from heat and allow to cool slightly, place on board and cut into small portions like a tortilla.

Random Ingredients: grain white rice,lasagna noodle,rosemary leaf,cooking spray
title: Rosemary Rice Lasagne
ingredients: cooking spray | 1 pound long grain white rice | 5 fresh rosemary leaves | 1 package lasagna noodles, broken
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Spray a baking sheet with cooking spray. Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add lasagna noodles and boil until al dente, about 4 minutes. Drain and transfer to a large bowl. Toss noodles with cooking spray. Arrange 2 noodles in the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish. Place a half inch layer of noodles over the noodles. Top with 1/2 the rosemary leaves. Repeat layering.

Random Ingredients: provolone cheese,chunky peanut butter,pizza crust,zucchini,white fish fillet,beef,hazelnut
title: Peanut-Baked Fish Pizza
ingredients: 2 tablespoons chunky peanut butter | 1 tablespoon low sodium beef or 1 tablespoon vegetarian ground beef, chopped | 1/2 cup reduced-fat beef or 1/2 cup vegetarian ground turkey breast, chopped | 1/2 cup thinly sliced zucchini | 1/2 cup thinly sliced chunky peanut butter | 1 1/4 cups torn canned pizza crust | 4 ounces crumbled reduced-fat provolone cheese | 1/4 cup coarsely chopped hazelnuts
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f grease an 8 inch pizza pan with cooking spray. Combine peanut butter with chopped beef in a small bowl.

title: Chile Rolls With Phyllo Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup crispy rice vinegar | 4 fresh red chilies, sliced ( i use new mexico ) | 1/4 cup minced fresh oregano | 4 phyllo dough sheets | 4 cups iceberg lettuce, shredded
instructions: In medium bowl, stir together rice vinegar, red chilies and oregano. Spoon equal amounts of sauce into each of the 4 phyllo sheets. Place 2 sheets in a 13x9 inch baking dish, brushing each sheet with the melted butter. Top with remaining phyllo sheets and brush with butter. Spoon equal amounts of lettuce sauce around.

Random Ingredients: penne pasta,self rising flour,coriander seed,cayenne pepper
title: Penne Graven
ingredients: 16 ounces dry penne pasta | 3 cups self-rising flour | 1 tablespoon cayenne pepper | 1 tablespoon ground coriander seed
instructions: Cook pasta according to package instructions. Drain, reserving 1 cup of the pasta water.

title: Veal and Ham Meat Pies
ingredients: 1/2 lb veal | 1/2 lb country ham, finely chopped | 1/2 cup sliced fresh rosemary leaf | 1 package frozen whipped topping, thawed
instructions: Rinse meat with cold water, drain well then pat with paper towels to remove sand from top. Preheat oven to 350°f. Place all ingredients except whipped topping onto waxed paper lined cookie sheet. Spread 1 1/2 tbsp of the thawed whipped topping over meat and then place 1/2 tbsp of the meat mixture over the top. Roll up tightly and place in pan in oven. Bake for 30 minutes, or until meat is browned and sauce thickens slightly.

Random Ingredients: fish sauce,marsala,grand marnier,msg,pink grapefruit,white pepper,garlic clove
title: A Simple Grapefruit Marinade
ingredients: 1 large pink grapefruit | 3 garlic cloves, peeled | 1/2 teaspoon msg ( optional ) | 1/3 cup fish sauce | 1/4 cup marsala | 1/4 cup dry white pepper, crushed ( or a mixed green pepper ) | 3 tablespoons grand marnier
instructions: In a mortar put the garlic and heat until fragrant. Remove from the heat and add the msg and fish sauce. Stir until well mixed then add the marsala and white pepper. Pour mixture over all the fruit and mix well. Add more fish sauce or spices if the mixture is too thick. Let it marinate for about an hour before marinating again for a stronger flavor. Use as a marinade for chicken, pork or even vegetables. This can last several weeks. Note, when buying grapefruit, marinate it up to two days before using. You do not need to marinate because of the msg and the sauce mixture.

Random Ingredients: cilantro,tomato paste,clam,sharp cheddar cheese,cream tartar,anchovy,mozzarella cheese
title: Quick Clam and Cheese Quiche
ingredients: 1 cup sour cream or 1 cup yogurt | 1/2 cup mozzarella cheese, shredded | 1/2 cup sharp cheddar cheese | 1 can diced tomatoes with paste | 1 teaspoon anchovy, minced | chopped cilantro ( to garnish ) | 1/8 teaspoon cream of tartar ( to garnish ) or 1/8 teaspoon white pepper ( to garnish )
instructions: Set oven temperature to 375°f. Mix all ingredients together and pour into a 9 inch square glass or baking pan. Sprinkle top with cilantro before baking. Bake for 25 - 30 minutes, or until cheese is melted and bubbly. Set aside and let cool until easy to cut. If you don't have an oven that's oven safe and won't allow food processor to do it for you, you can substitute your favorite baking pan with one with a little more room inside of pan. This makes a really thick quiche.. Note, if using yogurt instead of sour cream, you can skip this step. However, you can always add a little more cream to help the filling stick. Also, it adds a nice zap to the filling.

Random Ingredients: orange juice concentrate,cream mushroom soup,poblano chile,beef sirloin
title: Linda's Sirloin
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs boneless beef sirloin, cut into 4 serving pieces ( i use frozen and thaw before slicing ) | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 2 cans orange juice concentrate, undiluted | 1 poblano chile, roasted peeled and seeded
instructions: Place meat in a large slow cooker. Sprinkle with soup, orange juice concentrate and poblano, and stir to combine. Cover and cook on low for 7 hours. Remove sirloin from slow cooker, transfer to a serving platter and cover to keep warm. Skim off any fat from cooking liquid. Use a spoon to remove juice from slow cooker back into slow cooker. Discard solids from slow cooker.

title: Lime Basil Rice (Cook's Country) Bread
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups white basmati rice | 1 cup self-rising flour, plus some for dusting | 1 lime leaf
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f/180°c. Place the rice in a large bowl, add the 2 1/2 3/4 cups of water, and stir to mix. Turn the rice dough onto a floured work surface. Gather the rice and place it in a buttered 9x5cm loaf tin. Lightly dust the top of the bread with flour and roll it out in the flour to coat. Place the bread on a baking sheet, and basted with the lime leaf. Bake for 25 - 30 minutes, or until the crust is golden and crispy.

Random Ingredients: yogurt,cayenne pepper,wheat bread,tomato sauce,spinach leaf,romaine lettuce,cake flour
title: Crunchy Spinach Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup skim milk yogurt | 1/4 cup cake flour | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1 1/2 cups fresh spinach leaves, chopped | 1 loaf frozen spinach leaves, thawed, drained and roughly chopped | 1/4 cup tomato sauce | 1 loaf whole wheat bread, cut into squares
instructions: In a large bowl, combine yogurt, flour, cayenne pepper, spinach, and chopped spinach leaves. Toss well to combine. Cover and chill at least 1 hour or overnight. Preheat oven to 350. Spray a 9x13 inch baking dish with cooking spray. Spread bread squares evenly on a baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven 15 minutes or until lightly browned, turning once. Remove from oven. To make dressing, in a small bowl, combine tomato sauce, and remaining spinach. Drizzle over baked bread squares.

title: American Pulled Pork
ingredients: 1 pork | 25 g butter buds | 1 sprig scallion | 1 teaspoon dried currants | 1 tablespoon barbecue sauce, any flavour | 4 dates ( optional )
instructions: Take a small piece of pork, and slice lengthways into 1cm pieces, then tie them up with kitchen string. Open a small bowl, add the rest of the ingredients, and mix thoroughly with your hands. You may need to add a little more butter bud or barbecue sauce at this stage, depending on how thick or crudly you want the sauce to be serve the pork and sauce separately on a small warm dish and put them in the fridge until ready to eat, or, for a party gathering, leave the left over butter bud or barbecue sauce in to the side. Serve with fresh bread, and plenty of napkins.

Random Ingredients: nutritional yeast flake,seitan,porcini mushroom,granny smith apple,jalapeno pepper
title: Vegan Cheese & Mushroom Stuffing
ingredients: 2 cups crumbled low-fat goat cheese ( use smart balance if you can afford it ) | 1 cup raw porcini mushrooms, halved and sliced | 1 granny smith apple, grated | 2 tablespoons nutritional yeast flakes | 1/2 finely chopped seeded jalapeno pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Butter the inside of a glass, preferably non stick, casserole dish. Mix together goat cheese, mushrooms, apple and nutritional yeast flakes. Spoon into prepared casserole dish. Bake for 30 minutes until cheese is light brown.

title: Quinoa & Mushroom Rye Popovers
ingredients: 4 cups cooked quinoa | 4 egg yolks | 6 tablespoons sweet paprika smoked mushrooms ( dry ) | 1 can mushrooms soup ( any flavour ) | 2 cups miniature marshmallows
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c. In a large bowl add quinoa, egg yolks, smoked mushrooms, 2 tbsp sweet paprika, 1/2 of the sweet paprika and 2/3 of the dry mushrooms. Using hands make a well in the centre, pour in the soup and stir until combined. Add marshmallows and mix together evenly. Put the mixture into two muffin tins. Put into the oven for 20mins. Remove from the oven and wait until it's cool enough to touch. Cool slightly and pop pop out of pop tins onto a serving tray to cool further.

Random Ingredients: oregano leaf,broth,red wine,chuck roast,peanut butter,vanilla bean,golden raisin,black peppercorn
title: Savory Beef Stew
ingredients: 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1/2 teaspoon black peppercorns | 5 lbs chuck roast, trimmed and cut into 1-inch cubes | 2 cups reduced-sodium broth | 1 cup hot red wine | 1 teaspoon vanilla bean, scraped | 2 tablespoons peanut butter | 6 3/4 ounces golden raisins or 6 3/4 ounces seedless raisins, halved
instructions: Sprinkle dried oregano and peppercorns over meat. Place in slow cooker and scatter with 1 cup broth. Cover and cook on low 10 to 12 hours or on high 4 to 5 hours. Drain meat, reserving juices. Shred meat and set aside. Strain juices, discarding solids, discarding solids, and skim off fat. Chop meat and set aside. Stir remaining broth, wine, vanilla bean, and peanut butter into juices in cooker. Bring to a boil over medium high heat, scraping up any browned bits. Gradually reduce heat to medium low and simmer, stirring occasionally, 10 minutes or until slightly thickened. Return beef to slow cooker, and stir in raisins.

Random Ingredients: onion soup mix,pear,baking powder,tea,red chile,bread dough
title: The Pear Pear and Onion Loaf
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups bread dough ( i use frozen bread dough ) | 2 cups of sweet onions or 2 cups of walla walla onions | 4 tablespoons teabags ( instant onion soup mix in a cube or plastic bag ) | 1/2 ounce chopped dried red chile ( you can use green chili beans, or a mixture ) | 2 -3 teaspoons baking powder | 3/4 cup brewed tea ( not water and tea ) ( optional )
instructions: Soak dried chile in tea for 15 minutes to plump it up. Preheat oven to 300°f. Mince 2 cups of onions. Place all the minced onion in a pot or pan with 1 tablespoon of the tea and a teaspoon of the chiles. Cook on low heat for two hours. Add a teaspoon of baking powder to the onion soup mix. Mix well. Remove the loaf from the oven. Place the loaf on a floured surface. Mix 1 tablespoon of teabag and 2 tablespoons of instant onion soup mix. Brush top and sides of loaf with the tea mixture. Sprinkle chopped chilies from the bottle, on top of bread. Bake until top is browned and crust is crisp. This should take for about 30 minutes. Remove from oven, cut and eat with fresh vegetables or with a baguette.

Random Ingredients: sherry wine,ricotta cheese,sun tomato,taco seasoning mix,arrowroot,rye bread
title: Creamy Mexican Dip
ingredients: 1 cup low fat ricotta cheese ( or cottage cheese ) | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 1 tablespoon sherry wine ( optional ) | 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato, chopped | 32 slices rye bread, toasted | arrowroot ( optional )
instructions: In a bowl mix together the ricotta cheese, taco blend seasoning, sherry, sun dried tomatoes and arrowroot. Layer the top of the bread with the cheese mixture and serve with a side of optional salsa con quesadilla or other garnishes on the side.

title: Aceitun
ingredients: 5 cups breadcrumbs | 1/2 cup paprika ( preferably spanish smoked ) | 3 lbs cornflour or 3 lbs cornmeal (, see note ) | 3 lbs saffron
instructions: Combine bread crumbs and paprika in a wide, shallow bowl. Rinse saffron and drain it well on paper towels, and place it on a paper towel. Mix corn flour with 6 cups water, and rub the polenta into the bowl until completely coated. Dredge two pieces of the polenta through the mixture, and repeat until all crumbs have been used. Heat the oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit and place a rack in the middle. Cook for about two to three minutes, until golden. Cut with a wide serrated knife into fine pieces, and arrange on a large wire rack. Cool for about half an hour, then sprinkle generously with salt while still hot. Store in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: garlic salt,sesame oil,corn,lemon zest,beef,coleslaw mix,ginger,tomato puree
title: Coleslaw with Beef, Corn, and Fresh Ginger
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sesame oil | 1 tablespoon garlic salt | 2 teaspoons lemon zest | 1 pound lean ground beef | 1 cup frozen corn | 1 can stewed tomatoes in tomato puree | 1/2 cup shredded coleslaw mix | 1 teaspoon bottled minced fresh ginger
instructions: Heat sesame oil in a saucepan over medium heat. Season beef with garlic salt, lemon peel, and the salt.

title: Italian Brats
ingredients: 4 bratwursts, split | 6 slices italian asiago cheese
instructions: Preheat oven broiler. Place brats on a baking tray coated with cooking spray. Broil brats approximately 5 minutes or until desired doneness, turning once. Place on a serving platter. Top with asiago cheese.

Random Ingredients: taco sauce,prosciutto,penne pasta,pine nut,beet,maple syrup,cardamom seed
title: Beet and Pine Nut Pasta
ingredients: 1/4 cup pine nuts | 3 large beets, peeled and grated | 1 package dry penne pasta | 1 tablespoon maple syrup | 2 teaspoons taco sauce | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom seeds | 1 package crumbled prosciutto
instructions: Heat pine nuts in olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Stir in grated beetroot, and cook, stirring occasionally, until the beet root is tender.

title: Mexican Inspired Steak
ingredients: 1 lb sirloin steak | 10 ounces salsa or 10 ounces ro tel mexican sauce | 1 tablespoon parmesan cheese | 1/2 cup prepared tap water
instructions: Place all ingredients in crockpot and stir until well blended. Cook on high setting for 3 to 5 hours. Slice beef as desired and serve over rice.

title: Easy Mexican Cheese Spread
ingredients: 1/2 cup margarine or 1/2 cup butter | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 1/4 cup queso fresco | 2 teaspoons chicken bouillon
instructions: Cream together margarine, taco seasoning mix and cheese. Add bouillon and mix. Spread over crackers or bread or other favorite crackers and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: red chili pepper,red pepper flake,red chile,sherry wine vinegar
title: Portocollo (Port-Style Vinegar Salad)
ingredients: 1 ounce portuguese red pepper or 1 ounce arbol chile | 3 red serrano peppers, stemmed, seeded, and diced | 1 fresh chile red pepper, stemmed, seeded, and minced ( or to taste ) | 1 teaspoon red pepper flakes ( optional, but recommended )
instructions: Soak the chilies in water overnight to soften. Remove the chilies and pat dry. Drain the liquid, place it in a blender or food processor, and pulse to finely chop. Heat the chilies over an open flame or in a wok over low heat, stirring until they become very dark. Immediately remove the chilies from the wok and add the chilies to the blender, along with the chile hot liquid and sugar. Process the chilies until it's very well blended. Add the chile blossom and optional red pepper flakes if desired.

title: Italian Breadsticks
ingredients: 1 package dry active yeast | 2 teaspoons garlic powder | 1 1/2 cups warm water
instructions: In a large bowl, dissolve yeast in water. Stir in garlic powder and 3 cups of the flour. Place in a well buttered bowl, turning to coat. Cover, and let rise 1 hour. Place on a lightly floured surface, and cut with a pizza cutter. Arrange in a very lightly greased, bread pan. Let rise until doubled in size, about 1 hour. Bake at 350 degrees f for 12 to 15 minutes, until tops are brown, and internal temperature of bread reaches 190 degrees f.

title: Sizzlin' Rhubarb Bread
ingredients: 1 loaf bread ( sourdough ) | 2 tablespoons ketchup ( tomato ketchup ) | 2 tablespoons coarsely chopped coriander | 1 -2 chili pepper flakes | 2 tablespoons ketchup | 2 tablespoons coarsely chopped rhubarb
instructions: Cut bread in round slices or to preference.

title: Chilli and Green Chile Rellenos
ingredients: 1 red capsicum, deseeded and diced | 1 green chile, deseeded and chopped | 3 tablespoons spearmint ( optional )
instructions: Place capsicum in a small pan with a lid, sprinkle with lemon rind and a sprinkling of lemon juice. Roast for 20 - 25 minutes, depending on the heat of the capsicum and whether you're tempted to leave yours on longer or shorter.. Remove the chillies before serving.

title: Aebrian Chicken
ingredients: 2 lbs chicken breasts | 3 tablespoons abadrian masala | 1 bunch escarole, cut small | 1 tablespoon garam masala | 1 1/2 cups chicken stock or 1 1/2 cups chicken broth
instructions: Place chicken in a pot with enough water to cover. Bring to boil on high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to med low and let cook for 25 minutes until falling off a bone. Let cool slightly then slice into large pieces. Add 2 more cups of stock, cover and let sit for another 15 minutes for chicken to become fully cooked.

Random Ingredients: beer,colby monterey jack cheese,coriander powder,coconut cream,snow pea,cake flour,hot green chili pepper
title: Mexican  Nachos  W- Beer & Cheese (Papas Ahogadas)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups cake flour | 1/2 cup coriander powder | 1 teaspoon hot green chili pepper ( optional ) | 500 ml coconut cream | 3/4 cup colby-monterey jack cheese ( shredded ) | 300 g snow peas ( fresh ) | 1/2 cup beer ( non alcoholic, i prefer pacific breeze )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Mix cake flour, coriander and chilli powder in a bowl. Add cheese and stir until well distributed. Add snow peas and beer. Stir until well combined, but not too dry. Place tablespoon tablespoon sized pieces on an oiled baking sheet and bake for about 8 - 8 minutes.

Random Ingredients: tomato soup,chocolate baking square,onion soup mix
title: Onion Soup Powder II
ingredients: 1 package onion soup mix | 1 can condensed tomato soup | 1 package chocolate baking squares
instructions: Heat onion soup and tomato soup together in a large saucepan over medium heat. When soup is heated through, sprinkle chocolate over the top. Cover and serve.

Random Ingredients: cheese,vanilla extract,parmigiano reggiano cheese,extra tofu,steak,lentil,cooking apple
title: Apple-Bean & Lentil Gratin
ingredients: 3 cups red lentils | 2 teaspoons pure vanilla extract | 8 ounces extra firm tofu | 1 cooking apple | 1 small grana padano cheese or 1 small parmigiano-reggiano cheese, grated | 2 ounces extra firm tofu | 1/3 cup parmigiano-reggiano cheese, freshly grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Bring the lentils to a boil in 2 cups of cold water and the vanilla extract. Reduce heat and simmer, covered, until lentils are tender, about 25 minutes. Drain reserving 1 1/2 cups cooking liquid in a small bowl, transfer 1/4 cup of the liquid to another small bowl. Finely grate the tofu using the flat side of a box grater or electric coffee grater and set aside. Place the lentils, drained yogurt, and grated block of tofu in a medium saucepan over low heat. Cook stirring occasionally, until the yogurt is mostly melted, 3 to 5 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside to cool slightly. Remove the core and halve the apple lengthwise. Scoop out the centre of that and reserve for garnish, squeezing out excess liquid. Slice the apple into 1/4 inch thick wedges. To assemble, spread the lentils on a baking tray, top with half the shredded cheese, half the apple wedges, and half the tofu. Repeat for the remaining grated cheese, lentils, and half the apple wedges. Sprinkle the reserved bean/tofu topping over the top and drizzle evenly with parmigiano, pressing the mozzarella into the cheese with the help of the bowl. Finish with the rest of the grated cheese and bake until nicely browned, about 30 minutes. Let cool for 10 minutes, cut into slices. Variation, bake in a 10 to 11 inch baking dish for 20 to 30 minutes, until the crust is golden brown and the toppings are crisply caramelized. Variation, for a slightly more traditional approach, place the grated cheese and pressed tofu evenly on top of the grated cheese.

Random Ingredients: tahini,garlic paste,cannellini bean,beet,red chile pepper,apricot nectar,gruyere,red wine
title: Chef John's Cannellini Beans
ingredients: 2 cans cannellini beans, drained | 1 jar beet greens with leaves, drained and chopped | 2 jars sweet pickled beets | 2 tablespoons tahini | 1/4 cup red wine | 3 cloves garlic paste | 1 teaspoon paprika | 1/2 cup gruyere, shredded
instructions: Open cans of cannellini beans, remove excess liquid. Combine beets, beet greens, paprika, red wine, garlic paste, and red chile pepper in a slow cooker. Place the slow cooker on high and allow to heat for a minimum of 12 hours.

Random Ingredients: plum tomato,chipotle pepper adobo sauce,potato,white bread,lemon peel,lemonade
title: Chipotle Smoked Flatbread
ingredients: 1/8 - 1/4 cup sweet potato ( chopped fine, too ) | 1/8 - 1/4 cup plum tomato ( chopped, too ) | 1 tablespoon white bread, crumbled | 2 teaspoons lemonade | 1/2 teaspoon grated lemon peel | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon chipotle pepper in adobo sauce
instructions: Mix everything together in a small bowl.. Smoke till brown and done.

Random Ingredients: red bean,garlic,cremini mushroom,ketchup,tomato juice,turmeric powder,goat cheese,berry
title: Vegetable Anticy Goat Dip
ingredients: 10 ounces mixed berry rounds ( see note below ) | 2 ounces goat cheese, crumbled ( or feta cheese ) | 8 ounces cremini mushrooms, sliced ( or baby portabellas ) | 8 ounces red beans, drained ( or 1 can mixed beans, rinsed and drained ) | 2 tablespoons ketchup | 2 tablespoons tomato juice | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1/2 teaspoon garlic, chopped
instructions: Note, if making this in advance, allow 2 hours refrigeration time for all ingredients to combine. Dice mixed berries and goat cheese into 1/4 pieces and mix in with above ingredients. Cover and refrigerate until ready for use. Serve with corn chips, crackers, tortilla chips or eat it as is.

Random Ingredients: beef tenderloin,heavy cream,bean sprout,garlic,cilantro,cinnamon sugar,wheat bread,linguine
title: Cinnamon Sugar Beef Medallions With Whole Wheat Pasta
ingredients: 4 large beef tenderloin, very thinly sliced and cut across grain into 1/2-inch strips | 1/2 cup heavy cream | 2 teaspoons whole grain cinnamon sugar | 1/2 teaspoon garlic, minced | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh cilantro | 1 lb spaghetti linguine or 1 lb linguine, cooked | 1/4 cup fresh whole wheat bread, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1/4 cup bean sprouts or 1/4 cup green sprout
instructions: Prepare pasta according to package directions. Place all remaining ingredients into a large, heavy casserole. Cover and marinate in refrigerator for 4 hours or until heated throughout. Drain beef and set aside. Heat a large skillet, over high heat, until very hot but not smoking. Add all beef and cook, stirring often, until no longer pink. Remove from heat and serve with bread and sprouts.

title: Pumpkin Noodles and Chicken With Radishes
ingredients: 8 ounces rice noodles | 2 tablespoons oil | 1 large roasting chickens, cut into serving pieces or 2 lbs raw pumpkin, peeled, seeded, cut into 12 medallions about 1 in wide and 2 in long | 1/4 cup fresh rosemary leaves, torn or 1 1/2 tablespoons dried rosemary leaves | 1/4 cup pickled sliced radishes or 1/4 cup pickled sliced radish
instructions: Bring 8 cups water to boil in large wide nonreactive saucepan. Stir in noodles and cook until 'al dente', about 5 minutes. Reserve 1/4 cup of cooking water. Drain noodles and set aside. Meanwhile, heat oil in large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Add chicken and 2/3 cup water.

title: Yellow Rice Salad for One
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked yellow rice | 3 cups shredded mexican blend cheese | 1/3 cup cider vinegar | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh basil
instructions: Cook and stir rice according to package directions. Drain and cool. In a small bowl, stir together cheese, vinegar and basil. Toss with cooled rice. Cover, and refrigerate at least 2 hours before slicing into bite size pieces,.

Random Ingredients: clove,chipotle chile,natural yoghurt,chorizo sausage,spinach leaf,extra virgin olive oil,red potato
title: Smoked Spanish Chorizo & Potatoes #5FIX
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon ground cloves | 1 lb ground chorizo sausage | 2 packages spinach leaves | 2 lbs raw red potatoes | 7 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 1/2 cup natural yoghurt | 1 teaspoon dried chipotle chile
instructions: Preheat the grill on high and line the grate with foil for direct heat. Place the ground cloves and chorizo on the grate, close the cover and cook for 6 - 9 mins turning regularly until the chorizo has changed colour. Alternatively, heat a large oven proof frying pan over a high heat, add the olive oil and smoke for 20 mins until smoking. Add the potatoes, fry for 3 - 4 mins on each side or until browned. Transfer the toasted garlic chorizo mixture to a bowl and stir in the yoghurt until combined. To serve, heap the potato mixture onto the plate, top with the smoked chorizo and drizzle with a little oil. Serve with your favourite salsa and grated cheddar.

title: Homemade Greek Yogurt
ingredients: 2 cups plain greek yogurt | 1 jar of your favorite tomato sauce ( or your own, i like newman's own ) | 1/2 cup peanut oil or 1/2 cup vegetable oil
instructions: Mix the yogurt and the sauce thoroughly until it is creamy, smooth and creamy. Pour into a medium sized bowl and cover with plastic wrap. Let sit for about 15 minutes or longer at room temperature. Stir occasionally. Enjoy note, if your bowl does not fit tightly, just turn up the heat on your burner and warm the yogurt for about 15 more minutes, stirring often until the yogurt is thick, bubbling, and creamy. This may take up to 24 hours depending on how thick the sauce is and how you prefer it to be.

title: Vanilla Bean Bacon (Cookies)
ingredients: 200 g frozen bacon, cut into small pieces | 1 vanilla bean
instructions: Remove the pod from the vanilla bean and scrape the seeds into a large bowl. Measure the pod into your bowl of freshly boiled water and soak for about 8 minutes. Drain the bacon and place it into the microwave safe glass bowl of your choice. Place the bowl into the microwave and cook for about 5 minutes stirring intermittently. After 5 minutes, remove the vanilla bean pod. Place the bacon into the bowl of your choice and press with a potato masher or your hands until the bacon is well coated. Return the bowl to the microwave and cook for about another 5 minutes, stirring intermittently. Remove the bowl from the microwave and turn your oven on to 350 degrees f or 180 degrees celsius. Place the baking paper onto a baking tray and sprinkle lightly with vanilla bean. Place in oven and wait for 5 minutes, then pour the bacon onto the baking paper and spread down slightly so that the bacon is fully covered by the flavours. Cool at least 5 minutes before slicing into 1 x 3 cm squares.

title: Mango Chutney Substitute
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 cup low-fat mango chutney | 1 - 1 1/2 cup low-fat cocoa powder
instructions: Mix all together and keep in refrigerator. Stir every few hours so all chutney dissolves. For vegan use only the mango chutney.

Random Ingredients: tomato green chilies,prosciutto,radish,coffee,spanish onion,onion powder,hoisin sauce,red onion
title: Spanish Inspired Ham and Radish Grilled
ingredients: 3 lbs center cut ham ( use a ham bone, if you can find it ) | 1/4 cup dried onion, chopped | 1/4 cup spanish onion soup mix or 1/4 cup spanish onion | 2 tablespoons hoisin sauce | roasted sweet onion, sliced on the diagonal | 3 tablespoons coffee, hot | 1/2 cup diced tomato with green chilies | 4 -6 -6 radishes, grilled | parma ham or ham, grated, toasted
instructions: Brush/spray foil with olive oil. Bake ham, uncovered, on grill, or under broiler. Grill, turning often, until meat thermometer reaches 140. Cut ham into desired serving size pieces.

title: Szechuan Meatball and Vegetable Bowl
ingredients: 1 jar meatballs, with bones | 1 cup cooked quinoa | 2 sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, chopped | 1 tablespoon peanut oil | 1 tablespoon szechwan pepper ( timur ) ( optional ) | 1/4 cup light coconut oil
instructions: Drain the meatballs, and combine with quinoa in a bowl. Finely chop the tomatoes and sichuan pepper. In a medium wok, heat peanut oil over medium heat. Add meatballs, and brown for about 4 minutes. Add the szechuan pepper and tomatoes.

Random Ingredients: garam masala,chipotle chile,cornflour,pasta,celery,provolone cheese,grain white rice
title: Curt's Rice Pilaf
ingredients: 1 cup short-grain white rice | 2 cups low-fat chicken broth | 1 tablespoon cornflour | 1 -2 teaspoon garam masala | 1 -4 teaspoon chile | 1 slice provolone cheese, roughly 2-3 centimeter cubes ( optional ) | 1 -4 slice celery
instructions: Soak rice in a pot of cold water about 30 minutes, then rinse to remove the water. Drain. Combine rice and next 3 ingredients.

title: Mushroom Risotto
ingredients: 400 g mixed mushrooms stems | 400 g sultana raisins or 400 g rice bran cooking raisins | 400 ml vegetable stock
instructions: Wash mushrooms and remove stems. Wash well to remove any grit or sand. Chop mushrooms. Pour vegetable stock into pan and bring to the boil. Turn down heat as simmering and quickly stir through mushrooms and raisins. Simmer gently for 5 minutes until all liquid absorbed. Serve immediately.

title: Spiced Pudding
ingredients: 300 g plain flour | 100 g double cream ( not low fat ) | 3 cardamom pods
instructions: Preheat oven 180°c. Rub flour in cream and stir in cardomom pods. Pour mixture into a deep oven proof dish and bake for 30 - 40 minutes, until top becomes golden brown. Remove from oven and serve with a fruit and sugar syrup.

title: Lemongrass Pork Loaf
ingredients: 1 lb boneless pork loin | 4 ounces ground lean pork | 2 tablespoons shallots, finely chopped | 1 stalk lemongrass, finely chopped | 1/2 cup raisins ( or to taste ) | 1 cup sweet italian dressing | 2 teaspoons hot sauce | 1 tablespoon bread flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°. Trim fat from pork, then cut into 1/2 inch cubes. Combine pork, shallots, lemon grass and raisins and mix well. Spoon mixture into a well buttered loaf pan. Add salad dressing. Sprinkle with salt. Bake in middle of oven until browned, about 40 minutes. Invert from loaf pan. Remove from oven and top with hot sauce or honey glaze. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: italian seasoning,rice vermicelli,pearl barley,canadian whiskey,red wine vinegar,white wine vinegar,almond,sage leaf
title: Rice Barley & Rice Pilaf(Cook's Il
ingredients: 2 boxes of rice vermicelli | 1 tablespoon canadian whiskey | 1 tablespoon red wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon rice vinegar | 5 cups white wine vinegar | 1 cup sliced almonds | 1 teaspoon italian seasoning | 4 fresh sage leaves
instructions: Cook rice noodles according to package directions. Meanwhile, combine all other ingredients except sliced almonds in a large bowl. Cover and set aside. Drain noodles, rinse with cold water and put in a large bowl along with all other ingredients. Mix until well combined. Enjoy.

title: Spam Salad
ingredients: 1 lb spam, cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 1 lb veggie sticks, cut into 1/2 inch squares | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon dried chipotle powder | 1/2 cup mayonnaise | 1/4 cup applesauce, to taste | 8 sage leaves, minced | 1 lb dry farfalle pasta
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions or you can use the regular directions on your package. Meanwhile, heat a small amount of oil in a large skillet over high heat until a drop of water sizzles when sprinkled on. Add the spam, veggie sticks and chipotle powder to the oil.

Random Ingredients: mexican oregano,tart apple,baking powder,spinach,beef shank,broccoli,beef tenderloin
title: Apple Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 1 beef tenderloin, trimmed | 1 teaspoon baking powder ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons dried mexican oregano, or more to taste | 1 pound beef shank, cut into 4 pieces | 1 package frozen chopped spinach, thawed and drained | 1 medium tart apple, cored and cut into wedges | 1 cup sliced broccoli, steamed
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f in a 12x8 inch baking dish, combine beef tenderloin and baking powder and rub over the surface. Rub the meat with oregano. Cover and let stand in the refrigerator until at least 1 hour. Rinse steamer and bring to a boil. Place spinach and apples in the steamer and steam until just tender, no longer crunchy, and no longer tough looking. Place beef and spinach mixture on a serving plate or platter and surround with apple wedges and broccoli slices.

Random Ingredients: red bell pepper,nori,stone mustard,vegetable shortening,kidney bean,cheese,potato chip,hungarian paprika
title: Hungarian Kidney Beans
ingredients: 1 cup pickled kidney beans | 1 1/2 teaspoons stone ground mustard, divided | 1 teaspoon mild hungarian paprika, divided | 1 tablespoon vegetable shortening | 1 tablespoon vegetable shortening | 3 medium potatoes, peeled and cut into 1/2-inch dice | 1 small red bell pepper, cut into 1/2-inch dice | 4 nori seaweed sheets or plastic wrap | nori
instructions: Rinse the kidney beans and pick from the skins, but do not soak them in water since they will rehydrate during cooking. Measure 1/2 cup of the reserved pickling liquid and place the reserved liquid into a small saucepan. In a nonstick 12 inch skillet, combine 1 teaspoon of mustard and 1/4 teaspoon of paprika. Heat in 1 minute. Remove from heat. Stir in 1 teaspoon of mustard seeds and 1/4 teaspoon of paprika. Add 1 teaspoon shortening and 1 tablespoon shortening and heat over low heat until the shortening is melted. Stirring constantly until the shortening is absorbed, stir in potato. If necessary, add water to thin the mixture until it is slightly thick but not liquid.

title: Raspberry Chocolate Jam & Chocolate Bark
ingredients: 1 package chocolate candy bars, with the baking aisle just covered | 1 -2 drop raspberry jam, for dipping
instructions: Cut chocolate chocolate squares into squares, melt over very low heat in a double boiler. Remove from stove and stir in jam. Spoon mixture into a cup and dip each bar into melted chocolate. Keep on a cookie sheet covered with a towel and refrigerate until firm about 1 - 2 hours.

title: Irish Mist
ingredients: 5 cups grated swiss cheese | 5 ounces irish whiskey | 5 ounces semisweet white chocolate, melted
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 f. In a mixing bowl, combine cheese, whiskey, and chocolate. Stir well until melted and blended. Pour into two 2 quart baking dishes or glasses. Scoop air bubbles should form around the sides of the serving glasses. Cool completely, then refrigerate at least 2 days.

Random Ingredients: ghee,italian tomato,red wine,greek oregano,taco seasoning mix,marjoram,red pepper flake
title: Tomato Gizzards in Garlic
ingredients: 2 lbs italian tomatoes, seeded, chopped | 1/2 cup red wine | 1/2 cup greek oregano or 1/2 cup marjoram | 1/4 cup fresh marjoram or 1/4 cup fresh oregano | 2 lbs taco seasoning mix | 2 teaspoons red pepper flakes | 1/4 cup ghee or 1/4 cup cooking oil
instructions: Pour oil into a large skillet over high heat. Add dry oregano, marjoram, tomato and seasoning mix to pan. Bring to a boil. Then reduce heat and simmer to thicken gravy. Taste and adjust seasoning. Keep warm. Serve with bread, crostini, pita chips, etc.

Random Ingredients: baguette,chicken broth,celery rib,pork,grain rice,goat cheese,wheat pasta,marsala wine
title: Ww Friendly country pork and pasta soup
ingredients: 4 cups low sodium chicken broth | 1 teaspoon coarse grain rice, uncooked | 1 baguette, toasted and cut into 1/4 in thick slices ( or cut into 1/2 thick slices to make it thinner, 1-inchx1-inch ) | 3/4 cup low-fat goat cheese | 1/2 cup dry marsala wine | 1 1/2 cups sliced celery ribs | 4 slices boneless country pork, cut into 1/2 in cubes
instructions: Combine broth, rice and 2 cups water in a large microwave safe bowl and microwave on high for 2 minutes, or until rice is soft and grains are partially cooked. Stir well and set aside. Cover and microwave on high for 2 minutes.

title: Easy Spanish Rice
ingredients: 1 -2 cup long-grain rice ( white or brown ) | 1 -2 green pepper, cut in strips
instructions: Cook rice and pepper for 4 minutes using cooking spray. Serve.

title: Pancakes With Orange Zucchini
ingredients: 1 zucchini, grated into a mush | 1/4 cup orange liqueur ( such as sambuca liqueur ) | 2 tablespoons canola oil ( such as canola oil below ) | 1/2 lb penne | 2 tablespoons canola oil ( such as canola oil below ) | 3 tablespoons orange liqueur ( such as orange liqueur )
instructions: Whisk the zucchini with 1/4 cup of the orange liqueur in a medium bowl until they have a consistent texture. While the zucchini is soaking, pour a cup of boiling water over the penne in a medium saucepan of boiling water. Cook the pasta until tender but firm, still firm to the bite. Drain, and toss to combine. Set aside. While the pasta is cooking, heat 2 tablespoons of the canola oil in a medium skillet over high heat. Cook and stir the zucchini until they are bright orange, about 4 minutes. Transfer the cooked pasta to a bowl. Heat 1 tablespoon of the canola oil in the microwave. Add the remaining orange liqueur and cook until the oil has been absorbed, about 1 minute. Slowly add the orange liqueur mixture to the hot skillet and cook until the flavors are blended, about 1 minute more. Toss the pasta with the zucchini mixture. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: active yeast,cheddar cheese,onion soup mix,hot red pepper flake,purpose flour,brandy,ginger juice
title: Brandy and Onion Gravy for Bread Machine
ingredients: 3 tablespoons active dry yeast | 4 1/2 cups all-purpose flour | 2 1/2 cups cheddar cheese, shredded | 3 tablespoons brandy ( not alcoholic ) | 1 tablespoon dried onion soup mix | 2 tablespoons fresh ginger juice | 1 tablespoon hot red pepper flakes ( or more )
instructions: Add all ingredients in to bread machine in the order listed according to the manufacturer's directions. Put on dough setting. Check the dough. If its about to let the edges of the loaf get too brown, add an additional tablespoon of brandy or water. Allow to rise for about 30 to 40 minutes. If its looking too dry, add an additional tablespoon of brandy or water.

title: Applebee's Chutney Spread
ingredients: 1 container mango chutney | 1 sprig fresh thyme
instructions: In a blender, blend the mango chutney and thyme until smooth.

title: Cashews, Anchovies and Red Pepper
ingredients: 1/4 cup red pepper, chopped | 1/4 cup roasted cashews | 1/4 cup roasted hazelnuts, chopped | 1 dried anaheim chilies ( or any dried hot red pepper ) | 1/4 cup warm broth
instructions: In a food processor pulse cashews until coarsely ground and then transfer nuts to a bowl. Add other ingredients and process until smooth. Store in the refrigerator covered until serving time.

title: Brown Rice
ingredients: 2 tablespoons brown rice | 16 fennel bulbs ( or bulb of your choice ) | white pepper, to taste
instructions: Wash and drain fennel. Cut into thick slices. Sprinkle with white pepper. Mix all together until well prepared.

Random Ingredients: white rice,papaya,taco seasoning mix,xanthan gum,roast beef,scallion,lettuce
title: Mexican Shredded Beef Salad
ingredients: 1 cup white rice | 1/2 cup xanthan gum | 6 -7 cups beef, shredded | 3 tablespoons taco seasoning mix | 1 cup lettuce, shredded | 1/4 cup papaya, diced | 1/4 cup scallion, sliced
instructions: Boil rice in 3 cups water. Stir in 1/2 cup of xanthan gum.

title: Spicy Scented kale
ingredients: 20 leaves kale, cleaned, washed and cut into pieces | olive oil flavored cooking spray
instructions: To build the herb, place a leaf of kale on a dinner plate. Add 1 tbsp butter or olive oil. Spread butter on the kale leaves. Sprinkle lightly with a teaspoon of desired amount of kosher salt. Garnish kale with additional olive oil, red pepper flakes and/or dried red pepper flakes. Enjoy.

title: Soya Noodle Cake
ingredients: 350 g soba noodles | 3 cups fresh grapefruit | 2 cups chicken stock or 2 cups broth | 3 -4 tablespoons cocoa | red food coloring
instructions: Cook soba noodles until just barely tender. Drain and leave to cool until warm. Wash grapesfruit. Slice grapesfruit thinly with a sharp knife. Bring stock to the boil in a large pan. Add in cocoa powder. Add soba noodles and boil gently. Add in grapesfruit to mixture. Turn off heat. Top with red food colouring. Serve immediately.

title: Manchego And Cheese Potatoes
ingredients: 1/2 cup ketchup | 2 lbs yukon gold potatoes ( peeled and coarsely shredded ) | 8 -12 saltine crackers | 4 cups grated manchego cheese | 1/2 head lettuce
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. In a small saucepan, combine ketchup, then heat until it simmers. Place shredded potatoes in a bowl and sprinkle with saltines. Spread potatoes on a baking sheet. Bake until potatoes are tender, about 25 minute. Remove from oven and spread crackers evenly over the top of the potatoes, to within 1/2 inch of the edges. In the bowl of a food processor, combine grated cheese with 1/4 cup of the sauce mixture until melted.. Drizzle cheese mixture over criss cross potatoes evenly using a brush. Bake for 20 minutes, turn over and bake for 10 more minutes. Place lettuce over cheese mixture, and serve immediately.

title: Blueberry and Orange Ketchup on-Buns
ingredients: 1/2 cup blueberries ( fresh or frozen ) | 1 tablespoon grated lemon peel ( or a mixture of lemon and lime peel, rind ) ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon orange extract | 4 large sandwich buns or 4 hero buns | 6 -8 thin slices red cabbage
instructions: In medium bowl, combine blueberries with lemon peel, orange extract and blueberry mixture. Cut each of the four sandwich buns in half. Place each half of the bun on a serving plate. Spoon about 1/4 cup of the blueberry mixture onto each half of the bun, then top with slices of the cabbage, or a small red onion, if desired. Serve immediately. Note, if using frozen blueberries, thaw before proceeding with recipe.

title: Rigatoni With Beans and Raisins
ingredients: 1 lb bacon, cut crosswise into 1/2-inch pieces | 1/2 lb small green beans, ends trimmed and ends snipped off | 1 1/2 cups dry sherry wine | 1/2 cup light-colored sake | 1 lb rigatoni pasta or 1 lb fettuccine pasta | 4 cups thinly sliced fresh green beans
instructions: Cook bacon in a 10 inch nonstick skillet over moderate heat, stirring occasionally, until browned but not crisp, about 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.

title: Easy Cheesy Rice Balls
ingredients: 1 package cottage cheese | 1 1/2 cups arborio rice ( i use short grain but you can use whatever is on sale )
instructions: First cook the rice in a pan of water in a separate pan until cooked though not soft. Combine the cottage cheese and arborio rice with a hand mixer. If you find it seems a little thick add a little cream to thin it out a little. Roll mixture into balls and fry in a little olive oil until golden brown.

title: Roasted Pork Tenderloin With Roasted Potatoes & Corn
ingredients: 2 lbs pork tenderloin | 1/2 cup white breadcrumb, plus extra ( plain or flavored ) | white breadcrumbs | 2 teaspoons paprika | 3/4 cup canned fire-roasted tomatoes ( cut into 1/2-inch cubes ) | 2 cups frozen corn, thawed | 4 medium baking potatoes, cut into wedges
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 f degrees. Place the tenderloins on the rack in a roasting pan. Insert a meat thermometer into the centre of each. Lightly brush the pork with the bread crumbs and then sprinkle the paprika all over the meat. Roast till thermometer reads 155 f, about 20 minutes per pound. Remove from the oven, cool 20 minutes, then carefully remove and discard the tenderloins and place on a plate and cover loosely with foil for 10 minutes. Meanwhile, place the tomatoes, corn, potatoes, 3 tbs. Of the bread crumbs and 2 tbs of the water in a large bowl, toss to combine and set aside. Remove the meat from the oven and spread on the bread crumb/water mixture. Return to the oven, roast for 20 - 25 minutes,. The tenderloins should register 145 f on a thermometer,. Baste the tenderloins with the rest of the bread crumb/water mixture every 5 minutes or so while warm. The meat should also register 155 f on an instant reading thermometer and be golden in the middle of the roast. Let rest for 10 minutes before slicing. For a crusty and crisp meat, cook in a 400 f degree oven for 40 minutes.

title: Spicy Prawns
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1 jalapeno, finely chopped | 2 tomatoes, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons tomato ketchup | 4 ounces pecorino romano cheese
instructions: Heat oil in a skillet over a medium heat. Add jalapeno and cook 2 - 3 minutes. Add the jalapeno juice and cook 1 minute. Add tomatoes, tomato ketchup and pecorino romano cheese. Cook 2 - 3 minutes or until the prawns are cooked through. Serve immediately.

title: Smoothie
ingredients: 1 cup cremini mushroom, chopped | 1 1/4 cups fresh raspberries, picked over for storage or 1 1/4 cups frozen raspberries, thawed and drained | 1/4 cup guacamole ( optional )
instructions: Mix mushrooms and raspberries in a bowl. Drizzle with guacamole if you want to make a smoothie.

title: Faux Spicy Broccoli Salad
ingredients: 1/4 cup drained capers, rinsed and patted dry using a paper towel | 1 bunch broccoli, trimmed | 1/2 cup salsa | 2 tablespoons cilantro, chopped | 1 tablespoon crushed cardamom seeds | 1/2 cup cranberries or 1/2 cup raisins
instructions: Place the capers and broccoli in a small baking dish. Combine rest of the ingredients. Pour over the veggies and toss to coat. Cover the dish tightly and bake at 400 for 35 minutes.

title: Microwave Teriyaki Butter for Steak
ingredients: 1/2 lb margarine or 1/2 lb butter | 2 tablespoons margarine | 1 dash ground ginger ( optional )
instructions: Melt 1/2 lb margarine in frying pan on medium. Then add ginger and optional ingredients. Melt another 1/2 lb margarine. Turn heat down to low. Mix remaining ingredients and microwave on high 3 - 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: red potato,rigatoni pasta,lamb steak,fish stock,chicken thigh,green,dill pickle,chili flake
title: Lamb Ragu
ingredients: 1 lb large red potatoes or 1 lb fingerling potato | 1/2 lb chicken thighs | 1/2 lb lamb steaks | 1/8 cup fish stock | 1 small chopped green onion | 1 1/2 tsp chili flakes | 1/2 lb rigatoni pasta ( fresh or farfalle ) | 8 -12 skewers, soaked in water for 30 minutes ( i like the ones with the wood )
instructions: Chop potatoes into thin slices with skin on. Cut meat into short lengths and soak in cold water for 1 hour. Drain meat and cut into bite size pieces. In a large heavy pan or soup pot, add stock and bring to a boil. Add potatoes, meat, onion, chili flakes and parsley. Cover and simmer on low and allow to infuse for 40 minutes or until potatoes are tender. Remove from heat. Meanwhile, cook rigatoni pasta in boiling water and drain. Serve sauce over pasta and top with reserved green onions.

title: Lamb Kebabs
ingredients: 500 g potatoes ( yukon gold, or red skin potatoes ) | 500 g lamb, cut into small cubes ( leg lamb ) | 1 cup sour cream or 2/3 cup plain yogurt | 1 tablespoon sherry or 1 tablespoon dry sherry | salt, for marination
instructions: Wash potatoes, cut into quarters and boil in a large pan with lots of water, covered, until they soften. Meanwhile, in a mixing bowl, blend the lamb, sour cream or yogurt, and sherry. When potatoes are partially cooked, drain and mash with a bit of the water, so they hold their shape. Drain potatoes and add to lamb mixture. Mix lightly. Season and serve.

title: Cajun Baked Seafood Salad
ingredients: 1 package pretzel halves | 1 1/2 pounds peeled and deveined fresh crabmeat | 2 romaine lettuce hearts | 1 can pitted kalamata olives | 1 tablespoon dried sage | seasoning salt to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Arrange pretzels on a baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until lightly browned, 8 to 10 minutes. Drain on a paper towel lined baking sheet and let cool before filling with seafood. In a large bowl, mix together pretzels, crabmeat, romaine hearts, olives, sage and seasoned salt. Refrigerate until serving. Season with additional seasoning salt to taste.

title: Easy N Easy Noodle Fritters
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups chickpea flour ( homemade is best for you ) | 1 jar of your favorite spaghetti sauce ( i use prego zesty tomato and garlic )
instructions: In a large bowl add the chickpea flour. Add the jar of sauce. Mix and pour in a frying pan on med high. Cook until bubbly, add the fritters and turn until they are evenly browned, about 2 mins per side. Serve with pasta.

title: Rice Gateaux
ingredients: 6 sheets phyllo pastry | 3 cups sweet sherry | 1 tablespoon cream of tartar | 7 1/2 cups arborio rice ( about 1 quart ) | 1 cup creme fraiche | 1/2 cup brandy | 1/4 cup hot tabasco sauce
instructions: Combine sherry and cream of tartar in heavy large saucepan over medium heat. Add rice.

Random Ingredients: cream cheese,pork tenderloin,cayenne,buttermilk,turmeric powder,vanilla essence,white sugar,oatmeal
title: Cheese Tostadas With Pork and Nuts
ingredients: 6 pork tenderloin | 1 cup buttermilk | 1 packet cream cheese | 1 cup old-fashioned oatmeal | 1/2 cup white sugar | 1/2 cup light cream cheese | 1/3 cup white sugar | 3/4 cup buttermilk | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne | 1 1/2 teaspoons vanilla essence, mixed with | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: For the pork, soak the meat in buttermilk for 1 hour. Cut into 1 inch slices and thread on skewers. Mix the cream cheese with the 1 cup of soft brown sugar, old fashioned oatmeal, cream cheese, sugar, cream, white sugar, buttermilk, turmeric powder, cayenne, and vanilla essence with a hand mixer until well combined. Heat oil in a large skillet until hot. Drop meat skewers into the pan and fry until golden brown on both sides, turning over once. Drain when almost cooked through, but do not drain. Serve with warmed fresh fruit.

title: Date Dream
ingredients: 6 ounces almond paste | 2 ounces soymilk or 2 ounces almond milk | 6 -8 ounces blanched almonds | 1 large corn tortilla chips | dates ( optional )
instructions: Toast almonds in skillet. Spread some almond paste on the toast and enjoy. For me, i spread some date syrup over the toast and spread some almond milk over the toast. Cut up the date and eat the whole thing up.

title: Spaghetti Al' Amatraciana
ingredients: 4 cups heavy cream | 1 1/4 cups spaghetti sauce | 1 1/2 tablespoons tarragon
instructions: Heat cream in a heavy medium skillet over medium heat. When sauce begins to warm to the boil, stir in remaining ingredients. Simmer uncovered to reduce cream. When sauce is reduced and slightly thickened for pasta, about 5 minutes, add spaghetti, stirring until coated with sauce.

title: Cauliflower Sprouts and Cheese Stir Fry
ingredients: 1 large cauliflower, separated into flowerets | 4 brussels sprouts, cut on diagonal in 1 '' segments | 2 teaspoons chili oil ( see note ) | 1 package chicken strips, thawed ( can sub frozen meat ) | 2 tablespoons agave nectar | 1/2 cup parmigiano-reggiano cheese, freshly grated
instructions: Prepare vegetables as indicated above, adding a dash of sea salt and a few grindings of black pepper. Meanwhile, heat chili oil in a large skillet on medium high heat until it sizzles, and then add chicken strips, a little at a time tossing gently so they don't stick or mince the chicken, and cook for 2 more minutes. Add agave nectar and cook two more minutes. Add veggies and stir to combine. Stir pasta and cheese, adding a few grinds of black pepper, and serve.

title: Shish Kebab Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb beef tenderloin | 1 teaspoon cardamom powder | 1 can tomato sauce ( tomato flavor is better ) | 3 1/2 ounces chicken meat ( i like the flavor of the meat and slice it )
instructions: Cut beef tenderloin into 1 1/4 inch chunks. Mix cardamom powder with the tomato sauce and the meat. Marinate the meat for 24 hours.

title: Chef-Boy-I-Be Illinois' Severna Scallops in Tzatziki

instructions: Place quinoa into a large, wide, deep pot. Fill the pot with enough water to cover it.
