Place scallops in a large bowl, and toss with reserved quinoa and 2/3 cup reserved cooking liquid. Place remaining 1/3 cup cooking water into a small pan, and bring to a boil. Turn down heat, and simmer scallops for 3 minutes. Drain scallops, and cut into small pieces. Set aside. Wipe frypan, fill with reserved liquid and bring to a boil. Stir in reserved quinoa, and let boil for 1 minute. Remove scallops and cheese, and place into a serving bowl. Pour sauce over scallops and serve immediately with tzatziki for dipping.

title: Maraschino's Almond-Studded Almonds
ingredients: 1 cup blanched almond, at room temperature | 1 cup grand marnier, chilled ( or other orange-flavored liqueur )
instructions: Crush the almonds with your hands until fine. Place the almonds in an electric grinder or food processor and grind until almonds resemble coarse cornmeal. Mix in the grand marnier. Transfer to a bowl and store in the refrigerator until serving.

title: Rice, Mushroom & Egg Rolls
ingredients: 16 spring roll wrappers | 1/2 cup corn flakes | 4 cooked mushrooms, sliced | 1/4 cup diced ham ( or any fresh ham, chopped ) | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric | 1 tablespoon cider vinegar | 1 tablespoon grape, juice ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons dried sliced mushrooms
instructions: Mix together the rice, mushrooms, ham, mustard, turmeric & vinegar. Place the 1 tbsp grapes juice into a small bowl or dish & leave it for later use. Place the 1/2 tsp of grapes juice into a small pot. Serve with spring roll wrappers.

Random Ingredients: bamboo shoot,oil black olive,herbes de provence,liquid smoke,kaffir lime leaf,catsup,tomato basil pasta sauce,butter
title: Italian-Style Baked Olives
ingredients: 2 tablespoons oil from bamboo shoots | 4 teaspoons butter | 2 cans black olives, rinsed and drained | 3 kaffir lime leaves | 1/2 cup catsup | 1/2 cup tomato basil pasta sauce | 3 teaspoons herbes de provence | 1 teaspoon liquid smoke
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place vegetable oil and butter in a large skillet, and toast the black olives over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until fragrant, about 10 minutes. Cut the reserved can of black olives into four smaller slivers, and slice the kaffir lime leaves lengthwise in half. Melt the kaffir lime leaves in the skillet with the oil, butter, green olives, kaffir lime leaves, catsup, pasta sauce, herbes de provence, liquid smoke, and tomato basil pasta sauce, respectively, in a preheated oven. Bake in preheated oven until bubbling and the flavors have mingled, about 1 hour.

title: Honey Braised Italian Sausages
ingredients: 3 italian sausages ( bulk ) | 1 bottle sunflower oil | 1 pint blackberry ( fresh and sliced in half ) | 1 tablespoon honey
instructions: Preheat oven to 375ºf. Lightly oil a small baking sheet. Place sausages on pan and sprinkle with salt, pepper and the honey. Bake sausages at 375ºf for 1 hour, basting every 10 minutes.

title: Lemongrass (Lemongrass) and Pineapple-Almond Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup chili powder | 1/2 cup blanched almond, sliced thin | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric | 2 tablespoons sherry wine vinegar | 1/2 tablespoon almond extract | 1 large lemongrass, cleaned, trimmed and sliced thin | 1 lime, cut into 8 wedges
instructions: Mix spice mix ingredients together in a bowl and add water for a relaxed version. Toast coconut in the oven for about 10 minutes to make a golden color and crisp texture. Cool. Add cooled mixture and toss together. Serve with fresh lime wedges. Traditionally, this salad is served hot, but will mellow out over time.

title: Tikka Masala
ingredients: 2 cups turmeric powder | 1 tablespoon ground ginger
instructions: Mix turmeric powder, ginger and tikka masala together. Heat a flat wok or frying pan add tikka masala mixture into it. Sprinkle ginger on top.

title: Lamb Roast With Tequila
ingredients: 800 g stewing lamb | 1 large onion, finely chopped | 125 g cranberries | 100 g pecans, roughly chopped | 1 teaspoon dried cranberries | 1 ounce tequila | 1/2 red capsicum, chopped | 1 red capsicum, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c. Rub the roast with the olive oil and place on a rack in a roasting tin. Add the chopped onion onto the rack and cook it for 2 1/2 3 mins until very soft. Scrape the onion into a bowl and mix through the chopped cranberries, pecans, dried cranberries, tequila and dried capsicum. Pour over the meat in the roasting tin and stir around to coat everything in the liquid. Roast for 5 - 8 hours. Remove from oven and allow to rest for 10 mins before carving.

title: Beer Flavored Beer Skirt Steak
ingredients: coarse salt for coating the meat | 1 tablespoon garlic, minced | 1 pound skirt steak, cut into 3/4 inch thick pieces | 3/4 cup beer | 1 teaspoon vegetable oil | 1 teaspoon garam masala ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven's broiler. Coat the meat generously with coarse salt, then set on a baking sheet. Heat the garlic, beer, and vegetable oil in a saucepan over medium high heat. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low.

title: Onion Rice Ball (Raw Foods)
ingredients: 1 bag rye bread, crusts removed | 1/2 cup chopped dried fenugreek | 1/4 cup finely chopped onion ( i use dried onions in the asian food section of my grocery store ) | 1 pinch salt | 2/3 cup pecans, chopped | 2 teaspoons rice granules ( i use brown rice starch to help thicken up the rice ball ) | 1 lime wedge
instructions: In food processor place bread, fenugreek, onions, salt, pecans and rice granules, pulsing on and off until mixture forms a breadcrumb like texture. Add 2 tablespoonful of liquid from bread to rice and toss. Roll into 1 inch balls and either store in an air tight container while the rice is still raw until ready to use or freeze until needed. Serve with lime wedges.

Random Ingredients: almond,mango,head iceberg lettuce,linguine,cinnamon sugar,picante sauce,chili sauce,olive oil
title: Baja Lettuce Salad
ingredients: 1 head iceberg lettuce | 1 small mango, peeled and sliced ( optional ) | 1/4 cup chopped almonds | 1/4 cup sweet picante sauce | 2 tablespoons chili sauce blend ( koon chun brand ) | 2 tablespoons lite chili sauce | 3 tablespoons cinnamon sugar | 3 tablespoons olive oil
instructions: Wash and chop lettuce into bite size lengths and put in a bowl. Add sliced mango, olives, salsa, cinnamon sugar and sweet chili sauce blend. Mix and add in oil. If the salad is still wet put in a small bowl and add oil until it's creamy and pour over the salad. Enjoy.

title: The Banana's Quick Breaky Wake up: Bananas in Fluffy Hot Water!
ingredients: 1 banana, peeled and sliced very small ( approx. 1-1 1/2 cups ) | 1/4 cup hot water
instructions: Open a can of banana sections, and scoop out the pulp with the tip of a large spoon or fork.

title: Quick Indian (Spear) Pepper Mix
ingredients: 3 green cardamom pods, crushed | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne
instructions: If desired, mix the cayenne pepper into the crushed green cardamom pods before serving.

title: Togar (Garlicky Dip)
ingredients: 3/4 cup plain yogurt ( preferably greek style ) | 1/2 cup ground pepper | 1/2 cup green bell pepper or 1/2 cup red bell pepper
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small bowl. Serve immediately with pita bread or toasted pita chips.

title: Spinach Pudding
ingredients: 10 ounces frozen chopped spinach, thawed | 2 fluid ounces whipping cream | 2 -3 firm ripe peaches | 1 cup chopped fresh fruit
instructions: In a buttered casserole dish, combine spinach, cream, peaches and fresh fruit. Cover and bake at 300 for 30 minutes or until heated through.

title: Vegetable Empanadas
ingredients: 4 ounces dried fruit ( any dried vegetable can be used ) | 1 medium tart apple, diced ( or 1 cup dried sweet potato, or 1 cup dried apple chunks ) | 1/2 cup diced frozen vegetables ( like broccoli or cauliflower ) | 3 tablespoons sweet chili paste ( such as ketchup or tabasco ) | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 1 teaspoon sugar | 4 ounces crescent rolls
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Place all the dry ingredients in large bowl and mix well. Add the dry ingredients, except for the crescents, to the fruit mixture and stir to combine. If the mixture seems dry, add water, only enough to cover. Turn dough out onto lightly floured surface and knead until smooth, about 4 minutes. Divide dough into eight pieces. Divide dough into eight equal protion portions and roll each one into a rope about 5 inches in diameter. Twist ropes and twist more or less often. Repeat with remaining dough, placing an empanada on a lightly floured baking sheet. Place on top of the baking sheet and bake for about 20 minutes, or until dough has puffed up and turned slightly golden brown. Allow to cool slightly before filling with the fruit/sugar filling.

Random Ingredients: self rising flour,cardamom seed,green bean,cornflour,pita bread,dill weed
title: Vegan Tikkarni
ingredients: 1 cup shredded green beans | 2 teaspoons cornflour | 1 teaspoon dill weed | 1 teaspoon green cardamom seeds | 1 teaspoon self-rising flour | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom seed | 3 breaded pita bread
instructions: Drain the cooked beans in a strainer. Combine the beans in a bowl with the cornflour, dill, cardamom and salt. Toss together until well combined and add the mix to the pita bread, making sure that the entire mixture is coated. Spray a large non stick frying pan with oil, or grease the pan. Place the mixture into the pan and fry until golden but crisp. Serve warm.

title: Potatoes With Powdered Fingerling
ingredients: 6 large fingerling potatoes | 2 cups good quality white peppercorns | 1 1/2 teaspoons nutmeg, grated | 2 teaspoons red wine vinegar
instructions: Boil the fingerling potatoes until just tender with plenty of simmering water. Drain well and transfer to large, clean pot. Add peppercorns to potatoes and bring to the boil over high heat. Add all remaining ingredients and reduce heat to simmer, covered, for about 10 minutes.

title: Easter Chicken Crescent Rolls
ingredients: 2 cans refrigerated crescent dinner rolls | 1 cup sour cream
instructions: Unroll each can of 2 cans of crescent dough onto a lightly floured surface. Using a rolling pin, or a rolling pin, roll each can of dough out onto a lightly floured surface into a rectangle about 1/8 inch thick. Spread sour cream evenly over each crescent roll. Using fingers, fold the crescent dough over the sour cream to form a crescent shape and seal the seam by pressing the seams together. Repeat process with remaining cans of dough and sour cream. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place the crescent rolls onto a lightly greased cookie sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until golden brown, about 15 minutes.

title: White White Wine Mousse
ingredients: 1/2 cup white wine | 1 1/2 cups shredded colby-monterey jack cheese
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix together 1/2 cup white wine and 3/4 cup shredded cheese.

title: Tuscan Noodles
ingredients: 1 package whole wheat spaghetti | 24 fresh basil leaves | 1 red bell pepper, cut into 1/2 inch pieces
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook noodles in boiling water, stirring occasionally until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 11 minutes. Drain. Toss spaghetti with fresh basil leaves, drained bell pepper, and red bell pepper in a bowl.

title: Tahini Fish Salad
ingredients: 350 g fish fillets, fillets, cut into chunks | 125 g unsalted cashew nuts | 1 cup golden raisin | 250 ml tahini | 1 tablespoon cider vinegar | 2 tablespoons cucumbers, peeled, grated | 1 tablespoon cider vinegar
instructions: Pour boiling water over the cashews and raisins and let sit for 10 minutes. Drain and toss in the tahini, vinegar and cucumber.

Random Ingredients: chicken stock cube,ramen noodle,canola oil,prosciutto,self raising flour
title: Prosciutto & Ramen Noodles Yummo!
ingredients: 10 slices prosciutto | 1 chicken stock cube | 2 1/2 cups self raising flour | 1 cup canola oil | 8 ounces ramen noodles
instructions: Place the prosciutto on a baking tray and flatten with the back of a ladle to approximately 1/4 inch thick. Cut the chicken stock cube from the pack. Place the flour and seasoning into a bowl and stir. In a separate pan, melt the canola oil until bubbles, then add the ramen noodles and fry until tender. Add the ramen noddles to the bowl of flour mixture and stir until combined. Turn off the heat and add the canola oil to your saucepan. Drain the noodles. Place noodles onto a plate and pour warm noodles on top.

Random Ingredients: cooking oatmeal,butter,white hominy,red wine vinegar,apple cider vinegar,dipping sauce,sherry
title: Hominy with Apples and Oats
ingredients: cooking oats | 2 cups chopped apples | 1/4 cup red wine vinegar | 1/4 cup white hominy | 1 tablespoon sherry | 1 tablespoon cider vinegar | 1 tablespoon melted butter | 1/2 teaspoon salt
instructions: Cook the quick oats according to package directions with about 2 tablespoons hot water. Drain and then drain again. Combine all ingredients in large casserole dish. Cook in 375F oven for about 1 hour. Serve with sour cream and chopped fresh cilantro.

Random Ingredients: beef tenderloin,chicken bouillon cube,breadcrumb,beef chuck,ginger garlic paste
title: Beef Cutlets With Ginger Crumbs
ingredients: 2 lbs beef tenderloin, cut in 3/4 in cubes | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 1/2 inch ginger-garlic paste | 1 cup dry breadcrumbs | 1 egg | 2 teaspoons ginger-garlic paste
instructions: Combine bread crumbs with ginger garlic paste and egg. Add beef and any leftover mixture and mix well. Place in a baking dish and marinate in refrigerator for 1/2 hour. Cook meat on hot grill or medium oven setting. Serve with vegetables.

title: French Bread
ingredients: 1 loaf brioche bread, cut into 2 x 1/2 inch pieces ( or other day-old bread of your choice ) | garlic powder, to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees. Place bread pieces in a large baking pan, and sprinkle bread with garlic powder. Pour enough water into pan to come halfway up the side of the bread. Cover pan tightly with parchment paper or aluminum foil. Bake until bread is soft, 45 minutes to 1 hour. Allow bread to cool before serving or storing in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: thyme sprig,beef bouillon,white flour,chicken breast half,fennel,yellow pepper,sugar
title: Bergie's Chicken Fingers
ingredients: 6 boneless chicken breast halves | 1 teaspoon beef bouillon | 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme sprig | 1/2 teaspoon fennel | 1/3 cup yellow pepper, diced | 3 tablespoons raw sugar | 3 tablespoons unbleached white flour
instructions: Wash, cut, and pat dry the chicken breast halves. Cut strips into 1/4 inch wide strips or smaller and place in a shallow non metallic dish. Sprinkle with bouillon, thyme, black pepper, white sugar, and flour. Marinate for 1 hour. Place remaining 1/4 cup cold water in a frying pan to a depth of 1/4 inch and place over medium high heat. Add the meat and marinate for 4 minutes, or until no longer pink. Serve with couscous, rice, or noodles.

Random Ingredients: button mushroom,dark soy sauce,mustard seed,jalapeno chile,baguette
title: Soy Sauce Crostini
ingredients: 5 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 1 tablespoon pickled jalapeno chile, thinly sliced | 1 tablespoon rice-wine mustard seeds | 24 button mushrooms, sliced | 1 baguette, cut into large cubes, toasted
instructions: Whisk together soy sauce, jalepeno chili, and mustard seed in a bowl. Place mushrooms in a dry nonstick pan, and sear on both sides. Remove mushrooms, and set aside. Arrange toast on a serving plate, and top with mushrooms.

Random Ingredients: green chili pepper,yellow onion,cucumber,guinness stout,vegan butter
title: Kathy's Green Chile, Mexican Cucumber, and Guinness
ingredients: 1/2 large cucumber, chopped | 1/2 small yellow onion, chopped | 2 fresh green chili peppers, chopped ( i use jalapeno ) | 1/3 cup vegan butter | 1 can guinness stout
instructions: In a medium size bowl, toss together the cucumber, onion, green chili peppers, and vegan butter. Pour in the guinness, taste and adjust seasonings.

title: Welsh Barbecue Dry Rub
ingredients: 3 3/4 tablespoons dried marjoram or 3 3/4 tablespoons chopped fresh marjoram | 1 tablespoon dark brown sugar | 1/4 cup lard
instructions: Combine ingredients. Store away from direct sunlight. This recipe makes about 10 1/4 oz. Rubs for about 2 meats and poultry. Keeps for up to 3 months, refrigerated up to 3 days, shaking the container from time to time to prevent drying out. If possible, prepare only the correct rub. This recipe can be tripled. Store in an airtight container in a cool, dry place.

Random Ingredients: vegetarian chicken broth,hamburger,velveeta mexican cheese,snow pea,pear,poblano chile
title: Sopa De Queso
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger | 1 cup vegetarian chicken broth ( from cooked chicken thighs ) | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil or 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | sliced poblano chile, canned red onion ( for garnish ) or cilantro leaf ( for garnish ) | 1 cup uncooked snow peas | 2 ounces velveeta mexican cheese ( for garnish ) or 2 ounces other cheese ( for garnish )
instructions: Brown and drain hamburger in a skillet over medium high heat. Remove hamburger and drain fat from skillet. Return skillet to stove, add broth and cook, covered, for 10 minutes. Stir in poblano chile, onions and cooked chicken or turkey meat and heat till hot. Sprinkle cheese or vegetable cheese over mixture with salt and pepper and add peas and stir till cheese just melts. Serve with corn tostada, or serve as directed in recipe#195210, adding a touch of sour cream, salsa, or other desired toppings before filling.

title: Marinara Mushroom Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 cup marinara sauce | 1 package white mushrooms, halved
instructions: In a skillet, bring marinara sauce to a boil, stirring frequently. Spray a large glass saucepan with cooking spray.

title: Cream Cheese Pie Crust
ingredients: 1 can refrigerated pie crust | 1 package cream cheese | 2 tablespoons dry sherry
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees f. Press a pie crust into a 9 inch pie plate. Beat the cream cheese and dry sherry together in a bowl over medium heat until smooth. Pour cream cheese mixture in the pie crust and bake for 30 to 40 minutes in the preheated oven, until the top is golden brown and filling is bubbling. Let cool for 20 minutes.

title: Fenugreek Potatoes
ingredients: 3 russet potatoes, peeled, cut in 1/2 inch squares | 1 package fenugreek seeds | 1 package egg roll wraps
instructions: Place potato squares on a baking sheet lined with parchment. Bake at 425 degrees for 20 minutes or until tender. Turn over. Let cool slightly. Drain. Combine fenugreek and egg roll wrappers in a food processor. Process until the mixture is crumbly.

title: Yummy Mexican Pizza Fundido
ingredients: 2 tablespoons mozzarella cheese, shredded | 2 tablespoons manchego cheese, shredded ( or your favorite mexican cheese )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Line a pizza stone or baking sheet with foil, or lightly flour your hands. Combine all the ingredients except the olive oil and pour it into the shell of your pizza machine. Bake for 15 minutes. Remove from the oven and cool to room temperature. Add more cheese if desired. Cut into slices, and serve with more shredded cheese on top or on the side.

title: Quick Ravioli With Oranges
ingredients: 36 frozen beef ravioli | 1/2 cup orange zest
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to boil. Meanwhile, in a large bowl, place frozen ravioli. Place the zest onto a microwave safe plate and heat in the microwave on high, stirring occasionally until the zest forms a fine dark orange peel. About 5 - 7 minute check the zest for doneness. Meanwhile, place a skillet over medium heat. When it's hot add the remaining zest and orange zest. Stir fry the zest over medium heat just long enough to slightly toast it, not blacken it. When the zest is just a bit darker in color but still slightly crisp in the center, pour in the orange zest. Drain the ravioli and place them onto plates. Spoon 1/4 of the orange zest over the top of the ravioli and serve immediately.

title: Vietnamese Eggplant
ingredients: 1 eggplant | 3 packets vanilla instant pudding ( like sure-cook or cool whip ) | 2 teaspoons rice wine vinegar ( or red vinegar )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Slice eggplant lengthwise. Cut into 1/4 slices. Mix vinegar and rice wine vinegar and spread on eggplant slices. Sprinkle top of eggplant slices with this mixture.

title: Hungarian Green Beans
ingredients: 1 lb fresh green beans, trimmed | 1 1/2 teaspoons sweet hungarian paprika | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt
instructions: Cook beans uncovered in a large pot of boiling water for 4 minutes or just until crisp tender.

title: Turmeric Hazelnut
ingredients: 2 -3 medium celery ribs | 2 teaspoons turmeric powder | 2 tablespoons sweet paprika | 3 cups hazelnuts
instructions: Pre heat oven to 325 degrees f. Line a medium size baking dish with foil, and lightly oil it. Place the celery in the microwave oven. When it is done, remove it and set out the vegetables to cool. Remove the outer layer of celery from the microwave on the stove. Cut the celery into 1 inch pieces.. Mix the turmeric, paprika and 1/2 cup water in a bowl. Spread the turmeric spice mixture over the cooled pieces of olive. Spread the hazelnuts evenly on the top. Add the remaining tablespoon of water, and cover the dish. Place in oven for 1 hour. Remove from oven, and spread the remaining 1/2 cup water on the outside. Leave to sit for 5 minutes, then cut.

title: Tofu Panini
ingredients: 1/2 lb extra firm tofu | 1/4 cup pizza sauce | 1 lb napa cabbage
instructions: Cut tofu into 4 squares. Cover with pizza sauce and cabbage.

Random Ingredients: raspberry,currant,active yeast,chive,caraway seed,cornflour,grain white rice,brown sugar
title: Raspberry and Chive Baked Dinner Rolls With Raspberries, Caraway & Currants
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups seedless raisins or 2 1/2 cups currants, about 5 handfuls | 2 tablespoons fresh chives, chopped | 1 tablespoon cornflour | 1/4 teaspoon caraway seed | 1/4 teaspoon active dry yeast, dissolved in | 1 tablespoon water | 1 tablespoon brown sugar | 1 1/2 1 1/2 cups cooked long-grain white rice or 1 1/2 cups wild rice
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Heat raisins, chives, cornflour, caraway and yeast in water until thickened and bubbly. Add sugar and rice, stirring well. Spread cooked rice onto baking tray in a thin layer. Cover loosely and set aside to warm to 120f for 30 minutes or until slightly foamy. Roll 2/3s. Of mixture along each long side. Place in baking dish, leaving a 1/2 inch border over the top. Cover tightly and bake at 120 f for 30 minutes or until bubbly.

Random Ingredients: chili pepper flake,pita bread,plain flour,brussels sprout
title: Pita Chips
ingredients: 4 large plain flour biscuits | 1/4 teaspoon dried chili pepper flakes | 4 brussels sprouts | pita bread
instructions: Preheat the grill/broiler. Dust a board with flour and roll the biscuits out to about 1/4 inch thick. Place the sprouts in a single layer on a lightly oiled baking sheet. Brush with water and sprinkle with chili flakes. Place under the grill or broiler for 8 - 10 minutes. Turn over.

Random Ingredients: button mushroom,cream cheese,tarragon,lasagna noodle,honey,season italian dressing,cocoa powder
title: Hot N' Sour Mushroom Rollatini
ingredients: 12 ounces lasagna noodles, cooked but not overcooked | 1 package cream cheese | 1 package mushrooms, sliced | 1 package button mushrooms, sliced ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon tarragon, fresh and chopped ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon honey | 1 tablespoon unsweetened cocoa powder | additional tarragon, for garnish
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f. Using a food processor or electric mixer, blend the cream cheese until creamy smooth. Set aside. Spray a large pot with nonstick cooking spray. Add all ingredients to the pot. Place mixture into a 9x13 inch casserole dish. Sprinkle additional tarragon over the top. Bake. Cover with foil if nessecary if preferred.

title: Sausages (Stuffed Sausages)
ingredients: 3 slices good quality pork ( from a roast pork loin ) | 6 thick slices of ripe portuguese banana ( the kind you get sliced into 6 long segments ) | 1 -2 teaspoon sweet passion fruit ( optional ) | 3 -5 tablespoons cashew nuts ( optional )
instructions: First combine the cashew nuts and passion fruit in a bowl, and mix. Next wrap each sausage with a slice of sausgeat on each skewer so that it is tightly closed, and use toothpicks or clean utensils to prevent sticking. Grill the sausages, turning, about 6 minutes, until nicely browned and no longer pink inside. Serve immediately.

title: Easy Book Club Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 2 cups cooked rice | lettuce leaf
instructions: Put rice in a bowl. Slice lettuce leaves diagonally. Lay a piece of lettuce in the center of a wrap. Spread a small amount of rice on the lettuce. Fold the lettuce in half and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: grand marnier,pasta,chicken stock,romaine lettuce heart,queso fresco,white balsamic vinegar,white sugar
title: Pasta with Queso Fresco
ingredients: 1 cup chicken stock | 1/3 cup white balsamic vinegar | 1/4 cup white sugar | 1/2 cup dry pasta | cracked white balsamic vinegar, for brushing | cracked white balsamic vinegar, for brushing | 1 whole head romaine lettuce hearts | 6 ounces queso fresco, crumbled
instructions: Place chicken stock, white balsamic vinegar, and sugar in a small saucepan over medium heat. Bring liquid to a boil and remove from heat. Simmer to reduce heat to 1 tablespoon. Let mixture rest 15 minutes. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook pasta in boiling water until cooked through but firm to the bite, stirring occasionally, about 11 minutes.

Random Ingredients: steak,puff pastry,curry leaf,cold water,ginger garlic paste,bell pepper,pumpkin puree
title: Upside Down Pot Sticker Indian
ingredients: 1 lb round steak, sliced super thin ( for stew ) | 1 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 2 fresh curry leaves ( green or red ) | 1 fresh bell pepper, finely diced | 2 tablespoons pumpkin puree | 1 cup cold water | 1 sheet frozen puff pastry, defrosted
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. Dry beef with paper towel, if using beef, and season with salt and pepper if desired. In a large skillet over medium heat, saute beef in ginger garlic paste until cooked through, and the oil is no longer pink. Remove to a plate and discard ginger garlic paste. Stir in the curry leaves, bell pepper and pumpkin puree. Add cold water. Return meat and vegetables to skillet. Spread half of puff pastry sheet on baking sheet to form a rectangle. Spread with meat mixture and top with remaining pastry. Bake in oven for 20 minutes, or until dough is puffed and golden.

title: Noodle Salad
ingredients: 5 slices avocado ( approx 1 package ) | 3 ounces prepared mustard | 3 ounces mushrooms | 1/2 medium onion, finely chopped | 1 1/2 cups egg noodles, cooked and drained | 3 tablespoons white flour ( approx to thicken )
instructions: Mash the avocado with the prepared mustard and finely chopped mushrooms. Mix the noodles with the onion and then spoon over the sauce. Mix well and serve immediately.

title: Kabali (Zucchini Soup)
ingredients: 1 can beef consomme | 1 medium zucchini, sliced | 1 can sliced black olives | 1 1/2 cups greek yogurt ( plain or lite )
instructions: In a sauce pan, put consume and heat on low. After 5 minutes on medium heat, add zucchini, olives and cook for 20 minutes. Serve in soup tureen with greek yoghurt.

Random Ingredients: brown sugar,button mushroom,green grape,el fajita seasoning mix
title: Tasty  Beef   Burgers
ingredients: 2 lbs lean ground beef | 1 package old el paso fajita seasoning mix | 1 pint green grape, halved | 1 package la famiglia button mushrooms, sliced
instructions: Combine ground beef, fajita seasoning and grapes. Chill for 2 hours or at least overnight. Form into 8 patties about 2 1/2 inches thick. Grill over medium hot coals for 15 - 20 minutes per side or until desired doneness.

title: Chinese Style Barbecue Carrots
ingredients: 1 can chickpea flour ( besan ) | 15 baby carrots | 3 tablespoons catsup | chickpea flour ( for dredging ) | 1 cup ice cube ( or more )
instructions: Drain chickpea flour and carrots, discard the carrots. Rinse and drain the chickpea flour again reserving the flour. Heat some oil in a saute pan over medium high heat until smoke rises. Combine the reserved flour and water in a deep bowl. Stir in 1 cup of ice cubes until well mixed, then add the flour mixture and stir. When the carrots are coated with flour, add the carrots and stir to coat the carrots with the flour. When the carrots are fully coated with flour, add the chickpea flour and stir to combine. Let stand for 30 seconds. Tip, if you are using only the 3tb of flour and 3tb of chickpea flour use only 3tb of cold water or the amount of cornstarch used per the flour and water. Add more flour so as to thicken the sauce. Serve with rice or pasta.

title: Grilled Caribbean Ribs Pasta
ingredients: 1 fresh pork rib, about 1 pound total | 1 lb penne pasta, cooked according to pkg directions | 1 large avocado, cut into slices | 1 teaspoon ground cumin powder | 1/3 cup dark rum or 1/3 cup whiskey
instructions: Trim excess fat from ribs and cut into thirds.

title: Caribbean Concoction
ingredients: 1 package macaroni | 1/4 cup red wine | 2 tablespoons banana liqueur | 1 teaspoon cumin | 1/2 cup coconut rum | 1 large head cabbage, cored and cut into wedges 3/4 of the way to the head | 1/4 cup chopped fresh chervil, or to taste | 1/4 cup salsa, or to taste
instructions: Cook the macaroni in a large pot of boiling water until just tender.

title: Baked Spicy Crabmeat
ingredients: 1/2 medium onion ( finely diced ) | 1/4 cup fresh picked crabmeat ( picked a small amount ) | 1 packet onion and mushroom soup mix
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. In a small pan mix all ingredients together and pour into greased casserole,. Bake for 15 minutes. Then remove from casserole and serve hot with jasmine rice.

title: Soupe De Provence (Meat and Quinces in Sauce)
ingredients: 3 lbs sweet meat, firm, with some of the fat left on them | 1 bottle dry italian parsley, in large pieces | 3 tablespoons fresh ground black pepper ( to taste ) | 3 tablespoons coarsely chopped fresh italian parsley ( with stems, if you dont have them ) | 1 bay leaf
instructions: The day before using, in a heavy fry pan, dry the meat with just enough of the fat from the meat to cover generously. You will have to do this in batches, as the meat browns fast, so be sure to regulate the fat from time to time. Remove the meat carefully to a casserole. Cover lightly in the remaining fat from the meat and pour in the juice, the parsley, pepper and the bay leaf. Cover tightly and bake at 350 degrees f. For 1¼ hrs or until the meat very tender and the sauce dark and thick. Do not overcook, or the fruit will be mushy and tough. Serve at once.

title: Queso Blanco Spread
ingredients: 1/2 cup queso blanco | 1/2 cup pecans or 1/2 cup almond | 1 -2 tablespoon capers
instructions: Combine all ingredients in food processor or blender and process until smooth. Transfer to a bowl, cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate several hours. Best if refrigerated a day or two before serving.

title: Apricot and Rye Shortbread Cookies (Abm)
ingredients: 2 cups rye flour | 1 tablespoon apricot jam
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f or 180°c. Cream the apricot and grainy jam together until it forms large clumps. Fold in the rye flour. Knead on a floured surface and shape into a log. Use your hand to press the dough up the sides of the log. Wrap log tightly in waxed paper allowing excess to escape. Place in fridge. When you are ready to bake, place on a greased baking sheet and prick with a fork. Cook for 15 - 20 min until crust is light golden. Transfer to a wire rack and spread with melted butter. Cool completely. Break in half or toasted. You may also roll half at a time like above.

title: French Vanilla Pesto
ingredients: 1 jar pesto sauce | 2 tablespoons maple syrup | 1/4 cup white wine vinegar | 2 teaspoons maple syrup, or as needed
instructions: Toss pesto sauce with maple syrup and 1/4 cup white wine vinegar in a bowl.

title: Brussels Endive
ingredients: 1/2 lb belgian endive, washed and trimmed | 2 1/2 lbs boiling anchovies, drained, peeled, coarsely chopped
instructions: Cut endive into 3 wedges.

Random Ingredients: cooking tapioca,catalina salad dressing,beef stock,turmeric powder,italian sausage,bread flour,pecorino romano cheese
title: Tailor's Italian Sausage, Tomato, & Pear Clafouti
ingredients: 2 lbs italian sausages ( cut into 1- inch chunks ) | 3/4 cup quick-cooking tapioca | 1 1/4 cups beef stock | 1/2 cup catalina salad dressing | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1 teaspoon quick-cooking tapioca | 2 tablespoons grated pecorino romano cheese | 1/4 cup bread flour, plus | more bread flour, if necessary

instructions: Arrange cabbage rolls in a 9 x 13 inch baking dish. Mix soup, brown rice and cider or sugar in a bowl until well blended. title: Mexican Breaded Stuffed Poblano Peppers

instructions: Preheat oven to 425f. Spray 9 x 9 inch square baking dish with non stick cooking spray. title: Italian Appetizer - Aka Rigatoni Salad (Copy Cat Recipe)
ingredients: 2 heads romaine lettuce ( romaine is the best for this recipe ) | 1 cup pasta sauce ( any classico traditional recipe would be fine. you can also use a homemade one if desired )
instructions: Place romaine in to a strainer and rinse thoroughly with cool water. Remove leaves and cut into bite sized bits.. Line a medium sized bowl with lettuce. instructions: Cover potatoes with water.

instructions: Spray a large nonstick skillet with cooking spray and heat over medium high heat. Add the pork and cook, stirring about 3 minutes. Add the chili powder and cook about 3 minutes. title: Paneer-Style Bread Salad

instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Place the bread on the baking sheet and cut a circle out of it to form a hollow loaf shape. Place the hollow bread on the top. Mix the cream cheese, vinegar, and mirin together in a small bowl. Layer the torn bread with cream cheese mixture. Bake bread in the preheated oven until toasted, about 15 minutes.

instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f combine first 3 ingredients in a bowl and mix well. Place whipping cream in a shallow dish and drizzle mixture over whipped cream. title: Mashed Lentil Fritters

instructions: Put lentils into heatproof bowl and cover with boiling water.

instructions: Heat grill. Put ham, bell pepper rings, and jalapenos in a large skillet. Lightly spray grill with pam. instructions: Heat the chili oil in a large frying pan. Add prawns and fry until pink and just cooked. Add 1/2c water, beans and coriander. Heat through stirring often, and season to taste.

instructions: Slice the cheese into 1/4 inch cubes. Combine all ingredients. Sprinkle with freshly ground black pepper. Place cubes on a parchment paper lined cookie sheet. Bake at 400 degrees fahrenheit for 15 minutes. Remove to a rack to cool slightly.

instructions: Combine all ingredients into a bowl and mix well. Serve at room temp.

title: Beef Tenderloin With Garlic and Corned-Up Chicory

instructions: Preheat the oven to 220c/425°f. Wash the beef under cold water to remove the excess juice. Cut the tenderloin into 2, 5cm slices. Arrange the slices on a rack in a roasting pan. Remove the foil and bake until the tenderloin is golden brown, about 30 minutes longer. Scatter the egg around the tenderloin and serve.

title: Italian Pasta With Lentils

instructions: Combine cooked lentils and 1 3/4 cup of the alfredo pasta sauce in a slow cooker. Stir in dried fruit or berries. Cover and cook on high for 3 hours.

instructions: Dissolve half the bouillon in 1 cup boiling water. Melt margarine in a small saucepan over medium low heat. Pour rosewater over margarine. Cook 30 seconds, then stir. Garnish with lemon verbena leaves and additional lemon verbena leaves.

ingredients: 1 can tomato sauce | 3 ounces green olives or 3 ounces kalamata olive, sliced thin | 1 tablespoon shrimp paste, paste | 1 tablespoon chili paste, chili paste with seeds ( sriracha as per spice packet, found in indian stores ) | 1 teaspoon ground cumin ( optional )
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together in a sauce pan, bring to a boil, simmer for a couple of minutes, then set aside to cool slightly. title: Quick Sun Dried Tomato Dressing
ingredients: 8 dried sun-dried tomatoes | 1 tablespoon rice vinegar
instructions: Slice the sun dried tomatoes into rings and toss them in a little rice vinegar. Let them steep for 20 minutes to release some of the oil. Chill them before serving.

title: Cucumber Frito's
ingredients: 4 medium cucumbers | 1/4 cup cornflour | 2 tablespoons flour | 1 garlic ( large or small ) | 1 chicken stock cube, dissolved in | 1 cup chicken stock or 1 cup water | 2 tablespoons breadcrumbs | 4 tablespoons fresh orange juice | white pepper
instructions: Skin the cucumbers with a peeler and cut them in half lengthwise. Separate the layers. If they are large, cut them into cubes about the size of your cucumbers, but not too small. If they are small, cut them a quarter inch thick. Put the cornflour in a small bowl, and then add the cucumber pieces. Mix the garlic in with the cucumbers. Pour the dissolved stock into the bowl, making sure it covers the cubes. Add salt and freshly ground pepper. Dissolve the chicken stock and dissolve the maggi cube in it. Dip the cucumbers and garlic mixture into the chicken, coating evenly. Heat a frying pan on high. Put the coated cucumbers into the pan. Cover the frying pan, and let the fritters bubble over. When the fritters are brown on the bottom, flip them over. Take the frying pan off the heat. Put the breadcrumbs and orange juice in a bowl. Mix with a fork. Sprinkle on the fritters. Sprinkle top with breadcrumbs and orange juice. Put in a hot oven and serve.

title: Almond Sauce

instructions: Combine all ingredients in a blender and process until a smooth paste is formed. Cool.

instructions: Peel, slice and chop all the ingredients into small pieces, then place in a serving bowl. Add chopped boiled egg and sprinkle with curry leaves. Serve at once.

instructions: Cut the onions into half then slice lengthwise thinly. Coat bottom of crock pot with nonfat cooking spray. Place sliced onions in crock pot, sprinkle with worcestershire, stir.

instructions: Place all ingredients in a glass casserole dish. Microwave on high power about 1 minute to 1 minute and stir, cooking from time to time. instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients.

title: Chilli Nuts

instructions: Put water on to boil to prepare nuts. Cut chilies in half lengthwise and slit lengthwise. Scoop out seeds and stringy parts of the chillies. Poke macaroons with a fork in a criss cross pattern and steam in microwave on high for 3 minutes. Garnish with sprigs of celtic. Serve hot.

title: Agua De Almendras (Almond Soup)

instructions: Mix everything together. Add enough water to cover everything. Simmer until water boils. Strain if desired.

instructions: Combine bread cubes with crumbs and rum and place bread in flat bottom fry pan or heavy duty plastic food storage bag. Heat to a boil.

title: Beef Samosas -- With Turkey or Chicken
ingredients: 500 g stewing beef, cubed | 200 g turkey or 200 g chicken, cubed | 1/3 cup parmesan romano cheese or 1/3 cup romano cheese, grated | 1/2 cup coriander or 1/2 cup chopped coriander | 1 teaspoon black sesame seed, toasted | 1 teaspoon curry paste | 12 toothpicks | 1 butternut squash ( peeled, seeds removed and peeled ) or 5 pumpkin seeds, patties
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c / 400°f. Wash and pat out the excess fat from the cubed stew beef or chicken. Combine with all the ingredients except the toothpicks, pumpkin or sesame seeds and mix well. Lay the toothpicks on a tray or large baking dish and cover with parchment paper, baking tray or foil and spray with cooking spray oil. Bake for about half an hour. Toast the sesame seeds and curry paste in a pan until fragrant. Spread the sesame seeds on foil or baking tray. Remove the sesame seeds from the oven and allow to cool. If you don't have to deseed the pumpkin/nut add a pinch of ground roasted sesame seeds at the end, along with any seeds left on the tray. If using chicken or other meat and poultry the flavours are to be adjusted. The meat and sesame is delicious served with boiled potatoes or rice.

title: Santa Fe Beef Brisket
ingredients: 1 lb center-cut beef brisket, scored | 1/2 cup adobo seasoning, mccormick montreal brand steak seasoning | 1 cup maple syrup, use honey preferred ( or more ) | 1 package cream cheese, room temperature | 1 cup cilantro, chopped coarsely | 8 cremini mushrooms, quartered and sliced ( about 2 cups ) | 1/2 jar bacon bits, chopped | garlic powder or chili powder ( to taste )
instructions: In small bowl, combine steak seasoning with maple syrup and let stand at room temperature for 15 minutes. In an ungreased 12 x 8 baking dish, toss beef with 1/2 cup jerk seasoning. Arrange half of bacon bits evenly around meat. Spread half of mushrooms over bacon bits. Dot with 3 tablespoons bacon fat and half of cream cheese. Repeat layering until pan is 3 rows on top. Top with remaining mushrooms. Drizzle with remaining 1/2 cup jerk seasoning. Cover tightly and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or up to 4 hours. When ready to serve, preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Remove beef from marinade and place on rack in baking dish. Brush with remaining 1/2 cup of jerk seasoning. Sprinkle with garlic powder or chili powder. Bake uncovered 12 to 15 minutes or until no longer pink in the center. Slice and serve with rice.

title: Peanut Sauce Fingers-Topped Sandwiches
ingredients: 8 slices breadcrumbs | 2 tablespoons chunky peanut butter | 4 tablespoons fresh breadcrumbs | 2 tablespoons cooking oil | 4 tablespoons low-fat chutney | 1 tablespoon apple juice | 2 teaspoons mustard | 1 tablespoon rocket ( rocket )
instructions: If you use a bread machine, press the breadcrumbs, peanut butter and 2 tablespoons breadcrumbs into each of four well greased sandwich trays. Brush each tray generously with the oil. Preheat the oven to 220ºc/425ºf/gas mark 8 and leave all the wet breadcrumb mixture to one side. Using one tray at a time, carefully cut 2 slices of bread into a rectangle and arrange these slices in to the sandwich tray. Brush the top of the breadcrumb mixture with the oil. Using your thumb or a knife, make a small indentation in the breadcrumb mixture, being careful not to cut through the filling. Push the left side of the breadcrumb hole through each sandwich to spread out the mixture. Brush the breadcrumb mixture lightly with the oil and sprinkle the breadcrumbs in between each sandwich. Place in a preheated oven and roast for 15 - 20 minutes, or until golden and soft. For the chutney sauce, blend the apple juice and mustard in a small saucepan for 2 - 3 minutes. Stir in 2 teaspoons hot water. Remove from the heat and stir through the rocket leaves. Serve with breadcrumbs fingers.

title: Chinese Grilled Vegetables
ingredients: 1 tablespoon ground cumin | 1 tablespoon dried tarragon | 1 can sliced bamboo shoots
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together the cumin, tarragon and bamboo shoots. Place vegetables on a large plate and sprinkle with the spice mixture.

title: Garden Almond Cilantro Spread
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh cilantro | 1 bunch fresh celery | 1 teaspoon almond extract | 2 tablespoons chopped toasted almonds
instructions: In a blender, combine the cilantro, celery, almond extract, and almonds. Blend until smooth.

title: Cardamom Melon and Pepper Salad
ingredients: 1 large yellow pepper, thinly sliced | 6 seedless cantaloupe, sliced | 10 tablespoons ground cardamom
instructions: In a large salad bowl, combine yellow pepper, cantaloupe, and cardamom. Drizzle in olive oil.

title: Paneer Cheese Spread
ingredients: 120 g puree paneer, without rind | 150 g sugar | 25 ml triple sec | 4 teaspoons vinegar
instructions: If there is more than two pices of paneer, break it into smaller pieces. If there is less you want 2 smaller pices of cheese, place the remainder into a processor. Place paneer in processor and combine. Add sugar and triple sec and process till combined. Add vinegar and purée into an airtight container or use your hand to mix and force the cheese through the sieve. The more pices of paneer that float in your blades, the smoother it will be. If you like, you can spread the spread a little bit at a time over your favorite fruit/cake, or use a spoon to spread into a puddle to make patties/cakes.

instructions: To make these sandwiches, place beef chunks and pita bread pieces in baking dishes or loaf pans with a lid. ingredients: 250 g fresh spinach leaves | 500 g corn ( frozen or fresh, defrosted and squeezed ) | 500 g nonfat sour cream | 250 g caster sugar ( to taste ) | 4 slices bacon ( optional )
instructions: Heat oven to 200c and position rack in centre of oven. Line a medium roasting tin with baking paper and leave to stand in a warm place. Spoon into prepared pan and spread evenly. Return to oven and bake for 20 - 25 minutes, or until thick. Cool, then cut into wedges.

instructions: In a bowl combine the crushed tomatoes with the raisins, baking powder and italian seasoning. Mix well. Turn crust into greased loaf pan. Bake at 350 degrees f for 1 hour and 15 minutes or until a crusty top is golden brown.

instructions: Mix curry paste, vinegar, and ice to make marinade. Pour over meat, turning meat to coat. Cover and let marinate in fridge for 2 hours. Drain meat, discard marinade and cook in skillet as directed. Serve on lettuce.
