Random Ingredients: celery salt,baking potato,tabasco sauce,courgette,chicken broth,salmon,alfredo sauce
title: Smoked Salmon & Potato Bake
ingredients: 4 large peeled baking potatoes | 1 tablespoon celery salt | 1 teaspoon smoked tabasco sauce | 1/2 tablespoon baking potato water | 1 packet alfredo sauce | 1 1/2 cups chicken broth | 4 skinned boneless skinless salmon
instructions: Place potato on an oiled baking sheet and drizzle with just enough olive oil to lightly coat. Bake at 400f degrees for about 40 minutes or until soft. Mix celery with tabasco sauce, baking potato water, alfredo sauce and chicken broth in a pan to make it creamy. Cut top off salmon and remove the skin leaving a 1/2 inch shell. Drain, saving the flesh and any juices. Reserve the liquid. Place salmon on top of potato, and top with potato. Place the shell on top of salmon and pour reserved potato water on top of everything. Bake on 350f degrees until salmon is cooked about 20 minutes.. Serve with your favourite sauce.

Random Ingredients: pepperoni,pecorino romano cheese,rump steak,onion soup mix,center pork chop
title: Italian Pork Sandwich - for One
ingredients: 2 center-cut pork chops, thick | 2 center-cut pork chops, thick | 8 slices pepperoni, cut in half | 1 packet dry onion soup mix | 1/4 cup finely grated pecorino romano cheese
instructions: Place both pork chops between two sheets of waxed paper and pound to a thickness of 1/4 inch and 1/4 inch. Lay 1 slice of pepperoni on each breast and 1 slice of pork on each breast. Using a meat pounder or mallet or rolling pin, pound each pound until somewhat thicker. Combine pepperoni, chicken strips or sliced deli ham or turkey, onion soup mix, and cheese in a small bowl. Spread mixture over both meats. Serve sandwiches hot.

title: Grilled Salmon with Olives and Italian Herbs
ingredients: 1 teaspoon italian seasoning | 1 pound salmon, skin removed | 4 pitted black olives, quartered | 12 green olives, quartered | 1/4 cup chopped fresh italian parsley
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together the seasoning blend and salt and pepper. Brush salmon with herb flavored oil. Place skin side down on a non aluminum grill lined with foil. Grill for 3 to 4 minutes per inch of thickness, or until flesh flakes easily with a fork. Turn salmon. Brush with oil once more. In a small bowl, combine sliced olives and chopped parsley. Sprinkle olives over salmon. Return salmon to the grill, skin side down.

Random Ingredients: heath candy bar,horseradish,cayenne,mustard seed,garlic,white wine vinegar,blue curacao,semolina
title: Spicy Butterhead Cheese
ingredients: 7 ounces semolina ( cracked wheat ) | 1 1/3 cups white wine vinegar | 1/4 cup dry mustard seeds | 2 cloves garlic, minced | 1 tablespoon horseradish | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne ( optional ) | 1 cup blue curacao | 1 cup heath candy bars, coarsely chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Place cracked wheat in a medium bowl and cover with several inches of hot water.

title: Feezy Hummus
ingredients: 1 can chick-peas, drained and rinsed | 1 container low-fat yogurt | 1 package fat free cream cheese
instructions: Place chickpeas in a blender or food processor and pulse until coarsely chopped and smooth. Combine chickpeas and yogurt in medium serving bowl.

title: Zucchini and Yogurt Salad
ingredients: 500 g zucchini, trimmed | 3 teaspoons baharat ( the spice mix ) | 1 red chili powder ( optional ) | 7/8 cup plain yogurt
instructions: Slice zucchini in thick diagonal slices. Place zucchini in a large bowl and stir through the baharat, chili powder and yoghurt. Season and serve.

title: Chile Powder
ingredients: 2 tablespoons crushed dried red chile | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves
instructions: Combine the dried chili, the dried oregano, and the crushed oregano. Store in an airtight glass jar.

Random Ingredients: corn oil,habanero chile pepper,hungarian paprika,flat leaf parsley,bell pepper,whipping cream,angel food cake
title: Habanero Dessert With Sweet Peppers
ingredients: 2 habanero chile peppers | 2 inches piece round sweet bell peppers or 2 inches yellow bell peppers, peeled and halved | 1 cup whipping cream | 1/3 cup corn oil | 1 3/4 teaspoons sweet hungarian paprika | 1/4 teaspoon hungarian paprika | 2 tablespoons chopped flat leaf parsley | angel food cake ( available at asian markets )
instructions: Cut tops off chiles to expose seeds and discard. Wash and remove seeds with a teaspoon or knife. Slit a slit down the side lengthwise and discard seeds. Using gloves, gently cut the peppers lengthwise into strips. Cut strips into 1 inch squares. Add a heavy frypan or large pan with about 2 inches of water to medium high heat. When water comes to a rolling boil, add chiles. Cook for about 5 minutes or until softened and skins swell. Drain, peel off skins, and slit peppers into strips. Transfer chiles to a bowl. Add whipping cream, corn oil, 1 1/2 teaspoons sweet and 1/3 teaspoons paprika. Mix. Transfer to 4 serving dishes. Sprinkle with parsley and remaining 1 teaspoon sweet and 1/3 teaspoons paprika. Chill for at least 1 hour or until serving time. When ready to serve, garnish plate with the reserved chile peppers and serve with angel food cake.

title: White Beans in Yogurt
ingredients: 1 lb white beans, dried | oil ( for frying ) | 1 cup greek yogurt
instructions: Soak the white beans overnight in cold water. Wash well, remove hard stalk ends, and cook them in a large pot of boiling water, covered, until they are tender, about 40 minutes. Drain. Heat oil in a large skillet. Drain the cooked beans, and mash them into the yogurt by hand, adding a little warm water to thin if necessary. Toss the white beans with the yogurt until well coated. Serve hot.

title: Greek Diced Cherry Tomatoes on Skewers
ingredients: 6 cherry tomatoes, quartered | 2 teaspoons lemon zest, grated | 1 tablespoon dried oregano
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium. Thread 4 cherry tomatoes, 2 tablespoons lemon zest, 1 tablespoon dried oregano and 1 - 2 teaspoons oregano onto each skewer. Arrange skewers on a rack set over a baking sheet. Grill tomatoes for about 45 minutes or until the cherry tomatoes have begun to give off their juice. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: margarine,green bean,italian seasoning,bouquet garni,pimento olive,cocoa powder,salt black pepper
title: Green Beans With Olives
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs fresh green beans, trimmed and snapped into 1 inch lengths | 1 pimento stuffed olive, sliced into 2 inch segments | 1 teaspoon salt and black pepper | 2 tablespoons margarine | 1 tablespoon unsweetened cocoa powder | 1 tablespoon italian seasoning | 1 pimento stuffed olive, sliced into 2 inch segments | 2 teaspoons garlic and herb bouquet garni
instructions: In a large skillet, heat the margarine, olive, cocoa, italian seasoning and bouquet garni. Cook the green beans 1 minute or until slightly crisp. Add the green beans and their juices to the heated margarine. Cover and simmer until green beans are tender. Add more salt and pepper if needed. Note, i usually add 1 tbs extra virgin olive oil and garlic and herb bouquet garni during the last minute of cooking time. Serve over white or black pasta.

Random Ingredients: spinach leaf,irish whiskey,sherry wine,pine nut,yellow bell pepper
title: Irish Whiskey Spinach
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs fresh spinach leaves | 1/2 cup sherry wine or 1/2 cup red wine vinegar | 2 large yellow bell peppers, seeded and diced | chopped pine nuts ( optional )
instructions: Wash spinach and steam in a skillet with the 1/2 cup of sherry, or red wine vinegar. When it wilts, drain and reserve. Heat remaining sherry in a skillet and add the diced bell peppers. When the peppers are tender, add the cooked spinach and remaining sherry. Add pine nuts, if desired. Serve warm. Note, if you use fresh tomatoes that are not added to the dish, they will cook more quickly.

Random Ingredients: brown gravy mix,sirloin,cremini mushroom,wheat spaghetti,wine vinegar,russet potato,cheddar cheese
title: Smothered Beef and Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 lb ground sirloin | 1 package soft wheat spaghetti, broken into 6 to 8 inch pieces | 1 cup cremini mushroom, halved | 1 jar brown gravy mix, prepared according to package directions | 3/4 cup wine vinegar | 2 cups shredded cheddar cheese, divided | 3 large russet potatoes, cut into 1/2 -inch cubes
instructions: Heat oven to 350 degrees. Spread spaghetti in a 9 x 13 baking dish. Sprinkle beef over spaghetti in dish, turning with tongs to coat evenly. Top with mushrooms. In a large bowl, mix gravy mix and vinegar. Add cheese, and toss until mixture is melted. Spoon over mushrooms, and top with potatoes. Bake about 40 minutes, until potatoes are tender. Top with remaining 1/2 cup of cheese.

title: Grilled Eggplant & Green Beans
ingredients: 1/2 eggplant, peeled and sliced lengthwise | 1 can green beans, drained well | 1 teaspoon hot pepper sauce | 1 graham cracker crust, baked until bubbly
instructions: Arrange eggplant on a foil lined grill over medium high until lightly charred on all sides, about 7 minutes. Move eggplant to a cutting board & cut into 1/2 inch slices. Arrange on a foil lined grill over medium heat, overlapping ends, & brush with pepper sauce. Grill until eggplant is limp & beginning to char, about 3 minutes. Place green beans on a cutting board & cut into 1/2 inch pieces. Spoon half green beans & half sauteed eggplant among green beans.

title: Italian Mac & Cheese (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 1 medium yellow onion, diced ( about 1 1/2 cups ) | 1/2 teaspoon italian seasoning | 2 tablespoons light mayonnaise ( i used low fat ) | 0.5 can kidney beans | 1 1/2 cups elbow macaroni, uncooked
instructions: Add the onion, italian seasoning, mayo, beans, and macaroni to the crock pot. Stir to mix. Do not drain the cooked pasta. Cover and cook on low for 5 - 6 hours or on high 2 - 3 hours. Serve with grated parmesan cheese on top.

title: Quick Refried Beans or Beans <RECIPE_STAR
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups black beans ( black beans or kidney beans with liquid ) | 3 limes | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon adobo sauce
instructions: Soak beans over night in cool water soak beans in hot water. After soaking, drain water. Pour beans into large strainer and rinse thoroughly. Place in pressure cooker.

Random Ingredients: pistachio,thai red curry paste,water chestnut,pine nut,green pepper,vodka
title: Madagascar Vodka Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons thai red curry paste ( i used kikkoman ) | 1/4 cup water chestnut, chopped ( canned ) | 1 teaspoon pine nuts, toasted | 1/4 cup fresh green pepper, chopped | 2 tablespoons vodka | 1 tablespoon pistachios, coarsely chopped
instructions: Mix all except pine nuts, green pepper and pistachios in a bowl. If using kikkoman, buy it pre sliced and pre cut. Then cut into chunks, i like to use pieces on the skewers. If desired, drizzle with extra virgin olive oil. Can also be served with fresh fruit such as jasmine rice. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: jeera powder,pimiento,white vinegar,oatmeal,cherry,kalamata olive,onion powder,liquid honey
title: Savory Roasted Cherry and Olive Medley
ingredients: 1 cup dried cherries, rinsed | 1 cup old-fashioned oatmeal | 1 1/2 tablespoons minced capers | 1 ounce minced pimiento | 3 tablespoons minced onions | 1/4 cup distilled white vinegar | 1/4 cup liquid honey | 1/4 cup chopped kalamata olives
instructions: Heat the broiler. Line a cookie sheet with aluminum foil. Heat the oven to 300 degrees f. Mix the dried cherries in a small bowl with the rolled oats, capers, pimentos, onions, vinegar, honey and olives. Spread the cherries evenly onto the foil. Broil, turning frequently, until the liquid is bubbly and thick, about 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: velveeta cheese,monterey jack cheese,kielbasa,baby shrimp,tabasco sauce,salt,baby corn
title: Spicy Shrimp and Cheese Dip
ingredients: 2 packages velveeta cheese or ( 10 ounce ) packages cheese dip ( such as velveeta ) | 1 can baby corn, drained | 1 can baby shrimp, drained | 1 package kielbasa, sliced | 3 drops tabasco sauce | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 1 package velveeta cheese, cut into cubes
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. In a large bowl, combine velveeta cheese, baby corn, shrimp, kielbasa, tabasco, salt, cheese and velveeta cheese. Spoon into a 2 quart casserole dish. Bake for 1 hour and 30 minutes or until bubbly, stirring frequently.

Random Ingredients: tapioca,coconut,fruit,malt vinegar,vegetable carrot,red bell pepper,sesame oil
title: Sweet, Sour Salad
ingredients: 8 cups mixed fresh fruit | 1 1/2 cups peeled vegetables, such as onions, red peppers and cucumbers, thinly sliced | 1 cup red bell pepper, chopped | 1 cup sweetened flaked coconut | 1/3 cup malt vinegar | 1/3 cup sesame oil | 2 tablespoons tapioca or 2 tablespoons arrowroot
instructions: In a large bowl, toss fruit with vegetables, bell peppers, coconut, vinegar and sesame oil. Cover and refrigerate several hours for flavors to develop.

title: Creamy Pasta Primavera
ingredients: 6 tablespoons heavy cream | 21 ounces lasagna noodles, uncooked | 1 ounce fresh cranberries, chopped | 1/4 teaspoon dried sage
instructions: Cook the pasta according to package directions. In a large bowl, whip the cream until it forms stiff peaks. Toss in the noodles, cranberries and sage. Cover the bowl and refrigerate at least 2 hours. Bring to the table and serve.

Random Ingredients: yeast,cream chicken soup,cardamom seed,tomato ketchup,rice krispies,french onion soup,green chili pepper,deli ham
title: French Onion Rolls
ingredients: 2 cups rice krispies | 1 teaspoon instant yeast | 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1 can french onion soup | 2 green chili peppers | 1 teaspoon cardamom seed | 1 teaspoon tomato ketchup | 1/2 lb deli ham, finely diced
instructions: Add all ingredients into saucepan except ham, heating until soup is melted and bubbly. Spread out on cookie sheet in a layer. Cut rolls at a 45 degree angle, roll up and serve with salad.

title: Homemade Cheese & Olive Dip
ingredients: 3 -4 cups low fat cottage cheese | 1/2 cup minced celery ( optional ) or 1/2 cup minced green onion ( optional ) | 1 -2 teaspoon dried mexican oregano ( optional )
instructions: Mix all together. Keep in fridge in clean jar until ready to use.

title: Beef Kelagu (Beef Kebabs)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 1 pound sirloin, trimmed | 2 tablespoons asafoetida powder | 12 cherry pie filling, or as desired
instructions: Heat oil in a saucepan or wok. Add meat.

Random Ingredients: rosemary,rice wine vinegar,chili powder,lime leaf,ladyfinger,scallion,cider vinegar
title: Tangy Rosemary Slice - Slice With Ladyfingers
ingredients: 1 cup sweet rice wine vinegar | 1/2 cup chopped scallion | 1/4 cup cider vinegar | 1/4 cup chili powder | 2 -3 teaspoons rosemary | 1 teaspoon lime leaves | 1 large egg roll ladyfinger, split crosswise in halves
instructions: Place in the freezer covered dish until solid, about 5 minutes. Remove from freezer and stir in remaining ingredients. Freeze until very firm, about 3 1/2 hours. Turn out onto a sheet tray and cut into 10 slices using a cookie cutter.

title: Clam Shanks
ingredients: 2 lbs lamb shanks or 2 lbs lamb chops | clam juice or beer | dark molasses
instructions: Wash the meat and put in a large pan. Pour enough clam juice or beer over to just cover. Add dark molasses to barely cover. Simmer slowly for 2 - 3 hours. Add clams during the last half of cooking.

title: Dutch Betasstås (Smoke Sausages) (Sausage) Bols Vlaai
ingredients: 2 bundles bols banana liqueur ( vanrols ) | 1/4 lb smoked sausage
instructions: Boil banana liqueur, remove from stove. Heat a skillet over medium heat. Smear sausage slices with the banana liqueur, place in heated skillet and cook 7 minutes, or until nicely browned. Serve immediately.

title: Shirley's Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 container large-curd cottage cheese ( neufchatel ) | 1/2 red onion, sliced | 1 3/4 cups fresh mushrooms, sliced thin, stems left on | 2 tablespoons prepared mustard | 1/2 cup tomato juice
instructions: Place cottage cheese on serving platter. Place onion on top. Place mushrooms on onion. Mix mustard with tomato juice. Spread mixture over vegetables. Chill. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: dark brown sugar,heavy whipping cream,roasting chicken,thyme sprig,pimiento
title: Cajun Chicken
ingredients: 1/3 cup dark brown sugar, packed | 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme sprigs | 1 roasting chickens | 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream | 3 tablespoons chopped pimientos
instructions: In shallow baking dish, combine sugar and thyme. Place chicken in sugar mixture, turn to coat. Turn over in dish, cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Wrap chicken tightly in plastic wrap or aluminum foil and place in roasting pan. Bake 10 minutes. Remove plastic wrap and turn chicken 45 degrees f. Roast about 20 minutes longer for a golden brown color. Transfer to serving platter.

Random Ingredients: vegetable broth,romano cheese,oregano leaf,flat bread,rice flour,green olive,pecorino romano cheese
title: Olive Pizza
ingredients: 1/2 cup vegetable broth | 3 tablespoons rice flour, or more as needed | 3 tablespoons grated pecorino romano cheese | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 10 green olives, pitted and sliced | 1/2 cup shredded romano cheese | 1/4 cup coarsely chopped fresh flat bread, or as needed
instructions: Stir rice flour, pecorino romano cheese, and oregano together in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: arugula,cannellini bean,nectarine,lemon zest,red chilies,lima bean,habanero pepper,plum tomato
title: The Queen of the Antipasto
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups dried cannellini beans | 1 cup lima beans | 3 small red chilies, chopped | 2 prawns, deveined and finely diced | 3 nectarines, quartered and slightly charred | 1 habanero pepper, deveined and finely diced | 1 tablespoon lemon zest, freshly grated | 2 cups arugula
instructions: In a large saucepan or dutch oven, add the beans, lima beans, chilies, prawns, nectarines, habanero, lemon zest, and arugula. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat, cover, and simmer 2 hours, until the vegetables are tender and the sauce is thick. Serve hot or cold.

Random Ingredients: focaccia bread,beef gravy,orange zest,ranch dressing mix,pistachio,tomato juice,ancho chile powder,bread crumb
title: Carpaccia Fondue
ingredients: 8 cups tomato juice | 1 cup ranch dressing mix | 1 teaspoon orange zest | 1 teaspoon dried ancho chile powder | 1 teaspoon dried bread crumbs | 3 cups shaved focaccia bread | 2 teaspoons extra-virgin olive oil, divided | 1 cup chopped pistachios
instructions: In a heavy bottomed pot, combine the tomato juice, ranch dressing mix, orange zest, ancho chile powder, bread crumbs, and 1 teaspoon olive oil. Bring to a boil and reduce the heat to a gentle simmer. Cover and simmer until the mixture thickens slightly and the bread is lightly chewy, about 50 minutes. Transfer the sauce to a fondue pot, and keep warm over low heat. Remove the fondue pot from the heat. Stir in the pistachios and serve on a warmed fondue platter.

title: Peachy Brussels Sprouts
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 bag frozen brussels sprouts | 1 cup freshly peaches - peeled, pitted and sliced | 1/2 cup chopped hazelnuts ( optional )
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook sprouts in boiling water until tender, about 5 minutes. Drain. Transfer sprouts to a large serving dish. Stir soup with mushrooms, halved, and sliced peaches into soup. Spoon over sprouts. Sprinkle with hazelnuts.

Random Ingredients: cognac,apple juice,tart apple,kaffir lime leaf,red potato,yellow cake mix,chicken bouillon granule
title: Apple Kaffir Apple Red Pot Pie
ingredients: 1 red potatoes, sliced | 1 package yellow cake mix | 1 package frozen tart apples - peeled, cored and sliced | 2 tablespoons chicken bouillon granules | 1/2 cup apple juice | 1 dash cognac | 2 kaffir lime leaves, crushed ( optional )
instructions: Arrange potatoes and apples in a greased 9x13 inch baking dish. Sprinkle with chicken bouillon. Pour apple juice over potatoes and season with cognac and kaffir lime leaves, if desired.

title: Spinach Filled French Fries
ingredients: 5 lbs fresh spinach | 3 -4 medium potatoes ( depending on size or preference ) | 1 1/2 - 2 cups crumbled feta cheese | 3/4 cup swiss cheese | 1 cup marmalade ( i used homemade dressing, but you can substitute any amount of balsamic or pineapple juice ) | 2 tablespoons red chili powder ( or more, to taste ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit. Remove stems and tough leaves from spinach. Slice potato's into strips about 1 1/2 inches long, then cut the strips 1/2 to 3/4 inches wide and then cut strips into 3 inch lengths. Add potato's and all other ingredients to a large bowl and mix well. Add flour all at once and mix well until everything is incorporated. Add more flour as needed, as a thickener of choice. If the spinach and potatoes are too dry, add water a tablespoon or two at a time, making sure the potatoes aren't too tacky. Add as much of the flour as you feel needed to produce a slightly moist, but not wet, dough. Mix well to achieve a smooth, loose consistency. Dip the fries one at a time in the mixture and drop onto oiled baking sheets, allowing them to spread as they bake. Bake for 20 minutes, flipping over the fries halfway through. The fries should be golden on the outside and crisp on the outside. While the fries warm up nicely, they can be served warm. Variation, replace the swiss, swiss cheese, parmesan cheese, mozzarella cheese, or use a mixture of cheese, ham, and other tasty fillings.

title: Black Beans
ingredients: 2 cups rinsed and dried kidney beans or 2 cups cooked black beans, from a can | 1/2 tablespoon dried cilantro leaves | 1/2 teaspoon cajun seasoning, such as mccormick's montreal brand | 1 teaspoon cornflour | kosher salt or sea salt
instructions: Put beans, cilantro and seasoning in a large bowl. Make a well in the center, add any other seasoning and cornflour and mash the mixture with a fork or potato masher so it makes a thick paste. The beans may be used to form small patties. Preheat any non stick cooking oil or a little olive oil in a frying pan or skillet. For extra moisture when forming patties, add the mixture to the frying pan and fry a minute or two on each side before turning. Serve warm with plain bread to mop up most of the grease left from cooking the beans. Note, a nice touch is to add a little flour to the liquid in the pan as the beans cook. It can then be served without flour at all. If you are trying this option in a recipe, add 1/2 cup water to the liquid after cooking the beans.

Random Ingredients: spaghetti sauce,oregano,ice cube,sea salt,coconut cream,sultana raisin
title: Chilled Spaghetti (Spaghetti Al Piemontese)
ingredients: 1 cup sultana raisin | 1 1/2 - 2 cups prepared spaghetti sauce, warmed | 1 tablespoon dried oregano | 1 teaspoon sea salt, or | 1 can coconut cream, well chilled | ice cube, for serving
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees. Combine sultanas and drained spaghetti sauce in a 2 quart glass baking dish. Pour warm sauce from the can over the breaded sultanas. Mix oregano with salt and sprinkle over the breaded sultanas. Cover dish with plastic wrap and press plastic wrap directly onto the surface of the breaded sauce. Let sit for 15 minutes. Using a fork or spoon, remove plastic wrap and sprinkle on the remaining salt. Rinse dish with cold water and remove plastic wrap. Place on a cutting board and cut into 12 even sized pieces. Add ice cubes, one at a time, and press out excess moisture with a spatula if water is squeezed out from a piece of ice. Arrange molded ice cubes on a plate and set aside. Serve with some additional sauce, if desired.

title: Tortos De Papas (Spanish Pork and Beef Patties)
ingredients: 5 lbs pork tenderloin ( about 1 1/2 pounds ) | 8 ounces pork tenderloins, trimmed of extraneous fat and cut into large chunks | 12 ounces jicama, peeled and coarsely chopped ( about 2 cups ) | 1 1/2 quarts cake flour | 1 1/2 tablespoons cardamom seeds | 1 teaspoon saffron threads | 1 cup beef or 1 cup chicken stock
instructions: Toast the cardamom seeds in a dry 15 to 20 skillet over medium heat, stirring, until they turn a light golden brown color, then set them aside to cool. Trim the ends off the pork and beef, then cut in 2 inch cubes and put the meat in a mixing bowl. Toss in the dried spices and the jicama, then stir in the flour and add just enough stock to make a fairly sticky dough. Turn the dough out onto a floured work surface and knead it briefly until it is smooth, about 5 minutes.

title: Hot Sausages With Herbs and Red Pepper
ingredients: 3 tablespoons mixed fresh herbs ( i normally use chives. ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried thyme sprigs | 1/2 teaspoon ground sage
instructions: Blend all ingredients in a small food processor to make a very fine paste. Sausages should be thinly sliced, about 3cm deep.

Random Ingredients: nut,salad oil,sirloin,catsup,garlic salt,cocoa powder,vegetable oil cooking spray
title: Sirloin Steak Nuggets
ingredients: 1 lb sirloin, cut into strips | vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 cup chopped nuts | 3/4 cup catsup | 2 tablespoons unbleached cane sugar crystals | 2 tablespoons brewed salad oil | 2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium high heat. Coat pan with cooking spray, add sirloin strips and cook about 5 minutes, stirring often. Add nuts and mix well, cook for 5 minutes or until meat is slightly brown and crumbly. Repeat with additional cooking to desired tenderness. Stir in catsup, sugar, salad oil, and cocoa. Heat through. Serve topped with sour cream, if desired.

Random Ingredients: coconut oil,pumpkin pie spice,hot italian sausage,mini marshmallow,mint,rotel tomato,half
title: Pumpkin Sausage & Marshmallow Pies
ingredients: 3 tablespoons coconut oil | 6 hot italian sausages, casings removed | 1 can rotel tomatoes, drained and diced ( mexican-style ) | 1 1/2 cups mini marshmallows ( optional ) | 2/3 cup half-and-half | 1 teaspoon pumpkin pie spice | 1 tablespoon of fresh mint, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Heat coconut oil in skillet over medium heat until just hot. Add sausage and cook until browned. Stir in tomatoes, marshmallows, half n half, and pumpkin pie spice. Simmer until marshmallows are melted. Add mint. Spoon about 1/4 cup of mixture into each miniature muffin tin, filling to the tops. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: farfalle pasta,bean check,eggplant,italian tomato,pumpkin pie spice
title: Cousin Pete's Italian Pasta
ingredients: 3 large eggplants | 2 cans italian-style tomatoes | 2 cans pumpkin pie spice | 1 can fat-free baked beans ( i like the ones with the baked beans ) | cooked farfalle pasta ( optional )
instructions: In a 9x13 inch pan, place the eggplants and tomatoes, breaking up as needed. Sprinkle each with their own pumpkin spice mixture and top with baked beans. Bake at 300 degrees for 35 minutes. Note, for a crispier texture, you can cook the beans in a separate pan or microwave.

Random Ingredients: coconut milk,vegetable stock,vinegar,lime wedge,onion powder,jalapeno pepper,chicken breast half
title: Thai Coconut Chicken
ingredients: 1 can coconut milk | 1 cup vegetable stock | 2 large chicken breast halves, bone-in and skinless | 1/3 cup shredded sweet onion powder | 1/3 cup lime juice | 1 tablespoon vinegar | 1 jalapeno pepper, thinly sliced
instructions: Pour coconut milk and vegetable stock into a blender or food processor. Add chicken and onion powder, blending until no longer pink. Cover and blend again until chicken shreds but is still well coated. Transfer chicken to a platter. Squeeze lime juice, then mix into shredded chicken. Cover and refrigerate for at least one hour. Stir in sweet onion, vinegar, and jalapenos.

title: Green Lentils and Tortillas
ingredients: 250 g green lentils | tortilla
instructions: Put the lentils inside a colander over large bowl and let them sit for half an hour or so. Drain well. Rinse the drained lentils under running cold water. Soak in plenty of water for 10 - 15 minutes. Heat pan on medium high. To test if the lentils are soft, stir the pan. If it bubbles up, lower the heat a little to make sure the bottom gets some softer rind. Drop the tortillas into the pan and quickly put the lid, with a small piece of aluminium foil, on top of them. Cook for 3 - 4 minutes or until crisp and golden. Remove them from the pan, cut in half and serve.

Random Ingredients: oyster sauce,rice wine vinegar,serrano chilies,chuck steak,graham cracker crumb,broccoli floret,prosciutto
title: Chile Con Carne II
ingredients: 1/8 cup rice wine vinegar | 2 ounces thinly sliced prosciutto ( about 2 ounces ) | 2 tablespoons minced fresh serrano chilies | 1/4 cup oyster sauce | 3/4 cup graham cracker crumbs | 2 lbs chuck steaks, cut into 1 1/2 inch cubes | 1 1/2 lbs fresh broccoli florets ( about 10 to 12 large )
instructions: For marinade, combine first 5 ingredients in a 2 cup glass measure.

title: Apple, Ham, and Penne Primavera
ingredients: 4 pieces frozen tart apples | 8 ounces cooked penne rigate | 4 -5 slices cooked ham
instructions: Preparation, dice and combine apples in an oven proof dish. Cover with ham slices, and bake at 350 for 30 to 35 minutes. Cook's note, if you prefer to use a processor, you can prepare this in advance to save time. After baking dish for 30 - 35 minutes, take out of oven and stir thoroughly with a fork. Bake for an additional 15 minutes. Remove from the oven, and enjoy.

title: Zucchini Fingers
ingredients: 1 lb zucchini ( about 6 ) | 1 cup icing sugar
instructions: Wash zucchini well and cut into 1/2 inch slices at 1 inch intervals. Toss with icing sugar in a large bowl until coated evenly. Cover and chill for at least 2 hours or up to over night. Arrange zucchini on parchment paper lined baking sheets. Arrange fingers 2 inches apart, flat side down. Let stand until slightly crisp, 20 minutes or so. Place fingers on a rack and set flat before baking. Bake in 400 degrees f oven until lightly browned and crisp, 20 to 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: linguine pasta,pimiento,green onion,bean paste,lime juice zest,chicken breast fillet
title: Linguine With Chicken, Dipping Sauce and Pimiento
ingredients: 500 g linguine pasta | 3 tablespoons pimento | 1 kg chicken breast fillet | 1 jar of refried beans ( fountain ) | 2 tablespoons lime juice, and zest of | 1 cup green onion
instructions: Saute pimento in olive oil until slightly soft. Cut chicken into thin slices and saute in the pimento until chicken breast is cooked. Add the refried beans and mix thoroughly. Remove chicken and keep warm. Add lime rinds to the lime juice. In a deep pot, place linguine and add enough water to cover the bottom. Add the chicken mixture and cook until the water is absorbed. Add lime juice and green onions and combine well, stirring thoroughly. Add in the red pimento. Serve warm with rice.

Random Ingredients: nutmeg,chocolate syrup,sugar syrup,serrano pepper,almond extract,cucumber,vegetable stock
title: Gramma's Persian Cucumber Soup
ingredients: 2 large cucumbers, sliced very thinly, seeds removed | 1/2 cup coarse semolina or 1/2 cup granulated sugar syrup | 5 cups vegetable stock | 1 1/2 teaspoons almond extract | 1 1/2 teaspoons chocolate-flavored syrup or 1 1/2 teaspoons honey | 1/6 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1/4 teaspoon serrano pepper ( optional )
instructions: Place sliced cucumbers in a small bowl, add remaining ingredients, stirring until smooth. Heat soup and stir constantly until boiling, approximately 1 minute. Reduce heat. Slowly pour in mixture and bring to a simmer. Simmer for approximately 15 minutes. Do not boil. Serve hot.

title: Korean Hamburgers
ingredients: 4 kiwi pulp, peeled | 1/2 kg ground meat | 4 leaves lettuce
instructions: Put the kiwifruit pulp in a microwave and cook on high for 1 - 2 minutes to soften. Put the kimchee in a bowl, mix with the meat and seasoning and then use your hands to mix everything well. Form the mixture into balls. Heat up the grill till hot, put in the meat balls and cook on all sides. Serve with shredded lettuce.

title: Homemade Marsala Wine Sorbet
ingredients: 4 cups whole milk marsala wine | 1/4 teaspoon chili pepper flakes | 4 allspice berries, crushed
instructions: Place milk into a large, deep saucepan. Place allspice berries into a medium frying pan. Place allspice berries into the pan with the boiling marsala wine. Bring to a boil, lower heat and simmer until liquid is reduced by 3/4. This should take about 20 minutes. Transfer the pan into a bowl and allow to cool to room temperature. In the freezer, in batches, place the frozen mixture into a freezer safe bowl. Scoop the contents of the bowl into the cooled milk. Freeze until firm, at least 3 hours or up to 4 days. Remove the contents of the freezer bowl from the freezer bowl and place into the freezer for at least 2 hours or up to 4 days.

Random Ingredients: chilies,orange blossom water,pork shoulder,thai basil leaf,sugar snap pea
title: Orange-Braised Sweet Peas With Pork
ingredients: 2 lbs sweet potatoes or 2 lbs sugar snap peas, ends trimmed | 1 lb pork shoulder or 1 lb boneless pork loin, cut into 6 pieces | 6 fresh chilies, seeded and chopped ( preferably thai ) | 1/3 cup fresh orange blossom water | minced fresh thai basil ( optional ) or fresh parsley ( optional )
instructions: Slice potatoes or snap peas about 1/4 inch thick on the diagonal. Cook in rapidly boiling water just until tender, but not mushy. Drain and immediately transfer to a bowl. Add pork pieces to boiling water.

Random Ingredients: turmeric,fish fillet,banana,shiitake mushroom,lasagna noodle,anise seed,beef,baking potato
title: Namurrah-Yogi (Fish Lasagna)
ingredients: 8 -10 fresh shiitake mushrooms, cleaned | 1 medium baking potato | 2 lbs fresh fish fillets ( such as halibut or sea bass ) | 2 1/2 lbs lean ground beef | 3 large banana, peeled | 1 teaspoon turmeric, preferably ground cardamom | 1/2 teaspoon anise seed | 1 1/2 cups plain coarsely-shredded lasagna noodles ( about 3 cups )
instructions: Place the shiitake mushrooms over medium heat and cover for 5 minutes, or until soft. Discard the caps, stems, and or leaves. Heat the oven to 375°f peel potatoes into 2 or 3 large grater holes. Cut the potato lengthwise into 1/8 slices. Trim off the hard ends and cut into 1/8 slices. Place the slices on an ungreased cookie sheet and bake in the heated oven until golden, about 20 minutes. When done, drain the mushrooms, pressing with your fingers to remove any excess moisture and set aside. Dice the fish. Put fish, shiitake caps, potato slices, ground beef, banana, turmeric, anise seed and 2 cups of water into a saucepan. Heat to boiling over medium low heat, stirring, then simmer, uncovered, for 15 minutes. Add the noodles and mix well until evenly coated. Remove from heat. Divide the noodle dough among 4 large shallow baking or baking dishes. Lay one noodle in each dish and set aside. Cover with another dish and set aside. Repeat with the remaining noodles, meat mixture and remaining filling in the next dish. Cover with a single layer of plastic wrap and a heavy book. Let stand at room temperature for 2 hours. Preheat the oven to 375°f place a baking sheet over medium heat. Cook lasagna for about 3 minutes on each side. Top each serving with 1/2 cup of the nut mixture, spreading evenly.

title: Walnut and Pear Mash
ingredients: 1 large russet potato, peeled and cut into small wedges | 1/4 cup walnuts, chopped | 2 teaspoons chopped fresh walnuts, optional
instructions: Place the potato wedges in a microwave safe bowl, cover with water, and microwave on high 5 minutes, until tender. Drain, and cool.

Random Ingredients: orange juice,soya sauce,coconut milk,liquid smoke,iceberg lettuce,nonfat milk
title: Budget Bytes' (Filipino Beef and Vegetable Salad)
ingredients: 50 ml nonfat milk ( low fat if possible ) | 150 ml sweet soy sauce | 6 tablespoons orange juice | 1/2 tablespoon liquid smoke ( optional ) | 2 heads iceberg lettuce | 200 ml coconut milk ( optional )
instructions: If the diet is ultra rich, you may substitute skimmed milk for reduced fat milk. If you do not plan on using low fat milk, you may substitute 2 tbs of plain fat free margarine. If the diet is for meat and salad, omit the soy sauce. Combine all ingredients in a large bowl and toss to incorporate. Refrigerate at least 20 minutes or overnight. Serve the same day or the next day. Great over cooked jasmine rice or as a side dish with your grilled, boiled, or barbecued meats.

Random Ingredients: savoy cabbage,chicken bouillon cube,vegan margarine,rose water
title: Homemade Vegetable Stock
ingredients: 2 cups savoy cabbage ( approx 8-10 ) | 1 vegetarian chicken bouillon cube ( i used knorr's organic low fat ) | 1/2 teaspoon rose water | 1/2 teaspoon vegan margarine
instructions: Add all ingredients except for margarine into crock pot. Cover and cook on low for about 6 - 8 hours. Remove from crock and discard liquid. Allow to cool slightly before putting into container for storage. I used my hand held blender to get out the fat. Store in refrigerator or freezer container for later use. Serve over soup, rice or noodles.

Random Ingredients: creole seasoning,red cabbage,kaffir lime leaf,vanilla essence
title: Red Cabbage
ingredients: 3 small red cabbage | 3 kaffir lime leaves or 1 large limes ( see note below ) | 12 -16 ounces creole seasoning ( or other flavourful ) | 1 tablespoon vanilla essence ( not vanilla )
instructions: Wash cabbage carefully. Cut into bite size pieces. Rinse lime leaves under cold running water and place in bowl. Drain well and leave to dry out a slight odorsiness. If you have a hand blender you can do this step. If not use fresh lime leaves to dry out the citrus flavour. If using kaffir juice, use the entire bottle of creole seasoning. Put cabbage aside. Pour the bottle of creole seasoning into a pot and heat over high heat. While this cooks you can make the vanilla essence by pouring a teaspoon or two of vanilla essence into 2 or 3 glasses of hot water. If your using regular creole paste, put this into each glass and mix the entire liquid by pouring slowly into the bowl, one cup at a time. Keep stirring. When the cabbage is a little tender you can use a spoon or slotted spatula to lift out leaves. Using a large spoon or slotted spoon, remove the cabbage leaves and throw away. To give you all the flavour, take the leaves out again, so as not to lose any leaves after. Turn up to high heat and add about 2 or 3 tablespoons of cream to the curry/liquid. This would only take two to three minutes. Toss in some of the leaves and the liquid, tasting as you go, until they are well coated with the sauce/flour mixture. This should be fairly dry. Turn up to high heat until just simmering. Stir in the rest of the leaves and taste, adding more cream and creole seasoning if necessary and stirring all the while. Once just simmering you can carefully pour the mix in bowls. Serve immediately, with basmati rice/chow mein noodles and top with extra cream if desired.

title: Beef for a Crowd
ingredients: 1 jar beef stew meat | 3/4 cup grand marnier
instructions: Pour the grand marnier into a large container, and put the stew meat into the container with the grand marnier.

title: French Milk
ingredients: 1 quart milk, warm | onion, finely diced or grated
instructions: Combine all ingredients and serve. This should be a cold but hot mix to your taste.

Random Ingredients: pork roast,tomatillo salsa,self rising flour,tomato soup,celery,plain flour
title: Pork and Tomatillo Scrolls
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs pork roast, cut into thin shreds | 300 g can tomatillo salsa, mild | 1/2 cup self-rising flour | 1/2 cup plain flour | 1 teaspoon tomato soup | 1 1/2 cups celery, cut into thin slices
instructions: Preheat oven to c or mark grease oven trays with oil.

Random Ingredients: cheddar cheese,napa cabbage,tabasco sauce,boston lettuce,fontina cheese
title: Hot Coleslaw Sandwich
ingredients: 4 teaspoons tabasco sauce | 1 head napa cabbage, shredded | 1 bag shredded fontina cheese | 1/2 head shredded fontina cheese | 2 heads shredded iceberg lettuce
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix together the hot pepper sauce and tabasco sauce. Add the shredded lettuce and shredded fontina cheese. Mix well and toss salad with this. Best prepared 3 to 4 hours in advance. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: artichoke heart,penne pasta,chicken bouillon cube,red cabbage
title: Penne With Artichokes and Red Cabbage
ingredients: 6 -8 cups prepared penne pasta ( you can use other pasta ) | 4 -6 cups thinly sliced red cabbage | 1 chicken bouillon cube, dissolved in | 1 1/2 cups chopped artichoke hearts
instructions: Boil water with bouillon in a kettle.

Random Ingredients: lemon peel,kosher salt pepper,chutney,fire tomato,chili,pimento,italian parsley
title: Chutney from the Devil Inside
ingredients: 1 jar chutney | 8 ounces fire-roasted tomatoes | 2 tablespoons dried chutney | 1 tablespoon dried onion or 2 tablespoons kosher salt | 2 tablespoons dried italian parsley | 1 tablespoon lemon peel, finely shredded | 1 teaspoon chili, ground | 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt and pepper, finely cracked
instructions: Preheat oven to 250 degrees f. In a 2 quart baking dish or bowl, stir together chili, parsley, lemon peel, and salt and pepper. Add chutney and tomatoes, and stir until thoroughly mixed and the tomatoes are soft and chunky. Spread mixture into dish and bake mixture for 1 hour. Stir occasionally, so it is well spreadable.

Random Ingredients: arugula,kaffir lime leaf,blueberry,chickpea,spaghetti noodle,green bell pepper
title: Red Vegetable Noodle Salad
ingredients: 500 g chinese spaghetti noodles | 15 1/2 ounces canned chickpeas, rinsed and drained | 4 green bell peppers, seeded and finely diced | 5 kaffir lime leaves | 200 g rocket | blueberries, to decorate ( optional )
instructions: Cook the spaghetti until tender then rinse under cold water and drain. Combine the noodles and all the ingredients in a large mixing bowl, mixing well. Serve on a bed of rocket or mixed salad leaves.

Random Ingredients: romaine lettuce leaf,chickpea,sugar,tortilla,cream,vegetable oil cooking spray,scallion,apricot nectar
title: Apricot and Chickpea Salad
ingredients: tortilla, warmed | vegetable oil cooking spray | 6 tablespoons apricot nectar | 1/2 teaspoon sugar | 1 head romaine lettuce leaf | 2 scallions, chopped | 1 can chickpeas, drained and rinsed | 3/4 cup sour cream
instructions: Wrap the tortilla in waxed paper and heat in a 400 degree f oven until warm, about 10 minutes. Place the nectar and sugar in a blender and puree for about 10 seconds or until smooth. Set aside. Tear the lettuce, scallions and chickpeas into bite sized pieces. Spoon 1/3 cup of the sour cream over the salad and toss lightly. Spoon dollops of the nectar over and let sit for about 1 minute. Drizzle some of the nectar over the top or serve on the side.

title: Chia's Rice Pilaf
ingredients: 1/2 cup applesauce | 2 green bell peppers | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano | 1 cup uncooked basmati rice
instructions: Bring a small pot of water to a boil. Add salt. Meanwhile, cut ends off bell peppers. Remove seeds, and coarsely chop. In a small bowl, mix applesauce, chopped green pepper, and oregano. Place rice in a skillet.

title: Spicy Tomato Achar
ingredients: 2 cans tomato puree | 2 medium yellow peppers, cut into chunks | 1 large avocado, cut into 1-inch pieces | 2 cloves garlic, sliced | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon anise seed | 4 -6 ounces crushed unrefined yellow peppercorns or 4 -6 ounces crushed whole anise | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric
instructions: Put saucepan 2/3 full of the water in a large saucepan with a lid. In a frying bowl put puree, yellow pepper, tomato puree, avocado and garlic. Add anise seeds. Cook on low heat until mixture forms a thin syrup, stirring almost constantly. Add turmeric and black pepper and simmer until all the liquid evaporates. If you have to thin the mixture a little, you can add 1 1/2 tbsp cornstarch mixed in a little water and stir until well blended. Serve immediately as a side dish or as a spicy main dish to hot noodles or rice.

title: Peppercorns Bread Coated in Sour Cream
ingredients: 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1/4 teaspoon baking soda | 1/8 teaspoon ground black peppercorns | 1 cup breadcrumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Line baking sheet with foil, leaving about 4 inches of foil around side of baking pan in the oven. Combine cream of tarter, baking soda, and peppercorns in a shallow dish, then mix well, forming into a loaf. Spread loaf with breadcrumbs, and season with more paprika if desired. Bake in middle of oven 15 minutes, or until lightly browned, and a thermometer inserted in center of loaf reads 160°f remove from oven, and slice.

Random Ingredients: pasta sauce,dill pickle,classic beef ravioli,corn syrup,mint sprig,egg wrap
title: Beef Ravioli in Tomato Sauce
ingredients: 1 box classic beef ravioli | 1 jar pasta sauce | 1 tablespoon corn syrup | 1 tablespoon fresh dill pickle, finely minced | 1/4 cup minced fresh mint sprig | prepared egg roll wrap
instructions: In a small saucepan heat the tomato sauce, corn syrup, pickle, and minced mint over medium heat, stirring frequently. As soon as the sauce comes to a boil, reduce heat to low. Cook gently for about 15 minutes or until the flavors are well blended and the sauce is warmed through. In a large bowl soak the ravioli for 3 or 4 minutes so they are not too warm. Place half the ravioli on a large plate. Place 1/2 a cup of the warm tomato sauce over the ravioli, leaving about 1/2 inch of room at each end. Place 1 more ravioli over the tomato sauce. Cover with one more tablespoon of tomato sauce, then cover with a second 1/2 cup of tomato sauce and cover with the third ravioli. Cover the bowl with your wrap and refrigerate for at least 1 hour to let the flavors blend. When ready to serve, place the ravioli on a platter and drizzle the remainder of the tomato sauce over the ravioli. Garnish with extra mint sprigs if desired.

Random Ingredients: flat leaf parsley,chive,mandarin orange,marshmallow,sunflower oil,chipotle chile,panko breadcrumb
title: Devilled Mandarin Appetizers
ingredients: 1 can mandarin oranges, chilled, well drained | 1 cup panko breadcrumbs | 1/3 cup shaved roasted sunflower oil ( from an oil-packed mandarin ) | 1/4 cup finely chopped flat leaf parsley ( plus extra flat leaf parsley ) | 1 tablespoon finely chopped chives | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon dried chipotle chile | 1/4 cup miniature marshmallows ( optional )
instructions: Mix 1st four ingredients in large bowl. Sprinkle chipotle over, mixing just until chips have covered everything. Divide mixture among 4 paper lined muffin cups. Let stand at room temp for 30 minutes. Divide remaining mixture between each cup. Sprinkle with reserved parsley, pressing lightly to adhere. Refrigerate until ready to use.

title: Warm Mexican Nuts (Acevole Rojas)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons walnut oil | 2 tablespoons sugar
instructions: Combine walnut oil and sugar in a small saucepan. Over low heat, stir until sugar is dissolved. Remove from heat, add nuts and serve warm.

Random Ingredients: lime zest,baby lettuce spring green,scotch bonnet pepper,chicken thigh,salsa,hing,prosciutto
title: Chicken Kebabs With Mexican Salsa
ingredients: 4 skinless chicken thighs, about 5 ounces each | 2 scotch bonnet peppers, halved lengthwise and deribbed | 2 slices prosciutto | 2 tablespoons salsa | 1/2 teaspoon fresh lime zest, finely grated | baby lettuce and spring greens, to serve | 1/3 cup loosely packed fresh salsa
instructions: Combine chicken, scotch bonnet chiles, prosciutto, salsa, lime zest and half the salsa in a bowl and season with salt and pepper. Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour. Thread chicken onto metal or bamboo skewers. Grill skewers over moderate heat, turning frequently until chicken is cooked through, 15 to 20 minutes for white and 30 to 40 minutes for dark. Transfer kebabs to a serving platter and spoon hot salsa over chicken.

Random Ingredients: pie crust,black pepper,spinach,nonstick cooking spray,saffron,chipotle powder,grain white rice
title: Rice, Spinach and Saffron Empanadas
ingredients: 10 ounces frozen chopped spinach, thawed and squeezed dry | 1 teaspoon ground black pepper | 1/8 teaspoon saffron | 1/8 teaspoon dried chipotle powder | 1/8 teaspoon dried saffron | 1 cooked pie crust, with crust | nonstick cooking spray ( for greasing ) | 1 1/2 cups long-grain white rice or 1 1/2 cups arborio rice
instructions: Place frozen spinach in a colander & press out any liquid. Tear off any large pieces of spinach & set aside. Mix remaining ingredients except rice & reserve. Spray a non stick skillet with nonstick cooking spray & set over medium heat. Add the rice & heat, stirring often, until the rice is golden. Remove from heat. Stir the rice into the reserved spinach in the skillet in a large, quick succession. Place 3 or 4 ramekins on each of 4 plates. Place the spinach mixture on top of the ramekins, pressing down lightly. Preheat over to 375°f. Spray rimmed baking sheet with nonstick cooking spray. Bake, covered, 35 - 40 minutes or until a golden crust is browned on top.

title: Dee's Beef Rolls (Saskatchewan)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef stew meat ( or use top round or eye round ) | 2 tablespoons grapeseed oil ( a must for really soft rolls ) | 2 -3 teaspoons beef roll spice ( saskatoon )
instructions: Cut the stew meat into cubes a little smaller than walnut size pieces and place them in a bowl. Heat the grapeseed oil in a heavy bottom skillet on medium heat. Dip the beef cubes in the oil, and then place in the pan in single layer. Sprinkle the saskatoon roll spice over the stew meat. Turn the heat to low. Do not stir too much, just let the beef brown. When there is just a few minutes left of cooking, cover with a lid and cook for a few minutes. After 3 - 5 minutes, remove the lid from the pan. Cover the pan with a lid. Let the beef cook. After an hour or so, check the beef to see if it is tender. If still a little bit pink on the inside, remove lid and turn heat up slightly. If it is, remove lid and turn the heat down. After an hour, check the meat again and if it is tender. When the meat is tender, remove from heat and cover with lid. The meat should be covered with very little liquid. You may have to add a little water to the pan, if you find it drying out. When meat has cooled to about room temperature, you can roll it in the spice. To serve, you can divide the meat between two small plates. Cut it up into bite size pieces, and serve with gravy or potatoes for sandwich.

title: Zucchini & Bell Pepper Stir Fry
ingredients: 300 g zucchini | 1/2 cup bell pepper | 250 g black olives | 1 tablespoon rice wine
instructions: Slice the zucchini into thick rounds about 1/2 inch long. Place in a small bowl. Wash and dice the pepper into about 1/4 inch thick rounds. Cut the olives in half, remove the pit & remove the spines. Slice the zucchini into thin slices, removing the stem section if they're large. Place the bell pepper slices in another shallow bowl & combine with the olives. Heat a wok, add a little oil & add the vegetables. Stir fry for 2 minutes. Add the rice wine. Cook for a few additional seconds or until the vegetables are just tender. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: chocolate,beef stew meat,baking chocolate,raspberry vinegar,water chestnut,veal,tomato juice
title: Veggy-Free Meat Pies
ingredients: 1/2 cup water chestnut, minced | 1/2 cup dry-roasted unsweetened chocolate ( like hershey's ) | 1 teaspoon raspberry vinegar | 1 teaspoon beef stew meat | 1 lb lean ground veal | 1 can diced tomatoes with juice | 3/4 cup unsweetened chocolate, melted
instructions: Toast the chocolate in a medium saucepan over medium heat, stirring over medium to low heat until it becomes fragrant, about 2 minutes. Bring the water chestnut, chocolate, and vinegar in a bowl to a boil and remove from the heat. Add the stew meat and veal to the chocolate and stir until the veal is just cooked through. Cool 5 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in the tomatoes with their juice and the chocolate. Return to medium heat and stir until the chocolate is melted, about 5 minutes. Cool for at least 10 minutes before cutting.

title: Greek Cardamom (Algerian Cardamom Cardamom) Cream
ingredients: 10 egg whites | 6 whole green cardamom pods | 1 1/2 cups whipping cream | 1 tablespoon italian seasoning or 2 teaspoons dried oregano
instructions: Line a cookie sheet with foil or parchment paper. Preheat oven to 325 f. Place cardamon pods and 1/4 cup of water in a small saucepan over medium heat. Bring to a boil, then remove from heat. Cover and leave in liquid for 5 minutes. Remove seeds and pods. Using a slotted spoon, remove cardamon husks and discard. Remove and place on parchment paper lined cookie sheet. In a bowl, whip egg whites until frothy. Add remaining 1 cup of cream and beat until stiff. Fold egg whites into cream. Pour into a 9x13 dish coated with cooking spray. Sprinkle the remaining 1 tablespoon of italian seasoning or dried oregano over the top. Bake 25 - 30 minutes, or until golden brown. Let cool 10 minutes then turn out onto plate with a slotted spoon. Serve warm.

title: Pesto Babas
ingredients: 4 egg yolks | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala powder | 1/2 cup basil pesto
instructions: Beat egg yolks and garam masala until light in color. Mix in salad oil or pam, mixing well.

Random Ingredients: cucumber,flour,sugar snap pea,tabasco sauce,red pepper flake,cornflour
title: Easy English Pea Salad
ingredients: 16 ounces sugar snap peas, peeled | 4 cucumbers or 3 rutabagas, peeled and sliced | 1 tablespoon flour | 1 tablespoon cornflour | 1/2 - 1/2 teaspoon red pepper flakes | 1 pinch tabasco sauce
instructions: Boil the water and add some salt. Boil the peas for 10 minutes or until they are just softened. Mix together the flour, cornstarch, pepper flakes, and red pepper. Slice the cucumber/rutababas, and toss with the flour mixture. Toss the peas, vegetables and sauce together and serve.

title: Mexican Sopa Seca
ingredients: 2 cups soda water | 2 poblano chiles, seeded and minced | 2 ounces salt pork or 2 ounces lean beef | 1/2 cup bean, fresh drained | 1/2 cup chicken stock ( can substitute broth ) or 1/2 cup broth ( can substitute broth ) | 8 ounces linguine, cooked al dente | 2 -3 tablespoons tamarind pulp
instructions: Combine the pablano chiles with the soda water and let stand for 20 minutes. Rinse the chiles under running water and pat dry. In a saucepan, mix the minced pork or beef and 1/2 cup bean and simmer over low heat over low heat until the meat is cooked through. Stir in the chile/soda water mixture and keep cooking over low heat for another 10 minutes. Taste and adjust seasonings if necessary. Add the remaining 1/2 cup bean and stir into hot poblano mixture. Turn the heat up to high and bring to a boil. Cook for 1 minute. Add the cooked linguine and cook for 2 minutes. Stir in the tamarind pulp and remove from heat, keeping a warm place for 5 minutes, serve over hot noodles.

Random Ingredients: napa cabbage,chili paste,butter,apricot jam,celery rib,mirin,broccoli floret,green pea
title: Chinese Vegetable Salad
ingredients: 3 medium napa cabbage | 1/4 lb green peas, shelled | 1 small head broccoli floret | 1 small celery rib, chopped | 2 tablespoons butter | 2 tablespoons mirin | 2 tablespoons sweet chili paste | 1/4 cup apricot jam
instructions: Core the cabbage and cut into wedges. Cut the greens crosswise into halves and remove the woody base of both ends. Cut into fine 3 1/2 inch diagonal slices. In a large saucepan of boiling water, blanch the green peas and broccoli for 2 minutes. Drain and set aside. In a large skillet, melt the butter over high heat. Add the celery and onion and saute briefly, stirring frequently. Stir in the mirin, chili paste and apricot jam. Remove from heat and add the vegetables. Mix well and chill. Serve at once.

title: Kale With Rice
ingredients: 1 cup basmati rice | 1 bunch kale ( about 5 cups )
instructions: Put rice in a bowl and add enough cold water to cover it. You may use 1 to 2 cups of cold water. Stir to coat the rice. Rinse the kale well in a colander and place in the pot, cover with a lid or lid, and set over the direct heat without stirring. When steam comes out, cover and steam for 5 minutes, then remove lid.

Random Ingredients: tomato soup,lavender flower,king prawn,pear,ancho chile,cornbread,tomato green chilies,tart apple
title: Potato Prawns in a Chunky Tomato Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 cup tomato soup | 2 dried ancho chiles ( or other dried chilies ) | 4 ounces raw king prawns ( or other red-fleshed large shrimp ) | 4 slices tart apples (, about 150g ) | 1/4 cup canned diced tomato with green chilies ( see notes below ) | cornbread ( see notes below ) | leaves lavender flowers, leaves for decoration
instructions: For the sauce, combine all the ingredients except cornbread or lavender in a pan and bring to the boil. Turn the heat, remove from the heat, and cool for 10 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, remove the prawns from the pan. Reserve the cooking liquid and prawns. Remove the heads and shells from the chiles and slice them in half lengthways. Remove the seeds and ribs from the prawns and coarsely chop the flesh. Tear or dice the prawns into large chunks. Add enough reserved cooking liquid to the sauce to make a sauce of consistency your liking, and then place the prawns in a mixing bowl and stir in the minced apple, tomato, and chilies. Season to taste with salt and freshly ground black pepper and gently mix in the chopped lavender. To serve, divide the cornbread between 4 warmed serving bowls, top with the prawn mixture and top with a few lavender leaves. Drizzle with the tomato sauce and serve with wedges of lemon on the side. Notes, if you wish to serve this with some of your fava chilies, you can substitute 1 teaspoon of dried minced garlic for some of the dried red peppers. If you wish to serve this as a side dish, you can fry the prawns just before serving with the sauce and add to the dish, or substitute chicken breast fillets for the prawns. Alternatively, if you prefer to serve the dish in a single layer, divide the sauce between 4 serving bowls and place the prawn mixture underneath them and top with 1 slice of lemon and the cooked chicken breast fillet. It can also be served as a topping for some of the potato pancakes.

Random Ingredients: tomato juice,ham,phyllo dough,bell pepper,baby spinach,allspice berry
title: Spinach, Ham and Pepper Pie
ingredients: 200 g baby spinach | 1/4 bell pepper, diced | 125 g ham, diced | 1 teaspoon allspice berry | 150 ml tomato juice | 1 -2 tablespoon phyllo dough
instructions: Add tomatoes, spices and spinach in saucepan with some water and simmer on medium, until spinach has softened. Remove from heat and add peppers and ham, stir gently until combined. Cut sheets of phyllo dough in half. Take the half a sheet, and fold into three, making a 3 in diameter piece until it is the size of a pie crust. Fill each piece with filling, and roll up in your hands until it's the size of the pie crust you have used. Cut a steam hole in the top to vent. Bake at 190c for 30 mins or until golden.

title: Sopa Tava (Rhubarb Chicken)
ingredients: 2 lbs red potatoes, peeled, cut in half and then in 1/2 inch slices | 1 lb rhubarb, cut into 1 inch slices | 12 ounces boneless skinless chicken breast halves, cooked, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 lb cake flour, sifted | 1/2 cup ghee ( vegetable oil can also be used ) or 1/2 cup other oil | 1 lb fresh pasta, cooked
instructions: Place potatoes, rhubarb and chicken in a large pot and cover with cold water. Bring to a boil, then cover partially and cook until tender. Drain and cool. Heat flour on low heat until thick.

title: Homemade Spiced Tea
ingredients: 1 ounce lemon peel, in fine pith removed | 6 ounces mace or 6 ounces ground ginger | 4 ounces hot green tea ( or strong hot tea, or sweetened condensed black tea )
instructions: Prepare a double boiler of water. Cover the bottom with a sheet of wax paper. Add all of the ingredients except the tea and mix well. Bring to a boil over medium high heat. Stir in the hot tea and remove from the heat. Let steep for about 10 minutes. Strain into cups and let cool completely. Store in an airtight container at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: white mushroom,baby bok choy,chicken breast half,dark brown sugar,tahini,pizza sauce,meringue
title: Easy Chicken with Mergingues
ingredients: 1 pound skinless, boneless chicken breast halves - cut into strips | 1 package baby bok choy | 1 package mergingue, frozen concentrate, thawed | 1 cup pizza sauce | 1/2 cup dark brown sugar | 1/4 cup tahini | 6 large white mushrooms, sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Toss chicken with sherry and brush both sides with tahini. Place on baking sheet, and bake in preheated oven for 20 to 30 minutes, or until juices run clear.

Random Ingredients: cooking oil,orange bell pepper,vegetarian bean,peanut oil,corn,sherry
title: Vegetarian "Chinese" Fried Bean Rings
ingredients: 1 tablespoon peanut oil | 2 tablespoons cooking oil | 2 medium orange bell peppers | 1/2 small red sweet bell pepper | 1/2 cup vegetarian refried beans | 2 tablespoons dry sherry | 2 tablespoons corn or 2 tablespoons rice flour
instructions: Separate and cut the orange & red sweet bell peppers into rings, about 3/4 inch thick. Cut the red & green bell peppers into rings. Cut the refried beans in half if using regular beans & stir them into the hot oil. Add the bell pepper & orange strips. When the mixture is golden & a little crispy on the edges, add the sherry. Serve and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: live lobster,wine vinegar,celery,icing,monterey jack cheese,italian sausage,tamari,ramen noodle
title: Lobster Tamari Noodle Salad
ingredients: 3 packages refrigerated ramen noodles, broken small | 3 live lobsters, cleaned, chopped ( about 2 pounds ) | 2 cups shredded monterey jack cheese or 2 cups cheddar cheese ( 2 cups ) | 3 tablespoons icing, sifted ( i use 2 tablespoons ) | 1/4 cup tamari | 1 tablespoon wine vinegar | 1/4 cup finely chopped celery | additional icing, for topping ( optional )
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees. Spray two 8 inch pizza pans with nonstick cooking spray. Add noodle pieces, breaking to fit.

title: Aussie Sausages
ingredients: 1 packet bamboo skewers | 1 cup chopped cooked meat | 4 tomatoes and green chilies, chopped | 1 package spring onion, thinly sliced | 1/2 cup capers, drained
instructions: Preheat bbq plate at medium temperature. Thread skewers onto skewers, lengthways, evenly. Combine remaining ingredients.

title: French Dip (For Beef)
ingredients: 2 cans artichoke hearts, drained and rinsed | 1 lb ground beef | 1/2 cup catsup | vegetable oil ( for deep frying )
instructions: Mix beef and catsup thoroughly. Heat oil to 350°f coat a 2 lb. Slow cooker with oil. Dip in batter. Fry until golden. Serve with crackers.

title: Ice-Cream Noodles With Hot Chili Peppers
ingredients: 12 -16 rice noodles | 2 -3 fresh hot chili peppers | crushed ice cube
instructions: Boil rice noodles until soft. Drain noodles and put in a bowl with ice. Peel and slice chile peppers into thin 2 inch long strips and add. Stir until coated in ice. Enjoy.

title: Spiced Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 cup cremini mushroom, sliced, stems removed | 1/2 cup unsweetened brandy | 1 teaspoon mild curry powder | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1/3 cup reduced sodium soy sauce
instructions: Combine all the ingredients in a heavy small saucepan over medium heat. Bring to a simmer and cook until mushrooms are tender, about 5 minutes. Transfer to a serving dish and serve immediately.

title: Toasted Almond Rollups
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups almond flour, divided | 1 cup white flour | 10 ounces frozen whipped topping, thawed | 1 can sliced almonds, drained
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees. In a medium bowl, combine 1/4 cup of the almond flour, white flour, and the thawed whipped topping. Stir until just combined. Add the sliced almonds and stir to coat. Spread 1 cup of the almond mixture on a piece of parchment paper. Roll the parchment paper up and jelly roll fashion, jelly roll fashion, pressing into the entire surface. Repeat until all of the almond mixture has been used, keeping in mind that each roll will absorb some of the moisture. Cut the rolled up rolls into about 8 pieces. Place on ungreased baking sheets and bake for 25 minutes.

title: Eggplant (Aubergine) Salad
ingredients: 4 large eggplants | 1 cup iceberg lettuce, chopped
instructions: Peel eggplant, cut into 1/2 inch cubes and place in a saucepan. Sprinkle with salt and cook over medium high heat until lightly browned, about 10 minutes. Transfer to a bowl and allow to cool slightly. Cut into 1/2 inch cubes and toss with lettuce.

Random Ingredients: oregano leaf,onion soup mix,hoisin sauce,pea,poblano chile,chicken bouillon
title: Poblano
ingredients: 1 cup fresh peas | 1 poblano chile, seeded and chopped | 1 envelope dry onion soup mix | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 3 cups cubed cooked chicken ( from 1 1/2-pound rotisserie chicken ) | 2 tablespoons hoisin sauce
instructions: Place the peas, poblano chile, and onion soup mix in a slow cooker. Season with oregano, and salt. Top with chicken. Stir hoisin sauce and remaining 1/2 cup water.

Random Ingredients: lemon balm,salmon,ruby red grapefruit juice,white bread
title: Dilled Salmon, Grapefruit and Sherry Tray for Salmon
ingredients: 150 g cherrystone smoked salmon | 150 g white bread, cut into 1 cm cubes | 1/2 cup lemon balm | 2 tablespoons ruby red grapefruit juice
instructions: Place the salmon in a baking tray and pour over enough water to cover. Sprinkle over the lemon balm and grapeseed juice. Bake at 180 degrees celsius for about 30 minutes, until the salmon is cooked and the cherries have burst. Serve with warmed salad.

title: Fettuccine Alfredo
ingredients: 1 lb farfalle pasta or 1 lb linguine, cooked and drained | 1/3 cup apple cider | 1 dash thai fish sauce ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons finely snipped fresh thai fish sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and toss until well combined. Adjust seasoning and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: thai red curry paste,tuna steak,currant,fish sauce,catsup,basmati rice,potato starch
title: Potato Curry Tuna (Tuna) With Coconut Rice
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dark thai red curry paste | 1 packet of thai fish sauce | 1 kg fresh tuna steak | 1 packet catsup | 1 1/2 cups white basmati rice | potato starch, for dusting
instructions: Cook the rice. Preheat oven to 200c fan forced or 200c 180c fan forced. Rub curry paste into tuna in a large oven proof dish or roasting tin. Arrange, preferably with the side uppermost, on top of rice. Pour over the fish sauce. Bake in oven for approximately 12 minutes to crisp up the fish. Combine catup, rice, potato starch, and water. Pour over tuna mixture. Serve hot.

title: Spice Smoothie
ingredients: 200 g lemonade | 2 teaspoons mixed spice or 2 teaspoons lemon extract
instructions: Combine ingredients in a blender. Serve.

Random Ingredients: mango powder,creme fraiche,milk,pie shell,couscous,cumin seed,red chile
title: Chilled Couscous Salad With Mango Dressing
ingredients: 2 cups couscous, uncooked | 1 1/2 cups milk | 2 tablespoons creme fraiche or 2 tablespoons sour cream | 1 small red chile, deseeded and finely sliced ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon ground cumin seed | 1/2 teaspoon mango powder ( try stella artois brand )
instructions: Preheat oven to 190°c or 140°c if fan forced. Place the couscous in a medium heatproof bowl. Lightly flour the surface, then transfer to a baking tray and put into the oven for 18 minutes. Stir the milk and creme fraiche together in a small saucepan and heat gently over medium high heat. Meanwhile, toss the chilli, cumin, mango powder and cumin seed in a small dry frypan. Remove from the heat and stir over low to medium heat for 1 minute. Pour over toasted couscous and toss to coat well. Scatter over the sliced chilli and serve.

title: Scotch Barley Salad
ingredients: 2 cups pearl barley | 3/4 cup roasted red pepper, in bite sized chunks | 3/4 cup sweet red pepper, in bite sized chunks | 3/4 cup snow peas, in bite sized chunks | 2 tablespoons golden syrup | 1 tablespoon ground mace
instructions: Cook barley according to package directions. Drain. Combine all ingredients. Mix well. Cover & chill well.

Random Ingredients: leg lamb,pork belly,italian herb seasoning,egg yolk,cabbage,red chile,sesame seed,cumin
title: Moroccan-Crusted Baked Leg of Lamb
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 lbs leg of lamb, butterflied, cut into 1-inch slices | 3/4 lb cabbage | 1/2 lb pork belly, cut into 1-inch slices | 3 large egg yolks | 2 tablespoons sesame seeds | 2 teaspoons ground cumin | 1 small hot red chile, finely chopped | 2 teaspoons mixed italian herb seasoning
instructions: Preheat an oven to 325°f. Remove all excess fat and from lamb, but do not chop completely. Cut lamb into 1 1/2 cubes. Cut cabbage into quarters, remove cores. Slice into 2 inch slices. In a 5 or 6 quart ovenproof casserole dish, arrange lamb, cabbage, pork belly slices, egg yolks, sesame seeds, ground cumin, chile, and italian herb seasoning.

Random Ingredients: mussel,meat,tomato ketchup,green bell pepper,soy sauce,green pepper,marjoram
title: Yummy Mussels
ingredients: 1 kg fresh mussels | 1 tablespoon tomato ketchup | 1/4 cup soy sauce | 1 green pepper, chopped | 1 green pepper, chopped | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley | 1/2 teaspoon marjoram
instructions: Scrub the mussels in a sink of water. Discard any shells that can be opened without breaking them. Soak until the shells open for 15 minutes, then remove the beards. Discard any mussels that have cracked or cracked shells or shells. Cut each mussel in half lengthways. Rinse under cold running water and remove any shells that have cracked or cracked shells. Remove any shells that have cracked or cracked shells. Wash the shells thoroughly and dry thoroughly. Place the shells on a baking tray and pour about 1/4 inch boiling water over the shells. Broil the shells for a minute or two, or set aside. To make the sauce, combine the tomato ketchup, sweet soy sauce, green and red peppers, chopped parsley, and marjoram. When you want to serve this in the traditional manner, pour the sauce over the mussels, dividing them among them. Top with croutons or boiled potatoes.

title: Jamaican Bloody Mary
ingredients: 3 roma tomatoes, seeded and chopped | 12 sprigs tarragon ( leaves only ) | 3 tablespoons dry sherry wine | 3 tablespoons dijon mustard | 3 tablespoons premium tequila | 3 -4 tablespoons angostura bitters
instructions: Mix all the ingredients and keep in the refriderator.

title: Cream Soda Bread Crackers
ingredients: 1/4 cup whipping cream | 1 teaspoon baking soda
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Butter 3 - 5 or 6 1/2 inch loaf pans with 1 tablespoon soft butter, 3/4 cup cream, and ½ teaspoon baking soda. Cut batter in half crosshatch lines, then each half into 4 circles. Spread top with remaining butter. Sprinkle tops with remaining ½ teaspoon of baking soda. Bake in preheated oven for 5 to 7 minutes, or until puffed and golden and top is golden. Allow bread to cool to room temperature. If desired, loosen sides with a small knife. Cool completely, then store in airtight container at room temperature, at least 3 days. Cut into 16 triangles using a 1 1/4 inch biscuit cutter.

title: Chipotle Beef Tacos
ingredients: 3 lbs beef chuck, cut into 1 1/2 inches squares | 3 lbs good quality sausage, cut into 1 1/2 inch pieces ( i prefer joes of your choice ) | 3/4 teaspoon smoked paprika | 10 -15 tortillas ( depending on size ) | 3 -4 chipotle peppers, canned
instructions: The day prior to making the tacos, place chuck in a deep bowl with a piece of smoked paprika on top. Add about a third of the chipotle pepper to the bowl with the chipotle. Pour the entire contents of the entire contents of the chipotle pepper jar into the bowl with the pork and beef. Marinate in the refridgerator overnight. If you need more than you'd normally do, go somewhere else. If you find the mixture is dry, take another third of the chipotle pepper jar with the contents of the jar and place it in the next step. When you're going to fry the tacos, you will want to brown the meat a little at the bottom side, about 5 minutes later. Using a couple of spatulas, turn the meat so the top side is just browned, about 15 seconds on each side. Using the rest of the chipotles, add about seven or eight tablespoons of hot oil to a frying pan over medium heat and saute the meat until very crispy and cooked through. Drain the oil reserving about a teaspoon or two. Use a little oil to make the tacos, if necessary. Add the meat to the warm frying pan along with a couple of taco shells, chopped fresh tomatoes, shredded lettuce, and crumbled chips to serve along the way. Don't forget the extra crispness from the cheese.

Random Ingredients: rice wine,red pepper flake,pickling onion,thai chile,topping,oatmeal
title: The Best Thai Peanut Soup Ever
ingredients: 20 ounces topping frozen mixed vegetables ( carrots, green beans, celery, spinach, peas, asparagus ) | 1/2 cup rice wine, rice vinegar or 1/2 cup white vinegar | 2 thai chiles | 1/2 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 2 tablespoons dried toasted oatmeal | 1 medium firm shallots or 1 medium walla walla onion
instructions: Drain vegetables and let dry at room temp. Cut veggies into smaller pieces. Combine all ingredients in a large stock pot. Bring to a boil. Cover pot and simmer 20 minutes or until vegetables are tender. Serve hot.

title: Gruntney® Sage and Vinegar
ingredients: 1/3 cup white sugar | 2 1/2 teaspoons finely dried sage leaves, crushed
instructions: Using a mortar and pestle, crush the basil to fine crumbs. Mix in the sugar. Stir in the sage. Cover and refrigerate 1 to 2 hours.

title: Healthy & Low Fat Vegetable Barbecue
ingredients: 4 baby carrots | 1 cup fresh greens leaves | 4 leaves chard leaves | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 1/2 cup fat-free refried beans | 1/2 teaspoon italian seasoning
instructions: Microwave carrots for 2 minutes, then cook on high uncovered for 3 minutes, or until just softened, to make them a little chunky. Transfer carrots to a bowl and toss with beans and italian seasoning. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: ice water,potato starch,lettuce leaf,thyme sprig,filling,peanut oil vegetable
title: Potato Flower Filling for Pierogi Bites (Pan-Fried Potato Flower Filling)

instructions: Mix potato starch, potato starch, and 1 tablespoon water together until mixture is smooth. Stir in enough ice water to make a smooth paste. Cover, and refrigerate for at least 1/2 hour. Divide poppy flowers between 2 small dishes.

title: Avocado Spread II
ingredients: 4 large avocados - peeled, pitted and chopped | 8 ounces plain sweet biscuit | 3/4 cup chopped fresh parsley | 1/2 cup ghee | 1 tablespoon dried chili pepper flakes ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground allspice
instructions: Mash avocados until smooth using a fork. Mix in biscuit, parsley, ghee, chili flake, and allspice. Serve with chapati.

title: Noodles With Meatballs
ingredients: 200 g noodles, medium size, washed | 1 kg ground meat ( i had to use lean ground meat ) | 2 cups of sweet sherry wine | 1 pinch allspice
instructions: Add sherry and allspice into meat mixture and mix thoroughly. Add noodles and mix thoroughly. Using your hands, form meatballs and bake in oven or oven tray at 200c for 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: white miso,bamboo shoot,leek,coconut oil,green cardamom,vegetable broth,penne pasta,rump roast
title: Penne Pasta With Shredded Pork
ingredients: 4 leeks, washed and finely sliced thin | 1 1/2 cups vegetable broth | 3 tablespoons grated coconut oil | 3 tablespoons white miso, sesame paste or 3 tablespoons regular miso | 1 1/2 - 2 lbs rump roast, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 package dry penne pasta or ( 16 ounce ) package other egg shaped penne pasta | 1 can bamboo shoots, drained, rinsed and diced | 1 green cardamom, lightly crushed
instructions: In a skillet, saute leeks in vegetable broth over medium heat about 3 minutes until tender. Set aside. Meanwhile, in a medium bowl, combine miso paste with 2 t. Of the coconut oil. To serving dish, top with half of meat in a thin layer, then sprinkle with half of miso paste and half of the bamboo, green cardamom, and remaining coconut oil. Repeat layering until all ingredients are used, ending with miso and remaining meat. Serve hot. Garnish with remaining green cardamom if desired.
