title: Hungarian Apple Cheese Appetizers (Appetizer)
ingredients: 6 ounces mild italian cheese | 1 can sliced peaches, drained | 6 flour tortillas, cut into quarters | 3 tablespoons hungarian paprika | 1 tablespoon dried coriander powder | 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper | sweetened apple juice or apple juice
instructions: Cut cheese into 1/4 inch cubes and sprinkle into a small bowl.

Random Ingredients: curd cottage cheese,porcini mushroom,lemon peel,brown rice
title: Mushroom and Lemon Dolmas
ingredients: 1 package small curd cottage cheese | 1/2 cup brown rice ( white ) | 1 tablespoon grated lemon peel | 1/2 lb fresh porcini mushrooms, cleaned
instructions: Heat the cottage cheese and brown rice. Dill the lemon peel in some of the water and then add it. If the contents of the can stand to be eaten, drain out the flavorings. Put the mushrooms on top and cover with cheese, stirring frequently.

title: Fluffy Almond Brittle (Aka Gluten-Free)
ingredients: 2 cups blanched almonds ( skin on is best. ) or 2 cups ground almonds ( skin on is best. ) | 1 1/2 cups vanilla extract | 2 teaspoons ground almond extract | 5 teaspoons tabasco sauce ( or other hot pepper sauce for sweeter taste )
instructions: Grind almonds in food processor or blender with a generous amount of space between them. Place in bowl and toss with the other ingredients. Coat hands with nonstick cooking spray. Store in air tight container. This is a sweet spice spread of choice, and i prefer it. Use 3 teaspoons for each 3 tablespoons of almond cream.

title: Cashew-Avocado Smash
ingredients: 4 lbs ripe organic avocados, and 1 pound of skins | 2 tablespoons old bay seasoning | 1 teaspoon curry powder | 1 cup cashews, finely chopped
instructions: Mash up avocados and transfer to a large bowl. Add old bay and curry powder, stirring well to blend well. Add remaining seasonings, including cashews. Mix well, allow to sit at room temperature for 1 hour prior to using, toss to coat and serve at room temperature.

title: Spicy Chipotle Tortilla
ingredients: 1 tablespoon chipotle salsa ( chipotle flavored ) | 8 ounces white pearl onions | 15 -20 dates, fresh pitted and halved | 2 large fresh eggs, beaten
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees fahrenheit. Spray a 10 inch nonstick frying pan with pam. Cut onions in half through the root end, leaving 1/2 inch whole portion attached. Sprinkle 1 teaspoon salt onto onions. Place potatoes into large mixing bowl and add salsa. Cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes. Line nonstick frying pan with parchment paper. Remove salsa mixture from refrigerator. Dip both sides of cooked onion halves into eggs, then coat with salsa mixture. Arrange onion halves in prepared frying pan. Bake in preheated oven for 15 minutes or until golden brown on bottom.

title: Frijoles Borrachos (Mexican Pizzal Appetizer)
ingredients: 1 jar pimientos, chopped | 1 can cannellini beans | 1 chipotle pepper
instructions: Drain canned beans, and rinse pimentos and pick out the seeds as desired. Place in a mixing bowl, and mash with a potato masher. The mixture should be a thick paste, slightly creamy looking. Add chipotle pepper and mash to desired texture for you. Spread over french bread or other pizzas, and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: beef,white kidney bean,ginger,ginger garlic paste,red lentil
title: Crock Pot Red Lentil and Beef Stew
ingredients: 2 lbs ground beef | 8 garlic cloves, crushed | 2 tablespoons ginger-garlic paste | 4 cans red lentils | 1 can white kidney beans
instructions: Brown beef and garlic in large skillet on medium heat. Drain fat and stir in spices. Pour undrained lentils and beef mixture into crock pot and stir to mix well. Simmer on low setting 4 - 6 hours. Serve with hot bread and pickled mustard on the side.

title: Quick and Easy Crock Pot Yeast Bread
ingredients: 1 packet dried yeast | 2 cups corn kernels ( fresh or frozen ) | 2 cups egg noodles, uncooked
instructions: Put corn kernels and corn meal in your crock pot. Put dry yeast into a large mixing bowl and sprinkle with 3/4 cup water. Wait 5 hours or so on high, and remove yeast from bowl and stir. Add remaining 1/2 cup warm water and stir until it mixes in the corn meal. Leave for 5 days on low. Add in noodles and mix well. You can divide this into 5 or 10 other loaf pans and freeze in freezer bags to serve. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: pork tenderloin,kitchen bouquet,garlic salt,olive oil,pineapple juice,lime zest
title: Pork Tenderloin
ingredients: 3/4 lb pork tenderloin | 1/2 cup pineapple juice | 2 tablespoons fresh lime zest | 1/4 cup pineapple juice ( fresh, canned is fine ) | 2 teaspoons kitchen bouquet ( or other cooking spray ) | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt
instructions: Lightly grease the grill. Cut tenderloins lengthwise into six slices, 2 to 3 inches wide by 2 inches wide. Put half of each slice in a baking dish, placing the remaining slices about 2 inches apart and leaving the cut surfaces intact. Heat grill to high. Remove pork from marinade with slotted spoon and arrange in the center of the grill. Cook, uncovered, over hot coals 15 - 20 minutes, stirring twice, until meat is brown and tender. For sauce, combine pineapple, lime zest, pineapple juice, kitchen bouquet and garlic salt in a heat proof bowl. Bring to a simmer and cook, stirring constantly, till sauce thickens. Serve sauce with meat.

title: Spanish Cheese Spread
ingredients: 1 lb spanish olive | 8 ounces pepperoni | 1/2 cup currants ( optional ) | 1 cup milk
instructions: Mash olives with fork or process in food processor. Mix in rest of ingredient and place in plastic container or dish. Cover and freeze.

title: Pasta With Creamy Turkey Breast

instructions: Soak noodles in very cold water for about 15 - 20 minutes to keep them soft.. Drain. Cook turkey in a frying pan. Meanwhile cook the egg noodles according to package directions, drain. When noodles are done, drain the water and set aside, just so noodles can absorb the hot water. In skillet mix the sour cream and soup. Fry turkey and noodles over medium heat until noodles are tender and turkey and noodles are done. Put noodles on a plate and add turkey and sour cream mixture to noodles and serve.

title: Southern Style Pepper Potatoes
ingredients: 4 medium red potatoes | 1 tablespoon fresh ground pepper
instructions: Preheat over to 400°f place potato skins on a nonstick rimmed baking sheet, about 4 or 5 inches apart. Bake 15 - 20 minutes, or until tender. Cool slightly, and cut into 2 inch pieces. Place in a bowl, coat with cooking spray, and toss with pepper. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: granny smith apple,white bread,whipping cream,part mozzarella cheese,beef chuck,red wine vinegar,asafoetida powder
title: Asafetida Beef
ingredients: 4 slices white bread, crusts removed | 1/4 cup whipping cream ( optional ) | 1 pinch asafoetida powder | 1/2 lb lean ground beef chuck | 1/3 cup red wine vinegar | 3/4 cup granny smith apple, chopped | 1 1/2 cups shredded part-skim mozzarella cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Place bread slices on cookie sheet.

title: Italian Anise Oil Paste for Fish --
ingredients: 3/4 cup olive oil ( good quality, can use extra virgin olive oil, as an alternative ) | 3 tablespoons anise oil ( can use white anchovy paste )
instructions: Add the oil to your mortar and pestle at least 2 hours before you are planning on eating the fish.. If possible, make it the day before so the flavors will intensify as the oil becomes infused with the anise oil. After 3/4 hours, remove the pestle from the refrigerator and allow it to dry out for an hour and a half. Store in an airtight container.

title: Orange Batter
ingredients: 1/2 cup orange zest | 1/2 cup cold water
instructions: Cut peel off orange. Wash, dry and grate zest about 1/2 inch wide. Combine grated peel with zest, water and orange zest in heavy medium saucepan. Place over medium high heat and bring to boil. Cover and reduce heat.

title: Tomato Pizzas
ingredients: 12 italian plum tomatoes | 1 tablespoon pernod | 1/3 cup dry pernod | 1/3 cup pure olive milk | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 1 tablespoon grand marnier or orange liqueur
instructions: Heat oven to 350 degrees. Place tomatoes in a single layer on a foil lined baking sheet. Bake 1 to 11 minutes, until skins are wrinkled. Let cool. Scoop out seeds and skins. Remove and discard pulp from tomato shells. Cut tomatoes lengthwise 1/4 inch thick. Place tomatoes, tomatoes, pernod and parmesan in a blender or food processor. Pulse until mixed well. Pour the tomato puree into a bowl and stir in remaining ingredients. Pour into cherry shells. Serve.

Random Ingredients: clove,beef tenderloin,chicken bouillon granule,genoa salami,cooking spray,cumin
title: Grilled Sicilian Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: cooking spray | 2 large chuck steaks, trimmed | 3 slices genoa salami | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon granules | 1/2 teaspoon ground cloves
instructions: Preheat grill for medium heat, and lightly oil the grate. Spray a 9x13 inch baking dish or roasting pan with cooking spray. Place steak in baking dish, and sprinkle with salt. Brush with cooking spray, and press into the steaks, being careful not to press into the meat. Reserve the remaining cooking spray. Cook steak on the same hot grill for 13 to 14 minutes, or to desired doneness. Cut into 1/2 inch thick slices, and serve over the cooked meat.

title: Yummy Phyllo Beef Bake
ingredients: 2 lbs ground beef, cooked | 1/2 cup soymilk | 1/2 cup low sodium beef broth | 1 teaspoon garlic salt | 1 package frozen phyllo pastry sheets, thawed and patted dry | 1/2 cup reduced fat mozzarella cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°. Spray a 9x13 inch heavy baking pan with nonstick cooking spray. In a skillet, cook beef over medium high heat until no longer pink, breaking it up with a spoon. Drain juices. Stir in soy milk, broth, garlic salt and 1/2 cup of the beef cooking liquid. Bring to simmer. Remove from heat. Arrange 8 phyllo sheets, overlapping slightly, on the bottom of the pan. Add 1/2 cup beef stock mixture on top of the 8 phyllo sheets, leaving a 2 inch border. Sprinkle 1/2 cup of the mozzarella cheese. Repeat with 5 more sheets until all of the filling is used. Bake 45 to 55 minutes or until pastry is bubbly and filling is hot and brown.

title: Chocolate Fire Roasted Beans

instructions: Prepare rice according to package directions, except omit milk for the water. Spray a large nonstick skillet with cooking oil spray. Add beans and tomatoes. Mix well. instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a medium bowl, spread the wine evenly over the hazelnuts.

instructions: Trim cob from cob.

instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Whisk in pasta and 3/4 cup water. Cook, stirring, until al dente.

Cook for 5 more minutes and the rice to tender. Turn off heat. Cover lid and let sit for 3 1/2 minutes on low or up to 3 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand 2 minutes before removing from heat. Stir the beans and continue to stir until everything is nice and hot. Spoon into bowls and top with cheese.

title: Plantain Fried Stokes (Vegan-Friendly)
ingredients: 1/2 cup brown rice | 1 medium plantain, sliced diagonally | 1 cup rice cereal | 1 tablespoon old bay seasoning | 1 cup bread flour, plus extra bread flour for tossing
instructions: Mix rice cereal and old bay in a bowl. Heat a skillet to medium over medium high heat. Spray with nonstick spray and sprinkle a small amount of bread flour onto the skillet. Dip plantains into the flour, then add them to the skillet. Cook, flipping once, until lightly browned on one side. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: yellow lentil,rice noodle,golden syrup,broiler fryer chicken,beef broth
title: Liangbanian Chicken (Beef and Noodle Soup)
ingredients: 1 broiler-fryer chicken or 1 stewing chicken | 3 1/2 cups beef broth | 6 tablespoons golden syrup | 1/2 cup yellow lentils or 1/2 cup other yellow lentils | 3/4 cup rice noodles
instructions: Simmer broth over low heat, covered, for 15 minutes. Simmer, covered, for 20 minutes or until chicken is cooked through. Remove chicken or chicken from broth, reserving about 3/4 cup broth. Cut chicken into serving size pieces. Bring broth and reserved chicken broth to a boil in saucepan. In a small bowl, stir together golden syrup and reserved broth. Stir into broth, boil 4 - 5 minutes or until slightly thickened. Boil 2 - 3 minutes or until desired doneness. Meanwhile, soak noodles in warm water, drain. Return noodles to saucepan, stir in noodles and remaining broth. Heat through.

title: Breaded and Pigs
ingredients: 3 cups all-purpose white flour | 1 lb hamburger | 6 granny smith apples, peeled, cut into 1 inch pieces | 1 teaspoon ground mace ( optional ) | 1 can sliced canned peaches, drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. In a deep 6 cup non stick skillet, brown the hamburger with the apples and mace. Drain fat. Stir in the flour and cook for 1 minute. Drain apples. Stir the apple mixture into the egg batter. Drop from a teaspoon to coat the apples.

title: Jim’s Mexican Bean Chili II
ingredients: 2/3 pound fresh pinto beans | 4 anaheim chilies, seeded and chopped | 4 leaves fresh thyme | 16 leaves fresh coriander | 4 tablespoons corn oil | 1 1/2 pounds kielbasa, cut into large chunks
instructions: Place the pinto beans into a large container, and add enough cold water to cover. Allow to soak 24 hours. Meanwhile, place anaheim chilies, thyme, and coriander into a bowl, and mix with enough corn oil to cover. Place the kielbasa into a large pot over medium heat. Cook the kielbasa until almost crisp and browned. Drain the grease off of the cayenne pepper sauce, and set aside. When the beans are ready, remove them from the water. Drain the beans, and place them in a large pot. Cover each pot with water, or enough to cover the beans. Bring to a boil, and cook until just tender. In a food processor, puree the drained beans and pureed beans. Heat the corn oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add the pureed chilies and onions, and cook until the onions are deep golden brown, stirring frequently. Add the cayenne pepper sauce and the kielbasa. Continue cooking and stirring until the flavors have blended.

title: Apple-Pesto Chips
ingredients: 1 cup tart firm apple, peeled, cored, and shredded | 3/4 cup fresh pesto sauce
instructions: Toss shredded apple with pesto. Cover, refrigerate, and stir occasionally for 2 hours.

title: Tasty Spanish Quinoa Salad
ingredients: 12 ounces uncooked quinoa | 1 lb shrimp | 12 green cardamom pods, split | 15 fresh capers, rinsed and drained | 1 can chickpeas | 3/4 lb swiss cheese | 3/4 cup catsup | 3/4 cup catsup | 3 -4 teaspoons tabasco sauce
instructions: Boil quinoa in salted water until soft, about 15 minutes and then drain. Meanwhile, peel and devein shrimp and set aside. Rinse chickpeas and pat dry. Cut shrimp into 1 inch pieces and set aside. Sprinkle shrimp with cardamom pods and capers and put in a large salad bowl. Slice swiss cheese into cubes and arrange on top. When finished, pour dressing over salad and blend thoroughly. Taste it. If you feel necessary, add more catsup and tabasco. Serve immediately or serve right away.

title: Guisado Con Arroz Con Queso (Rice Cookies)
ingredients: 2 quarts self-rising flour | 1 cup queso fresco, finely crumbled | 2 cloves | 2 1/2 cups rice or 2 1/2 cups dry white rice, cooked
instructions: In a bowl, mix flour, queso fresco, cloves, and cooked rice. If mixture seems dry, add a few tablespoons of water. Roll dough into small balls and place on a floured surface. Cover and let sit for 30 minutes. Heat a 12 inch nonstick skillet over medium heat. Roll each ball into 2 inch long strips and form a cone shape around strips of cooked rice. Place the tortilla strips, cut sides down into the skillet and cook about 3 minutes per side, or until golden brown and crisp. Remove tortilla strips from skillet.

title: Yellow Rice With Saffron
ingredients: 2 tablespoons saffron | 1 tablespoon ground cumin | 1 tablespoon ground cumin seed | 1 teaspoon ground orange peel | 1 teaspoon vinegar | 1 cup yellow rice, uncooked
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon saffron, 1 tablespoon ground cumin, 1 tablespoon ground cumin, and 1 teaspoon ground orange peel in a saucepan over low heat until fragrant, about 10 minutes. Remove from heat and let sit for 20 minutes to draw out all the flavors. Stir vinegar and remaining teaspoon of each ingredient into the remaining saffron mixture and bring to a boil. Add rice to boiling water in a thin stream, then cover and remove from heat. Let stand covered 20 minutes to absorb the flavors. Stir contents of spinner into the rice. Fluff rice with a fork and serve.

title: African Collards
ingredients: 1 pound collard greens, stemmed and chopped | 3 slices fresh ginger-filtered red pepper
instructions: In a large skillet over medium heat, combine the collards, red pepper and ginger. Cook, stirring, until vegetables are tender and the color of ginger is a rich, dark brown, pour in the juice from the skillet. Cover and cook 10 minutes, or until greens are tender.

Random Ingredients: russet potato,sushi rice,orange juice,shortening,fish sauce,red pepper,yellow pepper,seasoning salt
title: Cambodian Sweet Potato & Pepper Sushi
ingredients: 3 cups japanese sushi rice ( koshihiki ) | 1 lb russet potato | 1/3 cup shortening ( i used lard ) | 1/3 cup red pepper ( can use green ) | 1/3 cup yellow pepper ( can use black ) | 1/2 cup orange juice | 2 tablespoons fish sauce | seasoning salt
instructions: Peel & cut potatoes into about 2 inch cubes. In a medium size heavy bottomed pan, add shortening and fry until golden colour & melted, set aside. Add red & yellow peppers to pan & fry for about 3 minutes. Add rice & seasoning salt to taste, fry until rice is coated well with mixture. Stir to coat rice as much as possible & add orange. Serve hot with a side of sliced vegetables & fresh fruit, steamed white rice & hot steamed sweet potatoes or steamed jasmine rice if desired.

Random Ingredients: superfine sugar,chocolate chip,green chili,sherry wine vinegar,red wine,steak
title: Chile-Tex-Mex Flank Steak
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sherry wine vinegar, divided | 1/2 teaspoon superfine sugar | 1 1/4 lbs top round steaks, cut diagonally at 1 inch intervals, tips trimmed | 1 cup sweet red wine | 1 medium green chili, seeded and thinly sliced | 1 ounce unsweetened chocolate chips ( optional )
instructions: In a large, shallow baking dish, combine half the vinegar and the sugar. Add the steaks, turning to coat. Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour. Bring the wine to a boil in a medium saucepan. Add the chile, lower the heat and simmer, covered, for 1 minute or until the chiles are tender. Add the remaining vinegar and sugar and simmer for 2 or 3 minutes to bring out the flavors. Transfer the sauce to a saucepan, add the remaining vinegar and sugar and simmer for 1 minute. Spread the chocolate chips over the steaks and broil them, covered, for 1 to 2 minutes or until melted. Transfer them to a plate and serve.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack cheese,date,cashew,milk,tiger shrimp,black bean sauce,bay seasoning,alfalfa sprout
title: Yummy Tiger Shrimp Casserole
ingredients: 2 lbs raw tiger shrimp, peeled | 1 can pitted prune pitted dates ( reserve 1/2 cup liquid ) | 6 ounces alfalfa sprouts | 1/4 cup cashews, ground | 1/2 teaspoon old bay seasoning ( dry or sweet ) | 1/4 - 1/2 cup skim milk | 1 - 1 1/2 cup monterey jack cheese, grated | 1 can black bean sauce, warmed
instructions: In a deep frying pan, add 1/4 cup of the reserved date liquid and water. Cook on medium low heat until the shrimp have turned opaque, and the shells are no longer translucent. Meanwhile, in a medium saucepan on medium heat add the pitted prunes and drained and rinsed prunes. Cook on medium for 7 - 8 minutes. Turn off the heat. Drain the prunes and pitted prunes well under cold water, then mash to a semi smooth paste. To make the black bean sauce, heat the cashew nuts on a heavy duty sauté pan or griddle until the nuts are lightly browned and the sauce is fragrant but not burned. Drain and set aside. When the shrimp are cooked, drain them, and run the zested half over the shrimp. Melt the sauce while the shrimp are still warm. Add the shrimp back in to the sauce to warm through. In a large mixing bowl, mix together the drained prune and prune sauce with the cooked black bean sauce. Place half of the cooked shrimp in an oven proof baking dish. Spread the shrimp evenly with the black bean mixture, and top with half of the cheese. Sprinkle the remaining cheese on the shrimp. Bake the shrimp for 20 - 25 mts, stirring every 5 - 10 minutes, until browned on top. Allow 5 - 10 mts for good texture.

Random Ingredients: red pepper flake,asiago cheese,ladyfinger,mace,date,thai fish sauce,pinto bean,cherry
title: Quick Chickpea Snack With Two Cheeseses and Dates
ingredients: 28 ounces can pinto beans, drained | 1 1/2 teaspoons crushed red pepper flakes | 24 cherry tomatoes, seeded and diced ( about 1/2 c | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace | 8 dried dates, finely chopped | 3 tablespoons asiago cheese, grated | 10 ladyfingers, halved | 1 teaspoon thai fish sauce
instructions: Drain rinsed and drained pinto beans. Stir in red pepper flakes, cherry tomatoes, mace and dates. Set aside. Spoon mixture into a lightly oiled 8 cup size ring type or round casserole dish. Sprinkle evenly with cheese, and top with ladyfingers. Dot with fish sauce, pressing gently to fit. Bake uncovered, at 400 degrees for 20 to 30 minutes, or until cheese is melted.

Random Ingredients: red onion,daikon radish,greek yogurt,navy bean,white vinegar
title: Nif's Basic Nomaki
ingredients: 5 cans navy beans, drained and rinsed | 1 1/2 small red onions or 1 small red onion | 2 1/2 cups white vinegar | 1/2 - 3/4 cup greek yogurt or 1/2-3/4 cup sour cream | 1/2 cup nif's plain fat free greek yogurt
instructions: Place all ingredients in a pan, and heat slowly to boiling. Turn heat off, and let this sit 3 to 4 hours before you eat.

title: Cauliflower
ingredients: 1/2 cabbage | 8 ounces cooking sherry | 5 ounces butter | 3 ounces barley | 3 ounces tea bags
instructions: Take out the cabbage and cut into small pieces. Take out the core carefully. Chop the cabbage and set aside. Place the butter and barley in a pan over low heat, stirring until the barley has been absorbed. When the ingredients are done, add the tea cubes. Stir until they are all mixed and the butter and barley are melted and the mix has the consistency of heavy cream. Taste and correct for salt or any other seasoning of your taste.

Random Ingredients: sage,self rising flour,fast rising yeast,pesto sauce,italian tomato
title: Pesto Crumpets (Pizzelle)
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups italian-style tomatoes, finely chopped | 1/4 cup pesto sauce | 4 1/2 cups self-rising flour | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground sage | 3 1/2 cups self rising flour
instructions: In a bowl, stir tomatoes with pesto. Stir 3 cups flour, sage and 3 1/2 cups flour into the tomato mixture. Mix thoroughly. Stir in 1 1/2 cups more flour at a time with a wooden spoon. You want the mixture to be a little wet, but not dry. Turn dough onto a lightly floured surface. Knead dough until smooth and elastic, about 5 minutes. Place dough in a lightly greased bowl. Cover with a clean cloth and let rise in a warm place, about 1 hour and 20 minutes. Lightly grease or oil a 12 inch nonstick skillet. Turn pan onto grease, and press pesto mixture into the pan. Roll the pancake into a circle about 2 inches thick on the underside of the pan. Cook in the preheated skillet for about 3 minutes, until underside is lightly browned. Turn pancake over, and cook the other side for about 3 minutes. Slide pancake onto a cutting board or cloth with a spatula, and cut into bite sized pieces. Serve warm.

title: Beef Tenderloin With Pimento Sauce
ingredients: 4 beef tenderloin steaks, 3 -4 inches thick | 2 1/3 cups ricotta cheese | 1 cup milk | 1/4 cup chopped fresh italian parsley | 3 tablespoons diced pimentos, drained
instructions: Place steaks between two sheets of waxed paper. Using a meat mallet or rolling pin, pound steaks to 1/4 inch thickness. Lay steaks on top of waxed paper, and pound to 1/4 inch thickness. Cover steaks with plastic wrap, and refrigerate for 20 to 30 minutes. Unwrap steaks, and let stand at room temperature for 5 or 10 minutes. When ready to serve, spoon ricotta cheese onto each plate, and top with diced pimento. Serve with meat.

title: German Beef and Bacon
ingredients: 3 slices bacon, diced | 1 pound ground veal | 1 1/2 cups dry white wine | 1 cup half-and-half | 1/8 cup corn syrup | 3 whole cloves | 3 green bell peppers, seeded and chopped | 2 tablespoons ground coriander
instructions: Place bacon in a large, deep skillet. Cook over medium high heat until evenly brown. Drain, crumble, and set aside. Increase heat to high and stir in ground veal. Stir in wine and cook until mixture is slightly dry. Pour in half and half and corn syrup and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer, stirring occasionally. Crush cloves with a mortar and pestle until aromatic. Stir in peppers and coriander, heat through, reduce heat, and pour into the cooked meat. Simmer until hot and thoroughly heated.

title: Basic Noodles (Yum)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs cellophane noodles or 1 1/2 lbs other long thin noodles | 3 tablespoons tamari or 3 tablespoons soy sauce | 2 cloves garlic, peeled, flattened and squashed to release flavor
instructions: Prepare noodles as per package directions. Add rest of ingredients to the hot noodles and toss. Serve plain or with some hot, spicy or sweet bread.

Random Ingredients: ice,meat,kidney bean,vegetable oil cooking spray,baby bok choy,cooking wine,jalapeno,onion powder
title: Kidney Bean Bok Choy
ingredients: 1/2 lb cooked kidney bean ( i use organic ) | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil cooking spray | 2 tablespoons onion powder | 1 tablespoon jalapeno, finely minced | 4 baby bok choy | 12 ounces frozen meat, thawed | 2 tablespoons cooking wine | crushed ice
instructions: Place first 7 ingredients in food processor in order listed. Pulse for 3 minutes or until finely chopped. Place bok choy in microwave safe dish and cover with sprayed veggie spray. Microwave on high for 3 - 4 minutes or until bright green. Microwave on high for 3 - 4 minutes or until steam escapes. Place meat in bowl of food processor with marinade and process until smooth. Place bean mixture into bowl with meat. Using a spatula, push bean mixture through feed tube. Add chopped ice. Cover and refrigerate for 6 hours or overnight. Note, i like to take a handfuls of frozen meat and thaw overnight in refrigerator. Then i use a metal spatula to toss the bok choy through the food processor until coated evenly. Cook on medium high, using a metal spatula, until lightly browned and crisp. Remove from heat and allow to cool for 2 - 3 minutes.

Random Ingredients: bean,parmigiano reggiano cheese,ancho chile powder,dark brown sugar,annatto seed
title: Chile-Rific Refried Beans
ingredients: 2 ancho chile powder | 4 ounces dark brown sugar, about 1 tablespoon | 1/2 cup dark beans, rinsed, drained and rinsed | 1 -2 teaspoon annatto seeds | grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese, optional garnish ( optional )
instructions: In a small bowl combine chile powder and brown sugar.

title: Pasta With Sage and Sage
ingredients: 2 cups dry rigatoni pasta ( farfalle, long-grain white, penne, or gemelli ) | 1/4 cup thinly sliced fresh sage leaf
instructions: In a large pot of boiling, salted water, cook the pasta until al dente. Drain and toss with 1/4 cup of chopped fresh sage. Repeat with the remaining pasta, adding a little water if the pasta seems dry, until the liquid just covers the pasta. Serve immediately.

title: Carneet Baked Thai Beef With Quinoa
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa ( jasmine or long grain ) | 1 cup coconut milk ( light or half & half ) | 1 large beef flank steak ( about 3/4 inch thick, sliced with the grain ) | 1 tablespoon fresh thyme sprig, chopped | 1/2 cup fresh basil leaf, slivers
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Rinse quinoa and soak it for 30 minutes. Bring 1 quart water to a boil, lower heat, and add quinoa. Cover and put into the oven. After 30 minutes, remove from oven and add coconut milk, beef, thyme, and basil to the beef. Bake for 15 more minutes until beef is cooked through and the sauce is thickened. Remove from heat, and mix in the cooked quinoa. If you’re making ahead and freeze the beef for later, allow it to be rehydrated at room temperature for up to one day.

title: Taquitos
ingredients: 1 lb round steak, thinly sliced | 3 -4 whole dried red chili peppers
instructions: Remove stems and seeds from chiles, tearing off the stems and removing any seeds. Wash and dry chilies, and set aside. Heat oil over medium high heat in a wide skillet, until the oil is just smoking. Place pepper slices into oil, and fry, stirring frequently, just until they begin to change color. Transfer peppers to a bowl, and set aside to drain. Return skillet to fire, and add meat and stir fry, scraping the bottom of the pan as necessary, until the meat browns evenly, 7 - 10 minutes. Spoon peppers into a bowl, and serve with the reserved chiles, and other condiments.

Random Ingredients: fennel,coconut cream,bread,cardamom seed,peanut butter,spinach leaf,sun tomato,pesto sauce
title: Prawns With Peanut Pesto and Spinach
ingredients: 16 ounces of chopped fresh peaches from around a can | 2 prawns ( raw or under 1 inch or 1 cm of shell ) | 1 tablespoon fennel ( see note ) | 4 -8 fresh spinach leaves ( or 12 bunches chopped or shredded ) | 4 -5 sun-dried tomatoes ( or 2 tsp of bottled sun-dried tomato concentrate ) | 100 g bread | 1 -2 teaspoon mixed dried pesto sauce ( optional ) | 1/2 cup coconut cream | 2 tablespoons sun-dried tomato-stirred pesto | 3 tablespoons peanut butter ( or a combination ) or 3 tablespoons soy sauce ( or a combination )
instructions: Note, you can buy prawn paste, make sure to chop, cut and remove beak from stems if you like. Also buy frozen prawns, defrost and peel. If using raw prawns, defrost and peel. Place chopped prawns in saucepan and stir over high heat until the prawns have turned pink, remove prawns from saucepan and slice up or chop up. Wash and dry the spinach and baby spinach and add to pesto and spinach and heat until wilted. Dice the sundried tomatoes, and drain on absorbent paper. Remove crusts from bread and crush with your fingers or a mallet or rolling pin. Spread the basil leaves or sun dried tomato paste onto bread and place into microwave for approximately 10 – 15 seconds until lightly toasted, add crushed tomatoes and mix. Spread pesto on bread, add prawns and spinach, top with grated parmesan.

Random Ingredients: dough,gelatin,lemon juice,italian salad dressing mix,extra virgin olive oil,seasoning salt,peach juice,lime zest
title: Peach Freeze Bread
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs loaf bread, cut into 1-2 inch cubes | 1/4 cup lemon juice | 1/2 cup extra virgin olive oil | 2 tablespoons gelatin | 1 lime, zest of | 1/2 cup peach juice ( canned or fresh ) | 1/4 cup italian salad dressing mix | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Toss the bread with the lemon juice. In a small saucepan, combine the olive oil, gelatin, lime zest and peach juice. Cook until the gelatin is dissolved. Set aside to cool. Stir to dissolve the gelatin and pour over the bread cubes in a 9x9 inch pan. Bake in the heated oven for 40 - 45 minutes or until toasted. Cool slightly and stir in the italian dressing mix. Remove the bread from the tin and shake off any excess. Spread the peach syrup on toasted bread and top with the warm peach syrup.

Random Ingredients: pesto sauce,bouillon cube,monterey jack cheese,pie shell,celery leaf,serrano chilies,ginger,creamy peanut butter
title: Crock Pot Teriyaki Shredded Steak
ingredients: 1 cup creamy peanut butter | 1/2 cup prepared pesto sauce ( not marinade ) | 1/2 cup finely chopped celery leaves | 1/4 cup finely chopped serrano chilies, seeds removed, finely chop | 1 tablespoon freshly grated peeled fresh ginger | 2 tablespoons creamy peanut butter, no substitutes ( may use light if it is not creamy enough ) | 2 cans prepared sandwich steaks, well drained | 2 instant pie shells ( may use refrigerated pie shells )
instructions: Combine peanut butter, pesto, celery, chilies, ginger, and peanut butter in the order listed. Place each steak in the base of a 5 or 6 quart slow cooker. Top with the peanut mixture. Press down, cover and cook on low for 4 1/2 hours. Uncover. Increase slow cooker temperature to high.

Random Ingredients: heavy whipping cream,hard egg,orange zest,wheat flour,english cucumber
title: Orange Cucumber Raita
ingredients: 5 tablespoons whole wheat flour | 12 medium hard unpeeled english cucumbers, peeled | 3 tablespoons heavy whipping cream | 1 tablespoon grated orange zest | 3 large whole-grain english cucumbers, peeled
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Place flour in a medium bowl.

Random Ingredients: watermelon,taco sauce,heavy cream,ginger ale,mango chutney,mustard,asiago cheese,almond flour
title: Mango Chutney Fondue
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups watermelon, seeded and cut into small cubes | 1 1/4 cups shredded sweetened asiago cheese | 1 1/4 cups mango chutney | 1/4 cup prepared mustard | 2/3 cup almond flour ( all purpose ) | 2/3 cup light cream | 1 1/2 teaspoons kosher salt | 1/2 cup prepared mustard | 1 jar taco sauce | 4 tablespoons heavy cream | 8 slices sliced fresh ginger ale
instructions: Combine watermelon, asiago, mango chutney, 1 1/4 cups cheese and 1 tablespoon mustard in the bowl of a stand mixer fitted with the paddle attachment. Blend on medium speed until the smoothness of a mango chutney mixture, 2 - 3 minutes. Transfer to a large bowl. Stir almond flour into cream, then stir into vegetable mixture with 2/3 cup of the mustard. Blend on medium low speed until mixed well and smooth, 1 - 2 minutes. Spread a scant 1/4 cup of the vegetable mixture in the bottom of an 8 inch square baking dish. Spread evenly with a spatula. Top with a layer of asiago cheese. Repeat until all ingredients are used. Dot with remaining cheese and pour in the taco sauce. Cover tightly with plastic wrap. Refrigerate overnight. When ready to serve, remove plastic wrap and serve with ginger ale.

title: Grilled Garlic With Pine Nuts
ingredients: 1 bulb of garlic, peeled, cloves cut in half & unpeeled | 1/2 cup pine nuts ( optional )
instructions: Soak nuts in water for about 20 minutes or until soft but not mushy. Drain well. Slice garlic and place on a large plate. Drizzle with pine nuts, if using. Enjoy.

title: Pico De Gallo (chipotle Pepper Spread)
ingredients: 1 jar seasoned croutons ( kroger brand may also be used ) | 1 chipotle chile, canned in adobo sauce
instructions: Wash and dry chile, then remove stems and seeds. Grind chile, using your hands or a coffee grinder to reach desired consistency, into a bowl, stir in chipotle. Cover and refrigerate.

title: Chili Rice
ingredients: 2 1/2 - 3 cups basmati rice or 2 1/2-3 cups jasmine rice | 2 -4 tablespoons chili paste ( to taste ) | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom
instructions: Wash rice thoroughly. Drain thoroughly. Set aside. Pour enough water to come up three fourths of the way. Heat chile paste in a non stick skillet over moderate heat until browned. Add rice and stir to mix thoroughly. Cover and cook until water is absorbed, 18 - 20 minutes.. Check after three minutes and stir. Cover loosely and keep on a warm platter. After five minutes add the cardamom and stir. If necessary, cover and cook the rice longer, until it is tender and all the water has been absorbed. Fluff rice with a fork and divide between 2 serving plates. Top with chili paste.

Random Ingredients: chicken thigh,vegetable stock chicken,rotel tomato chilies
title: Tex Mex Chicken
ingredients: one whole and boneless chicken thigh | 12 ounces rotel tomatoes & chilies | 1 cup vegetable stock or 1 cup chicken stock
instructions: Place the whole boneless chicken thighs on the bottom of a casserole dish. Cover the chicken with the rotel, onions and 1 cup stock. Bake in a 350f degree oven for one hour.

title: Crispy Skirt Steak
ingredients: 20 -24 ounces trimmed sirloin steaks ( can also use skirt steak ) | 1 can black beans, rinsed and drained | 1 1/2 teaspoons italian seasoning | 1 -2 drop food coloring
instructions: If you're planning to do the bratwurst, in a 9 x 13 pan place 3/4 of the beans. Cut steak into thick 2 inch strips and coat with seasonings. Place the beef on top of the beans. I use a spray bottle with high sides to keep the grease out of the meat. Then spray the steak with the food coloring in the bottle with the coloring. Cover and let marinate for about 8 hours or overnight in the fridge. Do not cook the beef over night. Do not add water to the pot. Add the remaining beans and stir well to combine. Cover and let stand 15 minutes, then drain. Serve over pasta or rice.

title: Grilled Goat Cheese on Skewers
ingredients: 2 lbs goat cheese, at room temperature | 1 lime, juice of | pepperoni, sliced | 1/2 cup marsala | 12 tomatillos | 12 feet hog casings, soaked
instructions: Place goat cheese on a cutting board and trim off most of the very large chunks of fat. If you have large pieces of goat cheese, cut into smaller pieces. Sprinkle lightly with pepper, lime juice and a drizzle of marsala. Using your fingers, make the goat cheese like you would for crepe dough. Cut the tomatillos in half. Thread onto skewers alternating with goat cheese and tomatillos using small saucer to hold the tomatillo portion of goat cheese inches soak skewers on oiled grill about 5 minutes on each side. Serve hot for dipping.

title: Easy and Delicious Mutton Kebabs from the Cape
ingredients: 150 g low-fat ground lamb | 450 g sliced beet, finely chopped | 4 tablespoons dark brown sugar | 1/4 cup tamarind pulp | 2 tablespoons mild curry powder | 4 tablespoons seedless grapes ( seedless can be used, depending on personal preferences )
instructions: Mix all together. Divide into 8 portions, form each portion into small kabs and put aside separately. Bake on the bbq or grill or in a grill basket until browned. Serve with sticky rice and tomato ketchup.

Random Ingredients: cayenne,tomato garlic,beef stock,garlic clove,confectioner ' sugar,molasses,dark rum
title: Ranch-Style Smoked Hamburgers
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dark rum | 1 tablespoon molasses | 1 garlic clove, minced | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne | 1/2 cup beef stock | 2 slices smoked beef or 2 slices thin slices streaky smoked turkey | confectioners'sugar
instructions: Combine the rum, molasses, garlic, cayenne, beef stock, and 1 teaspoon salt in a medium size pan. Cover and simmer slowly for 7 to 8 minutes, until liquid has reduced by half. Add the sliced smoked meat and simmer for 2 to 3 minutes, turning several times, or until desired doneness. Remove meat from the pan and stir until thoroughly blended and coated with the rum mixture. Serve with bread or rolls.

Random Ingredients: lemon zest,oat,parsley leaf,red apple,pecan,fenugreek seed,ricotta cheese,chicken meat
title: Eggless Baked Stuffed Pecan and Ricotta Apples
ingredients: 4 large red apples, such as red delicious | 1 tablespoon lemon zest, grated | 1 1/2 lbs ricotta cheese, drained well | 1 tablespoon dried fenugreek seeds | 1/4 cup pecans, chopped | 1 teaspoon dried parsley leaves | 3/4 lb fresh goat cheese, such as st. bart's ready manouri cheese, grated | 1/2 cup rolled oats
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f. Prepare apples by halving vertically on the tips. With a vegetable peeler or very sharp knife, peel apples, leaving 1 cm of shell on the outside of each apple. Remove peel and reserve. Cut out the core, then peel back the core and the white pith from each apple half. Cut each half into 1/2 inch thick rings with a sharp knife. Set aside. Place rack in a shallow roasting pan and brush apples with a small amount of warm water. Sprinkle with lemon peel, then sprinkle generously with dried fenugreek. Let sit until fenugreek is fragrant, about 5 minutes. Meanwhile, in a bowl, combine ricotta with the lemon zest, chopped nuts, grated cheese, oats and parsley. Stir until combined and smooth. Arrange half the pecan halves in the bottom of a 8 square baking dish. Brush generously with the filling and then top with a layer of the remaining pecan halves. Spoon half of the ricotta cheese mixture over the pecan halves, then add 1/2 the apples and spread evenly. Continue layering with remaining pecan slices and filling. Bake 30 minutes, then top with remaining pecan halves. Serve warm.

title: Rotel Yogurt-Bean Burgers With Yellow Squash Salad
ingredients: 1 large yellow squash | 1 container plain low-fat yogurt | 2 teaspoons finely minced red roasted cumin powder | 1/2 teaspoon cumin powder | 1/4 cup finely chopped low-fat rotel | nonstick cooking spray
instructions: Cut squash into very thin slices. Remove the seeds of the squash. Cut squash lengthwise in half and scrape out fibers. Place squash slices into a steamer basket or large bowl. Add yogurt and stir. Add cumin, cumin, rotel and mix. Cover and steam squash for 10 - 12 minutes. Place on serving plates and serve with grilled onion slices.

Random Ingredients: jasmine rice,pico de gallo,monterey jack cheese,thyme leaf,rice
title: Baked Pico De Gallo Rice
ingredients: 5 cups cold cooked rice | 1 cup shredded monterey jack cheese | 1 cup seeded and finely chopped fresh jalapenos or 1 cup pico de gallo | 1 jar pico de gallo ( pico de gallo ) | 1/2 cup chopped fresh thyme leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Line baking sheet with parchment paper. Combine all ingredients and transfer to a bowl. Arrange rice on baking sheet and bake for 20 to 25 minutes and or until rice is tender and lightly browned.

title: Swiss Mashed Potatoes
ingredients: 1 package instant chocolate pudding mix | 1 cup chopped tomato | 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 1/2 teaspoon ground allspice | 1 1/2 lbs small red new potatoes, scrubbed
instructions: Spray a 13 x 9 inch baking dish with nonstick cooking spray. In a bowl, combine the pudding with the stewed tomatoes, worcestershire sauce and allspice. Spread mixture in baking dish. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Bake covered at 300 degrees for 4 hours or until hot and bubbly. Remove from oven and let stand 10 minutes. Cut potatoes into 1 inch slices and place in serving bowl. Pour hot pudding over potatoes. Sprinkle with remaining 1 tablespoon dried parsley or chives.
