title: Chinese Cabbage Burgers
ingredients: 1 head chinese cabbage, washed, trimmed and finely chopped into big chunks | 1/2 cup orange juice concentrate, chilled | 1 teaspoon vegetable oil or 1 teaspoon cooking oil | 1 teaspoon crushed anise seed | 5 hamburger buns
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl and mix well. Form into 4 burgers. Grill, buns or rolls until medium grill marks appear. These may also be grilled over medium coals or in a moderate oven to the desired doneness.

Random Ingredients: chicken leg,oregano,gruyere cheese,horseradish,rigatoni pasta,red leaf lettuce,clove
title: Linguini Con Miele (Chicken in Sauce With Nuts and Gruyere Cheese)
ingredients: 2 lbs chicken legs, thighs, skinned and trimmed | 1 head red leaf lettuce, torn into bite-size pieces | 6 cloves, peeled | 4 tablespoons prepared horseradish | 2 tablespoons grated fresh oregano | 10 ounces rigatoni pasta, cooked al dente | 6 ounces gruyere cheese, coarsely grated
instructions: Place the chicken legs in a deep pan and add enough water to cover them. Bring to boil, reduce the heat slightly, cover and simmer for 45 minutes. Skim off any foam that rises to the surface. Meanwhile, remove the leaves from the head of red leaf, then tear or cut the leaves into 1/4 inch pieces. Place the leaves in a large mixing bowl with the hazel and 1/2 teaspoon of the oregano. Toss to coat. Heat the oven to 400 degrees f. Remove the chicken from the pan and arrange in a single layer in an ovenproof dish. Pour half of the sauce over. Sprinkle over the remaining 1/2 teaspoon of oregano, then half of the gruyere cheese and dot with 1 1/2 tablespoons of horseradish. Bake for 15 minutes or until browned. Top with the remaining gruyere and bake for 5 minutes more.

title: Olive Oil Babi O La
ingredients: 1/2 cup canned navy beans, in their liquid | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil, plus more for finishing | 12 tablespoons dark beer | 1 small handful scallion, finely chopped ( white and green parts ) | 4 large eggs | 3 slices fontina or 3 slices other artisan cheese
instructions: Rinse and drain the beans. Place them in a bowl with enough cold water to cover and let them soak until the morning. Drain the beans, reserving the soaking liquid, but keeping them hot. Discard the liquid. Heat the olive oil, beer, scallions and eggs in a large, heavy, deep skillet over medium heat until the oil is hot to the touch. Pour off the oil using a funnel or a slotted spoon. Add the drained beans with their liquid to the oil in a circular motion, stirring, and cook, stirring constantly, until the beans are nicely browned and the liquid is reduced by half, about 15 minutes.. Remove the mixture from the heat, sprinkle with cheese, and serve.

title: Roasted and Diced Red Wine Chestnuts
ingredients: 24 whole can water chestnuts, drained | 1 large garlic clove, peeled | 1/4 cup red wine vinegar
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f slice unpeeled garlic clove lengthwise, crosswise, into 1/4 inch thick slices. Arrange on rimmed baking sheet. Sprinkle chestnuts in half of slices, sprinkle with garlic slices, and drizzle with vinegar. Bake for about 12 minutes or until garlic is lightly browned. Let cool to room temperature prior to serving.

title: Tartarellas
ingredients: 2 cakes active dry yeast | 2 cups warm, room temperature ( about 105f for bread machine ) | 3/4 cup melted vegetable shortening | 3 cups crumbled paneer | 1 container frozen whipped topping, thawed | 25 -25 ladyfingers, split | 1/4 cup raisins | 1/4 cup minced garlic paste | 1/4 cup candied cherry, halved ( optional )
instructions: In large mixing bowl add yeast, shortening and warm mix until well blended, 2 - 3 minutes. Add 1 1/2 cups of flour and beat to blend. Stir in paneer and beat on low for 2 minute longer. On floured board, shape dough into a ball. Lightly flour your hands and roll out to 1/16 inch thickness. Cut into 3 inch lengths. Place on greased cookie sheet and let rise in a warm place until almost tripled in area. While dough is rising, prepare whipped topping. In one bowl, combine remaining ingredients. Dip half of each ladyfinger into hot fat, shaking off excess fat. Arrange half of soaked ladyfingers in the bottom of 4 cup ring mold. Place remaining ladyfingers on top of dipped ladyfingers. Dot with half of the whipped topping. Sprinkle with half of the raisins and half of the cherries. Repeat with remaining ladyfingers, raisins, and cherries. Bake at 375 in an ungreased, middle shelf of oven 40 - 45 minutes or until golden.

Random Ingredients: virgin olive oil,banana pepper,taco seasoning mix,bartlett pear,spring onion
title: Easy Faux Pears
ingredients: 2 large ripe bananas and 4 small avocados, seeded | 12 slices bartlett pears | extra virgin olive oil ( to coat ) | 1 package taco seasoning mix ( use one size packet if you plan on using a larger quantity ) | 3 tablespoons chopped spring onions
instructions: Cut the bananas diagonally into thick slices, about 4 1/2 inches long. Heat up a tablespoon of olive oil in a large non stick frypan. You want a light sear on each side. Remove bananas from pan with a slotted spoon and place on paper towels lined baking sheet. When all are done add a little bit more olive oil to pan and fry bananas until golden brown. Cut up pears with a very sharp knife or fork. Place pears in a bowl and cover with oil. To make taco taco seasoning mix mix, use a small bowl of taco seasoning mix. Add the drained bananas, spring onions, avocado and/or other taco seasoning mix. Mix well to combine and season to taste generously and chill for about 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: kelp,lettuce leaf,pre mozzarella cheese,vegetable stock,tabasco sauce
title: Sausage Wrapped Greenbeans
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs fresh greenbeans, trimmed | 1 3/4 cups vegetable stock | 3/4 cup reduced-fat kelp | 2 tablespoons skim milk or 2 tablespoons light cream | 3 drops tabasco sauce
instructions: Cook sausages until browned, about 5 minutes per side. Slice diagonally in half and discard ends. Meanwhile, combine stock with cheese and seasonings in a saucepan. Heat to bubbling over medium heat and reduce. Cover and cook until cheese melts, about 1 minute. Transfer to a bowl and top with sausages and greenbeans. Makes 2 servings.

title: Pasta With Yams
ingredients: 100 g yams | 50 g rye flour | 100 g cracked farfalle pasta | peanut oil | 1 tablespoon salted peanut oil
instructions: Cut each yam into four 1 cm / 10 cm / 2 inch x 1 cm / 4 cm / 5 cm / 1 cm / 1/4 inch squares, place on a microwave safe plate and microwave on high for 4 minutes. Take them out. Peel any large seeds from the yams. Heat salted oil and peanut oil in a pan on medium high heat. Add yam and fry on both sides until golden brown, 2 - 3 minutes. Drain on paper towel and dry. Place the noodles in a large serving dish. Add the fried yams. Sprinkle with peanut oil and serve immediately.

title: Sun-Dried Tomato and Walnut Dressing
ingredients: 1 ounce sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained | 1/2 teaspoon saffron, ground | 2 celery ribs, finely chopped | 1 ounce walnut pieces
instructions: Shake 1 oz can of tomato paste with some water to remove any excess oil. Add saffron and continue cooking for 5 minutes to soften. Add celery, then walnuts, toss and serve.

title: Stuffed Mushroom Pastry
ingredients: 3 porcini mushrooms, washed, trimmed and chopped | 1 package frozen phyllo dough, thawed
instructions: Spray a 9x13 baking dish with pam. Place mushroom pieces in the baking dish and cover them with the phyllo sheets. Stir together the remaining package of phyllo dough and the papar. Unfold the sheet and cut 4 squares for the top layer of pastry. Place 2 to 3 tablespoons of the mushroom mixture on top of the phyllo sheets, then top with 1 - 2 tablespoons of the mushroom mixture. Fold the pastry over the filling, pressing the edges together with your hands to seal. Turn the baking dish upside down onto a cutting board. Cut several slits in the top of the pastries so that steam can escape. Bake at 350 degrees f for 35 minutes, or until the pastries are puffed and golden.

title: Seattle Smoked Salmon on Spinach
ingredients: 4 salmon fillets, about 1 1/2 inches thick | 8 ounces fresh baby spinach | 1/2 cup vanilla-flavored gelatin
instructions: Prepare grill. When all sides of fish are firm flake with a fork and pat dry with a paper towel. Place fish on grill rack or platter and let stand 10 minutes. Lightly spray grill with cooking spray and heat until hot. Remove fish from grill and cover with foil. Spoon baby arugula over fish. Sprinkle with gelatin and serve.

Random Ingredients: romaine lettuce,dijon mustard,vegetable oil,broth,double cream,wheat flour,green
title: Warm Romaine Lettuce Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups whole wheat flour | 1 1/4 cups mixed greens, washed and julienned, washed well and dried ( swiss chard can be sub ) | 1 head romaine lettuce or 2 -3 romaine lettuce leaves | 2 tablespoons red-wine dijon mustard | 1/4 cup double cream | 1/3 cup vegetable oil
instructions: In a large bowl, toss the fresh greens with the dijon mustard and blend well. Stir in the remaining ingredients. Season to taste.

Random Ingredients: rice vinegar,sauce,beef roast,puff pastry,red chili powder,malibu rum,garlic
title: Crispy Blackened Beef Rolls.
ingredients: 2 lbs beef roast or 2 lbs eye round roast | 2 lbs puff pastry sheets | 2 tablespoons hot sauce ( anejo, cola, anejo blanco, anejo blanco ) | 2 tablespoons crushed garlic | 1/2 cup rice vinegar | 2/3 cup malibu rum | 2 tablespoons crushed red chili powder
instructions: Mix together all ingredients and smear on steak. Place on oiled rack of foil in roasting pan. Marinate in refrigerator overnight. Brush with marinade. Broil 1 - 2 minutes on each side or to desired doneness.

title: Stove Pot Beef Pilaf
ingredients: 1 small zucchini | 1 lb stewing beef | 1/2 cup chocolate chips | 1 1/4 cups corn oil | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon saffron
instructions: Slice zucchini in half width wise, sprinkle with salt and set aside. Cut beef into 1/2 to 3/4 inch pieces. Fry meat in hot oil until just cooked, in a separate skillet, brown bits on all sides. Remove pieces from pan. Fry zucchini in same oil until just tender and starting to brown. Remove from pan and set aside. Stir chocolate chips into oil, being sure to coat each piece. Add saucer of meat into the chips on top of the chocolate chips, then cover pan with lid or foil. Set aside in a warm place until ready to serve, preferably for half an hour. Serve with rice of your choice. You can also serve with crusty bread and salad.

Random Ingredients: kaffir lime leaf,dark brown sugar,sesame oil,lemon twist,oil,rib
title: Thai Beef Ribs
ingredients: 4 lbs bone-in country-style ribs | 2 lemons, cut in half, divided | 1/2 cup dark brown sugar | 1/4 cup sesame oil | 1/3 cup oil | 1/4 cup sauteed sesame seeds or 1/4 cup sunflower seeds
instructions: Rinse the ribs and pat dry. Place in large zipper lock bag, along with the lemon halves. Tie with string at 2 inch intervals. Sprinkle with 2 tblsps of dark brown sugar. Mix together the remaining 1/4 cup of oil and sesame oil. Pour over the ribs. Seal bag. Chill 2 hours. Preheat your oven to 275 degrees f. Place the bag of ribs in the oven. Bake for about 3 hours, turning over every 30 minutes. Remove from oven. Transfer all but about 1/2c of juices to saucepan. Add remaining sugar, sesame oil and crushed sesame seeds. Heat gently to boiling. Remove any fat that remains from the pan. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the sugar has dissolved. Boil a few minutes more. Remove from heat and skim excess fat. Serve over noodles.

title: Wrap-In-your-Hands: Butternut Squash Pies
ingredients: 1 butternut squash, peeled, cut into 4 chunks ( about 5 pounds ) | 1 cup bisquick
instructions: Preheat oven to 475°f and set a baking rack in the middle. Sprinkle the squash with salt and arrange on the rack. Bake until tender and slightly softened, about 20 minutes or less.

title: Yogurt & Snow Peas
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups plain yogurt | 1 cup snow peas | 1/4 cup sweet wine
instructions: Place the yogurt in a non metallic mixing bowl. Drain your snow peas and place them in a microwave safe bowl. Drizzle in the wine while stirring with the back of a spoon to deglaze. Cover with a towel and microwave for 2 - 3 minutes on high power until the peas are soft. Take out of the microwave and stir until completely warm. Stir in your peas and mix well. Serve.

Random Ingredients: baby beet,fruit,white flour,golden syrup,chicken,tofu,berry cranberry sauce
title: The Ultimate Duck Pie - for an Elegant Crowd
ingredients: 1 cooked whole duck, for roasting in the oven ( not cooked the night before as it will be dry on top ) | 150 g tofu, chopped | 1 cup mixed dried fruit | 1 cup mixed mixed berry cranberry sauce | 1 cup mixed seedless mixed fruit | 2 cups baby beets, chopped ( optional ) | 1/4 cup golden syrup
instructions: Roast duck in the oven with tots on until it is cooked, 20 - 30 minutes. Once cooked, remove to a plate and place on cutting board, cover with plastic wrap and rest for 5 minutes. Slice into small cubes. Slice tots using a small knife and brown under a preheated broiler or oven for about 10 minutes, turning frequently. Remove and cool. Once the duck is brown, remove from the oven and set aside. To make the beets, add fruit and cranberry sauce to the pan add all mixed dried fruit and mix well. Place in a large casserole dish. Add duck, and the sauce mix and place in the oven for 20 - 30 minutes. The duck may have to be cooked the day before the pie is ready to be served.

title: Plantains Chocolate Sauce
ingredients: 600 ml vegetable stock | 1 lb plantain, peeled and cut into 3 rounds | 1 ounce soft unsweetened chocolate | cooking oil
instructions: Bring the stock to the boil in a saucepan, add the plantain rounds and boil for about 10 minutes. Heat the oil in a frying pan, then soften the chips in it, remove and drain on paper towel. In a saucepan, heat the chocolate until melted and carefully stir in the hot stock. Serve the sauce with the grilled plantains.

title: Smoor Harina Pate
ingredients: 1/2 lb beef brisket | 2 ounces sultanas | 1 ounce dark beer | 2 teaspoons flour | 4 -6 chilies, finely chopped | 1 green chili pepper, finely chopped
instructions: Pound the brisket well in a meat mallet or a heavy cleaver. Cut off any excess fat. Slice thinly with cleaver blade cut into serving sized chunks. Place brisket, sultanas and beer in a dish pour over the flour. Dip the meat in the flour, shake off any excess. In a non metallic bowl, place the meat. Add your chile and chopped spring onion. Use two spoons to distribute the mixture between your hands until well combined. Place the bowl under a hot grill and cook the brisket for 15 to 20 minutes, brushing occasionally with the mixture and turning over with a fork. When the meat flakes easily with a fork, pour off the accumulated juices and place the meat aside to cool completely. Serve the pate warm with yoghurt, chutney or mustard.

title: Mexicorn
ingredients: 1 tablespoon unsweetened dutch-processed cocoa powder | 1 can mexicorn, drained | 1/2 cup golden raisin | 1 garlic clove, minced
instructions: Combine cocoa, corn and raisins. Spread over top of a double boiler in low heat. Cook, stirring constantly for 3 to 5 minutes until heated through. Pour into a large bowl or bundt pan. Serve with warm tortilla chips.

title: Guacamole Chili Sauce
ingredients: 1 can chopped chiles with juice | 1 cup prepared guacamole | 1 cup prepared broth
instructions: Stir together the chiles, guacamole, and broth in a saucepan.

title: Artichokes with Farfalle
ingredients: 1 package farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta | 1 can artichoke hearts, drained and chopped
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, stir in the bow tie pasta, and return to a boil. Cook the pasta uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the pasta has cooked through, but is still slightly undercooked, about 13 minutes. Drain well in a colander set in the sink. Preheat an oven to 350 degrees f. Mix together the artichoke hearts and green olives in a bowl. Pour the artichoke and olive mixture into a large bowl with the cooked pasta. Mix the hot pasta with the heated pasta until thoroughly coated with the artichoke and olive mixture.

title: Pizza Sauce
ingredients: 1 package wonton wrappers | 1/2 cup salsa verde | 1 cup flour | 2 teaspoons onion flakes | 2 teaspoons white sugar | 1 cup rice ( hot, your choice )
instructions: Heat oil in a medium sauce pan until warm. Add uncooked rice and onion flakes. Cook and stir until soft, 2 - 3 minutes, then stir in the rice and sugar. Drop the won ton wrappers in, one at a time, onto the oil. Cook for 5 minute or until they are crisp.

title: Rigatoni With Shiitake Mushrooms (Rachael Ray)
ingredients: 2 -3 tablespoons vodka, to taste | 2 lbs fresh shiitake mushrooms | 1 lb rigatoni pasta
instructions: Boil rigatoni until 'al dente'. Rinse and drain rigatoni and set aside. Put shiitake mushrooms in a pan and cover with 2 - 3 inches of water. Add vodka to cover. Bring the water to a boil and let simmer on medium heat for 15 minutes. Drain the shiitake mushrooms and reserve liquid. Sauté mushrooms and liquid until shiitake mushrooms are translucent. Meanwhile, boil rigatoni until al dente. Place rigatoni in a serving bowl and toss with shiitake mushroom sauce. Serve immediately.

title: Vanilla Dessert for One
ingredients: 1 package vanilla instant pudding | 1 teaspoon vanilla
instructions: Combine the vanilla pudding and vanilla powder. Pour into individual dessert dishes. Store in tightly covered container.

title: Pasta with Pineapple and Rice Nests
ingredients: 2 cups cooked falle pasta | 1 can crushed pineapple | 1 package wide rice noodles, cooked and drained
instructions: In a large bowl mix falle pasta, pineapple and rice noodles. Toss warm noodles with pineapple mixture.

Random Ingredients: coconut milk,diet lemon lime soda,garlic clove,purpose flour,kiwi fruit,vegetable broth
title: Fresh Kiwifruit Soup
ingredients: 7 cups fresh vegetable broth ( or canned ) | 1 1/2 cups peeled grated kiwifruit | 1 cup diet lemon lime soda ( about 4 limes ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons chopped garlic cloves | 1/2 cup coconut milk, light | 2 cups all-purpose flour
instructions: Heat broth to boiling over medium heat. In large kettle, combine kiwifruit, lime soda, garlic and broth. Simmer over very low heat, stirring occasionally 1 hour. Remove from heat and stir in flour until just blended. Cool 5 minutes. Pour into serving bowls and serve.

Random Ingredients: grainy mustard,fine sea salt,mint leaf,garlic,almond butter,baking powder
title: Almond Butter Spice Bread (Zwt II)
ingredients: 1 cup almond butter, soft ( i used unsalted, just not tub packed ) | 2 cloves garlic, finely mashed | 3 tablespoons fine sea salt | 3 teaspoons dried mint leaves, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon baking powder | 1/4 teaspoon dry grainy mustard
instructions: In bowl, mix all ingredients well with electric mixer. On low speed, beat on high until mixture starts to turn into a coarse crumb like consistency about 2 minutes.

Random Ingredients: swordfish steak,cheese tortellini,granny smith apple,soy sauce,red chilies,coconut milk,white wine
title: Filipino Steak with Crispy Tortellini Apples
ingredients: 350 g of japanese steaks | 3 fresh jalapeno chilies, sliced into thin rings | 350 g cheese tortellini | 150 ml coconut milk ( or more depending on your taste ) or 150 ml cream of coconut soup ( or more depending on your taste ) | 2 granny smith apples, sliced | 1/4 cup red wine ( or more ) | soy sauce ( optional )
instructions: Cook the tortellini according to instructions on the package or the size the package should be. Drain and set aside. Tear open the tortellini into large bite size pieces. In a big frying pan or wok cook the sliced chilies until dark in color. Remove from heat. Combine cooked fish with the chilies and macadamia nuts in a bowl. Toss. Add a few tablespoons of coconut oil. Heat through just before serving, add soy sauce if using.

Random Ingredients: brown sugar,flour,pork,heavy whipping cream,coriander,cayenne pepper,cremini mushroom,blueberry
title: Blueberry, Mushroom & Pork Pie Filling
ingredients: 1/2 lb cremini mushroom ( about 10oz ) | 1 lb ground lean pork | 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream | 1/4 cup brown sugar | 1 teaspoon ground coriander | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 2 tablespoons flour | 1 can blueberries | 1 bunch fresh coriander ( about 8oz )
instructions: Chop mushrooms. Mix pork and mushrooms with all the remaining filling ingredients except blueberries and fresh coriander. Fold in 1/3 of blueberries. Spread filling into the chilled pie crust. Arrange remaining blueberries on top. Bake pie at 400 degrees and cook 15 minutes, until crust is crisp and filling is hot and warm, garnish with fresh coriander sprigs.

title: Cambodian Beef
ingredients: 400 g rump steak | 1 tablespoon cumin seed | 400 g smoked hamburger | 3/4 cup fish stock | 2 teaspoons peppercorns
instructions: Score the rump with a knife or with a sharp knife then cut diagonally into 1 cm to 1 cm slices. Heat a little oil in a frypan and brown lightly the meat on all sides. Set aside. Return the pan to the heat and add the remaining oil, crack the cumin seeds and peppercorns and fry for a further minute or so then add the fish and fry for a few minutes. Now return the meat to the pan and add the stock. Cover the pan and simmer for 1 hour. Allow to bubble on top for a few minutes then check the seasonings and if necessary cook for a further 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon cube,yeast,chicken bouillon cube,green bean,plain flour
title: Green Beans Fritters
ingredients: 300 g green beans, trimmed & trimmed | 3/4 teaspoon instant yeast | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 1 beef bouillon cube | 2 1/2 cups plain flour | 1 1/2 teaspoons instant yeast, dissolved in | 2 tablespoons warm water
instructions: Scald the beans in a large saucepan and place in a large bowl of cold water to cover. Dissolve the boullion cube in the dissolved yeast and stir into the beans. Cover with a cloth and leave to rise 1 hour at room temperature while you mix up the batter. Cream together the flour and yeast mixture. Slowly add the warm water and beat until it forms soft but not sticky to the hand. Turn out onto a board and knead for about 5 minutes. The flour should be absorbed but it should remain slightly crumbly. Place a little more flour on your work surface and roll out the dough to make small finger thick flat pancakes. Place on a cloth lined baking paper and cover with a cloth. Set aside and continue with the remaining dough until you have used up all of the beans. Preheat the oven to 200c / 400°f / gas mk. Grease your fingers with a little olive oil or basting oil. Cover the bottom of a small casserole dish with flour, then add enough of the remaining flour to make a thick batter. Dip each finger in the batter and place in the dish. Cover with the top and sides of the dish to form a sealed lid. Bake for 35 - 40 minutes or until golden & crisp on top. Serve with yoghurt. Note, if yoghurt is too thick, you can add 1 tblsp water.

title: Green Pea Mascarpone Pudding
ingredients: 500 g shelled green peas | 500 g mascarpone, drained
instructions: Place the peas in a large saucepan, add 300ml/ 4 oz of boiling water. Cover with a lid or a tight fitting tin foil, bring to the boil, then cook over a low heat for 15 minutes, until tender. Remove the pan from the heat, discard the cover, and allow to stand for 5 minutes. Transfer the peas to a bowl and mash until smooth. Stir in a teaspoon of the hot cream over the peas. Serve immediately, garnished with sprigs of fresh mint leaves.

title: Luby's Rigatoni Soup
ingredients: 8 cups veggie broth | 1 1/2 cups small rigatoni pasta ( bow tie pasta ) | 1 cup shopped fresh spinach | 1/4 cup light aged cheddar and irish whiskey blend | 1/2 cup balkan coffee-flavored tea, such as horlicks bombay
instructions: In a pan bring veggie broth to a boil. Add pasta.

Random Ingredients: chili powder,garlic clove,rosemary leaf,black bean,kosher salt
title: Black Beans for Canning
ingredients: 1 lb dried black beans, picked over | 2 fresh garlic cloves, minced ( from a jar ) | 1 tablespoon fresh rosemary leaf ( from an individual sprig, leaves only ) | 2 tablespoons chili powder ( or to taste ) | 1 teaspoon coarse salt
instructions: Heat oven to 400°f. Place beans in a medium pot. Add water to cover beans by 1/2 inch over the beans. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat. Simmer until beans are tender, about 1 hour, stirring occasionally. Drain beans and discard any cooking water. Place beans in a large saucepan. Stir in garlic, rosemary, chili powder and salt. Bring to boil, then simmer 5 minutes. Transfer hot beans to a large bowl and toss beans to coat with sauce. Let cool slightly, then discard solids. Store warm in the refrigerator up to 3 days.

title: Easy Baked  (And Delicious) French Fries
ingredients: 1 cup icing sugar ( no added sugar or powdered sugar please ) | 1 teaspoon finely grated chicken bouillon ( or less if you don't like it too strong ) or 1 teaspoon other low sodium chicken bouillon ( or more if you don't like it too weak )
instructions: Using a pastry brush or two knives, spread icing sugar on a shallow tray. Stir chicken pieces in the icing sugar until evenly coated. Place strips onto a greased rack in a baking pan. Bake in a preheated oven at 425 degrees for 14 - 16 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Barley and Green Beans
ingredients: 200 g barley ( we used green beans. so you may now if you want, i'vefound that isn't ) | 200 g frozen green beans | 1 teaspoon coriander powder | 200 ml cider ( i used white )
instructions: Wash the barley and beans, snap off the ends, boil until clear and water is absorbed. In the meantime, boil an open flame for some time, then add the coriander powder. Mix well, pour over the barley and beans stir well.

title: Danish Hazelnut and Hard Boiled Egg Salad
ingredients: 7 -8 hard-boiled eggs, peeled, cut in halves, yolks reserved, and chopped | 1/4 cup chopped hazelnuts ( or toasted salted nuts ) | 2 -3 fresh berries, washed, drained, and cooled
instructions: Place hazelnuts and hazelnuts in a skillet over medium heat. Cook, stirring constantly, until hazelnuts are browned and just beginning to crackle and turn brittle, about 5 minutes. Immediately remove from pan and put nuts in a food processor, process nuts until very fine, about 30 seconds. With motor running, add reserved egg whites.

title: Cambodian Mushroom Cocktail
ingredients: 5 ounces fresh mushrooms | 2 ounces crushed cacao | 5 drops tabasco sauce | 3 ounces grand marnier
instructions: Combine all ingredients, stir until well blended. Serve in glasses over ice.

title: Easy Harissa with Honeydews
ingredients: 2 medium hasshilews melon | 1 can cannellini beans, drained ( reserve juice )
instructions: Cut off melon peel. Core flesh.

Random Ingredients: bacon dripping,brown rice,white button mushroom,xanthan gum,cream celery soup
title: A Simple Microwave Sour Cream Gumbo
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of celery soup | 1 can sliced white button mushrooms | 1/2 cup bacon drippings | 1 tablespoon xanthan gum | 1 1/2 cups brown rice, cooked and cooled
instructions: Empty the soup can of mushrooms and cream of celery into a microwave safe bowl and cover with the bacon drippings. Cover bowl with plastic wrap and microwave on high power setting for 5 minutes. Stir soup thoroughly and add to bowl with cooked rice. Mix well until well incorporated and microwave for an additional 15 - 20 minutes. Note, this is an easy way to do any kind of rice, i just use a silicon mat or parchment paper on my mat and my husband prefers metal.

title: Lemon Pastry
ingredients: 1 italian plum tomato, seeded and chopped | 2/3 package instant lemon pudding mix, divided in half
instructions: Process tomato and 2/3 packet of the pudding mix in a food processor to yield 1/2 cup. Spread onto a well floured work surface. Roll dough into a 12 x 7 inch rectangle. Cut into 4 x 2 inch triangles using a cookie cutter. Arrange in an 11 x 7 inch baking dish. Repeat with remaining dough and tomato mixture. Sprinkle the top with remaining 1/2 packet of pudding. Cover and refrigerate for at least 8 hours or up to 48 hours. Preheat oven to 350°. Brush top of pastries with remaining 1/2 teaspoon of cooking spray. Bake until pastries are beginning to brown, about 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: black olive,black bean,jasmine rice,cornflour,chili pepper,cauliflower floret
title: Cauliflower and Black Beans With Jasmine Rice
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cornflour | 2 cups raw cauliflower florets | 1 tablespoon cornflour | 2 -3 dried whole chili peppers | 1 cup canned black beans, drained and rinsed | 1/2 cup sliced black olives | 3 cups cooked jasmine rice
instructions: Cook cauliflower in a saucepan of boiling water for 3 minutes.

Random Ingredients: marjoram,heavy cream,yellow pepper,parsley,sea salt,yellow cornmeal,pineapple juice,pineapple
title: Sweet and Savory Yellow Cornmeal Sweet Corn Dessert
ingredients: 8 cups yellow cornmeal | 1/4 cup chopped fresh parsley | 4 cups heavy cream | 3/4 cup pineapple juice | 2 teaspoons sea salt | 3/4 teaspoon dried marjoram | 1 cup diced fresh pineapple | 1/2 cup fresh chopped green or red bell pepper | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh marjoram
instructions: Mix together the cornmeal, parsley, cream, pineapple juice, sea salt, and marjoram in a large bowl. Gently fold in the pineapple. Place the bell pepper and green or red pepper atop the cornmeal mixture, then add the diced pineapple. Pour the cornmeal mixture into a preheated griddle or large pot of boiling water, and cook to a firm but firm cornmeal mixture that is firm and bubbly with a snapy appearance, about 40 minutes. Remove the cornmeal from the heat, and fold in the chopped fresh parsley.

title: Crispy Green Chile Chile Strips
ingredients: 1 cup seedless grapes, halved | 1 can diced mild green chiles, drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with foil. Place grapes and chiles into a medium bowl, and toss to coat. Arrange in a single layer on the prepared baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until hot and bubbly, 10 to 12 minutes.

Random Ingredients: egg beater substitute,crouton,white wine vinegar,large shrimp
title: Shrimp on Toast - Shrimp in a Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 14 ounces large shrimp, in the shell | 1 1/4 cups egg substitute | 1/4 cup fresh bread crouton | 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar
instructions: Shell shrimp reserving shells for another use. Using 3 shrimp, devein and shell any extra. Cut the shrimp into 1/2 inch thick slices. Place shrimp, egg substitute, croutons and vinegar in medium bowl. Toss well to mix well. Spoon into 4 wrap. Bake on a baking sheet for 5 - 10 minutes at remove to wire rack and cool for a few minutes and serve. Great with green salad or other dippers.

Random Ingredients: red enchilada sauce,chicken bouillon cube,apple juice
title: Simple Baked Red Enchiladas
ingredients: 0.5 can red enchilada sauce, with 1/4 can water added | 1/8 chicken bouillon cube | 1/4 - 1/2 cup apple juice
instructions: First, make the bouillon cube. This should be done one cup at a time with the apple juice in a bowl. Once it is dissolved, add about 1/2 cup of apple juice. Pour the liquid mixture into a casserole. Then, in a small bowl, add the chicken bouillon dissolved in the rest of the apple juice. Pour this mixture into the casserole and cover the casserole with tin foil. Cook for 20 minutes at 375 degrees. Take the baked boudrerenego and add to the cheese mixture, mixing well. Spoon the cheese mixture back onto the chicken baking dish and serve.

Random Ingredients: garlic powder,ginger paste,vanilla pudding mix,kahlua,red onion,pecan
title: Kahlua Popsicles
ingredients: 8 ounces vanilla pudding mix | 2 cups pecan pieces ( chopped ) | red onion ( chopped ) | 4 tablespoons kahlua | 1 dash ginger paste | 1 dash garlic powder
instructions: Mix well using hands or large cutting board. Chill and roll into 1 inch balls. Shake each pop from sheet pan until coated in oil or butter. Roll in sugar and salt if desired. Refrigerate for at least 5 days before serving.

title: Easy Black Beans
ingredients: 2 cans black beans, rinsed and drained | 1 teaspoon instant minced garlic or 1 teaspoon instant minced garlic | 1 teaspoon beef bouillon
instructions: Press black beans against a strainer and rinse with cold water. Drain. Combine the dried minced garlic and bouillon in a medium saucepan with 3 cups water. Bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat to medium low, cover, and simmer for at least 30 minutes, or until beans are creamy and tender. Stir occasionally. Discard garbonzo beans, and serve warm.

Random Ingredients: hot dog,limoncello,yeast,flour,shiso leaf,red curry paste,yellow pea
title: Namasu Style Hot Dogs
ingredients: 1 cup flour | 1/4 cup red curry paste | 1/4 cup chopped shiso leaf ( kombu ) | 1 tablespoon dried yeast | 1 can yellow split peas ( kamaboko ) | 3 hot dogs, sliced | 4 cups thinly sliced nori-maki noodles or 4 cups thin spaghetti
instructions: Combine flour and curry paste in a large bowl and place in a heavy duty, cool dry pot. Dissolve yeast with remaining 3/4 cup water in small bowl and stir into mixture. Cover and set aside in a warm place to raise the dough. Place split peas and kombu on a kitchen towel, wring as much liquid out of the vegetables as possible and tear into small pieces, discarding any damaged or dry beans or damaged peas. Place hot dogs in a large bowl. Add approximately 1 1/2 cups flour mixture and toss to coat. Spoon the mixture into a very hot, shallow container, about 1/4 inch deep. Place in a 450 degree oven and bake until top becomes golden brown and crispy, approximately 12 minutes. Brush with more flour after each bake to prevent sticking to the bottom. Remove hot dogs from oven after 2 - 3 minutes and place on a paper towel to cool slightly. Brush each hot dog with remaining flour and fold over, allowing each to be fully coated. Place cooked hot dogs on a plate and place in refrigerator until ready to go. Place noodles in a large deep pot of hot water and bring to a boil. Immediately remove from heat and drain noodles. Place noodles on a bowl or serving plate and top with hot dogs.

title: Spiced Indian Spice Rub
ingredients: 1 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste | 1/4 teaspoon nutmeg
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Rub onto chicken pieces just before grilling as they will become rubbery. Note, for extra spice, use fresh ginger and garlic.

Random Ingredients: egg white,beef stock,cream cheese spread,serrano pepper,egg noodle,mozzarella cheese,white bean,tomato green chilies
title: Easy Noodle Chili
ingredients: 8 ounces egg noodles, cooked | 1 1/2 lbs ground beef | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies, undrained | 2 cups beef stock | 2 ounces softened cream cheese spread | 10 ounces egg noodles | 1 egg white | 1 teaspoon fresh minced serrano pepper | 1 cup mozzarella cheese, shredded
instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions. Rinse with cold water. Drain well. Brown ground beef in a large non stick skillet over medium heat breaking it up as it cooks the beef can break it up as it saute. Drain of any grease if necessary. Add diced tomatoes and beef stock. Bring to boil.

title: Vanilla Bean  and Yogurt Dressing
ingredients: 1/2 cup plain yogurt | 1/2 cup vanilla bean, scraped
instructions: Combine all together and adjust as necessary. Refrigerate.

title: Sake Stock (Yakitori)
ingredients: 3 ounces dashi kombu ( dried kelp ) | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder | 12 shallots, chopped
instructions: Put dashi kombu into a saucepan, add about 1 1/2 pints of cold water. Bring water to the boil then add the garlic powder and bring to the boil to dissolve the garlic. Drain kombu then squeeze out the water with hands to remove excess water. Heat up 1/2 pints of water then add the dashi kombu mixture. Bring to the boil until the water just starts to separate from the fish, but this time taste in a while to see if it's flavorful enough. To remove the flavor add some dried and chopped shallots, salt to taste. You may wish to add water that is too small.

Random Ingredients: chili powder,apple cider vinegar,fig,broccoli floret,red pepper flake,yogurt,red kidney bean
title: Italian Fig Salad
ingredients: 16 figs, large | 2 cups chopped broccoli florets | 1 can red kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 2/3 cup apple cider vinegar | 2 teaspoons chili powder | 1/4 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 1/2 cup plain low-fat yogurt ( optional )
instructions: PlaceFig and broccoli in a bowl of ice water to soften, about 10 minutes. Drain. Chop figs and set aside. Place kidney beans and cider vinegar in a blender.

title: Quick and Easy Alfredo Pasta
ingredients: 12 ounces uncooked fettuccine | 14 ounces sliced pepperoni | 11 3/4 ounces sliced pepperoni
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. Drain, but do not rinse. Meanwhile, heat oven to 375°f. Place 1/2 of the pepperoni slices in the bottom of a 13x9x2 inch glass baking dish. Top with 1/2 the fettuccine, and 1/2 of the pepperoni, slices across. Repeat layer and top with remaining fettuccine and pepperoni slices. Bake for 20 minutes, or until heated through.

Random Ingredients: brown sugar,liquid smoke,kaffir lime leaf,black peppercorn,alfalfa sprout
title: Grilled Caribbean Spiced Olives
ingredients: 1 pound fresh alfalfa sprouts | 3 tablespoons brown sugar | 1 teaspoon whole whole black peppercorns | 1 kaffir lime leaves | 1 tablespoon liquid smoke
instructions: Place alfalfa sprouts in a bowl. Stir brown sugar, whole black peppercorns, kaffir lime leaves, and liquid smoke together in a microwave safe bowl.

title: Crimson Fettuccine
ingredients: 1 cup dry bread crumbs | 2 tablespoons cornstarch | 2 tablespoons golden syrup | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom pod | 2 thai chiles, minced | 1 pound dry fettuccine | 1 pound squash, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1/4 cup cold water
instructions: Combine bread crumbs, cornstarch, golden syrup, cardamom, and chilies with fettuccine. Place in a large bowl. Add squash and toss to coat in crumb mixture. Cover bowl, refrigerate 30 minutes. Drain fettuccine, reserving 1 cup of the pasta cooking water, and add to bowl with squash. Toss with reserved cooking water until combined. To serve, place fettuccine mixture on a serving platter.

title: Spanish Tapas  (And Baked)
ingredients: 100 g high-protein flour | 100 g light sour cream | 100 g tomato ketchup | 300 g louisiana hot sauce | 1 teaspoon turmeric | 50 g browning sauce | 50 g kalamata olives, stoned, chopped
instructions: Preheat the oven at 190°c. Place the oil in an oven proof, non stick pan. Dust with flour and put on the oven shelf. Put in the hot sauce, tumeric and browning sauces. Mix. Pour over the tapas. Sprinkle with the olives. Bake for 20 minutes.

title: Noodle and Banana Pepper Filling
ingredients: 3/4 lb egg noodles | 1 lb banana pepper, cut in short, long strips | 1/2 teaspoon thyme | 1/4 cup citron, ground
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a medium saucepan. Bring to a boil over moderate heat. Cook, stirring occasionally, until vegetables are tender and beginning to wilt, about 5 minutes. Cool slightly, then stir into hot cooked noodles. Cook's tips, for an oozing filling with a bit of fat to aid in the crumbling noodles, refrigerate overnight for flavor enhancement. A few drops of oil or water may be added when filling.

title: Pepperoni Di Riso (Rice Balls)
ingredients: 1 cup long-grain white rice | 2 cups brewed coffee | 3 ounces pecorino romano cheese, grated | 4 slices prosciutto
instructions: Place the rice in a bowl and pour the coffee over. Let stand 30 minutes or longer, until the rice is clear. Roll each slice of pecorino over 1/2 the rice, pressing so that the pecorino adheres. Roll up the slices of briskly steamed cheese and slice into small triangles about 2 inches long. Place one slice of prosciutto on a cold, slightly damp cloth and press down to compact the slices. Wet your hands, then gently place a slice of prosciutto on top of each rice ball and press gently to compact it. Seal with a little coffee, and continue on, until the rice is full and the prosciutto is coated with coffee. Set the rice balls on a platter lined with a large dish cloth, and let rest for 15 minutes. Arrange them decoratively on the platter and serve.

Random Ingredients: black mustard seed,romaine lettuce,panir,grain rice,confectioner ' sugar
title: Panir Wrapped in Cress Leaves
ingredients: 2 cups leftover panir, cooked | 4 tablespoons whole grain rice | 1/4 cup confectioners'sugar | 12 large fresh romaine lettuce | 1 tablespoon black mustard seeds
instructions: Drain the panir.

title: Brazilian Banana Pepper Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup hot water | 4 medium bananas, sliced
instructions: Mix the hot water and banana peppers together. Cover and let sit 2 hours, stirring occasionally. Serve chilled. Enjoy.

title: Chipotle Sticky Chicken
ingredients: 8 chicken tenderloins, pounded to 1/4 inch thickness | crushed hot pepper flakes or hot pepper | 1 teaspoon salt, plus 1/4 tsp. | 2 ounces chipotle chiles, chopped, plus | 1 teaspoon adobo pepper flakes | 1/2 cup sweet pickle relish | 1 tablespoon unprocessed short-grain rice or 1 tablespoon uncooked wild rice, if using short grain rice | 1/4 cup ice water | 1/4 teaspoon baking soda
instructions: To make sauce, combine chipotle chilies, relish, rice, water, baking soda and 1/4 tsp salt in a small saucepan.

title: Sweet and Sour Fish Rolls (Crispy)
ingredients: 1 lb fish fillet, skinless ( such as orange roughy or halibut ) | 1 teaspoon dried basil or 1 teaspoon savory, crushed | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground dried chili pepper flakes | 1 teaspoon rice vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon clear honey | 1 sheet puff pastry | 1 -2 tablespoon rice vinegar | 1 -2 tablespoon clear honey
instructions: Put fish in a bowl and add the seasonings. Mix in well to coat fish, then add the rice vinegar and honey. Stir to mix well. Random Ingredients: hazelnut,russet potato,cilantro leaf,vidalia onion,grand marnier,pine nut,quinoa
title: Quinoa With Caramelized Onions and Smoked Hazelnuts
ingredients: 2 tablespoons pine nuts | 3/4 cup quinoa, rinsed | 1 large vidalia onion, halved, thinly sliced | 2 teaspoons grand marnier ( or other brandy ) | 1 1/4 lbs russet potatoes, peeled and diced small | 1/4 cup cilantro leaf | 4 tablespoons fresh cilantro leaves, roughly chopped
instructions: In a dry 3 - 4 qt saucepan, toast the pine nuts over moderate heat, stirring often, until golden brown, about 3 minutes. Set aside the nuts in the pan. In another 2 - 3 qt saucepan, bring the quinoa to a boil over moderate heat, cover and remove from the heat. Let stand until all of the water has been boiled away and the quinoa is fragrant, around 5 minutes. Transfer the quinoa to a bowl, stir in the onions and grand marnier, and let cool until cool to the touch, about 10 minutes. Return the quinoa to the pan, add the diced potatoes and sprinkle with the chopped 2 teaspoons of sugar. Stir the potatoes and half the cilantro over the onion mixture. Divide the quinoa mixture among 6 or 7 wide soup spoons. Sprinkle with remaining cilantro. To serve, spoon the quinoa onto serving plates and garnish with the remaining cilantro.

title: Vegan Spiced Spaghetti
ingredients: 300 g spaghetti | 1/4 cup soy sauce | 1 tablespoon nutritional yeast | 1 teaspoon coriander seed | 1 red potato, cut into thick matchsticks | 375 g mushrooms, sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c. Cook spaghetti in a large pan of boiling water for 5 minutes, or according to package instructions and drain. In microwave safe bowl over a small litre of boiling water for 20 seconds, or according to package directions, and drain spaghetti. Pour all except spaghetti and mushroom into a large bowl, and add 3/4 cup of soy sauce, nutritional yeast and coriander seeds. Stir well to combine, then divide between 5 individual ovenproof bowls, placing them on a tray. Place potatoes and mushrooms on the top of spaghetti, then pour over remaining soy sauce and extra soy sauce as needed. Cover with aluminum foil, and heat in the oven for 2 - 3 hours. Turn off the oven, and leave for 5 minutes before eating to let cool.

title: Quick Stuffed Fruit Bell Peppers
ingredients: 2 large unpeeled assorted firm fruit ( or 5 baby-breast or 5 firm, peeled, or 5 large, preferably ) | 6 tablespoons capers, drained ( can be purchased from another specialty specialty delicatable like walnut or cannellini ) | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | chopped fresh parsley
instructions: Remove the fruit and slice the center into halves, and set aside. Remove the pulp from the insides of the fruit and discard. Slice the fruit fairly thickly. In a bowl, combine the fruit with 2 tablespoons of capers. Stir the cream of chicken soup into the strained capers and season with salt and pepper. Stuff the remaining capers into the fruit and discard the ends. Arrange the stuffed fruit inside a baking tin and spoon on 1/2 cup of the soup mixture. Sprinkle the remaining 1/4 cup of soup over and top with parsley. Bake at 350°f for 20 to 25 minutes or until the sauce is bubbly and the top is lightly browned.

title: Cheesy Baked Cheddar Dip
ingredients: 1 cup shredded colby-monterey jack cheese | 1 cup shredded cheddar cheese | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh chives
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Lightly grease a medium baking dish. Mix the colby jack cheese with the cheddar cheese, chives, and remaining shredded cheese. Spread into the prepared baking dish. Bake for 20 minutes in the preheated oven, or until bubbly and lightly browned.

instructions: In a saucepan cook onion with 2 tablespoons water over low heat until tender and golden, 7 - 10 minutes. With a spoon drain onion.

title: Plum Tomato Mushroom Dip

instructions: Mix together ingredients and use to top or side salads, such as crostini or ravioli, or into your homemade garlic breadsticks or croutons.

title: Italian Roasted Sausages

instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Combine pine nuts and 1/4 cup of water in a glass bowl. Dip sausages into the nuts, allowing excess to drip off. Place sausages on a parchment lined baking sheet and bake in the preheated oven until the internal temperature of the sausages measures 160 degrees, about 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: celery rib,red onion,honeydew melon,blueberry,salt substitute,cornstarch,sea salt,chicken bouillon cube
title: Honeydew, Blueberry, Red Onion, and Cornish Applesauce
ingredients: 4 ounces honeydew melon, diced | 1 red onion, diced | 1 celery rib, diced | 1/2 cup blueberries | 1 can low salt chicken bouillon cubes | 8 tablespoons cornstarch | 1/4 teaspoon sea salt | 1/4 cup light cornstarch | 1/4 cup red onion, diced
instructions: Place all ingredients in a large covered blender container and puree until smooth. Cover and refrigerate. Drain vegetables and rinse before using. Enjoy.

title: Onion Rings in Oil

instructions: Line rimmed baking sheet with foil. In small bowl, stir together onion rings, oil, and salt. Spread the rings evenly on the baking sheet. Bake in 450 degrees f oven until dark golden brown, about 20 minutes.

title: Fiesta Frozen Ricotta With Guacamole
ingredients: 1 cup frozen corn, thawed | 1 cup guacamole | 1/2 cup fresh grape juice ( or fresh squeezed lime juice ) | 1 tablespoon fresh lemon juice | 1/4 cup ricotta cheese
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a container and refrigerate. Serve with tortilla chips or fresh vegetables of your choice.

title: Cashew Delight
ingredients: 2 lbs meat | 1 cup cashews | 1 cup golden raisin | oil ( for frying )
instructions: Soak the cashews and raisins in warm water for 20 minutes. Add cashew raisins, cashew nuts and meat. Heat frying oil and fry the meat till both sides are golden brown. Serve and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: strawberry jam,graham cracker,mace,spaghetti,fennel seed,baby spinach,baby corn
title: Spinach & Fresh Strawberry Jam Strata
ingredients: 8 ounces spaghetti, uncooked | 1 tablespoon fennel seed, crushed | 1/2 teaspoon mace, ground | 1 1/2 cups strawberry jam | 2 1/2 cups fresh baby corn, kernels | 5 cups baby spinach | 2 cups fresh strawberries, sliced
instructions: Cook spaghetti according to package directions, drain. Meanwhile, in small skillet combine fennel and mace. Stir in jam. Cook over medium heat 3 minutes or until melted. Add corn, spinach and reserved tomato. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat.

title: Easy Microwave Chicken Provolone
ingredients: 1 chicken bouillon cube | 1/2 cup part-skim mozzarella cheese, shredded
instructions: Place chicken bouillon cube, approximately 1 cup of cheese and 1/4 cup of cooking liquid in microwave container. Microwave on high for about 45 seconds, stirring every 2 minutes. Remove lid. Microwave for 30 seconds more, shaking container. Repeat twice more while shaking container, to ensure even cooking. Spoon 1/4 cup of cheese onto a piece of wax paper, top with 2 pieces of chicken breast, then press cheese down the center, leaving a 1 1/2 inch space between pieces of chicken, and continue with steps 3 - 5 until chicken is fully cooked, and cheese is melted, about 3 - 5 minutes more. This should serve 2 people as an appetizer, or 2 as a side dish.

title: Homemade Beef Seasoning
ingredients: 4 teaspoons garlic salt | 2 teaspoons mustard powder | 2 tablespoons hot pepper sauce
instructions: Combine the salt, mustard, and pepper sauce. Store in an airtight container in a cool, dry place.

title: Homemade Pasta
ingredients: 2 cups all-purpose flour, plus extra for dusting | 4 cups sunflower oil ( or sunflower oil for deep frying )
instructions: If not using a thermometer, take a small, shallow hole in the flour.. If one does not, then sift 1/2 cup flour into a bowl with a little extra flour. Dip the s dente flour into the sunflower oil. Dust a clean surface with some flour and make a test dent. Drop into the oil and fry until golden.

title: Easy Homemade Greek Pork Skillet
ingredients: 2 lbs of pork loin, cut bite size | 1 head of mixed veggies, cut bite size | 1 can of sliced greek olives, cut thick | 3 cans stewed italian tomatoes- drained in juice | 1/4 cup white wine vinegar | 1/4 cup greek style olives, chopped fine | 1/2 cup plain greek yogurt, plain or | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil or 1 tablespoon olive oil ( optional )
instructions: In large pot add the veggies, pork, tomatoes and wine vinegar. Cook 15 to 20 minutes on med low heat, stirring every so often, let meat stand covered for 15 minutes. title: Brothy Pleats

instructions: Bring broth to boil in an 8 or 10 inch frying pan. Add margarine. Put mixture on lowest heat until melted and mixture is hot but not boiling, 1 to 2 minutes.

title: Wild Rice Crackers
ingredients: 1 package yellow cornmeal | 1 package wild rice, or any flavor
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Mix the cornmeal and wild rice thoroughly and stir together. Place a layer of rice on a baking sheet. Lightly spray the entire top layer with cooking spray and sprinkle with a pinch of salt and pepper. Spread a layer of the wild rice mixture across the rice. Repeat with another layer of rice and the final layer of rice. Bake for 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until the center has been lightly brown.

title: Easy Chocolate Shortbread II
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups all-purpose flour, divided | 1/2 teaspoon unsweetened cocoa powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Move one 11x7 inch baking sheet in the oven. Whisk 1 1/2 cups flour, cocoa powder, and 1 1/2 cup flour in a bowl until batter is smooth. Stir batter with a rubber spatula to combine and spread the batter evenly in the prepared pans. Using a knife, prick the top of the batter, tilting the pan to spread evenly. Cut crumbs into squares with a 2 inch biscuit cutter. Place on the prepared baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until crisp, about 20 minutes. Let cool on wire rack.

title: Taco Con Frijoles or Con
ingredients: 1 can red enchilada sauce | 1 can kidney beans | 1 1/2 teaspoons mixed italian herbs
instructions: Combine the enchilada sauce and beans in a 9 inch glass baking dish. Add the herbs and cheese.. Stir to combine. Bake at 300°f for 40 minutes. Cut into wedges. Serve with rice or tortillas. Servings are estimated.

title: Egg and soya sauce soup
ingredients: 4 hard-boiled eggs, peeled | 1/3 liter vegetable broth ( or water ) | 1 teaspoon soya sauce
instructions: Slice 4 eggs into 4 pieces. Heat oil in a pan on medium high heat. In a bowl, combine the soy sauce and soya sauce. Add the eggs to the pan and gently stir them. Fry for one minute or two, stirring constantly. Add the broth. Cover and cook on a low heat for 20 minutes depending on your taste.

Random Ingredients: puff pastry,coffee liqueur,egg yolk,splenda sugar substitute
title: Coffee Vanilla Sables (No Eggs)
ingredients: 1 package frozen puff pastry | 1 tablespoon splenda sugar substitute | 1/3 cup coffee liqueur | 1 egg yolk
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°. In small bowl, mix together splenda and coffee liqueur, blending well. Wash and unfold puff pastry sheets to make flat strips about 1/4 wide. Coat with splenda/splenda mixture and place in ungreased 10x15 inch baking pan. Cover with half the coffee mixture. Repeat layers with remaining pastry mixture, making 5 sheets each. Bake for 18 minutes or until pastry is golden and puffed.

title: Green Lentil Salad With Lemon Vinaigrette (Porotos Granados)
ingredients: 200 g green lentils | 200 g maraschino cherries | 200 g maraschino cherries
instructions: Boil the lentils for 10 minutes, remove the pan from the heat and stir to remove any debris. Place the lentils in a pot and cover with cold water. Bring to the boil, then remove from heat. Allow to rest for 15 minutes. Drain the lentils and set aside to cool for 5 minutes. Remove the cherries from the stalks and finely chop. Combine the lentils and cherries in a salad bowl. Pour the vinaigrette over and gently toss to combine. Chill, then serve.

Random Ingredients: american cheese,catsup,pecan,chicken stock cube,chicken bouillon powder,chicken bouillon
title: Chicken Cheeseburger American Style
ingredients: 500 g chicken wings ( i used chicken breasts, but any cut can be used ) | 2 tablespoons chicken bouillon ( i've used instant granules, powder. my brother doesn't like this, but adds more flavour ) | 50 g american cheese | 1 tablespoon chicken bouillon powder ( i've also seen chicken bouillon powder, which helps to moisten the meat while freezing ) | 1 tablespoon catsup ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon chicken bouillon powder ( i've also seen chicken bouillon powder, which helps to moisten the meat while freezing ) | 1/2 cup pecans ( optional )
instructions: Slice the chicken in half and then cut each half into four even pieces. Put the chicken, garlic cloves, bouillon, cheese and nuts into the bowl and mix with your hands until everything is coated with the sauce. Marinate your steak for at least an hour in the fridge. After that, fry them on both sides in a little oil until they become crispy and the cheese has melted completely. Serve with rice and salad or fresh bread.

title: Curried Creamy Chilled Cheese

instructions: Heat the vegetable broth in a medium saucepan. Add the curry powder, saffron, and black cardamon pods to the pan. Simmer for about 5 minutes over medium heat, stirring often. Stir in the cottage cheese until melted. Remove from the heat and fold the chocolate into the cheese mixture. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for several hours or until set. Cut into cubes.

Random Ingredients: rice noodle,red pepper flake,beer,fast rising yeast,riesling wine,mango chutney,cayenne powder,shortcrust pastry
title: The Singles and the Riesling
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb fast rising yeast | 1/2 cup beer | 2 tablespoons shortcrust pastry ( such as crisco ) | 1 cup riesling wine or 1 cup other good drinking wine | 1 1/2 tablespoons red pepper flakes | 1 tablespoon cayenne powder | 3 tablespoons mango chutney | 3/4 lb rice noodles ( i use the thin ones # 452941 & # 430802, but if you can't find these, use another favorite bibb if you have them, i've used penzey's )
instructions: In a medium sized pot with just a little water, sprinkle the yeast over the 1/2 cup and let sit for 5 minutes. In a large mixing bowl, combine all the wine, beer, red pepper flakes, cayenne powder and mango chutney. Heat the wine mixture over medium heat, and stir until well dissolved and almost boiling. Set aside to cool to lukewarm. Place 2 sheets of plastic wrap on your countertop or kitchen counter, and a cookie sheet. Drape the sheets of plastic wrap over the plastic, and using a rolling pin, roll a few times to roll out the dough as thin as your finger can stand. If you use thin shortcrust pastry, cut it into 24 rounds, then cut each round in half. Working with one round at a time, place a rounded tablespoon of dough in the middle, and put one palm full of the mixture on the dough. Bring all the sides of the dough towards the middle, and fold over the filling, and pinch the edges well to seal. Repeat with the remaining rounds and filling. When all the dough has been folded over, place on your baking sheet, cover with plastic wrap, and let sit in a warm place for two hours. When well rested, preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Bake for 40 - 50 minutes. Allow to sit for 10 minutes before removing. After five minutes, brush top of dough with any remaining melted butter or margarine, and serve with chutney.

title: Frenchy Taters Salad
ingredients: 1 bag french dressing | 2 teaspoons chinese five spice powder | 1 teaspoon taco sauce | 1 pint cherry tomatoes
instructions: Mix all ingredients & pour over bread or party. Serve immediatley.

title: Mexican Lamb Stew
ingredients: 1 pound lean lamb, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 can green enchilada sauce, divided | 2 cans tomato paste | 1 small head cabbage, shredded | 2 large fresh red chile peppers, cut into rings | 3 tablespoons kosher salt | salt and pepper to taste
instructions: Place half of the enchilada sauce in a medium saucepan over medium high heat. Place the lamb in the saucepan, and cook and stir until evenly browned on all sides. Set aside. Place the remaining enchilada sauce ingredients in a large pot over medium heat.

title: Baked Cinnamon-Garlic French Fries With Shrimp

instructions: Preheat oven to 300 f. Grease large, shallow baking pan. Trim the shrimp. Wash the bananas under warm running water and remove the peel. Cut into 1 inch pieces and place in medium sized bowl. Juice half to save. Add 2 tablespoons brandy to shrimp and toss. Dredge shrimp in cinnamon and baking powder and set aside. Place in the oven, immediately lower the heat and bake for about 30 minutes. Do not open the oven until the 30 minutes are up. Remove from oven, sprinkle the cinnamon flakes over the dish of fries and serve immediately.

title: Jamaican Spice Blend

instructions: Mix all the ingredients in a clean spice grinder or mortar. Cover and store in an airtight jar.

title: Pineapple Sunrise
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 1 1/2 tablespoons coconut milk or 1 1/2 tablespoons pineapple juice | 1 teaspoon coriander powder | 2 tablespoons ice water | 1 pineapple, peeled and sliced
instructions: Put the sesame oil into a bowl stir in 3/4 cup of coconut milk/pineapple juice and the coriander powder and stir well to coat well with oil mixture. Add the remaining coconut milk/pineapple juice. Mix well and remove from the heat. Put the pineapple slices in the bowl with the spice mixture. Serve immediately.

title: Crock Pot Beef Tips
ingredients: 1 can beef broth, beef flavored broth
instructions: Pour broth into crock pot. Cook on high for 4 hours. Strain beef tips. Mash beef tips with potato masher. If desired, stir in a dab of sour cream.

Random Ingredients: macaroni,chili oil,pine nut,yellow onion,head broccoli,wine,lemon wedge
title: Macaroni, Broccoli & Pine Nuts (Veggies)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups macaroni, medium size, uncooked | 3 cups baby broccoli cuts, trimmed & broken into florets | 1 small yellow onion, halved, thinly sliced | 2 cups diced raw carrots or 1 cup broccoli, medium julienne cut | 2 teaspoons lemon wedges | 1 teaspoon chili oil | 2/3 cup dry white wine ( optional )
instructions: Cook pasta according to package instructions. Meanwhile, cook vegetables according to package directions. Drain pasta & rinse in cold water. Drain macaroni. Place pasta mixture in bowl & toss with macaroni & pasta mix. Serve warm or chilled. Garnish with lemon wedges, chopped parsley & chili oil.

Random Ingredients: extra virgin olive oil,thyme leave,courgette,thai red chili pepper,beef bouillon,shiitake mushroom,bread flour
title: Crusty Mushroom Braid
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups bread flour | 1/4 teaspoon thyme leave | extra virgin olive oil | 4 sheets good crusty bread ( thick & cut into 1 cm slices ) | 500 g shiitake mushrooms or 500 g white button mushrooms | 1 small red chili pepper, deseeded and finely chopped ( or use a combination of chilli, dried chillies ) | 1 teaspoon beef bouillon with 2 tsp. sugar
instructions: Preheat grill to high. Lightly oil the grill grates, or place rack 6 - 7 inches from heat source. In a bowl, whisk together the flour, thyme, olive oil and a pinch of salt. Working from the center out, press the bread into the bowl to moisten it. Transfer to a work surface and place the bread around the side of the bowl to flatten into a rectangle slightly bigger than your ramekins, about 16 x 12 inches. Transfer to a baking sheet lined with foil and refrigerate until ready to use. Heat a grill pan or a large heavy skillet over a moderate heat. Brush the mushrooms with oil and season with salt. When the pan is very hot, cook the mushrooms for 4 - 5 minutes, till they start to soften, then remove and set aside. Grill the chilie pepper under the grill, with another pinch of salt until lightly charred, then remove and leave. In a mixing bowl, combine the beef sauce with the dried chilli, the stock powder and sugar. Stir to mix well and set aside. Place the braid in the oven for 8 - 10 minutes until golden. Serve warm.

title: Crunchy Nori Onigiri
ingredients: 6 thin slices italian bread | 2 tablespoons whole wheat flour | 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 1/4 cup toasted chopped pecans | 1 sheet nori ( dry seaweed )
instructions: Soak sushi rolling mat. Remove crusts from nori. Cut nori in half lengthwise, then cut to 1/4 inch sections. Soak bread in water to cover for 15 minutes. Drain water. Soak at room temperature 30 minutes. Stir flour, cinnamon, and nuts together. Place a layer of Nori in plastic bag. Sprinkle 1/3 of mixture on bottom of bag. Top with another layer of nori. Fold the nori over the filling to form a triangle. Repeat process with remaining nori nori. Cut nori into 6 wedges.

title: Spicy Spanish Onion Mac and Cheese
ingredients: 2 bunches fresh dill | 6 fresh spanish onions | 4 cubanelle peppers ( roasted, peeled, seeded and sliced vertically ) | 1 package pre-made penne | 1 can capers | freshly shucked capers | fresh cracked peppermint leaves or fresh parsley ( to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Boil water to cover 2 onions and 2 bell peppers in rapidly boiling salted water until crisp, 45 to 55 minutes. Drain and rinse in cold water.

Random Ingredients: tawny port,egg yolk,sharp cheddar cheese,salmon fillet,egg noodle,canola oil
title: Salmon and Noodles
ingredients: 2 cups egg noodles | 1/4 cup tawny port or 1/4 cup port wine ( 2 small port-packed portages ) | 2 egg yolks | 1/2 cup canola oil | 1 lb salmon fillet, cut lengthwise into 3 pieces ( about 12oz. ) | 1/2 cup sharp cheddar cheese, grated plus | 1/2 cup shredded sharp cheddar cheese
instructions: Bring large pot of water to boil. Meanwhile, cook noodles until just tender, about 2 minutes less than package directions say. Drain. Toss with port. Cool completely. Beat yolks and 1/2 cup oil in large shallow dish. Dip salmon in egg mixture and arrange in single layer in shallow dish. Cover and chill for about 1 hour. Sprinkle salmon with cheese. Drain noodles. Cover loosely with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 20 minutes or up to 4 hours.

title: Spanish Green Salad
ingredients: 1 cup sour cream or 1 cup mayonnaise | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 3/4 cup green olives, sliced in half ( or use a mixture of the two ) | 1/2 cup fresh orange liqueur or 1/2 cup cognac | 2 -3 radishes, sliced thin | 1/3 teaspoon dried marjoram or 1/3 teaspoon oregano | 4 medium radishes, finely chopped ( or 2 scallion or 1/2-3/4 tsp basil ) | 6 -8 large radishes, peeled and cut in thin long strips | 6 -8 large green olives, slices in brine or 6 -8 large green olives, slices in brine
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine sour cream and mayonnaise. Mix in mushroom soup, 1/4 cup sliced olives or scallions, 1/2 cup orange liqueur or cognac, 1 tsp dried marjoram or oregano, and radishes. Line a baking sheet with foil and place whole radishes on top. Cover and chill for 30 minutes to 1 hour. Unwrap shredded radishes and slice thinly in half. Divide mixture into 4 servings. For presentation, sprinkle each serving with reserved radish slices and sliced green olives. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast,chili paste,chili pepper flake,milk chocolate chip,pepper ring,yukon gold potato,garam masala powder
title: Malai Lati (Potatoes & Pepper Rounds)
ingredients: 6 yukon gold potatoes, boiled | 1 tablespoon chili paste | 6 cloves garlic, crushed | 3 chicken breasts, cooked and finely chopped. | 1 teaspoon chili pepper flakes | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala powder | 3 tablespoons milk chocolate chips
instructions: Place potatoes in a medium size saucepan, pour in chicken drippings. Turn heat to high. Turn heat down to medium. Cover and simmer for 20 minutes. Place chilies, garlic, chili flakes, and garam masala powder together in a bowl. Sprinkle over potatoes. Turning over occasionally for 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Place chocolate chips in serving dish and top with potato mixture. Serve.

title: Quick 'n' Spicy Broiled Vegetables
ingredients: 3 medium courgettes, sliced | 150 g cashews | 120 g roasted sweet pimientos
instructions: Place the cashewnuts and sweet peppers into a non stick pan over medium heat, tossing every now and then. When the cashews have started to turn to golden brown, remove them from the heat. Spray a large, non stick frying pan with olive oil spray. Add the courgettes and saute for 5 minutes over medium high heat. Add the cashews, sweet pepper slices, and smoked paprika.

Random Ingredients: wine,hazelnut,rice noodle,passion fruit,oyster,parsley flake,pasta shell,vanilla essence
title: Tropical Pasta Salad Noodle Soup
ingredients: 150 g whole grain rice noodles | 200 g pasta shells | 2 ripe small passion fruit | 2/3 cup hazelnuts | 1 jar sweet wine ( or other dry white wine ) | 1 tablespoon vanilla essence | 1 tablespoon dried coriander plus 1 tablespoon dried parsley flakes | 2 tablespoons dried sweetcorn kernels or 2 tablespoons frozen mixed fruit pulp ( optional )
instructions: Boil water for rice noodles. Drain noodles and allow to cool a little. Rinse with warm water and set aside. Meanwhile, peel the seeds from the passionfruit and cut into small pieces. Cut the passionfruit into strips and then cut each strip lengthways so that it can be seen through. In a small bowl mix together the hazelnuts, sweet wine, vanilla essence and coriander. Add rice noodles and toss to coat well. Transfer the noodle bowls to a roasting tin or tray and add a layer of noodles. Toss the pesto sauce ingredients through to coat. Sprinkle top with a little hazelnut flakes and bake at 220°c for 30 minutes. Remove from oven and let cool slightly. Sprinkle with remaining nuts if using. Serve with a dollop of creamy pesto.

Random Ingredients: tamari,italian turkey sausage link,chicken broth,pineapple juice,vegetable broth,self raising flour
title: Italian Sausage Loaf-Ups
ingredients: 6 -10 italian turkey sausage links | 1 cup vegetable broth | 1/4 cup tamari | 1/4 cup chicken broth | 1 cup self-raising flour | 1/2 cup pineapple juice
instructions: Place hot sausages in a large roasting pan. Pour broth over it being careful not to rinse out all the fat from pan. Make sure that the pan is very clean of sausage grease. In a small bowl, combine tamari, chicken broth and flour until flour is mixed well. Spread flour mixture evenly over the sausages and bake in a moderate oven for 50 to 60 minutes or until golden brown. Remove from oven and serve with your choice of accompaniments.

Random Ingredients: ziti pasta,rice noodle,steak,salt black pepper,hard egg,walnut half
title: Vietnamese Beef & Noodles
ingredients: 1 lb flank steak, thinnly sliced and cut crosswise into 1/2-inch slices | 1 package ziti pasta or ( 11 ounce ) package penne pasta, uncooked | 4 hard-boiled eggs, sliced | 1/2 cup chopped walnut halves | salt & freshly ground black pepper | 1 - 1 1/4 cup dry rice noodles or 1 -1 1/4 cup vermicelli, broken into 3 even sections
instructions: In a large pot of boiling water, cook ziti until just tender, 13 minutes or according to package directions. Drain pasta and transfer to a bowl. Toss with the steak and set aside. Preheat the broiler. Spray a broiling pan or large lidded metal saucepan with non stick spray.

title: Fluffy Granola
ingredients: 1 cup granola cereal, granules | 3 green cardamom pods, split | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground turmeric
instructions: Boil granola and cardamom pods in a large pot of water until a candy thermometer reaches 250 degrees f, about 1 minute. Drain and allow to cool. Grind granola and cardamom pods to a coarse powder.
